text: Our family returned for breakfast again this weekend and the food and service was again impeccable ... Highly recommend
Three stars not because of food, the food is good but, the service is slow. I think they need 1 or 2 more people up front when placing an order if your waiting and not using the kiosk to order.
Great food and friendly service. I will definitely be back. Menu variety is great.  I had the Monte Cristo crepes, absolutely amazing

Ordered an iced mocha  and an iced white chocolate mocha and they were both was awful.  They  had NO coffee flavor or chocolate flavor at all, very watered down.  Even went back and asked the girl to add another shot and why.  I think she remade them, instead of just adding another shot.  Still had NO flavor.  Not even sure how you could make it that bad.  We both ended up throwing them away on the way out.  So sad, not even worth drinking.

First time for lunch.  Extensive and flavorful gluten free menu.  

Good lunch and friendly service.

Overpriced and underwhelming.  Had the sausage/egg:cheese sandwich this morning on whole grain $4.89. Sausage was cold and the sandwich was about 1/2 the size of the picture on the menu. It comes on these large plates and it's just a embarrassing.  Husband had bacon/egg/cheese on brioche, $4.89 and his egg was cold and the entire sandwich was greasy.   I can get this kind of food at McDonalds for a fraction of the price.

I just recently moved to Idaho and today I went to Chipotle and she comped me one meal (out of 3) and it made my week let alone my day lol. She was so nice to start with and had the best customer service! She definitely stood out in the staff, her name was Taylor. She's absolutely awesome!

Went to this Taco Bell last night.  It was 1 30 and it said 30 minutes to close.  All the lights were on.  We backed up and forward twice and no one would wait on us.  We gave up and pulled up young man was at window closing  register.  Taco Bell was happy to serve us.

Definitely dug this place...rather hipster-ish and way, way reminiscent of Este Sugarhouse in Salt Lake, but I liked it a lot despite all that...pizza here is definitely a lot better, as is beer selection. This may wind up being one of my more regular haunts as I slog my way through more of their menu (I think I may need to heavily modify next time I'm there), but so far, I have no cause at all for complaint and much to celebrate. It's interesting to me that the environments of the various locations are different, sometimes vastly, yet all have their own unique and innate charm. Whoever is running these is doing a phenomenal job, so props there.

One thing of note here...the ordering system is extremely clunky and seemingly disorganized and I sort of dislike it. Not enough to stop coming here, since I really dig the vibe of these, but on one of my less patient nights, that sort of thing may be enough to cut this out of the running. Definitely a good spot for pizza and a brew (or several), though. I back it.

I came from out of state to attend an annual New Years party at my in-laws. This year theme was "prom". I asked the ladies to make me a corsage and boutonnière for my wife and I, and I asked them to make sure it was fun, large, not your typical classy and clean but loud and obnoxious due to the style of the party. I let them have their way and these ladies NAILED it! Thank you!!

The Lucky Perk is a pretty cool place to meet with friends or clients. I've been here a few times and always get good coffee and an inviting atmosphere. The only thing I didn't care for was the sausage burrito. It was hot but 99% potatoes and a 1% sausage. Not worth the money. Other than that, it's a cool place and I'll go back.

This place was soooo good. I went for breakfast because my sister who lives here did it's the best place to go for breakfast. I ordered the country Benedict and it was awesome! I also had a pancake and that was delicious. I love brunch and breakfast food so this place hit the spot for sure! 

It's a little loud cause it's very open and has a cement floor so it echos a bit. 

Food is great, service was great no complaints!
We hired Minuteman to re-key our new home as well as add deadbolts as needed.  They were prompt, courteous, and friendly.  We will definitely use Minuteman in the future. (Meridian, ID)

Okay so I've spent the last year traveling between California and meridian for a long distance relationship and I'm a huge breakfast junkie. My boyfriend brought me the express cafe( which we call cafe express lol) because I LOVE eggs Benny. This place is amazing! I've had eggs Benedict at many places, it's my go to and this place doesn't disappoint. Beware they do not take reservations and the wait can be pretty long but it's sooooo worth it. I'm finally in Idaho full time and ecstatic I get to eat here every week.

New to the area and needed some freshening up with a trim and layers.  Wanted a curly look for the night also.  Saw reviews of Megan but was afraid if I asked for her she would be booked.  Luckily when I called they offered me Megan so I grabbed it.  
So glad I did!  Megan did exactly what I wanted, curled my hair, told me what she was doing the whole way, and was great to talk to.  Megan is my kind of people ;)  Very happy to have found my new stylist!!!  YES!!!

Terrible terrible terrible. Out of 6 meals we ordered to go, 5 had to be thrown away. We were missing half the components that were supposed to be part of the meal (no buns for our burgers, no fries that were supposed to come with it) items which were described as vegetarian came with bacon, it was just a major fail all the way around. The few components that we did try were completely flavorless. We will never go back or order from here again. Waste of time and money as I then had to go home make make dinner.

What a great find in Meridian! I walked in and was greeted instantly! The customer service was amazing. They helped me pick out just the right things! Can't wait to go back again! Will be my new go to boutique for clothes and gifts!

Visited at breakfast time and liked having the coffee pot at the table.  Have eaten at the Plano, Tx location also.  LePeep is consistently fresh and offers a broad range of menu options.   Will definitely be back again.

This just became my go-to breakfast spot in the valley.  

Truly.

First bit of fabulousness:  Upon being seated, I ordered coffee.  To which, my server responded, "Sure...we have a house roast, dark roast, or a vanilla flavored?"

Are you kidding me?  A breakfast place with coffee OPTIONS?  And, one of those options is DARK roast?  Color me caffeinated.  I promptly ordered their dark roast which came poured out of a carafe left at the table.  Plus, they have flavored creamer (bonus!).  This was definitely not your usual (awful) diner coffee.  It was dark and delicious.

Fortunately, my dining companions were familiar with the menu and HIGHLY recommended the Salmon Eggs Benedict.  Always a fan of anything including hollandaise sauce--I went for it.  My people!  Perfection.  Here's the thing, when you smother something in hollandaise, you can easily be lazy in the preparation of what comes UNDERNEATH the hollandaise.  I mean, it's going to be smothered in all that lovely, buttery deliciousness--who will notice?  I will notice, people.  I will.  And, there was definitely nothing lackadaisical about the preparation of this dish.  The salmon, even without the hollandaise, was moist and flavorful.  The eggs were perfectly, beautifully, delicately poached.  It was the single best Salmon Benedict I've ever consumed (possibly the best Eggs Benedict in general!).  

The Benedict came with a side of home fried potatoes, which had a light peppery flavor that I quite enjoyed.  The service was spot on--prompt, attentive, and friendly.

One final note I have is the menu:  The menu is expansive.  If you have family and/or friends in town with diverse tastes--this is a wonderful option for breakfast.  They have all your classic selections covered (bacon & eggs, chicken fried steak, various scrambles).  They have the sweet (pancakes, stuffed french toast, waffles, crepes).  And, they've got your savory (An entire list of various Benedicts, skillets, and classic to creative omelets).  I can't imagine anyone NOT finding something they'd enjoy.

Plus, I was informed they have an entire gluten free menu.  Not merely the slight modification of items on their regular menu--but an entire menu of creative gluten free options.

Get to it!
Absolutely horrible service, cold soup and my salad was drenched in dressing. The iceberg lettece was browning, soggy and pickled.  This place should not even get 1 star.

I was super excited to try this place as I love soup salad sandwich places. I wasn't disappointed in the taste of food, what I had (broth bowl and half a turkey sandwich) was really good, but holy smokes was it expensive!!!! For what my husband and I got (he got chicken noodle soup and a sandwich) it was a little over $30!! I feel for this price the portions should be bigger than what they were. Good food yes but pretty pricy for what you get.

I enjoyed their Chorizo Omelette its nice to find a place around here that server Mexican Chorizo so that excited me.  The restaurant  was fairly priced and the food was average. I would have given them 3 stars based off of that but where they make up for ok food they give you HUGE portions.  My daughter had a kids Hamburger that was the same size as the burgers off the regular menu, my omerette was half the size of the plate. My wifes French Dip was missing a horseradish sauce and ended up being just a typical roast beef , the au jus was pre-made so that was disappointing. Im really interested to try some of their other dishes to try and see where they excel. We will definitely be going back

Stopped in for a friend's birthday on 8-17-2015. Natalie was our server and she was delightful. She greeted put party as soon as we walked on the door with a wonderful smile and a great attitude. She seated us a couple tables right away and went over the menu and specials they offered that day. My wife was undecided about what beer to have so Natalie was great and brought out several tasters for my wife to try, it was a big help.  She made sure that everyone had full drink,  and took a accurate order from us. The food was well prepared and tasted great.  I had the boneless sticky fingers with the original buffalo sauce and they rocked. The steaks fries where awesome,  cooked perfectly,  was very happy with my dish. The service was outstanding,  very professional and attentive to out party. The only thing I would change would the price of food,  seemed a little high. Other than that,  was a fantastic experience. Thank you Natalie for great service,  you are the best.

My Samsung 650 TV would not turn on. The red light in the front panel just goes on and off. I call Caden. First they charged $40.00 to come over to look at. Then he wrote a bill for $410.00 for repair. I guess I  look old and dumb, but he seems to be sincere. So I let him do the work. Next day, he said he had fixed the problem and will bring over. The TV came back and he gave me a 6 months warranty. I did some research on this problem and found out it is only the capacity problem. And it is relatively cheap to fix. The maximum will cost you for less than $180.00. So, watch out for Caden to sock to you. Call other first before you call him.

This was my second visit to Deja Brew - the first time ( which I didn't review) was an enjoyable dinner while being entertained by Katie G and the Half Macs (they were excellent, by the way). At that visit I had the Grilled Chicken Caesar Salad and two glasses of wonderful Cabernet Sauvignon. Service was great, ambiance superb!

This morning we tried Deja for breakfast. Service was different - we had to stand in line to order - one person on cash register, one making coffee, one delivering meals to tables and it appeared only one person in the kitchen. It seemed to me to be a slow and clunky way to do breakfast. After we ordered we were given a table number thing, which to our surprise, didn't mean drinks were delivered - they were called out from behind the coffee bar (noisy atmosphere and senior hearing doesn't make this a good system). My wife ordered a heated cinnamon roll and a side of bacon - she declared the bacon excellent, but the roll was delivered cold (she's too polite to send it back)! I ordered the Cheese & Bacon Grits. I love grits and have always eaten them "creamy", it seems Deja serves them baked - that was a surprise but even more surprising was that they were very good! Yes, said, very good.

Overall, I would give the evening meal and service 5 stars and the breakfast 3. Except for the cold cinnamon roll all the food was very good and wait staff polite.

I LOVE this place! If you are looking for a quick adjustment without all of the unnecessary chatter about supplements and yoga then this is the place. I was in and out in ten minutes and I felt amazing. I had all of my questions answered and felt well taken care of plus it is super affordable.

I have gone here now a few times and have been overall very happy with my hair cuts... I have a very short pixie cut that was started by my usual hair dresser. Unfortunately she moved to a different state and it has been so difficult finding another stylist like her. I have gone to so many different salons and have paid more money than I normally would just to find someone who can cut my hair the way I want it. Well I happened to stop here one day just because I needed my hair cut and had no other ideas. It turned out great!! I was so happy to finally have my hair cut correctly! Melanie and Shelly have both done my hair and I'm very happy with how both of them have done my hair. I haven't tried anyone else at this salon but it seems like everyone is very happy with their hair cuts. The price is great and the stylists are friendly :)

Food was ok. Nothing special.
Ordered the fondue as a starter  and the "vegetables" noted on the menu was one vegetable.....be warned. We got brussels and bread. Cheese was ok.
We ordered a burger and turkey sandwich. Both orders arrived with cold fries. Note, this is a Sunday evening around 6:30. Very light. No reason for cold food.
We received our alcohol very quick given that we sat in the bar.....that was all we got from service. Our waitress also worked as the bartender.......not a good combo. She never checked on us and the check took forever.....but sadly it was a Sunday and it was quiet. 
If you sit in the bar, get an employee not working as the bartender. 
We were so hopeful as we love to support local. 
Keep your expectations low and all will be great as this place is nothing different or special.
Love this place! The owner and staff are friendly and fun, and the food is excellent. I'm from California, but visit Meridian often, and I'm definitely going to be back!
Was in town for work and I was really out of line. Called this place, walked in and got adjusted really quick. I'm a stickler for convenience and that it was!!!!
Great setting with a nice beer selection. Food is over priced and not an outstanding quality. Service was really great!

"The best Eggs Benedict I can remember ever eating."
OK, it was a lovely morning in Boise,  sunshiny and people enjoying the patio and the spacious bright inside restaurant.  The staff was very attentive and pleasant... like they were actually glad we were there.  From my view... this was a wonderful breakfast experience.

Review update!
What a difference a few months makes ! The place was packed on a Saturday morning. 

The hostesses did a great job, we only had about a ten minute wait for our table, and when seated we were greeted by our waiter and offered drinks promptly! Yay!! Much better! 

 Whole experience went smooth this time. Our waiter was friendly and on point, food came out warm, correct, and all at the same time.
All 5 of us each ordered an 18 wheeler(awesome deal for $9ish bucks) and ate it with no complaints! Love their regular French toast. We all had a pleasant time and were in and out in about an hour :)

Good job Le Peep :)

The place was clean, smelled great had fast service and the food was excellent. They have a massive beer selection. I tried gnocchi and had a few bites of the bison burger. We also had the jalapeño popper egg rolls for the app. All were great. I will def go here again. And our waiter, Christian, was the best. Very helpful and knowledgable about all the food and drinks.

My sister, my great niece were at the Village and thought we'd give Cinnaholic's a try. I sure am glad we bought the mini cinnamon rolls but wish we hadn't bought any. The bread in the cinnamon rolls was dry (either cooked too long or stale), there was hardly any cinnamon filling and the toppings were horrible. Mine was supposed to be a standard cream cheese topping but it didn't taste like there was any cream cheese in it.  Maybe they gave me the wrong topping because it tastes like coconut. My sister got maple flavored which she did not like.  The 6 year old ate her cotton candy frosting but we did not like it.  To say the least, we scraped off all the toppings and still didn't eat all of the rolls. Perhaps this was a fluke but I seriously doubt we will come back to find out. Sorry.  I don't like writing bad reviews.

Had to use Glass Doctor twice, in shop and call out, both times work was done professionally, quick and to total satisfaction. What makes it great, on time, great people, and happy customer. Thank you!

Good pizza/Bad service
I'm new in town and decided to order some pizza for delivery while we unpack. 
Not knowing where to get the best slice around, I turned to Yelp to read reviews. 
Common theme with this place was while the pizza was good, the service was not so good. 
Took a shot and right out of the gate experienced the poor customer service. 
With my pizza I ordered something called "monkey bread". The menu online only lists one kind of "monkey bread"-garlic and parmesan. 
When the food arrives I open the "monkey bread" and find bread knots with cinnamon and frosting......
So I call back thinking I had mistakenly gotten something from another customer's order. 
Turns out there are two types of "monkey bread" and I ended up with something I didn't want. 
They offered to give us a free "monkey bread" the next time we ordered from them or would give us one now if WE DROVE THERE to pick it up!!!!!
Are you kidding??! I've got hot pizza that you just delivered and I'm supposed to let it get cold driving to your restaurant to fix something you screwed up???!!!
How in the world could we have known there was another kind of "monkey bread" if it's not listed on the menu??!!! 
It was their responsibility to clarify when they took the order. 
Not sure if the owner reads or cares about the reviews online.....
Doesn't seem that way.....
It's a shame because the pizza was pretty good. 
Had they just said "we'll make this right and bring you the garlic and parmesan in a few" they would've had a new long-time customer (and we have three kids so pizza is a staple in our home!). 
Instead I'll be ordering from the competition next time. 
Now I'll be looking for good pizza AND good service from another place because I'm sure not going to find it here.

I was in Boise visiting family and one of my sisters raved about Express Cafe. Even though it was lunch time, I ordered breakfast and it did not disappoint. The pancakes are huge, eggs perfectly cooked, yummy bacon, etc. service was impeccable!! Will definitely return on my next visit.

It'Sugar is a fun new candy store in the Village!   Fill full of all kinds of sweet treats for all ages!  They have hundreds of packaged candy and hundreds of others that are sold by weight. A  Little on the expensive side but what the heck!   The staff was very freindly and very eager to help the ankle bitters!  So just another great reason to check out the Village!

We ordered coffee juice and tea and they didn't bring it.  I never had anyone bring burnt toast.  The toast was black.  They didn't bring syrup with the pancakes.  It was the worst food and service that I had ever experienced.

Easy to get ahold of and things taken care of as a potential tenant... impossible to get things taken care of once papers are signed and they get their money. Very disappointing.

Update. Service just keeps getting worse. Unbelievable.

I really enjoyed the food as did everyone in our party of 7. The prime rib was great. Can tell that the staff/chefs are still working out the kinks (took a while for the food) but the taste and beers were awesome!

For years I've been purchasing my daughters yellow roses for their birthdays; one stem for every year old.  They are17 and 19 now,  so you can imagine how expensive this could get.  I shopped around and found that The Flower Place consistently has the best quality roses and at a much better price than their local competitors. I HIGHLY recommend you check out The Flower Place, first. Don't let the old gas station exterior fool you. You'll be glad you did.
Just a regular Panera Bread but not quite as comfortable as some others I've been to. I love their pasties, bagels, and their Thai salad.

I bought the Groupon massage as well.  When I called, they said they were booked out to the second week of October and my Groupon expires Oct. 2nd.  Not impressed at all.  It sounds like the massage isn't worth it anyways from the review here.

Excellent food and even better people here. Great customer service, ordered the sticky finger wrap and it was amazing. Also a great atmosphere for the family this coupled with affordable food makes it a must stop whenever hungry or travelling.

My husband and I were headed to Chili's, when we noticed that Barrel 55 had just opened, so we decided to give the new place a try. The interior of the restaurant has been transformed from a Mexican restaurant. It was well lit, and quite comfortable. We were their first customers of the day, so no waiting, we were shown directly to a table. We couldn't have asked for better service! Every need we had was met almost before we knew we needed it! 

The menu is a little limited, but we found plenty of dishes that sounded great. We finally settled on the beer cheese fondu and the prime rib sandwich with fries to share between the two of us. The fondu was delicious, served with cubes of bread and roasted Brussel sprouts. The good stout cheese held up to the Brussel sprouts, and was very flavorful. The sandwich was very good, moist flavorful thinly sliced prime rib, covered with caramelized onions and au jus for dipping. I thought the flavor was very good, but the little condiment cup of au jus was way to small to try to dip the sandwich in. We suggested they look at a different container for their au jus. But the fries were wonderful! I don't eat fries often, so I consider them a treat! Barrel 55's fries are real potatoes, well seasoned and cooked just right! My only disappointment was they didn't offer fry sauce to go with them! Our server immediately promised to go make some for me, but alas...the kitchen didn't have any mayo. I'm not sure how they prepare a burger without mayo, but I'm sure I'll find out eventually! 

I have to say, we definitely enjoyed our meal and will go back for the prime rib sandwich, I loved those caramelized onions! Our iced tea glasses never ran dry, and our server was attentive, but not annoying. 

I suggest you give Barrel 55 a try, I hope it will be successful and be around for a long time! It is a welcome change from the big chain restaurants.

I give only one star because that is the lowest possible rating. My experience with Park Place has been one of complete dissatisfaction. Park Place is not looking out for the owners interest, but instead they are looking only to extract money from the owner through their maintenance services. I discovered them installing/proposing to conduct so called maintenance and repairs that were unnecessary and improperly priced when compared to competing contractor services. In addition to that they failed to properly screen my tenants who caused significant damage to the property requiring insurance claims and significant $$ to remedy. Lastly, their accounting and complete lack of internal quality checks coupled with inaccessibility to executive management is infuriating. Landlord beware!!!!

I echo the many complaints filed here about Park Place ID property management and I only rented from them for 4 months and still lost a third of deposit to unreasonable maintenance issues and for filter that I replaced and was less than 30 days old. I was warned they would not give back full refund and left place in better condition than when moved in so not a reputable place to do business with so stay away if possible.

High hopes.. Big let down. Let's start with service. Once seated we waited considerably longer then expected for our server. She was pleasant but admittedly running "very behind". The menu was delightful and the items sounded delicious. I ordered the chicken fried steak. My wife had the tacos. She said they were fine, but she is not into food like I am. Then again how do you mess up tacos? Although, she did admit the filling was far too wet and caused the corn tortilla to fall apart. She was not unhappy and enjoyed her meal. Now on to my dish, the Chicken Fried Steak. Great idea poor delivery. The steak was an oily mess, the English muffin was cold and very obviously not toasted correctly. The scrambled eggs seemed out of a carton. I served in the Navy, and these eggs must have been manufactured at the same place. Now my biggest let down of the meal... The massively hyped potatos.. they were so awful. If I had to guess these were out of a bag and deep fried. At least half tasted like they had sat under a warming light to the point of fossilizing. 
 They were hard dry and way to salty.. 
The check came in at roughly 60 bucks. Not worth the money. Totaly missed the mark.

For those who have never been, allow me to clarify a few things as I wax poetic on the greatness of this pizza and the establishment itself:

1 . This is not a quick "grab and go" pizza. If all you want is a quick fix, either go to some crappy chain, or just call ahead to order and tell them what time you expect to be in. 

2. You seat yourself, and you go to the counter (or the bar) to order. Their staff are often doing multiple tasks at once, so be patient. That being said, these are also the most kind, hilarious, talented, and quirky people in the business. If you treat them politely, they'll take great care of you; if you act like a pushy jack***, you don't belong here anyway. 

3. Yes, it takes time to handcraft a pizza. Unlike the pizza warehouses that shall go unnamed, the Pie staff don't make your pizza until you order it. This means hand-spinning the dough, adding all the toppings (which are fresh and delicious, may I say), and baking it. 
Baking doesn't happen microwave-fast. Grab a salad (maybe a beer or glass of wine if you're so inclined), play some pinball, have an actual conversation over the free breadsticks which will be brought fresh from the oven, and live like you're actually enjoying the company around you instead of cramming food in your face in order to sustain life. 

4. Don't get too attached to a beer, they rotate fast! There's always the Coors/Bud Light (not my bag), and the Triple Pi (made by local masters of all things beer, Sockeye Brewing, and only available at Flying Pi), but the other taps rotate about every week or two. You can also request beers tone brought on, and they'll kindly call you when the keg is tapped. They also allow you to sample so you can find a new beer you're bound to love. 

All this taken into account, get yourself a Zerto Magnifico (add cream cheese, your life will be forever altered), come for habanero season in August, and take some time to just enjoy the simple pleasures of great pizza, great beer, and great company. Honk the horn on your way out!

Great Pizza!  Like just about everywhere else we've encountered on our visit, great people behind the magic as well.  Took our friends who recently moved out as a thank you for hosting us while we visited and explored this weekend, and they now have a new go-to pizza place.  My husband, who doesn't usually like breadsticks, ate three plus several pieces of the "no vegi" pie.  It's one heck of a good deal compared to what we pay in Northern California too.  

As if we needed one more reason to try and move to this wonderful state, you've added another to the list!

My husband and I just moved to Boise and we're in need of a jeweler. Lee Read came recommended to us. We were greeted right away, offered bottled water and helped promptly. Sarah answered my many questions and was very knowledgeable. Our rings were cleaned and looked brand new. I bought a watch battery and Sarah put it in and set the correct time. This is our new jeweler. Thank you Sarah!

25 minute wait on a Saturday night when half of the tables are empty. There wete not enough cooks to adequately prepare food in a timely manner. Shame on you for not preparing for a Saturday evening. We have been looking forward to visiting your restaurant as this would have been our first time. We won't be back to try for a second.

Jim Closson with Sit Means Sit of Boise, ID was able to show us how to teach our dog all of the commands we had been struggling with in just two private sessions. We went from not being able to get our dog to come when called to walking with her off leash in one week. What a fantastic training program! I uploaded a video of my dogs progress to my blog at the address that follows. 

http://www.tumblr.com/blog/sitmeanssitmethod

Arriving into a restaurant that very clearly made no changes from the Mexican restaurant it used to be. Was given a crumpled up piece of paper that was my drink menu. All bar drinks were $10+ but none were even remotely worth it. I ordered a beer and had to give a second choice in case they didn't have the first one, apparently it happens a lot. As we are getting a small appetizer a bus boy proceeds to tell us gross stories of children contaminating the tables and how he can never get them clean. I was very unhappy with this place.

Place has gone downhill.  This is a newer establishment in Boise based on the Amazing Restaurants they have in Boise.  Problem is the food is not good.  Salad bar is a joke - Beer is Super Expensive and pizza was just so so.   Even the video games take your money with nothing in return.  Only reason I will go back is if someone else is buying.

I went in for a color correction and Afton did an amazing job! It took a couple appointments but the final outcome was great. Thank you Afton for dealing with my stubborn hair and doing such an awesome job. You're amazing girl!

AWFUL, AWFUL, AWFUL.

As experienced renters we have never had to deal with a group of people so incapable and uninterested in doing the job in which they are paid for each month.  After simple repairs were continually neglected on their part, we had to call and email on a daily basis for over three months to have a simple appliance repair completed.  That of which, didn't last as our dryer broke a short two months later.  Regardless of the PPPM employee we dealt with, our problems were met with excuses and never an apology.

We will NEVER rent through Park Place Property Management ever again.  Experience in laziness and incompetence must be on the job description.

Overpriced food. Slow service. Not worth the effort. Mentioned slow, inattentive service to the manager and he said we could always eat elsewhere. Won't be back. There are too many good restaurants in the area to put up with that kind of attitude. This place will be closing soon. Not very busy at the lunch hour.

My parents had an experience with this company when they used them to manage renters in their home while out of state.  I absolutely recommend you read the 44 reviews that are  down at the bottom the page. They are extremely informational and must read!

This was our first time at Le Peep. We loved it!  I had the Wanderer skillet, my wife had the Taco's duo, and my kids had the Plaincakes with chocolate chips.  Everything was awesome. Way better than I expected we'll be back for sure.

This place is solidly ok. The service was very good, save for our appetizers being so late as to be served with our meal. And the tiny kids drinks being empty often.  The drinks that come with the childrens meals are about 4 ounces, which seems a little stupid if you ask me. 
 The food on the other hand not so much. The finger steaks, so so. The burgers, not good. The kids meals,  also just so so.  The fries were pretty good.
Egggggghh.  Some weird flavors.  Would like to see a couple classics.  Chocolate tasted funky.

I wish I could give Anita Corbett negative stars, but unfortunately, Yelp doesn't allow that. I have attempted to contact her several times via voicemail as well as email and have yet to receive any contact from her. I consider that not only blatantly disrespectful, but also unprofessional on the part of a 'licensed' individual. She felt it appropriate to share about all her successes; however, did not feel the need to share how she was recently fired, after three months, as a couples' agent due to inability to even show their house. After hiring a new agent, within 10 days their house had sold. I would not only advise AGAINST using her as your agent, I would say stay as far away from any of the services she could potentially offer, she is nothing less than a wolf in sheep's clothing.

Nice franchise restaurant that has a long tenure prior to arriving in Meridian.  Good choice on the franchisee part. The food and service was very good.  Diversified menu with quality ingredients.  
I know everyone in Boise always says they love local restaurants but they really vote with their feet and end up a chain restaurants because they are consistent.
I like joe momma but they argue with their customers.  Steve's cafe down the street boast of game meat but can't properly execute basic bacon and eggs.
This one will be a winner!
I live in California, everytime i go see my little brother...I GO HERE and multiple times! Great people, great food, great prices!!!! Simply Awesome!!!
Came here for lunch with a co-worker, our waitress was wonderful, and the food was great! I especially liked the French fries! Will definetely come back!

Went shooting this afternoon and worked up an appetite. My fiancee and I had the Flying Pie on State Street once before, so we were really excited to try the one closer to our home. 

We decided to try and call Flying Pie in Meridian. The number just rang and rang. We tried 4 times, to no avail. Finally we just decided to go in. It was hard to get there with the one way street when traveling southbound on Meridian Ave. BTW. We walk in to the restaurant, and we see two families sitting down eating. While waiting in a one person line I decided to call the phone number to see what would happen....NOBODY EVEN FLINCHED to answer the phone. We got to the front of line and told the gentleman working the counter that we had to tried to call several times with no answer. He shook this off like it's a normal thing to not answer the phone and that it seems ok to do so. We were going to order anyhow, but then we found out it was going to be 45 minutes to an hour for TAKEOUT. This infuriated me after not being able to reach them on the phone,  then drove over, to find that out. Plus, the counter seemed totally annoyed and didnt care one bit that we were hungry and upset...almost as if he wanted us to leave. We left and I'm writing this in the parking lot because I'm so mad I feel this is more important than actually getting food that I'm so hungry for. 

This company has great tasting pizza, but the service here at the Meridian location is absolutely horrible. They may be laughing this off today, but when more and more people turn to social media to find out where to go, they'll have dug themselves a hole too deep to crawl out of. No second chance with this location for me. Maybe I'll go to the State Street location if I'm out that way sometime.

Recently moved to the area and was needing a groomer for our Lab- so I googled and yelped and came across Wags to Riches. I pulled up the website and was a little skeptical since the website didn't offer much info- but decided to call based on yelp reviews- so glad I did! They were able to fit my dog in the same day! Sandy was great with our dog and he looks and smells so much better and the price is super reasonable. This will be my go to place for my labs grooming needs!!
You would never even know it's vegan! They are absolutely delicious with just the right amount of sweet and creaminess!

I love these girls! I have three dogs who are all a bit crazy. Two are rescues and one of them is an extremely worried 7 pound chihuahua. Kelly and Brianna take great care of them and are really patient. Their prices are reasonable (which is important when you literally have a pack of dogs), they are quick, and easy to schedule with. And most importantly they come back looking beautiful and smelling great! I would recommend wags and riches to anyone and everyone!
Dr. Griffin and Dr. White were great. I had been having pain between my shoulder blades for a while and they were able to get rid of it!!!!! Great people and great chiropractors as well!!
Everything was on point. The food was delicious the servers were kind, generous and efficient. Definitely going to come back for a second time.
I thought the yogurt was great with tons of toppings to choose from.  You can go healthy or go crazy with all of the choices.  Seating is very limited but service was great. I will be back.
Great food, beers and great service. Visiting from out of town and we enjoyed our stop at Barrel 55.

First time going in, and this will be my last. The service was subpar at best. Our server was barely at our table and took forever to get our food to us. We were there for lunch and it took 20 minutes to get a side salad out (and it ended up coming right before my entree). I ordered the salmon and I took 1 bite and noticed something was off with the taste. It was so noticeable that I had my sister try it and she noticed the taste too. I couldn't even finish my food.. At the end of it all our server brought boxes for us and the one on top had food in it already.. Needless to say we will not be returning.

Welcome to Meridian, Panera! Love the Pick Two with Chicken Cobb Salad and Chicken Noodle Soup. Ever since Corner Bakery dropped the Santa Fe Salad I've been looking for a substitute - thanks Panera, I found it. Excellent flavors and good portions. Still working out the kinks of a new place-they forgot to include part of my meal and the iced tea ran dry in mid day. Those things should never happen, especially when you're trying to create a new fan base. Hopefully they will work those things out. The layout of the restaurant is not ideal. Order area is cramped and tucked awkwardly past a small pastry display. Chairs and tables are cramped and scattered making it difficult to walk to a table or the drink station. Hopefully they continue the good food choices and keep the place clean and stocked properly. I'll be back!

DO NOT GO TO THIS PLACE. they are disgusting! and i'm not meaning the food. the food is decent, but if you want to feel unwelcome and uncomfortable then this is the place for you. the whole entire place is TERRIBLY unprofessional. i'm 16, and even i am just appalled. they are all thugs. they are running the place into the ground. i watched them take a woman's register to put orders in, and put PORN IN. THEY HAD PORN ON THE POS SYSTEM, WITH KIDS AROUND TO SEE. i am completely amazed at how horrible this place is. for this bad of service, do not go here. even though the food isn't exceptionally terrible, it's still nothing you should spend money on. completely insane. i am begging you guys. DO NOT BRING YOUR KIDS HERE. let alone yourself!

One of life's most under-appreciated pleasures is a good, local breakfast spot. Express Cafe has become our go-to, especially if we don't want to schlep down to Big City or Goldy's. I go into chicken-fried steak & eggs withdrawal if it's too long between visits. My wife says the other menu items are very good -- I wouldn't know. 

If you're looking for innovative artisanal cuisine or ambience , this isn't your place. It's straightforward, unfancy breakfast fare, consistently well-prepared and served up by some of the most pleasant wait-staff you can imagine.

Be prepared to wait during weekend prime-time. Weekdays are also busy, but there's always room after the morning rush or at the counter.

Fantastic service! Our waiter Jarrid is so nice! Even came and brought me a to go box without me having to ask! The food was delicious and will definitely come back! I had the Black N Bleu Burger and the Peaches 55 (or 55 Peaches?), and the fries... OMG THEY ARE SO GOOOOOOD!!!
I like the atmosphere in here! I also like that they're considering selling my jams! I love local places that support local people!

Julie did the flowers for my dads wedding and they were SO beautiful. Bright, lively, well-arranged, and perfect for the event. The staff is friendly and the shop is bright and adorable. Definitely stop in to meet the whole crew (even the shop kitty) and browse some blooms.

I love this place. The food is great and the service was just as amazing. We will call ahead to make sure Maddie is working just to sit in her section. Thanks for the high quality service and original food selections.

Went on Tuesday night for the gourmet pizza night! 

Cost my husband and I $20 for all you can eat pizza, drinks & salad! Not too shabby!

It was fun trying the different flavors of pizza they had available!
Salad bar was fresh clean and had a good selection of toppings! 

The only complaint is the Samoan pizza needed to be cooked longer some of the cheese on top wasn't melted all the way... smh! Other than that everything & everyone was awesome!

I have gone to this restaurant many times in the past with some satisfactory results but the last two times I have gone I have been dissappointed.  I was trying to hurry on my way to work and ordered two spicy chicken burritos.  What I was hoping for did not arrive.  What I received was two poorly wrapped, tasetless, cold burritos.  This seems to be happening alot at this particular restaurant lately.  I would just skip this place next time or find another place to stop in at.

This place is terrible. Let's start with their service, or should I say lack of it. Waited over 10 minutes to get anyone to acknowledge us after we sat down. Had to continually ask for items that came with the meal, i.e. she never asked what salad dressing I wanted when I ordered. Had to ask for the bread too, which was supposed to come with the meal. Had I not asked for these items, I probably wouldn't have them served. I also had to ask for drink refills; this is a deal breaker for me since it tells me the server can't even pay attention to their customers. The food came, 35 minutes later, and it wasn't what I ordered. My wife's salad was mediocre at best. I ordered a pork chop and received a sandwich. I understand it was a busy Saturday night after Thanksgiving but great food and service should occur consistently. Not coming back.

Wanted to love this place as we just moved from Portland and the Flying Pies are AMAZING. Totally different pizza and ingredients, this one was meh. Service was extremely slow but they were busy. Ordered breadsticks and waited 30 min, never came. Pizza took a bit longer. The Portland locations have amazing sausage with LOTS of it on the pizzas. This was very sparse and crust is totally differen,t being just ok. Will try the Fairview location but if you are expecting the best pizza like the Oregon locations have, dont.
I love this place. They take great care of my dog's health. The groomer is awesome too! Bring your pets here, they will thank you for it!

Food was ok, not worth the money. Over priced version of red robin. The beers on tap tasted like plain Jane craft beers. I had the burger and it was dry and over cooked. My wife had the prime and the aujus sauce was overly salty and we could barely eat it. And that's coming from a guy that loves salt. Service was great but not good enough to keep me coming back.

This place has only been here for two weeks but very good! Buffalo finger steaks were great! Prime rib was perfect, buffalo ribs were great! Roast d salad was very good. There was four of us and we all shared a little bit off each other's plates. Drinks are good and love the setup here. Check this place out definitely!

Walked in for the first time today. The wait was not long and our waiter Nancy was courteous and gave us the right amount of attention we needed. I had stuffed French toast and turkey sausage and my husband had Belgian waffles combo. Coffee was good. Perfect breakfast to start off the weekend!

I love this place! Excellent customer service, clean inside and out and  consistent product. They have a couple of sorbets available, but I usually go with the golden vanilla or chocolate. If you've never had a shiver you've got to try one. I get something called the Triple Threat (yes that's a proper noun). It's chocolate yogurt with brownies and Oreos. My wife gets them with "enrober" which we call crack sauce. There's a few reasons why it could be called that: it's addictive, it hardens and cracks when upon the fro yo, and well we'll stop there. My wife gets crack sauce and Reese's peanut butter cups in golden vanilla.  Get a large eat half and freeze the rest, you won't be sorry.

I took my little Charlie boy to Wags to Riches for the first time today and I was extremely happy! Samantha was his groomer and I would have to say this was probably the best haircut he has ever had! Not only was the haircut fantastic their service was great! They were able to work with the drop off and pick up to accommodate my work schedule. I will never go anywhere else!

Greeted and seated promptly. 
Ordered the original sticky fingers. They were excellent. Great taste and cooked perfectly. 
Waitress was friendly. 
Great meal for the price.
First time here, man, I could eat Monti Cristo Crepes daily!!   Outstanding, food and service. Can't wait to go back

I've done business multiple times with Boise Glass Doctor and I highly recommend them for Auto or home glass needs.  I have referred my neighbors and friends and have always been happy with how they treat my referrals, too.

Unremarkable. Food was good, but it took a long time. When I asked for a beer taste, the waiter told me it was going to take awhile because the bar staff was super busy. I thought, this is a beer restaurant, surely a beer taste isn't too tough.  The atmosphere was dull. The wait staff seemed unhappy. Don't think we will go back.

Worst experience I have ever had with a property management group.  Was looking for a hone to rent in Boise area and was treated horribly.  They wouldn't return calls and when they did they were rude and short over the phone.  I had set up times through their system to view homes and nothing gave me suggested times, just repeated responses that my time needed to be rescheduled.  Finally I had set up to view a unit and the wrong key was in the box.  They then missed two subsequent showings.  It just not worth working with them.  Its hard enough to find a rental without this group wasting valuable time.

Absolutely horrible food for the money. You can go to Kona Grill or Yardhouse and have good food for the same price. This place charges to much for low quality food. I posted it on my facebook and everyone agreed and wont go back. The menu has little variety and whats up with the pasta section how about normal pasta and if you are going to do a fondue you don't do two greens you add a green and maybe like an apple or a meat with the bread not broccoli and barely cooked Brussel sprouts and the cheese was gritty. To bad cause it has nice curb appeal and nice inside but thats all that is nice.

I had the usual problem: my Samsung had blown it's caps and was cycling endlessly.  I called Caden TV, Luan came out the next day and had the problem fixed within the hour.
Very competent and polite and the price was reasonable.  I would call them again..

Dennis came out promptly and gave me a detailed written quote after we had viewed and discussed the four trees that needed major trimming. He and his crew arrived right on time this morning and four hours later, the job was finished, and I am delighted with the result. It wasn't easy as huge limbs were hanging over two different neighbors' yards. They cleaned up all debris AND even blew 30 years worth of juniper needles off of the corrugated patio cover, which were packed down and stuck like glue.  (By the way, my backyard is very inaccessible, but Dennis and his employees are used to challenges, so it wasn't a huge problem but did require extra time and effort transferring the limbs to the wood-chipper parked out front, on the other side of my picket fence.)

YOU'VE BEEN WARNED. It's called Barrel 55 because it takes 55 minutes (at least) to get your food from the time you order. We visited this morning (Sunday, 2/11/2018) for brunch (group of 4), and were seated promptly. The server took our order relatively quickly, and then it begun. We waited. And waited. And waited. We waited for 40 minutes after placing our order before inquiring about our food. We were assured it would be "right out". We waited about 20 more minutes. At this point we asked again. Our server said "2-3 more minutes". At this point we were incredibly irritated and seriously thought we were being punk'd (where's Ashton?). We set a stopwatch. 12 minutes later (approximately 1 hour and 12 minutes after ordering, for those counting) we received 3 out of 4 of our meals. The 4th meal came 13 minutes after the other 3. THE FUN DOESN'T END HERE FOLKS. 1 of our meals was piping hot, the other 3 were freezing cold. 2 of us had hair in our food. We asked for the manager, he apologized- giving some excuse about their kitchen being busy- and comped our meals. We will never EVER EVER be back. Ever.

I love sweets and cinnamon rolls but I was very disappointed with this place. The rolls are large but dry and the icing is overly sweet and you can crunch on the sugar granules. I tried a plain and one with various toppings and they were pretty disgusting.

Great breakfast! Service was top notch! 
The portions were HUGE! if you want a great breakfast stop in... good coffee too

Good luck getting something to eat here. The service at the snack bar is bad today. (9-3-18) Only one person working, a bunch of customers standing around. No organized line, no one knows who's next, just a jumble of people. The girl working doesn't seem to care. People that came after me got helped first. I got frustrated and walked away and left soon after to get food elsewhere.

What can I say, this place has perfectly crafted food. I brought a group of people here with hesitation since it was new, and man they overdelivered! The service seemed to be an issue when they first opened based on the previous reviews, but it seems to have come around. My advice...give it a try.

They literally never respond back to you. They also have a 45 dollar application fee and for the total amount of almost 150 dollars to apply for 3 adults I would expect to have a call back when I contact them at least twice a day. And also try to get ahold of them by text and email. If you want a prompt response by a management company I would definitely not go with this management company. Its evident that they are just out to collect application fees and not actually help people find a home.

Love this new coffee/lunch/drinks place!! Locally owned, which I'm all about, and has yummy drinks, great food, and will be offering wine and beer by the end of the month! The atmosphere is cozy and cute, and the people here are so welcoming and friendly. So glad this place is in the neighborhood now!

This place usually has a wait list in the mornings for good reason; it's the best breakfast in town. Large menu, the best staff, and incredibly quick. Don't  let a wait deter you, it's usually just a few minutes and is well worth it. I've eaten here about once a month for years and never been remotely disappointed. So delicious.
Visited again. Fantastic. French onion soup the best. Steak sandwich with mild horse radish and Gorgonzola cheese out of this world. A bit pricey but good grub.

This place just opened, so I thought I'd give it a try. It used to be On The Border, and they did a decent job renovating. I sat at the bar, where I noticed about 20 beers on tap.

Menu was limited but varied. I ordered a prime rib sandwich with salad instead of fries. The salad was $2.00 extra as a substitute for the fries. I should've stuck with the fries. The sandwich and salad arrived with good presentation, but I noticed there wasn't much meat. There was a piece of bread under the salad to give it the illusion that it was bigger. 

Everything tasted very good. A wonderful blend of flavors, but the serving sizes were too small for the prices, including the beer.

Service was fair, but it's new, so give them some time for to get on their feet.

I'm not going to say I won't give it another try at a later date, but I will go knowing that the prices are too high for the serving size and a minimally renovated Mexican restaurant.

After two failed attempts at layers by fancy, shmancy establishments, this one got it right! My daughter got an adorable bob cut and I got the layers I dreamed of! Miranda did a wonderful job! And so did the dude! I feel so bad, I didn't catch his name. But I think he was the only guy working there. I will absolutely be returning. These stylists actually listen to what you're saying.
Shea was great and very efficient in my face sugaring. She made me feel comfortable with this first-time experience. I'd recommend this esthetician and business.

Very average pizza including the tasteless crust. On top of that, I ordered their 10" "everything" pizza with additional anchovies for $1.50 extra. Got home and no anchovies. The prices are are high for the quality and taste IMHO. Smokey Mountain Pizza on Fairview is much much better both in crust, Smokey flavor and price. That's where I'm going next time.

Great service from Gem State.  Came in at 9:00 Am and my truck was ready the same afternoon.  Had a real bad noise from an installation of a large gas tank from a dealer.  These guys found that the DEF hose was not routed correctly and solved the problem.  No rattles, inexpensive fix and super nice guys.  Will definitely be back for my regular service and any other needs.

I have been eyeing this place since I drive by it everyday from work and knew I wanted to try it when it opened. I was not let down! It's nice to have a new local restaurant rather than a chain restaurant. Service and food was great, it was very clean, decent prices and the staff was very knowledgable and helpful regarding what to order. I think it's a great place to kick back on a Friday night, I will definitely be back!

Heather from Vitality acupuncture is a super kind, very personable acupuncturist.  She is flexible in her treatments and also in her scheduling; always helping me find a way to get in and get what I need.

She is very knowledgeable in her profession and works well with a wide clientele.  Before I saw her I was terrified of needles, yet she has helped me find a way to experience the amazing benefits of acupuncture.

She is really helpful and I appreciate that she remembered me and my needs and goals from visit to visit; I didn't have to repeat everything when I saw her.

Totally recommended!

I took my kids and the line was pretty long. The cinnamon roll was a bit hard. And the toppings were not that great. I feel like the price for what you get is not that great of a value. I prefer Cinnabon at the local Mavricks.
Had breakfast there last week. What a treat. Best breakfast I have had in a long time. The service was unmatched. I definitely will eat there again.

The pizza is always good. We loved almost everything about this location. The parking was a bit insane. Good food, beer and atmosphere. The hostess was a bit rude. Aside from that another win for FPP.

Nice place, friendly morning staff and fresh coffee. Lots of choices on the menu. French toast with 1 egg and ham was good. Other plates looked good too. No crowd, food came out quickly, waiter kept my cup of coffee full. Also provided a glass of water.

After reading all the reviews that everyone has left. I just wanted to put out there that my deposit I had to pay was $850.00. I understand that $200.00 of it will be taken out of my deposit for carpet cleaning. Pretty much leaving me with $650.00. I'll be sure to give you all am updated status on what I get at the end. I'm about a month into my lease I'm upset with how things have been handled. I'm paying for a garage unit that still has NOT been fixed. I was told that the builder was going to contact me. Still haven't heard from anyone. When you move in, it was the biggest hassle of having to get your internet and any TV service set up (btw the place is not design properly for TV placement based on where the COAX cable is located). You have no option of calling whoever you want to get it hooked up. You have to go through a Company Park Place is in "contract" with but then in a different email it showing you can contact someone else. So don't expect to get the latest deals on any of your services. I still have not received an up to date lease agreement either so I can just see and prepare myself for the end results.

From my understanding rent is paying for everything to function properly. Not only is my garage door not fix, but it opens my neighbor's garage door from my remote. I've come home a few times before having to unplug my garage unit to an open garage door. I was told that all the garage units are the same and it can actually open up any of the other units in my place. Yeah, that sounds reassuring to know anyone can get into my place. I haven't heard of how all the move-in check list will be taken care of. As I read in my lease agreement, pit bulls are not allowed... Well, the people at the end of my unit has a pit. There has been a few times I walked by their place to get to my front door (again due to garage not working) and there were dog crap everywhere. No one monitors these places so you can pretty much get away with anything. Parking at this complex is horrendous!
Decent service. Food was bland. I'll probably find somewhere else to go next time. It seemed really slow so I'm. It sure if that is indicative of the service or food.

Had a bad first experience despite the positive reviews.  

Pros: They had three different coffee roasts to choose from, the staff was friendly, the food was hot, and the prices on the menu were very reasonable.  Also, they had a big screen TV playing NFL which was great!

Cons: They made us wait for a table for ten minutes even though there were at least 4 tables open within eyesight (not sure if this was some policy or another reason they did this), the skillet I ordered was pretty decent tasting but consisted of about 40% broccoli which seemed like an odd food to include in a breakfast skillet, we never received drinking water, and I was hoping to get some coffee creamer (because I saw the awesome selection they had at various other tables) but the waitress was too busy.

I will say that this place was packed during the time I visited and that excuses a bit of the lack of service, but as for the food, not good enough to return for me.

I have been going to Scott Dentistry for 2 Years now. Excellent dentist! I noticed that they had started providing a new service for teeth whitening, a 40% hydrogen peroxide. I had used the bleaching trays that they sell with fare results but I wanted something more powerful. 

I get my teeth cleaned every 3 months so I scheduled this whitening a couple days after a teeth cleaning, I wanted maximum results. When I arrived at my appointment there was some paperwork to fill out, most describing the procedure and what the expectations of undergoing the procedure. Which I really liked, because depending on the condition of your teeth the whitening could work or wouldn't. 

I was taken back by Mandy and was again described in detail of how the procedure was to be performed. She compared my teeth on a color wheel and gave an expectation of what the whitening would do. She was very articulate in letting me know what she was doing and what she needed me to do. I was able to do three treatments of the whitening during my appointment. Mandy notified me at the start of the side effects of the whitening (shocking feeling in my teeth) which I didn't start to feel until the end of the third treatment. Mandy told me they would go away in one to two days but mine subsided after 8 hours and using fluoride toothpaste. 

After the treatment was over we compared my teeth on the color wheel and my teeth had whitened a shade whiter. I couldn't have been happier! Later that night I was at my nephews Christmas concert and we were standing in the dark and my mom says "boy your teeth are so white"! Exactly what I was looking for! Totally worth the time and money. It now has been three weeks since the whitening and my fiancé still makes comments how white my teeth are!!!
Awesome place, so glad it's on the west end of town. Good food and good beer selection!

Three strikes you're out! The first time I came here, I got the Cuban sandwich and it was amazing! I was so excited to have found an awesome new place to eat. The second time I came, the food was a major disappointment. I thought maybe it was just a different chef on and it was the luck of the draw. The third, time we came thinking we'd luck out again, but the food quality was super sub par; we laughed and said it tasted like Barffood. This last time we came for Sunday brunch, hoping that we could experience that awesome taste sensation we had the first time. We sat down, waited ages for a server, about 15-20 minutes, and as I stood up to get a manager, one showed up. We ordered an omelette,  and waited. And waited. AND WAITED.... we finally decided if our food didn't arrive after we had been there for 50 minutes we would just leave. And now we're sitting across the way at another restaurant-I wonder if our omelette is actually even ready yet?

A new restaurant in meridian we were so excited to try out. First off our waiter was the most awkward 20 something year old we've ever experienced. All of us at the table were looking at each other trying to pin point what he was doing. I don't even know, I honestly can't even describe him but he made us all uncomfortable. Enough that everyone mentioned something about him. One thing I can't stand is when I get my side salad with my entree. When ordering I clearly said can I get my salad before, he said yes, well guess when my salad came out. With my entree. Annoying. Food took a while to get, it was decent, not enough to make us want to come back though. Could of had potential but severely under delivered. Bummer

I just got back from the drive-thru, and am always pleased. The workers are always chipper and kind and the yogurt is much better than the self-serve places, in my opinion. Plus - who wants to drag the kids out of the car, when you can drive thru! I even like to get an empty cake cone for the baby in the back seat. Definitely my favorite spot for ice cream in Meridian.

My husband and I have tried Le Peep twice now.  The first time I was pleased and my husband was not.  The second time, we were both disappointed.

The first time we got there, we did have good service and were seated quite quickly.  It is a large restaurant with high ceilings and a lot of hard surfaces.  This means that the noise level is quite loud.  We ordered our breakfast.  I ordered the ham and cheese omelet.  It was was normal and nothing stood out about it.  The hash browns that came with it were a tad on the greasy side.  My husband ordered the special of the day.  The eggs were overcooked and his bacon was so overcooked it would break when you tried to pick it up.  He was so unhappy that we didn't go back for months.

We decided to try again on a Sunday morning.  It was very busy and there was a wait.  I put our name on the list and the hostess said it would be a 10 minute wait.  After 20 minutes, we still had not been seated and we began to notice several people who had come in after us going in.  After 30 minutes and watching a lot of people going in ahead of us, I finally went over to ask why we had not been seated.  The hostess said these other people had reservations so they were being seated.  She then proceeded to say if we wanted to be seated right away, we could sit at the bar.   We were hungry, so opted for that.

We placed our food ordered and visited with the other people at the bar.  Again, the food was unremarkable.  My eggs and hash browns were very, very greasy this time.  

More than the unremarkable food, we were really quite perturbed at being told our wait time would be 10 minutes then waiting 30 and finally having to question why we felt we were being ignored.  If there had been places at the bar, why were they not offered up front when we first arrived?  We didn't know they took reservations.  It would have been better to let us know that others may be seated before us so if we had a time limit, we could have gone to another place that could have given us a better estimate of how long it would take to get a table.

We'll take our business elsewhere.

This was my first time at this restaurant. The restaurant is very clean, very courteous polite and friendly staff and the food was excellent. I'd highly recommend the trout and eggs. It was delicious. I'll definitely return many times to this restaurant.
Awesome experience, especially for a first timer. Super easy to make an appointment. Great customer service, makes you feel welcome and wanting to come back.

Awesome cinnamon rolls!  I highly recommend the cinnamon roll with pumpkin frosting (when in season).  If you don't like overly sweet, then don't go for the ones with a ton of toppings.  The simple ones are the perfect sweetness for me!  Vegan family members have even been able to enjoy them!  Though I would've never guessed that the cinnamon rolls were vegan!

I love massages and have had many of them. That being said...WORST MASSAGE IVE EVER HAD.  I purchased the groupon coupon and was extremely disappointed. Not only was there no grapefruit aromatherapy, the 1 hour massage was only 40 minutes. I told her at the beginnng of the massage that I wanted just my upper body worked on, not my lower body. She gave me some stupid excuse as to why she needed to do range of motion on my legs...

Throughout the "massage" she proceeded to tell me about multiple things that were wrong with me. I know for a fact that everything is in alignment and that I'm FINE. At some point, she told me that my S7-10 vertebra were at risk for hemorrhaging. I ALMOST DIED LAUGHING!!!! I'm a neuro nurse at St. Luke's and was horrified by this woman's medical terminology. Bones do NOT hemorrhage!!!! Also, I'm not sure what verebra she was talking about!! As a professional, it's important to get your anatomy right!! Good grief!

Aside from her stupidity, she did a horrible job massaging me. She pressed on weird parts of my back and bottom. I didn't know whether to get up off the table and leave or count down the minutes until she was finally done. 

At the end of the massage when I was out in the waiting room, she tried to sell me a chiropractic appointment. Very annoying. She told me that multiple things were wrong with me and it would be in my best interest to be seen....

Avoid this place at all cost....it was literally a waste of time. I wouldn't go back if it was 100% free.
Confusing menu for first timers. Waited nearly an hour for a 12" cheese pizza after ordering. Try somewhere else unless you're not in a hurry.

I am a regular here.  It's convenient to my house but I'd drive across town for a great place for breakfast.  I don't need to with these guys.  They're AWESOME.  The staff is super friendly and the food always delivers.  I'm a huge fan of the BACON.  I'm either a biscuits and gravy guy w/ bacon or the traditional Bacon and Eggs.  I've tried other dishes, and everything has always been awesome.  I'm told the doughnuts are good, fresh baked at the restaurant.  I just can't go there...

Wow!! My friend chose this place for me to take her for her birthday lunch. I am new in town, so she wanted to show me the best of our area & boy was she right! I cant wait to go back with my daughter so she can partake in this culinary excellence!  Well done!!

Oh my!  Love a good breakfast, but this was ahhh-mazing!  
The biscuits and gravy were soft, not soggy. The gravy had a perfect sausage/gravy ratio. 
The waffles were perfect. Crisp on the outside while fluffy on the inside. 
The portions were extremely adequate. 
The eggs Benedict was everything.  
The military discount was incredibly appreciated. 
We will be back! Again, and again.

Wow!  This Urban Air is fantastic!  My son goes often to Urban Air in Wichita, KS and this one has so much more to offer.  Aside from the usual dodgeball, trampolines and ropes course, this one has rock climbing walls, mini golf, laser tag, battle beams,  Skyrider, DropZone and warrior course.  Great fun for kids and parents.

Called them today to deliver some flowers to my sister. They were able to deliver very quickly and the arrangement was sooo pretty. I left it up to them to decide flowers and colors within a certain price range and my sister absolutely loved them! I'm sure its somewhat annoying when people don't know what they want but they did a great job recovering for my lack of interest in art! haha Thank you to the employees there!

We stopped in on our road trip. It was our first time trying Panera, as there aren't any locations in Utah. The service was excellent, and the food was great. The girl at the counter was very helpful and polite. I will definitely stop there again the next time I'm going through that area. They even have outside tables where we were able to sit with our little dog. I'm not sure what their pet policy is, but no one seemed to mind our little guy being out at the table with us. It's so nice to be able to have good food while on the road, and not have to leave our little baby i  the car.

Enjoyed a hour or two at the Lucky Perk the  Mocha i had was very good the service was very good the young ladies behind the counter were fast and courteous. The setting area is well set up with a fireplace and a area where you can have some privacy and not be distracted  by the door opening and closing or the people passing by outside. I will return there and enjoy another Mocha or perhaps some tea.

I think we found our new favorite place for breakfast! Express Cafe exceeded even the great expectations set by fellow yelpers :) The staff was super friendly and did a fantastic job. They made us feel welcomed and appreciated while handling our large table seamlessly. All our food came out piping hot and my special order came out perfect (I had the veggie omelette no eggs, sub hash-browns) and it was *heavenly*. This dinner is a great, low key local place I was so excited to find. ENJOY!
Stop on twice for coffee here really enjoyed coffee and service girls working were friendly and happy to serve

The food was good but is rather highly priced for breakfast. Our waitress wasn't great, I think she may have been new. We had to wait for refills on water several times. I would go again but I don't like spending $11-$15 / person on breakfast.

Owner experience: Absolutely the worst Property Management company in Boise. If you are an owner looking for a company to provide Property Management services for your rentals, I highly recommend looking elsewhere. The only reason they are getting 1 star is because 0 stars is not an option. 

We had 4 homes under Park Place, and they were absolutely terrible when it came to communication, offered no consistency in property managers (5 different property managers in 5 years), and they never followed the homeowner requests with the property (paid county taxes when they came out of escrow, would never email semiannual property inspections once complete, never called for routine approval for maintenance, provided terrible repair services, etc...). I could go on for pages and pages, to the point where their VP of Property Management personally offered to manage our properties. If you are an owner that cares about your tenants, your properties, and/or your bottom line, I would 100% look elsewhere. There are honest and wonderful Property Management companies in the Treasure Valley, but unfortunately Park Place isn't one of them. I am happy to provide additional details to anyone who is considering hiring or renting from them, but bottom line: take your business elsewhere.

I took my car yesterday and still can't believe the results. Erik went through every detail before he began and helped me to understand the whole process. My car received the full detail. It is a time consuming process but worth the money. I have never seen this car look so amazing. I highly recommend Dynamic Detailing and look forward to future service.

I got the cappuccino and avocado toast, my husband had a chicken quesadilla. Let me tell you that was delicious. I love simple food. Simple food done right can be more satisfying than any complicated menu item. We were brought delicious little sample muffins, and my cappuccino cup was topped off with coffee when I was done. 

The owners were crazy nice and helpful. Service was A+. They let me know they will start being open even later soon. I will be making this my go to spot to hang out and chat with friends, or get a little work done away from the office.
What a great place. The food was very good and fresh. The grinder was so filling and the gumbo was to die for. The surprise was the wine. This is much more then a coffee shop.

I had to bring my brother to this place, one more time before we left. Omg! Everyone get the Vegetarian Benedict. So amazing!!! I wish this place was in LA. Perfect amount of class without the trendy hipster stuff that I'm forced to suffer. I love the staff, just as friendly and lovely as the first time.
VEGAN JUNKFOOD DELICIOUS!!!!!! Who knew you could get a cinnamon roll that taste so good, just so good and it's cruelty free, total WIN WIN! #stayWOKE

I just got charged $ 446.00 to change a $5 capacitor. I can't afford to take off another half day and I needed my AC working because I have animals, otherwise I would have called someone else. 
The technician was friendly and he showed up on time, but he spent less than an hour on the entire job. 
Let's be overboard and say the capacitor ( or as they call it a " voltage storage device" ) costs $ 50.00. That means I paid $394.00 for a service call that took less than an hour. 
You can do better. Keep scrolling

My wife and I went in on a Wednesday
After 5 and waited up front for someone to sit us for over ten minutes... there was another couple in front of us that had been waiting before we had even got there. There was no one at the front dest, the bar tender and the person in the kitchen made eye contact with all of us over and over and didn't bother to even say, someone will be right with you . We always drive by the place and it always looked empty. We know why now. That was our first and last time there.

I ordered"the burger" the waitress told me"it comes a little pink, is that okay" I said no, no pink please and she seemed irritated. The burger came literally charcoal burnt.
 I complained to my wife but she doesn't like to stir the pot so I didn't complain to the staff.
 Fries were a bit soggy but good flavor, fry sauce was good. 
My wife really liked her bison finger steaks. 
For the two of our meals, my wife's water and my one beer not including tip was $40. WAY too much.!!!! 
I wasnt happy and will not go back. I will tell anyone who asks this place was not worth the money. Not impressed..
P.S. this is my first yelp review but was so unhappy with the service and food I felt compelled to review.

Eric detailed my wife's 2015 Range Rover and it looks better than it did when it was brand new. I have had many vehicles detailed over the last twenty years, I've never received my vehicle in better condition than new, I didn't even realize that was possible. Definitely worth every penny and I wouldn't go anywhere else, as I am sure I would be disappointed.
Great place, friendly environment, the cook is coming up with some great menu ideas.  Bartender is awesome.  I highly recommend this place for lunch, dinner or a place to reconnect with friends.

I won't return to this restaurant. It's especially not for health-minded eaters. There isn't much of a selection on the food menu. The salads were unique, but the house salad entree I ordered had a bunch of oil on it.  My dressing was on the side like I asked.  The side for almost all entrees is just garlic mashed potatoes.

I was very much delighted by the customer service I received at 4pm on 2/13/2018. I went in to order a chicken burrito and because I had to wait for the chicken to be cooked, I was treated to a free beverage while I waited. When the chicken was ready, not even minutes later, I was given generous portions. When I went to pay, the cashier let me know my meal was on them. I was surprised! I have been to another Chipotle location closer to my home and have walked out because no one greeted or helped me. I will definitely be coming back to this store as customer service goes a long way in retaining customers at chains. Thank you very much!

I know they just opened, but they did such a fabulous job on my order.  Food was fresh, hot and rather fast coming out.  I had one of their skillets and it was so tasty.  I will be coming back again for sure.

I have never once ordered a cinnamon roll and thought, "I wish I had a diffevent flavor icing or more toppings for this." That being said, my kids thought it was a great idea! I also thoroughly enjoyed the 'old skool' roll and thought it warm and sweet, but not too sweet. We will definitely go back. They could definitely have a better drink selection, would be my only feedback.

Unlike Edge Brewery these guys actually have bears on tap and lots of different types not just IPAs. I had the cheese burger and it was cooked medium. Presentation of the burger with fries looked good. Liked the seasoning on the fries, nice and crispy on the outside and soft inside. My burger was juicy and had a good smoky flavor with a good soft bun that was not soggy or too thick. Good atmosphere with friendly staff.

Great little cafe. Had an omelet ( tasted just like home made) with hash browns. Really friendly servers. A lot of food, so ask to split the order. They are happy to do it. The wife and I will be coming back soon.
Awesome food, good prices, and good drinks, my family loved this place, I'll definitely go back
