Well, well, well, I thought I would visit this location with a friend since it was the closest one to his house. Mind you I was first introduced to this wonder of fresh food in Portland, OR in 2005. 
First this location claims that a traditional quesarito is no longer free. Typically when ordering a quesarito they put some cheese on the tortilla prior to steaming it and while it steams you order your free double rice with free double beans, and other momentous fresh goodies along with more cheese if so desired. All at the price of a regular burrito. The young man informed me that this is no longer the case, you now only get a choice of melted cheese or not. They do not provide both any more. I have one word to describe this, "CHEAP"! 
I have a suspicion that they are going cheap on their customers at this location since I have since tested this and found it false at other locations in the valley. Perhaps someone should tell everyone else or Chipotle at the village stop being so cheap and offer their amazing secret items. I would not visit this location if like me you enjoy consistency with your service. If you have been unfamiliar with these things in previous visits, at least you can get your cheese melted. 
One last thing, ask for boneless chicken, mine was not...ewww! Perhaps they have down graded their meat quality as well.
Fantastic. We had our dog go though their immersion training. What a difference that made. I don't think we'll ever try to train a dog on our own again.

Literally just sat in line for 45 mins in the drive threw that's not an exaggeration. When reaching the window no apologies just handed food, when I went to check our order out of fear of sitting in line again looking back at the line of cars, the girl seemed irritated that I looked. To my not surprise I found out why, of the 7 items ordered only 3 were right. One bag we were handed was in fact probably someone else's as it was nowhere near our order. No apologies were made for our missing items, only attitude given. Waited another 10 mins just to get our food thinking it would be right this time, but no, again we were missing an item that was specifically asked for to be remembered, at that point closing in on a hour it was not worth driving back and waiting in line. The worst experience I've had here, I maybe would have given more stars if the blonde girl working the counter who happened to not return my receipt today at 6:30 would have been sympathetic but no she treated us like we weren't a concern.

We went to this restaurant pretty much the same week it opened. For a restaurant that's not even been opened a week, it ran very professionally and the hors d'oeuvres and dinner was beyond expectation. The servers were more than accommodating and happy to help in any manner. We joke, yet believe it will become one of our local hangouts and eatery.

Barrel55 was not what I expected...if you're thinking it's just another pub with burgers and fries you would be mistaken.  While they do have burgers and fries, their menu is more artisanal...it's fancy pub food, which is also reflected in the pricing.  A burger and fries costs about $13 but it's kobe beef.  The smoked salad was tasty with mixed greens, bites of smoked steak, big chunks of Bleu cheese, and ciabatta- style crutons, roasted red peppers, and lightly dressed in a lemon vinaigrette.  The smoke on the steak was a little strong but it was good nonetheless.  I ordered the cheeseburger sliders kids meal  for my kids, which the two were able to split as they're light eaters, and the kitchen kindly split the meal between two plates.  Their burgers were  well flavored but overcooked.  I was able to sample the fries which were a peppery seasoned fry, well seasoned but needed more time in the fryer for crispiness.  The service was great with no wait time, our waitress was on top of refilling drinks, and our food came out quickly.  Overall not a bad experience would try them out again.

Good option instead of a low quality chain. Tried a big bowl of noodle soup with a fresh apple as a side. Soup was ok. Nothing mind boggling. I rarely don't finish my soup bowls and this wasn't too impressive to do so. But better than a fast food place. The Panera bread in Virginia where I lived for years used to be bursting with ppl every time we went there. Had delicious and nutritious dishes to offer. Maybe I waited for them to open one in Boise for too long. Maybe my taste buds changed. Will try it again

Sunday afternoon, friendly and prompt staff the right amount of checking in on us. Had The Burger, Clam Linguini, Classic Flatbread. All hit the spot. Burgers cooked medium unless you request more, very juicy, seasoned great and served with Hand Cut Fries. Very tasty we'll be back.

Visiting from out of town, looked like a great place to try. We were there at noon on Monday, only one other couple was there. Should have been our first sign. Menus were old and ratty and limited on choices. Pretty pricey too. The atmosphere is very nice. So, I ordered a Turkey sandwich my sister ordered the cheeseburger. Waitress came back with a menu because they were out of the Turkey sandwich I ordered. Really! What restaurant runs out of a staple like that. Like I said it wasn't packed, only one other table eating. So, I ordered the roasted beet and goat cheese salad. The salad had ice chunks in it, very special to bite into, and they tossed in some canned, not roasted beets. I can't recommend this place until they get it together. Clearly, poorly managed.

Wonderful food! First time visit tonight and we will definitely be back. Gnocchi and strip steak were perfect, chocolate torte was heaven.  Nice dinner with appetizer, 2 entrees, drinks and dessert for $75, well worth it!.  My new favorite place.

One star deducted for one reason, and I wish I could just deduct half: WAY too much garlic!  I like garlic, but some bites bordered on overpowering.  This could probably be remedied by simply asking them to go a little easy on the garlic.

We wandered in on a Thursday evening and it wasn't too busy yet.  The guy at the counter (James) was extremely friendly and explained their system to us.  He recommended a pizza size that ended up being plenty (we had leftovers!) and we got free breadsticks to munch on while waiting for our order.

The pizza (other than the aforementioned garlic issue) was perfect.  The crust was just the right amount of chewy with great flavor.  The cheese was just the right amount of stringy, and the chicken was tender and well-flavored.  (And I've had a chicken aversion since I got pregnant!)

All this for a VERY reasonable price!

And you get to honk a little bike horn on your way out :)

What a really cool little coffee shop and placed a just get a bite bite to eat unlike words located in has a little found Newport kids or dogs I personally went in play then it myself awesome area nice people it was really fun

This is a very modern, clean, and well put together service shop. They are not the least expensive and don't really match pricing for similar services which is why I'm taking off a star. But, they are fast, thorough and a pleasure to work with.

I had my daughter's iPhone screen replaced, I was in and out in under 90 minutes. They have great videos playing talking about your equipment and you wouldn't be unhappy sitting there waiting for them if the wait was short.

They offer great service and deliver on time. I'll definitely be back when I need their service again.
Great, quick service! Scott is super friendly and thorough. Explained what he was doing and was super efficient. Had me in and out in 5 minutes. Bonus- he has a friendly, canine partner: Rocket!
It's just your ordinary chain hair place but decent prices and they do good work.

For our anniversary we decided to begin by going out to breakfast.  As the day was special we wanted a location that was a bit special as well so chose Le Peep's.  The morning was mild so we ate out on the deck.  While the deck was not at all fancy it served its purpose.  Good menu variety and good food.  We enjoyed our server Sophia and her hospitality as well.  Would recommend this place as a go to place for breakfast in this area.
Great place for a friendly breakfast. Stopped here while visiting family and were so pleased.

Let's just start with this, I am absolutely devastated for my former co-workers that got all laid off last night. Cliff decided to completely screw them all over and just close the restaurant without former notice and some didn't even know they were not coming back. I worked my ass off for that place about 6 days a week, made sure to do my job and I had believed in that place. The owner Cliff fired me for no reason and accused me I find out later on for things I didn't do. They were terrible owners and I hope that you all do not go and support Barrel house. I am appalled at the way I was let go as I'm sitting there rolling silverware working my butt off for owners who completely didn't appreciate all the work I did for them. I have kept my mouth shut since I got let go. That was an amazing staff there and the fact that he did this to all of them there is absolute crap. What a selfish human being. Please don't let one penny go to this man. I'm livid to see that staff hurt and jobless because he didn't have the guts to do it properly.

We didn't end up buying from Sleep Country, but liked the store.  the gentleman helping us was great to work with.  He changed some of our ideas on mattresses, and what we were looking for.  Ultimately, the store could not come close to the price we got, for a very comparable bed and stand.  We would have paid a premium to work with this Sleep Country, but the difference was much more.

I came to town from California to tour apartments with my roommate. We found park place and chose to view two apartments through the company. Terrible choice! Not only were they unaccompanied tours (what if we have questions or chose to put down a deposit?) the second of the two apartments was destroyed! Garbage lined the floor, the bathroom cabinets were off their hinges, the stove top was completely disassembled, and to top it off there was urine on the carpet!! It was like no one even came by to check out the property or make sure it was in proper shape for a viewing. When I called to tell the company they were aware! They just chose not to clean it up because they "don't do maintenance on the property until it is rented". Excuse me, but what are you paid to do then? TRY DOING YOUR JOB. Very unprofessional.

Usually our go to for shakes and dinner in a hurry. Tonight the service was extra slow and unfriendly. We waited about 25 minutes for dinner for two. The screen changed indicating food was on the way. After about 10 minutes we pushed the button again and were notified that the ice cream machine was empty and they were waiting on that. Food finally arrived cold without a sorry from anyone. Sorry Sonic. We are done with you.

When you first arrive at the Express Cafe, it doesn't look like much.  It's an older restaurant and the front makes the cafe look a lot smaller than it really is.  Don't let that deter you from coming inside.  This place is excellent!

The service is always good.  Most of the staff have been working here for many years.  They are happy with their jobs and it shows in the pride they take in their attitudes and their service.  Sunday mornings are usually very busy.  There will be a wait most of the time.  They have a couple of benches inside on which people can sit, but you'll find people standing in the front of the bar, standing in the breeze way, or sitting on the benches in front of the restaurant.  

Be forewarned, on busy days, when they take your name, they will ask if everyone in your party is there.  They will not call your name until everyone is there because they want to make certain the tables are turned over as efficiently as possible.  A place this popular needs to do this to keep the customers happy.

On busy mornings, if you have to wait for your table, you don't have to wait for your morning cupa.  They will have coffee, cups, sugar, and cream so you can drink your coffee while waiting for a table.  They will also have water available if you're not a coffee drinker.

The menu is split between breakfast and lunch as they close for the day in the late afternoon.  No matter what you order, you'll not leave hungry.  The prices are very reasonable and you'll get a lot.  They don't mind special orders and customize anything.  

The waffles you can take as an option on the side are crisp on the outside and tender on the inside.  They are served with a generous dollop of whipped margarine and a small container of syrup.  If you want more syrup, just ask.

My husband has been a real fan of the Eggs Benedict that will often appear as a special.  The eggs are always done well, the hash browns are done very well and are not at all greasy.  

The breakfast burritos are so big, you'll want to save half for another meal.

I've only had lunch a couple of times but will indulge in the potato sticks with real fry sauce.

If you don't want to go inside, they have a drive-up window.

We've never been disappointed and will continue to make this a regular stop.

I've eaten at Panera's in Wahington, California, Michigan, and now Idaho.  All pretty much the same.  I like most of the menu items I've had.  Tonight I had the wonton soup.  Just the right amount of food- fresh veggies and wontons in a flavorful broth.  Unlike the Panera's in CA, they don't bring the food to your table.  Not a huge deal.  The place was clean and they prepared the food quickly.

This place is loud and not your conventional pizza place. If you are looking for a quiet place to eat fancy pizza and sip wine, go somewhere else. The people working here are extremely casual and very energetic. They yell out orders and cheer loudly when a happy customer honks the horn. 
We usually purchase a 5 gourmet pizza card and use it on a couple of different visits. I personally love the Zambini pizza. 
They will let you sample the beer on tap. Be careful, the Triple Pi beer will bite...

First time here. Brew pub atmosphere, relaxed environment. Great selection of beer and wines. My wife had a Bison burger, a little dry but delicious. I had the smoked prime rib which was excellent! It was actually the most tender prime rib I have had and the smokey horseradish sauce greatly complimented the beef.
Good food! Great service! Friendly and very personable staff. Jessica was great! We really had a great experience !

Food was great, but when FOX news is on and you're unfortunately sitting in such a spot where every time you look up, you're staring at the ugly face of Ted Cruz, you tend to lose your appetite. Probably won't go back until I'm guaranteed Rupert Murdock and his brain washed acolytes won't be there to torment me.
Good food!  The people that work at Express Cafe are great!  Friendly make you feel like you want to come back.

We came here while visiting Boise on a snowy day. The kids had a blast and burned off tons of energy. There are so many different activities they were busy for hours. The only con I have is the music played was so loud and annoying, a quieter viewing area would be perfect for parents who just want to sit and watch.
!!!!!!CAUTION!!!!! If you go here once you'll return over and over and over...... Fat kids rejoice! Awesome cinnamon rolls! Other treats as well. Just do it, you'll fall in love.

Worst service I've ever received!! Our server was so focused about impressing her boyfriend (I assume) who was sitting next to us, using the to-go containers (very childlike) as puppets messing with him. She was so distracted she dumped a FULL glass of ice water down my lap. Immediately brought me the bill and charged me for my entire breakfast with without even getting a chance to eat it! I had to leave to change because I was soaked so Talked with management, they didn't care AT ALL. I cannot believe the service they provided. Will not recommend or return. Definitely a 0 out 10.
If I could. I'd give no stars. For them to take so long you'd think food was fresh. No. Not at all. Highly upset.

This place is a decent greasy spoon. They seem to focus on Breakfast. The place was exactly what I expected. It's basically a diner that makes a good traditional breakfast. It's not anywhere near the quality of Goldy's but it is sufficient.

Went there for the first time on a Sunday. It wasn't too busy so we thought we would try it out. We found a seat and the waiter immediately came and gave us menus. It started off pretty well, but then the service went down hill from there. . . but there was a reason for it. He seemed to be an avid Steelers fan, and we had caught him on his "off day". Everything we asked for seemed to inconvenience him from watching the game. He never really asked if we needed anything, or how everything looked or was, he just cared about getting back to watching the game. The food was decent. I had the french dip. It was pretty basic,  but that was to be expected. 

This place has potential if it had a more friendly staff. They could also benefit from offering breakfast on Saturday's & Sundays to bring in a larger crowd. It really reminded me of The Lift in Boise off State Street.

Food: 4/5 - Decent, not great, nothing special.
Atmosphere: 4/5 - Lots of TV's and lots of seating
Service: 2/5 - Lacked personal attention, distracted & inconvenienced
Price: 3/5 - Not bad, but little value.
Value: 3/5 - Small portions

Bottom line: Might give it one more chance, but will have to make sure the Steelers aren't playing when we go, maybe he will be less distracted and inconvenienced.

What do you go to TCBY for? Yogurt... delicious, moderately healthy, tasty yogurt at an affordable price. And for that they absolutely deliver! I give them 4-stars. Also, it's SO CRAZY AFFORDABLE compared to some of the self-serve yogurt places in the valley. Trust me, you get more bang for your buck at TCBY. With daily specials, you just can't go wrong.

Food: They have hand-scooped yogurt and sorbets, soft serve yogurt and sorbets, tons of toppings to pile on top, and cartons of yogurt as well as yogurt cakes. You just can't beat it! The cake batter soft serve is great. Pralines and Cream and Strawberries and Cream hand scooped flavors don't even taste like yogurt. They'd totally fool me! They're SO GOOD and creamy. 

Drinks: n/a

Atmosphere: It's very start and simple, but hey, it's a yogurt shop. They do have benches outside and a drive-thru. I feel like they cover all the bases.

Service: Super sweet and friendly. It's not a 5-star restaurant... it's almost always kids who work there who are earning a couple extra bucks. This is most likely their first job. Give them credit, they do a great and superb job!

Happy Hour Offerings: While they don't have happy hour, they do have daily specials! Make sure to check the sign posted out front for the deal of the day!

Healthy Hack: Wanting a little bit of a treat? Try a dairy-free sorbet to cut calories or go for a kid's size. 

Tips: n/a

We arrived around 10:30 with a party of 5 for Sunday brunch. There are 7 or 8 outdoor tables and there were patrons at only 2 of them. It was perfect weather to be seated outside.  
We were surprised to see so many people waiting for tables as there were 3 or 4 available inside as well as those outside. We were told there was a 20 minute wait. 
I watched as some people left when the wait time stretched out. Our wait was about 23 minutes. We were seated inside despite our request to dine outside. We were told that they prefer to "group people together" to make it easier on staff. 
Our waitress was quite pleasant and efficient at keeping drinks on the table. 
The food was just OK. 2 of my grand children ordered strawberry French toast. One got 8-10 strawberries. The other got 4. It was more of a decoration and shouldn't have added to the cost of the meal, but it did. The rest of the food was good but not exceptional. 
We noticed that the patio tables were full when we left. 
We won't be going back. It wasn't worth the wait or the money.
Jim helped us find and train the perfect dog for our family. Great trainers, fun classes - especially the trails class.

I love Garbonzo's Pizza! This location is just as good as the Caldwell location! I ordered a small pizza this time and I was so happy that the toppings were just as plentiful! The staff was friendly! I ordered for dine in and had the place to myself. I noticed a sign outside that said "Pizza buffet lunch special $7.50(?) with drink. My cashier was really great about up selling. She almost convinced me to grab dessert to take home, apparently there is money bread for dessert! I can't wait to go back!

They just don't stack up to the other breakfast spots in town. 
You open their menu and everything is overpriced. There's no cheap options AT ALL. It also has a dirty feel inside even though it's not necessarily. 

I just can't stomach going here when there's - not only way better prices elsewhere - but Joe Mama's and Moe Joe's food is wayyyyyy better. 

Nice people though.

If I could give a NO STAR it would be appropriate.  Sunday between  2pm & 3pm , less than 10 tables of customers and it took forever to get 2 burgers. Mine had everything I asked for and the items I asked not to be on it.  My wife asked for her burger "Rare". It came well done. Fries were luke warm and lacked the crispiness that good fries have.

I was immediately struck my the friendliness of the staff, everyone was talkative and nice and served with a smile. The food was very good, haven't had a chicken friend steak that good in a long time!

I have been going to Marnie since October of 2016. She, from the start has been a great groomer for my dog but also professional and a swift to complete the job. Ry is an easy dog to love but just ask him if he 'is ready to get a bath' and watch him light up and begin to go in circles hoping it will be soon. She is marvelous and I have recommended her to many. Thanks Marnie
We were so sick of the crappy (delivery) pizza joints in town. This place was so refreshing to find. The monkey bread is killer. Our out of town guests were even impressed!

Wonderful food! First time visit tonight and we will definitely be back. Gnocchi and step steak were perfect, chocolate torte was heaven.  Nice dinner with appetizer, 2 entrees, drinks and dessert for $75, well worth it!.  My new favorite place.

Some of the best pizza in the area. Love the combinations of pizzas. Been here when both busy and slow. The staff is great, salad bar is great and beer variety is great. Only thing is when it's busy there is limited seating but, can't do much about that.

I love Menchie's!!  They have a good array of frozen yogurt flavors and toppings.  I stop in for a treat once a week.  Get the rewards card if you go often, it really adds up.  Cute decor and friendly service.

Free wifi and ammex big tables.  Pretty solid breakfast joint in the middle of a Boise Idaho strip mall.  Had the breakfast burrito.. I was like having a small ocean container on a plate.  great flavoring.  The place wasn't too crowded on a weekday and the staff was happy to let us linger around and finish up some e-mails

Pretty good food, great prices, and super friendly service. Over all this is a great place to have breakfast. The food isn't amazing but it's good and consistent. I'll definitely go back. Oh, and they have an extension gluten free menu.

Great place in downtown Meridian. Husband had Gunslinger Breakfast Burrito, served with gravy-amazing! I had avocado toast with bacon- delightful! Coffee good too!

2nd visit-We had the Tree Hugger & Huevos Rancheros. Just as good as 1st visit! It is apparent that they take pride I. The quality & plating. Another happy breakfast!

First time for lunch.  Extensive and flavorful gluten free menu.  

Good lunch and friendly service

Sometimes life gives you challenges that you don't expect, and that are difficult to solve.  One puzzle that continues to present itself to my extended family over and over is "Where can we go to eat?"  Why is this such a hard problem?  One person doesn't like beef.  One person can't eat dairy.  One person doesn't like tomatoes. One person is just stubborn about whatever gets chosen. One person is kind of picky in general. There are two small children (ask me to show you pictures of my granddaughters sometime when you have an hour or two to kill). Well last Sunday Chipotle Grill presented itself as a solution to our puzzle that day.

The fast-food mexican food was pretty good, and there is a variety of things on the menu to satisfy a broad range of tastes.  The place is family friendly, so bring the kids and grandkids all you want. The price is right for a big family lunch too.

I had a large window in my living room replaced. A pane had been broken for years, so there was some sheet rock damage at the very bottom of the window. The customer service desk was highly accommodating and professional, and got my work scheduled in 4 days. A local competitor claimed tempered glass always took two full weeks to order. I was thrilled to get this done so quickly. The service window was scheduled between 2-5pm and I called the service desk to tell them I had an appointment in Boise at 6:45, and I would appreciate either getting a firmer time, or rescheduling. The service tech said he would be there close to 3pm. He showed up exactly at 5pm. I was desperate to get the job done, so I told him to proceed. He replaced the window and sealed it, but because the sheet rock damage at the bottom, he did not replace ANY of the trim, or caulk it, as initially quoted. He simply changed the wording in the final bill. I would have just told him to do the work, but since he showed up so late, and the basic install took over an hour, I didn't have time to wait for the trim work. I paid my handyman extra dollars to do that part, AND the Glass Doctor tech did not reduce my bill. I give them 3 stars "A-OK" rating  because they finished the job within the time frame quoted, and it appears to be sound.  I'm glad the job is done, but I would have rather have that rare and wonderful experience where I felt like a highly valued customer.

I called Caden TV after Samsung had referred me to their Authorized Samsung Center.  I discovered it was in Sunnyvale and that they charged to pick up and deliver.  Believe it was $60.00 each way.  I looked them up and found their reviews were mostly negative.  I didn't want to chance it.  As they get all referrals I believed they couldn't devote the time needed to repair my TV responsibility.  I checked online for a shop near where I live which is San Jose.  Luan (owner) is such a pleasant person.  He listened to my problem and felt that my tv had the backlight burn out.  He came out and checked it and it turned out he was right.  He took the TV to his shop and in less than a week I had it back in my home.  Plus it came with the Samsung warranty on the part he replaced.  I will recommend his business to my family and friends.  You won't be sorry.

Best in the breakfast and lunch business.  My fave is the ham and cheese omelet with hashbrowns and toast.  Hubby's fave is the biscuits and gravy with bacon and egg.  Never have had bad service from any server.  Great place to work apparently due to the length of time the servers have worked there.  Worth the wait during breakfast rush times!!!!  Love love love!!!!

This place was the worst, the food was bland and tasteless, they give you like 3 pounds of hash browns, not even cooked through to mention. The only good thing about this place was the customer service, the staff was nice but felt like I was eating in a soup kitchen for the needy
Very pleasant to work with.  Called...came in 30mins...fixed and very reasonable.  Will be calling them again for all future work on our televisions.  Thank you again Caden TV

Oh how I love Flying Pie - and how exciting that there is now a Meridian location! But I have to agree, it was not the Flying Pie experience I have come to know and love. The reception was a bit chaotic - after waiting in line, a super friendly employee directed us to the back bar where we could do some beer tasting. The bar tender was less than enthusiastic to help us and it seemed like more of a pain to him that we were asking for samples.
Which is disappointing as their menu encourages sampling. And thats what's so great about Flying Pie; their customer service, funky atmosphere, giving back to the community, etc. 
Free breadsticks - yes, please! Buy one pizza, get another 1/2 off - hello! The pies were really good - the place just didn't have the vibe we have come to know and love. Maybe in the next few months they will work out the flow of seating, ordering, etc. I hope so as they have such a great thing going on!
I live no more than 1 mile from this shop, and they were trying to charge 35.00 for an estimate. No thanks. I can only imagine how expesive the repaire will be.

My friends and I went before an event and one of us got a burger, which looked amazing, but was way too spicy, and two of us got fish tacos (again, way too spicy). We all shared an order of the beer cheese fondue, which was watered down, but good flavor. They actually comped us for one order of fish tacos because it was basically inedible. Please work on the quality of your food (or at least advertise the spicy level), you have a great concept, but with all the restaurant choices, this would not be my first, second, .... or twentieth choice.
Food is great Maddie was awesome my girls loved her to the time to be personal with us. Thanks for the grear experience.
Definitely not worth a try. The service was very slow and the food was extremely bland and overpriced. My daughters meal was cold and there was no paper towels in the restroom. Skip this one.

Flew back to Idaho to visit my mom and at the top of the list was to have Debbie cut and color my hair.  I love my new color and style.  She is amazing!  Thank you Debbie, it's always a pleasure to come in and talk shop with you!

Love the new look. You can tell the owners/ operators really care. And the new food menu is awesome, they hired a really talented chef, that seems to really know what he's doing. Clean and legit. Awesome spot.

Amenities are nice but don't expect to get your deposit back! I got charged almost $100 for nail holes when I hadn't hung anything on the walls, the carpet cleaning was over $300 due to pet stains (a couple very small, and already cleaned spots mind you) because they replaced the pad, and other completely frivolous charges. The sad part is the manager at my complex was awesome, but moving out left a super bad taste in my mouth. 
I did try to reason with them, but they held firm. Seriously, over $500 from my deposit and I left a clean apartment after 6 months? The only reason you get 2 stars instead of 1 is because of Jaime at Brassy Cove.

My mom was in town and we decided to finally give this place a try and I'm so glad we did!  I had the French toast which was scrumptious but what really put it over the top were the Sassy apples they had on the side.  It's like warm apple pie filling.  So good!  Their Peasant potatoes are also delicious -- I stole those from my son's plate.  My daughter got their kids' pancake which was a pancake with a smily face on it in fruit.  She loved it.  All in all, we will definitely come back for more!  It wasn't very crowded when we went but it was a Wednesday morning -- I have seen it with a line out the door on a Sunday.

I hadn't hopped on the Panera crazy train yet, but I was in the shopping center and saw they were open so I figured I'd give it a try. The menu has many options; I went with a "Pick 2" combo with a steak and white cheddar panini and baked potato soup. I was told they were out of the baked potato, which I thought bizarre for it being mid-day. I went with the broccoli cheese soup instead. Jessica was my cashier and she was extremely pleasant and informative of the MyPanera rewards  program. When I picked up my food, I was somewhat disappointed with the size of the panini given the price. However, the flavor was good (especially if you like Dijon). The soup was hot and flavorful as well. The price seems on-par with similar sandwich shops in the area like Kneaders and Cafe Zupas. The dining area is comfortable with free wifi and lounge chairs by a fireplace. While I've yet to decide if Panera lives up to the hype, I will definitely be back to try the other selections on the menu and find a favorite.

We met friends at 6:30 tonight (Sunday). While the wait staff were very friendly, we waited for far too long-20-25 minutes--for our food and had to wait forever to get our bill paid as well. Food was meh. My beet salad was nice looking but the beets aren't really cooked so I had to leave most of them, which left me with maybe a cup of greens for dinner. My husband's prime rib sandwich was good--hence the two stars. Not worth it in the end.

This is my new favorite for breakfast!  The Monte Cristo Crepes are Ahhh-Mazing! My husband said that his Eggs Benedict was one of the best he's ever had! Love the service and the restaurant atmosphere as well!

Great chain and food is fresh and wonderful.   Steak cooled to perfection where at other chains the steak tends to be a little tough.   Met a girl who told the history and story of the first Chipotle she use to go to in CO.  Very cool.

Overall, I thought this place had solid breakfast and lunch options.  Stopped by Le Peep in the late morning so a few of us ordered breakfast and a few ordered lunch.  The restaurant itself was clean and featured some pictures of great local scenery.  The waitstaff was friendly enough and the food came out hot and in a timely manner.  The menu had a lot of different options for both breakfast and lunch some of which included locally sourced ingredients.  The Denver omelette I ordered was satisfying although the filling was a little watery.  The breakfast potatoes and toast that came with it were pretty good.  My fiancé ordered the sirloin steak sandwich with sweet potato fries.  He said the sirloin was tender and the bread was crispy.  All in all he enjoyed the sandwich although he thought the bread to meat ratio was a little off - wished there was more meat.  We would probably stop by again for a quick lunch or breakfast.
Went for a Saturday afternoon lunch. Food was okay, but awfully pricey for a burger at around $13. Good beer, but again pretty pricey. Restaurant was clean and staff was nice.
Love this place, great food ,huge portions. Eat inside, not drive thru. Healthy options a little expensive, but worth it! Desserts are excellent for that sweet tooth as well
Tried twice, both times food was DISAPPOINTING .  Service not too bad but that doesn't make up for the food. Definitely need to work on perfecting the menu

My second and last visit. The yogurt is great, but a gift card I was given wasn't honored even though I had the activation receipt. When I paid with cash they were unable to give me change, as there were no coins in the drawer. There were dirty fingerprints all over every sign, the fudge bottles were empty and covered with syrup dripping down the sides. Water bottles were for sale but cooler was empty.

I LOVE LOVE LOVE this cafe! The coffee and food is very good. The place is always clean. The employees and owner are extremely friendly. The location is great, too. I really enjoy walking downtown and getting coffee from here.

Came in here and Bought the Resort Series Monaco; best hot tub I've ever owned. Friends and family love it! I never float in the lounger and it feels like a true massage every time. No issues whatsoever and the owner Michael gave me an amazing deal and set it up perfectly on my patio. Clearwater spas really are the best. I used to have a Cal spa and there was just one issue after the next with it. It broke almost every week on me. I can only go with a Clearwater now thanks four seasons spa and pool!!

Went in at about 5:30 Tuesday 3/8 and the girl that was working was FANTASTIC! Her customer service was right on and she was generally happy help me when I had questions about selling my designer sunglasses. She even looked up pricing online and told me about consignment options. Grade A customer service and I will most definitely be back. 

I have only been in the store that time but I found it a breath of fresh air compared to other stores like it because it was well organized and not cramped and crowded. The prices were also great! I can't wait to come back and do some more shopping.

I bought a Groupon for this location because the deal was too good to pass up and I needed a Brazilian. Cost is never a good deciding factor when it comes to where to get a Brazilian but I took the chance. What a great decision it was!!
Shea was great! If it wasn't for her I probably would have tapped out early and left with a mohawk. The process was extremely painful but Shea kept me talking & distracted the whole time, encouraging me to stay tough.
The experience was more painful than I had remembered (or prepared myself for mentally). Maybe  because this salon uses a sugar based "wax" instead of the heated wax?  
In the end, the results were and still are great a week later!  Worth the pain 100%! Thanks Shea!

I ordered BLT sandwich, which came with fresh salad. Both tasted very good. It was a Friday noon time. Sitting at the patio, watching the world goes by, sipping a nice coffee is truly pleasant experience.

Update! Same exact dust bunnies everywhere, no more towel service.
Not vacuuming and cleaning daily is alarming. All sorts of bro fungus festering in here - you're going to get sick. Very sick. 

Alright settle in, kids - Iceman's gonna drop some real talk on you here:

First of all, this is a brand new facility that somehow manages to remain pretty filthy. Don't believe me, Axiom staff? Take a peek around your jungle gym station - pretty sure those dust bunnies have established a political structure and are launching a space program soon. 
You've had a broken faucet in the men's locker room for a month. Inexcusable. 
You have an uncovered towel drop in the locker room, which is not particularly sanitary but more so is just disgusting, especially when it's the first thing you see upon entering.
The one or two maintenance people you employ are friendly and industrious, but you need more of them. If you go to any quality fitness club in a major city, you will see staff cleaning not only the locker rooms, but the equipment itself at least once an hour. I have yet to see anyone cleaning equipment at this location. That is troubling.
It should not be the responsibility of the member to spray the equipment - people are lazy and just won't do it. If you want them to wipe down machines, replace the spray bottles with Clorox wipes. It's easier and you won't have soggy used rags soaking up bacteria all over your facility. 
Your water fountains are visibly harboring mold cultures and probably shouldn't be used until you figure out how to clean them. Inexcusable. 

Moving on... 

Front desk staff are the typical disinterested college types, normally seen texting and avoiding eye contact rather than even faking good customer service. 
I'm not sure if there is any in-club management - if there is, he/she/they are not visible which tells me that they don't really care. 

Next, can we please for the love of Goose's widow lose the '80s and '90s pop music??? You are the only gym not named Curves that still plays that crap. 
You want the truth in fitness? Your music blows. At least stock some headphones in your shop area for those who may experience suicidal tendencies from your playlist.

Next, why do you have multiple TRX stations, but no TRXs available for anyone to use? Are you that concerned of theft? Why not purchase a few of the handy dandy TRX ceiling mounts? 

Why do you have a "track" if one lane serves no purpose other than to house your kettlebells and rowing machines? Poor design as well, as the far lane isn't even really a whole lane because of the nearby windows. 

Which is a nice segue to the next point - lack of equipment as a result of poor layout and lack of space. 
Hex deadlift bar? Nope. 
ViPRs? Nope. 
Dual cable/pull-up station? Nope. (Side note, how can you have ONE cable station for an entire facility? That is absurd, especially during peak hours.)
Oh, but we've got curl bars up the wazoo! You can do curls all day here at Axiom. No waiting!
Again, the whole truth in fitness thing is a joke. Axiom was absolutely taken to the cleaners by whomever coined that tagline. 
The truth in fitness is that a decline bench serves no practical purpose and you have several machines that can cause serious injury as they promote dysfunctional movement and harmful torque - Smith machine, quad/hamstring extensions, etc. 
Imagine what you could have done with the space occupied by unnecessary equipment and your "Cardio Theater". Rather than have two people ride a stationary bike while watching Caddyshack, you could have installed more practical equipment and training space, which right now is virtually nonexistent. 

And how about a no cell phone policy? That's a no brainer in this day and age. It's one thing to keep your workout on your mobile device for reference, but there is absolutely no place for phone calls on the fitness floor or in the locker room. 
(Hey management, this would be a great opportunity for you to come out of your cave and establish a presence!)

As the Treasure Valley continues to grow, it's only a matter of time before a LifeTime Fitness or Equinox moves in and puts Axiom out to pasture. This is a convenient, low-cost option geared towards bros and people who like to listen to Garth Brooks and Mariah Carey while they work out. Poor atmosphere, poor customer service, poor layout. 

This is all a reflection on the corporate strategy, or lack thereof. The branding and marketing is illogical - there is no "truth in fitness" reflected in anything happening in this facility, and the hyped-up Perx program offers incentives to pizza parlors and tanning beds, which, last I checked, were not the cornerstones of a healthy lifestyle. 

As someone who has spent his entire life in front of a mirror flashing his pearly whites, the Iceman knows a thing or two about gyms. Without serious investments in marketing and operations, Axiom is headed for a rude awakening. Book it.

Iceman

Interesting place, real local vibe. I come here frequently for their pizza buffet which is a great deal. Wish their soda selection was better, but what they lack in soda they make up for in beer. Great choices on tap, always something new to try. Pepperoni is my fav! So good!

Run- don't walk- in the opposite direction. I cannot stress enough how much I regret bringing my business to Park Place Property Management. My experience was terrible, start to finish. I didn't feel like the staff were knowledgeable or friendly, and even if they had been, I couldn't get ahold of my own property manager during the two years I lived in their apartments. Repeated phone calls and emails during a wide range of normal business hours over the course of months went totally unanswered. On move-out it didn't seem to matter how well we cleaned; we were never getting our refundable security deposit back, even in part. It's not just us- no one I've talked to that had the misfortune of going through Park Place ever received a reasonable refund on their deposit either. I wouldn't recommend this company to anyone.

I've gone to a lot of really awesome frozen yogurt places, so I honestly wasn't expecting much from this one.  But it was so good!  Small place compared to some that we have around here, but the flavor choices are so much better!  I wish they had a few more fruit topping options, but honestly I was really impressed with it over all.  The staff friendliness was spot on too.  I've found my new yogurt place! MMmmmmmmm

There was a short wait, we gave our name, and got a text when the ramble was ready. Awesome, we went to the nearby grocery store while we waited. 
Restaurant is bright and clean. Big fluffy pancakes were excellent. All the food was just what we hoped for. We got 2 lumberjack breakfasts and an omelette. 
They even asked if we wanted a gluten free menu which we will next time when I bring my husband. Go to Le Peep for breakfast!
my favorite place to have breakfast!!! the staff is super friendly, and nothing beats their food! try the cinnamon roll French toast!!!!!

Seriously  love this place, I love the food, I love the attention to detail, I love the whole pot of coffee they bring you to your table, I love the staff, love how reasonable the prices are and how generous the portions are... LOVE LOVE LOVE Le peep

Great service and food! Last time I was here (several months ago) the service was poor and the food slow. My waiter this time was efficient, courteous and stopped by just the right amount to check on me. Thanks Juan! -A lot more male servers this time. They were all very friendly, well groomed, classy and efficient. 
I had the White Lightening egg white omelet. Amazing, not greasy, with a nice salsa side. And food came out with good speed. Plating was appealing, and portions were more than I could down.
Only improvement I could say is very loud inside. Everyones conversation echoes.
I would come again. I am re-converted. :)
I was just visiting from out of town but Robb treated me as if I would be a client for life.  Took a lot of time to match my color and cut my hair.   Good service. Good haircut!

If you're looking for the cheapest price - I'll flat out tell you, you're not going to find it here. If you're looking for reliable, friendly service and thorough work - call them. And be honest with them about what your situation is. They WILL work with you to provide a variety of solutions. One year, they triaged the repairs over the course of several months so it didn't hit me all at once. I will always use them for HVAC service.

The place is a bit quirky, but that's ok.  The process of ordering is a bit odd, grab a menu, find a seat and come up to the counter when ready to order.  OK, got that.  The problem is the length of time it takes to get a pizza, nearly an hour.  I've had pizza all over the world and nowhere does it take that long.  But, the pizza is good with a nice crispy crust.
The person working the counter seemed to be the only one working the floor.  There's a lot of shouting and activity, but not a lot getting done.  It appears they could benefit from some actual management and enough people to clean tables and bring the food when it's ready.
High quality pizza, it's been very good every time we've gone.  I recommend it.  The staff has always been very accommodating, it's a family run business and they do a great job.

Great company to work with.  Austin, Brook, Stephanie and Shaun has all been fantastic.  They are quick to respond, have great follow through and are flexible when working with your schedule.  HIGHLY recommend this company if you are looking for any property in the Treasure Valley area.

We tried this place for the first time last week and were much impressed.  We tried the typical fare of eggs basted with a side of corned beef hash plus an order of crepes stuffed with ricotta and blueberry compote.  For a hot beverage we went with a pot of the house roast coffee.  All of the food was excellent, the service was prompt and helpful, and since we were fairly early it was not crowded.  The interior is pleasant, simple with concrete floors, and minimal décor.  What I also find appealing is that the entryway is enclosed, so that one is shielded from extreme temperatures.  I did notice a bench or two there so that if there is a wait it can be a comfortable one.  Another couple of perks on the menu---fresh orange juice and specialty coffees.  A keeper and a place we will probably frequent!
Super super super sweet and nuget cinnamon rolls. Fun for kids and adults alike for a once in awhile sweet treat. Actually preferred the edible cookie dough over the cinnamon rolls.

Love this place! I was hungry and you fed me I was thirsty and you gave me something to drink! I needed Internet and it was easy. So friendly and caring and just the perfect place to get some work done! I will be back.

Loved it. Ate here on a road trip. Really glad they did. Very celiac friendly. They have a complete separate gluten free menu. My husband and I had a yummy gluten free waffle. The staff was very helpful. Service was good and I would recommend this if you're looking for a quick place to have breakfast/brunch.

I might have given them another star if we didn't spend $27+ on lunch for two people.  Expectations are a little higher for this semi-gourmet fast food place.  I had their new Asian soup(can't remember the exact name) which would have been great if it was hot and not just barely warm.  Very healthy and tasty ingredients.  Also had the steak and arugula sandwich which was very tasty but they made the mistake of having ice cold meat in it.  It's okay to have the makings cool but ice cold takes from the experience.  The pickled onions on it were fantastic though.

I have taken dogs through nearly every training approach in the valley and I can say that Sit Means Sit has been the most effective dog training for my dogs to date.  I have a younger dog who went through their immersion training program and, while he isn't perfect, because of his training we can deal with his bad behaviors quickly, humanely, and effectively.  I have also taken my older dog through their basic obedience class and found it to be just what his soft, ready-to-please heart needed.  Like with any dog training method, the human HAS to listen, learn, apply, and maintain the training with the right energy and attitude.  I think Sit-Means-Sit is well worth the time and money!

I wish I had an expansive enough vocabulary to accurately describe ParkPlace Property Management, but I don't know any words with a negative enough connotation to do it justice. 

My entire experience renting under this management has been beyond dreadful. I was so excited to move into such a beautiful complex for such a low price. For less than a standard one bed/one bath I had a gorgeous 3 bed/2 Bath with outdoor storage, a washer and dryer, granite countertops, covered parking, and all utilities aside from power included. It was a beautiful property in the perfect location, and it almost felt too good to be true. Enter ParkPlace. 

I would now gladly pay an extra thousand a month on a one bedroom to be under any other management company. They violated our lease agreement, adding late charges on the fourth instead of the fifth when the lease clearly states you have until end of business on the fifth to pay without penalty. I called, and the CSR girl rudely tried to explain that "The lease isn't legally binding because, like, it's a grace period and we can charge whenever we want to." Now, I'm no attorney, but last time I checked signing a legally binding agreement makes it, well, legally binding. I kindly tried to explain that to her so we could correct the mistake and move on. Eventually, I just paid the extra $100 because it was easier than dealing with someone who was clueless about her own workplace policies. (Worse, this is a common problem. So much so that the neighbors have an attorney and are working on a lawsuit.) 

Maintenance almost never came, and no one called me back. Every time I called with a question someone would rudely brush me aside. My debit card was stolen at an airport right after switching banks, so I went into the office to pay by check and the CSR rolled her eyes and lectured me in being "so inconvenient." 

And to add a cherry on top of an already bad experience, I found a TV hooked into private Ethernet with mobile sharif capability chords that can be wired and rewired with cameras if desired behind a two way mirror in my bathroom and spent days in a police investigation. My CSR said that "they knew about that and I don't need to be worried." I had to consult an attorney and the police force and go in several times with an appeal before ParkPlace even bothered to address the situation, and after I explained that I didn't care that "it was an awesome feature" because I did not sign off on having such worrisome technology in the mirror of my BATHROOM they finally let me out of the lease. I am now paying extra for a smaller place under other management, and I absolutely will not be renting from them again. In fact, I want nothing to do with them again. 

Do yourself a favor and stay FAR AWAY from anything with their name on it.

The price is what got me to go and now I love the convenience.  I have been going to chiropractors for a long time and paying lots of money.  This is a quick alternative and I go regularly to stay aligned.  The other Dr.s would charge $40 to $60 each visit and after a while the adjustments would be repetitive and quick. At The Joint you have to be specific about what type of adjustments you want and start slow with a new Dr., as he gets to know you he can work deeper.

This management sucks!! They charged us for so many things when we moved out that were already broke or needed replaced before we moved in... Make sure you take pictures before you move in. Or just don't move in one of their places at all! They took our whole deposit and then some!

Normally  I don't  do a review  on a Restaurant on only one visit!  But I will make an exception for this place.  It's dialed in!  The restaurant spotless and clutter free!  This might sound weird but I really like the art work on the walls.  The service was calming.  Everyone  freindly and very happy to give recommendations on what to try.  I really like it when a waitress says things like "my favorite thing to eat here is"  or " you must try this it's so good". 

If your looking for a greasy spoon this is not the place.  This is more quality than quantity.  My breakfast  was very good. I wanted to try something a bit different  so I went with the Eggs Benedict which was highly recommended.  Normally  not a huge fan of hollandaise sauce because of other bad experiences. But I will tell you it's the best I've ever had and would put it on everything!  I would order it as a soup it's that good!  The only complaint would be I could of eaten a bit more... But my wife says I need to cut back some anyway so it was perfect!   This is a awesome  new restaurant that I recommend to everyone!

My wife and I ordered chicken fried steak and eggs.The breakfast was absolutely horrible!!! The hash browns were old and stale,burnt and cold.Told the waitress and another waitress overheard our conversation and came over to our table and they both explained how they have had  problems with the vendor that supplied their hash browns and they were getting a new vendor soon. Really?So you are going to continue serving old stale hash browns until you get a new vendor?And if you like frozen chicken fried steak patties that are bland this is your place!Eggs were great!

I hate this little place.  The service is horrible and served with a steaming bowl of douche.  

The wings are soggy and over sauced.... really not good at all.

After my third voyage to this generic little shit hole I have finally convinced myself that no wings are better than lazy servers and less than mediocre food.  I won't be back.

I gave 5 stars even though I wasn't the one who ate here.  My son lives in Idaho and we live in Oregon. We wanted to surprise him with dinner for his birthday so with a referral from one of his friends I called here. Tate, the young man who answered was extremely helpful. He helped me navigate the online menu and made several suggestions to enhance the meal. My son was surprised and very pleased! Thank you Tate and Flying Pie Pizza in Meridian! !

Wingers lives up to its name. Since its named wingers I have only ordered the wings here and am never disappointed very good. they are always crispy and the sauce has just the right amount of spice balanced with sweet and zesty. I have very rarely have had bad service here but it has happened from time to time.Good beer here too.

Started taking our Yorkie to Wags to Riches about a year or so ago; Brianna does a fantastic job. We adopted a Yorkie/Cairn Terrier mix a month ago from a local shelter...she was a mess. Wags to Riches made time to groom her last minute, which I was extremely grateful for. Brianna wasn't available, but Andrew was and he did a great job, too. Brianna's service has been consistent and all staff I've talked with is extremely friendly and knowledgeable.
Park Place Property Management has excellent customer service. We're very satisfied and will continue to use them to manage our rental property.

Amazing food! The marinara sauce is heavenly and the selection is great. The atmosphere is fun, but I am a hermit and it was a little loud and crowded (The lights were also pretty dusty and desperately need cleaning. Past that, a great little joint.
This place is great! The food is incredible and the atmosphere is awesome. A must to visit!!

I gave this place 3 stars because I love the atmosphere/ decor and the staff is friendly. However i do not encourage you to try their coffee, it is watered down and not flavorful. I have tried different coffee drinks from them but end up dissatisfied every time. They do make a yummy summer drink called " pink lady" which is delicious! It tastes like a fruity coconut spritz. Other than that I'm not impressed with the food either.

Called ahead for a dozen bagels and 2 speads to pick up for an early morning business meeting. I get there and I'm one of only 3 cars in the parking lot (they weren't busy - no line at the cash registers). 
They tell me, "We forgot your order... we'll get that right out to you." 
The girl is battling with the bagel slicer and I'm checking my watch. The manager comes out to me with a card. I'm thinking, "Alright.. a gift card for messing up my on order." 
No, it's a card for their web address to place orders to go. 
He politely tells me, "If you'd placed the order on-line rather than called it in, we wouldn't have forgotten about it."
Uh...OK.
Finally get the bagels to my office meeting... and someone has to get paper towels out of the bathroom because there's only 3 napkins in the Panera bag.

I've been to plenty of Panera locations and this is par for the course. Only went there because it was close by. Not again.

I hired Dynamic Car Detailing to clean the inside of the used car we just bought. Erick did an excellent job of removing all the old smells and stains and leaving it looking brand new.  We would definitely recommend this company to anybody needing a clean and shine job done. He made it so simple by picking up and delivering our car.

We decided to give Le Peep a try because of some family posts indicating it was good place to eat. Wow it did not disappoint the meal was perfect. If anyone has ever dealt with running whites at other locations La Peep has perfected the over easy way of cooking eggs. I believe we have found our new breakfast location.

Has tv's around the place and plenty of booths, but no bar to sit at and no NFL ticket to watch games not on the local channels. The food was good, not great, and the service was good. Probably won't ever be back though.

Went through the drive through and the girl at the window was nothing but rude and had a disgusting look on her face the whole time. Not only that but when I looked in the bag all of my food was upside down. My mozzarella sticks and corn dogs and ketchup were all over the bag.

The salad, smoothie, and scone were delicious! My big problem is I ordered a cup of chicken noodle soup, it smelled like Campbell's, and there was seriously 3 carrots, 5 noodles, and a couple pieces of chicken in it. Don't give me greasy broth with a couple of pieces of food and charge me around $3 for it.
A nice clean comfortable place. I had French roast brew coffee. Nice and strong and fresh. Decent selection of muffins and scones. Nice wait staff. Fast WIFI. Good seating. Pleasant place.

Barrel 55 exceeded our expectations as the venue for our rehearsal dinner! They were able to accommodate, and definitely impressed 50 of our closest friends and family. They created a private section of the restaurant where we weren't bothered by other guests and could socialize and have fun with our party. The whole staff was so awesome, they treated us like family and even helped us set up and decorate! Coordinating the event was so pleasant(unlike dealing with some of the chain restaurants in town& it was nice to keep it local!)...The manager Chase and also the owner were willing to work with us to make it perfect and stay within budget- Chef Dana even offered to customize a menu for the bride and groom... and he hit it out of the park! (He even made an Asian dish my grandpa would have been proud of and also made sure everything was gluten free so those with issues didn't have to worry.) Everything was soo delicious! Flavors were awesome, Service was wonderful! I would definitely recommend barrel55 to anyone! Especially for an event!

So we were driving through on a road trip and it always seems you make the worst decisions when you're hangry.
I'll be honest. Everyone here was super friendly but this place is total crap! The dipping sauce for the breadsticks is straight tomato paste with some spices. It was baaad. The pizzas we got were super bland and just terrible. HARD PASS.

Great burger and beer. Carmelized onion and bacon burger was great! Nice thick patty with plenty of cheese and bacon. Felt like there could've been a few more onion rings. Jess was great, basically working bar and tables mostly by herself on a busy Friday evening.

We enjoyed our visit. Great food, extremely tender chicken fried steak, generous portions and very friendly and attentive service from everyone serving. The restaurant was bright and very clean. Would definitely recommend for a pleasant,and filling breakfast

I was looking for a place to eat lunch with my wife halfway between her work and mine (meridian).  Saw Flying pie on yelp and decided to try it.  My son raves about this place so I had to try it.  It was really GOOD!!!  The lunch special was a pizza buffet with salad bar for $7.50.  The pizzas were amazing with plenty of toppings and melted cheese.  The more the lunch crowd showed up, the quicker they put out pizzas.  There were 6 different kinds of pizzas and there were always three of them out at any given time.  Even as many people seemed to get up at the same time and rush the buffet, there were still plenty of choices for everyone.

By the time we left the place was completely packed, which isn't surprising, given the quality of food!

We just found a place to meet for lunch from now on.

Fantastic food & awesome service! Our waitress was Rachel H. I haven't been receiving the best of service at other restaurants so it was great going to the Barrel 55 for the first time and receiving fantastic service. Rachel H. was awesome at her job and I could tell that she genuinely cared about her tables. I would go back 100% to this restaurant just because of Rachel. Our food was very good too but overall customer service from Rachel was over 5 stars worth!

The team at Modern printers are competent, friendly, helpful and most of all accommodating.
Their services are fairly priced compared to internet and box stores. I highly recommend them.

Typical pizza joint. Nice environment, clean dining area and bathrooms. The cashier was knowledgeable and helpful. 

Prices are standard. No waiting and the pizza came out quick. It wasn't crowded either. 

Thumbs up!

Best hair cut I have had in years!  It was my first visit to this shop and I will be back.
Miranda was awesome and listened to what I wanted!
I will become a regular!

My wife and I stopped in for breakfast for the first time. The service was outstanding (thanks Jess) and the dark roast coffee was the way I like it. I had the stuffed french toast and my wife had the Roma skillet.  Both were great.  We'll definitely be back...even with all the other great breakfast joints we now have.  Welcome to Meridian Le Peep!

The pie always tastes great, sometimes there's a topping missing, but what has frustrated me is that it is sliced extremely carelessly that it makes it difficult to eat, let alone share with the family evenly. This has happened EVERY time I have ordered pizza here. I'm optimistic that each time I order, it will be sliced "normally" but it never is. I suppose I'm at the point to blantantly asking them to put a little more effort into slicing it - I feel awful for asking, but I'd really rather have evenly sliced pizza slices... has anyone else experienced this? I did leave a photo as well.

What a great locally owned place! I got a new fence lock and needed two tumblers re-keyed. I was in and out of the door within 5 minutes with the two tumblers, 1 house key, and 1 mailbox key. Price was EXTREMELY fair! I will continue to use Minuteman for any lock/key related needs! And I suggest you do the same!!!
Got the Old Skool Roll and absolutely loved it. Bun was fresh and the frosting was deliciously fluffy! I'll definitely be back for more. Can't wait to customize my own roll!

Great little place. Our server Samantha was very nice and apologetic as we had a dinner menu when they were only serving breakfast and lunch. The serve breakfast until 4:00 which allowed my wife to get a bowl of yogurt with granola and fresh berries while I had grits. I would have preferred either the dip or chicken breast sandwich but they were only available after 4:00.

The specialty mexican coffee was very good.

Looking back at my posts I see that I've written a string of sour, negative reviews. Well, that can't be good for a person's mental health. Thankfully I just now remembered that I've not reviewed one's of my favorite breakfast cafes! 

The food and staff are Five Star all the way. Many of the staff proudly wear T-shirts that show how many years they've worked at Express Cafe: 5 years, 10 years, 15 and more! That says a whole lot more about the quality and atmosphere of this establishment than my puny words can convey. 

We've eaten at Express Cafe several times, always a satisfying experience. We've consistently been greeted at the door by a cheerful host, wait times have been minimal, servers friendly and prompt, and food delicious and copious. Saturday mornings are very busy for them, so expect to be given a pager and wait for 10 minutes or so. But the wait is SO worth it. 

It's all good, but my favorite is biscuits and gravy, eggs over easy, hash browns and sausage, and great coffee.
Usual Panera so a 3 for food. Unfortunately this is the dirtiest Panera I've been. Had to clean the table myself. There were plenty of tables available, about 10. Just all dirty.

Very expensive and sad food. We got 2 bowls of pasta $17 and $18 respectively. I don't mind spending the money but a $18 bowl of pasta better do more than fill my belly. I won't be back to this place. It was disappointing.  I can get a cold beer almost anywhere in town.

I first visited Flying Pie during the mid-1980s, at the Fairview location and the former BSU shop next to the Suds tavern. I then spent more than two decades in western Oregon, but would drop by when I was in town visiting. Pizza and service were always top-notch.

I was surprised by the negative comments directed at the Meridian store regarding poor service. Many of them came from folks who have eaten at the Boise locations and are fans of the Flying Pie. 

My brother and his wife and I went in today for the seasonal habanero pizza, triple hab edition. The servers were friendly and attentive and the habs were smoking. 

They didn't bring us any ice cream, so they must have seen we weren't struggling with the heat. Maybe they'll add a quad hab next year. Ha.

Good: great beer selection and nice bar area along with outdoor seating.

Bad: My wife and I wife decide to try this place on a Friday night about 5:00 pm. We sat in the bar and were greeted by a nice server. She informed us they were out of the artichoke appetizer, finger steak appetizer and something else. Thought it was weird to be out of three items on the appetizer menu for such a new restaurant at 5:00 pm on a Friday. We ordered a couple beers and the fondue which was suppose to come out with bread and grilled Brussels sprouts. When it arrived, fondue was cold and no Brussels sprouts. When I mentioned it, the server checked and came back to tell us they also ran out of Brussels sprouts. Odd this wasn't mention before the dish was served? I didn't ask, but was expecting a discount on the appetizer, but none was given. Not sure if we will give this place a second try.

James and Luke were fast and friendly! They came out to do my regular service on my a/c and they were took care of business and had things up and running in no time. I called Monday and they were out Tuesday. I'd recommend them to my friends and family.

Mild roast is a choice, the potatoes are cooked to crispy hash brown perfection, and the Monte Cristo crepes are so delicious that when I come back I'll have to remember to remind myself that the other selections sounded just as good. 

Happy Wednesday to me!

I wouldn't suggest going here during lunch time on the weekends. The restaurant was VERY full and it ended up being a 20 minute wait for a salad and some mac and cheese. I wasn't a fan of the buzzer system. It's difficult to manage several plates by yourself when you're out with children alone and the tables aren't within view of the pick-up area. You end up having to drag your kids up to the front with you and had my daughter not been of walking age, it wouldn't have been doable. The food was pretty good, but the kid's meal I bought for my daughter was way too hot and she had to wait an additional five or six minutes for it to cool down after already waiting the 20 minutes for them to make the food. My ceasar salad was a little small for the price tag, but the roll it came with was yummy. The cookie we bought wasn't all that great. Between my sweets-loving toddler and I, we didn't end up wanting to finish the M&M cookie. It wasn't a terrible experience, just a little disappointing and inconvenient. I don't plan on going back.

Recently moved into Meridian area, love this cute coffee shop. Delicious coffee and scrumptious food. It's like a home from home .. if you're in town stop by you won't be disappointed.  It's not fancy upscale place, but very cozy and warm. Great place to catch up with a friend or do some reading or catch up on your homework..

If it is possible to give this place 0 stars I would.  First time I ate there the food was horrible.  I had ordered the new chicken burrito that is being advertised on the commercials and it was not good.  It was cold, chicken was rubbery, and the supposed guacamole sauce was anything but guacamole sauce.  Guess they forgot the avacados when they made the sauce.  
So today on my way to work, I stopped in to give it one more chance.  There was two other cars in the drive thru at the time.  I sat there for a minute or so and then said I was ready to order.  I heard a voice that said "You will need to wait a minute".  I thought that that was slightly rude and they must be busy.  As I sat there I noticed that the other 2 drivers had this very exasperated look on their faces.  No food or money exchanged hands.  I looked at my watch and noticed that I had been sitting there for 8 minutes with not a peep from the person with the headset.  I said "Hello" and got a "I said I will be with you in a minute".  So instead of being late for work I drove off insearch of somewhere else to drop a few dimes too instead of going in  and wasting my breath on the manager.  STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE!!!  I know its fast food but come on, it shouldnt totally suck.

I'm giving three stars based on service. The food was good but service was lacking. Is it to hard to run a check for a customer when they inform you ahead of time that they're going to be pressed for time and ask for the check when placing the order? I did this and had the waitress tell me I had to take it to the counter one I was done. So I get to the counter and end up waiting for 5+ minutes for the counter person to ring me up only to have them tell me the waitress could have run it for meif I had asked. Well I had so so much for good food, poor customer service will cost you mind and my family's future business.

Arrived in a Sunday for brunch & for two people, we waited less than five minutes. We could have coffee or water while we waited. We were given a buzzer that went outside & into the parking lot. It was our first time here & we were thoroughly impressed with the quality of the food, selection & service. Ordered the veggie burrito on a whole wheat wrap, subbed hash browns for home fries, served with guacamole & salsa on the side. 

No wonder these guys have been in business so long, they do everything right!
Menchie's is awesome and delicious.  I did learn however if you put every topping on your ice cream it's gross.  You have to try the honeydew ice cream, it will blow your mind!!

Bread is too tough, food prices don't match the lack of quality. Go to Cafe Zuppas where everything is soooooo delicious! (Apparently this review could only be written if I worked at Zupas... As if to advertise for them? I am in no way affiliated with the Zupas restaurant, just a very happy customer. And VERY disappointed with Panera. Enough said.)

Friendly servers, cold beer and wings...not a bad start...

The atmosphere is just what you'd expect from a generic sports pub located in a Meridian strip mall.  TVs for miles and blue collar workers dowsing the flames of mediocrity with barley and hops.  God bless America...

The bartender was damn proud of their wings, in particular the garlic & Parmesan variety. So, I tried them.  They weren't "spank my ass and call me Margret" good, nor did they have me rubbing my balls for an hour....They were definitely better than most anything you will find in the valley but don't compare to the Bitter Creek wings. 

Overall,  this place has the same vibe as most sports pubs albeit cleaner than most.  Not a lot of character but a good starting place to meet after work.

On the upside, the waitress at least had the courtesy to display her enormous Tttt talents.

Excellent breakfast.  We were seated promptly within a few minutes on a busy weekend.  Tables were spread out so nicely, it didn't feel cramped liked most restaurants.  I tried the Chicken Fried Steak and it was the best I have had in a while.  My wife had the Breakfast Burrito and she liked it as well.  Prices were good, service was excellent.  We will definitely be back to try other things.

This is the type of good you would expect from a breakfast only restaurant. Excellent waffles and gravy on the chicken fried steak. However the chicken fried steak was not homemade which is a letdown and hard to come by these days. Very expensive for a breakfast place and price does not adjust for children's options.

Wonderful place full of happy faces and great service. Busy day, Mother's Day and all are working hard. Roses for both my sister and I and great coffee. They have a menu that many can choose from and it looks to have a private room to use for a large group. The women make wonderful goodies as well and our 6.00 dessert plate from the dessert bar. Don't pass this gem up! Happy Mother's Day!
My Samsung tv had no picture. They came by and figured out what was wrong right away. Replaced the bad board. Good as new. Very professional.
great food and atmosphere is excellent..the hours for business however are not..closed by 2 makes it hard for the working class to get there for lunch

This was my first time in at this location. It is a brand new place and super chic! I loved it! I came from Vegas and was SO happy when they opened this location. The customer service was fantastic, the food was great and the wait time was super short. I will be back for sure!

Frequented this location since it's opening. Very friendly staff and the food is always excellent. Only small thing is that the menu doesn't list everything on each item so you just need to ask the cashiers.

The goods:  The food is very good.  The bison short ribs were outstanding.  The beer list is extensive.  The artichoke appetizer was ok - it lacked seasoning (i.e. salt).  The halibut cheeks were also well received.  The decor is nice and the smells from the kitchen are appetite stimulating.  
The bads:  The service.  Just awful.  My second time here and the waitstaff is not pulling it together.  I sat down with a bunch of birthday presents fouling my eating area.  Our female server simply ignored it.  Another tall, bald, male waiter kindly took them and placed them on a side table for me - too bad he wasn't our waiter.   They were out of two beers.  I ordered rack of lamb and they were out of it - at 6:45 pm.  Someone asked how the halibut cheeks were prepared - she replied Panko Parmesan crusted and grilled - lol.  Yes, they were flaming hunks of carbon - not.  Do your homework prior to coming on shift - they were pan sauteed.   
We were rushed by our server.  There was no suggestive selling (would you like a side salad?).  While we would never ask - there were two birthdays at our table.  For a party of six we dropped around 250.00 - I would think you could have done something.  

Overall, the female server's distinct lack of warmth, and clipped demeanor detracted from the quality of the food.  I'm not sure we will be back......

I want to thank Glass Doctor for coming out and being a honest company. After being told by a Window Cleaner that I needed a new window I called them to come out only to find there was not a problem with the window. The window cleaner used an excuse so he didn't have to clean the double pane window that was just dirty!  I want the public to know I appreciate the honesty of this company.  I will call them if I ever do need a window.  Thank you, Glass Doctor of Idaho.

Panera Bread was fantastic. My wife and I took our four young boys in for dinner and were not disappointed. I especially recommend the Goddess Cobb Salad. I got the half salad and half soup and the serving size with the bread was perfect... and I have a big appetite. The kids all had tomato soup bread bowls and all commented that it was the best soup they'd ever had. The general manager was keen to make sure that we were well taken care of. I highly recommend Panera Bread.
Great environment and delicious food. I have a gluten allergy and they were very accommodating! They have gluten free English muffins that are wonderful!

I had Park Place manage my properties (2 houses and 8 townhouses) and I found the service to be terrible. I chose them since they gave me a little lower rate but what a terrible mistake. They turned over Property Managers ever couple months and were always getting my statements incorrect. I found may errors where I would have lost money. They did a terrible job finding good tenants and they rented units to people with extremely low credit (they never even asked me if I would accept tenants with such terrible credit).
