My units were turned over way too often and they charged a small fortune to fix them up to re-rent out. I've owned properties for 30 years and this is by far the worst property management company I have worked with. DO NOT USE THEM!

Great breakfast place! Food was good; big servings. Great customer service. We went on a Monday morning and it wasn't busy at all, but I'm sure it would be on the weekend. Glad we finally tried this place. We'll be going back! 
Typical diner setting, but very clean and seems to be well run.

When you think of venues in Idaho, performers normally go to The Knitting Factory, The Morrison Center, or Taco Bell Arena in Boise or they go to The Idaho Civic Center in Nampa. Meridian is also an excellent venue for music. I saw Krystos at The 127 Club. Meridian is posh, but what in the world is up with the parking? It's like I ended up in another country. 
Little did I realize Gayle Chapman resides here in Idaho. Being a huge Prince nerd I was really excited to see that she was performing at Deja Brew Laugh a Latte. Knowing how I enjoy eating and drinking in Meridian, I just had to check out Deja Brew and I was not disappointed. 
After trying to find somewhere to park in all of the construction and blocked roads I found a place. I entered an environment that I really like. Deja Brew is a very stylish restaurant with walls that are lined with interesting paintings. Of course, the servers are pretty cool. They are covered in ink and piercings and they have a warm and welcoming presence. Okay, I like it. Want to come again already.
The food is very good. I got the finger steaks with mashed potatoes and veggies. The finger steaks were very unique. They were the most fluffy ones I have had. The vegetables were a tasty combination of red bell pepper, green beans, and carrots. I got a nice glass of pinot grigio to go with it. Very fancy.
I was pretty happy with my visit and the music of course was awesome. Two thumbs up. I hope this place is open for a long time.
We have been renting our home from AIM for almost four years. We have only ever had two issues and they were both taken care of with 24 hours. I would highly recommend renting from them!
Good food! Great service!!! Clean and inviting. Reasonable pricing and good portions. Will be back!!!

I really have an addiction to this place.  I would eat chipotle every day if I could.  I've visited this location quite a few times now, and I'm pretty happy with everything!  And I am happy to report, that although it is in a limited quantity, it appears that they do have pork back!!! WOOOOHOOOOO!!
THEY HAVE IT BACK GUYS! And it's as good as ever!!

Pros:
Many options to choose from
Bright, clean & open made for a nice atmosphere
The service was great. I like how they leave a carafe of water & a thermos of coffee on the table to refill at your own pace
Dark roast coffee was delicious
Bacon was great! Flavor, texture & thickness were all perfect 
Potatoes were flavorful, despite the way I thought they'd taste based on appearance
They take the time to present the food in a nice way. Some places, especially breakfast, seem to just "throw" it on the plate & it looks sloppy. This extra attention to detail show me they take pride in their job & food
Prices were standard for breakfast, but better quality & generous portions made it a great deal

I look forward to returning & trying other dishes!
5 star pie, 5 star service. Great pie great beer, this is one great atmosphere for enjoyment.
Great breakfast bistro.  Service with Jess, Kim, Lindsay and heather is always good.  This is my first day eating gluten after 3 years being gluten free.  Opened a whole range of menu items

We dine out for breakfast every weekend morning, and always land at LePeep one of those days.  Superb menu, cooked or presented to our preferences, and we've experienced excellent service since Day 1 when they opened.  Good lighting, quiet enough for casual conversation (not the case at some competitors) and exceptional delivery (even when packed).  Also, good coffee!

And, the owners are present most weekends and will address any perceived issues or observations:  they are on top of it!

So I have to say I have been a huge fan of Panera for years and have gone to many of them mostly in California...was very excited to see them open up here! Only have gone once and it was within the first few days they were open but it was disappointing for sure. Soup was lukewarm which always makes me nervous. Full salad seemed completely undersized compared to what I have been served in the past. Don't get me wrong, I will be back for sure but hoping they improve as they are open longer because it has historically been fantastic!

I give this five stars for the category. I know it's not a five-star restaurant it's fast casual dining. However their food is consistently good and I like how fast they are. I love ordering online and just picking it up, I also like to order from my table. Good food fast what's not to like

Had an awful experience with Park Place. We lived eight months without a microwave because they couldn't get maintenance out when we were home.  Also, they kept most of our security deposit for frivolous "cleaning" that had to be done, while the place was a mess when we first moved in.  Lastly, they care more about their owners and if there is a problem that arises, it is most certainly the renters' fault, they will not investigate.

I have been waiting for a place where I can enjoy a delicious cinnamon roll and cinnaholic is my new go to! I have never been a fan for Cinnabon because there is a thick, gummy paste of overly strong cinnamon inside. Cinnaholic is so much better! I'm not vegan and cannot tell the difference. I typically stick with just a plain roll with cream cheese frosting but right now I'm in love with the pumpkin pie frosting. They are always served warm. It's on the pricier likely due to the non dairy ingredients.
Very good food! Service was phenomenal! Everyone was so friendly!!! Large portions also. Will definitely go back.

Usually when I go out for breakfast I use chicken fried steak and eggs as a benchmark for how good the place is. You can tell in one bite if the chicken fried steak or gravy is pre-packaged junk. Not here. Also in my eyes a skilled line cook should be able to make sunny-side up eggs with all the yolk runny and none of the whites. I very...very rarely find this but they hit my second mark here. I love nothing better than sopping up a mix of gravy, yolk, and tabasco on toast at the end of my meal. Coffee was never more than half empty.  But that's just the food. 

This place has been here for over 20 years and you can tell. Not because it's worn down and dirty (which it isn't) but because you can see a steady stream of regulars in and out of the door. You can tell they've been coming here for over 20 years with their families and friends. Great small town feeling in this place and the staff is warm and welcoming. Quite possibly the best meal I've had in Boise.

this place is the bomb!!! best breakfast in town!!!
excellent service great food will be a repeat customer for life!!!
madison is the best server!!!!

After getting into town after a 5 hour drive home from UT we were not up for cooking. So we stopped by the recommended Flying Pie down the street from our place. Ordered a single medium 14" pizza. Little over priced but the pizza was bigger than expected. We really enjoyed it. Not the best pizza I have had, but they did not skimp on their toppings and meat, which was so good! You can make it custom which we love. Crust wasn't as crunchy as I usually like, and it took a while for them to make it (1/2 hour) but luckily we were able to go home quick and unpack and then go back to pick it up instead of sitting and waiting.

Guacamole rotten brown chunks
Rice hard
Customer service poor
Love no GMO food  policy here so 2 stars for that

Thank you Julie C. for consistently giving me the best haircut and color services.  She always knows exactly what I would my hair to look like, even if I don't know what to say it. Her prices are reasonable. The salon is clean, spacious and relaxing.

.I had the erroneous idea that this was more like a Chili's. I'm thinking Chipotle~Chili. Not even close. This place doesn't have fancy plates, table cloths, or a bar serving alcohol. You get a totally casual seat-yourself environment, with stainless steel table tops, and stiff wooden seats.
.The custom burrito building idea is nothing new. We have seen this at Qdoba, and Taco Del Mar. Who does it better? If you want your burrito to have a tomato or spinach flavored tortilla, and refried beans, it's not here. However, if you want it to have barbacoa or sofritas (a vegan blend) or corn, this is the place.
.Oddly enough, I was not offered chipotle chili (look it up). When I asked the charming young lady about it, she showed me a bottle of Tabasco branded chipotle sauce, available near the soda fountain.
.Mexican fast food - Okay, I agree with that part. Just don't expect Mexican decor, Mexican music, or Mexican waitresses.

This is my second contact with Glass doctors .  Two broken windshields in a year.  Professional, friendly, on time, excellent work . Approved by State Farm. Best of all they came to our house to do the work.

I had breakfast here this morning. This is not the first time but it will be the last time. I ordered an omelet with bacon, cheddar cheese and avocado. It was the driest omelet ever. I could not find any cheese and the avocado was so hard I could barely cut it. The potatoes were overcooked and also very dry. We also ordered the pancakes. They were very heavy and had no taste. And why do they have to have the music so loud. As a couple we like to talk to each other. We could barely hear our own conversations. I have to say the coffee was very good and also the hot chocolate was very hot! I will not be going back

The only ice cream place (as far as I know) with a drive-thru, which I can really appreciate.

TCBY has been around for a long time and still seems to stand strong amongst the new self-serve frozen yogurt places. Personally, I think the quality of TCBY yogurt is much better and they also have hand scooped ice cream.

The best flavor by far has got to be the white chocolate mousse. It has a sweet, but slightly tangy and unique flavor. They have different deals throughout the week and are generally more affordable than other ice cream shops.

Not bad. Little over-priced. I was expecting Frech cuisine. I got traditional American breakfast. The carpet does not match the drapes when you consider the name.  I might go back if I was scheduled for a business breakfast. Otherwise I say mehhhhhhh.

Great place!!! I worked for Le-peep and was thrilled to to see it while visiting a friend. They're all independently owned (wasn't aware). All wait staff are tested on menus knowledge before being allowed on the floor (aka: wait tables).  Fresh food. Great service and the owner stopped by to say hello. You won't be disappointed.

We were seated quickly for a Friday night, but the service was probably the worst in Boise . Food was good but lukewarm by the time it was served. We had out of town guests and this was not the best example of the typical service and food in Boise .

We wanted to try something close to our neighborhood. Decided to split the prime rib sandwich and have of the classic cocktails. I felt like it was do as little as possible. Drinks were poor quality. Food was just trying to covered up with generic quality. It was a wannna be ale house. To top it off service was slow on a slow night. In a great location with good beers. Need to work on everything else.

Stopped by on a Sunday around 1:15pm.  Not a busy time.  Bartender took our order for drinks.  We then had to wait around 15 minutes for him to come back and take our order.  He was quite engrossed in the volleyball on the TV.  Ordered and then took at least 20 minutes for 1 sandwich to to be served.  Had the Prime rib sandwich.  Meat was VERY smokey and the salad that we substituted for the fries had a large slice of grilled bread under it which presented the salad as bigger than what it actually was.  The entire menu was expensive and out of line with other venues we have tried with the same caliber.  All in all, very disappointed with the slow service and pricing.  Unfortunately, would not recommend when there are great restaurants right down the road in the Village.
Manager is fantastic and worked with me. He was respectful and kind. Holly is super kind. Glad I came in again!
i ordered a chicken burrito and it fell apart, because of the shitty rolling job, and so i thought to myself "i might as well have gotten a damn bowl, even tho i wanted a burrito". #1stworldproblems

Love this place!! Great, upbeat and welcoming attitude from the staff. The food is absolutely delicious, top to bottom off the menus. All my family requests on Sunday is here! 

Mom loves biscuits & gravy! I'm a vegetarian that doesn't like egg so they make me an omelette off hash browns with cheese and a bunch of veggies I can never finish even though it's a half portion. The waffles are my fav when I have space or a sweet tooth. My love can't keep from special ordering a burger because they're too good! Then my dad usually sticks to the chorizo entrees because he loves that they offer it! Really can't go wrong on anything. 

Tip: skip the wait call ahead to go on a Sunday! They're so good it's busy the whole time they're open. I wasn't able to find any menus online so I decided to post them myself, hope it's useful!
Pancakes were good service was friendly. Will be coming back with family. Next time if i might try something else.

Chipotle sings the songs of my stomach people. From burritos to tacos, these guys can sling some killer Mexican food a step above fast food. They specialize in locally sourced food and healthier cooking. Their menu is small but adequate and I crave the burrito bowls with a passion about once a week. I've been to chipotles in both Washington and Idaho and the quality is excellent at both. I'm surprised at the previous reviews here as I've never personally heard a complaint about the franchise from any of my friends or acquaintances. Give these guys a try if you're in the mood for some quick Mexican food!

Ordered the #1 Contest Combo for delivery. This is the best pizza I've had since being in New York. Pizza Hut and the other national chains don't even come close! They said about an hour for delivery but came in about 35 minutes and...the pizza was actually still almost to  hot eat. Driver was very kind and professional.  I look forward to their product when I return to Boise. 5 plus stars.

My experience with Tresidio has been nothing short of phenomenal.  I have had multiple business dealings with the owners and they are stand up people.  I have also been very impressed with their rapid growth and success.  It is impossible for a builder to have this kind of success if they aren't doing things the right way, taking care of their customers and those they do business with.  Another thing I really like about Tresidio is their ability to try new things.  They bring the fun back into new homes!  If you get a chance to walk some of their homes you will see what I mean.  A close friend of mine recently built with them as well - an Italian style home with clay tile roof and it is amazing!  My friend later added an external garage with a climbing wall in it and it is beautiful as well.  These guys do it all.  A+.

I'm not sure what all the rage about Panera is/was.  I was excited to try this place, however my first Panera experience is a definite FAIL.   The food was expensive! for what you got, and the layout of the restaurant was awkward at best.  First, I placed my order. (By the way, I absolutely HATE the phrase, "What can I get started for you?"   Just ask, "May I take your order?" or "May I help you?"  I don't want to wonder why the order is only getting started.  I want you to finish taking it too !)   

I realized immediately what a rip-off this place was going to be.   "Pick Two" meant two items were slightly discounted, but still would have been more than $14 if I had picked two and added a drink.  I chose just a half panini- White Cheese and Steak, and a water.  It was almost $6.67.  Sorry, but I could have had a foot-long Subway Sandwich for that amount.   When the Panini was handed to me, I asked the manager, "Really?!?"  to convey how lonely this morsel looked on the huge plate it was served on.  And, if I can take a bite of your panini/sandwich (I have a big mouth) with ONLY getting bread, you're NOT putting enough into your over-priced entree.

As to the layout of the restaurant, I had to "swim back upstream" through the line of people waiting to fill their drinks at the drink station, to get my food.  When that didn't work, I had to wade through the too-closely-clustered tables in the dining area, to make my way around the line I had come from to get my order, then try to get through the drink crowd again.  Such a poor traffic flow, traffic pattern.   But, given how they must be embarrassed about the portion size, I can see why they wanted to make it difficult to get my food.

In summary: Expensive, Mediocre Food, and Inconvenient Service.  I won't be back.

I love their coffee, and the baked goods are awesome! My family in the area meets here once a week, and it has something for everyonand, plus the staff is so nice. We love meeting in this inviting place!

Our experience at Lee Read was one above and beyond all expectations! After visiting a few other stores in the valley in search of our dream engagement ring we were discouraged. The other store employees tried to get us to buy something we couldn't afford and didn't want. We then visited Lee Read and our hearts were lifted! Thanks to an amazing employee, Mekensy Elwood, we were not only able to design our custom ring, we were treated like friends! Mekensy listened to our ideas and concerns and promptly got back to us and was excited about our ideas! She never tried to sell us something we didn't want or told us we couldn't do something. Through her amazing attitude and thorough follow up we were able to find a ring we loved and customize it into our dream ring! A sometimes taxing experience was nothing but joy and excitement for us! I highly recommend Lee Read over any other jewelry store in the area. Thanks to everyone at Lee Read for helping us create a dream engagement ring! We will be back! We are customers for life!!!
This is the worst property management company. Don't use them they will treat your house like it a dump and do nothing but charge you!!
They have great customer service. They keep us up to date on our property and what is going on with it?

Meridian tree service was prompt and professional. They did an excellent job trimming 4 of our large fir trees.  The price was very reasonable and they cleaned all the debris from the branches.  I would highly recommend this company.

This place is a little slice of heaven. Tucked back a bit from the street with plenty of shade on a pleasant patio. Food is fresh, amazing, and the presentation beautiful. 
Definitely on our top ten list!

This was our first home building experience and I'm so glad we went with Tresidio! 

From our initial meeting, we were impressed with the knowledge and organization of Tresidio's home building process. After selecting our lot, we met with staff on site to see it. Then over the course of a few months we got to see our house take shape from original inception to reality. 

I love that Tresidio allowed customization. We loved the variety of options and enjoyed making our home truly ours from the home design down to the finishes. The office staff was courteous and helpful too, making the experience that much better. 

As the construction progressed, we were impressed with the quality of craftsmanship and when we had questions regarding the construction we were pleased with the efficient and immediate response from Tresidio. 

Having lived in our Tresidio home for over a year, we can also recommend their warranty. We had a couple minor items to be addressed and they were handled quickly and to our complete satisfaction. 

If you're looking for a quality home builder in the greater Boise area, we highly recommend Tresidio.

I had decent expectations for this restaurant. We were highly disappointed. The food was very bland except for the fries, the fries were good. The waitress had zero personality. She would ask a question like how the food was and would walk away before I opened my mouth. She was on top of our drinks which was nice. I do not say this lightly but I would have preferred a burger at Carl's Jr. over our meals that we overpaid for. Just disappointing.
The best breakfast restaurant in Meridian! The staff is always been very nice and accommodating!

Horrible. They wiped out a $1500 security deposit on a house we rented. Twice. Thieves. They charged us for a carpet cleaning that never took place. They charged us to replace light bulbs that worked. They charged us for weed removal that I can prove were never removed. I have pictures of the filthy floors in the house we rented and my wife scrubbing them like Cinderella, but they charged us $500 in unspecified cleaning  fees. These guys are terrible.

Yummm! Went here for the first time and had the old skool roll. It was delicious!!! It tasted fresh out of the oven. Icing was a little on the runny side but I didn't mind that at all. That made it easy to have a little taste on every single bite! Staff was friendly.

Called around town looking for tires. Called Point S and spoke to Fabian. He listened to me about what I was looking for and my budget. He gave me a few options to compare with the other tires stores I had contacted. I told him I would call back in a couple of weeks to get things scheduled. 

I called on a Thursday later afternoon and got Fabian again. I asked to set up an appointment and asked for the tires we had discussed. Despite those no longer being "on special" he honored the price and set up the appointment. I dropped my car off, headed to work and within an hour, they had the new tires placed. When Austin called to tell me my car was ready, he mentioned that they had looked things over and my windshield wipers needed to be replaced. I thanked him but said I'd take care of that. 

When I went to pick up the car Austin was great and again recommended the windshield wipers be replaced. He also invited me back to for any other service I might need. 

I appreciated the service and openness with which I was treated. Recommended Point S to my next door neighbor based on how I was treated and she loved them too!

Absolutely wonderful place. Always clean, always friendly , and always wonderful food/drinks. My wife and I love this place. If you haven't been I highly recommend it, and if you have been, keep going.

Here's another place I've driven past 100 times. It looks like some old diner & ain't much to look at from the outside. I was doing a couple of business meals with a client and she recommended meeting here instead of a little better known joint in town.

I wasn't sure about this place, but it exceeded my expectations. I had the chicken fried steak & eggs. You can choose between a pancake or hash browns & toast. I choose the hash browns & toast. It was a very full mean and I was already planning on skipping lunch & only having an grapefruit.  I probably got my full day allotment of calories for breakfast, so you have to sacrifice to get what you want, right?

It was worth it & I enjoyed every bite. I held off licking the plate and just used my bread to clean the plate as best as possible.

We had one more follow-up meeting for the business at hand & when she asked if we could meet there again, I didn't hesitate to agree.

I have a 2013 Ford Edge and a 3 year old!  I got it fully detailed by Erick yesterday and WOW!  It has NEVER looked better.  From under the hood to the wheels, everything is spot on clean and detailed.  I knew that he would get it looking good, I didn't expect it to look this good.  As I mentioned, I have a 3 year old so he kicks the seat in front and where his car seat sits takes the most wear.  It is amazing how clean Erick got it.  Even the seat belts have been cleaned.  I am truly amazed at his work.  He even came to my work and picked up my car and brought it back to me. Talk about customer service.  And did I mention the headliner?  I am not even sure how it got as filthy as it did, but its cleaner now than it was when I purchased the car.  Erick even talked about a few things that he could do to make it look even better, so I will schedule that for the next time I get my car detailed.  Thank you so much.  I am glad I found Erick.  I recommend him to anyone looking to have your car detailed.

This is a breakfast place that is doing things right. They have not overlooked the need for great service. Each table has its own water carafe which was kept full. My coffee also came with its own carafe which was great in having the convenience of refills. Another nice touch was the complimentary to go coffee at the end of the meal.
Food was good and reasonably priced. I would definitely recommend this place and will be back.
Awesome environment, wounderful customer service, and the coffee house is so nicely setup. Chai tea was the best I ever had. A great place to get caffeinated and work on proposals.

I used to love Wingers. This was about 8 or so years ago. In the past, this place had one of the best burgers in town.

Well, times change I guess. Maybe they got a new owner and that new owner just does not know how to run a restaurant. (Time to place a call to Restaurant Impossible?)

Maybe there is just too much competition and because of that, they just cant afford to pay for good cooks anymore. Lots of competition here in the Meridian area, so this must might be the case.

ok, on to the review. 

I had a burger. Who would have guessed, right? I love a good burger. 

The bun was huge. Not big around, but thick. It was very bready such that this was about all I could taste when I took a bite. Not the best start here.

The patty was overcooked and dry. Each time I took a bite, was like putting mothballs into my mouth. Not a pleasant experience.

After I finished the burger, (hey, I was hungry, so I would have eaten most anything put in front of me), my mouth felt like it was coated with oil.

Not sure if this was from the burger of the fries. The fries were.....well, they were not good either.

The server hit the wrong key, or something. She brought out garlic fries at 1st. Now, I love Garlic. I am from Greece, so Garlic is my food of choice.

The Garlic Fries should have been called Grease Fries. They were so coated with Grease, I could see it, taste it, and even feel it. (Time for a bath)

Our server recognized her mistake and also brought out regular fries, which were no better.

Because of her mistake, she took the fries off our bill, which was nice of her. I wanted to try the wings, which they claim they are famous far.

Have you ever noticed that lots of places say they are famous for things? Im pretty sure that if I was to go to another state and ask some people there if they knew of these wings, or another menu item that they claimed was famous, these people would say; "What? "Never heard of the place or that food!"

As much as I wanted to try the wings, I have learned over the years, that often when a  restaurant has a couple items that are bad, this often means that there is going to be little to nothing there that is any better.

I might decide different and bravely try their wings some day, but I will definitely not have a burger or fries here again.
Absolutely wonderful food and service!  Presentation was beautiful and will definitely be coming back. Don't miss this gem.
This is one of my favorite places to go when I just want something sweet and indulgent. I've tried several of their concoctions, but my favorite is Bananas Foster with fresh bananas and amaretto.

Love the yogurt.  Inside is very clean modern looking.  Colors and design are very cool.  The yogurt is smooth and tasty.  Cups turn Coles when they get cold.  Cool place for kids with the paper cars they give out.  Customer service by the two gals was awesome.

There are plenty other options for breakfast in the area.  Disappointed by frozen potatoes that are the same as in a hotel chain who simply reheat them.  Nothing great or special about this place other than it was close and didn't want to drive to something better.

I came to visit my best friend and wanted a bloody mary after her busy wedding day.

They have such a diverse breakfast menu. I honestly did not know what to choose. I got the breakfast enchiladas they came with a side of beans. They were soo yummie. I also got a side salad and that ranch is by far one of my favorites ever. My bottomless coffee was sooo tasty and my cup was always full. They brought a larger pot for me to share with someone else. It was perfect. 

I did not get a bloody mary however I did taste it and holy moly that was like the best one. The presentation was appealing. It had asparagous, an olive, and a piece of bacon! 

Service was also great! Very tentative to our party of 7! I wish I had one back home!

Ordered anniversary flowers for my wife of 3 years online. The florist pulling the order copied an old delivery name from over 6 years ago with my ex wife's name on it. The flowers were delivered to my wife with attention to my ex wife. My wife was very upset. It ruined our anniversary. I won't buy from them again.

Love this place! We went to a million furniture places before we came here. It's a mom and pop shop, which I really like. We got our leather couch/love seat for a really great price. The owner and employees were so nice and not "salesman-ish" just really chill and nice.  Makes me realize why I hate RC Willey.  Next time I need furniture I'll be coming here!
Amazing place!!!!  the management and customer care is absolutely awesome and the food matches it..

Park Place is a terrible company. the house we rented was already not move in ready. The first day we moved in we had to submit several maintenance request. After waiting a week for a response, they came out to look at the problems and either didn't fix them, or half heartedly tried to fix the issues. My property Manager Britnie Taylor refuses to pick the phone up and avoids calls and emails before the weekend so she can brush it off until Monday. After we moved out they charged us for all the maintenance that they deemed necessary. They bought brand new blinds and a fridge off of our deposit. This isn't the only time this has happened, my parents have rented from them several times and this seems to be their playbook, charge you for everything they don't want to pay for and hope you don't fight back.

Glad I have seen the brighter side of Le Peep, this mornings experience was one not to complement. My wife was served her breakfast and tried waiting for mine to arrive (never did) she ate hers while it had some semblance of warm. After finishing my bloody Mary I cancelled my order with the server. A couple of minutes later some (manager I believe) served the breakfast- I told him I had cancelled and asked for my check. He gave me the impression that he would remove my charges from the bill, I told him good because I was leaving which we did. I did get the opinion from the manager that waiting a mere half an hour was cool, he didn't agree that we had waited 45 minutes. He needs to return to managers school. The server (Aaron) was not tipped and probably needs to return to server school. I will probably give Le Peep another chance but not right away.
Went there with a large group of picky eaters. Breakfast was very good. Like that they have egg white omelets. Great service. We will be back.
Just had lunch with some good friend. 7$ lunch buffet was awsome! Great all you can eat pizza and salad bar and excellent quality for the price! I defiantly recomend it as the best local pizza...

This Del Taco location is the best in the Treasure Valley!  I've never had reservations about ordering at anytime whether it be 2AM, 4AM, 8AM, 1PM or 6PM.  Staff is always friendly and food always tastes great.  I wish I worked near this Del Taco instead of the abomination of a Del Taco on Broadway in Boise.  Dear Del Taco on Broadway in Boise, maybe you should take a lesson from this Del Taco and figure out a better business model.

No complaints...good to have a Chipotle in Meridian.

Food is typical Chipotle (Mission-style burritos). I note they've added "sofritas" for vegetarians. My family had a steak and a carnitas burrito, plus chips and guac, and they were as good as I've had at any other Chipotle.

Staff here was notably more courteous than at other places...really went out of their way to be friendly. 

I'm not sure I'd go too far out of my way for Chipotle over Qdoba, but I think it's slightly better...I'd certainly drive a mile down Eagle Road for it.

I'll be back!
Hello lover! This roll is absolutely delicious! I still can't get over the vegan part. You would never know, but I am so glad it is!

My family and I have been coming here since shortly after they opened....
Well before they started advertising.

As the popularity has increased, the quality of service and food has decreased a bit.   

This morning my wife's eggs were overcooked and my potatoes were cold.

We will be going back again in hopes that they return to there five star past

We ate here a couple of months ago.... had a burrito with their homemade salsa.  I've never had a breakfast burrito I didn't care for until I ate this one.  It was so salty, neither me or my husband could eat it (and my husband likes salt!).  When I mentioned it to the waitress, she said she had several other customers say the same thing...  She then went back to the kitchen to inquire about it and then informed us that this is how it is supposed to taste, so it must just be our taste buds.  She was nice about it, so we don't blame her.  The only reason I'm giving it 2 stars is because their banana pancakes were pretty tasty.  Just wish they would have handled our complaint differently.

Have to say my pretty little ride looks as great as she did when I bought her.  Erick was able to schedule me right in, showed up on time, explained the things he would do after walking through his routine with me.  Things I never thought about cleaning, well, Erick does.  And we have to say my little Benz shines.  The inside interior is gorgeous and cleaned with special treatments he used on the leather. Floors, dash, vents, wow!   Price was very reasonable and he's a great guy.  He'll be doing our SUV as well and comes highly recommended.  You can't go wrong with this hard working young man who takes great pride in his work, it shows!

Went in to get a bed and mattress. First guy that quoted was great. I went in the next day and purchased. The second guy seemed nice and wrote everything up. The salesman recommended a 5 year warranty for the adjustable bed. I was home that night and looking for the dimensions of the bed and found the 3 year manufacturer  warranty which was the reason I picked up the 5 year warranty was actually a 20 year warranty. I've called and emailed the company to get a refund on that Warranty but I have not received any type of contact. 

WATCH OUT!!

Our first choice for breakfast. Traditional home style menu items. Portions are generous, even their "Baby Cakes". French Toast and Waffles are the best in town. And, the very best Servers, as well. Not to mention that they truly provide your meal quickly...Express Cafe!

Not impressed... food ho hum. Beer *sigh* boring. Service awful. Waitress took really long to take our order. Almost 30 mins to bring our check!!! Good grief!!! Better places to spend my money and get a good craft brew.

This place is pretty small but the friendly and helpful owner more than made up for it. Very affordable. I took my mini schnauzer in and gave her a haircut and bath. Took me an hour and the charge was $20. Will be coming back for sure!
Great burrito! Friendly staff. :) The Restaurant was clean and the staff are on top of it even when it's busy.

Best pizza in Idaho (and maybe Texas as well)!  I stop into Idaho once a year for a week or so and make sure to eat here as often as possible.  Handy they have several locations around the city.  Staff is friendly and informal (which I like) although I think this throws some people for a loop.  They do need to be a little more attentive to calls and incoming customers though.

Opted to make a custome pizza. It was out of this world good. Original dough, red sauce, fresh jalapenos, mushrooms, pepperoni and canadian bacon. Got the 14 inch buy one get the other half off so we could bring it back home with us. This place is next to the RV park that we stay in when we travel, so it will now be our go to place for trips. Great service.

Went here w my mother in law and sister in law. Food was great but our breakfast salmon was undercooked, when we brought it to the attention of the manager she was not graceful w her response, she just asked coldly if we wanted another made and when we said we would eat around the undercooked part she just walked away w/o apology or another word. We all thought that was odd.

I love the pizza at  Flying Pie locations, but the experience at this location was very disappointing.  Brought my family in to try and order lunch.  I stood at the order counter for several minutes.  There were 3 employees making pizzas and one standing at a table on his phone.  Several looked up and saw me, but no one acknowledged me with even a "someone will be right with you."

After a few minutes it became apparent no one was interested in taking the order so we walked out.

Le Peep is a welcome addition to the Eagle Rd corridor.  The food and the service is well worth the wait.  The portions are good sized. The flavor and quality is excellent and delicious.  One word of caution. This place is noisy and very busy.  So factor that in your time frame and you'll be ok.

Love the atmosphere and the patio. Just stopped by for a drink and appetizer. Ordered a Chardonnay and Seattle cider. Both were good. Ordered the cheese and fruit plate. Shy on the fruit and bread but nice portions of cheese. Service was very slow!!! Almost non-existent. So many other choices in town.
The food was delicious! Fantastic finger steaks! The wait staff were friendly and attentive. Food and drinks were served quickly. I will definitely be back.

Most restaurants I go to I try to order something different every few times. Chipoltle is not one of these places for me. Every single time i eat here i get the same exact thing. I chicken buritto bowl.  One of the great things about chain restaurants is the familiarity. No matter where i go my chicken bowl should always be the same. At this location however it is never the case. I feel the only way i ever get a decent portion of chicken in my bowl is to pay for double meat. Most times i don't even get a full spoon full. I love chipoltle. But this location is lacking big time and is never generous with food portions. I'd rather eat down the street at Qdobas or stick to the millwaukee location.

Oh my gosh cute! From the signage to the service, food to espresso, it's all good!
Came here for the first time with my sister on Mothers Day. Received a rose and the owner brought us our coffees herself to welcome us. 
Decorated in a funky quirky way that makes you feel comfortable immediately upon entering...
Oh and their logo and name!!! Can't miss! Check it out...

My wife and I went here on a Saturday night.  Unlike many other restaurants in Boise/Meridian, these guys weren't busy and now I know why.  Their service was just bad and the food was just as boring and forgettable.  It's safe to say that we won't be going back.

The salsa is too spicy and the cheese tastes fake. Chips taste just like any other chip. Chicken is rubbery. Burritos are too messy to eat without a container. A bit overpriced. Save your money and go to costa. They have better coupons and better service.

I am a chef and i was excited to try the new dessert option, i was very disappointed in my experience.  I have a soy allergy and wanted to make sure that there is no soy in the food and the staff had no clue what was in the products.  They eventually discovered that soy is in cinnamon rolls and cookie dough because of the soymilk.  I asked about the frosting and brownies and they confired that there was no soy in it.  I tried the brownie with a couple sides of frosting and had a reaction to the products, as they must contain soy in one of them.  I will not be returning as the prices where to high and the lack of knowledge and customer service by the staff, socializing in the back was more important them helping the customers.

I went in and wanted to buy a glock 19 cause they do the blue lable program and I'm military i stood there for 15 min at the gun counter and did even get acknowledged I will never go back in here and I will tell anyone I know to stay away from this place!!!!
Slowest service, wrong food and they locked the front door while people were in and could not get out. I am going to file a law suit

Pretty good food, but this is not a single $ place. It's more like $$. Our average family of 4 had breakfast....$52. Little painful since we're used to around $40. On the upside, the service was great & food was tasty. So if your looking for good food & not on a budget, this is a good place to come.

I recall the days of old when The Pie was the most ingenuitive pizza joint on the planet. Our entire dorm would jump in "DaddyO" and head to The Pie for all you can eat night. We are talking late 80s and early 90s.... The pies were MIND BLOWING! It was something crazy and new every week with ingredients like salmon, sauerkraut, refried beans, and on and on. For its time this was revolutionary. No one was putting chicken  on pizza let alone BBQ sauce. But alas all good things must come to an end. Now "gourmet night" is all you can eat, heatlamp tepid pizza everyday. Pepperoni, Hawaiian, All meat...Just regular uninspired pizza.  I miss the pie of yor.... So long good friend..

Came to watch the college football national championship game. The atmosphere was decent, the place wasn't crowded. The bartender gave us drinks right away  but we didn't get any waters. Bartender then forgot about us for 45 minutes. Within that time he took other customers food orders, and poured the wrong beer twice. Told us we wrong for cheering for a team. Finally able to order another drink and we were forgotten. 

Would return with different help, waiting on food to determine quality of food. 

Would recommend but with caution.
Staff wasn't super attentive, prices were higher than most, selection was slim, definitely nothing to keep me going back.

Fast friendly and delicious, exceeded my expectations. I wasn't expecting much from exterior. I was amazed at how fast I was served and had my order in front of me. Great quality food, too easy to overindulge though on all the home cooked goodness

We were super excited to try this restaurant and we ended up being super disappointed. When we got there we were told it would be a 35 to 40 minute wait. We waited for an hour and there were tons of open tables. The explanation given to us by the hostess was that the kitchen was backed up. Sure enough we waited another hour for food and only saw our waitress a couple of times. They were hardly busy compared to other restaurants in the area. We ordered the jalepeno  popper egg rolls as an appetizer. Two egg rolls both cut in half arrived one of the egg rolls was undercooked and doughy. I ordered the steak flat bread that would have been good with a tiny bit of fennel but instead it was covered in fennel which did not compliment the other flavors of the flatbread. They have 55 beers on tap but they don't offer flights. With that many beers on tap its odd that they don't offer flights. There seems to be some restaurant management issues going on between the slow kitchen and poor service from the waitstaff. We will not be returning for a second visit unless we hear that drastic changes have been made.

Don't be fooled by the first three negative reviews for Flying Pie in Meridian, those people were obviously being extremely over dramatic, even accusing a host of being "on pills," wtf is that even?! He was probably tired from working, since at the time  this Flying Pie had just opened and was super busy while the hype was wearing off. This is the best Flying Pie in my opinion and the only one that offers a lunch buffet, which is a really good deal for the quality of pizza and salad bar. 
Those people with the over critical reviews need to get real. They were expecting perfection from a brand new place, and were some how confused about the very obvious layout of the restaurant. The interior is straight forward, has an awesome bar with great craft beers for a good price, and has a comfortable atmosphere with a staff that is friendly and helpful. 
Best pizza spot in Meridian by far and second best in the valley in my opinion (right behind Casanova pizza)

I love Chipotle food... Huge fan! Could eat it everyday but the service isn't the greatest. I prefer the bowl but for the price you pay they jip you on the contents. They run out of chicken a lot it seems... this day in particular they had only half portion of the chicken so instead of waiting 10 mins for it to be ready I said a little bit off steak would be fine to make up the difference. At the register they tried charging me for double portions. Doesn't make sense that since they can't keep items available that I have to pay more.

At first I wasn't entirely sure if I should repair my plasma tv. My tv had a problem with the power board because it would turn on and shut down after 5 to 10 minutes.  So I called caden tv. They came out the next day and took my tv.  Said it would take a week or so for the tv to get back to running.  They replaced the power board  within 4 days and returned it. It was done fast and reasonably  priced. Luan Nguyen was the techician .

Lucky Perk has the most amazing frapp drink called the Caramocha. It is so amazing, it may as well be a dessert! I have been coming here for years. I prefer their hot drinks to Dutch Bros. I know, I know...... But, it is true! Lucky Perk is better!

Great helping of food! The chicken fried steak is thick and you can cut it with a fork easily. Gravy and potatoes were excellent. Staff was super friendly and even with a full house got our food to us in a timely manner. Will have to come back and try their lunch!
Friendly service. Good beer and great list of appetizers (we like appetizers best). Live music on Friday and Saturday night.  Cowboy Nachos. Yum.

My experience here was good. The services people were very friendly. The vibe was very relaxed. Ordered the #1 on their menu and asked for no onions, although there were some onion pieces we found the pizza wasn't bad.

We needed food before leaving Idaho to head home, and came across this place. My friend got the chicken fried chicken and a bloody mary. He said both of them were good, especially the bloody mary. I had the rancheros, which was good. Prices were decent, we got out of there for about $30 dollars, so not bad.

Had a wonderful experience at Casa Bella recently while I was in the Meridian/Boise area on vacation. The salon/spa is truly a beautiful oasis. As soon as you walk in the door, you know you are somewhere special. Friendly people, tranquil atmosphere, great prices and amazing professional services. I was able to enjoy a 90 minute massage which was heavenly. Will definitely be back!

This place is the worst! I hate writing a bad review but from beginning to end our visit was a mess. They had no children's menus available (she said they ran out???) They had also run out of children's cups. So my three year old had to drink out of a glass without a lid. She only spilled twice Then the food took ages and it was only 5pm, not even busy yet. When our food came my husbands burger (which he ordered medium was beyond raw. They took it back to fix it and didn't return till my daughter and I were done eating. I ordered my 3 year old chicken breast which she loves normally. But it was so heavily seasoned she couldn't eat it. I requested my fries crispy and they arrived literally limp and wet. The water tasted liked the scooped it out of a toilet bowl, so clearly not filtered. And that's just the things that stand out. When I politely answered the managers question of how i'd liked everything she seemed disappointed and said she wanted to make it up to me. She returned a few minutes later with a literal five dollar gift certificate. Five dollars!!! I didn't even take it because I would ever go back!! I couldn't believe they didn't comp or meal. 90% of the food was left on our plates and we were clearly unhappy. Don't waste your time or money!

We couldn't be happier with Tresidio Homes.  We've had a continuous relationship with Tresidio over the years and they have a commitment to quality and service that is second to none.  Tresidio's building process is meticulously orchestrated to ensure your new home is completed on time, on budget, and most important - so that you receive the home you've been dreaming of in the end.  From the beginning design phase through completion and ribbon cutting where you receive your keys, the Tresidio team is there every step to the way to guide and help you along the way.  If you are interested in a new home, Tresidio Homes will exceed your expectations!

People with a sweet tooth can rejoice! You have a new option to satisfy those cravings and it's Cinnaholic located in The Village at Meridian. 

You start with a basic vegan cinnamon roll. Yes, you read that correctly, no animal products are used in the making of this delectable delight. 

Then you add your frosting(s) and your toppings, ranging from fresh fruit, to brownie bites, to pretzel sticks, or from any of there other 20+ toppings and frosting flavors. Try the peanut butter with the brownie bites. 

The roll is served hot and it's delicious. You can customize it however you see fit and there are thousands of possibilities.

Definitely worth the visit, especially after dining in The Village; seeing a movie; or just a reward for a job well done.

How this has anything below five stars is beyond me. Yes, it's an eclectic collection of employees, but they're rowdy, fun, and are a blast when you get to know them. Excellent salad bar, great beers on tap (served by some of the most knowledgable and good-hearted bartenders in the valley), and the pizza is unbelievable. Seriously, the frommage a trois is a godsend, the habanero pies in August are devilish magic, and there is nowhere I've been that comes anywhere close to this good of pizza (and yes Manhattan, that includes your fair city). Cheerful, chaotic fun awaits- complete with an arcade for the kids.

I'm surprised that their aren't more reviews for this shop! Great place, not very busy during the week. Weekends a little busier. 

Megan just did a great job on my hair, had a great attitude, and personality. I hope she is working next time I go in for a cut!

Prices are decent as well. Recommended!

We had a late start to our Saturday morning breakfast outing and our usual restaurant was unusually busy. Rather than waiting in line we chose to explore a new restaurant. For the past several months we have driven by Le Peep and agreed that we should try it some time. Today was the day.

Upon arrival we were quickly seated. The coffee was good, I like that they delivered a small coffee pot to the table. I choose the Homestead breakfast (two biscuits with sausage gravy covered with chives, two eggs, and their diced potatoes). My wife chose the bacon breakfast burrito (A flour tortilla, filled with bacon, along with two eggs, onions, green chilies, refried beans and potatoes. Topped with their homemade pork green chili, cheese, tomatoes, sour cream and chives.) the food arrived quickly.

Upon arrival my order was incorrect. The waiter quickly resolved the issue. Overall, I rate my food a 1 out of a 5. The sausage gravy tasted like slimy flour with hardly any sausage in it. The consistency of it was not appetizing, nor was the flavor. The biscuits were doughy. They could have been cooked a little longer. The diced potatoes were very disappointing. They tasted like they were over-boiled, they had no flavor and no seasoning. I think they were boiled then fired (which should have made them brown, crisp and delicious), but they weren't fried long enough, I guess.The eggs over-medium were good. I ate about a third of the meal and couldn't finish... not because I was full.

My wife's breakfast burrito was decent. She commented on the lack of flavor of the same potatoes in her burrito. She ate about half and was full.

The waiter noticed that I didn't finish and I politely said it wasn't very flavorful. He called the manager over and I asked them not to go to any trouble. They removed the $3.00 (4oz) orange juice to make up for the dissatisfaction, which we thanked them. Then I noticed we were charged for 2 coffees. The gal at the cash register quickly resolved that issue.

Overall, the food was less than marginal tasting. I had much higher expectations for breakfast food. It was really a waste of $23.00 and I left still hungry.

We had a great experience and will definitely return. We recently moved to Boise and arrived with no couches. Furniture Outfitters had the couch we wanted in stock with our preferred fabric in the back warehouse and were able to deliver a couple of days later for a small delivery fee. So much better than everywhere else where we would have had to wait 6-8 weeks to have a comfy place to sit.
Best breakfast in town...I especially enjoyed the pancake special.  The servers were friendly and the environment was clean.  The food was just exceptional.  Great place to bring your date:-).

I can't believe I haven't rated Le Peep yet! My husband and I started coming here nearly every weekend after we discovered it on our search for breakfast a few years ago. We occasionally go to other places for variety but no place has been as consistently good as Le Peep. My husband swears they have the best coffee of any place in town hands down. I usually go with tea but they also have mimosas if you're into that. I've never found the wait to be too long- maybe 20 min at most, and it's usually shorter than their estimate. The food is solid and the service is usually good. We've been here so many times that occasionally there will be a server that is off their game that day, like taking a really long time before coming by after you've been seated to get drink orders or refusing to take food orders and drink orders at the same time, but that's very rare and most of the servers are awesome. Most of the time the service is 5 stars and the food gets to the table super fast. The combo platters are great, and so is the seasonal menu. Definitely recommended!

I usually love chipotle but my last two times at this location have not been pleasant. 

The first: a young girl being trained was having a little trouble ringing us up (which is no problem at all, we completely understood). The problem was that a taller man with brown hair and glasses who appeared to be trainer her was a complete jerk and clearly made her upset! We were appalled by how rude and disrespectful he was towards her right in front of us. Not cool! 
The second: I came an hour before close and the chicken was super cold, the girl making my bowl was pissed that it was a "horribly busy day" and made it clear she didn't want us to be there, and my stomach was not feeling great after eating. 

I won't be back.

Love this place!!!

If we are going out to breakfast this is the only place we go. The food is always great and the service is awesome! Make sure you grab a homemade donut. They only make a limited amount so I always order one to go first thing and eat it later in the day after the food coma from there amazing breakfast has worn off. From the outside it doesn't look that special but trust me it is awesome!!
Love this moxie! The staff is just as awesome as the coffee!! Have always had a great experience here.

The salon is spacious yet cozy. Has warm colors with cool splashes of trendy eye catching accessories and furniture. The staff are very welcoming and helpful. I came for a facial which was AMAZING! See clarity skins review for details. I'm looking forward to returning for different services and establishing a relationship with this salon. They are excellent!
Seriously some of the best breakfast in Meridian. The breakfast burritto is huge for even a guy. The banana walnut pancake is delicious and huge. Not a greasy spoon place. Very clean and nice.

Had to edit this review. Food/service/staff is great, but poor management/ownership/cutting corners cut this place from a 4-4.5 star food to a 2.5-3. It's good local food, but unfortunately after everything that's gone on, they've replaced original scratch kitchen cooking with store bought supplements that doesn't offer anything original or new to this area. This place has potential.

We had an incredible experience working with Sarah and the staff at Lee Read. With such an important decision to select the perfect rings, they made it enjoyable and pressure free. The customer service and desire to make everything perfect is evident throughout. It comes without hesitation to recommend and encourage everyone to work with Lee Read.

Megan did wonderful job with my difficult hair.  I wanted a trendy pixie cut and I'm enjoying my new look!  

 I loved this salon it offers many different services and everyone I met on my tour was friendly.

Excellent service, delicious food, hearty portions and a pleasing environment... This place has it all. I took my two kids (5 and 12) for breakfast and they both gobbled up their meals! The smiley face pancake my 5 year old ordered put a huge smile on her face and the chocolate chip pancakes for my 12 year old were perfect! My eggs Benedict was cooked to perfection. The food came out quickly and the staff was very attentive to all of our needs. Will definitely be going back and recommending LePeep to all my friends and family. Thanks LePeep.

My husband and I came here on a Sunday morning.  It appeared to be very busy but we decided to stay anyway.  They had coffee and tea while you waited so that was a nice touch!  We were seated probably within 10 minutes or so.  The staff was very nice and friendly and the food was delicious!!  We'll definitely be going back!!

Great team. Clear expectations set from sales interaction to execution of install. You can tell the team truly cares about what they are doing by seeing the attention to detail from every aspect of the job. From the straight and clean lines of the lineset, and ducting, to the question and answer to make sure the system was optimal for our use and house. Top notch in all aspects.

Amazing amazing vegan cinnamon rolls. We are visiting family from out of state and based on the location I was in this place was recommended. My cousin has no allergies and I have a dairy allergy so knowing this place was all vegan settled my nerves. My cousin and I shared a cream cheese frosting with peanut butter cup cinnamon roll and a cream cheese frosting cookie dough roll. WOW!  They were so delicious and the service was great too. They even informed me of one near my home in California. Wahoo!!
Great staff. Always friendly. Made an error on our order and promptly apologized and fixed the problem. Food is always good. Order the "off the menu" Quesadilla. A Must have.

Came here for lunch today, ordered the Belgian Waffle meal, and it was very delicious! We were seated immediately, and the service was overall very great.

My only complaints are that they were out of crepes when I came (understandable, it was late, but still disappointing), they forgot a part of my meal, and there was a fly bothering us.

The meal was very good! All of my party's food was great, and it was not too expensive (about $55 for the four of us). And they had a ton of different sweet & savory options.

We just moved to Idaho 2 1/2 months ago. We did our rental search online and spoke with the rental company by phone and email. We figured we couldn't go wrong renting a brand new townhouse. The day we were coming to Idaho we were notified that we wouldn't be able to get our keys until after 1:00 pm the next day and that they were ripping out our master bedroom wall to redo drywall to try and help with noise complaints. We were told they would be done the following day. Almost three weeks later we finally were done with the constant in and out of contractors and waiting around all day for them to not even show up. We had to wait five days to get a working stove because the one installed in our unit didn't work. Not only did this force us to have to pay to eat out most meals but it also affected my business which requires me to have a stove. We were patient and more than tolerable of the disruption that we were put through, but we felt that moving us into an unfinished unit and then not compensating us was not fair. We have been asking for some type of rent credit for two months now with no response from the "owner's". You can still hear through the walls! We were basically put through not being able to fully unpack and move in along with disruptions for nothing. The walls are so thin you can literally hear word for word your neighbors conversation! You can hear coughing, phone ringing, people in the bathroom.... EVERYTHING! While these townhomes are beautiful and in a great location the rental company is out for themselves and the craftsmanship of these townhouses is horrible. The garbage dumpsters are constantly overflowing and there is garbage all around the dumpsters always. It's disgusting! We have told them they should get a bigger dumpster or have picked up more than once a week and their response was they come twice a week and they are working on it. Well, they only come once a week and this has been an issue since we moved in. We still have an alarm hanging out of our master bedroom wall that we have asked to be connected for two months and still it hangs out of the wall. If you want to rent from a crappy company with crappy properties then this is your place...otherwise steer clear of Park Place and their "Stones Throw" townhouses!
Update....Pool and clubhouse we're supposed to be done by Memorial weekend...it is August and neither are even close to being complete. We are moving in September. Can't wait to get out of here!

Renting with Park Place Management was a horrible situation Certainly makes me research all of the property management companies in charge of renting potential living space's reviews first before signing any type of contract. Doing business with this company is Not recommended and I'll continue to spread this word to anyone in the market to rent in the Treasure Valley area.

As far as the cinnamon rolls go I was very happy and will definitely come back. It was warm, soft and delicious! So 5 stars for the cinnamon roll. I'd also say 5 stars for service. They were kind and happy people. I'm giving this an official 4 star review because I think the actual space is lacking. It was not a very pretty store at first impression. It is very small and oddly laid out. There is also no where to sit inside, so I ate on a bench outside in the wind. Not bad, just not ideal. Overall, delicious cinnamon rolls and that's what counts I guess!
Not your typical breakfast/brunch/lunch fare that you get in the rest of Boise - friendly, attentive staff and love that the coffee pots are left on the table. Well worth the stop :)

Like so many others out there, the Windows 10 update bricked my desktop!  My computer was maybe five years old and had everything I wanted on it.  It functioned great until Windows 10 was released.   I tried everything to recover, fix, repair it remotely.  No dice.  I really liked the smaller scale foot print and aesthetic features of this particular model/ brand and didn't want a different desktop.  I took it into Quick for a diagnosis.  Well...D.O.A. was the verdict.  Thanks Windows 10!  They refurbished my desktop with a memory, processor, flash drive HD and power source upgrade and...wait for it!  Recovered my data from my old hard disc!  All this for about $200 less than a new computer!  Service was  done on time and at the price quoted.  No surprises.  Great job Quick Computer Services!

Amongst all the new places for me to try I really didn't want to go anywhere with less than 4 stars on Yelp and I did well choosing this place. Megan was very courteous and very nice. She even offered to show me around town since I'm new. She did a great job on my hair, was timely and pleasant to talk to but she gave me my space as well.  Very clean and professional.

This is our favorite place to come have coffee, breakfast or lunch. Well, ok, also dinner. My husband and I have been coming here every Saturday morning for our weekly coffee date for over a year and it is always great. Coffee drinks are original as well as traditional. Food menu is nicely varied, and every item I have had has been delicious and well presented. And the cookies! Try the coconut chocolate chip! Today I am trying the avocado toast and it is wonderful. The staff are friendly and the owner, Cecyle, will make sure you are welcomed and satisfied with your food and/or drink.
I was trying to think of any negatives to mention, but other than running out of chocolate chip cookies on National Chocolate Chip Cookie Day and therefore we had to take a cc cookie hot out of the oven - oh, wait, that's a positive.

I've been here twice and now I've gotten my husband to join as well! 

Needless to say we are now part of The Joint family!

If you need a good Chiropractor I recommend this one 100%

I want you to know that my family was looking forward to having a place to call home, we took a risk on this company and well,this company is dishonest.  As Monica from the Median Office stated,  This company took a picture of another duplex and showed it to us claiming this is the duplex we are renting.

We had just about hit our limit with our mini schnauzer.  We had tried different training and nothing worked.  Our dog would pee on everything and people, bark, whine constantly, steal food, act like a complete idiot around other dogs, chase cats, run off and ignore our commands.  We enrolled him in the submersion program and after just a short time, he is a completely different dog.  All of his problems are gone and he is so eager to please.  Watching these guys work with the dogs is the most amazing thing I've seen.  There are incredibly friendly and helpful with all questions.  We love Sit Means Sit Boise!

We ate at Pauly's this spring and I forgot to review them. Good food, great service! I had finger steaks and after trying them all over the valley now, I rate Pauly's the Best! My date had a sandwich, I forgot which one but he liked it. Our friend had the chili and he said it was great!. Just try this place, you will not be disappointed!

Emily is amazing!!!! She took really good care of us the other day!!
Bald Jared is super funny!!!!

Solid 4 star on the food. The menu is small but everything tasted good. Bartender was serving the bar area as well, thankfully it was a pretty quiet night so the service was good. I will say the bar area was unbearably hot. Today was a hot day and it didn't seem any cooler inside. Not sure if they're trying to save money or having a/c problems, but it was uncomfortable. We won't back until it cools down.

I needed a couple of chip keys cut that I bought cheap off Amazon, and these guys did the job for only $2/key. Not only that, they cut one of their own keys (at no charge) for testing to make sure when they cut my chip key it would work. I was very impressed by their professionalism and by how much they wanted to get it right for me.

I would definitely come here again.

You will really like Micheal and his crew at 4 Seasons Pool and Spa. They are amazing, they have the best spas in Idaho and the best prices on chemicals. Above all they make it really easy to understand how to care for your pool and spa.  I am not the best at balancing my spa, these guys will give you a road map to clear, clean blue water.
Tom Young
Boise ID

My first visit to Casa Bella was a great experience, and I will be returning.  I feel so lucky to have found this gem, and Debra, the owner and Master Stylist, who is an all round amazing person.  This woman knows hair! I have extremely curly, thick, kinky hair, and  I have been a bit of a shock to a number of hairstylists over the years - it's a challenge to handle, that's for sure! But not for Debra - she jumped right in, made excellent suggestions, and was full of confidence.  She didn't suggest anything unrealistic or scarey, really understood the way my hair behaves, and I actually left the salon happy, with my hair looking great - which has never happened before, or at least not after hours have passed and everyone's exhausted.  A true professional, honest, skilled and a lovely person.  The salon itself is beautiful - spacious but also cozy, friendly staff, good product selection and a lovely place to have any of their treatments.  Easy to find and good parking too - a win/win! So happy to have found them!

We LOVE froyo! We visited Menchies as first time customers.  Employees were friendly, but that is the only good thing we have to say about the shop.  My husband and I both chose three flavors...we didn't sample any, but it was offered. We filled our cups with yogurt and headed over to the toppings where it was a total mess! I chose one topping and called it quits after touching the sticky spoon. Tables were all taken, so we took it to go.  (Employees were standing behind counter and could have taken the time to clean up). We drove over to the park to enjoy our yogurt only to be disappointed with every bite. Out of all six flavors chosen...we did not like one. Super bummed and will not be back.
This place is really great. Jessica was our server. She was absolutely fabulous. Great gluten-free menu.
Fantastic place! Can't say enough about the awesome food and service. Wonderful company with a great mission.

I recommend using anyone but Parkplace management.  They are complete liars and anyone that would give them five stars obviously are friends of the employees.   I just wish I could a gave them 0 stars but Yelp will not let me
Great staff very informative just started the program cheated with tequila shots still lost staff supportive and helpful.

Got a call early this morning from Lisa, that our forms were completed. I asked for staples and they hot melted adhesive to our forms (so awesome) and they exceeded our expectations immensely. Great Job! The forms look amazing! Thank you for thinking of a way to make our forms look better than we even thought of ourselves.
i ordered a chicken burrito and it fell apart, because of the shitty rolling job, and so i thought to myself "i might as well have gotten a damn bowl, even tho i wanted a burrito". #1stworldproblems
more like le-meh.... wasn't impressed, I might give them another shot...I honestly don't even remember what I had here thats how underwhelming I remember this place to be

Just had the tri-tip breakfast burrito and it was the best breakfast I have ever had. When you order a diet coke they bring you a big pitcher so you never run out. So good. They also have a great kids menu. My son absolutely devoured the chocolate chip pancakes. 

I wish I would have found it sooner.

My deja brew was amazing and delicious.
Great customer service and there wasn't much of a wait.

I've worked with printers all over the country for over 25 years.  When I call Greg at Modern Printers, he just gets it done for our company.  Simple as that.  Great pricing and always there for us.  Thanks for the service and bumping deadlines for us.  Patrick

We have been renting now with Park Place for a little over a month and they have been great! We are happy with the property and the costumer service is high quality. We have had small issues that required maintenance and every time they have been on top of it sending someone out to fix it promptly. Everyone from the repair guy to our property manager have been so friendly and efficient. There website is easy to use and they have made our transition to Idaho go smoothly.

Stopped by for lunch today and sat at the bar. The young man working the bar was fast and friendly. We both had the French dip which was really good and a good price. We will be back. Not sure what the other reviewers experienced but our service was great.

My kids are in absolute heaven. However, this place is way under staffed. Jane over at the climbing walls has been hustling non stop since we've been here watching our kids climb. She could definitely use some help. Looks like the facility has met its capacity with the amount of people here. I'm definitely calling in advance the next time we come. West Ada day and there is only 6 employees working - definitely a hazard of kids getting trampled on and a law suit waiting to happen.

One of the best Chipotles I've been to!  Employees are attentive and friendly and don't cheat the portions!!

The guacamole is better here than other Chipotles!!!  I would eat here all of the time if I lived here!?

Anybody who Compares this to anything else is out of his or her mind. This place is unique. First of all everything is vegan, with healthy ingredients. They don't even use shortening or partially hydrogenated junk. Everything is based on the same cinnamon roll. You choose your frosting and Topping. The choices are overwhelming, as they have many different frostings and toppings. Even the base cinnamon roll by itself is excellent. Don't compare this to the other garbage you get at the mall or other places because there is nothing like it.

Avoid this company at all costs! Unfortunately I did not have the chance to do so my lease was purchased by them mid lease. Horrible customer service they do not fix broken things it took me two months just to figure out the leaves have changed hands and who to pay the rent too. I always pay my rent on time and kept the house clean and well-maintained. Before my lease was up I got an evection notice because they wanted to raise the rent they said the yard look bad. I vacated the residence and fortunately when I first lease the house I took a bunch of pictures of all the damages because I had moved in site on scene. After I moved out I got a letter saying I owe them $4300 for the damages that were there before I moved in which I have time stamped photos and emailed this property management the photos and the dispute. Two years later I get a call from a collection agency they never took care of my dispute and they sent me to collections horrible company horrible morals horrible attitude of the office manager. This company is not worth the headache! So now the only way I'll get back my deposit is to sue them which I will do. The office manager makes a bunch of claims that are not true thank goodness I keep good records of my written responses and pictures. Again for this company at all costs!!

Wags to riches does a great job with our Maltipoo. He can get irritable and they have the patience to deal with him. The shop is clean. I also love how the dogs are allowed to mingle with each other and not locked up in a kennel. I'm always happy to see how my dog looks when I pick him up. I highly recommend wags to riches!

We were a little slow to start our order, but when a neighboring table pointed out the problem it was instantly solved.  We had the Wings, flavored peanuts and jalapeño eggrolls as appetizers with our drinks.  LOVED our waitress and had excellent wine and beers.  Cheers to Taren, our special server, and Bill, the bartender.  We'll definitely be back for the Entrées.

Well, finally went to the Meridian Flying Pie Pizzaria after living here for a year and a half. Everyone kept telling me, you got try Flying Pie it's the best in town. Boy were they wrong, the pizza is just average and for the price it should be a lot better. As for the staff it didn't seem like they were really in any hurry to help you.

OK if you want to train your dogs to sit, come and do basic commands this place is great. However when it comes to customer service they are not the best. My husband and I paid for a years worth of training for both of our dogs. We got the basic commands down but when we tried to contact them again so they could help us train them with other things we could not get a hold of these people! We e-mailed and called several times and no one ever got back to us.

We were very upset since we only got a few months of the year of training that we paid for. They do know what they are talking about when it comes to training dogs but they need to have some better customer service!

We tried this place for the first time. Staff was friendly and we were seated quickly. It was Wednesday at 11:30 am so not busy. Liked the pitcher of robust coffee...very convenient but $2.69 per cup? The food was average and a little expensive. Potatoes were dry and too salty. Hollandaise sauce on eggs benedict was not good. Omelette was overcooked. This place cannot compare to Steve's Cafe or Goldy's in Boise. Sorry but we will not be back.

You know when you buy a pizza, and want a healthy portion of [YOUR FAVORITE INGREDIENT]?

You know how you wonder if you need to order "extra" or "double" to get the amount you want? 

Not a necessary struggle here, my friends. 

The pizza was some of the best I've had, in quality and value. Ingredients were plentiful and delicious, with far more than the average options available. The staff is young and energetic, with extensive knowledge of their pizzas and beers. 

The food was available quickly & with precision. Prior to the pizza, we received a delicious order of breadsticks for free for dining in. 

Highly recommend this worthy pizza experience!
Gluten free dream! Delicious GF English muffins. New favorite breakfast in the Ho! It's nice how they give you a whole pot of coffee.

Finally!! Have been waiting for this sine Aug!! Moved from San Diego to Boise... And this Panera has kept its quality and consistency! Great place to eat in- next to the indoor fireplace- plus free WiFi! Delicious food for breakfast/Lunch/dinner and a place to grab bagels- Finally!!

The food was decent I got the chicken sandwich and my boyfriend got the Cuban.  He said it was really good.  My bun was soggy and my chicken was kinda small, for $12 I would expect a bigger piece of chicken.  The fries were very salty.  The service wasn't the greatest there was a table that got sat 15 min after we did and they got their food at least 10 min before we did!  We didn't even get a sorry your food took so long.  Long story short I am not coming back.

I can't believe this place is not better reviewed - what a hip, fun spot!
