We are a couple from San Diego, we enjoy our craft beers and boy did I enjoy the knowledgeable bartender that jumped to answer my question when I asked about the local brews. Three taste tests later I was crazy about the house tap that was triple distilled for them and the local Boise cream ale. 

Now to the food - we just so happen to arrive on Tuesday and Tuesday's here means a special 12 flavor pie (pizza) buffet with a fully decked out salad bar. Yummm. The only downfall I saw here was that they didn't bring out an ordinary pepperoni pizza for quite some time. Unfortunately I
Enjoy plain Jane pizza and was pretty full by the time the pep came out.

Only other disappointment I had was with the dessert. I really shouldn't complain here because the dessert was never mentioned and it was a surprise addition to our buffet experience, but it was  a pizza with a glaze sauce crumbled mint Oreos and fresh raspberries - the disappointment comes in when I asked if there was any other type of dessert dish since my partner can't do mint and chocolate mix - the answer was an empty "no". 

So for a full belly, fun & hip atmosphere I would go here!
Have been once and it was good. I'm sure we'll go back when in the area.  The breakfast food offerings looked good but we'd already eaten so did not try.  Comfortable relaxing setting.

I tried the biscuits and gravy half portion. It was really quite good. The staff is friendly, fast, and courteous. The price is excellent footer the quality of the good. Definitely give this place a try.

I couldn't be much happier with Lee Reed.  My husband and I did allot of research and looking around for rings before deciding on purchasing our wedding bands there.  I was looking for something unique and, glamorous....and they had the best selection.  Now, I don't think that they are the most inexpensive ...but definitely worth the cost.  They were very friendly and helpful.  They even have a children's area with a chalkboard and TV. to entertain your little ones (if you have them).

I highly recommend Lee Reed!
Pizza here is awesome ! Nice, friendly staff. The buffet is great. Try the pizza challenge and the monkey bread.
I moved here recently and needed a new stylist. I seen Leeann Griffin. I have difficult hair ( I think) and she did a great job with my color and my cut! So pleased and will be back!

Very average.  I'm an omelet lover, so I expected a lot from an "egg place."  I was disappointed.  My White Lightning omelet was small and almost no avocado.  It was not much better than Dennys.  The chairs were not comfortable and it was noisy.  Service was okay, but nothing to write home about.  Since I was just visiting the area, I'm sure I won't be back.

This place had a great atmosphere, but the menu was small and what I ate was tolerable, but I'll never go back I thought there was no variety and between me and my husband we didn't not enjoy our food. Sorry never done a bad review. Maybe they will step it up and make a bigger menu? We ate their vegetable beef soup and their Smokie salad.

Jeweler Mitch M. was fantastic as he worked on my wedding ring to help it fit better and not rotate left to right once it is on. He was very professional, knowledgable and his customer service was fantastic. Lee Read will always get our future business. The jewelers are right on site to assist you. The Treasure Valley is very lucky to have such a professional jewelry store where customer service is top priority. Thanks Mitch for making my wedding ring comfortable to wear and so beautiful again. You made our day!

Luan was great. He was able to respond quickly, we removed the TV off the wall together, he opened it, took the board that needed repairs, came back 2 days later and the TV is now working perfectly. Luan was on time, knowledgable, and super friendly. Recommended!

Finally had a chance to see what was all fuss about lLe Peep. We went this past Friday for breakfast. The owners? were outside talking to vendors and did not even take a moment to say hello, ( I knew this was not going to go well for a restaurant that already had reviews of outstanding service ). We walked inside. It was neat, clean, updated motif. We stood there wondering if we should seat ourselves or wait.  Several employees walked past us and didn't acknowledge us.  Finally, the girl from the counter sat us.  We commented to each other about the uniforms.  There are several colors.  Bright Pink, Green, and Blue and it is not clear why who wears what color and their role?  It was clear that there is no uniform standard.  Only one shirt was tucked in, there were no slip resistant shoes being worn, and the chewing gum and jewelry standard was non-existent. So moving on to the menu. Fairly good offering of breakfast and lunch. They claim a lot of the dishes are homemade and are created with care. We ordered the breakfast burrito and the tostada tango. The burrito choice of meat was chorizo.  For those who don't know chorizo is a Mexican spicy sausage. There was some confusion with the wait staff as to who's table we belonged to and another table received another tablets order. The dinning room had six tables occupied with two guys at the counter. The food came and the presentation of the tostadas were beautiful. The salsa appeared to be homemade due to it being warm, but the salsas were from a can simply warmed and not freshly prepared. The burrito is huge. It is really a meal for two people. It is filled with lots of eggs and potatoes. Strangely, there was no chorizo. The sauce that the burrito is swimming in a pork green sauce. Good favor, but way too much and specially since it's not clear if the chorizo is the pork sauce or it's something else entirely. See pictures. For two people, 20 bucks, and that with both of us drinking water and sharing a 6oz freshly squeezed OJ. If Le Peep is know for it's service it called in sick when we were there.  I may try the lunch to see if there's a different vibe, but Le Peep is not that savior of a breakfast / Lunch place that Meridian has been waiting for.  Don't be fooled by the reviews.  Check out their website. Anyone can be a franchisee.  They have a 7 week course for training. Maybe a little more time spent on service and standard operating procedures won't hurt.  Finally, check out the place yourself. With any restaurant, don't get caught in the aura. Check the floors and the edges and measure that with how the employees present themselves to the food on the table. All of it should be consistent. This chicken is crossing the road.

If you like a dingy dumpy pizza dive right behind a gas station this place is for you.

Not much seating inside, and the tables they so have they do not seem to clean often.

Salad bar is poor, not stalked, lettuce swimming.

Kitchen is open and visible, so you get a great view of employees with questionable hygiene practices handling your food.

We got the Chicago style pizza and it is terrible. The "pizza sauce" is gross and tastes like sugar was mixed in it.

Stay away from this place.
Marnie always provides great customer service and fantastic grooms for my boys. My yorkie and lab always look and smell amazing.

In town for business. This bar is what it is and doesn't advertise to be anything extravagant. I wouldn't take a first date here, but I wouldn't pass it up either. It reminds me of a townie bar solid three stars.

PROs:

- Well priced, they have a good $5 lunch.

- I had the cheeseburger, it wasn't bad. 

- Lots of good beer. 

CONS:

- Service is kind of slow, but this shouldn't really matter.

- Food selection isn't the greatest.
The food is awesome and priced just right and the best coffee in the Treasure Valley.  The service is great too.

3 stars?  What this is flying pie pizza?  I know!  I've had the lunch buffet the last few times and it just wasn't the best.   So with that said.. The pizza you order or get for take out is always a solid 4 stars!  But I agree with Megan Z  Aka Nutmeg.  This new location isn't my favorite either.    

And for the Bad news.. And I've never wrote about this before so I'm not sure why I am now because I usually don't complain about these things.. But for being less than a year old the bathroom was gross!  Something you would expect in a honky tonk bar.  Not a great pizza place!   And no I didn't take a picture!    I almost did and thought to myself.. "What the hell am I doing?  That's weird"   So I didn't.  Please clean the bathroom.   Thank you!

After being seated by the friendly hostess we looked over the menu and we were happy with the selection. 

After looking over the menu  for 10+ minutes we realized we haven't been greeted by our server yet. We had to go out of our way to ask who our waitress would be.They must have had some sort of miscommunication because it wasn't even busy at all. One girl was sweeping, another wiping down tables and putting together silverware while we were hungry and confused on when we would get to order.  Finally our waitress came which felt like an eternity. She was friendly and pleasant. 

Husband ordered the Eighteen Wheeler. His scrambled eggs, bacon, potatoes, and French toast were all awesome!! Also they brought his plate out way before mine and he was almost finished when they finally brought out my cold French toast.

I ordered half stuffed French toast and half regular. Both cold. Also looks like they skimped on the portion size. I specified that I would pay the $7.99 stuffed price which is a dollar more but I received less total than the photo above of just stuffed French toast and you think that having half of regular French toast would be cheaper for them... So I'm not sure what happened there!  Didn't care for the stuffed French toast, and didn't even try the regular french toast on my plate because it was too cold. 

My husband gave me his french toast which was cooked better, and also warm.  I really enjoyed it. If they cook their french toast like that every time I would be a happy camper. Mine was cold and was a completely different color than his it looked dry instead of moist  and was a darker brown in color. Very inconsistent.


Staff was all friendly, food was good but not consistent, atmosphere was clean and modern with a touch of Idaho art on the walls. Definitely need to work out some kinks and be more aware of their patrons time.

I've been to this restaurant at least 30 times in the past 10 years...  When we have the day off of work and we want a nice filling breakfast or lunch, this is the place we go.

Love their scrambled eggs, soda is awesome, waiters are always friendly, but the best thing is the homemade donuts right when you walk in the door.

Read the daily paper, watch the people come and go and enjoy the meal.  

WISH they were open for dinner!

Every time...

They're never serving blast in the evening bc the machine overheats. 


Every time.
One of the best breakfast in the Meridian area. Never been disappointed in the food or the staff. An easy four stars always.

I've been twice and the experience got worse, not better.  The first time we just had beers at the bar.  Beer selection was lackluster for a place who calls itself Barrel House 55.  We walked out saying, "That won't be there long".  I only returned for an event I was invited to... food took an hour and 10 mins to come out so we had to cancel the order altogether.  The wait staff said they were slammed but it wasn't that full.  As we were leaving we noticed they boxed up a bunch of food, I sincerely hope this wasn't our order which had now been sitting for 2 and a half hours! No way we're eating that.  I did order a drink from the specialty cocktail menu and that was good, but they charged $10.60 for an old fashioned.  What?!  We're still in Meridian Idaho right?  That sealed the deal for me.  There's better service, value and food choices out there.  Good luck B55!

Great FAST serving breakfast place. I've only been twice but the first time definitely left an impression with how quick they were to get your order out. Everything was amazing! I would say I had asked my waiter for "over medium" eggs and definitely got eggs that were less than over easy so that's why I gave it 4 stars. Other than that I would go again.
Maddy was an absolutely amazing waitress all the stuff went above and beyond to wait on us with a great attitude and the food was amazing will definitely go back all the time!
Breakfast and service was awesome. We had the French toast and chicken fried steak. Wait wasn't long and I liked being able to pay on the way out.

If I could sum up this place in one word, anti-climactic!  Menu looked promising, waitress seemed promising and it all kinda sucked.  Hamburger was way under cooked and they totally botched the order.  It's too bad, this place is really cool inside.
Great, fresh food- I love the all you can eat buffet! It's e best deal in town!
Super sweet staff and delicious pizzas. We arrived 15 minutes before closing and the staff didn't make us feel like we were a burden. Truly a great meal... was with my kids and they loved it too.

Andrew Propst and the rest of the staff at Park Place Property Management are first class all the way.  I have had many interactions with Andrew and have found him to always be professional, forward thinking and innovative when it comes to property management.  I have taken many of his classes and consider him to be a fantastic resource for all things property management.

Le Peep offers fantastic fresh food for a great price. They have always been amazing with our kids.  Management Walks around and talks with customers. The restaurant is super clean. Unique menu satisfies every craving from hot delicious breakfast to a crisp, fresh salad.

For some reason, Goldys in Boise keeps winning best breakfast place.... I'm not sure why that is. All my girlfriend was looking for was a good place for biscuits and gravy. The first time we went to Goldys, she got their biscuits and gravy which were cold and hard and we had to send it back and their service is is subpar. The reason why I started off with that is to say that Express Cafe is none of those things. They had excellent service from the moment we walked in. I ordered the cinnamon roll French toast which is as good as it sounds. The biscuits and gravy were finally soft and hot. Perfect breakfast place and great cake doughnuts!
Excellent breakfast, best we have had in years..   We are from out of town and stopped in by chance.  Megan can cook eggs!!  The French toast and bacon were also fanrastic!

Maybe they're just having a bad day...
The blood orange lemonade was fermented - they replaced it. My broccoli cheese soup was almost hot. The chipotle avocado chicken sandwich had one very small sliver of avocado on it. The other lemonade selection was good, the fireplace was nice and toasty, and the customer service was good. I'm disappointed with how much I paid for how little I got. Come on, Panera, you're better than this!

I was expecting a lot from Le Peep based on their menu and other reviews on here. I guess I was expecting more than I should have. The good: This restaurant is bigger than it first appears from outside and though I expected the typical rush wait on a Saturday morning around 930, we  were promptly greeted and led to a table. Service was also very friendly and prompt and our carafe of coffee came right away. While waiting for our order, we noticed the crew worked very efficiently at clearing and cleaning tables, quickly getting them ready for the next customers. This greatly reduces wait times and I applaud them for that. I ordered the Omni omelet which is "Ham, sausage and bacon, add a blend of veggies, mushrooms, combo cheese and sour cream and chives. A Le Peep creation." The filling was mostly fine even though they seem to have left off the chives. Now for the bad:  It is served with Peasant potatoes which were really what I would call "Country Style" as they were essentially dry cubes of fried (or baked) potatoes with a bit of herbs on them. One bite and I was tired of them.  It also came with a toasted English muffin. Ready for the ugly? Here goes: Going back to the omelet, the eggs were thin and more like a crepe. This would have been OK except they were very overdone almost to the point of being burned. This of course made them rubbery and pretty much impossible to cut with a fork.  The cheese that was on the edges also was harder and more burned than anything. Finally, the English muffin was dreadful! Well beyond crispy, it was like a rock and weirdly squished into an ultra thin shape. Inedible!

My wife had the Wanderer, a skillet filled with Peasant Potatoes, crisp bacon, onions, tomatoes and combo cheese all topped with two basted eggs. She loved the perfectly done eggs but once again, dry potatoes along with hard, "melted" cheese and a lousy English muffin really took away from what she was looking forward to. 

We may give them another shot in the future, but for now... Meh!

We've tried this place twice and have had exceptional service and great cinnamon rolls each time.  I read the negative reviews and I will say, be careful in selecting your icing and toppings, just because it's on the menu doesn't mean it will be amazing.  Oh, and we bought a dozen rolls for a gathering and they were fabulous, not at all dry.

This is where you go when you want the basics done right: food, service, and price.  All are 100% top-notch.  We've been numerous times, and not once have we had bad service.  Always quick with the food to the table, same staff for years.  We've never tried it, but they have a pick-up window as well.  One of the last places that make you feel like you're getting well worth your money.

Great food and excellent service. My coffee and water were always filled immediately. They also have other side options if you don't want the potatoes and toast. They even have a drive thru window to order breakfast or lunch. All the staff were extremely friendly.

Totally disappointed. Although the menu looked high end the food sadly was horrible.the wait staff and manager were pleasant. We popped in for lunch and ordered the barrel roll as an appetizer it was horrible. Thanks sauce it came with was like glue. I ordered the gnocchi and my partner ordered the wild BLT. Unfortunately both were very unpleasant. We were seared where we could see kite staff cooking and prepping and what looked to be the head chef was constantly looking at his phone,another with ear buds in..looked to be uninterested in providing quality dishes and there was little to no visible communication between kitchen staff. Unfortunately we will no be returning.

Just arrived home from Minn. and decided to stop and try this spot on way home. Husband got the burger and I had prime rib sandwich. Neither were great. Prices about the same as the Minn dinner we ate at which severed better food. Tried once will not be back. Sorry 55 Barrel. Wish you luck but need a better menu.

Having spent the last 2yrs in Denver  (home to boring bland pizza) I was delighted the first time I tried this place. It's near my wife's work so we tried it for lunch one day. The all you can eat salad bar was a great price though the salad bar is nothing to write home about. The pizza however is delicious and there are many kinds to choose from everyone one of them as good as the last. The only complaint about the pizza is that they concentrate on putting specialty pizzas out and there can be a wait for the traditional standby pizza (cheese, pepperoni and combination) as a parent of a picky teenager I will not go for the lunch buffet with him for this reason.

I called and it rang and rang. Called again, no answer. Called again,got an automated message basically saying they were too busy to answer, "quality over quantity." Got through about 45 minutes later, and knew the wait would be worth it. Their pizzas are consistent at all locations, and this meridian one is a lot cleaner than state and Fairview. Yes, it was $25 for one pizza, but the smoked Gouda on the Samoan can't be beat. True idahoans love flying pie!

This place=NOT GREAT- Terrible service -we waited an hour and our server stopped by once- watched the hostess texting friends- the owner of this restaurant must not have a clue or had all the kitchen staff quit at the same time- haven't done this in years but empty drinks we couldn't wait any longer for food, left 10$ on the table and bounced

First time and highly disappointed. They staff was very pushy and in a rush to get you to order although I was the only person in line. The food was bland and cheap quality. Don't waste your time folks! Also VERY expensive for what you get.

Wow. Just, wow. Ordered a meal, no large cups so we got a medium.  No big deal. Fill up said cup and they only had large lids. Ok... Wait for our food and decide to grab some mild sauce. You guessed it. No freaking mild sauce. I ask when she hands me my food and she said they're out of mild. No wonder there was a flier on the door looking for a new manager... That place needs serious help.

This is a wonderful establishment amid so many chain (boring) national companies. There may be more than one location, but it felt like a community based co.

The pepperoni is to die for. That's all I care about, so I ate an entire pie.

Sorry, other customers....

The kids and all of us had a blast! Raymen in the cafe was really hard working as I was there quite a few times with all my kids requests and snacks :) thanks Raymen! This place has so many activities and fun for the whole family! Groupon has better deals for pricing which I was happy about! Music is too loud. Otherwise thanks for everything!

We stopped at La Peeps for breakfast. We had a coupon for 1/2 off entree with purchased drink. Omelet good English muffin chewy and not toasted and potatoes dry.  Ho hum coffee. Will not go back. Not exciting at all. Other places in Boise and Eagle will get my breakfast dollar.

Love their lunch time pizza and salad bar, same great pizza as you get when ordering a single pizza and great choices.  I also love that they deliver both pizza and beer for those days when leaving the house is just not happening.
Awesome lunch buffet for 7 bucks.  Great pizza crust and sauce.  I' will definitely cone back for lunch .

We wanted to like it, but the cinnamon rolls were sub standard.  The dough was dry, rolls were small (for the price), service was terrible.  We bought the standard roll but it tasted like synthetic strawberries.  

There is a lot of potential in this place, but the product isn't there.  Seeing the workers scoop cream cheese out of plastic containers also detracts from the over all experience.  

It can be like the Cold Stone of cinnamon rolls, but it isn't there yet.

The wait staff was awesome but the food could use some work. Good environment with an interesting layout. Understandably it's breakfast food but nothing my wife and I ordered tasted any better than something we could make at home. There are definitely better places to have breaskfast.

They will not work with you on anything.
The bottom line is that anytime you ask for anything or help with anything, their answer is either no or they hand it off to someone else who says no while also putting you on hold for a significant amount of time.
1. If you call early before rent is due because you have an extenuating circumstance making it impossible until 3 hours after the due date, they will charge you a late fee even after explaining to them you can pay, you just don't have access to something that allows you to pay.
2. They will screw you on your safety deposit - much more so than the average landlord. When I moved out of my first place with them, I left the place spotless. It was in 99% mint condition. When I left, they overcharged me for repairs by an outrageous amount taking my entire security deposit and saying that I owed an extra $180 on top of that which they eventually sent to collections attempting to get me to pay by hitting my credit.
This company is run by thieves who make it impossible to get in contact with someone who will actually help come to a resolution on any problem you may have with them.

To summarize: You will be overcharged and you will not be able to resolve any issues you have with them or the property at which you are staying.
My favorite breakfast place in the Treasure Valley. My kids absolutely love it too.  Thank you for providing a delicious gluten free menu and the coffee is good too.
This was the absolute WORST pizza we have EVER had. I got sick and didn't even finish one piece. We threw away 2/3 of the pizza.

I was really disappointed when I discovered this wasn't a strip club - totally misleading name here, people. 

As previously stated by others, it's a chain, it's "eclectic", service and atmosphere are average - basically your run-of-the-mill grease pit. 

Would recommend Joe Momma's or The Griddle ahead of Le Peep.

This is probably the all around worst dining experience I've ever had.  Poor service, long wait for food (almost 1 1/2 hours) cold food and a chicken breast that was pink and raw in the middle.  My daughter-in-law cannot eat gluten and our server was clearly annoyed when asked for a gluten free menu or gluten free options on the regular menu.  She was unable to find any options that were GF and finally suggested a salad and eventually a grilled chicken breast from the kids menu.  The "salad" was just arugula-no dressing-and it was accompanied by a small amount of cold, undercooked grilled chicken.  We waited for an unreasonable amount of time (1 hour, 20 minutes) without the waitress even checking on us).  I think a certain amount of grace needs to be granted to a new restaurant (new staff, new menu, new processes), but this restaurant will not survive without a dramatic turnaround.  Really disappointing: we won't be going back.

The Express Cafe is legend. Delicious home style cooking, large portions and a great all around value.  For a small indie restaurant that caters to breakfast and lunch, the menu selection is quite extensive. The staff is friendly, the service very good, the facility clean. This is a very popular place, so waiting is always a possibility.  But well, well worth it.
The breakfast was so good! It's an awesome place and awesome service. I would definitely recommend going here for good food. Be prepared for a short wait though it's very popular.
Lance and the entire team are amazing.  We wouldn't think about using any other company. Prices are very reasonable and customer service is the best.
Hands down one of the best places to have breakfast in the valley. The food is great and the staff is better. The owner is a really nice guy. We love it.
Just walked out of this place, I was looking to get some good pizza, and was trying to get helped. Completely ignored by the entire staff. Never coming here

Food was awesome - I had a cedar plank salmon with a dill purée and grilled asparagus so melt-in-your mouth delicious I was stunned! My husband had a burger and fries (without the bun) and he reported that the fries were killer!!

Why not 5 stars then?? Well, truthfully the service was a little...weird. We arrived and the place was pretty empty yet well staffed and yet no one seated us for awhile even though I made eye contact with a few passing servers. But aside from that the server was friendly and helpful and our orders were correct so we were very pleased.

Other than that the place has interesting ambiance/decor. You can have dinner or watch a game (we are not sports people ourselves, but there is the option!) The restaurant itself seemed a little physically split between a sit down dinner place and a sports bar BJs kind of place. Part of me would love to come back for the sit down dinner aspect but I felt the bar area was more busy/inviting and I didn't really like that part because the TVs have the game.

I will definitely be back for more of that salmon!

Daughter had Gooey Buns, they were burnt, she scraped off the almonds.  I had the Country Benedict and was severely disappointed.  The description in the menu sounded delicious, but it was far from that.  Ham was lacking, just a few tiny cubes of ham, not the "country ham" in the menu.  Hollandaise sauce was weak, not creamy.  Steve's and Express Cafe just down the street are far better.  And expensive.  Service was okay.  Nice location, atmosphere.  Didn't realize this is a chain/franchise.

My wife and a friend went at another time and had a similar poor experience (breakfast tacos).  
I will give it one more try, hoping they are just working out the kinks being a new restaurant.

One of our faves for breakfast. Always very clean which is important to me. They are always busy but despite that the service is great! They close at 2:30 on the weekends but will happily serve you at 2:15.
Affordable chiropractic care. Great location, great staff. Highly recommend!

I didn't even get to have anyone come out and I am leaving a negative review. I called just to see about getting a quote for a gas line and I couldn't even get out my request because the guy that answered was so concerned with the reviews on yelp and why I chose them. When I finally was able to let him know why I called he asked if I was looking for a cheap install because they charge a premium and cost more than most so I may be calling the wrong place... Nope when it comes to a gas line I am looking for quality but to be honest I was very put off by the manner of the guy I spoke to and will not be using their service.

I agree with other reviews. Meat is very bland and poorly seasoned. Crunchy tacos were not that crunchy. My taco had  so much cheese it was simply gross. Looked like I had ordered a cheese taco and not a beef taco. Taco Bell is much better than this. Now, if you want to lose weight, by all means eat here. The food  is so bad/bland that will kill your appetite. I ordered 3 tacos and only ate 1 simply bc I worked 12 hours, then went hiking on the mountain and it was 10 pm and desperate for some food. But not desperate enough to eat all 3 tacos. I will not go there again. Drive thru staff girl is super sweet! But the food is .

Always wanted to test this place out but was always too late sincetheyonlydo breakfast and lunch. Decided to have breakfast before work today. I got a pitcher of (assume ) filtered ice water, that's nice instead of the chlorinated water you usually get. I had a late and the Rock Lobster Scrambler, both excellent choices. The eggs were perfectly scrambled and a side of perfect  fried potatoes, not too greasy. 
I'll be back :)

Eaten here several times.  Every time the food and service is spot on.  The owner is often there to offer a greeting or take you to your table.  Their scrambles and breakfast burritos are great.  A regular breakfast and lunch spot for my family.

Yogurt definitely tastes great, but we went in on a Saturday afternoon and the employee was posting signs on 3 machines that ran out of yogurt.  3 out of only about 12 or so flavors is a ton!  You're not left with much else, especially when 5 of the other flavors are fruity sorbets.  I need dark, rich flavors.  There are so many delicious flavors on Menchie's website and I wish the store would carry those but the flavors today were just out of the ordinary.  My suggestion would be to cut down on the sorbets and increase the low carb/no sugar added options.  1 is not enough and it's just plan old vanilla.  Boring.....

I love Panera; it is nice having a healthy option instead of all of the garbage fast food out there.

My only issue with Panera is they need to build more!!!

Love their flavors - dulce de leche, cheese cake and hot fudge. This place is next to Chipotle and is a perfect way to complete an evening.

Cute name too - Menchi.

I can't say enough about this company and their stellar customer service and fantastic management and employees. They did amazing work for my wedding reception, going above and beyond and again for my little sisters wedding. And just recently they helped in a tremendous way with a fundraiser we are doing for our dear friend who has stage 4 cancer. They took the time to look into everything for me, jumping thru hoops and going the extra mile to help. From Cody, to Sara, to Nikki, and Lance and everyone else who works so hard at Event Rent, you are forever our go to event specialists and the best company in the community to work with. Fan and customer for life!

Very good food! Our waitress was very helpful and gave good recommendations. They even have mimosas which is rare at breakfast places for some reason! Just wish they had longer hours! Will definitely be back.

We went there around 6:30 on a Friday night. We seated ourselves in the bar and waited awhile before we were able to put in drink orders. We were told the kitchen was very backed up and that they were out of atleast 7 items on the menu. We had to continously flag our waitress down for refills on our soda for the entire visit. One of these menu items that they were supposedly out of was served an hour later to friends that came in after us, so not sure how that happened, but was disappointed to hear that. The bison burger was great, but the clams we ordered were small and not worth the money. Even though the burger was good I would not go back there until they get their kitchen and wait staff on a better flow to help move dinner along in a timely fashion.

Gooey deliciousness. This may be the best cinnamon roll my husband and I have ever had.

I was a skeptic at first because I hate the v (vegan) word, however, we were pleasantly surprised.

The "old school" choice from the menu is our favorite.

As this  place just opened, will have to give it a second chance.  Very interesting menu, with offerings quite different than expected.  The buffalo wings were very good, but why is the blue cheese dressing served with peppercorns in it?  Had the Wild BLT, and while very tasty, the chopped up boar bacon fell out of the sandwich quite easily.  If you opt for soup, there's a $2 charge that I missed seeing on the menu.  But, the soup of the day, curried chicken with rice, was also good.  The biggest drawback is service time.  There was a party of 6 or so seated outside just as we got there, and at best, 4 tables of customers in the bar area.  Still, it took close to an hour to get our food, the excuse being they were backed up do to a "large party".  Reading other reviews, I see that the kitchen being backed up is a common theme.  Our waitperson also was serving as the bartender, so that also delayed the process.  With their grand opening just over a week away, hope they step it up.  Interestingly, the service issue was about the same when I last went to their sister location, the Barrelhouse on Glenwood.

Just had the tri-tip breakfast burrito and it was the best breakfast I have ever had. When you order a diet coke they bring you a big pitcher so you never run out. So good. They also have a great kids menu. My son absolutely devoured the chocolate chip pancakes. 

I wish I would have found it sooner.

Wife and I went to Flying Pie Pizzaria in Meridian. On a Saturday about 3:00 with only two tables occupied at that time. 

 We sat at a table and waited for a waitress for well over ten minutes just for someone to offer us a drink or anything. Finally after about fifteen minutes . We decided that was our first and last visit to this Pizzaria.
They should be classified as a slow food restaurant. If it takes 20 minutes to make a taco then you've got problems.

I really like it there.  Love Alicia!  I've been going here for years.  I've moved to Nampa a couple years ago but still drive to Meridian to come here.  I have a REALLY hairy dog!  I can't IMAGINE having to do it at home again so I'm thankful Doggie Day Spaw is there....

I love the concept of this shop! Meridian, Idaho store front is modern; associates very helpful.

I needed the charge port changed on my ASUS chromebook. I did a quick google search of how much the part replacement might be and how hard it would be to install it.  Looked quite simple to me. 

I was told the charge would be a total of $114.00. I asked for a breakdown of the cost (parts and labor) and they would not give that answer to me. They said the charge for the part is confidential. The cost for this repair is almost half of what a new chromebook would be.

I expressed my concern with the charge to an associate and they took $10.00 off. I went ahead and told them do the work as I appreciated the $10 discount and I just wanted my chromebook back. It was a convenience issue for me/plus my sister gave me the chromebook and it has sentimental meaning.

When I picked up the chromebook, the associate said the repair was extremely easy; no soldering was needed as is with more tablets/laptops. I asked if he would consider reducing the charge and he said no; it's all just for the labor (which didn't make sense to me, but I wasn't brave enough to push the issue).  

I'm not sure if I will try this same shop again. I do see that many people have had a great experience and I'm glad for that. 
 
I just felt like I might have been ripped off a bit; but not sure.

Had a contest combo pizza delivered. Something very off about the sausage, definitely tasted old and bad. Combination of ingredients was not well balanced, onions were hard and inedible. Ate here one night for Gourmet Night and was not very impressed that time either. Off my list of pizza joints.

Consistent things about this place: very clean (as in spotless), extremely nice staff, good food. That's in order. I've been here a few times now and today I used it as backup after another breakfast joint snubbed us. Food is great. The menu is standard breakfast items but everything tastes and looks great. That's the only reason I gave them 4 instead of 5 stars. The waffles are incredible. I was hurrying up to eat it before my stomach realized it was full long ago.
Disclaimer: This place doesn't look like much from the outside. But give it a shot. The staff have all been there for a long time. There's a short wait to be seated. The longest I've ever waited was still less than 10 minutes. I always recommend sitting at the bar though. Be social for once and meet some new folks. The coffee is very smooth and it never ends. We had the chicken fried steak and the strawberry Belgian waffles. If that doesn't make you happy for breakfast, I don't know what will.

Good tasting frozen yogurt, variety of flavors, 2 sorbets available (pineapple and mango), no added high fructose corn syrup and as silly as it may be, great spoons!  

As a family, we had the chocolate, coffee, vanilla(no sugar added), and both sorbets. All had great flavor and none had high fructose corn syrup.  They also have good options for toppings.  

Great service and located in a good shopping center!  As for seating, there are usually not enough seats - it's likely that we've come during the busier times of the day but we haven't been able to find seats when we go.

I will start with the negatives first as it is always nice to end with the positives. Service was chaotic and very slow. The time between our meal order and delivery was 45 minutes for a few burgers and a sandwich. The order came out wrong and was missing parts of what the menu said came with the meals. My son ordered no salt as he has a low sodium tolerance and you can guess what happened. My wife's burger was just cheese and bacon where it was supposed to come with the normal accoutrements. 
Now on to the positives. We were seated quite rapidly and our beverage order was taken and filled. Nice selection of beers. When the waitstaff did finally come by to check on us we explained the errors to which she apologized and comped a slice of chocolate torte. Still for what the meal cost and the amount of time it will be a while before we return.

I went in to talk about gaining a membership. It was a Saturday morning, and they didn't have enough membership representatives working so we had to wait 15 minutes. Then the guy we worked with struggled to communicate the policies and different options. We kept asking questions, and he said that he didn't know many of the answers. Finally, when we were able to see the actual fees, it was outrageous! $20 a month sounds great, but then you have to pay a $200 joining fee and an additional $40 within three months of signing. I asked him if he ever had specials on the joining fee, and he said he didn't know. He said that you could stretch out the $200 joining fee into smaller monthly payments. It's not when I have to pay it that's the problem, it's that the $200 joining fee is absolutely ridiculous in addition to another $40 within three months.  It was pretty packed when we were there, and he said that the kids club could have up to 40 kids in one room. That's insane! Also the hot tub is broken down when we were there. Needless to say, I walked out without a membership.

All About Paws displayed great skill in grooming our two dogs, Koal & Gracie. Gracie posed several challenges - like lots of matts... but when we picked her up, she was beautiful!!!  Both dogs were expertly done... Marnie and her crew were great with our big dogs!  We'll be back... good prices and service makes an exceptional value.

This place is a blast!!! It's a little pricey for entry but I liked the fact you could stay as long as you wanted. I removed a star because the food was AWFUL. After waiting 20 mins for a meal, I politely reminded them that they forgot. She apologized and said she would make it. We waited another 30 mins and they never made the chicken. All 4 kids didn't finish their food and said it was gross. 
I spent over $150 for entry (no laser or golf) and food/drinks for 4 kids but overall they had a ball.

Not sure how the doctors are. I understand they're fantastic. But this is the second time I've had an appointment and it has been cancelled or mixed up some how.  I wish you better luck than me and my pets.

I've been to this location 3 times now. I really enjoy this chain, but this location has been sub par. The rice has been under cooked and the pork has been cold and dry on each visit. 

This is disappointing because it is so close to work, but I have officially given up on this location.
This is a great place to eat.  I've always received great service, the menu has a variety of options, and I love the food.

Saint Alphonsus in general is a hot mess.
I had to cure myself since they couldn't figure out what was causing my problems after 4 months.  Then I get a gigantic bill (for nothing) and the billing is all screwed up.
We paid our bill, but keep getting notices in the mail.  I've called multiple times over the last 6months and am never able to get through to the billing department, after being put on hold for over half an hour and finally giving up each time.  I've called urgent care, customer service, and other people who will pick up the phone in their building and was told several times that I had a zero balance.
This weekend I get a collection notice for the balance I was told had been paid, and when I finally got through to someone in Urgent Care, they told me I still had a  zero balance, but apparently my entire bill isn't accessible for their viewing.  She said maybe I had a balance from other departments.  My entire balance is from Urgent Care.  And why was I previously told I didn't owe anything?
I am frustrated, to say the least.  I don't have time to sit on hold for hours to repay a bill that was taken care of 6 months ago.

This place is great to watch a Sunday football game at! For 13 dollars they offer all you can drink domestic draft beers which is a steal. We also tried the chili which was quite tasty and the fried pickles were pretty good too. We found our new game day hangout for sure!

La Peep is a mystery to me. Some of their dishes are delicious... spinach crepes Benedict will keep me coming back for more, but a few of their dishes... like the steak sandwich and sandwiches in general have been downright awful. I love this restaurant enough to keep coming back, but the owner needs to come up with a menu of consistent quality.

Ugh, went based on past visits in other states and was sadly disappointed. Service was OK but slow.  Acceptable for a new restaurant though but hold off going right at lunch time for now.  The worst part was the food itaelf.  My turkey sandwich was almost soggy with mayo, maybe to make up for how dry the turkey was.  Baked potato soup  was nice and hot but bland and all cream base. All of that and way overpriced, I'll be avoiding.

One of my faves for a quick to-go meal. You can't beat the burrito bowl! Always good for 2 meals for me. Service is always good and speedy. Employees are friendly always seem to be busy either with customers or cleaning, etc. And here's a first for me... saw an employee taking temps on all the heated the food products. Good to see after their history.

I locked my keys in my car again! We had a change of insurance so we had to get someone out to unlock the car. My husband contacted this company and they were amazing. Quick, clean, and very professional.

Went this am with the family...very inviting staff, clean interior (yes I know it's brand new but still) and plenty of space for seating.

Staff was very attentive and took drink orders within a few minutes of sitting down. Bfast orders were a few minutes after that.

We ordered a variety if items...mostly your standard bfast fare. All of the food came out within 15 mins prolly. Everything was well executed, fresh and hot! Huge portions as well...don't think any of us actually finished but would have if we wanted to be totally stuffed!

Bfast for 4 was ~$40...we will definitely be back and will probably have this at the top of our weekend bfast spots!

#1 - The owners and employees care, always in a good mood.

#2 - The selection is good if you use all the toys, we are RV people only

#3 - The value, where else can you rent a A-Class this cheap?

$4 - They bend over backwards to accommodate unique pick up or drop off times

Great concept, very happy we joined 2 years ago!

Looking for a great meal - with great service.  Prepare to wait your turn during peak times, but this place is the real deal.  The staff has been there so long they wear shirts noting their years of service.  The boss is obviously doing more than putting out great food at an ever greater price.

They have a big selection that's on par with other candy stores in the area.  The employees seem nice.  I got the impression that the prices here are really high however.  

I wouldn't mention the price difference if it was just a few cents.  Candy purchased here will run you about movie theater price but it will be what you want.  I was really shocked at how much more I paid for the candy.

Ordered White Chocolate Mocha and Americano. Both drinks were excellent. The barista was awesome; friendly, chatty, fun... took our drinks to go but the dining room looked really comfortable. The food menu looks great, I will be back for sure.
Love this place there coffee is great, service is great and they are a BUY IDAHO business. Great drinks and snacks, perfect atmosphere for a large group, studying or just catching up with a friend.
We've been here several times and lived it. Today was our first brunch experience and, despite having to drive in from Boise, LOVED it! Awesome food and service. We'll be back!
Best thing on the menu is the trout with eggs, hash browns.  Usually great IF the owner is present.

Taking our rescue pup to SitMeansSit and spending a little more for the immersion training was the best financial and mental decision we made in 2015.  The piece of mind we get every time we take our excitable pup into public is well worth the money.  However, more important than the cost of SMS training is your commitment as a dog owner. You could spend thousands of dollars and if you are not committed to the process and actually listen to Jim and his trainers, you're spending good money after bad. RECOMMENDATION: Go to SMS and listen to what Jim and Devin have to say.  Then picture yourself confident and comfortable with your loved pooch out in public.  Its a no brainer!!!

Great food, super clean,  and usually its standing room only. Not to long of a wait though because they are quick. The wait staff must love their job most have been working their for years. They have the best bacon and fry sauce around.

The massage therapists offered me a $20 one hour massage so I scheduled with them.  When I got to the business it was actually a chiropractic consult.  I really don't appreciate the bait and switch.  What a bummer.

As of March, this is a bogus company. They put the townhouse we own "up for rent" or was it a scammer impersonating them. No response from our phone messages. Research says they no longer exist. Flagging the rental ad on Zillow, Trulia, etc. has not been 100% successful.
Man, this place is great. They got me right in and out. They know what customer service is all about!

Today was our first visit to All about Paws after being highly recommend by a family member and I am so glad we went. My little chihuahua Roxy absolutely loved Marnie as did I! She was amazing and very personable. We ended up chatting for about 10 minutes when I came for pick up. Roxy was groomed, nails cut, the works and I was very pleased with what we were charged. We will DEFINITELY be back!!!! Thanks Marnie for a great experience

Wonderful breakfast experience today! Started with a nice chat with our front door host, Ashton. He told us about his menu favorites along with great recommendations. A very nice and engaging young person and excellent first greeting. Dining service was right on par, Eggs Benedict, biscuits and gravy were a few of our favorites, perfectly seasoned and delicious. Thanks so much! We will be back!

I sure do like there food and coffee. The only thing that keeps me from going here are there prices. Way to high for a breakfast place. If you take a family of 4, hope you have at lest a 60 dollars on you, but they do have some of the best French toast I have ever had.

We are just traveling through and decided to get breakfast here because our hotel did not offer breakfast. The food was just okay. Kids had ENORMOUS chocolate chip pancakes (a little over cooked) and my husband and I had Colorado omelets (not terrible, not amazing....a little dry.) The service was good and the restaurant is very clean.
Top service and integrity for days. I definitely recommend this place for most of your auto service needs!
You can't beat the price of their pain management plans. I've been a member and pain free for over 2 years. The staff is incredible, and the adjustments are a must if you have chronic pain.

The food was not anything outstanding. Actually I didn't really like it for the price. Then customers were being sat around the edge of the restaurant. Our waiter was not around much, so the service experience was lame

Food was very good with excellent balance of texture, presentation, and most importantly taste. I had the burger, wife had prime steak sandwich. Lotsa meat In the sandwiches, these were not meat-teasers. Fries were very good they are prepped with spices to give em that tweak that keeps you reaching for the pile. Our waiter Aaron was very prompt, courteous and helpful. I had lost river raspberry beer and it was hellov good

Our experience was positive tho I really do feel marketing their burger meat as "Kobe" is a stretch and misleading. Wagyu beef is more likely but who would take Wagyu, or Kobe for that matter and grind it for a burger.... Cmon guys. Internet is full of education on Kobe. Don't do it!

Event Rent did a great job helping me make up my mind, and the lady that helped me pick everything out was knowledgeable. The prices are pretty fair, and you can pick up items the day before your event, and return the following Monday if you're renting over a weekend. The only thing I would warn others about is an "optional" Damage Fee that is 12% of entire rental cost...She never asked me if I wanted this added on, or never told me that they even offered damage protection. I reviewed my invoice later and called, they refunded the amount. 
I told them that it was shady not to ask customers before adding on such a charge. They lady got a little bit curt with me when I told her that. That being said, I would rent from them again.

I alway thought they could nothing wrong with pizza but last couple of times the pizza has not been that good. If anyone there reads this do some quality checks don't just look at them they looked good just did not taste that great and that's sad...

I bought a Groupon for $20. A supposed $70 value for a one hour massage and Aromatherapy treatment.  I asked what the therapist was doing for the aromatherapy and she said she put some lavender oil on the sheets. My massage was only 40 minutes long and I didn't smell any lavender oil. I had to ask her to put on some soft music, and once she did, the same song played the entire time.  Groupon was nice enough to refund half of it but I wouldnt buy another one for this place. The massage was decent, but I've had way better.

Fast seating, awesomely friendly staff.  Food was ok, although I have to admit, the hash browns were terribly bland.  Didn't seem to have any butter or salt or anything.  Was a little disappointed as the rest of the food/experience was so good.  Hopefully it was a fluke and next time we go they were be great!

Outstanding frozen yogurt and toppings! They allowed someone to bring their puppy in the store the other day, and that was a little disturbing. Other than that, I really enjoy stopping by for a treat. It is addictive!!!

Not worth the $18 for the two of us. Really small meals and the salad came with very little dressing not even enough to enjoy it. I love Panera in Seattle but in idaho they suck and have a very long way to go.

Just returned from our first trip there and I can say is you can only make a first impression once and this one was not so good. No water without asking, no beer list, first beer ordered out, missing ingredients for the sangria so had to skip that...just a sampling of some of the service missteps. Now this place does have promise. Some of the food was well done...the maple bacon peanuts were great as were the clams as an appetizer. When my wife asked about the bison short ribs, she was told they were kind of a small portion...for $28. It actually was a good dish but the server was right...it was kind of small. My bison burger was good but I had made some modifications upon ordering and they weren't actually followed. I ate half of it and pointed out to the waitress who apologized and that was that. I also would have expected to see a manger type person walking around such a new place but no such luck. I hope they work out these kinks and once I hear good things, I'll try it again. Until then, there a much better options around town.
The food was really good, a bit pricey. They have a very limited menu. Very nice inside and a good selection of local beers. Love the chandelier.

I love the concept of The Joint. I live part time in Idaho, the rest of the time I am in Florida, plus I travel and can pop in to any of the Joint locations around the country. I did love My previous chiropractor, but he retired and since my insurance only paid for a few visits a year, it was not cheap. There are several doctors at the Boise location and I do prefer some over others but for a quick adjustment and none of the other hassle, it's working out great for me.
My only complaint is that I wish they opened at 8am rather than 9.

Second visit was definitely different from the first, some things better and some not.

Customer service was definitely more friendly and chatty this time. Took time to go over and explain away to the friend with me regarding any questions she had.

The bun I had this time was nowhere near as good as the first. I ordered raspberry icing with chocolate drizzle and fresh raspberries.The chocolate sauce is kinda low grade Hershey syrup type stuff. The raspberry icing was kinda runny and meh. Fresh raspberries are always good. Bun itself was dry. Ate half and put it my fridge and it ended up in the garbage. Just had no desire to finish. 

Friend got chai icing and fresh fruit with caramel. Hers looked better but I hate chai flavor so didn't try it.

My friends bun went the same way as mine. Total bummer considering she was in town and I talked this place up big..    :/

Where is the big fluffy icing I see in their ads? Both times I've been now the icing is runny. Am I ordering the wrong thing? Don't get me wrong, the cake batter icing is very good but neither icing I've tried so far looks like the giant cloud of icing in their pics..

Going to try again sometime..
Great selection, fresh toppings, friendly staff and always clean. This is our "go-to" yogurt place and it never disappoints. I love the crushes jolly rancher topping!!

Possibly the worst pet groomer in town. Not helpful. We've given them multiple chances and are disappointed every time. Not only are they poor at giving the cuts, they don't even seem to want to let you do it yourself. We went in one day at 1:30 to do it ourselves and they said it wasn't a good time because they were going to be "closing at 4". Another time we took a dog in, there was literally zero difference in his hair when we went to pick him up after. We're done wasting our time, don't waste yours either.

Food was okay but not worth the price. You can go to either of the neighboring restaurants for the same food but for cheaper. We will try again in a few months but it's just not what it's trying to be which is a "unique taphouse restaurant".

A great new place.  Son-in-law started with 5 samples of beer and said all of them were great.  Had an appetizer of beer fondue which comes with bread and roasted brussels sprouts!  I love brussels sprouts so all of us loved this.  I had their burger with the bacon and it was very tasty.  I want my meat well done and this was done to perfection.  No pink but still moist and flavorful.  Son-in-law had The Prime and said the meat was good but would have liked it a little more rare.  He said the au jus was excellent!  Large sandwich and he ended taking some home.  My daughter had the gnocchi and said it was ok.  The gnocchi was a little over cooked and it had roasted onions in, which she won't eat.  She is a very picky eater so I didn't take any points off for that.

The waitress was very attentive and the bill was reasonable for what we had ordered.  Will definitely be back as their menu has items you don't regularly see.

I purchase d a home using Jaylene Groeniger, and I am the worst client can have...a n out of state Realtor!.  

Jaylene who works at Coldwell Banker Thomlinson worked above and beyond to ensure my transaction closed and after closing helped orchestrate all the elements an out of state move requires.

She is amazingly thoughtful and generous with her time.  Thanks Jaylene and Coldwell Banker Thomlinson for helping me through this transition.

Park Place took over management of my and my roommate's rental property after we had moved in with a different property management agency a few months prior. Their service was absolutely pathetic. When my bedroom flooded in my apartment, they were extremely slow to work with the owner's maintenance crew and did not communicate with me at all throughout the process, and consequently I had maintenance workers coming in when I had not planned for it because I had received no information from Park Place. Furthermore, when I called Park Place and asked them if there was a way I could let the owner know that the head maintenance man was rude to me and completely absent when I had all these floods (my bedroom flooded 3 times, so I had to deal with these men on 3 separate occasions), Park Place told me that I could write a complaint letter and send it through them to the owner. To this day I have no idea if they even sent the letter through, as I never got a reply or even an acknowledgement that it had been sent to the owner.

Finally, we were given short notice that we were being taken over by yet another new property agency for the last few months of our lease. Two weeks before this change happened, someone had parked overnight in my designated parking spot; however since nobody had bothered to put warning signs over the assigned parking, they couldn't legally be towed. I called Park Place asking if they could find a way to get a sign up; they gave me this pathetic excuse that since they were only with us for 2 more weeks, they did not think it would be worth it for them to go through the process of putting up signs. Turns out that when I asked our new property management about it, they had a sign up within 3 days of my calling them.

Park Place fell extremely short of my expectations, and I am deeply saddened that they were the ones who managed my apartment complex for 3/4 of the time my roommate and I lived there. Unless you actually want half-assed, pathetic service, I would strongly advise finding a home through a different property management agency.

Great facial by S. atmosphere was like a Shabby Chic meets modern decor. We were offered a free makeover after our facials in wigs he make up area she gave me the most beautiful new look. Will be back.

this place is awesome really.    if you have 5 bucks and love tacos, you are in business. 

  in fact - if you have 11.00 you can feed your family. LOL    the place is clean and the staff is friendly.     get your own pop or water.    if you buy more than ten tacos you get them for 39 cents a pop.  it's a great place for fun and it's  awesome cheap.

I just started coming to this office and needed a crown fixed.  I am one of the many not so fond of the dental visit.  The whole team makes the process more enjoyable (tolerable), from insurance headaches, cleanings, explaining costs and procedures, to the gentle dentist Mr Scott.  They show you pictures of what they are fixing on the monitor so you know what is happening or better yet, give you headphones and the remote if you would rather not see.  I feel totally comfortable referring them to anyone.

A neighbor asked us who trimmed our trees today, and I happily gave our recommendation.   Then I realized I hadn't posted a review for Yelp, so here it is:

We had Meridian Tree Service tend to some trees that hadn't been pruned in some time.  We also needed help with a shrub that was causing damage to our fence.   Theirs was the very best quote we got, and we couldn't have been happier with their service.  Everyone we dealt with, from Dennis the owner to Teena on the telephone, was pleasant and professional.

At the time the work was done, quite a few cut branches fell into a neighbor's yard.  They cleared out those branches as well as all the others.  The shrub needed to be removed, and they did a great job with that, too.

We'll happily use them again if we need any tree work done, and we'll continue to recommend them to friends & neighbors.

Service was great! Good thing I ignore some of the reviews. I shared an old skool with my husband and it was the perfect sweetness...not overly sweet like typical cinnamon roll stands. My daughter got a marshmallow frosting with marshmallow toppings. She was quite pleased. We are visit f from out of town but impressed enough to ask for other locations. We when are back visiting, we will definitely be back.

Was really great start to our mini vacation! Loved the atmosphere and the people. I had a white chocolate mocha and the Denver omelet while my husband had the biscuits and gravy! No complaints on either meal!

My wife and I went here for breakfast our food was delicious. Our eggs were cooked correctly and our food came out warm. The service was quick and polite. This place makes there own coffee drinks and the person who took our order was extremely helpful in explaining what each coffee drink was. Awesome environment, would higher recommend this place.
Awesome service! Fixed the issue right up. Honest about prices and fast. Will definitely return.
The menu is very big and the food is awesome! My wife and I have found are new breakfast place in town! It is a must try the biscuits and gray are the best in town.

I am mainly giving this place 5 stars because they are open later than almost all of the non-corporate store in the greater area.  They also pull some good coffee and have a pleasant atmosphere for study or work, so they earned the stars all around.

Called him and he responded quickly and basically diagnosed it over the phone..was the second person to tell me to buy a new tv so no point in fixing my screen on my tv since it'll cost as much as new tv. Thanks for the response!

I would honestly have to say this is one of the worst actually it is the worst Property Management I have ever rented from. The majority off the staff are rude, never email or call you back. Haven't kept not 1 appointment we have scheduled. I have lived in my unit and now for almost a year and nothing has ever been fixed needless to say I will never sign a lease with them again.

Local ownership among a crowd of corporate eateries...great start!  Love the booths.  Smells from the kitchen told me the food was going to be great...and..it was!  Had the Smoked Prime Rib sandwich.  The au jus sauce had just the right hint of horseradish--delicious.  Went with the fries, good, crisp, but the best part was the ranch dipping sauce/dressing.  Very unique and pleasing flavors--told the owner they should bottle it and sell it.  Hubby, a chicken and fish guy, had the kobe burger and said more than once how good it was.  Commented that his side salad was different (fresh greens atop a slice of baguette) but that he really enjoyed it.  All service personnel were pleasant and helpful.  We will go back and I am saving that 5th star for a more complete sampling of their menu.  Easy to support this local business.

Enjoyable new dining with nice fresh ingredients.  Dishes seem to be a bit of a different take on traditional breakfast dishes so if you want the same old eggs and potatoes may not be the place for you.  We found it to be a nice change from the run of mill dishes, same things served with some imagination.  Staff was very nice, place is very clean and service was good. They are very new and working out small issues, be a bit patient and kind,  food is really tasty.  Prices are in line with many other places, although I thought coffee was pricey!

These are the best wings in town.  They have mild, medium and hot sauces available. Their garlic fries are incredible also. 

For the lighter eater, they have salads, but let's be real, we don't go here for vegan fare. There is a nice lunch menu to choose from as well as a kids menu. 

It's Super Bowl Sunday and we just picked up a party platter of wings and I can't wait to serve them.

I would give them none start if it was possible, they are the worst possible property management, they are incompetent, rude and will take months before they fix anything, but be aware if you are renting take pictures of everything in the property especially if is any damage and keep it, because they will find the way to take your deposit money and even change you more money to fix something that is not even Broken, but they won't fix anything because they keep playing the same thing to the next people getting in the property you just left, we rented for two years and to be completely honest we left the property better than we found it,and when we asked for our deposit back the girl on the other side of the desk said that it was berry funny,  they give us a huge list of things that need to be replaced like a brand new carpet that it took 20 months for them to replace but ones we left they want us to pay for a carpet replacement.  They did the same thing to my sister, well I ges that's how they make their money.

I was not familiar with the chain Panera Bread.  When they opened up near my workplace, I thought why not?  I took a companion and here is what we observed:

Ambience:  Tiny areas for sitting.  We chose a table in the back and our table was so close to the next table that we could barely fit in to our tables without brushing up against the other diners.  When getting up to fill my drink glass, I bumped in to 2 different purses/jackets hanging on the back of diners chairs.  There was just no place to move and feel comfortable.

Service:  Average at best.  Workers behind the counters seemed pleasant but with undertones of feeling stressed and just wanting to get us through the line.

Food:  Panera gets one star for their food.  I ordered a 1/2 Panini with a cup of soup.  My Panini was overly cooked and the outside tasted like burnt toast.  The soup was tasteless except for the salt that over-powered any limp vegetables in my cup.  My companion ordered a 1/2 Turkey & Avocado sandwich with a cup of the same soup.  When she opened up her sandwich, there was the tiniest smattering of avocado - less than 1/2 a teaspoon.  What a joke!  My companion then looked at our bill and this was the kicker.......

Price:  When first observing the menu board, Panera Bread has cleverly tried to disguise their high prices.  They show 1 price for the sandwich and then show another price for 1/2 sandwich and cup of soup.  Unfortunately, that price is incorrect - that's only for the sandwich.  They then charge you a la carte for the soup.  
For the both of us to have 2 - 1/2 sandwiches, 2 tiny cups of soup and 2 regular sized drinks, it cost us $28:00.  That's insane - especially since everything else was terrible to mediocre at best!
We then heard the diners next to us (how could we not, we were practically in their laps) complaining about the same thing.  They were upset about the menu pricing and how they felt duped.  Another diner ordered a a bagel and cream cheese and they were charged separately for the cream cheese.

A complete waste of time and money.  I suggest you go to Kneaders, the Boise Co-Op or a 1/2 dozen other sandwich establishments in the same area.
Best breakfast in the treasure valley hands down! Love the hash browns and biscuits and gravy! The service is just as exceptional too. My favorite place for breakfast.

We dropped our golden retriever off at all about paws this morning, we have never brought him in before.  We are very happy with his bath and hair cut. The staff here seem to genuinely love all of the animals that were brought in for their grooming.  They were very personable and polite. Boost (our golden retriever) looked great when we picked him up. What was a nice surprise was boost was actually relatively calm when we picked him up; usually it takes about 20 minuets to calm him down when we get him so we think that is was probably a good experience for boost also! We will definitely be coming back here for more grooming!

We have recently re-discovered TCBY! I drive by this location a couple times each day and always think I should stop and never had actually done it, until a couple weeks ago. I love that they have daily specials, especially "Waffle Cone Wednesday". $1.99 for a small waffle cone is great! We generally go to the drive-thru and always have great service.

Stopped by later (9-ish) on a Friday night. First thing that caught our eye was the menu - very basic...same crap you see at any run-of-the-mill 'brewhouse'. Beer selection was okay, but spendy ($6 each).

Hubby ordered a burger, me, a sandwich. Burger was okay - bland, but not overcooked. My grilled sandwich was another story. Noticed an off-putting smell right away. Everything tasted okay, but it took me a few minutes to place that smell. Apparently the cooks were feeling a little antsy to get out of there...the smell was grill cleaner. Fries were good, though!

All in all, a waste of money - lots of better options in the area.
Great breakfast. My family really enjoyed the pancakes.  The service was really friendly and the prices were fair.  I look forward to returning soon.

Went in for Pedicures and were delighted with the service and friendliness of our techs.  Prompt service. 

It was nice being off in a separate room.

Beautiful spa and clean.
Very inefficient. Girls at front counter more interested in talking to each other rather than seething people. Empty tables.

A typical diner, but lacking compared to other Boise counter-parts. I went here do to the high star rating, but found the food to be above average, but the prices and decor were just average. Nothing too special, WYSIWYG

Service was above par and deserves 4 stars, but the overall experience left me wanting more. Maybe it was the school cafeteria florescent light feel or just the customers there on the day we went.

Had high hopes for an "around the corner, you can walk to" breakfast place. The food turned out to be a big disappointment. Two day old, out of the refrigerator-cold bacon, and stale potatoes. Prices would be acceptable if the food was better. Wait staff was pleasant. Hostess needs an attitude adjustment. Hopefully, we just hit them on a bad day.

I ordered sympathy flowers for a client of mine. My order should have been a large arrangement of yellow lilies, instead I got a phone call thanking me for the pink flowers. Umm no. So I had her send me a photo and sure enough my sympathy card was on a tiny sparse pink and white arrangement. Not at all what I ordered online. I called to get the issue resolved, they will not take any responsibility, they have no interest in making things right. They charged me a lot and sent a little. And the worst part is i sent this because their was a death in the family, that's not a time to get things wrong!

Stopped here because the name was catchy! Delighted to get delicious food and service to match. The patio was clean and pleasantly shaded for an enjoyable outside lunch with my pup (another bonus). They had no problem welcoming him with a bowl of fresh water. I had a half BLT and salad. Nothing spectacular but plenty of food with good flavor and a nice presentation. The wait staff were friendly and prompt. Prices reasonable. If I lived in Meridian I would be here more often but while in the area I'll stop again. They serve breakfast until 4 so that might be my next visit!

This company charges far more than a fair rate. Do your research in Boise before calling this company. Very friendly, but they surely don't understand how repeat business works...as it relates to competitive/fair pricing.

Looking for something new and found Le Peep on Yelp so gave it a try, and we were glad we did. The family ordered a variety of dishes which were enjoyed by all. The pancakes of the month were Lemon Ricotta Blueberry, which were to die for. I had a mini omelette, perfect for my appetite. Instead of just frying potatoes, they bake them chopped up, so none of the greasy taste.  All of the other choices disappeared quickly from the plates. Casual dining at its finest.

Upon arriving in Boise with my u-haul and needing a place to live as soon as possible, I toured various properties some of which were PPPM properties. I decided to sign at one of Park Place's communities. They were able to get me moved into my new home in less than 24 hours after I provided a signed application! I could hardly believe it. 

PPPM uses technology to make applying and then signing leases quick and extremely easy through the DocuSign system. (No printer needed for any part of the process). The staff at their corporate office was very friendly and eager to assist me in the process despite my pressure to move quickly. The property manager and her assistant were responsive and helpful during the process.

Time will tell how Park Place holds up as a management group, but I have had a very positive experience thus far. The community that I am a part of, Linder Springs, is great. The townhouses are brand new and I loved the flood plans they had to offer. I have zero complaints thus far since moving in a few weeks ago.
Good pizza but not great like the Flying Pie in Boise little loud up front by the register and you can't buy your beer with your pizza must go to the bar

Stopped by here before heading to the airport. Place was pretty busy even on a weekday so just got seated at the bar. Ordered the stuffed french toast with a side of hash browns. Found most of the food to be just okay, nothing special. Prices were decent and the service was pretty mediocre. Certainly not a bad place, but not great either.

My experiences at other chipotle locations has been stellar, as far as the meridian location goes, I was disappointed. first of all, the chips were sub par, and the jalapeños inside of my corn salsa were massive. On top of that food safety was obviously not a top priority of the staff members. Overall I was not satisfied. Last time I was at this location the chicken was undercooked causing illness. I won't be returning to this location. However I love chipotle and will go to any other location than this.

Robbed us of $200. The maintenance company they use upcharges any supplies used ($19 for a quart of bulk paint they keep in stock VS. $7 at Home Depot... OR... They'll charge you for tools and then "throw them away"... Yeah right... I just bought the maintenance man's new paint brush. And mind you $10 bought him a nice one. Enjoy your paint brush!!!! What apartment honest company does that!?!?!?... OR... We had maintenance come fill a porcelain chip in the tub (he had a liquid bottle of porcelain in his maintenance truck), yet when we moved out they filled a tiny porcelain chip on the stove they "had" to buy a WHOLE new bottle, charge us for it, and then they "threw the rest away"... Yeah right... Just paid for his new bottle of liquid porcelain ;)... OR... They'll charge you $140/4hrs to fill and paint holes from your wall hangings. Idaho State  Code states this as normal wear and tear... But we made the mistake of assuming we could "LIVE" in our apartment. According to their lease it is not considered "normal" wear and tear... So you pay for it $$$ ENJOY! Just expect to be robbed when you move out ;) you've been warned. The manager is nice though :) God bless her

The smoked prime rib is amazing!!!! Great service and killer beer selection. When the restaurant first opened, the service struggled on the high-traffic nights but went in this time on a Saturday night and the service was great. I love having a nice place like this to eat without having to park downtown.

My family and I have been here several times and we have never had a bad meal. They cook the over easy eggs perfect! My kids love the pancake faces they do. We have tried the eggs Benedict, omelets, biscuits and gravy, and the chicken fried steak. Ea h dish was amazing. The hours are limited so they are always busy.

The most aggressive/abusive trainers in town
 I had my beautiful yellow lab there it took me 4 extra days to get him home. Within in 12 hours of having home bit me in the face.he had sores,burns and scabs all around his neck that we were not made aware of. Won't follow through on any warrantees they speak of it was terribly high pressure sales. Never.never,never use these guys again. Run from them.

Stopped in for lunch.  Pauly was his usual jovial self, busy getting the lunch crowd served.  He managed to pour me a clam digger, but had to remind him "you know, like a bloody mary, but with Clamato".  Probably better known as a Bloody Ceasar.
