Ordered the lite lunch, burger and cup of chili, and was delighted to find the cooks homemade chili to be excellent.  Reminded me of chili houses in Kansas City back in the sixties.  Yum, the lunch sufficiently satisified the palate and a second digger finished it off.  Will definitely be a repeat lunch stop sometime soon!  Sure glad I don't have a job to go back to after lunch.  But glad to have a driver.

If you like a waitstaff that ignores you unless they are being rude, this is the place for you. The pizza is good, but not worth it. Service was beyond horrible. Tables were dirty. Napkin dispensers were empty. Did mention the service was poor?
Our most favorite breakfast place! Food is always great and service is also superb! This is definitely our go-to place!

How this place has 1 $ sign is beyond me. An omelet is $11.99 which is actually more than most other restaurants. Oh and get this, I ordered the western omelet and asked to sub bacon for ham. Sure we can do that for a buck. Really? So you kept the ham and charged me a buck? That's terrible. Decent food, poor food pricing and lack of transparency in pricing is worth 3 stars. And don't tell me that this place is any cheaper than other restaurants in town.

Horrible service, waited 10 minutes after being told to sit where we wanted. Zero service. This is our second attempt at giving this establishment a try. Previously our drinks were all completely wrong, we complained to owner at that time. Now a service issue. Not impressed.
Just picked up our Bichon and he looks amazing !! What a great job they did and the atmosphere is great for dogs. Very friendly people we will be back . Thank you!!

This was the worst experience ever. Do not take your dog here. I was crying after I picked up my puppy. As a matter of fact I'm contacting the BBB tomorrow. They did absolutely nothing to my dog and then charged me for service. I showed up and they acted like they didn't know I had an appt. I left my dog and came back. She was in a cage. They had not done a thing and tried to tell me it's because it was her first visit. Both of the women were so rude. My dog was shaking. Please do not bring your pet here.

The crew did an absolutely exceptional job with our 40ft Motor Coach. True professionals! They work as a team and take every precaution to leave the site clean. The wheels glisten. The body shines. Will definitely call them again.

Service was absolutely amazing!!! Our sever Echo made us feel welcome. The Rock Lobster scramble was too die for! We're from Arizona and in town to visit friends, this will definitely be a redo when we come back!!! Try the blood orange mimosa!
Friendly and great service! They were very helpful with tightening up a large hitch bolt. Very clean shop!

This is the best pizza in town. It has quality ingredients and tons of toppings. However, it takes forever to get your pizza and you can call for to-go and there will be a recording that they arent taking any more orders. I understand they want to make sure the pizza quality isnt jeopardized. But it makes it difficult for those of us that want pizza to understand that at the time LOL

Went there today with the wife and kids. Had to wait about 10 min at 11:30. Which was a good sign. It was pretty busy but appeared to be organized and people were getting in and out pretty quickly. The menu had a lot to choose from. We were all able to find something that sounded good. I did the works omelet which was $ 9.95 I think. I portion size was good and our food came out fast. The omelet and hash browns were very good. They even had my favorite condiment chipotle tabasco, which I hardly ever see anywhere. Overall very pleased with our meal!
Delicious!!! Too pricey at $7-$8 for one cinnamon roll but high quality nice treat once in a while.

I'm ashamed to say that in the 15 years we've lived in the valley, we've never been to a Gourmet Night. We planned a night out with some coworkers, and hubby was looking forward to getting a habanero pizza to go (crazy boy loves them, but only cold). However, our experience was less than stellar. 

The first time we tried to go was 7/17/18. We walked into an oven - the a/c was broken! We were assured that it would be fixed the following week, so we left.

Fast-forward to tonight, 7/24/18. 100+ outside...welcome to a Boise summer! Again, we were welcomed to a sweatshop. We didn't want to postpone again, so we suffered thru it, though we did not stay long - we would have loved to stay to have a few more beers and chat with the AWESOME bartender that was on shift. I couldn't bring myself to even try most of the pizzas being offered, but the few I did try were great. Would be nice if they were labeled, though.

Disclaimer - I will edit my review once we get to visit with working a/c! The fact that people have to work under these conditions is asinine...and it speaks volumes to how little you really care for your employees, much less paying customers.

I have been going to Panara Bread for years from California to Iowa. I must say I was disappointed in the Meridian store. The Thai salad was terrible plus they were out of their French baguette which was very disappointing. The Asian salad was good but much smaller than I have had at their other locations. I will go back but I'm hoping they will improve.

Honestly stop looking. If you need management services or are looking for a home Park Place is going to work well for you. Great team, fantastic leadership and all the tools they need to make your relationship with them exactly what you're looking for.

Two thumbs down. Very expensive. Waiter forgot my son's Coke. Then later forgot my wine. Wife and son only picked at their turkey sandwich and finger steaks. I went home with a stomach ache from the prime dip. Won't be returning.

This place hits all the marks from friendly staff, to quick service and delicious food :) I got the one biscuit and gravy special with hashbrowns extra crispy, scrambled eggs and bacon. Wow it was a great deal and I couldn't even finish it all. If I was living here this would be a regular spot, but sadly I can only have this when visiting the parents. I guess I'll have to visit more often!

Disappointed...dirty, very few fruit options left 4 hours before closing, and most looked dried out. If this was our first experience at a Menchie's we'd never go back, but since we've had great experiences at other locations, perhaps this was just an off night. It was so slow that I can't give an excuse for the dirty tables, floors, food counters and walls. Maybe a pack of unruly people just left?

A long-time fan of Panera from back when I lived in Oklahoma, I was excited to see it finally make an appearance in Boise. I am initially giving 3 stars for several reasons, but man, this just wasn't what I expected. I think it doesn't help that I'm such a HUGE fan of Kneaders and just can't see myself ever going to Panera in lieu of Kneaders. All in all, I don't think I have anything AGAINST Panera, I just think there are really good similar spots in Meridian that I'd rather visit instead.

Food: The food is all really good. The bagels, soups, sandwiches, salads, sides, treats, coffee... it's all VERY GOOD. And a little pricey, but hey, you're going out to eat, so who really cares? The food is NOT a complaint at Panera. They do it right, especially their cinnamon crunch bagel, yum! 

Drinks: Serve yourself coffee bars are always a win. Their hazelnut brew is delicious.

Atmosphere: This is where Panera falls short. I think it will be better once the weather warms up and their outdoor seating expands, but the inside seating area is SO CRAMPED. My husband and I took the cozy chair seating by the fireplace and were very surprised at how many people ran into us (literally) as they were passing us to go to the soda fountain. It was just absolutely packed, which is good for Panera, but bad if you're trying to enjoy a peaceful meal. My only advice is don't go during peak times (breakfast/lunch/etc) and you'll be set. 

Service: Very friendly. It seems like the workers there truly enjoy working at Panera.

Happy Hour Offerings: n/a

Healthy Hack: Shoot, normally I opt for oatmeal but theirs has over 60g carbs! Grab a side salad & cup of brothy soup instead.

Tips: Don't go during peak hours!

My daughter had her wedding on Saturday but her hair plans fell through. Debbie, Vanessa, and Casa Bella CAME THROUGH!! They accommodated us before normal business hours and did an amazing job for my daughter and my wife! 

The style was perfect to match their dresses, skin tones, and facial structure. And they charged us such a fair price! They really could have taken advantage of us but did not, thankfully! We were so impressed and will be forever grateful to Casa Bella for helping to make this most important day just perfect!

We always enjoy going to Cinnaholic and making a tasty creation! It's like Cold Stone but with Cinnamon Rolls.. so fun and so many delicious frosting and topping choices! We've yet to find a combo we didn't like!

I'm so glad Boise finally has a dump and crack seafood place! What's more fun than putting on a lobster bib and digging into messy buttery seafood?!

The decor is kitschy and fun. About what you would expect from a casual seafood place. The wait staff were all super nice...although ours had no idea how to work the technologically driven waiter iPad. But we had a good laugh about it. 

There are some great fried basket options as well as the steam bags. It's on the hefty price tag but we expected that. We ordered the Reels Catch with 1.25 pounds of snow crab legs, 1 pound of mussels, and one pound of head on shrimp in the garlic butter sauce. It also comes with two corn on the cons and some red potatoes. Everything was delicious, especially the sauce. And the food arrived so fast which was nice because we were starving. 

This is a great fun experience for the whole family!

We had avoided PPPM for many months due to the scathing reviews online, until we found a home that was truly perfect for our needs. Our experience has been stunningly good- everyone we have interacted with has provided excellent service, a caring, can-do attitude, and personalized help that contrasts many of the reviews we read. In fairness, we just signed our lease and received keys today, but so far, I could not be happier...
Came here for the music one night and they had a lady from Challis playing.  She was awesome!  The serving staff and manager were also great!  I'd come here again!!

The family and I were drawn here because of a Facebook offer and were quite disappointed. The shop itself is very small with only about 4-5 tables inside and 2 or so outside. Because of the small space it becomes very crowded and chaotic quickly. The flavor options were good and flavors were good but not over the top. The topping options were sufficient but nothing that sparked much interest from myself or my wife. If you are looking for some self serve yogurt I would avoid Menchies and head to yogurtz or aspen leaf. Both have bigger facilities and more yogurt flavors to choose from.

Great service, quality food!  Surprised at how affordable the menu is. A lot of other breakfast spots in the valley are so expensive. I ate the pancakes and eggs and they were some of the best pancakes I've had in town. Definitely will come back!
Because I can't give negative stars. They don't put their customers first and are only out to make money for themselves.

I love this place and I'm not even a cinnamon roll/sweets junkie. My favorite is lemon frosting with raspberries as a topping but the cream cheese and vanilla frostings are really good too! My husband loves the blueberry pie option. The best thing about Cinnaholic is that it's vegan. My husband can't do dairy so this is the perfect dessert spot. We've also taken several friends and everyone has enjoyed it. One out-of-state guest insisted we go back three times during her four-day visit.

We stopped by for a first visit today based on a full parking lot daily and strong Yelp reviews.  Breakfast is their focus with a lunch offering as well.

We opted for eggs and all the extras .. 

A clean place with helpful staff, good marks here.  Where the slope begins to get slippery is with both the price per person and the food quality.  Volume is their gift but if you are looking for a taste delight you may want to pass.  The country potatoes are deep fried and missing any loving care.  Eggs average and the toast/jam was ordinary (vs extraordinary).  

When we looked at the $30 tap for two breakfast plates (without tip) the product just didn't measure up.  A one and done for us - onto the next hot spot please.

The wife and I gave Barrel 55 a run on a Friday at 5:00 PM.  Despite being the only patrons in the dinning area we were directed to the booth right outside the kitchen,  really?  I asked to be seated elsewhere forgoing the kitchen / server traffic.

We started out with Beer Cheese Fondue and Artichoke (the things we do to avoid decisions).  Both were very good but surprisingly I preferred the Artichoke and would pass on the fondue next time.

Wife had the Cedar plank salmon and I had the 16oz prime rib, both were delicious.  

Service was good and attentive.

Whenever the wife and I leave a restaurant we look at each other and ask the non-verbal question, "will we return?"  We both shook our heads "no" and I can't quite explain why... except maybe I was left wanting for a memorable experience.  Barrel 55 will meld into the amalgam of forgotten dining experiences like so many countless others.  

So, yah... pleasant but forgetful.  Which is why I had to Yelp it... just by the off chance I wish to return.

My husband and I enjoyed a bountiful breakfast of good grub and stellar service in this 'locals come here' unpretentious little spot that has been in business for 30 plus years.  Operating seven days a week no less.  Imagine the work involved!  This is the kind of place where who owns it makes all the difference.  Pride of ownership shows everywhere.

YOU DON'T NEED TO BE SWANK TO BE SPECIAL:  The staff loves working here and customers benefit from that in splendid service.  The food is good home cookin' and the prices are fair.  The cafe curtains, formica tables, flourescent light strips in the ceiling and seasonal painted motif on the windows in this sparkling clean space all work for a reminder that you don't need to be swank to be special.

As we soaked it all in we told the friendly server, whose shirt was embroidered with "18 years" for her service there,  if the guy who owns this decides to retire this will never be the same.  She laughed and said, "You're right.  We are never going to let him retire for that reason!"  

Some places pretend to be "old fashioned".  This place is the real deal in the best possible meaning of high standards and work ethic.

We are reminded that nothing lasts forever.  So there you go.   Go while you can.

SET ASIDE PRETENSION & ENJOY:  Another reviewer expressed less enthusiasm with this comment;  "Great place for the older crowd but not a place for people who actually like food.".  With all respect, how funny is THAT! :)

Although I wasn't sure whether to laugh about it at first, they be my Peeps after all, the older crowd, I did chuckle in the end.  On the premise that one gets better at what they do the longer they do it, we who are Boomers and beyond have a good amount of experience eating and drinking our way around the States and beyond.   Good food we know.  Of all ilks.  And this is good food. So is Del Posto.  This is not that.  But it is good food for what it is.

There may be reasons some people have better palates or food instincts than others.  But age isn't the deciding factor.  Still, this isn't a hipster hangout.  So if that's a factor for you, there you go.  Go find one.

Otherwise, set pretension aside here and enjoy it for what it is.  You won't find emu egg omelettes or mimosas served six ways or single grower coffee.  You will find "we're glad you came" service and good home cookin'.  Like Daily brand lean, perfectly cooked bacon, super hash browns, eggs served lots of different ways. pancakes, waffles...and on the days when Eggs Benedict is on the specials board you can even order a half portion if you ask.

LOCALS
I'd wager nearly all of the diners packing the place for breakfast on a weekday morning were  local.

BREAKFAST & LUNCH BOTH SERVED ALL DAY
I doubt I'll need that lunch menu with breakfast available all times.  But one never knows.  If I live long enough, maybe I will.

THIS N THAT:

1)  PARKING:  Private lot.

2) ACCESSIBILITY:  One non van accessible parking space in the front lot.  Van acessible space in side lot.  Level in, all one one floor.  Standard height tables.  Women's loo is accessible but not men's...says my hubby re the latter.  The ladies' can be used by gents who are disabled if they need accessible loo.

3) CROWDS:  Lines out the door on weekends.  Weekday breakfast time slows down a bit depending on day of the week but seems 10:30ish is a good bet time to get a table or better yet a booth!
I left this place really excited knowing that there is another great place to get a good breakfast where it seems that they care about putting quality food on your table.
Regarding the message from Danny H at PPPM I would love to have a conversation regarding this situation so please let me know how I can speak to you directly and I will call

Let me start by saying that we have been customers of Flying Pie for many years, & love your pizza. The last couple times we ordered for delivery, our pizza showed up much later than quoted, along with being cold/wrong size, etc. I placed an order for 2 medium pizzas & extra sauce for pick-up on Fri evening 12/21 at 5:15, & was told it would be 45 minutes. My husband showed up around 5:50, paid up for our order, & let the guy at the front know where he'd be sitting, & had a beer while he waited. He checked on the order after a while & told it wasn't ready. The guy he paid went on a break, & didn't return until approximately 6:40-6:45. When asked where our order was, he went & got our pizzas. My husband asked how long it had been ready, & was told "probably since I went on break". He got home with 2 cold pizzas, one of which was burnt, & no extra sauce. As has happened in the past when our delivery order was wrong, no one answers the phone when I try to call & discuss this with a manager. We won't be going to or ordering from the Meridian location again, & may not go to any locations in the future, which is unfortunate since the food used to be exceptional. It seems that customer satisfaction is no longer something this location cares about.

The gym and bathrooms are both very clean.  They have lots of equipment and floor area.  This location has a pool. 

I'm on a trial membership coz I just moved here.

Buying a new bed for a child is not easy nor fun. Nor is it enjoyable to shop with two little kiddos. But, the staff at Sleep Country in Meridian were very helpful and catered t the speed at which I had to make a decision. They are prepared to cater to families and offer the kids a play area while you shop. The sales team was knowledgable and friendly. Would definitely shop there again!

We used to come here once a month and get the New York strip steak... which was amazing! Delicious veggies and potatoes. Loved the artichoke appetizer! Unfortunately, we were informed that there is a new chef. They took the artichoke off the menu...our $30 "medium" New York strip tasted cheap and chewy and was well done... nothing like before. They added a glaze that was not good. To be fair they offered to remake the steak but after waiting for 20-30minutes and having them forget our salad, bread and very late refills we declined. We also came in after 8 and were basically ignored by staff as they were just chatting with each other- which I don't mind if I still get refills! We are so sad! Loved this place! Bring back the old menu!

We frequent all the local seafood places like Joe's crab shack and lucky fins and hands down this is the best. My husband and I both got the create your own basket and it was amazing. The crawfish were big, the shrimp were cooked perfectly and the crab legs tasted fresh. We will continue to go and will recommend it to all of our friends and family

There are lots of fanciful names for simple classic breakfasts. They do however have some more "progressive" options like turkey sausage. My experience was very average but not bad. Our waiter was a bit impatient but ultimately accommodating.

WORST customer service EVER!!  I've been visiting this store for two years on a weekly basis.  About three weeks ago I was asked by an employee if I had a frequent visitor card.  NO?!  I had NEVER been offered it.  Tonight I go in for Waffle Cone Wednesday and guess what?!  They are out of waffle cones.  They tell me they have other waffle cones but I will have to pay $1.50 for them because they are dipped in chocolate.  I suggest that they comp me the $1.50 and give me one of those cones and my other yogurt in a cup.  The young lady tells me she can't.  So, no fault of hers, but the owner doesn't even empower his employees to offer good customer service.  Two years, once a week...NEVER AGAIN.  I'll go to Yogurtz across the street who has more flavors, better cones, and way better customer service skills.  There are lots of yogurt choices in Meridian, so skip this one!

Not quite sure this even deserves two stars. Went in for 1/2 leg, brow, and thong, Meridian location. Here's why:

1. Unprofessional. She told me that she was new and wasn't used to the sugar that they were using. Um, excuse me? I am going to let you touch my face and rip hair out and you have no idea how to use the sugar? Yeah, it was her first time. 

2. The legs....she said that she wouldn't be able to get all the hair off. What? Why? Oh...did you know that sugar doesn't work as well as wax? Lie. Before trying Stache Studio I was going to The Wicked Hair (wanted to try something closer to home, so here I was at the Stache) and guess what? The sugar DOES take it all off. I left with my legs partially sugared and ended up getting a HUGE rash on both legs that I had to treat.

3. Pain. Sugar is not nearly as painful as wax, but I had to ask several times if she was actually using sugar. This stuff hurt. It felt like she was waxing. Not sugaring.

4. Thong. What's that, she asked? What do you mean, I said? I get that "area" sugared in the "thong" shape. Okay...so I had to explain to her what that looked like because she had no clue. I did NOT leave with a thong sugaring.....

5. It took her over 2 HOURS to complete. I have a family. I don't want to spend TWO HOURS in any salon.

6. Eyebrows. Hair wasn't completely removed and the sugar she used was new and apparently she had never used it before....

Positives...she was nice.

Love being able to sample everything. Always get too much. Bowls allow you a large portion. Good variety of flavors. Service has always been friendly. About 5 dollars each. They have a rewards program. Bright colorful atmosphere.

I went here for a quick lunch and was great. I got the quinoa Greek Salad and the turkey Chili. I was expecting the Greek salad to have more quinoa tan it did, but it was still a pretty good salad. The turkey chili wax also really good. It had great flavor and I loved the variety of beans it had in it. I would definitely go here again!

Terrible rental company! Not only are they rude and hate their lives, but they also hate their jobs! They love to take your app fee and then tell you there is nothing they can do. I was warned to not use this compnay by too many people to count (stupid me) but couldn't believe they could be that bad, right?! Wrong! I now signed a lease on a beautiful home and am so very happy I did not go with Park Place! Do not pass Go, do NOT collect $200 dollars;) this place is a joke!!

Came in to urgent care on a Saturday. The staff was incredible. I cannot remember the doctor's name, unfortunately, but my 2-year-old thought he was the best thing ever and even let him check her throat. Couldn't have been more relieved as a trip to the doctor is usually traumatizing for her. Hopefully we don't need urgent care often, but if we do this is where I will come.
Pet Care Clinic has very friendly service.  They are through, and they include "Groom and Board".  They always take excellent care of my pet when we board her there.

I've taken my mini dachshund in twice for (the dreaded) nail trims.  She's had spine problems, and when I mentioned that, everyone was very careful with her. It actually takes two people to do her nails, and they've been wonderful -- I get to watch the entire process.  Both times, I called ahead to see if they had time for her, and both times they were able to take her within an hour or two.  Not saying that happens all the time but they've been very accommodating!  I also noticed that all the dogs in there, both times we've been in, look very calm, happy, and comfortable in a "I'm getting groomed -- no big deal" way.  Good sign.
Good food!  The people that work at Express Cafe are great!  Friendly make you feel like you want to come back.

Greg has been my contact at Modern Printers. He's very helpful and willing, fun to talk to, and always has my work ready when he says. I'm loyal to them as they have met of exceeded expections every time I've used them. They are on Main street in Meridian, easy to pop in and out quickly.

I've been to this location several times and never had any problems with ordering or our pizzas.  Normally would only give a pizza place 3 or 4 stars, but feel like I need to counter the bad reviews.  Most importantly my kid like the pizzas.  Glad they are closer now.

Probably not going back. I was a little hesitant to go here with my family as it is new and I have not heard a lot about this place. Here is my breakdown: service 5 stars, food 1 star, drink selection 2 stars. The wait staff was very friendly and prompt. The menu looked appealing, but I would not bring kids there as it didn't offer a lot for my teenagers. They offered a good selection of beers, but there wine list was a bit weak in my opinion. We ordered the prime rib, tai chili wings, and flatbread Classico. The flatbread was actually quite good just a small portion. The chili wings were a bit spicy, but lacked real flavor, and were way overpriced. The prime rib was ok, but not great. It should have been served with real  horseradish with the option of the other sauce. We also ordered a bottle wine. The wine was good, but when the waiter poored my wife's glass he spilled quite a bit onto the table. He apologized but did not offer anything to compensate. Service was still friendly. All in was $105 and disappointed. Sorry but a lot of work needs to be done.

Food is amazing.  I have had the beef chicken and pork and all three were excellent.  You have to try the pull pork.  Best I have ever had.  Flavor is intense.  We had them cater a lunch and everyone loved the food.  Food was right on time and just like dining in.  Good to have another new option in town to eat and not feel like I need to ride 20 miles after eating.  Good customer service along with good food.

I found this place on Facebook from a post saying they could help with knee pain, so I went in for the free consultation. After discussing my issues, which included migraines 1 to 2 times a week, I agreed to move forward with them. After the first week of getting adjusted and physical therapy I have been migraine free and still am to this day. My knee pain is about 60% better than it was and I feel better over all. I would definitely recommend giving them a shot, if they don't think they can help you they will tell you as much.
Fast and good! The western omelette was perfect. The kids pancake was really generous in size. We are from out of state and do glad we found this place.

These guys seriously saved the day. Their modern and clean shop was a bonus to how friendly and helpful the staff was. I was having issues with my iPhone 7, an issue I thought was unfixable! Everyone there helped me with no judgement only wonderful customer service. 

I hope I don't break my phone again, but I'll be back if I do. I HIGHLY recommend them to friends, family, and yelpers :)

Extra points they are open on Sunday!

Best pizza I have had in Meridian. Went with my family which included several kids. They were very helpful with each kids order very friendly and they have games in the back for both adults and kids. The place is loud. The pizza was great. Very good pricing. Only down size is the salad bar. Small not a lot of selection , but hell I was there for the pizza. The pizza great the kids loved theirs. We will be back
Yummy pizza, fun atmosphere, friendly staff, but can someone please dust the light fixtures.  I was afraid a dust bunny was going to land on me or my food.

I moved into Avondale Apartment complexes six months ago. Glad I only did a six month lease. Originally requested a home that did not have cats in it. They put me in a place that use to have more than one cat. Once I had my stuff in and was unpacking it kicked up large amounts of dust and that triggered several asthma attacks. Over the course of three months my asthma was terrible. This company finally cleaned the carpets properly and my asthma went away. 

The floor boards were loose throughout my lease and the carpet still kicked up large amounts of dust. They sent someone out to fix and they did a half way job. The apartment still kicks up dust and the floor boards are still loose. 

They refused to compensate in anyway. Zero compassion for their tenants. As long as they get their money they are happy. 

Also I had directv installed but you have to use one guy they approve of. It really comes off as a shady process, he wants your social security number and all but you still have to call directv and set up everything as well. 

If I could give less than one star I would. 

50 percent of my stay at Avondale consisted of difficult breathing. Did they do anything to compensate? NO
My apartment to this day has loose floor boards and cheap carpet. 

I WILL NEVER USE PARK PLACE PROPERTY MANAGEMENT EVER AGAIN. ALL I HOPE IS NO ONE TRUSTS OR USES THIS COMPANY EITHER. THEY ARE A PRICE EXAMPLE OF WHAT NOT TO DO AS A PROPERTY MANAGER. 

Oh on a side note they did send me a card with a five dollar gift card to subway for my terrible experience. Thanks for the additional slap to my face!
You like American breakfast? Gravy and biscuits with eggs and potatoes! Good price and great fast service. Locally owned and operated for 30 years and you can tell.

Excellent, traditional style pizza. The meats they use are fantastic, especially their thick-cut ham. My wife and I order from here frequently and have never been disappointed. Their lunch time buffet is a great deal: 6 bucks for all-you-can pizza and access to their stellar salad bar (and this coming from a fat guy who doesn't like salad). We also LOVE their parmesan garlic monkey bread and order that every time.

The owner is a real nice guy. Always makes sure you're taken care of. I can highly recommend this place to anyone!
Service was great and they were very attentive. Great breakfast selection. We both ordered the chorizo with scrambled eggs and country fries. It's was all hot, fresh, and delicious!!
We loved their $1.99 waffle cone Wednesday deal today. Yummy! We haven't been to TCBY for years and it didn't disappoint :)

Ordered mozzarella sticks and a corn dog and open the bad to find two cheese burgers (drippy soggy cold ones with cheese so soggy it looked like sauce). Even repeated the order to us at the window and I still received something completely different than what I asked for. Not to mention SO SLOW. The only pro if this location is a few of the friendly employees.
I really like this place, although not the cheapest or yogurt in the area. Selection and taste I would say is best. Staff is friendly, extra bonus that cups are buy one get one on Tuesdays.

Expected more from this place, as it's allure definitely grabbed our attention. Unfortunately, subpar food and awful customer service. I've never been somewhere I've felt unwelcome. The staff seemed like they didn't want to be there, they worked at a snails pace as dozens of people waited for their orders. I would say this place seemed busy, but really they were waiting and waiting for the staff to get a little excited about being there. We weren't greeted, we had to ask around if anyone had ordered as the girl at the counter just stared off into space. That being said, my husbands $8 specialty roll didn't even have icing on it. Mine was placed in the bag and spilt all the toppings all over the box and dripped all over inside the bag. Talk about a waste of money! My kids enjoyed their baby buns, without any icing. They weren't offered or asked what kind it came with at all. Just very odd...for a place that has such great reviews, it left much to be desired. I definitely wouldn't return for the price and service we received.
So the tap list isn't as long as it should be and the steamed clams were gritty and lacking quantity. Not impressed. I wanted to like this place...

Compared to previous experiences I've had, Park Place wasn't too bad for the first year or so that we had them. Then they started raising the rent until it was $150 higher per month than we started out, and they changed payment methods so you can't pay your rent without fees unless you auto debit it from your account. Pretty shady and money grubbing. 

They also charged us $500 out of our deposit when we moved out because they apparently had to "clean it twice." Highly doubtful as we paid to have it professionally cleaned before moving out and there's no way we were that dirty. 

You could probably do worse for a rental company, as they were responsive to maintenance requests and their website is easy to use. But be warned.

I went here last night. Two people working didn't even acknowledge me waiting. Not even a " Hello, we'll be right with you", so I left.

I will never go here again.

Bad experience, ordered a 16 oz prime rib medium rare and got a well done 12 oz piece and half of it was fat.  It was a celebration dinner with my daughters and food was bad, service was bad and I won't go back.  Too bad looked like a great place and was hoping for good food etc.  Boise has lots of choices not this place has to step it up or it will be out of business

The owner of the property I rent recently switched from first rate property to park place property management. I LOVED first rate property and hope I will be similarly impressed by park place. My initial experience hasn't been great. I signed a lease for 1175.00 a month. When I went to pay my rent for the first time with park place I was told my rent is now 1185.00. because of increased fees with this property management company. I know its only an extra 10 a month but still, how does a lease just change with no notice? After reading all the other reviews I am concerned about issues with deposits and move out fees. I will review again at that time.

I had reservations about a vegan cinnamon roll because I'm sort of a cinnamon roll snob...but now I'm a convert. I became somewhat lactose-intolerant in recent years and thought my cinnamon roll days were over. Then we found this place! Even if I could have dairy again, I'd still get my rolls here. They are THAT good. My kids think EVERY time we go to the village that we have to get a cinnamon roll. They are usually right. Love the variety of options and friendly staff.
My WiiU is in for repairs now. Kendall has been very responsive and easy to work with. My repair is not complete yet, but my expectations have been met so far, and at a great price.
Very organized and very friendly employees! I had a great experience using this property management.

Vitality Acupuncture will heal what ails you, trust me!

I had heard about acupuncture before, but was always a little wary about it because I'm not a big fan of needles. Heather Bergstrom convinced me to try it out and I'm glad she did. 

For my first visit, Heather spent about an hour upfront asking me specific questions about my health, current and past. She then felt my pulse and checked my tongue. I had heard about pulse readings before, so it was cool to see how it actually worked. She explained all these procedures throughout the consultation and talked about some of the history behind them so I understood why she was doing what she was doing.

Once she felt that she had a pretty solid understanding of of my current health, it was time for the needles! To my surprise, it didn't hurt at all. In fact I immediately felt relaxed. I seriously walked out feeling like mush...in a good way! I'd almost say its better than getting a massage.

It is clear that Heather has a passion for what she does and cares deeply for her patients. She is calm, knowledgeable and has a great sense of humor which will help put any of your nerves aside. I highly recommend her services!

I have used Park Place to manage my rental property for almost 3 years.  From the get go I was nervous.  They are hard to reach for service... always in meetings.... and continually make up reasons to take money from the monthly rental payments.  Out of 3 years, I probably saw my whole rent payment 4 times.  There is always the property inspection fee, or the yearly admin fee, or the maintenance that "Had to be done" but they can't provide any pictures even when you request it for all maintenance.  DON'T USE PARK PLACE PROPERTY if you have a house to rent out.  Even my tenants were not happy with them.  Because of their horrible maintenance policies, I now have to pay over 3k to get my house back up to where it was when they took over.
A friendly shop that fixed the problem in a timely manor. My final cost was even under the estimate they originally gave me which shows honesty. Can't think of what they could of done better.
Cinnamon rolls are my favorite and this place definitely lives up to my expectations! So yummy and unique!
Been going here for years, love love love this place! Yogart is great and the employees are always nice. Worth the trip from other side of town.

This is a wonderful place.  Whenever I'm in the Treasure Valley I make it a point to eat breakfast here at least once.  The eggs Benedict is wonderful, as is the Rock Lobster scramble.  And the bacon- don't get me started. The coffee is so good!  But by far, the best thing about Le Peep, are the people.  The servers, the bussers, the cashiers- always smiling and pleasant.  It's a great destination!!
I just loved their hollandaise sauce! As I am a sucker for a good eggs benedict, this place gets 5 stars in my book.

This is a great go to breakfast spot. Their menu has some great breakfast options and large portions...so don't be shy about splitting one of their yummy cinnamon rolls or the gooey buns and then splitting a meal!

I've been here many times and have never been disappointed. One of my favorite breakfasts here is the Taco Duo and their skillets are yummy, too!

Artichoke over done,  Flatbread was cold,  thought Flatbread was cooked like pizza,  but flavor was fabulous,  beer fondue with Brussel sprouts was awesome!  Beers were great.  We will be back.  Heat the Flatbread like a pizza,  go easy on the artichoke. Give us a little more garlic butter for artichoke ands cheese in fondue..

Don't care to go back. Pizza was just average.  Service was extremely slow. Appeared to be well staffed but very unorganized. Appears to have poor management. Salad bar was good. Ordered two pizzas and they came out ten minutes apart after waiting about 40 minutes for the first one. Don't waste your time or money.
Please don't review this business if you received a freebie for writing this review, or if you're connected in any way to the owner or employees.
CLOSED.  Although with a 2.5 star average on Yelp and owner who seemed to let this place slide from marginal at opening to worse as time went on, I imagine it isn't going to surprise or upset many.
Update to previous, they are a good company and they have taken the time to reach out and figure out a solution to make the move out and move in proses with them as painless as possible.

My family and I just moved here from Kansas City and were looking to get our haircut quick. I've now been here for almost 2 months and my son and I have gone back to Anthony multiple times. Anthony is a great guy, the place is clean, would highly recommend anybody to come try him out. It will be well worth it. No luck involved.

This is absolutely hands down the worst property management company I have ever dealt with. It's almost impossible to get ahold of anyone and get issues resolved. Our AC went out this summer and was 114 degrees outside. We came home to the AC not working and it was 86 degrees in the house. We have 3 small children and we were told unless it reached 90 degrees in the house there's nothing they would do because it's not an emergency and we have to just wait two days until they can get to it. That is only one instance of things we've had to deal with them. The managers don't care and tend to be rude. I will never rent through them again.

We recently rented our second house with Park Place and the staff has been nothing but professional, kind and timely.  We had to move from our first house for a job relocation out of state and instead of breaking the lease we just decided to keep paying (cheaper that way) for the last few months. We relayed this info to the staff and they were more than supportive... They actually found someone to rent the house before our lease was up which was not only appreciated, but it was not something they had to do at all. When it was time to move back we only wanted to deal with Park Place. Our first experience was such a great one we didn't want to chance it with another property management company and they have yet to disappoint again. Kristen has been such a huge help with the whole process. Everyone knows moving is stressful but park place makes it that much easier. Well done!!!
We have had several rings, chains repaired here several times. Always professional, work done on time and repaired to our satisfaction. They have my trust and future business.

They don't adhere to the contract.  I received to NSF because of there system screwing up and now they stopped online payments. Don't live here at any of there properties. They seem nice until you have finished signing the contract then they throw in a $10 monthly fee for a filter for the AC. July couldn't come soon enough

Came there first time and got a deal: facial+massage,90 minutes for $50! Best massage I ever had! Joy Wise was very professional,and very friendly! 
Sharon did my nails,very good!  Only $45:)
Love this place!
Hope to get massage for my husband and I! Only $100 for two people, and 60 minutes!
Was very pleased with the professionalism and service completed by Meridian Tree Service. I would certainly recommend them.
Delicious coffee and food.  Breaded finger steaks are fantastic.  They are prepared in house and its taste reflects it. Highly recommend!
Great food and great service. Best Chicken Fried Steak I've had in Boise. Our waitress, Maddie, was super fun and made us feel at home.

Event rent was not what I had hoped. "technically" showed up on time (just 2 minutes shy of the latest time when I asked them to be there as early as possible) with just one worker to unload tables, chairs and linens for over 200 people. Needless to say our groomsmen and father of the bride had to help unload and it still took over and hour to get everything inside the venue. Linens had some stains. Called and told the company how I was disappointed and they insulted me by offering to take $25 off of the $800 bill. I told them that was not why I called and that amount was an insult. In the end they didnt take off any of the bill and I wont go back there again.

It was our first visit  to Hook and Reel. We found the restaurant to be down to earth and very inviting.  We ordered a couple of baskets, flounder and chicken tenders, both were very tasty. The price was great and we got our food in ten minutes. We will return again soon to try their king crab legs!

Not impressed with their massage services. Got a massage coupon from Groupon and it was definitely worth the $20 paid for it. Hannah, my "massage therapist" was not consistant from one side to the other (left and right), her "new" CD kept skipping thru the whole hour, and at one point I'm pretty sure she was texting on her phone. I was on my stomach, so I'm not 100% sure that is what was happening, but regardless, she was distracted. The coupon was to include a pink lemonade aromatherapy. It's not something that I was completely looking forward to, but that didn't happen either. And of course since it was at a chiropractic office at the end of the masage I had to hear a sales pitch for chiropratic services. I will say I got what I paid $20 for. The $70 value listed on Groupon is a complete joke.
Will not be going back. Living Social and Groupon users beware!

Flying pie suuuuucks!   Why anyone would choose flying over pie hole is a mystery.   Flying pie is a greasy mess with so much dried seasoning on top to hide the crappy sauce.   I would rather have dominos over flying pie!!!!!   Pie hole is your best option!!!  I dont get the hipster obsession with this place- maybe it is just that they are all so drunk they dont care how bad the za is??

Oh goodness!  Cliff's comment on my original review of me walking out on my tab is a desperate attempt to cover for poor service that day.  If that were true, how would I know what I got charged for the only drink I was served?  If that tab had food on it, don't you think I would have spoken to someone about the charge and disputed it on site?  If you have footage of me walking out of your restaurant having not paid my tab, wouldn't you share that with authorities to ensure I did pay?  That comment is lacking customer service in total and drops my rating to poor, confirming I will never step foot inside this place again.  Best wishes... until you get your customer service under control I suspect there will be fewer and fewer people walking through your doors.

This was the first time eating here, and it will be the last. I will never even attempt it again it was a joke. As soon as the phone was answered I was asked if I could hold, I'm OK with that and I said yes. It was not too long later someone pick up the receiver took my name, asked if it was for delivery or take out, took up my phone number. Then, all of a sudden they were some how unable to understand me. It was not an issue before. I literally spent  19 minutes on the phone to order two pizzas. About 12 of that I was on hold the entire time. The lady said she couldn't hear me and  after about 15 times of me repeating out my address and spelling out my address she  asked me to wait while she grabbed her floor lead, and I waited on hold for like seven more minutes and then he picked up, got my address, and asked me to hold well he got The manager to approve it (approve what?) and I waited a whole bunch of more minutes. 19 minutes to order 2 simple pizzas and then an additional 70 minutes to wait for it to be cooked and delivered.  Such a madhouse joke. The pizza was good, so I will bump it up to two stars. I was only going
To give one star for customer service.
 It's really a bummer, I was excited to try this place out as we just moved here and did not have it where we were from.  The pizza was good, so I will bump it up to two stars.

Everyone was super helpful in getting our rental ready quickly after we bought it as an investment. This is our first investment property so we didn't know what to expect. The whole process was very smooth and we had an accepted application within a couple of days

Park Place kept my deposit without justification.

It's too bad this company lacks ethics. The people who help you individually seem to really care and treat you well. However, in the end, no matter how much I communicated with them via phone calls, emails, and even stopping by in person, it all leads to false promises.

They had multiple staff changes during my lease so none of the communication I had with them was transferred to the new people even though the important items were in writing. Basically, my property managers (yes, 3 different ones) all told me there would be no problems with my move out and any dispute items would be handled easily and that "they are very reasonable" when dealing with deposit refund dispute items. I was told that exact thing by 3 property managers and two other staff members.

I even made sure to attend the maintenance walk through with the guy who photographs and assesses the place for damage, etc. I had it professionally cleaned, and had a construction company come out and fix wall holes, paint, etc. The PPPM maintenance guys told me "this is the nicest place he's assessed in over a year...It's literally move-in ready." PPPM still charged me hundreds for work I'd already done without contacting me.

It has been over 10 weeks since my move out date and they violated the state statute requiring them to refund my deposit with in 21 days. When I finally got it they had kept hundreds of dollars for things I had already done or paid for or documented previously. I filed a formal dispute within their process and 5 weeks later I still have had no return phone calls from them or any manager as I've requested multiple times.

I have been in contact with the Better Business Bureau and my attorney and have found that there are nearly TWO DOZEN BBB complaints against PPPM and nearly half of them resemble my issue. The worst part is that if you rent a place you may not be able to choose your property management company. I would consider avoiding a rental operated by this company or just be prepared to get screwed by them in the end.

Frankly it's amazing to me they can legally do this to people. But as you know, legal and ethical aren't the same thing.
This place is not good. The cold cuts are slimy; the bread is dry. I don't know what all the hype is about. Not good.

Sunday breakfast with my girls :) 

A "lite" omelette big enough to feed two. 

Biscuits and gravy. 

Nothing makes me forget the 8 mile run I just took and the yard work awaiting me like a good breakfast. Le Peep is consistent, the service is always great and the food is delicious. 

What more can you ask for?

I bought the groupon, too.  And I get that they aren't making a lot of money off groupon customers, but I've found a lot of good businesses that I re-visit because of my groupon experience.  Not the case here.  First of all, their receptionist was very unfriendly.  When I arrived  around 8:40 for my 9:15 appointment, the first thing she said to me was, "You know your appointment isn't until 9:15, right?  You're going to have to wait."  What she should have said was, "Our massage therapist is running late - why don't you run down to Starbucks and grab a coffee?"  I ended up sitting there, unacknowledged until 9:40am when I finally got taken in for my massage.  So, almost 30 minutes late, plus the "change clothes" time, I got about a 45 min massage that had nothing to do with Pink Lemonade (or any aromatherapy, for that matter).  The redeeming point here?  The massage was lovely.  The therapist obviously knew what she was doing.  Unfortunately, I won't return because of their lack of respect for my time schedule and their rude receptionist.  Also, the chiropractor that was working was also in the office.  Seems to me if I saw someone sitting in my waiting area for over an hour, I'd be inclined to check on them...

I also got snagged for the Why I Need A Chiropractor Speech, but ditched out because, seriously, I had already been there forever.

This is a quick & easy place to go for some inexpensive taco-type grub.   Dad & I prefer the shrimp tacos.   The standard 39¢ tacos haven't made it all the way home in the best shape, so tend to eat in.

We've been waited on by quite a few different staff members.  They've all been pleasant, but Carlos has been the smiling standout of the group.

Awesome furniture! If you love it, buy it. Stuff flies out the door here. We bought two couches and an ottoman for our new house and I absolutely love every piece 3 months later. The sectional we bought for probably 1/3 of the price that a very comparable Joybird piece would have cost. The upholstery is beautiful and holding up very nicely with two kids 2 and 4. I have absolutely no regrets and highly recommend them. Great service should not go unmentioned as well.

These guys make the best wings and they are good sized, not the banny rooster wings from BWW. When I come into Meridian from Twin Falls this is the place I go for my wing fix. No one else comes close, my favorite is the Garlic Parmesean. They also have pool tables and big screens and a shuffle board
Just in town for a few days and were introduced by friends to this little gem. Love the food especially the salmon Benedict! To die for.

I can't believe I went so long before visiting this amazing Spa!! This place exceeded my expectations and I can't wait until I can return again and enjoy other services they offer. I came here for a brow wax and custom spray tan, and was welcomed warmly by the receptionist and offered a beverage. The woman who worked with me was so sweet and professional! It's not always the most relaxing experience getting a custom tan but I won't go anywhere else after the FLAWLESS application she did! My brows were done with extreme care, even the table I was laying on was heated for added comfort. Prices are insanely affordable for the luxury you will experience! Love this place!

Best Breakfast or lunch in town! I love the 18 Wheeler combo for breakfast! Makes for a good weekend! Service is always fast and polite.

This is our go to breakfast place almost every Saturday!
Staff were all amazing and I so appreciate the Dr. allowing a discount on the two kittens I brought in for care.  THANK YOU!!

First of all we were asked whether we would like to be sat or enjoy the seat yourself bar area. We elected the latter. We sat ourselves in a nice corner booth and waited, and waited and waited. After 15 minutes plus we were greeted with a " here's some water be right back". My fiancé and I both work at a busy seat yourself restaurant and we both understand that a table can get missed here or there but we saw it happen many times throughout the evening to other guests. 

 The menu was small but diverse, she ordered the prime sandwich. It was tasty and looked great. The fries on the other hand, well don't waste your time unless you need 4,000 mg of sodium. I had the smoked salad and it was actually very delicious, it may be the savior for the night. I hate seeing business fail but it's easy to see this one probably won't be around very long, due to all the other great options in the area.

Great beer selection, good food, and fantastic service by Deanne. We ordered steelhead and a black and blue burger w/ fries at lunch. Service was fast and friendly, and the food was very tasty. Whether you like stouts or IPAD, the beer selection covers the range and includes a ton of local brews. Give Barrel 55 a try. I think you will like it.
Best cinnamon roll around. Great friendly employees as well.  Lots of great toppings. Always fresh, always warm.

We came on a Friday night and sat at the bar. This is a friendly hippy kind of place. We enjoyed the pizza and different kinds they offered. If your a beer drinker be sure to sample the triple pie. Delicious!!

A Panera is a Panera-- I would categorize this Panera Bread with many of the others that I have visited around the country and knew what to expect visiting this new location. It seems that many people in the Treasure Valley might not know what to expect which is why there are such a wide range of reviews. Panera is a fast casual, non-fancy place to get a solid soup, sandwich and salad plus a lot of really yummy baked goods. Its not exactly cheap but its a step up from your typical fast food establishment. Some favorites from Panera that my dining partner loves (and are full of gluten which I cannot partake) include the BBQ Chicken Flatbread, the Spicy Thai Chicken Salad and any of the yummy scones that are offered daily. As someone who is gluten free, I most often order the Spicy Thai Chicken Salad which I order according to instructions on the Panera website (minus crunchy noodles and Thai vinaigrette). Service at this location is prompt and friendly. They do not bring your food out at this location but no biggie in my opinion.

Panera food is the best! I love that I can eat here and not blow my diet. And their healthy options are so delicious. I signed up for their card, and so far I've had a few free bagels, $2 off a salad, and 2 free pastries. Yay, I love getting a bargain! The staff here is always extremely friendly and helpful. The only thing I don't like about it, is that the tables are so darn close to each other.
If you love brekky, this is a must. A little spendy for a few basic eggies, (Basically $10 per person) but if breakfast is a favorite meal of the day, you have to eat here.

Highly recommend anyone who wants a great color and cut experience to see Katie Scheid. She did a fantastic job and really listened to what I was looking for. Even got a "wow!" from the husband when I got home. Thanks Katie!!
I'm still on the fence. They really should tell you about all of the magical fees and additional costs beforehand instead of when the service has been performed and its time to pay.

It is a chain, but does not feel like a chain.  Coffee flavors are good, servers are wonderful and work hard.    However the food is "Eh", breakfast potatoes are lifeless, honestly the entire point of my review, dry lifeless, not sure if they come in frozen, but definitely seems that way.

It is 2015, Would like to see Organic options non GMO or cage oragnic fed free eggs have way more nutrition.

We had an AMAZING 9th birthday party this weekend for my son!!  The staff at Urban Air made sure all the details were taken care of.  I literally had zero stress at all with this party, and they made it so seamless and special for my son and his friends.  From start to finish, their crew made this party so wonderful and easy for me.  Lincoln is STILL talking about how much fun it was and how special he felt!  

The team took care of party favors, and the kids were begging to stay when the party was over.  I ordered 4 pizzas and really only needed three (for 10 kids), and we brought our own cake.  It was a blast and a huge hit!

We made a vlog showing the party if you want to see what it was like: https://youtu.be/6NZcIxaSOXM

Fantastic small town breakfast joint.  Food is always good to fantastic and prices are reasonable for the portion sizes.  Tried everything from the biscuits and gravy, pancakes, hash, omelet (not on the same visit obviously) and they were all good. Be prepared for a wait on weekends, but its well worth it.

First time eating here and it will be a regular stop when we are in town. It is a upscale fusion food experience. I loved the sauces the amazing fresh veggies and salad. My chicken picatta was perfectly cooked. I would suggest a couple more low fat choices. It was hard for my husband but he enjoyed his Bison burger.

I needed to replace my EDC knife so I went on the internet and spent way too much time reading reviews and checking all the big (and many small) knife retailers online to see my options. Ultimately reading specs and looking at pictures of knives got old so I decided to see what Northwest Knives offered.  

What I found was an incredible selection of knives at all price points (much larger and varied than any of the gun/sporting good/outdoor stores in the valley), great customer service, a ton of knowledge, and a desire to help the customer find the perfect knife.  All at prices comparable with the big online knife retailers.  Don't waste your time shopping elsewhere, head to Northwest Knives first.   Highly recommended.

This is one of those business's that's been in the valley forever, a friendly environs that ament is excessively loud at times but still enjoyable. 

The food is sub par to be honest, not allot to it and the quality isn't as good as it really should be, but what all you can eat joint is really all that great? 

It's a staple in the community and that's what keeps this place thriving. Staff is always very cheerful and upbeat and that goes a long ways in finding a place to dine. Also this place gets three stars because it's decent relaxing and familiar.

My first time here before dawn. Thanks it opens early @7. I've made a 12 miles trip it was all worth it. I enjoyed my breakfast meal. They are fresh and prepared just about right. Not oily nor creamy. I gave three stars because of the space and the sitting made me felt like im eating in a fast food place.

This is a great way to learn to paint ! Michelle makes it simple and is an excellent teacher ! It's fun relaxing atmosphere and is a good buy for $15 to $20 ! Your paint and easel and canvas is provided ! We will continue classes there ! Michelle picks fun subject pictures that make you say " Oh I can Do that ! "

Pretty good food, very quiet (like abandoned) on a Saturday night. Had the beer cheese fondou which was just bread and brussel sprouts. It was ok. Wife had Halibut fish and chips very tasty. I had the porkchop which was very good the roasted potatoes where way undercooked but everything else was great. Staff was very freindly.
This was our first time to urban air.  Our kids had an awesome time and several of the employees made it very fun for them.  We will definitely be back

I see a lot of poor reviews lately which don't reflect our experience at all.

The atmosphere feels a little off.  Not a slam, it's just feels like a local restaurant rather than a big chain with tons of resources.

We visited after doing a little Christmas shopping. The restaurant was very empty which seemed to us was more of a reflection of the time of day rather than slow business.

The place was professional restaurant clean, no John Tapper problems.  (A must to keep us in an eatery).   Our service was attentive and professional.  She really hit the mark between friendliness and service.   Just enough to make you feel welcome, but not obtrusive in your dining.

We both had the Philly Cheesestake Sandwich.  Best we've had in the Boise area hands down.  It was tender and flavorful.  The sandwiches hit the sweet spot between too dry and too greasy.  In other words, it seemed to be made from quality ingredients.  It came with tasty fries which I finished.  (That's a rarity for me).

In summary great Philly, clean joint, and great service was our experience.  We"ll be back.

I am currently a tenant at their Anderson Apartments in Ferrelview, MO (Near Kansas City).  As a former military family, we have moved around a lot.  Every place I have ever lived has had its ups and downs, but this one takes the cake.  I filled multiple maintenance requests online, by email, and in person that were never acknowledged until MONTHS later after I had already given notice that I was moving out.  Due to their negligence myself and my dog were both injured.  This is unacceptable! The original leasing agent for my property was fired... not surprised.  Now the company refuses to even consider my request to handle the situation professionally. Please take my advice and look elsewhere!

Went In to see what they had to offer after looking at rcwhileys. We knew exactly what bed we wanted. After telling them what rcwhiley had to offer, we had to listen to a 5 minute crap talk about how they are a furniture store not a mattress store and sleep country would match there price. After I told "jeremy" we needed it today and he said he didn't have it in stock, he tried to sell us the floor model. When we said we didn't want the floor model and might have to go back to rcwhiley he turned red and got very aggresive and rude with us. Raising his voice and being very rude about not being able to wait. Horrible person to deal with. As a business owner myself, I would terminate employment if I had a employee as horrible as "jeremy".
Vanessa did amazing on my highlights and trim! Decent prices and beautiful salon! Thanks girl! Will be back

Axiom and I got off to a bumpy start when I encountered an incredibly rude and unwelcoming salesman.  I am happy to say that my initially terrible experience with Axiom has been overwritten by the wonderful service that followed.  After lodging a complaint, they were super quick to respond.  They truly took action and made me feel very welcomed.  Brandon, one of the trainers, was encouraging from the start and through his actions alone, was integral in my decision to officially join Axiom as a VIP member.  Alex and Jason were both very helpful and I am excited to start my new fitness journey.  As the working mom of a toddler, I find that where going to the gym was once a chore, now it's a treat.  This gym has a ton of wonderful amenities to offer and I look forward to logging many hours in several Axiom locations.  Thanks again, Axiom staff for turning a poor beginning into a great one.

James and Roland were professional, efficient and extremely friendly.  We have done business with Access Heating & Air for years and have never been disappointed.  They do not try and sell you things you don't need and also let you know that they have the least expensive filters that we can drop by and pick up at anytime.
Thanks!

We have been wanting to come here since it opened. We finally did. Worst place to go in Meridian. It's nice, has a lot of potential but the service was bad: Food took about 1 hour to get. Menu has literally about 10 items only and very pricey. The food was good. Nice beer selection though...Won't come here again...

After reading the reviews, we decided to try this place out. We ordered takeout. When we called in the kid that took our order sounded confused over everything we asked for (toast, eggs - sunny side up, hash browns and french toast). They were fast. They said it'd be ready in 5-10 min. When I arrived to pick it up I think I dealt with the same kid. When I asked him how much he looked confused and then when I gave him a $20 he didn't seem to know what to do with it and I wondered if he knew to bring me the change. I get home and the eggs were scrambled, they forgot the toast and the french toast came with no syrup! The food wasn't anything to brag about but filled us up. I would consider going in and ordering and trying it out in house but would never order out from there again. The customer service that we received deserves NO stars. I'm giving 2 stars because the food didn't taste bad, it just was mediocre. I've had better and will probably seek out another diner/cafe if I decide I want a little breakfast fix and am not in the mood to cook. $15 was way too much money for what we received and our experience.

Came here for the first time last week with my mother in-law and husband. We got a table right away, drinks started and food ordered. Good was fresh and delicious. Service was great. Owner/manager did a table touch to check in with us. Will definitely come back!

It's been said many times, but it's worth repeating. Flying pie is not your conventional business. You can say it is very eclectic. 

The staff is always friendly and helpful. I've never felt unwelcome, but I have felt like I stood out or didn't belong. Like I wasn't part of the correct crowd. 

The pizzas are good, but I've had some that didn't taste great. I'd say that is more a lack of menu knowledge than anything. 

I went today for the name of the day. I actually got my exact name which means free pizza. You also can make your own behind the counter, but they said they were too busy to take me. I'll admit I was a tad disappointed. 

Overall I enjoyed my time here. I would definitely bring out of town friends so they could enjoy it.

This is a fun *little* place. Man I wish there was a little bit more room inside. 

There are tons of candy options, over sized options, gag gifts, naughty candy gifts and everything in between. You could browse around forever! 

There are three large tables filled with loose candy that you can make your own mixed bags out of. A whole table is dedicated to different chocolates. YUM! 

My two boys loved our time in this little shoppe. We each filled up our own grab bags & sat outside and dug thru our bags trying new things! Thanks for the memories!

This is for Cole M. Are you just getting around to reading my review? My mom is now 82 and in good health Physically and Mentally. For you to say that the facts are un true is beyond me. Just take it like a man and do better. You won't receive any of my business but that doesn't mean you can't do a great job with someone else.

I hate giving a bad rating for such a nice place. The place was pretty much empty so you would think the service would be fast.  It took forever just to get the side salads that came with our meal and it took even longer to get the rest of our meal. I ordered the New York Strip with fingerling potatoes. The steak was okay but had zero flavor. I had to send my plate back because the potatoes weren't done. When they brought it back, the potatoes still weren't done. The server came by and asked if the potatoes were okay. I said yes only because my husband had finished his meal before I even got my steak and potatoes backl and we were ready to get out of there. There were plenty of people working but they were all busy visiting and not paying attention. The worst part was getting our credit card statement and the server had upped her tip amount!

Worst drive through ever encountered. Very long wait just to get an incomplete order, second time in 2 days. Tried to get a partial refund for what we didn't receive and was told I'd have to come back in for that. Didn't want to have to drive back but they refused to mail me anything. Several attempts at contacting corporate resulted in just being ignored. It's really worth your time to stay away from this Taco Bell.

Self check out was somehow difficult to deal
With, especially ordering for 6 people. 
The food was served in a timely manner, it tasted good and portions were decent. 
It's a good choice to have in this area. 
Water from the drink fountain tasted bad. Other than that, it went well.

We had our AC unit serviced.  This was the first time in 12 years...  The serviceman gave me a short AC 101 course because, i was asking a lot of questions.  He explained in depth the AC unit.  He did a complete test and serviced the AC.  I was very impressed with his patience and willingness to explain how the system works.
 
I would definetly recommend this company to anyone.

We recently adopted a dog that is incredibly sweet and smart but has some behavioral issues like chewing and being hyper so Sit Means Sit seemed like a great option. My boyfriend called and talked to them about our issues and they recommended a group class. 

The first class is without the dog where we learn about the course. Seems a waste of an entire class to simply read off a syllabus but we just went with it. The majority of the people in the class had dogs with behavioral issues like chewing, barking, jumping up on people and housebreaking issues. 
**None of those things are addressed in this class.**
 The class is only to teach the humans how to train their dogs with "on leash" commands. The teacher does not train them - you do. He simply says train them with treats, positive reinforcment and repetition. It's all about telling the dog what you want him to do instead of the bad thing he wants to do. I'm not convinced that's worth $250 but, again, we figured we'd give it a shot.

The first class with dogs was tough because everyone else's dogs wanted to jump up and bark and run at each other. I felt like I had to get between our dog and the dogs next to us the entire class because one kept lunging at our dog and other was trying to bite our dog. The teacher briefly touched on how to correct jumping by telling a dog to sit if he's jumping up on people. There was a big dog that kept jumping on him when he was trying to demonstrate with it. He demonstrated the situation and explained they just do it for attention. We were given the basic instructions to teach 'sit', 'stay' and 'come' commands and then sent on our way home to practice. Our dog already knew those but whatever.

For the second class we decided to try to sit away from the other dogs because they had been trying to bite our dog in the first class. The teacher intended to teach the command 'place' so he passed out a bunch of little platforms so we could all teach the dogs to jump up, or 'place'. He slid them all around and shoved them toward everyone which I could tell adjitated the dogs. Our dog had barked a bit but calmed down. Five minutes into the class we were working with our dog on the little platform. Our dog was incredibly hyper that day so as the trainer walked by our dog tried to jump up on him. The trainer leapt sideways out of the way and claimed our dog tried to bite him. I saw what happened and our dog had a goofy look with his tongue hanging out the side of his mouth. He was not being aggressive at all. Our dog has never once tried to bite a person or dog. Still, the trainer kicked us out of the entire class right then and there. No discussion. No refund. 

What gets me is that we were five minutes into the second class with the dogs. He didn't even know our dog or how it acts. A few other big dogs had not only jumped up on him in the last class but actually tried to bite our dog. Yet we get kicked out? When he asked us to leave he said he'd call to discuss options for a private class which he still has never gotten around to doing. 

Frankly, I wouldn't give them another dime. It was a waste of money paying for a class that teaches tricks your dog can learn in an hour. I sure wouldn't give them more money for a $600+ private lesson. It seems to me the instructor overreacted and knew it but then didn't even follow through with his offer to transfer the money we paid to a private class. It's been weeks with no word. What an absolute waste and disappointment.

Thry are really good with our shih tzu. Reasonably priced. 

Taking the cat there this Friday she needs her nails trimmed will write another review on experience.

Needed a quick lunch yesterday while in Eagle so we stopped by the local Panera.  Ordered the get two lunch which consisted of a cup of soup (I got tomato) and a small salad (I got the chicken lime ranch).  The soup was creamy and tasty and the salad was quite big for a small salad and filled with chicken, quinoa, tomatoes, lettuce and a nice ranch dressing.   It also came with a chunk of a fresh baked baguette.  Fast, pleasant service and good prices.

Let's just call it what it is these people will mistreat you and mis bill you when it's time to leave.  Checking in is right up there with entering a Federal building you will be harassed every time and when the counter girl is busy guess what you can wait on her to check in because no ones getting in here for free!  The internet is trash running at a whopping 3mbp you can't stream music for crap.  Crunch fitness is less money and won't harass you coming and going plus the internet is around 35mbs which is video worthy.

My husband I and I lived in one their properties for 3 years. Worst experience ever. Their maintenance is horrible their managers are worse. Rude and lying thieves. They did a "inspection" and took pictures of my dirty laundry. They lost my lease not once but TWICE and threatened to kick me my husband and our son out. It took them. Year to give me an oven that actually worked. I would never recommend to my worst enemy
Great pizza and the atmosphere is very kicked back. The noise level is minimal even though the have pin ball games. I recommended.

Love. This. Place!!! I could eat here every day. I'd have to be rolled out, but I could do it! The pb frosting is amazing. I love that you can choose all your toppings and it's completely customizable.

Use to be good but lately the food is super gross. Last time the chicken in the quesadilla was very hard. It was digesting. We tried it again today to see if it was a fluke and the soda is watered down and the food tastes old. Like it's been sitting out for a long time. Not worth the 15 minutes I had to wait for it in the drive through...

The owner is super friendly and knowledgeable. This isn't a "I need commission" type sleazy furniture store at all. They have great furniture at extremely reasonable prices. You can't find this stuff anywhere else! Very "with the times." They are also knowledgeable about the older homes (I had a very old north end him). He knew exactly what pieces would be able to fit through the doors. I went home and measured and he was right! The doors were smaller than standard doors. 

We have bought two couches from them and we will be back for more when we need it! Highly recommend this place.

Was so excited for this to be a potential hangout for us because it is walking distance from our house. So sad that it won't be.... I recognize that sunday staff are not the A team but this was awful.  Took at least an hour to get our food & we got the excuse that the "chef" cut his finger but lots of other food came out while we were waiting.  They comped our last round which was $10 but we still had to pay the $26 for the meal that took an hour to get. Not impressed & will not be back
When you go through the drive thru to order a Chicago Dog, only to get home and find the Chicago Dog you ordered was just a dog... #boo

The manager on shift this evening is a clown.  The restaurant is a pig sty, tables have been empty for 30+ mins and not cleared, the food was wrong after a 52 min wait and when questioned why it took so long the answer was 'it's not dominos man'...we won't be back!!!!

This place is the bomb!  Everything is fresh, nothing frozen.  Awesome sandwiches, and great fries.  Friendly staff.  So many different sandwiches on the menu, not the standard ones offered at other shops. Run to the ONLY JSS in the Northwest! How did we get so lucky?
This was GOOD pizza. A nice alternative to Idaho Pizza. Definitely my new go-to pizza place.

Le Peep is a little gem with a nice atmosphere and feel, an open seating layout and small tables for two. Quaint with a dash of modern. They don't have booths so I would say that it's an ideal place for the couple who wants sneak away and have a nice breakfast/lunch, at a place with great service and appeal.

I sent my cousin Marilyn sympathy flowers and when she called me she said it was the most beautiful bouquet she'd ever received.  In fact, she called Brenda to tell her the same.  I completely relied on Brenda to make something beautiful.  I told her how much I wanted to spend, she asked "in total or before tax etc" and away we went.  She asked if I had certain colors in mind, and I told her I just wanted something beautiful.  My cousin was so impressed, couldn't say enough about how wonderful the flowers were.
