That's exactly what I wanted.  I will always call this florist for future needs.

Best detailing business in Boise hands down. Erick is so professional and knowledgeable at his craft he made my 2016 Kia Sorrento better then when I bought it new! They are a true high end detailing service they offer ceramic coatings as well which I will be doing to my car in the near future, I'd recommend this company to anybody looking for proper detail!

Our family had our first experience with LePeep's restaurant. We arrived at noon on Sunday and had a short 5 minute wait until we were seated. We were greeted by Jeff Hall, one of the managing partners, as we were seated, nice guy and nice touch. My wife had the breakfast burrito, which was huge. She expected to take half of it home but it was just too good, we helped her finish it off. I had the Tostada Tango. It was crisp, fresh and hit the spot. My daughter had the Taco Duo. She ate hers but wish she had ordered the burrito. As we were having our lunch we saw several customers eating their cinnamon rolls that look fabulous. We had one for desert and it tasted as good as it looked.  We're now big fans of LaPeep, great experience !!

First time here.  And even on a busy Saturday we were seated in less then 15 mins.  The server was very nice and we received drinks quickly and order was taken timely with all questions answered.   The food arrived in a decent time and was hot and very tasty.  The ranch dressing is obviously home made and my son thought it was the best.  The portions seem to be the right size and I wasn't left hungry.  The prices were very reasonable for the quality and quantity.  All in all a great first time experience and I will for sure be back.

I LOVE this place. It's super clean, lots of space, service is always on point, the food is healthy and not super greasy, portions are the perfect size to eliminate waste. The coffee is better than any other cafe, with lots of options, along with an espresso bar. I have never been disappointed. My only complaint is the wait is always crazy long( because they are so yummy) it would be nice if they decided to put some extra seating along the window on both sides of check out desk. On the upside you can call and have your name added to the wait list so that's nice. Other than that.. it is wonderful

We LOVE Urban Air! We bought the gift card deal on Black Friday and when that runs out we will be doing the monthly membership! Zip line, softball dodgeball, trAmps everywhere, foam pit, climbing area, ball pit and black light mini golf AAANNNDDDDD laser tag! The employees are super awesome and nice.

Just had my older furnace checked out by A-1.  The service man (Nate)  was right on time, polite, happy and very knowledgeable.  He found the problem, fixed it, answered my many questions, and showed me how to use my heating system most efficiently.  I highly recommend A-1!

This company is a gem. I called Dream Clean when handy.com notified me at 6 am that the house cleaner I had booked for a move-out cleaning at 7 am couldn't make it. It's my last few hours in Boise before relocating to another state. If I don't find someone, I'm probably going to lose my security deposit. I desperately started calling every house cleaning service I could find on google. Of course at 6 am, no one is awake and I just get voicemails. But at 8:08 am, Denise from Dream Clean calls me and said that they normally aren't open on Saturdays, but she heard how desperate I was in my voicemail, and she would come to help me out of the unbelievable situation the other company had put me in. I didn't think that this type of person or company existed anymore. I'm still pretty dumbfounded about the whole thing. I wish I could give 10 stars.

I will always come to this place to have any repairs made on my devices.  I experienced exceptional customer service and very knowledgeable staff.  The manager, Kendall, and his staff member, in particular, Tim, were great to work with. They genuinely want to help you without any upsale.  It's good to know that they do repairs beyond phones: computers, TV's, gaming consoles, and most anything electronic.  I highly recommend this place for the next time you need any repairs on your electronic devices!

Arrived at 1110, we were seated right away, the place was not busy at all. 15 minutes later we left. No one came to wait on us. A couple arrived 10 minutes after us and were waited on immediately.  We were passed by 3 waitresses and the manager multiple times. Not one even stopped to say be with you shortly.

My husband and I decided to try out this place out for our date night away from the kids.  Our waitress was Deann and she really went above and beyond to make our experience the best it could be. We were both were so happy with the service and food! We will be going here again for future date nights and will even come back with the kids.
we had burgers that were great. The roll up window provided a pleasant seat for lunch. The bar was busy , which slowed our service a bit.  when we go back , we'll try the bar.

I had to get my windshield replaced.  I originally got a quote from Safelite (see my review here on Yelp) and it was pretty low.  Kevin from Glass Doctor returned my call and provided me with a quote a bit higher than Safelites.  I thanked him for calling and told him I was going to go with the low Safelite quote in which I shared with him.  He said it was a very low quote and that the other guys were definitely trying to earn my business but that they probably were going to use an aftermarket glass that may not fit properly into my windshield.  He advised that his company uses a higher quality aftermarket with identical mold and thickness.  He detailed about the importance of these things due to safety reasons and for leaks.  I had never considered any of this, and was so thankful for his expertise. He then advised about his 1 year guarantee: 1 free windshield replacement (even on new damage) and free rock repair.  Holy wow, that is great.  I scheduled an appointment with their FREE mobile service(even to Kuna!). I called Safelite back mostly because I was annoyed that they possibly were going to try to use something not up to par on my vehicle but also to give them the opportunity to address this concern.  The male customer service representative at Safelite that answered when I called back yelled at me. He yelled that they do use aftermarket glass and that they frequently have leaks but that they fix this issue for free, so they don't feel it's a problem.. Um, this sounds terrible!  Heads-up Southwest Idaho, if your glass isn't fitting well enough to hold out rain then it isn't going to be safe if a rock hits it or G*d forbid if you get into a collision.  He also belittled me and said that it was "impossible" that any company would offer the guarantee that I detailed above.  I am so glad that I found the Glass Doctor. The  techs were on time, were super nice and did a great job.  So to sum up:  1. The staff and techs are super nice and highly qualified  2. The best glass guarantee in the Treasure Valley (the country, maybe?)  3. Free mobile service.  4. Fair prices   Thank you everyone at the Glass Doctor!

I've been here twice now and I'm a fan!  On my first visit my husband and I came here for a quick dinner before Bible study.  The place was clean and the service was quick and friendly.  I was actually impressed with the efficient service being that this place has only been open for a couple of weeks.  Usually new places take a month or so to work out the kinks.  Anyway, I ordered a small classics beef sandwich.  The favor was yummy the meat was tender.  My husband ordered a side of fries with his meal and wish I would of ordered my own.  The fries are amazing here.  Just the way I like them.  

On my second visit I ordered the Cuban sandwich.  One of the best Cubans I've had!  The pork had a smokey flavor which added to the deliciousness of this classic sandwich.  I'll definitely be coming back!

My fiancé scheduled his appt online and when he arrived someone else took his spot . He brought this up to the receptionist and they took others before him and put his name on the bottom of the list . He waited over 50 minutes before leaving . We WILL NOT be returning .

Unfortunately there isn't a zero stars option. I don't feel good about giving this place any stars since we were never waited on. The menu looked intriguing but we never got the chance to try anything off it. We chose to sit in the bar so we could watch the football game. We waited 20 minutes and never had anyone serve us. After we had been there 10 minutes without service another group of three came in and had drinks on their table in less than 5 minutes. We ended up walking out and going to The Pinnacle Bar And Grill. The service there was great!

Denizens of the Treasure Valley, I must have driven past this place literally a hundred times.  Each time I did, I told myself that at some point I would have to stop in and give it a try.  Well last week, I finally stopped driving past it and actually STOPPED.  My son and I popped in for breakfast and I am happy to report that if you are looking for a quick, homemade breakfast served by friendly people, Express Cafe nails it.

We were seated immediately, but I would note that it was a weekday.  On the weekends, I have seen people sitting outside waiting during prime breakfast hours, so do keep that in mind if you plan on visiting during the weekend.  I got a cup of coffee right away and my son asked for a hot chocolate, which he managed to finish before our food even arrived.  Our order was taken quickly and the food was delivered quickly.  Everything about the service was spot on, quick, and attentive.  My coffee was topped off regularly and we were checked on enough to be convenient, but not so much as it felt bothersome.

The food itself was excellent.  I opted for Eggs Benedict, as it is one of the few breakfast dishes I cannot make on my own.  I got home fries instead of hash browns and this worked out well to sop up the extra sauce and yolks from my main dish.  The eggs were perfectly poached and the sauce had great texture and flavor.  Very well done for a "short order" type of restaurant.  My son got a half waffle with sausage and ate the whole thing, which is probably the highest "praise" a young child can give.  Although I think he was more impressed with his hot chocolate than any of the food he ate.

Bottom line folks, if you're in Meridian and in need of some eggs and a good cup of coffee, don't drive past the Express Cafe.  Stop in and give them a try. :)

Recently Mr. Euro and I stopped here after an appointment. When we walked in we were amazed by how open the area was and how lively it was. We ordered an orange juice to shard which was more than enough, they give you options on how much you want. Mr. Euro ordered a scramble and I ordered my usual, the chicken fried steak. He cleared his plate. Absolutely loved it. I liked mine, although I'm used to chicken fried steak not coming  in bulk from a box. If they could learn how to make their chicken fried steak from scratch it would be ten times better. The store bought taste doesn't cut it anymore. Other than that, it was a great experience. Service was kind and efficient. Prices weren't bad either. I would definitely give it another shot.

This is a very nice gym, that is not what this review is about. What it is about is their shady practices of keep charging and charging fees.

Sign up fee, monthly fee, annual fee, it never ends.

And yes, I know it is in your contract, the contract you sign after some high pressure sales, but it is ridiculous to charge an annual fee inside a couple of months of the initial signup. Of course I expect an annual fee, no issue, but they should come once a year.

Your practices are deceptive, and given you had to put a WARNING on your voicemail system for your billing company, I know I am not the only one that thinks so.

In addition, perhaps you should think about customer retention, and perhaps instead of hiring strictly high pressure sales people, you should hire someone in charge of customer retention.

A simple reverse of the excessive charge, even a good portion of it, and I, the customer, would have felt heard. Instead I got: "too bad too sad" and I cancelled my membership.

To top it off, and what settled my decision is signs such as: "Pool out of service until further notice" and "no more towel service"

I guess the technical term you are looking for is "Bait and switch".

So sad because I love Panera but my husband and I came for an early lunch there was no one in line and my soup was barely warm and looked 5 shades darker than normal. I'm thinking it was not fresh soup and maybe had been sitting out for some time. Hope they get their act together because I normally love this place.

Found this place on Yelp while looking for breakfast in Meridian area. They have authentic Mexican hot chocolate and Mexican mocha, with the real cayenne pepper dust on top. The grits with bacon and cheddar is delicious, and not too fatty as I have seen in other places. Also the granola yogurt was delicious. The portions are pretty big too! I didn't give a 5 stars because their pastry selection was not that great to complete the review. It's a must try place. Eat outside by the water fountain, it's relaxing and beautiful.

Cons: mediocre pizza. Pros: after waiting an hour and a half for it, you'll be so hungry you'll eat it all anyway. 
We went on a Friday night. The place was packed. Long wait to sit down.  After we ordered and paid, they informed us that one oven was broken and the pizza would be an hour. We rolled with it. Our hunger grew and grew as we waited. When the pizza arrived, it was mediocre. Good toppings but a firm, tasteless crust. If you hold a slice out only by the crust, the tip will point straight out without bending. Very similar to what you get if you make pizza at home on a pizza stone. After living in New England for a time, I'm a pizza snob, and I worry that there probably won't be anything better in Boise. How I yearn for the crispy (but pliable), flavorable crust I once knew. My search continues.

My wife and I have been here around 5 or six times now. The service has always been fast and friendly, and the food is great, especially for the price. There are other places to go for breakfast in Meridian but this is the only place we go!

Needed the small forest in my backyard trimmed up and liked their reviews on Yelp so I gave them a call.

Tina was very nice and quick to reply and answer any questions.

The work was done on schedule and the trees look great!

Will definitely call on them.

Posted my original review 6 months ago and they were okay but not worth the price. Fast forward to today and they have definitely uped their game. The flavors were good, prices were more on par with what they were providing, and the menu has been paired down to something kore manageable which allows for better delivery on what it promises. I do recommend that you ask for them to double cook your fries. Ours were flavorful and hot but super soggy the first time. We went back a few days later, asked for a double cook and they were much better! Worth a try for you. Family friendly, too!

My husband and I looked a few of there homes all not cleaned and one they kept telling us had a key but three days of trying yo see it no key. we finally checked at this 4500 sft home. The moment we waled in we loved it  except it was very dirty and had not been cleaned anywhere throughout the house, we found this strange not even the carpets and their showing a very expensive home to people.  We decided to rent it and asked if they were going to clean it? Yeah of course!! NO they did not... Carpets were wet and not any cleaner, and they had a guy come over to touch up paint after we were already moving in.. After we move in here is the list of problems we EMAILED about
Both fireplaces don't work, 1 week to come fix
Refrigerator doesn't work, 2 weeks and 3 different people to fix it
Shower upstairs doesn't work, half fixed it with a part from the shower down stairs
Shower down stairs doesn't work, 4 months to fix 4 people to Look at it
Jets in the tub, 2 months then I fixed myself
Stove has a gas leak, 3 weeks 4 people looked at it we got it fixed because we need a stove.
Garbage disposel leaks still leaks
Sprinkler pump broken 3 months 3 people to fix it and caused us a $100 water bill trying to save the lawn
3 sprinklers broke, 1 day fixed (WOW)
Sprinkler pump pipes exploded flooded the lawn and yard my husband and I painfully held the pipe together until someone came to turn it off and still NO ONE has come to fix the pump and the grass has now started to die again.. I got a call finally they will be out Tuesday to fix it. Mean while I have the owner wanting to sell the home the yard is dead and we look like bad tenets... 
All in all we think for $2,500 rent we should have a fully functioning house and faster response time when u need to water  an acre of land, feed your kids, refrigerate your food, and have more then one working shower.
Two thumbs down!!!!

I'm a die hard chicken fried steak fan and....they did a GREAT job! Their gravy is home-made which always makes a difference. I was good and shared a bite with my husband but just one. The nice thing it seems that they always have a different special listed on their sign everyday.

The customers did seem to be an older crowd but that could have been due to the fact that we went on a weekday morning. It was still a good group of people and everyone seemed to be glad that they were there. It's good to find a comfortable restaurant to eat at.

Ahh, the fabled Flying Pie. Her siren song has mislead many a hungry patron in her time, and I have several times myself followed the winding whispering tune, only to be crushed in the jaws of mediocrity. 
Time stands still at the Pie, I would suggest you bring a pillow and some snacks for the 45 minute wait. Especially the snacks, because the breadsticks and sauce look good but are not good. The opposite in fact. Too much tomato paste.
Oh, yes that famous service. It sucks. Prepare to be ignored. Hipsters should not run restaurants. Hipsters should stay at the Hot Topic and leave my pizza the hell alone. Real pizza is made by fat guys named Guido, not burnt out terminally confused Morrissey fans. 
You might be thinking, "Well hell, I'll just get a few drinks while we wait, that would take the edge off!" And you would be correct, but be prepared to deal with an unfriendly "bartender" who will look down on anyone who is not ordering the Himalayan Yak Dung Double Bock (6$), god forbid you should want a nice cheap American beer. 
The pizza eventually will arrive, and will be ok. Not great, not amazing, nor stellar or delicious. Just ok. Toppings are fine, cheese is good, but the dough is too tough, and the sauce is pretty terrible, way too much tomato paste. But you will eat a bunch, because of course you will be starving by the time it shows up, perhaps it is part of their diabolical plan.
So friends and neighbors, to summarize:
The good: Pinball games, Ice Cube/Ice T dispensers.
The bad: Everything else.
Oh
Ver 
Ray
Ted

My family and I had a sweet tooth while walking around the Village and decided to try just the simple basic cinnamon roll. We loved it! Flavor and portion size was great for my hubby and I to share. I took off one star because there wasn't any inside seating (only a couple tables/chairs outside which were already taken). So we walked and ate at the same time. Next time I would like to try one with a topping.

Bacon, ham, pork roast, summer sausage, rib eye, heaven!  I keep telling people about this place, and those who already know about Greenfield's are as happy as I am with their prices, quality and excellent service.
Great location, clean, friendly staff! We've been to several Chipotle locations and this one is excellent!

I have used Park Place for several years now and have found them professional. They have always responded to me in a timely manner and made every attempt to solve any problem   I have had. I would recommend them to anyone looking for a property manager.

Best breakfast in town!  Ken runs a great kitchen, staff is friendly, food is consistently great!  We frequent Express Cafe often.  They even have a drive-thru for those times you can't sit and visit.

The first couple of times we went in, it was good, not great, but it is hard to find a decent sandwich in the T.V. We did a phone order last week, when she got home with it, I got a 6 inch sandwich instead of the 12 inch I ordered. Called to complain, and they took care of it, but I am not driving thru 5 oclock traffic to get the replacement. We went in yesterday, and got take out, got home and it was the wrong sandwich. I wont drive back to get it fixed. You shouldn't have to. When the manager leaves, all the help grabs their phones and dont do squat. If I bought a franchise, the help would leave the phones in their cars.

I eat at chipotle regularly and really enjoy it but tonight I was a little disappointed. I arrived at 9 PM (closes at 10) and they were out of the grilled veggies. Instead of offering to make more they just put it on one of my bowls and said they were out for the other. I understand needing to clean up for the night but basically calling it quits an hour early seems a bit premature....oh and I got a tortilla on the side. It looked sort of stale when they went to warm it but I figured it would soften when they did. It did not. So now I get to eat a veggie-less bowl off a tortilla plate. Yay.

In all fairness to new restaurants just starting out, we gave Le Peep a 2nd shot after a blah first attempt... and sadly, we were even more disappointed this time.

1st attempt: Breakfast burrito was filled with badly undercooked potatoes and flavorless chunks of meat.
Coffee was bad and service was super slow.

2nd attempt: faster service, better coffee, and then... an order of crepes arrived at our table with a long black (they are always black, aren't they? Never red, never blonde) hair curled on top of the hollandaise sauce (the server didn't notice?!?). The kicker: we didn't order crepes with hollandaise. (Or hair for that matter.) The server seemed super unapologetic (and almost as if he wasn't surprised that he put the order in wrong) but he got the right order brought out quickly. 

The "right" order, however, had:
1) potatoes that were again badly undercooked,
2) bacon and omelette fillings that are all very obviously pre-processed and not fresh tasting at all, and 
3) burnt toast with no butter. 

There are a lot of above average breakfast places in the area, and we will give them our business instead of visiting Le Peep again. From the otherwise oddly good reviews, I'm sure we won't be missed.

Best breakfast place EVER. Friendly, clean, spacious, and great food. Extraordinary variety. Good coffee. Great aroma! Not your typical "clanky dish" breakfast cafe. Great place to meet. Comfortable and enough space so others at nearby tables aren't forced to participate in your conversation. Tasty lemon-glazed blueberry pancakes were my treat this morning.  Good sized portion too. If you get the chance, visit the one in Coeur d'Alene.
Love the pancake of the month! Family likes to eat breakfast at Le Peep because of the food quality and staff.
Amazing breakfast!!! Great service and staff. I had the Denver skillet, my husband had the Belgian Waffle combo and my son the pancakes. The coffee was also good. We'll definitely be back!!
If you want to know how it feels to get sheared like a sheep, get your hair done here. The stylist took a huge chunk of my hair and sliced it straight across to add "layers". Yikes

My fellow citizens of Boise and Meridian... have you ever tried an establishment based on incredible fanfare in hopes of a grand experience only to stop, scratch your head in amazement and ask yourself, "what was that all about?"

This happened to us at Panera Bread.  My wife ordered a half chicken salad sandwich while I got the Italian with two Caesar salads as part of the "You Pick Two" special.  Upon first glance I thought the "You Pick Two" was part of a combo or "buy one get another half-off" deal.  Unfortunately it was not, and the two small sandwiches and two small salads came up to more than $20.

You read right... $20 for two small half sandwiches and Caesar salads that appear to have come off of a Sysco truck packed into a custom-made box to appear fresh. Can you imagine how much higher it would be if we had thrown two drinks or full sandwiches in there?

The sandwiches were nothing special either. My wife's chicken salad sandwich was mostly bread while mine consisted of just basic bread, bland meat and lettuce that tasted like something I could have made at home for half the price.

The end result?  A lot of money spent on food that was nothing special.  No thanks.
I love this place, the lady that is up front is always very sweet and it's clear she loves dogs.  They bend over backwards to help us and our 3 dogs.

I really appreciate having Greenfield's close to home.  I love the fact that you can come here and ask for specific cuts of meat or asking for 1.5 inch thick NY steaks and they will go in the back and freshly cut them for you.  They have a wonderful cooler filled with amazing meats such as steaks, sausages, bacon, beef jerky, etc that you can quickly choose and be back on the road in minutes.  I recently visited to pick up some beef bones to make beef broth and I just had the most wonderful customer service experience here yet.  I am disappointed that I didn't get her name.  She was super friendly and informative as I was making beef broth for the first time and not only did she go above and beyond in helping me, she was able to help educate me on the best bones to make the best broth. 

They also have specials posted on the wall of whole, half or quarter prices on beef and pork.  I am sure the specials change but that is always nice to be able to buy in bulk and receive a better price.  They are a bit more expensive than buying at your grocery store but it is well worth the price for great tasting products.   I will be back soon!

Food was awesome - I had a cedar plank salmon with a dill purée and grilled asparagus so melt-in-your mouth delicious I was stunned! My husband had a burger and fries (without the bun) and he reported that the fries were killer!!

Why not 5 stars then?? Well, truthfully the service was a little...weird. We arrived and the place was pretty empty yet well staffed and yet no one seated us for awhile even though I made eye contact with a few passing servers. Once we were finally seated the man who took our order was just a little odd, he stroked his beard like a Bond villain while talking to us. And for the most part that was fine, but it just rubbed me as a weird kind of thing to do at a restaurant. Nervous habit? Anyway it made me a bit uncomfortable. But aside from that he was friendly and helpful and our orders were correct so we were very pleased.

Other than that the place has interesting ambiance/decor. You can have dinner or watch a game (we are not sports people ourselves, but there is the option!) The restaurant itself seemed a little physically split between a sit down dinner place and a sports bar BJs kind of place. Part of me would love to come back for the sit down dinner aspect but I felt the bar area was more busy/inviting and I didn't really like that part because the TVs have the game.

I will definitely be back for more of that salmon!

Ok so update** I went back for some more of that salmon and the place was happening on Saturday night! Our server Kristina remembered my husband and I and remembered how much I loved that salmon hahaha so that was awesome! We had a wonderful experience and my 2nd Cedar Plank Salmon was just as delish as the first!!! Woo hoo!!

Husband had the Steelhead Gluten-free Beer-battered fish and chips (don't ask me how that works) and he LOVED IT. There were no crumbs left on his plate. 

We both really dig this spot! Food is creative, yet simple and the execution is perfection! Enjoy with or without alcohol!
Had breakfast here with a group of friends and it was delicious. Very generous portion sizes and great service.

Waited 30 minutes for my food one time, could've went to Sharis and got my food quicker. Plus the dude working at the time was hesitant to give me a refund saying it was "almost ready". Absolutely ridiculous. The only reason I ever go back is because it's the only thing open that late. 

Update: 9 months later, I have to say this place has improved 10 fold, the staff is amazing and the food is consistent and most importantly, you get your food fast, the way fast food is supposed to work. Never thought I'd go from giving them one star to four, but here we are, good job for turning the place around. Only bad thing is that sometimes the lobby is pretty filthy, almost asked for a broom because I was gonna clean the lobby myself

We moved from CA to Idaho and park place property management has mad the process really easy. Spacifically Deanna in their office. She has been so incredibly helpful and I sincerely hope that her bosses recognize how great she is. 

We had a maintenance call and the tech who came out, Chris was very friendly and knowledgeable.

The only reason I didn't give five stars was because of our unit itself. There were spots of different color paint on the walls where they did some patching from the previous tennants. Everything works, bit it just looks bad. We had an issue with the front door and the back screen door and hopefully those will get taken care of on the next visit. 

So far it has been a good experience!

A little pricey, but not a bad option for southern food in this neck of the woods. There are lots of choices on the menu - and, of course, being southern style, you can get just about anything fried. Otherwise, you get your seafood in a bag - yes, a big plastic bag. Did I mention this is casual dining? Don't go in your Sunday best because it's gonna get messy. But they have bibs for you, too. You pick your seafood, then your seasoning style (garlic, tradition Cajun, etc.), and then your spice level. Mmmm. Crawfish was pretty decent in size and flavorful. The hubby had lobster tails and enjoyed the heck out of them. Worth a try in my book.

Nancy, our server, was so friendly and attentive. We sat up at the bar, and our food was really great! The corned beef hash was to die for. Great food, great service. Highly recommend and we will be coming here again very soon.

I had an issue with my washing machine, and scheduled an appointment online.  I received a call as expected to set a time for my appointment and he was willing to work around my busy schedule.  Terry was friendly, knowledgeable, honest, and provided excellent service at a very fair price.  He even gave some attention to my overly friendly lab.  I will definitely be calling again if I need help in the future.

This place is a little slice of heaven. Tucked back a bit from the street with plenty of shade on a pleasant patio. Food is fresh, amazing, and the presentation beautiful. 
Definitely on our top ten list!
About a year later and we still enjoy Deja Brew.  Outdoor patio is a must when the weather is nice.

Being in line for 10 minutes and barely having the line move when there are 4 to 5 cars ahead of you is a complete fail. When the car got through the drive-through just as I was pulling up and then the line didn't move again until about the time I finally gave up.
Best cinnamon roll around. Great friendly employees as well.  Lots of great toppings. Always fresh, always warm.

I agree with the review below! If you are plant based and refrain from the meat + cheese, you still get charged extra for guacamole and charged the same price as if you have all of the animal products in your meal. I feel if I don't get cheese or sour cream or meat, guac should be at least included for free-I am eating less. The black beans and especially the Sofritas are always old and crusty looking, or they are out completely and I have to wait for them to cook. Customer service was blah. Workers were bickering about "where they put the tofu."
Def a bigger Flame Broiler fan after this visit.

A wonderful business all around! Consistent service from all of the kind and knowledgeable employees. They saved my computer and provided further protection measures for it. Great company and will return for any future computer needs.

This is my favorite place to go for a quick great fresh meal. But the last two times I have in there they have been either out of chicken or steak. Not sure why that keeps happening but it does. 
Last night June 13th was no different. The steak was out and however I did get last of chicken. The staff seemed overwhelmed or disorganized. The staff is always friendly. No one seemed to be cooking anything either. 
The place last night looked like a bomb had gone off in there. Dirty tables, lids for cups were out, the spoons were empty. When I was there around 8:00 pm there was a family of 4 and myself inside so being busy was not an excuse for cleanliness. 
I do love getting my burrito bowls fresh and fast but the cleanliness of the place last night was horrible. 
I hope on my next visit they have improved.

Very proud to make this my #100 review and my first review of the Boise area.  My wife and I were in the market for our first new mattress in *cough*  fifteen years.  We were going to purchase one from CostCo but we weren't sure how we'd get it home since we wanted a King and it wouldn't fit in our truck.  So while we were exploring our options, I decided to swing by this Sleep Country USA location as it was between our house and my job.

I couldn't be more happy with my decision to do so.  Tony was extremely helpful.  I told him what our price range was.  I told him about the CostCo mattress we had already picked out, and he immediately was able to "price match" the mattress with a model they had in store, along with free delivery and set up.  I told him I had to check with my wife on the final purchase and I'd get back to him.

When I returned to the store, he had found a different mattress that was an additional $100 less than the one he offered previously.  I plopped down on it, liked the feel even better than the previous one, and I was sold.  Counting what getting the CostCo mattress home would have cost us, Tony and Sleep Country USA saved us almost $500 in all.  Delivery was right on time as promised, and the delivery crew was quick and helpful in getting the bed set up.

It seems like there is a mattress store on every corner these days, but if you're near the "corner" of Eagle and Fairview and need a new bed... I can't recommend Tony and Sleep Country USA enough.  Everything about my experience there was top notch.  

Now if only my kids would let me SLEEP on my new bed more.... :)

Never really had Hawaiian food in my life, but I figured I'd give this place a shot. Walking in was a clean, decorative setting with Hawaiian vines. The menu is thorough enough to make a decision without guidance. The process is similar to Cafe Zupas where the friendly staff members ask what sides you want, meat choice, etc. The staff was super helpful and friendly. And the price is just right for what you pay for.

I got the Mini Teri Chicken and Mini Katsu chicken and they were on both fantastic. The teri chicken was tender and well seasoned. The teriyaki sauce accompanied by it was a cherry on top! The crispy Katsu chicken was amazing as well, but I do recommend to eat it with the sauce they provide with it; otherwise the taste is kind of boring without it. The sides with both the dishes were chopped cabbage, macaroni salad, and white rice. The cabbage was a good balance for that neutral, crunch flavor. The macaroni salad and rice were good, nothing mindblowing. 

Right now, I believe they have a Buy One Mini Size, get one FREE up till August 15th. The Mini Size they say is bigger than you think, but still great value!

9.5 out 10 would go again.

Still LOVE the staff here.  My favorite place to have breakfast.  However, today it's like my favorite cousin died.  I went in for breakfast and Express Cafe did something that can't be forgotten.  They changed their Bacon.  They no longer carry Daily's Bacon.  Some stuff was on my plate that didn't taste like Bacon.  The eggs were still fantastic but breakfast wasn't the same breakfast I've been having for years.  You know when family can mess things up and you don't visit for a while?  Well today, I feel like that's what has happened with my favorite breakfast spot.  No matter how much you love the people, the Bacon is what called out to me.

They're back to Daily's... I am a 5 star in love with this place again guy.  :)
Nice salon/spa. Vanessa does a great job with my hair and never strays from what I ask for. She very friendly and professional.

Would be 1 star for service but the food was great.  Arrived 12:08 left at 1:34.  Waitress walked past us to help a 2 top that sat down after us.  She literally did everything to avoid us.  Greeted first by the buster/dishwasher who was very friendly, 15 minutes after sitting down.  Got coffee at around 25 minutes, and ordered food at 30 min.  Coffee went dry for another 15 minutes, finally refilled by the busser.   Waitress literally had no contact with us for at least 30 minutes.  After the busser asked us if we had already eaten around 1pm we said no.  She apologized and checked on our food for us.  The server came out and said I'm sorry you felt ignored.  Let me just say when you're ignored for 30 minutes it's not a feeling, it's a fact.  Coming from a fellow food service worker of over 20 years this review is a burn, as I understand how busy things can get.  Instead of making excuses for everything just keep the coffee full and keep your table informed.  Every time I said thanks I was either ignored or got an uh huh unless the polite busser was there.  Food was great, swap the dishwasher for the server we had. You know who it is.

Had a great experience!  Sue was great!  My dog left clean, peppy, and fluffy!  Loved the shampoo, conditioner, face wash, ear clean, and teeth cleaning products included.  Separate drying area worked well.  Will be back
Service was amazing from the second we walked in the door. We were "first timers" and the pizza is yummo

If I could leave -5 stars I would. I said my order 7 times and he still didn't understand me, even though I was saying it exactly how it was on the menu. Then they forgot the thing I ordered. Then I take a bite of it and it's not what I ordered. He wasn't friendly at all.

I really don't know why we don't visit Le Peep more often,  but we love this place!  The food is good: nothing overly processed like chain breakfast joints, and the meats and eggs are always fresh.  

I've had pancakes, omelettes, crepes, French toast, eggs and bacon, etc. here, and I've never had complaints about the food, the quality, or its preparation.  The service is good too, which is always refreshing.
My favorite part about Le Peep is they served bloody Marys and mimosas, which are always delicious.

If you are tired of deep fried bar food, this place is for you
  Lots of food choices and good beer in a venue that doesn't assault you ears.  We had great service and food was excellent

Love this place. Chiropractors are great, hours are great, rates are amazing. Fits my busy lifestyle. Location also works well for me. Look for deals. I just bought 10 adjustments...no expiration date, $17 each. You just can't beat this place!

Breakfast at Le Peeps was a pleasant surprise.  The food was good and they have a gluten-free menu (huge plus).  The whole family enjoyed what they ordered.  It's a newer place, spacious, inviting, and they have wonderful, local landscape photography on the walls.  It's a place were you can feel comfortable taking your out-of-town guests for breakfast because the menu is extensive enough to satisfy just about anyone.  The vibe: modern.

Some of the best seafood I've had! Almost as good as places I've eaten at right on the ocean! The Cajun seasoning is awesome, drinks were not watered down and you get a TON of food. I love that hard boiled eggs are an extra option for your boil, AMAZING! Some of the clams and oysters were small but, they were packed with flavor and cooked perfectly! The bad reviews absolutely baffle me! If you don't like getting messy, go somewhere else! C'mon! The best part of a seafood boil is getting messy. I loved that the Manager was out and about, working his butt off. Being a former waitress, I love seeing that. Don't listen to the one star reviewers. This place is top notch!

Went into urban outfitters last weekend looking to furnish a two bedroom condo.

Salesman was awesome, but the lead time was 2 months one the couch i loved. There was a table I liked but wasn't sure if it would look good spatially. So I went back to buy the table once I knew it would fit. 

Side note there were 3 working, two in the back office which can see the door. I walked in while the salesman was with a couple, another 2 couples walked in and no one came out of the back to greet any of us for 20 min. 

Anyway, the only piece in stock that I wanted was floor model that is opened so I asked if there was discount was told no so I said I'd buy right away if delivery was waived, $25 for 2 miles.

Manager said no because of profit margins on their furniture. Furniture markup is huge, and even though I was willing to pay full price for an open piece of furniture but to say a delivery fee can't be waived for such a close delivery on an opened item? Come on man. That's just cheap.

Urban Outfitters furniture selection:

Their furniture is very nice for mid-century modern style with a lot of options if you're willing to wait (biggest selection is living room furniture good tables, chairs, stools, but bedroom stuff is sparse to see on floor). Their prices vary but there is something moderately affordable for most budgets.

 The young guy that works the floor is amazing. He is not overwhelming when you say you're just looking. When you have a question he is knowledgeable and gets you all the options of each piece. 

If it wasn't for this young man I would've given this place a 1, the management and their BS pricing reasons is not remotely true. Also the fact they stayed in the back while their sales guy was with a customer and not see if they could help any of 3 groups.

Taco Bell on Meridian rd by flying pie and winco the cross streets i think are meridian and franklin is the slowest taco bell ive ever been to in my entire life. I like taco bell. I have no issues with the food. I love getting the taco salad. But this taco bell is insanely slow! I was stuck inbetween cars in the drive thru this week for 57 min! When i finally got to the window they said they were very short staffed. But ive been to this one over last 5 years 12 times probably and the drive thru is typically a 15 min wait. So they have an on going issue. Its right by my house so if i know im in a hurry i dont go to this location. But waiting an hour was just ridiculous especially when youre stuck and cant get out!

2/3 of the time we come here, they miss at least one burrito from our order and we have to go all the way back to the store to get what we paid for. Oh, and they only read the whole order back to you when a manager is present. All other times they don't even check the bag to make sure everything is in there. The place is a mess every time we go there and the drive thru is a really long wait. It seems like they are always training new staff. High turnover is not a good sign. So make your work culture better. Train and support your staff. But Kudos to the one older unsung hero of a team leader who works Tuesday nights. She is the one reason why we still come.

Again -- another great experience. Kali is talented in both cut and color. She is gradually returning my hair to blonde after a temporary stint with red! She is amazing! I'm not a fan of selfies...  it check this color.

My review tonight is not on the food but ability to place an order. Several weeks ago, I tried to call an order in and could not get through on the phones so my husband went to the restaurant. He stood at the area to order and no one approached him at all. He waited about 5-10 minutes and no one approached so he left. Tonight I called to order...my first few attempts I received a busy signal. I finally got a ringing line and was asked to please hold. I was put on hold for 14 minutes and no one returned to my call. I hung up. I hate to leave negative reviews. I have been in Food & Beverage business for 20 years. I understand the business from all positions. However, I don't understand failing your customer at this level and making placing an order this difficult and frustrating on more than one occasion.
It was okay the second time;  the chicken was a bit drier and the employee first plated me a burnt teriyaki chicken, which was a bold decision for them to do :/
Kelsey is awesome.  My hair was a nice shade of green from a previous salon experience (different salon).  She fixed it wonderfully.  I don't feel or look like the grinch anymore!
Becky is fantastic! Very friendly, upbeat, and professional. This was my first time here and I'll definitely be back - her results were super thorough. Check Groupon before you go!

Convenient location, extremely clean and well laid out store. Dan sells only the best of the best and extensively tests all the equipment he sells before he recommends--let alone sells--it to his customers. Prices are competitive, service is outstanding. Family owned and operated and it shows. You can't go wrong here.

I had scoped this place out about two weeks ago and found it to be really good. I had the soft shell crab sandwich. My friend had the crab legs and everything was fresh and delicious. 

I made reservations for 13 ladies at 1:00 pm today 9/5/2019. They claimed my resveration was at 11 am.
This is what happened: 

My friend again ordered crab legs and they were just awful. They had been frozen and the meat had dried up or there was no meat in the legs. I ordered the lobster with scallops. The lobster was an epic failure. For $16.00 I got two pieces the size of two small shrimp. The scallops had been shaved down so thin that they looked like water chestnuts and the muscle had been left on the scallop. The scallop was so thin that there was no flavor. The butter garlic sauce was terrible. Something was wrong with the garlic. It was uneditable. The lady next to me never got her lunch. When it was time to pay our bill the waiter could not remember who ordered what and had to have the manager come and sit at our table and ask each person what they ordered. They then printed one bill at a time. I have never had this bad service like this before. We go out every month and have had a good experience each and every time. My bill was over $37.00 which was outrageous. I was not given anything to eat my potatoes with or to cut my food up. What a disappointment. The restaurant was not busy and our waiter only had to deal with our one table.

Sorry to say none of us will return or recommend this place to anyone.

Just.No. 

If there isn't a complete 180* change... I don't see this restaurant surviving a year. 

Their Bar must be keeping them afloat currently. 

Menu vs atmosphere= confused. 

Menu wants to be inventive and semi high end... Yet the actual menu is literally flimsy plastic + paper standup marketing on all tables.

Atmosphere... Well I'm pretty sure they just kept the tables and chairs and booths from On The Border. Actually I'm 99% sure they did. 

Food: our table ordered: 
Country Salad- burnt baguette+ watery cold roasted cherry tomatoes + very chard chicken. 

The Burger: overdone beef patty+ flimsy oily fries. (Their ranch* is another tangent- taste nothing like ranch and more like mayo and celery salt.

Prime Rib: purple potatoes looked esthetically like chard balls    

We won't be returning. Bummer, we were looking forward to this being something good.

Many businesses Groupon the right way -- they deliver such an impressive experience that the first-time customers have no choice but to return (and will happily pay full price).  Sadly, Back 2 Life is not one of these businesses.

Their cut-rate Groupon, $20 for a one-hour massage, was too cheap to pass up.  I kept it in my arsenal until I returned from a long trip abroad that involved too much sitting in buses or planes.  So I cashed in my massage, hoping to loosen the tightness in my hips and legs that had accumulated from all the sitting.

After telling my therapist what areas hurt -- and clearly emphasizing that my pain was concentrated in my lower body -- she proceeded to perform the most paltry upper-body massage I've ever had.  "I like strong pressure" translated to soft, barely-detectable brushes.  And she never offered to adjust the head rest, which caused my neck to strain downward and actually *caused* neck pain where I had none prior!

It was also obvious that the therapist lacked understanding of muscle interconnectedness.  When rubbing my upper arms, I craved for her to take the opportunity to lengthen my trapezius and open up the shoulder/collarbone -- every other massage therapist I've visited has worked this muscle group together.  But this woman treated each of my muscles like they acted alone, and never connected movements from one muscle fluidly to another.

The massage session was merely a sales pitch for their chiropractic services -- she talked my ear off the entire hour about how their chiropractors can resolve my hip issues.

I got what I paid for.
This place is a wonderful curse! I can go all out on my sugar fix. I love this idea and I can create many different versions of a cinnamon roll. Sometimes the staff is apathetic or annoyed though.

Because I am new to Meridian, today was my first visit to Casa Bella, recommended by my mother in law.  I had an appt for a color/cut with Lorrie.  She talked with me first and was very meticulous about coloring/cutting my hair the first time.  She did a fantastic job and I will definitely be back.    Two big thumbs up!

I was bummed to see Dr. Klure go after 12 year of seeing him at his dental practice.  The new Doctor, Dr. John Scott is the new owner.  Dr. Scott is very friendly and gentle when looking around the mouth.  I wish my teeth were as perfect as his :0D.  The staff at Dr. Scott dentistry are very very friendly, starting with the receptionist, like Dava who's been there 20+ years.  I always request Teresa for my teeth cleaning. She's so personable and easy to talk to even when your mouth is full of dental tools.  I got my teeth cleaned today and was told about their new Opalescence 'teeth bleaching disposable trays', I payed $49 for 4 of them.  These puppy's fit so well and are reasonably priced compared to the other custom fit trays with bleach solution you have to squirt into the trays, and compared to the 'Crest Whitening Strips' that get all over your mouth :0)

I'm so glad Boise finally has a dump and crack seafood place! What's more fun than putting on a lobster bib and digging into messy buttery seafood?!

The decor is kitschy and fun. About what you would expect from a casual seafood place. The wait staff were all super nice...although ours had no idea how to work the technologically driven waiter iPad. But we had a good laugh about it. 

There are some great fried basket options as well as the steam bags. It's on the hefty price tag but we expected that. We ordered the Reels Catch with 1.25 pounds of snow crab legs, 1 pound of mussels, and one pound of head on shrimp in the garlic butter sauce. It also comes with two corn on the cobs and some red potatoes. Everything was delicious, especially the sauce. And the food arrived so fast which was nice because we were starving. 

This is a great fun experience for the whol

New place. Went for lunch. Thought it was overpriced for what we got. Food was mediocre. Service was slow. Not sure if they were not fully staffed yet or not. But my first impression was less than stellar which given the other eating options nearby means I probably won't go back.

Atmosphere:

The atmosphere is always similar to this chain. This Chipotle is small in size, but has modern décor and design.  The aroma was a kick to your gut. Your hunger pains will kick in when you enter the facility.  Like many Chipotle restaurants the atmosphere is always hip and "cool". 


Staff:

The sole reason why I'm giving a 2 out of five stars. The staff needs training in "customer service". I asked for double fajitas because I wasn't getting any rice or beans. The gal assisting us seemed like it was the biggest ordeal. She even rolled her eyes.. rolled her eyes at me. I even said "May I please have extra fajita" with a big smile. She didn't acknowledge me, just rolled her eyes. She sent my burrito bowl down the assembly line without a further acknowledgement. 



Prices:

The price is about 10 bucks a person, which includes a drink. 


Location:
At the Village, next to Zupas. 



Parking / Venue: 
Limited parking in that little square. However, I've never had a problem finding a parking spot in front of Chipotle after the dinner rush or lunch rush. 



Food:
 The food is fresh!  You get to pick the food which goes into the bowl, burrito, taco, or salad. There are many options which includes of: meat (chicken, pork, steak, or beef), two types of beans (Pinto, black), two types of rice (cilantro, brown), fajitas, corn salsa, lettuce, sour cream, salsa (medium, hot, mild), guac, and cheese. 

Specialities / what "they" are known for?
 
The "assembly" line. The quick convenience and fresh "fast" food options. 

Star rating:
2 out of 5


More importantly Would we ever go back? 

Yeah, especially when I'm on a calorie crunch.

I've always had the best experience here with food and customer service!! Their cinnamon rolls are the best I've ever had!! Such a great business! Never met the owner until today, and he's a great guy. He's extremely professional and knows how to run a business to keep people coming back. Cinnaholic fan for life!

Green fields is simply amazing.... 

I am from Boise but live in San Francisco... I dutifully make the trip to Greenfield each time I am home (which is a long trip).  The Bacon, and Chorizo are not to be missed. Actually, everything here is the best you can buy.  The prices are not cheap but try to find the same quality even in the Foodie Haven of SF is impossible. This place is the no doubt the best available anywhere at any price... I promise

I am almost reluctant to review them for fear that they will figure out exactly how good they are and start charging accordingly.... I am a very frugal man:-)
Le Peep is now our favorite breakfast stop in the Meridian area. The food is fresh and we ha e always had good and consistent food and service. We would definitely recommended giving g them a try.

We are always on the hunt for a great breakfast place that has a friendly staff and great food.  Skillets and omelets are usually our go to choices and set our high water mark. All three were great. Beyond that and what truly impressed us is the most was the extensive gluten free breakfast menu We've ever seen, including French toast. We have a son that has celiac's, so choices are always appreciated.  Finally The gluten free options are very high quality including taste and texture, thank you, thank you!

Breakfast on Saturday means you better be willing  to wait. The food is served hot and is large  portions. It's not cheap but where is breakfast cheap anymore. No blaring musIc, not a greasy spoon. The staff is professional  and thEy even have uniforms. A+
Best bacon I have had in years. Love buying from a local source, will be going back frequently.

Tried this breakfast restaurant this morning because it was on the way to my destination... and it is highly rated. Always important to me is the ratings.  

The Mexican Mocha called "Groundhogs Day" is really good.  I tried to order "Grans Tuna" for my meal but raw onions are in the mix, so anyone allergic to raw onions cannot order this item.  As we age raw onions become problematic for some.  Unfortunately I'm one of them.  So, as usual, I spoke to the staff and asked if the chef and manager might consider removing them from the mix and offering raw onions to those who want it.  To my surprise she actually said she would talk to them today and said it was actually a good idea!  Wow!  If they do make that change I will consider this my "go to" lunch spot!  And I will change the review from 4 to 5 stars!  Easily!

Anyway, back to the meal I did have...  French toast.  It comes with 2 eggs, home fries, a choice of bacon or ham and 4 triangles of French toast.   The syrup was not the real stuff which I prefer, by far, but it was decent quality at least.  I should have asked the brand name... my bad.   The eggs I got scrambled, well done... cannot abide egg goo of any kind.  But instead of browned and cooked to death like my eggs usually come out... they were light and fluffy and totally cooked!  Delicious!  Now I'm really impressed!   I chose ham over bacon.  2 very thin slices of real ham ... impressed again!  The home fries are not fríes but diced potatoes cooked with red and green peppers and some kind of spice that made my lips and mouth burn a little bit.  I suspect it was cayenne pepper.  Again I forgot to ask.  Again my bad.  I don't mind a little spice, but for those who cannot handle it... beware!  My mom, for example, could not have eaten them.  So the menu should mention the spice, but I do not remember any such warning.  It may be there, so don't quote me.  I'll check the menu next time.

Overall, the meal and the coffee was enjoyable.  I would definitely recommend giving Deja Brew Laugh A Latte a go. I know I will be back!  See you there sometime!

Firehouse Pub & Grill -- KITCHEN CLOSES AT 10 PM! BAR AT 2 AM. 
Reviewer number 24
Service: 3/5
Food: 3/5
Price for value: 4/5 (tax is included)
Bariatrics/Healthy Options: 3.5/5

Overall stars for this establishment, for me, is 3 and here's why:

First off, I thought this place was Firehouse Subs which is a sandwich chain with many stores, but this is a local pub and grill and a completely separate company so if you too thought this was a sandwich shop it's not! It is more of a neighborhood pub as this is a more residential area mostly. It is in the same parking lot as the Dutch Bros, Jacksons, a car wash, Subway, and doughnut shop. It's kind of tucked away in the back and not too noticeable from the street. 

When we walked in it was about 9:45 at night. Their kitchen closes at 10, which we didn't' know. The waitresses/bartenders started talking about us saying the kitchen is about to close, and the other was like let's still serve them, and the other gave attitude. They made me feel bad for wanting to eat there... not cool! The waitress that advocated for us to stay, was our server, and she made it all better albeit leaving a bad taste in my mouth. Who wants to eat somewhere where you're not welcome? I felt like Julia Roberts on Rodeo Drive in Pretty Woman...
 
Looking at the interaction with the bartenders with one another, and with the patrons, I think this is a family owned and operated establishment and their friends frequent the pub--which is awesome to me. The place is decorated awesomely in my opinion with sports, beer, firemen putting out fires and much more. There are pool tables, televisions, and dart boards for your entertainment. They have sitting for all: small tables, tall tables, and booths. 

I ordered a chicken salad for $8, tax included, and it was okay. They have decent ranch--my only complaint was that it came in a plastic basket with holes and wax paper, which isn't ideal to eat a salad in.  

My dining companion, Jon, ordered 20 wings for $20 and ordered two different flavors: garlic parmesan and BBQ. He liked them. He didn't realize how many 20 wings is apparently because he took 13 home with him. 

My other dining companion, George, ordered the finger steaks and tater tots. George said they were good--now, George is one of those people that see the good in everything and rarely sees any negative in anything, so don't take his word on this! LOL.  But I've eaten enough meals with him to know that they weren't his favorite and he didn't take his leftovers to go. 

I think it's a spot you should try, I just think that it should be earlier in the day and not close to their kitchen closing time. The bar is open until 2--

Thanks for reading! I hope you're having a good day whenever you read this!!! Leave a comment and say HI! Would love to know your thoughts on Fire House Pub and Grill.

Property management is a difficult business with many moving parts.  I have used Park Place to manage three different fourplexes over the past several years, with very good overall results.  We have had occasional, minor errors in billing/accounting, however when issues arise they deal with the problem promptly and professionally.  Currently Serena Rhuman and her team are assigned to manage our properties and we are very pleased with her work.  If you have questions or concerns she is responsive and deals with the issue in an expeditious manner.  She maintains an open line of communication and has a level of confidence that puts you at ease when she is managing your property.  As I said in the beginning, it is my opinion that property management is a very challenging business, where you are representing both property owners and tenants.  It has been my experience that Park Place Property Management handles this delicate balance quite well.  I currently live out of state, but I am very comfortable with Serena and the entire team at Park Place managing my properties.
These guys are great. Fast and friendly and they worked with my insurance on a rock chip. I highly recommend them. Customer service doesn't get better than this.

Long 30+ minutes wait for food. Soup was cold and had to be sent back. Environment unpleasantly noisy especially shouting and yelling from kitchen but also loud voices from servers. Problem agravated by room design and unsuccessful attempts to solve problem by hanging panels from ceiling.
Would I go back - maybe in 6 months to see if they have resolved problems.

We almost lost our dog from bolting multiple times before we went to Sit Means Sit. After doing the immersion program with private lessons I can walk my dog without holding her leash through a busy park with kids and other dogs. It is truly incredible to be able to enjoy her more and not fear taking her places.

I found the seafood to be boring. I was bothered by the up charging for the kitchen to remove the head from the shrimp. I know Cajun. This ain't it! As we left all in my party agreed that we would stick with Joes Crab Shack where the food is by far more enjoyable.
Good was good but poor service.  Didn't get my drink till well after meal and I had to remind them.  Meal took forever.

I'm a huge fan a Cinnabon and thought these might compare. They didn't. 
They looked good. The buns themselves were soft and chewy but lacked the cinnamon flavor. The frosting tasted like sweet whipped butter, no cream cheese like a cinnamon bun should have. 
Way overpriced for the quality.

I loved it when I first joined it, but I've been targeted by one of the management members. Today one of the front desk clerks asked me (a VIP member) for my ID and made up that it was a new rule, starting today. 
The facilities need better maintenance and cleaning, towels for cleaning the equipment shouldn't be re-used, because that's perfect to spread bacteria and viruses, so I usually use the scarce wipes located in a few spots around the gym. 
Swimming pool and hot tub need some maintenance, the paint is peeling off in several spots, which makes it unpleasant to the touch. 
It's definitely time to improve and update!

Great food excellent drink selection and very friendly staff! Reccomend anybody check it out! Added bonus the outdoor patio seating and blankets are ADORABLE and make it a perfect brunch spot! Will be coming back!

I just love Express Cafe. A lot of great food, awesome prices, staff & service impeccable. My family and I have been going since 2008 and have never been disappointed. Love this Mom & Pop restaurant. Plus supporting local versus franchise. They serve breakfast all day.

The best part of this place is the drive through- pick up bagels and cream cheese for Saturday morning, a healthier lunch than most other drive through options, and soup and sandwiches for dinner all while keeping my naughty toddler and immunosuppressed son in the car. Awesome. They have a decent bakery as far as nice, crusty bread goes. Negatives are that they've run out of things twice when I've come (basic things like veggie cream cheese), and the inside doesn't have the ambience I have enjoyed in other states like TN, NC, VA, etc. This one is dark and cramped.

I saw the stinky reviews, and yet, I still went to get my haircut there today. I am visiting for the week and I was desperate. It was the closest place to the hotel, I had a Supercuts gift card with me, and I desperately needed a cleanup before my grandmother's memorial service. 

I am so glad that I went! The gal who cut my hair did an amazing job! I have an asymmetrical bob, and it had some funky parts leftover from my last cut (the gal who usually cuts my hair had an off day). She cleaned up the shag perfectly, adjusted some lines, gave me some volume in the back, and styled it super cute. The products she used were really good too... they actually helped my hair a ton. I loved that she wasn't just pushing product on me--she actually showed me how cool the stuff was and how it helped my hair (I could see a total difference). To top it off, I noticed some crap brows on me when I looked in the mirror, so I asked if she could clean those up as well. They look great! 

I don't know what the other reviews are about, but this gal was awesomely talented and did a beautiful job with my hair. Added points for the fun conversation. Here's the worst part though--I forgot her name!!!! So I can't even recommend her or thank her. She was young, wore cute glasses, and had short, brightly colored reddish/purple hair. What a boring description, but I do hope that whoever she is, you find her if you come to this Supercuts. She was great! Now I wish I actually lived here so she could be my go-to... broken heart.

First time here-wasn't sure what to expect since seafood and Idaho don't always play well. Had a great experience, and the Yelp waitlist feature made it super convenient. Impressed with the service from our server Natalie, and the manager even came to say hello. We ordered a combo platter plain with the Cajun sauce on the side. Crawfish, scallops and clams were perfectly cooked. Seems like more of a beer place instead of cocktails. My margarita was $11 and not terribly exciting. Definitely surprised by the quality of the food and service though. This would be one of the few places I would actually feel comfortable ordering oysters on the half shell. Looking forward to coming back for our next seafood craving!

I needed to find a new stylist ad salon, mine moved after 9 years.  I had heard good things about Casa Bella, so I scheduled an appointment and was scheduled with Afton.  Afton was new to the salon, but I was so very lucky to be scheduled with Afton!  I have had my hair done by Afton a few times now, I love the way she colors my hair, and the cut is perfect.  I now get many compliments from family and friends, even strangers on how great my hair looks, and everyone loves how natural the color looks.  Afton styled my hair for my sons wedding and I loved it, so did everyone at the wedding.  Afton even did my makeup at the salon for my sons wedding before she styled my hair.  Afton listens to every detail of how I want my hair colored, styled or cut.  I highly recommend Afton to you if you are looking for a new stylist.

Best seafood place!! Very friendly customer service and very patience with a large group. The server always check on us often to make sure we are ok and got everything we needed.  The food was amazing and delicious!! It's our 4th visit and looking forward to come again soon. Taste way better than Joe's Crab Shack.

I was super excited to finally try Panera bread as I'm from Salt Lake City and we don't have Panera. I arrived an hour prior to their closing time which is suppose to be 9:30pm. I ordered 2 meals which my total was a little over 30.00 with two drinks. One of my sandwiches was the steak and white cheddar and I wish I would have taken a picture because I hardly had any meat on the sandwich. I felt rush during my whole visit, they even took the drink heads off the drink station and I couldn't get a refill to my 2.33 soft drink. There were two female employees sitting in the lobby watching us and waiting for our dishes and rushed over to us as we got up to leave to take our dishes from us. I was already over it at this point... as I was walking out the door a family of 5 asked me why they closed early and wanted to be let in because the doors were locked. Sure enough i checked the door and indeed they were locked early!! I couldn't explain why but seen the disappointment on their faces. Just an awful experience all together and I hate that I was in a position where this family questioned me about them closing early!

My husband and I love le peep. We come here almost every Sunday for breakfast. I try to get something different every time I go and so far everything has been great!!

Also while I was reading other reviews I noticed if someone wasn't happy with their meal someone from the restaurant actually commented back to them apologizing, how they are working to fix the issue, and offered them a free meal. It actually says a lot that they take the time to do that and shows how great this place is!

We stopped one evening after dinner and shopping in the village. Nice little place. Friendly service. It was crowded so there was a little wait but not a big deal. It smelled heavenly as you would expect. Very pricey but very yummy!

Delicious breakfast and great service! I ordered the eggs benedict and they were cooked perfect and bursted with flavor. Super accommodating in splitting plates for the kids. A lot of places frown upon it.  

Love the small table in the corner for the kids. 

Totally recommend for a relaxing and scrumptious brunch!

Great spot with fantastic breakfast and fast friendly service. I was also blown away with how clean it is. We will definitely be back. Don't be surprised if you have to wait to be seated, stick around, it's worth it!

This is a brand new restaurant and with that patience is required. Having said that the best part of our experience was our server, Angela. She was absolutely fabulous. Aside from Angela, there wasn't much else we found great. When we walked in we asked about patio seating and the hostess handed me our menus failing to mention none of the tables were big enough to accomodate our family. As we made our way back inside to get seated we waited until both a hostess and a buser could finish their conversation in order to be seated. Once seated we met Angela. She was friendly, attentive to our children and did her best to salvage our experience. We waited for nearly an hour on a Tuesday for our food. The fries were fabulous. The gnocchi was heavily salted to the point it wasn't edible in addition to being cold. The price points did not reflect in the food. The food was alright, but mediocre, which was a disappointment considering the beautifully articulate menu describing beautiful food. 

Angela comped us a dessert, but that won't be enough to bring us back. Good luck on your growing pains, Barrel 55.

Fantastic place to take the kids!!!!! I'm actually in awe of how great this place is! We spent 4 hours here on a Friday night and could have stayed longer! They offered food to purchase and even drinks for parents. We saw workers cleaning the entire time we were there! There are workers at the different activities and lines were short! We will be back monthly for sure!!

Please for the love of god never ever rent from here. I know it's tempting but PLEASE DONT DO IT. If I could give it -10000 stars I would. They are relatively attentive prior to signing a lease, but once you have you're screwed. If you have issues the only method of contact is email. If you ask questions they will ignore you, they "go out of town" the 1st-5th so you can't ask questions without being late on rent. They allowed us to go without a heater for a week in the middle of winter. Our manager Emily is the absolute worst part about this company. She's rude, demeaning, lies to you every step of the way, and refuses to communicate with you if you're unhappy. Don't even think about trying to move out early. You have to pay rent till it's taken over, advertising fees, utility bills and $1000 lease break fee. Plus you have to forfeit your massive deposit ($1200) then pay an additional $500+ when you move out because you don't have a deposit anymore. And when I questioned Emily about these things, she conveniently "went out of town". 

Plus the positive reviews were given in exchange for a discount. So don't trust those.

Went through drive thru for two drinks. Ordered a large diet cherry limeade and a small strawberry lemonade. Received drinks and drive off. When I tasted the diet cherry limeade it was awful! Tasted of chemicals and soda water. There were no limes in it either (minor detail). So I called and spoke to manager. I informed him the syrup must be out on diet soda and the drink tasted of chemicals so they might want to check it out. He said ok and hung up. Where's the "can we fix it for you" or a simple sorry? I wasn't demanding or mean. I was just trying to prevent another customer from getting a gross drink.  A little customer service goes a long way.

My son had his birthday here and it was amazing! The hostess we had Taylor was the best! She was attentive and friendly. The place was clean and had several workers managing to make sure the kids were safe. There's a variety of things for kids to do! It's a bit pricey for the birthday package but worth it to me because I just get to sit back.

I have to admit that I am not a big breakfast fan. I could get by on a bowl of cereal in the morning.  But I think that Le Peep may have changed all that. 
Hub and I were out and about on Sunday and noticed people lined up outside the restaurant.  Must be a good place, right?   The wait was not long. They keep the line moving without making customers feel rushed. 
The interior is modern with plenty of elbow room. Noise level is good too so you don't have to shout across the table.
I ordered the Petit Toast...French Toast and bacon. I was expecting the standard fare, but somehow Le Peep manages to elevate each dish. The French Toast was light with enough body and the syrup tasted like real - deal maple. The bacon was perfectly crispy not crumbly (yes, there is a difference. ) Hub  had the Hen-pen...eggs, cottage fries, bacon and English muffin. All were spectacular. (usually cottage fries are just a "throwaway" dish, but these were amazing; crispy on the outside, creamy on the inside with perfect seasoning.) Prices are very reasonable for the quality. 
The wait staff is delightful too.  I think that I am a breakfast convert.

Bread sticks were good. Pizza was good but not great. If you like hippie pizza then you might like it more. The service was poor and we had to ask for things like plates and silverware and refills and the check and...  The staff looked like the dirty hippies of the northwest that we came here to avoid. Dreadlocks and aggressive piercings are the norm.  Most of the staff seemed angry at some unknown family member and their demeanor stayed that way despite our best efforts to charm them. 
Not bad food but not great but they make up for it with lousy service.
I have had several meet here. Very friendly staff. Good coffee. The drive up is great too! There are not a lot of coffee spots near us so this is my go to and very happy with them.

My family and I have eaten Flying Pie several times and love eating there, there is 6 of us and usually love the environment and the people, but tonight was a huge let down, we came and waited for about 20 minutes for a seat, it was extremely busy, but after that 20 minutes we were extremely rudely told that we would have to wait another 30 minutes to be seated and people were ahead of us that were not were to be seated first. To the short, dark haired girl at the cash register, you will be the reason my family of 6 will no long be giving flying pie our business. Very disappointed in your service and attitude accepted at this location.

I have a beautiful 70 inch Sony SXRD, it was the top of the line model in 2006.  Recently, the light engine went bad.  I called 4 TV repair shops and three of them told me that it can't be fixed and that I should just go buy a new TV.  Luan was the only one who said he could fix it.  He immediately diagnosed the problem over the phone and gave me a fixed quote which was a fraction of the cost to buy a new comparable TV.  He arrived on time and was extremely professional.

Delicious! A fun treat with many adventurous flavor options. We enjoyed cinnamon rolls at the shop, and brought some home to enjoy the next day. Even the reheated were excellent. Have visited several times, all good!
Great food and lots to choose from with many dietary issues at the table. Everyone went away  full if not with a Togo box.
The food, service,  and overall experience is beyond fabulous.  I highly recommend going.  You won't regret doing so.

We were traveling thru Boise and needed to transfer data from one broken computer to a new computer.  The service we received was excellent!!  We will definitely recommend to our family members that live in meridian to get their computer serviced at this location  if they ever have computer issues.    The gentleman that fixed start computer was very friendly and professional 
Sincerely Kelly & Chris

Dennis and his crew did an outstanding job. Came to my rescue after the huge wind storm we had in May. I had a branch break and was concerned about the rest. Called Tina and she was able to fit me in the same week. My tree is simply beautiful, nice shape and now I'm not afraid of branches dropping on neighbors property.
I highly recommend them.

So very happy!

I live in California while my mom lives in Meridian, ID and I wanted to send her flowers for her birthday. Not only was it easy to order the flowers online, an employee called to inform me they didn't have a certain vase and asked what I would like to have as a replacement. I told them I just wanted a square vase and to do what they thought would look the best. What they did exceeded my expectations. I also order the flowers at 9:45 am and they had them delivered by 1pm on the same day. My mother loves them and so do I! The arrangement was beautiful!! Thank you for making my mom's birthday special!
