Excited to have a great new breakfast spot in Boise! Le Peep raises the bar and distinguishes itself from the usual diners or bland chains. We really enjoyed the fresh fare, upscale menu and great service!  The salmon benedict was incredible - delicious and a huge salmon portion for the very reasonable price point. We'll be back soon.

We have been here a whole heck of a lot and every single time we are blown away with the amazing staff, the food, and the over all experience. Top to bottom, they nail it and have ruined us for other breakfast places!! Well done, Express Cafe

"The Flower Place" is my go-to shop whenever I need flower arrangements.  I have been a faithful Flower Place customer for probably upwards of 15 years or more, mostly because I they have done such a great job with every occasion that I have need to call upon them.  Weddings, Funerals, Proms, Valentine's Day are just a few of the occasions where we have used The Flower Place, and we have always been happy with the results.  Most recently, I called upon  The Flower Place to get an arrangement for my wife for our wedding anniversary.  I ordered the flowers online, and when I went to pick them up, the flowers were ready.  They did a great job, as the arrangement was beautiful.

Best customer service I've ever had! Called this shop last minute right before Mother's Day. I live out of town so needed someone to hand deliver and the flowers were delivered to my mother within a couple hours. Fast and friendly. The flowers were so beautiful and my mom is STILL raving about  them. Thank you!!!

This place is delicious! Definitely going to be my go to for Hawaiian food while I'm in Idaho. I had the mixed "mini" plate which is actually not so mini, it definitely fills you up. Everything was really yummy! The teriyaki sauce and katsu sauce are packed with flavor! The only thing I wasn't a fan of was the cold chopped styled cabbage under the meats, it would have been great if it was cooked or if it wasn't cooked shredded. Other than that I enjoyed the food.

You think I'm joking, but this Taco Bell deserves four stars.  

Location: 3 out of 5
Eh, since everything in the Boise area is within 15 - 20 minutes of each other, this isn't too terrible.  I stayed in Meridian over a 4 day span, and this location was close to the Best Western Rama Inn there.  I only ate here once, though.

Decor: 2 out of 5
It's a Taco Bell.  They look similar.  

Cleanliness: 4 out of 5
Quite clean, actually, probably due to this next factor...

Service: 5 out of 5
I kid you not, the person working there when I went was the model employee.  Not just for Boise, but for restaurants everywhere.  These are the things that he did that made him stand out from any other fast food experience I've had:
1) He held the door open for me when I walked in.  No joke
2) He took my order and made intelligent small talk in the process.
3) After I sat down, he and another person brought my food out to me.  They didn't make me stand around, but attempted to bring it to my table.  Since I'm not used to this type of treatment, I met them half way. Ha.
4) Every few minutes, he'd come by the main dining room and either ask people how they were doing, how the food was, or if there was anything that he could do to make things better.  He took other patrons' empty trays and wrappers, for crying out loud.

Quality of food: 4 out of 5
Say what you will with all the lawsuits. Taco Bell food is greasy yes, and my stomach fought back a few hours later (not unexpected), but based on all public requests and data, they use "real" ingredients.  And you can't fight the fact that they try some pretty goofed up stuff that tastes ok.  I had the 5 dollar box.  I was no disappointed.  I was full, went into a food coma shortly after, and had that lovely aroma of Taco Bell on my clothes until I changed.

Overall: 4 out of 5
Honestly, probably one of the best dining experiences I've had in the last two calendar year, and without a doubt - the best fast food experience I've had, period.  Kudos to the young man working there.  All people in Boise were friendly, but he went above and beyond what was expected.

Lucky Perk is my absolute favorite of all our local coffee shops, and consistent across the board, no matter which location I'm going to. Why are they different? They feature a rotating "dessert" brew each day. No cals, lots of flavor, great aroma. I love love LOVE their dessert drips! Plus, customer service is ON POINT across the board. They are MY spot!

Food: The oatmeal is very good! It comes in a coffee cup with your choice of mix-ins (almonds, brown sugar & cranberries--you pick 2). It's not fancy but I really like that it's house-made, not a HUGE portion and not pre-packaged. I love that they also offer a wide variety of meals (oatmeal, burritos, salads) and pastries. The breakfast burritos are very good... they're heavy and very filling. They offer different flavors (the bacon, egg & cheese is yummy!) and serve with hot sauce if requested. The cinnamon rolls are homemade by a local gal and are SO GOOD! She does a really nice job! The frosted sugar cookies are the icing on the cake. You won't be disappointed.

Drinks: The dessert brew! They do a good job with their lattes, hot chocolates and tea variety as well, but I love the dessert brew. It's a new flavor each day. They also serve a decaf gingerbread tea that is so great... make it a "London Fog" by adding a splash of milk!

Atmosphere: They are always very nice and cozy for a casual catch-up date or just a solo study session. I like the tables (high and low options) and the comfy bed couches. There's always a variety and the fireside seating is also a bonus.

Service: The service (and dessert brew, of course!) is what keeps me coming back. The staff is always friendly, upbeat and smiling. 

Happy Hour Offerings: n/a though they do have punch cards & text club

Healthy Hack: The dessert brew is a flavored coffee with no cals. Bonus! If you're looking for a light but satisfying meal, ask for the oatmeal. It's an appropriate serving and won't tip you over the edge on calories, sugar or cost!

Tips: Ask for the dessert drip! It's a rotating flavor ranging from vanilla to almond, etc. No cals, lots of flavor, amazing aroma. Join the text club for deals and discount alerts!

Great staff very informative just started the program cheated with tequila shots still lost staff supportive and helpful


Update:
Came back to the clinic for testing thought I was going through menopause...had my consultation done which was very pricey tests also very expensive....couldn't come back for a while for my results do to money....yes expensive to get them...shocked at the results and how it was presented to me but thankful nonetheless to know the results. I'm taking the information with a grain of salt and will be going to an accredited doctor to compare the information. This is not a cheap clinic...yes the staff is great but I'm not rich enough to continue to go back nor do I truly have complete faith in the information given to me....happy I went but it was a experience that cost alot....Also a huge miss communication on possible charges of office visits.

Great place for food, beer, wine and liquor. 30 beers on tap and great house wine. They also have a good variety of reds and whites. Friendly and fast service with a good atmosphere. Centrally located between Caldwell and Boise.

Great food and even better beer on tap! First time going here, and it was a delight. Had the prime rib which was "melt in your mouth good" and had a few local beers. We will be coming here again! And again!

The guys at Quick Computer Services in Meridian, ID really ROCK! I've taken 2 laptops and 1 notebook computers that needed to have several things wrong with each.  The repairs were quickly fixed and the cost as EXTREMELY reasonable. I'll definitely bring my computer back to them if or when it needs work.

SUPER Customer Service - something sadly missing from other businesses.

Had a good evening with friends. Some really good food ( I had a 16oz. Smoked prime rib) and they have quite the draft beer selection. Our server was friendly and got our food out in a timely manner. I was surprised to hear that Almost everything on the menu is made in house. The kids had cheese burgers from the kids menu and I couldn't believe how big the burgers are! We also met the new manager as he came by to check on us. This was our second time here ( much better experience than the last time) we will for sure be back!!

This place is always a mess. The beverage area where the utensils and everything are is ALWAYS disgusting. I've found food in the bottom of the canisters that hold the forks. Disgusting. A mess. The tables are rarely wiped off and there is food all over the ground. I've sat in line with one person working the line and I'm waiting to order and the other staff just look at me like, she will get to you when she's done. Just standing around talking and doing nothing. Staff needs to step it up a bit and maybe a few more rounds of an employee going and cleaning tables off and cleaning up the beverage utensil area.

It is clear to me that the two 1-star reviews are from other "seafood" restaurant employees or owners in the area.  There is NO WAY those things went as bad as they said.  Been to this restaurant several times and different times of the day and the service and food was outstanding. Better than any other restaurant serving seafood - hands down.

You folks writing the fictitious 1-star reviews - get back to your place and fix your problems first.  When you are getting 5-star reviews from actual customers, then you can throw out a bit of criticism.  Until then, clam up (no pun intended).

It was happy hour and we were told that the drinks were on happy hour price.  They didn't tell us that only certain ones were at happy hour prices.  Very disappointed with the "false advertising".  The food was delicious and beer selection was great.  Finger steaks, prime rib dip sandwiches, and fondue were all good.  I would definitely recommend this restaurant.  Just don't expect the waitress/ waiters to know what is going on.  They are supposedly a part of the Boise beer buddies and we were supposed to get a dollar off our first beer (It was even posted on a flyer in the bathroom) but didn't receive it even after requesting it from our waitress.  She said" I'm not familiar with that.  We had 8 people in our party and I didn't want to pursue the matter.

Not sure I could love this place more! 

As someone who doesn't eat chocolate, this has really turned into my go to place for a sweet treat! 

I'll regularly stop in for a 3pk of baby buns and try a different icing each time on them.  

I've also done a regular sized cinnamon roll, but it will take me 2-3 sittings just to finish one.  

I love the variety of flavors for both icings and toppings.  

Sign up for their rewards program to get deals and coupons. 

Only recommendation- wish they would always serve the cinnamon roll hot.  Sometimes the baby buns are not and they always test better when they are. 

Overall they have a great team working there, helpful, customer service oriented and friendly!

To find a place of this quality and professionalism is very hard.  The ambience, the knowledge of the owners, and employees is worthy of emulation by like businesses, and those near them.  The care for customers, and the candid desire to make sure you have not only quality, but something they would put their own names on is above commendable.  They set a standard all merchants should be measured by.  Thank you, and we look forward to coming to your store for years to come.

Rodolfo and Faye

I decided to try Panera Bread in Meridian again. I got there before 9 in the morning and tried to order a sprouted wheat bagel. They were out. I asked if they were going to make anymore and they said no. If I want the sprouted wheat bagel to order them the night before and I can pick it up the next day. It seems they never bake enough of their signature items and have no intention of doing so. There are many places in the Meridian area that make bagels and bread at a cheaper price and if they run out of their baked goods early in the day they make more. I'm very disappointed in Panera bread of meridian Idaho.

Yesterday I have planned to have a really nice dinner time with my sister for mothers day. I was so excited to have hook and reel since my sisters never been. When my son picked up our order, it wasn't what I have ordered. The shrimp boil was so small and the crab boil and scallops were so tiny. Definitely that wasn't enough to feed 4 ladies. When I called the lady who answered the phone could bearly help me. I was really disappointed with my service last night.

came here on a sunday at lunch. they have a pretty small menu- which i think is because it's sunday brunch. so it's a lot of simple breakfast items and only a few lunch items.

the inside of the place is cool! we sat in the bar and the decor is awesome! they have this giant chandelier over the room that is made out of beer bottles...i've never seen anything like that before. 

they have a full bar as well, so you can get anything you want. it was a little early for me, but my mom ordered off their pretty good sized wine menu.

mom ordered the bacon cheeseburger- i ordered the BLTA with sweet potato fries. it took quite a long time to come out. i want to say around 30 minutes. the servers kept coming over asking if we needed anything- they must have gotten backed up in the kitchen. it happens...and we were not in a hurry so it's all good.

the food was really good! i loved my meal- the fries were perfect. they were better than average sweet potato fries. and the sandwich had really yummy thick cut bacon. my moms burger was sinful! it was so huge, and i loved the caramelized onions on it. their regular fries are also super good, and their fry sauce has some spice to it- i liked it!

i have every intention of coming back, just maybe not on a sunday so i can see the full menu and have a cocktail or two.
Prospective tenant experience good.  Easy to locate, navigate available rentals.  Quick response and ease of application.

This place was terrible! One guy nice, the other talks to you like you should know all of his nerdy computer lingo. Took my laptop in because hard drive froze up. Was told they would replace hard drive and try and save my personal files. The next day was called and told my laptop was ready for pickup. Wow! That was quick I thought. Got there only to find that they didn't save any of my files, my touchscreen didn't work and I had been upgraded to windows 10. When I told the nerd my touchscreen was inoperable he said " Oh, that's a touchscreen?" I told them to give me back windows 8.1 and fix my touchscreen. I had to come back 4 hours later only find out that now my keyboard didn't work properly. The techs comment was "well, we've got it this far". The whole time I was there I had to hear how my laptop was just a bunch of Chinese crap. Numerous references to how crappy a consumer grade Chinese laptop was. His words not mine!  They even told me that they should be charging more. Not my fault they didn't get it right the first time. I now have a laptop that doesn't work properly and I'm out 202 dollars. I will never refer anyone to them. As smart as they talked I would've guessed they were better at their job. Totally disappointed!!!!!
Great food good service and great music! Downtown Meridian kid friendly. Great asset to downtown Meridian.

Excited to experience Flying Pie Pizzaria, but treated rudely by young teenybopper who didn't want to take our order. No one was there other than a couple of people playing pool way in the back. We ordered the pesto primavera, which was fresh and crispy, but burned. Took over 35 minutes to get our order brought to us. The breadsticks were fresh and hot, but hardly cut into pieces we could pull apart. The salad bar was surprisingly good; however, there were FLIES hovering over the food, arbitrarily attacking the exposed offerings. My only wish was that the salad plate was larger...being the size of a child's plate. The pizza overall was good, but should not have been sent out in its burned state.

I really love Panera bread! Nothing better than those banquettes haha! Everything I've ever tried is so great, and the staff is wonderful as well. The only frustrating thing is that my order is almost always wrong. I get home from picking up my order, and there's either chicken all over my salad (I am a Vegan so this is really disappointing) or they've forgotten dressing or sides. Other than that I love this place!

There are a lot of self serve yogurts these days. But in my opinion they are expensive and not that spectacular. 

TCBY has a wide selection of hard frozen yogurt as well as soft serve. They have normal cones, waffle cones, and cups. They also have an assortment of toppings. 

They also have smoothies, which use yogurt as the base. And sorbet is also an option.

The customer service has always been good and the establishment is clean. It's a great place.

The service was excellent. The lobster bisque was spicy which I didn't expect that and neither did my stomach. I am born and raised just outside of Boston Mass and I know my seafood and love it. I know this is a Cajun restaurant but a bisque isn't supposed to be spicy. So my stomach didn't like it so the waiter was gracious enough to get me some clam chowder. It was delicious.  Also tried the appetizer paella OMG just simply wonderful a bit of sweet with all the seafood and the portion was excellent. Even had some cold the next day and it was still amazing. The rest of my family aren't seafood eaters so they stuck with the chicken platter which for them they loved it. The portion size was spot on. The flavor was thumbs up and the fries they fell in love with them. Crunchy and warm till the end. Keep up the good work and service.

Ordered a 14" Triple Pie to go. Was really cheesy and full of different bits of meat, not like loaded, but adequate. And I enjoyed the heat, as it was just the right amount I wanted. The crust was really tasty, almost sweet!  Service was very friendly from everyone I encountered. But mainly my five star review is for their homemade ranch dressing. I asked for some to dip my pizza in and guuhhhhhhh....it was DELICIOUS! Made me very, very happy. If you are a ranch dressing fan, this place will deliver. Next time I will try their salad bar

This is one of my regular dining locations due to the location, the quality of the food, and the live music they offer on Friday nights. I came here with a group of friends to hear a local band Captain Snafu. We all enjoyed our dinner, I had the chicken berry salad, fresh and flavorful. The staff is always friendly, get here early though as seating is limited when there is a band.

Amazed by the true talent of Jessica Reeves. I came in with a color correction disaster and she totally transformed my hair while maintaining shine, softness, and the overall integrity of my hair. I was so shocked by how reasonable her prices were and just how kind she is. On top of the amazing color I also received possibly the best haircut I've ever had! So happy to have found a stylist in the area that knows what she's doing!

Don't get me wrong, love the roll. I've only been once but was totally in love with every bite. I've been waiting to try this place since they were a one shop place in California and I lived all the way on the east coast. They are most definitely better than their Cinna competition.

I didn't pay attention to the assembling process so I can't comment there but the roll came out looking lovely imo.

What keeps this place from being a 5 star for me is definitely customer service, like others have posted, it's totally flat. 

This store in particular is in a place where people for the most part expect a step above the rest so hopefully they will bring it a little more.

The food was fantastic. It's one of our favorite places for seafood. The spices were just right. So many times they say spicy but aren't. We used to go to Joe's Crab Shack but love this place much more. Even the spaghetti was really good. The servers and management were nice. Can't wait to go back.
I love coming here, the people are so great. I've never waited in a line for too long for my food. It's always clean and maintained. I'm in love with their mozzarella sticks:)))

The vanilla breve shmacks. THEY GOT BEES. They could use some music outside. Customer service is BEYOND ME!! Great i had a blast only thing that killed it wERE THE BEES y'all. Can't blame them for that sksksksk. Anyways the vibe and food was gr8.
Best Hawaiian I've had. Great service and good. My whole family is excited to gave this place in Boise. We will be visiting often.
Love this store! We always get the greatest deals here. Name brand gently used clothing, without the name brand price!!! Love that it's clean and well organized. Excellent customer customer too! :)

One of the worst meals we have had I a long time. Not only was it over $25 for two people to eat the pick 2 the quality was terrible. On one of the sandwiches there was one small piece of chicken and one small piece of avocado. Then to top it off people around us were having to clean off their own tables so they could sit down.  As you can see from the picture this IS NOT a 13 dollar sandwich
Great pizza. The crust has a great flavor lots of topping    Chicken wings very tinder and full of flavor. Cinnamon monkey bread was a sweet end of the dinner. Will be back soon.

I really like Mo Betta's. It's not hardcore Hawaiian and the menu isn't comprehensive, but it's really good if you're looking for a little flavor and more importantly, you're looking for something different from typical quick serve. The portions are substantial, it's not expensive for what they serve, the employees are cool and they play Cali Roots reggae. It's hidden in a little strip mall, but definitely worth searching out.

Run fast and far.  The most abusive form of training ever. My beautiful sweet yellow lab went there too help socialize. He came home a totally different dog.  He hadn't been home for 12 hours and he bit me in the face requiring 2 surgeries and it was 30,000 doctor and hospital bills. After the bite we examined the dog to find multiple burn marks around his neck from a shock collar.  I was told to watch for blood in his stool.?? why not mention the burns.  I was forced to put my beautiful registered lab down.  Never heard one thing from this company.  
My dog came home abused and now I am scarred for life. The worst place around.  Do not let your animal out of your sight, protect them from terrible abusive trainers.

Me and my husband thought the food was great  however i had bad experience with my waiter alexis i was rushed with my order. When my food came my order did come back right ..#2 i was placed at the smallest corner in the resteraunt i asked if i can move to a regular table booth she said no and asked me if where i was sitting at fine.... becuase if we didnt come in a group there was no booth available even though there was one available on front of us plus 2 more... at the end of the day i decided to take my food to go . it was my birthday it didnt feel too much like it the only thing satisfied me was the food. It sucks becuase i loved the food.

I've visited twice in two days. This place replicates Hawaiian plate lunch perfectly. As good if not better than many plate lunch I've had in Hawaii. What a great concept for fast casual Hawaiian food. The chicken katsu is great! The kahlua pork is perfect with light saltiness and smoke. Even the rice is cooked right! The tall guy behind the counter is energetic and enthusiastic about the customer experience. The portion size, even for the mini, is very generous and the price is very reasonable.  They also have a good selection of Hawaiian Sun beverages. I want to go back right now! So ono!

Beware of the safety of your pet here. I had been taking my miniature schnauzer to Wags to Riches for a year and half and was happy. This past Monday after I brought her home one of her eyes was bright red in the white of her eye. Took her to the vet hospital and the vet said she had trauma to her eye. Something happened to her at the groomers. When I called the groomer to try and find out if she jerked her head and hit something or squirmed and fell and all she did was get upset with me that I was accusing her of doing something to my dog and I didn't accuse her of anything. Her very defensive actions and getting upset with me tells me something happened that wasn't an accident nor my dogs actions that caused the injury.   I wanted to share my experience because my little schnauzer is so sweet, I can't imagine someone hurting her the way someone did at Wags to Riches.
We tried this for a lunch date and we were pleasantly surprised on how authentic the food is! We loved everything about it and will go back again.

The juice definitely isn't worth the squeeze here. I've eaten here before, sadly I can't give a food rating today. After waiting 45 minutes and having multiple groups who came In after us seated in front of us, we walked over to Barrel 55 for an excellent lunch with exceptional service.

The atmosphere in this place is very inviting. We loved our server. She was friendly and personable. Everything we ordered for lunch was spot on and delicious. A welcome establishment in downtown Meridian.

After moving out of state for a couple years, I was in need of a new waxer with a different technique. I found Shea after searching for sugar wax in the Meridian area. She was friendly, fast and efficient. Happy to have found her.

Second time we've been here and the food was great! Rack of lamb was good, not too fatty but could've used a little more seasoning. Bison finger steaks were great and the roasted salad was great again! Service was great and hope more locals check this place out.

Finally decided to try after weeks of my husband hinting to me. Place was busy & very clean. Ordered 3 sandwiches. They were stuffed with tons of meat! Which is great - way better than what you might get at Subway or Blimpie. Loved the seasoned fries with it. Only thing is on the Italian sandwich way too much sauce versus the meat & veggies. The sauce shouldn't be the star it should be the other goodies. Otherwise great place to get a yummy sandwich.

omg this place is amazing okay at first time went it was OK but i went to go again and let me tell you it was AMAZING !!!!!!! okay i had the burger and fries and just water. okay still wondering why we don't visit as often well now i'm going like twice a week now soooo that's great and thats all i have to say is you'll fall in love. and love the devil.

OH MY GOODNESS, this place is the best! Loads better than Plato's Closet. Their inventory is AMAZING, their prices are unbeatable, the girls who work here are the sweetest, and they are very consistent about what they do or do not buy. Fantastic shoes, jewelry, formals, bags, even perfume! The ladies even remember our names!
We LOVE Epic!
The customer service was excellent and the pulled pork did not look like the best but after I tasted it I was blown away it  was the best I have ever had!

So sad that so many don't get Panera. The food is delicious and healthy. The portions are NORMAL size. Too many are used to overeating at restaurants. The quality is superb and fresh. When one walks away from Panera they do so with a satisfied belly NOT an overstuffed food baby and pains for an hour.

I guess I should have taken the other reviews more seriously. We dined in. The air was smokey inside, which made the dining experience not very pleasant. We started with pepperoni bread which was excellent. The pizza though was mediocre. My beer was served in a dirty glass. I'm not a super picky reviewer, but I probably wouldn't try this location again.

Hubby and I pride ourselves on our low country boils. That being said, I thought the shrimp boil was priced well (though not as good as ours, LOL) and I asked where the oysters on the half shell were from. Bartender asked the MOD who said California. I ignored and ordered them--not good. Restaurant was also a lot more of a chain restaurant atmosphere than we expected. Hubby liked the crab cake basket; bartender was fantastic, but a manager who tells you the oysters are from California? That being said, the staff hustles, food came out quickly.

Planned to spend a ton of money here tonight. No one helped, their costumer service was terrible. When the apparent manager came over to help us check out she didn't even look at us and was rude on top of that. The total would have been about $300 and I ended up just saying forget it.  
Love the store and clothes, but they are losing costumers from their attitude.

I've been ordering takeout pizzas from this location 4-5 separate times now. Even though this place has good reviews and praise, I still don't think it's really a 5 star place. The main issue (for me) is the price (bang for buck). The pizzas here are very pricey. Yes, I know this place isn't on the same level as Papa John's or Dominos, but it's almost twice the price of those kinds of places, and the pizzas here really aren't 2x better. Yes the toppings are fresh and abundant, but man it's still pricey. 

Even though they have the buy 1 get 1 half price deal for medium or large pizzas, your total will be around $40 for 2 larges, while I can get 2 larges from other places for right around $20 (when those other places have 50% off coupon codes, etc).

The pizzas are tasty, ingredients taste fresh for the most part. Lots of variety available. My personal favorites are Garlic Chicken Pizza & Contest Combo Pizza.

Someone in a previous review mentioned that they never answer the phone when you try and call to place an order. I found that to be accurate, since 1 time I actually tried calling 3 times to order (each time 5 minutes apart) and no one answered. They have been better at that recently though, and I only had 1 time this happened within the last month or so.

Overall, they have tasty pizzas, but if the pricing was re-evaluated and dropped slightly, this place would be 4-5 stars easy. I really enjoy the pizzas when I order here, but the pricing is just a little off IMO. 

As a side note, their Habanero pizza they have in the summer is HOT AF. I got the "weakest" version, and I was sweating and dying after my first slice. If you LIKE  hot foods, level 1 is for you. If you're a savage that likes torture, get level 2. If your previous life was you living your life as a BBQ charcoal briquette getting roasted in jet fuel in the middle of the Sahara Desert, then level 3 is for you.
Came in on Christmas Eve to visit family and Anthony hooked us up. Great service. Next time I'm in town I will definitely stop in again to get lined up. I will recommend this place

Of all the seafood I've eaten in my life, this was hands down the worst! Everything was over cooked and had way too much sugar. The lobster bisque tasted like sugar when it should be a savory soup. The crab fries had a sweet sauce on them, when they should have been savory. The shrimp cocktail was overcooked and had zero flavor. The service was fine but the food is down right disgusting! I will definitely not be eating here again.
Doug Flanders is the best realtor! He is attentive and understands your needs. He is also very ethical - you can trust him.

Had my Brazilian before I went on a tropical vacation, I've had them for years, so i knew what to expect. Very clean studio, and shea was super informative with sugaring. Plus it's nice to have communication during the procedure, to get your mind not thinking about the process.. if you have never sugared your missing out! I was a waxer for years.. and will never go back! If you can do hard wax, sugaring is like a dream come true! I came in though with a major MAJOR burn from the lovely tanning bed ( getting some color before tropical sun) anyways.. Shea, was kind and nice and even though it killed just because of my burn, she was so quick, yet very thorough. Last thing you want is to have a missed spot down in your lady bits on vacation . Very pleased with the results! Thanks again!!
Andrea

Who wants to even think that this Cajun seafood grille could be any comparison to Joe's on the Boise River. This adventure has been amazing! The flavor and food was endless! Next time I will not forget the photo of the oysters. Rene at the bar slings great drinks and Robert was the perfect host for us first timers. We will definitely be back with friends!
Kendra was an awesome super attentive server. About time Boise got some crawdads and flavor! Definitely a good fix for missing home and not overpriced.

We dropped off our son's phone because we thought the charging port was broken. They said they would look at it the next day, but by the next evening they still hadn't looked at it. The following day they put a new battery in it and said that it needed a new battery and charging port. Then yesterday they call and say that the screen is broken and there are lines going across it. His screen had a tiny crack in it when we dropped it off. But there was nothing wrong with it. They said that a large amount of pressure had been put on the phone. It's obvious that when they opened the phone up they broke it and have an integrity issue. I obviously don't trust them to fix it, so I picked the phone back up yesterday afternoon and am taking it to someone else on state street to now fix the battery, charging port and screen.
I really appreciate the time involved to be personal with us humans that Pet Care Clinic provides. The prices are decent too!

I cannot say enough good things about SMS and their dedicated staff.  We took our two yellow Lab pups, Frannie and Charlie there last summer when they were 8 months old.  Our only regret was we didn't start them sooner!  We haven't missed a week yet of some sort of class or another.  Both have thrived with all the training and continue to learn through the specialty classes offered.  They both have recently finished advanced retrieve, and Charlie is about to go through the SMS Go Team therapy dog training this weekend.  I always like to remind dog owners,  you get out what you put in.  Just because you've paid for great training, it doesn't mean a thing if you don't work hard yourself with your dog to further their progress.  Devin, Ryan and all the other trainers give you the tools to make it happen.  Therefore, I highly recommend Sit Means Sit dog training!

I just picked up Panera about 15 minutes ago. Usually, this is my go-to. However, my salad dressing was 2 millimeters high (not even 1/4 full in the container) and my mango smoothie was full of ice chunks. This will be my last time giving this Panera some grace!
Cozy atmosphere and a very welcoming spot. Wonderful staff, amazing setting, and the food is absolutely amazing. Drink a latte or a glass of wine!

I have now dealt with this company twice , and they are above standard on both my visits , there is nothing worse than shattering your phone screen right ? Wrong . This company both times had me in and out with a new phone screen in less than two hours , location is right in all the shopping so it's easy to kill time while you wait for your repair , the staff both times were above average , friendly , knowledgeable people , great customer service , chatted with me about my toy collection ! If the manager that loves vintage tmnt reads this / I had the purple turtle not orange or I would have brought it to you lol !!!! , I highly recommend this spot for any phone repairs , at least start here before you go somewhere else
Anthony is an amazing barber and an even greater person. The conversation, the environment and the cut are all top level! Kid friendly and very clean shop!

This place and its owner is the real deal. Ryan is super cool and knowledgeable of all things bike and skate. He gives the type of service that all small business should emulate. It's a small and personal shop dedicated to a great buying experience. Exactly the way a bike shop should be run. Highly recommended.

If you're looking for a Bloody Mary/mimosa-style brunch, just don't. This is not the place for you. Both beverages are more tomato juice/orange juice with a hefty price tag attached, but I'm going to set that aside and review the food and service for now.

They have quite a big selection of savory/sweet options, which was nice. I was in the mood for sweet and ordered the Monte Cristo crepes. My partner ordered the lumberjack breakfast, complete with eggs, bacon, potatoes, and a short stack of chocolate chip pancakes. 

The wait time to be seated plus the wait for our food was a bit on the ridiculous side, but we didn't have anything pressing, so we waited, and waited, and waited. When the food came out, mine was pretty good. The crepes were assembled like a traditional Monte Cristo sandwich. I had to pick through the potatoes on the side, though, to avoid excessive crunch, and the garlic breadstick was completely unnecessary and went untouched. 

Half of my partner's dish was served at the same time. He started eating while waiting on the pancakes to be delivered. He described it as just "okay," but had the same issues with undercooked potatoes. The chocolate chip pancake was dropped off once we were pretty much done. He took a few bites, but the "short stack" was literally larger than his head. Seemed like kind of a waste. 

Overall, the extensive menu may work for families with a range of tastes, but the atmosphere and food quality weren't a match for ours.

After seeing some of the other reviews my expectations were neutral. Got the 12" Bomb and it was good. I agree there should be more flavor but throw some of your favorite hot sauce in, and it goes from good to really good. The bread was soft and the portions were good. Not sure if it's worth $12 but I will definitely be back to try a few of the others. Staff was friendly and prompt. You'll wait a few minutes to get your sandwich, but I don't mind an extra couple minutes when I can see fresh ingredients being cooked to order right in front of me.
Our family ate here for brunch and the food was delicious. More importantly we met the owner Aaron and his attitude along with our conversation was professional and much appreciated. Thank you!
Great experience.    Allison the server made our gluten free experience great.  Gloves changed and new product used.  Food fresh and tasty.
Love this place! The cubano sandwich and the jalapeño popper egg rolls are absolutely amazing! The people working were so friendly and made sure to take care of us.
Love this place they actually gave you a lot of seafood for what you pay for. A lot better than Joe's Crab Shack. I would totally come here again, And you get to meet the guy from the commercial.

Pet Care Clinic has been a wonderful experience for our family even through tough decisions. We decided to try another vet because our past experiences at another location have been poor.

Facility is clean and spacious. Nothing too exciting, but they do have several shopping areas if you are looking for pet supplies. The wait time was very short, but we did have an appointment. I'm not positive on walk-in time, or if they even allow it.

The Vet was thorough and sweet with our family. Explained things to use clearly and gave us options going forward. 

I will recommend this location to anyone who is looking for a small Vet location.
Been here a few times and was always a good experience. The coffee was delightful, the decor whimsical, and the service friendly. I love that they have a kids area that my daughter can hang out in

These guys came by the same day to diagnose my big screen TV. It needed a video board, they took it to their shop and returned it after a few days. Hooked it back up to the components and it works great!

Flying Pie is a family fun pizzeria, and the employees are the fun family. Their pizza is nearly unbeatable and the environment and staff are matched only by the other Flying Pie locations. If it's good pizza, good beer, and a good time that your looking for then Flying Pie is the place to be.

Awful business practices. My wife and I rented here for a year and a half and ended up ending our lease early to move out into a house. We were told there were no consequences to leaving early as long as we paid the fees. Four months later we received a letter from a collections agency that we were overdue on the move out fees (cleaning, repairs, etc) which we had already paid. Called Selway and they said they showed we paid but that they couldn't take out names off the collections report. Called the collections agency and provided them with all the information they needed. Selway told us that because we left early they automatically sent in our account to collections, even though we were all paid up. DO NOT RENT FROM HERE!!

I had Michael out to take a look at the hot tub at a home we purchased last fall. I had no idea if it worked or not, especially after the hard winter. He came out, assessed what I was working with, and got the spa turned on/tested things etc. He also talked me through a little bit of what I needed to do to maintain the spa. So far so good. I am still waiting to see if the heater is going to work (will take at least a day or so for the water to heat up), but I have clear directions from him regarding next steps in terms of draining, refilling, and treating once we confirm everything is running properly. So far, I am very pleased with Four Seasons Pool and Spa.
Disgusting breakfast burrito, by far the worst I have had in town. There was a 30 minute wait to get in, not sure why. I won't be back.

Came here on a Sunday around 1230 PM after reading all of the great reviews. We thought it would be much busier for a Sunday, but it was only us and a couple other tables. 

We ordered the Gunslinger, Treehugger, and The Benny. A little while after, the waitress let us know that the cook had messed up our order and combined the ingredients of the Gunslinger and the Treehugger. We decided to wait for them to correct it and 50 minutes after we originally ordered, we got our food. 

What made the situation worse was the service. Our waitress did bring us a complimentary cookie while we waited, but she didn't say anything to us when she dropped it off. She didn't refill our water or our coffee the whole time we were waiting, so we ended up going up to ask another waitress for a refill. We didn't make a big fuss about the wait while we were there, but it seemed like she was avoiding talking to us to avoid confrontation which made the situation so much worse. 

The food overall was good, but I don't think it's worth coming back again after this experience.

This is a great place to grab a bite! The staff is always friendly and they have a lot of different options so they can serve so many people. If you're diabetic, they have options for keeping it low carb, same with vegetarians! They have options for you as well! Chipotle just started offering Carne Asada (Mexican meat) which is very good! I recommend eating here!
Absolute worst place I have ever rented with. Stay away!!! All of these low reviews are absolutely accurate and what we have dealt with. They are a SCAM company!!
These guys do high quality work.  Their facility smells clean and fresh.... which says a lot about a meat packing place.

Don't waste your time or money eating here.  The so-called oyster basket had six fried little chunks of batter with very little oysters.  The bowl of clam chowder was a watered down bowl of potato pieces and maybe a couple of clams.  I was very disappointed with my meal, and will not go back.  I really hated to give them even one star.
Got food poisoning from this place yesterday. Anybody else?

LOVE.  This is by far the best toy store I have ever experienced.  Truly amazing selection, and knowledgeable staff that REALLY help you zero in on the best toys for your kiddos.  Unique toys that you won't find in big stores like Walmart or Target.  If you're stumped for a gift idea, you really must head to Toytown!!!
Fabulous store.  The staff were friendly and helpful as they helped me look for American made brands.  Walked out smiling with one adorable spring dress and an elegant maxi dress.  What a gem!

Rarely do I ever regret eating. Out of five people eating, nobody was very excited about the food they received. On a positive note the bloody Mary was excellent.
Brunch, is not super difficult to cook. Maybe the dishwasher was the only one in the kitchen, and he had to prepare all the meals. If that's the case hi 5 dish guy.

I had an amazing appointment today with Crystal. She did a root touch-up, partial highlights, a trim and texturizing. She did a phenomenal job. My hair looks amazing! I highly recommended Casa Bella to those who want a great experience and great hair.

I didn't know what to expect when I entered this restaurant. I had my expectations and I was pleasantly surprised. We ordered the meal for two which was a lobster, shrimp and clam boil. It came with potatoes and corn on the cob. We chose the hook & Reel sauce and made it firery. It was the most delicious seafood boil I've ever had. I would have given this 5 stars but the price was a bit too steep. $46.00 for 2 isn't outrageous but it could have been a little lower. I would highly recommend this restaurant. I plan on returning soon.

We tried to have lunch at this location and once again, a fail. It wasnt a food issue, we never stayed long enough to eat. It was a customer service issue. 4 registers, 1 person ringing up customers, and 3 other workers bumbling around behind the counter. Do these people not know that customers are what keeps the doors open? We waited at least 10 minutes. The person ringing up the other person was patiently dealing with an indecisive customer while these other people wandered around aimlessly. Needless to say we left and walked across the street to Qdoba.
Delicious and generous portions... only downside is they have no spam musabi... we've been here 3 times and plan to visit more!
So good! The cinnamon roll was warm and the cream cheese frosting was delicious! Its such a fun shop and we can't wait to go back!

Pricey for what you get. Better quality seafood elsewhere. Also, beware of garlic bread. Pretty terrible. I ordered fish and chips which was ok. My husband's shrimp basket was fine. But better competition nearly everywhere means I can just grant this place 1 star.

I have ordered 3 full-size sandwiches (each was a 'to-go order, and all were made at a time when there were zero customers in the store) in the last 13 days at the Meridian, Idaho location. ALL THREE sandwiches were made incorrectly and at EACH visit, I experienced incredibly poor customer service via the cashiers ~ ex: young, unprofessional, laying (yes, laying) on the cash register the entire transaction then delivering the sandwich saying "hope we got it right this time"). Paying $12 per sandwich (each order was the same, a simple BLT, without lettuce, add onion, and add provolone) is unfair to the customer when they are made incorrectly (missing ingredients, adding random non-ordered ingredients) every single time!!! Dismal...  
Oh, and don't bother to write to Jon Smith Subs Corporate ~ even though their website clearly states "WE WANT TO HEAR FROM YOU! Thank you for your interest in Jon Smith Subs. Please complete the form below and someone will respond to you within 24 hours."  I'm still waiting for their as promised 'within 24-hour reply', 8 days later.

I love this little location. They are in the corner of a strip mall, way at the end. Kind of like a hidden cove of coffee just on the outskirts of suburbia. For the most part, this location always has room. I have met with large groups and small a number times and each time there seems to be plenty of room. The coffee is pretty good and they have a wide variety of choices. Service has always been spot on. 

This place has the 90s written all over it and makes me feel like there should be a poetry night up in here now and then.

I'm clearly going to be in the minority with this review given Chipotle's cult like following but here goes: Cold and watery. That's my take on their burritos. Tried it twice, chicken the first time, pork the second. The outcome was similar...ice cold food and a soggy tortilla. The second time I returned to the front counter and asked if there was a way to warm up my burrito and the nice girl gave me a to-go container and said I'd probably have to warm it up at home. Very nice girl...poor response.  I know people love this place and this review is only for the two burritos I've tried but both experiences have been way less than spectacular.
This is the best fast food I've ever had in my life ! The building was very clean and well maintained! 10/10 recommend

This sonic I have been to twice now and will never go back. It's the worst sonic I've ever been to and I've been to a lot. The food was disgusting and tasted old. We ordered a lot too. I tasted everything my family got seeing if anything was good at all and none of it was. We ordered at 8:30 at night. Regardless, it should be more fresh and the burrito I got shouldn't have been hard and crispy. It was gross. My kids didn't even want to eat the food because of how gross it was.

I love Flying Pie and all the varieties. So glad Meridian has a Flying Pie. Flying Pie is a more expensive than your Pizza Hut or Dominos but you are getting better quality and well worth the extra $$$. Plus FFP has an awesome salad bar, too!!

AMAZING but must eat right away when they are fresh. 

They are all vegan & you would never know it. 
As delicious as they are- they are packed with sugar & can be overly sweet (I cannot finish one by myself). 

This is like a once or twice a year treat thing for me. 

Service is great!

Park Place Property Management has been almost impossible to deal with on several  occasions.  Lawn care maintenance is a mess, harassing neighbors, and they are just unwilling to be accommodating or flexible on anything. They make renting very hard and stressful. My property manager Autumn is rude to deal with and should take a lesson from Jamie on customer service.
Scott was fast, friendly, and efficient! I will visit him again when I need emissions testing. Highly recommended!

PPPM is the worst management co that I have ever rented from. For starters I rented the house for 9 years for which Pinnacle Properties managed it for 8 years 5 months. PPPM then took over management for the last 7 months that I lived there. I could never get a response to any maintenance requests or anything else. I wanted to move immediately but was told that I was being held to my lease although the lease was with Pinnacle. They came to do a walk through and tried to charge me 50 dollars because I have a dog. What does that have to do with a walk through? Upon move out I hired a cleaning co and paid them 350 dollars. They kept my 1050 dollar deposit and wanted 1000 more for cleaning and repairs. Things like 2 fence posts, a 15 year old refrigerator that had a broken shelf, trimming bushes, etc. The fence posts were as old as the house 1989. My advice would be to never rent from them but if you do take pics of everything because they will try to rip you off

My friend and I tried this restaurant today.  We shared the sampler plate, everything was amazing.  The chicken and pork were my favorite.  This was an amazing experience service was good, food amazing, dining area clean, and it was reasonably priced.  You got to try it

If I could give this place negative stars, I would! Run, don't walk away from this place as fast as you can.
From the beginning. I was promised to be able to move in,  and on the day I was supposed to move in the apartment was not ready. The cleaning lady was cleaning my apartment as I was moving my stuff in, and the manager couldn't even be bothered to be in the office when I showed up to get the key. I had to wait. NO HOURS were posted on their website or on their leasing office.
Next issue was the leaking windows in the dining room. In the rain, the water came right in from the structure of the window/apartment. I called and was told it wasn't an emergency and they would get to it when they could. It took several emails and about 3 months to get the issue 'fixed'. If you look, you can see where the entire back side of the unit was already re-stuccoed once for structural issues and the windows that were fixed again the stucco is simply grey. They didn't even bother to try and make it look like they care. With the crappy patch job that is already cracking, I am sure the windows will leak again. When they told me it wasn't an emergency, that is fine too. It is their walls with water running down them, onto the hardwood floor, and into the HVAC system. Not mine.

Then there was the issue of the neighbors above me moving out and leaving boxes under the stairwell. A few days later I got a nasty letter on my door threatening me with 3-day eviction if I did not immediately clean up under the stairwell. I sent an email back to the management informing me that if they want to threaten me with eviction to be sure to at least know whose property is under the stairs.

Then when it came time to inform them of breaking my lease because I was moving into a house that was being built they wanted to not only keep my security deposit but an additional $1500 for maintenance and cleaning fees since I was breaking my lease early. They won't work with you. 

They will also charge you each time you use your bank account or credit card to pay rent. They do not accept checks and you have to do it through their online payment portal. I cannot recommend this property management group to anyone. Terrible, unprofessional, and out to take your money any way they can.

If you do decide to be duped by this place, be sure you read up on Idaho real estate law and know your renters rights! Park Place Property Management will take full advantage of you!
Ermina is a wonderful hairdresser.  I recommend her for cut, color and Brazilian Blow Outs.

I've eaten at the flying pie pizza places for years/decades. The one on Fairview is my preferred but I don't get all the low comments on the Meridian place. Great pizza with lots of other food and lot of specials.  Mostly take out from Meridian, but still just as good as the other outlets.

My 2-month-old daughter & myself were recently seen here.  Our insurance changed, so our primary care doctors changed, too, & we were assigned to doctors at this location.  I have had a great experience here so far.  I've had two appointments for myself & one for my daughter & every time, I've been very happy.

When we arrived for our first appointment, I was informed of where the coffee, tea, and water, bathroom, and specific waiting room could be found by the receptionist - I didn't ask for that information, so I was very impressed.  The receptionist was also very friendly & greeted us with a warm smile.  We were seen on time, something which has rarely happened anywhere else, which I appreciated.  

The only doctor we have seen so far is Autumn Freeland.  She has been super friendly & very knowledgeable and her nurse is nice & funny!  I want to say her nurse's name is Tammi, but I'm upset with myself for not being 100% about that...I love that the people here actually have a bedside manner.  Dr. Freeland does speak rather quickly, but hey, she gives me all of the information I need & it seems to allow her to see her patients on time, so no complaints there!  She always makes sure to ask if I have any questions & answers them thoroughly, if I do.  

All of the staff here has been really playful & great with my daughter.  Shots are no fun, but they get them done quickly.  They were also very helpful & offered to hold her or do certain things with her to help me out during my portion of the appointment.

Dr. Freeland knew exactly which tests to do to determine the issue with my wrists.  Within a minute or two, she identified the issue & was able to refer me to a specialist.

I am very happy here.  There has been ample parking & I think that it is conveniently located.

I brought my wife and kids for breakfast - we all loved it!  I haven't been to Le Peep since I was in Atlanta over 20 years ago and it's as good or better now, and I loved it then.  The restaurant has a great feel and the food is still fantastic!  If you want a go-to breakfast spot that will always over-deliver, Le Peep is it.  Give it a try and you'll see why we love it so much.

We ate here on a Friday evening. The food was delicious, but a but on the pricey side. The menu is diverse with a variety of unique dishes.  We tried the maple bacon peanuts as a appetizer.  Our party of six (including 2 picky eating kids) enjoyed our meals.  My husband had the elk dish. It was quite good. I had the salad that included prime rib.  It was as delicious as others colorful.  My parents both had the salmon and it looked quite tasty.

My kids enjoyed the cheese burger sliders and mac and cheese.

Overall I think the food was unique and delicious. We didn't sample the beers, however the huckleberry mojito sounds good.  

We plan on dining again as there were so  many dishes we wanted to try that we couldn't decide what to have!

Two weeks ago I put in an application to rent a townhome in Meridian after I viewed it. I have called and emailed their business repeatedly to ask about it and other rentals. Still no reply. How is this business still making money??
Sooooo good! I got a steak burrito and I can't wait to go back. The employees were very fast and friendly. My only complaint is that the restaurant was dirty.

Jennifer just sugared my chacha.. I am amazed at how easy and quick it was compared to regular waxing. It was also considerably less painful. 

Jennifer was really nice and pleasant to speak with. The location was a little strange (enter through the backside), but it was new and nice. 

Overall I am so excited and pleased with the end result.

Wandered into Hook. & Reel on a sunday afternoon... Grew up on the east coast and in the south so we're partial to good seafood, especially cajun style. We were so pleasantly surprised with how good and fresh-tasting the food was for being a seafood place in Boise! It's so hard to find good seafood here, so happy we've found a spot for a little taste of home.

My family has been doing business with Quick Computer repair for quite some time. Approx 6 years. Today my mother ( who is 79 ) picked up the computer she had cleaned out and repaired. Even with the 6 months that these folks had guaranteed it cost her $49.00. The technicians were rude and talked down to her. Now my mom is very active and her faculties are in tip top shape. She enjoys reading the news and sending E-Mails to friends all over the United States. She was left with one of the technicians telling her "maybe you should not use the computer anymore". I will not be back. I will tell everyone I know about this experience. Maybe they were having a bad day. What I do know is this. Your rudeness to a 79 year old woman is inexcusable. Shame on you. Jeff Brennan

This is a very solid West Boise breakfast spot. If I'd have written this review a couple of years ago I wouldn't have been as kind but they've really upped their game over the last couple of years.

The food here is staple American breakfast food. Eggs, bacon, sausage, pancake, toast, etc. But, they do it all very well. Eggs are always cooked the way you like them, the coffee is fresh and they even leave a pot behind so you don't have to wait for your refill. They also have a very nice seasonal menu full of great foods.

The pancakes here are very good, definitely worth ordering and my daughter likes their waffle as well. I'm not a fan of their home fries, they are always a bit chewy and tough for my liking.

The staff here is top notch, they are always friendly, remember you and really try to provide a great experience (one of the things that has really improved over the past couple of years). I often go here alone and sit at the bar and the service is every bit as good at the bar as anywhere in the restaurant.

Le Peep is a great place for breakfast meetings as well as Sunday brunch. I need to try it for lunch but always end up there for breakfast. I'll update my review when I finally get around to lunch.

Service was terrible and the employees were more concerned with hanging out with each other than helping guests. It took almost an hour to get our pizza and it wasnt even busy. To top it off it wasnt completely cooked. Will not go back, it didnt live up to the hype for me and it was expensive for pizza.

Very helpful with helping me lose weight and knowledgeable about what I need to do differently for the success I want. Would recommend if your eating healthy and exercising and not seeing the results you want.

Clean, classy and good service.  The salon sent me a text message to remind me of the appointment the day before and then when I paid they sent me my receipt through text too.  A girlfriend of mine and I had manicures done; super happy with the service.

I've been here a few times now and overall I like this place a lot! So yummy!! Loved the food and atmosphere. The only negatives I would share are that I wish they had a full bar (which i was told is in the works) and most of the servers have been great but some, not so good :/ Their were some that I've had that just seemed new at their job, or with serving all together. Maybe some more training is needed. Like I said, overall I enjoy this place and most definitely will be back!
I go to this chipotle every week and I am always satisfied with the service and how clean it is! I definitely recommend it to anyone who wants food quickly without the fast food feel!

On July 24th I took my car in for an oil change. We were visiting from California. We were told we could have a free tire rotation. I agree to that. While waiting for the service to be completed the service manager came up to me and said "we need to get a better tool for those lug nuts, they're a real  problem". When I got back on the road heading to California I looked and the lug nuts were stripped. Five of them were no longer any good. The worst part is they never told me that they stripped my lug nuts. I would not recommend this place.

I have rented for over 25 years, and have found the four years of being a tenant of Park Place Property Management to be the most frustrating and negative experience I've ever had.  The incidents below are only examples:
- Maintenance appointments were frequently missed because "we printed the wrong address on the work order," or "the person's truck broke down and we didn't know," or "our computer system crashed so we didn't know what address to go to."  And no notification of the situation or apology was given.  
- It took me over a month and numerous calls to finally get a large fallen half-a-tree laying across my outside back porch removed. PPPM sent four different companies to handle it before they finally figured out they needed one that could actually remove a tree.  
- The first two years the sprinkler system worked great.  After PPPM blew it out and then restarted it the third year, all the valves started leaking, the system didn't cover the full yard, sometimes the system couldn't be turned off.  I made numerous calls for assistance.  Technicians kept patching up one valve at a time. The system still isn't working right.  
- One month I received a letter sternly telling me that PPPM would no longer accept rent payments in advance.  As I have never done that, I called, and it turned out that the balance was an incorrect $25 late fee they had charged me that needed to be refunded.  They told me to come to their Meridian office to pick up the check.  I was in Salt Lake City supporting my partner who was in the University of Utah Burn Unit for 50 days.  I asked PPPM if they could simply mail me the check.  The answer was no.  
- I wanted to keep my furnance filters changed, and asked at every semi-annual inspection where the furnance was.  It took two years (five inspections) before finally one technician discovered it was upstairs off the back porch.

I have lived in Idaho for over a year now, and had yet to find the right stylist for myself. Lucky for me, I seem to have found her at Casa Bella Salon & Spa! I had the pleasure of working with Marnie today. I'm getting married in two weeks and was nervous about having a new (to me) stylist dye/highlight my hair. But! I have to say Marnie was just so friendly, easy to talk to, and really made me feel comfortable. I showed her photos of what I wanted and she got down to the specifics of what I liked about the look.  She also helped me better understand the look I wanted, and how we could make it work with the color I already have in my hair. It turned out absolutely perfect. I love the contrasts of color and it's just so clean and soft. She did a great job of listening to what I wanted, and working with me, I felt comfortable with her before she even put anything in my hair. I will definitely be going back! Thanks Marnie!

Super fun place. Well staffed. Pay one price for all day , as many hours you want to stay. Many types of activities, trampolines, ball pit, sky rider, climbing walls, laser tag, ropes course, slides, mini golf. So much to do. Kids played for over six hours, they had a ball. Add a parent pass for only six bucks. Great deal.

We took our 10 mo old Havanese Max for his first scissor cut today. Previously we had him in for a bang trim and Samantha did a great job so we had him
Back to Samantha for his first scissor cut and couldn't be happier. Thank you Samantha

I made an appointment based off of good yelp reviews and was referred to Danielle at the salon. I have to say she was amazing!! She did a wonderful highlight and superb cut which isn't easy on my thick curly/frizzy hair. I highly recommend her and am so happy to have found my stylist!!

Heather is an exceptional provider, very professional and knowledgable. I had never experienced nerve pain, and it took a few months of discomfort before I sought her services. She had me feeling better almost immediately, along with providing me great alternatives to traditional pain medication. The office is a lovely little oasis, and Brenda at the front desk couldn't be nicer to work with.

So good! Got a massage appointment the same day for two of us. Tech was polite, professional and communicated well. The place is nice inside and clean. I was able to enjoy the service and will be back again.

Rented a trail sled for the day.  Everyone there was super friendly and explained everything in detail.  Very reasonably priced and the guy that checked the sled in and out was a super friendly guy.  They had 2019 equipment I will rent again.

What fantastic service and food. They make you feel so welcomed here. Atmosphere wonderful and clean. I had Grandpas Biscuits and gravy, came back the next day and had CEC's protein breakfast. Perfect amount. Going back for a third time this week incognito.

Had hook and reel for lunch today, and it was wonderful.
The service was as good as the seafood. They were so attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed.
The seafood is delicious, too. I have been waiting for this location to open, and it was well worth it! Their original Cajun sauce is absolutely delicious. Just a little heat, and went so well with the crab. 
No bar quite yet, but we will be back to try drinks with dinner very soon.
And thanks for the shrimp chips!

Sooooo happy to have a local shop that caters to Freeriding/Downhilling!  Ryan, one of the owners has been so awesome to me in helping me find a bike that is perfect for me.  Really down to earth people who just want everyone to have fun no matter what level of riding they are at.  Not like the vibe you get from some of these other bike shops...

Just to speak a bit about the bikes they sell...  The "Intense" bikes are plush! I demo'd their M16 full carbon and it was a blast.  Such a quiet bike and so solid on the jumps, turns, and through the rock gardens.  I put it to the full test to riding Rally Cat, Drop Kick, and Double Down at Canyons Bike Park.  

The only negative is that they are in Meridian and I live in Eagle, haha.  I just wish they were closer for my own selfish purposes. 

Lastly, I'll just say that this isn't just a bike shop.  They have a riding team of varying ages.  They help out at the Eagle Bike Park, and they have done a bunch of work with the trails at Tamarack.  Truly doing positive things for the community.

Thanks Kore North for all you do.  Recommending you to all my friends.

What to say about the most incompetent, inept, deceitful and most ignorant in property management I've ever delt with. The tenants all complained of poor response for maintenance as well and when they did respond the quality and detail of the job was severely lacking. When you call PPPM you're lucky if they answer and when they do you're transferred to another recording. Very frustrating. Along with current rent rolls that they didn't keep up with and several tenants had expired leases with very low rent. As an owner you'd expect they would keep the rent at market value for their income as well as the owners. Wrong !!  Enough on ragging  on these inept moronic Boisians.
