STAY AWAY FROM THESE GUYS !!
I'm sure this is all why they have a 1 star rating

Been living in the apartment complex for 3 years. All of a sudden i get a message on my door telling me i was speeding and threatening letter to take a way my parking spot. For over 3 years I've been driving the same speed limit. All the management does is send me a message that came across very disgraceful. I guess this apartment complex can careless and not ask me questions about the situation. Or even figure out if they have the same person.  They should spend more time giving fines out to people for not picking up their dog poop. Or having kids not run up and down the breeze way cause loud disturbances in the apartments. I have also asked multiple times to get my bath tub fixed due to it dripping and raising my water bill, but i always get the response "the equipment they need to fix it is on order". The complex also can't handle the amount of waste people dispose of, but yet they still raise sewer prices every month. I encourage anyone who lives here or is looking to renew the lease to read the lease agreement and keep options open.  Also I'm not the type to complain about stuff but this  is the icing on the cake. If anybody has any question feel free to reach out to me. I'll provide my personal experience.

We were in the neighborhood and dropped in for a bite. The atmosphere is fun with very animated staff who keep things lively. The process is: you grab a seat, take a look at the menu, place your order at the counter, and either pick up your pizza or they will bring it to the table. Pretty much self serve.
The menu has a lot of offerings. We decided on the 10" customized pizza which serves 2 amply. We ordered the cheese pizza with sun-dried tomatoes, mushrooms, with half pepperoni, half linguisa sausage. 
The pizza arrived piping hot with a lot of toppings. I wish I could say that it tasted as good as it looked. The crust was bland (needs salt and maybe seasonings), there was too much mozzarella cheese that became rubbery in a few minutes, and the sun-dried tomatoes were tart instead of sweet. I really couldn't tell that there was sausage on the pizza because it too was a bit bland.
The price wasn't bad for a custom pizza. But I'll file this one under "average."

This shop is near my house so that is what brought me there. I was in need of only one replacement tire and the size was unusual and the shop didn't have one on site. It's 1:30PM. I was helped by Brad and after he learned my need to have this tire same day, he went well above and beyond to help make this happen for me. I got my tire back at 4:00PM. I couldn't be more happy with the service I received and they have earned my loyalty for tire purchases in the future. Thanks again Brad

Went to Dirty Harry's in Meridian on March 2, 2019.  The drive-thru machine took my $5.00 but the car wash wouldn't start.  Wouldn't return my money.  Can't reach anyone at posted phone numbers because 'mailbox is full".  How can I get my money back??

I recently had to move states, before doing so I came into axiom with my outrageous $150 cancellation fee so that I can get out of my extremely overpriced membership. Paid my fees and left. 5 months later I get a letter in the mail from their collections agency with a $500 bill inside. When I called in I was told there was no manager I could talk to so the front desk was as far as I got. Almost 2 days go by until I finally get an email back from the assistant manager saying the cancellation was never filed and she gave me the agencies number. Possibly a 2 sentence reply is all that I got. This place sucks! If you ever decide to get a membership keep clear documentation of everything on the account, I didn't and it may end up costing $650 by the time it's all over....

We ordered food Togo the reel catch for $46 and on my gosh it was everything I thought it was an more!! Got the 2lobster tails 1lb crawfish and 1lb black mussels hook and reel blend sauce and the spiciest you can get and it was fantastic! After my fiancé and I ate the ENTIRE meal I looked at him and said we have to eat there again! Looking forward to actually dining in the restaurant next time! Our wait time for Togo order was quoted 15min and they were spot on. WAY TO GO!
I love this place! They are so good to my dog. They are always happy to see him and he comes back clean and happy. I love the service and know that my dog is in great hands. Brutus loves you guys!

I accidentally showed up on preview day and was turned away at the door. It was awkward and embarassing. Apparently others had a better experience that day. Yesterday I tried again. I used the drive through and tried to order one of their everyday soups, Baked Potato. "I'm sorry we don't have that today" Uh, isn't this an everyday soup? "Sorry" So I ordered a cup of chicken noodle, a broth bowl for my husband. I asked specifically if their soups came with bread. I was assured that each entree I ordered came with bread. Of course when I got home there was no bread to be found. The chicken soup was pretty good, the broth bowl was just so so. For the prices they were charging I guess I expected a little better food and a lot better service. I would like to note that the girl who took my money was very sweet and apologetic about not having the potato soup.
Not the gym you want. Dishonest. Will continue to bill you after you cancel despite them telling you they won't.

A cool little place with some great pub food. Reasonable prices and good atmosphere. The reason it gets a poor rating is the service. Unfortunately we get the same waitress "the only one " every time we go. Very unfriendly, slow, and if you're not a regular, your pretty much on your own after the food arrives. I may go back, but if I see the same waitress, I'll go somewhere .

We used park place to manage our property. Our experience was awful not only was our property manager rude she never once contacted us, not even to tell us they had found a tenant. They like to take our money but not offer any management services. We live out of town from our property and had to not only manage it but also park place. DO NOT use them you will be very disappointed they will NEVER call you back!!!!

This a small Yogurt place.  Been in Meridian for 10 years and have seen about a dozen or do of these places come and go.  Two young teenage girls counting the time until closing while mostly female customers try to figure out what flavor they want.  It doesn't take much for a big guy like me to feel intimated by two or more ladies shuffling between sampling flavors.  Made the mistake of ordering Apple Pie.  Not for me.  The topping and sauces are what you would find at any yogurt place.   The clincher for me at all of these places is that no matter how little or how much I fill my cup, it always seems to weigh the same.  Can't figure that out.  How is possible that I fill my cup half way and my daughter fills her to the top with pineapple gummies and both weigh the same. Defies logic. No offense to Menchies but that's happened to me at all the yogurt places.  Sorry I rather have coldstone and go to the gym.  At least there's no mystery to how much I am getting.

The service was nothing like it used to be when the previous stag of graphic designers were operating out of there.  The guy in charge was a prick, and was really frustrated with me  asking questions; aren't you supposed to ask questions before buying something.  They've gone downhill.  I say it's a bad spite for businesses looking for a well rounded printer to service them.  Two stars tops.

What a great new coffee, breakfast joint in downtown Meridian. Best eggs benne I've had in awhile. The hollindase was perfecto.  The service was friendly and helpful in a nice way. The atmosphere is more comfy than the institutional places, leaning more toward a really great coffeehouse, and they serve wine too! So I'm going back in the late afternoon to check that out. Great job, I'm bringing my wife in for a special occasion date.

Delicious! We loved everything! Excellent Mac salad and rice! The chicken, pig, shrimp, and katsu was tasty! The shrimp was probably my favorite. You HAVE to get the cake! It is so smooth, rich, and creamy! My husband enjoyed his soda there from the stand. The restaurant is open and bright. The decor and color theme is simple for comfort. Very spotless and clean environment. All the staff was super friendly and courteous. They were happy to answer all questions and showed us all our options multiple times. There's great options for kids here as well. We will definitely be back!

A brand new Meridian establishment, Barrel 55 has taken over the old On The Border restaurant. Not only have they remodeled, but they have easily become our go-to spot for draft beers and DELICIOUS, and I mean DELICIOUS food. We sure loved OTB, but boy do we now love B55! 

Food: We tried two items on the menu, the Lunch Burger and the Country Salad. We didn't make any modifications and just wanted to see what came out. The burger, as my husband says, is the BEST burger he's had in town. It was thick, prepared the way he likes it, and the bun was so fluffy and good. The fries alongside it were seasoned perfectly. Yum! I had the country salad, and it was a good portion with an awesome piece of chicken on top. It felt very healthy since the dressing wasn't too heavy and also had a crunchy crustini underneath... what a surprise for a salad! I would definitely order it again. We also had the Japanese Cotton Cake, which is like a hybrid between cheesecake and angel food cake. It wasn't too heavy and was absolutely delicious! 

Drinks: Awesome draft beer and awesome prices! Hard alcohol, ciders, wines... they have everything. 

Atmosphere: It no longer feels like OTB in there. They've made it wood-y and black, making it feel like a neighborhood brew-house. Their patio was our all-time favorite, so to get to enjoy it again as a new restaurant is a true treat. 

Service: They've only been open a week, so we won't cause too much of a fuss, though the service was a little slow. However, we went during lunch so they did seem short-staffed. I'm sure it's better at busier times! 

Happy Hour Offerings: Sun - Thurs 4-6... drink specials, $2 off all appetizers and other food specials, too! 

Healthy Hack: Try the country salad or ask for the soup of the day! 

Tips: Ask the server for their preference... they have such a fun and interesting menu!

Husband and wife own this store and treat you very well.  Had my kitchen knives sharpened and ended up with a $500. Folding knife. Lol

Great selection of kitchen knives and pocket knives.  Very honest and informative if your looking for a good set.  Clearly tell you what the best for the money is.

I chose Casa Bella because it has such great reviews so I was disappointed to find out the reason they have such high accolades is because some of the stylist offer 20% off if you rate them well. My highlights/low lights ended up the front being dark brown, and the back honey blonde? Like a color mullet. The next day after I styled it and realized how silly it looked I went back and was told that I would have to contact my stylist directly to see if she would fix it for free. Oh AND she was on vacation and wouldn't be back for a week. You would think after paying $150 the manager would be willing to have someone other than the person that messed it up, fix it for me.

I had an issue with my furnace.  Called Access, they sent a technician out the same day!  The tech, Jeff, has been out to service my HVAC system in the past.  He is extremely professional.  You can tell he is very knowledgeable and it gives you comfort knowing your heating & air are in good hands when you call Access!
Absolutely the best groomers. Been to PetSmart all these years, but found my new favorite spot!

I bought the groupon.  Big mistake.  Reception was friendly, but the massage was horrible!  The massage therapist did not use fluid hand movements and was just jabbing the tips of her fingers into my back.  It was very painful, and the whole 45 minutes I was wondering if I should get up and leave.     

At times she would only be using one hand to massage, and I could hear her scratching her head and thought she was looking at her phone.

The day after the massage 3 bruises showed up on my back, and one on my foot.   My back has been hurting ever since the massage- maybe that's how they get people in to the chiropractor next...

Not happy with the experience AT ALL.
Brenda was so helpful when I called to order flowers for my Daughter-in-law.  The bouquet was beautiful and the service was excellent.

This place was just OK,  forgot my sons order and did not get it to him until everyone else was finished.  Food was good, but not great, at this price point I guess I would prefer a higher class establishment.  $100+ lunches and paper table cloths are not a combination that really excites me .

Pizza here is pretty good. The first time I ever tried it was better than the second time. The employees look fun and enthusiastic. Overall it's pretty good. Their salad bar is delicious and I highly recommend it. The wait is about 25 minutes but it's worth it. I wish they had more choices for fountain drinks. Prices are ok. Just like any other pizza place.
Food ok but over priced. Nothing special. Four seafood lovers went here and we won't  be going back.
Steve and his team did a great job. I especially appreciated him coming late in the season when I realized the service I've used in the past skipped me. Professional, friendly, and great service!

these guys are great, you bring in your pool water, they poor it into their machine, give you a print out and sell you the necessary stuff with out over selling you. they have a very pleasant and knowledgeable staff. it's nice to have this service on this side of town.

Pro: The lobby is clean and there's always a friendly receptionist to greet you and she will ask you if you need anything while you are waiting. There are also spa related products to peruse through if your smartphone is not keeping you entertained. When  I first started coming here I was seeing Katherine who is super amazing. So amazing that is always booked months in advance. And I'm instant gratification kinda girl so I always like to schedule last minute. Over the years, I have seen many different masseuse and masseur and they are all just as amazing. They have one male massage therapist. I have to admit, I was little apprehensive at first but like all the other times I got a massage there, I fell asleep during and woke myself up snoring. Another plus is they keep records of your visits, why you were there last time (neck pain? back pain?) and if you like firm massages or not. 

Con: Did I mention they keep records of your visit? When they say "You saw so and so last time you were here" I feel like I just got caught cheating. I"m not going to ding them a star for it because they never make me feel bad. It's just all in my head. 

So if you need pain massaged away, don't hesitate to give them a call.
Fun.  Great for all ages.  Diverse activities.  Good food. No time restrictions! Will trade you socks from other places like circus trix. Yay

Ordered the turkey apple Brie grilled cheese the first one I got hardly had any Bree on it so I sent it back got another one and hardly had any free on it so it wasn't really a grilled cheese it wasn't anything exciting at all I would never order it again. Their french fries were very good
Nothing about Le Peep is unforgettable... Nothing on their menu stands out, nothing that they make is extraordinary... The food is to the equivalent of IHOP

Been coming here off n on for two years  pretty good hot drinks & RedBull too to choose from. I would just wish the girls that work there would be a little bit more attentive to customers and not there cellphones or their looks at the moment.  Place is always neat and tidy.

Man this store is fun to look at, but their customer service is HORRIBLE! I went in to It's Sugar last night with my husband. I saw 2 associates working, we were greeted by the first one with a warm "Hello."... so i thought this would be fun! It all went down hill from there.... We walked around to look at the Harry Potter candy's and drinks that they are. After about 5 minutes of the other associate talking to some guy, that was obviously not a customer, I was able to ask about pricing. Their butter beer is $3.99 a bottle!!!! WHAT?? They are also sold in a 4 pack and by the case, but there are no discount for buying a large quantity. Their bulk is $13.96 a pound which is crazy for gummy bears! They did have some cool "giant" fun gifts, like a huge heresy syrup bottle coin bank and 5 pound gummy bears. Overall... this store is not at all worth going back too unless they amp up there customer service.

All of the employees at the Cherry Lane store are PHENOMENAL. They always remember my name, what I order, where I work. It's a small gesture, but to someone like me who gives $50 a week to the company, it means a lot.
Great drinks, great bar-food, great staff (Shelley, Mayhem, Rene and Pam), great karaoke!  Safe, good crowd, easy parking.  Nothing more to be said!

We had it on our list to try since they opened. We decided it was going to be our last date night of 2019. Good choice!

We got there around 730 and only waited 5-10 minutes for a table. The tables are covered with paper and you're provided a plastic lined bucket. They also provide gloves, bibs, and wet naps. The big draw of the food is basically a seafood boil. You choose your proteins, sauce, and heat level. 

After an appetizer of his puppies (my bf wasn't a fan but he hadn't had them before), our dinner was brought out. It comes out in a bag which they open and dump into what looked like a round cake pan. It all looked good. 

We chose shrimp - with the heads removed, calamari, and snow crab legs, with their special sauce. The shrimp was good, though be prepared to shell them. The calamari was meh. I didn't care for the texture. I don't normally eat crab, but the crab legs were my favorite. There were also two small red potatoes and some corn, but we didn't really touch those. 

Overall the food was good. Even mild had a good amount of heat to it, as expected with Cajun food. Reminded me of New Orleans. We'll definitely be back. Service was kinda slow but everything is slower in New Orleans so that wasn't a worry at all.

We've been to a couple of the other Flying Pie's around the valley, and this one does not live up to the name.  The service was slow, the restaurant was a mess, the table wasn't clean, the A/C was out (or non-existent), and the pizza was just OK.  It is sad to say that you can't simply trust the Flying Pie name.

I love this store! I found so many cool & cute stuff here for Christmas presents! They have everything for a wide range of ages. 
The size of this store is unbelievable!  It's kind of nice to go shopping where you won't get elbowed from other shopper!
I will definitely come back!

The kids have fun but if they had to wait in a line for 15 minutes just to get in or get a water/beverage/food like their parents it might lower the fun meter. Lots of staff but most seem to be standing around not really knowing what to do. They also need more seating for parents in the main area & the parent lounge is a joke. Our drinks were thrown away because we used a table that was empty from an earlier party...5 icee's at $2.75 each and only half gone thrown in the trash. We would have used another table but there are none. It could be a lot better for those of us that aren't here for a bday party.

We are SO happy that we found this place and our groomer Andrew. Andrew does the best job on our dog. Ralphy always looks so "styled" after his visit to see Andrew. Many groomers just cut the hair short and then he looked shaved and strange. Now he always looks like he has a well thought out cut. Highly recommend Andrew if you are a picky client

Thought we would try this Taco Bell again. 10 minutes in the drive thru, cold food and the food tasted old. It was so gross. I now drive to the one off of eagle which is way farther because this one is so awful. It's disappointing we have to waste gas if we ever want a burrito without hard beans or to get warm food. I really hope they figure their crap out soon.
We had grilled steak sandwiches. We thought they were great. The steak was yummy and lean. No waste meat.

Chicken quesadilla is super dry, the chocolate chip cookies are poor quality, and the soup was salty and of poor make. The only decent quality is that it was clean, and the waitress tried to help out.
Good pizza, our pizza was forgotten about so we waited over an hour for pizza but otherwise good. Good selection of pizzas and drinks.

We had a group of 12 for dinner tonight. I had the elk meatloaf special. Others at our table had the prime rib, ribeye, finger steaks, fish & chips and the Barrel 55 burger. Everyone  enjoyed our meals. The service was good, and the bar selections were wonderful. We'll be back.

Le Peep is le poop.  By far NOT the self-proclaimed "The Best Breakfast Food In the World"...(again, self-proclaimed, because you won't hear anyone else saying it). You would be better off traveling an extra mike or two and go to Moe Joe's (the best breakfast), or Steve's Cafe (2nd best) or Joe Mommas. Don't waste your time at Le Poop!

I gave this place 3 tries. I, like a previous poster, was met with total apathy from the management.

First try: Ordered: 2 eggs scrambled, bacon and hashbrowns. Received:The eggs were watery, the bacon burnt, and the hashbrowns were pasty-white. Management comment: "We are still new and trying to get the hiccups out. Order the hashbrowns crispy if you want the browned."

Second try:Ordered: 2 eggs over easy (can't mess up, right? No water to mix in), corned beef hash, and "crispy" potatoes. Received: 2 eggs over well, blackened corned beef hash from a can, and potatoes so over-cooked you couldn't stab them with a fork. I called the waitress over to look at the meal. She took the plate back, and returned with 2 eggs over medium...and the rest of the food still there (now cold). She only replaced the eggs! Management comment: "The potatoes are frozen and deep fried, so if you order them crispy they come out inedible. Next time order the hashbrowns.". Nothing about the corned beef or the eggs.

Third try (only because a friend wanted to go): Ordered: the crepes special with fresh fruit. (can't go wrong here, right? (no offer of something else. aka: suck it up) Management comment:" Many people love our crepes. I guess you are too picky:

In synopsis: The food is mostly FROZEN,CANNED or pre-packaged. NOT FRESH ingredients!

Wish I could leave a comment for the comment left by the owner. But I can't so I'll leave it as an an edit to the original.

My husband and I went to Illuminate on Saturday, July 13th, and we weren't completely sure what we were getting into. Jay, my husband, has extremely sensitive teeth and was really nervous about doing it because he has had poor whitening experiences in the past. The woman that was there (we can't remember her name, sorry!) explained everything very thoroughly and assured him that she would do everything in her power to make his experience a positive one. She definitely exceeded our expectations! Our entire experience from start to finish was great. She applied the desensitizing gel, which we both highly recommend getting, and started the three-twenty minute sessions. She was very attentive the entire time and made sure we were comfortable. The results are incredible! Jay had fairly stained teeth and his results are remarkable. My teeth weren't as stained but my teeth went several shades whiter as well. We had a little sensitivity after but it went away by the end of the day. We highly recommend this business!

Overall, light 3. Definitely not the worst place I've had breakfast, but certainly not the 5 star experience like everyone previously mentioned.

Cinnabon has already proven an entire store based on cinnamon rolls can work.  

But wait! This place has added a twist - toppings! It's kind of like the Menchie's or Cold Stone of cinnamon rolls. All the cinnamon rolls are the same flavor and actually pretty bland all by themselves. But throw on a flavored frosting and BAM! Amazeballs. I had amaretto frosting with bananas and caramel, also known as the bananas foster roll. Once I recovered from the mouthgasms that came like tidal waves after the first bite I plowed through most of the rest and promptly fell into a diabetic coma. OK not really, but seriously...HALF of one of these is sufficient for a person. It was rich and delicious and uber sugary sweet. Let's not even get into the number of calories one of them might have. 

BONUS: The cinnamon rolls themselves are vegan. Yeah, I said vegan as in no animal products. And the palm oil they use is sustainable. So now I can raise my blood sugar, add another quarter inch to my waist size, ruin my appetite for dinner AND be earth conscious! There really is a god somewhere, and he or she is smiling down upon me. 

Pricing is pretty reasonable in comparison to the copay for your insulin shot after this. One bun will run $6-8 depending on the number of toppings you get but Tuesday is 10% off day so we got a little bit of a break on it.

My husband got chocolate frosting with chocolate syrup and chocolate sprinkles (he likes chocolate). We also got a mini bun for our daughter with just plain frosting and she loved it. It's a little big for kid-sized but then again, we're pretty conservative with her sugar so maybe it's normal size and I don't see it. 

The only down side is there is no seating inside. You have to be outside and the time of day we were there the sun was beating down on the tables and chairs outside. There was no shade. Someone throw shade. Please. :D

My wife, daughter and I had just come from Grimaldis, our favorite pizza place, when we saw Cinnaholic.

I love Cinnamon so I suggested that we try this. I had no idea what it was from a distance but assumed that it must be some sort of desert. 

We entered Cinnaholic and looked around. I saw a few displays of Cinnamon rolls, so this made me happy. I love Cinnamon rolls, but right off, in my mind, I could see and taste the ones from Cinnabon so I knew this place would have an uphill battle.  

Like so many people around Boise, I am very familiar with Cinnamon rolls from Cinnabon, and so is my wife and daughter. They eat there a lot!

When you walk into Cinnabon, you smell lots of Cinnamon and hot fresh rolls. 

I love a fresh hot roll!

Who doesn't, right?

So I expected this or better. After all, this was the name sake of the store, so its a requirement they have to deliver on, right?

Cinnaholics claim to fame is that they make "Gourmet Cinnamon Rolls". You start off with the actual cinnamon roll, then add on toppings. They have a lot of these toppings, which is supposed to elevate their rolls above the norm.

The lady behind the counter also showed us a hand laminated sheet of suggested combinations. 

If I had not seen the name of the store, I would have had no idea they served anything cinnamon. There were just a few rolls out, there was no smell of Cinnamon, or fresh rolls, and the displays were not where even close to full.

The store was very plain and anemic looking. 

I ordered the Raspberry Cheesecake Cinnabon roll. Sounds really good doesn't it?

The Raspberry Cheesecake roll was good. It had a very strong flavor of Raspberry, but very little Cinnamon flavor. What it needed was a good balance between the 2. Not too Rasperryee and not too Cinnamonee. 

Thats a word right? Cinnamonee

The roll itself tasted a bit on the stale side. It was not hot and fresh like a Cinnabon roll. It was on the tough side and almost tasted...... crusty.

My daughter, like all teenagers, loves sweets. She ordered the original cinnamon roll with no toppings. I was glad that she ordered this because I wanted to see and taste how their regular cinnamon rolls stacked up against Cinnabon.

She took 2 bites of hers and threw the rest away. It is not that this one was bad, but my daughter eats Cinnabon a lot. If we had not tried a Cinnabon, this one might have actually been just fine. But after having theirs, this one just does not compare.

I tasted it as well. I really wanted to like it, but I just could not. There was very little Cinnamon flavor to it. If I were to compare this to a Cinnabon roll, I would give this one a 3 or 4. 

So I am sorry to say that Cinnaholic failed to deliver on its promise. Though I cant help but wonder if they were not as good because they were not fresh. We ate here around 5pm. The main advantage that Cinnabon has is that they are almost always fresh, but I have had a bad Cinnabon once or twice. It happens. 

I am going to have to return to Cinnaholic in the morning when they are fresh to give them a another chance.

One more thing before I forget. These cinnamon rolls are expensive. 2 of these costs us $15!

Now I would not mind this if they were over the top good, but they were not. Sorry guys, Gourmet Cinnamon rolls are a good idea, but at least on this visit, they did not deliver.

Hubby and I had dinner here last night. Service was very personable and on point. Food was good too! We had the hook and reel special blend spicy - def recommend but it's spicier than you would imagine.

Ordered flower for my mother and grandmother for Mother's Day -- I'm living across the country and wanted to get them something nice since I couldn't be there. I work at a flower shop in Florida so I know the price of flowers/arrangements so when I saw a picture of the arrangements for the price I paid, I was livid. I called them and they said they could refund $29, I said I'd rather get what I paid for. They weren't helpful or nice and definitely didn't get what I paid for.

This company managed one of my properties for 5 and a half years. They started off very good (and under different ownership/name as My Guardian PM) but have steadily deteriorated in the quality of their service. They also started doing real estate in addition to property management and I believe that began derailing their focus on management. I finally let them go a few months ago when in reality I should have done it several years ago. I literally could not understand what I was paying them to do since I had to remind them to do their jobs on so many occasions. I also just discovered they have 4 complaints on them filed with the Better Business Bureau.

Below outlines several of their failures - the house is a single unit home built in 2001 in the North End ~1600 sq ft.
Basics:
- I did not want tenants with dogs allowed - they let a tenant with a dog sign a lease. Despite re-emphasis of my wishes, they continually showed the property to people with dogs and asked if I would accept them ("oh, they have old dogs" "oh, they have little dogs")
- When a new tenant signed a lease and moved in - I had to ask for a copy of said lease EVERY time. They said most owners don't ask to see the lease...I find this very hard to believe.
- For the past 3 tenants, with 1 month remaining on the lease...I had to ask ProCore if the tenants were going to sign on for another year...they of course didn't know. When it was resolved that the tenants were not signing a new lease...I had to inform ProCore to begin advertising my house for rent (having already missed a few weeks of advertisement)
- Said advertisements were often not in publications/websites they were supposed to be. Also, changes to rent amounts (and statements such as "No dogs") were  not updated to entire portfolio of advertisements leading to a complete mish-mash.
- After my house went without a tenant for over 3 months...I posted my own Craigslist ad and received several interested people. I provided ProCore their information and directed them to contact the potential tenants ASAP. They failed to do this and 4 of the people I called back to follow-up with said they never heard from them and found another place. It ended up being vacant 4.5 months.
- For 5.5 years (at every tenant change) I had asked for pictures of the place to document condition/damage. This never occurred until just before I fired them (would not have happened if I had not been so firm).

Advanced Screw ups:
- One tenant shorted me on rent 3 times. This went unnoticed by ProCore EACH time and I had to bring it to their attention. 
- A French national lost his job and wanted out of the lease, I agreed as long as he paid advertising costs and stayed until a new renter was in. He stayed through the month he paid through then left. Procore did not keep tabs on him nor previously start any advertisement. They did say they'd call a collection agency to go after him...in France...good luck with that.

Their service/maintenance work seemed to be okay - I haven't seen their work to personally judge quality but it was a decent work rate. Their accounting leaves a little to be desired as to what is what on the statements for charges.

Overall, property management is easy: is current tenant staying? No = advertise, get new tenant. Throughout keep the owner informed. This absolutely did not happen to my liking and I continually had to hound them for information/follow-up. Unsat.

I initially had a bad experience here, but the Manager reached out to me to see how they could do better. They've offered to take care of me and fix the issues we had the first time. So far, it's been much better. I'll update this review again after services are completed this time. I'm happy to give them 5 stars if their service stays like this :)

Went here for my birthday with my Mom! Our servers were very kind and knowledgeable about gluten-free menu items. The food we ordered was cooked perfectly and came out quickly. Lovely atmosphere, great coffee, and overall a wonderful visit! We told our waitress that it was my birthday and she came out a few minutes later with a freshly baked, warm, strawberry, icing, and whipped cream-covered cake! So nice of them to do that! I also liked that they have bottomless coffee and give you a pitcher of water for your table! Will definitely be visiting again!

I can't say enough wonderful things about Crystal. I went to her after a bad cut from another salon and she worked her magic and fixed my hair! She's the best. She explained what she was going to do and how to have my hair cut as it grows out to get it back to how it was. She's simply amazing!!! The Salon itself was clean and the staff friendly.

I went here for the coffee and stayed for the lunch and dinner!

Deja Brew is a convenient location in downtown Meridian for business meetings and work. The restaurant is a mix of dining set up and coffee house that you'd expect.

I've been here a few times now and finally got around to trying lunch and dinner. Their menu is much more robust than I'd imagine a place like this to have and the food is solid comfort food. I had a French Dip (I think they call it something else but that is what it was) and it was exceptional. The beef was well cooked, thinly shaved, a little cheese and very nice au jus. 

Lunch is a good mix of sandwiches and salads and of course more coffee and other drinks.

The seating could be a little better for going to work or to meet, it is an eclectic mix of tables and chairs but overall it is solid. I have ordered cookies there twice for my daughter and both times they were overcooked and burned, I'd pass on those in the future.

The coffee is very good, served just the way you like it and competitively priced. This place is definitely worth the visit if you are in downtown Meridian and want to skip Starbucks.
The food was so dank and especially love seafood because I'm from Oregon and have always been close to the ocean so I appreciate good seafood!!!

All the employees are super nice, the food is exceptional, and it's wonderful that all options are 100% vegan (and you wouldn't even know it!). 

Definitely one of my favorite places in Boise if you have a sweet tooth!

These guys NAILED IT!!!! Being a fitness freak, I am EXTREMELY PARTICULAR on how I want things cooked, and prepared, and these guys just deliver flawlessly EVERY TIME!! I'm posting a pic of my customized fit for life omelette comprised of proteins, fat and greens....yummy!!
I love their friendly service and good food.  The portions are good too.  I haven't left hungry yet.  My favorite is the cinnamon roll French toast!

My family has been going to Bridgetower Dental since we moved here 2 years ago . From the moment I called they have been pleasant , polite and gone above and beyond for us . 
My 13 year old love to get her teeth cleaned by one if there hygienist . They always offer her suggestion on how to floss and keep her teeth pearly white .
My husband had to have a new crown put on and they sat down with him and I and explained every part of the process and took the time to explain about payment . 

 Highly recommend this practice not only for adults but family's .

They did a GREAT job catering our Christmas dinner on Saturday night! Prime rib and salmon choices, all done to the right requested temperatures. Excellent side dishes, amazing desserts, and service was perfection. Restaurant all to ourselves, nicely decorated, and appropriate background music to add to the festive atmosphere. Priced just right too!

Oh, how I miss you! It's been awhile since I had a burrito from Chipotle. This was my 1st time at this location, and I was not disappointed. There was plenty of seating and room for the lunch rush, and there was enough staff to handle it accordingly as well. We managed to arrive right before the rush. I had a super veggie burrito with corn, grilled veggies, lettuce, rice, beans, salsa & of course, GUACAMOLE  Thank you for always giving me a reason to return!

I love The Joint Meridian! I really look forward to going every week! The staff are super caring and friendly and the care is great! I'm feeling SO much better than a few weeks ago when I started going!  They are open such great hours and I always get seen very promptly!

We tried this place a few weeks ago for the first time. I have to admit we were both really nervous about the fact that there was no wait at 7:30 on a Friday night. However the service was quick the food was very good.  We had steamed clams and prime rib. The medium rare meat was cooked perfectly and the steamed clams rivaled any other restaurant we've had them in (that includes Dutch Goose and Bens Crow).  The cost of the dinner was medium priced. A good value for the service and food we received. This restaurant will be on our list. We will definitely be going back

Whenever I happen to have a day off during the week I go find a breakfast place I've never been to- main criteria is they have to have their own unique signature coffees .. today I found myself at Deja Brew Laugh a Latte in Meridian.  It's a cute spot, the music is unedited and local art for sale decorate the walls.
I ordered the 'Groundhog's Day' an almond Mexican Mocha with cayenne and  the cheddar/bacon grits .. I've only had grits twice and you'd need 4 people to finish this bowl! This would be a perfect spot to meet a group of friends for breakfast or lunch (a great menu) and they have outdoor seating when the weather warms up .. 
I dig it!

We had such an amazing experience with Park Place Property Management. Victoria is incredible. We are coming from out of state and won't be in Idaho until move in day, she has made herself available to us for all questions, was extremely patient and helpful thru the whole process. I definitely recommend working with park place, they made the full process easy and bearable!

Pretty standard food quality and service as compared to other Sonic locations. I was a little surprised that they hadn't thought, or perhaps had simply decided not to shovel or plow the snow from their drive through. Got stuck a few times making the loop this last week.

When I got home and looked in the mirror I felt diasappointed. Vanessa was nice and personable. Lots of time was spent on my hair. But, this was a costly visit and I didn't get the caramel-hued bayolage I came in for.

Um... Ick. I suppose if you're vegan then you have a better appreciation for this place. But if you're not FAIR WARNING! There isn't much in the way of signage advertising that this is a vegan bakery. Nothing in the world will make vegan cream cheese frosting taste good. And if you go into it expecting the real deal, then you'll be doubly disappointed.

I've been acquainted with the owner for a few years now and I would say that he's fair and honest. He's doing his best to keep his store up and running, selling firearms is a tough way to make a living. The owner "Dan" has worked with Tactical Solutions and Primary Weapons Systems, he came from a firearms background and has a good working knowledge of the business. I've been in his stores many times and have purchased a few guns from him, his prices are fair and competitive and he has a good inventory of items some of which can't be found at the large chain stores.  Support the local guy.

I love this place, the pizza is awesome! Whenever I travel to Boise I make sure I visit a Flying Pie. The Samoan is my favorite, staff are super friendly. Definitely not a fast food pizza place, very original and home made

Stopped in today for a quick bite with my son food was awesome as usual but the servers weren't very friendly and the cleanliness of the floors and tables were gross. They weren't very busy so I don't think there's any excuse for that. I've always been big on clean restaurants. There was only one girl in there with glasses that was friendly. I understand not everyone has good days but I think they need to step it up with keeping the floors and tables clean.

Coming from out of state alternator starting giving out on the Dodge, we limped into town. Called Gem state they got us in the following morning and took care of us. Back on the road Brian and his crew did a great job.

Nice and cleanly laid out. Hard to get help though and one of the staff is really rude- the guy with the red hair and accent! Everyone else there is good but this guy acts like he hates customers; very short tempered. Plus he was super rude and yelled at another employee while we were there. If you're going in don't get help from him. Tell him you'll wait until someone else is available. Quite a bit pricier than other places in town.

It's 5:30pm on a Monday and their phone goes straight to voicemail that says they are too busy making "world famous pizzas" to answer the phone, then hangs up. I made 3 calls over a 4 minute period. I guess you guys don't need any more business! See ya!

This place is fantastic. Great ambiance and different from your run of the mill type restaurants. 
I love how authentic everything is including the decor. The owners are super friendly, of course they are, they're Hawaiian.   They will sit down with guests and just talk about anything, just like the locals do in Hawaii. 
Now, the food is incredible too. Everything has amazing flavor and the portions are huge. You can't go wrong with any plate you get and definitely try the P.O.G.

We held my daughter' 8th birthday party here and what a great experience! Staff was nice, kids had a blast, and Lexie was amazing with the kiddos; gave them the "pizza tour", helped them make their pizzas, was patient and sweet, and the game area was great too. We fed 7 kids and two adults (plus drinks and salads) for about $100! We will very likely be celebrating more birthdays here.
3/11/2020.   Got below reply back from the manager, nice copy and paste....guess he did NOT read my review.

I was a client of this company for a year and a half, and had an amazing experience with them.

But, don't take my word for it - be sure to scroll down this page to find a greyed-out notation which says "12 filtered" (the number may be different by the time you read this), click on it, go through the process to prove that you are a real person, and read the reports.

I promise that you will be not be sorry!
Best steak sub I've ever had.  They call it the Bomb, and it really is. Don't know if I would order anything else it was so good. Tender and tasty.

To start we got hush puppies! Very good warm, great flavour. Then order the catfish sliders, and the shrimp basket. The catfish was average at best, flakey as catfish should be, but drowned in mayo, couldn't really taste the flavour of the fish but was flakey! The Cajun fries and regular fries are amazing, well worth getting those. The shrimp basket, was overly breaded! But all in all for 2 people at 40 dollars was not bad at all. Don't think I would go back for the hush puppies and fries, the wait staff Ashley being our waitress was decent if I could giver her a rating she was the best thing about the meal knew most of the questions I had about where the product came from.

I've dealt with this store many times and they've made many mistakes before, but I'm done going to this one altogether. In the past, they've made a ton of mistakes and had horrible attitudes. This last time was the breaking point. They accidentally put sour cream on my burrito and I told the man it was okay and to just scrape it off. He gave me a terrible attitude and kept insisting that he just remake it (and he definitely wouldn't be happy to do so). I said it was okay, nicely and my boyfriend was telling the same guy to try to reduce the water from the pico de Gallo on his burrito and he started slamming pans around violently. We told the manager and she didn't do anything except remake my burrito, which I didn't really care about. They didn't seem to care and I'm done going there.

It was good, but expensive. The experience is different then places like Joes Crab Shack. Each seafood meal comes in a big bag and the server dumps in a large round flat pan. Their food has great flavor and the restaurant has a nice atmosphere. But, it was expensive.

I take my grandmothers dog to Doggie Day Spaw.  Doggie Day Spaw offers a great self wash area, the tubs are always cleaned the staff is very helpful and friendly, and they clean up afterward., Very clean. Would recommend bringing your dog to Doggie Day Spaw

Not sure if I had high expectations but since I have never been there before how could I? It was such a disappointment, and to many anomalies to chalk it up to an off night.

- Dirty Menus
- Long waiting periods to speak with server
- My card was left at the front when the check came back to me.
- Non-Inviting

I'm not overly searching for things to add to the book to throw at them, in fact I left out other situations, it's just when you don't feel welcomed and you sit down to a dirty menu and then you are consistently having long waiting periods to order or get what you ordered and when you pay and you card is left at the register... it's time to move on.

I am STILL stuffed while writing this a day later! Starting at the beginning, this place is super busy, but understandably so. They don't have the best waiting area, or setup. They also need the little buzzers to let you know your table is ready instead of having three different hostesses yelling across the restaurant for the next party in line. I personally think that's very unprofessional, but I'm not going to take a star away. Everyone, and I mean everyone, is so smiley and friendly. Whoever owns this place found himself a fantastic crew. Waiters and bus boys all help each other out whether it was their table or not. We had the pleasure of having Zabrielle as our waitress. She was so fun and wonderful. The food was all so delicious. We had the calamari appetizer, shrimp basket, and a basket of several different meats. Their sauces are so creative and yummy! Ask for a side of the everything sauce. They have a name for it but I forgot. The atmosphere was lovely. Cute themed and so very clean. My husband says they have actual private bathrooms. Idk why contractors here put so much space between stalls like we all want to see people squat, but the bathrooms here are professionally and privately designed, and well kept! We will definitely be coming back as we had a wonderful experience. Thank you!

What a great, non-traditional, dining experience. Food was great and beer was cold. Nice selection of brews to choose from. Entire staff was great, owner or manager swung by a couple times to make sure all was good. Only problem I found was trying to drink your beer with your messy hands. Highly recommend!

This place has great food but management is TERRIBLE!! They are very unprofessional and treat their employees badly hence why they are understaffed . They stole my husbands tips and we had to contact the BBB to get his money. I would NEVER give them my money again until they have better management.
Disappointing. Limited menu was over priced, however the Cuban sandwich was good. Good selection of local beers but not much less than $6 for a small glass.

I am very impressed with the Glass Doctor.  

Kevin was extremely helpful over the phone getting me set up.  Very knowledgeable and an excellent salesman.  His prices are only slightly higher than the competition but their 12 month guarantee completely makes up for it.  Add to that the experience and professionalism of Luke who did the work on my windshield.  I am a very happy customer.  

Luke took time out of his busy schedule to answer my questions and explain details about complications and differences in changing the windshield.  I have replaced my windshield several times in the past, and it is apparent that Luke is much more knowledgeable than any of the past technicians that have worked on my car.  

Excellent customer service and I will absolutely use Glass Doctor again in the future.

Thank you!

23rd reviewer of Deja Brew Laugh a Latte-- this is my 392nd review. 
UMMMM---- ADORABLE! 
I mean, the name alone is a 5 star in my book-- humorous, clever, and catchy. There is a little seating area for little ones, that's completely adorable!

BTW-- the atmosphere was conducive to laugh a latte! 

Located in the heart of downtown Meridian, this nice sized, well decorated, friendly staffed, establishment, not only makes good coffee (Latte) but some yummy food, too! 

We ordered the chicken nachos (A+), the turkey sandwich with no bread with potato soup, and avocado toast. All was homemade and very good-- the potato soup was a little watery for me but to each their own. 

I recommend this place! Inbox me and lets laugh a latte (can't get over the cute name) over some java!

For 3 years Jeff kept me updated about homes and new developments close to our children and Grandkids.  When a new subdivision opened within a few blocks of our son, Jeff was there to help us with building our new home.  The builder was difficult to work with and Jeff always had our backs.
      It took 20 months from start to finish and Jeff was always there for us.  We are grateful that he insisted that we have a 3rd party independent inspector to go over the property before we closed.
      This is our 4th new home.   We had previous homes built while living out of the area or across the country and never had the problems with a builder that we had with the one in Meridian. 
      Jeff did all the dirty work for us and in the end he personally installed the handicap hand railing in the bathroom.  Not part of his job description.  That is the kind of dedication he has  to his clients. 
      Thank you Jeff and staff.  If you need someone that is in your corner during a moving process Jeff will be your White Knight in Shining Armour.

Best wings I have had. I have gone here a lot over the last few years and no other wings stack up against wingers wings. I read the negative reviews on this place and disagree. This review is for the wings only, I haven't tried anything else on their menu. 

The wings are breaded well, then tossed in a sauce of your choice. The sauce I normally get is the rebel, which is a combo of the original amazing and the classic buffalo. The size of the wings are bigger than any other place also. The sauce is nice and thick, not too thin. These wings actually taste good and fill you up, unlike BWW's. 

The service here is always good. In fact tonight our waitress forgot the free popcorn when we sat down and gave us a free side item. 

We go here to watch a football game every once and a while. It's not the best environment to catch a game. The tv's are small in some areas and the viewing angles are not ideal. 

This is a family friendly joint, so only small selections of beer and wine. This is the only negative I have on this place, but the wings make up for it. If you want a better place to watch a game go try the Nampa location.
Great pizza. The crust has a great flavor lots of topping    Chicken wings very tinder and full of flavor. Cinnamon monkey bread was a sweet end of the dinner. Will be back soon.

So, I just spent a few minutes putting together an order for our office for breakfast only to find out upon check out that they are not opened for breakfast at 8:00 a.m.! They open at 10:00 a.m.

We'll never know how yummy they are!

You cannot go inside and order food, online only, just ridiculous! This experience has tainted the atmosphere and ever wanting to come here in the future.  Maybe more convenient for them but not the consumer.

Came here on a Saturday morning for some brunch. We had to wait about 20 minutes before we got a table. Once we were seated the service was quick and the staff was friendly. Also the coffee was super good. I got an iced vanilla latte and I loved it. I got the breakfast sandwich and it was fresh and tasty. The food was reasonably priced and staff was friendly. Great spot to grab a bite to eat!

Ok, we tried this place for the first time last night. Our server, Gianna, was awesome. She explained the menu thoroughly, helped me open my boil bag, and always wore her mask and gloves. She was fantastic. The food was great. I had the Dungeoness crab boil (butter & garlic sauce was yummy!), my hubby had the flounder Po' Boy, and my dad had the fried flounder basket. It was all delicious. 
The ladies room was super clean, so appreciated when it was time to wash off after eating all that crab. 
The only thing keeping me from giving 5 stars is that only 50% of the staff were wearing masks properly. Your staff needs to be wearing masks covering their noses and chins at all times. Not just when someone walks by. At all times.

Only giving a star because I have to. We've been frequenting this place, typically once a week, for a few months now. We are usually quite pleased with our food and customer experience.. until today. They messed up our order and when we returned to have it fixed, the girl made rude comments about us placing our order online. Clearly she made the sandwich that was messed up, and she was probably embarrassed by it. When I pay $10 for a simple turkey sandwich I expect it to be made right. Anyway, that experience alone ruined it for us and we won't be back as that is no way to speak to a customer.

They have a general inability to communicate properly with prospective tenants and tenants. Currently experiencing an outage of heat in a portion of our rental since last Saturday. Today, February 1st, is day six without heat in the main room of the house and tge room where we sleep. They insist that the owner is requiring multiple estimates to replace the original 8' baseboard in a 40 year old duplex. This a compete lack of responsibility and terribly inconsiderate to us and the business professionals that they are running around. They have refused to tell us if they actually even WILL have it repaired or when. Our only saving grace is that the days have been warmer than normal and the low at night around 32. I would never recommend this "management" group and can't wait to be done with them.

My husband found this place on Yelp so we decided to give it a try.  We were surprisingly pleased to find that the katsu and teriyaki chicken were tasty and not greasy. The teriyaki chicken was moist and had a good char to it without tasting burned.  It had the right amount of sauce and the macaroni salad was delicious. We've eaten at L & L Hawaiian Barbeque and Ono Hawaiian BBQ and this is very comparable to those established chains.  I had the regular, two-item plate with katsu chicken and teriyaki steak and ended up having leftovers to enjoy later.  They even have POG but I didn't get to try it  since we took our food to-go.  Next time for sure, though!!  We will definitely be returning to eat again. And, the staff were all wearing masks and the tables were spaced out to adhere to social distancing protocols.

Used to really like coming here but the last time I was at the still Taco was the worst experience I've ever had at a Mexican drive thru.  

I ordered a churro, medium fries, couple tacos. Tacos were broken and a mess and my French fries were soggy limp and disgusting. They were so greasy I couldn't eat them. And the churro was still frozen inside, it was slightly warm on the outside but once I get in it went in the garbage. I was pissed and it was too late to complain because I already got home and had to get up for work in the morning so I didn't have time to deal with going back or calling and going through the hassle. The kid at the window had a lousy attitude, the greeting wasn't even a greeting it was basically asking for my payment turning away, running my card and handing it back. He shut the window and when my order came out finally, he basically shoved the bag at me and shut the window. I should have known to check my bag but I was tired after work. Sad.

I had the weirdest experience at this place. First, the waitress was one of those sugary overly pushy types who kept calling me "honey" and "sweety" and checking on us every two or three minutes (but not bringing our food, the straw we asked for or doing anything to provide service).  I ordered a huckleberry vodka cocktail from their menu. She brought me something in a mule cup with ginger beer. I mentioned that it wasn't what I ordered but that it was fine - mostly because I wanted her to leave us alone so we could eat. She argued with me that it was in fact the item I ordered. I explained that I thought it was a different menu item but again said it was fine. She came back five minutes later to tell me that she had confirmed with the bartender that the drink was in fact the vodka one I ordered. I again explained that it had ginger beer in it and no vodka.  I am not exaggerating when I say we had three separate conversations about the drink.  I left wishing I had just kept my mouth shut because it ruined the whole meal. The food was fine - we had fish and chips which were not bad - but based on this experience we won't be back.

Great selection of many different kinds of sandwiches. Something for everyone. You can also build your own. French fries were great. Staff were friendly and fast. Great addition to 10 mile rd.  You can also order online and just pick it up.

Express Cafe is Iconic locally owned and operated for over 30 years breakfast and lunch restaurant. 86th person to review Express Cafe in Meridian on Fairview near Meridian Rd. This is my 466th review.  I wanted to try this place for such a long time, but they are open limited hours and are almost ALWAYS busy. Finally, I was able to try and to be honest I was disappointed. A-OK. 

Reading the many reviews my thoughts were..."YES!!!", but nothing sparked that in me. I took two of my babies with me and had a good time. Being a foodie I was excited for the home cooking and the large portions, but again, MEH. Perhaps I visited on an off day. I will say the people were pretty cool. Mostly younger teens. Some people though have been there for many years and they wear their start year on their sleeves-- which I thought was pretty neat! 

The parking lot is small but gets the job done. Walking into the restaurant you are greeted with a roundish table to sit at if you desire (bar like area) before being greeted and shown a table. 

The menu is very sufficient and similar to Sunrise. Many options for all. Nice hardy meals. BEWARE-- Something that I didn't like was the size of the kids' meal-- it was absolutely huge and I just didn't agree with that, personally. For the record, some may be okay with that, especially for leftovers, but not me-- my kid will eat the whole thing and I am trying to help her with good choices while eating out and portion sizes are important. The child's meal came with a large plate-sized pancake, 6 thick slices of bacon and three eggs-- too much for even a grown adult. 

I will say skip the Chef Salad-- watery and not fresh/quality ingredients and costly for such a salad. Also, the hot chocolate comes with sprinkles and was super cute!

This one is my least favorite of the locations. The energy of the staff does not compare to the upbeat and friendly personalities of the other locations. I've been here a few times for the lunch buffet and there never seems to be any sense of urgency in greeting and assisting the customers or cleaning and restocking the salad and pizza bar. However the food is always great. I just wish the service would match.

The Firehouse is a great little neighborhood bar and grill - my husband and I love it. Our favorite menu items are the fish and chips (crispy and tender), jalapeño poppers, lumpia (homemade egg rolls), and their wings - wow! I like the wings dry, and my husband likes them tossed in the spicy garlic-Parmesan sauce. So good! 

The bar staff makes a mean drink, with no skimping on the pour. The servers are friendly and accommodating. It's an all-around great place to hang out and watch a game or catch up with friends.

Rented a condo from Katie with no problems. Unit was very clean with utilities already turned on. Noticed small wear and tear after moving in and all issues were promptly handled. Literally had pest control out in days after I found a spider in my babies room. Family friendly! Pet friendly! We have cats so it's pretty much a given there will be damage and there pet deposits were very reasonable. Many places won't even consider cats so we're happy to have found this unit. Nice vinyl flooring with wood appearance for pet owners is very helpful.

I have only been once, and I did have 2 mochas while I was studying. The first, was amazing, freshly steamed milk with the shots blended in the froth....mmmmmm. After a couple hours I ordered another, it was delicious, but you could tell that she had steamed the milk and added more then steamed it again, which watered down the flavor significantly. Was not too busy and the decor was nice. The service and Mochas are outstanding for the Treasure Valley!

We had five locks we wanted re-keyed to one key.  I called The Maintenance Shop and Steve came out the same afternoon to have a look.  Re-keying was not possible and Steve patiently explained why not.  We ended up with four new locks and one original lock being re-keyed.

Steve was prompt, quick and reasonably priced.  I would definitely use him again.
Great food and I love the size options!  The staff is always friendly and I have also ordered online and was able to just run in and pick up my food.

I have always wanted to try this place and last night we decided we would. Had a group of 8 so figured the wait might be longer than if we had a smaller group. Hostess up front was not friendly at all. After waiting and hour I asked the hostess if she knew how much longer and she said she did not know and pretty much didn't care. 15 minutes later asked again and she told us do you see that table over there? We will seat you as soon as they leave. Ummm ok?? So after waiting 1 hour and 30 minutes I talked with the manager and he pushed to get us seated right away. He was friendly and made sure the rest of the night was a good experience. Food was definitely good and will probably be back. Just wasn't pleased with how it took us over three hours from beginning to end of dinner. Way to long!!

I just cant say enough good things about the Express Cafe. Ive never been there for lunch until today. Best hamburger I have eaten in a long time. I had the BBQ Bacon and my hubby the Jalapeño Burgers. Both were juicy and flavorful. The meat was cooked perfectly and the cheese and sauces complimented the burgers. I liked that the fixings come on the side and I could choose to eat my tomatos not on the burger. Fries were delicious especially with the homemade fry sauce. 

The staff is a whole other story. Muliltiple waitresses that have been there over 15 years. Obviously this is a good place to work. They are all friendly and remember us from visit to visit. They are friendly and very efficient with out being rude or pushy. Upon leaving I counted 5 thank you and come agains.
This was my first time in Idaho and the Yelp review was right on. The service was good and the food was great. I will go here again when I'm in Idaho.

I came to try the lunch salad and pizza buffet with my husband, it was my first visit and his second. We were there about 11:35am and no pizza was on the buffet at that time. 
We started with the salad bar, everything was fresh and they had lots of great options. However, after we finished the salad they finally put two pizzas out. It went fast because the restaurant was busy. It wasn't until around 12:15 when the pizzas started coming out in quantity to feed a busy restaurant. Right about the time we had already finished filling up on salad, and had to get back to work. 
My recommendation is that if you are going to sell the salad and pizza bar, have it stocked for a restaurant full of hungry and in a hurry lunch patrons. I would have given 4 stars, but we didn't really get to try much pizza. 
My husband said the same thing happened on his first visit, but was willing to try again. Probably won't be back anytime we are in a rush, or will go later in the lunch hour.
Great service and the best smoked pork chops you will ever try!

This seems like a hit-or-miss place based on the previous reviews, but I can say I definitely had a 5 star experience today.  My aunt and I stopped in for lunch - she had the flounder fish and chips and I had the dungeness crab with the Cajun sauce medium spicy.  OMG the crab was SOOO good - I think it was the best meal I've had in Idaho. The medium spicy is pretty spicy, so be warned.  I love spice and was very happy with the spice level.

The crab was a large portion (whole crab!) and my aunt received 3 pieces of fish and a good size portion of Cajun fries.  The fish was one of the best pieces of fish I've had in a long time and the fries were tasty too.  We also ordered the hush puppies as an appetizer which were also outstanding.

I can't wait to take my husband there and have that crab again!!

This place is such a great find. The people working there are knowledgeable about the toys and everything they have recommended has been a hit with my grandchildren, I was surprised to see a 1 Star given for customer service...guess there is always one in the bunch!  I haven't found better. They have an enormous collection of quality toys. I love the fact that they are an Idaho company with pride in their work.
Yum! Service was great and the food was even better. I think they were understaffed that night because our waitress thanked us for being patient but we didn't even notice :)

I love this place and recommend it to anyone and everyone. The owner is eccentric and fun. The atmosphere is energetic. Her instructions are easy to follow and she'll even let you purchase a couple of her paintings. Want to bring food to your party there? No problem, she's ok with that. Great, great place for children and adults.

Love Park Place! We are apartment owners and needed a great property management team. Before hiring PPM we did our research. We went to see several properties, pretending that we were going to rent, with different property management companies before choosing Park Place. The difference between Park Place and the other management companies is like night and day. Park Place is very organized and has their system down to a science. I wouldn't have purchased properties in Boise if I didn't have them. We have owned a 24 unit property for three years and have had very minimal vacancy. This last year we purchased another large, brand new complex. Park Place filled it in record time. They are amazing!

Restaurant names are important. They cement a memory inside of you that is associated with the food. Speaking of cement, the purple potatos that came with my smoked prime rib were equally textured. It's not easy to mess up potatos, but somehow the kitchen managed to desecrate the enduring symbol of our great state. Unforgivable. Know what else is unforgivable? Putting a pound of peppercorns on my $30 primer rib, choosing jalapeños that are bowels of #€!! hot for your poppers, and charging $7 for a "made fresh" cookie that tasted like rancid cow intestines to everyone else in our party but me. I guess I was so wanting the kitchen to get SOMETHING right that my taste buds were temporarily suspended. Barrel 55 huh? Unfortunately I can't shake the image of the 54 previous barrels that are probably buried somewhere in the desert with terrible chefs inside. Hey guys, I can buy you a lid for barrel 55.

Shark Tank/ Dessert / Design your own Cinnamon roll!?  I was all about it and excited to try.  And EXTRA excited for my no dairy/no egg partner.  Upon arrival the owner helped us and was very friendly and informative.  I grilled him about the history, # of franchises, the product, etc. Baffled at how they'd do a vegan cream cheese frosting, I asked for a taste and the ingredients. He said that was proprietary. Information... This day in age that's not the right answer. My brain automatically went to artificial scariness but I'll never know.  And it tasted weird to me. So I went ultra basic:  cinnamon roll with vanilla frosting. My cohorts got peanut butter frosting, cookie dough - that kind of stuff. They did say they taste best very fresh so we rushed to our hotel to eat them (7.5 mins). I couldn't eat past 2 bites. Sooooooooooooo sweet (& I'm a dessert gal) and the texture was just not what I'm used to in a cinnamon roll. The Vegan ate his but didn't love it. The child didn't even like it and tossed half. Sadly, this was a thumbs down for us. But the owner was very nice and it's location is great if you're looking to shop.  Note:  an outstanding Vegan cinnamon roll does exist:  in Reno, NV at the Great Basin co-op. Heaven. For reals.

We stopped by for lunch and to check out the new place. They have a broader menu than most sandwich joints. They also offer a low carb option by making any sandwich into a salad. Not sure how anyone could get "soggy" fries. They don't cook them until you order them. Ours were too hot to eat at first. Simply fries with no added junk and a light salting.
I ordered a Cuban sandwich and fries. Best Cuban since we left Maraton Key this summer. Spot on. My wife ordered a Cajun chicken sandwich as a salad. We both loved what we had. The staff was friendly, the service was quick. We'll be back.

This Taco Bell location needs some serious help. Whoever the Manager on duty at any given time is must be sleeping in the back room because no matter what time of day you come to this location, your order will take forever. Worst case you should only be waiting 5-10 minutes during prime time. I can name a few times that I have waiting 30-40 minutes in the drive thru! One time when I went inside, they only had 4 people working. 1 working drive thru, 3 making food, 2 of which were making food for drive thru, and 1 was making food for the walk ins. There was a line wrapped around the building and the only one who was hustling was the guy making food for walk ins (he was actually kicking butt and deserves kudos). I didn't see any manager on duty to help out with the rush and the other 2 food makers were just taking their sweet time. When there is a long line backed up, management needs to step in and help out. I loathe going to this location which sucks because it is closest to my house. Otherwise I have to drive to overland/eagle location. That location operates much more efficiently. Get it together Taco Bell!

Very disappointed. This place is usually good but today it was off its mark. I don't know if the business is down sizing their portions or what. We ordered the mini mix with Kahlua pig and Katsu chicken.  Pig portion was 3 little bites. Whats the point of the mix if you don't make it proportionally worth it. Check your order before you bring it home. Staff also was more into helping the Door dash personnel then actual customers there to place an order. Customer service is gone. Unbelievable.
Free breadsticks didn't arrive and after waiting an hour for our small pizza it was burnt! Sorry we cheated on you Idaho Pizza to try something new..... won't make that mistake again!

Not sure what others see in this place, was let down from the first bite. Super bland, one note dishes, plus dine-in meals served in styrofoam with tiny plastic utensils. Can I get like a tray or a plate or a metal knife to cut my chicken?

Kalua pig: super DUPER long stringy pieces, could not taste much at all? Had to douse in teriyaki, barely tolerable. Has such high hopes for this one specifically.

Pulehu chicken: tasted like I burned chicken on an old bbq out back and forgot to season it. 

Mac salad: honestly had better at the Albertsons deli. So disappointed since the mac is one of the best elements of Hawaiian food.

Hate leaving a bad review, but this gives Hawaiian food a bad name. We both felt like crap on the drive home, so greasy. Kanak Attack please come back to Meridian!!!

A new cuisine for the Treasure Valley. Took friends from that part of country to check it out. From the hushpuppys to the entrees we had was all good, very good. On a busy Saturday around 4:30pm. We only waited 15 mimutes. Gianna took good care of us making sure we had everything we needed. Their pick your entree menu made deciding tougher but fun. We will return
Fancy pizza that you have to wait a long time to arrive at your table. Atmosphere is loud if you want to carry on a conversation. Location is great and staff is friendly.

Ordered "The Bomb" was expecting a decent sandwich but it was lacking flavor, besides the onions and peppers it had zero flavor. They were nice people but for the location the flavor was something I won't drive back too.

We met up with a couple friends for brunch and we had never been here before.  I was disappointed at the small/simple menu so I went with the standard Two Egg Breakfast.  The eggs and potatoes were good but the toast was dry (no butter) and they don't bring a variety of jelly.  My husband ordered Country Fried Chicken and said it was "okay" but he wouldn't order it again.  The best thing on the table was probably the Bloody Mary which passed our test but won't be added to any "favorites list".  

The restaurant was empty aside from a few people in the bar.  Considering how slow it was the service was awful.  Our waitress was irritated when we asked for sides or refills.  At one point in time she came and asked us if we needed anything; when we responded NO she told us she was going to take a break and go sit down.  I have never had a server act so careless about their job or their service.  I definitely do NOT recommend this place for Sunday Brunch but I may have to go back and try their regular menu.

Best breakfast food I've had in a while. I even ate it for lunch. I ha da campfire biscuit. A cheddar biscuit topped with gravy, bacon, and an egg. Great flavor and amazing gravy. I'll be back here maybe tomorrow to eat it again!

Ordered food at 6:29 and food arrived at 9. The food is not edible and the smoothies are water. This is by far the worst experience and food that has come from Panera. We have enjoyed getting food from here often and this is enough for me to not visit again. Seriously disappointed.
Our experience on our first appointment was great, our girl Holly was so relaxed and happy when we picked her up and her cut was immaculate!

Me and my daughter's favorite place to eat. Everything on the menu is delicious. My family has been going there since I was a young lad & now I take my child there. The staff is family like & they seem very tight with each other. When my friends suggest somewhere else to eat, I always get them to go here. I come here because I know what I'm going to get & I know I will leave satisfied.

When I don't cook at home I want to go to a restaurant that will give me the feel of a home cooked meal and give the feel of being at home.  Had an incredible experience at Deja Brew.  The service was amazing.  The food was incredible.  The coffee was like no other tops any coffee shop! You know you are in a great place when the owner comes out to speak to you.  Not only is their service exceptional, but their treatment of whom enters the front door is absolutely heart warming.  Most business don't take the time to thank you for the business or for coming to help keep their doors open.  This restaurant does both.  Support a local business!  Although it rained last weekend it was wonderful to be inside.  I cannot wait till spring and summer to get to sit outside!  I left the best for last...Heather your suggestions and service were excellent!  Cecil thank you for your hospitality and great restaurant going back today.... oh and that cooking yum!

http://alattelaugh.com/

Moved here in March so I was in need of a visit here for sure, I was hesitant as I did have my favorite sugaring place in Corona Del Mar CA, but as soon as I walked in the Studio I felt very comfortable and knew this was my new place. Thank you for your professionalism, see you next month

Maple Bacon Chicken, Glazed Teriyaki, The Gator, the Steak Bomb, Authentic Italian... everything I have tried I have liked! And I love that they can make any sub into a salad... making it gluten free/low carb. The fries are always done perfectly crisp and even their cookies are good. The employees are always ready with a suggestion of what to try next and are helpful and happy. There are aren't many places to eat in this specific area as of yet, so I am glad there is a good sandwich shop to go to!
Absolutely delicious! Considerable amount, tender and juicy shrimp, and humongous New Zealand muscles.
Loved this place and so did our kids!  Staff was great and place was spotless clean!  Definitely suggest this place for parents and kids!

It's neat to have a large candy shop in Meridian but unfortunately there are too many things I don't want my small kids looking at in the store. In order to stay in business, I would suggest they re-evaluate who their customer base in Meridian, Idaho is and get rid of the trashy merchandise.
Servings based upon weight, which includes shells of items ordered. Helpful that provide bib, gloves, and handiwipe!

Le Peep was great, but since ownership has changed hands the service has taken a plunge. Before I would drive all the way from Kuna for the GF waffles, but since the new owner has changed product manufacturers they are HORRIBLE.
