Nothing worse than spending 30% more for gluten free products and then have them arrive tasting terrible! I won't be travelling 25 minutes for those waffles and slow service anymore. :(

My son and I arrived right after they opened for the day. It was 11 am. The floors, tables, and soda area were filthy. It did not appear that they cleaned prior to opening or closing for the night. There was hair all over the floor of the hallway leading to the bathroom and trash.  I saw an employee go into the men's room, grab the trash, and walk back into the kitchen with it to dispose of.  Disgusting!

Planned to spend a ton of money here tonight. No one helped, their costumer service was terrible. When the apparent manager came over to help us check out(I think her name was Kailee) she didn't even look at us and was super rude. The total would have been about $300 and I ended up just saying forget it.  
Love the store and clothes, but they are losing costumers from their attitude.

Food was horrible and not what I ordered. Waitress refused to fix it. I had to go get the manager since he would not come over when flagged. I was offered soup in place of my food. But we still had to pay for the food I never received and the soup.

I bought a membership the first week that The Joint opened.  I was experiencing chronic back and neck pain that was brought on by my crazy sleep positions. I was in a bad way... At times, I could have passed for someone who had been in a car accident. My health insurance did not include chiropractic coverage. I decided to give The Joint a try: One visit. My pain level diminished after getting off the table. That made it an easy decision: I signed up for the four visits per month. It was, perhaps after the fourth or fifth visit that I began to feel like my old self.  That was 4 (or 5?) years ago and I have been getting my 4 adjustments each month ever since. I have not had any major problem since I started this regimen. It has improved my well-being 100%. It is, without a doubt, the best money I have ever spent!

Okay, I have been meaning to try hook and reel since it opened but I like to give places time to work out the bugs. That's an important note that will make sense here in minute. 

So I decided to take my wife here on a date and it ended up being a terrific date night idea. I'm a foodie through and through..so if you are anything like me this joint will be like our arts and crafts time. You get to fiddle with little delicious creatures, and take them apart until succulent surprises reveal themselves. Now that the thoughts running thru my head are written out it sounds like the making of a serial killer...but trust me! It's delicious, its FUN, and it can be adventurous for some as well. Trying things perhaps you haven't tried before while dredged in a savory Cajun sauce is a great way to dive into new or even familiar culinary treasures from the sea. 

So the food was amazing.. made that point. Now to touch base on my opening comment. The service here was fantastic...plainly, simply, irrevocably great. What ever was happening in previous reviews with the service are happily reported here to be resolved. We had a wonderful experience at hook and reel...and that's what this place is...an experience! You get a delicious meal, a fun time, and great atmosphere. Great job to all those involved in this establishment. 
The crowds speak for themselves. Get there before 6 on a weekend and you'll be looking at a 15-20 min wait. After 6 expect 45 min.

My rating reflects not just the food but the entire experience of the meal  We will be going back that's for certain...give it a go, rock the bib like you own it and eat up Boise.

It looked nice from the outside and the inside atmosphere is nice. Our server wasn't very in touch with her job. She didn't refill our drinks or even check to see if the food was okay. Only saw her to take the order and then to leave... don't recommend

Had both rear right side tireson my dually flat this morning. Took them both off and took them in. Two and a half hours later they still haven't fixed the flats! I understand busy,but I couldn't exactly make an appointment for an unseen flat. Nice clean place but dont go here if your time is important. No explanation just sit there without any updates. Could have at least let me know.

New England girl bias here. Not a fan of the clam chowder... runny and Idaho loves filling it up with potatoes and minimal clams. Lobster bisque was great, with a lil spice heat. Salad was a major disappointment. Equivalent to Walmart prepared salad with shrimp on it. Was a glorified side salad, just lettuce and tomatoes. Calamari was good, liked that it was lightly battered.
It was a great place to eat. The food was delicious!They do over spice all of their boils. When you order make sure to ask for light seasoning.

I have used them for a few years now. No issues and good communication. You need to read his blog daily to know when he's coming, in case you need to unlock your gate like I do. However, I enjoy reading the blog! I especially like that I can pay online.

Food was just ok. The potatoes needed to be cooked longer and my eggs were scrambled but had water underneath them.  The service was terrible. We arrived and were seated right away but it took forever to get our food and my husbands coffee was never refilled. We had brought a guest and half way thru her eating her meal they started rushing us by asking if we needed boxes and collecting our plates.  We felt we couldn't even relax and have a conversation while eating. No one wants to be rushed and it was only around 10 am  I will NEVER go back there. We are always looking for a comfortable place to take our clients to for breakfast but this is definitely not it!!

I have been working with Jake Gold (a trainer at Axiom @ The Village) for a little over a year.  I have been happy with with my results and I think the staff at The Village is exceptional.  And I do agree with one of the other reviews that said it gets crowed there sometimes, but the other members are so nice it ends up being an excuse to make a friend.  And my review may seem a little over the top but my doctor just told me that I will not need to take blood pressure meds because my exercise and diet reduced the need.  Axiom is great!

My favorite breakfast spot! Try the cinnamon roll French toast, it's the best! Express cafe has become my family's favorite place to go for breakfast when we go out. The service has always been amazing and the donuts are really good too, they make them fresh every day.

I lived in the Rock Creek Apts for about 5 years before Park Place took over management, and when they did, it was not for the better in several ways. With the previous managers, the cost of rent would go down the longer you stayed with them. With Park Place, our rent went up immediately after they took over. They also started doing "Pet Inspections", adding another $50 every month, which consisted of simply walking around and taking pictures with an iPad, but nothing that had to do with the actual animals themselves. Also, when the previous managers had something they wanted to communicate, they would do so by sending out a flier to each tenant and communicating the same message to all. With Park Place, baseless complaints by neighbors were followed up by mailing out warnings and threats to fine, without even the courtesy of a flier, phone call or email, to inquire about the situation, which would have quickly resolved the misunderstanding. Notices to enter the premises were also mailed out 24-48 hours beforehand, barely enough time to make plans to make sure we were there. The previous management never did any of these things. With other properties I've lived in, I've always received all of my deposit back, except for carpet cleaning and painting. With Park Place, most of my deposit ($500 out of $900) was kept due to fixing things that were actually brought to their attention about a year earlier, were supposed to be fixed but never were (floor tiles that were not secured permanently), resulting in around $400 in labor being taken out of the deposit; (labor that they were supposed to provide, but didn't until after we moved out). More money was also kept for cleaning things that were either already clean or weren't there. ie. "Dust/bugs in living room lighting fixtures", however there are no lighting fixtures in the living room, that's why we had to use lamps. "Cleaning microwave, top of fridge, sink", all of which were already thoroughly cleaned. "Filling nail holes", which we already did. So despite staying in contact with them about things that needed to be repaired, treating the property inside and out as if it were my own, (ie. replacing outside hose myself, watering dry grass patches, replacing kitchen lighting myself, picking up neighbors garbage in the surrounding area, tossing trash bags left outside the bin into the dumpster on several occasions, picking up other dogs' poop, etc.) thoroughly cleaning everything that needed to be and more (resulting in sore shoulders and bleeding finger tips, not worth the small return), and paying out the rest our lease, even though we wouldn't there anymore, (all of which you should do anyway, but I've heard horror stories of people who do the exact opposite) I still wasn't treated like a good tenant. Given this experience, I cannot recommend renting from them.

I've been twice now. Once on a Wednesday and once on a Saturday - both times for breakfast. 
This place is interesting. Very much a coffee shop kind of vibe, but they essentially have a full menu all day. Not just pastries like most coffee shops. The coffee is excellent. Food was good. Service leaves something to be desired. Do not come in here and expect fast service. The Wednesday morning we went there was no explanation given as to why the service was so slow. The coffee drinks are made on the spot, so I expect a little wait for that. The downside is only one person at a time can make the specialty drinks. Very inefficient. 
That being said, the Groundhog's Day coffee drink is definitely worth the wait!
My first visit was with the hubby. He got the biscuits & gravy that comes with two eggs and home fries. The home fries were really good and had chopped onions and bell peppers. The gravy was just ok. I got the breakfast quesadilla. It was really good and I'd order it again. 
My second visit was a Saturday morning (10am) with a friend. The first waitress took our drink order, told us they were very understaffed and then left. About 5 minutes later a different waitress came to take our drink order - again. Luckily we had some catching up to do because we didn't see waitstaff again for close to 15 minutes. This time I got the avocado toast with chopped bacon. It was really good. But seriously, it's toast with mashed up avocado and chopped up bacon. It shouldn't have been such a long wait for that and my friends scrambled eggs with cheese.
As we were leaving our original waitress was telling us about local entertainment on Friday evenings, and that they have a full dinner menu with beer and wine. I asked if they did mimosas in the mornings and she enthusiastically told me "Yes. I guess I should have offered that when you came in". They do not have this listed on any of the menus, posted anywhere nor was it communicated to us as we were thinking about our order.
It's definitely a fun place to hang out and catch up with my girlfriends. We'll just know before we go what to expect. However, my hubby was completely turned off by the service we received and then my next experience. This is not the place for a quick bite to eat. And if you have questions about something, be sure to ask as the waitstaff really just focuses taking your order and then delivering the food.
And watch your ticket. Our 3rd waitress of the morning got ours switched up twice.

This place may be geared towards kids, but we went with a bunch of adults for a birthday and had a blast. The trampolines, games, climbing, slides, putt putt, and lazer tag offered lots of fun for a wide variety of people. The staff were helpful and good natured. Totally worth it, would absolutely go back!
Ordered through Doordash. Processed by Alyssa per the receipt. Food was cold. Drinks missing from the order. Wrong sauces included. Pulehu steak was super bland. Won't be ordering from here again.

My daughter and I joined a friend today for lunch. Staff were very friendly, helpful,  and accepting of our youngest diner.  Even the other diners were happy to play with her!  I would definately choose to meet a friend here again.  We had the Nana's Club with avacado, and the house chicken noodle soup. Oh my, the soup was to die for, will be back for this veggie loaded spiciness.  My latte was scrumptious, rustic, and perfect.  Can't wait to return.

I purchased the Ultimate Birthday Party package ($375.00) for my sons birthday last Sunday. I was told we could not bring in any beverages or food because Urban Air had its own cafe and we would need to purchase it from them during the party. 

When we arrived for the party, their Cafe had signs on the counter stating they were "out of pizza", they were "out of C02" so they couldn't provide any soda or well drinks, and they couldn't sell any adult beverages because they didn't have an employee working that was over the age of 18. I contacted the front desk staff who stated there was no manager on duty and the manager "Justine" would call me on Monday.

On Monday I received a call from Justine and I explained the situation and my frustration with being unable to provide additional food and drinks to my sons friends and his parents. After hearing what happened she offered me a 10% discount on the party price or three free entry passes. Really ?  This was unacceptable and I asked to speak with her manager or the owner. She told me she would have her manager call me by Wednesday. Needless to say I never received the phone call.

We will not be having another party there again and I urge everyone to find somewhere else to have your special event.

I am sitting at home alone, feeling delightfully relaxed and looking gorgeous. My face is professionally made up, and I surprisingly don't look the least bit like Tammy Faye Baker. Under my smoky eyes and primed and perfected skin tone, my skin has been masked, moisturized, and microdermabrasioned to a silky smooth luster. But wait, there's more! My body has been pummeled and oiled into langorous submission, and my feet - well, my feet were treated better today than a hot stripper at a lumberjack convention. 

All for $110 (plus tips), thanks to Living Social and a little foresight on my part. Further, everybody in this pampering oasis was incredibly friendly (not always a given in the spa world) and I left without being harangued into purchasing any product. 

My only problem? My husband has gone hunting and I have nowhere to be with my gorgeous face and beautiful ruby toenails. Alas!

I walked in for a soda.  I work nearby so this location is good for a quick snack or drink.  First I'm grossed out because Kenny has a huge group of hickeys on his neck.  He gets behind the desk to take my order and he's got a post-it note over his name tag that read "my name is Kenny and I'm gay."

I asked him if he thought that was appropriate and he snatched it off his tag.  

I don't know of any place of business that would condone this appearance or allow an employee to joke about someone's orientation.

If you haven't been to Le peep for brunch you're missing out. Locally owned Le Peep is a fantastic breakfast brunch and lunch place.

My husband loves to get eggs Benedict and I love to get the egg ham and cheese sandwich on a croissant with fresh fruit on the side. Sometimes I'll splurge and get French toast but on this particular day I had the breakfast sandwich. It's always more than what I can finish so I end up having a lunch about three hours later.

The restaurant is typically busy so go and plan to wait about 15 minutes for a table if you go during rush hour. It is worth the wait though!

I am new to Idaho and I haven't had my hair dyed since I've moved here and was nervous if It would come out the way I hoped. To my surprise and excitement my hair stylist Afton was AMAZING! She did a fantastic job at making me feel comfortable and did a fantastic job on the cutting and dying of my hair! I was worried my boyfriend was going to have an issue with the length and color but even he loves it! I will not be going to anyone else from now on!

We are thoroughly disappointed with this property management. If you are looking for a professional company that resolves property issues, noise complaints and any other renting issues in a timely fashion, please do yourself a favor and look elsewhere. My wife and I have been residents of Idaho for 12 years and in that time have never encountered such a sub par leasing company. Good luck to those new renters out there!

Our drinks had good presentation and generous proportions, and tasted pretty nice. However, the service was sub-par. The sit-down format is a bit impractical for a couple drinks, as we sat waiting with drinks pushed to the middle, masks on, wallet ready for about 15 minutes before we were even checked on. The interior didn't quite live up to the photos, as it seems that over the years, tacky, hilariously expensive artwork and clutter has replaced simplicity and class seen in the photos. Proper mask-wearing could also be improved by the staff. Still, nice coffee.
Lots of nice furniture but not a consignment store as I thought. Super friendly staff. Zero pressure. Worth stopping by if you're in the market.

This place recently opened up near us and we have been wanting to try it. Finally made it in for lunch today and were pleasantly surprised! You can either do your seafood fried or boiled. We tried the Oyster Po Boy- delicious- and Cajun fries- a great flavor! We also tried the lobster tail basket- YUM! We haven't ever tried fried lobster but it was great! Lastly, we tried the boiled shrimp(head off) in the old bay seasoning. It comes with boiled red potatoes and corn on the cob. So so good!! You get 1 lb of meat and you can mix and match the meats as well with a big variety! We will definitely be coming back.

I like Flying Pie's pizza. They have great sauce and they load on the toppings. I mean LOAD them on. The crust has decent flavor, though it is a bit thick for my preference. I love all their unique combinations. The Habanero is incredible but wowsa... it is hot! I really liked their garlic chicken. Great flavor and the white sauce was not overpowering. 

I love that we can get draft beer or wine DELIVERED right to our front door. It doesn't even seem legal, but I'll take it! 

Even though I like their pizza, it remains at 3 stars for me for a few reasons. It is really expensive. They always send out coupons, which are a must for us to be able to afford them. They are also a bit slow. It takes maybe 15-20 minutes for the pizza to arrive to your table. And be sure to plan ahead if doing delivery or carry-out. We have waited 1.5 hours to get our delivery. Also be careful using their online ordering system. We completed an order once for carry out at their Meridian Location and when we went to pick it up...they didn't have our order in their system and said that online ordering wasn't even an option for their location? Totally could have been user error...but I don't know. Lastly, we tried to use their Yelp Check-In deal (20% off when you check-in on Yelp!), but after waiting through 2 employees who had no idea what to do, we couldn't wait any longer and had to leave without our discount. That was a bummer.

We rented through pro core. When we moved in the property was dirty. We were advised to get the garbage disposal to work by "stick a broom handle or pole into the sink and jam it around". Work order requests were only completed if we called and emailed multiple times (it took a week for the carpet tacks to be covered while my 6 month old cut his legs or we stepped on a new one). We rented with them for a 4 month period. It was the tail end of the lease of someone who bought through them and was released from their lease. 
     Out of our 1650$ deposit they returned 590$. You may be thinking that we left it a mess... Not the case! 400$ alone was for the carpet cleaning which is outlined in the lease as it will be done but not outlined what the cost to you will be. When I asked for photos of the rest it was minor things that I didn't quite wipe down (a portion of the tv wall unit where it goes into the wall) or the outside wall which daily accumulated debris. They do not allow you to do a final walk thru or an initial walk thru with them so pretty much they can take whatever they want. 
     Bottom line, take lots of pictures! This was our first time renting in 7 years and I will be thankful to hopefully never again. I definetly have learned for next time though.

As a reformed "dentist hater", the fact that Dr. Cox and his team have addressed ALL of my reservations relative to dentistry is a sincere compliment. They not only provide great quality care, they provide efficient, yet personable care. They do NOT overs-schedule treatments, and are extremely helpful in handling billing and insurance issues. I have ALWAYS received great care, but in my most recent treatment, was impressed by their new hygienist Amy. As hard as it is to imagine, I actually ENJOYED going to the dentist!

To the always cheerful employee who rang up my order today (8-29-18) around noon - thank you! I had cut my finger and needed a bandaid. You not only brought me that but also some antibacterial ointment. It probably seemed small to you, but it helped me a lot! Thank you for your thoughtfulness.

We have been taking our Bulldog to sit means sit since she was 8 weeks old. Everywhere we take her people are amazed at how well behaved she is. She is now over a year old and we continue to challenge her in the classes she takes. She is well on her way to becoming one of the best dogs in the Treasure Valley. Thanks to Jim and Devan for helping us show that Bulldogs can be people and animal friends.

People are great, service is great and the food is good. However, if you think that your customers don't notice when you use the same rag that you use to clean the counter to clean the frothing mechanism of the espresso machine, you're mistaken. It's not only disgusting, it's dangerous to your customers. And it was repeated at least a dozen times while I was there. It may not be worth it to come back.

Do not take your phone here!!!!

A few months ago my phone had some water damage from steam in the bathroom (didn't even know this was possible). Now, the phone was still KIND of working, and I even have photos on my camera roll from this day, after the steam damage had occurred and before I took it in to get fixed. After having them repair the phone my front camera no longer worked. I called and was told they said it was probably from the water damage... but it worked after the water damage had occurred. After having my repaired phone for about a week or so the front screen came detached from the phone and was literally falling out of the phone.  They had told me this is probably due to the adhesive that they use not being as strong as the factory adhesive. I took it back to get it fixed and they charged me (half price , but still irritated) to put the screen back in place. I asked if they would fix the camera while they had it and he said he would try. The camera only worked for a couple of hours before it went out again, and after a few weeks the rear camera stopped working as well.

This is kind of unrelated but worth noting; at one point I had my father go to pick up the phone for me and they charged his card THREE times. They said the payment system wasn't working, and it could've been a mistake but my father was not happy with the way they handled the return of the funds.

I would never recommend this place to anyone. Just take your phone to Apple, it may be more expensive but they'll do it right.

These guys are amazing!! All of them are so friendly and courteous and eager to help. My phone was not working in the most simple aspect - it could not take or place calls and I also could not check voicemail - all because I had no audio in or out! When you're in a business where phone calls are key, the issue is crippling! These guys understood that and provided top notch service. They worked quickly and got my phone fixed as soon as possible. Communication was top notch as well. I will recommend this repair store to everyone I know, for any and ALL electronics issues! I seriously don't think I could have gotten better service!!!

I applied to rent a property through Park Place.  The person that had previously lived in the house I wanted to rent had clogged the sinks and flooded the house before leaving.  After dealing with them, I'm somehow not surprised.  They declined our application based on information we had given to them prior to even filling the application out.  They told us we wouldn't have a problem, took the $70 fee, then decided not to rent to us, not because of anything on our background or credit checks.  I emailed the office manager because I understand that background and credit checks cost money, but seeing as those weren't the cause of the lack of willingness to rent to us, and nothing had changed on our end from when we told we'd be good to go, I felt that it was rather shady to take our money and then change her mind, but to no avail.  I'd advise staying away from this place.
This place is so cute. Fantastic friendly service. The Benny was AMAZING! And the coffee is huge! Will definitely be back!

the owner rudely came up and told my 5 yr old he can't break up the crayons because it makes a mess. seriously? sadly, his over-the-top bad attitude toward my child gave his restaurant a one star. when we told him to next time talk to us as the parents if he's offended at child activities at a breakfast table, he snapped back that he felt its messy and disagreed with us. then his restaurant should not pass out crayons to kids and then bark at the children like they are animals!! one of the servers there said the owner lost 3 servers this same week because of his poor management and destructive behavior. BEWARE. they are always losing employees due to his awfulness. notice on the from of the restaurant "now hiring". there is a reason for that. we were regulars there, but never again. we've been to thousands of restaurants across the nation and we've never in our lives ever had an experience like that with an employee let alone the owner! bad business man. bad person.

Went in as a group of 6 moms with multiple toddlers... we all agreed these were delicious! 

I ordered cream cheese frosting topped with fresh strawberries. Cream cheese was light and tasty, cinnamon roll was soft and fresh. 

Others at our table were a fan of the peanut butter on top of their cinnamon roll. Peanut butter tasted as if it were homemade. 

I'd love to try it again... you know... to make sure it's just as yummy!
Meh. Not an amazing cinnamon roll. Just a plain ok cinnamon roll topped with oodles (of your choice) of  sickly sweet sweet caloric toppings. Nice to try once but I won't be back.

I went to the emissions place in Star and it said "Open" I waited and waited.  No one was there.   I checked my phone and found Emissions Testing Pro's in Meridian.  Scott was so nice and made it a good experience.  They are fast and reasonable.  I even got a discount.

Took my Wheaton in for the first time last week for a grooming. The job was by far the worst I've ever seen, nothing short of a butcher job. I swear it looks like the groomers first job ever. 
I'll never go back and will never recommend this business.

Lots of fun and very agreeable staff! I came to this location as part of a family reunion with about 25 other people and most of used the Idaho GetOut Pass to access the park. When there was an issue with the service that we were supposed to get through the Pass, the staff allowed us to simply use the rest of the park as well. The guy at the concessions stand was very friendly, as were all of the safety monitors. Truly a lot of fun for all ages.

We had a great family breakfast here while visiting Boise. The staff was super friendly and made our experience very pleasant. The food was delicious and the coffee (americano) was spot-on. We'll definitely be back!

My husband and I are from Seattle and visit Meridian a few times a year and every time we visit we visit Deja Brew for breakfast.  The breakfast is always delish, the outside patio is beautiful and the service is always great.  Over 
Memorial day weekend when we were in town we took my in-laws for breakfast.  We had the absolute BEST service from Becky!  Becky was friendly, personable and went above and beyond to make sure all of our needs were attended to.  
Thank you Becky for making our visit such a treat!

I have attended this church since 2002. This is my home. My church family. If you are looking for solid biblical teaching, and an environment where you will be loved, and challenged, than Harvest Church is the place for you! Wonderful worship where the presence of God is felt, and experienced. Passionate people who seek to grow in the knowledge of our savior, and in understanding of the word of God. It's the real deal ! !

Just got back from Urban air.   Forgot covid. This place was nasty.  Packed with way too many people, they tried to get people to leave that had certain wrist bands on but no one left.  However they keep letting people in.   People were sitting on the floor , other adults sat in baby boosters seats. So many bodies everywhere and so many rude people cutting kids in line and shoving other kids.  The bathroom was a nightmare with period blood all over a  toilet.  I am not worried about covid ( that's why I go to jump places).  It was just plain nasty, no air, rude semi violent customers, clueless staff, don't even think about going into the bathroom, be prepared to wait an hour in line to get a small bag of popcorn kinda day. My recommendation. NEVER GO ON A WEEKEND
Amazing staff. Amazing patio. Amazing coffee. Love it here! We only stopped in for coffee. Next time we will try the food. It looked yummy!
Nice setup and brings some much needed variety to the Boise area. Having lived down south this is a true seafood boil low country style!  Will definitely be back!

Great service and decent food. I probably would've given 4 stars except that it came up as a dog friendly restaurant and that was not the case. It has outdoor seating listed which is only seasonal for this location. Update this listing and you'll be good to go!

Saw that there was live music there, my wife and I miss that so much with the Pandemic times. We drove away to get there last night as we live in Boise but it was SOOOO worth the drive. Nice décor, awesome menu. All we got was wine and cheese cake but we were eying all the dinner plates others got for next time. LOL The music was very VERY good, just a great time out for sure!

ACCESS HEATING AND AIR, DON'T EVER TRUST THEM ...
So I'm wondering how ethical it is when somebody comes out sells you one AC system, installs something completely different, without telling you, when you notice they come up with several different excuses first will run better with your furnace, then they were out of stock on your unit and didn't know it until they were halfway out the door on Monday, and then for absolutely no reason they just decided to step up and put in a much more expensive unit "at no cost to you you, we lost money on this", why would someone do that for absolutely no reason ... arranged for one set of staff to come to your house that knows where everything is, then try to send another crew and get mad because you won't allow them to do it (dogs in the house, liability etc) then you take the day off to go be at your home for the install, they accuse you of not trusting their staff because you won't give complete strangers complete run of your home without you in it. Then you spend weeks chasing paperwork that should have been handed over on delivery, now they're trying to walk away from their install warranty because" this is too stressful and they're losing money". this is the most unethical and dishonest situation I have ever seen in this house and trust me I've seen a lot. 3 years ago these people replaced my furnace, I've done nothing but praise them for that situation, that's why I didn't shop it I figured they had earned the business with the AC, now I'm starting to wonder what's underneath my house. They didn't actually deserve all that praise they sold me a garbage unit and then stepped up and replaced it before it turned into a big battlE, that's the way business should be done. I guess they figure that gives them the right to to rip me off on this part of the job, I trusted them and didn't even shop it. Who does that? Sells you one unit puts another one in and then fights you when you ask for paperwork, that's as shady as it gets, access heating and air, don't ever trust them!!! And apparently, they didn't pull permits.
Great alternative to Joe's Crab Shack.  Lots of parking and friendly staff.  Great food!

I came here on a Sunday morning around 11 am so I was expecting a wait but we only had to wait 20 minutes AND they let us call ahead to put our name on the waitlist. Once we sat down, we ordered right away and our food took a while to come out. It was plain, nothing special. I would come back again though because it was cheap and good if you're looking for something simple

0 for 4 on our recent orders, in terms of preparing the order as requested.  This last time it was tacos missing cheese, sour cream, and lettuce.  Preparation is also very inconsistent compared to other Chipotles.  This last order also had soggy chips...yup soggy.  There's nothing complex about the orders they are getting wrong either.  I can't understand how the quality could be so very poor.  I love Chipotle, but I cannot recommend this location at all.

Do yourself a favor and pass on this place. Joe Mommas and Hot Spot Cafe are right around the corner and offer fresh choices and better service than Le Peep.

I've been here many times and keep hoping the "new" cook will be better this visit. It's been hit and miss, but lately the misses have been greater and greater. It's time to say Good-bye. But let me give you the skinny before I go...

The Food: Chicken Fried steak is frozen and Corned Beef Hash is from a can. Hash browns are cold and sometimes icy in the middle. The Peasant Potatoes are better but usually under-cooked and crunchy. Better when I took them home and finished cooking them with a little onion.

My last visit: The Monte Cristo Crepes were very good according to my 10 year old granddaughter. 

My trout was so burnt it was black all around the edges, and so dry it was inedible. The female manager came over, apologized, and said the server should have never brought it to the table - and brought me a 2nd one which was much, much better.

Per my husband, the hamburger was dry and tasteless. The male manager came over and was a total JERK about the burger. Said when ordering lunch for breakfast, that could sometimes happen. It was 11 am!

The staff is a revolving door due to the poor management style. He has a pious manner and I have heard him berate the staff in the middle of a busy service - not cool, dude. Compliment in public, reprimand in private.
And leave the religious music for after hours. He is argumentative to the customers or dismisses them by saying they should talk to their server. C'mon. Man up. You are the manager, are you not? Then manage!

DD - out.

I found an ad of theirs online. Called to ask various questions and was treated like royalty on the phone. The next day, I went in for several items. Again, I had many questions regarding inventory, options, etc. Within 30 minutes I was out of there with everything I needed for my new office, same day delivery within two hours of my purchase and an excellent experience. The staff was friendly, knowledgeable and fun. The delivery folks were on time, kind, accommodating and very professional. Mad props, keep up the great work!

Very happy with janie! Sold our house n bought the house of our dreams through her! I wouldve  Given her 5 stars if we received a congratulations card and/or gift like we've gotten in the past  from realators  when buying n  selling a house!

Called them today and asked how far they were booked out. Wasn't expecting them to say come on down now. They had my dog done before they closed and they did an excellent job. Same day service! Love it! The staff was so kind! Definitely will be bringing my dog back to All About Paws.

It's somewhat hit or miss but when they get it right, man is it awesome.

Like a lot of the smaller local chains, consistency would be my only minor criticism, but here's the good:

The pizza is next level, incomparable to the average pizza chain.  Dough is thick and chewy, sauce has a deep, dark richness about it, and the toppings are super quality.  When they cook it right, it's one of the better pies Ive had.  And when they get it wrong, we kindly ask them to make us another and they always oblige.

The salad bar seems meticulously put together, great selection of different greens, and a bunch of ingredients beyond the typical including artichoke hearts.

The complimentary bread is simply so good it's surprising they give it away for free.

The bar section is sufficiently quaint, helps to maintain the youthful spirit of the place while still offering a bunch of different beers, which they'll happily let you taste test before you decide on one.  

As for the feel of the place, it's got a hip young diy warmth to it, without being pretentious at all.  Reminds me of an 80s clubhouse, with a few classic arcade games in the back.  Very welcoming, and hard to leave.  We usually stay for an hour and a half or so and just enjoy the vibe. 

Fortunate to have this unique and fun pizza place.  On a busy weekend night when the staff is on top of their game, there's almost no other restaurant in town I'd rather be.

I have given this store a couple shots thinking how bad can you screw up a chain store?  Pizza Hut is Pizza Hut right?....How hard can it be?  First off answer the fricken phone?  The phone rang approximately seven times and then sent me to an automated service asking me if I wanted to hear the specials or if I was ready to order.  I was ready to order so I hit the designated number. Well I guess the system knew the store was unavailable to take my order and then chose to send me to some #800 center where apparently several hundred people are employed to just take the overflow Pizza Hut calls.  Interesting.....but okay let's just get the order in and my delivery going.  Well this person located somewhere in the US can't find my address in google maps, which has been happening because it is new construction.  So she says she has to transfer me back to the store where they will know more about the local area.  I said the local store is not answering which is how I then got to her.  She says, well they will answer for us!  What the hell?  So she gets back on and says when I transfer you back you will be on hold and someone will be right with you.  I was on hold for 7 minutes.  Service sucks.

Please understand, given our location we have very few options.  Sooooo I hung up and called back this time someone answered.  Delivery was going to be 2 hours so we decided to do pick up.  All three pizzas were over cooked and horrible.  I WILL NOT visit this store again.
First time here - the service was excellent and the seafood was great! Our server Haden was top notch, and we just loved the food. Cant wait to go back

A cool little place with some great pub food. Reasonable prices and good atmosphere. The reason it gets a poor rating is the service. Unfortunately we get the same waitress "the only one " every time we go. Very unfriendly, slow, and if you're not a regular, your pretty much on your own after the food arrives. I may go back, but if I see the same waitress, I'll go somewhere else.
Called in order told would be ready at 11:45 got there and still waited 40 minutes to be told they were just starting our order so we paid for our drinks and left very crappy service
File a small claims civil suit if you want change!!! I won my lawsuit today against PPM by default!! Wahoo!! They are dishonest to the maximum! I recooped my security deposit and prorated back rent.

Came in on a Sunday morning they weren't busy at all. Service was great my husband and I i both ordered the biscuits and gravy, they were  delicious. The potatoes could be a bit crispier but the seasoning on them was great. We both had  iced coffee they were delicious  too we'll definitely be back!

Run far away from this company. We rented a house in Eagle from them while we built, and can't say anything good. Our air conditioning went out in the upstairs over summer, and it took over 6 weeks to get it repaired. Leaving the house upstairs over 90*
Anything that broke they didn't fix it. The house was filthy when we moved in. We made notes of all damages, but didn't note things that weren't there, like screens on windows. 
When we moved out we were charged for missing screens, cleaning a sliding glass door, when the house didn't have one, cleaning the house after we had it professionally cleaned. When we called to discuss they had us fill out a dispute form, and then they ignored it. 
They're dishonest and only concerned about themselves. Stay far away.

Can't make french toast to save their life! They don't soak the bread long enough in the egg mixture. It was dry inside, they flipped the bread in the egg mixture and then put it on the griddle and it seems like they poured egg mixture over the bread while on the griddle. As it had huge crusty egg runoff edges that made it even more unappealing. 

Bounding overwatch micromanagement from what appeared to the stern faced female owner. Instead of quality control and coming around to each table to see how meals were and welcoming guests she ran around without purpose. Additionally when I went to the cashier stand the owner just stared at me and did not even speak to me, to inquire about my meal, or even to say have a nice day. 

Coffee was not very good, bitter and weak. Way too expensive. Perhaps if you at least we're served real cream with it I could accept the Starbucks price (at least at Starbucks I'm not getting shelf stable "creamer" like I did here)

I don't know how you can have a Cajun restaurant without Gumbo or Jambalaya.

The food was good, not great. Joes Crab shack has better steam pots and options.

The po boys are good, but not worth the 10$ price range.
This Panera is the worst one I've been to. I ordered a sandwich most of which was bread as you can see by the photo. Avoid this one- the Panera by the mall is much better. So irritating.

I'm not one to write bad reviews but this company has such poor business practices and communication it is warranted. I first ordered a couch, which they confirmed was in stock to find out the day of delivery they didn't have it and it would take 8 + weeks to reorder.  

I then tried again to order a ceiling light (which I was told would be delivered on the weekly shipment). I never received a call for pick up; went in 1 month later to find out the item was no longer available. I never received a call and was charged. 

I removed and got rid of my old ceiling light in preparation for the new one and I have since been dining in the dark (thinking it would only be a few days, not a month). Now I have to scramble to find a new one to have light while we host Christmas. This business needs to verify inventory and improve communications. Will not be wasting my time on them again

Ordered for delivery to my mother and grandmother on mother's day weekend.  Excellent customer service, prices, quality and prompt arrival.  A simple, yet thoughtful gift!  I chose to go through the same florist last year as I live out of state from them

Holy clamshells I was surprised by the quality of this venue. I was having a grumpy day (they don't care) having woken up with sleep paralysis (stop writing Justin this is irrelevant) and that threw me into a really weird mood (for the love of God please stop) but my dad still wanted to go get lunch with me thankfully. WAM! Suddenly we were having FANTASTIC seafood!

Everything we ordered: Clam chowder, steamed clams, fried oyster po boy, garlic bread. It was all really good! Even the presentation of my sandwich was lovely. I ordered an additional side of aioli preemptively but I really didn't need to, my meal was perfect. And I'd say the pricing is pretty good too. I've been to New Orleans several times... and such comparisons aren't really fair, but you can get a po boy twice the size for the same price there. That being said, I'm amazed by the taste and quality of the sea food considering the location of Idaho.  

The decor of the restaurant is super jazzy and fun. This would be a great place to bring a first date to kinda say, "hey let's just loosen up and have a silly goose time, it's no worries. See! Look how slap-happy and fun this place is?! It's okay if we don't get along and this keeps happening to both of us until we are assuredly going to die alone or with someone we just settled with! Let's have some seafood!"

Lastly I want to touch on the service of this place (that came out wrong). Our servers were amazing. Our waiter was great, the greeter was great, random people we talked to and asked about the restaurant were great. Two thumbs up. 

But now I have to get to the reason I took away a star... I'm sorry; we were having so much fun. One of the servers walked by us and I could smell cigarette smoke. I'm highly allergic so it's easy for me to tell. If you're a manager, please please please don't throw the baby out with the bath water, maybe just make sure the staff keeps away from that sorta ordeal until work time is over. My dad and I loved each and every person we interacted with here, and we feel they're all deserving of praise. 

So that's it that's what I got. New place to get some great food in Meridian! Hurray!

Server deserves 5 stars.  The food .. 3.5-4.  It was extremely saucy and kind of one note... spicy.  I think I might enjoy another one of their sauce options.  But the environment is fun and as I mentioned service was excellent.

Their staff is pretty interesting, had one guy who was super friendly, one guy who acted like he didn't care what day of the week it was, and another guy who seemed like ex military-ultra serious. All of them down to earth and extremely knowledgeable. They gave sound advice during my gun build and carry the highest quality gun components (you'll spend your paycheck). Their prices are somehow just as competitive as you can find online though. Support your local gun shop

Absolutely not happy, I went to take my 2010 camaro for a wheel alignment. Cost wasnt the issue it was fair priced at 85. The problem was upon getting back into my car the smell of my burnt clutch was apparent.  Whoever is doing the tire linement on the vehicles doesn't know how to drive a vehicle with the clutch it's noticeably damaged and the whole cab of my vehicle smells like it's on fire. Would not recommend to anyone. When I asked why the vehicle smelled like my clutch was burnt. Chris replied the vehicle has to be driven that way. I disagree, unprofessional an end result is a burnt clutch and my car still pulls to the left. Had my chevy serviced as well with no issues. I really cant believe my vehicle was given back to me in that condition compared to my prior service. The owner unfortunately wasnt around.  usually the who helps me out, really nice guy. Still speechless
So yummy! Must try! Friendly staff , clean and if you're an essential worker, you get a discount!

My favorite Del Taco a huge disappointment today.
No one else in restaurant this morning.  I ordered a burrito  and it was ready  before I was even finished at the counter. It was barely even warm. No reason for this. Should have been prepared fresh but this was not fresh or hot! Wont be back here anytime soon.

It was our first time and it was as amazing! We have been wanting to try it for a while and I am glad we finally went for a date night. We usually go to Joes Crab Shack for crab but we are so over their lame food lol. Husband and I shared the meal for 2 and it was so much food. We got the snow crab (1 1/4 lb) and then shrimp (1 lb) and mussels (1lb) for $46.00 and it came with 4 potatoes and 2 corn on the cob. We got the house spice in mild and oh my gosh it tasted so good! At Joes we usually get the old bay seasoning but we tried something different today and we are so glad we did! Service was wonderful as well. Yes, the food was messy but that is what it's all about! They give you a bib and gloves if you want to stay "clean" but we like to dig in. It's finger licking good food. Can't wait to come back for my bday. Also, the shrimp chips are so good too!!

Park Place is a good property management company. They have managed a rental home for me for several years and overall they've done a great job. Kelly is the Property Manager, she's on top of it. I've always received funds and statements like clockwork, rent has steadily increased and they've done a good job of holding onto longer term tenants. Sure there have been occasional bumps in the road, but that's how it sometimes goes when you own real estate. I'm satisfied with PPPM as my prop mgmt company.
This is a terrific family owned business that is greatly missed during this pandemic when they reopen let's all support them to reestablish this loved place

I was actually surprised to see how unimpressive this place was after hearing reviews from coworkers. We arrived fairly early on a Saturday night, approximately 5 PM. The place only had 4 to 5 tables full. We were told that our pizza would take 45 minutes, and it ended up taking close to an hour. The free breadsticks are nothing more then cooked bread without much flavor. When the pizza came, it was tough and nothing special. The price was pretty expensive, and the place was fairly dirty. Needless to say, I will be choosing something else from here on out.
Stopped at Mo' Bettahs as we were passing through on a road trip. It lived up to the reviews which brought us there. Great place for a quick fast service bite! Will stop again.

My favorite Hawaiian restaurant and by far the best, my family and friends love the food and the staff. The macaroni salad is to die for and keto lovers the Pulehu Chicken is amazing! If you love Hawaiian food you need to give Mo'bettahs a try some the best food I've ever had.

My brother clued me in to give this place a try. This being my first time in, I have to honestly say it was a great experience. The lady taking our order graciously got
my wife and I a sample of the wine and beer choices we wanted to make sure we'd like them. 

They served us a complementary order of breadsticks to start us off. Very tasty. 

We opted for a pizza with sour dough crust and was that ever a delightful treat!  Pizza was cooked exceptionally well leaving us actually wanting more than the 10" size we ordered.

Every person we engaged with treated us well. Everyone seemed happy to be working here which made it more enjoyable to dine in on the first visit.

Excellent breakfast! Between the five of us (2 adults and 3 kids) we had a cheese omelet with the fixins, scrambled eggs, stuffed French toast (mmm) and the dawn breaker. It was all perfect. 
I also really love when I get an entire carafe of coffee for the table. Give me ALL the coffee...
The servers were also great. Overall two thumbs up!
I called them quite last minute and they made it work!  I was moving a client into a new home and the crew Denise sent went out of their way to accommodate us!  Nice people too!  Thanks Denise!

Tried this for breakfast, cause calories on Saturdays don't count. I was very pleasently surprised. There were lots of different flavors of frosting and toppings. I ended up getting the macadamia nut frosting with strawberries and blueberries. There was just enough frosting to get some in every bit. But not to much where your gaging on the sweetness. The rolls were warm and fluffy and had the perfect amount of cinnamon. Definitely will be trying this place again.  The only downside is that they only have outdoor seating. And the tables do not have heaters. We ended up meandering to another restaurant and buying coffee so we could sit there.

I'm 20 years old and I moved here from Washington state two weeks ago, needless to say I'm pretty tight on money at the moment. I rescued two kittens that had pretty severe upper respiratory infections and some nasty eye infections. I unfortunately took them to pet care clinic for treatment and prescriptions. The doctor was relentless about testing them both for Parvo ($65 each I think) and when I said I could only test one- which should be fine because it's a highly contagious disease and they have been together for 8 weeks at this point, the doctor caught quite the attitude. I started to get that vibe that she only saw my two babies as numbers on her paycheck, but I wanted to make sure they were healthy and nobody had openings for the rest of this month because of COVID. We went ahead and tested the one for Parvo, which came back negative and left paying over $250. When we got home to give the medicine, I noticed it was only prescribed to one cat for 10 days and that it was set to expire 3 days into the treatment. When we called and asked if it was going to expire they told us that it doesn't say that anywhere on the bottle? Obviously the medication only lasted 5 days for the two cats and when I called in for a refill for my half prescription, the doctor said she is "uncomfortable" prescribing anything without seeing the cats. They said it would be another $45 for them to look at them to give me the rest of my prescription. At this point I'm two weeks into looking for a job, and had rent to pay. I explained that she only gave me half a prescription and the kitties are doing much better but I was anxious to just stop halfway through treatment. The receptionist- Kimber I think, went seriously out of her way to try to explain to the doctor that I just needed the medicine and I could feel that she was very genuine and worried for me and my babies but the doctor wouldn't bother listening. When I asked to speak to the doctor directly, she was "busy." Big shout out to Kimber for her excellent customer service. 
 This doctor does not care about your pets/ fur babies, she cares about the money she can suck out of you and it is extremely apparent. She is condescending and rude. I would never recommend her to anyone.
Checked in online to notify that I was there for curbside pickup & waited 25 minutes. So I called and the order was the ready the whole time. The food was cold.
The team came out promptly and offered a fair price for the services performed. They were professional and Courteous.

We've had a Christmas Eve tradition for 6 years now that we would go to dinner in Bodo, and Urban Outfitters- where we each got a treat, gift for the 3 neighbor kids, and I'd sneak some cool stocking stuffers in too. Average purchase $200 not bad. 

Well. They moved to the village so we came up here and  attempted our tradition. 

The employees here are rude, arrogant and elitist. 
Listen kiddo, I've been shopping at urban Outfitter since you were in diapers. 

When I addressed it, they were nonchalant and smug. I put my items all down where I stood and walked out - will never. Ever. Come back 

This isn't the first establishment I've seen move to the Village and get too big for their britches. Just the most disappointing fo

*pssst Bodo is was more swanky thank the Village guys* 

2018 update. Thought we'd try it again.  I upped the stars to 2 bc This time the staff was much nicer but the stock is predominately for girls and we will change our tradition for sure.  Spouse was super nonplussed.  Just isn't the cool urban experience it used to be.

Great selections for the gluten free seekers. I had the Desperado and my daughter had the stuffed French Toast. Both are excellent choices. A friendly and helpful staff and a very clean and bright environment make Le Peep 5 star worthy!

We just moved to Meridian two weeks ago and was happy to find The Joint close to our new home. The drive and move here was tough and our backs took a beating as a result. I'm happy to say that the doctors at this location helped to correct my back and alleviate the pain associated with the move. 
It's tough to beat the service, price and expertise at The Joint Meridian. We would highly recommend to anyone needing injury resolution or general maintenance.

Noooo!!! I was so excited it's for delivery! I placed my order. I used a coupon but somehow it was removed from my order and I lost out on a $5 coupon. Order arrived fairly timely. Got my lunch back to my desk to realize my mocha wasn't even full. Food was mostly warm so I was impressed with that. 

I visit Panera often because when they're good, they're GOOD! Lately those experiences are far and few between. They're making good marketing strategies but now the service needs to follow.

Yay!  I found Mo Bettahs quite by accident but what a sweet surprise.  I lived in the beautiful Hawaiian islands for many years and plate lunch was a regular for me.   Who knew that Meridian Idaho could come this close to the real deal!    Great Teri chicken and mac salad.     The only thing missing is that Hawaiian style stew.  Maybe someday that could be added to the menu.     Great lunch.  Mahalo!!!!!

So happy we found this place! It's amazing!! My husband and I love eating authentic Hawaiian food. I ordered the mini and he ordered a regular half and half and I was so full. Their Mac salad is BOMB. We'll definitely be back!
Wait staff was good. Wife had oyster basket.  Overcooked and too much batter. My shrimp tent was ok but  I've  had better. Will go back and try again. Would have bought a beer but $5.00 is too much.

Not sure how this place has the stars it does. Food and service was a major let down. Pretty sure the eggs were pre-made like you get at a Best Western breakfast so not sure why it took over 20 minutes to get our food. The coffee is the only thing they really have going for them.

Decided to give Le Peep another chance and had a much better encounter than before. Our server provided excellent, friendly service  and the food was first rate. Everyone at our table enjoyed their meal today. Thanks for the super breakfast and much better experience!
World class customer service. Very nice furnishings for a modern or traditional home.

This establishment is family owned and operated and they are good people and they make good food! Every time I've gone there I've always gotten a good friendly welcome and good beer and good food! Their wings are some of the best I've ever had! And they have over 20 different Taps of draft beer! They have 2 pool tables a shuffleboard table in a couple of dart boards as well! Their restaurant is family friendly and they will always greet you with a smile.

This was the best stop we made on our visit to Boise Idaho. The food is amazing and prepared perfectly.  Each of our meals were gifts to our taste buds! We were greeted by Pam who was the poster lady for customer service and her friendly personality made all of us feel so welcome and comfortable. Sherri also helped us experience Deja Brew's generous hospitality with her laughter and heart felt joy. HIGHLY recommend this delightful location for your next meal and coffee. 
Thank you to the entire staff for making it all so enjoyable!!

Our groomer that we have used for many years retired, my wife searched for quite some time to find someone who would do a quality job for a decent price. This was our place- they were very friendly, helpful, and the facility was very clean. They were able to get us in the next day after we called for an appointment. Time for the cut very reasonable and my pups look amazing! Best they've ever looked. Highly recommend this groomer.

I recently moved from San Diego with my Australian Shepherd and had no clue where to start looking for a new groomer. We had some bad experiences in the past before we found a place we loved back home. We were not looking forward to a trial and error process once again. However, I happened to be browsing Facebook and saw that a new coworker used and loved Wags to Riches in Meridian. And their Facebook page had some really great pictures and glowing reviews. I immediately pulled it up on Yelp, but there weren't any yelp reviews yet! I utilize Yelp for everything so I was a little nervous setting up the appointment. But I went ahead and scheduled with Lauren. 

On appointment day we walked in and was immediately pleasantly surprised. The building was very nice and the inside was super clean and welcoming. The best part for us was seeing how comfortable the dogs getting groomed were and the one dog waiting for pickup hanging out with everyone (not in a metal cage in a back room somewhere!) 

Lauren was expecting us and called my dog by name. She also had his new customer paperwork already ready for us. We then showed her a quick picture of how we wanted our pup to look from a past groom and she took one glance, gave a nod and said "Got it."  We were skeptical but hoped for the best. 

About 2 hours later I got the call that he was ready to be picked up. I asked how he did, seeing as this was a new place with new people for him. Lauren responded "You're lucky you are getting him back. He was great!"  

Upon pick up, we couldn't have asked for a better haircut. Dare I say, he looks even better than the picture we showed her. The attention to detail on his feet and ears, and keeping his classic Aussie chest hair shape is impeccable. Lauren was right, she knew what she was doing! 

We will definitely be back soon!
Taco Bell used to be good witch it still is but it's really expensive and there comerciales are terrible. I recommend to eat at this place 3 to 5times a year.

The atmosphere is very theme restaurant. Lobster was overcooked, the garlic butter had almost zero butter flavor, and the crab cakes are the worst I've had from upstate NY all the way to the Oregon Coast. On the other hand, I really enjoyed the heads-on shrimp and the crabmeat fries. Plus nobody else in town is doing this, and they're really close to home, so I'll likely be back. I'll just be careful when deciding what to order. More details at my website if you want them.
This is a great little Barber shop. Anthony is a great Barber and a cool Dude. Small town vibe. Five stars across the board. Perfect for kids on up.
Oh my goodness! The food was delicious, spot on. We will definitely be back.  Staff amazing prompt and courteous.

My wife and I visited this place for the first time a couple of weeks ago. It's a fun and relaxing atmosphere, and the service was great. We both had some really good coffee, and ordered some food. My wife has avocado toast with bacon and loved it. I ordered some sort of breakfast burrito, and it was really good as well.

The staff here couldn't be a kinder bunch. Dave helped my fiancé find and design a unique engagement ring. He can't say enough good things about Dave and how helpful he is. I get compliments on my ring multiple times a day! Gorgeous selection of rings to choose from in the store and Dave is going above and beyond to find unique bands to match my engagement ring. Thank you lee read and Dave!
Very upfront pricing, open communication with suggestions, however I didn't feel pressured to purchase additional services, super quick turn around! I was pleased with their customer service.

Contacted Brandy just a few days before we were set to move into our new home in Middleton. Being from out of state and very pregnant I decided to check companies on Yelp for quotes. I read all reviews and contacted Idahome and a few other cleaning services. Brandy was very prompt in sending me her contact info so we could discuss details. She was very pleasant and professional over the phone. She gave me a verbal quote without seeing the house and her bid was very reasonable. She was able to fit us in right after Thanksgiving before we moved in and worked around another contractor that failed to complete his project on time. Even when it turned out to be a bit more work then was expected, she kept her word at keeping the price at what she verbally quoted!! She does not take advantage of her customers, no matter what state you're coming from. So if you're coming from out of state, like we did, give her a call and see what she can do for you!

This is a great place. Great tasting food for incredible value$$. Huge portions. Friendly staff. Great atmosphere if you decide to eat at the restaurant. We also enjoy their pick-up service on busy nights.

This was my first experience in Le Peep. I headed over on my 15 min break to grab something quick, not knowing what the atmosphere was inside. As I walked through the doors I realized I may have made a mistake. It was a Dine-in cafe, I wasn't going to have enough time. The hostess quickly greeted me with a welcoming smile which drew me in. With the time crunch I was on, I was suggested to get the Gooey Buns. Simpler to cinnamon rolls but so far from it!

Not too shabby to say the least eh? Very delicious burritos and their medium sauce has a delectable kick to it. They have the creamiest sour cream my taste buds have ever came into contact with. Everything is very fresh there and I attend about once a week because I crave their burritos very often. Service is always on point. They are very quick are whipping up your grub. Only thing I gotta say is occasionally some nimrod doesn't know how to roll a burrito but even then, it still tastes great. Price is a little more expensive then your Taco Bell or del taco but you are for sure paying for quality. I can still get a burrito and drink for under $10 here at good ole chipotle. Kudos to y'all

This is a great place in Old Town Meridian.  I have been there for breakfast, and had the gunslinger burrito.  It was excellent.

They also have great dinners and appetizers.  We have been there several times on Friday nights for live music and it was just a fun atmosphere.  

The staff there is excellent.  They are nice and friendly and make the experience worthwhile.

Stopped for a to-go order with the hubby. He got The Gator and I got the Ruben. We also ordered a large fry to split.
The service was good and the restaurant exceptionally clean. A good selection of hot and cold sandwiches, a couple salad options and fries or chips as the sides.
The sandwiches were both very good. The Gator was HUGE, filled with chicken, steak, kielbasa, grilled onions, bacon bits and i don't know what else. The sauce that was on it was delicious! But hubby was only able to eat half. Hopefully it will heat up ok. My ruben was pressed like a panini but without the grilled/toasted outside. The pastrami was very flavorful. It looks super thin, but was beyond filling.
The fries were a disappointment. Some were crunchy, but most were soggy. They lacked salt and are not something we will order again. The fry sauce that came with them was also lacking any flavor and did nothing to help the fries. But at a sub shop I expect great sandwiches and not necessarily great fries. If I need something crunchy I'll get a bag of chips.
For a warm sub or sandwich i will definitely go back. I was torn between their steak sandwich and what I got. Based on today's order I am going back for that and to try a couple of the chicken sandwiches.
I used to eat at this place often. But recently have come to realize it is just overpriced hospital food. I will no longer be spending my money at Panera bread.

GREAT FAST SERVICE!  Traveling thru and ended up with a rock chip in our new windshield! Googled rock chip repair and Glass Doctor came up! They got us in and out so fast and they were very polite! 
Highly recommend

They have really good pizza! Definitely one of my 3 favorite pizzerias.
The only drawback is it's a bit expensive.

Delicious coffee, a relaxed and friendly atmosphere and a decent amount of seating. A few little board games and such for kids of any age and a helpful and friendly staff at the counter!

I had a cinnamon and nutmeg latte (soy) at the recommendation of the barista and it was fantastic. We ordered an herbal tea for the kiddo and they made it at just the right temp and he loved it (orange mint). We will be back!

If I could give less stars I would. I've been giving this location a chance since it opened and EVERY SINGLE TIME they screw something up. We've ordered wigs from this location several times and every time we would go to pick them up and they hadn't even started cooking them. Tonight we ordered pizza and had  to wait almost 2 hrs for delivery. It's ridiculous. The staff is rude and horrible at their job. I refuse to order here ever again.

First time, I guess were not in to Cajun. Ordered the platter that included shrimp and clams, with corn and potatoes. Clams were so small, smaller than the size of a dime and had sand in them. The corn was inedibly tough, And the sauce we picked which was a combination of everything was terrible. One good thing was the lobster bisque soup we had prior to the meal, it was amazing and great size of portion. We were tempted to order crab but the tiny portions would not have been satisfying enough.  If you're into Cajun and this is what you like you might enjoy it, we won't be back.

I've attended Harvest Church for 12 years. The congregation has something for any age - from new borns to retired. The Bible is preached and growing in relationship with the Lord is the priority. The pastors love & care about people who come in the doors. I've grown so much with the help of the classes, small groups, serving and messages. There's something for everyone & I love to call this my church home.

I rarely to write review, but I think I should. I ate at this place a few times and I loved it. However when I ordered pizzas for delivery, I was so disappointed. For my first order, I placed an order a few day a head. But delivery came, one pizza got completely burnt at the bottom. I called back and a manager sent me a new one for replacement. Secondly, I ordered two pizzas, one was wrong dough. Since I wanted original dough, it came out wheat dough. I was so busy to eat until my coworker ask me. But it was too late because they had already eaten. I think everyone should be careful to order pizza for delivery at Flying Pie or choose other pizza place.

My first visit: I had thrown my sister a birthday party 1.11.19 and it was terrible. I paid $300 for a birthday party, a host and unlimited play. Everything besides the host was good. I had to track down our pizzas which were sitting ready to be served. I had to track down our "host" multiple times including to get water and her to do the cake, presents and pizza. I might as well of just done the party myself and saved a bunch of money. 
Second visit: Despite my bad experience, my daughter wanted her birthday here 1.18.19 because to her, it was the perfect party last time. Spending another $300 exactly one week later was worrying because I wanted a better experience for that much money. It turned out great though! The pizza came out early, the host was always easy to find and we had so much fun, we ended up doubling our time from 2 hours to 4 hours! Can't wait to come back here! With different packages for each, I think it's a great place and throwing the best party is always rewarding!

Flying Pie is the best!! My boyfriend and I order "take out" from here all the time. Our pizzas have always been delicious and ready on time. The staff is very kind and always helpful. Our go-to pizza place!
Poor girl working super hard while the other staff was visible rude and bitchy to her. Never coming back here again.

I took my daughters out 2 eat at hook and reel we come here frequently and always have a good time. Eddy was our server he was absolutely fabulous the food was great  and atmosphere was even better, 
But  DESTINEY the bartender was a total disgrace .
shes extremely rude,arrogant and left a very bad taste in my mouth.Shes needs to clean up her attitude and learn how to treat customers with respect. I tried to take a picture of her to post on yelp but she literally jerked at me. Wow I could've believe it. 
Hook and real: please remove temper tantrum throwing DESTINEY from you establishment so that every experience going forward can be a 5 star experience instead of a 3.

My wife and I bought a couch here, and what started off a a great experience, ended pretty poorly. We custom ordered a sectional coach and throw pillows, the salesperson was very helpful finding us exactly what we wanted and even got us free delivery. After about  8 weeks, our couch arrived we found that half of the pillows we ordered with the couch were incorrect. We took them back and they said they would reorder the pillows for us but said it would be an ADDITIONAL 8 weeks- this seemed a little ridiculous for pillows but we had our couch and half the pillows so it wasn't a big deal. This order seems to actually take even longer than the original order for the couch- it was more like 9-10 weeks before we were told our pillow finally came in. We had to go to the store to pick them up, and when we got back In the car we realized unlike our other pillows they were filled with cotton stuffing and not down feathers filling we ordered. Not the end of the world but when you spend around $3k on a sectional and pillows it would be nice to get what you paid for. We took them inside and our salesperson was able to take the pillow case and swap it with one of their display pillows so they had the correct filling. So no big deal. Well we got home and put the pillows on our couch and found they are a completely difference size- much smaller than our original pillows. It's just pillows and normally wouldn't care- but this was our first time custom ordering a couch, and after $3k and 4-5 months of waiting we didn't end up with the product we paid for/ordered- it seems like they just ordered cheaper pillows for us instead of fixing their mistake properly and it has really soured the experience for us. I doubt we will return in the future
This program is well worth the money. Devon is a great trainer. So is Ryan. The new location in Boise is great.

Stopped in this store this afternoon 10-9-19 for a to go order and I would give this a ZERO stars if yelp would allow.  The beans were not cooked all the way and the food was flavorless.  Not to mention the chips tasted like they were made three days prior or left out too long.  I may not return to any chipotle it was so bad.  I drove from Nampa to this location to get food to go as it was the closest location, HUGE mistake!  Definately not the standard I am used to from other Chipotle locations.

This place has really great pizza but zero customer service! Delivery can take up to 2 hours and we live about a mile away from the restaurant. So I tried picking up our pizza and  it still took an hour for the pizzas (2) to be finished. When I arrived to the restaurant 20 minutes after I called  in going over the order to pay discovered it was written wrong and had to be made again.  Before leaving I realized they forgot to include our side!

First, me and my friends get banned for "not following the rules" but they dont make you wear a mask, they don't make you use hand sanitize, there is 0 supervision, and the one place where they do supervise is right at the front door. Otherwise there's kids running around EVERYWHERE I get this is a family friendly place but if your going to talk about me not following the rules maybe you should do your job and we will. The reason you gave me over the phone because while we "broke the rules" is Bullshit. do not come here I recommend defy in nampa or boise. one more thing the prices are horrible $25.00 to be able to do everything is rediclous your socks are $2 a pair! Do NOT COME HERE.

It was just OK.  I had shrimp basket and husband had flounder.  

It could have been crispier and less greasy.  Fries were also on the soft side, as was our appetizer of mozzarella sticks.  I've also had better cold slaw.  

Probably will not go back. Our tab for the above and one coke and one glass of wine was over $50.00!  Probably worth about $30.00.

Disappointing.

I've experienced quite a bit of chiropractic care, but only came to The Joint since it was one of the few chiropractic business open on the Saturday that I needed. The cheaper price was appealing, of course.. But is one of those things that I found out the hard way is "you get what you pay for". I went in with an uncomfortably sore neck. It was odd to me that there is no real evaluation previous to the adjustment, as if every body needs the same treatment done. This has never been the case with an chiropractor I have been to. There was no change in my neck after it was adjusted, so the guy tried yet again. Rather than any cracking/popping, it was only yanked on. I have since been in incredible pain throughout my neck, head, and upper back, and am nearly immobile. I am surprised at the rate of stars for this business, but I'd also be a bit weary that a chunk of the reviews are from unknown "people" that have only written reviews for this place and nowhere else. I would not recommend The Joint for chiropractic care, and will never trust my health to them again.

I first went as a free guest when the Meridian store opened and was underwhelmed. A following fully paid visit a month later did little to change my impressions. A very confusing seating and ordering method were you're directed to a table, look over the menu and then get up and go place your order then you have to move on to the bar to order a beer. The salad bar sucked, the beer and soda were way overpriced and the pizza was mediocre. Maybe they need to abandon the restaurant motif since they seem to have no knowledge about how to run one and just go with a carry out/delivery service in a lower rent location.
Quick, Delicious, small, mom and pop eatery. Very small gets busy but great service and good portions of food. Try the cinnamon roll french toast!

I would describe this place as meh. When reading the menu, myself and my 3 friend's mouths were watering. Way to go on the descriptive words! I wish the food lived up to the description. I got dry, overcooked pork chops. Asked for a simple modification with my side which was not honored until pointed out to the waitress. Out of the 4 of us only 1 liked their meal, the carbonara. Service was ok, prices were a little steep. I probably wouldn't go back.
Really good place. The hot subs are really good, and they're not lying when they say they're known for their fries! They're delish!

I utilized Park Place Prop. Mgt for over 3 years to manage my rental property in Boise.  Before I signed up with them, my previous property manager absconded with the tenants' security deposits on 440 properties, including mine.
