I then received a letter from Park Place dated 12/21/06 indicating that they were aware of my situation and that Park Place would assume responsibility for the tenant security deposit, provided I allow them to manage my property for at least 2 years.  The letter states, "In lieu of the previous property manager not having transferred the tenant trust account to you, we are personally guaranteeing the tenant trust account on your property provided you sign a 2-year property management agreement with Park Place."  The letter goes on to say, "Rest assured that our professional teams of qualified property managers are fully aware of your predicament..." and that, "We are dedicated to providing you with accurate accounting ... and the highest ethical business practices."

Park Place sent me their Management Agreement and Security Deposit Addendum, which reiterates the terms indicated in their letter dated 12/21/06.  As requested, I filled the documents out and faxed them back.  I have proof that I sent them and they received them.  Both parties then fully performed under the agreement, their agreement.  They "managed" my property for over 3 years, at which point I terminated my relationship with them (due to numerous documented instances of their gross incompetence, which I will not go into here, but would be happy to substantiate upon request).  

When I asked for the security deposit, Andrew Propst, very rudely and abruptly informed me that if I did not "agree" to accept the random amount of $500, which he had just come up with off the top of his head, in lieu of the $950 which I am owed, he "would not send me a penny."  When I reminded him of the agreement, he said he didn't care what the agreement said and that an agreement with them "was not was not worth the paper it was written on."  If promises made in THEIR letter and THEIR agreement "are not worth the paper they are written on" as Andy says, then Park Place truly has no integrity whatsoever.

The security deposit that Park Place assumed responsibility for when I signed up with them was $700.  Since then, they collected an additional $250 from the tenant, for a total of $950, which I will have to account for when the tenant moves out.  These amounts are not in question.  The only question is whether Park Place has any integrity.  Not so far, but we'll see...  It's never too late to do the right thing.

This would be so much better if they would just season their food. I have had the steak bomb a couple of times and it would be so much better if they would just salt it or even take some of their Cajun seasoning they put on the Cajun fries and season the meat. The sandwich just lacks flavor. Also some guy walked in with a big hairy dog and I'm sure this is an unpopular opinion but I don't like eating around other peoples animals.

I am so thankful I found Wags to Riches for my two babies - Bella, a standard poodle and Ruby, a golden doodle.  Kelly has groomed them each and every time and I am ALWAYS so happy with her attention to detail!  Wags to Riches is clean, everyone is so friendly, helpful and excel in customer service!

I ordered flowers from California using their website. The website was easy to navigate and choose a cute arrangement. The flowers were for my stepdaughters mom in Meridian. It was 2 days before mothers day and we didn't think we would get them delivered until after. Thankfully this shop did us a solid and delivered the next day. The flowers were nice and fresh looking from the photo she sent. Im super happy with their service and attention to detail! Definitely saved Mothers Day.. Thanks so much guys

Amazing place with awesome customer service!! The cashier was the sweetest girl who was a huge help since I've never been here before. I also like the setup of this cute place. It's very cute and was clean.

I have been to many acupuncturists over the years, mostly in the San Francisco Bay area where acupuncture and alternative medicine is highly utilized.  I feel very lucky to have found Heather right here in my hometown of Meridian.  She is well trained, knowlegable, and very professional.  

The clinic offers private one on one appointments which I have utilized, and they also offer a walk in clinic once you become a client, which is extremely convienient if you have having a problem that needs to be addressed quickly.  They have a few hours dedicated to this 4 days a week, which I think is a wonderful option.  I suffer from chronic migraines, and happen to be in one day for my appointment for something that was unrelated to my headaches.  I told Heather that I was having a migraine attack, she changed her course of treatment for me that day and actually GOT RID of my headache.  I have NEVER gotten any relief from anything other than hard core medication.  I was so happy and amazed.  It is wonderful to know that I could stop in if I am having an attack any Tues-Fri when they have open clinic hours.  One must call in first to make sure there is space, but what a wonderful option.  

Acupuncture is a very effective treatment for many aliments, and is not painful in the least.  I do not care for needles, and have to get Botox treatments for my chronnic migraines which are very painful to have administered, Acupuncture needles are nothing like getting a shot, and are very thin.  When inserted, one feels a small little zap, almost like static electricity,   It is actually very relaxing and I almost always feel like dozing off.  

If you are in need of an Acupuncturist, look no further.  If you have never tried acupuncture, but are wondering if it might help you, you can be assured that Heather will give you the best treatment and care around.

This place drips coolness and is much more than a coffee shop. They have awesome breakfast and good food in general. The decorations are pretty neat and creative to boot. Fine! You don't want coffee, have a beer then. This is a good place to work and study because they have different seating options, and the music is not too loud. I managed to find a couple of vegan options too. Most importantly, everyone is nice especially the owner. This is my go-to place when I am west of Portland...

We came here as a family recommendation and we are happy we did. Great pizza and beer! We had a coupon where we got 2 12" pizzas for $28 and the beers were cheap, 3 for $15.11. Classic rock on the radio, cool wall art, and friendly staff. Highly recommend. 

We got the "No Vegy Pieway" and "Garlic Chicken" pizzas. The first pizza was with sourdough and the second with original dough. We all liked the sourdough best.

Great selection of knives. From budget to Mid-line to High End, they pretty much have it all.

Very friendly staff too. When I walked in, they acknowledged me, and left me to shop. After answering a few questions, the asked me what I was carrying (a We Tech folder), which started a fun conversation about all things "knife" .

They have a really nice selection of Kitchen knifes (as opposed to just hunting and tactical blades).

Northwest Knives also offer sharpening. Cool store, cool people!
Very friendly very helpful. Really fast. Dog lover, Gave my girls some treats. Best admissions place I have been to in the whole valley.

I don't know what it is but most restaurants with multiple locations in the area their worst locations in terms of service and food are on eagle road. I walked in one person on the line plenty of others just standing around a few clearly on social hour. One girl is helping a customer; she's running the whole line. The line was 10 deep no sense of urgency; guess they figure it's chipotle you'll wait. I got the new guy; asked for corn tortillas he didn't know what those were lol. This only gets more weird lol I get to the end and show to the cashier my UPC code on my phone for my chipotle rewards account. She didn't even know how to scan or how to put it manually. She doesn't even know the rewards program; I told her this is my second entree as part of the program. She thinks the royalty program means everytime you come in you get free food. She was absolutely lost and clueless. I was like okay free food-awesome!!! The food quality um not very good tortilla and meat were cold. Portioning was spot on and enjoyed the rice and beans on the side. This was a very odd experience something I haven't experienced at their other locations like I said must be because it's on eagle road my advice visit one of their other locations don't forget to use your royalty card for the next 3 months(if you attempt to use at this location they just you your food for free!!)

A solid option for dinner with the family, but nothing to set it apart from others of its ilk. "Grit" in Eagle seems to do the same sort of menu and has a similar vibe. I wouldn't steer people away, it's a good place to go with a group, and everyone can be happy with their food...just nothing super special about the place. If you don't want to cook, and want something better than Chili's or the like, it's a good pick.

I went with the family, as well as a couple of out-of-town guests.I think we had a coupon for a free app, so we had some finger steaks, which were pretty good. Our party ordered a couple of burgers, the fish and chips, and a pasta dish...I believe the gnocchi? Burgers were good, but done more than the medium rare we ordered. Bread served with dinner was quite good...I believe locally sourced. Fish and chips were tasty, but fries were really over-seasoned...tons of seasoned salt on them. Pasta was good, I think...I didn't sample it, but heard no complaints.

 The beer list was pretty good, and the service was friendly, so it's not a bad option for dinner. I think they dialed their menu back a bit from when they opened...good to see the owners responding to market forces (but a shame to see the original inventive menu go away...I get it, it's a business).

It is as good an option as any other in the Village area...definitely good for a "I don't want to cook tonight" night.
Gabe was a great server and he did a lot more than most people with food service friendly and attentive will definitely  come again

My husband and I went for a very late dinner. We drove through the drive through because the lobby was closed and there were maybe five or six cars in line. We had to tell our order three different times, only for it to still come out wrong. We pulled up to the front, and when I walked up to the door with my bag of food, one of the guy workers, (holding an unlit cigarette by the way) yells, "we a got a fuck up!" He then tells me that they can't let me in the lobby because it closed at 11pm, and that we'd have to drive back around and wait in drive through. I asked him if he was kidding, because it was ridiculous to go wait back in a line of five or six new cars. It would have taken two minutes to fix our order, but they wouldn't. Awful customer service.

Gourmet sandwiches, soups and salads. So yummy! I wish there were more gluten free soups and cookies, they used to have two. They have a delicious sourdough bread. Customer service is wonderful! I love the cozy fireplace in the winter! They don't freeze you out like so many other places. Great spot for a romantic dinner. Nice and quiet.

You can get the same products at other shops.  You CAN NOT get the same service.  Owner/operator Ryan is as good as it gets when it comes to service.  I've dealt with him on several custom/complex builds and his level of knowledge is as good as I have seen.  On top of that, he treats your issue like it's the only issue he's dealing with.  I've been to other shops in the area and just have never seen anyone match Kore North's combination of expertise, service and value.  THANK YOU Ryan and team
Why do we keep coming here... expecting something different each time? Simply the slowest Taco Bell in town with the most immature staff. DONE!

Flying Pie what happened to you? The customer service is now sub par at best. I USED to LOVE flying pie so much until I became a delivery driver for all the food service apps. (Doordash Ubereats etc). The horrible way that this location in particular treats us courier drivers is honestly shocking to me. The thing that I think they do not understand is we are picking up and delivering food for THEIR customers, they do not start making the pizza until long after we arrive, food should be ready within 10 minutes of us arriving and most restaurants have it done before they even send for a driver.... not Flying Pie!!! They put us drivers dead last, we sit there waiting for a minimum of 30 minutes and that greatly effects our pay, our rating and if we get deactivated (fired). The customer is YOUR customer Flying Pie!! Treat them faIrly and us courier drivers are also your customers or, were your customers in my case. I will never take my family to another Flying Pie again! The workers last time I picked up blatantly told me she didn't care about my time restrictions and i was going to need to wait as long as i needed to! She was condescending and rude. The kid working the cash register was pretty indifferent with me too but probably because they all treat us drivers horrible. The restaurant was empty, not one other person but me in the place! The 30 plus minutes they made me wait, when the pizza should have been done before I got there or at least by the "pick up time" on my app. That I made a whole $3 to deliver it. The only way we delivery drivers can even make money is if the restaurant has the food ready when they send for us drivers. If we sit at restaurants and wait 30+ minutes on the food, we make about $6 an hour before gas and expenses. I am so disappointed in this place because I used to love them and its our #1 local food place we always take family visiting from out of town, not anymore though!! Please understand Flying Pie, these customers we deliver to are YOUR customers and they deserve fair treatment! We delivery drivers are too.

Windshield cracked thanks to a rock on the freeway.  Had used Glass Doctor years ago to have a custom mirror cut, so I gave them a shot for auto glass repair. 

Contacted them by e-mail and promptly received a phone call from Kasiaha(sorry if I spelled it wrong) who walked me through the process and insurance stuff.  Scheduled me for a repair in a few days.

Today I get a phone call from John who says he is about ten minutes out.  Five minutes later he shows up. Asks me to reposition the car so he'd be able to have clearance to work, explains what he's going to do and answers all of my questions.  

Fast forward about an hour and a half (exactly how long he told me it would take) and the new windshield is in.  John answers and explains everything and after the paperwork he is gone.  Very professional.

From the outstanding first impression I got from Kasiaha to the impressive job done by John, I was very happy with my experience.  I'll be back if/when I need you again.  Thanks!
Absolutely the worst property management company ever!!! They will take you deposit and more if they can!! Do not use them!! I have warned you!

I tried Mo Bettahs on a trip to Salt Lake and loved it. I was so excited when they came to Meridian. Same great food and flavors and great service as well. I will definitely be back. Decent prices and large servings. My past visit the Mac Salad was oVerly Mayonaissey. The Mac salad is always my favorite but this time it was overboard. Lighten up on the mayo a bit and then all is perfect!

Our favorite breakfast place! Must start with a cinnamon roll to share amongst the group. The daily specials are always a great deal. The wait staff have all been there for a decade or more it seems! They are super accommodating if two people want to share one order. Coffee is always kept topped off. Service is absolutely five star plus. Worth the wait if you go and there's a line out the door! We went on Valentine's Day for breakfast, and there were heart sprinkles on top of the hot chocolate. Nice touch Express Cafe. You all are like family.

I spoke with Lana about a few properties to rent out and we (my roommate) decided to make a good impression and go into the office and apply. They said it would take 24-48 hours to process our applications, but 1.5 weeks later we still hadn't heard anything. Both he and I called and emailed them numerous time asking about our application. I missed something and Lana gave me 1 HOUR to get it to her. As I knew that was impossible, I asked for more time. She gave me a total of 3 business operating hours which was zero help to me. She was simply concerned about getting money out of the property and since my application wasn't complete with the 3 extra hours she passes us over. Lana put terrible pressure on us and we were trying out hardest to get everything to her in the impossible time she requested and as I called for more time she was so rude she began talking over me listening to nothing I had to say as if she wasn't getting paid to talk with me about giving the company she works for more money. Lana didn't even know what she was talking about as she told me two different stories about the application while lying in the process. I called my mom to see what I should do next as time was running out and she wanted to speak with management as I have 830 credit score, great income, no loans, no debt, only cash flow in. Lana screened my calls, screened my mom's calls, and gave us a dead end number to "upper management". I guess they're allowed to be as rude as needed since housing is always in demand. It's unfortunate people have to deal with people like Lana and their impossible to get ahold of "management" company.

So delicious! Gianna is a wonderful waitress! (At the eagle location) 
Great service from her and she knew the menu like the back of her hand. Give her a promotion or raise!

Terrible. Terrible service (really, Ashley, why bother with a mask if it's on your chin?) Food greasy and salty. No silverware, salt/pepper on tables. We brew our own tea? Straight out of the machine they mean. Three times I've tried them. Three terrible experiences. They don't even deserve 1 star but no option. Gonna need to stop at Walgreens for pepto bismol. Gross.

Doggie day spaw is a great pet grooming shop. They truly do love our pets as much as we do, like they say on their website.  I have a big dog that we take in to self wash and their tubs are very convenient. And when our old small dog needs grooming they do a great job.  Alicia loves dogs and I trust her to treat our dogs with loving care.  The shop is clean and the groomers do a good job.  Our dog came home with a fresh hair cut and a cool bandana tied around his neck. He looked great and I could tell he felt better too.  I would highly recommend doggie day spaw.  There is lots of parking and they are conveniently located right behind pizza hut at Linder rd and cherry lane in meridian.

This is the BEST volleyball facility in Idaho! We love it at RISE! 
When you walk in, there is laughter and joy. There is this feeling, a culture they have created that is incredible. You can tell the athletes want to be there. And you can tell the coaches want to be there too. 
I have heard a few of the athletes say this is a safe place for them and they look forward to practice every week. This is so important for our kids, now more than ever. The coaches are engaged and work very well with the athletes. It is incredible how much some of them have improved over the course of a season. You can tell this place is special! I encourage anyone to go. Rise also offers volleyball for young children who are just learning, one on one training, camps, clinics, open gyms, and recreational level play for adults!

Great place for the older crowd but not a place for people who actually like food. The service was great, the establishment was clean but the food was mediocre at best. We ordered biscuits and gravy, sausage, bacon, hashbrowns, and eggs. Biscuits were cake like in texture, gravy tasted like it came out of a package, and the rest was ordinary. Again, nothing to write home about.

I come in and see Patty once a month and my skin has never looked better! My skin now transitions beautifully from season to season without a breakout or drying out! Not only does she do wonders on my skin but she has a great touch that feels amazing and allows me to relax and zone out. Whenever I come into Rejuv I feel very welcomed in by the staff and you can tell they try to give you a good experience from the start even when the phones are ringing off the hook! The spa is also very clean and tidy which I appreciate also!

Jim Closson is a fantastic trainer.  We have had a wonderful experience training our dog.  Jim is very down to earth and relates the material well.  He has helped our dog be obedient and us be better owners.

We have lived around the corner from Le Peep for over a year and always flirted with the idea of visiting- but never have. We went this morning around 12 and the place was packed. I never mind waiting for a restaurant, I worry when I don't wait....We had biscuits and gravy (steaming hot, but cold to the taste- weird) an Omni omelet, which was good and she had some egg whites, corn beef hash and a honey wheat English muffin. Food was decent, not amazing- service was fast and friendly and the restaurant was clean. Since I don't think I will ever find a REAL New Jersey style diner in Idaho, little corporate breakfast places will have to do. We would return for the service :)

Dirty, crowded, overpriced, nowhere to sit when putting on shoes (maybe there is when not all tables are reserved for parties?), not enough cubbies, not enough parking, wouldn't let us use the *grip* socks we brought and made us buy theirs (Safety issue? Please. It's all about the money). Paid for a basic ticket which is trampolines only. What they didn't tell us was that the foam pit trampoline was closed down. So my poor son got to jump on the few available trampolines when he could find a space. Ugh. Worst trampoline place we've ever been to. I felt like a complete mom fail for even taking him.

We took my daughters phone in to have the broken screen fixed. Prior to bringing in the phone my wife called and asked them out the phone repair. They said they could do thr repair but they don't have the parts and would have to order them. I took the phone in today to start the process of the phone repair to find out they did have the parts but it would take 24 hours to do the repair. We told the guy that the phone was drug thru the water in the ocean and how the screen got broken. Never did the employee tell us that they can't fix phones that have been wet and they never told us that Samsung won't allow them to repair phones that have been wet. The phone worked fine outside of the giant cracks on the screen, the reason we asked them to repair the phone. Three hours later the store calls me to say that there is water damage corrosion on the charging terminal and they refuse to fix the screen!!!!!

The phone worked fine even the screen. I asked them to replace the screen. THEY REFUSED TO FIX THE SCREEN. I told them that this review was coming and they still refused to fix the screen. I'm not sure what scam these guys are trying to run here but I advise avoiding them.

So when I was driving by this place I saw the sign and something inside said "you need seafood...." lol so I pulled into the lot and when I got out you could smell the savory aroma in the air. 
  Upon walking inside, we were promptly greeted and sat.  Looking around the restaurant, the decorations definitely set the mood of a seafood restaurant. Plenty of nautical theme going on.
  I ended up ordering crab legs, shrimp and crayfish. I'll have to be honest, being in a land locked city so far away from the coast, I didn't expect much. Boy was I wrong...when the food came out, I noticed that the crayfish were very large compared to many other places I have been to. I also chose the "hook and reel" sauce as my seasoning, heat level "spicy" . It was definitely the right choice.  I'll just stop here because the last picture of my review shows what I thought of the food. I mean....it was all gone and I kinda wanted more...don't get me wrong. I was stuffed! I just loved the flavor that much.

It was Real Estate Agent night and received a free 10' pizza.  It was really good.  Their crust is amazing and was super thankful for the free pizza as it opened up a new pizza option for me.  I really enjoyed their pizza bar which includes ranch and parmesan cheese.  I was pleasantly surprised in the whole experience and definitely will be back.  Thank you FPP for your generosity in the community.

I LOVE chicken katsu at Hawaiian restaurants and this one was certainly on the list of some of the best I've ever had! I came in very very hungry so I ordered the full chicken katsu plate that came with rice and macaroni. As I watched them make my plate I saw the HEAPING portions they had given me and wished I had ordered the half! They give you two filets of crispy chicken katsu, two rice balls and one of macaroni. Drizzle some of that sweet sauce they give you and you're in absolute heaven. 

Very clean place with friendly customer service. Definitely would recommend as a great lunch spot!

Truly happy with this service. I was met by Sarah who was super friendly and helpful. She explained everything throughly and was very professional. My results were fabulous!!! I will definitely go back again. I also feel the price was fair. I can't imagine anyone not being happy with their own results.
Had great service, with great food, and a great value!  DA cheezy beef is awesome!  This time I had the chicken fried steak and it was awesome as well.

Flying Fie Meridian-Wouldn't answer the phone for a to go order. Called for over 20 min with no answer, no option for online ordering either. Called the Boise location and they picked up within 2 rings and said there is nothing they can do and that they don't have luck calling the Meridian location. Such a shame that just a simple concept of answering the phone was impossible for them to accomplish at 6 pm on a Sunday. I would recommend Guidos who picked up the phone on the first ring... although a 45 min wait, we weren't disappointed with Guido's Amazing Pizza and customer service!

Walking in we really liked the look, there isn't really anything like it in our area. The food is exciting and looks great but the quality was not so great. Many things seem to have come from the freezer. For the price it just wasn't worth it.

I am a returning customer at your Meridian location and today was a great reminder of why I go. I went in for lunch today (12/12) and I forgot my wallet.  GM Yvonne helped me and let me know not to worry about it because I do come in often and said it was on the house.  She is such a great person and can't thank her enough for the gesture! 

p.s. I love the reggae music!

Flying Pie, what are you going to take away next?

I first ate at your Fairview location with my family in March of 2010, and fell in love with the funky, quirky 80's vibe. I even remember leaving some notes in a green book that apparently all new diners used to sign on their first visit. The pizza was high quality, but the experience was so consistently good that I wouldn't go out to any other pizza place in the Treasure Valley. FP had something different. I used to travel a lot internationally, and literally almost every time I'd come home, my first meal out with the family would be FP.

You expanded, opening in Meridian, and after some growing pains, seemed to have found your stride. But in the past year or so (2019-2020) I keep wondering what happened? Many or the quirky and unique things that made FP different and special are going away, or gone, and what's left is pretty good quality pizza, served slowly (45m-1h for dine-in), at a premium price. 

It might seem silly, and many of the things that are gone might not seem like much, but as they add up, FP goes from being a premium product, different from competition, to a commodity. And now that Idaho Pizza Company has decent draft beer, they're in my rotation.

I applaud testing the market, and seeing if some of the stuff you do isn't appreciated or valued by customers. But I think you guys are going a bit too far, and are fraying long-term relationships. The old Flying Pie experience doesn't seem to exist anymore, and when I take out-of-town guests in, they ask me "that was good, but pricey, and man, we waited so long...what was the big deal about the place?"

What's gone:
-Mints at the exit
-Fabulous 5 Pack (gone for awhile, now back...that's promising)
-Free breadsticks for dine-in (costs you like nothing, and makes the long wait more bearable).
-Gourmet Night
-Many of the old staff that recognized us, and that we recognized

Guys, the pizza's still OK, and I can live with the slow service. But without all the quirky fun things that made FP what FP was, you're just another pizza place, so why shouldn't I go to IPC and get a quick combo and a few pints of Sockeye?

Downgrading my review (of the Fairview location) to 2 stars per above. TLDR: Good pizza, above-average quality, but expect a long wait. Decent draft beer selection (used to be much better). If you just want a pizza, you can do better somewhere else.

Great late breakfast on Easter Sunday.  We were visiting from out of town, went to the "other" place up the street and the wait was 1:10.  Came here instead and glad we did.  Friendly service, great food. Decent prices.  Especially like the carafe of coffee.

Had a party there for my daughters 8th birthday the owner was amazing and led them on an amazing painting journey to make some gorgeous peacock feathers. I was nervous thinking all of them would look the same and be boring but they're all unique and completely differ. I cannot express the gratitude I have for her allowing me to bring my own food and cake and letting the girls all run around and have fun.

I've been here before (18 months ago) and the service and food was really good! However the quality of both have dramatically declined. I ordered a crawfish boil which I had before and this time around it was not good at all. Super small crawfish and not seasoned very much at all. We also ordered some shrimp and they were also very small and under cooked. I don't recommend the cheesecake dessert either. Tasted very processed and had an off-putting after taste. Sad to see the decline in quality.

Do not waste your money or time here. Walked into an almost empty restaurant and the staff who was just standing around debated on who would seat us. Bad service up front..waited and waited to be served. Ran out of sweet tea after receiving one glass. No one in the place but 3 tables and us. We had 2 orders of snowcrab in the "Jiffy-pop" bags. They gave us plastic gloves to eat with which broke through with the first spiny leg, leaving our hands covered in grease.  With a double order of crab, it wasn't enough to feed my 8 year old son. My wife and I gave our boy the slivers of meat we were given. We paid the bill..over $50.00 and and wife and I had to go to another restaurant to get a meal. TOTAL disappointment. I am sure this place will be out of business soon.
One good comment. The food was good tasting.. just not anything to really consume but a couple of small boiled potatoes.

The Crawfish was on point. The shrimp poboy and crab sandwich were great. Tried the lobster bisque and the Cajun rice... Both incredibly disappointing. The bisque was too thick, too creamy, not enough lobster. The rice was straight out of any very pedestrian Chinese restaurant's fried rice-even with the soy sauce taste. Skip it! 

Really... Visit for the Crawfish and the po-boys. Great prices, great flavor... Skip the extras!

Great food & staff a very comfortable place to be for sure
 & Pauly you Rock :)

What a fun evening filled with laughter and sparking creativity.
 As you will see, while my turkey is not the most beautiful that I did during my recent visit to the Angry Easel but it was so much fun! I loved all the quotes around on the walls and the pictures that people have done. The owner is bubbly and passionate about her business and enjoy bringing people together.

This was a wonderful surprise as I didn't even know this place existed before this Yelp night. Thank you for having us and I know that your business is going to grow and grow!

First timer! 
Absolutely love it, customer service 100% very helpful. Facility very clean ! I recommend this place. Thank you

The location is great for me.  The facilities seem nice, in spite of the typical "bro" culture that you just can't escape from in big gyms.  My only issue is I've had nothing but terrible and rude interactions with the employees that work there. Just asking a simple question gets you eye rolls and comments like "it's a gym, it's pretty self-explanatory".  Alrighty then...sorry to be a bother.

My special needs child pulled my back out during a seizure. I suffered for a few weeks and finally decided to try the joint. I went on Saturday, couldn't hardly walk going in. The doctor did a few adjustments. I left feeling slightly better. Of course was sold into getting a plan. Went in Monday. Watched 3 people ahead of me get adjusted. This doctor did the exact same adjustment to every person. Didn't ask me what's wrong, nothing. Just did the same thing. I have a fused neck, which he adjusted. By the time I came home I had a blinding headache and major sciatic pain. Figured it could just have been that time. Sadly got the same person the next time. Same results. Final time I went in same blinding headache, same adjustment given to each person in front of me. Sadly it was the same doctor. I cancelled my service with them. I'd rather deal with the back pain then go back.

The flower arrangement was so fresh and beautifully arranged.  It was impressive!  The flowers were left in an alcove at our home because we were not home.  They went out of their way to confirm with us that we found them.  I highly recommend this local business.

I brought a whole block of kitchen knives in for sharpening.  Some were vintage, some modern and some were single bevel handmade Japanese damascus steel knives.  These guys did a beautiful job, got all the bevel angles correct and even managed to repair a knife that had been dropped down a garbage disposal and was banged up from all angles.  I know how to use a set of sharpening stones, but just don't have the time. To that end, I was a little worried about having my knives done on belts, but they came out just as sharp as if I sweated over them; probably a little better.  The fellow that sharpened my knife set was a craftsman.

As for the person complaining below about identity politics in the store, I'd write off that complaint as pretty absurd.  Idaho politics lean very heavily to the right.  I do not.  As such, I can guarantee some of the staff didn't vote for the same people that I did in the last election, but I never felt anything other than overwhelmingly welcome from the moment I stopped in to the moment I left.  Moreover, no one asked me who I voted for, either.  I'm sorry the kitschy but popular coffee display offended you.  The last time I checked, it was still ok to try to make a dime in America.

Northwest Knives sells many products and services you can't get anywhere else in the Treasure Valley at a fair price.  Also, they really do know the knives they sell on a level you won't get at Williams Sonoma.  Don't let some histrionic and devisive person that takes offense to a bag of coffee stop you from supporting a great local business.
Great place in downtown Meridian. Husband had Gunslinger Breakfast Burrito, served with gravy-amazing! I had avocado toast with bacon- delightful! Coffee good too.

Mindy and Laura were amazing. So welcoming and the food was so delicious  
Thank you for a wonderful brunch

A little hard to find but well worth the looking. The parking lot was full but there was no wait. The hostess should us how to read our choices, choice of dishes, choice of preparation, choice of spiciness. Our appetizer was hush puppies. I had the Cajun with crab legs and shrimp it was awesome. My wife had the garlic and butter with shrimp and lobster she said it was the best she ever had.
Love this place! The food is great and always get great service! Always kept nice and clean and food is always fresh!

I read quite a few reviews on the store prior to venturing out. My mission was to find some outrageously large Halloween candy for the three little boys that live next to me.  That Mission failed. They had a lot of cool stuff but not exactly what I was looking for.

Some reviews mentioned that it was pricey. At roughly $15 a pound it doesn't seem that much more expensive than paying a dollar for a 1 ounce or 1 1/2 ounce candy bar. In fact you can mix and match whatever you want so that's kind of cool. I didn't have an issue with Price.

The one thing most important to note and the only reason I deducted one starfrom what would have otherwise been five stars is that there are items that are quite adult in nature. If there was a sign on the door that said an age minimum I didn't notice it. There were multiple items with the F word on them. And literally a candy box that was called dick in a box. Yes candy penises that you can suck on.

The store is certainly not for children or anyone who is offended by such things. On the other hand if you're shopping for a bachelorette party it might be just the right place to go.

It's cute. it's bright. it's clean. it's really not all that expensive just know what you're walking into.

PS I have limited mobility so I was very grateful to get a spot right in front of the door! Lack of parking is the only reason I don't visit this shopping center more often.

I am currently renting with Park Place.  I am becoming unhappy with their poor management of the utility billing responsibilities.  Park Place didn't update the info on a number of utilities when they were supposed to.  After not taking care of their updates the property manager contacted us to let us know we needed to pay multiple months worth of back payments to bring everything current.  

I am going to pay for my bill as it is my service that was being billed.  I simply want this company to properly communicate information with me the tenant so I can properly budget my resources.  No one enjoys getting a demand for an extra $200 out of the blue.  

In addition to not relaying information in a timely manner they are setting me up for a late fee on the utilities.  I don't feel that is necessarily all my responsibility.

Lastly the property manager made false and inappropriate statements about what they were going to do if the money was not tendered immediately.  I suppose they are trying to cover their own error as soon as possible to stop the utility company from notifying the owner of the possibility of a lien against their property for non payment; drawing scrutiny and revealing their negligence.     

If I were an owner I would not entrust my property to a company with such a lazy approach to their responsibilities.

I've always enjoyed eating at the Hook &Reel so I was excited to see they were open for takeout tonight. Extremely friendly service even at the door delivered my food to my car.. everything was packed up so nice Shrimp Basket was amazing as usual. The hush puppies have to be one of my family's favorite things.. everything was great what a way to end the long week thank you..
We had a rough start with out wait time. We checked in on yelp and ended up waiting an hour and a half. One food and waiter were great though. We will go back in the future.

I went into Lee Read with an impossible task. To my surprise Anthony Pemberton made it happen.
He was able to make me a custom piece of jewelry in under 2 hours of when I walked in the door. AMAZING 
Thank you so much!

Coming Sacramento area I know good barbers and these guys are good people have good prices with lots of of experience cutting hair. Solid barbers for sure go get you a fade, line up, ect... what ever you need they got you.

Our first time here. Friday night, party of 5. Started with appetizers of meatballs and bruschetta. Both were amazing. Everyone was happy with their entrees including Filet Mignon Pasta, Hay Hay's Special and the Chicken Carbonara. Service was amazing as well!
This is by far the best place I've ate at since I have been here for work!!! Highly recommend the teriyaki with rice and Mac!!! It's amazing!!

We used the waitlist, was seated within the expected time frame. The host and hostess were very accommodating and gracious. Our appetizer was not authentic paella (where was the saffron?), yet palate pleasing. Our main course were delicious, hot and timely. We did not feel rushed, nor was the service slow. Wait staff were exceptional and present. Concern: nowhere to sit while awaiting a table. This gives H&R 4.5 stars.

In stall #8 today @ 7:05 and the girl on the ordering just could not get a simple order done, had to repeatedly tell her we did not want fries with one of our kids meals. Sat there with a blank screen and no order repeated back to us just sat there no screen to pay or anything had to push call button again and she claimed "that never happens" like we did something wrong. Finally screen up and we tell her again there's fries on order we do not want fries just tots and claimed it was already done and to go ahead and pay and guess what, fries came out with our order. Told the girl who came out who just seemed completely irritated that our order was wrong. First time at this location and after all the hassle won't be back, sorry.

Installed our furnace before we purchased the home but never checked air output. Temp difference in the house is remarkable. Duct work was unconnected & is still messed up and they won't stand behind it.  We will have to spend $ on fixing a problem they should have dealt with before cashing the check they received from poor older woman who owned the house. Customer service is not a priority.
Great pizza. The crust has a great flavor lots of topping    Chicken wings very tinder and full of flavor. Cinnamon monkey bread was a sweet end of the dinner. Will be back soon.

OK I never thought I would be reviewing a knife shop, but I gotta say when I experience such awesome, professional service I have to share. I have a small pocket knife that I wanted sharpened. When I brought it in, I was told it was probably too small but he would see what Aaron (the owner) could do. A few minutes later Aaron brought out my newly sharpened knife, handed it over and said there ya go! I asked how much I owe, he said no charge! While waiting I looked around and talked to the other guy working (sorry didn't get his name) and I learned more about knives and Idaho in just a few minutes than I ever expected to. They have so many knives at every price point and I was fascinated to look at a few. Made me want to buy a new one! Someday I'll upgrade and if I'm ever in Boise again I will definitely come here to purchase. Thanks guys!

Huge shout out to Chipotles!!!  Their menu is simple, wholesome and delicious and very affordable too!  If you want a healthy lunch or dinner and you love great, fresh Mexican cuisine, look no further than Chipotles.  Oh and did you know their whole menu is made with non GMO ingredients?  You can't find that at any other restaurant in town especially fast food!

We were craving Taco Bell decided to drive through and saw they had a new combo pk that included tacos and burritos (The craving pack) this was very good, highly recommend for something quick and comforting. The combo pack is called the craving pack you get 4 crunchy tacos 4 beefy five layer burritos.

I attached a snapshot of my correspondence with pro core agent Richard. Also, the unpaid bill is the water bill which you have to co do with the landlord when renting. We moved before the bill came to us and it took to long to get fw:  when we did recieve it, it had already been paid. All of which was not included in my review of the company because it wasn't relevant. My review was not to try and get my money back. It was to give my experience for future renters. I would have asked for a hard figure on the carpet cleaning in the lease. Taken photos and emailed them the day we moved in and out. I would have insisted on a representitive walking through with us. If I had read this review prior to moving into any rental I would take the proper steps to protect myself and my deposit. I hope my review is helpful and that is why I wrote it.

Fun place for the kids for sure!  I rated two stars because I witnessed a food service worker dip his own used cup into the ice bin.  This could be a potential health issue with cross contamination if this individual were ill.  A bad habit in my opinion.  I called and left a message so I could speak with someone about it but they never called me back, the other reason for two stars!

You have to stop in here. The breakfast's here are fantastic. I always get the biscuits and gravy with eggs, bacon and potatoes. Lots of good old fashioned home cooked food. Lunches are a little bit of a let down, but you can't beat this place for breakfast. The staff makes you feel like everyone there is family. The old timers are great to listen too. Stories of long ago in Meridian and Boise. On the weekends expect a 10 to 15 min wait ..... at least. But it's worth it.

I lived in TX for 10 years, and have missed cajun cuisine. Mostly crawfish, corn potatoes, anything like that. When I found out that Boise had a place I could get that stuff, I was so excited. 

I have been here 3X's now, and every time I am in Boise I come here to eat. I always get the 1# crab, and 2#'s head on shrimp. It comes out the traditional way with red potatoes and corn. Always have to get root beer' Izzy they don't have coke products. 

I would definitely recommend this place.

We just bought a home in Boise. I had a short time to furnish our living room, and I visited at least 5 different stores. I ended up buying all my pieces from F.O. Kristen and Chad were so helpful. The prices are great, and everything was delivered so fast! I will be back!

What on earth is with no one ever answering phones in the rental business? I'm so tired of the lack of communication, and I am tired of my money being thrown away to these ridiculous fees. If a property has been rented out, tell the potential renter. If there are other similar properties available, tell the renter. Another option, if the company is so busy to not do their jobs and answer customers' inquiries directly, then invest in improving your website. Create a site and alert system that directly emails the customer status on properties. Provide the option for the customer to go online and directly change application options to new properties. 

Finding a rental is extremely frustrating and stressful, and a potential renter looks to a company to provide guidance and support as the company is the one who handles this on a daily basis. If the business has difficulty answering the phones, then the business needs to spend the money to update their website, so all information can be provided there as well as the customer easily filling out, and changing applications. Lord knows they can afford it with the overcharge of applications and administrative fees to provide templates that already exist for them.

We just tried Express Cafe. The outside appearance is nothing special, but get inside to the wonderful and friendly staff, delicious food and cozy vibe. We will definitely be back for their giant pancakes, delicious gravy and breakfast skillet to brag about. Did I say that their staff was awesome? Thanks Misty! Laura, you are hilarious and made our morning! We will be back with the rest of the family.

It was close to their closing time, I had a long day and I called them to order and said I'd be there in ten minutes, the woman said they should have it ready for me. It took a few minutes once I got there but was handed a drink for my wait. Everyone was great for being so close to going home, food was great and super healthy portions!

The food was delicious! Great service and very friendly staff. They have a great gluten free menu as well. The food and services was done in a timely manner, never felt like we waited too long for anything! We will be back very soon
Love Casa Bella! Friendly staff and great conversations. Service is exceptional and my hair is much less wild now! Thanks to Katie S. for her great, "chairside manners" and expertise!

First time visit at Chipotle and probably won't be back.
Staff rushed me thru my order even though there were no other customers in line. Surprised when I sat down that the food was cold. The chicken was tasty, too bad it wasn't hot. Dining room was so dirty, only a couple seats that were clean. Trash cans were overflowing. There was cups and fluid on the floor. Drink counter was dirty as well. There was plenty of staff behind the counter, but they were more interested in each other than doing their job apparently!  So disappointe

I checked in online and was told that there would be a 15 minute wait. I arrive 20 minutes later and notice that there are multiple tables open and figured I would be seated immediately. That was not the case the hostess told me that I would have to wait another 15 minutes minutes because of a reservation even though I was told on the phone call that they are not doing reservations. This is the second time I have tried to eat there and the second time I have been disappointed because the first time I waited over an hour when I was told it would be 45 minutes finally when it was my turn the hostess told me that it would be another 45 minutes because she seated someone before me with the same name. I will never come to hook and real again because it is too disorganized and not worth it to me.

When we went to the Hook & Reel for the first time we absolutely loved it. Great atmosphere and one of the best and most friendly waitresses we have ever had. The food was fantastic!  We will make this one of our "go to" restaurants in the Treasure Valley. 

10 out of 10.
Wow absolutely amazing! It's like hot & juicy in Boise Idaho!!!!!!! So amazing so yummy!!

I asked for bangs and walked out with a botched semi bowel cut. The manager emailed me after I went to the location to show them what their stylists did. I emailed her back and never heard anything back. I will be sure to spread the word.

I gotta give new restaurants two visits, especially when the first visit was dismal. Well, visit #2 was not better, and quite possibly worse than visit #1. I was sat at a table with obvious grease and cocktail sauce stains. My table may have been bussed from dishes, but not replacing the butcher paper was kinda disgusting. Visit #1 was partially disappointing because of screaming children. Visit #2 had another screaming child, and one with a boogery nose that the mom kept asking to blow and quit wiping on the chair and table. Gross. And with only one choice to make with my order: fries, sweet potato fries, or Cajun fries, my server got that wrong. They still don't think enough about customers to brew their iced tea for those of us who want unsweetened tea. The fried food I got was mostly breading. There really is no reason to come back. I think people are just giving this place a lot of stars for the novelty, but this really pretty bad.

My children and I see Peter Larsen. He is wonderful, helpful and understanding. One of the best practitioner's I have ever had. We also used the urgent Care at the same location. We were seen within minutes and the Doctor was amazing with my 6 year old son. They even called the next day to check on him. 5 stars all around!

Everytime I go to this Taco Bell my order has been wrong. I then have to proceeded inside to ask for my missing item/incorrect order! I am greeted by an unconcerned employee who gives me my order and doesn't offer any other menu item to make up for me waiting 10 more minutes in line to fix my incorrect drive through order

Our HVAC was going out. We went to Costco looking for a deal. In the past I bought  a Subaru through their auto program.  We loved the deal we received so we went back looking for a HVAC comp. We were directed towards A1. I was quoted a great price with a GREAT brand. I was very impressed with the professional contractors who installed our new units. I would recommend going through Costco because we received a gift card to Costco for 10% of our total bill.

Waited 45 minutes from the time they said it would be ready, til when I got the food. It was all completely wrong. I didn't get veggies, salsa, or the guacamole that I asked for, the rice in the tacos wasn't cooked all the way so it was hard, and it managed to be cold. Horrible horrible horrible. There was 30 people sitting waiting for their food. Every single one of us should get refunds.
Horrible,Horrible,Horrible.!!! I spend almost 70 dollars on a delivery, got my order wrong. Lots of toppings were missing, spend your money in another place. Not worth it.
This place just straight kicks ass. GREAT drinks, GREAT food,and the staff is just down right rad. Do yourself a favor and give them a chance, they won't dissapoint. And they have great croutons :)

My experience at this Chipotle location has always been great!  I typically come in before or after the normal busy hours, so it's fast to grab my food and get home to eat. 

The store is always very clean, and employees are very friendly. Portions meet my Chipotle expectations from the many other locations I've been to. I love to get a chicken bowl with their hot salsa on the side. I can't go more than a day without eating an avocado, so I fork over the extra $$ for the guac. 

I will continue to frequent this location, as it's near to a lot of other places I enjoy going to. Keep up the good work!
2nd on "the machine ate my money and can't get a hold of management" train. Too bad because the car wash is decent but I'll just have to find somewhere that doesn't steal their customers' money.

Probably one of the longest waits we have ever waited in the drive through lane but we chose to just wait it out and I am glad that we did. One of the managers Dylan was working the window and was very kind and apologetic on the wait. He made the wait and experience worth it. He gave us drinks and cinnamon twists for my kids and I and also discounted our meal. Thank you Dylan. Your doing great!

Holy cannoli this place is delicious  
My son got a baby roll and I got the strawberry cream cheese roll! Being vegan, I was soo excited to try this place and it exceeded my expectations  yumm

I have taken my pets here  several times, and for up until now, it has been fine. With my latest experience though, I felt I had no choice but to write a review. 

My cat Max has a lump on his back that is growing. We were concerned, as any pet owner would be, so we took him into the Pet Care Clinic in Meridian.

When I took Max into the clinic, it was at the tale end of the Covid Virus crises. They had just re-opened their lobby just a few days ago. No one at the clinic wears masks. The doc did not wear a mask either and was coughing. She told us the cough was not Covid related, but how do we know this?

She should have worn a mask to re-assure the public. Even if she knows she does not have Covid, the responsible thing to do is wear a mask. This showed me that she does not really care about other people's health.

After the exam, the doc told us that Max should have the lump removed, but really did not explain very well what it was or why it should be removed. It would have been nice to know if it was life threatening, cosmetic, or just something good to do, and if there any alternatives to surgery. 

I scheduled the surgery in spite of not knowing because I trusted that the doc knew best, but now I am not so sure. Have you ever taken your car in for a check up and they recommend some expensive work that you felt was not right?

This is how I felt, but I moved ahead with this anyway because I was concerned about Max. No one at the clinic gave me anything as far as either literature or even a talk on how to prep Max for his day under the knife, weather to feed him, or anything like that.

I was also not given an estimate, or told anything about the costs. When the big day came, I took Max in. I had to ask about the costs. 

I was made to wait for them to build an estimate. Why nothing was presented before hand is beyond me. Is their way here to not mention the cost until afterward, present you with the bill, and then you have to pay it because the surgery was already done and you have no choice?

When I finally got the estimate, it was just under a grand. If I had known it was going to cost this much, I would have shopped around and got a 2nd opinion. Was this the Pet Care Clinics plan all along?

I certainly hope not.  Surely this place cares and wants to provide both the pet and the owners with piece of mind, a good plan, decent prices, and alternatives. 

When I thought about the costs and the Pet Care Clinic's lack of presenting me with anything, I had to go back and pick Max up. If they are this lack luster with prices and prep, how can I possibly trust them with my Max?

When I called them to say I could not afford their price, they only told me to come pick Max up. They did not try to persuade me to get the surgery,  give me any alternatives, or wish Max well. The feeling I got from all this was that all they care about is the money and really dont care about my cat.

If you are considering taking your pet here for any procedure, demand an estimate before, and if the price seems high, shop around!

Took my big chocolate lab here for a good scrubbing. They have really big bath tubs which you can access from both sides which was my favorite part! When you have a big dog it can be tricky to reach their far side if the tub is against a wall!! They also had great shampoo, conditioner, face wash, mouth wash, eat cleaner, tons of towels and a blow dryer! Very friendly and helpful staff!

Toby did such a fantastic job helping me buy my first home years ago. I chose to work with her again on the purchase of my second home and subsequent refinance. Toby and her team are knowledgeable, professional and an absolute joy to work with. I highly recommend Toby and Premier Mortgage Resources!

My son and I were hungry for just a good burger, did a quick local restaurant search, and Pauly's Bar Room came up with good reviews on both Yelp and Google. Since it was close by, we thought what the heck, lets 
give it a try, good choice by us!

Service was friendly and prompt, we were greeted right away by a nice lady who was also working as the bartender. 

After looking over the menu, my son ordered decided on the grilled onion/cheeseburger and I did the Ruben burger. A special request from both of us was to please grill the burger not past medium (still a little pink).

Our food came out right away and was so piping hot we had to let the burgers sit a bit before biting into them! 
It was worth with the wait! The meat was cooked perfectly to our request,still juicy and delicious! The fries and onion rings were very good as well! 

We will be back!

The guys at Kore North are awesome.  Took care of me even though I bought my bikes elsewhere.  I give these guys 5 stars because of their professionalism and experience.  Turn around on fixing my bike was fast and they did a better job then performance bikes.  Definitely cheaper as well.  I'll take all my bikes to them from now on as well as any upgrades in the future.

I've had the distinct displeasure of dining here recently, because I learned the hard way that Flying Pie has the most unorganized service model of ANY restaurant that I've been to in the 1 1/2 years I've lived in Meridian. The decision to go there was purely out of convenience, a decision that ended up being one of the most inconvenient dining experiences I've had in years.

When you enter the restaurant, you may or may not have someone manning the "Order Here" area. You might even watch them leave to go do something else seconds before you walk up to the counter, even though they clearly see you coming.

"Another customer?! Run away... aaahhhh!"

Should this be your fate, plan on waiting at least 3 real-time minutes before someone acknowledges your presence and another 3 (for a total of 6) minutes before someone takes your order. And once you've paid for your meal that's when they spring on you with the, "your pizza will be out in about 45 minutes."

At this point, just smack yourself for not leaving to go eat at KFC next door.

If you can still see straight, take the oversized playing card (which I thought represented my order "number" but in hindsight realized that it was a resemblance of how the house always wins and the odds were stacked against me) and go seat yourself. 

To pass the time, because you will have a lot of it pass, I encourage you to observe the staff. Because in my experience, every time I watched the staff (and I do mean EVERY time), at least one person, and occasionally the entire staff in unison, looked completely and utterly confused.

I seriously watched a server walk around like the undead for a solid one and a half minutes with a basket of breadsticks.

Oops, I mean "pizza buddies." (Someone from the open kitchen annoyingly yells "pizza buddies!" every few minutes.) After which, your form of entertainment is placing wagers as to whether the shoe leather and tomato paste belong to you or not, as the server attempts to find out what table is supposed to have it.

Ordering the AYCE salad bar was probably the only wise decision I made. No. Not because I thoroughly enjoyed the wilted spring mix or the general salad bar unkempt-ness. But because I was able to put something in my stomach during the debacle.

By the time the pizza did arrive, I simply asked if I could have it to-go.

So just in case your wondering, "was it worth the wait?" If you couldn't already tell by my twinkle, twinkle little one-star rating, the food, while somewhat creative ingredient-wise, wasn't very stellar in taste or texture.

Mostly, my distaste is toward the dough. There's simply nothing to enjoy about shoe leather...

...or more than twice the necessary wait time to receive said leather.

I have come here the last few years for my tire and oil changes. I have usually had great service and could say they have been fair. However, today when I came to ask to have a diagnostics ran on my car for my check engine light I was told it would be $95 and would take an hour.  I didn't feel right about that so I stopped in at O'Reillys.  Not only was the diagnostics test free but it took less than five minutes. This is very disappointing to charge so much for something that is so simple to do. The diagnostics should cost close to nothing so that people can use that money to pay for the actual service for repair. Doing so would be a greater service to your customers. Honesty as of utmost importance. This test does not take an hour to run. Had it actually an hour for the vehicle to be ran through the test that would've been a different story but that was not the case. I asked about bringing it in at a time they were not busy and was told it would still take an hour. Truly disappointing.
Brandi's crew came in and did a wonderful job with deep cleaning portions of my home. They were thorough and quick. I will be when back to do more.
Very very underwhelming. Food was very average, prices were not good. Server was attentive but host staff is horrible. This place will not get my business again

I was a client of this company for a year and a half, after which I wrote a report of my experiences, and posted it on this site.

But, because only glowing reviews are prominently displayed, my report was hidden, as were many other similar reports.

To see the true worth of this company, you must read down this page to find a greyed-out notation which says "11 filtered" (the number may be different by the time you read this), click on it, go through the process to prove that you are a real person, and read the reports.

I promise that you will be amazed!
Best breakfast around. Huge delicious portions, plenty for leftovers. Hollandaise sauce is the best as are the omelets.

don't even trust your house to this company their only problem is to charge you extra money that they can earn from you. they never answer their emails, do stuff without owner of the house asking them. promised to rent out the property in two weeks but it lasted for 6 months and lowered price for $400 more. they charge extra for breaking the contract even though they couldn't rent it out 
worse company that i have worked with!!!!!!

(Due to my last experience a couple months back) The store is very clean and organized, however, terrible customer service.. I am not greeted when I come into the store. I get dirty looks from employees. I've also noticed employees sitting around doing nothing. I've never once been asked if I need help finding anything, etc. The manager had no idea what BOPIS (buy online pickup in store) was (I had some questions about their BOPIS return policy, etc.) On top of all that.. I asked one of the associates what jeans were included on the BOGO deal, her response was "I don't know, ask someone at the counter". I love urban outfitters products, but they need better employees to turn that store around.
Total scam. Door to door sales claiming to be an "air quality survey".

I went in for a massage that had been purchased for me. I loved the massage therapist, she did a wonderful job (I wish I could remember her name!) But I believe the therapists are paid to up-sell chiropractic to their patients. It was irritating to have her constantly trying to convince me to come in to get chiropractic while I was trying to relax in the massage.

I caved and went back in for a free chiro evaluation. "April" (she wasn't actually a doc, but the "marketing director") took xrays and some other tests, but didn't actually do any evaluation...she then told me I would need to come BACK in another time because "the doctor" needed time to look over the xrays. I showed up again and the doctor didn't meet with me, nor did April. I got yet another girl - who was ALSO not a chiropractor. She told me all about my xrays and then tried to convince me to get adjusted. I declined for a few reasons:

1) I was suspicious of a "diagnosis" that didn't come from someone with an actual medical degree.
2) I was disappointed that the doctors did not seem to have time to meet with patients.
3) They wouldn't let me get a single adjustment. I had to sign up for a huge (like $1,500) care plan and commit to coming in several times a week.

I refused to make that kind of commitment without an actual DOCTOR's diagnosis. It reeked of scam to me.

Good quality pizza everytime! The hand toss(whirl) their crust. Tv hey just upgraded their salad bar. It is a huge improvement! There are at least 30 different ingredients to select from in the salad bar. Don't forget to order the Triple Pie Beer. :)
Awful food. Long wait. My French baguettes were cold, damp, and thrown into the bag. My 10 dollar salad has a half cup of greens. I have been disappointed twice. Not coming back.

Service:  above-average compared to other breakfast places in the valley. 

Food: also above average compared to other similar restaurants. The house potatoes are surprisingly good.  Chicken fried steak is delicious.  Also try the Eggs Ben.

Price: very reasonable for the food.  Most items are 7-10 bucks.  Beverages are a little expensive. 

Worth the visit, especially if you live in west Boise or meridian!

Wow!  We had so much fun!  Took my family ages 2 - 51!  We all had a great time. Set up well for the whole family to participate and have a great time together. We will be back many more times!  Not too crowded and well priced!
Staff is super friendly, quick service and extremely cold beer! I love this place! The food is great pub fare!!!
My local place, the hot and sweet wings smoke away anything else in the valley, crispy, sauced, and served hot! Solid ownership, staff, and options!

This just might be my new favorite breakfast spot! I absolutely loved the vibe and the food. Everyone was so nice and friendly. Today was my first time there but they treated my wife and I like were were regulars lol! And again, the food was fantastic!! I highly recommend eating here and I'll definitely be coming back

Only giving a star because I have to. We've been frequenting this place, typically once a week, for a few months now. We are usually quite pleased with our food and customer experience.. until today. They messed up our order and when we returned to have it fixed, the girl made rude comments about us placing our order online. Clearly she made the sandwich that was messed up, and she was probably embarrassed by it. When I pay $10 for a simple turkey sandwich, I expect it to be made right. Anyway, that experience alone ruined it for us and we won't be back as that is no way to speak to a customer

Update 08/08/29: we've given it another try as it's been awhile and we do enjoy their sandwiches. Once our experience was fine, but the most recent time we experienced poor customer service again. Probably won't be coming back.

We just got into town and this is my first stop always. When I walked in Chiro was ready!  I looked at him as I was getting my coat off. He looked familiar and mentioned that to him. Funny he mentioned a few cities and Albuquerque was it!!!! He transferred her from there in August. I can't remember his name now tho. Anyway we laughed about that!!!! He looked up my chart and voila there I was. 
   He proceeded to adjust my lo back shoulder and neck. Wow I feel so much better. Thanx doc !

Final Walkthrough Fee: $50.00
Final Move Out Carpet Clean $279.00
Final Move Out Clean $90.00
Final Yard Clean up $125.00
4 Rolls of Sod $35.00
Utilities for the week after we moved out $5.00
Final Move Out Touch Up Paint/Minor Mainteance (sic) $85.00
Total withheld from the deposit: $669

As we were moving out they had us show the property to prospective new tenants. They would send several groups of people at the same time to walk through the home while we were moving out.

This was after we had already paid $590 for cleaning and yard cleanup. 
We did not receive any communication about this in the 30 days after we moved out, and had to send a certified letter to get them to respond.

When we moved out I had requested to schedule a walk-through of the home, but they (Katie) would not schedule a time to do it. They just told me they would take lots of pictures. 

If you rent from them, take a ton of pictures when you move in and move out. Make your own video walk-through of the property. Insist to be there for the final walk-through. Print a copy of any lease you sign from their web portal in case they delete it. I have asked for copies of our deleted lease twice and they just ignore the requests.
Emily always does a great job grooming my dog! She's friendly and professional and takes the time to get the job done right!

My kid went to a birthday party and was bullied by unsupervised kids.  Tried to get help from the management but they didn't believe our group. We even witnessed the acts personally.  Will never go back.

Had a great experience with this florist! I reached out last minute from California just 2 days before Mother's Day to a few florists and Brenda responded quickly. Ordering from a vendor from a different state is risky and worrisome especially if you are unsure if the pictures end up being what they post. However, this florist reassured me they'd be able to deliver on Mother's Day and gave me my first time $5off discount. The arrangement was true to what is posted on her website. And the website was easy to pay from. Thank you so much my bestie loved them!

My hairdresser, Michelle, was wonderful! She actually fixed a poor haircut that I had previously and I was able to notice the difference. 
She helped me keep the length while simultaneously getting rid of the dead ends, which I appreciated. 
On top of being great at her job, she was just a sweet and genuine person to converse with. The whole experience was wonderful! I will be going back!

Take my golden doodle puppy here for grooming. It's his first time getting a grooming so he gave the groomer a hard time. They worked on it for 4 hours without complaining anything. Not to mention how cute my puppy look after. Highly recommend!

Loved it ! People were so nice and welcoming. Very delicious. I enjoyed the variety of options. Also enjoyed the vegan options. The girl with the green hair helped me and she was very well informed of everything and answered all my questions with confidence and really knew her stuff. Definitely will come back !!

I Beni Boutique is AMAZING!!!! The girls who work there are helpful and keep the vibe positive ... trying on clothes as a female isn't always a 'hit' ... but I don't think I've ever tried on anything in their shop that I don't feel like a TOTAL BABE in!!!! The owner knows what she's doing when it comes to finding clothes that feel comfortable and highlight all your assets in the best possible ways ... The best thing about I Beni aside from everything??? Their Instagram page ... talk about a teaser!!! I wake up each morning to see the new items they got in and feel immense excitement to go in and try it all on!!! I love you I Beni!!! Best boutique in the Treasure Valley by far!!!!!

My 14 year old son went with a group of friends to UA on a Saturday afternoon.  He ended up having an issue where his debit card & so my review is based on how they handled the situation. 

My son attempted to pay for his admission using his debit card.  While the card was processing, there was an error and the session timed out.  So, my son went ahead and just paid cash for admission.  That night I noticed that he had a pending transaction for the admission price on his bank account.  I waited a few days to see if the transaction would fall off, but it never did.  It ultimately posted to his account.  When I called UA to tell them what happened, the girl that I spoke to was very apologetic and said that she would see what they could do to get the charge reversed.  About 20 minutes later she called me back and told me that she could not get the charge reversed.  She felt very bad about it, but her system just wasn't allowing it.  She asked me to dispute the charge with my bank.  I thanked her for her help & trying to get it done. After I finished speaking to her I called my bank and disputed the item.  It took less than a week for the dispute to be completed and UA refunded my sons money.  I was really impressed with how quickly it was taken care of.  Disputes usually take 4-6 weeks. 
About 10 days after getting the money back I received a letter in the mail from UA! I opened it up to find 2 tickets for admission for the Ultimate package and a sweet note thanking me for being understanding.  I am so impressed with this gesture! I appreciate Urban Air going above and beyond what they needed to do.  Thank you, UA!

Travling for work and was looking for a good burger. This place definitely delivered. Not only were the burgers great and all the choices but so was the staff. So friendly and attentive. You could tell it was a local bar bc everyone knew each other but it was nice to see and nice that they were still welcoming to new people coming in. I've been to some local bars where it's an inconvenience for you to be in their bar haha. Definitely coming back to this place whenever I'm in town.

I can't say enough great things about this office. From the front desk to the Vet, each person is incredibly kind, patient and helpful. I was given so much time with the vet to go over things, so much so I asked if I was taking more than my scheduled time. I feel that they really love what they do and they want the best for my puppy. We have tried other vets through the years of having pets and they are by far one of the best, and the others were really good.

First time having TCBY and i loved it. I just moved to Idaho and have never had TCBY before. I'm glad i live close because this will be a place I visit often. I had the brownie sundae first, and now i am hooked on the parfait. Very friendly staff!

I have no clue how I haven't already written a review for this Chipotle. It's so so bad, if you can make the time to go to another location. We've been going here probably since they opened and it was great at first of course but they've slowly gone downhill probably since 2019. They constantly have new workers it seems and so you always have to ask them for more of this or more of that because they don't get the proportions correct and give you way less than the spoonful they should be giving. They always seem to be out of something, whether that's white rice (has happened numerous times for us), crispy taco shells, certain meat, romaine lettuce or their small tortillas. I've had to call back and let them know my delivery order didn't have any toppings on it too. They can't seem to season their white rice right either, it's sometimes missing cilantro or lime or even salt. It's just a clown show at this location at this point. I've gone to the one on state street and the one by the boise towne square and they are really good about having food in stock or just overall better tasting.

I'm surprised that their aren't more reviews for this shop! Great place, not very busy during the week. Weekends a little busier. 

Megan just did a great job on my hair, had a great attitude, and personality. I hope she is working next time I go in for a cut!

Prices are decent as well.
So fun and so accommodating! Had my friends birthday in the park painting& she set up tables and chairs for us and everything! I would recommend her to anyone, she's so nice!

I am so disappointed! Panera is a regular place for my family and I. Today I ordered a half salad and a beverage. I was unable to finish the salad. They was so much wilted lettuce and the tomatoes were gross. I don't think I will becoming back to this location.
Service was good. Food, not so much. If you're a quality over quantity type, probably avoid this one.

First time and most likely the last time ordering here. Ordered 2 sofrita bowls (vegan friendly) which one bowl had beef mixed in, they were out of lettuce, they were out of lemons and chips were stale and tasted like they were at least a week old. Came back and asked for a refund. Food/Kitchen counters were messy. Employee had a face mask but was pulled under her chin (mouth and nose all exposed); either wear it or don't, looks tacky.

What a godsend! My family and I just moved into our home and finished unpacking. After the projects were done, we found ourselves mired in construction dust and without the energy to tackle it. It was a situation! In comes Brandy to save the day! She and Ash arrived on time and ready to roll up their sleeves to help. They were thorough, hand washing every surface. Now we can finally recuperate from the move and enjoy our new digs! I wouldn't hesitate to recommend Idahome/Brandy for any cleaning need, big or small. I'd give her 10 stars if I could. Can't wait to have her back!
