Store has closed, with good reason from what I have been told by some of the locals.

Sorry l, but I have no updates on where they have relocated to.

I had the most rude, horrible experience at this "healthcare facility" this morning.  The only person that was nice to me was the front desk gal. I didn't go to the urgent care for fun, I went because I was incredibly ill. Instead of making me feel better, I felt frustrated and brushed aside. The nurse that checked me in was ok, she could have been a bit warmer. I felt like she was irritated that I was there. (I wore a mask without being asked out of courtesy, I wouldnt wish this on anyone) I'd been up coughing the entire night, my whole body hurt, my head hurt and my voice was hoarse, and I had a fever.  She kept asking me to repeat myself and seemed frustrated that she couldn't hear me. I wish I could speak louder, but like I said, I had been up all night coughing my lungs out. I tell her my son was diagnosed with strep the day before. She swabs me for the rapid strep, and sticks me in a room she hadn't cleaned yet. She's ripping the dirty paper off the exam table while I'm entering the room, and doesn't bother to wipe the table with the sanitizing wipes. she tells me the wait won't be too long, since I'm next. Inwaitnjn the room for 20 minutes,  then the most rude and uncompassionate PA enters the room, tells me my strep was negative, but doesn't bother to test me for the flu, even though I had told the triage nurse the my son's school had an outbreak of flu and strep. The PA, Rebecca, was also irritated that she couldn't hear me, keeps asking me to repeat myself in a very rude manor. Never once did she smile at me or offer any sort of comfort of compassion or empathy for my situation. (as insignificant as it may have seemed)  I've had T-Mobile tech support reps show me more kindness and empathy than this woman. She spends two minutes with me doing a very rough exam. (pulls my shirt up without much warning, cold hands cold stethescope) Puts me on antibiotcs for a bacteria I don't have, and gives me the boot. I felt so defeated when I left. How can someone work in healthcare if this is the way they treat people? I work in healthcare too. I love my job and couldn't imagine treating someone that way, no matter how big or little their issue was. I usually direct people to this facilty when my own doctor can't see them, and I always hear, "I don't want to go there. We've been there before, and will never go back" Now I completely understand why. I'll never ask a patient to go there again. Personally,  I'll never go back. I never go to the doctor when I'm sick, cause I know it will pass. I haven't been sick like this in years. I would rather suffer through an illness than go back there and be treated like an inconvenience. Sorry for asking you to do your job today. Do us all a favor, if you don't have a compassionate spirit for the sick, stay out of healthcare. Your clinical skills were shoddy at best and your compassion was zero. Her bedside manner was the worst I've seen in years. My advise: stay away from Meridian health plaza urgent care. Or, ask to see Kelley whitehead-price, she is fantastic!!! I saw her over a year ago and will never forget how nice she was to me! Sorry St. Als, you've got a real grouch on your hands.
one of my absolute faves! GREAT PRICES, LOVELY FRENCH TOAST!
Awesome place and people. Took my dog in for a nail trim and they did it while I waited. No formal appointment either. I would definitely recommend them!
We continue to love Le Peep even after Jeffry and Tamara sold it. Same great food, same great servers, same atmosphere, and same value for your dollar.

We were lured here by a $50 gift certificate for $25 from one of the local radio stations. All I have to say is I'm so glad we didn't pay full price for our experience tonight.
We came on a Monday night and the place was empty. Even the bar area wasn't busy. A pretty bad sign for any place that has a Happy Hour (which I only knew about from the discount listed on our bill at the end of the meal). 
All of the reviews on Yelp that complain about service sum up our experience perfectly. We constantly had to remind our waitress of our drink orders, our water glasses were never refilled and our check took about 15 minutes from the time we provided our credit card. At one point I saw our waitress walking around the restaurant trying to get the guy I assume was the manager for some reason, with our ticket and my credit card sticking.
I ordered the cedar planked salmon that the menu said came with a side salad and bread. Halfway through the meal I realized bread was never delivered. Had to finally ask the hostess because our waitress had once again disappeared.
My husband orders a burger with some kind of cheese sauce and bacon on it. He finished it but all he had to say about it was "eh".
The good things - it's a clean restaurant with a very good selection of beer. I never saw a wine list so I just ordered a house chardonnay, that ended up being very good. And the honey butter that came with the bread was wonderful! Glad I remembered to ask for it. The salmon I order wasn't anything special, but wasn't awful either. Pretty thick cut piece of salmon served on the cedar plank. I'm not sure what the green stuff was it was served with. It looked like wasabi, but tasted a bit like dill mixed with something. Again, not much flavor. The steamed veggies the salmon was served with were very good.
I'd consider Barrel 55 again except for the service we received. For the prices listed on the menu I'd never go back. Mediocre food but really poor service.

Guns are extremely over priced here. I like the idea of supporting local shops but this getting bad. Walked in, (with 2 other customers in the building mind you) nobody but one person was being helped! Nobody had asked me if I needed help, nor could I ask for it either. They're was more employees in there than customers and thought playing around and having other conversations about whatever was more important. I got my fire arm $100 cheaper some other shop. The employees are rude, and need to brush up on some people skills.

Please do not let these people take your money and ruin your credit score! My husband and I rented here for a year, and when we moved out they charged us for new carpet throughout the entire apartment even though is was not brand new and it was your normal wear and tear. We didnt feel like arguing with them, because they are not willing to work with anybody on anything. We received a letter stating we owed $1,000 and needed to call Riverstone Residential to pay the debt. I called Riverstone and set up monthly payments, paid on time and finally after everything was paid completely off they filed a "collections' on my credit report. I do not have anything negative on my credit report, until now, and it has damaged it severely. They refuse to remove it off my credit and told me I took advantage of not paying it off in full. I told them that no one told me there would be negative consequences for setting up payments and paying on time. You cant win with these guys. Good luck

Outstanding pizza! The cheesy breadsticks with meat candy were great too. They have my favorite beer on tap- "Hazy Little Thing" from Sierra Nevada brewing. The way you order beer is weird as you order it separately at the bar, but it seems to work.

Had a wonderful experience with Lacee!  I recently moved here from San Diego and was nervous about trying someone new.  I'm used to using Yelp to find the right person but found that it was hard to find a lot of reviews for a specific stylist in this area.  (My stylist in San Diego had hundreds of reviews and took up to two months to get in.)  

I was fortunate to find Lacee on Thursday and able to get in for a highlight/lowlight/cut appointment on Friday! Unlike other stylists I've used in the past, she will listen to your requests and actually follow through, giving you everything you ask for and more!  I paid half what I normally pay in San Diego and my husband could not tell the difference between the results.  Thanks Lacee!

Huge portions. The 3 meat Platter actually was 4 meals! Weighed nearly 3 pounds. Everything was DELISH and we will return. The only criticism would be the pork was very salty. ‍ that happens sometimes and is more than acceptable as it was TASTY TASTY

I highly recommend Heather at Vitality Acupuncture!

- Heather is professional, kind, and attentive. She spent lots of time with me during my initial visit. Even when 2 months pass, she still remembers my name and what we talked about during the last session. She was incredibly sympathetic when I explained my stresses from work and life. 
- The office is quiet, clean, and calm. The receptionist is super friendly. They send me email reminders so I don't forget about appointments. 
- The rates are super reasonable. Community acupuncture is awesome because Heather uses curtains and white noise to maintain some privacy. 

I came to Heather because I spent an entire winter sick with cold after cold. I had a baby in daycare who was bringing home every cough and cold, I would catch everything and never had a chance to recuperate. Since I was nursing at the time, my options were limited. I really couldn't believe it, but I found sinus relief within 24 hours of my first treatment. I now go monthly to the community acupuncture and find that I am spending a lot less monthly on co-pays for running to the doctor for sinus infections and the flu. Heather helps me work on these issues right as the symptoms arise. 

As someone who is new to acupuncture and skeptical of eastern medicine, I have been 100% satisfied with my experience at Vitality Acupuncture and hope to make it a part of my health routine.

Scam company. They try to tell you that you "won a free gift", but take the "gift" back unless you buy into their product. Their product actually sounds good, but I will never endorse a company that tries to lie to their clients in such a blatant way. The sales staff are very nice and kind, but the whole sales system the company is based off of feels very shady. 

Two stars because at least they choose nice people to be the face of the company.

My husband and I called Caden TV on a Tuesday night about our Toshiba projection TV having no picture. We are both huge fans of Comcast Cable so to be without TV is a such a sad feeling! Caden TV arranged someone to come out the very next day (Wednesday) at a time that worked with my schedule. (Wow)! We received such great service on the phone so I was optimistic about the TV tech arriving at our apartment. We received a phone call about a half hour before the appointment telling me he would be there. When the TV tech arrived, he was very polite and very knowledgeable. Within about 15 minutes he had the solution to our problem. This was such a great experience. It's very difficult to trust someone helping you with something you know nothing about, however Caden TV made me feel comfortable saying yes to fix the TV instead of buying a new one. If you need your TV repaired, before buying a new set, call Caden TV and see about fixing it. This is saving me and my husband a lot of money.  A+ service.

Took my dog here twice in one week. I will admit he had every single symptom I have ever seen in dogs happen over that week so I thought it was reasonable all the tests and stuff they ran. We are now 5 days from my last vet visit & my dog is sicker than ever. I am taking him to a new vet today to hopefully get the answer I originally thought I would get with them. When I called today I expect them to own that they didn't do anything to help and at least offer to take a look at him. NOPE I GOT TOLD TO GO TO ANOTHER VET OR PAY ALL THEIR FEES AGAIN FOR THE SAME TESTS. I have been a pet owner all my life and today I expected more from them. Also, the medications I got for my pup don't make sense. When I came in the vet tech was very concerned about his fever (which I understood) but did not even hear what I said apparently. I told them he vomited ONCE but wanted to eat shortly after so I gave him food. They gave me almost 150$ of charges for NAUSEA AND VOMITING. To which the box of pills are still on the counter unopened because he is not vomiting and still eating every bite of food. Also, the last time I was there he was so sick they had him come out the side door not the front. However, they gave him to be soaked in fluids (literally had to towel dry his whole body when we got home) and no explanation on the pills or what I was doing when we got home. You don't spend that much money & get a rude throw your dog out the door type goodbye. To say I am unhappy is an understatement, I am disgusted!

The food is great here! Never disappointed with the food but the customer service could definitely work on what they say through the drive through. I had the employee taking my order make is super difficult to order. My son wanted half a Caesar salad. She didn't explain what came with it or ask me anything. So I asked her again then I got yelled at through the drive through. The manager at the drive through wasn't all that pleasant either. I work in customer service and have since this pandemic started. There is no excuse to have a bad attitude.

I rarely buy meat at the grocery store...have no idea where it is sourced, nor the freshness and quality. So happy to have found Greenfield. We now buy all our meat products here. Their selection is awesome; I can't imagine a cut that they do not have. We also buy sausage, ham, and ham hocks for soup. Every product we've tried has been of excellent quality. I normally buy ground sirloin, but their ground chuck is very good. The staff is also friendly and accommodating. I make my own Italian sausage and the owner said that he'd grind the pork to our specifications. Every time we've been here the place smells clean and is spotless. Happened to be here close to closing and watched, through the glass window, as the soaped down and power washed all their equipment and floors.  Very important! 
The only downside for me is that they are opened at the exact time and days that we work. They are definitely out of our way, so getting there before they close is always challenging. Wish that they were opened half a day on Saturdays, or close on a week day and open on Saturday. Also, would like to see a glass meat counter where you can select your own steaks, roasts, etc., and buy fresh ground beef in the quantity you need.  Their ground beef normally comes in 1 or 1.5 lb frozen packages. 
Regardless, whenever we are in the area, we'll be sure to stop by.

Great place for kids to have fun jumping, dodge ball, trapeze, slides, zip line, laser tag, and jousting while balancing yourself lots of exercise and lots of it. My son and daughter-in law had our grandson 8th birthday party here and as a grandmother my opinion, the bathrooms could have been cleaner however I did like that they had sanitizer everywhere. Your kids will have a blast!

I LOVE Angry Easel! I am and will always be a 'cheap-o' at heart. Im a sucker for a bargain and I found it with Angry Easel. I always thought those fancy 'paint and sip' parties looked so fun but were WAY out of my price range and seemed to 'hoity toity' for my taste. When my best friend threw a party here I was impressed. So I threw my sisters 30th here and was blown out of the water! 

I'm so pleased the owner Michelle keeps it affordable for all. $15 for a painting lesson (including paints and canvas)? Can't beat that! But what makes it even better is she lets you bring any food or drink (including booze) in! If that doesn't save you hundreds of dollars I don't know what will!!

Michelle is so very kind, funny, laid back, and talented. I'm thrilled Angry Ease got so large that she had to expand out of her garage. She totally deserves it!

Support local artists! Support local businesses!

I was not happy with my service with Dream Clean. I paid for the deep clean only to find major spots of mess left behind that were supposed to be included. I sent pictures into the team and my response was these items were attempted but couldn't be clean. I had asked the cleaners to let me know when they were finished. Which they did but I would have been less mad about the "hard" spots if they brought it to my attention before they left. Then I received a call saying they were going to charge me $100 more for the service because of the extra work. I couldn't believe this because certain spot weren't even cleaned!! The rep said he would give me a $50 credit. After sadly agreeing to this I told him I just need to transfer the funds. He said they payment will go out 7pm. The payment went out at 6:20pm and now I have over draft fee. I would never recommend this place!

Great and friendly staff
Out of towner here bringing my cat who has the sniffles in to make sure she was okay and they were just as concerned as me.
Everything checked out okay. 
Exam fee was average and unlike my home vet they didn't scold me for things my vet back home does, so I will be finding a new vet when I get home.
Will be back if I need to (hopefully I don't)
Recommend biscuits and gravy, scrambles. Better than any I've had before. Pleasant service. Popular on a Thursday, mid-morning!

My husband and I just moved to Meridian and needless to say we had a ton of laundry to do.  Brought them to Laundry Haus and we were pleasantly surprise how clean this facility is.  They've got machines to handle large loads which saves a lot of time.  We weren't quite sure how to operate the machines but their employee name Jennifer helped us out.   She made the whole laundry experience pleasant.  I totally recommend this place for anyone looking for a good laundromat.

Had the most disturbing thing happen when I took my dog in for a check up today. She's been recovering from a UTI the past week, so naturally the vet wanted to do a follow up to see how things were progressing. They took her back without me, and when they couldn't get her to produce a urine sample, they extracted it from her bladder with a needle!!! Without asking me!!!! I could hear her crying from the waiting room!!! She hasn't been ok, panting excessively and urinating frequently since and I'm furious! First, who even thinks it's ok to practice this barbaric method and second, WITHOUT CONSENT?!!! Warning to everyone who takes their pets here. This is not the first time I've been overly frustrated and did not agree with their practices. Had them recommend a VERY expensive, invasive procedure for another one of my dogs who's currently on hospice. Wanted to do a CAT scan to help decide exactly what was wrong (another vet used a stethoscope), and wanted to put him on all kinds of meds, still giving him less than a year to live even with the $600 in 'treatment'. They will tug on your heart strings, and make you question your loyalty to your pet in tough times. Stick to your guns and always get a second opinion if you do go to them. Several other vets disagree with the practices I've relayed. Save your money and get better service elsewhere. For the love and safety of our pets, we will NEVER be back.

Absolutely never take your vehicle here. Ever. Came in and dropped off truck for a fuel pump and shifter cable and once I got the $1400 quote I backed out and picked up the truck. The tech who brought my truck out was being extremely shady and pulled out, back in, and out of the garage. I got my truck back and felt an eerie feeling so I decided to check under the hood only to find my brake booster line taken off. I did my brakes the day before and I know for a fact it was intact. Those lines don't just come off. It was intentionally taken off. Absolutely horrid. That's criminal stuff. Also left with a check brakes light which was not on prior. Never ever bring a vehicle if you care about it.

Not impressed . As a small business owner i absolutely understand you can't always have the lowest price. That being said i normally do not give a review . In this case , i will make an exception . Needed a piece of glass for a personal project . Went in to get a quote and for a 24x36 piece of tempered glass was told 475-500 dollars !!!!!! ARE THEY NUTZ . From Roadrunner glass for EXACTLY the same parameters they quoted me $65.00 . I understand price differential but this is absurd .  I mentioned i had just moved here from California . Im thinking this guy assumed that ALL people from California are rich . Well i am not and for him to give me a quote that is almost 1000 % above the other only means that he is either really in over his head or a full on CROOK . Would never reccomend a company that miss quotes this bad to even my enemy . Shame on you Glass Doctors

I'm really happy with the service I received at Casa Bella Salon. I absolutely love my haircut. It's exactly what I wanted. My hairstylist Debbie took the time to discuss how my face shape would affect the look of the cut I wanted and then we tweaked it accordingly. I will definitely be a return customer.

Just went through the drive through. Drove home 5 minutes away. Double Dell : Stale bun, old meat. Chicken Soft taco was hard and old. These people need to be reported. My wife had already stopped going here and now I'm going to stop and tell everyone I know about how terrible the food is. It's a shame because It's usually good during the day.

First time dining at this location. The wait staff was great, super friendly and accommodating. The food was delicious and the atmosphere was fun.  Will definitely return to this location in the future!

Ordered delivery. Pizza arrived undercooked and doughy. Called and complained they sent out a replacement. Another undercooked pizza. I drove to the location and let em have it. Managers response was that sometimes pizzas just cook like that?!?!?!? Do I look like an idiot. Never again. Fix it before you get people sick!

I had my nails dipped & they did a great job!  Then I fell & ruined 3 nails hours later in day! Oops!  
I went back that day and they fixed them for no charge, even though it was my clumsy feet that caused my fall hours later.  I appreciated them doing that for me!!
Good fresh seafood . My wife and I had the dinner for two which includes shrimp, crawfish, lobster potatoes , corn on the cob in a garlic sauce. Good stuff. $49 . No bad for two. Good service

Here is how a standard To-Go intersection here goes:

1) place order on phone and get 1+ hour ready time
2) arrive on time and get told it will only be 10 mins more 
3) wait a minimum of another 30+ mins watching helplessly as the lost and understaffed teams runs around trying to make heads or tails of the orders they are taking in
4) go to the counter for the obligatory "uhum" conversation to be like "do you know what's going on?"
5) eventually they figure it out and you take your half warmed pizza home because it was lost in the shuffle and could have been given to you hot when you arrived most likely. 

I have never had a good interaction here. They get the stars for the food products and nothing else.

It is always a pleasure to visit Anthony at his barbershop on Franklin... He does a fantastic job... Has a awesome personality... And is remarkably wise for his age... His location is clean, has plenty of parking, and he is always very courteous when I come there to get my haircut.  I highly recommend!

I've taken my kids here several times with no problems. But the last two visits have taken over 20 minutes to complete the order.
Something here has to change....

Not even about the food but mainly the experience. Ordered a bunch of food through the app and apparently the store was already closed. However when I checked my bank account it had already processed through and posted. Called the store the next day and spoke with the "General Manager" Selena and she said to come in and they would make it right. Went in and basically stood there for thirty minutes while she was on the phone with her boss and then was told to come back on Monday or call her because it should just refund to my account where they never accepted the order. Well it did not refund so I did call her back on Monday around 2:30 in the afternoon, she said she would call me right back, I called AGAIN at 4:45 and was told she had gone home for the day. Literally to make this all better would be to just make the damn food instead of giving me the run around. Because now I want my money back and I will get it. And she kept saying it's a third party app and they wouldn't do anything. Just poor handling and makes things way too complicated.
Hello, went and had work done very surprised, Mike was extremely helpful and full of knowledge and I will say a great price. This was a gem finding this place will continue to have work done.

My husband and I read the reviews before going here for an early evening dinner. 

Rule #1: if you see a bad review, look and see what else the person has reviewed. Anyone who gives Barrel 55 one star and Noodles and Company, Olive Garden, and McDonald's five stars....well, just sayin. Pocatello, Idaho is a culinary wasteland, so what does someone from there know anyhow? 

And then there are the folks that give EVERY review a one star. Stay home and cook your own food, I say. You can have your frozen dinner as you sit on your widening hips in front of the TV. Have as much soda and salt as you want. You will never be happy. 

That being said, we really enjoyed Barrel 55. The beer selection is outstanding. That is important. If your beer menu consists of Bud Light and 754 IPAs...then you have lost me. But this beer selection was great, a balance of several German beers, ambers, porters, some sours, and many offerings from local and regional brewers.
 
I had the salmon: Nice presentation of sockeye (might have been chinook) on a smoky plank with some roasted veg. The seasoning and sauce was excellent. 

My husband had the burger because...well he always gets a burger. He is the expert burger guy in Boise, though I wish he would splash out and get something more exciting. A burger does, in fact, help to bring out the best in a beer. It looked great, on a nice bun. 

I tried the fries when my hubby wasn't looking and they were very good as well.

The waiter was all about himself, telling us that it is his birthday and practically reading his resume to us. Ok. Just bring me my food and go away please. But I figure that bad waitstaff soon exits through the back door. The guy didn't make my food taste good. The chef did. Can't make a living by acting like an idiot waiter. We didn't do much in the way of tip, as not to encourage his bad behavior.
Excellent food! Can't wait to go back. Especially enjoyed the bruschetta, chicken parmigiana and meatballs.

My kids and I love Urban Air! We have a membership and it's such a great bargain considering the daily ticket price! 
My kids enjoy the laser tag, zip line, and trampolines.  I work out of my home office so I'm able to catch up on work from my laptop while they play.  The food is mediocre but its convenient having a cafe! I wish they offered iced coffees and some healthier cuisine but maybe in the future.  WiFi could be stronger for all of us working parents haha! 

Avoid on weekends due to the crowds, lack of seating options, and parking spots become limited. Birthday parties galore on saturdays!

I am very impressed with this company! They were very professional but also very down to earth and friendly. The most important thing to me, however, were the results. I have always been one to use the Crest whitening strips but this whitening was much quicker, gave me better results, and hurt my teeth less! I will definently be coming back in 6 months.

Dennis and his crew did an outstanding job for us. In addition to removing 3 trees and pruning 2, they were able to restore some semblance of beauty to 2 ugly trees we had feared were hopeless. 
Reasonably priced, extremely nice crew, and very professional. Couldn't have asked for more.

Great Service. Easy and quick free diagnostic of the problems I was having with my device. Very trustworthy and respectful interaction with the team. Highly recommend using their services. We tried to repair our tablet on our own and it worked for a month and then started having problems. Chalk it up as a good lesson on how little I know about electronics. I appreciate the confidence of the 90 days I can return it if it malfunctions again. Well worth the price to have  ubreakitifixit take care of the repair. Thank you.

We've taken all (3) of our trucks here and have been treated with respect and courtesy!
We've dropped in on short notice and the crew always comes thru for us!
Sometimes there are more issues going on than you may realize (especially with an older vehicle) that's life...you can choose to follow their recommendations, get a second opinion or take your chances.
We recently took our 03 Dodge Ram 4X4 in for u-joints/driveline issue.  Had a couple other items fixed too. 
I can't be sure if you all fixed our "lamp out/left turn signal issue" but it has not been chiming off and on plus the left turn signal functions properly now. Even when bouncing off the rocks and ruts off road. Thank you ALL for the great service!
We will be back, and we have recommended your shop to others!

My favorite breakfast place!  Delicious food, cooked to order just how you want it. The staff is so friendly, the service is fantastic and the food is so good. A great start to the day which keeps me coming back. Highly recommend!

We went to Jon Smiths with a group of 8, the restaurant was clean, the staff was friendly and very efficient.  All of the staff were wearing masks.  The tables were spaced appropriately for the times we are living in.  We sat 4 people at one and 4 at another.  None of us had been there prior and everyone was happy with their sandwich and fries.  The bread was soft and fresh.  We will definitely be back!
Awesome Hawaiian food!! I really enjoyed there katsu chicken and teriyaki chicken. There macaroni salad is excellent too!
Fast, friendly, and easy. Located in the Stinker parking lot. The whole process took about 6 minutes.

Not sure where to start with this one. I used to love Chipotle and then about a year ago they did me dirt and it took me a whole year to want to try it again. Good lord I wish I didn't. 

I ordered two burritos nothing special just guac and queso on the side. They said it would be ready for pick up at 3 because customers are not allowed in the establishment at the moment. At about 3:25 we got our order. That's alright I'm in no hurry. We drive off and realize they forgot the side of queso and utensils as if we were going gently cup guacamole in our hands and sculpt it onto our burritos because lord knows they definitely weren't gonna fit in the cup.  So we go back. We let the girl know that the queso wasn't in the bag and we have the receipt if you'd like to check it. To which she swiftly replied with "well that's because we don't have any." After a few more awkward moments of silence and waiting for her to offer a refund, we finally just ask the queso be refunded then. She snaps back with "we don't do refunds." At that point my burrito is getting colder and colder while my irritation is getting hotter and hotter. Maybe the look on my husbands face said it all because then she said she would just give us a cup of guac and a get us utensils. 
She came back with the guac and no utensil. My father once told me "You gotta pick the hill you wanna die on." I decided it wasn't going to be Spork Mountain. 

After all that we finally started eating our food. The ingredients in the pico seems to have been chopped by someone who was told that they were not allowed to handle anything sharper than a boiled egg. Stevie Wonder could do a better job of chopping with a broken Slap-Chop. 

FYI I don't know who needs to hear this but black beans shouldn't be crunchier than the arthritis in Gram Gram's knees on a cold winter night. 

Lime seeds also shouldn't be in rice. Just sayin'.

Great food! The severs are so wonderful and always treat me like family!!! I enjoy the food and the location is convenient and near my house. I usually drop my car off next door for an oil change at Jiffy Lube, and eat an amazing meal at Express Cafe! Yum!!!

COVID-19 TESTING!!  Two of us went to the Cherry Lane location for drive-up testing.  We called the screening number in the morning, answered questions asked by a real human (Brianna? very comforting yet professional), and were advised to head for testing.  Right at the driveway, we were met by clear signage, AND a very pleasant nurse who made sure we went to the correct part of the lot.  We had ZERO wait time (mid-morning, on Day Two of this site opening!). Another nurse came right away to take our info, briefly explain next steps, and direct us to a parking (waiting) area. I note they had all of us using every OTHER stall -- good automotive distancing.

Every step of the way (more screening questions; a phone call from admin from inside the building; time with either a doc or PA, and then the testing swabs themselves), St Al's personnel were cheerful, efficient, and reassuring. I was really amazed at how smoothly the entire process flowed (especially having seen the news about the zoo that is St Luke's' testing).   We received two tests -- flu, and Covid.  The flu results were ready in about 20 minutes. In addition, because of symptoms, a prescription was phoned in for us -- and was ready in just a couple of hours at our pharmacy.  (Covid results take 7-10 days.)

Shouts out to the entire crew working on March 19, at around 10am.  PA Jose Gomez was kind - but still efficient - in assessing us. He also gave very clear information, and directions for what to do while awaiting results.  The nursing staff we encountered were awesome.  We felt well cared-for, and as prepared as we could be.  Thanks to you frontline folks!

And btw -- St Luke's took 48 hours to just call us back for "triage" nurse screening!  With St Al's --  from the screening phone call to flu test results -- about two hours.  Not saying this will be the same for you, but they are working hard, and seem to have process flow down well.

Toby and team were incredible to work with! I just completed my second loan (a refi) and had the same great service as the first. Toby is incredibly knowledgeable and gave me a sense of peace throughout the process. Speaking of process, her team is on it! From documents and contracts to tracking me down for signatures, they were always a step ahead. Thank you Toby Team and Premier Mortgage! I would highly recommend working with them.

We drove to this location Sunday early afternoon for a late lunch. To our surprise, there was a notice on the door that they were closed due to inclimate weather. Well that was not true as the weather was just fine and even if it was bad, it is an indoor restaurant. We started to leave, when someone walked out with food. So we went back in and went through the open door. The few staff told us they were closed for the day. However, more food was being prepared. Not sure what this was about. I wrote into to corporate Chipotle on their website and received a canned response that they would review everything with the store. That was worthless. There was no concern that a store was closed. I can only assume it was a forced closure of some sort. Maybe by health department? I have read many reviews about it being filthy. But then why would they still be producing food for some? Sounds like they need management to manage this location. Either fix this location or close it.

So ... on the scale of sandwiches here in the valley. This place is a solid 4th. Just ahead of "sell your first born" Jersey Mike's, and just behind 3. Uncle G's 2. Fat Guys and still my favorite for quality and quantity Firehouse Subs

Fries were cold and soggy. I went against my better judgement in ordering them because a real sandwich doesn't have fries. The sub wasn't bad or good. Perfectly mediocre.   Kind of one of those places you eat at when you discover you are hungry and have few other options.  Definitely not a destination or "Oh my gosh I need that sandwich" type of place.

Ordered late night pizza 1030pm placed the order the manager Jacob calls me and tells me that it's going to be an hr or an hr and 30 mins for it to get here. Which I thought is pretty normal. After we got off the phone I saw they closed at 11pm so I guess he was trying to get me to cancel it. My stuff arrives within 40 mins and when they drop the pizza off, no one rings the bell or knocks on the door and just leaves the pizza outside and walks away, if my security camera didn't notify me, I would have never known it was there. When I go grab it I notice that one of my sides looks like it's been stepped on, and one of the pizzas the cheese is stuck to the top of the cardboard like it had been pushed up against the roof of the pizza box or flipped with the amount of sauce that was on everywhere. 
I get that it was close to when everyone is getting off, but you close at 11pm I ordered 30 mins before, you can't punish your customers by ruining there food. 
I spent close to 60$ and I left the driver a 6$ tip. 
Are you guys for real.
These people are crooks.  The give you an estimate, show up at your house, then call and leave a message on your voicemail that it will be double their estimate.

We have taken our cocker spaniel here  about 5 times.  We had one grooming where he back looking really ridiculous but i chopped that up.to a mis communication over what I aaked for versus, what theu did.  So I brought in pictures after that and they did a great job...my dissatisfaction started with the last appointment. They schedule me to drop him off at 9am, so by lunch time, I figure he will be done. I head out on my lunch break to pick him up and call to see if he is done...busy signal.  I try calling multiple times during my 30 minute commute to pick him up...busy signal.  I thimk they must have left their phone off the hook.

I arrive and the owner is outside pacing the sidewalk on the phone to someone. I go inside to inquire about my dog and theu tell.me another 20 minutes, so I wait and come back.  Owner is still outside on the phone! I pick up my dog amd all is good.  I call this week aftet hours and see if I can get an appt in the next couple days (not usually an issue) and never get a call back.  

Guess I am kinda done. Looking for a new groomer.

I stopped by for a quick lunch last week. Went inside, it was good but not a great Po' Boy like I'd expect at a top Cajun restaurant.  Hook & Reel has the normal seafood decor, like Red Lobster, McGrath's (sad about them), Joe's, etc. with a Louisiana twist. 
I thought I'd get the oyster Po Boy, a New Orleans standard with fried oysters, shredded iceberg lettuce, sliced tomatoes, and a remoulade aioli sauce (spicy Mayo).   It was nice on a fresh sliced toasted French baguette, but they were skimpy with the smallish oysters. I believe there were only 3 or 4 total. The oyster basket with fries included most everything else the same for roughly the same price--and with more oysters!! I should have gotten that.  Instead of fries, I paid extra for clam chowder. It had lots of potatoes, few clams. The oyster crackers with it were on point and soaked up the clam juice broth. That was nice. 
  I was alone, next time I'll go with others--the crab boils appear to be the standout items on the menu.  I saw and smelled the steam fest at the table next to me. The spicy plastic bag of fun looked great. Although I've never found anyplace that gets everything cooked just right at the same time...I saw sausage, mussels, shrimp, snow and Dungeness crab, crawfish, plus corn cobs and red potatoes in there. They have several seasoning choices as well. I should have taken pictures!  
I will be back, but no more Oyster Po' Boy.  The value ratio isn't great on it.

We visited a few times here and one of my children had a birthday party here. We booked the party a few months prior and ordered pizza as they don't allow any outside food. The pizza was average but we were glad we ordered it as the food vendor ran out of pizza in the early afternoon. They allow you to bring cake which we did. There were numerous activities that the kids enjoyed. All the birthday party guests were allowed to stay after the party was over and continue playing. Needless to say most kids were exhausted after a couple of hours. The party host was pleasant. Some attractions (e.g. zip line) have a height restriction. The place is nice and clean but I felt there wasn't much supervision by the staff on the floor.

Always a sad day when you have to share a 1 or 2 star experience, rather than a 4 or 5..

Setting: A/C was still hibernating from the winter so I took it in to the closest place I could find. Had heard some commercials, the gentleman had a pleasant voice and a clear message about fair pricing and quality work. Maybe I should have know that words (even broadcasted) don't actually fix cars, lol.

Diagnosis: Recharge, wake up, full service and what initially felt like a fair price, all made for a fairly happy camper (only disappointed that it took two days for the communication to coordinate on the repairs.. kinda need those wheels for work and what not, ya know..)

Anyway, $233 to get the A/C going and I'd be on my way that evening.  Sounds good, right...  Well, a quarter good..  let me explain.  When I got back to pick up the car, I found that while yes, ONE of the 4 front vents was blowing out some cold air, the others were bringing the heat son!

'Ok', I thought to myself, 'I can live with that for a couple days until they can get it back in to finish the job, no problem.'

However... it was at this point that the problem, in fact, did enter the picture.  

Sidenote - Quick recap: After (Point S) suggested specific repairs, quoted a price and "completed" the work (as a reminder, "fix A/C." a.k.a. 'make air cold in car', ..pretty straight forward request and expectation) I was left with a car that became hotter when the A/C was on, and a pretty good dent in the bank account.  Upon returning to get the job finished, I learned that I was going to break out the wallet again to the tune of just a touch over $400, and then I could totally expect them to finish the job they'd started.

hmmm, ok, time to call the management team and find ourselves a resolution.  ..Long story short, to Dave "resolution" meant; hey, how about only $300 more dollars to finish the job. Woo hoo! Oh lawwwd how I feel the love and appreciation as a customer!  Just warms me to know how much they care. I'm sure you'll feel that same totally satisfied, not-at-all duped and overcharged feeling if you choose to take your car to Point S. That awesome sentiment that makes these beloved car repair experience so comfortable and not at all anxiety ridden. (slight sarcasm implied ; ) 

Either way, I learned my lesson.. Had a great mechanic get in there and finish the job, and now have this story to share with all of you to (hopefully) make sure you have a better experience than I did when car repair becomes undeniably needed in your lives.  There are a lot of companies to choose from out there. I've realized that the number of commercials an auto repair company has doesn't necessarily correlate with their ability and success in actually fixing cars. Won't return, regret the decision to go in there in the first place.  Should've consulted yelp before I took it in.   Live & learn... and share..

I love that you can customize your cinnamon roll! I always end up with the regular, plain roll.. But I like knowing that I can customize it if I wanted, lol. Their chocolate chip cookies are AMAZING. Staff is always very friendly

It was just ok. The waitress I feel was a little deceiving when getting us to change our order to king crab. Our bill ended up being almost $200 for 2 people. My fault also for not asking. Really sad because I didn't eat the king crab and accidentally left our leftovers on the table. We probably will never go back.

So the first time I went the pizza was okay. Those that were working were friendly. This last time I went they "forgot" to make my pizza from my call 25 min. before I came to pick it up and neglected to tell me until AFTER I paid. They quickly whipped it up. The manager kept her back to me the whole time I was in there. When our pizza was finally done and we got it home, the dough was rolled out or hand tossed very unevenly (some parts didn't have dough at all), and they rushed the cooking so it was still doughy, of course not in the paper thin spots. This pizza was awful and so was the service.  I will never go back!

Tried Mo' Bettahs for the lunch today. We ordered online through their website and our food was ready for pickup in less than 15 minutes. We've tried quite a few Hawaiian restaurants in Idaho, but being from Hawaii this was the first time I had a plate that truly reminded me of home!

First of all, the portion of my mini mixed plate was huge! Definitely worthy of a Hawaiian plate lunch. The kalua pig was perfectly seasoned (something that a lot of other places get wrong) and the teri chicken was moist and perfectly charred. My husband's chicken katsu was also really good and surprisingly wasn't soggy by the time we got home 30 minutes later. The mac salad was exactly how I like it with no random things added, just simple Hawaiian mac salad.

We will definitely be coming back again soon and I can't wait to try their full menu. Hopefully next time they'll have their chantilly cake available!

We had our Dungeness cravings satisfied!!! Their lemon pepper sauce, OMG I'm still drooling! Our waitress Kaylee  was so awesome, always checking on us...my other half even shared with her how to kill the seafood smell off your hands lol. Atmosphere was incredible and heartwarming. I think they need to expand or open another location. Too crowded and don't have too much of privacy while we cracked those crab shells with our teeth lol as busy as they get every night, I think it's time they open a new location. I know seafood is expensive to begin with, but prices is a little on the high side. Its good to cure the cravings though when you don't live by the ocean. We'll be back in Lenten season for sure.
Very thorough and professional atmosphere. Staff is very customer oriented and Dr. Scott is an awesome dentist. Highly recommend him and his staff to anyone.

First I will admit I did not purchase anything from Ryan.  I called him based on all the fantastic Yelp reviews to see if he offered any hybrid bikes.  Ryan answered the phone and gave me a lot of helpful advice.  He also offered if I had ideas of what I wanted, he could try and see what he could get through his distribution channels (there is a real shortage on hybrid bikes right now with everyone exercising on their own during these shelter in place orders).  I hope I can use Ryan's services in the future.     Ryan is a great local business that deserves any support we can give him.

Highly recommend getting on the waitlist especially on the weekends or dinner time. 

I was able to get on the waitlist and was seated in less than 10 mins. Our waiter Dan was so helpful when recommending what to try! Kudos to him for the amazing customer service. 


My bf ordered the reel catch and I ordered the perfect storm with the calamari appetizer. The calamari was perfectly battered and tasted really good compared to other places. I ordered spicy and my bf ordered the fire and it was the perfect level of spicy. Let me just say that the seafood was cooked perfectly!!

Amazing customer service. Very clean restaurant. Quality seafood!

We wanted to find a new, casual place to grab a bite to eat. We stopped in here on a Saturday around 5:30ish. It wasn't busy, and the bartender came to our table quickly and took our drink order. When he returned with our drinks, we ordered food, which came out fairly quickly and very hot! We had a burger, and a Reuben, and they were delicious. The burger was cooked well, and the Reuben was the best I've had in the valley, the fries were also great- hand cut. The portions are huge- we both took half of our food home. Our drinks were strong and well mixed, and our service was superb. Everyone from staff to other patrons was very friendly!
We will definitely be repeat customers!

Boy, what a great place! The food and service was up to par. Thank you! We'll come again.

Alexa, thank you for your service. Continue doing great!

The wife and I recently had lunch (second time) at the "Hook and Reel" restaurant in Meridian, Idaho. This second visit, unlike the first, was very disappointing. In two words I would say "Not Enjoyable"! The food was not very tasty and very overpriced for what you get. I had the soft shell Blue Crabs with fries. It came with cocktail sauce and tarter sauce. The best part of the meal was the two sauces. The fries were cooked "Cajun" style. Not a lot of great flavor, fresh out of the freezer. The soft shell crab had very little meat and too much batter. My wife (Patti) had the "Lobster Boil". Should have sent it back but we let it go. This meal was terrible and I made a mistake not sending it back. The Lobster was overcooked and very small. Hard to remove from the shell. It came with two small  boiled potatoes and a piece of boiled corn-on-the-cob. Not worth the $18+ charged. Our total meal was $38. Look at the photo and you will tell me ....................... "You NOT Gonna Eat That". Visit my Facebook page at: Brogar's - "You Gonna Eat That"?

Ordered take out oyster po boy and Cajun fries. The sand which  was awesome the fries slightly undercooked but still crunchy when I got home. The only drawback was when the  hostess asked me if I wanted any sauces and I said  " remoulade" she looked at me like I hade  9 heads. She asked the cooks and came back with honey mustard. What the fuck kind of Cajun restaurant has no idea what remoulade sauce is. 
Fake Cajun only gets 2 stars
Food was good, not out of this world. And it took 45 minutes to get our breakfast. Didn't think I would be there for over an hour and a half after getting seated to eat breakfast.

We had Meridian Tree Service remove three of our old trees.  We contacted Meridian Tree based upon the recommendation of my neighbor who has hired them a couple of times.  Two of our trees were sick, and needed to come out.  One of them was healthy, but was planted too close to the house (Who planted it that close, I wonder?  Oh wait, that was me!  Doh!)  They also ground out one of the stumps.  They had a crew of guys who came in and made short-order of the three trees.  They cleaned up AMAZINGLY, and you could hardly tell that any work had been done.  It was like three trees just disappeared.  We immediately planted another smaller tree in the spot where the stump got grounded out, so that job appeared to be well done too.  All in all, while it was sad to see our trees go, the experience with Meridian Tree Service was excellent!  Also, I can tell you that their bid price was lower than the other contractor that we got a quote from, so saving $$$ is also a plus.

Bomb seriously bomb. I pick up here all the time door dashing but tonight was our first time ordering we ordered the 3 meat plate definitely was not disappointed so so delicious they could step up their salad game but overall we'll definitely be ordering again!!
Chicken was dry and burnt won't be eating here again- I heard many good things however the food wasn't up to my expectations

Wow! We are true foodies and found this new restaurant on a quick visit from Portland. The food and ambiance were all 5-star. Do not miss the mussels; they are amazing green lipped mussels from New Zealand and a broth you will want to eat as a soup! Had the Il Sugo pasta and loved it!  Good wine list. There are a host of other dishes I want to try. Savor this wonderful new restaurant. Thanks for a great meal!!

Tucked away in the fancy, glamourous Village (outdoor shopping mall decked out with Christmas scenery and lights at this time of year), you'll find this plant-based bakery that provides a variety of tempting cinnamon rolls that would give non-vegan rolls a run for their money.

POSITIVES: The ambiance is very modern and inviting. It feels much like a donut shop at first, with a counter/register and a simple glass display of a handful of their creations. The customer has the liberty to build-your-own rolls from an abundant list of toppings and frosting options. They also provide a sizable menu of pre-created options, with diverse yet complementary toppings. Doesn't matter whether you are a fruit or chocolate lover, they'll hook you up. They also have edible cookie dough, and a MASSIVE brownie, not to mention other treats in case you're not feeling a cinnamon roll.

NEGATIVES: to an extent, looks can be quite deceiving. The toppings/frosting were the saving grace, as the cinnamon roll itself was quite bland. The portion size overall was big, but the ratio of roll-to-toppings was nonproportional, with the average quality cinnamon roll outweighing the frosting and toppings. It is a bit on the expensive side, and while you get quite the special treatment due to providing vegan-friendly options, the taste doesn't necessarily redeem it.

VERDICT: it was decent, worth a shot on a date night. The elaborate designs on these rolls and customizable toppings are quite the "eye candy". But suffice to say that after eating here, I wouldn't consider myself a cinnaholic.
Excellent crust  and great Pizza. Very consistent quality. This is a go to from now on

I honestly can't say enough about Pauly's Bar Room, formerly Rick's Press Room, in downtown Meridian. When we were new in town, we were looking for those local hangouts, the neighborhood bars and Yelp gave Pauly's a great rating. From the first 5 minutes we were there, everyone was super welcoming. The bartenders and the patrons were chatty with us, which we love, the drinks were stiff and the beers were cold served in chilled glasses. Since that first visit, we have been back many times, on our way to becoming regulars. I have to say their daily and nightly food specials are amazing. They have some hard working talented cooks at Pauly's. We've had meatloaf, prime rib, tacos, then regular menu items like burgers and tots and such. Everything is good. I actually check their Facebook page regularly to see what the specials are. They have a Sunday Brunch which is pretty popular, although the regular menu isn't available until after brunch.. I do think food and drinks are fairly priced too. Overall, if you are looking for a friendly, local, not stuffy bar, check out Pauly's!
My kids love it here. If you like rice bowls or teriyaki plates this is easy, fast, reasonable, and yummy.
Wow I love this place! I ordered a plate to go and got to try the teriyaki chicken which was to die for. Great barbecue flavors. The prices are fair and the meat is delicious.

Went on a Saturday morning for a spot of Late breakfast. The place was marginally busy, we were seated straight away. Our waitress took about five minutes to show up for our drink order, straight black coffees please. Three minutes later we were placing our order for food. Then we waited, and waited. And waited... Oh here comes our food! But wait, where's the coffee we ordered over half an hour ago? Nope not anywhere to be seen. Huh... Ok wait here it is finally. All in all the food was ok for a breakfast meal. Kinda hard to screw up breakfast right? Service was terribly slow and discombobulated. Take your own coffee if you are hankering for some.

In the 3 years we had our property with Park Place we had 9 property mangers if we had one.  Don't waste your time you can do a better job yourself.  Oh yeah, did I mention the milking of maintenance,  billed repeatedly for items that did not happen.   SAVE YOURSELF THE HEARTACHE AND RUN AWAY NOW!!!!!!
We love it!  Service and food was amazing! Even the clam chowder was outstanding.  Great experience.  Albeit messy.  Lots of fun!

We are from Portland Oregon where the best flying pie is on Stark St.  This pizza was not even close to the quality we're use to.  We asked for a vegetarian with sausage and no sausage was to be found on our pizza.  I asked for extra garlic and I can assure you no vampires will attack.   It was late so we didn't make a fuss.   
Just passing through and we'll not be back

I've never left a salon as happy as I was when I left Casa Bella Salon & Spa. I made an appointment online with Vanessa, the website is convenient and easy to navigate. Vanessa was honest, and an overall joy to be around. I can't wait to go back.
One of the best seafood restaurants in the Boise area. Their seasoning is authentic, and they do an amazing job. It is a long wait on Friday and Saturday, but 100% worth it!!!

Found this place while on a short visit. Very good food and friendly service. Always on the lookout for good and authentic tasting Hawaiian food. I ordered the 3 meat plate so I could try more than one. This could easily feed 2 people.

Ok I have to admit I lowered my expectations because we've been to New Orleans several times and love Cajun style food. I knew better than to expect that anything served in Idaho could truly compare  so I tried to be realistic . Having set my own bar pretty low Hook and Reel managed to still disappoint. 

First of all it's called Hook and Reel but 99% of what they serve actually is caught in pots because they don't serve any fresh fish, only shellfish. Even more surprising because most of their decor is varied stuffed fish hanging from the ceiling.

The irony should have been a warning signal that what was to come would not be what I hoped for.

They primarily specialized in various Seafood boils that come with two small potatoes and a tiny hunk of corn on the cob. They actually have a pretty good variety of shellfish options from mussels to lobster tail and cajun seasoning to add flavor. My wife got the lobster tail and I got the Cajun shrimp alfredo. 

Although I certainly expected a small amount of lobster tail for $16 it was even more underwhelming than I anticipated and under done so that the meat was very difficult to remove fully. The two tiny potatoes and bit of corn we're less than satisfying although the flavor was fairly good. If we had not also ordered a side of Cajun French fries we certainly would have needed another meal somewhere else.

Next my shrimp alfredo came out on a sizable enough plate but the tiny little shrimp looked like something I would expect on a salad rather than a main dish. Kind of sad that I can get better shrimp alfredo at Olive Garden than a place that is supposed to be a Cajun restaurant. Beyond the minuscule shrimp no pun intended the giant chunks of onion were so undercooked it tasted like they had just chopped it up and tossed it on the pasta. I could only manage about a third of the dish before I couldn't stand it anymore.

I was going to give the review two stars for a disappointing experience but then my wife made the mistake of using the restroom before we left. We've seen more sanitary conditions in truck stops in Nevada. It was truly disgusting and not just because it was well used during a busy time. The walls were filthy and the cleaning tools standing next to the toilet were gross. There were no toilet covers so my wife had to be creative with toilet paper across the seat to protect herself from taking home something else unexpected.

So many better ways I could have wasted $50...

If only Evangeline from New Orleans would open a location next to this one.

When the Dream Clean team is at my house, I feel stress and anxiety leaving my body! They are phenomenal, thorough, expedient, detailed, and extremely polite. I have had had different housekeepers clean our house in the past who cost a little less, but don't do nearly as good of a job as Dream Clean. Do yourself a favor and invest in your own self-care by hiring them. Best decision I made in all of 2021.

I highly recommend Jeff as your realtor! He first sold our house quick for more than we'd hoped, giving us great advice on how best to go about it. And then he found the perfect house for us to purchase too. Jeff was able to move quick so that we didn't have to move into an apartment in between either, which was great. He has great contacts to help make the whole process smooth and easy, like carpet cleaners and handyman services. The whole experience could not have gone better - thanks Jeff!

Worst Chipotle I have ever been to. Countless times  they have been out of ingredients during normal times of day, trash cans spilling over, disgusting tables. Now they only allow pickup orders which you will most definitely have to wait over an hour for (like I did for the third time tonight). They have three staff members at a makeshift counter preparing orders while usually over a dozen people wait in the lobby together very covid consciously, obviously that must be the idea here. Love to see the logic. I received my order that I had set to pick up at 6:10 (mind you I placed this order at 4pm) and I did not receive my meal until 7:15. On top of that the food was entirely wrong, the guac I added wasn't there, the burrito was 100% not my burrito I had ordered and my bowl was also quite wrong. A complete waste of money and time, I am SO disappointed.

Great place! Mario came out & replaced our locks & got everything working on the same key. He was fast, efficient, under budget & even chatted with my little boys. They are so happy with his work and will use them again!

Go.  Just go.  Get your purse/wallet/bag-o-cash, whatever...they are "used prices" for new quality!  

They are housed between the Aquarium and a pawn shop and apparently have been there for awhile.  I guess I have driven by a few times and never really paid much attention but drive by no more! STOP in and browse!  If anything, you will be inspired by all the pretty things!

I was just going in looking for a table after visiting several consignment shops.  I came out purchasing a table AND a acquiring a long list of things to purchase in the future.  They have tables, chairs, couches, coffee tables, dressers, headboards...furniture.  Their inventory is always changing because the owner scopes out deals from high quality stores.  He is then able to sell the items at fractions of the prices in the actual stores.  I ended up purchasing a new 83 inch, recycled wood table for just around $800, comparable to any consignment shop around.  Both guys that were working there were awesome.  They put up with my questions and gave me all sorts of suggestions!

They have free shipping on purchases over $500.  I got the table delivered the next day, no issues at all!

We visited here for the first time on Father's Day. It was delicious! Our waiter was awesome, very nice. The food was fantastic. Glad to have found a seafood place out here. We've been to Maryland where the best crab is, and this is a close second!
Go see Sonya! She is so insightful, kind, and got my body and mind back on track. As close to a miracle worker as it gets

So, my daughter and I stopped in for the lunch buffet, and as you can see in the picture it was rather sparse. To be fair I didn't include a picture of the "salad bar" with its wilted lettuce and mystery dressing. The pizza was ok but the laughs we had over the "buffet"were the best part.

Kids are having fun, but we had time to write this review while we're waiting for the pizza. We placed an order about an hour and a half ago. And still waiting. 

Staff refunded the money and pizza did eventually come out.
Take it from this old Sea Captain . We had them on the half shell and in the  basket these oysters are first rate.

Yelp never fails to help me find good food when I'm out of town on business. I couldn't decide between all the good choices. Glad I got the big boy because all 3 were great (katsu, kaluah pork and teriyaki chicken. I've had plate lunches in Hawaii and this was comparable to what you can get on the islands.

This place is the bomb! Everything tastes super fresh and the staff is great. We've been here several times since we discovered it last month and it's our new favorite place for date night or to celebrate with family and friends.

What can be said..
 Place was amazing I have been dieing for a pastrami and finally found one. loved it grilled onions and peppers and cheese all grilled. meat was hot and juicy not dried out.   Was such a delight sandwich fries and a drink. My girlfriend had the Grilled reuben and I don't like rubans but had to try a lil taste. Must say it was STELLAR also. The menu will take a month to make it threw all the sandwiches But I think I am up for the task. I know they are new and I bet the smiles and the food get nothing but better... Great meal thanks.

Great fresh cinnamon rolls. You can choose your frosting  and toppings. For myself I went with the "old fashion ". There was no skimping on the vanilla frosting!  Warm and fresh and great flavor. The balance of the flavors were perfect.

Heather and Brenda are wonderful. Easy online appointment option. Deep and extensive understanding of pain relief and the body. Heather listens to you and suggests treatment that is comfortable for you. Very relaxing atmosphere. Cozy and clean. Helped me immensely for back pain after accident, fertility treatments and stress relief. Treatments help body heal itself. Better and cheaper than the medication route, expensive Doctor appointments that usually help with nothing and never find what's wrong with the body. Alternative medicine works. Go try it and see. Addicted.
I loved going there to do my laundry. Reasonal priced washers and dryers. Always clean. Had a question tho. Washing clothes had 3 quarters inside, washer stopped, quarters gone??  Where did they go?

This is owned by the same person as is Barrelhouse.  My husband and I would not have gone in had we known because among our all-time worst dining experiences for hospitality and food was a dinner at Barrelhouse.  Sometimes ignorance is bliss because not knowing the ownership link we were intrigued by Barrel 55 enough for menu concept of something other than formula chain food in Meridian (which is chain restaurant central...alas) to give it a try.  We enjoyed it enough to say we might to back sometime.  Maybe.  But they have lots and lots of work needed to fix new restaurant wobbles of getting food out of the kitchen in reasonable time and with consistency and true up the mixology skills at the bar.  One would expect experienced owner to do better than this at opening.

VIBE:  Revamped from a former chain Mexican (On The Border) restaurant, the space is cavernous and divided up with restaurant on one side and bar on the other.  Although we chose the bar for seating on our first visit, the sardine can tight, high table seating  and too loud music along with TV chaos would have us choose the restaurant side next time. 

SERVICE:  Through every step of table service, the server for our meal was professional.  She knew her stuff for the menu and delivering the dishes in the order we requested even if it took way, way, way more time than one might expect for the kitchen to prepare dishes.  It was tail end of happy hour when discount-deal prices are over and bar patrons had exited en masse and the restaurant had not many folks seated.  She kept us posted about the long delays each step of the way, so good for her.  Actually at the end it was sort of funny as we wondered if someone from the kitchen was traveling to Japan to fetch the cotton cake dessert it took them so long to put it up.  Two appetizers + two cocktails + dessert = 1 1/2 hours.  We like leisurely dining.  This was not that.  This was painful delay.

FOOD:  Grilled artichoke was a nice meaty one with just the right amount of grill char.  The steamer clams were tasty too and a tip if you order these - ask for extra bread at the time of the order as it is lightly grilled and perfect to soak up the good broth.  Japanese cotton cake for dessert was just sweet enough but not too.  Prices seemed reasonable in context of Meridian and food quality.

LIBATIONS:  We chose seasonal specialty cocktails.  Neither was chilled enough and seemed inexpertly crafted.  There's a first world problem, I know.  But for ten bucks each they need to do a better job.  The wine list was minimal.  Also, no sparkling wine by the glass available.  Although they did have a cocktail with Prosecco in it, they would not serve Prosecco by the glass.  (Yes.  It did bring to mind the conversation between Jack Nicholson's character and the waitress in Five Easy Pieces when he was trying to order toast. :-)* )  Coffee was awful because the kitchen hadn't figured out the brewing system and our server graciously took it off the bill without us having to ask.

THIS N THAT:

1) ACCESSIBILITY:  Accessible parking in lot although not in numbers required by ID code and ADA. Level in the door and throughout it seems.  Looks like mostly standard height tables and booths in restaurant.  Once again bar seating is mostly high perch.  Loo is accessible.

2) PARKING:  Good sized private lot.

3) WHAT DO YOU MEAN YOU DON'T KNOW THE TOAST SCENE*: A classic.  Linked here.  'I'll have the toast...' is an inside joke comment between my husband and I when what you can't order doesn't make sense.   https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hdIXrF34Bz0

Review is for Chipotle on Eagle Road in Meridian Idaho. Management needs to hire staff that have some basic customer service skills. The person at the register today clearly has zero customer service skills. A simple "thank you" would go a long ways rather than shoving my food order across the counter and acting like I was a bother. Never again.

I like the food here, always fresh and tasty, and the service is usually very good. I do have an issue with the coffee however, which is why I only give it 3 stars. The problem is, the coffee is not always hot. Rather than filling a carafe with fresh hot coffee for each customer, I suspect that they fill them ahead of time, and then the carafes sit for too long. The servers are good about replacing it, but I shouldn't have to go through that process. I'm a weekly customer, and I've seen this on more than one occasion. Fresh hot coffee is a must with breakfast!
I love this place, I always take awkward first dates here so I can seem like "in the know" about the best cozy coffee shops lol

Stopped by for a late lunch. The manager, Robert, was there and seemed as personable as he was in the TV ads.  We were seated immediately and ordered two po boy sandwiches, one shrimp and the other chicken. Later we added an order of hush puppies.

Food was very good and served piping hot.  It was an enjoyable experience and we're looking forward to eating there again. 

Normally I wouldn't comment on the restrooms but they were super clean!  I mean really clean!
I love Axiom mostly because of their mystic spray tans they offer! I get unlimited each month at a really decent price. Glad they offer dark in the unlimited package as well!

It's always something. 

This time, the drive guy takes my order through speaker, proceeds to ask if I want sauce.  I say yes, plenty!   The older lady at the window hands my bag of food. I ask her if there is sauce in there. She assured me yes. Of course I drive all the way back to work. And of course, not one packet. 

Before the fries were soggy and cold, another time a burrito I ordered might as well be part of a kids meal, it was tiny. 

The only consistency there, is it's always something

Um... I think I found vegan heaven... I can't believe I haven't been here before in the Cali locations!! The girl working was so nice and helpful! I couldn't make up my mind so I decided to create my own. Annndddd the best part... not only is EVERYTHING VEGAN but i didn't have a stomachache afterwards like some "vegan" bakery's. The calories are insane, but well worth it!!
Awesome coffee & matcha :-) definitely worth the mile drive off of the freeway to support a local shop!

Work virtual Holiday party was a paint session with Michelle. She was so engaging and fun! I would love to do an in person session with friends.
I would recommend The Angry Easel for any painting event! Great prices, super fun host!

Redline recently took over the marina at Lucky Peak. We rented a boat this past weekend while we had guests in town with plans of going tubing. 

1. Our boat had ridiculous damage to it- duck tape holding up the table at the back of the boat. And a massive dent in one of the front pontoons which dramatically impacted our experience and the performance of the boat. None of which was ever mentioned to us. The boat was also full of the last renters trash. 

2. With each rental, you get an inner tube. Apparently Redline could care less if they honor their end of the deal as we were told other inner tubes had been popped a couple weeks ago- but from our perspective it's their job to replace them. We had two younger kids with us that would be inner tubing and as a result would require an adult with them. They decided to give the larger, more stable Inner tube to a group of teens who were towing it on a jet ski, not even a boat- than to rent it to us. Despite all this being pointed out to them, we ended up with a small single person inner tube. I find it wreck less that they didn't do the right thing to ensure the safety of their respective renters. 

3. The teens who run the dock where you pull up to return your rental and gas up, are more concerned with maximizing their social hour than they are doing their job. They were zero Help in guiding us in, until they pointed out the gas tank was on the opposite side of the boat- but the buoys were on the wrong side. It made no sense. They made us go back out and reverse back in and didn't seem to be bothered that there were no buoys on that side to protect the boat. We had unloaded our stuff and put it in the car when my husband came back to
Pay for the gas- it shouldn't be any surprise that they were busy socializing and hadn't even started to fill the gas tank. 


Bottom line: Redline is only about getting your money. Not safety, not customer service and not ensuring you have a good experience.

I just moved to the Meridian area and I had my hair done by Debbie, the salon owner. She did color and pixie haircut. I love my cut and my color. She really very skillfully took into account my facial type and head shape, and my new hairdo is very flattering and sophisticated.  I will definitely be back.
I've had the opportunity to have them replace three iPhone screens and have always received good service.

Excellent from start to finish.  Great customer service and very specific in getting us a quote for cleaning.  Checked in and they were on time with a crew and cleaned every corner and left the rental home sparkling clean.  Highly recommend them!

We took our Doberman "Berty" there today. Was greeted quickly, but the most important thing was the Caring, Professionalism, and friendliness we found. Our dog loved the Vet Tech and Dr Anisha Kumar. It was nice to see our dog respond to these two people people like she did. Thank you so much for your help!!

Randy was very responsive to my Medeco deadbolt request and answered all my annoying emails. They are only one of 2 authorized Medeco key outfits locally. Chad came and installed the 3 deadbolts, and even went back to his office to find 2 ANSI 1 bolts which were missing from my new lock kits, with no extra charge! He showed pride in his work, and made sure these difficult deadbolts were all installed perfectly. His drilling and chiseling was careful and he let me know what he was doing. I recommend these professional locksmiths.

* I like the beef "Del Taco". Really really. Hard to beat. Yet I think I prefer the tater tots at Taco Johns as opposed to the fries here.
* Today I drank some Cherry Coke before eating the tacos, and then the meat didn't taste all that flavorful. Was it a change in recipe, or was it the phosphoric acid messing with my taste buds? Somebody help me out here. 
* Last week I had a strawberry lemonade, which seemed like a great deal, at only 1 dollar. In their haste, the server didn't mix up the muck of strawberry preserves at the bottom of the cup with the weak (not fresh squeezed) lemonade on top.
* My server offered a free replacement lemonade today, and it was an improvement. Yet I would not want to spend another dollar for it.

I don't know why we continue to do this to ourselves- the fact is that we rarely ever order from here. And we forget.
our memories of spending the night in the bathroom after consuming one of their pizzas fades away and the $8 coupon for a large pizza seems too good to pass up. 
The crust is greasy and the sauce is tasteless. Sickness ALWAYS follows. 
The people who work inside the restaurant have not figured out what customer service is just yet. 
Maybe they should hire more people?
Maybe they should make employees wash their hands?
Maybe they should cook pizzas thoroughly?
Is salmonella an extra topping I'm not paying for?
Delicious. These are the best cinnamon rolls I've ever tasted. My wife and I keep going back. She's decided these are the only cinnamon rolls she wants now.

Healthy Habits is top notch as far as I'm concerned because they don't just spew out a bunch of information about what foods to eat and so on. They're one of the few weight control clinics that truly help you with effective appetite suppressants. Don't waste your time going to the Spokane Valley clinic. They hired a new doctor about a year ago and she's a total paranoid idiot. Went in to get a refill of medication and acted as if I was asking for heroine. Said she thought my heart rate was too high (NOT) and didn't want to jeopardize her reputation by giving me more. It's not a dangerous drug and I've never, ever had any side effects but she seems to be under the impression that it is. Go to the Coeur d Alene clinic, staff is super kind and the doc there, Lori Taylor, is awesome!

Highly recommend Lee Read Jewelers! My Fiance proposed to me over the weekend and I cannot get over how gorgeous my ring is! Not only that he would not stop boasting about how helpful Rebecca was. He traded in a ring that he bought me while ago for something better and Rebecca could not have made the transaction easier for him. I cannot wait to go select his ring! Thank you Lee Read.

I came to wash my dog bed cover and wasn't sure what to expect my first visit. Anna the attendant was super friendly and helped me work the machine! She is amazing in customer service! Super clean and great accessible location.
These guys gave us some advice over the phone before coming out. We avoided a service charge and it was nice for them to offer the good advice that worked.
Fantastic, Fresh and beautiful custom arrangements. Thanks you for putting together such a beautiful bouquet for my special day!

We ordered our pizza online because half the time you call they don't answer. It said it would   take an hour. Showed up and the pizza wasn't even started and it took another 45  mins. While waiting the light in the fridge for the bottled sodas started smoking which distracted all the workers from making any pizzas. They also didn't any ranch :(

The last time I was here was about 5 years ago.
