We got seated right upon arrive. They have curtains separating each table. Everyone is required to wear a mask except while you are at your table. 
We order 2 coffees I gotta admit the coffee wasn't as good, its too weak in taste. Its like water down coffee. But the food WOW!! THE FOOD........
The food its great the portions are big the taste is big so I can't complain about the quality of food.  They got the part down. Service was good. 
We order 2 meals to go and that was just as good as eating in the restaurant. I'll definitely come back again.

So let me start with I'm not normally a sonic person. But corndogs were .50 and I got a family to feed. We sat in the dining area.
Pros: 
Cashier was nice
Food came out quick and was hot
Cons:
As we walked in an employee in back yelled "we're closed" thinking we couldnt hear her. We heard her and felt oh so welcomed..ps it was 7pm.
The dining room was in shambles. Chairs everywhere, trash over flowing, tables were dirty. 

Overall not impressed I watched employees walk around chairs and trash blatantly ignoring it. And it's not like they were swamped they even had an employee washing windows(not well, looked like he was using a spray bottle of grease) 
After seeing that this location has 1.5 stars I totally understand why. I'm thinking the only reason it's still open is because there are few fast food options in this area. I'll drive out of my way to a different location if I ever feel like having sonic again.

Worst customer service I have ever personally experienced. I get you may lose a ticket or get busy and forget an order. The manager at this location chose to argue and called my husband a prick in front of other customers rather than apologize for losing our ticket, making us wait for 2 hours to get an appetizer. Then slammed the refund receipt down in dismay. Never once offered an apology or to make things right. Worst manager I have ever seen. Zero customer skills.

Pizza is horrible quality. They are never prepared for the lunch rush. When you only have so much time for lunch before you have to get back for work, you don't want to wait 30 minutes for them to make pizzas from scratch. Not to mention they are made from scratch and still taste like a dead Sea Otter's ball sack. The first bite I take, all the rubbery cheesy slides off the whole top of the slice. Highly would not recommend this "restaurant".

The reviews did not lie with this establishment (a fancy word for this place :) BAM, Pauly himself greets you with a big smile and ask's you whjat you need.. no need to order a double in this place.. they have outstanding cocktails and AMAZING food! Do yourself a favor and try this spot.. CLEAN, friendly and a much needed go to for an 11 o'clock lunch... keep up the great work Pauly and staff.....
Try to have gourmet upscale bar type food but don't pull it off all the way. Good was decent but not great.

Very casual and laid back pizza restaurant with tons of choices to eat! You do wait a bit for the made to order pizza but the bread sticks holds you over. Definately will be back for the yummy sour dough crust.

If I could give less I would. The owner is on a power trip. I'm thankful my daughter is not left alone with a man who cares so little with the well being of children. Playing hard core tournaments for 8-9 hours with hardly any breaks and they have to wear a mask even when they can't breathe. Child abuse. The owner Loren singles out parents and families to harass. No mask ordinance or any reason this would be the case. Making a child with asthma and a written health exemption wear a mask or leave and provoking an issue with a parent asking for clarification on mask rules is insane. I wouldn't trust my kids alone in a gym with Loren. He clearly thinks the power to do anything is his... he said it himself he makes the rules ( it's an entire league not his personal choice )

Meh... chain restaurant... sort of a cross between Red Lobster and Long John Silvers but with a Cajun'ish theme (lots of plastic fish hanging from ceiling). Almost expected wait staff to wear suspenders with "flair.".  "Cajun'ish" because nothing blacken'd on the menu. 



Crab cakes and crab roll were pretty good, raw oysters just ok, prawns in spicy oil just ok -beware you'll have to peel them yourself... Pretty sure everything but oysters were previously frozen...

All in all, just okay. Def not the place to go if you're looking for fresh seafood cooked how you want it - all very formulaic e.g. Choose your protein, spice combo 1-4, heat level 1-3, and it all comes out steamed in a funky plastic bag.
Zoe and her team were excellent to deal with and able to get me moved in with in 72 hours.  Apartment was great

I attended for 9.5 years and enjoyed many of those years, however, I prefer the truth of grace in both words and actions in a church. My family and I were watched very closely here, what we watched, read, who we talked to and what we did outside of church, ect. Though this felt like love at first, it became controlling over time. My family and I have enjoyed our freedom since leaving.

Our kids jackets were taken within 15 minutes of getting there. The staff seemed nice but there wasn't much they could do. A lot of young kids running the place. 
The most frustrating part is when I called to see if the jackets were turned in no one ever answers the phone!!!
I had to drive down there and the staffs comment "oh we are too busy to answer the phone" and "oh jackets go missing all the time". They need to get to the bottom of it!!!
Other than that the kids had a blast. If you go early on weekends then you get a discount. That part was cool.

Unfortunately my experience here wasn't the best. Reason why I'm even giving two stars is due to the fact that the customer service skills from the employees were all truly on point and everyone who was working there all had very nice and polite attitudes. However, after ordering we had to wait for 45 minutes to get our food. At the time there were only 4 tables, including my own that were being occupied. Upon getting our food, it sadly came out cold. The food itself wasn't bad but just the long wait and coldness of the food made my decision to not come back.

I would have given 5 stars if the woman was friendly. I mean, even the tiniest bit. I guess I didn't realize it was vegan when I asked for milk. They only had cold brew coffee in the fridge and said they had to "make THEIR  coffee from scratch" per person so I should just go to village Coffee. 
The cinnamon roll was good but they need to be way more approachable and maybe smile.

The guys working here were very knowledgeable and (more importantly) *very* patient with the three boys I brought into the shop to do Christmas shopping. Will absolutely be back to purchase from the "wishlists" that were created and am very thankful for these guys and the way we were treated. Much appreciated & happy to be able to shop locally.

Hook & Reel was fantastic and the pricing was very good. The food was genuinely spicy. The seasoning had a real kick. Every bite was enjoyable and our server treated us very well. Her timing in coming to the table and checking on us was well measured and the atmosphere made sitting there and enjoying some drinks enjoyable.
I wish they had outdoor sitting.

I love this place so much I brought my entire family the next time I came. The eats seem really authentic and everyone is super nice. I think if I'm not careful I'll be a weekly customer for life and go broke
Best food in Meridian hands down! Prices are good, portions are amazing, and staff is fast and friendly!

Best toy store in town. Walk in, get help immediately. I just tell them how old the child is and ask for recommendations. And we are off - going around the store with many good suggestions. It's nice to see intelligent toys and not a lot of junk. Toy town is my first choice when I am looking  for kids toys.

Food was delicious and service was great!!!! Pricing however was a little greedy lol they charged us $1 for a side of salsa with our omelette and every extra was a $1 too (I just find that ridiculous to charge a whole dollar for like 5 mushrooms in an omelette etc etc) but over was yummy and would recommend!

First time trying tonight. Will be ordering here again! Keep up the good work guys! Maybe look for a way at to keep the sandwich from getting soggy if possible for uber eats, but that isn't something that is a male or break. Yumm!
First time here, for lunch, really great food! Had the tuna sandwich w avocado and wife had the Berry and Chicken salad. Both outstanding as was Tara our server!

Worst grooming experience ever. I always came to here to groom my dogs. We decided to try a new groomer here this time, she did not follow instruction well. I understand my dog have some mats around the neck, so she have to cut shorter, but with other groomer, they  at least leave half inch of the fur . The new groomer straight up shaved my dog to save her own time and left razor burn and some bleeding spots under my dogs ears. I found out after I picked him up, she didn't even mentioned to me that she cut my dog. She did not show my dog until I paid. Worst experience ever. If you don't want your dog to get hurt, don't send them here.

They Reeled us in, but we aren't entirely hooked.
Id like to make this a 3.5
We heard lots of good things and saw good reviews when Hook and Reel opened so we put them on our list to visit! 
In a nutshell the atmosphere was fine, very low-key almost 'Skippers' style. 
The service was awesome, we had an attentive server, food came out quickly and nothing went wrong.
However the main issues for us was the food consistency, taste and quality. 
Most of our items we ordered were breaded (by choice) the breading looked great until we were disappointed to find the breading was very over seasoned, not with Cajun seasoning but just too much salt and took over the taste of all the seafood. 
The shrimp and calamari under the breading had no seasoning so it was difficult to taste the quality but the sizes and portions were decent.
We ordered the calamari, hush puppies, shrimp basket with Cajun fries (very overseasoned) and the shrimp Po boy with lobster bisque
My husband also ordered a flavored lemonade that was non alcoholic, first the pineapple. There was so much pineapple syrup that we could not taste the lemonade and switched it for the peach lemonade.
This one was slightly better but still overly sweet and no taste of lemonade.
Overall our experience was great and we enjoyed the night out and trying the food. 
If you're interested definitely give them a stop in, I feel that consistency is likely an issue here but with COVID and high job turn over recently in the valley this is likely a culprit so Id hope to see improvement in the future!

NOT PLEASED AT ALL!!!!!
When I walked into this location i had said my party would consist of possibly 7 people. I'm not sure if she is the manager or the owner but when i said 7 she asked me if I was sure about the number of people. I was taken to a table and the waitress got me a drink as my party continued to arrive there ended up being 5 of us total, our waitress got our drink orders and then decided to eat breakfast with the owner/manager. We waited 20 minutes before asking the hosts to grab our server being that we were ready to order. The bartender ended up coming and taking our orders and was very rude about it as our server decided she wanted to eat breakfast. We ordered more drinks and waited for our food. The food was good! but the bartender almost threw our plates at us when he brought them to our table, and left before asking if we needed anything. This was supposed to be a team bonding event for my coworkers and I, it ended up being all of us very unhappy with the attitude and service we received. we will not be coming back

My husband and I went in about 45 minutes prior to closing- which I thought was enough time to have a very late breakfast. Apparently, it was not. It took 10 minutes for anyone to acknowledge that we were there, even after we were seated ridiculously close to another table that had JUST been served. The waiter explained they had just started a new closing technique. Not really a great excuse for poor service, as they weren't even that busy (bus-girls and waitresses were putting together tables, refilling jellies, etc). He seemed annoyed in general. I ordered a coffee which took another 10 minutes (the dark roast was actually phenomenal, when it arrived), and our meals came shortly after. We ordered a french dip and a "gypsy skillet". The skillet was quite good. The french dip left a little to be desired. We may go back just to see if it was an off day.

So salty. Like it had been sitting under the warmer for hours. Mac salad was not good. I just can't get over how salty everything was. The hawaiian place is nampa-Island Kine Grinds- is 100 times better and the food tastes fresher.

Been here twice to have my eyebrows threaded. Never had them threaded before and it was a nice experience. My brows always look good after I leave here. Chill vibe, friendly. I recommend and will be going back. Beware, the threading may make your eyes tear up a bit.

I was craving Hawaiian comfort food and decided it was time to give Mo Bettah's a try. Since they opened not long ago I've heard great things about them. I used their online ordering system so I didn't have to wait once I got there which turned out to be a very efficient process. The food was ready as soon as I walked in the door to pick up. I tried the kalua shredded pork and chicken katsu with brown rice and mac salad with Mo Bettah's sauce on the side. The meat was pretty good, nothing like true Hawaiian comfort food you can get on Kauai and the Big Island, but it filled the gap. Some gravy on the pork would have made it phenomenal. I was not a fan of the sauce either. It definitely was ketchup based because that's all it tasted like - ketchup. However, the mac salad was out of this world delicious! I enjoyed every bite and liked it better than the entire meal! I'll definitely be making my way down just for some mac salad and maybe
try other meat options!

They mess up my order every single time! They always forget to give me
My drink, utensils and napkins as well! Their online service sucks! They also ignore you when you try to ask for all the things they forgot to give you in the first place!

My husband & I rented from procore for a year.  The turn over for us to move in was fast.  The tenants there moved out & we moved in the next day.  I took pictures of the place as we received it to cover myself.  Well, basically out of our deposit the took $115.00 for maintenance.  Doesn't sound like a lot, but it is.  The pictures I received from Richard where stuff that needed cleaned well I also paid out of my deposit  $150.00 for cleaning.  So what's the maintenance charge?  The blinds, walls, over grown outside plants.  The only thing I did not do was trim the plants back.  The blinds & walls where from the previous tenants.  Sounds like double dipping to me.  Maybe do your homework Richard.  Look at the information you have from the previous tenants.  He mentioned oh we fixed the blinds, no you did not.  The only time anyone came out was for the fan & stove issues.  I find this ridiculous.  I am a landlord & have a property manager I would not charge something twice & label them each different charges.  I found Richard very condescending when I've delt with him. No follow thru either.  DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY!!!

We decided to visit this restaurant today based on the 5 star reviews. We arrived there and right from the get go there was some confusion on where and who was going to seat us. No big deal right? 

I ordered the oyster po boy sandwich and soft shell crab. My wife ordered the shrimp and crawfish pot. She received her order first. After about 15 minutes of my wife receiving her order, I still haven't received my sandwich. I notified our waitress and she went in the back to check. It seemed that someone forgot my order. The manager shortly brought out my food and apologized. 

The food was good. My wife's dish was good and spicy but our waitress failed to bring us water. 

At that point we just wanted to pay for the bill and leave. It took forever to get our check and they couldn't remember where we were sitting at so they can bill us. I just wanted to pay for the bill so I can get the hell out of this shit hole. Those clowns can't even get their billing system right much less their crappy customer service. 

The wife complained to the manager who seemed like he couldn't do anything. His experience on managing a restaurant was just as bad as the waitresses serving food. Believe it or not, the only guy in the restaurant that had a good head on his shoulders was the guy mopping the floors. He should've been the one managing the restaurant. 

If you like crappy service and good food, this is the place for you.

A great breakfast spot with a nice,  clean vibe. Loved the soft and delicious cinnamon roll. The hash browns were perfectly crisp. 

It's so refreshing to see the beautiful smiles of all the staff. We will be back!

My husband and I both had tire issues at different times. We have gone to Roger's Tire Pros three times and had the best service! The people who work there are very friendly and helpful. They have definitely earned our business. :-)

FROM A LANDLORD- Do not trust your home to these people. If you own a home and are considering renting it out, please reconsider!!! I left my home in perfect condition only to receive it back after 3 years of renting looking like a fixer upper. The tenants destroyed the grass and sprinklers, but the property management did nothing about this. So now it is my expense to fix! They allowed a couple to rent my home and run a daycare out of it without my permission, which permitted massive damage to walls, carpet, etc. After inspecting the home after it was "Cleaned", there were multiple items that were CLEARLY not clean. Finger smudge prints, the toilet seat was black, etc. There was tape still on the walls. It was clearly not cleaned thoroughly, if at all. The house smelled of smoke, even though I had specified NO SMOKING!!! The front door has scratch marks on the inside as though a dog was trying to get out. despite not allowing pets. 
The tenants flooded my kitchen due to negligence, but it was at my cost to repair and replace the flooring and dishwasher. This was THOUSANDS of dollars in damage due to the water damage.  The property management did not even pick a dishwasher that was the same color as the rest of the appliances, therefor sticks out like a sore thumb! 
There is clear indication they DO NOT care about your property!!!!!

The somewhat negative rewiews are not accurate. Not crowded; tables well separated, good menu, tasty food with good accompaniments, fast service.  Prices are a little high for lunch. French onion soup very good. Will definitely go back.

After living in Hawaii for 14 years we've never trusted Idaho's land-locked plate lunches. We were pleasantly surprised with their plate lunch. We got Kaula pig and Teri chicken with rice. No Mac salad (we just aren't fans). Their Teri chicken is made with chicken thighs and their Teri sauce is pretty good. They have Aloha soy sauce (which is the only kind we will eat) the pig was my favorite (even over my typical Teri chicken) we saw their pog juice (passion orange guava) which we were so excited! This is the one place in Idaho we've found that has Hawaiian sun juice. No need to get your own plate unless you want leftovers. My mom and I shared a 2 choice mixed plate and it was perfect. Definitely coming back and bringing my dad who has lived in Hawaii most of his life.

So decided to come here because my other place had a long wait. Missed opportunity for sure. Came here after reading Yelp reviews. Seemed like a nice little place. No signs letting you know you seat yourself so that took a minute to figure out since I was new. Sat down and ordered Gramps Biscuits n Gravy. Unfortunately it took over an hour to show up. Waitress never asked for any refills had to ask another waitress for water. I literally watched her film the out her then she never came back. I sneed up walking to the counter for my bill because the waitress walked past me 100 times without even acknowledging me. While checking out I calmly explained that the service was bad and was told they were short staffed. I get that but acknowledge your customers don't leave them hanging and finding their own water. Never again!

Update 8/2016
We bit the bullet and had Ultimate Heating & Air come in and fix the duct work plus install a new A/C unit. We found out that our furnace was undersized for our house and that half of our ducts including our return ducts were not connected so our A/c unit was pulling in attic air (temp 130+) and trying to cool and recirculate. NONE OF THIS WAS CHECKED WHEN A1 INSTALLED OUR FURNACE.  This has resulted in hundreds if not thousands of money spent in trying to heat and cool our house.

Unlike A1, Ultimate's employees are well trained in the ways of customer service. They were polite,
thankful and eager to help us feel comfortable and listened to. 

Our airflow has increased significantly after Ultimate Heating and Air came in and fixed A1's crap installation. (That they wanted to charge us to fix). Our house is finally comfortable. If you need HVAC help, call Ultimate Heating and Air!!!
Great Food! Great people working there! Named a hamburger after my husband.  The Shawn burger.  Burger with onions, mushrooms, fried egg, and bacon.

I'm an out of state landlord and when my tenants water heater went out I started calling plumbing companies.  None of the companies could give me a guestimate.  I entered my request in Yelp and Steve responded within 2 hours as stated.  He quoted me a price and did the job all in the same day.  I highly recommend him!
Very cool spot. Pizza was delicious, a much thicker bread-ier crust than I usually prefer but still good.
New to the area and have used them twice in the last month. Very helpful and knowledgeable. Highly recommended

This rating will likely change as time goes on.  Currently we are in contract with Park Place.  But I do question the people that referred us to them.  We have had very little go right with our dealings with Park Place, though admittedly, most of it is small stuff.  But so many things .... so many.  It does make one wonder just how poorly run a company can be and still maintain existence.  

I hope that when the year or two is up I'm able to write and say something better about them.  Currently I have to encourage anyone looking to rent or have their properties manged to look elsewhere.  I wish I'd checked them out here before.  They apparently have a history of dissatisfied former tenants and property owners.  

Remember your due diligence.

It is your money!

Toby and Sharan were a huge help for me to buy my first home. They were always on top of everything. Whenever I have a question or concern, they are always easy to reach out to and responds back quickly. I'm very thankful working with such great people. I highly recommend if you're looking for a lender who will provide you with great service!

So it's Saturday morning and I wake up and I decide I want some biscuits and gravy. But not just any gravy, I want some sausage gravy. So I jump on yelp and I start looking around at different breakfast spots and all I see is a bunch of gravy without any sausage in it.

Then I come to Deja Brew and right there on the menu grandpa's biscuits and gravy, yes!! Now we are talking, the meal hit the spot and satisfied that craving. Thanks!

This is one of my favorite breakfast/brunch restaurants. I have been here on many occasions but our experience today is what prompted my review. We arrived at 10 with a party of 12 and were told the wait would be 30 minutes. At 10:30 we went to check on the status of our table and were told it would be 20 more minutes. I was irritated and my 3 year old was starving. When we finally got seated they promptly brought out complimentary cinnamon rolls for us to snack on while we looked over the menu. Our waiter was great the entire time. We ordered and received our food in a timely manner with the exception of my meal. The waiter brought me a bowl of fruit while I waited. Once my omelet was done the owner brought it out and apologized for the wait and explained a cook had gone home sick. The omelet and potatoes were delicious. We received the bill and were pleasantly surprised to see the owner had paid for my meal.  We would come back even if they didn't do all of this but they went above and beyond.

This is by far the best place for breakfast I've been in the Boise area. The food is flavorful without being too salty. The portions are very generous. I'd probably share with my daughter next time. They were very accommodating of my substitutions. The service was crazy fast and very friendly.  We will come back next time we want breakfast!

The gym provides all the amenities you need to get the gains you want, but a certain staff manager named Brent needs some work on proper etiquette. There is a free 7 day trial pass offered online to try out the gym. I tell him my background of how I'm interested in Axiom because of location, but i have other friends that go to a different gym. Therefore, I want to try out the pass to see what the vibe is like and a week seems long enough to get a sense of the crowd. On the other hand, Brent takes me on a 30 minute tangent on how the other gyms are unbearable and why Axiom is the best. Furthermore, he never introduced himself. I understand you have to sell the gym, but just let a person do the free trial pass, record him in the system, and let the person do their workout. The only vibe I got from Brent was another dollar sign. Like I said, good equipment, but make sure you feel respected.

New to the area and I was doing recon of the local shops here. Great selection, super helpful staff and normal prices. The two guys I spoke with took extra time to talk to me about everything that was different here in Idaho. All in all a really great shop! I look forward to buying more stuff there!!

This coffee shop is so darn cute.  Who knew?  Nestled at the corner of Cherry and Lender sits Lucky Perk Coffee.  This is my new favorite coffee hangout.   The staff is friendly, coffee is very good and I enjoyed the atmosphere and ambiance most of all.  I liked the fact that there was plenty of room and space between tables.  They also offer a pretty good variety of pastries - which I plan to try on my next visit.

First time that we have ordered delivery from Flying Pie- We did go one time and dined in. The dining experience was great!  Tonight the man who helped me on the phone with my order was patient and helpful. Had manager come and make sure my address was submitted properly as we are a new home, then helped me to be able to see coupon to my order. The pizza was warm and delicious when it was delivered. Love the tomato sauce that you use, as we are Italians it's hit or miss with us;  this was just the right amount and great. Highly recommend

We eat at this location frequently. Maybe once every couple of weeks. The service is usually mediocre at best. A couple weeks ago, however was particularly awful. Pulled up to the drive-thru. It's getting dark and the menu board is unlit, but we always order the same thing, so no biggie. Kid takes my order and for once, gets it perfect on first try. I'm impressed. Even more impressed that he doesn't say they are out of apple empenadas, which they almost never have. Three cars ahead of me in line, goes pretty quick. Kid takes my money and promptly gives me my drinks. Tells me food will be right out. Twenty minutes, still no food. I can see three teenage boys "working". Not one of them so much as glances my direction. Toot my horn. No response. Google Taco Bell and get phone number. Call them. Rings six times and I get a fax tone. Think I mis-dialed. Hang up and call again. Kid answers. Tell him I'm at the drive thru window wandering what happened to my food. Kid says he's sorry. They were waiting on empanadas and they take six minutes. Tell him I've been sitting there for 30 minutes at this point and to please remake the tacos if it's gonna be much longer 'cause I don't want to eat soggy tacos. Kid says ok. Ten more mins go by. Here comes food. No apology. No offer to comp something. No coupon. Nothing. Ask to speak to manager. Manager comes to window. I calmly explain I think he needs to teach his employees to communicate a little more clearly. Had I known I'd be waiting 40 minutes for two empanadas, I would have skipped them. He says sorry, and says he did re-make my tacos. I asked him if he was going to compensate me for my 40 minutes sitting in his drive thru. Expected at least a discount coupon or something. Instead he just stares at me. At this point, I lost my cool and told him that even though we eat there a lot, I'll drive over to Taco Time or to the Taco Bell on Eagle Road. So frustrating!! Avoid this location at all costs!!  Food is usually good, but not worth the wait and horrible service.

We won't be returning.  First, we wait 30 min for a table.  There are alot of people, you think it's going to be delicious.  Wrong.  Everything was just o.k., not with what they charge for just o.k.  When they brought out our food, my husband's was the completely incorrect order.  Not just a little wrong, but a completely different item.  The waitress said she had misunderstood....I get if you misunderstand a change or substitution in an order, but not the completely wrong dish.  My pancakes were so dry they crumbled and stuck in my throat.  No amount of butter or syrup made then palatable.  I asked the manager if they were normally this dry.  His response was that the cook said they were "cooking up fine", which leads me to believe that yes, they're always that dry.  The manager did offer to get me different ones or something else, but at this point I was done.  He took $5.00 off the ticket, uhhmmm thanks(?)  My husband didn't even get to eat with the rest of us and I almost choked on the dry pancakes.  

Not worth the wait or the prices for the "just ok" food.

Erick detailed our Prius to get it listed (we got $1k more because it was so clean) and then ceramic coated our new Tesla 3. His work is impeccable! All with his pick up and drop off service from our home in Boise. Worth every cent and I also tipped him. This is the one!
We used to love going to this TCBY. They have now jacked up their prices to over $5.00 for a small Shiver! On a fixed income and won't be going back.

Our home build with Tresidio homes went smoothly despite coordinating & communicating from out of state. Since we've been in our home we've had the expected minor adjustments but otherwise everything looks and works as we had hoped. Andy Rice our 2nd Project Manager took over at a crucial point in the build and did an exceptional job ensuring all exceptions were promptly corrected. Couldn't have asked for better service! Looking forward to enjoying many years in this beautiful home.

This place is the number one place to bring your pup for a nice bath, haircut, and whatever else they may need to look and feel their best. My pups can be a bit anxious, but I know they are in good hands when I leave them. I have two mini Aussies, Sweetpea and Nova. The woman who owns the place and the people she employs are outstanding at their job! I used to be able to walk in but I think I've told too many people how awesome they are...so I recommend making an appointment. Keep up the great work!

The server, Christian, was a 10!  Perfect service, friendly and prompt.  The food on the other hand, not so great.  The sushi roll appetizer tasted burnt and the artichoke appetizer was flavorless.  My daughter had the kids pizza and it appeared to be a frozen pizza.  The restaurant is nicely decorated and I really wanted to give them a good review.  The dinner special described sounded incredible but we only stopped in for a drink and appetizers.

When you say shit happens, this is what I happened upon. Was really looking forward to a nice coffee and breakfast to start my day on the road. 
Almond milk latte curdled and my steamed egg croissant was a scrambled mess. Don't have high expectations. 
I love supporting local businesses as opposed to going to Starbucks but I'm so disappointed.

Delicious food, loved the simplicity of the menu. I used to go here all of the time for lunch because it was super quick and they had mostly everything ready to go. My favorite meat would be the chicken katsu; and don't forget the teriyaki sauce! Although, it's sad because they give less portions now and it's definitely noticeable.

I cannot say enough positive things about Vitality! The care I received was kind and professional. I also got a last minute appointment, that they were so understanding to let me schedule. I was two weeks over due in my pregnancy and my doctor scheduled for me to be induced the following Monday. Vitality fit me in right away because I wanted to induce contractions and avoid being induced. My contractions started that evening and I had a healthy baby girl that Friday, so I did not have to be medically induced! Thank you!

I tried so hard to like this place. The food has always been good, but our order has NEVER been correct in the 3 times going here. The first time was through door dash, the order was 2 hours late because the wrong driver picked up our order. The second time, I ordered online and picked it up myself. I ordered curbside pickup, arrived at the designated time and checked in on the website. An employee placed my order on a table in the front of the restaurant, let it sit there for 15 minutes before bringing it out to the car. The food was cold and they didn't give us any of the sauces included in the order. Today I ordered online, but went inside the restaurant to pick it up. They forgot a salad from the order (but still charged me for it). 

I could understand forgetting things if I made substitutions or ordered things not on the regular menu, but I don't. Really frustrating not getting what I am charged for.
Loved the food, large portions, yummy teriyaki was ONO!  Staff were high energy and very helpful.  Love to see some desserts, huapia pie!  We'll be back, new to the area.

Brandy and her team were fantastic! All three had positive attitudes. They were gracious, friendly, professional and highly efficient. Oh, and they did a wonderful job cleaning my house! All this and reasonably priced as well. AND, Brandy managed to get my grungy bathtub to sparkle (-I wish I'd taken before and after pics but really didn't think she'd be able to get it clean - I was told by a shower installer that the fiber glass tubs were impossible to clean once dirt got into the tiny splinter cracks.... Brandy proved him wrong!). Well done. No need to look any further, you've found a great cleaning service in Idahome & RV Cleaners. And I understand they also do interior painting. Call Brandy to book her services today.

We used Lee Reade a number of times over 6 years  They were always very expensive but we knew no better.  I would say twice my wife's rings were not sized correctly...their fault?  I suppose but on my last visit I had a ring sized and was quoted $60 or so I thought..........the repairman spoke very broken English and actually had said $160!   Even though I complained it was not appropriate to have a person who spoke very poor English..the owner refused still to compromise on the repair quote....so we go elsewhere where perhaps they are more business friendly.....nice store, nice high repair costs and arrogant owner.  There must be better places.

New to Meridian and looking for a regular stylist. Well my search is over. Summer Hutchens nailed it for me today. My girl in NC sort of botched my "shag" request into a semi-mullet and Summer redeemed me from wearing a cap these past few weeks. Sweet as she can be, an Idaho native with tons of tips on places to visit. Super convenient, I can even walk here and very affordable.

Freaking SCRUMPTIOUS!! Ordered The Reels Catch (meal for 2) with snow crab legs and 2 pounds of shrimp, in garlic butter sauce (Spicy ), with some sauces on the side. And there was lots of shrimp left over btw...

The spicy butter garlic sauce was so delectable. Every morsel of seafood was a delight to eat. I really enjoyed getting messy crackin open crab legs, pulling off shrimp heads with my hands, and yep, I wore the plastic bib, hehe! Trust me, you won't care if you look stupid once you taste the food- your primitive side will take over, and you'll feel like a sea cave dweller happily eating your seafood boil!! (And your shirt will be clean) Your meal also lasts much longer because you have to crack and peel everything! It's also like an activity + dinner. My date and I had a great time and our server Jacob was super informative and very friendly. 

You will not be disappointed with these bangin cajun favors!! 

And ps,  just my recommendation, keep your seafood in the bag on your tray, (dont have them dump it out if they offer) or it will get colder faster!! Enjoy!!

By far the worst property management company I've ever had! I am an experienced long time renter, I'm in my mid 30's; I'm not new to the game. When I first moved in this "no pet rental," it reeked of pet urine. The property company seemed uninterested in the problem. They wanted me home to change the key locks when I first moved in, this was their idea and stated it was a policy. Yet they were unwilling to work around my work schedule (traditional Monday-Friday). After several attempts and them not showing up, I gave up on the changing locks idea. They do not let you pay rent in advance, not even by a few days. I am a person who likes to pay a month in advance, I found this very annoying. They do inspections twice a year, I have nothing to hide...fine. However every other place I've rented from always gave a month notice prior to entering your home (usually for filter changes). This place gives you a week notice which they send via snail mail. As someone who does not get a ton of mail, and I don't check my mail daily, I have missed these notices. It's always a mad dash and scramble to get a filter (which this particular filter is not a standard size).  Now to the part and main reason for my 1 star review. The agreement you sign when you get your place, is as someone else stated about 25 pages or so; several does not apply to you. I am in the process of trying to buy a home. Now I can not be the first person who is going from renting to buying. I called to see how to get out of my agreement (thinking I will lose my deposit and maybe need to find a renter... Possible fee). Nope!!!! If you end your agreement you will lose your full deposit for me it was $800 there is a $500 cancelation fee. You will still have to pay your rent and utilities until they find someone else to take over the lease. They DO NOT do lease transfers even if you find someone to take over your agreement, in which case you would still lose the deposit and have the cancelation fee. So say you can't  get your house to close by the end of your lease, month to month payment? You will be looking at about an extra 150$  A month to pay month to month. Way to work with people who ARE GOOD RENTERS, ALWAYS PAY ON TIME, KEEP THE HOUSE SPOTLESS CLEAN! If I ever have to rent again after I buy my home I will never use this company again. I will also make a point to avoid this company at all cost. Nothing but pure headaches with them! Fairview crossing apartments off of Fairview and Milwaukee, that was a very good rental company, check them out.

I wish I could warn everyone that is considering do business with these crooks.  First of all I was lied to on several occasions.  The quality of their organization is absolutely unacceptable. A month after moving in I received a nasty voicemail from them telling me several neighbors are complaining about our excessive parties,  fighting,  beer bottles in the yard and a gun clip found out front. Then they stated that this is a neighbourhood,  not a frat house. I called back in a panic of tears insisting that is not how we live. The guy on the phone then realized he called the wrong tenets and without any apology quickly hung up.  Then they increased my rent 300.00 with my lease renewal date only 3 days away. But of course suggested they hook me up with the realtor that works there and her lender.  And of course they could then push out my lease renewal to see if I could get approved.  BAIT AND SWITCH! !!! The communication skills are a joke. They had me showing the rental to people and I had people showing up to see the house without any notice from procorp. When I moved in the first week of Jan 2013 it was snowy. When it melted I noticed TONS of trash (broken chairs, a torn pool, broken bbq ext. ) on the side yard. Not to mention the 5 ft weeds on the little out cove area on the other side of the backyard. I left the weeds just as they were and got charged for clean-up.  They charged me for removal of a satellite dish that was on the home. I never had cable! It was already there!  They failed to address it with the previous renters because they didn't thoroughly inspect the house. The previous renters moved out the day before we moved in. So because of their negligence they charged me!  They charged me for repairs that I listed on the first inspection report ( i still have it) and charged me for lawn service because the lawn looked like a Amazon due to the house being vacant for a whole month after we left. My friend live right next door and told us nobody mowed. Thanks to the internet I have met several others that have had much worse experiences with this NO INTEGRITY COMPANY!!!!!!!

Loved it! The crab was amazing, the fried shrimp basket was awesome! Absolutely would recommend. I ordered the crab seafood combo plain, my husband ordered the calamari and head-on shrimp seafood combo with Cajun medium spice. Both of our seafood combos were wonderful, and the medium spicy was pretty spicy and packed with flavor. The fried shrimp basket came with medium large shrimp with just the right amount of batter, not too light, and not doughy, perfect crunch. The fried were terrific, hot crispy outside with soft steamy inside. We had a great dinner...looking forward to going back.

I've eaten at this place back in the 90s and it was way better. I believe its new management as the flavors were not the same. Pizza seemed cheap yet the price was of a higher end pizza. This pizza is no better than pizza hut but without the chain. I would actually rather had Pizza hut at the time.  This was my pizza while growing up but now its just a hole in the wall going the wayside of out of business.  Not able to recommend.

Horrible company. They only returned $150 from my $1200 deposit. And it arrived over a month late. I took care of the house and left it in great condition when I moved out after only one year. During my stay, the food disposal unit broke from normal wear and tear and the bearings on the dishwasher were replaced without my consent due to "being too loud" and they billed me for it!?! Ridiculous. They charged me over $500 for it. When I contacted them about it, they would respond and say they would "look into it." I never got a responce multiple times. Renters beware! If you want to get a fair amount of your deposit back, go with a different company.

Tonight was my first time ordering from Flying Pie and I've gotta say I love the variety on their menu! We ordered the Zamboni & I loved the sourdough crust! The pesto was really good with it and the jalapeno added some fun spice. We also ordered a plain pepperoni and it was loaded with cheese. My only complaint was the zamboni was a little on the dry side but that might have to do with the crust. Delicious though and the 1/2 off the second large deal was awesome!! I'll be back to try the habanero next!

Toby and team are our #1 choice, always. They are efficient, professional, effective, clear and honest. She helped us buy our home 18 years ago. After 2008 we went to her to refinance. She helped us work through our totally 'under water' loan. Then, we just refinanced again in 2021.  I trust her implicitly.

Very load near the concessions/snack area because of the ropes course inconveniently placed directly above. The pizza is ok and popcorn could be better.   It gets boring after a while because they never add anything new which would be a simple expansion of the current building (like wahooz  has recently done and roaring springs is going to do soon) would real in a lot of customers and make it a lot less boring for us ultimate pass holders like myself.

Their customer service was fantastic, even though I did take them a while to answer the phone... The young lady that helped us was very professional, and very sweet. However the food left a lot to be desired... From their extremely bland meat, two they're soggy bread Jon Smith subs has a lot of improving to do. Their steak sub that apparently made them famous, overall made me nauseous. Their meatball sub left a lot to be desired as well with their meatballs lacking overall taste of really anything besides bland meet. However they're red sauce that came with the meatball sub actually contained flavor! Which was a pleasant surprise compared to the rest of the food.

i was happy to know this place made it through the first shut down and hope it continues to stand strong.   it's a great place to eat!  the staff and owner are friendly and provide great customer service!!! oh and the food is fantastic!!!

Awesome pizza buffet. Salad included . The slices are a little small but who cares just get up and get more . Little salad bowl, who cares just get up and get more . Not a big deal. Good deal at lunch time.

These guys are the absolute worst. Avoid at all costs. Under their management we've had to resort to collection agencies to collect unpaid rent from not one but two tenants. I would give zero stars if that were possible.

Not Your Grandma's Furniture Store!!

We are a young couple (mid-late 20s) furnishing a new home and looked everywhere for a dining room set with a more modern feel.  We went to 9 different furniture stores, spent 5+ hours shopping, and dealing with associates who were backed up or didn't know their own inventory.  We stumbled upon this place as I was leaving RC Willys almost ready to give up hope.   Thank god.
Chad was knowledgeable, knew his inventory like the back of his hand, was polite, and knew how to work with tight spaces.  That being said, the furniture speaks for itself too!  There are no, " furniture sets" so put you're creative hat on, and enjoy Chad's company. 
I will close by saying this.  The price was fair, the delivery was quick (no waiting for weeks to get your furniture), and the options plentiful, but not overwhelming.  We will definitely be back.

This is a big management company in the area and they will run over you. I stayed in a place managed by them a for 2 years about 5 years ago. I own my own place now and just got a yelp account and Park Place is one of my first reviews I can wait to tear into. That should be enough said about them.
First and foremost don't expect a deposit back. I know, I'm sure everyone says that no matter how they leave a place. Not me. I always leave a place better then I found it, with out fail. For example, they charged me out of my deposit for things that were already there when we arrived and for cleaning etc. We left that place cleaner then when we found it. Moreover they charged us for repairs that were already there that we addressed with them and they did not fix while we were there, AND, they did not fix them before they put another tenant in! Dig this, I left an upgrade, a motion light under the car port I bought and installed myself and they charged me for replacing the bulbs on it! The list goes on but I'm going to end with this. Do what you want of cource and maybe you have or will have a better experience with Park Place then I did; but as for me, if I every had to use a management company or rent from one again, I would steer clear of Park Place.
Poor service no one answers the phone. It states they are available for "dine-in" with is incorrect
Dr. White is amazing! I always leave feeling ten times better than I did when I walked in. I have shoulder pain and tend to get tension headaches -- he always takes care of me!

This was an awful club experience for my daughter.  The girls spent 6 months going to open gyms that they called practice.  They had little, to no, coaching and were never given any instruction on proper skill development.  They spent every single practice playing 2v2, 4v4, and 6v6.  Tournament play was very painful to watch as they did not know when to sub players and often didn't know their rotations or positions on the court.  They simply weren't coached how to play.
Great sandwiches and fries! The staff couldn't be nicer! I would recommend any sandwich but the Italian Cold Cuts is my favorite!

We enjoyed working with Jeff and he answered us quickly when we had questions.  He also helped a great deal with the interactions with our lender.
Our move to this area has been difficult, but thanks to Jeff it was much smoother!
This is a cool place for birthday parties or being taken there by your granddaughter. They have  like 17 different areas you can do as tiff.
Great conversation. Great haircut. No waiting, appt based shop which I prefer. I would recommend.

If you are looking for the best realtor, search no more!  Stewart Reality is top notch.  In a 1 to 5 rating, my husband and I would give them 10!  My husband and I just moved to the Eagle area in August, 2018.  We previously owned a 5 acre home in Meridian.  We had the pleasure of working with Stewart Reality (Jeff and Sheri).  In our past, we have sold three homes and bought four homes.  Never have we experienced anything close to what we experienced with Stewart Reality.  You will not find anyone as professional and ethical as Jeff and Sheri; they are a fantastic team!  Jeff not only sold our home in Meridian, but found us exactly what we were looking for in Eagle on the golf course.  Both Jeff and Sheri work very hard for you and make the whole process a very positive experience.  We could not have asked for anything more!

We've been to this sonic multiple times, I've never had a good experience. The order we had this evening was given to us incomplete. When we told them we were missing the burgers we had to wait another 5-7 minutes while the sides got cold to receive the burgers. When we got the order we asked for  marinara sauce for our cheese sticks. They finally handed us our burgers after every one of our sides were already cold and I noticed we were missing the marinara sauce. We asked for the side of marinara sauce and thought the handful of sauce they gave us was the request sauce. Instead we drove 7 minutes back to our house to proceed to find out they gave us ranch, the burgers we completely cold to the center to the point we had to microwave them.  Also we discovered the chili cheese frys were completely burnt and just covered in chili to mask the fact that they didn't give fresh fries, or redo the order when they realized the fries were burnt.  I have never had this many problems with an order from sonic and will never go back to this location again. The staff was very slow to fix the problem and still gave us incorrect sauce and didn't seem to concerned that the order was wrong.  We received a "sorry about that" and then the window was closed directly after the very poorly delivered apology. This is not the first insistent of missing product from our order, and the lack of care from the staff at this branch. We would have expressed our concern at the location but felt the management would not have handled the situation correctly and just continued with a half hearted apology and no resolution.  If I could give it a lower review I would. This sonic is the worst in valley. If you want your order to be correct go the the one off Ustick and five mile. This sonic is garbage and I will never go back .

We had the Triple Pie on original crust and we were very pleased. The pie had nice heat, just the right amount of cheese, and a crispy crust. We  will certainly order trim Flying Pie again and would recommend the place to anyone looking for a great pizza.
Del Taco is my favorite and this location was gross. 4 meals and 4 different people. Everyone in our group said it was nasty. Definitely not going back again. The food taste was not right.

DO NOT TRUST THESE GUYS!  Dropped off my Iphone for water damage and was told they powered on my phone and the screen was damaged, (that great news it powers on) but here is the deal I have this phone set on find my iphone as lost and no updates as it being powered on from my other IOS devices.  Then I am told give it another day maybe this isn't the problem.  What is another day going to do fix my fictitious broken screen that has been magically powered on?  LIES LIES LIES

Honestly on the fence about whether or not this place is worth it. We've been a few times and each time I feel like the level of fun is slowly declining, which makes the $50 I drop become questionable. 

The first dilemma is that I've got short kids, the are 6 and 9. . . so they are definitely interested in climbing walls, mini golf, laser tag, etc.  But only the 9 year old qualifies for things like the zip line. So I feel like I'm getting wrangled into the top of the line pass, when some of the attractions aren't going to actually get used. 

The second dilemma is my kids like to find other friends to play with. So if the place isn't busy, well then, they easily get bored and want to leave. I've tried coming in the peak of the day to help minimize the risk of this. In general though, I have noticed a steady decline in how long they are entertained before they ask me to go home. 

Third dilemma is that the food really isn't that great, so you've got to plan your trip before or after lunch time. We only attempted the snack shack on one visit and the pizza took so long to come out, even the girls working the counter seemed to be concerned (honestly I think they lost our ticket) and when it did mine was not event cooked. It was a total doughy mess. When I asked for a refund they had no clue how to handle it and sent me to the front desk. Which was a nightmare because the line was long with people getting checked in. So I chalked it up to a loss and a learning experience to not do again. 

Overall, I'd say it's a great place to host or attend a birthday party. Because you don't have to do anything and the kids entertain themselves. I have done this and it was a good experience. But it might not be worth it, if you're hoping to get your money's worth for an afternoon outing. Or maybe it just depends on the age of your kids.

Like another reviewer, my family has experienced issues with a Coldwell Banker Tomlinson Group agent as well. BRAD MINASIAN'S lack of professionalism has just cost us a new construction opportunity with a good floor plan, in a nice location that is within our price range.

He is a poor communicator and doesn't answer pertinent questions via email at all or in a timely manner, but found time to write a rude response to tell us about how we, the buyer, the client, should behave. He seems unaware that he is in a SERVICE industry. I have heard that other's have had trouble with him in the past, yet his behavior continues to go unchecked.

He has odd expectations, like refusing to even answer routine buyer queries or to meet with us unless we first submit a contract, which isn't possible until he provides the builder answers to our pricing questions...cart before the horse. We either have or are in the process of interviewing several other builders in the area to find the best fit for us (floor plan, location, pricing), and none of them or their agents have made demands like this.

Although my buying agent escalated our concerns about Brad to his superiors, Bob Van Allen and Patrick McTigue, in an effort to get a new agent to work on/complete/salvage our deal, we were told they would not help, as the selling agent has a relationship with the builder, Riverwood Homes, who, unfortunately, just lost a sale due to their steadfast association with this type of agent. It's a shame as CBTG's name is tainted by their employment of someone who would treat customers this way. This should go without saying, but selling agents should keep in mind that it's ALWAYS the buyers' market.
Great coffee, very friendly staff.  Awesome wine selection.  I really love their food menu.  Ill be back again soon.
Had these guys work on my furnace and A/C unit multiple times. Always friendly, and willing to answer any questions I may have.

I never like to give a place a bad review when I know they are trying to do the right thing, but... Barrel 55? What can I say? 

They have a huge selection of beers, so many that when I asked the waitperson for  a wheat beer she couldn't find it on the menu - she had to go ask the bartender. I will say that when I did receive it that it was very good. 

The atmosphere is kind of cold feeling - huge dining area, attractive if you are into stone and wood, but nothing that makes the space warm and inviting (only was in the dining area, never saw the bar).

Service was great. We were met at the door by a friendly host, seated right away (1 p.m., so missed the lunch crowd) and were presented with a lunch menu, regular menu and a drink menu. Waitperson was very nice, chatted with us and talked about the various items on the menu.

The disappointment came in the form of the food. My wife ordered the BLTA   And I had the Country Salad. Both were only so-so. Nice presentation, but taste didn't live up to appearance.

The best part of our visit was that we may have discovered a great bakery! The bread served on the BLTA and accompanied on the salad was excellent. It's from Acme Bakery (our waitperson went out of her way to find their source for us).

So, overall only three stars and would be less if it wasn't for excellent service.

I called The Glass Dr. and told them I had a glass table top from my patio set, and it was urgent that I  have it replaced in time for my daughters graduation party on June 2nd. They told me to bring it in, gave me a quote (which was higher than they gave me on the phone), and said it would be done the following Thursday (May 31st), and I could pick it up on Friday (June 1st). There was NEVER a mention that it might not get done, or I would have gone somewhere else. So Friday my husband goes to pick it up and it's not done! I never received a phone call or an email with why there was a delay and what the issue was! So I was extremely upset that I was not notified of the delay and asked to have a manager call me when he was available. Imagine my surprise when that didn't happen! 
The receptionist called and told me that the table wouldn't be done until the following Tuesday, So I deal with the situation and scramble to find a table for the graduation party on Saturday. So Tuesday rolls around and I get a phone call, my table isn't done, Wednesday it isn't done, I get a phone call Thursday June 7th, that my table was ready. Now that the party is over and my company is gone! I had asked for them to wave the balance due to the miscommunication and the lack of customer service! They have me a $25 coupon. 

I don't normally give negative reviews, but if you are looking to get something done in a timely manner, this is not the place to go, so disappointing! 
I should have just purchased another table for what I spent on the glass top, or I should have taken it to US Mirror and Glass.

Honestly the best furniture store in Boise hands down. I've visited like 7 other furniture stores before coming to furniture outfitters and was so close on giving up. All the other furniture store carries the generic out dated furnitures. Something your aunt would own. but here is different, everything is so up to date and nice. Definitely the place to check out if you're In the market

Reviewer # 3. 

This is a good car wash with machines that work well. You can get quarters here, but cleaning products and air freshers, vacuum, do it yourself car wash (the best kind) and a shampooer. It's very helpful to be able to shampoo your car when something gets spilled or an animal or child gets sick,

Could not decide what we wanted to eat so decided to pop in here to try it. Very good food & beverage selection.  My husband tried a couple different beers & I tried the huckleberry creme & cream soda cocktail. Yum. I got the Mac n cheese and he got a steak sandwich (can't remember the name. Both excellent. We were there during a shift change and both bar tenders were great and very friendly.  Will be back.

Once upon a time this place was incredible. The reason for the lower stars now is the lack of cleanliness. The showers are missing grout which tells we we will have mold soon. I've brought it to the attention of the manager but seems to fall on deaf ears. Shelves in the shower and shower heads are leaking frivolously. Maintenance overall has gone down and is my reason for less stars on this update (2 1/2 years now)

What a great place! I have been meaning to write a review since our first visit about four months ago. Since then we have been back 7-8 times, for breakfast and for lunch, weekday and weekends, with the kids and without. We've gotten a pretty good idea of the overall business!

The people here are fantastic. Always so pleasant, very helpful, patient when we have the two kids with us, willing to work with us on orders if needed (we have a couple allergies and they never even bat an eye, just offer helpful options). They remember our drink preferences and move quickly without ever hurrying us. They wear shirts that show length of service for each employee and it is so lively to see the long term of the staff, and the awesome mix of people! Truly one of the best mixes of staff that are ALL sweet and helpful and GOOD at what they are doing. 

Food... the only thing I have not been a fan of is the omelets. We don't do pork or beef, so the omelets are a bit more limited to the veggie omelet for us (they don't have a chicken or turkey sausage or bacon option sadly!) and each time it has been a bit different and a bit disappointing. With spinach it was super watery, without it the veggies were just raw tossed on top, one time the veggies were all soft except for the onions which were totally raw. I finally had to give up and just order eggs. All the rest of the breakfast items are delicious (I adore the basic awesome hash browns! The country potatoes are basically just short fries but they are good too lol, just need some more seasoning!). The sandwiches we've gotten have all been great and the steak fries our the family choice although the seasoned fries are delicious. 

Don't come here for a "health" meal, although you can order decently healthy options. This is a small, local diner (gets packed for breakfast, much slower for lunch and they close early so check the time!) and the food fits the atmosphere: smart, simple, well done and welcoming!

A great place to go for Gluten Free peeps!  They have everything gluten free marked (on a separate gluten free menu).  Plenty of options to choose from.  They have a great tasting gluten free English muffin.  Prices are very reasonable.  Highly recommend!

I would say getting two free appetizers cause food wasn't cooked properly and we had horrible service. Only thing can say is the calamari appetizer isn't horrible.But all 4 of us who are have been sick so be aware.

Love this gym! I've been a member for 1 year now, coming on average 4 day a week and have been so impressed with the staff  (which seems to have very low turnover). 

Bathrooms are impeccably clean as well as the gym floor. And let's face it, we've all seen those gyms where you know nobody's put a broom anywhere in a long time. :-) this is not that gym.

 I spend a lot of time in the saltwater swimming pool which is cleaner than most. If if you're going to swim, this is one of the most beautiful pools in the area with three walls of windows that go Floor to ceiling.

 The gym never seems to be extremely busy to the point of standing around waiting for equipment all the time.

I really enjoy that they have supplements as well as a juice bar to go grab a protein shake in case I forget mine after a workout.

Dave is very knowledgeable, honest along with Bryce's awesome skills, my 2006 5.9 mega cab drives like a dream now..

If you don't know what your doing like me and need some work done to any part of your diesel truck give these gents a call for an honest assessment...

The people working here were very nice! As someone who is polynesian and lives around Caldwell/Meridian area. I will tell you that this is the right place to come to! Food is great and it reminds me of back home especially for a random place in Idaho haha.
Why ask me what type of sauce I want and even go so far as to repeat it back to me, and then not put any sauce in my bag? Stingy af.

I've been bribing my son with Wingers all week. We got there tonight and they decided to close 35 minutes early on a Friday night. My son (7) was devastated. After consoling him for 15 minutes we finally got him to agree to a different restaurant. Needless to say, we won't be going back to Wingers for awhile. If they're so slow that they're closing early on a Friday night, they probably won't be around much longer anyway.

Kept waiting after being seated. Then, difficult to get a drink refill. And then, she only bright one iced tea refill, even though both my wife and I had iced tea.

Brought out appetizer,b and almost immediately one of the main dishes. My wife's, ten minutes later.

But, the food was ok. Well not really the poboy sandwich was pretty tasteless.

The funniest part, the waitress explained to us how she had to type in everything, which then got translated to Mandarin, because all the Cooks are Chinese, and so we may not actually get what we were asking for.

Why would anybody come here?

I first signed up with The Joint Chiropractic on the monthly plan.  I do not have serious back issues so this worked for me. I am not sure I would recommend to someone who does, as they do not x-ray. It was convenient and worked for my schedule. I took a job out of state and cancelled my subscription plan but bought packages for when I was home. I received notice for the first time in July that my visits were going to expire the end of July. When I purchased the package, there was no talk of them expiring. I called to ask about extending the visits since I work out of state or transferring them to someone else. I was told the manager would get back to me. I called again a week later and left another message. I was in Meridian and stopped in. I asked and was told the manager was out and would call me but they were extending the visits until the end of August. I received a email this week that said they were sorry but since the package expired the end of July they could not be transferred. When I mentioned the end of August the said I could still use them but could not transfer. 

I think they do an adequate job as a chiropractor but the administrative side leaves much to be desired. It seems to be more and more of a racket.

I went here in person because I didn't have a cancellation paper for the Hyla. I was greeted by Grace Henson who was so kind and wonderful. She not only gave me a cancellation paper no problem but called the finance company to cancel also. I had brought the machine and equipment with me and she let me drop it all off there. I was very relieved and pleased. She even insisted I keep the small humidifier with colored lights that was my gift for the demonstration. I'm so thankful I went by! It's also a lovely office inside. Thank You! Again Grace.

Great locally owned and locally visited bar and hang out with great food!  Had the chili and it was so tasty with cheese and onions and grilled sourdough bread!!! Friendly service and fast drinks! Looks like a cool outdoor area for the summer!

What an abomination! The wife and I tried mo bettahs on a whim tonight. We had always been curious about the food since they opened. We often visit the other restaurants in the area and we can now confirm we will continue passing this place up to go elsewhere. The online ordering was a mess and for being "mobile" the phones had a really hard time operating the website on two separate phones and browsers. The ordering website did not offer any descriptions, so for us as first timers, we had to go to a completely different website to see their menu descriptions. The easiest part of this process was after we arrived. You can go to a (OUR THIRD) website that's listed on the parking stall to "check in". After picking up our food and arriving at home, we sat down to enjoy our dinner. I immediately found my order to be incorrect even though the receipt clearly stated what I had ordered. The wife received all of her items. Not a biggy. I could get over it, I'm not a super picky person, but then came....the food taste. 
The chicken was severely overcooked. The plastic knife included could barely hack through the chicken. The taste would have otherwise been pretty good other than the chewy and dry texture. The rice was undercooked or possibly overcooked (sat too long) and had many hard pieces. This is quite the surprise when you're biting down. The worst for last... the Macaroni salad. I will include the MAC salad on the very short list of completely 100% unpalatable foods of my life! It was so over dressed with mayonaise, I'm not sure there was much else. Ever eaten a spoonful of mayonnaise? That's what the MAC said tasted like. Oh dear lord, stay away from the MAC. Overall we were completely dissatisfied with our experience and ended up making something else for dinner when we got home. This was a surprise to us because we're not the type to be picky, but this was truly awful food.

I took my two shih tzus here . They came back all neat and beautiful.  I sure can say that Simba had his best hair cut here. The lady was a very good listener and she gave the exact kind of  hair cut I asked for. She even sprayed funky dog colognes on each of my puppies. My boy had a very musky smelling cologne on him. I can't remember the name of it. My girl was sprayed with what was called 'Butterfly Kisses'. Oh how pampered they smelled . 

We moved from Meridian some time back and I m sad I found this little gem of a place just before we moved.  I would definitely recommend this place to all the doggy parents. I can't recollect the name of the lady who did the job. She was very sweet and polite and friendly- to both the dogs and me.

THIS is our "go to" place for breakfast. We  have been going for well over a year now. We have never had a bad meal! The people are fabulous, friendly and fast! My favorite are the biscuits and gravy. 
We always take out of town guests for breakfast here. Everyone we have taken loves it and wants to go back! 
My favorite breakfast place by far!

Called with a 'last minute' same day need. They stepped up, and made it happen. Friendly, courteous, and helpful. Great choices and made the order process smooth and efficient. I will use them for everything to keep giving them as much business I can...

Entire restaurant is filthy. Every single table was dirty or unavailable.
Bathrooms were dark, and also very dirty. 
Very disappointed with this particular chipotle

Extremely clean and well kept establishment .
There was an employee on site disinfecting all counters, chairs and machines. 
The prices are very reasonable and we'll as the soap options etc .

Jeff was very attentive until we started running into problems after closing, due to damages left by sellers. I take responsibility for not catching Jeff's contractual mistake right away, but as a seasoned realtor he should have not made that crucial error that left me 100% unprotected. When I did discover the problem, supposedly it was too late to make changes and Jeff gave me his solemn promise everything would be fine. It wasn't and Jeff knew it because he did the final walk through that we could not participate in... again because of poorly written contract. He even admitted to mistakes and then became unresponsive when we expected him to keep his promises. Ultimately , he left us high and dry with a disgusting home and $6,500 worth of damages. Shameful!

I occasionally walk my Dane up to Doggie Day Spaw for the last 6 years and self groom him.  I like that they have shampoo, conditioner, ear cleaner, and different doggie colognes and smell good sprays.  I ask if I can use their dog toe nail trimmers and, if my Dane is acting up Alicia will help wrangle him with me.  Sometime I hold my Dane and Alicia will do all the nail trimming with NO charge, awesomeness.  Alicia is the one that always helps me out and was the manager (don't think she works there anymore) :0( and Dawn comes over and lends a hand too when she's free.  One time I asked her Dawn " How do you squeeze a anal gland, bc my dog is scratching his butt all over the floor".  Dawn came over and took that situation under control lol, no charge.  Dawn and Alicia are super friendly. Their's one male employee, he's quite, & does his job well.

I recently stated taking my gmas Pomeranian here.  He's is a ridiculously crazy rescue dog we got for my Gma for Christmas with serious behavior issues.  I explained we wanted a wash and hair/ nail trim.  I don't know who groomed him but he was "OnFleek".  

At one point Doggie Day Spaw had a teeth cleaning system service they offered.  It was ummmm about $40 or around that price.  My Danes teeth look amazing and I only ever did that once, beats the $250+ teeth cleaning at the vets.

Overall I like the prices and services I had paid for.  Sometimes in the summer and around holidays I cannot book a appointment that day, usually a week or two out.  Sometimes I have to call a couple times too in order to get ahold of someone bc it is kinda loud like most dog groomer businesses.  I support this business bc it was one of the first around the meridian area.
Very disappointing. Our pizza was not as ordered and part of it was burnt. This was our first time trying Flying a pie and it's also our last.
This place is no joke! I used to live in the south and this food is amazing. Awesome service. If you want a change from the ordinary and flavor that will rock your world. Please go here.
First time in and I  got the Christmas time special cinnamon roll pancake. So good. Large enough portion that I had breakfast the next day.  My husband got one of the Benedict's and enjoyed it too

Ordered flowers on a Tuesday afternoon for next day delivery indicating the business closed at 3:00 so please deliver before that time.  Flowers were delivered by noon.  I was texted photos of the arrangement and it was beautiful.  Flowers were nice and fresh, lovely variety of flowers and colors.  Very happy with the price and the service.  The recipient said she received compliments all day long on the lovely display.

Great food. Blueberry pancakes were awesome. The atmosphere is very light because of all the enormous windows. It's also easy to carry on a conversation, the accustics are good. If you like good breakfasts go here.
Food looking little pricy and here the company has a boss that is soup nazi and cant keep a good team. My friends 3 i can say that dude is over kill.

*** ZERO STAR REVIEW*** First of all, we were a crowd of four extremely excited to try the new seafood joint in town. My baby sister and her boyfriend of almost 5 years were in town for work by coincidence, so suffice it to say this was a special dinner. I had been dating this guy I met off Tinder and it was time to meet the fam, so let's just say this was an extra special occasion. 
My date and I arrived promptly at the restaurant 15 minutes late at 6:15PM. My sister and her live-in boyfriend were there at 6PM. They had a round of iced water and one drink served at this time. The waitress brought us menus and took our drink order. Appetizers were ordered at 6:20PM, along with my sister and her boyfriend's complete order. The waitress advised us she would enter in their order, but place it through to the kitchen once my date and I decided on our order so the entrees would be brought out together. 
The first round of appetizers came out within reasonable time. It's now an hour later and the second round of appetizers came out. All the while, my iced water cup was never refilled. My table of beloved family and new guy, kept dumping their iced water into my glass because I was parched. It is now 7:45PM and entrees have not been served! The waitress looked shocked that our entrees have not been served, which was odd since she would have been the one to serve them. It is now 8:10PM and we did not get the order of side Cajun fries that were supposed to come out with the entrée. Again, the waitress looked shocked, no surprise here. She put the fry order in "double time."  The manager then came out to apologize and explained that another waiter took the food to another table and didn't tell anyone. She apologized and offered a free piece of cheesecake, which was not awesome by any means. The manager said the food would be discounted only since they are unable to discount the alcohol, understandably (we're not completely unreasonable). They only discounted the one entrée by 15%, which discounted the total bill by $3.15... pathetic. 
Now as far as the food goes, the steam oysters were good.. good if you like giant raw chunks of garlic in your garlic butter seasoning, which in this case we all did, but vampires beware. The house seasoning was liked by half the table, yam fries by my sister and I and the boys liked the Cajun fries. 
We do understand that the staff did have to cater to two birthdays and had to clap in unison whilst walking to the birthday celebration, but still, the restaurant was basically empty on this particular Monday evening. So, to sum up, no we will not be going back, and remember to spay and neuter your pets.

This is an excellent place. Had the boil with crab and shrimp. The spicy Cajun was perfect and we enjoyed the entire meal. Nice wait staff and another great night in Boise. Can't wait to come back soon. 
Cheers!
Slowest food service for miles around. Appetizer is taking 30minutes and still waiting.

Ordered online for pickup at 7:40pm. We didn't our food until 8:15pm after standing in line for 25minutes. Got home, 2 chicken bowls got no meat on them after we asked for steak instead (out of chicken). Started eating our food and rice was NOT cooked all the way. Honestly was barely cooked. Beans were uneven. No mild salsa on any bowls. Just an overall lack of customer service and quality of food. Do not eat here.
Absolutely the worst customer service!  A couple had a game on hold, one of the workers let them skip the busy line to check out first.
