These fine folks helped us with our floral emergency with grace under pressure and only 20 minutes to close. We fixed ourselves up with an absolutely sublime arrangement of two-toned roses and a gorgeous tangle of greenery. Thank you, The Flower Place!

stupid staff come to your door promise some dumb gift to give a review for 5 mins, when you kick them out after saying you don't want to buy their product they threaten to call the police. horrible salesman

I wanted to give a big shoutout to this barber. He fixed a pretty messed up fade I had gotten at a shop down the road and I couldn't be happier. His shop was super clean, he was very friendly, and he knows what he's doing when those clippers are in his hands. He also gave me a military discount, which was unexpected but very generous. 

I would highly recommend this shop to anyone of my close friends. I value craftsmanship and skill, which you will definitely get here. 

He just found a new customer. Thanks again!

This place is legit!  I heard from a friend that live in Meridian and was from Laupahoehoe.  Plus I live in a place that has lots of local food.  So ono!
Now for shave ice.

Sweetest server ever, Kasie, we had lunch on a Wednesday afternoon.  Totally yummy! Ordered iced tea & they brought a full carafe of beautiful dark brewed tea.  My friend had an Arnold Palmer & she got a carafe too.  Also, extra water on the table... I drink lots of water & tea so that's huge to me. I ordered the breakfast burrito, smothered in delicious sauce & topped with melted cheese, dollop of sour cream.  Love at first bite! Best breakfast burrito ever. My friends ordered a Turkey apple sandwich with melted Brie cheese & they both loved it. Side of crunchy sweet potato fries with lime sauce was a hit out of the park. My first visit, impressed with the food, service & cleanliness.
Fancier version of Joe's Crab Shack.  Seriously, though, it was good.  A bit pricey, but you get what you pay for.

Can't say enough about Dr. Madera she is compassionate and great at her job. Thanks for helping with our Yorkie, he is a huge part of our family! She treats your pet as part of your family, if you are looking for the best Vet in town it is Dr. Madera!

I didn't have high hopes for this place but since it was so packed I assumed maybe it would be decent. We waited over 25 minutes for our food which would've been fine except our waitress literally ignored our existence other than taking our order and giving us our check. Didn't check in even once, looked over at us multiple times and checked on all her other tables around us but would just keep walking. My boyfriend never got his OJ which isn't a big deal but had she checked on us we could've asked for it a 2nd time. The food was mediocre- we both ordered an eggs Benedict. Awkwardly enough a manager came to check on us at the same time as the waitress finally brought our check and I just didn't have it in me to answer honestly when he asked how she was doing in front of her. I worked at and managed restaurants up until Covid hit last year and I was honestly cringing at the lack of service. 
The brunette hostess and older gentleman at the front were extremely nice though- hence the 2 stars.

DON'T ORDER FOR DELIVERY!!! Everytime we order through delivery they give us like half a bowl but this was the worst, we could literally see the bottom of the plates.Is it really that hard to serve a proper amount? is it really rocket sience? Unbelievable, never buying from these useless people that need to be held by the hand, I will just do it myself (rice, guac, steak, done you got yourself chipotle )

Went in for lunch after the rush, so they were not busy.  Wasn't greeted by any hostesses, they had troubles deciding who's section I needed to be seated in, and apparently the wrong section was chosen because I was never served on.  I had a hungry baby who couldn't understand why there was no water in her cup.  Waited for about 10 minutes, then decided to move on with my day.

After years of seeing another chiropractor, we happened across The Joint. What a great experience! From beginning to end, our visit was so pleasant and continues to be even a year later. The Stokes are such nice people and they make your short wait time very comfortable. Dr. Hawkins is extremely skilled and puts you at ease immediately. And the hours are perfect for even the busiest of schedules. Thanks for being so awesome The Joint!
Expensive menu. We ordered Sunday lunch. I got the Kobe beef burger; it was overcooked. Fries were undercooked. Dinner menu more a wild game menu and expensive.

Whenever I get chipotle I typically always go to the meridian location and I always enjoy the environment and the staff is always friendly. I love the food and always felt that my meal was being handled properly and that the greens are cleaned. HOWEVER, last night my husband brought me home a steak bowl with lettuce from this location, and as I'm eating my meal, I find a VERY LARGE green bug in bowl. I immediately stopped eating it and showed my family members I was with, and then threw it away. I didn't even want to try and take it back for a new bowl because I was so disgusted. This isn't the first time I have ever had a bug in my food(not previously from chipotle), but this is the first time that there has been a very large bug in my food. Definitely something that should have been caught. It was very noticeable, and so gross!. I have zero intentions of ever visiting this location again, and am considering not attending a chipotle in general ever again. Definitely left a bad impression, which is unfortunate considering how much I loved chipotle.

We tried four different groomers before finding Marnie. She is so good with our dog and gives him a nice cut. Curly dogs can be hard to do, apparently as our guy has had his share of hatchet jobs, but Marnie does a beautiful job every time. She really loves dogs and that shows in her work.

I absolutely love Panera, but I have been greatly disappointed lately with this location. Three times in the past month they have gotten my drive thru order wrong even though it was printed on the ticket correctly. It's hard when you're going through the drive through and you get bagels, I just look to make sure they are both there but I'm not pulling them out to make sure they are toasted while trying to drive. So when I get to my destination and they aren't toasted and I have no way of roasting them currently it's a little annoying. I love their food and usually they have great service but have been pretty annoyed with the drive through.

Hook n Reel is a good place to eat. Make sure you call ahead, unless you like waiting awkwardly by the front door. Don't forget your I.D. You can't wait at the bar without it, even if you just want a soda. LoL

The food was ok. Nothing spectacular. 
What was spectacular though, was that the waitress noticed my Star of David necklace and was kind enough to delicately ask if I keep kosher. I told her I did, and she advised me that a portion of my selection contained lard. 
This more than anything I appreciate. 
Also, lemon water! And I didn't even have to ask.

This was my first time using Steve for sprinkler blowouts and I am glad I chose him. Scheduling was easy to do with the online form. I loved how he sends a text the day before you are scheduled. You can also check the blog on their website to see updates and a daily route map of blowouts being done that day. I already recommended Steve to my friends and will be using him again. I appreciate that all the terms of service were clearly spelled out when I scheduled and liked that I could cancel if needed using the online cancelation at least 12 hours before to avoid a charge. Most companies require 24 hours notice.

We've had the joy of tasting Panera's baked good for many years.  Here lately, the quality has just gone down hill.  The cinnamon roll was my favorite, sourdough, flaky, fun to unroll as you eat it.  Now, this is a "processed, industrial" roll so gummy and flavorless, tasting no better than an off-the-shelf packaged cinnamon roll. The blueberry muffins were my wife's favorite, but now they are of the same experience as the cinnamon rolls, industrial and not worth the effort to even drive-thru and pick up.  What used to be a roll, flaky and full of blueberries is now an Otis Spunkmeyer packaged pastry bought at any convenience store.

Come on Panera's, you had a good thing going and are just letting your customers down in a bad way.

This is a bit of an overdue review, but let's just say Truffles etc does not disappoint. 

I happened upon this shop as I got sushi from Sushi Shack across the street. This area is filled with little shops that were so adorable, I had to wander around to see what was in the neighborhood. It was during this little exploratory trip that I found Truffles etc.

Truffles etc not only has such friendly staff, they also had a delightful amount of chocolates, ice cream, and caffeinated drinks to choose from. I chose an Early grey truffle and a lavender truffle. My lavender truffle also has pieces of lavender on top to accentuate the flavor. Each of their displayed chocolates were beautiful and unique. There were so many things to look at, it's definitely a place to visit more than once. 

Additionally, they have board games to play while you enjoy some of their snacks. Truffles etc is definitely worth the visit!

My wife and I have been going to Panera for a while now. Usually the food is good. I love their mac and cheese and their sandwiches are good. They are a bit more expensive than you get for your money, but the quality is usually pretty good.

On our last trip though to their drive through, we were very dissapointed. I do understand that every business has a bad day sometimes. It happens. 

Shoot, I have been around the block more than a few times, I am a Christian, and I still have my days. Thats life, right?

But when a place completely falls on its face and does not own up to its mistakes and takes care of them, then my hackles go up. And if you have ever seen my hackles, you would not like them.

They are like the Hulk. "Dont make me angry. You wont like me when Im angry" in my best Hulk impression.

My wife got a Green Goddess salad as she usually does. By the way, you ever seen a green goddess? The Jolly Green Giants wife, right?

The salad was completely wilted, runny and disgusting. Nothing was in any way, shape of form edible. We had to throw it out.

I immediately wrote to corporate hoping from an apology, some compassion, and hopefully a refund. 

Their response was canned. Notning personal, nothing to say we are sorry, nothing. Just a canned response they send out to everyone that said thank you for your feedback. They offered to send us a gift to our account for the feedback. 

Very Disappointing Panera!

Worst customer service ever. We have purchased chipotle for years, but the Employees here  were very short and rude to my wife. The two Teas we ordered with our meal only had 3 to 4 ice cubes in them. The Chips were very stale. We will not be back to this chipotle. The food being sub par wasn't even the worse part I can't stress how bad their customer care is at this business.
Obviously there location is the only reason their business works because nothing else positive to say about this specific chipotle establishment.

Beware of the safety of your pet here. I had been taking my miniature schnauzer to Wags to Riches for a year and half and was happy. This past Monday after I brought her home one of her eyes was bright red in the white of her eye. Took her to the vet hospital and the vet said she had trauma to her eye. Something happened to her at the groomers. When I called the groomer to try and find out if she jerked her head and hit something or squirmed and fell and all she did was get upset with me that I was accusing her of doing something to my dog and I didn't accuse her of anything. Her very defensive actions and getting upset with me tells me something happened that wasn't an accident nor my dogs actions that caused the injury.   I wanted to share my experience because my little schnauzer is so sweet, I can't imagine someone hurting her the way someone did at Wags to Riches.    Update, after I posted this Yelp, the owner didn't call me, but instead went to my vet for my dogs records. When I called her to ask why, she told me because of the yelp and denied anything happened at her business. The vet wrote suspect blunt force trauma.  Owner noticed yesterday evening and was groomed yesterday. Sclera hemorrhage.  The owner refused to pay the vet bill and said she had the 7 people working there witness nothing happened. Again, no concern for my dog, just being defensive. I will take her to small claims court once my dog is done having to go the vet, so the judge can decide if Wags to Riches should pay my vet bills. If this was a reputable business, they would have insurance and pay the vet bill.

This place was OK nothing to really write home to mom about kind of like a cafeteria,food was average weight staff was very friendly quick to seat us no real complaints but nothing to cheer about either

Decent experience so far.  There have been a few bumps but PPPM seems to be at least in contact with me about all of them and following up every chance they get.  I am only 1 month into my lease but so far so good!
Delicious food, friendly staff and made things right when they messed our order. Appreciated the great customer service.

These guys are smart and great customer relations. Fast and friendly. They will keep you apprised of what's going on and they will make things right if they make an error. Good customer service is a must for me and they do it! So is doing excellent work, and they do that too!

Love this spot! Atmosphere is cozy and comfortable and the staff is friendly and kind. Tried the Mexican hot chocolate with a cup of tortilla soup ... yes, a weird combo, but there's  a theme? It was all delicious and I'll definitely be back.

They were the worst property management company I've ever dealt with in 50 years over 4 different states.
I rented a house that had 30 year old carpet,   asked owner to replace it numerous times, tack strips riped my socks and it smelled like cat piss when we moved in.
They had the nerve to say my dogs ruined the carpet and passed that on to another private landlord. I was so upset and outraged by their outright lies and misreprensentation of the truth. Owner was a slum lord at best.
Pro core is not looking out for the renters interest at all but suck up to owners only at not cost.

If you are coming here for weight loss using hcg it's a huge rip off. It costs $1500 for 43 days. You can get a prescription online through nuimage medical for $400 for the same amount of days. They greatly inflate the cost by requiring consultations and marking it up for the b12 shots. The package they sell for hcg is full of unnecessary thrills to mark up the price and take advantage of people that are really desperate to lose weight. I recommend not even going in. Also their scale is off to try and make people already uncomfortable with their weight feel even worse.

Stumbled on this place in Yelp, decided to check it out, didnt realize it just opened a week ago but this place is great! Food was amazing, crab, oysters, clams,shrimp were so fresh, definitely on my  favorites list. Service was awesome! I highly recommend checking this place out if you love seafood. You'll get messy but they have bibs and wet naps lol

My husband and I have been going to Express for 25 years, never have been disappointed,  they serve comfort food I have never sent anything back what I have done is take leftovers home for the next day, because the meals are that big. Servers are always happy, some have been there since we started going there.
The food is great! However, every time myself or my coworker have ordered from here parts of the order are missing or we get the wrong things.

This pizza is five stars. Love that they have crust options! Sourdough crust is my favorite and isn't always available at pizzerias. We love the variety of specialty pizzas. The all meat is delicious and we tried their Samoan yesterday. I love the Gouda cheese on it! Definitely different from your normal Hawaiian pizza and it's good! 

Love the chewy crust and the slight char flavor you get from the cook in the oven!

168th review of Le Peep in Meridian, Idaho. This is my 393rd review on Yelp. 

Hi fellow Yelpers all over the world, and my fellow Idahoian Yelpers-- if you're looking for a great breakfast place, that offers all-day mimosas than this is your place! 

I've seen a few of the people I follow--shout out to Lino, Mitzi, Ophilia (miss you girl),  Charles F., and Cassie and many others,  I've felt like I NEED to try this place. It's perfectly located on Eagle and Ustick. I work out on the HP campus, and this is the perfect location to go visit friends for lunch. 

Walking in, the staff was friendly, and the menu was mouthwatering. I was working, therefore, I didn't try the mimosa's but my dining companion gave them an A! I did order the turkey sandwich with no bread. The ingredients were high quality, not lacking value and overall excellent tasting!

The best part, for me, is that they care about our pockets! They have a punch card. For every $10 you get a stamp-- once you get 10 stamps, you get $10 free!! Additionally, if you link your credit or debit card to YELP, which I have, you get 7% cash back-- heck that's good! I always take advantage of YELP's cash back, and check in offers-- free money... count me in!

Been here twice ... EXTREMELY slow and/or nonexistent service both times. Unable to rate food as I was not offered a menu and got tired of waiting for the server to check on our table. Will not be going back ...Two stars for semi - decent beer selection.

A go-to option for lunch for me, since I can eat for just over $2. I get 3x value tacos ($0.69) and a $0.99 half-pound bean-and-cheese burrito...with the $1-off bounceback receipt coupon, I'm out of there for under two and a quarter. (Water to drink.)

The tacos are good, for what they are...crunchy tacos with meat, lettuce, and cheese. The salsa bar is nice, the service is always friendly, and the burritos are good too. (I won a lunch bet that they really used real pinto beans.)

For a cheap lunch, this is the place to go. And free wifi too!
Clean & new. Machines accept cash or plastic. Nice in comfort features and in a good neighborhood. The attendant is very welcoming as well.
Delicious breakfast options, and great breakfast drinks. The coffee is not the greatest, but everything else is amazing.

Great coffee, wonderful candy and such a wonderful little family business! I was so happy to happen upon this little gem! Family business with great service and always a smile...not to mention everything is delicious!!! They also take phone orders!
Very friendly and helpful staff would refer them to everyone! Great results this clinic has something to offer everyone from weight loss to testosterone and b-12 shots!

Had a bad experience with this place blowing out sprinklers. The bottom line is once you sign up they rely on text messaging to communicate. And when you sign up you don't get a specific time. I don't know where the issue was but I never recieced the text messages so I assumed I wasn't going to get a blowout. My fault for assuming I suppose, cuz they showed up and started the blowout. Problem is, I didn't know it was happening cuz of the lack of communication, so someone else blew them out a week prior. When I told the tech this he said it seemed that way since all the valves were closed. The only reason I knew they were at my house was because my camera alerted and I heard the compressor fire up. They didn't ring my doorbell although the owner (who wasn't there) swears they did. They didn't and he doesn't know. I was actually home.

Anyway, despite not completing the blow out, they still charged me full price through a separate Google pay app invoice notification (not a text message), I replied I wasn't paying it, and recieced nothing back from them. Text or otherwise. The only way I found out this was still an issue was two months later they threatened via email to put a lien against my house. Still no texts, although the owner emailed screen shots of them being sent. Well, I didn't get them. Text sent doesn't mean text received. It's enough of a problem that they address not receiving texts in their terms of service as not their problem and they don't follow up via other methods despite emailing me a lien threat. I paid the bill (since their terms put me on the hook) but I recommend someone else for your blowout needs.

I'm sure they will respond with some diatribe defending their terms, their reputation, their years in the valley and how I should have thoroughly read the fine print on a sprinkler blowout. Whatever. You may have a different experience, but I had a bad one.

I recommend All Patriot Powerwashing, for blowouts. Link below. They were $10 cheaper than these guys on a 5 zone system anyway and have set schedules. Plus they are Veteran friendly. https://www.facebook.com/AllPatriotPowerWashing/

Went here for breakfast and would go back again. Cool and unique place with tasty food. Went big and had chicken fried steak, very tasty, not chewy or tough like some I've had at other places. Gravy is tasty, I like what I make at home better but that's slightly unfair comparison. Eggs cooked as desired and very friendly/prompt staff. This place has a lot of regulars and rightly so. Want to check out for lunch someday.

Prob The Best In Town A lot Of Choices and Beer It very Brice restaurant for this price. I like the service and the Food there a lot of choice I can myself choose from and it very enjoyable restaurant. The hamburger is the one I like in the restaurant I recommend you trying it out.

Not impressed. Horrible slow service. It took 45 minutes to get our food. The waitress checked in once during that 45 minutes. Then brought us the wrong food so we got to wait another 15 minutes. When we didn't tip and complained about the service the snotty waitress informed us that it wasn't her fault and told us we had a bad attitude and said she hoped we didn't come back.
I went to Debbie and she gave me a great haircut. I would recommend her.

I, personally, have been eating your food since the very begining. I have even eaten at both restaurants in Portland. It was to far to drive, to come back home! I have enjoyed your pizza begining with the first bite. All this being said...our visit to the new restaurant in Meridian was a nightmare. The noise level was unbearable!! The noise eminating from the kitchen was the worst of it. I can't complain about the "music"  because you could not HEAR the music. I was reminded of my time in the Marine Corps in the mid-60's...a chow hall...have to say it made me long for the chow hall! The service was a combo...the young man was rude, the young lady looked as if she would love to be anywhere else. I couldn't believe what I experienced...then I was reading your timeline...a new owner...hum...ya know, I couldn't believe that you closed on broadway...must have lost a fortune, with that move. But you didn't lose your identity. Kept on moving forward...we love you! My point is that some one made a really bad decision in Meridian. It's obvious that you made the move there for the money! We won't be back to this site ever. Really, no shades on the late afternoon windows? Flies? The front door was wide open for most of our stay! My wife even went up to pay at the bar on the way out, and complained about the volume of flies and the young ladies response was paraphrasing...this isn't that bad, Barbacoa is way worse. Really? The wife was stupefied!!! A truly horrible experience. It's a damned good thing the two stores in Boise are still open...for the time being.

A loyal customer

Michael Fisher
I have been there on several occasions with friends.  Each time the service is very prompt regaurdless of how busy they are and the food is amazing.

Took my car for a routine oil change. They rotated my tires (that had just been rotated 2 weeks prior) and messed up my alignment. Then they told me that my brakes were just fine (I've known I need my brakes replaced for a while they squeal, and I've been told by 3 different mechanics in 3 different locations they are needed soon) they also told me my car was leaking coolant (I check this myself, never been low, no evidence of a leak, etc) and were super pushy for me to let them fix it. I've heard issues with them but was shocked at how much they try to pull the wool over peoples eyes. Definitely do not recommend.

Great food, great service, and lively atmosphere! We came in on a whim just to try out this please since we live just around the corner. I was surprised how packed it was but it was Friday night so that was probably why. We both ordered burgers and it out in about 15 minutes. They were actually pretty good! Since we're about a 5 minute walk away we will definitely be back for more!
I'm giving this place five stars just based upon to ladies room!!! So clean and very nicely decorated! Great place Pauly! So happy for you!!
Great food and customer service! David the shift manager is a great guy and makes sure customers are happy. Best Del Taco in Idaho

We just got into town and this is my first stop always. When I walked in Chiro was ready!  I looked at him as I was getting my coat off. He looked familiar and mentioned that to him. Funny he mentioned a few cities and Albuquerque was it!!!! He transferred her from there in August. I can't remember his name now tho. Anyway we laughed about that!!!! He looked up my chart and voila there I was. 
   He proceeded to adjust my lo back shoulder and neck. Wow I feel so much better. Thanx doc !

  Well no Dr Oglsbee today. He is downtown Boise wed- sat I think he said.  Anyway I had a decent adjustment. I hadn't had an adj in 2 weeks and was hurting when he was pushing and stretching me. Whew! All over. Now I'm walking easier! Thanx
Blueberry pie Cinnabon!  Awesome!  You can't help but stop here after a movie and grab dessert.
Not going to go into alot of details. Never ever again, and im not recommending to anyone. Just so sad people get treated the way the do. And that everything is about $$$$

Good and terrible values to be gotten here. The best deal on the menu is the seafood fried rice. They call it 'paella', but I would not myself. Paella usually is crispy rice and lots of seafood. This has shreds of crab, a few shrimp, and flavor of other seafood in it. Plus some mixed (frozen?) vegetables tossed in with the rice. It is very good and a huge portion. Much better than PF Changs for $7. The oyster basket was a winner too. Around 10 smallish fried oysters with fries for $14.  It comes with a choice of sweet potato, regular, or "Cajun" fries. I tried those this time. They were crisp with a batter of some type on them. No Cajun flavor detected. But the oysters are tasty. Smaller than what I get freshly shucked in Oregon but good. And twice the number of oysters as in the Po' Boy for a dollar less. 
The crab salad is $13 and was barely worth $8.00. The picture on the menu shows a large dinner salad smothered with shredded crabmeat. The salad was nice enough, while the crab was definitely less than two scant ounces. Closer to one. I should have taken a picture. It literally looked like a light sprinkling of fresh Parmesan cheese over the salad. I would have preferred a decent portion of fake KRAB to this pitiful amount.  You can get a great meal here if you order correctly. 
My wife had a "boil", which they are known for. Shrimp and scallops with 2 red potatoes and 1/3 ear of corn. Perfect taste on the scallops, shrimp was rubbery. Corn tasted like shrimp and was great. I understand it's hard to cook it all at the same time in a bag, but that's their job. 
I know they will put a note, "I'll pass the word to the cooks/kitchen."  That seems to be hook n reel's standard reply (management not taking any responsibility). But someone taught them how to make the salad. One other thing, bread should be included to sop up the juices (like Joe's Crab Shack) rather than $7 for garlic bread. I spent $67 for what would be worth around $40.
Just went in to eat. Sit down menu $1-2 less on most items than take out.  That's wrong.

The place itself is pretty cool for older kids. I was there with my 1.5&3 year old (on a dead week night) and they need to be supervised by me at all times. I had my own grip jump socks that were basically the same so I didn't buy any for the extra cost when I checked in. I was pulled aside after 30 minutes saying I wasn't allowed to jump anymore unless I bought their personal socks. So now I clearly understand that they don't make you wear the socks for safety.. it's just to get an extra buck, bc my socks were the exact same but a slightly different color. It seemed pretty petty, especially considering I clearly wasn't there to jump myself.. just to supervise my toddlers.

We dropped in here for a quick dinner Friday night.  This was our first time here.  The waitress was great, the Caesar salad was good and the service was fast.  The dinner menu seemed a little limited with not a lot of options but it appears that their breakfasts and coffee might be their main thing, so we want to go back and give that a try.  Back to dinner; they had three musicians entertaining out on the patio.  The food, music and beautiful weather made for a pleasant relaxing evening.
The kalua pig was really good.  We also got the kacsu chicken and that was really good too.  We will definitely be dining here again.

I just moved here from Hawaii one week ago and we were craving a plate lunch so we decided to check this place out. I was happy to find the food was pretty good, considering where we're at. The pulehu chicken was very tasty. The chicken katsu was surprisingly on point. The bbq chicken was alright (a little burned on the edges). The steak was very good.  My partner wished he ordered more of that. We both ordered the ekolu plates but mine was the mini. The portions were hefty IMO. The Mac salad wasn't bad either but definitely too much Mayo. We will be back when we need a fix and to try the other items. I'm glad to know Oahu locals own the spot. Gave it 3 stars since I'm fresh off the plane and my standards are high. But again, we would go back there. You should try it out and if you know local Hawaiian food, then you know it's a pretty legit spot.

All right, we should have known when we walked in the door and were greeted by the same foul aroma as pizza hut that we should turn around. But we were in the process of moving to Idaho, we were really hungry and wanted a beer. And to be honest, we thought it was fun that people were dressed as pirates for "talk like a pirate day".

They even had a special beer brewed for them by a local brewery that wasn't half bad. That made me really hope that they might have some quality food. The menu had some interesting combinations. And at $18 for a medium pizza, they should have decent ingredients. There were free breadsticks, and you get half off a second pie. We both love leftover pizza, so we decided to get two 14" pizzas, and a large house salad. 

The salad came first, after waiting for twenty minutes or so. Iceberg lettuce and a few Cisco veggies on top. For six bucks I thought it would either be bigger or have a lot more veggies. 

My girlfriend went to get us more beer at the bar where she had to show her ID a second time, and got hassled about who the other beer was for. She's 35, I'm 32.

The breadsticks came, and all I can say is that Little Caesar's are better and the thick, sour sauce they came with was just bad. 

So, the pizzas. The bbq chicken was the better of the two. It had "chicken" on it that was the texture of chicken mcnuggets. Rubbery chicken bits pressed into a loaf and cut into strips. The other one had pesto, artichoke hearts, tomatoes, etc. It was so sour and nasty that we didn't even want to take it with us for leftovers. 

The final blow was getting the bill. I had them print it out itemized for me because I couldn't believe it was right. The culprit? The beers, which don't show a price on the menu, were $6 each! I'd be upset at that price if they were 20 oz pints. These were 16 oz. 

We left $50 poorer, feeling ripped off. Welcome to Idaho!

Deja Brew is one of Meridians newest gems! The owners, chef, and the employees are so sweet and know what they are doing! I recommend Deja for a casual breakfast or coffee, since the atmosphere is so quiet and cozy. (We went around 3PM).

The dentist was always my biggest fear, until I walked into this office. My mother and sister go here and finally I decided to take care of my teeth.  There isn't one person working in that office that doesn't go above and beyond to make me feel comfortable.
Nice folks and decent selection. I have been shopping here for several years and have never been disappointed.

I was given a gift certificate and when I called to make a hair appointment they would not honor it, very disappointing since they didn't mention that when it was sold. Even the menu booklet that comes with certificates shows hair services

Similar to Joe's crab shack you get a selection of seafood boiled and then drenched in sauce. Overall the idea of being able to ala carte choose whats you in your boil is great. The sauce is a bit too much and its dripping in it. Some things like the scallops get a bit mushy being boiled and the soaking in sauce.

Overall it was Ok.. I would probably go back if someone else wanted to go but it wouldn't be my first choice. There are better options for good seafood across the street.

First time here while visiting friends. I don't have Sonics in my area so I really wanted to see what the hype and shakes were all about. I went thru the drive thru so I can't comment on the inside or car hop experience. 

Bacon double cheese burger was pretty good. Beer was cooked properly, plenty of cheese and bacon was nice and smokey. The fries were hot although very salty and oily. Now to my shake/blast. I had the M&Ms blast and at first was pretty disappointed in the amount of M&Ms. I scooped half way down my cup and only saw color streaks showing signs if M&Ms bit hadn't bitten into any. Well guess what they were all at the bottom. Maybe not mixed as wel as it should have been. But they were eventually in there.

My order was fulfilled correctly by Natelly and service was friendly. Even the carhop boy crossing by waved hello to our car. 

Not a bad place for quick bite and cool treat. Would like to try the car hop experience. Have had better blast (flurry) type drinks tho.

We have been very happy with the service from Access. Luke did the routine furnace check and he was very professional and friendly. I really like that a picture of the tech is sent to you before he arrives. Great company to work with !

Came in for a peanut butter shake and loved it! Was out in under 2 minutes and the car hop was extremely nice! I definitely appreciate the atmosphere of the restaurant and the over all cheap prices! I will be returning!

I was looking to have under eye filler done and came across ReJuv Medspa. I was curious in the products they used and had some questions so I called and spoke with the manager MULTIPLE times. She informed on the products, pricing, etc. She  told me they have a payment plan, greensky which I applied for intending to use on under eye filler. I made the appointment a couple weeks in advance. I used PTO to take a long lunch and drove over from Caldwell. When I got there I checked in, filled out all the paper work (for fillers) and was called back. Once in the room the nurse who was going to be doing my procedure came and asked what type of filler I was having done. I said under eye  and she stated that they did not do under eye filler! I was frustrated but she was very understanding and went to speak with the manager ( who I spoke with previously on the phone but never came to apologize or talk to me while I was there) and offered me 12 free units of Botox, which I happily accepted. BUt remember that payment plan greensky, the one I  planned to pay with. Well three months later, no joke THREE months they decided to  charge over $300 to it! The crazy thing is I checked it the first two months just to make sure it didn't get  charged. I only found out because greensky called me. They charged the account two weeks before it expired. Nobody called me to let me know, they just  charged it. I called to dispute the charges and they (ReJuv) wouldn't do anything about it. Needless to say I would never go back or recommend it. The nurse was great but the management and customer service is horrible.

I wish I had something nice to say. The sonic near where I live in East Boise is great. But this one, for some reason, is sooooo slow. And as others have said, I've repeated "I would like onions on my chili cheese fries" twice and it still didn't end up on the screen OR my fries. 
If it wasn't near my work, I'd not go back. 
And its never any faster...dear managers...I'm not sure why its a problem...but it is.

Oh... my... goodness!!!!
This place was soooooooo much more fun than I ever could have imagined!
We got the family catch with snow crab legs, New Zealand musssels and shrimp. 
First of all, they charge $4 to behead the shrimp.
Let me tell you, don't pay the extra $4 Bc you get  a way better experience when you behead those shrimps yourself! 
It comes out in a giant plastic bag that you shake up and eat right out of. 
The food came out fast and the aroma hits when you open that bag. 
They provide a bib, a giant wet wipe and gloves. 
In the midst of all the excitement,  I may have missed the gloves. 
There is no nice and clean way to eat this.
I dug right in and when I broke that crab leg, juice sprayed the table. We got a good laugh from that.
We got the hook and reel seasoning and that stuff was finger licking good!
Now comes the really fun part.
Ripping those shrimp heads off was so much fun. 
It comes off easy and it brings out your primal instincts just digging into that giant bag of meat!
AlI in all, the food was delicious and it was a fun adventure! 
I will be talking about this experience for awhile to anyone who will listen.

I can't say enough good things about this dental office. Everything is updated and every single staff member was exceptionally pleasant. The hygienist that worked on me, Yaya, was a delight and verbally walked me through the entire checkup process. She went into detail about what certain terms and numbers meant so that I could fully understand what she was seeing and recording with my teeth/ gums. This type of disclosure is SO appreciated so you understand what you're paying for in case you need additional treatments. She answered every and any questions that I ad (I had a lot) as we went. They also have tv screens above the chair so you can see your x rays along with them. 
Dr Scott was just as friendly and attentive as everyone else and I felt like he was extremely thorough.  
Overall, I highly recommend this practice.

The food was pretty good but I ordered through Grubhub and they left out 2 orders of fries and 2 cookies. I called and they said, "what do you want us to do?" I said I'd like to be refunded for the fries and cookies. They told me they couldn't do that and apparently Grubhub can't either. Poor customer service.
They also didn't even put my order in until my delivery person had shown up to pick up the food. So it ran almost 30 minutes longer than it should have.

Mo' Bettahs really broke out after I moved away from the Mountain West. It's been on my radar for a while now so on a recent trip to Idaho I knew I had to stop! Service was really fast and though the menu is rather simple, the food items are really well done! I got the katsu chicken and the teriyaki steak. Loved each one! The rice was nice and moist and not dried out and the macaroni salad was plentiful. 
Prices are really reasonable and there is a lot of food in these meals so come hungry or be prepared for tasty leftovers.

Horrible property management company. Maintenance Issues take MONTHS to resolve. Their maintenance techs are very flakey and when they do show up they do pretty much nothing. Maybe take a picture of the problem then disappear making you wait again. You call in to speak to the girls in the office and it's like talking to robots. They don't want to lift a finger to help you with any issue. I've never dealt with such extreme level of unprofessionalism. I will never lease through this company again.

EDIT: LOOK AT THE IMAGES TO SEE A PIC I UPLOADED OF THE TRASH DUMPSTER. THERE IS GARBAGE ALL OVER THE GROUND SURROUNDING IT AND NOBODY WANTS TO DO ANYTHING ABOUT IT.
$20 lunch for one and this is the "chicken" salad sandwich you get. A tiny bit of chicken, soggy brown lettuce and a lot ic

My girlfriend and I decided to stop in for breakfast and this place is amazing. The service was great and timely. I ordered the Bloody Mary, country Benedict and breakfast crepes and it was all excellent. Everything is reasonably priced as well. Will definitely be back again!

The food was ok. They're using fresh ingredients which is the reason I'll give a three star. Simple menu with fresh foods. Scrambled eggs were good, fresh avocado, lovely homemade salsa-without any heat at all though. However, the bacon was burnt, the breakfast ham was thin lunch meat heated up in a pan, and the "gravy" is BAD. It isn't even gravy. It's like a white pasta sauce made with a butter roux. I ordered my gravy on the side, and my breakfast burrito was quite good without it. My husband had it mixed in his breakfast bowl and it was really not good, and upset his stomach later as well. 
The latte was good, but I like my coffee strong and robust, so I ordered it with an extra shot. Only one shot in the small. The mocha is made with cocoa powder mix, so chalky and heavy.

The food itself was good for Del Taco, no complaints there. However this review is specifically for customer service. My sister, mom, grandma and I went through the drive thru around 10:15 pm tonight. My grandma was in the drivers seat, and after we approached the window she gave the woman a coupon, and gift card to start then cash for the remainder. The woman, named Patricia, was already not very nice from the start, she seemed to have an attitude from the beginning. We got our food then my grandma asked for green sauce at the end, the woman was very rude about it. She rolled her eyes, and then sent another crew member to bring it to the window to us, making us feel like an inconvenience for wanting sauce. We pulled out to eat in the parking lot, because the inside was already closed, and my sister was missing a fork in the bag for her chili cheese fry. My mom walked up to the window to ask for a fork and the woman huffed and puffed, as if it's our fault that she forgot to give us a fork. She also didn't give us any napkins either. I was very disappointed in how my grandma and family were treated by this woman for simply ordering food and spending our money at this establishment. Will not be back if this is how customers are treated.

Great downtown bar and grill. Love that it's within walking distance from my house. 
Good food!

Everything my family had was delicious.  We has the eggs Benedict, biscuits and gravy, hen house,  and the breakfast burrito. Coffee was also fresh and great flavor. The burrito was huge! I had it with chicken and it was delicious! You get your money's worth here. Breakfast done well. Now one of my favorite  breakfast joints!
Gavin was super nice! The second i got there he asked me how my day was and we were able to have a great conversation. The food was also great!
This location has always sucked, food is crap and all the food was barely hanging together with how they folded it. Taco Bell sucks as is but I'm surprised this one hasn't shut down yet

Be forewarned this company scams people. The owner, Ruth Reinertson, is a sick individual who should be prosecuted for her behavior and dishonest business conduct. These people are predators. They will come to your door saying they are doing a "survey" in your neighborhood. In reality, they are actually asking pointed questions in an attempt to qualify or disqualify you as a customer. They will try to get your phone number - don't give it to them! Shut the door, immediately. They are selling cheap vacuums and want to take your money. They'll do anything to get it. The owner poses as a Christian woman from the south. She's nothing more than a sick, overweight, unattractive, greedy individual who will do anything to get your money.

Decided to try this place for breakfast today. Less than impressed. Only ones in the restaurant at 7 on a Saturday. Biscuits and gravy were lukewarm. Gravy had large flour lumps. Home fries warm to cool - not hot. Extra gravy was meager and lukewarm. Croissant sandwich with bacon was warmer but missing cheddar cheese, although may have been mixed in with eggs. No check in while staff socialized in the kitchen. But one redeeming quality was a good biscuit.
Great selection of furniture, the staff was friendly, helpful and if it's on the floor you can take it home with you!

One of the best things panera has going for them lately is the bacon egg and cheese on a brioche bun. The egg is real and runny, which is different from every breakfast sandwich that comes from a franchise restaurant. The fact that they don't serve breakfast past 1030 in the morning is why they get 2 stars. Serve breakfast all morning. People have different schedules and should be able to order a breakfast at 1045 in the morning.

Stopped in yesterday for the first time that I've been to a TCBY in YEARS!!! All the ladies working were so cool and even sang me 'Happy Birthday'  Awesome customer service and their no sugar added yogurt was DELICIOUS!

These paint parties are so much fun. Even if you can't paint, like myself, the owner takes you through the painting step by step and it is so fun to learn. And if you can paint, it's a lot of fun too, a huge array of paintings. You can have a party, a girls night, a couples night and I like to go with my mom. It's a wonderful bonding moment. And it's also inexpensive!!! I highly recommend the Angry Easel, you won't be disappointed for all occasions.

Good service and the food is better than a Sherri's or Denny's but nothing special.
A little overpriced for the atmosphere and quality of food.

The service, steak, rice, macaroni salad, and chicken katsu were really good. I am giving four stars instead of five because of the katsu sauce. It had a sour taste to it, and didn't compliment the chicken ver well. Overall, we really enjoyed our meals and the service though! Thank you Mo' Bettahs!

I was looking to get my knives sharpened and there were not a lot of options. Went here yesterday and spoke with Layne. He was great, he explained things to me that I had no idea of. How to properly sharped a knife, and he showed me a lot of knives so I can feel how they fit my hand. Purchased a large knife block (very happy with) and had my kitchen knives sharpened. They sharpen knives overnight which is great, just in time for the weekend. Everyone here is very friendly, well versed in their craft, and I am most definitely coming back. The business was clean and the prices were fair and reasonable.

I love Panera, I come for lunch frequently. It's convenient to use the Kiosks and the App, to which I also use all the time when I know I am coming, and helps out that it saves my card on file (password protected) for when I leave my card at work by accident (which happens more than i care to admit). I have my favorites saved for a quick, easy ordering process and gets delivered to my table. The servers have always been nice and polite of the times I've been here. And my food rarely let's me down! The white cheddar Mac & Cheese is the best I've ever had, same with the turkey chili. I even found a copy cat recipe on Pinterest that ive made at home.

Wait times be dammed, eating here is worth it. Le Peep is as good as it gets for breakfast eateries in Meridian. 

Restaurant: Simple and unassuming from the outside, cozy, almost bordering on small on the inside. Of particular note is the waiting area separate from the restaurant. The two sets of doors does help keep the bugs out during cluster fly season. Overall, seating is comfortable and tables aren't wobbly. Decor is local photography. 

Menu: Breakfast! Fancy breakfast, basic breakfast and much in between. 

Food- Really good! It doesn't take much effort to make good breakfast food, but they go the extra mile to make theirs stand out from the crowd. 

Overall- I highly recommend coming here over any other breakfast place in the area.
Destiny the bar tender should be fired. She should not be able to work in a public establishment. She has major attitude and I felt very disrespected. FYI the food and other staff were amazing

The first year we signed up for Red Line things were great.  While signing up we were told that getting a boat would never be a problem unless we were trying to book for the upcoming weekend.   It is now the second week of June and the boats are about 95%  booked up for the summer.   The online system is on and off for working.   I have multiple emails sent asking for help booking with no response.        We have rented boats directly from Mile High Marina, in McCall more so than through Red Line which is unfortunate.   We also have had to use other sources for side by sides.    We have an enormous amount of points that will likely never get used do to lack of availability.

My husband waited in the car as I walked into The Joint and walked out 10 minutes later. "Wait!" he exclaimed, "That's it?! Are you done or did you just sign in?" After years of waiting for me in chiro offices the shock of how quickly you can get in and out of The Joint has still not worn off. "You mean you can just go in and get adjusted and they don't talk to you for hours about supplements and treatment plans and God and subluxations and X-rays?!!?" he asks me every. single. time. I. leave. The Joint. Yes! The answer is: you CAN just go in and scan your membership card, get adjusted and leave in MINUTES! There are no pitches, no x-rays, no supplements! But there is a downside to this and that's why there are four stars on my review and not five. This is the fast food of chiropractic. They get you in and they get you out. There is no special treatment, no discussion about what's ailing you, and no traditional bedside manner. They are nice but I don't know anybody by name in there and I signed up for the month-to-month program that gets you four adjustments a month for the low-low price of 49.99. If you want a quick adjustment in a relatively convenient location then this is the place for you. If you want the "Cheers" of chiropractic where everyone is going to call you by name and you are going to stay for more than 10 minutes to get vitamin B injections, hot stone massages, e-stim, jade roller treatments and chakra tunings, this is not the place for you. I appreciate the quick in and out when all I need is a basic adjustment but I don't feel like I can say, "Hey, you missed a spot. Can you adjust me again?" or "Can you adjust my wrist, knee and ribs and hit me with that machine that looks like you should be buffing a car instead of working out the kinks in my muscles?" because A. That's what my regular, long-standing chiro is for, and B. they don't HAVE any machines like that here - and if they do, I'm sure - like Massage Envy (yes, this is the Massage Envy of chiropractic) - there is an extra charge for them. Don't get me wrong. They are super duper nice and professional - and they even have special days when they bring in chair massage therapists or give adjustments to first responders (you get some cool emails when you're a member) - but if you want a more detailed and involved level of care you may want to look elsewhere.

I regret the day my husband bought my ring from Lee Reed.  They boast a customer service policy to fix or replace missing stones from jewelry purchased from their stores.  You MUST bring your jewelry in every six months to have it checked (which I do, religiously).  BUT you must keep track of documents to prove your diligence.  Really, in this day of technology?? If you do not have your documents, they will provide you with a card and tell you to bring your paperwork next time(they will graciously update it for you).  If you don't, they charge you for a service they boast is free to loyal customers.  What a joke!!  If someone is willing to return to your store every six months FOREVER, Don't you think you could maintain records electronically?

Such a cozy beautiful place 
All the staff were more than nice !!!
Had breakfast so good and filling 
Will be going back !!

My boyfriend and I pulled into the parking lot to do a driver switch as we are on a road trip! My boyfriend went to order and I sat down. A man, I assume is the owner or manager greeted me and began talking to me about how we found the place and I explained by accident and were not from here and he began explaining about the franchise. Great service!
 
To say the least, it took no time at all to get the sandwich and my boyfriend loved it! 
We are very glad to have stumbled across this place!

My son and I were hungry for just a good burger, did a quick local restaurant search, and Pauly's Bar Room came up with good reviews on both Yelp and Google. Since it was close by, we thought what the heck, lets 
give it a try, good choice by us!

Service was friendly and prompt, we were greeted right away by a nice lady who was also working as the bartender. 

After looking over the menu, my son decided on the grilled onion bacon cheeseburger and I did the Ruben burger. A special request from both of us was to please grill the burger not past medium (still a little pink).

Our food came out right away and was so piping hot we had to let the burgers sit a bit before biting into them! 
It was worth with the wait! The meat was cooked perfectly to our request, still juicy and delicious! The fries and onion rings were very good as well! 

We will be back!

One of the top breakfast spots in Meridian for breakfast food, flavor, options (lots of GF!) and value. As a repeat customer I always find that the hosts could be more genuinely friendly upon arrival and leaving but the wait staff makes up for it.

After a failed attempt at a different location I found emission testing pros on my iPhone maps. I pulled right up at 3:30pm and was helped immediately.  Very fast and friendly service!  I will be back next time I need a smog
Good, fresh breakfast in a diner atmosphere.  I had the chicken fried chopped pork patty (not it's real name but I can't remember so... that's what it was) that was crispy, flavorful and tender.

My rating may be biased and based on experience. It stems from the service I received as a first time customer not knowing what to expect and looking to enjoy a great meal, in a great atmosphere. My sever, Ashley, who happened to be the manager,  provided sub par service to my daughter and I as we were celebrating her 18th Birthday.  I was a newbie to a crab boil and didn't know what to expect . So, I observed every server in this establishment as they served this much talked about crab boil. They mix the bag full of delectable seafood and empty it on the metal plate in front of the customer. Ashley, set the metal plate with the seafood down in front of my daughter and I all tied up in the bag and was ready to walk away. I loudly asked, are you going to open it and plate it? She said "No, we don't do that because the crab legs will puncture the bags and and spill. " 5 seconds later a different server comes out and plates my family and Friends' plates and I asked them to plate mine because my server said "she didn't do that." Mind you, this was my first time at a crab boil, god forbid anyone else come in and the sever would have to EXPLAIN what a crab boil is and how it is served for your first timers.  Not to mention the fact that our party consistently had to wait and ask for things we needed instead of being asked. This server left me questioning  if she treated me different because of my skin color, and put a damper on the celebration of my daughter's birthday. For that, she earned the customer service rating of 1 .
The food was great , and the company we had made up for the lousy customer service. 
We were definitely satisfied with our portion sizes and the cost. 5  for food.

We have a spider and a wasp problem and we've tried to take care of it ourselves for the last two years. But after both our kids got stung by wasps last summer, we knew we needed to get some professionals. 

I was referred to Vertex by a friend and then of course checked the Yelp reviews. It was a pretty easy choice! We opted for the quarterly service which includes a first, thorough treatment.  Because we were referred, we got 50% off! So this first one was $85. After that it will be $99 a quarter. 

They sprayed the foundation and eaves, put granules in the grass, dewebbed and denested all over the house and treated all the areas where they found nests. If we see any nests or extra pests, they will come out every time to take care of it free of charge! 

I can't yet speak to the long term quality of the service, but I was really impressed by our first appointment. Matt was our technician and he was amazing. Efficient and very knowledgeable. He patiently answered all our questions (while maintaining a 6 ft distance). 

Yay for no more wasps!
Terrible all around. Order was completely wrong, when brought up to the assistant manager, who acted like a child, said "what do you want me to do about it?". Never Going Back.

Where to begin? First I guess they should change their name to, "We cheat'um and HOW!".

Stay away from GSD and Brian, they are not honest and will try to relieve you of all your money in your account. I had greenfield butcher two cows and they didn't trim the meat well at all.  It was so gross!  I had to pick through tons of gristle and fat every time I tried to eat anything.  Even the hamburger had gristle in it.  BLECH!!!

First time here. The staff are extremely friendly and professional. As a business owner myself I was impressed with the communication with in team members. Initially we were told that there would be 10 to 15 min wait. Within 2 minutes we were seated. The most amazing thing was we were helped by 5 different servers they got EVERYTHING CORRECT. Food was hot and delivered very quickly. I even watched as a patron was rude and demanding to the staff. He even blanantly lied to the manager, I know because I overheard  the conversation. Very terrible experience here. Me and a girlfriend went into the store to browse the candy. There was about 15 other people in the store but a young dark skinned cashier singled me and a friend out and started following us around and staring at us. He then addressed me as a "dude" and when I ignored him, him and the other young cashier kicked us out of the store. We were unsure why. I love the food! Everything always tastes fresh and delicious, except the raw oysters, they can use some help. Just a friendly reminder, it is highly important the oysters are preserved and stored in the proper environment to avoid poisoning. Probably, won't be ordering them again.

These guys and gals have serviced my home for many years for a reason; They're just that good.
A1 has something, actually a lot of somethings, that most businesses have either lost or never had and that is integrity. Above all, that's the most important factor in business. Along with that, they're very knowledgeable, dependable, and get the job done correctly and expediently. 
Do yourself a big favor and use them. You don't stay in business this long if your a schmuck

This was an amazing experience.  The food is fresh and tastes awesome.  They give you great options and amazing service.  The staff were friendly,  the restaurant was clean and well taken care of. I would highly recommend this restaurant for special occasions, birthday dinners and anytime you want amazing seafood. Our server Tarna was awesome,  very helpful and took great care of us.

My friend and I waited nearly an hour for our food when there was a total of 10 tables in the entire restaurant and our drinks were not refilled at all. Absolute worst experience at a restaurant, we will not be coming back.

These guys and gals are legit.  Professional, quality work and good customer service. Plus, all work is warranted by nation wide network. I found them by accident when researching tires.  They gave me a very competitive price then knocked a little more off for good measure. The manager Chris spent nearly 20 minutes with me on the phone - who even does that anymore. Anyway, I finished my research later and called to make an appointments. They even sent someone to the warehouse in Canyon County to get the tires I wanted before I had arrived. Over and above. I was there for a while waiting on tire install and alignments, I never heard anyone try to "up-sell" or provide advise that was  anything but in the customers interest.   Anyway, first experience was positive. I will be back and have already recommended to family members.

If you are looking for the best realtor, search no more!  Stewart Reality is top notch.  In a 1 to 5 rating, my husband and I would give them 10!  My husband and I just moved to the Eagle area in August, 2018.  We previously owned a 5 acre home in Meridian.  We had the pleasure of working with Stewart Reality.  In our past, we have sold three homes and bought four homes.  Never have we experienced anything close to what we experienced with Stewart Reality.  You will not find anyone as professional and ethical as Jeff and Sheri; they are a fantastic team!  Jeff not only sold our home in Meridian, but found us exactly what we were looking for in Eagle on the golf course.  Both Jeff and Sheri work very hard for you and make the whole process a very positive experience.  We could not have asked for anything more!
What has happened to chipotle.   Order was supposed to be ready at 1:15.   It's 1:44 and the place is packed with annoyed customers.   Get it together.

Won't go back.  Service was the absolute worst.  4 of us were there 1 1/2 hours, saw several parties come in after us and get seated.  Checked with the receptionist several times and were continually told yes, we are still waiting for something to open up.  Spoke with the manager who demonstrated no empathy or desire to take the opportunity to change our experience.   After seeing more tables for 4 open without being seated we just left.  Too many other places who care about the customer experience.  Could probably be solved with giving you a buzzer when you check in.  The calling out names doesn't seem to be working.

As far as pizza goes this is my Jam...  My favorite is the samoan with some cream cheese and fresh jalapenos....oh and in August they have a habanero pizza....if you like spicy this is the best freaking pizza out there.  Flying Pie is a regular for my family. We all love it and no other pizza compares in our eyes.  Plus you cant beat the buy medium or large and get a second medium or large half off.
My new favorite place to eat. Always good. Always fast. Always friendly!
Long wait but food was good. We had a large group with us but the server was able to accommodate us all very well

I first went here for a manicure for a friends wedding.  The manicure was excellent and she even fixed a chip in my toe nail polish for free.  All the girls (and a couple guys) that work here are super friendly and fun to chat with.  I also had a full body,one hour massage done here and it was heavenly!  I get my eyebrows waxed here too and they always do a good job for a reasonable price.  I would recommend ReJuv for special occasions or the monthly appointment.

First time coming here and probably won't stop by again. The staff was very helpful and friendly but the good stopped there. The store was extremely warm so I decided to take my sandwich to go. I got the teriyaki chicken sandwich, it had been cut in half after it was wrapped so it ended up being a big leaky mess. The bread tasted store bought and it was loaded with onions and barley any meat. The bread was soggy from the excessive amount of runny teriyaki sauce. The fries were okay. The total cost of my order was over $17. Very expensive for what I received. $14 at subway gets me a better combo meal with 3 cookies and a drink.

came in for lunch with my mom. the place is very big and bright and open inside. lots of tables and half-booths. 

our server was really nice and attentive. they bring you carafes of lemon water and iced tea (if you order it) so you're never without a beverage, which is awesome. why don't more places do that?

we both ordered from the lunch menu, even though this place is primarily a breakfast spot. I will have to review it again when I come back for breakfast. 

I ordered the pablano chicken soup and side salad with greek honey dressing. the salad was so tasty- loved the dressing! it had cucumber, avocado, red onion, tomato, croutons, and romaine. it was all very fresh. the soup was really yummy- it had corn, black beans, chicken, and it was a little spicy. my only complaint was it was not super hot. that was disappointing.

my mom got the grilled cheese with tomato soup. the soup was THICK. it had really great flavor though! the sandwich looked okay- i'm not a huge grilled cheese person so I didn't try it.

I look forward to trying this place again, it's a cute little spot. I would say go for breakfast though!

Filthy Restaurant. I think all Taco Bell's here just don't care about cleanliness! This is the one in Meridian on Meridian Road. Disgusting. The counter where they made the food was just as bad. Unfortunately the girl took her hand and swiped the food into the trap with her hand before I could take a picture of that disaster. Here is their floor though.

Ordered the finger steaks... I'm kind of a finger steak snob because I've had REALLY good ones from scratch at other places.. but I really wanted to try these.. they were medium. Not seasoned at all and not cut against the grain, so when you bite it the breading comes off. Grease was kind of soaked through breading as well with "wet looking" spots. I'm not impressed!

Wow, after living on the Gulf Coast I never expected to find an authentic shrimp boil anywhere near Boise Idaho. Large shrimp with heads in spicy traditional Cajun sauce - yummy! Poor boy sandwiches and hush puppies are fantastic as well. What a treat to have in the Treasure Valley.

On the other hand, the fried oysters were overdone and the lobster bisque & crab french fries were too sweet. This is not really a Cajun restaurant; there are too many core dishes missing. However if you need to satisfy a craving for some Cajun cuisine you can get that here. Glad to have you in Meridian, Hook and Reel.
The lobby was closed, and they wouldn't let us walk through the drive through. Horrible customer service

I was surprised to see the two negative reviews. My daughter looks forward to  going to practice and she stated that she is on the team with the nicest girls. I have been quite impressed with Rise and her coach, and I have great admirations for Rise during this crazy Covid time. Communication is clear, payments are easy, tournaments are in person, and the kids and parents appear to feel grateful that they are part of the organization. My daughter is right smack in the middle of the skill level, but she and I both feel like we are getting 100% out of Rise.

After a busy day exploring farmers markets my husband and I found this small cafe in downtown Meridian. First of all I was super delighted with how adorable the place was decorated. We sat on the outside patio so I could enjoy the beautiful hanging flowers. 

The service was very friendly right off the bat. Our waitress was very informative and patient while we decided what we wanted. I finally settled with some classic biscuits and gravy. Even though there was a little bit more grease than I would have like I thought it tasted great. The biscuits mixed in fabulously with the gravy. I would think they were homemade. My husband got the breakfast bowl upon the waitresses' recommendations. It, too, tasted fabulous! I enjoyed picking at his plate after I nearly inhaled mine. The toast was toasted well, I've been some breakfast places where the toast is either burnt to a crisp or hardly in the toaster. 

Thanks Deja Brew for an awesome morning! I wouldn't have wanted to start my weekend anyway else. Ill definitely be back with some friends in the near future.
Food was cold, service was slow, and the place is disgustingly dirty.  They only started cleaning when we started taking pictures.

Outstanding sub.
That had just opened and I loved it!
I have no idea why someone would post less than 5 stars

Sucker. That's what I was for thinking I could go here to get a cheap adjustment. Its cheap for a reason. Not real treatment, no identify whats going on, no is it fixed, nothing. In'n'out sure, cheap sure, good no! If you want your high school buddy to pop your back this is what you get, if you want a doctor to help you and "treat" you stay with a real Chiropractor. I've done many chiropractors over the years in different places I have lived, I always always always keep one in my tool bag and have had good experiences 90% of the time and not so good experiences, as with anything in life, and this pretty well takes the cake. I went like many to try on a weekend when my guy was out of the office. I'll wait or call in to him next time and I'm not telling him I cheated either, Ha Ha. I agree with other reviewers on here not sure who wrote the alleged 5 star reviews. How can there be such polar opposites?

April was incredible in applying and transforming our teeth from off white to brilliant white. My husband was reluctant, but he said it was not only easy, but loved his teeth score from 11 to 1. It was a huge change. When I come back in 6 months, I'll definitely ask for April. Thanks, April!

Given "good chain restaurant" is an oxymoron in my vernacular, I didn't become acquainted with Panera as their customer until a couple of years ago and at this location only a few months ago.  For each of the half dozen-ish times in, whether for breakfast or lunch, I've enjoyed very friendly counter service, pretty healthy food options if I choose wisely, and a clean setting with lots of standard height table seating even if the seating is too tightly spaced in some of the eatery.  Plus, introvert that I am, I can find certain times of day to be crowd free, even at this location in a new-ish strip mall backing to a main thoroughfare in one of the fastest growing cities in the United States.

Having something to celebrate on this early November morning besides the good results of an early morning dental check up, I stopped at Panera and squeaked in just in time for breakfast to try the new Farmstead breakfast sandwich.  (FYI - they make the turn to Lunch Menu at 10:30 or so.)  In the mode of celebration, it was a darned good sandwich on toasted-dense-chewy bread with shaved ham, sliced cheese, a generous amount of  roasted tomatoes and an egg for a little over five bucks. 

FYI - a surprise to me that the egg was over easy and not hard cooked...next time I'll know to order the egg differently or vote for the kitchen to leave it off. 

FYI - in the mode of "aw shucks, every thing cannot ever be exactly as we want it", I learned from the nice woman at the counter that my favorite Panera sweet treat, the Pecan Roll (aka sticky bun) will be coming off of Panera's menu, likely forever, chain-wide after November 15.  I share that with others who may be fans with the reminder that sweet things in life are fleeting.  Eat thee Pecan Rolls while ye may.   My theory is calories don't apply in the face of farewell purchases. 

FYI - if you need good baguette and don't want to make the stop at nearby CoOp for local bakers' Gaston and Acme options, Panera's baguettes are darned tasty and worthy of your home recipe fromage fort or Zahav recipe hummus.

THE DRILL:  Order at the counter or by kiosk at the front of the store. They'll give you an electronic "id disk" with a number on it.  Take it with you to the table or booth and when your order is ready, they deliver.  Bus your own when done, but if you fail to do that they do clean up after folks.  Food is served on real plates.  Hooray.  Coffee, the dark roast is more than decent, is serve yourself in ceramic mugs or big paper "hot cups".  

CUSTOMERS:  Range in age from little children and family groups, to people of all ages in business attire, to 'ladies who lunch' and 'gents who kibbitz' groups, to folks who are well into senior years.  All people are welcome.  And noting one recent reviewer of this or another Panera location commented that "every old person in the town was in there for lunch", my reply back was "not really, I wasn't there, for example".  :-)  How it is dissing people who are aged became acceptable sport is beyond me.  Fill in the blank for any other minority population and see how funny it is...not.

PARKING:  Private lot which seemed to have not quite ample number of spaces. 

ACCESSIBILITY:  ADA parking in lot - 3 spots and 1 is van accessible.  Level in the door and all on one level inside.  Lots of standard height table seating but some paths of travel are too tight at full house times if using wheelchair.

NUTRITION incl CALORIES:  Available on paper flyers in store or at their easy to navigate web site.  A good thing!

So the other day there was a knock at my door and when I answered it there was a young lady standing there. She introduced herself and then handed me a package and said: "This is for you". I accepted it and said thank you. Then she stepped right through my door and took the package back, proceeded to fill the item with water from my kitchen sink. She was chattering away about something and then said that her associate would be here in a minute to demonstrate, which he did show up a moment later. He began unloading all this crap and trying to make small talk. Finally, I said, "Wait a minute, what is all this?" He informed me that he was going to demonstrate his product. I don't know if I'm being hyper-sensitive or if my feelings were real but I never heard of this company and now they want an hour of my time, unannounced with no appt. or forewarning. I told the young man that I had an appt. in town and could not spend an hour right now watching his demo. So he packed up his stuff and then went into my kitchen and took 'my gift' I got from the girl. What the hell?

Great place for boiled seafood in landlocked Boise. I am from S Louisiana- the food here isn't really Cajun (no gumbo, jambalaya, etoufee, etc) but is good none the less! We had raw oysters, so nice and cold- pretty large although not salty like gulf oysters. All around FUN experience, prices were reasonable for great quality food! Great service, the manager even brought out our food himself since they were super busy. We will definitely be back soon!
Just as good as our experience in Salt Lake! Great service, clean, welcoming and of course - delicious!

I love IBeni!! It's my favorite boutique in Boise! I've missed going in regularly since moving back to San Diego but every time I'm back in town I stop in and shop! All of the girls are lovely! I follow them on Instagram and recently got the cutest spring outfit! Great prices, great quality and you won't find better service! Can't wait to visit again!

Nice service, quality food, clean.  Never disappointed but surprisingly good every time I eat here.
Try finger steak, cheese stick and sandwiches....
Easy access from freeway...

This place is the most unprofessional place I have heard of. My cousin lives there and I have never ever seen him so stressed in my life I go over there seeing all of the papers the landlord leaves on their door with fines and trying to make them do maintenance and cleaning in the MIDDLE of their lease. I have told almost every single one of my friends not to rent from this place due to the poor treatment. I have also began to look into the laws as well as violations they are committing. HORRIBLE PEOPLE

This place has awesome food! Very yummy surprisingly quick!
Great deal too dinner for two is easily 20 bucks and we were still both so full we barely finished!

Worst service and wait. 30 minutes for 4 burritos to go. This Taco Bell always has issues. Constantly dirty and always has other problems with  staffing. Management here must totally suck and the ownership must be idiots.
Loved everything from the drinks to the crab & shrimp bag. Flavor was incredible and so was the service. Highly recommend!
The food was good. Our server, Nancy was amazing. However, the Christian rock music they were playing kind of ruined things for me.  Atmosphere is important. I don't like hidden agendas.

A while back I brought in some clothes and understandably they didn't even want anything but one item and wanted to give me 1.33 cents for it. I honestly just walked away bc what is that going to help me? I decided to try again today and I brought in a basket full of clothes. I would have kept a bunch of the items bc they were cute I just wanted to really minimize my closet. I get it, they wanna make money flipping these clothes but I will never go back I'm laughing so hard rn. For 8 items I was offered $11. I flat out said no bc one of the ripped pair of jeans that I have only worn once were $40 and that was just ONE of the items, the romper she liked I bought for $20...I realize that companies like this need to make money but to offer people such low prices for what I know is high profit for them is almost offending. The two girls that helped me were really nice so that's the only reason I gave it a 2 and not a 1 so s/o

This place was very fun to rent boats and had very fun! They gave us a blower to blow up are floaters! But they had very bad communication! If you lose something there don't expect it back! They told us they had are wallet and then they said they didn't but then they lied several times more about but oh well! We had fun!
Very tasty pizza and great service. Had the place to our selves and the service was wonderful.

Okay maybe I have high expectations, or maybe I just make poor life choices. However this is literally the worst pizza I've ever had. I'm actually not very confident that what we consumed was  pizza. This is what happens when your 8 year old picks out where you go for dinner. Also it came out to $28.00 dollars, but when I made a comment about the price the cute pizza guy brought it down to $22.00 and gave us even more pizza...? A little confusing but I'll take it. So definitely a no go on the pizza, but a yes on the customer service. :)
Dr. Cox and his staff makes you feel comfortable. Dr. Cox is kindhearted and always listens and offers reasonable options to to address any of my concerns. Thanks again, ROY B.
