Not for me. I think this place is probably great for people who don't have any chronic issues or need more than a super quick adjustment. I found the layout to be strange. The tables where you get adjusted are out in the open, so keep that in mind if you're someone who prefers some privacy. I also found the chiropractor that adjusted me to be a bit patronizing (I haven't been to a chiropractor in a while). All in all, I think the price you pay is fair for the services received, but I personally think I will be searching for somebody that can provide more.

i came with 2 of my friends for a late night snack. we called them ahead of time (all of 20 minutes)  and they told us that they were open until 12. and we were 15  minutes away. we show up at about 11:15 and they didn't answer at the drive thru. we drove up to the window and we saw someone dart out of the way. we drove back around and saw 4 or 5 employees outside by the trash cans and then they ran back inside. don't tell someone that you're open until 12 and then not be open until 12.

I have had exceptional chiropractic care, The Joint didn't come close. I was desperate and they were nearby so I thought I would give it a try. The chiropractor was okay but honestly I didn't have any confidence that he really knew what he was doing and I was in more pain the next day. The really frustrating part was that this is a membership franchise so they wanted my credit card and were going to charge me a monthly fee even if I didn't use the services. Of course I could cancel anytime but they will charge me for one additional month at 49.99 a month. So beware because if you sign up after your first adjustment you will be out a total of $100 over two months.

Omg! If you want a decadent brunch item or dessert, this is the place to go! The service is friendly and warm. The cinnamon rolls are heavenly. We did the online order for pick up with 6 custom rolls. The fruit was fresh and bright, while the frosting was sweet, and the roll chewy and soft. The perfect pairing with coffee. This is a fun try for out-of-towners. 

I'd take a picture but they were devoured the second I got home with them!!! I would definitely order from them again or when fully open, go there in person to see what creations they have available. Their menu is extensive with goodness! 

Thank you for sweet treat!

Overpriced, a one bedroom will run you around 900 dollars, ridiculous contracts, poor maintenance practices.   Not a good place to live, they show you a really nice apartment and don't let you see yours until you move into it and then it looks nothing like the one they showed you. Low budget appliances. Just a horrible place to live. You could pay a mortgage for how much they charge.
The people are amazing and the food is so delicious with huge portions! They close by 2pm so if you plan it right, you can make it a weekday brunch!

As first time home-buyers, my wife and I could not be happier that we found Stewart Realty.  We are fairly picky, and we even completely changed the type of property we were looking for multiple times mid-way through the process.  I'm sure that's a little frustrating for a realtor.  But through it all, Jeff was nothing but patient, helpful and very honest.  He gave many helpful suggestions along the way (did I mention that we were first-time homebuyers? ... we knew nothing about the process) and genuinely had our best interest at heart.  We will be contacting Jeff again the next time we need to buy or sell real estate in the Meridian area.

I was watching a football game of my favorite team. The owner changed the channel. I asked the server to see if he'd switch it back. He said no because the game was a blowout although there was no other game of interest to switch to and I was the only one watching that TV!  Why in the world would you not do what your customer asks?????  Servers are great but the owner, not so much.

Dave and his staff have been very helpful on those hot summer days when your air conditioning goes out for no apparent reason whatsoever. The first time Dave responded to my call, he quickly changed out the thermostat in a matter of minutes, and the second time his staff answered the call, they quickly replaced the capacitor in less than 5 minutes. Both experiences were awesome, and I would highly recommend this business to anyone that has any HVAC needs.

I moved (back) to Idaho after several decades away and quickly noticed their sign for habanero pizza and recruited a handful of friends to check it out. I consider myself a connoisseur of the hottest of the hot. Not many can deliver on that expectation but you'll find it here. Buyer beware (in the best way).

Great service my battery on my iPhone went out and the guy over at uBreakiFix diagnosed it quickly and fixed quick as well they have great customer service I strongly recommend them i just moved to the area and will be bringing all of my devices to them when I'm having problems ... thanks uBreakiFix you are appreciated ;)
Great breakfast choice this Saturday morning! Service was great and a nice addition to the valley!

moved to idaho from california and wanted to try a hawaiian bbq spot. good servings, good service but the flavors just aint it. there was no flavor in the mac salad and not much on the menu. in my opinion, the rice was too mushy.

In addition to my diamond falling out of my engagement ring and not being able to find it, I had to have my ring cut off because it had become too tight to get off myself. My diamond was gone, my ring was in pieces, and I was super upset. Enter the "diamond doctor", Sung. I picked out my diamond and he took my ring in all the pieces and made it look brand new! Amazing, beautiful work that brought tears to my eyes!

Multiple times we have been to this location, they are ridiculously slow.  We have been sitting in line for 25 minutes.  When we finally get to order the guy was rude and seemed annoyed to be there.  Will be our last time visiting this location...
Who doesn't love alcohol brought to your damn door and the pizza here is good ! But by far have the best crust

After the disastrous experience that was Island Kine Grindz, my wife and I decided to try the other new guys in town for Hawaiian. Mo' Bettahs is the fast casual dining experience that the treasure valley has been looking for. 

We knew we were going to take our food to go, but their online ordering system was giving me more trouble than what it was worth. We walked in to find that food was prepped in mass quantities so it could be provided fresh as you went down the line. I was thrilled that the online ordering wasn't actually necessary for our Tuesday evening date. 

As per usual, I ordered the Mini Elaku combo plate with Chicken Katsu, Kalua Pig, and Teriyaki Steak. 

To their namesake, this experience was Mo' Bettah than our last venture. Every piece of the combo was delicious, and brought me back to potlucks on north shore. The Mac salad had an interesting addition of shredded carrots. I've never had a Mac salad like theirs before, but the additional crunch and texture was entirely welcome. 

The downsides are mostly me being a stickler to an authentic experience. Why on earth does your restaurant not offer chopsticks? Additionally, the feeling of the Aloha Spirit was missed by a mile when I watched the girl weigh out my food, and place the tiniest fingernail size piece of steak on my plate to ensure I met their portion consistency metric. 

All in all, if you are craving some real good Hawaiian food with generous portions, you will be able to find it here. I'll be back for sure.

My new favorite and I hope you try it!  The chicken and pork are so good! The salad is super fresh. There was one time we ordered delivery and it was burnt chicken, I'm
Thinking it was an off day. Mostly it has been good quality.

Tried this place after hearing all my co workers RAVE about it. Cute place, I had the chicken katsu which was delicious with the sauce and the white rice was just fine. I was fairly disappointed in the Mac salad. I love a good Mac salad but this one just really bombed at having any flavor. Not even salt. Only thing I noticed that I would have liked to see was all the employees on the line out front wearing gloves. None of them were wearing gloves, even the girl working the grill. Kind of grossed me out especially with the hepatitis problems this area is having in the food industry right now. Other than that it was good. I think I would be more apt to make return visits if they wore gloves and will be sticking to only rice in the future for me. Decent place worth a visit.

I took my Truck I just purchased to Gem because it wouldn't pass smog. They inspected the truck and found smog equipment had been removed. They gave me an estimate to repair it but suggested I go back where I purchased it to get them to replace the missing equipment. When I picked up the truck Dave refused to charge me but gave me a detailed report of what needed to be installed to return the truck to stock. Great shop  they will get all my business from now on.

I had the worst experience ever with this chain. I ordered food for my sister and I while I am visiting from Virginia! We both ordered Hook and Reel sauce, MILD. However, upon getting home and unpacking the food to heat, I discovered the food had more than just a little kick to it. The food was really and truly unbearable to eat, especially for someone that does NOT eat spicy things at all. The heat had to be SPICY/FIRE. I called the restaurant because we could not even eat more than one piece of the food and all they offered was a 20% discount. 20%?!!! Not even half off after I paid damn near $100 and will have to trash the food. Oh And NO APOLOGY was given for the error. After stressing the fact that this was suppose to be dinner and that I had not even eaten more than 5% of the food, the associate and manager were both still RUDE and attempted to even be condescending. Now at almost 10pm at night I have no dinner due to their mistake.

It's been a "reel" struggle to find a decent seafood restaurant here in the treasure valley. Unfortunately this is another one of those "bleh" restaurants. Tried several items on the menu with a group of friends. Everything tastes the same and just doesn't have that good old fashioned Cajun taste and quality.

Great local style Hawaiian food in Boise? You better believe it - Mo' Bettahs, located in a strip mall in Meridian. It was opened by two locals (from Hawaii), they did a pretty good job of re-creating the local flavor and generosity in portions. Rice, mac salad, meat (kalua pig, teriyaki chicken, katsu, steak, shrimp) - I opted for the "mini" kalua pig and teri chicken and it was not "mini" as it was very filling. And yes, it was ono and brok the mouth! (Hawaiian pidgin for really delicious).
If ever in the mood for local style Hawaiian food, try Mo Bettahs...looks like there are a whole bunch of them in the area.

Lawsuit waiting to happen and not in a good way.  We came here for free on a coupon and it was not worth the cost. Unsupervised children running loose with golf clubs and golf balls. The black light mini golf is in the back corner with zero supervision. There's a stairwell behind a black curtain where kids sit unsupervised. Golf clubs and golf balls go flying around the room. Twice we nearly got hit in the head. Laser tag is an unsupervised mess. Little kids get trampled. Don't get me wrong I'm all for less rules and more fun (I.e. I'm not a Californian) But this is pure chaos. So much so that it's not fun at all. I felt like I was babysitting everyone's kids the whole time we were there. I have spent a lot of time taking kids to different trampoline parks and I recommend giving this one a miss. Unless you want to experience what the world would be like in an apocalypse situation. Definitely not worth it!

Look, as much as I hate to admit it, my hair is important to me. It's the one thing I have!
Whenever I move or for some other reason need to change my hairdresser, I get stressed out and I'm very picky so it usually takes me a few different people until I find someone I like.
Well, I just got my hair cut for the first time by barber-extraordinaire Richy, and let me tell ya, I'm happy!
I'll be back again, and so should you!
Enough said.
I come here every week or so with my baby and it's always nice seeing Megan our server. Coffee is great, they have a nice large selection of drinks

I was in here on Friday morning for breakfast and I saw the owner or manager arguing with a kid, didn't look over 18. As the kid left the manager said, and I cannot make this up, "I wish you the worst and you can suck my c*ck." This was the worst experience I've had at a restaurant in the Treasure Valley. To yell at a kid like this was totally unacceptable, good thing we were done with our meals and was able to leave. Never eating here again.

Best appliance repair company! Great customer service,  fair pricing, and always complete the job well. Calls returned  promptly and are able to schedule within a few days.  Hause was referred to me by a neighbor who also raved about him and I am so grateful. I have used them for several appliances and always been happy.

Here I am...giving it another try. Just ice cream today. 
Not too slow...but they no Longer have malt. Or sweet green tea. Blah blah blah apparently this have to be longer.

So here I am in October back at the sonic. Because it's close to my work basically. Today I decided to use a stall and the app to pay because the line in the drive-through was slightly long and as I said I'm going to work. 10 minutes to get a drink in the stall. Just when you thought the drink was just easy. I only gave it to stars because the guy apologized.

I was so excited to try this place new place and exciting! But then I ordered clams and crab and the crab was okay the clams were very sandy and tasted off. Service was okay. I got really sick after eating here though. Be careful what you order and how it's made.
Great spot to find a table in this town where brunch is like a religion.  Good prices and friendly staff.

Very convenient to schedule online. Day before you get a confirmation prompt. Terry had a tracking feature so I could see what job number I was and which job he was working on (like tracking a UPS package).

He was quick to tell me my dryer was completely shot and we both agreed it was a piece of junk. Lint had gotten into the heating element and started a fire in the dryer. I was blessed it didn't spread outside of the dryer into my house. We talked about what I should look for with my next dryer and he gave me some recommendations.

Thank you for your assistance today, Terry!

Attached: My invoice minus PII, looks like the minimum service charge is $80, something I was concerned about not knowing about in advance, but I knew I needed to get the damned dryer fixed.

GREAT PLACE! The food is alwys spot on, but the staff really makes the experince rad! Friendly, promp and they go above and beyond to enhance the customer experience. Keep up the great work! Hte manager on staff (glasses and tats) greeted everyone and kept my glass and belly full. Cheers all!

A repeat visit. How do they do it.  The staff doesn't change. The food only gets better. The portions are large.  Talked to the owner - what a nice guy.  Doesn't look it from the outside, but there are good reasons people line up outside for a seat.

The food is steam cooked and spiced to perfection. I was a little bummed that creating a combination was so difficult. I am not a huge eater, nor was my dining partner, but we ultimately settled on one combination platter to share. Ended up be just the right amount of food for us.
Excellent selections of carry and kitchen style knifes. Friendly staff. They sharpen knives, they put a nice edge on my edc pocket folder. They are a Benchmade authorized dealer.

Ive missed great food like this. being from the bay area we have our share of poly food. when i saw this place had to check it out. 
took my wife and her little sister there. 
Was not disappointed. im looking forward to eating there again. 
super good. if you havent been go there. simple but great and tons of food for the price. you cant go wrong.

Talkin' take-out here, which has been my modus operandi for eateries since mid March 2020 and will be for some months to come.   Being stuck and hungry the other day, I decided to download the Panera app and see how the service worked to order in advance for curbside delivery.  The outcome is it worked like a charm.

Ordered while finishing up at the car wash a few blocks away and by the time my hubby and I pulled into one of several pick up parking spots in front of the Panera building and answered the 'Let us know when you're here' prompt, a nice young guy with mask delivered our order to our car in a flash and popped it right in the back as he thanked us for doing business with Panera.  

The (newish to their menus) flatbread and half order of Greek salad we shared two ways when we got home was more than ample to feed two hungry on the verge of hangry people in late afternoon who had skipped lunch and breakfast.  Pretty darned tasty too in the context of chain food. Plus, it was a bargain at only about $12 total as I recall.

Noting the opening of my earlier review in which I acknowledge that I think "good chain restaurant" is an oxymoron and I next to never support them, Panera is one that I'm comfortable with even if  I didn't visit one more than three-ish times a year in the 'before days'.   December 2020 is the first time I've stopped by in this crazy year.  But in these pandemic times when to-go is the name of the game for my hubby and me and given my absolute refusal to use drive throughs (I'm claustrophobic if caught in a drive through line and I'm not kidding) very nice to know Panera's curb side delivery is easy to use and the process works well if I want to give it a go again. 

Last 'thumbs up' is I appreciate how complete are the descriptions of the food items on their menu and also that calorie counts are provided.  Yes.  I know this is Fed requirement for all chains of certain size, but I still appreciate it.

Panera is our go to on cold busy days. My kids love the food and love the you pick two especially a warm bowl of soup when I'm sick. We usually get a dessert to share. The drive thru option is amazing! We typically eat inside because my kids enjoy the fire place.  Tonight we did the drive thru our orders a little confusing since we've came for so long and menu items have changed. We got home to find that what we order was much different than what we received. Have 3 young hungry kids on my own hopping in the car to get it corrected wasn't an Option. I called and spoke with a manager, he was very kind and apologetic he offered to send me some free meal coupons. That is customer service at its finest. :) job well done!

This was our favorite pizza place for a number of years..not sure what happened, but after yesterday we will not be going back..the past few times we have eaten there it has been so-so..one time was even a little burnt.  So yesterday was Halloween.  I expected they would be busy so I placed an order for 2 medium pizzas online in the morning sometime between 10-11 to be ready at 5:15.  My husband went to pick up right around 5:15 and they had not even started making it! They were not apologetic, just said they were busy, turning people away..told him to come back in 20 minutes and they were getting it started.  He came back 40 minutes later to give them extra time and was told again they had just started making it! Never apologized, just talked about how short staffed they were.  I totally get that, but the way this was handled was wrong.  If you knew you were short staffed at anytime during the day someone could have called and advised our order would be late or something..not a word..we ended up canceling and getting something else..:(
Great food! Love their teriyaki chicken and beef! This reminds me of true Hawaiian cuisine! If you're in the area I would recommend trying. Prices are decent!

I have ordered from Jon Smiths Subs a bunch of times. Twice now I received a sandwich on stale bread. I love the sandwiches when on fresh bread but they are below average on stale bread. I know Covid is messing things up but I will not eat at a place that serves stale bread. I want to support local businesses but they have to help themselves.

Had been here before and had a good experience with a helpful lady that works there. Today (Saturday) called them at 3:40 asked how late they're open. She said 5 and do it yourselfers needed to be there by 4. So we rushed to get ready and headed over. Car clock said 3:58, IPhone said 3:59.  Got in the door, lady looked at the wall click that said 4:05 (not kidding) she said "we don't allow selfers after 4. SERIOUSLY? She said Yup! Left and won't be back. Went all the way to the "dog wash" on Ustick in Boise. Was done within 45 minutes.

After days of backwoods camping our trailer was a dirty dusty mess.  We were passing through Boise and found this place via Yelp. It was so easy and cheap! We drove our trailer into the large RV bay, put in our credit card, then my husband and I each took a wand and scrubbed the trailer clean in no time and for under $4.00!   Well worth seeking out.

We have shopped here more than a few times since we moved to the area a few months ago.  They have a pretty good selection of fun home accessories and seem to get in new pieces fairly often.  This is not a high end store but they have good looking items that don't break the bank.
Great food, amazing service, and the vibe is perfect! 10/10 will come back again! The churro french toast is a must!

OMG!!! The best locksmiths we have EVER dealt with! GREAT pricing, GREAT Customer Service & GREAT workmanship! Unfortunately, due to the carpentry quality when our home was built, we have had annual issues with our door knobs when the weather changes. Of all the local locksmiths we have tried, we have had the most successful and lasting workmanship done by Minuteman. If you happen to get CHAD showing up at your door, you're in for even more of a treat. He's polite, professional, down to earth & a joy to work with. After fumbling through locksmiths over the past 6 1/2 years, I am happy to say that we finally found one that we will stick with. THANK YOU MINUTEMAN! THANK YOU CHAD!

I have gone here for years.  Unfortunately, it has really gone downhill.  I had my eyebrows waxed and tinted, a month ago, the color came out almost black on my fair skin.  I called and asked for a correction, she told me there was nothing that could be done, that they would lighten.  I told her I thought they could strip the color and redo and she said yes they could do that.  She was quite rude and irritated.  Why lie?  They really don't seem to care about the quality of the service.  I went in today just for a brow wax, she didn't clean the area like usual or put any lavender or aloe on afterwards, just quick wax and done.  I had to come home and pluck more hairs out.  So disappointing!!

Have been looking forward to trying this spot, after seeing signage outside the building for the better part of a year. Stopped by for a late weekend lunch and enjoyed the food, not too impressed with the service, though.

We were promptly greeted by our server and placed our drink orders, and we then decided on a couple oyster po' boys, and hush puppies for an appetizer. That brings up our first issue with the service - less than 5 minutes passed between being served our appetizer and meal. Either the kitchen needs to learn how to time their service, or the server needs to learn how to put in her orders. 

Hush puppies were good, but I wasn't a huge fan of being given melted butter to dip them in. A remoulade, or even tartar sauce would be a better pairing, in my opinion - or give diners a choice!

The po' boys were excellent. They were stuffed with oysters, with a little lettuce and onion. The spicy mayo was great as well. Fries were good.

During the course of our meal, the server stopped by to ask us how our food was. We replied good, and I had hoped she would have noticed my almost-empty iced tea...she didn't. The next time she walked by, my glass was empty, but she didn't stop. I wasn't going to yell after her, so I was out of luck.

We'll probably be back to try an actual steamer basket meal, and make a final decision on future visits at that point.

Great restaurant! This was my first time visiting Boise, and having Celiac Disease can make it hard to travel. However, Le Peep has amazing gluten free options. I felt completely safe, the food was delicious, the staff were friendly, and I was able to try my first ever Eggs Benedict. Yum! Needless to say, I will definitely stop by Le Peep again.
They are very professional and knowledgeable.  I highly recommend them and will continue to support their business.
Food line was not clean or wiped down. Food was cross contaminated with different foods in each bucket of food. If I want sour cream, I don't expect salsa to be in it. I understand busy but come on!

This is our new favorite place! The food was flavorful and the service was amazing, very friendly. Other places over or under cook the corn and potatoes, but not Hook & Reel. The corn we had was delicious and potatoes were perfectly soft.

Never again at this location.

I called two weeks in advance for a reservation for 10-15 people. I called 4 hours in advance to confirm and place our order.

The problems started with the tiny parking lot, forcing us to park 2 or 3 businesses over (which I'm sure those businesses didn't appreciate, either.)

Inside we were seated at two booths with backs to each other. (You think with a two-week notice they would have saved us a long table.) We sat for a while before someone came over and said we'd need to order beverages at the counter, so we had to wait in a slow line to do that.  

The pizzas came out 15-20 minutes later than promised, and the salads we ordered came out another 15-20 minutes after that. It was another 10 minutes before we had dressing, which didn't really matter because they were out of forks. "All our forks are being used right now." They said they were washing some, but couldn't tell me if that would take 10 minutes or 30 minutes. I finally flagged down someone in the kitchen to give us plastic forks, and we received enough for 8/10 people to eat salad.

And that sums up our experience. I don't know if this location is poorly managed or understaffed or what, but it was absolutely not what I have come to expect from Flying Pie.

Great gun shop, I dropped in to browse around and found the staff to be very friendly and welcoming....turns out one of their specialties is 10/22 rifles.  Well, Ive been working on a 10/22 and having a few issues.  The owner, Dan along with some of the other guys there inspected my rifle and gave me a lot of very valuable information regarding the operation of this model , as well as some things to try before shelling out $$$ on components.  Based on their recommendations mu rifle is currently working a lot better... definitely on the right path.  Their integrity in dealing with this issue  says a lot about their character... a lot of good.  They'll still get my $$$, probably a lot more of it in the end since I know I can trust their advice and buy with confidence!

My kid was on the hunt for a skateboard. I have no knowledge about skateboards. So I used Google to find skateboard shops around me. It give me like 3 options and we choose to go here. I must say the experience was good. I wish I had gotten the name of the gentleman who helped my daughter. He broke it down to her on what board is what and the level of experience my child has. He helped her find the right skateboard for her level of experience and comfort.  She was very excited to get her 1st skateboard and it happened to be a long board to help her get comfortable riding and when she gets the skill down she can move on to the other type of skateboard to start doing tricks and such.  I was very satisfied with the service.

Worst customer service in the valley. We called to get reservations and they said it was first come first serve. We arrived and half of the tables were reserved. We asked the person at the register and he just shrugged and stated he would ask the manager. When we spoke with the manager he said they do reserve tables on certain days, and we must have been misinformed and walked off. The best thing about this is there are several other great pizza places as well as other restaurants to eat at, so we never have to go back.

For any of you that want to have better pizza and customer service, try Flat Bread Pizza on Linder and Chinden or Idaho Pizza.

Very rarely do I get my parents to eat fast food.  Today is the day I talk them into Chipotle.   NEVER AGAIN!   I ordered online and my parents went to pick-up the food.  Please note 30 minute drive one way.  Let the folks know the food will be ready at 12:30pm.   They arrive back at 1pm.  I took one look immediately and knew the order was WRONG!  Over half the order was missing.  My mother commented the young lady stated everything was there.  NOPE!!  NO QUALITY ASSURANCE!   This time I had finished Dialysis, so I grab my receipt and drove back.  30 minutes drive back.  I get there AND no one is out side.  FYI before starting the drive back, I tried calling three times.  Did anyone ever answer?!?!   NO  Hey guess what, NO CUSTOMER SERVICE!!! I thought at least I would call giving them heads up, that was it would be ready and I wouldn't have to wait.  Get there, people are waiting out side.  No one to help.  Then this young lady comes out, I tell her what happened.   Again, waiting...  She hands me a bag.  Still not complete.  I'm waiting once again.  I complain about having to wait, I complain about no answer, AND THIS PISS ANT, goes, she doesn't answer the phones, and that I should have sent an email.   If they didn't answer their phone, why should I believe they would actually answer an email and have food ready.  Now that is a funny joke! No sh!t Sherlock!  NO ONE ANSWERED THE PHONE!!!  AND the 30 minute drive home.  UNBELIEVABLE!!!  I have never had such horrible, Customer Service and 70% of the meal missing.  I loved Chipotle, but I will never again.

Tried to leave customer service a note....  Guess what,  unable to leave a note one their customer service.

We saw this from our table at The Yardhouse and were drawn to it because it seemed like a fun atmosphere & seemed to have candies that I grew up with as a child.  We walked around the store really pleased with the selection UNTIL we came upon some "adult" type products.  I was really bothered that they had things in that corner that should not be available for children to see.  They also had some Anti-Trump toilet paper.  We didn't go in looking for politics and there really isn't a need for this in a candy store.  If you're going to sell that kind of stuff, have the decency to shelve it where children won't see it.  We weren't impressed and left immediately without buying anything.  I've been to a great candy store in Scottsdale Arizona and one in Billings Montana and we didn't see anything questionable in either.
Love the food just like Hawaii. Couldn't get more real. Great sauce. Great service. Always good

It's with a full stomach and heart that I share my experience at Hook and Reel.... I was thrilled with the authentic cajun flavor and variety of food. If this is your first experience with real cajun seafood then erase all expectations and just enjoy. I expected a few small issues knowing that they've only been open a short time. Our service was awesome and the food was perfectly delicious. I want to know where they found a cook in Idaho who can make perfect cajun seafood. 

I will be back, often.
Wonderful breakfast and the service was just as amazing. I would definitely recommend this place. Not expensive at all either. Very clean inside.

Brandy and staff are fantastic.
We scheduled a move in clean that was desperately needed for a home we had just purchased in Nampa.

Top to bottom, inside and out, everything was cleaned spotless.

Great communication, professional and incredibly easy to work with.

This place is in a spot that doesn't seem like a restaurant but more like a store so or industrial feel. The food was good it is geared toward being healthy so no hearty heavy country style here although you can get things like pancakes and biscuits and gravy it will just be on the lighter side but still very tasty.  Kind of chilly bring a sweater .. concrete floors.

Not sure how I missed this for so long, but of the 3 locations, this one is definitely the king of the heap. Awesome layout, very impressive selection and knowledgeable staff makes it a pleasure to check out. You probably won't be able to whip through this and it is a touch hidden from the road, but it's well worth the effort to ferret it out. Like the other locations, there's not a ton of mass market stuff here, but there is some cheap. Clearly, they mean to leave the import junk to the larger outlets and concentrate on more unique offerings so if that's what you're after - or are just a fan of toy stores in general - this is the place.
Go to Joe Momma's instead! Way better food. Way better owner there. Le Pee owner is rude to the servers and treats them badly. We've seen it first hand.

I think it speaks volumes that a pizza place that has a lunch buffet & not 1 person shows up. However, when the pizza buffet consists of 1 pepperoni pizza that taste the same as an elementary school cafeteria pizza I see why nobody comes.

I had a terrible experience on November 21st at about 3:15pm. There was an employee working that was obviously sick and dripping snot while serving food. She was wiping her snot on her arm and wiping it on her pants while making food. I proceeded with making my order and paying for it so I didn't embarrass anybody. I then called the health department because that is against health code to have someone with bodily fluids serving food. I then called the manager and explain what happened and asked to refund my order. She said that was fine, apologized and said to come in and get the money back. Today, November 26th, I went back and a different manager was rude and disrespectful to me. She talked to me like I was stupid and it was surprising since I had already had a negative experience that she was making worse. She looked at me annoyingly like I was an inconvenience to her. She then told me I needed to come back later since I had shown up a little before they opened. They have made me so disgusted with this entire situation that I don't ever want to come back and I eat Chipotle daily so they've now lost a DAILY customer over something I had no control over. I am a loyal customer and the disrespect I've experienced here is appalling. Save yourself the time and go somewhere else.

Amazing!!! I walked in thinking this fix would cost a minimum of $75. The manger fixed the issue (damaged charge port) and didn't even charge me for it. Amazing customer service.. the best that I've seen in a long time. I will recommend everyone to come here.

Just tried this place after hearing great things, and I have to say I was pretty disappointed. We ordered the eggs benedict and monte cristo crepe, both of which were okay, but definitely not great. Both dishes were fairly salty and lackluster. The homestyle potatoes were not good either. Before this, I've never had bad homestyle potatoes but apparently they exist. The pancakes are good though. 

The service was shoddy at best. We came in half an hour before closing, and our server came to us immediately and said we needed to order now because the kitchen was closing in a minute. Not a particularly welcoming feel there... She only came back once after that and handed us the check and a box because apparently she would "be in the back for the rest of the shift". We then brought our check to the front to pay and the guy up there says he just clocked out so someone else would have to help us. Heaven forbid he do a minute of work off the clock.

Overall the food was okay but not great, and the service seemed neither professional nor customer-oriented. Definitely not the worst service I've ever gotten, but I am not impressed.

I honestly wish I didnt have to give a start at all, This is my second time writting a review because apparently my first one got deleted, to put it simple: DO NOT RENT from this place, I had a 9 month lease and had nothing but trouble with park place the entire time.
   For pretty much every issue that came up I would have to drive to Meridian because phone calls and emails were never returned, and then when I would go in person there was a new receptionist every time who had no idea what she was doing just like the rest of the property managers. One time they tried telling me my rent was over a thousand dollars and then blamed it on a "system glitch" (which later turned out to be the exscuse for the million of other problems that came up.) For instance my boyfriend and I would always round up our rent to $800.00 so we would just pay an even $400 each, which means a credit should have been posted for the next month but park place continued to zero out our balance, when we confronted our property manager on this she had emailed us our transaction history which was different then the one we had printed out the first time showing their mistakes HA! Kelly our property manager was nothing but rude and unproffessional to the both of us, she also could never come out behind her desk to speak to us and had the receptionist be her messanger every time we had come in.
    The first time of having a bad encounter with her I let it pass, the second time I thought maybe she was having a bad day? I understand having a busy and stressful job, but the third time of not having a phone call or email responded to and then having a snobby and condescending attitude towards the residents? NOT OKAY. Our house was listed with "AC" which we then found out was a box you put in through a window that barley worked, when we moved in the backyard was covered with dog feces, The paint and molding looked like it was done in 20 minutes,there was exposed wires in various places around our house, and we had a MAJOR ant problem now this is all stuff we fixed and dealt with because they sure weren't going to do anything about it. Maintence did fix our leaky sink TWICE and fixed the telephone jacks so our internet would work (yes it is true we didnt even have phone jacks) and they were actually really nice guys, they didn't ever have us sign anything so that was kind of weird, BUT the main point I am trying to get across is this company does not care about their residents! I only wish the owners of the properties knew what a terrible job they do.
   I could go on and on with the problems i encountered (they were all in my first review which dissapeared) but i do not have the time today. because I am in the process of MOVING thank god my lease is up on the 31st and if we do not get our deposit back (which was WAY too much but we were desperate in finding a place at the time as quick as possible) you can count on them being taken to small claims because we are leaving the place in better condition than when we moved in. & If you do decide to go through park place make sure you read your lease at least 5 times so you notice how many times they contradict themselves oh and that pretty much nothing is considered "normal wear and tear." with them. & as for you park place, take a course on customer service because you clearly don't know what it means. I was beginning to think maybe things would have been better if we had a different property manager, that was until I read other reviews for PPPM on different sites, and Im pretty sure 90% of the good reviews they write themselves, how pathetic:)

Excellent food, every time I've had it. Whether it's spicy or not, you're guaranteed to get your money's worth if you are a TRUE lover of seafood. The scallops, the crab, the oysters, etc, they are all epic in flavor and come in incredible portions. I've never visited the restaurant, and I plan to, but when I think seafood, I think Hook & Reel. Thank you for your service and tremendous cuisine.

Excellent service! I have used safelite for years...after reading some not so good reviews I thought I'd give Glass Doctor a try. I will never use safelite again. Glass doctor did an awesome job. My kids and I dropped our vehicle off and walked to sunrise cafe for a yummy breakfast and by the time we returned our vehicle was done. Highly recommend.
Just had the peppermint bark ice cream and it was out of this world!!! Hope they decide to carry it year-round.  The hot chocolate, chocolate bombs were a hit.  Hope they keep them around all winter.

My Friend and I were Their this past Monday And it was our first time their and it won't be the last !
The Service was great our waitress and all the staff including the Kitchen staff were SO friendly it made us fell like we're with friends.
The food was very good nice and hot , good portions and served in a timely manor.
The Coffee kept coming without us needing to ask for more.
And the place was Super Clean & SANITIZED and their restrooms were immaculate.
Appreciate their hard work in keeping us Customer's safe .
Everyone Should try this place .
This place was so great!! Only wish we had one in Salt Lake City!! We had shrimp, clams muscles, oysters, sausage... YUM YUM YUM so much food, such a great value!
Really bad catfish basket. Terrible flavor and over deep fried. Sweet potatoes fries were rubbery. Shrimp basket was good. Eight good sized shrimp properly deep fried. Probably won't return.

Ehhh ... Wanted to like this place. Where to start?  Really small Portions, like half a sandwich bread size. Like, when I was in 5Th grade my mom packed a larger sandwich for me. Price? Really expensive for a very small sandwich.  Bread, hard and dry. Turkey?  The same. Why 2 stars? The service was nice. For the money Kneaders is a better bet.
While I enjoyed the convenience of The Joint I signed up for a 6 month plan. When I tried to cancel they told me there was no refunds. I will not be returning.

(This review for my wife's experience)

She says:

I have been going here for years since I started working at the Fred Meyer in the same complex. Many of my fellow employees have left expensive hairdressers because they have seen co-workers come back from HairMasters and couldn't believe the quality of their cut. I went in today to get a dramatic makeover and got exactly what I was looking for. Surprised about the two poor reviews for this store, I have had nothing but great experiences, and great people there too.

What do I love about Rise Volleyball Academy? 

1. This was the first club I played for where I felt the coaches cared about me far beyond just an athlete or player.  

2. Everyday the atmosphere in the gym was highly competitive. 

3. By the way the practice is set up, each player gets a lot of touches allowing them to improve their skill. 

4. This club prides themself on not just making great athletes but also great people and that is not something you see in other clubs in the Treasure Valley. 

5. Steve

Rise Volleyball Academy was one of the best volleyball experiences I encountered in high school!  I highly recommend to any girls looking for a club to play for!

Incredible service and extremely knowledgeable!!!! Our sound went out on our Samsung. We made a call to Camden TV and were advised to check a couple of possibilities. Magic!!!!! The sound was restored in the course of a few minutes of over the phone diagnostics and advice. No service call needed....and a loyal customer gained for all future needs!
I made an inquiry on Yelp and Brandy was quick to respond to my request. I needed someone to clean my vacation rental and her company has done a terrific job keeping the place sparking clean!

As someone who dislikes going to the dentist, it's important to me to find a caring dental team. That's exactly what I found here, and I will always recommend my friends and family to come see Dr.Andrea. I felt like everyone in the office truly cared about the patients and weren't concerned with up selling.

I've been looking for a place with some good Island food and finally found it. Food was wonderful and plentiful. The Teri sauce was legit and really made the food pop. I had the Katsu chicken plate and my wife the combo plate. We found a new favorite and will be going back often.

If your moving out you probably won't get your deposit back. Don't worry about cleaning the place because they will clean it and charge you anyway. We left it better than it was when we moved in, but we rented it as is. Don't do that. Whatever you do don't move out early and believe they got your back, they don't. Bad move on our part. Property management companies are all the same, self serving.

Me and my friend went here because everyone was going here and it looked very good from the photos, although don't let the photos for you because it actually taste really disgusting and it's all thrown together in a little box and it looks really nasty. 

Looks can be deceiving though so we tried it and every single chicken dish tasted like fish, slimy, and very crunchy. I got the "favorite meal" and not only did I not eat the chicken because it was disgusting. I also didn't eat the Mac salad because it tasted like rotten mayonnaise and it was so overwhelming. We even got the Pog drink and it tasted like water, the only thing good about this meal was the rice which I can get from panda express for like two dollars. I will not be returning here because it was disgusting and not worth any of the hype it's getting!

Wow, just moved her from Las Vegas and stop in to enjoy lunch with my daughter and it was a terrific meal. The line was out the door and now i see why because the food is delicious.  The line coach, tall young man name Daniel was friendly,  fast  and knowledgeable about the items. So, thanks for the recommendations and I'm a 
customer for life.

Breakfast and lunch only are served here. Haven't been in years, used to be one of the best breakfasts around. The food is decent, servings are quite large, service is very good, pleasant wait staff. The average breakfast was about 12.00,  food was just ok. I had omelette, hash browns and toast, felt it was overpriced, nothing fancy.
Came in at 830pm on 11/16 and had a great experience. From the way I was greeted, helped, and food was delicious!! Thank you staff!

I wish I could not even give one star. These people suck. Worst management company I have ever rented from I don't care what reply gets back to this from them. All I have to say is save yourself the head ache and don't rent from them.

My family and I have gone to this location three times in the last few months (thanks to a groupon that had to be used multiple times). Every time we have went in to this location it is dirty and out of a few of the flavors. I don't understand how an owner could let their workers get away with not wiping off the machines, counters and tables. It seems like they only hire teenagers who usually have their friends in with them. It's not been busy when we have been in so there should be plenty of time to wipe things down. 

We will let our last group in expire without using it. I think Aspen Leaf has our money from now on.

I used Dream Clean's move in cleaning service and was absolutely thrilled. They were very professional and friendly. The house was quite dirty after the last owners moved out. The cleaning far exceeded my expectations in fact they were so good, that I will be using them regularly as my maid service. They really made a stressful time for me much easier. Thank you to the crew.

My little yorkie is very picky where she's goes and I was very happy to see how happy she is every time I pick her up. Nice place and does a great job! Keep it up and thanks you for making Bella feel comfortable there!

During a first visit, chose the burger menu.  The Rueben Burger is big on flavor and quality.  Big hamburger patty (6 oz. hand pressed) and then a thick layer of corned beef.  It is topped off with sauerkraut, Swiss cheese and 1000 island dressing.  This wedged into a big brioche bun.  It was a good choice and causes me to plan a return visit for such intriguing options as an Elwood Blues or Ham O'Neer burgers.  With a side of tots, this meal was a real keeper.  Strongly encourage folks to try Pauly's.

THEY DO NOT DO CUSTOM!
First, the quality it good. The ingredients and dough are awesome (Best gluten free for delivery), but every time, EVERY TIME, I try to customize one of their pizzas (add or remove ingredients) they mess it up. This is especially frustrating since there a food allergies in my home. Tonight, he even repeated the order back and messed it up! 
Their prices are also higher than most places. If Flying Pie had Gluten free crust, I would never order here again.

Always great food and excellent service! Anytime I order takeout or to-go it is packed nicely. This is one of my husband and I's favorite takeout spots! The staff is always super friendly. Highly recommend!

Good food at a good price. I got the Teriyaki steak and Kalua pork with rice and macaroni salad. The lady checking me out was really friendly and service was quick when placing my order to go. The only reason I'm giving them 4 stars is I found a piece of bone in my food that was pretty decent sized.

This spot is terrible!  Food was delivered 25 minutes late, ice-cold, direct our complaint to their customer service line located in the Philippines which manager refused to get on the phone.  Still trying to get a hold of the location on the number provided but so far after 10 minutes no one is answering.  Just a joke of a company and especially the management, staff, and food.

Update:  Meridian, ID location still has not answered the phone after 45 minutes of trying.  Went to their Facebook and Google pages...so far no response!  Complete joke of a Company!

I came in last night with the most ridiculous problem in the world. "Abnormal Wear" is the devil and Mike and Sean are The Inquisition. They were so helpful and really went the extra mile to help me out. Seriously, go see Mike and Sean, they'll help you figure out where your life went wrong and get you back on the road to happy destiny.

Truffles Etc.

On 7/31/21, I visited Truffles Etc. In Meridian. It is a cute store, full of local art, that sells handmade Truffles and ice cream. I didn't buy anything but I tried 4 ice cream samples: Honey Vanilla, Bourbon Pecan, Cherry Cordial and Jan's Delight. They were good. 

One of my friends ordered a scoop of Jan's Delight ice cream, which is cardamom and marzipan soaked cake. She enjoyed it but thought the cardamom was a bit strong. Then she got a bite of the marzipan and thought that was a little strong too. All I could taste in my sample was the cardamom. 

My other friend bought a caramel. She thought it was a bit stale due to the texture of the caramel. 

I intend to go back at some point and try a scoop of ice cream. The reason I didn't get a scoop then it's because I couldn't find a flavor that I liked well enough and they don't do scoops of two different flavors.

In all fairness, the problem was mine, but I would like to warn others who are VIP members to closely read what A-1 will and won't cover.  It had been several years ago that I purchased my service contract, and for some reason I thought it covered a service call if I had a problem.  Wrong.  They came out today.  My issue was very minor.   It took him 1 minute to figure it out.  I am a widow who is not mechanically inclined at all.  I would have first asked my son or a friend to look at my problem if I dreamed it would have cost $84 to have A-1 come out.  I am not blaming anyone but myself, but just wanted to give other VIP members a heads up.  The expensive "insurance" that we pay for to be VIP members is really rather limited.

Man, the holidays sure have been busy! If you live here in Boise, you know these past two weeks have been decimating our cul-de-sacs with snow. Well, for those of you stuck inside today, stay warm! For those who still find the drive to get out there and shovel some pepperoni-and-cheese bread in your face, we might have a recommendation...

PizzaKen was the one to inform me of Garbonzo's, which he seemed to discover at their Ustick location in Meridian. I've since discovered that they have a few other locations, including one on Lake Hazel a bit closer to Boise, as well as Caldwell, Middleton, and New Plymouth locations. Quite the impressive franchise! Yet, I'd never heard about it growing up here.

So is it a hidden paradise of pizza? Or is there a reason you haven't heard the name?

Well, the interior of this particular location was cozy. At the counter, you can see all the pizza-making action happening. Similar to Santora's. It was impressive to see them hand-tossing the dough. We asked what's good and ended up going with a pie that included bbq sauce and chicken, and a pepperoni (of course).

It took less than 20 minutes to arrive, and the staff were very friendly to talk to. And so:

-The BBQ Chicken-
Nice. You gotta love the sweet taste of a good bbq sauce, and the juicy chicken and crunchy onions. It reminded me of what we had with Chicago Connection, except that this time everything was done right.

-The Pepperoni-
Solid pizza all around. Nothing stuck out to me, although their crust was really light and golden. Probably comes from that hand-tossed care.

-The Verdict-
Garbonzo's is good. As far as we could tell, though, they didn't do much to stand too far apart from the crowd. However, they offer their pizza at an affordable price. A large pizza is gonna hit you for about $20, which is a bit on the cheaper end. The friendly staff and small, local atmosphere might be unique to Meridian's location, but it's definitely a happy plus. Families are welcome here, and if you're near the area I'd recommend them over any other nearby chain.

3 slices out of 5
Get your shit together. Apple Maps says you accept Apple Pay, you don't. They also arnt accepting cash. I'm fucking done with this place.

We had high hopes for this establishment. Since they are newly opened we expected some issues with staff and yes we encountered that. However if the food was spot on then we would definitely be back for a second chance. 

Our server was poorly trained and really did not have any idea how to properly serve her customers. We basically had to ask for everything. 
She did not explain the menu or the process well to us and though we tried to ask the right questions it was a miss. 

When the food was delivered we were surprised to see it in a plastic bag. We ordered shrimp, crawfish, and scallops. The crawfish are small and lacking any meat. The scallops were likewise small and completely overcooked. The shrimp were slightly better. We sampled all the sauces offered and nothing really stood out as spectacular to our party of four. We ordered a side of Cajun fries and even those fell short.

In the end we all agreed this was not something we would like to try again.

In town visiting from Pittsburgh and my brother wanted to go to lunch with us. We saw Mo Bettahs on Yelp and wanted to give it a try. We like a good Hawaiian dish every now and again and this place did not disappoint. My husband and I each got the smaller size plate and it was still more than enough food for us. I really enjoyed the pulehu pork and the teriyaki chicken, as well as the mac salad and sauces. Restaurant was clean, service was friendly.

Their menu are unique and plentiful.  I've been here before and was always happy with whatever I chose.  Their coffee is delicious.  Today I ordered crepes with spinach, mushrooms, artichokes, chicken and Brie.  This was my first disappointing meal.  The crepes were not crepes.  They were super flat eggs.  I don't like eggs very much, but do love crepes.  So if you like crepes, make sure you ask what they mean by crepes here so you're not disappointed when they come out exactly like super thin crispy omelettes.
I got hush puppies and a fried fish poor boy. Both were great. If the server had not pulled her mask down to her chin I would not of had a complaint.  I think eating carry out is over for me.

I'm really surprised by all the negative reviews of this company.  I've rented 3 different homes from ProCore over the years until I purchase my own home.  I'm now in the market for a new rental since selling my home.  
ProCore recently advertised a nice townhome in which I jumped on immediately Saturday morning, sent in my credit fee and my application.  During the weekend, I did find another place that I was more interested in and rented that place instead.  ProCore contacted me first thing Monday morning to process my application to which I told them never mind, I already found something else.  Today, 2 days later, the 30 dollar fee was back in my checking account.  I give a shout out to this because there were 3 other property management companies that took my money, didn't run my credit and rented to someone who was ahead of me and I never received a refund.  Nice way to make a few extra dollars, bad business!
Anyway, the previous homes I have rented from ProCore were clean and if there were ever any problems after moving in, ProCore was on it immediately.  I always received my deposit back, less what I owed, in a timely manner.  The communication was outstanding and Katie, Richard and their crew are just amazing to work with.
If I ever looked at a rental that had problems, such as odors or tattered carpet, or just in shambles, I would think it would be my choice whether to rent from them or not and can't see where that is ProCore's fault.
Anyway, amazing company!  They are definitely my go to company first for any rentals!!
This 5 star review is more for one employee there. I hope management sers this but Mickey went above and took care of me even though im thecone that messed up
Great food, outstanding service with a fun upbeat atmosphere what more do you need ... LOVE this place

Wow I just was told to wait 20-30 min which we did and then we were seated at the booth that was available the whole wait which we asked about the booth and she wouldn't sit us i well
Not be returning with this BS

Celebrated my birthday here last night. Very pleased with our dining experience! Our hostess told us Jenny would be our server. Jenny did an outstanding job making us feel welcomed, helped us make informed decisions on the menu, and made us feel special. We chose the reel special sauce and it was delicious. We had calamari appetizer, scallops, shrimp, craw fish, potatoes, corn, cheesecake, and drinks. We were very impressed with everything except the corn. It was over boiled. Jenny's service is the reason we will be back and the cleanliness of the establishment. There are protective glass between the booths, servers were wearing masks and gloves. Floors and tables were spotless clean. Taking covid seriously. Highly recommend Hook N Reel place if you like Cajun seafood.
It's just alright. If you don't want to wait 45 minutes elsewhere, this isn't a bad spot in a pinch.

I have been here before and it was good. My most recent time was AWFUL. The food is absolutely disgusting. I spent a little over 60$ for shells. There was no meat on seafood and if there was it tasted rotten and way to soggy. I don't know if their cooks have no idea what their doing but it was a waste of money. I have never gone out to dinner and walked away from an entire plate of food but today i did. Our server was great and super kind but i will NEVER come back and advise you too not waste your money, go somewhere else!!!!
The Joint is awesome! They always remember my name and make me feel so welcome. Everyone is fast, friendly and efficient! I will never go anywhere else for chiropractic care.

Hailey, was very thoughtful of our animals and she was a pleasure to work with. 
Thank you

I had been having trouble with my cars electrical charging system for 18-22 months. Had taken it to the dealership, and they said it was fixed, but it wasn't.  The crew here had it analyzed and repaired in under 5 minutes. So cheerful too!!!! Zack and Fabian are so pleasant and honest, and make it a rewarding  business experience.

Snuck in for a lovely breakfast. It was a delicious breakfast with normal menu items to select from. I ordered a pumpkin latte with almond milk and it was great. I recommend calling ahead to add your name to cut down on wait time at the restaurant. Otherwise the wait can be pretty long. Which is why we haven't been there yet. Great atmosphere and nice staff. Our waitress was very good and didn't miss a beat even though a side order didn't make it with the meal. She handled promptly after we mentioned it.
I loved the vibe here. The deja brew and chia tea are both suburb! The Benny came out cold but was still yummy. I really liked their specialty bowl. The gravy is the best part!

The lady on the phone said she could send us a coupon for a free pick two, which we paid for in the first place. What a JOKE!

Like most reviews the price is a little high.   I don't mind the price if I can see a difference in the food or service but this was not the case here.   Had the buffalo finger steaks.    A little chewy which I guess can be the buffalo, but my big issue is They came out near room temp and the breading had no texture like they have been out for a while.   Others had the buffalo burger and they noted the burger was almost cold and the fries were defiantly room temp.  Serving old fries is a huge problem in my book. Nothing great about the food, shrimp was rubbery and not fresh, crab had hardly any meat, soup was salty and the staff visited the table on multiple occasions asking about our experience.

Ordered online. Was told one hour. Arrived to get my pizza and was told 30 more minutes. Ok, pizza is good not great. Service sucked. Should have ordered Dominos and had my pizza on time.   Being short staffed tells ownership maybe you need to change some things so you don't lose your order online customers as well.
Food was decent but service lousy.  If my empty pint glass was a snake the owner and waitress would have got bit 20 times before it occurred to them I might want another beer.

Today my wife, daughter, and I decided to go here for breakfast.  My wife had read some reviews and they were positive.  As we approached, I realized I had driven past this place hundreds of times.  It isn't very big, so it is easy to miss.

We went inside and were greeted by very friendly staff and were immediately seated.  Our waitress, was Aneta, and she gave us great service.  Our daughter ordered eggs Benedict, my wife had the veggie skillet, and I had the meat lovers skillet.  All of us loved our breakfast.  The food was fresh, cooked just right, and we never had to ask for refills of coffee or water.  

The portions were good, and the prices were very reasonable.  My wife wants to go back and try their hamburgers for lunch.  This is a small place, and easy to pass by, but if you are ever in Meridian, and hungry for breakfast, stop here it is really good.

I was only in town 4 days visiting my husband's mom and we decided to try this place on the second day as it advertised vegan desserts. I am allergic to dairy so I asked the woman working there which ones I could choose from and she said "none of them have dairy".  What?! I've never had so many choices in my life. The first day I got the turtle cinnamon roll, and my husband got the smores one. It was so good we went back the next day and the morning of our last day before we headed home. In all we tried 5 flavors (Bananas foster being my favorite), as well as the cookie, the brownie and the cookie dough. Superb! I got the peanut butter cups for my dad and after having one, he's refusing to share. I'll definitely come back here if I'm in town again.

Ice cream was great! Food was amazing! The only reason I'm not giving it a four star is because my milkshake flavored Oreo has almost no Oreos!
Great food! Awesome prices! Their crepe are the best I have had in a long time! Great service! I will recommend to everyone!
we love this place! great pizza options and they pour a good sized glass of wine. :)  good music and lots of veggie options for the pizza! Will definitely go back .

Great food and atmosphere.. Friendly
Neighborhood Bar
Pauly is great .. we giggled recommend the food is Bomb!!!!

Second time buying a 1/4 beef from here. I can't say enough. Perfect service and fast turnaround. Ordered it on Monday and got it on Thursday. I couldn't ask for anymore. The meat is fantastic better than any butcher I have ever been to. Would have paid double. Thank you so much. This is the only butcher I would ever buy from.

I have been using them for 11 months in a new housing track where I was concerned about bugs and rodents. Their taxes are always friendly and very professional and explain each treatment that they are going to do and let me know when they're finished. I would highly recommend them for your bug rodent needs

I have loved everything I've tried here! Their coffee is so good - cold or hot. And they have really good pasties that taste fresh & homemade. Today I tried a sugar free pumpkin spice latte. I didn't even know sugar free PSL existed! So good! The people that work here are so friendly, the inside is nice with lots of seating & tables, and they have free wifi. Make sure you get the punch card - after 10 coffees, you get one free!

The price you pay for the small portions is not worth the effort of waiting in line for this place. I'm pretty sure my potatoes were either from one small red potato or they cut and plate a quarter of one regular size one. I don't normally complain about portions but it was the $10-$14 you pay for those portions. They are trying to make up for the location cost of the rent I guess. There are way to many places in Boise And Meridian that have better food at a better price for me to ever want to wait 30-45 minutes to eat here again.

These guys went above and beyond to try and fix a weird problem for us related to a memory device. They brought in their own personal gear to diagnose the issue and tried everything. We were kept informed throughout both in terms of price and time to fix. We didn't go through with the repairs after all but would definitely go back for other services.

My wife, mother, daughter and I were very well treated and fed at your new Meridian location. We shared around all of our meals and each one tasted great, your biscuits and gravy excelled, I ordered a breakfast burrito that filled me up and was flavorful. My wife had to put most of her BLT in a take home because it was so large, made a great snack later. The omelet my mother ordered was yummy. The hand squeezed orange juice had to be the best that I have had. 
As we live in Nampa please hurry and build one there!
Thanks for a great morning.

It used to be that Chiptole was a good spot  for those with a vegetarian or vegan lifestyle. While it's still true, the quality is severely lacking. Our last couple of visits to this location have been sub-par and that's being friendly. 

The employees simply are not familiar with the differences between Vegan, Plant Based, and Vegetarian. 

A little bit of training would go a long way.  Here's how they should be trained 

1- Hi Welcome to Chipotle. No Meat No problem? Are you following a dairy-free, vegetarian, or vegan lifestyle? No worries, I know the differences. 

Then all the dumb questions about cheese, sour cream and meat would be obvious. 

It's not hard. 


Let's go over the quality of the ingredients and the quantity as well.

I typically start my order with the brown rice then order either black or pinto beans, both beans had the crust along the edges of the plan and then I  order the Sofritas crumbles.  They looked old and I am rarely at Chipotle when they are made fresh.  Next comes the salsa. They had the pico de gallo and the corn / mango salsa.  Of course, I didn't want Sour Cream or Cheese but I wanted to share Guacamole portion with my wife who was next in line.  In the past, about 6-8 months ago, my bowl would be as large as the USS Reagan Aircraft Carrier, but lately the portions for my bowl are smaller than a US Coast Guard Cutter. Not sure why, but it is what it is.  The kids behind the counter don't have any leadership and the manager does not have any synergy with the younger kids. Perhaps he's not the manager as he's dressed like the regular employees but there's a lot that is missing.  Two bowls and one burrito for our daughter was $23.00. Yikes.   We'll pass. We're not picky people, but we shouldn't be penalized and charged more for eating less.  

Here's what Chipotle should do.

(1). Train the employees for those customers who have special dietary needs. 
(2) Create synergy between management and employees and empower the employees to take care of the customers. 
(3) Be consistent in your servings and prices.
(4) Don't charge Steak & Lobster prices for someone who orders a salad. Do you really want to lose those customers?
(5) This location is always icy cold. That's why we always take our order to go but since this will be the last time, it's not our problem any more. So, future customers, bring a jacket and a blanket.

Good luck Chipotle. You lost three customers and we don't even eat the meat which has been a problem for you.

Very shady up-selling. My wife dropped a tire off at Rogers Tire Pro's, to get a screw removed and patched. Puncture was within the tread no where near the sidewall. Lady called my wife after an hour and half to tel her the tire was "unfixable" and that we would need to buy a new tire. Take it down the road to @LesSchwab and they had the tire patched and taken care of in 10 minutes. Lesson, go to LesSchwab first next time. I am back! Had breakfast at "Le Peep" restaurant yesterday with family. This is a chain restaurant that serves breakfast, brunch and lunch. This particular restaurant is located in Meridian, Idaho. We had great service and there is a great variety of meals on the menu! I chose the breakfast burrito and it was delicious. The pork green chili sauce, cheese, onions and refried beans on the outside gave it even more flavor. My burrito was stuffed with scrambled eggs, potatoes and my favorite meat, chorizo. Delicious and unable to eat it all. I will absolutely return to try more meals. Next time I walk through the restaurant I will point at the meals people are enjoying and ask them "You Gonna Eat That"? If not I will! Give them a try sometime. Check out my restaurant review Facebook page at - (Brogar's - "You Gonna Eat That"?)
Great food.  Very friendly staff.  Love the Hawaiian vibe.  Makes me miss the islands.  Will definitely go there again.  I had the the item with all 3 meats,  a lot of food.

Selway has been a temporary home while I purchased my new home. It has been a clean and quiet place. I have lived in a lot of apartments and overall this has been the best I've lived at. Staff is consistent on making sure things stay tidy. Some residents don't seem to care about making sure their dogs are on leash or picking up after them. This will soon change since Selway soon will have poo prints and help eliminate this issue. I would recommend this place! Thank you Selway staff for taking care of things!

The staff and management at this location are the most maladroit and inept team of people I have ever run into. A simple order for one cheese burger turned into a total failure. I was repeatedly given the wrong items, then the wrong receipt.... I made it clear at that point I didn't trust their service and just wanted a refund and cancel my order. They credited back someone else's order, you're welcome... I didn't catch this until I left the location. I had to turn around - go in and track down a manager to get it fixed. Super glad I found this place! My stylist, Megan, is really friendly and does an awesome job. The pricing is reasonable and the space is comfortable and inviting. I'll definitely be back.
Jim is always kind and courteous and he provides wonderful service! Thank you for being a great company to do business with!
Ymmmmmm,  Plus great service. The garlic is killer they give you tons. Definitely if your garlic lover come And try it!!!!!! The snow crab Was awesome!!

To start off, I have eaten flying pie multiple times, through delivery, take out, and dine in. Due to having moved out of their delivery range a little over two years ago we started doing take-out much more frequently. The taste of everything is great. My complaints are regarding the phone and in-store customer service. 

When trying to call in an order I usually have to call several times before anybody even picks up. It doesn't matter what night of the week it is. The day after Christmas I called around five times and never got one answer. It was on my way home from work so I stopped in to place the to-go order. With the girl that took my order, I let her know I called numerous times and no answered; and her only response was "yeah we were too busy to answer the phone." Sad customer service. For the price of the food, this response is frustrating. Especially when it is getting harder and harder to come pick up the food because no one answers the phone. I have also noticed the in-store customer service getting worse and worse at the bar. Unfortunately a majority of the floor employees seem annoyed to have to work.

Food is good but don't expect any quality customer service. I apologize to those at the establishment that do work hard because you are overshadowed by those who don't.

I'm from New Orleans and I was so excited to hear that a seafood place (especially with crawfish) was finally coming to Idaho. I had high hopes and they exceeded them. The food was absolutely delicious and the service was perfect. We had the shrimp and crawfish. The fire seasoning is awesome. I would give them 10 stars if I could.

A-M-A-Z-I-N-G!! Truffles, Etc is perfect for gifts!!

I've used Truffles for two years to send "Idaho" gifts out of state.  Lisa is so helpful and accommodating!  Our business has also received her truffles at Christmas time from other businesses in the industry...SO DELICIOUS!  Shopping on the website is easy, and they ship for you!  HIGHLY RECOMMEND giving Truffles, Etc a try!!

We really enjoyed the food and the staff was really nice however it was so hot in there we couldn't even enjoy it the atmosphere the employees said that the AC has been broken all summer they need to get it fixed it was so hot in there it was miserable also the beer was flat and warm

Sit Means Sit actually trained me!!! It should be called "Sit down Human and Learn." The sessions I attend are truly training for myself and it's the best investment you can do for your entire family. Your dog is soooo not the problem, I can promise you. It's all you. It's your attitude, it's your own mental blocks, fear, anxiety, excitement and mis-direction that get in the way of the success of your dog. You have to learn to speak dog body language and these people are very fluent!   

My pup did the immersion where she went for 10 days with trainers to learn the basics with the remote collar. Then I got to join her. The trainers and team were amazing. Parker trusted them, she worked with them, she's a wonderful dog. It took me time. I bet she learned more in 10 days than I have still after 8 months. Humans are much harder to train than our furry companions.  I have to actively work every single day to get myself in the frame of mind to be a great owner for my dog who is and was already a great dog. 

I didn't know how to work with her. I didn't know what would motivate her. I felt like I said NO all day long every day. Pulling on leash- NO, up on furniture- NO, digging in the yard- NO, barking and barking and barking- Darn it Parker, NO.  I cried the first 2 weeks I had her because I was frustrated and not sure how to achieve harmony at home.  That ALL went away when the team trained me.  It was never Parker, she wasn't the issue. She was not getting any direction from me, nothing consistent at least. I was motivating by anger when I would yell. That didn't curb the behaviors, only enhanced. Yes there are treat motivators, yes there are praise motivators and yes there are toy motivators, you have to find out what your pup values more than the bad behavior, then you have to work every day with them!  Like I said, I did the 10 day immersion. It was a good way for me to settle down and get my mind right for when Parker came back. I never expected her to be 100% trained after 10 days, I knew the work would be on me and it was. The training team never denied that the effort they put in all day with her for 10 days would go down the drain if I didn't step up and participate. At first it was a lot of info, there was homework, the commands I would get confused with, and the timing of what I was watching and when to reward were hard to grasp for a while, but we worked. The team told me I was doing fine, they told Parker she was doing fine. We grew together during our training.  Is it always perfect, no. Does Parker still pull occasionally, yes, does she bark, sure does! But you know what I do, redirect, re-motivate, play with my dog so she can focus on something better than what she's barking on. That's how you learn to be a responsible dog owner, you work every day.  I do say No still but now I stay No- Come, No-heel.  I tell her to stop the behavior and then direct to what I'd like her to do. It's a miracle and oh such a simple concept.

Training classes are fun, sometimes they are a lot of energy to deal with, but they are a blast. I'm tired mentally from them and so is my pup and it's worth every single penny. I have learned skills for my whole life!  My dog is so much happier, i'm so much happier. We have turned her pawing at my leg into high fives, and now into a toy she can paw at that spins a bottle which drops a treat. We have turned "unwanted" behavior into fun behavior. 100% recommend this program, the trainers, the ownership family team and facility.  They are available if you call with questions, concerns etc, they want to see you all succeed. It's a grand feeling when you do too!
Absolutely delicious! Very flavorful and perfectly cooked. If you want to do a boil with out actually cooking yourself this is the place for you.

* This is the best seafood restaurant I have found in the county. Wow very impressed.
* The waitress carefully summarized the menu, and answered my questions patiently. She suggested the fried flounder basket with regular fries. Sounded good. These fries were not what I think of as 'regular' as they were battered. The tartar sauce cup didn't seem to be enough to dress the three large pieces of aesthetically pleasing fried flounder, so I requested another. My shadow waiter was happy to provide an extra cup. Really really tasty fish and sauce. The fries? Not so much. I might use ketchup next time, or I might try the sweet potato fries.
