* Parking was easy. The inside decor was quite charming, even like the fake fish hanging from the ceiling racks. It did not even remind me of bathtub toys. The bar, still under construction, had color-changing mood lights on the boundary wall.
* They have an ambitious menu, with several different fried fish options. Three pieces, and a choice of fries, no substitutions. I would like to see a two-piece option, for smaller appetites, and why not some flexibility with the sides? In most Mississippi fish restaurants, hushpuppies are the default side with your catfish. I was curious about the crawfish, but will stay clear until the waitress can convince me they are purged. "Brought in fresh every day" doesn't quite impress me when I know it's frozen.

The best breakfast in Boise. I travel to Boise frequently and have been looking for a go to place with all of the usual items (plus a few more) and reasonable prices.

With the opening of Le Peep I have finally found it. Great omelet cooked perfectly (not easy to do with an egg white omelet) and fluffy pancakes.

I have not tried everything, but I will be back. 

Thanks for opening in Boise.

So we decided on this pizza place because my sister in law said it was good. The reason for the docked star is because how long it took to deliver. An hour and a half at around 5:30 pm for dinner and didn't arrive until close to 7. Very disappointed in that but the pizza was very good! We all ordered our own little 10" pizza and it had that thick crust you usually want. They don't have a ton of options for toppings (basil, roasted garlicas another franchise like say Blaze pizza but all in all it was good. I will say though if you are hangry, go somewhere else or maybe see if you can pickup! 

Update 6/29/20
Ordered again for my family who was visiting. I told them it was good pizza and was close. I did carry out and the gal told me 20 mins so that's when I arrived but had to wait about 10 more minutes, which was fine. I took it home to eat and unfortunately my parents didn't care for it which was a bummer but I understood why. The pizza turned out soggy for some reason and hard to eat. I also had got the sweet monkey bread and it was not good at all. We all agreed it was so spongy and had a very weird texture. I am updating it now to 3 stars because I'm still trying other pizza places at the moment, and in all honesty dominos will always have my heart because it's fast, easy to order and delicious! But if you are wanting local this could be your spot.

Used to love this place. We were super regulars. Like extreme regulars. 2-3 times a week. Still love the food and some of the wait staff. App used to worked well. Now two times we have come and showed up when there were one or two parties ahead of us still on app and they tell us when we get there they took us off the list. Today happened again, checked in on the app at 11:02 am. we got there with two parties ahead and the girl at door says when we go to check in, oh I can't find you, you weren't here when we called so I took you off list. I am frustrated but say ok. Then she says well you can't all check in because your whole party isn't here. Annoying because I knew what everyone wanted to eat but I didn't say anything. Then we watch group after group go ahead of us. I figure they are smaller parties than a party of six. She seats another group of six. I ask her what is up. She gives us the snottiest smile and says you've only been wait x long. I said that is not correct I know when i checked in via the app and it's a lot longer than that. She says your whole party wasn't here. I say, you told us before that we were no longer on the list so that is not the accurate time. She says again with a snotty smile yes it is. I go to speak to the manager who has seen us eat here forever. She takes the hostesses side. We left. NEVER AGAIN.  That is what loyalty gets you at le peep. Two times that an app is right over a customers word.
My favorite seafood is coming to town you guys check it out very fresh and delicious great service and great food,, what do you waiting for
A friend of mine wanted a inch cut off and this lady did a horrible job!! A basic trim shouldn't be that hard but no she just chop it like it's nothing.  It's not ok!!

I've been here twice now, once for an oil change and another the same and a patch on a tire. Scheduled an appointment both times. Service was consistent and friendly each time. The crew seems to be on task and always moving which is the opposite of other shops I've experienced. I recommend this shop and appreciate the effort.

So I ordered online for faster service. What a joke. 26 minuets i waited. Sorry guys won't cut it. Especially on a Sunday at 2 pm. I don't think there was any one over 16. You need to pick up the pace. Drive in line was 25 to 30 minuets wait. If I drive up and more than 2 cars in-line I'm leaving.
Found this fun trendy way to eat Cajun Seafood while visiting family in Boise. Great food. Great service. Great atmosphere.

This store is a good toy store. Just that the pricing is a bit high, the good is that you find great things. Store is perfect for kids, even they have access to small carts. The people who work there are very kind. Bathrooms are available for customers and staff. I recommend that you give it a visit when it opens.

Atmosphere is beautiful & quiet. Our server was amazing, I was indecisive about my sauce choice for combo, so Eddy brought me all of them to try with my garlic butter Dungeness crab and black mussels. 
Mom ordered the fried oyster basket, (she would like to see a fried combo basket), but was very pleased in her selection as well.

Overall, food tasted amazing, our server Eddy was amazing. 
So waltz in like we did, and enjoy yourself!

Usually I love Chipotle but today was not a great experience. First I was so upset they had no guacamole and they said it would be 15 minutes before they had any made. Then my order was to go and I was on my way home when I realized they didn't give me my children's juice they came with the meals so I had to go back and get the drinks.  By the time I got home our food was not warm and for some reason didn't taste as good as always. I was very disappointed.
My cat will rip me to pieces when I try to clip her nails. Pet Care Clinic makes it look like child's play! In and out in 5 minutes and reasonable price! Thank you, Pet Care Center!!!!

I went to Panera Bread this afternoon to pick up a baguette loaf. When I got home it is at least a day old. (Super hard) Then called the 4 time and kept getting hung up on. Look at there crusty loaf it is getting smaller every time I almost buy it. For almost $5 bucks you would think it would be a decent size.

Been wanting to try this place for a while and had a good friend in town so we thought it would be a fun place for us both to experience together. Let me tell you, it was an EXPERIENCE! our server, Ashley, took amazing care of us, she walked us through the menu, we ordered oysters on the half shell and snow crab for two and shared. The food came out fast and the presentation was so fun! Everything was delicious. We geared up with bibs gloves and probably could have had protective eye wear.  will definitely be back! We had a really great night! Also, ashley, If you ever read this, thanks for taking such great pictures!

My wife got a shrimp and croadad meal and I got the catfish basket. The fries were good the catfish was ok. The shrimp and croadad were a bit dirty and she didn't eat it. Probably won't return but it was worth a try.

I've found my new favorite boutique!  How did I miss this gem over the past 2 years?!   Attended their 2 year Anniversary party this week and it was a blast!   Great staff and SO many cute women's trendy clothing pieces at such affordable prices (average of $50 or less per item)!!  The store was overflowing with endless options, I spent most of time shopping the clothing but next time I'll be buying up the adorable Home and Gift merchandise!  
They said new clothing arrives daily, so it looks like I'll be there weekly now!!

Food was good service was marginal. Waitress took way to long before service. Did not come back to refill water until we asked. Ordered Apple juice for a child and it took about 5 mins to receive at the table.  She was busy talking to other staff members We will really have to think about whether we will return because of the poor service.   Only 7 tables were in use so they were not busy at all. Also told waitress we had never been here before but she really didn't seemed interested in telling us about selections. Never saw management to voice our concern. Waitress was Aleah G we were the only table she was waiting on.  This was a Tuesday at dinner hour

This place is tasty! Too many different to options to choose from, so I went with the classic strawberry shortcake cinnamon roll. Wowza! I got mine to go and ate it the next morning for breaky. I'm sure it's amazing fresh, but I had my hands full so to speak. I just popped it in the microwave for 20-30 seconds, and it didn't miss a beat. The taste, texture, flavor, fresh strawberries & strawberry sauce were decadent in every way. I can't wait to go back to try some other favorite flavors. Thank you, Yelp, for helping a new mom out. I will pay it forward, Michelle!

I'm so happy this place opened up in Idaho and even bettah it's 15 minutes from my house and just a few minutes from my work.  Eh, if you never been to Hawaii dis food is it.  Thanks Mo Bettahs for bringing my Hawaii here.  Maybe someday you can include some lomi lomi salmon, poi and Hawaii style Spam Musibi.  ONOLICIOUS!!! Hope you hang around for a long time. \m/

I have been going to Casa Bella Salon with Deb since last fall and relatively pleased.  The salon is nice, clean and the people are friendly.  But all went south when I had my hair highlighted 3 weeks ago.  I ended up with a severe chemical burn making my scalp painful, itchy and a disaster.  After seeking help from my dermatologist it was confirmed that this was a chemical burn to the scalp.  This is something I never want to experience again.  Sorry but i will be looking for another salon.

I was less than impressed with this bar and the attitude we received while we were there. Ventured in on a Wednesday at 10:30pm...obviously we weren't expecting a huge crowd of people in the middle of the week. The sign on the door clearly stated they were open until midnight. We walked in to find a few patrons sitting at the bar. I asked the bartender if they were still open...
"Well kind of, we were closing up."
"Oh okay. Your sign said you were open until midnight but we'll leave if you're closed."
"Well it's fine I guess. Oh it's only 10:30. What can I get you?"
We ordered a beer and a shot. The bartender never offered to take the bar stools off of the bar, in fact I got a nasty look when I tried to take a stool off to sit in while we ordered drinks. So instead we stood, holding our drinks, unable to completely see through or reach to the bar amidst the stools. I did give Paulys 2-stars because once the bartender found out it was my friend's birthday, she gave us the shot for free.
My friend-"This may sound like a weird question, but do you have any orange juice I could use as my chaser?"
Bartender-"Uh have you seen where you are? Of course we have orange juice. Most bars do. Have you ever been in a bar before?"
Have you ever heard of good customer service before?

I've been going to acupuncture with Heather. I went in on a cane and I'm walking better now without the cane. If you're skeptical like I was about acupuncture it will change your mind. A plus service I can't say enough about the help they gave me.
This place is wonderful! Great food, friendly people, and a lovely ambience. You will not be disappointed!

Ok folks, I'm being very cautious when posting this review because so many others love this place, but I don't. Let's start with seating and go from there.

Seats will support large and wide bodies like mine and I managed to share a booth (I was just as surprised as you!) but only because smaller bodies sat across from me:-)

When we were there the place was super busy and loud. This is totally not a quiet place for an intimate dining experience. Expect though to get very close to your fellow diners as you lean in to hear what they're mouthing. A short ASL class may help those of you who don't want all that closeness during this coronavirus pandemic we're currently in:-)

So, let's get on with the food, shall we?

Here is my challenge to give this a higher rated review. There is no fish on the menu. There's plenty of shellfish baskets, but flaky fish? Nope. There is no gumbo over white rice. No spicy jambalaya. No red beans and rice. I was disappointed, but now that I'm familiar with the menu I'll better prepared to know what to expect.

Tonight I ordered the fried oyster basket. Very good sweet potato fries. Exceptional sweet potato fries, actually. The oyster bits, yes, BITS were very crunchy and fried. Won't order these again.

Two in our party shared a "boil" of black mussels, shrimp and crab. Two potatoes and small slices of corn on the cob in a garlic butter platter. It was very tasty and I'll order if I return.

Another in the party ordered crab legs with corn and potatoes in sauce. She liked it but had wisely ordered a side of fries because her main dish of crab legs was small sized IMO.

The wisest guy at the table ordered a shrimp poboy and chicken wings. I should have asked him to order for me rather than be filled with regret over my order.

Will I return? Absolutely, to order a boil or poboy and chicken wings.

Y'all enjoy yourselves!

1 star for the Pulehu Steak, 5 stars for the Kalua Pig, so 3 star average. The steak was overcooked, dried out and flavorless - I really couldn't tell if they put any of the rub on it or not. On the other hand, the Kalua Pig was moist and flavorful. Sides are fair. The macaroni salad is in desperate need of pepper, but okay after you add that. The sticky rice is, well, rice - standard stuff.

I've been coming to Deja Brew for breakfast, always great service and feels like home from the moment you step in the door! The food is great and the selection is enough to satisfy any kind of breakfast desires! Plus with an extensive coffee menu, you can't go wrong!

Not terrible but nothing exciting.  We make our annual trek to Flying Pie every August for the Habanero Pizza and now that it's August, our trip is completed.

We were in the Meridian area and thought we'd visit the Meridian location.  Place was cleaner than I expected.  I really enjoyed the layout of the building.  Pizza took about 30 minutes but they supplemented our waiting with free breadsticks (YAY!!).  The pizza was great!  I've been disappointed with Flying Pie in the past but this time was much better.

The only down side was the inattentive staff.  The two women making the pizzas were like machines cranking out pizza after pizza.  However, the wait staff were more just hanging out and chatting.  Had to find our server to ask questions.

I won't let this experience taint my future visit.  I liked this Flying Pie and I liked the location.  We'll be back again for sure.

My experience with Caden TV repair was very favorable. They've made  prompt repair to my TV and returned it in a timely manner. Even though it's a 1-man army kind of entrepreneurial operation, I'm impressed by the young entrepreneur's profession-ism and knowledge. I would use Caden TV repair again for any future TV repairs.

My husband was super excited to try out Panara Bread since they now have a flatbread pizza. He got the pizza and a beef sandwich. I tried the pizza with him. The pizza was dry and the crust was not cooked properly. It was like there was no sauce. It was almost like eating one of those lunchable pizzas but without the sauce. Then the sandwich was... pathetic to put it lightly. They put one small piece of meat and cheese on soggy, yet burnt, bread. My husband was extremely angry. It is a pathetic looking sandwich. He even weighed the beef just to see how much they put. 1oz of beef. Photo of the sandwich is provided. He had to take the top piece off the sandwich and fold the bottom one in half to make a tiny sandwich in order to taste the meat. 
Very displeased and for the quality provided, overly priced.

Parking is limited
The hours are bad, and they require a reservation so you can't go on a whim.
The bathrooms are not clean and very outdated.
It is extremely crowded on weekends.
There were no workers on most attractions.
They don't seem to care about covid or germs in general.
Wonderful, thoughtful service.  The food was very tasty and well presented.  My first experience with this restaurant, but certainly not my last.

I'm going to give flying pie a five star, it's hard to find pizza better than here.  Hard to believe this is only our third time here and I have not posted a review yet. Pictured is the combination pizza which I believe is number one on regular crust, it is phenomenal. When you dine in they give you free cheese bread. This is the second time we eat our large combo in the restaurant and only had one piece each, taking the rest home!   They also have a large salad bar but we would be 4 too full two about about ha ha. There are so many different combinations of pizzas, toppings, and crust. Three times here three times perfect, really no reason to go anywhere else.   This pizza is so good you can stick it in the toaster oven the next day and it's perfect, so unlike dominoes and those other terrible waste of money places.
Super good food and excellent service! One of our secret little favs! Cool little cafe atmosphere.
YUM! The variety of all things yum makes it hard to choose!  You wont be let down!!!!!

Beautiful bouquet of 24 long stemmed roses for 25th wedding anniversary which was also Valentine's Day.  They had a beautiful red and silver big bow and dispersed with  silver lacy things. Delivery guy was super nice too. Very happy and can't stop looking at them

Hook & Reel Cajun Seafood & Bar has a "Seaside" fun ambience! The music is good. I appreciated the nice service from the staff, they're welcoming. My waitress Ashley was EXCELLENT on point! We had a nice and pleasant conversation about the menu and restaurant. The food was Super Fresh Cajun DELICIOUS!!! The Cajun Shrimp and Salad satisfied my pes·ca·tar·i·an cravings! FYI, I had seen the boils and they looked steamy & full of flavor tasty!!!

7/10 would bang again. 
Had a shrimp Po-boy with a side of lobster bisque. The Sammy was good would totally order it again but maybe next time with a little less sauce on it. Just ended up being too much by the end of the sandwich. Bisque was good but could be served a bit warmer. 
Over all would come back.

Since Del Taco was taken away from me in San Francisco (closest location is somewhere far away in East Bay!), I jump at the opportunity for the experience when out of town.

This was my first dine-in experience, but pretty pleasant. Staffers behind the counter we very nice and polite, just what I'd expect from Boise ;) Tables and booths looked relatively clean as well, not always the case at fast food restaurants.

What to order? Chicken soft tacos, crinkle fries and a burger. DUH!

Definitely not healthy, but I love it!

Bill was $10.26.   Gave carhop $20.26.   she had to go get a calculator to make change.  
Fries were cold, no sauce nor ketchup... Not a good experience.

I used to come here multiple times a month when I lived close by - I loved the staff! They all knew me by name, were so sweet and funny, and they allow substitutions on the meals which is awesome. I used to get extra toast instead of hashbrowns to turn my eggs and bacon into a breakfast sandwich! I would highly recommend this place for a great value, a portionable 'home-cooked' type of meal, and friendly staff in a home-y environment. The atmosphere is super special at Express, I hope you give them a shot!

The first time we went here it was probably the most delicious thing we've had for a deserts ever. 
The second time was yesterday, I had preordered it for a exact time, and when i showed up to get them, they were cold cold. Like they made them when I first ordered it hours before that, even though I ordered them to be made right before I was coming to pick them up. On top of that the frostings were barely covering the roll, the toppings were just basically nothing, for instances my strawberry banana roll had one slice of banana and two slices of strawberry. It was honestly a shock. The first time we had them it was so good. We had taken 6 rolls to a taste test for a wedding for who they wanted to cater. I voted this and I went there with the mind set I would win and get to eat these all night at my bro's wedding! But nope everyone was like "hahahah, youre kidding right" I was like oh you're absolutely right these are extremely disappointing. 
Luckily we found out they weren't capable of being consistent with there cooking so we didn't spend thousand dollars or more for this mess. 
I hope someone reads this and does something about this because I'm trying to come get hot rolls with actual frosting and toppings like the first time I went. You made me look like a liar
Not cool

Park place is the worst company I've ever dealt with. Worse than Century Link when it was Qwest, if that tells you anything! They are slow to non-responsive. They ONLY let you pay rent electronically, and charge you an extra dollar for the privilege of paying. They charge a late fee if you don't pay by the first, but they don't post the rent charge to your billing account UNTIL the first, so you can't pay early, either! Their payment website crashed the first 3 months they took over my lease. 
I warned them 3-4 times in 2 years, about the sprinklers hitting my window, and they finally remedied it the 3rd season, but I still had to walk AROUND the sidewalk and through a rock bed every morning to get to my car without getting wet. THEN the had the gall to charge me for re-screening! They didn't salt or scrape the walks or the driveway in winter. There was no assigned parking. They raised the rent $150/mo in 2 years without providing any improvements or extra services! They had my sons car towed because it was for sale, without warning ($220) and he is on the lease! I spent 8 hours cleaning my apartment when I left, and they tried to charge me $400 out of my deposit. Good thing I took pics! And saved all the emails I sent them! If they don't make this right after I provide evidence that they are overcharging, I'll be contacting the attorney general.

I am just beyond disappointed in the way this gym is run. I have had an issue for awhile now and in the beginning they let me know they could fix it and now they have gone back on that and have charged me even more money. I have been trying to get ahold of upper management for awhile now and when finally I did they didn't even want to work with me. Very upset. You are better off going to a more personal , smaller gym. Take caution when signing up!

This is my first Yelp review and I felt the urge to make one after our incredible experience. The service was great and the food was even better. This blows Joe's Crab Shack out of the water (no pun intended). The food was bursting with tremendous flavor. We got snow crab, lobster tail, shrimp (head off), sausage, corn, and potatoes in the lemon pepper sauce and the hook & reel special sauce and EVERYTHING  was delicious.

Tonight I placed an order to pick up.  Silly me for not looking inside to make sure the order was correct.
They left off fajita veggies, pico and guacamole on both of my dishes.
Yes, I could have driven back for it, but I didn't.
They were busy and our order was late.  No biggie.
But, I LOVE their guacamole.
Lesson learned!  Look inside your bag to make sure your order is correct.
Food was delish as I doctored it up upon arriving home.
They Flaunt not wearing masks and the majority of the staff are pompous assholes. Go here if you want shitty wings and over priced boozed in a venue packed with redneck and incels.
The prime rib sandwich was very very dry and the place is way over priced. The clams linguine was good but small for $18 for lunch.. Service was fine

The staff was friendly, environment nice, but toppings were scarce for the additional price, $2 ea veggie $3 ea meat, and that's on top of the base price for the pizza or calzone. I don't mind paying for toppings but I'd like to have more than a sprinkle of them.

I've ordered here several times (stupid, I know) and I don't think a single order has ever been correct. The most egregious example was a "veggie" bowl which literally had rice, a few beans, and then just flooded in hot salsa...guess those were the only ingredients they had left. And let's not get carried away on the quality...the rice was undercooked and crunchy. At this point, you have to think it's intentional. If they're going for the worst Chipotle ever, well then congrats you've made it!

Stopped in here on a cross-country road-trip just because we liked how punny the name is. The code was good and the bakery items were excellent. I only wish they'd had sweatshirts and coffee mugs with their logo.

One of our "go-to" places when we just do not feel like cooking.

The staff is always friendly and they ALWAYS tolerate my husband and his jokes. I switch my order around quite a bit, but the food and menu selections are always the same. I will say though.. I have been in quite a kick with their salads and I really enjoy those. 

I gave 4 stars because there is a lack of consistency occasionally. The first time we ever visited this location, they ran out of cilantro for the rice, etc... 

Nonetheless, this is a great establishment that stays clean. Their food is still good and the workers are kind. You can't go wrong with chipotle.

It doesn't matter how old you get, whenever you walk by a candy store you are immediately transported back to childhood! It'Sugar has great curb appeal.  The store is bright & has pops of color everywhere! 
As I walked into the store, I was greeted by 2 employees.  One of them offered to be of assistance if I needed it. The store was well decorated and well organized.  The walls are adorned with everything from candy to novelty gifts.  All of the wall candy is prepackaged. There is a section of gross candy. They carry a yellow, slime like candy packed in a urine sample cup.  It was so disgusting & awesome!  There is also a bug candy section with scorpion lollipops & chocolate covered crickets. An adult candy section with edible candy bras & panties and a SNL Dick in a Box candy. 
The center of the store is filled with bins of loose candy. They have a great selection of sour candy & gummies! Impressive amount of variety.  You could find something to satisfy anyone's sweet tooth.  
The prices were a bit high.  They have a Chinese food take out box that you can fill for $14.99. Overall, I like the store.  I'm sure they make a killing especially with all of the teenagers who like to hang out at The Village! If I could, I would have given 3.5 stars.

Panera has upped their selections and service since my last update. From 2 to 4 stars is indicative of their effort.

The breakfast sandwiches are a great improvement and much more selection. Their pastries are very good now and the bagels have always been good. Probably the best in the area now. And don't forget, Tuesdays are bagel bargain day with a bakers dozen for about $8.

We like their coffee and although they use hot pots, a free refill is available. The cold drinks are a good selection and you can get a refill there too. The dining area is kept clean and attractive. Same for the Loos. We would always stop at a Panera on trips for eats and Loo breaks. Consistent across the country.

The help is courteous and knows their products. One or two have been there since the opening of the store. 

Last thing, they take Apple Pay and it works!!!!

I was having troubles with some keys on a rental property. I drove to Home Depot on meridian and they were completely clueless on how to help me. I asked if they could then make some copies of keys for me and for some reason their machine wouldn't work. The sales rep said to try Lowes so I drove over to Ustick Fairview. I experienced the same thing. Not wanting to spend 60 bucks replacing my door fixtures I called minuteman. They were closing in 5 minutes but said they would hold the door for me. Walked in got what I needed and a new set of keys to boot. 

I've gone here twice since then and have had nothing but great experiences. I usually shop local and i disappointed in myself for not going here first.

Brandy recently did two move in/move out cleans for us.  She was super easy to work with, quick to respond, reasonably priced, and did a great job on the clean itself.  She obviously cares a lot about her business and makes sure her customers are happy with the work she's done.  Thank you again, Brandy!!!

So ordered from door dash. Food was hot. But the carbanra burrito was a total of 6 " wide. May as well been a soft ball. Rest of my order the same. 7" for the burrito. I get cut backck on cost ect. Add more filler so a 19 doller burrito feels like it. Thank but no thanks
The food is  delicious, but when you order to go they will never give you a utensils, you always have to check before you go, otherwise you gotta eat with your fingers

First time here this morning and pleasantly surprised! Food was excellent, as was our service from Kel. My husband had the Huevos Rancheros, which was a generous serving, while I had the tasty Breakfast Sammy. We enjoyed a hump day Mimosa that was also a very generous pour! Kel was attentive and super friendly! We will  defiantly be back.
What are your hours? Every night I try seems to be a gamble. Why have posted hours online and yelp if you're not gonna be open for them?
If you have been to Joe's Crab Shack then you have been to Hook and Reel. I would have to say the only difference is you have more of a choice a Joe's
Super cute Boutique!  Great place for unique gifts. Great reasonably priced clothing.  They have dressing rooms you can try on the clothes. Excellent customer service, everyone was super friendly.

Dentist is great along with staff in the back. My issue was with the front desk. I was waiting for my insurance year to start over so I wouldn't have any out of pocket expenses and was told I was I was good to go to have a crown done and the date they gave me for my new insurance year was wrong by a few months. I could have waited a few more months there was no hurry to get my new crown, now I am out $1000.

Came here on the recommendation of a friend.  The facility was impeccable, the service fast and very friendly, the food good (they nailed my hash browns *crisp* order), but the prices a little high for what was essentially standard diner fare.

This was the first time I used a property management company. Our contract is coming to a close and I must say I am so dissatisfied. I feel very mislead, I am consistently told one policy, and then emailed something by another employee that contradicts what I was just told. I can now understand why renters do not want to work with a property management company. You will save money with AIM, keep that in mind when you are short changed in quality. When the manager Lindsay has to deliver a message that will be less than favorable to the home owner she will send an email Vs calling the home owner. I provided feedback asking to cease communication via email when she had to deliver messages such as the one described, yet no changes were made. I was told if I allowed a tenant with 5 pets that they would be paying a non-refundable deposit, when it came time to end the contract I was then told the non-refundable deposit was paid to them!

Where to begin?? Everything about our visit was top notch! We were all impressed with the extensive breakfast menu and gluten free options. The food arrived quickly and perfectly prepared - every bite was beyond delicious and the portions are incredible. We couldn't believe we had found a place that had so much to offer - fabulous food and very reasonable prices. We can't wait to go back and try the lunch menu. The staff was very friendly and eager to please and the atmosphere is very family friendly and inviting. We found our new family favorite for sure!!

Ridiculously overcharged!!!

My AC went out July 7th and these guys made it out same day (business hours) which was great. Based on symptoms and a visual of the capacitor, knew what was wrong w/in 5 minutes. Replaced the $25 part and ran a few diagnostics. Gave me a squirt of 4oz of R22 Freon which I did not ask for and was stated would not be billed. And that was that. Spent about 35 to 40 minutes on site including time for a few glasses of water, some headache meds and chit chat time
. 
Final bill - $440!

I paid but it seemed pretty steep so I politely asked for an itemized invoice the following day and 4 more times over the next 10 days. I really didn't  think it was unreasonable to want to know exactly what I paid for. 
I have yet to see that invoice. 
I Will never use these guys again & cannot in good conscious recommend them. 

A quick look into their review history will reveal some very similar stories and a habit of grossly overcharging. Especially for capacitors. I had to chuckle at one explanation offered which was that they only install the premium made in the USA capacitors. You know, the ones that cost $25 instead if $10! 

I would avoid these guys at all cost. Many, many fair, honorable and respectable choices out there who won't gouge you for basic repairs. 

I've downgraded my review from 2 to 1 star based on the fact that after 13 days of trying to communicate with them, i only hear back after they see the poor reviews and i still have yet to see any attempt at an itemized invoice. Pathetic business ethics.

Be forewarned; if you do pick them and it's your capacitor,  a 10 minute installation of a $25 part is going to cost at least $440.

I really want to like this place. I've been 3 maybe 4 times and my experience is the same every time. Maybe I don't know the jive of the place, but with a name like Deja Brew Laugh a Latte I assumed it would be more of a coffee shop and less of a sit down restaurant. Each time I've been in, I've ordered my coffee at the counter and the person working although very nice seems put off that I'm ordering at the counter and expects me to take a seat. I'm not looking for a traditional restaurant when I'm coming in to order a coffee, again unless I'm wrong and this isn't a coffee shop and is just a restaurant. I love the location and in the summer and fall the patio is just so beautiful and inviting. I'm tired of feeling awkward and like I should only be there to sit down and be waited on. Unfortunately, at this time I think I'll be taking my business to another locally owned coffee shop.

I've given this place a few chances and every time I go it's worse each time. The owner is an ass and has no idea how to properly run a restaurant. The servers are always very sweet but they can only do so much.
This place is the bomb. We order here every other week. Big portions, good food, good prices. Order extra, it makes great leftovers!

So so

Good flavor but lacking substance.
The good
The bread
I love the shredded lettuce that is nicely chilled,  it holds the vinegar oil and pepper perfectly.
The pastrami was tender and well seasoned. 

The not so good. 
The near absence of meat. 
Chopped pastrami that is a mess to eat vs bigger thin sliced pieces.

I may give then one more try but I'm in no hurry to do so.

This is a three-part review: food gets 5 stars! We had a dozen oysters on the half shell, shrimp basket and soft shelled crabs. Oh, my, fresh, and tasty, even the cocktail sauce was amazing! Now, service was less than stellar. We sat and hubby wanted to know about the beers. Server showed him the domestic, imports, and draft. He ordered one draft. After fumbling on her iPad, she said they didn't have that one. He ordered second choice. Shouldn't a server know what was 86'd BEFORE service started? I asked if they brewed their iced tea or was it that nasty Pepsi stuff out of a machine? It was the nasty stuff. Really? A seafood restaurant that prides itself on Cajun style seafood doesn't take the time and energy to make some brewed sweet and unsweetened tea??? Silverware didn't come with our meals, we had to ask, and it was brought over in our servers hand, not wrapped or on a plate. Salt and pepper? Not available unless you ask. Once we finished the oysters, the server left the tray on the table when she brought our meals. No room on table to maneuver. Finally called her over and she took it and brought the salt. Meanwhile, a kid was screaming her lungs out. (Not the restaurants fault.) Overall, we'll be back - but not for awhile. Parents: have a "chat" with your kids before entering a restaurant. If the chat doesn't work, you should leave or plan on picking up the checks for those who had to endure your brats temper tantrum.
This was recommended on a fb site I follow so we decided to try it. Doesn't look fancy but waitress was lovely and attentive and food was good.

This place is great! Great food, great portions, and great service! We had the Teriyaki Chicken and Katsu Chicken. Both were delicious and I liked that they are generous with the portions. Both orders were served on a bed of cabbage, served with two scoops of rice, plus a side. They give two sides of your choice of sauces. The two of us had enough food for four so saved it for the next day's lunch. We ordered take out and the food was packaged well and arrived very timely. We will definitely order from Mo'Bettahs again!
Delicious and authentic Hawaiian. The mac salad was a bit off, but everything else reminded me of a little place on the Big Island by the airport. I will be back, a lot!

My heart was broken tonight, Mo' bettahs has let me down. I have been telling everyone I know about this place Bc I truly am a fan. It's fast Hawaiian food, how can you go wrong? However, the customer service has continuously gone downhill since they opened. I understand it is ran and worked by young kids probably still in high school, but they need to be taught how to work with customers. Tonight, we decided to order to go. The cashier told me it would be a few minutes for the steak and for me to have a seat and she would call me when my food was ready. I had a seat while I waited. A few minutes had passed and I saw a packed up order on the counter. The workers were gaggled around talking to each other (the manager included). I went up to the counter and asked if my order was ready, in which she replied "yeah, it's right here" and continued to talk to each other. I am disappointed in this place, however I will still be ordering their food as it is still delicious. Wish they had better customer service, but what can you expect from a fast food restaurant?

It was a blessings for me to find Steve and his Son, Jacob on Yelp.  I had reinforcement door brackets installed on three doors, a Schlage deadbolt lock and a larger than normal privacy peep hole.  Sample is in picture below. 

Here is the good part of meeting Steve & Jacob, they do much much more than door/camera security; they have lots of other extremely useful talents; a homeowner's one stop shop for nearly everything that needs to be done at home.  They are the Real McCoy's who care about quality workmanship in all they do.  I'll definitely use them to install a storm door, put up some fan ceilings fans, and get advice on how to go about with other future home improvements.

The service itself was seamless. They were fast, explained everything, reasonably priced, and had me out in 5 minutes. The issue is the unleashed dog. I pulled up and as I was not immediately greeted, got out of my car and opened the door. There were 2 seated gentlemen, and immediately their dog came up and started sniffing my thigh. Im a dog person, so no worries I said hey girl and started to pet her. One of the gentlemen became extremely nervous and warned me "Careful, careful! She's been known to get nippy". I froze. The dog, sensing my discomfort gave a small growl. I got back in my car quickly. The two guys began to argue, one telling the other not to overreact she's a nice dog and the other insisting let's not take a chance we don't want to pay anyone's medical bills today. Hey guys, how about not having your nippy possibly medical bill-causing unleashed dog not answer the door to your business? The service itself, like I said, no issues. But if you have kids, are afraid I dogs, or think you might need to get out of your car for any reason (remember they need to open your drivers door to hook up their equipment) I would be cautious.

Staff was very friendly and knowledgeable of the menu. Any questions we had the waitress could tell you exactly what it was. So many delicious menu options. Too much decorations but it's the food that's matters right? The food was amazing! Delicious and I can't wait to explore more of the menu!

The best seafood in Meridian. Don't sleep on the crab meat fries, they're amazing! Their prices are a little steep but you truly get what you pay for. It's delicious and the service is THE BEST! Make sure you join the waitlist on Yelp, it makes it so much easier to get in on time.

Delicious New Italian restaurant in Meridian. 

My mom requested Italian food for her 70th birthday. I had seen this new restaurant before it had opened so decided to give it a try. They do not currently take reservations so we arrived shortly after 5pm and we were seated right away. 

There was 5 of us total and we all absolutely loved our food. I personally had the filet pasta. It was delicious. The portions are a very good size as well. 

The restaurant does sit in a strip mall, however, the decor and set up of the restaurant does not feel like you are in a strip mall. I definitely recommend this cute Italian restaurant. We all will be back again!

I received the perfect flower arrangement last month when my husband passed away. If I had picked out the flowers myself they would have been exactly the same as I received. Now only that but they lasted a full ten days!
At such a hard time those flowers brightened each and every day. I smiled each and every time I looked at them!
My deepest appreciation to The Flower Shop!

If you look up 'Greasy Spoon' in the dictionary, chances are, you'll find a picture of Express Cafe right alongside the definition. 

Nothing flashy at all, just a room filled with bright florescent lights, cheap silverware, friendly servers who've likely worked there for 20+ years, and not a single item of fruit to be found anywhere on the menu. If you're trying to eat healthy, look elsewhere. But if you're looking for a meal that's bound to slay even the mightiest of hangovers, pay 'em a visit. 

With breakfast items like biscuits and gravy, country omelettes, waffles, pancakes, hash browns and the like... it's the kind of wake-me-up that's sure to make you want to take a nap about 45 minutes later. Great if you're planning on watching the entire Star Wars trilogy with the remainder of your day, but if you have any important business to attend to, stick to the home pantry for brain food like oatmeal or blueberry yogurt.
Amazing service and hospitality! Yvonne the General Manager was awesome! Very personable and friendly. We had a great experience!! Definitely coming back.
We LOVE this place! It is authentic and delicious. Worth the wait, we are so glad they opened a second location in Meridian.
They sell a bunch of liberal democratic junk and candy. If I wanted to see Obama And AOC stuff I'd got to San Francisco.

Always extremely slow, no sense of urgency. Orders are always 40+ minutes after promised time when ordering online. They are constantly changing whether you can order online or if you are allowed to order in store. This location also closes way earlier than posted time. We sat in front of the store and called (to see if they would let us in) because they had a sign on the door saying they were closed, we watched the employee ignore our phone call standing right in front of us. Completely rude and unprofessional.

YES! YES! YES!

Alright, first of all...I'm not much of a chocolate person. I'm not a huge fan of any dessert, but chocolates especially tend to hurt my teeth. I know, I'm lame. 

But... I love to give away chocolates and I always fill my husband's and children's stockings with handmade candies found local in the Treasure Valley. I usually have to drive downtown or to one of the bazaars to find these treasures. But not this year! Truffles Inc has opened up a brick and mortar in downtown Meridian and it is perfect. Stunning truffles fill the glass case, pre-packaged gift boxes are carefully laid out to fit each person in your life (vodka, wine and beer chocolate are all options!), and incredible house made ice cream and hot espresso drinks are also available. 

When I went in mid November 2020, they had super cute local crafts available for purchase as well. I was also able to take care of the gift for my Mother in Law and a convalescing friend. I will also be ordering some custom hot chocolate bombs for our Christmas Tree cutting tradition. 

I spoke with the young lady behind the counter for quite a bit. She's the daughter of the owners - mom makes the truffles and dad makes the ice cream. Also brother makes the ceramic plant pots available for purchase. A true family-run business. 

Let's support this beautiful store and stock up on all the holiday treats!

DO NOT EAT HERE. Just put an order for pick up and the portions are the worst I've ever seen. They forgot a bunch of the ingredients. 
Look at this...

This family owned place sucks. They have lots of taps but 10 are colors and bud type beers. 1 local fucking beer! Sockeye dagger falls. Services sucks. It looks like their shitty distributor picks their beer for them and it's what ever he can't sell to other bars in town.

Some asshole named "wish" works there and is like the walking dead. What a fuck. No wonder his son is an asshole. Good thing people still like miller light or this place would be closed.

Sherry and I came to enjoy dinner and participate in trivia night with Justin.  Sherry ordered the Deja Dip, I ordered finger steaks.  Both were good but not memorable.  My finger steaks were served with what I thought was ketchup.  When I asked the waitress for some cocktail sauce, she brought more of the same and told me that there was indeed horseradish mixed in, just not very much of it.  Sherry's Deja Dip was tasty but the meat wasn't as tender or sliced as thin as some I've had.   Service was friendly and helpful, and Trivia with Justin was fun even though we came in last.

New to area and called to see if I could get an appointment for our 18 lb labradoodle.  

She first asked what kind of dog it was.  Then oh we are not taking anymore new dogs.  What????

It would have been better had she said they weren't taking any new dogs first so I concluded maybe another breed would have gotten an  appointment.

Wouldn't go to them now even if they had an opening

This place is bad on a good day. And now you can't watch them make the food. Get ready to figure out there app. Because you can go in. Super lame they use Covid to hide them making there food food that's been sitting.

Urban Air is similar to other jump parks with some added attractions. So why give a 5 star rating because? Because of the interactions we had with a single employee, Justin. He went above his job duties to ensure people were having fun and areas were clean. I watched him remind employees of duties and check in on guests. He was upbeat and smiling and making the environment a fun place to be. This was not the case for all employees, so based on this exceptional employee, I gave it a 5 star and hope the rest strive to be like him!

I have had massages other places but nothing compares to Julia and the service she provides. She's thorough and always does an amazing job. She has a relaxing vibe and knows her stuff. I highly recommend booking the signature 90 minute with Julia!

Pet Care Clinic has been part of our family for 11 years!  Dr. Madura has saved my dogs life when he was seven.  In 2016 he took his last breath as a 15 year old minature pin.  Now its 2017 and we have a new frisky min pin in our life and our first stop when we picked her up was Pet Care Clinic.  They take such care of us and really have our dogs best interest at heart.  We love them!

If you plan to get your food when it's "promised" you'd better think again.

Order at 6:00, promised at 6:20? You're not getting your food before 6:45 at the earliest. It's outrageous.

My daughter and husband rented five months from this company.  They left because when they called for maintainence they were always told that the owner didn t have money for repairs.  They had an ant infestation from day one in their living room under the carpeting.  It was never taken care of.  This was just one of many problems.
Now their trying to rip them off.  Their even charging them for caulking the windows and changing a fire alarm battery.  My daughter is seeking legal help right now which is costing them.

Family rented a house from this company and talk about a joke. The place was filthy on move in. It was not cleaned. It was an older home so yes the windows leaked a little to be expected. Every time the shower in the hall was on the smoke detector would start going off so it was taken down and set on the counter being outdated anyway but as they did an inspection there was a $75 fine for not having it put in place. Well shouldn't they have replaced it in the first place and it wouldn't have malfunctioned? Updated blinds were installed in bedrooms and one in the bathroom that was never there not by the management but was charged for a wand to open and close them. $20 for a lost key. $300 for windows that were never broken and the best one $700 not including carpet for the cleaning bill. Are they joking? The place was ten times better than the move in. So a $2000 dollar move out bill goes right to there now 1 star rating

I have a 2016 Honda Civic, and got it fully detailed but Erick and the guys at Dynamic.  They took really good care of my car and got the swirls out and clean the engine bay.  I appreciate the fine attention to detail from everything to the tires, to the interior.  My car looks better than the day I took it off the lot.  They offer ceramic coatings and I cannot wait to get that done as well.
Will be bringing my other cars here and all of my friends to Dynamic.
Thank you again!

Have not used their product but they showed up to my house and disregarded my no soliciting sign (even said he wasn't selling anything so it was okay) and tried to get my phone number and sell me a water product. Also couldn't be bothered to WEAR A MASK when knocking at strangers' homes DURING A PANDEMIC. Obviously not concerned about their prospective customers. When I called to complain, I was just told "have a nice day."

Sure, you too, Covid Cathy.
Parfait Monday madness.   Just found out you could get any of the scoopable hard ice cream's or the machine yogurts in your parfait, delicious!

This place is awesome. Anna and Jennifer are pretty incredible. Jennifer on the weekday mornings and Anna for the evenings and weekends. Pretty freaking fantastic customer service for sure. It's always accessible and if you are staying in Meridian there's no reason to go further afield when you can get the best customer service right at Laundry Haus. What are you waiting for? Get clean. Laundry Haus. Anna and Jennifer. They the best.

We went here last Saturday for lunch. First red flag was the place was almost empty. We saw a commercial on tv and decided to go. It reminds me of Joe's crab shack. I have not found king crab legs around. I asked what was market price and the server said $60.00 and  I was expecting that. I ordered the garlic butter sauce with noodles that were extra $$$. Meal came and it's 1 leg only for $60.00!! The menu or food server do not mention that. Total ripoff, if you just be warned. The bag thing is odd, but the food tasted good. Might go back, but I doubt it.

Set up a weekly maintance program for $50 a week. Informed them that this is a new pool and dont know anything about it. Mike was very friendly and answered several questions. How ever the guy who actually does the work came out and vacumed the pool and left. Said to wait and see until next week before he added any chemicals. The following week the same. By this time my kids were crying that there eyes were buring. Third week they did nothing but vacume again. So I called into talk to Mike and he wasnt there so I explained the situation to the other guy working and I told him I didnt want the guy warned in advanced. I own my own business and I would want to know if my employees where doing what they were supposed to do. One of two things were going to happen either I was going to fire them or the employee needed to be fired for not doing his job. The guy agreed. The employee shows up and flat out told me he had been warned and that was the first time in a month that they tried to fix the issue. They added several chemicals which still didnt fix the problem but atleast they tried after a month. Long story short still have not talked to Mike but Spent $200 for a vacume job that I could of done. I hired them to take care of the chemicals and teach me what needed to be done. They failed at both.

Truly one of the best breakfast joints in the Treasure Valley!   Generous portions and super friendly and efficient staff. 
May have to wait a bit on the weekends, but it's worth it!

This is such a great place in old town Meridian. We had breakfast and it was absolutely delicious. It has a quaint and eclectic feel and the people that work here are super friendly. It was a great stop and a small business EVERYONE should support. Shop local and enjoy some quality made with love coffee and food.

This place is an absolute gem. They have an amazing selection of toys and games but what makes this place amazing is the staff. The staff really knows their stuff and has such passion for both toys and games. I went there for a new set of board games for the kids and I to play. I told him the ages and that I wanted to be able to play with just the three of us. He excitedly took me to the game table where I got to try out the games with him prior to purchasing. So much fun!

While there we purchased additional toys to entertain the kids unplugged during the biggest snow storm in 30 years. These toys did not disappoint!

I highly recommend coming here for games for the family and/or presents for kids.

Today, Indigo and I went to Urban Air for their uncrowded toddler Jumparoo time. It's a specific 2 hr block of time just for toddlers. 

We signed a waiver (could have done it ahead of time but forgot about it), bought socks (if you or your toddler are going to jump on the trampolines, their almost 3$ per pair socks are mandatory) and then we just roamed around. 

They have trampolines, basketball trampolines, dodgeball trampolines, slides, kid obstacle course, massage chairs, and ball pit. 
There was a rock wall and ropes course, laser tag as well but these were not open for toddlers. There's mini golf but I didn't see if toddlers were playing, however it would have been perfectly to scale. 

After an hour of trampoline and other madness, I was winded. We stopped for water and a snack. No outdoor food or drink allowed. 

The snack bar was closed at the time but there were snacks at the front desk, ice cream and candy machines. 

I think this would be well worth the price of admission and socks if your toddler enjoyed and engaged in the majority of the available activities. My toddler was mostly interested in the slides and just running around. Not worth it to be a frequent customer just yet, however I'm not mad at the initial experience.

Random Notes 

There was a changing table. 

If you go, wear workout clothes. 

This would be a fun place for a kid party or party for non kids. 

Indigo gives 20 stars for the slides....

I don't always jump around like a clumsy gazelle... but when I do, I'm at Urban Air.
Love this little coffee shop in downtown Meridian. Great service & staff. Nicely decorated. Tons of yumminess on the menu. Atmosphere is great! Staff is friendly and up beat.

My friend (a VIP member) and I went to the Axiom in Meridian right by the entrance of the freeway on 7/25 at around 8 PM. It's a great gym and I really like working out there so I decided to get my own membership. I went to the front desk to talk to someone and waited for a minute while the two employees stood there flirting with each other and completely ignoring me. I finally had to approach them and ask if I could sign up for a membership. They looked at each other and then the girl said, "Ummm well you can just do it online if you want to do it tonight or you can come back tomorrow and someone can help you." There was no indication that the front desk was closed/closing or that they stop doing memberships at a certain time. There was really no reason at all as to why neither of them could help me considering the fact that they were both just standing around doing nothing important. I felt like they totally just brushed me off and basically told me to either do it myself or come back another time. They were not very friendly or helpful at all and they seemed to be focusing more on each other rather than doing their jobs and gaining some new business. I did end up getting a membership online and I'm excited to start working out there but that encounter was just kind of confusing and frustrating.

This was the second time I've tried eating at this establishment but after reading the reviews I'll listen to the Universe and take the hint.  
The First time I tried eating at Barrel 55 it was about a month after they opened and although there were lots of empty tables there was a wait list due to the Kitchen staff stating they can't keep up so after they stated an hour wait we left and went to Pinnacle across the parking lot got seated right away  and food was wonderful.
The second time was this last Friday night, again people were waiting and a lot of empty tables and we waited for a hostess for about 10 min before she appears and tells us there was a 35 min. wait, again I said look at all these empty tables why the wait?  SURPISE!!! the Kitchen isn't letting her sit tables.  Since when is a kitchen dictating when people can be seated, and how do you run a successful restaurant this way, but like I said earlier from the reviews....not very successful...!!!  Their other restaurant on Glenwood is just as bad which is ran by his wife.  So again we ended back at the Pinnacle and will continue.  This place is not worth spending your hard earned money at.

I had heard about this place, and I enjoy Hawaiian food from the few times I've experienced it, but I never had any sense of urgency to eat here. I got a 50% off DoorDash coupon to use during this "exciting" age of Covid-19, and decided to use it to finally try Mo Bettahs. Damn am I glad I did as it was fantastical. I got the huge platter called the Ekhulu plate or something like that. I know that's not how it's spelled but I'm writing this on my phone and am far too lazy to look it up. That came with the Katsu chicken, teriyaki steak, and something pig, along with rice, macaroni salad, and some Cole slaw. EVERYTHING on that plate was amazing. I mean it. The pork...just wow. The flavors coming out of it were intense. I mean, just so much flavor in every bite. Mixing some of that with a little teriyaki and rice...heaven. The steak was cooked perfectly and delicious, and then I was a little skeptical of the Katsu at first. The initial bite I had of it was small and super fried, so I thought the rest of it would be the same. Luckily I was wrong...the bugger pieces, which were way more numerous than the smaller ones, had perfectly cooked moist chicken inside the breading...it was just phenomenal. I mixed the macaroni salad with the Cole slaw and it turned into a tasty, refreshing side. Yum. 

I also got a separate giant platter of teriyaki chicken with rice and Mac salad and slaw. Cooked perfectly. Just slather on some teriyaki and it's one of the best meals you can have. 

Now if you know any of my reviews, I always talk about how much I love and crave large portions. This place had me smiling before I even tried anything. The Ekhulu plate (still spelled wrong probably) was HEAVY AS HECK right out of the bag! I LOVED it! It must have weighed a good two pounds or more! Also, the chicken plate was pretty hefty as well! 

Normally when I give a place a 5-star rating, I might have something minor that could be fixed at the end. In this case, I honestly can't think of anything. Not too pricy for the huge amount of amazing food that you get. Trust me, I'll be back here often!

Anti vaxxers and not wearing masks. Goodbye forever. Call and ask if you want to know for yourself, but we aren't comfortable getting spa treatments from anyone not vaccinated and not willing to wear a mask. I don't write this review to change anyone's mind on vaccination, rather just to provide information for people who also care about this issue.

I was looking for a bar and grill because I didn't want to cook dinner.

I sat at the bar, and ordered a drink and two orders of their Taco Tuesday special: Three tacos for $5. You have a choice of chicken, beef and pork. Since I asked for two orders, I got two tacos of each meat. Along with the meat, lettuce, tomato, cheese, and olives are on top, with a side of sour cream.

The meat was flavorful and juicy, and the tacos are definitely worth coming back for, if not for the price and atmosphere alone.

Two orders of 3 tacos + one soda = $12.72

While seated at the bar, I met the bartenders, Ana and Dutch. Extremely friendly and helpful. We got to talking and they shared with me the things to do in the Boise area since I'm new.

I will definitely be visiting this place again. If you need anymore incentive to check out Pauly's, the place is a former crematorium and is supposedly haunted!!
Love their "pancake of the month" -- April is carrot cake!!   Their staff is always friendly and attentive.  May be a wait on weekends, but totally worth it!

Chipotle has lost all credibility for good food fast. This is the second time I have come to this location to discover they are only taking online orders. I placed my order online it originally estimated 5-minutes. By the time i completed the order it was 10-minutes, fine. It took 25 minutes to get my order!!  

They have only two employees making orders in a side kitchen that is a mess!  I honestly wasn't sure I wanted to eat my food. 

Unfortunately I am done with Chipotle!!!  You need to value you customers time and live up to what you are promoting.
The wifi did not work well at all. Was disappointed because I went there to study. Also the environment isn't very cozy or comfortable. My drink was great though!

I really liked this bar. I went in close to closing and they offered us 1 beer before they closed an we were so thankful for that.  I needed to use the restroom before I left so I told the bar staff an my friends. They then told my friends to wait outside. I walk out of the bathroom an see my friends outside an can't get out. Unfortunately I was locked inside this bar and forced to run out the back through the fire escape. It was a funny story and not a big deal at all. We were having a good night, an the staff working was great. The next day when we went back to get the phone. The owner or whoever was the opener was super rude and very inconsiderate about the whole situation. I looked in the bathroom where I left it, and so did my friend and no phone so I looked outback to see if I dropped but it wasn't outside so we showed the guy the location on find my phone so we had proof my phone was in the building. All of a sudden he went to the bathroom and found the phone. I'm not making speculations about his character or this place but he was not apologetic or anything about the things that transpired. I found it so rude and disrespectful.

Pauly's has officially landed on my list of favorite Treasure Valley dive bars. The drinks, the food and the vibe are all totally up my alley. And let me tell ya, this place and it's patrons know how to have a damn good time. 

After freezing our asses off at the Meridian Christmas parade my friends and I strolled into Pauly's and were greeted by the friendliest servers who immediately took our drink orders. They aren't stingy with their booze. My Tanqueray and Tonic ($5.50) was STRONG AF. Everyone else I was with enjoyed their drinks. For food, I got myself a basket of Finger Steaks and Fries ($12.95). Holy shit this is exactly was my cold and drunk ass needed this Friday night. I enjoyed the whole thing and practically inhaled it unregretfully. The basket came with three sauces, ranch, fry sauce and horseradish ketchup (?). They were all amazing. The finger steaks themselves were delicious, not chewy whatsoever and perfectly fried. Fries were A1 as well. 

As it was Friday, we got to enjoy some fabulous karaoke. While I didn't participate it was so fun watching people stumble upstage and sing with so much power and might. SUCH A GOOD TIME!!! I would definitely return to Pauly's and recommend it to anyone. One of my new faves in downtown Meridian!

Spoiler Alert:   No gumbo or jambalaya. 
The three of us  all agreed it was great food.  Our server, Jacob, was great! 
A unique approach to the most common seafood boil. 
Was totally bummed they DONT serve gumbo or jambalaya. I dont recall seeing cornbread or a few other  staples.  
So --mor of .  a seafood joint than a cajun restraurant.  
Still a good addition to the area.

It is never great when you have mechanical problems with your diesel, and it's not if, but when, you do, I suggest you go to Gem State Diesel. They are honest, priced fair and keep their shop clean. Just an overall good experience with the folks at Gem State Diesel. I highly recommend Gem State Diesel for anyone needing repairs or just routine maintenance.

We were told 40 minutes wait time put our name on the list went inside at time they said  a family of 6 was in front of us with no waiting list and they were told 3 minutes it's been over 2 hours now and we're still 9th in line  total crap I have no idea how long it would be once inside and seated to get food  Atlas forget it going somewhere else  now it won't let me post

Prompt friendly service, great classic diner food prepared with excellence. Small, but efficient and they survived COVID!! Love the Veggie or Meat Lovers omelette, salsa and guacamole are flavorful without being too spicy. Coming back with family and friends!! Want to try the Cinnamon Roll French toast.

Wow, what an awesome bike shop! Serious, 45+ year road biker recently converted to MTB. Stopped by the shop (without an appointment) with a popped bead and some needed wheel work...and these guys stepped right up, took care of my repairs, answered all of my (novice) questions and sent me on my way "ready to roll."

If this is the kind of (incredible) service a new guy gets...well, wow, couldn't even imagine how well they treat their long term customers!

I'm a customer for life...check this shop out, you won't be disappointed.

Grouchy owner!  Owner was bartending but couldn't be bothered with greeting two new customers that walked up to the bar. Rather than say "hello, what can I get you" or some other rendition of a decent greeting he simply asked if he were sitting on the patio and told us to go get our drinks out there. WHY OWN A BAR IF YOU CAN'T HAVE DECENT CUSTOMER SERVICE?!?!  I totally understand if you want to help your server out to get the tip, but there is a good way to handle that conversation and a bad way. He chose the bad way. Thank goodness he has nice servers.
Food was all soggy, none of the bread was toasted, bacon was soggy, and there was no flavor to anything. Worst breakfast i've had in a long time. Our server was great though!

The server was nice and friendly. The salad was hardy.  

The lobster bisque was very bland without any evidence of lobster. The clam chowder also without much flavor but did have a few pieces of minced clam.  The muscle and shrimp with linguine was just ok...nothing to be impressed by.  Maybe should have tried the seafood in a bag as many were served.

I've been hunting for a reliable men's haircut place in Meridian and have tried several with disappointing results until I decided to give this place a shot. It's not as flashy as some of the others, but I can usually get in within a reasonable amount of time, the stylist I've had acts professional, and I always walk out with a quality haircut.

We recently had 2 diamond rings appraised at Lee Read Jewelers (value $13,500).  One was removed from the setting to obtain a more accurate appraisal.  It was returned to us in a little plastic bag, which was inside their logo'd paper bag.  On April 30th, I stopped by to see if they had a display box that we could put the loose diamond in for an estate auction.  They brought a small black acrylic box from the safe, saying it was one of their old display boxes.  It was definitely used, and I was not able to photograph that the top acrylic was scuffed.  While I was telling them that was exactly what I was looking for - a lady said that would be $10.60.  I about choked.  This looked like a dollar store box.  I wish I would have had time to go elsewhere, but I was on a tight schedule to deliver the diamond for the auction.  

I thought it was tacky for them to return the diamond in a plastic bag in the first place, but wanting $10 (plus tax) for this used box was just greed and not good business.  I certainly didn't expect it for free, but I didn't expect to be taken advantage of like that.

We have had rings re-sized at Lee Reed's in the past, and have considered making future jewelry purchases from them (supporting local business), but not anymore.

Two photos are attached to Lee Read Jewelers page - one showing the box, and the other showing my receipt.

TL;DR: Bland, expensive, great customer service

First, the employees here are extremely friendly and provide great customer service. They even carry your order to your table, or bring it to you if you're carrying out.

Second, this place is pricey. For a 12" Italian sub, chips, and a SMALL drink, my total came out to $14 and change. Not the place to go if you're pitching pennies. 

Third, the flavor of the sandwich was very bland. The meat wasn't seasoned and the marinara tasted like straight tomato sauce. I tried my buddy's fries and even they were plain without seasoning.

My coworkers and I decided we probably won't be back unless we have a BOGO coupon.

This was a rough day for this chipotle. I'm definitely gonna avoid this chipotle in the area since there are other chipotles in the area. It starts off with the worker skimping on the beans and rice. I noticed they did that for the customer in front of me and behind me as well. I've never had a chipotle burrito this tiny. Then they were out of fajita veggies and pico de gallo. I got there at 8:30 and they still had 1.5 hours till closing. You shouldn't be running out of these ingredients that earlier. The workers were clearly new or untrained since they kept struggling to wrap burritos for customers in front of me and behind me. If you want chipotle and are in the area avoid this one.

Why do I have to order a full pound of seafood?  While I like seafood, I shouldn't be forced to order more than I want or can eat!!

My question above wasn't answered..all I got was a blanket reply!!!

My sons and I were looking for a new place to try tonight for dinner and il Sugo popped up in my search. When we arrived it was a smaller location, but not cramped, with interesting decor. They were busy, but not packed, and we were sat right away. We started with the Bruschetta as an appetizer. The bread was fluffy yet crusty and the tomatoes with pesto sauce what a good blend of sweet and herb flavors. For my entree, I got the Hearty Bolognese over Pappardelle. It was flavorful and definitely a comfort food. Both of my sons ordered the il Sugo, one over papardelle and the other over fettuccine. It was a mushroom, shredded pork and cream sauce dish, and I liked it more than what I ordered. It reminded me of a cross between a stroganoff and an Alfredo dish. Our waitress was very friendly and I'd look forward to eating there again in the future.

Idaho Folks, Erick is the best detailer in all the land! He also does beautiful ceramic coating work! He detailed our kid/dog Prius and took it from good condition to very good condition for us to sell. The paint on the Prius was thin, so Erick made the expert decision to only buff it once because a second go might damage the paint (consulting us along the way), but because two were included in the package, he detailed our engine instead. He also put a ceramic coating on our Tesla Model 3 and it looks incredible. Erick is super friendly, efficient and professional. He also offers white glove concierge service. Can't say enough good things!

I rented from Park Place Property Management from June 30, 2015 -September 23rd, 2016. During my time renting, I had some troubles with the constant change of property managers, which had changed 4 different times while I was renting, all of which neglected to introduce themselves in any way to at least let me know who my property manager was, or even that my property manager had changed in general.

A few of the employees at Park Place Property Management are not fully equipped to conduct their job title (lack the management skills and customer service) which I had the pleasure of having to deal with a few issues with these employees. 

However, after a list of Employees I did meet and had a rough time with, one employee was super helpful, considerate, on track of handling issues and very understanding from the renters perspective, If you need anything handled or just want the best customer service from Park Place Property Management, contact Zoe Durr. She was VERY helpful in helping me come to a mutual resolution with the issues I had and it was usually someone I looked forward to talking to instead of feeling stressed or bothered that I had to have to go back and forth to have an issue resolved. Absolute amazing and understanding customer service.

Always impressed with this place and their food is 100% comfort food...If you like mac and cheese, get their Mac and cheese bites...I literally lived for these things for like 6 months straight and came in , AT LEAST twice a week and ordered them. Service is always good, food is always out quick. Definitely in my top 3 favorite restaurants

This is about as far as you can get from Cajon food as Idaho is from Louisiana. 1st, I have never had to pay for hush puppies. Hush puppies are something that is brought to your table when you are seated but yet you charge $7 for about the equivalent to a piece of corn bread. 2nd don't get me wrong I understand we are in Idaho but the south doesn't have snow crab or salmon and it not like you can't get flounder here. Considering everything is going to be frozen anyway. And 3rd how can't you serve a captains platter? The staple of a good southern meal. Flounder, Oysters, and shrimp prepared fried, steamed, or baked in any combination one may choose. Come on man!

Attempted to eat at Hook & Reel. Called to verify they were open and asked to be put on waiting list. Was informed to put myself on waiting list via Yelp app when we were on our way. This is what I did. Arrived at location and was informed that wait time was double what Yelp indicated because restaurant only running at 50% capacity because of COVID. Therefore a 45-60 minute wait on a Saturday night at 7 pm and I could wait outside in 100 degree heat. No chairs outside. We left and ate somewhere else. Irritated that they could not give me more adequate information over the phone. They are not the only restaurant that has such a problem. I guess I will have to ask every detail that I really want to know when I make the effort to call first.

Been here a few times and the food is pretty good although the the place is pretty loud.  Meridian has some very good breakfast places and I would put this one in the middle.

Clean and the staff is very nice.

Excellent customer service!
I dropped my knife off to get sharpened, when I came back the next day to pick it up.
They said it was on the House, free of charge!
Thank you!!!!

The worst massage I've ever received.  I fell for the Groupon because it was so cheap, but you get what you pay for.  My "one hour" massage was only 45 minutes.  I asked the massage therapist several times to use deep pressure, and she did for a minute or two, but then went back to barely putting pressure again, plus she didn't focus on the areas that I asked her to.  My back still hurts and the muscles are still tight.  Avoid this place if you want a good massage!

Very disappointed. This place is usually good but today it was off its mark. I don't know if the business is down sizing their portions or what. We ordered the mini mix with Kahlua pig and Katsu chicken.  Pig portion was 3 little bites. Whats the point of the mix if you don't make it proportionally worth it. Check your order before you bring it home. Staff also was more into helping the Door dash personnel then actual customers there to place an order. Customer service is gone. Unbelievable.

I have short hair and was looking for someone that would really listen and look at what I wanted (yes, I always bring a picture or 2 or 3 or 10). I have been looking  and trying other places and have finally found the one. 

The salon is beautiful, clean and offers full salon services. This is so nice so I don't have to run here and there for my nails, hair, massage and eyelashes... I love it!

My stylist, Melissa was ready and waiting as I walked in (impressive, since most are always running behind). She asked and listened to what I wanted and then looked at the pics I showed her. She took her time and checked with me throughout the process to see if I wanted more off here or there and gave me just what. I asked for. It was so nice to have someone who knew what she was doing and took the time to ensure I was happy with my cut.

I am looking forward to my next cut and trying other services here too.

I don't think I have ever given a pizza place 5 stars, but this place deserves it!
A couple of years ago I saw Flying Pie Pizzaria featured on an episode on Man Vs. Food. I thought the pizza looked good, but since I lived in California, I never thought I would have the opportunity to try it. Fast forward to present day....I now live in Idaho & the Meridian Flying Pie is less than 5 miles from my house.  Saturday night date night with the hubby brought us to Flying Pie. 
We arrived at around 7:30. As we opened the door to the restaurant we were hit with the glorious smell of delicious pizza. There was an employee who explained to us how the process of ordering is done:
1. Grab a menu
2. Seat yourself
