3. Review the menu & decide what you want to order
4. Go back to the register and order & pay for your pizza

I really liked being able to take all the time I needed to look over the menu without worrying about holding up the line at the cash register. 

We ordered 2 medium pizzas:
# 2 pizza without onions or peppers
Pepperoni and pineapple

Flying Pie offers a discount of 50% off your second medium or large pizza. They also give you free breadsticks if you dine in. The total for the 2 pizzas, breadsticks, & 1 soda was $28.

The wait time for our pizzas was not bad, it was about 25 minutes. While we waited they brought our breadsticks to nosh on.  When the pizzas arrived they looked & smelled delicious! They were loaded with toppings & had the perfect amount of cheese. The crust was nothing short of perfection. It had a nice crisp bottom & the right amount of chew.  I could pick up a slice and hold it up and it wouldn't drop down. The crust was able to maintain its integrity under all of the toppings. The sauce was also great. 

I highly recommend Flying Pie. It will not disappoint.

Coming from a different perspective, I am a property owner who didn't want to sell my house when I transferred out of state. I found Park Place (Now called Home River) online. I wish I had looked around longer. in 10 months, I have had 6-7 Case Managers. None have stuck around long enough for me to memorize their names. Their turnover suggests this is NOT a happy place to work. They rarely answer the phone and I expect they must not be very accessible to the tenants either. My monthly statements are often missing funds with no explanation. This month, it is already the 13th and I have received nothing from them at all. This is the last straw. I am giving them the boot and replacing them with someone who actually wants to do the job. Real Estate is a huge expenditure and much too important to trust to people who obviously don't care about your money.

We've been with Park Place for a year now and have nothing but great things to say. Our house is beautiful and anytime we have a problem, which isn't often, they come right out. We moved from Atlanta GA to Boise and they also made that transition very smooth for us. If you see the Park Place logo you can rest assure they will take care of you. 
For the unhappy people who posted below...I'll call their bluff. There's no way they can be this easy to work with and have problems like they are saying. Guess some people just aren't happy.

Ordered twice in two days , I spent about 300 each tome for our family . The food is definitely worth it . The snow crab legs were great and fresh you can customized your order as well . Definitely one of my favorite places in Idaho  .

Absolutely terrible. I ordered the Apple Pie. The cinnamon roll was cold and hard. I specifically asked when it was made and the kid said it was fresh out the oven...I don't like being lied to. The apples were not even cooked! The frosting is disgusting. Very disappointed.
I sent a message over yelp and they responded very quickly with an nominal quote. Excellent service and took care of our needs! Thank you!

I give a 10 Star rating to Dynamic Detailing and highly recommend!  The quote from Erick was almost instant and the service and detailing was awesome!  In addition to the interior and exterior detailing they also restored the headlights on my car. It was all so easy;from picking up my car at my work and delivering to my home and -ON TIME!  Will definitely be a return customer and so pleased from start to finish.  No need to look further!
Le peep? More like le poop...  food was nasty and customer service was weird. Very unprofessional setting

I was referred to Cecyle at Deja Brew by a mutual friend.  I was planning a large gathering at my home and did not want to do the food.  Cecyle made it easy and the food was wonderful.  She had lots of options and was able to provide great food for my guests including vegetarians.   There was a huge platter of marinated veggies that I liked but would have preferred some fresh veggies also.  I learned a lot and will know better next time what I want.  If I needed a caterer again I would definitely call Cecyle.

I'm giving this place 4 stars, but I feel it's more like 3.5 stars. 
I had the beef tacos that came with a side of corn, and rice.
When our food came everyone , was like wow that looks good.  The taste though was that of total blandness. Just not good. I'm giving this place 4 stars, because I had some of the others food, and it was good. 

Couple of suggestions

1. Season the beef , it had no flavor.

2. With the corn, add a little butter, and come up with a seasoning like a mixture of salt, Chile powder, onion powder, garlic powder, etc; you get my drift. just mix up some spices and come up with something good. Just not overpowering.

3. Would of been nice if the tacos came with some kinda hot sauce or salsa. Something! they were kinda dry.

Alright then. Not good not bad. Just tweak the recipe a little. Make it juicy add some heat and flavor.

I've had many memberships to gyms and have faced every single underhanded tactic they will use to screw your of money. Up to this point, axiom in the Village, has done nothing other than exceed my expectations. 

The equipment is new and in great condition. The space is large, and while crowded, I've never felt judged or out of place. 

I personally love the younger crowd that frequents this gym. It's fun and friendly place to work out and meet new like minded people. I wish the yoga room was free access with a membership, but it's not. Def a disadvantage there. 

Overall I love this gym and location.  Recommend it to everyone.

2 stars just for the Turkey and Brie sandwich. It was soggy, with maybe 2 thin slices Turkey, a teaspoon of Brie on each half of the sandwich and maybe 4 very thin slices of apple. That was it. No flavor really. Finishing it out with an overcooked chocolate chip cookie. Not a great meal.

I paid 23 dollars after tip for my meal. The staff was friendly enough, when I received my fries, for some reason 10 minutes before I received my sandwich, they were cold and bland. They tasted as if they had been sitting out for over an hour, when I tried the sandwich (the bomb/steak) I was extremely disappointed, so bland, no seasoning, the steak was chewy, to much Mayo, I had a hard time eating it to be honest. I always try to keep it local which is why I went here, on a Friday afternoon, but, will never be back.

The management at this gym needs to take full responsibility for it's overall condition versus tell patrons to submit issues on line,  the gym is dirty, pool is very dirty, equipment needs more attention and maintenance, clean dry towels to wipe down equipment after use are non existent most of the time and need replaced way more often.   Members I have talked too are fed-up with the excuses and lack of action to clean and maintain the gym, sure the gym is busy that's a good thing so management should make sure maintenance and cleanliness keeps pace.  I only see one lady cleaning and doing her best to keep up but she needs help to stay on top of issues.  I see lots of people at desks and only one working hard on the floor.  So, management get out from behind the desk and out and about with your eyes and ears open to the real world.  Try asking around about what you can do to keep the gym in great shape, you might just get an ear full both positive and negative comments. Don't try to defend just listen and take notes..
Thanks,

Don't rent from them. This is a pathetic excuse for a rental company. When I moved out of my rental(after 7 years) they sent me a bill with all the receipts for everything they had to pay for cleaning and maintenance and expected me to pay 100%, this was over 1000$ on top of my deposit. 650$ for a cleaning fee and over 800$ in maintenance, yet they had someone else completely moved in and living there 2 days after I moved out, makes sense. I originally rented from park place and apparently they lost my move in inspection documents when the owner switched property managers 4 years later, so now this company wants to charge me for items things that were there when I moved in. Park Place is an atrocious property manager but 100% go to them not AIM, because you will have far less issues. Now I have to pay my attorney to deal with this, better than giving them my money, I guess. Also, review the comments they leave back on their negative reviews trying to justify the fact that they don't know what they're doing, they attempt to belittle or shame their customers to make themselves look better. Completely unprofessional and petty, absolutely not a company to do business with. There is a reason why this company has 2 stars and this many reviews, the reason is the company not the customers. Seriously, go to Park Place, they are bad, but they're not this bad.

This is literally the worst company I've ever dealt with. In my opinion, they are only in it for the money. I've been treated very rudely by them a number of times. Take your business elsewhere. There are better options than this horrible company.

As one of the Italian-American yelpers, I really hate reviewing Italian restaurants, because I'm always overly critical. My wife and I came on a date, the place was very nicely appointed, we had some wine, the Proscuitto & Mozerella, and Arancini as appetizers. My wife had the Filet Mignon pasta and I had the Puttanesca. My wife was thrilled with her entree, me not so much, but I should know not to order a Puttanesca on the first try at a restaurant. The pasta was not al dente and a Puttanesca is about all the elements of the dish in balance, and they let the olives overwhelm the dish. Other than the pasta, which was disappointing, everything else was great, and my wife's reviews were glowing. So we'll say the place is Good. Next time, I'll try something else and tell them to make it al dente, and if they don't know what that means, as Nono used to say "yah see, then we're gonna have a few problems paisan."

I recently went down to Utah to the mecca of knife stores (Blade HQ) almost as a pilgrimage. It was an awesome experience to see the massive selection and the passion and knowledge behind the counter. Driving back to Idaho, I griped about how cool it would be if Idaho had such a place... Ladies and gents, Idaho has such a place. It's called Northwest Knives and the knowledge, passion and professionalism behind the counter is Aaron, the sure to be proud owner of the company. Who needs Blade HQ?

Jeff and his team provided excellent service in the sale of our home. His careful research and insights helped us price our home perfectly so that it sold faster than we were expecting. Once under contract, we were guided from start to finish with quick responses to our many questions. In the end, we were able to close early and had a very smooth transition. I highly recommend Jeff for anyone looking to buy or sell a home in the Treasure Valley.

My friend recommended this place to me. Until last Friday, I had no clue that this place existed and until I went in there, I honestly could not remember the last time I had a cinnamon roll. I think, seriously, it was in high school. Restaurant back then we used to go to after school dances..called, Perkins, haha! I'm sure some remember that place. It was the best! And they had incredible cinnamon rolls lol.
So last Friday, we went to the Village to see Bohemian Rhapsody. It was sold out. Boo! 
We left to head to another theater and I said to my girl, Alex...omg, that's the place Jade told me about. 
Alex is like...we are going! It's amazing. 

I'm a super picky eater. So I get to the counter and said to the girl "I'll take the basic bitch cinnamon roll" She laughed and knew right away the one I wanted hahaha. I turn to my right and see these enormous brownies. 
For YEARS I stayed far, far, FAR away from brownies. Just thought they were disgusting. 
Took a photography class a couple years ago and the last class, the professor brought in brownies.
Timmy's 25 year hiatus from brownies had officially.....come to an end. I TORE UP them brownies hahaha!
My mom makes them every year when I'm home for Christmas. I never ate them. Now? Well, let's just say....I, umm, 'enjoy' them haha!

So this place has enormous brownies. End pieces, are my favorite...probably that way for a lot of us lol.

Ok, the Cinnamon roll did NOT disappoint! Like, not even in the slightest! I was like a really happy fat kid tearing through that thing. I loved every second of it and was terribly sad when it was all gone. Again, I felt like a little fat kid who gets sad when his candy is all gone haha! I probably felt extra sad about it because I haven't had one in almost 20 years and I am SO. GLAD. that my return to cinnamon rolls was one from this place. 
The rolls are so damn tasty! The staff, she was SO friendly and so sweet! One of the best employees of a place that I've come across in a long time. 

BACK to the brownie. They are like.$2.50. The size is worth it, the taste... not so much, lol.
I ate the brownie the next day. It's like super moist, but not...if that makes sense. It fell apart into millions of pieces when I bit into it ‍‍ haha! 
It tasted like a piece of chocolate cake. The only brownie tasting bit...was the top part of it, the end piece. I dunno, that's just my two cents on the brownies hahaha! 
And yeah, last Friday was my "extra" cheat day hahaha! Fridays are always my cheat day, but last Friday, I went a little crazy hahaha! Cinnamon roll, pizza, cheesy garlic breed AND cherry coke and junior mints at the movie hahahaha! 
I say this in other reviews, we ALL deserve cheat days like that. No harm in it. If you take care of yourself/your body....indulging once in awhile os fine. 
Don't you love how I'm trying to justify my piggish ways, hahahaha! Seriously tho, no harm in having treats like that.

This place is amazing. I will DEFINITELY go back! It's worth every penny....the cinnamon rolls are 
My friend got the cinnamon rolls, pumpkin spice something or other. A girl getting pumpkin spice...shocker! Hahahaha! Just kidding, ladies...even tho you guys do love you some pumpkin spice stuff hahaha! 
I'm talking shit when I ordered the basic bitch cinnamon roll hahahahaha!

Check this place out if you haven't already! It's pretty amazing!

Thanks so much for reading, Yelpereees!!!


Cheers!

We came here for toddler time and when we arrived there were 150 high school kids there as well. Toddler time is advertised on their website and Facebook page as every Friday from 10-12 for kids 5 and under. They told us before we paid that the older kids would be jumping as well so we could decide if we wanted to stay. We stayed because you cannot tell a 3 year old that has been excited to come jump for days that we are leaving and not jumping. If a big group is coming during a designated time for toddlers they should have posted it on their Facebook page. 

My son jumped a little but the older kids were running around and not looking out for the little kids. If we wanted to be there with a bunch of older kids who don't pay attention we would go during normal jump times.

Ordered delivery. The photos online are what I'd consider to be "false advertising". Quantity and presentation were sub-standard for the high price. Containers were filled 2/3 full. Salad greens were past their prime. Wilted and dark on edges. Avocado should have been in the trash and not on my salad. Tomatoes had stem portions attached and flesh was green inside. Stick with local restaurants and avoid this chain. More than disappointed. There are so many other quality places from which to order lunch.

From the beginning to the end I had an absolutely wonderful experience. I initially spoke to Cary on the phone. He was very friendly and super informative. He took the time to explain the differences of glass quality and how they operate as a company. He didn't bad mouth any other companies. They made an appointment immediately to come to my place of work so I didn't have to ruin my whole day. When the technician, Luke Hooper, got to Bish's RV, where I work, they were very fast and efficient. What an absolutely pleasurable and professional company to work with. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for windshield repair. Thanks Glass Doctor, you guys are the BOMB!

Great customer service, flower selection, and prices! I also really liked their website and when I called to confirm delivery, they answered right away and helped me. 
Giving 4 stars ONLY because the flowers started to die the day after delivery. However, the Flower Place made it right, and went above and beyond to deliver a new arrangement right away. It was my Grandmother's 80th birthday, so these were very important flowers. Showing pictures of when they were delivered, when they died, and when they were replaced. 
I would absolutely recommend the Flower Place to anyone looking for a local delivery! Thank you for replacing the first flower arrangement!

Great neighborhood pub with EXCELLENT food. Like walking into Cheers bar - several "Norms" included. 
Giant, hand pressed burgers and hand cut fries. Friendly service by Michelle and it's nice to hear "Hi Hon, will it be the regular?" And a full bar to boot.

I have ordered from this location on multiple occasions and it's been good but not great. I ordered tonight and I always order the same pizza and I'm not w
sure it's even from this pizza place that's how different it is. I've ordered from their Boise location as well and you get tons more pepperoni and it's overall a much better pizza but I can only get that through Uber eats and not DoorDash and often times Uber Eats wants to charge 6 to 7 dollars for delivery from the tastier location which is ridiculous. Anyways tonight's pizza was almost in edible. Dry, very little sauce and cheese and I didn't get all the toppings I paid for. I won't ever order from this location ever again.

The Flower Place did an amazing job delivering quality arrangements for a reasonable price for my moms celebration of life. We will definitely be a long time supporter of this flower shop. Excellent service!

I recently relocated to Meridian and needed to find a salon.  I went to Yelp to read a lot of reviews and decided to try Casa Bella Salon.  Looking through all the bios of the stylists on their web site, I chose Savanna as she specialized in blonde hair.  Sometimes a risk pays off.  The risk of an unknown stylist without a personal recommendation is very scary.  Savanna did a fantastic job matching my root color and styling my hair.... all while being super personable to chat with.  I will absolutely be back to see her in the future.  And, the icing on the cake, she takes Venmo.  There is literally nothing more I could ask for.  Savanna is a Yelp gem that I'm going to share with others..... hoping she remembers I was the first to write a review for her specifically (so i can still get appointments with her).
Had a worker shortage like it seems everywhere else in the great Northwest but the food was good.  If you like SoCal Del Taco you will like this one too.

Park Place Property took over management of home and in Castle Hills Subdivision that is been an embarrassing eyesore the past 10 years. The overall effect on neighborhood property values has been significant.  After multiple calls over several years to Ada County officials, Park Place Property Management and the the actual property owners, Dolan and Elizabeth Keeney, it appear PPPM and Keeney's have no concern for the neighborhoods in which they operate. Slum lord might be the best summation.

I took my goldendoodle pup here twice. Both times he had a ring around his neck from the noose being so tight on him. The second time I brought him in he started shaking uncontrollably I'm the car. He peed when I walked him inside. Both times picking him up he peed when he saw me. Marnie was the groomer. I felt so guilty taking my dog there, something was not right. 
Now we go to a different groomer - been with them for 3 1/2 years. Both of my dogs love them, jump in their arms and never pee, never shake or have noose lines around their neck.

We just moved into our new Tresidio home in Star and my husband and I couldn't be happier. We made our design selections a few weeks before the pandemic stay-at-home orders in CA and were unable to travel the entire time our home was being built. Project manager Joe Lords was fantastic--he video chatted with us weekly and posted lots of photos to the Tresidio portal so we could see the progress on the home and he was very responsive to all of our questions. 

I also want to give a shout out to the design team. Their new design studio is amazing--they had samples of everything and we were able go online in advance of our meeting and make preliminary choices that we finalized in person. I thought it was going to be quite daunting, but it was a lot of fun. I cannot imagine having to go to each vendor to make choices.

We are just thrilled with our home and with the team that built it - from the design and project team to all of the vendors they used throughout the process. I highly recommend Tresidio Builders. Feel free to reach out to me with questions if you are considering building with them!

What a special find!
Driving up to a little neighborhood strip mall,  you never quite know what to expect.  But this little gem has the appeal of a quaint little Italian Cafe, ambiance and decor done perfectly!  We were pleasantly surprised to find a full bar in addition to a wonderful selection of wine.   The bar area opens up to a small outdoor seating area which will be perfect for dropping by for an app and a glass of vino. 
The food is delicious.  We had the bruschetta which was packed with garlic fresh flavors! So good. 
Then we each had another flavorful pasta - Spicy Arrabbiata and the Il Sugo, both which were delicious.  The pastas were fresh and hearty. And very nice portions!
Lastly,  we met the owner/chef. What an engaging and nice man.  His dream of having a place for couples to enjoy an evening out does not disappoint.   We will definitely be back!

Despite what their Recording says when you call them, this dining room is not open. They need to update that because it clearly says that their dining room is now open. It's not. We've been here two weekends in a row now and have to get our food at the drive up. The employees are doing their best however. It's just ridiculous how many establishments don't have enough employees and are trying to hire. Seems like a lot of people don't want to work right now

I have been coming to this beautiful salon for a couple of months and have extremely happy with my new hair stylist, Melissa.  It has only taken her 2 visits for her to grasp exactly what I like and she just "makes it happen" perfectly.  

I recently had an eyelash lift and tint with Janea who is absolutely wonderful.  I was amazed at great my lashes looked after the process and love her beautiful room, with the relaxing spa music and heated table she has....ahhhh.  After a long day at work, this was a wonderful and relaxing way to end my day.  She is great at what she does and is so friendly and professional, I immediately felt relaxed letting her do the lift and tint.  I am so happy to have finally found a salon that offers everything and has true professionals that "know" what they're doing.

I definitely recommend this salon for anyone looking for great service, great atmosphere and decor, and professionals that know what they're doing.

This is a great brunch spot! I have been a few times and every time it is a great experience. They are always busy but luckily you can call and reserve a seat before you head over. They also take your number and text you where you are in line and give an estimated wait time. They have mimosas that are pretty good. They also have an espresso machine that makes some specialty coffees.  I have had quite a few of the breakfast foods and they have all been good. The breakfast enchiladas are to die for. Everyone who works here is very attentive and friendly. Our waitress was very attentive and took extra care of the little one we had with us. She brought out the babies food ASAP and even gave her a little bowl of fruit while she waited. Great service and great food!!
Pictures speak volumes. Keep an eye out for IG specials. Stacey was delightful. Plan on a min of 90 mins. I'll be back for my touch up in 6 months for sure

It's sugar gets a five star rating based on the fact that they know what they are and they do it right. 

Staff Is helpful and will help you find special treats of gift ideas. 
 The bins are great with a ton of variety. I don't have much of s sugar tooth, but I can appreciate the work this business has put into bringing a unique candy store to the village.

I went in for a cut and was reassigned to a different stylist due to illness. That was fine but what I asked for wasn't done. I was told the cut I wanted would "look choppy." I asked for thinning because I've had a lot of pain when I put my hair up (thick hair) and that didn't happen. The stylist basically gave me a blunt trim. Then without asking first, she curled my hair and used a ton of hairspray. 
I also felt like she was super rough. Without brushing my hair, she ripped her fingers through it a lot and then told me it was tangling because my hair is damaged. 
I honestly just wish they'd communicate more, and ask questions if they don't understand what their client wants. Also, the constant shilling of extra services is a bit much. If I'm coming in for a haircut, I obviously don't want you to dye it or try to upsell me to do more. A small mention is fine, but if I decline just leave it alone. 
I feel like I paid for nothing. Not returning. 

Pros: the facility is nice and I didn't have to wait long for my appointment to begin.

It has been one year since we moved into our Tresidio home (Davenport plan) in Star. We stumbled across this builder on the internet and kept falling in love with the practical plans and floor layouts. We were lucky enough to build this home from dirt up and had control over our design choices. The builder provided an internet tool to prepare ourselves for the detailed in person design selection. The tool was nice to have and was often updated with new choices such as paint and fixtures. The design center team was remarkable as we had a chance to see and modify our online selections. We were assigned a project manager and the home building process began. I was so impressed with their repeatable methodology and planning for home building. Joe Lords was our assigned project manager who kept us apprised of build status weekly and even after key hand off.  All our warranty issues were addressed timely. We appreciate the quality of the product and Tresidio being so patient with us in building our new forever home. We couldn't be happier.

Totally ripped us off with the small print. Don't tell you until a day or 2 before that they're coming. Tech came today while I was at work. Charged my wife $90 for a 6 zone yard because I have 4 additional hose hookups that account for 4 of the zones. These are not hard to access and are easier to blow out than the regular sprinklers! I paid another company $40 last year and I guarantee it took them longer last year than it these guys this year. I even talked to the guy on the phone as he was starting and he thought nothing of mentioning the $60 extra it was going to cost as I was telling him exactly what needed to be done. This is obviously how these guys make any profit in this business. I would have kicked them off the property myself if they had quoted that to me in person. Mailboxes are full when you try to call so you can't talk to anyone.  I was able to text them but they are just citing their small print and stating that it's not their issue. Their small print is extremely long, probably because they've added to it year after year when customers complain. If you have anything other than a plain Jane sprinkler system, do not use these rip off artists.

And in response to his response...2 of these "extra hookups" we're literally about 10 feet from where his truck was parked. So I don't buy his "back and forth" excuse for the high charges.  It should be based on actual work done not just an over arching policy. Yeah, they did things "by their book". I never claimed they didn't. But I did read their terms and obviously didn't realize my connections would be considered extra.  I'm sure with much more complicated properties such charges may be worthy. For our property it is a scam for them to make up money that they don't make on the quick $30 jobs. They will always chalk it up to "you agreed to the terms" but that does make it morally or professionally right.

This is probably my favorite Chipotle. Staff was super friendly and restaurant was very clean. Portion size was perfect ( Not to little and Not to large). Thank you for restoring my faith in fast food.

I walked-in this morning - grateful that they accept walked-ins. I had Jessica cut my hair. I asked her what my preferences are and she exceptionally delivered my expectations. She was also a great conversationalist and even gave some recommendations on food trips. Their salon adheres to cleanliness and safety.

I love my haircut. I am grateful to visit their Salon. Thank you Jessica. More power to your salon. Happy New Year - I wish you guys all the best.

I have been buying my meat at Greenfields for several years and noticed the quality has changed and not for the better. Twice in the last few months I have had grissell and fat on my Tenderloin steaks. I don't mind paying a premium price, but I expect premium meat, which I used to get from Greenfields. I was talking to a neighbor, who I had recommended GF to. He has had the same experiences. I wondered why I didn't recognize any of the employees, and every time I go in there are different people working. I will be looking for a new meat source.

Clam chowder is thin and just ok. Crab cake basket was not bad but by the time I got sauce it was cold. My Chardonnay at $8.50 a glass was warm, when I said that next glass came with ice.  My husband had a margarita, marginal at best!  Beer next and it was flat. 
Don't recommend.

I am sad to give only 3 stars, but I had an unfortunate experience this afternoon. I only received 3 of the 4 meals I bought for my family that was in town. The order was delivered fast but missing a large item, and the bag even had 2 receipts attached, they were correct but the food was not.

When I called to let them know they said they were to busy for the manager to jump on a quick call and to leave a message. I get being busy....but really. 

My family said the food was delicious, but I did not eat so I will take their word for it.

While I really want to give 1 star for this experience, I understand things happen. But It was the lack of caring or acknowledgment from the management team that will take my business else where.

We've always heard that Express Cafe is the place to go for diner food. Finally one morning, when I wanted biscuits and gravy, we decided to give it a go. From the outside, it looks pretty sketchy, but the staff was so friendly and it had a great diner atmosphere. The biscuits and gravy were great, but my favorite part was the crispy bacon and the homemade cake donuts. We will definitely be back!

I am new to the area and I was lucky enough to find a great hair stylist in Emily.  She knows what's she's doing with hair color, low lights, and high lights.  She listened to what I wanted for my hair and answered all of my questions, as well as giving me some great advice!  She took her time and did not make me feel rushed at all.  She likes what she does and that is a very good thing!  Thank you, Emily!  I will be back!

Always a fan. These guys do so very well with my skittish senior dog. Friendly, professional, and cheerful folks. There is a good reason it's hard to get an appointment and well worth calling ahead to get one, *especially* if your dog doesn't like getting groomed! Highly recommended.

Had dinner again with out of town family. Another great meal and experience. The Cajun boils are tasty and a fun way to get your seafood fix. Fair price and friendly wait staff.  This was our fourth visit with no bad experiences or nasty food. Nice job!
No need to blame COVID for bad service. 
Cheers.

HOLY GRAVY, BATMAN! That would be Alfred's reaction if him and Bruce Wayne were eating at Deja Brew which would unfortunately give away Batman's secret identity, however Mr. Wayne would be forgiving after he tried the gravy and realized that Alfred's reaction was completely involuntary and justified. If nothing else, this is how I felt after I tried their phenomenal gravy, which may have been the best breakfast gravy I've ever had. 

Now the fact that this place was amazing is double good news for me because when I went, it was the first time me and the family went to a sit-down restaurant and stayed there to eat since before the pandemic, even if we were out on the patio. And I mean the WHOLE family as my parents and brother were visiting for the first time in well over a year. 

Now I'll speak to what I ordered as well as the lady cause those are the only things I tried, as cool as it would have been to start picking things off my parents plate with a fork like I was spear fishing or something. After we ordered with the super sweet southern waitress, I was handed Bobby's Breakfast Bowl, which was their home fries with bacon covered in their gravy with two scrambled eggs on top and some toast on the side. Home fries were crisp and flavorful had plenty of onions and peppers. Same with the bacon, while the eggs were scrambled nicely or something like that. Now while all this would have been pretty good by itself, THAT GRAVY THO!!! I can't even explain to you how good the gravy at this joint is. I think it was a sausage gravy, but whatever it was, we were told it's homemade and not thrown together with a sauce mix or packet or whatever. It's just...epic. It was perfect with EVERYTHING on my plate. Like everything. The lady got a breakfast burrito looking thing which was good by itself, but then it came with a BOWL OF THEIR GRAVY ON THE SIDE! I LOVE THIS JOINT! I tried a bite by dipping the whole burrito in the gravy and just took down a gaping mouthful and that gravy immediately made it a top-5 breakfast burrito I've ever had. I'm telling you...go here and get anything with their gravy. It's so damn good. I'm so happy I'm within walking distance because this has certainly become a place I shall frequent for breakfast or brunch and one day order enough gravy to pour it on my head and dance around like a king.

My family and I were invited to this church (April 2021) by some friends we went to high school with many years ago. It has changed our lives. We've never felt
The presence of the active Holy Spirit as we do here. This church loves to WORSHIP and they take it seriously!  Our kids love the children's ministry. We love our small groups. Our prayer lives have become abundant. We're in the Word and journaling every day. Pastor Mark and the other Pastors on staff are authentic and full of wisdom! We LOVE this church. It's an answered prayer!

We were in Boise for the night and our trusty Yelp app helped us find another awesome breakfast spot.  
I got an original breakfast and asked for my potatoes and bacon crispy, and they were perfect. 
My son got stuffed french toast, and it had ricotta and cream cheese in it with orange and lemon zest.  It was unique and very tasty!  It was probably my favorite thing on the table.  
My daughter said her waffle was the best she'd ever had.  Breakfast win!  Her giant chocolate milk wasn't bad, either.  (Vacation, am I right?)

Stopped in on a Sunday for a quick lunch.  We walked in, past the patio, there was a clean open table, we asked to be seated outside but the hostess stated it was full, so we were seated inside at a booth.  Looked at the menu, we just wanted a simple burger, I asked the price and she had to check with the chef to see what it would be, we ordered the burger, it came with a side of fries, it wasn't bad.  The service really needs to step it up, it felt like they hadn't been trained and seemed a little confused on how to do a full service, our waitress was very nice but she seemed a little lost. Might try it again but not for a while.

Alright I have 2 ratings here. First off I love the fact I can come into a dessert store and order anything off the menu with our having to check each ingredient. I can rest easy knowing each and every item is vegan. I ordered an apple pie and old school cinnamon roll, a cookie, and brownie. The Apple pie was out of this world. So good with a cup of coffee. Five stars for taste. My complaint came when I checked into the shops yelp and then received a 10% off your order. When I went to use the code, the employee said they would not take it and they were not on yelp and it must be another store. I proceeded to show her that the address matched and was taken aback because I've never had this happen before. The employee continued to say they would not accept the yelp store discount. So I politely apologized and paid full price for my order. While I waited a customer behind me had a larger order and was served before I was. Overall the employee customer experience wasn't the best, but I would still return for the deliciousness.

Axiom fitness is a real breath of fresh air as far as the 24 hour-ish gyms go. Now I have been a member of the Anytime fitness and Planet Fitness, as well as Snap but this one just is a few steps above in quality and atmosphere. 

From the moment I walked in and was greeted by the staff I was impressed. They have membership people and trainers who also give new members evaluations/assessments for free and of course those at the front desk who great you with a smile each visit. The locker room has been a little less than clean on occasion and the counters are always covered with water and there are no towels, paper or otherwise available for wiping down. This could use some improvement. The facilities seem to be clean at all times and if a piece of equipment seems to be broken, it's only for a day or so before it's back in service.

Stay away!!I requested that they turn on my sprinker system two weeks ago. I received a request to fill out a form to get the process started so I did. I received a notification that they would be out on May 23 saying "We will be in your area for sprinker start up please be prepared to allow access to ...... I took half a day off work to help them. No show, no follow-up, no message saying "Sorry, we were too busy so we will reschedule..." Nothing. So I called a different company that understands service and they showed up and did a great job! I get a message today, almost two weeks later, saying "We are coming today to get your sprinker system turned on..." I told them that I already had it done and I don't need it." He responded with "Things happen. You never submitted the magic form saying that you cancelled it." This is unacceptable and terrible service. I am pretty sure that the form probably has some clause saying that I would owe X if I did not turn in their magic form.  They will not show up, bill you and insult you.

I bought 6 chiro visits from this place. I paid around 180$. Today was my 5th visit and I have to say I'll be looking for another place. The chiropractor hardly did anything. I asked if he would adjust my jaw because I have tmjd. He said they don't but another doc did at a different visit. There are too many chiros at this place. To me it's a mess and you don't end up getting quality care. Which doesn't make me happy since it's not cheap.

Took my truck here because my check engine light was on and they tried to charge me $280 for a MAP sensor. I took my truck to another shop and they charged me $25 for a brand new factory MAP sensor. There is literally no reason to charge people that much for a $25 part. I will never go to this shop or any other Point S ever again.

For whatever reason, DT always sounds delicious after a punk rock show! My experiences at this location are based on my drive thru visits & they are always between midnight and 2am. 

The good:
The food is always made to order & comes out hot.  The crinkle cut fries are perfection and bring me back to eating crinkle cut fries at Carl's Jr when I was a kid.  There is something about those crinkle cut fries.  Yum!! The tacos are always full of fresh shredded cheddar cheese.  Their cheese is to die for! It tastes great & it doesn't have that corn starch film on it.  Fresh shredded is so much better than the pre shredded stuff! The meat, cheese, lettuce ratio is on point. The tacos are awesome & my absolute favorite. 
The employees are always very nice, helpful, & above all patient! I can be pretty indecisive when it comes to food. 

The bad:
The bad is limited to the people who are making the food. There have been several times where my order has been wrong. 
Onions:
My hubby & I don't do onions.  Like one onion will ruin an entire entree.  Lol. Yes, I have issues.   We have gotten onions on items that don't even come with onions.  Tomatoes:
Another issue that we usually have is that the tacos will not have tomatoes on them. Or if they do have tomatoes, it's limited to a single tomato.  The tomato issue happens every single time I eat there. 
Crushed Tacos:
Many times I will get tacos that have been crushed. It sucks to open up the taco and have to grab a fork because you actually have taco salad in the wrapper. 

I think the food prep people just need to slow down a bit & pay attention. That would solve the problems at this location. I will be back.   At the end of the day, I still love Del Taco's tacos...crushed & all.

When I started with Park Place we had agreed on Inspection Fee only. After thousands of dollars of repair I asked for invoices from the vendors - I never received. This last month they charged me for unauthorized repairs, pest control and landscaping I never agreed on. Once I received an estimate that was, on one item, twice of what the repair should have been and the second repair was 3 times what it should have been.. I mean come on !  $180.00 to replace a microwave door handle ?? I'm in the repair business and in a higher priced area that repair should have been no more than $90. For the longest time I had to remind them to send me statements. Also after changing my manager 3 times I don't know who to talk to anymore.. Beware of this company as they seem very sneaky in their approach to your money.

I CAN'T EVEN BEGIN TO TELL YOU HOW RUDE THIS COMPANY IS!! My furnace stopped working on a Saturday of course...and when I called, I didn't even get to tell them what was wrong before they rudely started quoting me prices. "It'll be $139 just to send a tech out and then you will have to pay after hour prices on all parts and labor." I was so disgusted with the tone of the woman on the phone that I simply hung up. Aren't you in the business of fixing furnaces? Why do they act like I'm putting them out by calling for help with a service they provide? YEP I'M DONE HERE!!

I have frequented this establishment almost as long as they've been open.. always great service and delicious food.. waiting for a table when it's busy is one thing but I waited over 30 minutes ( quote was 15 minutes) and I swear there was at least 9 open tables. Food took longer than normal. The service was courteous. I expressed to my husband something seemed off. Shockingly I discovered the business was sold and under new management. Not impressed. Looks like we will be looking for a new breakfast spot.

The reviews are correct.  Perfect example- salad in a basket meant for a burger and fries. That's right a paper lined basket. So imagine pouring dressing into a salad, one that's less than stellar, and then using a fork that pokes through the paper to eat it. No kidding. Best part we were ask if we'd like our check before we had received food and one round of drinks. Why? Because it took 45 minutes for fish and chips and a side salad with ranch.

Ahhhh.... Friday night, game night, long week! This place is a seafood shack that crashed into a sports bar. I kinda like! We were seated immediately. Staff was super friendly, especially Tarna? We had way too many requests and questions and she was patient and accommodating. Our drinks were out quickly (which is more important to me than the food)! Our meals were great and we'll definitely be back.
I would highly recommended Greenbelt. Very friendly and helpful,professional service!

I had bought a couple of games for Christmas for my children. We ended up already having one and changed our mind on the other. They were unopened. I had them ready to return and 2 of my girls came down with Covid and we had to quarantine so I did not make the 30 day window. When I tried to return them the first time it was less than 2 weeks past the window. Also, their computer was down so they could not return them at all. I was told I would have to come back. When I returned the next week and explained the situation again, I got the same reply. I was very frustrated and will not shop here again except out of desperation and to use my gift card.

Good beer selection with over 30 beers on tap...including some from my favorite breweries from Bend and Enterprise Oregon, California and Colorado. Not to mention all the local beers!! I had the cedar plank salmon for dinner and thought it was good...not amazing...but good! To finish we shared the apple bread pudding...AND IT WAS AMAZING!!   By the way...i dont usually like bread pudding, so that is saying something.

First the positive - they were efficient, the email reminders were well done and the multiple team(s) were timely.  They did the job in 1 1/2 days.  I was grateful that they were able to squeeze us in before year end.  They did an excellent job of deep cleaning. 
Now the reason they did not get a 5 Star rating from me.  When I normally get an estimate for a job - I want my quote to be one price.  Not ala carte.  I also don't want to be involved in every single detail.  Isn't that their job?  I dealt with a woman named Denise.  When I placed my order I told Denise that I would do the cabinets initially myself.  There was one room that I didn't get to do so I tried to add this on last minute.  I would gladly have paid extra but she said that they could not do it.  They would have to do ALL of the homes cabinets and were not able to do one section only.  It was against "company policy".  Really?  Isn't house cleaning part of their scope of work? 
Oh well!  She wasn't going to budge.

So - are they good?  Yes!  Do you have to pay attention to every single detail when you place your order?  Yep - be very specific- and don't try and change it up.  I feel they would be so much better if they were more flexible.

This place I have been to a couple of times seems like the service keeps getting worse and worse. I came in on 5/31/2021 to celebrate my birthday with my family. Our tab was around $300 dollars for a table of 5. I walked in and ordered drinks. The drinks are not very good the secret is to stir them a bit before you take a sip I have learned then they are yummy! We got oysters to start off with and when we received the salt it was all wet and soaked in the inside. The waiter we originally got at first seemed not very helpful and indecisive about everything on the menu to food and drinks. He looked bothered when I went to go find him to switch our salt but we had been waiting 20 minutes for him to come out of the back and our oysters were just sitting there. I ended up walking up to the bar and again no bartender was there so waited for anyone at that point to walk out from the back. I can see how annoying that can be for the server who is working that table but what else is a paying customer supposed to do when you take that long to come back out to check on our table. Also I may add it was not very busy there was only 3 tables near my section.  Sure enough around 15 minutes later he came to introduce a different server who was taking over because his shift was over. We got buckets of seafood and another with a whole crab we asked for mild but they were spicier than ever before making it not 100% enjoyable to eat. I ordered the Shrimp Alfredo and I found a hair in there took it to the back to be discreet about it since there was people near my table. Employee grabbed the plate and hair apologized and said he would take care of it with the manager. The manager was nice and came over to the table to apologize. Thankfully enough he removed it off our tab. The deserts here are not good at all definitely do not recommend them here. 
Maybe giving Joe's Crab Shack another try doesn't seem so bad after these last couple experiences.

Still very busy thru 1 pm for lunch crowd, but for take out it is great. Their breads are outstanding. The baguettes, sprouted grain rolls and focaccia are especially good. Their Danish, pecan rolls, and orange scones are outstanding. The Paneta bagels are excellent and give Blue Sky some competition. And- Ta Ta- on Tuesdays you can get a baker's dozen for $6.99. Plus, these are big bagels, but not fluffy, but dense like a true bagel should be.
Was able to get my Bella girl right in within a few days.  The groomers were friendly to me and loving to Bella.  The grooming was beautiful, reasonably priced, would recommend

My husband and I has been coming here ever since we moved here to Meridian and absolutely love this place. They have the best selections of beer and Curtis the owner is always friendly and makes it a point to come say hi whenever were there. The food is great and it is a great local place to gather with friends. They have a number of screens so watching the games is always great and the staff is always very friendly. Whenever we are there we always feel like we are home

Le Peep has been a staple stop for quite a while. I've been to two locations and am generally really happy with it. 

Today we started with gooey buns for the table (these are delicious!! Too sweet for a meal, but so good to split.) and mimosas. The mimosas were basically just juice. No champagne to be tasted or seen. For the price ($6.99/glass) that's a bit of a bummer... 

I had the Baja Benedict, which was okay, but I should have gone another route. The bacon wasn't very crispy, and cut really thick... it just didn't quite hit the spot. The potatoes were the perfect amount of crunch though! And seasoned really well. I was very glad so many came with the breakfast, as they were my favorite part!! 

I'm disappointed masks aren't required for guests while waiting or walking around, but that's pretty typical in Meridian. 

We will definitely be back! I'll just order different next time. :)

Great place for a quick breakfast! They offer to go and sit down.  

Butch Hollers Sammy is my favorite.
Today I I tried the French toast and the sweet French toast and savory potatoes together were amazing!!!  Great recommendation from our waitress.
Great selection.  Knowledgeable and friendly staff were extremely helpful in selection process of recent firearm purchase.  Couldn't be happier with the entire experience.  Thank you!

These guys just blew out my sprinklers. Easy scheduling online, easy following online where they will be, when. Totally reliable and priced competitively. Sprinkler blowouts can be stressful in the fall, but this was easy. I will use again!!!

I have never been so disappointed as I was leaving this place. I walked in after some convincing from my mom after a long day of weird, sudden lower back pain that created pain while sitting and walking. The receptionists were cold and short with me, but that was nothing compared to how the chiropractor treated me. I have had plenty of chiropractic care in the past but never have I ever experienced the rough handling and disinterest that this chiropractor showed. He didn't say 10 words to me, never asked me how I felt. When he had completed, it was "you're good to go" with a wave of his hand, and that was that. I left feeling worse than I started, and endured many more days of pain before meeting a more professional chiropractor that not only expressed care but also addressed my specific problem. I wouldn't return here if someone paid me.

Ordered the King crab- it was prepared well if kinda pricey...Asked for the Cajun spicy and it was VERY spicy! Sauce drenched everything so you could not taste any flavor of the crab itself...
Too spicy so I asked for a glass of milk and they don't have it- considering I opted for the mid-level spice option, this surprised me- what's your plan when someone gets something too spicy having not been here before and not knowing your spice levels.  I'll try some other options next time.

We went the 2nd night they were open, got there about 4:45pm to beat any rush. We had a lovely dinner and great service with Tiffany as our server. The food was great - the wine pour wonderful and we didn't have room for dessert since the meal and appetizer was so satisfying. Great ambiance also! We will for sure be back to enjoy again!

do not rent here! applied and kim who is in charge of the applications told me i qualified just need to put someone else on as well for certain reason once i did she said to bad you don't qualify and she basically robbed me of 3 application fees and basically just laughed at me please don't give business to a company that scams people for lying to them!!!!

We had such a great time...Ashley was an awesome server and Robert made us feel right at home....
We will definitely be back
THANK you so so very much

Love TCBY so much and this is the best location. Large, clean, bright flowers and friendly staff. Literally best frozen yogurt ever. They have both scoop and soft serve. Toppings are fresh and tasty. Love this place.

Some girl friends and I wanted a few drinks and appetizers and figured we would find a locally owned place. Staff was friendly and welcoming when we came in but we realized very quickly that regulars got good service whereas we had to walk up to the bar to get any help. We felt a little out of place and awkward after a while due to staff being very friendly with all their friends and regular customers and slightly stand-off ish with us. 
I would be back to give it another try as the food was good but how do they expect to get new and reoccurring customers if they aren't welcoming to them?

They need to close this restaurant down, hire all new management and then start over. We all know how hard it is to hire people right now but what are they doing so wrong here? 
Today, right before lunch, they had one girl preparing food and three others that seem to just be getting in the way.  I ordered ahead using the app and it said be there at 11:20.  I waited an hour before finally walking out without my food.  There were dozens of people in the same situation. The worst part was that the printer kept pumping out tickets with new online orders as we entered the lunch rush.  I'm sure many others never got their food or a refund just like me.  This place has been bad for awhile, but I tried one more time and got stung. Never again!

This is my go to for birthday gifts for kids. Such a relief to be able to support a locally owned business vs big box corporate conglomerates like target and Walmart that I avoid at all cost, I don't want to feed those beasts and their questionable politics. Every time I need something I call ahead and they prepare things for me to select from, the customer service at Toy Town is seriously the best! Hands down the friendliest most helpful. They are like you're own personal shoppers. Highly recommend. They have an amazing selection and they're simply the best! When the choice is available, choose these guys over the corporate industrial giants.

Service was great, food was really good as well. Zoey (I think was her name) knew that we had not been in before and was so kind to come over to our table to see how everything was tasting. Would certainly go back again. The only thing I wish was that they had a veggie add-on option, as its not the healthiest (although portions are huge!)...meat, rice, a sweetish mayo mac salad, and some cabbage. I did see some small side salads - ill get that next time instead of the rice. Again, super nice service and fast!

Who was the joker that made my chili cheese fries???  (Yes i am eating healthy tonight)  I asked for extra sour cream - see the picture i posted... grrr

Other than the comedian that gave me a gallon of sour cream, this place is good. Food was fresh and fast.  The place was clean and has a salsa bar. I don't have to open 40 of those little packets? Win win!

The Panera's have put out some new pastries and they are very good. The only down side is that they did away with the Pecan Sticky Roll. But their almond croissant, blueberry scones, brownies, and whole wheat sprouted grain rolls are excellent. Some new breakfast and lunch sandwich and soups also on the board. 

You can order up on line or on the kiosk terminals and pickup or have it delivered to your table. Very convenient if you are in a hurry or feel somewhat antisocial that day.  

Refills available on cold drinks and coffee. Coffee is one of the better brewed I have had and they do have espresso coffees available. 

Place is kept clean and tables are cleaned usually after each use. The staff does an excellent job.

Get a Panera card and enjoy the periodic free goodies and sale notices. We still buy our bagels for freezer fodder on Tuesdays when their excellent bagels are a bakers dozen for almost half price. They make the best bagels in town.

Located at the village at Meridian, next to It's Sugar, and right behind Yard House. Little cinnamon bun shop with counter service. You can create your own cinnamon bun by choosing the sauce and toppings, 50 cents each. There is a handy cheat sheet with customer favorite combos as well as a big board on the wall with all the options. You can also buy a scoop of cookie dough in a cone. And everything is vegan, so no egg, and no chance of raw egg sickness. I got the cinnamon bun with peanut butter frosting and dark chocolate peanut butter cups, because, peanut butter. It was yummy, though I wish I would have left off the chocolate cups because they melted fast and the whole bun ended up tasting like dark chocolate, which is fine, but, peanut butter.  I'm glad I saved room for cinnaholic because I've been wanting to try them ever since I first heard about them.  So cool to have a vegan dessert shop!

Update: I have been back many times, and I love this place. But the frosting flavors are very very sweet and if you eat a whole cinnamon roll your stomach will hurt afterwards. Sweet sweet pain. I would recommend splitting a roll with someone.

I had just received my notice for smog renewal. I went to the site,  pulled up showing  the gentleman my post card for the smog. He did his  work and was polite. I was in and out in 10 minutes. Thank you for the nice experience. I will be back with my other vehicle

I'm incredibly frustrated and disappointed, to say in the least. I call Flying Pie to place an order, and it takes about ~10 minutes to get someone to answer. No big deal. I'm told it will be 30 minutes.

I arrive 35-40 minutes later, they took my full payment and THEN decided to tell me they "forgot" to put in my order. When I asked them what they are going to do about it, all they said they could do is make it "as soon as they can."

What!? So guess who has been sitting around for the last 30 minutes waiting for a pizza that was supposed to be done 45 minutes ago.

Terrible customer service. Get it together.

I called and made and appointment 20 minutes in advance for one of my clients and when we arrived another customer complained that he would not be getting serviced (all though we made an appointment and he was a walk in). The lady that was working with him told him it was ok because we just walked in and wouldn't mind if he went ahead of us. Very unprofessional and we had to cancel the appointment because my client went into behavior from waiting too long.

First time at this Flying Pie location in Meridian and what a cool pizza place. 

We ordered 3 pizzas to take over to our friends house for dinner.  They had the Habanero Pizza with 4 different "heats" to it.  We got #3 and I'm sure we're gonna need a big gallon of milk to get that sucker down. 

I think I just found my favorite pizza place!

Have been a customer of dream Clean for a year and had a positive experience until today, when I was informed that I will be charged a flat rate based on the  square footage of my house, despite that I am
Only have less than half the rooms cleaned, making is less than half the square footage of my house plans. I am happy to pay for the square footage that is being cleaned, but to be charged for tbe entire square footage regardless is illogical.

These guys used to be the best.  I have purchased 4 systems from them in the last several years.  A couple of years ago their customer service went to the dogs.  The quality of their work has gone way down and they have started just ripping people off on service calls and filters and unnecessary work.   I too would give them a zero star if i could.  This is a typical story of a company that has got too big for its britches and thinks they can treat customers like they are stupid. I even wrote a letter to the owner about my last poor customer experience and received a letter today back from him chewing my ass out for saying negative things about his company.   He felt the need to defend against what I was saying.  I had all the facts wrong.  Well the simple solution for me is to take my 4 units and all the maintenance and service calls to another company.   He obviously doesn't want my money.  And I don't think you should spend yours there either.  If I was anyone reading this I would pick up the phone book and call someone else.

We walked in for dinner while traveling, and they took such good care of us. We felt extremely safe, and their team was very accommodating in their processes to help us. We really had a great interaction with everyone there and the pizzas were delicious. We had the phosgo pie, the garlic chicken and pepperoni sticks. Everyone walked away full and happy! They also offered wine and beer, which was needed after a long day drive and I couldn't have been happier. This place is a must try when in the area!

Arrived at 4:37pm with 3 other tables full or people. Ordered food and drinks around 4:40pm.

Sat at the table for a good 30 minutes before we finally were able to flag someone down. Watched 4 other tables get food and drinks who arrived a good 30 minutes after our party. 5:30 came as we watched the 5th table get their food. 

Regardless of this, and excuse that a cook was late, but some how other tables were magically getting their food, we got up and left.

Worst service I have ever seen in a restaurant or pub. Will never be back.

Returned for some more of their pork bacon and bought some beef bacon. Wonder how that tastes? 

While there I asked about their sausages which were not in the case. She said they make sausages like chorizo, Italian and more, but things will need to slow down before they can make them, too many custom cutting and wrapping jobs to get done. 

Also asked them about their source of animals for their own sales. We wondered if they were locally sourced or did they buy carcasses from big companies like Tyson. She said they have two local ranches that they source their meat from. 

So far we are happy with the cuts we have tried from them.

The atmosphere is fine, but what a disappointment. We went to dinner on Friday at 5pm so it wasn't like we were at the tail end if busy dinner hour. Yet when we tried to order coconut shrimp appetizers we were informed they were out. (Also out of whole lobster.) 

I ended up ordering the lobster bisque (I love seafood bisques) and fried shrimp. The only description I can apply to the lobster in the bisque is "crumbs." Teeny pieces. I'd be embarrassed to serve something like that to guests because it would make me look pretentious and cheap. Which may be the theme here. 

The fried shrimp was tasteless which makes me think they get their seafood frozen. (I lived seaside for several years--both coasts--and I know freezing destroys the delicate taste of shrimp.) 

We also ordered bread sticks, but what we got was slices of garlic bread. 

All in all, I feel no need to ever darken their doorstep again.

We had guests coming in during a particularly busy time for my wife & I at work, so we hired them to get the house in shape.  Specifically, we asked them to only clean the downstairs of our house.  I should have known that something was up when they told us that they base the cost on the full size of the house if they're only cleaning part of it.

We were quoted $212 for just the downstairs. OK - a little steep, but I also get that it's a one-time thing, so for a good job that seemed OK.  

Here's what they did for $212: cleaned our main living area (wood) with our cleaner and our solutions.  Vacuumed.  Swept.  Partially dusted (appliances and furniture had visible areas that were untouched).  Wiped counters, but left residue and left crumbs under small appliances. Cleaned the toilets, I guess, that we cleaned the day prior to save them the worst of the work.  Cleaned the shower and, somehow, left it needing more cleaning after the fact.  We cleaned the shower prior, and they did something that left a powdery residue (cleanser?). They didn't appear to touch the shower fixtures.  The kitchen counters were covered with residue from whatever they cleaned with and we had to re-clean them.

They *were* here for some time (according to my holder children), but I have no idea why they were here so long.  This felt like about 4 person-hours of work for $212...over $50 / hr.  But even so, that's not really the issue.

After the fact, we got a call from someone from the business that they were tacking on another $120, because our house was a "4".  To be fair, we were in a time crunch and we agreed to their assessment, so we knew this was a possibility, but there is no question we were taken advantage of.  It may well be that if you use them regularly its fine, but we are talking about $332 for a little over 2000 square feet.  If you're cool with paying $332 for a pretty substandard cleaning job, this might be the service for you.  I do appreciate the ease of the transaction, and we did get *some* cleaning done in advance for our guests, but the overall quality is pretty poor/limited and the price seems very high.

To be clear: there were 2 people here more than 2 hours.  So I'm not saying it was actually 4 person-hours we paid for...I'm saying the actual work done shouldn't have taken nearly that long.  It was a shakedown.

--------update-------
In Denise's comment she suggests these pictures were not from the parts of the house that they cleaned, but they are. They are all from the downstairs, and they are all from rooms that were cleaned.  They just did a shoddy job.

But, thanks Denise for your condescending response.  Way to treat your customers.  

Folks - to be clear, we were charged $332 dollars to clean a downstairs that contained 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a great room, a dining room, a mud room, a laundry room and a kitchen.  ALL of my photos are from those parts of the house.  A very high price for very poor work, and a response from the business that is basically calling me dishonest.

I mean - look at my pictures - there's one of our refrigerator...there's one of an espresso machine...there's one of a toaster oven....would those be upstairs in our house?  It's bad enough that the service is poor, but basically denying it and calling me a liar is next level.  Run away from these awful people.

Where do you go for chicken fried steak?  Here
Have it my way
Plain waffle. Chicken fried steak. Smothered in gravy. With 2 over easy eggs. Tom et 2 fav

Best, cleanest laundromat I've ever been to! Came to wash all my bath mats and rugs, but I'm tempted to come back to get my week's worth of laundry done all at one time. They even have laundry service.
Had many flower bouquets created from this place and they are AMAZING! Not sure what the whiner from CA is complaining about with her "$10 bouquet".
I simply want to order online, and pick up my order in order to avoid wasting time being in line, but nooo - this location often does not allow online ordering.

This is the best church I've been to in the Boise area. I'm new to the area the past few months, and with my night job, I wasn't able to attend Harvest Church's service, but I tried several other churches and nobody was as kind and spirit filled and biblically sound as this church! I am so impressed with how the people have consistently stayed in touch with me despite me not being able to always attend and they've been so loving and understanding. I am now going to do whatever I can to get involved, because I feel like this is the church I'm supposed to call home, while I'm here in Idaho! Highly recommended. One of the best churches I've attended, ever.

I LOVE frozen yogurt! I saw a Groupon for the new Menchie's in Meridian, so I decided to buy the Groupon and try Menchie's. The first thing I noticed as I walked up to the glass front door, was how dirty the door and windows were. There were fingerprints and smudges all over. I reluctantly went inside. I walked over and grabbed an empty cup, from the stack, to begin filling. The cup felt slippery, but I thought it would be rude to put it back, and grab another one, after I had already touched it. I proceeded to fill the cup with a couple of flavors. When I got to the toppings, I started to really notice how filthy the place was. Everything seemed to be covered in a haze of stickyness! There were spilled toppings all over the place, from the counter to the floor. The serving spoons were sticky. I did not like touching them. I was really getting grossed out! I went to the cashier to pay and the counter was smudged and sticky with goo. I started to put my purse down on the counter, and decided not to get it sticky. The shop was not busy. The employee looked to be alone, but seemed to have time to clean-up if he wanted to. It did not look like the kind of filth that would have accumulated in one day. The place was just filthy, and no deep cleaning appears to be done. Gross! I have three more Groupons and do not want to go back and use them! I won't be back!

I tried this place based on the reviews of some people that I know. These people were very impressed with this place.

I have seen La Peep for a while now. But I never bothered to try it because of the name. I thought it was some sort of French place I have have very bad experiences with French places in the past. So this put me off right away. Coming here, I now know this is not french. Though the design might give one a slight nod toward something French. Clean Lines and more of a modern design. 

I guess it was the La part in La Peep. It just made be think French. Now that I have been there, I am guessing that they are fans of baby chicks that go Peep Peep.

I am not sure, but lets move on.

From the outside, this place looks really great. Once my family and I were inside, well, its odd looking.

There is a long and large counter at the front by the door. It reminded me of a desk used in a hotel for a concierge service. At the other end of the inside is a bar with bar stools. I found the decor and lay out very confusing as to what they had in mind when they built the place.

Everyone has a different opinion on how design should be, so I neither gave marks, nor took them away on account of this

Ok, now on with the food. My daughter is a very picky eater. I suppose to some extent I still am.

My 10 year old daughter ordered a fried egg cooked hard, or well. The waitress even repeated this for us. "So you dont want any runny yolks so you can eat from it?" To which my daughter wrinkled up her nose and cringed.

We assured the waitress that we did not want a runny yolk. We wanted it cooked well so the yolk was hard. 

When it came out, the yolk was runny. We did not want to make a scene in a crowded restaurant, so my daughter just left the egg alone. After the meal, when it was time for the check, the waitress even acknowledged the the egg was cooked wrong. But she did not apologize for this or take it off our check.

I ordered the breakfast Chicken Fried Steak. It came with eggs and home style potatoes. Now being from Texas, I crave a good chicken fried steak. I have not had one here in idaho yet.

The steak was pretty typical of what I would expect in Idaho. It was tender, which was a plus. And I did enjoy it was what it was. The gravy was good. But the steak was not crispy at all.

If I were to judge it based on what I expect a real Texas Chicken Fried Steak to be, I would give it a 2 on a 1-10 scale. If I were to judge this based on the version of Chicken Fried Steak that I expect to find here in the north, Id give it a 5 out of 10.

Next came the eggs, which I got scrambled. This is my 1st big rant. It seems that every single breakfast place here in Idaho has no clue how to make scrambled eggs.

What they do is put eggs in a skillet. They do not attempt to actually scramble them, which requires beating them with a frenzy with milk and maybe some seasonings.

They let the eggs cook never even bothering to stir them. When the eggs are done cooking, they have the consistency of a thick Omelet.

They take out the eggs from the skillet and start cutting them up. What we get a a cut up omelet instead and scrambled eggs.

To cook proper good fluffy scrambled eggs takes some knowledge ,but its not rocket science. You take eggs, mix with Milk or half and half (Almost a 50/50 ratio) and beat em. Then cook em up. Thats it. Unfortunately I have yet to find scrambled eggs like this anywhere in town. 

So for breakfast of good ole Fluffy Scrambled Eggs, I go to Che Phillip's.

The eggs tasted and felt like rubber and had no flavor at all.

Then came the special Pumpkin Pancake. It was overcooked and dry. It did not even have a good strong taste of pumpkin.

The final straw for me was what they called their special home-style potatoes. The potatoes tasted like they had been left under a meat lamp way too long. They were tough and didnt have much flavor either.

I cant recall what my wife had, but the fact that she had nothing to say at all about it tells me that it was also unremarkable.

We wont be back

Looks pretty decent from the outside and was really looking forward to trying this place out! Went on Black Friday for a late lunch and got seated immediately. There was a large table and maybe 5 other small tops. The waitress stopped at the table before we even had a chance to review the drink menu so we got ice tea. We ordered the steamed muscles, the catfish sliders and a shrimp po'boy. The muscles came out within 5 minutes and were gritty with sand & I even cut my gums on a piece of loose shell that was mixed in the butter & garlic! The sliders & po'boy were really good though!! That's why it gets a 2 star! After we were done eating we waited about 40 minutes before we were given the check. Waitress never came back after our food was dropped off except for right as we put our first bite in our mouths. We paid and that was that. Waitress never said thanks for coming, come see us again, look forward to seeing you, just said "thanks" as she gave us our card back. Will never go back since we felt nauseous for the rest of the day.

The portions are huge compared to how much you end up paying. The employees are always so cheerful and seem to be so relaxed; even when under pressure (because there was a line) they serve you fast to get you out of the line so that "the grub time" can start.  Their food is always hot, fresh and ready every single time that I come. Their P.O.G. Juice is hands down the BEST!  Most importantly, their tiny ice has to also be one of my favorites. 

If you haven't tried Mo' Bettahs... TONIGHT is the night!  

P.S.: Sorry for the bad pictures, I promise it was neatly served (I just started eating and realized I needed a picture. Best I could do before everything was devoured.)
Great pizza and servers are very nice! Hipsters work there and all are very friendly lol!!

Park Place Property Management has been extremely helpful to my partner and I in helping us to secure our new home. Kimberly B was crucial in helping us resolve an issue standing in the way of buying our home. They treated me with respect, professionalism, and urgency. I would highly recommend working with this property management company. Thank you PPPM and Kim!
Super yummy. Loved it! The kalua pork is really good and the teriyaki chicken. I like mo bettah sauce but there are alot of options.

Worst service ever!  We waited so long to get our food that we actually finally asked for our ticket and paid for our drinks and app only.   Waitress told us our ticket was still 2 down when we had been already there 45 minutes.  I mentioned that the tables around us were getting served and they had all arrived after us.  The waitress became combative and told me I was wrong and that they had not been there before me.   She never asked us if we doing ok, asked if we wanted water refills.  After we told her that we just wanted our ticket and we were going to find another place to eat she said "fine " and didn't ever try and make it right.  This was the worst experience ever.  1st and last time we will go there and I will be calling on Monday to discuss with the Manager.  Angela C was our waitress and clearly needs training in customer and social skills.   DO NOT EAT HERE!

Super delicious!
Came here with the family as our last stop in Idaho before heading home.
Perfect diner experience. I totally loved it.
My son got the kids pancake and it was HUGE. Definitely more than he could eat but so good.
I had the eggs Benedict and the Hollandaise was so flavorful and good. 
Huge portions of hash browns.
The whole family was very happy with their meals.
Staff is wearing masks, bathrooms are very clean, there are donuts up front!

Could not have asked for better service. We were told our furnace need to be replaced so we called A-1 for second opinion. A-1 agreed and their price was several hundred dollars less than the other guys. They were out the next morning to start work before I even left the house  to go to work. Very friendly and took very good care of us. Very happy with the service and the product.
Super cute Boutique with a great variety of gifts, clothes etc. Fabulous customer service. I found some great gifts and fun items for my home here.

Great ambiance and excellent service by Kristen.  Went here to celebrate a birthday.  Had bruschetta, il Sugo pasta, filet mignon pasta and chocolate mousse cake.  Both pastas had a cream sauce that needed seasoning, but the cake was awesome!  Enjoyed the overall experience and will come again.

Friends, we went to Il Sugo to celebrate my husband's recent promotion and we were so impressed with the entire experience.
