I almost feel greedy having such a great little establishment here in my area of Meridian. Our server Shelly was such a sweetheart, thank you for dealing with our almost three year old who is a loud talker and a total mess. And yes, we brought our kids to join in celebrating as a family. But I would recommend leaving them home as Il Sugo is a really charming date night restaurant and everything is better without chicken. We ordered the bruschetta and we really enjoyed its freshness and the balance of flavors. The whole family enjoyed their caesar salad, although it was a tad bit heavy on the mayo but still delicious. I loved their chicken parmesan as it was lightly breaded with an outstanding marinara. And the kicker is that it comes with linguine covered in a creamy white sauce. Wine by the bottle seemed really reasonableat only $35 although I hope they include some local Idaho wines or at least some WA wines at the least. We ended the night with their tiramisu, which was obviously made in house. I am going to dream of that dessert tonight, it was perfection. We can't wait to come back!! Our first experience was pretty awesome.

I absolutely love Ibeni! I always leave feeling better than when I arrived. Also it is like having your own personal shopper when you come in. The staff is very attentive helps pick out clothes and the owner is hands down the best!! I highly recommend shopping here!!

Seriously lacking help. Came in for apps and lunch. Waited almost half an hour for an order of wings. Never got them. Finally got our lunches and the waitress got the order wrong. Sent back the lunch and she corrected it. Still no wings. Never showed up and no reason was given, just that they were sorry. Will not go back. Not sure if they didn't have staff but service is seriously lacking and food is subpar. Very sad. Ate here before and it was really good. Now not so much.  Much better places to spend your money.

Third review and a big downgrade for their breakfast. Small, but expensive items if you select off of the boards rather than pastry and coffee. 

No really cooked items, all pre-prepared-or so it seems. The soufflés are small. The yogurt parfaits are about a half cup and cost over $3 each. No potatoes or fruit with soufflés. No cooked eggs choices. 

I would not recommend Panera for anyone needing a good, filling breakfast to start off their day.

This was my 3rd visit.  Pizza was okay, but not great.  I came for the lunch buffet.  While it was a little late in the lunch hour, there were only about 3 pieces of pizza left and they were all of the same kind.  I waited about 5 minutes and they finally brought out more pizza.  The staff was quite immature, parading around like they were really something.  And most disappointing was the appearance of the place.  There was food on the floor both in the serving area and where they make the pizzas. The dirty appearance was a total turn off.  I think I will skip this place next time.

My family and I had breakfast here this past Sunday.  The food and atmosphere was great.  The best of all was our server Madison. She was so gracious and patient with us.  Made sure to get pancakes out ASAP for the little ones who were nearing starvation break downs.  Got all the orders right and was so nice with all of our requests.  She even kindly offered to take a picture of our family as a memento.  Thanks to Madison and her great personality!!! We will be back again!!!!

Great for breakfast. Really a locals type place, old building, but clean. Fast and personable service. Food was good, well cooked, and large servings for a fair price. Really liked their bacon, tasty and good sized strips. 

One thing we would improve is their coffee. Farmer Bros. doesn't cut it for me. Wonder if they would let me bring in my own?  Next time I'll ask.

I just called this groomer and was excited to establish a new relationship since our groomer of 8 years retired. After asking some questions and giving our specific information about payment, I was given to someone else on the line. This person was so rude and basically called me a liar, stating that the government never paid for a service dogs grooming. She went on and on. I was shocked at how crazy she sounded. I would never entrust my dog to someone who can not act in a professional and 'normal' manner. My son has Autism and part of his yearly budget goes towards grooming and vet care. We get a yearly check cut and given to the groomer. This check is cut by Consumer Direct. However, this lady on the phone told me I was a liar, was very aggressive on the phone, and I ended the conversation calling her an expletive. They will never get my business and I will NEVER recommend this person. They have refused service to us and my disabled child. I am disgusted at the ignorance and hatred that I encountered.

Disappointing. Appreciate the touch less order as a safety attempt, but reduces Chipotle to the rest of fast food places when you can't watch them put together your order.   Messed up half of our six person order and left off extras like guacamole.   A bit excessive when half the order is wrong. We'll pass until the regular ordering system returns.

I ate here when they first opened and was a victim of their over salted cottage potatoes. That was enough to keep me away until recently. What is that.? Two years? I may not be Italian, but I can hold a grudge with the best of them.

Anyway, was lured back in by my wife and must say I was pleasantly surprised. The place is always clean with smiling servers. Widely spaced regular height tables means easy access to anyone. You might want to think twice about weekends, really crowded. It's popularity seems high. Weekdays are much calmer. Outside dining is available weather permitting. But, we are not much for road noise, brake dust, and gawkers, so we usually opt for inside dining. This is a breakfast-lunch place, I assume everyone knows. 

First, the food is straight forward and tasty. The cottage potatoes are still too salty for me. But they have a great solution, for me at least, shredded hash browns. They are not mentioned on the menu, but they have them. So an order of crispy, shredded hash browns, no salt, and I don't go postal. This is also one place I have found to have an acceptable chicken fried steak that is not too greasy and will let me have the gravy on the side. Also not too big or too small and for $8.99 with two eggs, hash browns, and toast, that is a bargain. Their waffles, however, need to be done a bit longer, for crispy. Also, their fresh fruit for sides, is not up to the quality of Moe Joe's. Ask for the dark coffee, if you like that strength. They leave a caraf on the table, so you can caffeinate to your own state of nirvana. 

Nicely located, near Rosaeuer's Market, the ID Credit Union, and the NW Pets Store, it is convenience central for us.
Pretty messy but fun!  It's pretty spendy so won't go too often but it was a fun experience.

This company was good in the past like in 2014.
But they have changed management and some office staff and since then it's gone to HELL they don't answer calls, texts, or emails in a timely fashion If they Respond.

Brought in 20+ people for a 50th birthday party. Someone bought the birthday girl bottomless beers which is supposed to run until 6, but the rude owner/bartender didn't want to give her another one even before 6? Owner seems put out, and our waitress had bo so bad I could literally smell her from across the bar. Most of the party works in the service industry, so they could have picked up a lot of  business for Sunday football, but since they put up chairs and practically pushed people out the door at 6, we won't be back.

Located at the village at Meridian, next to It's Sugar, and right behind Yard House. Little cinnamon bun shop with counter service. You can create your own cinnamon bun by choosing the sauce and toppings, 50 cents each. There is a handy cheat sheet with customer favorite combos as well as a big board on the wall with all the options. You can also buy a scoop of cookie dough in a cone. And everything is vegan, so no egg, and no chance of raw egg sickness. I got the cinnamon bun with peanut butter frosting and dark chocolate peanut butter cups, because, peanut butter. It was yummy, though I wish I would have left off the chocolate cups because they melted fast and the whole bun ended up tasting like dark chocolate, which is fine, but, peanut butter.  I'm glad I saved room for cinnaholic because I've been wanting to try them ever since I first heard about them.  So cool to have a vegan dessert shop!

I have purchased several knives from Northwest Knives and have had nothing but First Class service. I was very sad when then move the store to Idaho , but, then their on-line sales and service is the best in the industry. I'll definitely stop by their store the next time I'm rolling  thru, but until  then, the on-line experience is fantastic  and I would highly recommend  them to anyone.  I've even emailed Aaron that I was looking for new knife and gave him a price range, intended use, and other knives I own,and Aaron's recommendations have always been a home run, because of his knowledge and experience. If you appreciate real customers service give them a try!

Been here several times and always had a good experience. The Pick Your Catch and Seafood Combos are the way to go. I have had the Lobster Tail Basket but didn't expect the lobster tail to be breaded and fried. It was a bit overcooked that way. The lobster tail is much better in the regular combos. The shrimp is amazing in their garlic butter sauce. The fries are excellent and their mozzarella sticks are really good too! The marinara to dip it in is quite tasty. Much cheaper and bigger quantities than the equivalent food at Joe's Crab Shack. Fun atmosphere and clean restaurant; definitely recommend it!

Very disappointed and will not be back. This way our 3rd visit. The first was awesome. I wrote a review saying I would be a customer for life. No, not anymore. 2nd visit was not good, but everyone has bad days , so I tried again. 3rd visit. I walked in with my dog, a girl yelled over the noise from the back. I had to tell her 4 times who I was. She was not nice to say the least. Finally someone came up to the front and we got my dog checked in, after telling this girl 3 times who we were.  Usually around 2 hours they call to tell me she is done. not this time. after 3 hours i called them. Someone answered and I asked if she was done. i told her the name she said who is that? I said Benji, she yelled to the back to ask if she was done, she gets back on the phone and says  " I don't know, can you describe her?" WHAT?? She yells to the back again and someone yells back , another 20 mins. I arrived to pick her up, and was totally disgusted. A chop job for sure. NOT what I asked for. Trimmed some nails , not all. Missed places on her legs, I had to finish when I got home. The girl from before came up front, again just not a nice person. I will not be back nor will I recommend this place ever!!

Went for a pedi today. Had a gift card I had to hang onto because of the pandemic that kept a good portion of us pretty much at home. All went well the girls were very nice and pleasant and I really enjoyed the pedi. When going to pay I took out my gift card and was told they don't accept them any longer. The business changed hands during the pandemic and they just decided not to process the outstanding gift cards!  So they had no way any longer to know who held the cards and the amounts, they said records were destroyed when the business changed hands. So someone there made off with the $ paid for the gift card and charged me the fee for the pedi. They were paid twice for the same services and they had no records! Really disappointed in the way they do business and hope not too many more people have gotten burned like I did. Who buys a business and doesn't reconcile all the outstanding transactions?  They did a nice job but I won't go back again.

This location only has online ordering available and honestly I don't quite get why. I walked in here just over a week ago and I was able to place an order on the line and walk out within minutes. Instead I get here and see that they only have online ordering. I place my order and said you know what I can wait the 10 minutes for my food. Although I ended up waiting more than 20 past the pickup time for my food to be ready. I would not recommend coming here unless you order your food WELL in ADVANCE. 

Usually I don't care about whatever regulations somewhere is choosing to stick to but the fact that they have gone back to no walk in orders for seemingly no reason at all is beyond me. 

If you're in the area I would suggest going anywhere else and I can promise you'll get your food faster

Tried this place for the first time today, and I will be returning soon!
Friendly cashier, my kids loved watching the guy throw the dough in the air, and the Canadian bacon and pineapple (yes, pineapple belongs on pizza!!!!)  was amazing.   Seriously, try the Canadian bacon.  It's the best I've ever had.

My wife and I was looking for an Italian restaurant and we came across IL Sugo. Beautiful atmosphere, good and friendly service and the food was delicious. You have to make reservations before go though.

I know someone right now who applied to a rental from this company, and from what I hear I wonder if they may be scamming applicants by showing apartments, putting people on waiting lists, and collecting application fees while having no intention on actually renting out certain locations. Is there anyway to report this in Idaho? Seems like this should be illegal...
Sitting here waiting for my husband inside watching an employee help a young man with fixing his car..Goes above and beyond in my opinion...

Took the crew out for breakfast this morning. My first visit but some of the guys highly recommended. Seated right away but I had called a few days earlier to give them a heads up a large party would be coming in. Peggy greeted us and finished setting up our table. Maqueena was our server and did an excellent job. Water was refilled, coffee was refilled, very attentive. The flavor of the food as excellent. I'm a self proclaimed egg's Benedict snob... it was SO good. Love it when the hollandaise has a touch of lemon. The eggs were cooked perfectly and the ham was sliced just the right thickness and plentiful. The burrito ordered next to me was huge and gone within minutes. The very small downside was the peasant potatoes were cold. My hunch is that, since we were there as soon as they opened, the heat lamps might not have been warmed up yet. I'll certainly be back with the hubby for a weekend breakfast

I am very grateful for The Flower Place being so far apart  from friends and family especially during these challenging times it is nice to be able to reach out to loved ones across the states and be able to do something special for them. You never know ordering on line the quality of the company and when ordering you always hope that it turns out good especially since you are not there to see their work. The arrangement  you made for her was beautiful and it really made her day. I can not say enough about what a beautiful job you did in creating it and delivering it to her today. You didn't have to you already sent your delivery drivers out for the day you could have waited until tomorrow  but you didn't you made sure that she got them today.  For that  I am truly grateful and blessed that I placed my order with your company. I will definitely be placing my future orders with you from out her in California.

I have eaten here on several occasions, over the past year. Of all my experiences,  the very first time was by far the best experience. They had just opened and you could tell there was "excitement in the air."  The wait staff was super friendly, giving recommendations on what to choose, talking up the scratch made recipes, etc. The food was very good and so we put it on our list.

However, on each subsequent visit (3 to be exact). I feel like the quality and service is slowly diminishing.  Based off others reviews,  I would say others are noticing this too. 

In all our visits,  the restaurant is not overly busy; which really questions the extremely slow service. On our visit before last,  our server did mention they were short staffed and to pardon her slow response. I also found my finger steaks to be super greasy and very, very salty. It was also frustrating upon getting served,  to wait a long period for a check in to see if we needed anything.

On our most recent visit, I was caught off guard on how long it took to bring out a side salad and an appetizer.  In fact, the meal came out before I finished the salad and even tried the appetizer. The jalapeno cream cheese eggrolls were not very good. Waaaayyyy too much cream cheese. I couldn't even taste the black beans, corn,  etc. We have ordered these before, so the shift in taste was surprising. 

The sign as we entered,  said there was a new menu. I didn't notice anything different about it. Other than, they now offer sweet potatoe fries.  We found this questionable because on our last visit, we asked if they had these and the server said no. No, because the chef only cooks with fresh, ingredients and had not perfected a method for creating these yet.
We opted for the upcharge, to give them a go. Seasoning was good,  but texture was off. I'm not an expert, but I would guess they were frozen. Outside was crunchy and warm,  inside was cold and kind of mushy.

I appreciated that our kids meals came out before ours. But honestly it came across like, poor timing in the kitchen and less about pleasing the kids. And our app and my salad hadn't appeared yet either. 

Hoping things get turned around, as for me it's not about price. It's about good quality food and good service.  If this isn't there,  then this option comes off the rotation list.

F*** this Chipotle location! This is the absolute worst one I've ever had the displeasure of walking into. Not only do the "teenagers" working here lack ANY decent level of customer service, they can't even make eye contact or greet you politely. Not that I care too much, I just want delicious fresh food. Don't we all?

My Girlfriend and I don't eat meat, so of course we always look forward to Chipotle's fresh grilled peppers and onions on our burrito bowls. 

When we ordered veggie bowls, the chubby girl with acne working at this location softly said, "we don't have veggies." We responded with, "no problem, we'll wait for some fresh ones." 
She then reiterated that they don't have any veggies.. I was taken back, I asked her to clarify and she responded rudely by saying they "don't have any veggies at that location."

Not only was I immediately infuriated because of hanger kicking it, but I was blown away by the total lack of empathy. Not once did any of the 3 teenage girls working the counter apologize, they literally didn't have the mental capacity to think outside the box, or respond like decent human beings.

It's a shame that Chipotle hires humans like this. It's a gross reflection of not only their business, but their brand. I am tempted to never support this chain again based on this sh*tty experience, but because Chipotle is literally the only fresh "fast food" in America, I will take my business to another location. 

Hopefully those other "owners" have a higher standard of service when hiring kids to run their store.

Did I mention this was my first time ever visiting this location? Talk about first impressions..

Absolutely unprofessional, and the direct opposite of customer service. After standing in line for 10-20 minutes on Saturday, I was told that due to being busy, my phone could not be fixed within a timeframe I was willing to part with my phone (4 hrs). I fully understood, and offered to come back at a time that was more convenient for them, at which point they could guarantee a shorter time frame (90 minutes) The associate stated that making an appointment for first thing Monday morning, would put me at the top of the list for that day, and that that should guarantee the "quick" in and out. I show up this morning, early (9:55AM) for my 10AM appointment, and I am the first one in the store (literally as the OPEN light flips on). I check in for my appointment and, "Yes, we will be done in 4 hrs, there are several other people ahead of you" After stating my displeasure that this is not what I was told, and that the purpose of making this appointment was exactly trying to avoid this situation, I get the same message repeated. THIS IS NOT ACCEPTABLE. Either do not take the appointment (including the expected wait time), or honor the appointment.

I really wanted to like this place cute area and great menu. But rude customer service. Lots of workers but slow. I didnt notice anyone distancing and we all had to touch the same touch screen to check in. Going in you can see everyones  faces and no one was smiling or welcoming. The order I called ahead for I had to wait for them to make anyway. So just overall disappointed.

I submitted a request for a sprinkler blowout in the fall - twice online and never got an on screen confirmation nor did i receive a confirmation email. The don't accept phone calls so no way to discuss the issue with anyone. Naturally, I went with someone else who came out within a couple days to perform the blowout. Then, on Nov 22 I see a text from The Maintenance Shop saying they'll be performing my sprinkler blowout the next day - though they never sent a confirmation and I saw nothing online to let me know my request went through. I then get a text showing a picture of my house saying the completed the service and sent me an invoice. They never even confirmed my online request went through - no way was I paying. I got multiple texts and emails after that threatening legal action. I then got a screenshot of a Claim of Lien being placed against me for the amount due x2+. I cannot believe the audacity of this company and Steven Crist to do this after his faulty website never even confirmed my submission or appt.

**UPDATE** In response to the business owner's reply, none of this would have happened if their website would have been working properly, a phone number listed and available or an answering service like any professional business. 

To his point about not responding for two months, that's a blatant lie. I responded to the text he sent to me with a photo of my house the day the work was done (the day after his original text), saying I never received a confirmation from him and had another company do the work since his website never even said my submission was successful nor did I ever receive an email confirmation.

Usually when a would be customer let's you know there's a problem with your business website, the business appreciates the heads up and looks into it. Instead he told me I'm ridiculous and it was all my fault. 

Sadly, I had to pay the $35 for Steven's incompetence. 

Steven is greedy, dishonest and unprofessional. He is a disgrace to all business owners.

Ordered several Christmas Wreaths for neighbors and friends.   Of course we had to try one before ordering several for gifts and the flavors were outstanding!   Our friends are going to love them as they are a cut above your average cinnamon roll.   Great gift idea.

1st time customer

I had a great experience ordering a bouquet of flowers and balloons for my Mothers birthday.    Flowers were vibrant, fresh and absolutely beautiful, delivery was on time ( same day order).  This will be my "Go To" flower shop in Meridian 

Thanks so much!

These motherfuckers  fuckin fucked my shit up. If you eat at this place you're a fucking faggot. Worst fucking taco beLl ever in the fucking existence of the god damn hell hole. I'm pretty sure there waS mouse shit in my burrito. I'm so fucking pissed I think I might just fuckuNg fling my shit at them like a fucking animal

If you are looking for the best realtor, search no more!  Stewart Reality is top notch.  In a 1 to 5 rating, my husband and I would give them 10!  My husband and I just moved to the Eagle area in August, 2018.  We previously owned a 5 acre home in Meridian.  We had the pleasure of working with Stewart Reality.  In our past, we have sold three homes and bought four homes.  Never have we experienced anything close to what we experienced with Stewart Reality.  You will not find anyone as professional and ethical as Jeff and Sheri; they are a fantastic team!  Jeff not only sold our home in Meridian, but found us exactly what we were looking for in Eagle on the golf course.  Both Jeff and Sheri work very hard for you and make the whole process a very positive experience.  We could not have asked for anything more!

Jim has a fantastic resume as a trainer, including a degree in animal science, and his dedication and experience are apparent when you see him with a dog.  Additionally, Sit Means Sit really went the extra mile for us in terms of customer service. Through no fault of Jim, after signing up for and completing a number of lessons we discovered our dog had aggressive behaviors toward our kids, and we decided the dog was a no-go.  Jim not only agreed to allow us to duplicate the lessons with another dog, he offered to help us find the right dog for our family! Can't recommend Sit Means Sit and Jim highly enough. Very cool.

There was no reason,  no good reason to close down the downtown location! Especially with BSU located just a couple blocks from the old store.
The downtown location is YUGELY missed! Was just a better store.
The Village store is smaller, has...omg their stock is half or more of what the downtown store had. 
Also, I feel the downtown store had more mens clothes.
Urban Outfitters has gone full PC. So I think they think that guys like me are comfortable wearing women's clothes or this ridiculous "gender neutral" clothing. 
Not the case, ya'll. 
This Village store seems to be loaded up on women's clothes and the mens section...honestly, you really don't know where it starts or where it ends. I saw one rack that was all mens. That's it.
Basically what I'm saying is....Urban Outfitters has 100% lost it's appeal. 
They don't cater to everyone anymore. It's so sad. I used to LOVVVVE shopping here! Now men are basically tossed aside, hahahaha! And their prices are absolutely RIDICULOUS! I can't believe how much they charge for their items now.
I know a lot of people love this store...and ones who love the store at the Village.
But someone who has been shopping there since the late 90's...we can all agree that the Urban Outfitters we knew and loved....is NO. MO.
The staff at the village literally wants nothing to do with you. Been there 2x recently (friend of mine, she kinda likes this place)...we walk in and not once was asked "how r u today" or "need help finding anything?" 
They saw us, just looked at us and went about their business. 
At least the downtowners were nice and actually acted like they were happy to see you.
They may be full on with the PC nonsense, but yeah, the downtown store is missed. They had product for both men and women and had a lot for both. I also kinda miss the all the ridiculous, kitschy, home products the downtown store had.

Anyway, I won't ever be returning to this store. I'm done with Urban Outfitters. Waste of time and certainly a TOTAL waste of money! All their clothes look used AF. Which is ok. But charging lile.$58 bucks for like some raggedy ass, shriveled up, dirty looking...TANK TOP!!...hell naw! Gtfoh! Hahahahahaha!

Thanks again, yelpeerees! 

Cheers!
Waited a half hour for an appointment they confirmed three times - no one showed up. Complete waste of time and completely unprofessional (this was for Northwest Arkansas area).

Scam company, rang my bell after 7:30pm and said they were giving out "free gifts" to everyone in the neighborhood and handed me the item and asked if they could come in and explain it. I said no and they asked if they can come back and I said no and then they took the gift out of my hands. Scam scam scam, pyramid scheme business.

DO NOT EAT HERE. I wish I had checked reviews before ordering, but I assumed (wrongly) that Chipotles are pretty standard. This is a joke. Take a look at my order, and at the half-empty slop I received.

Perversion WARNING to PARENTS!! Do NOT let your children go in there. As if it is not bad enough to charge $14 per pound for candy, but 95% if this store is geared towards kids... until, at eye-level, your child reads these swearing, sex-talking items! In our state, it's illegal to swear in front of women or children. I guess this doesn't count?! But it should. I will NEVER spend my money here again. This is the WORST kind of bait and switch, entrapment, and lewd conduct from a store I have ever witnessed in my life. If I drag my kids into "Spenser's Gifts", I might expect this, but in a candy store?! So. Not. Cool. With. This. Never thought I would have to cover my kids' eyes and explain this kind of vulgarity to my little girl.

Everyone on the Morgan team were spectacular to work with, especially  Leah Morgan. She has been working with my husband and I over several years. We kept going back and forth looking for a new home, but never finding one that was right for us. She dealt with our indecisiveness admirably. If I was a realtor and in her shoes, I would of dropped us long ago! Leah alone had shown us 10-15 houses if not more! Leah and her team are genuine professionals who care about their clients and know how important a house is for families and individuals. They try to take their time and figure out what the client is looking for in a home. Then they do everything possible to find that perfect house. We never felt rushed to make a decision. With Leah's help and her team, we finally found our home. We couldn't be more grateful.

Servers were extremely nice, still waiting for food after almost an hour. Would not be so bad, but I am tired of listening to hip hop and r&b in a Cajun restaurant. Has a nightclub feel to it. Being a Louisiana native, sounds like staff is screwing with the radio.

The best part of this entire place is the outdoor patio that is nicely landscaped. Went for lunch one day and the service was slow, the food over priced and was average. Felt ripped off due to the low food quality versus high cost. Never again!
Had a great anniversary dinner here a few nights ago.  The staff was friendly and the food was great.  We split a half-liter of wine, which as a great alternative to by-the-glass or bottle.

My boyfriend and I were at a brewery watching the BSU game and decided to order food from the new Italian restaurant a few doors down. We were exceptionally pleased with EVERYTHING we ordered which was the bruschetta, Il Sugo (sig dish) over fettuccini pasta (you pick your pasta) and the seafood risotto. We have been back with friends and are sure to become regulars. Will not disappoint!

I'll definitely be back, and have a feeling that as they heat up the red sauce (no, really, it was barely warm) and I try more things this will become a favorite spot, and one of the, like, five Italian restaurants mmediately have my sympathies.  I'm really picky about Italian, have found two places in Treasure Valley that I like, and am pretty sure this is going to be added to my list.... eventually.

Inside is very nicely decorated and not overdone.  That and the friendly staff made for a really nice atmosphere.  Somebody who I assume was the owner or a co-owner was making rounds to some of the tables to see how people were enjoying their meals.

I was served complimentary cheese toast.  Scroll to the end for my rant about the complimentary cheese toast.

Ordered the chicken parm almost without looking at the menu.  It's like the standard that I use to sort out Italian restaurants.  I didn't see that the spaghetti served with it has a pesto cream sauce, rather than the red most places go with.  This made for a really cool presentation, it was all on one plate, half red with chicken parm, half light (super light) green with the spaghetti.  Also, the pesto cream sauce was pretty good, with points for being different from the norm.  The chicken parm was great, with some sliced parmesan on top (also different and cool) and if I remember right, some grated cheese under the sauce, on top of the chicken.  The only pain point was the red sauce which, while delicious, was just north of room temp... and I didn't let it sit at all before eating it.

I'll definitely be back, and have a feeling that as they heat up the red sauce (no, really, it was barely warm) and I try more things this will become a favorite spot, and one of the, like, five Italian restaurants that I actually enjoy in the world.

End of review.... unless you wanna read about the complimentary cheese toast, in which case, do proceed.

K, I know, it's complimentary.  I didn't order or pay for it.  It just showed up at my table like magic.  It's also the very first thing I ate at this really nice new Italian joint, and it was meh.  I'm assuming the bread was baked on site, then sliced, and baked for a bit with cheese on it, but for all the effort, it ranks... below the Texas Toast they serve at Sizzler (which is toasted, but soft on the inside.)  I even tried sopping up some of that room temp red sauce on it... still meh.  I honestly think the fact that it was cooked until it was hard (toasted) is what my hang-up is on it.  I'm more of a fan of soft(er) bread, but maybe it's just me.

It sounds like I'm bagging on them, but they're new and appear to be aiming high, and the couple pain points I had... were... I think below what their own expectation is.  I honestly think over time I'll prolly end up changing to five star.

Want a good breakfast place? WELL YOU FOUND IT!! I judge a great breakfast place by their ability to make amazing eggs benedict and belgium waffles...THIS PLACE KNOCKS IT OUT OF THE PARK ON BOTH!!! And they have friendly staff and great service...so you really can't go wrong!
Great service, amazing food and drinks. The Salsa is homemade and absolutely delicious 10 plus Stars!!!!!

I came in because I love seafood. A little too fried on some things for me. I have options next time. Since it was just myself I didn't want a lot of food. I had the soft shell basket. It was good. I was told you can ask for less batter. 
The reviews you see on here for Gianna are so right on. I had her as my server. She is as genuine as could be. Server's aren't usually so sweet. Gianna will go the extra mile for you. I will definitely ask for Gianna next time I'm in.

This place is soooo good. I've been to CK Hawaiian BBQ before and it is good but this place i love their beef teriyaki it is so tender and delicious. Plus for the mini plate it is still a ton of food! Lots of rice and Mac as well. Definitely will be coming back. 

...oh and the chicken katsu was amazing!
Worth the wait! Food was amazing, get the Cajun sauce! Staff was friendly and helpful. Restaurant was clean and had a great atmosphere.

I contacted this company for a specific treatment quote from their web page after describing my problem. They responded with a general quarterly plan and did not provide details about how they would successfully treat my ant problem.

Went here for the first time tonight for date night with my wife & absolutely loved it!!!! Great ambiance, loved the open air touch & most importantly, great food!!!! If you haven't been there, what are you waiting for???!

Went in and tried to order but they said you have to download the app and pay as they won't take the order in the restaurant.  We left. Looking at other reviews they may not be around much longer. Home office needs to do something about this location.

We waited 40 minutes for our nachos and it was not overly busy. Our server had no idea what beers were on tap and wasn't familiar enough to even be able to come back with options when we said "ok, how about a blonde or a pale ale?".The nachos were cheap tortilla chips, liquid fake cheese, a few olives and tomatoes and the lowest quality ground beef you can imagine. I've had better food from a high school concession stand. Severely disappointed.

Don't know why this chipotle only does digital ordering.  Had to wait 30 minutes for 1 barbacoa bowl no beans. When we got home we found that they had given us the wrong order, we got beans and rice! My son was super disappointed and hungry!

The service was good but overall I would say that the food was bland but it was pretty to look at. My wife had the pheasant I thought it was extremely dry I had the prime rib and it tasted like average prime rib nothing special. The purple potatoes that came with it while pretty to look at they were dry a little bit of olive oil or butter may have helped out a lot or possibly seasoning.  We also ordered for an appetizer the peanuts. I would say that they were peanuts in a bowl that I paid $4 for enough said?
Amazing and truly quick service! I was actually pleasantly surprised by how quickly they were able to access the hard drive on my ancient, dead laptop and transfer the data to another driver for me.

Great store, friendly people. Lots of accessories if you need parts. Helped me work through a suppressor application and pick up a few odds and ends. This is my go-to store in the Boise area and will be going back in the future. It's easy to give them a call and work through some questions to better understand submittal processes. Further they sell Blue Label Glocks for those who are prior service / first responder, great that they support the good guys.

Terry Lugar responded promptly and arrived precisely at the appointed time.  He correctly diagnosed complete failure of our Bosch washing machine as the result of motor graphite brush wear and spent over a half hour describing our options (replace brushes or replace machine) and their cost.  I valued his insights and went with the cheaper brush replacement.  He ordered the parts and returned two days later (again, precisely on time) to complete the repair.  Machine is running fine and there is a 90 day warranty on the repair.  I highly recommend him.

First time trying their place out and I was very impressed!! It was an accident coming across this place as my wife and I were looking for a bar and grill for a late lunch and I found this spot and we just went! Clean, inviting, the staff is friendly, and it was nice! You can tell that this spot has regulars that keep coming. The well drinks were only $3 each on a Saturday and the food was great! Great bar food but hold the excess grease. I was very happy with our lunch here.

This little sandwich shop just opened close to my apartment, which now makes TWO total food places within reasonable walking distance. I ended up liking the little teriyaki place NEXT to Jon Smith Subs, so I was hoping that I wouldn't like this sandwich place because I'm trying to stop eating out and it would be much easier if there weren't two good places right next to each other. Fortunately, or maybe unfortunately, I wasn't too impressed in any way so that should make it easy. 

Went in today to try it for the first time. Lot of staff members were present...I was helped by a nice, young lady. I asked what the most popular sandwich was in the shop's young existence, and was told "The Bomb." Now if you've read any of my past reviews, you are well aware that I LOVE large quantities of food. Of course, I love quality, but in my case, I love quantity equally to quality. So I ordered a 12-inch "The Bomb" with grilled chicken and no mushrooms to go. The wait wasn't too bad, went home, and opened up my ordinance. Oh, and I should mention, when I received the order, I was already a little disappointed as I figured a $12 foot long sandwich called "The Bomb" would be heavy. It was not...either I have been working out too much or they should rename it "The Cherry Bomb."

Ok got home, opened it up...visually, it was deceiving. It almost looked like a big sandwich, but that's because it was MOSTLY BREAD! The loaf they use is huge and airy and took up most of the room in the bag. Inside, there was a good amount of chicken I suppose, however it was all incredibly dry and not seasoned well at all. The grilled onions and peppers were lacking, whatever sauce they used was also lacking AND had no flavor, and they somehow still managed to get a couple mushrooms in there. AND I was told there was supposed to be a strip of bacon through it...nope, no bacon. Overall, just a bad sandwich. Not the worst sandwich I've ever had, but it was bad. In their defense, they ARE pretty new at this point with a new staff who possibly are just getting the hang of it, but for now, I won't be back for awhile as it's not worth it. I'm sure I'll try again at SOME point, but not for awhile.

Best gym I have found in Idaho. Started with Idaho athletic club and all they do is screw you in every which way possible. Staff here is super friendly and there when you need them. Just like any other gym they have there challenges but this gym is super clean always kept nice and tidy. Showers were recently re done and the locker room doesn't smell horrible, the weights and machines and all up to date and nothing to old.  Pool is nice as well as the sauna and spa. 

I can see why you pay a little more here cause of the equipment and cleanness that this place offers. I come late in the evenings after work, it's rare that I have to wait for a machine or a bench to use.

The people are great. It is always very clean and the equipment is alway in good repair. I've never found anything to complain about  with the only exception being that the weight area is to small and sometimes in the morning it seems crowded. However they are expanding so I will be excited to see if they make more room for weights

Turned us away when trying to attended church said it was "private property" I didnt realize god cared about such things nor did i think it was appropriate seeing as a church should be welcoming of all. Not impressed very disappointing people

This is by far the worst Chipotle of all time.  You can't make this many mistakes in a row and still be in business under a corporate name like this.  Last 3 online orders have been incorrect and horrible portion size.  It's like they don't even care.  Just a complete waste of time.  Go somewhere else and avoid this one at all cost.

We ordered online for pickup and got there just after our time to find it was still not ready. There were a lot of people waiting so I figured they just were a bit behind. To my surprise, they said it would be another 15-20 min to get our food - once the line died down, no other staff helped with the online orders! This place needs a serious look at their customer service, who ever manages the place needs to step it up. People shouldn't be waiting 20min for an online order when the walk in line is slow, they should be helping to get online orders out... they told us if we go through the line we have to pay again which makes no since why they can't just fulfill an order if the walk in line is slow but people are waiting for their online order. On top of that, both my husband and my order were wrong.

This is the worst Chipotle I've ever been to. Placed an order 2h ahead and arrived 2minutes after the promised time. Waited 41min! 2/3 of my order was missing, the guy promised a refund. Never got it. They charged full amount. The burritos I got were just rice, beans and meat. Lots of ingredients missing, the size was half of what I get at my home chipotle. This place is horrible, management obviously very incompetent. Don't buy from this place!

Considering myself a pizza aficionado (hehe) I dole out the stars pretty conservatively (see my other pizza reviews) and it takes a MAGNIFICENT pizza to get 5 stars from me. That said....

Pretty tasty pizza sauce
Good crust flavor
An ample amount of cheese
Pretty consistent pies (will be the same next time you order)
Decent prices (with coupons)
Good atmosphere
Decent craft beer selection

Note: 
The last pizza I had ordered that had an Italian sausage item had a "chintzy" quantity of it....a piece of sausage placed here and there. No bueno. If the guy/gal had been making it for a friend or for themselves there would be an ample amount. Not being mean...just sayin' it like it is. It was obviously a purposeful "chintzy" amount added to the pizza.

A bright side....Sarah at the bar area is nice, talkative and will allow you a small sample of beer to try before you buy. She'll check on your pizza status while you sip a cold brewski.

I gave it a 4 star "good" rating and did not remove a star for the "chintzy" sausage issue. It is not a 5 star pizza. I am sure they'll read this review and course-correct.  ;)

Amazing food and friendly management. I was passing through on a road trip and thought I'd check it out. So glad I did! I've tried other Hawaiian restaurants before and this one blows the others away. Juicy kahlua pork and chicken. The katsu sauce is super tasty. Even the macaroni salad was on point. Bonus surprise, the manager comped my meal, unprompted, she had no idea who I was, just did it because she wanted to. Chatted with her after I finished my meal and she believes in the company, which started out as a small business, and enthusiastically stands behind it. I dig her energy and hope her supervisors keep her around. 10/10!

I ordered a burrito bowl. Having been a while since I have chipotle, I was definitely looking forward to it. I was disappointed when pinto beans were in the bowl rather than the black beans I ordered. I also ordered lettuce but definitely was not expecting the gigantic pieces I received. As much as I love Chipotle, it will be a long time before I go back.
Great food. We enjoyed the sauce but if you put too much on it it is a little salty. My wife and I will be back.
Dope bar! They have great food, just be sure to get down there and order before 8pm. The burgers and the Hombre Fries are fire!!!

Eaten here twice..last time.
Ordered a hamburger n salad.
Hamburger came out plain n I mean plain.
Nothing on it.. had to ask for mayo n mustard... salad NEVER came out after 20 min..they ran out of lettuce.
Not worth th time or money!

I REDACT MY PREVIOUS REVIEW AND APOLOGIZE TO ANYONE WHO MAY HAVE USED A1 BASED ON MY PREVIOUS REVIEW!!!!

I was shocked at what I encountered recently from A1. There's a gentleman that posted a review stating he's done business with these guys for many years but as of recent I found the company to be dishonest, doing unnecessary work, and charging way more than what should be charged. I could not agree more with him. I don't know what happened to this company but they made a sharp turn south and it really really shows.
I've been remodeling my home for the past year redoing pretty much everything on the interior. I've called A1 out on a few occasions over the past year to check on a few things and make sure things were done correctly and have them do certain things as well. Everything seemed to be fine every time that they were here. The last time I phoned them, I had the young man come out to check my house over before I buttoned everything up with drywall and closed everything in. He told me everything was fine, everything looked good and it was all operating okay. Just the other day I phoned them to have them come out because I had a problem with a couple of the lights flickering and no power to a certain section of the home. The usual person that shows up to do the work was on vacation so they sent out a couple other technicians to take care of me. These guys looked things over,  told me that they could take care of it, and that it might be a few more hours than what they were scheduled out for that day so I would have to have them come back to finish up. They worked a few hours got some things back to working right and left for the day. I phoned to make another appointment to have them come back to finish. That day of the appointment my regular technician showed up with his apprentice I believe. After about 20 minutes he came up to me and told me that things looked really bad. He told me that things were really screwed up and if I really wanted to be safe and feel safe in my home I would have to rewire the entire house. This is the same technician that just a couple months previously told me that everything was fine before I buttoned it up and that things were working correctly. I questioned things in my head wondering why the two technicians that were there previously had no problem with fixing things and said it could be done and yet this technician is telling me that no it cannot be and that my whole home needs to be rewired. I told him that I trusted him and what he had to say hoping that he would redact his statement. I knew darn good and well that my home did not need to be rewired and so I gave him a few chances to redact the statement but he kept insisting that I need to have a complete re-wiring. I told him OK if that's what I need then will have to do it and please give me a quote. I was given a quote a couple of days later of $21,000. Yes that's $21,000! Pretty much knowing he was full of it I phoned another electrician to have him come out and take a look at it. Turns out it cost me $1600 to have the few things that needed to be fixed, fixed which should've been taken care of before I put up the drywall. Also I had asked the A1technician when he was here previously to do certain things, One being to run wire for my cameras for my alarm system. I had quite a surprise when my alarm technician came out to wire the cameras in and found there were no wires to connect to. That was just one job I was charged for and paid for and was not done. Dishonest is an understatement when it comes to something like that. When it comes to the rewire job at $21,000 it's beyond dishonest as far as I'm concerned is just plain fraud. A1 actually tried to defraud me out of $21,000 for work that I did not need to have done. I have done business with these guys along with my parents for the last 40 + years. They used to have a decent reputation and I would agree with their good reputation. However, today at this point I have but a couple of terms of art to describe them;
CROOKED, RIP OFFS, CROOKS, DISHONEST, LIARS!
You guys totally suck and I hope Your business sinks into the ground where it belongs.



Question; if it's such a conundrum and there's so much messed-up stuff, then why was it that A different electrician came in here for $1600 and was able to fix everything? 
Another question; why did the other two guys that showed up here not suggested I rewire my home and that this was wrong and that was wrong and they were all willing to fix everything that needed to be fixed?
And additional question; why did you not inform me that I had to have my home rewired Wayback when rather than continuously coming out here doing service calls and charging me for them when in the long run I was going to have to re-wire my whole home anyways? Just to make a little extra cash? As far as permits go, I was never told I had to pull a permit on anything. Another one of your oversights?

I was absolutely disturbed by the filth and liberal political garbage being sold in this "candy store". This place was riddled with the most distasteful, disgusting, trashy products, sold at child eye level. My niece kept asking what certain things meant and I was dumbfounded that these things were even on display. Shame on you!

If I could give zero stars I would. I've been calling and emailing this business since the day after Thanksgiving and have sent 3 emails to terminate our membership and they STILL CHARGED US 20+ days after we informed them of our cancellation. 

Now I have to dispute the charge bc they won't refund us nor do they respond in a timely manner to our requests. This is a ridiculous business practice. 

Literally stealing from us.

ABSOLUTELY LOVE THIS PLACE! I was visiting from LA and met up with some girlfriends from when I lived in Boise and the food (and Mimosas!) were absolutely amazing! The staff was super attentive and friendly. We had a 20 minute wait and the manager brought us mimosas, which I'm sure they don't normally do. We had such a great time! Definitely coming back the next time we are in town!

Have had an annoying interaction with scheduling person. Canceled my appointment 
and said I wanted no further contact.I received more messages after asking for no more contact. I essentially canceled my appointment based on the rudeness.Glad not to have this person in my life.Have an excellent day Riley.

Where's the aloha? Maybe it was off days when I went, and maybe my expectations were too high, but I've never felt so cold and unwelcomed in a Hawaiian restaurant. Not super stoked about their rice or mac salad, which are the two most important sides to any local dish. I've tried this place twice and both times the rice was mushy and the mac was just... off. The beef is good, but the other options (I've tried the katsu and pulehu chicken) just fall short. I'd recommend Island Kine Grinds in Nampa. It's only 20 minutes away and a much better experience.
2nd time here! Ate lunch in the patio, Food is so good and the service is awesome! Had the Monte Christo! Highly recommend!

Espresso was fairly watery and just did not have a very good flavor at all. The environment wasn't the best it was very dark and the music just wasn't my favorite either. Definitely something for an older crowd - not very teenager friendly at all in my personal opinion. Just combined by the atmosphere, the drink I ordered, and the lady not knowing what an espresso drink I was asking about was made me not want to go back again. But the staff was very friendly and kind so that was super nice. I don't like leaving bad reviews but this is very representative of my experience. Worth a try for the food maybe?
Awesome product!! People are friendly and competent. We will be back! You are the friendly locals with great product

Worst process I've experienced with the current Covid situation. Every other restaurant is open for dining or walk up order, (subway, Panda Express, etc) except Chipotle! Having to sit in my car to place an order and wait another 15 minutes for me to have to go back up, wait another 5 minutes for them to bring it to me is far from convenient. At least let us walk up to place our order. Better yet, let us go inside and place an order like everyone else.

This Yelp ad says "free estimates" yet when I went in with our 2006 Dodge Mega Cab we were told it would cost "$5,000 just to look it over". We have 4 diesel trucks (3 F-350's & the Dodge) that could have potentially gone to this company Too bad for them.    I took it to another shop all it was was an idler pulley a loose fuel line and two bushings cost $600 I don't know where he was getting 5000 just to look at it.   There was also the deterrent of one customer sitting in the waiting room and as soon as I walked in the door he asked if I was there to get screwed also as he was collecting his bill and paying!! I will not be going back and I don't recommend anyone else go there to be screwed over there are plenty of good diesel mechanics around this area!!

I decided to check out Healthy Habits Wellness after reading through a free monthly local business magazine that came in the mail. The free magazine had services in all different industries and on the last page, Healthy Habits Wellness, I saw an advertisement for a 'Male Hair Regrowth' program using a Class II Red level laser.  I scheduled a consultation and was told amazing things and was shown prior customer pictures to back up the claims. The staff is over the top nice and friendly especially the 2 receptionist.  The treatment room is comfortable with a basic vibrating massage chair and a TV with Netflix's.  I never wore any goggles though with this Level II class laser.  I bought a 48 session package for about $2000.  Each session is 30 minutes.  Within 7 months I used about 44 treatments and saw 'NO' results. I asked my family often if they noticed a difference in my hair lol, they said "nope".  I started the first 1 month with 3 sessions a weeks, then 2 sessions a week for 2 months and down to 1 session a week for 4 months. I remember they even let me come in for extra sessions because I'd forget to track the days.  If anything my light colored hair turned dark brown and I did not regrow anything.  I also had to call between appointments and remind them I had not had my 'post-progressive' before and after pictures taken.

Heather is absolutely fabulous! I recently experienced an odd back injury that left me completely debilitated. I couldn't sit or stand, I could only lay flat on my back. I went to a chiropractor, which not only made it worse, he actually caused nerve damage in my foot (which has now been numb for over a month). I went to one treatment with Heather. When I walked in, my pain was at an 8-9. When I walked out an hour later, my pain was at a 1. She saved my sanity that day, and since then, has been helping to restore the feeling in my foot. I 100% recommend Heather. She's very kind, gentle, and personable.

We wanted to go out for breakfast, but not at a chain, so I Yelped the area and we decided to go to Deja Brew Laugh A Latte in downtown Meridian.  Why the long name tho?  Deja Brew or Laugh A Latte would have been sufficient, no?  Anyway ....

We were the first customers of the day and were worried about there not being anyone there at breakfast time does that mean no one likes this place?  But someone has to be first, and soon after, the place started to fill up pretty good.  We sat ourselves (as the sign said) and our server came over.  We told her we hadn't been there before, and we'd need some time to check out the menu.  My daughter had already checked out the pastry case and ordered us a blueberry muffin to share.  It was sizable, (easily shareable), warm, loaded with blueberries, came with a good amount of softened real butter, and it was delicious.  A little crispy around the top edges, sweet, just really good.

My daughter had been wanting to try matcha and ordered a matcha latte; I ordered just a normal cup of coffee.  She wasn't crazy about the matcha and our server offered her some vanilla to mix in.  That, plus some Splenda and cream and she enjoyed the drink.

Our entrées:
Daughter had Huevos Rancheros.
Husband had Grandpa's Biscuits and Gravy.
And I had the French Toast.
We were all mostly pleased with our meals.  I say mostly because I'm the only person who had an issue with their dish and that was that there was no French with my Toast.  French toast should be eggy; it's a dish made of sliced bread soaked in eggs and milk, and mine was not.  It really was just toast with some cinnamon on it so that was disappointing.  My eggs were as I had requested them, the potatoes were good, and the ham was delicious.  Our server was really nice and attentive - even when the place got busy - so I didn't say anything about the French toast.  That's really the only issue we had.

The place is bright, spacious, good service, mostly good food; we'd definitely go back.
I love the "Cheers" atmosphere in here. Friendly atmosphere, tables to eat, a lounge area to relax and traditional bar. The food is outstanding, haven't had a mediocre meal yet. Plus, strong drinks!
This is a great place to go for emissions testing! It's in the Stinker gas station parking lot, and the service was fast and friendly.

In my opinion, the best pizza place in Boise. I have come for a couple of their gourmet nights, once for the "It's your day", and for a could regular lunches. The meridian location is significantly less busy than the one of state street or their fairview location, but that does not mean it isn't as good. It is probably better! The employees here are super helpful and friendly. I have not had a pizza I did not like here, but I am sure if I did, the employees would rectify the situation immediately and with a sincere smile on their faces. We will me moving closer to downtown the beginning of next month, but we will still be making the trip to this location!
Cold tacos and burrito, trash where they cook and on the ground, uncooked hard rice, rotten guacamole. Place is a disaster.

So I ordered a couple of Beefy Fritos Burrito on April 1st. Went back to my job site and began my feast. I asked for no cheese so I have to always double check to make sure cheese wasn't added. During my inspection on the second burrito I saw this staple inside the wrap. I know things are a little chaotic with Covid-19 going around but seriously? Not a very cool April Fools joke.
Ordering system is trash. And real people won't pick up the phone. Really disappointed in Chipotle now.

been here twice now. both times after I feel like I need a seriously strong seriously hot shower. the place is so filthy. the ball pit and the foam pit look like they have never been cleaned. the tunnels and slides and all that look so filthy. the mini golf section is black light and picks up on all the dirt on there and it's just retched. gives me the shivers just thinking about it.

that being said, the kids love it. everyone is always having fun in there and jumping and laughing and screaming. my son is nothing but smiles from the minute we walk in. he loses his mind. 

they need to figure out how to clean the place better. I have no idea how considering the place is filled with dirty little kids every day.

Finally stopped in after a family member recommended Le Peep.  It was pretty hopping when we stopped in and waited about 20 minutes to get seated.  

Everyone was so friendly and our server was always smiling!  They have a variety of items to choose from blintzes to Benedicts and everything in between.  They even have a breakfast banana split!! Hmmm, intriguing!  They also have a Keto option plus other health choices like  egg white omelets.  I had the Lumberjack, which is offered in most breakfast places but the bacon here, was super crispy and to my liking! I'll have to go back and try some of their other plates!!

My husband and I stopped in early in the morning & everyone was super nice & energetic. Clean space, great coffee, flavorful food & nothing we were served was greasy unlike some other places around meridian. Great way to start our day
This company sent one of their minions through our neighborhood to knock on doors IN THE MIDDLE OF A PANDEMIC WITHOUT A MASK ON. Are you kidding me???

It used to be such a nice place to go into.. I'm not sure if it's a change of management, but the warm Hawaiian hospitality was not there. Everyone just stares and rolls their eyes like they aren't happy to be there. I haven't been in since beginning of September and will not be coming back. The owners wouldn't be pleased.

Waitress was awesome.  Manager and kitchen help were horrible.  Not the first time we have been in.  I meant to write a bad review last time but figured I would give them a second chance.  The waitress had too many tables and the manager chewed her out for being social, trying to smooth things over with customers.  Food isn't great, not worth the poor treatment of the staff.  Sad that on a game night there are less than 2 full tables at 10:00 at 3rd quarter.

The total perk of a proposal without a ring is that you get to choose what you truly like. 

My now husband and I found this jewelry store on yelp and decided to start shopping. This was the first and only place we needed to go. I was able to have fun and build my ring to the design and style that I had in mind. All of the employees were incredibly helpful with helping us find the right design. 

They have a great program of cleaning your ring every 6 months and are always available for any questions. We will definitely be returning when my husband is ready to buy me the additional bands for our 5 year hahaha!

Avoid this company at all costs! Unfortunately I did not have the chance to do so my lease was purchased by them mid lease. Horrible customer service they do not fix broken things it took me two months just to figure out the leaves have changed hands and who to pay the rent too. I always pay my rent on time and kept the house clean and well-maintained. Before my lease was up I got an evection notice because they wanted to raise the rent they said the yard look bad. I vacated the residence and fortunately when I first lease the house I took a bunch of pictures of all the damages because I had moved in site on scene. After I moved out I got a letter saying I owe them $4300 for the damages that were there before I moved in which I have time stamped photos and emailed this property management the photos and the dispute. Two years later I get a call from a collection agency they never took care of my dispute and they sent me to collections horrible company horrible morals horrible attitude of the office manager. This company is not worth the headache! So now the only way I'll get back my deposit is to sue them which I will do. The office manager makes a bunch of claims that are not true thank goodness I keep good records of my written responses and pictures. Again for this company at all costs!!


I'll post before and after pictures, anyone the doubts may just go check the Better Business Bureau rating it's an F

Helped me in a pinch and quickly...I didn't find them initially since looking for Meridian Lock & Key...was able to make a key from a broken key too.

Thanks Randy for being so helpful and quick about it!

It's a bummer I cannot give Park Place 0 stars or I would. Seriously, save yourself and DO NOT RENT FROM THEM. All these people care about is money and how much they can legally suck out of you. Every single person I've talked to thinks the same thing & it looks like most of these reviews are saying the same thing. They do not care about you or what's in your best interest, though the ladies at the front desk are very nice. They will not communicate and are super unprofessional. Save yourself the hassle.

Go back to the old ways of doing things. I want to be able to walk in, make an order and walk out. Not sit in my car, place an online order and wait 10-15 mins to find out that my order was made wrong..
This location is going downhill.

Jeff made it so that everything worked out well. Jeff was very thoughtful and kind to me and my wife's needs. He and his team were easy to work with. I would recommend him easily to anyone moving to Boise.

I love coming here for breakfast! Either by myself or with a group. The waitresses are always on time with coffee refills and friendly service. I'm the type to find a place I like and not try anywhere else in the area so this is my spot!! Don't hesitate to stop in, even for a cup of joe. Hope it becomes your favorite as well!

I love the fact that there's a Vegan sweet go to so close to me.  It's like an oasis in crazy milk and butter desert world.  I usually just stick with the old school.  There's no fruit or crazy concoction but if you wanted one of those you can pick from what's in their fridge or create your own. 

The old school is a simple cinnamon roll with frosting. A lot of frosting. I'll say it again, a lot of frosting. 

There's a strawberry shortcake and you can create a bout a thousand different versions with all sorts of toppings. 

My only complain is that customer service can vary. Sometimes it's great and sometimes me and my group feel like we're hassle to the cashier.  The makers typically don't interact with the customers unless they are handing off an order but at least they do it in a personable way.  

I have a sense that the workers are not vegan which is ok but at least have a sense of why we are vegan.
Fun atmosphere for seafood lovers! I have been here twice now and each time the food was worth it! They also offered options on the menu for the one person with allergies to shellfish in our group.

Best bar/food in town!?
Food is amazing , great staff and environment  awesome vibes. A MUST try!!
-Ace The Barber

Ok!  The beer is good but that is about as good as it gets. No wine  or beer list on the table - had to ask for it (people got up and went to the bar to obtain a beverage), wrong and incorrect orders(no clue who ordered what and if correct , it had been served to the wrong person), warm Chardonnay, out of food, under cooked food, others in the group already finished eating before others ever received their food. Seriously, everyone was done eating before my husband received his dinner (except me).  My burger was "bloody". I clarified that I wished for my burger to be well done. I was informed that all burgers are done well unless otherwise requested.  I was the last one to receive my meal. So much for our annual  birthday dinner gathering.  I think this is the first time I have never left a tip (and we always tip and tip well). I will go again.... but only for a beverage. Never again for dinner!! Very disappointing!  To top it off, on the way out our server stated "thanks for getting me fired tonight"! Really!  We were there to have a great time with friends, eat and drink. As much as many of us wanted to have desert, if a dessert menu had been offered, we would have declined. Only two out of group had ever been here before (yes- I had made reservations with the correct number of people).  I signed up for "Yelp" so I could provide a review. I will call the Manager later to discuss the challenges. I had been so looking forward to trying this establishment! So much potential but oh so disappointing!!!!

Decided to try the new sub shop down the road when I was grabbing a quick lunch with a friend. I tried the Maple Bacon Chicken sub, with fries, and a soda. While it sounded good, what I got was pretty disappointing. I unwrapped it to find two large piece of bread, an incredible amount of shredded lettuce, and 5-8 small pieces of chopped chicken drowned in sauce, with one piece of sketchy looking bacon buried in the mix.
The bread tasted ok, but the entire sandwich was overwhelmed by the sauce, and the lack of protein or substance. It was just gross.
I moved on to the "famous" fries, which were famously bland and tasteless. For a price 7-9 dollars, there was no value there. Looks like someone in leadership is trying to fluff their profit by getting the cost down, and went way to far.

While I am not a fan of Subway or JimmyJohns, at least you get some food for your money, and comparatively you get a much better sandwich for a lot less. Nor I or my friend will be going back.

Such a cool (and tempting) concept of a place. By far my favorite treat from this place is there EDIBLE COOKIE DOUGH. It tastes exactly like the Non edible (delicious) kind. I would recommend a visit there for a special occasion, or even to take family or friends who are visiting from out of town!

After the latest meat plant scares, we decided to look for a local meat market who does their own butchering and sells local pork, beef, and sheep. Greenfield was recommended by a friend of ours and so off we went to try their meats.

This is a family run operation and we could see the steaks, bacon, ribs, ground lamb and lots of other meats. Everything looked clean and their was even a USDA Meat Inspector doing his periodic inspection the afternoon we were there.

We asked the young lady what would it take to get some custom cuts and she said that they were booked up through November doing custom slaughter and processing. Wow! She said if we wanted certain cuts, please call and they would see what they could do.

We finally got a chance to eat some of the meats we bought. Their beef is Choice grade and the ribeye steaks were some of the best we have eaten. Same goes for the wonderful smoked bacon we purchased. Smoke ham hocks are next on our try list.

We plan to buy all our meats here.

Thank you Mo' Bettahs for being open today!  I ordered and paid online, and pick-up service was great.

My wife got the Regular Kalua Pig and I got the Regular Teri Chicken.  Both were fresh and tasted great.

Really good take-out dinner!  Thanks again!

I end up ordering a lot of lunches for different medical offices through my job. One office repeatedly asks for Mo Bettahs every single time I take them lunch. Since I was in the area today, I stopped in. I ordered the two meat plate with white rice and Mac salad, and a six pack of their wings which they made fresh while I waited. The wings were crispy coated in their sweet and spicy sauce, while juicy and hot in the middle. The wings didn't actually make it home with my to go order, because I ate them first. The Kalua pig was just as good (salty, tender and delicious) as any i have had on the islands. so if anyone is creating an authentic Hawaiian plate lunch, Mo Bettahs is Da Kine!

One star off for not sharpening scissors/shears, three stars off for selling proud boy coffee and merch in a knife store. You know, just to make it *very* clear where they stand. I'm sure good ole boys feel welcome, but I would recommend all my non-white friends stay far away.

[edit]
Please see the response from the owner below. Yuuuup. I need say no more.
Ummm the best grilled cheese I've ever had in my life!!! Eating it super slow so I can savor every freaking bite!! And if course Cecile had the perfect wine to pair with it

Ignacio gave me the best customer service I've ever had in the Treasure Valley. After testing my battery, starter and alternator- he installed my new battery that was greatly needed. I've had that Toyota almost 19 years and I couldn't believe how friendly, thorough and professional he was- to top it off it was my birthday... dealing with car trouble was thee last thing i wanted to be doing. Thanks Ignacio and O'Reilly on Ten Mile Road!

I ordered a burger, asked for it to be cooked well done, it arrived med rare.  I didn't want to send it back, but I couldn't eat it.  Should have canceled my order.  The new burger was so full of sodium, the fries have way too much sodium, and I love salt.  The burger was well done, but it didn't make me feel good, my husband had a burger and felt the same way.  Didn't feel good, won't say anything further, took awhile for us to feel better.  Odd thing, it was happy hour, no discount for my Budlight, nothing fancy...it's not included in happy hour, seriously no discount for a Budlight?!  No worries, I will never go back!
Awesome food! Awesome service! My husbands favorite place to eat. Good prices. You don't have to wait long for your food.

It's just Panera they just serve regular ass shit nothing good. I have no pictures because they don't deserve any pictures on yelp. Hey Siri what is bland how many people that work there are just planned.

one snowy night it was the only place serve burgers still open around the meridian area.  My wife was craving a burger with onion rings.  I called in and ordered her the caramelized bacon burger with mushrooms.  She said it was one of the best burgers she has ever had.  I've ordered that same burger with onion rings about 3 more times since.  Very friendly staff as well.

I am absolutely over the moon with Brandy from Idahome...  she was able to carve out time for me during a very busy time just before the holidays and I couldn't be more appreciative!  She did a stellar job cleaning my home for the first time.  I don't have the stamina to do certain things like the floors so it's been a while.  When she left everything looked and smelled so clean.  And I've hired her to come back every two weeks from here on out... because she reasonable and affordable, which is not the case with most housekeeping companies.  Believe me, I've checked!  Plus Brandy does so much more than just cleaning.  Anything I need done she can help with.  Just ask!  I highly recommend Idahome and Brandy!

I loved the name of this coffee shop and I had some time to burn in the area , so I gave it try.

I decided to have an early lunch and ordered my "safe" BLT.  The BLT  was just fine.  It was not the best I have ever had; the "toast" felt like it had been waiting for me ;) (It LOOKED like toast but it had been out of the toaster for a while. ) This did not discourage me because it was a good quality bread and the other components of the sandwich were of good quality .

It is a great space, with good wifi and very pleasant and service oriented staff and I like the name of the place :)
I was pleasantly surprised. I didn't know my house could get that clean honestly. Great company!

Tried this for the first time and have to say, it was good. We had to wait about 40 minutes,   just know that this place is usually busy at dinner and there will be a wait.

I ordered clam chowder, crab cakes and hush puppies. All of our items were so good! The clam chowder is one of the best I've had in a long time. It was so creamy and loaded with clams. Crab cakes were filling, fries were also on point. I could've had just the hush puppies for dinner! They were definitely a crowd pleaser. Portions are a good size a so we ended up taking food home. 

Prices are a bit high, but let's face it, it's seafood!! This restaurant really makes sure they offer a variety of seafood options. I'll definitely be back!

Saw this new restaurant had opened when I was getting my nails done a few doors down and was pleasantly surprised with all the positive reviews for the first location in Boise.  We went for dinner and are so glad we did.  The restaurant does not take reservations but there was little wait.  Our waitress was super attentive, knew the menu well, and quickly had our food ordered.  The Caesar salad was delicious but I would not order if you don't like Parmesan..... there is a good amount of it in the salad.  Garlic bread is served while waiting for your meal.  We had the lasagna and scallop risotto.  Both were flavorful and ample portions.
Excellent communication, honest & reliable. Used them for our move out cleaning and the place was left spotless & smelling amazing! Thank you very much!

Hass was prompt, friendly, and most important honest about  my washer repair. His prices are reasonable and didn't try to upsale me. I'm  definitely keeping his card for future services and recommending to all my friends.

I just wanna say thank you to Ethan and the young lady that recommended the Steak bomb
It was amazing 
You guys were quick and friendly

I ordered takeout for lunch and really enjoyed their Flatbread pizzas! The Chipotle Chicken & Bacon was my favorite; delicious, with soft tender chunks of chicken & topped with their Chipotle sauce. The pepperoni was classic and yummy as well. On the side I had their Greek salad which was fresh & loaded with veggies. To drink I highly recommend the Passion Papaya Green Tea it was so refreshing and full of flavor! Great job Panera!!

We were lucky to stumble upon Panera's "preview day" while out exploring this afternoon.  I asked my husband to see if they had opened yet and sure enough there were cars in the parking lot and drive thru even though the sign still said "Opening Soon".  When we pulled up to the speaker we were told that they were not offering the full menu but they were taking donations of $5 per entree for preview... Score!  Our order should have been nearly $30 as pictured.  This was not advertised to the public but was more of a training day test run for friends and family; however, they did not turn us away.
