The person taking our order was SUPER helpful and patient.  We are new to the Panera world and had no idea what to order.  She was very knowledgeable and gave a lot of helpful hints and information.  I chose the "pick 2" with 1/2 a Frontega Chicken Panini and Mac & Cheese.  It also came with a bag of kettle chips.  All of it was delicious but I must go back for more of that Mac & Cheese ASAP!

My husband ordered and Italian Combo Sandwich with kettle chips and a bowl of French Onion Soup.  The sand which was much larger than we imagine it would be and came with a large pickle spear (they scored major points with the hubs because he loves pickles).  He didn't do much talking while eating but raved about his lunch when he was done.  He also forced me to try a bite of the soup and I will admit it was good.

I have OCD and I'm extremely picky so one of the major bonuses to me was the way they packaged our to go order.  My panini came in a nice neat box, there was a cardboard holder for the soup and mac bread all packaged separately, etc I also didn't have to leave the comfort of my car and wore pajamas through the drive thru. I didn't go inside to check out the facility but from the window I could tell it was a packed house of employees training.  The customer service was excellent and they got our entire order right.

They officially open to the public this TUESDAY 1/12/16 :) I look forward to going back and trying a salad (with a side of Mac & cheese of course!).

Sad to see a restaurant go down hill so fast! We will not be back!!! The Crab salad use to be so good we would come from Caldwell just for the good salad. The crab use to be REAL, sadly no longer. Why push the imitation off as real? So discussing!!! We will not be back and will tell everyone we know to avoid this place!!!!!

I've been going to Trista for my nails for a couple months now and she is amazing!! She has really taken her time to make sure we have a good fit for my nails. She uses forms to build up the acrylic, instead of tips, which gives a better shaped and fitted nail. Highly recommend this salon!!

I came to this Taco Bell to get some food and there was a sign on the door that said their lobby was open 4pm-9pm. I had showed up right at 4. I noticed on the other door they were having on the spot interviews from 4pm-6pm today so I waited patiently. I saw multiple employees look at me from the inside and walk by. I finally knocked and the door and the employee basically shooed me to the drive thru. So we went through the drive thru since we were. Una order food already and when we got to the door and asked about the interviews, the employee seemed to not know what we were talking about and neither did he care. I worked for Taco Bell for 4 years as a Supervisor and I would never talk to customers like they don't matter.
Gem of a store. Affable owners who have lots of knowledge and experience with the items they sell. Definitely worth a visit.

*2/19/15*** yelp was read...bathrooms improved greatly! HOUSE MUSIC WAS TURNED UP EVEN LOUDER FOR SPITE. You can see what you're dealing with here- encouring others to join other clubs and comiserating with others how problematic management hasbeen on such a silly thing. Lose another star.
*UPDATE* 2/18/15Axiom at the villiage has really gone downhill since only 4 months. With the hearing loss due to WAY TOO LOUD HOUSE MUSIC...my eyesight has improved to see how filthy the ladies lockers and general locker room are. The toilets are often disgusting also to mention often OUT of toilet paper!! The gym management in charge won't hear you over his enormous ego....relagating all issues to "intolerace". I'm pulling a star from my review for these major oversights in good business.
10/30/14-Lots of gym for your money. Its very clean. Great equipment; never see a down machine- and I'm here nearly everyday. Childcare is state-of-the-art and attended with kind and lovely women. Massage spa in house big plus! Movie theater workout is the BOMB! The pool and hot tub is treated with a salt water solution; 'le love'!!! My  only compliant (and the reason two of my friends quit this gym and I can't get anyone else to join - hey I want my perks so I want to get joiners) but their house music is so loud I have to blow my ear buds out not to hear their awful music selection on the P.A. system. Or worse, I feel like I have to shout to a pal to chat during work outs. Not good for ear health. Maybe more people will complain and they'll turn down the nasty house music. There are more workout options; but the above is what I use.

Horrible... I moved out of state for work and decided to use Park Place Property Management to rent out my house.  Worst decision of my life.  I would have been better off letting the house sit vacant for 2 years.  They nickle and dime you for BS repairs of coarse done by their own people. I paid $180 4 different times to have a stove burner fixed along with many other things every month.  There was obviously no screening done with either of the 2 tenants as the first one trashed the place and created a waterleak in the bathroom which caused a mold problem which mysteriously they never caught on their supposed walkthroughs that I'm sure never were done.  The second year i never even received any payments due to all of the repair costs and the new tenants rent was posted through a "low Income" source so definitely there was not any tenant screening.  The entire 2 years PPPM was trying to purchase my house from me sounds like another scam.  I ended up selling my house (not to PPPM) in the end because i couldn't afford the loss I was taking.  When i talked to a Realtor, he said I'm not the first person he's heard this from about PPPM.  In my opinion they are a crooked company and should be investigated by the BBB
This is the beef ravioli is was tasty. The bread given out is too hard (burnt/ crispy) for my liking.

There's a 1 star because of the safety of my pet is not what it should be here. It's unfortunate it had to end this way after getting my pet groomed here for the past 3 or so years. It's also really weird that we had the EXACT same situation as another reviewer. Yesterday we picked up our toy schnauzer and paid. After paying our groomer Samantha, asked us if anything was going on at home? My husband said no (unsure what she meant by that) and when he saw our dog he was blown away by what he saw. Our dog had full blown hemorrhaging in both of his eyes. Blood shot and one was worse than the other. How can that possibly happen? And honestly how can she even ask us if anything is going on at home? That sounded like she insinuated we had done this at home prior to bringing him into the salon. She then said it must have happened during the wash then. Our little guy is seriously a sweetheart and VERY well mannered so it was a shock that this had happened after the 3 or so years he'd been here. Since we have texted she said she's had the same assistant for the past 5 years and that she said ace did good, obviously her assistant or someone doesn't need to be working with dogs if this is how we get our dogs back. We have texted back and forth and she was kind enough to pay for our vet visit and get it taken care of. I'm hoping it starts to go away with the ointment provided by the vet. I just hope others are aware of what could happen at this grooming salon. First time he got kennel cough at the salon and we let her know and we had got the treated. Second instance she said he moved while grooming and she cut his ear to the point where she had to put blood clotting stuff to make it stop bleeding. I should've known then to stop taking him there but I didn't realize it could be this bad especially for how long he's been going with her. She did a great job at grooming no doubt, but all this to say, at what cost?

This company is pure garbage. They do not answer your calls/voicemails, texts or emails. You have to physically show up to the office in order to get anything done or addressed. They tried to charge my spouse over $700, IN ADDITION to his security deposit upon moving out despite the fact that he cleaned the place spick and span from top to bottom. They even tried to charge him prorated rent when he had already moved out at the beginning of the month! When you move out, make sure to read through what they're charging you with a fine toothed comb. They will put random abbreviations and not explain in detail on the invoices why they would charge so much for something. The invoice isn't even detailed. It was spelled wrong in various places and honestly, seemed like they made it on their own spreadsheet. 

To put it lightly, this company and the people who work for it are HUGE scumbags. DO NOT RENT FROM THEM. I doubt they treat their owners with respect. They hire people to fix up the place, who end up CAUSING damage and then try to pin it on you by charging you out of your security deposit. If we could give this company ZERO STARS, we 10000% would. We are so glad that he no longer has to deal with them and to be finally rid of these people. They are cheating scumbags. Not one good thing to say about this company at all.

Tonight hubs and I decided to check it out. Definitely busy...would get there early ...we got there around 6:30 and had to wait about 20-25 minutes. Place was packed & busy. My hubs had a Po boy sandwich with Cajun fries. I had snow crab boil with mild seasoning. The mild seasoning was a bit too spicy for me...got hot, little sweaty & nose started to run. It was good but next time gonna try different seasoning. 
Will try another time - hopefully won't be as busy...hard to have conversation cause it was loud inside. 

Had a mother daughter date lunch. Had a crab roll which was tasty. Filled with tons of crab meat. Daughter had shrimp/crab boil with butter garlic sauce. Nice amount of shrimp. Lunch time is definitely the time to go...definitely happier this time around!!

After church my husband and I decided to grab a burger for lunch but wanted to try someplace new.  So he drove and I pulled out our trusty Yelp app to find a burger joint.  The reviews looked good here so we decided to come and check out Pauli's.  Arriving, we noticed that this establishment used to be Rick's Pressroom, but obviously new ownership has taken its place.  We came in and the place was pretty empty, with the exception of a few patrons at the bar area.  It was obvious you find your own table and so we found a place and as soon as we sat down we were greeted by the friendly server/owner. surprisingly they were serving brunch (it didn't feel like a brunch place) and we had our minds set on having a burger.  Our server told us that since they were really only serving brunch at this  time but would ask the cook/owner if he would fire up the grill and he agreed.  However, when we asked what they had for the brunch, thinking we would come back to try brunch at another time, we changed our mind and decided to eat brunch.  I'm really glad we did!  They make your eggs fresh so you go up and grab all the other delicious options---biscuits and gravy, Coconut French toast, pancakes, bacon, sausage and fresh fruits with homemade whipped cream.  Everything was delicious.  We will definitely be back and try their burgers or have brunch again.

Ordered flowers for my Daughter's 50th Birthday.  These were just so beautiful and they made her so happy.  Fantastic place to work with, delivered on time and exactly how they should have looked.  I am from out of state and they were recommended by the Meridian Chamber of Commerce.  Rick is actually the one that recommended them.  Hats off to him also as he stated they use them for quite a few deliveries.  Julie is who I worked with and she was a sweetheart.  So glad I went through them and will again.  You won't be sorry.  See attached picture~~~~  Just lovely

Recieved a beautiful flower arrangement from a friend in Germany.  It is gorgeous!  Thank you to all who work to make these special gifts very very special.
karen morrow
We loved this spot in Meridian!  We ordered a crawfish boil bag for the teen, and I had fried catfish & sweet tater fries. It was delicious, and reminded us of our trip last winter to New Orleans.

So I really  wish I could describe how good that bomb steak sub was. Like things this good really be illegal. Its just stupid good, I Really don't understand how it could be this good! Seriously you will NOT be disappointed!

I've been coming to this location for over a year, the workers are amazing and always know exactly how I like my coffee. They're so kind and I love coming to this location. They're as good as it gets when it comes to coffee and other drinks!

This place is a good, old fashioned pizza joint. The decor is fun with old cartoon paintings. Lots of booths & tables to dine, and some fun air hockey & video games. The have a "buy one get one half off" deal, and our pizzas were pretty good! The crust is thick - I'm not sure if you can order it thin but I'll check next time. There's a little bar area, and I noticed they will deliver beer along with your pizza! Nice!

Not a fan!  Apparently I'm not into eating with my hands and getting messy.  We went on a double date to check out this new place and I don't think we'll be back.  They were packed as it had just recently opened.  We grabbed cocktails at the bar while we waited about 20 min for our table.  Apparently they had just gotten their liquor license that day so the bar wasn't fully set up and it was rather chaotic.  This is very much a chain restaurant trying to set a vibe with their kitschy decor.

We ordered hush puppies and fried calamari right away.  The food came out quickly and the hush puppies were delicious but we would not order the calamari again.  Half of our table ordered their food cajun style while the other half opted for butter & garlic.  I will definitely say that the cajun fans enjoyed their food a lot more.  My husband ordered the Reel's Catch ($46) with lobster tails, crawfish, and clams.  I ordered the make your own combo ($27) and got 1 lb of snow crab legs.  We shared our food and both agreed that we would never order the crawfish again.  The food was okay but everything tastes the same and it is very messy.  We may go back down the road to see if it has improved but I'd rather spend my money elsewhere.

They came to clean my AC and heating unit. They actually subcontracting the cleaning out to another company which is ok but it was a bit high on the price side of things. They quoted me for a sum of money for a few thousand for cleaning and putting a new top on my exhaust line. They said it would not be close to that price but they put it in the quote just in case something happened. They ended up charging me pretty much the whole quote price and didn't have a really good reason why. I paid it because my system needed to be cleaned. Nice salesman but again, it's pretty high in the price side.
Place was on point, good atmosphere, great convos, relax environment, very friendly staff and quick service with appointments. Haircut has been the best place I've found in Idaho
My family and I love this church family! The Pastors love the people and worship is incredible!! I have called Harvest Church my church home for 18 years.
Great Hawaiian food. Good portion size. Excellent flavors. Cool atmosphere for a good lunch.

I was greeted by friendly, knowledgeable and energetic employees who re-familiarized me with Hawaiian barbecue (it had been over a decade), enthusiastically recommending and letting me sample their favorite dishes.  I've seen this before in some of the world's best run companies, from high tech to services to food, and it's always a sign of the same thing - a culture driven by the CEO that is empowered to hire the best people, provide the best training and tools, then let them spread their wings to be the best they can possibly be.  And they are hiring!  If you want to be part of this awesome family, text HIRE ME to 85760.

Oh, I got so excited about the service I almost forgot about the food.  I had the Teriyaki Chicken with Brown Rice and Mac Salad, and it was ah-maz-ing.  The bottomless house made Passion Orange Huava drink kept my thirst quenched, and the slick little utensil dispenser kept me entertained.  Check them out!

I've been meaning to post a review but life happens and I forget. Today when ordering online  I noticed the reviews weren't great for this location and I thought I've never had a problem the last few years.  
Pizza Hut has actually been the fastest delivery, hottest pizza and friendliest staff in the area. Today it said 70-80 minute wait time for delivery it was actually around 40 minutes or less. As always the pizza and breadsticks were hot and delicious. 
The first time I ordered delivery a few years back they got to our house so fast that I even said "Wow, that was super duper fast."  The man apologized and they emailed me a coupon.  He must of thought I was not happy but I was.  The pizza was cooked; hot, fresh and delicious. I even left awesome feedback on their survey. 
I've had no complaints in the last few years.  I have gone here for carry-out as well and they are always polite and my pizza is always hot and the correct order.  
Pizza Hut has always been my favorite since I was a kid. We would go inside; eat breadsticks and salad bar why we waited for our pizza.  We would play songs on the jukebox and of course play PAC-MAN. Those were the good old days.  At least now we can still enjoy the same pizza at home.  
Thanks Pizza Hut for being prompt, polite and above all hot, fresh, delicious pizza.
This place is so good! We always get a boil with crab legs and shrimp, seriously so good. The wait time can be a bit long so plan ahead for that but I would recommend!

Finally found our go to Italian spot! Everything we ordered was absolutely delicious! Husband LOVED the Filet Mignon Pasta. Service was wonderful--Antonio, thank you for your fantastic customer service. The chef even made it a point to greet table to table which is always appreciated. Love the 1/2 liter wine option as well. We came in about 5:15pm on a Saturday and were seated right away. Noticed all tables filled up quickly thereafter. Definitely will be coming back time and time again. Superb all around.

my portions are perfect in a medium box not cramped together normally but today they were very small I had to ask for another small box for my meat because they were trying to stack stuff and it wouldn't even close and when I asked for another box they were rude trying to put it on the side for me to move the meat into the second box later and I had to ask for them to move it so the box closes all the way. I didn't appreciate the attitude normally I have good customer service and normal portions but today was a bad experience.

I so enjoy leaving a positive review for a business that demonstrates excellence in every way!  Hoss of Greenbelt Appliance Repair is knowledgeable about appliances old and new, works hard to be able to at least stop by and assess the problem the same day you call, and sets up a timely repair--even when
 he has to order parts.  I have an older dishwasher that wouldn't close and it turned out the latch was broken and had to be ordered.  But the part arrived super fast and a couple of days later my dishwasher was up and running.
Here's what he DID NOT DO:  
1.  He DID NOT charge a fee to walk in your front door.
2.  He DID NOT try any sort of "bait and switch" tactics -- did not say, "Oh, well your dishwasher is an older model, and you need a new dishwasher.
3.  He DID NOT charge by the hour and then take forever to complete the repair.  He completed it within a half an hour, started it up and did a cleaning rinse, and determined that it was good to go.  
4.  He DID NOT  charge me an arm and a leg for the repair--I felt that the total for parts and labor was VERY fair.

I told him I expected that I would be needing a new washer and dryer in the future; he asked to look at them, and told me they were in excellent condition and easy to repair and to hold on to them.

Who demonstrates that kind of integrity these days??? :-)  Glad to say that Greenbelt Appliance Repair does!

Vitality Acupuncture is a great place to go to get feeling better. 

I wasn't sure weather or not acupuncture would help, I've never gone before and I was almost 5 month post ankle and toe surgery, I had tried everything to get the swelling down and nothing worked. After my first visit the swelling went way down and I was able to work on movement without all the swelling.  Just within the 2 weeks I have gone I have seen so much improvement.  I am so happy I went and will continue to go until healed.

Update 6/22/2020: we have seen zero wasps this summer. I would pay SO much money to keep this incredible result. 

We have a spider and a wasp problem and we've tried to take care of it ourselves for the last two years. But after both our kids got stung by wasps last summer, we knew we needed to get some professionals. 

I was referred to Vertex by a friend and then of course checked the Yelp reviews. It was a pretty easy choice! We opted for the quarterly service which includes a first, thorough treatment.  Because we were referred, we got 50% off! So this first one was $85. After that it will be $99 a quarter. 

They sprayed the foundation and eaves, put granules in the grass, dewebbed and denested all over the house and treated all the areas wh they found nests. If we see any nests or extra pests, they will come out every time to take care of it free of charge! 

I can't yet speak to the long term quality of the service, but I was really impressed by our first appointment. Matt was our technician and he was amazing. Efficient and very knowledgeable. He patiently answered all our questions (while maintaining a 6 ft distance). 

Yay for no more wasps!

I attended this church for a number of years, I left over a year ago and myself and my family are still consistently harassed by leaders and members of this organization who are literally angry at us for leaving and have sought to turn our old friends and even family against us. I would not recommend attending this place.
Amazing food, would recommend.  The Mac salad along with teriyaki steak and pork is unbeatable
Love this little coffee shop in downtown Meridian. Great service & staff. Nicely decorated. Tons of yumminess on the menu.

This as authentic Hawaiian as your going to find in the Treasure Valley, or even in all of Idaho!

The katsu, teriyaki chicken, and kalua pig are all quality picks. They're full of flavor, juicy, and given in generous portions. The mac salad is some of the best I've ever had. I usually ask for extra mac instead of rice.

The staff is very friendly and courteous.

It's absolutely possible to get out of here for under $10, unless you want more food to take home with you.

This place is one of my mainstays in the Valley.

O'Reilly has always been good about having parts. They are also very helpful when I need to figure something out too. I needed a computer for my vehicle. The closest one was in Salt Lake. I called them at 5:20 in the evening and they were able to get it on their shipment and had it here the next day! Thank you guys! A++++

I'm going to start out strong and simply put - I hate Panera. Ridiculously inflated prices for subpar food that will have you spending more time in the restroom than it took to eat your meal (TMI?). On 07/07/2021, I ordered a pick 2 meal Turkey avocado sandwich and side of Mac and Cheese. Correct me if I'm wrong, but wasn't it around $8.00 for the pick 2 meals before? And I swear the sandwiches were bigger. I paid $12.49 for the smallest meal I've ever ordered at a drive thru. Sandwich wasn't even good and the Mac and cheese has gone downhill. What was I to expect? Whatever. I'm just an upset customer who was left still hungry after paying 1.5x the minimum wage for a stupid fast food lunch. Ugh. 

Also, I would love to know (or maybe I'm better off now) knowing what the hell kind of preservatives or flavor enhances Panera uses. I had a God-awful stomachache the entire rest of the day and next morning. 

I never have luck with fast food places, especially as of lately. I guess I'll just have to start making my own lunch to much of my annoyance but at least I know what's in it.

I've thought long and hard for the past 3 years about my most recent hair decision - that is longer than I've thought about any one of my tattoos, or purchasing my car, or going to college out of state. I say all of that to make the point it was a big deal that I finally just went for it and...drumroll...permed my hair.

To preface the rest of this review, I will say I had zero color on my hair when I did this, which allowed the perm to take really well. I showed my stylist, Tisha, dozens of photos of perms that I loved and plenty of photos of what I did not want (I was terrified of looking like I stepped out of a 1980's rom-com). She knew exactly what it was I was going for. She incorporated lots of different size rods throughout the perm to give it a really natural look, which totally worked. I didn't expect it to turn out exactly like I wanted...but it did!! And I am so excited about it.

The whole appointment took about 2.5 hours and consisted of getting my hair washed...A LOT. As she styled and dried my hair, she gave me the full scoop on how to care for my perm (what shampoos/conditioners to use, how to blow-dry it,  how often to get a trim, and when she thought I should come back to touch it up.) I'm so thankful she did, because I'm already finding that curly hair is a heck of a lot different to care for/style than my natural locks. Her perms cost $140, which is a price I am more than happy to pay for her experience and expertise (she's been doing hair for over 30 years and did perms when they were in style).

I left the salon giddy about my new hairstyle. I'm so glad I finally did this and I am SO thankful I came to Tisha for it. It turned out better than I could have ever hoped for! Thank you, Tisha!

I, too, had a massage groupon given to my by my wife for valentine's day.  I'm very glad that, after reading these reviews, I kept an open mind.  There are some issues, but the therapist was awesome!

Booking:
I had a hard time remembering to call during the mid-morning hours to get an appointment scheduled.  Had left 2 messages, never got a call back.  Once I talked to someone, they were booked about about 3.5 weeks.

Massage experience:
The entry area is a bit noisy, but not bad.  Definitely a busy chiropractic office.  Once she came to get me (about 10 minutes before the actual appointment time, I'd filled out a simple questionnaire when I arrived about 15 min. before appt.) we walked through the chiropractic care area to a back hallway - much quieter.  She asked if I saw a Chiropractor, which I do, and she never mentioned it again.  She'd also asked if I got massages, and again I do, but not in a few months.  We discussed my pains and any issues, and she left to let me get ready.  She had a fan on, and noted it was to provide white noise, and asked me to let her know if I got chilly and she'd turn it off.  She had nice music on, so I considered it, but decided since I heard noting from outside I'd let it go.  It was never an issue.

The massage itself was excellent- as I like medium pressure.  She definitely found the knots in my calves, forearms, and shoulders, and worked them out well.  Since it was only an hour, we agreed beforehand that me staying face down the whole time was optimum.  She stretched all my limbs, and from my perspective was as well or more qualified than any of the other therapists I've seen.

I do plan to go back, but buy 1.5 hr packages.  By the way, her name is Traci.  I would highly recommend her.

Worst chipotle in the country. I once ordered a burrito from Uber eats off here and it was no larger than the width of my hand. I've never had a pleasant experience with the staff here, no matter how fast the turn-over rate is and how often they get fresh faces. Very disappointed to have a chipotle in meridian, but have it be the worst in the nation.

This place gets excellent reviews, so I'm not sure whether we hit it on a rough night, or what. It was clear that the waitstaff were rushed off their feet and trying very hard to keep up. We appreciate their efforts.

The good, first: our meals were very tasty. We each ordered a different pasta, and while I thought the "Il Sugo" sauce was lacking, generally we were pleased. Between us, we had Arrabiata with penne, Italian sausage sauce on fettuccine, the filet minon pasta, and the Il Sugo with radiatori. All pretty good. My children were also very happy with their Italian sodas.

The downside: the antipasti we ordered was kind of meh, the bread was pretty disappointing ( why bring in Gaston's bakery and then sprinkle it with bagged Parmesan and dried herbs? Bummer.), and our sodas were under-syruped. 

Overall, our children loved it, but I don't think my husband and I would go back for date night.

What can you say about one Panera v. another. One good thing about formula restaurants is if they are under tight control, one is pretty much like another, no matter where.

The new one in Meridian runs true to form.Panera is one of our favorites for quick and good food, especially when traveling. Beats stopping at McD to use their restrooms and the clientele is a bit more upscale, along with pretty good food, clean premises, quick service and fair prices. The menu boards, pastry and breads are well laid out so selection is easy providing you know in advance what you want. But if you are new to a Panera, it may take time to order as you peruse the goodies and menu boards.

The breakfast menu stops at 10:30 AM. Hot menu items are many. Lunch goes from regular sandwiches, panini, hot dishes, soups, and salads. Calories are shown by each item on the menu boards. We like the  You pick 2 lunch, pick 2 of the following for your lunch: Cup of Soup · Half Sandwich · Half Salad · One Flatbread. The Broth Bowls with Soba Noodles or Quinoa are also good and different.

This period is during their "newness" so the crowds at lunch were almost overwhelming. We would expect them to decrease as the novelty wears off. But we bet they are really putting a dent in Kneaders' business across the street. But even with the crowd, service was quick as the staffing was sufficient to handle the lunch crowd. Questions were handled and explanations were good and as detailed as necessary.

Parking is good and plentiful. Handicap access is easy and correct. Rest rooms are fully adequate for wheel chair patrons. But the tables are a bit crowded for wheelchairs. Seating is at regular height chairs and tables.

For a chain, we find them useful and attractive with better than average food.

When my sister bought them the first time, it was pretty good. We did microwave it though to warm it up. The second time, I went. The customer service sucked! The girls behind the counter were rude and not helpful. We were the first in line, but our 2 rolls and brownie took long to get. I seen others getting their order before ours. And, here I'm standing, barely, with my handicap self with a cane, watching other customers get theirs made and given to them as they pass by me. The roll itself was cold, hard, unflavorful, and I couldn't even get past a couple of bites. I only sifted through the topping to try and eat what I could to salvage the overpriced hockey puck called a cinnamon roll we bought. The brownie was crumbling and was so-so. A boxed brownie mix would've been better. Soooo disappointed in this place!  I am perplexed how it gets 5 stars..although, my sister rated it 5 the first time we had them. The toppings are a great idea..make the buns better though, and have your employees be kinder and use better customer service.

Great service and beautiful flowers! I placed a same day delivery order and the flowers were delivered within 3 hours of the time I placed the order. Special thank you to the delivery driver who was extremely friendly and patient while i was trying to figure out the gate code for the delivery! I highly recommend this flower shop! :)

Have had a facial and go there for pedicures. I love the pedi room and the chairs are easy to get in and out of for seniors.  Everyone is super friendly and helpful. My facial was wonderful in fact I want to get another one

This wasn't our first visit to Le Peep, but may be our last. First the 2 of us were seated at a table by the windows and entrance to the restrooms, were I had, maybe, 3 ft between the wall and  my elbow. After waiting 15 minutes we still hadn't give water or asked if we wanted coffee, so we walked out. I'm not sure if there have different management but service was totally lacking. All I expect is some acknowledged when we get seated. Too many options to go back again.
I give it 3 stars for our previous times there, otherwise it would be 2.

I have eaten here on several occasions and have consistently had the same quality of food and service.  

First off...everyone is always so friendly and accommodating. Two thumbs up for the family that owns this business. Every time I have come, the husband is happily running the front end while his wife ( the owner) is taking care of the back of the house.

Big props for the truly expansive gluten free menu. It is honestly one of the only places in town that I feel there is actual, real options to choose from and not a list of items off the main menu with half the ingredients omitted. 

I have been here at breakfast and lunch and both were great. The gf hamburger comes on this tasty flatbread served open face. A breathe of fresh air from the usual thick bready buns most serve.

My favorite breakfast option is the 18 wheeler. Eggs, your choice of meat (ie bacon, sausage) and two slices of gf french bread. The french bread is oh so good!!

They also have a great kids menu with reasonable serving sizes and prices.

Tips:
They get super busy on weekends, so expect a wait if you arrive at prime breakfast time.
 
They have a punch card. Ten punches, $10 off your meal

Check in for a free coffee!!

My boyfriend and I were really excited to try this place finally! We called ahead and the hostess said she would put our name on the list via Yelp, and the wait time was 60 mins. The app kept us up to date on how many people were ahead of us. We got there 60 mins later, went in to check in and the hostess tells us "oh we're telling everyone it's 75 mins now". I asked if she meant we had an extra 15 mins of waiting, or if she meant and EXTRA 75 mins on top of the hour we already waited. She shrugged and said "I don't know, people take their time to eat". SHE SHRUGGED. 

I'm sorry, I've been a server for 13 years. I'm in a restaurant at half capacity right now too, and the hostesses at my restaurant would NEVER shrug at a customer and not know what they're doing. These two girls were airheads. They were poorly trained, and had ZERO clue what they were doing. It's not too hard to say "hold on one sec, I'll go check tables and see if anyone is checking out soon so I can quote you a better time. Since you've already been waiting the time we quoted you!"  So easy, and exactly what I would have done in their shoes. 

The food? It was alright, the seasoning was awesome! The portions were very small for the high price. Next time we'll go to Joe's Crab Shack, at least their employees are friendly and know what they're doing. 

Side note: the manager was hanging around the hostess stand with the underage girls for the entire hour and a half we were there. Like a vulture. My boyfriend and I both thought it was very creepy and unprofessional.

My partner and I just purchased an engagement ring. Anthony helped us and was incredibly helpful, patient, and kind. He made our experience positive and fun from start to finish, and we walked out with the most perfect ring we could have asked for. He was attentive to our every need and spent a significant amount of time with us. We never felt rushed and we had his full attention throughout the entire experience. He helped us to achieve the look we wanted within the parameters of our budget and we couldn't be more grateful and excited! Thank you Anthony, we love Lee Read!

I just bought some Greenfield smoked pork chops and thank God I read the ingredients before serving to my husband.  We were so looking forward to having these for dinner. They have a host of really crappy additives including propylene glycol which my husband is severely allergic to.  MSG is in it which I have an allergy to.  Several other ingredients I can't even pronounce.  I thought greenfield was supposed to be more natural meats?  Just wasted $14 dollars and now no dinner.  Never again.

Breakfast was good but customer service was even better. My husband grew up in Meridian and we were back in town visiting and he remembered our waitress working there when he was a kid! She was a peach and they even made me something that wasn't on the menu. My son had amazing French toast. Will return again when we are back in town.

Le Peep was a bit of a surprise. Decided for some brunch after checking out some of the other businesses on the block and settled on LePeep. 

From the outside it looks as if it will have a smaller layout and a ambiguity to it that is interesting. The inside is clean and has a very "corporate" feel to it. I'm not sure if it's a chain or locally owned, but it runs like a larger company. 

The food was very generous on portion size and price. Ordered a breakfast burrito which was massive and a side Belgium Waffle. I thought the burrito would be smaller so the double order was fine. Let me tell you it was massive and full of flavor. 

Really enjoyed my time here. Would visit again.

This review specifically goes to Sierra. 

Walking into a candy store, I really didn't expect the level of customer service that I got from Sierra. She was beyond helpful and answered any questions I had. She asked me questions and then recommended me different items based on my answers. 

Kudos to management for training Sierra to be super helpful. 

Thankyou Sierra for making my visit worth while. :)
She did good work, but she was 10 minutes late to the start of my appointment. I was walking out to leave as she was walking in. I hope that was a fluke and not her typical level of professionalism.

Limited dinning area wasn't cleaned there is only three tables and they were all open but dirty  and we had to sit at a dirty table. Staff was very bothered when I forgot that I needed to order a drink and asked to get one and were just not approachable.
Terrible and unprofessional people. They are unreasonable unkind and irrational. Slum lords...and don't  care about people at all.
Very good!  The staff is friendly.  Just take the tail off the shrimp, if it is plated with the shrimp in top it may be ok.  Alfredo was great.  My hubby had the pesto noodles, too much.

Ah...so much hope, so little delivery. I have waited MONTHS for them to reopen so I could try their "authentic cajun." Today, for Fathers Day, we finally tried them. I knew that my only choice would be crawfish, what's more Cajun than crawfish?

I opted for the cajun season and wanted it as hot as possible, having lived in the Gulf Coast, I have really missed real authentic crawfish, heat intense enough to make you question if you're allergic, but flavor so wonderful to push through the heat.

Sadly, the crawfish did NOT deliver on either front. Yes they were large, but were previously cooked, then frozen, so tough and with absolutely none of the incredible flavor fresh mudbugs have. Heat, seriously, they call this cajun hot? This was cajunish mild and that was being generous! I?d like to suggest someone from corporate to try my favorite place in the Houston are, Dickenson Seafood, that or any of the Crawdaddys locations in the gulf coast. THAT is what good mudbugs are supposed to taste like.

I wonder how many people try craws here, don't care for this sad travesty, and never give them the chance to be the thing of beauty they can be.

M wife, she ordered the chicken as she's not a seafood person, she was also disappointed.

So the question is, will I return...probably, alone, but never again for frozen crawfish! Look, crawfish must be fresh, live, if they're out of season, don't offer them, simple as that.
Our server Cambridge was awesome! She was so sweet and attentive, and helpful! The food was pretty darn delicious too. It was a great experience.
The menu was great. Very busy because the food was good. Service was amazing. Quick and efficient service.

I wish the sugary sweet niceness wasn't just surface. I had a very positive experience, I only attended youth group and didn't get close to anyone and went on some Sundays. Some things were conflicting with their rules so that's when I realized the control. I really wish they didn't exclude others from other churches wanting to visit. I do miss their dances, that was fun. I wish they were more accepting to visitors like all churches. Or people wanting to be involved in their community who don't go to their church.

Ok, so this is just a preliminary review because I actually haven't been to their office yet.  I was at an Idaho Stampede game the other night and Dr. Hawkins and presumably some other staff members were there and offering free adjustments.  I have suffered with knee pain since the fall of 2010 when I took a spill and whacked my knee on a curb.  That night at the game the pain was incredible, approximately an 8 on the pain scale.  As I have previously had success with chiropractic adjusts (last adjustment was in 2006), I thought I would see if an adjustment would help. Dr. Hawkins adjusted my knee and I felt it pop; relief was immediate.  That was four days ago now and I am still virtually pain free.  My knee hasn't felt this good in almost five years. A huge Thank you to Dr. Hawkins and the young lady that registered at me.  She was very polite and very friendly.

I've taken my dog here numerous times over the years since they opened, but my last visit was horrible. My corgi went in for a bath and brush grooming, nothing major. She takes a sedative before she goes and has never had an issue. This grooming, however, caused a medical crisis. My dad took her in while I was at work. He was told when he picked her up that she has a nosebleed during grooming. That's never happened before. When she got home, she was VERY crippled up when trying to walk. She was wheezing. None of this has happened before. As I was petting her the next day, I discovered a fairly nasty cut near her shoulder. A phone call was made to Dawn, who asked us to bring Sayde back to the spaw and denied any wrongdoing. We said that we would not bring a traumatized and ill dog back there, but text message photos of the cut to Dawn. Oh, and Dawn stated that my dog was unhealthy. She has a managed medical condition and is under routine care by a vet. She is NOT unhealthy. Needless to say,  I never got a reply, call or anything. Meanwhile, my dog was placed on daily steroids for a week and it took weeks for the cut to heal. I don't know what happened there. If I had to guess, I'm guessing that the groomer was too rough and my dog fell off the table while in the "noose". As for the cut, I don't know. 

I don't have enough adjectives for terrible to use here.

il Sugo Italian Kitchen was a pleasant surprise. We celebrated my moms 70th birthday and she requested Italian food. I had seen this restaurant in the strip mall before it had opened and decided to try it. They have decorated the inside super cute. The service was amazing, attentive and friendly. We all enjoyed our food and had a great evening. I love they have a front slider door that allows for fresh air in the restaurant. Definitely a must try if you are in the mood for Italian food.

This place has some very fresh food and pretty good waiters. I've had really good service here once and mediocre service here another time. However, I thought the food was decent & has really good coffee. I really liked the scenic photos around Idaho in the restaurant - it gives the restaurant a nice touch!

SHADY- DO NOT GO HERE!!! MUST READ: My husband and I took our Yukon to get new tires and they asked how he wanted to pay. He said Id prefer to finance. After running his credit they let him know the interest and he immediately let them know that we decided to pay in cash. We paid in full upon pick up 24 hours later and here we are.. 1 week later and WE JUST RECEIVED A CREDIT CARD ACCOUNT OPENED UP IN OUR NAMES! They legitimately signed us up for a Tire Pros credit card, which many of you know hurts our credit and we are now stuck with... WITHOUT AUTHORIZATION. This is not only illegal this is unethical and wrong. DO NOT GO HERE!

Excellent handyman service.  Professional and competent.  Will use again when the need arises.
DES/Joan
Not a fan of crawfish, the rest was great. Service was ok. This place gives you a lot of food, so plan on sharing.
Le Peep has never let me down.  Great food and great service from happy, friendly people!
Awesome place the gm Yvonne is great at her job and the food is unbelievably good seriously the plates here are huge and packed with flavor not to mention it's fairly priced.
Exceptional service can be had by Jon Bean with the Caldwell Banker Tomlinson Team! The call was painless, (208) 204-6762, the results we're unmatchable!

Got take out breakfast from this spot today. I ordered the gluten free breakfast sandwich. I took one bite of my sandwich and it was so dry I could barely swallow it. The eggs were overdone and there wasn't any sauce or condiments on the sandwich so it was like eating stale bread. I ended up just eating the one piece of bacon out of the sandwich and the potatoes instead. 

If you're ordering something other than the breakfast sandwich it may be worth stopping here but overall there are better breakfast spots in Boise!

I ordered a burger, asked for it to be cooked well done, it arrived med rare.  I didn't want to send it back, but I couldn't eat it.  Should have canceled my order.  The new burger was so full of sodium, the fries have way too much sodium, and I love salt.  The burger was well done, but it didn't make me feel good, my husband had a burger and felt the same way.  Didn't feel good, won't say anything further, took awhile for us to feel better.  Odd thing, it was happy hour, no discount for my Budlight, nothing fancy...it's not included in happy hour, seriously no discount for a Budlight?!  No worries, I will never go back!  
Actually cliff it was just minutes after 5, i asked if it was happy hour, and she said yes.  Our server was great, but the food made me sick, sodium level is off the chart!

This is a good almost diner-style breakfast place. The decor and environment are nothing to write home about; the place is kind of noisy. However, they are exceedingly efficient at getting you sat down, getting your drinks and order, and getting your meal out. That makes it ideal if you want to get a good-tasting breakfast and don't want to wait forever. That being said, the food is exactly what you expect, a very no surprises straightforward breakfast place. 

Because the place is busy, try to be nice to the wait staff. That seems to be a lesson many of the people around us failed.

Nearly 4 years later and the Express Cafe has maintained it's food quality and locals ambience.  The food is still good and well cooked and the quantities are huge. Certainly share-able for normal eaters. You can't find larger orders of hash browns or country potatoes than here. The fact that they have shredded hash browns is a plus in my book. And their Belgian Waffle are CRISP, not soggy like some places, is also a home run.

Jammed at weekends, so we go on weekdays when the crowds taper down.

Why not 5 stars? As before, they serve (UGH) Farmer Bros. coffee. Weak, Weak, and no body, need I say more. I still haven't tried bringing in an outside coffee to drink with breakfast. Will they throw me out? We'll see.

My Bogie loves it here! We've been bringing him for about 1.5 years and so far, so good. Dr. Madura and her staff are always friendly and happy to see Bo.  He's a Boggle-a Boston Terrier and Beagle mix and man, is he loud!!  They all know when Bogie is visiting because he howls and "talks" to them.  We crate him when we have to go out of town and he gets all of his medicine and vaccinations here.  They're affordable and provide excellent care!

My husband sent me flowers for our 20th year anniversary.  These roses are over the top beautiful!  They arrived on June 2nd and they are just as beautiful today June 11th. Very Impressed!  The white roses are Huge! I will definitely use The Flower Place the next time I need an arrangement of flowers.
This place is wonderful. I love the park up and the food and drinks are incredible.  Thank you!
I would recommend this place to anyone it is a great atmosphere with helpful friendly staff great prices and great results and they have you in and out in no time
As other people have stated, this place could be great if the owner never stepped foot in the building.

So I ordered through door dash and the food was not good.  It seems like it was fried but left out. The fried oysters tasted off. The sweet potato fries were hard and dried.   For the amount of money I paid I would not recommend the food.  I ordered 3 items and had to discard 2.
Love! Love, love! Reasonable, outstanding work! I will use Idahome from now on! Every detail of my move out house cleaning was tackled, Brandy even did touch up paint to get my full deposit back!
I love the food here! My favorite is the teriyaki steak and chicken plate. Always good and always fresh.  I stop every time I'm in Boise.

We have been using A-1 for about 2 years at our residence for both routine checkups and general HVAC maintenance.  Both the scheduling and the service personnel have been pleasant and professional, and the service techs have shown up on time.  Most recent service tech "Nick" provided the most thorough cleaning and detailed condition report I have ever had during any checkup visit from any HVAC company anywhere ever.  Definitely recommend these folks.

Not very happy with my experience. I had an appointment with Vanessa scheduled for 1, stylist rescheduled 30 min. before my appointment for 1:45 because her current client was taking a while, which I thought was understandable. I arrived at 1:45 and ended up waiting until 2:30. When my stylist came out, she seemed very rushed, again, understandable. But she never slowed down, made me feel anxious. During the appointment, she was very rough and would pull my hair hard while telling me to keep my neck straight. While she was applying color, she would basically hit my head with the brush. I literally had a headache. The end product was pretty but not at all what I wanted. She was very nice but I went in wanting light brown with golden, honey blonde highlights and paid $95 for straight up silver hair.
I'm sorry but over a hour for pizza is ridiculous and the door dash guy is still waiting for the pizza to come out of the oven.

Can't recommend these guys enough!  Brandy is amazing. I was super stressed and busy trying to get my dad's house up for sale. I basically told her to "do whatever you think needs done", and she went ABOVE and BEYOND - the house looked amazing and was sold within hours.  I will definitely be using Idahome and RV again.

Had an unfortunate experience in dealing with them. Tried to force me to close on a home prior to conditions outlined in the inspection being completed. Turns out the language on the contract was written by them to warrant closing whether the work was completed or not. Not the kind of representation any buyer deserves. In the end - they have you sign a representation agreement to be locked into using them even if the representation is not satisfactory. Unfortunately, Holding you to a contract is much more important than serving your needs as a client with this group.

Being from the South and spending many years in Louisiana, we are always looking for good Southern and Cajun food.  Unfortunately, this place did not deliver.  In all fairness, this is the only time we have eaten here.  More than us feeling it fell short on authenticity of Cajun food, we were most disappointed by the value.  It was expensive for the portions and quality of food.

WOW!   5 Star service from the start.  We were seated in Taylor's section and she was an amazing waitress/server.  We unfortunately did not take photos of everything, but highly recommend the Bruschetta to start (the best we've ever had), mussels, the caprese salad, beet salad, chicken parmigiana, chicken fettuccine Alfredo, chicken carbonera.   Must try.  We will be back our next visit to town.

Visited on a Saturday afternoon a few weeks ago for a birthday party.  Upon arrival, it was frustrating to deal with a severe shortage in parking.  This place was busy with a combination of birthday parties and individual visitors.   The lobby was packed with people getting registered and signing waivers.  We had a slightly bumpy start finding our party but once we did the hostess (employee who was overseeing the party) was very helpful.

She walked us over to the kiosks and walked us through the waivers.  I am glad she was there because it was slightly confusing linking my kiddo to the party.   This of course determines that your kid belongs to the party group AND that you don't have to pay.  We also brought two siblings and was able to include them on our family waiver but did not link them to the party.  (We didn't want to impose on our hostess to include the sibs).  The kiosk also processes payment and gave us three price points to choose from.  I recall it ranges from $20 to $25 per participant for admission!!!!  This is an all day pass but wowzers, that's pricey!  They give you the special socks with grippy soles which you can keep after using there.

The facility though is impressive if you can see past the crowds.  They have trampolines and much more.  It was geared for the older ages which is great when you don't have toddlers anymore.  My kiddos liked the crazy motorized zip line, ropes course, multi surfaced, tall climbing walls, the big foam pit under an obstacle course, and jumpy basketball courts.  This place is fun for a few hours but I highly suggest finding out about their memberships or other discounts.

Wow... it does seem like the staff at The Joint have all written their own reviews for this place. Several of the 5-star reviews of this (quite terrible) chiropractic office is the 1 & only review from that person... seems kinda fishy to me.

I've been going to chiropractors for over a decade. I know how it works. Or rather - how it SHOULD work. Chiropractors have you stand, bend, sit, flex in ways to see what the problem is at that given time, pushing or pulling or moving joints to assess pain and mobility. I might feel a "problem" in one spot but it's actually due to a problem in another. They know that... they are the experts.  

On one particularly painful Saturday morning, I was frantic to find an open chiro and decided to give this place a shot. On the New Patient paperwork at The Joint, I noted that I have a regular chiro that I see (but my guys isn't open on Saturdays)... so first things first, the chiro at The Joint makes a snarky, rude comment about me "not having any loyalties" to my regular guy. Cool, dude. 

Then The Joint chiro asked me what adjustment I wanted him to do, rather than figuring out and assessing what my problem was for himself. He said he "didn't want to reinvent the wheel." I told him that this pain is unlike what my regular visits fix... but The Joint Dr just didn't want to identify my problem, he just wanted to do the things that would get me out of the door quickest, not more efficiently. It felt very lazy. 

It is not surprising that I left feeling zero percent better than when I came in to The Joint. Super disappointed and frustrated by The Joint and their laziness.

UPDATE 7 Days later....Nov 16, 2021 (Meridian location again)

Created an online order for ASAP pickup...two 12" pies...one all pepperoni, mushroom and black olives. The other...half Canadian bacon and pineapple and the other half sausage and onion. The online ordering system said pickup 6:39 PM which was about an hour away....hmmmm...must be pretty busy for Tuesday night. Now, here's where things go awry. I get home and check the pizzas...where is the pepperoni???? Argggggh! None! Check the pics of pizza and receipt. The Maintenance Shop blew out my sprinklers for the 3 year in a row! They are fast, efficient, professional and extremely trustworthy! 

From my experience with Steve and The Maintenance Shop team they have been very honest, reliable, and seem like really great people, I plan to use them as long as I'm in the Treasure Valley!!! Thank you!!!!
I've now used Vertex for nearly four years.  Their staff is always kind, educational and thoughtful.  I appreciate having the service done well, and also the wonderful staff they've engaged.

This is the worst Chipotle I've ever been to. We ordered online and picked up our order, only to get home and realize that they gave us chicken instead of steak, forgot to put salsa on our burrito bowl, and gave us brown guacamole. We tried calling them numerous times and no one would pick up. I'm never going to this location again. The customer service and quality of food at this location is terrible.
This is a modern dentist with a friendly and experienced staff. I just got a crown, and I must say this is the best crown experience I've had. I'm very happy.

I have been using Steve's Maintenance Shop for a year, for blowing out and turning on sprinklers.  Recently, I had a rotor sprinkler that I needed to stop (cap) immediately. I tried to do it myself, but I couldn't dig deep enough or didn't know what I was doing. I called 4 sprinkler places (including Steve) and they were all booked out for weeks and said they couldn't help me. But Steve actually came THAT VERY DAY. He was booked too, but because he was going to be in my area, he decided to take care of me on the way and cap that rotor!  Thanks to Steve and his crew, our precious water feature is safe from that powerful rotor!
Steve is friendly and personable, and his web-based scheduling is very efficient.

From the start they were pretty shady, their prices are significantly higher than you can find for better quality diamonds elsewhere. I try to support local businesses but refuse to be blatantly ripped off. Never the less I purchased a setting from them in an effort to somewhat support local businesses and I got a higher quality certified diamond elsewhere. I returned to see them about soldering them together (the setting I purchased from them and the band I found at a much better price elsewhere). It's then they will inform you that the will only work on items from their store. Meaning if you decide to buy the same band elsewhere they won't solder it for you. So if you want to pay excessively for buying local and have a company that wants to lock out competitive pricing then Lee Read has your name written all over it.
We were excited to go in today but it seems  they are remodeling or shutdown. Either case I hope they're back open soon! Put some signs up for your plans thank you

Been goin g here for years. Pizza is outstanding and still is;however, customer service has dropped off since the makeover. Called in an order after work, showed up 40min later and watched 8 other customers get their orders before me and no explanation. I just left. No call no questions. My son called another time and asked for a pizza with jalapeño, was told habanero season was over and can order any pizza adding jalapeño. the supervisor in charge named Mike does not even know his own menu. Could have offered the tripe pie and been great. I'd love to have a conversation with the manager Chris about both of these situations. Sad that a place I loved to frequent in the past has become so terrible. Not sure what was wrong with previous management , but I never got treated so poorly?

We had driven by this place several times and never stopped. .. glad we finally did. 

We are a family that loves our pizza and we have tried all sorts of pizza from all sorts of places. We were pleasantly surprised the first time we came here; the pizza is excellent. Super tasty, fresh ingredients, and reasonable price. The pepperoni is nice and crispy, the crust is super soft on the inside with a slight crunch on the outside, and the cheese and bacon breadsticks are so good that it's hard to stop eating them! 

The decor is super cool and the music is always good (a mix of current rock, 90s alternative, and the occasional country).  They have a tv with sports and one with old fashioned cartoons. They have super fun art on the wall. The whole vibe is very 80s and 90s kids themed with a mix of some more recent movies and themes mixed in also.  It's a very chill ambience. 

It's a nice place for just adults or families too. We liked it so much that we came back a week after our first visit and plan to come back again soon. 

Depending on when you come, you could have a little slight wait for your pizza so be prepared... They seem to have a heavy amount of takeout orders that they try to keep up with.
Love this cute cafe & coffee shop in Meridian. Staff is very friendly. Prices are great.
Perfect neighborhood Italian  Great cocktails and service! The mussels are spectacular and the chicken parmigiana is delicious!
Super yummy food! They have large portions so an entree is usually two meals. It's a pretty basic menu but that's fine because what they do have is really good. I've been here quite a few times.

I had a great experience at Mo' Bettahs and it definitely satisfied my craving for Hawaiian bbq. Hawaiian BBQ at Mo' Bettahs is essentially Asian fusion- there's usually elements of several different Asian food groups (Japanese chicken teriyaki or chicken katsu, Korean fried chicken pieces, etc). 

I thought the service and value were excellent in general. You can get a massive plate of food for $10. I had the 3 choice mixed plate for $15 and this is easily 2 meals for most people. My personal favorites were the teriyaki chicken and the chicken katsu. The grilled teriyaki chicken had excellent char and flavor to it. The chicken katsu was crispy and delicious and the katsu sauce was really tasty (almost like an Asian bbq sauce). The Kalua pig was also very good - fairly juicy, tender pork. The mac salad was also tasty but nothing extraordinary compared to others I've had.  

Overall, I would definitely come back to this restaurant. Wouldn't mind seeing some sort of Mochiko chicken offered either, I think that would be a hit.

Amazing teriyaki chicken! Macaroni
 salad was not it.. only dressing used is Mayo. Sauces, rice, - 10/10

I spent many moments talking folks about how great this place is! Great meat!
Then the owner sold out.
And that was the end of that.
Unfriendly up front, and the meat prices have gone up, and the quality has taken a dump.
See ya!!!

OK we are dedicated Chipotle consumers so understanding the drill is in our wheelhouse.  The Meridan/Eagle Chipotle has yet to disappoint us in .. wait for it - being disappointing (without fail).  We just dropped in yesterday ( yeah gluttons for punishment) to pick up a couple bowls.  You would think the servers there are on an austerity program, the less food they put in the bowls the greater their bonuses .  YIKES any less food in the bowl and I could have used my jacket pocket and saved the recycling .  Do yourself a favor and frequent one of the other stores, this one gets the official 2021 lump of coal award, congrats!!

I would give this location 0 stars if possible. 

The meridian location is full of rude disorganized employees. Who seemingly could care less about good service. 

It seems this location randomly chooses to do mobile orders only, turning away walk in customers. They then promise you a pick up time that tends to be way off. We had a pick up order time of 5:20 and didn't have our food until 6:15. 

We attempted to come here again. They were out of steak at the moment. Rather than the employee sharing how long it would take to make more, her response was we won't have it for a while then stared at us. The person making the steak overheard and shared it would be 10 minutes. Within 5 minutes of waiting for steak, they ran out of beans and rice. 

Again, clearly unorganized. Wouldn't recommend coming here unless you want to spend a good portion of your day waiting for them to get their act together.

Update: they also have no chips currently.

Left an updated Review! ---- Service was good! Super busy and small so if you're looking for something quick quick because of not enough seating you might not get that here. Breakfast was amazing. Ordered the country platter and everything came out delicious. Will be going again!

Roy's Appliance responded quickly to a dishwasher problem I was having and showed up on time! Terry was very professional explaining what was wrong with my dishwasher, made the repair(s) needed without scratching my new floor. Also price was very fair. I highly recommend using them.

D. Gardner

one item in our order was missing. a little annoying since we had just driven over from another taco bell that was closed due to staffing issues. seems the taco bell's in the area are having issues. luckily the manager said we can come back and get a refund for what was missed and we appreciate that.

Horrible. We loved our townehome and read reviews about park place and heard terrible things but thought since we loved the place so much we didn't care. Do not use park place. The maintenance is literally a joke. Our dishwasher has been broke for 5 days and has not been fixed yet. It is beyond frustrating and they are zero help. Not to mention when we first moved in there was construction going on as they were building more town homes, which we were made aware, however they were working at obscene hours 5 am and 12:30 am. Such a joke. This is at the Aberdeen apartments complex. Connor is our property manager he is super nice but things still don't get done

These ladies are so great! They have really great prices, and took such great care of my dog (who is scared of everything). They also have self wash stations, with all of the fixings you'll need to scrub your pup!

The ABSOLUTE WORST location ever to exist! Orders are Always late or incorrect. Today staff had the doors l over and were ignoring us standing outside even though the door said you can place orders inside and they open at 10:45. This was 11:20 and they weren't answering the phones either. Not to mention my meat was undercooked. Wish they would open another location closer to my house

Love at first sight does exist! I fell in love with this place as soon as I walked in! It's a laid back setting with a baked goods window, tables, and a bar. Almost everything came with sausage gravy, so of course I had to try it. We ordered the huevos rancheros and gunslinger. The gunslinger comes with sausage gravy to dip your wrap in. It's called a wrap, my fiancé says it's a breakfast burrito. That aside, it comes with sour cream if you prefer that instead. The gravy has oomph to it, it's not bland like you get from most restaurants. The wrap is grilled to perfection. Huevos rancheros was tasty and the potatoes it came with were cooked perfectly! They're crunchy on the outside but soft on the inside. The food was cooked with love! This place is also woman owned, AND they give back to the community. Will be coming back more often now that I know about this gem!

Quaint little place with plenty of seating, nice menu for breakfast &lunch (sorry no picture) they serve lots of different coffee and tea selections, if it wasn't so echoey in there it would be a great little coffee shop to have a meeting. My lunch date and I had a hard time hearing each other because it was pretty loud in there.  She got the soup and salad combo for lunch which seems to be a lunch sized portion with a cup of soup, and I got the very berry chicken salad, which was extremely tasty with candied walnuts and lots of different berries fresh field greens and a berry vinaigrette dressing. The presentation was fantastic for a little coffee shop and I would definitely go back to try some of their other lunch selections, Possibly even breakfast.
My husband bought these flowers for me for Valentine's Day. They are so beautiful, and smell absolutely amazing. Would definitely recommend!!!
One of my favorite guilty pleasures. I don't go often, but when I do- I really enjoy the cinnamon rolls, and the cookie dough. Very delicious- so many different combinations of flavors to choose from

Outstanding, start to finish!  This is the first time I used a rental company for tables to set-up in our community garage sale and all I can say is WOW!  I had exposure to a few different ladies, during the overall process, and everyone was so nice and courteous without exception.  Prices were reasonable and loved the fact they stayed open until 4pm on last day of garage sale so tables could be returned...I will definitely use, and ALWAYS recommend, Event Rent again when the opportunity presents itself...thank you for great customer service Event Rent!
Clean and not to crowded.  Definitely the best laundry mat I've ever been to.   People on site are very helpful if you run into any problems.

Simply one of the best service experiences I have had in a long time!

Nice little breakfast or lunch place across the street from Lowe's on Ustick and Eagle. No wait, seized immediately.  Friendly staff, nice menu. The best urgent care I've ever experienced.  And at my age that is saying a lot!  I hope I never have to go anywhere else!

So good and I Clearly am not the only person who thinks so! Chorizo Omelet is fantastic. It was such a large portion, it turned out to be 3 meals. Was able to call in the order and pick up. Easy leash!

Be aware. This place is probably okay if you don't care about your health.  I've had to visit various businesses throughout Ada County the past few months. I prefer to support local businesses. But at what cost? This business is singular in that ONLY the customers wear masks and attempt to socially distance. Everywhere else I go, there are Covid precautions in place.  Not here, though.   I and other family members were in the lobby on 6 different occasions in November. We wore masks and every customer who walked in wore a mask. Not a single employee working in (or entering the lobby) could be bothered to wear one. The employees don't seem to care at all about the health and well-being of their customers.  There are no dividers at the counters, no employees wear masks, and no attempts are made to socially distance (other than efforts made by customers), and there is no effort at all toward preventing the spread of Covid-19. This in a state where Covid rates and deaths are climbing.  Is it some kind of political statement? I'm guessing yes. I find that annoying given that this virus that is KILLING people doesn't seem to care even a little about politics.  Other than not caring about customer health and safety, the basic service was fine.  I don't plan to give any more of my business to this company given its willful disregard for public safety.  I spent well over a grand there in November, alone, but from here on out, Costco is the better (and safer) bet for me despite not being "local".  I prefer businesses that care about their customers.

I've been here a few times now.  I thought i would give them the benefit of the doubt the first few times.  However,  service is consistently awful.  It's not okay to feel like you are a burden on the wait staff.  The food was sub par. I like pub food,  but not nachos that are skimmed with cheap nacho cheese sauce.  I don't recommend.
Sorry wrong barber!! Did not go here. Can't seem to delete the review

DO NOT get involved with Park Place. I've been renting for the last 15 years and never have I had such a bad experience as with a management company. The price of the apartment seemed fair at first, but over the course of the lease I ended up paying over $1700 in fees, not to mention all the wasted time and headaches of dealing with these people. I hired a professional carpet cleaner to run throughout the unit, they still took that $ out of my deposit, I patched all screw holes and repainted where it was needed, they billed me for that in my deposit as well. They will try to whittle your security deposit down so far that you only recuperate a couple hundred dollars out of the $1000+ you put down. With the size of this company and the abundance of staff and resources they have, it is absolutely ABSURD that they treat their tenants this way. AVOID AT ALL COST.

I have been eating here ever since I was little, and always look forward to go in, or going through the drive-through! Their customer service is always fantastic and up to par, as well as their speed when it comes to filling orders. Their menu has a lot to choose from, leaving the pickiest of eaters able to find some thing to dine on. The flavors of their dishes very, but does leave something to be desired. Overall their food does have good flavor, but is overall bland, and could use some more seasoning. But besides that this restaurant creates a fantastic experience for those dining in, and out.

I was visiting my friend for the weekend, wanted to try out Axiom at The Village. I will not be visiting this location again, instead i will drive out of my way to the Park Center location.

Shoutout to Mack for treating me so special for my Birthday!!! She showed me all the pastry choices describing each one in detail at my request. She took the time to make sure I'd be happy with my choice & her helpful suggestions were spot on! Thanks Mack for great personalized service!

This is my favorite paint n sip. I have painted with Michelle 4 times and every time, I walk away feeling like a real Picasso. She is warm, funny and a wonderful teacher. 

I'm a sucker for a bargain and at only $15 a class (and I can bring my own booze and food!) this paint n sip is a steal! You can go on public paint night or host your own private party. I have hosted 2 parties and it was always a blast. Michelle has a great space now at the renovated church. There is a kitchen so you can heat or cool your vittles. 

Go do something different for your next ladies night or date night. Get a little painty.

I picked up my order on Friday and they told me they were behind, which I understood since it was Friday. I waited for 25 minutes beyond my pick up time. I would have been completely fine with that if the quality of food was on par. When I got my food the portion was tiny. Less than 15 pieces of steak, about a tablespoon of guacamole (that I paid extra for), and a tiny handful of lettuce.  $12 for this?! It's absolutely absurd and I wont be going back.

This is the nicest laundry mat I've ever been to. Clean on the inside. Washers are great and have some over sized ones for big loads or big comforters or other large items. The dryers work super quick. Overall decent price. There is some seating inside but limited and not very comfortable. I just left my stuff and came back. Luckily nothing was take.  Though it would be weird for someone to want to steal my old stuff.
Our first visit to Il Sugo exceeded all expectations! Chef/owner Grant Rosendahl and entire staff was awesome and food was great. We will go again and highly recommend it.

It's been three years that I've had my membership here so I figured an update was needed. The gym still has a very "new" feeling to it. Lots of the equipment is updated and in good service. 

I lowered my rating from a 5-4 mostly due to cleanliness of the facility and the attitudes of the personnel training staff. This Axiom location does suffer from poor locker room cleanliness, but that could be an indication of the life cycle of an active gym. There are a lot of people who go through this location daily so the janitorial staff needs to be on top of things. 

They have recently renovated and expanded the main gym floor. Honestly it feels like an actual cohesive floor plan now. They've doubled the Astro turf and added more equipment all around. I definitely still recommend this gym, but I'd like to see more efforts from management on cleanliness and ensuring that their training staff treats all members equally.
