Healthy Habits has helped me lose 30 pounds! They checked in with me weekly and the staff was wonderful!
If you've never had brunch here - you need to make it happen.  Terrific food and service every time!
I love this local restaurant! They have amazing and friendly service, great food options, they are different and so delicious! 10/10 would recommend!

This year I chose to get something local for the Valentines in my life. I went into this business and blown away with customer service. Then at home my girls went on and I about the "fabulous truffles"! Thank you. Excellent local business.
I would like to add I asked to be contacted by the vet about this matter as I have pills that have no been opened & I am still pissed. 2 days later can not get a response. What a way to do business!

The kids had a ball. It's expensive and not worth it if you don't have a discount of some kind. They're pretty cheesy with their extras. You must use their socks and of course it costs money. The free snack card the kids got was not for any snack on the snack list. Only popcorn. Deceiving. That's the name of the game. Nothing is up front. Plenty of extra charges. Beware!!!

Jeff Stewart did a great job helping us find our new home.  We relocated to Meridian from out of state and found Jeff's profile online.  We were impressed by his experience in the Meridian real estate market.  After sending him a note, Jeff reached out and scheduled a call with us and spent the time to get to know us and in particular what our housing needs were.  

The morning we actually met with Jeff and started looking at homes, it wasn't long before we found our house.  However, we quickly discovered that there was already a full price offer on the home.  Jeff reached out multiple times to the listing agent to discover what we could do to tip the scales in our favor in a competitive bidding situation.  We were very happy later that same day to learn our offer had been accepted.  Jeff continued to work hard all the way through the process.  Like others have mentioned, I felt not only did we find a great house but through the process Jeff became a friend.  I highly recommend Jeff Stewart Realty for any of your real estate needs in the Boise/Meridian area.

This TCBY is the best ever, always so clean and the People are so nice, The owner really cares about his Business and People I hope and Pray they can make it and stay open for drive up during this C-Virus scare.
Hang in there TCBY Fred Meyer.

So we decided on this pizza place because my sister in law said it was good. The reason for the docked star is because how long it took to deliver. An hour and a half at around 5:30 pm for dinner and didn't arrive until close to 7. Very disappointed in that but the pizza was very good! We all ordered our own little 10" pizza and it had that thick crust you usually want. They don't have a ton of options for toppings (basil, roasted garlic etc) as another franchise like say Blaze pizza but all in all it was good. I will say though if you are hangry, go somewhere else or maybe see if you can pickup!

Always so good. The Kahlua pork is a must and the macaroni salad is always the perfect side. Ordered through door dash when it was super snowy and it was still hot even though we live a little ways away.

I posted a very factual account of my experience with Park Place Property Management on Yelp in March 2014.

Karen

Saw a billboard outside for a pineapple Dole whip and immediately had good memories of Disneyland. Walked in and satisfy my craving. Service was very pleasant and efficient. Thanks for reminding me have a good memories at Disneyland!

I'd heard a great deal about Wingers, so when a friend suggested we pick up dinner from there one Friday night I was pretty excited about it.   Even though we'd called in our order, we still had a bit of a wait when we arrived to pick it up.  It was a drag to have to wait in the busy doorway with other people jostling in and out. Will not allow you to order in-person. Why? Employee shrugs his shoulders. Is there a reason this physical location even exists? Guess I'll be dining at a different restaurant today (or driving to the downtown Chipotle). So confused...

STEER VERY FAR AND CLEAR. and if anyone has any questions, I have documentation to substantiate this, I'd be happy to show you. I couldn't upload them.

I was pleased to see this place as a location on door dash, as I have been waiting to try them but am never out un Meridian. 

 I ordered the special today and was pleasantly surprised, as it was just like I remembered traditional Hawaiian. The chicken used is dark meat with a slight glaze and juiciness. The teriyaki sauce is sticky but not too thick. Flavor wise, the spices are subtle.. that's how hawaiian teriyaki is generally supposed to be.  

The rice is sticky and just the right amount. The macaroni was really close but not quite there. It has the mayonnaise feeling without the dryness that I was hoping for but the taste was there. It kind of reminds me of a version that you would buy in a store but with Hawaiian flavor instead of American picnic flavor, if that makes sense? The Hawaiian macaroni flavor is there just not the texture maybe that is a better way to put it?

In any case, it was definitely pretty close and I'm not disappointed. I ended up with leftovers as the portions are sizable. If you're really hungry, you can probably eat it all lol

I look forward to trying the katsu next time period

About three years ago, I went into Lee Read in Meridian to look at their tank.  I own a saltwater aquarium and many of friends in the boise area continued to tell me that I needed to go see their aquarium.  I went there one day at around 2 P.M. and when I walked in I was on the phone with a friend.  I went straight to the tank to look.  After about 5 minutes, the owner of Lee Read came out and introduced himself as the owner and asked me if I was going to buy something.  I said, "perhaps...but I really wanted to see your tank."  He got really upset with me and said, "Well this IS a jewelry store and the tank is here for our CUSTOMERS enjoyment."  He told me that it was extremely rude of me to go into the store and look at the tank and also said that i could not take any pictures of the tank.  He said he thought I was from a tank cleaning company and that i would the pictures to show people that I clean his tank, and he made it very clear that he maintains his own tank.  CONGRATULATIONS!  I decided to leave and he walked me out of his store and I go into my car.  I drove away in my brand new BMW M3 Convertible and looked at his face as I drove by...I could tell he felt bad for being so rude to me.  Every time I have driven past the store I look up at the sign that invite people to go see the aquarium.  But I'm warning you, they don't want ppl to go in without buying something.  So if you want to see the aquarium, make sure you bring your wallet.  The Owner is a Jerk, and I have told this story to countless ppl and will forever do so.

We waited 55 minutes for our pizza. At 45 minutes, I asked someone at the counter how long it would be? We saw dozens of pizzas going out the door, and we were one of only 3 parties eating in. When it arrived, it was cold, not tepid, not warm... cold, like leftovers. Horrible pizza and we will never be back.
Do yourself a fad or and do not shop here unless you want to be asked as you walk out " did you find everything. Ok". Save yourself the time and energy.
Huge, filling pizzas. Great flavors!! It's a new favorite place! Hot in delivery. You won't be disappointed!

A group of us are employed from a clinic across the street we walk over a lot because it's the fastest to get food before we come back to see patients. 
Not only has it happened once twice or three times. It's happened more than that, our orders are always always wrong. We've had to walk back to the restaurant to pick up the food they've forgotten. They over charged a slushy! Worse thing of it all is that we were asked to wear a mask while half of the employees there weren't wearing one ESPECIALLY IN THE KITCHEN. Meanwhile the lady that asked is wasn't even wearing one. They're Loby is open and open to the public, tell me how the heck were suppose to eat with a mask on. This is probably the WORST experience ever.

really fun place but with how busy it is they do not have enough staff. The supervision of the ball pit is two people and they need four or more. The children get hurt in there right and left. The staff are mainly teenagers and don't even step in to help the children. Expensive but worth it if you plan on staying a few hours.

Went here last night for dinner with another couple.  My husband and I  ordered the seafood boil with crab, shrimp and scallops.  We got it spicy which I regret.  I like spicy food but this was a bit much for me.  The service was good and my only critique would be to cook  the shrimp a little less.  Shrimp doesn't take long to cook and it was over cooked.  Other than it being a bit too spicy for me (that's on us) and the shrimp being over cooked, our meal was good--messy, but good.

Brandy did an extraordinary job on my move-out cleaning! Was so blessed to find her. She was professional, caring, thorough and extremely efficient, I was proud to welcome the new owners into their new home! I HIGHLY RECOMMEND Brandy for any of your needs! 
Thank you, thank you, thank you!!!

First time going waited 30 minutes on a Friday to sit not bad was good. Took about 7 minutes for someone to approach us at our table. We go to order and first thing he says is that we are all out of the bison Ribs and it was only 630pm and that they are backed up and it would take an 1.5 to see any type of food. He said 
We will not be returning again. 
Who gives a brand new restaurant 2 chef in vacation at the same time.

You will not leave hungry. What ever size you are thinking about ordering... probably best to order the next size down. These portions are huge. I thought they had mistakenly given me the wrong size. I had the teriyaki chicken with usual sides. Chicken was perfectly grilled with som char. Rice was nice and moist. Macaroni salad (which I'm usually not a fan of) was very good as well. Cabbage was a little bland, but it was good having one vegetable to counter all that meat and carbs.  This place surprised me, a rarity in Treasure Valley  restaurants. This place would be a solid 4 stars in a larger city, but in Idaho... 5 Stars!

Placed a door dash order with them on a Sunday, ordered a 12  in turkey, 12 inch reuben, & 12 inch chicken bomb with 1 side of fries. When the delivery was dropped off, we were shorted half a sandwich, and the whole Reuben. My husband called to let them know, they offered a gift card or for us to come get it (defeats the purpose of doordash). When my husband got there, he asked if the meal was correct this time with the 12 in Reuben and 12 in chicken bomb, they said yes, so he left. Welp, got home and only have 2 6in subs instead of the 2 12 in he paid for. 1 screw up can be forgiven, but a second screwup in the replacement order, seriously? 
My 12 in turkey was good, but who wants surprises when it comes to delivery food. Mark this one off the list for reorders.

A really cozy space with cozy food & drinks!! It feels a little bit like a cabin inside. There was even a moose on my mug of matcha, and I enjoyed breakfast there. My server's name was Lorena and she was super kind. A weird part of the experience, however, was the manager/owner randomly coming over to say, "DO YOU NEED SOMETHING?? BECAUSE YOU KEEP GIVING A LOOK LIKE YOU NEED SOMETHING" and seeming angry when I was sitting there on my laptop enjoying the space and gave no such looks to anyone?? This was offputting, so I probably won't go back, but it was otherwise a positive experience.

I guess now that they don't allow you to order inside, they can use it as an excuse to skimp you big time on your order. I paid $11 for hard shell tacos and got soft, instead of hard shell, the amount of chicken is laughable- maybe like 4 small pieces. A few strips of lettuce. I paid extra for guacamole and got maybe a teaspoons worth. These are the most poorly made tacos I've ever gotten. I won't be ordering from chipotle again unless we can actually WATCH them prepare our order. This deserves a refund it's so bad.

Came home excited to eat my Mo' bettas until I opened the box. The chicken was so charred through and dry and the steak was also very dry :( not to mention they got rid of the Mini Ekolu plate. I'm really sad because I loved Mo bettas so much!  

Please do Better guys and bring back the Mini ekolu plate!

I usually never leave a one star review, but that is the only thing that can represent my recent experience with them.  I recently purchased a ring for my now Fiance' from a nice lady on Craigslist.  She had originally purchased this ring at Lee Reads and had an appraisal done for the ring there.  When we all showed up at Lee Reads to merely get the appraisal verified, the owner was extremely unhappy and uncooperative.  They were frustrated that we were performing a 3rd party sale, and would not simply verify that they had performed the appraisal.  Furthermore, the owner totally lied to us that the setting on the ring needed to be redone as she explained it was worn down.  We then took it to 2 different jewelers who confirmed that the owner lied and were just angry about our sale and wanting to pull in some money for themselves.

1 star reviews are for cheats and liars.  Thank you Yelp for enabling people like me to warn others from shady practices like these.

DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY! Don't fool yourself, they are not "dog friendly" They are dishonest and take every opportunity to scam you out of money. Their dog restriction list is outdated and lacks any real facts behind why most dogs are restricted. They are unprofessional and rude. Run far away from this awful company.

Wow! My son keeps talking about how tasty the frozen vanilla yogurt is at this TCBY location. He loves his sundae with just mini M&M's and sprinkles. Thank you for the awesome service! BTW the dining tables are all decorated with homemade gingerbread houses, which my sons loved as well. Thanks again 4 a great experience!

I went to Rogers because I've had great luck with Tire Pros where I lived before. I needed an alignment on my car and tires/alignment on my truck. 
I went in and they quickly and easily scheduled me for the next working day. Everything was great. They explained everything to me and even told me I didn't need certain things. Great service. 
I'd come back in a hot second.

I'm going to give flying pie a five star, it's hard to find pizza better than here.  Hard to believe this is only our third time here and I have not posted a review yet. Pictured is the combination pizza which I believe is number one on regular crust, it is phenomenal. When you dine in they give you free cheese bread. This is the second time we eat our large combo in the restaurant and only had one piece each, taking the rest home!   They also have a large salad bar but we would be 4 too full two about about ha ha. There are so many different combinations of pizzas, toppings, and crust. Three times here three times perfect, really no reason to go anywhere else.   

------------------------
1-31-20

Again with the consistently amazing pizza, this is the combination along with the free cheese bread, you're lucky if you can eat two pieces each, dined in and paid the half price for the additional pizza to take home for the kids. Love this place!

My family was in the drive thru and we simply order 4 $6  box meals. When they told us our total we thought it was too high. When we got to the window and asks the young lady why was the price high. She got upset rolled her eyes and shut the door. Then this older short lady asked us what was the matter we asked why was the was high. My husband asked for her to re tell us our order. It was wrong, so I told her what we wanted again. This time the price was over $40 for 4 $6 boxes. So I again explain what we wanted. We also told her to make sure.we don't have no lettuce on the tacos. She got mad shut the door started screaming saying we don't want lettuce and we are yelling at her. How hard is it to take a simple order make the food right and move.on. Then she came back and said we are yelling at her and we made them make all that food, even though it wasn't what we ordered. Screamed at us and told us to leave. The most rudest person and fast food experience I have ever witness. I will never go back again.

I've been to Hawktech twice, both times with my wife. The first visit was going to be our last and I would have rated the store a one star because of the attitude and service we got from the one person working the store at that time. There was a customer in the store who was much more friendly and helpful than the man on staff. However, just within the past week we were referred to Hawktech to see their line of Ruger custom products by the manufacturer of the custom Ruger guns and accessories. This visit, our reception was first class the minute we showed an interest in the Rugers. The man who so favorably impressed us is Dave Freshwater. Hope the first guy moved on.

I had a wonderful experience here with Vanessa. She was professional, personable and did beautiful things to my hair. I'm Covid vaccinated, so I opted not to wear my mask, but she immediately offered to put one on to do my hair which I thought was a very thoughtful gesture. From the minute she started working with my hair I could tell she was an expert and I will be making all my future appointments with her from now on. The salon itself was clean, inviting and spacious. I liked the group atmosphere they have crafted there. 10/10 recommend!
Always super clean. This has been my favorite place to do laundry while waiting to buy a washer and dryer.

Wife went to Panera on Eagle and was happy to report it was packed, and as good as she remembered from Caifornia and Virginia.  She had the Fuji Apple Salad and one of her friends had a soup sandwich combo that she liked a lot.

Steve just blew out my sprinklers. Two other vendors failed in the 24 hours prior to this. Steve is smart, has years of experience and most importantly, patience to figure out a less than straightforward issue. And he was no more expensive than anyone else. AND I paid someone who showed up and failed just an hour prior who told me it wasn't doable and that I had wasted his time. I adore Steve. I will be calling him again. Here's his website; http://treasurevalleyrepairs.com/

His website is set up so that he can be in touch very quickly. Modern automation, how refreshing.

I highly recommend this vendor.

We bought a home with an existing spa and had no clue how to maintain it.  Mike came out, 
looked at it and gave us some basic info on what we needed to do.  John at the store lent us free of charge an amazing submersible pump to drain the spa and explained our options, i.e. enzymes vs. chlorine, for keeping the water clean.  We're very happy with their service and looking forward to enjoyjng the spa.

Great store with impressive inventory/selection.  My boys and I spent two hours in this store and received excellent and impressive attention.  
Chris is great!  Really knowledgeable and interested.  Best thing?  If he didn't have an answer to one of our myriad questions, he admitted it!

So nice to be able to find a store like this.  We will definitely be back to spend more time and money here. 

P.S. - picked up a nice little Spyderco yesterday.  Great knife!

Pizza is great!  Service? Not so much. Called in an order of one 12" pizza and was told I could pick it up in about 45 min.  I show up and am then told it will be another 35 minutes.  I then had to demand my money back as this is the 2nd time this has happened.  I'm crossing them off my list. Management clearly has no idea what they are doing.

Alex was very helpful & knowledgeable. He has helped us twice at Lee Read Jewelers. We will definitely go back to purchase our jewelry there. 
The staff was honest & friendly.
I said don't call me after they showed up to give me estimate on hvac  system. Over priced. They call me daily. Over bearing sales tactics. Leave me alone.

Had the most disturbing thing happen when I took my dog in for a check up today. She's been recovering from a UTI the past week, so naturally the vet wanted to do a follow up to see how things were progressing. They took her back without me, and when they couldn't get her to produce a urine sample, they extracted it from her bladder with a needle!!! Without asking me!!!! I could hear her crying from the waiting room!!! She hasn't been ok, panting excessively and urinating frequently since and I'm furious! First, who even thinks it's ok to practice this barbaric method and second, WITHOUT CONSENT?!!! Warning to everyone who takes their pets here. This is not the first time I've been overly frustrated and did not agree with their practices. Had them recommend a VERY expensive, invasive procedure for another one of my dogs who's currently on hospice. Wanted to do a CAT scan to help decide exactly what was wrong (another vet used a stethoscope), and wanted to put him on all kinds of meds, still giving him less than a year to live even with the $600 in 'treatment'. They will tug on your heart strings, and make you question your loyalty to your pet in tough times. Stick to your guns and always get a second opinion if you do go to them. Several other vets disagree with the practices I've relayed. Save your money and get better service elsewhere. For the love and sakof our pets, we will NEVER be back.

*To the vet who responded: we have no cats. You are referring to the wrong records.*

Twice we have ordered online from this location, paid for the order. Went to pick up the order only to find the store locked with a sign that they aren't opening today. Why accept online orders if they are closed? It's a hassle to get a refund for the order I paid for and wasn't delivered.

Nice waitstaff although they seemed stressed. 
And it wasn't that busy. 
Service was a bit slow but fine for girls chatting it up. 

Great mimosas- good OJ vs champagne ratio. Little spendy for what you get but hey Sunday brunch! . 

Not enough choices for me on the sweet side- French toast /  waffle/ pancake etc but I got the traditional eggs Benedict bc that's what I do - i loves the thick slice of ham, eggs cooked perfectly as I asked.  Hollandaise was okay - maybe a 7 on a. 1-10 scale.  My only complaint is that the English muffin was... Literally nothing done to it, not toasted, not grilled, not buttered, not even heated.   that's a mistake IMHO but I'd order again, just being more specific about how I want my bread toasted

Friends got French toast and like it, their eggs also cooked to order - side of bacon cooked well and yummy 

Nice diner feel, wouldn't want to get seated in the back by the bathroom Hall - but I wasn't so 
I'll be back

We took my daughters phone in to have the broken screen fixed. Prior to bringing in the phone my wife called and asked them out the phone repair. They said they could do the repair but they don't have the parts and would have to order them. I took the phone in today to start the process of the phone repair to find out they did have the parts but it would take 24 hours to do the repair. We told the guy that the phone was drug thru the water in the ocean and how the screen got broken. Never did the employee tell us that they can't fix phones that have been wet and they never told us that Samsung won't allow them to repair phones that have been wet. The phone worked fine outside of the giant cracks on the screen, the reason we asked them to repair the phone. Three hours later the store calls me to say that there is water damage corrosion on the charging terminal and they refuse to fix the screen!!!!!

The phone worked fine even the screen. I asked them to replace the screen. THEY REFUSED TO FIX THE SCREEN. I told them that this review was coming and they still refused to fix the screen. I'm not sure what scam these guys are trying to run here but I advise avoiding them.

To add insult to injury when I called Samsung they told me that this store is the one that they want me to go to. The store lied and gave me nobody to contact avoid these lazy scam artists!

I called to place a order , as we've done before . The guy that took my order didn't have patience. I gave him my number he said he couldn't find it , looked under the name couldn't find it . Took several times giving my number . He was like no nope no one ordered here with that number . Then he found it . I told him I wanted to order the same as last time , the lady that usually takes the order finds it by my number . He seemed annoyed , he took my order told me 10 minutes it would be ready. 
It says they close at 10 I got their 5 min before then they were not open called several times nothing . The lady that usually takes my order calls me when the food is ready to get and tells me . Nobody said they close early as the order was near closing . Smh so I came in the next day ordered 5 ponds of snow crab with sausage and corn and shrimp two different ordered . The food is always great , and fresh . The service, the need to be more efficient with letting people know their hours . The food is always outstanding.

Food was great! The woman's restroom was disgusting. Not sure we'll go back 
This was our second visit, the 1st time was great back in 2019.

I was really excited to try this place when I was visiting my elderly parents that had raved about it. We placed an order online for curbside pickup. When we arrived, we called and they said they were about to start on it. No problem, we waited about 10-15 mins and observed several customers enter without masks. Then my dad noticed most of the workers weren't even wearing masks, either! 

I was horrified and disgusted, but we had already paid and everyone was hungry and it was too late now. When the girl brought our order out to the car, you guessed it, she was not wearing a mask either!! But luckily we were although I took little comfort in that fact. Once we got home, I made sure to microwave all the food before we ate (just in case since Covid is AIRBORNE and helloooo we're very much still in a pandemic) in attempts to make it a little more appetizing after we all saw their failure at health and safety protocols firsthand. 

The food was alright, otherwise I'd just give one star. The katsu sauce tasted overly sweet but the kalua pork and Mac salad was tasty. It's a real shame, I'd like to give 3 stars if it weren't for the terrible service and brazen disregard for customer's health and safety with their bare faced staff getting their aerosols in all the food. It makes you wonder how seriously they adhere to other food safety handling procedures, or if those are optional, too.  

Sorry to say, we will not be returning and I do not recommend going here unless you are ok with your food safety being politicized/sketchy, don't believe in science, or are ok with microwaving your takeout before you even get to eat it. 

Disappointed. It'd be "Mo Bettah" if they had their masks and maybe some gloves on and cared about their customers.

Well, my wife and I decided to try Chipotle here in Meridian, Idaho. I got a shredded beef burrito and my wife two shredded beef tacos, two chips and a queso and two drinks. $28.00! Food was bland, food was cold, food was greasy, food was VERY expensive. Chips were stale. I don't know how long the chips had been sitting in the paper bags sitting on the shelf but were chewy and stale. I returned both in one bag and the girl requested to see the empty bag to exchange them!! 
I turned around and handed it to her from our table. The new chips weren't much better. It's ridiculous to pay the price they charge for garbage food. We will never return there again. I do not see the hoopla over this place. Good bye Chipotle.

I got sucked in to the whole thing they offer. I ended up seeing 3 different chiropractors and found that I really liked one of them but due to my crazy schedule, I ended up w my least favorite.  I would leave w headaches that lasted for days on end. I asked if they were going to take x rays at the end of our treatment plan and they said no.. I'm sure its because nothing changes and they know it. I skipped an appointment and they never called... I never went back. The lack of personal care did not impress me, besides getting cracked like crab legs...
Yummy food and friendliest staff! They were welcoming and the waitress was so kind   We will keep going back!
Awesome service.   Was as easy as excepted.   Tables were in good shape, linens were clean, service was on time and friendly. Executed my needs flawlessly.

I never thought I'd write a Yelp review for an emission testing place, but this guy was so courteous, thorough and efficient that he actually made me feel good about doing something mandated by the state.  I'm betting he'll make you feel the same way.
We have went to Toby two times now  amazing person Great Office ,  able to help up both time I recommend her and her office to amyone

We came in as a group, and the kitchen staff was horrible, it took over and hour and a half for us to get and order of wings, Blt and a burger. They had only two waitresses working and the dude behind the bar didn't do jack to help them out. I will say the girls working did the best job they could. Kitchen staff need to go and the lazy bar tender.

Well the description didn't match the apartment I ended up living in. I was looking for 2 full baths but that wasn't such a big deal. The carpet was disgusting, I mean disgusting and really needed to be replaced instead of cleaned. My fireplace never worked and there wasn't anything they could do about it. My oven-that I had a serious problem with. It wouldn't reach temperature and took forever to fix. Overall it was ok. Walls were thin. If I needed something they sorta got back within a reasonable time. When you talk to them you never seem to talk to the same person, it's always someone different.

I use the assistance of an outside rental company on a very regular basis. Event Rent is my go-to choice, when the need arises. I have rented everything from a few linens, to hundreds of pieces of dinnerware, to large scale tents and dance floors. Whatever you need, they have it! If they don't, they will do their best to find it for you.  

The staff is always helpful, friendly and accommodating. The business is locally owned and operated, which always adds that little extra sense of attention to service.  The delivery crew is always on time and willing to go the extra mile without complaint.

They offer delivery or in store pick up, if you prefer. Unless you just need a few linens, I recommend the delivery it is so worth it!
The manager and staff bent over backwards to accommodate my needs for my wife's birthday and they did a great job.  Our whole party loved the food and the service was great as usual.  Thanks much!

This review is not for the pizza but for the location. When I went tonight to pick up an order, no one was at the front because they were so busy, which is normal. As soon I saw someone come over, I went to line up. Because I did not initially see a second employee go to the other register, he stared at me and seemed offended that I did not come to his register because ~10 min later, he came out to say, "Ma'am, have you been helped already? Because I just wanted to make sure that EVERYONE HAS BEEN HELPED." This was while I was sitting on a bench waiting for my order. Later I heard my name shouted loudly from the food prep area, which I thought was weird since no other customer had had their name shouted, and no one had come out to meet me at the time. Hence, it did not occur to me that someone was asking me to come claim my order. I just assumed someone in the kitchen shared my name. After a while, though, I realized that was in fact my order. So I went to ask about it and received it. This contrasted with how other customers were treated while waiting for their orders: they were remembered, and someone came out to speak to them directly to verify their orders. Additionally, no employees wore masks, which is fine for them, but they did not have to treat me differently for wearing one, if that was at all a factor in this strange experience. Given this experience, I would not return to this location of Flying Pie.
Good yogurt, lots of toppings to chose from, no "high fructose sugar", and very friendly and helpful staff. Will definitely be back!

Yogurt was good but the girl at the cash register seemed to be more into her 5 friends that had come to visit her during her shift. We had to maneuver through them crowding around the check out counter while they just stood there talking. Then when it was time to ring it all up they once again didn't budge. We had to step around the side to pay. Seriously? Move out of the way for customers. The employee at the counter and her friends continued to gossip the whole time we were sitting eating our yogurt as well, as probably 10 more customers came in during this time and got to experience the same customer service and high school whispering and profanity. Fun times with my little one!

Kali is incredible. She is a great stylist with a strong talent for hair coloring. Whenever o get my hair done, I get tons of compliments. My husband also goes to Kali... as she is consistently good. She is also kind and easy to talk to. Although they're a busy salon (which is good), she always finds time to fit us in her schedule. We love it!!
GREAT pizza! They had ciders on tap, and the service was friendly, I'm not a pizza person but will definitely go back here!!

Not bad, we had sausage and black olive.  I would recommend to add some basil or garlic to the dough, it was a little bland, or at least give that as an option when you order. The crust was slightly doughy but the next day we put it in the oven and then it tasted a little better.  I'd try it again but I think next time I'd order something with peppers on it. The cashier was such a nice young man, I had to tip, so friendly, that's why they get the 4 stars.

We had a company lunch meeting with six people and it worked out great. We loved the menu (all day breakfast rocks) and the food didn't disappoint.

A welcome positive addition to Meridian lunch options.

We came for a quick lunch today with my Cajun hubby and son.  We ordered clam chowder and coconut shrimp.  Our son had a shrimp Po Boy.  He reports the fries are really good here, and I consider him a fry expert! 
As we waited for our food, I seriously felt some jealousy as I watched giant steaming bags of seafood deliciousness being carefully tended to, tableside, by the servers.  
We are definitely going to have to come back and try some other menu items! 
The place is really cute inside.  I immediately loved it when I walked in.  It smelled good and the decor was fishing nets adorned with flashing Christmas lights and plastic fish hanging on chains. 
The service was fast and the food was great!  Give it a try!!
The food and service were both amazing. We had Caesar salad, filet Mignon pasta, and the il Sugo pasta. We loved everything. I would highly recommend the Filet Mignon pasta!!
Great service as always.  They always are willing to do extra at any time and always with a smile.   Always professional and on time as well.

The atmosphere was spectacular! It was someone's birthday, and this place made it special! It's always nice to make someone's birthday special. 

The prices weren't too horrible!

Deep dish was the way to go. I love me some deep dish pizza. The ingredients were fresh. The waitstaff was nice. 

Will we go back? YEP! Can't wait to try the buffet bar.

If you want a big, satisfying meal at a low price, Chipotle is your go-to spot.

Food: Chipotle serves huge portions and typically doesn't hold back on the toppings. Treat them nicely and they'll definitely make you a worthy meal. I usually prefer the chicken or sofritas salads as healthier options (and skip the cheese, sour cream and guacamole--using salsa as my dressing), while my husband usually goes big with a giant steak/chicken combo burrito. 

Drinks: Self-serve soda and refrigerated case of other beverages.

Atmosphere: The Eagle location is the lightest and brightest, with a separate room that tends to be a bit quieter during the busy times. Great and quiet outdoor seating as well. 

Service: The staff is generally nice. 

Healthy Hack: Go basic with a sofritas or chicken salad with black beans, fajita veggies and salsa. Plenty of flavor, low on cals.

Tips: Ask for sour cream and salsa on the side if you don't want a drenched burrito. Try salsa for salad dressing instead of the vinaigrette.

Way overpriced for what they have, they advertise "real" "non franchise " pizza but it's just the opposite to me!! There are much better pizza places around here with much cheaper prices for a much bigger and better tasting pie!

We use Event Rent every year for our school auction and this year was no different. Rebecca was my new BFF by the end of the event. iI think I called everyday with changes and what not and she didn't even hesitate to help and reassure me that it was no big deal. Thank you for the awesome customer service...dropping off items, setting up, and picking up. All of it is top notch!! Thank you!
McKayla is the best server EVER! Food is amazing. Highly recommend country Benedict and Bloody Mary! Won't go wrong dining here!

My husband and I are in LOVE with Cinnaholic. We constantly come here for - treat on date night after eating street tacos next door at Calle Street Tacos. Cinnaholic has such a MASSIVE variety of options on the menu, as well as so many options to create your own dessert. There have been times when we've gone in for a cinnamon roll to split and then a few minutes later we have to turn around and go back in for a SECOND roll, because they are that good. These are such a treat and would make a great little pick me up for a friend or a great snack to bring home for a babysitter to say thank you. I'm blown away that the cinnamon rolls are vegan and that has been a huge plus as I've been off of dairy while nursing my new baby. This a business that will continue to thrive and be successful because they are making such a yummy and high quality product!

Very overpriced!! A "double rum and coke" was 12.50 and was a tiny glass  not even a tall! 
I ordered pasta 55 it came without bacon or steak .. hmmm how did they miss that?  Once it came it was good but not worth 18$ ( it came with no sides) 
Atmosphere was good and waitress and hostess were both  nice but will not be back  !
Favorite place in town. Great cinnamon rolls with a ton of options. Everyone needs to go here!!!

Husband and I decided to try something new so we tried Le Peep. The service was friendly and I liked that they gave lemon water in a cute pitcher (my husband goes through drinks ridiculously fast so this very helpful) my husband ordered the pancake of the month which was a blueberry lemon ricotta and they were huge! I trying to eat healthy ordered the White Lightening omelet and was pleased to find it was full of flavor with egg whites, chicken bell pepper, onions and avocado! The food was big portions and the service was great! We'll be back!

I really wish  I could  post videos of my puppy before and after training here in yelp. That should pretty much sum it up all.

I have this toy poodle puppy who thinks that she is a hot star since she is tiny and everybody who sees her, especially the kids wants to pet or play with her. So my hot star puppy can't even go for a walk without making the strangers notice and greet her. You know that attention seeking puppies? Yup, That's her. Fast forwarding to almost 5 months after her training now, I am the proud owner of a dog (more like a kitten  if you see her) who goes off leash with me everywhere. Now, I feel like a star when I take my puppy out on off leash and when people look around at me.

My big time whiner (what barking?) behaves so decent now  and constantly looks at me for my approval. She is doing her advanced group training now and she is yet to do  her speciality training. Terrific program, worth the time and money. Love all the trainers here. 


P.S: of course you need to work with your dog every day consistently, put in lot of hard work. I remember the days I used to say to myself that she is gonna be a great dog one day soon. Why you ask? What can this tiny monster possibly do? Oh nothing much - just pull out every fiber from the carpet. Who needs to chew on those smelly shoes anyway. But if you are ready to put in some effort to work with your dog, these guys have a terrific programs to help you to get in there.

They make sure and collect their commission every month but when it's time to do any work, you are doing it yourself. Each time a lease was up for renewal, I had to research the rental market myself and tell them what was going on up in Boise despite that I am in California. You would think that was part of their job?!! Afterall, they take 8% of the rents each month. They charge you a huge fee for advertising a vacany and here it is the middle of the month, with the tenant set to vacate on the 31st and there's no posting on the web. I had to put them out there myself. Let me also caution a prospective client- they offer in-house maintenance which sounded good at first blush until you get a huge bill over $200 to replace out a light ballast.
My recommendation_Stay away from them. If at all possible manage the property yourself. I hear none of the property management companies are looking out for your investment.
Excellent! I love to support this nice, local chain. They give great service and an awesome frap. Eat your heart out, Starbucks.

My husband dropped his Samsung phone face down on the pavement and his screen shattered. On advice from my wireless insurance I went here for repairs. They did a perfect job and you can't even tell it was ever broken! Completed the repairs in under 90 minutes and the staff was great!

We would like to commend Cole, Matt and Mike at Quick Computer Services for fulfilling our requirements for a custom built computer.  We provided them with a build spec and they responded with a fair estimate the same day.  Following our approval they produced  the computer in 5 days  that completely met our expectations.  We loaded the computer with two large programs without difficulty and they have produced the desired result.  We enjoyed working with Cole, Matt and Mike during the process and highly recommend their services for your computer needs.  We will definitely return to them for any future computer needs.
Very friendly and professional. Fixed my ailing laptop on time as promised. Works great now. Very satisfied. I would highly recommend.
Used to be a 5. While the stock price is going up, the food quality is going down. Is this even steak, or just griddle and tendons in disguise? Ugh

I wish I could give him six stars.  After my Samsung started turning off on its own, he drove 60 miles house the next morning (a Saturday), for an incredibly modest charge.  He diagnosed the likely cause, and gave me helpful advice on whether it would even be worth repairing if the problem recurred, as well as advice on brands and models if I need to replace it.  Unbelievably good experience.

The front disk staff is as useless as a degree in peeling oranges. When a patient tell you specifically that they are here to check on their baby after they got into a car accident. You don't just walk in the pregnant patient, just so your nurse can tell them that you don't have the equipment to check on her! And if you got the nerve to bill the patient you are a garbage organization. 
It just happened half hour ago. Thanks for wasting the pregnant lady time.

The staff that works at this location is SO much fun,  they always make the experience a treat. The pizza is always delicious and my family loves coming here. There's some video games and lots of space here, so bringing the family is never an issue for us.

Tried Deja Brew our for dinner.  Finger steaks were really good.  I've never had finger steaks cooked that well.  The breading wasn't anything fancy, but it wasn't greasy, and was just the right amount of breading to meat.  

Live music was fine, usually not a fan of a live band but wasn't insanely loud like most are.  Great beer and wine selection.  Service was great.  Not what I expected from a "coffee shop."
Great availability, service and time management! I called last minute and now know why it is called Minutemen LOL Shout out to Josh! Thank you.

I can't say enough about the excellent customer service here. It was a long day and I put in an order for pizza tonight for pick up on my way home. Well.. I got to the Meridian location and they didn't have my order. No fault of theirs. Apparently when I was ordering tonight I somehow clicked Middleton. The gentleman came out to my car , and said no problem. We will make you a fresh pizza and work it out with our Middleton store. I was on the verge of tears for MY mistake, and he came up with a gracious plan to make me a pizza here. Thank you for being so wonderful! The pizza here is delicious as well, and this act of kindness in addition to the quality of food is beyond words!

Portions are small for the prices. Food is just okay. Ordered hash brown and instead received their potatoes. Instead of taking my whole plate back our server brought out hash browns when we were finished.

I love this Veterinarian clinic! The staff is friendly and professional, the clinic clean and up to date on the latest technology and most importantly they respect dog and owner alike. The prices are reasonable and they do not oversell, they outline the dangers and leave the optional treatments up to the owner's discretion and don't make you feel judged. Lily (my chihuahua) has been going there almost 2 years and I have never had in issue. In fact, we recently added a new furry daughter to our family, Scarlett and I can't wait to bring her in. Thank you to the complete staff at the Pet Care Clinic for all the care and attention you give.
Very pleasant and knowledgeable staff. Quick service (overnight!) coupled with fair prices!  Will certainly use again!

Excellent breakfast :) The wait was a bit but they use a texting system for when your table is ready and the hostess was very sweet.

Our server took quite awhile to greet us or get waters (hard when you have kiddos with you) but he was very nice and helpful. 

We ordered different potatoes so we could share and try them but they brought out all the same. I brought it to his attention when I finally got hold of him after the food was brought and he apologized and said he was sorry he and the expo missed it, and he brought out the correct order right away. Nicely handled. 

The omelet I got was a make your own, and it was very good. The broccoli and cheese was all kind of gooped up on one side and the broccoli was very minimal, but the tomatoes and turkey sausage in it were great and overall it was huge and delicious! The oatmeal for the littlest was tasty and cooked well and a decent portion, and our older got a kids meal of eggs and bacon and it was a good size, PLUS all options came with fruit automatically! LOVE that and saw it was the same for their lunch options. 

My girlfriend got french toast and eggs and enjoyed it. We also got a cinnamon roll to take home and it is MASSIVE. It took three days to eat it lol ;)

The environment is family friendly without being a kid's place and the kid's menu doesn't speaking down to the kids who enjoy real food and healthy options. There was plenty of variety (took awhile to choose!) and something for everyone for sure. It's average pricing for a brunch spot in this area (think The Griddle or similar) but much better portion sizes and a solid service team. We enjoyed our brunch and will be abck!
Best place ever! Girl serving me was so nice. And was so generous with the scoops. Overall great taste and place to go if you love a little creamy goodness.
My initial experience was not good but after speaking with the staff at Access Heating & Air we were able to come to a resolution and currently trying to rebuild trust.

New fan!!! I wish Meridian had more appetizers that are offered by other locations tho & open up your driver's radius another mile, so we could get delivery. We picked up our $75 order, and we would order more often, if you had more delivery options. We ordered a few specialty pizzas, along with some cheese bread with marinara, and it was all gone by the end of the night. Thank you 4 tasty pizza!!!

Great cinnamon roll with a MAJOR exception - NO RAISINS!!!  Not a raisin in the whole place!  Of all the bizarre toppings and frostings available, not a single raisin to even add as a topping let alone being inside the roll.  A cinnamon roll isn't a cinnamon roll without raisins.

As a seafood lover, we were so excited when we found out about their soft opening so we immediately came. The food was fantastic and everyone was nice except for that one guy who's talking to customers table per table and had some conversations with them, but when it is his turn to spoke to us, he asked how the food was, and we replied that it was good and we got an awkward reply from him which was just "Ehe" and just left. We would understood if he didn't like to talk to us instead of letting us feel that we are not welcome. I should have rated this 5 star if not for that guy.

I really really liked the shrimp po' boy and would definitely recommend adding some squeezed lemon in top and a coors light . Crazy good ! Our waitress was really nice and the place appears to be pretty clean . I can't wait to come back and try the crab , sausage , potato, and corn broil where it's all dumped out on the table . I only wish they had more vegetables on the menu . Because of that I would rate this place an A-
Food was decent. Friendly staff. Was served after two people came in after me though.
The best gun shop in Idaho for competition shooters or scary black rifles. Good selection of parts and accessories. Very knowledgeable staff.

Went in a few days ago, my server Daliah was great. She was in a great mood, very friendly and made sure to explain the menu and make recommendations. All the servers seemed very happy to work there. We Ordered the Reel's Catch as recommended by our server, the crab was amazing as well as the shrimp and crawfish. We got the mix with all the sauces and the flavor was spot on. Her manager delivered the food with her and he made sure everything was as we ordered/wanted it before leaving the table side. We will be here in the Future and recommend you to everyone we know.

ABSOLUTELY RECOMMEND, don't even waste your time with anyone else.  We inherited major oven issues missed by the inspector in our new home and it wouldn't heat up.  Our appliances are all Fisher & Paykel, so we worried about finding someone who was certified to work on them.  We were so overwhelmed with issues during that first month and I was so frazzled Terry was such a blessing, his calm demeanor and the way he explained everything made it all seem tolerable.  
He spent over an hour and totally took our range apart to try to find the issue and discovered the faulty thermostat.  Our drawer dishwasher was not working either, and he helped us to realize that it was just so filthy from the previous owners and just cleaning under the bottom plate would most likely take care of it (and this was the case) 
The thermostat came in promptly and he was able to repair our range so we could use it,we were so grateful.  Now, here's what drives it home.  We were having issues with getting reimbursement from our Home Warranty company (I know BIG SURPRISE) I had just given up.  Terry's wife Jackie who had already been so very helpful, took it upon herself to speak to Fidelity and clear the whole thing up and I am now getting a full reimbursement beyond the measly $300 promised by the warranty!!!!  I not only recommend this company, I say your daft if you go anywhere else!!!!  Thank you Terry and Jackie, your a Godsend and we LOVE using our NEW OVEN!!!!  xo

I bought a brownie and it was the worst brownie ever, hands down. It was dry and crumbly and resembled a muffin that brownie. Super over priced. Their cream cheese frosting is pretty disgusting as well.
Really enjoyed our first time. Reminded me of good old Louisana seafood, fresh and served piping hot in a steaming bag. Will return again soon

I was done with my mop of hair (reached my bra line) and decided it was time get the big chop (short pixie)  so I made a last minute appointment with Megan here at Casa Bella. Megan is just awesome,  welcoming,  friendly, reassuring, and fearless! When I told her I wanted to chop all of my hair off, she was all for it,  no hesitation,  no trying too talk me out of it. I showed her a picture of what I had in mind, we talked a bit about my concerns,  and she went to work.  Gave me a razor cut, with tons of texture that works for my hair type.  She showed me how to style it and have me advice on how to get the looks I want. Y'all,  I love my hair. I've taken a million pictures in my car as I run errands,  just mugging it up.  It frames my face perfectly. I could not be happier. I can't wait to show it off at work tomorrow.  Thank you muchly, Megan!  You are a wizard!
This is a place to get a tasty sandwich for lunch. They have quality ingredients which make it well worth my dollar.

Service was decent, food was terrible though. My friend got scrambled eggs with avocado, I got 'huevos rancheros'. We eat out a lot, several times a week. This is the worst restaurant food (quality taste and presentation all terrible) I have ever had. The eggs are unrecognizable (like the texture of finely ground meat is the closest I can describe, almost a sandy texture, no moisture. Not sure if they were even eggs?) black avocado slice. Huevos was a couple dried out cold corn tortillas with beans and the same terrible eggs. This place might be good for hanging out with a glass of wine, but we've eaten dinner here twice and breakfast once trying to give it a chance, and none were impressive, but the breakfast was so bad we still joke about it a couple weeks later.

Like any place like this it's just about average. When u come here your going to get decent for a decent price. I will give them one thing they are consistent with there food.. if you want a good meal for a decent price don't hesitate to stop in. Always good friendly people and clean restaurant. It just doesn't blow my socks off that's all.
Really fun local bar. I love it when they have the big window open. My favorite type of place to hang out when I'm in town for the weekend and I feel like "slumming."

I have had my dogs hair cut here twice now. I feel bad writing a bad review on this place when the other 2 reviews are really good ones. But I have to tell the truth and let anyone else know that is considering taking their animal here to be careful.

The first time we took our little dog here, I was not paying attention. After the 2nd time, that was not good, my wife said that she was not happy with the 1st one either.

This time, it was me that picked up the dog, so I paid attention to the cut. Our dogs body was cut at one length. Then his head was either not cut at all, or cut at a different length. Im pretty sure they did not touch it at all.

The change in hair length between the body and head was not evenly cut or made to blend so it was not that noticeable. 

Some people might like their dog looking this way, so maybe they confused us with someone else. I am not sure. The hair under our dogs neck looked like a bad chop job. Im pretty sure I could have done it better than this.

So if anyone reading this decided to take their dog here, my advice is to examine your animal carefully when you pick him or her up and if its not right, say something.

As for us, unless we can find another groomer, we will be going back to Petco.

I love seafood! This place is great for a seafood lover. You get to pick what you want, what seasonings you want and how spicy. I ordered crawfish, shrimp, mussels and crab legs. They were all perfectly cooked and delicious. 

The reasoning for only three stars is because the drink was super super strong and made it a little difficult to drink and also...I know that this is a seafood place but we just wish there were more none seafood options for those who don't like seafood so they can enjoy the restaurant too. My husband got the chicken basket and that was pretty much the only thing on the menu that was not seafood. The chicken tasted really odd...not like it was rotten or anything but it tasted different. The fries were also not very much better either. 

I am not saying that I will not return...because I will but until they ( if they ever do) add more non seafood options I will have to find someone that loves seafood like I do to come with me.

I'm begging you to please change your mac salad recipe, it is SO awful. All of the other food I have had at your establishment is REALLY bomb, but for some reason the Mac salad is horrible. I can't even eat it. I tried it a few times thinking maybe it was a bad batch and can't do it. I have had a lot of Hawaiian food and have never tasted anything like it. 

If that ever changes I'd love to come back, like I said all the other food is delicious!

Tried Jon Smith subs today because I had a coupon and was not impressed. I had the turkey deli sub and probably could've made a better sandwich at home. The sandwich was flavorless and the roll was very dry. Not to mention, we visited this restaurant during Covid and employees were not wearing their masks properly and continued to touch their face regularly with their gloves which did not seem very sanitary to me. Overall, there are many much better options for the money to get a sandwich in Meridian.

The truffles are fine. Honestly, almost everything that gets called a "truffle" nowadays, which is often just a fancy chocolate, falls flat to me. If you've ever had a really good truffle, you know what I mean. But this place is still above average for that sort of thing. It does not stand up to The Chocolate Bar in Boise, which has been my gold standard for years, preferring them to much more expensive places in Seattle and Portland.

Where this place really shines is the ice-cream. The ice-cream is the real star here, by far. This ice-cream is right up there with Salt & Straw, better even. Probably right up there with the real old-school places in New York. I can't say enough good about it. The quality is top-notch. Very few if any imperfections. And the lemon blueberry flavor is just...wow.

Lastly, the local art selection is much better than one would expect from this area. Very good stuff, and makes a much more heartfelt gift than the same old Sino junk from Target or WalMart.

P.S. Oopsies, I accidentally hit "no tip" instead of "custom tip" on their register last time I was in, and felt bad because I didn't bring cash either, and the lady was super helpful, really the service is fantastic every time I go in.

P.P.S. My only complaint is that sometimes they give you a bag covered in glitter, not something I want around my food, also there is the environmental aspects of glitter to consider.

I spent most of my life in and near Orange County where this type of Cajun seafood "dump on the table" is very popular. I have to say, Hook & Reel has really nailed it. Fresh crawfish, succulent crab, clams, shrimp and all the other goodies you can find in a Cajun seafood restaurant. Service was excellent and they have a very nice selection of beers on draft. There isn't really a kids menu, however on the app side there are chicken strips, fried mozzarella which is really good and some other items which make it a kid-friendly place. 

I'll warn you, medium spicy is HOT so plan accordingly. I'd suggest starting with mild and you can alway ask for a container of the edium or hot if you want to try it. Portions are generous and it comes with potatoes and corn. Andouille sausage is extra but really makes the meal. 

Crawfish is where it's at IMHO. They're a little work but so so worth it. 

Enjoy your visit to Hook and Reel. I'm going back this week!

It says online and I also on here that it is open 24 hours however I have gone there three or four times after 12 o'clock and it is not open I have also called them and someone comes to the phone and answers and says they do not open up till 6 AM please at least fix your hours if you are going to open later it is a very very big inconvenience

This place is good if you have never experienced true Cajun/creole seafood. The snow crab legs were small and did not have any seasoning besides your typical Cajun seasoning. The shrimp and mussels were decent. When I visit a local seafood restaurant, the experience needs to match the prices that I am paying for.

Listen guys, let me make this easy. Minuteman Lock is a no BS no Hassle business. They made upfront and great to work with. Don't waste your time at big box locations looking for keys or lock solutions. Call these guys up and tell them what you're working with and they'll help you find the best solution. Even I'd that means sending you somewhere else. GREAT, stand up local guys looking to help you out.

This is a good location and I've been here a couple times. It's been hit or miss as far as amount of meat on the burrito - but nothing like a 1 star review that I'm seeing... it's Chipotle....and I'm sure this location get extremely busy at times. They'll be here for a long time, keep up the good work!

We highly recommend Jeff Stewart of Stewart Realty for all real estate needs.  Jeff is extremely knowledgeable and hard working.  Jeff and his office manager, Sheri, helped us find our home in Star.  Jeff worked closely with us as we refined our search for just the right home for our needs.  He was great at asking clarifying questions and letting us know right away when a house went on the market that he thought we would like.  Since we didn't live close enough to visit all the homes, he even went to check on some of them and would let us know what he thought we might like and not like about each.  Jeff really knows his way around all of the cities and towns in southwest Idaho.  He drove us to each listing, describing the features of all the towns and really helped us narrow our focus.  Jeff also knows so many people and service companies.  He has terrific recommendations, even for great restaurants that he knew we'd like!  We can't thank Jeff enough for all of his help and his patience as we searched for just the right home.

The server was very nice - especially to our 3 and 5 year old children, but the food just wasn't all that great.  The eggs were vastly over cooked, the bacon was paper thin and under cooked, and it seemed like the sausage patties were either pre-cooked frozen patties or also over cooked.

Brandy is an amazing house cleaner! She is also very kind, sweet and willing to do whatever ot takes to make her customers pleased with her work! Her prices are in line and my house smells good and sparkles when she's done! Giver her a try, you won't be disappointed!

Sadly this was our first and last visit here. We have visited a few other local "DIY" options and this was the only one that smelled horrible, and made us feel like we were walking into a shady, creepy place. The woman who greeted us (eventually) seemed annoyed to see us and then was helpful on a very dry and "if I have to" level. The shampoos and conditioners were in unmarked/labeled bottles and very well could have been dish soap, especially based on smell and look. The dryers are in the back in a separate room behind where the groomers work, so you have to move the pups back and forth. Some of the towels by the tubs were dirty/stained, and the place in general just felt... dirty and ignored. 

We have a wonderful groomer we love, but with four dogs having a local place for a quick bath is very helpful.  This is not that place for us.

Loving all the sandwiches! Reminds me of a sandwich shop I used 2 go 2 in the Bay Area, CA called Togo's Eatery (8 We ordered 7 sandwiches (3 Steak & Onions, Meatball, Pastrami, BLT & Tuna Salad), and they all vanished in less than 5 minutes. We also ordered 1 small fry and a small soda. I think we were supposed 2 get 6 other small sodas, but we didn't specify. I forgot, but overall, it was a tasty experience. We will be back soon. Thank you.

We went to Hook & Reel in Meridian for the first time (Curbside Takeout only.)  We ordered the Reel's Catch, a boil for 2 with a choice of a whole Dungeness crab, 1¼ lbs. Snow Crab or two 6 ounce lobster tails, plus a choice of two of 1 lb. clams, 1 lb. shrimp, crawfish, mussels or black mussels.  There is a choice of sauces from plain to cajun or the Hook Reel Special Blend that is a combination of all the sauces (Cajun, garlic butter, Old Bay, and lemon pepper,) in mild, spicy and fire.

We ordered the lobster tails with head-on shrimp and clams, with Hook Reel sauce in mild.  It was huge!  The shrimp were large to jumbo and there were a lot of them.  The lobster tails were perfectly cooked. 
 Unfortunately, over half of the clams were closed, and couldn't be eaten, so we really didn't get our full $49 worth (hence the 4 stars - had we been dining-in, I would have requested a break on the cost).  There were 4 new potatoes and 2 corn on the cob halves.  We also ordered two orders of clam chowder (I wanted lobster bisque, but they were out).  The clam chowders were generous, but could have had more clams.

All in all, there were leftovers of everything.  It was delicious, and plentiful, and we have leftovers!  We will be back after it is safe to dine-in, (so that if my clams aren't open, I can let someone know!)
The Joint Chiropractic is the best chiro service I have been able to find regarding quality, price and value. In addition, you do not need to make an appointment which is very convenient.

Owner only cares about money. Huge inflation in product and quality is poor.
They change pharmacies constantly looking for the cheapest price and that does not get past down to the patient. 
Patient care is their lowest priority and $$$ is there number one concern.
If you truly need help losing weight see a real dietician ( they do not employ anyone with a real degree for "counseling " ) .All you will get her is a constant push to buy more product.  Trust me I know.

I went in to buy a $5 gift card, I was going to buy several for co workers.
They refused to sell me gift cards at that low amount.  Said not worth the effort.
I walked out and went to dutch bros.

My husband called and requested for someone to come do a basic service and cleaning (we have never had any problems with our HVAC) since we are selling our home and that was part of the agreement with the buyers. Someone came out and did a full inspection of our HVAC and then quoted us over 2600 for a deep cleaning since our system was "extremely dirty." We are selling our home so we weren't interested in any extra services and we were told we basically needed to restore our 21 year old system. Ended up paying for another service/cleaning from a different company that understood more of what we were wanting and was more reasonably priced. 200 dollars for a "service" didn't include filters or basic cleaning that other companies offered. Should've done more research prior to contacting them. Pretty disappointed.

My kids tried the zip line, at first they were just down to three and they were already geared up, a party of 10 came and they all ended up being geared while my kids waited for another 15 mins to put their  harness on before they let them start going to zipline, they should put more enough staff on the zipline so that we don't have to wait 30mins before they get started. Plus it was Friday around 1pm, so they need to put extra people to work with kids

Staff was friendly and knew the menu well. We ordered right away and thought it would be pretty quick as there were only 2 tables of ppl and the larger table already had their food.  We ordered the contest combo and the Samoan Our pizza took about 30+ minutes to come out and we just got the Samoa first. Which was very skimpy on the toppings for a $20 pizza. We asked if that was normal as this was supposed to be a specialty pizza and they said they would remake it.  Finally our combo pizza came out and it was loaded!  
Overall the service was good , slow but good and pizza needed a bit of salt as they tasted a bit bland 

I will post the pic of the 1st skimpy pizza then the new one they remade
Worst managed Taco Bell I've ever been to. Drive thru EXPECT 20 minute wait. Definitely worth the extra mile drive to another location.

This establishment has the BEST ice cream I the Valley!  The truffles are out of thus world too! The store is off the beaten path but well worth it.  Two of my favorites are the cold brew and lemon flavors.

The review of two Mortgage Companies 
(A cautionary tale and why staying local is key)

Sorry if this is a little long winded but I have to give high praise to Tina Burney of Premier Mortgage Resources here in the Treasure Valley. I don't write reviews on goods or services unless they are really bad or really good. And now The Rest of the Story....

I decided I wanted to go from a 30 yr fixed to a 15 yr fixed and pull some cash out. Having been a mortgage loan officer and California real estate licensee for 20 years, I know the business. And because of that I know that my situation with my  finances, credit, stability, etc is what we used to refer to when I was in the business as a "slam dunk" deal.  I decided to contact my current mortgage holder, Freedom Mortgage for this need because I had been with them for over 5 years. What a mistake that was! Long story short, Freedom Mortgage company was inept, unprofessional and non-communicative. After 3 months of playing with this company, I ended up e-mail blasting 15 top level executives to include the CEO to try to get some action. They still could not pull it together!

A friend of mine told me his son had just had a great experience with Tina Burney at Premier Mortgage Resources so I called her. After talking with her, I decided to pull my application from Freedom and to reapply with Tina. I found her very professional, knowledgeable and fast! On May 6th she took my application. On May 8th she had an approval pending the title report. We signed our docs on May 22nd and the deal was funded, recorded and wire transfer in the bank was complete on May 28th. So what Freedom Mortgage couldn't get done in over 3 months, Tina Burney got done in 22 days start to finish! 

Bottom line is this. If you want your loan process to go smooth and fast, go to Tina. And no I do not get any kickbacks for this! She is just that good!
Dirty car go to Dirty Harry's. He is often times found working there and he is always helpful. It's not expensive either so value for the money...

Took a friend to the restaurant and my autistic son was wearing his Trump 2020 ball cap. The individual behind the counter ignored us and when I asked for help she refused and got someone else to take our order. When the pizza was cooked she wouldn't deliver it and again got someone else to do the work. Now, during this time she moved though the dining room asking everyone if they needed anything and how their meal was but refused to even talk to us. This is not customer service and not American everyone has their right be who they are and have their own beliefs. Pretty childish for a long time Idaho restaurant.

Ive been a member for quite a while. The gym is fine, but I have been noticing it going down hill quickly. The place is filthy. The bathrooms are disgusting. The toilet paper and paper towels are always out, and you can actually see the mildew buildup on the bathroom counters... SO gross!! I would be willing to bet a lot of money that the bathrooms aren't even getting cleaned weekly, when it should be daily. Really really disgusting. There have been a lot of new members since the beginning of the year, and we've been noticing that none of the newbies wipe down their equipment or put their weights away, which is frustrating. Today I watched a female trainer "training" (improperly by the way) a client, and afterward they just left the barbell on the preacher curl bench and walked away... shouldn't she have been teaching this new gym goer the proper gym etiquette? 
If you go upstairs, the whole upstairs just stinks like mold and sweat. The whole place needs a serious deep cleaning. The new YMCA opens soon, and it will be interesting to see how well Axiom does.

We bought our Tresidio home in June of 2020. Cinnamon Dilworth was amazing to work with in picking out the perfect lot for us. The design process was amazing and working with Nadza and the team for two days to make our home exactly what we hoped for was an great experience. We lived in CA during the entire build process and our Project manager, Kai Duncan was awesome. He kept us update weekly, provided pictures and worked with us to schedule inspections that met our schedule so that we could be here in person. The entire process was stress free.

We have been here five months now and absolutely love our new home. The build quality is amazing and we have not had any issues. We love our new community and state, and would highly recommend Tresidio to anyone looking to purchase a new home!

Requested an estimate. If they come to your house they charge you per window, even if you don't use them. NON REFUNDABLE...For me it would have been $100 just to measure for replacement glass. I called another company and they charge $150@hr...NOT HAPPENING.
 So, I measured the glass, on the (3) broken windows, and turned that in. I had to go to the business the following week on Tuesday,(5 days later), to find out the estimate. I had never recieved a response.
The lady at the desk was rude. "They have so many people answering phones upstairs"...that it was going to take a minute. I remembered the name of the person I sent an email to. The lady at the desk look at me and verbally gave the $930+ estimate for 3 panes of glass, no written estimate. Said that was a low estimate, that they would not know full details until they arrived at the house. I had to write it on the back of a card. So technically no estimate.
 I asked for an estimate for a windshield for my little truck. $400+, and that would not include any extras from possible rust damage on such an older vehicle. Never looked at my truck.
First off I am a disabled Senior citizen, on a fixed poverty income. I have to be very careful of what I do. $930 is not much to pay bills with.
Three local window company gave me a huge shove off...they didn't have the time to fix windows as they were booked on new window installations.
I will be looking to find the glass for my windows and replacing it myself. I can afford that.
 Yes my home is open to the elements due to broken glass.

Omg, all I have to say is, they are so generous with their portions!!!! It literally last us the WHOLE day! My favorite is their teriyaki chicken! 
I love their employees also! I didn't know the difference between their sauces & one of the worker forgot her name gave me each one to try.  I love me a happy worker.

Horrible business and Steve is truly something else.  I had tried multiple ways of contacting this service to turn on my sprinklers (as my lawn was dying) and had no reply whatsoever. Multiple emails, texts, service requests and phone calls were made. I received ZERO communication back or confirmation via email. I ended up having to hire a different business. Then one Saturday afternoon somebody shows up in my driveway and helps them self to the backyard. When I asked them to identify themselves he said he was Steve from the maintenance shop.  I explained to him that I had never received communication from him so I hired another service and did not need his services. Additionally when the other service came to turn on my sprinklers a sprinkler head was damaged and they said it was likely due to the blowout that the maintenance shop had done prior to the winter.  When I mentioned all of this to Steve he threatened me with a lien on my house and having his attorney contact me. He charged me a service fee for his poor communication. I paid the petty fee to get him off my back but will never do business with place again.... they were unresponsive, rude and almost hostile with threats.  Beware.  
Here is one of the threatening messages I received directly from Steve:
 "Nothing was damaged when it was blown out. If there had been, you would have said something already, and we've never, ever had damage to a system before. You're welcome to leave a review, but it won't stop an invoice or lean.  If you leave a review regarding damage to a sprinkler system because of a blowout, you better be able to prove it. My attorney likes to send demand letters to those who make false accusations. The only bad reviews we ever get are from those who don't want to pay their bills. They are overlooked quite quickly, my people looking for service because of the common denominator. I wasted enough time on this today. I have a lot of work to do. I'm behind because I had to stop at a house that I really didn't need to stop at. Thank you. Have a nice day.  
Steve
The Maintenance Shop"

Of course I didn't want to pay his bill because he provided no services for me.  It is not my fault that he was unresponsive and non communicative and totally rude on top of it all.



IN RESPONSE TO STRVES REPLY: you can clearly see that he is defensive, difficult to work with and borderline hostile. He has a convoluted system that is not user friendly. I reported my honest customer experience and he refuses to believe or even consider that his system may be flawed.  I'm not the only customer with this complaint yet Steve refuses to recognize how his reactions and behavior are completely out of line.  I paid my bill, received no services and was threatened several times by Steve.  Interesting how responsive he is when he's upset with a customer complaint however he was never able to communicate with me when I was originally attempting to procure his services.

This is probably my favorite seafood place.  Nice decor and the staff were all wonderful, especially our waitress (I think her name was Tanra). What a doll...my husband noted they served his favorite beer (Tetton 208) and had commented that he wished he knew if a store carried it. Well in a few minutes she was back at our table with information about where we could go. We were so impressed that she went above and beyond like that....Now THATS customer service!

Now on to the food...the clam chowder was the best and the lobster basket was great. Also, they give you a basket of Shrimp Chips that were so different from any other kind of chip I've ever had....and they come in different colors...yum!

My husband had the Shrimp PoBoy and it to was great. We will definitely be back

My husband & I went to the Firehouse last night and sat on the patio.
