We had the fish & Chip with tots and finger steaks (which the menu said was battered, they were tiny tiny burnt curled up ice cold rubber! so were the tots. The fish was a greasy mess with soggy batter and rubber tots, we also had one O'Doul's and one drink special the tab was $32.00 rounded off. This place sucks
Delicious, lots of flavor varieties, and very affordable! My favorites are the Salami and the Bavarian dessert empanadas!

The second time here.  Great margaritas and every time we try a different entree, it is fantastic.  My wife had the fish and chips and I had grilled pork chops. The food is fresh and the vegetables are perfectly steamed 
The wait staff are always nice and friendly.

As a sandwich lover, I of course had to try the famous Togos. Nice people, very clean restaurant, but meh food. Had the pastrami best seller with the usual toppings and mustard on sour dough. The bread is terrible, ruined the sandwich. For that price it should have been way better. The pastrami is good, toppings seemed fresh, but it was overpowered by crummy bread, at the end I was picking meat out of the sandwich and threw the bread away. With so many other wonderful sandwich shops (Hugos, Fat Guys) I will not be back. Once again, meh. Try the local guys, they beat Togos easily.
being new to the area and never visited this chain before I wasn't overly impressed. the staff seemed bored .the food wasn't as good as I'd heard and overpriced. ...I won't be going back

My wife and I stopped at Steve's Café during the week for breakfast. We are new to the area and are big breakfast people and early risers, so we were pleased to find someplace good that is open at 6:30 am. This is the first breakfast place in the area where the coffee was actually good. The majority of time the coffee at other locales has been very weak. I ordered the chicken fried steak and my wife got the eggs benedict. Both were very good. The pancakes that came with my breakfast were a little cold and spongy but overall had good flavor. The portions were substantial. We will definitely return. (Oh...and for the young whipper snapper who comments about old people--your time will come kiddo.)

I have been to a chiropractor or two (or 6) in my life and Dr. Anderson is top notch!  After wasting my time with a chiropractor in Boise who seemed more interested in cross-selling me on bio-feedback allergy testing and some sort of hormone injections (seriously?) than adjusting my rather pained neck, a friend of mine referred me to Back 2 Health Chiropractic.  I couldn't be more pleased.  Dr. Anderson is professional and knowledgeable and utilizes state of the art technology to aid in pinpointing the precise problem.  She takes great care to explain the particulars of your treatment and specifically how she will go about helping you.  I would readily recommend her and her office to anyone--absolutely as good as it gets.

Just came into this place for the first the with my wife and niece for lunch, and I have to say, WOW. Delicious soups, delicious hot and cold sandwiches and the best carrot lemonade I've ever had. I highly recommend this place.
I have never experienced such poor customer service in my 73 years. Went to the customer service desk, three people working, lights on nobody home. Not a one of them had a clue or cared

I've been here twice so far...once for lunch and once for breakfast.  So far, I would say I'm happy to have it around.  Especially for breakfast since I live in Kuna and there's not a lot of options around here.  The breakfast that we had was delicious too so that doesn't hurt!  My husband had the biscuits w/gravy and eggs, etc.  I had the dish that resembles a fancy huevos rancheros.  We also tried the bloody mary's which were also sooo good.  The staff is always nice and the atmosphere is nice and laid back.  I'll be back.

We used to be loyal Cafe Ole customers but have not been pleased the last few years. Corona Villages quality is better, its service is WAY faster, and its menu is far more extensive. We were also pleased with the prices. We'll be back!

You walk up to the counter and the darling lady with a welcoming smile greets you and explains what the restaurant is and points you to the parchment paper with the daily hot soups they are serving, you can sample every one of them, the grilled cheese and the tomato basil soup are an excellent cure to a rainy day! If you're looking for something a bit more hearty, try the chicken noodle. I'v been there twice and i will continue to go. 5 stars all the way! Keep up the good work!

My favorite breakfast restaurant.  Like most breakfast joints, it gets busy so you have to arrive early.  I get the veggie omelet.  It is full of veggies and has avocado.  Yum!  The hashbrowns are the best ever because they are very crispy.  No soggy potatoes here.  The prices are normal and the wait staff is always so friendly.  They have a coloring page kid's menu and crayons for the kids along with fun breakfast items for them like frog in a hole and chocolate chip pancakes (also healthier options). They have weekend specials like pumpkin white chocolate chip pancakes.  Their plain pancakes are so good too, very rich flavor, not bland like you're eating flour.  Highly recommend.

You guys have gotten my order wrong the last 5 times I've came in, every time I ask for extra tomatoes but get none. It's really frustrated, once had to come back 3 times in one day to get my order right.... if you guys didn't taste so good and weren't super friendly I wouldn't still be coming back. Like I said it's just super frustrating when all you want is extra tomatoes and can't even get that without having to check the order every time or end up having to drive back... 
First, second, third time I understand but 5 times in a row; like how?!

First and last time here.  We went to Rudys around the corner, it was packed.  We decided to explore restaurants around the area.  Went to Hideaway, it was empty on a Friday night (your first clue).  Walked up stairs, the restaurant layout is very strange.  Went to patio and sat and sat and sat.  We watched two waitresses and bartender bs forever until we caught eye contact to get service.  There was maybe 3 table in the entire upstairs.  Then we proceeded to wait again for our drinks and menus.  When she finally arrived she asked us for a card? To order food we needed to give them a card?  We left, went to BFC and guess what, they were packed out the door.  The Hideaway will be closed within 6mo without serious management intervention.  They aren't pulling the traffic for a reason, owner read and pay attention to your reviews.

The caramel pecan sticky buns are the best I've ever had, period. They are amazing. The only problem is that other people have figured this out and they sometimes sell out before I get there. Their brookies are phenomenal too - soft and moist all the way through with an impossibly thin and delicate crust that gives it just a little bit of crunch when you bite into it. I'm sure everything else they make is fantastic as well, but the caramel pecan rolls are so good I can't ever bring myself to get anything else.

This is one of my go-to breakfast spots in town.

I always come here when I visit from out-of-town. One of the best items on their menu as most know is the Huckleberry Stuffed French Toast!

There is hardly ever a wait depending on the day you go and the staff is always courteous. This morning I had tried the Marionberry Pancakes. Sooo good! But be warned, the portion for even a half stack is humongous! The pancakes take up the entire plate.

For the quality of food, portion size, and polite staff you'll be hard pressed to find a better breakfast spot!

They are also open until 2:30pm, which is a plus for those late risers. I will definitely be back to Steve's Cafe!

If you're on the fence hop on over and have a bite at Steve's!

I started riding in November 2016 and haven't looked back since. The workouts, facilities, employees at Cyclebar are first class all the way. I consistently get a killer work-out and have made some amazing friends, with both riders and instructors alike. I highly recommend Cyclebar if you want a high-energy/high-intensity incredibly fun sweatsesh!

Very friendly service. Great place to take a first date or current girlfriend. Like the menu. They have great sushi for the fish lovers but also a complete open menu. They also have a huge selection in there bar which is nice for a small restaurant like this one

What joke!!! A full one third had no meat on it at all.  Cheese was sparse at best.  You're far better off with a frozen pizza from the store.  I have to wonder what happened to Pizza Hut.  Are they all like this one?

Place is cool but the staff just absolutely kill the place and vibe. They offered the table next to me perks and to me nothing (maybe because they were white i don't know) but I realized they had attitude towards me and my spouse but were being outgoing with other customers. I will not be coming again do to my experience being here. I absolutely do not recommend this place at all towards anyone!!!!
Best chicken chimis ever (ask for no beans)! Great salsa, too!

Went to Lucky Fins with some out of town business guests for happy hour. Great deals on drinks and food only downfall is happy hour is only available in the bar and service was a little slow on a not packed night. Food was excellent and will definitely return.

Wow. I don't think I've ever left a grocery store thinking, "holy great costumer service!" I walk in and enquire about the apples. Produce guy cuts open a variety and allows me to try them. My son was meanwhile begging for one of those produce isle fruit roll ups, and a man who I assume was the store manager, opened up one there for him. Made my sons day. The staff is always friendly and smiling. What a great grocery store!

I rented a home through this company and had troubles as soon as I moved in. The house had some issues that were never corrected even though I repeatedly requested they be fixed. I had billing issues all along the way and got a lot of run around each time I called to discuss an issue. I received several notices and visits to the home from companies associated with a bank that wanted to foreclose on the house. I called to discuss this and was treated poorly and told I didn't know anything about the situation (I worked in the home loan business for over 10 years and have significant knowledge of this situation) 

When I moved out I thoroughly cleaned the home but was still charged to have it cleaned. I left the home cleaner than it was provided to me. I cleaned base boards, windows, blinds appliances and do on. I was also charged for past due fees. I have an email invoice from the company the month I moved out after my last rent was paid showing a zero balance. The records I was sent after I moved out had been altered to include fees that had not been there. I was charged parts and labor to replace items that were not broken or missing. I asked to attend the walk through when I moved out and was told they don't do that. I took pictures and video when I moved out. Additionally the refund and letter was not provided within 30 days. I feel I am owed over $400 in addition to what I was refunded. I have tried to work with this company to get additional funds back with no luck. I have yet to cash my partial refund as I try to work through this situation but the check will expire soon and I feel that I am up against a wall. It is an unfair situation to be put in.

Each drive through visit has been great. They really have the best finger steaks. Great hamburgers and tasty cold beverages are consistently great here. I'm looking forward to having my hubby try their milkshakes!

A large group of us met there today to watch a good friend of ours race at Talladega Superspeedway. We called ahead to reserve a spot and confirmed we could watch the race. The first problem was the first waitress. She Seemed to have an issue with our group. I politely asked twice to have the TV changed when the race was about the start. I finally had to go to the bar and ask the bartender to do it for us so we didn't miss the start.  I walked up to 3 staff talking to each other about another worker or something, complaining about stuff. I stood there for about a minute. They all saw me finished talking, THEN ALL 3 WALKED AWAY!  I finally said excuse me and got someone's attention. This must of ticked her off because she got a crappy look on her face and then asked another waitress to take over our area because she couldn't handle us.   I could clearly hear her 10feet away. The new waitress provided relatively good service but had a few bitchy remarks when we asked for specific things.   Separate checks seemed to be a huge hassle.  When one of us asked if she was ready for us to order food she said "I was waiting on you to order" very rudely, not sarcastic. The food was good. Near the end of the race there were lots of cautions so it lasted a bit longer than planned. I could see several wait staff talking about our group and sending dirty looks our way because we had paid but not yet left. Only talking about 10-15 minutes mind you...
I guess they must have had another group waiting. Although we were never told we had a time limit. 
The last straw was the waitress literally complaining that we were cheap and didn't tip well to someone in our group!!!! We were all talking outside and we all left at least 20%.  
I could understand if we were unruly drunk people but we are middle aged mellow people who just wanted to watch a race. 
Consensus is that none of us will go back. 14 customers lost today!!!

This is a great nail salon.  They are brand new at the corner of Eagle and Ustick.  The massage chairs are amazing, the decor is cool and relaxing, and they do a great job on nails.  I thought the girls were really friendly and I enjoyed chatting while I got a manicure.  There prices are the same as any around, but I enjoyed the atmosphere much more than other salons in the area.

Burger was eh. Small meat patty large bun. Fries were good fry sauce was good. Chips and salsa were not so good. Fried pickle spears were good. Boneless wings were ok. Didn't care for the sauce. I tend to like it a little more spice an a little less sweat.  My wife got the cordon blue sandwich and I tried it it was tasty. Good atmosphere.

I had incredible service here. The haircut was fantastic too. It's nice to get back to an old school barbershop. The barbers use an honor system set up for who is next up in line; they don't force everyone to sign a paper on the way in to keep track of who's next. Because of this, they don't always know who's next up and have to get the customers' honesty in it, which to me isn't a problem. One of the previous reviews tried to make this into a race thing when they were almost skipped. I can assure you that race had nothing to do with it. While I was there, around 10 others came in and out so it's easy to see how it could get mixed up. It seems to be a pretty busy establishment, deservedly so, so expect a bit of a wait. But who cares, I would rather wait for a good haircut than get immediate service for a crap cut.
Tried a spicy chicken with fries for the first time, not very good. I don't see what all the fuss is about, certainly not worth waiting in line for.

Good place to eat, the fish there is good. My mac and cheese was good but not great, because it was greasy at the bottom. The service from the people is great, they do a really good job of taking care of you.

The people at this restaurant were so friendly.  They greeted us and asked if we'd ever had empanadas before and explained their menu. There were 50 different choices of empanadas, everything from traditional argentinian ground beef empanadas to salami and cheese, chicken moleh, cheeseburger, and even dessert empanadas like bavarian cream and cherries. All the empanadas are 2.50 each and they are pretty big--I ordered 2 and they filled me up! The food came out fast and was fresh, hot, and delicious. I can't wait to go back!
I LOVE tangos. The food is delicious and authentic. Service is great and pretty quick most of the time. I always make a point to go when I visit Boise for the holidays!

I have given RC Willey three stars because they have made it right. I have received all my tables and they have tried their best to make it right. Thanks to Allen for getting me a table for Christmas. The delivery guys were great!

Ate a Bronco Burger here the other day and it was the best damn burger and fries I've had in a long time. Even got a bonus burger out of the deal because they got my order wrong and they immediately got right on it to make it right. Great customer service and food. Two thumbs up.

Stopped by with the family and tried over 6 different flavors. Not a single one disappointed. The Hawaiian, in my opinion, was the absolute best and the desserts definitely do not disappoint either! Will absolutely be back!
They don't give anyone the time of day. Couldn't get ahold of our prior property management whose office is just down the street from thiers so they denied out app. Very poor judgement calls.

So we have been pretty disappointed the last few times we have come in today was really bad. This was my sons birthday breakfast also. 

Our Bacon was ice cold and no drink refills. The restaurant was also not busy so there is not any excuse for this. My sons omelette was really greasy and the ham was bone dry. We will not be coming back to eat at Steve's Cafe. For the price you have to pay for the food it should be a lot better than it was. So disappointed.

We tried La Créme at the Village at Meridian last night. It's smaller than the usual fro yo shop with a few less flavors available at a time, but the location is great. They also sell hot beverages like cider, coffee and hot chocolate, a large variety of cakes, pies and cheesecakes or by the slice, and a small assortment of other treats like chocolate covered Oreo cookies. 

I had the peppermint with chocolate chips, and it's as good as anywhere else.  I look forward to trying the other goodies in the future.

If all you're after is the largest variety of fro-yo, you'd be better off with U-Swirl or Aspen Leaf, but this is a cute little shop in a great location. Unless I'm craving a specific flavor they don't have, convenience trumps variety.

First the reason for the 3 stars.   The amount of food does not match to the price.  I'm giving them a little bit of benefit of the doubt since this is their grand opening.

I ordered 2 cups of soup, one full sandwich, one half sandwich, and their chocolate bacon.    It was  $23-24 bucks! ?  

As far as the food,   the sandwich quality looked good,   good flavors,  but the amount of the sandwich is my problem.  They use regular ciabatta bread,  about 4 inches square.   I will post some pictures of the sandwich.    I think the price point may be a bit high for the size of the sandwich. 

Then the soup.    I didn't know what to expect.  I had the Buffalo Chicken soup.  The soup was good.   Enough chicken,  good broth,  good spice.    This soup is good.   

Bacon: the website shows that it's a crispy piece of bacon skewered, dipped in milk chocolate,  then drizzled in white chocolate.    While it was crispy, skewered, and coated in chocolate,   it was coated then with peanuts.      Review: unfortunately, stay away from it.    They need to use thicker bacon, cooked at lower temp for longer.   And the Chocolate needs better tempering.

Now this is a local store,  mom and pop shop,  so I don't expect systems in place like at franchises.   I will try them again in the near future and write a new review.  



Edit***
I previously wrote that I got a wrong order.    I did.  But they have fixed the issue. I went back after work and advised the problem.   Without hesitation they apologized and remade the sandwich.   Thank you! 

This is a small company that is just going to have some hurdles to pass.    *here's to your success SKG!
SO GOOD! Chick-fil-a is one of my favorite restaurants. Great service great quality food!

I had a burger ($6.99), fries ($1.99) and a side salad ($2.99).  The food was good.  Do the math - that's $12 for a lunch without a drink at a fast food counter (no wait staff).  I think Yelp listing it as $$ is understated.  I'd show it as $$$ with no table cloths, silverware, or china!  I tried their website for a survey.  It insisted on me rating a drink I didn't buy and environment I didn't use (it was to go order) - don't waste your time with the survey!  I know, with out 50% off or more coupon/promo, I won't eat their food again.

Food is awesome, service at the bar is very good and the bartenders make good drinks. If you go there sit at the bar and you will have a great experience. Where the place lacks is table service. After several visits service is just slow. Waited 20 or 25 minutes after we finished our drinks to get noticed. Could not get the servers attention. We finally got the bar tenders attention paid the check and left.

If I could give no stars I would. Extremely rude. I called on a Wednesday at noon and asked if they had time in the next 10 minutes for a full set (because I was across the street). I knew there was a good chance they'd say no, but I asked anyway. She said no. Okay cool. I then asked, "Are you guys completely booked for the day?" To which she snapped back with "Well that's not what you asked, you asked in the next 10 minutes"... WOW. I replied, "Yes that is what I asked, and now I'm asking if you have other openings today." There was silence long enough to make me question whether or not the call was still live...then she finally said, "We have a 3:30" I sadly said, "Oh no, that's too late for me" AND was going to continue with "can I make an appointment for another day?" Before I could to that I was immediately cut off with "BYE" and hung up on. I have never been to this place and have my own nail tech who is AMAZING, but I was in a bind and thought I'd try them out because of their rating. NOPE. I won't add the expletives that I'm using in my head right now either.
First time trying a Chick-fil-A. Probably best chicken sandwich I can remember eating and the waffle fries are good too.

First off, before I forget, LeighAnn is a fantastic server. I highly recommend her.

I had the fortune of ordering the Shrimp Scampi Supreme and it was great. the creaminess of the sauce, the shrimp cooked to perfection, and the noodles al dente.

The crushed red pepper brought the perfect heat too.

But alas, my son enjoyed mine more than his...

So! I was also able to partake in the appetizer: Lobster Flatbread Trio.

Great dish. I will probably order it again. I do have some minor critiques though. I believe the Chimichurri sauce would be better served in smaller lines in order to be spread out more. Lastly, the small scallops were a bit over done, turning a little tough.

All that said, I will bring me, mine and anyone else here again and again.

One of my favorite restaurants in Idaho. By far.
Both times we have been there and bought furn. We have been impressed by the service. The delivery was fast and great. Will shop there again.

Super Fun and Tons to do here! Go karts, mini-golf, laser tag, bumper cars, arcade, ballocity (jungle gym), 3-D interactive game, laser maze. We didn't even get to the sky trail, bumper boats, indoor Twister ride, or bowling!!

I ordered fish and chips and upgraded to onion rings to avoid just "salted" french fries. The fish pieces were the smallest I've ever seen in my life, more than have 1/2 the size of the smallest I've had before today. The taste was ok but nothing special. The 5 or 6 onion rings were average at best and really small to medium in size. The service was friendly but I asked how big the fish pieces were before I ordered and they turned out 1/3 of the size described. I was asked if I wanted coleslaw (below average) and I asked if it was extra and I was told "No it comes with it" I'm glad I wasn't asked if I wanted fish. With an ice tea it was $18.31 before a tip. No way. Last time here.

Great massage - hot stones and hot towels.  Liz customizes each massage according to your painful areas and works out the knots. Very clean and relaxing with soft music and the sound of breaking waves!  Definitely the best in town.
Service is always prompt here. Good value and portions. Love the crunch wrap supreme. And free wifi.

Outstanding! The food was extremely tasty. The gluten free pancakes were totally awesome! They have an entire gluten free menu. The owner is very friendly and came by to say hello. The Mexican homemade sausages were to die for- and they sell them to take home as well. Ill be back by to buy some before I leave town to take home with me. Love this place! I will be back for sure!
I love these empanadas.  Grab a couple and a mandarin Jarrito to complete the package!

The "Kids Korner" shelf in their donut case may be my favorite square foot in all of Meridian, narrowly edging out spot in the Zamzows cage where, each spring, all the baby chicks huddle up together under the heat lamp.

There's a chance these dudes straight up care more about the donuts they put out than their peers at every other Albertsons in the universe. They pump out  wacky varieties and load everything in that Kids Korner with enough candy and  ridiculously bright sprinkles to simultaneously induce both seizures and diabetes. If dumping every loose bit of sugary detritus in the store onto those goofy kiddie donuts every morning isn't the highlight of somebody's day, then I have lost all faith in humanity.

Along the same lines, there's absolutely no good reason to make a croissant-shaped raised glazed thing and call it a "donut croissant," but this supernarket bakery totally went for it anyway, and I love them for it. They're donut people.

I go to TOGO's at least once a week, maybe more. Since I'm a business owner, I have a lot of networking meetings and I like to take them to TOGO's because it's fairly quiet and the food and service is great.

For those of us who have been around Boise for a while, we can remember when Cobbie's Sandwiches were the best. But I've been to several different Cobbies' locations in the past 6 months and every time, every location I went to the bread was stale! The bread is the foundation of a good sandwich and if you have bad bread, you have a bad sandwich. 

So because of my disappointment with Cobbie's I embarked on a mission to find a suitable sandwich replacement!  So I've been to Hugos', San Francisco Sourdough, Firehouse Subs and a few others, and while they weren't bad (they were all fresh), they just weren't what I was looking for. Then I tried TOGO's, and I found my new sandwich love!

Now I must let you know that I always order a turkey and avocado on sourdough.  And I've never even tasted their other breads because I love the sourdough so much! I like to say that it tastes like Cobbie's used to taste!

In response to Mr. Nielbecks' review below (HI Mark!) yes, the sandwiches are pricey, but they are about the same price as just about any sandwich shop in town. Those of us who work in agriculture know that the price of meat has gone up substantially in the last year or so; and no  just at sandwich shops but at the grocery and at every restaurant in town 

The only reason Subway can sell a cheap sandwich is because they have reduced the size of the pieces of meat that they give you, as well as they have reduced the number of pieces of meat.  (My BFF managed a Subway for 5 years.). You probably don't even get an ounce of meat on a sandwich at Subway anymore.  

TOGO's, on the flip side, serves up big generous portions of delicious, fresh meat.

The service is great too, restaurant is clean. TOGO's is my new favorite sandwich place.

Excellent meal, yet again!!  We brought the kids, 4 and 5, this time. They really dug the chalk wall and it kept them entertained. We had great beers, on happy hour yet!  The food was great, I had an amazing hamburger (one of the best ever, and I'm picky about my hamburgers).  Hubby had the greek salad and loved it. My 5 year old had a pizza (flatbread) and ate almost the whole thing, she never does that!  Excellent service that totally understands dining with small children.  The "family area" (with sports on TV and a chalk wall and cute littleplay  table) was perfect and you felt out of the of the way of those dining sans kids.

Save yourself the trouble and skip this dive. Pizzas are Nothing like the ones pictured here: you get flimsy, bland crust that's as thin as the cardboard box it comes in. Sauce and cheese are okay but toppings are pitifully sparse. Slow and impersonal service, and it's way overpriced. Keep looking for a Real pizza parlor!

STP is such a good store!  I shop more online than I do in the store because the selection is significantly larger and I always find better deals!  When I pick up our online orders, I end up doing some in-store shopping as well and have also come across good priced good quality items!

They have a huge outdoor gear selection but really, anything you can think of!  I've gotten some great ideas for Christmas gifts by just browsing their website.  

Since the STP, Marshall's, HomeGoods/TJMaxx merger, their selection has gotten much better and it was already good to begin with!   

They have great brands at highly discounted prices!  The sales staff is so friendly and always very helpful.  

Returns always take a while, even if it's only a couple of items (3 stars for that) - I hope this improves.  

Parking is usually available right out front and weekdays are the least busy.
Such such such amazing empanadas! I stop here on my way through Boise and it's great if you're trying to grab a snack for the toad! Really flaky crust!

After reading reviews, gave this place a try on a Sunday morning at 8:30. No line. No other customers. Cases were half empty. Very typical choices - glazed, chocolate glazed, sprinkles. Nothing you haven't seen a hundred times at every other donut shop. Donuts were fine tasting but nothing special. Will keep looking for a donut shop a little more innovative.

A nice suprise as I am used to good seafood from the Oregon Coast. The Oysters were good. My wife loved her Meditarnian Mahi Mani. We had several rolls of sushi- enjoyed them all. I need to try more of the fresh catch before I give it a five star rating but I definitely will be back.

Fast friendly service. My coffee cup is almost never empty.

They use a yukon potato for their hash browns rather than russets. Light and golden.

This is also one of the few places that knows how to make an egg "over'easy". Everyone else, from Cafe Express to Kitchen Hut to Goldies to Egg Factory, an over easy egg comes out medium. I've tried them all. It doesn't stop me from eating at those establishments, but, just saying, Steve's gets it right.

They have an elk steak that is great. How many places serve elk steak for breakfast?

They custom make their own sausage too.

But my all time favorite is the PORKIE. Only on their specials board every 3 months so I watch for it on Facebook. I tender cutlet of pork, coated in a chicken fry batter, then topped with the yummiest gravy ever! (I'm drooling just thinking bout it.)

They make a chili relleno that is very popular. But its not a traditional chili dipped in egg batter. No, no. Its a pasilla chili that had been stuffed with cheese and salsa, with a wedge of lime.

Still one of my favorites. The food is fresh not frozen (unlike Le Peep), and served hot!

Although most prices were on the higher side for breakfast, the serving sizes were also quite generous. The chili omelet was fluffy and had a nice amount of chili and cheese in it, but was on the bland side. Luckily the table is stocked with an assortment of hot sauces. The accompaning pancakes were nearly perfect: thick, yet fluffy, evenly browned and not rubbery.  These are some of the best I have had in the Treasure Valley. The oatmeal was a large bowlful with raisins and was served at the perfect thickness that I like. Service was welcoming, prompt and friendly. BIG cups of coffee were quickly refilled.  I will return!

I have been going to Steve's for a long time and thought I was a regular.   Lately the staff has become inattentive and snippy.    

Sorry     Not going back.     Can get this service anywhere.    Apparently this place is doing so well that treating a customer badly is OK to do.

Go at your own risk

Went in for appetizers - bad idea. The oysters on half-shell was OK but the crab stuffed mushrooms were terrible, contrary to the information on the menu the mushrooms were breaded and the crab stuffing was a firm dry ball of crab and bread. The mushrooms were totally raw. I suspect this was reheated from frozen. The crab cocktail was served in a ridiculous dry-ice contraption and the shrimp tasted of nothing except water - again I suspect frozen not fresh. Your only option is to smother the shrimp in the sugar filled cocktail sauce. The punchline - $40. Will not be going back.

I am updating my review, not because I have gone back to the restaurant but because I have stumbled across the Lucky Fins Sushi in of all places the Winco grocery store! Now I bought it because I thought what what the heck? I know, dangerous right? I was pleasantly surprised to find that it was actually pretty good. I had the Lucky Fin roll which at $7 was not a bad price considering it had real crab and the salmon was fresh tasting. I tried the Spicy California roll and was a bit sad that it didn't have avocado but it was cheap at $5. So what does this mean??? I guess it means that you get the same quality sushi at the grocery store as the restaurant without the high price and the 45 minute wait? Hmmmm...I was not expecting to find it wedged between the hummus and the mozzarella in a grocery store that is known for it's focus on cost and value. I'm still puzzled.

I still stand behind my original review and though I did find this worth pointing out, it does not warrant raising the restaurant itself another star. If anything maybe it should lose another star...

We used Maija Karin Photography for our wedding at Mountain Springs Lodge in February 2015. We really enjoyed working with Maija. She did a great job of quickly making us feel comfortable and coaching us to ensure we got great pictures. Our wedding photos turned out so beautiful! We love them and have received so many compliments from our family and friends.

When planning our wedding, Maija was a little more expensive than other photographers we looked into. But we loved her photos and I knew photography was where I was willing to splurge. In addition, we very much envisioned a winter wedding. However, when we arrived at Mountain Springs Lodge, there was no snow in sight. I was so thankful I spent a little more and choose Maija. It gave me the peace of mind that even without snow, we had a very experienced photographer who could still take beautiful photos even if early spring isn't the prettiest time of year.

We were very happy to have Maija as our photographer. I highly recommend her and would very much like to find an excuse to have her take photos of us again.
0 APR financing closed the deal. Friendly staff that stalk you as soon as you walk in door. Just like car salesman.  But nothing bad to say. Have to give them 5 stars.

Anytime I go to the Meridian village I have to stop in and look at my favorite jewelry. I was in their recently and loved looking around and the ladies working there were on point to offer me any help. 

I was wearing a Brighton necklace and they saw it was a little dirty and offered me a tip about how to clean it better. Loved that! 

I also had been looking for some earings with my daughters birthstone and the ladies found perfect ones right away. 

Yes their jewlery is a going to cost you, but not as much as other jewlers. I will keep adding to my Brightion collection!

We've eaten here twice...and won't return.  The service was slow but friendly.  The food was "just OK" but nothing outstanding.  The chips (with salsa and bean dip) were stale, both times we ate there.  The re-fried beans were tasteless ("blah") and "doughy" while the rice was dry (too dry), as well as tasteless; both were probably kept warm for long periods of time (until all used up).  The dessert (complimentary with the meal) was the best part!

Ordered a to go pick up, needless to say disappointed on all the rolls. We ordered 5 different ones. Minimal amount of fish was used, and the fish that was used seemed old. For the lack of fish, a lot of "junk" was used to top the rolls with a lot of rice.  The sushi was WAY overpriced for the quality. We will never be ordering sushi from here again.

It seems that we find ourselves at the Curb on occasion simply because it is convenient and we always seem to get a table.  We have finally decided that the convenient location doesn't make up for the inconsistent food. We realize that we are not at a location with 5 star dining expectations, but when you never know if your food is going to be cold, perfect or missing items, there is a problem.  We have had all three on the last few visits.   If they could get the food thing down pat, they would have it all.

I have been here for dinner and lunch and both meals were very good.  This is one of the few restaurants that serves collard greens and they are gooooood! The Sandwiches are tasty, but beware they are messy. My friend had a bacon cheeseburger and seriously needed to be hosed off afterwards.... haha just kidding. I had the tri tip sandwich. It was tender meat with BBQ sauce and coleslaw on a fresh cooked bun. I would order it again. The french fries are very crispy and salty. I like my fries that way. The kitchen is visible from the dining room and you can watch what is going on. They bake their buns fresh here and they are good. There is an interesting selection of beer on tap. Lots of beers I haven't heard of. On the night we went the bartender gave us samples until we found a beer we wanted to drink. I noticed there are lots of IPA's on tap today. The atmosphere is comfortable. There is a lot of wood. There are high tables and low tables. There are big windows behind the bar that give the place light at lunch hour. This restaurant is a little dark, but it fits the motiffe. Give this place a try, I bet you will want to go back. I do.

I love Chik Fil A plain n simple. If I order a spicy sammich, gotta get a strawberry shake to prevent heartburn the rest of the day. But seeing how thier shakes are a step above too, not a problem. For those that have never been, Chil Fil A invented the chicken sammich all the other fast food places are trying very hard to copy. But so far no one does a chicken sammich like Chik Fil A. Two tips!

1) unless its your "thing" skip the pickles they Taste  weird.
2) learn the sauces, and don't be afraid to ask for more than they hand you.

Only one complaint I have. And that is they are getting into the habit of pre cooking thier chicken. While still good, its not great! And just kind of lazy in my opinion!

Chik Fil A.....Stop pre cooking your food! We don't mind the extra wait for fresh goodness!
For the love of Pete do not eat here!!!!  The food was horrible.  We got the $20 nachos and cheese fries.  I guess that's what we get for buying food at a bowling alley.
The frys are fresh and hot. Friendly staff. My truck broke down and I waited in their place. It is 17 degrees outside and falling. A life saver.

Excellent service today. Took my iPad in because after falling on the floor it would not start up. Turns out it just needed to be reset and there was no charge. When I went to pick it up I asked about a new docking port on my iPhone. The gentleman took one look and using his tweezers removed a little ball of pocket lint. 

Thank you for fixing what was broke and nothing more!
We love visiting Lucky Fins! They are always so friendly and prompt. The food is always fresh and delicious!

Had lunch here with my husband the other day! Best service ever! Great food.  Other comments were right, lobster tots are delicious!  My husband is a picky eater but his fish and chips got a thumbs up.  We will be back!

Stopped in tonight from Seattle while visiting my aunt in Idaho. Saw the pics on Yelp and thought we would try. The Lobster trio flatbread did not disappoint and was so good, with shrimp, lobster and scallops.  The cilantro cream sauce was so yummy and it had a sweet touch with the grilled corn and onion on top.  I also had a mojito which was a nice size and good with lots of muddled mint and lime, which is how I like it! My aunt ordered Halibut fish and chips and she enjoyed it, and loved the fries as well. They looked nice and crispy not plain and bland like some can be.  Server and hostess were friendly and smiling:) The owner came over and chatted with us and thanked us for coming which was a nice touch.  I want to come back for sushi!  It looks good!

If I could give 10 stars I would! They did a wonderful job! They repaired my Tahoe after I was rear ended and had it done in 3 days! They also got me a sweet rental car. They took care of all the paper work and all of the hassle for me. The ladies there were super friendly and went above and beyond to help me and my husband understand what happens through the process with pictures to keep us in the loop. And the best part is they clean the Tahoe inside and out! I had juice stains and god knows what else from my son and boy they clean it spotless! I was so thrilled to pick it up! I would recommend them to any and everyone I know!

This is a nice little bar and grill with standard bar fare and some interesting and notable drinks.  I had a new item, the pastrami sandwich which was good, wife had mahi tacos which were very good.

Their selection of mules was an added bonus, thought that was kind of different.

Service was good, had a baby with us and they treated us no different, always a plus.

Would stop again, for lunch at least.

They deliver on their promise of quality, tasty, and quick. We went for the first time today, we both ordered the special: ham and swiss with a cup of soup, it was awesome. We both ordered the cheeseburger soup and it was flavorful, light, and comforting. The sandwich was wonderful. It was a no fuss ham with swiss, tomato, lettuce, and mayo but the ingredients could all stand on their own in quality and flavor so the sandwich was great. The staff was friendly, informative and efficient. We will be back!

Great food, if you want to watch the bartenders do shots w their favorite customers this is the place for you.  

Was great to sit and wait for a drink while they chatted with the locals, both bartenders btw.  I don't know, if I owned a bar, maybe I'd make it a priority to sell alcohol to people who wanted to buy it?  

Don't get me wrong, I'll be back because of the food, but I don't come here for the service, and we're there another option in the area, likely wouldn't come back.

Corona Village has to be HANDS DOWN the WORST Mexican Restaurant I've ever eaten at. The food was unremarkable. It had some weird flavor that I've never tasted before. I was looking for Great Mexican food and found it isn't here! I'll NEVER go back. it was Terrible!

An OK place to go if you're dieting and Hometown values has coupons for it. Bowls are basic but decent tasting, nothing that special but plenty adequate. I've only been there during lunch.  Something unusual is they play Christian rock fairly loudly.  If the owner wants to do it it's their franchise and a free country I guess.  Doesn't seem to adversely affect their business.

Amazing!  Craig and his staff are impressively professional, timely, and thorough.  They  take the time to understand your needs and go above and beyond to meet and exceed them.

I will be hiring them in the future for updates to the rest of our home and advise anyone who is searching to use them as well....you will not be disappointed!

Blok & Co is a long awaited presence in Meridian! No more driving downtown to get great coffee. They serve Form & Function coffee (Local). I would recommend the Cortado! They also have a great food menu Wednesday-Saturday from 10-1. Five stars!

On a Saturday afternoon I had called to make an appt for 2:00 at Y'lan.. they said that they had room for me to come in for a full set & my friend to get a fill. We arrived exactly on time, and the shop was completely full of customers. We still had to wait 10 mins to even sit down. Once we were sitting the lady that ended up doing my nails made me switch chairs with another customer because her electric file wasn't working.. she then put tips on one of my hands and left to work on another customers nails. I don't understand why she would tell us to come in if they didn't have enough nail techs?! Anyways, she finally came back an hour later and finished my nails within 10 mins. They looked horrible, uneven, and already looked grown off. Not to mention one of the diamonds she put on had fallen off before i even left the shop.

At this point she hadn't even started on my friends nails and we had been there for over an hour and a half. She moved my friend to another chair& some other lady started working on hers, finally... the lady filed the gel polish off, and kept filing until my friends nails started to hurt. Her nails ended up looking like crap too. And also we could hear the lady that did my nails talking crap about us to her new customer because we complained.

Never again will i go to Y'lan, they have poor service. Don't say you have room, when you don't. .. it's as simple as that.

Best soup and sandwich I have ever had. Try the buffalo chicken and get the Italian Sandwich.  Great service!!!  My wife had the chicken noodle and said it was the best broth she has ever had too.  Try the bacon dipped in chocolate for a fun after dinner snack. I am taking some soup to go!

First timers on a special day. My husband said he would hear great things about this place so we took my mom on Mothers Day ! I'm not a big seafood lover as in like fish so I order the Baja burrito with scallops and shrimp. The blend of the peppers with the sauce and shrimp/scallops was  amazing! 
My mom order the halibut w/risotto omg the risotto was awesome! You have to try the amazing Bloody Mary they serve super cool presentation ....

Went here for a quick lunch with my husband. I got the chorizo grilled cheese sandwich with a bowl of cheddar corn chowder, while hubby got the chicken salad sandwich. A short while later the chef brought our food out and told us to enjoy- one thing that I loved was that my sandwich and soup we both steaming hot, as I am a sucker for piping hot food. So I appreciated that. The corn chowder was hearty and satisfying. My chorizo grilled cheese was delicious. All in all, very well prepared and very tasty. My husband said he liked his chicken salad sandwich. I would definitely come back here again and I'm looking forward to trying more of their sandwiches and soups....I saw that they have lobster bisque... Next time...!

(Also, on a side note, I please ask that you use or buy a music source the doesn't play multiple ads during your customers dining experience. Maybe this is just a personal preference of mine, but I feel that going out to eat and then listening to advertisements while I'm eating is kind of off-putting.)

Screaming kids that run around like crazy zombies totally oblivious to other peope, what's not to love.  Hey there a lot of things to do here for the whole family.  The prices really aren't that bad for the passes.  Laser tag, they got it.  Go cart track, check.  Bowling alley, yep.  2 miniature golf courses, oh yeah!  Honestly these are some good putt putt courses.  

I reduced the stars because the food, especially  the pizza, is just awful for the prices they charge.   Plus, the last few times I've been there the staff on the floor seem to ignore the adults spending their time talking to each other.  The time I was there before none of the employee knew where one of their party rooms was.  The 4th person finally knew and honestly this room was hidden.  

If you want a place for a birthday party or just have fun it's a good place to go.

We love going to Steve's Café because we really like the food.  My favorite is the biscuits and gravy.  I have never found a time to go that wasn't very busy, with a long wait.  If you find that magic time, let me know.  We usually wait 20-40 minutes for a table.  The staff was friendly, and usually are.  They may seem a bit slow or overwhelmed, at times.  I attribute this to how busy this place usually is; I'm not sure the crew gets much of a break.  The prices are good.  There is nice variety and we have never had a bad meal.

Moved to Idaho less than a month ago and have been here twice. The grilled Gouda is possibly the best grilled cheese sandwich I've ever had. Today I have the potato leek soup which was delicious(I liked this better than the tomato soup I had last time). 

It's a family-owned business, and you can tell. They were all very knowledgeable and eager to help us!

Hmmmm, Harry's  Hideaway was terrible.  The waitress was awful, the service was sloooow & the food doesn't make up for it.  We had a French dip, chicken wings & a taco salad.  The food was average at best.  The wings had to come from a baby chicken at $2.00 a piece.  The French dip was dry, the taco salad was lacking.  The music was so loud you couldn't converse.  We won't be back!!!!!!!

Some of the BEST Wings in town, and the FRY Sauce is one of my Favorites too!  Always a FUN place to eat and have a cocktail or Cold Beer!  Bloody Mary's Sundays with some Football always a Great start to the day!
I go here frequently for gel manicures and pedicures! The service is friendly, and they do a good job for the price.  The chairs are comfy and the salon is clean.

No stars would be the best for this. After confirming three times that my order would be delivered on a specific date and having a delivery person confirm, a sales person changed the delivery date, WITHOUT my authorization, because part of the order would be there the next day.  Who cares?! I paid the delivery charge, deliver again the next day! The bulk of my order was delayed AFTER I confirmed three times!!!  And, so far no compensation for my wasted day waiting on them to deliver an order I wasn't going to get on the day I specifically scheduled. If time constraints allowed, I would cancel my whole order and go somewhere else. This is NOT the kind of customer service I like, especially when I spent quite a bit of money at this place.
The most amazing donuts ever! 10 stars!! Light and fluffy and yummy! The employees are really helpful, and sometimes throw in a few free donut holes! These are the best donuts I have ever had!

This is a true coffee lovers coffee shop. The menu is brief, but exactly what you'd expect to find in a shop that focuses on quality technique and ingredients. I had a cappuccino, and stayed long enough to also enjoy a cortado. The locally sourced coffee was excellent, but the baristas technique with perfectly pulled shots made it sing. I also sampled a pecan roll, and found it to be delicious.

Went to the one in Meridian on a slow day and it was still busy. Great atmosphere and clean place. The building is beautiful and the owner is very welcoming and comes around to check on customers' overall content. For it being a seafood joint, and having ordered five orders and alcoholic drinks, we were expecting it be over a $100 but to our surprise it was around $70, which was so great! 

The food, omg, is so delicious. The best seafood we've ever had. I ordered fish and chips and it was all fish with thin batter and their sauces are all made there and have their own unique taste to it. It's definitely a wonderful place and we will be returning customers absolutely. My husband loved their coconut shrimp and me not being a fan of shrimp, I ate all the variety shrimps on the table. My father had the linguine and as soon as he got it, it was all gone and devoured lol. You won't be disappointed here. Best blue moon my husband has ever had too he says. My kids got the popcorn shrimp and even that was so fancy and delicious!

We have heard several times about the all you can eat crab on Wednesday and Sunday so we decided to go on Sunday. The food and service was excellent, the only problem was that I couldn't eat any more of the all you can eat crab .

Love everything about the place except their identity crisis. Are they a bar/restaurant or a dance club?? Music was so loud the the patrons were practically shouting which made it impossible to have any conversation. Good thing the salad was so good but bring ur ear plugs!!!

I am somewhat conflicted. The Curb is so close to my house that I could just about throw a baseball from my deck and hit the place and so I really really want to love this place. But I can't. The Curb is so convenient but so...average. 

Drink prices are fair but not great though their drink specials are pretty well priced. Their beer selection is okay but again, not outstanding and nothing you can't get at similar establishments. The food is your standard pub fare and nothing amazing. Last time I was there I had their Black and Blue Burger. It was good. I asked for fries with it and mysteriously it appeared with tater tots but no big deal, I am cool with tots. I went at lunchtime and my food came in a pretty timely manner. My service was also acceptable but not great. 

To summarize, if you live near the Curb it is a decent neighborhood watering hole with food and drink on par with similar places. That being said, I wouldn't travel great distances to come here. While handy for me, the Curb is an extremely average restaurant/bar.

The only reason this got one star was because the food was so good. That's it. We ordered drinks, beer, soda and a Bloody Mary. The Bloody Mary arrived 10 minutes after all the other drinks. Everything we asked for seemed like a huge inconvenience. My drink was empty and I asked for another one and had to wait at least 10 minutes for that. Once we finished eating we asked to split the check. She brought them back. And they were wrong so i explained what was wrong, she left and came back and i explained to her again. Then she brought them back and they were still wrong. When we had asked for our checks we ordered another beer that we ended up having to get from the bar ourselves. As we were closing out she confronted the table behind us as to why they only tipped her $1. Terrible. So terrible. Super disappointed in the service and doubt we will ever go back.
Always the best price and best service!  My favorite store in town!  Sign up and get emails for an even better discount!
$6 for 3 draft beers at happy hour... place was empty and free pool... down side was they allow smoking inside...

Great friendly staff! Service was quick for getting new trailer tires, Towmax STR ii. Front counter staff was knowledgeable and service tech was helpful with loading and unloading the trailer tires from out of my truck.  I dropped off the tires and they were ready in a couple of hours. Will come back when I need tires again.

Good tasting pizza but every time I order from Dominos, not just this store but all over the US, they always forget something, wether it be sauce for wings, marinara for bread sticks or icing for the cinnamon sticks. They have 30+ minutes to get the order ready, there's no excuse to forget something, they have plenty of time to double/triple check the order. They're always willing to bring the sauce back but by the time they get here it's another 30 minutes and by then everything's cold. You shouldn't order deliver from this place unless you're too drunk to come pick it up, because they'll most likely forget something... the only reason I'm giving 3 stars and not 1 or 2 is because the manager Chris made it right by sending out a new order of wings and making sure it was right this time!

We had a late dinner here on Friday night.  We showed up about 7:30 and there was still about a 20-30 minute wait for a table.  The bar (which is small) was packed and there really is no waiting area so everyone was crowded by the front door which was a little awkward.  Luckily a spot opened shortly at the bar where we were able to get a couple cocktails and ordered an appetizer of calamari while we waited for our table. 

Lots of menu choices here and the prices are decent for seafood.  The calamari appetizer we had was good.  All rings, no tentacles which was odd but they were cooked well.  The sauce that came with them was nothing special.  Tasted just like mayonnaise.  My husband and I decided to order the crab and shrimp steamer platter for two.  It started off with a salad which was really big for a just a dinner salad.  Nice greens and cute bowls they were served in.  Then out came our platter........Wow, lots of flavor and the crab although messy and time consuming to eat was well worth the elbow grease.  The shrimp that came with the dish were big and cooked just right.  There was also andouille sausage in the dish but I have to say the sausage was super salty and pretty inedible.  Then to top the dish off, there was a pound of fries on top which was an added bonus!  All of that for just $40, what a deal!  

The restaurant itself is on the small side.  There is a bar above the restaurant that was playing music that you could hear downstairs in the restaurant which was also playing music so needless to say it was just noise all around.  The restaurant should have turned off their music to at least not compete with the sound coming from upstairs.  The service was really good and the staff was friendly.  We didn't get to the dessert menu but it looked inviting.  This place is pretty affordable for fresh seafood.
Blok and Co is my go to for homework all day everyday. The baristas are wonderful, the coffee is great and the environment is the best.

When we first walked in our expectations were pretty low. It was later at night and it looked a bit run down. But the staff there were incredibly friendly and the burgers were amazing. I highly recommend getting the mac and cheese for a side. It's small in portion but it's absolutely delicious. I got the Hawaiian style burger and the ingredients were fresh and it was very flavorful.  We're definitely going there again.

My daughter and I had breakfast here and really enjoyed it.  They have a varied menu with nice combinations and lighter fare I'd you prefer that.

Hash browns are really great as were the biscuits and gravy.  Daughter had a chicken apple sausage which we huge but delicious

Like the family feel it has and enjoyed the service and food.  Great alternative to your chain greasy spoons around town.

Would definitely return and look forward to it on my next trip to Boise!

Steve's is one of the best breakfast places in town, especially for us gluten free folks. First of all, this place gets busy! On the weekends from about 8:00am on, there is a wait but its usually quick and well worth it. The menu has all of the traditional breakfast fare with the addition of unique items such as elk burgers for lunch and pumpkin pancakes during the holiday season. For the gluten free crowd, the gluten free pancakes are top notch. The traditional, Huckleberry and pumpkin varieties are all delicious (pumpkin is only available during November, boo!). Everything else I've ordered is just top notch, made with high-quality ingredients including their coffee, crisp and hearty bacon, homemade sausage (the apple chicken is the best) and fresh omelets. The service is excellent, like a well-oiled machine-- all of the wait staff are friendly and efficient. Get to Steve's for some down-home comfort food!
great donuts! friendly staff!! The best part is they fill your filled donuts when you order them. Will be returning soon

The staff here is beyond nice--they go out of their way to be friendly and helpful, and if you're looking for something they're willing to drop everything to help you find it. They actually bag groceries well enough that things don't end up smashed, and take their time to help you to your car if you need it.
While the prices aren't great, their products are wonderful quality. The produce has been very fresh and I haven't bought a bad piece of fruit yet. I'm always impressed by the size of their apples, and they've got a fun variety of exotic produce like lychees, dragon fruit, cherimoya, and other hard to find goods.
The natural foods department here has things that are hard to find anywhere else, including Whole Foods. The body care section has a full range of products to try as well, and a good variety of herbal supplements. 
While I stick to Winco for staples due to their lower prices, I really want to support Rosauers because I'm so impressed with their customer service and commitment to superior food products. Winco also doesn't treat their employees very well, but the staff at Rosauers has said they feel they're compensated and treated fairly, which is important to me.
I once bought a package of pancake mix that turned out to have been cut open. When I contacted the manager, he insisted I bring it back so he could give me a refund. He was incredibly kind and apologetic. I get the sense they value their customers very much.

I really wanted to like this place. Its so close to our house and the first time we went there, I had the best hash browns I have ever tasted. Really.

However our most recent experience was not so great. We were a table of 3. One person was 5 minutes away (we verified by text and didn't just say that) We asked if we could be seated before the arrival of the third person in our party as the restaurant was getting busy and we made a special effort to get there early on a Sunday. (oh joy)

The person at the front (the owner I believe) was adamant about not seating us until the third person in our party showed up. I get why restaurants do this. A huge party comes in and with not everyone there, they take up valuable tables. 

Logic people..there are three of us! We will not take up valuable space and I was not kidding when we said 5 minutes away.

Once we sat down, we ordered our food and the server was very nice and prompt. Our food came out quickly and she had a wonderful energy...the only good thing about this place at this point.

The food was disappointing. My eggs came out too runny (i asked for over medium) The english muffin was barely toasted so it tasted like a gluey mess with the butter. The hash browns were not the hash browns I tasted the first time we went here. They were oily and soggy. A shame because I think they once had the best hash browns in town..and I love my hash browns :)

My mother in law enjoyed her stuffed french toast. However I was surprised at how small the portion was. Granted I think portions these days are way too big. However in this case , I would say the portion was too small.

Unfortunately we won't be back. The demeanor of the person in charge of seating together with the food made this experience a negative one.

Highly recommend Mo Jos in Meridian...great food, great service. It does get very busy with lines out the door so get there before 9 am on the weekends.

If you have to buy appliances here, go somewhere else. Their sales team is great. Because they know how to sell a product. But RC Willeys' installation and repair (yes, a brand new dryer already needing a repair because of the installation). After spending the kind of money we just spent on the washer and dryer, you expect great service. My recommendation to potential buyers: be aware.

Pretty good grub and very decent comfort food when looking for a Mexi-spot to enjoy with the fam... Very nice portions, cheesy, not too greasy like some joints... Friendly staff... attentive...
After a big meal, nice treat at the end... the mug o'suds was bigger than my pint sized daughter...
Good experience... They've been around for quite a while... for good reasons...
They even honored my coupon with no strange faces made when I presented... Hey, we go out and eat lots... So I have a coupon for a partaaaay of 5.

Fresh fresh fresh!! I've recently discovered and become a fan of this little, delicious donut shop. The service is always very friendly and welcoming and they seem to have sample donut holes available every time I'm here. The donuts are SO delicious and sweet and fluffy, that I've been back more times than I'd like to admit. Every donut I've tried is very tasty, but I've found I keep coming back to the perfect glazed. I love Krispy Kremes, but I will ALWAYS choose this place over there now because of the great price, the generous owner, the sweet customer service and the phenomenally fresh donuts. Not to mention, I feel better about supporting a local business rather than a chain. I love this little place and hope it stays open for the long haul!

I ordered several martinis...straight up and dry...yet they were sweet.  We also ordered the nachos with carne asada and they came meatless without the proper toppings that come with it.  We also ordered wings and never received them.  We were there to watch Encore (the cover band) play and they were great. I highly recommend seeing them play!  I really wanted to like this place but it was seriously lacking.  I always give a place 2 tries so maybe next time they will get there game straight!

I was lucky to have an excellent lunch here with my friends.  the service top notch, our meals came out quickly, and our drinks never went dry.  the creamy, roasted poblano soup was delicious, even though slighty under-seasoned, but nothing a sprinkle of salt and pepper couldn't fix.   the Japanese salad was top notch with sushi grade  raw ahi and salmon bites, shrimp, and edemame on top of a bed of rice and mixed greens drizzled with a refreshing citrusy, teriyaki like ponzu dressing.  the salad was  filling yet lite  and didn't leave you feeling grossly stuffed  nor still hungry, a perfect balance.   prices felt slightly high for lunchtime but  the food quality with its  fresh flavors and great service helped make up for it.  will definitely return for another great experience.

As always, great service, great food and I'll be coming back.  The gang here was fast and the service makes you feel as if it's a sit down restaurant. Not sure how they do it but the service is solid and as stated before, definitely coming back!

On impulse we stopped here for lunch today with our two young sons. We tried 4 different savory and a cheesy one and they were all good. Staff were very friendly. The restaurant was very clean too which is always a plus. Glad we stopped and can't wait to go back!

This place rates right up there (or down there) with the used car lots we so hate! Their products are over priced and less appealing from what one could find on the Target or Walmart website. Yes, over priced! The same couch we found here was $500 less at another business. The worst thing is that not one sales person acknowledged us and there was a group of 5 talking to each other right inside the damn front door! If that's how they do business I wonder how they stay in business. Oh yeah, over priced shit!

Was very disappointed with our last visit. We had a coupon and it said one per person on it. We had 9 people in our party and everyone paid their own bill. Because someone else also had a coupon, they would not let us use ours. They said one per table. I will not be going back to that location! Very rude service. So sad because I like their food.

Got my order wrong 3 times after I had paid cash for a $4000 couch!!! Couch was damaged 2 times and wrong items on 2 of their 3 visits to my home. Also the manufacturer did a poor job of putting this couch together. The buttons were installed backwards.
Best pastries I've had. Home cooked taste. Fresh and hot. Wonderful owners with great conversation. Quaint place to sit and drink some hot coffee and fill your belly with sweetness.

We just recently moved to Meridian & literally live right behind this place. My family & I decided to try it out for dinner tonight. Overall we really liked it. The music is a little loud & today, was not appropriate for kids, even through there were several in the place. A lot of F-bombs being dropped. My 11 yr old wasn't impressed with that. My hubby got the black & blue burger & loved it. He also liked the selection of beer but would've liked a list to look at because there are so many. My daughter got the chipotle chicken salad & really liked it. I got the puffy tacos. They were not "puffy" at all but were very delicious. I also got the raspberry Corona, loved it & I'm not a beer drinker at all! We'll definitely be back. Great place that's walking distance for some Mommy & Daddy time :)

What a great little place in Boise. The food is only outdone by the selection. That said both are great! It's inexpensive and the ladies that take your order are friendly. A empanada is like a hot pocket but don't let that description decide for you they are deep-fried yummyNess. Try them  out!! And they're cheap too!

Full disclosure: A decade ago, I worked in the produce department here. Sometimes, I secretly wish I still did. l had a spectacular time carefully stacking loose potatoes into comically tall and precarious spud monuments, and can still pick a damn fine cantaloupe. But, for the record, that emotional baggage has no impact on this review. Because, as always, I'm really only here to talk about the donuts.

And speaking of donuts, they have decent ones here. They're better supermarket donuts than anything you'd get on the East Coast, though I recommend sticking to the raised donuts with hilarious candy toppings and steering clear of typical mainstays like the apple fritters (dry and emaciated) and the old-fashioneds (not fried or frosted enough).

My red velvet cake donut was so good! No cream cheese feature. Didn't need it. A simple, well made cake donut with a delicious light icing. Then I tried a bite of all the others. Yum! Yum! I'm feeling sick from all the sugar...

When my bike tire hits a goat head in the middle of a ride out in BFE, these guys are johnny-on-the-spot with friendly flat repair.  I've been stranded out this way on my bike a few times.  And no, I don't want to add the weight of self-sealing tubes or a repair kit to my bike. Call me Spartan.  Or masochistic.  I love the pain of being stranded.  

But not really.   That's why I love the super friendly and helpful staff here at Idaho Mountain Touring.  Good selection of bikes and accessories.  May not be as cheap as Walmart or F Meyer, but at least you can get expert help!

Went in on Friday evening hoping to miss the after-work crowd, still quite a few people but was able to get a seat outside and enjoy part of our drinks and food before the Idaho winds forced us in. 
Burgers are great, the wings are typical but I really liked the fry sauce with the horseradish in it. Drink was Margarita and they were not to good, no blender, Had two and still didn't have a buzz
Go see Lori she is awesome & so helpful!!!! Every time we go there we get hugs from Lori, she knows exactly what we are looking for!!!!! I always walk out with more than I planned!!!!

Fantastic Hidden Gem!!  The service was familial and genuine. The food is flavorful and made with great quality ingredients.. I came here off another yelpers review and had the Reuben sandwich (knife & fork style since I'm on the Keto diet ATM) and the Buffalo Chicken soup.  They both tasted delicious.  Although, they are known for they're unique grilled cheeses, so one day I'll have to make a cheat trip!  Thank you so much for the great food & great experience.  
Although on a side note, This would be a 5 star experience with real flatware & cutlery.  I don't like coming to sit and eat and have to use plastic.  
But honestly, you guys are doing an incredible job!  Can't wait to come

What an unexpected treat to find truly authentic Argentine cuisine in Nampa, Idaho.  The empanadas are the fried style (not baked) and contain a generous portion of meat.  1 or 2 is perfectly adequate for a meal.  The owner is very nice and clearly puts her heart into the food.

STAY AWAY!!!
The evening of 02/12/2017 - Just in case the owner cares enough to figure out who the obnoxious bar tender is.

A friend and I went for a few drinks and dinner.  We ate at the bar.  It became obvious very quickly that the bar tender was only paying attention to the regulars and ignored us and a couple of others who I assume were also not regulars.

The bar tender would be very nice to the regulars and ignore others.  When she would manage to attend to others she was rude and acted as if it was an imposition to help.  
She would say as few words as possible, if anything.  Never a smile or even a "you're welcome" when thanked.  

When not tending to regulars or ignoring others the bar tender spent 90% of her time talking to a friend seated at the end, closest to the server station.  


I assume the owner doesn't care or has no clue what happens in his place.  It's owners like this guy that will later say "gee, why did I go out of business, I thought everything was fine?"
While paying no attention to what is happening.  

Suggestion to the owner.  Use an undercover patron and get real feedback.  I guarantee  you will be shocked at what you learn.

I love this place! Great instructors go the extra mile to make sure your doing things right.  I have also had 90 minute massages here and both were great!  They give you your first class for free and offer a nice discount your first month.  The clientele is great... everyone makes you feel at home :)
Love this place. Always cheap, and the staff is very friendly. When I'm not eating sushi, I head over to this taco bell.
Really good seafood at reasonable prices. I will defiantly be going back. Good services. the drinks are also priced well.

I had the lucky platter, not bad but a bit on the greasy side and over cooked. To bad cause the coleslaw was very good and the dipping sauce trio made the platter. Overall not bad but there's room for improvement.
Exceptional food! Slower service, they are always very busy. Popular place on Saturday mornings.

I took my family here on a recommendation of their "awesome sushi". If your looking for a sushi bar THIS ISNT IT!! They have a few rolls and a couple nigiri options. I asked for white rice which at ANY other sushi place would be?? steamed white rice! NOPE... we were served the cold sushi rice they use to make the rolls with. Now some who have not eaten at many sushi places might say.. AHH rice is rice , stop your complaining. EXCEPT.... It was as if they had mixed uncooked rice with half cooked rice to compensate for too much initial water resulting in part of the rice being mushy and part of it being hard and uncooked. That would be bad enough but they used the same batch of half cooked rice to make the rolls which resulted in a texture resembling rice crispy treats dipped in mayonnaise. Which I guess I could forgive if the salmon had a even a semblance of firmness as fresh sushi grade salmon should. Instead the salmon reminded me of the flsh I would pull from a day old carp as a boy to use as cat fish bait. I have had high quality sushi grade salmon and while it is buttery and does tend to "melt" in your mouth that is a far cry from the mushy excuse offered up as salmon nigiri here. Also order was the fish and chips. While it wasnt the dismal failure the rice and sushi were it certainly didnt leave me with a sense of quality or money well spent. It was more like eating yet one more MRE after 15 days of the same. It provided nourishment but really was more of a chore than a pleasure. The cod used to make the battered fish lacked any flavor, yes I know cod is a mild and gentle flavored fish thats why they batter it, Thats also why they flavor the batter.  At the end of the day I wrote the whole meal off as a learning experience. I learned there is one place in town I will NEVER return to again..

We were traveling through town and Soup Kettle Grill came up as Gluten-Free.... not only do they have GF bread, the soups are also ALL Gluten-Free, even the Lobster Bisque we had! Great taste and fresh made food! Thank you!

My wife and I eat at Soup Kettle Grille about once a week. The staff is always friend and the soups and sandwiches are always so fresh and incredibly tasty. 

I highly recommend the Chicken Buffalo soup or Chicken Salad Sandwich. Or both!!

Best yoga studio I have ever attended. My love for the practice is truly being inspired by Liz and the fantastic teachers she has here. Having this studio and these teachers in my life daily makes me such a better mother, wife, and all around human being. I love how strong I feel after the classes here and love how they are sculpting my body. They truly teach you how to engage your entire body in every movement to get maximum results from your practice. The level of technique that is taught and the assistance and attentiveness the teachers are willing to give is wonderful. Stop thinking about joining Body Calm and come today! You will never regret it! Improve your life now!

Love the great range of organic products, beer and wine, and huge range of grocery items. I don't find them that expensive - probably on a par with Albertson's, but the service is stellar. Buy a lot and they will take your purchases out to your car for you and load them in. Can't find anything? Just ask and someone will always help you. I wish all supermarkets were like this - they certainly know what service is.
I freakin love me some chick fil a! I get the number 1 with chick fil a sauce and an Arnold Palmer to drink :) Shout out to my girl Emily Lange for doing an awesome job there marketing!

After a visit yesterday I have to downgrade my original review of 5 stars.  The staff are still extremely friendly and the food is great but their prices are $2 higher than most other breakfast joints.  When people (and probably their employees) are making minimum wage, who can afford to pay $11 for a veggie omelet.  I perused their menu and a lot of other dishes were $15.  Simply outrageous.  Will probably not be back.

Been here twice and the seafood was very good. It is expensive and the drinks are expensive. Not good for the retired folks. Service was a little slow but the food was worth it. We need more seafood restaurants in this area.
Music too damn loud, but excellent food and service. Planked salmon, loaded mashed and veggies exceptional. Key lime pie great. Attentive service from Jonathan.

It's decent Mexican, but service was subpar. They combined our orders onto one check without asking how we wanted it, failed to refill my Pepsi so I sat there thirsty for 10 minutes. Sorry, can't recommend.
I don't know what was worse, the fajitas or the old fashioned. They were both easily the worst I've ever had. Easily. It gets two stars because the service was friendly and prompt, and it was clean.

On our way from Seattle to Las Vegas and stopped in for a quick lunch.  Absolutely delicious.  The lemon empanada was AMAZING. The staff were delightful.  We are traveling with a small dog and had to place our order in shifts.  They were accommodating and very kind.  Highly recommend!!
