ZERO ZERO!!!  Absolutely TERRIBLE!!  1-1/2 hour delivery time.  No receipt with order.  Missing sides.  Cold as ice.  Store would not answer phone to talk to manager after 10+ calls.  Had to contact corporate call center.  Would not negotiate without being directed from supervisor to supervisor.  Refused to refund and resend the order.  Really???   Furious!!  Will never order Pizza Hut again.  Please feel free to contact me Pizza Hut to discuss.  I will be adamantly spreading my dislike until you make it right....

My husband and I agree, jury is still out for this restaurant.  Will go a couple more times.

Food:  Had Sushi so I don't know if it's fair to rate them on this.  Don't go for the sushi.  Husband had shrimp but no sides came with it considering it was $12/13 thought that was odd but he liked it.
Service:  Very Prompt, got seated right away but went at 530-6. 
Atmoshere:  Trendy but loud
Price:  Three people, no alcohol, including tip $55.

 From a kids point of view:  (my eleven year old)
I liked the adult size sea food enchilada and corn but I did not like the rice.   I agree with my parents I would like to go back a couple more times.   I would like to try the shark too.

Never going back to this place... Manager came screaming and cursing at everyone, was completely unprofessional, and to top it off the pizza was greasy and not anything I would want to come back for. Don't listen to the manager's friends posting on here with their 5-star reviews, that band had no reason to be kicked out that night and that was not the first time I've seen Slyce in a terrible light. I've tried it multiple times and it literally gets worse every time, food-wise and management-wise. Get it together.

Okay experience overall. We were there during happy hour. We had calamari, Kobe beef tacos and mahi mahi tacos. The calamari was good, but the sauce was meh. The tacos were good, but I felt the happy hour deals weren't much of a deal for the amount of food provided. We also had a glass of wine and a beer, the beer was $1 cheaper than the regular price, the wine was full price because it wasn't their house wine. The waitress was polite and professional. The atmosphere was nice, but the music was a little too loud.

Wanted to try something new, environment was fun, enjoyed several games and liked the large patio. Decor is fun. The food was average, not bad at all just not real exciting. I had tacos and the chips that came with them were pretty stale. Great beer selection and good bar options. Service was fine, not over the top but we were not ignored either. We will probably go back on a big game day.

I like Charlie had a shocking price experience. First I was there on opening day and you could see all the prices and then on my second visit half were taped over so you didn't know exactly what you were getting into ,but come on its donuts. One dozen mixed with a few fancies came to $23 ,I could never had  imagined that I could have spent that much but because there was a line behind and my daughter beside me I paid but never again. I can get almost double the amount for a max of $$16 at Country Donuts and are much better ,the only problem is that they are about 20 minutes away and this place is about 7 minutes . I guess I'll be back to DK in Meridian when time is a factor and it to is a much better bang for the buck around  $$13-15  and when time allows County Donuts on 5 mile and Overland

Placed my order two hours ago and am still waiting for my order. An hour and a half in I called to cancel and she told me there was no way to track my order or see if it had already left. Then she offered $2 off. Gee. Thanks. I'll never order from here again.
Great service, great beer, the food was okay but could use some improvement. I had the fajitas and had to ask for more tortillas

Lucky Fins is the best seafood place we have ate at in Boise!  We had the mahi  black and bleu burger, mahi tacos, stuffed crab mushroom burger, and the scallop enchiladas.  The four of us traded portions with each other and none of these items disappointed!  And as a bonus, they gave my wife a free triple chocolate cake for her birthday!  I have no complaints about the restaurant, the food, or the service!  Thanks again Erik!

I found the fish tacos mostly lacking fish.  The taste was fine, but the fish got lost in the cabbage &salsa and such.   We tried the crab stuffed mushrooms, but what we found was a tasteless paste inside a fried mushroom.  The sauce and Cheese shreds that came with it were far batter that the stuffed mushrooms themselves, so while the mushrooms were a disappointment, it wasn't horrible either.


My wife had Fish & Chips with fried Shrimp, The fish was a disappointment; very greasy , but the shrimp was the best thing we tried so far. the fries were double-fried and crispy, very good.  One surprise:  I tried the apple cole slaw that came with the fish & chips, and was pleasantly surprised.  Apple sounded like an odd choice for cole slaw and I half expected giant slices of apple in a traditional slaw, but the slaw was very light, not as drippy-creamy as standard slaw and the apple slivers mixed in made the flavor a standout winner.  This made for a very mixed plate: sad fish, but excellent fries, slaw & shrimp.

Overall, we were not overly impressed with the food.  To be sure, there were a few standout items, but it seemed excessively hit-and-miss.

Basically, we've had better seafood locally and Lucky Fins provided nothing special in that direction, but the service was indeed excellent. (otherwise it would have been 2 stars at best)

My husband and I ate breakfast here this week. The food was good and the portion size was large. I had an entree that included an Italian sausage that is made in house from an old family recipe. High quality sausage with little fat an no chewy gristle. The hashbrowns were done to a golden crisp but soft on the inside. Scramble eggs done perfectly, not slimy and runny or brown. HUGE coffee mugs with speedy refills. My husband had pancakes that were hot, fluffy and tender. I only gave this 4 stars because the price point is a dollar or two higher per entree than other restaurants similar to Steve's. We will be back.

We took a friend from the East coast to the curb. He travels all over the U.S. and said this is one of his favorite place to eat and visit with friends. Every time he comes to town we meet there and have dinner followed up with cocktails and cigars on the patio.   The owner is very pro military and donates to the VFW. That alone is a good reason to go there.
Amazing burgers and beer!  They have so many different beers, fun to try new drinks.  The burgers are thick and juicy.  Definitely recommend trying this place if you haven't been there.

Today we actually decided to try food instead of just their delicious ice cream options. I order the finger steaks and my son ordered a double bacon cheeseburger. Both my finger steaks and the cheeseburger were delicious. Tender and juicy. Bacon was not over cooked. Only reason I did not give it 5 stars is because I felt like the price of the finger steaks were a bit on the high side for not coming with a side.
Quent and his crew are the best. Fast accurate service. Extremely helpful.  Great quality. They make window treatments easy and affordable and the after you buy service is A+. Thank you.

Myself, my mom and my sister had a fabulous first visit to this store today! We had never been in before and so therefore didn't really know what the store was all about. Being typical girls out and about though we had to check out everything in the store and man was it fun! They have such a great variety of fun products! The staff was very helpful too, they checked in on us but werent  overly pushy. If we had any questions on anything like a "shampoo bar" for example they were glad to tell us all about them and what ones might be best for our hair. We ended up buying some bath fizzies, some bath bars and some shaving lotion for my husband. I can't wait to go back and buy a fancy soap for my guest bath!

Its so much fun there. Sometimes it can get too crowded on some days especially tuesdays and they get pretty busy but its still worth the money you pay. When my little girl gets older i will having her birthday here

After a mis-communication between the Sales Floor and Merchandise Pickup, Adam from Customer Service promptly contacted me as a result of my two star review here on Yelp and he and Kim solved the confusion over the missing box spring to the set I purchased.  Kudos to Adam and Kim.

"My pleasure".... Have you heard that before?? 
This is becoming a real trademark to the Chick-fil-A chain. I love that they are bringing back great customer service and appreciation. 
You can't beat a great Chick-fil-A sandwich, nuggets, or their delicious lemonade, but top it off with great customer service, and it rounds out your perfect meal.
Here's a little delicious tip, Mix barbecue sauce with mayo and stir it all together to dip your waffle fries in!  You're welcome Friends!!

For the money hard to beat. I always call in the order so it's just ready when I get there. Backfires once in a whole but works for the most part. Crew is generally high school aged kids, pleasant but still learning social/ customer service skills. Once the messed up out two orders of hot wings and besides the hassle of having to go back in cold weather the mgr fixed the issue right away.

Our friends raved about this place. So we went for my birthday. Great food for the price! So friendly the owner even came out and chatted with us as we left. He remembered our friends.  They even came and put a sombrero on my head and made the whole restaurant sing to me and gave me free sopapillas.  It was very clean restaurant.  I ate the Camarrones Jalisco. They also brought out a large platter of beans, rice, lettuce, salsa, guacamole, sour cream.  It was fabulous!  My husband had the Carne Asada Burrito he said delicious. It was very large. We left stuffed! Will definately be back. Don't let the outside of the restaurant scare you away.

This place use to be great. Good food and good service. BUT I went back in recently and the service was horrible. Bartenders left empty glasses in front of people even after looking at them. Slow slow bar service on drinks. Saying that there were a few bartenders who kicked ass and were good. Took care of people and got drinks out quick. The bartender named LAUREN was amazing. Loosing almost all the good bartenders and servers killed this place.
Food is decent, but you have to wait forever to get it. When I asked about the delay, the girl was completely unapologetic. There are better places.

We've been here twice now, both times on a Saturday afternoon.  Had a burger the first time.  The burger was good but it was not cooked the way I requested.  I asked for medium and it was definitely well done.  I had a bacon bloody mary, which was good, and a scooner of blue moon.  The beer is ice cold and soooo good.  Came back a second time and had the pork omelet.  That was alright, too.  The food isn't gourmet but does the trick when you're hungover.  Had the pepper bloody mary this time and another blue moon.  My cousin's love the club sandwich here.  The service is just ok.  Both times we have been the servers have messed up something with our orders.

Was recommended this place for sushi. It is not a sushi restaurant. It's a bar&grill with usual fare. The sushi is very very limited. I did very much like the poke bowl which was unique with lettuce and various other greens and a very good sauce. Higher end than Chili's et al but not really trendy like Bardenay for example.

Not our first visit, music was good, loud, but good. Service was slow, but we were not in a hurry. Hubby likes the beer options, food generally okay.

Tonight I had the Halibut and Chips, not good at all! Could only eat one piece before getting a tummy ache and when we got home I got diarrhea! I'm never ordering that again!

I am new to spin and was worried about being packed into a room of experienced cyclists, techno music, and judgy eyes lol. I was definitely hesitant to take the class however, like most challenges I took the bull by the horns. This place is awesome, upscale, modern, clean, well staffed, and grounded in delivering and exceptional workout experience.

Upon meeting my friend outside before class entered and were greeted by a very nice woman who directed us to several touch screen monitors that allowed us to "check in", and also gave us our bike numbers and a layout of the cycling room we would be in. 

After that we were shown where the restrooms, showers, and lockers were located. All of which is white and modern. Very very clean with upscale products from shampoo to moisturizer, all free as part of your ride. 

The woman then helped us select out spin shoes which clip into the pedals on the bike. Sure enough they had my size 14 wide (I am 6'6") and I was not looking forward to cramming into a 12 or something small. She showered us how to properly fit the shoes and then offered us a free BPA free Cyclebar water bottle and asked if we preferred chilled, or room temperature water. At this point I was already super impressed.

We were then guided to the spin room, shown where our bikes were and the young woman assisted us in clipping our shoes into the pedals on our bikes. She gave brief but precise instruction on the digital equipment on the bike and adjusted everything from seat height to resistance for us. Then the class begin to fill up and our instructor Gonzalo pepped us up with some great music and class started.

It was such an intense but totally doable ride for anyone of any fitness level. The instructor made it clear that if we felt we were pushing too hard (or might injure ourselves) to take it easy and focus on ourselves, our bodies, and not what everyone else around us was doing. 

The instructor was so encouraging and fun, you could feel good vibes coming from him and it was clear he loves what he does. His positive attitude was infectious and very fun. It was an amazing workout.

Afterwards we were offered cooling wipes to clean our bikes and then damp, rolled, lavender scented towels to wipe our faces or hands with, and then, a glass of champagne in honor of the instructors last class. I was told on Wednesdays that beer and wine are offered in the gorgeous lobby post ride as part of Cyclebars wine down Wednesday.

If I could give this place 50 stars I would. I was wow'd by every single amenity and piece of the whole experience. Some may balk at the single class rate but if you purchase a package, and given the level of the experience it is WELL WORTH it. 

I cannot wait to go again! It was that amazing!
Soooo your driver cuts me off, almost causing a wreck, I honk, then she proceeds to flip me off, for the next mile. Way to represent the business.

I don't mind spending money for food especially good food. This in no way qualifies as good food. If you are specializing in one genre of food make sure it's good and not Canned. Canned chile relenos are not good. The taco resembled a taco johns taco which he fine if I was spending taco John prices.  Hoping  to actually find an authentic Mexican food restaurant in the area.  Only redeeming factor margarita was okay but not really. Service wasn't anything to write home about either. I kinda like a smile or friendliness thrown in the mix somewhere. So all and all, skip it, save your money.

I did not have a good experience here. The decor is super dated and cluttered. The waitress was young and uninterested in customer service. The fish and chips were ridiculous. The fish was so thin and flat they looked like children's chicken strips. They were dry and flakey they were so overcooked. Guess I was expecting another Spuds experience. Certainly not. Disappointing for Queen Anne.

Trax Customs is a locally owned and operated car audio/video installation facility, and a bit more.  In Boise, owner Travis Etchart, has converted his residential garage into a top-notch professional installation center.  From the very moment that I met Travis and walked into his work space, I felt at ease.  His installation environment is clean and professionally organized, and Travis himself is a very good communicator with many skill sets.  Trax Customs is legally registered with the State of Idaho and is an on-going business concern

The project I had brought Trax Customs on Sept 11, 2012 was very basic.  Remove an OEM stock system from a 2000 Toyota Corolla and install a new receiver/deck with a power amp and 4 speakers, on budget.  On average, local area competitors wanted about 35 to 60% more money when quoting their labor price for this same job.
 
I supplied Trax Customs with all the components and most all of the required hardware.  But if you'd prefer avoiding the challenge of chasing down the endless details of product acquisition, Trax can do it for you.  Upon inspecting the work I found the attention to detail to be meticulous, matching or exceeding my expectations.  Many years ago I supervised one of the largest installation facilities in Northern California and I have seen the good, the bad and the ugly.  I know the difference good workmanship can make.
  
Travis did this job the way he would have done it for a very old and dear friend, on budget and on time.  I have a feeling this is the way he does all his jobs, big or small.  It's about pride, and he gets it.  Travis is humble, but at the same time exudes confidence, the kind that can only be grown from years of experience.  When I inquired about the warranty for the work I'd paid, he smiled and said, "Oh it's lifetime, I'm not going anywhere".  Trax Customs is quite possibly the best installation center in the Treasure Valley.

Visit their website, it too... is extremely well done.

traxcustoms.com

Bill Roulo -written Sept 12, 2012
strumfunn (at) gmail.com

Bowling only: we bowled in the vip section which is more money. You would expect some ounce of better service. Our lane broke. We had to go up to the desk 4 times. Don't press the service button on the consol to get help that does nothing. We wait for 25 min for someone to fix it (we had the lane for 1 hr). Finally fix it and offer us 5 min back. Spent over 150 bucks to go bowling. Awesome
Delicious, fresh food. Friendly service. Looking forward to going back. We had the reuben, meatball grilled cheese, buffalo chicken soup, and an asparagus herb soup. It was all outstanding.
Seriously so good! Will definitely be back. The vodka martinis are top notch and the sushi is very good!

We are from the East Coast and also lived in CA near SFO, so we are very picky about finding FRESH, seafood.  THIS is the place to go in Meridian.  The sushi is top notch because the tuna is very fresh!  The halibut florentine was amazing too.  Husband really  liked the whiskey butter ribeye. Get there early as the lines get long, which is a good sign because you know the service and food is good.  We'll be back!

On a recent Friday night (Feb 2016) we had one of our WORST EXPERIENCES ever in a restaurant.

We arrived about 6:45pm. We were seated by the window. The server did not know if Ice Tea was available (it was on the menu), there was only diet product in their self-serve drink machine was diet Pepsi, so we both had water (which was never refilled), and several items were not available "because this is a new menu, and we do not have the ingredients".

There were several items that they did not have (no french fries to go with chicken wings, out of one of the listed sauces) or other items were only available on the weekend (one of chicken wing sauces) or they did not do that type of crust requested on personal pan pizzas (10 minutes after the order was submitted this was passed on from the kitchen). From here it went down hill.

A party left beside us and their table was not cleared for 35+ minutes. There was a mess on the floor that was not cleaned up for the 2 HOURS it took to get our order of chicken wings and two personal pan pizzas.

Our pizzas were delivered after 1 HOUR and 15 MINUTES, but they were:
(1) delivered to the table behind us, 
(2) the customer accepted them even though they did not match their order, 
(3) the server spilled one of the two personal pizzas on the floor, 
(4) it took 20 minutes before it was partially cleaned up, 
(5) our re-order was sent to the kitchen with a "priority" on it, but 
(6) they did not appear for 45 ADDITIONAL MINUTES.

All this time the MANAGER NEVER CAME OUT OF THE KITCHEN. There was a 25% discount offered due to our problems (but we were only given a 20% on the ticket), and our 2 hour wait. Based upon server and other customer comments (come back on a Tuesday, it is our slow day) this did not seem out of the ordinary.

Some other observations:
(1) An order board was displayed over the cash register, by name, on how orders were being prepared, but as a sit-in diner we were never asked our name,
(2) There were 2 servers handling the telephone, cash register, walk-in pick-ups, and sit-down diners, but one of them still had time to "chat" with the customers.
(3) There were 8+ people in the kitchen,
(4) As we were getting in the car we saw 3 pizza delivery men enter the kitchen within 30 seconds of each other.

Needless to say we will NEVER go back to this pizza location. They are definitely orientated toward their call-in and delivery business, with little or no attention to their walk-in and dine-in customers NOR the cleanliness of their establishment.

Management of this franchise location should be ashamed of themselves for their lack of customer concern and not having procedures in place to keep the tables and floors clean.

I just went to spin class at CycleBar; I have to say that I've been to about every other spin place: SoulCycle, Flywheel, Revolution, Orange Theory and various single owner operations. 

I have to say that my experience at CycleBar was absolutely awesome. Everyone is super friendly. 

The class music was excellent and completely fit to the workout. The instructor was engaged with the class and was very motivational towards the riders.

I rank this among the best indoor spinning studios I have seen. I will be coming back.

I went back today to spin and was several minutes late due to heavy traffic. I was told although I did not know this before that there is a zero late policy meaning that even if you're one minute late you cannot go into to class. So please be aware of this. However, they pleasantly refunded the class purchase to me very quickly and the manager was very responsive and accommodating.

Amazing food and drinks!!! We had the Lucky platter and the shrimp scampi both very good. Our waitress Haley was super nice and friendly. We also got the calamari and that was delicious. 

I got the Fins fish bowl for my drink.....Loved it!!!! The manager was also really nice, going around and making sure everything was tasting good. Super friendly and great food.

I stopped by today for lunch. I ordered a half  grilled cheese sandwich, a cup of potato leak soup, and my bill was $10.50.

Things I liked: quiet atmosphere, great for a working lunch, plenty of seating, friendly staff, quick service, home made meals, plenty of parking, variety of payment options. 

My potato soup was also very good. It came with crackers and it was a nice lunch "cup" serving. 

Servings are not large and I would say true to size in terms of cup or bowl. 

Things I think could be improved upon: 
My sandwich tasted great, however it was a bit difficult to eat.  My half Gouda cheese sandwich came with red peppers and onions.  Again, it tasted great, however the vegetables were chopped very largely in that you took a bite and everything came out with your bite.  I think if the veggies were sliced smaller it would have been easier to eat.  Also, my half sandwich looked like it was in a hamburger bun.  I didn't see any actual bread.  It was soft and cheesy, but so dark (from the cook top) that I couldn't tell which end was up.  It was very smooshed flat, and toasted darkly, not burnt though.  Again tasted good, but not eye appealing. 

Overall I like the place because it is family owned and operated and I am big on supporting small businesses as well as buying local.  I'll go back, but I probably wouldn't take visiting family there.
Great park, lots to do, open plan. Kids area is good, water pad VERY COOL. Band shell for music nights, shelters for rent through the city. The senior center is ok, attended a wedding in there.

If you're looking for a beer in a college cafeteria setting, you have found the place. Boring and very odd layout with just enough beer signs to make you remember you're not in Wendy's. And enjoy the excessively large parking lot for motorcycles on your way out. Whoever created this horrible building should be forced to drink a glass of wine from their dirty glasses. Fail.

We came here on a field trip with 40 people!!!! Chick-fil-a was amazing AND accommodating for all of our students with special needs. Thank you chick-fil-a! Our kids were all smiles. I called ahead and planned with Amber. It was amazing. THANK YOU!
These guys have the best freshest doughnuts around. Don't believe me try them. I stop in 2 to 3 times a week for work and get the same results every time. Praise all day long.

I have eaten at Lucky Fins many times before and had good luck, but this last time I had the mojo roll and got horrible food poisoning. I called the manager to have him check into it and he did everything he could to deny that it was their sushi that made me sick. All I can say is eat at your own risk. If the manager is turning a blind eye to food poisoning I can't imagine what else is being swept under the rug.

I called for prices and was told it's told complicated to discuss over the phone. I asked for a general idea told the same thing. Not thrilled. Came into the store to purchase a tan. I waited while she was assisting the customer before me. Once I reached the counter, I was told the girl was going to check in several others that got into line after me as it takes a while to enter my information since I'm a new customer. Um not cool! More customers had gathered in line while she was checking those customers in!!! Started getting rather frustrated! And $25 for someone only doing 8 minutes in a level 3 bed is insane! The girl wasn't very knowledgeable about the beds or prices but did offer me a courtesy tan which alleviated my aggravation some and the only reason for 2 stars.

YESSSSS! Finally Togo's is here. Everything is still delicious, they bread is so good. So much more meat and overall goodness that that s*bw*y place.
You cant go wrong with #16 italian sub, then again turkey and avocado is the most popular. They also boast about their pastrami, but Ill be honest with you, not me favorite. Tends to be chewy and fatty. 
If youre vegetarian they have a hummus sub that is just crazy good. Omgosh i need one now. 
BTW, if you order online, you can usually score a free soda. Bummer they have pepsi not coke, but meh.
Love the variety for both regular and dessert empanadas. Come in frequently and like trying different combos each time. Reasonably priced for good portions.

Don't just don't. For one they're literally just out to make a sale. I purchased a couch from them for a grand because they talked up their financing. Then I get forced into the acceptance now program... (Mind you my credit is perfectly fine) now I'm screwed into paying 1,600 more then what the couch is even worth. To top it off the last time I went into see where my payments were (back in March)I was told I had 4 months left. Called today and they are now telling me 7.4... seriously the woman told me 7.4 wtf This place is a joke. Don't shop here is not worth your time. And DEFINITELY DO NOT GO THROUGH ACCEPTANCE NOW. It's pretty pathetic a company would even allow such a disgusting financing option. I'll never go back, once the couch is paid off I'll take my business to places that don't lie and talk their customers into this backwards kinda debt.
Dr. Uranga is awesome! Great communication and on top of things! She may be a little hard to get into, but she's worth it.
Awesome service , Hapeville Georgia home of the first Chicken Place ;) this place is awesome , the staff is very friendly and they have a lot of good morals and Standards !

Terrible service! The waitress was extremely rude! You could hear her and the cooks arguing in the back. The salad bar was out of everything and it was noon! I ask if there were more items for the salad bar and she said nope we're out! Really at noon? Dirty tables as well!! Don't waist your money at this Pizza Hut! And if management reads this, please make some changes starting with your rude staff!!!!

This place is such a treasured find!  Tasty, homemade baked goods made with love. Croissants are flaky yet tender, coffee is hot and fresh, and owners/staff are always happy to see you there.  Prices are very reasonable. 

Get here early because they are sure to sell out, that's how good this place is!  Closed Sundays and Mondays, too.
This place ROCKS!!  Great concept. Crust enclosed meal. Delicious flaky crust. Good choices of fillings. Meats. Chicken. Dessert fillings. Very good. Very well priced.

I recently bought a 3 piece decorative lantern set at RC Willey in Meridian. I purchased online and used their Free store pick up. I LOVE this feature. I am very happy with the quality and size of the lantern set. They look great on my plant shelves. The ordering and pick up process is easy and convenient.

We had a Ruben and regular Burger. Both were just ok. Great fries as far as fries go. Waitress was very friendly but forgot the horseradish sauce I asked for. Not a big deal to me. She was by herself and it was busy. She did apologize and felt genuinely bad. The beer was the worst. Not cold at all. It was actually warm and there ain't much worse than warm beer. For this reason we probably wont go back and the reason for the two stars.
Clean fun place good little area to take the kids and there is laser tag for the teens. The adult bowling room is nice with your own server.

This is not a very good Mexican restaurant.  Stopped in and tried and it was below average and we already have plenty of average Mexican places in the Valley.  Food was bland and tasteless....had to add lot's of hot sauce to make it taste like anything.  We also made the mistake of eating in their other store in Wyoming.  Figured it was a coincidence.  Same lousy food, so avoid it if at all possible.

My first time in Boise ID. I saw and advertisement for Lucky Fins from the escalator of the airport. The restaurant is a little hard to find with GPS but it is worth the hassle. Great food, friendly service. I had the sushi roll and peach halibut! Both were very good. The local beer was a perfect match. Thanks to my server Nikki!! All three were her idea.

Food came out in less than 5 min. Hot and perfect! Because our shakes took a few minutes longer they brought us a couple 'Free Milkshake' Coupons. Felt like we won the lottery tonight they were so kind

This is a great park for walking, running, or on weekdays when it is not crowded, riding a bike for exercise around the park's perimeter. It is also nice to just sit on one of the many benches or on top of the little artificial hill they built, and watch the clouds moving past the Boise Front Range. Many thanks to the Kleiner family for providing this park for all to enjoy. Julius M Kleiner must have been a great man to have such descendants.

Just like in Florida, Chick-fil-A is a hit here in Idaho, with little wonder.  For fast food, the chicken ROCKS!  The cross cut fries, ROCK!  The vanilla shakes, ROCK!  Prices are reasonable, staff very friendly and the food is consistant.  What else could you ask for??  This one has a play place for the kiddies, FYI.

Fun ice cream flavors and swirls however every time I've gone through the drive thru it takes way longer than it should. Last time I waited forever to just place the order and even more time for them to prepare a dipped cone. I'm hoping it is just them being new but I'm hesitant about going again.

We went for mothers day and got there just before the dinner rush, even as the place reached full and people were waiting out side our service and speed of food coming out was excellent! As far as the food goes every thing we tried was put together very well and was really enjoyable. I really can't wait to go back again.

This place really is a fun place for adults and kids alike. They have really big things to do like laser tag, water bumper cars that squirt water, and a slick race track. They have two different levels of the slick track. One for little kiddos. One for adults. The inside is superclean and very well-maintained. There's constantly people going around and picking up trash, checking to make sure that your game is working properly, refunding you immediately if something is wrong with the game. The food is not half bad, I do enjoy the group pricing rather than just our little family of five pricing. To get pretty decent pricing you have to have 10 in your group or more. It still wasn't too bad, and lots of fun.
The food was AMAZING! We had some filthy fries for an appetizer and I had the Devils Burger for an entree. Everything was so good. They also have an awesome drink menu. Highly recommend.

Craig Walker is professional, personable and a perfectionist when it comes to his work. I highly recommend him and his team for all of your painting needs. He did our Log home that's pictured on his website. Superb job Craig! Thank you!

I love hanging out at The Curb. It has a great atmosphere. My favorite is the wings, they are yummy! My cousin got a Ruban sandwich, I wouldn't recommend that sandwich. Usually the staff is fantastic, but, that night our waitress was definitely not on her game. That was the first time we had her help us so I'm not sure if she was new. 

Overall, it's a fun place with good food and drinks.

I agree with one of the reviewers that the portions are a little small for the price.  But I could stand to eat healthier sized portions, and it is high quality healthy food.  
Owners are very service focused.  Soup and sandwiches are great.  6 year old son loved the gourmet grilled cheese on kids menu. 
Have some fun drinks and baked treats too.
The smartest idea is the leftovers are frozen for purchase to take home and feed the family.

A great place for lunch. The soups are cooked from scratch and filled with flavor. I especially love Jed the broccoli cheese soup, not too cheesy and filled with broccoli. Their sandwiches are filled with tasty ingredients. 
And the staff is helpful and efficient.

This place is great. Good food good prices. The people who work there are helpful. The one thing the desserts are way ro rich. I tell everyone I know to go there it is one of the true hidden gems in nampa.
Such a great park! So much space and a great location. Love the water pad and walking paths.

This is the place that I always buy dog beds. They are always a variety of beds to choose from. Also they have a good selection of owl stuff that my daughter is always wanting. For quick cheap home furnishings this is the place to go.

A friend and I went in to RC Willey to look at some mattresses and a coffee table. One employee, Van, was nice, friendly, and didn't push us into buying anything. However, the rest of the staff we encountered were not.

 In the electronics department, EVERY SINGLE person did their best to avoid eye contact and quickly walked away when I approached them. Really? Really. When I finally did get help, I was told I would have to check-out at the customer service desk as I was applying a discount to my purchase. No problem. Well, when I got to the desk, the person checked my item without so much as a hello. When I asked about my discount, he VERY begrudgingly said, "Oh, you want a discount? Well, I'll have to get my manager then." I'm sorry you had to walk 10 steps to the manager sitting at the desk behind you. 

ANYWAY- the prices here are NOT the best in town for mattresses (I ended up purchasing one from a nearby competitor) and customer service is insanely weak. I don't intend on returning.
They are spend heavy but GREAT burgers and fires. Try the haystack fries, those are good. They make malts too, very good on that.

The Curb is a great place to go if you want to enjoy the beautiful weather, sit on the patio with your dog and not have the sun beating down on you. The service was amazing! It was my first time eating there and honestly the food was decent but it was the service that would bring me back. Heather was our server and she was fun, funny, efficient and accomodating..all characteristics of a great server. My burger was very over cooked the first time and I almost didn't say anything because I don't want to be that person (you know who I mean) however, i couldn't get over the charred taste in my mouth.
Heather graciously took it and made me actually feel good about sending it back.  It was better the second time. It was the Devil's Burger which I asked Heather if we coukd call it the Angel burget because I didn't like the name..hmmm! Perhaps THAT'S  why my burger was fried! Lol:)
My friend had the Mahi tacos and he said it tasted a bit like tuna..and my other friend had shrimp fajitas. She said they were good. My Dad had a BLT which was not on the menu but they had no issue making it for him and he really liked his. All in all it was a good experience and we will go back.

I know this can be an expensive place to bring the kids. But how fortunate are we to have this great place in Idaho!   The kids love all different aspects of this place from the go karts, bumper boats, miniature golf, arcade, laser tag,  awesome bowling alley, and now a new cool interactive game that 7 kids and 1 Dad can ride and shot.  And it records who the winner is.  Winner Winner chicken dinner!  Sorry I'm kind of a bad winner. :)   

So only thing that isn't the best (other than the food :()  is... Why in the heck does it take so long for kids to pick out a plastic slinky?  Just pick something with the 34 tickets and LET'S GO!!!  OMG makes me nuts..  Any one else feel my pain?

I ordered the mango shrimp tacos.  They were great.   My daughter ordered the seafood enchiladas.   So good.  I'm ordering that next time.  I peaked at the salads at the next table.  They looked great.   Captain crunch fried ice cream for desert    Why not .....

Not triathlete friendly. Not only does this place not have a pool, they recently removed their stationary road bikes from the cardio floor. The only way you can use a road bike is by taking a class. I'm currently in Ironman training and am beyond frustrated that I am driving all over town to try to accommodate the workout I need to do that day. Stationary road bikes are pretty basic piece of equipment to have and to expect that everyone who uses them wants to do a class is just ridiculous. Even more ridiculous is the low-energy instructors they've got teaching there. We will be switching to the YMCA as soon as it opens near us.
Wonderful place for a Mothers Day dinner.  Super busy today, but our server Kevin was the best.  Thanks for a great experience!

We are very happy with our new StorMor detached garage. We live in the historic district in downtown Boise and must abide by some pretty strict rules. We were out of state when the Historic District (HD) scheduled the public hearing. Preston spoke on our behalf and we were able to successfully move forward with the build. We built a two-story 22x24 garage -- both Nathan and Preston were wonderful to work with. They listened to our ideas and told us what was possible within the guidelines of the HD. We made some minor adjustments as the project progressed and they did them all without missing a beat. There were a few kinks that needed working out on their end too, and they responded to everything quickly and made sure we were happy with the product in the end.  This is a very well built garage and we would hire StorMor in a heartbeat.

I love this Lush! The employees are the sweetest, most helpful, and especially friendly staff! I have been to this location many, many times and have NEVER had a bad experience. They are so knowledgeable about any product, which is extremely helpful for someone like me who has a tropical fruit allergy. Also, they are the best problem solver people I've ever encountered! This place is amazing, especially due to the staff! Always coming back!!
Stopped by the DRIVE THRU for a latte- it didn't disappoint. I'm excited to actually stop in and enjoy the inside of the shop.

It's always nice to find a place where people make things personal and truly care. The staff that helped me and my daughter on Saturday were fantastic. They took the time to answer all of our questions and show us some basic bike maintenance as well as show me how to use my existing bike rack. I needed an adapter for our bikes to hold them safely on the rack. Something the place I bought it from never told me. Not safe. What I loved best about this store is they didn't try to sell me anything. They were all awesome.

I don't enjoy shopping here. It's like a sleazy used car lot with n w furniture. The prices aren't crazy, but they also aren't always the cheapest. I went to buy a couch in their clearance section and was informed that if I use their delivery service, than I would lose 10% of the current discount. What kind of place does that?? They are shady. We bought a mattress a few months ago and was told our old one would be picked up for free. Ugh no. They tried to charge us for delivery and pick up after the salesman promised they'd do both for free.
Almost 3 hours of sitting there and they hardly spoke to us. Toes and fingernails looked great, but came off the next day. They were pretty rude.

severely overpriced groceries.    Nice apple fritters though. have to admit.   what a JOKE though about these prices.   who shops here?  GOOD LORD!  i cannot think of anything that would be more wasteful than shopping for food here, No bang for your buck.    If You went to WIN CO and bought everything you needed, then looked at your shopping receipt and dived it in half money wise, and then took that 1/2 amount out of your wallet and set it on fire in the parking lot you might be very close to being as wasteful as shopping at rosuars. 

    WTF!    OMG.   are You kidding me?  this is so bad it makes shopping at albertsons seem smart!
sandwiches always have lots of meat and the produce is fresh.The service has been great the five times  I have been in

This is a good market to come to for fresh fish and deli items.  Other than that I find the grocery items to be pricey and the fresh meats and produce not the best quality.  Still it's nice to have another supermarket shopping option in this area.

hands down, the best in the business. There are others in the valley but either they are some national company or one that says "they are just as good". Looking to keep my $'s in Idaho and the best quality, bottom line, these are the folks to choose.

Best donuts! Customer service is excellent with the friendly employees. I love the idea that they fill the eclairs when you order them. Great idea. Donuts are soft and not to sweet. When I have order a few dozen, they throw in a few donut holes. I recommend to everyone.

This use to be my go to nail place when I still lived in Meridian. I live in San Diego now, and I still have a hard time finding a place that I love as much as Glamour Nails. 
I also use to take my grams here, she likes her nails a certain way. I cant remember the woman's name now, but she was always great with my grandma (she has dementia, and I'm really sensitive about her.) Anyways, I plan on going back when I go home for New Years! They are the best.
UM, why haven't I been to this place sooner?! Sunday's are happy hour all day with special menu items and sushi rolls buy ONE get ONE 1/2 oFF. YuM YuM and YuM. You know where I'll be Nxt Sunday.

Used to be obsessed with these burgers and amazing flavor. Now, they are gritty and difficult to enjoy. Staff was friendly, at least. Wasn't easy to finish my burger this time, so realistically I won't be back. Bummer.

First time trying this place and we enjoyed it very much. I had the jumbo fried shrimp and when it got to the table it was nice and hot. The flavors were great. One of my dinner companions had the lobster mac and cheese and she loved it as well. My other companion had California rolls and a Caesar salad which she enjoyed as well although the portion was quite small. She was advised by the server that the California roll was rather small thankfully. It is a nice atmosphere, but it is very loud. If you are looking for a romantic spot or a place to carry on a conversation I would not recommend this place.
We tried to go for lunch but taking our order appeared to be too difficult for the staff today. Unfortunately I have to give them a star but I'm glad I don't have to give them another chance.
Great place for the kids, for the money is great. Keeps the kids busy all day long. Staff is friendly as well.

Hiring Curtiss Property Management, Inc., (CPM) was the biggest mistake we've made as owners of rental properties.  In March 2013, we hired CPM to manage our new 4-plexes in Boise.  Owner Brandon Curtiss was our primary point of contact at CPM.  After several months of receiving less than expected rental income, we analyzed the account information provided by CPM and identified what we believed to be accounting errors and management problems.  For example, one tenant continued to be charged the first month's prorated rent rather than the full amount of rent.  Some tenants were not being charged enough for utilities.  And, some utility payments were not being paid on time. 

After two long phone calls with Brandon Curtiss in September 2013, he apologized for the mistakes, and blamed the problems on a software error and a new secretary.  He said he would be personally responsible for managing our accounts and that we would not be charged for September's management fee.  But, CPM took its September fee anyway.  By late October 2013, we had not received rental income for two months.  Curtiss claimed the rent checks had been mailed twice - once on October 16, and then overnighted on October 30th.  Nothing ever came.  I called him on November 1st and asked where the checks were.  I recall him saying, "I don't know.  I'm not the mailman."  Setting aside his rudeness, I understood that he would put the checks in the mail that day by 4 pm.  Again, nothing came.  We gave CPM 30 days' notice that we were terminating our contracts.  

By November 5th, our access to CPM's online owner portal had been cut off.   We became very worried about what had happened to the, now, three months of rent payments and security deposits being held by CPM.  Not knowing how else to protect our money and our tenants, we called the Boise Police Department.  They started an investigation which was determined to be a civil, not criminal, matter.  Brandon Curtiss threatened to sue us for false allegations and told us to get a lawyer.  Taking him at face value, we hired an attorney and filed a complaint in the Ada County District Court.   It took 11 attempts and 3 different process servers a month to serve Brandon Curtiss and CPM.   

It seemed that CPM refused to cooperate with our new manager.  Brandon Curtiss wouldn't turn over information about utility accounts in CPM's name, or tenant accounts other than leases.  He refused to turn over tenant security deposits for several months.  When he finally did, CPM had withheld several thousand dollars.  Brandon Curtiss claimed CPM could keep the thousands of dollars of security deposits as late fees that CPM had failed to collect from the tenants.  Records produced by CPM during the lawsuit showed that certain tenants were not late, even though CPM withheld money from their security deposits for late fees.  Our comparison of records provided by CPM before the dispute, with other records CPM produced during the lawsuit, seemed to show that CPM's general ledger had been altered to show rent payments as late.  

Shockingly, in March 2014, several months after we had terminated the management agreements, CPM gave a full deposit back to tenants without our permission.  These tenants had broken their lease and owed over $2,000 for unpaid rent and damages.  

During the lawsuit, Brandon Curtiss seemed to do everything he could to cause delay.  For example, he refused to come to a mutually scheduled mediation just two days before it was to take place in December 2014.  In April 2015, the judge determined that CPM had breached the management agreements.  The focus of trial was going to be how much money CPM owed us.  Two weeks before the original June 2015 trial date, his attorney asked the judge for permission to withdraw from the case.  His attorney specifically cited to part of a rule of professional conduct comment that states:  "Withdrawal is also justified if the client persists in a course of action that the lawyer reasonably believes is criminal or fraudulent ...The lawyer may also withdraw where the client insists on taking action that the lawyer considers repugnant ..."  We do not know what happened between Curtiss and his first attorney.  The trial date was rescheduled for September 2015.  In September, a judgment was entered against CPM for the full amount of damages claimed--nearly $20,000.  Since then CPM's bank accounts have been empty and we have not been paid anything.   

At the end of October 2015, another judgement was entered against Curtiss Property Management for 100% of our legal costs and fees, which are far more than the original damages.  On September 17th, 2015, Brandon Curtiss filed with the Idaho Secretary of State to start a new business--Liberty Property Management LLC.  CPM'S website redirects to libertypmllc.com.  Same address.

Hiring CPM to manage our rental properties in Boise was a horrible experience.  We would not recommend relying on Brandon Curtiss for any reason.

Sales reps are rude, impatient, and unhelpful. They lied about delivery dates and then forgot to put one item on the delivery truck, and wouldn't redeliver the piece for an additional 10 days. I decided to pick it up instead of waiting. The pickup process is a joke and took entirely too long. The whole company is unorganized and sloppy. The furniture I got was high quality and fairly priced but outside of that this company is absolutely horrible and not a place I will do business with in the future.

I don't know if it goes for all of them but this Domino's is on top of things. I know that after I place my order I'll be eating within 20 minutes. They always get it right thanks for the quickness cause I don't eat a lot but when I do I need it ASAP otherwise I lose my appetite. Thanks Domino's

Tried going for the first time, just passing by to get my oil changed and was met with a server that could only point to a sign that said min $5 for card purchases so I added another one on, she said it would be $4.10 not budging from the rule taped to the counter. There are so many places to go that do t have this ridiculous rule. I would have been ok if they just added the 3% to the bill, but don't just deny someone's business. So boo will not be returning to this place for any of my donut needs.

Excellent donuts and such nice people working.  My husband chose a blueberry donut as "his" in the variety we bought.  At first I thought blueberry was an odd (and maybe boring) choice but it ended up being my favorite.  While we were dining in, the man working behind the counter brought out a plate of piping-hot glazed donut holes for us at no charge.  The glazed holes literally melted in our mouths.  Screw the diet, donuts for everyone!

Please note this is the same review I wrote under their former name (OB/GYN Associates) before they rebranded to OGA  - 

I selected OGA for a few reasons, including a recommendation from a friend, which hospital I wanted to deliver at, and some research on their physicians (were they board certified, where did they do their residencies, etc.).  Overall, I had a great experience with the medical staff and felt confident throughout my pregnancy that they were providing the best care possible.

I tended to schedule my appointments in the late afternoon, and my appointments tended to be on time if not a few minutes early. I never felt rushed by the nurses or physicians during my appointments - though I am not one to ask a lot of questions as long as I am told everything is going well.  While you do not know who will be the on-call physician to deliver your baby, you can schedule out your prenatal appointments with your preferred physician(s).

My first appointment was cancelled three times, which was a tad frustrating - thankfully, my fourth (and final) attempt at getting a first appointment worked out.  I saw a certified registered nurse practitioner for the first half of my pregnancy.  When one of the schedulers was entering in my 20-week appointment, she told me I was supposed to have met with a physician before my 20 weeks - I appreciated her being upfront with me though not so much her slight berating of the other scheduler (who I guess did not follow protocol).

I did not have any issues with insurance billing, but I did have to make sure one of my contract payments was credited properly - the front desk staff had the record of each payment, but the billing person to whom I spoke did not - it seems that paying for my monthly contract plus another item on one check caused the confusion.  The missing payment credit was fixed after we reviewed the front desk's printout of my payments and the EOBs I brought with me.  

If my husband and I decide on a second pregnancy, I will definitely be returning to this practice.

This location was cleaner and quieter than Nampa, same brand name stuff my teenager wants for cheaper than elsewhere. Friendly and efficient cashiers. 

I got stuff here than I had to return in Nampa cuz that's where I live and it was quick and painless. So returns to a different Ross than where you bought it should be fine.
I've had probably a dozen visits to Storie at Revive. She is the best deep tissue massage therapist. I've had many massage therapists over the years. Storie gets in there without killing me.

We were in town and weren't sure about seafood in Idaho. But this place was great!! We had the stuffed mushrooms and lobster tacos!! The food had great taste!! Miranda was our waitress and she did a great job!! Fast , friendly service !!

Met my nephew and his 4 year old son for breakfast New Year's Day.  The service was great and very friendly. I had the huckleberry stuffed French toast which was light and flavorful. I look forward to going back.

Sassy Nails is the only place to get you fingers and toes beautified.  The salon is clean and pretty, all of the staff does excellent work, and their pedicure massage chairs are to die for!  If you want five star treatment at competitive prices, look no further.

I have dealt with Chris a number of times over the years and have always been pleased with the service and the quality of repair work...and the service is outstanding...Chris is always on the ball and keeps a person informed as to progress of repairs being made....highly recommend Chris and Kadel's....

After 10 days I have received no response from the "Corporate"  email address.

Called the customer care (LOL)  phone for this region.  Of course no one answers, let a message, we'll see if anyone calls back

And, it's very strange how the review from "Patrick F." keeps coming to the top, even though it is months old

Bowling by the hour a pretty good bargain. We arrived at 450pm and were given the pre-5pm price for our hour of bowling. 

Waitstaff available if you want to order food and drinks.

Decent food, we ordered the white cheese dip and it was amazing. Margaritas were amazing also. For my meal, I had spinach enchiladas. They were just ok, there was too much oil so it ran out of the enchiladas.  The rice and beans were really good. My kids had cheese enchiladas which were ok, not amazing. My husband ordered a burrito which he said was delicious. We will probably go back even though we don't eat out often. I'll order a different main dish. 

The staff was very friendly and they were great with my kids.
Great place for lunch!  Fish tacos and Blt lettuce wedge are good picks. Good food and service is high quality.

If you are not choosing Craig Walker to paint your home, you have just made the biggest homeowner mistake.  I acquired 3 bids to paint the interior of my home.  #1 came, looked around and chatted awhile.  He said he would e/mail me a bid.  No e-mail.  No call back.  #2 bid from a 'large' company.  They came in measured, wrote a bid on the spot and TOLD me what paint I was going to get.  I would get to choose the color.  I'm paying thousands of dollars to have someone dictate how it's spent?  Their bid was too high anyway.  Craig showed up.  Gave me a realistic bid which I accepted.  Showed up on time and, along with his right hand man went to work.  They worked hard, tackled what I would consider a difficult job due to high angled ceilings and other architectural challenges with the skill one would expect from professionals.  They are professionals.  From start to finish an excellent, clean, mistake free job.  Good people too, fun to talk to.  His bid was 16% lower that the other guys.  My wife and I are very much pleased with the job and would rehire without a second thought.  Once again.....if you need your home painted and don't hire Walker Painting, you are making a grave error.

I prefer Dominos. I love the hand tossed where the bottom is crisp, but it is also chewy. Yesterday I had my 2 godchildren over - middle school and they wanted pizza so I went on line and clicked on the 2 medium pizza for $5.99 each. Then I chose my toppings and ordered. It made sense that the price was $14.00+ because I added extra cheese. The kids & I were looking forward to our treat. When the guy delivered, he gave me one medium pizza. So in addition to the $14.00= there was a delivery charge and I knew he had nothing to do with the mix-up so I tipped him. One medium pizza for over $17. I doubt that I'll order delivery from Dominos again. What a shock and what a disappointment.
Absolutely Yummy! Best seafood ever. I am very particular about seafood and have never had a bad meal here!

Amazing!! We went for lunch and I'm hard to please. But this place blew me out of the water. It's so obvious, by the quality of the food, that there's not a cook in the back, there's a chef. This will be on our list of favorites for hopefully many years.

I attended an event in which the Curb bartended. During dinner service they ran out of red wine and we're extremely slow in their service. One hour into dinner service I over heard the bartender, Megan telling people that they were closing the bar early due to people being belligerently drunk. I thought it was very unprofessional to hear this conversation and disagreed with her judgement call. having two glasses of wine myself I was offended when she said the entire group was cut off. as a guest this was a respectable wedding party. I felt she had other plans on her Saturday night and was trying to leave so they didnt have to stay. I felt her attitude was disrespectful and the service was below average. I would never recommend this service.

I absolutely love this place.  The food is always fresh, hot, and fast.  Quality does not fall to the wayside.  The staff is positive and attentive without being overbearing.  They love to chat with you and their recommendations are spot on.  Just an amazing place to grab breakfast.

Been here twice and I can see why this place is not busy.  Outside of being over priced, ($7.00 for a 3/4 cup of yogurt).  The yogurt was very icy and nothing LaCreme about it.  
On a more positive note.;  the place was clean and the two young male employees were very helpful.
Absolutely fantastic.  Had the gaucho, tinga and the lemon.  All three were great.  You can't go wrong with the gaucho though.  I will be back!

The gal I'm working with in the carpet department, Cindy, is very nice, helpful and patient. Today I went in to exchange one carpet sample for another because when I got home, the color was all wrong (too brown and not enough red). I took a picture of our B-board and wainscoting on my phone, so I could get a better idea of a matching color. The man who waited on me was not very respectful, rather snotty, with a god-like attitude. He quickly passed me off to Cindy, who changed the paperwork easily and efficiently, even though it was a busy Saturday.  I should have introduced myself as Dr. Bower and see if that would gotten me more respect from him. Women are NOT second-class citizens and should not be treated as such. I pity Cindy at having to work with this man. He immediately went over to a couple and started talking to the man as if the woman was invisible. Really??? This is the 21st century, not the days of slavery. I wonder if I'd been a black woman how I would have been treated.

I got the soup and salad combo, the Caesar salad was DELICIOUS. But, the clam chowder-homemade-was THE BEST clam chowder in town. Truly made from scratch, tender clam, chunky potatoes and the perfect amount of creamy goodness. I will 100% come back. James and Ed did such a wonderful job cooking our meal. Courtney waited on us and she was an absolute doll. :) Salads and soup were HUGE portions. My fiancé got the buffalo chicken salad was also awesome! :) Burgers made from scratch and my mom really enjoyed her party melt!

Lot's of great specialties. Some have said it's expensive which I considered before visiting.  However if you consider their food is made of fresh quality ingredients plus they offer a unique menu (elk burgers and elk steal among many others specialties) with much more than just your traditional breakfast choices it's very fair. For instance my wife had the veggie omelet on our first visit. All the vegetables were fresh, quality and tasteful. The avocado was perfect, not to ripe an not under. How long does an avocado stay perfect?  I had the hazelnut stuffed French toast which was delicious and highly recommended by me. that's something you don't see on every menu around town. My kids had the chocolate chip pancakes that are fairly abundant around town but even the chocolate chips used were something better than your standard Hershey store bought. The staff was friendly an accommodating considering we had 2 adults and 3 young kids, 1 in a high chair on a very busy Saturday morning. We never felt rushed and Holly did an exceptional job taking care of us. This is not a "big box" cafe where they serve an average product with the standard choices for a cheap price. If you want that look elsewhere. I have it 4, not 5 stars because of the relatively tight fit when crowded and the inside was nice and clean but different than I had anticipated from the sign and building it's in. It has a small town country, local feel which is good just not expected. I would also advise the staff to mention to their customers they can pay upfront or the wait staff can take payment when leaving the check at the table since customers might have a preference.
We had grilled cheese rueben and gouda sandwiches with tomato soup.  First time here.   Nice staff and good food.  Very casual.
From forgotten sauce to the wrong sauce TWICE in the same night... These guys just cannot get it right.  Check your orders twice and do not choose delivery.

We tried a ham scramble and a mushroom and swiss omelette, one with fruit and one with pancakes. Both were fine but "fruit" only consisted of melons and the pancakes were flat and lacked fluff. As a tea drinker I am also interested in getting more than just "extra hot water", extra tea bag would be nice (don't ever see coffee drinkers have to recycle their coffee beans). This is a good, plain jane breakfast and decent portions but nothing that blew me away.

I've been to the Boise location before & loved it! A great hang out spot with friends. Unfortunately I'm so bummed with the new location they chose for this one. It's so hard to find a good parking due to it being in a smaller area. Overall, I do love their burgers!

I was very pleased with my experience at Kadel's.  I was in an auto accident and the other driver's insurance recommended Kadel's.  I was skeptical, as you might imagine.  However, from estimate to completion, the service from Kadel's was top- notch.  I would highly recommend this company to others.  The manager, Chris, is one of the best I have ever had the pleasure to work with.  As for him and you'll see what I mean!
Excellent job hosting 50 luncheon attendees. Service was great and food was awesome!

For some reason it is hard to find a good donut place in Nampa/Caldwell. So I pulled up Yelp and found Sweet Sensations in Meridian. It's a little bit of a ride but worth it if you want good donuts! Way better than Krispy Kreme and a Dutch Brothers coffee is right out front as well! We will be back to this locally owned gem!!
Never had a bad meal at Steve's and service is always number one in my book. The corned beef and hash is the best in town and believe me I've looked.

Had an awesome day at the park racing go karts with the whole family and the nicest persons we met was sweeping up the parking lot, thank you Chris for the heads up on year round park access and making sure we had a good time!

I give the food 3.5 stars but I give the service 5. I ordered a glass of wine, half a dozen oysters and the ahi salad. I wasn't happy with the oysters so the waitress kindly took them away and had them replaced (unbeknownst to me) with another type of oyster than I didn't even see listed on the menu. When the oysters arrived, she was very sneaky about it. The GM checked in with me to make sure I was happy and to ensure they lived up to my expectations. They did. They both checked on me a few more times (I was doing work during dinner so I stuck around for a while) and were truly genuine to myself and all the guests. Based on other reviews, I'll definitely come back to try other dishes and because the service was so great! Thank you Lucky Fins :)

I'm a sandwich guy.  I constantly eat sandwiches.  In fact, I had to put down a sandwich to write this review.  So, I know a good sandwich when I taste it.  

I was excited to see a new sandwich shop opening up here.  Although it's a chain, it never hurts to have around more tasty sandwich options.  After tasting both my and my fellow sandwich adventurer's sandwich choices, all I can muster is, "Meh."  And that's not even an enthusiastic "meh."  It's a plain old "Meh, I wish I'd gone to that other place..."

Also, you can judge a sandwich place by the bread.  The bread here is spongy.  A terrible sin within the halls of great sandwiches.  Unless you like that sponginess sort of thing.  

Expensive.  $20 for two small sandwiches and 1 drink.  Oh and, I almost forgot:  they have Pepsi products.  That's like having a RC cola dispenser.  I'm just pissed off now.  

Not impressed.

The burgers here are fantastic.  Very flavorful and cooked perfectly.  The toppings really compliment the burger.  The only thing that was subpar...the french fries were not good.  The burger is so good you could forget the fries.

My friend and I with a total of 8 kids in tow went to the Meridian location for dinner last night. We have kids with dietary restrictions and one with Celiac so we were able to feed everyone at one place without anyone getting sick. 

More notably, Alan is the one who took our order and served us. He was super patient and understanding with their energy and our long ordering process. He paid attention to the kids when he would check in at the table. At one point he noticed that the kids ran out of chocolate milk and brought all of them water (with kids and straws) so we didn't have to get up. It was so nice!  He was cheerful and helpful and professional and made dinner so much easier.

We just found another favorite breakfast place.  Tried Steve's for the first time today and were reasonably impressed.

We shared an order of corned beef hash, basted eggs, and huckleberry pancakes.  The corned beef was excellent---not fatty, or gristly and had a good brined flavor.  The hash consisted of shredded corned beef and diced potatoes.  Really good!

Pancakes had the taste of sourdough and huckleberries in the batter.  Light, fluffy, with homemade huckleberry syrup.  

We were there today, Thursday around 10 AM and the place was nearly full.  When we left there were only two tables vacant.  Obviously a popular place and I can see why.  Also have to add the service was very attentive, helpful, and friendly.  I would love to come back and try lunch!

I've been a customer here for about two years their equipment is "ancient" dinosaur years you cannot do a simple auto pay. If your calling to try to pay them their employees will tell you "you can't pay over the phone and there has never been a way to pay over the phone" then hang up. However in fact you can pay over the phone and you have to be directed to a different branch to do so. Once you have credit with them it's almost impossible to make your dates when you pay online because online payments takes a week to days to clear. I don't recommend this place until they make some serious changes
Sandwiches are amazing! My favorite reuben and meatball sub by far. Great service as well. I don't understand how this place gets lower reviews.
Great place for a birthday party. Unlike most places in this category, the pizza is actually REALLY good. Highly recommended.

Can't believed I happened on this place on a whim. Really couldn't believe it when I came in the door and found all their soups are homemade even down to a homemade broth. I had a hard time between choosing between the two samples I tasted the sweet potato put chipotle and the cold strawberry soup, but I chose the sweet potato and I'm not sorry. Can't wait to come back.
Giod stuff. Fresh made soups & sandwiches. Reasonable prices and very friendly staff. We will be back.

So delicious. I had the sweet potato chipotle soup that was to die for. It had a kick to it, which I loved. My husband had the potato leek soup and that was yummy as well. The staff was super friendly and helpful and let us sample several soups as well as the carrot lemonade. I'll be back.
It was my first time here. I got a couple of the Mediterranean sandwiches and a cup of the tomato soup. I was very impressed with both the sandwiches and the soup. I would certainly go again.

Great food!! Being from Seattle I don't typically seek out seafood when traveling but I am so happy I made this exception. My kids were begging for sushi of all things so we popped in to have some. I had the special - a generous portion of blackened halibut. It was delicious! The service was excellent and the vibe was festive. Very kid friendly (thank you!). There were several things on the menu I would have liked to try. Next time!

what a perfect donut. We went in last Saturday morning and wow what a treat.. so light and fluffy one of the best donuts ever. my husbqnd goes in and gets a dozen for his work crew and they devour them. the young lady, with long long dark hair, Cassidy,  is so sweet, warm  and friendly. we will be coming back a lot and spreading the word!!!

This is not your typical sales establishment.  We proceeded to look at appliances for about a hour prior to us asking for assistance.   We ended up with a sales person named Lamont.   We picked out our fridge and a washer and dryer combo.   We asked Lamont to order them so that they could be delivered by a certain date. The day prior to delivery I stopped in to confirm that they would be delivered the next day.   Come to find out, Lamont had failed to place the order and we are stuck without any.    I'd suggest going with someone who can follow up on commitments or maybe a different provider.

After spending all morning and most of the afternoon, my wife and I stopped by Mattress Land Sleep Fit to give mattress shopping one last shot. The moment we walked in we were greeted by a very nice, honest and non-pressure sales manager (Casey Timmons). He thanked us for stopping by their store and for considering to shop at a locally owned business. We went through the way-awesome bed fit program (you lay on a bed to determine the softness or firmness you need) and it showed us the best mattresses for our needs/wants. After many questions by me and my wife(which were all answered), we bought the best mattress for us. We left the store feeling like we had made the perfect buy and are so excited to get our new bed. Update about the bed to come...
So yummy! Very unassuming interior, so I was doubtful it would be so good. Got the turkey avocado on sourdough roll- so so yummy! Love the fresh bread.

Steve's is an All-American strip mall experience with friendly service and good food.  There is nothing interesting about the venue but the food and service are solid.  You are going to pay a tiny bit more than some places but not over the top.  More than anything, Steve's is locally owned which I would rather support than a no name d-bag from elsewhere.

I have had annual service contracts with Advanced Heating for years.  Sometimes I get the same service person, but most often it's someone different.  They have all been very professional and efficient while working in my house, the few minor repairs that have been necessary have been taken care of quickly and with full explanation.  They call in advance to let you know when they will arrive.  Can't ask more than that.  Apollo was the most recent technician who serviced my units today.  Very professional and courteous.  Will continue to use them after I sell this place and move into another.

Wow how convenient, My massage therapist and I have the same name! First of all, I must say I love their little set up. Their waiting room is so cute and it smells so good ! I went there for my first prenatal massage and their prices are very reasonable. Liz was so awesome and used the perfect amount of pressure. I will continue to come here and also recommend it to all of my family and friends. Next time I'm bringing my husband.  I loved the peppermint oil also. It was so pleasant and the rooms were so relaxing. Can't wait to schedule my next visit!

We have eaten at Steve's Café a few times and have been satisfied, but our last visit was a real disappointment. The service was slightly rude. My omelet left me feeling a little queasy, as the mushrooms were slightly sour and the cheese was strangely chewy. The pancakes also seem to have changed, as they were hard. Overall, I would opt to spend my money at a different restaurant.

My wife went in today to get a pedicure. Payton provided services for my wife but fell very short of being professional and providing the best service possible. She was very clumsy, rough, and very impatient. She skipped steps and she was very unfocussed  (dropping stuff all over). My wife said she looked as if she was on drugs of some sort, which she works for canyon county courthouse and deals with drug addicts all the time, so she knows the signs. There is nail polish all over her feet and my wife did not enjoy her time there. My mother goes there all the time for her nails and she will be going elsewhere if that issue is not resolved. We know most of the techs there are really good, just one bad apple. But, still that one bad apple can cost them dearly.

My wife and I were out and about on Memorial Day and needed some sustenance. I remembered Lucky Fins from a Yelp search I'd done before and found we were near it.
We're both glad we were! We arrived just as their Happy Hour started at 3PM and decided to try the Happy Hour menu. We ended up with the Kicker shrimp, Calamari and the soup and salad meal. The Kicker shrimp were sweet, spicy and perfectly cooked. Definitely needed the ranch dip, but it made them fantastic. The Calamari were the most tender we've ever had and also cooked perfectly. The soup and salad we split with my wife having the Miso soup- also great and me having a Caesar salad. The salad was above average in flavor and the dressing coated all the greens. Portions were fine and we were pleasantly full at the end of our meal. Service was also suburb since we were the only ones in the room at the time and the server was tending bar and our table. She was there every time our drinks ran low with refills. 
Prices were good for this level of restaurant, and we'll be back again for more of the appetizers.

Curtiss Property Management recreated itself as Liberty Property Management but it's management by Brandon Curtiss remainder the same. I cannot recommend this business at all. I had a property in management with them for nearly four years and at first everything seemed fine. However, this past year has been a night,are. Late rent payments to me culminating in no rent sent to me for the last month they had it in property management, as well as double billing me for utilities they paid between tenants. I got a lawyer, sent a letter of de and, no response, and now they owe me $1,000 plus legal fees - I don't think I'll see a dime of this.  Brandon owes money all over town and has filed bankruptcy for the third time on February 3, 2016.  Do not do business with this company!

If you want to feel like your at the club while working out this is the place for you! Instructors are amazing,  they are full of energy, and are really positive and push you to be the best version of yourself. First ride is $5 if you are just going to go once I recommend Genevieve her energy is contagious! The owner JP is so sweet,  shoes are provided so you don't have to worry about that. They also provide towels and on your first ride you get a water bottle. They have super cute tops, did I mention they offer student discounts!!! I love the cyclebar I get so excited to book my rides and I feel amazing afterwards get ready to kick your butt kicked!
Service was wonderful! Fun and upbeat personality and very attentive... Food was amazing!!! They don't skimp on the helpings either.. Haha just how I like it :)
Friendly and welcoming staff!!! Never cycled before and was greeted when entering. Shown how the cycle works and the instructor Whitney was awesome and motivating.

I was super disappointed after visiting Corona in Meridian.  They got my friend's order wrong and the I have never had such terrible customer service.  We actually just had to leave money on the hostess stand because after waiting over 45 minutes for our bill they never came.  They were all just laughing and talking in the back and not checking on tables.  I would recommend going to the location on State Street.  The customer service is much better there and they get the orders right.

Awful!  Nothing good about anything served. Iced tea was bad. Chips were bad.  Entree was terrible. I don't know what happened in six months, it once was a good resturant, now just plain bad.  I'll never go back.

Zero stars is more accurate.  The Hideaway has reopened without "Harry's" name, not far from the previous location.  We arrived 5:10 pm to a packed bar.
