No seats available at the bar, so found an empty table for two.  The previous diners signed credit slip still on the table.  Waited 10 minutes before wait staff noticed us, picked up the credit payment, and took order for beer and water.  Another 8 minutes till the wrong beer arrived, with menus and table service and waters.  After another 15 minutes, no wait staff came back to take our order, so we decided to leave.  Paid for the beer at the bar and complained we had received no service.  Three bartenders, at least six wait staff, and we were ignored for 30 minutes.  Absolutely no management involved in the dysfunctional waiter or bar service.  We noticed an adjacent table had ordered before we arrived, and were still waiting when we left after 35 mins.  Improvements in management will need to happen if this place expects to succeed.  Doubtful we will ever return.

Food was subpar. I wasn't blown away by the black bean burger, fries or shake.
The real problem is, I'm pretty sure that I got food poisoning after eating the food.  Can't guarantee it, but I felt sick soon after eating it. 
I definitely won't be going back, because I'm not sure if I will get sick or not.
Delicious food pretty crappy waitress could barely hear what she was saying but the sushi rolls were amazing!

Less than impressed. We found a table and a waitress came by with some menus and to let us know someone else would be by shortly to take our order. 20mins later no one had stopped by to take out order or ask if we'd like anything to drink. It appeared that the 2 waitresses were on child duty - tending to a young child. Is this a childcare or a bar & grill? I don't even think the waitresses noticed we were there. I'm not sure why we didn't leave. We opted to try sitting and the bar and we were greeted and served drinks immediately. The bartender was efficient. She took our order but one of the waitresses served us...without silverware. Did she want us to eat with our hands? She almost seemed put out by my request to eat with utensils. The food was room temperature, and mediocre at best. Aside from the bartender, this place has HORRIBLE customer service. For the same price, one could go across the street to Gramercy Park where they have excellent customer service and seriously delicious (and hot), food. I won't be back here.

All my husband want for his birthday was fish and family. So we had a party of 9 tonight. We had a variety of ages and everyone seemed to like the food they were served. The gentleman greeting people when we walked in seemed uninterested and a little disgruntled. Our server tried very hard to keep our glasses full and even had the pies we brought with us for dessert cut and brought out with a pie server. Thank you for the delicious food and good experience.

Went for a quick dinner with hubby. Restaurant was filthy. Food and trash all over the floor. Went through most of the tables to try and find a clean one. Finally settled on one that was somewhat clean. Looked at the salad bar as that is what I was planning on having. Very thin selection, especially of lettuce that looked old and brown. Asked waitress if they would replenish the salad, she said "not right now as it was too late in the evening" It was 6:30 pm. Ordered personal pan pizzas for two people. Came pretty quickly. Never saw the waitress again after the pizza was delivered. Since we had coupons for free personal pan, we left a couple of bucks for a tip and walked out. I can see why Pizza Hut is always empty. For the entire time we were there, no one came out and cleaned tables, chairs, or floors. Sad way to run a business. Won't be back.

It took awhile, but I found my new nail place!  Tracy is awesome (and Sassy btw).  I really don't think it matters much which Operator you go to here.  I hear they are all fabulous.  Love the location and atmosphere.  And, they are FAST!

First time being here. Service was amazing! I was able to try out the soups before ordering. I got their Rueben sandwich which was delicious. I was sad they were out of the creamy tomato basil soup so I'll be back for that!

This is a solid place for fast food. I had the chicken burger with bacon and avocado. The chicken was hot and tasted great. The avocado was fresh with no brown spots. The Smash Fries are awesome. You don't even need ketchup. I definitely would choose this over Five Guys or of course McDonalds/Burger King. It's definitely a better choice for a "fast food" sandwich.

Really good first lunch today...as my 8 year old said, "it's homemade and it is really good because it's healthy and nutritious." We tried the chicken noodle and the asparagus leek and both were really good. Turkey sandwich was good as well. Nice to see there were a good number of people in there. One feedback is the plastic bags aren't ideal for take out...a stronger and smaller paper bag were the soups can sit upright would be better. Will be back for sure to try the other varieties. Be good to have a daily Twitter or FB post with daily soups for that day...
The empanadas were cheap, wonderful and delicious. With so many choices, one can't go wrong with eating here.
I've ordered from Slyce Box three times now, all three time were perfect. Great pizza, affordable, and available on Uber Eats.

The atmosphere was pleasant. The booths seat 6 which can be convenient for large groups. 

My wife got a spicy soup that was delicious and I had a traditional New England clam chowder. I found the New England clam chowder very tasty but my wife thought it had a spice she didn't care for. For my main dish I had the chipotle halibut with cilantro lime rice and asparagus. 

My wife had the shrimp scallops and clams with risotto. My wife loved the risotto with while it made me gag. I can't blame the restaurant though because I think I learned I don't like clams in the shell that aren't breaded and deep fried. 

The only complaint I had is that I was still hungry and my fish cost $20. But I found it very tasty and a nice atmosphere so overall I gave it 4 stars.

Great place! Had a wait, which is a good sign that the food's good. Steve brought coffee for all of us sitting in the waiting area. I appreciated that and the free WiFi. After about 10 minutes or so we were seated, our order taken about five minutes after that, and our food delivered about 10 minutes after that. Waitress was very friendly, very attentive. I enjoyed sitting where I could see into the kitchen. All the prep staff seemed happy and efficient. Our breakfast was tops! Robin's shrimp omelette was over-the-top delicious, as was my homemade corned beef hash. Coffee spot on, pancakes delicious even without syrup. Great breakfast!
Great food for the price. Convenient location, fast and friendly service, and just all around good eating.

What a great store, wish I lived closer.  So much to look out that it could be overwhelming.  They have an excellent selection of health food in addition to standard groceries.   The prices are higher than Winco but similar to Albertsons.  As I was wondering I noticed they had a two day sale on boxed cereals for under $2. 

Excellent customer service, very friendly cashiers.
Food was just ok.  For lobster tacos it was difficult to find the lobster.   It is a cute place.  Service was good.  With so much competition for my business I'll probably keep going to new places
The tacos and lettuce wraps are really good. Very noisy and understaffed though. Also strawberry mojito was not good. No sweetness to the drink at all even after adding more purée to it.

This place is awesome! I'm an extremely picky restaurant critic and rarely do you find a place that provides good, strong and delicious drinks while provide excellent service AND delicious, well made, quality food. Whoever owns this place is doing a  GREAT job. While providing a family friendly atmosphere (more so during the day) they also consistently provide a very proficient functional bar/good time atmosphere. I highly recommend The Curb for anything from a date night (where you have to bring the kids but still what an adult atmosphere) to a night out drinking with friends. Excellent everything!

I love this place but it's so inconsistent! Sometimes we've had great service and sometimes it's sucked. We sat out on the patio once and were told they didn't have a beer list, we had to get up and go walk inside to look at the taps which was annoying but not a huge deal. The fried pickles are always amazing.

Great lunch place. We will definitely return here. The Thai Chicken Currie soup was delicious. My wife ways that the Reuben Sandwich is the best in the Boise area!  My Mediterranean Sandwich was great too. Friendly service, and very nice setting. Like I said, it was a great lunch!

Rosauers is the place to shop. It doesn't always have the lowest prices in town but the service and cleanliness goes above and beyond any other grocery store in the valley. The deli and bakery are great. Their Huckleberry Market is nice and has a good variety of gluten free and organic products. 

While not all of their prices are the lowest, Rosauers is definitely my recommended place to shop.

Worst pedicures! 
They did a 25 min pedicure which included a clip and color, no massage or clean up which I had to do myself! They also over charged me and after arguing with the manager she shouted to another employee to "just give her the damn money back", how unprofessional. After writing on Facebook they deleted my review of my experience, also very unprofessional! 

Don't ever go here ever!!

I went this morning and honestly I really loved it. I am leaving a 3 star rating because of the price. The unlimited monthly price is $179!!!!! That is INSANE! Especially since in Los Angeles, California the unlimited monthly price is $99! It really sounds like somebody made a bad business deal on the CycleBar here in town and we are the ones who have to make up for it. I would love to see this location and other locations excel in membership and do well because I really do like going. But I refuse to pay that price. Yes they have packages that results in lower fees overtime but I am a regular cyclist and would like to go more than 10 times a month which also cost $180. I will raise the star rating when the prices lowered to something more fair. Over all the facilities were excellent, I think they need more than two showers. The instructor that I had and the equipment that I used were stellar. And I really appreciate the 6 o'clock start time that got me to work on time as well.
Excellent Pineapple Cucumber Gazpacho and Ham and Swiss sammich. Super fast and great customer service! Will be back

3 out of 4 of the people I asked for assistance were rude and talked down to me while being seemingly too busy talking with other employees to be bothered to help. This is the worst experience I have ever had at a grocery store. The only nice employee at this location was a very tall fellow named James in the meat department. If I owned this store I'd fire half the people at this location. Extremely rude. Will not shop here again.
Really good soup. I sampled several and it was hard to choose. I went with the roasted tomato and it was great.
Best Fish n chips! Such a great spot to stop by on a Saturday afternoon. Friendly, clean, great prices! Will definitely be back.
I work right next to this place, so I tried lots of different menu options. Chicken buffalo soup and grilled sandwiches are the best. I think it's a bit pricey, but healthy and super good!))
The seating at the lanes is uncomfortably close to the next lane. And the pizza was gross. I did like the music videos that they play at the end of the lanes though.

Been there several times..atmosphere and food are really good but the waitresses are lousy!!  Had the same 2 there every time we go...one is super ditsy and the other is extremely rude!!  It would definitely be one of the best bars in the area if it weren't for them!! 
We will go back on occasion because of the food, but can t stand dealing with them on a regular basis!!  Get some new girls and you'll have regulars!!!

I was a regular customer due to the convenience of the location. My last visit, they gave me bright red(which I didn't want) and painted one blue. It was absolutely horrid and when I said I didn't like it they didn't do anything. Pedicures are sloppy and they don't take their time. Take ur money somewhere else. They also get very mad if you don't tip. The front desk lady named Tracy was very rude

Very dishonest company, do not sign up for a membership they make it nearly impossible to cancel and charge you through the roof over $80 for 3 tans that didn't work, they claim to have a satisfaction guarantee. When I tried to cancel they refused to do it over the phone or email or fax or scan or mail

I have the mystic package here and really love it.  Great price for a month of unlimited mystic tans. My only complaint is that the floor doesn't always seem
mopped and can sometimes be a little icky when you are in the mystic room barefoot and changing. Other than that it's great!

Yum! This small place has a handful of cold sandwiches and hot sandwiches. Their speciality is their soups (if you couldn't tell from their business name lol). It's a family business (you can tell) and take pride in their place and are super friendly.

It looks like they have 5-7-ish soups on rotation at a time. They have the current soups written on butcher paper on the wall. Soup sounds boring but they have gotten creative with their recipes. They don't focus only on the traditional soups offered in restaurants.

The nice thing is they allow you a little sample of the soup before you commit to a cup/bowl. I settled on the buffalo chicken. I also tasted the cheese burger soup. As a cheese burger lover, for whatever reason this sounded gross in a soup. I tasted it, and it was actually good.

They have various soups you can take home to eat later in their fridge. Since their soup isn't massed produced, you never know what is going to be available.

Seriously! We come to Idaho so seldom and we can't go anywhere but the curb! The service is stellar. The prices are great and the food!!! Even the kids grilled cheese is out of this world! Thank you for creating a locals hang out relevant to all ages and creeds. If you are anywhere in the treasure valley, this I a must try! Bring the kids too!!!

Buyer beware!  So, I passionately dislike this business after my experience with predatory billing practices.  I paid for personal training sessions.  I thought I was being charged $156 for 4 sessions.  Little did I know they charged my card $156 per month for 3 months after I completed my 4 visits.  So they are fine charging you until you notice.  I was left with a $500+ surprise bill on my credit card.  They are the worst and will never do business with them again.

I have so many good things to say about this Chick-Fil-A! One of them being that their customer service is always top notch. Never have I once had an issue with this location. Another thing is I always receive my food as fresh as possible so that is always a plus! No one wants cold food once leaving through the drive through. They are so quick even when there is such a huge lunch/dinner rush. There is one specific time I wanted to mention about this location as well. I don't usually carry my wallet with me when my husband is with me so I figured he had it on him. We get to the window to pay and he completely looks embarrassed and we both realized we had no way to pay so we asked the gal if we could come back and pay for it and them just save our meal for us. The gal was so sweet and said "this one is on us!" We were so shocked and thought that was the nicest gesture a fast food restaurant has done for us! I am always raving about chick-fil-a especially because I never grew up with one in my hometown and never realized what great customer service was until I stepped foot into this fast food chain. One last thing is that the owner of this location is so sweet and although I've never met him, he is always sending coupons for a "free treat" on the app! AND btw if you don't already have the app, GET IT!! You earn rewards just by scanning the barcode!

Me and my wife went out for our anniversary dinner and we decide we want to try some seafood we were down in the MERIDIAN area and thought this might be a good idea. Boy was I wrong. You know I've eaten a lot of places all over the world and I think one of my favorite things is lobster mac & cheese which I ordered off the menu. I would highly suggest that no one ever order this dish again I made it clear to the waiter that it should be taken off the menu immediately.Into the restaurant was really nice it was a fun place to eat but the food choices really lacked a certain something.

Horribly slow kitchen service time. Turtle covered in peanut butter walking through quicksand slow. Wait staff is unresponsive. Had to specifically ask for napkins and never got silverware. Order came out incorrect. Won't be back.

First time here. I wanted something different and this place hit the spot.  The front hostoss sat me down right away. The server also came right away. She knew her specials. I ordered the sashimi salad but was surprised i got something else.  I pressed for time so i decided just to eat it. The server was good enough to take it back but again i was pressed for time.  The manager came out and said they will make it right and make it fast. They did that exactly. I have to give the management a thumps up for the service they gave me. Over all this place is great and i recommend it highly.

My wife has gone back to Sassy Nails and was treated very well by the staff, the young lady that she had the bad experience with has been let go for multiple bad experiences with customers. My wife and mother in law were very happy with their customer service and quality of product. Thank you Sassy Nails!

Took my son in there for a beer and a sandwich on a Saturday afternoon. We sat at the bar and it took almost 8 minutes to even get a hello. The place wasn't busy. Bartender was too busy chatting with friends or regulars. Strike one. We got our beer and never got asked if we wanted food. Our beer was empty by the time she came back, remind you we are sitting at the bar. She again was to walk off when I asked her if they had food. She never responded and simply put two menus in front of us. Strike two. Again, another 15 minutes to get her attention to place a lunch order. 
The food was not worth the long wait. We both had pastrami and the meat was fatty/chewy and barely noticeable. I told her and showed her and she apologized and asked if we wanted a different sandwich. I said no and asked for the bill, with most of our sandwiches still on the plate and we were done eating. No discount, nothing and we left and went elsewhere to have lunch. Strike three. 
Never again.

The service was far below par. The nail technician performing my manicure cut me several times...leaving three fingers bleeding. There was also gel polish on my skin around my nail causing the gel to peel just days after getting them done. I will never return.

I had Liz and she incorporated hot towels and hot rocks into my massage. My two friends had other female masseuses and were happy enough with them, but not as thrilled as I was with my massage. I recommend booking with Liz if possible. It is in an upscale strip mall with other professional offices. Reception area is simple, but nice. No place to lounge in robes like you might find in a full day spa.

Most of the staff here are pretty knowledgable on what they're doing.. But this place makes it super super uncomfortable for new customers .. It's like everyone already in there (including the staff) see you as a show.. Like you need some pass to walk in there. They keep staring like they've never seen an outsider before. 9.9/10 of the times are mostly dudes, and the prices for Everything are crazy expensive ,I'll just buy my juice at the gas station.. Too bad, the atmosphere has potential, but only for guys.

We stopped in for dinner during a road trip last week. My wife and I shared some appetizers & entrees. The calamari was good with an adequate portion size. The caesar salad with salmon was excellent - the warm, tasty filet resting on the cool salad greens hit the spot!  We also had one of the specials: a crab cake with arugula & garlic. The dish was tasty though we would have enjoyed some bread to offset the tomato sauce.

Service was good, but worth noting that the shift manager (or similar) stopped by our table multiple times to ensure all was ok. She was not irritating - we appreciated it. Very rare to have that amount of attention.

Overall a very enjoyable meal.

Steve's is great. It's in close proximity to Denny's and IHOP. I would go here hands down to those places. The prices are reasonable. They do have affordable smaller breakfasts that are not ridiculously small and still leave you hungry (well at least for me).

I'm not a big pancake fan but I love their huckleberry pancakes. There are huckleberries in the pancake. I think they make their own syrup but I'm not sure. It's not thin but has some "chunk" to it. Their service is pretty consistent. I think out of my 10 visits there was only one time it was a little slower.

They keep the place clean. You don't find sticky residual (syrup? lol) on your table or menus from the previous people.

I have only been there for breakfast. I have not tried them for lunch.

After the night we had this is not an establishment I would recommend or a location I would go back to! I will see if the downtown location has suffered the same quality & service issues. Wish them luck but things need to change! I love Fancy Freeze but this was not the Fancy Freeze of old that made you feel like family & a valued customer!

This restaurant was a complete disappointment. My sister and I ate dinner... We ordered the calamari with lime aoli for dipping. The calamari was bland, and the dipping sauce didn't have a hint of lime... it was almost tasteless. We asked for cocktail sauce, which was much better.  For dinner, we ordered the fried shrimp combo, which was ok, but  we weren't impressed with the smothered mashed potatoes. They had so much garlic, that's all you could taste. 
Our waitress was new, and it was apparent. She didn't hear us order one of our dishes, so we had to wait awhile to get the other entree. She didn't seem very concerned with her mistake, and may have offered an apology, but that was the extent of it. 
We ordered the black and blue fish (I don't remember the type of fish). The sauce was completely bland, and the fish wasn't seasoned any better. The loaded mashed potatoes were no different than the first, completely overpowered by garlic. We also ordered a cup of clam chowder, which also needed salt, and had not a bit of clam or potato in it. 
Two margaritas, one cup of soup, two entrees, and an appetizer plus tip was around $75. We weren't only disappointed in the whole experience, but mad that we spent that kind of money for food that was bland and tasteless for the most part.  I will not be back!

Why does Albertsons always smell funky?

I am a frequent shopper at Albertsons mainly because they are just down the street from my house. They are your basic grocery store with the standard food options and for that they get a an average review. The one thing I wish they had was more gluten free options. I feel that most other grocery stores have come privy to recent food/diet trends and adjusted there offerings to accommodate such but don't see that much here. The other thing I wish they would address is the smell!!! For some reason it always smells funky in there, which is not the best atmosphere when you are shoping for food.

Wow, what a disappointment. I feel bad for Idahoans if they think this is good seafood. 

I guess I should have known better. Seafood in Idaho?  But they said fish is flown in fresh daily. 

My server was great. Sympathetic even. I don't think she knew any better. Bless her heart, as we say down south....

The calamari was body rings only. Over cooked. Tough. Yuk. Not fresh. My fault for ordering calamari in Idaho, I know. 

How about a shrimp cocktail?  Are they from our continent?   Nope. Indonesia and India. Skip it. 

I thought, hey, maybe a fluke. Bring on the crab cakes!  Oh, they are red crab?  Hmmm. Ok I will try them. Terrible. Salty. Mostly binder. Looked like identical twin corn fritters. Guarantee you they were frozen in a box 5 minutes before they hit my table. Ugh!  SAMs club would have something better in the freezer section - I am not kidding.

I don't know why, but I stayed and ordered the just flown in seared tuna special. It was seared all right. Seared into complete submission and damn near well done. 

Wine was good. Server was sympathetic an service was good. She offered to comp the calamari. I didn't want to go through the hassle.
Wonderful pastries.  I only wish they weren't so high priced.  Even the pastries in restaurants are less expensive than here.

AMAZING STORE!!! Reminds me SO much of Wegmans from back home in New York. I love Rosaurers, but WOW the prices there! OOOOOH!!!! HIGH! Expect to spend $$$$$$$$$ they are NOT cheap! at all! 
but the store is beautiful! its clean, the staff is awesome! truly a wonderful store :)

Great lunch today!!  Everything was delicious.  I had the key lime calamari and the seasoning on the batter made them delicious plain but then dipping them in the sauce made them even better.  I loved the Baja enchiladas also but the RICE!  Oh my goodness it was soooo good!  And I don't think I've ever gone crazy over rice haha!  This is only my second time eating here but I think I will become a regular!  Service was stellar as well.

I know they are new and still learning everything but everyone is super friendly when we've been and their ice cream milkshakes are wonderful. The inside is super clean and open and they have seats outside.

Went here for lunch... Had the Lobster flatbread... It was really delicious, then had the lunch special of crabcake/lobster sandwich... The sandwich was dry and lacked flavor.... If I had of stuck with a couple flatbreads they would have knocked it out of the park... But sandwich brought them down to just "ok".... Too bad.. Good beer selection

I love this place for so many reasons!  Their food is amazing, every staff I've encountered is extremely friendly, it's the cleanest fast food restaurant I've ever been to, and it has a kid play area that is clean!

Today, we had two very kind gentleman come by our table and ask us if we needed anything and one brought us mints!

I have been here many times and have always had such a great experience! 

Highly highly recommend this place if you haven't already tried it! But really, who hasn't tried Chick-fil-A?!

Thank you Chick-fil-A staff for making our day better!
BEST service in town! The food is great, the atmosphere is fun and uplifting. Even when it's busy they still move quick. Love this place.

It's still Pie Hole with lipstick. Completely rude staff, subpar pizza pie, and an astounding amount of flies. I always seem to stumble in here around midnight while crawling the downtown Meridian bars with a group of friends. It's decent enough to soak up some alcohol, but it's instant heart burn.

The ladies were nice enough, and I was able to get a same day appointment. However, my pedicure took less than 20 minutes! There was absolutely no pampering. I felt like the tech was just trying to rush me through. Also, the place isn't very clean. With all the other options around town, I won't go back to Sassy Nails.

Went to the Curb for the first time on Saturday and yum! We ordered fried pickles for an appetizer and they were so good. I usually don't like dill pickle spears so I was pleasantly surprised. The taco salad was big! Tons of meat and guacamole. Can't wait to go back!

The service was excellent but I had mixed feelings about the food at this restaurant. 

The first thing I tried was a creamy roasted poblano and jalapeño soup.  This soup was awesome.  The flavor was perfect with just enough jalapeño to give it a bite but not enough to overpower the poblano or other spices.

I was disappointed though with the BLT wedge salad.  While the portion size was huge, it came with just a drizzle of a very runny blue cheese dressing which pretty much ran off the lettuce before I could eat it.   Worse yet, the dressing had very little taste and almost no blue cheese in it.  While they told me that they made it themselves, I would have bet that it was a cheap house brand dressing.  Not that is was bad; it was just slightly below average.

The promise of the soup might cause me to return if I am town long enough but I wouldn't make an effort to return.

I hit at least five or six shots once a month when I come to Boise and these guys are awesome. Every time I taste upwards of 20 flavors spend a half hour of their time tasting and they're always very cordial and informative. If you're a serious vaper and like higher wattages these guys rock!

Holy Halibut! The Lucky Fin is fantastic what a great dinner we had. The Halibut is off the hook crazy good and the Aloha roll is amazing, along with there specialty soup. Excellent service
We definitely will be returning

To be successful in the restaurant business you need to consistently follow the basics.  It's cute that you offer elk and bison sausage but if you can't cook bacon and eggs your business plan is doomed.  Ordered a standard breakfast; scramble eggs, bacon, hash browns, and pancakes.  Eggs were overcooked, bacon practically raw, hash browns under cooked and dripping with flavor fry!  Got two stars because the pancakes were good.   Could have had a better breakfast at a chain.  Had to listen to the cook argue with the sever over the pancakes.  I say you fire the cook because he is going to run you out of business!  I don't think this place will be around for too long as there are much better breakfast places in the valley.

Love this place. Not typical of Boise. A lot of people were dining, but you could still have a conversation and enjoy yourself. 

Highly recommend!

Customer service is simply the best in the fast food industry.  You get your food fast then any other fast food place I have ever been to.  The food is excellent.   The interior in clean. Outside is hip.  There is just nothing bad to say about this place.  Cannot believe Carls Jr. Is still in business.
It's a great place to go have a fun night with the family. The glow in the dark pins is a nice touch. If your looking for a fun date night its a good place to be.

We will not be back. We were excited to check out the new place. The service was unfriendly, and took forever to even get a drink order. There were maybe 4 tables being used.  We didn't sit at the bar, but in a booth. The waitress looked annoyed to even be there. The food was TERRIBLE. We ordered the cheese sticks, and French dip sandwich. The cheese sticks were your typical bar food cheese sticks but they were served on a bed of shredded lettuce....(weird) The French dip may have been the worst sandwich I have ever had. The meat was tough and rubbery, the bread tasted old and was chewy. The au jus sauce was so salty you could float an egg in it. It made our mouths dry from all of the salt. We had our friends taste it to verify and they agreed completely. 

We were so very disapointed. My husband and I ride, and we were excited to have this biker bar as a local watering hole but sadly we wont be back and will discourage others from eating there as well.

Worst experience of my life.  Please do not make the same mistake I did!  I bought new appliance, awesome right?  Well until they got delivered.  The fridge arrived damaged and the stove is missing the hook ups.   I thought, no big deal.  They will make it right, boy was I wrong!   First they put me on hold for over an hour and then needed to call me back.  Now another day later, nobody has called and the stove is still in my living room.    To add to my frustration, they left all the boxes and did NOT install anything.  I know I have learned a lesson, I hope you don't make the same mistake!!

The truth is very hard to swallow. The best breakfast burrito is found at Rosaeurs in Meridian. I have tasted the breakfast burritos at Los Betos: Too much potato. I've tried every restaurant that's willing to open in the morning. It's shocking that a grocery store would have a good breakfast burrito but it's absolutely true.

The monster is about as big around as Hulk Hogan's pythons and has enough bacon, ham, and sausage to give Lance Armstong a fucking triple bypass. It is the perfect blend of egg, meat, cheese, roughage to form the most perfect breakfast burrito around. They top it off with some house made salsa that is unreal. And it's only $4. A single breakfast burrito at Rosauers is big enough to feed a Vietnamese village.
These empanadas are pretty good. I've been here a few times and only get the desert ones. I love sweets. They remind me of my grandmas that she used to make when I was a kid.

Please open the drive through and keep it open. We would love to visit this place more if hours were set in stone. We drove an hour and the store had closed early Drive through is a must! In a hurry for breakfast us moms do not want to drag in and out a herd of kiddos!

I'm actually pretty disappointed in this place. The reviews were good, so when my daughter needed donuts before school, I figured I would stop here. 
There were no full dozen prices displayed anywhere on the menu board. Where it looked like there may have been, there was blue painter's tape over the item listed. So I had no idea what this would cost. I ordered 3 dozen mixed anyways. 
The selection was low. The lady took a long time filling the boxes. 
When she rang up the price it came to $41. $41 for 3 dozen donuts? I didn't argue or question it because I didn't ask before ordering. But I never imagined it costing that much. My fault for not asking. 
I won't be back. Beware of the high price for donuts here. Krispy Kreme is a better value.

Steve's has great food. I found this place a few months ago and really like the food. I like a lot of verity when i order food and have yet to find anything I don't like. I would recommend this to my friends.

The sandwiches were delicious! I love the gluten free options. My kiddos enjoyed the grilled cheese and cookie! The husband couldn't decide on which grilled sandwich to get so her got two halves! He tried the jalapeño and Buffalo Grilled cheese and he loves both. The staff was so nice and accommodating. I would come here more often but we live in California. Next time we're back visiting we will stop for sure.

Lobster tator tots were tasty, not much lobster but I'd order them again with a beer and it could be the whole dinner! El Diablo sushi was interesting, will order again. Huge, great crunch on outside. Louisiana shrimp very good flavor. Veggies perfect, loved the rice too.service excellent.

This place is always clean, fast, and consistently good.  I love the fry sauce and glad to see that they brought it back.  The mushroom burger is to die for.  They have great kid's meals and are always so kind to our whole family.  We are regulars here.  Prices are not too bad either.
Really good carne asada!!! You must try it if you go there, my family also loves the dessert chips!

Pleasantly surprised by this place, great ambiance and lighting, the staff is friendly and good looking. We went with an app and tried the Lobster Flatbread trio, this alone is with stopping in for.  Chucks of lobster and the aoli with cilantro was just perfect. My wife went with the Key West Cobb, I didn't try it, but it looked great. I tried the Island Burger (9.99) topped w/ coconut shrimp. Perfection!  Juicy and bursting with flavors. The caramelized coconut shrimp were perfect. Thick juicy party, tomato, lettuce mixed cheese, red onion and topped with the shrimp on a really good bun (forgot bun type). We ended with a home made slice of Key Lime pie, (7.99) the pie tasted great, but, a little skinny. The 18oz Cadillac Margarita was mixed perfectly. We will be back!

New to the area and chose this place for a haircut.
Didn't have to wait long at all. 
The guys there were friendly and best of all I got a great cut. Definitely going to be the spot I go to from here on out. An easy 5 stars.

We have used RC Willey for 10+ years. Nine of those years have been at the Meridian location. We have 10 kids and so we are very hard on washers, dryers, dish washers, fridges, furniture...you name it. We always get the RC Willey's extended coverage and have always been pleased with the guys they send out to fix the problem or they replace it. Always. 

Cindy Jones is the sales lady that we always use because she is very knowledgeable of the products and always gets us the best deals...and is just the sweetest person you will ever meet!!!

Hit the Curb for a post softball game beer with some teammates. Nice tap selection. This place is an echo chamber. Place was about half full and the gals a few tables down were laughing, screaming, whatever...and we couldn't hear ourselves yelling to each other across the table. Service was good though.

Based on their name - Soup Kettle Grille - you may think they specialize only in soup.  But their sandwiches are the best!  Sandwiches are on fresh rolls and thick with meat/cheese and full of flavor.  A side bowl of yummy soup and I'm stuffed!

I had a wonderful time here with my girlfriends. The manicure turned out beautiful and is still chip free a week later. The staff was friendly and helpful. The environment was clean and relaxing. I will definitely be coming back!

I wish Yelp offered 10 stars, I would give them all to Steve's cafe.  Since my original review, I have been here multiple times and I can honestly say that the service and food is as consistent as it gets.  I LOVE the ambiance of this place.  It carries the warm and cozy feel you enjoy during breakfast.  Their coffee is excellent and instantly you are greeted by warm and friendly staff.  I feel as if Steve's cafe is not another breakfast place but a place you can go and have a family environment breakfast.  You just aren't limited to one server.  It's as if everyone cares and is willing to help any table, not just the ones that are assigned to them.  Steve's continues to be my favorite in Meridian to have breakfast.  Did I mention the best hash browns??  Make sure you try them.

I spoke with the owner Brad Martin and he rectified this situation to my satisfaction. I really appreciated Brad's understanding and he made the situation right. I also provided some additional feedback for him on the technician, who was very nice, but possibly additional training is needed. After this experience, I will give Stanley Steemer a 2nd chance. We have used them before without any issues.

Brandon made the very best "generic" turkey sandwich with jalapeño on the side.  Sydney made an amazing BLT w/ no T and cucumbers!  Lauren, Brandon, and Sydney made me feel so at home.  Watch out, Togo's, I may just have to recruit your employees to work in my biz!  My compliments to the Eagle store manager!

This is a great new park in Meridian right next to the Village of Meridian. They really put a lot of thought into this park and have a little of everything for just about any situation. The playground for the kids is really cool and modern, there is a place for the kids to play in the water, bocce ball, basket ball, a very nice walking path, a couple ponds, and an amphitheater. This summer they have started using the amphitheater to do concerts in the park which are really fun. They have vendors there so you can buy food and they allow alcoholic beverages in the amphitheater so you can enjoy a cold one wail listing to the band. My wife and I had a great time and will definitely be going back. The best part is that the play ground is right next to the amphitheater so our kids can go play and still be in eye sight wail we enjoy the concert. It really is a great evening out.

If you're looking to get a short but intense workout in while having a blast, then this is the place to go. I have tried many cycle studios in different cities and CycleBar in Meridian takes the cake. Always such upbeat and caring staff as well as having the best playlists! Genevieve is my favorite instructor by far, and I love her connect classes! Definitely recommend this place!
I love right next to this park and am obsessed with it. It is the most beautiful, clean, spacious park in meridian. Well done!!

I grew up in California and love Togos! My family and I were so looking forward to it coming to Meridian and all I can say is yuck! It tastes nothing like I remember, bland and actually my husband, son and I felt sick after eating the pastrami. The girl making my sandwich ignored me and carried out a conversation with her co worker about her piercings. The manager seemed rude and mean and demanded the girl making my sandwich go put something on his desk, don't mind me I am just standing there waiting for my lunch. We won' t be back.

This is the best breakfast I have found in eagle/meridian. The people were soo friendly and the service was amazing! The place was busy, but we were seated at the bar immediately. They have a lot of good options, including enough exotic choices to satisfy a curious eater like me. We had the Monte Christo, a side of chile relleno (a special)  and my boyfriend had the country friend steak. Our total bill came out to $30 including a tip. So it's not the cheapest place, but you do get a perfect amount of food. Everything was really tasty. The fruit cup was a little bleh, but everything else was good! We will definitely be going back soon! Thank you for such great service!!!

A definite gem in the Treasure Valley. Great sandwiches and great soups. Owners are awesome people and have developed a great place for breakfast and lunch. I had the Chicken Noodle soup and the meatball / cheese sandwich. My wife had the Buffalo Chicken soup and the Gouda Cheese grilled sandwich. Wow, great flavors and portions are good for the price. We saw the USA Today story about great places in Idaho for potato dishes and had to stop in to see for ourselves. We loved it and you will too. Give it a chance and you will have a new favorite.

This is a great nail salon! It might not be fancy or posh but it is very nice, clean, the staff is very friendly and I've always have gotten the best service! I bring my 6 year old daughter with me and they give her nails and toes the exact same attention as mine which I super appreciate! We love this place and always come back!

I love STP. I go there all the time. I just bought some shoes ( Montrail Masochist trail shoes) for 40 bucks. They are $80 on Amazon. I also had to return a backpack that was too small and the staff was awesome. The Meridian store is excellent.

Inaccuracy with staff regarding missed scheduled dates and times.  States made phone calls when did not. Owner apparently doesn't believe in the slogan of "Customer is Always Right" but instead that his two employees are irreplaceable no matter what their actions.
Clam chowder is amazing!  Great food and atmosphere. I'd highly recommend this place.

Ok,  where do I start?  Poorly managed,  wait staff not trained well,  haphazard,  the list could go on.  Plus side,  good bloody Mary. Heard rumors the owners friends get to harass the patrons and the wait staff with no consequences. It shows.

This is exactly whats wrong with franchising a restaurant. Ive never been to the original restaurants but I would have to assume they had something positive going on. This franchise on the other hand does not. Walking in on a Thursday night over half the tables were dirty only one was sat at they were fully staffed and business was at a lull. The franchisees were on site looking to be in their mid to late 50's and looking as though they've never worked in a restaurant before... Im sure they're retired and thought, 'how hard could a restaurant be to own and operate?'.. Well, judging by the quality of the food and the shape the restaurant was in, they bit off more than they could chew... I will never go back and to be honest I passionately tell others to avoid at all cost. Whatever the place started with- it has lost. I gave it two stars instead of one because the high school kid behind the counter was obviously undertrained but tried hard none the less.

I have not rushed to review this restaurant because there is definitely nothing here that compels me to write a review. The name itself though is entertainingly ironic and tragic if you were a fish. Let me say that I am amazed at the sheer numbers of people that pack into this establishment to pay some very high prices for food that is what I would consider fine chain cuisine. I am not certain where the trend started for sushi to be crammed full of cream cheese, avocado, and then deep fried it really is kind of appalling and out of control. I get that you can be creative but there is a point of diminishing returns as well as some people that label it as "healthy" still just bewilder me. Not to mention the price per roll is pretty unreal. Now let me address the food. The calamari we ordered came out very quickly and was hot! It was completely FLAVORLESS! I mean like no salt or seasoning at all on the batter. Some sort of gross mayo was served with it. The highlight was the cocktail sauce which was actually outstanding. Note the cocktail sauce did NOT come with it, I had to ask for it. Both of us ordered fish for our meals. To their credit the fish was cooked perfectly. I will say though the prices were really high for what you were getting. It's not like a local chef was back there painstakingly coming up with the menu for that evening. Let's be real, it's coming from corporate via the internet. I'm not hating, I'm just being realistic. It was not a dining experience I would pay that much money to repeat. Also for those that are sensitive to what they eat. I ordered a bloody mary and was suspicious of the olive as it had something crammed in it that was white. I didn't eat it and asked the waitress. Sure enough it was bacon. Some people would say no big deal, unless of course you don't eat pork... which I don't anymore. To their credit the wait staff is very nice.

I have been going to Fred's Reel Barber Shop since the fall of 2009, shortly after moving to Idaho.  As former military, i value a good cut, and these guys really do it right. Time after time, i have always been happy with thier work and never dissatisfied with the results.  We even scheduled a special session for myself and all my groomsmen to get haircuts here the night before my wedding in 2011.

Thank you for your quality services!

Meh. 

I don't agree that smashing the ball of beef makes a juicier burger, mine of always been crispy and no meat juices. I won't return.

Decent pizza here. My slice was a little under cooked. The decor is interesting. The parking is right up front, not a common thing in meridian.  The place is clean and the staff friendly. They have an interesting menu. I'm sure I will revisit them again.

We were so excited to try this based off the reviews but it was a bit disappointing. It wasn't bad but it was also nothing extraordinary. The meat lacked seasoning. The desert ones are amazing though!

Was kind of excited to get a ice cream place in the neighborhood but ugh it was pretty bad.

First of all there is no order to the way they do things. The line is long and slow because of the way they serve food.

The hamburger and fries where what  I would expect at McDonald's.

Won't be coming here again.

It's Chick-Fil-A!

Very friendly and very clean.

The chicken sandwich was wonderful and we enjoyed the relaxing music.

Kids had a great time in play area.

Lots of parking.
Great food, great service. Definitely will be back. I am sad the Asian chicken salad is gone but love the strips, shakes are too die for and fries are always hot.

I love Rosauers so so much, but it is so expensive I can't go there every time I shop for groceries. It's the best though, sometimes I even go just for fun. And then end up buying a few things and it's like $50. The people are so friendly! I love it!

This was literally the worst experience I have ever had at a restaurant. We were there for 50 minutes before any food was brought out at all. My husband's food never even came, even though we were there for over an hour before leaving. The manager tried to make it up to me by not charging for the soda my husband ordered. When I said that even free food couldn't make up for my ruined evening because we were going to miss our movie because MY HUSBAND STILL HAD TO EAT, she did cover my whole check. I had a cup of chili, which tasted like blood, and the lettuce wraps, which were unbearably salty and served with jarred peanut sauce. Terrible.

Okay, I'm going to revise my original negative review of R.C. Willey.
I still say their corporate policies are patriarchal and antiquated with not being able to add the wife of 48 years) onto my husband's account without going into the store, but this last time, I had a gift card to spend at the store from having carpet installed recently by Willey in our home. The gift card had not been invoiced yet, but the store personnel not only bent over backward to invoice while I was in the store, but the male cashier was so nice to issue me another gift card in the same amount, saying he would run mine through when it became active. That meant I didn't have to make another trip to the store, and the male salesman (Keith) was super nice and helpful.  There are some very nice men working in that store who do treat women with respect.

This place is ALWAYS good, we have never had a bad meal in 5 years of freqenting this place.  The shrimp and mushroom dish with the chipotle cream sauce is heaven on earth, as is everything else I try there.  My husband is also a big fan, as well as our 5 year old son.  The top shelf margaritas are the best in town, and one is enough as they pack a punch.  We hit this place at least every 6 weeks or so.

This is an awesomely fun place. We frequent often and appreciate the ease of watching several kids at one time, the great rides, ok food, and all around fun. Only feedback would be to lower food prices.

This place is awesome! I took my friend from out of town and we are obsessed! The ladies took their time (we were there for two hours) and were so thorough. My nails  and toes look amazing and the price is right! I've tried numerous places in the valley and have been dissatisfied with all of them for one reason or another but I am happy that I found a great place! I will definitely be back!

Made an appointments for three pedicures.  When we got there they were busy. They put us in the chairs with cold water soaking our feet. After 20 minutes they said it would be another 20 minutes.  Needless to say we got up and left. Why do they take appointments????? Will not go back!!!!

By far, the worst booking experience I have ever had.  Bought a Groupon back in Jan... it took Storie 4 months just to get me an appt.  2 days before my appt., she cancelled.  Multiple text messages later; she said no one else could pick up the appt.-- AND no one from the spa ever returned any of my phone calls.

I actually really like this place. The staff is super friendly. You can taste the soups before picking one without feeling like you're being incredibly inconvenient. The soups themselves are pretty darn delicious (exception being tomato basil, I found that one to be less flavorful than the others) and made with great ingredients.

But they have never failed to make me sick when ordering gluten free. Every. Single. Time. When I mentioned it, I was told something about the bread looking different. I'm supposed to magically know when bread is gluten free or not? I can only have gluten when I'm prepared--I have a sensitivity and it will make me physically ill without a specially formulated enzyme to help my body digest it. If it's not a special occasion, I choose not to have to take a pill and pick food I can have without issues.

Or try to, anyway. The 'eh, oh well' response I got when I finally raised this concern--after eating there 3-4 times and trying different things to make sure it wasn't just me...glutton for punishment, I know--has put me off ever returning again. It's decent food that I liked grabbing on my too-short lunch break, but nothing I want to have to pop a pill for. Every time I see a post it makes me want to stop by, but the total lack of concern over the fact their mistakes have made me sick (and in the middle of my work day, generally!) has completely ruined this place for me.

It's just not worth it.

Which is such a shame because I could crawl into a pot of their potato leek and live there. So if gluten isn't an issue for you, you're all set, but I'd advise lots of caution otherwise. Their new hours make it even easier to stop by. 

I should note it has been a while, and maybe their processes have changed to help avoid this so one can eat a tasty sandwich without living in fear of the aftermath, but based on the above, I rather doubt it.

I get the mystic tan couple of times a year for special occasions and it's very inconsistent. Sometimes it's really good and other times it looks horrible or it doesn't tan at all so I have to go back and re do it. Like right now.. Very frustrating!! The girls are usually very friendly and the prices are pretty good. I just wish they could be more consistent.
Meh. Portions are really small for the money.  Fries were ok. I was the only one there and the place was fairly dirty for 3pm, only one clean table.

This was my first visit here, and I must say I was not disappointed.  Great fresh food.  Good customer service, I did have to ask for a punch card, this doesn't really effect my rating because they happily gave me one once I asked and they were right where customers can see they're available I think I may have a new favorite close to home.

This corner of Meridian is packed with self-serve frozen yogurt. It's bizarro, and they'll all run each other out of business in time, and then we'll be bummed.
Anyway, this froyo place has nothing about its yogurt or toppings that stands out from the rest. There are fewer flavor options than any of the competitors, and they didn't have a basic tart yogurt. No option to sample, either, so you'll be filling your cup without the option to know what you're getting.
Toppings seemed pretty fresh, but the selection was limited. I tried several fruits and while the raspberries were good, the strawberries were woody and tough, and the blueberries had stems attached, which I had to spit out.
Along with frozen yogurt, they sell a variety of hot drinks and other treats like pretzels and cakes. I didn't sample any, so I can't assess the quality.
The young man at the cash register was a bit surly and unfriendly. I was the only customer in the store, so it wasn't that he was overwhelmed by the volume of customers. The prices were in the $0.39 per ounce area, which seemed a bit more than average but not out of line with other prices. Given that it's in the Village, I appreciated that it wasn't totally extortionary.
What I really hated was that by paying with a credit card, I had to sign a copy that included a spot for a tip. This is SELF SERVE yogurt! The purpose of the place is that the staff won't have to do as much. I got a glare from the cashier when I wrote a zero in the tip line. I felt bad, but for $3.00 of yogurt it seemed a bit silly. The employee's noticeable annoyance when I didn't tip was uncomfortable.
The seating area was clean and bright, and had plenty of indoor and outdoor seating. 
I will go out of my way to get froyo before I come to the village, to avoid this place. It's the only coffee shop in the Village, so I'll likely come by again and try out their espresso, but otherwise I'll stay with Menchies.

Awesome!  So nice to have a great Seafood restaurant in Meridian.  Went last Sat. night.  Had to wait for 20 minutes so had some drinks in the bar.  It was worth the wait...some of the best food I have had in the Boise area.  

The service  was great and the head chef even came out to visit with his guests.

The prices are so reasonable we were not expecting the food to be so good. My Tilapia was amazing with the lemon sauce.  Only $12 The potatoes are really fantastic as well.  The pumpkin bundt cake dessert was really tasty as well.

Best part of the meal was the poblano and jalapeno soup. I could eat that everyday!!!

I can't wait to go back and try their other dishes!

Pretty decent food in an increasingly growing section of Meridian. Last time I was here I had a burger and some fries which were average in taste. 

If you drive a huge pickup truck, wear jeans with white stitching, and/or have insecurity issues, this might be your spot.

Great market, this was our first time here.  It's not necessarily unique but it was a nice clean grocery store. It is similar to an Albertson's in size and in products,  but a bit more, I guess I would say upscale? They have an area with health food items. They have a bakery, produce area, meats and deli. Cold beer, beverages and a wine selection.
The employees were super friendly and helpful. We had a nice chat with the lady at the register. They have a ton of sales, they do a bunch of radio advertising for their 13 hour sales. We would probably shop here more, it is just not in a location that is convenient for us.
Wonderful pastries. The shortbread melts in your mouth. Not only are the goodies fantastic, but the owners are delightful to talk with and the place is decorated like my Nana's house. I love it.

the best burger around this state.  they also make delicious malts.  everyone there is helpful and never miss a lick.  sometimes i order ahead and its always perfectly bagged etc.  we go there often.  the meat is legit.

We USED to go here a lot until the waitress refused to honor a coupon; what happened to the customer is always right!? The amazing thing is, why wouldn't they honor a coupon that they paid an advertiser to place to drum up more business!???! 

Was it worth saving the 20% discount (works out to be $4!!!!)? So to save $4 they lose a regular customer!

Wow!

Oh well, there are PLENTY of other Mexican Restaurants out there AND their food isn't really that great anymore!

I usually don't write reviews but I ordered a meat pizza for my husband and a cheese one for me. (I'm a vegetarian) and while eating the cheese pizza there were chunks of meat on them. I was sooooo grossed out. I'm disappointed in dominos. Especially because I've been coming here for years. Overall the pizza is good I just wish people were more careful.

Went here for our anniversary tonight.  Something has changed - it just wasn't up to the high standard we have seen before.  We had scallops and halibut.  The scallops were off-color, tough, and a little off-taste.  My halibut was dry and tough.  This definitely wasn't fresh seafood - more like frozen and pretty old at that.

The service was still quick and friendly, but we were very disappointed in the food , especially after our previous good experiences here.

The old lady at the front refused to sit my mother-in-law and my 2 kids for a party of 3 claiming they only seat full parties. Excuse me, but any place that refuses my kids a table doesnt deserve my business. A very large family will no longer be coming to this cafe.

Hard to find this store... buried deep in a strip mall.

They take Meridian water and filter all of the contaminants out of it.  Then they sell it for 50% of what you can purchase water for at the big box stores...

Tasted a bit bland to me... not as fresh as spring water.

They will sell you a huge 5 gallon container if you want and you can take that in and get it refilled when you want.

Very friendly and informative...

Hours say you are supposed to be open until 11pm, but when I walked in at 7pm with a hungry family I was turned away. Poor form. Waitress said something about not wanting to turn on her closed sign. First time coming, probably the last if this is what customer service looks like.

Not the best experience. Took my 8yr old to bowl and only half the lanes were open. They put us next to a huge family whose kids were crawling all over our sofas took my sons hat etc. How embarrassing for the parents that cannot control their kids. 31 bucks for an hour of bowling and on my last frame the time ran out and game was done. What a joke!! If you want to bowl... go anywhere else as this was ridiculous. Pic attached to show it went out right before my ball hit the pins. Smh

I am rating Wahooz based on a recent experience with a group booked Wahooz experience. My work took us to Wahooz and treated us to dinner and 3 hours of unlimited attractions, and $5 in arcade games. They have really upgraded all of their attractions and added on to everything. It is way bigger than I remembered a few years ago. My only complaint would be the guy who worked at the bowling alley check in station at 6:00pm on Monday 8/14/17 was really rude. That is where our group was supposed to check in and my manager was waiting there to greet each of us when we came in and showing us where to go. Our manager took us to this check in station located close to the bowling alley and this male employee stood at the other side cleaning the counter and when he saw us, he stated that he would only take care of us if we went to the other side of the counter even though our wristbands and game cards were on the other side. It seems petty of him to act so rude about which side we used. Other than that I had a blast.

Great burger and fast service. This place has never disappointed for a fair priced quick burger. I'd recommend the mushroom Swiss which has a truffle mayo which is incredible. Their shakes are great too. We frequent this place for takeout too.
I drive from central Boise to have my nails done there.  It's so worth the drive.  My nails never lift, everyone is friendly and professional, and the salon is very clean.

First impressions: 
1) small serving for the Vegas roll (overpriced)
2) Mediocre tasting sushi
2) Limited beer selection (overpriced)
I will return once to try something different.

I have to revise my previous review.   Although the original delivery experience was miserable, we have enjoyed our  furniture so far.  After I posted my original review, I received an email from a staff member asking for more information so they could investigate.   I then received a personal call from the Store Manager, Jon Jensen, who listened to my description of the horrible experience I had.  He sincerely apologized and said that he appreciated the feedback so that they could make improvements.  He said that he had already set up a meeting with the Delivery Dept Manager and would be arranging  staff training  to improve customer service.  He spent several minutes on the phone with me and I felt like he was very interested in my experience and what he could do to make things better.  I felt that Mr Jenson was sincerely concerned and was dedicated to improving customer service

I also received the second part of my order almost a week sooner than promised.  My second sofa was scheduled to be delivered sometime after Feb 18th, but I received a call that it would be ready by the 13th.    The delivery this time went MUCH smoother.  I was scheduled for an afternoon delivery and was promised a call between 1:00-3:00 p.m.  I was called at 1:07p.m. and told the sofa would be delivered between 3:00-6:00p.m..  The courteous and careful delivery drivers arrived at 3:15 and did an excellent job getting the sofa through our narrow sliding glass doors.  

After all is said and done, I would shop here again.  The store Manager Jon Jenson, the sales staff Cathy H and Brandon S, the delivery drivers, and the furniture all made up for the poor customer service representatives I spoke with on the phone with the first delivery.

AWFUL AWFUL AWFUL!!!!! Unprofessional, horrible communicators, rude, "shady" to say the least, threatening and power hungry. It is simply AMAZING that these guys are in business! I was dealing with a Boise-based office and the experience would rank at the very top of the "worst business experience ever" list.

First time visiting Soup Kettle Grille and I will definitely be coming back for more. Our server Hailey was super nice and friendly. She helped us pick out an amazing take home soup. We tried a few different kinds, and im officially hooked. The prices are reasonable and the environment is comfortable. This is one of my new favorite lunch spots!

We always enjoy Chick-fil-A and today's food was as good as ever. We always have a cup of thir chicken noodle soup with whatever we order because it is sooooo good :) The reason for 4 stars today is because one impressive thing about eating here is that there is always a PR person walking around to refill your drinks and check to make sure you are happy with your meal.  However - today that staff person spent the whole time we were eating visiting at one table and didn't even scan the area once.  We actually took our drink up to the counter to have it refilled. Otherwise - food and service are always outstanding.
Maliya was super upity and ditzy. I had never been addressed like a "commoner" by someone so vapid before. SHE HAS GOT TO GO!

Greasy, way overpriced, weak menu. Small portions. Even buying the biggest burger and eating half of my wife's I still left hungry. I am not a large person with an eating problem either. Been there a number of times trying to make myself like it and I just can't. Salad was good though may go back for that....just maybe.
Not open Sun or Monday unlike stated on Yelp. This barber shop rocks and it stinks they are closed on my days off
These doughnuts are the best. Especially the red velvet. Staff is generous with the doughnut holes.
It is a avg. runn of the mill park.  Nothing to get excited about.  Seemed to be made for old people.

Nice place , great food and friendly staff.
I will be back. Had the chipotle chicken wrap and it was awesome. Highly recommend it.

Be careful with 6 months no interest plan.  I bought and meticulously paid off both a TV and an oven.  They are charging me $166 claiming they weren't paid off.  I am furious.  A long time happy customer no more.  Taking my business elsewhere.

I really like this clinic. We've never had to wait too long, even when we have been walk ins. The front desk staff has been a little challenging as far as follow through.......But the medical staff and care we receive is great! The hours are also a huge plus! I highly recommend this office.

Well, it was nice that they want to help me with giving me yet another date to hope my tables are in.  They were quick to apologize and say they made a mistake. Doesn't help with giving me accurate date or I would be happy with a close date. Only one star left...going fast. I will call again next Wednesday like I was told to do. I am sure I will get another date to look forward to. Thanks R C Willey.
Best place in town to tan! So many options for any level of tan you want.  Very friendly staff & clean business.  I love this place!

I love the hot dogs and beer battered onion rings I had today. But I especially love all the different flavors of soft ice cream cones and the Peanut Fudge Parfait. I still have to try all their other menu items. I will definitely be back!!

Oh Togo's how I've missed you. Being from California, my life was not complete without Togo's! Togo's costs more here in Idaho than in California and the Franchise manager could definitely be nicer but those are my only complaints! Better than any other sandwich shop I've been to. And, people, don't leave just because there's a line! It goes fairly quickly and it is oh so worth it.

I love soups and often crave them. This place offers 100 types of soups. Committed to have 4 new different ones everyday. Sounds like my kind of place. Price is high for just a soup and the bread that came with it for dipping was a bit stale. I'll try another time and see if the dipping bread offered is fresher. If not, will lower a star. Tried leek and potato soup for about $6. Tasted good. They say they use fresh ingredients. Need to ask what does that mean. Hope none of it from Cisco

This is one of the best Lush shops I have ever been too! This was actually my first lush store I have ever visited and I have become addicted to there products! The staff here was super friendly and very knowledgeable about all the products when I visited. They helped me find some great solid vanilla perfume and body wash! This store is huge in comparison to the shops that are near me! I wish the stores near me were as nice as this one! 

I highly recommend there fairly traded honey shampoo it is the best! It is my go to shampoo!

I highly suggest never using this company as an outside Bartending vendor. Being an Event and Wedding Planner, I've used multiple outside companies for this service, and I've never had such an awful experience before. It's a shame that our venue recommended them. If your venue requires you to use this service, I suggest finding another  venue who will allow another vendor. Having an unprofessional Bartending service can ruin your event, which sadly happened to us by using The Curb.

One star for the nice  patio. Unfortunately, they allow smoking on it which isn't ideal. Can't review the food because we waited and waited but never saw a server. Left without even seeing a menu or having a glass of water.
As always #9 was delish an service was awesome. So glad Boise finally has a Togo's and it's is a great location.

This location is pretty clean and generally have enough checkouts open so the lines don't get very long (YAY!)  and when you use their rewards app and coupons decent prices along with fuel points for discounts at the pump in the area. I don't do all my shopping here because of limited options working around food allergies, along with higher regular pricing on a lot of items.
Great staff and food.  Live music on a few nights is becoming popular.  A great place to get a drink with friends.
Has that Portland vibe. The coffee was on point and the customer service was great! Be sure to check out this new cafe in Meridian!

Service wasn't bad and wasn't great. Came to get my feet scrubbed because of the dry dead skin on my feet. She scrubbed both heals within 20 seconds. Polish looks good but that's about it. Place was clean.

I am new to Boise and tried this salon over the weekend. I have had no problems with girls at other salons in California soaking off my gel nail polish, however this girl at ylan told me "it takes too much time" and insisted on shaving the nail polish off my fingers. My finger nails are already weak and thin and break so easily, needless to say I was not happy. I had made an appt with my friend to get mani and pedis but after sitting down the same girl insisted I should only get a polish change. I felt like she didn't want to be bothered to do my nails. The color I picked out looked nothing like the color on my nails. I told her the color was actually so faint you could still see the white on my nails. She seemed very annoyed to have to put another color on top. She charged me $23 for a polish change. 

    I was getting my nails done for my birthday and now they look like crap and you can still see my cuticles. I wouldn't recommend this salon to anyone! I wouldn't even give them one star.

OK. So, here's my story. I bought a piece of garbage 2006 Subaru from a guy in Eagle, Idaho, and quickly had some concerns that it was band aided for a quick sale. So, I brought it to Heritage and they were absolute gems. Without asking a penny, they reviewed the car and gave me a thorough review, making sure I understood every problem with the problem car I bought. 

On one hand, I felt like an idiot. Why would I let myself buy a car like this and be robbed? But, the guys over at Heritage were so kind. They were a silver lining. It was like they were telling me I had cancer, getting a straight line and being told my options. 

Don't hesitate to go to Heritage. I think they're the best local shop. A little expensive; however, you get what you pay for and for Heritage, they do the work correctly and back their work, unlike "other mechanics" I've had experience with. 

And if you have a car you're looking to buy, please do take it to them before you buy the car. Best money you'll ever spend.

Who doesn't love pizza and beer on a rooftop? This is an awesome little pizza place. So far my favorite slice is probably the green goddess. It has artichokes, and tomatoes, and mushrooms, and other yummy stuff all on pesto. You have to try it. They also have this super delicious, funky potato pizza. Because: Idaho. 
It's a cool place. Exceptionally relaxing. The people who work here are very easy going. I love the experience every time I go. There are video games in the corner, benches lined with skate decks, and some pretty cool art on the bathroom doors. But my absolute favorite part of the place, other than the food, is the rooftop. When you visit, Go just before sundown, sit on the roof under the twinkle lights, stuff your face, and hammer down. It's like therapy.  You won't regret it.

I have friends that rave about this place so I had to try it. This is a national chain so I would expect the food to be the same at all locations. 

My review is that the food it okay. There is nothing wrong with it but there is nothing great about it. I prefer KFC's original recipe better but that it's just my opinion. I guess if you don't like KFC then this is the place to go for a chicken sandwich.

The restaurant is clean and the staff very friendly. Just don't come here On Sunday as they are closed on Sundays.

Service was very bad. Ordered our beers and asked the waitress to come back for our food order.  We didnt see our waitress fo 30 mins.  I asked a go-waitress to let our waitress know we were ready.  The go-between waitress was appologtic and tried to rationalize the long wait because they were busy.... Ummm.. Tables had come in after we got our beers and were half way done with their meals before our waitress came back to check on us(and thats by request).  

Ordered the wings and they were horrible.  Wings were soggy and rubbery ... and the wierd onions on top  gave the wings a wierd taste.  

Other people in our party said the burgers and steak fries were good.. thats why they got 2 stars..

I travel a lot for work, so finding a place to eat that has consistency in its atmosphere, food and service is the hardest thing to find. Hands down Lucky Fins has always done A+++ in my book. From the moment I walk in the door, to the moment I leave. Service is outstanding and friendly! The food is always on point & in a timely fashion. And the atmosphere is Key! Tonight my server was Sam, she did an awesome job! I will be back, again. Thank you all for a great experience!

Well, here it is December 6, 2014, still no tables...but, I was promised, for sure, they are on the way from Salt Lake City. You will have them by December 5, 2014. Bummer! I believed them...my bad. Now I wait for end tables and coffee tables that I was never told were on back order from a purchase date of October 24, 2014. We now wait for a dining room table too, we do have six beautiful chairs,. We were told the dining room table was on back order and we would receive December 5, 2014.   We really hope that we receive the dining room table by Christmas now.  I highly recommend that if you have to shop at RC Willey....please don't put yourself through this agony and make sure they really have it in their warehouse...not in Salt Lake City, not in Reno, but, truly in the store right where you stand. We have been lied to so many times and told so many dates I do not know what to believe.  I do know I will never recommend RC Willey to any of my friends.  Adam Y. I have given you all my information and yes you contacted me but, I still have nothing and RC Willey has my money!
I really like the friendliness and the openness of this coffee shop! The coffee is delicious and the wooden chairs and table are hearty.

I said it the last time I went, but I definitely will never go here again. The bowling lanes aren't properly waxed, the wait staff is not knowledgeable on alcohol and beer, the glass that my drink was served in was cracked, and the nachos were definitely not worth the $20 that they cost. It was a terrible experience overall. I will say though that the wait staff made up for their lack of bar knowledge with their friendliness, but it's not enough to bring me back. Definitely going back to Big Al's.
I ordered the tri-tip sandwiched & to be honest, at best it was uninspired (bland).

This is truly a great spot for Mexican food close to home. We came in tonight (Friday) and it was packed! The staff did a great job of taking care of everyone even though it was packed. Queso dip is a must!! God was pretty good.

The donuts here are always fresh! I've never had a bad experience, very friendly customer service. The Maple bar is my favorite, not too over powering its JUST RIGHT! Their kolaches are also one of my favorites.

We liked Steve's.  A lot.  With some of the negative Yelp reviews we almost passed it by.  That would have been our loss. Because inside the cheerful storefront we found warm greeting at the door, sparkling bright  "all people are welcome here" ambiance, good food  with many items house made, a menu with options for vegetarians to omnivores and it seemed for those who eat gluten free or vegan too, very fair prices, breakfast served all day (yahoo for that) and super efficient and friendly service.  The sign outside says "Breakfast and Lunch among Friends".  That's just what it felt like inside. We will be back. 

FOOD
Noting the owner's surname is Italian (Vincelli), my hubby (whose name ends in a vowel too) asked if the Italian sausage was homemade.  Yep.  And so is the chorizo and so is the chicken apple sausage.  The Italian variety is on his "to try" list for next time.

I appreciated that among the extensive menu of breakfast offerings they had a handful of great options for "lighter fare", which means things like half portion of Eggs Benedict or Classic Breakfast.  Nice.

The kitchen got my poached egg just right (and I order them in completely non PC  'well done' format which is tough for kitchens to do), the bacon was crispy (and enough to share), the biscuit (baked each morning) was fluffy and the hash browns were crispy on the outside, tender on the inside and not one iota greasy.  

My hubby liked his huckleberry pancakes and the huckleberry syrup that came with them was just sweet enough and not too much so it tasted like fresh berries.  The short stack was more than enough to fill him up.

They grind their own coffee beans and the coffee cups were kept filled with a good medium roast brew.

PRICES
Seemed more than reasonable for the food quality and serving sizes.  In our case, breakfast for two with two coffees came in at about $18.00.  Deduct the beverage and for food alone you'd be under fifteen bucks.  A very good value.

AMBIANCE
Booths line the walls and in front of the window.
