Formica tables with wood chairs are in the rest of the space and are thankfully spread far enough apart to avoid "sardine can" seating for diners and too tight squeeze getting to and from for diners or staff.  There are also a few stools at an open counter.  At the 'shoulder time' between breakfast service and lunch all the booths were taken and just a couple of tables with folks who all seemed as if local regulars. 

SERVICE
Topt notch, from greet and seat through order and eat they hit every beat.  We asked several questions about items on the menu and our delightful server could answer every one.

THIS N THAT:

1) STRIP MALL LOCATION / PARKING:  Steve's is tucked off of Fairvew in a little strip mall and can be a bit tough to spot at first.  The benefit of the location is an ample sized parking lot.

2) ACCESSIBILITY:  Level in the door and throughout the space.  Ample standard height seating.  Accessible parking in the lot.

3) WOULD RACISM FLY IN YELP REVIEWS?:  I'm wondering if a reviewer commented in assigning a two star review that he saw too many people inside Steve's with Mexican or Asian heritage and went on to outline stereotypes if that would fly as "funny" in reviews?  I bet not.  I'd find it obnoxious.  So why is it a Yelp review where a leading criticism offered up in a snarky way was that there were too many older people dining at Steve's on the day the reviewer was there a funny review...at least in "Yelp votes"?  Ageism is like racism in my book. Neither one is  funny.   And no matter how hard that Yelper may try, he's gonna be in that population one day.  These older folks are people who helped keep the world safe and the economy fueled in their day.  Should we expect they stay home from a neighborhood cafe?  Please.  And yep, getting close to that age myself, I take it personally.  Enough said.

4) THANKS DUE: to Yelper Carl Y and his spouse because it was their good mention of Steve's that led us to ignore the two star reviews.  Otherwise, we may not have ventured in.  We're glad we did.

We went here recently and the soups are delicious, as well as the sandwiches.  Service is very good.  I like that they let you sample the soup, before making your selection.  I loved the grilled cheese sandwich too!  We will be going back!

This is the first time I've ever been to this location. (used to frequent the Harry's on Main St in Meridian a while back)~I ordered the fingersteak basket...finger steaks were good however for the price the very least they could have done was include a full handful of fries...my daughter got a flatbread sandwich, again with fries...not worth the price. Waitress was very nice- but the service was AWFUL. Most likely won't be back.

Great lunches here!  The lunch specials are pretty reasonable at 10 to 15 considering it is seafood.  Their pastas, dish tacos and grilled fresh fish dinners are all very good
Tony

In a word: Delicious!
The service is quick, concise and friendly. You know you have great service when they bring you something you need before you even ask. I LOVE that. That is how every server works at Lucky Fins. They are mind readers. 

There is typically a saying that you should not eat seafood so far inland. That is not true for Lucky Fins Grill. Whenever I am in town visiting family (having lived in Seattle and San Francisco) this is my first choice to eat at. The sashimi is incredibly fresh and everything is top quality. 
My favorites: 
1. Poke appetizer. your tummy will thank you
2. Hamachi Sashimi with jalapenos. This reminds me of the incredible Hamachi that is served at the famous Nobu restaurants in Las Vegas and San Diego. Mouthwateringly delicious.  
3. Fish & Chips
4. Lobster Pizza

Least favorite: 
1. This odd soup that had red bell peppers but did not say on the menu it had bell peppers. I despise bell peppers. Needless to say, I hated it.

Was out celebrating friends birthday & had dinner at Matador with friends tonight then hang out at the Village Cafe for coffee & decided to just get our desserts here to go. This is a froyo place but it's nice that they also serve some cakes. 

We ordered 3 different kinds (sliced cake), I forgot the names but, there was this chocolate lava, strawberry one & caramel one. It's like $5 each, pretty much the normal price for desserts when you're in a restaurant. It seems like they're not moist enough though & kinda hard, makes you think if they're not freshly baked/made at all but maybe just the type of their cake? Delicious nonetheless! Perfect coffee match!

I like the look of their establishment, it's very inviting actually! Open & well lit! 

I'll probably come again & try their frozen yoghurt with the kids sometime.

Mandi is by far the best chiropractor in Idaho. I've been going to her for a couple years now and she always know what to do. A year ago I tore my wrist up pretty bad. I've been to 2 orthopedic surgeons to try to figure out what's going on and had two cortisone shots. And nothing seemed to be working. On the verge of surgery Mandi asked if she could give it a go and I figured why not. So far it's been 3 months of no pain at all. This is very important because I am a hairstylist and nail tech. I need my wrist and can't take time for surgery. I am truly amazed at how much of a difference this has made.

Good little burger chain.  My wife likes them more than I do, but the food is solid and passable and occasionally craveable.  

The rosemary fries or sweet potato fries are both excellent, but are quite greasy and are potentially hazardous to the rest of your day if you consume many of them.  Same with the onion straws.

The burgers are served pretty dry with a thick, eggy bun, so I would always recommend getting extra sauce of whatever it is you order.  We get the barbecue burger most often.  Very good, quality meat, quality cheese, etc.
One of the best property management companies we have ever done business with. Highly recommend!

Run, don't walk, away from renting or listing a place with this company. Tom is the most unprofessional property manager I've ever encountered and I've dealt with many private homeowners and property management companies over the years as a renter. My calls were never returned, he was unwilling to speak with the homeowners of my place on my behalf, and he's about as rude a person as I've ever had the displeasure of meeting. As a homeowner looking to rent, you should be concerned that he will scare away qualified tenants, because he will. As a tenant, your needs will not be of any concern. If you choose to move forward with this company good luck.

I hadabsolutely no idea what I'm doing when it comes to vaping when I first started coming here. Fortunately unlike other shops I've been to no one cared, and I was treated the same as people spending $300+ on something. They were willing to walk me through everything when I first started and continue to do so.

Y'lan was my go-to salon for gel nails and pedicures - they were decently priced and pretty quick. 

My 3 other friends and I had made a reservation for some mani's and pedi's for 5:30 on a Friday. All of my friends were taken back and my manicure wasn't started until almost 7:00. Really!? The receptionist kept telling me it would "just be a minute" and by this time the soapy water they has me soak my nails in was cold. Finally it was my turn and two women alternated working on my nails - both seemed rushed and it was about closing time. We all paid, tipped, and finally left.

Two days later my gel Polish begins lifting and the nail polish peeled off like butter - in one perfect piece the size of my nail. Irritated, I called Y'lan and they told me to come in to get it fixed. The lady apologized and said it was because she used a UV base coat with an LED light. While waiting, I pushed my cuticles back as I had noticed the this was not done very well the first time. I had to ask the lady doing my nails the 2nd time if she could cut my cuticles for this reason as it seemed she was going to leave my cuticles looking quite gnarly. She cut them and then used the drill to smooth out my nail bed. She painted them, seemed rushed and actually beat me to her own car in the parking lot.  

Two days later my nails started lifting AGAIN. I called Y'lan on a Friday and talked to the receptionist. She said they were "just too busy" at the moment and someone would have to call me back. Monday rolls around without so much as a phonecall and I call in again. The lady said the receptionist lost my number and she hasn't had time to looked for it. At this point I said I just wanted a refund. The lady argued that she can't offer a refund on a "service" - even though I told her that the "service" wasn't very good. I thought maybe they would throw in a pedicure or nail art - SOMETHING to make up for having to have my nails redone twice. Nope! I said I wanted my knew back to go to a girl named Yogi at the salon, because the last time she did my nails they lasted 3 weeks. She said that was who she was gonna have do my nails this time. I asked her what was going to happen of I had to come back for a 4th time and she would never answer me.  

I ended up canceling my 3rd appointment because I was so angry with their customer service and I'll never go back. My friends and I are looking elsewhere for a new place to get our nails and toes done. My nails are so thin brittle after having them filed and drilled down twice in such a short time that they hurt and the nails keep splitting. 

Unless you request Yogi, I wouldn't recommend going here.
This place isn't cheap, and the staff is still figuring things out, but my pastrami was so good!

Have been here many times and have never had such horrible service and treatment as we did this week. We went on Wednesday and got the wristbands from 5-9pm. We decided to go bowling it's included. We had a waitress take our orders and get everything wrong. It's ok cause we told her and she fixed most of it. It seemed like she was new. A while later a short blonde waitress came and asked if we wanted to close the tab. I told her I hadn't ordered yet she grudgingly took my order. A bit later a short dark hair chubby girl came over and told us we had to leave. She asked to see everyone's wristbands then said if you want to play you have to get on the waiting list that's over a hour long. I told her we were never told by anyone that we had a time limit and I hades gotten my food yet she had no comment as my food was just arriving. She then started taking everything off of our table the other girl brought me the bill and proceeded to stand over all of us while I was trying to put mayo on my sandwich and packaged it to go. They both were talking about us standing over us glaring at me that my nephew came and sat by me because he felt they were harassing me. I got up and they both came to our table and started taking the rest of the stuff and were trash talking about us. This was the most disrespectful, harassment, toxic environment for kids I have ever seen. What happened to customer service?? Btw there wasn't anyone waiting to bowl or a hour waiting list.

Best Burger is always sort of a big opinion.   Most are pretty close to same.  
For me:
1. Smashburger
2.  Fuddruckers
3.  Five guys

 But fries are all over the place in quality and taste. By far best fries. 
1. Smashburger
2. Mcdonalds
3. Five guys
4. Fuddruckers but won't eat um

We got three sushi rolls and steak tacos.  The steak tacos were super small and the steak in them was like little bits of burnt steak that they cut off of someone else's steak.  The pico was good but for $14 it was not worth it at all.   It was kind of loud for dinner, but the place was nice.  There are better sushi places in town, but it wasn't bad.
Hands down the best burger I've had anywhere. It's not cheap, but it's worth it here. Smash fries are heaven on earth.

I love this place and the food is really good. I've enjoyed the gyros here and the quality of the food. The food I would rate it a 5, it's tasty and I enjoy it. I've taken away a star for service. I've been here quite a few times, since it's just down the street from my house and my order correctness has only been 1 time. My order is always wrong, but since it's so close to my house, I don't want to go back to get it fixed. Another star is taken away from value. I like their salads, but they are pre-made. Here's my problem with that, I don't like everything in them, so I ask for them to be removed. The logical thing to me, is replace it with something else, but they don't. So here I am paying about $5 for not even half of the small salad. It's not worth it to take anything off. I then ordered a large drink with my combo and it was about an inch and a half from the rim of the cup. The staff is always friendly at this location.
The best donuts in town! We've tried a few places but Sweet Sensations is BY FAR the best around! We drive 20 minutes to get them :)

We are Axiom members and don't like coming to this location. The girls are either not trained or snotty. We really like the Overland location inside Axiom. Olivia and Audi are well-trained and friendly.

Outstanding customer service and quality products from beginning to end! I bought this beautiful little home and the seller took his curtains out. I decided that I wanted custom-made curtains and tie-backs in every room of my home. 

Liza was awesome and so patient helping me pick out the finials, the fabric, and repairing my Hunter Douglas blinds as well.  The process took over nine months because of ordering the fabric and the finials including the installations. The curtains were installed in stages because of my budget. There were able to listen to my concerns each step of the way. 

Most importantly, the curtains were needed for extra privacy and cost-effective way to lower my air-conditioning bills. Having darker rooms during the heat waves, the A/C does not have to work so hard. Over the course of the years as I own this home, I will have a lower carbon footprint.

My house looks like a mini-mansion, so elegant and classy at the same, and not ostentatious. I even got a rebate at the end.  Liza and all of the staff were wonderful answering questions and confirming appointments during the process. My home's value will go up because of these beautiful curtains throughout.  I would highly recommend them for the quality of customer service as well as the high quality products they install.

I had some older 1996 Hunter Douglas blinds that broke.  I came here hoping they would have the part needed to repair our older generation blinds. They had the lift away tape I needed and my blinds were fixed for less than two dollars! Will definitely come back for repairs and eventual replacement. Great to work with!
Great vibe! Decent draught beer selection. Friendly staff. Best mac & cheese ever!! Definitely will return!

Potato skins are absolutely disappointing to say the least. The menu description is incorrect. They are not stuffed but rather covered with some goodies, the potato  is either baked slightly or boiled but not a true potato skin

We are traveling through Meridian in our RV towing our car.   Found we had a slow leak in a tire and were referred by locals to Les Schwab.   Our tire was fixed, the others checked and tires were rotated---for free!   We were speechless!   The employees are all polite, the work was fast, and we were treated kindly and respectfully.  We cannot say thank you enough!

Let me preempt this by saying that this restaurant has only been open a couple of weeks.

Pros - Great atmosphere and decor, decent patio.

Cons - Slim beer selection, slow, confused service, a little overpriced for what you get.

I went here with high expectations for a cool place in Meridian where you could get decent food in a good sports bar atmosphere. I'd classify this as a higher end sports bar without enough televisions. Great open kitchen, which was really an enjoyable experience.

So why three stars? Well the service for one, it was really slow and there weren't many people in the restaurant, two the food was very average. The soup tasted like any soup I could buy in a can at the store and the "secret family recipe" finger steaks were tender but doughy and flavorless, some family secrets should stay in the family. I got five finger steaks on my plate and about a half pound of fries. I'm sure they finger steaks are served by weight but the portion was so visually small that it really made it seem like a poor value.

I'm going to give them one more shot in a month or so to see how it changes but if it doesn't get any better, you have your pick of similar places within a block and Rudy's is much better.

This place is a good for a cute care-free date night or a magical memory creating family night. It's not too expensive to play around; similar to most family arcades. My date and I enjoyed playing a round of mini-golf and we really enjoyed ourselves. The only thing I would have changed would be the 90's boy band music that accompanied us outdoors. 

We got there a little late to experience more fun but it's a clean, safe environment with well stocked bathrooms and a cute pizza joint.
Dreams on the Fly owner/professional guide led Andrew led us on a full day trip and we could not more highly recommend him.  He is very knowledgable,  infinitely patient, and a true professional.

My kids love this place but I wasn't so thrilled.  They don't tell you that the unlimited wristbands expire after a few hours. I had one kid (in the party we hosted) get so upset, after waiting in line for the bumper boats for over 15 minutes and then come to find out he couldn't cause the wristband had expired, that he cried. We scheduled a party and they didn't even give us a party "attendant" like they promised, they just dropped off the pizza and walked away.  And the pizza is gross and gave EVERYONE indigestion (and I chose the nice word).

Again , don't want to give one star but only option ! I tried getting ahold of you on Monday , and I was on hold for 20 min , the customer service lady said she'd have to get ahold of the mattress department manager , I've been waiting all week with 2 calls back to rc willey , finally I was told that someone would be out to inspect mattress on aug . 15th!! 
I'm very upset , I'm tired of sorrys ! 
And I'm not even staying with my fiancé anymore because I can't sleep !!! 
Should we both go to the doctor and send you our bill from our backs being messed up!? Not to mention my hips , his shoulders and my chest!? 
This is beyond unacceptable !!! 
Completely ridiculous ! 
We want our money back ! Not a new mattress from you !!!! 
Never ever doing business with rc willey again !!! 
My body has paid the price !!!!

Our experience buying and set-up was good.  What I am not happy about is the company's customer service.  My pump quit working after  a little more than 2 years.  I called the store thinking that they could schedule a repairman to come here the next day.  My bed is concave and no way to change it.  We own a king and a queen with sleep IQ from that store.  I was given a 1-800 number to call.  The service person on the phone was great but I am sick and have arthritic hands so it was hard for me to go through all the testing with his prompts.  In the end I was told they would send me a new pump, it will cost approx. $180 and will arrive in about a week.  I think I could have done better with a different company.

So far being my first time experience at shopping at this store its been a comedy of errors.....

First off the Sales Lady, Maggie was awesome!  Very good at what she does and made me feel welcomed and helpful through the process of buying furniture for a spare bedroom for guest coming a week later.. She was spectacular!

However, when the furniture arrived 4 days later it came with the wrong sized bed rails, full instead of a queen. No worries, mistakes happen.  When can they right rails come?  Saturday they say and will kindly credit my delivery charge..($59) (Still waiting for that).... Well today (Saturday) they arrive my guests wont have to be hobo's sleeping on the mattress laying on the floor...

Oh WAIT, they have the same full size rails, same that were the wrong size before Wednesday?

Now I'm pissed...And the customer service rep says "I'll refund half the cost of the rails" ($50) and we will get you the new ones...

Now i'm livid, what is going to make me believe that this is next time is going to be any different? you can credit the whole bill for as much as I care, I have guests sleeping on the floor...

The rep was nice, apologized and all the standard customer bla bla bla.. but yeah RC Willey will not be my 3rd choice next time I look to buy furnishing...and it has nothing to do with their staff but the quality and consistently of their stock and ensuring mistakes dont happen a second time...

Favorite restaurant in Idaho. Service is excellent. A little noisy, but not bothersome. Everything I have had is good. Fish tacos are to die for. Honey seared salmon is on pointe. Salmon dish is better than tilapia if you are trying to decide between the two.

We live in Baker City but come to Meridian for their wonderful Fred Myers super -store.. We haven't been in while and noticed a new restaurant across the street.  I hit up a Fred's employee to inquire about the Flamed Broiler and he said " it's very decent fresh food ". Good enough for me. 
We had the grilled steak bowl with rice and veggies with green onions as a topping.  Wow! Very good. All the rice is gluten -free and non GMO grown in California.  The beef is certified grass grown and delicious . Plus they have a "sauce-bar " for your bowl.  Tangy to triple hit!  Yum. 
Cost:$7.95. They have mini bowls for less and "plates" for $2 more.  Plus you can have grilled chicken or tofu for you who don't eat flesh.  Very fresh and tasty.  Great staff too.  Clean booths and flat screen TVs with sports.

The friendly service and homemade food make this one of my favorite places tho eat.  Steve is a great guy.  He cruises around making sure everyone is happy.  Food is always good.  Hashed browns are the best as are their huckleberry pancakes and home made sausages.

I really, really like this place. I have had two of the best massages at Body Calm, one by Teresa and the other by Noaeu, both are excellent massage therapists and I have been to a lot of them. The atmosphere is calm and inviting.  Paul who I believe is one of the owners, is really welcoming, kind and informative.  The prices are pretty much average for massage/spa like experience.  They are worth a visit.
A little too spendy for what you get. The food was OK but nothing to write home about. If you want seafood there are better choices in the area.

The coffee is actually very tasty, simple just like I like coffee. The atmosphere leaves a lot to be desired if they are going to survive in that spot (long history of failed business there)  I had the americano to see if the flavor was there, and I truly enjoyed it. I hope they stay.

I  have been getting my nails done at this salon for years. Love the friendly and relaxing atmosphere. The owners are amazing at their craft and making their customers feel comfortable.  I have never had any nails pop off or even chip.  Their art and designs are imaginative, elegant and beautiful.

They are polite and friendly. Pushy about buying their products like lotions, etc. when signing up. Tan beds and rooms are clean. No hidden cancellation fees when ending membership. Too busy to use this service currently. But will come back later.

First of all they will say anything and everything to part you from your money. Delivery dates, product quality, fitting your needs whatever! They will say it all, until that money changes hands then it's all out the window. We were promised a specific delivery date as we left our vacation the day after the proposed date. Fast forward to the day when no one shoes up and they try and argue with us about what date they said they would be out, fine a day short on our annual vacation. I can live with that, but within less than two months our living room set was showing incredible sharp staples on the arms of the couches as the fabric separated in various places, not long after the bed from the bedroom set began sinking on the left side while making the loudest creaking sound you can imagine if you simply tried to roll over. Oh did I mentioned it was all delivered with no plastic or moving cloths? Well we tried to seek respite but although they claim otherwise no one bothered to show up on the date when they were suppose to repair or check it all out. Which was scheduled by them nearly 2 months out from the day we contacted them. Now I can't even use my side of the bed without nearly rolling off, the ottoman leg falls out and won't screw in the cushions have flattened like pancakes and it's only been some 18 months.

Really feel violated and exploited by these guys, it was our first all new living room and bedroom set and it's in as bad as condition as what it replaced.

Lastnight was supposed to be a great time, girls night with a band we were looking forward to seeing but what a NIGHTMARE.  We even called to make a reservation so we knew we would have a table.  Upon arriving we were told by the hostess that there was a birthday party upstairs so we couldn't go up there, I explained that we had a reservation which went right over her blonde head.  We ordered a pitcher of COORS LIGHT which came out in a WATER pitcher, of which we didn't even get 4 full glasses (there were 5 of us) we ordered potato skins (8.99) fried pickles (7.99) and a jalapeño pretzel (7.99). The pickles and pretzel arrived fairly quickly, however almost an hour later we still had not got the potato skins.  The waitress came to take our empty dishes and asked if we would like to order anything else and we told her we were still waiting for the skins.  She found that they had been taken to another table but got some more ordered and to us quickly.  The skins, remember $8.99 came to the table.....there are 4, yes 4 skins....not even enough for our party to each have one.  In the mean time one of the members of our party went upstairs to find out if we could get to our table because it is now ten minutes to 9pm only to find out that they had given our table away (THAT WE WERE TOLD WE COULDN'T GO UP AND SIT AT) because we didn't show up....SO.....now extremely irritated I receive my bill of which shows the price of the mini pitchers of beer....WHO in their right mind would charge $13.00 for a WATER PITCHER of beer..do they pour it from a golden spout...I asked to talk to a manager (Nikki) who not only proceeded to glare at us from behind the bar, but refused to even make an effort to come over and speak to me, after 30 more minutes of waiting to speak to a manager we were able to talk to Paige who was actually working upstairs, she came all the way downstairs to help take care of the problem.  In the mean time the blonde hostess is cleaning a table behind us and when we inform her that since she did not allow us upstairs that we have now lost our RESERVED table, she proceeds to tell us in a very unprofessional tone "I can't turn back time so I'm not sure what you expect me to do about it".  Needless to say, I won't be back, it was AWFUL and there are plenty of other places I can/will spend my time/money at.

I got $900 LG washer from the store and got financing which is good. So only reason why I shop at that store sales guy was nice. But the To delivery guys that came out complain all the time and my old washer broke and had water in it and I just kinda laughed and said wow I bet that heavy just joking with the guy and he's like I don't know why you're laughing but the guy couldn't take a joke and he tried just to drop off my new washer in my living room instead of putting in the laundry room and they didn't take the old washer out so you're better off saving your money and just take it home and install it yourself. And to my surprise they just left my old wash machine in the middle of my driveway and I had to call the delivery manager to tell them to come pick it up worst customer experience ever!PS I think the delivery guy needed a pill for his huge vagina He was complaining so much.

Went with my man to see the new place as the old Harrys used to be my home away from home. I will start out saying that the layout and bar its self was pretty cool...but...we sat at the end of the bar so we could take in the whole new  experience of things. First thing is if your short, as I am, it was not made for you to sit at the bar as the  stools are very tall with nowhere to put your feet..Second..we sat for 12 minutes and was not welcomed, told they would be with us in a few, or even acknowledged that we were there even though the bartender looked at us several times,was not busy and seemed like she could care less..third after having the bartender finely ask if we wanted a drink, making us feel like we where putting her out to have to ask and not personable at all, we ordered and proceeded to wait some more for our drinks to arrive. We where not going to eat at first then decided to get something to munch on..asked for menus then sat and waaaiittteeeddd for her to take our order..now the bar is getting kind of busy, we can see people coming in and having to wait a good 10 minutes for any help and was able to hear 2 tables behind us comment how they wouldn't be back..25 minutes later our food comes out from a waitress that was in the back running food...she in my opinion should be out helping behind the bar as she was a doll and could tell our fustration when she delivered our COLD food! in all for the $70.00 we spent in the 1.5 hours we was there I was not impressed at all. We did end up with a different bartender who I remember from the old Harrys that I loved..she ran her butt off as the other bartender did not make us feel comfortable at all...not sure if we'll go back sadly. The bar its self was net...staff on the other hand especially the bartender that we had to deal with not so much..

Atmosphere is pleasant and the place is clean.  Service was prompt and efficient.  And the food was quite good.  I had the ruben sandwich and fries.  The corned beef was seasoned very well and was very lean.  The fries were delicious!  There was plenty of food.  My wife had an omelet with some delicious sausage, salsa, and hash browns - and pancakes.  My wife said the coffee was not as good as she likes.  We will return and try other items on the menu.

We usually get here once a month.   Food is always good and service is normally better then normal.  Today wait for food was extremely long and found out that they had a computer glitch and backed up tickets.  Manager and server were very apologetic for the delay.  Best part of the customer service was manager comped our breakfast.  We were not expecting that but greatly appreciated.  That is awesome customer service and we will continue to come back and make sure we share this experience.   
Anymore it is hard to find good customer service in the treasure valley restaurants.  This is what should be.

Talk about a bunch of morons!!! I only gave them one star cause i had too.  It took these idiots 1 week to schedule a delivery. And after they scheduled the delivery we waited and waited for another week and a half just to hear some lame ass excuse as to why it hadn't been delivered yet,  either " oh, its not on my truck, to we'll deliver tomorrow morning.  After waiting for these dip shits for almost 3 weeks i gave up and told them to take there crap and shove it up there ass!  Btw this was after spending roughly 1,000 $.  What a Fucken JOKE!   You can get better service at your nearest Mcdonalds!
Great food and a neighborhood feel. The people were kind and energetic and treated everyone like family. Highly recommend
Love this place! I was in town visiting a friend and ended up coming here twice in 3 days. I had food and ice cream and I have no complaints about either. Really wish there was one near me.

Tried Steve's for the 1st time today. Hit them at the busy lunch hour on a Saturday. We had to wait about 15 minutes to be seated, but they offered coffee to everyone waiting. Service and food were good. The only complaint is that it took 20+ minutes for our food to come out, and we only had pancakes, eggs, and bacon - generally fast items. We'd go back!

My Classic Smashburger was good, and I don't like burgers unless I'm ravished! But the kicker for me was location and the fries (both times were cold). Compared to Five Guys, it's a go as far as the burger is concerned, but it definitely didn't blow my socks off.

Ayé díos mio!

 Ice popped in for some tacos y cervezas, only to learn that this joint had recently lost its liquor license. No bueno!

Not sure if that cloud is still hanging over the CV, but if so, be forewarned.

Their donuts are melt in your mouth good. I am not a donut person and usually pass when offered one but some ladies highly recommend this place. I went and got a few donuts for the family and they are amazing! So light and fluffy and not overly sweet. They also fill the donuts when you buy them, if you are into filled donuts. We've been back 1x a week since the first time and we are customers for life. This place is so good!

Great staff, they closed at 20:00, but continued serving me all I could eat crab until 21:00 as well as several other tables seated after us. Super great food. Treated my wife to a complimentary piece of Mango Cake. It was also amazing.
Love this place. The are off the chart friendly. The salsa is really good and they don't let your drink go empty. The food is fantastic. We have loved this place 17 years and counting.

I always love shopping at RC Willey. The salesmen are never high pressure and are always very pleasant and professional.  This trip was to purchase a refrigerator as ours had gone out that morning. The gentleman that assisted us took the time to see what refrigerators they had in Stock and could be delivered the next day. We were very happy with this experience.
Amazingly wonderful soup! Really nice staff and clean establishment. Feels a little pricey, but for a quality home cooked felt soup, its worth it.

Hit the drive through for a quick dinner after running around all day. The person taking my order was super friendly. Service was very quick. It was busy inside and there were a few cars in front but the wait was not very long at all. The food was fresh and very delicious. My son loves the nuggets here. My wife and I snacked on the fries on the way home, they were great. Especially when dipped in their Polynesian sauce!!

Well first time at this location....and won't be coming back.

I ordered from the vegetarian menu and from the dessert menu too. 

Drove home about 5 miles away.

Both full of meat. They are labeled correctly but the wrong empanadas. I assume the arroz con leche is not supposed to be chicken and potatoes WITH POWDERED SUGAR ON TOP yuck!!

Needles to say I won't be going back. If you don't eat meat I'd recommend breaking the empanada open first before taking a giant bite of it.
All I have to say is...Sweet Potato SmashFries.  I can die now.

Five 5-star reviews and nothing else? 

Yeah it was pleasant enough but it was sort of spartan with limited coffee menu choices. I went on a Saturday so I couldn't sample a food menu, but there were some tasty Mexican soup samples they were passing out.  Will try back when food is being served.

Coffee was done right, no complaints there, and sure enough they know how to draw leaves with the cream.  Prices are comparable to the market averages.

I agree with the lack of hipsters being a positive, but I hope something else fills the void.  It is the one coffee shop in the valley guaranteed not to cause claustrophobia.  Maybe a few pics on the walls is all it would take.

It's right next to TCBY and it's in the same  space half a dozen coffee shops occupied before it, notably Moxie Java.  I wish them well and hope they grow into the five star ratings they have gotten so far.

I had the roasted tomato basil soup and the buffalo grilled cheese. Both amazing. I was curious about the lemonades and they allowed me to try both, carrot lemonade (yes, carrot lemonade) and the berry lemonade. Both were really good. 
Great food. Even better service and friendliness.
Just come and eat. The empanadas are authentic and delicious and worth double what they charge.

I received my first pedicure here and loved it so much! The massage chairs were amazing and my nails are still not chipped after 3 weeks, regular nail polish. The prices are very affordable and they have punch cards! You even get a discount for paying in cash. I will be back.

Used Dreams on the Fly for a full day outing yesterday and had an awesome experience fishing the Owyhee system in Oregon.

I've been fly fishing perhaps four or five times, all with guides.  Without fail all of my fly fishing outings have been great fun and experience.  So, I pretty much knew what to expect from a guide session.  Dreams on the Fly did not disappoint.

I'm in Idaho for the first time in my life, and on my list of things to do was to do some fly fishing.  So I give Dreams a call a few days before flying into Boise.  Dreams indicated that the best fishing at the time would be on the Owyhee system about 50 miles west of Boise, and that they could accommodate us.  So I made the reservation.  Before I reached Boise, we got a couple more calls from the guide asking for things like accommodations required, meal preferences, etc.  I appreciated their anticipation for our arrival, and attention to details.

Dave, the guide, picked my wife and I up at the hotel the day prior to the outing to take us to get fitted for waders and boots, and to pick up the essential equipment.  We had a wonderful chat with the shop owner, and were fitted.  Dave collected all the gear and delivered us back to our hotel.

Dave then picked us up at 10am to take us out to the Owyhee.  The drive took us about an hour and half, and we had a nice chat getting to know each other, and talking about Boise and the surrounding areas.

We fished a total of three spots throughout the day, landing perhaps seven or eight nice sized brown trout.  I think one of these was perhaps a foot long, but all of the others were more like 20 inches or better.  So, it was a great day.  We fished our fishing at about 9PM.  

The guide was always professional, knowledeable, patient, very courteous, and flexible.  Couldn't have asked for more.

This is the absolute worst freaking tire facility I have ever dealt with.   The company I work for insists on using them regardless of their horrible customer Service.  Waited 90 minutes for a simple tire rotation and they still did not get it set l done. Obviously people coming in to purchase new tires are way more important then maintenance customers even when we have 70+ vehicles in our fleet.  NEVER EVERY AGAIN.

Checked out their new restaurant on a Saturday morning for breakfast. No wait at all. This was after our first two stops had 30+ minute waits.
Nice clean restaurant/bar. They were open at 9:30 on a Saturday morning, but I found out they can't serve a Bloody Mary until 10am because of their liquor license.
Hubby got a scramble and I got the Philly omelette. Both came with toast. Mine came with hash browns also. Although mine was more warm than hot, all was good. My husband liked his too.
The service is why I'm knocking this down a couple stars. Our waitress was very friendly, and didn't screw up our orders, but got lucky on that. She didn't bother asking what kind of toast either of us wanted. So either they only have sourdough (which was what we got and was actually very good) or she didn't know or think to ask what we wanted. And for my hubby's scramble she didn't ask how he wanted his eggs. They came out as overcooked fried eggs. He didn't mind, but if that was my dish I would have had to send them back because I don't like eggs cooked that way. 
Also, I ordered the Peppar Bloody Mary, which I actually pointed to on the menu when I ordered it. She instead brought me, and charged me for the bacon bloody Mary. It was a good bloody Mary so I didn't complain. But didn't realize the difference until we got the bill.
Would we go there again? Yes. The food was good and there were other things on the menu that I'd like to try. However, of we do and the wait staff isn't better I'll deal with the long waits at our normal breakfast joints.
And at 10am this is very clearly a bar. Shots and big beers being poured as we ate our breakfast. Not that I have a problem with that, but don't think it's an environment for kids. While we were eating there was a family, with several young kids in their party.

This was our first time at Lucky Fins and every single aspect of our experience was fantastic. Service was incredible, food was sublime, drinks were delicious. Amazing. (Our server, John, was magnificent.)

First time. Friendly staff, fast. They deliver to your table, inside or out. 

Nice old fasioned ice cream and candy shop. With a nice variety of specality candies. 

A new regular motorcycle stop.

All of the servers are very friendly and helpful to one another.  Their uniform is jeans and non matching polos, very informal.  The decor is clean, pleasant with a touch of country charm.

We couldn't decide what to get, so the server very nicely brought us a taste sample.  Yep, the Montana Chili was worth ordering.  Yummy and not too spicy at all.  It came with fresh crunchy tortilla chips with just the right amount of salt.  

One main reason I continue to come here is for the hash browns.  They are awesome.  Cooked all the way through in butter, crunchy and great compared to the half cooked hash browns that seem to be the norm these days.

The bacon was just the right amount of crispy without being over done and chewy. The moist fluffy scrambled eggs looked great, but they were a bit bland.  Not sure how to fix that besides adding more pepper or butter.

There was a 15 minute wait for the food but with ordering the chili and meatball dish, it probably took them a while to get it together.  The meatballs were very full flavored, a touch spicy and chewy.  The hoagie roll was very fresh and soft.

Soda tasted good.  No music blaring in the background.  This was my daughter's favorite restaurant.

I can not recommend that anyone purchase here. It's been  one month since paying for my new sofa and love seat, and still haven't had them delivered.   The last I heard, my sofa is in Reno.   It seems they really don't care, as long as they get their money.
Delicious. Friendly service. I want to eat the meatball grilled cheese every day for the rest of my life.

This has got to be the best burger I have ever eaten--bar none!  The flavor of the beef was delicious and the seasoning just perfect. We tried the swiss and mushroom burger and it needed nothing else on it--no ketchup or mustard.  It was really moist also.  The fries were good also. The large size burger  is enough for two people to share.  There are a lot of other choices on the menu as well, like salads, chicken sandwiches, hot dogs, chili, and even a black bean burger, which would be fun to try!
Brought the family in for a nice meal.  Chef Mark's Guatemalan Wild Mahi Mahi was absolutely incredible!!  One of the best seafood dishes I have ever eaten!!  Great atmosphere and excellent service

These guys had the best Poke I've ever had. Good fish and shrimp tacos. The flatbread would be better if it was crunchier. It was hard to eat since all the toppings would fall off when you picked it up. Overall good food and good happy hour.

For a fast food restaurant, they sure do deliver excellent customer service. The food never disappoint. I used to come here once a week. I've tried other locations but I feel like this one is the best.

My friend and I are visiting from out of town and had the lunch hour free. After some online research, we came upon Corona Village.

At first glance, this restaurant is located in a very humble, possibly crumbling strip mall. Off-putting as the building may be, there are definitely some gems inside.

The staff is pretty quick to provide service and very friendly. He offered us a spicier salsa when he saw us fiddling with the hot sauces. The restaurant also customarily gives retried beans along with the salsa with their chips. We ordered the queso as our appetizer and got a liberal serving of creamy, well-spiced cheese.

For our entrees, we both ordered the vegetarian chimichangas, which came in very large portions and with beans, rice, sour cream, and guacamole. The chimichanga itself was nice and crispy, with a stuffing of delicious vegetables and a jalapeño cream sauce.

A pleasant surprise at the end of the meal was a small plate of complimentary sopapillas. Overall, I really enjoyed my experience at this establishment. Good food and great service! Don't let the outside of the building fool you.

Honestly literally the worst experience I've had at a restaurant. Went with my wife and we ordered, waited 20 minutes and were told they couldn't do her request on a salad. She ordered something else and we waited another half hour. Her order came out mine was nowhere to be found. Turns out they did not put my order in at all and had the wrong thing on the order anyway so I guess it doesn't really matter. Terrible.

Loved the finger steaks, not greasy.  The horseradish cocktail sauce really good.  Chicken tenders had great crunchy batter and the fried green beans outstanding.  Our waitress was funny and attentive.

I freakin love me some chick fil a! I get the number 1 with chick fil a sauce and an Arnold Palmer to drink :) Shout out to my girl Emily Lange for doing an awesome job there marketing! And to Henry, the nice gentleman who refills our drinks :)
The kitchen has recently closed.    If you are just looking for a beer they can accommodate you.    They always had great burgers but now that is just a memory.

My wife and I had ordered the special today, the ahi and halibut. Upon cutting open the halibut, out came worms, enough so that their wiggling bodies covered every visible portion of the fish.  Our appetite was ruined, food returned, the manager apologized and gave us a $25 gift card that was a nice gesture that we will not be taking advantage of anytime soon.  We have eaten here a few times and always enjoyed the food.  Hopefully this was a one time issue.

Best hash browns in town and the chicken fried steak is awesome. Try to go early as they fill up fast. We've waited 45 minutes to be seated before, but it you can get there before 10am on a Saturday, you're golden. One of the top 3 of breakfast places around town. go there- you won't be disappointed!

I always take my out of town workmates to Lucky Fins and they are always impressed. The food is affordable & delicious and the ambience is pretty cool too. The service is friendly (the Chef usually makes rounds saying hello to everyone). Yesterday was no exception. I'd love to see them open another spot in downtown Boise because I bet they would do pretty good there too. I only wish they could bring back the Jamaican Style Escovitch which was my favorite!

Not impressed at all. The Spicy Baja burger was on the very rare side as well as my companions. The regular fries tasted like rosemary. Had I wanted the rosemary and olive oil fries I would have ordered them. The iced tea tasted like one tea bag per 3 gallons of water tea. Had it been one just one item that wasn't satisifactory I could have lived with that but all 3 is not acceptable. Won't go back.

With experience comes all advances in all things. The staff here has become excellent at encouraging experienced in new riders. The format has evolved significantly and in a very positive way. This spinning establishment now can go toe to toe with any of the best national chains like Flywheel.

This Domino's really is the best domino's we have ever ordered from.
The manager Doug really does make sure the pizza's that go out of his store are the best quality.
Doug is also really big about helping his local community, my daughter has gone into his store multiple over the last 4 years of high school and he always has done something to help with her cheer leading fund raisers and my other daughter has gone in the last three years and he has always helped with her fund raisers as well.
Doug really should be training not only the managers for his area here in Idaho but should also be training the cooks and drivers. everyone is always very pleasant and helpful.

Great job Doug keep up the good work

Best place I've gone to get my nails done! They are so friendly and they do an amazing job EVERY time! They do the best pedicures, sugar scrub, leg and foot massage, and they always give you a hot towel at the end. Very relaxing, I highly recommend this place!
Great service! It was fast, and the manager went to each individual table and asked each customer if they needee anything or if he could do anything for them.

My husband had noticed a sign for Sweet Sensations near our home. He went to go grab a box on what happened to be their grand opening.  They were almost sold out of everything, so we only got to try some glazed donuts, blueberry donuts, and raised donuts with chocolate icing.  When we get donuts, we typically get a dozen.  That's usually enough for my husband and I to have one or two, our kids to pick the icing off of one a piece, and a few left over for a snack that evening or the next day.  When I first bit into a blueberry donut, I was surprised at how light it was.  It wasn't greasy or dry.  It was blueberry donut perfection.  My husband and I were leisurely sipping some coffee and eating our donuts, when we looked over and realized that the box was empty.  I have 3 small children.  They typically gnaw all the icing off, crumble the donut into a billion pieces, and ask for another donut to repeat the process.  But that morning, they had each eaten 3 entire donuts and wanted more.  I have never seen any of my children eat an entire donut, let alone, 3 a piece.  I only got to try 1 1/2 donuts, but they were both light and fluffy.  The glazes were perfect.  We've tried almost all of the donut shops around Boise, and these are by far my favorite.

This place is a great new addition to the bleak Meridian dining scene. Lucky Fins was opened in the same location of the defunct Blue Ribbon Bistro. This location has seen quite a few flops since Blue Ribbon Bistro. There was a terrible Italian restaurant, followed by a "gourmet" burger place. I have a feeling that Lucky Fins is here to stay.

I had the blackened catfish with bourbon creme sauce and crawfish tails. I have to say that it was the best seafood dish I've had in the Boise area. I'm not sure where they get the crawfish in this area but they were superb. The catfish was cooked perfectly and the seasoning was spot on. 

The restaurant does seem to have a bit of an identity crisis. The menu features a mix of Cajun, Mexican, Jamaican, Italian  and Sushi. (WTF?)  I guess the focus is seafood but I fear that any restaurant that spreads itself out over so many cuisines tends to lose focus. That doesn't seem to be the case yet at Lucky fins. I tried their one of their specialty sushi rolls and it was incredible. 

There's no doubt that I'll be making this one of my favorites in the months to come.

Friendly servers, fun chalk art walls and an eclectic mix of patrons make The Curb my very own Cheers! I'm never disappointed with the food, drinks or ambiance. The outdoor patio area, with its beautiful mix of flowers, is a relaxing place to enjoy nachos and a cold beer or three!

It's hard not to be a hypocrite when playing the grocery game, wanting to get as much as possible for your buck yet remaining cognizant of where your food came from and its impact on your body. Rosauers is a pretty good compromise. It's a bit more expensive than the other local stores but the quality is MUCH higher. I am so grateful they entered this neighborhood near my sister's house. Now we can actually find the fresh, quality ingredients we are looking for when we cook for my family.  They have an excellent selection of organic and natural foods and the staff is quite nice too. Last but certainly not least, the beer and wine section is also pretty stellar. Sweet.
Oh, and if you don't believe me, check out the BBB site on this business. They have an "F" rating with 6 complaints against them.

Good atmosphere and great food. Had the oysters and ahi poki for appetizers and did not regret it for a second. My fiancé had honey glazed salmon and she loved it and I had the scallop risotto which was a great choice. Highly recommend this restaurant to anyone who's looking for good seafood in Boise with a fun atmosphere. The staff was also very friendly and attentive. We will be back here the next time we are in this area.

This is pretty generic Mexian food, nothing on the menu really stuck out to me as "special" and I was right, the food was good, but not great. I was excited to try the queso that everyone was clamoring about on their reviews, but I was a little disappointed, I've definitely had better.

Overall food is good and service is ok. 

Fun/weird side note, all of the servers here are SUPER short!

Finally had trouble with my furnace this very cold winter.  Polar Heating was recommended by my home warranty company.  Charlie came out and was able to fix things right up, even better than it was before.  He explained several different things with my system and I am much more educated about gas furnaces now!  I recommend them highly!

Sometimes the best part about getting your nails done is the staff... aside from the killer job on my perfect french pedi, there is always a "comic relief" atmosphere when I'm at the salon. 

Growing up Korean in Idaho makes you VERY ethnic. No, my parent's do not own a drycleaners, nail salon or wok. But for this very brief segregated moment I feel like i'm "IN" when there. How many white girls get the same speal when they're there? "You want long nail?, I do fo Figh dolla!." - try talking to the wonderful staff once in a while, they're hilarious- mostly because of the language barrier, but I guarantee you'll leave in a better mood. 

See I don't go to the spa because i'm too lazy to paint my nails- it's for the theraputic laughter & accomodating staff. Sassy staff rock and will keep me coming back.  

TIP: The guy does the best french tip!

I had one of the most positive dining experiences here. The service was spectacular, the manager was very attentive, it was clean, the atmosphere was inviting, and the sushi was nothing short of amazing. 

The manager came and checked up on us twice. The second time it was because we returned a sushi roll that wasn't exactly up our alley (not that it was poorly executed, but rather I took a risk on something outside of my comfort zone and wasn't thrilled with it). She came and asked for our feedback and was *so* kind and understanding. 

The location is a little hard to find and its hard to see off Eagle Road but, once you know it's there, you won't be able to forget it. I'll definitely be coming back for my next sushi craving

* Rumors are this business is outselling KFC with just half the number of restaurants. Not sure about that, but I see Chick Fil A has expanded into Boise, with 4 new locations since I've lived here. Maybe its the superior condiments?
* I've seen their billboards around the country, with the silly cow humor. To summarize: save a cow, "Eat mor chikin". If the chicken here didn't taste so good, those cow ads would dock at least one star from my rating.
* Here in Boise, I've been through a few drive throughs and ordered the classic Chick Fil A sandwich, with Chick Fil A sauce -- its delicious but its more of a thick mayonnaise than a dipping sauce. Hard to spread onto a sandwich from the little tub or cup, unless you get a butter knife to help.
* Today is my first walk-in. When asked for todays special, the waitress replied, "Sir, we don't have specials. Sorry." So I tried the nuggets meal. Still is great tasting chicken. And I tried a couple different dipping sauces. Polynesian (with pineapple juice) , and barbecue. None were bad, but I'm partial to certain barbecue sauces. Another story for another day. Surprised by a janitor who offered to refill my lemonade cup, and its darn good house-made lemonade.

Super busy on Saturdays.   Good food but waited a while to seat and get food.  Waitress was very short.  She was nice but very busy so I got a little bit of the soup Nazi feeling. 
Food came out as ordered.  Had to ask several times for forks as they were so busy she forgot.  
Summary: great food.  Basic atmosphere that is friendly for families.  Go on a weekday when less busy.

Steve's Cafe is one of my favorite local breakfast spots. Nothing fancy decor wise, but my breakfast is always perfectly made! My favorite go-to breakfast is the half order of the classic Benedict, and I add avocado to it and I prefer the hollandaise sauce in the side (it also comes with hash browns). I have been here several times and always leave happy. I do want to branch out and try something sweet next time, and I anticipate that will be a great experience as well. On a side note, I really like that they put down a large white sheet of paper under the kids high chair when my son is eating. He always drops food and it makes clean up easy! And makes me not feel as bad when half of his food ends up on the floor (by accident- he's only 1 year old).

We've eaten at Soup Kettle a couple of times now and I can honestly say it's some of the best soup I've had and a nice break from a regular ol' fast food dinner. The service is friendly and helpful and I love trying the free samples. The soups and sandwiches are made from scratch and you can taste the difference! Together we've had the clam chowder, roasted potato leak, buffalo chicken soups, Reuben, chicken salad, grilled cheese, and meatball sandwiches. Everything was delicious but I think our favorite has been the buffalo chicken and leek soups and the grilled cheese sandwich... That was just amazing! Give it a try. You'll be back!!!
I love the CycleBar! The instructors are phenomenal. I look so forward to every class! I always get a great workout and have so much fun!
Love this park, the play structure is wonderful and the picnic tables are a great place to sit and read while the kids play!
l eat  Breakfast here almost every time l am in town, The house made sausages are fantastic. make it a point to try Steves the next trip to town.
Arrived about an hour before closing on a weeknight. Service was good, food was good. I had a grilled chicken salad. A little spendy, but I'll probably go back.

The show room is wonderful, but i must warn you IT IS HORRIBLE after you have purchased your product! I purchased a couch on the 2nd of Dec, it was backordered. ok i understand, not there fault. Said it would be in on the 14th. Got a call Jan 4 saying it was in. Said it would be delivered on the 11th. Well today is the 11th, i received no call from the delivery department so i called, she told me its still in Salt Lake and scheduled for the 18th. Pleas tell me, what good is a product sitting in salt lake for over 2 weeks that was bought and completely paid for 6 weeks ago. Unfortunately Boise is lacking in nice furniture stores. Unless you are willing to pay Thomasville prices, you are screwed.

Do not ever go to this location. I'm not sure where they find their employees here but they all look like they are on drugs and act like it. My kids love Taco Bell so we now drive across town now. They need to clean this place up big time. They are barely open now. As you can tell by pictures at 10:20 they were still not open.
Excellent soup, sandwich and service. A bit pricey for lunch. Would be great to pick up supper on the way home from work. Has drive thru.

The Curb recently catered and tended bar at our wedding, and the staff did such an incredible job! We had BBQ Chicken Kabobs, and Asian style Meatballs, with their famous Mac N Cheese (with bacon) and some garlic bread and caesar salad. Their bar staff also did a fantastic job. I would highly recommend The Curb to anyone in need of catering, wanting to host a private party, or just for a fun place to kick back and grub out!

We went here for dinner a few weeks ago. This is definitely a "Bro" joint. I ordered the patty melt with Mac and cheese and my husband ordered the finger steaks. I also ordered 2 bloody Marys and he got 2 beers. The patty melt was fantastic! The Mac and cheese, not so much. Very soupy cheese sauce with so much bacon on top that all you could taste was bacon. I tried one of the finger steaks and it was ok, but I'm not really into finger steaks. Our waitress was pleasant but it took her a while to bring our drinks. I ordered my second Mary and waited for about 15 minutes for her to bring it from the bar to my table. I would have given this a 4 Star all things considered. However, while we were eating we noticed the cook eating! He was standing right in the window where the food is placed for the waitresses to pick up and he was just chowing down while food was sitting waiting to be picked up! This grossed me out beyond belief. Of course we saw this after we had eaten 2/3rds of our meal. We couldn't take another bite after that, paid our $70 check and left. There didn't seem to be a point in trying to bring this to anyone's attention, so we didn't even try. We would have been back but the guy eating made this place a no for us.

Fast, fresh, and insanely tasty! Everyone working here is happy to be at work and you can tell they have fun. This is honestly, for me, the perfect place for lunch. Soup and a sandwich, you can never go wrong. Not a whole lot on the menu, but what is there is done right. They also have a wide variety of soups you can take home. I have two and a half weeks left in Boise, and I plan on returning often.

We had breakfast at Steve's Cafe for the first time this morning, having driven past it often and wondering. We finally decided to give it a try after reading some favorable comments here from reviewers whose preferences tend to align with our own. We're glad we did, and Steve's is now "in the rotation" for daytime dining.

I really don't have a lot of new information to add here, and am posting largely to balance some negative assessments that have been submitted recently. We were greeted warmly by at least three employees and served on by a delightful young woman who was knowledgeable about the menu and attentive without being overbearing.

The space is open and inviting, with the tables spread far enough to allow conversations with the ones you came with more than than the strangers at the table next to you.

My wife's omelet was light and fluffy, as were the hash browns. I'm a fan of huckleberry anything, so I went for the pancakes. These are the thick, heavier kind and a short stack was ample. The eggs were cooked just right. The "country" patty sausage was among the best I've had recently, though I'm eager to try the housemade variety on a future visit. The coffee was perfectly fine, though not a highlight and nowhere close to Big City (my gold standard currently). 

All in all we pretty much pigged out for about 30 bucks, including tip.

Maybe some the more negative reviewers just caught them on a bad day or maybe we were just lucky. If the latter turns out to be the case, I'll do a follow-up.

P.S., I'd like to add a note regarding some posts, one in particular (looking at you, Mr. T), that I found offensive in their remarks about senior citizens. Maybe they were intended to be funny, but they are not. Hey, we're not fond of children who are allowed to scream and run around, or loud cell phone conversations, etc. But we are reacting to their BEHAVIOR, not their very existence. Cut us some slack, people. You probably have parents or grandparents and with any luck may one day enter this category yourselves, provided you haven't driven while texting into a telephone pole or vaped yourself to death. Grrrr.

I've only been here actually twice.  They seem to have an odd selection of merchandise, but I have to say I was extremely happy to have found a light work coat after searching about 5 other stores, and I got it for just over $60.

The ladies working the checkout were fun, friendly and very courteous.  Kudos for them making my whole day.

We have lived across the street from Steve's for over a year now and have finally made it in for breakfast!!! My husband had the breakfast burrito. He enjoyed all the fresh onions, tomatoes, and peppers as well as the salsa. I had the short stack with marionberry compote & side of ham. 

The cakes and compote were delicious. The ham was tasty but a skosh salty. There was enough food that I took some home for later. You shouldn't go away hungry from Steve's and they're reasonably priced.
Great place for lunch!  Fish tacos and Blt lettuce wedge are good picks. Good and service are high quality.
We had a blast. Laser tag was the best. Package deal is great... We spent 4 hours there.
Terrible, bland, over priced food.  I'll never go back!  Though the waiter did a great job, if I want bad food I can cook that myself.

Absolutley love this place. So cheap and affordable! I have tried a couple of different empanadas, and I don't believe I have a favorite yet. I have loved every one I have tried, except the chorizo one that my hubby made me try. I'm just not a chorizo kind of girl sooooo it doesn't count!

They tout having a reasonably priced menu which is true, but WATCH OUT for those drink prices!!!  $5-$6 beers!

Fresh seafood, but they drench the fish in sauces.  Flooded our plates!

Husband and I were both ill after our meal.  "Junk" floating in & settling out of both of our beers, so not sure what caused the illness...food or something ick in the beer lines?

Service was rushed and gal was for forgetful.

We gave this place a another try in 2016 and we're still not impressed. Slow & forgetful service. Overpriced bar drinks. Food was OK, but we're enjoyed better seafood in town. The menu raves about their calamari and it's source. Rubbery tiny bits on a plate. We've even tried the Boise location. It's a nicer restaurant inside, but the food is still mediocre.
Been here a couple of times now.  The food and service has been consistently excellent.  We found the seafood menu to be somewhat limited, but what they do offer has been superb.  We'll be back.

I got a flat and stopped in Commercial Tire.  Jerry Robinson got his guys on it right away.  Very clean, shop with a great selection, with a nice waiting area, and even a kids room.  Very welcoming.  If I was there 15 min., I wouldn't have known.  When the tech came in with my key, Jerry handed it to me and said, "Have a nice evening!"  No charge.  Wow!  I'll certainly be a return customer!  Thanks Jerry!

This place is authentic and just as good as the Boise location since the lady that started it is from Argentina and is working the Nampa location for now.
You may have to wait for your empanadas to be prepared, unless you call your order in ahead of time. That appears to be a very smart idea from the lines I have seen there already.

I lived in Argentina and can confirm that the quality is what you would get down there.

After a bumpy start with wrong delivery dates and missed communication, my order has been cleared up and everyone is satisfied. It was touch and go for awhile, but the follow up to the problem was outstanding. I will be a returning customer. They were dedicated to find a resolution which worked for everyone. I am very pleased with the results.

Bloody Mary, Calamari, and Salmon were
 fantastic.  You can't beat this place for the price.  One of my new favorites.

Don't expect your deposit back. We left our place in better condition than we found it. Never returned phone calls & if they did they would be rude. We had a gas leak that could have possibly burned down the whole complex if we lit a match...they laughed at us on the phone, mocked us, and hung up on us and said we were just girls that didn't know anything. Idaho power company had to come out and fix the leak and said that it could have been extremely dangerous if something happened. Our floor upstairs also was flooded from the washer and it took them a week to resolve the issue. You don't want to rent from these people. In fact they are $80,000+ in debt. Don't think they will bend for you for anything.
We love it! ! The staff is great the food is always amazing! If you're just or for a drink an appetizer or full lunch or dinner never disapoints!
Rad spot.  Super cool place, staff is a lot of fun, and great coffee!  Meridian has needed a place like this for a long time.

So, I was contact by Togo's regarding my review.  They stated they were so sorry that I had bad service and hoped that we would return and give them a second chance!  They said they were going to send me a gift card to use on my return trip!!  I stated they could send it, but doubted that I would return!!!  So, in the mail today I got a $ 5.00 gift card!!  Haha!  A whole $5.00's!  I am pretty sure that $5.00 is far less than I spent for the worst service ever!    So, if anyone wants the gift card, let me know and I will continue to tell people more than ever how terrible this company is!!!!  What a slap in the face!!!  P.S. Only reason for 1 star is I have to!!!!

Purchased a fridge on a Saturday and we were told it would be delivered on a Wednesday. Some how the fridge was lost and we were told it would be Thursday.  We were suckers and went in Wednesday evening and bought a dinning room set thinking the fridge delay was just a one time mistake. Long story short the 2nd fridge was lost again and we were offered a different fridge that is supposed to be better then the one we purchased but wouldn't be delivered until Friday afternoon.  During all this our dinning room table was not going to be in at the time we were told either but the best part was when the delivery guy showed up with only 2 of or 4 chairs and 2 random bar stools we didn't order and now we have to wait 4 days for 2 more chairs. This place is a joke.

Delicious dessert for here or to-go. Of course we all had our cones and cups full of ice cream and toppings. The flavors were all good. We took some lava cake to-go which was decadent to say the least and enjoyed a cookie on the way home. Sugar rush much?! The best thing about this joint is the location. This shopping are is gorgeous and although parking is a bit troublesome if you want to have the front row spots, it's worth it. There's a kids jungle gym right outside and a beautiful water fountain. 
The girls in this shop were super sweet and helpful as well. Happy satisfied family to say the least from youngest to oldest.

I was pleasantly surprised how good the food is here! I absolutely loved it and the magic sauce is the best! The folks that work here are super nice and efficient. I will definitely being telling my family and friends and I look forward to going back....I could eat this every day!!

I was impressed by the repairs done at this Les Schwab Tire Center.  Sam was the mechanic who worked with me to replace the rack and pinion assembly.  They got me going in a very reasonable amount of time.  The staff was very professional.  This will be the place I go to for my repairs.

unreal that people like this, maybe it's just me..  I mean, I have eaten good Mexican food and this is definitely not . it's bland, it's plain, and both times I tried it were the same. 
 funny thing is that the place had people in it eating both times I went.   I am glad I picked lunch to go because dinner would have been more expensive and I would have been more mad. 
     this is slightly better than 98 cent tv dinner from wal mart.     I am guessing that more people than I knew like that sort of thing. 

  In case you are wondering, the second time I went was because my kids were me and they wanted to try it too. I said it was awful the first time I went in and they agreed afterwards.  makes no sense to go back.
Good place. The #9 pastrami is good. Request the chipotle mayo and enjoy. . Cool people. 6-8 bucks for a sandwich then add combo.

We really like this place.  We have brought all ages, from 9 up to 75, and everyone has fun.  It's shockingly clean for a bowling alley, and is so new that it doesn't have that used shoe/sweaty kid/old man smell that most bowling alleys seem to have. I'd like it to be a bit less expensive, but is like everything to be less expensive - so maybe that's just me.  

One small complaint.  Last time we went, my special needs son stuck his finger in a ball and it came back out with an old, used band-aid stuck to him.  Yuck!!!  He was repulsed and it took a long time for him to trust another bowling ball.  So one star off for that.  I sincerely hope it was just a fluke. I'm going to choose to believe that they do clean the balls on a regular basis - unless it happens again.  Then I'll be really grossed out.

I usually do not like massages. Yes, I said it. I always end up being the Theraphist and find that very un relaxing and kinda defeats the point for me. Not in this case. Liz is amazing. Great touch. Gives you your time. Has great boundaries, understands it's not time to chit chat and when she is done, your body will thank her skills and fabulous hands. Place is very quiet, inviting and CLEAN. The only place I will keep going back to. Super professional and skillful.
Best place for soup I've ever been. Made scratch from whole food ingredients. Small family owned business that has that personal touch

Over priced and poor selection of produce. They removed the self service registers which was a bad idea. A quick one item purchased is dragged out to a 10 - 15 minute wait at times. If it wasn't for the great chicken and fresh baked French bread I'd never step foot in there again.

Great burgers and fries.  Clean dining area. During warmer days you can sit outside. The staff is always friendly and makes sure you leave happy. Don't pass them up or you'll miss your chance to eat a great burger!

Excellent bang for your buck! You're never disappointed with the deliciousness of these gyros. I've tried several and all are mouth watering good. The combo cannot be beat.  You can get an excellent salad and a beverage for a great deal. Highly recommend.

Lucky Fins hits the nail on the head with their food, service, and atmosphere. It's THE SPOT to score on a sushi happy hour, grab a drink with friends, and enjoy a delicious meal. 

Food: I have never had anything at Lucky Fins that didn't tickle every tastebud fantasy of mine. From their sushi (Dragon & Atomic rolls, oh my!), to their nacho appetizer, to the miso soup, to the lobster mac and cheese. It's all a plethora of YUM! If you enjoy happy hour, go in for specials on their apps and a buy 1 get 1 50% off sushi rolls. You can't beat it! Their poki appetizer is also DELICIOUS... so much amazing, fresh fish!

Drinks: Great drink menu. They mix up a mean cocktail and offer great deals during happy hour on their drinks. No complaints! 

Atmosphere: There's a great bar, seating lounge, indoor sun room, and "octopus" hanging lights to liven up the vibe. I LOVE the atmosphere at Lucky Fins. It's a great social place. We enjoy the Boise location a little more than the Meridian one, but either one is great! 

Service: Whether in the lounge or at the bar, the service is always fast and excellent. 

Happy Hour Offerings: M-F food, sushi and drink specials. Honestly, for the vibe of the place AND the specials, it's hard to beat!! 

Healthy Hack: Sushi & miso soup. Or the poki appetizer. Doesn't get much cleaner! 

Tips: Ask for the server's sushi recommendation. They know that menu inside & out!
Always on time. Always courteous and professional.  I always recommend TruGreen to neighbors who need to get rid of weeds and have a healthy, green lawn.
Charged 1.95 to deliver beyond a tip.  Cheesy bread sticks were a hit.

My sweetie and I visited Harry's last week for happy hour and were not disappointed!  The service was excellent!  Our server was friendly, funny and attentive!  I had the loaded fries and they were da' bomb!  Great place to unwind after work or to meet friends for a drink and munchies!  We will definitely be back!

I really like this restaurant.  Not a chain, the owner comes to your table to say hello, and the food is good.

Ordered the Teriyaki Salmon; crisp exterior and delicious vegetables, perfect cook, very good.

I had the black and bleu Mahi Mahi sandwich as well.  Flavorful an the bleu cheese with the fresh fish was delightful.  See photo.  Fries were really good too.

The Ahi Poki/ Poke appetizer was quite good; well seasoned fish with sesame and soy, a little spicy, and light.  See photo.

Ordered the key lime pie.  It was extra tart, and was fine.  Also had the captain crunch ice cream with raspberry.  It was delicious and recommended. See photo.
This place is amazing. Best biscuit and gravy around. The super size is plenty to feed 2 people! Will most deffinatley be going back!

If you like Quality pastries like me! We know that quality product makes quality pastries. Little Kitchen Pastries bring extra smile with delightful party in our mouth, every time we are here. This place takes their time, dedication and love of baking that is no where to be found in Treasure Valley. I believe pastries is art and this place has the best French Croissants, Danish, Caramel Pecan Buns. And more! Be here early and because they close at 2:30pm. Don't forget to request Lemon Almond  Braid - you will love every it.

I didn't get a chance to use the brick and mortar store, but was recently looking for an item online and the best price I could find by a good margin was through IMT.  On top of the great price, they shipped the product quickly, and I received in on the other side of the country in just a few days.  To top it all off, the package arrived well packaged and included a short, but personal hand-written note from Mark.
I'll continue to use Idaho Mountain Touring as an option for online shopping, and the next time I'm back in the Boise area visiting my in-laws I'll make sure to swing by and visit the store!  Thanks!

Wahooz has lame go kart rules. My son waited in line to ride their slower than molasses go karts for 20 mins only to be an inch shorter than allowed and be turned away. I would understand their rules if their karts weren't the slowest pieces of junk around. I would understand the hype if they were fast lanes go karts (which I HIGHLY RECOMMEND). Most of their employees walk around with power trips and don't embodied the "family fun" experience. The bumper boats carry more risk than their slower than turtles go karts and I'm pretty sure they pick the most miserable person around to be in charge of the bumper boats. Change your policy on the karts or make them fast enough to actually have the rules you do. I will steer people away from your karts and bumper boats at all costs because of your lame rules and people running them. I'm positive I can jog faster than your go karts and stock riding lawn mowers would dust your karts no problem.
