Oh. My. Goodness. This is the spot to go if you like empanadas or if you are thinking of trying one. They have about 20 flavors that you can choose from, ranging from savory, to cheesy, to sweet. The pastry part that surrounds the fillings melts in your mouth. 

I am forgetting the names of the exact empanadas but the ones I would recommend is the shredded pork, the sausage and cheese and the second one on the menu. The only side they serve are fries. They are actually really good. There are also sauces that you can ask for that go from mild to "what in the world"?!

I am visiting in the city for a limited time, but I have already been to this spot 3 times. It is most certainly recommended!

If you havent been to this bar you must go give it a try.  They have live music and good food and not only awesome service but the staff is gorgeous and the ladies that go to this bar are equally as gorgeous.  Great people all around, good music, good food and great company.  What else could you ask for.  Try it out.
Great sushi and good calamari. Fish and chips were okay. Overall this is a nice place. I would suggest to someone to go here. Super nice place and friendly staff. Really liked the atmosphere.

I consider myself a bit of a crab expert and I have high expectations. This place did not disappoint! They have a great menu and I ordered pretty much everything on it today. The crab stuffed mushrooms were delicious and not in any way soggy, as they sometimes can be. I had an amazing lobster tater tot that is not at all what you would expect. The house salad was fresh  The highlight of this feast however was the crab platter! This thing is massive and the crab is seasoned perfectly! For desert I had the California roll. Also perfect in every way! This is my new favorite seafood place and I can't wait to go back! Totally worth the hour drive it takes for me to get there!

I give the food 3 stars but I give the service 4 I ordered a glass of wine, half a dozen oysters and the ahi salad. I wasn't happy with the oysters so the waitress kindly took them away and had them replaced (unbeknownst to me) with another type of oyster than I didn't even see listed on the menu. When the oysters arrived, she was very sneaky about it. The GM checked in with me to make sure I was happy and to ensure they lived up to my expectations. They did. They both checked on me a few more times (I was doing work during dinner so I stuck around for a while) and were truly genuine to myself and all the guests. Based on other reviews, I'll definitely come back to try other dishes and because the service was so great! Thank you Lucky Fins :)

Completely unprofessional. Watch out for early termination fee $500.00 
Never returns phone call, or emails.
Works out of their home, DO NOT HIRE THEM!!!!!!!!
REVIEWING JACKSONVILLE OPERATION

I'm from California. So no stranger to flame broiler. I have eaten at this one twice. First time was good. As expected. The second time was not good all. About half my chicken I spit out. It had skin and a lot of gristle left on it. And some pieces just were rubbery and un chewable all together. Kinda makes me never want to try it again.

They have the absolute best doughnuts available. That's why they always sell out this is the only shop I will go too no greasy mouth coating that other doughnut shops have an issue with. Definitely recommend if I was smart I would give a bad review so when I want them I have less competition
This review is exclusively for their patio. It's amazing! It looks like Barbacoa, the staff is friendly and their happy hour is fantastic! Definitely stop by!
Solid, semi-fast food with good beer and great, old-school milkshakes. Hard to beat when you have that nouveau diner hankering.

I love their food! Especially the kids meals only problem I have is they get stingy with sauces and thwy always mess up my order when using the drive thru.. I have to drive from caldwell so this is very disappointing.

Found this place off a hotel recommendation while driving through Boise. Beautiful park, lots of places to walk. I went there to walk my dog (who was a bit nuts after the car ride) - very well marked paths for walking, there is an off leash dog space designated for big dogs and then also little dogs, as well as playground for the kiddos.

These funds are awesome! Ordered some donut holes for my wedding reception. They were gone in under five minutes. Of course we did do some taste tasting both donuts and donut holes. Both we yummy, my husband was happy. My twist donut had cinnamon sugar sprinkled on top prior to the glaze......ummm delicious

Their gluten free pizzas are sooooo delicious!! I also adore their juice bar - yum!! They have a decent organic/natural section but I think I still prefer Whole Foods or the Co-Op as I feel they have a bigger selection. 

Their linguisa is pretty fab!!

Unbelievable! This place amazed me from the second I looked at the menu...matter of fact, even before! We heard this place was a can't miss from a few sources who's trustworthiness is now seriously in question (good thing it wasn't my proctologist)!

When we arrived at this little delight early on a Saturday morning I was surprised by how old everyone was, like I has just stepped into the mess hall of a senior citizen community. Thankfully I brought my grumpy face and knitting needles, I fit right in. To make it more "kid friendly" the staff places giant paper blankets under the highchairs of grand kids so they don't have to actually work and sweep up...genius really.

Don't bother getting a kids menu because no substitutions are allowed. As if kids aren't picky about food. And here's where it gets unbelievable. You can get the exact same meals at almost every other breakfast place in United States for nearly half the price. I don't know how this place stays in business being literally 30% more expensive than every other breakfast restaurant!

After my wallet vomited in its mouth a little and I gave it some antacid we decided to share the breakfast burrito for $11. What was unbelievable to me was our otherwise bubbly waitress, Shawna, choked and huffed when we decided to share breakfast and only ordered one meal. We also ordered some pancakes eggs and bacon for the kids.

When my food came I could finally relax because the table next to us had just left and I was no longer getting an uncomfortable "I'm going to kick your ass and steal your girlfriend" stare down from these two old creepers who both looked like they were packing nunchucks.

Oh yeah, the food! It's good I might even say very good. But it's your run-of-the-mill, nothing special breakfast for way more money. I'm never going back. Thus, 2 stars for being way below expectations, and making me further question the trustworthiness of people I hardly know.

What a RIPOFF!!! $7 per person for mini golf? $3.75 per person per game of bowling not including shoes? 50 Cents to play a game of Packman?? We turned around and WALKED OUT after watching this joke of a business bad attempt to rip off little children.

Their empanadas are so good, and you can't beat the price! We've tried the Gaucho (our favorite so far) the Rancho, the Barbecue, and the Picosa. We were too full for dessert, but we will will be trying them soon. So glad to have them in Nampa!

The real deal! I worked in some of the best cafes in the Portland area for 8 years; I can tell a good shop when I see one. I just moved to the area and was extremely relieved & excited to stumble upon this place. This is a solid cafe. The barista was knowledgeable, kind, helpful, and genuinely wanted to serve his customers with a great experience. He delivered. My cappuccino was velvety with the rich, sweet espresso profile you'd expect at a premier shop in a more "hip" coffee market like Portland, without all the hipster pretense. My wife's chai was also excellent, not too sweet or too spicy. Loved every moment from walking in to walking out. I will be a regular here!

My GF and I stopped in for lunch/brunch Saturday buffet.  My wife is a huge Monte Cristo fan and she was pleased because she found the equivalent of her favorite Monte Cristo from her youth.  The owner was gracious and suggested the buffet for $1 more over ordering off the menu.  She was right.  The buffet was very, very good.  Did I mention the Monte Cristo?  Soup, scones, sausage, eggs, fruit, potato, deserts, tarts, etc.  And for the guys, I wasn't the only male present.  Not a very large establishment, so there may be a wait, although we didn't on that day.
Love this place! They always treat you right.  And the sandwiches and fries are very good.  Also have to try a lemony, really good.

I just recently moved here about 6 months ago, it's taken me awhile but I found my new nail salon. I just got acrylics and an eyebrow wax and I absolutely loved the staff. Nice and quick and friendly. My nails look awesome just in time for Halloween and my eyebrows are nice and cleaned up. Helen was great .
Best Mexican food in all of Meridian! My girlfriend and I are regulars there and haven't even been disappointed once. Their staff is all great, they are always on top of things.
Great haircut from a friendly retired LEO.  Old school atmosphere,  good conversation.  This is what a barbershop used to be like.

My husband and I LOVE chick-fil-a!! We always eat there when we are traveling as their isn't one close to where we live. Everyone that we have been to is always nice and clean and the employees are so friendly and courteous. We especially love the breakfast chicken biscuits!

The girls' competitive team coaches are focused on winning, which is good. Many are bullies, though, and the top gymnasts leave for gyms that use positive and professional methods to get results. Unfortunately, there's not much else in Meridian. If you're considering competition, then look closely at several coaching sessions and speak to some of the parents who have been there for awhile, before making a decision. The daily grind is difficult enough, without having the love of the sport ground down by poor coaching.

1/6/2016 
Sales flyer came out today, showed item for sale in deli. Drove over there to find didn't have the item. I recommend call to see if in stock . Gave it a one due to have to drive back again.

We've bought electronics and furniture from here and have never had issues. They were great with customer service, and when we had to exchange a subwoofer it was no hassle and replaced within a couple days.
Biggest word of advice if you buy here is, do your homework and make sure the item is the quality you want and best price in town.
Great experience for us and we will definitely buy here again.

Stopped in here to have a nice dinner after a long day of traveling. It was happy hour which was nice buy one get one 1/2 sushi rolls. I had the Vegas roll (minus cream cheese) and it was so delicious that I had the same thing for my second roll. There were three or so bartender/servers helping me out and they were all so nice and friendly. Great service and great food!

My dear husband treated me to Lucky Fins this evening since I put in a new faucet in the bathroom and the food was fantastic. I partook of the crab in the butter sauce with bread bites circled around it. It was a lovely presentation and every taste of the crab was a delight.

My husband had the platter and also delighted in every bite, including their excellent fries which I also nibbled on.

The mango cake was out of this world. My husband questioned rather he would enjoy it; however, he was most pleasantly surprised as we shared a slice.

The restaurant displays an appealing, tastefully decorated appearance with ease of parking.

Wow! That was Yummmmy!!! The atmosphere was laid back and fun! Our server was very great and the food was to par, but the sushi and soup WOW was it beyond my expectations. We will definatley be back for more... Loved it.

Lucky fins offers plentifully sized dishes for a reasonable price. If you're looking for the Seattle feel in boise this might be it.

Lucky fins is still relatively new to the area, but already has garnered quite the customer base. There hasn't been a time that I've visited during dinner rush that it wasn't packed. This is also one of the problems. Lucky fins offers low amount of dining room seating and booth space is extremely limited. I'm talking like 5 booths to the whole restaurant. They do offer plenty of chair tables and the bar is filled with high stools,  but sometimes it's nice to enjoy the booth.

Another issue I've noticed is a lack of consistency in their entrées. Doesn't mean the food tastes poorly,  but it could taste different depending on the chefs. 

I recommend the tempura sushi. MOJO. It's probably the best dish Lucky fins offers.
This place was really good! I highly recommend it! The lobster stuffed avocado was such an interesting combination but tasted amazing!!!
The BEST place to eat in Meridian!!!!servers are the best! Look for Robin! Or Mckenzie! Or Mckayla! Service is outstanding and the food is Awesome!!!!!
There's never anyone available to answer the phone, the lines are constantly out the door, and deliveries are frequently misrouted.

First of all one star is way too much...Went today to get a pedicure  and thought we would give this place a shot. Absolute biggest mistake..they were so rude did not talk to us but once,  and continued to chat in their language each time we would make a request or make a comment. Which we all know means they are talking shit. They were in a bug hurry to get us out of there, they didn't even ask what package of a pedicure we wanted. When I asked for a manicure or polish change (which she could have done at the seat I was in) she said they were too busy.  Mind you there wasn't anyone waiting... when I asked if she could please use the tool to get off the skin on heels she said she could not do that as they aren't allowed anymore.. when it was time to pay they told us it was 40 dollars each, which sounded way too expensive. When we went out to the car I looked online and it looked like we were charged for a package we didn't get..scrub etc. So I went back inside to ask if I could talk to the lady who did our nails..well she said she didn't have time to talk and to leave my number. Umm noo that didn't fly with me. (I assume she speak no English) so I asked the front office gal for a menu of their pedicures. When she asked the gal she said that they ran out of menus on mother's day and they didn't have any left and the printer hadn't finished them. Haha what a bunch of bullshit. Also didn't have master copy to show???? Needless to say I am not hapoy at all with the service or lack there of that we received at this crap hole. DO NOT GO HERE!!!!!!!!!!! Hope to see them shut down eventually.

I have eaten here a few times and oh my goodness makes me go back to when I was a kid and at my grandma's house. Wish they were open on Sundays that way on my day off I can enjoy as a day off instead of its lunchtime meal. Soup and Sandwiches are so yummy and all the soups they have I at least want to try all of them. Try them out, what do you have to lose ??

Miss Tami's is an excellent place to eat...seating is odd as it's in an old house, but they make it work.  My wife and "the girls" go there when they are in town and I've been there a couple of times.  Have never had anything that wasn't top of the line there.  Their Monte Cristo's are the best I've ever had.  Over the top!  Great little place with odd hours, but if you know it in advance and plan your trip accordingly, then no reason to give it a lousy review based solely on that.  Highly reccomend to anyone.

I think that this is technically the same location as Boondocks, but the new name is Wahooz.  Yelp Admins, it may be prudent to merge the two?  

Location: 3 out of 5
From Boise, it's about a 15 minute drive, and very close to the highway.  I was staying at the Best Western Rama Inn just down the street, so it was a very quick drive.

Selection of Games and Activities: 5 out of 5
I won't lie - it's pretty comprehensive.  From your sporting games like basketball, skeeball, and air hockey, to the great selection of somewhat modern arcade games, to the "prize" games like stacker and "cut the rope", there should be something here for everyone.  My buddy and I spent 1 dollar each and went through Time Crisis 3 from start to end.  It took 45 minutes and it was a little draining on the ol' noggin.  We played lots of games of basketball, and the air hockey tables work very well.  BUT!  The highlight was the laser tag area.  Not the biggest I've played in, but very well maintained, moderated, and safe.  

Customer Service: 4 out of 5
The nice people who worked there must have thought something was a little funny when two guys showed up randomly on a Friday morning (guys close to the age of 30 mind you), but we were treated with cordiality, respect, and overall friendliness.  The lady that walked us through the laser tag was patient with our silly questions (where's the base, can you shoot the base, etc. etc. etc.)  

Overall: 4 out of 5
Pretty cool place, please take into account I went on a week day in the late morning.  I'm sure things pick up at night, as there was a set queue for laser tag.  I had a good time, and between my buddy and I, we spent a total of 20 bucks and killed probably 2.5 hours there.  We ended up giving all of our tickets away to these little kids, who were grateful for their new stash.

Who doesn't love chicken?! Put them in a sandwich, salad, eat them as nuggets! 

The staff at both locations (Franklin and Eagle Rd. ) are very corteous and friendly. Even if they are very very crowded on Tuesdays between 5-8pm this month of May, they are still very patient and accomodating.

Not as good as I remembered trying in California. They don't have all the sandwiches they have in California. I asked them why and they said they can't get the ingredients???? Not bad though, fresh and clean, nice people. Maybe it just doesn't live up to the high standards in my memory and it's all in my head. No complaints I will eat here again.

I was their first customer the day the doors opened. I have to say that I have been disappointed with the prices. I can buy the same stuff at winco or Walmart for a lot less. They do have fresh produce ( winco sucks in that area) I bought some Porterhouse steaks. They looked awesome and the price was ok. They were the toughest steaks I ever ate. i would never return for meat ever. Basically I only go back to get something I cannot find elsewhere. It is a beautiful store but thats about it

First time here, got seated right away. Our waiter was great! Pricy drinks. We had an appetizer and shared a dinner plate. Everything came in a timely manner.  Our waiter continue to give good service. The seafood enchalada was on the salty side but overall! ! Very good!! I'll be back!
Wow- Doughnuts are amazing. Owners are very nice and sweet! Definitely coming back for more!

Don't buy a mattress here unless you know exactly what you want!

My wife and I shopped around and we found that RC Willey had the best price on the Simmons line we were looking for.  We did look at other brands but we ultimately were after a beautyrest pocketed coil mattress.   We picked out a mattress, it was a "dual comfort" which has softer coils on one side and firmer coils on the other.  One of the questions we asked before making the purchase was "could we exchange it if we didn't like the mattress?"  "Of course" we were told, "we have a 60 day comfort guarantee."  "If you don't like the mattress after a minimum of 30 days you can exchange it."   

Well after just a week I had horrible back pain on the firmer side and my wife kept complaining that on the softer side she felt like she was always being "pushed" off the side of the bed.  Keep in mind this is a standard KING mattress so there is plenty of room for both of us.  I contacted RC Willey customer service and they told us they would "try to see" if they could get someone from Simmons to come out and check it for defects...  They called back nearly a week later after I visited the store twice to find out what was up and said "Sorry, they wont come look at it for at least 30 days."  Which I firmly believe is their standard statement.

Well after the 30 day mark we hated the mattress, I contacted RC willey and said "we would like to do an exchange and we would come in to try out a different bed... " This is where the fun begins.  "She says sure no problem, there is a $59 delivery fee and a $150 fee for the exchange."  When we purchased the mattress we were never told there was any fee associated with the exchange the rep who sold us the mattress made it sound like if we were unsatisfied for ANY reason it was a worry free, hassle free exchange.   I go a couple rounds on the phone with the customer service rep before ultimately giving up as they are completely unwilling to amend their policy.  She tells me they have to charge me the $150 because they will sell the bed in their "clearance" section and take a loss..  Funny thing is the bed is no longer on sale and even if they listed it for $150 off their current price it's still nearly $400 more then we paid.  COMPLETE SCAM!

We purchased our bed from RC willey on credit not because we couldn't afford to pay it outright but we wanted to establish new credit together as I was recently married.  We picked RC willey to purchase the mattress through because 1) they told us they had a hassle free exchange policy on the mattress.  2) They sell furniture and electronics so in the future we could purchase a Fridge, Washer, Dryer or TV if needed, and 3) Because we felt like the sales people we dealt with were very friendly and not very pushy like the other mattress stores in the area.

Well RC Willey I'm very sorry to say the dupe is on us.  You got our $1500 for the mattress that we now loath but ultimately the loss will fall with you.  We will no longer shop the location and when the mattress is paid in full we will close out our account.  Very, sorely disappointed.  If you are thinking about buying a mattress in the Boise area look at Denver Mattress, they have a truly "no hassle" return and exchange policy, RC willey forbids returns on any mattress for any reason...  We never wanted to return it only exchange but now I wish we never would of made the purchase. period.  "F" for RC Willey

I have had pedicures and manicures here before and been fairly satisfied with my service (3 to 3.5 star rating, I don't like the red marks the drill leaves on my natural nail). I have had medical issues and not gone in for about a year. I tried to get a pedicure today and was told they would not allow my service dog inside. I pointed out that he is a registered service dog and was told that he was still not welcome.  I guess I will find someone else who is willing to take my money where I don't have to apologize for having a medical condition.
Best donuts in town.   They are taking the traditional donuts and making them awesome.  The bread part is ultra soft and soooo goood.   People are nice.... service is quick.....  a must try....

Had a couple bad experiences one being we were told to coat our own swirl cone with candy while we drove home and a little cup full of crushed heath was shoved in my husband's hand. I called and talked to a manager she admitted training was taking quite a bit longer than they'd expected and offered free cones. My husband and I went through the drive thru and we received our free cones along with rude stares from the employees gawking out the window at us. We will be going to Dairy Queen from now on they have stellar service.

I've eaten there 5-6 times for the crab legs. Food is really good and service is amazingly awesome.  But for the price of all you can eat crab legs was way over priced. $45.00 per person. It is generally $30 per person.  Especially for farm raised crab legs. Cant be sure if it was ocean caught. The shells were way to soft and too red when served. Not that nice orange color I associate with ocean caught crab.

This particular location is incredibly friendly. I've never had a bad chic fila experience but the Meridian location is very nice.  I was there last week when the Miss Idaho contestants came in and it was incredibly busy.  The staff maintained a clean and friendly atmosphere.  They refilled my drink promptly several times.  They managed the crowd incredibly well.  Overall it was a wonderful experience!

I have been eating here since I was a kid, and it's the best place in the Treasure Valley for Mexican food, hands down. From the outside it looks like a bit of a hole in the wall, but that shouldn't scare you. It's clean,  the food is delicious, and the service is always friendly and attentive. Their salsa is by far the best salsa I've ever had in a restaurant (I always say you can judge a Mexican food restaurant by the chips and salsa). The entrees are wonderful as well, and I always tell myself I'm going to save some to take home as leftovers, but I just can't do it. The food is too good. I love their enchiladas especially!

Don't let the name fool you, this place is way more than just burgers (although the burgers are delish)! We came here for a Yelp event and I think we ended up sampling the whole menu. Flavor-filled chicken, great fry selection, and the veggie frites are the best I have ever had! Stop in for a great meal. :-)

Been to every bar grill in soutwest Idaho and none come even close to this one. Just a fantastic place to hang out and enjoy your favorite beverage and munchies. The staff is over the top. Love this place

If you spray tan an the Eagle Rd or Axiom gym location you should be aware.  For whatever reason, the spray system leaves about 1/3 of the solution in the container.  
If you pay extra for specific items, 1/3 of you money is being wasted.

This has been brought to the attention of district management, 3 weeks ago.  I was told the problem had been fixed at the Axiom location, it has not as of this date

I have purchased thousands of dollars worth of appliances, TVs, beds, and couches from RC Willey. I emailed them today to ask if they would be willing to help out regarding a two year old dryer that has been serviced three times and is again in need of additional parts/service. Nope. Not one thing. Their greed knows no end. I won't be buying anymore products from this outfit.
My new favorite store! Very nice and clean, the employees are super nice and friendly! I specifically like the whole foods area, they have such a wide variety of whole/organic foods

I love Anthony! He gives the BEST facials and microdermabrasion hands down! I would recommend him to anyone and everyone looking for a relaxing and pampering experience. Your skin feels softer than a babies butt when he's done.

Ok, here is the deal. I just cannot give a franchise five stars. For a franchise the burgers here are great. WAY better than other fancy burger franchises. 

I have not had every burger yet but, so far have not been let down yet. 

It is a little pricey for a burger but worth it.

Wahooz is a fun place for the family to go.  We went on a Tuesday and paid $12 for each person in our family.  That made is worth it. The kids had fun with laser tag and mini golf.  We added bowling and had a great time.  The staff were helpful but not amazing.  I was disappointed by the conditions of the restrooms.  Also, the games that are included for the $12 are mostly shooting games which didn't meet my younger kids' expectations.  They did like the play-land structure.  I would only recommend this place if you are going on a discounted night.
Great fish dish, med mahi mahi, would eat again!  Great quick lunch and fairly healthy, definitely recommend and will be back :)

This is hands down the best place in the city for a burger.  Yes, I said it.  
Five Guys can't even hold a candle to Smashburger.  Five Guy's uses little more than Kraft singles on their burgers, whereas Smashburger uses REAL cheese.  The menu here is varied and has all sorts of clever ideas, such as a burger all ready adorned with potato chips.  

My latest trip there was greeted with a Bronco Burger, a bleu cheese burger with Frank's Red Hot Sauce.  I was appreciative of both the clever name and fantastic flavors.

The fries are equally impressive.  Their sweet potato fries set a high standard for fries in this city and at a great price.  The seasonings really help to draw out the natural flavor of the potato. 

This is my favorite place in Boise to get a burger.

MERIDIAN, ID: I am updating my review to Five Stars instead of four.  Every time I come in I have a terrific server, the owner comes by to say hello, it's a nice ambience, and they have several excellent dishes.  It is a restaurant I like coming to every time I am in town.

The salmon is excellent, the sushi is good, the tuna appetizer is great, the swordfish is delicious, and although I'm not a huge sandwich fan, those are good as well.

I even ate the ice cream rolled in ground Cap'n Crunch.  Delicious. Eat here and show some local pride!
The grilled Gouda sandwich was AMAZING dipped in the buffalo chicken soup! I loved the was the cheese was crispy at the edges and the grilled onion n red pepper were perfect!

I found this place while searching for a "tea room" for a friends Bridal Shower. I was very excited to try it. We had reservations on a Saturday, and I'm glad we did because it is BUSY. The little waiting area/gift shop can get kind of congested and awkward. But it's fun to have cute little things to look at while waiting. Once we got seating we did the Saturday Buffet. It was great. Fruit/cookies/soup/monte cristos/crepes/ and my favorite the MAC & CHEESE. was SO YUMMY. We enjoyed the apricot tea. It was amazzzinggggg. Try it.

This was my first visit and was expecting a much longer wait. 

The pastry was flaky and tender, very excellent and the 2 different empanadas (1 savory 1 sweet) were delicious. The fries also were good, hot and fresh from the fryer.

I'll definitely have to come try more options

They will rip you off if you're not careful.  I purchased an expensive 4-seat theater couch from them.  Within 18 mos it had leather that was peeling off and springs that were broken and mechanisms that wouldn't work to recline the chairs any longer.  We used these about 1 day a week on average at most.  

RC Willey wouldn't honor any warrantee because the leather had expired and the mechanism would cost me $70 for service call.  The guy comes and fixes the springs and mechanisms.  Now they don't recline at all.

I go to the store and complain.  "too bad" so sad.  They won't help.  I call the store GM.  He says someone will call and correct at least the mechanisms.  Someone does call, 4 times, while I am at work.  I call back the next day and leave 2 messages.  It's now been 2 months -- no return call.

Ripped off on the $2000 couch and now ripped off on the $70 service fee to "fix" my couch.  They actually broke it.

NEVER BUY ANYTHING THERE!!  Cheap, cheap, cheap.  Don't take pride or responsibility for their merchandise.  This is my opinion.
Good food, fun atmosphere, young crowd. Try this place. I had a hamburger, the fries were good and the burger was large. Not disappointed.

I am a California transplant and was sooo excited when I saw this Togo's!! Unfortunately I was disappointed. My sandwich was served to me with the bread falling apart. I honestly don't know why the girl making my sandwich didn't just get another piece of bread? and the girls working were not very friendly. Won't be going here again...which makes me so sad. I got to the table...looked down, and this was my sandwich. :-(

I like how they offer chicken soup and coleslaw as a side. Ok chicken sandwiches. Very little toppings.... Just 2 pickles, 1 slice lettuce and 1 tomato slice and no sauce?? Went through the drive- thru one year  and got a free coupon for a peach milkshake which was fantastic but I don't think they serve them anymore sadly. To me, chocolate, strawberry, and vanilla are boring flavors. And cookies and cream is just gross. Wraps look good though I haven't tried them yet and I like how they offer trays, the chicken wrap tray and fruit salad tray look most appetizing. From now on if I go there I will probably order a chicken wrap and a cup of soup.... But not the most exciting place.

Curtiss PM has a high employee turnover rate in both front office and maintenance staff.  The office location has also been moved 3 times in the last 4 years. As an owner, rent was normally paid out to us over 45 days after collection and sometimes after several calls to get paid.  The company did not properly inspect or have our rental cleaned after it went vacant so we lost several months before we had to travel to Meridian to empty garbage, have carpets cleaned and re-rent it ourselves.

Denizens of Treasure Valley, we are not so far from the ocean as other places I have lived, but the quest for good seafood is always a precarious one.  After falling in love with sushi a few years ago, we always make it a point to find a good place to satisfy that craving.  Now we knew going in that Lucky Fins was probably not going to be the most "authentic" experience for sushi, but we weren't expecting the best, just something that would fit the bill that we would feel comfortable bringing all our kids to.  Unfortunately, I have to report that Lucky Fins fell far short of those expectations.

Most of my disappointment with Lucky Fins has to do with the service.  Everything took an extremely long time from drinks to soups to the actual entrees.  I can understand being a little backlogged in the kitchen, but we saw patrons who were seated after us receive their meals before we did.  When you have three small children to pacify, these kinds of delays become that much more difficult.  The other aspect of the service that really bothered me is when it came time to finally get our check, the waiter stood there telling us the entire history of the restaurant as two of our three kids were crying and we were trying to get them out of there.  So instead of promptly paying our check and getting out of the way, we had to sit there and listen to a "sales pitch" while our kids cried... and disturbed the meals of other patrons.  I get that servers are trained to "sell" the restaurant, but this was not the time or the place for such a thing, in my opinion.

As far as the food goes, it was ok.  The stand out for me was the poblano pepper soup.  It had great flavor and was the only aspect of the meal that was above average for me.  The sushi rolls both myself and my wife ordered were acceptable, but we have both had far better even at similar restaurants, to say nothing of more authentic sushi bars.  There was nothing wrong with the food, but there was nothing about it that seemed good enough to warrant a repeat visit, especially in light of the service difficulties that we encountered.

Bottom line folks, if you can get better service, you'll get a decent seafood meal at Lucky Fins.  But my advice would be to look elsewhere first.

Place was clean staff was friendly. The food so so. I got the chicken bowl. Was surprised to see they use frozen veggies. The carrots were undercooked. The flavor profile seemed boring. Needed sauce or something. I took it home added teriyaki sauce and cooked the veggies in a pan. Made it into more of a stir fry. That seemed to help.

I've had some disappointment with this grocery store. Walking in appearances are important. I see the grocery carts are dirt and garbage littered, I see the trashes in the bathroom over-flowing. I see leaves and other debris on the floor in the main entryway. The grocery cart belts are broken, old and brittle
.With premium.prices I'd hoped for more premium services. They are often pushy to take out your purchases. It never seems to fail when something is "on sale" I have to show the cashiers the price to get it over-riden! Huckleberries is in real trouble with more down to earth pricing from Fred Meyers, Natural Grocers and now The Co Op. I'm glad they want to maintain a clean store but they never cover the deli items when they spray windex or amonia on the glass
 I would never buy a deli item there again.
Love their pizza! But they don't deliver Monday-Thursday! Only Fridays and Saturdays so it's inconvenient if you just want to order some pizza or if you can't leave your house for some reason.

Love the food. The waitresses are the worst, especially the red head. If she comes to serve you either move to another spot or go to obradys! Went there on Superbowl. Had signs all over saying drink n food specials. So we asked about them and were told they didn't have any? Huh!

Nice selection, prices were ok, found the same sofa here that was priced at least $100 more at other local stores.  The employees obviously work on commission, are very pushy and aggressive, but that is just the way it is set up there (and at some other local stores too, granted).  We actually ended up buying furniture (a couch they did not have there) at another store and a lot of that was just the atmosphere and quality. There are some really great cheaper/reasonably priced pieces at this store, just not the one for my family.

I was disappointed.  Chicken noodle soup was tasteless.  All served on plastic ware.  Sandwich was pretty good.  I had the Cubano.  Staff was friendly.  How do you manage to get DRY chicken in a soup with soggy vegetables and no herbs or salt?  I don't recommend unless you are starving and no place else is open.

So glad to see a healthy offering close to home! The menu is simple: pick your protein- beef, chicken, tofu, or beef/chicken combo; pick your base- white rice, brown rice, or salad; pick a size. The veggies are fresh, steamed for 1 minute so they are still crisp and flavorful and the meat is marinated in a special teriyaki sauce and grilled. No added fats or oils, just good honest food. 
I'm confused as to why some reviewers thought the food was "flavorless", the portions small, or the staff disinterested. We did not find this to be true at all. As prepared, the meal is not drowning in sauce as with some Asian dishes (Panda Express, anyone?). For those who want to sauce it up, or add extra heat there is a sauce bar (free) where you can create a swimming pool for your meal if you choose. Not my style, but some may like this. The regular portion was equal to that at any rice bowl restaurant and filled me up to the "very full" level.  If you are a light or heavy eater you can choose whatever size suits you. The value was excellent.  At $7.99 including drink it is hard to find a meal any other place except McDonalds.  I'll take the healthy, fresh, and flavorful option please! Service was fast, friendly, made to order, and helpful. We will be back (often)!
Husband is a fan of Zen Bento and claims this is better!

You can look at this place as an REI that's cheaper, but with worse selection, or an online store where you can try stuff on before buying, but with worse selection. If those are your expectations, this place is great! The clearance rack has things that are discounted by 50% to 80%. Compare that to a normal outdoor goods store, where the clearance rack will have things that are 20%-30% off!

The selection isn't as good as at the Utah STP or the Denver STP, but they have way more stuff on clearance here than at either of those other locations.

People are complaining that the prices used to be better (perhaps true) and that the selection isn't as good as online (obviously true because you can buy online from a giant warehouse plus multiple store locations and this is just one store), but this is still as good as it gets if you want to try on some deeply discounted outdoor clothing.

This place is wonderful. I am a religious customer - every 2 weeks with Oreanne. She is quick, efficient and creative. All the workers there treat each other like family, which I really appreciate and this place is usually PACKED. 

I recommend scheduling an appointment as walking in can be a little bit hard to do with the amount of business these guys receive. I also recommend Tom, he is a hoot to be around and he's a great nail tech. I've had my nails done by 3 different people here, and they're all great. 

I've also had a pedicure there by one of the newer girls and she was great, super easy to talk to, professional, and fast. Loved it.

One of those steady eddy restaurants you can always count on for good food and excellent customer service. Tonight we split the nachos with half chicken and half shredded beef and it was very good. Very comfortable dining ambiance. Chips and salsa were great and I love their free creative dessert. Prices are average to higher than average.

We went to lucky fins to celebrate my birthday. I called in ahead as there were six of us going. When we got there we were seated at a very small table that uncomfortably fit six people. The wine selection was great. We got a bottle of moscato and it was very enjoyable. We ordered the stuffed mushrooms and the crunchy sushi roll for appetizers. They were both delicious. We all ordered the crab. It came on these giant plates that did not fit at our table. They were hanging off the edge. It was a challenge through out the meal to keep it from dumping off of the table edge into our laps. The crab was good...but it's kinda hard to screw that up. The crab came with fries. They were delicious for about five minutes until the crab juice absorbed into them and made them soggy, which was kinda gross. So would I go back? Maybe. I think I will try a different location next time. It was not as great as I had heard.
Omg so good. Best burger in town. Kinda pricy though. Would have given 5 stars if the lady at the front got our correct order

I went in for a gel manicure and it didn't even last three days before chipping. I went back to have them fix it and they only wanted to fix the five that had chipped. I said no thank you because the others will most likely chip then. The owner argued with me in front of the whole salon saying they would put another top coat on the others. They did eventually agree to fix them and 5 days later chipped again:/ Bad experience I will not go back.

I am a California native and grew up on togos . Turkey Avocado has always been my fav . Until I had it in Idaho . What's with the tasteless bread . I don't remember the bread being completely tasteless . Also I found
It odd that who I will assume were the owners were not up helping guests. I stood at the counter while the one kid out in front made a wrap for another employee and had a lovely convo while I stood there. The male assumed  owner eventually said someone will 
be with you and then another girl came scurrying
From the back . I understand , your running a business with a bunch of 16 yr olds at the helm . If I were you I would be hands on till they know the ropes . Customer service is key ! Especially with that terrible bread . There are plenty if sandwich places in Meridian. You better step up your game . Don't have a guest wait while you prepare food for a employee and when you
Notice your employees drop the ball
Get In there . Don't sit down and eat a sandwich :/ .....cuz that's what dude did and then the kid with the wrap joined him . While I was still waiting for my food .
Nice place.  Only one visit but impressed but service and food.

Love this place! The staff is awesome and so is the food! I've had the elpuerco, rancho, gardel, la Nona, Brazilian, doc, and pumpkin. Me and my family have never been disappointed and everyone I take absolutely loves it. I keep on coming back!

This is a definite spot to eat at..we started off with the shellfish appetizer and it was delicious fresh oysters and perfect crab and shrimp. .The Cadillac margarita hit the spot..we ordered the forbidden tuna and the lobster crab cakes for dinner...booooomb..Both were perfect..and of course we had to get dessert the mango cake was freckin delicious !!!! like I want that for my wedding cake delicious.THE BEST!.and our waiter Josh as well as the rest of the staff  was  wonderful..we will definitely be back  for the fresh seafood and drinks and desserts

Megan my sales person is excellent. Have purchased multiple items, bedroom set, living room furniture etc. Megan has been very helpful each time I've come to the store. The delivery teams have been excellent. I have had 4 separate deliveries with no problems. I will definitely continue to shop at RC Willey.

The food here is great when you compare it to other sports bars on the meridian area on the south side of the freeway. (Rudy's, Harry's). The service has always been great yet sometime a bit slow. Like most sports sit in establishments big games, Sunday and Monday night football Its just to crowded. I would like it to be a little bit bigger. Yet overall great place to grab some food, drink a beer, and watch the game.

Wow! These guys added me to their busy schedule and came out to install a new air conditioner in 93 degree weather. Took out the old unit on Wednesday afternoon and put the new one in on Thursday morning. Everything was done perfectly, including new sheet metal for a four-inch filter and brand new pipes. It not only works beautifully, but they came out today (Friday) and spent 40 minutes sealing an annoying air leak. I heartily recommend them for any heating or air conditioning problems!!!

Came here earlier in the day with girlfriend and a couple friends for a good ole game of miniature golf.

Perfect day today with blue skies and 72 degree weather especially for us Seattle folks. A game per person was $7 and change which was very affordable for 18 exciting holes.

The employees were friendly and smiling which meant they enjoyed their jobs. We spent about an hour and a half playing 18 holes which was a blast. $7 bucks for person for an hour and a half of fun?! Nowadays is very hard to find.

Would definitely recommend for everyone!
Pretty good food good service will probably return.  Thought the French dip could have had a little more meat  but very tender

My tire was SCREWED! 
Last night my tire pressure indicator came on. This morning the tire was flat. I aired it up and drove straight to Les Schwab. I expected to wait a while, especially on a Saturday morning at 10:30 but I was in and out in less than 15 minutes! Turns out I had picked up a screw somewhere. The employees here are amazing, efficient and the model of what customer service should be.

Friendly staff, great service. The only observation is related to the price, I only changed the battery of my Ipod and I was charged $30+tax, it seems a little pricy but maybe I'm wrong.
Thanks

Purchased a sofa sleeper at 3pm on a Friday and was able to pick it up Saturday afternoon after 4pm. The purchase itself was easy and quick, Carlotta was a great help. When we picked it up the fabric protector was already sprayed dryer and re-wrapped for my pick up. When we got home we set it all up and realized the couch hadn't come with the legs. Called the store and they got me a new set of legs the next day no hassle.

This was the worst coffee ever. Probably would be better if the barista had proper training. She was super sweet but... we both ordered 12 oz hazelnut lattes, she poured the shots and let them sit for 4 mins 17 secs... yes I timed it! And THEN she steamed her milk... twice and it was like warm. She poured the hazelnut straight in the cups as well. I knew the coffee was gunna be bad but I tried it Anyhow to see if I could at least bare it... nope. Dumped it down the drain along with my money. I hope you decide to actually train your baristas or your company will fail.
Wonderful customer service and the food is off the hook.  Great panini combos that pair well with their made from scratch soups A+++++
Worth getting up early. Red velvet and blueberry cake donuts are out of this world. This place makes the best donuts in town
I will never go back there. The pizza was greasy. Yech.  Drunk manager who cursed at everyone.

Yummy, we get a couple spicy rolls and sushi and just enjoy ourselves.  Sometimes the chef has a tuna cheek that isn't on the menu but it's worth asking for.  The servers are always great and the owners are often in the building.  We keep buying gift cards for our friends and then using them ourselves before we give them away.

My hubby and I had wanted to try this since they opened. He works most weekends and has been gone for the rest, so we took a rare Saturday morning and visited there. The wait was so worth it. The famous huckleberry pancakes were awesome and light and I hate pancakes. But the Corned Beef Hash was amazing, once again not normally one of my favorite foods. Far more homemade corned beef than potatoes and I scarfed more than my husband would have preferred from his plate!! Please give them a fair shot and help support the local business making our little corner of the world a better place to be -and to eat!

Veeeery slow during lunchtime, waited more than half an hour for the food. 
It's good for a beer or cocktail after work.

This was from a couple weeks ago.. Went for lunch and ordered 1/2 sandwich, small deli fries, and a water. $7.50.. The Sandwich tasted OK but hardly had any meat or cheese on it.. the Deli fries also tasted good but there were literally only 5 fries. I just felt as their product is pretty good but lacked any substance for what it costs. Might give them another try but order a whole sandwich to see if its worth the $

I will tell you up front, I'm originally from the area and have watched "Speedy" the owner go from being a server here to owning the place. And make no mistake, he has upped the whole experience as far as I am concerned. I now live in Utah but every time I go home to visit, honestly, I stop here to grab some great food before I see the family. My favorite is the Mole enchiladas, this is his family recipe. I've tried others when I travel but found nothing that compares for me. My wife now considers this her favorite Mexican too, she loves the chile relleno, and the Fautas oh my! I've got to stop, now I need a road trip.

Their customer service is unlike any other I have ever experienced! I went there when they were slammed with customers and I was brought my food to me not even asking my number and yes my order was correct..how did they know it was me I have no idea. I got ask if I wanted a refill while waiting for my food too. The store was very clean and everyone was friendly too. Of course Chick-fil-A's food was top notch, I highly recommend stopping by when passing through Meridian, Idaho you won't be disappointed!
Worth the trip...my expectations were high with the favorable reviews and I wasn't disappointed.  I must say this is a place you will want to frequent!

Had screen damage to my iPhone 5c. The boys in the shop were polite and helpful. They quoted me a time of 20 minutes, however I went in on a busy Saturday afternoon and was in and out in less then a hour! $85 bucks tax included. Not bad considering the soonest I could get into the Apple Store was Wednesday (not for another 5 days) and these folks did the job for $50 less then the Apple Store and with a lifetime warranty on the glass.
Thank you Idaho iRepair

Will not be back.  Not really sure where to start - Service was poor, took 50 minutes for a table of two to get breakfast, served warm at best.  We heard a lot of excuses, kitchen is backed up, we  are out of bacon right now, waiting for it before we can get your bacon peppered Bloody Mary.   My husband asked for coffee after 1/4 of his cup had coffee grinds in it.  They said they had to make a new pot so that would be awhile.   A couple who had been there an hour was left in tears as they did not understand why they could not get there food.  A big table next to us left a good amount of the food as they stated how gross it was.  Poorly managed, bad ownership.   Disappointing to say it best.

This place is one of the best breakfast places I've been at; food is amazing, people working are very nice, and the dining area is very clean and nicely lit.

Review: Man, I really, REALLY loved eating here. Food was very tasty, portions were big, and just the overall vibe was great. Servers were fantastic and the dining area was very well lit. We got a Cafe Mocha ( I think that's what it was called), and it really was a treat. I tried Italian Joe's Special, Strawberry French Toast (Smaller Breakfasts), and also one of their daily specials (Turkey Avocado Omelet with Swiss Cheese and something else). Everything was top notch. 

I'm literally getting hungry reviewing these pictures that I took, I think I'm coming back there this weekend, it's just that good. I haven't tried their lunch options, but if they are as good as their breakfast, I'm all in.

Trust me, if you're in Meridian, you HAVE to stop in here... 5 stars EASY...

I was on vacation in Meridian in June 2016.  I thought I had a slow leak, but I had a cracked front rim on my truck causing it to lose air.  "Jared" not only was a friendly knowledgable young man, he worked with me.  Jared and David knew I was in a pinch up there and yet they assisted me fairly and professionally.  I will send everyone I know to Les Schwab Tires.

A big THANK YOU to Jared.

I'm really disappointed after coming here. I got a mani pedi spa and was over charged. They tried to charge me the price of a regular mani on top of the mani pedi I was getting. My girlfriends also got a pedi and we were all confused about what the hell we were paying for. The pricing on their website is not true. And a couple of the staff couldn't explain to us what was included in the different pedicures. They have no menu of what services they provided, I asked! 

Overall my nails do look nice and the staff was friendly, but they overcharged me according to their website and that definitely bothers me.  Won't be coming here again.

I prefer Mattress Land Sleep Fit more than any other mattress store in Boise and the reason is because they have this machine that you lay in and it calculates the support number.  Then you have a wide range of mattresses to choose from in your number.  In addition to this awesome machine that provides your support number, THIS IS THE ONLY STORE IN BOISE THAT HAS LATEX MATTRESSES!!!!  Yes, I put that in caps because it is a very hard to find mattress, it is guaranteed for 25 years, and other mattress places in Boise don't have these because they want to sell you a mattress every 10 years!   Anyhow, my husband and I got our last mattress at Mor, it lasted 9 years, we came here and worked with Casey Timmons, and now we have a latex mattress that we love and it is guaranteed for 25 years!!!  Thank you Casey for your patience!!!  We love our new mattress and most importantly, I'm not in pain when I wake up anymore!!!  Thank you!!!

Worst customer service I have had at a Vape shop. Bought an "authentic" mod from these guys. Used it the first day, and it was shocking me. Brought it back in and one of the employees took it apart and found metal shavings where the firing pin is. He cleaned it out and I agreed to try it again. One week later same issues and took it back in. I told them I wanted to swap for a different mod and they said they couldn't without talking to a manager and sent me back on my way. Will not shop here ever again. If something is obviously defective empower your employees to make it right.  Plenty of other shops that actually care about doing good business.

We stopped here while visiting the area. My wife ordered calamari rings and salad. I ordered mahi mahi tacos with rice. 

I had doubts about a seafood restaurant so far from the sea but the food was awesome. 

The calamari was crisp-fried but not greasy. The tacos had many layers of flavor and texture and also tasted great. The surprise was the rice. It had a nice flavor and slightly creamy texture. It was fabulous. 

Overall great value for quality and quantity was well worth the price. Staff was great too

My father in law is visiting from Arkansas, so we took him here for brunch.  The timing was perfect; 10:30 on a Wednesday, not busy at all.  The food was great, as well as the service.  My father in law said he loved his meal and was glad we took him.

I love that there is finally a restaurant with healthy choices! I got the mix so I tried the two different kinds of meats and I love that they top it with green onion so healthy and such the right proportions. Will definitely be eating here again. I just wish they had a drive-thru.

My wife and I had ordered the special today, the ahi and halibut. Upon cutting open the halibut, out came worms, enough so that their wiggling bodies covered every visible portion of the fish.  Our appetite was ruined, food returned, the manager apologized and gave us a $25 gift card that was a nice gesture that we will not be taking advantage of anytime soon. Hopefully this was a one time occurrence.

If you like Quality pastries like me! We know that quality product makes quality pastries. Little Kitchen Pastries bring extra smile with delightful party in our mouth, every time we are here. This place takes their time, dedication and love of baking that is no where to be found in Treasure Valley. I believe pastries is art and this place has the best French Croissants, Danish and Caramel Pecan Buns. And more! Be here early and because they close at 2:30pm. Don't forget to request Lemon Almond  Braid - you will love every bite of it.
I usually get the daily special and try a new soup each time I come here.  So far, the clam chowder is my favorite.

This is hands down THE BEST breakfast eatery in the Treasure Valley!  We have eaten breakfast close to a dozen times now since we moved here two years ago and discovered Steve's.  This restaurant is so well run....very clean, great servers/customer service and the food is soooo good, especially the pancakes, just packed with yummy berries and the syrup, oh yeah!  Piping hot breakfast served in less than 10 minutes (20 at the MOST on a busy weekend), my kind of place.  Prices are reasonable and you won't leave disappointed!

This is definitely one of my favorite places to visit in Meridian or in Boise for seafood. Last time I visited Boise in the summer I was on a great conquest to find the best sushi in the treasure valley with the best deal and I think Lucky Fins won it! Lucky Fins not only has some pretty good sushi but they also have happy hour for their sushi, so if you're craving some good sushi without breaking the bank, this is FOR SURE the best place I've found so far! Also, the staff at the Meridian location is phenomenal! I was telling the waiter that I had been on some weird kick with Shirley Temples and for some reason every restaurant I went to never gave me cherries. When he brought out my Shirley Temple he provided me with PLENTY to make up for the lack of cherries I had received elsewhere! Great restaurant!

I make a point, every time a travel for work, to give myself at least one morning where I can go and try one of the local spin studios. I've been to quite a few, and as lovely as they are, there's nothing like coming home to CycleBar that makes you appreciate what you have when you have it. The CycleStars are always challenging and encouraging. Support staff is engaging and helpful. The studio is top-of-the-line. All amenities are thought of. And the cherry on top is the community that is created here. I'm beyond grateful for my CB fam!

It was no where near as good as we were expecting. It was really cool that we could order ahead of time to save time. However, the fries were tasteless, the milk shakes were so thin, they treated like chocolate milk. ..with a root beer after taste. ...was very odd. I posted the bbq bacon chicken burger. Super greasy. Not to mention the order was Ali wrong.  I just wanted bbq sauce, bacon and crispy chicken. I got bbq sauce, pickles, cheese, unions and grilled chicken. 

I think we will go to five guys next time.

It's Chick-fil-A. When we lived in Tennessee we had it but weren't super impressed. Maybe it's that I got something different (spicy chicken sandwich). Hubby got chicken strips. We ate his with plenty of chick-fil-a sauce :). We also got a bunch of extra sandwiches and stowed them in a cooler (and froze them at home) for his coworker from the south whose family really misses it!

Fresh, non-fried fish and seafood is hard to come by in the Boise area, and I am glad that this place has opened to fill that void!  

The first thing that impressed us with the menu were the PRICES.  Unlike most seafood restaurants, most of the dishes were under $15.  The specials on that particular night were a few bucks more, which is still helluva reasonable for the product you're ordering!  While there are some fried items on the menu, most of the entrees highlight healthier preparation methods.  In addition, the variety of fish used was diverse, as well as the methods of preparation.  

For our visit, our order came from both the special 'fresh' board, as well as the menu.  Everything was above-average quality, and our server did an excellent job to make sure that our visit met our expectations, and the chef/owner made sure to stop by every table to introduce himself as well.  My favorite part of the meal was the Escolar poke appetizer - it was all I could do to not lick the martini glass it came in!

I foresee us making the trek from SE Boise to the dreaded Eagle Rd./Fairview intersection on a regular basis - it's just that good.

Update:  I'm just editing this in an attempt to 'unfilter' my review...not sure why it was filtered in the first place?!  We visited this place, loved it, and plan on going back - end of story!!!

It's a great gym, well maintained large facility.Coaching staff provides organized/structured classes. My daughter has learned so much! By far, the best gym in the state with state championship wins!!!

Very clean and the staff was very helpful and friendly...the prices were good and soups are very tasty, great choices and not heavy cream based they are broth based...the grilled cheese was awesome BUT messy:)...
Quick service and excellent selections. My club sandwich was delicious and packed with meat and the French dip was one of the best ever.

What a pleasant surprise to find Lucky Fin. I asked several people around the area before going there. How good seafood could be in Boise anyway ? Much to my surprise it was excellent. We tried a couple different appetizers and the four of us each had something different for an entrée. Everyone was delighted with their meal. I'm sure you will be too.

I thoroughly enjoy going to Ylan Salon and Spa. Tasha does my nails and she does then fabulously and I'm greeted & welcomed professionally. I'm fussy about how my nails are done so I'll keep going back. By the way, I schedule my appointments so my days runs smoothly.
Great place to grab a quick and yummy dinner. Made fresh and you cook it., not greasy like pizza parlors. Kids love it!

Yea!!!!!  Super nice and friendly staff.... sitting at the bar was an absolute pleasure...awesome customized drinks.... Real..actual, delicious and fresh oysters on the half shell!  Beautifully prepared mussels for a special appetizer... modestly priced and  well selected wines by the glass.....Likey likey!  We will be back!

My husband and I are both long-term customers and we've always loved going to Steve's. We usually have breakfast there but we have lunch there yesterday about 1 p.m. I ordered their corned beef sandwich, fries with a side of coleslaw. I was really enjoying the sandwich and fries but when I went to take a bite of coleslaw there was a hair in my food. I pulled it out and gave her the hair, asked her to send it back and take it off my check. My husband mentioned to me this was the second time in a row this had happened. Our server didn't come over for quite a while but then apologized. The manager never came over. In a bad situation like that a manager always comes over in my 50+ years of dining experience. When I mentioned to our server that this was the second time in a row she didn't really say much, and there was no refund for our lunch offered. After having been there a long time and really enjoying the place, I'm wondering if things have gone downhill since Steve has left? This is just really BAD customer service. We won't be back.

Really pleased with this establishment. The staff is all extremely kind! I had my eyebrows waxed by Helen, who is great! I absolutely adore her. She's entertaining and she did a great job. Tom did my nails. He was very gentle. For once, I didn't bleed from getting my nails done! 
I didn't wait long. The staff was organized. And I'm happy with the results. Will absolutely be returning. :)

My wife and I ate here for lunch, both of us had the special chicken salad sandwich with soup, I had the roasted tomato basil soup and my wife had the broccoli four cheese.  Both were excellent, I will return.  Interesting they have carrot lemonade drinks, I went for the more mainstream cranberry lemonade, it was ok.

This restaurant is still pretty new to the Treasure Valley. A little hard to find unless you are looking for it, which is probably why it wasn't very crowded. Atmosphere is very nice. Love the lighting. 
Agree with the last reviewer, the staff was super friendly and very eager to answer any questions.
We had the calamari appetizer with a key lime aioli, which was good (it is the fried strips type not the rings and tentacles, which makes it easier for some people to enjoy if they can't get past the look of it). Aioli could have had a little more lime in it, but it was still very tasty.
Their iceberg wedge salad was very good. Nice cool crunch, with lots of flavor punch from the toppings.
I had the baja crusted rainbow trout, pretty good - the fish was cooked perfectly, and the crust was a nice texture. Personally, I think it could have had a bit more salt. Chef might have expected the crushed tortilla chips to lend more salt than they did.
My son let me try a bite of his fins fish tacos, and they were excellent! Great balance of flavors and a nice level of spice.
My husband had the baja seafood enchiladas. The flavor was great, but flour tortillas in enchiladas always seems a little odd to us. The texture of corn tortillas seem to hold up so much nicer to the sauce. 
My son also couldn't help but to get the captain crunch fried ice cream, which was a fun alternative to the traditional variety.
All in all it was a fun experience and the food really was very good. I would love to see them become more popular, they have so much potential in becoming a great restaurant. I look forward to going back and trying some more of their menu.

Just had dinner here and it was really great. It was nice to be able to sample the soups before ordering. We ordered Tomato basil soup with a Reuben and buffalo chicken soup with the chipotle turkey sandwich. All of it was super tasty and went perfectly with the soup! We picked up a Blue Crab curry soup from their frozen section to take home. Cant wait to try that! 

I'm surprised to see some reviews mention high prices. I thought it was very moderately priced, especially for made from scratch, delicious food! Quality ingredients, quality establishment. We will be back soon!

I've been to your eatery multiple times and am always pleased. The food is always good. The staff are always AWESOME. I'm at a chick-fil-a in Austin, Texas at the moment. The food is good, but I miss your service!

New favorite family restaurant!

I wanted to try something new and settled on this place after searching on Yelp and checking out the reasonably priced menu online.  It was packed tonight and we were told we had a 25 minute wait, but I think it was more like 10 or 15. The hostesses are friendly, and our server was great as well. The restaurant has a nice ambiance. It's also on the noisy side. 

I was pleasantly surprised to see popcorn shrimp on the kids menu so our toddlers split that. It was lightly breaded and flavorful. I wanted to try the Hawaiian sliders. It was the one let down, only because I was expecting it to have some sort Hawaiian BBQ sauce but it was dry.  My husband liked his steak even though he prefers rib-eye, and my step-daughter's burger was amazing. Ironic that the best burger I've had in a long time was at a seafood restaurant. They also have two kinds of fries, one basic and the other seasoned to taste like BBQ potato chips.

I just had to try the fried ice cream for dessert. They use Captain Crunch for the crust. It was yummy and a fun throwback to my childhood.

I look forward to returning and trying other things, namely that burger.

Seafood in Boise?   Yep this is the place for me!  I really like the whole vib and feel of this place.   Just can't believe I've never stopped here before.   I've been upstairs many time at the bar upstairs ( varsity pub)  but glad I tryed it today.   

Food,    Salmon cooked to perfection and my po boy was very good.  I asked to have a combination  ouster  shrimp poor boy and it was so good.  The bread was perfect.   Very important to use the right bread when making a po boy!   Claim chowder was ok.  Not as good as kahoots a few block away.   Next trip I will try and jalapeno soup and fried ice cream another yelper recommended.
 

Everyone very freindly and happy to give recommendations!  Over all just a cool  classy little seafood place.    Going back for sure!

They responded and credited me the delivery fee and 1/ 2 the cost of rails (~100 total) and finally got it right....Had the Manager, Delivery Coordinator and Customer Service rep all call me prior promising that the rails would be measured before delivery and followed through perfectly...As I have said RC Willey has TOP notch Customer Service..fingers crossed some 'powers that be' in RC Willey Corp...Re-evaluates their relationship with this particular vendor..

But strangely they deleted my FB post to the same.. But no worries..no reason(sadly) to have their dirty laundry aired....would have gave the company props....

Will look to them again, but with trepidation....

Super friendly staff, the manager (maybe he was the owner - not sure) was incredibly nice and was up helping make sandwiches. The produce was all very fresh and the bread was fresh.  I have nothing but good things to say about this location. I come here every time I'm in Boise.

Went for the first time last night for a beer.   Ordered a beer and flat bread and got a pizza?   My buddy ordered a non-alcoholic beer and they were sold out......on a friday night?  But the place was packed so that must mean something.  Nice atmosphere and will go back for dinner just to give it a chance.

This is a new sit down burger joint that popped up in Meridian.  I was curious about what made it so different from all the other ones that are out there.  It has a fast food feel to it, but you can sit and relax without the feeling that they want you to eat and get the heck out.  I ordered a 1/2lb BBQ, bacon and cheese burger and something called smash fries.  These are regular fries but they are coated with olive oil, rosemary and garlic among other herb.  They were actually very good.  I would highly recommend that you give these a try.  Definantly are better then regular fries.  The burger ended up being HUGE.  I enjoyed it but was not able to finish it all.  This is a pretty good joint, I would recommend that you give it a try.  Only problem is that they do not have a drive up window at this location.  Not sure if any of ther other ones do.
Horrible customer service. Called in my order and they sold it. Walked in and paid for seven pizzas and they took 45 minutes. forgot to serve me and served 9 other people who came in after me.

Excellent Service and Food. We were a little leery because of the rating but we were pleasantly surprised. We sat out on the patio and had a cool fire top table. Our waitress Alyssa was excellent she even offered a blanket because it was chilly out.  We had drinks and appetizers and everything was delicious-  the filthy fires and nachos were amazing. The small nachos were large enough that 4 of us shared them. Definitely recommend this place!
I rate them 1 star and that's just being nice because of the horrible experience we had which I posted earlier.
Sweet staff and great donuts! Actually everything we had was awesome. Best in Meridian!

Good food, but rather expensive for what it is.

Big, wide open restaurant so it is pretty loud.

Service is pretty good. 

I wanted to like this place a lot more but 40+ for a standard breakfast including kids food is kind of steep..

Unlikely to return.

I have been driving past the shop for the last few months and finally decided to stop in. This is definitely a mom and pop shop. I was told everything is made in house except for the scone filling. And it shows! Everything I ordered was delicious! The ham and cheese croissant was amazing! The croissants really are like a true French pastry not an out of the box mix. The sticky bun was rich and gooey and perfect. The shortbread cookie was like a fancier version of a Keebler "Pecan Sandies"cookie. The "morning roll" is a crescent roll dough rolled up with cinnamon, sugar, and orange zest. If you like orange rolls you will love this! Owners were very friendly and very helpful at describing every goody.

This place deserves zero stars! No wonder the place was empty at lunch; horrible service, uncooked food and wrong order served, server tried to tell me that was what I ordered, gave me a lesser priced sandwich and then tried to charge me for the higher priced sandwich I ordered...and then wanted to argue about it!!
Save your hard earned money and go spend it on a place that appreciates your business.
Kelvin was so helpful! I shattered my iPhone 5 screen last night and really needed my GPS today. He fixed it in less than 20 minutes and it's perfect. Thank you so much!!!

Ok, I was so looking forward to this place opening and when it did... I was blown away at the quality of food and service. Who ever is working there is honestly working their hardest to give the best service they can. The food it fresh, and excellent quality. They have a huge variety of menue items and a variety of sauces. I enjoy the "Deluxe" and the "Z". The spicy sauce is good if you like the heat... I will return many times for more of your Greek Tacos.

Great little restaurant with a soup, sandwich and salad menu. Open during lunch time.....for now. Buffalo Chicken soup is everything you would want if you were wanting wings and soup. They have the grilled cheeses down, making sure there is crispy cheese all around the edge. Try the carrot juice lemonade, nothing like you would imagine!! Also grab some soup to take home, we did!

I beg of you not to even enter this establishment (I use that word very loosely) We had a big problem with this location about a month before the latest experience.  It took literally an hour to get a take out order. The owner demanded that if I wanted the "sale" price that I needed to be seated and do an internet order. I tried doing this and their internet service wasn't working. The place was hot and people were just RUDE! I had to ask several times for different things they "forgot". So why in the WORLD would I choose to go there again? Honestly, no clue. My bad. But we just went there on 6/29/2015 and the waitress at first said their dining room was "closed" even though it was not closing time for the restaurant.  When the manager decided to LET us eat there, the waitress spilled water all over my children and didn't even apologize.  She used curse words loud enough for my kids to hear. We never got a refill of drinks, silverwear, menu's...our breadsticks didn't come out until AFTER we talked to the shift leader about the bad experience we were having.  The waitress plopped piping hot food down (and I mean plopped..almost THREW it at my children!) in front of my toddlers hands and he burnt his hand! He screamed in pain and the waitress snickered.  Seriously...this experience was more than rotten! Please never visit this place.  This was more than bad customer service.  It was negligent.

One of the few places open late. We sat outside at a high table that had a fire pit in it. It was a little cool outside and they lit the fire pit at our request. They also offered a blanket to put on our shoulders. They took our drink and food order right away. The food came out quick. We got a small nachos and it was huge. The quesadilla was very good and the bacon on top was the bomb. I got the lettuce wraps and they were good to. Great drink selection.

Food wasn't bad, but not highly impressive for the price.  The wait staff was pleasant and the service was excellent.  The noise from the bar was a little overwhelming to have a nice quiet meal for two.
The meat is Smokey and they provide a hefty serving. I love that they serve fruit and veggies with their meals. I think it's a great value for a quick on the go meal option.

As far as fast food type burgers go this place was excellent. It gets good reviews for a tasty burger and a tasty burger it was!

That being said, the reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5 was because in the back of my mind I couldn't help thinking that for the money I would have been happier with a burger from Red Robin for the same price. 

The difference maker for me would be if they included fries with the burger, saving me two bucks, I would have felt like I got a better overall deal, therefore making it a fantastic bargain for great food. 

Still, if you haven't tried it, I think it's worth stopping by.

Before I start my review I want to explain that I am an experienced tanner that has been at several salons over the years. 

So the girl working the front is super friendly. She is engaging from the moment you walk in the door (pretty sure her name was Megan). I asked a bunch of questions about the actual tanning beds and the lotions and unfortunately she has a tough time answering them. I signed up for a monthly unlimited plan and didn't get a copy for my records which is weird. The price is in my opinion high but not unreasonable. The salon was clean. 

My issue is that I got burned........really really burned and I haven't burned in a tanning bed in at least 5 years. I specifically asked to be in a bed with cooler bulbs, I was placed in a bed with the hottest bulbs in the salon. The bed itself was outdated and literally had loose screws hanging off of it. I was told the fan was on high, it was turned off. I don't expect every sales associate to be a pro but I do expect a sales associate to be educated enough to know which bed is best for me. Like I said I haven't burned in 5 years and I was scorched. I didn't even do full time. I hate to imagine what would have happened if I had. I will be back but I will never use those yellow beds again. They are total early 2000 beds and it's no wonder I burned. 

Despite the burn, this place is okay. Oh and it's Jamaica......not Jamaca. Just saying.

Hands down my VERY favorite restaurant in Idaho right now. The Curb is a really nice restaurant with a really beautiful look to it. I love that there is a ton of indoor and outdoor seating. The service here has always been amazing! And there is no plate on earth better than the taco salad made by The Curb.
