I go here often and each time I do I keep telling myself I need to venture out and try more options on the menu, but every time I go back I can't steer myself away from that taco salad; it is to die for! This business is such a great one and I will go back time and time again.

We went on another trip with Dreams On The Fly guide Andrew Catt and experienced another incredible fly fishing experience.  If you're considering an outing on the Owyhee, other Oregon hot spots, or Idaho rivers, Dreams On The Fly is THE place to book your trip...highly recommend !!

This is a great barber shop with lots of qualified barbers and several chairs to get you in and taken care of quickly.  The staff is top notch and the atmosphere is relaxed and friendly.   Great place to get a real haircut.

You must eat the lobster avocado, it is fantastic! The mango shrimp tacos are another favorite. Everything I've eaten at Lucky Fins has been delish, great flavors, and fresh ingredients. The service is hit or miss - I've never had bad service, but I've only had great service once, my other experiences have been in the subpar - average range. That said, the quality/value of the food is worth average service.
We come here at least twice a month. Their Mango Tango roll is one of my favorites!  The staff here is pretty pleasant too.

Cycle Bar has seriously changed my life for the better. I have always struggled with my weight and constantly fluctuate as I loose interest in different exercise plans. Since I have started my unlimited plan with Cycle Bar almost a year ago now, I have shown no signs of slowing down and have been in the best shape of my life. It is the first time I feel in control and confident in myself while also feeling like I am apart of something. The employees have made me feel welcome and as if I am family since day one which I have not always felt at other cycle locations. I would definitely recommend joining Cycle Bar if you are looking for a great work out and obvious results while surrounded by awesome people. Plus it just feels like a giant dance party!

We used to go to Harry's at the old location and liked the laid back atmosphere, and it was a great place to watch football. We recently went to the new location to watch a Thursday night NFL game, when we walked in they had baseball on every tv in the restaurant. After asking 3 times to change only one tv to the football game we decided to leave. They asked why we were leaving after only ordering 1 drink for the group of us and we told them the issue and they still did not want to turn it on. We went to another sports bar and had a great time! The atmosphere is not the same at the new location and I doubt we will ever return.
Food is always excellent and the all you can eat crab is a good deal! Love the teriyaki bowl and the sushi rolls aren't bad. The restaurant is always busy and service is always spot on!

Please go for lunch, say hello to Henry.  He makes this place and is the reason I will go back again and again.  He takes care of the people and he cares.  He is a rare jewel in these days and makes this place great.  I don't know the man and he does not know me but he is my reason for going back.  Oh yes the food is good too

I've eaten here several times. The pastrami here is definitely better than most sub shops. The employees do seem a little "deer in the headlights" sometimes, but I'm chalking that up to the new-ness. It's a solid option for when I'm in the area.

What can I say about Papa Murphys? The consistency is always spot on and the pizza never gets any fresher because you bake it at home. They normally have weekly specials and an unadvertised special for a $5 large pepperoni. Each time I decide to take and bake I am pleased.
The miniature golf course is surrounded by the go-karts and the freeway traffic. As a result it's loud and hard to maintain any type of conversation with people.
This place will be right up you're alley if you like Chilis, Applebee's, or Beef O Brady's. They have a lot of beers on tap, but they are mostly macro brews. It's also pricy for what you get.

Best mexican food we have found since moving here. My wife had the spinich enchiladas and I had the tolucos platter, both were excellent and you could actually taste the liquor in the drinks,  we will definitely be back again and again. Rosie was our waitress and hope she always is.
Hugo's is an above average sandwich shop. If your looking for a good sandwich that's local and not a chain stop here. The French fries are so good so don't miss these.

Like many posts I too grew up in CA.  Togos was half a mile from my house and went there weekly.  The sandwiches my wife and I got were okay, nothing to right home about.  I would give the food three stars.  But the owner, oh the owner, she was very rude and seemed hateful toward the customers.  I don't know if she was having a bad day but we will not be back.  Too bad.

Was super stoked to have a more "hometown " burger and shake shop added to the neighborhood (Vs. the national chain around the corner) but have now been here at least 5 times and every time have been disappointed:(.
Drive thru- my biggest complaint is the LONG wait times and by the time you do get to the window the shakes are either 1. Too soft and halfway melted, 
2. they hand them to you with ice cream leaking down the sides, 
3. or don't get your order right. 
I will say that the huckleberry shake would be good if they could correct all of the above. 
Inside- same complaint with long wait times  and inaccurate orders I've only ordered their burgers and they are average. 
I think my biggest observation is that every time I go it's a bunch of teens/younger employees that could benefit from better training/leadership with focus on attention to detail and efficiency. Our last visit was last night-my husband swears he's never coming back but I would like to give them another shot later to see if they can get their act together.

When my husband and I walked into the restaurant tonight, we almost walked out because the acoustics were so poor. No fabric anywhere...We hoped the rest of our experience would be better as there are good ratings on yelp. Unfortunately nothing lived up to expectations. The sushi was filled with way  too much rice, the fish was cheap. The server, although she was a very well-meaning girl, was not able to speak loud enough for us to hear. In general, the staff seemed to be helpful, but did not know what is appropriate on different occasions.

Nothing special or memorable.  Not a very good value for the actual quality of the burgers.  I don't get the loyal following this place has.  I've eaten there twice to be fair and it was mediocre at best.

I love this coffee shop! 

In terms of coffee, it is the real deal. This is good coffee, not burnt coffee like most of the chains serve. Good stuff, at great prices. No where else can I get this good of drip coffee for $1 (including a free refill!).

In terms of atmosphere, it is fairly minimalist in a good way. Very open, and simple, a refreshing break from the complicate and distraction filled world that we live in. 

In terms of staff, this place rocks! The main day to day barista is also one of the owners, and he is great. The staff make this place is more than a coffee shop, it makes it a community. I personally spend entire days working from open to close on my laptop in this coffee shop. I love that whenever I need a break I can walk over to the owner and have a pleasant chat with him.

All in all, great coffee, great atmosphere, and great relationships! I drive way out of my way to make this coffee shop my work space.
Had some of the best donuts in Idaho at this shop.  The donuts weren't heavy but very lite and super fresh!

It is an outlet and yes it is pricey because they are selling outdoor clothes which are regular price very expensive!

I say it is worth a stop, its near the interstate!

Great options for everyone, breakfast and lunch. Best hashbrowns I've had in a while and I'm not really a hash brown person. Service is really what will bring me back. The server wasn't super great, friendly but only came to our table twice and our food took a long time. But he owner came over to personally apologize and took a significant sum off of our bill. Other staff offered us coffee as we waited and consistently checked our table for a refill which was nice. Everyone that left thanked the owner and said it was great as always which is pretty rare and special to see that everyone praised the restaurant as they left. Definitely a worthwhile breakfast spot. 

Taco Burrito- I had it with egg white and no taco meat (vegetarian) and it was still very large and came with good salsa. Wasn't super flavorful but fulfilled my breakfast burrito craving. 

Huckleberry Stuffed French Toast- flavor was great, sweet, fruity and cinnamony but has barely any filling in it :( so it was mostly bread.

I can not say enough good things about Craig and his team.  We recently moved to a new home and although the cabinets were in good condition I wasn't thrilled about the color of stain. I was hesitant at first painting over perfectly good caninetry and if it would be a mistake but after seeing the samples and meeting with Craig I felt comfortable with his experience that it would turn out good, which it did! Their attention to detail is amazing!!!!!!  We now have a beautiful white kitchen that looks custom. We have recieved numerous compliments and can't wait to refer clients and friends to Walker Painting.

My boyfriend and I got pedicures and manicures. We were happy with the service and the gals were friendly. Everything seemed clean and hygienic. Only complaint is that my polish chipped in less than 24 hours. We definitely plan to go back again.

I have been going to Sassys for 4 years now and I love it! I have my pedicures and acrylic nails done here. The techs are hilarious and I love how friendly they are. I would definitely make an appointment at least the day before because they are so busy. They always do an awesome job.

Loud music, chain-restaurant-type interior and no one to greet us in the entry made my husband and me pause at the door to wonder if we should retreat. But it was past lunch time and we were hungry so we soldiered on to wait until the a man emerged from behind the bar to ask if we wanted a table for lunch in the dining room. In fact we preferred a booth there and he had one cleared that was not yet tended.  Nice of him. The beginning of the warm up for us. There were more good things to follow but enough on the downside that we are only lukewarm about Lucky Fin.  Interested enough to say we'll might give them another try but not enough to say we are eager to go back.

VIBE
Casual. "CAN YOU HEAR ME NOW" music level. At least it was good music.  The Rolling Stones "Get Off of My Cloud" and Neal Diamond in the 70's era.  A good thing.  Wood or wood look tables and chairs run down the middle and along an inside brick faced wall of the bright dining room, booths seating six each are against the window wall. Seating for maybe 60-plus.  The red cloth napkins are another good thing.

SERVICE
The server knew the menu, could answer our questions, delivered the food hot to the table, followed up at just the right time and was stellar in making us feel welcome. 

LIBATIONS
Along with the food menu you receive a laminated double sided libations list. I noted wines by the glass for as little as six bucks (a White Zin...seriously...people drink that) and up to around $9 for some good options among the choices. 

They have a full bar.  The Margarita with jalapeno and cilantro ($9) was calling my name to share with my husband. It was served over ice in a mini fish bowl sized glass (I stole, um borrowed, that line from Doug H) and delicious - tart using fresh juice and house made sour mix. It packed a punch.  Sharing is a good idea. A little wrinkle was the minced jalapeno is the just right size to stop up the straws. A tip: Smuggle in a couple of Starbuck's Frappucino fat straws so you can drink up that yummy jalapeno. (Not kidding.)

MENU
A broad and eclectic menu on three laminated pages. To scratch the surface; a little Baja (fish tacos), a little Japan (sushi, mostly rolls) a little New England ("lobstah" flatbread) and even some Americana (burgers) and it has the benefit of changing quarterly (said our server) and having some interesting options. Like steamer clams in habenero infused broth.  But some of the menu items seemed just confused.  For example, the flatbread with lobster, scallops and shrimp is a good start but also has ranch dressing and cheese says the menu. Ranch and cheese on shellfish?  Different strokes.

In general I do not eat sushi anyplace where I can't see a sushi chef. But three of the five other occupied tables were ordering sushi rolls. I made note of that for a subsequent visit.  They didn't look great as they were delivered to the tables.
 
There is the added benefit of blackboard specials; on the day of our visit a Central or South American fish ribs (no typo).

FOOD
We tried fried calamari and a half pound (full pound also available) of steamers in habanero garlic broth. The former were good with fresh flavor but all rings and no tentacles, a drawback in our book. The rings were just kissed with coating and perfectly fried and came with lime to squeeze over, all pluses for us. The lime aioli dipper was tame.  A tip if you order these; ask for extra limes and their fresh cocktail sauce that has horseradish. 

The steamers were the star dish with pieces of habanero served with fresh clams in the perfectly seasoned broth. (Remember the Scoville on habaneros is more than 100,000.) The wrinkle for this dish is the bread served with the dish may as well be cotton batting. They should do better with that. Tips: 1) smuggle in good bread, preferably local baker Gaston's, to soak up the broth,  2) ask for spoons to sip all the broth, 3 ) eat the habaneros. 

We ended with key lime pie which was good enough to spend calories to try it once but not good enough to repeat and local Dawson Taylor coffee served piping hot with cup refilled.

VALUE:
Two appetizers, one libation, one dessert, one coffee and we clocked it at just about $36 before tax. Good value.

THIS N THAT:
1) PARKING: In private lot that is too small at peak times.

2) ACCESSIBILITY: Two accessible parking spaces. Non compliant for location but useable curb ramp. No standard height seating in the main bar; a bad thing that is actually illegal in discrimination under the ADA that would be easy for them to correct. Standard height seating in dining room. 

3) HAPPY HOUR: Certain hours during the week and all day on Sunday but only in the bar.

4) NEIGHBORS: Red Robin is across the parking lot.

We love this place for breakfast. Great homemade sausages! Good portions for great prices. Coffee cup was always kept full. The ham and cheese omelette is huge and delicious.  And I love that the manager is always walking around, checking on customers. Its not huge inside and gets very busy on the weekends.

Bought a $1,500 mattress and it did not last what so ever.  Matress is less than 3 years old and the company sent out a rep to measure the mattress.  The determined the matress had failed and had 1.5 Inch indentation.  They stated that the box frame was not purchased at the time of the mattress or box springs so there is warrenty because of that.  BUYER BEWARE.  This was not told to us and thus we thought we had a warranty.   It is eveident they sell you and forget you!

i love to frequent this place!  i used to always get the crab cake entree but they've recently changed the recipe.  it's good, but i think the previous recipe was better.  not a fan of the sushi, i've had better.  but the atmosphere and service are always great, the prices reasonable, and the food good.  i usually never eat coleslaw but their fuji apple slaw is the bomb!  i also highly recommend the crab stuffed mushroom appetizer!  when no one is watching, i will sometimes actually lick the plate clean after having those!  They also do take out.  presentation is definitely not as strong when doing take out, but i don't expect it to be.  the food is still good.  one of the freshest seafood places in this area, so i'm a fan!

I had an issue with a tire on my 5th wheel trailer. These guys got me serviced and back on the road even though it was closing time.

I can't say enough about them and have made a future Les Schwab customer out of me! 

Thanks James and Jared  You guys are the best  And a perfect example of what customer service should be. Thanks again!

I guess it's called Smashburger cause they press the burger patties while cooking on the grill.  I had the bacon cheese burger and it was a juicy with a lot of flavor.  They have real ice cream shakes.  The smash fries are good with the rosemary taste, but a little too salty for my taste.

Super happy to see a new donut place open and this place is fantastic. Light and fresh tasting, not heavy, greasy, or overly sweet. I usually cut my donut in half, eat part and then get mad at myself for eating it when I knew it would make me feel icky... not this time. I just wanted more! The apple fritter was the best one I have had in forever. The savory treats looked delicious too. A great place! We will return!

Order:
Pasta Alfredo with sausage tomatoes and feta
Chicken bites
Parmesean bites

Garlic sauce 
Marinara
Buffalo

This location is just as good as the original in Boise. I was excited to see a drive thru too. I usually get just the empanadas,  (the Gaucho is THE best) but the kids got fries with their order and those were REALLY good. An awesome meal and an awesome value!

I honestly don't know which was more of a disappointment...the sandwiches or the customer service? This was my first time visiting a Togo's in years. I remembered the bread being more dense like a hoagie roll and the sandwiches were the best I had ever had. Moving here I was excited to be able to have my favorite sandwich again! Total let down! Sandwich was no different than your basic Subway sandwich. Now to the customer service...we were greeted by two young girls that seemed a little impatient and more interested in what was going on outside of the store vs taking care of their customers. They were looking over our heads and talking back and forth about their friends they could see.  Seemed annoyed that we were making them work. (We were the only customers in the store). When they rang us up they said total, I paid, and no thank you or anything...instead they both leaned on the counter and continued looking out the window. We did not feel valued as customers whatsoever and sandwiches were nothing special, so needless to say...we will not be going back.

Please do not go to this location. Four people in the lobby and we had to wait over 25 min for our food. This isnt the first time for long wait time. I had two soft tacos that were mostly lettuce and cheese with no seasoned meat. Wont be back to this location.

My wife and I came in for Lunch while we were out and about. We both got the chicken bowl.  The vegetables consisted of green onions and a few pieces of something else. I've been to other flame broilers while I was out of town (Brea ca) and expected a lot more from this place than I got. The food just wasn't up to other local competitors that I prefer like Yokozuna or Mongolian Grill.
I prefer to have more vegetables maybe some broccoli carrots onions to add favor and I'm not really a vegetable person

Absolutely fantastic coffee - REAL coffee. Don't come here for a pumpkin spice latte, come for a latte or pour over because these guys know what they're doing. 

The milk is steamed perfectly (hot enough, but not too hot to drink immediately) and the espresso is bursting with flavor. 

Not a huge range of food options, but the avocado toast (aka "why we don't own a home yet") was great and had an amazing egg on top. They had something with Nutella in it that I really want to try as well. 

Simple interior, friendly and personable baristas, and fantastic coffee. May not be the place you stay to study or read for hours - but it is the place you should go for beautifully crafted coffee.
I had the Lobster Mac & Cheese,but have them leave the burned Bacon off.  Not know if I will back.

OMG! For once I could eat a bowl of soup and have a sandwich and not walk out with a migraine. The food was amazing. I loved that the soups are not filled with just salt or MSG. Chicken noodle was delicious, we sampled the buffalo chicken and roasted potato and both we so good. Loved the buffalo chicken. We shared the Chipotle Turkey sandwich and it was delicious. The bread was fresh, tons of turkey and the hint of chipotle was yummy. Cannot wait to go back.

Wish I could give this restraint more stars! Amazing customer service and exceptional food. Bill took great care of us while we were there. He treated us like old friends and really attended to our every need. Fast service too!

Great yoga classes and relaxing massages. The owner, Liz does a great job of putting together workshops and extra classes to really encourage a community of friends. I would definitely recommend this studio!

Your search is over with Pamela Noeau Day!  Due to my career, I have carried thirty pounds of gear on my waist/hips for years. Unfortunately, in doing so, I damaged my SI joints. I have tried chiropractic care, physical therapy,......nothing has relieved my pain. After a night of no sleep (I couldn't get comfortable due to the pain), I asked my husband to find me a massage. He called around and made me an appointment with Pamela Noeau Day. Not only was I able to sleep that night pain free, she provided me incredible information about my body. Her knowledge and experience is absolutely impressive. She is not just a body worker, she is the entire package. Give yourself a tremendous gift and go see her.

Been to Lucky Fins over a half dozen times the last few months, and I have to say I am becoming a regular.  The host staff and wait staff are friendly and helpful, but the food is the star here.  I love all their entrees, the soups are fantastic, especially the roasted poblano and jalapeno soup, very creamy and delicious.  The clam chowder is great as well, but I generally prefer it a little thicker, but nonetheless, very good.  The Fettuccine of the Bayou is a very good dish, and spicy which is what I love.  It has andouille sausage, scallops, and vegetables tossed in noodles with a spicy creamy sauce.  They have sushi there as well, which I haven't tried yet but hear good things.  The only dessert I can personally testify on is the Key Lime Pie, and is very, very tasty.  Overall, I come here very often and have yet to be disappointed in the food.
Great food and atmosphere! Definitely seems like a place that would be downtown. Love thehappy hour $4 flat breads!
Tasty juicy burger.  Can't go wrong.  #1 burger in town for me.

First, Smash burger concept is truly a niche, overall I love them but the one at Boise airport needs help. It looks like a 3 person operation, 2 in back and one cashier. When lines form people wait, not the only issue, the cashier takes orders, makes change, makes milk shakes and fills orders without ever washing her hands in between the money and the food. This is a disgusting habit and a health hazard as our money is dirty, literally.
So even though I love the burger I cringe as I sit eating it and waiting for my delayed flight.

I really like the service staff, they are always attentive and friendly. The food selection is really fun, I find the visual layout of the menu hard to read but take your time and push through it 'cause there are some good items hidden in there. Drink specials and selection is good as well.

This is the best little soup and sandwich joint in town. Not only am I satisfied with my meal on every visit, but the customer service is impeccable. This "mom and pop shop" astounds every customer that walks through the door. I have yet to have an unpleasant experience, and I truly hope they succeed and expand.

Always FANTASTIC!!!!Even though this is my "first check in", I've been here at least a dozen times. Steve's NEVER disapoints. Omelets are huge and the huckleberry pancakes....Mmmmm. I love to take out of state family/friends there. There's always extra to take home so that's one less meal I need to cook!

My husband and I decided to try Harry's Hideaway out since it was under new ownership and had supposedly been revamped. We walked in and it was fairly busy. We found a table within arms reach of the bar. We literally sat there for 15 minutes before we were even acknowledged. I was grabbing my purse to leave when the waitress finally approached us. She took our drink order and that took about 10 minutes to get. Which is fine. We ordered wraps and when we got them after my second bite I bit into something hard, it was a broken piece of toothpick! It didn't come from the toothpick that was in my wrap though. My husband ordered the teriyaki chicken wrap and it was soaked and soggy by the time he received it. Again, we had to wait 40 plus minutes before our waitress came to check on us. The bartender noticed that we were out of drinks, food was done and pushed to the edge of the table and we were ready to leave. She asked if we needed anything and we told her we just want our ticket so we can go. In conclusion, the service is really crappy and food was just average. 
on a side note...the couple sitting at the table behind us had the same experience (no service) and walked out the door behind us.

Gave the new shop another chance today. Bad all the way around. Brown avocado and terrible service makes paying $11 for a 6" chips and drink unbearable. Guess this place just isn't for me. 

If you hate money and good service, give this place a try!!
I had the pastrami on rye it was pretty good, I'm pretty picky about sandwiches but the pastrami had good flavor and the bread was really soft, I'll definitely go back!

I am currently the Duke of RC Willey and I am ready to hand over the throne to any poor sap willing to deal with their annoying 14 day return policy. I had a bad return experience that fortunately resolved in the customer service rep doing the right thing. It wasn't fun for either of us and I must now warn others to watch out for this anemic return policy.

Let's say you buy a small electronic gift for your wife on black Friday (Nov 25). She opens it on Christmas, you try to hook it up, and you fail because Sony product designers are living in 1990 and haven't upgraded their audio inputs to modern digital standards. OK now it is Dec 29, respectfully close to gift opening day. How would you rate your experience when the cust. serv. rep asks "Is there any reason you are returning this a month late?" Um yeah dude, are you familiar with the retail buying and gift giving period known as Thanksgiving - Christmas? Best Buy allows me to return something until the middle of January. OK no biggie RC is not a modern company, they have draconian severity, whatever. At least we are going through with the refund process. 

While the refund is being processed, I actually see the sales rep over in electronics. I think of badgering him to come over and explain why he thought it was OK to sell me this outmoded crap. But I am interrupted with a lecture from the cust. serv. rep about RC's 14 day return policy. Give me a break! Even for the holidays? How about I never shop here again for gifts? I have purchased major furniture items here. I am thinking never again for those items either. What if I had to make a return after 15 days because it took me that long to realize something wasn't appropriate?

Yeah the cust. serv. rep was annoying, his lecture and tone were not appreciated, but he gave me the refund in the end so I can't give RC 1 star. Still, the vice president who makes this policy needs to get his or her head up to the speed of modern American life if they want to keep customers who are treated better at other electronics retailers.

This place was great! The food was fabulous, the service was speedy and great atmosphere.  The only thing keeping this from a 5 Star was the A/C! Granted it was 109 outside today, but it felt just as hot inside! 

I highly recommend the filthy fries as an appetizer.  To die for!!

Friendly staff, attentive service, delicious food.  Try the breakfast burrito and ask for the spicy chicken.  The chicken nuggets are excellent, and the fries and even shakes are good.

One thing to be aware of: they are miserly about sauce.  You will never get a single ketchup packet you haven't specifically asked for.

Passing through Meridian on a Sunday so we stopped and had breakfast at Steve's. All though busy we were seated within 10 minutes and fresh hot coffee was brought right away. (Steve's will serve you fresh coffee while you wait for your table on busy mornings). Our server was friendly and her timing was like clock work. We did not have to ask for refills. The food was delicious made with fresh ingredients. I had my bench mark dish.. Chicken fried steak & eggs. Very Good! loved it!

I thought $10 for a sandwhich was a lot, was flabbergasted when the owner charged me extra for cheese!  So $11 for 1 sandwhich, no drink or extras. And then the sandwhich was tasteless, it was a mouthful of bread. It was a very disappointing visit and will not go back.

I started my membership at the one on Eagle Rd. The girls there have been super friendly and knowledgeable about the products. Their hours are fantastic, very easy to work around your work schedule. They do get quite busy around 4-7 on week days. The weekends are hit or miss. I have been to the one in The Axiom Gym on Overland but it is much smaller and does not have a level 4 bed. I am told the one by BSU has the best level 3 beds by one of the girls at the Eagle rd. location.
They don't require a contract and you can freeze or cancel your membership at anytime. A Definite plus! 
The price is a bit more than I am used to but over all I am pretty happy with this tanning salon.

Do NOT order fajitas to go!  This is not exclusive to this restaurant just a general rule that I will follow from this point forward.  Fajitas are best served sizzling!  And I disappointed myself last night.

My husband and I stopped in so I could order chicken & shrimp fajitas to go.  I will come back and update my review after giving them a second chance fresh in the restaurant.  The majority of the mix was onion, the chicken is sliced in very thin strip and the shrimp are small.  This may just be different than what I'm used to but I prefer bigger chunks for my fajitas.  My husband sat and had chips and salsa while we waited.  The best part is that they serve Pepsi and not coke products!  They also packaged are food very nicely.

Up front:  I am not reviewing the furniture yet since I haven't received it.  The floor sales folks I worked with (Brandon S and Cathy H) were great.  They were low key, answered all my questions, and Brandon even volunteered to move an ottoman over to the sectional to see if I liked it.   I think the sales staff are pretty good.

It's the delivery system that SUCKS.  I was told by the cashier to expect a call from 700-900 a.m. regarding delivery time of our sectional sofa, 2 chairs, and an ottoman.  Six HOURS after this we'll-give-you-a-call window (and after I called them FOUR times) I finally get a phone call at 3:15 p.m. telling me that they can delivery between 730-1030 p.m. tonight.   So basically there is a 12+ hrs delivery window!?!?!?   I don't mind the late delivery hour, I mind that I wasted an entire Saturday and had to make 4 phone calls to even get a delivery time quoted.   (It really ended up being 7 phone calls after I talked to the supervisor and 2 calls from the sales person).

They finally offered $100 off another sofa we ordered which is on backorder and is supposed to arrive I don't know when.   Yeah right.    No discount for today's furniture because "it's already on the truck". 

We decided to go ahead and accept today's delivery and I will post an update later regarding the furniture.  

So far, if you are ordering something from RC WIlley, I suggest you pick it up yourself.  Call first to make sure it's there though.

UPDATED REVIEW 1/25/16
I posted my original review almost 3 weeks (20 days today) ago, and was contacted by a customer service representative who asked for my contact information. I promptly provided it, and he emailed me and said someone from this particular RC Willey would contact me in reference to my experience. They did not. So, one star now instead of two. I'd rather my time didn't get wasted responding to requests that have no follow through.

When we come to visit family in Meridian we usually eat here at least once.  The staff is always friendly.   The food is always fresh and good.  
The menu is pretty big and has a lot of choices.  
Give Steve's Cafe  A try. 
See you next time.  
From New Mexico, USA
Amazing! Best Honey Chipotle salmon I've ever had. Nice, clean establishment. Fast service. Savanah served us well. :)

This is a very fun place to take the kids. Decent price for a fun filled day with the family. If you want to save a bit of green take a lunch and eat it instead of the concession. Wish the laser tag was a bit longer, seems you spend more time suiting up and waiting than actual fun time, maybe increase times a bit add a minute or two extra. Staff is friendly and helpful, something that some businesses could learn from.

Had breakfast here today. Ordered the con beef hash and eggs. Small portion of coned beef ( not really hash). Only like 3 small pieces of potato in the hash, which might be strange to complain about, but it was basically just some corned beef. So, portions either really small, or prices a little high. You decide. Probably will try them again, just will order something else. Just so-so.

I don't know why this salon doesn't have more positive reviews. Every time I've come, the ladies are super nice, funny and do a great job! You can bring your own champagne and they don't even charge you a corking fee! Maybe it's an LA thing? I don't know. Anyways, this is my go to place when I'm in Boise. Love these ladies!

Great selection of fro-yo and amazing combinations already set up. 

Clean facilities, friendly faces & relatively affordable. 

Loved the strawberry shortcake & cheesecake combination. 

Tip: sorbet are dairy free!

Our family went to Wahooz last night for the first time and our children had so much fun! My husband had been into this family fun center years ago and said that things were pretty run down and he doesn't remember it being super memorable. Well, last night was a different story! When we walked in my first thought was " welcome to the future!" There were fun rides and a big flashy lights all over the place and it just looked like a childhood dream at first sight. Our kids had so much fun playing and doing the ropes course and our younger girls loved playing in the smaller playground area with slides. 

We ate at one of the little built-in restaurants and they had some really good pizza! I was surprised! It was such a fun place to go to as a family and I would recommend it for any family with children young or old, traveling through Boise to give this place a visit!

My dad and I just went on a fly fishing trip with Andrew Catt for Father's Day weekend. We had an AMAZING time. Andrew was so patient with us as we had little to no experience fly fishing prior to this trip. We would HIGHLY recommend Dreams on the Fly for your next guided fly fishing outing. Looking forward to getting a chance to go out again!!
Great selection, high-qaulity meats and produce, friendly staff.

Updated May 2018: The Curb hosted my engagement party. We filled up the patio, which we're told holds like 90 people. The servers and other staff simply blew us away! Drinks were constantly refilled, lunch orders were served without delay. What an amazing experience! Thank you, Robbie, Lexie, Alex and the whole crew!

Friendly servers, fun chalk art walls and an eclectic mix of patrons make The Curb my very own Cheers! I'm never disappointed with the food, drinks or ambiance. The outdoor patio area, with its beautiful mix of flowers, is a relaxing place to enjoy nachos and a cold beer or three!

Out of ranch. OUT OF RANCH. When I come to a pizza place I expect to receive ranch with my pizza. This place receives two stars instead of 1, because it was cheap and quick since there wasn't a single other person in there--no surprise. The one employee they had working needs to learn about customer service too. Definitely won't be going back, and the only reason I went is because I was hoping to try the bacon mac n cheese pizza which wasn't even available for a slice.

Ugh.  We decided to try RC Willeys again since our first experience, although negative initially, turned out ok.  But the experience we had today takes the cake.  Hands down, this was the worst sales experience we have EVER had shopping for furniture or flooring.  We specifically wanted inexpensive vinyl flooring and thought we found the specific product we wanted on their website.  So we went in prepared to buy today.   But when we got to the flooring department, we had to wander around to find the vinyl, which was on the opposite side of the store from the wall sign that  said vinyl. We couldn't find the product that we saw on their website.  And although you are approached frequently and often in the furniture section at RC Willey, we had to wait 10+ minutes for a sales person to offer to help us.  And it turns out he was the worst salesman in the history of sales.  He was inaccurate in his representation of vinyl tiles (which we didn't want), he was reluctant to answer questions, and he spent maybe 5 minutes with us.  When he realized we didn't want vinyl tiles but sheet vinyl, he said "Well this is really all we have" and pointed at the small display and walked away without another word.  My husband and I turned to look at each other with our mouths open.  We have never been treated so poorly by a salesperson ever.  We promptly walked out and won't be back again.

Dr. Anderson is one of the best! She really takes her time to see what issues you are having and then gives you a plan and schedule to fix them. Yes, I said fix, she isn't like most chiropractors that you have to go to for life. She is also very personable and friendly.

Reading the reviews compelled me to add my own.  The people that work here have always been kind, courteous, friendly, never snotty or rude.  They are so helpful and have explained the mystic tanner to me a million times (I always forget what to do), yet every time they do it with a smile.  Yes, they try to up-sell you on add-ons, you don't have to buy what they offer, they aren't pushy.  Don't not go to this location because of the bad reviews, try them out and decide.  Hopefully you will encounter the professionalism and friendliness that I have.  :)

In town for a horse show and in desperate need of a pedi. Checked rwviews ans chose based on those.The salon is clean, not super new BUT my chair was awesome and comfortable.  My service was awesome and I would definitely return if I was in the area again. I love that she asked how aggressive I wanted my legs and feet massaged!  Many loyal customers coming in and calling while I was there.    Thank you glamour nails. Scary to walk in to a salon you don't know.

My brother brought us here because he had a good experience in the past.  We came Sunday afternoon.  No wait, but the music was pop radio, too loud, not a great atmosphere.  Brother said it was better Friday night.  Not great service.  I chose the halibut fish taco and must say it was the worst fish taco I have ever had.  They are very small and should be listed strictly as an appetizer, but I was hoping for good flavor to make up for the size.  They were very small pieces of halibut which I could not taste due to the breading.  The sauce was no better.  Very disappointed.  
Tried my mom's salmon dish; the salmon was so-so, Atlantic is not the best salmon to begin with; however, the mashed potatoes were very yummy and her desert, Mango cake, was also good.  Can't say I would go back to Fins.
Your fries suck. They are to soft. And wedges suck. Your food has nothing tasty about it. Why do people like it at all? Your shakes are awesome! Food?! No

I just went to spin class at Cycle Bar; I have to say that I've been to about every other spin place: SoulCycle, Flywheel, Revolution, Orange Theory and various single owner operations. 

I have to say that my experience at Cycle Bar was absolutely awesome. Everyone is super friendly. 

The class music was excellent and completely fit to the workout. The instructor was engaged with the class and was very motivational towards the riders.

I rank this among the best indoor spinning studios I have seen. I will be coming back.
Emily B. was very professional, kind and quite helpful in answering all my questions; and this facility is picture perfect when it comes to cleanliness and orderliness.

My first experience with Blind Gallery was 12 years ago when we moved from Seattle.  It was during the construction boom and there was a six week waiting period before someone could come to the house.  I called Blind Gallery, they came out and we were able to choose our window coverings and they were ordered and installed before the other company would be able to come out.  Excellent customer service.  

Star, ID
Phyllis Messenger
There new location is great for watching sports and eating food. Good food with a big menu.
Had the tofu bowl. It was good, more vegis would be better..needs the magic sauce for flavor  staff was friendly. .will try again

Well, I have never written a mediocre review as of yet, but I am afraid I must.  My family went to Lucky Fins tonight and quite frankly I was a little disappointed.  I had eaten at the downtown location, and that was fine.  I had the Fin's sampler with coconut shrimp, fried shrimp and cod.  It was good, but not outstanding.  I thought I would give other things a try out near my home in Meridian.  I ordered a crabcake to start.  $6.99, with one average size cake which was way more cake than crab, and I do believe I spotted crab with a "K" if you know what I mean (immitation crab for anyone who doesn't get my drift)  the topping was interesting with green onions, roasted corn, tomato and a barbecuey tasting sauce.  Strangely enough, I didn't really taste any crab, and neither did my husband, eh, next.  So salads were fine and good size, no complaints there (I had a caesar and it was good), then I ordered the cedar planked scallops with loaded mashed potatoes.  When it arrived I was a bit confused because there were 3 scallops on the plank, and I mean three scallops that were not large scallops by any means, larger than a quarter, but perhaps slightly smaller than a half dollar.  It had the same garnish that the crab cake had, with the barbequely sauce that was suppose to be some bacony thing.  THEY LEFT THE MUSCLE ON the scallops, which for $18.99 bothered me.  Any respectable seafood restaurant should always remove the muscle from the scallop before serving it!  Yes, perhaps I am spoiled as I lived in the Bay Area for 12 years and got use to wonderful seafood.  Yes, the scallops were cooked correctly and they were good, not a grain of sand, BUT SERIOUSLY 3 #@%$!!! for $18.99.  Felt pretty jiped to tell you the truth.  OK, I can see maybe $15.99 and I wouldn't be so offended, but charging $18.99 for 3 small scallops is a bit steep.  
      My husband ordered the Forbiden Ahi tuna (prepared seared)  He felt that the fish had been frozen, which I was under the impression that they flew in their seafood.  He did however really like the veg that went with it, some sauted squash in a teryiaki sauce.  It was good, I tried it, my squash and veg were cooked in garlic, and it was alright.  
    The kids meals looked great, and my son had the sliders and he said they were wonderful, and it looked like most of the kids meals were around $5, and that is great. 
      I will give it another try, but I think I will stick to the better deals and more pedestrian fare, as that seems to be the better value.  They have soup and salad for $7.99 would be a wonderful deal.  
      As far as being  an upscale dining experience, nah.....but a nice weekend night out.  I just don't want to drop another $85 on a dinner that was worth maybe $50.
You see the name and think it's a burger place. It's not, but it's really good. Get the half avacado, it's a yummy addition.

I selected OB/GYN Associates for a few reasons, including a recommendation from a friend, which hospital I wanted to deliver at, and some research on their physicians (were they board certified, where did they do their residencies, etc.).  Overall, I had a great experience with the medical staff and felt confident throughout my pregnancy that they were providing the best care possible.

I tended to schedule my appointments in the late afternoon, and my appointments tended to be on time if not a few minutes early. I never felt rushed by the nurses or physicians during my appointments - though I am not one to ask a lot of questions as long as I am told everything is going well.  While you do not know who will be the on-call physician to deliver your baby, you can schedule out your prenatal appointments with your preferred physician(s).

My first appointment was cancelled three times, which was a tad frustrating - thankfully, my fourth (and final) attempt at getting a first appointment worked out.  I saw a certified registered nurse practitioner for the first half of my pregnancy.  When one of the schedulers was entering in my 20-week appointment, she told me I was supposed to have met with a physician before my 20 weeks - I appreciated her being upfront with me though not so much her slight berating of the other scheduler (who I guess did not follow protocol).

I did not have any issues with insurance billing, but I did have to make sure one of my contract payments was credited properly - the front desk staff had the record of each payment, but the billing person to whom I spoke did not - it seems that paying for my monthly contract plus another item on one check caused the confusion.  The missing payment credit was fixed after we reviewed the front desk's printout of my payments and the EOBs I brought with me.  

If my husband and I decide on a second pregnancy, I will definitely be returning to this practice.
Yummmmmy! Amazing fresh fish sandwich and husband had sushi roll very good! Great environment great customer service! Don't forget to order the mango cake OMG!!!! The best!!!

If you're around the village and want a sweet treat I would totally recommend La Creme! They have a huge variety of sweets and snacks so everyone is happy. Not to mention their frozen yogurt is Great! The staff is very friendly every time I go in there and there is never any hesitation to help other customers. I love La Creme!

We needed to waste some time before the corn maze opened so we popped into Boondock's for some mini putt.  We ended up buying some super fun pass thing for $15.  With that we played two rounds off mini putt, raced around in go-karts, zipped around in a game of laser tag, spent far too much time playing arcade games in effort to winning a Care Bear monkey... and overall had way too much fun.  We ended up spending like 4 hours in this place.  

One of my highlights in Boise. :)

I have to say that Smash Burger is one of the best burgers in town!  When I was going through a sickness it was one of the few foods I craved and could eat.  The burgers are juicy and super tasty.   The smash fries and onion straws set it a part from five guys.
Love coming here and working out here. I've tried many gyms before and no other gym has come close to this one. Love it love it.

Best empanadas I have ever eaten!! The staff are friendly, the prices are awesome and they have a great selection. Everyone has their favorites, but the Gaucho and Mole are the best in my humble opinion. Make sure to ask for lots of chimichurri sauce, it is excellent. The dessert empanadas are yummy too. This Brazilian restaurant is a definite check it out! My mouth is watering just writing this review :-)

I may dress trendy, but it's not because I drop the dollas at a retailer or high end department store. I am patient and always optimistic to see what's waiting for me on the rack at STP. Art'eryx, Patagonia, North Face, Marmot... Ski gear, kayak, road biking schwag as well as some stylish home decor. Don't forget to peruse the "Bargain Barn" to check on the gently used seconds that provide for much larger discounts.
Happy shopping!
Dined there and all our dishes were over cooked. Cooking fish is not rocket science. The water tasted like the smell of an old sour dish rag.

I love this place. The staff is amazing, the food is mouthwatering and the atmosphere is very comfortable. Seriously all the food here is good. I have never been to any other restaurant where I can order anything on the menu and like it. They have vegetarian and pescetarian  options as well that are A++

Not a good place to go to for nails. It is extremely dark and gloomy, and I was getting my nails done for homecoming. I asked for a flower to be painted onto both my thumbs, and it barely resembled a flower. It looked like a fan. And when he was done, he tried to send me out the door while my nails weren't dry. Horrible. And he was too harsh shaping my nails before putting the acrylics on, and so when they came off.... my nails were ugly, weak, and jagged. I won't be back. I wish I saved pictures.

First of all my rating is not based on food. The food was good. My review is based on the customer service and service. This was my experience: my cousin and I went here for dinner before a show. We went upstairs to the 21 and older section that only serves appetizers. We ordered bloody Mary's that we're pretty tasty. My cousin ordered a second Bloody Mary and the waitress/bartender asked if she could reuse my cousins glass to make her a new drink in. My cousin said yes, and when she walked away we both looked at each other like "wtf!?" I have never in my life been asked if my glass can be reused. Weird. Then when we went to pay, she asked if we wanted the bill split, we said yes. My cousin handed her cash, I gave her my card. She hands me the cash takes my card and says "I'll just give you the cash and put it all on the card" and walks away. First off:why ask us if we want the check split if you plan on just taking one payment. B, what if I didn't have the full amount on my card to cover the whole bill and that's why we were splitting? And C. Rude. The next day my cousin realized we were over charged. We call in to complain about the above events and let them know we were over charged. The manager says she can't help us she need the gm, fine. Dewayne calls my cousin back and says we were charged for shots. No big deal it happens. My cousin explains to him the above events that also occurred. His way of making it right... "well I guess I can give you a $6 gift card (the amount of the overcharge) but you need to come get it and text me first because I can't leave it up front". Uhm weird. 
I call in to talk to the owner cause I'm pissed. After all that happened to us all we get is a $6 gift card that I have to come get that is my own money to begin with? That's how he felt best to compensate us and make sure we will be return customers? No way! Surely the owner doesn't know his business is being ran this way! 
Owner calls me, it's Dewayne, the guy my cousin talked to. He says he will bump it to a $10 gift card like he has just done me some huge favor! After realizing this dude has zero customer service and is not going to go out of his way to make this right and make sure we will come back. He says he will do me another giant favor and mail me my $10 gift card, SIX OF THAT BEING MY OWN MONEY THEY OVER CHARGED ME! So he wants me to text him my address so he can mail. I do so, and he then says "how bout I send you and your cousin $10'each IF you leave me a good review". 
WE WILL NEVER EVER BE BACK STRICTLY BASED UPON THE WAY THIS JERK HANDLED THE SITUATION! Zero customer service skills OWNER!

They never have the same inventory of many products because they are an outlet store -- you have to go often and see what kind of goodies you can score. Its like a Ross or TJ Maxx for outdoor gear, you never know what you will find but the prices are usually a lot less than the big guys.

They sent us a damaged mattress!!  We both had back issues after sleeping on it.  They sent mattress Expert who said it had been bent and compromised!!  
R C Willey took forever to pick it up and we still don't have our money back!!  
Slimey to do business with!    I needed several other items and carpeting for my rental, but not going there again, no matter what.  We have been out a lot of time and discomfort, but they don't care!!

Well, after passing by this little shop for the last 6 months, I decided to go check it out while I had a tire being fixed.  Wow!  Wonderful pastries!  Don't be fooled by the unassuming store front, there is a world of sweet love going on in there!  
     The sticky buns were the best I have ever tasted, and as I am a pretty decent cook myself, and have made them regularly.    John, the chef told me that he makes them out of Brioche dough.  Of course, I thought, as I bit into it's firm rich texture.  He also makes a caramel glaze for it, not some cheap, overly sweet concoction, I am talking about real caramel with the richness that only cream and butter can deliver.  Very impressive. 
      I decided to buy a few more things to take home and try.  I also ordered a couple of tarts, a beautiful apricot scone and a lemon-sugar cookie.   They make all their dough in house, and it shows.  The puff pastry used in the tarts has a rich buttery quality of a fine french pastry shop, and the cookie was so good it almost reminded me of a fine scottish shortbread with a wonderful lemon flavor that was not overpowering, but fresh and sweet in taste. 
      The apricot scone was an actual scone, not some crumbly  junk that most of the places try to pass off around here.  Kay, John's wife and partner, who are very pleasant by the way, explained to me that they used whipping cream in their scones.  Good deal, as it improves it texture tremendously and makes it moist but still firm, YUM.....
      So, this place has made a customer out of me, and I would hope that you would give it a try too.  Don't be fooled that it doesn't look very fancy on the outside, inside is a nice area to sit and enjoy your coffee or tea and a wonderful slice of heaven in pastry form.
     As far as customer service, you couldn't find nicer folks than the owners Kay and John, they seem like very nice people who really care about making their products great with good quality ingredients and a lot of love and pride.
      I spent over half my life in big cities, Chicago and San Francisco, and have a fairly picky pallet, and I guarantee that Little Kitchen Pastries could hold its own against any well-known Patisserie!

Nothing average about this place.  Breakfasts have always been way above average.  The menu is unique and even eclectic.  I don't eat here often due to the above average prices as well but then I just prefer not to pay a lot for breakfast.  I have been there maybe 4 times, my wife many more.  We both feel this is very definitely a place to visit.

Had the best fish taco's I've ever had in my life here last night. Get 4 Mahi taco's, you'll be satisfied. They have a great selection of drinks - beers on tap, and the waitresses are great. Love the seafood smell of this place when you walk in. Get the spicy shrimp appetizer and an IPA, you'll love it.
Food was mediocre at best.. Mahi Mahi tacos lack flavor, the filthy fries were way too salty to consume. Mixed drinks were weak. Can't say I was impressed with anything at this joint. Oh well.

I'm always impressed with this location! It's not the closest Les Schwab to my house, but the staff is always extremely courteous and friendly, so it's worth the drive. They're quick and they do a great job. I can't say enough good things about this location. I always leave with a smile and my car is in tip top shape.

The R&R and/or Public House...what's in a name?   They did a nice job on construction as the ambiance is nice,  The salad I had was above average and service was good. Food take a long time even when they are not busy. The place is hard to find and it does not stand out from the street.  To build a brand name is difficult to begin with but when you pick a name like that you will have trouble getting people to remember: is it: R&R or Public House and what does does public house mean?  Free food for homeless or rail road workers?  The parking sucks and they do have a nice patio.  I wish them luck in their new endeavor.  You can tell that they spend some money on this restaurant...it does have some class.

I wonder why people keep going to this place for pedicures. . .understaffed, substandard treatment, and nothing relaxing about it. Sure, the price is reasonable at $25, but my pedi timed out at 13 minutes. Thirteen minutes with a distracted (looking around, talking to the other staff) clinician who only went through the motions and as fast as she could--and then the receptionist hustled me out as fast as she could to fill the chair. Not worth it!

Ditto Lynnsy, I love this place. It may not be as posh as salons in much larger cities but it is casual, relaxing and the techs are friendly if you engage with them.  English is their second language so some of them are a little shy. The price is great, too! I only get pedicures but it is a treat for me to come in and relax in the wonderful massaging chairs, gossip with my mom and get a lovely leg massage and pedicure that lasts a month, easily.

I bought some couches a few weeks ago at this location. Once I got home, I realized they weren't going to work in my front room. I immediately called the sales woman, Susan and she was extremely helpful in putting the order on hold and helped me choose different options. She adjusted my original order and refunded me the difference. 
I had them delivered and it was totally worth it! The delivery service sent me an email to remind me the day before delivery. They also called me the morning of and gave me an ETA. Most places just tell you they will be there sometime between  8-5...not these guys!!
The store had a really nice selection of quality furniture and plenty of helpful sales people waiting to assist.
I will definitely be going back for my next furniture purchase!

I think there is a new trend in Boise area pubs. I recently visited the Curb and was greeted personally by the owner and asked about my experience. Brewforia does this as well and I can tell you that these to spots have it going on. 

I recommend the Curb. Great staff, good times and neighbor hood pub personality.
Amazing food. Great people and service. The grilled  Gouda was amazing. Will have to come back.

This is by far a place with some of the friendliest staff I've ever come across. They are amazingly friendly people!( and Lori reminds me of Andrea Zuckerman from the original Beverly Hills 90210!!)
Now, the food! It is so very good, I haven't had anything that I didn't like! Soups are amazing, sandwiches are delicious a drop even the carrot lemonade is worth a try, go on, try it! I know some have mentioned it being a bit high priced, but I think they are pretty good portions, and we don't want to over eat, right? If you haven't tried this place, you really should.

Had high expectations but frankly did not come close to meeting them...

Good atmosphere with lots of people and energy. Sat at the bar for a drink while we waited for our table.

The food just was not really that good sadly. Two appetizers were not what I expected...both were fried and didn't need to be. The crab stuffed mushrooms tasted as if they had been frozen and were deep fried. The shrimp had good flavor but again were fried and were almost as small as bay shrimp.

My catfish entree was good...crisp and not greasy. My wife's cedar salmon was under-seasoned and all you could taste was the cedar plank...some salt and pepper livened it up, but doing that in the kitchen would have been much better.

Key lime pie oddly enough might have been the best food of the night...

I will give them credit for not being a chain in this area, but it isn't some place I will feel the need to go back to based on this experience.

Best dobuts ever. My husband brought them home one morning and i called them magical because theyre really that good and that fresh. Chocolate iced lemon filled is my fave! Try it
 Also best aplme fritters ever. And the kreullers or whatever the old fashioned donuts are called are omg delish. And the cake donuts. anywho theyre all amazingly delicious.
Awesome food. Authentic food, great portions and unbeatable price. Best Taco Truck in town. Would recommend to anyone looking for a quick, affordable, tasty meal.

The food was great and the drinks were on point, but they allow smoking on the patio and the demographic was uncomfortably trashy. We even notified our server that the table next to us should be cut off because they were so sloppy drunk, slurring their speech and hardly able to keep their eyes open. A gal was even cussing at another table across the patio with young children just a few tables away and making obvious and explicit sexual advances to the guy next to her. Not 5 minutes later they were all served another round. It's not a matter of those people getting hurt after leaving, but who they may injure or kill on their home. The Curb should be ashamed of themselves and should lose their liquor license!

Met some girlfriends for some drinks and appetizers as the location was very convenient. No cocktail menu available, so went with the old stand by. Ordered 2 flat breads and a salad. One flatbread was amazing, perfectly cooked. The other was way overdone and disappointing. The salads were fresh, but plain. Our waitress was very pleasant, and the atmosphere nice but it wasnt worth the money spent. I won't be back.
I will be back. I had a juicy shrimp dish. The sauce was so yummy that I dipped my bread in it! Only go to the one in Meridian.

Google Maps gives you the wrong location. This place is next to BlackRock Coffee on the corner of Chinden and Linder. We ate here today on the grand opening day. The portions for the plate size were good but a tad pricey. The meat was very tasty. The veggies were only lightly steamed and very crunchy. Almost raw. Definitely get the magic sauce. The hot sauces were good and very hot. Some of the oranges were not ripe. The food isn't greasy, fried Asian goodness, but you feel healthy when you're done. The service was good.

SLOWEST SERVICE EVER . I don't mind really waiting , but it was a 40 minute wait for our food. I ordered a regular hamburger and double bacon. When we finally reached the drive thru window, I checked my order and my regular hamburger was missing. It was just a box full of fries. So I had to go inside and a young girl helped me and was she super helpful. Moreover , if you are super hungry and wanting food don't go here , because the wait will take forever. They really need to work on faster customer service and probably more experienced staff. I know they make their food to order , but seriously I have been to places like these and it doesn't take this damn long. Oh and when I went home I sadly found out my double bacon wasn't a double bacon it had one patty and was sloppily made.

Very good service.  Nice selection of beers.     Flat breads were good.  Hummus appetizer had a little to be desired.  Portion was small the extra stuff was not up to par with other restaurants in town... Went on a week that I was only eating vegetarian... So didn't really get to try much else.

I really enjoyed my experience here. Everyone said happy birthday to me even though they weren't my server . I was disappointed they put bacon in the shrimp salad but I didn't read the menu correctly lol. They were friendly, attentive, and really on top of their service. I will definitely visit again when we are in town.

Made an appointment here for my wedding party to get Mani/pedis. I pacifically told this to the lady who took my appointment down. I don't know where things went wrong, maybe they didn't write a reservation down but when we arrived there was another wedding party all sitting together getting their toes and nails done. We waited about 15 or 20 minutes and then one by one they fed us in to the empty seats. The 'group' experience did not happen.  Then they told us they didn't have time to do our nails just our toes. I was the bride so they did my nails and managed to fit one more bridesmaids nails in but they said it wasn't part of my reservation. The only thing I can think of is there was a language barrier because I made the appointment for seven Mani-pedis. Left feeling pretty rushed and unplanned four and just down about the whole experience.

Big store with a great deal to choose from but the service is absolutely horrible. We bought over 10K worth of furniture which took about 4 or 5 separate deliveries to get it all to the house. All but one of the deliveries contained damaged furniture which we had to send back. Many of the damaged pieces they "didn't carry anymore" or were "back ordered". So we chose to get refunds and shop elsewhere. Well this is where the service ended. The saleslady was nice until we wanted the refund for the damaged furniture. Now it's excuses, unanswered messages, and no return phone calls. We will never buy from this place again.

I've been here four times and find the food consistently very good.  It's healthy, tasty (and you can always add more), and well prepared.  The chicken seems to be more tender than the beef, but both are good.  Both the brown and the white rice are very nicely done -- not soggy.   I get the regular bowl (with veggies) and find the price reasonable.   The place is very clean, as is the kitchen (you can look into).  I also want to compliment the staff -- all quite young (high schoolers?) but enthusiastic, polite, pleasant, and efficient! Twice they've had my food ready before I even finished paying!

Not impressed. I did not like the bread - it was a bit dry and just didn't have any taste. In fact, I did not finish the bread but instead took off all of the meat and cheese and ate those on the side.  LOVE THE PEPSI PRODUCTS.  And what's up with the napkin situation?  No napkins near the soda fountain or on the tables. Had to ask at the register for more. Then there is the price - 2 sands, one bag chips, one large drink = $20. A bit high for Boise.   Good thing we had a dollar off coupon. 
Good things:  
Super friendly and helpful staff
Pepsi Products
Easy to read menu board
My hubby had a Boom Boom Pastrami. He likened his sandwich.
I love me new cozy comfy chair! The price was so reasonable and Cruz was super helpful! I highly recommend shopping at RC Willey and tell Cruz I said hello!

I am an extreme endurance athlete which means I go to the gym a lot and workout hard. I've had memberships to anytime fitness, Idaho athletic club, freedom fitness and axiom. Axiom has the highest quality equipment, repairs or replaces broken equipment quickly and has nice facilities. 

Minus a star for no family swim day and no wifi in the facility.

We came in for lunch today. They have a decent amount of beers on draft, but 6 dollars for a tall microbrew. Kind of pricey for a dive bar. I ordered the crispy fish tacos. They would have been good if the slaw/
Pico topping wasn't ICE cold. Pricey too for a dive bar.

The team here is exceptional, great service, smiles, and extra care taken to be sure we are receiving the best results with any projects we have! We referred  many people here over the years because they always come through & care about customer service!
 Thank you Martin, Kirsten, if course the always smiling, ever so kind Kristi & Michael!
Nothing to rave about.  Marginal food.  Slow service. Fairly nice atmosphere.  Ok to stop in if your in the area.  But not a destination establishment.

We were traveling from CA yo Boise. We got a flat when we got to Boise on my left rear. Also  had a noise coming from the rear right side. The fixed the flat and checked out the right rear. They did this while I waited, they were busy, but it was quick.  They fixed the flat, checked out the squeak and did not try to up sell anything... and did it for no cost. I was impressed. Integrity - that's not a word I associate with tire shops, but I do here.
We love this place, kids ask for it by name and love the raspberry filled Bismarck. We also love the donut holes.

Been there...won't go there again.  It was equal...maybe a half step up from Red Lobster!  Food was awful.  Grilled romaine, way too much garlic.  Lobster crab cakes...sauce so spicy you never tasted anything fish related.  Service was sub par, and was glad to get our check and run....  Time, money and a Saturday evening wasted.

Amazing first experience.  First rate cocktails, premium service, which recognizes the little things matter.  Bartender made a perfect cocktail.  The food...amazing!  Perfect from begining to end.

Had butter roasted king crab, BLT we'd get salad and Seward ahi and scallops.

Absolutely impeccable experience  Will definitely be back!
Super tasty! Our first time and will definitely be back! Worth coming and trying! The maple bar and cake donut were our favorites.
Terry & Chance were great, I really appreciated their input and willingness to answer all my questions. I love my new couch table and will definitely be back.

Visiting our daughter & family. She heard good things about Steve's so decided to try it out. Did not disappoint!! Excellent service!! Huckleberry pancakes upon request with Huckleberry syrup, so good!! I usually get biscuits & gravy, never have I gotten actual meat in the gravy!! Was very surprised! Delicious down home style food!! Will be back whenever we are in town!!

We stopped and got a sticky bun to go. There wasn't a lot of choice available at 10 when we stopped in but the sticky bun was very delicious. As others have noted, the grandparent type couple that runs the place are very congenial and warm, lending a very nice atmosphere to the place.

We dined at this restaurant at lunchtime on Saturday, Feb. 4th.  My first impression was that the atmosphere was warm & inviting.  From there, it went downhill.  It was clear that our server needed additional training in providing attentive & prompt service, along with proper etiquette.  We had to ask for everything, more than once.  And leaning over my plate to point out the 2 or so pieces of lobster in my "Lobster Mac & Cheese" dish was a real turn-off!  The only plus on service was earned by the efficient young woman who came later to refill our drinks & clear our plates.  As for the food, it was not worth the price.  The Lobster Mac & Cheese was overly (& inedibly) salty & presented only with a wedge of dry toasted bread.  My friend also was not happy with  her Fish & Chips dish.  We ordered dessert with the hope that it would make up for the disappointing entrees.  The Key Lime Pie was good, but it would take a lot to make us want to go back!

Don't know why my review was filtered.  It was an honest assessment of our experience.

I got my furniture delivered today, they forgot one item. When I called the customer service  the lady I spoke with was extremely RUDE and hung up on me!!! I called back and asked to speak with a manager and they said that a manager would call within 5 min. 1\2 he later I get a call from her. I explained what had happened and she told me the customer service lady was P.G. Really! Make excuses for her rudeness I'm appalled to say the least. I have made several large purchases from your store. Will never ever go back. I will also inform others about the customer service I recieved.. UNBELIEVABLE!!

Cute little shop that reminds me of being at my Grandma's house! I ordered the Caramel Pecan Bum and it delivered on size and sweetness! Pair this with a good cup of coffee, and you have a delightful morning treat! This place has great service, great atmosphere and delicious pastries!

There is only one word to describe the food, service and ambiance.  AWESOME.  For those of you who don't mind paying a little more for quality and for the feel of a true breakfast place, Steve's Cafe is the place.  I feel bad I haven't reviewed this place yet.  I have been there multiple times and I have had excellent service every time along with consistency of great food.  Eggs Benedict, Hash browns, varieties of sausage and omelettes are just some of the items I have tried and they have all been wonderful.   This is my first choice of breakfast places near Meridian.

This grocery store is really great. To me it feels like a cross between a Fred Meyer and a place like The Co-Op or Natural Grocers. They have some interesting items in their produce and cheese sections that you wouldn't find at other stores. I see specialty items in almost every department. Organic section is HUGE. Lots of variety. My favorite thing about this store is the bakery. The donuts are delicious and just the other day my husband and I tried these cannolis that had a toffee shell around them.... AMAZING!! Another thing I like is the store is open until midnight on weekdays. They have 13 hour sales and huge meat sales sometimes. Keep your eye out. Very friendly service. Very clean store. Don't forget to pick up an item or two to donate to the food bank bin on your way out.
Restaurant was clean. Not what I expec from a fast food restaurant. Visiting family in Boise. New Chick fil A opening in In my home state. Tacoma Wa probably will not be eating there.
Food was excellent, coffee was ok. They won't seat you until everyone is there. It was pretty busy and loud on a Sunday morning. Would be a great place for families.
Great neighborhood bar and grill. Inside and outside seating. Friendly staff. Live music several nights of the week. Food is really good, but a little pricey for a bar.

I work down the road and finally stopped in today! I ordered the Gouda Grilled Cheese and the Creamy Tomato Basil. The staff was SO kind and friendly. They seemed as though they were passionate about what they were doing. The lady taking orders at the register (Lorie) offered the indecisive customer in front of me a sample when asked what to order. She continued by telling her she could try as many as she would like. I liked that they weren't rushing her.

For a place that has soup in its name I was a little disappointed. I LOVE tomato soup in all the different ways it comes. I order it every where and probably would not order it from here again. It was very bland and lacking of flavor. The grilled cheese picked the slack up though! I will definitely be returning to try something else.

Seriously who doesn't love Smashburger? Having recently relocated from NorCal it was nice to see a familiar place to build a fresh burger exactly how I like it. Service was friendly and fast, place was clean and food was delicious.

Great experience!  Rose did my pedi/mani, and was kind and very meticulous in her work.  She took the time to make sure all my nails were thoroughly attended to.  Rose made sure I was happy with everything.  The salon is clean, smells clean, and staff was professional and friendly !

Hands down, the best donuts I've ever had. Ever. The staff is so friendly, too. It's just like the little bakeries from my childhood, only better! You have to get there early to be sure your favorite is there, but if it is not, you will find another new favorite! Try the blueberry cake donut, or their raised glazed, fresh out of the back room. You will be an instant fan!

This place is a great place for healthy fast food. 

I ate at one of these in California and was excited that it opened.  It is everything I remembered.  The rice is properly soft yet sticky, and the blanched vegetables served with the flame grilled chicken (I haven't had the beef or tofu yet) are fresh and tasty by itself, but the magic sauce (a teriyaki based) sets off all the flavors.

It truly is a terrific alternative to the usual fast food options, but due to the location, may not get the business it deserves until the area builds up.

6 stars if possible.     Ben the owner cut a great deal for a birthday party of 13 twelve year old girls.  He saved me a bundle.  We will recommend this place to everyone.  Very accomendating.  We have been here many times before and staff is always friendly.  Thank you La Creme

This restaurant has only been open for all of a week, so it was pretty empty when I came for dinner. I'm surprised because the food AND service here were really good! It's a little hard to find, but from Eagle Rd., when you see Red Robin, Lucky Fins is in the same center close by.

First, let me say that the staff here are ridiculously helpful and friendly! They even let me sample the soups before I decided on my order, which made me want to order a ton of food...even though I was eating by my lonesome (don't judge!).

Cedar plank salmon w/roasted veggies and hot potato salad - Huge portion and everything on the plate was good. The friggin hot potato salad...trust me on this one and just get it! It's diced potato with cheese, bacon, and green onion...how could you go wrong?!

Coconut shrimp - Good

Soups - Clam and the other one...Good - The clam chowder was not as thick as I'm used to, but it had tons of clam and the flavor was a good different.

House salad - Huge portion and could actually almost be an entree salad. Also, it had mixed greens. Not just the cheap iceberg lettuce only salads...Thank goodness!

Hopefully, the business here will pick up because it seems like it has potential to become very sucessful!

I was here yesterday and had the turkey avocado on wheat bread. It has been a while since I ate at Togos, with only one distant location in Phoenix. Now I may have to make the drive. Great sandwich with plenty of filling and the bread is really good. I will be back the next time I am in Boise area.

I believe this is the very best small soup kettle kitchen you will  find in the Boise area the owners Shane Ryan and his wife are just very pleasant people you will find absolute best soup ever best sandwiches ever you will never find a bad meal or you might even witness a good joke so come and enjoy the atmosphere and dirty up their kitchen not yours

Fun, varied menu, good service needs more fresh fish
2nd time, both enjoyable.
Menu is varied and has some fun items, e.g. roulette.
About 10 drafts and a few more wines by the glass.
Wife liked Halibut Florentine, good veggies & prep
Stuffed Avocado was a treat, esp at $6.
Mikayla is knowledgeable about their beer, wine and menu. Also patient and looks in often. Perfect.
Con: Lucky Fins, especially considering their name, could use more fresh fish on the menu - apparently offered only on weekends

Happy holidays sign still up and it's January 31. No where near ready to serve breakfast when they opened at 9.
