Bar stools still upside down on bar,  kitchen not ready at 9, was told they had to "warm things up", food was pretty good though.  Management needs to have place ready by opening and take down Halloween decorations and Christmas messaging.

What a fun place to take your kiddos for an afternoon of fun and entertainment. Now that my kids are older, they run for the race cars first. There's definitely plenty to do for all ages. Bowling, miniature golf, batting cages, video games and amusement rides

Wonderful food , and service. Very clean, and they change options all the time with soup. If you haven't been I highly recommend it . I can't say I go all the time, but I do go a couple times a month. Prices are fair , and you good a decent amount of food. All made fresh everyday. The meatball sandwich is AMAZING!!!!
I really like the customer service here.  There is a convenient location for me to stop and have lunch during work hours.

Took my husband here today to get some pedicures,  we are from out of town and went here based on other yelp reviews. Staff was super friendly, place was clean, chairs were great. My nails look fantastic and the foot and leg massage was amazing. Would definitely come back.

When it comes to chain pizza places the pizza is pretty standard i order pizza hut with that in mind with that said i do like their pizza however my review is based on the service i received from this location...they are awesome! The girl who answered the phone was very friendly and we had hot pizza in ablout 30 minutes...not to mention she went the extra mile i mentioned to her we had just moved into our place and were unloading boxes still and she said she would be sure to bring plates and napkins and then apologized that they didnt have cups...HOW SWEET!! Ive never had such awesome service from a pizza hut! Thanks guys!

We usually come here during Friday's because they have open play for $5 per kid. Great place to get the jiggles out! You can hang out by the sides to watch the kids from afar but  I suggest to go with your kids to watch them close. Open play starts at 10 and ends at 12 so come as soon as they open so you get most of your time. I just hope they have some more adult supervising on every area to help out the kids.

The chocolate cake I had was amazing!  Also, I've had a lot of froyo in my life and thought I just didn't like the stuff. It's always been watery and flavorless, but La Creme changed my mind!!  It tastes just like soft serve!!  The flavor selection is amazing and I can't wait to go back and try a new flavor!! I can't say enough good things about it!

The staff was friendly and helpful. I love the decor, especially the large photo of Neuschwanstein Castle and the soda shoppe-esque area behind the counter!
Nice little find for a breakfast place. From out of town and wanted a good breakfast experience. Food took some time to come out but overall it was a good experience. And the food was very good.

Pleasant, casual atmosphere with grilled seafood and sushi options. I had The Lobster Crab Cakes and split a El Diablo roll as an appetizer. Both were very good. I also got a double gin and tonic which actually tasted like a double. I will be back.

Sorry to see TOGO's Meridian close down.
Great food, great owners that put their heart & soul into this place...

To much competition in the area, the slice of pie is just getting to thin!

Creative menu with nice fresh fish dishes and yummy deserts. Great service too. Ahi ceviche was nice and fresh. Scallops and seared ahi dish was very nice. Citrus salmon bowl  was just ok. Mango cake and bread pudding were both great.
Really good soup and sandwiches. Their kids option is a man size over filled sandwich which my 1.5 yr old couldn't eat.

Pros:  
Friendly, fast, fabulous service
Quality foods
Clean location 
Great little indoor playland
Community minded

Cons:
BUSY - everybody knows how great this place is
Closed on Sundays (I bet this goes in the Pros list for employees, lol)

Prices may be competitive with Albertson's or Fred Meyer, but the majority of the items I priced were more than my preferred grocer (WinCo). 

The fruits on my visit appeared to have been more roughly handled particularly the oranges.  The meat department had a good selection and on sale prices were good. A good selection of bulk foods and spices (but I didn't see bulk shelled peanuts). And a plus is a section for natural/organic food at the usual prices. Many of the bulk items were marked as organic with the price to match.

This visit spent $64+ and saved $54+

Overall I'd say, if your savings are more than 40% of the total bill there is something wrong with the "regular" pricing. Albertsons tries to play this "savings" trick as well.  Comparison shop to know the difference and buy accordingly.

Also, we didn't see any shopping cart corrals in the parking lot. This may be due to the fact that the baggers will assist you in loading your vehicle.

To get started I hate giving this place a bad review but I have to be honest. The people are very nice and the shop is very unique with lots of potential. We decided to go for Saturday and service was fast enough when we got there. We were slightly disappointed that when given our menus to find out that the buffet was our only option but decided it might be a huge upgrade from the standard buffet house. After all they were only open 4 days and it was 12-13$ a person. Well that assumption turned out to be wrong. The first plate I picked up in this like maybe 10-15 item "buffet" was covered in food underneath which immediately made me question the cleanliness but wasn't enough to deter me from trying the food. 

Moving into the actual buffet which actually had crock pots for several of the items was disappointment after disappointment. For the most part it was similar to what you would expect to find in a free buffet in a lower grade hotel and I've had better prepared eggs in a buffet line in some hotels. There were very few options and nothing stood out as overly amazing though I tried most of it. I did not try the monte cristo but the first trip through the buffet turned me off to the food enough to not have interest in going back. 

The only food highlight I encountered was the chai tea which as they described it was "heavenly". It was a leaf tea and combined with what was either fresh ground nutmeg or cinnamon topped with frothed milk. It was truly a great cup of chai and the main reason I may give this place another shot on a non-buffet day. They seemed to have a good selection of tea which was all loose and sitting there for just a cup of tea would probably be worth it as the outside is very pleasant. 

To sum this up this place does not have an impressive buffet so I can say for certain it gets an F for Saturday as it is your only option. The tea is at least an A- as it is excellent and uniquely presented but I can't say better than shangri la as their selection is not near the size. The people are very nice but sadly it does not make up for disappointing food and dirty plates. I did enjoy the atmosphere as it was unique and quiet outside. Sadly I go to a restaurant to eat and if the food is bad I just can't endorse it. Giving this place a shot on a regular food day may be worth it just because their tea is so good but buffet is really not anything you haven't encountered in a cheaper hotel and for 12-13$ not worth it at all.

We have been long time loyal customers of RC Willey. 
We recently had an experience where a fridge we purchased, along with the extended warranty, completely destroyed the beautiful floor in our BRAND NEW house.
This could have been avoided. I called every time that it had an issue (5-6) different times. Each time RC Willey sent someone out, and just basically put a bandaid on it. The final time a servicemen came, our fridge was deemed unrepairable, but some how this information was never reported to us!  So a few weeks later I came home to a massive puddle of water under my fridge. I called and was treated so horribly by the woman I spoke to with the warranty department. Even though this was RC Willeys fault, and that I had an extended warranty, she said that they were absolutely in no way responsible. Then she gave me less than $1000 to go pick out a new fridge. The entire thing was a complete slap in the face!!! 
We had picked out a new recliner for my husband who works over 60 hours a week serving the community, but after we got the bid to fix our floor, and ended up spending more on a decent fridge- there was no way that we could afford a nice chair that he so deserves.
We are incredibly disappointed to say the least. We have taken our business to RC Willey happily for years. We have furnished 4 different homes in the last 7 years, but after the way that we were treated through this mess... I'm saddened to say that we won't be back.
***UPDATE- the general manager of the meridian store contacted me personally in response to my review. He is so kind! He asked me to tell him what had happened, and he listened to the whole story. He obviously was not able to fix our floor, but he did ask us to come into the store so that he could try to make a bad situation better. I most likely will not buy appliances from RC Willey anymore, but because of John Jensen's kindness- we will continue to shop there. The meridian location is lucky to have such a wonderful man representing their store! Thank you John!

Had lunch there today with my wife; we had a $12 Groupon. I had the traditional Smashburger, regular size, and my wife had the swiss & mushroom Jr. burger. I had "smash fries" and she had the sweet potato fries. Both of the burgers were cooked medium, on request...the default is medium well, which is not the way to get a burger. We had sodas to drink; beer selection was not particularly good.

Overall: Excellent burger. Great meat flavor, seasoned well, good proportion of topping/vegetables. Really good. Wife's had good flavor as well. We also both enjoyed the fries, both sweet potato and regular. The rosemary and garlic is a nice touch;  they were fresh and tasty. I would've preferred more salt, but that was easy to add at the table. I also would've toasted the egg bun a little more so it held up better, but it was still fine.

What was good: Burger quality. Fries were good, too, but not blow-you-away great.

Not-so-good: Beer selection, and price. All-in, it would've been a bit over $20 for the two of us...for burgers, fries, and sodas! That's just a little too high a price point for me.

I'll be back, but only with a coupon. The quality is really there, but it's just too pricey.

My second time here and their 6in Hot Pastrami sandwich on wheat with mustard and pepper jack is still one of the best I've had for a chain restaurant. The Pastrami is cut thin and falls apart in your mouth with each bite of the sandwich with a ton of flavor. It's comparable to Quiznos in pricing and equal to many of the local sandwich places in downtown Boise like bluebird etc...you wil drop around $10-13 for a meal if you get the combos. The quality of meats and the amount of meat you get on this sandwich, makes it worth the extra cost. Service from the sandwich artists was good and the place was very clean. I will have to come back and try some of their other offerings but it will be hard to pull away from that pastrami goodness.

The Kettle Soup and Grill in Meridian is amazing! I had an emotionally immersive taste experience with a gluten-free gouda cheese onion and red pepper grilled sandwich paired with an absolutely divine tomato soup. All of their sandwhiches can be made gluten free and all soups are gluten free except for the soups with noodles. The owner taking my order was just as smily and helpful as can be. 

The The owner/cook is friendly and truly cares about gluten sensitivity. He came out to greet all of their customers personally to see if they were happy. That's 5 star service. 

He has celiac so cross contamination is something he is very conscientious about. I really didn't feel like eating out, but I needed to. I am so tired of lettuce wrapped hamburgers or places with nothing for me to eat but French fries. I recently realized I was glutening myself accidentally with white chocolate mochas and eating out can be scary sometimes. So, it is a great comfort to find a place with a chef who is truly in the know. 

I was ecstatic the moment I walked in the door and saw the chalk board with G marked next to menu items. This is one of the purest gems in the Treasure Valley.  The quality ingredients shine through. I could rave about this place forever. Go check it out!

Oh! I was completely satisfied with the portions as well. My 15 year old ordered a whole grilled gouda on sourdough  bread (I am so glad I know what kind of bread it is now. I guessed wrong!). She loved it. We were both delighted with the crispy cheese! She added the ham and was so satisfied she could only eat half of the sandwich. The girl can eat too. The second half of her sandwich  was the first thing she looked for when she was ready for a snack and my kids don't do leftovers most of the time. 

The price ended up being right around $20. I thought it was comparable to many other places, only I felt like I got what I paid for. I felt good about making a healthy choice for lunch as well. I could pay just as much at my favorite burger joint and walk away feeling heavy and guilty. It was refreshing to know I made a good choice for my body and soul.

Thank you for having such a great place to eat Shane!

DO NOT EAT HERE!!! They literally seem to be running the place with about 5 people on staff. Some of the worst customer service I've ever received and the black haired girl in the kitchen sounded like an absolute horror. If you eat here you will over pay for a tiny burger with few fries and it's only a matter of time before the place has an outbreak of some kind of sickness.

This company is terrible and unprofessional. They continually show up on your property without prior notice. They charge fees which are not laid out in the lease agreement, and are borderline illegal and unethical in their management practices. We have had so many issues with them. They didn't even clean the property before we moved in and had to do so after the fact. They never return calls, and are rude when they do. I would never rent or list my property with them. I hope they go out of business.

Went back to try it again.
Food: 
Swordfish - portion was very small ~4/5 oz for $20, and not great
Fish ribs-$9 this was good
Calamari- we sent it back/ Greasy and bland
Service:
It was good only complaint is having to ask for drink refills 
Atmosphere: loud
Second visit didn't make me a regular I've had better seafood dishes at Kahootz for less $.

Our experience shopping at RCW was positive from beginning to end.  The sales person was professional, knowledgeable about the furniture, patiently showed us various selections and above all was kind.  We experienced great service on the showroom floor and in their clearance center.  It's my go to place for furniture.

Got our ice cream right away then waited almost 30 minutes in the drive thru for one burger and two order of fries. Once we got our burger the ice cream was completely melted but that's not the worse of it. I shared the burger with my daughter and now we're both sick - wishing we would've never ate there :(.
Jadea is so friendly, she fixed my iPhone screen so fast no more than 20mins, I would always go back here whenever I need my phone fix. Thank you Jadea!

Sweet Sansation Donuts are the best in Idaho. So good!!!
Every time we walk in Sweet Sansation Donuts, we feel so peaceful!
Keep it clean, great service, always good with the kiddos, never had a cut where I left and wasn't happy. Always feel good to walk out and rock the new looks!

I bought a house full of furniture here two years ago. They made us wait weeks and weeks to deliver our furniture for us... the salesman on the floor, "James" was our best friend while we were shopping and spending our money, but as soon as they got it, we were no longer worth their time. We finally ended up having to actually RENT a Uhaul and pick up our own stuff. Now, 2 short years later, one of our expensive leather couches is peeling and cracking in spots, revealing that they were literally just "painted" over... very low quality piece of crap. Good thing we purchased the 5 year warranty, right? Wrong... they have now made us wait months and months to fix the couch, from August to now, without even the common courtesy of a phone call. The last time I spoke to someone... a very disinterested young woman, I was told the part would be here from CHINA in the middle of November. It's already almost half-way through December. Awful customer service, low quality products, warranties that are pretty much useless... you decide whether this business is worth your time. We will NEVER be back.

UPDATE:
So after this original post, they started the process of repairing our couch, which was under warranty.  When the man was at our house to complete the color match, we pointed out to him that the love s shortly eat was beginning to peel exactly as the first one did.  He took photos, and told us that we would be hearing back so that we could get it repaired.  Guess what?  Here it is 3 months later, and no word AT ALL.  I am so sick and tired of this company.  Seriously, DO NOT SHOP HERE.  You are wasting your money, and they will treat you like crap.
Dr Uranga is amazing and everyone at OGA was great. I would definitely recommend them.
So delicious! I have been to both the Nampa and Boise locations. The staff are always friendly and more than willing to offer suggestions of their favorite empanadas.
Wow. -more than a donut shop!! Great food and donuts are amazing. - one stop and got donuts for kids. -ham croissant and breakfast burrito for mom and dad :)

This is probably the best Taco Bell I have ever been to. I've been. Ext door at the hotel, and these kids actually seem to understand what good customer service is. I'm really impressed, and I usually don't get robbed of those precious ingredients I pay for. God bless you all
Great store. I have found prices are a bit higher. But their customer service is the best. Especially the Pharmacy thanks to Stephen, Josh, and Stacy.

A brand new local donuts place in Meridian. I went there to give it a try after my workout (go ahead U can judge me!). I picked up a few donuts & breakfast items. Everything's was good & fresh! The ladies that work there are nice! It feels good to support a local business. I'll be back for more!

I stopped in at Steve's because I had heard they had breakfasts made with fresh huckleberries, a real rarity. The Stuffed French Toast with Fresh Huckleberry Sauce really delivered, the toast nicely done, two thick pieces of Texas toast slitted and stuffed with a thin layer of ricotta cheese stuffing. The sauce itself was amazing, not too sweet and chock full of the fresh huckleberries. A nice cup of the sauce on the side gave plenty of sauce to dip each piece of toast into. Accompanied by a side of well-grilled ham steak, this was one of the best breakfasts I've had in a long time. Oh yes, their fresh-roasted coffee was good too!

A friend and I popped into the free intro class on Saturday morning. As soon as we walked in we were welcomed by Kelsie and guided to the iPads along the wall to quickly check in, then Kelsie gave us a quick tour of the showers, and main locker area. 

We were both very impressed by the layout and great customer service. 

For those who may not know: 

-There are lockers for your valuables
-As mentioned, there are showers with all of your basic needs, shampoo, conditioner, etc
-They do provide cycle shoes that allow you to properly clip into the pedals, however they do sanitize them after each use
-Towels to wipe your sweat (because trust me, you will break a sweat) are also provided along with water and water bottles if you happen to have forgotten yours 

Cyclebar also runs various happy hour and wine Wednesday classes which sounded like a great girlfriends night out or date night if you want to change it up....talk about taking the "wine workout" to a whole new level. 

Before the intro class was even half way over I knew I'd be buying a package of rides. They have some great offers for First time riders, with the best offer being $99 for 10 rides ($10/ride). I will admit the rides become quite a bit more expensive after that, a single ride will set you back $23 but if you buy a package that's where you can save. The standard ride packages can also be shared within the same household, an added bonus. 

I look forward to my next ride, time to get my butt in gear.

Excellent entertainment for the kids.  I love the $12 Tuesdays, but one star off for not including go-carts in that price.  It's great to be able to get the kids unlimited wristbands, but only a few of the arcade games work with the wristbands.  That's frustrating.  So one star off for that too. Other than that, the place is decently cleaned - not perfect, but I think that's to be expected for such a high volume space.  The staff have always been kind and professional as well.  The kids keep asking to go back, and it's nice to have a fun, safe place for them to hang out with their friends.

Our family loves coming here(especially the parents), as it provides the kids fresh, simple, non-fried food.  It is a great alternative to fast-food or drive through food.  It is a very simple menu that can be customized to give you a great teriyaki rice bowl or teriyaki salad with protein choices of chicken, beef, or tofu.

The magic sauce is awesome, with a kick of one of the hot sauces and it is perfect for me.  The kids go straight magic sauce on their rice bowls with blanched broccoli.

The only reason they are not getting a 5-star from me is that the price is a bit higher than I expected.  I guess it comes down to paying a bit more for freshness and organic food like you so in a grocery store.  No star reduction for food or service as both were spot on!

Have driven by this place for some time, finally decided to stop in and try it....had a couple of Savory Mexican style flavors and a Lemon desert empanada.  Much larger than I thought they would be, and actually too much to eat.  One of the Mexican flavors was good, the other one was lacking and the lemon pie, well just about the same as the hostess pies you get at the gas station.  2 weeks later I decided to try again and did the Argentinian fillings, this time it was excellent and did Tres Leches on the desert.  Now I'm starting to like this place.  Went again a week later had another Argentinian flavor and it was excellent also, then Tres Leches with Chocolate and Cream Cheese....I do believe I have a new addiction now!  Very good, some of the help is not too excited to be working there, that's the 4 stars, but the flavors are great.

We purchased a couch and recliner in December of 2015.  The chair had a problem that happened at the manufacturers end and I ended up receiving and returning 3 chairs before we got one that didn't have the problem. Our sales person was Bambi, and she was great, she never left us hanging and always got back to us about the issue, she keep us updated on what she was doing to resolve the problem.  It took 3 months to resolve, I always felt that Bambi listened and did everything she could to help resolve the problem.  This is the first time we have purchased from RC Willey and if we go back we would definitely  ask for Bambi.

The black bean BBQ burger was DELICIOUS! I am vegan so I got it without mayo or cheese and added the mushrooms, avocado and the fried onions which was perfect! I got a side of buffalo sauce (of course) and the tots on the side. I was so satisfied and not overly full. Definitely recommend. Not many choices for Vegan but that one was perfect!

If you are a savvy shopper that likes a bit of a challenge, Rosauers is the place :) 
If you are looking for local/health/green options and specialty options, Rosauers is a fantastic start :)
If you are shopping with kiddos, GREAT! :)

They carry a ton of specialty options to serve those with special dietary needs and the health/green conscious. The health section is under the Huckleberries name and they have monthly sales (10% off a certain section, etc). 

I find several of my favorite things that I used to have to order from Amazon LOCALLY AT ROSAURERS. They also carry local products like Zacca Humus, local farm honey etc. 

While some things are a little more expensive than at large chain grocery stores, if you pay attention to sales/coupons one can reap the benefits with the specialty items. 

Fun points if you are shopping with kiddos: 
- They have 3 different car-carts available (besides regular, easy/small carts, & motorized carts)
- Lately they've had a little fruit tray in the produce section for snacks to keep the kids happy while you shop
- There is a yellow toy truck ride in the foyer that is set up for FREE RIDES when you wrap up your shopping

Eh. We heard rave reviews, and when our usual breakfast place was crazy busy, we hopped over here and gave it a try. I was hopeful, and more excited when I saw marionberry and huckleberry options on the menu. My husband ordered a scramble and I got the marionberry pancakes.

My pancakes were HUGE, but they were also dense, thick, and a mega gut punch--not at all fluffy and flavorful as I would have hoped. Honestly, they seemed like they had been mixed inexpertly using Krusteaz mix and not enough moisture. There were berries, though, so that was helpful. My side order of sunny-side-up eggs were lukewarm, so overall I was disappointed. My  husband felt like he could have chosen better in ordering, but overall his food was just ok.

Service was good, people were pleasant. Booths are WAY too high off the ground--my feet didn't touch. This is something I've never run into before, and it made for an uncomfortable dining experience. I don't think we would ever go back.

Have been to Tami's about five times now.  
It has become a favorite lunch spot.  I have tried a different item every time we have gone in.  I have not been disappointed.  The flavors are unbelievable and fresh tasting.  
The pasta salad is one of the best I have ever had.
I can't wait to try everything on the menu!
The staff makes you feel so at home and they genuinely seem to love the place!

The beds are great & give you excellent color, my problem is with the staff. I'm not sure if they are paid solely on commission from tanning lotion, but I am blown away with how pushy they are every. single. time. I go in. It's pretty rude. Every time I go in and simply ask to tan, they spend several minutes trying to sell me different lotions, for my face, my legs, different times of the year, etc. I order my lotion online, so I have told them, "I'm covered, thank you," and they have legitimately asked me to get it out of my purse to prove to them I have it, only to try and sell me a better one. One girl told me to cancel my online order so she could sell the same lotion to me. It's uncomfortable to go in there, and I wish I would have signed a contact somewhere else.

Good food ample serving. Omelette was excellent
 Hashbrowns were more like a potato pancake. Clean nice friendly and prompt service. Price was typical but no bargain. Will return again.

love this place and the food is really good. I've enjoyed the gyros here and the quality of the food. The food I would rate it a 5, it's tasty and I enjoy it. I've taken away a star for service. I've been here quite a few times, since it's just done the street from my house and my order correctness has only been 1 time. My order is always wrong, but since it's so close to my house, I don't want to go back to get it fixed. Another star is taken away from value. I like their salads, but they are pre-made. Here's my problem with that, I don't like everything in them, so I ask for them to be removed. The logical thing to me, is replace it with something else, but they don't. So here I am paying about $5 for not even half of the small salad. It's not worth it to take anything off. I then ordered a large drink with my combo and it was about an inch and a half from the rim of the cup. The staff is always friendly at this location  

Update: I commend this place for working out their opening bumps and my orders have all been correct. They have handled this review amazingly.
Bob and Myrna is my new favorite sandwich!   Good portions, good bread, great fries!  I'm glad to have a sandwich place close by that isn't subway

RC Willey is awesome!  We furnished our entire new home and bought all of our appliances there as well. Their high quality furniture and high end appliances have now made our house a home!  Cindy was our furniture salesperson and she is creative, very knowledgeable with attention to detail. She made the process so easy and the best part was that we received all our furniture within 2 weeks, even though we ordered a week before Christmas!  We highly recommend them!

Not happy with this place. My husband went to play basketball in the gym and needed to take my son with him. My son is nine years old, very mature, and actually is a Baller! I had to drive all the way back to the gym to pick him up because they would not let him sit on the sideline and watch his dad play basketball. It's not like he's a toddler running around. Poor customer service. Not welcoming.

They were great went in there got really good help bought a sectional sofa from them with recliners but a- year later the handles for reclining back broke called to get some help no one gives a dang can't get anyone to help us fix these chairs I've been there 3 times they take my name my phone number and never get back to me won't buy anything else from them there they have a great selection but after you buy beware

.I used to go here often for lunch. It was convenient, and I was willing to pay a little extra for the convenience. The chipotle turkey was one of the better sandwiches I've had. Tomato basil soup was very satisfying. Would like to try more soups, but I'm not gonna spend time waiting for my soup to cool.
.The cashier (who has always been the same gal) once gave me a loyalty card, but I'm not sure if they still do that.
.They appear to be green-thinking, offering a paper recycling bin, not putting napkin dispensers on tables, and offering emailed receipts rather than printed paper. You do get a couple napkins with your order. The chairs are sturdy, and comfortable. The tables are small. The restaurant interior looks clean, like the owners really care. The wall decor exudes a fresh "Soup Kettle" theme.
.Today I tried the Mediterranean sandwich. It was wrapped in paper. Seems that turkey is their meat of choice on cold sandwiches. Fresh bread. The half sandwich by itself is a meal for me, although a bit pricey.
.The specialty food here is really the soups. They are home-made with fresh ingredients. It's served steamy hot in special durable (not throw-away) bowls. I noticed they were offering quart-size soup in take-home containers, in a cooler near the cashier. Must be at least a dozen different kinds of soup there. I picked out something I had not tried, to save for dinner, so my wife could have some as well. We like fresh soups, but $12 a quart makes me hesitate.

I walked into this Lush location as a first-time customer and not knowing what products I really wanted. I explained my skin "wants" to Cheyenne and she was great about demo-ing different products on the back of my hands for me. She also seemed to sense that I was in a bit of a hurry - so while still being helpful, we still moved along pretty quickly! If I'd have wanted to linger, I'm sure that would have been fine, too. I purchased a facial cleanser, moisturizer, and scrub, and so far am very pleased with all three items. She threw in a little sample of eye cream too! Looking forward to my next visit when maybe I'll have time to browse a little more. I also interacted with another employee - I didn't catch her name - but she was really friendly too.

By far the best soft serve ice cream around!! So glad they have a location in meridian!! Their food is great, and I've never experienced any negative issues at either location. The service is always fast, friendly, and affordable.

Fried pickles were perfect. CBG tacos were super over stuffed(Not that I'm complaining), hubs grown up mac and cheese was such a big serving, he had to take it home. Just wish the Jameson and ginger ale was a bit stronger. Pretty dang good.

It gives me peace of mind to know that our vehicles are serviced by knowledgeable, honest and fair people. We have taken our car here over 3 years and they have always exceeded our expectations. I would not hesitate to recommend Heritage Auto to anyone.

I typically wouldn't go out of my way to review a fast food restaurant, but these guys went above and beyond when I visited this location. You see, the Chick-fil-A in Meridian is the last one before you enter the terrible Chick-fil-A-free zone of the Pacific Northwest (until 2015). 

We were up early to finish up our long drive from the east coast to Tacoma and arrived just as they opened for breakfast. I explained to the two employees (Ana and a manager) my terrible predicament of having no access to their delicious chicken sandwiches for the foreseeable future and they graciously agreed to make non-breakfast sandwiches for me to take home to hoard for later. Knowing that I wouldn't be eating them all in one sitting and not wanting my sandwiches to become soggy messes, they took it upon themselves to separately package the buns, chicken breasts, and pickles. They finished my bag with a HEAPING handful of Chick-fil-A sauce packs. I may have cried a single tear of joy.
Had my toes done yesterday's Anna your  I now have a nail place very clean and friendly toof

2 adults and 3 kids.  Nicely done!  Food was exceptional as far as the cedar plank scalps and Tokyo salad.  Service was very nice and prompt. This is a great local restaurant for Meridian when you want something other than burger and steak ...although they have that too!

I preface by saying my review is of a drive-thru experience. I showed up at about 8:30pm Sunday evening 8/19/18 and ordered the following
-1 med chocolate malt
-1 med strawberry shake
-1 med mint chocolate shake
-1 order of fries 
-1 order of chicken strips

First, the bad news . . . I was in the drive-thru for a solid 30-35 minutes. NOT KIDDING HERE. Very slow moving through the drive-thru. At some point, I would like to go again to see if this is a common thing. But I don't know if I will be able to muster the courage to try the drive-thru again, that wait was brutal.

As for what we got, the shakes were all enjoyable and I would order again. Fries were decent and I really liked their Fry Sauce. Chicken strips just okay, probably wouldnt order those again.

First I want to start by saying just how nice and friendly the staff is. Everyone was very friendly and excited to help us. I thought they were going to us when they found out it was our first time there. The menu is rotated each week to feature a handful of soups that are hot and fresh, but they also have a freezer with a larger selection to take home. I ordered the meatball grilled cheese with a bowl of the buffalo chicken soup. The bread on the grilled cheese was toasted really well with some crispy cheese on the edges. There were a lot of meatballs inside the sandwich but unfortunately they were pretty bland and took away from the flavor as a whole. The soup was kind of thin, it wasn't the thick brothy soup I was hoping for on a chilly day and it could have used a bit more of a kick, but that didn't stop me from eating the whole thing. I would try this place again, but I would check what soups are on the menu that week ahead of time.

Three stars because their cookies and sodas are fine and I don't want to trash their reputation over hot chocolate. That being said, huge problem with the hot chocolate. Was surprised to see hot chocolate on the menu at a relatively affordable price. I thought this was a nice option, but didn't expect much. The hot chocolate itself was fine... tasted like some type of name-brand packet drink, but the delivery method had me really scratching my head. My hot chocolate was served in a standard soda cup with plastic lid and a plastic straw. Perplexed, I assumed this was some sort of Utahn food hack, and went to town. I was greeted with scorching-hot hot chocolate. Fine, joke's on me. After letting the drink cool for a few minutes, I discovered that the plastic straw I was given had begun slightly melting. Five minutes in and my hot chocolate reeked of plastic and I had to throw it out. Lesson learned: don't get the hot chocolate at a soda shop.

We did get our mattress about a week after my last review. The mattress has been amazing. I had some questions regarding the mattress and Casey was always available or got back to me within the hour. I definitely recommend Mattress Land for their service and products.

Best chicken sandwich I have had from a fast food.  The breading on the fried chicken is very tasty and well seasoned.  Real white meat chicken.  They have a large choice of sauces for your chicken sandwich.  Very clean and open atmosphere.  I will be coming back often.

I find it extremely "original" that every up-coming Bar & Grill pulls the "Our vision is that it's like a modern-day Cheers," card. Meridian is slowly accumulating it's local business gems, and with some creativity I think this new Bar & Grill will far surpass your average Applebee's or T.G.I.F. 

They go local where they can, using Idaho-raised meats and Simplot fries on their menu of pub fare and southwest specialties, such as ancho chile burger, honey chipotle burger, and taco salad. 

I'm a HUGE fan of the pull up wall/door that gives you open air atmosphere. The sweet potato fries and honey mustard are just one of their winning combinations. I'm very anxious for the full menu and bar to appear! 

Happy hour goes from 3 to 7 p.m. Mondays through Fridays with $1 off any beverage. The Curb is open 11 a.m. to 11 p.m. Mondays through Thursdays, 11 a.m. to 1 a.m. Fridays and Saturdays, and 11 a.m. to 10 p.m. Sundays.

I had my nails done here less than two weeks ago and my gel has completely peeled off. The shaping was inconsistent and manicure/pedicure was completed in less than an hour. Normally I appreciate efficiency, but that timeframe led to a lack luster and hastily done manicure/pedicure. I was with a friend at the time who was ranting about their amazing work, but was equally disappointed with the outcome of her mani/pedi as well. If I returned, I would go on a less busy day and hope for more attention to detail!

Still waiting for 3 months after pictures were taken of our love seat to have the peeling repaired. Same thing happened with our couch and that also took months to get fixed! Horrible that you spend thousands of dollars and are treated horribly. Even the representative over the phone was rude. I will not male one more purchase from this store. Very disappointing.

Went there for a late breakfast and found a line out the door.  Our family of four put our name on the waiting list, told the wait would be twenty minutes, and went next door to Stadium sports to look around. After buying a couple of things at Stadium, we went back (just after 20 minutes). The woman at the desk told us that we did not answer when our name was called and I could see that we were the next to the last name crossed out, so we only missed them calling our names by a couple of minutes at the most.  I explained that we were next door (supporting the neighboring business) and she said "you have to stay here, I guess no one told you".  And, instead of finding us a table she said, "I'll have to add  you back to the end of the list and it's a 30 minute wait". Whatever.  This is really just a chain anyway and there are other restaurants willing to take our money without being rude.
Definitely mediocre halibut , but we are spoiled after living in Alaska.  Service was good and deserts above average for boise

Either u are a fan or not.  Like Apple or Like Android.  We like it.  The latest coupons for a free salad are awesome. They let us swap it out from the Asian to the Cobb no problem. Service is always outstanding. The breakfast and the spicy chicken deluxe are faves.

This is a great environment to lose the meatball. It's a fun place to workout in a helpful team environment. When combined with a personal trainer you will Be all set. I am a year away from being put out to pasture and I use it for cross training for stair climbing. I can't wait to see my results at next years climb and at the Redbull 400 in September.

Excellent place to eat! Nice little hybrid between a seafood restaurant and a sushi bar. Had the stuffed mushrooms, a snapdragon roll, and a mojo roll. All were wonderful. I highly recommend you try this place.

I'm not very picky person but this was our experience,  first walked in someone greeted us but not sure we're from. Stood there for a while before we figured out you seat yourself . sat down and notice the waitress in far back corner chatting with friends and on her phone. She finally came over to get our drink order , she was nice but very into herself and that is coming from a guy. But food was good and delicious.

Brighton is my favorite store. Handbags, wallets, and jewelry are made with high quality and are offered in a variety of styles. Also, they know me!! It is so cool to go to a place "where everyone knows your name"... Brighton is like my Cheers! Stacy, Celeste, Lori, and the rest of the girls are amazing!!

We are remodeling our kitchen and the first item I purchased was a $10K Subzero refrigerator with the intent of buying double ovens, steamer and and induction range top.  But, we got such horrible customer service from the sales guy we have opted to purchase everything else someplace else.  The lack of communication and attention to detail was unbelievable.  I don't expect to be treated like a princess, but I expect organized delivery and installation service - I felt like a cow waiting in a line to pick up my daily feed ration.  Get your item, move on.  The guy knew we were looking for other appliances and never bothered to follow-up or even send us a thank you note.  Oh, did I mention I'm looking for other furniture, too as part of the remodel.  Well, we will not be stepping foot inside CHF in the future.  Sad, too.  We love to buy local.

Steve's is a great little breakfast place you might drive right by if you weren't looking for it. They good is good and the service is friendly. My kids loved the huckleberry pancakes and French toast. I had the eggs Benedict and the eggs actually came to the table poached and runny like they are supposed to be...I am about 50-50 finding a place that actually get the eggs correct. I will come back to this place.

Kind, sweet, efficient, and GOOD!  

Maija took our family photos this last fall.  We have a 4 and 6 year old.  She was quick, efficient, kind, calming, good with the kids, and creative.  She had our pictures back to us within a few weeks and I could not be happier!!!  They are stunning!  Probably fair to say that taking family photos can be a stressful situation but Maija made it painless and enjoyable.

The burgers were great and the fries were almost good enough to be eaten without a dipping sauce (high praise from me) but it's not the greatest value if you're just in the mood for a basic cheeseburger.  There are a lot of other options to craft a more unique burger.  They did serve us very quickly so if you want a quick, delicious burger and don't mind spending extra for more flavor and less grease than a fast food place, Smashburger fits the bill.

I do wish they had a honey mustard.  All the sauces they have to choose from, and my favorite is woefully absent.

I should have turned around when I saw their prices but I decided to try it anyway. I got the turkey with avocado. It's not like Subway where they ask you what you want on your sandwich. Mine was turkey with brown avocado and cheese and nothing else. I made it through one bite and couldn't stomach a second. I asked for a refund and they asked what the problem was. I said the sandwich had no flavor. They said it was their "most popular sandwich" and "we don't need ignorant customers like you." They literally tossed my $15 back at me and told me not to come back.

Togo's that won't be a problem. Trust me.

Evergreen was amazing during the home loan process they went above and beyond being available weekends and any time we needed to answer questions and help us. Dawn was awesome to work with she was extremely helpful and nice.

My wife and I went there for her 40th birthday and met up with some friends. We haven't been there in a while and didn't realize that they change their menu offerings. I didn't see the Island burger and asked about it and thats when I was told about the menu changes. But I'm happy to say that they still made the Island burger for me which was still fantastic. We had the Lobster flatbread trio which for 9.99 is a great deal. The street tacos that a friend had looked amazing too. Customer service was great, my only little complaint, they have wifi but it's locked and not available to guest. Also, they need a twitter account for specials. FB isn't the only player in town
Very cool aesthetic, great customer service and amazing coffee / food. Love coming in here. You always feel like a regular!

I love doignmy groceries here. Fruits/veggies are a tad-bit more expensive than Walmart/Target, but the entire shopping experience makes up for the few extra pennies you might be paying.  If there is something you are looking for and they don't have it in the store, you can talk to the manager and they will actually look to get it for you. They take your phone number and will call you when they get it. Isn't that amazing..!

If you want to eat pastries that taste like a little piece of heaven, then this is the place! It is operated by the owners; the friendliest cutest couple ever. Everything made with fresh ingredients! You can taste and see the difference. Go today and try it!

I came here for the first time after moving to Idaho from CA. I've had the same barber for years, so needless to say , I was uneasy. Fred asked me what I would like and he gave me a great cut. He was cordial and informative . I'm sold . He's my go to barber now.

What a great place to find a variety of sports ware.  If you are in the Boise area, stop by.  If you want to see what they have, get in touch with them to get their catalog.  Really good bargains.  And they even have DOG toys.  Go figure.

Just dropped 80+ and we wish we had gone to Denny's. The mango cake was the only acceptable offering. Service was clueless and all but the cake poorly prepared and swimming in grease. If you see this place run far, far away!!!

Nice atmosphere w/patio.  South Meridian needs more establishments like The Curb.  Kinda like the last outpost on the way to Kuna.  Pleasant staff and spacious environment. Good draft beer selection.  The price point could be better, but all and all a very nice establishment.

The quality of the fried selections left a lot to be desired. There weren't a lot of fish options considering it was a fish place. There was too much bread and not enough meat! The tacos were delicious, although the tortilla fell apart before they got to the table... I ate them with a fork. The service was nice, the waitress made honest recommendations and she was very prompt. She however cannot compensate for the quality of food.

While trying 2 other locations I came across Glamour Nails. They are fantastic!  Cleaned up mistakes from 2 other salons and I will never go anywhere else. Their team is fantastic and always prompt and such a fun and clean environment.

I didn't even want to give RC willey a one star !! My fiancé and I bought a mattress and boxspring from them , we picked it up ourselves , brought it home , slept on it, felt weird, not comfortable at all. We called the next day, the customer service gal was no help , our sales lady , Carlotta told us to give it 2 weeks for our bodies to adjust ... We waited , many sleepless nights and sore backs later we called back, they told us we had to wait the 30 days for our warranty to kick in! What!? After the 30 days we called back , no one was on the same page about fixing our mattress , we got the run around !
Finally after going into the store and complaining , a different salesman was very rude and told us we had to make an appointment through customer service ! 
Why didn't customer service Inform us of this!! We waited a few days , finally got a call from the mattress warranty dept. made an appointment , several days later he came to inspect out the bed , it was completely warped! Don't they inspect these before leaving the factory!? Long story short we did end up getting a " new" mattress after about 7 months of waiting , but it had to be the same price as our original mattress !!! 
We picked one we thought would work , again we had to pick it up ourselves, brought it home and we are still having the same issues!' Waiting for the mattress inspector to come inspect our bed !!!
We literally have to sleep on the floor because our bodies hurt from our necks to our shoulders and back!! 
Between us we weigh 215 pounds !! 
To top it off we received a bill for the cost of pro rating the mattress ... What!? 
We called them immediately after 30 min on hold we got " were sorry , we made a mistake! " 
Still waiting for someone to come out and inspect the mattress !!!
I've come to the conclusion that they must refurbish mattresses , because never in my life have I had any of these issues! 
Don't do business with them!!! 
We wasted our money and time , and killing our bodies in the process!!!

We won't be coming back....
My girlfriend and I went to the Lucky Fins on Eagle Rd. for my birthday, what a disappointment. The coconut calamari was advertised as an entrée but turned out to be an appetizer. The calamari had absolutely no coconut what-so-ever and was rubbery. The drinks are WAY overpriced. We asked for the house wine and paid about twice what a house wine should cost. Also the environment is very noisy so don't expect to be able to carry on a conversation at a normal conversation level.

We've dined at Lucky Fins several times, and twice during the past two weeks.  We've thoroughly enjoyed the food every time!  The prices of the standard dishes on the menu are all very reasonable -- many of the entrees are priced below $15 even for dinner.  The specials offered are priced higher, but the ones we've tried have been worth every penny.  I've tried several types of fish that I'd never heard of previously, and all were beautifully prepared.  My husband is less adventurous, and always gets the fish and chips.  The fish are nice and crispy, and not at all greasy.  The french fries are nice and thin, and perfectly seasoned.  He also loves the clam chowder, but I'm not as big a fan -- just a different taste than I'm used to.  I prefer the wedge salad, which has is topped with bacon, egg, and plenty of additional blue cheese.  I don't usually eat dessert, but since everyone else was having some tonight, I ordered the mango cake.  I ate the whole thing!  It was a light sponge cake with mango creme between the layers, and a pureed mango topping.  Served with raspberry sauce and whipped cream -- so good!

The staff is very attentive and helpful.  We've had great service every visit.  The atmosphere is casual and relaxed.

One negative is that when full, the restaurant is quite noisy!  No carpet, booths, or padded surfaces to absorb the sound.  Not the place to try to have an involved conversation or a quiet romantic dinner.  If that's important to you, be sure to arrive at a non-peak time.

I bought a house full of furniture here two years ago. They made us wait weeks and weeks to deliver our furniture for us... the salesman on the floor, "James" was our best friend while we were shopping and spending our money, but as soon as they got it, we were no longer worth their time. We finally ended up having to actually RENT a Uhaul and pick up our own stuff. Now, 2 short years later, one of our expensive leather couches is peeling and cracking in spots, revealing that they were literally just "painted" over... very low quality piece of crap. Good thing we purchased the 5 year warranty, right? Wrong... they have now made us wait months and months to fix the couch, from August to now, without even the common courtesy of a phone call. The last time I spoke to someone... a very disinterested young woman, I was told the part would be here from CHINA in the middle of November. It's already almost half-way through December. Awful customer service, low quality products, warranties that are pretty much useless... you decide whether this business is worth your time. We will NEVER be back.

UPDATE:
So shortly after this original post, they started the process of repairing our couch, which was under warranty.  When the man was at our house to complete the color match, we pointed out to him that the love seat was beginning to peel exactly as the first one did.  He took photos, and told us that we would be hearing back so that we could get it repaired.  Guess what?  Here it is 3 months later, and no word AT ALL.  I am so sick and tired of this company.  Seriously, DO NOT SHOP HERE.  You are wasting your money, and they will treat you like crap.

We go here almost every Sunday for Hideaway Mac 'n Cheese (sooooo good!). The coffee is pretty good. 

Suggestions for Harry's: 1. Atmosphere is depressing. 2. We have had GREAT servers and lousy servers. They're usually working alone covering the bar and the tables, which is never realistic.
Large selection of home made soup & sandwiches, friendly staff.   This is one of our go to places in the fall and winter!

Love this place! My favorite seafood restaurant best service I've ever had delicious food and manager brought us free sushi they made wrong for someone else. One of me and my husbands favorite place to eat

This place needs to be sued. They discriminate based on ethnicity and colors. We went with our kids and my youngest daughter was not allowed to ride as passenger for Go Car. I was ok initially and try to convince my daughter but she won't calm down. Then when I was watching my 2 other older daughters riding the cars, I saw couple of Go Cars had kids smaller than my youngest one who got rejected. So, I brought this attention to staff, manager and even wrote a email to CEO none of them even said sorry and we will check height from next time. No sorry word in their dictionary. We will never go back to this center again. Worst customer service and very rude and non responsive staff and executive.

When I've been to other bar and grills around, I always find decent food. I don't drink alcohol but I can for sure say this place has the best food out of all these places I've been. Ever. Honestly it has better food than most regular restaurants that I've been to. Today I got the sliders, which was more than enough to eat without fries. I got one of each of the flavors. The cheese burger, the pulled pork and the buffalo chicken. They are all amazing. I can't decide which is my favorite. Thank you The Curb for excellent service and food.

I had to say great job here.  The Staff they have makes me come back. Whether they are collecting baskets outside or calling up more checkers, even late at night because they see a line forming, they are always cheerful and helpful.  The rumor that I buy a lot of Zingers there is true, but they are for my pets-not me.  Uhummm..  Thanks...

Had the Mahi Mahi tacos, they had excellent flavor and were huge. One issue, they were "wet" so much so the plate was covered with water. Message to the cooks, drain your tomatoes better, hell put them on a paper towel to absorb the liquid PRIOR to putting them in the tacos!

Really great experience here for lunch on Saturday. Super helpful staff, good soup (buffalo chicken) and sandwich (Reuben). AND all gluten-free! Thank you so much for having gluten-free bread and making so many soup options for those that have sensitivities! Not exactly in my neighborhood, but worth stopping when I am over that way. I even took home a pint of soup for later meals :)

Went for happy hour. Super disappointing. Waitress asked if we wanted a double on the $4.00 well drink and we said yes. When we got bill the drinks were $9.00 each. Not sure how that math works. Ordered the queso fresco and it was so runny, barely any cheese. Would not recommend this spot for happy hour at all!

Stor-Mor exceeded my expectations in all phases of our transaction.   David Argon in the sales department was professional and knowledgeable regarding options.   Their website is extremely user friendly in setting up your requirements.   The installation crew was professional and considerate of our property and they showed pride in their workmanship.  The date originally promised was met and the communication and follow up from the staff was accurate and timely.  I highly recommend this company as one to consider for any storage shed.
Great, fast service, but the chicken on the California Cobb sandwich was so greasy. Not impressed.

Walker Painting is the BEST! We have had a ton of work done using sub contractors and I have dealt with my share of bad ones!  WALKER was as good as it gets.  Great communication, showed up when then were supposed to, did a fantastic job, and all in the time-line they gave me. I couldn't ask for more.  We LOVE our "new" front door.

In August 2013 I visited Y'Lan and received the worst customer service from a nail tech I have ever had or seen. So bad, in fact, that I'm wrote an email to the managementFROM the salon before our services were even completed. (I never did receive a reply...)

Traveling from out of town, I arrived with several friends for services for a wedding, one of us had called to make the appointments several days prior. 

Upon arrival, we were greeted by a woman who seemed a bit irritated that we did not know the exact services each person wanted. Dry and short, she mediated and arranged the appointments with the friendly blonde girl at the receptionist desk. 

While our arrival was less than friendly, it was the next person whom I saw that ended up giving atrocious service. As my friend and I were choosing polish, the girl at the farthest station (I believe her name is Tosha, no one offered their names) came back to her station and condescendingly said 'excuse me' as she tried to get by to complete the nails of her customer sitting drying. (As if it were our fault that the space was tight). It was then I realized she had come back with a bowl of what looked (and smelled) like guacamole. Eating in front of a client is not my idea if a professional environment, however it was obvious she was stressed so I chalked it up to that. 

Not long after, Tosha came out to the seating area, food in her mouth as she spoke, asking frustratedly 'who's getting the full set'. We smiled, pointed at the bride and I asked "may I come with? She hasn't had acrylics in over a decade and is unsure on how to tell you what she wants". She nodded and we sat down. 

Without asking a single question, she yanks at the brides right hand and starts clipping her natural nails short. On nail 4, she said "what length?" the bride said uncomfortably "we'll...really short and natural. Kind of like the length and shape of what you just cut off. I just had a few that broke and wanted them all the same for the wedding". Tosha replied curtly, "well, I kinda HAVE to cut them". 

Over the next 15 minutes, Tosha's demeanor was annoyed, rude, condescending and combative. At one point, the bride asked if an uneven nail could be thinned and put that hand down for the repair when Tosha said 'NO, the other hand!' The bride repeated herself, asking for the adjustment and Tosha grabbed the opposite hand and said "I'm not done!" 

Finally, I calmly said to Tosha "are you okay?" Without looking at me she snapped "yeah." I countered and said "were getting a very unfriendly, combative and condescending feeling from you." I didn't expect her to change much, as its clear she hates people. She made a few comments along the lines of her knowing what she's doing and her client not knowing... I finally said "ok, I'm going to need you to be a little friendlier in the way you communicate with us and physically handle my friend. I would think you could have a bit more patience with a client who hasn't had a set of acrylics in over a decade." The rest of the interaction was rushed and silent. 

I quietly asked the friendly gal at the front desk (Emma?) if there was a manager I could speak to. After telling me there was not anyone until Tuesday, she offered to take my name and number and relay it. She asked if there was anything she could do, offered a reason for the wait (something about another bridal party arriving late earlier in the day). I never did receive a call from anyone.

To clarify, my complaint and horrible experience were not because we had to wait or the time of each service nor the quality. It was the awful way Tosha treated us, verbally and physically. She clearly does not like people, which makes working in the beauty service industry disastrous to Y'Lans business. 

Upon my next visit to Idaho, I will not be returning. Nor will the 5 other local women I came with. We will find a salon that can give us the service and experience deserved. Especially for a special event, like a wedding.  It's too bad, I'm sure there are lovely nail techs and hair stylists that work here. 

Do not give this place your time or money.

We've been to this location too many times at this point. We always swear we won't return because the wait times are ridiculous and it's about a 50/50 chance that they get your order right or you'll recieve only part of your order. Basically, the service is terrible. The shakes and peanut fudge parfait keep us coming back. If you're craving some ice cream and really enjoy the long wait, this is the place for you! (Plan for about 10 minutes per car in line). Management, pull your staff together and make some changes. You've got enough reviews on here mentioning this issue that at this point it needs to be a priority of yours.
Edit** (added 1 star) fast response from owner. Wait times are due to hand-spun shakes. This is something I have no understanding of, so I'm just going to roll with it. We'll be back!

So delicious. I had el puerco and the doc. Both hot and not dry. Good amount of fillings and the crust reminded me of funnel cake but was really good with the savory filling and the sweet. From out of town but which I had one close to where I am from.

Thank you to The Curb staff for the excellent service and fabulous food! You went out of your way to make our celebration of life an absolute wonderful and memorial day!  Megan, Alex and Amanda made sure everything was covered and everyone was happy. Our glasses were full and your staff made it happen. Rob and Rob Sr.  You all make it look so easy.... And we know it is a lot of work.   THANK YOU SO VERY MUCH!  You made our day special. Peace and love
I love Steve's Cafe! It's my family's new favorite place and I plan on letting all of my friends know as well! I've been in at least once a week since opening and I can't get enough! love it!!(:

We had our carpets cleaned by Stanley Steemer on 9/1/18. The guy was here for no more than 45 minutes to clean 4 rooms. He sprayed, but did not rake and when the carpets dried, they left big patches of dark marks around the living room, hallway and master bedroom. My husband rented a rug doctor this morning to re-clean the effected areas. The water coming out of the bin is dark black and I have the video which I am happy to share with the Manager. I am not sure what this guy cleaned, but it wasn't our carpets. I have called the Meridian office to return my call on Tuesday 9/4 after the holiday weekend to get this sorted out. I am happy to update this review if this situation is made right.

UPDATE: 4-10-19
Okay, now I have been here five or six times and every single time it's been a great experience. Whether coming through the drive-through or dining in my experiences have been great.
Staff working here are friendly and knowledgeable and super helpful. Place is immaculate and there's more meat on the Gyros than I can describe. The place is great!


I have come here 2 times and enjoyed the food both times. I got a basic Original Gyro. Really good. Best I've had in years. 
80/20 Beef to lamb ratio. Great seasoning and sauce. Big portion. Priced rI will start trying the others now each week.
First experience with Budget Blinds was awesome. Very friendly. Very helpful. Very knowledgeable. I look forward to seeing my new blinds.

Big fans of Zen Bento & Yokozuna, my husband and I were hesitant to try this out because we had such high expectations. But boy, are we sure glad we did!  

Food: Super simple offerings to include chicken, beef and tofu bowls & salads. I like the half & half beef and chicken bowl. I love that they weigh their protein as they add it to your bowl to ensure you get what you pay for. The bowl with the 5oz portion is perfect for me! 

Drinks: soft drink choices. 

Atmosphere: clean and bright. Pretty limited seating, but not too busy in the off times. 

Service: EXCEPTIONAL. The dude behind the counter was helpful and friendly. He made us feel welcome and explained the choices. Impressed. 

Happy Hour Offerings: n/a

Healthy Hack: order cabbage salad & veggies instead of rice for a less carb/calorie bowl. 

Tips: make it your own. The options are limited but they're flexible! I'd love to see a peanut and/or thai sauce added to the sauce list.

This Pizza Hut is the worst. They mess up my order every time. If I decide to dine in, it takes forever for anyone to come to seat you, or take your order. I've never had this problem with a Pizza Hut before. When you do complain, they try to pin it all on you. The manager has asked us not to come back.

Always enjoy this place when I visit Boise.  Great atmosphere and service.  Have tried the seafood enchiladas, tacos, salmon and a variety of sushi (the spicy stuff is awesome). I would recommend starting with their thai ginger or habanero edamame.  Parking is limited on the weekend.

Best seafood lunch I've had in a long time.  I had the Mediterranean Mahi Mahi.  It was absolutely delicious.  Flavorful and cooked to perfection.  The service was exceptional.  Looking forward to this restaurant opening in Boise.

Had a fantastic experience here.  The food was great and they had some great beers on tap.  They make their bread fresh on-site each day and have a cool spot you can sit right up by the cooks.  The Co-owner came out and talked with us and even sat down and stayed a bit.  Very good service, nice atmosphere too.  I ate the Steelhead burger and fries and it was awesome.  They said the Steelhead is flown in fresh each day and they grind and spice the meat for the burger fresh as well.  Was really great. They have a creative and unique menu here  and is great option for Meridian.

Surprised but the flavor and great pricing! My ultimate gyro was packed with meat and flavors! Kids loved the pita melt as well. Even tried and breakfast gyro (served all day) and so yummy plus great service!

Dr. Mandi Anderson is awesome. I have been to a couple of chiropractors in the past,  they have never really solved my pain issues. A friend recommended Back 2 Health and Dr. Anderson, she is very professional, but takes the time to explain the process of how she plans to help you. Her treatments are straight forward and effective, no massage or drop tables, just hands on adjustments.

So much fun!!! Felt like a kid again but with grown ups haha we played a game of mini golf and ate Dippin dots ice cream which we don't have in Washington or that I've seen. It was very affordable and a wonderful time. The park also has water bumper cars and other family fun choices.  The place is clean, well maintained and it wasn't crowded for a Sunday. Loved it.

Hi Steve, I just now went back to see my review here on yelp on your restaurant. Sorry I didn't get back to you sooner. My wife and I have moved to Calif. If I would have checked sooner, I would have got in touch with you for sure. A friend of mine who eats there from time to time actually told me that the food is a hit and miss when it comes to how hot the food is when it gets to the customer. I am just real pickey when it comes to the temp of my food. If I was to compare food temp, quanity, and price, then Express Cafe wins...... Sorry
A group of us went here tonight and had a blast!   Great staff and great prices. Will be back! Highly recommended!

My family didn't appreciate it when my granddaughter was told that she could not be a passenger in the Go-kart ride because she was not quite tall enough.  This happened right after another child that was shorter than my granddaughter was allowed to ride.  We thought for certain we were going to be allowed to ride because the other kid ahead of us was so much shorter.  Probably 3 inches shorter.  
After we saw another kid be allowed to ride after we were not,  I spoke to a supervisor,  Alexis.  He told me that the ride attendants were trained to measure the children and he would speak to the team. Ha!  Even after speaking to the supervisor we saw another smaller child ride the karts.  The attendant did not measure the child at all.  When they got off the ride I walked past them with my granddaughter so I could see better.  She was a lot shorter than my granddaughter.  We were discriminated against!  I'm not happy about that!

My family and I had breakfast here and loved it. I had French Toast and he had the special; a chimi chury pork chop and hash browns. It was all wonderful. The hash browns were perfect which is a hard thing to find.
Storie Hall is best for swedish or deep tissue massage.   Professional and thorough.  Can't wait for my next massage.

Drive thru experience was great!  This is not your normal fast food.  Food is cooked to order made just the way you want it.  The extra wait is well worth the taste of a fresh gourmet burger or a hand spun shake!  The staff was very friendly, polite and happy to help.  A refreshing experience compared to normal fast food places!  This will be a go to location for a quick dinner or lunch and a short bike ride for a great shake on the weekends!  Well Done! 5++ stars!
Absolutely delivers!  Clean, friendly staff affordable diverse choices, vegetarian empanadas, food was taste, hot and definitely coming here again.

My husband and I were super excited to try this place out. We went once a couple days ago, and we both ordered medium milkshakes. While I can say the shakes were good, We waited in the drive through for almost 20 minutes waiting for our them! it was super irritating but figured you know maybe it was a one time thing. We went again tonight and we waited nearly 35 minutes this time! Not only that they got both of our orders wrong, and served my husband from a cup that had been punctured on the bottom! The staff wasn't very friendly either didn't let us know why it was taking so long or anything! As good as the food itself is, the service alone is enough to keep us from going there again!

Stopped in after tacos at Calle 75 - my GF had some frozen yogurt and I had a freshly baked chocolate chip pizookie. Yes, you no longer need to go to a BJ's to get your pizookie fix. Hell, I only paid $6.95 for the one I had and we were not able to finish it. They also only have one size for their frozen yogurt and my GF didn't finish hers. This was officially the last place we dined at before leaving town.

Another of the many who have gone here for years in Citrus Heights, CA.  The sandwiches are still sublime.  This location is still reeling from the see-saw of people who pack it and then leave. (have you ever tried to staff for this type of fluctuation in volume?)  So I'm giving them a pass on how long it takes to get a sandwich made, and the flow will balance out over time.  The only complaint is that prices are on the high side which is what I believe killed Gandolfo's.  The food is excellent and I will continue to go.  The staff will improve.  The prices, sadly, may not.

I have to clear Steve's Cafe's name! My husband and I went there for Mother's Day. My hubby is always on the quest for the best biscuits and gravy, and it was delicious. This is his new favorite place to get breakfast. I've had both the pancakes and the french toast, both very good. We came with a two year old, and they are the only geniuses who put paper down under the high chair so that the moms don't have to pick food off on the ground or leave it entirely. Don't know why everyone doesn't do it! Anyway- great food. I hope they get more reviews.

Service was fast and friendly. Honestly thought the food wasn't good at all. Meatball sandwhich was burnt an dry. Potato soup was very watery. Tomato basil soup wasn't very good. The mediteranian sandwhich was basically a Blimpie sandwhich. For the price I felt the food lacked quality.

I'm surprised there wasn't already a listing for this park, which has been around for over a year now, and I'm ashamed I didn't think to mention it before. 

The summer splash pad has been somewhat of a mixed bag. When they first opened, the paint was too slippery when wet so they had to refinish it. Now it's less slippery, but a little too rough relative to similar splash pads. And yes, it's nothing compared to the splash pad at Settler's Park, but Julius M. Kleiner has a lot of other amenities to offer.

There's a playground with swings and slides to suit all ages, as well as covered picnic areas. It's a lot easier to find a shady spot here in the summer. What little shade there is at Settler's is almost always reserved. Like Settlers, it has a fishing pond but it's larger with nice sitting areas just for relaxing. There's also an amphitheater.

The real treat that makes this park unique is the hills. Children like to roll down in the warmer months and sled those rare times we get enough snow. 

I feel very fortunate to have such a great park nearby.

Got two of their frozen soups to eat at home- the three cheese broccoli and the roasted tomato basil. Not only are they super over priced, the soup is tasteless. $25 for two things of soup? This place was super disappointing...
Update: this place gave me violent food poisoning! All I ate the entire day was this soup and I ended up sick all night.

Better than Subway.  Heard this place would knock my socks off so I had high expectations. Got the triple dip. $9.95 for a 6 inch.  Decent quality meat, but somewhat bland which surprised me. Not a terribly creative menu. Might get lost in the shuffle of all the eateries on Eagle rd.  I will probably be back, but not very much.

Brandon Curtiss is part of the 3% and pacific Patriot Network. These groups, lead by Brandon Curtiss has invaded my hometown and wreaked havoc. We have repeatedly asked him and his followers to leave but they refuse. As someone on the business of selling homes, he's done a great job of destroying mine.

I grew up with Chick-Fil-A and have missed it for the years I've lived in Idaho.  So glad they're here!   Now I don't have to scope it out every time I travel.

Hubby and I went today (they've been open for 4 days) at breakfast time.   I had a breakfast meal and he ordered a lunch meal.   It took a while because they had to make his meal special -- they do serve lunch items at breakfast time, but they don't have them teed up and ready.  No problem there.   I'm not much of a breakfast person myself, so this is cool.

The only hiccup we had was hubby's deluxe sandwich.  He wanted the lettuce & tomato, but not the pickles and cheese.   They got the pickles right, but it did include cheese.

The restaurant was very clean and every staff member we encountered was very friendly.   They offered us drink refills more than once (yeay!).   I'm sure we'll be regulars.

Rosaeurs is a chain of standard products grocery stores (think Albertsons-ish).  Nestled inside some of them are outposts of the Spokane Washington based natural foods market chain of Huckleberry's.. This Meridian located Rosaeur's hosts a Huckleberry's.  And if you look for Huckleberry's listing via Google or otherwise, you'll be directed to Rosaeur's.  So that seemed the right place to post this review too. 
 
Huckleberry's carries organic and natural foods brands in supplements, household items, frozen foods, bulk bin items and dairy.  My hubby and I eat very few processed foods, that is things that come out of a can or box or package of any kind, but when we do (think San Marzano tomatoes or Greek yogurt) we look for the kinds of  brands that Huckleberry's sells.  

While we do most of our shopping at the Boise or Meridian Co-Op, there are also things that we go specifically to Huckleberry's for as they seem the only source in the Treasure Valley.  Examples:  1) Double Rainbow real frozen custards and also fruit ices - both released this summer as part of Double Rainbow's 40th anniversary celebration and I am in disbelief at the passage of time given I also enjoyed Double Rainbow during its' inaugural year.   2) Stahlbush frozen and sustainably raised  boysenberries and marionberries.

There are also some surprises at Huckleberry's for items you might not expect to find in a natural foods market and which can make lovely gifts, like Archipelago candles infused with essential oils.  I have purchased these through Nordstrom in times past and was surprised to find them also on Huckleberry's shelves.

Like Rosaeur's overall, Huckleberry's is light and bright with ample aisle space and well stocked shelves.

As for Rosaeur's in overall, given how seldom I purchase a standard grocery store item, I'll offer as unqualified observation that Rosaeur's seems maybe a skoosh more spendy in general.  Perhaps price is a contributing factor to the few shoppers inside Rosauer's no matter what time of day or day of week we have visited.  That lack of shoppers is something we like, but I imagine it is tough on the bottom line of the store.  Use it or lose it would be my advice to shoppers who want to keep it. 

They have a huge deli here and while I can't speak to the quality of the food contained in it, all the cases are always sparkling clean and the food looks fresh.  Ditto for the meat and fish case at the back of the store.  (I don't shop those products here, but it is right across from the wine section...hence me spying it. "Hic..." :-)  )

It may be indicative of the shopperdemographic for Rosaeur's but the produce section is pretty limited for a store of this size.  The good news is the breadth and quality of organic produce seems to have stepped up in the last couple of years.  But clearly, they don't sell a lot of it.

Friendly people work here too...although here's a hoot of a story.  Whether Rosaeur's or Huckleberry's products, one checks out via the Rosauer's checkers.
