And on our fist visit in, about 3 years ago when new to the area, the nice young checker observed based on the items in our basket that we would probably want to know about Boise's Whole Foods which was, said he, "A really GOOD place to shop."  Ta dum.  No. Seriously.  A true story.

THIS N THAT:

1) PARKING:  Private lot which seems to always have ample open spaces, unlike a lot of other grocery stores in town.

2) ACCESSIBILITY:  Accessible (aka ADA) parking in the lot right at the entrance, level in and throughout the store, ample aisle space.

After a horrible experience with a midwife during my last pregnancy I was forced to be induced and had Dr. Pittard deliver my son. He was amazing! I have seen a few other doctors from this office and every one of them had been awesome as well!

How can they be picky about not substituting menu items but not picky about following my order.

Eggs over medium.  Simple right? Nope runny.

Cinnamon roll...a day old.  Also, add some cinnamon too it. 

Sausage sampler.  Barely warm. Sent them back. 

Pancakes were good.  Fruit? Not ripe.

Also, men's restroom has a sign that says if you pee on the seat wipe it off...no! How bout you clean your restroom.

It was okay. My wife thought it was good, but, mostly because we only paid half price for one of the burgers. I have to agree with a couple other 3 stars or less reviews. The 4 & 5 star reviews are crazy (imo). The burger was a tad bit salty and the fries were greasy. They dress their hamburger buns with a lot of butter and I'm not a fan of that either (It's really brushed on heavily). Overall, it was a better burger than Carl's or McDonald's, but those are big fast food joints. $7 does not include a drink or fries. For price comparison, 5 guys burgers lack flavor and seem to always be messy, but, I would actually prefer 5 guys over Smash and that's truly not saying much. If you want a good burger with no GMOs try Wingers. Yup, Wingers makes a better burger than even Red Robin. If you like spending $7 for a burger and the other fast food places don't do it for you then, maybe go to Smash. At least they cook it fresh and not by microwave. I'm not sure a coupon would be worth a trip back.

Finally, a place with great food. The stuffed french toast was really good. The sausage sampler was excellent and the bacon melts in your mouth. Steve's is a great addition to Meridian. Steve and his family were over several times to check on us.

This was the single worst restaurant experience of my life. I feel obligated to write this review, only to save anyone else from being treated the same way. We arrived with a party of 7 on a busy holiday. They were vastly unprepared for the rush that hit them. The hostess told us there would be a short wait to get sat, which we gladly waited as other similar restaurants in the area had much longer waits. When we sat down shortly thereafter the mayhem began. They were short on menus, so we had to share 4 between us, but no big deal. We then waited nearly 20 minutes to get waters for the table. For some reason, the waitress only brought 3 waters the first round, we then had to ask for more water for the entire table. She brought 3 more waters, still 1 short of what we needed. Still, not a big deal, but we were beginning to question the situation. As we waited nearly 20 more minutes to put our order in, we watched 3 other tables get up and leave because they weren't being served. Then, the server came up to take our order, but warned that it was going to be a "pretty long wait" for the food to come out. We had already been there for 40 minutes, not sure why she waited that long to warn us that the kitchen was backed up. We put our order in and hoped for the best. Our server would intermittently apologize for the wait, and we felt for her. She was out of sorts but she was trying. We then waited over 90 minutes for our food to come out (yes, I said 90!!!!). Unfortunately, some of the food came out wrong. We sent this plate back, only for it to come out wrong again 10 minutes later, with many of the ingredients on the menu missing. At that point, we didn't care and just accepted our food and ate it. Not surprisingly, the food was mediocre. Considering all that had happened up to this point, we were expecting them to comp the meal or at least offer something for the bad experience. To our surprise, the waitress then asked how we wanted to split the checks. I responded that we wanted to speak with the manager. The owner came over a few moments later and asked what was wrong. I told him that this was the worst experience we've ever had, that we had been there for nearly 2 and a half hours total, the food was wrong, and that we did not feel comfortable paying for this meal. He responded with, "Wow." That was it! No apology, nothing! We were totally shocked and this was where we drew the line. I told him we refused to pay and he said, "ok, fine." We left a small tip for our sever and then prepared to leave. In the weirdest turn of events throughout the experience, as we begun to  walk out, the rest of the staff began to shout things out at us. The bartender yelled, "I can't believe you guys think you can come in here and eat and drink and not pay for it." Another server yelled, "your server is going to have to pay for your $130 tab, I can't believe you would do that to her." Lastly, the owner chimes in and shouted, "don't come back!" I've never been treated worse in a restaurant and my entire group agreed. If I could give a zero star review I would.
Food is great and have a selection for everybody including American/Italian choices. Really glad we found this place.

Their Chai is amazing! There's two types of chai they provide and I got one that had "train" in the name. Ask the baristas and they'll know! (Sorry I forget the name) I'm the type that typically gets the same kind of coffee over and over again because I'm just not a big fan of other flavors. However, one of the baristas recommended trying the chai latte and I was SWEPT off my feet! Delicious and the ONLY place I like my Chai!!

One of the baristas whipped me up a coffee when I didn't realize they had already closed. He was nice enough to make my cup of joe anyway. Super nice of him! 

Decor is awesome and modern. Menu seems very small but ask the Baristas what you like and they make it all for you and even recommend you something new to try!

This was my first time eating at Smashburger (I met my wife there for lunch). The burger was pretty tasty, but the French fries were way too greasy.  When the manager came by and asked how the food was I told him the burger was good and pointed out the greasy fries.  The little 5 oz tray had literally a tablespoon of oil at the bottom as I let them drain in order to eat the ones that weren't too greasy.  He indicated that they were way too greasy, but that was about it.   not sure if I'll make the trip to go back there again.  I added a picture on my profile to show the amount of oil at the bottom of the tray

This would be a 4 start maybe even five if it weren't for the check out system they have. The check out clerks seem to always need to get the managers assistance. 
That being said, they have a great selection of furniture and electronics, and I live their lay away plans.  I enjoy the environment because they set up
So many bedroom sets to look at and it opens the door to so many great ideas.
The worst cleaners ever! We're done in less than 20 minutes. They got the carpet wet and that's the extent it was cleaned. People very pleasant and customer service great.
The Meridian restaurant is excellent.  Great customer service and the food is delicious.  Family run and a family atmosphere.

Cold day, and thought a bowl of soup, and a sandwich would hit the spot. Had drove by Soup Kettle Grille many times, and decided to stop in.
was greeted right away (very friendly, thinking she was an owner). Like so many places now it is walk up ordering. I perused the menu, and decided on a Gouda grilled cheese sandwich, and the tomato basil soup.
My order was taken, and I was told they would bring my order out when ready. 
The place is small, and again like so many places , almost cafeteria style seating. Comfortable though. 
After maybe 5 minutes, my order was brought to my table. The grilled cheese looked really good. The Gouda cheese oozing out of the sides of the bread. It also had caramelized onions, and red bell peppers in it. It was really good.
The soup...meh... The first thing I didn't care for was the consistency. I was coarsely blended, almost had a Gazpacho feel to it....small chunks of tomato. It wasn't really flavorful. 
To be fair...they did offer me free samples to try before ordering. I might have opted for the creamy tomato soup instead.
So, I will give this place another shot. The prices were fair, and they had lots of soup options. Stay tuned.

I like the beds here but the customer service does not match the price you pay. I would expect much friendlier staff for the price. It's like eating a fancy $100 dinner but you are seated at a McDonalds restaurant with McDonald's waitstaff if that makes sense.
We eat here twice a week and have had almost everything on the menu. Service is great and the prices are wonderful. Locally owned which is a plus. Love this place
Mark, a "customer service expert" as they answer the phone, will be the primary reason we never ever order from this location again. Absolutely unprofessional and rude.

This review is just on the pins aspect of Wahooz as all we did was bowling. I know these kind of places are geared more towards families and kids and not for the serious ballers but these were the worst lane conditions I have ever experienced in the 30 years I have been bowling. My first ball I literly fell on my face as I went to release the ball and slide a bit my shoes just stuck. This has never ever ever happened to me, and it's not like I run up to the foul line. The end the 2 kids next to use literally slamming there balls in to the lane on every throw and not having any bowling eddicete and the fact they have one of the ball helper things for small kids on every line that I kept kicking on every pass I was just over the while situation and can think of any other place in boise i would rather go bowling then this place. All there needs to be is a little monitoring of the lanes just to make sure all people are having a good time a being curtiouse of others hopefully they get this fixed..
Best value in Idaho. Great staff and even better food. Try the new butter poached crab, mango tango roll and key lime for dessert.

I made an appointment for 3 pedicures and 1 gel manicure. When we walked in all but one pedicure chair was full and they were 1/4 of the way done on all the customers. They made the excuse that we were 5 minutes early. Not sure how they were going to finish their clients in 5 minutes. After waiting for 15 minutes we walked out. Will never go there again. If you make an appointment and you are either on time or early, they should be ready for you.

I discovered Lush when a friend gifted me with a bath bomb for my birthday last fall. Since then, I found their location at the Village and am there at least monthly - if not more.

First off, I adore this company as a whole. I'm a fan of anyone who focuses on lessening their footprint, hand-makes products, and fights animal testing! They're extremely innovative and continually seek ways to be better.

This Lush location is a prime example of what the company works to represent. Each time I've been in, the staff is friendly, knowledgeable and helpful. There is a large selection of products and the bath bombs are beautifully displayed. Plus, they always send me with the latest catalog and a sample of a new product. 

I also love that Lush focuses on naked packaging! Their shampoo bars are a prime example of that. 

If you're into health care / beauty products at all, do yourself a favor and checkout Lush! You'll definitely find something perfect for your needs.

I took my family to Steves Café. Most of the food was average. 
 The stars of the meal was the taco omelet and the chicken fried steak. The omelet was folded nicely with the ingredients inside and not mixed in the eggs like a scramble how most place's do now days. It was a good size with good flavor.  The chicken fried steak had a nice meat to breading ratio and was not over cooked. The country gravy was good but not great and the eggs were a  properly cooked over easy. 
  As far as the what fell short as for the meal.  Hash browns or lack there of were subpar at best. They had this strange orange look to them, (must be the oil or whatever the cook them in). They also reminded me of Dennys hashbrowns, in that they were only cooked on one side. Is it really that hard or time consuming to cook them on both sides? They were also thinner than my pancakes.
  And lastly why would an owner of a restaurant argue with one of his guests over a $1.95 glass of milk? My daughter did not like her milk she ordered,  so I tasted it and I agreeded that it was not that good.  So we sent it back, and when we got up to pay my wife said something about it on our bill. One of his employees when and got the owner and then he tasted the milk and said it was fine. So inturn he preceded to argue with my wife about it.  So my question to Steve is was charging for that glass of milk worth lossing a custom for life and worth it be talked about on Yelp and being talked to other people? 

Anyways thats my 2 cents take it or leave it.

Decided to try the new place instead of my regular sandwich shop (that's in the same parking lot). Had the roast beef 6" and found that it was really expensive compared to my normal stop at $7.25. 

Meat was decent but it had the same amount of it as Firehouse, but for over a $1.25 more?  For that price I could almost get a full 12" and a 1/2 pound across the parking lot. 

That said, besides not being a good value, the food was good, service was fine. I may be back, but there is just better values elsewhere.

My husband and I searched far and wide for a reasonably priced, quality mattress. In all of Boise and Meridian, Mattress Land had the best prices and employees. 

We came in on a Saturday and were helped by Casey. He was friendly, attentive, and knew all there was to know about mattresses. We left that day with a mattress, 10 year warranty, and two free pillows with a free mattress cover. They also will take your old mattress and charge a mere $10 for moving and cleaning to prepare it for donation.

We purchased our mattress and waited for our free delivery. It did take about 10 days to arrive, so keep that in mind. The delivery team was friendly and quickly moved our old mattress out, and the new one in. 

Once the delivery guys had left, I noticed my brand new mattress cover had a hole in it! All I had to do was call the store, and they notified their warehouse I'd be on my way to pick up a new one. The warehouse was super close to me, and the guys working there had my new cover ready for me in less than 5 minutes. 

I'm glad we chose to get our mattress here, and we are both totally loving getting a much better night's rest!

Sam and his team were absolutely wonderful to work with.  Our refinance was painless, so easy and done almost entirely from the comfort of our own home via the computer.  We've bought two homes and sold one prior to this refinance so I was pretty familiar with how stressful and time consuming this sort of thing is.  Not with Sam and everyone at Evergreen Home Loans!  All of my questions were answered promptly and my emails and calls were returned right away.  I felt valued and that our best interests were the priority.  Thank you for a smooth and stress free refinancing experience.  I've already recommended you to several friends and will continue to do so!

Brighton Collectibles is a chic little shop nestled in the heart of the always happening, Village at Meridian.

I was on the hunt for a gift and had looked a couple other places in The Village and hadn't stumbled upon anything that was just quite right, when I wandered (for the first time) into Brighton. Filled with handbags, jewelry, and accessories--Brighton has a good mix of the chic and the quirky. 

I loved the colorful variety of handbags and wallets. They have something to suit every personality and taste. Their jewelry selection is equally varied and fabulous. It's a small shop (for The Village), but they've packed plenty into the space. I felt like I could have wandered hours! And, thankfully, I found a wallet that uniquely suited my gift giving needs!

The service is lovely and they offer complimentary gift wrap on any purchase. The proprietor was utterly friendly and completely helpful. Plus? She offered me a fresh baked cookie when I arrived! Amazing!

Get to it!

Service remains consistent and good. Food quality is also consistent. I got the crunch wrap supreme. I love this food item. This is the first time it wasn't "sealed" all the way so was kind of messy to eat. Great go to place for lunch. Free wifi.

I used to go to the shack on Fairview, but this one is closer.  I may start driving the extra distance. The gyros here are smaller and the pitas have been dry and tough.  Last time I was there the said they weren't hooked up to rewards yet so they took my phone number. Today, they said they weren't doing the rewards program. Too bad. Would have been nice to have one so close.

today went to an unnamed deli in meridian and had a very good sandwich and an inedible bowl of chicken noodle soup.  reminded me that soup kettle is the only place in ada county to get soup.  have tried many soups there and some are better than others but all are very, very good and definitely not from a can.

keep up the good work.  now on to try the chili!
This is a very nice sports bar with a decent menu and good drinks. I've stopped for dinner and also just for a couple drinks after work and have always been impressed.

GREAT FOOD

Miss Tami introduced herself to us, explained how things worked at the restaurant/tea house. The staff was very friendly and bubbling with estrogen.

VERY GIRLY! It is a great place to have a girls day or daddy daughter lunch, or whatever. They have a cute shop in the front with tea's and little gifts.

We went to the Saturday brunch. The food was great, everything had a little twist on it. The biscuits and gravy had dill in them. The oatmeal had craisns and peach. Everything is homemade and you can tell.

They have a coffee bar which serves pretty much anything you want a lots of fun things you have never heard of before. The tea shop in the front has a lot of selection. And they have homemade truffles!!!

My husband and I went to for breakfast on Valentine's day.  I know it would be busy, but after we waited for quite sometime and then saw them setting  other people that came in after us, I went up and asked about it.  Ya we missed you so then they seated us at a table right by the kitchen.  I was so upset.  I don't think they cared at all.  I will not be back! Sad!

Habanero Wings with Ranch are spicy hot and sweet and as good as you'll find in the valley.  My wife who generally doesn't like hot things, loves these I think because the Mango cuts the hot sensation along with the Ranch dressing. 

We always order 40 because we know we'll be craving more and more, so that $25 order goes for about 6 meals for us.  That's not too bad a value either.

The Dominos on Cherry Lane always has courteous delivery people who always present themselves and the food as hygienic making you feel better about the food preparation process and who's cooking.

Enjoyed our second visit to Lucky Fins with extended family.  We had a variety of items from a burger to the all you can eat crab.  The entrees were fantastic, everyone was satisfied with their order.  
We had calamari and oysters for appetizers.  The calamari was really good with the key lime aioli, oysters were ok, a little large for my liking (and asked about size prior to...confirmed they were smaller).
The all you can eat crab was seasoned well and while a bit over cooked/steamed, it was worth the work.  My wife had the southwest poke bowl which was gone by the time I looked over at it, well done on that!
Desserts were really great, especially the pumpkin cheesecake and mango cake, tasty!
Good service from Chase, will of course be back!

We had our company party here at the Pinz Z Lounge.  The staff and whole experience was incredible!  Meg and Carolyn followed up often to ensure the details were in order.  The had great wait staff to help, put on Cosmic bowling for us,good pizza, etc.  place is very clean and was a fun place to say "thank you to our staff!" We had a staff of 50 there and everyone had a good time.  -Owner of Wingers Grill and Bar and Dickeys Barbecue

This was a new restaurant we tried last night. We loved the interior decor. Very fresh, new and clean. Trying new foods is something we wanted to do this new year... so we tried the oysters... the flavor was good but I think it was a texture thing. Not for me. I had the chipotle salmon. It was delicious, by to spicy but had a great flavor- I literally cleaned my plate. I would absolutely go back and recommend this to family and friends!

I was finally able to get to the Soup Kettle Grille on Wednesday, and very happily so. 

One, I love soup! 
Two, the staff was friendly and welcoming
Three, they use quality ingredients
Four, the food is made there
Five, it was delicious!
Six, the portions were generous (my half-sandwich was the largest one I've seen, with a generous portion of turkey)
Seven, great value!
Eight, so many soups! And, they let you sample them!

We'll be going back today for lunch!

The best pharmacy Ive ever seen!  Helpful, nice and very interested in making sure customer/patient has all the tools and info they need. They really go the extra mile.

The store itself is also very nice. Clean, fresh items and helpful staff!
Not the cheapest like Walmart- but also a much nicer experience!!  Watch their sales. They have great ones!

Buyer Beware. I purchased PT and then ended up not being able to use it. I paid 3 months at $280 a month. I requested to cancel my membership. They canceled my membership, but won't even offer to refund 1 month of PT. Be careful of the Manager Danne, he goes on and on about politics. The PT Manager will also inject himself into every conversation when you go to sign up.  It's worse than buying a used car. Just keep driving and don't stop. There are too many other gyms in the area.  Go anywhere but there.

Wish we had one in Boise...this place was jam- packed on a Tuesday night. The employees did a superb job of getting the lines of people down rather quickly. 
We had a large group and decided on the Party Box...12 cookies (you pick the variety) for $25. We did have plenty left. The banker in me determined it was the best value at $2.xx/cookie. That particular week they had coconut lime, salted caramel cheesecake, Reese's chip, and we opted for the chilled sugar as well. The cookies were good...some way too sweet though. Very greasy, I assume from all the butter. Our family's favorites were: the Reese's chip(not very sweet and had nice balance of chocolate to PB), chilled sugar (it was pink frosting! Woohoo!!!), and salted cheesecake(not too sweet and the tartness of the cheesecake shined thru).
The coconut lime was so sweet all you tasted was sickeningly sweet sugar and that was it! Despite the adorable lime slice adorning the tops of each cookie. Maybe we should have squeezed the juice on the cookie :)
I appreciated how the young man making up the batter was using a scale to weigh the ingredients (best way for accuracy and uniformity) and it was fun to watch him do so; and then marvel at those commercial mixers whirring away nonstop. 
It was nice to also be automatically enrolled in their rewards program when paying with my CC and having my receipt texted to me. 
I like that they have rotating flavors each week. This fact will probably keep me coming back down nasty Eagle Rd to try ones that tempt my palate. 
I don't like that they are in Meridian (off the despised Eagle Rd!) and so of course, don't deliver. And that the cookies are quite pricey for the size you get. Also, closed on Sundays--not good for me.
But overall, it is worth checking them out.

The Mrs. And I eat here quite frequently. Last time I was here I ordered the baked lobster Mac and cheese and it was perfect. In my opinion this is the best seafood joint in town. I'm always excited to see what the daily special is and have had the chance to eat a number of different types of fish.

It was pretty good but they best Gyro places I've been to toast the pita or warm it up, mine was cold and I thought more stuff in the pita would be better but (buzzzz) I was wrong.  Less is more, quality over quantity.

My friends and I love Crumbl!!! We love seeing what flavors are going to come out and there is always something for everybody! We cannot wait until the ice cream is available at this location, we're absolutely in love with Crumbl. Our favorite flavors are Oreo, Muddy Buddy, Lemon Glaze, Biscoff, and Cinnamon! The staff is always super sweet and helpful, 10/10 would recommend!

Great seafood! I had the salmon, which was recommended by our server, and it was delicious! It's a definitely a diamond in the rough. Ashley was very attentive and friendly! We will definitely be going back!
I really enjoyed the seared shi and scallops. I would have liked it with less sauce but it was delicious.

This is the best Mexican restaurant I have been in the Boise area.

Most of their reviews are due to poor service this was not our experience.

Food was delicious service was good.

I went in to the Cycle Bar to see about classes & get some water on a hot day.  The guy that helped me I believe Joshua?  was amazing & super sweet in providing information & getting me some water.  Can't wait to try the class! Thank you for the good vibes in your business.

We went on their website to see what time mini golf was open until and they stated 11pm. Got there at 10 after 25 minutes of driving to get there only for them to tell us the whole place is closed at 10 for a private party.

On 4-13-15 around 7:00 pm we stopped in for a sandwich, we ordered a 12 inch hot Pastrami on Honey Whole Wheat, there was not enough Pastrami, so we changed the meat to BBQ Chicken to avoid inconvenience. After a good 15-20 minutes, the sandwich was completed and the counter person seemed annoyed and flustered with our order. We left highly disappointed and will not be back.

If you are not choosing Craig Walker to paint your home, you have just made the biggest homeowner mistake.  I acquired 3 bids to paint the interior of my home.  #1 came, looked around and chatted awhile.  He said he would e/mail me a bid.  No e-mail.  No call back.  #2 bid from a 'large' company.  They came in measured, wrote a bid on the spot and TOLD me what paint I was going to get.  I would get to choose the color.  I'm paying thousands of dollars to have someone dictate how it's spent?  Their budwas too high anyway.  Craig showed up.  Gave me a realistic bid which I accepted.  Showed up on time and, along with his right hand man went to work.  They worked hard, tackled what I would consider a difficult job due to high angled ceilings and other architectural challenges with the skill one would expect from professionals.  They are professionals.  From start to finish an excellent, clean, mistake free job.  Good people too, fun to talk to.  His bid was 16% lower that the other guys.  My wife and I are very much pleased with the job and would rehire without a second thought.  Once again.....if you need your home painted and don't hire Walker Painting, you are making a grave error.

The breakfast was excellent!! My husband and I ordered the smaller portion breakfast and each was cooked to perfection. Additionally, I usually find restaurant coffee stronger than I prefer and somewhat bitter at times, but Steve's had the best coffee I've ever tasted in a restaurant!

We will be returning customers without a doubt
Great service, great product, love this place. My sandwich was fresh and matched my expectations based on all I have heard.

I hired Maija in early 2008 to take some candid and professional photos of me for my website and business.  She was fabulous - put me at ease, was efficient and managed our time impeccably, and the finished product was beautiful.  All at the right price.  I was lucky to find her!

Every time I come here I get the four cookie box.l believe it's $10z. I've tried several flavors and they have all been great. The sugar cookie and snickerdoodle is my favorite. They are bigger than the palm of my hand and always super fresh. Worth every penny. I only wish they delivered to my area :(

Eh. Ok stir-fry quality food on a bed of rice. There's nothing particularly bad about it, but nothing great, either. Neither the ambience nor the service made up for the unremarkable and slightly overpriced fare.

Amazing place.  I was in Nampa because my mother fell ill, then passed away.  The last "date" she had with one of her girl friends was to have monte cristos at Miss Tami's, but the weather took a bad turn, so they didn't go.  I asked her friend to go with me to remember my mom.  We had a lovely lunch.  The Monte Cristo was amazing, and their tea (I had the market spice) was incredible.  I loved the service and the gift shop.  I took my dad, my brother and his wife, and my son on the Saturday after my mom's funeral, because I knew they'd appreciate that it was her kind of place.  We went for the brunch.  The food was unbelievable, as was the price ($12 for a BRUNCH)!  I think the biscuits were the best I've ever had ... anywhere.  They had crepes, and sausage, and pancakes (made to order), and fresh yogurt, and Tami-made macaroni and cheese, and sausage gravy, and a bunch of other yummy food.  It was a lovely place to remember my mom.

Sorry!  Just not the place for me.  When the guys said hey let's meet at Harrys.. I was not very excited because of past experiences.   But sometimes places change and figure it out.  But it is just not the case here.  Drink special was ok price.. But more sour than strong if you know what I mean.  Service seems to be ok if your a regular, which I am not nor will I become.   The food... No comment.   Just not a freindly local hangout in my opinion.  They do have a shuffle board table which are hard to find if you like to play.  Sorry but just not coming back......

We read the review in the Idaho Statesman and drove to Meridian to try it. Got there at 1:50, they close at 2 (on a Saturday which is strange) but we were turned away! The soup might be delicious, I wish I could say, but alas I may never know.  Just some friendly advice to the manager, if you close at 2, you should be prepared to serve customers until OR after 2, especially when you've just had an article written about you.

WORST EXPERIENCE EVER!  Caveat Emptor!  Curtiss Property Management, now reincarnated as Liberty Property Management is owned by Brandon Curtiss.  As of today's date, Curtiss has still not paid us a dime of the judgments against his company.  Since I posted my original review (shown below), many former clients and tenants have contacted me sharing the same kinds of experiences we had. He has also declared bankruptcy for the third time and been sued repeatedly by others.

My wife and I are grandson and daughter-in-law had breakfast there this morning. We ordered the normal French toast, hash browns, eggs and ham and bacon and all the food was excellent.  well prepared, and our waitress Amy was an excellent hostess.  we would highly recommend this location for breakfast in the future and plan on attending in the future.  The location was easy to locate on Fairview Avenue, the record was very nice clean and people very friendly.

The staff was very professional and attended to every need. Iv never had that before in a "fast food" restaurant, very cool. I say fast food, but it doesn't feel fast foodish...it feels more like a sit down restarant where you can sit and relax for a minute before getting back out to your busy life. The food was hot and fresh and the chicken was very good. Great light breading, flavorful taste, and a good crunch before you hit the tender moist meat. All of this at a very resonable price. Great job Chick-fil-A! Winner in my book!

Great service by Desa and flexibility of the kitchen to split the two edamame appetizer options into one order so I could try both options. Awesome Poki - which is hard to find. Very good food and very reasonably priced. Would love to come back.

I love this place i worked in the first one ever built of course years after it was built...lol in san jose cali off willams st by san jose university so where i i move to i  heck to see where one is abd the one here was unexpectedly awesome and the worker was great

Update: We've been doing a large family order every couple weeks for the last several months and service/food quality has gone down enough that I'm updating from 3 stars to 1 star - we won't be ordering pizza hut again :( The last 4 orders in a row, our order has been wrong to the point that one or two of us don't get to eat (PB&J looses it's appeal when you've been waiting 45 - 60 mins for pizza). i've called to get our order corrected or the messed up pizza credited each time but this last order started on a bad note - no credit for last pizza mistake annnnnd they messed up this order too. I promise, our wierd pizza that can never get made right is "large veggie lovers NO CHEESE," We've gone through a lot of variations on what part of the order can be wrong when we add this jinxed pizza to our order, and now we are so tired of the hassle that we'll be skipping Pizza Hut from now on. So sad, since ordering pizza is supposed to be a relaxing thing lol.


This is a PIZZA HUT. Not some locally owned fancy pizza establishment.

Pros:
Your pizza should be similar to any other times you've ordered that pizza from any other pizza hut

This particular location shines via it's DELIVERY SERVICE. Our delivery orders show up correct (working with some allergies) and hot. 90% of the time the person taking our delivery order is fantastic and helpful - THE KEY IS TO LISTEN FOR THE GREETING: if they say Pizza Hut on Cherry Lane in Meridan, you've got a person at the store that will be delivering to you (YAY!). If they answer with generic service specialist info, you've got the Pizza Hut corporate service that answers if no one can at the local stores - not a fan of the call center "help".


Cons: 
They don't pay or train for amazing awesome super service so chances are you've got a student learning how to be a server as their part time job, rather than a seasoned professional.


It's a chain restaurant that's pretty reliable, but not outstanding, our go-to pizza delivery when we need it! :)

1st visit & YAY! i finally found some good mexican food. it's not tex-mex good, but it's still very good. has flavor. so much of it up here is just bland. i had a cheese enchilada, have to try them every place i go & this one was wonderful & cheesy. had cheddar & either mozzarella or jack together & enough cheese that is was over flowing. very happy with them & that alone will have me going back. i also got the steak fajita quesadilla. full of cheese meat and onion with some diced tomato. came with sour cream & average guacamole. refried beans weren't bland & the rice was average, but bad. i had a pina colada that was refreshing, not overly strong, at $8 it could have been stronger. my son had the same wiht chicken. tried both & the steak was way better, but both still good. he agreed the enchilada was wonderful though. at the end of the meal they brought us two triangles of a sopapilla with cinnamon whipped cream & some strawberry sauce on them. very nice touch. greeting service wasn't immediate when walking in, but the over all service was quick & they were good about checking up on us. did not have to wait for refills or the checks.

Once you walked in you were greeted with a smile. The hamburgers were made to order which you could make a combo with sweet potato fries and tater tots and a fountain drink. The order was brought out to your table. The food was very fresh and yummy.  I'll be sure to eat there again.

Do not trust Brandon Curtis in any way shape or form. I am a landowner who Brandon has stolen from.  There are multiple civil judgements against him by people he's stolen from. He keeps filing bankruptcy and changing his company name to get out of paying back money he has stolen both from landlords and tenants. Currently,  he calls his company Liberty Property Management. I wish Yelp had a rating lower than one. He doesn't even deserve a one star rating.

Was there for my birthday. First time there since it changed from old location and from what I hear new owners and you could tell. Waitress was prompt but clueless. I had the finger steaks with coleslaw and the Mrs had chicken wings. The blue cheese dressing was watery and tasteless and the wings  average at best. My finger steaks were over cook in dirty oil and tough, maybe freezer burnt. The coleslaw was as bland as it could get. Tasted like cabbage with some sort of watery fluid added.
  The other thing I hate is how many  strip mall bars really go cheap on acoustics of the place i.e. bare ceilings with all duct work and poor electrical craftsmanship and wires exposed which creates a very edgy , harsh and noisy atmosphere even with only a small crowd.Then when you add a poor sound system for the sports events on tv it really gets bad. And lastly as it was my b-day the wife mentioned it our  waitress, as every bar I've ever been to offers a free drink to celebrate and the waitress totally ignore it. Oops there went a good tip:) 
  2 bad meals, 2draft beers, 2 weak drinks all for a $50 bill. Not again

Fantastic fresh soup, salads and sandwiches.  Lots of vegetarian and GF options. Mediterranean turkey sandwich was loaded with fresh turkey and crisp vegs.  Go with the half and cup of soup unless you are really hungry.  Also tried several other soups and all were good.
This is the type of place where everyone knows everyone. I was traveling from out of town, but needed a cut. I really enjoyed the service and my wife says it's one of the best hair cuts I've had!

Simple, easy and always tasty. Its frozen yogurt, which is REALLY hard to mess up :) 
There are a lot of options in Meridian, heck, there are two in the Village, but this one works. The staff is always super friendly, smiling and attentive. The place is always clean and the product is consistent. With all the foot traffic the Village generates it should be easy for them to be successful.

We just ate dinner at the hideaway, and there were a few little things that could use some improvement...
But Caleb earned this 5 star review. He was one of the best servers we have encountered anywhere. The food was great, and Caleb was right there to recommend something that I would like. The cheese quesadilla was fantastic! 
He made us feel welcome as soon as we walked in, and set the tone for a great meal.
Thanks Caleb, we will be back.

I went here to pick up food since my husband was on hospice and many relatives had come into town.  The staff was kind and even gave me paper plates and silverware and even a huge tray of cookies at no extra cost.  They also carried everything to my car.  This place will always ho a special place in my heart.  P.S. The food was delicious as usual.

I'm giving a 1 star only because I had a really nice store manager help me. The staff are always very nice and helpful. However the quality of product is horrible!  If you buy from this place be sure to pay the extra for any type of extended warranty because you will need it. I bought a bedroom set, living room couches and coffee tables and a fountain.  I had bought the wood warranty for my wood purchases. Thank god! My end tables on my bedroom set didn't hold up at all. They came out and fixed 1 of them once. Then it started showing a nail through the top. The manager helped with replacement of a new set because they discontinued my set. My back couch cushion starting disintegrating about 7 months after purchase and the bottom lining and staples were coming out. They came and refilled the cushion and restapled the bottoms of both couches.  NOW...the bottom couch cushions are slowly falling apart at the seems. Because its been over a year I am no longer under warranty and would have to call the mfr. Really? My living coffee table wheel fell off after about 6 months so they replaced the wheel. In the meantime I have seen a couple of bearings from the wheels on the floor. And the outdoor fountain I bought had to be returned after a few months because the clear coat was peeling off.  There are only 2 of us living in my home and I am  very tentative person with my belongings and take care of them. So for everything I have bought and spent a great deal of money on....its not holding up. I will now have to put sheets or couch covers on my couches in order for them to hold up dor hopefully a few more years.  They have truly beautiful and unique things in their showroom but lacks any type of quality.

Excellent donuts...they are light, not oily...better than the donut shop chain with the white,red and green sign.  
We had a variety of donuts...I loved the apple fritters which were very light, airy and not oily.  Pastries were very fresh and service was quick.  Place is very clean and the people are very friendly.

I will definitely be returning!

Cute new restaurant in Meridian. 
Based on our visit, I feel like the first couple of reviews are pretty harsh - they must have been still working out some kinks.
There were about 4 or 5 empty tables when we arrived (also a Saturday morning). They were quick to get us seated, take our order and deliver our food. After the food came, we had frequent visits from multiple waitresses to check in on our beverage levels and to make sure everything was OK.
I tried their huckleberry pancakes with a side of bacon. Portions are very generous, the 'short stack' was 2 plate size pancakes - made with fresh huckleberries, and served with a nice fruity (not too sweet) huckleberry syrup. Pancakes were thick and fluffy, nice light buttery flavor, and not 'rubbery' like many other pancakes I have had around town. Bacon was high quality - thick, and crispy with good flavor and it came with 4 pieces! Would be plenty to share with another person if you want something a little lighter.
My husband got an omelet with hash browns. He thought the eggs were perfectly cooked which was great, because so many places overcook their eggs. Hash browns were light and crispy, and there were no greasy puddles on the plate. 
They became much more busy as we were getting ready to leave, and they seemed to be managing the crowd fine. 
We will definitely be going back!

I don't do drugs but I imagine an addiction feels like shopping in this place, I need that, I need this, I need that, oh look at that price - I definitely need that! I can't say no, Sierra Trading Post is the weakness of my life. (One of them. I might even be able to honestly say it is equal to french fries addiction.)

The gear, the clothes, the shoes, the trinkets, the hats, did I mention the shoes, oh I did well... oh the shoes!! Discounts to the left, discounts to the right, discounts on the bottom shelf and over in that bin! 

I think I look cooler on the trails because almost everything I wear is from Sierra Trading and little do people know, I paid a whole little for a whole lotta!

Their return policy has changed which was one of the main reasons I loved Sierra to begin with. I enjoyed that they let you wear your shoes on the trail to really see if they work or rubbed but now... sad to say can't be done anymore. 

Sierra, I still love you.

Holy crap why am I here? I have no joke been in the drive thru line for 21 minutes. I was right behind the person ordering and they moved up quick so I thought it would be ok. No. I ordered one crunchy taco and the tiny nachos and a small soda. This is a joke, albeit a bad one cause I'm wedged in line, otherwise I'd drive-thru ditch this place so fast. Never again. And it's 9:45 pm. Not even lunch time. Freaking 4th meal.

I ordered a small pizza with garlic bites on sat.  Mon I was looking at my bank and noticed they charged me 3 times for the one pizza.  (They only delivered 1).n When I called on Monday they said too busy to talk to me and hung up.  Wrote to Corp they told me call the store.  Called the store again and was told it was a ghost charge and should hopefully fall off in 15 days or so.  Which will make me late on my house payment.  They offered me a $5 off coupon of my next order.  I will never over from them again.  This 1 small pizza and 6 bites is costing me almost $100 and all they will do is give me a $5 off coupon.   Dominos suck

I stopped in to Steve's Cafe for a quick breakfast the place was busy but I got seated with no problems. My server was very friend and suggested the Stuffed French Toast which I tried, it was very tasty and filling. I enjoyed my meal and was out the door in no time. I will definitely return the next time I'm in town.
My husband and I love this place.Always super friendly and delicious! A little expensive for us but totally worth the fresh food on a cold day!
Food tasted okay.  Serving sizes were small compared to the price.  2 pancakes, nothing else $10 wtf?  So many other better places to go.  My food was just warm.

We've tried several Mexican restaurants since moving to Meridian a few years ago.  This one is our favorite.  While we have dined in the restaurant a few times,  we usually get takeout from them.  The food is good and the prices are reasonable.  We've had a couple of items missing a couple of times,  but very rarely.  The staff is helpful and orders are quick to arrive.  You can't go wrong here.

Great place!  Loved the huckleberry french toast and pancakes! What a treat!  Delicious bacon, cooked to crispy perfection.  Big portions. Very clean. Very friendly staff. This place is a fave of my aunt and uncle,  who live locally. 

One downside...I live in Portland.

In our Entertainment Book we had a coupon for buy one hour of bowling, get an hour free so we took advantage of the coupon and we bowled 2.75 games before the lane shut off right on the 2 hour mark.  We paid an additional $5 an hour to bowl in the quieter area of the bowling alley but it wasn't worth it.  We were next to a huge party of kids (duh its a bowling alley) and it was as busy and loud as the main area.  Overall we had a great time and will probably go back and do it again.

This guy is totally a dick and a total liar. I am glad that he has poor reviews on here. He lied and said that my little dog which was a chihuahua was attacking kids that the neighbors said that. Which was a bullshit lie. His wife looks seriously like a mean ass bitch. He came over one day and started yelling at my support staff and cussing at her saying "Mind your own fucking business" because she was asking why I have 30 days to move out. He even called her a "Bitch" too I think. Well the next day was like hell for me. Because he put the black lock on the front door so I would think that he locked up my house so I couldn't go in. So I was crying and scared because I was thinking about my dog,and all my stuff like thinking what has happened to it. Well my staff went into the back door and the front door was not locked. He did it just to scare me. I hate this asshole. I never ever had such a shitty landlord like this before. 
NEVER RENT FROM THIS GUY! BECAUSE I AM NOT THE ONLY ONE WHO IS GIVING HIM A BAD REVIEW IT IS ALL THE REST OF THE PEOPLE ON HERE DOING IT TOO! 
He lies and says that my dog is a mean one. He is a fucking chihuahua. It would be different if it was like a big dog. But he only weighs 6 pounds.
Wanted a little base before hitting the Hawaii beaches! Nice clean place,front counter staff friendly and knowledgeable. Locally owned so that's a plus too!
Service was slow but the food was really good! It wasn't a crowded lunch spot so no waiting to be seated

Was excited to try this place out due to the good reviews. Ordered the mango shrimp tacos that sounded completely delicious. What I received on my plate was lukewarm and severely lacked in flavor. I should have said something but went against my better judgement and ate it anyways. Based on the menu descriptions I expected loads of flavor, I rarely complain about restaurant food but honestly I could have had better from a cafeteria. My fiancé had sticker shock over the price of his fish and chips meal. He said the flavor was ok but the portion was measly for what he paid. I didn't even bother finishing my plate, it was that bad. Went home and wound up getting sick 30 minutes later. I'm baffled over this place having such good reviews. We won't be returning anytime soon.

This is my go-to place for tires, batteries, brakes, etc.  The service is the absolute best, and everyone is super friendly, even when the lines are long and you can tell people are getting stressed.  They offer competitive prices, and have always treated me right.  Great products, Zero complaints, and lots of compliments!  What else could you want from a company?

[ Why do chicken coops only have two doors? Because if they had four, they would be chicken sedans! ]

My hubby and I had wanted to try this since they opened. He works most weekends and has been gone for the rest, so we took a rare Saturday morning and visited there. The wait was so worth it. The famous huckleberry pancakes were awesome and light and I hate pancakes. But the Corned Beef Hash was amazing, once again not normally one of my favorite foods. Far more homemade corned beef than potatoes and I scarfed more than my husband would have preferred from his plate!! Please give them a fair shot and help support the local business making our little corner of the world a better place to be -and to eat!
My husband and I love this place.always super friendly and delicious! A little expensive for us but totally worth the fresh food on a cold day!

Super nice store with great products.  You pay for their products but you just have to know that when going there.  I really appreciate Huckleberry's, an all natural store within Rosauer's, loaded with hard to find products.  It is really nice to have such a wide variety of healthy foods including hard to find items that you can only find online.  If you want it today instead of waiting for shipping, check out Huckleberry's but as mentioned, be ready to pay a premium to get it the same day.

Their store is always clean, friendly and convenient.  I enjoy the hot food bar along with a fresh juice bar and ample seating to enjoy your lunch.  They also have Wi-Fi so it is an awesome stop for a quick bite to eat especially if you are working and need internet or just want to surf the web.  Restrooms are always well maintained.  I would love to see them reintroduce cooking classes as they have a small kitchen with limited seating for cooking classes.  I haven't heard about them in a while.  Really neat store and a wonderful addition to Meridian.

So disappointed. My husband had the original with horseradish and I had the French dip. There was a generous portion of meat on each sandwich, but both sandwiches were fairly tasteless and bland. The bread was unremarkable and soggy.  We won't return.
Mark did a great job. All the barbers there are very skilled and experienced, would recommend to anyone looking for a good haircut!
Delicious! I had the seafood salad. We arrived at 8:30, they close at 9 but still welcomed us and we had all the time we wanted. Service was fine.

Solid seafood in Boise! I stopped in on a Sunday and took advantage of the all-day happy hour. My service was great, with the server frequently stopping by to ask if I needed a drink refill and if the food was prepared to my liking. 

I started off with the shrimp and scallop flatbread, which was super-tasty and perfect for sharing with 2-3 people. I then took a chance with ordering the salmon Caesar salad; risky because in my experience these are usually prepared with either too thick of a dressing or way too much. Not the case here at all! The dressing was perfectly light and matched the salmon very well. I will certainly visit again when I am in the area!

The fact that you make something called Cantaloupe, Watermelon and Honeydew Soup or Watermelon Gazpacho makes me love you already...and I haven't even tried it yet. 

...but am coming in tomorrow...

KC was the BEST!   Not pushy at all, very respectful of my needs.   KC listened to what I wanted and did his best to find our family the best solution at an affordable cost!   I would recommend him to anyone!  KC the experience you gave us was top notch!
If I could give a negative rating I would.  Had a terrible experience with the worst service from their staff in the appliance department.  Will never give RC Willey another dime of my money!
My husband went for lunch. Got a horrible half assed taco. Would not recommend if this service continues

So, I recently drove about 25 hours from Boise to Milwaukee to be with the love of my life.  But, oh what I left behind!  Dr. Anderson, my back hurts after that drive and I just don't see why you can't move your practice to MKE???  But, then I guess the good people of Boise would be seriously out of luck.    
Seriously people! If you have the need, any need, to see a chiropractor, go see Dr Anderson.  Simply put, she knows her stuff.  I've gone to Dr Anderson literally almost crawling in pain, and 20 minutes later walked out relatively pain free.  Yeah! She's that good!

Pizza for the price is always good and fast service. I tried their Philly sandwich and it by far exceeded my expectations and I'd easily order again in the future. However, the wings are in my opinion, pretty terrible. They bake them so when they arrive they are awkwardly sticky and not very tasty at all.

Ok 5 stars because really this is the best place in Boise to go and just be a kid again - or take your kids, but they can work on a few things here and there, who can't?
This evening was Tuesday - which means $12 for unlimited mini-golf and Laser tag plus $2.50 in tokens!! We ended up with a group of over 10 so actually purchased a package which was $11.50 for 3-hours of unlimited mini-golf, laser tag and bumper boats (which literally just opened!)
It was one of my good friends birthdays and we threw a "Suit Up" party as Barney would say and our general goal was to play a lot of Laser tag (accomplished).
They didn't have a lot of staff and it took a good 20 minutes to get 14 of us fully paid and ready to go have fun. It also took them a while to set-up the bumper boats since no one had been using them for a while - but they did come out right as they noticed we were interested in the attraction.
Also, they now have Pinz Bowling attached to the facility which I didn't get to do tonight but I have in the past and they are amazing! If you go on a busy night there is often quite the wait, but you get some tokens to pass the time which is nice. The bowling alley has screens above the bowling lanes playing music videos and great music, but it can be a bit loud. Also it's fairly dark with colored lights all over which is unique. And they have a bar attached to the bowling alley which I believe serves food too! I wouldn't know though, because they have employees come around every 15/20 minutes to check up on you and see if you need anything and brought us fries and water! It's great! A bit pricey - but so worth the mini splurge for a great time!

I have been going to Sassy for ten years and have been completely satisfied with a wonderful tech named Orianne.  The other people all seem friendly most of the time except for the owner's sister, Kim.  I have learned (and so has many people I have spoken with) to stay clear of her and tread lightly because you never know what she will do or say to you.  At one appointment with my daughter Kim actually said "I can't believe she is your daughter, she is way too pretty" and it wasn't a joke.  I didn't come back for awhile but realized I was hurting myself by letting an uncaring, naïve, selfish person keep me away from a relatively good place to go.  Since then I try to call when Kim isn't there because if she answers the phone she is very gruff and mean and short.  It is like she doesn't want you as a customer.  But, today she hit it out of the park.  I was getting my nails done and the salon was full of customers.  Kim came up behind me and started tapping my shoulder and in front of everyone said "don't disrespect me ever again....you hang up on me...you hang up on me".  I was so shocked, I didn't know what to say and couldn't believe she was berating me in front of my tech and all the customers.  I burst into tears and she kept going....although I was too upset to hear exactly what she said after that.  I didn't think I had ever hung up on her but you never know when she is done talking on the phone because she literally says three or four words and stops.  I have been a loyal customer for a long long time and have sent many many people to Sassy.  I cannot believe the owners would let one employee treat anyone like that inside their salon.  Apparently family is more important than respect, business, and customer feelings.

Stopped for a beer and a bite after a long day at work.  Great drink specials tonight!  Beer for a buck! That's awesome.   And I got a tip from a great source that the Cuban Sandwich and mac and cheese are very good. And he was right. The mac and cheese is gourmet.  Sat at the bar where the bartender and server were very friendly!    Spent some time looking at the menu and the specials during the week and weekend and they are some of the best I've seen.  I'm so glad I gave this place another try.

Went tonight with a 4,15 and 1 year old...very good place for kids with a chalk wall, small play table and cartoons on a tv for entertainment. The kids menu was great as well...having salmon as an option for the kids is great!

We wanted to start with the mussels but they did not have them or the clams...we had wings (which were great...garlic hot sauce) and calamari (lightly fried and well seasoned) but would have been nice to know about the apps ahead of time.

The food was good...hanger steak had great flavor (with garlic mashed potatoes and green beans) but was not as hot as I would have liked. Also had the seafood pasta (good with a lot of seafood), bread salad and roasted veggies...everything was good.

Will certainly go back...nice atmosphere, laid back, good beer, etc...I hope they just continue to evolve and get even better in the future!

These guys are total newbies and have no idea what they are doing.  But they make a killer cheeseburger.  I've had their double twice and was blown away. Exactly what you would expect from a place like this.  Ice cream is generous and fresh.   Do yourself a favor: visit a few times, give them a chance to perfect, and then never again visit the total sh*thole known as sonic nearby. :)

Stopped by last week to try out mattresses and spent nearly an hour with Shawn, who really knew his stuff and never tried to "hard sell" us into buying something. So refreshing! After looking at one other mattress store, we came back and purchased from Mattress Land. They went out of their way to make sure we were happy with our purchase, and we were especially impressed with their customer service! Thanks Shawn!
One of the best breakfasts ive had , the hor chocolate was rich, and the biscuits and heavy were delicious , steve came to our table to make sure everything was perfect , made me feel vip

This place was awesome! I have been looking for a great barber for my two young boys and husband and we have found it at Fred's "Reel"  Barber shop. 
As soon as we walked it my son was asked to take a seat. He received a "little boy" cut and it was perfect. Honestly one of the best cuts he has ever had! And to top it off he was done and we were out the door in 10 minutes. 
Needless to say we will be regulars.

Hangers steak was flavorful but undercooked, sent back and was great.  Cook (owner) gave me more mashed potatoes for having to wait. Wife had Public House burger and raved about it, it's better than any fast-food, better than Smash or Five Guys, but equal with Red Robin in taste. Service was very good, atmosphere was festive but also family friendly.  Will go back.

The bowling and arcades are very nice, the food is overpriced, the vegetables on the burger are an additional .99 which is a joke. The bartender/waitress we had was very very slow. The lemon drop was over $10.00 and extremely strong

This is my favorite laundry mat to frequent in Boise. It is exceptionally clean and well kept. All of the washers are in pristine condition and smell fresh. Misty is always so welcoming and accommodating. I'm thoroughly impressed by Rave and will continue to frequent. Not to mention, it is rarely crowded. Truly a hidden gem.

I had to get work done on my car, I went in and they did great job. Reasonable price, everyone was so nice, gave me a ride home, timely service. This is definitely where I will be taking my car from now on.

STP has some screaming Clearance deals online. I recently purchased ExOfficio long sleeved shirts for 9.00 and quick dry camisoles for 11.00. The best way to shop this store is to look and order online, and ship to the store for free pick up. 

When I went to pick up some luggage recently, although I wasn't greeted upon entering the store, the pick up process was super quick and easy and the sales associate was nice enough. 

I came in a couple hours before closing and the store was dead. I think there were about five customers total. A couple of the sales associates were engaged with customers here and there but I was left to my own devices. I was there until closing and the only time I was asked if I needed help was if a sales associate happened to be close-by. I appreciate the space to thoroughly go over the clothing racks (this the Nordstrom Rack of sporting goods stores) but at times it felt a little lonely, especially when I could hear the associates talking amongst themselves. At times it felt like I was there crashing their party. 

I think the associates need a little training on how to engage customers who come into the store. It's one thing to say, "You doin' okay over here?" and another to say, "Do you have any questions? Is there anything I can help you with?" (I know. I worked in retail!)

Prices in-store are okay but generally not as great as what you can find online and I would probably never buy anything full price here because the full-priced stuff is expensive. Selection is definitely bigger online. The only drawback is that I found a lot of things in-store that I might have purchased online, but many did not fit. Luckily the store is close to home so I can return items that don't fit. I will continue to shop online and limit my time in the store.

This place is amazing. It is so spacious. There's everything you could possibly wish for here. There's a restaurant too. The food is amazing. I like the layout of the store. There's even a Starbucks. I could spend a few hours here easily. 

There's also local products, such as products from the City Peanut Shop.

There is an amazing amount of parking too.
I absolutely love breakfast food, and this place is worth the wait. Typical cafe except this place is extremely clean and great service.

If you would like to pay over priced drinks, watch the owner pass out at the bar because he is so drunk, watch his girlfriend try and manage the place with no experience, then this is the place to be. Dwayne Fulbright has run the Hideaway into the ground and the person to blame is himself. He is charging downtown prices, doesn't acknowledge his customers, treats his employees with no respect. I don't understand how it got so bad from the old location to the new location other than greediness. There are plenty of other bars in Meridian to go to for better service and better prices and much more respect. This place is a disgrace.

All the prior reviews are right on the money.  Friendly,  clean, and expensive.   The up front deli is great for sandwiches and soups! The open pizza over is pretty cool as well.  So for me once and while shopping is fun!  So when I become a rich man Winco will loose a shopper because this is where I will come! Haha.  I will say the they have the largest beer in wine selection that I have found!  The beer cooler alone is like 200 foot long!  And just so everyone knows I do shop for more than beer!   Just saying!

Prices are massively high at this place. Good luck finding a juice you Actually like, and one with the right mg... I can't find anything I like under a 18mg. It's a shame because the flavors aren't that bad. I couldn't see myself staying more than 5 minutes, an even then the 'loungers' make things super uncomfortable. Doesn't matter, done with this place.

Loved the facility. Very clean and friendly folks. The line getting your tickets was really slow. Five people behind the counter and one person checking everyone in. Overall great experience. As a parent I loved the digital ticket tracker on a card.
Great food! Great service and the owner is awesome! The establishment is kept clean and a better healthier option if you're craving some food but not "greasy" styles of food!

Absolutely the best!!!! We stopped by the lot just looking knowing we had bad credit and nothing to put down and we drove off the lot two hours later fully approved with a 2006 suburban! Not exactly what we expected, but they were all very friendly and helpful. They got us approved for what our family needed very quickly and easily! I would recommend to anyone and everyone

This place does not disappoint! The service & quality of food is great. I recommend the Smith and Hook Cabernet Sauvignon & flatbread trio. Overall everything I've ever had at Lucky Fins was really good.

Disappointing. The beer steward guy is great. Service is great all around. It's just such a poorly designed store that it's impossible to hear anything in there. What a monstrous waste of money. It would make so much more sense to have a series of smaller more specialty shops. Still, they have good selection and everything. Just feels stressful to shop in there. Maybe that's a ploy to sell beer and food to give people that dopamine hit? Either way, it utterly lacks the charm and chill of grocery stores you can drink at in WA and OR like Thriftway and New Seasons.
This is one of my family's favorite Mexican Restaurants in the Treasure Valley, and the salsa IS the best!  There is some kind of secret magic ness in it.  Make sure to order a pint to take home.

It was a spontaneous trip to Luckys on a Sunday morning.  And...holy crap. Our food was just wonderful! Probably the best fish and chips I've had in Boise. Besides the Sockeye Brewery. Their (Luckys) tartar sauce was really good and unexpected. Tastes like it was homemade, and the coleslaw, which I'm never a fan of, changed my mind! It had pieces of apple and the creamy sauce had an apple bite to it. Omg. Yes! My fiancé had a lobster Mac and cheese. He tells me that's the best and one of the oddest combos he's had.

Awesome fun zone! The kids love this place. $20 Tuesdays with $5 add on options is the way to go. We didn't order food so no review for that. Make sure your kids have socks so they can do ballocity. Twister was a huge hit. Well worth the money spent.
When did they start charging $3.50 for a fricking glass of water?  I won't be going back.
Great go-to sandwich stop. Used to only get them at Disney, but now that I can get one in Boise, I know where lunch is.
I absolutely love Smash Burger. The bronco burger is amazing! Fries are good, and so are the shakes.

Hands down the best grooming experience we had with my senior and arthritic cocker spaniel who hates being groomed. We see Sarah. Sarah is incredibly patient with my special needs dog. If my dog gets worked up, Sarah will pause, give my dog a break/rest, and resume once my dog has calmed back down. Sarah doesn't force my dog to do anything and works at my dog's pace. If my dog is feeling tender in her joints, Sarah will put my dog in a special hammock, relieving pressure and pain for my dog. Even though my dog hates going to the groomer, she'll greet Sarah with a wagging tail and will walk back to get a bath with her. When we moved to Boise a couple of years ago, I tried a few diff groomers and never felt great about any of them, including having a horrible experience with one that left my dog shaking and in pain. Two of those groomers were on various "Best of Boise/treasure valley" lists. I found Sarah via following the Meridian Canine Rescue on Instagram. Sarah volunteered her time to take care of one of their dogs and MCR spoke highly of Sarah so I googled to find her number. This place also grooms cats. They are true animal whisperers.

I am SO happy that the Treasure Valley is starting to get some variety in the whole foods / health foods department.  We went to Rosauers on the way to the mountains for the weekend.  It was great to see that they have a juice bar, a wonderful looking salad bar, and tons of options at Huckleberry's Natural Market.  We also went into the "regular" part of the store to buy beverages for the trip.  However, the majority of my review is about Huckleberry's.  Although there is a great selection of foods you may not get at other stores, I still think that the co-op is better.  There are a lot of good options now in the Treasure Valley for "health food" and unless I'm looking for a wide variety or some ingredient I can't find elsewhere, I would not make Huckleberry's my regular stop for the food and supplements I buy.  The main reason is because most of the items we browsed were much more expensive than what I would pay elsewhere.  The only way I would shop here is if I shopped the sales - because the sales seem to be pretty good.  Otherwise I will stick to the co-op, my local Fred Meyer, and Full Circle.  It's great that we have options, and I hope that Rosauers sees its share of success, but it's just not my first choice.
Cuban grilled cheese + Tomato soup = Perfection! Usually busy, but they're kept busy for a reason. :)

One of the best seafood meals I've had in Boise.  We had the Diablo Roll- great combination of smooth, crunchy, hot and sweet. (We left off the atomic sauce)The special was crab stuffed halibut with the best risotto.  Our waitress said the halibut came in today and I believe her- super fresh.  It was our anniversary and they comped us the mango and coconut cake- to die for.  Our waitress was great only negative is it's pretty noisy

Had the flat iron steak with garlic mushrooms. WOW.  I'm a Viet  vet and was really treated with love and respect.  This wonderful place really treats veterans with love.  I  could drink and eat here every night. Ok so I already do. Kind of like the cheers of meridian. Ever night we meet new and fun people.

WOW! What a restaurant! I expected the Chick Fil A to be a mediocre establishment! But, in reality was phenomenal! I came home after eating a 12 pc nugget and a fry, and ended up having a constant, endless, unending stream of liquid diarrhea pouring out my rectum! I love this restaurant!
We absolutely love this place. Great seafood creations. Our server Kevin is consistently treating us like royalty. There is nothing I can say negatively about this restaurant. It is a must try.

I've been going to Celia for a couple of years now and I love her. Every time I leave my hair feels healthy, fresh and done right. She gets me as a customer, never up sells me, and listens to what I want and is honest. My hair has gone from dark brown to blonde and back to brown and always done beautifully.

If you have ever shopped in a Wegmans on the East Coast or a Publix this Albertsons put them to test of excellent products great selections and quality. You cannot beat the Snake River meats that they have, AMAZING! The Italian selection of provisions is equal to any fine shop on the East Coast the pasta and the sauces are just blow you away. The deli has a great selection for this area, The bakery has some amazing wonderful breads, pies cookies cakes and don't forget to stop and get a gelato.

They have and amazing floral selection with designers that can make anything. You just have to stop in there's just so much in the store from the spices to the coffees to the teas to all the specialty products they carry.

Fresh produce is top-of-the-line perfect.

One of my favorite sandwich shops around. They're consistent in their quality. I have ordered multiple things off the menu, but my favorite is the French Dip. Yuuummm! The fries are to die for! Pair them with their fry sauce and that's about as close to heaven on earth as you'll get. 
All the people who work here are so nice. The wait is about 5-10 for food...sometimes a little more depending on if they're making fresh fries, but it's worth it and they're always extremely apologetic for any wait.
I put a lot of stock in cleanliness, and this place is always pristine. I love the fact that you can see them making your food right there. 
It's a little spendy, but totally worth it. I'd eat here every day if I could. 
Heading there now!
Pizza was okay, but the salad bar gave us food poisoning!

This place has to be in the top 10 for best fun centers in the whole country. Is there an official list? Do I have to now visit every fun center in America to determine which is the most fun? I'll do it if I have to. I'm not afraid of having fun. I can tell you right here, right now though that I haven't had as fun of a day at any other fun center than I did at Wahooz.

This place is delicious and the staff is just as sweet as sugar ! Love eating here and I never come alone ! Always bringing someone new to try these awesome treats/ get the one that literally says "it's hard to pronounce " it's right under the chili one on the menu - sooo good , and they are cheap !!! So you can't beat tasty and cheap hehe ten stars if I could !!!

For years I managed my Boise Duplex by myself and resisted the idea of hiring a property management company.  I didn't understand the benefits of having someone else manage my property and assumed it would be cheaper if I did it myself.  Cassandra Swanson offered to manage my property in 2013 and kept in touch with me until 2014 when I finally decided to let go and give it a shot...now I wish I had done it sooner!  Cassandra and her staff at Paramount handle EVERYTHING.  I never have to worry about tenants, utility payments, vacancies or emergencies.  I've actually gone whole months forgetting that I even own a duplex in Boise and am only reminded when I get a month end summary statement via email.
The peace of mind alone is worth the management fee but in my case, the work that Paramount has done has actually allowed me to increase my rents so that I make more now than when I was doing things myself.
Whenever I meet landlords managing their own properties, I give them my spiel about how nice it is when you hire someone else (property managers) to take care of things for you and if they are in the Treasure Valley I wholeheartedly recommend Paramount Property Management!!!

What a beautiful new store!    Dad & I went for their grand opening and have been back several times since.

The bakery has beautifully decorated and delicious items, the service deli has plenty of options, and prices are fair.  Lots of variety on the shelves!  For example, we like Yaya's popcorn.  They have flavors of Yaya's at Rosauers that I'd never seen anywhere else before.

The clerks in the butcher/seafood area in the back of the store have been great.  They are friendly about special requests and even have recipes for some less-familiar items.

We've developed a fun rapport with Theresa, so we always like to get in her lane.  The company president even helped us at the check-out counter on opening day.   We'll be back often, I'm sure!

So me and some friends decided to go out for a cocktail and some appetizers.  Big mistake choosing Harrys as our destination primary due to the poor service we received.   Waiter check back time was terrible. We wanted to try some of entrées but where told that the kitchen  was closed by our server.  Then 1/2 hour later food was cooked and being served to new patrons.  We asked the waiter if it was just a mirage that we saw food going out, and he said he couldn't control the cooks.  Hope your experience will be better than mine.

We have used them several times. They have always done a good job. This time, they were exceptional. I heartily recommend them. I think it was Dave and Lucas. They were very professional, thorough, and courteous. Well done!
Great service, they went above and beyond the call of duty to help me with my bad credit get into a nice lil truck. I will definitely recommend them, also very clean lot and good selection!

I have been wanting to try this place for a while and we finally made it out.  I would like to say that I thoroughly enjoyed the ambiance and setting of this nice restaurant.  I absolutely loved the decor and design of this place.  There was a nice balance of booths and tables.  

Service:  We had a delightful waitress who was on the ball and friendly.  We really enjoyed her service and everyone there looked like they were friendly and attentive to their tables.

Food:  Since we have been wanting to try this place, we decided to take our time this evening and try a variety of dishes including their sushi which other reviews said they had great sushi.  My wife ordered the Mango Shrimp Tacos and I ordered the Fish and Chips.  Both were pretty bland and needed some seasoning.  My Fish became soggy pretty quick verses having a nice crunch and seasoning.  We took our friend out for his birthday and he ordered the Mushroom Crab Burger and he was very pleased with it.  We ordered a couple sushi rolls, the Atomic and El Diablo.  Both were good but the Atomic was excellent.  When we let our waitress know it was our friend's birthday, she mentioned our friend gets a dessert for free and he ordered the Mango Cake which was excellent.

Overall, I love the location and ambiance but the food was hit and miss.  We are planning on coming back to try different menu items and we are hoping to find our favorites through trial and error.

This has been the best store I've ever come across... however, it's been awful for my bank account haha! 

When I discovered my first market street, it was at the down town location. Because this location is larger and it's closer to my house, I find myself visiting frequently. 

When it comes to groceries, they have literally anything you could possibly need or want (which can be very overwhelming. Their produce, meat selections and bakery are all stellar! 

What I appreciate the most is their meal options. They have everything from deli sandwiches, a fantastic salad bar, sushi, burger bar, bbq, etc! This has been incredibly helpful for my husband and I when we both want different things for dinner and cannot come to an agreement.
