Breakfast is made very easy there as well. They offer a wide variety of breakfast pastries, bagels as well as breakfast burritos and sandwiches. 

If you're in the area, this is always a place checking out. Maybe even get a cocktail WHILE you shop!

The staff were really nice and friendly; however, the soup wasn't good.  I had a chicken noodle soup and it didn't have any flavor. The broth was so watery with no flavor. It was as if they just boiled an onion in some water. There was no depth to the taste. It barely tasted like something more than hot water, and it didn't have the look of the typical broth in soup. It literally looked like water with parsley thrown in it.  The chicken breast in the soup was very dry also. Honestly Progresso canned soup from the grocery store has more flavor than this soup (and I despise canned soup).  The description of their sandwiches sounded good, but they were made with bread that had soybean oil in them and I'm allergic so I can't report on those. With a name like the Soup Kettle... one would think that they would have fantastic soup as their specialty. Sadly, it really was awful.  I'd recommend trying Panera instead.

This was my third time here. The menu is ok but I'm yet to find something I love. Hubby raves about the fish tacos and loved the burger he had tonight. My food has been mediocre. The service is my only complaint. The bar had three bartenders and it still took forever to get drinks. Other than  that it's all good.

What a pleasant surprise! I got the Gouda grilled cheese special and the buffalo chicken soup. The onions and red peppers were a fabulous touch! I'm so impressed! Yum! I'll be back! And the people working were so courteous! Very impressed!

My first time eating here I get a burger, nothing special really. However they didn't remove the paper that was originally on the raw meat patty. So I get a mouthful of disgusting burnt paper on my burger. They made me a new burger ( minus the paper) however I think my sandwich should've been on the house. Go to 5 Guys, it's right down the road.

I came in the other day to ship out a package. The man in front of me in line was treated horribly by one of the men working there. I'm not exactly sure what lead up to the situation since I had just gotten in line. The man dropping off the package very kindly asked to speak to a supervisor, however the employee would not get the supervisor. From someone who has worked many customer service jobs, you should always get the supervisor when someone asks. Especially considering from what I saw, the customer was being very polite while the employee was being belligerent. This is only my most recent experience, I have come in countless other times and dealt with rude employees. Nothing will ever change of course because it's the US Post office, they don't have to care about customer service because they will always be in business. However I would recommend going to the UPS store instead if you can, the employees are definitely kinder and you most likely won't wait as long.

I give Abra Auto Body in Meridian, ID 0 stars. I had Kristen do an estimate on my car and was told that he would send the estimate and photos to my insurance company that day. He did not. One week later my adjuster from my insurance company called to tell me he tried on three occasions to get the photos sent to him. Each time Kristen said he sent them, my rep from the insurance company would never get them.   I called and spoke to Kristen about the situation and he told me he never had a conversation at all with my insurance rep for that claim. Never heard of the guy's name. I called Kristen's manager Jason and told him about  the situation. I told him if he was serious about my having my business he would have this resolved by business day that day. I then called back my adjuster to see if Jason had called. He did not. I confronted Jason again and all Jason wanted to do is argue with me, talk over me and blame someone or something else. I do not recommend going here. I felt like I was dealing with a bunch of twelve year old's who were given the keys and responsibility to run an auto body shop.
Store on steroids I got lost in all the cool stuff. Huge like a wal Mart but classy like a Whole Foods store. You have to check this place out

The food is so good here that I don't even want to call it a "chain." Every single time I've eaten at a Chick-fil-A, the food comes out piping hot, fresh, and quickly (today, the food came out before I'd even gotten to my table.)
I love the chicken fingers because they are crisp, without too much breading, and not dripping in grease. I wasn't sure if I'd like the cross cut "fries" but they've grown on me and taste really potatoey. They have great dipping sauces too. And BONUS they serve Heinz ketchup...the only ketchup I eat. 
Service is super friendly. The place is immaculate. And you need to stop by to say hi to Henry, who must get the "employee of the month" award all year.

My husband and I have had Togos sandwiches several times. He's fanatical about several sandwiches including the Triple Dip, Pastrami Ruben, etc. I'm a fan of the Asian salad wrap, and that's only  $5. The crew is always friendly and helpful.

Not only beyond slow- order is NEVER right. Food is always awful- like cheese never melted in quesadillas, or a burrito that's all nacho cheese and a bit of rice (it was so gross) with like no meat.....it's the closest Taco Bell to my house, so I've tried to give it a shot a million times and I'm just done. I go out of my way to the Taco Bell on the other side of town now if I want it. Won't go to this location.
Amazing everything. I love this place. The owners are the bakers. Cinnamon rolls are just like grandma's.
Went here for the first time at this location with my daughter.  Two of the employees were so friendly and helpful, I was impressed. The store was organized and well put together.

Our first time was so good. Everything we ordered exceeded our expectations. From the deviled Lobster eggs to the Halibut tacos. On top of great food the service was awesome. Everyone was so kind and helpful. They all went out of their way to help us and make great suggestions.  We will be back.

Love this place! Classy and clean. I think they're better than Wegman's which is on the East Coast. It's relaxing and caters to everyone's needs. Lots of hot food bars, restaurant, Starbucks AND an alcoholic bar! It's a huge grocery store and very easy to get lost in here. DO NOT walk into this store hungry or you'll be sorry, you'll buy up everything! LOL I will say their bathrooms are too small and don't have enough facilities. Weekends are difficult to find parking.
Food is yummy, but wait time is ridiculous! Waited for about 45 minutes before our food was ready.

Clean cafe. Staff is very friendly and no shortage of them.  Hash-browns are made from Yukon gold potatoes giving them a nice color and flavorful taste. Some dishes are a little bland, while others are very good. Weight time is average.  I would go again.

I'm sorry, but it Should not take over a week to deliver a dang card from Meridian ID to Bass Lake CA. You tell me they will get it on Monday but yet my dad finally got his card on Wednesday and my mom still has not gotten her card and it's Friday. I mailed out the cards on the same day and time. Why are you guys being so dang slow on the mail.

Dr McRae is a lifesaver. I had been feeling super sick for three weeks and even after hours he was able to get me antibiotics. He's very professional and easy to work with. I would recommend him to any of my friends and family. His office is also so convenient to get to and is connected to my dentist! It is BEAUTIFUL inside.
Best fish place I have eaten in Idaho, all my friends and loved it. Very reasonable prices.

What a lovely place to have a facial and/or massage!  Noma was wonderful, kind and gentle.  Very educated and helpful with great tips and advice to take care of my overactive skin.  Thank you to everyone there! So accommodating and such a peaceful place to go!  5 STARS & 2 THUMBS WAYYYYY UP!! ‍

I love this place, food is the right price, service is nice and fast. The drinks are done very well and atmosphere is great. It's hard to find places that fry foods in canola oil, if you have a soy bean allergy this is the only oil you can eat, and they use canola oil therefore all the fried food is fair game which made my best friend extactic since she almost never gets to have fish n chips. I can not however give it 5 stars because they discontinued their all you can eat crab on Wednesday and Sunday which means I'll probably go there less often.
It was pretty good, not sure I would wate 30 mins again but it was opening night and something new.

Only place in town to buy furniture from. Great selection and price range for all budgets. Megan and Maggie helped us out. Both have excellent customer service very helpful and knowledgeable.  I will and do recommend RC Willey to all of my family and friends.

We've been there 3 times, the first time their Liquor license was being held up by the city fathers!!!
The second time I had the Fish & Chips and my wife had Sushi, which she did like, as did I my Fish & Chips.  The third we also enjoyed our meals.  The service has been very good and they seem to be trying to get things right.
We'll be back tonight with a couple friends so I can edit or repost.
I would give it 5 stars but I figure there's always room for improvement or at least maintaining higher quality.

EDIT!

New Years Eve dinner was awesome, all our meals were great, from the Prime Rib, Crab, Salmon to the appetizer. As usual service was great!

We were in the bar tonight, I had the Fish & Chips again and will again in the future!
If you have an issue, talk to the owner, I bet he'll more than make it right.

I had to give it 5 stars now... they keep trying to do better, as far as we can tell.
Worst salon ever never going here again she cut me with the blade several times and when I pulled away she looked at me like I was an idiot. The shape is horrible as well!
Great marinated deep fried fingersteaks. Nice patio. Great beverage selection. Good prices.

set up a guide trip with Derek for fly fishing on The Owyhee River. No experience what so every with fly fishing. This is a good read for anyone considering a guided fishing trip with Dream on the Fly.

So, yes, no experience. I felt like the Karate Kid with his teaching technique. Presentation, mending, drifting, pointing the rod tip at the indicator, watching the indicator, casting and feeling the weight for whipping. It is pretty complicated, but his technique really helped me grasp the process and I felt pretty confident after an hour or so.

I learned the hard way once or twice about respecting the power of these river trout. They are good sized and put up enough fight to break a line pretty easily. LET THEM RUN WHEN THEY FIGHT! Don't force them in too fast. Take your time, but keep your rod up and line tension tight. 

The scenery at The Owyhee River is gorgeous. In all, you will learn a lot with them about the river, fly fishing, and Idaho if you are a traveler. Great experience. We had some great catches and I learned so much. I would recommend this trip to anyone looking for a great fishing trip!

I need to give an updated review. I'm out of state visiting and was here last week and wanted to purchase a tan. The price of one tan was the price of a about two tans of the level 4 VIP package tans. I explained I was out of state and as I was visiting with one of their VIP members if they had a buddy pass or an out of state option as a package was not an option. She told me it was priced intentionally to that way for customers to choose to buy a package.  I left without purchasing anything. My friend went again a couple days later and said let's ask another one of the employees. To our surprise the two gals that were there were more than welcoming and went out of their way to help get me a weeks package that was fair pricing for someone who is out of state. The even offered me a package of buy 4 get one free, which is a day more than I will be here but I was more than happy to buy it because they were so great. The beds are clean and with new/er bulbs and there is no waiting time. Thank you Ladies you Rock!

2nd time I went to meridian store for a hot and ready pizza as advertised between 4-8 pm and they didn't have them ready.  Pepperoni and 5 meat pizza.  They were not even in the oven.  I had to wait 15 minutes.

It's not too bad.  But looking for a good bowl of menudo.   Not even on the menu.
So far , Idaho does NOT have good Mexican food.

One of the WORST nail experiences at a salon. My nails look disgusting. It's has t even been a week and 2 of my acrylics have popped off and the rest have lifted or have lines through them. Although I'm more upset about the hour I just spent so uncomfortable at this salon. It is too bad because I'm new to the area and looking for a nail salon and I happen to live right up the street from this place so I thought perfect. I will say it's a nice salon regarding have nice chairs, up-to-date magazines, you can watch a movie, all the things that make for a nice escape from your kids to go relax and get your nails done. Not the case today unfortunately. I think it's the lady that owns the place that was so rude to me, she seemed to be in charge and barking out orders. Again, I go to the salon to get away from my kids and relax and the owner or employees kid was watching an iPad very loud right behind me. I have zero interest in hearing other kids watching and playing video game on their phones. It was so loud and the woman that works there should've had the courtesy or decency of asking her kid to turn down the obnoxious sound. So, horrible experience. I'm not usually a yelper, though I do read them a lot. What was so weird about the lady is she was very nice to some of the people so clearly she has it in her to be nice so why she had to go out of her way to be so rude to me on a Saturday morning is beyond me but I won't let it damper my day any longer though I did feel so wronged I had to share. Maybe this review will remind her to be nicer to people because I'm a great client and my nails done quite often and she lost valuable business... But clearly she wasn't interested in my business or she wouldn't of been so rude in the first place. I gave them one star for having up-to-date magazines.
Mahi tacos were great but the roles were the stars of our dinner. Waitress was very nice. The owner came out and spoke with us. Everyone was so nice! A prefect dinner in Meridian.
Great empanadas at a great price. Plenty of variety. The $5 deal is a great way to enjoy something different without spending a lot of money

By far the best Domino's I've ever had. Everyone that delivers off the pizzas are always friendly. The food tastes great and you can tell they always put their all into making the food. Absolutely would recommend and normally I don't necessarily like chain pizza.

Wow... so I had a double patty huckleberry burger with blue cheese. Amazing. Moist patties. Sweet and savory. Loved the bun, soft, flavorful. 

I ordered one of their specialty sodas, the dirty bill. Fantastic!  Fries and onion rings were amazing. I consider myself a burger connoisseur, this was AMAZING. I finished off the meal with a shake, vanilla with banana, peanut butter and chocolate. Wow...

Loved Fanci Freez. A friend who lives locally recommended it to me. The place was packed, I really enjoyed the energy and flow of the place. I travel a lot all over the country on business so when I ask for recommendations from the locals I emphasize how important it is that wherever they send me not disappoint. This was a delicious meal in a nice clean space. Loved it!!!

They have a pretty simple menu to order from. You pick a |size|: mini, regular, or plate; |base|: white/brown rice and veggies, or white/brown rice, veggies, and salad; then |protein|: chicken, beef, half & half, or tofu. I ordered chicken with white rice then put some "magic" sauce and triple hot sauce. It was  tasty.  My husband loved his beef plate w/ brown rice and my girls enjoyed their chicken bowls. They said it tasted like home-cooking.
It's basic but good food. This is nice sometimes when you want quick, healthy, yummy food for you & the family.
We will be back!

I think they are amazing sandwiches! I ordered the Holiday Turkey and it was delicious! The filling goes from side to side and from end to end. The turkey was tender, the stuffing delicious and the cranberry sauce just right. 
My husband got The Earl's Club and he loved his as well. 
We will definitely be going there again soon!!

I brought the wife and kids here yesterday to begin our search for a new mattress. When I go into these places, I feel overwhelmed with all the beds, and how could I possibly pick one that will be right?  Well, Casey was right there to help us and showed us their bed fitting set-up that measures your pressure points, among many other diagnostics, and gives you a number that is best for your sleep position and body type. Then, all the mattresses in the store have a number associated with them that narrows down your selection to only a few that will be best for you.  Casey showed us four mattresses that fit us best. After that, it was only a matter of trying out a couple and coming to an easy decision.

Casey was professional, not pushy in any way at all. He was very knowledgeable about the products he offered, and made the overwhelming process sooooooo much easier. We decided on which bed we wanted, and Casey took care of the rest. The whole process of financing took about 3 minutes. We shared with him the story of a recent bad experience shopping for a twin mattress for our 3 year old, and the terrible quality mattress the company ended up delivering. Casey felt bad for us and threw in a free twin mattress to replace our daughter's.  To be clear, we did not buy the twin mattress at Mattress Land. Yet Casey gave us a free mattress for her anyway.  Think about that! 

I HIGHLY recommend not only buying a mattress at Mattress Land, but starting here and not wasting your time ANYWHERE else.  This will be your first and last stop.  I could not be happier with my experience at Mattress Land.

I'm
Not surprised that Lush is at the Village especially with Charming Charlie on one side and VS and LuLuLemon on the other. 

Not sure what Lush is?

You don't have to look just smell. 

Lush offers natural  soaps, body washes, cosmetics, and shampoos. 

This is where boyfriends and husbands get dragged and come out with a bag or two. 

But that's what I thought when I went in for the first time and it changed on my subsequent visits.  

If you're guy and you're looking for Manly Man smells like a naked guy riding a horse on a white sand beach, you won't find it. Those smells rightfully belong to Axe, Old Spice, Dial and the rest. 

But hey, don't walk out yet, I know the fragrance is strong so let me explain. 

There are the benefits 

1. All Natural ingredients. No chemicals. Know what you're putting on your head and your skin. If you can't pronounce it or you don't know what it is or what it does, why would you put it on your scalp or skin?

2. In the long run, it's cheaper. - What ?!?!?! I know I see your face while you're reading this review. Hear me out. 

Let's talk about shampoo. A regular bottle of who knows what's inside for $3.99.  You probably got about 1-2 months use depending on how much and how frequently.  You'll won't be able to get what's at the bottom of the plastic bottle unless you dilute it with the top off and swish it around. On average you'll have about 50-60 washes. Then you gotta throw away the bottle. 

The shampoo bar at Lush is about 10-12 bucks. It's the size of macaroon ( if you don't know what that this, it's a French cookie.) How about as round as Half Dollar Coin but 1.5 inches thick or tall. 

The shampoo bar is great for several reasons. 

1. Up to 90 washes - Yeah 90 washes .13 per wash

2. Environmentally friendly - No more plastic bottles anywhere

3. No problem with traveling - It's shampoo bar.   It's not a liquid. HA! - TSA Agents!!!!!

The staff is super friendly and they know their products. There are about 100-200 different types of personal hygiene stuff so my recommendation is to start with shampoos and conditioners and then work from them.

Ask for a catalog to take home as it will help you with all their products. 

Now, don't be the super macho guy when going in but if you do, you'll be coming out smelling like a Rock Star - A chart-topping hit with an irresistible vanilla scent and a luxurious lather. OR Outback Mate - Zingy Eucalyptus, lemongrass, and peppermint are a wake-up call for your skin and mood. 

BUT wait there's more!!!!

Bath Bombs - I can't review since I haven't tried but my friend Tyrone says that they are the real deal Holyfield.  We'll see. You'll have to wait for an updated Yelp review.

The photos Maija captured for my daughter's engagement session were more beautiful than I ever imagined. I can honestly say that everything was just perfect! Maija made the couple feel at ease and the shots were romantic and classy. So many of them belong in a magazine, it's hard to choose just one favorite. And being from out of town, Maija's electronic pay system was easy and convenient. If you want a truly amazing experience and seriously Vogue results, I highly recommend Maija Karin Photography in Boise Idaho.

Have had dinner here with my family more than a dozen times, and never been dissappointed. Teenage son says one of best burgers ever, plus the sushi is great. I am always amazed how low the bill is, and my tummy is satisfied.

The place is way understaffed so the kitchen is really slow (only 2 people working).  May just have been a bad day.  Also the guy taking orders was handling money and then going back to make food with the same gloves on...gross.  Sandwich wasn't very good and the soup was just okay.  I can make better at home.  If you just wanted soup it would be okay since it's already made.  I don't plan on returning.

I arrived at the bakery around 8:00 AM on a Tuesday.  There wasn't a lot of items in the cases but what was there looked fantastic.  I selected a caramel pecan sticky bun and a cherry almond danish like pastry.  The cost was just over $11.00.  I ate the sticky bun for breakfast and it tasted okay.  The problem was the sugar in the caramel was not dissolved enough.  There were some solid sugar chunks in the middle.  The cherry danish was enough for my family of three to have it for dessert that evening.  Everything about it was perfect.  The only reason for the three stars is the sticky bun and the cost.  I will definitely return and may write another review if all goes well.
This place has the BEST cookies!  However, if you want to call to place a large order, don't expect anyone to pick up the phone.....like ever.  Seriously...what business doesn't answer their phone??

I have gone through the drive through at this place 3 times.  My order has been wrong 3 times.  Every time, I've gotten home, I realize MULTIPLE items are missing.  EX: I just went through and ordered food for my family (we are in the process of moving and the kitchen is packed up).  We ordered 7 bean and cheese burritos and 3 tacos. We got home and realized we had 5 burritos and 2 tacos.  Is it that hard????  On the bright side, the employees I've dealt with have always been friendly.  Perhaps the location needs to come up with a better system to ensure orders are correct?

Very good burgers and delicious milkshakes!!! Their tater tots (gems) are always very good too! My only complaint is that sometimes the service is a little slow but they have gotten better at that lately.

I had the BEST "Blacken Fish" ever!! I had to make sure it was a regular dish on the menu! Monday night wasn't too crazy busy. Enough people to know it's a dang good place to eat at but not too many to where you had to wait. The hostess seated us right away. Our waitress Virginia greeted us happily and just in time! So sweet and knowledgeable on the food/drinks menu. Was awesome on suggesting entree options. Was so friendly and great to chat with! Love her!!! The amount of food I got was a surprise. Much more than I expected. The price was SO reasonable too! The restaurant was clean! I didn't use the restroom but if it was dirty my MIL would have said something. HA! Just overall a great place to hang out and have GOOD EATS! I've ate here twice and my dish has been SO good both time! I'm probably going to make this a regular restaurant.

This place is great.     The staff knows the nail business and really goes all out on pedicures.    

Yulia does a great job and will never hesitate to return.    

These people actually paid attention and talked to the customer instead of going though the motions and eyes glued to the TV sets.     

Prices are reasonable and the work good.

I love supporting local businesses, but The Hideaway will not be getting any more of my business. I came here for lunch with two friends. Our food took about 40 minutes to get to us. My medium rare burger was very well done. My buddy's medium burger was very well done as well. My other friend's meal was cooked correctly, but the order was incorrect. We had to go to the bar to order a drink. We received our bill and left my credit card on the table for about 15 minutes before taking up to the cash register to pay ourselves. I wanted to like this place, but it was bad. I won't be back.

Stopped in here while on a roadtrip with my friend and we were sooooo happy! The plae was busy and bumpin in the morning(always a good sign) and when we ordered hot chocolate instead of coffee (because even though we are 28, we are children) nobody batted a lash. Said hot cocoa was delicious and came with tons of whipped cream by the way.

I had the stuffed huckleberry french toast and she had raspberry cheesecake french toast. Both were INCREDIBLY delicious. I could've eaten several more without stopping to think what my waistline would do. 

Friends we were with had egg/meat/hash brown combos, and everything was very fresh and good and well portioned.

I would definitely definitely recommend this place whether you are a local or just someone passing through.

This restaurant has THE BEST food! I'm telling you, you will not be disappointed! 
Delicious, fresh, beautifully presented. We have never been disappointed when we've eaten here. Definitely a 5 Star Restaurant for Meridian!

Awful experience with Les Schwab. Went in to get four tires mounted on my vehicle. Not only do they charge $100 more to mount four tires than anywhere else in the treasure Valley, I also returned to their location with 30 minutes before closing and they refused to help me with my vehicle. Lady at the front desk was extremely inconsiderate and tried to immediately justify it however why I have closing hours if you close 30 minutes prior to actual  closing. Truly disappointed and will not return.

Two of my kids have worked there along with many of their/our friends. We've had fun family experiences there and the kids don't want to leave. All of the staff is involved in cleaning which is great. The dons great job. The attractions are fun!

First time being here and I'm sadly not impressed. The shift manager seems... off somehow. Ordered a salad with goat cheese added and I got a confused look. Also ordered a burger in a lettuce wrap and got a bun instead. Had it replaced with limp lettuce placed on it, not wrapped. Salad tastes good, toppings are skimpy and not much dressing. Smashburger is mediocre at best.

The associates at Lush know the true meaning of good customer service! They have been able to answer any and all of my questions or concerns. I've had help picking out the best products for my routine, and couldn't be happier with what they recommend! I'm surprised by how clean and organized the store is as well.

Good "Old Fashioned" Doughnut Shop.

They have good variety of doughnuts and pastries as well as breakfast sandwiches.

I'm so glad to see this in Idaho. It's fresh, healthy, and they have a lot options for sizes and the price is good for what you get. Living in Los Angeles this was my go to spot for healthy and fresh dining . I recommend getting the half beef and chicken with brown rice. The magic sauce is great and the perfect amount of flavor. This is a better option than fast food and your body will thank you for it.
Went to this park and it was super duper awesome it was really big it was water fountains in the far back there's a statue lots of kids lots of Running Room basketball court just lots of fun

The food was good,  the service I wouldn't describe as friendly, more couldn't wait for us to leave? Priced on the high side for the service. Most likely won't return which is unfortunate as husband would have appreciated sports bar in walking distance.  But as I described,  they don't care.
Very tasty pastries, friendly people.  We liked the almond croissant the best.   Late' was good too, not too sweet or overly flavored.

This was just a horrible experience. The girl painted my toe nails 3 times & it is still messy. My toe nails are either filed to the right or wavy...and this is after she was asked to fix it. She painted all over my cuticles & skin & left paint off of the nail area on other nails. The sad thing is she attempted some nails 3 separate times & still couldn't get it right. 

I'm also questioning the cleanliness of the nail shop. TWICE I saw them put people in chairs that others just vacated & all they did was rinse the chair tub & use the water sprayer on the drain. This is disgusting & beyond dangerous.

Update my 4/12/19 Kind of rethinking after our last visit. Not impressed. Purchased 4. 2 were a bit underdone. I was looking forward to trying the lime but it was a big disappointment. So crumbly that you couldn't even hold it and icing was super sweet and grainy. Probably won't go back.

We decided to try out Soup Kettle Grille for lunch when family was visiting and we really enjoyed it. It's nice the soup options rotate, we all had different soups and they were all delicious. You can also get soups in containers to take home, already cooled in the cooler. The sandwiches were good and the staff were very friendly. It was a little pricier than we imagined but a nice place to go for lunch.

Visited the Family Fun Zone before hitting the water park and it was a great call arriving right after it opened at 10 am. There were no lines for any attraction/ride. Very reasonable package prices. I have 13 year old twin boys - one is on the autism spectrum - and they both loved it. We spent a couple of hours there and they enjoyed the rope climb, bumper cars, go-karts and other attractions. Definitely would return when we're in the area again.

When I do go here it has always been for breakfast. They have a small town feel, if you like that. They are never really busy before 9 but then it starts to pick up almost immediately. I have never had an issue with the wait staff and hostess. They are welcoming and attentive but the food is hit or miss. Occasionally my food has been over cooked (burned the bacon and hash browns). Their portion size is quite large though. And their menu offers a lot of options, even offer gluten free choices (this menu has to to be requested).
I would recommend them.

Such a sweet place! I took my cousin there for her birthday and they made us feel very welcome.  We had the pinwheel pastry and it was out of this world delicious. We were also lucky enough to be there when she took a coffee cake out of the oven and we got to try that!

Burger was burnt, tacos small and blah. French Fries were limp, greasy, soggy. 
Server was a nice young lady. 
Music not too loud. 
Nearly every table was full at dinner time while we were there but we were not impressed.

Taco bell is soooo good! I've been a fan for 20 years. This one is good. I read other reviews and I didn't experience what they did. I think those are isolated events. I've been here many times, and have not once had a problem. Friendly people. Keep up the great work!

We went in at 8 pm. They closed at 9:00 pm. The waitress acted like she didn't want us coming in even tho there was still an hour left before closing time. I tried to order a Mexican beer. Every beer I asked for she said they were out. My son and his girlfriend were with me. She wanted to order a pina collada. The waitress asked for her ID. She handed it to her, the waitress walked away with it, and disappeared for about 15 mins. This made her uncomfortable. Why did she take the ID. She didn't do that for my son. When she asked for his ID she checked it and handed it back like normal. Makes you wonder what she was doing with her ID. Food was very sub par. I don't recommend this place at all
The best sandwiches in town.  A custom, hot pastrami is exactly what I needed.  The customer service was great as well.

I have given this place several opportunities,  the upstairs patio is awesome but the service is very slow and some of the staff is unfreindly. Food is good but the cocktails are watered down with little alchohol, this place has a ton of potential but needs to pick up the service
Sodalicious is the best! Peanut butter cookie with frosting and an AK Special are a match made in heaven...

Nice place with some good food. Prices aren't necessarily the greatest but not bad either. It's always nice to go to a place like this. It has a relaxed atmosphere that's hard to replicate. All of us had a great time!

I am a big fan of Smash Burgers and this one is one of our favorite stops when traveling through Idaho. The burgers are juicy, fresh tasting and good condiments. Smash fries are very good also. The restaurant is always clean and well bussed. The wait staff actually came around and asked how our meal was. Haven't gotten to try other items on the menu as the burgers are so tempting.

Drove down there on a Sunday at 9am, during snow. Figured selection would be decent. It wasn't bad, but wasn't great!  Whatever, it seems all donut places are like that, selection wise. 

The donuts appeared to be fresh, and after getting home,  definitely are. They are good, no argument here. 

But just buying a dozen donuts, off the regular shelves. Nothing crazy. No cinnamon rolls, bear claws, typically premium items. 

Why is a dozen donuts $$ 18.45 ????

I love supporting a local business. I own one myself. 

By why price gouge your customers?  You know we complain as a society here, that we dislike the growth, and masses moving here, and changing what we have here. But this type of business practice does nothing but open that door. 

I travelled to San Diego a month ago, near the beach. A dozen donuts was $$ 10.34 and the donuts were very good. Comparable to this place.  8 dollar difference tho?  

I won't return. Sorry. It's a donut, not my gas bill!

If you're looking for top quality in materials and workmanship Stor-Mor is the place to buy your shed! Super helpful, Olivia was wonderful, friendly and experienced from building my shed on their useful on-line digital modeling tool to final installation. Brain and his team were very thorough to ensure the shed was placed in the exact spot, door opening, level/square and touching up paint. My custom shed was built to the exact specification, including custom matched paint colors, they even supplied me with extra paint. Could not be happier and would 100% recommend Stor-Mor!
The delivery people are great and the sales staff very helpful. They have the best selection on appliances, tvs, and furniture in the Boise area.

Simply incredible. We usually have one of there weekly specials. Seems like every one is better than the last. Has quickly become one of our favorite place to go.
.

I have recently moved to the area and discarded my old bed prior to my move. I did the rounds visiting the big box stores and eventually walked into Mattress Land due to the outstanding Yelp reviews. 

I was greeted right away by Frank. We were both transparent and that eliminated much wasted time for both of us. Frank quoted me a great deal for a Queen bed. I left the store needing some time to think.

I returned shortly there after and struck a great deal with Frank on a King bed. During the process of gathering my information, collecting my payment etc I quickly realized why the reviews are where they are at; customer service! Frank not only was engaging and professional but talked to me as if we've known each other a while. Frank set expectations and he delivered! I am so impressed with the customer service from Frank even the gentlemen delivering my new bed were awesome! 

Mattress Land you've got yourself a life long customer!

I had a massage by Liz. It was perfect. I had two specific areas on my back that needed attention. She asked good questions to understand the issue, she listened, then delivered an excellent massage based on my specific requests. Additionally, the reservation process, check in and check out process, and payment was smooth and as expected. A well run operation.

We come to this place regularly and today service time took forever during the slowest time of day between 2-3pm. We had our choice of tables. Our order was taken  at least 15 minutes after water was served. Food took a long time to come out. Kids Mac and cheese was tasting like it was sitting under heat lamps for a while. We had to ask for new fries and sauce for Mac and cheese. This won't be our regular place anymore .

Love this place! All Crumbl cookies are delicious, but our favorites are the chocolate chip (of course) and any that have the brownie cookie as the base. A box of four cookies is just right for our family to cut up and share, but if you are feeling crazy go for the party box... the cookies are huge and if you don't have friends to help you eat them you will be eating a LOT of cookies.

This place hopping on a Thursday night.  Their finger steaks are good especially with the horseradish in either dipping sauce.  The wings were good too especially in the Thai Peanut sauce.  Service was good.

My daughter enjoyed going there. We had signed up for a class on Fridays (which is listed on their class paper schedule that the receptionist handed me as well as their website).The receptionist urged me to sign up TODAY because the class was filling up. She had me specify the class, the time and the age of my daughter on the paperwork. I received a call a few days later that there was no kindergarten class and I had to take another class. She was rude when I questioned it and blamed it on the "new system". If there was such an interest in the class and it was almost full, why does the class all the sudden not exist. It felt as if they were being dishonest and if they don't have the staff to teach the class on Fridays, then just tell me. Don't blame it on the system. I can't believe how rude she was and why am I the bad guy for questioning the fact that I was persuaded to sign up ASAP.

I get the impression that they didn't need my business the day we brought in our Mustang for a brake assessment. Perhaps they were just too busy. 

Although I have the necessary skills to assess and replace brakes myself, I didn't have a lot of time to devote to doing this anytime soon and since this is my sons first car, I thought I'd present him a life lesson and opportunity as to how the world works, what it costs, etc., so I asked him to make an appointment to have his brakes looked at. It took nearly two weeks to get in. Although that seemed like a long time it was ok since the check was going to be free, so we decided we would wait. 

When we finally brought it in and they quoted us nearly $840 for all new brakes on a 1992 Ford Mustang! The value of the car itself is probably twice as much. I thought I had heard wrong but nope, that's the number they presented. What makes my experience worse is that after they wanted to replace every part in the brake system, I went to assess it myself. Up front, the calipers they said needed replacing worked perfectly and the seals weren't too worn. The pads they wanted to replace were around 20-25% (ok, that's getting close but still not urgent and they weren't causing the brake squeaks). The disc brakes they wanted to replace - still in great condition and thick enough. 

Now to the back of the car. Same thing: drums still had some life. The wheel cylinders were perfectly dry and no leaks. Seals in great condition. 

The only benefit about this place is the free brake check, HOWEVER if they are going to try to pull one over on you and sell you all new parts when you don't need them, that free assessment isn't free! My advice - take the time to assess the brakes yourself if you have the ability and if not, go to someone who comes recommended by a friend or who knows something about auto repair. Get 2 - 3 assessments if you can or one really good one. 

I will NEVER recommend this place to friend nor foe. The parts markup is ridiculous (close to double of online pricing). BTW, I just replaced the front brake pads for under $15 and the car stops better than ever and the squeak we originally noted is now gone! To add, the discs don't even need turning! I saved money simply by not choosing to do business here. Do your research!

This was a wonderful experience.  We went to mattress land to buy a base that sits up for under the mattress. Our salesperson, Dave was great. Fun, spunky, bubbly, knowledgeable. He stayed late to help us get our credit so we were able to get what base we wanted. They have great prices. Also latex matresses if your looking for one. 4 to choice from. Plus other wonderful feeling matresses.  Get Dave to sell you your next buy. Hes funny. And puts you at ease. Im very impressed with their selection. They are there for you. Not pushy. They also have cooling pillows. Nice selections on then also.

Excellent place for lunch. Great homemade soups, sandwiches, and salads!  I had the 1/2 chipotle turkey sandwich, which was big for a half sandwich, thick turkey slices, lettuce, tomato, and mild chipotle mayo.  Paired with a cup of the best chicken noodle soup I've had from a restaurant, it's like the one I make at home.  Most restaurants make it way too salty but this was perfect.

Others in our group had tomato soup, also very good with bits of tomato and lots of flavor.  Chicken salad sandwich had chunks of chicken with grapes and mayonnaise, lettuce, tomato, very tasty.  The Asian chicken salad looked fresh and the person who ordered it said it was good.

You get to taste any soup before ordering! Service is very friendly and excellent, food came out lightning fast.

The only reason they get a one star is because it is required!!
We were very unhappy with our first visit to Togo's.  My order was incorrect, and I offered a solution to fix it (cooking for 40 years).  I was talked to like a little child by Alan, who is a trainer.  I was told by several employees that he would only be there a little while longer.  
An employee (teenager) came out to our table and apologized for the way we were treated!  
The food was just ok at best.  Blimpi or subway is far better.
I am pretty sure that my close friends and family will not visit this new sandwich shop, nor will we return.

We ordered a table from here and it came broken, so they sent it back and it took 6 weeks to get a new table in stock. That table was also broken. It then took them an additional 4 weeks to get another table. Since we had recieved two broken tables the told us they would give us $100 off of our purchase. When they finally got a table in stock that was not broken, they didn't honor their promise of $100 off. DO NOT SHOP HERE.
Spectacular store!!!  However, when I can get the same grocery item for so much cheaper elsewhere. That means I don't go there much at all. :(

The staff make this place so great.  They have job ownership and authority to assist guests as needed.  Every single staff member was kind, helpful, and attentive!  The gal running the laser tag made guest safety and fun her priority.  I saw her wiping down the hand rails in the waiting line....this almost made me jump for joy!  You know places like this with tons of kids have tons of germs....and here she is taking the time to clean the bars between kids.  As a mom, I really appreciate this.

The only think that was below excellent was the food.  And since I'm giving a full review I'll let you know that I was thrilled with the time it took for the pizza, breadsticks and salad to arrive.  By the time we ordered the kids were starving and it came quickly-thanks!  My husband said the pizza was a step above Chuck E. Cheese but he would never order it for takeout.  My salad was fresh but the chicken had some nasty grizzle on it and I really would have preferred that to have been cut off.  The bread/cheese stick things were strange...I saw one of the kids take a bite and quickly return the stick to the pile (ha ha!).  

We will probably only come on the days they have deals, as the prices seem expensive.  I'm happy to see Wahooz is considering replacing activities (such as bumper boats or mini golf) with other options when you buy a package deal if those attractions are closed due to weather and they should.

I really liked the food here! Went with a group of 5 and got to try some of everything and it was all good. My faves were the lobster tots, the lobster stuffed avocado, and the spicy shrimp! We got a few rolls and I had the best one, Mango Tango.. sweet and spicy and oh so good. The service was great, I can tell our server was well tenured as she knew the menu well and had great timing with all the apps and rolls and entrees we ordered. I had the fish and chips (Cod) and was full when it came so I just had a few bites, but when I had it for lunch the next day after heating it up in the toaster oven it was delish and fries were tastily seasoned. Would be interested in trying the weekend brunch, love seafood!

These are some of the best donuts I've ever tasted. The dough is so light an airy and the frosting is on point. The apple fritters where crispy on the edges, soft on the inside and the apple just right. I love that they included a couple donut holes in my bag, it was a nice surprise! This was my first time here and I'll be back for my families donut Friday tradition we have.

I have been to SmashBurgers before in other states.  I will say that the food here at this location was a bit lackluster compared to what I have experienced before.  However, I would totally return to this location because the staff was outstanding.  I was in town to visit a friend with a baby who was not eager to hang out while we were dining, and I will say that staff was so helpful and nice and made this a good dining experience.  The staff at this location truly impressed me!!

Great way to relax on a Sunday! Did someone say Sunday Funday?! Delicious food and even more amazing drinks! Highly recommend the Mt. Angel Mule! Great atmosphere, chill music, and very friendly and quick staff! I will definitely be back!

I truly enjoy Taco Bell, but this location (which happens to be the closest to my home) leaves much to be desired in terms of service. I was recently one of about 5 people in the restaurant at about 2:00pm. Apparently my order for two $1 potato tacos overwhelmed their staff... Any other Taco Bell can turn the order in about 30 seconds to a minute yet it often times takes this store FIFTEEN minutes. Shame on me for returning.

Group of 4 yesterday.  Don't know who the dishwasher was, but our party couldn't get a clean plate or glass to save our lives. No kidding every single dish had dried food caked on or was wet. Staff was super annoyed when we pointed this out. This was our 3rd and final visit to Unlucky Fins... I never complain I understand it happens sometimes but this was ridiculous especially when the check is $200 for a party of 4.

This place has a great location , great bar, friendly staff, a super cool chalk drawing on the walls and they used to also have an an amazing food menu. They recently changed their menu and got rid of a lot of their fan favorites... such as the curb dip lettuce wraps and others. Don't get me wrong the food there is good I just wish they had not changed the menu. As much as  I love this place unfortunately now I have to find another place to go that has the food that the curb used to

LOVE the Rueben and chicken salad sandwich. I get the Rueben with turkey and they are always accommodating. The service is superb and so fast! I am impressed with the food, service and cleanliness of this little cafe. The soups are all homemade and they even have them ready to go in larger convenient take out containers. It isn't easy to see from Overland, but it's at the Silverstone intersection across from Zamzows. Worth looking for!

Not the best service.  We got here at approximately 3:30.  Drinks & appetizer came in a timely manner. 30 min later the waitress came back & asked what we had ordered.  She mentioned she lost half the ticket.  Order came 30 min later.  There were only 2 other couples in the restaurant at the time.  Food quality was average.

I'd first like to say how amazing Coach Amanda is! She was my daughters coach for summer classes, for a few weeks. She recently moved to the advanced class and we are definitely missing her. She was great at giving the students direction and correcting any mistakes in a nice/gentle manner. The two girls that took over for Amanda don't seem to enjoy their jobs much. They sit and chit chat with each other during most of the class. There is minimal instruction/direction to the students. They aren't very good with young children, based off of the interactions I have seen between them and the students. They talk down to them and make them feel dumb, if they can't  get something right the first time. I feel like they need to focus more on the kids, rather then catching up on their gossip. My daughter use to leave feeling good about herself. But since the new girls have started coaching, she leaves feeling down, if she couldn't get something right the first time trying. The gal at the front desk is not very friendly either. She always seems to busy to help, and annoyed with everyone but I believe that is her only job. Basically customer service. She talks to you like you should know how things are run within the building. God forbid you ask her a question. You will get attitude, no matter what your inquiry is about. I was glad to learn it wasn't just me she spoke to like that. The facility is big and has a lot of equipment. It's a bit muggy in the building, most of the time. And definitely come early if you want a chair. I usually just park on Watertower St, because the parking lot is almost always packed.

I don't know what happened to this location.  The State St. location is excellent, but Meridian has gone so far down hill.  We used to be regulars, and always left satisfied.  A few months ago we stopped in and the service and the food were both bad.  The tortilla soup, a regular order of ours, was very different and tasted bad.  No refills on our water, poor service in general.  The other food was just okay.  Two nights ago we were in Meridian and thought we'd give them another chance.  It was horrible.  My quesadilla was no different than Taco Bell in flavor, and the consistency was a mushy, wet mess.  The soup was nothing but onions, and very little other flavor.  We will not go there again.  It's State Street Corona Village for us only from now on.

Another great experience with Joel! He met me outside before I reached the front door.  I came in to get an inexpensive set of rims for my snow tires so the seasonal switch is easier and less expensive. He showed me exactly what I was looking for and when I changed my mind after the car was on the lift he made a great recommendation! I'm totally happy with my purchase, Joel! I'll be back when It's REALLY spring

I am writing this review after having my Stor-Mor shed for over 13 years.  The reason I am writing about our 13 year new shed is because of the value, dependability, and excellent craftsmanship of it.  

My shed has been used extensively over the past few years.  It is still in excellent shape and all the original parts are still functioning properly.  We are in the market for a new one and they are still the lowest price with an excellent track record with us.  Ours is a 10x20 Gable.  We painted it to match our house colors.  I have never had any issues or concerns with it.

I will miss it but I recently visited Stor-Mor shed and I am "VERY Impressed" with the numerous shed options.  The work bench, loft, and window.  Yes, my next shed will have all 3 added features.  I am looking forward to this purchase.  So, if you are looking for a dependable and durable shed this is it.  NO Exceptions!

I just died and went to heaven. I am not a big meat eater by ANY means but just stopped at Flame Broiler and had help from the KINDEST employee, Kyle. He walked me through the entire experience and acted like I was the only customer he had to serve all day like, taking his time and sharing his references and the best secrets about bowls and combos and sauces. We did two bowls of the half and half dark meats and they had the BEST flavor and moisture and I honestly could have drooled over these bowls. I said yum probably fifty times as I ate my meal. Kyle is the best, these bowls are unreal and the entire experience was MAGIC. I'd recommend avocado and magic sauce on top all the way! Thanks for an amazing meal and beyond amazing customer service. Kyle is helping this business thrive!

The food and service was below par. The menu describes everything as being better than the actual execution. They cut corners in preparing their food and in customer service. If ordering the buffalo steak be prepared for a buffalo patty. If ordering an omelette expect a watery mess. The hash browns taste like Mac and cheese. Both times I went the waitresses made no attempt to find out why my food went untouched. I would give them
0 out of 5 stars but unfortunately that isn't an option on yelp. 
If you are some how dragged to Steve's cafe I would recommend the water.
Best burgers I've had in the Treasure Valley.  I'm from So Cal and I never really cared for In'N'Out like most people do.  I love all the choices and that they serve wine and beer too.

This is a great grocery store. It's not as large as stores like Winco or Costco, but it has a different focus; it provides reasonably priced food, with an an emphasis of specialty items, with convenient and quick service. 

At their produce section they have freshly made packages of  pre-washed corn, stuffed mushrooms, hamburger toppings (slices of onions, lettuce, and tomatoes), vegetables for grilling, and bowls of chopped fruit. Each item is $5. These items are really convenient when you don't want to prepare it yourself but don't want to pay the costs of going out.

They have a decent selection at their deli with your typical items such as potato salad, fried chicken, and a wide variety of other options. In their meat area they have options for pre seasoned cuts perfect for grilling.

They also have a good selection of organic items and vegetarian options that are hard to find elsewhere.  

The flower selection is really good too. I can get a nice bouquet for $10. My wife won't even let me go a florist anymore even on Valentine's Day because she likes these flowers and the price is much better. 

This place has certainly made a remarkable transformation. For a while, the service was terrible, the prices were ridiculous, and they didn't offer  a lot of their convenient prepared food options. But, for the last few years, it's became a great store to visit. They will never be able to compete in price with Winco and Costco so they started to focus on customer service and it's payed off. The lines are much faster than they used to be, and they are quick to get more help if needed. They've reduced their prices down to reasonable amounts and have provided quality food and more specialty items.

Raising my rating from 2-star to 3-stars.
We came in and the entire staff was a bunch of young male kids ... probably 21 and under.  They were a-OK.  It seems like our order took longer than it should have - parties of equal size that came in after us got their order before us.  But overall, this visit as OK; getting better!
Great food and atmosphere.  A little high priced, but its worrh it.

The food was amazing, the prices are fair and the service was fantastic. Love Yelp because it helps us to find awesome places like this. We will be back and the Gouda cheese with the Potato Leek was perfect in portion and price.
I don't recommend this Health Care Facility Susan ricciardi and her staff are very unprofessional ..The staff was very unpleasant to deal with.

This is my new favorite Mexican place!  So much flavor in the food and the service was great!  There was a large group waiting to be seated so there was no place for us to wait for our table. Since it was cold outside, we were discussing going to the bar around the corner for a drink while we wait and they offered to call us when our table was ready!  We took them up on that offer and exactly 15 minutes later, they called and had our table ready!!  I can't even explain how amazing the food was!  I had enchiladas and they were soooo good!  My husband had a chicken chimichanga and a Picadillo tamale....both were delicious!  The chimi has so much flavor and the tortilla was crispy and flaky!  The rice was also pretty tasty!  Oh yeah, best chips and salsa too!  We will definitely be back!

They're a little too concerned with trying to look swanky then caring products that actually makes sense.  when I can't buy a larger jar of Adams peanut butter because it's more swanky to buy smaller bottles of organic peanut butter then you lost me as a customer.

OMG worse place ever 
Bad service: not sure what the bartender is smoking I ask for a drink that tasted disgusting I made vomit it got me sick, will just pass them the urgent care bill but per the bartender it was great.
As soon as you walk in it smells like cigarettes.

Reading the bad reviews on here is a little hard to believe- we have been long term of customers of RC Willey (Summerlin - Las Vegas) and have always had great service. When we located to Boise in June we were excited to see a RC Willey (we did not have the past few years in CA) As always the store delivers great products with great customer service.  Although we have not had our delivery set up yet (waiting on home to be completed) so far every thing we have requested as been completed and in a very efficient manner. Cant wait to get my beautiful furniture.

This has a feel of a hidden gem because it doesn't look like a restaurant from the outside, but it's worth checking out. This is a spot my mom and I always hit for lunch when she is in town. I like the atmosphere and they have a wide variety on their menu. I always go for the lobster Mac and cheese! Mmmmmm! Delicious! Plus, I have come home with leftovers every time which my husband promptly chows down on. My moms favorite menu item are the fish tacos. Very fresh and flavorful. Boise doesn't have that many great local seafood restaurants (seeing as we are land locked), but this one is a good alternative.

If I go to Rosauers it's for the Organic Section aka Huckleberries. I always find what I need and if you have any questions their associates will do everything they can to assist you. Their Customer Service is definitely refreshing. They offer a decent selection of fresh produce and their choices for some one who is dairy and gluten free are excellent.

Yes yes yes!! Gouda grill cheese and tomato basil soup was spot on! Long line but once ordered it came out quick. Small seating area and crowded, loud due to size. It's a grab and go or grab and eat, don't expect to hang out long.

We are mid way through our 'journey' with Mattress Land, a privately owned business by a man who clearly cares about doing things the right way.  Our purchase just made and more to follow when the product is delivered, but the our experience to date was so good as to 'shout out' now. Part of the reason we chose Mattress Land was because of reviews highlighting great customer service.  If our shopping experience is a typical one, top-notch customer care from Mattress Land staff sets the store apart from competitors.

But we also came for the mattresses because, to quote Amy A, just as she typed it in her review, "THIS IS THE ONLY STORE IN BOISE THAT HAS LATEX MATTRESSES!!!".  

Once you've owned a quality latex mattress for the great sleep surface it is, you'll appreciate why Amy A. highlighted that in caps!  So a latex mattress was on our requirements list for a guest room, but Mattress Land also has mattresses in standard innerspring coil formats  as well as memory foam and across all price points.  Something for everyone for a good night's sleep no matter what you snooze best on.  

QUALITY BRAND NAMES ACROSS PRICE POINTS & MODALITIES: 
Not only was Mattress Land, in fact, the only store in Treasure Valley  that carried the quality mattress brand we prefer (Kingsdown) and latex to boot, they also carry other American made company products.  Brands like Sealy, Sleep Fit (which is their brand made for them by Springair), and Stearns and Foster - all brands with traditional innerspring core or mixed with latex or latex only -  as well as Temperpedic and other brand memory foam mattresses.  We weren't shopping for an adjustable mattress, but if you are it is  worth noting that maybe 80% or so of their in-store inventory can be ordered in the position adjustable mattress format.  They have several in the store to try out.

EXPERT, PROFESSIONAL, FRIENDLY  &  PATIENT SALES STAFF:
We started our journey here a couple of  months ago and Brooke, who normally is in their Nampa location, helped us as she was filling in for one of the Meridian store staff.  Today, when  we went back to decide and buy, Daron was the guy who helped us and wrote up the sale.  Both of  them were patient with us during our umpteen questions about mattress materials, construction and dimensions.  We saw them extend the same professional care and courtesy to other customers.

REPEAT CUSTOMERS ARE THE BEST RECOMMENDATION:
If it means anything, while we were shopping, there were two customers who came in to make second purchases because they had been so pleased with their first purchase and the service here.  Those repeat customers have "high praise" value.

COMPETITIVE PRICES:
Prices are competitive to start with for the product lines they carry and just as in the auto sales industry, there is negotiating room on some mattresses.  We sleep on mattresses for many hours each night so if  you were to prorate the price difference in a really top notch mattress over the umpteen nights of sleeping on them during the lifetime of the mattress, it is likely pennies a night difference for the invaluable benefit of great sleep.  But if a lower price is your key concern, they have mattresses that fill that bill too. 

BED FIT DEMO TO FIND THE RIGHT 1.0 - 4.0 FOR YOU:
Light, bright, well laid out for being able to "sleep around" to try out the mattresses inside the store.  And one of the best features is a  BED FIT program which allows you to lay on a mattress while pressure points and sleep postures are identified to help you zero in on a firmness range from 1.0 (most firm) to 4.0 (least firm) which is right for your body and spine.  Since all mattresses for sale in the store carry a designation of 0.5 to 4.0 this will allow you to narrow down your best fit options for optimum sleep.   If you're an "odd couple" of a larger person and a smaller person or a disabled person and able bodied person, you'll find some of the King mattresses can be ordered with one side at one number (say 2.0) and the other side at another number (say 3.0) to keep everyone happy.  

TO BE CONTINUED:
We ordered a mattress from a company which custom makes them in NC so turnaround from order to delivery is about 10 - 12 days.  Mattress Land delivers for free and will take away your old mattress set for free too.  To be continued once our mattress arrives...

THIS N THAT:

1) PARKING:  Private lot shared with competitor Mattress Firm.

2) ACCESSIBILITY:  ADA parking in lot.  Level in from sidewalk through door and all on one level.  Ample aisle space.  Accessible loos, both he and she.

Straight to the point. Wife's fish was good but my plate was fraudulently represented. I was craving a good Cabernet and what better than a good "Kobe" steak to go with Cabernet. Well, not even Wagyu!!  Steak was chewy, thought I would choke if I didn't chew on it with the attention of a 90 year old with dentures. This should not be the experience with "Kobe" but equally as irritating, should not be with Wagyu!!!  This steak was common beef. My gripe was that it's labeled as Kobe!!  In the name of profit I'm ashamed of lucky fins to stoop this low. Pfft!  What ever!!
Best nail job I've had in years! Thank you, well done! Lovely and fast, walked in, got service.

My family and I live near this restaurant and are always looking for a good place to eat breakfast when we are lazy and don't want to cook. I am sad to say this this place is not very good. The hashbrowns tasted like butter (and left a nice pool on the plate) and the country gravy had hardly any taste at all. We were all not very impressed. The place was clean, but being open less than a month I would be disgusted if it weren't. We will definatly keep going to Express Cafe.

Coffee was served hot. Yes they serve good hot coffee. If you'd like a breakfast fare they serve it and never lunch. The young people that work there are nice and professional. The atmosphere is clean and not loud at all with pounding music. It is a good location too because it is at a great intersection of Fairview and Locust Grove.

Decided to try this place out for our anniversary lunch date. After reading other reviews I decided to keep an open mind. I love seafood and I am always looking for new places to try..first let me say this..to the reviewer who said it wasn't fresh...don't be a snob. What we had today was very fresh and very excellent. And I am not from Idaho originally so I do know better..and so do most idahoans anyway. I had the sushi salad. It was fantastic. Sushi rice topped with a great selection of mixed greens, on top of that was shrimp, tuna, and salmon, with cucumber slices and avocado slices. With a sweet yet spicy vinegerette. It was absolutely amazing!! My hubby had the lucky's platter. Coconut shrimp, beer battered shrimp and cod, with their house cocktail sauce, sweet sauce, and tarter sauce. He loved it! As his side he chose the Fuji apple slaw, I tried it and thought it was the perfect compliment to his dish. Dessert was my favorite. We had captain crunch fried ice cream!!! Sooo great. The prices were very reasonable...we got out of there spending $40 with the tip. I will most certainly be coming back. Can't wait to bring my kids...they both love seafood.

Not too bad a place to eat.  The burger I had was the Huckleberry Burger which was quite tasty.  The Bronco Drink with raspberry flavoring was very good, mich like a Sonic drink.  The onion rings were good but didn't quite grab my attention as a "gotta have" item.  The fry sauce made them better.

I cannot say enough good things about my whole experience with Stor Mor Sheds in Meridian Idaho. Marc helped with the design and planning of my shop building, Alex and his crew did a phenomenal job with the construction and finish of the project. All in all, just a great experience. I would highly recommend them to anyone looking to have a shed, shop or garage built.

Yesterday was my very first time tanning and the girl that helped me was friendly but didn't really explain the process I was super lost and I didn't know the differences in shades and all, she didn't even tell me to remove jewelry or any of that (and yes that's kinda on my part too it's logical) but then today I woke up with the worst marks on my wrists. I went back in to fix it and ask them if I can re spray or apply a lotion or for some advice or just something to help me and all they said was "just wait until Saturday or soak in a bath and scrub yourself with a Magic eraser" after I clearly had mentioned I get married on Saturday, they were almost rude and were talking in little words maybe because I went in around 9:13 and it was close to closing? But they were just no help at all! this needed fixing ASAP.. I was so so kind to them and I left feeling so upset bc they didn't have importance to what i was saying.. I went to a different location and they were so different I actually got my wrists fixed and I love the color i got! The lady was ever there past closing just to help me for my big day.

I have been a frequent flyer of the Soup Kettle Grille since they opened. They never disappoint. They staff is super friendly, addressing most people by name. 

The food is just awesome. I took a friend of mine there this evening. She is a gluten-free eater. She had their amazing Gouda Grilled Cheese and fell in love with it. On days like today, a bit gloomy and cool, I opted for the Roasted Chicken Noodle. 

There are a lot of restaurants that could learn a thing or two from this business.

My girlfriend and I were super hungry for breakfast on Saturday morning and we're driving down Overland and she wants Merritt's and I want food NOW! I spotted Harry's and saw their breakfast sign on the window and pulled in. It's a pretty sick atmosphere with more TVs than BestBuy and wall art to keep you distracted from whatever you need distracted from. We ordered the mimosas which were FABULOUS and put in our breakfast order. I had the biscuits and gravy with a side of bacon. The bacon was cooked exactly how I love it without even asking! Not all crunchy and sh*t like everywhere else but not too undercooked. Just right-floppy, juicy, and heavenly. My biscuits and gravy were so bomb! My girl had a ham and veggie omelet which she devoured. We both ate until we thought we would explode and ended up with take home boxes that made a great lunch with still awesome portion sizes.

Well, that awesome experience left us coming back for lunch today (I'm writing this from the table). We ordered up a couple of Bud Lights and I ordered the Reuben with onion rings. My Reuben was pretty good as far as Reuben's go especially for bar fare! It's probably top 3 in the Treasure Valley. Onion rings were awesome and you can tell they were cooked in fresh oil since they weren't overly greasy. My date had the fish and chips but instead of the chips she had the Hideaway Mac & Cheese. So we've started calling this plate the Hideaway fish..in case you want to be cool and ask for it.  The Hideaway Mac & Cheese was soooo good and has a little kick to it which makes you dive back to your ice cold beer (cute trick, Harry), and the fish (like the onion rings) was cooked perfectly and you could tell it wasn't frozen and was cooked in fresh oil. 

We are totally digging this place and will continue to come back! Great service, clean, and damn good food!

Mattress shopping is supposed to be a chore, one of those necessary evils one hopes arises every decade or so. That's what I expected. And it's what I'd gotten... until trying Mattress Land and having the good fortune of meeting Casey Timmons--a delightful fellow who made us feel that he truly cared more about our satisfaction than his commission. We were searching for two twin beds  for 14 year-old boys and two Kings, for our master and guest suites. Where one of his competitors saw potential $$$, Casey simply saw our needs. Yes, he was right about 14 year-olds not needing expensive, top-of-the-line mattresses and platforms. We actually asked to see somewhat more expensive products than the first he showed us. Ultimately, after about an hour of comparing beds and some fine conversation, he found us four beds at a great price (with unadvertised discounts!). Suffice to say, if we or anyone else we know in the Treasure Valley is in need of a bed, we will strongly recommend Mattress Land. And if they call ahead and find Casey working, we may just go mattress shopping with them.

A new low in customer service... After moving from Louisiana I chose  to purchase my appliances from RC Willey because I wanted to do businesses with a local company in my new home town. All my appliances were delivered the day I moved into my  NEW house and the delivery men tore two big gashes in my brand new floor before making a quick exit. Initially I felt reassured that RC Willey would resolve this issue but it has been several weeks and no progress since the initial assessment. I feel I have been extremely understanding throughout this ordeal but I have reached my limit with chasing down updates and/ or trying to move my claim forward. There seems to be only one person that handles claims and follow up on "next steps" have been at a stand still since the contractor inspected my home and assessed that the floor could not be patched or repaired over a month ago. No one from the Meridian, ID store has contacted me to let me know anything about replacement of my floor. Despite numerous phone calls and emails requesting any information about a course of action, I have had no response. I really regret my decision to purchase my appliances from a company that has absolutely no intention of resolving their customer claims. Really disappointing that my first experience as a new home owner will involve having to seek legal action to get my damaged property fixed

Kim is outstanding. I have never gotten a French fade before and was nervous nobody could get it right or get the shape to fit my finger shapes. I am overjoyed! They turned out SO beautiful and the shape was absolutely perfect. Thank you Kim!

RC Willey is selling Amana dryers that have a design flaw. Mine broke one year and three months after I bought it. The repairman (to whom RC Willey refers its customers) said "It is unrepairable. It has a design flaw." I presented this information to RC Willey customer service. They said it wasn't their problem as it was outside a year and I didn't buy the extended warranty. I put them on notice, but they are continuing to sell this Amana dryer that is essentially $400 worth of garbage. Consumers beware!

Boston Shake: shake with a sundae on top!
S 4.19 | M 5.09 | L 6.19 | XL 7.29
I ordered the medium and it was huge - a small would be sufficient for sure.  You choose a shake flavor and then you choose a sundae flavor.  I ordered the s'mores shake and the chocolate sundae.  It was good.  Really sweet, but good.  And I could taste little crumbs of graham cracker in it.  I didn't taste any marshmallow though, so I wouldn't say it was s'mores.  More like graham cracker and chocolate.

Huckleberry Burger
4.99 | 5.49 w/Cheese 
+ $2 to add fries and a drink
Way sweet.  Needed something to cut through the sweetness (even though there were red onions on it).  And it's not that "it's not for everyone" because we've done the donut burger at Barrelhouse.  It just didn't work - needs to be re-worked.

Finger Steaks
9.89 (comes with fries)
Way salty.  I mean inedible salty.  I had to immediately take a drink of shake with each bite as it was so incredibly salty.  I peeled off the batter to see if it was the batter or the meat, and it was definitely the batter.  Dipping it in ranch just made it worse.  The meat was salty too - but not near as bad as with that batter on it.  And there's not even a lot of batter - - - or a lot of finger steaks for that matter - - - but the salt is just so concentrated.  $9.89 for the amount of finger steaks is well overpriced.  It's $3 more than the chicken strips.  And if you peel away the batter you can see how little beef there actually is in each finger steak.

The staff was fine, the service was quick, the place was busy, and they seemed to be on top of the cleaning of the tables.

I've never had a meal that was bad here. Everything I've tried I would reccomend to someone. Beers on tap are decent,  just depending what beer you like. I absolutely love the Adult Mac & Cheese with grilled chicken, but their newest CurbBallz are crave worthy too
I really look forward to the fall and to having laurie's delicious soups. It's always fun to see what she creates I love the family vibes there too. Good people. Good food great soup!
Bar area better than I expected. Nice live music and happy hour deals. Albertsons, however, still pricey. Beautiful store. Have to admit I like it.

This place is so great. My friend and I called only an hour or two ahead of time and were able to make appointments. The color selection is amazing and the techs are knowledgeable and friendly. Can't wait to come back!

Fantastic !! 

That is the word to describe our experience. First we went on a Friday night, fully expecting it to be busy. Yes we had a wait. During the wait we were asked if we would like drinks, nice, then they brought my 4yr old daughter some goldfish to nibble on, impressed, then the owner came around with a plate full of shrimp nachos, fantastic.

We were seated and our waiter was very patient with all of our questions,nice, drinks were strong and delivered quickly,impressed, and our bill was very very reasonable, fantastic.

Our food: the kid, corndog, not much can go wrong so they get a pass on that one. I had the surf and turf stir-fry, full of shrimp both large and small, lots of steak and tons of flavor, very impressed. My wife had the cedar plank salmon, cooked PERFECTLY, very moist and full of cedar flavor. Fantastic.

The most impressive part to us was the OWNER came to our table at least three times to check on us, and the CHEF made two appearances just to make sure we liked our meals. We are ordinary people, this made us feel like rockstars and the place was busy which made it even more special. 

Again.... Fantastic is the word. The place is Lucky Fins !!!

I only ordered a grilled cheese with mushrooms and swiss, but it was truly magical and delicious. My dining partner from Chicago, ordered the Chicago Hot Dog and swore it was better than any dog she has gotten in Chicago, it even had the celery seed. The regular fries were rosemary and salty goodness. We both paid less than $10.

If I lived closer, I would be here often.

Today was our first visit to Lucky Fins.  I've been hesitating to visit because we tried their sushi (that's sold at Reel Seafoods), and it was so gross that we threw most of it in the trash!   However, a recent discussion with a friend convinced me to give it a try.

Dad & I have been jonesing for a shrimp po-boy sandwich since our drive through the New Orleans area, and we finally got one today.   First, we had the clam chowder.   It was OK, but I probably wouldn't order it again.   Next came the unique calamari.   It was a large order of calamari rings, served hot with a nice light breading.   We loved the key lime aioli that came with it.   While we enjoyed that, the po-boy arrived.   It was at least 4" tall & full of shrimp!   The bread was soft (can't really call it a baguette) and just wonderful for the sandwich.
