I asked for the chipotle aioli to be served on the side, and I was glad I did...  that sauce didn't pair well with the po-boy.

Service was friendly, but a little bit inconsistent.   The server didn't bring catsup, despite the mound of french fries on the plate.   At the end, it seemed like a long wait for the check.   Also, we were visited by a man who I gathered was the manager in a long-sleeved plaid shirt at the beginning of our meal.  He said he'd be back to see how things went, but we were there for another hour and he didn't return.

We liked the sea-related decor in the bar area, with the jellyfish lights and the metal sailfish.   The main dining room, however, had very little in the way of ocean ambiance.  The restrooms were clean & spacious.

We'd certainly consider visiting again.
What is there not to like about this place.  I think their chicken is really good.  I am always treated well by all their employees.  My favorites are the chicken strips and nuggets.
Absolutely love it here they got the best fresh squeezed orange juice and much more!! You Have to check it out!!!

Best fish n chips in town!, try it, u'll not regret it! As much as i love to have 3 pieces, I can't finish it so I have to settle for 2.  I love their fuji apple salad that comes with it. Tried their shrimp cocktail and it was awesome. :)

I always have such diverse experiences here. I love the decor, very quirky! The coffee is always delicious. The people vary. Some have been talkative, some say nothing and aren't into customer service. When doing work, the atmosphere would be perfect. Very clean and quiet ambiance.
From sale to delivery, RC Willey was an ease to work with. Quality chair was delivered by 8am & the guys were polite, friendly, and efficient. Have and will use RC Willey.

Always a supporter of the government worker. I too am in public service.

 HOWEVER, our mail is often not received and many times delivered to us by those with the same 3 numbers in their address, or their street has the same first letter. NOTHING else being similar: name, street, or direction.

Have tried numerous times to contact the post office to complain of services and of grave serious concerns. In return, pretty much expressions, without saying, they don't care. This would include the Post Master who doesn't return phone calls and makes excuses for employees who just don't bother to read the writing on the mail. 

The simple neglect or complacency of their responsibilities have left us often missing important mail at tax season, late on filing important documents,  and a few packages, paid for, that just never arrived.

If it weren't for the kindness of strangers we might never receive packages and/or mail. By our calculation strangers deliver sometimrs more accurately and consistent they those who are paid. 

For those who get my mail, are honest enough to not keep packages, and continue to drive to my house making sure I get it. Thank you Thank you Thank you

I was freaking out about that box of checks I ordered!!!

I love this Albertstons store!  It reminds me a little of HEB in Texas.  The food is always fresh and fantastic, and the samples are amazing.  I wish they would open up a lot more like this all over the valley.  It is a great place to get a variety of food that you cannot find altogether in one place, like organics and hard to find items.
Off the hook good!  My favorite was the biscoff with cookie butter and you can never go wrong with the choc chip.

I hesitate to review, as I hate crowds.  Fact, you can find anything!  Fun, not only does this have a full bar with Happy Hour, you can have a full meal, snacks or appetizers.  If you cannot find something to enjoy, you are just not trying. Everything is reasonably priced. Sat on the patio, all had different drinks and everyone brought back something different to eat.  One downside is small patio seating.  In addition the in-laws sent me a beautiful bouquet and Marketplace is the one that put it together and delivered it.
Love the selection of organic products they have here. Cant beat the beer and wine choices either. Only thing I've found similar to the Boise Co Op or whole food thats on this west side of town.

Alright. I have been to Wahooz a handful of times since my last post, but this last visit in August took me by surprise. This place has changed so much!!

We were out at dinner when all of a sudden we were arguing about who was better at mini-golf. So, we decided to put our skills to the test and raced to Wahooz once dinner was over. One of their course options (my personal favorite) was closed for remodel or upkeep. I look forward to being able to play it again.

The main reason for my lower star count is that their arcade area has slowly been dwindling away. This is a large reason my family typically goes. They've used half of the arcade area for an inside rope course. It feels like they're trying to pack too much into the space sometimes. After all, they still have mini golf, bumper boats, go-karts, laser tag, bowling, etc. They also have a very small selection of prizes for their arcade game and it seems to get smaller and the items seem to cost more 'tickets' as time goes on.

Overall still a great place to go and have a fun evening - I just wish it didn't seem so crammed.

We came here for the first time on our way home and grabbed some shakes. Oh my gosh they are delicious. I've been here 3 times in the last week, I haven't had a flavor I wouldn't get again yet. Best so far was the grasshopper and my husband loves the watermelon! Staff is always very friendly and we will probably be back again within the next couple days for our shake addiction.

Honestly, I was a bit nervous about shopping here after seeing the reviews. However, the overall experience that we had here was good. The purchase and the assistance on the floor itself was quite good and the sales person that we had was very knowledgeable but not pushy. They were friendly and offering, options and give us the information without feeling like we had to make a buy.

We opted for a 20 percent down and pay the remainder a few days later when we picked up our products. We were told that we could call in a head of time and ask them to pull our item and have it ready for us. Once we got here though it was not pulled and we had to wait longer than expected. Even with that the customer service was good and the people in the back were friendly.

Most of the pricing was comparable on furniture to other stores in the area. Electronic seemed a bit more expensive and for those kinds of items I would probably go elsewhere.

Man this was one of the best breakfasts Ive had in a long time the hot chocolate was amazing and the biscuits and gravy were so rich and delicious they knocked my socks off, Steve  the owner came to my table to make sure everything was perfect  I felt VIP. I will be going at least once a week.

High expectations lead to disappointments. Flavors were not evident in the proteins and everything was just blah. Got our food right at noon and there were only two other customers around. The employees were taking breaks at the rush of the lunch hour because they were bored. What does that tell you? Back to Panda Express.

My mom and I were talking about this store again yesterday - a week after we had visited.  It's in an old Shopko location, 100,000 square feet plus, so much bigger than the average Albertsons.  To put it mildly, if it's not in this store - it may not exist.  There's a tavern / bar inside the store - something I would expect from Whole Paycheck, not Albertsons.  They had stations for just about every cuisine imaginable - fresh made chips and guacamole?  Check.  Popcorn? Check.  Grill? Check.  I could go on and on...

This store was very similar to some of the Smith's Marketplaces I've been to in terms of selection. I asked one of the employees if this concept was going to start rolling out to Safeway and the other related chains - it sounds like the two stores in the Boise area are guinea pigs and will start rolling out to other chains.

Came here just to see how good it was. Not impressed at all. Higher prices than I expected for the amount of food you get. Food was warm when served.... not hot. A so very average place to eat. Won't go back.

Great local place, good atmosphere and a personable staff. The tacos are incredible.
If you're looking for a good local place to hang out with friends food and some drinks this is it
Super good food and fast. Our new favorite soup and sandwich place.  Babcia would be proud!
My daughter introduced me to this location and I really enjoyed the meal. The spice from the soup (Buffalo chicken) and the sandwich was a perfect combination.  I'm a fan for life. Tha ks

By far the best breakfast in the Treasure Valley.  Service is spot and....And they give you a big mug of coffee, unlike most of the places that treats coffee like army rations.

The Sausage is home-maid and awesome.  I do not east carbs, but Steve's has options  and no additional charge.  

The Owner is a very nice, and the recipes come from his family, does it get any better?

My only complaint is I only go during the week, to packed on the weekend.
Great but maybe the presentation needs some work. Server was friendly, prices are ok.

These are SO SO GOOD. The cookies are giant, warm and gooey. Delivery is super speedy, and just walking in is quick as well. I am honestly scared that this will be a weekly event in my house as everyone is in love with this place. We have had several different varieties and they are all amazing.  We love Crumbl!!

This place advertises they have sushi but i guess that its only on selective days.  The servers are good but  most the food is average. The party of 8  i was with where all torn on what we thought of our meal. I thought it was ok some thought it wasnt good and expressed they where not interested in returning while others thought it was really good. All in all im not impressed and have no intentions on going back to this place as for the quility of the food is not worth the price they charge.

We went to RC Willy to buy furniture for our new home in Eagle. We needed everything! I was completely impressed with the customer service and quality of furniture we purchased. Terry was an amazing sales associate and personally handled a couple minor issues we had. Delivery guys were so nice and professional as well. The only thing I would say they could work on is it takes WAY too long to check out.

We've been having perfect "seafood weather"....cold, wet, and overcast....so I thought it the perfect time to try Lucky Fins.  The restaurant is very cute and cozy. It reminds me of an old-timey train station. Wait staff were efficient but not overly attentive.
I ordered fish and chips. Hub had battered shrimp.
Pros: ample portions, flavorful batter, crispy fries, nice sized, plump shrimp, and amazing apple coleslaw.
Con: the batter on both our dishes had separated from the fish. Mine was soggy on the bottom. If you are doing deep fried fish, you need to pat the fish dry before battering. Wondering if the cod was frozen. It was more watery and rubbery than flaky. 
This wasn't the best fish and chips I've ever had, but it was tasty enough to satisfy a seafood craving.

I have been to almost every vape store in the Nampa/Boise area and this store is by far the best! Not only is it a beautiful store, the customer service is excellent. I drive from Nampa to this store for all my e-cig needs even thou there are 4 or 5 stores in Nampa because they are worth the drive!

Having done online research and planned out this major purchase for months, I stopped by Mattress Land in Meridian after work to continue the in person decision making process. The staff specifically Dave was extremely helpful and guided me through the sleep fit process and showed me a few mattresses that met my requirements. When it came down to putting together the final package he was very patient and responsive to my questions. My mattress had to be shipped from the warehouse and was delivered and set up very professionally. Almost white glove service as far as I am concerned. I love my new adjustable bed and super comfortable mattress and am so glad I went to Mattress Land/Sleep Fit!
Staff was so friendly! Quick. Gluten free, dairy free, and vegetarian options clearly labeled. Lots of fresh options. Good food. Awesome spot.

What a Fabulous Cafe!  We all found something we loved.  The sweet potato fries were the best I have ever had.  The reuben and French Dip were great.  Omelet fresh and tasty too. 
We have been back several times.  Portions are good, and the smaller options are wonderful when I'm not so hungry.

Staff was friendly and efficient. 

Can't say enough about this place.
Kim the owner does an amazing job and always is always accommodating changing schedules

I am in a weird spot with this place. We ended up here in a pinch to get a hole patched.

My friend was driving my car and did most of the transaction. 

She noted how great their customer service was. From what I hear, they greeted her as she pulled in and started helping her immediately upon walking in. I got there just in time to give my personal info since it was my car.

They ended up doing the patch for free (with the promise of a good review online).

My original review of Les Schwab was poorly. I have revised that at this time as their quote may have been correct as they have been backed up by another facility.

I apologize for the veracity of my original content.

What joke!!! A full one third had no meat on it at all.  Cheese was sparse at best.  You're far better off with a frozen pizza from the store.  I have to wonder what happened to Pizza Hut.  Are they all like this one?

This is an update.  

Just saw that they are, as of 9-7-17, advertising 50% off.  Based on my experience, it should be 75% off, always!!!!  You get 25% of what Pizza Hut used to deliver.  For decades I was a dedicated Pizza Hut customer.  No more.  Buy store bought frozen.  Way better.

UPDATE:  6-11-19
Bad news, the two for one on Wednesday is no more and the fries are in but I have to say they were cold and stale. That was disappointing.
I got two Gyros and they were pretty good though so they're still holding their own.

UPDATE: 4-10-19
Okay, now I have been here five or six times and every single time it's been a great experience. Whether coming through the drive-through or dining in my experiences have been great.
Staff working here are friendly and knowledgeable and super helpful. Place is immaculate and there's more meat on the Gyr then I can describe. The place is great.

I have come here 2 times and enjoyed the food both times. I got a basic Original Gyro. Really good. Best I've had in years. 
80/20 Beef to lamb ratio. Great seasoning and sauce. Big portion. Priced rI will start trying the others now each week.
Did not follow my directions. Not only am I angry at Fred for apparently being an idiot, but I won't be back.

So I have been looking for a new nail place for about a year (yes a year,  it's been a struggle)  and this is by far the best salon I've been to.  The place is very clean and organized,  and the lady that did my nails was very attentive on asking questions.  The reason I have 4 stars is because on the foot/leg massage she had told me she applies a lot of pressure (which I said was fine)  and when it came down to it..  It was not.  I told her she could apply more pressure and she said she didn't want to hurt me. I tried to explain to her my best friend is an MT and I'm used to deep tissue, so she wouldn't hurt me. Maybe she couldn't go harder or maybe because it was my first time,  I am not sure.  Also when she was doing my nails she was asking me to relax every 5 seconds..  If I was any more relaxed I might as well have been unconscious lol she stopped once I asked her to stop asking me to relax,  otherwise everything was great.  I tried to post a picture but I don't know how, My toes and nails look wonderful and chances are I will come back again!

MASSIVE FLY PROBLEM. Literally dozens and dozens of flys just flying all over the restaurant. They attack you the entire time you're there, all over your food the whole time you're eating,  constantly having to swat them away. Can only imagine what it's like in the kitchen, and frankly, I don't know how the health inspector hasn't shut this place down because of it. Have had to leave early twice because the flys are just THAT unbearable. Food is alright but I won't be back.

First trip here found on Yelp. I have to say the food was pretty good. I couldn't ever quit get over the in house sit down dining with really low quality bowls for salad and sandwiches wrapped just in paper. Loved the buffalo chicken soup but my salad came out with really cheap and small "to go" bowls and the salad extras came out in small portioned cups. Barely enough to tase. Quality of the ingredients was good, Just not impressed with the salad. Very friendly people but they need to get a little quicker service and present a little better in my opinion. If I'm dining in I'd rather not feel like I'm eating on a picnic table inside

Having had my kids in charter schools and public schools around the US, Ambrose has been an amazing find.  The teachers genuinely care for the kids and the moral standard is amazing...  the curriculum is tough in the upper grades, but my kids are thriving...

Absolutely terrific SERVICE starting from the greeting at the counter when I walked in, to the information when when I was finished. 

I stopped in with no appointment on a busy Saturday with a recurrent slow leak. They promptly found the problem, a nail, and got me on to my weekend list, NO CHARGE! Fast, friendly, reliable. Thank you.

We will never purchase a car from any auto ranch again. Our salesman was great but beyond that it was a nightmare. We were told the car we purchased came with a 3mo. warranty on the power train. After having the car for a less than a week we started having problems, which were part of the power train go figure. They would not honor what we were told and then sent us in the mail the letter in the photo informing us we had just been screwed. They were not honorable. My husband has spent so much time and money fixing this car.

I have been here twice in the last month, and both times have had great food, been treated well, and enjoyed my experience.  First time I had a turkey sandwich and fries (I was playing it safe). It was very good.  Fries were awesome!  Second time, I got a little adventurous and tried the chicken-fried steak breakfast. OMG.  The best I have ever had! I could tell it was homemade... super flavorful, awesome gravy, crispy hash browns (soft in the center), and even the scrambled eggs tasted wonderful!  My husband had a two-egg breakfast both times and he loved his food. This is now our go-to place for great breakfast food (and lunch!).  Can't wait to come back and try something new.
My first time at a Lush location! I asked a lot of questions that were answered by their knowledgeable staff. I look forward to using their products.

Not great customer service. I had my oil changed a couple months ago due to a loose oil plug as well as a tire leak. As I walked in to the store the kid at the front desk "greeted" me with a "what do you want?" On top of that it took them over an hour to rectify my needs. Other customers showed up after me and left before me(it was not that busy, there was an average of 2-3 other people in the lounge the entire visit). Some of the worst customer service I've experienced in quite some time.
I've only been once and don't think I'll be back anytime soon; due to location.  The sandwich I had was good and the service was very friendly.

Dr. Anderson is one of those rare finds; a Dr. who truly listens to you, knows the right questions to ask to get the most effective information, puts it all together for the most efficient personalized results, and delivers those results with precision gentle adjustments, personalized for each visit. Plus, I really appreciate that she explains what she's doing and why. I always leave feeling great as well as educated. 

I had been going to a different Chiropractor for months (before I went to Dr. Anderson), who created more damage to me than when I first started going to him. He would just give me the exact same adjustments every time. I left him and found Dr. Anderson, whom in the first few visits correctly diagnosed my problem and relieved the chronic pain I had been experiencing for months. Thank You Dr. Anderson!

It feels like such a "shot in the dark" to find someone great. I feel like I got lucky finding Dr. Anderson. I Highly recommend her.

I saw that the place got so bad reviews but I had to try it out because I've also heard their sandwiches were amazing and worth it.  I have eaten there 3 times now and the food has been fabulous.  I have also been fortunate to served by a girl named Shaniqua.  What wonderful and kind service you get.   I tip her extra every time I go there.  All of the staff has been great.  My favorite though is not a sandwich.  I like the Asian wrap and they have a great broccoli and cheese soup.  Go and enjoy, ask for Shanigua (can't be her real name) and tip her well and get some of the best food a place like this can give.

Pretty spendy for what you get, they did offer a couple vegetarian options which is nice...good drink specials but the bloody mary tasted like marinade with all the worcestershire sauce.  Overall the food was so-so, the mixed drinks weren't all that great, and the favre jersey on the wall didn't help either (but didn't affect our rating).

The coffee is superb and the food delicious and fresh. Hands down the best coffee and cafe food in the Boise and greater area (having sampled a LOT of the so-called "best coffee places " that come up in reviews). This is the last week of opening so definitely come and try it before it disappears ..

Drastically declined over the past few years with new administration. My kids hated it. 
They are finally happy, learning and not stressed to the point of illness any longer. We now attend Nampa Christian and love it. I'm sad for the kids stuck in this prison.
Don't Be afraid to try the ribeye. I went against my rules only ordering a seafood entrée at a seafood restaurant. Ribeye was one of the best I've had and very reasonable for $24
Went for dessert last week with a few gal pals. Wonderful little place with friendly staff! I think for people with small children its probably good for a weekly treat. Ill probably go once a month.

This is the first LUSH location in our area, so it's no wonder that the place was absolutely packed for their Grand Opening party this past Saturday.  It was my first time inside.

I was impressed by the friendliness and knowledge of the staff.  They were well-trained and could answer any of the questions I had about the products.   Although the shop is rather small, the variety of lotions, bath bombs, face masks, shave creams, and other bath/beauty items is astounding.

The company is very environment-conscious, opting to keep many items un-packaged and other packaging is 100% recycled.  They also have a container trade-in program.

Because many items are out in the open, the fragrances could be overwhelming to anyone sensitive to scents.

Thinking about opening their cute pink boxes make my mouth water. 
Their cookies were so yummy and they had amazing flavors! They always have chocolate and sugar cookies and rotates seasonal flavors every week.
The store is also so really pretty! I just wish they sold coffee there too but I know I will go there even if they don't have coffee! Lol!

Loads of fresh seafood yes please!!!! Fish and chips and shrimp fried in canola oil instead of soybean oil???!!!! Yes please!!! The restaurant is beautiful and the drinks were so delicious. I had a strawberry lemonade martini that was so great. It was one of the truly great drinks where the memory of the flavors linger on days after in your mind. Our waitress was patient and accommodating. They even added a bun to my seafood platter so that I could make a sandwich with my fish. Everything was fresh and tasty. What I loved is that even though my meal was fried, it didn't have that overly greasy oily taste.  Their lobster tater tots are also delicious. The only thing that stinks is that they got rid of heir all you can eat crab special. Bring that back Lucky Fins!!!

First time I went I was impressed by the looks of the place thinking it was a Whole Foods knock off but you have to beware of  hydrogenated items and look for organic items.  The one purchase we made, was incorrectly wrung up at the cashier. We had to go to customer service for a refund. 
Second time I purchased a fruit tart from bakery and could not eat most of it because of the strong rosemary taste due to the garnish.

Celia was perfect. The entire place was clean and well managed for the current situation. She got us in and got our haircut and got us out in great timing but was also very careful to listen to what we wanted and both mine and my daughters haircut came out wonderful!

I had to get a couple dozen donuts for a meeting. I am from out of state so I relied on Yelp to direct me to somewhere great to get some fresh donuts. They didn't disappoint! Super fresh, delicious, and carefully packaged by the owner. Very pleased. Thank you.
Love the 48 hour chicken!  Friendly staff and things move fairly efficiently.  Even got us in on a busy night when we made reservations at the wrong location.

We eat here a couple times a week. Don't let the fact that it is inside a gas station fool you, this place it top notch. The food is fresh and hot! It is consistently good and reasonably priced. I typically get the ham and swiss, my husband usually gets The Original. Both are excellent choices. Go ahead and add that brownie, too, you won't be disappointed.

The attractions are fun for the kids. The service was terrible in the food area though. I sat at one of the tables near the door. I orders a buffalo wrap of the menu. She said I had to pay ahead of time, which I thought was weird considering I'm sitting at the table where there is a call button to push for the check. However, I paid cash. She came back for more cash, my wrap was suppose to be $9.99 and I gave her $12. She later came back for more. Which didn't make sense considering it was $9.99. When my food came out I got a buffalo chicken sandwich not the wrap and it took forever to get to the table. I then waited to tell her about the mistake. She however, never came back because I had already paid and tipped her. Awful service. Watched her not be attentive to many other tables during my 3 hour time waiting for the kids. This was on Memorial Day at around noon.

This place has become such a disappointment lately. I'm unsure if they are severely understaffed, or if something else is going on, but the hours are so inconsistent. Roughly half the time, the lobby isn't open at all. There are often limited hours posted on the drive thru, but they aren't always open during those hours. 

When they are busy, be prepared to wait. A couple weeks ago, I went in to be told it could be up to half an hour before my food was ready. 

I will say though, the employees are consistently friendly, and apologetic if things are slow. I hope they manage to return to their former standard.
Sick with a cold and husband stopped at this Gyro Shack on his way home from work. Best food ever!!  I love my Husband and Gyro Shack!

The Top Shelf margaritas are hands down the best margaritas in town!  You can't lose on any of the platters. The chicken and picadillo are flavorful and moist. The handmade tortillas are delightful.  Friendly staff treats us like family.  This Corona Village location has been one of the most consistent restaurants in Meridian.  Quality is top notch and has not wavered since our first visit 7 years ago.

To other reviews: Anyone that bases their review of a Mexican restaurant on nachos should not be allowed to review Mexican restaurant.  Everyone knows that nachos are not Mexican.

On our second visit to Steve's Cafe, we were pleasantly surprised to see the restaurant as already gained a following so there was a 15-20 minute wait.  The staff served coffee to waiting patrons.  Since we had breakfast last visit, we decided to try their lunch menu this time.  Portions are huge so I chose to order off the smaller portion menu on the back of the menu.  Opted for a burger and cup of soup.  Soup of the day was reuben soup, which sounded intriguing to me since I'm a big reuben fan... The burger was moist and juicy with a fresh bun.  Toppings were the standard fair - lettuce, tomato, onions slices and pickles.  Burger was good, but nothing special.  The reuben soup on the other hand, was fantastic!  Corned beef, carrots, potatoes, cabbage, onions in a broth served with rye croutons and swiss cheese melted on the top.  We finished off our lunch by splitting a piece of cake among the group.  The cake looked better than it tasted.  I'll skip dessert next time...  The restaurant is clean and the staff friendly.

Best Deli in Boise, been going there for 20 years. They have reasonably priced food thats off the charts. A sandwich for anyone as well as many other sides, Fried Chicken, Potato and mac salad, awesome fries, chocolate moose, Cheesecake...I could go on. The staff have always been professional and and willing to do whatever to make sure you get a good meal. Highly recommend.

A colleague mentioned the frosted sugar cookies here, so we headed down Friday afternoon to check them out. 

Our first impression wasn't great - they didn't say anything to us when we walked in.  There were 3 or 4 people working, they all looked at us, and no one said hello or welcome to Crumbl or anything.  
We walked to the counter and then a girl came to take our order.  I told her we'd never been and asked if they have these cookies all the time and she explained that the milk chocolate chip (a warm cookie with milk chocolate chips) and the chilled sugar (a chilled sugar cookie topped with sweet almond frosting) were all the time and that the others rotate weekly.

This week's cookies were churro (a warm cookie rolled in cinnamon sugar topped with cinnamon buttercream and a sprinkle of cinnamon sugar), lemon glaze (a warm lemon sugar cookie topped with lemon glaze and a slice of lemon), peanut butter & jelly (a warm peanut butter cookie topped with peanut butter frosting and raspberry jam), and s'mores brownie (a warm chocolate and graham cracker cookie filled with a mix of milk and semi-sweet chocolate chips topped with marshmallow creme and graham cracker crumbs).

$3.48 for 1 or $10.98 for 4 is a no-brainer.
We went with the chocolate chip, the sugar, the lemon and the s'mores.
The sugar cookie was awesome.  Sometimes those ones have an unpleasant after taste.  Actually, all the time.  This one did not.  I was soooo happy with this cookie!  Just pure buttery almondy sugary sweet deliciousness.  And not too sweet.  Just perfect all the way around.  My son had the s'mores and gave me a bite - it was really tasty too and warm with that melted marshmallow center.  The lemon was a fail.  A huge fail.  It was bland, missing the lemon in the cookie and on top.  The chocolate chip did not have enough chocolate.  It was a good cookie, but not great.

The pink box is cute.  We may go back - probably just for the sugar cookies though.

I visit flame broiler often, and have never been disappointed, I came in this afternoon and got the same thing I usually get and have been nauseous all day ever since! not sure what the problem was today but something was off from every other time I've eaten here. A little nervous to go back.

All three locations have good equipment, staff, and services.  However, when you sign up for a month to month membership, you are asked to pay the first and last month dues up front.  The salesman will reassure you that this isn't a big deal.  Then when you go in to cancel, you'll be told that the last month dues is not refundable and so basically you get billed for your last month twice.  I questioned the policy, and the assistant operations manager told me that in her 10 years experience they have never refunded a single last month due, and that it was basically a cancellation fee in disguise.  And she proceeded to tell me that basically Axiom is still doing all the same stuff Gold's Gym used to do they just re-labeled it.  Not impressed.  I was sold one thing two years ago and am now finding it is the same old dishonesty.

Celia has been my hair stylist for over 8 years now! 

She's guided me through every cute trend I've ever wanted to try and has even fixed my own "experiments" at times. You cannot go wrong with a new 'do from Celia.

We've bonded over coffee and raising children. So, aside from leaving her chair feeling cute, I always feel like I've just caught up with a friend.

Amazing service!!
Purchased 2 queens from Casey.
Friendly, helpful service!
Would recommend this store without any hesitation.
Ask for Casey

I love the staff here. The products are great. Store is clean, neat and orderly. The prices are too high, though. That's really my only complaint about this place. I like it other than that. Would recommend.
My favorite thing about this store is their Huckleberrys side.  Love this section. They have the best products.

Went 2 fridays ago in the evening. Of course, they pick the rudest person to run the register. The person who literally yells "what can I get you?" As we're walking through the door threshold taking our sunglasses off. I just ignored her because I hate that! She then preceded to make it very clear that she hates her job and hates us for ordering cookies. I quickly order 4 cookies despite never being there before. No joke: she runs our card, then walks away without a word.  Comes back a couple minutes later, gives my husband a "what do you want?" look, then says "someone else brings your cookies out." Gave us a good laugh I guess when we got out to the car! The cookies were large and dense, but I would probably only order sugar cookies next time if we ever go back because they were the moistest/ softest.
The pizza would be great if it didn't have onions on the pepperoni or the all meat. There's always most of the time there's onion under the cheese.

This place has made me enjoy working out again! One of the things I missed about where I used to live was my cycle classes/instructors and was having trouble finding good ones here. CycleBar instructors/classes are even better than my old ones! All the instructors are encouraging and energetic. Music they pick is fun and easy to ride to. CycleBar also provides towels and shoes to clip in.
I am so crazy about Bardonays fish and chips I was afraid to try Fins. They were fantastic and their coleslaw was incredible. Wait staff so friendly. Very enjoyable experience.

Friendly customer service lessons could be held here. A nail went through my tire and I needed to find a place to fix it without needing four new tires. After calling around, Les Schwab said they would do it for free and put the tire back on the car and put the spare back under it. All for free! They were so nice and I appreciated their wonderful customer service during this stressful experience. Y'all rock!! Definitely coming back for tires!

Maija is fantastic!  Would definitely recommend her for weddings.  Very easy to work with and beautiful results.  Our wedding photos turned out better than we could have imagined!  Maija did her due diligence and toured the wedding venue prior to our big day.  She discovered some unique and stunning areas on bridges and near streams around the venue to give us a variety of shots... totally unexpected and absolutely amazing.
Maija is sweet, fun loving and a joy to work with.  Easy to communicate with and responds promptly.  She did everything that was asked of her and so much more.  We are so happy to have chosen her to be our photographer!
xoxo
I had the lettuce wraps. They were so good. Love the drawings on the chalk board walls.

It seems ridiculous to leave a review for a fast food restaurant but this place is terrible.  This isn't based off one visit... or five... but many many visit.  Tonight my order was actually correct but the means inside my burrito are hard and my soda tastes like carbonated water.  Usually the order isn't even correct.  And it's the slowest drive thru ever.  I realize nobody checks the reviews of fast food before eating there, so this may seem pointless.  But I'm just throwing it out there in the event that the franchise owner or corporate actually decides to care about quality control or brand representation.

A little disappointed yesterday on my food.  My family can have bread.  I can not.  I asked for a pilgrim In Salad form.  I only received lettuce and turkey.  No cucumbers or sprouts.  It is hard enough try and eat good but when you do and expect the sandwich ingredients as told it should be what you pay for.
I'm so happy to see Earl in ID! Best hot sandwich I've ever had! Italian and Chipotle Chicken Avocado are the best! Great service is a plus!

This is the biggest grocery store I've ever been to in my life. They have so many fresh food options from customized salads, sandwiches, sushi and poke bowls to more. Tons of free samples on the Saturday we went. We stopped in to grab a quick bite for lunch. The woman who served us by the bar was sooo incredibly friendly. Husband had a cubano and liked it. Came with chips and salsa and he ordered a $5 beer. I went and got a poke bowl and my tastes very fresh. I wouldn't shop here every week because it's insanely crowded on the weekend but it's definitely a nice store. How cool is it that you can get a drink at the bar and take your drink and shop?!

Went in for the first time with my husband. We both got dipped cones. One chocolate, one coconut. The ice cream seemed a little soft and was running out any crack it could find. That being said, we should have brought it to the attention of the workers there and had them make us new cones or given them the chance to get us something different while we were there. 

This shoppe has a large selection of milk shakes and many other treats and food options. 

I appreciate the manager, Nick, for taking the time to reach out to me upon reading my complaint and wanting to make things right so that we don't hesitate coming back.

This is the worst place I've been to in my life. I have never written a review on anything, not a restaurant, not on amazon, absolutely nothing... but I've just spent the last 20 minutes downloading apps and whatever I can to write as many reviews as possible to help my fellow Boise and meridian residents, spare yourself some time and go ANYWHERE but here.  The first time I went here to eat we had 8 people so they said 1/2 hour wait, no biggie! Then after two hours I asked for some help. The staff was rude and finally set us at two separate tables nowhere close to each other.  Please just tell me it will take several hours and I will happily go down the street, but no they acted like it was my fault for bringing a large group. Now, this one is on me, I took my family of four back (5 yr old, 3 yr old and parents). They said 15 minutes so we stayed, 1 hr later they tell me a family is eating and when they are done they can seat us. WTF? Just tell me if it's gonna take several hours instead of lying, now I have two starving, crying kids eating pizza at home, well past dinner time. #nevergoingback

This was my first experience getting good quality blinds and I had absolutely no idea what I wanted or what colors to choose.  I was so incredibly nervous and worried I would make the wrong choices. Thank goodness for Liza's expertise and designer eye!!  She spent a lot of time at my home helping me to pick out different types of blinds for certain windows and choosing the fabrics.  I could NEVER have done this on my own.  My blinds were just installed and they are GORGEOUS!!!!  Liza's recommendations were spot on and I am absolutely thrilled with the outcome!!  I can't thank Liza enough for her help and excellent customer service!!!

Went in for a vin inspection to register my car. It's a simple task, it takes like 3 minutes. The receptionist at the front desk was kind and quick to help but the officer she called to help took 40 minutes to come out and look at the car! He was there in the building the whole time. They were both respectful when talking to me, just took way too long for a simple task
It was a lIvely fun restaurant! Delicious food - oysters, sushi! But we all got sick overnight - beware!

Today will mark the first of many, many more stops at Sweet Sensations. These are hands down the best donuts we have EVER had. 10/10 would recommend. The staff was very sweet. The store was very cute and modern looking. The lady ordering next to us overheard we had never been there before and was blown away lol. Now we know we have been missing OUT! She said we'll be back, and she wasn't wrong! We can't wait to come here again. :)

Love my other local Albertsons but dealing with the unpleasant cashier Jim I will go anywhere else.... treats customers like they are a waste of his time and rolls his eyes when asking questions on where things are.

Came here 30 min before closing this week... everyone was super friendly, helpful & energized!  Can't beat Trader Joe specialty products on pricing & quality!  Fav deals thus far will be the salad kits & French roast LOW Acid coffee I can buy here- not avail at Boise Co Op nor Natures Grocery... great addition to healthy grocers near Eagle!

I don't live in the area but I have family that does so we tend to find ourselves in the Treasure Valley a few times a year.  We have a Tax Deduction and sometimes with all the family visiting we bore him to tears so this last visit I decided we would check out the big place off the Interstate finally.   Glad we did!

First off it is big, they have lots of do and more importantly for the games and deals and packages it is reasonable.  The staff was so amazing and helpful.  We got him the unlimited lazer tag wristband that came with bowling and some tokens for games.  I think we paid $29 for that and it was the right way to go for him.  

As the Tax Deduction kept busy in lazer tag we played some games, sat down and had a soda and as adults do here, look at our smart phones a lot.  But even with all that, we were having a good time.  Since this was over Thanksgiving weekend and was really cold I can only imagine what this place is like in summer when the huge water park is going on.

There is even an awesome bowling alley called Pinz, but I am reviewing that separately.  It's a good place!

Handicapped access grade is an A+, parking is close and the entry is smooth for wheeled people.  There is plenty of room to move around and maneuver wheelchairs or knee scooters.

Next family visit we are definitely headed back here for some more fun!

TruGreen has been doing my lawn 11 plus years, I personally know my tech Larry he's done such an amazing job these last few years. Anytime I have to talk to the local branch or  I have any issues Jessica is all over it, she's so sweet and treats my account like I'm family. The service manager Troy runs a tight ship. He is always willing to go above and beyond, one time when my escape artist Dog, cooper escaped my yard not only did he take the time to secure him, he also took the time to call and let me know. We highly recommend TruGreen and have loved our green luscious lawn

After shopping for a king mattress set all day to 5 different furniture and mattress stores we stumbled across Mattress Land in Meridian. It was 20 minutes before closing time. Casey welcomed us as we walked in. He never made us feel rushed and he was 10 times more knowledgable than any other salesperson we had met with at the other stores. We found the mattress that we had been looking for and we saved several hundred dollars over the mattress sets from the other stores that we had looked at all day. The quality of the mattress set is excellent and the customer service from Casey was fantastic. Save time and money and go there first when shopping for a mattress.
Fast food done right !  Good food Always clean!!! And well trained polite staff, what a pleasant experience each time

The staff are experts here! With so many products to choose from I didn't know where to start and how the ingredients affect my skin. The staff listened to my concerns and made recommendations. I'm happy with the vanishing cream, eye cream and a cleaners I got in a sample. The cleanser left a different texture but the results were what I was looking for.

I had thought their service was decent up until today. I had come through and asked for a #12 with a soft taco instead of a crunchy one and they had trouble figuring out how to do this and so the register guy accidentally changed my entire order to a #11 and when i brought this up to get fixed they gave me the quesarito but instead of the soft taco they gave me the shredded chicken rollers so they had managed to mess up my order twice in a row and I'm very unhappy probably my last time going to Taco Bell ever

Surprised by this food option in Albertsons. The food choices are a little hit and miss, but sometimes they knock it out of the park. The atmosphere is a little different at first, but grows on you. Highlights have been the poke bowls, barbecue, and Ivars soup bar (hidden in the back). Great value!

I'm writing this review because we've had three very different "experiences" shopping at RC Willey.

Being new to the area and needing a washer and dryer, we followed the billboards to Willey.  We were then "jumped" once we got to the washers and dryers section of the store and the guy, while being very cordial and pleasant, just wouldn't leave us alone---kept pointing out features and yet wasn't listening to a word we said in response.  Oblivious would be a good description.  Fine.  Bought top of the line units from LG.  Went to pay and found that he had set up the account with both my wife's and my names in the "first name field", which their system couldn't handle so it mashed them into something we recognized but was neither one our names.  Fine.  After undoing that, then there was some other glitch that he did, which had to be undone by the cashier.  At this point I'm just looking for the door and wanting to escape the loony bin.

Second time we were looking for furniture.  Jumped on as soon as we were about 20-feet into the store.  Same fake pleasantness but we were far more successful in keeping them at bay, given our defenses were up (based on our first trip).  Again, got the hell out of there.

After going to several places in town, looking for a cocktail table that we liked at Willey, we were forced into returning to the land of unsuccessful reformed used car sales people.  Gotta tell you that we connected with Kim Williams who didn't pull the high pressure sales crap with us.  She knew her subject, offered thoughts as needed, listened to us, etc.  We bought the cocktail table from her and will deal with her exclusively if we need to buy more furniture there.  She made up for the others.

Visiting from out of town and incorporated a walk (Hampton Inn) to Steve's. It was very good. It beat eating at the hotel with all the craziness. 

Eggs were great, hash browns browned correctly, sausage was very good. I would eat here when I return to Boise.

Awesome and varied daily specials.  Frequent customer but still haven't been able to decide which is better - the food or the service!
This place is SOOOOO worth the occasional wait time!

Love the calming relaxing feel you immediately get when entering. The staff is always so nice. I had a fantastic massage by Vicki. She was so fluid with her motions and pressure was on point. I also had a great facial with Kim. She was great with skin care advise when I asked. Highly recommend Revive!

Instead of telling you when you are purchasing a wristband package that construction has eliminated almost the entire course of one of the miniature golf courses, you get that unexpected experience when you go outside. A simple sign saying sorry for the inconvenience. Wow, maybe, just maybe the people you are giving the money to, could speak up and say btw miniature golf is limited to one course. I know customer service what a concept. Other than that nothing super exciting about this place.

This is one of my favorite cafe's. I have had the Chicken Fried Elk Steak... it's a limited time only dish... PHENOMENAL! Loved! My late husband's favorite was the Huckleberry Stuffed French Toast. I finally tried it... WOW! Portions are perfect, if not a little big, but great value for the food. Service is always good! Well worth the wait on the weekend!

A delicious option for a quick treat and they're open until midnight! I really enjoy the minimalism with only 6 cookie options at a time, with many flavors rotating in and out.  Weekly menus are posted on their social media accounts so you can always be in the know. I have yet to find a cookie I don't enjoy but their sugar cookie is what brings me back time and time again.  These extra large cookies are great for cutting up so everyone can sample the variety. 

Added bonus: the adorable pink boxes make these cookies an easy last minute gift.

Body Calm is a beautiful space with a great feeling to it. I went and had a much Mama-To-Be body massage with Vicki today that reminded me how important it is to take time to rest and recovery from our busy lives. She was very sweet, very professional and very attentive to every area I had asked her to pay special attention to and helped answer any questions I had. My massage was WONDERFUL and put me into the same place as a good meditation or yoga nidra practice! 

I also met Paul who is very kind and added to the good environment and a great first impression of Body Calm. I'd for sure come again and I'm excited to look into the yoga classes they offer here! 

Thanks Body Calm!

Had the black and bleu burger with tots and a bulldog drink, service was great and the food was amazing. We sat outside which was beautiful. The only complaint i had was that the bathroom is small with only one toilet, i had to wait in line just to use it.

Bad news.  Rosauer's is closing this store as of December 2 and leaving the Treasure Valley.  That mean's Huckleberry's, a natural foods and supplements store that is inside Rosauer's, will be gone too.  And all the nice people who work inside will be out of jobs.   It may be that decision makers at this Spokane headquartered grocery chain saw the writing on the wall for their sales getting worse, and they already seemed to lag other stores here, once Albertson's opens their behemouth, state-of-the-art new store planned for near the Village Mall on Fairview and Eagle Road.  Going out of business sale starts on October 11.

I understand and expected slow delivery of our carpet (in stock) Vynal (not in stock, but coming from utah to Idaho. We have waited for over a month. Ordered 1st week October Told vynal will be done Monday-Tuesday 2 days installed. (We will see) Carpet to be couple days after vynal.  Paying for purchases at time of order it's a little frustrating! We discussed discount or compensation for long delay which we were told something can be discussed. I'm going to give a lower score & once job is done & if promise of discount is given I'll send pictures and raise reviews to higher scores. I've just been very disappointed paying for something I was hoping b4 Thanksgiving. I'll update. Thank you.

The service was okay, no better/worse than others I've used.  I have a weird line in my carpet now which wasn't there before, and the technician said it was the carpet fibers laying in opposite directions, however, it wasn't there before.  Carpet looks clean otherwise.  Their equipment dripped water all over my laminate floor which I wasn't too happy about.  Water trail from the back bedroom to the front of the house. They also left two pieces of equipment in the street.  Local number not on the receipt, so had to call the nationwide number and sit and listen to their recording for a long time on hold in order to let them know there was equipment in the street.  I thought Stanley Steemer was supposed to be the crème de la crème, but it's really pretty average.

Chyrill was great, with us and the kids! The Chipotle chicken wrap was a bit too spicy but the southwest ranch it came with was a great pairing. Kiddo had mini corn dogs off the kids menu and they were typical fried kids food but he loved them. We started with the creamy chicken and rosemary soup on Chyrill's recommendation and it was delicious! Kiddo had fries and we had the tots and we shared so we could taste them both as we are potato fans! Both were tasty but I think the crispy fries were just a touch better. 

It's a seat yourself place with tall tables and chairs, and a big football crowd that is a bit loud and can be rowdy during game time, but a casual atmosphere still. 

There are definitely a few things I want to come back and try (a few of the tacos, the Curb Dip). We will probably try to avoid coming during a football Sunday crowd but will be back! The service was what knocked The Curb into five stars, although the food was a solid four.

Quite literally the slowest Taco Bell I've experienced in my entire life. I've been sitting in line long enough to decide, 1 star review is completely valid. Who ever manages this place needs to be fired. Unacceptable service. 35 minutes with 4 cars in the line. I left with I car still in front of me.
The most blinged out Albertsons I've ever seen in my life.  I think they've even got a taproom attached to it!  Good selection and easy self-checkout as well.

This company charges a $100 "administrative" fee. If it takes $100 in administrative man hours to get someone "in their system," it sounds like they better take a look at how that is currently being done.

I would never use them again. I purchased 5 homes in my lifetime, and never have I gone through what they put me through. I bought in 2017, and have had a chance to talk to MANY people in the business about my experience. I was treated differently I believe because I was a retiree. Even though I had enough assets to buy the house 4 times over. The first person who was assigned to me was good, but then they switched my file to someone who wasn't fully experienced. For example, I would get an e-mail from her most mornings saying "To Do List." The next morning I would get an e-mail entitled, "Fix it List." All the fix its I had to do were because she gave me incorrect or incomplete instructions the prior day. They also made me pay off my car which was 9k. I have since been told that since I had GAP insurance, there was no need for me to pay off my car. Yet they never said anything, and should have asked. GAP insurance pays off the car should anything happen to the car. A wasted 9k for me. It was one of the most stressful experiences in my life. This gal had me on my computer chasing after this and that for about 6 hours a day, and pretty much it was fix it fix it fix it because of her poor instructions. I complained and they should have given my file to someone more experienced based on what I had complained about. I never went through any of this with the previous 4 houses I bought. I might be buying again this summer and I won't be using Evergreen.

*****Update******
10/26
Steve,

Thank you for your offer for me to try out your restaurant, for a third time. I was in the process of deciding a date to stop by. This past week I have a had a number of family emergencies, from my grandfather almost dying and finding out my dog has diabetes. I apologize that I haven't had time to reply to you. 
I have seen your reply to my review chastising me for not replying to your message in "weeks" when it has only been a week. From my knowledge 10/18-10/26 is a week and one day. I know time passes fast, I just didn't realize that a week had turned into weeks. I also apologize that replying to social media wasn't my highest priority this past week. As I am sure you can imagine, my hands have been pretty full with greater responsibilities.
Steve, you made a valid point in your reply, you mentioned that one bad day shouldn't justify a bad review. I completely agree, that is why I gave your restaurant two tries before I made my review. Now, I would've been more than open to communicate to your staff that I didn't enjoy my food, if they had bothered to ask why I didn't eat my meal, both times I came in. 
I'm sorry that you don't like my original review to your restaurant, but I didn't like my original experiences at your restaurant. I was looking forward to giving your restaurant a third chance, though, but after your reply to my review chastising me for not replying fast enough, I will not be giving you a third chance. I don't wish to do business with an establishment that is trying to bully and harass me into deleting my review.
Now, what I don't understand, Steve, is that if you have so many positive reviews why are you putting so much energy into harassing the negative ones? Everyone has different taste, and you can't please everyone.


Best of wishes,
Maryanne (not Mary Ann)

Couldn't have been more pleased with my experience at Heritage.  I have been seriously "burned" by mechanics in the past, so my guard is always way up there any time I need work done on my car.  I can confidently say, I was extremely pleased with EVERYTHING about Heritage.  The look and feel both inside and out, was clean and inviting.  No lewd or crude posters, pictures or language at this business!  Restroom is spotless!

I feared my car would need a lot of work, and I was right; however, Scott communicated everything thoroughly and in language I could understand.  Prices were always given up front. 

Seriously, you will not be sorry if you do business with the fine folks at Heritage.

Way too much money for boring generic tasting food. Their sushi was lacking. The salads again, lacking nothing homemade tasting. There are just way too many better options here in this valley to spend my money in this place. Best thing I tasted in this joint was the soup and that was probably out of a bag.
OMG !!  Light crunchy fish with lobster tot appetizer that was 10/10 YUM!!  Easy location for a quick stop in dinner. Friendly staff!

Its bad when you go to this taco bell location two weeks in a row and one week they are out of hot sauce and the next it doesnt have sour cream, large cups or hot sauce. Never again will i go to this location. Absolutely terrible

All of the classes look too large for the instructor:student ratio. Terrible parent seating area & parking. Unhappy employees. 
We enrolled our three and four-year-old for one month. Two of the four classes only had one instructor for 10-12 kids, which caused them to be extremely unproductive. The kids pile up at each station and spend half the class waiting around, and about 15 minutes total going to get a drink of water. Even on the days with two teachers, they looked frazzled and unhappy. The woman who answers the phone and sits at the front desk is rude, cold and unhelpful. I felt like I was bothering her EVERY SINGLE interaction. 
There were some older kids who looked like great gymnasts, but for us, it was a very negative and disappointing experience. My children were much more engaged at the little gym. The instructors were so sweet and helpful, and great customer service. We will be heading back there.

I always have a great experience coming here. The vibe of this place rocks. All the employees are cool and easy to chat with. Try the chipotle chicken wrap! It's absolutely delicious. Their fries are excellent too. Obviously this is a bar and grill- so the drinks are what get you there, however the food gets you to stay as it is top notch!!

Corona Village is marked in my books as the place to get the best cheese dip aka queso I've ever had. Oh my gosh. It's thick, it's heavenly, and it's actually made from real, melted, bonafide cheese. Like, don't get it if you don't want to be addicted. In addition to the queso extraordinaire, Corona Village is a great place to get some yummy Mexican food for a reasonable price. We are fans! 

Food: OH MY GOSH THE CHEESE DIP. In fact, your receipt will probably say "cheese deep," which really made me laugh the first time I saw it. "I'll take the Cheeese deeeeeep pleeease!" Anyway, their fajitas are also BOMB, and the sample fajita platter (for one) is not only HUGE. but the taste is also superb. Ours is always cooked to perfection and comes with a ton of extra tortillas. The burritos, quesadilla, chips, salsa and bean dip are also good. I'm definitely a fan of their fried ice cream as well! 

Drinks: Heavenly blended margaritas. The grande's are so good! Yum! 

Atmosphere: It's a tiny joint, so there may be a wait if you go at a busy time. The ONLY THING I don't love about Corona Village (similar to other Mexican spots), is that I leave and have to throw my clothes immediately in the wash or they smell like the kitchen until they're clean again. Does anyone else have this issue? 

Service: They sometimes seem rushed, but our service has never been compromised. They're always nice and always checking in on us. 

Happy Hour Offerings: n/a

Healthy Hack: Chicken tortilla soup without cheese! It has tons of grilled chicken and is really light. The cup is plenty.

Tips: Try the fajita sample platter. It's so good!

Super friendly staff, a clean and bright space....I'm so pleased that I found this place! I took my niece here to get acrylic nails; she brought in a picture of what she wanted and they delivered!  I also think their prices are quite reasonable given the quality of their workmanship. We will definitely be back!

Awful managers can kill the entire experience. ***  We were treated unprofessionally and very poorly.  I booked a party of six people whom were in a wedding party two days later.  The party was comprised of six pedicures, five full sets and a manicure.  Because there are only four pedicure chairs, we knew we could have to have three people getting pedicures while three did their nails, and then the group would switch.  When we arrived they asked for four of us to start with the pedicures.  Because they did not follow their own scheduling, they ran out of time to do everyone's nails.  Our appointments started at 11:45AM and we were supposed to be out of there around 2:00PM - 3:00PM.  They "did us a favor", according to the manager as they called in another stylist to come in and do the last person's full set.  We walked out of there after 5:30PM.  When the manager was trying to bring in another employee to complete that last set of nails, she turned to me and said, "Do you want a 3:15PM appointment or NOT?"  All the stylists were stressed, there was so much anger on the part of the manager...it was an all out awful experience.  For a pedicure, which was done hastily and poorly, and a full set, we each paid over $140.  And that was for nothing but gel polish and one accent finger decorated with a couple rhinestones.  Truly, go elsewhere.  The only compliment that I could fine would be Jade.  He was very professional, made sure I was completely satisfied with my nails before he was done.  I only wish he rented a chair at a salon that actually knew how to treat their customers in a responsible, professional manner.

Post Owner Reply on Google:   I find it curious why the manager says it's our fault because we initiated the four pedicures be done at once.  We knew that had to have three pedicures done at once, while three full-sets/manicures were done, then we'd switch.

The owner then accused us as not bringing up the issue while we were there.  I did bring it up.  I was very dissatisfied and the reply from the owner was, "Do you want the 3:15PM appointment or NOT?"  She did not approach the situation tactfully or professionally.  

So no, this wasn't our fault.  We called over a month in advance to book our appointments at the very same time.  We were aware that the group would have to be split in two, and I called the week prior to make sure everything was a go.

Putting the substandard treatment wasn't our fault.  Treating your customers poorly falls directly on the shoulders of you and the staff.

My wife and I have been here a handful of times when since moving into a place. We now have more room and that means more furniture! 

We originally came here for a media stand for our tv but we just didn't find what we were looking for. On our second trip, we ended up picking up a dresser for our bedroom that we love!

Our first stop is always the back section where they sell the discounted items. These items are discounted for a variety of reasons but most of them have some sorts of scratch or blemish on them. 

We found one with a slight surface crack in the top but it was discounted a couple hundred dollars and didn't seem to be an issue. After some negotiating, we were able to get an additional $40 off of the sticker price since it was an "as is" purchase. 

We paid for the dresser and ran home to get our SUV so that the dresser would fit. We went around back and it was there waiting for us. They loaded it in the car and off we went. 

I really wish I remembered the salesmen's name because he was a pleasure to work with. We even received a hand written card from him a week later thanking us.

We will be back!

Watch out!!  We cleaned the house top to bottom, and they only gave a portion of our deposit back.  There was no recourse for us either because we moved out of town.  If you don't mind not getting your money back at the end, then they are a decent management company.
The soup is great but I honestly love their sandwiches! It's not super crowded even with the business park nearby.

This is a fantastic store! I normally shop at Whole Foods but heard of the new Albertsons Market Street while in town visiting family. The store is so big that I did not have time to see it all. Next trip for sure though! It's like an Albertsons got married to a Whole Foods and had a child the size of Costco! It is that big people! We got Prime Rib Eye Steaks for $18/lb and they were FABULOUS! Next time we are in town we most likely will skip Whole Foods altogether, as we got more food with the same clean-eating as Whole Foods, and for less in price. I honestly would move back to Boise just for this store, lol. Clearly this is a place you must stop in to check out if you haven't already...my exclamation points says it all! The meat/seafood department case alone is INSANE. Now I just have to get a second job just so I can save up money to shop and stuff my face while I'm in town. Run don't walk people, GO quickly or you will be missing out on a good thing. Now to figure out how the heck to get one in Eastern Washington #GOALS!

I have been in and out of Nursing Homes for years in my line of work. This is an excellent building. The Leadership has been in place for 13 years and really understands the business and how to put patients first. It is a beautiful physical plant, which is a bonus and the staff are extremely friendly. I would recommend this place if you are looking for skilled rehab

We came here for a birthday party, and we did not book a party by mistake. However, it was still a ton of fun, and our guests had a blast, including the birthday boy. Thank you for the good times. We'll be back!
I have been going here for years. The shop is super clean, great selection of colors, and very kind staff

In customer satisfaction business theory, it is often true that a customer who has had a problem and had it successfully resolved is more satisfied with and loyal to a business than a customer who never had a problem at all.  We were plenty  pleased by our experience with Mattress Land out of the gate for the sales experience there.  (See previous review.) And after a Lemony Snicket-worthy "Series of Unfortunate Events" led us to need Mattress Land to resolve a customer service issue, we are loyal customers for life!  We have the highest praise for the Store Manager, Casey Timmons, who modeled the best of proactive and professional solutions.  Bravo!  

Sometimes it is so that one person, one employee, in that "moment of truth" for follow up to solve problems makes all the difference.  In this case that person was Casey.  I once managed a customer service organization and were I doing that again, I'd want Casey at the head of the management team.  This was a pretty complicated service issue related to order fulfillment and he made the resolution of it painless for us.

So, second verse same as the first in how happy we are to have bought a mattress from Mattress Land.  Seeing almost 3 dozen reviews behind the Yelp filter here, if you take a peek at them too you'll find lots of other reviews from people who also had five star experiences with this business.  We would only shop at Mattress Land for a mattress and we recommend you do too.  Simply the best for product quality and value, sales and service.

Not to mention everyone snoozes like a baby on the new Sleep-Fit latex mattress in the guest room...including me when I get perturbed enough with my husband to move in there to sleep.   In fact, it is so comfy, I'm finding reasons for him to tick me off.

Came here for breakfast but could only get alcohol. I'm not complaining though. Should have stopped after 1 drink. Been here 3 hours now and have to Uber home. 

Ps I love you. 

Katelynn is kinda cool even though she said she don't like chicken and waffles or McDonald's.
This review is for the lady that was so nice when I asked about their vegan options! She even double checked to make sure my smoothie was vegan. Thanks for being so accommodating!!

Traveled here for work and wanted a manicure. I waited 40 minutes to be called; and, waited another 20-30 minutes after to dry my nail polish. The lady that did my nails said I was 'okay' to go. I left, minutes later my polish came off. I called and asked to have it fixed. Came back and was given the worst service. The owner was very unprofessional.
Unbelievable place for sandwiches and anything else.  Super clean, well stocked and efficient.  Had s breakfast sandwich that was crazy good.

Between a 2 and 3 stars. Food was a 3. Had the planked salmon. Not a lot of flavor but enjoyable.  My husband had the marlin which was seasoned nicely but dry. The big negative was once we were seated we were ignored while she cleared a table (it was only 5pm so they were not busy). When she got it cleared we still did not see her in dining hall for quite awhile.   Ok so to me here is the biggy- if you seat in the dining room Happy Hour does not pertain to you. We sat a table 10 feet from the bar but would have to move to get happy hour prices. REALLY!!  We giggled on the way out that their fake smiles and thank yous made us feel like they were happier to see us go then come.

Got a manicure. Lady left polish all over my skin. When I asked her to fix it, she glared at me and grabbed my hands very roughly. She then clearly complained about me in her language to the other employees there. This picture was after she "fixed" it. My nails also have lots of bubbles and bumps in it. I took the polish off as soon as I got home because it looked so bad. She also did not fix my cuticles or shape the nails at all

UPDATE: also just learned that she demanded my father in law pay her a tip of 20%.

Great store!  I could live here!  All the freshly prepared Deli foods, fresh baked bakery (not thaw and bake or thaw and sell but truly baked!), not to mention the fresh seafood and aged beef!  Grocery selections were extensive and wonderful!  The only thing missing from the British section was MiWada. I only wish we had one of these store in the San Francisco Bay Area, but then I know I'd spend way too much money on groceries!

Two weeks ago I ordered 2 chicken bacon artichoke pizzas from this location and they were both delicious with plenty of toppings. The experience was so good that the boys wanted me to get the same order again tonight so I called in and ordered the same pizzas as before. I noticed when I got home that these two pizzas has a lot less toppings than 2 weeks ago and it really showed when we ate them. I called the store and told them about our disappointment with tonight's experience and the young woman who I spoke with asked if I would be happy if she personally made me a pizza with heavier toppings than before to pick up tonight and I answered that would be great. I'm truly pleased with how I was treated and offered a complimentary pizza for my dissatisfaction and I feel that this shows truly amazing customer service  that is sorely lacking  these days. I highly recommend this  store for your take and bake pizza needs!

Been here a couple times now, two days in a row because I just found out about it. Apparently this location has been here since August 2016. How did it not get into Yelp yet?? 

Hugo's delis have been around here since I've been around here (early 80's). Just a solid joint with friendly people making great sandwiches. They're stuffed, so half options are available. There's something for everyone on their menu. If you want to add, delete or change something in the sandwich, they'll gladly do it for you. That brings me to the one Hugo's item that could bring world peace: Their deli fries. I can't begin to describe them in a way that would do them justice, so just try them. Get the spicy ketchup to dip them in. Similar to a cocktail sauce with chunks of horseradish. 

This location is a Hugo's Express, so they don't have the full offerings afforded at the other locations, like the fried chicken and salads, but all the sandwiches seem to be there. They use my favorite local sourdough, which goes great on their combo sandwich.  Other great breads and rolls available. Tables and chairs or booths, level throughout for easy access. Get there early to avoid the lunch crowd cuz this place is gaining popularity, probably more so that they're in Yelp now. DELI FRIES!!
Wow , I was hoping that just because this was in a gas station, it wouldn't be a gas station sandwich. I WAS WRONG. Disappointed.

Best sushi ever! If you like a little spice, try the El Dieblo
Fresh oysters, great clam chowder. My youngest boy can't stand fish so he gets the burger and fries. He says it tastes amazing
Medicap Pharmacy staff are the best! Courtney, especailly helpful to me with my Bi-Est RX. They go the extra mile and truly care about their customers! I highly recommend Medicap.

Ok look, I don't have time to fill in tons of details. Just stopped by because it was better than any other drive-thru options. 

Just grabbed 6 Hawaiian empanadas. Hoping for the best. 

Honestly, it was almost worth driving over 4 hours from Idaho Falls. 

Hot. Fresh. Crisp. Flaky. Melted cheesy gooey. Delicious!

The only hang up is that they charge for water. 

Even though I've left out some details, you don't really need much more info. Just swing by. Stay in your car. Eat well.

I purchased a extended warranty for the washing machine I purchased from RC Willey. When the machine failed you sent out a repair company.  The service man failed to tighten a hose clamp.  The machine leaked and damaged my hard wood floors.  As of today you refused to repair the damaged you caused.
First time eating here, service was great.  I ordered a cup of Clam Chowder and the Baja Salad. Salad was really good,  but the chowder was just okay, it just reminded me of a Insta bag.
Dr Jessie is great but the service from his staff was a disappointment in my last visit.

I went here on a recommendation and they did not disappoint me.  Had a leveling kit, wheels and tires done.  The work was done right, faster than I expected and best of all at a great price.  Thanks you Joel and Pat at the Meridian store for taking care of me.  You guys are awesome and so is everyone at that store.  If I could give it 10 STARS I would.
it's a little confusing at first but I like the new variety. plus the pizza is great for little ones.
Best donuts I've ever had. The glaze is good, the dough is soft and melt-in-your-mouth good. I would fight somebody for the cinnamon twists.

Could eat here for breakfast lunch and dinner. Best chicken sandwich in the world and the chick fil a sauce is absolutely amazing and addicting, it goes with everything. Breakfast is to die for here, the biscuits make everything better, the chicken minis are a miracle of life.
We visited for the first time this past week and we were not disappointed. The Puffy Tacos were amazing! Great service, fun environment, we'll definitely be back!

I know it says Korean, but it seemed like a pretty basic teriyaki bowl. That said, it was well executed and tasted good. I got the beef and tried magic sauce and hot sauce. Definitely worth going to again, but maybe not crave worthy.

C.J. is genuinely one of the nicest people I've ever met!! He helped us so much and explained his process as well. We can't thank you enough!! It was a great experience and we will definitely be back!

After a horrible interstate moving trailer accident left us with no household goods we went to RC Willey and spent thousands to replace everything we lost.  Over the course of 8 months in Idaho we have replaced a 70 inch TV, Dining Set, Patio Set, Dishwasher, Club Chair, Area Rug, 2 ottomans and more from this store.  There has always been glitches in delivery & set-up, however, not enough to keep us away.  

This, however, will keep us away. 3 weeks ago (April 9) my husband bought a "faux" leather storage ottoman.  In just 3 weeks time the fake leather is peeling from the corner.  I called customer service and was told to "send in a picture" so a manager can look at it.  I sent a photo the same day. After not hearing back I called to follow up and was told "your dog must have chewed it".   Are you KIDDING me?  After spending THOUSANDS of dollars at RC Willey I'm being told they won't give me in-store credit to replace a 3 week old peeling ottoman?   My dog certainly didn't chew it (or anything in our home) and they wouldn't have known we had a dog had I not mentioned it. (so much for being honest!)

I escalated to management and got the same response. 

Safe to say we'll spend our Seattle incomes elsewhere.  I can hardly believe this company would send our money elsewhere over $300!  We weren't even looking to get a refund, just a replacement of a higher quality item and I was clear about that. 

Shame on RC Willey's lack of customer service.  

I'll Craigslist the ottoman and buy a new one at a different store that actually cares about the quality of their furniture AFTER money is exchanged.

I remember driving past Earl of Sandwich and was curious because the name is a little bit random. After noticing that they also have a location in Vegas at Planet Hollywood, I decided to check out the location in Boise. 
The service here is pretty good and a little annoying at the same time. The friendliness here can feel a little overbearing. After I was done placing my order the person kept on talking to me (from up-selling to how's the weather?) and it seemed a little bit awkward. I may be exaggerating a little, but that was exactly what it felt like.
