They were pretty quick and they had a cookie for my dog. I kind of forgot how odd this entire experience was. 
I ordered the holiday sandwich. It was good to a certain extent. I enjoyed the combination of food, but they are so generous I did not really enjoy it. I think it would have been better without the dressing. 
I am not sure, but if  I ever feel like a sandwich and I am on Eagle Rd, I would return.

Brandi at Budget Blinds did an amazing job with my in home consult and blinds suggestions. She totally understood the look I was wanting and helped me through the process. The installation was also very fast. Very happy with my blinds!

I love coming to BarkWash. The two times I walked-in for my mini Aussie's full bath, the staffs were always very nice and accommodating. They also have treats and few necessities you might need. My puppy definitely enjoy their treats!

I love this store. What i don't like is it taking 15 min to get lunch meat at the Deli.  @10 am on a Wed morn.  Bunch of workers around and then they all disappear. Finally someone comes up to help me. A girl who had a runny noise and kept sniffing ugh. While I was waiting another lady - both of us seniors came up and had the same problem being waited on.  She said to me there is never anyone here to help.  We complained to each other while we waited. Then over in the dairy area a girl was stocking and I asked about Mexican Chorizo. She pointed it out across the aisle and said "can you see it" no I said so she walked over and pointed to it. Of course it was on the very top shelf and I am vertically challenged- everything I need seems to be on the top shelf. Can you get me one down and she did but she seemed annoyed. On the positive side I had good service from the cheese counter, meat counter and at the checkout stand. Oh and over in the decorations some nice girl asked me if I had a coupon- what coupon? And she handed me a 30% off coupon. Bless her.

Came in to have my Miele Complete C3 Marin power line vacuum repaired. The store owner quickly assessed the issue and  had the repair parts in store, in addition to great prices on Miele filters. I highly recommend this place if you're looking for a knowledgeable opinion or recommendation for your next vacuum.

Had my daughter in tumbling here for two year and the program really went down hill. The coaches were changing constantly and getting worse and worse, and the class size got larger. Toward the end, my daughter would sit idle for up to 15 minutes of the hour-long class, while the 2 coaches would work with one person in the class. My daughter's skills have barely advanced at all in the two years. I finally left the gym after I watched my daughter do another girls hair for 17 minutes, as the coaches ignored her and most of the class while they worked with one girl. And no one seems to be overseeing the coaching! I do not recommend.

This evening I went in to tan. Upon checking in the woman notified me this month's bill didn't process through. My wife received a new card and she wasn't available to update the info. So I asked if I could tan tonight and return tomorrow with the updated payment info. I was told no. I asked the cost for a single session tan for eight minutes. She stated $25.00. Seriously?

We have been going to PBT for the past four or five months with no issues. It's ridiculous that they can't accommodate faithful customers. I was even more disappointed with the lack of empathy by the two women working the front. It was apparent they weren't concerned with my obvious frustration. If staff can't be more empathetic and understanding there is no need to continue patronizing this business. Furthermore, dont tell me you cant help then go back to looking at your cellphone.  

We will not be renewing our membership stemming from poor service and overall lack of professionalism.

What an amazing grocery store! But so much more. I was amazed by their selection of...EVERYTHING. Grab something freshly made to eat in their cafe area, or something for later with their pre-packaged items. Stare longingly at the cheese counter and wonder how to pronounce most of their offerings. Wonder how good the dry aged meat is when it looks long past edible (I know it's tasty though). And the bakery! Beyond what I've ever seen in a grocery store.
All with very friendly and helpful staff. Willing to give out tastes and samples (yay cheese!) And walk you to the product you are looking for. I spent an hour and a half half wandering the aisles and half grocery shopping.
I decided to get a Big Kahuna poke bowl from their Asian/Sushi counter. It was better than any of the poke bowls I've had from places in town.
This is truly an grocery shopping experience! But could easily serve double duty as a date-night or happy-hour with friends place too. That is my kind of one-stop shopping experience.

Pretty happy with this gym so far I have not found a better place in boise and I believe this is the largest one sometimes it can get kind of packed around 5 o clock but overall good equipment, nice people, and a great gym.

Will continue to come here.

This place never misses a beat when it comes to customer service. I've been here early in the morning, during the lunch rush and in the evening, and the customer service and food quality always exceeds my expectations. Usually places when there super busy lack in customer service this place does not, if anything it's better when it's busier they go above and beyond to please. It says a lot about the management and owner when the employees talk highly of there job even when there off the clock but I've seen the quality this company produces in the food,employees and customer service at the establishment and away from.

My first time in many years was a rich experience. While my husband had the baseline meal of fish and chips, I tried the Cajun Fried Oysters. He was very happy with his meal and looks forward to a return trip. I was leery of the cornmeal breading but  the jalepeño infused breading was light enough and had good texture. The cocktail sauce that comes with it is a habañero spiced one and I think I would have preferred a standard sauce or had the menu define the type of cocktail sauce. I ate it but it does clash with the oysters a bit, in my opinion. 

The pippin apple slaw could be dressed with more flavor and more apple. It was dull and bland.  Ordinary comes to mind. 

The chips were excellent.  

All in all, a great experience and we will be back.

I moved here over three years ago and purchased over 10k of merchandise. I'm pretty sure the delivery guys stole two jewelry containers from me with jewelry in them, the sofa is literally falling apart and one side of the bed will no longer go up and down, the dryer handle is broken. No, no no. Buyer beware!!! I have sent in a picture with details to reviews@rcwilley.com Update: 11-7-18: They did send a service technician out to fix the dryer handle, however he also took lots of pictures and said I would hear back from them and 7 to 10 business days to see if they would fix or replace sofas, I have left many messages out and an several emails and have yet to hear back about the results. The sofas are unusable at this point.

Denizens of the Treasure Valley, many of us with a culinary interest are familiar with the old saying that you "eat first with your eyes."  Well I would say that it is almost equally true that you "eat first with your nose."  Little Kitchen Pastries is a symphony for your nostrils before you even put any of their creations in your mouth.  Seriously, the first time I walked in the door I just stood there for a moment and enjoyed the smell of all the freshly prepared baked goods.  It was quite simply amazing.

Baking is not my forte at all (in fact just ask my wife what happened the last time I tried to make a pie crust) so I more than appreciate the skill and effort required to make a good pastries, and the ones at Little Kitchen are very good.  The various danishes are spectacular as are the croissants.  The staff is incredibly helpful and friendly.  On one visit I got a cinnamon roll literally fresh out of the pan.  Great stuff all the way around.  I love to support passionate, local businesses and Little Kitchen absolutely fits the bill.

I have to hold back the fifth star for a couple reasons though, and they may seem "nit-picky," but I do try and reserve five star reviews for the nearly flawless.  The first minor issue is mostly a consequence of the type of business this is.  The selection of items is limited and you don't always know exactly what is going to be available from day to day or even different times of day.  Now to be fair, this could also be seen as a positive.  It means that every item is made fresh based on what is available and what the chef wants to make.  Absolutely true.  However that isn't much of a consolation when you REALLY want that ham and cheese croissant or that cherry danish.  So you just have to accept that your personal favorite may not be there at any given time.

The other minor issue is simply one of personal taste.  While I really enjoyed their danish and croissant, I did not care for the cinnamon roll at all.  I'm not a fan of raisins and while a "too sweet" glaze can certainly be off-putting, I found theirs to be almost tasteless.  It added very little to the roll aside from getting my fingers sticky.  But that's just a matter of personal taste, your mileage may vary.

Bottom line folks, if you are hungry for a great danish or croissant, or just want a "feast" for your nostrils, stop by Little Kitchen Pastries.  It is an awesome local business and you know what you are getting is made from scratch on site.  Your stomach and your nose will thank you.

First time eating at this location. The drive thru employee Christina gave the best customer service! She was personable, informative and plain nice. Hope all employees are like her. Our food was delicious as well!
Hamburgers are great!  Some of the best I have had on  this side of town. Good customization option on menu to get exactly what you want.

I love Sassy Nails!! They are very affordably priced and they do an amazing job. I have tried many places in town closer to my house and I am always disappointed so I keep coming back to Sassy Nails. Everyone that works there is great, Angie is my favorite, she is so sweet and does great pedis. They can do great nail art, I have brought in pictures from Pinterest and they have duplicated them. They have 5 big massage chairs for pedis so it's fun to bring your girlfriends along. They are always busy but if I'm in the area they can usually squeeze me right in as a walk up.

Just ordered from there from the manager Tifffany only because i had to have 35 shots in my head neck and shoulders and cant drive. No where else delivers that has gluten free. Last two times i have ordered here ive had to go to the hospital im praying that Tiffany makes sure this time that its right but she was real rude on the phone. Anyone know of the corporate office for this Dominos i mean i need to eat but being afraid to order from the local dominos because the manager is so put off by me telling the truth i was praying there would be a differnet manager. Sad but true. Anyway let ya know if i end up in the hospital again.
I thought the food was ok. But appetizers were actually better than the main course.  Food was over priced and under portioned. But the service was excellent.

I would give it less than a 1 star if I could due to the HORRIBLE bartender!  We just arrived in Meridian and wanted a quick drink before hunkering down for dinner and the night. She brought the wrong drunk for my husband, didn't listen to my order and omitted the pineapple juice. My husband felt bad about sending back a drink (wasting) so he drank it anyhow plus the 2nd drink, during that time I sat for 27 min without a drink! She NEVER checked on us and we had to almost beg for our check, then waited over 10 min for her to return, she never came back to take our CC, so we ended up paying in cash just so we could leave. WE WILL NEVER COME BACK!

If you have time, exploring Albertsons Market Street is for you!  Don't skip aisles!  You won't gain full appreciation for what is being offered. Start out with getting a cup of coffee to sip while you peruse.  I totally enjoy making sure I have more than an hours time to shop. And do make sure you have your Albertsons app pointed to this store. Deals offered are different than the base stores.

I am a first-time mom and new to the area, so choosing an OB/GYN was something I did not take lightly. I did a TON of research and met with more than one practice. I decided to go with Dr. Scott Armstrong with OGA in Meridian, ID and I am so happy I did. 

At OGA, there are multiple doctors and any of them could potentially deliver your baby. I wasn't as concerned about that as I was having the same doctor throughout the pregnancy. This was not a problem at all and while they encourage you to meet with other doctors so you are comfortable, I chose to strictly see Dr. Armstrong and that was fine!

My pregnancy was not smooth.. I had a cyst on an ovary that was monitored via ultrasound at each appointment. I also had placenta previa and ultimately had a placental abruption. I was admitted to the hospital (they delivery at St. Luke's Meridian) at 32 weeks and was in the hospital for 12 days before I ultimately had an emergency C-section. Because of that, I was exposed to all of the doctors in the OGA group and I felt completely comfortable with ANY of them delivering my baby. 

Dr. Armstrong is considered a conservative doctor, which is what I wanted. I am very type A and wanted a doc that was going to keep me to the books on what to do throughout the pregnancy. If you are looking for a doc who is going to say drinking wine is ok, he isn't it and I appreciated that.

Dr. Armstrong was on call the night I ended up delivering - but that was just by luck. My C-section went perfectly and my incision is immaculate. He also saved me from getting a second surgery for the cyst on the ovary I mentioned because he took that out while he was "in there". He saved my baby's life and I couldn't be more thankful. I owe him the world! 

If you prefer a female doctor to a male doctor, I recommend Harmony R. Schroeder, M.D.. She also is on the conservative side and didn't put me in an emergency C-section the day I was admitted when the baby's heart rate went back down (even though she had the teams prepped for surgery). That also shows that she is cautious without being impulsive.

I honestly can't say enough good things about the front desk ladies, ultrasound techs and doctors at OGA. If you are looking for someone to deliver your baby, you will be in AMAZING hands with this group!!!
I just love this place. Fave place to get a Sammy. Thx for being the best part of my week.

Coming from SoNV, I've been really missing "The Bobbie" sandwich from Capriotti's Sandwich Shop.  My all time favorite sandwich place here is Fat Guys, but since this place has a "Thanksgiving" sandwich similar to The Bobbie, I gave it a try.  The flavors were all there..turkey, stuffing, cranberry sauce, mayo, all toasted nicely on their yummy artisan bread.  Very good!  I would have given 5 stars if their turkey had been hand pulled for texture, but it was sliced.  Their menu is varied and appealing.  I'll come back here for this sandwich tho!

Monday's deal $3.99/Med one topping hit the spot for our family! Took 8 minutes for two pizzas. Awesome deal! Perfect amount of cheese not too much and perfect amount of spices on the crust. Will take advantage of this deal!

Amazing!! My first visit to Soup Kettle Grill was awesome and delicious! The employees were very friendly and knowledgeable.  I enjoyed their 1/2 chicken salad sandwich with a cup of buffalo chicken soup, Devine!!!! I left with a Togo tomato basil soup that I had sampled.  Tangy and a true tomato basil blend... I will definitely make them one of our usual drop-ins.  Keep up the great service and menu

I get a good feeling when I walk in here.  This place seemed very clean which is a major score in my book. Kim was very personable and friendly. She also took time on my feet without rushing through scrubbing them or massaging them. She also took out a fresh set of tools out of a package for my pedicure. She made sure I was comfortable and had the right temperature for the water.  I also get my lip wax here, and she does a great job. I'll be back to try a mani and a gel pedi.
Clam chowder was runny and fishy, service was very spotty, could not get any waitress to stop while they were walking by.  Seemed like they did not want customers bothering them.  Not impressed

I've only been here a handful of times, but each time I go, it is a very frustrating experience.
This last time, I had less than five items. Two registers are open with lines to the isles, while three workers are standing next to the bagging area just laughing and talking.

So I decided to do self-check out. I scan my first item and it didn't scan... so I scanned again. Next item was fine. Third item didn't ring up again and said it needed assistance from a worker. The light on top of the register is flashing. I wait there for several minutes. The workers are standing less than 15 feet away, laughing, talking, looking at the flashing light. FINALLY one of them came and scanned her badge to make the light stop flashing. Didn't ask if I needed any help or what the problem was. Just walked away back to her coworkers to laugh some more.

Funny thing is, the thing still didn't scan. I still don't know if I paid for the last item, since she was no help and then the receipt machine was out of paper. What. A. Joke.

When a grocery store makes it nearly impossible to purchase items - you have a problem.


P.S. Albertsons, you're ridiculously overpriced.
Strawberry banana Smoothie today was so good! I will definitely be back to try more flavors.

The salesman was great. Wife bought a washer. Quoted $650 @ Lowes, he matched it. Sold her delivery & warranty so it's $850 now. Took 5 days to deliver. They hooked it up backwards, the clothes came out of the final rinse cycle steaming hot. Shrunk our load of clothes. There response has been they'll refer to corporate so they can do better next time? THEY DON'T KNOW HOT FROM COLD, that's professional installers! They'll send out a repairman to fix it in 3 days. Hum... What our lawyers #?

Hands down the worst food I've ever had at a Taco Bell!  I ordered the new chicken rolled tacos which are deep fried taquitos plain and simple.  My goodness were the rolled chicken tacos greasy!!!!  I couldn't only stomach 2 of the 4 I ordered and I had to force myself into eating the second one.

The worst part is the beef chalupa supreme I ordered.  ABSOLUTELY INEDIBLE!!!!  The chalupa shell felt like it had been made 24 hours prior and just sat out waiting for a sucker like me to order it.  After one bite, I was beyond turned off.

This Taco Bell location isn't good.  If I can help it, I'll never visit this location again!!!

A bunch of us will meet here periodically on Sunday morning for bloody marys and breakfast.  Today was one such day and will probably be our last. The service was absolutely horrible.  Food was cold. My order was missed altogether so I finally got something different from what I ordered after everyone else was done eating.  I asked for water with lemon 3 times and never did get it. 

Horrible horrible horrible!
One of the best massages I have had in a very long time. The location is easy to find and very close to my home and Vicki was awesome.
The food is pretty good but ordering take out is insane. They need a better spot to take orders. I had to scream into the phone and she still didn't hear but half my order right.

Entered the store today and was immediately pounced upon by a sales person. Told her I just need to look around a bit.  Continued to follow me through the store asking questions. Told her numerous times I just needed some space to look around. Sales person was relentless.  After ditching the first salesperson I got the same routine from another salesperson. Got so fed up I left without making a purchase.  Made me want to take my business elsewhere.

After another tire center could not figure out why our snow tires for an older car (on wheels we've had from them for 15 years) were causing issues, this particular Les Schwab got us in just before closing, figured out what would cause that and offered a solution. Not to mention, got us set up with new snow tires for our new car. Everyone was friendly and quick to help us. They went above and beyond!   We will definitely be back to this location!

I have recently purchased "top of the line" refrigerator, desk set, filing cabinet, and TV stand and each has come dented, cracked, or otherwise damaged. These four deliveries have turned into eight deliveries due to exchanges and has taken months to sort out. Be prepared to take lots of time off work for deliveries that they often cancel the same day due to their lack of preparedness.

Amazing fried pickles with homemade ranch and jalapeño ranch! A must try. Kayleigh was attentive and very nice. We happened to stop for apps and beer while the super bowl was on and the manager brought around sunglasses and beer coozies for their guests!  We will be back!

Bought our first sleep number bed and am very impressed.  Our service while purchasing was fantastic and we received excellent customer service.  They told us 2 weeks to get our mattress and we even got it earlier than that.  They delivered it when they said they would and set it all up for us.  Would definitely recommend this place!

Very solid sandwich spot with very good fries and homemade fry sauce. Everyone before and after me ordered fried chicken, so they must be doing that right too. I was super happy with the turkey, bacon, avocado and veggie sandwiches. Good amount of meat and fillings, fresh veggies, and good quality meats and cheeses. 

My only knock is the bread. It is just regular store bought rolls or slices (not sure about the rye though) and my sourdough roll was not particularly fresh or soft. Getting paired up with a local bakery would take this place over the top. 

I'll be back to try all of their other options but will probably stick with sliced sourdough or wheat.

I'd never been here before and needed to grab a quick bite while out running errands on a weekday evening.  There was just me and a car in front of me at the drive-thru window.  Even if this isn't considered fast-food, the wait was excessive.  I didn't really see that the car in front of me ordered a ton of food, but I waited way too long to get to the window and then place my order and wait some more.  I wondered if I was supposed to order at the menu, so I even backed up to check, and wasn't greeted, so I guess you order at the window.  I asked the girl if there was a speaker or way to order back there, and she said no.  So, I guess you order and get your food at the window and it just takes a long time.

I ordered a regular gyro ($4.99), and the free medium soda that was in the Yelp app for checking in.  I asked what was in the gyro (Gyro meat, Tzatziki sauce, tomato & onion) and asked about the onions - if they were finely diced, or ... ?  - and she said they have an onion chopper, so, yes, finely chopped.  No.  No, they were not.  I had giant pieces of raw onion in my gyro.  So, I opened it and picked them out (I like onions, but not big when raw).  But worse than that - the meat was so salty.  I mean nearly inedible salty.  And peppery - a little too much for my taste, but that could just be me.  But the salt.  Gah, that salt.  Too much.  I powered through my free soda trying to choke down that salty gyro.

Meh.

UPDATE 6/5/19. Very different experience this tome around. Food came out fresh and on time. Server did a great job as well. 

We come to this place regularly and today service time took forever during the slowest time of day between 2-3pm. We had our choice of tables. Our order was taken  at least 15 minutes after water was served. Food took a long time to come out. Kids Mac and cheese was tasting like it was sitting under heat lamps for a while. We had to ask for new fries and sauce for Mac and cheese. This won't be our regular pla.

I cannot get enough of these cookies! They are so delicious! I have tried several of the weekly cookies such as the s'mores, birthday cake, chocolate chip and muddy buddies. My favorite so far is the muddy buddy cookie it was the perfect amount of chocolate and peanut butter and the muddy buddies on top of the cookie was also very very delicious. Thank you!
Does anyone taste the food before serving?  The last two times we went to this location, the meat was so salty that it was almost inedible!  We love the gyros but will never return!

I went to Wahooz this Sunday with my 9 year old daughter. It was a great mother-daughter day! We opened the place up at 10am which turned out to be very smart. It was a rainy weekend (and a holiday weekend to boot) so the place was packed by 2. We got the Unlimited Indoor Fun Package for my daughter. For me, I got a smaller package and added on the ropes course and clip in climbing wall. It cost me around $75 for the both of us....ouch. However, it was what I was expecting based on what other people told me. The ticket guy was super patient about getting the best price for what I wanted to do

Ropes Course was our fav. So much fun and the staff was amazing and helpful. Loved seeing my daughter push past her fears. if you are brave enough to go to the 3rd level it is much less crowded. Very safe and perfect for my daughter's age.

Clip in climbing wall was my second fav while my daughter loved the bumper cars.

We had lunch in the cafe. I had the grilled chicken salad...no gluten allergy reactions so good there. Just be sure to tell them no croutons. Lots of great kid options. Prices were again high but the food was good so I was ok with it.

The only thing that made me mad so the $3 small bottle of water from the vending machine. That just felt outrageous. I guess everyone has their limits and that was mine lol

After lunch, we played arcade games and redeemed prizes. The staff at the prize counter should be deemed saints. My daughter changed her mind SO many times, yet they never seemed annoyed.

Overall, it was a great day. I am glad we went! However, based on the price, I won't be returning any time soon. For me, this is a 'special treat' versus regular. And if you are an adult wanting to do the Ropes Course...Bodies in Motion is way better and affordable.
My daughter wanted so badly to get a pedicure so I took her here. The ladies were so sweet to her and we had a really good time!

Been there three times in the past week with an average wait of at least 30 minutes.... they are so ill equipped to handle any kind of steady business. 
Typical usps ... never kept up with their changing demographic...
FedEx here I come.
Love the breakfast buritos and the omlette bar on Sundays.
they're not very good about cleaning the restrooms. Constantly find the restrooms unsanitary. I like maverik . they would get a higher score if we could keep the restrooms cleaned

Amazing education, top notch teachers, nurturing environment, beautiful campus, great music program, and solid sports program with positive competitive spirit - have never heard any parents 'go ugly' at a game. This has been the best decision we have ever made for our children's futures. Affordable, private education at its very best.

They got us in quick (within a half hour of calling) which was great.  

Great massage, polish and I was happy with the nail art. 

$25 for pedicure plus $5 for nail art. I would go back.

Took a long time to get a cup of tea..  the smoked pork omelette was tasty but was supposed to have a verde sauce and it did not.  They forgot my hash browns.  And finally the salt and pepper shakers were disgustingly nasty as if never cleaned on the outside.   If your not expecting much then this is the perfect place for breakfast...

Corey Newell and his team helped us purchase our first home. We relocated from CA and did almost everything remotely. He is very knowledgeable and responds quickly to any questions. Also his follow ups skill are excellent!I would highly recommend him!

Went here for the first time a few days ago. It had been a long day of moving to the area, so we decided to stop in and grab a much needed lunch. Immediately the waitress appeared annoyed and was just downright rude. She not only got my father's order wrong, but seemed to be friendly with every other table but our own - chatting, laughing, and constantly checking in with other diners. When we asked for more salsa, she brought another table their stuff first (which wasn't really anything large) and when my mother tried to get her attention she flat out ignored her and sauntered away. A few minutes later, she finally brought the salsa, but we were already halfway done with our meal. The food itself was cheap, but bland and small portions. The salsa was soupy. We will definitely not be going here again.

I love the hot food!  My husband and I don't eat a lot so sometimes cooking is difficult. We can go to Marketplace and get a great meal for much less than going out or cooking at home!  The salad bar is great. When I am cooking I can find anything I need!  I love this store!!

I really like the food at the gyro shack and it's always fresh! One thing I would suggest though is maybe have the employees trained a little better on making any gyro into a rice bowl concept. I ordered the Z in a rice bowl and they had forgotten 3 major ingredients (feta, Peppercinis, and tzatziki sauce) which would have made it cheaper than what I originally paid for..I went back through the line to ask about the mess up and the girl was super nice and accommodating but she  didn't seem to know what all it was suppose to come on it..
Great food all in all.

Great food and great stuff.  One of the cleanest cafe's in all of Meridian and Boise which is huge in my book.  Why go to IHOP or Denny's this place is 10 fold better.  Prices are a little high but quality of food is excellent.  Weekends are busy get their early.

First time here and won't be the last. Way better than Quiznos. Had a Caprese sandwich and my wife had French Dip, both were great, but the dip was exceptional. Usually the meat in a dip is well done, but this was medium rare. Marvelous! The Caprese has big slabs of mozzarella and fresh basil. The tomatoes had plenty of flavor with a really nice hit balsamic. Definitely worth the visit!
The fish and chips were amazing. Ordered online and picked up. The fish was still crunchy and flavorful.

Very disappointed.   Quality of the food was good.  It seems like the last few times the cost has gone up and the portions have gotten way less.   example... I do not  get rice and I had a plate.  I get all veggies and half chicken half beef.  The veggies on a plate was maybe about a cup of veggies.   My salad I could not hardly taste the dressing.   Very disappointed in this as it is not real cheap so I expect to get the same portion size when I go not way less.  Not sure I will go back as I can get bigger salad or meal for the same price elsewhere.  I do love the food so it is a bummer.

The best food I have had by far in Idaho! I have gone two days in a row and I'm going back again tomorrow! My favorites are the gaucho and the saltena. I have tried some of the other empanadas and they're amazing as well! The prices are great and the service is exceptional. The owners are extremely kind and are so welcoming! And honestly if I could rate this place higher I would. I usually don't write yelp reviews but I felt like my experience here warranted one! Thank you for the amazing food!

Much like a "Family Fun Center", previously under the name "Boondocks", this is a standard family fun facility that includes games, bumper boats, mini golf, bowling (Pinz), Go Karts, etc. They have a large food area too and shocker... the food was actually good. We had out son's birthday party here, which was really just a bunch of pre-teens playing lazer tag and video games. They have a number of "party" options and group discount passes. It worked out well for us but the adults got hungry and so we ordered food and were quite surprised. The chili cheese fries were both good and ginormous. Plenty for 2 people to have as a meal or 4 people to be snacking on. 

The building and everything to do was up to date. The gaming area has a simulator and plenty of multi-age ranged activities for the younger crowd and older teens as well. The downside is that the way it is laid out, it is easy to lose track of the smaller kids, and I don't mean toddlers... so parents, keep your eyes peeled. Kids are going to walk off when they are surrounded by games, it's a no brainer. The games area is more packed than a Chuck E. Cheese and there is a large age gap of kids that are going to be present on the floor. There are also multiple exits, so for this reason... this paranoid parent gives a star off for the fact that I could see a number of ways that a kid could get stolen if you are juggling too much. It's really not designed for toddlers though, so maybe best to take the older kids only to the game area. There is a specific toddler sections however and it is engaging. We found a problem with it being right next to the simulator and the gate on the toddler area is easy enough that a crawler could get out of there. So, just saying. Maybe I'm crazy, but I think of these things. 

It was really my only complaint. The customer service staff was excellent and even with dealing with kids all day those behind the ticket counter to redeem prizes for the kids seemed upbeat and interested. The facility is clean and has a lot to offer. Definitely a fun place for the family for a day out.

Since this placed opened in Boise, it has served the most phenomenal food, Argentinian empanadas. Light, fluffy and flakey all at once! So happy to see this family owned and operated business is doing so well. For people that have yet to visit Tangos... stop what you're doing and go! It's great for experimental and picky eaters alike. 
Staff is always friendly (especially the owner), the atmosphere always buzzing and comfortable, the food consistently delicious. The empanada taste never changes with the cook, the recipe is so solid that there is never a gap in the quality or the flavor. So please, do your tastebuds a flavor favor and discover Boise's hidden gem.

They came out on time. Charged me 79.00 for the service call.
That was fine,but they don't apply amount to the repair. He went under the house and tighten the trunk line. No more then 30 minutes.
He charged me 200.00 plus the service call for half hour. Not bad.
What a rip!!!!

Tru Green was the company who took care of the lawn fertilizing at our rental home.  Interactions with the person spraying the lawns can best be described as odd.  When I asked if the fertilizers were safe for our two dogs, I got a flippant answer as if I was annoying the technician.  The last straw came when we were moving from this property. Our movers had apx. 10 more minutes left to pack our belongings. When the Tru Green guy showed up we politely asked if he could wait until we were done or come back after he finished other lawns in the area. He shook his head no and started spraying. Our doors were wide open, so the toxic smell wafted throughout the house and we all had to hold our breath walking in and out of the house. 
Based on these experiences, I doubt that I would ever hire them for our lawn care.

I have lived at my rental going on 4 years now. The first year was a different management company. 
I have to say that when Morehouse took over I was a bit worried, and the first few months it was bumpy, but whenever I needed something looked at for repairs or replacement, Morehouse was right on the top of it.
I found that it is easier to communicate with them via email because at least you have it documented.
I do wish that they would change the rental due date from the 3rd to the 5th and not have it month to month after my yearly lease expired. 
But other then that Morehouse Property is really great to work with.

We wanted to tell you how thrilled we are with our new shed. Spencer and Andrew were Fantastic! You can tell that they had experience. Your company is the Bomb! Kailee,  (our sales person) was so warm and helpful!

Came here for the batting cages - cuz shalommm it's baseball season. 

It is so cheap. I think it is like $3 for 24 balls or something like that. They have ample batting helmets and bats - or you can def. bring your own in. The have about 6 different cages with different speeds of pitches. We opted for the slowest since my little dudes are only 10 & 9. 

The only problem we had was that we selected softball & the baseballs would come speeding out. Or if we selected baseballs then the softballs would come out. There was no rhyme or reason and we couldn't figure out why? So we just hit what we were pitched. We still had a great time. 

We also used the bumper boats even tho the sprayers weren't working. 

I love this play! Prices seem fair, and there is SO much to do! We will be back!

Cute little place!! Their sugar cookies are amazing, and the soda choices are better than sonic. You can build your own fun soda or choose  one of their recipes. Either way, you're in for a treat! There isn't too much seating. It's not a great place to stay and eat your snacks, but it's definitely worth a stop by.

Because I was pleased with the owner's response (both privately and publicly), I decided to give these guys another try. I went all out, okay, because if I DID get sick it better be worth it! Oh, there sandwiches. And there were soups.

I'm happy to report I felt completely fine! Yaaaaay! The food was tasty and I didn't feel sick at all. Because I'm a nit-picker, I'll say more cheese on sandwiches please! But overall I'm thrilled to put the Soup Kettle back on my list of Places to Go. I really can't get over that Potato Leek. Thanks for listening, and for acting like you said you would. :) Delicious!

Seriously such good donuts! Everytime I come in they are very courteous and helpful. Lots of selection and everything is always fresh. Their red velvet donuts are to die for!! Also the earlier you come in the better

This is like the Disneyland of grocery stores! Everything you can want and more! We really like their bakery. I've had great experiences with custom bakery orders; my oldest daughters graduation cake and my youngest daughters birthday cake and cupcakes. We love this place!

This place is an absolute joke. The service was terrible and the food was just as bad. We called ahead to reserve a table upstairs for the band, when we walked in the hostess asked how many for a table and when we tried to explain this to her she told us we couldn't go up yet because there was a private party so we would have to wait. I later discovered that we lost our table because the staff upstairs thought we hadn't shown up. We ordered the fried pickles, all you could taste was salt, and the potato skins which had been fried and then later microwaved and had been sitting under the heat lamp. Which they charge you $9 for, four potato skins, that's two potatoes, we didn't even have enough for everyone at the table to have one. We got two pitchers of Coors Light, which came in water pitchers, and they charged us $13 for each one. It took at least fifteen minutes to get our first pitcher. We waited on the potato skins for almost an hour. Our waitress had been double sat when we were seated, it was busy and so loud because of the sound system you had to yell across the table to be heard. Dont even try to walk into the  bathroom. The bartender, who we later discovered is the General Manager, was a complete and total bitch. She had attitude behind the bar and was GLARING not only at us but many other customers as well. Then when I asked to speak with her she refused to come to our table and walked away from and ignored our waitress everytime she tried to go get her. Then she sent the JACKASS that they have for a bouncer out from behind the bar and around to where we were sitting to listen to the conversation we we're trying to have with our waitress concerning everything including their "manager". He then very vehemently refused that he worked there and was just getting a drink. As this is going on, the "manager" is still ignoring us and refusing to DO HER JOB. I then proceeded back upstairs to grab Paige, the only person in the whole place that was willing to help me, and take her away from the bar where the band was playing to help me get things figured out. She came down, and talked with us so we could explain what was going on, she was also ignored by their "manager" when she went to talk to her about it as well. She comped our bill by the end of it because of the entire disasterous shit show it turned into. 

It's way over priced for what you get and the service was horrible. I've worked in food service, I've been behind a bar and in that position, that is NOT how you treat customers. Have some respect for your customers, they are paying your bills. I know how shitty it is, I've seen it all, but you still put a smile on your face and DO YOUR JOB. I will not return and I would advise anyone else to take your money elsewhere. 

To the owner's, I would seriously consider getting rid of some of your staff. The kind of attitude that the customer's, especially the female ones, receive is absolutely uncalled for in that line of work. And Nikki your "manager" is an absolute joke. She isn't a manager and she's not bartender. She will be the cause of your ruin if you don't replace her with someone who can do the job the way it needs to be done. Honestly, I'm absolutely appalled.

Paige, you were AWESOME. You seemed to be one of about three people staffed in that building that has a brain. I'm sorry I had to drag  you into it but thank you so much for listening to us, that was all we wanted. We appreciate your help!

Moved here recently and this has become one of our frequent stops. Service is friendly and attentive and typically get a "hello, sit wherever you'd like" on the way in, and a "thanks for coming" on the way out. Tacos have been a highlight for me, good selection and all have been repeatable, although am partial to the green chili pork option. Other than tacos everything else has been fine, but nothing I'm dying to have again. Also have a great selection of beers, which is my thing, but if cocktails are yours they've got some signature stuff to go along with your standard fair.

The staff is friendly and helpful here.  They give you more than enough shampoo and conditioner for a pet bath.  I don't know what dog wash prices are, generally speaking, but I guess what they charged seemed fair to me.  I bought the upgraded oatmeal shampoo so that added $3 to my bill.  2 things made it a four star rather than five star experience for me... first, the towels aren't very big or absorbent and they only gave me two. Second, the dryers are way too rough on little dogs.  Mine was miserable under the dryer so I had to stop and just take her home soggy.  Luckily it was a very warm day, so she was fine.  What made it a 4 star instead of a three star for me was they had inserts to bring the bath higher for small dogs.  It's what saved my back.
I did not have a good experience with using Axiom as a gym membership. They didn't provide with good customer service when discussing the issue.
Lived in Boise for about 3 months and this place was THE BEST!!!! HIGHLY RECOMMENDED & the staff was super friendly and let us try lime every type of soup bc we couldn't decide. Miss it greatly

For a national franchise sandwich shop I was very pleasantly surprised. I had the Thanksgiving style sandwich while my wife did a more traditional style and they were both very very good. They both had a lot of meat and the breads that they have are very very good. Much better choice than any of the other sub shops that are chain stores out there

My wife and I love Sodalicious!  The staff is awesome!  I wanted to give a huge shout out to two employees in particular, and it is easy because they are both named Zach!  Both of them had excellent customer service and were fun to talk to!  One of the Zach's made an off menu drink for me called Area 51 which was INCREDIBLE!  Hopefully they add Area 51 to the menu soon because I will be asking for it!

The most we have had to wait is about 5 minutes going through the drive through. The gyros are always so good and tasty. Highly recommend coming here!! The new greek fries are delicious!! Make your way over here!

Had my birthday here today and was so good! Walked in and had reservations. We were seated right away! The place was busy for Tuesday night! I like that they had a kids menu with a variety of selections for my non-seafood eater. Everything from the sushi and main fish entrees were delicious! The wait staff looked professional and were friendly! I had the halibut and my boyfriend had the honey chipotle salmon. Both were fresh tasting and cooked perfectly! We will definitely be back!

I have been going to Dr. Mandi for about 3 years and have never had more success with a chiropractor.  I have had improvements with pain in my lower back, neck, wrist, thumb, and elbow along with decreased sinus symptoms.  I have had more relief from sinus pain and pressure with being adjusted than with surgery.  I also had a sledding accident this past winter and it only took just over a week to go from a state of pain and dysfunction in which I could not perform my job to being pain free.  She is a truly caring provider with a gift for adjusting and helping her patients.

I really like flame broil it is somewhat healthy fast food. The chicken taste great and I always get extra veggies or brown rice on the side. If your looking for a healthier teriyaki bowl with tasty chicken and veggies go to FB.

Wonderful, clean and quiet place. It wasn't very busy which I am ok with since no one rushed me to leave. Very nice looking salon. I had a wonderful pedicure, it was relaxing and my nails looked great after. My gal was attentive and very kind. Would recommend and I will be back.

Please be advised, parents, that if you do not submit a drop form prior to the first of the month, you will be charged the full month's tuition for all children enrolled, regardless of participation. Asking for a refund will result in a terse, "Tuition is non-refundable. It was stated on the registration form. Sorry!" Empathy and flexibility should not be expected as a part of their customer service.

If you love paying too much for everything but steak you'll love Albertson's new Marketstreet! Plus you get the added bonus of shopping with drunks, yup that's right, Albertson's serves shoppers alcohol, enough that some express they are getting drunk and beyond the legal limit to drive. 

It's an overwealming store with a great selection and high prices to match. If you think wine and cheese is the bees knees then you'll love Albertson's Marketstreet, until you see the prices of course.

If you are a steak lover, then this is the place. The best selection, the best display, and if you keep your eyes peeled there are good deals to be found during sales on various cuts.

By recommendation I enjoyed this local spot. Rainy day comfortable atmosphere arrived shortly before the 5pm crowds trickle in.  I ordered the Baja enchiladas. Although they were tasty the menu described them as blackened shrimp. When they were served they definitely were not blackened.  I accompanied my Baja enchiladas with a jalepeno margarita I also enjoyed as long as I can dodge the jalapeno seeds.  Yes I will return but three stars since it definitely was not blackened shrimp as expected and very little cream sauce. They were more like two burritos rather than enchiladas. 

Baja Enchiladas

Blackened shrimp, bell peppers, and onions hand rolled in two flour tortillas topped with cheese, poblano cream sauce, and pico de gallo served with cilantro lime rice.

I am visiting from California and my mind was blown! This is quite possibly the most beautiful supermarket I've ever seen. It's just a spectacle to looks at with all the bright colors and easily marked sections around the store but what I was most taken a back by was the cafe section. It has literally EVERYTHING you'd want to eat for lunch or dinner with a terrific seating area to compliment it. There is a full Starbucks inside which isn't that surprising but what is surprising was the fully stocked BAR yes bar in the store! You can come in so some shopping an d have a great cocktail to pair with the many food options (sandwiches, soups, poutine, BBQ, sushi, pizza, Chinese options, desserts... everything!) the selections was incredible. 
When I say down to eat my salmon chowder (which was glorious by the way and reasonably priced!) a server?!? came up to me and asked me if I'd like any water and she threw my trash away for me when I was done. I loved that service because quite honestly I wasn't expecting that. I couldn't tell if it was a grocery store or a restaurant. It was my first solo experience with the people of Idaho and it didn't disappoint! This Albertsons was so awesome I may come back today and try something else! 
Great experience, wonderful prices and memorable salmon chowder!

I love this place and better yet it is locally owned and operated!!!
  The front office staff are so helpful and courteous and the providers take there time with you and make you feel like you matter and they don't rush and hurry you through to just get you out of there to collect their money.  I always feel satisfied of the care my family and I have gotten there. They also have a Med Spa and I have frequented it often and they offer lots of services.  Suzi is wonderful and is extremely good at what she does.  The skin products I have gotten there are very good and I can tell a big difference since using them.  I  wouldn't go anywhere else.

I have been coming here on and off for the last couple of years.  They have always done a mediocre job, so they had been a good choice if I needed to get my nails done last minute. But after my last appointment, just a couple days ago,  I will definitely not be coming back. The staff treated my friend and I with complete disrespect.  And acted like we were a huge burden to be there. Even though we had an appointment. It was also the worst set of acrylics I've ever had. After just 2 days, three of my nails already broke. I'm very disappointed in the direction this salon has gone.

Ordered takeout, trying to support a local business and maintain social distancing. Order online, got an email saying call the curb, your order may have not gone through. I called. Reordered, went in and picked up our order. Got a call from a random number about the time I got home, ignored it of course. Got home. Opened the order....it was not our order, listened to a voice mail from Alex, profusely apologizing, telling us we received the wrong order. They told us to keep the wrong order we received and gave us our right order free of charge. We received probably $100 worth of food free.

The cookies are soft and while one said it was sold out, I asked if more were almost ready being cooked and they were so I opted to wait a couple minutes for a flavor that was said to be sold out. The organization in the store was not well, and the customer service was not good. The person would not look at you when talking and then even we're not looking at each other when talking. They spoke quietly too, and could not be heard by the customers or each other. The price is ok at $3 for a single cookie, $10 for a box of 4, or $25 for a box of 12. The cookies are very sweet and rich in flavor. The cookie batter itself is not very flavorful, but the toppings and chocolate either in or on them is very sweet. I could not finish a whole cookie in one sitting due to the sweetness. I ordered 6 cookies and used a military discount and paid about $15. The presence is appreciated, especially how they show you the cookies in the box before giving them to you, and the person calling that the orders were ready appeared to have the best customer service. The place was busy and appeared to stay busy. 
The cookies themself are big and worth a $3 price. They are very sweet, ok flavor, but nothing that would make me excited about the flavor or about returning. The presentation makes the cookies seem more worth it than they are. Since they are large, the outside gets a rim of light crisp, and then the inside is gooey and chewy. Overall I think the batter is a little bland but then overpowered by the sweetness of the chocolate or toppings, taking away from the base cookie flavor.
Absolutely love their cookies. Never had anything so tasty. If you order them for delivery they will show up at your door warm and ready to eat!!

Stop whatever you're doing and eat here.  Soup and sandwiches that are absolutely killer and made from scratch.  Boise is full of chains with recipes bogged down with horrible ingredients and plastic tasting food...not this joint.  Aside from the really friendly staff and fast service...the food is RIDICULOUS.  I gave up on finding a good soup/sandwich joint in Boise.  East coast dominates that world...but this spot is giving my neighborhood deli a good run for its money.

Absolutely love this place. We stopped by during our visit to Idaho and quickly realized there wouldn't be enough time to do everything in one day. There is so much to do! Everyone was super friendly and helpful. I have to give a shout-out to the kids working the go karts. They were working so hard! They were friendly and made it so much fun with great personalities. They cleaned everything after every ride so we felt super safe. Thank you!

Ordered from this company twice. First time we ordered around 9pm and called after the hour allotted time and we called to check on the status and they said when we called another hour to be delivered. Cookies didn't get delivered until 11:30 pm.  Gave us a coupon.

Second time we gave them another chance and same thing happened. Called after the hour allotted time and said it would still be another hour. They offered to cancel the order and refund which we did but still no cookies :(

Do yourself a favor and go to the grocery store, get the ingredients, go home and make them, do the dishes, eat them and you'll still get the cookies faster than they can deliver.

My cousin told us to come here and we loved it! The owners were so nice to our kids and gave them a couple of free donuts. The donuts were very tasty and fresh. I will come here again and bring friends and family here when they come in from out of town. The donut holes melt in your mouth.

Great place! The staff is very friendly and seem to really enjoy working there. They tested a couple shave attachments to see what level I wanted and were genuinely interested in making sure they understood what I was wanting. 

It cost me $50 for full groom on my 13 lb Shih Tzu.

I would like to see some kind of stamp system/ incentives for repeat customers implemented.

Ahhhhmazingness!!! This is definitely a family favorite. They put such care into everything made, quality/fresh ingredients, everything I've tried has been flavored/seasoned perfectly! My favorite is the buffalo chicken soup...yum!

We ordered the Original Sandwich and the Mediterranean Sandwich with no cucumber. When I was ordering the Mediterranean I was feeling a little sad that it was the only vegetarian option. I feel often Mediterranean and Greek sandwiches are the go to for vegetarian options and it shows lack of creativity. However, I was completely wrong in this scenario. Their Mediterranean sandwich is probably the best sandwich I've ever had. It was incredible. It was creamy and did not taste like the stereotypical Mediterranean sandwiches. It was perfectly filling as well.

I love this store. and at last, it opened at my side of town. No more driving 30 mins to get my shopping done. So excited about this store opening on eagle Rd. Yay! Has more or less the same layout. Albeit different. Friendly staff and great products. The best part is traders joe teaming up with an Israeli company (osem) and manufacturing my childhood snack (bamba). We stock on it weekly. Am in and out in about 30 minutes tops. This girl knows her way around traders joe lol
Really neat store! It has a large variety of products and is suitable for every budget. I like that I can go there to buy specialty products along with "normal" groceries.

Oh, my gosh! This is the Disneyland of grocery stores!!!! They have everything!!! Sushi, deli, pizza, burgers, a pharmacy, coffee shop, restaurant, bar, gifts, floral, you name it this place has got it and with a LOT of class! Beautifully done, Albertsons!!! It's huuuuuge!

Excellent cookies - very busy shop but it is always hot inside and in the summer I am concerned about the working conditions for the employees.  When asked I was told the air conditioner was "broken" - but for months now?  Heat stroke is a thing.
Best ever. Hands down. Service, atmosphere, food drinks. Love. Sometimes the occasional annoying waitress, but hey everyone's got some of those right.

Worst Service Ever!

We've been looking for a good sandwich shop in Idaho. Have yet to find one. We stopped at Hugo's today to order lunch for everyone. Having never been there it was a little overwhelming reading the menu. I didn't have time to wait for family members to get online to look up the menu. My daughter tried to snap a photo to message to the others at home, but the cashier made a comment that they weren't for photographing. So I did it by phone, but apparently this aggravated the cashier as well. Who turned to her co-workers and made a snarky comment, saying, "and this is why we don't allow this." Come to find out there is a sign on the register stating no cell phones. While I would understand this if I were just having a random conversation, I was not. I was getting everyones order. I was ordering 7 sandwiches, 3 were meals, and a large fries. When I asked if they carried BBQ chips the cashier with attitude said there in front of you. She gave us our total, $78 for 7 sandwiches and 1 order of fries. I went to get sweet tea and it was empty. I advised the young girl it was out. While sitting waiting I never saw anyone fill the sweet tea, so I again advised the cashier who was the one who rung us up that the tea was empty. She stated I took care of that already. Do you think if a customer who is waiting to get a drink tells you the tea is empty, you might let them know that you took care of it!! Now let's get to the food. It was horrible. Lacked any taste at all. I ordered 5 turkey Bacon Advo, and truthfully a little crumpled up pieces of bacon do not count as bacon. I was expecting a few slices of bacon on the roll. Further, the rudeness and the lack of welcome was enough to never have me stepping in their store again. I will be calling as I see there are more than 1 store, and hoping they have a district manager. Further had I heard the comment that the cashier made, I would have cancelled my order on the spot and walked out. I can make a better sandwich at home, and should have.

Great atmosphere, lots of TVs and cold beer.  The burgers are amazing and the macaroni and cheese is the best I have ever had! 
They have a special everyday, food and drink. They serve breakfast both Sat and Sun till 1.

OMG this is the best place ever I'm literally obsessed! The empanadas are AMAZING. Hot and fresh every time! The bread is so addicting! There is a yummy variety to choose from, from meats to desserts and they are all fabulous! I've yet to try everything on the menu, but what I have tried WOW I'm impressed! I hope this place stays around for a long time!

I used to have Scotts until True Green bought them. I have never had even one weed with Scotts. True Green either don't put enough on or their product is weak. I have many weeds now and they just were here 1 month ago.
Visited The Curb today. Our daughter in love said that the fish tacos were good so tried the Baja they were great! The girl who waited on us was very pleasant.

If you drove up to the Fast Eddys looking for the sandwich joint...keep looking past the fuel stations and locate the convenience store portion of the property and you will find the sandwich shop inside the convenient store. The Fast Eddys store built room for a small sandwich shop with about 6 tables and another 10 bar stools to sit and eat.
The convenient store is very clean and organized and the sandwich area is no different. The employees were very friendly and helpful.  The service was quick and easy given the simple to follow menu. 
I ordered the Italian sandwich, chips,  and a drink for a little over 9 bucks. The sandwiches are sold in one size and are definitely filling. The Italian was filled with plenty of Italian meats and a tasty italian sauce. The sandwich is warmed up to make the sandwich even better. 
If you are looking for a tasty quick sandwich on Eagle road, you will not go wrong here. You just need to find the Fast Eddys first. Also note that seating is limited so please be warned if it is busy. 
Cheers Always!

Great food and service. The Lobster Avocado appetizer is absolutely delicious! The aged rib eye was cooked perfectly.

Let me start by saying that the many of the photos if this establishment by yelpers prior to November 2017 are of the old Harrys, which was more bar scene and didn't have it's act together like this new place does (is working on).  

I had a 5 experience but there were a few things that knocked the rating down. Here's why I loved it and what I can see improved. I will eat here again and will update my review when I do. 

Parking for this establishment is ample. The only thing is you don't know where the entrance is. I walked one way and it appeared to be the wrong way leading me to the outdoor seating, which was closed, and an exit door. As I walked to that door, which you park by, I walked past a mess of floor mats, garbage, and a broken down ice machine. I walked all the way around the restaurant and realized that parking is behind the restaurant essentially so everyone sees things that are usually hidden in the back like messes, trash bags and such. I noticed a large parking lot for motorcycles. 

I walked through the main doors and in the middle of the dining room is a well-balanced bar and lots of sitting to eat. Downstairs is more of the restaurant and upstairs they have a bar, private patio with television screens, some pool tables, and a chill, relaxed environment. Downstairs has lots of seating for all sizes and shapes, a jukebox, shuffleboard, and a lottery machine. We were asked if we wanted bar seating. I said no, table or booth, please. We were then offered a high or low table-- the low table was our preference. We were sat down on the side of where the kitchen is. Everyone was very friendly by this point. I, however, noticed that I can see into the floor of the kitchen and the floor was super dirty. Now, it was busy, this is a softish opening, and I've worked in a kitchen before so I get it, but not everyone would and for customers to be able to see into the kitchen it needs to look clean (photo attached). 

The waitress came rather quickly, Renegade, and was super polite. She offered choices and suggestions. We spoke about the old restaurant vs this new one. Their menu was easy to read, fair to high prices and somewhat creative. I went with the cobb salad and my dining companion,  George, went with the nachos. 

The nachos-- BEST EVER! Seriously we both enjoyed the nachos. He was asked if he wanted half or whole ($11.99/13.99). He went with the hole and will take the leftovers. The waitress was very good in explaining that it will be huge. A half is a cookie sheet with one layer of chips pretty smothered and a whole is the same thing with more layers. They came out (see photo) and was huge! Homemade guacamole on top (can't get better than that), juicy, not dry meat, fresh ingredients, and simply a very good taste/flavor combination. I really wish my YELPER friends Jon M and Yulia tasted these Nachos with me. I think I'm going to invite them both here soon. We both ate off of them (ok, I had three bites) and he ate until he was stuffed to the brim and he still had a whole un-closeable box of left-overs (again, see pics). Oh, he did add chicken (+$2) making these Nachos $14.99 and again, well worth it. 

I had the Cobb salad-- not a whole lot to write about with a salad, but it had some of the best fresh bacon, nice and thick, that I've gotten on a salad. There was a good amount of everything-- half of an avocado, blue cheese crumbles, a hard-boiled egg, olives, and juicy shredded chicken breast. The salad was very well balanced, not watery like many others I've had, with fresh quality ingredients. $11.99 for this salad, which was on the average to high price for similar establishments. That bacon though... mmmmmmmmm

Again, the service was top notch, very friendly, fast, nice, talkative yet not too talkative, fun vibe, great food... It was an overall good experience and I encourage you to check out Harry's Hideaway in their NEW location right across from the Sonic in Meridian on Overland near the majestic and the Harley Davidson building. 

All-in-all, clean the kitchen up, the side and back of the buildings, put an entrance sign up in the parking lot and this would easily go up to a 5 star, for me. Perhaps we should have a Yelp Event at Harry's...Amie... :)

Made reservations on theIr WEB site for reservations. It was a Saturday

We were in the area for the weekend and love seafood, so this was a natural choice for us. I ordered the stuffed avocado salad and the mango shrimp street taco (thinking I was only getting one, but I got 3). I over ordered, but the street tacos were delicious and I passed them out to everyone at the table. They were a favorite. My salad was one of the best things I had on my trip. The dressing was the star here, with a spicy bite. Our server was pleasant, but a little awkward, lol. The atmosphere was pleasant, but it was pretty busy in there on a Friday night. My husband had the baja enchiladas - he said they were, and I quote, "f*ckin' phenomenal". He said it, not me. Anyway, my daughter had some deluxe sushi roll that was shared with everyone one and very yummy. 

If you want a great meal and you love seafood, you should definitely give it a try! I think it would be great for families, casual, and the price is reasonable for seafood. I will say they overuse their butter in a perfectly awesome cilantro rice, and the atmosphere could be pumped up a bit, but I would definitely recommend it. Good value. :) Go there!

The gals are great. They do a really nice job and I am always happy. Prices are reasonable. I always leave happy with some fresh new nails, and I like when they suggest things, like adding sparkle, because I wouldn't do it myself, so it's nice to have that additional opinion on making my nails fly.

The best thing about this place was definitely the price. $25 for a gel manicure. Toto I don't think we're in California anymore. It's a big salon with lots of chairs, nice interior and very clean.

The cons were those of us just getting manicures had to wait about a half hour to get our nails done, even with an appointment. We were with a large group and they just didn't have enough staff to help us all. Mistakes happen so I get it. The girl at the front desk was super sweet and apologetic.

The brand of gel they use was one I didn't recognize either. I'm guessing it was a more affordable kind to put it nicely. Normally I can remove a gel manicure by soaking them in acetone but it's now 2 months later and I still have remnants of it on my nails after many attempts to remove it. The manicure didn't last the full 2 weeks like they usually do either. It started to weirdly crack after about a week and a half. 

I don't live in Boise so this is all based off one visit. Places have bad days so other people might have had a much better experience and we were just there on an off day.

The food was great. And everyone was friendly and polite. Overall we really enjoyed our meal. Watch out for the salad bar. The selection was fresh and falntastic, but you are paying for the meat. Flank steak and beef rib were my favs.

So many options here. I love the layout and it's large enough to fit everything so it doesn't feel cluttered. despite it being so nice it never feels unbearably busy. The deli, sushi, soup, salad and such is super fresh and good. And I also appreciate there being a good amount of parking for the store.

This store is able to sell top brand merchandise at a fraction of the MSRP. I picked up some Asolo hiking boots this month, for over 50% off of the full asking price at other stores. They do provide military discounts for those that served, which gives you an extra 10% off of their already great prices.
Make the trip if you are in Boise.. great prices and an amazing staff especially Darren!

I brought my yorkie, Herman, here for the first time for a sanitary cut. Sarah did an amazing job and I will certainly be returning for his future haircuts. Sarah groomed him exactly as I asked and did a good job with his yorkie cut. The pricing is very fair and she did a very thorough job. Thank you!

The homemade sausage is really good.   Service is great, a really friendly atmosphere.   My only complaint would be to add a 2 egg kids omelette to the kids menu.  Lunch menu is really good.   The food is homemade and it shows. In a day and age where Americans eat plastic type food everyday, Steve's Cafe is a welcome spot for my health conscious Family.

These guys are a smooth talkers. They have one mission, to separate you from your money. Their fee to do the sales paperwork is at least $100 higher than I have ever seen. Why question them about it they told me it was because they provided such great service. Yeah OK. We also tried to sell me a $299 window etching extra claiming that if my car was ever stolen it would help get it back. Anyone with half a brain knows that's ridiculous. The police go by a car's license number and vehicle identification number not the etchings on the window glass. If you have a trade-in prepared to get lowballed. But that's pretty much standard for any dealer. On a positive note, they usually have an inventory of some pretty decent cars. I was happy with the car I got but I didn't like all the sneaky stuff they tried to pull. Since the purchase I have been spammed relentlessly via US mail and email for automotive related products and offers I have absolutely no use for.
I love going to this location! Maddie, Miranda, and Claire are the best. Always so sweet when I come in. Got a spray tan today and feel so much better.

I just moved to Idaho and needed some help trying to find a vape and some juice. The dudes in this place were helpful and didn't seem to mind helping a clueless girl. 

Thanks guys!

The most amazing grocery store you'll ever walk into. Everything is so beautifully displayed that you almost feel you are in an art gallery. They have food selections from major chains to local and international. All shelves are stocked to bursting. I don't think they've ever been out of something I've needed. Even though it is always packed, I have never waited more than 1-2 minutes in line. It is very well organized. 

Plus my young kids LOVE going grocery shopping with me here! They have free fruit for the kids to munch on as well as amazing free samples. None of the cheap stuff either, they have exotic fruit, expensive cheeses, delicious pastries, and more. They even have fun holiday events that the kids can participate in. For example, during St. Patrick's day you walked around the store finding the free sample stations and getting a stamp to fill out your card. Then you could be entered into a free drawing. My boys thought that was just the coolest!

Don't forget this place for lunch or dinner either! Seriously...bypass the busy restaurants and come here instead. They have everything from made to order pizza, Asian bowls, sushi, American cuisine, sandwiches and a stellar salad bar. Nothing is frozen and everything is made from scratch. Plus, everyone can get what they want! The seating is ample and they even have waiters that come around offering you water or other beverages. 

Bring all your out of town guests to Albertsons Market Street, and they will be blown away!
Phenomenal food and incredibly fast. We were in and out in 30 minutes. If you love seafood and your Idaho, can't beat this place.

I placed my order through the drive thru. I ordered a nacho bell grande that ended up being the size of a nacho supreme. I ordered a taco supreme but they forgot tomatoes and sour cream. The bean burritos I ordered looked like cheesy roll ups. The portion sizes were inadequate and part of the order was wrong. Won't be coming back here!

Smashburger has SUCH good, juicy burgers!     So good, in fact, that I may never get to try their chicken.   I mean, why order chicken when the burger so clearly rocks!?

I was a little apprehensive ordering my first burger with the multi-grain bun, but it was soft, fresh, and delicious!   Okay, so I'm eating a huge burger with fried sides and soda... at least I can make one little healthy choice.  :)

Everything came out exactly as ordered.   Even when the restaurant was busy on a Saturday at lunchtime, our food came out faster than we expected.

The french fries are on the thin side, and were cooked nicely both times we ordered them.   Dad's choice, the haystack onions, were much better than I expected.  They were very thin, delicately breaded onion "rings".    Hot & tasty.  Based on their success with sides, I plan to try the veggie frites (with fried asparagus, green beans, and carrot sticks) and the sweet potato fries on future visits.

The root beer float, as you can see in one of the photos I took, was served with scooped vanilla ice cream in a frosty glass accompanied by a bottle of root beer.  Very nice!    As a big soda drinker, I appreciate the soda fountain available for customers to refill drinks.  I also liked the 'to go' cup so I could take some soda on the road.

One thing that brings Smashburger up a notch from Five Guys and other "burger" spots is that the staff is so attentive.   Despite the counter service, employees were regularly coming around to make sure everyone had everything they needed.

I went here, in hope of some good teriyaki. First off, let me say, the rice tasted exactly like the rice from Happy Teryaki. I was waiting in line, and the man made it unclear who he was talking to when he said the words, "Wait a minute." I thought he was talking to his coworker. Apparently, he was telling me to wait to order. I didn't get that, so I just started ordering. He gave me a dirty look. Then, he proceeded to give me the wrong size bowl. And the wrong sauce. He thought I was disrespecting him when really he didn't know how to properly communicate.

I think one of the best breakfast houses in Boise/Meridian area. We eat here often. Hours of operation are shorter than most, and almost always a line to wait in especially on Sunday. The food is outstanding and the staff is quick and courteous. We almost always take part of it home with us. I love eating here!!

Got them delivered to my temporary home. Really nice. Surprisingly good, in fact. All the meats are good, and the side dishes are leagues better than one would expect. At most places, shakes are kinda "meh" for me, but this place uses really good ice cream. Really fresh and fast.
Nothing in the valley can beat Tangos. Period. The owners are also the most fabulous people, as a bonus.

I have come here 2 times and enjoyed the food both times. I got a basic Original Gyro. Really good. Best I've had in years. 
80/20 Beef to lamb ratio. Great seasoning and sauce. Big portion. Priced right. I will start trying the others now each week.

I grew up in Southern California and have always loved Trader Joe's! The food quality is top notch, there are so many yummy options and the staff is so great! I especially love the staff at the Meridian location! I went in the other morning to buy some flowers and the cashier asked what the occasion was and I told him it was for my birthday dinner and he gave me the roses "on the house"...seriously so sweet! Thank you TJ's!

This is the best donut place I've been to! I'm here visiting and we have had pretty bad luck with most of our food choices but this was not one of them. Definitely recommend if you like donuts! Recommended if you don't like them! Great place and great environment! Customer service was also on point... just a good place all the way around.

Came home to eat (because we couldn't eat there, see below) and my fiance had a long dark hair in his gyro! Disgusting! He has short hair...it was not his hair! I watched him pull it out from the gyro, tangled in meat so it was deep in there. He also ordered pita with hummus, but did not receive the hummus. What's the point of eating pita without hummus? Oh and they close at 9:00 pm, but we were told we could not stay in the restaurant to eat at 7:40 pm. What a shame because the employees were very friendly and we were looking forward to going back in the future. This was our first time here too. We had been working for 12 hours and were starving. We both threw our food in the trash and had to cook (which is what we were trying to avoid tonight). We're very into fitness and clean eating...we hardly eat out, let alone fast food so this was a splurge for us after a long day of work. Beyond disappointed!

This place is extremely professional and delivers great service. Not only do they repair sewing machine but also vacuums which do also sell, they carry Sibo made in Germany which is the best vacuum on the market. Highly recommend this place for any needs you have with your sewing or vacuuming.

Their food is good for the most part. It has been hit and miss in the past but not enough to stop going completely. Shakes are incredible though! I only give three stars because some of the staff like to do donuts behind the store after they close really late! It's loud, throws rocks and they can come close to the fences in the back near homes. I have complained to police but they don't get here there in time. Staff needs to grow up and be more respectful to neighbors!

Just bought a new mattress from Mattress Land. A very positive experience. Darron Humphrey was a very nice salesperson. I loved all the choices I had. I also loved the prompt free delivery and the removal of my existing (old) mattress and box spring. The Yelp reviews brought me to this place and I am glad I went.

We ordered our Thanksgiving dinner from Albertsons because my mom is terminally ill.  I ordered online and confirmed in person with deli that they had received our order and we were good to go.  Albertsons called this morning to let me know my order for dinner was cancelled due to a glitch in the system.
