What was supposed to be a stress free last Thanksgiving  with my mother has turned out to be a disaster with all of the family members out trying to find a turkey the day before.  I will never shop at another Albertsons out of principal.

Our first time in and we weren't disappointed. We (mostly my floofer) were greeted right away and given the whole low-down. I appreciate that they made my little ol' girl feel comfortable with lots of attention and she loved the treats. The facility was clean even with some fur remnants that was being cleaned up from a couple of previous washes. Fur, I can handle; filth I cannot.

They offer diy or full grooming options. For the short time we were there, they were busy with pick ups and drop offs. That was a great sign for me. We'll be back for sure!

After two days of wearing my new hundred dollar jacket zipper broke. The store would not take it back since there was a little stain from the mornings breakfast. I asked why they would not stand behind a defective product and they said if they cannot take said product that is defective and put it back on a hanger and sell to the next fool they will not take it back. Now that TJ Maxx owns the store it has gone far far downhill. Many of the brands that used to sell or not carry it anymore and their customer service is typical of a TJ Maxx. Such a bummer our town  lost a terrific store.

Before we moved to Idaho last year we sent a certified letter for our deposit in our apartment there. After a few weeks our apartment call us and ask where the check was, and we were shocked to learn that it never left the post office. The Meridian Post Office actually had our certified letter sitting in a box neglected! I call the USPS to complain, but was told basically that it was an administrative and bureaucratic nightmare to try and prosecute this. Since we have moved here, the mail delivery has actually been good, but I noticed that one of the female postal carriers left our mailbox open once, and then  did not deliver a package even though the note said "Sorry we missed you!" I have surveillance cameras and saw that she never even got out of her vehicle. So this morning I go to the post office to pick it up and the line is out the door and it was only 8:30 a.m. on Tuesday morning. Pathetic!
Average burger, more expensive than other fast food places. Not worth the money or attention.

This place was a tasty treat!

Pros:  Tasty food with generous portions!  The servers were very friendly and quick to refill drinks.  The cinnamon rolls are also a must-try! The place is very clean and bright with a lot of windows to let in the sunlight which I really enjoyed.

Cons:  Even though my group made reservations in advance, we still had to wait around 20 minutes for us all to be seated.  Other than that, no complaints!

Overall, if I lived closer, I'd be a regular!

We went in to buy a dining room set and living room set. Found what we liked, the associate Kim, told us the dining table was on back order which we thought ok we will wait and get it anyways. A week later our order arrives with no coffee table or end tables and told they are back ordered as well. We would have chosen something else if we were told this up front. Call customer service and they have no real answer as to when we will receive our tables. Love their commercial" always in stock" liars! Don't buy here thinking your stuff will be delivered in a timely manner. Very disappointed with the whole experience. Will never recommend RC Willey to anyone. Two stars were for the poor guys that delivered the couch and love seat and had to listen to me complain.

My favorite go to donut shop since moving to the Treasure Valley 1.5 years ago.  Nice selection of donuts and prices are reasonable.  Last time I went in it was later in the morning and the donuts were a little greasy tasting but still very good.

This gym is well equipped and a great variety of classes. One problem is they offer too many classes at one time. The gym floor can be crowded, not enough seating for parents and the parking is HORRIBLE! Some instructors are great and the others lack an interest in their job. It's hit and miss what type of instructor you'll get. 

I just found out this summer that you're suppose to let them know to stop your automatic withdrawal at the end of the season. Why wouldn't it just stop when the classes stop in May!!! I didn't realize this until the middle of July! When I called I only got reimbursed for one of those months. The receptionist told me they posted signs and handed out fliers letting parents know to cancel their accounts at the end of the season but my child stopped going the middle of April so we never saw the notices. Again, not sure why it just doesn't stop when the classes stop. Maybe trying to catch parents like myself that don't realize this and that way they can keep getting the money! SHADY!!!
Amazing cookies! I personally think they are the best in the area, and the weekly options keep you coming back for more!

Love this place, reminds me of Publix subs (southerners will know) which I do miss!

Every time I have ordered from here, I order online and go pick up. The food is always ready as soon as I arrive and very fresh tasting even as I get home.

It's typically teens working but they are always pleasant.

It's not top of the food chain sandwich shop but it's what I expect in a quick, pick up and go sandwich shop.

Will return.

I went here a couple days ago to get my dog a nail trim. Of course being new around town I did my research on the best place to take my senior Chihuahua. I called and they were able to get me in the same day, which was wonderful. They took him back to get his nails done and I looked around the store. They have dog food, treats and even baked goods for dogs! They have a couple chairs to sit in. It's a very cute place! With this virus going around I wanted to make sure I was safe as well and the employee told me they clean everything and sanitize constantly. Which made me happy to hear. I bought a couple baked goods for my dog which were so cute! I decided to try the self wash baths they have. I made an appointment for the next day and it was a wonderful experience for me. Not so much for my dog but that's because he hates bath time. Hence why I was willing to try something new. For smaller dogs they have a tray which helps your back so much! They give you towels, shampoo and perfume plus ear washing cotton swabs with witch hazel. The drying room is wonderful. Unfortunately my dog hated that part the most because he was scared of the dryer. It was pretty loud and powerful. I loved it but I have a bit of a scaredy-cat. I will definitely recommend this place to anyone with a dog. It is so cute in there as well as clean! Plus it smells nice as well! Which is impressive for a dog shop. Oh and they gave him a pupocino which he loves!! Awesome place! Take your dog there, you won't regret it. We will be back for sure.

I have given this place 3 chances and every time it is exactly the same, SO SLOW. I could sit down and eat a meal at a restaurant faster. Save your self sometime and head to the jack in the box a few blocks down.
Very clean and open joint and the pizza is up to par. Everything seems very fresh and the prices are super competitive. Definitely a repeat customer.

Great local spot for soup that will warm you up! I stopped here on with one of my best girlfriends and it was perfect for the cold spring day that it was. There were lots of soups to choose from with plenty of dairy free, gluten free, and vegetarian options. They even have take out containers of soups that you can take home and impress your family with. 

The only setback was my deathly fear of onion chunks. Not one soup didn't have onions in it.  Now I know I'm crazy but for me...it's a big deal. I was able to spoon around the onions and still enjoy the creamy soup!

BarkWash is a great place! The employees are great and eager to help! Shampoo, conditioner, ear cleaner, brush, doggie  cologne and apron are provided. They have a room to dry your furbaby with a blow dryer. Place is clean and has good background music while you wash your pup

We go many times a year to Wahooz and the water park. This time We went to eat and bowl. The food quality has fallen short lately. We ordered chicken nachos. There was very little chicken, no guacamole and was not good. Also ordered steak fingers and fries.....fries were good....steak fingers, terrible.  We then waited over 2 hours to bowl as they forgot about us, we checked on our waiting spot twice. Finally we get to bowl and the server was terrible....wouldnt ask us if we needed anything, until we went directly to the bar to get served. I love Wahooz, but they were not even very busy.....seems either the staff is not well trained or what???......next time we will head back over to Big Als....if we are going to spend 200 bucks to bowl and eat, we might as well go somewhere we can get better service. Also, it would be great if you charged per game instead of by the hour. We were at the very end and it just stops dead......

This being the 3rd house I have bought it and I never had everything go as smooth as it did this time. I contacted Kendra and explained my situation and basically what I wanted and were I wanted to be with my new house purchase. She got me exactly were I wanted to be and explained all the details along the way. Even when they decided to move my closing up she made it happen. She was in constant communication with me either by text, or email or phone calls. Words can not explain how happy I am with the whole overall experience with her and evergreen. I would not hesitate to recommend her to anyone looking to buy or just need info... Thanks for everything..
Arbitrarily add charges and never respond to inquiries about same. Look for either delays or denials on all request for maintenance.

I haven't eaten here for at least 7-8 years. I had a bad experience 2 times in a row, decided no to eat here anymore. I was pleasantly surprise. The food was awesome, piping hot, flavorful and very good. This is now my go to Mexican food restaurant again. The chicken fajita burrito, shredded beef burrito, and pork burrito all were very very good.

Love this place for delicious, just out of the oven, cookies! They're so delicious. With s couple standard offerings (eg chocolate chip) and new creations, you'll always be able to get your cookie fix. 
Party boxes are also available for those special occasions.

I have nothing but great things to say about this company and their employees. They are one of the best property management companies in the treasure valley and I've lived a lot of different place with a lot of different companies. They are always kind and courteous and I love seeing their smiling faces when I go into the office to pay my rent. Brandon really knows what he's doing and has this company running so efficiently that I can see him being around in the area for a very long time. 
They have always worked with me on any problems I've ever had and been very kind about it also they go the extra mile to make sure their tenants are happy and safe in their dwellings. YOU GUYS ROCK!!!!!! They are getting a high recommendation from me. They will also look at each individual situation of their future tenants and help them in any way they can to get them into a place to call home.

Fantastic grocery store. Good location by the village. Lots of variety in the products as well as freshly cooked items in the store. Clean and almost brand new. We love the fresh in store orange juice, tortillas, queso, and guacamole. Also, the pre-formed seasoned burgers in the fresh meat department. Friendly service from the staff. Small but clean restrooms on the right side of the business. Free WiFi. Plenty of free parking.

I love Fanci Freez! I'm a native and have enjoyed many summers getting ice cream downtown. I was thrilled when they opened their new location. BUT-there's always a "But."

UPDATED:: I had previously stated some confusion regarding the quantity of an order of onion rings. I'm thankful I shared because I was contacted right away by management that the info I'd received wasn't accurate and they made it up to me. 

All I can say is, good job in being attentive to your customers, learning and growing. Oh, and for having stinkin' good fry sauce. :)

We stopped here on our way through Boise and couldn't have been more pleased! Excellent service, tasty food, very quick and convenient. I rarely review, but I felt this business deserves one! The soups are incredible :)
Grabbed a quick bite and brew on the patio.  Good beer menu and great steak nachos.  Friendly service.

Have read so many awesome reviews had to check it out. My daughter & I went last Saturday morning. Lots of flavors. Cute little shop. Young blonde hair gal was super sweet & patient while we decided to get. My daughter loved the donut holes filled with sweet yumminess. Their cake donut (which are my favorite) where light and fluffy (ie like a cloud) - SO SO good. Definitely recommend & will be going back soon.
Best fast food ever, my only complaint is that there isnt more if them. It's the type of meal prep I do at home honestly.

Corona is my best Mexican Restaurant so far.
Very welcoming, wonderful servers, tasty meals and perfect portions.
The wait time is no longer then 12 minutes depending on what you order.
The server Lucy is an amazing woman and you can tell her passion for what she do through her services.
I strongly recommend Corona restaurant and I will definitely be back whenever I visit Idaho.

You pass it without even seeing it but it is well worth finding it.  The soups (I tasted 3) are truly great.  The chicken salad sandwich was filled with chicken chunks, really good.  Check it out (and can't wait to stock up when the cold gets here!)

Aesthetic: excellent. Clean and relaxing!
Environment: felt like I had walked into my friend's kitchen. 
Professionalism: the gal that took my order and made my coffee was so pleasant and positive! Quality of coffee: Best coconut milk latte I've had in Boise. 
I love this place! Great place to meet up with a friend or to do work or to read a book!
Deplorable! If you like eating ina garbage can, this is the place!! Filthy tables, floors, walls, etc, and we were the only ones here, not busy at all. Will NOT return.
Friendly professional service. Great quality product. Excellent and professional installation. Good turnaround time.

Hey it's the Village otherwise known as the Meridian Money Pit.  It is what it is, so knowing that ahead of time helps out when you buy two yogurts with minimal toppings.  Have that $20 bill ready.  La Creme is a cute little yogurt sweet store tucked off to the side by Cafe Matador and the edge of the Valet service. It's neat and clean and the girls that run the register are most likely Pokemon and Snapchat experts. Face it, you're not here for the ambiance or the small talk. It's hot and you want something to cool down.  Grab one of the "buckets" and fill it ever so gently with the different favors and then add on the fresh fruit or sugary treats but keep in mind that it will all get weighed at the end. The fresh fruit is fresh and very tasty and there are the usual yogurt suspects when it comes to the sugary treats. 

Boy, that scale is pretty obvious and scary. I never know how they calculate the price, its like so mysterious.  Do they tare the scale to take in account for the weight of the bowl? errr bucket?  Who knows?  There are other delicious treats in the case but I was deathly afraid to ask how much.  

Maybe it's me and the fact that I'm budget conscious about this type of stuff but I when I think about a container of Tillamook Ice Cream costing $5.00 or so and filling my bucket half way with yogurt, fresh strawberries, a little bit of chocolate for $10.00 or so, I think I rather bring my Tillamook Ice Cream container with me the next time I go and sit at the Village.

This place was pretty difficult to find. GPS pit is a block away and had to call and drive around to find it. Not well marked. The fish and chips were some of the best I've had. Coleslaw with apples in it, amazing. The calamari was great also. Service was average. Clean restaurant. Good prices, for the quality of the food.

My dad loves seafood so whenever he comes into town, he suggests Lucky Fins for food. Their calamari is amazing. Their lobster Mac and Cheese is amazing. Their everything is amazing! My mom eats salmon everywhere we go, but the Cedar Plank at lucky fins is arguably her favorite, she says. The downtown location is fun and lively. The meridian location is calm and comfortable. We go to both, they're both amazing.
We come here quite often. Every single time we get the best service. They have always been so friendly. I love the tofu bowl!
The guy bartender is legit. The new girl tonight had an attitude and was poor service

I experienced face to face lying, bait and switch techniques with a special offer I brought in and a persistence level of pressure that made me so uncomfortable that I just had to leave but to do so I had to be sharp and to just go while they were still badgering me with their lies. 

  This treatment was not just dreamed up the day I went in, it's pretty obvious that a person with a little less knowledge about what is wrong with their vehicle  would have been snared in this trap as soon as they walked in the door. All of this Bald Face Lying was so unnerving I felt like I was running away from some kind of monster as I drove out of this dead end street trap. I am not kidding. BEWARE

Why have hours posted on the entry door if you don't actually stay open for customers!?
My kids and I drove 20 mins to have dinner at 7:30 last night only to find the "Open" signed turned off and the doors locked. 
Customers don't come back if they can't rely on a place being open as advertised. 
SO frustrating!

Love love love their mango shrimp tacos literally come dine here just for those! The drink are very yummy as well and the ser is good plus I love that o can reserve a take with Open Door! Only reason it's a 4 not 5 is because I went in recently and noticed they changed the tortilla from corn to flour & I want the corn tortilla back!!!!! Please bring it back it's not the same!!!
Supermarket on steroids.  This place is fantastic and all the staff we encountered were friendly and helpful.

As usual I find Steve's to be hit or miss.

Went for late breakfast.  As always, the place is very clean; from there it went downhill.  Ordered ham and american cheese omelet with pancakes.  Have no idea why but the pancakes were the worse I have ever had; very much like rubber and being a senior citizen I do not digest rubber very well.  The omelet came with cheddar cheese as opposed to what I ordered.  The hash browns were very good.  In total was not a good breakfast for $14.00+.

However, the cafe is a very social place.  The waiter and waitresses stood around and held conversations with each other.

Was given my bill prior to my completing my bfk.

By the way, NO WI-FI.

I really don't have many complaints. They are fairly priced, have really talented people, and are usually pretty friendly. However, I'm not quite sure about their scheduling. They usually have a 10-15 minute wait time --at least. But they really are pretty good. I would still recommend them!

Called on a holiday weekend (of course!), and Dan answered immediately.  Gave us some possible helps for our situation, and set an appt for the next morning.  Was prompt, diagnosed quickly, and had the part we needed on hand already.  Fixed it right there, and gave our a/c a little tuning as well.  Definitely would recommend.

There seems to be a new trend in bowling centers these days and Pinz is effectively on the cutting edge of bowling fun.  Cushy chairs, lane side drink and food service, quality balls to choose from and super friendly staff who check in to make sure you are having fun.

There are 24 lanes available in the standard bowling area, then, situated in it's own room are about another 6 or 8 lanes for parties and laser enhanced bowling.  I didn't get a good look but it seemed like a place near where I live where it gets very psychedelic.  

This place is part of the Wahooz Family Fun Center so it's not just about bowling you can utilize the rest of the facility and really find something for everyone in the family.

Have tried every donut shop in the Valley and none were up to par with a shop we frequently visited in Alexandria, Ky.
Until today! Sweet Sensations had what I was looking for "glazed blueberry cake donuts"! Now if they could add "Carmel frosting" to their choices of custard filled donut's, my husband would be over the moon!
Staff was awesome! We were there around 10am, still plenty of variety! Highly recommend!
The kids working there are always super friendly! Everything always tastes great. Nice thick shakes and super yummy fries!

Newly opened location off Eagle near the 84. We decided to give them a shot, Bogo coupon in hand. Our order consisted of the Original, Philly, Super with green sauce, Super with red sauce, and an order of Greek fries.

The Supers were flavorful and packed with ingredients. We were pleasently surprised. The Philly and Original Gyros were okay but could not stand up to the flavor of the Supers. The fries at $6 are overpriced and did not deliver. 

It took a bit of time for preparation but it was worth the wait as everything is made to order. Our cashier greeted us and did a great job taking the order, asking all the right questions, and even apologised for the extended wait.

We will definitely be back to get our Gyro fix.

The've always had great service and took great care of my wifes car when she had a flat tire (no charge) last month even though it has the factory tires on it still. We purchase all of our tires at Les Schwab. I also used to come to Les Schwab with my Dad decades ago and never have had a bad experience at any location.

My car battery died... at least I'm pretty sure that's the case.  I looked on line to find a highly rated auto mechanic near me and came across Heritage, so I gave them a call.  Someone answered the phone, so right there I'm impressed.  After explaining the problem and that as my only car I didn't want to leave it there for an extended amount of time... afterall I could just keep jumping it every time I needed to go somewhere... so he gave me an appointment of 2pm that same day.  

This shop is busy!  With several double bays there were mechanics swarming the cars.  Every single bay had a car in it.  I felt fortunate that they even had a space for my car.  About half an out later they came out with the diagnosis.  They had tested my car twice and confirmed the battery was dying.  They had already ordered the part and it was on its way just in case I agreed to have it replaced right then and there.  Awesome!  The cost was reasonable and doable for someone on a strict budget like me and as a Yelper, I got a 20% off labor coupon for logging in as first time customer.  Win!

This was my first time but I will definitely be back. The service was excellent, Caleb and the kitchen staff, took really good care of us and even allowed for food customization without resistance or extra charges.  The food was really good and that comes from me and my friends...one friend personally thanked the cook before we left.
This place has a great set up for large private parties and though it was pouring down rain in the middle of winter last night, they gave us a tour so I could see the upstairs patio...and needless to say, I will definitely be back when the sun is shining!

Worst pedicures ever. They have a low grade from the health department. Prices are not listed anywhere. Paid $90 for me and my child to have pedis. No scrub or massage, cuticles were not trimmed. I had to ask for these things and still wasn't done. Got in the car to see that my kids nails were only half polished. I came back to have it fixed. Been here for 2.5 hrs. Very unsatisfied. The people doing nails here are not properly trained. Don't waste your time or money.

Beautiful furniture and beautiful decor.  That's all that's beautiful at RC Willey.  Walking in I was greeted by an employee and they seemed nice enough until I walked further into the organized shuffle of employees.  I would pass one employee thinking they would acknowledge my presence but to my avail not a single employee did so.  I love the store but it's employees seem a little self absorbed.  I know they aren't busy because they are sitting down on couches laughing it up as though they were at home.  I am all about customer service and their store seems to lack much of this.  In my eyes if a customer is not dressed to impress, than the employees don't feel the need to impress their customers.

Took both vehicles to get the tires rotated and as always the guys did a great job. The facility is clean, the front counter interaction is pleasant and they completed the tire rotation and no courtesy inspection quickly.

Great place to buy tires and have them serviced!

We just bought a bed yesterday from Daron and it was a great experience! Super friendly as soon as we walked in the door and really took our needs and back issues into consideration. As soon as we tried the bed he recommended, we melted into it and we were both sold!! He worked with us on the price and we are SO excited to get this bed into our house and finally have a peaceful night sleep!! Thank you again Daron for such great service!!

Came in to try the gym out on their "free trial" they give out online. Told by the lady at the front I would have to pay $10 to try the gym because a "Fitness Councilor" has to activate my free trial pass and one won't be there till 9am. I said I'm more then happy to talk to one on my way out cause I'll be here for a while. She simply would not let me try the gym and started to act all snobby with me. Well you guys lost my business. Having worked and been a fitness coach at a gym before I know how it all works, but if you want new memberships be accommodating.

Was super impressed with this place. Service was very fast and friendly. I was a bit intimidated with how the whole menu worked, since it being my first time. But the girl servicing me made all those worries melt away fast. For it being so busy that night, I was surprised and happy how fast they were to get my order out. Excellent tasting burgers and shakes. The fries were just ok though. Also if you are someone like me who loves whip topping I would suggest getting your shake somewhere else because they charge you for it here. It is a little more pricey for what I wanna be paying for that kind of meal. But I mean what place isn't a bit pricey these days?

Called this store and was quoted a price over the phone of $190, got to the store and was quoted a different, higher price of $210, decided to proceed since I was already there and the increase was only $20 more, had them write up the work order and gave them my keys, later was told it would be an even higher price, actually DOUBLE the price to over $400. when I attempted to explain that the scope of the work as explained over the phone was the same as explained in person and it was a misunderstanding with the counter person writing the work order I was repeatedly given the impression it wasn't their problem and the actual price would be double what I was originally quoted. I then explained that I wasn't going to force them to do a job for less than what they felt it was going to cost to do, so I told him I would not be proceeding with the work but that he should speak to his coworker and have a little better communication so you don't disappoint future customers and he constantly kept repeatedly deflecting blame away from himself and the store and insinuating that the scope of the work changed, The scope of the work never changed and when I suggested he speak to his coworker for proof I kept getting excuses from him without any action towards getting to the bottom of the situation. Lastly he suggested he would "meet me halfway" and do the job for a slight discount to $300, and then I explained to him that point S tire, down the street had already quoted for the exact same job $200 so of course I went over there and had everything done for $200. Now I don't expect les Schwab tire to do a job for less than what they think it should cost, but man oh man they need to train their employees better and get better communication at that store. I'm not impressed with the way it was handled and I would not have proceeded with the work if they were willing to do it for free at this point. Regardless of the scope of work and the price, I still would have considered going back to this location to purchase tires in the future if I had gotten an apology and not felt like I was accused of saying or doing something wrong. They need to train the staff to qualify the scope of the work and ask the right questions to be professional and straight forward both over the phone and while producing the work order.

Heard that this place has killer Monte cristos. Went to get one and the kitchen closed at 3, well 230 that day. Really bummed that they don't serve later. I have not been back since. Pretty crappy to run a place and have it only open for such a short time for the food.
Great selection of donuts and even have a delicious sausage roll for some protein.  Very clean and nicely decorated.  Coffee is good too!

My husband and I came here for happy hour. The place was empty except for one other couple. I was hoping for great deals and fresh sushi. The happy hour deals were a buck or two off the menu price. Ok but not great. We ordered two sushi rolls, one Spicy tuna and one Lucky roll (not on HH menu). The Spicy tuna roll was not great, even smelled fishy. I don't believe we finished it. The Lucky roll was better quality. Liked that one much better. 

Service was good, environment was good. Food could be better.

I chose Stanley Steemer because of price. I should have remembered that you get what you pay for. The employee showed up and immediately had to call someone to figure out how to work the truck. This guy was really shy and I dont think he spoke English very well. I had everything moved out of the rooms except for the couch and loveseat. When he finally got started, he was going to just go around the furniture! I had to stop him and actually move the things myself. He went really fast and in my opinion didnt do a very good job at cleaning anything. Overall I was really disappointed and have since found a different company for my carpet cleaning needs.

Great market. It's divided into two parts: organic/natural on the right & traditional/regular on the left.
The butcher kindly gave me whole fresh chickens rather than frozen Perdue ones for the same price which was really nice of him.
There is a very decent selection of cheeses from around the world.
The store is immaculate, organized & the staff is very happy to offer direction/help.
I prefer the natural side- excellent selection of just about anything you could want/need.
They also offer premade food to go as well.

Dr. John is amazing! He is so thorough and good at what he does. He's a great nurse practitioner and answers all of your questions until you feel comfortable! Plus it's super convenient that his practice is in the same building as my dentist! He has an amazing esthetics program that absolutely everyone should check out for themselves!

Our go to park for picnic on the grass, flying a kite, riding scooters and bikes. This park is fairly new so the paths are  smooth paths for little kiddos and easy access by cars. Adjacent to it is a wonderful and always super busy playground that we avoid during pandemic time. But rest of the park allow for comfortably social distancing while still enjoying all amenities of the park. Many fountains and space. Wonderful.

Very horrible experience. We purchased a mattress- Serta Beauty Rest and bed from RC WILLEY. The mattress failed and started to loose its shape. We filed a claim for warranty and it was denied because they stated the bed didn't provide adequate support for the mattress. So their salesman's lack of knowledge and training selling us something that shouldnt go together has led us to loose thousands of dollars. Do yourself a favor and go to a different furniture store that cares about their customers and don't consider you just a number.

Shame on you RC Willey. Lost a long time customer.

We go here for the sushi but appreciate the variety in the menu for kids.  Happy hour on the patio in the downtown location is spectacular, the drinks are strong and the people watching is prime. We arrived around 4:00 on a Friday and had our choice of seating and very attentive service.

Corey and Kristi were absolutely amazing! They gave me a killer rate, made the loan process so simple and painless, and informed me of everything along the way. I'm thankful my realtor referred them to me because it was such a great experience for buying my first home. Thank you!

Let's be honest no one is excited about taking a car to the shop, you know you are going to spend more money than expected and the industry reputation is poor. Heritage automotive provides high quality work at a fair price with great customer service and outstanding after service care. They have sent a after service survey, called to check in and mailed a hand written thank you card.  I will be using heritage automotive for future repairs and major maintenance.
I bought at CHF Furniture on Orchard. Colleen is my fabulous sales associate: helpful, kind, patient, intuitive, knowledgeable...everything RC Willey's is not.

My sister-in-law bought some furniture at RC Willey and I was there helping with her move in when John & Derek arrived with her delivery. They were is good spirits despite the late afternoon delivery and carefully maneuvered her furniture that included a large sofa bed & dining room table & chairs.  They assembled the dining room furniture amazing fast but carefully. Their knowledge of moving a large sofa bed through doorways & a narrow hallway was amazing. They helped move a very heavy dresser with a flat screen TV on it as an extra favor. We couldn't have received a better, more polite, more professional team if we'd selected them in advance.
Not only is RC Willey a fantastic 'one-stop' shopping for everything one needs in a home, but they appear to carefully select their delivery teams for efficiency & professionalism. 
P.S. the strength that these two demonstrated was also impressive. Not sure another team could have maneuvered the heavy sofa bed as these guys did.
Thank you Brittany for the phenomenal service. What a perfect way to spend one of my final days in Boise--out on the patio soaking up the beautiful weather!

Fun store to go into. They have the bar appetizers all kinds of deli yummy's, lots of bakery yummy's. You could get a meal to go without too much effort.  Beautiful floral department very clean and so far no lines.

I've been to a lot of gyms, but this one is huge and really well-equipped.  I can't speak to their lessons, but the open-gym time is pretty sweet!  They don't charge a lot, and they give you access to most of their gym and equipment.  The only downside is that certain things like the foam pit and the trampolines can get pretty crowded, but there are plenty of other things to use besides those.

Spasibo Danik za vash otlichni bizness!

If I could give this company a zero I would. Very jnprofessional, rude, won't respond to maintenance requests but will serve you a 3 day notice if you have a dandelion in your yard. I managed to make it 4 years renting the same home from these guys and dealt with them because I liked the home and location. I kept the home in pristine condition while I was there and even made improvements to the yard since it was left in horrible condition from the previous tenant. They are very greedy and out for making money by serving erroneous 3 day notices for minute things that could just be brought to someone's attention so they can get that extra 35 bucks in their pocket. I would never recommend renting with this company or using their services to rent your home.

Cyclebar is the best! They have amazing/friendly/kind people who work here as well. They have a lot of times to choose from for when you want to ride! You get your own lockers, they provide cool towels after your ride, it just feels like a luxury workout! The workout itself it challenging but fun while still being uplifting. I would recommend this anyone looking for a good work out experience! It's so nice to do something else besides the gym a few times in my week!

I had a dead battery and the Ford dealer said I would need to wait a week for an appointment. 800 miles from home and the Ford dealer could not give me any help. Not so with Les Schwab. I got my car jumped by a tow company and made it to Les Schwab just a few minutes before closing, They changed out the battery even though they had to stay a few minutes over closing time. They were friendly and I felt well cared for and that my business was appreciated. The Meridian Ford dealer should be ashamed of themselves. Whatever happened to helping someone out? Congratulations to Les Schwab, a true neighbor when I was in need. Les Schwab had a get it done with a smile attitude that really saved the day for me.

Well, just my luck- I moved to Star, ID right before the coronavirus shut everything down. So, when the barbershops were allowed to open, I called Justin At Fred's Reel barbershop to make an appt. I showed up on time, spoke to Justin briefly about what I wanted and he gave me the best haircut I have had in years- hands down.  This is my new go to barber!
Iiiiii iiii iiiiNot open in meridian, Id. Don't come a knocking no one there. Is it long enough now

Horrible!!!!!!! I waited 45 minutes in the drive thru last night! It literally took 10minutes a car! I finally get my order and go home. My daughters cheese quesadilla has jalapeño sauce which I asked for them not to put on,so she could not eat it cause it was to spicy for her!! I also asked for a soft taco instead of a crunchy taco and got a crunchy taco! Disgusting! I also got a a crunch wrap supreme I get home it has no sour cream and very little meat! Fast forward to the next morning I am on the toilet with Taco Bell coming out both ends! And I try to wait it out around noon I am weak and can barely stand! I go into the Dr. and he tells me I have food poisoning! And am severely dehydrated. I had to miss work and am hoping I'm better so I can go tomorrow! The moral of the story don't go here unless you want to get very sick! And wait 45 minutes for the wrong food!! If I could put No Stars I would!!
They are the worst, I supposedly have a package to be picked up but they can't find it, it's only been a WEEK and I keep hearing excuses from the people working there.

Positive: We knew what we wanted but needed some assistance on the details.  Our sales rep answered all of our questions and gave us a recommendation.  We were in and out with our new TV in a short time frame.  

Downside: The check out process too the longest and we paid by CC.
Amazing staff and great energy! Worth the financial investment in yourself!  I highly recommend cyclebar to anyone, regardless of your fitness level

today mid afternoon to get information regarding a brake job hopefully somewhere could be done .. The man behind the counter as he was eating his sunflower seeds look down at me under his glasses and said im 3 weeks out I can't do a brake job!
             And this is a 4 star shop!!
    *Wow really 3weeks*  
        Sorry for being in town!!
              Rude,"
Helpful cake counter. Great samples everywhere. Clean, well-lit, and lots of friendly help.

We went to Sweet Sensations and purchased some delicious looking donut creations, and we enjoyed them immensely .
Thank you so much Meira and staff for your smiles, kindness and service!! WE HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!

One of my favorite hometown cafes.  So many soups to choose from and all very good.  Soups are on rotation so theres always new things to try.  Lots of gluten free soups to pick from, all are labeled.  The grilled cheese sandwiches are to die for (and they have a gluten free version now!).  You can even come in and take frozen soups to go to cook at home later.  Owners are very friendly and welcoming.

What the hell did you do with your gas pumps?   You use to be a convenience store.  Now every time I swipe a card at any of the pumps I have to walk inside?  No thanks.  I'll hit the Sinclair only a mile away from now on.

I would give more stars but they have the worst communication in general. The employees working there that answer there phone as well in customer service do not know respect. If they don't want to talk to you they transfer your calls to people who are NOT in the building so your forced to leave a voicemail and not get a call back for a week later or hang up and call again only to go through the same process of not being treated well. I paid good money for my furniture that was backordered when I purchased first week of January... then when it was delivered it was not even the correct console but too coffee tables. Then backorder again for a month?? Now we're in the middle of February only to be told that we have to wait a week for delivery, so we go to pick it up cause we didn't want to wait longer and they tell us they gave it to someone else and ours is now in salt lake.... uh what the... they then tell me that they will call when it's in again.. four days go by no call so I call them and it's been there 2days but I'm playing ring around the Rosie with customer service again... I would give 1star but I liked the guy we worked with for the order originally even though he inputted it all wrong. Super frustrating RC Willey and to be treated like we have been. Three months for our furniture and STILL nothing. Why would I go back to pay good money... over 2grand to be treated like this...

Mahi Mahi tacos are fantastic! $12 for large portions, grilled fish, chips and salsa, house slaw- DIVINE! By the way- beer selection? 20 beers on tap. Wine. Liquor. Shady patio. Great sports feel, but had a book study group meet here as well. Drop the kids at Roaring Springs and head across the street!

Honestly at this moment if I could give RC Willey a 0 stars I would as I am so upset with them. I have bought multiple large purchases at RC Willey over the last year and unfortunately several weeks ago my what I feel is brand new (April 2020) range quit working in which time I contacted RC Willey where I was told since it was an LG product that the customer service representative would have to put in a ticket to them for a repair well needless to say after several oops no ticket made calls and a visit to the store nothing was ever done to fix the issue. On my last visit to the store (8/22/2020) I was told that LG hadn't contacted me because they were backed up due to COVID so even though I was told I could NOT contact LG myself as it needed to be handled by RC Willey I called them this morning and spoke to a very helpful representative who advised me that for one that they would have someone out to my house this week, two that they NEVER received any ticket from RC Willey and for three which is the most infuriating especially being in healthcare that they WERE NOT booked up due to COVID. So needless to say the representative at the Meridian customer service window decided since COVID is a easy excuse she'd just say it was due to COVID not caring that there are people working long hours (including me), people dying, and a nation struggling which is infuriating to me.
You lost not only my business but my respect RC Willey shame on you!

Solid as it gets for sushi, dinner for 2, etc. Everything has been super fresh, waitresses have been extremely nice and courteous. I honestly haven't had a bad experience once in 5 or 6 visits - and it's become one of my favorite spots. Nice restaurant, as well!

It's wonderful that is no longer smoking, the bathroom is the dirtiest, smelliest thing that I have come across in a long time(and I am a truck driver), my companion said the same about the women's restroom.

OMG!

 I have a $25 gift certificate to this place, but after reading the reviews and looking at the storefront in person, I'm not sure I even want to use it.

Im always satisfied! Every order is correct and they have very excellent Customer Service. I've worked at a fast food restaurant and sometimes it is very hard to be nice to dumb/rude customers so props to them for always having a welcoming attitude and great manners! Food is delicious.

The best cookies around. Stick with the chocolate chip and follow it down with some ice cold milk. 1 cookie is almost too much, may have to share it or save it for later. We moved from Utah where Crumbl originated from and we were so excited when we heard one was opening in Meridian. Recommend everyone to come try a cookie, you won't find a better one anywhere!
Tried this place today for a to go order.  We had the fish tacos and sweet potato fries and tots.  They were all good.  They also have great ranch.  We will definitely try them again.
Thank you so much man! Really saved the day! Was in a crunch and Now my headlights are perfect and everything I've dreamed of. Super hard worker! Appreciate you so so much

Fu#$ me dead this place was a disaster! Protect me oh lord for my life is in the hands of ambiguously clean teenagers. This was just a pickup order but wow people! Uniforms! Of the 5 employees in the back who I saw I think two were in uniforms. For all I know, they picked up a couple kids from the local middle school to do a little cooking. 

The pizza is not horrible, I will give them that. But the rest of the operation is an unmitigated disaster. Yall got lucky tonight. But I still feel the need to pray for a calm stomach and no severe gastric distress tonight. 

This review was taken down previously. But this needs to be said. This Pizza Hut is in deplorable condition and the management staff should be ashamed of what they are doing. I WILL NOT BE SILENCED!! I'll keep coming back again and again and again.

I recently had to move states, before doing so I came into axiom with my outrageous $150 cancellation fee so that I can get out of my extremely overpriced membership. Paid my fees and left. 5 months later I get a letter in the mail from their collections agency with a $500 bill inside. When I called in I was told there was no manager I could talk to so the front desk was as far as I got. Almost 2 days go by until I finally get an email back from the assistant manager saying the cancellation was never filed and she gave me the agencies number. Possibly a 2 sentence reply is all that I got. This place sucks! If you ever decide to get a membership keep clear documentation of everything on the account, I didn't and it may end up costing $650 by the time it's all over....

Excellent food and a neighborhood gem.  Breakfast here is fantastic and the service from the staff has always been excellent. Steve is an asset to the community and has always stepped up with supporting it.

I cannot stand this store! The sales associates act like they're so bored with their job and when you ask questions about their products, they answer, "I don't know..." and that's all they've got. Once they see you pull an item off the shelf, the follow you to check out so they can snag commission off ya so they can "claim" they helped you on the floor. True story. Such cheap quality crap for such expensive prices! I've got a HUGE problem with their financing department too. To summarize, I had a joint account with an ex with a limit of $800 that we closed together. They allowed my ex to re-open that account on his own and charge $1200 on it and billed it to me! That was 8 years ago. I will NEVER shop there again.

Oh. My. Goodness. If you live in the treasure valley area and you have not tried these empanadas... what are you doing with your life? Freshly made, lots of flavor choices, and a very unique thing to have for lunch or dinner. When you bite into the empanada, you get a crispy buttery flaky pie like crust with a savory filling with depth of flavor. They have a variety of both savory and sweet filling options. Since they are made after you order, there can be a little bit of a wait but trust me, it is worth it! We tried a variety of flavors and my favorite was the cream cheese cherry dessert empanada. Our favorite savory was the gaucho which is the original from Argentina. I know of at least one location that has a drive-through but this location does not.

I have eaten here dozens of times and I always justify bad service because they have done something to fix it, like given us free slices, however today sealed the deal for me. I ordered breadsticks only to find out when I arrived on time like my online order profile said they hadn't even started my order, like everytime before. And then instead of getting my order ready he cleared out the entire lobby and 3 people that walked in before even making my order. Then I realize the guy is new, so while some pastel haired girl with a hole is the ass of her pants and what I assume is a manager with the dark short hair and the tiny slice box t-shirt on stand in the back and talk and do nothing they left the new guy to fend for himself! It took and hour to get breadsticks! I WILL NOT BE BACK! THIS IS WHY LOCAL BUSINESSES FAIL. FLYING PIE WILL GET MY BUSINESS FROM HERE ON OUT!

I really like Sierra Trading Post's Catalog. If you like it too, you will be sorely disappointed by this place like I was. My first visit about 3 years ago was great. I left with quite the haul. Apparently they never restocked after that as I haven't been tempted to make a purchase since that day. The women's selection is beyond pitiful. As a man, your selection is larger, but it's a good thing you will be in the great outdoors as you won't want to wear anything they are selling in public. That leaves the rest of their selection which is grossly overpriced. Except maybe the socks. (+1 star for socks) Good luck to you if you do find something and have to endure the epically inefficient checkout line.  Pass.

They have something for everyone. If you're looking for that specialty item The new market street may carry it / or you could request that they order it for you. I've been an Albertsons shopper for years and this concept is working well , ohhh the Bar is plus as well
Spent my Friday night here with my 4 year old. Super clean and friendly atmosphere. Constantly saw the drums being cleaned and the floor swept. Card is $1 when first purchased with a $10 minimum

We dropped off our dog at 10:00 am. We gave specific instruction to Sara, that we did not want our Golden Doodle cut like a poodle. We asked for his head and face to be trimmed but not cut short. We did ask for his body to be trimmed shorter due to the warmer months ahead. We were told we would get a phone call within a few hours, but at 3pm still had not heard from them. I arrived at 3:30 to pick up my dog and when I walked in to the shop I told them I was in to pick up my dog. To my surprise he was still on the table but he was unrecognizable. I honestly did not recognize my dog. My heart sank. I made a comment to Sara, and she told me she had to cut him short due to matts. I brush my dog regularly and felt like I was being shamed. We had our dog groomed at BARKWASH 6 weeks prior and I brush my dog several times a week. He did have matts around his beard and goatee from food and water and he had some matts around his feet as he spent all weekend playing in the water. He did not have severe matts and did not need to be shaved down like a poodle. If Sara felt she could not properly groom our dog as we requested she should have called us and gave us the option. Sara unfortunately took it upon herself to give our dog a standard poodle cut. Poor customer service, we were excited to give this place a try. We were referred to Sabrina but she was booked out so Sabrina offered to have Sara do it. I regret trying this place out. Should have stuck with BARKWASH!!

I know, I know... the politics are debateable, however the lemonade and the ice cream are top notch. I personally enjoy most of my Chick-fil-A visits, even if they are not all that often. This location especially, is always a pleasure. The staff is uber friendly, almost creepily so. They always have a pleasure in helping you - or so they say ;) 

I like the ease of the location and that the drive-thru is usually pretty quick. It's right down the street from Settler's Park, so makes a good place to stop for a bite to take to the park - especially on movie night :)

I'm counting my lucky fins that I live so close to this place!

The quality of the seafood is excellent (can confirm, I have relatives that supply the seafood and they say this place gets the 'good stuff') and decent prices to boot! It's clean and just fancy enough to impress the in-laws on a surprise visit or perhaps an impromptu date night, but chill enough that you don't feel you need to take out a loan to have a good time.

This seems to be a great spot for people who are doing the post-church Sunday brunch/lunch as that is normally when we visit and often we see long tables of entire families enjoying sushi and fish dishes of all kinds.

I highly recommend the Honey Chipotle Salmon. OMG. So flavors. Much crispy exterior. Wow! Even my husband who has always been wary about trying seafood of all kinds was eager to munch up my HCS. Get your own, honey.

Also, California rolls made with REAL crab. None of this imitation stuff. 

Wait staff is extremely helpful and accommodating to food allergies. Check this place out.

From the moment you walk in, you are greeted with a smile and feel so welcome to be there! If you don't have a reservation, you are never turned away! We never make a reservation, and we always enjoy a cocktail at the bar before dinner. The staff at the bar are so attentive and friendly. There are usually 3-5 friendly and very capable bar staff ready to take your order. I love the jalapeño margarita. Very refreshing. The food is excellent. Always consistent. Staff so friendly and consistently excellent service. I love the fish tacos. My husband and I have been to Lucky Fins several times. We are never disappointed. It's a very friendly upbeat place. Very friendly for families with small children too, because the atmosphere is loud. A baby crying would be welcome and no big deal, would be a welcome addition so if you are concerned with small children, no worries at all here. There are a variety of people who go: couples on a date night, families with small children, older - younger people, it is a popular place for all. The restrooms are modern and spotless. Another thing we notice is that the staff are always so friendly and genuinely seem so happy and enjoy their work. We notice such great teamwork all the time. The bar staff always helping each other and last night, the waiter staff helped the bar staff with closing duties, bringing heavy ice buckets out to them. Noticed the bar staff thanking him and he patted her on the back saying no problem. Such nice attentive and friendly staff and of course, always excellent food. Highly recommend.

Love this place! We don't do our usual grocery shopping here as it's more expensive for that but to get special items it's great! It's also a nice place to just go and chill. The food is pretty good but they can off days for sure! We enjoy taking visiting friends or family here since it is pretty cool. We love the bakery/dessert area!

They didn't give my daughter a foot massage. Then when she asked them about it the girl said she did give her a foot massage. And just left her there. And my daughter said no really I didn't get one. And the lady yelled at her in another language. And I said all you need to do is give her a foot massage. And they said no. So we left. Went to pay AND SHE ASKED IF I WANTED TO leave  A TIP!!

I won a gift card of $25 and my husband and I stopped by to use it. It didn't even cover 2 meals. Very over priced and the soups and sandwichs were not up to par. They ran out of pork and failed to mention it when we ordered. So after we already paid and starting eating we noticed our sandwhiches were missing meat. They said oh sorry we ran out..like thanks you could have said something prior or added more meat of another kind instead of giving us a crappy sandwich. I won't be back.
My go to place for year! Love the staff and they always do a great job on my nails! Just got these done this past week! Great prices too definitely makes me excited to always come back!

Excellent donut place! I got there at 10 on Saturday and there was lots to choose from. The kolaches are DELICIOUS, especially if you have them warmed. There was one like a long croissant filled with cherry and dusted with powered sugar that was amazing. Honestly, they were all good but those are my faves. I should have taken a picture of the box I got, but my kids got a hold of them and they were gone in 5 minutes. 
The place was clean and the staff friendly. All in all, nice joint. Just wish I lived closer.

I am very happy I decided on Budget Blinds for window coverings in my new home. They have a wide variety of options including shutters and roller shades. Cheryl Waterbury was very helpful, accommodating, professional, knowledgable, and friendly. My window coverings came out beautiful and the quality is unbeatable.

My wife and I met here for some dinner Tuesday night after an evening of driving for Uber. She had a coupon for some money off, and it had decent reviews. It was a packed house when I showed up(my wife beat me there) which was good because we would have waited for a while otherwise! I sat down and was greeted pretty quickly and was able to order a beer. Their selection is pretty good but there are other places with better selections. Anyway my wife ordered nachos and I had a turkey club with a salad. Service was a little slow but given how busy it was I fully expected to wait a bit. The waitress was very nice and helpful too which helps. Anyway back to the food! The sandwich I ate was really freaking good! It wasn't your normal thin sliced deli turkey it was thick slices with really good bacon and roasted chili peppers on sour dough! It was awesome! The salad was your usual suspects... romaine, tomato, onion, olives and croutons. Solid meal though. The nachos were also very good! Cheese was melted nicely, lots of toppings and the salsa was on point. My wife and I both give this place two thumbs up!

Eagerly anticipated opening - marvelous products not available in the area like gorgeous purple treviso, a big variety of radishes, braseola - and other high-end items we probably didn't notice.  Gone, gone, gone!  It was a big splash but unless you want prepared foods, not too much special now they're past the grand opening.  If they don't leave these items long enough for people to learn about them or make suggestions about how to use them - a loss for area foodies.

When looking for a wedding photographer, the piece that really sold us on Maija was her amazing use of lighting. She is extremely talented and has such a creative eye. We made a good choice in hiring her and sure enough, our photos turned out amazing. She was able to quickly look around the venue/grounds and identify locations that would make for great photo backgrounds. 

I appreciated how quickly she responded to any questions that we sent her way and we loved working with her in person. She is calm, talented, and just a genuinely good person! Definitely recommended.

Seafood~! Pescetarian favorite lunch option.. Though My second time here I was still attracted to the interior at the moment when I walked in..the bar with brick wall..a very presentable, dark rich chocolate  theme. The service was friendly and super fast. I caught bacon in my dish the waitress fixed for me in no time.

My husband and I worked with Gabe and were very happy with the help and service we received. We were first time home buyers and felt that he did a great job communicating with us, addressing our concerns, and getting us the help and great rates we needed. I would recommend this mortgage company to anyone!
Nice store, easy self checkout.

HUGE shout out to Lucky Fins tonight. We ordered from grub hub and ended up having to pick it up ourselves. Long story short, grub hub never sent the order to Lucky Fins. So I walked in ready to pick up and leave, and they had no idea I had ordered food. Kenny the manager helped me on the phone to have my account refunded for the grub hub order, and then put my order in on a rush and had it out quickly. Kenny and Robin were so helpful and definitely made the experience better. And good food to boot! Thank you! We will be back!

Love everything about TJs! And just like other reviewers, I noticed the parking to be wayyy better than the Boise location. I've been to the Boise location since this one opened, and while it's not as busy, the parking lot is still a mess (especially with the MOD Pizza place that opened in the same lot). So, this location is more ideal!

Kudos to, Michael(sacking groceries)today! When we were checking our groceries he noticed we could get an extra pound of Strawberries for the same price and exchanged them for us and saved us some money! Wow...what great service. This guy is a real treasure to his Employer for sure. We will come back. Great customer service even at this big, big store. Love the samples and the variety. Carmel Corn...yummy!
Best place in town Great food, great prices, great atmosphere,....bonus: great musac!

Oh my!! So delicious!! 
I have had several people recommend this place. The Tomato Soup and Grilled Cheese Sandwich definitely exceeded my expectations. I will definitely be back at least every other week!

Everyone talks about this place and I finally went last year for the first time and I'm not impressed. There is very limited options and most of the food is generic brand. Plus it's so small and always packed.

I've only been to the Las Vegas location and I was a bit surprised to see one here locally at a gas station. The actual location inside the gas station is clean, but there are limited seating arrangements. The places available are nice though. Earl of sandwich offers a loyalty card so take advantage of that if you're into value. The sandwiches I've ordered have all been good, but a little small. I feel this location could have stood on its own just dine, but being where it's at isn't so bad.i just have a hard time choosing to go to a gas station for lunch.

My lawn always looks beautiful with TruGreen and if it doesn't it just takes a quick phone call and they come right out and find out what is wrong and get it fix. My neighbors comment on our lawn and always ask what we do to keep it so thick and green with no weeds all summer long.
Great food but the service is terrible they are so slow and we felt a bit ignored.

Tried lucky fins again. Ordered the clam chowder which was very good, plenty of clams. Also sushi was good.  Service was very good. But the greeter at the door was a total snot.  Like don't bother me. Very unfriendly.

Moved to Nampa from out of state 2 years ago and have yet to find a nail salon that checked all the boxes -until today. I called on a Friday morning and got an appointment for my pedicure in the early afternoon. I arrived right on time, picked my color and sat down in the first spa chair (there were 4 or 5, I think). The chair was clean and in working order, foot soak right temp, and Bill did a great job - gentle, thorough, and took care not to cause pain on my 7-months foot surgery scar area. No big frills, but massage chair, foot and leg massage, hot towel, and my toes look and feel great!  People were professional and friendly. Worth the 25-minutes from south Nampa! I'll be back. Review relates to pedicure and general look/feel of the place.

Very good and service was good! Wish they had more locations though! It's simple and easy to order, fresh and tasty. I love their variety of hot sauces as well because I love spicy! My husband and I both ate our food so fast. So yummy. Definitely will stop by for some lunch if I'm in town.

Dee Vinci is fantastic.  She is a great asset to RC in that she goes over and beyond for her customers.  We will be coming back to see her next time we buy    

RC Willey is the best when it comes to delivery.  In most cases just a few days and a one time delivery charge applies for a whole year.  

I also like that there is a large inventory of furniture to chose from so you never feel like you have to settle.  I could spend hours looking around and envisioning home decor.
This place is amazing. Misty was super helpful. Showed me the ropes. This place is so clean. Best laundromat I've ever been to.

We had our AC go out on an 85 degree Friday, and over that weekend realized our heater was out too when it was in the 50's.  Called our usual HVAC people who said the 1st appointment was 5 days out.  I set the appt hoping someone else would cancel but had to wait...day of the appt they didn't show and said nothing was in the calendar, lady had it on a sticky note and forgot to enter it.  

APOLLO FROM ADVANCED CAME THAT DAY AND FIXED IT (just a busted fuse) IN LESS THAN 5 MINUTES!!! We are loyal customers from here til forever and are so grateful for their exceptional service!
This place is the best grocery store in the valley. Even the restaurants are good in there. Worth the drive!

I'm not the kind of person to go out of my way to write a review on a low expectation fast food place, but this specific location is a joke. I've gone here several times and the location had to close early due to being understaffed, the wait in the drive thru is beyond ridiculous, and the food is crap. I know I shouldn't have high expectations going here but after today's experience, they lost my business. I had two cars ahead of me in the drive thru. I ordered a beefy 5 layer burrito and a cheesy Gordita crunch. After waiting over 15 min (that's when I started to look at the clock), I was given a potato griller and a bean burrito with cheese. Of course I didn't realize till I got home. But clearly this isn't what I paid for. I was informed that they ran out of mild sauce...after I paid, ok ..that's whatever. After seeing all the advertised employees needed signs posted all around the building, I totally understand why now. I tried giving this business a call before I wrote this review but of course no one answered. Don't have high expectations with this place. If i could give zero stars I would.

My husband wanted to celebrate his Birthday at Fanci Freez. He's always heard it was so good!  He ordered a Mushroom burger & Chocolate Malt. The Chocolate Malt was pretty good but the burger took forever. They forgot about that part of his order, they confessed. When he got the burger, it was slathered with mayo on both sides. It was beyond gross. He said it was inedible. Poor Guy, so disappointed. We won't be back

I love how happy the girls here are. It feels like they actually enjoy their jobs. I can typically get in and out of here in pretty quick time - which I love. I've also used a few of the other local PBTs and even used my membership in So. Cal. Really enjoy how clean everything is as well. 

I have suspended my account 2x over the last year and a half and have never had any issues.

This store has epically failed on my couch order. I originally explained to the sales woman that I have a unique entry way to my apartment. I took photos and measurements. Two of their sales people convinced it me to go ahead and order the one I wanted because they were "sure" it would fit. The couch did not fit and the delivery men actually said "don't listen to the sales people, they're just trying to sell you a couch." Then I went back and chose a sectional so it could fit in the apartment in separate pieces. I scheduled a delivery date and moved my furniture and scheduled a pick up for my old couch. The day of the delivery, they called and said they had ordered one of the pieces incorrectly. So I cancelled the pick up of my old couch. I waited 6 to 8 weeks again for them to get the correct pieces. I scheduled a new delivery when they said it was ready, I scheduled my old couch to be picked up. The day of delivery, they called and said they think they have the wrong pieces and checked and said they had the correct pieces. They never showed up or called me back to say they actually DIDN'T have the right pieces. They had ordered it incorrectly AGAIN. I then had to wait another 6 to 8 weeks for them to order the correct piece. At this time the original sales woman had left the company so I was speaking with someone totally different. Then i received a message saying my couch was ready. I called and spoke to customer service to schedule the delivery and made it clear that I was expecting to end pieces and a middle piece. She said it was all set. So I moved all my furniture and took the day off work again to be there. THEY ONLY BROUGHT THE MIDDLE PIECE. And I had to schedule another delivery day for the other two pieces that were sitting in their wear house. I just don't understand how a company can mess up an order this bad. I wish I could give zero stars.
cold beer shopping and getting the beer shopping buzz love it best store in town. bar tenders are not fast enough when in a position where beer is needed in hand

Came to Lucky Fins based off Yelp reviews. Don't need to return. I had the fish and chips and they were ok. Nothing special. Husband had fish taco for 12.99 and they may have had an ounce of fish between the 3 tacos he paid for. Sunday is Happy hour all day. Well drinks $4. Not if you get a name brand vodka like Tito's or Huckleberry 44. $12. No need to come back. Food was ok. Service was ok. There are better restaurants in the valley.

I had my first visit with Dr. McRae today. This was my first experience with injections and I was nervous upon arrival. During my appointment I received 24 units ofJeuveau (Newtox) From the moment I walked in I was instantly put at ease. The office is beautiful and I was greeted by friendly staff. Dr. McRae is knowledgeable, thorough and his attention to detail and genuine care for his patients is obvious. I was told to expect results within a few days, but noticed improvement the moment in got in car. I absolutely recommended this office and am so thankful I decided to schedule with them.
Use to be good but not anymore. My burger was raw, the service was slow, the mahi tacos looked like someone the slaw and spit on the taco. Do not go there

I went to Nails plus yesterday ( 11/25/18) and Gi Gi did my pedicure. She did an excellent job! I had been going to a number of different nail  places for the past 3 months only  to find that they were shaping my toenails wrong causing me to get ingrown toenails. Fast forward to toeday ( haha) Gee Gee got the ingrown toenail out and I am feeling so much relief. I cannot express how much relief she gave me! She was a very hard and determined nail technician and was bound to get those two ingrown toenails out! Thank you GIGI!!!!!!!!!!! You are the best! I Will be back!  Only reason I gave 4 or of 5 is that the lady who is in charge in the front was a little abrupt and cranky. Like she was getting burnt out from doing nails and providing customer service. Just my observation! GiGi, you are the best! It took me a long to find you and a lot of $$$ but I finally found someone who understands ingrown toenails!!!!  lol

I can't believe I haven't provided a review for Kleiner Park yet!?!?  We absolutely hands down love this place!!!  The playground area is perfect to kids 2 to 12 as most places are.  However, a couple weeks ago, we showed up to play on the playground but were blown away with the Splash Pad being turned on.  What?!?!  There was water and kids everywhere!  Our son LOVED the water flowing everywhere.  There was water shooting here, water shooting there and umbrellas of water to stand under.  Boy he had a ball!

Summertime at Kleiner Park is amazing!  Have a ball if you dare.

Surprised by this food option in Albertsons. The food choices are a little hit and miss, but sometimes they knock it out of the park. The atmosphere is a little different at first, but grows on you. Highlights have been the poke bowls, barbecue, and Ivars soup bar (hidden in the back). Great value!

Was shopping around for a new refrigerator and it was 1 of 5 places we stopped in to. We already knew the model that we wanted so its not like we were needing to be educated on 50 bazillion models. 
Ever since RC Wileys came to Meridian we've stopped in maybe a half dozen times, though we never bought anything there, maybe due they never have anything we like, but its probably due to how they sell stuff....in your face, not in a rude way but annoying way. You just can't browse without 20 salespersons coming up and asking if they can help you.
On the refrigerator,  we ended up buying from Best Buy. Better pricing and knowledge staff.
The best cookies! We love the cookies and the staff, they are always nice and very fast. If you're looking for a good treat this place is perfect!
Fast, efficient, delicious and clean. No free refills during COVID... poor choice. Don't keep taking things away from your customers.

Buffalo chicken soup and the chicken salad are my favorites! If you are on a low carb diet, then will put the chicken salad on a bed of lettuce for you instead! Always my go-to for lunch or a quick dinner. They are really fast too.

Great food. Great service. Nuff said. 

Featuring the Idaho Mule, Mango Tango and Lobster Stuffed Avocado.

I can not say enough nice things about Darin And Casey. I went in to buy a matress and I knew what I wanted. They listened to what I said and only showed me what I had asked for. They did not pressure me into buying a box spring. When I said mine was still good they let it go. I felt no pressure to buy and I felt that they could read into what kind of shopper I am. During delivery there was a small hiccup, but it mattered to me. They handled the issue with Grace. Greg the warehouse manager even reached out to ensure my satisfaction. I believe that you can really see how great a business is from their missteps and recovery. They handled everything with poise and grace. I will be back for every bed I need in the future and I am very comfortable recommending them. Thank you for the great service and perfect matress.

We got four cookies this time, the pumpkin roll, the cinnamon roll, the sugar and the chocolate chip.  They were all wonderful, except for the chocolate chip. The cookie I got last time had at least a dozen chips in it and was baked just right. Today, I got a raw-centered cookie (and I'm not a fan of raw cookie dough) with 5-6 chips in it.  Is their quality diminishing? I would have been better off getting a cookie from Costa Vida next door for half the price.

Letting the owner's web page speak for his delightful coffee house: "...unpretentious, welcome-to-everyone, peaceful, hope-filled, fun-loving community. A place for groundbreaking conversation and culture-shaping ideas. A chance to step out of the traffic in our fast-paced world and into a space thoughtfully designed for rest, connection, collaboration and joy."   A match made in Yeaven (Yelp Heaven) for me given listed at the top 'things I love' on my Yelp profile is unpretentious people and places, "all are welcome here" vibe, universally accessible design and further down the list is dark roast coffee.  Bingo for a great fit at Blok & Co.!

COFFEE:  The coffee beans are from Form & Function and the dark roast here will, as my grandfather used to say, "put hair on your chest".  Not literally.  But you know what I mean.  That roast is for grownups!  I loved it.  They also offer less robust roasts as well as beverages like latte, cappuccino, mocha and Americano.  And as to the footnote on the menu board, 'decaf sucks & then you die', I agree!  I say that with a wink as they do, in fact, have de-caf if you ask but, really, why would you?   Prices range from $1 to $4.50 depending on beverage and size. 

VIBE: Industrial, white and bright but still warm and welcoming.  Seating is all at standard height tables with chairs.  Hooray!   (There's the universally accessible part.  Do you think little people or disabled people or elderly people or toddler people can boost themselves up on high-stool seating heights?  Nope.)  Also seating is spread out enough to be able to navigate around in the space.  No "sardines in a can" here.  Breathing room.  Hallelujah!  You'll find people across age and walks of life sitting, sipping and talking (there's a novel sight these days) as well as some face planted towards smart phones and laptops.

A fun touch is added by a fireplace with cow painting above it and mantel lined with beautiful succulents in little pots.  But the real character is in the ferns.  Yes, the ferns.  All of whom have names.  When we last visited there was Maurice, the star of the show, and the newbie Junior, and also Don.  Bob used to be in the house but he may have been replaced because I think the other fern was named Debra.  Or not.  Maybe it is that I asked the name before I'd had my coffee.  The music mix was just right for the space, think artists like James Blunt and Amy Winehouse, and set at the perfect level to know it was there but not to compete with conversation. 

EATS:  Limited in options but tasty in flavor.  There is a small bake station right in the back of the space and on the day of our last visit we could choose between a scone or cinnamon roll and snagged the last yummy cinnamon roll of the day.  The nice baker was just putting her batch of delicious-looking ham and cheese rolls into the oven.  We understand those are a regular item too so look forward to trying one.

PARKING:  Ample amount in paved lot.

ACCESSIBILITY:  Accessible parking near the door, level in the door and all on one level, many seating locations that would work for a wheelchair.  Loo is accessible too.  

NEIGHBORS:  Fred Meyer is in this same strip mall.

Crumbl Cookies - Meridian you are simply amazing, I had a spectacular experience here yesterday. Great great atmosphere. Every thing that I have actually tried has been quite tasty. The staff is very pleasant too. Love that spot! Will be back.

This is a beautiful store filled with everything you could imagine. Plus it has a pub and a Starbucks. The prepared food makes it easy to grab and go for work. So easy, I've already been almost every day since they opened. 

The meat case is full of wonderful options and even house made sausage which I sampled. We purchased wagu beef and it was so juicy, not as tender as I had hoped but it was probably the cut. 

For the prepared bars...I have tried the sushi and pizza both decent. They also have a sandwich station and BBQ that I haven't tried. A worker chased me down with a sample of turkey and pepperjack cheese one day and it was delicious, so will be back for a sammy soon! The breakfast burritos are very good as are the donuts for your early meal.
