Every corner you turn an employee greets you with a smile. The only complaint I have is while the sales are fantastic, everyday prices on basic groceries is high. Also, Mary at the customer service desk is the only unhappy and rude person I have encountered there. Maybe she was having a bad day. My request was overheard and happily obliged by the other customer service attendant. I just wanted change for a large bill. 

I will recommend this place as a must stop and shop!
Really nice store.  Great work keeping it clean and full of variety.  I am from California and this store reminded me is a Nugget or Whole foods.

Daily freshly made Donuts are so fresh, soft and delicious.
Great customer services, with  smile.

Wish I had gone elsewhere. One issue after another. I had given them a second chance by ordering blinds again from there, even though the first experience wasn't pleasant.  But second experience was even worse

I have lived in Meridian for over 20 years. When I recently crashed my new car I had it towed to Westside. My insurance company did not have an "agreement" with them and encouraged me to go with one of their companies. I told them no that I wanted my money to stay local with a locally owned business. My car was in the shop for quite awhile but Eric was great to work with. He kept me updated the entire process. I have a very hard to match paint color (pearl white) and my paint looks awesome. You literally can not tell a difference. My buddy down at Peterson Toyota said it was an excellent job. Due to the extended time my car was at Westside, the management worked with me on my deductible. I was treated well, fair and I would recommend this company!

Dawnetta Earnest
Meridian Idaho

Our job is still in progress, but I wanted to leave a review about how professional and easy the in home consultation and ordering process was. Cheryl Waterbury was our consultant. She was SO friendly and a total professional! She had an array of samples all with excellent quality. I appreciated her suggestions on lift systems and cord lengths. It was a very quick and painless process. I can not wait to see our blinds after instillation!!

Walked in around 630 on a Friday night. The empty tables, about 15, were all trashed. Not one clean table open. We stood by the host stand for about 5 mins clearly looking around for help, until we decided to ask for a table to be cleaned off! The girl was rude & asked how many in our party. We told her four & without response she wiped down 1 table & walked by and said, "ready". We then waited for 10 mins for our server to even acknowledge that we sat down, & no one ever did. We left. 

We could see the kitchen where we were sitting & the floor was covered in food, saw a cook wipe the sweat off the forehead and return to cooking. (He was tall, & we could see over the counter). 

We watched another family do this same thing while we were waiting to be acknowledged. 

Awful service & very dirty. Would
Not recommend to anyone.

Excellent flavor. They are large but pricey. $3 for 1 cookie and $10 for 4cookies. They change  different flavors every Monday. They keep 2 staple flavors then rotate 4 other flavors. The staples are warm chocolate chip and chilled sugar cookie. Both are good. My husband fell in love with the peanut butter cookie. It's soft and has a thin layer of peanut butter in the middle. The snicker doodle has great flavors. If you like a crunchy outside and soft inside this is your place. There open late and closed on Sundays. Yummy

This is my fav place to take my son. He loves ball city, the arcade, bowling and all the lights, of course. We had a blast! We ordered pizza while bowling. It was actually great pizza! We are definitely having my son's birthday here early next year for his 4th birthday. Thank you for a wonderful experience!

Denizens of the Treasure Valley, I do not often review chain restaurants at all, much less fast food ones.  You know what you get from these places.  You don't need some random guy on the Internet telling you what to expect.  So when it comes to chains, I generally only leave a review if they do something VERY impressive... or very disappointing.  And today, the crew at this Chick-fil-A location did something VERY impressive.

I walked in right on the tail end of the lunch rush, about 1pm.  The drive thru lines were still very crowded, as was the interior.  I had a huge order to take care of as I was picking up food for my entire family and some guests.  It was a big order, and it was complicated.  We are picky eaters.  But these guys knocked it out of the park.  I ordered nearly $60 worth of food, and as busy as the place was... my order was ready within a couple minutes of me finding a seat to wait.  Seriously, I had barely gotten comfortable when a young lady walked up to me with my order.  I was shocked.  I checked through the bags and not only had they gotten the order done quickly, but it was 100% accurate.

Bottom line folks, the crew at this Chick-fil-A know how to work a restaurant... quick, clean, and efficient.  Pay them a visit when you need to get your "cluck" on.

I have my own washer and dryer but I had a friend come over that was planning on doing laundry at my house and I also have my son home from college doing his as well so we ran over to this new laundromat and it was fantastic! So clean and the machines are so nice it's a little bit of a pain that you have to put money on a card because if you don't use it all then they keep your money if you never go back but still way worth it because I did go grab a comforter that needed to be washed I finally got that accomplished!

One if the WORST nail experience. My nails look disgusting. Although I'm more upset about the hour I just spent so uncomfortable at this salon. It is too bad because I'm new to the area and looking for a nail salon and I happen to live right up the street from this place so I thought perfect. I will say it's a nice salon regarding have nice chairs, up-to-date magazines, you can watch a movie, all the things that make for a nice escape from your kids to go relax and get your nails done. Not the case today unfortunately. I think it's the lady that owns the place that was so rude to me, she seemed to be in charge and barking out orders. Again, I go to the salon to get away from my kids and relax and the owners kid was watching an iPad very loud right behind me. I have zero interest in hearing other kids watching and playing video game on their phones. It was so loud and the woman that works there should've had the courtesy or decency of asking her kid to turn down the obnoxious sound. So, horrible experience. I'm not usually a yelper, though I do read them a lot. What was so weird about the lady is she was very nice to some of the people so clearly she has it in her to be nice so why she had to go out of her way to be so rude to me on a Saturday morning is beyond me but I won't let it damper my day any longer though I did feel so wronged I had to share. Maybe this review will remind her to be nicer to people because I'm a great client and my nails done quite often and she lost valuable business... But clearly she wasn't interested in my business or she wouldn't of been so rude in the first place. I gave them one star for having up-to-date magazines.

One of my absolute favorite sushi places in the world! The Mango Tango sushi roll is to die for! The staff is super friendly and very helpful! I'm normally helped by Hunter or Savannah and I've never been more satisfied with a restaurant. They have a solid deal on happy hour and I've gone almost every week since first going! A must-go stop for anyone visiting the Boise/Meridian area!

These cookies are DELICIOUS and really big! For my family of 6 I buy the box of 4 and quarter them at home - we're all more than satisfied! My lack of a star comes from the people who work behind the counter. They usually have a line to the door and one person packing up the cookies and another prepping dough. The girls working every time I come in are as slow as they come. The one packing the cookies doesn't work efficiently WHAT so ever and then dryly tells everyone"sorry for the wait." She's sorry? If she were hustling I'd accept but she's not and it's actually maddening to watch her work at her slowest pace possible when it's crazy busy in there. The girl prepping dough works just as slow and gets distracted by the amount of people
coming in and will just people watch until returning to her work. Usually the person taking the orders is quick, friendly, and efficient - possibly owners? However, I keep coming back because the cookies are incredible. Hopefully management can teach their workers the importance of being efficient and working quickly and to take some pride in what they do!

Food was amazing! Menu wasn't overwhelming but a great selection to choose from. Seafood is a favorite of mine so I can me picky.... no complaints there. 
Service was a bit on the slow side, and it was loud.  
Will go again and cross my fingers the service is better.

We just moved into new home and were in need of a lot of new things.
We purchased a Refrigerator, Washer & Dryer, Vacuum, Desk, Vanity, TV,  office chair and a Wall clock.  The staff there is so professional, friendly, and knowledgeable.  They did not pressure us at all.  We love our products and will go back to RC Willey for future purchases.  I highly recommend them.  Lot's of really cool things and GREAT sales.

What an amazing group of people!  Very welcoming and just comfortable atmosphere. Dr. J is amazing.  Friendly and knowledgeable and honestly one of the best adjustments I've ever had.   I've found my place for life!!!

The service is very bad. I have been here twice. The first time we waited over a half hour for dine in (and they got the order wrong). The second time was the drive through where we waited over 20 minutes to get a kid's meal. And again . . . they got the order wrong. The food is good, but because of the frustrating wait times I probably won't be back.

We went in with our three teenage sons and The employees were incredibly friendly and helpful! They didn't stalk us around the store like these places usually do, but they were always there to help and make sure we had the right size/style. Despite the large amount of Christmas shoppers, checkout was quick and efficient. Love this store!

Finally a healthier fast food place.  Meats and veggies plus you can add avocado for some fats.  There sauces give the food a little extra lift especially the magic sauce but not sure how much sugar is in it so wouldn't want to over do it if your trying to watch your sugar intake.

Super friendly staff.  Butcher staff is outstanding. I don't particularly care
having to check expiration dates.  They don't.

We ordered last week from Uber eats and were very happy with our meal.  We had cheese enchiladas, quesidillas, chimichanga, and the carne asada tacos.  We enjoyed the food so much, we are ordering again today :)

I am feeling frustrated with the Meridian location this week. My husband and I were looking for an ipad to use so we could facetime our sick family member. Monday evening we went in and found a used Ipad mini and took it home only to find out the sound didn't work. We tried many attempts to fix it with no avail. I took it back the next morning with the response of "so sorry, everything is usually thoroughly checked before being put out on the floor." He then offered me another Ipad mini which I then took home. Within an hour I took that one back as well because the front camera didn't work at all. They immediately told me there was one in their Boise store and offered to bring it to the Meridian store for pick up the next day. Never received a call for pick up the next day so I called the store an hour before closing. The response I received is frustrating. They received the other Ipad mini but there were problems with it so they decided to fix one of the three but it wouldn't be done for another day. Not sure why they couldn't have the decency to call me when they realized it wouldn't be ready for pick up. I am still waiting for the Ipad mini so we can facetime this family member before they pass away. 3 days wasted and counting. We have used Irepair several times but starting to doubt their service.

These cookies remind me a lot of the deep fried candy bars at the fair...4 people can split one because they are so decadent. Delicious, but artery clogging. 

This is a cute little shop in a strip of shops on Eagle Rd. Cookies are $3 each or $10 for 4. They come in adorable pink boxes. When I went in they had 6 different types of cookies. I was a little surprised that the majority of the cookies were so tried and true (chocolate chip, m&m, sand dollar and sugar cookies) Only two of them were semi-unique (lemon glaze and the caramel cheese cake). I was hoping for a little bit more out of the (cookie) box thinking. 

We tried the lemon and cheesecake. I had one bite of each and was done. They were good but really sweet. I would have liked about half the amount of cream cheese. 

The staff was quick and courteous. Everything was clean. I love that they deliver and will have to try that feature one night when I'm stuck at home with sleeping babies. 

A good concept, but only in bite-size portions.
This place is so good. I love it. It's cheap, too, which is a bonus. I just wish they'd stay open later!

Fast Food pizza is a very hit and miss proposition. it is a bit like going gambling.

You roll the dice and hope and pray that you will get a good one. Sometimes you get just the right cook, that is in just the right mood, and you get a pretty good pizza.

Other times, you get a cook that could care less about their job and is only their for the money. These cooks usually prepare pizzas that are just plain awful!

Truth is that you can get bad food, or a bad pizza, from anywhere. It happens. Every restaurant can have an off day. 

But in the Pizza world, it seems that Pizza Hut is worse than most. You are more likely to get a bad pizza at this place.

I have ordered hundreds of pizzas in my time, not only from Pizza Hut, but other companies as well. This pizza I just had ranked with the top 10 worst i have ever had. In fact, it might have even been #1.

#1 in the category of the worlds worst pizza is not a distinction that you want. But its what Pizza Hut got today

The reason why I decided to write this review for Pizza Hut today, when I have had their pizza hundreds of times before, is that in all the times I have had their pizza, I have had bad ones way more times than I have had good ones.

The only reason we ate it is because we were very hungry. The pizza was not even good enough to given to the dog. That is how bad it was.

Im pretty sure that if I had given it to the dog, that the dog would have gobbled it up, but then a little while later, either puked it back up and died.

The paper under the pizza as nothing but grease. ( on a side note, this paper that they put the pizza on is more like wax paper. If they purpose of this paper under the pizza is to absorb grease, why would they use wax paper which absorbs nothing?

I did not order pepperoni for that very reason. Often pepperoni is not cooked very well, so the pizza is very greasy.

So for that reason, I did not order pepperoni. But wouldnt you know it. The pizza was just as, if not more greasy that any pepperoni pizza that I have ever had.

There was so much grease that the delivery person must have tipped up the box a bit. When  they did, the entire pizza slid together so that all the pieces lumped together like a greasy mountain of pizza slices.

The grease was so bad, that later that night, my wife puked. The only reason I did not puke is because I eat lots of hot stuff, so I have what they call a cast iron stomach.

My stomach hurts, but I will live. I am not so sure about my poor wife. If I had the ability, and the means, I would sue. Thats how bad this pizza was.

Restaurants should be held accountable for service food this bad and putting folks in pain.

I am pretty sure that we are done with Pizza Hut!

Went for lunch on Sunday the  5/26, sat ourselves. Waited bout 10 minutes for a menu and to place our drink menu. There was about 18 people at the time. Ordered a bloody Mary and a beer and the waitress picked up the olives with her fingers and put them in my drink. UUGGG! We ordered a turkey wrap and the Mac and hotdog with cheese on the tater tots. After over 35 minutes we gotta turkey sandwich and cold Mac with no cheese on the tots. Waitress never came back . We watched 2 other groups walk out cause no one ever came to the table and someone else brought over our check. NEVER GOING BACK. Shame. Not a lot of bars in meridian

I would have gave them a 1, but i can remember they were good at the begging.  I started with them a few years ago. At the time they were professional and the price was rhe price.  I think they got comfortable with me and started saying they did double treatments or had to add something. My lawn had tons of weeds when they started and now that it has less weeds, they have to double spray... i say double charge. Anyhow,  im done. I seen on here that someone switched to Zamzows. I think i will do the same.

Was told there was a 15-20 minute wait...45 minutes later our table was ready but, oops, we didn't know you had a baby with you so you'll have to wait a bit longer for a table that will accomidate a high chair.  Hmm, I was holding the baby when I checked in and even said "2 adults and a baby."  So, couldn't wait any longer with a restless little guy.  Can't say how the food is, never got to try it but it seems that they need to re-train on wait time estimations and general observational and listening skills for the staff.

We buy our tires for all of our cars here. My tire has been leaking air and I stopped by this location today to see how long it would take them to look at the tire. The very rude dark haired girl that has worked at the front counter for years made me so angry I will never set foot in that store again.
It is not the fact that it was going to take 3 hours to look at my tire, it was her abrasive attitude.
I told her I do not have to buy tires from Les Schwab, that there are many places I can go with better customer service. She did not say a word, only smirked.
Why do companies keep an employee in a customer service position if they hate people??? I don't get it.
It is not that hard to be polite and kind. To repeat back what the customer has said and sound sympathetic goes a long way!
When I am treated as rudely as I was today, that's it! There is no excuse for that and I have many choices available.

Ordering is simple, food is tasty, healthy and freshly made. Portions are perfect and price is right. 
My kids love the taste of their tofu and my husband dies for their sauces.
The food was good but had to deal with quite a few pesky flies making us cover our food while eating as well as trying to eat one handed so the other is shooing away the flies.

Thank you to Vanessa and to the lady who also assisted us on Sunday for the Seahawks game!  Also a shout out to the Philly's manager guy who helped us on Friday evening with amazing cocktails & the reservation!  We had a great time & the food and service was wonderful

We stopped in here, and I'm so glad we did!  The food was so good, and we had the sweetest server!  Abby was absolutely a delight, very attentive and brought us what we needed before we knew we needed it.  We will definitely be back, and if Abby is working, we will be requesting her for sure!  Very happy customer here!

This was our first experience with Postal Annex. We took our family heirloom cradle to them to ship to Oregon for the birth of my niece. We also sent clothing. We were really concerned that it would be damaged during shipping, but that was the only way to get it there. We were extremely pleased with the way the item was packaged (which you can tell they took extra special care with) & protected during shipment!!! It was more than we expected and we were elated to see it arrive undamaged!!! Thank you postal annex for doing such a GREAT job!! We will definitely use your services again!!

Great experience getting my iPhone battery replaced. Made an appointment online, got email and text reminders, brought my phone in, and walked out in about 25 minutes with the job done. Completely the opposite of my terrible experiences at the "Genius Bar" (which I will never use again).

Cookies are great and I like they change every week. However....... it is like a sauna in there. They said the AC was broke 3  weeks ago but I highly doubt that it has been broken for that long. I was only in there for a few minutes and couldn't stand it. I feel really sorry for the employees having to work in those conditions.

I have been coming here for the last 4 months, and I like it! No matter who does the pedicure, they do a good job. My favorite is Tuyet, she is hilarious and I think, she does the best job, taking time to take care of any rough spots and giving a good massage on my feet. I will continue to come here, as will my coworkers whom I referred and have also decided it's the best pedicure they've received.
Love the food court addition. The place can be a bit overwhelming because of its size and selection but it's a great place to come grab what you need and some lunch.

We have been taking my son their first awhile and we love it! Everyone is so kind and welcoming. They always do exactly what we ask for. I love that you can schedule an appointment, not just add your name to a list. And, you get a free beer, soda, or water too!
The best donuts that have ever graced my lips! I am not easy to please when it comes to donuts, this place is like donut heaven on earth!
I love going into this store, but I wonder how they are going to make it.  And I won't do my actual grocery shopping there.... fun for a date night though!

Went in to get my camera lens repaired, ended up having my camera ruined, replaced and worse off them when I got there. Customer service was not good. Will be paying a little more next time to go somewhere else

The food in this little place was OUTSTANDING!  Don't be fooled by the drive through window. There is nothing here that isn't made fresh from scratch. Family owned, friendly staff and yummy food. There isn't much more to ask for in a lunch spot!
Shitty service and terrible experience leave me to not suggest this place to anybody for any of your needs. It was overall a giant regret.

Attention! People with food allergies such as Celia Disease, Gluten intolerance, casein/lactose intolerance. Do not eat here.  The person taking the order got it perfectly correct.  The kitchen staff was something else. First they served the sandwich with cheese.  I sent it back and then they sent it out with a wheat bun.  Fool that I was I trusted them and I didn't realize, until half way through that it was a NOT a gluten free bun. Of course, they refunded my money and said they were sorry but the head crew leader looked at me and said, "We gave you your money back.  We apologized.  What more do you want.  Can't you see we're busy!"  Do I care if they are busy when I'm the one who is going to be sick.  I don't think so.

So, I gave them the courtesy of calling corporate.  I was told that the area manager would get back to me in 24 to 48 hours.  Not hearing from him for four days I called again.  This time he called me back the same day.  He was very conciliatory and offered to send me some coupons to give them another chance.  This all happened about a month ago.  I'm still waiting only now it is too late and the corporation has lost a customer.

I have been going to Celia for my hair for nearly 10 years! I've had a full highlight, partial highlight, Brazilian blowout, numerous cuts and trims, and have gone dark dark brunette and super blonde in her chair.  I've left the salon feeling overly happy every single time. I recommend Celia to everybody! Thanks to Celia for always making my hair beautiful while keeping it healthy!
piss poor service and food for the price, won't be going back just not worth the space

Beyond disappointed with Matt's customer service! State Farm recommended we have our body work done here and the car seemed to look fine but less than 24 hours after picking up our vehicle I noticed a loud sound that sounded like something was hitting the wheel well. I presumed this would be a simple fix and so called Matt and mentioned the issue assuming that he would look over the car and tell me what was wrong, but instead he told me that the car was in fine condition when I picked
It up so it was unlikely that the sound was related. After a long conversation he refused to even LOOK at the vehicle! What kind of a warranty is that?!?! Les Schwab looked at my car for free and found they forgot to attach a simple wheel well cover and they even fixed it for free! If Westside wants to keep a business they need to teach Matt what customer service is or replace him! I will NEVER BE BACK!!

This place was awesome. I called around to get some quotes to install a radio, backup camera, and air horn in my Jeep. This place was financially similar or even less than other installers. The guy that does the audio/wiring work was soooooooo easy to work with. Trax Customs will forever be my go-to for my  custom needs.
Had a dozen oysters on half shell, and a martini and thoroughly enjoyed both.  Service was great.

I used to order Pizza Hut but Dominos has stepped it up and is much better quality and a lot less greasy.  Very fast delivery from this location and the pizza is always perfect.  They also always have great specials
This place is really good!!! If you love soups you will definitely want to try this :)

I've been a TruGreen customer for a few years.  They have treated our trees, shrubs and grass in the past.  On a Saturday I received a call from a Sales Representative who was trying to sell me on tree and shrub care which I had paid for in the past.  I told him I wasn't interested any longer due to the cost.  He agreed to lower the price to $59.99 per treatment and I agreed to this.  This week they treated our trees and shrubs and my checking account was debited $109.00. I was told they applied two treatments which I did not agree to. The representative then told me she was submitting a request for a refund of $50.00.  Come to find out, the refund issued was only $20.00.  I cancelled our service immediately and will be taking my business elsewhere.  Super shady company.

I am so glad to have a Trader Joe's located near my house with the spacious parking spots! I often drive to Boise downtown at least once a week or more to go to Trader Joe and Whole Foods, well not anymore! 

I love their flower arrangements, premade salads,  frozen breakfast items and their cheese selections and don't forget their famously affordable, easy to drink wine! I can come here as much as I can now! Yay!!!

Great meat and veggies plates ready to go if you're concerned about healthy eating. Little bit of everything so yes you have to avoid the junk. The good stuff out weighs the bad. Beautiful decor and flower selection. Great wine selection. Lots to offer but you get what you pay for!

The furniture quality is great. No complaints. The customer service though? A complete disappointment. The sales representative was cocky and inconsistent. We moved to ID with almost no furniture so we purchased a large sectional and dining table set. We also kept our moving truck so that we could pick up the furniture. They failed to tell us that there could be delivery delays due to the holiday. So we showed up twice when they told us it would be ready, and it was not. Had to pay to keep the truck longer. Finally got it all and decided we didn't love the color of the sectional and custom ordered a new sectional. Delays due to COVID, understandably. But finally it was going to be delivered on 6/19. Then get a call from our salesman that it would actually be 6/22, no big deal. Then get a delivery confirmation text for 6/19. Then received a call from the delivery driver confirming 6/23. Come on... at this point I'll be surprised if it shows up this month at all! I will never buy from RCWilley again unless I can take it home then and there.

How could you not love this place? Something about receiving warm cookies is so satisfying. My wife and I stumbled upon this place the first week they were open and I swear we've been back every week since. My wife's favorite is the chocolate chip and I love their sugar cookie. They also rotate 4 other cookies weekly and we've tried a good variety of those as well. Haven't found one I didn't like. Definitely check this place out if you have a sweet tooth. Oh and btw they deliver too!

I called in today and got in for a pedicure within 30 minutes! I had went to another place before glamour and they had rejected me and I'm so happy they did. The ladies here are all so nice and I had a great pedicure. The salon is very clean and organized! Will choose them every time for my nails!

Huge fan of Lucky Fins and we've supported them throughout the COVID pandemic with take out orders.  Tonight we were 2 min away and called to ask about their wait for a party of 6.  We were told no current wait, only to arrive within 90 seconds to  be told it was a 45 min wait.   Still love the place, but be aware.  Disappointing way to try and drive traffic.

Tango's empanadas is a wonderful little place that makes fresh hot empanadas Argentine Style. Their selection is varied from Meats to fruits to desserts and more. They're reasonably priced and have some nice lunch specials as well. You won't go wrong to give this place a visit I really enjoy it.

A friend and I popped into the free intro class on Saturday morning. As soon as we walked in we were welcomed by Kelsie and guided to the iPads along the wall to quickly check in, then Kelsie gave us a quick tour of the showers, and main locker area. 

We were both very impressed by the layout and great customer service. 

For those who may not know: 

-There are lockers for your valuables
-As mentioned, there are showers with all of your basic needs, shampoo, conditioner, etc
-They do provide cycle shoes that allow you to properly clip into the pedals, however they do sanitize them after each use
-Towels to wipe your sweat (because trust me, you will break a sweat) are also provided along with water and water bottles if you happen to have forgotten yours 

Cyclebar also runs various happy hour and wine Wednesday classes which sounded like a great girlfriends night out or date night if you want to change it up....talk about taking the "wine workout" to a whole new level. 

Before the intro class was even half way over I knew I'd be buying a package of rides. They have some great offers for First time riders, with the best offer being $99 for 10 rides ($10/ride). I will admit the rides become quite a bit more expensive after that, a single ride will set you back $23 but if you buy a package that's where you can save. The standard ride packages can also be shared within the same household, an added bonus. 

I look forward to my next ride, time to get my butt in gear.

I went in and showed them the picture of what I wanted and ended up with these nails. I absolutely hate them. I let him know my extreme dissatisfaction and he said it would be $18 to repaint them. I am absolutely dumbfounded. My 5 year old son could have done a better paint job. He didn't listen to what I wanted and seemed not to care about my opinion. They ruin my confidence and make me want to cry. I don't even want to be seen in public with them. The place is always to busy to have an actual connection, they care more about money than quality. Disappointing, what a waste of money.

This place has the best donuts in town! They have a huge variety of donuts, and they look so pretty too! Each one I've tried has been amazing. And there is a drive thru, which is especially handy these days.
You're going to pay restaurant prices and wait restaurant times for your fast food quality food. You're better off deciding wether you want fast food or restaurant food and going somewhere else.

This morning, my wife and I went to the Republic Transfer station to drop off a load of cardboard. 

On the way back, we stopped at a coffee place to get my wife a cup of fancy coffee.

While we were there, we saw a doughnut place that I had never been to. It is called Sweet Sensation Donuts.

I told me wife that I had to try it. Every since I have been in Idaho, I have been searching for a good donuts shop. One that is different from the rest. One that puts creativity and love into their work and donuts.

Many people seem to like Crispy Creme, but I am not one of them. Crispy Creme is the Fast Food of the donut world.

They have conveyor belts and machines that make their donuts as quickly as they can. Nothing could be further from love, care and creativity.

I crave a place that makes their donuts the by hand the old fashioned way and cares about their product.

Now comes Sweet Sensations to the stage. I tried several of their donuts including the Apple Fritter, Cinnamon Roll, and of course he normal glazed and chocolate.

The Apple Fritter looked fine, but did not have any Apple in it that I could see. It had no apple flavor at all. It just tasted sweet.

The Cinnamon Roll did not have much cinnamon flavor at all. Well, not as much as I thought it should, but I am a cinaholic. To me, there is no such thing as too much cinnamon. It mostly just tasted sweet.

The glazed and chocolate covered was good, but again, for me, way too sweet. I know im not really normal when it comes to these things though. I freely admit this.

I like my sweets a lot less sweet. I like to be able to taste more than just sugar. My wife and I got about 6 different kinds of donuts. But after a few bites, every one of them tasted the same.

This experience makes me think that maybe my standards are too high. Maybe most people like over the top sweet stuff, hence the name of this place. Sometimes I feel like Frazer on that old TV show. There was this one show where Frazer and Niles had gone to a Steak and Potato restaurant with their dad.

Frazier turned to Niles and said; "Have we become so spoiled by expensive food that we can no longer appreciate simple steak and spud anymore."

Now I am not a huge falutin foodie that turns his nose up his nose up at the simple things in life. Heck, I love me a good hamburger and fries as much as the next guy.

But for me, I just think there should be more than just the same ole same ole food out there. I think there should be more to life and our food than just sustenance.

 I want creativity, I want adventure, I want to eat food that shows the people that made it did so because they loved to cook and put their love into their food. 

I want more.

Philip

Middle aged Blonde lady maybe Amber. Was very disrespectful. As we left the restaurant after being refused service she said "We don't want you here" called to speak to a manager Erik and he sided with his employee. Needless to say we will not be supporting this business and there horrendous attitude towards us.

I would give a zero if it let me, I took my car in to have the battery checked that I bought there, it was bad, so they installed a new one, but my car would not start ever again, it had to be towed, while selling it due to it not ever wanting to run again, the guy who bought it told me how he found that the battery had been installed backwards and fried my car from the battery to the brain, showed me pictures of the burns etc, so they installed my battery backwards, did not tell me they did and I lost several thousand selling my car for scrap after spending all kinds of money trying to find out what was wrong, they are cheats and liars and left me with out a vehicle, never again will I ever spend a penny at that company... ever

Thank goodness for this company. I needed some paperwork served and had lost track of the person to be served. thankfully after calling around I was referred to MS Recoveries & investigations. Not only did they track the person down, but they also got them served in a timely manner. I will be using their services again if needed. but we will have to see if the person I had served goes to court or not.
If you need a good process server, I definitely recommend them and if especially if someone is hard to find. They will find them and get the job done in a timely manner. And affordable pricing too. Their services are invaluable to the needs of many and google reviews are outstanding.

Always loved this place. Friendly service and reliable food.

Stopped for dinner and had to pee. "Restrooms closed to the public."  Asked why, as they were open last week and there's no ordinance against it and all of the other restaurants' bathrooms are open. Told: "Not enough staff to keep them clean." 

Surprised and disappointed with a place that has traditionally been customer-centric.

At least they didn't give me a load of crap about how they're trying to protect me by not letting me pee.

Will be going to Chipotle and other places with "enough staff" to keep the place clean.

This full grocery store carries lots of Russian foods including fresh vegetables with some sold on discount if they are extra ripe like onions perfect for soups. They have a well-stocked deli with good selection of cheeses. They carry a large selection of sweets and chocolates and of course all the canned goods.

I wish I didn't have to give them a star at all. I hope future renters read reviews before deciding to use this company and realize they need to go elsewhere. We moved from CA to ID and wanted to get into a house, (we should have been weary when working with them to rent was difficult) PMP had one listed that fit what we needed at that time. When we moved into the house (site unseen for us) the kitchen floor was so dirty that it turned our feet black, instead of calling to let them know, I just cleaned the floor..no big deal things happen. We started to notice other things, garage floor: oil stained and dirty, Lawn: dirt holes and rocks, Sprinklers: hit the house and fence, etc. The full year we lived there, we fixed everything up. When it came time for lease renewal, PMP decided to add items to the lease that we had sent them emails about (broken sprinklers for example), when we questioned their "Addendum", they wrote back a very rude email that included "use common sense". That was the straw, we gave 30 day notice and have now moved out. We requested to be present at the time of the inspection, in our lease it stated we had to let them know that at least 5 days prior to the final walk through, we gave them 2 weeks notice. We heard nothing back, the day prior my husband email Tom and asked him to have the "inspector" Mike at the property at 4:30 so we could be there. Tom came back and said that Mike would be there sometime between 1:00-5:00. My husband and I both work, he then asked Tom if he could work with us on the time. No response from Tom. Inspection happened at 4:00, we went by the house and the inspection list was literally Jaw Dropping. They accused us of not cleaning the house at all, that everything was grease stained, windows dirty, floors a mess (Carpets were professionally cleaned by the way). We are now prepared for a battle to get our deposit back. Wish us luck! **Idaho requires a 21 day return of deposit, but PMP will push to 30, just FYI if you do rent with them** You Tube Video showing our house they deemed to not be clean: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sFKhDHJgZZs

It always feels odd to me reviewing a grocery store, but I've been floored with how impressive this location is. The selection is beyond expected and I can usually find what I'm looking for. 

There have been times when I'm looking for a specific local item and it's not available, but is at locations like Fred Meyer. This keeps me from using this location as my go to.

I'm also not as impressed with the meat department. The handling of my food needs wasn't very desirable and could use some retraining. We'll keep going back because it's just an awesome location.

We come here literally every week! The cookies are so yummy and the staff always gets the order right, even when the place is full of people. They are always friendly and the establishment is very clean.

This was my first time here and I will be going back!  I had huckleberry stuffed French toast that was heavenly!  Stuffed with hackberries, cream cheese and love. I couldn't finish it all and happily took it home for dinner dessert!  The chicken apple sausage was juicy and had great flavor. The menu has fantastic selections, even for lunch. I can't wait to go back!

This is my favorite nail place I've ever been to! It is always a very pleasant experience. The staff are quick and efficient and my nails are always looking amazing! I especially love getting my nails done by Rene or Tracy! Tracy did this beautiful ombré for me yesterday and I love them!

Have known Bill & Kim (owners) for a long time. Love taking my daughter there to get her toes done. They are fast & efficient. Prices are comparable to other salons in Meridian. Awesome location right next door to Grants Bar & Grill. So go get lunch and afterwards treat yourself to nails, toes, waxes over at Glamour Nails!

Kerri is an amazing person to have on your side. As first time home buyers we didn't have any idea on what that process is like, or what "the next step" is. She kept in touch every step of the way, explained in words we can understand (for the most part, that is haha) and gave clear direction on what we needed and how to get them. She helped us immensely throughout this process and is very knowledgeable. I would highly recommend Kerri!

the WORST!!!
Had the worst experience. Called ahead got a quote on having blinds trimmed and was going to set up an appointment to have all the other plants in my home replaced. When I came in they change the price on me and double that. Be careful of this place...bait and switch.

I have  mixed opinions on Wahooz.   From a rides and things to do perspective it couldn't get much better.  Wahooz has it all for entertainment, and for a kid I'm not sure there are any places in the valley that can rival what they offer for fun.  Very well done in that regard.  Where they miss the mark is the service on the food, drink and bowling area.  The last 3 experiences I've had have been terrible.  From cold and undercooked food, to 40 min waits for basic things like soft drinks, make this disappointing.  Tonight when our food came out without any sauce, it took 20 min for our server to finally bring the sauce that should have been on the food to begin with.    Their process is broken.  Rather than have a server there to take care of you, you have to page when you need something which seams to irritate them, they will show up 20 min after you've pages etc.  Wahooz is a great place but needs help with the staff and process in the bowling, food and drink areas.

Had a service call and Joel responded to our location. He arrived earlier than expected and provide excellent service. He fixed our flat tire in no time and checked/fixed the other tires quickly and professionally. All that between other sevice calls he was handling. It was much apprecited and we got safely back on the road. A huge thank you to Joel and les schwabb for taking care of us on the fly.

I had their cheeseburger soup and it was yummy! The staff was nice. I love how they let you taste the soups prior to ordering. 

I thought the prices were a bit high for the amount you get, but I am torn because the soups are made with quality ingredients. This is a family owned business and for that, I think I will overlook the prices (spend an extra $ or $$) because the pros outweigh the cons!

First time here they have a good selection of soups and sandwiches. I ordered the chicken vegetable noodle and a half a turkey sandwich.   
My wife ordered the loaded baked potato soup, it came out quickly and hot. Everything was great not a single complaint here. Place was clean and staff was friendly. We will definitely return here frequently. Will try the salads next time.

Great store with a much bigger selection than other Albertsons'.  The bar inside is really nice too.  They basically have a full food court as well.  You can get lunch, drinks and even do the grocery shopping.  Great location as well.

Average. I only ordered off the happy hour menu, so it's possible the regular stuff is better. 
Mango shrimp tacos: ok, very bland and shrimp were slimy
Calamari: ok, fried stuff is always ok served hot, which this was. The batter was pretty salty, and the dipping sauce was very bland white stuff that tasted like nothing

These cookies are so rich that I only ever need one to share and I only need it about once a month! 
Well worth stopping in as the flavors offered rotate on a regular basis. 
The last time I went I got a key lime sugar cookie and I was really pleasantly surprised! I like key lime pie so I wasn't sure how this was going to stack up, but the key lime icing was just the right amount of sour/sweet and not overboard in thickness. 
Be sure to stop in!

We visited this store in search of a new couch. We just moved to Idaho and needed new furniture. Walking in the store has a lot of cute items and it looked inviting. We were greeted at the door and then it was a constant flow of new sales associates asking if we needed help. Every 10ft we were approached my someone new. It began to bother us because we were excited to be buying a brand new couch as husband and wife. We wanted the experience of talking it over and sitting on almost every couch in peace until we found the one we liked. Halfway through the store we were sitting on a couch chatting about it and a lady asked if she could help...we said no we were fine thank you, but she stayed there. She then again tried starting a conversation asking what we were looking for, etc...we said we were trying to decide, and she wouldn't leave.  We started to feel like we were on a car lot with this salesperson hovering over us and decided we did not want to even be in that store any longer let alone buy from them. We ended up going down the road to Ashley Furniture where we had a much more relaxing and fun experience.
It is new, clean, and well attended by friendly staff.  My favorite so far.

Worst experience buying a washer and dryer waited tune half weeks for it to be delivered and set up in my house when it finally arrived there were 2 dryers the little delivery guy said that they would take it back and get a washing machine well I was told it would be another week because they only deliver once to my town once a week I told him that was totally unacceptable but I got nowhere also the to individuals that delivered it on the RC wooly truck during the cauvet 19 epidemic didn't even have mass or gloves on really know math to enter into someone's home with a pandemic really RC welly I will never purchase from you again or recommend you to anyone

As grocery markets are concerned, this place is HUGE inside with lots of produce, vegetables, specials, a great wine selection, lots to choose from for beer, tons of choices for barbecuing, every type of meat, pre-seasoned with all the fixin's, a great choice of seafood, wild caught salmon, calamari, octopus, you name it, plenty to choose from. We always go out of our way to shop here rather than local stores since there's so much to choose from. Whenever we're stumped for ideas on what to serve at home, I make it a point to stop in here. More than most markets carry. Highly recommended!

These folks did a great job on my car. They promised my car in five days but it was ready in three. Considering the paint job that they did and some other things, they really did a great job relative to some of the other body shops in this town. I do recommend this business to others.

Albertsons Market Street eating is a novelty for Boise, just because there's nothing like it here.  In larger cities like Seattle, Portland, or the like, there are super grocery stores (especially Asian ones) where this sort of thing is more common place.

The food is good, but is as expensive as going out to a mid-range restaurant, and it is certainly not as good.  We had a sushi roll, some Chinese, and a deli sandwich.  The Chinese had lots of breading, and was not as good as, say, Panda Express.  The sushi roll was what you'd expect from a grocery store, as was the deli sandwich.

I'll only eat here again if I'm in a hurry.

I had the platter dinner with shrimp, battered fish, and truffle fries. My friend had chicken, Mac n cheese, and mashed potatoes.

Battered fish and chicken were severely over cooked. Both were a very dark brown instead of the nice golden fried fish like we got at the Boise location. The Mac n cheese was gooey, not creamy (like Boise). The only saving grace was the shrimp and fries.

We would have sent it back but our server didn't come back until much later and we needed to get back to work. We showed her how over cooked the fried item were and she offered to replace them both. She even offered to have them make it and put it in a to-go box. But it was too late - wish she had checked back with us earlier. She could have looked at the food and notice how dark and overdone the food was before serving it to us.

Zero stars for the food. One star for the server. One star for the steps they are taking to protect staff and customers during the COVID virus.

Slapped my shed together late one evening when crew was terribly behind schedule. Nails left  everywhere, terrible shim work.  They were supposed to return within a few days to add the roof vent but never did even after multiple calls and texts. It's been 4 months.... Make sure you are home to see it's done right.

Stopped in for a quick bite for lunch. I got the chicken breast sammy. I thought that surely it wouldn't be smashed, but it sure was! Looked like a fried egg, all sticking out of the bun here and there. It was very tasty, and there was a nice selection of drinks at the fountain. The guy at the counter was friendly, and the place was very clean. Not five stars though. Almost nobody gets that! Don't feel bad, Smashburger on E Louise Dr.!

A little over a year ago a co-worker brought in a few bags of donut holes from a local donut shop. She gave me a bag, which was oh so sweet of her, and I instantly fell in love. For the next few weeks I felt like I ate here almost daily and then I realized that if I was truly going to savor this deliciousness, I needed to stick to enjoying it only once or twice a week! That being said, I no longer work or live near Sweet Sensations so I am lucky to get there once a month now...but we used to be regulars. I absolutely love their donut holes. They are super affordable as well! I've never seen a better deal on donuts than these. Plus, they are delicious warm, cold, the next day. Hehe. You just can't go wrong. And why share with the kids at that price? Get them their own. 

As far as other donuts go, my husband's favorite feature is that he can fill any of the donuts that he likes with their many fillings right there on the spot. No settling for a filling you might not be in the mood for, they got you covered! My kids always go for one with lots of sprinkles or candy toppings, and they always have lots to choose from. They also have a drive thru, so once you know what you like and don't need to look in the case - then just pop through the drive thru in your pajamas and hit up dutch bros for coffee after. You won't regret it!

Unimpressed. I visited 4/16/2014 and yes it was a Saturday and busy. However, not one, not even ONE sales person approached me the entire time I was in the store for 90 minutes!  I needed to grab one to ask a simple question and he seemed perturbed that I asked him. Wow, the days of being nicely greeted and asked "how can I help you?" by a sales person at RC Willey are gone!! Granted, I'm a single woman...not strolling around with a man, but I had money to spend and I did...somewhere else. Yep a good $5k on multiple rooms of furniture. I am assuming RC Willey sales persons do not work on commission because typically they are all over you like flies on honey. Oh, where I did purchase... The sales woman greeted me, asked how she could help me, showed me all over their showroom, answered my questions, was pleasant, and then handed me her card when I told her I needed some thinking time. THAT is the way you do business to gain my hard-earned money. My advice: shop around!!

Omg! This little place is so on point with their gyros!!! Try the deluxe with the red spicy sauce!! Their gyro meat is bursting with flavor! Everything is always so fresh! The staff at every location are fantastic AND they have a reward program! After purchasing I think it's 5 gyros you get $5 credit toward your next visit. That's basically a free gyro!! You've got to try this place!!!

The folks that work at this location are friendly and willing to lend a helping hand.  I've been continually impressed by them.  Today I accidentally paid full price on items I had big coupons for.  Immediately the cashier had someone on it.  No waiting, they just took care of it.  Where I used to live, this never would have happened.  I'll keep my grocery business here!
OMG! What a great place to shop... The experience was unbelievable... Makes shopping a blast! I've never been one to enjoy shopping but I now go whenever I have a chance!
I love it! Incredible store. Well done Albertsons. I love the variety, the local products and the wonderful prepared foods.

I tried Blok & Co for the first time yesterday.. the barista recommended the custom made sweet potato latte and it was delicious, the coffee is better than your drive thru varieties and I'll def return.. only downfall would be the atmosphere- it seemed cold and sparse. It's freezing outside and the place could be made to feel a bit more welcoming and warm instead of a completely quiet white room.
Best cookies in the treasure valley. By far. A dozen is $25 and worth every penny. They're so big we actually cut them in half.

I found the coolest place to take my Bella fur puppy for Grooming. Thanks to a friend's recommendation. I am pleased w/ the staff kindness , acknowledge of products and services . Thank you Bailey, Riley and shop owner to answered all my questions . It was my first visit today . It was a stress free experience ! This will be my new place for my girl !!
Excellent service and staff .

I have been in the last few Saturdays in the the afternoon.  It has been busy and really need to have two girls working so the wait isn't so long.  I have seen several people walk in and walk out because the line is 5 deep.

I really want to like the soup, it's homemade and small batch. But the chicken noodle is always BLAND. Is it the broth? The chicken? It's in desperate need of salt for one and maybe some other spices.

The chicken salad sandwich is really good. But again probably needs some seasoning. Some paprika would be killer.

Maybe the other soups are good. But if you can't get chicken noodle right, I doubt it

I set foot into Mattress Land after seeing a commercial on TV about the unique sleep test technology. My husband wanted me to do research on several stores before we made the plunge to purchase something we would need to be happy with for the next 10 years. The manager Casey immediately welcomed me to the store. He put me in the test mattress to measure what mattress would work best for me, and he even put my husbands measurements in since he was not there. He at no point tried to pressure me in any way. I thanked him for his help and told him maybe I would come back, maybe not. I did my shopping, and the salesmen at the competitors were so pushy I felt as if I were buying a new car! I could not wait to get back to see Casey! He hooked us up with a great mattress and a great deal! I don't usually write reviews but I had to write one for this place. Top notch service and no pushy salesmen! Not to mention If I don't like my mattress I can return it up to 6 months. I will recommend Mattress Land to anyone buying a new mattress!

What an incredible store! It's really more than a store -- it's almost like a food court, cocktail lounge and mini mall. There's even a grill back at the butcher block so they can share cooked samples of their meat offerings. On my most recent visit, there was a grill up front, too, sampling marinated chicken.

This location has a large deli area and specialty cheese selection. They make their own fresh mozzarella here.

There are plenty of self and cashier checkout lanes. I would prefer having the option to have a plastic bag, but this store is paper only.

Have an electric car? There are three or four free charging spots among the parking spaces in the lot. Cart corrals are covered.

This Little Caesars shouldn't even get one star! Their staff and pizza are horrible and their location is a pain to deal with. The staff is usually totally unprofessional, even for low pizza joint standards, and they could care less about anything. Unfortunately, their 14 year old looking "assistant manager" made that clear again tonight. We've tried this location off and on over the past 11+ years we've lived close by and we've had far more bad experiences than good. If you like stale and rock hard crust, burnt to charcoal crust, and/or old, cold, pizza, this is your place. Tonight was our final straw. It's our spring break and we planned a day out for the kids with an early pizza and movie night in to follow only to finally arrive home, across town, with $25+ worth of burnt BLACK deep dish pizzas! Mind you, we have 6 kids, from an infant to teens, that are all starving and had to deal with rush hour traffic again, going clear back and then clear home again after getting some dinner elsewhere, and the pain of getting in and out of their horrible location, again. They were unsympathetic when I called to let them know we were coming back and that they never should have sold the pizza they sent us out with, so we just returned everything and asked for a refund. Of course they will only refund it back onto my debit card so now my account is tied up the extra funds and meanwhile we're two + hours into this mess of grabbing some quick pizza. Instead we're now waiting for pizza, that we can actually serve our family, across the street at Johnny's. As said, to the kid "in charge" at Little Caesars, we won't come in there again. I learned a long time ago to check our pizza there before we left and it was my big mistake for giving them the benefit of the doubt tonight! BTW, Johnny's was a better deal, we spent less, tasted better, more options, etc. and I really wish we would not have wasted half of our "fun" evening in to find that out the hard way.

This location sucks, after trying for 10 minutes to get in often being crowded road and into their tiny little parking lot with a drive-through wrapped all around the corner with 20 cars in it just to find out the lobby is closed, what a joke. Are we that afraid, if we're willing to risk Taco Bell obviously were not afraid of Covid!
Awful customer service, our drive thru server was Andie C. Waited in line for 10 min. for a hot dog and grilled cheese. Felt very disrespected and u wanted as a customer.

I always come here for pedicures and they are great at them. I came in to get a fill, but this time I was greatly disappointed. I waited for almost an hour, which I didn't mind because I didn't have an appointment. The guy I had was really nice (he was the younger one) but did a horrible job shaping my nails and with the gel polish. The gel polish is very uneven and has dark spots where there isn't enough polish. I brought it up to him and he told me it's because the color is so light, but I've had this color before. The tips of my nails barely have any polish at all. He was just really horrible at applying polish. My nails are very uneven in length and shape too. I'll only be getting pedicures here from now on.

I knew this location was here but I had yet to visit until yesterday. it's tucked away on mcmillian, but they do have a drive thru, which is around the back of the building. 

really extensive menu with lots of burger/chicken/fish options. tons of flavors of sodas and shakes and ice creams. we were just there for a quick bite this time.

my dad got the mushroom burger with swiss, mushrooms, lettuce, tomato, and a really amazing looking bun. he said he loved it. it was a fair price too, if I recall.

I wanted something small and they have CHICKEN NUGGETS on the menu! what?? you never see that at places like this. of course I had to try them. they were absolutely epic. homemade for sure, and better than popcorn chicken or chicken strips. very unexpected and so cool. also their ranch is up there with some of the best i've had. it's perfect.

we also got tots and crisscut fries. they have 5 different kinds of potatoes. I didn't eat either but they were hot and fresh.

they lose a star because we were about to drive away and realized one of our fries weren't in there. when you tip the drive person wouldn't you expect they make double sure everything is included in your order? that was lame. she even looked to make sure we tipped her. girl, earn it. don't get lazy. took another 5 minutes to get our food because of that. whatever, the food was good and hot and fresh. 

lastly, we signed up for their emails and they already sent an email to thank us for our business. I think that's really cool and good friendly service. you get points for signing up too, and free food. it's worth it. I recommend supporting this local business, they seem to have it right!

A fun shopping experience.  Sushi is very good there. If you bring kids and they are hungry, there is a basket so that they can take a piece of fruit while you shop. It's very clean and the employees are super friendly.

Fast, efficient, and on time.  Very good delivery process. They called in the morning with a two hour window, arrived at the top of that window.  Walked up with love seat in hand, placed it, plugged it in, tested it, went right back for the chair. Made furniture moving look easy.
The Filthy Fries are a meal themselves, they were so good! I recommend the adult mac for sure

The cookies are great, but EACH ONE IS ALMOST 800 calories!!!!!  I can't even figure out how that is scientifically possible. I'm pretty sure eating a stick of butter is healthier. 

But, if you are ok literally gaining a quarter point with each cookie .... go for it.

Overall, this place isn't horrible. The employees are wonderful, as is the customer service. The sandwiches are unique and actually pretty delicious. My biggest issue is with the soups. I do love that the offer gluten free, vegetarian, etc. and cater to a wide variety of diets and people, but the soups themselves are a bit watery and lack a lot of flavor that you expect a good soup to have. It's definitely worth a try at least once, though!

I started going to Body Calm when I first moved here in October 2016. The first thing I looked for was a yoga studio in Meridian. As soon as you walk into the studio you're immediately taken in by the soft sounds, soothing atmosphere, friendly staff and very welcoming students. I absolutely love this studio and recommend it to anyone from an advanced yogi practitioner to a first-time beginner. You'll be treated with respect and your needs will be met.

Additionally I just started having my facials done there and am really impressed with Sara W. My appointments are now every two weeks. She takes excellent care of me and my skin. I couldn't be happier.

The sushi is always great here! The other food is okay. I have had the shrimp tacos twice. The first time they weren't the best but I decided to give them another try. They were better the second time around. I've had a couple of the appetizers and they would have been good just for a meal!

Grossly overpriced for simple repair parts.
I needed replacement lift cord for my blinds. 30 feet cost $9.00, 30 cents a foot. This cord sells in bulk rolls for $7 to $20 max for 300 feet. That is 2 cents to 6.6 cents per foot.  That is a 450 to 1500 percent mark up. It takes 60 seconds to pull it off the spool. 
At half that price, I would have thought the price was a bit high but the availability of service with a smile would justify it. 
Any company that will gouge on the little things will never get my business on the big things. 
So much for service before the sale. 
btw, The young lady who helped me was nice as she took my money with no apology for the gouging price.
Visiting from California just have to say how nice our server Sam was she was very friendly and the food all you an eat crab was amazing! The Ultimate Bloody Revolution Bloody Mary was phenomenal.

Super unprofessional. Sara told me she wouldn't be working there anymore and then I called back today and found out she was lying because she didn't want to give my dog the service. I would've preferred you just being honest with me. If they lie about that, who knows what else they lie about..

Where do I begin with my 1 star experience . Let's start with the fact my mother used to go to this owners old salon when it was off chinden. This was over 15 years ago. So I was thinking I would be walking in to a very sweet ass manicure the first time I walked in. The first couple of times I walked in there was always some kind of gossip between the front desk lady and the nail techs. Bashing one of their hopeful  future employees. Talking about how she hated her and how in the hell did she think she was good enough to be employed. I Felt like I was in highschool. These bitches were cruel. However the prices were cheap I would go back from time to time. THIS last time is going to be the last time I step foot into this place . I walked In asking For A Matte finish. They talked me into gel because it lasts longer. My Girlfriend got a regular matte polish.During my day of pampering the lady burned and cut my finger. I think she said sorry but I'm not sure because she speaks the language I don't understand the whole time she is doing my nails. When it's all done I ask where the mate finish is and they don't make matte finish in gel or are out.Cool!!! After I pay they ask me to leave a better cash tip basically. Really I walk out asking for something I didn't ask for paying more then I should of and they ask for a better tip. Hahahahah please don't waste your time on cheap nails for a cheap expierence.

New gym at the Meridian is pretty cool :) Clean, new equipment, amazing staff....everything you could ask for in a gym. 24 hours so you can't make an excuse why you didn't go...It will be amazing when the pool is finished, but its ahead of the competition so far.
We loved Bark Wash. Everyone so nice and helpful. It was nice having everything we needed to wash our pups! We are actually going again tomorrow. This will be our go to place from now on..
I have been inside & though the drive-thru. I recommend to go inside instead of the drive though might be there for awhile. They have fun food & shakes for the family. Customer service is great!

Dr. Jessop has excellent bedside manners and is very personable. He listens to his patients and clearly cares about their wellbeing. He does not just adjust you and send you on your way, in addition to adjusting you he also takes the time to massage the knots that are causing pain and discomfort. I would highly recommend Dr. Jessop to anyone not just experiencing pain but anyone who is interested in optimum health!

My sofa was delivered this morning. As the delivery guys brought it in with the front facing me as they set it down, I did not notice the bottom was already torn until I reached under for a dropped item and felt the flap. 

Many MANY sharp staples poking out. Or not even holding the material in place. Or rusty. I have three small children, this is unacceptable. 

For spending nearly a grand on a sofa, more (and BETTER) was expected. Who threw this thing together????? 


I spent so much time scouting all the local furniture stores and online. Settled on this sofa after several visits to rc willey on separate days to make sure this was the sofa wanted. Had one salesman that I literally zig-zagged the entire store to "lose" him as he circled me like a shark. STOP TEACHING THIS SALES TACTIC! Customers shouldn't have to feel like prey(I'm about to start referring to RC Willey as RC-Ashley Furniture). On top of that, I called him out on being dishonest while trying to close the sale. After attempting to purchase straight from the counter and being denied since I had to go through a salesperson, I found another man whom explained to me that I was stuck with the shark since he had already given me a quote and I had to wait until that dropped(in a day or two) in order to get help from someone else... then proceeded to answer his phone in the middle of another question and walked off. I get it, you're not going to make commission off of me so I don't matter. Left the store in completely disappointment. 

Went back late in the evening and was relieved to get service from a non-pushy and genuinely helpful fella. It was quick and I was out of there with my sofa ordered and paid for within ten min of walking in. But unfortunately, that small blip of positive experience has not been able to outweigh all the negative. I never anticipated being so stressed out over the purchase of one piece of furniture. 

P.s. There is a group of employees here that are apparently referred to as "The Mafia"? Whether true or not.. it's certainly not hard to believe.

I rarely write reviews in general and I have never written a positive review about an insurance provider.  I could not pass up the opportunity to write a review about Kathy and her staff.  Kathy took a personal interest in my experience and was my advocate.  I had a previous State Farm agent that was dishonest and unethical in his practices and when I switched to Kathy it changed my view on the company.  Kathy was responsive and transparent.  I was treated with respect, care and support.  Thank you Kathy for your attentiveness and care!

When I first moved here four years ago, I couldn't break away from my old nail place in Southwest Boise, even though it took almost 45 minutes to get there. I finally decided I had to find one in Meridian, and I worried I wouldn't find one as good as I had. I found one better. Kim (and Bill too) are wonderful with my nails. She and her husband even go above and beyond sometimes and don't charge me extra, which means a lot since I'm retired and on a fixed income. I have a couple of nails that want to split, so I had to go to fake nails a while ago. Kim always makes my nails look beautiful, is really a sweetie, and an amazing mom too.  I read the review about the gal who commented on the kid playing on the Ipad. I think she's being rather ridiculous. I'm glad Kim can sometimes have her kids, who are great by the way, with her at work, and since she owns the business, that should be a given. Maybe that woman doesn't like kids.

I've come here many times, and had a great experience. I've also had my fair share of awful experiences a this last one deserved a review. Decided to take my younger cousin to get some froyo,,it was his first time. He didn't realize how it worked and out to much in his cup, I asked if they would remove a small amount so he could get some toppings on it, the refused after asking multiple times. Was an easy request and I am reasonable just wanted him to get the toppings he wanted without him getting half of them all over himself. Awful service to top
RCWiley is an amazing organization.  I buy 80% of my furniture and appliances here Just purchased a freezer it was 9 months out due to issues being manufactured in mexico and hot it in 6 month
I've been hooked for years, the Deluxe is my favorite.  Skip the burger joint and try this if you haven't, you won't regret it.

I only got so far as trying to schedule an appointment with them. Perhaps it was just the scheduler and not the business, but she is the first point of contact making a huge impression. She wanted to schedule me for one specific time, but when I said I was unavailable at that time due to another company coming to give a quote at that time, she said something "happened" to open up suddenly. As the day approached, she called back saying she needs to reschedule as the person does not want have availability on that Friday anymore due to a company meeting they just had. I asked for another week, but she claimed that's all she had. I told her,  "Well I guess it's not going to work out then." Clearly, this company does not appear to want to make money. To summarize my interaction with Budget Blinds, they were shady, inconsistent, pushy and lacked customer service skills. I do not recommend them, but I'm thankful they are "transparent" enough to show me this from the beginning so no further time was wasted.

I came here for my birthday lunch with my mom and a girlfriend. I had never been here before so I was excited to find a new place that i didn't even know existed- this restaurant is off eagle but it's tucked away in a parking lot and i have never noticed it from the street before. it was lunchtime on a monday and there were a really good amount of people in there though so I guess they don't need any help with people knowing about them!

I ordered a sangria and my friends got wine. they have a full bar and a lot of mixed drinks on their menu. 

the server was really sweet. she was accommodating and helpful with everything.

to start we got the "lobster tots" (lobster and potato formed into tots and deep fried!) and the "crab stuffed avocado" (deep fried half an avocado topped with crab and sauces) both were sooooo good. If I come back here I will just order those as my meal LOL. incredible. decadent. 

for our meals, my mom and I got the shrimp tacos. they were just okay I guess. the server raved about them but they didn't wow me. just pink shrimp on a tortilla with some chopped up mango and a tasteless sauce. I wasn't impressed. the rice they serve with them is super delicious though. definitely try that- it's creamy and yummy! 

my other friend got the southwest poke bowl- a very generous portion. 

we left pretty happy and stuffed. I'd say it was a good experience.

I have shopped at RC Willey in Meridian, Idaho for many years but probably will not go back again. We bought a dishwasher and the salesman promised us easy delivery and installation for a small fee. Turned out to be me on the phone for 3 days trying to get someone to install it. I got the runaround and when I complained to the salesman he laughed at me and wished me luck trying to find it anywhere else. So I'm done with RC Willey. I'm done with sales people in general.

Meridian's Post Office is great.  This tiny little post office is all about service.  They work so hard to please their customers.  When I go inside it just brightens my day.  They are always willing to help me pack my packages properly.   You can also catchup on local gossip when you stop in.  
I imagine that long, long, ago when customer service was important all post offices were like this.

Sitting in the bar at the new Albertsons. Good food. Music. Variety second to none!

Came in to see the Soft Open and have been kicking around for an hour, tasting the samples and stopping for a snack and a drink. 

The good...
Wow. Everything looks great! Custom salad, pizza, sushi and drinks!

These people are straight-up thieves. Do not buy a gift card from them. If you miss the appointment, they just steal your money, give you the middle finger and say "it's our policy". Which is fine, I myself have a strict policy of businesses stealing from me. They refuse to provide an appointment card, a text, a phone call, an email - nothing to remind you, even though they're booked out two months. Evidently they don't want actual clients, they just want the quick cash grab. A real shame since Casey is a great chiropractor but I'll never set foot in this place again.

I'm satisfied with the quality of the products we purchased. We purchased appliances, bonus room furniture, and electronics. Cindy, Forrest & Bob were very knowledgable about the different products. I would give each of them a 5 rating. They were prompt when delivering our items. The rating is a 3 for a couple of reasons - we have a new home and their delivery personnel need to remove their shoes or wear covers on their shoes when walking through someones new home. They were walking through our house with dirty shoes. I also feel the warranty costs as well as the cost to install TV's is over priced. They installed three TVs and one sound bar. I feel the cost to install the big TV with sound bar was sufficient. They also charged us to install the two smaller TVs, which was over priced.

Very nice hot sandwich ordered on yelp through Grub hub. The food was ready on time and delicious. 
Nice to have the convenience store right there to pick up drinks and chips.

I ate a Smash Burger a couple years back and don't remember thinking it was that great.  Typically I avoid chain restaurants,  but my buddy suggested it after Cars and Coffee on Saturday as a close place to grab a bite.  I ordered a build your own burger, with bacon, mushrooms and sharp cheddar.  It was delicious!   A little on the greasy side, but very juicy and tasty!   Shoestring fries are always generic,  and these are no exception,  but overall my food was yummy and at $11 for a burger, fries, and a soda, a good value for a Saturday lunch!

My complaint isn't with the Pharmacy Side of the Clinic.  It is with the CPAP side somewhere between their receptionist/secretary and their billing department.  I leased to own a expensive CPAP machine of which I had not meant my insurance deductible so I was paying out of pocket.  The agreement was to charge my credit card $150 a month until it was paid in full.  This was suppose to be automatic.  First time I noticed the problem was when I got statement and realized they had not been charging my card.  I would take time to call, someone from the billing department would call me back.  They would apologize and give me some sort of excuse and charge my card.  I think I got three statements in the last 11 months.  Every time I got one and noticed something was amiss I would call them.  I called them 3 different times and asked them why they were not charging my credit card.  I got excuses, apologies, and promises this would no longer happen in the future.  They reassured me my card would be charged on the 15th from here on out until it was paid off.  I thought everything was O.K.  I hadn't received any more statements and thought it was paid off months ago.  Today I got a call from Bonneville collections stating $190 got turned over to collections for an unpaid CPAP machine.  I have NEVER been turned over to collections in my life.  I immediately paid the collection agency.  I didn't receive any more statements or any  phone calls before they turned it over.  Their billing department is very unprofessional.
