I have called and spoke with a nice Pharmacist from the other side of their building who is going to speak to a owner about it but frankly, I do not have much faith their billing department will get it together.

This was very disappointing. First off sitting in the chair. Water cool. They said pick a color which I did. But I wanted gel. No one told me where those colors were. I pick one and they don't have it!! I guess you can only pick the colors that have a black mark. So of course I picked my color and it wasn't gel!! Had to pick another. 
Very rude employees. They didn't even say one word to me or my daughter. They were speaking there language, so you didn't know what the hell they were saying. They kept looking at the clock. Get in and get out, that's how I felt. 
Checking out it was $40.00 each!! They didn't even give us a choice nor where we told about the different price packages they have!! Not worth going!!
Not happy! The worst!!

A lot of people describe this store as being "Albertsons on Steroids," which is a really bad idea considering the implications that arise when talking about food and steroids... 

I'd describe this store as Albertsons all grown up with a cushy job in The Big Apple, it rarely calls its family because it's too busy crunching numbers and dropping big money on lavish meals and shiny women. Occasionally its estranged brother calls to borrow money and Albertsons is kind enough to lend concern and a helping hand; and that's when you see that although Albertsons appears to be all business and no heart, its actually quite sweet and emotional. We later find out that at night Albertsons has an alter-ego, it watches over Idaho in a black costume, with bat ears.........

This Albertsons is more like an Albertsons Theme Park. As a result you're going to encounter more lines and tourists, but there's A LOT to do. Fresh bread. Cocktails. Way more options including fresh (considering we're not by an ocean) sushi, and baked goods. Of course you also have your kitchen supplies and pharmacy and tamagotchi selections and frozen meals and blindfolded speed dating and meat market and a Harry Potter ride and desserts. I threw some suggestions in there, you figure out which is which, put in some effort...  ya know?! You've contributed nothing to this review and I'm tired of it.

Anything else you want to know about this place you should just walk around and figure out. I promise you, you have the time.

And a friendly reminder to be polite to the staff: they're not responsible for not having you're favorite brand of soda, they don't know who you are and the only reason they currently care is you're for some reason lecturing them on something so beyond their power they're literally frozen with confusion as to how you could possibly not understand they have nothing to do with what you're complaining about.
Tried for the first time. Food is awesome and the triple hot sauce was nice and hot. Had the half and half with the brown rice, both the chicken and beef had great flavor.

Great people. Took my car in for a check up as my ABS was acting up in the morning a few weeks back. They mentioned they might not get to it today but for sure the next morning and contacted me later on in the same day stating they were able to get to it and diagnosed the problem. That was a Tuesday and said it should be a quick fix and ready for me the next Morning however was not able to pick it up until Friday that week due to a couple of errors completely on them. Wrong size part, breaking another part of the car that then needed another reorder to fix that. They did not charge for those parts or the labor it was just unfortunate it took as long as it did with me having to call them on multiple occasions to see what the delay was. I would go back but wasn't the best first impression.

This is probably the best art studio I've ever seen. Who would've thunk to create artwork using sandwiches people can eat, AND having it inside of a gas station to provide more reason to go for tourists and them Californians. I'm from California, and I can vouch for my fellow property price increasers that this location has brought on a new rennaisance era. No Da Vinci or Michaelangelo can compare can compare to the Earl. Tasty sandwiches too.

This place seriously has THE BEST donuts in the valley. Skip the new fancy donut places that charge $25 for 4 donuts and go here. I'm not kidding! Every single donut we've ever gotten here is amazing. Order at least a dozen donut holes with your purchase, you won't be disappointed. Oh and if you like filled donuts, you can pick your filling and they fill it right there for you fresh and on the spot. No soggy donut middle.

Disappointed.  Below average service. Walked in and stood around for a few minutes before asking a staff member (had 3 walk by us) if we should seat ourselves. 

Fries were limp and looked like they had been sitting around for hours. The rest of the food was average at best. After food was brought out, we asked for silverware since we had soup. No spoon was brought over. We had to go get one. 

We took a shot and it was a fail. Won't be back.

RC Willey is the best place to buy a bed because they have most all the big brands and Joe Meier treated us great and made sure we were satisfied within store guidelines. Our first mattress didn't work for my bad back, too much motion and bounce. They exchanged it (with a bit more money for the price difference) for free. He made sure we were sure on the second bed, final exchange. We upgraded to a Tempur-Pedic Pro Adapt soft. We are thrilled with it after we slept on it in a warm room to help the foam bloom. It's only been 3 nights and already my bad back is improving! Joe Meier went out of his way to help us, I recommend him.

I'm amazed that the friendly staff knows so many of us by name! By the time I get up to the counter most of the time my account is up so I get in right away. The salon is always sparkling clean. The staff is very friendly and helpful and efficient. Bailey helped me the last time I was in. She is very knowledgeable about their products. Amazing experience every time I tan. Thanks to all the staff!

I adore this little donut shop. It reminds me a lot of my childhood. No commercialized glitz...just damn good donuts. 

This is a small store on Franklin Ave, tucked behind a Dutch Bros in a little strip mall. There was 1 or 2 places to sit, but most everyone gets their donuts to go anyway. You must go early! I've been in at 7:00 am before and half of the days donuts were gone. 

They have tons of varieties and they're all carefully crafted. I love their cake donuts. Substantial, tangy and they come in tons of fun flavors like Red Velvet, Chocolate, Apple Pie and more. They also have some other fun pastries like sausage rolls and fritters. Sweet Sensations also does custom orders! We ordered a bunch of cute blue and green donuts for a baby sprinkle once. They throw in a handful of donut holes into any order so you can snack on tiny puffs of heaven on your way out the door and avoid any chocolate or powdered sugar mess on your mouth. Always thinking of the customer! ;)

I have been totally satisfied with quality, dependability, accuracy and  delivery system.
Everything from appliances, living room furniture, bed room furnishings and carpets were all ordered and delivered within 2 weeks this summer.

I am especially thankful for Cindy Berg, a very conscientious sales associate. She understood our needs, listened and performed beyond our expectations. She was dependable, followed our orders up until delivery and always followed up with us, and calling making sure all was to our satisfaction.

Lucky Fins is an awesome place! great food great atmosphere... The service is awesome and the 14 ounce smokin ribeye age 52 days is smokin delicious, the best ribeye I've ever had. the spices are right the juices are right everything's great about it love this place!
The best donuts in the treasure valley. The couple that owns this is so sweet and kind. Their donuts are fresh, light and perfect texture and taste!

My 71-year-old mother visited your store on April 15, 2019 at just after 10 a.m. and spent 25 minutes trying to get someone in the appliance section to help her before leaving in despair. Salespeople were laughing and joking with each other but wouldn't even make eye contact with her. Ageism? Our whole family has always used RCWilley as our go-to place. Never again!!!

Nice place. However, the waitress never came to check on me through out the main course, let alone, offer an Restaraunt specials as I was new there. The pistachio halibut (maybe 5 ounces at best), was a bit chewy but the veggies had good flavor. The fish was supposed to be the star of this meal, not the veggies. Luckily I ordered an appetizer (missed the half price by 3 minutes). Definitely, this halibut plate was NOT worth the 29 bucks. Overall, I give it a 3 at best for my current dining status, when it should really be a 2. I hope it's better next time.

Had issue with mattress purchased within the last year and went back and discussed with same salesman and they took charge of the situation and corrected the situation  and provided an excellent resolution.  I will deal with this store and staff since they took great care of us. These people know customer service... Come on in and tell Casey that you saw this review.

My wife and I visit family once a year in Star, Idaho for the Fourth of July and I came across this shop when visiting a local coffee shop. The pastries are nothing short of amazing!! Truly delicious and hometown goodness! Everyone MUST try it

Well I have to say I was upset by how the customer service handled a complaint. Then one of the mangers called me and made it right. They looked at the paper work again and I did receive credit. Sometimes people are just having a bad day and maybe I needed to be a little more understanding. walk away and call for a manager. Lesson learned, the management was so understand and listened and it became a win-win..

I've been here two or three times so far, and for the most part, I did enjoy the experience & food here. The interior is very modern, and I LOVE the high up tables / chairs. My seating preference here is in the room to the left, once you walk into the first floor entrance. It's naturally lit, huge windows, and of course has the high bar chairs / tables that I love. That room also has 2 TVs, along with the TVs you can still see at the bar area. 

Every time I came here, I made sure to come during happy hour (3PM - 6PM M-F, ALL DAY SUNDAY). The Calamari is pretty good, the overall size of what you get is kind of small, but for $7 I'm not complaining. The sushi here is tasty, presentation is very nice. I'm not a sushi snob (I just love all food lol), and I enjoy the sushi you can buy at Winco. Comparing Winco's sushi to the sushi here, I'd say you can definitely tell the increase in taste and quality at Lucky Fin's, but the overall price per value isn't as good as Winco's, IMO. Still, I enjoyed the sushi here VERY much, and paired with the great atmosphere, natural lighting, and friendly staff, it's almost a home run.

I'm kind of picky as to which place I give 5 stars to. This place is a strong 4. The only big negative that's preventing me from giving a 5 is just the overall price. If the pricing was slightly lowered (doesn't have to be permanent, but perhaps a higher discount during happy hour), this place would be 5 stars easy.

If you're a soup person, I STRONGLY recommend the Roasted Poblano & Jalapeno Cream Soup. It's very tasty, and has the right amount of spice. I'd also recommend the calamari (during happy hour), it's just a little finger food to start you off and get you in the right mood. There's ALOT of sushi choices, but I prefer the hot / toasted ones (not exactly sure what the correct terminology is). 

Overall, the interior vibe, natural lighting, high up tables / chairs, and the food / presentation are all great pros here. The pricing is just a little high, but it's definitely not going to stop me from coming here again in the future.

Technician Giao did an awesome job repairing our  dishwasher. He came out and assessed what was wrong and took his time, and noticed that the motor also needed replaced. He didn't hurry through the appointment like most technicians probably would have and would have missed a couple of things. When he came to complete the repairs the next week. They were done in a timely manner and he had no problems. Took his shoes off before coming into the house and layed a towel down on the floor to not scratch our brand new floors. Really could not have been a better experience with Giao!

Stor-Mor offers a great product at a fair price.  Installation was very professional and accurate.  I was unable to be home at the time, and they easily built the shed in the proper configuration with basic, quickly written instructions.
I shopped around quite a bit and looked at many local options for a shed installation.  I'm very glad I chose Stor-Mor.

Stopped in for sushi and was not impressed. It was weird like a tex mex. Now the crab leg bloody mary was good just wasn't what I was expecting to eat at all. Service was not that good either very slow and never got a refill on my drink and there were only 5 people there eating. And they should also make it where if you use a gift card you can tip from that card.

The cookies are fantastic.  However when I order on line for curbside pickup I expected to have the cookies ready. Both times I have used this service I ordered an hour before I picked up. When I let the store know I was there I had another 15 to 20 minute wait. When I asked why they said they had in store orders to be filled. 
I feel I gave them time to fill my order so I would not have to wait otherwise I would have waited and placed my order from the parking lot. Please fix your curbside pickup!!!

Look no further for the best customer service &  product knowledge. If you are looking for Hunter Douglas window treatments the Blind Gallery has it all & this is where you need to go. It is helpful to have a showroom providing hands on, touch & feel samples of numerous options. Choices abound and you get what you pay for; they stand behind what you purchase with the ability to resolve any problems that could arise. Amanda Campbell is the manager & she worked hard to find our perfect solution to our window related challenges. So refreshing to find a vendor that cares & does what they say they will do. Thank you Amanda!

I decided smashburger would be a great way to take me out of my sorrows. I went with high expections and a hungry stomach. Our food took forever, our burgers were cold, and we were given WHOLE WHEAT buns (who does that). I kid you not, the burgers were so messy that I had to use a mountain of napkins to clean my hands. The service was horrible and rude. I'm very disappointed smashburger, and I'm even more in my sorrows now. Very sad.

Dr. Mandi was very professional as well as welcoming. The diverse staff was extremely nice and helpful. She listened to my partner's concerns and communicated with her on pain and everything she was doing so we were more comfortable. She was very friendly and so was the receptionist who was working.  Definitely reccomend going for chiropractic needs.

Togo's is one of my favorite places to eat. The Asian Chicken Salad is amazing as well as the #24 and #7. This place brings back fond CA memories:).  The prices are a little on the high side compared to other sandwich shops but I think it's worth it!

Ordered a large. 3 topping pizza. Sausage, green peppers, mushrooms. They asked me if I wanted the 7.99 deal. I said I guess so. Asked for a side of jalapenos and told they dont do that anymore. Picked up pizza and asked about side. We can do it but you have to pay. Fine. I just want to get a great pizza. Get home...like 5 pieces of sausage on pizza. I am done with dominos. Should have charged me 15.00 for a loaded pizza. You wasted my time. Lesson learned.
Soup kettle has some damn good sandwiches and the variety of soups are amazing. Highly recommended if you're wanting to try something new for lunch!

I love this place! So friendly and my dogs come back smelling and feeling like they just came back from Paris!!! Ok maybe over exaggerated a bit but they do smell good! 
Ok . 5 stars because I like how easy it is for you to pull up tell them your there for a doggie spa day and they come out to your car get your dog and walla!! The cleaning begins. Very reasonable price, great PR, clean looking place. And my fur baby's are clean!! So call make an appointment and you and your pet will be happy.

Came home from work today and air conditioner was not working. Called Advanced at 6:00pm. They fit me into their packed schedule (first over 90 degree day).  They Kept me informed of my spot on their schedule and arrived at 9:30 pm.  Wow! Apollo was extremely nice, knowledgeable, and thorough ( did I mention it was after 9:30 pm).  Thus is the second time  Advanced has come to the rescue on a very hot day. Can't say enough about their customer service!! Whole heartedly recommend them.
Amazing food, quality fresh ingredients, and fast friendly service. The food is always amazing, and the fries are out of this world (get then with cocktail sauce, you'll thank me later)
Great place to go !  They care about their patients and are open 7 days a week from 7am - 7pm just to accommodate the working family !  They also have a med spa as well!!  Highly recommend!

I noticed a screw in my right front tire so I took the truck to my local Commercial Tire location in Meridian. I was immediate welcomed by the front desk and they informed me they can handle it with-in about 30-40 minutes. The tire was repaired, a courtesy Vehicle Inspection was completed and the vehicle was parked at the from door for easy access with-in the promised 30 minutes.

Great Job Commercial Tire!

Bob

Pharm. John is awesome.  He always has time to answer my many questions regarding my bio-hormone cream and my supplements.  I really trust him.   Most of the staff are awesome and so informative.  I love to refer new patients to Medicap Meridian.  I've been with them since they started doing bio-identical hormones years ago.   I've never had an issue that they didn't fix with exceptional service and a smile. I really appreciate their free mail service to south Boise. I love Medicap- its the people and their service!

Used to shop here weekly!  Love a lot of their products. Especially their peanut butter cups and veggie fried rice!  But staff is extremely rude (minus a select few) and just got worse once covid got here. Won't be returning anytime soon.

Treat their customers horribly! 

I have used this company at the Meridian location before to fix simple cracked screens for our phones this time I brought a laptop to Mitch to fix, he told me to price and time when it would be done which was 4 days I agreed and left it there. I went on vacation and 10 days later called and asked the status of my repair and she put me on hold at no time did I ever get a phone call to tell me there was a delay in my repair. I ended up waiting on hold for 10 minutes when I finally hung up. I tried to call back but no one answered, finally someone answered and she told me to hold again, but this time hung up on me. I thought that was odd and so I called again, no answer and again, no answer finally I received a phone call from the associate telling me that I was rude to keep calling. I was blown away that a company would call their customers of which they don't have time to check your order status, but to tell you that you're being rude for calling. So not only this customer service issue, my repair is is over 6 days late! 

That same day Mitch called me and proceeded to argue with me about things, and relayed to me that my order just slipped through the cracks and he was sorry. He then began to lay into me on how I treat people and laughing during our call and after saying he was going to fix my machine and what more did I want.  When I finally understood that Mitch was saying he'd pay for my repair I gave them the benefit of the doubt, Mitch told me he forgot to order the new part and he would order it that Saturday. I then asked him when it would be done and he told me by Friday. I asked him what if it's not done by Friday, he then told me that won't happen and not to worry.

So now it's the day before Friday and Mitch calls me before the store closes to tell me that the part he ordered on Saturday won't be here till Saturday, and that he forgot to check up on the part. I then proceeded to point out that it's the same situation as before of "things slipping through the cracks" and forgetting about orders. He then does the same thing that's done before and being extremely sarcastic on the phone, and then tells me after I talked with him about not understanding why they didn't follow up with the part or ask why they shipped it out so late Mitch begins to tell me that I'm not worth it as a customer and that he'll put my computer back and I can pick it up tomorrow.

I am absolutely floored by the way this company or maybe it's just the Meridian location treats customers. Here's the issues I see 

- Lack of employees, normally only one employee is at each location, and with busy stores this is crazy
- Lack of process to track orders, everything slips through the cracks
- No one knows status of orders
- No customer notification of repairs that are delayed
- Complete lack of customer service skills and complete lack of care of how they treat customers
- Skill set of repair knowledge or know how behind screen cracks is low

I really wish I could say good things about this company, but they have lost all trust with me, after my interactions with Mitch of the Meridian store.

I would use these guys instead
Rockstar Computers & Iphone Repair Meridian

If you have not been to Cyclebar yet, you need to book a ride.  I am a Cyclebar devotee, and it is in large part the amazing environment and relationships that are made in this wonderful place.  Most importantly, you will get the most amazing workout.  Book a bike today, you won't regret it!

Great place to spend family time! You have a lot of games and activities to choose from. The prices are okay but just make sure you plan to spend at least 3 hours or more so you can get want you have paid for....

The service and food quality is ten star! Can't wait until the Meridian,ID location is open at Fairview and Meridian Rd! You can get an entire meal for right around $5 (empanada, fries and a drink) but you are going to want to spend the extra couple of dollars on a dessert empanada! The menu choice is extensive and there is something for everyone... vegetarian options as well.

So, you need to get to this place, now that it is Fall, and definitely soup season!  We had a great experience with the owners who are the staff.  They encourage sampling soups before committing to just one!  I tried the buffalo chicken soup, clam chowder- creamy and luscious, and scrumptious chicken pot pie soup!  I decided on the Friday special, a cup of (chicken pot pie) soup with a remarkable, crunchy grilled Gouda cheese sandwich, with chopped sweet onion and roasted red peppers inside!  Oh.  Worth every penny.  Some restaurants feed you, and a special handful provide an "experience."  This clean, little cafe is one such place.  We also took home a frozen quart of chicken noodle soup for my daughter who was sick- the reason we came in. I will be coming back when they make their Lobster Shrimp Bisque, which I am excited to try.  In addition, they had a little case of delectable treats for those with a sweet tooth.  I can't believe I said no to fudge, but I was too enamored with the soup menu.  Hopefully, the location will get you there quickly: off the Eagle Road exit.  Enjoy, but be prepared to have a time narrowing it down to your favorite soup.

Got a haircut and beard trim/shave by Max and my son got a haircut by Thomas... both were excellent and came out looking and feeling great!  We're so glad we finally came in here and look forward to coming back.  This is a great new/old-school barber shop with a great vibe and professional staff.

If I can give them 0 stars I would. Workers are super rude to customers especially the elderly. Drop box is rarely emptied and they act like they're better than everyone else. Worst customer service imaginable, 0 stars, zero.

I'll break this review into 3 phases...appliance review/selection, purchasing, delivery install.

Picking out our new washer/dryer and fridge were made EXTREMELY easy by Shane our rep. Easy peasy painless process. 5/5 stars

Purchasing and waiting nearly an hour to get my credit check approved and work verified was a bit frustrating and seemed like there were gaps in their process. It took far too long imo... 4/5 stars

Delivery and install was pretty horrendous. We also purchased a new TV and Soundbar that were floor display models. Needless to say on delivery day most of our goodies showed up but our floor displays didn't. Again a GAP in their process, somewhere along the way the ball was dropped. We had comcast scheduled later that day and guess what, no new tv so had to have them rescheduled which wasn't free. Also our delivery attendant was somewhat rude and condescending to my wife... 1/5 stars

Just moved to Boise yesterday, came across this restaurant by chance and HOLY SH!T soooo good!! Wings dank as ever, drinks will get you lit, solid AF service, pretty much the illest spot in Idaho. Don't miss out on this place. 10 stars

I've been here recently a few times and ate in the dining room. The kitchen has been atrocious each time, and today I watched one of the guys [with gloves on] remove his hat, scratch his head, then proceed to sprinkle cheese one somebody's taco. The customer service has never been up to par. But it's Taco Bell, there are apparently 0 standards or health codes to follow. I'm grossed out and will not return to this location any time soon

We were driving by and thought we would stop in for breakfast and were pleasantly surprised.  The decor is fresh and inviting with a friendly staff.  My husband thought the homemade Italian sausage was wonderful and would have liked to take some home to have with our spaghetti dinner.  I tried the eggs benedict and it was one of the best I've ever had.  The sauce wasn't overpowering.  Our son tried the bacon and egg omlete which was overflowing with bacon.  Large portions which make it hard to finish everything but I did notice there were several smaller combos on the last page of the menu.  We definitely will be back!

Patiently waited my turn in line at the chocolate counter, watching employees busily performing tasks that were seemingly more important than serving customers while one employee was actually helping people. Once it was my turn, the employee looked at me and ignored me as a teenager, who came back to order more truffles, cut in front of my family. Instead of having her wait, the employee served her instead. Needless to say, we left, disgusted at the service of this hoity toity establishment.

What a little gem!  They make everything from scratch here and do they look delicious!  I bought a pastry with home made lemon curd which  is one  of my  very favorite things.  I will be back, again and again!
The portions no way justify the price, I took two bites of the 5.00 Mac and cheese and it's halfway gone, sandwiches are super tiny as well. We spent over 30.00 and are still hungry

I love Nails Plus!  Kim is excellent and has been doing my nails for over 20 years! The shop is beautiful and the staff is all excellent! It is a good idea to call on your way in, they can get very busy.

This place is over the top in quality of food! The service was most excellent! They went out of the way to make sure we were happy! The waiter (I wish I could remember her name) was superb in her knowledge and service. I will always come back here!

Pretty awesome bowling :) 

Check in is easy & the workers are kind. We had the unlimited attractions so we could bowl all we wanted for free. The lanes were pretty empty and there are tons of bowling balls to try out. 

We ordered some lunch while we bowled. The lady never refilled our drinks so that was kind of annoying, but the food was good. We had a small pizza (yum!) a sandwich and some fries. Everything was hot and delicious. Prices seem fair. The have optional bumpers and the little roller things for the kiddos. 

It was a nice break to come in from the outside fun. I wish the music was a little bit louder! We will be back!
Great donuts. Even better Kolaches. Friendly warm service. Best donuts in the Treasure Valley!

We moved to a new home and were very grateful to find such great furniture and service at RC Wiley. Right in the door we were helped by Carlleen who listened and showed us the many style options they have to offer. We bought beds and have gone back to make additional purchases. She is like our personal furniture shopper now. I highly recommend her and the store.

We purchased an Electrolux washing machine. When it was delivered it didn't power on. The service tech came and got it to start but scheduled Electrolux service after that. The sales person called to ensure we were happy with her situation. When I told him what happened he scheduled a replacement to be delivered the following week. The new one is working fine and we're very happy with the quick resolution.

This place never stops amazing me. I have gone multiple times since my last review, and each visit was excellent. They recently closed the inside, which is a bummer, but the drive through is great. Outstanding customer service and food. The price is fair as well. I would recommend not getting ice with any drinks because since they are so good, the drinks will be gone before they are warm anyway.

We ordered a family size nacho (to go) for $17+ and were pretty disappointed. The size of the nachos would be better described as "for 2" (if that). Definitely not worth the price. I expect much more for $17 nachos!! Value was $7 tops. So bummed.

What's not to love about a store that sells outdated junk?  All you need to know is that it's a TJ Maxx company so you know the quality is lacking.  Just visit a store and look at the racks of stuff that wouldn't sell at a flea market.

We go to this grocery store several times a week and it has never disappointed us. 
We ordered a 2-tier birthday cake and themed cookies and they turned out beautiful!! 
We've tried their sandwiches, sushi, poutin, hamburgers and other food and they haven't let us down. 
The cocktails at the bar are delicious. 
We definitely recommend this place, especially if you want high quality food while you stick to a budget. 
Employees go above and beyond to help their customers.

Dinner was great. The specials were well described by the wait staff.  The manager was very apologetic the food didn't come out quick enough to his standards and offered to compensate us for the delay. We politely declined because we didn't feel their was a long wait for our meals. Will definitely return.

I can speak as a former employee and customer that management here and customer service is absolutely atrocious. Does not schedule or keep enough employees to have cookies, constantly running out. Ordered here three times since leaving the company. First time ordered delivery and was given cookies without the frosting. Second time they were out of their 2 cookies they have "every week". Last time took 15 minutes after payment to let us know they were out of chocolate chip cookies and another 15 to refund our money. Employees here are trying their best but management does not care and not worth the time or money. Take your business elsewhere.

First of all if you want Taco Bell DONT GO HERE! My boyfriend went with his brother to get food for dinner and a man comes out and tells him it's a 1 hour wait. He decided to stay and as he got to the window he asked for his reciet and the nice lady said that they couldn't because they had problems with the system. A lady yells out over her and says we can't and that we can't know why. Not even kidding a lady is yelling behind her it was so horribly disrespectful I could hear from his phone! :(. He sat in the parking lot with everyone waiting and chatting saying how they have been there for a hour or two. After 1 hour waiting a cop shows up. Yes a cop. He said that everyone was yelling outside and threatening to shoot up the place. I was on the phone the whole time and my bf and I had conversations with the nice people that would wait. The cops were amazing and said that we need to get our food and ended up writing down everyones orders. (There was 11 people) three cops later they told us that they had to go to something more serious than this bull shit. The cops got them to get there act together and give people what they ordered. Everyone in that fast food Taco Bell was just sitting there picking there nose. WORST MANAGEMENT EVER! Even being on the phone with him the whole time I was so anxious to drive up there. That's not even the worst part they didn't do my bfs drink right 3 times. I wish I could tell those cops they deserve the money that those workers get because what the works did was down right disgusting. I worked at subway and drive thrus and there is always away to get everyone there food even on busy days. All I can say is the people that worked there on May 31 you should be disappointed.

We tried to go in for a dog wash at 2pm on a Sunday afternoon (with masks on). The sign said open until 5pm and no other customers were inside. We were told "per cdc recommendations" we can't come in to wash our dog. No other explanation. Not a single other customer in the place. No idea what this cdc recommendation is where you can't have a single customer in your establishment, or why they would keep an open sign turned on, but they better not be collecting any of my tax paid stimulus money to keep themselves open like this.

Service is 10/10 
Accountability 10/10
Micah the manager was extremely helpful, and took responsibility for a few issues that have come up.

Never had a issue here, there customer service is right up beside chicka filet, and the cookies Mmm cookies. You can even send special messages on the box, how cool is that. On top of all that they make the cookies look special each one having there own unique look and special add ons too them, the example the waffle cookie looks like a waffle and has a ball of cream cheese in the middle that looks like the butter you would place on a waffle, and then comes with maple syrup to drizzle over.. Mmm waffle cookies.  They all have something special which makes each one even better.

I went in during my break time and Valentino helped me with my flat tire right away. He was really nice, didn't take advantage of me as a customer to sell me tires I didn't need and fixed my flat for me. I gave them permission to replace my tires if needed and when I came back he said they still had life on them. I was honestly shocked that I wasn't expected to pay for anything because companies simply aren't this honest anymore, and these guys were. I can see why they're so busy!

There are limited fresh food options for vegans & vegetarians, but overall the food is alright. The produce is fresh, although I wish there were more organic options. One of the employees wasn't being careful with the shopping carts in the parking lot.
Our kids always have a blast when we go to wahooz. Quite a bit of options as far as entertainment goes. We love to go for bowling or mini golf. Super fun place!

Sales Manager Scott Wilson was a complete JERK so I refused to buy from there.  He was so full of himself and when I said I didn't like the color of the color he gave me an obnoxious menacing laugh saying, "only a girl would care, get real".  After giving him all the information I was seeking in a car, he could not deliver and then yelled at me, blaming me for not choosing what he had available.  Horrendous treatment

Unique and pallet tantalizing. Has not disappointed yet.  We are frequent fliers.  We would recommend to any fish lovers out there.  Do not forget to order their clam chowder:  There is no chowder that can compete.

I came here with my son looking to purchase a mattress, not browsing but with the specific intent to buy while there. We walked around the store for one hour, during that time we found exactly what we wanted to buy..the problem was I couldn't get one single sales person to even look at me. There was plenty of them, either looking at their phones or helping customers they thought were "worthy" of their time. Taking my business elsewhere as they are obviously interested in missing out on an entire demographic of customers.

We are so happy with our blinds! Brandi came out to our house just a couple days after we called and spent over 2 hours going over different looks and options. She was very knowledgeable and helpful in picking what fit our house style and functionality. Ordering was seamless and they were installed less than 3 weeks after we ordered which was much faster than expected! Our installer was friendly and quick and explained the function of each. We'll definitely use Budget Blinds again in the future and I'll recommend Brandi and her team to my Real Estate clients!
Les Schwab has offered great customer service and communication the two times I have been in for tire services. They go above and beyond. I highly recommend them!

We love this place. The finger steaks and waffle fries are amazing! Today I'm venturing beyond the norm and having a hot dog. It's great! Sliced in half and grilled. So good!  My favorite drink at Fanci Freez is the Polar Bear Coke. Tastes like a melted Coke float. Mmmmm.

My sister-in-law and I decided to pop in while visiting family for Christmas and we do not regret it at all! Our instructor Bryden was energetic and fun. The owner JP could not have been more helpful. The first rider price ($10)  made this ride an absolute steal. Drop in price is great too, at $23. Great workout, huge space. Thanks for the perfect Christmas Eve Ride!
Most of the time this place is great.  We've been once disappointed, but I suppose I could take some responsibility in communication. It's mostly great.
Great service, great food. Can't beat the Bostons.  So many great flavors to choose from.  The possibilities are endless.

Just a quick update. It's been eight months and I still love the shop that Stor-Mor built for me. I had a slight problem with one of the doors this week, called them and the next day it was taken care of. Great company to deal with.

Don't trust everything they tell you. 

Took the tire in to Les Schwab and they yanked the nail out. The guy was quick to assume that with it's trajectory it probably went to the side and into the sidewall and I'll probably need a new tire. They call me 15 minutes later. Yep it's in the sidewall, can't fix it. Would have probably believed them but the tire wasn't going to be in until Monday and that wont work. 

So I took my wheel/tire to Commercial Tire in Meridian. They take the tire off and tell me it never even touched the side wall. Fixed it for me at no charge and I'm on my way home.

It could have been a $350 day, but it was $0 due to the honest guys.

Honestly super sweet workers. Assistant Manager with the bun was so kind! I felt so awful we came in late and she was so nice and treated us great. So sorry I didn't catch her name. Their pizza is always super delicious and they are always kind! Definitely will be back.

By far, the most unprofessional clinic I have ever been to. The front desk staff was completely rude and unapologetic about their attitude and behavior. 
Their Covid protocol is questionable and irresponsible. 
At first, they began by bringing me paperwork to my vehicle, and I was told the exam would be in the vehicle. However, they decided to bring me in to the office for the Covid test even after I explained that I have had positive Covid exposure. 
I returned a day later for a family member to take an exam, and again they brought us inside. While discussing insurance information with the front desk, I was asked why I was hanging around inside when it was THEIR DECISION. I was told right there and then that I was positive for COVID-19. This did not feel like an appropriate way to inform a patient in the middle of a reception area. 
Finally, the front desk lady decided to yell at me, telling me to get out of the building when I was trying to pick up some paperwork that I had left with them. Again, THEY DECIDED TO BRING ME INSIDE.
Very rude, very unprofessional, very dissatisfied!!! 
Don't come here.

Stopped by 45 minutes before close on a Friday night to grab a bite to eat.  Enjoyed the ambience.  It was obvious that they were cleaning up for the night but the staff was still friendly and the food good.  Had the finger steaks and fries.  Enjoyed both...  Will definitely go back.
Every time I come here they've been nothing but helpful! Even with Christmas coming up they really go above and beyond.

Advanced did a "service" on mother in laws new home and the unit was extremely dirty. They changed the filter but didn't bother to wipe out the filter access that you couldn't even tell was sheet metal because it was caked in dirt and dust. They didn't pull and clean the blower motor because they charge extra for that, even though the blower motor is heart of the furnace. They didn't clean the flame sensing probe either. So pretty much they came and put a sticker on it and changed a filter. When I called to ask why they didn't do any of the above mentioned things lol I kept hearing was "that's a extra charge" or "we don't do that in a service". Won't use them again.

This is franchise (the first in Idaho perhaps) of a fast food chain tucked inside locally owned Fast Eddy's convenience store.  My husband and I enjoyed unexpectedly good eats with our choice of the Breakfast BLT here and at under four bucks, including tax, it was a great buy too with friendly service being the little extra something.  Good enough that we who avoid chains at nearly all costs - including choosing to go hungry rather than eat at  them - would not only go in again if in the area but might actually make EOS a destination to try other sandwiches from their breakfast and regular menus.  A tip - they make the turn away from hot breakfast items at 11am.  

OUR EATS:  Just enough bacon but not too much cooked just right, fresh tomatoes sliced just right, fresh curly leaf lettuce in just right amount on a toasty bun of just right size and when we said "please hold the mayo" they got that right too.  It might be the best BLT we've had in a year'ish and so we told the nice young woman who made it - she a new employee we learned - before we left.  
 
FRIENDLY SERVICE:  A big part of why we'd go back is the friendly service from the young people working behind the counter.  You think fast food service can't be done right?  It can and this is how.  Bravo to all the folks working there and to the owners who took the time to hire and train them.

EAT IN OR TAKE AWAY:  There are a few tables to sit at if you want to eat in and like all of the Fast Eddy's convenience store the Earl of Sandwich area is sparkling clean.  As aside we noted many of the folks coming in for lunch orders - we made our visit just before 11am turn to lunch - were taking their orders to go.  A tip -  there are also fresh made Earl of Sandwich sandwiches in the 'grab and go' section of Fast Eddy's just inside the entry door.

GOOD VALUE:  Breakfast sandwiches are almost all under $4 with tax included and lunch sandwiches which are generous enough to feed two people clock in between only $6 to $9 with tax.   A tip - since this is a chain, you'll find calorie counts on the menu to help you decide if you want to share that sandwich and the calories that go with it. 

THE "CORPORATE SCHTICK:  The chain was started by an 11th generation descendant of the Earl of Sandwich who is the guy tagged with starting the sandwich to begin with.  True - it is a relative who started this.
 
FAST EDDY'S:  We were enough impressed with locally owned Fast Eddy's in general, after having our car washed there for the first time, that I took the time to write a review - no kidding for a car wash / gas station / convenience store - and you can find that here if you want to know more about what it offers.  https://www.yelp.com/biz/fast-eddys-meridian-9   I imagine the EOS franchise here is owned by the same people which may help explain why it is so well managed.  

ACCESSIBILITY:  Inside is ADA compliant, just as one should expect in 2019, 29 years after that US Civil Rights law was passed.  Table seating is at standard height and seems as if wheelchair floor clearances available at some.  BUT accessible parking misses the mark of ADA law in that the ADA parking spots have been put at the far sides of the convenience store and not near the front door where they should be.  The law requires ADA spots be proximate to the entrance so that a disabled customer does not have a longer route to the door than an able bodied customer.  The far end placement of the parking makes the trek to the front entrance longer for sure.  It would have been easy and still possible to locate these spaces at the front near the entrance. The owner's obligation is to follow the ADA in parking placement.  

LOO:  There is one for ladies and one for gents, both at the opposite end of the store from EOS.  Speaking for the ladies - a two stall - it was sparkling clean.

Usually love this place for a beer after work with darth wife. Server came to table with mask under her chin. Uh does not work if not covering face.  We are one of the hot spots in the country with COVID and hospitals filing up. When darth wife inquired why she was not wearing her mask correctly she quickly responded that she was. Doe all those that fail to understand, the mask protects others and gives you some, but very limited protection. Bummer for waitress, I think she would have liked a tip when customer numbers are down. Wise up Hideaway owners. We will not be coming back and will seek out someplace where they care enough to wear masks correctly and approved by darth wife. Incidentally my wife's name is not Karen.  BTW beer was great.

We bought a leather couch from RCWilley and got talked into the extended warranty...it was expensive, both the couch and the warranty.  When problems arose, I called and spent 48 minutes on hold before getting the customer service rep. They said they'd call back with a ticket for the repair.  Never heard back.  Tried again, never heard back. Paid a small fortune for an over the stove exhaust fan. It's noisy and so ineffective that the smoke detector which is 20' away goes off when the oven door is opened if I'm using the broiler and with the fan on high. Bought a $3000.00+ zero gravity chair with a 1 year warranty, this time I passed on the extended warranty.  In less than a year it squeaks when reclining, the joints feel loose, and it's possessed sometimes,going up/down whenever the chair feels like it and not going up/down when you push the buttons.  After over an hour waiting on hold, We got on the schedule for a repairman to come out...so we'll see how that works out. But for it to be failing in less than a year for that price!!?  We ordered a washer/dryer on July 1st to be delivered/installed on the 18th with the promise of earlier delivery if the dryer came in sooner.  Called today, another 59 minute hold time, then the customer service rep said she couldn't tell me anything and would have to send me to my salesman's cell phone which she assured me he would answer....well, got transferred, went to voicemail, then received the message that his mailbox was full..Good-bye.  I've never had a hold time less than 45 minutes, and when I expressed my frustration with the long hold times (before the virus as well as now) and suggested they hire some more people to provide customer care/vs salesmen stalking you from the minute you walk in the door was told that people don't want to work and they were trying to hire people.  So, I went to their website and there are absolutely NO openings for customer service. I think I may have finally learned my lesson...and after the other reviews of installers connecting appliances backwards or damaging their gas lines, am questioning the wisdom of letting them do the work.  Bottom line is they are about the only game in town here in Idaho, unless you want to order things sight unseen or get even less quality for the money.  They don't have to care after the sale. I've been loyal since they gave me my first line of credit about 40 years ago when I lived in Utah. At the time women still needed a husband or father to co-sign to put something on credit, so happy that's not the case anymore. They still made me have my husband co-sign (even though I earned more than him and the credit was for a $50.00 table) but they let me have the credit in my name only.  That was a big deal to me, so I've put up with the above out of gratitude and loyalty. If I can find another washer/dryer before someone calls me back I'm going to cancel.

I was visiting from California when I dined at Corona Village. I was pleased to find that this is an authentic Mexican restaurant. The food was good and the staff were nice. I would recommend this restaurant. And I would definitely dine here again next time I visit.

Hubs and I had a day date lunch. Hands down Lucky Fins Fish-n-Chips are the best. The fries are truffle fries and yummy.  The star for me was the Coleslaw ... it has a house made apple dressing that is super delicious. I tried to get the recipe for the dressing but no such luck! Next time I will have fish & chips but no fries but extra on the coleslaw! Dessert was a Key Lime tart - subtle taste. Not too tart and not too  sweet. Definitely recommend!
Tried this place out for the first time while we had family in town. Was a good experience. Food was tasty, drinks were tasty, and we will definitely return!

We love the sushi at Lucky Fins. The lobster deviled eggs appetizer and the fried stuffed avacodo are just awesome. Right now they have a killer take out deal (25% off!) that really makes this a great time to try them out. Love this place!

When I found Celia a few years ago I was at my wits end with trying to find a stylist. I had had horrid luck with my previous stylists. If they weren't busy frying my hair, they were canceling my appointment at the last minute. From the start Celia was a breath of fresh air. She is responsive, makes sure to discuss any questions or concerns I may have, and never bats an eyelash when I say I want to go from blonde to brunette or add purple highlights. But most importantly, she ALWAYS makes my hair look freaking awesome! I have never received so many compliments on my hair as I have since I have been going to Celia. In addition to the amazing wizardry that she performs on my locks, she also provides amazing products to help keep my color vibrant and tresses healthy. So if you enjoy having fabulous and healthy hair I would highly recommend spending an hour or two with Celia.

Went here with a group of friends and we all thought Smashburger had a great thing going on.  Burgers and fries and shakes were great.  Customer service was awesome and we really appreciated the staff here.  Friendly and on the ball.
The best donuts you will find in the valley. They are always light and fluffy. The cake donuts are moist. Don't pass up the donut holes!
