Companies mess things up.  It happens.  And it's okay.  We have all had a bad experience with a company at some point. The value and reputation of a company is not only in their products, but also by how it's people respond when they are confronted by a frustrated customer.  And this is where Idaho iRepair completely fails.

I was not expecting or asking for a freebie or a handout. I simply wanted someone to listen to my complaint without treating me like a child, and idiot, or a liar. Unfortunately, that is not what happened. 

To start off, it's important to know that I've had my iPhone 7 for over a year and have never had any issues with cracking. The screen has survived countless drops and crushes through various cases.  I am not particularly hard on phones.

On Saturday, I dropped my phone on the sidewalk and it cracked.  It happens.  The screen shattered. It was my own fault and clumsiness. I went to the iRepair in Meridian at 1530 S Millennium Way. The tech there was kind and professional and repaired the screen in about 30 minutes. For this service I was charged $137.  Fine.  

Fewer than 36 hours later I was sitting on a couch, perfectly innocently, with my phone in my pocket. I pulled it out and, to my shock and devastation, the screen was cracked again!!

Now, I know how this sounds. I'm not an idiot. I know that phone screens don't crack on their own. I know that there has to be either some trauma or some workmanship defect in the installation process.

The thing is, there had been NO trauma. I had not dropped my phone. I had not bumped my phone.  I just hadn't.  I had to conclude -- reasonably I thought -- that the repair that iRepair did was poorly done and made my phone vulnerable to cracks where it should have been fine.  Is that so crazy?

I broke my phone the first time. My phone broke itself the second time. There was no drop or smash or throw. It is clear that Idaho iRepair is responsible for the damage that my phone sustained after their repair.  Something was done wrong. Phone screens don't break them selves absent some shoddy workmanship.

As soon as the Millennium Way location opened up on Monday morning, I returned and started speaking with the kid working there. 

The employee, "Zack," was appallingly rude and unprofessional. He did not attempt to understand or resolve the issue. He repeatedly groaned and scoffed and straight up accused me of lying to him about the circumstances of the break. What possible reason could I have for paying an arm and a leg to get my phone fixed, just to break it a few hours later in order to come in an get a refund? Absurd. When I asked "Zack," the high schooler, to let me call the manager, he would not give me the number. He continued to laugh bemusedly and roll his eyes. Zack has clearly never been instructed on the appropriate way to speak to customers. He was rude and insulting. 

Eventually I gave up trying to reason with Zack and called another location. When I asked to speak with their manager there was no problem whatsoever. I was speaking to the manager of the Village location right away. He was professional, but he also refused to listen to or accept the facts of the case. While he did offer to replace the poorly-installed screen for $75, I was not interested in giving any more money to this company. If an alligator bites your hand off and says he'll only bite three fingers off of the other hand, you don't stick your other hand in its mouth. 

This whole situation could have gone much differently for all of us. Had the screen been installed correctly the first time, it would not have spontaneously cracked. Had Zack been more professional and listened to my concerns, the manager never would have been called. Had anyone along the line been willing to take any responsibility for shoddy work, I would not be writing this review. Mistakes were made again and again. 

Idaho iRepair didn't do their repair or their customer service correctly. I will never return for their service. I am visiting Boise with over 40 people for a family reunion, who have all heard my story extensively, and all agree that the customer service and general response of this business was terrible. 

There are many more options on the Boise metro area.  Use them!

This is a very solid Mexican restaurant in a place you wouldn't expect one to be. The strip mall Corona Village lives in is kind of dated and rundown but the food here is fresh and tasty. 

My favorite order is the Tres Amigos which is a chili relleno served with chili Colorado and chili verde. The serving is huge and everything on that giant plate is awesome! 

The service here is also very good and the staff is more than willing to tweak an order to make it just right for their guests.

This is by far the worst pace to get your phone fixed the only reason you should come here is if you want them to break it more for you. They use refurbished screens, not new ones. I've had them put 4 on my phone so far and they all suck. The first time the manager victor tried to fix my phone, he is so incompetent. He doesn't know what he is doing, he has no customer service, and he is rude. He will cuss at you and attempt to demean you. It took these guys almost 3 weeks to finally get my phone in working order(all that was wrong was a cracked screen) but victor decided to go ahead and break my ear piece as well. So having a phone you can't call anyone on is pretty shitty. They won't give you a refund either. Take your business to a place that knows what they are doing. Anyone is welcome to take a look at my text messages from the manager of this store, and you will see what kind of business these people are really running.

Spray tans have changed my life!! This location is hands down my favorite. Maddie, Miranda, and Claire always provide the best service and are so sweet. They are always so helpful and point me in the right direction on what tans/products to use. These girls deserve a raise!

I came to this place a few years ago. Maybe 4 or so. Came tonight with a friend. There was pretty much one waitress. Poor woman was very overwhelmed and you can see that she was trying her best. We ordered the fried pickles. They were cold and very salty. Had a nice crunch though. I ordered the chicken and walnut salad as a wrap. I asked for the fries to be cooked a little longer. The fries
Came out soggy and cold. The wrap was ok. My friend for the finger steaks. They were ok. The fry sauce was pretty awesome. Not that good. Maybe it was a bad day for them. I don't know. I just don't know if I will go back again.  Also!!! I am in good service myself, but the people cooking weren't wearing hats or hairnets. That isn't sanitary.
They were awesome in every way! I highly recommend for financing needs. They helped me purchase my first home!

I am currently moving and needed some clean clothes as I had to sell my home washer and dryer. I was weary to go to a laundromat as they have a bad reputation for being dirty and unsafe. But let me tell you something.... I am a changed woman!

Rave Laundry is the cleanliness and most efficient laundromat I hav ever seen. I felt safe the entire time. They had an attendant who was knowledgable about the machines and how to get a card to pay for the machines. It saved me about 10 bucks for just one trip. (I only did a small amount of laundry so that was a lot saved). 

The wifi is free so I could be productive the whole time while my clothes were washing and drying. The entire space is full of windows and spacious as well. This makes me want to open my own laundromat in it's image! Laundromats are forever changed in my mind now.
The flavor in the clam chowder was incredible! Huge chunks of clam meat! The turkey sandwich was also superb! We will definitely be coming back!

My wife and I went there for dinner on our anniversary and the food was fantastic! The staff were equally as good and the manager not only came out to find out how our meals were, but gave us a free desert because it was our anniversary!

I have to disagree with the review from the person from Alabama. As a member of the military and having been all over the world, Ive eaten seafood in some of the best places on the planet, and this place is good! Granted the food is not pulled right out of the ocean, brought in the back door and thrown on the stove, its still damn good!

You dont have to be from Alabama or any other state near the ocean to appreciate or know what good seafood is. Idahoans DO know what good seafood is!

Ive been to Lucky Fins three times and I have NEVER had a bad experience there.

If you like seafood and being treated well, I highly reccomend this place!

I came in on a Saturday morning at around 9:00, and they had their fair amount of steady traffic. Not thinking ahead, I walked in knowing that I had to get $60 worth of donuts to bring to work with me, which I didn't call in advance for. When I walked in, I was greeted with cheery smiles and welcomes from all of the staff, hard at work! They took my order with pleasant haste, as they could tell I was in a hurry. There were no exasperated looks or rolled eyes, (although I knew that I would be overwhelmed with an order this size) they just got right to work, giving me a bang for my buck, and not thinking twice! I had my order of five dozen donuts within 5 minutes, and I have got to say those were the best pastries I have EVER tasted. Everyone at my work was in obvious agreeance!
Great store and customer service.  The kitchen employees are so nice and friendly and working really hard to please you. The hot bar is amazing!

I chose Westside Body Works because they were one of several options State Farm recommended after a small traffic accident with my truck. They were able to begin work right away and kept me abreast of progress via text messages every few days. 

The damage from the accident was to the front of the vehicle on the driver's side. However, they also buffed out some dog scratches on my left rear passenger door and painted my rear wheel flares (which had been bleached black to grey from the sun) FREE OF CHARGE. I can honestly say that the truck is better now than it was before!

My experience with Westside Body Works couldn't have been better. Special thanks to Sharon and Ryan for their hard work! Much appreciated :-)

This is the worst Little Caesar's I have ever been too!!!! I ordered two items that were supposed to be Hot and Ready and I ended up waiting twenty minutes for my food. Everyone who works there is a Millennial they were all standing around talking and texting on their phones while the lines got backed up and the girl in the back was left alone to cook everything.

I'm new to Flyfishing so I decided with a friend to use Dreams on the fly for guide service. Best decision I have made. Andrew was our guide, he was absolutely great.This trip was my first to the Owyhee River and we caught lots of fish. I Caught about a 22" Brown, and the rest were 18 to 20". Andrew took us to a specific hole were you can see the fish in the water. Me and my friend took turns fishing it, ever 15 minutes or so we would catch a fish then we would switch, anther 10 minutes or catch another one one and so. It was my best fishing day so far and it was a blast. Andrew takes care of everything so all you have to focus on is fishing and he makes lunch. I highly recommend using Dreams on the fly for guide service especially going out to the Owyhee River with Andrew, I will definitely be using them again in the near future.

We have lived in Boise about a month and the amount of mistakes that RC Willey's employees have done are unbelievable.....It's been one thing after another.  When I walked out today, I headed straight for the door instead of shopping around like I originally intended.  The hassle of doing business here is not worth it for me.

Just moved to Idaho from out of state. I bought a whole-room living room set, and a dishwasher from RC Willey. Love these guys. They're nice on the sales floor, not pushy, but there to help. Their prices are a bit high, but just shop around for the best price, and then go to RCW and they'll match the price, plus throw in something extra sometimes. Their delivery program is outstanding for people like me who are slowly filling a house with furniture and appliances. The thing that I thought was really cool was all 3 purchases I made I got a hand-written thank-you card from each of the salesmen. Who does that anymore? That meant a lot to me, being from California where they don't even say thank you when you leave the store. Little things like that go a long way and keep my loyalty to a place that does it. Call it cheesy, I call it classy.
Exceptionally good food.  Fast, friendly service.  Definitely recommend Tango's for a great, cost effective meal.  We'll be back for sure.

If I could give 0 stars I would. We purchased a entertainment center and upon delivery there guys broke a part and tried to hide it, I quickly found this and called and they ordered a new piece, I asked for a delivery after 4 pm and got 5 phone calls from RC Wiley in one day. Seems no one knows what's going on. They wanted to come two hours early while I was still at work, I finally was able to get home a little early and they replaced the broken part but it just made things worse and now I can barely close the doors on my entertainment center. I have never seen such a bunch of incompetent group of people. I am just going to return the entertainment center  at this point and go elsewhere. Let's not even get started on the extremely long hold times to just talk to someone in customer service, overpriced, incompetent. I'm just returning the entertainment center for a refund now.
4 1/2 stars! Excellent food excellent service multi seating options- many gluten free options clearly marked. Big recommend!  Wish it was a bit quieter- but happy they r a successful place

Aspen Transitional Rehab facility is not the place you want to send loved one to recover.  The facility is marginal at best.  You need to stay on top of the nurses to be sure your loved one is getting the care they need.  They are friendly but do not pay attention to detail. The therapy staff was not what we were use to and not the best.  The CMA's are young, friendly and try to do a good job.  Beware, they have a hairdresser to supposedly meet the patients needs but seriously, don't have a clue on how to cut hair.  We would never recommend anyone to go there.

I had some comforters to wash and dry and was pleasantly surprised,driving by to a nearby competitor laundromat, that Rave is now open. Clean, smells great, dozens of new washers and dryers to use. Customer Service was great as I was approached upon entry looking at the machines trying to decode capacity and payment options (cash or debit/credit, 1$ fee for cards). One of the two ladies working showed me two options for machine size and walked me over to the payment kiosk and showed me how to purchase a card to use in the machines. She was genuine and helpful. Here are the prices: 0.39/7 min of drying time, small washers for 2 standard plastic laundry tubs of laundry (2 loads), $1.75, regular washers for 3 loads, $2.40, large washers for 6 loads, $4.15, and XL washers for 8 loads $5.10. I used the large washers for each of my king sized comforters. Came in near the end of the evening and the staff were cleaning machines and mopping the floors. 14 minutes drying completely dried my king size comforters. The washers and dryers can be registered to you cell phone when purchasing payment cards and will text you when each load is done. I highly recommend bringing your laundry here!

I was a walk in the day I moved to Idaho. I was lucky enough to get Tracy as my mail tech, and she is great!! I hate picking a color, I can never decide. So, I bring pictures and she nails it every time. She's clean, friendly & does great work!
Poor food and must have been a bad night. We tried it again with slightly better results. For such a great spot they are packed,but could be so much better. Disappointed.

This place is amazing, wonderful customer service m, great soup options and delicious. The sandwich was amazing and so was the Thai soup. The hardest part is deciding on what soup to get since there are over 15 fresh options served daily. If you are in the area this is a must try.

Our sandwiches were really good!  Thanksgiving and caprese.  Would definitely get both again. However, the seating is terrible. The chairs are small and cheap and felt like they would break at any minute.  The tables are crowded and I felt claustrophobic. Next time we will get our food to go!

I've been here several times and as far as it is for grocery a store, it's awesome!  This place is crazy on the weekends and has plenty to offer as far as grocery shopping or if you want to stop for lunch or dinner for that matter.  There's plenty to choose from, whether you want a salad, sushi, fried chicken, pizza...and the list goes on.  

My review is based off of my current visit here at the deli counter where you could choose from about six sandwiches or create your own sandwich.  Let me preference first; the service was great.  However, my sandwich was meh... bland and dry.  I ordered the Cubano, which had the typical ingredients of a Cuban sandwich (ham, pork, Swiss cheese, pickles and mustard) but also had salami on it too.  The salami, for me, was weird and didn't seem to go with the sandwich so I picked it off.  The pork was dry and the ham was tasteless.  So overall it wasn't that great of a sandwich, even when I added more mustard to it.   I ate about half of it and threw the rest away.
I got a deluxe gyro.  It was fresh and very good.  The staff was very pleasant and attentive.  Great place to grab something quick!

If I could give my experience at this store and with the store manager, Samantha, a negative number I would. Samantha treated me so poorly I am having to file a complaint against her. I was waiting in the outside line to get into the store with my mother and sister and I got out of the line to take a phone call from my husband and when I returned she immediately confronted me and told me I had to get to the back of the line. I was so surprised I immediately thought she thought I was cutting in line and that I didn't know the people I got in line with. When I explained that I was with my mother and sister she didn't want to hear anyone of it and asked me to go to the back of the line. Two people walked out of the store and so my mother let my sister and I go in and take the two spots. Then when I turned around Samantha was telling my mother she had to go to the back of the line in my place. I immediately asked what the problem was she said the customers in line were upset so I turned to the customers and asked if they minded if us three women went in to the store together and I explained the situation. None of the other people standing in line appeared upset or bothered by me stepping out of the line and then returning back and they all said they didn't mind at all. My mother then followed me back into the store and quickly bought something so as not to take up the extra space in the store and let more people in. When she left I was followed by an employee while I walked around and then a security guard entered the store and followed me around like I was a criminal. When I asked why he was following me around Samantha said that she called him because I was raising my voice at her and she felt I was a danger. I'm 5'2 on a good day! It was the most ridiculous and appalling experience I have ever encountered in a store. I was treated with such disrespect, I will never enter that store again. It's very sad to see someone taking their role of, "power," way too far! I'm waiting to hear back from Customer Service and will be explaining this whole experience to them.

Visited this restaurant for the first time today for their (very affordable) happy hour and thought it was great!

The calamari appetizer was almost creamy - not rubbery in the least - and the breading was light and crispy (I can't stand heavy, greasy fried food). My husband and I also split a couple sushi rolls and thought they were great. (I'm pregnant so we were only able to eat cooked fish rolls; I'm looking forward to trying their raw sushi when I can).

Service was fast and very friendly. Attentive, but not overbearing. 

The decor was a strange compromise of super hip and grandparent-friendly. There's a nautical theme going on, but it's unclear of whether they're going for a modern, eclectic sushi vibe, or an old-timey fisherman feel. 

Overall a very positive experience. Unless your dining experience is based on an establishment's light fixtures, you'll enjoy your visit.

Our experience here has been okay.  It just seems like this place has way too many kids with young teens teaching them with no person in charge and no real direction for kids advancing or reaching goals.  Today is their spring showcase and there is no owner here to even see how to goes or see how poorly organized/run it seems.  Way too many kids. The girls are in lines of 15 waiting forever for their turn to do something.  It just feels like this place is happy to take your money but no one has a genuine interest in if your child is advancing to the next skill/level.

I recently hired Walker Painting to paint the entire inside of my new home.  It looks stunning, with so many compliments!!  Walker Painting is a professional team with product knowledge and expertise.  You can count on them to follow-through, take pride in the job they do for the customer.  I had different colors, walls, trey ceilings etc., which required different paint sheens and levels of expertise.  It is so difficult to find quality, skilled, professional people in today's world.  So refreshing to have found Walker Painting.  Judy C

For such a large store, I received personalized service by the salesman, Calvin W. He was extremely knowledgeable and helpful. Didn't try to talk me into a selection. The cashier was also really polite and professional. I will be back again for future appliance purchases !!

We are traveling and this sounded interesting. It was great. We had nice
 cocktails - dirty martini, and cucumber basil, lobster stuffed avocado and calamari followed by 6 spice thai & lobster mac & cheese. Key lime tart that was a huge weWedge and excelkent.
We were so pleased and Hunter helped us with a little help for a lovely elderly couple.
So cool! Teresa is amazing. The guy at the front desk was super nice too. Very peaceful and calm vibe. Loved every second and felt very relaxed afterwards. Will definitely be coming here again!

Oh my goddddd. These are the best donuts I've ever had. The owner is so sweet & I'm beyond happy that I happened to notice this place while passing by. I will definitely be back! Definitely go give this place a try! You will not be disappointed!
Another good burger place after in n out, but this is my favorite chicken sandwhich place no doubt. They have the best fries with their fry sauce.

I just moved to the area and joined Axiom because my employer has a great deal for us with them.  I have only been in three times so far, but I have very few reasons not to give them a great review.  The staff is knowledgeable and courteous.   The trainer that I worked with, Dave, was awesome.
I like that you can enter an account into the equipment and follow your workouts.  Also, if you sign up for training sessions, you get a heart monitor.  Not a bad deal!
The gym is clean, however, the one thing I question is the use of community rags to clean the equipment.  I think I like paper towels better, but that is just me.

Delicious!!! This place is usually a bit busy but so worth the wait. Great food, good prices & awesome service. We had the kick in shrimp, calamari, dinner salad & tacos and it was all phenomenal & so fresh !

As always, incredible customer service. We've been coming to them for more than a decade & will never choose anywhere else. 

Fair pricing, excellent work. They won't cheat you or try to convince you to get work done that you don't need; have had many other places try to do this because I'm a woman & they presume I'll just agree to whatever they say. Heritage has never done this. 

If you're looking for an auto repair shop that will take care of you, Heritage is the place.

We have bought furniture and carpeting from R.C. Willey. When there is an issue, they take care of it quickly, and they follow through with promises. Thanks to David,Brad, Luis, and Edgar for their service.

Love, Love The EMPANADAS The Best In The Area .
Have tried other Empanadas at other places and their is no comparison, Can't wait till they Open their other location in Meridian anxiously awaiting for its opening !

Little Suggestion: How about making a Grande Empanada for those of us who can't get enough of your SABROSAS EMPANADAS ?

By far the WORST breakfast sandwich I've ever had. Went through the drive thru and it took forever. Dry bun. Burnt egg. Burnt microwaved bacon that was like beef jerky and it big clumps. Tasteless.  Had to toss it!
Still bad. My son went and got me a cherry milkshake tonight it was flavored with so much cherry syrup it was undrinkable. So. So. Gross. Do not recommend.

Love this new to Meridian location! The team at this location is friendly, helpful, and always working hard. This is one of the few Trader Joe's locations I've been to that has great parking :) As usual for a TJs, lots of delicious food options, specialty treats, and great gifts. They stock so many allergy friendly, vegan, gluten free, goodies, makes me happy. The great customer service here really makes it a pleasure to shop here.

I had high hopes for this place, but the service was horrible. Our waitress was non-existent. All we ordered was a sandwich / salad and it took them almost an hour to come out and tell us that they made it incorrectly (which is why it was taking so long). Either the server forgot to ring in our food, or there is a serious lack of cooking staff at this restaurant. Either way, we cancelled our order after an hour of waiting and left. I will not be coming back. Total waste of my time.

Called to do a to go order and they apparently didn't update their online menu as the person I talked with said they didn't offer several rolls I tried to order. Far less than impressed, update your website. Very disappointed.

I'm always good for a burger and I have had some good ones and some pretty bad ones. I even managed several " burger places " so I know a fresh burger when I bite into one.  My fav location for a burger is a drive from where we live and the are closed on Sunday's, so we decided to try this location. We visited the Franklin location when they first opened and it was okay so I was hesitant about going back.  Before pilling the " Griswolds" into the CRV, I checked the Smashburger menu online. First plus is that their website works and it's easy to follow. There are no tricks or misdirections. A second plus is that for my wife and daughter there  is  a customizable section and lastly they have kids meals.  So, we got into the CRV and went down the road to their Meridian location. No, we didn't lose Grandma on the way nor did we encounter hot models on the road, but we did encounter an empty Smashburger at 5pm on a Sunday.  Sometimes, an empty restaurant is a kiss of death, but we were determined to have a fresh burger on a Sunday, and not even an unarmed security guard who resembles John Candy would stop us.  The staff is very friendly and put with a lot of our questioning.  Soon after our inquisition of questions, the crowds came.  We were relieved just like that time when checked out of the Royal Imperial Windsor hot. I ordered the Bronco, the girls customized their burgers and my son ordered a kids meal. We ordered sides of sweet potatoes and onion shreds. ( there's a name for them but my " Rusty beret " must be affecting my mental capabilities. ). The girls ordered their burgers with spicy chipotle sauce and they assumed that the sauce on the side with the onion shreds was extra spicy chipotle so they added it to their burgers.  That sauce was not spicy chipotle but rather Smash's " Pedal " sauce. That comes complimentary with the side of onions. The pedal sauce was not to their liking and they didn't figure it out.  For me it wasn't bad but not my thing.  I deduced that it had horseradish. Well come back to later after seeing Big Ben and Parliament. Onto the burgers, they were hot, fresh, not frozen and juicy. Wow. Awesomeness. See the pictures. My only knock down was the green tomatoes used, otherwise it was perfect burger paradise. The Bronco has Bleu cheese, buffalo sauce bacon, lettuce and tomatoes on a egg bun.  The girls had chipotle bun with peeper jack cheese and the spicy chipotle sauce. The sweet potato fries are good but I erred like Clark at the French Bistro and I should have ordered the Smashfries!  Fries tossed with Olive Oil with Garlic and Rosemary.  I'll be the pig in the poke, Oink Oink next time and get the Smashfries!! The Milkshakes are like visiting WalleyWorld and you are the only ones there. Highly Recommended. Plenty of flavors to choose from. So back to the Pedal sauce. I asked one of the employees about the spicy chipotle sauce and the shift manager came by and explained all the saucy details.  The spicy chipotle does not have horseradish and does not come served on the side but rather on the burger itself. The sauce with the onion shreds( Haystack ) does have some horseradish.  The staff was very polite, accommodating, and knowledgable. Can't go wrong with Smashburger. Plenty of options and the burgers are fresh and tasty. Lastly, the prices are very reasonable.  Whether you are on vacation or looking to get out of a rut take a drive and visit your local Smashburger, it's a winner!
Chocolate Chip cookie was by far the best!!! It was super warm, moist, and soft after coming out of the oven!!!!

We recently had the worst experience here. We received an order that was not correct. We weren't angry at all. I mean mistakes happen and we are not the type of people to get upset over a mistake but when we called calmly and requested the error be made right (because that's what ANY good business would do) we were met with the most rude and arrogant attitude. I have never been treated so poorly. I have been a customer here since they opened and often recommended it to family and friends but to be treated in such a way I can't even believe it. We will not ever be returning even though they have a menu item we love and can only find here. I'm not sure if it's new management or just poor training but after attempting to resolve it nicely and receiving such a rude and combative response we will never give this establishment another dime. After our bad experience I checked to see if anyone else has received such poor service and found I'm not the only one. Check their Facebook page.

Renae (I hope I am spelling her name correctly.), was awesome. After 6 months trying to find someone that would do a great job to my expectations (cause I am very picky), she did an amazing job! She was courteous from the start, easy to have a conversation with, super fast with quality work, Knew exactly what I wanted as I was conversing to her about my previous experience. She said it was the longest she had spent on someones cuticles. ...She took care of me. She hit it on the nail! I will be going back with her for sure! She is badasss! 



My first actual review ever!......

I was here last month and thought I had reviewed them. 

Great doughnuts, nice selection, friendly service.  Drive through if you don't want to get out of your car.  

What more could you want?
They are the best! So caring and gentle with our pup. Plus, she always looks great when they are finished with. We love Sara and always ask for her.
Really helpful. He had my rainbow vacuum hose fixed in one minute flat and it was only 9$. I also appreciate that he did not try to sell me a different vacuum.

Had a nice dinner experience. We had chipotle salmon and the shrimp scampi pasta. Excellent fish and attentive service. We'll be back again. 

Cheers!

Fast and friendly service, they do try to up sell you and get you to buy bread sticks and other stuff. I got the $8, 3 meat pizza that was advertised as hot and ready. It was ready and almost too hot to eat. The pizza is a deal for 8 bucks, it was loaded with bacon, sausage and pepperoni. The cheese tasted like the real deal too, if it was fake cheese it sure fooled my taste buds.

Had to stop here to see if this would be my go to donut place and happy to say it is the place!  First of all this is a roomy shop with a few seating spots. It's very clean and easy to social distance. I have been looking for a cream filled donut similar to what I grew up on in Ohio. Sweet Sensations will fill the bars or bavarian donuts with your choice on request. I asked for a glazed bavarian with butter cream (raspberry, bavarian cream were other choices).  Then my husband got a blueberry cake donut and a cream filled donut topped with chocolate. The butter cream is thinned so it can be this creamy goodness when you bite into it. I found my Ohio donut (took me 30 yrs)!  This place will be our go to donut shop for that special treat at a reasonable price.  Lots of fun donuts for the kids. Donuts topped with gummies.. yesss!  Glad they are so close on Franklin near Linder. Handy next door is a Dutch Brothers coffee. Yummy and pleasantly surprised.
Greatly appreciate our Meridian Police Department. The few times that I've called to ask code enforcement related concerns, they were always responsive and helpful.

Best donuts around!!! Love that they wait to add any filling until you buy it so they don't get soggy.  Donuts are light and always fresh. I'm just glad I don't live closer to it because I'd go there way too often.

I called ahead of time and they were able to fit me in the same day (Wednesday afternoon) for both pedicure and fingernail polish.
Kim was very pleasant and so easy to talk to. 
The massage chair was amazing during my pedicure.
Kim works efficiently and the quality work is so good, I will definitely be returning.

First time at this location, nice clean and new while maintaining all the original flavors. When visiting Boise this is always a must stop. I come here for 3 things, the huckleberry burger, creamsicle soda, and the shakes! Will be back again when in town!

We had a really disappointing first experience with Smashburger via Doordash delivery today. Our order was delivered with a missing burger. Not to mention, everything was cold and the fries were cold and stale. When I called the restaurant to let them know about our missing BBQ burger, the female employee was quite rude and proceeded to argue with me explaining what was on the order from her end. I explained each item on our receipt and confirmed, again, that we were missing our BBQ burger. She continued to argue with me repeatedly cutting me off when I was speaking and was incredibly unprofessional throughout the entire conversation. She relayed that they were busy and that there was not a manager for me to speak with at the present moment. I gave her my phone number but I doubt I will be receiving a call back. There are so many amazing burger restaurants in Meridian, don't waste your time with this one. How terrible, especially during this pandemic, that we had to waste our money on Smashburger. This was supposed to be such a treat for our family that only turned into a disappointing experience.

Dr. ANDERSON, is uniquely trained in specialized Chir care and she is simply a phenomenal Healer. I highly recommend her to anyone facing spinal, neck, hip, knee, foot, hand or shoulders,  to achieve your expedient healing and new you

I thank the Lord for care of my entire family and I

Walker Painting... A trusted expert.

Craig Walker, the owner of Walker Painting, has done continued work for me over the past years.
 
I wanted to take the opportunity to share with others and recommend his services, since it can be difficult to find a skilled professional who does quality work, with expertise in different areas; and, who takes pride in his work with attention to detail.

Walker Painting is more than just painting... 

Craig and his team have refinished my kitchen cabinets and bathroom vanities, sanding them..'oh so baby fine'.  All of the different colors, techniques and finishes have made them look brand new.  They are experts in all of the cabinet refinishing techniques.  A friend of ours had them do their kitchen cabinets using the antique style.

They have painted my home's exterior, reviewing the scope of work and doing the walk through with me.  The prep is critical to an excellent paint job, the look and paint longevity.  One learns and sees the value very quickly.  Quality work makes everything feel like new and lasts.  

Walker Painting has completed the interior painting of my home.  Their expertise/knowledge of color and the best product material to use in each scenario makes such a difference.   Always explaining to ensure that, I, as the homeowner am informed.  

Walker Painting also does staining (decks, log cabins), commercial projects etc. 
 
Judy C - Sunnyvale, CA

Tried to contact them. All I received were computer generated "canned" responses. When I finally got a salesman named "Justin Tucker" via email, he was a rude, condescending smartass. Why I'm surprised I do not know, as he is a car salesman. I'll do business elsewhere!

I have dealt with process servers across the US, and these guys are hands down the best I have ever encountered. They are very professional and have great pricing. I highly recommend using this company for any of your process service needs.

Great looking bar.  Drinks and food were disgusting.  It's bar food so it shouldn't be hard to serve chips that aren't stale, or hot onion rings.  I had never been in before and have always wanted to stop in, now I wish I hadn't. The staff seemed like they had better things to do.  I sat there the whole time thinking what a great looking bar it was and then bewildered as to how the owners are just throwing it all away.  Sad.  Won't be back.

RC Willey deserves more than the two star average they currently have.  The huge selection alone is worth three stars, throw in the friendly, helpful and knowledgeable sales staff and I don't see any reason to not give them another star.  That said, they don't seem to keep stock on hand.  So whatever you buy, you gotta wait to get it... and we're Americans (which means we want things NOW!)... minus one star.  I did get a pretty sweet deal on the media center I was looking for, and I really didn't mind the two day wait to get it.
     I'd probably go back and shop there again if they had something I needed or wanted.  At the end of the day, I came to the conclusion that RC Willey is A-OK.

Great shopping experience!!! Store is clean and well organized. Service is great as is selection! They had ribeyes on sale and they were to die for! Flavorful and melt in your mouth tender. I like that you can sample many items before buying and the service is exceptional. Some prices are higher but I have found the wine on sale for great prices.

Can I give this a 10 star . This place was the bomb!!! I would drive to Idaho again just to eat here. Ha! My husband and I were starving, more like hangry! Long story short we ended up here as a second choice as the first one fell through with a two hour wait! We had a long drive and we're tired. So we found this online and went for it! So glad we did. We got there and it was packed and they were doing a big Christmas party too! Ended up only having to wait 45 mins, not bad for a Saturday night in a big city/ town. While we were waiting the manager passed out a sample of their appetizer, a crab stuffed mushroom, oh my freaking yum! He apologized for the wait and thanked us for our patience. It was beyond our expectations and was a great touch to amazing service we got the entire time we were there. They had a special the crab stuffed halibut with brocolini and risotto. Holy crap out of this world delicious!!! I think I could have stuffed my face with two of these dishes! My husband had the  blackened ribeye , fresh veggies and mashed potatoes. Holy crap good too!! The steak had such great flavors and tender. The veggies were so good and fresh! We also had out of this world bread pudding and a key lime pie! I had a wonderful bloody Mary with shrimp, crab legs, blue cheese stuffed olives. They gave me extra crab for waiting. It was freshly cooked too! The service and atmosphere was perfect! We left so super happy and keep talking about this place. Can't wait to have a chance to go back again! A must go to!!

One of my clients raved to me about this water. At the time, I was drinking water filtered through my Brita exclusively. I went to All About Water and bought the 3 gallon jug as its easier to carry.  The first time I tried the water here after bringing it home, the difference was immediate to us. It tasted so much more pure and clean. The Brita water only seemed to taste clean for a week, and the filtering would slow down too much, probably because of the hard water we have in Meridian. Now, I never buy store bottled water any more, as this water is a huge money saver at $1.35 for three gallons if you buy a prepaid card, or $1.50 at the outside coin operated water station. Highly recommend trying it!

Booked an appt with Macy to get hard gel on my nails. My first time to this salon. Macy is amazing and super sweet! She did an amazing job at being my nails back to life! She is forsure my new go to nail girl!

The curb is a sports bar. Not a bar and grill. Their social media page and promotions claim they have decent food. They do not. My Reuben took 45 minutes to arrive. When half the tables were empty.My wife, her parents and her sister had to wait even longer for burgers without buns, a roast beef sandwich and a quesadilla. The burgers were burnt to a crisp and each meal was pretty unsatisfactory. If you want a beer and a TV come here. Don't eat here, I'm currently prepping myself for the unavoidable food poisoning I'm about to experience. 

Abandon all hope (of edible food) ye who enter here.

I've been using Commercial Tire for all of my car maintenance  needs now for a couple years. They have always treated me fairly and like family. Customer service has always been above and beyond and I highly recommend them.
Very busy, very organized & overall, good service! I was able to make an appointment on a busy Saturday afternoon and was out within an hour for a manicure/pedicure service. Thank you!

One of the best sandwiches I've had in the Treasure Valley! I got the Holiday Turkey, which was to die for. My husband got the French dip - which was also a hit! Each sandwich was around $7, I think, so very affordable. Plenty big & super delicious, too!

Different vibes than most coffee shops in the area. The owner Jon has some hand tattoos so at first I thought the coffee was going to be tough but man it was smoother than a Kenny G on a Saturday afternoon .  Best coffee in Meridian.

Let me clarify, the cookies are a 5 star but now after my last two experience I couldn't give anything more then 3 stars (and that's being nice). The first time I called to simply ask if I had any options when ordering on line (could you mix or match) The girl who answered the phone seemed so inconvenienced with my call and snapped at me. Telling me that they only have one option when ordering on line. Tonight we placed an order for 3 boxes of cookies. When they arrived we could immediately smell cigarette smoke. When we got the cookies into the kitchen we noticed there was cigarette ash all over the boxes! I called them not wanting a refund or new cookies but simply too let the company know (I'd want to know if it was my company). This time the girl on the phone at least seemed happier. Sadly the only response that she could offer was, that they have no control over the driver.... ummm, you have your own driver and YOU (crumble) contact DOORDASH to deliver your orders when your own driver can't keep up. So I would think you'd like the feedback on how your cookies are showing up to your customers!?!

How to start as I have come here for years before it turned into garbage in the evenings. 

This use to be the locals place to hang out in meridian as it was originally a smoking bar. New owners have taken over and have done a decent job on picking the place up compared to what it was. The flooring is actually original from the 50s I believe which is always a fun fact. 

During the day this place is pretty quiet were some locals return for chats along with watching the games on TV. Not as busy as it use to be during the prior years. Pool tables, darts and music as normal along with a shuffle board table. Good beer and cocktail selection. 

The back patio has had a nice renovation done including fire pit and benches which need some sand and paint every year for upkeep. The outside also offers a place to smoke and grab some food from the food truck. Pretty good food actually. 

The evening...ok here we go...

This place gets way rough when there is a bunch of young kids hanging out. 21-25 is about right. Lots of new out of state trash come here now. Rude and disrespectful kids along with trash wearing females. If I was a parent I would be discussed to see my kids act this way. But that's society at its finest. There has been fights, guns pulled and police every weekend evening which detours a lot of good people going here in the evenings. As some of the crew try and keep up with security, I wish them luck. Restrooms, get overly full and smell pretty bad as people don't flush and/or pee on the floors. I believe the kids get way over served with to much alcohol in their system and they can't handle themselves in a respectful manner. 

I am been generous and giving this place a 2 now. (Should be a 2.5) Use to be a 4 and can be if they cleaned up the evening crowd.

This was actually easier than what I thought it would be. It's not often that you need to use an investigator but in this case I'm glad I did. Excellent service and quality work in a timely manner. They made a tough situation better then anything I could have imagined. 

Not only did I get the information I wanted. But a whole lot more that I didnt even think I could get on my own. Time and money well spent for certain. Well worth the money and time. If you need someone reliable and that can get the job done look no further. Call these guys today and get the answers you need.

This is a great place to get shades, blinds and window treatments. The service is excellent and the staff very friendly. 
I love our new blinds.

I wrote my first review too soon. And I really had to soak in the outcome of the second experience to decide how I felt about it. It took my 3.5lb toy yorkie 5.5 hours to be bathed and cut. I dropped him off at 1p. I did not leave with him until almost 6:30p. I feel that this is completely unacceptable service. There is absolutely no excuse to make this okay. I am so extremely disappointed. It threw off my entire day and, honestly, I never want to bring him back here. Never, at any groomer that I have taken my yorkie to, has it ever taken longer than two hours for a full service groom. Not only that, but he looks absolutely terrible. Nothing like the picture of a previous cut I had wanted for him. Sarah is a nice lady, but I am just so very very upset with the entire experience.

Just ate my first doughnut from this little shop- it was so light, fluffy, and just sweet enough! It wasn't cloying, but perfectly light and decadent. They were insanely busy for the location - kind of plunked in the middle of suburbia. I will definitely say these are the best in the Valley. We tried a bunch of mini doughnuts- and a couple regulars. My goodness, so yummy! I thought the maple bar was lucious, but not sickly sweet as maple bars can be. The itty bitty cream puffs are great- the custard inside is light and sweet. I thought the blueberry cake doughnut was super fruity and like a super yummy muffin. Mini apple fritters? Yes, please! Far superior glaze than the big chains, and not as overpowering as the places down the road. The filled doughnuts are called eclairs, and filled to order (I heard raspberry,  lemon, and custard ). Sausage rolls were really tasty, and a different type of pastry (I loved the mini, it helped with the sweet!). They did run out of a few kinds (they said they don't like to have them on the shelves for more than three hours, so they will make fresh ones all morning).  And, there isn't anything super fancy, but if you want a darn good doughnut, prepared correctly, this is the place to go!

I will be back.

During the weekend of 5/5/18, a Tru Green rep was walking through our subdivision (Copper Basin) trying to create new business/customers.  My husband and I were working in the garage when the rep (older woman, mid-50s, glasses, red hair) approached our driveway and asked if the tree next to the garage was ours.  I told her it was and what she wanted.  She dramatically put her clipboard over her head and said, "ew, your tree is covered in aphids and I don't want them to fall on my head." She then asked if we wanted a quote for tree and lawn service.
First, you make fun/criticize that we hadn't worked on our trees yet and then you want me to give you money??  I think not.  You may want to train your techs on how to close the deal and customer service 101 before sending them to represent your company.  I recommend Gary Vee or Tony Robbins for insight.  You can be sure I WON'T be recommending TruGreen and will discourage anyone who mentions they are thinking about using your "service".
Mandi is the best chiropractor in Idaho. She makes sure to provide the service you need, and makes sure that your appointment is made for you. Love this place!

I love Axiom gyms. They are all very clean. The equipment is new, and the staff are very knowledgeable and friendly. I generally use the Axiom in the village gym, but also go to the Meridian Axiom as well. I love the classes especially Shine, Body Combat,Body flow, and Zumba. The instructors are great!! Lots of fun.

I have ordered from them before. Once for delivery and twice for pick up. Great food and all but today when I ordered for delivery I was a bit disappointed in my mojo roll. There was no tuna, barely any salmon and hardly any avocado. There was a mixture in the roll with little salmon.

I have asked for extra avocado or tuna or salmon for no cream cheese. I said I'd pay extra if I have to. I've said this before and they have done it twice. Except for this time. 

Honestly I've been craving for sushi while I was working for a week and to get this made me frustrated. It's a pet peeve of mine when things like this happen.

Other than that. They do serve good food and their service is great. Just not this time
Great store. The associates are always super friendly and helpful. We only go to this location now.

It's been a long while since I was here and I was a dine in customer. The empanadas were good, but I couldn't get over the price of drinks. My fountain soda was a short cup. I really hope this has changed since, I don't feel I enjoyed the empanadas as much due to becoming thirty.
Great service. We were not attacked in the store by salesmen. Delivery was easy and well communicated.
They are the best! So caring and gentle with our pup. Plus, she always looks great when they are finished with her.
Just called to make an appointment and since I am a guy asking questions, the one on the phone decides to say she has a call and just hangs up on me..

My wife, my 10 year old daughter, and I are always searching for good places to eat in the Boise area. We prefer to stick to Meridian when we can though for several reasons.

We live in Meridian, so when possible, we like to support the area that we live in. Plus we just dont want to have to drive that far.

Steve's is fairly new to the Meridian area. This is our 2nd visit here. The 1st time, I did not write a review. I think our 1st visit was shortly after they opened up. I dont like to write reviews when places are new, because they are usually still trying to work the kinks out of their menu, find good staff and such.

I want to give them time to get all these things worked out before I give them a review so that it is fair.

Steves Cafe looks...well, it looks like a small cafe. Even though there are a few small signs, it is still easy to miss. Steves sits in a little strip mall close to Capitol Christian Center.

it stays pretty busy here, at least in the mornings. I have not had a chance to experience their lunch menu or see how busy it is for lunch.

There are a lot of Breakfast places in Boise and also in the Meridian area. I think one reason there are so many is that Breakfast is a pretty inexpensive menu, so as far as restaurants so, places that serve breakfast have a little better chance at staying in business.

Steves is clean. The highlight of the decor is a large mural on the upper wall. Whoever painted it, did a good job of painting over and hiding the unsightly air return.

On to the most important part, the food.

I had Biscuits and Gravy with a side of bacon. The gravy had way too much grease in it. It is possible to make a good, flavorful flour gravy without using grease from bacon or sausage.

When too much grease is used, like it this case, instead of the gravy being a Flour Gravy, it becomes Grease Gravy.

The biscuits were just ok. I don't think they were made from scratch. They were probably frozen biscuits.

My wife had a Bacon and cheese Omelet. On the plus side, there was a lot of crumbled up bacon in the omelet.

On the negative side. the eggs had no flavor at all. Its amazing what a little salt and pepper will do for food ! The eggs were overcooked, so they were rubbery.

My daughter had a kids pancake. Now I know that this is supposed to be a pancake for kids, but this was very small indeed.

Pancakes are one of, if not the least expensive items, on the breakfast menu to make. I think they could afford to make it a little larger and still make a good profit.

This was one of those meals that after I eat it, It weighs on my stomach like a ton of bricks. This is a tell tell sign that it was not a good meal and was nothing but grease. 

I could not help but notice the people at the table next to us. There was 2 people, probably in the 40s. They sat across from each other, but did not look up at each other the entire tine we were there. 

The reason you might ask.

They were both buried in their cell phones. Now I hate cell phones. I think there are a necessary evil. I use them because I have to and they do serve a purpose. But there has to be a line somewhere.

To bring them with you and do nothing but look at it the entire time you should be interacting with your spouse or mate at the table is just plain rude and sad.

Technology should be a tool for us to use. It should not be our masters. We need to learn to talk to each other in person again. 

Sorry, I had to throw that out there. I found this to be very very sad. Ok, back to Steves.

We wont be back here again. We will continue our search for a place that can make a really good breakfast that is made with Love, not Grease!
I Love RC Willey, delivery & setup included in price

I have been going here for years!  Tony and Gigi are great!  Watch out for Kim! 
She cares more for new clients than keeping her old ones I guess.  She was Rude, rough and down right nasty tonight.  6 out of 10 of my fingers were bleeding,  she blamed it on a new file.  He said she was sorry for "my talking Mean" and then passed me off.

We just moved to town and are staying in an Airbnb while we look for a house. Luckily, we found Rave Laundry early - such a nice, clean, and friendly place! The machines are all new and work great. I especially love the pre-loaded card system, which means no fussing with getting cash and buying coins to use in the machines. The attendants are super helpful and keep the place very clean; it smells fresh and airy (unlike some laundry places I have been that smell musty and humid). Love the free WiFi and flat screen TVs - Thank you!

No noise, smooth shifting... I don't remember it ever riding so well (Bogus Basin Around the Mountain was amazing). Full disclosure I had to wait to get it in, but they are busy because they are good. It's worth the wait. 

These guys also tuned up my sons 20" bike. I love that they took a lot of pride in working on a kids bike that looks like it's been to hell and back. Guess it beats working on a bike that's been collecting dust. Orange Giants XTC Jr.  thanks guys.

Have a routine with our kids that when we go to see the fountain in the village on a hot summer day, we get an ice cream from here and share. I love they incorporated sanitary gloves for when you use the machines to dispense the frozen yogurt. Not everyone uses them but at least they are available. Nice toppings like gummy bears and little bursting dots and best part above it all is the hard shell chocolate. We get one tub for an adult and two little ones. It's plenty!

Hubby was craving a shake and when we looked on Yelp the reviews were great for this local place.  On a Sunday afternoon the drive thru was empty and service was fast.  I ordered a medium cone and it was HUGE.  I have no idea how a large would fit on a cone.  The soft serve was fantastic.  My hubby ordered a chocolate shake which he thought was delicious.... great consistency and good chocolate flavor....... not overly sweet.  Highly recommend if you're craving soft serve or a shake!

Overall satisfied with everything they did to help. My initial consultation was with a different attorney than who settled my case but Dillon did a good job.  He gave good advice and acted quickly to answer questions I had. I'm still waiting to hear a few last minute details regarding insurance payment but overall very satisfied. I really felt confident with Dillon and crew.
I highly recommend Lake Appliance Repair and their tech, Chase. He was super nice and very professional, and fixed our dryer in no time.

Tried BarkWash today for the first time and was so impressed! My Australian shepherd got a full service bath and is so soft and clean. Although they were busy with the holidays coming up, and even though my dog can be quite active, they did such a great job! Much better value than a lot of the groomers in the area! Highly recommend.
Took my dad in for a haircut. The barber made his old baldish head look great! I definitely recommend this shop.

Love Fina and staff. I have been going here for 5+ years and every time I leave - my nails are gorgeous! I get so many compliments on my nails. The nail techs are very talented. Always great friendly service and delicious shakes!!! Even when super busy, they seem to get food out quickly.

I spotted this place out of the corner of my eye while passing through a parking lot.  Really jonesing for an ice cream cone, I stopped in.  They were very busy, which is always  a good sign.  I didn't realize, by the name alone, but they had lots of savory things on the menu as well.  Many were in there ordering food, but I had only one thing in mind... ice cream!  I came out with a hot fudge milkshake and yummy!  I was not disappointed... I'll be back to try other things on the menu and of course get another ice cream treat!

We love Gyro Shack! The food is always fresh and full of flavor! The meat is tender, the pita is puffy perfection, the taziki is divine, and the crinkle fries are a fun treat. We love how many convenient locations there are and how they are all consistently delicious.
Really yummy but also really expensive!! $.52/oz. (too pricey for us med students) we paid close to $18 for two bowls. Not worth it

It's the 27h of March, 2020... These are trying times in the United States. We are in the middle of a global pandemic and the Gyro Shack is alive and kicking providing excellent service and outstanding food to it's loyal and new customers alike. I have eaten at every Gyro Shack in the treasure valley and I can say that Magic View, Meridian is the place to go if you want some real greek food quick and in a hurry. I've eaten everything from the original gyro to the ultimate bowl and this is without a doubt the most culture and flavor you will ever see in a "fast food" restaurant. The quality of ingredients ranging from their fresh and juicy tomatoes to their bursting serrano peppers are on par with a five-star restaurant in Paris, France. The lemon pilaf rice in their bowls is warm, soft, and is an accent among the other rich flavors in a gyro. I highly recommend this original twist on greek food. There has never been an occasion where my order was wrong, the staff are friendly, helpful, and able to answer questions to new customers about the menu, and most importantly, they're timely and efficient in every single thing they do. If you work a day job I'd also tell you to try out the supreme breakfast gyro. It's delicious and filling as a morning meal. The Gyro Shack supports uber eats and door dash which is very convenient during our pandemic and they also fill catering orders for large parties (remember to save that info for a few months from now after social distancing requirements decrease). To sum it all up in a few words: Eat here. You can thank me later.
I'm really surprised to see any negative reviews. This gas station looks like a movie theater.  The staff and crew are amazing and they clean everything thoroughly.

This was a happy accident we found . The service was top notch! Are oders were spot on. The establishment was clean frei dly and inviting. The food was DELICIOUS

I brought in two dogs. One was easy to handle and he got cut just fine. The second dog they lied and told us he had fleas because he was a little harder to cut the way I wanted. This is a must on your Top Ten places to try!!!

This donut shop is the finest I have ever been to and their donuts are of the highest quality. My Father (bless his soul) had a donut shop for many years and I always thought his was the best till I went to Sweet Sensations! I don't know it they are closed because of the Covid 19, I pray they never close.

Win. Win. Win.

I've colored my hair blonde, brown, copper, and added some pink and violet on occasion and I'm always happy with the results. I've also gone from a short bob to long layers and am always pleased with the cut. Her prices are fair and she uses quality, eco-friendly products. I've referred several friends and they've always had good experiences as well. I highly recommend Celia!
