For those who may not know: 

-There are lockers for your valuables
-As mentioned, there are showers with all of your basic needs, shampoo, conditioner, etc
-They do provide cycle shoes that allow you to properly clip into the pedals, however they do sanitize them after each use
-Towels to wipe your sweat (because trust me, you will break a sweat) are also provided along with water and water bottles if you happen to have forgotten yours 

Cyclebar also runs various happy hour and wine Wednesday classes which sounded like a great girlfriends night out or date night if you want to change it up....talk about taking the "wine workout" to a whole new level. 

Before the intro class was even half way over I knew I'd be buying a package of rides. They have some great offers for First time riders, with the best offer being $99 for 10 rides ($10/ride). I will admit the rides become quite a bit more expensive after that, a single ride will set you back $23 but if you buy a package that's where you can save. The standard ride packages can also be shared within the same household, an added bonus. 

I look forward to my next ride, time to get my butt in gear.

I LOVE this restaurant! The lobster tator tots are to die for and so is the stuffed lobster avacado! And that's only the appetizers! My loaded Bloody Mary was also huge and it was all served to me in good time by Madison Majors who went above and beyond to make sure we had what we needed! The service and food are great!

I started out with a tub of cold water in an overly busy salon. They have plenty of chairs, but they clearly overbook. We waited about 30 min soaking until someone came to give an 8 min massage. The technician was nice enough, but was rushed and barely spent time with me. 

No offering of water even. Very disappointing. I will not return.
Zack is a great asset, very friendly and knowledgeable.  Got the Christmas Special, double meat.... huge!

My daughter and I went Christmas shopping for a friend. Our friend said she's never owned anything made by Brighton so we were really excited to get her her very first Brighton jewelry. My daughter and I had our masks on and entered the store. We were immediately approached by a store attendant. She had hand sanitizer in her hand and reached out to me. I told her no thank you. She told me if I didn't use the hand sanitizer I couldn't shop. She was very rude about it and had a dirty look on her face. I was so confused and uncomfortable. I told her I had just used some sanitizer and had used it a lot today. We keep sanitizer in every vehicle we own and use it regularly. She made my daughter and I leave. I told her that was okay that we would take our business elsewhere. I've bought a lot of Brighton jewelry and purses over the years and I will never be a Brighton customer again. I've never been to a business that forced me to use their product or I couldn't shop with them. I don't know what kind of sanitizer she wanted to force me to use. What if someone is allergic to something in the sanitizer? Beware of places like these that are overstepping. I do not recommend Brighton.

Absolutely favorite sandwich shop. The fries are heavenly, the bread selection is sublime, and the staff is absolutely incredible. They are always so friendly and willing to help, even through all the stress of the pandemic. I wish I could be as friendly and optimistic as them.
Support local, support small businesses, especially this one!!

One day my bestie and I came to this Alberton's Market Street on the hunt for some cookie mix. We couldn't find it so we asked for help and an associate named Heather was extremely rude to us. I think she was mad that we had the nerve to ask her for help while she was texting up a storm. She said "follow me i guess i'll just have to show you" After she showed us where the cookie mix was she would not stop telling us to buy the already made cookies from the bakery. She told us "you two look lazy to me, maybe you should get the already made cookies from our fresh bakery! it'll be way easier for you guys." and when we declined she insisted that we buy the already made cookies. I do not like Heather's vibe one bit and I will NOT be returning. Instead I will drive out of my way to go elsewhere. 10/10 do NOT recommend.

My first time at a Lush location! I asked a lot of questions that were answered by their knowledgeable staff. I look forward to using their products. 

Update : ok, even though the customer service was great, I had to downgrade my original rating because of the products. I went their specifically for their bar shampoo and conditioner, which I ended up buying along with a mask. 

After using the shampoo and conditioner a few times, I am disappointed in the quality of the product. The shampoo bar falls apart and you have to reshape it and hope it stays together. The conditioner melts away really quickly. I have both bars on their own soap holders so that they don't sit in water.  

I would buy the face mask again and the Shangra- la moisturizer but give up on the bar shampoo/ conditioner.

I used to love going to the Curb. The service was friendly, the food was great and the drinks came fast. But the last 5 times we have gone, it's gotten worse and worse and this last time was the cherry on top. 
We had one drink and an appetizer in the first hour. We couldn't get our waitress to stay long enough for us to order our meal? Maybe don't under-staff your girls on a Saturday night? The people across from us got up and left because of the service, or lack there of. 
We used to be regulars but we won't be coming back.

We are newer to the area and have been searching for "THE" donut shop. This is it. We've tried lots of different places. My kids like cute donuts but I like delicious donuts and in our experience, it's hard to find a place where you can find cute donuts that taste good too. 
I got a chocolate cake donut, a blueberry donut and a maple bar. YUM. My kids got the rainbow and m&m donuts and demolished them. 
We went to a fancy shop in Boise and my kids didn't even finish the donuts. They looked awesome there but lacked real flavor and were very stale.

These are the classic donuts I'm used to. 

The owner was SO nice! I mentioned that we had been looking for our new donut shop and she threw in a maple bar for us to try for free. She was super friendly and so sweet. 

We were able to eat inside (thank you!!!) and they had lots of napkins (like real ones, not the tissue paper ones lol) to help me clean up my messy kids. The inside was super clean. I also noticed the drive thru once I came in which we will definitely be utilizing in the future. 

All in all, great experience! Can't wait to come back here again soon!

Our kitchen aid dish washer broke, Damon came out to asset why it want working. He arrived on time, with mask and shoe slippers. I was grateful for that. He had to return when the part came in and fixed the dishwasher. When he worked, his area was clean he was respectful. All of this was done very fast. Definitely would recommend.

OMG!  What would we have done without Kerri Wattier at First Choice Mortgage?  Getting a mortgage on a second home while owning your own business is so difficult these days, but she never gave up on us.  This second home is to be our retirement home and means so much to us.  Kerri's efforts, diligence, attention to detail and her ability to help us work through the process were not only exemplary, but should stand as an example of excellent customer service to all mortgage brokers.  When we started to get discouraged, she would quickly move us past it and get us back on track.  Ours was certainly not an easy application to work through, but Kerri did not falter in her resolve to help us.  I truly don't believe that anyone could have done more for us than Kerri.  Again, what would we have done without her???
Food here is so delicious! Their fries are so tasty! Shakes are Häagen-Dazs ice cream. And the burgers and chicken sandwiches are perfection!
Went to purchase a washer that opens from left with hinges on the right- they had one and we met with one of their appliance people. He took us through the models and options and we bought one.
Yummy yummy yummy! Delicious fresh donuts.  Variety of flavors and great customer service...

Absolutely amazing food and service! Go there all the time, very nice family run business. Perfect wether you want a nice sit down or if you would like to get out quickly. Staff is very friendly. I would 100% recommend!

Cyclebar is more than a place to workout, it's a community. 

Whether your looking for a good sweat, a new friend, a community, or just to try something new, Cyclebar is for YOU! It's a high intensity cardio workout that feels like a party! The music is loud, the energy is high, and the instructors are the best!

Amenities- super clean! There are two restrooms and two showers which are convenient to get ready if your heading to work or happy hour after class! Fruit is provided but my personal favorites are WINE down Wednesday's and TACO Tuesdays! because #tacos 

Great for all LEVELS! If you're new to cycling or a pro, all are welcome! The room is dark and no one is paying attention to you because every one is too busy sweating it out themselves, so go at your own pace, learn the choreo, and keep proper form, but honestly just have a fun workout!

Called Polar because they were the last company to service the two A/C and Furnace units at our home prior to our purchase of the home in 2018. Both A/C units were working except 1 of 5 'zones' was not cooling. After attempting to troubleshoot the problem myself I ended up calling Polar as their sticker was on both A/C units from the previous owner's service.  I told the representative what the issue was (one zone not cooling) and a service date was set.  The technician arrived on time and was friendly but when he asked if I had any issues with the A/C units I was told Polar does not do 'zone' service...?  The technician seemed knowledgeable and did conduct 'annual' servicing (cleaning and diagnostic checks) of both units but determined a zone damper was most likely the issue but Polar does not repair them.  I paid the service fee but I had to call another  local heating and air conditioning company to set up yet another appointment to troubleshoot and repair the original issue.  If I had been told Polar does not conduct 'zone' troubleshooting/repairs (as I mentioned to the rep originally via email and phone) I would have just called another company.  Again- the tech was good and I think understood my dilemma but honestly after spending a few minutes to determine Polar couldn't help me I think should have just referred me to another company instead of conducting the service and leaving me with the problem that made me call them in the first place.

Worst place to go get a burger in Meridian.  The customer service is the establishment is terrible. An average hamburger with horrible customer service is a recipe for disaster. Stay way from this joint. .
Delicious! Fresh, pillowy donuts! Seriously we got a few different kinds and all of them were lights out!

We love RC Willey. We have purchased all of our furniture and appliances from them. The quality is great and the customer service is wonderful. I haven't had one problem. Their prices are very competitive too. Here is just a sampled the living room furniture. Still looks new.

This salon is super gorgeous! Kerstin Wood cut and styled my hair -- she did a wonderful job and was so friendly. She also offered me water or tea, and since my phone was almost dead when I arrived she even let me charge my phone while I was getting my hair cut! Definitely will be coming back here.

They best place i have been in a long time. I set up next to the bar and watched the wait staff as I enjoyed my drinks and Sushi which were both pefect. Who ever the manager of this place is should get a huge pat on the back, everyone working there gets along so amazingly,  they made the experience worth every penny and I will be back.

Wow.  We've done business with RC Willey a number of times before, but this time everyone just really went out of their way to make this a fabulous experience.  

And bless the delivery team!  Hubby and I are seniors with a number of physical problems.  We thought we had someone to come take away the old furniture, but they backed out at the last minute.   We were told the RC Willey guys would NOT be able to haul the old stuff out ... but the "boys" took the pieces out and put it in the back of hubby's pick-up truck.  What a relief that was!!   Major problem solved. Thanks, guys!!

Thanks for a seamless, wonderful experience RC Willey!

The best sandwich chain. Quality is fresh and great, service is friendly and fast, and also the best brownies! Super convenient that it is inside the wonderful Fast Eddy's, so you can grab a nice cold craft beer to pair with your sandwich.

Wow!! Can you say California Creamin from Mother Earth on nitro?? I stopped in there to check out this new Albertsons and noticed they had a bar. As I walked up I was greeted by almost every employee at the bar! I remember seeing smiles from ladies named Heather, Christina, Erin and there was more! I sat down and the bartender named Ali poured me an amazing drink she recommended she called the Ali Kat. It was so good! I noticed that Ali shook the shaker differently depending on the drink she was making. A sign of a true Proffessional! I looked through their food menu and ordered the poutine with brisket. A friendly gentleman with a huge smile delivered the food in good time and it was amazing! The fries were perfect, the brisket was generous and the taste was out of this world! One of the bar managers Angie came bye and asked me how I was doing. She offered if I needed anything, and after some of my questions educated me on her beers, wines and liquor! She was a ball of knowledge! That's when I discovered they had multiple beers on Nitro! I would say the one thing that stood out at Albertsons was the friendly employees. Traditionally I don't think about a drink at the grocery store, but this was a game changer for me!
Wait staff is awesome.  Food is pretty close to Skippers only way more pricey.   Place is very nice and great atmosphere.  Just wish they had better quality food.

My partner and I were driving from Boise to Nampa and needed a quick meal and drink. We ordered the sweet fire burger per recommendation from our bartender. I was so happy to leave Boise and stumble upon this fun bar. Keeton was so easy to talk to and had a great energy. The Bloody Mary she made might go down in history. We'll be back!

I think it's a good gym, nothing special but it's a solid situation. I had to cancel my membership due to personal reasons but  I feel like they may be able to keep more members on board if the front desk gave even 1/2 an effort to save cancelations. When I stated that I wanted to cancel my membership no one asked me why or if there was a way for them to keep my business they said "OK" and handed me a sheet of paper to sign (same thing my wife experienced 6mo earlier). That was that. Not a good business or customer service model if you looking to make money.

This is the one Chick-fil-A were whenever I go to they always fill my fries up halfway and not only me but my boyfriend also says that they never fill his fries up either. The food is always cold and the customer service always sucks here. The other Chick-fil-A near the Boise Towne Square mall is so good compared to this one, so if you have to choose one never go to this one because it always has the worst customer service and they never give you enough food and their chicken is always under cooked. After eating the chicken I went to the ER because of stomach pains, so if that doesn't urge you enough not to go to this establishment then I don't know what does. Like I said the other Chick-fil-A near the town square mall never messes anything up and has the best customer service ever, so I don't blame the food chain I just blame the owner of this restaurant since they are all individually owned. I even tried to reach out to corporate about this establishment on Eagle but they apparently couldn't care less about it and how horrible it is.

Have driven by this place for a while, and we decided to try it out. The friendly staff helped us the second we walked in, and treated us and our dog very kindly. The cleanliness and service is quite possibly unmatchable. We thoroughly enjoyed our entire experience, and even learned some tips about washing our dog! Our dog left being the cleanest that she ever has been! Definitely coming back!

This is the second time I ordered from WoW Bao, yesterday and today!!! I ordered through DoorDash.
I was craving for Siopao and this is the place I found at DoorDash.
1st order, I had the combo, teriyaki bwol and two bao.
I think the teriyaki bowl was a bit pricey for the size.
Bao's were delicios! I ordered the second time with just the 6 pack of Baos.... with flavors: Chicken Teriyaki and the Pork BBQ!!! 
I will definitely order again from this place....
Baos were freshly made and still warm when it arrived....

First time visiting  Blok & Co.  I ordered the  Vanilla Latte w/ Almond Milk.  OMG, hands down the best coffee in Boise.  I didn't even know it was possible to get such a creamy texture from Almond Milk.  I wish i lived closer so i could make it a daily event... will have to settle for regular visits.  Keep up the great work Blok!

PS.  While waiting for our coffee they brought us two slices of Banana Cream Pie on the house, very delicious.

Over priced poorly cooked food. Got a ham and cheese sandwich that was mushy like it had liquid on it and a blue cheese burger that was burnt. We ordered extra large waffle fries for $6.49 we thought they would be big enough to share we got 11 waffle fries. Very disappointed. For their prices I could have a much better meal elsewhere.

This was the very best attorney we have ever used!  They were very professional and, at the same time, very kind and helpful.  From the first contact until the last contact when our case closed, everyone in the office kept us informed and what was happening. Glenn, was VERY easy to talk to and also told me if I ever needed anything else to feel free to call him.  Our settlement was double what we thought it would be, which was a pleasant surprise.  I had been in an accident before, which I was not at fault for, and that attorney (a different attorney and company) kept after me about going to the doctor and physical therapy which I didn't need.  Come to find out, they were pushing me to do more because the more I went the more money they got! When that case was settled they got almost double what I received.  Not so with Glenn and Craig Swapp!   They don't get more than you do, AND, Glenn had me do whatever I needed and no more!  Again, they are EXCELLENT!  If I ever need anyone again, which I hope I never do...I will use Craig Swapp and Glenn again!

Their croissants! Wow! I had the Thai Chicken Curry soup and the number 7 which is a croissant sandwich with pastrami and bacon. It was delish. 
The jalapeño grilled cheese was excellent.
We got to sit down in the restaurant.
People need to eat here.

So my husband has this thing. No one can order the same thing at a restaurant. Weird I know but it's just a thing we do. We walked into Hugo's today and he ordered MY sandwich. The Santana. That's what I get for letting him order first. 

So I had to get Santana's sister: The Rachael. I mean ok, they are pretty similar but they are not. BUT come on, the Santana is grilled. That instantly moves it up a notch in my book. Hello...grilled marbled rye bread. Ok, so which sandwich are we talking about here??? Both I think. I'm confused too. The Rachael is corned beef, Swiss, coleslaw and mayo- served cold. The Santana is hot pastrami, provolone, thousand island, coleslaw and grilled. Yeah. Insert sigh for both. Maybe they will grill the Rachael for me. Hmmm...that could be a game changer. 

So go get one...or get both...and then let me know which one you prefer. And try their cheesecake. It's also fabulous.

I love the Market. The variety of foods. Especially the fruit section. I wish they had samples of everything in the store. The food court has so much yumminess to offer.  The meat section - wow! Their displays make my mouth water. The best time to go is early to mid morning...parking is easier bro find and less people in the store. Prices are a little higher but it's all good. Overall Albertsons Market is more of a 5+ star!

Claude and Charlie installed a new heat pump system in our 1974 home to make it more energy efficient and did a fabulous job!  Very easy to work with and showed up when they said they would.  We had some wiring issues so they had to come back a total of 3 times while we got that fixed and they never complained once about the extra trips.  Charlie also cleaned our air ducts which probably hadn't been cleaned in 10-15 years - great job!  I would definitely recommend this company.

This business was contracted by a warranty service to come out and conduct a repair on my refrigerator on Friday between 0800 and 1200.  Instead of keeping the appointment time, they called and told us that they only come out to my end of the valley once every two weeks.  The refrigerator is not operational.  At all.  And they want me to wait an additional two weeks to get someone to just look at it?!  Completely unacceptable.  What this company is saying is that someone who lives outside of the Boise/ Meridian area is not important enough to keep an appointment with period. Regardless of the need for repair in a reasonable amount of time.

To be clear, Lake rescheduled my appointment because they can't be bothered to come out to my end of the valley but once every two weeks. 

I'm understanding about staffing issues and sympathetic to them as well.  However, Lake would do well to not place blame on the customer for their shortages in manpower and look first to how they conduct business.  Don't lie to me or make excuses. 

Lake made a statement on Google Reviews that stated "It's unfortunate that people are not more understanding." This was a direct reference to our review. It was deeply offensive, especially since the central issue is NOT that they were dealing with manpower shortages due to employees getting sick (or not wanting to work, as is the common excuse out of employers who pay poorly and treat their employees poorly), but that you only visit this end of the valley EVERY TWO WEEKS!!!!!!!!!

This company has displayed a disgusting lack of integrity and ownership. Here's some advice for you... from a veteran... Take ownership... those who work for you and those who use your services will respect you because you show the character qualities that display the ability to take ownership and have integrity.

I will ENSURE that EVERYONE knows what kind of shoddy repair services this company offers. Full stop.

We moved from Denver to Nampa in June.  Back in March, our Realtor recommended that we work with RC Willey. 

We had several very positive interactions with Lamont Loveland (Appliances/Electronics) and Cathy Hendrickson (Furniture/Decorating) as we searched for needed furniture.  

Lamont spent several hours with us as we searched for a washer/dryer and refrigerator.  We ended up with three LG appliances.  

Lamont Loveland also provided excellent support after the first refrigerator was ruined by sediment in the Ice Maker/water line.    (In the new home, the builder's plumber should have flushed the line and the installers (ideally) could have also verified the line was clean.    Lamont and the RC Willey organization replaced the refrigerator after attempting to replace the clogged solenoids.   This was a blessing.   

Note: RC Willey went the extra mile (after the appliance repair firm determined the first refrigerator needed refurbished).  The first unit was swapped out within twenty four hours with a working refrigerator.  .            
 
Cathy Hendrickson helped us pick office Furniture and a downscale patio set (Our patio is tiny).   There were special orders involved in the sale.   Cathy coordinated the sale and delivery of the office furniture over a two month period. 

The patio set meets our needs.  And, the AspenHome office set (Made of Mangowood) is spectacular. Cathy provided a lot of decorating advice and was on the short list to help us finish furnishing the Great Room.  

As we discovered, there are a myriad of great furniture stores in Metro Boise.  After our experience with RC Willey,  we strongly recommend shopping RC Willey for your furniture and/or Appliance needs.

We are on the road and had laundry accumulated. So we searched for a laundromat near our motel and saw the positive reviews on this site and decided to go here. We are glad we went today. The machines are new and can handle a lot of clothes per load. What we thought were two loads were only one for the smallest machines. The place is clean and the staff are extremely helpful, patient, attentive and friendly.

I LOVE SMASHBURGER's hamburgers and Gluten free buns! Their hAmburgers and smash sauce are always DELISH! And their regular fríes are good, but I LOVE their sweet potato fries. My kids even love the gluten free buns for our hamburgers. Not dry and crumbly, but just yummy!!

Don't waste your time stopping by unless your on some gold star list. my husband has been by twice to buy and was ignored by the rude staff. Came in today ready to buy a mattress, salesman helped the customer in front of him and behind him. Never got back to him, never checked on him, and this was the SECOND time this happened! Unacceptable.

We have a very old Viking basic mechanical machine.  We had the tension mixed up, thick thread and just needed a basic stitch working.  Joseph was extremely honest and showed us how to use it correctly.  We bought the right thread and we're sewing again.  Wish we could have bought more to pay him for his awesome service.

Be careful the prices you see on your items is not what you're going to pay at the register, this has happened more than once to us that we caught. 
Please just check your items as they are being scanned. We actually love this market because they have everything but not to be over charged, it's frustrating because something that said $3.43 on the package ended up costing $7.78 and another item said $7.73 was scanned at $9.00. I really don't care to have to check my receipts every time we go to this Albertsons but I do now because of this happening so often. Not to mention their high prices anyway! But they are way higher than Win Co, Walmart, and Fred Myers for the same exact items. 
Disappointed!

Stopped in for a quick, simple lunch. I got a turkey sandwich and had to sample their fries. The bread was fresh and soft, the turkey had good flavor, and the veggies were fresh and crisp. The fries was great and the fry sauce had a pleasant, mild flavor.

Ordered 4 chocolate chip cookies for delivery. I ordered them to be delivered to my husband as a surprise midday treat between 2:30-3pm. I told my husband to be on the look out for a delivery he needed to sign for. By 3:10pm the cookies had not shown up. I called the store and they told me they would reach out to the driver and call me back. My husband then informed me the driver left a note on the door to pick up my delivery at the store. He never heard anyone knocking and our dog didn't bark as he usually does. And the driver didn't bother to call me to see if anyone was home, especially considering I paid a delivery fee!

I had to call the store back (they didn't reach back out) and asked them to deliver it to my work since my husband needed to leave the house. I finally received the cookies at about 4pm. Oh and they didn't include the note I had requested either. Go figure. I never received an apology and I'm pretty disappointed by the lack of customer service. Everyone just seemed confused.

As for the cookies, they were okay. Probably would have been better fresh and warm but who knows!


Edit: Crumbl reached out to me promptly and kindly with a voucher for a box of cookies and apologized for my previous experience. I really appreciate the prompt customer service and looking forward to trying some fresh cookies.

Oh. My. Goodness. 

Donuts are unbelievably good which makes up for the price (I think) however I've never paid so much for a donut in my life and assumed I never would again - then I tasted it. I've Been back several times and will continue to go back. The ladies are sweet and the donuts are delicious.

Atmosphere:

The atmosphere is large, but individual oriented. The gym has plenty of room to "stretch". Plenty of cardio machines, weights. Has a private women's weight room, which is nice! I always find the fitness classroom small. Some days there aren't enough room to attend a fitness class. 

Staff:

Upfront staff:
The staff is ALWAYS helpful at this location. I've had questions regarding vitamins, classes, and other questions regarding the gym in general.The gals up front always has the answer or goes and retrieves the answer. 

Personal Trainer:
I have a PT, Kelsey, she is such a delight to work with. She ensures she not only "coaches" but teaches you how to stay fit and get strong. She listens to the clients, and works around their needs. She ensures the individual is correctly conducting exercises. She is consistent with pushing you to the limit, but always accounts for your strength and weaknesses. She ensures the works outs are not stagnant. Overall, she is  one of the greatest PT's I've ever had. 

Classroom Fitness Instructors:
I've attended many different classes; with different instructors. The mass majority want to see you, the individual, succeed. The instructors strive to get to know each individual, especially when you become a regular. 


Prices:

The price is congruent to other gym memberships in the area. 


Location:
Meridian  



Parking / Venue: 
Plenty of parking! 






Star rating:
4 out of 5


More importantly Would we ever go back? 

Haha! Yes.

The absolute best part of my day is going to Cyclebar Meridian. I love how they get to know you, both the front desk gals and instructors. It truly is a community. 

Being new to the area, it was comforting to have been accepted right away by everyone at Cyclebar. I've been to other brands of spin classes before and never have I felt so welcomed and supported. You're not just a customer here, you're part of the family. The classes are fantastic and have a wide variety of times, instructors, and types of classes. I can't recommend a Cyclebar Meridian enough!

I ran out of gas at Ustick just east of Meridian. I was stuck in the bike lane until a couple young men pushed me around the corner. A Meridian police officer stopped to make sure I was ok and pushed me further out of the road. He was extremely nice and helpful. I really appreciated his help and concern for my safety. Thank you Meridian police!

Me and my bf have ordered from here so many times I love it!!!! The bao in bbq pork, sweet baby Jesus it's to die for do definitely recommend!!! One thing I do have to say because I am only giving it 4 stars is because of the the portion sizes are kinda small for how pricey it is but the food is great so it's worth it! Will be ordering again in the future!!

Awesome service! After setting my phone in a nearly empty juice glass my speaker wouldn't work. They checked for water damage and saw there was none- then cleaned the sticky residue off my speaker in less than 5 minutes and didn't try to sell my a new one that I didn't need. I definitely would recommend their services for your iPhone repair needs!
Breanah did such a good massage! I felt so much better after. She worked on areas I didn't even know were tense. Loved her!

I really enjoy and like the new people who took over soup kettle. I feel they are much more accommodating and much friendlier and are willing to do a much better job than the previous owners. They are extremely nice and accommodating which the previous owners weren't. The previous owners had a aura about them that they felt that they were superior To everyone. The new owners are so nice and will go out of their way to do any and everything they can to make their patrons happy. They are the pure American dream and put forth so much hard work but I definitely appreciate

Corey and his team were amazing and made this process seamless and pain free! We had a contingent purchase and they worked with everyone involved and we even closed a day early! It made our move to Idaho so much easier and I can't say enough about the excellent communication skills of the staff there. I would highly recommend them!

This new "restaurant" is cooking and delivering out of the Sizzler restaurant on Eagle Road. There is no dining in or carrying out (yet). Ordering is only through delivery companies like DoorDash and UberEats, which have their own problems and fees. We thought we'd try them with ordering from Uber Eats and having a couple combo meals with baos and dumplings. Each combo was $15.98 and the dumplings were $5.99, expensive for lunch. First combo: Kung Pao spicy chicken with Mongolian beef and teriyaki chicken baos, and a teriyaki chicken with bbq Berkshire Pork baos, and an order of ginger-chicken dumplings (potstickers). Well, the pork ones were by far the best and most flavorful. The chicken and beef baos were at best tolerable. Picture teriyaki chicken or innocuously spiced beef whizzed in a food processor and then piped into a wheat donut-like bun. Absolutely no texture and no flavor except spice and soy sauce. The dumplings were no better than and looked exactly like the ones you can get in Costco's freezer section. The "Chinese" food was really pretty pathetic. The portions were small and the only way we could tell the difference between the teriyaki chicken and Kung Pao chicken were the peanuts scattered on top. Neither dish had any discernible chunks of chicken or vegetables, just a very heavy dose of soy sauce and red chili flakes, and a few slices of green onion which I just noticed. As for the delivery, the service charge PLUS the delivery charge PLUS tip was $21, and that was before the food charges! Overall, this was a highly disappointing lunch for nearly $60. Hubby liked the pork buns and wanted me to give them an extra star just because they're different. Ok, but I'm 100% positive we can get frozen bao at either Costco or one of the Asian markets in town which will be just as good and cheaper, AND any of the teriyaki shops or Chinese restaurants in town have better food. So there you have it, a pretty comprehensive review. This is a new operation and I wish them well, but I don't believe we'll order from them again if I have to pay $20+ before the food costs.

They open at 8am Monday-Friday which is super helpful.  
I remember when post offices and banks didn't open until 9am or even 10am during the week, so I appreciate this.  The downer though on opening early is the staffing - there was only 1 person working the counter with a line of about 8 people, so the wait was significant.  The counter staff here is always helpful and knowledgeable and make it really easy to get your packages going in the most efficient way

This store is always clean and everything is labeled right, if you can't find something people are always happy to help. All the employees are extremely kind but I have to say Zach S. is seriously the best. I always come in late at night and he makes my night. Super great guy and a great store!

We brought our german shepherd, chow here. For starters, I'll say, he is one hairy boy! and we were very happy when we got him back. He looked beautiful, smelled amazing and didn't look completely traumatized :]

This I believe is a brand new location so it's very clean and nice. They were great at communicating too, I couldn't pick him until my son woke up from his nap and they had no issues with that. When we did pick him up it looked like he came from his own glass room, not a small cage like you see in other places.

It only cost us $90 as well which is pretty great for a big dog with a lot of hair and a terrible undercoat that they had to brush out. I'd highly recommend this place!

A group of us ladies went for bottomless mimosas and it was the WORST experience our group of friends have had at any mimosa brunch on a Sunday morning. We didn't ask for much, we were not intoxicated, we were not loud or disruptive. The waitress was so concerned about turning tables she delivered the check before our meal was finished and after our second mimosa she never returned to our table. We even asked 4 times for a 3rd mimosa and it never came. We proceeded to speak with the manager and 15 min later we still had no refill. The staff literally stood at the hostess station and glared at us until we left. We were there for an hour and 17 minutes, it's not like the 6 of us sat there for 3 hours sipping a $3 up of bottomless coffee. All 6 of us paid $19 each for bottomless mimosas. With food and drinks the 6 of us spent $350 to dine at this restaurant and for our $350 we had empty glasses and about 5 staff members glare at us until we were finally uncomfortable enough to leave. We will not be hosting our monthly mimosa brunch at this establishment, it was absolutely awful. The worst part about the whole experience was the fact the manager herself couldn't even gain enough control of her own staff to get us our drinks. How sad it is that a manager doesn't have enough authority to convince her own staff to provide some level of customer service...just wow.

Jerry worked hard for us to get our PMI removed and was able to get us an unbelievable interest rate last year when we refinanced. We got refi estimates from two other mortgage lenders in Meridian and Jerry's numbers beat them - both interest rate and closing costs. That's the golden ticket right there.

Excellent food, friendly accurate staff!! Love the grilled nuggets. Peach shakes in summer, and peppermint in winter. Incredible service today when I accidently left my mother's order at the curbside pickup. Telephoned and reached the manager, who remembered my order and they had it ready when I returned. Wonderful, example why we Love this location of Chick-fil-a.

We were out visiting the Village in Meridian and decided to check out this upscale version of Albertsons. I would liken it to a Whole Foods competitor. They have a food court and promote their cheeses, sushi, hot bar, and bakery by putting out samples throughout the day. I was super impressed with their much better sample selection compared to the similar Albertsons on Broadway in Boise. They had samples of spaghetti sauce, cheese, sushi, poke, pizza and baked goods. They had a beer special going on in their Talon Tap & Spirits pub. We chatted with the bar manager and since they did not have the special beer on tap she gave us an alternate pint for $3 vs. the normal $5. That was cool. Then she mentioned we could walk around the store with our beer and just drop the glasses off back at the bar or at customer service on the way out. This Albertsons also has an interesting skillet bar where you can pick up skillet type meals (think something like Bertolli skillet meal) and a seafood bar with Poke, and ceviche.

Richard was absolutely fantastic. On time, professional and personal. The entire experience with Lake Appliance Repair was seamless. They worked with me to get the part and schedule an appointment that was convenient for my wife and I. Highly recommend them.
Fridge is fine, tricky water dispenser until you get used to it. Store is large but nothing is usually in stock.  Salespeople are fine but limited knowledge.

I've been having my dogs groomed by Sabrina for over 10 years. I've followed her to 2 different businesses. When we moved across town, I switched groomers which was a big mistake. I now drive significantly out of my way to have her groom my dog. She is professional but kind. Fetching Furs is extremely busy which shows how much "in demand " their services are. All of the groomers are great but Sabrina is special to us.

Their online order tracking is painful, meaning you must call in to the store to track a ship to store order. If you order online for ship to store, you get zero useful feedback of your order tracking except "shipped", then if you use their "track order function", you have no way to click on the order and track? Sierra is part of the TJmax portfolio of companies and I hope they can upgrade their ship to store process to be more like REI. 
I have to say the associates at the store were very helpful in tracking down and holding my ship to store order. 
I do feel  the layout of the Meridian store is a bit random.
Finally, I have gotten good deals here so I'm going with 4 stars.

Just moved to the area, am 26wk pregnant and decided to go with OGA based on my insurance network as well as a other preliminary research.

I was very pleased upon arrival of how nice and new the facility is.


The staff were very friendly, even when my three year old was having a major meltdown.

My provider was also great, very patient with my toddler in the room and as far as a meet and greet very personable and interested in my history and how the current pregnancy was going. 

At this point, very pleased with choosing this clinic.

I do not recommend supporting this business.  My husband and I were regulars at this laundromat. Our last experience was awful. The young woman that was working didn't want to be there. I sent an email to management to address how we were treated and nothing!  Zero communication. I value business that value their customers. We'll never go to Rave again because of this.
Best place for soups and sandwiches. Great staff and the quality of the soup is awesome. They even let you try the ones you want before ordering.chighly recommend!

This is the cleanest laundromat I have ever been to. Just relocated to Boise and needed to wash everything that was packed. Was so glad I chose Rave! Misty was so helpful and went out of her way to show me how the system works.

What are all the bad reviews about!? This place is great! It's only 5 bucks an hour, which is about 3x less than Defy Extreme Airsports (Circustrix) in Nampa! The space is limited for open gym, because they have gymnastics gear set up, but as long as you don't go past the blue fence, you're great! It's great for kids who just want to run around, or for teen parkourists and freeruners trying to perfect their skills! It's also great for people who do Martial Arts Tricking and/or flips, because they have a big padded floor in the middle of the gym, as well as a tumbling tramp and two regular tramps that lead into a foam pit! There isn't anything to fuss about unless you are opinionated!

I can't help but feeling like I'm getting hooked up, every time I go to this location. I'm not going to give away all their secrets, but I've gone in a few times over the years when I need tire-related repairs - punctures, flats, etc. They've been able to do the work promptly, cheerfully, and there was a time where they couldn't get the tire immediately but found a very creative solution that worked out great. Today I visited for two punctures, which required a piece of specialized equipment for my weird rims, which they have there. Zack did me a solid and I was in and out in no time, with a replacement for a dead TPMS sensor and a rotation, for a price you wouldn't believe.
I don't know why I've never gone here for actual tires - maybe because I don't live close - but you bet I am from now on!
Good stuff guys, keep it up!

Big, Beautiful Park!
Kleiner Park has something for everyone -- from Jogging/Walking Paths to Children's Playgrounds, from Disc Golf to Bocce Ball and Basketball, from Fishing to large Pavilions and more!  The location is great, right next to The Village at Meridian.  I also like the slow-speed, one-way traffic route that circles through the park, thus allowing you to get close to your desired area without carrying all your stuff for a long distance.  The small hills add a feeling of expansive space while the fountains in the ponds keep the water looking fresh.  I rate this park as a local treasure.

My husband and I stopped in for an ice cream cone and peanut fudge parfait. Went to sit down  
And the kid gave my husband his order so we went and sat down. a family of four walked in and ordered then sat down. Another four people walked in and in mean time I am still waiting for my peanut fudge parfait. They ordered sat down. First family got their order , I am still waiting.  Second family got their order. I proceed to the register and asked the guy if he had forgot about my order so he goes and checks then the manager comes out to make it and I proceeded to  tell them that  I just  want my money back she voids the debit card payment and not even we are so sorry for the mess up or anything.  Long story short.  I WILL NOT BE BACK EVER. VERY POOR CUSTOMER SERVICE.
I called for a spur of the moment pedicure and they got me right in. The salon is quiet and the people are friendly!   I appreciated that it's a peaceful salon and not super busy and loud.
This bar is killing it! Great service, good food..... BUT they do put ice in the mimosas and that's a little strange. But other then that, Killer!
Great place to shop but the website has many more items than the store does.  The summer tent sale is great though.

Arcades, bowling, mini golf, go karts... so much to choose from at wahooz.
Open all year long with inside and outside activities. They increased the activities inside the past 2 years like the ropes and climbing wall.
This place is really fun for kids and adults. They offer day passes (some between $25 and over $50 for unlimited). The prices of the individual rides are in our opinion expensive and you really need to spend time there to make the pass worth it. The prices of the arcades are unfortunately really expensive too, but there is so much to pick from!
The laser tags portion is pretty small but quite fun. The go karts are opened during winter as well (we tried after some snow) and the rocky laps are really enjoyable!! 
The water park, opened only during summer, is really fun too! The place get busy really fast!!

I thought I made good cookies...my friends do too...but NO ONE will want my cookies after they taste the ones from CRUMBL!!!  And I don't blame them... these cookies are warm, perfect texture, huge - I've never had better!  My favorite so far is the cinnamon roll cookie, but the chocolate chip is a close runner up.  Go..  NOW!
The best fast food customer service in the game. In N Out comes in a close second but this place takes the gold.

Kathy Chambers is such an amazing person and Insurance Agent. She will go out of her way to help you with your insurance or just life in general. She is such a strong example and presence in the Meridian/Boise area.

OMG. 
Celia just cut my hair! I feel like I've made a pal! She got me and my sister in super spontaneous and last minute. She was so kind, hip, and super nice! NOT only that, but this is literally the best cut I've ever had!!! Totally worth every single penny. Book her! She's the bomb.com

Steve's is great place and you will not regret going there.  The service is great, the food is great, and the kitchen is clean. 
I read some the recent reviews and one - in particular - seems like the person who wrote it, was a few beers short of a six pack, if you know what mean.

Cutest haircut ever on our toy poodle, Alfie. He looks years younger and smells so good! It was our first time here with groomer, Karen. We will definitely be back. Thank you for doing such an amazing job!

just now

Delicious cookies!! They were super friendly and fast. I also had an experience chatting with someone online from this company and they were also so nice. I would recommend the lucky charm and midnight mint both are amazing. We split a cookie between my family of 5 & we all felt satisfied.

I would give him no stars if I could. I would rather eat a cup of noodles than eat at this restaurant. The manager was incredibly unprofessional and rude to his customers. I highly encourage no one to eat here.

Okay I'm going to start of by saying my expectations were not too high for the Curb. I kind of expected Applebee's/TGIF style food. It's not - I was very wrong! This place rocks and let me tell you why!!! 

I was craving a hot sandwich  and wanted to pick somewhere close to my husband's office so he didn't have to drive too far (He'd go anywhere for me, bless this heart). The Curb is conveniently located right off northbound Meridian Road so I scoured their menu and thought, why not give 'em a shot. My review is solely based on the food since I ordered takeout and didn't even pick up the order myself. 

After mentally deliberating for some time I chose the Southwest Turkey Club (roasted turkey, brown sugar bacon, cheddar and pepperjack cheese, roasted jalapeno, lettuce, tomato, onion, and chipotle mayo, $14.00) with a side of fries. I was very happy with the takeout service. The call was only 56 seconds long and I wondered if the person even heard my order right. 30 minutes later...

My husband walks through the door with my dinner and wooooooah it smelled dope. I almost forgot to thank him I was so stoked. I split the meal with him but honestly I could have eaten it all by myself. It was so freaking delicious! The bacon added so much flavor, and the chipotle mayo was like the icing on the cake. All the ingredients meshed so well together. One of the best hot sandwiches I've had in Boise. And I eat A LOT of hot sandwiches! Overall, wonderful dish I would definitely recommend this to anyone trying to decide! I mean just look at my picture! Yeah I'm no photographer but look at all those tasty ingredients and how beautifully they stack together! 

Overall I had an awesome dinner! GREAT FOOD! I'm looking forward to dining in one day! Thanks for the great experience! :)

Post Office supervisors take note!! This is the worst local post office I have ever dealt with. I'm not talking about how I'm treated at the office, I'm talking about how these folks don't deliver mail correctly, can't use common sense and couldn't care less about whether the mail gets to its destination or not. For instance, when I submitted address changes to this post office for home and business it was a nightmare. They held my mail for weeks without giving me a clue. I submitted all requests online correctly but it turned into a fiasco. I also regularly get mail that belongs to others both at my office and when my residence was in Meridian. I had an item I ordered delivered supposedly to the wrong address (per their tracking system) which caused me to have to buy it again and I couldn't get my money back for the first one which mysteriously showed up weeks later in my box. I hate that my office is still in this post office district and have no trust that my mail actually gets to me, or that it gets out of this post office correctly. Supervisors- please retrain your employees or hire ones who are competent.

I'm going with 4 stars here because I was totally on the hunt for good chicken fajitas and they delivered. Juicy and tender. Are they perfect? No, chips are artificial and need salt. Salsa is ok, depending on the day and who makes it. I loved their rice, just basic, but so good! Servers were nice but I think they might need to add one more person. They recently painted inside, it looks good, bathrooms were clean. I didn't initially have high hopes for this place, but we will definitely be back.

Celia has been my hair stylist for about 3 years and I couldn't be happier with her. She has always listened to what my concerns were and had a solution for them! She uses quality products and is always on time, and comes with the knowledge that is only gained from 14 years if experience. And she's a blast to chat with!

This place is sooo much fun. My favorite is the bumper boats, we just laughed and laughed and laughed. There is not a single thing to complain about here. The laser tag was the ultimate fun time. Bowling was interesting since I was the worst at it. The food was hot and fresh and we wish we wish we ordered more of it. The arcade was bright fun and so much to choose from. Mini golf was cool! But those go karts. That was the best. We pre bought tickets and didn't know there was an upgrade charge for one of the children, but they were very accommodating. Fantastic customer service. I can't wait to go back.
I highly recommend this property management company. The staff was a pleasure to work with; they were courteous, professional, and communicated with me very well.

Terrible place, go to the Starbucks in Fredmeyer.... Always a wait because they usually can't give the customer the right drink or food. Just go to the one inside Fredmeyer it's faster and more efficient than the one near McDonalds....

I love Albertsons.
This Albertsons I do not.
I stepped into the men's room during my shopping experience and immediately left the store.
 I'll never go back there to buy food again!

PHENOMENAL DONUTS - CLEAN STORE

These are the best donuts on this side of the valley. They are soft, made fresh every day, not super oily and you don't feel guilty after eating three. Something they do is fill donuts fresh with the filling so the filled donut is not all soggy and squishy sitting there with the filling. I have tried the bavarian filling with chocolate and it is a great balance. Donut hole variety is a must have. They have filled donut holes which I have never seen before! There is also a glazed donut with a zig zag cream cinnamon icing that is a definite must try. It is family owned and they are very friendly. The store is clean but a bit sterile feeling.

It was our first time and it was very good. Hubby and I both got combo plates. I got chicken enchilada and a Chile Relleno add beef and hubby got chicken chimichanga and a Chile relleno add beef. They didn't charge us for the extra beef which was very kind and goes A LONG way in our eyes (and tummy ). We got our little girl a cheese quesadilla and that was really good! $3.50 for a quesadilla, rice and beans. Our food was super good too. I am picky with rice and they have really good rice. The chicken was super yummy. I wasn't too big of a fan of the egg on the relleno but the chimichanga was really good too. 

At first our service kind of started off on a wrong foot as she seemed to really rush us when ordering and basically walked away as my husband was finishing his order but our food was correct and she was good the rest of the time. 

We even got a little dessert when we were done. Don't mind the photo of it half eaten  it was super yummy.

We came two nights in a row around 9:30pm to get milkshakes. The first night we came they said the ice cream machine was broken. We were upset but thought  we would just come again tonight. We have a friend that is an employee and so we asked her if the machine was down and she said no. We got in line and waited about 8 minutes before we got up to order. Right when we ordered, the employee heard in his ear that "we are no longer serving desserts." This was at 9:45pm. As we were leaving the drive through, the cars ahead of us were handed milkshakes out the window. We called to make sure it was a broken ice cream machine and not them wanting to turn their machine off early so they could go home. When we brought this up, she said "our machine is being finicky so you would have had to wait a while to get your milkshake." They never gave us that option, making sure that they could close the store and not have to work late to give us shakes because it "takes too long." The manager told us that she could give us free desserts but when we said that we had 7 people in the car she said that she could only give us 3 free desserts. Super annoying, a waste of time, and a terrible call on the managers part (August 6, 2020). 

Normally I wouldn't let one bad experience ruin my feelings about a company, but we came two nights in a row around the same time and the machine suddenly didn't work anymore right as they are soon to close. The didn't say the machine was broken, the just said no more desserts. It just isn't professional.

I just got into snowboarding last year and decided to stop by and ask questions. Braxton was great and helped bring me up to speed on the different types of boards I should consider.  I decided on the Burton Paramount board.  The price was right and the board was perfect!  Today, I went in to get some information on snowboarding boots and helmets. Once again, I was set up with the perfect equipment and now I'm ready for the 2020-21 winter season!  You can always count on Great customer service at Idaho Mountain touring!  Don't forget to check out Grant's Neighborhood Grill in the same parking lot!

To Cody S...I happened to be there yesterday when your wife came in!  She was told that they could fix her nails in 15 minutes.  She said "thank you", turned and walked out.  If anything your wife was rude!

Sassy Nails is the BEST place to have nails done...good job, nice, and very reasonable!

This is a very nice place. Very clean and comfortable. There is a reason that people go to laundry places. Because they dont have alot of money and when u double your prices after the first month it's more of a hate and switch then anything.

Totally sucked, when We got there it said our order was ready by the tracker, However they said it wasn't ,the store cleared out so we asked for our order and the person helping us didn't even know it was sitting on the shelf, Which was the same person that said it wasn't ready yet Food was cold. Pay for extra ranch didn't get it. We won't return.

Started my order before 10:30. The new employee didn't know how to work the computer system, and by the time we finished ordering it was after 10:30. They would not let us finish our breakfast order because it was 10:32. 

Won't be back.
A great little place with the kindest staff. My work is not far from here so I come by from time to time and the food is always delicious!
Excellent Customer Service. Straight forward and helpful. Thank you Frank Hines for making our mattress shopping easy. Kudos!
Clean and safe and no bums or weird ass hole looking steel your girls dirty panys and quarters  tv with wi fi 5 stars

Not the curb it used to be. I'm not sure when it happened (first time there in a while, suggested it to a group of fellow students) but they decided to go fancy. Menu is overpriced and the happy hour from 3-6 is drinks only, and really no deals on those. My $1 off beer was supposed to be $6, then after tax went to $7.40ish (6%??), and then they added the sneaky 20% gratuity for a group of 8. You never actually get to see a receipt as you pay on hand held devices from the waitress. Oh and the first waitress we had seemed to be in a bad mood and acted like every question we had was annoying. Thee second one was a little more helpful. Overall, 2 stars because their tortilla chips on the $12 nachos was good, still not worth more than $8 though. Won't return and neither will the extended group of students. Too bad

Self service dog wash was 'not open' and requires a reservation.  I've never seen a reservation requirement for a self service dog wash.  Store seemed like it could have some cute stuff but I needed to wash my dog and moved on to a facility that was open.
Really enjoy this restaurant!!!  Staff is amazingly, and wow, what a great menu.  Huge thanks for Lucky Fin!!!

I had never had an empanada before visiting Tango's and I must say they are delicious! My family and I ordered several different ones and the traditional beef one and spinach week my favorite! Very cheap and filling!
We went there the other day and ordered what else CHICKEN!!  This is a great place if you want fast food.  Love the service and food tastes great.  Chick Fil A Sauce Rocks!!!

My parents asked me to post this review for them, as they have no computer. They wanted to express their thanks to Lucas and Devon, who were very patient and pleasant with them today.  They both went the extra mile to make sure that each room's carpet was cleaned to my parents' satisfaction before moving on to the next room, and charged only what they had been quoted on the estimate.  My parents really appreciated that.  They were very happy with the final result, and plan to use Stanley Steemer again, should the need arise. Thank you Lucas and Devon!

Being Argentine myself since i was Born, i found this place lacking and disappointing compared to Real Argentine Food. I only gave it a 2 star rating, only because they are trying, not to hard, but they are trying... At least there is that place in Caldwell that is tasty and is run by Real Argentine Folks that know what Real Argentine Food is. Too bad the closest Real Sit Down Argentine Restaruant is in Salt Lake, but they are not as good as the one in Las Vegas, and they are not as good as the dozens in Los Angeles, and they are not as good at the ones in Miami, and none of these are as good as Real Argentine food in Argentina...

Waited 15min for my food while the staff joked around with each other only to find out my food had been sitting in the window for 10min. No one wearing masks or gloves and touching their faces the entire time. Not a fan and will not be back.

Trugteen Specialist was supposed to provide a free weed application to kill the weeds that weren't killed by prior applications.  Technician states the he knocked on the door at 8:00 am and no one answered.  My son was seated next to the front door with 1 of our dog.  Neither my son nor the dog heard a knock.  The technician was supposed to spray out entire property and only sprayed 800 soft of our 20000 sqft yard.  He made no attempt to access our backyard where the biggest problem exists.  Instead of doing his job he left a note telling us how he couldn't perform a totally different item that wasn't a priority.  This attitude of we the homeowner are stupid is unacceptable.  I will do myself a huge favor and use Zamzows for all of my yard care needs.  Do yourself a favor and do the same.

I wanted it to be good...but expectedly I was very disappointed with these gyros. I have been spoiled...and I know it, and because of it all other gyros will never live up to their true potential. But really, these gyros were worse than all others I have had in boise even. Any other joint is a step up from gyro shack so take the drive downtown and have at it....but what ever you do save yourself the trouble and look elsewhere.

My fiancé and I opted for the 60 minute couples' massage and it was absolutely worth it. I usually find myself looking forward to the massage being over because I don't do awesome having my knots rubbed out, but that was not the case here. I loved every single minute of our massage (especially the hot stone part!!) and was genuinely bummed out when it was all done! We both walked away feeling absolutely incredible for a very reasonable cost. We're definitely gonna be coming back here for all future massages!

Watch out for their subscription system!
Very easy to  sign in and expensive and cumbersome to cancel.
I was on vacation in Boise and bought 4 classes for $ 59 dollars. It ended up costing  me $ 177 dollars as they had an autorenewal clause and when I tried to cancel they told me that I had to give 30 days notice.

Ended having to pay 3 months instead of 1. Also consider that it is easy to sign up in their website but not to cancel. You have to call and write an email too cancel.

Plenty of Spinning Studios that offer a similar experience without the billing hustle!

Don't recommend it and be aware of all their not consumer friendly policies.

Nice clean place and the groomers are great. My dog loves going there. He comes back with a nice shiny coat, nails trimmed and smelling great. They also use an anti shedding shampoo that helps to control the shedding.

2 hrs for delivery and pizza arrived cold. not warm, cold. Thought it was a fluke so ordered again a month later and after waiting 35 minutes watching the tracker show no activity I called and they said it would take another 1.5 hours for delivery. pizza wasn't even started yet. I cancelled my order. Use to be one of my favorite places but even order pick up the pizza has not been good quality.

I just moved to the area and was looking for a great nail place, well, I found it! 
Been in twice so far, they do a great job and mostly friendly. Small shop by nice decor. Good ambience. 
Nails look great and are done quickly. No lifting or breaks. I have wished for more colors to be offered or to have the paint on the plastic nail samples but hopefully in time. It is hard to choose from the wall of regular nail color, Not what I am used to, but it won't stop me.

I redid my review and gave it a lower score because I have been constantly bombarded with text messages and emails from RAVE wanting me to review this location. Well, I did already on Yelp. 
I would recommend to never put in your information when you sign up for the card. Other than that, it's a great place to do your laundry. But if you're on a tight budget, I suggest going elsewhere.

Our A/C and Furnace were 40 years old and would break down whenever it would be over 100 degrees for the last 4 years.  It's not a good feeling knowing when it is super hot we will not have any air-conditioning.  Dan and the crew installed the furnace, A/C, return air vent, water heater, and electronic air filter in less than one day.  They were amazing, communicated well, and did an awesome job!!  I would hire them back in a heartbeat and I tell all my friends and family about their great work and fantastic equipment.  I am living in a clean filtrated house with amazingly cold air!!  Thank you again!!

FRAUD BEWARE. This company seems to LACK HONESTY AND INTEGRITY.  Our three year old $547 Maytag washing machine was no longer spinning the clothes dry. The warranty was for a ten-year period for the drive motor and wash basket. We looked online and watch a guy show how to change the hub. I figured it was worth seeing if it's covered under warranty before I tackle it myself. So we called Maytag and they said they would send out a tech and as long as it was covered in the warranty we would owe nothing. If it wasn't we'd have to pay $125 service call fee. I figured the drive motor and wash basket was a majority of the washers components. Matt B. the Lake Appliance Repair tech came out and told us we needed to change the gearbox (not covered under warranty) and the wash basket (covered under warranty).  The total bill for just our portion was going to be $589. I wasn't interested since the washer didn't even cost that much. He was very persistent and told us that we'd be lucky to find a washer or even parts right now do the shortages. I felt like he was selling us a condo share. We paid $125 service fee and ordered the part online for the hub which cost $8.95. I put the hub in myself which took about 30 minutes and it wasn't hard. The old hub did have broken splines on the inside. The washer works fine and spins just like it supposed to. I strongly felt like this company was trying to take advantage of us. We wasted $125  for Lake Appliance to come out and tell us we need to change a bunch of parts that clearly didn't need to be changed for a washer that wasn't even worth the repairs.

All they want to do is sell, sell, sell! I bit on a lawn care and pest service, prepaid and then had to cancel the pest contract because a previous contract was not finished (another company). 16 days later I still have not received my $260.26 back on the canceled contract. I cannot reach local office, just corporate, and they have a different lie each time I call, total of 6 now. They never respond to me- no calls or email with confirmation of anything.  Business practices are totally unethical and bordering on scamming. I would never recommend this company even if my lawn looks like a golf course at the end of the summer- yeah right. I do believe I might have to get an attorney involved...  bad dog!

Super knowledgeable tech. On time and friendly. Respectful of masking and distancing. 
5 stars

So, Boise and Argentina have a lot in common. To start with, you can get some great 
Empanadas in both. Okay, that's all I got.

Why not try something different for lunch? You can only eat a sandwhich or a burger so many times before you decide to leap from a moving car. Might I suggest Tangos? Even if you are an empanada master chef,  you'll be delighted with the choices and flavors available here, and all for less than what you'd pay for a Big Mac value meal. 

They manage to put choices for just about everything inside an empanada. Carnivore? Check. Vegetarian? No problem. Pescatarian? Yep. Sugar addict? Of course, but get some help.

I highly recommend the Gaucho. Sure it's traditional ground beef with egg and green olives, but they make a great one here. It's lightly sweet and a whole lotta savory, just like your Argentine grandma used to make. Just pretend you had an Argentine grandma.

The empanada crust here is a little different. A bit crispier on the outermost crust. It works, and everything I had was great.

They have some really solid lunch specials. 2 empanadas and fries for less than $8! Or 1 with fries for less than $6. Plus, they are nice people. Go and enjoy!

THE AMERICAN DREAM!!! I use to work with the owner at a local retail store when he was talking about his idea to start his own restaurant... many years later, and now he opened a second restaurant in nampa this week. GOOD FOOD! GOOD PEOPLE! FAIR PRICE!

Great experience with Corey Newell and his team.  Everything went smooth, two different types of loans explained and differences between them were explained.  Did our signing mobile from CA and sent off without any issues.  Closing came ahead of time and since we were ready it all came together great.  They made sure we had everything and on time by good prepping.  Thanks again!

Went to the drive threw and the guy on the microphone was very polite even tho I kept changing my mind on my order. The girl at the window was very courteous as well. Started to eat my meal and everything was put together super well! My 3 supreme crunchy tacos were evenly filled topped to bottom so every bite was delicious and the steak quesadilla was the same. Nice tight wrap on the tacos so nothing was spilled out when opened. Also looking in the window the inside of the store was very clean and looked well kept. I.E. no trash on the floor or counters. So which ever crew was working at around 6:30pm on 10-16-20 should be recognized!! Great job.

This was my first time visiting the Earl. I am very impressed. Top to bottom. Let's start the bun, the bread, the two pieces that top and bottom the sandwich. They're toasty, toasted to perfection. Then we got the special sauce. Delicious. By the way, I got the Earl, which is apparently the #1. It's the like Big Mac to McDonalds. The turkey. Yum. Ono. Delicious. My first bite sent an savory feeling in my mouth. I'm satisfied. Bacon, tomato, lettuce. So basic, but so perfect. The edges cut so nicely. Whoever made this sand which was an artist. An artist for the Earl. Amazing. Will be back.

Best Fish and Chips!!! The people that work here are some of the best in the Valley! I have eaten here around 20 times and will always be a costumer. Covid has caused some changes in how we all dine out but if you are looking for a great meal and even better service go to the Meridian Lucky Fins!

I liked it so much I came back two days in a row. Very good quality for fast food. Fresh ingredients, tasty meat, soft and warm pita bread. Good fries too. The second day I came in there was only one employee working north the drive in and the counter. Still got me my food relatively fast. I hope we can stop extending unemployment benefits so people have a reason to go back to work and restaurants like this one can get the help they need.

Do not see Vickey Schmadeka. Vickey would not massage me. She would not listen to my needs. I came here, in dire need of relief. I had some simple accommodations. I was assured Vicky was great and there was no problem. however, when I arrive, Vicky barely read my intake form. Vicky refused to listen to my needs and was dogmatic about her way or the highway. So I left. I have been a massage therapist for 10 years. it is not difficult to accommodate clients in need. Why she refused to do this is beyond me. Perhaps racist or just lazy.. I am appalled Vickey would ever be in a service industry that requires openness, kindness and listening skills. Instead, this is where chronic pain sufferers get ignored and allowed to leave a treatment, then listening to the client! unacceptable!!!

Came here to attend my annual wahoo tuna fishing trip. They refused to let me enter with my fishing poles, and requested I leave them my smartcar! It took approximately 15 minutes to get them out alone and putting them back took at least 30 minutes, and I almost broke my expensive Walmart rod. After I reentered I found there was in fact no tuna or any live fish anywhere in the premises! Only rambunctious adolescences!

Found my own go-to-OASIS doughnut shop!!!  

Dropped in for 3 doughnuts and walked out with MUCH more... including  mental notes for the NEXT visit.  =)    Doughnut holes MELT in your mouth!!  Not sure if it's standard practice, but my LEMON filled doughnut wasn't filled till I ordered it... soooooo much YUMMY filling!!  Surprised my son-in-law with several of his favorites; which included a very yummy looking apple fritter... he's sooo mad at me. HaHaHaHa

The Shop is clean, quaint and accommodates 2-3 tables, so don't be surprised if you're taking your treats-to-go.  Didn't realize there was a drive-thru until I was inside... LOL, might be the better way to go if you don't have control!  I can only assume the lady assisting me was the owner, in any case, she was very kind & helpful.

BEST HOT CHOCOLATE EVER ... seriously!!  Please NEVER EVER change your recipe!!!!!  =)
Showed up on time, Fred was very personable. Had a great conversation and got a great haircut, all in 20 min. I told him. I'LL BE BACK, Thanks Fred.

Taco Bell, we are breaking up. You know why. Everyone knows why. I could put up with you when I was younger but I'm too old for your shit and I'm done with your repeated lies. You'll never see me ever again. I mean it this time.

I haven't been to the shoppe but received a box of cookies as a gift. What an excellent presentation, adorable packaging & the cookies look amazing. It's a shame the flavor doesn't compare to homemade.

Advanced Heating and Cooling IS AS GOOD AS IT GETS!!!  I recently moved to Idaho and assumed that a newer home would have been properly maintained...NOT!  Fortunately the heater waited until the end of the snow and cold weather to stop working.  My realtor recommended Advanced Heating and Cooling.  I called them at 9:00 AM and their technician, Alex, arrived at 10:00!  He promptly set out on his troubleshooting plan, found the problem to be a dirty pressure sensing line, cleared it and proceeded with cleaning a very dirty furnace, performing a 25 point Gas Safety Check, and restoring the heater to perfect operation!  Alex really knows his stuff!  This is truly an honest company that achieves superior customer service.  I have contracted with them for annual heating and AC servicing.  Kudos to Alex and Advanced Heating and Cooling for a job well done!

Nope, not the place for a French dip sandwich.  The roll needs a hard exterior and no hot mustard made available.  Still trying to find a decent French Dip not some totally misaligned thing that bears no resemblance to a French dip.  

There out to be a law against advertising a French dip unless it actually has the right ingredients - sort of like bubbly wine can only be called Champagne if it comes from that region of France or like mezcal can only be called Tequila if it is grown and processed in Tequila, Mexico.

Truth in advertising is badly needed in this Idaho food marketplace.

Save yourself a headache and go to DeMeyer instead, which is right next door.  We purchased a few items at RCW and one item wasn't in stock.  We were told the item was "on a truck on the way to Utah" and that it would arrive at the end of March. Come May, still no bed.  Obviously they lied and the item was never on a truck. The rep I spoke with said it could be on a container somewhere.  Please be honest upfront. I would have preferred to have purchased only items that were in stock. I spoke with our salesman who said he didn't care what  we wanted to do and would refund my money.  He said I had to come in to the store to get a refund. I then call customer service and the rep said she would refund it over the phone and that we did not need to go in. She was the most helpful overall. Sure, I got my money back, but now my daughter has mismatched furniture.

What a nice little family run place.  You can try the hot soups before you order.  I tried the Gouda Grilled Cheese it was delicious...Ooey gooey and those yummy crunchy bits of cheese around the edges. I tried the Buffalo chicken soup and Potato Leek both were great.  Buffalo chicken had the perfect spice level.  Potato Leek was creamy and delicious but didn't feel overly heavy.  Quick and friendly service.

Maija is outstanding and it is no mistake that all of the reviews here are 5 stars.

We worked with Maija for our engagement photos and our wedding and my wife and I are blown away by her work.  Maija was very creative with our sessions and she was great at getting real and candid looking shots even though we are far from experienced in front of the camera.  Maija really took the time to get to know us and she was great a listening and filing away small things that we would say.  My wife and I put a lot of effort into doing a lot of the decorations in our wedding ourselves and Maija made sure to get really cool shots of the work that we did and she just picked that up from our conversations.

Maija was very prepared with ideas of where and what to shoot, but she was outstanding at going with the flow and getting truly natural photos.  We had high winds during our pre-wedding photos and she was fantastic at making it fun and getting photos that look outstanding even if we were about to blow away.

We had a lot of fun working with Maija and we could not be happier with her and we cannot recommend her enough to anyone looking for a great photographer.

Contacted hq about bad experience and was offered gift certificates to give them another try. I went inside this time to order to see what they did and how they made it etc.   The service was good. The chef even talked to me about he took pride in making the food exactly how the customer wanted it.  My wife loved her original with pepperonis instead of onions and I loved my original with this time fresh fries.  I tried a Philly cheese also since I love a good Philly.  It was a little bizarre. I wouldn't order it again but it was on me for trying it.  I really only needed one but my eyes where bigger then my stomach having been to busy to eat lunch.
