It's good for what it is... a fast gyro.  I would ask for the meat to be done extra crispy next time to give it more of an authentic taste and feel. They loaded it with good tomatoes this time and the tzatziki (spelling?) was good.  I'd go again but not later in the evening. I'd say 3.5 good but not insanely amazing. Decent and I'd go again as an option.
Exceptional sandwiches and salad wraps. Used to eat here a lot when we lived in California. Great to see them here now.  Now, if we could just get In and Out to step up.

We ordered through DoorDash for dinner. We could not decide what to have for dinner and this place offers a variety of selections. 

We got sushi, Chicken Wings, Cheesy fries, Trip tip, Noodles, Sweet n sour pork, dumplings, and General Tso Chicken!! 

Overallg the taste was alright. We did not like the Sushi. I like the sweet and sour pork. The dumplings were a little hard or maybe needed a little more cooking. The noodles was bland.

My microwave stopped working when I replaced the light bulb and since I had a good experience with Lake Appliance Repair a couple years ago I knew who to call. The visit was scheduled within a week for a four hour period. Lake had an app that let me know where I was scheduled during that period so I knew just about when to expect Chase, my technician. He arrived right when expected with a face covering and was knowledgeable and professional. He tracked the problem to a blown fuse and had the replacement with him. Wife is happy and so am I. Good company with with good people! Thank you.

Such a cute eclectic place. I went there with my lil fambam. My lil one got the chocolate croissant, the hubs got the cinnamon roll and I decided on the sticky bun. The pasties were very tasty! The owner was sweet and very nice. We will definitely be going back again.

Three stars based on the a rooftop patio.  

I would give 1 star for service. We had several times where these gals made eye contact, we motioned we needed service and would be completely ignored.  At one point we grabbed one of the gals to order and she basically said it wasn't her job.  We weren't in her section. When asking what their seasonal beers were our server said "We have a lot! What are you looking?"  Pretty obvious we were looking for a list! Also the cocktails are very weak, several times had to order an extra shot to make the drink a drink.

I went to this taco bell for breakfast since my early experience at a different location was not very favorable. Wow what a different experience. The young man working this breakfast shift was absolutely awesome. What a great help and customer service he gave me. Very fast and efficient service. thumbs up to this location for breakfast

Great atmosphere, plenty of game and good drinks. Becca and Dallas are great bar tenders. We just moved to the area and already feel at home. Best service I've seen in a long time. Couldn't rave enough about this place.

I'm so impressed with this store. Visiting my sister here in Idaho we do need one of theses in Tennessee! Customer service is off the chain! The options offered are are unbelievable from in store dining to prepared food you can't go wrong. Lots of options on multiple brands of groceries.
Love this place, really health food--fast. But I worried they might have closed the location.
The restaurant was clean and family friendly.  The kids loved the seafood...although the sushi was not the best.   Overall I would recommend eating here for the environment:-).

This store is massive! Loads of fresh produce and  baked goods . The widest variety of food in any grocery  store I've ever seen! Not much going on here in meridian Idaho but if there is , this must be the place!

Friendly service and the grooming was clean overall. 
Only reason I gave 4 stars is due to the price . 7lb chihuahua was 65$ for a haircut and that's without tip. She didn't leave with any bow ties in her hair or a cute bandanna . For the hefty price you'd think they'd add a cute finishing touch. 
Might return , might shop around for a better price .

This isn't just an ordinary Grocery Store! People are at a bar drinking, there's a cheese deli, butcher shop, bakery, premade meals. It's huge and if you need it, they have it. It's also PACKED. You don't go here for a quick run in for milk, this is an experience.

This is not "just a grocery store".  This raises the bar for all other grocery stores, all over the USA.  It's HUGE, mildly overwhelming, and has just as many good quick service counters as it does high end ingredients/meats/etc. 

From Lobster to Snake River Farms Beef, to plenty of things I haven't even discovered yet, but I'm sure are here, this place is a giant gourmet playground, and that doesn't even start to include the hot food counters.  The BBQ is the best I've ever had in a grocery store- and in the top 10 of all places I've tried (and I've tried a lot)- go with the BBQ pountine fries.  Great Sandwich counter-  (get a cuban, split it with someone you like.)

They even sell Mexican Coke, and have a great popcorn counter.  You could probably spend an entire afternoon in this place, and while you'd spend money, you probably wouldn't leave hungry.

Dr. Jessop and his staff have been fantastic! My wife, Mother-in-law, my son, and I have all received treatments from him. Every time, the service is great, staff is friendly, and he has solved our back problems. Thanks guys!

In the midst of this weird pandemic of a world we are living in my dear wife totally deserved some sushi for mother's day. So called around and luck would have it that Lucky Fins was taking to go orders! 

With nothing figured out for mother's day I placed the order (thru Yelp of coarse), and surprised her with an amazing lunch she had been craving for nearly a year due to pregnancy. It was a big hit... delicious...and made me a hero.

Good on you Lucky Fins...you totally saved my bacon this year!

Many know Wahooz as a great place for a kid's birthday party or to simply occupy the kiddos for an afternoon. 

And it is! 

It most definitely is that.

But, I'm here to tell ya, it's a pretty awesome place for the young at heart as well.

One time, I was there with three friends (all adults) and after a game of miniature golf and some fun go-cart racing, we decided to give laser tag a whirl. It was later in the evening on a weeknight, so there weren't many kids running around. Laser tag ended up being my friends and I on one team and four people we didn't know on the other (also adults).

It was like the universe conspired to bring together eight of the most ridiculously competitive humans who each possessed zero concerns with looking foolish. It was like Charlie's Angels meets Mission Impossible meets a Barney Stinson-esque laser tag battle. There were sneak attacks, battle cries, and coordinated offensives. It was the most epic laser tag battle of my life. The sort of game that even though we were all earnestly and competitively trying to win, by the end everyone was a winner because we all had so much fun.

That's what I told the other team when we won, anyway.

Aside from miniature golf, laser tag, and go-carts, they have bumper boats, bowling, video games, jungle gyms, and more. Oh, plus a restaurant inside for when you need to refuel (pizza, ice cream, etc). 

The prices are what one would expect (ie: not cheap). But, overall worth the fun (with the right laser tag opponents). 

Get to it!
Went here for a quick dinner and ice cream.  The kids raved about their food and my husband and I thoroughly enjoyed our burgers.  Great prices and ice cream!

I'm writing this review to give the Meridian Police Department and the Ada County Sheriff Department, particularly Deputy Hunter, an outstanding review for their help with a matter this evening. We really appreciate your mediation in a sensitive situation that could have turned into a legal, very expensive court matter, but with their voluntary assistance, they retrieved our property from a previous associate. Overall, we couldn't be happier with their services this evening. Thank you so much!

We are traveling across the country and stopped at a hotel near here and ordered delivery. They messed up the ENTIRE order. They forgot my sons fries, they gave me a rice bowl and added lettuce which I specifically did not note that I wanted, they failed to give me silverware, they didn't give my husband his side order, AND they gave him the entirely wrong sandwich. 

My husband called to speak to them and the guy who answered the phone VERY sarcastically apologized for forgetting the fries and told us to come pick them up. We paid for delivery and they gave the wrong order to the delivery person. He then got an attitude and said they aren't fixing it. My husband then asked for a manager or supervisor, and the employee said there wasn't one. My husband then asked for HIS name and the employee refused to give it.  Now I have to get my entire order refunded AND no one is eating their dinner in the middle of a cross country move. Whoever answered their phone needs fired.

I wont be back. I went in today to get the Skin Shield replaced on my 2012 Honda Accord. It was cracked & damn near dragging on the ground. They presented me with options that included zip tying it or replacing the Skin Shield altogether. I opted with the best long term option which the associate Brad suggested was replacing the Skin Shield altogether & I agreed. They had to order the part from the dealer and as a bright point, they were able to get the shield in and fixed same day, almost same hour (i came in about 2:40, they close at 5, & I was out of there by 4pm, so i appreciate the quick fix). 
I saw them arrive with the Skin Shield & I took a picture of the gentlemen holding it as he walked in. So I decided to use their free wi-fi access while waiting to look online and i saw Skin Shields for my 2012 Accord go for as low as $22 or as high as $75 from the dealer (which is where they got it from) & then varying prices in-between. I was charged $134 for the Part & $95 labor + envir fees & supply + tax, my total came out to $251.04. This just seemed a bit high & kind of unreasonable to me. So when i left, i called around and received quotes from other local mechanics for under $200. I even called my old mechanic where i use to live & he quoted me under $150 (where i was a regular customer for years, so i admit theres some established bias there).
The only reason I didnt rate this review lower is i was happy with the quick turn around & its mostly my fault for not shopping around more, but i am new to town and friends highly recommended them & when i checked yelp, they had good reviews, so why not commit to them?
 I'm a Lyft/Uber driver so i was hoping to find a good/honest place that i can trust to bring my car every 4-5 weeks for routine maintenance since i drive A LOT but when I'm overcharged by what my research tells me was at-least $75, I just have to take my business elsewhere. If i was smarter, i would have just bought the part myself and paid them labor, but i was anxious to get it done so I can get back to making money Lyfting/Ubering. 
I cant afford to be overcharged considering how much service i require as a lyft/uber driver. I even asked about the price of the part vs what i found online and all he said was they replaced the "whole part" which didnt answer my question since my question was about the "whole part". I just chalked this up as a $75 stupidity/ignorance fee on my part and as a lesson learned not to return. But they get 3 stars for a quick turn around-that i was happy with.

Had a great experience. Food was good, service was fantastic. Upstairs patio is super cool. Funky decor on the inside. You can buy some of the artwork. $1 pbr all day everyday. They also have bands perform like every other weekend!

Beside the super slow service which I can forgive since it seems no one wants to work anymore. Ordered Chicken Strips thinking that was a pretty safe bet. Tater tots were cold like they had been on the counter all day and the chicken strip were the same. Slow service does not equate to shitty cold food, that is total BS. Asked for fry sauce and cocktail sauce for dips. They were out of cocktail sauce and seemed to be rationing the fry sauce like it was WWII, terrible. There are much better places to give your business to that actually appreciate their customers. I won't go back again.

Located inside a gas station, but many terrific eating places are inside gas stations.  The employees are friendly and efficient and the Italian sandwich is spectacular. The service is fast, the portions more than fair. If you are looking for a break from the subway, head here.  You will not be disappointed.

I wish I had read the reviews on this store before ordering. I placed an order online for a fridge and that went smoothly but it stops there. The delivery men showed up and without discussing anything with me, removed my door. Brought the fridge in, and set it up but only removed half the styrofoam inside and banged the fridge door against my counter tops several times to "show me how not to do that". Ok..
The second delivery man takes my dining chair and STEPS ONTO IT to put my door back up. Why? Do they not have step ladders? They leave, I check my chair and see that it's now broken (it wobbles now) and has paint scratches where his feet were. 
So I called customer service. A guy picks up name Emmanuel, says no problem he'll take care of the fee for my chair, gives me an email address and tells me to send him photos of the damage which I do immediately. He calls me back and then proceeds to call me a liar and that he just "doesn't understand why the delivery men wouldn't get a ladder from the truck."
I ask to speak to a manager. She says her name is Alaina and in a huffy, confrontational tone says I'll have to make a claim with their claims department and connects me to their number. I'm on hold again and she had rerouted me to their main menu. So I picked the billing department (there was no claims department, Alaina was trying to lose my call) and the woman in billing after I explained to her what happened said she'd help me make a claim even though it wasn't her department. Sounds a lot like Alaina could've made the claim too doesn't it? After the nice woman in billing makes the claim, an insurance woman gets in contact with me and I re explain the issue and send her the photos. Two months later she refunds my money. 

TLDR: Don't shop here unless you want your furniture ruined by impatient delivery men, and your integrity questioned by incompetent 20 somethings who failed high school math.

Pre covid this place was clean and great! However, I went in for an appointment and three employees and one client all had masks over their mouths only! 
Yet, I'm required to wear a mask, have my temperature taken, wash my hands and distance. 
These employees walked right next to me several times talking and with their noses completely uncovered! If your nose isn't covered then you might as well take your mask off! As you are putting everyone at risk!  Maybe part of the covid spike is from here?  I'm not planning to come back anytime soon, as it's just not safe! 

They keep the door locked, but ignore their own rules!

Clearly this place cares to do things well.  Soup was delicious & I loved that on the 2 sandwiches at our table had melted cheese, they took the time to ensure both had some crispy cheese on the edges.  That's how I would do it at home & it's the first restaurant I've ever been to that took the time to do so.  It really makes all the difference.  Soups are clearly marked as GF, dairy free and or vegetarian.  The chefs even come out while you are eating to make sure you are enjoying your food.  We don't live in the area, but will be certain to stop in whenever we are in the area.

This is my go-to Albertsons, partly because it's the closest to where I live, and partly because..........actually the physical location is the only reason. Despite that, I really like this one. Mainly because of the staff who are all incredibly friendly and helpful. To point out one of them specifically, Kathleen is awesome! She's one of the checkers and is always so friendly and personable. I always enjoy chatting with her. Otherwise, I always see a guy (or two guys) dressed in what I assume is manager clothing walking around, and he (they?) ALWAYS ask me if I'm finding everything ok. That could be because they are great with customer service or I always just look THAT lost and confused, which is fine. Then when I ask where something is, he (they?!?!) always drop what they're doing and lead me to it, even if it's all the way across the entire store, making me feel way less manly as I feel like I had to ask for directions, but still leaving me feel grateful that I didn't have to search for whatever I'm looking for anymore. Also, I really like their deli area. Everyone I have dealt with in it has been really nice and funny in some instances. On a random sidenote, I always wear a mask into the store now because A. They're required and B. You know.....personal responsibility. When I head over to the deli section, my mask fills with the wonderful smell of their hot section, and doesn't leave until a few minutes after walking away from it. I know this is stupid to point out, but.....you're welcome. 

Anyway, bottom line is this store has a great selection, a wonderful little "day-old" bread clearance section, and great staff!

I'm going with 3.5 stars here. I walked in w/o appointment for an iPad screen repair ($100). The young guys were nice enough, but I left my iPad there without being given a claim slip or anything and also giving them my passcode. They said it would be a few hours. So we went out running errands. They called when it was "done", dry? I've have my screens repaired many times, different devices. I've never seen such seepage on the new screen. Even the guy who rung me up, was like, let me clean this a bit. I had to clean up the edges A LOT more when I got home. Repair was successful, but for price and time it took, I expected a little bit more.

I wanted to like this place, it sounds so good and gets good reviews, but it was really awful. I had the chicken soup and the chicken was unrecognizable, maybe ground chicken? The turkey sandwich was bad, slimy turkey meat, possibly from Costco. We won't be back.
Came here for the first time--excellent customer service, and the soup and sandwiches were delicious.  Very impressed-we will definitely be back!

The food proportion compared to the price of the food is very expensive and unrealistic. The food wasn't that great to begin with. There wasn't much flavor, and they were not very generous with the chicken to rice ratio. As soon as I realized this place was located in Sizzler, I knew it wasn't going to be too great. I appreciate the effort, but at least lower your price considering it's not very good at all.
* I had the Bowl and 2 Bao:
* Spicy Kung Poa Chicken Bowl (Not spicy at all and not much flavor)
* Vegetable Bao
*Spicy Mongolian Beef Boa (Not spicy at all and not much flavor)

If you want some really nice authentic Asian food, there is a place called Koco Bell. It's a small shack that sells Korean BBQ foods. They are a little bit pricy, but for the proportions you are getting (the flavors are absolutely amazing), it is completely worth it. I really recommend checking it out! Another place is Thai Basil, they also have very delicious authentic food!

Went into the Curb about a year ago and walked out after sitting at our table and no one came to our table.  We said that would never go back.  Fast forward to today, had a business lunch and they picked location.  They said needed to be there early before it got busy.  1130am @ 5 tables were seated.  Server took a little long to drop menus and asked what to drink.   Ordered water and coffee. She came back with water and said she had to make a pot of coffee.  Ordered lunch took about 20 minutes for a salad and burger.  Still no coffee. One server on and the lunch crowd was walking in.  Burger was good but once again will not go back because of slow service.  The management needs to figure out how to staff properly.

There's good Mexican and bad Mexican and then there's Mexican you can't get because your hostess keeps walking away in the middle of an order. 

Restaurant- Located on Cherry and Meridian in that weird building with the computer repair shop and what I suspect is a call center on the 2nd floor. I still don't know what's up there. We were sat at a table that looked directly into the kitchen which was a bit odd. No doors to separate patrons from the noise of the kitchen. 

Menu- Typical of any Mexican Restaurant found north of the border; a range of authentic to Tex Mex to Hispanic-American. 

Service- We couldn't get our order in for about a half hour because our waitress kept walking off in the middle of an order. It's like if we paused, she'd leave and put in the order of one drink or one dish or one request of additional chips and salsa, make her rounds then come back with the single item knowing we had additional items to order. Very strange! Also it was difficult to get a speedy order in to keep the kids calm. 

Food- Very meh. Not at all worth the wait. Edible but not spicy, nothing memorable or worth mentioning. 

Overall, there are lots of better quality options in the Treasure Valley. This place seems to rely on the lunch rush and that's about it. We stopped for a late lunch and it was basically empty.

What a load of crap! 2/13/18 @ 6:45pm
Well they have lost my business! We had a mailer coupon, "oh that's not ours" it's the other stores! This store is just three blocks away from me. No trying to help or offer anything to appease. 
I will pass this information to All my neighbors, along with my family!

I did not actually use Craig Swap. This review is only based on my initial phone call. I called to look into representation for an auto accident. The lady that I talked to was...well, not helpful at all.

I would not say she was rude, but I would say that she acted like I was an annoyance and she wanted me off the phone as soon as possible.

I told her about the accident. She told me very abruptly that it would not be worth the time for the attorneys and practically hung up on me.

I will never call these guys again.

I love that they offer recycling (incl glass!) our front, that they offer cooled/heated pet care options- & even free electric car charging! Product selection is much larger than at your typical store, & specialty products are well marked. Staff is fridndly & they r doing a great job during the eta of Covid-19 keeping eating tables clean, carts clean & people spaced.

This is my 3rd time at The Curb.   Their burgers are so good.  But today I tried tacos and wow... yummy!!!  I also got a side of beans and rice.  I love Mexican food.  It's my favorite mostly because I was raised on it.  Frijoles aka refried beans are a staple and those of us who've eaten them all our lives are somewhat particular about how they should taste.  I haven't found a Mexican restaurant that comes close in the Treasure Valley area yet.  Until today. At The Curb.  I'll be back!  (And by the way, The Curb isn't even a Mexican restaurant!)

big, and so much more than just a market, its a day trip to go in there, but did not get the service I expected from a place like this, it is so up beat but the checker was a major downer, will go back, everyone has a bad day, but was not the best way to greet a new customer.
Amazing service and food! I'm so glad we were turned away from Red Robin. We will coming back here soon!

Called in an order, the person who took my order was in training and couldn't understand English very well. Kept having to repeat myself. Needless to say, my order ended up being wrong and cold, they said it would be ready in 10 minutes, I was there in 10 minutes
This used to be one of the few Mexican restaurants I would eat at.
I am losing all hope that there is any good Mexican restaurants in Boise and Meridian.
Soups blah, sandwich's blah, both lacked any flavor. Not sure how this place got such good reviews.
From sale to delivery, RC Willey was an ease to work with. Quality chair was delivered by 8am & the guys were polite, friendly, and efficient. Have and will use RC Willey again.

I love this store and super happy to see all the variety;  from fresh fruits and veggies, to a salad bar, and more. There's Starbucks, a sandwich shop, hot foods, fresh popcorn, huge bakery and cheese shop. I love the fact that most of the other local Albertsons are following suit and updating their stores. I shop at Albertsons at least once a week.

This company managed my rental house for 7 years. During that time, they bounced their check to me, paid utilities late and charged me for the late fees, allowed tenants to stay in my house without paying rent, and more. Their ads and written communications were full of misspelled words. Their responses to me were either slow or nonexistent. They are inept, if not negligent. They acted as if managing my property was a burden, and did not act in my best interests. I chose them as they were family of my babysitter. Not a good reason to select a business partner, and I should have terminated my contract with them years ago.

I can't give less than 1 Star? 
Worse customer service I encountered in a very long time. The owners and management should be humiliated for providing that type of service to the community.

I could not find a separate listing for their eating areas. If there is one, please let me know.

I have avoided eating here because...well, its a grocery store deli. If they had good food, they would be the 1st among grocery stores to pass this milestone. My wife says she loves the salads here, so I decided to go with her and give the give them "A Go".

Albertsons claim to fame here is their variety. Typically, when a place tries to take on this much variety, they don't do any of it very well. I walked in though with high hopes that I would find Albertsons to be the exception to the rule.

They offer Hamburgers, Sushi, Brick-oven Pizza, Gyros, BBQ and more. I ordered the, wait for it...... Hamburger. For those that know me, and my reviews, I review more hamburgers than anything else because I love me a good burger.

Specifically I had their Bulgogi Burger. It's touted as a unique Korean burger with Kimchi Mayo, Daikon, Gochujang and Rice Noodles. The 1st thing to note here is time. If you come here in the hopes of a quick lunch, think again. 

Each of their specialty places to eat are separate. Its like having several different restaurants under the same roof. A cool idea. I actually had an idea similar to this many years ago, but I did not have the funding to build it. 

The problem is that each of these places will only take and cook your order. This is the 1st line you have to contend with. Next you have to actually pay for your food. For this you have to walk to another area. When I came here for lunch, there was only 1 cashier working. This line was long. 

Imagine all these specialty food areas having to converge into 1 payment line. It creates a huge bottleneck like a 6-lane road merging into 1 lane. I timed how long it took from the time I placed my order until I paid for it. 25 minutes.

When I finally got my food, paid for it, and found a table to sit at, I opened up the box to eat. 

Fries
The fries were good and crispy but not fresh. On my 1 to 10 scale, I would give them a solid 6 mostly because they did not taste like they were from frozen.

Burger
Next, I came to the burger, which tasted like Korean BBQ. Tangy, sweet and sour at the same time. The patty was dry, which was from the person that cooked it smashing it on the grill with her spatula. Maybe she thought she was working at Smash Burger.

Why people smash their patties I am not sure. I used to do this mostly because it looks cool when the grease from the burger drips onto the charcoal and flames up. 

I finally came to realize that aside from the cool factor, the only thing smashing accomplishes is draining all the juices from your burger resulting in a dry and tasteless patty. 

In the words of the Red Queen; "Off with its head."

The burger was first cooked on a grill, and then transferred to flat top to finish it. Normally cooks use this Technique because the grill gives the patty that good smoky backyard BBQ burger, while the flat top allows building a nice crust on the patty. 

The way its supposed to work is the cook then puts a little Beef Broth on the flat top, and puts a lid over the patty to build up some steam melting the cheese over the meat and also further flavoring the patty. I watched the person cooking my patty and she did not do this.

On my 1 to 10 scale, I give the hamburger a 4, which is a pretty good rating for super market food.
Worst ever. Had a reservation for 6pm didn't get sat till 710... why because we add a high chair to the group. Ridiculous. I will never spend my money there again.
Wanted to try something new for lunch. Ordered two sandwiches for delivery. I received one and the other was incorrect. Disappointed and will never order here again. Should of stuck with Jimmy Johns.

The staff is super friendly! The food is blah. I hope that with time it will get better. Chicken sandwich was over cooked and dry. I was praying for a good spicy coated sandwich, but was quickly let down. Onion rings were also over cooked. I think once they get the cook times down the food could be great.  We also ordered Mac n cheese and also very dry!
Always great service. Great workers and I love going there! Least expensive tanning salon!!!

Good, good,  good.  The pork with green salsa cannot be beat.   I personally did not care for the chicken and chipotle but that is just a matter of taste.   The pastry is light and flaky, and just really good.   Try it!

Gross, gross, gross. Bought two sandwiches potato wedges and a salad. Salad was ok. But the two sandwiches we had to throw away. The slime that coated the rotten lettuce made them uneatable. It was so disgusting how they have zero disregard for there food quality. If the employees are so easily able to put lettuce that is slimy on your sandwich, you can bet they do much more disgusting things at this place. 
43$ for potato wedges, salad, and to rotten sandwiches

I love going to the new Albertsons market place especially if I'm looking for a quick healthy lunch option. They have a hot bar a cold bar a salad bar and olive bar a taco bar and pretty much anything else you'd like to get for lunch is available and usually ready or can be quickly available for you. It is somewhat expensive as they charge per weight of your box, but they have healthier options than fast food so it tends to be worth it. Now that it's getting colder I love going for a soup and salad option for lunch as there is plenty to choose from.

We came here based on Yelp reviews and a shout out on the top 10 places to eat in Idaho.  I have to say that Steve's lived up to the hype.

Hubby had a short stack, I pulled from the specials menu and had the "Hunters Scramble"...a mix of potatoes, onions, peppers, ham, sausage, bacon, cheese and eggs.  Um, yum.  I believe that having ham in scrambles like this can sometimes overpower the rest of the mix...but the ham was savory instead of sweet, not to mention deliciously juicy.  There was a nice ratio of all meats with veggies...so savory and fulfilling.  Hubby loved his pancakes...those suckers are HUGE.  Hubby was very grateful for the short stack...he couldn't finish because they were so big.  To top it off, they came with a choice of side meat.  He got the sausage patty.  Delicious, every bite.

Service was quick, friendly and thoughtful.  We came and left happy.  Thank you for a wonderful visit.

My family and I are new to the area and we have been experiencing new restaurants to try every weekend. We utilize Yelp to help us locate the restaurants that look good to try. Lucky Fins was the place we chose today. Wow...what a great decision! It has everything we hope for in a restaurant....food quality, service quality, location convenience, prices, menu options. We were so happy with our experience. Our food was amazing! I personally chose the Enchilada Stack with Shrimp entree...plenty of food and tasted great with a little spice to it! My 5 and 6 yr old boys loved their Grilled Cheese and Sliders. My wife enjoyed her Sushi! This place is Gluten free friendly and kid friendly.

So we received our bill and by accident the server issued the wrong bill to us. Without hesitation I obviously brought it to her attention. The Manager came over and acknowledged our honesty and offered complimentary dessert to us. We were surprised by the offering and it would have never been expected nor even thought of. However, she insisted on us choosing a dessert. She was one of the nicest restaurant Managers I have personally ever been in contact with. This gesture was so over the top generous. The bill error was not a big issue at all obviously but she still handled it like it was. Actions like this by a business/restaurant is what will generate return customers. Give away something so minor in regards to your business overhead costs and receive big gains long term with repeat customers. I always wonder why some restaurants choose to do the opposite of what this restaurant does. 

This place is so great, we have already shared our pleasant experience with friends locally and we will return for sure!

They fell victim to covid. Husband and I would frequent this place and finally got the courage to go eat out again. First they didnt have the beer I ALWAYS order there, then the nachos we ALWAYS order there were no longer on the menu. Why bother, so we left.

We recently moved to Nampa, Idaho.  Due to our move, we needed to buy 2 sets of office style furniture, which had been built in at our previous home in Northern California.  We thought we had found decent replacement furniture at RC Willey.  WRONGAMUNDO!

Within 3 weeks of receiving the furniture, the entire front piece of 1 of the 3 file cabinet units literally FELL OFF!  On the other 2 file cabinet units, the left side of both units was coming loose, while the right side of the file cabinet seemed to stay secure.  

We were assured by the sales person that they would replace the furniture with the same style but different finish and that would correct the problem.  Au Contraire....  This morning they were supposed to deliver the replacement furniture with the different stain version and when it arrived, it appeared to be the same exact stain.  That said, we were at our wit's end.  

The upshot is that we spoke with the store manager and told him we want a 100% refund and would not accept the replacement furniture, so they were to take away ALL the furniture immediately.

We are not novices with furniture.  In fact, we're pretty knowledgeable, truth be told.  It is now clear to us that RC Willey sold us below par furniture and charged a hefty price for it.  

Our recommendation?  Do NOT buy case goods from RC Willey.

These guys are the most honest and truthful heating and AC guys in the state.  I was given a two year old furnace and AC compressor.  A friend highly recommended that I call them to see if they could install it for me.  Eric came out and checked to see if the new equipment I was given would work.  He double checked the equipment to make sure it would be a proper fit.  He gave me a very fair bid. Within 3 work days his techs were at my house conveying the equipment .  They had to do quite a bit install new pipes, venting etc. They did quality work and I could not be happier with how well they installed it and how well it fit.  The system works perfect.  I would recommend them to anyone.

We recently moved here & bought all new appliances, all worked but 1 and Kitchen-Aid sent us to Lake, which ghosted us 4 times for 4 missed appointments (never a call), sent a tech who was a jerk and blamed us for oven not working and the absolute cherry on top was their phone loop which disconnected me repeatedly before I finally got a woman who was annoyed to be answering calls and snipped, "you weren't hung up on, you were disconnected!"

Run!
Bought 2 drinks for almost 8$ just to get a cup of fucking ice. I fucking hate water btw never going back your good on all that ridiculous price for some ridiculous ass drink wtf is wrong with yall

I am very happy with my bed I bought in 2018, I have had no problems. I order some pillow on line in may 2020. I didn't like them and went to the store in meridian to exchange, met with Jessica very helpful with the exchange and also bought some other bedding.
Not sure what people are complaining about, if you have a problem with your bed then work with the store manager to resolve it.
Staff tries way too hard to wheel and deal. I've never been to this location without feeling hassled.

Tango's is awesome. This was my first visit to the nampa location. It is just as amazing as the boise location. Being a family owned business, the food is wonderful and consistent between locations. I love taking my family to Tango's, and they all love it too. I can't recommend this place highly enough!
Plus for $5 you can get the combo pictured. Yum!

I initially really liked this gym. My boyfriend and I joined this gym over Golds, Anytime Fitness, etc because of the basketball court. We had a month or two of using the court when Axiom very quietly started renovations on it. There was no communication about the real extent of changes and privileges being made to the court, or about the new "partner." We are now only allowed very limited time on the court, much of which is during regular work hours during the week, and then a small window of time on weekends. And just now we got kicked off of the court because the owner was watching on cameras. The court was completely empty-nobody was there. It was around 9pm when no HSB basketball practices or games are scheduled, so I'm confused as to why members can't use the court. I understand business decisions need to be made in favor of the gym's profit, however Axiom did not confront and address changes fully with their existing paying members. Very "sweep it under the rug" feel. Super disappointed.
Went while I was visiting this summer! Very yummy!! Bridget C is also an absolute saint

We hired TruGreen in hopes of a beautiful green lawn. We now have a full re-sodded lawn because of their lack of attention! From the start we did not get any results! We called them and told them that we found grubs in the lawn. They came out and left us a note that stated that we did not have grubs! We called back again and told them we pulled some of the grubs out and had them in a cup! They came back out and say they treated for grubs but we had almost half of our lawn eaten by the bugs you could just pull it up there were no roots left. Because this went on so long we had to pull out the dead areas and add new sod so that our HOA would not fine us! Now I can not get a call back from anyone at TruGreen! Locally or at coorporate! I feel sorry for their call center people they have been amazing at taking my calls and handling my frustration! unfortunately they can't help me!

We scheduled a viewing appointment over the phone with Ray to see two of their available units. We arrived at the unit we were going to tour at the time we had agreed on.  We sat in the car for TWENTY minutes waiting for someone to arrive, all the meanwhile calling their office trying to figure out why they were running so late.  Eventually a lady who introduced herself as a cleaning woman arrived.  She was nice enough to let us go in and give ourselves a self tour.  The whole apartment smelled like cat pee, certain things hadn't been fixed (like ripped up carpet), and was not "tour ready" in that regard.  I asked the lady what the plan was for the next tour, and she said Ray wasn't even going to come out since she was already there (so he never even left his office to meet us at the time he set for the appointment?!) The lady who let us in was nice enough to give me the cell phone number of Ray so that I could speak to him directly about the apartments.  He then tells me that the next apartment was actually now rented out to someone, and this one also had an application pending.  So basically there was no point at going to see the apartments because they were taken.  
We took out the time from our very busy schedules to meet for tours, and Ray never came to meet us (or even call to let us know he wouldn't be coming).  If this is how you treat potential clients, I don't even want to know how you treat your residents.  I am so unimpressed with the experience we had, and we do not plan to rent through this company any time soon for that reason.  My suggestion would be to actually keep appointments you make, or at least make a courtesy call explaining why you won't come.  And maybe spray a little febreeze ahead of time so the people who tour don't gag the whole time.

We went on a Sunday. Not the best service, but we were not in a hurry.  $ 3 mimosas were yummy. Food was okay. We might try again on a different day. Overall it ess okay, but not great ...and not bad.
Very good donuts. And we got free donut holes with our order. I donuts are light and fluffy. Sugary but not too sugary.

Super disappointing honestly. I've had good, real bao and this ain't it! Meat is tasty, but the dough is just wrong. Too bread-y, too thick, not enough filling. If you've had real bao you won't want this. The whole wheat veg one was gross I truly could not eat it. I also got a rice bowl which was fine but the portions were very skimpy and I didn't get much meat or sauce w my rice. It wasn't horrible, I did enjoy the rice bowl but it depends on what you're looking for.
great service very professional  on time     Found problem with fridge not  getting cold.   Timely mater.   Very satisfied

Great food and a really good happy hour with slices for only $2.25! Lots of drink options also. Try the huckleberry soda with a slice of their Hawaiian pizza. On a nice day, I'd recommend sitting up stairs.

Best water I've had so far. Always my go-to. The man who runs it is always so helpful and sweet! If you need help getting the water to and from your car, he always offers to help.
The water itself is reverse osmosis, from what I understand, which even filters out fluoride - yay!
I think it tastes great and refreshing. Very grateful to have this water and so cheap too. I recommend this place to everyone!

I always enjoy my visit to this new store. It's always a great experience. Friendly helpful staff and stocked with almost everything you might need from foods to gifts.. and the little cafe is a welcome touch along with Starbucks right there also
The folks that work there are so nice and really know there stuff!

Walked into this place tonight needing a large washer for my blanket. Wow, was I impressed. Not that everyone should be impressed by a laundromat, but I was immediately welcomed by the associate who quickly showed me the ropes and how to get a loyalty card and load it up with cash to start my laundry. 
There are no coins here, thank goodness, I didn't have any. The machines use a preloaded card, you load by using their system with either cash, debit, or credit card. You can activate the loyalty card with your information (I was assured it was safe) and you will be sent a text message (if you sign up) when your load is completed! There are TVs to keep you occupied, restrooms available, and a very clean environment. 
My large wash, king size blanket, took 29 min and 14 min to dry. Highly recommend this place!

Ordered an unsweetened tea, grilled chicken sandwich and fries.... was given a chocolate shake and a grilled HAM sandwich with fries. This was a drive through order, it's not like I can just walk up and give it back. Ridiculous... worst part is I left a tip!

Service was great from the super friendly staff, and owners! It was opening day! We were the second customers ever?, which was pretty cool! I am pretty sure we were over charged as the bill came to $35 for just two orders, but I still left a tip, as it was opening day! 

Food came out fairly quickly! We got ours togo, and it came in cool looking cardboard boxes.

I ordered the Cluck with mac n cheese bites. Somehow fries ended up in the box with my sammich, and the bites came separately. I Loved the sammich! Had great flavor, with nice heat and crunch. The slaw was great! Not that cheap sugary crap found at chain restaurants. I will order the cluck without tomato's next time around, as the tomatoes worked against the sandwich. Fries were of the extruded verity (not my favorite), but still hot and crunchy.

The mac n cheese bites were good. Nice mild flavor, came steaming hot with a nice crunch. My only complaint would be it needed a dipping sauce of some sort.

Next were The Nashville Hot Cluckles! The price we were charged did not match any advertised price, and when I questioned it was told thats just what the price was. With that said my guest thought they were excellent. Not much to comment on here. The chicken tenders were hot and crunchy. The texas toast was well? Texas toast.

Like mentioned before I cant wait to try the Shrimp Po Boy, and dirty bird. I will be back for those.

If the owner is reading this, please fix your pricing. Sandwich ala cart, or meal option would be awesome. I did have slight sticker shock when paying.

Also a few different dipping sauce options would be super cool.

Overall great super tasty food! I can't wait to come back to try more!

We've been here 3+ years and haven't found a donut place until now. This place has PERFECTLY fluffy donuts. We haven't tried the cake donuts yet but we will. The maple bar, cream cheese donut, eclair, and strawberry topped donuts were the stars. Their glazed and everything else is delicious. 

The woman who served us was super friendly. I also love the drive through. We will be coming here for our donut needs from now on!

I was shopping in this store with my two year old who was at the end of her rope for the day. It was admittedly a difficult day and I was doing my absolute best to make it out of the store without a total and complete melt down. My daughter tried on a dress that she really loved and when I went to take it off she started to completely lose it. I decided to pick my battles and she wore the dress to register to pay for it. The very first question I asked the cashier was if it was possible for her to remove the tag and scan it while she wore it. The cashier said that was possible and I made my payment. I was shopping with my sister and I left early to take the kids to the car. Once I left the cashier asked my sister if we were together. The cashier went on to tell my sister that the employees had been watching us the entire time we were in the store and that it is not okay to wear the clothes in the store. Completely caught off guard, my sister responded, Well you know two year olds. I obviously would have preferred that my kid kept her own clothes on but sometimes life doesn't work out the way we would like things to go. I was very hurt and upset by her comments. I called the store back to talk with a supervisor who agreed that the comment was inappropriate but then went on to say that wearing the clothes is a safety concern due to the security pins. However, the store provides fitting rooms to TRY CLOTHES ON. I also don't understand what that has to do with, "All the employees were watching you". I literally ended the phone call with the supervisor in tears. I shop at this store regularly but I do not feel comfortable returning at this point. I would suggest moms of small children don't shop at this store because their employees believe they are being paid to be judgmental.

I like the fact that they were always there to help me . Never a problem communicating with my attorney, he always answered all my questions. My Attorney fought hard for me to get a well deserved settlement. I would highly recommend.

This review is for the company, not the guys who cleaned the carpets. They were very professional and polite. I live in a new construction house that is 4 months old. We never wear shoes in the house and are neat freaks. We had the typical organic move in stains from the movers and workers. Again, almost brand new carpet with organic stains. 

When the carpet dried after Stanley Steemer cleaned it, literally every stain was left, I couldn't believe it. It's almost like the carpets were not cleaned at all. One of the stains was left by a plant. I got the Oxi Clean and spot cleaned it with hot water to see if I could get the stain out. After 40 seconds of scrubbing, completely gone!! 

I then went and got my 3 year old Bissell Crosswave out. Loaded the container with extremely hot water diluted with Oxi Clean. My house is 2600 square feet. It took me six hours (Going to the sink 100+ times to empty the small container on the bissell took forever), but the carpets came out absolutely spotless. So I pay Stanley Steemer $240, only to do the carpets myself for 6 hours. Proof is in the pictures, look at the dirt left behind after their cleaning!!!!!!!

Remarkably interesting buyer beware. since R.C. Willey has come to town we always shopped there and never had a problem till now. One I have a contractors account and a personal account. Never have used their floor covering department before so I was buying a full set of appliances and went over and scheduled a measure for someone to come out and measure the home, I was updating for LVP. The installed called me and we set the appointment. Well, he never showed up and no follow up by the salesperson. No big deal I just got it done by the people I always use.
#2. My wife buys a recliner in their clearance area and it is a power one. But it is making noises, so the salesperson sell her an extended warranty. RC Wiley's delivers it, and she uses it for a while. So, we rearranged the room and I look under it and the frame is broken. My wife calls RC Willey to come out and they schedule an appointment. Well, I get a call the day before and some nice lady informs me the warranty only cover the power stuff. Well, we know that this was a return because someone did not like it and that is why it was in clearance section. The customer service lady said it was not broken before we got it. Interesting it had noises because of the broken frame that is why the salesmen double dipped in a sale. The nice sales lady puts me on a hold and then comes back and everything sold in the clearance department is sold as is. So, I asked her so RC Willey will do nothing for us? She said no not our policy. So, I said it is like buying at a garage sale at 5 times the cost. She just laughed and then I let her know I was going to warm others by a yelp review. She thanks me and we hung up. so here are my reviews. So do not buy anything in the clearance section unless you get an inspection of the product first. It is buyer beware at RC willey clearance section.

As I parked and shopped at a nearby Walgreens, some 'idiot' scraped the driver side door of my nice car with their bumper. [arrrggg] Of course they left without leaving me a note or accepting responsibly.  :-(
So, I stopped at Westside Body Works (as it's near my house) to see what they could do to make the necessary repairs. 
Eric was 'great'  He listened to my story, looked at my vehicle and told me that 'maybe', most of the damage could just be buffed out.   He sent the car to the guys in the back and they began their work.  
A short wait and WOW, you can hardly see the damage.  Yes, the sheet metal is slightly indented (from the persons who hit me), but it's barely noticeable after they did their magic. 
It's an older car (but nice) so it's not important to me to have it 'perfect'.  
The work Eric and his team did was spot on.  the best part.... no charge!!  I couldn't believe my ears.    WOW!  thanks Guys!  I'm very happy (and so is my husband).  
I can't guarantee you'll get your work done for free, but whatever it cost, I'm sure you'll be pleased with the end results.   :-)

Manuel and his wife, Victoria, did an amazing build this morning!! Our shed looks fabulous and I can't believe they had it done in four hours.  I'm absolutely speechless. Thanks so much for providing such  great installers!! Stor-Mor has my endorsement and I will definitely recommend.
Brandon is an honest guy. I've done business with him for a long time and plan to continue for the foreseeable future.

Great service, mediocre food. If you like spicy soups and flavors,  there were a lot of options for this the day we went. Nice to get some soup samples as the curry one I tried made my mouth feel fiery. Then I tried mushroom and rice and it tasted bland. Ended up getting the chicken noodle soup which was tasty. My  sandwich was okay. Good but nothing special. The person who took our order and made our food was extremely nice.

TruDishonesty should be this company's name. Sheldon sold us a "special" for (tree & shrub service) 6 applications (2 for this year and 4 for next) for $249.  I thought, "Wow, that's a great deal".  Being skeptical, I asked quite a few questions to make sure I was clear about the deal even called him back and discussed it in detail.  What he clearly explained would cost $249, ended up really costing over $1000.  When I called them about the bill we got 2 months later, he said that I must have misunderstood. No, I didn't misunderstand.  I was very clear up front and made sure I understood. Their sales techniques are shady. We have been getting the lawn care for years with the previous company and were happy until TruGreen must have bought them out and it's been shady ever since!  We cancelled our entire service after this final experience.  It's not surprising they have such a low rating. Bye Felicia, I mean TruDishonesty!!!

Mr. Kleiner's story is an amazing story and while Incan spotlight it here in my review, I would challenge you to read more about Mr. Kleiner next one you visit this stunning park. JMK Memorial Park is a stunning gem for Meridian and the Treasure Valley. We are so fortunate to have the wide open spaces of JMK right in our backyard.  There are plenty of walk ways, green spaces, play areas, and places to fish.  

Every time I visit JMK Memorial Park, I always seem to find something new that I missed on my last walk.  My Husky, Kody, loves coming here and visiting with all the people.  He's such a flirt and a diva.  I can imagine him sitting on the bench overlooking the pond with the fountain and reading Voltaire and flirting with a French Poodle. 

My only grip about JMK Memorial Park is the over abundance of waste from the Canadian Geese.  It's everywhere. It's such a shame many areas of the park are littered with their waste and I am fairly certain, there's little that can be done about it.  

If only the Canadian geese would pick up afterwards or use lay their waste in a particular area that were not using, they would be awesome but that's not going to happen.  We'll just have to live with them and they'll have to live with us.  I think Mr. Kleiner would want it to be that way.

I walked in for a gel removal on my toes and gel color change only. Felt rushed and ended up filing my own toes in front of the tech because she did such a sloppy job. Then when I walked up to pay and they said $30. I was in disbelief!!! Never risking walking into a place again for convenience before reading the reviews ever again. Not sure they will stay in business with the kind of service provided.

This revolving coffee shop in meridian has featured many coffee shops over the years. Meridian has seen a recent explosion of coffee shops yet lacked a coffee lover's destination. When I first walked in my mouth just dropped what was a once a tacky poorly decorated coffee shop is now an open, warm, industrial space perfect for sipping coffee or time with a friend. I absolutely love the space wish I'd had more time to sit and take it all in yet today was coffee on the go. I ordered a regular mocha; the barista/counter guy was super friendly knowledgeable about their coffee and the process they use to make your super awesome coffee!! If you are looking for a "coffee shop" not one of those drive through destinations these guys take coffee to whole nother level do yourself a favor check them out if you are in the meridian area!!

Everytime I go in I'm overwhelmed, they have so many options to choose from. I can never truly decide what I want so I end up getting a few things. I do really enjoy their salad bar and they also offer amazing warm food.

Paramount Property Management made my daughter's first experience on her own an absolute nightmare. She sublet a duplex and the move-in condition was not what was expected or promised. It was not clean, though they claimed it was, but the move-in pictures proved otherwise, and several other items also needed attention. It was like pulling teeth to get any help and most items did not get fixed as Paramount deemed that they did not make the unit un-inhabitable. The security deposit was not returned when promised and we had to call to have that sent. (The check and mailing label had been ready for 2 weeks, prior to my call.) We ended up taking them to Small Claims Court for several items, including that the security deposit wasn't returned within the 30 day time limit, and won. After the 30 days, when the settlement was due from Paramount, just like the situation with the security deposit, we had to call and have it sent. Communication from this company is poor and their follow-through is just as bad, I had several phone calls that were never returned. Paramount blamed the late checks on the property owner but once I called, the checks were released and sent the same day. Paramount also has lots of fees so read your lease carefully! One ridiculous fee they had was that the tenants are responsible to clean the gutters (this was a two story unit). With that being said, Paramount had the gutters cleaned, without the tenants permission, and then tried to bill them for it. They also tried to charge for re-keying 4 doors but there were only 3 doors that required a key. Paramount also threatened with a lawsuit for any negative reviews left by those on the lease. When this review was left on the Better Business Bureau website, Paramount threatened to sue for $1,000 (the lease says they can do this for any negative reviews) and they also threatened to sue for the total funds awarded to the tenants in Small Claims, unless the review was removed, so it was. These people are bullies. Beware and do your research before dealing with Paramount. EDIT: Cassandra's memory on the court case is not true. I was never admonished or warned by the judge or the moderator, in fact, it was Cassandra who was warned by both the judge and the moderator. Nothing was misrepresented by me. I am the mother of a previous tenant and I asked the judge if I could present the evidence and was told that I could. I never coached anyone for an answer. There were only 3 locks changed at the property. We have pictures. Cassandra, quit your lying and your bullying. Yes, I will leave a review anywhere I can. This experience was that bad. People need to be warned about you and your business practices. I'd also like to mention that the judge awarded the tenants more than what Paramount Property Management was trying to withhold.

Great place! Not only do they offer pineapple dole whip floats like at Disneyland but they have a large variety of options to fill your own bowl, add some toppings, sprinkles, and sauces but they have a good selection of menu items as well. Just leaned today they have boba milk tea which I will be having next time. Great service and a nice place for a little summer treat.
Unprofessional, impersonal, and unresponsive. If you are referred here or are thinking of seeking out care at this facility, research/request a different clinic to go to.

I would not rent from them ever now. Credit score better be way over 600. They do an average so again it better be high. They say one thing then do another. God forbid you may have an eviction, but at the Sametime it better not show up. We were told  not a problem. I understand that money is money. We are going to have so many homeless because of the pandemic. We didn't lie We just didn't give our real names. Eviction really you didn't even bother to call the courthouse it was canceled and Closed So somebody's not doing their job correctly. This is only going to get a lot worse. So thanks for nothing!!!

I've eaten at Lucky Fins several times and love, love, love it! I've never had a bad meal  and the service is fantastic! Hope the one they open downtown is just as great since it's right down the street from my office.

Ray and Beth are amazing people and great to work with.  We have rented through them for 6 years, they have always been understanding and very approachable.  We would HIGHLY recommend them to anyone who is looking to rent in the Boise area.

I've been wanting to try Slyce Box Pizza for quite some time so, when driving by today, I decided to stop in. The eaterie is quaint with plenty of abstract/modern art and benches made of old skateboards. 

As for the pizza, I ordered one slice to check it out and ended up ordering a second slice. I ate the pepperoni pizza. The pepperoni has nice flavor and spiciness to it. The marinara, although lite, complemented the pepperoni and the cheeses.  The crust was thin and crisp. (Not cracker thin crisp though.  It is thin and crisp like New York pizza.)

The slices are good sized and, since I came during happy hour, they were only $2.25/slice. You really can't beat that. 

Now if you are wondering why I gave Slyce a 4-star rating it is because as far as fast, by-the-slice pizza restaurants are concerned, Slyce is better than most. I didn't give it a 5-star rating because it was a bit on the greasy side. I dabbed the excess off with a napkin before eating. 

So if you are looking for a good, fast piece of pizza and are in the Meridian area, stop by Slyce and have some "Za!"

Well. I didn't think a soda shop was the greatest idea but, I wanted to support the new business. So I showed up ready to order off of the online menu. I wanted a sugar free option. So I ordered one called the, " I Love Lucy". They informed me that they did not have the Ingredients to make that drink. So I asked if I could have the "Rocky Mountain high". They informed me that they could not make that drink either. 
    How about a regular sugar-free cherry Coke? I can get that at sonic, Jack-in-the-Box, pretty much anywhere that has a soda machine. No. No sugar-free cherry. I thanked them for their time and headed off to Jack in the box. 
I'm not one to go pour a bunch of sugary syrup's into a sugary soda and add a sugary dessert to go along with it. If that's your thing, maybe they will have some of the ingredients to make you a simple cherry soda!

We ordered the Large Meaty pizza with extra cheese and it was freaking fantastic! Lives up to its Pie Hole reputation. Perfect addition to football Saturday and Sundays! Staff is super friendly and helpful as well. Our new go-to pizza place!

Awesome fun place to take your kids if you got them, I would however stay away from the grill that they have at the bar, my wagu burger was over cooked dry bland and wife's chicken salad chicken was burned over cooked, but the Beer was good !! Ha ha ! But ya definitely recommend to go have fun. Food there sucks.

What a great addition to Meridian.  Super excited about having this store so close to where I live.  The massive store includes many items that are hard to find at other stores.  The layout makes it super simple to shop.

I really enjoy the food court with many items to choose from, from salads to sandwiches, to sushi, bbq, pizza, etc.  I usually pick something out and eat it in their dining area where you are greeted by very kind and super friendly waitresses.  Ask for Jessica and Christina.  Some of the nicest and most attentive waitresses I have encountered.  They add to the overall experience of this store.  I recently realized they have a menu that you can sit down and order from.  Their prices are really competitive and not only have I experienced the food but also hear from others how well they were pleased.

Great bakery and meat department.  Again, great additional to Meridian.
Usually love chick filA til I found a hair in my milkshake. It's little but it's still there which is really disturbing.

Great slices of pizza all ready to eat! The inside is cute, too. They have some beers on tap, salads, pizza & soda. Very friendly people! We'll be back.
Oh, I saw they give lunch specials on weekdays to teachers and students with an ID.

I'm embaressed to say that I'm barely trying this place after 8 years of living in Boise!! This place is phenomenal!!! I literally wanted to lick the plate after I finished. I ordered the honey bbq glazed salmon and it came with a generous portion of veggies and mashed potatoes!! You can always tell fresh veggies versus frozen and these were definately fresh!!! I also had their bloody mary which was fairly good and the calamari as an appetizer.

This place really knocks the ball out the fence when it comes to seafood in the treasure valley. The menu was so diverse I had a hard time choosing. My husband had the pistachio crusted hailbut and it was equally flavorful. The kids menu was good too, both my boys had cheeseburgers. The only negative thing I can say is I wish there was a larger seafood selection on the kids menu but it's understandable being that my kids are few who enjoy seafood.

Long story short, we will never go back to Red Lobster again :)
Excellent customer service and the best donuts with a wide variety! I am definitely going to be a returning customer!

The regular Al stores are extraordinary prices for ordinary groceries.  The Market (and Broadway) stores are even more expensive.  Al's motto must be, "We will match any price, no matter how high".

Sorry Joe Albertson, I'm sticking with WinCo.

I will never order from Albertsons delivery again. I ordered and was charged for T-bone steaks at 6.99 a pound for 4 pounds ( value pack) .They charged me $12.99 on delivery (next day) because they say the sale was over so my estimated bill went up over $20 bucks. Not o let that I was given 2 thin steaks not  a value pack for 36 bucks! 
Got on chat and was told to bad they can change the price after you pay because it's just an estimate! I get a few dollars but $20 ?
They were so rude I just ended chat and will never be back !
Walmart delivery is very easy to work with and will refund any errors without issue.

What do you get when Albertsons in their hometown wants to take the Whole Foods store model and do it their own way (aka better)? You get a home run is what you get. The location is primo, across the street from The Village in Meridian. Many times the family and I will have dinner at Village and then stop by Market Street on the way home, very convienent. Be prepared though the parking lot is always packed and getting in/out of the shopping center is not the best seeing how it is located on the busiest corner (Fairview/Eagle) in all of Idaho.

Once inside, my suggestion, hang a right and walk over to Talon Bar. My first and foremost tip for visiting Market Place, you can order a drink at the full bar and walk around with it while shopping! Then wonder back to the bakery area, and be warned it's all very good and dangerous on the mid drift section.

Meat and seafood counter are both fully stocked, we have tried lots and the beef is primary locally from either Double R Ranch of Snake River Farms. Albertsons regularly has sales one both which makes some of the best beef you can get for a great price.

Cheese department, check! Wine department that rivals a Total Wine, check! Fine european dried deli meats, check! I could just go on and on, my advice is wander around with your drink and try not to fill the cart too high because the only downside is much like Costco, you ain't getting out Market Place cheap.

Every-time I've been to this location their food is actually trash. Came in for lunch and their tea taste heavily of mold, the fries were over cooked and not salted at all, and the nuggets had a horrible undercooked texture to them! I will be avoiding this location!!
They charge you money to use a credit card or debit card.  This is a violation of every major credit card.  I will be reporting them and I encourage others to do the same.

How do you rate a place that has fairly good food but horrible service?
I've been to this particular Hugo's Deli a handful of times, and this particular visit was just like the rest of them:  bomb fries and horrible service.

I don't know what they bread their fries in, maybe it's just seasoned flour?  It's a really light coating and it really lets the potato be the star.  I have never had fries like these anywhere.  They are thick, and they are flimsy, not firm.  And I am not saying flimsy as in anything wrong with it.   It's just the way they are.  They are so big, with soft potato in the middle and the gentle breading.  They are incredibly delicious.  

The sandwich we ordered was a little better than OK.  Not bad, not great, just a sandwich.  We did a ham and cheese and my son asked for olives on it.  (Who does that?)  A good amount of ham, I didn't visually notice the cheese, but I remember the taste and feel of it - so it was good.  The bread is somewhat dense which I'm not too crazy about.  I like a softer bread.  But it wasn't a bad sandwich; I'd give it a 7 out of 10.

The problem with this Hugo's is the service.  
And unfortunately, it's really bad.  You feel completely unwelcome.  We went at lunch time.  The kids had just gotten out for lunch at the high school up the street.  But there were only 2 couples (adults) there, already eating, and then me and my son at the counter to order.  The high schoolers had not shown up yet.  The lady was so rude.  There was no greeting.  Not a hello, a what can I get for you, nothing.  She just stood there with an angry "yes?" look.  It's like we were bothering her by just being there.  "Yeah, and?"  And the heavy sighs, and the look of impatience and wanting to be anywhere else but taking our order.  She hadn't even rung up or put down the fries yet, when we were deciding between size and one order or two (we went for 2 mediums, because we each wanted our own).  I am shaking my head trying to figure out the hostility.  And I know that's a big word, but it's true.  And it fits.

The sad part is, those fries are BOMB.  And their fry sauce is homemade and delicious.  The perfect blend where you don't get too much mayo or too much ketchup or too much seasoning.  Just a creamy fry sauce with jusssst a touch of sweet.  This fry sauce and the way they prepare/cook their fries really celebrates the potato.  And we're in Idaho, so we're all about celebrating the potato.  I WOULD go back for those fries.  And I would recommend you have those fries at least once in your life if you like potato.  Just don't go in there expecting great service.  There is no sunshine or flowers here.  But if that ever changes, I'll report back.

I had an awesome prenatal massage by Liz, it really helped my sore muscles and pain in my lower back and butt. They are expanding and I can see why! Would love to try the prenatal yoga but I can barely get up from a seated position so I might try it in the beginning of my next pregnancy if it happens! Would definitely love to get involved in the studio anyways. Good vibes!

Really liked this company. Have had two sheds from them. However, their follow-up on quality issues is something to be desired. My shed is about 5 years old now and the side panels are are coming off. I stopped into the office to see if anything could be done or get some advice on fixing it and was given an email address to their quality control. Sent pictures and a description a week ago and have never heard back. You can plainly see the side walls coming off. Even if it's out of warranty they could at least tell me how to fix it!
Kinda disappointed on them.


Amendment: Stir-Mor sheds called the other day and told me they hadn't seen my email. Okaay.
I was told that my shed was out of warranty, which I knew, but since it hasn't been all that long and they had a crew in Kuna on Friday, they would have them stop by and fix it. They guy came out on Friday, fastened all the panels coming loose and caulked them all. Now this is the kind of service I remember from the company. Thank you Alex for taking care of this. Just confirms I went with the right people.

I got the Rueben, the club sandwich and the tomato basil soup. All great. The soup stayed hot forever in the container. I'm in from out of town and had these delivered to my hotel room. Fresh, tasty and done very well.

The beans were delicious everything was good. My name is Liam, i'm 8. The food was great. The service was so nice and friendly and the bathrooms are really clean. The chips and beans are my favorite. Our server was the best! The only problem is we are sooooo full!

I hate to give this place such a low rating because th staff is so friendly, but I got a full acrylic set here and within a week they were breaking off. I didn't like that they started so far above the cuticle either which makes it so I'd have to come in sooner. I did get a pedicure here and they did amazing. Just a no for the acrylic stuff.
Lucky Fin's...so impressive. Family dinner out. Atmosphere great, staff friendly & nice. Prices reasonable. Never disappointed-always happy with full tummies.

Love Love Love this place for cookies 
So fresh and always a new flavor each week! Yummy  they also deliver right to your front door.

Wow! My first time here, as we stopped in on an impulsive whim, and I've got to say, I'm IMPRESSED!! 6 varieties of fresh from scratch soups and some out of this world carrot lemonade!! This place is small but the food is mighty!! It's a knock out must try (and you can sample before you buy!) plus they have frozen soups you can rake home!! Could it get any better??? The owner worked the register, and all of the staff was SUPER gracious and courteous! Oh and the menu items listed vegan and gluten free options! Well worth the trip!!

Loving this location and the dine-in option! The restaurant is clean and charming, and the service friendly. Unlike previous reviewers, we received our food in just a few minutes. (Anyone who's been to any Fanci Freez drive-thru knows the wait is long--that's just par for the course.)

The burgers here are good (not great but not bad), but the shakes are worth it. I really wish all the locations would start carrying the same corn dogs they have at Overland, which are the best corn dogs in town, by far. 

Overall, a good experience, and I think we'll come back here instead of State St. from now on!

My husband hired these people because we were having problems with dandelions and clover in our lawn. We are going to be putting the house on the market in May and we needed our grass in top shape. This company had the worst customer service department I have ever dealt with. It just makes me so ticked off to even leave this review. Absolutely do not hire them. They are the worst and we still have all the crap in our lawn still. If I could give 0 stars I would. Avoid at all costs.
Best sports bar around!! The staff is always welcoming and the kitchen is always getting creative with weekend specials...

Best water I've ever drank!  Their water is so much better tasting than any bottled water out there.  Their water is filtered using reverse osmosis and you can taste the difference.  The water tastes clean, pure, and crisp with no off taste.  I've been coming here for more than 10years, even though it's slightly inconvenient as it's in Meridian and I live in Boise, but it's well worth the drive as it tastes amazing and is more affordable than regular bottled water. Not to mention, the staff is friendly and helpful; often helping me load my jugs of water in my car.  Great little shop!!!

It's a must whenever I'm in town. Where I live, (Pittsburgh) we don't have shops like this one and I sincerely wish we did. Nothing beats a rotating cookie schedule and for a place like Pittsburgh whose famous for "cookie tables" at weddings, I'm not sure why one hasn't surfaced there yet. I'll continue to cross my fingers. We got two cookies to share, the Nutella mudslide and the key lime and coconut. Both were to die for! Always great service, super fast, and always friendly.
The pear margarita and the bloody Mary are noteworthy.  Bottomless mimosas on Sunday 11 - 2.   Fabulous daily specials and the food is amazing.  Recommend getting a reservation on weekends.

Never treated so bad. Found a table with family and sat for over fifteen minutes without even any recognition from any server to even acknowledge our existence. I recognize they were busy, but how absolutely rediculous. Prior experience the food was lack luster at best. Tacos not bad, but won't be going back. So sorry my business is not important to you.

Four stars. I've been a loyal customer for several years now.  The deals are fantastic.  The sales are even better.  The Winter and Summer Clearance and the Shoe Blow Out Sale are legendary.  It's the perfect place for outdoor/sports/casual wear type clothing. 90% of my wardrobe is from Sierra Trading Post.  The staff is friendly and always helpful.  The store clean and well organized.  We are very lucky to have this store here in Boise.

Update 2-5-15:  Two stars.  What happened to Sierra Trading Post Outlet?  Last time I was in, I thought I was at R.E.I. or Cabelas.   Gone are the deals on clothing and shoes.  Now it's just another upper scale-over priced sports wear/outdoor gear store.  Sigh.

Horrible customer service, horrible followup on problems, and complete lack of respect for the homeowners. We had an issue with the landscaper hired by the HOA (Whitney Springs neighborhood) to take care of the common area lawns, but the landscaper decided to mow part of my front yard without permission. In doing so, the broke a sprinkler head but never bothered to mention it. I called the HOA office, was told they would handle it, but nothing happened. After numerous phone calls, I had to threaten legal action against the HOA and the landscaper (Blue Ribbon Landscape Services). Suddenly, my broken sprinkler head was fixed. Did anyone call to tell me they fixed it? No. Did anyone call to apologize for the problem and my inconvenience? No. These people are only concerned with collecting the dues and that's it. Don't count on them if you have an issue.
The service& knowledge I received from this vape shop was awesome! David was AMAZING!!

Terrible experience. Greeted in the parking lot by owner who was on patrol looking for people who are parking in his lot and not dining in his restaurant. While we were getting out of the car he came out and stared at us until I felt so uncomfortable I asked him if everything was ok. Inside the restaurant very few people were in there. We ordered a couple beers and some food to watch the game. Beers arrived warm, like room temp warm. Food was subpar. The ladies workin g were not very friendly. Our experience was poor.
