Didn't look at reviews until we left disappointed and upset. As we were leaving we noticed how many "no parking" signs the owner has posted. Probably owned tow company. Who knows. Avoid this place.

I took my daughter here for her birthday and our experience was garbage. 
I called ahead and was told that we wouldn't need a reservation, just come on in. When we got there we were told that they didn't have time for us. So we made a reservation for a couple of hours later. (Try telling an excited 3 y/o that we have to come back later) 
When we returned for our reserved time, they were STILL too busy for us. So we waited an additional 15 minutes in the waiting area. My daughter picked out two colors for her nails. Eventually a woman came out, told us she'd only be using one of the colors and made my daughter sit on a stack of magazines in the waiting area to get her nails painted. 
That was it-didn't get to sit at the counter or in a nail chair, didn't get her toes done, nothing. The woman didn't even try to check us out, she simply walked away and sat with another customer. Luckily I'd asked the price earlier so I walked over to her, gave cash and then left. 
I felt so bad for my poor baby, and her spoiled birthday nail surprise. How hard is it to be nice to a little girl on her birthday, especially when you're being PAID. 
Terrible customer service.
Went here for drinks and appetizers with the girls. We sat outside, great spot! Wasn't a fan of their drinks but the food was outstanding and it had a nice atmosphere
They give little attention to the patients. Most staff seem to be stressed out and don't give the family the time of day. Nice building poor staff.

Don't ask for tips in the drive-thru.  
I don't know any other place that asks.  
Does management allow and/or encourage this?
Medicap Pharmacy has the difficult to find supplements and always in stock. Happy to find Pure brand so close and not have to order online

We ordered pizza online, which we do often with no problem. The order didn't go through as I placed it, so we received it wrong. Called the manager to let her know. I was told by her she would send a coupon, which never happened. Very disappointing.

These are, without question, the best donuts I've had in my life! I came in on a Saturday at about 11:30 am, and the display case was half empty. But after trying them I can see why, they're so good. Not too sweet and perfectly fried. We ended up trying the cinnamon roll, eclair,  and cream cheese donut and my sons tried their adorable rainbow donuts. We all loved it. Can't wait to return!

I love this salon! It's very nice and clean. Celia made me feel completely comfortable and took time to talk about what I was looking to do. This was my first visit, since I moved here and it turned out great. I am so very happy with Celia and my new color and style!
Completely customer-oriented visit!  Good food, value, variety and super friendly and clean.  Wish we had these in Wa state.  Thanks Chik-fil-a!!

This store is surprisingly well stocked for a small town.  It's better than most Albertsons I went to in Las Vegas.

With all the panic buying and hoarding because of the virus, the employees are really hustling to get shelves stocked as shipments come in.  They really deserve to be commended for hard work and great attitude.

I'm looking forward to things getting back to normal but hey..
liquor isle is fully stocked!  ;-)

We met here for a meeting and the atmosphere is Lively with good overall service. We had a round of drinks and everything was good. However they only have two individual bathrooms which is not enough for this bar and grill. The bathrooms also needed more regular Servicing I would definitely visit again to try the food but was disappointed and the other facilities

We were crazy excited to try crumbl cookies, but weren't super impressed. We tried every flavor and ended up with two raw peach tarts (this was a real bummer considering the cost), really rich but tasty chocolate chocolates, kinda dry chocolate chip and toffee chip cookies, a too sweet birthday cake cookie, and a really very good strawberry cream cheese tart. Everything was a little too sweet. Considering how expensive they are, we expected more.

Our appetizer  (Lobster-Stuffed Avocado) was delicious. Took over 20 minutes to come to the table but worth the wait. We both had fish and chips (cod) and the slaw was tasty. Fries were nice and crisp but our fish batter was a little over cooked (dark). Lunch was a little busy. No wait, but took food a while to come out. Will try it again as we saw some sushi rolls we wouldn't mind trying.

Sad beyond words. Placed order more than 48 hours in advance for a special occasion using their website and recommended delivery service. Order was first delayed, then later canceled an hour after scheduled delivery time with no notice and no explanation or offer for support. They never answer their phone nor can you leave a message so no way to contact regarding support or help. 

I am in California and was arranging a surprise celebration for a family member which was to kick off virtually with the surprise delivery of the baked goods from Sweet Sensations. Unfortunately this was not possible. 

It was suggested I reach out and allow Sweet Sensations an opportunity to offer some restitution in good faith, understanding the situation created by them and their delivery service of choice by canceling after the scheduled delivery date and time had passed. However was not able to make contact with them after multiple attempts. 

Our ask would be for Sweet Sensations to fulfill the original order at no cost to us  (order #623013588830982) including delivery. While not the same impact as had they delivered as committed the first time, it would be a way of creating positive closure on what started as a painful story. Which then could be repeated to others when telling our story, to all parties mutual benefit

Thank you for listening, hoping for positive closure, willing to amend our story and/or leave a follow up review here and Yelp which is my next stop.

Mark

A dive bar with good food and strong, yet difficult to down mixed drinks. Sports bar with chick waitresses and TVs everywhere. I loved the Chili Verde taco, and the Avocado taco was good. Everyone told me I had to try it. Prices are fair. Parking is easy. Definitely a good bar to start or end the night, but I think they close kinda early. Love the outdoor patio more than the inside.

I absolutely love and adore Lush. I'm so glad we finally have one here in the valley and I no longer need to stockpile when visiting California. Not to mention the Location here is the nicest one I've visited, very large and organized. I actually have yet to meet anyone who has been that hasn't fallen in love with Lush! Even my fiancé finds products he loves for himself here (not to mention that he loves the smell of the products I use on me!) Aside from the amazing scent and textures of the soaps, bath bombs and scrubs they sell, you have to respect the fact that their products are all natural and they do not test on animals. I am a customer for life and if you haven't visited yet, you're totally missing out!!

Before we relocated to Meridian to be close to our daughter and her young family, we sold much of our furniture, TVs, and sold the appliances with the home.  So, we needed to buy lots of new furniture and appliances for our new home.  RC Willey was recommended to us, so we ventured into the complete home furnishings store.  We felt like going to RC Willey was like Christmas every day!  We've had great and not-so-great experiences, but in the end, all worked out to our favor. Even now, almost 6 years later, we often go to RC Willey to "check out" newer models of appliances and TVs, furniture, beds, etc.  We even venture into their large Clearance Department. We've never had a "pushy" salesperson, but have had experience of not finding someone to wait on us as the salespersons seem to be in ongoing conversations with each other just passing the time.  We've suggested more "training" through managers. Our only 'issue' has been with a Sony Plasma large screen TV which was installed and had a continuous "band" across the bottom.  RC Willey did send a TV technician to our home to troubleshoot the issue.  Unfortunately, the TV could not be repaired and it just happened to be outside the MFR warranty period, so RC Willey gave us a $500 credit.  But, after 5 years, the TV stopped working all of a sudden.  We should've returned the TV after we first noticed the issue.  The second issue, was the female salesperson who we worked with to buy a large leather sectional sofa sold the sofa to another person after we'd already put a hold on it after entering it "sold" in their system.  The area sales manager was very cordial in working through the problem with us; and they happened to have the same model and color sofa in the SLC warehouse.  
We continue to shop at RC Willey because it's where we find value in our purchases and the wide variety of models and knowledgeable sales staff (for the most part) are helpful, courteous, even if you have to hunt one down.  We do highly recommend RC Willey and will continue our regular trips to the store for their "freebies".

After going back twice after the first time, I see the pattern. No selection and low choice if you are there after 10:30. I don't see how they can stay in business. There were so few things to pick from at 1100(9/24/16) that all I could find to like was an apple fritter. And there were only 2 of those at this time. From a 4 star down to 2 star, maybe even a one star.

They are looking for help, but if they keep going like this, they won't need help as they won't be open. I am going back to DK donuts, at least, they have something to chose from at mid-day.

Running around, it's looking like 1PM on a Saturday, man am I hungry!  So we stop, try KJ's, it's a zoo, so we venture over to the Curb.  Read a few reviews, but like I said I was hungry, so we went in.  Let us be the judge!  Like some of the other reviews, they are accurate that this place is a bit loud.  Lots of people, wind killed any outdoor dining this day, and the inside was stuffed with people.  So, with that, and the acoustics, you get a pretty loud place.  It's a bar and grill, with TV's, Sports, the tall bar like tables, a corner watering hole.  20/30 somethings, and young families seem to be regulars.  The bar action seemed to be brisk as well.  My wife had taco's, as did I.  She did fish and chicken and I did 2 chicken.  Both of mine were good.  I think I made the better pick.  I don't think she cared for the fish taco.  But, as for choices there were plenty (maybe too many), mostly typical bar food, and I think they would be well served to have a few less items on the menu and really concentrate on quality and the items they do best.   It's always a better model.  The poor staff was understaffed.  They worked hard and do their best.  Please give them a break.  I was hungry and cranky and I was able to wait a little more than I wanted to.  You can too.  This is at many places (the low staff levels).  So, I'm not going to rate service as a factor.  It was as good as it could be, and friendly.  

I think Curb have an opportunity here, many good things going for it, with a little more work on the menu, try to tone down the sound, and I think they will see ratings start to rise.  The Curb, the place for OK.

Well, sat down and it took 12 minutes to be acknowledged. Ordered simple foods, because we had a movie to catch in 30 minutes, fish and chips, and chicken tenders. 

May I add there was only one other table, and a couple people at the bar. 

Our food took 25 minutes and the fries were burnt.

We ended up missing our movie, and my dinner date ordered wine, which is on their menu and they couldn't find it. 

So in conclusion, our server was MIA, our food was burnt, we had a lack of alcohol, and it was a waste of our time. You could tell our server(Caleb) was trying, but not very hard. Sad this didn't work out.

I love this place for a yummy sweet but also for a quick treat for a friend or neighbor. Their boxes make them great for gift giving. Love the Sea Salt Toffee! We also tried the Almond Joy and Snickerdoodle. Looking forward to trying other flavors.

Visited recently for my husband's birthday, as it was highly suggested by a lot of friends and coworkers. My husband commented on how noisy the restaurant was, for being barely after 5 PM on an off weekday, and that's the first I've ever heard him say that about a restaurant. It took a while for our server to figure out she was supposed to be at our table, then when asked for a drink menu seemed confused. She said we should have one and even moved our menus around as if we were hiding it, then when she returned with a drink menu, confirmed again we weren't hiding one(?). After our drinks it took several minutes to place an order for food. Then it took another 20 minutes before she came back to say she forgot what we ordered. It only took 10 minutes for the appetizer to come - stuffed mushrooms. They were good but drenched in pico(and did not look like the pics here show). It took a full 30 minutes after that to get our entrees - a prime sandwich and the glazed salmon. My prime sandwich did not look like pictures here. It was good but 3/4 hard baguette. My husband's salmon was a pretty skimpy piece for a $24 entree. Looked like a barely 4oz portion(I know they say fresh but this looked like a frown pre-portion like you get at the store). I guess they thought supplementing it with a pound of zucchini made up for it. My husband isn't the biggest fan of zucchini and thought "roasted vegetables" might mean vegetableS. Not just zucchini. It was also brown and soggy(like precooked hours before and warmed up again?), so wasn't really good for eating anyways. The highlight of the meal was my husband's drink, honestly. The food was basic fare - honestly not much special about it and feels a bit overpriced for what it is. We probably won't return, considering the cost and the experience.

Another disappointing Asian restaurant.  Rice was undercooked.  I don't believe the Bao to be made in-house nor the potstickers.  I venture to say, to save on food cost, the chicken is minced and mixed in with the other ingredients.

Best grocery store I've ever stepped foot in..perfect customer service, displays/stocking, range of available products and Convenience...I'll never shop anywhere else when I come home to idaho. Thank you Albertsons!

The new Market Street definitely exceeded my expectations. The sheer volume and unique selection of so many specialties is endless. Shopping here is more of an experience than a grocery run. Albertsons-you did this one right!

Always had good experiences.. finance and credit departments especially good!!! sales are always smooth, no hassles!!! and always a good selection in all departments. especially like the clearance area!!!
This place is awesome. Great ice cream and shake options. I'm here too often and plan to keep returning.
Great, personable service #1! Good food, nice bar, great interior, comfortable seating, great menu choices.  A winner in the area.

We booked a birthday party here for my daughter they rushed us through the whole birthday there were two young girls that were our hostess they sat back and talked about the presents we got my daughter they would walk by and knock the decorations off the wall they commented on my husband and my brothers looks very unprofessional I feel as though I have wasted my money my daughter didn't even get open her presents because they rushed us through the whole birthday the lines for 30+ minutes to ride anything I do not recommend having a birthday here

This review should be a 4* just based on the drinks and their amazing patio alone, but the service tends to get in the way of that 4th star much of the time. 
Service: 
The servers are usually friendly and helpful in figuring out what to order but man once that order is in... crickets.... no server, no service. Empty water and beer glasses and if the food didn't come out  perfect... good luck getting a hold of the server before it's cold. 
Food:
As mentioned above the food needs some attention a lot of the time once it arrives. Ie improper protein cook temps, no sauce, no dressing, wrong side and sometimes "this isn't what I ordered".  When and if the food is corrected it's usually pretty darn good. I don't think I've ever got the same thing twice just because I'm always looking to try something new.
Pricing:
I think for a lot of the menu (which is a good size menu too) the pricing is appropriate but for the salads and burgers it can be a bit high for what you end up with. 
So if these guys would spend a bit more attention to the small details this would easily be a 4 or possibly even a 5 star review.

My elderly step-dad has been having problems seeing at night while driving.  The factory lights in his Chevy Impala were part of the problem (the other part is simply his eyes).  Travis recommended two high intensity LED light bars behind the front grill, which he subsequently wired to the DRL circuit.  He also tuned the light output/orientation of the LED lightbar beams so as not to blind oncoming drivers.  The results were fantastic.  Now the road is lit-up 3-4 times brighter than the stock headlights (and nobody has flashed their high beams at my step-dad).  Additionally, I was concerned with my step-dad getting rear-ended by a texter, so I wanted to have the astonishingly-weak factory third brake light (non-flashing) replaced with something much stronger.  Travis suggested replacing that with LEDs as well, and added a flasher module that causes the lights to flash in random patterns (again, the results were fantastic).  For my car, Travis rigged up a hidden kill switch (kills power to the starter) as a theft deterrent (my idea).

Travis was great to work with; he even drove out to my parent's place to pick up their car, so my elderly parents wouldn't have to drive it to his shop.  His quotes were accurate and reasonable, he researched and ordered parts in a very timely fashion, and was very fast and efficient in doing the jobs.  On top of all that, the quality of his work (as well as the results of his work) is fantastic.  I'm planning on bringing my car back to him for additional mods (blacking out chrome, replacing more lights with LEDs, etc.), and am looking forward to the results.  I can't recommend his work/Trax Customs more highly.

My mother's VW was towed to Heritage. They thoroughly explained what problems they found and her repair options to her. They provided excellent customer service, they were personal, courteous and professional and made my mother feel comfortable and confident in using them for her auto repairs. Her car is now running great and she highly recommends them!
Love this place. Best thick sandwich and great home made soup. Their carrot juice lemonade is just the best and most refreshing drink.

Yum. Yum. Yum. Yum. 
What more can I say!? Warm cookies, amazing flavors, cold milk and even ice cream!!!

I cannot say enough about the wonderful people who work here. Healthcare workers are wonderful in general but it truly is a rarity to find people who care so incredibly much! Kimberly (nurse practitioner) and Karla (front desk receptionist) make me feel like family every time I see them. If you want a place where the people who work there validate you and make you feel important, go there for your healthcare needs. I go through unity with a monthly wellness program that allows me to pay a flat fee and be seen regularly with no copay! It has been a wonderful experience from the very beginning. Love you guys!

I love this place! The cookies are huge and flavorful. The selections change every week and so far I have loved every one I've tried. The employees at this location are always friendly and welcoming and keep the kitchen very clean. Also not to mention their point system has gotten me a free box of four. Love it!

The drinks are usually decent. The customer service however is lacking considerably. There was a younger guy at the window today who seemed bothered to do his job. I was in the passenger seat so I wasn't paying much attention, other than to grab our drinks. We drove off and I mentioned his crappy customer service. My boyfriend started laughing because apparently he was playing on his phone. Seriously? At the drive thru window? Extremely unprofessional.

Was greeted at the door immediately by a happy person and another happy person took my take out order just as quickly.  The atmosphere was very enticing with great sounds and smells coming from the kitchen. I'll definitely come back real soon.

Everything was fine just the bowling service was fucking terrible they guy who is in charge did not care about he was just slammed the shoes on the table and when we accidentally made a mistake he got hella mad and when we ordered drinks and finished nobody of service showed up and when we finished then they showed up and then we put our shoes on the table the guy in charge of it just Glared and smiled at us when we left

Upon entering the Market Street facility, I thought we were in the wrong building.  In front of us was a wine bar and sports bar with multiple flat screens around tables and chairs.  Then there was a row of food kiosks serving international cuisine.  Then there was a walk-in wine temp-controlled room with quality wines from around the world.  Then there was a meat counter that was the longest I have ever seen with a 20+ day aging chamber for beef on display.  There were a few aisles that had dedicated areas where international food, organized by country, were available, including Basque.

We were only there to pick up some odds and ends while we were visiting friends in Eagle and Meridian.  

The most alarming thing we found was a shopping bag at the checkout.  Yes, they gave out paper bags to shoppers without charging 10 cents to $2.00 like in CA.  When the clerk was finished, she put our items into the bag without lecturing us on the virtues of bringing our own reuseable cloth bag.  She didn't ask whether we wanted to buy a paper or plastic bag.  She didn't call the manager and security personnel over to have us escorted from the building for not bringing our own bags, as is done in CA.  Snowflake lefty Californians will faint away dead when they read this review calling it false and injurious to their idyllic society.  

Just to prove that the bag actually exists, see the pic of it.  You may erroneously think it is a bag, but it is really a Symbol of American Values.  It is also a Emblem of Freedom, freedom from the oppression from a Nanny state like CA.

Locals thought us very odd when we were dancing in the parking lot around our rental car shouting "Viva la Bag, Viva la Bag, Viva la Bag, Viva la Bag"  The really good news is that there were no Prius or Teslas in the parking lot and the individual parking spaces were actually larger than a standard Escalade SUV.  Awesome, Dude, like really.

I have nothing to say but great things about Budget Blinds.

I called to arrange a free consult and the employee came out and let us pick what we liked and measured. It was an incredible price for blinds for our whole house. She then let us know it would be 4-6 weeks which was fine. 6 weeks later, our blinds were installed. The installer was quick and also showed up very early. If I ever need blinds again, I will be using them again!

One of the better sandwiches I have had in Boise. Only downside was no cream in their tomato basil soup. My wife loved that, but you can't beat it when you have cream in it. Haha overall this is a good place with friendly staff.

I never write reviews but this place really did me good not only was the food gas but the employees were so freakin nice I'd visit from Cali again just to go to this place! Thank you guys for the outstanding work

I heard about this place from a relative of mine who said that they have an awesome Gouda grilled cheese. Being a huge fan of Gouda and grilled cheese sandwiches, I had to try it. There is a friendly lady waiting to greet you behind the cash register who was a great deal of help when it came to me deciding what soup to have. I obviously went with Gouda grilled cheese and one of their house soups which was the tomato basil. I am happy to report that the food is awesome. The soup was phenomenal and the sandwich was just as good. Though I wished the sandwich was a bit larger, being a big guy like I am. If you want awesome homemade soups and sandwiches in a clean and friendly environment, then Soup Kettle Grille is a must have experience.

I found this beautiful place Nails Plus and I love it!
Clean, organized, safe and extremely friendly and professional place! Soft music and no one is talking which creates a relaxing and professional atmosphere!
Kay is amazing master of pedicure and set of nails I only visit with her but everyone at the place doing an excellent work ( observation).
I would recommend this place to everyone!
I am very picky client and this place is above and beyond my expectations! Great location in Meridian  next to Rudy's on Overland.

I've been wanting to try this place since this summer, and what better time to try it than after a walk on the Greenbelt in chilly weather?

The restaurant is so professionally laid out and decorated it has almost a franchise feel to it, so I was surprised to find out it was a Mom and pop shop.  I ordered the roasted tomato basil soup and Gouda grilled cheese on the recommendation of the friendly and helpful cashier / server.  Both were excellent - I especially liked the Gouda grilled cheese which was served on soft bread with fresh grilled julienned red peppers and diced onion, with the perfect amount of cheese running out and caramelized on the grill.

On the constructive side, given the price ($12 without a drink) I would have expected a real soup spoon instead of a tiny one wrapped in plastic, and to have my sandwich served on a plate instead of wrapped in butcher paper.

I love getting my monthly facials with Kim! She is so talented at what she does and always comes up with the best regimens for my skin. I have seen her for over a year and love the experience every single time! Will be a forever customer !!!

Meh. I used to go here s lot and had a fav person but she's long gone and I don't live up here anymore. 

My last trip here, someone cut the under skin of my middle toe and that was like 3 years ago. I suffer from ptsd haha and in fact t's still kindof sore to this day. 

I know that is an honest mistake but they didn't really seem to care that my station looked like a kill bill movie and I never came back

So. 3 years later. They were accommodating on a Sunday afternoon for my nieces and I. 

Good color selections -lots of OPI. I don't do gel for toes and I tend to stick with OPI. 

We made an appt since there were 3. They got us In Promptly. But it was strange. My one niece was started approximately 5 minutes before us and she was complete about 20 minutes before us. Didn't feel nurtured at all. 

$25 is a reasonable price for this type of salon but they didn't use a foot scrub, which I expect (and they used to use one)

My feet were not smooth after the process. Granted it's summer and I'm active but ... I wasn't impressed.  The girl told me I need that cheese grater thing that is now outlawed and that there was nothing more she could do. I've been to other inexpensive salons and they took care of it. Seemed lazy. And she was rude. And rough with my toe, even after I told her it was sensitive. 

When I went to pay the girl was aggressive about wanting cash. I didn't have cash and I intended to pay with a credit card. It took a few minutes to resolve and me finally asking her if they want to get paid or not. 

I understand the benefit of cash and in fact try to pay services like this as such but it wasn't the day for me to do it and I felt uncomfortable. I am a business person and I don't pressure people to pay me cash so I can avoid taxes lol. 

Toes look fine. In a pinch it will do.

Went on a Saturday night and the place was packed but I can definitely see why. I got the fish and chips with halibut at the recommendation of our waitress, Abbey, and my wife got the shrimp scampi. Both had lots of flavor and my fish was perfectly crispy on the outside which is a huge dealbreaker for me with fish and chips. They had a great variety of cocktails and desserts as well, and the service was really fast, friendly, and attentive. Even staff who weren't waiting on us all seemed to be very friendly! We will definitely be back and will be telling our friends about Lucky Fins.

This is the mecca of all grocery stores--beautiful, beautiful, beautiful. Everything a grocery store should be! If they'd let me, I'd rent a space and just live there. Staff is friendly, set up is wonderful, and their vast selection of everything was just heaven. Huckleberry's attached to it was a complete bonus. It's far from where I live, not cheap, but it's beautiful and the ambiance just feels . . . heavenly.

LF is one of my most favorite places to go. It has been very different dining out during this pandemic but I recently went to Lucky Fins and although things inside have changed a bit, the food and service was topnotch! Robin waited on us and as always she was amazing and pays attention to every detail. She always remembers my likes and dislikes  probably because I'm so picky which at a lot of places the server gets irritated by that. She has waited on me a few times and is always pleasant and accommodating even when they are slammed. They have a great staff and that's just as important to me as the food. I have not had a bad thing on their menu yet and we've tried a lot of things over the years. I highly recommend the Sushi, Crab when available, appetizers, or any of their daily specials.

I travel for work, and since I was out of town, it'd make more sense to have a PMB than a PO box or going to the post office and requesting a mail hold, which anything with the post office means "return to sender" after 30 days, and I'm not about to spend $550 in airfare for what might be junk mail interspersed with the occasional legit mailing, but having a PMB is almost like having a concierge of sorts, and the biggest winning statement is that they don't mind holding onto mail indefinitely.

I was able to arrange this quickly and easily while I was out of town, and all I had to do was pick up my key once I arrived. Anabelle was friendly and knowledgeable, and the rest of the staff were friendly and eager to help as well; I highly recommend going here for your mailing needs!
Outstanding service and the food was very well prepared! Had the Polynesian Poke Bowl, very good blend of flavorings and the rice was outstanding! Prices very well for the quality of the dish!
Love Trader Joe's! Glad to have them in the Treasure Valley--especially the Meridian store (closer to me and ample parking).

Very good pastries and their ham and cheese croissant was amazing. It has a country cottage charm. It's like a bed and breakfast without the bed. They make everything from scratch, and it shows. The couple who run the shop are very hospitable and fun to talk to.

I have lived in the Boise area for 7 years and just got around to visiting Miss Tami's this year, thanks to a friend.  I've been four times this year and each time it has been amazing.  

I want to say clearly that YOU GET WHAT YOU PAY FOR at Miss Tami's.  Do not expect to go cheap here, because it isn't going to happen.  This is not store bought tea bags and cookies, it is tea fare and food that is created with thought and skill, from fresh ingredients.  My friends and I like to go for the Saturday brunch buffet.  Today, I spent just under $20 (including an 18% gratuity since I was in a group of 7).  I enjoyed freshly baked cookies, sweet rolls and banana bread, a cheese & cauliflower soup, scrambled eggs, fried potatoes, sausage patties, mini monte cristo sandwiches, biscuits and sausage gravy.   I had a pumpkin chai to celebrate October.  Others in my party enjoyed pots of tea, hot chocolate and coffee.   
We were celebrating my birthday today, and I was even surprised with a birthday scone, complete with candle and a chorus of happy birthday!

We reveled in the atmosphere, enjoyed perusing the gift shop, and I believe each of of us left with something to take home, be it a snack, a bit of jewelry, some loose tea, or in my case a CD of music they play in the tea house. Hat are not REQUIRED but they are welcomed.  My friends and I have a lot of fun finding hats to wear, and we turn heads when we visit. 

Reservations are not required, but you really should make one.  After our group this morning, they had the entire place booked, so anyone who tried to stop in after 12:30 was turned away, which is sad, but it happens.  That's what you get when you have a small marvelous establishment in your area. 

Miss Tami and her team are warm, personable and generally love what they do.  Next time you need to relax over a beverage and a nosh, think about heading for Meridian and visiting Miss Tami's.. you'll be glad you did.

This store located at 10Mile & Cherry Ln DOES NOT enforce the mask mandate. I saw over 10+ people milling around the store without a mask and stand 3ft from the staff and the staff said NOTHING. This location is 1/2 mile from our home and it's the 3rd time in 1 month I've see this at this location. We'll start looking elsewhere to spend our money. This location prefers Profits over Public Health. I DON'T recommend this location.

Wow it's like Whole Foods and Albertsons had a genius baby. Ordered a Starbucks before exploring. This is an amazing store. It had the prettiest produce section I've ever seen. And oh boy the wine and meat selection blew my mind. Only bought a few items but had such a fun time wondering and looking around. I'm going to come back, order a fresh pizza and take it into the bar area because how many supermarkets have bars?

I always love coming here. Food is great, can't really go wrong with anything on the menu, and I'm not a huge seafood fan. Service is incredible, our server Robin was very attentive and very welcoming. Give this women a raise!

So unimpressed. 
Their tacos aren't ever filled. They leave off most toppings when ever they feel like it. The food is cold and they take forever to make it. Pick a different location if you want GOOD fast food.

I've sent many shipping items from Postal Annex and bought stamps, supplies, cards and even a pair of handmade earrings. It's been my go-to mailing store for almost two years and I always have a terrific experience because the staff is so helpful and very pleasant! They offer several services and also every option for shipping boxes. I am often surprised at the final cost of a box shipped with two days to arrive to Nevada or California, and once to Kentucky! (And by the way, kudos to FedEx for fast delivery!) Mike and Kristi Hendrickson have a professional and friendly team, and have set a high standard for their client's needs. I highly recommend Postal Annex!! Thank you Mike & Kristi!

So this "bar and grill" serves up Children's menus with a side of Date Rape education to children. I was skeptical about bringing my 9 year olds here as we were looking to treat them to dinner out after baseball practice. But the owners decision to implement that its "good for kids" made it a selection to keep in mind, we called to verify it was a place to bring children before heading over as the woman who answered the phone stated "were a family establishment, not a bar." I'm not dense I know that people come here to drink, that's outside the owners control. But what is in the owners and staffs control is the environment they make. As soon as our food came out, very loudly the song called Date Rape came over the speakers. For those of you whom don't know the lyrics of this song, it talks in detail about a man who rapes a woman. Specific lyrics of the course repeated over and over," If it wasn't for date rape I'd never get laid. And "he now takes it in his behind." Not to mention specially when the singer shouts," SHE LIES THAT LITTLE SLUT." Those specifically that a rowdy group of gentleman screamed with the lyrics causing even more attention to it. Again, the horror my husband and I in dread as our food is in front of us or we would have left. Our server no where to be seen, and not wanting to draw attention to ourselves by having to shout over the bar we endured it. So thanks to this establishment wanting to promote that it welcomes children but yet doesn't follow through to make sure it's appropriate for the clientele, we got to have an uncomfortable dinner with a side of uncomfortable conversation as our children asked us the question, "what is date rape?" We won't be returning but hope that management throughly considers this situation into its future decisions.
Good in a pinch if you haven't had dim sum for a while. With it being delivered though, it is a little more dense of bao than the light and fluffy you might be expecting.

I needed to have some things checked on my car. I tried to get an appointment with the dealership, but the available appointments were to far out. I found Heritage Auto Repair and decided to give them a try. I am very glad I did! They ran a full diagnostic on my car, explained everything to me, letting me know what urgency level to set for each recommended repair/maintenance. They were super helpful and friendly. I intend to use them exclusively from now on. I highly recommend this business.

If I could give a negative 10 stars, I would!  I'm done!  I will not go back.  
I have given them several opportunities to redeem themselves and it just is not happening.  When I pulled in, there were 5 cars in front of me, so I am expecting a wait.  BUT NOT A 45 MINUTE WAIT!!!!!  The food was horrible.  I also paid for a supreme taco and got a regular one.  (No sour cream, no lettuce, etc). The supreme burrito that I order (almost $4) was nothing more than refried beans and a little sour cream which made it all runny.  No cheese, etc.  Disgusting!  Don't waste your precious time or money here!  Also, on a Saturday night they are only open until 7:00 pm????  What?
Taco TIME you have a new customer!!!

Don't even bother unless you want to walk on eggshells your entire lease. Ray is completely rude and acts like he knows everything about you and what you do in your rental. Just look elsewhere and save your sanity.

Great thin crust pizza by slices. It's so good, I ordered whole pizza for my entire family! 
Staffs are always friendly and place is always clean! 
Most importantly, pizza is great!

The only redeemable thing about my experience was my server, Courtney. She was sweet, patient and honest.

First things first, my friend and I had a reservation. I checked in with the hostess and she sat me, making no eye contact and had zero personality. Come to find out my friend had made the reservation at the downtown location. The hostess didn't even check to see if we had a reservation. I was told "we like to seat people regardless of a reservation or not". While I appreciate that, i was under the impression she knew about our reservation, had I been told our reservation wasn't in the system, I would have contacted my friend who was waiting for me downtown. It's her job to be aware and acknowledge my presence, which she barely did.

Secondly, Lucky Fins Gluten Free menu IS NOT Gluten Free. Upon questioning the server she let me know they only have one fryer and the GF claim on the menu doesn't really mean GF. I ordered the lobster stuffed avocado. I was told it could be made GF by not frying it. 20 minutes later I was told there is Gluten in the mix so they couldn't make it. Why did the cook wait 20 minutes to tell the server? All while my friends burger was sitting under the lights getting cold. 

After that I didn't trust the menu at all. The manager didn't even come to the table, she let poor Courtney handle everything. Unprofessional, it's not her job. 

Although they offered to buy my meal, there was nothing I could order. I recently discovered I have a Gluten allergy and have friends who are Celiac. I was afraid to order anything once I discovered the blatant disregard for customers health. If one of my Celiac friends ate here based on the menu claims, they would be in the hospital.

If the owner doesn't take this seriously, he is going to have a serious lawsuit on his hands.  

A sadly I will not be back to Lucky Fins, I was super disappointed because it came highly recommended.

This place is so bomb it literally should be illegal. The Cuban grilled cheese and Mediterranean sandwiches are  and the Thai soup is like liquid gold! Also, if you like boba or Vietnamese coffee, they are the best place to go!

Started off with the calamari and scratch chowder both of which were savory.  I prefer heartier thicker chowder as it was on the soupy side but it was great tasting nonetheless.    The cod fish and chips was excellent and the lobster mac and cheese was really, really good!  The six spice ahi tuna over fried rice was just so so as the six spice sauce came across as confused in what it was supposed to convey on my palate, perhaps too sweet.  The bed of fried rice was good but it was soaked by the spinach and sauce.  Best to have the sauce on the side.  Overall it was a great dining experience with very attentive and helpful staff.

Definitely worth a go.

We will not ever buy from RC Willey again or recommend to someone else. We bought a fridge, dining table, couch set, side tables and a new bed set at the beginning of June and it's been a complete nightmare. The lack of communication between the departments and customer service on the phone and purchasing your items is a complete disaster and incompetent. Getting our fridge, dining table and side tables went surprisingly smooth. However, with our couch set - first, it took several weeks to show up because it came from various warehouses. Then, once it did show up, the loveseat had a huge tear on each side from clearly being cut open by a box cutter. The delivery people "didn't notice" when they brought it in, though they were cut at least a foot long on each side. They told us they took pictures and would submit a claim for us to get a new one. Called the next week, no claim had ever been processed. We were lied to and had to wait even longer for our new chair to come in. As for the bed set, it took 3 months for us to finally receive it! First off, we will never recommend Kim Hilliker, the salesperson, to work with. He was terrible at communicating with us, didn't ever know where our stuff was, and couldn't give us any correct updates anytime you called. Apparently, when you do a special order, you have to put a 10% down payment for it. We were never told that from Kim or customer service while checking out. Two weeks after we placed the order we called Kim to get an update, first he told us COVID was making everything take twice as long so to be patient, then, once we asked him to look further into it, he called us back to let us know the order had been cancelled because there wasn't a 10% down payment on the order. If we hadn't asked him to keep looking, who knows when we would have been informed that our order had been cancelled. He told us he had never heard of the down payment requirement but that we needed to come in and pay it to reorder. So now with this special order that was already 4-6 weeks out, we had to wait even longer to get it because nobody communicated that to us. We ended up going into the store on a Saturday to discuss our frustrations with a manager, they tried calling 2 different mangers but could never "find" or reach one who could come speak with us. We ended up having to talk with a lead supervisor which, halfway through, took a lunch break and passed us on to another supervisor without giving them any background on our situation, so we had to tell the entire story all over again to the new supervisor. Like I said the lack of communication at this business is unreal and very unprofessional. Back to the bed set, we finally ended up getting it on August 28th which was 3 months after we had ordered it. We have told our friends and family about our terrible experience here and actually heard from several others how bad they are with communication, having their items show up damaged, difficulty getting through to customer service, and getting the delivery addresses correct. They may have good prices compared to others here in the Treasure Valley, but we'll go somewhere else where communication is key, and their employees are more proficient, the lower price isn't worth the hassle.

Stopped in at 7:30 on a Monday trying to support a local business. We were pretty much given the evil eye, "we close when the game is over."  Then we were ignored, so we left. My friends and I have dropped hundreds of dollars at this place for lunch meetings since it opened.  That won't be continuing.

Over the moon. My friends and I ordered take out. First time here. I'm sharing with all my friends.  We will be come regulars. I had the Gouda Grilled Cheese with ham, plus the Thai chicken curry soup. Both were excellent.

This place is amazing. I'm from southern California and Albertsons is a dying brand there, but here it was 100 times better than any Trader Joe's. Everyone in the store is friendly, you'll get more samples than at any Costco and they have EVERYTHING. There was even a nice gentlemen in the Beer isle on Saturday that overheard me talking to my husband and recommended a local Idaho Porter which turned out to be my new favorite. 

This place will definitely be my store going forward.
The cheeseburger pizza was a hugely delicious surprise--it's our favorite. The Philly cheesesteak is also a fantastic choice. And the app for ordering and tracking is one of the best out there.

Stopped on the recommendation of my friend Mike, who highly recommended it.  Had the cinnamon roll, big enough to share.  I loved it, so did my family.  Think I dealt with Kay, who was friendly and delightful.  I'll be back, want to try Mike's favorite - ham and cheese croissant. 
Brett

It's dangerous having a Gyro Shack so close to my house. It's one of my favorite places to get a bite without it feeling too much like fast food. Unfortunately the new location was a bit too much like traditional fast food to earn the 4 stars that I've given to other locations. 

They retrofitted an old Subway (yay repurposing!) This location had only been open about a week when I went, so I have lots of grace for the whole operation. The drive through wasn't working and they couldn't hear me waiting to place my order. Luckily a gal out on her break saw me and ran in and told the crew. So I ordered at the window. The worker at the drive through was incredibly sweet but definitely still in training. 

I ordered a custom made gyro. It was regular pita, gyro meat, cucumbers, tomatoes, feta and olives. I love a good briney olive but woohee this was a salty  combination! The meat is already well seasoned, so I should have known. I'll make a different choice next time. The meat was also ok. Crispy but luke warm. They do pack in the meat though which I love, because I always have to share with my tiny human leeches. 

This location serves fries! I was excited to try them. Unfortunately they are a very standard frozen, crinkle fry. Fine, but I won't waste calories on them again. 

One other thing that I'm excited to try is their new bowl option. You can get all the gyro toppings over rice (hopefully basmati!?). I'll report back when I try it next time. 

It's just so hard for me to say no to a gyro and a drive through. My tiny humans loved the meat and veg and fries. We will be back.

I'm a massage therapist who moved to this area 9 months ago. In that time, been looking for a place to get massages myself. Been massaging for 13 years and I've had some excellent massages in the past, so I'm selective about my own therapist.

So far, have been to Natural Foot Spa (Eagle/Chinden) and Golden Massage Spa (Fairview/Locust Grove). Prefer Natural Foot Spa, but both are okay - been to both numerous times. 

Today, tried Spring Massage and got Sarah as my therapist. Requested a foot and lower legs session only as I struggle with plantar fasciilitis. Sarah is the first therapist (in ID) who gave deep enough pressure to relieve my plantar fascia. In fact, I had to ask her to lighten up a bit. Yeah, it was painful at times, but I wanted a more therapeutic session than relaxation.

The place is easy to find, has ample parking available is very clean and quiet. Not sure how many therapists are available, but I got an appointment in a couple of hours. Sarah said it would be better to call in advance instead of walking-in as they have regulars who book up at the same times during the week. They are open 7 days a week, 9:30-9pm. Saw couples tables available, too. 

Sarah is a bit too heavy handed (for me) for a relaxation session, but when I need a therapeutic one, she's the one I'll book. Looking forward to trying other therapists. They also offer a punch card. Get 10 sessions and the 11th (1 hour) is free.

Andrew and Derek did a great job for our group of five. They were courteous professional and made every effort to show us a good time and catch a lot of fish.They are our go to guys the next time we visit Boise.

I'm not even sure if this business rates one star, since they never responded.  DO NOT use this business.  I subscribed to have Tru Green come out and look at my lawn and suggest what could be done.  After 15 days, and no one coming out, I called and cancelled.  The very next day on a Saturday, I received a call from Tru Green "retention," wondering what they could do to keep my business.  After I explained to them that the business had not even started, they stated that they wanted me to continue, and would give me a discount on any service.  I told them that I would wait a week to see if anyone would contact me.  The very next Tuesday, I received a call from Tru Green wanted to schedule aeriation.  When I asked how they knew I needed to have my lawn aeriated, since no one has even seen it, they could not answer that, and only apologized for the long delay.  I cancelled everything.  If this is the manner in which Tru Green conducts business, then they deserve to lose it, certainly mine.

So glad this has reopened under new ownership!   The inside has been totally been redone and looks amazing.  The menu has expanded to include an awesome salad bar and great soup choices.  Definitely recommend.  Best New York style pizza in the Treasure Valley.

Having previously eaten at three other locations including two in Las Vegas and Downtown Disney, I can say that the Earl of Sandwich has not lost any of it's charm. I have been eagerly awaiting the opening of this location, and after finishing my excellent sandwich, I can assure you that I will be visiting again in the near future.

Over the top grocery experience.  A public market with beyond everything you are looking for. Fresh mozzarella made right in front of you? Check.  Tortillas handmade right here, check. Think every grocery option (Whole Foods, Trader Joe's, farmers market) this has it. Plus an awesome bar and dining area.  Wow.

We went here on a quiet night, not a lot of people there. The food was decent and it was a nice place. The service needs a ton of work tho. The guy that was waiting on us really should not be a waiter. He forgot our drinks and didnt check back to have them refilled, he forgot to come back and get my friends 7yr olds order so she didnt get food until about 15min after all of us got our food. The checks were all messed up and there were things added to some of the bills that they didnt even order. But, after everything we just wanted to get out of there. If the service was on the ball this place would be an awesome venue to watch sports or hang with your friends.

This is my home away from home. I've been doing yoga for years but would never consider myself advanced. Every instructor gives great guidance and opportunity for modifications. The studio offers unique workshops and meditations frequently which keep the practice of yoga interesting. I've learned a lot about yoga and myself since going to Body Calm Studio.

And...my husband raves about how great Liz's massages are. I've had a couple myself and she is awesone!

Was really excited to try but was kinda bummed at the results. This place is next to my work so I wanted to try a bunch of things out to get next time. I ordered the Nashville hot Cluck,  Jalepeno poppers and mac and cheese. Mac and cheese looked really good but had about as much flavor as buttered noodles. The Jalepeno poppers came out still frozen. I had them bring me some more but these are just generic frozen poppers. The sandwich needs more flavor. You can't taste any seasoning on the chicken and wasn't spicy. The coleslaw was pretty flavorless and the most flavorful part of the sandwich was the pickles. The service was really good and i'm hoping that they're just working out the kinks of just opening. I'm going to go back in a week or two and hopefully I'll be changing my review.

I saw the big billboard signs in Oregon & Idaho... I stopped by and was very disappointed.  

What an expensive outdoors store.  I hope they remove the word "outlet" from all their signs...

Corey and his his team were AMAZING! My husband and I sold our home in early October in another State. Before we listed it Corey pre approved us and we were able to secure a new build. 
Over the years we have bought and sold several properties and this was the BEST transaction. 
They were very organized and got all the information they needed from the start. There were no surprises, except that Corey was able to get us a lower payment and interest rate!

Oh Lord. I got food poisoning here.  So sick
Never go here 
I think the lettuce was bad. 
I'll spare you the post of a picture.

We had a blonde waitress (longer hair) who was great. 
Food was extremely slow but we got our order in behind a large party, and we know all businesses are short staffed right now. 
Kids meals were good. Good fries and not just Kraft mac n cheese.  Real corkscrew pasta! 
There was no wait on Sunday for lunch.
Clean to the eye.
I'd like to go back and try their brunch sometimes. (French toast sounds good)

I would give 0 stars but it won't let me. So I applied for a home with my husband and even had a cosigner just to be extra sure we were okay. I paid about $38.00 per application and then we received a call that we didn't fill out some information on their application which can't be true because it doesn't let you leave anything blank. The guy who called me could hardly speak English and kept asking for pay stubs that we had already submitted.  Then he would email asking for more pay stubs after my husband had supplied about 6. So of course, we sent them more, little did they know I had been speaking with the actual owner of the house and he said he doesn't really look at credit scores but mainly our income, which we made more than 3x the rent, rental history was great, we've never been late on our rent. So the landlord and I emailed each other last night and he said not to pay the fee yet and he would see where they were with our applications but we had already paid the fee as soon as we submitted our applications. We just got a letter stating we were denied due to our credit score being low. Now if the owner said he doesn't look at that nor care then why are we denied. No one would respond back to us and it was also first come first serve and they said we had submitted our applications first. I feel they just took about $120.00 and now probably going to run someone else's and obviously take their fees. Keep in mind we had a cosigner who had high credit. This was a horrible company and ontop of that, the property has been on the market for a while. Tonight I will be writing BBB.

These donuts were just okay. They weren't terrible but definitely not the best I've ever had. The donuts were soft but a lot of the donuts tasted straight up like oil. Their chocolate frosted donuts were terrible. I'm not sure how you can mess up chocolate but they did. The only donut I enjoyed was the cheesecake donut but honestly it wasn't enough cheesecake on top. I would choose Krispy Kreme over this place any day.

I have been a State Farm customer for 49 years and have multiple policies to cover nearly everything that is in my orbit. Seriously ... I have a lot of policies! I recently moved to Meridian, Idaho and needed to change all my policies from my other State Farm agent because he and his firm are not licensed in Idaho so he could no longer help me here. Anyway, I was referred to Kathy Chambers, met her my first week in Meridian (11/15/19) and immediately realized that I was dealing with a bonafide and delightful professional. She took care of every insurance policy that needed to transfered and jumped right on the task. Since Kathy has been in this market for nearly two decades, she knows a lot of people from different businesses and she definitely knows how things "work" in Idaho and our local markets! Needless to say, she has been immensely helpful in referring me to other professionals I needed to service all kind of different needs. Kathy is definitely my "go to person" when I'm looking for a good referral of any type!

There are 2 things I know for sure:
1) If you want the most reliable insurance company in the U.S.A. you need not look further than State Farm and that comes from 49 years of experience as one of their customers. Also, be mindful of the "lower/lowest" rate insurance companies", even if they have a cute little "General" as their mascot in their commercials. The lowest rates are inconsequential because when you get into "a jam" you will be relieved that you chose State Farm, and isn't that what insurance is all about?

2) if you live in the Treasure Valley (greater Boise, Idaho area), Kathy Chambers has to be the #1 person you should meet!

Thank you Kathy for making my transition to Idaho extremely easy and successful!  :-)
I love this place so much.  I have met others for lunch.  Purchased the prettiest cakes at the best price.  Found my favorite biscuits from England, and seriously just shop here for fun :)

OK I didn't want to tell anybody but the chicken here at the deli the fried chicken is the best in the world. Better than KFC and Popeyes! Please don't buy it all though, leave some for me! It's always fresh and juicy and tastes great! If you get the meal, you'll get 1lb of mojos and 4 dinner rolls for $8.99 definitely recommend!!

71st person to write a review of the Curb, in Meridian Idaho on the corner of Overland and Meridian Rd. This is my 405th Yelp review. 

Again, another place that I've visited that is consistent, has amazing food, and has a lower average rating-- I encourage you to try this place, at least once. The only, and I mean only reason this place gets 4/5 stars for me, is that they are very pricey, to me, albeit really good! 

This is a sports bar primarily. When you walk in, the bar is the main focus and there is seating all around the bar and in the front of the establishment. There is seating outside, too, but I haven't experienced that. We generally sit in one of the booths, which are higher than average and it just seems right! Most of the other seats are high stool like seats, which may be hard for some people. There are a few tables that are normal. 

My dining companion and I shared the chicken lettuce wraps on this last visit-- so good! I liked the creamy wasabi sauce-- he didn't... oh well, more for me. There was more than enough for two grown men to eat this (granted I don't eat much). 

The staff has always been attentive and very polite. I really feel that if you haven't tried this place, you should!

We had an AC malfunction occur on the hottest day (6/8) so far in the year.  Being new to Boise, and to AC (coming from Seattle) there was some panic occurring in our home.  I called the 24 hour line and a very nice woman (I can't remember her name) helped calm me down and told me that the first available appointment would be on 6/16...that did not make me feel good, but I understood that everybody's AC was acting up with the hot weather.  Long story short, the office called the next day and sent Charlie out to help figure out the problem.  Charlie was wonderful...limping around on his broken foot he helped me understand how to efficiently use the AC, how to rearrange furniture to get the best results from the vents, and he topped up the refrigerant.  I was impressed with his knowledge and patience, and was very happy that they were able to squeeze me in during a very busy time!  Thanks again!

I am so glad that New Frontier Club was there to save the night. We were just treated like children by this bar's neighbor Busted Shovel. I was feeling blue and Troy happily let us in to have some beer and play some pool. 
I forgot about all of my troubles thanks to this wonderful staff. I love the variety of beer. Thank-you for a wonderful evening! Oh, note to Busted Shovel I got a free bottled water. The horror!

Found a nail stuck in my tire and I tried to go to Discount.  They didn't answer the phone so I ended up here and I'm glad I did. Super friendly, fast service, professional staff and best of all, no charge for removing the nail.  I know, most places do offer this as a courtesy but still!  Actually turned out to be a screw but either way, it was causing the air to leak out but now, it's as good as new!  Thank you Ariol for your speedy work and the cleanliness of your workplace.

Went on a Sunday and it was pretty busy. Even though it was 95 out. We sat outside due to the noise level. Seems every place these days is "industrial" in the decor, with zero sound absorption. I wear hearing aids which makes it even worse.

Decent selection of beers on tap.

For the food, I had the chipotle chicken salad and my squeeze had the southwestern Cobb salad. The salads were good size. Her Cobb salad was better than mine, as it seemed to have more ingredients. It didn't seem like there was enough beans and corn in mine, but the dressing was good.
Not much more to say about salads.

Service was good.

Love this place! I have been back three times since opening. I love the tacos, I get one grilled and one crispy.  I Love the Cluck sandwich! I love the jalapeno poppers, macaroni and cheese and the hot cheese bites. The staff is always friendly! But what I love the most is their story. Love the truly family owned small business. I cant wait for a location next to my work office!

Being in Meridian the fifteen years, I've seen quite a change in the Boise MCA and still remember the day that Trader Joe's  opened in Boise. Fast Forward to October  this year and now we have a Trader Joe's in the Huckleberry section of the dearly departed Rosauer's grocery store.  The Meridian TJ is larger than the Boise counterpart and wait ... The best part is that there's plenty of parking on Meridian. I love me downtown Boise and everything that goes with it but trying to get into the TJ / Chipotle / Panda Express / MOD Pizza parking lot is a Pain in the --- 

No such issue here in Meridian. The whole Rosauer's parking lot is available for TJ as well as the defunct Gold's gym parking lot.  

There's a lot to love about the Meridian TJ from the expanded flower section, the longer aisles, and dedicated vegetarian / vegan section but the entrance and exit doors are wonky to say the least.  I get it that they were trying to incorporate the structure from Rosauer's but it's  confusing and peculiar.  

The employees are super friendly  and extremely knowledgeable.  The trademark flower printed short sleeved shorts are in colorful abundance.  

Here's some of my fav things to find at TJ 

1. Banana Bread - Its so good and Vegan 

2. Everything Ciabatta Rolls 

3.  Pain  aux Chocolat. - In the frozen section 

4. Oak Milk - Fantastic dairy substitute 

5. Cauliflower Bites - In the frozen section 

6. Greeting Cards. - They are all 99 cents / $1.00 each 

7. All and all flowers. 


If you're looking for Charles Shaw, you'll find him all the way to the right. He may not be two buck chuck but you may find three buck chuck.

What I've noticed is that each Trader Joe's has its own unique flavor and spin. Meridian is no different. It's not as hipster as Boise but it feels like home right here in Meridian.

First visit to this restaurant. What a great surprise, fantastic menu,had a great pumpkin martini.great service.food was innovative and tasty.
Will visit again soon. I would recommend this restaurant to anyone. Prices were very good, quantities large.

My favorite pizza in Meridian. Flat New York style, not too bready. They have great customer service as well. Easy to eat in or take out, and I think you can get it delivered through those new delivery services. Reasonably priced. Crust has a nice aged taste to it. Not SURE if they use 100% olive oil, but it tastes like they use at least some.

CycleBar is awesome! My first time I thought I was going to walk out and puke but I stuck it out and have been going ever since. CycleBar is like a small family! Absolutely love the staff and the instructors are bar none the most motivating and inspiring when it comes to getting the most exhilarating cardio workout! I get much more out of CycleBar in 50 minutes than I ever did at the gym. Where else can you burn 500+ calories in one session WHILE laughing and dancing?! I love this place. Highly recommend.

Was here St. Patty's Day to watch the awesome band but was underwhelmed by the shittiest service I have ever seen. The owner obviously put a lot of time and money into the facility and if I were him, I'd fire all of the upstairs bar staff. They don't care at all. Rude, lazy and utterly worthless. Tables were piled high with empty glasses and bottles. Waitress didn't even ask to take any from our table when she bothered to come by once an hour. As a former bartender, I was embarrassed for them. Someone call Gordon Ramsey and get him over there ASAP because that place needs help! This place will go under by the end of the year if nothing changes- guaranteed.

Terrible! Completely disappointed!!! I am a SF Bay Area native and grew up with Togos.  This store in Meridian is a HUGE disappointment after waiting many years for a Togo's in Boise.  The store has very slow service.  I wouldn't mind the wait because I am a huge fan of the pastrami.  However, the high prices and rude attitude of the franchise owner/managers are an overwhelming bad stench that even the heavenly pastrami cannot mask.  The franchise owners don't want to punch the punch card for each sandwich, but only will give one punch per visit, even if you buy 5 sandwiches.  Also, we got a free birthday sandwich coupon from Togo's corporate, and the owner was hesitant about honoring the coupon -- pretty lousy to be treated that way on your birthday!  We visited this location every day of the 3 day opening weekend and again a few more times since.  The service and attitudes have not improved and the birthday visit this week was the topper.  I will probably wait until my next CA visit before I go to Togos.  Unfortunately, the price gouging greed & stinginess by these franchise owners have misrepresented the good name of Togo's.  As a Togo's fan, it is painful to see this happen.

Aspen Transitional Rehab has a very nice and clean facility. It does not have the medical smells or institutional feel of a common Skilled Nursing Facility. The Physical Therapists and Occupational Therapists do a very good job. They are the anchor of the facility. Most of the CNAs are caring and capable. Some are outstanding. Some CNAs appear to just be working their hours. Most of the LPNs are great and caring. 
The kitchen and dining room is better than most. Better communication with the kitchen would improve the patient experience. 
BUT, Aspen needs management to take an interest in the level of care and establish systems/protocols to make sure patients get all the care they need. Medication dispensing can be haphazard and even troublesome. Special diets could be better accommodated. Patients recovering from surgery need additional protein. Having to chase down a protein shake twice a day is not optimal. The kitchen staff have always been helpful when asked but should have a system that includes the regular provision of additional nutritional needs. 
Housekeeping is clueless. They lose things. There is no process for recovering lost items. Housekeepers smoking outside within the breathing space of patients is unacceptable. 
The administrator appears to be totally disconnected from patients. He never introduced himself. He never checked on them. He sets the model for the culture of care.
Some good talent in this salon...good music!!  Easy to get to location...

It's my first time here at Crumbl.  There weren't any customers but me at the time so I stepped up to the counter and was faced with 2 what looked like iPads.  Not being very good with tech, I was hoping to catch the eye of one of the 6 employees milling about.  Not one approached, however, every time someone new entered, they quickly responded.  Apparently they don't help you figure out how to order, but they do help you when you come in to pick up.  Well it took me a while to figure out the ordering thingy, but eventually (as the line was growing behind me) I did figure it out and ordered one of each cookie for my family to share and try.  

The cookies were intensely sweet and fresh.  The flavors were on point and really did taste like they were named.  The Pina Colada tasted like pineapple and coconut, the maple had a thick fluffy topping and some kind of granular maple sugar filling, the dulce de leche was my favorite because it tasted like cheesecake with a caramel drizzle.  We also tried the sugar cookie and the chocolate chip.  All were good. I found that they're best eaten 1/4th at a time, otherwise they're too rich and sweet for more.  

Now that I know how to order, I will be back!

These people manage the CBH developments. When I was given their number by CBH no one answered. Hours later I got a call back from a Michael Madison and he was rude, combative, and called me an idiot and then chastised me for buying a CBH home. I have no idea why CBH uses this company but they are horrible. To add insult, they never sent anyone out to fix the problem that out entire neighborhood has with flooding. I do not recommend this company.

I am so sad to write this review but unfortunately I will not be returning to Sassy Nails. The girl I wrote about previously is still there and she is great, she is the 5 star review and the rest of the staff, excluding a few of the pedicure only gals, get 1 star. 

I went in a few days ago to have my nails filled and the gel to be redone. Oreanne was off but I was leaving the next day and had no other choice but to go with another technician. I had had one previous experience with a separate technician named Tom and while he was fun, he was rough and rude. The time that I did have Tom, I didn't like the color so after one day of trying to live with the color I returned to Sassy Nails to repainted my nails. I paid for BOTH applications but apparently Tom took me coming back personally and now holds a grudge about it. 

Anyway, back to a few days ago. I had a new technician and I showed her a picture of what I wanted. I was not happy with the application and Tom, who was sitting next to my technician started making a public joke of me to not only her, but also his current client (regarding the one and only time he had done my nails). I was instantly upset. You don't bully your clients into just accepting the product you give them if they're not happy. All I wanted was for my technician to put on one more coat of paint so it wasn't see-through. 

When I did that the entire row of technicians started loudly speaking in a different language to one another - when they hadn't spoke anything but English before my request...Tom actually told the other technicians in English "calm down girls, that's enough being mean."

Needless to say I DID NOT feel welcome. I don't like using the word "bullying" because it portrays someone as being a victim but that is the best word to describe this situation. I felt completely bullied. 

Now not only did all that crap happen but at the end when I went to pay the girl who took my payment answered the phone in the middle of the transaction and somehow that stopped the receipt from coming out. So she tried charging me 3 separate times. When that didn't work my friend tried using their card and it worked so all in all, they charged me AND charged my friend for 30 each for just my nails. Then the lady kept telling me "I didn't charge you it didn't go through over and over BUT it's on my statement that they charged me. 

I'm going to try to go in tomorrow to get this resolved but if they don't resolve it then they just stole $30 from me. We'll see.

We were intrigued to try this place out based off food pics from Google and FB. We sat down and after five minutes we were told by the bartender 'I'm the only person here, hang on'. We felt empathy for the guy, having been in the business ourselves, so we knew he was probably stressed. After about *20 minutes he took our food order... not drinks... but food. Did not offer beers or drinks. When the apps came about 20 minutes after that, I asked if we could get a couple drinks as he was quite literally jogging away from our table, he half acknowledged it and miraculously we got drinks. He came back at the one hour mark to deliver our sons burger and see if we wanted to order food which we declined because we were just not willing to take the gamble on the wait time. He brought a check when we hadn't asked for it, although we weren't dying to hang around, it was just blatantly obvious this individual had no inclination to make more money or a larger tip. Ask if we want more drinks? Nope. Take orders in a timely fashion? Nope. Eventually he had help show up too, and the restaurant was by no mean 'slammed' while we were there. Maybe 15 patrons total. We wanted to like this place, it has great potential, and the food itself wasn't bad, but won't be returning due to the dismal at best service.
My nails look great! The ladies were kind and attentive if my time frame. Will definitely be back.
Drove through today for the first time to try it and was greeted by the sweetest employee who give me recommendations upon my request. I ended up getting the AK special and it was good!
Food is always so tasty and come out fast. The staff is great and helps with any problems. Has a very friendly environment! I've always loved chick-fil-a and always will!!

Terrible service! Next time I will drive the extra five miles to Whole Food where people are welcoming. Kindness is universal and maybe if they were following their own sign and wearing masks, I would not have seen the long unhappy faces. Third time here and they are a strikeout

Best nail salon in the Treasure Valley. Their products are top notch which is so good for my nails. The techs are true artists and really go above and beyond what you ask. 

I also appreciate their safety protocols and cleanliness since the coronavirus outbreak. Everyone was wearing masks, they took my temperature, all clients wash their hands upon arrival AND there are clear plexiglass panels between client and techs. 

Thank you for keeping us all safe.

Excellent place!!   I'm
Soooo glad I read reviews of all the other places before deciding to go here.

Unlike other places this one is new and clean, staff are all great, skilled massages, beds are well made - don't creak or move.   Very accommodating for appointments last minute or walk in.

I'm not from here but I'll be telling all my local friends!

This laundry place is awesome. 
It's super clean. So many washers and dryers. From a tiny to the extra big washers and driers.
The lady behind the counter is very helpful. She came to help me as I was too overwhelmed with what I need to get my laundry done. Thanks for the big help

Absolute worst customer service ever.  I can't walk through the door without being solicited to purchase additional products/services but when I ask for info or clarification, there doesn't seem to be any consistency in the information offered and I am often offered shrugs as answers.  So frustrating.

I love this bar. We have been here several times. The bartender you had here on 12/04/21 at night was terrible. He got engrossed with one customer and forgot others for long periods. It was frustrating.

As I was reading Larry's post about towels, I had the same experience from Dale just prior to Larry being approached. Maybe it is Dale's sense of humor, but he really lacks a true customer service approach when confronting a customer of the gym. I was first approached by two trainers and asked if I had my towel, I said yes and it is in my bag. They left and 15 minutes later Dale approached me and asked if I had a towel. And gave him the same reply and he proceeded to goad me and said well I don't see it, three times. Now, either this is his funny sense of humor or non professional way of customer service, or he maybe he needs additional training from management. It would have been nice for him to say, well sir, we are implementing a mandatory towel practice for all of our members and it is needed to be carried on your person at all times. Thank you for your support and patronage. And if there are any questions or concerns, please let me know. Simple huh? Overall, I really like Axiom and the people who work at the Meridian location. The majority of equipment is in good shape and they have a good variety to satisfy most of my workout needs.

This review will be short, but sweet.....
A bit pricey, but totally delicious every one. Free donut holes with every order! I had the cheesecake donut & the chocolate old fashioned, both rich & satisfying.

I am so impressed! I have been looking for a new nail salon after my last experience at another shop in Meridian.  I have had several people recommend Glamour Nails, so I decided to give them a try. I called to make an appointment for a fill and they were able to get me in that same day. Yay! 
When I walked in, I was immediately greeted by both people who were working (I later found out that they are the owners, Kim & Billy). Kim told me to pick my nail color and told me that Billy would be the one doing my nails.  
Billy asked if I was happy with the current shape & length of my nails and I told him that I was not.  I explained what happened at the other shop & said that I wasn't sure what, if anything, could be done to fix the mess that was on my fingers.  I told him that they were supposed to have been coffin shaped, but it didn't happen.  He told me that he could fix them & I could do coffin or stiletto shape. I was so happy!!! I decided to do stiletto. Billy quickly & meticulously fixed and reshaped my nails. He created a prefect stiletto! I was so impressed! He did great work.
