The atmosphere & energy at the shop is great! The owners know most of the clients by name.  They are really friendly and funny.  It's nice to see everyone having a good time chatting & relaxing while getting their nails done. In addition to nail services, they offer waxing and eyelash extensions. The prices are reasonable & the workmanship can't be beat. 
I am happy to say that I have finally found my "home". 

*I suggest calling ahead for an appointment....they are a busy shop!
Very hit and miss experiences. When you order right it is great but when you don't it's not. The fish and chips are not good but the lobster tater tots were bomb.

Came in to get a sandwich. Went to the deli and asked if I could get a sandwich made. The bearded guy in the back flippantly said "we make premade sandwiches". I replied that I knew that but my husband can't have those. He then reluctantly began to start the process. He was asking normal questions (type of meat, bread, etc) but it was his passive aggressive tone of voice that make me feel attacked. I asked him to please stop talking to me so passive aggressively. He gave some rude response to which I replied, forget it and left the store. Well I mentioned what happened to my husband and he decided to go back in, it was his sandwich after all. The situation didn't end well. There was no accountability and the assistant deli manager did nothing to remedy the problem. So disappointed.  If you hate your job don't take it out on me.

We had poor service and even worse food. The meat options took over 25 minutes to be done and were incredibly salty and tough. The "salad" was only undressed shredded cabbage, literally nothing else. The employees were all very young high school guys that were using phones and talking to friends who came in to visit. Definitely won't be back.

Food is always delicious. The prime sandwich and stuffed avacado are my favorites. Also the Shrimp Diablo when it is on the special. I have never had anything less than excellent service here and appreciate the enforcement of masks It is one of the few places in Idaho we go to eat during the COVID restrictions.

If I could, I would do away with the Meridian USPS. While some pf the employees are truly doing a yeoman's job, too many seem to be operating with a sub-average IQ.

The first thing I have to say is that I am going to stop doing mail-order business with any company that uses the USPS for the "last mile" delivery. Yesterday they said they had tried to deliver, but had to leave a note as to why they didn't. No note, so on this weekend I am wondering where the package is? It is the USPS at its lowest.

Second, their idiocy has seen as getting all the political mailers for Meridian, but not for Eagle. Why? Because, we are part of the 83646 Zip which is handled out of the Meridian Office, So all the automated addressing machines stick Meridian on our address, rather than Eagle. The Assessor and County Clerk know of the changes, but the USPS refuses to change their addressing. So we get Meridian mailers, but pay Eagle taxes.

Is it any wonder they lose billions of $$ every year?

I used to love this place but sadly will not be returning. 
I went in for a manicure 2 days before my wedding photos to get gel nail polish on and she didn't even touch my cuticles. She didn't push them back or trim them. They looked awful after less than a week. No lotion, no hand massage, no nothing. I was in and out in 15 minutes even after waiting 25 minutes PAST my scheduled appointment. I had also called the day before to see if I could have a friend join and they said no they were all booked... but took two walk ins while I was there? And started them before me. Wouldn't recommend.

A big fat 0 - that's what they get.  Ugh.  I wish I had read some of these reviews before getting caught in the TruGreen trap as someone else mentioned.  Last year they did an aeration for us.  End.  A few days ago, got an email stating they were on their way to aerate within 30 minutes of when I saw the email.  We did not order another aeration since last year, however, thought we might want to do it again.  However, our yard is significantly smaller than last year due to landscaping and I wanted an estimate for the smaller space.  Tried to call and ended on hold close to 20 minutes.  Hung up, tried again, waited long while only to be forwarded at end to voicemail box that was full and then the system hangs up on you.  UGH.  Guy shows up.  I tell him issues and ask for estimate before work is done.  He can't give estimate - takes pics on my lawn - no measuring, just pics.  No word back from them for an estimate.  Today, another message - this time phone message telling me they are coming tomorrow morning to aerate!  I call them, wait indefinetely.  Hang up, try again, wait, FINALLY get a real live person.  Tell her my story and she interrupts, not wanting to hear it to end.  I loudly say, "Excuse me, I'm not finished."  The nerve.  She apologizes for all and says she can get me an estimate.  I tell her here's what I want from TruGreen - I do not want any further emails, snail mail, phone calls, etc.  Take me off all your lists and do not contact me further ever.  She gives me another canned reply - well, if you would just let me give you an estimate, maybe... I cut her off and repeat the exact instructions back to her again.  She apologizes and says she'll make a note.  We shall see.  They are dishonest at best.

I do not recommend this place they are way over priced and have horrible management I knew a worker there and they treated them like crap and they manipulate people they also treat there guest like crap DO NOT GO HERE!
Very delicious food,clean service neat and tidy.must  come again. Friendly service and polite and would recommend it without hesitation.

Gina Piercecchi Anderson is  wonderful hair stylist. She knows what shes doing. You know when you go to a place for the first time and you don't know exactly what you want but you do. Well I only showed her a pick and she said "ok let's do this"...I just moved here from California and actually met her in a group on facebook called "Moving from California to Idaho". So many great suggestions in that group if you are new to Idaho. Anyway, I saw her post and she mentioned she works at a hair salon called Maven Loft Salon in Meridian. I made an appointment for my daughter and I and am so happy with her. If you are in the area of Meridian or just moving here from where ever....you found your next stylist! She's wonderful...put down that phone book or tablet and call her you already know your go to person!!!!
Thank you Gina!! :)

Corey Newell provided the most amazing service we have ever experienced in applying for a home loan. From our preapproval -- from out-of-state -- to loan approval, he demonstrated the highest level of integrity, always responding promptly and knowledgeably. Corey is one of those "can do" professionals who helped us to make a difficult life transition (moving to a new state) just that much easier -- and even had loan approval nearly two weeks early! Highest recommendations for Corey Newell, Evergreen Home Loans Boise, and his wonderful staff!

Kay did my nails! She was very thorough, friendly, and even got the supplies out again when she wanted to perfect the design. They also have a huge selection of colors as well and added the option for dip nails.

Best Albertsons in the state! They have an Asian section food court where they sell sushi bentos and OMG poke bowls! We from Hawaii so when we can get poke bowls in the mainland that's a bonus!! They get other stuff like pizza, bakery, salads, etc! So much stuff in this store! And an international section!!

I was blown away at how helpful and nice everyone was who works there. I appreciate you taking your time Emma to educate me on trailers and helping me load them into my big truck! You guys took your time to help us take off a seat that wouldn't work, and you exchanged it without any issues or making us feel bad. You will now be the only bike shop we use! Thanks for being awesome! Highly recommend this establishment!!!!!

great service - extra limes with my diet coke!
and lobster tater tots!
that's it - drop the mic....
The pizza and hot sandwiches here are great.  I especially like the take-n-bake pizzas.  My kids love this place.

Got their burger with ham and cheese,  gluten free bun..... not so impressed.  The burger was super thin,  small slice of ham - definitely not with the $8 it cost.  Fries were fine but could be a little crisper. My hubby really enjoyed their onion rings, they looked great but I didn't try them.  Their malt and shakes are good,  so well keep this place for deserts,  but get our meal elsewhere.

GO SEE THESE PEOPLE!! This may come off a bit long-winded but I have a lot to say about the staff at SlyceBox Meridian. Rick and his crew were absolutely phenomenal! My now wife and I decided to do our wedding reception on their patio rooftop as that is where we had our first date. When we had this idea and ran it past Rick, he was honored to do that for us and was so very diligent in the planning process. Between making sure the pizzas were fired at the right time, to setting up the tables and storing our cake, they went out of the way to make sure we had a perfect evening (which we did)! The pizza was delicious and if you haven't been here yet, what are you waiting for..?? The Potato-Bacon is a fan favorite and if you don't like that, you should definitely try the Mac & Cheese pizza. I would give them 20/10 if I could because they have great food, a fun atmosphere but most importantly they aim to provide a top-notch customer service experience!

BEWARE!!!

I've been trying to cancel my membership for weeks since moving away from the area and they have not reached back out. I am STILL getting billed during this time. Juxtapose this with when youre trying to SIGN-UP and they will roll out the red carpet for you. Not to mention how crowded these gyms can get. 

There are many other gyms around this area that you can go to:
-YMCA (income based gym rates/great pool and facility)
-Idaho Fitness Factory
-The Mecca

RUN away from this gym.

Buyer beware again!  You sign up for a 3 month PT and they charge you for 4 and then take even more out of your account then you agreed to. These guys are thieves. If this is how a business stays around by stealing people's monies off their credit cards, no thanks. Run, do not even go in into the club.  BTW, they talk crap about their competition when you are in there. They actually told me about Idaho Athletic and all of their issues by telling me which members said what about their memberships. This is a horrible place. You might as well go in and let them steal your money from you while you watch.

My girlfriend and I are always searching for great chicken sandwiches and when this one opened we were super excited to try it. We lived in SoCal before moving up here a year ago and we've had very little luck in finding a good chicken sandwich in the treasure valley. 

Honestly we both really wanted to like this place because the staff was amazing and the food came out in good time. Unfortunately the sandwich was no so impressive. Chicken was a bit dry and the hottest level was not very hot at all and did not have enough flavor, which does not resemble a true Nashville hot chicken sandwich. Coming from Southern California, places like this are everywhere and we've had some amazing sandwiches, unfortunately this one fell way short of our expectations 

We'll try again someday just because the staff and environment was awesome and hopefully we will add more stars.
This place has the BEST Pizza! Get the pepperoni with extra cheese! My mouth is watering just thinking about this Pizza!

By far the best frozen yogurt experience. Our server Kate H. was friendly, helpful, and overall outstanding. She helped us pick our flavors and she basically read our minds. They were so delicious. We will be back, we hope to see Kate again.

The team is always kind and accommodating. We have an older dog with special needs so it can be trickier to get him in for a groom. The groomers and front office team worked with him and made it an overall great experience. Oddie always comes out looking dapper and happy. 

The storefront is full of awesome treats and we always leave with more than we came in with. 

I would highly recommend them if you are looking for a groomer.

We thought we would try this place out due to all the great looking pictures on their website, with all due respect the shrimp cocktail tasted like water when you bit into it! My halibut was overcooked my husband's mahi-mahi was overcooked and hard. The service was great along with the drinks  calamari was good. We're not sure if we'd go back again.
Place was ok! I only got a basic pedicure but my friend got a gel pedicure and the nail tech never full took off her older gel so it looked a little funky on her big toe. Overall it's ok!

so here's the deal, chicken phenomenal idk what they do to it before they serve it/how they bless it but *chefs kiss* 10/10. my one issue: company invest in some pretty shady shit and is over all homophobic so like imma have to give the restaurant all together a -495/10. if you even an ounce of a conscience you won't support them.

OK, I left my review and received what I assumed was the standard reply to contact them directly at the site they provided.  I did, was contacted the next day, and I am not kidding, they made everything right.  No one is more surprised than me.  They refunded most of the cost of the useless extended warranty on the couch, contacted the manufacturer of the new chair and parts were delivered today (still waiting for the tech to come repair it), the appliance salesman did contact me and our washer/dryer were delivered on time and professionally installed.  I was told they will work on the hold times.  It would, of course, be better not to have had the bad experiences in the first place but I will give credit where credit is due. Thanks for making these stressful times better!

WOW! Where has the service gone?? Did it dive along with the place being a dive bar? I used to come here often, but my sister is right. Busted Shovel is not the same as it used to be. 
I went to Busted Shovel to meet someone to have a drink and shoot some pool. We were there for a few minutes waiting for a table. 
This lady with a condescending demeanor approached us and asked us what we wanted to drink. At that very moment I didn't have a drink in mind since we were only there for a few minutes. She stood there getting more and more agitated with our presence. I could feel that she was getting even more cranky.
So, I asked for a water to start. She got all uppity and said in a very condescending tone, "You BETTER order a drink." Really?? Wow, there are so many things I can say that I will not say here. What a rude individual. It will be a wonder this bar will stay open with this "positive" attitude; boy, are places closing down fast around here we have no place else to go have fun. 
My date and I debated about giving Busted Shovel any business and we went to the bar next door. The Frontier is clearly hopping because they have more professionalism than the Busted Shovel will ever have again.

Always a hit! The flavors here are very versatile and I have never been disappointed. There's lots of indoor seating for those colder winter months. They have a wide selection of freshly baked goods, too! I love the cake batter flavor with lots of fruit. There's raspberries and strawberries as well as raspberry and strawberry syrup.

Omg... Soup.... Sandwiches....soup to go
All soups are made IN HOUSE
Today I tried the buffalo chicken... Omg just the right amount of heat... Full of flavor... My Ruben one of the best and a half sandwich is HUGE. The employees and the OWNER very friendly. This is my new favorite place when wanting soup. 
And if you follow them on Facebook you have a chance to win a free quart of soup... Weekly winners

Best Lobster Mac in town! Service is incredible even with all the covid stuff going on. A big shout out to Robin our server, You really added to our experience and we look forward to coming in and seeing you again!

Was having a bad day when my tire had a screw in it. Called around looking for a place that could help me immediately. Les Schwab Tire Center really came through and took me in right away. Sitting in the clean lobby waiting for the tire to be fixed I could see how well run the business is. Thank you to everyone there. This is how a business should be run!

My wife has taken the day off from work for a trugreen rep to fix our sprinklers. We got an alert that he was on his way around 8, when he hadn't shown up at 1pm we called and found out he didn't have the tools he needed. So he just DIDNT SHOW UP. Still calling trying to get some assistance though to little avail and much incompetence.
Edit: private messaged as requested, heard back following day to reschedule.
Final edit: Larry came out to look at my shut off valve and while there was nothing he could do to repair it, he was knowledgeable and had excellent customer service. Perhaps Larry could start his own sprinkler business??? Increased rating by one star.

I signed up with TruGreen almost two years ago and have paid through two seasons of lawn care (8 lawn service visits each year for a total of 16 lawn service visits that include weed/pesticide sprays, fertilizer applications, over seeding, and aeration service...amounting to approx. $575-600 a year).  I have been given a paper receipt upon completion of each service but just recently decided to create an account and log in online to manage the service.  I was shocked (and honestly feel stupid for not checking earlier) that I have been being billed for service on a 1860 square ft lawn that I knew immediately was barely over 500 square ft.  I went out and measured our two grass strips along the drive way (twice) and came up with 540 square ft total.  Being overly conservative on the measurement (it's a lawn with several curves and different widths) I would say it's 600 square ft- being very generous with the measurements.  I went through all of the receipts for the past two years and found that the various service techs indicated they 'treated' 1860 sq ft of lawn with amounts of fertilizer, pesticides, or seed (indicated with exact amounts of gallons of fertilizer/pesticide or pounds of seed for example) to cover 1860 square ft...which means they either over saturated my lawn or fraudulently billed me for services not rendered (I think the latter as my lawn would have regularly been treated with over 3 times the amount of weed/grub pesticides or seed necessary).  Surely one of the many different lawn techs who serviced our lawn should have realized the lawn is 1/3 the size of what they indicated they treated???  Again- I blame myself for not checking my account earlier- I gave them the benefit of doubt and got burned.  I have already tried to cancel my service but have received no reply from 'corporate'.   I tried calling but was put on hold due to them being 'short staffed due to COVID' and eventually disconnected.  I'm sure I will eventually get through and be able to cancel my service before the fraud starts again next year.  I should have just taken care of our lawn myself and done it right and for less money.  If you need a lawn care service look elsewhere- their are many out there and hopefully you (and your lawn) will not get burned.

Matrix is the best vape shop in the area in my opinion, no one takes care of me or helps me out more than they do , if you come in looking for juices the don't try to just push the new stuff on you that ask you what you like and go from there . They also have a massive selection of juices and mods , they probably have the best quality selection and size. I would definitely say go check them out because they are super nice and really helpful.

Been there a few times have always had a great experience..but the last time my friend and I were double charged for the one Ruben we ate and shared and we paid for our drink a as we went but was also charged agsin for them.. Don't suggest going there when they are to busy.. Or make sure you get a receipt each time you pay for your drink.. Other than that karaoke there was fun and they have a lot of people who like to sing.. Definitly a relaxed dive bar..

BUYER BEWARE!! I was lied to. They can take the pervious 5 star review and toss it. We were told we could return the mattress protector ($200) if we decide to not keep the bed. LIES! We were told we would be out $200 for delivery but they wouldn't charge us for the $200 to pick it up. LIES! We are now having to buy $200 to return the bed. We're out $600 for the trying the bed for 30 days. We also spent $200 on blankets and pillows that I now regret. So $800 on this stupid bed that we aren't keeping. The bed gets hot. When when called to try to return (must have bed for 30 days) they told us they could give us a topper for free, so there is hope for someone who may want to keep their bed. I am going to contact Better Business Bureau now. Oh and our information was sold to marketers. Probably the information off the Sleep Number App as well. 


I had a great experience at Sleep Number! When we walked in, Lee greeted us. I could tell that he was genuine right away. It didn't feel like a car dealership at first but it started to as things progressed. Buying a bed really is an investment. Most of us spend near equal parts of the day at work and then in bed. Ok I might sound like I'm still trying to justify our purchase, but yes I am! Just like a car, a bed isn't exactly the best investment. It's definitely a necessary one, especially since our water bed didn't have much of a 'return of investment.' Getting back to our experience, we did decide to finance. We tried to lower the cost of things like the delivery charge by going to pick up the bed ourselves but because we bought a California King (husband in 6'4") we couldn't pick up in store. Also we had to buy a mattress pad to keep the 10 year warranty on the mattress. It is a neat mattress pad-it can go in the dryer! We added to our purchase with extras like pillows and blankets. Adding pillows and things does lower the cost, the best way to explain this is to check their website. I really do like the faux fur throw blankets! Excited for our bed, and excited that I hopefully won't need the chiropractor as often!

My husband said he was in the mood for some soup so I typed "Soup" in the Yelp search and up comes Soup Kettle Grille in Meridian.

It was a easy restaurant to find right off Overland.  They also had a drive thru as well but we were in the mood to go inside and explore.  The restaurant is small but adequate because it really doesn't take long to eat anyways.  The girl behind the counter wore a mask and was very friendly.  We both opted for the 1/2 grilled Gouda cheese sandwich with a bowl of tomato basil soup.  With no drinks the total was $19.04.  Very reasonable indeed. 

We sat down at a table and the girl brought a tray over with our food.   The portions were great and when we mentioned it was our first time at the restaurant, she also brought us back a sample of two of there other soups to try.  Very nice of her. 

The soups were very tasty and the sandwich was delicious as well.  The cheese was melted out of the sides of the bread and was a little crispy from grilling which gave it a even better flavor.  We're definitely adding this to our list of places.  Especially when you can use the drive thru and purchase 32oz packaged soups to go as well.   Picture a really cold night when you want something warm and don't want to leave your warm car.  

This is your place if your looking for comfort food.  Yummy
Not gourmet by a long shot, but not bad unless the person being held prisoner in the kiosk is bent on revenge for ordering 17 variations of gyro. I say thumbs sideways. Hot sauce good, heartburn bad.

Nice people & service to start! Greeted quickly and a quick glance showed lots of happy,  eating people!  

I asked for suggestions and was told the Biscuits & Gravy weren't "like everyone elses" and home made sausage was good and the waitress said most people love and comment about their hashbrowns.  I'm super picky about hashbrowns....let's see about that!

So...let me say..GREAT hash browns! Soft in the center,  crunchy on the outside AND no chemical-ly taste of processed potatoes..just nice fresh Yukon Gold potatoes-YUM!  The rest was pretty good too, the menu said a side of bacon was 2 pieces but 4 pieces were served.  My eggs were slightly undercooked for me but rest of the table said theirs were fine.  We split biscuits & gravy...pretty good, more of a slightly beefy base with tasty herbs.  The home made sausage was a winner too.

We'll be back....so many more choices and we didn't have room to try the huckleberry pancakes!
Awesome and varied daily specials.  Frequent customer but still haven't been able to decide which is better - the food or the service!

Great hometown business people. After getting my best price from chain appliance outlet (s) including my Military Veterans discount, RC Willey beat them by $260.00 on 3 appliance package deal. Then we picked out dining room table w/6 chairs on last day of Labor Day sale, saved another $200.00 dealing w/Rueben and Steve the store Mgr. No hassle, no pressure just overall great business acumen, pleasant atmosphere and honest employees. Five (5) stars out of 5. 
Maa, USN Ret.

Pretty good place overall. Reminds me of a fancier sports clips and not your classic barber shop but for the quality of the cut and the cost I give them an A. They also give you free drinks which is really cool.

I was a first time homebuyer and a out of state buyer to boot . Cory and his team was Great although the process ! The whole process was unbelievably easy from the electronic online signings that I was able to do before hand made the whole process a breeze! I would highly recommend Evergreen Home Loans !

Hands down, best fish and chips I have ever had! They're sushi menu is also a plus! Great tasting food and great in door dinning & the waiters are actually nice. Their Strawberry lemonade is also made with real strawberries which I was amazed at as well. Definitely going to be a spot to come to often now.

But this stores customer service help line is the worst of any company I have ever worked with.
My 4 year old LG Fridge needs a service its leaked / leaking water all over my hardwood floors. Wait till Monday to call.
12/6/21  3 plus hours on hold or being passed around by Customer service until being hung up on. Called back and went the please leave your # and they will call you approach.   Ya that never happened

This was our second visit to Lucky Finns. I ordered the seared scallops and ahi tuna. Tuna and scallops were tender. It came with flash fried cauliflower... and since cauliflower is bland I expected this to be flavored with spices.... nothing had any flavor what so ever. We had to ask for salt.  Didn't make much of a difference.  If we go back this one dish I will not order. 
My husband had the fish and chips (cod) and was pleased.

Upon arriving I was greeted and welcomed into an amazing salon atmosphere. The decor was beautiful and the vibe was relaxing. So many talented artist. I saw Abbie Ray she was very professional and did an amazing job with copying what I wanted. She is super friendly and down to earth. I was impressed with how much I paid as I budgeted and expected to pay way more than I was charged! Can't wait to return!

I love great soup, so I was very excited to try this restaurant. SKG has 100+ soups, six of which are available fresh daily and a take-home freezer section that features over 20 different rotating selections in quart size. I envisioned getting a flight of soups (3 cups of three different soups) and taking home several different quarts. Did I mention how much I love soup? Well, it was not to be. I was very disappointed. 

I tried samples of four of the six soups available, but none of them were well-seasoned or very flavorful. The Roasted Tomato Basil was the worst version of this particular flavor that I have ever had.  had. It was not cream-based, tomatoes did not taste roasted and the basil was practically non-existent. Great versions of Tomato Basil soup can be found at Bacon (formerly Berryhill's) and Richard's. The Buffalo Chicken was bland and had very little chicken. The Mac and Cheese was bland and had few noodles. The Roasted Potato Leek had more body than any of the other three soups, but it was very bland. 

SKG also has 3 salads, 5 grilled cheese and 5 cold sandwiches on the menu, as well as Carrot Lemonade. I got the Reuben Grilled Cheese which costs $8.15 (with tax) and comes with no side. Adding a cup of soup will cost $2.99 pre-tax. The sandwich was o.k. but overpriced when you consider that these are really grilled cheese sandwiches with a few ingredients added. 

The Carrot Lemonade is neither carrot juice nor lemonade. Imagine watered down carrot juice with a small hint of lemon and you've got the idea.

SKG has plenty of free parking and is nicely decorated, but essentially it's a glorified fast food restaurant that is independently owned. I love the idea behind it, but it is poorly executed. I think the owner would be wise to start with a rotation of 20 great soups and build on from there, rather than
offer 100+ soups, none of which are likely to be stellar, based on the four that I sampled. 

I have Richard's recipe for Tomato Basil, which I would be happy to give to the owner free of charge, so he/she can start moving in the right direction. There is a reason that this soup has been offered daily at Richard's restaurants ever since he open his first location in Hyde Park many years ago. 

I did think that the staff were very nice and friendly. 

If the focal point of this restaurant was grilled cheese sandwiches, I would have given a three-star rating, even though I feel the sandwiches are overpriced and appear to have been grilled with a weight on then, which results in a very thin and flattened sandwich. However, given that soups are their primary focus, I cannot ignore that this item is SKG's weakness.

Order:
8" double layer
White cake with custard and fresh berries in the middle/filling
White buttercream frosting on the outside with purple marbling 
Gold drizzle on one edge 
With a few gold dusted fresh berries and a pear on top
The message: Happy Birthday We Love You


What we received... 
8" double layer white cake with a cream filling no berries
White buttercream frosting with turquoise green marbling 
Gold drizzle around the entire outside
The entire top was covered in a pile of frosting and topped with berries to make it look like there was a lot of fruit on it with wedges of chocolate chunks sticking out and
NO MESSAGE

NO HAPPY BIRTHDAY. NOTHING. 

Best part was... I saw a cake just like it in the display. They did NOT make what I ordered.

Soup Kettle Grille delivers tasty food and "soup-erior" service in a fast-casual-order-at-the counter format.  The restaurant is not a franchise or chain, as the name might suggest, but a locally owned 'mom and pop shop' where you feel warm welcome the minute you walk in the door.  Serving scratch-made soup and grilled sandwiches (which may be the star here) for eating in or taking out along with frozen soup by the quart, this has potential to be a gem but for woefully uncomfortable "sardine can" table set up. 

THE DRILL:  Walk in and straight ahead to the counter where the friendliest person will answer your questions, take your order and offer you a sample of soup(s) of your choice if you're undecided on which o choose from the roughly half a dozen they have listed on their menu board.  (Note:  Buffalo Chicken is their best seller.)

They make more than 30 kinds of soup, half a dozen or so available hot for in-house or take-out in options that change weekly with many other varieties frozen by the quart in a case near the counter.

Place your order for eat in, take a seat, if you can get to it at the tables in the sparkling clean but sardine-can-tight dining area and they will deliver to your table.  Soup is served in heavy duty plastic cups or bowls with plastic spoons and a slice of bread in a paper sleeve. They'll clear the table for you when time permits, or you can easily bus your own to a 'service counter' at the window wall near the front of the eating area.   If your order is to go, they'll call your name when ready.  

THE EATS:  The grilled sandwiches smelled great and looked really tasty as we saw other people enjoying them, but 2/3 way through a two week diet, we opted for 3 cups of soup to share 2 ways.  For the record they were Roasted Tomato, Potato Leek and Buffalo Chicken and we would order them again although I did wish there was sea salt on the table to add to the former.  Cost: $4ish each ordered like this, about $3ish if you add a cup with a sandwich.  Soups that are Vegetarian or Gluten Free are marked, soups with dairy are marked, and there are also options that are noted as Vegan.  This is easy dining for Ominvores to Vegans and people with food allergies too. 

We picked up a couple of quarts of frozen soup in other flavors on the way out. Caribbean Black Bean (vegan) was surprisingly bland when we had it at home.  Spicy Sweet Potato Chipotle (vegetarian) had a hefty smokey chili kick. 

LIBATIONS:  Do not miss the Carrot Lemonade (@$2.80 for @16 oz)!  It is just barely sweet and uses fresh squeezed lemon juice with carrot juice.  A treat.

THE VIBE:  Ahhh...roma as you enter from cheese grilling in sandwiches almost seems to tug and hug you through the door.  Warm greeting from the people at the counter add to the sense of welcome.  As downside, I realize they need tables with chairs to put diners' fannies in, but the sardine-can sense of so many in a small space is the thing I'd wave my scepter to change were I 'The Queen' and have them remove a four top and rearrange for more "breathin' room".  It is the way too tight seats that will keep me from going back to eat in.  They've jammed seats for about 42 inside what would better hold 36 and be tight at that.  

THIS N THAT:

1) PARKING:  Private lot for the little strip mall has a good amount.

2) ACCESSIBILITY:  ADA compliant parking in the lot.  Level in the door. All on one floor.  Accessible loo (says my spouse, I didn't check.)  Tight table seating and aisles would make wheelchair access impossible.  I talked to the owner.  She realizes this is a problem and says staff would move furniture as necessary for a disabled customer to get to a table.  But the 28 year old civil rights law that is ADA says equal access to tables for disabled diners must exist as standard, not as workaround moving of furniture.  If US Rep Tammy Duckworth, who uses a wheelchair after losing her legs in wartime service as a Blackhawk pilot, were to come in here, she shouldn't have to be embarrassed and need to wait for 'musical tables'.  She should be able to take a seat like everyone else.

3) GOOD NEIGHBOR:  Sofra Bosnian is right next door.  It was empty as we walked by both to and from Soup Kettle Grille, which was doing a brisk business including folks waiting in line.

This review is not for the whole Kleiner Park, which is a very nice park for kids and adults (and would get a 4 or 5 star rating), but for the inclusion of this park in the off leash dog category by Yelp. It they had a zero star, I would give it for this category. 

There is NO enclosed area for off-leash running of dogs. For a temporary trial, the Meridian Parks (MPRD) allowed certain areas around the lake to be an off-leash area for dogs. It appeared that this was an experiment to try and drive geese off the grass and paths and to minimize the goose poop. At times, it became a veritable mine field for humanoid walking in those areas when geese called it their home. However, there is no "official" language in the MPRD for Kleiner Park web pages saying whether this has been continued or not. (I would assume not.) In any event, I would not trust my dogs to run off leash in this park unless you were 210% assured of them being under unerring voice command. A dog with high prey and hunting instincts is liable to chase wildlife or other animals. With moving cars, this is a prescription for doggie disaster.

Currently there is no dedicated off-leash dog park in Meridian. Plans for a new dog park at Storey Park are in the works, but that will not be until at least 2015. They told me that there are a lot of $30-$40 rotors out there but they only use the very best rotor in the industry that's why they cost more.  I goggled the rotor (part # 980636R) from the quote that they gave me and Amazon sells them for $33.78.  To me, that's a $30-$40 rotor.  They charge us $174.99 each for them.........again, YIKES!!!  Be smart, do your research!

A fan of the United States Post Office?  It can't be. How is that possible?  Well it is. Let's start with how affordable it is to ship something via the USPS.  Let's start with US First Class Shipping. 

If your item is less than 13 ounces and fits the right dimensions, you can ship US First Class mail. It's about a 2 to 3 bucks across the USA and it comes with free tracking. 

If your item is more than 13 ounces, your best bet is to do the Flat Rate Shipping.  Guess what, the Flat Rate boxes and envelopes are FREE.  Yes, you heard me  FREE. Let me spell it out for you. F-R-E-E.  I know you're saying, " What's the catch?"  There is no catch. go to their website and order your supplies.  Here's the run down on the supplies. 

The Flat Rate Box can double as Flat Rate or Priority Express Mail.  Flat Rate is typically two to three business days while the Priority is the next day.  Sometimes the Flat Rate and Priority Mail can be the same day.  If it does not need to be there absolutely positively overnight, just ship it Flat Rate. Flat Rate comes with $50 of insurance and Free tracking. 

Go to www.usps.com Click on Postal Store, Then on the right, click on FREE SHIPPING SUPPLIES

Order the Dual Use Priority Mail / Flat Rate Box 
11" x 8-1/2 x 5-1/2 

OR 

Dual Use Priority Mail / Flat Rate Box 11-7/8 x 3- 3/8 x 13-5/8 

If you are a Padded Envelope fanatic like me, you can also order the Priority Mail Padded Flat Rate Envelope. 9-1/2 x 12-1/2


Now that you have your FREE supplies, you are on your way to go to the Meridian Post Office. 

Your agents are Valerie, Amy, and Mark on most days. They are all great and customer focused.  Most likely you will be in line about 10-12 people deep. Most of the customers in front of you don't know how to mail or didn't take advantage of the FREE Supplies and the others are picking up their packages with their little brown slips. 

You can always use the two automated machines in the lobby. They will work with your Flat Rate boxes and padded envelopes. 

If you choose to see Valerie, Amy, or Mark, here's some tips. 

(1) Answer their question whether or not the item is fragile, liquid or hazardous. Matter of fact, check online before you go whether or not the item you are sending can be sent via USPS. 
(2) Know when you want the item to be delivered
(3) They will ask you if you need further mailing supplies or cash back so be prepared. 


Lastly, don't be that guy or gal that walks in and does the sigh of all time. I appreciate their service and the fact they do it so efficiently. Plus, I'm saving a bundle by shipping via the USPS.

If you don't happen to eat all your cookies in one day, microwave it for 8-10 seconds and it's nice and warm again! Yum!

Love this "healthy water" source for remediating contaminated (chlorine, fluoride, other...) water supply into my home! Bill has what you need to resolve the water problems in your life Thank you Bill for your devotion to an otherwise serious slow life killer

Pretty unimpressed with the gym.
It's aesthetically appealing, until you see the piece of equipment to person ratio is staggering. Get in line to use anything, or prepare to share. 
Axiom can't help that they are popular or in a convenient location for many people. 
I suppose the only solution to "thin out the herd" is to raise membership requirements/prices?
Their basketball court is amazing, until you realize it is impossible for a working adult to ever be given the opportunity to use it. Want to shoot around before 8? Too bad. Want to shoot after 4? Nah sorry. It's okay the kids go to bed at 8, so you should be able to use it at 9, 10 or even 11, right? Nope. Nice try but they lock that court up until about 12 am. Pretty lame. A beautiful, giant court being used by 0 people for a total of 4 hours. I have not been impressed with Axiom's changes thus far.

I was in need of repair services on my Samsung refrigerator due to the water system not working correctly. Jeff, who works for Lake appliance repair appeared at my house in a timely manner to check out the system and address my needs. Jeff was very professional in his demeanor and extremely helpful in his solution to my problem. I have to give him personally, and due to to his connection to Lake Appliances, as well many kudos for a job well done.  I highly recommend that anyone who needs assistance regarding Appliances give Jeff and Lake Appliances a call and a chance to meet your needs!

The Advanced Heating and Cooling associates are very professional and efficient. Communication before the service was excellent.  They installed our central a/c and provided a five year warranty.  They called us to set up a maintenance service.  We got a call before the technician arrived, and he arrived as promised at the scheduled time.  
The work was done quickly and although I did not shadow him, I think he did a good job and I did see a new filter box. He took all trash away.
There was no charge for this service, which took about 45 minutes. 
Apollo presented himself neatly dressed and clean.  He was respectful and knowledgeable. I think this company is excellent
The few times I've had to go to a laundromat, I've been very pleased with the business.

Hate to see a 4 Star place slide so low. The wife and friends went for a gals breakfast today and noticed that things have gone to the literal hell in a hand basket. Here are their observations:

1) All different help.
2) Poor service, tardy refills.
3) Coffee has gone back to weak swill.
4) Burnet toast served.
5) Smaller portions by a considerable margin from before.
6) Higher prices.
7) Not as crowded as before.

So one must assume that something drastic has happened, like maybe a change of ownership or management?

In summary, we have written them off from further meals.

I can't wait for these guys to open up their new place in Kuna. I love coming here for a couple of slices and a cold PBR always a dollar.  Friendly staff and every time I've been in I've loved the music.
Came here for an assorted dozen and we were loaded up with a wonderful variety of pastries! I even got a whipped cream and strawberry donut for myself. Fast friendly service and delicious donuts!

Friendly service, amazing sangria (at $8.95 for a half carafe with enough for 2 glasses each!), tasty chips and salsa, and best of all for this time of year *toasty warm*  inside.  Unfortunately while the food was good, neither Sherry's chicken fajitas nor my chicken en mole were anything to write home about.  Still, this would make a great place to meet friends for apps and drinks.

The salesman we had was very knowledgeable and worked hard on our behalf.  However, the store was TERRIBLE about making sure the items we purchased were delivered in a timely manner.  They delivered a broken couch, we waited for weeks to get it replaced, and the chair we ordered didn't arrive until almost two months after the order date.  We got excuse after excuse, and "the left hand had no idea what the right hand was doing. "  Customer service never returned phone calls.  Be sure to get the delivery date IN WRITING, and be promised a CASH refund if they don't follow through.  They will tell you they don't give cash refunds - only in-store credit.
Became a quick go to after the first time. Very authentic flavors and wide variety. Their cherry empanada is great!

This is an all around dessert spot; they had self serve frozen yogurt, shaved ice, cakes, cookies, cheesecakes, ice cream and more. We had the shaved ice and a slice of cheesecake, which were both okay. 

The restaurant was a definite French feel to it; it probably would have been nice if they stuck with French desserts? The menu is all over the place. However, it was pretty busy so I guess its a popular spot with the locals.

Have never been disappointed. You can sample their soups and they are all really tasty, fresh and unique. I had Thai Chicken and I'm still craving it a few days later. Pair it with a sandwich for a great meal. The turkey chipotle was amazing. Lots of meat and fresh veggies. I should come here more often!

My son loves the parkour class and the instructors.  Seems like a great class to get some good coaching and improve his skills.  However, the lady at the front desk was somethings else.  She obviously doesn't like her job and does not prefer to have any human interaction. I don't write reviews often, but felt Danik needed to know they are hindering their business by keeping this lady as their face of the company.  Every interaction I've had  with her is obviously a nuisance.  I hope the people who own Danik reads the reviews and does something about it.  All the other reviews I've read, mention how rude this lady is.  Best of luck!

Ordered from this place through DoorDash and it was fire will come back for sure 
Idk why Yelp keeps making me write more to post this review, but here we are lol

This gym has continued to get worse, the maintenance of equipment is substandard.  There are equipment out of service signs that have been there for weeks. I spoke with the manager a couple of months ago about some of the equipment issues;  she told me to go online and write a review because she couldn't do anything about it. I have worked out at the village and cole road gyms, they don't seem to have the same problem. I am seriously considering another gym.

5 stars @ Karen Curbside pick up 3-18-20
at 2p.m.

Thank you for helping my elderly mother get her drive up and go food order.

Exceptional customer service.

Rude and unprofessional doesn't even explain half of it.  Ray has no filter and talks down to everyone. Very demeaning  and overbearing and it is worse if you are a woman. I loved all the chicken options when I visited Nashville. Clucks definitely provides excellent chicken options. It's high quality chicken made to your spicy preference. I ordered the Chicken and Waffle. The spicy honey was awesome! We shared an order of the Dirty Bird fries. The queso sauce Dirty Bird fries was fantastic with the pico and chicken. The environment bright and vibrant and very enjoyable. The bathrooms were super clean as was the whole place. 

Overall, I highly recommend everyone check this awesome spot out!

It's smaller when you walk in, there are plenty of tables but they're very close together to the point where you need to walk side-by-side. They offer quite a bit of different options with sandwiches, soup, and anything else in between. They also had gluten and dairy free items. I ordered a loaded potato soup and their Gouda grilled cheese, they were both good but the cheese melted into the plastic wrapping which I didn't like picking out the paper while eating it.

No curved edges.  We can't do that.". So I showed him the door.  He was here less than a minute.  Total douchebag.

I needed some help learning my AC system and I called Advanced​ Heating & Cooling. The technician who came out,​ Apollo, was really professional and would answer any question I had about the system. He helped me learn the system much better, and now I am not worried about next month when we are going to be a full house of out of town guests in the heat of August.

DO NOT STAY HERE!  It looks great when you tour the facility & the staff is friendly, but, and this is huge BUT, they do not provide the level of care you'd expect. My mom was admitted post op for a femur fracture. We had two issues with the care provided there.

One, my mom told 2 CNAs on different days that she had a bladder infection. She was told the nurse would be informed so she could be tested. It never happened.

Two, and this is a huge one, my mom got SALMONELLA from eating there. She had horrible diarrhea & was diapered, which led to open sores, which led to SEPSIS! It is single bed occupancy here, the staff is on top of it & friendly & my mom has a beautiful view of the foothills from her bed. I sure wish we had started here!

This is one of my husband and I's favorite date night places to go! Delicious food, beautiful place and overall nice people and staff. Their crab legs are absolutely amazing! Always look forward to eating here!

I've taken my kids here about six times now.  The kids will stay hours, but the ticket prices are expensive. I highly recommend going on a day with discounts.
The food WAS great.  They recently changed to a smaller menu, and got rid of the Asian salad that I loved.  I tried the pretzel and it was hard as a rock.  
My other issue is that the menu didn't state an up charge for certain things and the waiter didn't warn me either.  So I let my kids change fries to tots and got a $2 fee each! They also switched to chocolate milk for a $1.50 fee.  You could imagine my surprise when I received the bill.  A small, frozen food kids meal turned out to be $12.  
They also got rid of the wazookie dessert which disappointed my kids. 
Wi-fi is good.
*note - they are limited right now and rotating attractions. Not everything is open at once, but you pay the same price.

BEWARE BUYERS! I took my truck in for a trade in on another truck. Of course they low balled me on trade in. December 1 2020 is when this all took place. This place is the best! I love it. There are very few places where I would order anything on the menu because everything is made so well-- this is one of those places. The service is amazing, and if they are busy it's for a reason and worth the wait! I recommend the carne asada burrito, normally I substitute french fries for the rice and beans. Also the speedy platter is amazing and the hot salsa is very good. Im a regular here and the food is always great and the staff is always on it.

This place is a joke. The ice cream is good but I was the only car in the drive-thru. Took over 10 minutes to get 1 Boston Shake.  Employees in the window are playing, wrestling, and laughing as I sat and waited. When it finally came a girl sat it on the counter it sat there for 3 min until another girl came to the window, took an order then finally handed it to me. After all that it was the wrong size. Over price the staff is not very friendly could have went to movies cheap everything is super expensive  hope you have a big wallet pojos has the same game for 1/4 of the price my kids had more fun there then at wahooz I will never ever go back just a big fat RIP off

Ok damn. I haven't been to a laundromat for a decade. Out of travel needs (ran out of clean clothes) found this place and damn. Modern. All run by RFID prepaid cards. Reasonable prices. I may never be back as I'm not from here, but this was a great experience that I was dreading.

Pretty good doughnuts, appropriately-priced, plenty left toward the end of a Saturday. My son liked the gummy bears on a chocolate doughnut, which was a nice touch. I would have liked a wider selection but I will be back.

Absolutely love this place! The staff are so knowledgeable and professional. They take really great care of you and the results are amazing! Prices are fair and they don't pressure you into buying anything. I will definitely continue to see John and his great team!
Ordered takeout for three people. Corona Village does it right! Not only did they get the whole order correct and on time, the food was delicious
Cyclebar is so much fun and such a great environment to get a workout in! All of the instructors are encouraging and always have a great playlist.

We read the review in the Idaho Statesman and drove to Meridian to try it. Got there at 1:50, they close at 2 (on a Saturday which is strange) but we were turned away! The soup might be delicious, I wish I could say, but alas I may never know.  Just some friendly advice to the manager, if you close at 2, you should be prepared to serve customers until OR after 2, especially when you've just had an article written about you.

Update- After seeing the owner/manager's snarky response I wanted to let you know that had you apologized for the inconvenience and invited us back rather than pointed out how wrong we were and how we neglected to read the signs about your closing rules (because we all know the first thing a new customer does is read all the signs posted in a restaurant), we would have given your store another try.

Ok if your not a regular I guess they don't care, but if they had done a good job I would have liked to become a regular.  Seated at 11:20 for an 11:00 appt, no big deal I'm not in a hurry, water was scalding so didn't start soaking my feet until 11:30 after I asked 3 times for water to be adjusted...(regulars with 11:30 & 11:15 appts got started before me) starts out good with hot towels, warm lavender lotion warm stones, then very little attention to my heels and bottom of my feet and now a crappy nail polish job and uneven filing.  I recently moved here and just want a good pedicure.  So far 4 places tried and not a decent nail polish file job at any of them

Today I had my first appointment with Elma and it was great. I would recommend this place to everyone! She did my nails perfect, clean and fast service, even the price was fair. I'm sure I will be her client for a long time...

Homemade soup goes a long way
with me!  We got the baked potato soup and the reuben sandwich.  Both were very good!  Great 'go to' place when you want something good and don't want to cook.

This was a very nice surprise in that the service was fantastic (everyone smiled and provided suggestions as to what was good to order), the size of the empananada was larger than expected (quite filling as a result) and the various offerings tasted quite good.   

Will certainly come back for more.

This is a food place and their cashier is open mouth chewing gum while also asking me for a tip. The gross hygienic issues on top of being sold out of two different cookies and waiting almost 15 minutes for a single cookie, I will not be coming back here.
Sushi is okay but not great, salmon fish and chips are very good. Nice staff/ friendly and accommodating.  Will keep going and trying more dishes!

Cassandra, the three maintenance requests you mentioned were for my neighbor. Insect infestation I thought was the landlord's responsibility. I brought up the mold in the toilet tank (it was black inside) when I couldn't explain the ring in the bowl and finally opened. I was told the  black was from the minerals in city water.

This place has steadily gone downhill over the last year. Ordered a Cobb Salad yesterday as usual and not only was it much smaller than in the past but the avocado was rock hard and the rest of the veggies sucked too. Won't be back.
Best place ever! Super clean staff are amazing. And the ease of all the machines and payments. Makes a once a month trip for our family of 6. Truly enjoyable.  You have to give this place a try.

I signed up for a monthly unlimited membership a few days ago.  The girl who helped me was very nice & answered all of my questions & gave me a great tour of the location. The salon was very clean, the beds look very well maintained, & they have a lot of different beds to choose from.  This location does not have any level 1 beds. But since I wasn't looking for a level 1, it wasn't a big deal to me.  
I didn't give a 5 star review because there were a couple of things that bugged me.  The main thing that bothered me is that they charge a sign up fee. That fee is normally $50, but it was discounted as a promotion for February and therefore was $20. I have a bit of a hard time paying a fee for someone to take my money every month! I mean you are auto debiting my credit card. It's not difficult at all. I purchased a pair of eyewear & a packet of lotion because I accidentally left mine at home. While discussing the packet of lotion that I was going to buy I explained to the girl that I did not want one with niacin in it because I am allergic. She informed me that none of the products contain niacin. I told her that most of the sizzle potions contain niacin.  She had no clue. This a a bit scary.  The people working need to know that niacin is in lotions & whenever someone uses a lotion with niacin it's important to clean the bed extra well because it doesn't come off like a regular lotion with bronzer.  The other thing that bugged me was the next day I came in to tan & there was a woman in front of my signing up for the EXACT same thing I paid for the day before & the employee gave her a free pair of eyewear & lotion packet.  I didn't get free eyewear or lotion. What the heck??
Anyhow, overall, I am satisfied with the salon so far.

I am writing a great review for the bakery I purchased a happy 60th birthday black and gold cake from a picture and they created it exactly like the picture not only was a beautiful and tasted good but the price was wonderful I highly recommend them.
It was truly amazing
I visited to find some Eastern European food and got really great service and products, I enjoyed my visit and will be back soon!

Living here is like living on a resort. The staff are extremely professional. The amenities are second to none - especially the pool and dog run. It's a perfect place to call home as we transition to live in Idaho. I'd recommend this community to anyone.

Alicia was so helpful and kind, she helped me figure out my shade, moisturizer, primer, and spa selection. Thank you girl! Other blonde girl was growly and not friendly. 
Versa Spa Pro was clutch!
EDIT:
My tan was a little blotchy so i went back in. Alicia was there, comped my charge and offered a free mystic tan. Also helped me by giving me a tip to use epsom salt to scrub off the undesired marks. 
Really pleased with my service!

Correct, Not Good, GREAT!

Fire the Disaster Recover Chief and hire someone else, it's affecting your customer base.

I called and they said to test it by isolating the chamber by capping it off. I did it and I'm still fat. It deflated. That told me, and them, that the chamber is broke.
I tried calling the support center in New Orleans. Twice. On hold for :30 each time with no connect. I finally called the local shop where we bought them and the first call I only got the standard, "here's our 800 number and please use chat online". Chat was disabled, and 800 number wouldn't connect me because there were so many people calling in.
So I went online and tried to fill out the customer service form for help. I then got a call from Jessica at the local store I just called and she gave me a "secret" number (or two) and said "call these, they'll help".
After I got done almost spraining an eye muscle from my eyeroll, I called the "secret" number. OMG, they answered!!! SHUT UP!!!!
Well, I told them what happened and within about 5 mins. they had a new chamber in the mail. 
Thanks Jessica!!!

The only reason I give it 4 stars is because of the broken chamber. :( Other than that, 5 stars.

OH!! and we bought one for our RV and it's great !!!! A C4 model, not the explosive compound either.

So, I didn't buy tires here (yet) but came in on a very busy and rainy weekday with a tire going low due to a piece of metal I picked up and even though they were very busy got me right in and out with the tire fixed and sent me out the door AT NO CHARGE. Now that is not only service...that's KINDNESS! Everyone was all smiles. I will be back to buy tires here. I will support a business and employees like this.

Prior to my move to Boise I did some research online to find a State Farm agent in Idaho to handle the transfer of my policies. Fortunately, I contacted Kathy Chambers first, and after a few minutes on the phone, I knew I had found a great agent. Kathy took care of everything related to my home, auto and umbrella policies before I arrived in Boise, and later provided helpful advice on scheduling an appointment with the Ada County DMV. Kathy is very responsive, knows her business, and is wonderful to work with. Great agents like Kathy are why I've been a State Farm client for more than 40 years!

This store was operating without following any COVID guidelines for safe operations. Employees were not wearing masks and not enforcing the shoppers to wear them. It's like 210000 people did not die and we are not living during the pandemic.

We visited today and had soup and a half sandwich each. Everything was excellent and served up quick and hot.  The grilled Gouda cheese sandwich was perfect and nicely done.  Nice seating area and easy to get in and out.  We'll be back.  
Cheers!

I love Tennessee hot chicken - at least I do in Tennessee.  This version is tasteless chicken with a tasteless coating, dipped in Buffalo wing hot sauce, and placed on a large tasteless bun with some coleslaw and a pickle. It barely tasted like chicken, and it's not cheep (sic).  $26 for 2 sandwiches, 2 cokes, and 1 fry.  The fries are heavily coated and don't taste like potatoes. The coke cups are small, and refills are necessary - but the straws are twice as tall as the cups for some reason. Be careful not to poke your eye. 
Greasy Kentucky Fried Chicken is better. At least it has the flavor of chicken.
This post office is usually pretty busy and I wish it had longer hours.  The staff are professional and have always been willing to do whatever they can to help you.

We got a couple drinks and a couple cookies in the drive thru.  The raspberry graham cookie was super good.  I think it's the cookie of the month.  The drinks we got were really good and the service was great.  The best part has to be the names of the drinks on the menu.  Got quite the chuckle.  Will be back for sure.

I have great Boise yelp friends. They're funny, kind, generous and very photogenic. Chanda, one of those friends, treated me to a facial which I would have never gotten for myself. Here's how it went. 

Sara, the esthetician, is just lovely. She knows what she is doing and I trust her with my life. All you need to know is that there are hot towels, an arm/hand massage, relaxing music, a comfy blanket, and in the end a much better face. 

I can confidently say that after my facial, I felt the most zen I've ever felt in my whole life. I felt like I was lying in a field of grass, surrounded by green hills, staring at fluffy white clouds in a blue sky, with no one and nothing around for miles. Just a soft breeze, crisp air, and the sound of birds chirping in the distance. Zen. 

No hesitation, 5 stars. 

Thank you Chanda.

The question is... what don't they have? Awesome store! We spent too much time in the bar listening to live music and having dinner and drinks that we didn't make it through the entire store before closing since it was just the "soft opening". Guess we'll have to come back tomorrow!

The tech went into my backyard unannounced and I caught him spraying my two golden retrievers in the face with weed killer.  When I called for immediate medical need of chemical safety sheets and the companies dilution percentage they wouldn't give me answers even though poison control needed the info right away.  Absolutely disgusting.  If you care about your pets do not use them.

This is the 2nd time Jesses has serviced our rugs.  He is always cordial and professional.  He explained and offered an additional deodorizer.  Once he was finished we did a walk through of the rooms he just completed.  He explained the time needed for the rug to dry and warned us about placing furniture omn to soon because the wood frame may bleed into the rug.

We will let the rug dry completely.  Good job to Jesse.  Great hard work and quality customer service...

Gabe
Awesome food and staff!!! The brunch was amazing they open at 10!! Drinks were on point can't beat endless mimosas!!

Wow.  We've done business with RC Willey a number of times before, but this time everyone just really went out of their way to make this a fabulous experience.

I've been to Argentina 5 times and always get empanadas so I saw this place and decided to try it out. Their empanadas are the real McCoy! They are very delicious and authentic. Thanks !

I've been here many times and I always come back! I love this little spot as a healthier drive-thru food alternative. The ingredients are fresh and it's worth having to wait a little bit knowing your food was made to order on the spot. I love their red spicy sauce and the crinkle cut fries too! The kids working there are always friendly and make sure to get things just how you want them.

Our family lives close to this Albertsons - we were a little concerned about the increase in traffic that it would bring but we are especially happy with this store. Genuine employees - I've never asked a question that wasn't answered kindly or left unanswered. They're super sweet to my children and I've loved the selection of food that they brought in.

I love Crumbl!! I can't wait to see the weekly flavors! I've always had a positive experience at this location, inside the store and with delivery.

I love this place and the selection of food they have. I'm also digging the wine/beer area and the food court. What I'm not digging is that girl at the bakery area yesterday grabbing my wifes cookies that she ordered with her bare f*cking hands. I would've caused a scene on the spot but I was shocked. Outside of that this place is great but beware of some of the hygiene practices at the food court.
