If you tend towards addiction tendencies, you should not try this place. O.M.G. 

Imagine, if you will, tender and flaky pie crusts filled with savory meat fillings, perfectly seasoned and sauced. Then, imagine following that up with sweet ones filled with Bavarian cream, Nutella or pumpkin.

This place is fabulous; however I regret stopping because now I know bliss exists with reasonable prices and a drive thru.

Yum yum yum and yum

I've been to this location multi times now- & during the era of Covid -19... I must say I'm very impressed. Racks are spaced out, social Distancing is actively encouraged to employees & masks are provided to anyone without one. Hand sanitizer is also available at multi convenient locations- as well as masks are avail for sale for adults & children at the front of the store. This is one of the few places I've felt ok shopping at- as a high risk person. So whether u need slippers a pan or a pillow- let alone a pullover- come shop at this store doing it right!
First time here. The gyro I had was very tasty. The gal who served me at the drive-thru was nice.

We booked our reservation through their website and found out when we arrived that the reservation was at their Boise location. The hostess at the Meridian location checked her accommodations and worked us in within 30 minutes!! Great food and awesome service!!

I've been going to this salon for a long time now. The staff is always caring and funny, making the experience amazing. Also if you're looking for a place to fulfill your Pinterest nail dreams, this is the place!

Loaf of fresh Russian Rye Bread $5
1 lb. tube of Mortadella
1 lb. tube of Chicken Bologna
1 can chicken pate
1 can paprika chicken pate

Equals $23 and a week of lunches or one big Saturday picnic for 8-10.

The Rye bread is fresh every day and is simply stunning.

There are thousands of other Eastern European products and mountains of various frozen perogies.

You deserve a visit and a sampling of their goods.  There is an indoor dining area.

All the ladies were cheerful and helpful.  

To all the COVID whiners - no masks because they are no longer mandated by the elite oppressors.

Well, we bought there again. One item had to be ordered. Okay we will do it. It came in early, BBUT when we went to pick it up, we heard our name and went into the loading office. They gave it to some one else!. Can't believe it. The guy said " we have cameras and will track down who we gave it to". Two day later, the sale person call and said they would order one and it should be here tomorrow. We shall see.

High reviews but ....

Service was friendly and nice.   But ...

Tried a half Gouda grill cheese.  I would have preferred less onion and no red peppers.  Cup of baked potato soup was good but not creamy.  The other half sandwich was a BLT on a croissant which was drowned in Mayo and mustard.  (Wait, mustard?  Seriously!)

Best part was the brownie.

The best donuts I have ever had. I ordered them on line for our business, D&B Supply. They were delivered exactly on time at 7:45 a.m. They're apple fritters are amazing.  We we ALL very impressed. Will use them again soon.

This place is out of this world when it comes to supermarkets. I love walking around and looking at all the wonderful items. The prepared food section is unbelievable. I can spend hours in there. The fresh produce is so beautifully layer out and the wine selection is incredible. It is a little far for me to go weekly but if I am in the neighborhood I always stop by to get a few items. The housewares are always so pretty and up to date with trends. The bread, rolls and cookies are always fresh.Just a great place to shop for a unique food item. They even have an international area with items from a variety of places. Five stars in my opinion

Very disappointing after waiting 40 minutes for my chicken sandwich it was cold and the bun was soggy the spicy chicken wasn't even that good I'm very disappointing I was looking forward to this place and they were very understaffed and you could tell the staff did not want to be there at all not to mention we had ordered hush puppies did not receive them try to get the money back for them and they said oh you never ordered them in the first place.. so there's that..

They were fabulous ... quick, speedy, creative ...

I go to Boise often to visit fam and I'll be back whenever I'm in town.

I want to express what an unpleasant experience I had three times this week at your Meridian location. Next year I will not purchase secret Santa gifts for work from Lush. My first experience involved being told I couldn't pick up my items because in using PayPal under my husbands name the receipt was emailed to him and he was not with me or available. Common sense should tell a person that if know what is in the order, have the same last name, know what account number was used to pay for it then an imposter is not trying to steal bath bombs. Come on! Then I made another purchase. Showed up at 705pm to pick it up. Facebook lists hours until 8pm in Meridian but they close at 7pm. I knocked on the window and the associates would not walk to the door to talk to me. So I called from my cell phone standing in the rain. They would not release my order to me because they closed 5 minutes ago. I understand not opening the door if counting money for safety but this was not the case. I asked if they could hand me my purchase as they left the store to go home since they said they couldn't open the door. So I waited outside in the rain until almost 8pm when they exited the store and gave me my purchase after checking my ID. When I went to hand out the gifts all 3 Santa gifts were covered in whatever substance was in the sample containers. It was disgusting and I had to give them that way or not have any gifts to give and make a 3rd trip to Meridian to bring them back. Your staff are not helpful and would rather let someone request a refund and cancel their order than to use common sense to fix the problem. I will not do business here again nor will I have anything positive to say to anyone else about this business again. Please update your hours on Facebook so they are accurate and include common sense in your interview screenings. Merry Christmas.

Last month I got a washer and dryer from RC Willey-- both work great and it was an awesome recommendation from the sales associate, Bob Pearson. He was SO GREAT to work with and every time I need to buy an appliance I will look for him personally. He was friendly and knowledgeable and answered every one of my questions (..and I had a LOT of questions).
The delivery and install was great too! They came the next day and installed everything quickly and covered everything I needed to know.

I'm debating if I'm rating this a bit too high, but it's because I find the place decent to shop it, until I hit the checkout register. If you shop the sales, you can get good prices and decent quality. But most items are considerably higher than the competition. 
The store is very clean and well-organized. The staff is friendly and attentive. The lighting, color scheme, and product placement are luring. But there is enough quality to make it worth repeat visits - but use the hand baskets so you don't over shop and break the bank.
Didn't get our order right, and was rude when we took it back to get corrected. Ridiculous

We have been going to this restaurant for 20 years and they don't disappoint. They are great at packing up a to-go order. They very thoughtfully include freshly made tortilla chips and salsa, lots of napkins and the usual generous portions that you always get when eating in. My order has always been correct thru Covid times. I can't say that about any other restaurant that I've frequented in the past 18 months.

Gave them a try for breakfast for the first time. Menu is based on chicken and biscuits and a few other options. Biscuits are great, but oh so calorific. Fresh made each day and as good as those at Bojangles (for you North Carolina folks). Coffee is excellent and free all the month of Feb., 2015, no purchase necessary.

We made a few suggestions: Do something different to the fruit cup. The blueberries were old and too many apples in the cup. Add a lower calorie option(s) to the breakfast menu. The Manager said they are adding an English Muffin sandwich in the near future.

Same friendly staff, clean premises and quick service. Food is good as always also.

This facility is brand new with all new machines. From the general manager do all of the staff they're extremely helpful courteous and kind all of the steps how to the best cleanest laundry you wouldn't want to expect. I highly recommend a family friends and the General Public to use this facility to get it your laundry and the cleanest in the most expedient way possible. I have this establishment five-star hands down! They know how business and laundry is done.
Shake was good but didn't have much flavor. I ordered a brownie shake but only got a couple tiny brownie pieces. Should of been called a Vanilla Shake.

Super good chicken sandwich! I read some other reviews before ordering and got the vibe that the hottest sauce wasn't all that hot... um NOT TRUE! Lol. My husband and I got the spicy honey (super good) and the clucks sauce, and Nashville sauce. Both of these were super spicy and we didn't end up using them. I'm sure they are delish for those who like really spicy. Next time we will try different sauces, but ultimately it was a great chicken sandwhich! Our fries were soggy but we ordered through UberEats so I'm sure by the time they got to us they weren't as fresh. Not their fault! Will definitely come back!!

Awesome and varied daily specials.  Frequent customer but still haven't been able to decide which is better - the food or the service!  (Karisa has to be one of Idaho's best servers!)
This place is SOOOOO worth the occasional wait time!

Great local donut shop with a large selection of donuts, good coffee, a drive-through option, and employees wearing masks during the COVID reopening. We drive past three or four other donut shops to come to Sweet Sensation because of the quality and cleanliness of this shop. Keep up the great work and see you next weekend!

Don't buy a bed from these guys!  They are the worst. Sales guy Lee was very nice then told me that I'd get the bed in 3 weeks. Wrong! They delivered 6 weeks later. Then it worked for 2 days! Stopped working nov 2 and they gave me a service appointment on December 14. Seriously. Do yourself a favor, buy a regular bed and then by $5k of lottery tix. Much better use of your $$$. This company is the worst!

If you need a place for a few hours of entertainment, then this is the place to go!  We had a great time with the miniature golf, laser tag and go karts!  We didn't dine at the restaurant, so can't comment of the food.
Nice pub, always packed, better than average pub food.  The salads are huge, fresh, and oh so yummy. Drinks are reasonably priced, with some very nice drink specials.

Salad bar is crazy good, with more options than you can imagine. It is overwhelming yes, but chill it will make you feel better about eating a salad.  The Salad isn't cheap but when you see the  overwhelming options you you won't care.  The olive bar puts this place on a higher plane for sure !  Pro-tip :  ONLY fill the clamshell half way unless you are making a salad for two.   The cost is by weight.  Half clamshell container is about $7.50.  Full is about $15.   These are averages from the past 4 visits.

I fell in love with the pizza through delivery, but the high quality salad bar, (real, fresh spring greens - no iceberg in sight!-and other quality ingredients,) and the roof-top dining keep me coming inside weekly. 
Sitting under the pavilion with a gentle breeze is comfortable even in the 90's! And it's a refreshing place whether I'm sharing lunch with my 2-year-old grandson (who loves exploring the large space and watching cars), having lunch with a favorite book, or dinner with family or friends, Slyce delivers every time! (See what I did there?)

My friend likes sipping a glass of wine with a Slyce of gourmet Pizza, or salad bar and soup, while her husband prefers their wide selection of beers.

I stick to soda and they have about 15 kinds!! or 

I haven't tried a sandwich yet, but the quality of their other ingredients makes their food delicious, and that house roasted chicken? Sublime! I I haven't been brave enough to try the Thai pizza, especially with the sweet chili sauce, but I might This week. I usually enjoy the Margherita pizza with it's roasted red peppers. 

Before I fell in love with the rooftop dining, I used to order pizza regularly through DoorDash. 
Their pizzas are HUGE! And they have a delicious crust that you can fold in half. 
the potato bacon is a fave in our house- the potatoes are seasoned and seem to be roasted before they go on the pizza in really thin slices. and they use thick, Hugh quality bacon And they don't skimp on that. So yummy! 

This used to be the Meridian "Pie Hole". While the recipes are almost the same, I prefer this environment, over the old Pie Hole feel. 
It's still casual but nicer and more relaxing to me. 

I TOTALLY recommend it and suggest you try the roof- -you'll exit out the back for the stairs. You'll thank me later.
My daughter looks like a super model now, with her perfect hair. Thank you Brittany ! You are amazing.

My husband and I were looking for a new massage place and we found it !! We both needed deep tissue massage and the therapists at spring massage didn't disappoint! It was the best massage we both had in a long time leaving is feeling like new.  It was easy to make an appointment, clean, and professional, we will definitely be regular customers.
This place is absolutely amazing!!! Their donuts far exceed krispy kreme.  My favorites are the barvarian cream filled donut holes.

You don't need a silver fork to eat good food-- Paul Prudhomme

97th reviewer. of Soup Kettle Grille. This is my 449th review.

I've been to this establishment about three times now. About two years ago I tried to go once. I went into the place 30 minutes before closing and I was told that I would have to eat in my car-- that didn't sit well with me and it took me all this time to go back, and I have twice now!

Food is food. Sure many places are better than others, but the people, the pricing, the ambiance, and did I mention people (yes, I did but it's worth a double mention) is all included in what makes a place good, right??? Well, Soup Kettle Grill (which seems backward to my poor brain) meets the top level of all of my criteria! The owner seems to always be here, you can tell she/they pour their heart and soul (wholeheartedly) into her work-- an amazingly nice woman who wants you to sample her/their works of art! She also makes suggestions, gets to know you, works hard and is overall friendly. 

The food is really, really tasty. Smallish portions, but just enough to get you satisfied. I recommend eating here and trying it. It's a no-frills, healthy comfort food alternative with super friendly hard-working people to meet.

This place is outstanding! My sister in Chicago ordered for our family as we were struck with covid & Soup Kettle resurrected my husband's loss of taste and smell. Great comfort, healthy food. Thank you Soup Kettle Grill!

Finally tried this place for lunch one day after driving by it many times on my way home...the reviews were promising!  I got the chipotle turkey sandwich, Italian sandwich, asparagus potato soup and buffalo chicken soup for me and a friend.  

Good things: the service was great and very quick.  Sandwiches were very fresh.  The buffalo chicken soup was pretty tasty.  

Not so good things: the asparagus was stringy in the soup and just did not have a great flavor and there was too much meat on the Italian.  

Overall I would have to say there are countless options for sandwich shops and this didn't rise to the top for me.  The food was good but nothing special.

Started losing battery power when starting my suv and was on a tight time frame to get it taken care of.  Talked to Scott at the front counter who told me everyone was booked up, but if I could bring it in and he would try to work it between appointments since it seemed like a quick fix.  Dropped it off late Wednesday afternoon and got a call from Scott the next morning saying it was done.  I have been dealing with Heritage Auto for years because they are fair, competent, and -this is important to me-Veteran friendly.  Today's experience only confirms why I will be going back.
Over priced, and the food was honestly not worth eating. Sad because, they have potential

Looked at their website figure out what they would charge, then I seen the reviews, they are not cheap and now I am receiving phone calls for looking not interested I also replied no thanks , Sounds like a hard sale Tackett, but when you have more bad reviews than anything at least come down on the price

I knew I was in for it when the last tenant was taking them to court for close to $5K and the tenant before them were screwed over as well.  They refused to fix the hot tub which was $200 out of my pocket.  Then they charge me a $60 for a few weeds on  the side of the house that doesn't have a sprinkler system.   The A/C sucks and they wouldn't fix it last summer which adds an extra $100 on the bill because it runs all day long and doesn't keep up with the heat.  Do not rent from them!!!!  I assure you, they screw you if they can.
Needed a laundry service in a pinch.  Utilized their wash and fold service. Great job. I would use them again.
They are fast and quick they did forget one of my orders though. I had to go back. Other than that great food
Good food, fast service and very friendly staff. Special thanks to host Ryan M. and Jenny for making our dining experience so welcoming! I would definitely recommend this place.

Horrible place. Broke out in a rash. I went to the dermatologist and the doctor asked if I had been in a tanning bed. He said he sees this type of bacterial infection a lot from unclean tanning beds. The prices are also outrageous for the minimal time they allow you to tan. I have tanned at several places over tge year prior to vacationing and never had such a bad experience or paid this much.

This place is amazing! We have been here a few times and the staff is always extremely nice and friendly. They have a drive-through which is REALLY convenient and their doughnuts are delicious! They can put any filling in that you like because they do it at the time of the order! Just tried a sausage roll today and I would highly recommend it!

Excellent experience. Fast and efficient service. Very polite and friendly. Offered follow up assistance if we had any questions or concerns. Left business card. Cleaned up area after refrigerator repair.

This is called the "Prime".  It is Lucky Fins take on the French dip, only way better. Picture is after I took one large mouthwatering bite.  Prime rib, cheese sautéed mushrooms and onions. The Ajuice is homemade, I think broth with onions and mushrooms as well. My suggestion, substitute the fries for the garlic fries, amazing!  Food is always amazing, staff is excellent and attentive and very friendly out less fear is outgoing, there's not much you can order it would not be a big hit!
Thank you for always being on call when my tires need air. It is very helpful as I think I may have to visit you guys very soon about one of my tires LOL

Cookies are amazing of course..... but Monday night the crew took exceptional care of my wife's online order. Taking the time to read the special requests section they were able to provide the extra attention to detail we asked for. Awesome job, awesome cookies.

Was sent there to take care of some things very rushed and got prescribed medication afterwards and took 2 days to make it to wal greens when was supposed to be faxed to wal greens that day. Originally sent there as well to get suggestions on the original problem but no suggestions I had to ask for another appointment.  Very nice staff not very organized. Very terrible dissapointing experience cancelled rest of appointments immediately.

Been wanting to try this place for awhile and finally tried it last night when the truck was in my subdivision. I would have to say they are pretty yummy! Tried two different ones (tinga and the saltena.) They were both tasty and fresh! Nice and crispy and made fresh to order. Definitely will be a returning customer.

Every previous visit was great, but after the last I won't return. Ended in a vet visit for one of my pups and my other dog was in a cone for two weeks from being cut and yes, they still charged full price.

After moving to idaho I needed to remove my out of state license plate. However the bolts holding the plate were so badly rusted that they could not be removed with a simple screw driver. I called various mechanics in the area and was quoted as high as 130$ at other auto mechanics for time and labor depending on how long it took. I felt that was too pricey for removing 4 screw bolts so I searched the highest rated mechanics in the area and found heritage. I called and explained my predicament and they told me to bring the car over and they will try and remove the plate free of charge. 

So I drove over and sure enough one of the kind mechanics was able to use some type of clamp device to carefully remove all 4 rusted bolts. Then he put the idaho plate on for me with temporary screws and let me know where I can purchase the new bolts I needed for my car. The whole process took around ten minutes and he said I didn't owe them any money, they were happy to help. 

I am so impressed with this company and their customer service and willingness to help someone. I will go here for all my auto needs and services in the future.
Thought I had broken my iPhone screen. Turned out I had only broken screen guard!  Easily changed. Took less then 10 minutes.

I've only been to the Las Vegas location and I was a bit surprised to see one here locally at a gas station. The actual location inside the gas station is clean, but there are limited seating arrangements. The places available are nice though. Earl of sandwich offers a loyalty card so take advantage of that if you're into value. The sandwiches I've ordered have all been good, but a little small. I feel this location could have stood on its own just dine, but being where it's at isn't so bad.i just have a hard time choosing to go to a gas station for lunch.

I called Trugreen for a consultation appointment for a few bushes/trees that I am concerned about but the company would NOT send someone to advice until I signed up for a treatment program! What business does this???? Clearly, I am disappointed  
Very sad.

Good pizza at this busy location. I'm a regular since I live nearby, and most of the staff know me by name. Food is usually good, but I always ask for extra butter and Parmesan on the crazy bread since otherwise it can be a little dry. Also, sometimes the crazy sauce cups can be filled below a normal level. Just ask for them to add some pizza sauce, they will usually do that. :)
Delicious!! Everything so far. Unique from the sandwiches to the soup. Must try it.  Great service.

Ana fluasco the director of operations was extremely rude to me. I came to get free hash browns I had on my app which I couldn't get bc it wasn't morning which I didn't know and the app didn't tell me. Corporate wouldn't do anything and neither would their manager. Horrible chain like customer service and I won't ever be back to eat here again.

We are just moving to the area and staying in an Air B&B and needed to do some laundry.  Misty was so helpful with showing me how to load a card and use the machines.  I will definitely be going back before we leave the Air B&B.

Overpriced store. That's not why you have the terrible review. As I walked out of the store I was about 10 steps behind the daytime manager leaving and walking outside and the alarm rang because another employee triggered the alarm ... the manager stops outside and looks right at me and says I better make sure that wasn't you trying to take something.... (Tuesday around 3:00pm).... ..... Bro!!!!! My wrist watch is worth more than you and your girlfriend. Again my watch is worth more than you, my watch. I would never steal anything in my life. I felt incredibly disrespected. I am introverted and I couldn't mustard the courage to say that to his face so I'll just slap it on Yelp. No need to reply unless you are apologizing.

I love going to this post office because the staff are always happy, friendly, and efficient! I can not say enough good about this location. I have been many many times and have always had a positive experience! They have been so helpful when I have needed tape or had the wrong address! It's like Santa's workshop everyday!

We've ordered delivery from here a few times and love it.  The prices are fair and the pizza is really good.  I will say though, I'm from NY, and that is not NY style pizza.  Still delicious though and I'll keep ordering.

Disclaimer before you read this review. While I did communicate that I wasn't happy with the color I did not fully communicate my disappointment to stylist. I'm a people pleaser and really didn't want to hurt her feelings. I'm writing this review several weeks after my experience because the more I thought about it the more I'd like to save both this stylist and potential clients this experience. I did not ask for a refund and did give stylist the chance to fix the color the next day. 

Approximately 2 weeks prior to this review I went in and requested a long bob with a trendy grey color. I had pretty specific pictures of both color/ cut. I communicated that I'd like the length kept long enough to put in a pony tail. I also purchased a Brazilian blow out to flatten a slight wave that my hair has. What I ended up with was super short, dark brown stick strait hair. I should have said something but I think I was in shock and wondered if somehow something was missed in communicating exactly what I wanted. After reviewing the specific pics I had shared with this stylist I still couldn't see how what I ended up with was even remotely close to what I asked for. I paid over $300 for these services and expected to leave with something similar to what I requested. I did go in the next day to have my hair toned out a bit more since it was such a dark brown and did mention that the Brazilian Blow out hadn't really taken out that slight wave. I was told at that point that Brazilian Blowouts tended to address frizz more than wave. I wish this had been communicated to me prior to me spending the $150 extra for this service. I will say that this service did result in frizz control. I just expected something more after I inquired about it from the stylist. 

After going back into the salon in attempt to tone down how dark my hair was I ended up with slightly lighter, brassy , splotchy  short boned hair. I immediately contacted a color correction/ extension specialist and was able to get in today to start the process of getting my hair back to where it was prior to this appointment. So after spending over $300 for a botched job, I'm having to spend another $500 plus to get back to the length/ cut and color I had specifically requested. The following pics are the examples I brought in and showed this stylist and the last pic is what I ended up with . It is my true intent to help others and stylist avoid this experience.

The food here is great, and they keep that drive-thru line moving along. But my husband ordered an iced tea that was almost all ice, practically no tea.  I wouldn't order the drinks here if you're thirsty.

Not at all impressed with the level of care. No personal connection with anyone on the staff, one receptionist is friendly. The other is aloof and often on her phone and argumentative. Their payment system is extremely unorganized and never told me I had a payment due, but one day walked in and told me in an irritated tone that I owed $800. Never got a paper statement in the mail or was asked to make any sort of payments until that huge one 3 months in... was waiting for a paper statement like I had initially received?

I know COVID is stressful for everyone and a scary situation for those at higher risk. On their recording they asked everyone that goes to
The clinics wear masks now unless you have a child under 2 - for them it isn't required - which I am fine with. I have to bring my 1.5 year old daughter In because my husband works and I have no child care otherwise. Also not to mention, I'm trying to prevent my daughters and my (a very pregnant woman) exposure to COVID. At my 39 week appointment I checked in with my daughter and waited about 10 min to be taken back. Went into a back room and waited another 10 min after my initial temp and weight was taken, the nurse had left the door open for that ten min which I thought was odd. She finally came back in and told me that I couldn't have my daughter at the appointment. She told me it was because of COVID. Even though I had brought her to the last 4 appointments... I told her the recording said it was fine. And she asked me what recording. I told her and she said she was going to go listen to it. I stopped her and said if she can't be here, that's fine, I'm just going to leave. I'm not going to wait another 20 min for them to decide if I can be seen or not. Long story short - they saw me and everything was fine. A different nurse told me it was that specific practitioner that wanted to limit her exposure and risk to COVID. That's okay for her to do... they should have asked that when scheduling rather than making me feel like a bad person for bringing my very well behaved child to an appointment. The whole situation was dealt with in a very unprofessional way and none of the staff knew anything about if she could be there or not. That seems like a pretty basic thing to cover In a staff meeting?

Overall not impressed with OGA. It's not run well. Very impersonal. Go some where else.

Meridian Location is the Best, always opens on time and Misty or Missy is so friendly!!! I tried the Boise Location and though I Love Rave, they were an hour late. I came back to Meridian, love them especially for Laundry Emergencies. Very Clean, great Jams and comfortable. Definitely recommend this laundromat.

We stopped in for a quick bite, split a Philly cheesesteak, not bad, everything was hot and flavorful. The atmosphere is your typical bar scene. The only negative was the restaurant was so cold, even our waitress joked about it too. I'd come back in the spring/summer, use the patio.

I will take my punishment for forgetting my appointment,  as soon as I saw they had tried to text me  we called them only being 7 min down the road we could have at least got 1 dog in , but no way! That jerk wouldn't even answer the phone when either one of us called , infact my hubby was standing at the door talking to him as he was calling and , he said im calling you he said I know,  you are marked as a no show! What the hell kind of customer service is that ? I had an appointment for 2 dogs , ok at least do one , say I'm sorry charge me 20 for missed appointment and nicely reschedule,  you know I'm an essential worker I don't expect to get things for nothing,  but never in my life expected to be treated like this by a guy I've only seen once ,  and that time he argued with me about what food I was feeding , omg  I have to say the owner needs to check her staffs attitudes! 
Never missed an appointment in this place thank you for the crapy treatment.
I really like this bar, it has pool tables, darts, shuffle board and a patio with fire pits. Everyone is really friendly and the drinks are made well and are decently priced.

As a former employee of a past State Farm agency in another state, having to change agencies when I moved wasn't a decision I made lightly. 

Working with Hayley in this office has made that transition easy.  She has been a great help the entire way, and is always quick to reply.  

I'm a little more difficult in some ways than other customers because I do know the system- but they have been wonderful!  

Highly recommended for new State Farm customers and folks moving over from other states.
The guys were really nice. They showed up on time and were quick. My carpets look great and I am very happy with their service! Will definitely use them again. Thanks Thomas and Darin.
A light switch on our fridge decided to stop working. Curtis replaced it with a new one and it's working perfectly now. Thank you :)

If you want awesome pizza and combinations you won't find at every other pizza joint in town, SlyceBox is your place.

The pizza here is by the slice or pie and it is delicious. The atmosphere is funky and fun and our whole family loves to come in. The deck on the roof is a great time in the summer with a slice and a glass of wine or beer. The interior is eclectic and fun, your kids (or inner child) will love it.

The staff here are always great and quick to accommodate you whenever you need something. This is a go to place for lunch because it is fast and very affordable.

Try the potato and bacon pizza or their version of Hawaiian (add more pepper just for fun). The pizza is consistently good every time I come, I've never gotten an average pie.

Very disappointed in the final product. We selected room darkening roman shades for our master bedroom which gets direct morning sun. Our salesperson, who's name I can't remember since it's been 6 months since we ordered, suggested the Signature Series in a beautiful fabric. We went with it, little did I know this is Budget Blinds own label, so of course making them the most profit. These shades are junk! We ordered top down bottom up, so we could let in light but still have privacy. When you pull these shades up, they do not fold like roman shades should, instead they gather only at the bottom and form almost a bulging flower shape. When you go top down, they pile at the bottom and practically fall out of the window frame. None of the cords are the same length, 3 windows side by side, looks silly. All of the safety disconnect cords break away almost every time, I will need to super glue them all. My biggest complaint is the amount of light they let in around the edges. I thought maybe they measured wrong. They call this "the halo effect" or "eclipse effect" or something, so they are aware of the issue, but don't disclose this when ordering. We were in such disbelief after the install, we called to ask for someone to come out to check if this is normal. Install was in December, finally got a tech out in May!!! Ben was awesome, but basically told us, yeah, this is how they are. No resolution possible. We're stuck with them! We paid a boatload of money for these, as it was our master bedroom. We are completely not satisfied and do not feel they stand behind their product. I would not recommend Budget Blinds to anyone.
Awesome place for a delicious Gyro. Loved the Colossal. Management (Vic) and staff were friendly and very helpful. Stop in if you want a tasty Gyro.

Stay away!!!! Worst place I have been to in a long time.  Went in for a manicure and the lady butchered my nails and got angry that I did not want to agree to put gel

Donna Abbott
The food is very average at best.  Not sure what all the hype is about.  The customer service on the night we were there was not so good.  I would probably never go there again.

Starting with the positive: The staff were friendly and responsive to our needs. The restaurant was clean and no tables were left dirty for too long. The owner was really nice. 
Unfortunately, it took almost 30 minutes to get our food  (the owner did come out and personally apologize for the delay and gave us a coupon for our next visit). I ordered the Cluckles Ole' Grilled tacos which is probably the blandest "Nashville Hot Chicken" I've ever had. No spice at all, just no flavor. Also, it was half a breast in a tortilla- I had to cut the chicken with a fork and knife in order to eat it like a taco. If you want a really good, spicy Nashville Hot Chicken taco, I recommend Mesa in Nampa. 
My husband ordered the Dirty Bird which had barely any queso on it. Just fries with breaded chicken. 
Overall, the place and people were nice but the food was very underwhelming.

Made an appointment for a Pedicure and Manicure.  When I arrived for my appointment I was ignored for 15 minutes before someone finally came up and told me there was a mistake and they could not do either the Pedicure or Manicure.  I then asked why I was not notified of the error since they take my phone number when I made the appointment.  They had no answer.  I can tell you that this is a common theme when appointments are made you have to wait for 30- 45 minutes. Delicious!!! Didn't know it was here... used to be  a Subway & stopped by here because of it, but what a nice surprise it was Gyro Shack. Got the Philly & Gyro Fries & they were hot, fresh & absolutely delicious! Definitely will be back! Sorry , Subway these guys blew u away.

We first started our lunch off with their Brussels and cauliflower. It is so good! Flash fried with bacon and blue cheese added and comes with a sauce on the side for dipping. Would order that again for sure! Great way to start off with a bang. I ordered their famous fish and chips with their halibut and I am so glad I did. It was also really delicious and their tartar sauce was also yummy. I will definitely come back for those items. My hubby ordered their sushi(el Diablo & mango sushi rolls) and he said they were really tasty as well. This place is a little hidden gem but once you find it and go at a decent time when it's not busy it's a great lunch spot. They were able to seat us quickly since it had just opened! Also the service was great, the gal was really friendly.
If you come here pay cash. Bartender will add their own tip that you did not authorize.

Watched from a neighborhood park as one of their salespeople walked door to door inserting a "service" flyer in the doors of homes (attached). He spent no time going between houses. When I returned home and saw the flyer, there were handwritten notes and "problems" with my lawn indicated, which I thought was odd since he didn't write anything on the flyer before inserting it into my door, or the doors of my neighbors. False advertising just to get you to call. Buyer beware.

Ross Dress for Less should be renamed... Ross unkind to disabled people... their carts cannot be wheeled to ones car.  No bueno ...  I need to lean on the cart to get to my car if my cart is full of semi-heavy items.  They said if I drive my car up to the curb in front of the door, someone will bring my things out.  So this disabled person is supposed to deal with extra traffic and pedestrians, eventually getting to the front of their shop, only to get back out of my car to open the back up for the person to put my stuff in for
me.  I don't think Ross management thought this through with an understanding of so many situations a disabled person might have to face.  Maybe I'll change it to 1 star... yeah, on second thought, they just lost another star..

Went in for happy hour yesterday and the food was good, but watch out for up selling during happy hour. Happy hour has on their menu lucky Fin mules $6, when the bill comes it was $9 and we were told no flavored mules nothing about that on the menu. Also ordered 2 orders of HH shrimp tacos but they served us two full dinners which was $5 more on the bill. We told them we were there for HH and sat in the bar. Just be aware if you expect HH prices.

One is either an enthusiastic shopper of Trader Joe's or someone who is 'not so much'.  The latter is me.  I share my bias right up front.  (What?  We all have them.)

So while I am not a TJs acolyte, even I was happy to have one open in Meridian, closer to my home and with a decent parking lot no less. It makes my maybe two times per eighteen months visits to TJs more convenient than the parking mess at the Boise store.

WOO-HOO FOR THE CREW!:  Whenever I shop at any TJs I so enjoy the friendly staff, which I think are called Crew - in the way of Gilligan's Island three hour cruise kind of fun kitsch with their island shirts and so on - who are cheer filled and helpful.  So it is at the Meridian store where the crew are particularly delightful.  The people who work here make it more pleasant for shoppers.

"MAMA EARTH" SHOPPER PROFILE BE ME:  We all have consumer profiles.  I am a close to the source kinda shopper who celebrates things local, organic when possible and providers using sustainable practices.  Local farmers, ranchers husbanding humanely raised pastured and free range animal proteins, local bakers and harvesters of domestic sea proteins following healthy oceans standards.  You'll find little of that at TJs.

And good, fresh food stores should have a fresh aroma walking in, in particular in the produce aisle.  TJs doesn't in any location.  Maybe because much of the produce is pre-packaged or conventional production.

Also I buy little in the way of package goods (as they're called in the industry) and when I do, say tomatoes in cans or dried die-cut pasta in bags or condiments in jars like preserved lemons or harissa, I have certain brands I'm married to.  TJs doesn't carry any of them.

Still, there are a handful'ish of things I like to buy at TJs.  I won't lie.  The items on my list include dark chocolate covered dried cherries, TJ's brand pineapple salsa in jars, the 'lite' version of TJ's brand of kettle corn (thanks to my friend Joy W who got my husband and I into that), their brand of salsa verde (very handy in a pinch when I'm too lazy to make my own) and their branding on a cheese named Unexpected that tastes like a premium aged cheddar with hints of Parmesan.  From time to time we might pick up something else when we're in there (like today's organic avocados) but by and large we're in and out with a short list and a very long time in between visits.  

DIFFERENT STROKES:  Trader Joes has earned a community of fans and even a sort of social culture.  Back in the day - like 25 years ago - before I knew what I know now about food production and sources, I too was a "Frequent  Flyer" TJS shopper when one was in my neighborhood. 

I reflected on that as a three women who recently relocated here from another state were chatting in the frozen foods section of TJs today, with their carts piled with goods, noting that in the city they came from in Utah TJs was 'the' sort of community social - networking place next to their church events.  They said they were already finding the TJs in Meridian had that same sense and were so happy to find that so.  Different strokes...

LOCATION & PARKING:  This location is where Rosauer's grocery used to be, so a big paved lot.

ACCESSIBILITY:  TJs does a good job of this at almost every location and so it is here for level in the door, all on one floor, ample floor space and so on.  The parking lot has accessible (ADA) parking but not enough to meet ADA for total numbers and there are too few van accessible spaces. But that is an issue for the strip mall owner to fix.
Robin is amazing. She answered all my questions on the menu I had. Highly recommend the mojo roll!!

I was helped by Nicole tonight and she was amazing! She was super sweet and very caring. RC Willy did a great job in hiring her. She was very helpful and gave great advice and talked about all the options I needed to know for what would work best for me. She was fast and efficient. I really enjoyed her company. I'd like to thank her one more time on here. Thanks Nichole, you're a life saver!

The cookies were super good and they are BIG. You can easily share. They need to work on the curbside delivery. My husband waited outside for 20 mins and then finally went in and they had lost our order.

I am so sad. We have gone here for years and have loved this place. I had the cheese steak omelette. It was not a cheese steak and just had a little sprinkle cheese on top of the omelet and was  stuffed with dry tasteless meat. Not very good when you are looking for a cheese steak. The biscuits were hard and days old. Not palatable. The jelly packs for toast were old and hard. Solidified. Pretty embarrassing.  You can tell that they are not rotating their food. Don't know if healthy or scary. When complained the server was great but there was little he can do except for offer more stale food. He said his hands were tied with the owners but would let them know. We will not be going here anymore and I recommend you not go there also. Sad sad day and this time of covid.. Our old stale tasteless food was discounted though. Still not worth the trip.

Use to be a big fan with the extra incentives to come in.  Now they have cut out their Buy 10 get 1 free punch card and also have done away with Monday Kid's night.  Not willing to go back as frequent now.  On the plus side, burgers are better than Fast Food.

There I was browsing my FB news feed when a link popped up claiming a list of the top donut shops in every state. Normally I don't go for this kind of click bait, but as a recent transplant to Idaho I was curious what they would list for here. I honestly expected them to say Guru Donuts (which I don't care for), but to my surprise it was Sweet Sensation Donuts which was all of 5 miles away but never seen/heard of it. 

One Sunday morning I get up early and stopped in. They open at 5:30AM and boy oh boy was the case stocked full of freshly baked donuts. I exercised restraint and walked away with only 5-6 selections from the racks of heaven on earth. For me it comes down to the classics; glazed, old fashioned, and apple fritter. Now I would call myself a bit of a donut connoisseur (ok pretty much anything food connoisseur), and man these are AMAZING donuts! Obviously freshly baked, perfect balance of gooey cake dough and really tasty icing. And the apple fritter, oh man!  Thankfully I'm on a diet and only can enjoy these on my "cheat day", otherwise it would likely be very dangerous for my scale at home.

Same great fast and convenient food and service. New items (at least they seem new) Cobb and grilled salads. First time I have had the grilled chicken sandwich. Lower in calories and very tasty. And to top it off, the new Frosted Lemonade (sort of a lemonade milkshake). Very refreshing and can even be had in their diet lemonade which cuts the calories down a bunch.

If they had stock (privately held), I'd invest.
I want my boys to get a hair cut, not a vaccine. this is utter BS that you are pushing stupid vaccines at a BARBER SHOP. Do your job and shut up.

Avoid as much as possible. TruGreen's applications killed most of my trees and shrubs. We had a professional analyze our dead trees and his assessment was that the weed killer that they used damaged my trees and they should have not sprayed near our tree. These were established trees and shrubs that I had in my lawn for a while. TruGreen initially apologized that they might have sprayed too close to our trees but later changed their story that their applications will not hurt trees.

I am a huge fan of Dr. John and his staff! Dr. John is so warm, respectful, kind, and easy to talk to. He allows plenty of time for me to ask all my questions. I feel like we are collaborating together instead of him telling me what to do, which is exactly what I want in a doctor-patient relationship. His office is clean, professional, and efficient  and they have all the latest and greatest treatments. I highly recommend coming in!

Raymond came out on time and communicated his arrival very clearly. I didn't have to wait around all day wondering when he will be coming. He was very helpful in fixing our dishwasher and did it quickly and efficiently. There was no shaming me even though it was due to my lack of knowledge and it was overall a pleasant experience.

This review is strictly for Trevor.. the pic speaks for itself.. what I asked for VS what I got. I specifically chose this hairstylist because the photos advertised on Instagram @trevhair.co appeared to be what I desired. I asked for a BALAYAGE and I for some reason received partial "foiled highlights" . There were numerous excuses as to why my desired look couldn't be achieved.. zero of which were sufficient. Having hair that was previously dyed black 3.5 years ago is a bogus excuse.. sorry. 2 sessions, 12 hours & $400 later..  choose wisely.

My husband and I frequently lunch here on the weekends. Especially now since it's getting cold out. The soups really just warm you right up. The jalapeño grilled cheese is a fave. But I really go for the buffalo chicken soup. Tastes homemade and so flavorful. 

Not only is the food good. The staff is phenomenal! And the service is fast!

I have heard really good things about smash burger from friends but my first experience was unfortunately spoiled. I was happily eating my burger when I bit into something really hard, I spat my mouthful of meat into a Tupperware and saw what looks like a piece of bone! I'm sorry but aren't burgers supposed to be BONELESS? Anyway I'm really grossed out and disappointed.
Very overcrowded! Felt like the Groupon of gymnastics. The coaches are too busy standing around chatting to actually help the students.

I'd give this restaurant 5 Stars but the chef won't serve Eel sauce with the Sushi they serve, which is almost as good as Yoi Tomo's, so it's quite a let down for us, next time I'll be bringing my own.. We've dined there three times and Madison our friendly waitress has served us and made the experience much more enjoyable. We love the Jalapeño Cilantro Margaritas and the Food is awesome, as well as the ambience and the atmosphere.

The staff is Always nice.  Ive been here a couple times and service is always up to par.  This last time i went to the location on Linder.  I rode over there with my girlfriend and her son.  I brought my dog so i couldnt go inside.  The staff actually brought me my food, and some water for my dog!  It's always a great place to go.  We love the icecream too!!
Best homemade old fashioned soup. Always so yummy. Whenever we have a craving for homemade soups we go here to Soup Kettle Grill. They make a yummy grilled cheese to go with your soup.

Kameron was kind, professional and most of all, he really knew his stuff! He diagnosed the issue with the dishwasher within moments and came back once the part was in to complete the repair. He cleaned up whatever mess was made and had the best attitude I have seen in a long time. Thanks for fixing our dishwasher! Our whole house is better and happy for it!

Love Wahooz. Every time we go it ends up being a fun time for hours. So much to do for littles and bigger kids too and adults. Full arcade almost all games work all the time (so many arcades have so many broken games), huge two story laser tag inside, a couple of restaurants with tasty food for whole fam, and so much fun. Staff are usually friendly and helpful and we love going to Wahooz. Packages are a little pricey except for if you go on Thursdays and get the discount package. Weekends though, cost is a little high.

Soooo the Meridian Post office is crap..... I truly truly was excited for the opportunity to be a mailman! I went through orientation only to discover that I'd never see my family again, they work you nonstop EVERYDAY and its unionized due to poor treatment....should have done my research! Now...  I am NOT getting half my pay due to them losing slips they are supposed to turn in for your pay for the 1st month....  I'm now soooo broke!! And heartbroken.... I'm thankful for another job but the USPS ruined me for a good month financially.....just wanna cry! Was supposed to be sooooo good, turned out sooooo bad.....

I am in the Customer Service business as I am a local realtor in the area. 
 My husband and I decided to upgrade to a King Bed and looked around at a few places before we came in contact with Casey at Mattressland.  We hit it off immediately---easy to talk to, knowledgeable and felt like I just made a new friend and someone I would feel comfortable sending my clients/friends too.  He will find the right bed, at your budget, comfort level and give you suggestions if you are new to mattress buying:)) 

Covid-19 hit and out of his control, shipments were delayed, etc. but Casey maintained close contact with me and making sure we were always good. We ended up getting the King Split mattress and cannot say enough great things about Casey and how he has treated us. Not a sales guy, but genuine, no fluff and I respect that. He takes pride in what he does and it shows.  Leadership qualities, personal touch and accountability are what differentiates him from the rest.  We will be referring our friends/family/clients to Mattressland and feel confident that they are in the best hands. :)

My husband and I were looking for a new place for some seafood appetizers and went to Fins for Happy Hour. We are very impressed. Although we saw the website said Happy Hour was 3-6 our waitress said it was 4-6.She talked to the manager that said to go ahead and give us the Happy Hour prices...good customer support!  I had the shrimp cocktails which was totally within my Weight Watchers points...and it was displayed on huge hooks. It was great!
I did take a bite of my husband's cod and  coconut shrimp and it was outstanding. The drinks were reasonably priced and a good atmosphere. I would highly recommend Fins. We are bringing some of our friends back this week to try it out again.

We did see the crab all you can eat for $30 but I'm not sure I can eat that much crab on WW so maybe another time!

Our service was terrific and we really enjoyed ourselves.  This might become our favorite place to eat ....thanks!

Where to begin? To say great is an understatement... this is thee place I've been searching for! I really should have written this review at the beginning of the summer...but then I couldn't have been able to testify that their gel polish pedicures can last an entire summer without a hint of a crack (and I play sand volleyball)! They are very gentle (I know because I can admit I'm a whiny diaper baby about my toes) and very friendly. They dont ignore you and speak to other techs in other languages, (they know its rude and makes clients uncomfortable). They dont nickle and dime you for every teeny dollop of lotion or rub, but give you a full service pedicure. Today I walked in and within 30 minutes was finished! Perfect escape from Eagle Rd. rush hour traffic!! Highly recommend!

I have not been inside the actual store but I did want to write a review for the salon aspect! Karen did such an amazing job!! After having a traumatic experience at another grooming salon, Karen left a note saying my little guy did great! She did a great job on his haircut and when picking up he smelt great too!! I loved the curbside dropoff since I have a little one, it was VERY convenient! So thankful for that. He even left with a beautiful little bandana ready for Christmas! Will be going back of course!!

My girlfriend and I dined at the curb for our annual Holiday meal. I was especially impressed with their Covid 19 precautions. Our table was highly sanitized, menu accessible using phone (scan bar code). Our server was phenomenal! Checked in frequently! Prices were very affordable. I ordered a salad which was massive! They are shareable! Grilled chicken was excellent! My friend had a burger with sweet potato fries. She cleaned her plate and said it was one of the best burgers she ever had. It was packed on a Monday night clearly a sports fanatic oriented place. Games on all TVs.

Well, dang, I ended up with bruising on my legs and feet after this session. That tells me it was too deep. Never had bruising on my feet - that's not common. Still, will try other therapists at this locale. 

So, again, be open and communicate with your therapist about desired pressure.

Lots of deli table treats here! Great family owed business, support your locals! Yummy food, soup and sandwiches, coffees, Italian sodas, smoothies and boba drinks! So many options available, there are 6 soups available hot and ready today, soups to take home (refrigerated) and soup samples available too! Everything I had today was delicious, attractive and delivered to my table. Loved this experience, thank you Soup Kettle Grill!
Even with an appointment  you still end up waiting a long time. Only one person knows how to do dip nails so they push gel, and the prices are higher.

Only been here once since it opened, but the time I went it was kept incredibly clean and the cotton candy shake I had was to die for!! Friendly crew and a great taste. Glad to see the same ingredients and quality in both the Boise and meridian store

It's so sad how much the quality has dipped in the last 6 months. i used to visit the meridian location frequently but stopped going as often due to my orders always being messed up. I always order a shake and they can never get it right. Tonight i went through the drive thru and ordered a small chocolate shake. Upon taking my first sip, i noticed some weird stringy texture in it. I tried ignoring it but after a few more sips i couldn't stand the texture so when i got home i decided to dump my shake in a strainer to see what was in my "chocolate" shake. Coconut. And not just a little. I never asked for coconut. these are the types of mistakes that happen almost every time i visit this location. I understand there's a labor shortage and there are new employees being trained, but it's gotten ridiculous with how often they can't get an order right. I hope they figure it out soon. For now, i'll be taking a break from visiting this location.

So SlyceBox is a Pie Hole. I guess there was some kind of war. Pie Hole Meridian was tired of being taxed so hard so they dumped all the za in the ocean and wrote the declaration of Slyce-dependence.

But like really... it's a Pie Hole. I don't know why Tom and I expected something different. They've got solid pizza. Good when you're drunk. Prices are the same ($10 for two slices and drink). Timing is the same (5 mins to heat the slices). Atmosphere is a bit different. Still very hipster, more space, fewer stickers. Feels more like a Flying M coffee shop than a Pie Hole. I like that.

Only major difference was the one person working there was very nice. They struck up good conversation with us while our pizza was heating up. I have a sneaking suspicion that it was mainly because we were the only customers and they are pretty much alone working there all day. That being said, much better than Pie Hole downtown where you always feel like you're bothering them, or Pie Hole on Broadway where they make it clear you're bothering them.

-Pepperoni-
Good. Tastes like a Pie Hole pepperoni. (Go check out our Pie Hole downtown review!)

-Potato Bacon-
Good. Tastes like a Pie Hole potato bacon.

-Loaded Potato-
Good. Tastes like a Pie Hole potato bacon with cheddar sprinkled on top.

-Verdict-
We recommend this place if you like Pie Hole but you live in Meridian.


4 slices out of 5

Awesome atmosphere! Tired of those salons so I thought I would try this place and man this place is great! Total man cave with four barbers who are very knowledgeable as far as hair styles! Love this place and plan on taking my fours boys here for good!

"Manager" was very rude. Ordered food from there Saturday, 02.20.2021. Ordered two shakes and only received one. Manager seemed more concerned with passing the blame to others and getting me off the phone than actually trying to solve the problem. Just horrible customer service and training with this company.

So good!!! I drove an hour away and definitely didn't disappoint. Loved that it was authentic! Reminded me so much of my moms cooking. It's so hard to find authentic Latin food around this area. My favorite was the Puerco DELICIOUS!!!! Definitely will be going back!

I went in because I was having a variety of symptoms that made me very nervous, as they are all signs of early ovarian cancer and I have a family history of a variety of female cancers. This behemoth of grocery store plus much more is an experience, but not where I would want to shop on a weekly basis.  It is just too large and pricey. A store this size needs large restrooms offering several stalls for serving several patrons.  Waiting is line to use them must have been a nightmare on grand opening day.  Unfortunately I will not be back preferring to continue shopping at two other competitors offering a friendlier layout and reasonable prices.

My home warranty people sent a guy out to repair and "tune up" my ac. Scheduled 9:30-11. They call me at 7:50 and tell me he's on his way. Have to  wake my son up and wait for him. He's at my house for 5 minutes, looks like he just rolled out of bed, said I need a new thermostat and a tune up, says he cant do anything today to fix it. And then when you're all done, do yourself a favor and look elsewhere.

Jacob was very helpful and knowledgeable and was able to answer all of my questions. Professional demeanor, and a positive attitude.  Very highly recommend this location.   I drive out of my way to come here because they make sure to keep the specific products I use in stock.

Ordered a pizza on Super Bowl Sunday. Came in to see an employee making a pizza sticking his full arm in a box of cheese WITHOUT GLOVES ON. It grossed me out, then I come to find out that no employee in the whole store is wearing gloves. I ask to talk to the manager, he says that because  they cook the pizza at a high temperature, the germs get killed, so they don't have to use gloves. Like even if Covid wasn't a thing I would STILL want them to wear gloves, but especially since we are in a pandemic, the way they work in the Meridian Domino's is extremely lazy, unsafe, and inconsiderate. Cheerful friendly staff and tasty ice cream. I also love their quick service. Happy hour with half price shakes is awesome.

I've used Stanley steemer for a long time, and there's a great reason for it. The technicians are respectful, thorough, and efficient. They move my furniture so I dont have to! Definitely a great start for my spring cleaning. They dont just clean, they also deodorize my house so my pets can remain as incognito as they think they are.

Really Albertsons?
Where are the WLM and ALM Carmel apples?!
Seriously. 
Or did the bakery just take it upon themselves to decide to make these?

The vibes, the vibes, the vibes! And the coffee...I'm in love!

Atmosphere: It's so pretty in here! Huge windows with lots of natural light (this alone stole my heart), mellow background music, genuine employees who provide top-notch customer service, and decorated with a clean/simple design. When in Meridian, this will no doubt be my go-to place to get work done!

Coffee: I was told if ordering an iced drink to get a lavender latte, and if I was ordering a hot to go simple and get a vanilla latte. I went ahead and did the vanilla latte (out of the norm for me), and I loved it! The milk was steamed to a light and fluffy consistency, the espresso shot was pulled just right, and they used the perfect amount of vanilla--sweet, but not too sweet. 

Etc: They use Form & Function Coffee (locally sourced), and it's delicious! I can't wait to come back and try out a cup of their drip coffee.

I went through orientation and training to become a Cca before deciding to do something else & they didnt pay me all I was owed.... I've sent emails, spoke to supervisors and the post master and still  NOTHING!! I am sooooo disappointed that it was completely disregarded, as if I didn't need that money for bills....
