Massive selections, fresh produce, hot food bar, an actual bar, fresh popcorn, the biggest wine selection in Ada county, and live music next to a pizzeria. The only thing the place needs is a mini roller coaster.

In all seriousness this place has become a staple in my weekly routine since they have some of the best produce and a fine selection of gluten free products. I enjoy coming here. The shelves are rarely empty and the checkout lines move pretty quick. 

My favorite checker is Coleen who is always polite and great for conversations during checkout. She's definitely a people person and I hope her manager knows what and asset she is to this store.

Keep up the great work guys.

Quick Easy Friendly Greasy Pizza by the Slice?! Nailed it. 

This place is super rad. We ended up sitting in here just enjoying the vibe and conversation for almost two hours. I am a sucker for cool art & metal stools. If it was nicer we would have utilized the outside seating! Prices seem great, and the pizza was REALLY good! 

Bonus Points GREAT playlist. :) I'll be back.

My 1st experience with them was good. I purchased an entire living room set and it was delivered quickly. I had to return an ottoman because it was too big and replace the chair due to damage to a corner. All of that went smoothly. So after 4 visits to look at sectionals for another room, I finally picked one. I was told by 3-4 different sales people that I could order it in ANY of the material samples they had. I even specifically asked if it only came in the materials attached to it and was told NO. I finally picked the fabric, the order was entered into the computer and I paid. The next afternoon I got a call from the sales person saying they could NOT do the sectional in that fabric. Only the ones attached to it (which I had already asked about). and did not like! Training must be poor since more than 1 person was mis-informed. I had to call, wait on hold to get a refund. And am still waiting for a call from the manager. That's ridiculous! What a waste of my time!

Today I had the worst service here ever. Waited at the deli for over 25 minutes to be serviced. When my turn came up they skipped over me and asked the next customer what they needed. Either put all your kalbasa out  so I can grab it and go or have better training .

I take my kids and grandkids out for their birthday. We call it BLD25 ( breakfast lunch dinner or $25)
Recently I took son in law Chet to Lucky Fins Meridian

The office did not provide the garage door openers to us as we moved in.  
When our lease was over, it took them 45 days to issue a refund of our rental deposit.  The owner did not use very professional language when discussing the landlord of the property we rented.  After waiting past the 30 days for our deposit to be refunded, I called the office, and the receptionist passed my call to Brandon.  When I politely explained the situation, and asked when I could expect the refund, he answered, "You will have to work that out with her (the landlord)...She is the one who tanked us." It was spoken in a very derogatory manner.  
The landlord was always very attentive, and quick to respond to concerns or questions.  She was in the process of changing property management companies after our lease ended.  
I am sorry Curtiss does not take a more professional, courteous approach to their customer service.

DO NOT contract residential business with this company in the Treasure Valley area.  I opened my service with TruGreen Meridian in June 2021 and have already cancelled (October 2021) as the local office has the worst service I have ever dealt with.  Not only do they not keep appointments or return calls, but they burned my lawn (attached are some of the photos taken).  If that wasn't enough, when I cancelled my service I was told by the customer service representative I would get the remaining money back and they managed to short me on that refund.  I paid in advance for a year's worth of lawn, tree, and shrub care and when the refund fell short, I called and spoke to a CSR who said he would look into it and call me back. I called back after a week as they did not call me back and I couldn't talk to him or a supervisor (via their policy) and no notes were made on my account from our previous conversation.  I've had to explain the issues created by the company to a new CSR every time I call!  Save yourself the headache, find a different solution to your lawn care needs.

This was the second time we used Stanley Steemer.  The first time a supervisor dropped by and did a second more thorough cleaning on some of the spots that still showed.  This time the technicians did a good job but not as good as last time.  I pointed out some spots to them and they just kind of made excuses about it.  My biggest reason for not giving 5 stars is the scheduling.  They told me they would be here between noon and 6 and that someone would call me.  I arranged my day specifically to be home by noon.  They arrived after 4.  I called shortly before 4 to see what was up and got an answer that they usually just call when they're on their way.  As a customer, i don't care what they usually do.  They knew their schedule much earlier than that and could have called to narrow it down a bit more.  This is not a utility company and I have choices.  I hope someone at Stanley Steemer reads this and realizes that next time I will consider other companies who are more concerned about the use or waste of their customers' time.

I found Celia while searching through many, many, many, Yelp pages when I was looking for a new hair stylist. I am so incredibly thankful I have found her as she is trustworthy, friendly and most importantly a freaking good hair stylist! 

Over the course of 5+ years, she has made my hair dark brown, red, ombre, and balayage. She cuts it perfectly every time.  The number of compliments I get my on hair right after it is done to right before it gets re-done is insurmountable. If that tells you anything, she does a really good job of coloring (and cutting) and making sure the color works for many months in between. 

I would highly recommend Celia. She is amazing, great, personable, friendly and is all-around, a great hair stylist!
The staff here are always incredibly genuine. The food is great quality and worth the price. Love love love supporting local shops, and this one is top 5.

RC Willey is awesome!  We furnished our entire home and bought all of our appliances there as well. Their high quality furniture and high end appliances have now made our house a home. Our furniture salesperson was creative, very knowledgeable with attention to detail. She made the process so easy and the best part was that we received all our furniture within 2 weeks. We highly recommend them!

What a great place for a family night or even a guys (or ladies) night. I could see corporate types doing silky tests of trust and communication off the walls. 
Anyways, great spot for just about anyone (no climbing on walls though, seriously), great prices and hardly a wait ever. The lanes are limited in number though so if you know what time you or your party will want to be in and if you have a particular lane you wanna be in... call ahead. 
The bar is close enough to run to if you ever run dry but worry not.. the staff is on top of their game. Drinks and food comes out quickly and consistently as ordered. 
Quality of food... meh... it's a bowling alley. I've had better for sure but I've absolutely had worse.
Quality of drinks... brilliant. The staff is obviously well trained behind the bar. They do God's work and are gracious about it. 
Prices... it's a fair price for the over all experience. Maybe eat ahead of time and just come thirsty... but come often! 

Thoughts for the future:
The steakfingers are lame. Small pieces... no bueno. 
How about a few veggie options... nothing says I love you like fried cauliflower.

I've been in several times to Heritage Auto Repair to bring my car up to Ievel of confidence to drive around town. The car is an older car and was neglected for a while. While we ran into some problems at first, it was not surprising because of the car's age. I am pleased with the service I have received. Aaron has been especially helpful keeping me informed of the issues on the car.  I appreciate his kindness and professionalism.  Much thanks to Heritage Auto Repair for their service.  I am glad they're there for me.  Repairing my old car was a lot cheaper than buying another car.
I had the pleasure of having Chad and Michael clean my carpets this morning.  They were extremely friendly, knowledgeable, kind, and efficient.  I highly recommend this company and Chad and Michael!!
We have always had great service here. Food is delivered with a smile and a thank you. Always hot. Clean lobby. Drive thru is incredibly fast.

Once again I am rating based on the overall experience.  We've been to Harry's several times for drinks and this was the first time we went with the intention of eating a full meal.  With not many options for sit down dining in Meridian it is a quick stop on the way to a movie at the Majestic Theater.  

We went on a double date night and the service was not great.  I believe there was only one server and she took numerous smoke breaks on the patio while we were there.  Our food was pretty good for bar food but the service wasn't up to par.  We actually had to rush our server to pay and we were late to our movie.

This park is pretty epic.

It's much larger than I was expecting and a great addition to Meridian (conveniently located right next to The Village).  There's a band shell for summer concerts, huge play area, covered barbecue area that can be reserved for private parties, and a pond with fish!  I think they may also feature family movie nights in the summer months. 

The only thing the park is missing at the moment is large shade trees--all of the landscaping is very young.  This, however, does leave you with vast expanses of lawn in which you may fly a kite unobstructed.  So, there's that.

Overall, a great place to hang, have a picnic, and do a little fishing.  My son caught his first large mouth bass here (smack in the middle of Meridian?  Who knew?).

Get to it!

We are an existing customer of BB who purchased a new home set up 18 months ago, a good initial experience and overall satisfied with the quality of products (top down / bottom up blackout blinds).  Great install and proper light mitigation .. sleep in !

We recently had a chance to "kick the tires" on the lifetime warranty clause, having a few of our blinds "squeaking" and a few were hard to roll up.  Called the company on Eagle and  they had one of their install experts drop in .. he called before coming by and was true to the time guess.  Ben was a pro, came in observed the issues and then went about fixing everything.  He explained the why behind the what AND showed us how to fix if the noise ever returned.  All in all .. great experience.  The only ding was the $75 service fee which I understand .. but cost them one star in the review today :)

My hubby and I visited here for lunch last Friday.  Honestly I was not expecting the shop to be located in a convenient store - but it was all good.  It was tucked away in a corner and was very clean.  The staff was "bend over backwards" friendly and customer service oriented.  Since this was our first time there - we weren't familiar with how they do things.  Such as pick your own chips located in front of the cash register...but that was not a big deal.  My hubby had the chicken avocado bacon sandwich - which he really liked.  I had the tuna wrap - and on a scale from 1 to 5 - it was a 3.  It was served warm but the tuna was a bit watery and could have had more substance to it.  

Regardless, we will definitely come back and will try another items on the menu.

How can one do business without having contact information? I ordered a family pack through GrubHub and only received the buns and potstickers. Tried dealing with grubhub and was politely told to bad F.O. I thought to myself this really isn't problem Wow Bao but I would call and ask them about it. To my surprise they don't even have a phone number listed anywhere on the internet. So I guess the joke is on me! ONE AND DONE!!!


Update WOW BAO IS SIZZLER

Who doesn't love pizza and beer on a rooftop? This is an awesome little pizza place. So far my favorite slice is probably the green goddess. It has artichokes, and tomatoes, and mushrooms, and other yummy stuff all on pesto. You have to try it. They also have this super delicious, funky potato pizza. Because: Idaho. 
It's a cool place. Exceptionally relaxing. The people who work here are very easy going. I love the experience every time I go. There are video games in the corner, benches lined with skate decks, and some pretty cool art on the bathroom doors. But my absolute favorite part of the place, other than the food, is the rooftop. When you visit, Go just before sundown, sit on the roof under the twinkle lights, stuff your face, and hammer down. It's like therapy.  You won't regret it.

Honestly this is such a cute shop, but the reason for the two starts is that they definitely have an image they stick with for the employees they have there and if you don't fit that then they fire you. I was hired there and was only an employee for two and a half days as the store manager before the regional manager came in half way through the day to tell me I wasn't a good fit for the company anymore, and the only reason they gave me was a quote they have for the company" We are slow to hire and quick to fire." I turned down three other hogging positions for this one. The REGIONAL MANAGER even the day before said how I went above and beyond the other managers in the past but didn't think I fit their "exact image" they were looking for ‍ I would never recommend  anyone that isn't hardcore LDS or Christian go apply here.

Recently my wife Pamela had to spend time at Aspen in Meridian, ID. following treatment for a spinal injury. Aspen was highly recommended by St. Luke's Hospital also in Meridian. In spite of the restrictions of COVID we found the staff very attentive and accommodating . Everyone we encountered is to be commended for the care given to my wife.
The facility was clean, quiet and well appointed. The food was very good and the food service staff was very eager to provide a flexible menu. The Nursing staff listened to my wife and was always available despite the extra workload and complex issues mandated by COVID. The Physical Therapy and Occupational Therapy staff were not only professional but pleasant.  

Insofar as the administration was concerned I was very pleased. My family was considered in every way. Hans was the one person I had direct contact with. He made sure that we were given every opportunity to visit personally with my wife within the confines of the COVID mandated restrictions and for that we are greatly thankful. His sincerity and attention to our needs was evident from the very start.

I don't give reviews like this very often , but when a family member has to be placed in such a facility there is a lot of concern regarding the level and quality of care they will receive. I wanted to take the time to give Aspen the credit it richly deserves and help those having to make decisions like this a little easier. Thank you all so much !

Today was my first visit to Body Calm. I've heard great things about their yoga classes, but I went for a massage. Currently they have a 60 minute massage for new clients for only $55. Well, their promo worked and I will definitely be going back for massages. Can't wait to try out a facial and yoga.
The 25 minute drive from where I live was completely worth it. My massage was with Marie and she was amazing!
The owners are amazingly friendly and welcoming. At this time they are following many safety precautions: masks, social distancing, temperature checks, hand sanitizer. Every part of the spa side was clean.
Bread was the best , "speck" was also very good and priced reasonable. Only negative staff not too friendly.

Not bad. Came in on a mellow night, had a couple shots and a cocktail.  Nothing glamorous except for the pretty black lab chilling by our feet, nice pup. The bar can be a little smoky but when you are visiting a bar called the Busted Shovel I really don't think you should be too hung up on the little things.

I tried this spot also a couple of months ago before all the craziness happened as I was on a visit here in this town.  Menu was a bit limited was only negative I had.  Service was fantastic and the fish was the best I have ever had anywhere.  Really made for a nice evening during a kind of rough trip.

Went by the other day and it was closed down.  Not sure if they are planning on reopening or not.  They used to sell their pastries at the farmer's market in Boise and they were really good.  I hope they aren't closed for good.

Really wish I could give 0 stars........  I knew it would be a wait to get through on a Saturday night which I was prepared for but what I wasn't prepared for was to wait all that time get my family's food and get home to find hair around a 5 layer burrito I purchased, and on top of that trying to call the store seems to be impossible the phone will just ring and ring. So livid at this point I drive back to the location and of course another 15-25 min wait to fix the order, no apology no refund nothing just remade the order which was a sloppy skimpy horrible mess we just ended up just throwing it away, I couldn't trust any of it.

In the foreign Grocery Market there is a new player in town and then come to play. This store is ultra clean very nice and has a Russian Flair. Lots of fresh produce lots of fresh meats and cheeses and Breads and even cakes and desserts. I highly recommend you come and try them out.

Exactly everything we have come to love about the chain!  Great products at amazing prices always tended to by beautiful, happy souls!  Seriously, are they even human?  They are never grouchy or too busy to talk!  Saints and Angels I say!
*Have you even tried the Superberry preserves?!  I'm not ashamed to say that I suspect it's a seasonal item so I bought 3 extras and have the tucked them away for those dull grey winter days when I need a touch of sunshine!  One of my favorite tricks is the Pumpkin bread mix that should be hitting the shelves during pumpkin season.  I can put it together, get it in the oven and have the dishes washed and put away in just under 10 minutes!  It cooks for 50 minutes so by the time you go get ready you can be walking out the door with a loaf of warm pumpkin bread everyone thinks you labored over for hours!

Such a great time for the entire family! We come not too often but when we do we go big and we all have a blast. Bumper cars, go carts, laser tag... mini golf... BOWLING ... I mean what's not to love?!?

Sure it gets crowded and you're soon sharing elbow space with 1000 teens and tweens but it's all good.. they sell alcohol here! 

My son and I love racing each other on the tracks and running around playing all the arcade games. My wife and I love competing on the golf course and then again over a round of bowling. 

So much fun! Kind of pricy when you start to add it al up but soooooo worth it every once in a while! Everyone here gets to be a kid!

We paid for 6 lawn care services and only received 3, one of which was in February when there was still snow on the ground!  TruGreen did not come out during June or July when our lawn needed it the most. It was impossible to contact customer service and get our issues resolved. We pre-paid for our service, which was a huge mistake!  It took us over five phone calls and hours on the phone and several live chat sessions to finally get a check refunded to us for the incorrect amount.  Terrible company! Do not hire them!

I would give zero stars if I could. They had one waitress for a room full of people and it took me 30 minutes just to get a drink. Then when I finally got my drink it had food and hair in it. Then when I asked for a new one the owner (dwayne) said I was lying. Why would I lie about something like that? I hadn't even taken a drink of it yet. And I didn't make a scene and yell that there was food and hair in my beer. I politely asked for a new one, how dare I right? For the owner of all people to treat customers like that is disgusting. Theres a reason this dump had two stars before I even left my review. I was scared to even order food because I thought they would spit in it. And I probably wouldn't have gotten it for well over an hour anyways. Avoid this place, terrible is putting it lightly.

Beware before you sign up.... If you change your mind about using Trugreen you will be in for a big hassle.  They do not have any local office phone numbers so you have to call the 800 number and sit on hold for sometimes,  several minutes to talk to someone sitting at a computer In Timbuktu.  We verbally said we wanted to use the service two weeks ago but within a couple days decided to go with a different lawn service.  We called the phone number immediately and cancelled .  We started getting texts messages that they were coming out to service the lawn.  I called Trugreen again and the girl at some computer somewhere  assured me it was cancelled.  I got another text a few days later that 'Angelo' was coming out to service the lawn that day.  I called again and the girl said she would cancel it but it takes 24-48 hours to go through.  She said she will put on Angelo's work order that it's cancelled but he has to open up the order when he gets here to see it.  I guess the only way to insure that Angelo does not do the service is for us to sit at the front window from 1:00-4:00 and run out there to stop him.  What a hassle....Don't get caught in the 'Trugreen' trap.....

We purchased a sectional set and a coffee table. Our sales associate, Ken Price was very helpful. He showed us our options and was knowledgeable about the products and services offered. Ken was not pushy at all. He let us look as long as we wanted. He was available for questions but was not hovering over us. 
All and all it was a pleasant experience. I would recommend R.C. Willey and if you go there ask for Ken.

I love this store. At first I was intimidated by the size and the variety of items but everything I have purchased has been outstanding quality and reasonable prices. The staff is super friendly and the whole process of purchasing, paying and scheduling delivery has gone smoothly every time. For once, in a retail environment you can actually find someone to help you!! My family has purchased refrigerators, couches, entertainment centers and recently a desk and a mattress. All are amazing and we're delivered and assembled damage free!!

I wanted to let others know that Heritage made fixing my broken vehicle a very pleasant experience. They kept me informed of the repairs from start to finish. Even better yet Ben (technician) did an incredible job on my repair! Scott was a pleasure to work with as well! Hats off to you guys for a great team performance. I recommend Heritage to all

My all-time favorite grocery store! The service here is amazing, the attention to detail is impeccable, and the food is out standing no matter what you buy!
Some of my favorites are the brisket poutine, the Tuscan sandwich, and the poké bar.
I love shopping here for gifts for my clients, a quick lunch for myself, and even household shopping. It's the perfect one stop shop!

This gym it's mandatory for you to bring a towel despite them having approximately 20 Clorox type cleaning wipe dispensers. Many people prefer to use the cleaning dispensers. But they continue to harass the members about having a towel despite them providing it a second option. I was approached by manager Gayle of axiom today and ask for my towel. I told him I had a towel. He he said he didn't believe me so he was calling me a liar.  I showed it to him and told him how disrespectful to call me a liar ! Then he verbally abused me for 10 minute about having a mandatory towel. I reminded him that I am a paying member and that I have done nothing wrong. I told him that I will continue to use his second option that they provide for the members for cleaning the machines. I told him I don't appreciate  being called a liar and treated like a five-year-old. The hired help should have more respect for the people that pay there salary ! Definitely a hostile and toxic workout environment thanks to Gayle !

very fun, well-made,soft and delicious donuts. they have a reasonable, but not expansive variety of classic and updated donuts. i was hoping for the fruit filled kolaches i'm familiar with. instead they have very tasty meat filled enriched roll that appears to more closely match Klobasneks. definitely a nice weekend treat stop.

Had lunch there today for the first time and had a wonderful experience. Great service and food. Had the best burger I've tasted in the Boise area! My wife had the chipotle chicken wrap and enjoyed it as well. Alex, the GM, stopped by the table to thank us for coming in. Nice touch!!! Will definitely be back.
I've been here 5 or 6 times. Always consistent. I've only had the original with a side Greek salad each time, but has been great each time. Good food.

Kameron did a great job analyzing the issue we are having with our oven door. He has ordered the parts and we are looking forward to installation/repair next week, as well as being able to safely use our oven again!!!

My son loves Nashville chicken and wanted to try this place. We both loved our sandwiches and the fries were delicious. My son had the Cluck original sandwich with the Nashville Sweet. I had the Cluck original with Nashville warm. They have a great menu that explains the spice level. They have something for everyone 

The staff was super friendly. The restaurant was very clean. This is a very casual dining that offers take out. 

If you like Nashville chicken this is a must place to try out.

I had a bad feeling when I saw an empty drive thru at 12 in the afternoon.  Sure enough, when I got home the burger was completely cold...not room temperature, like it felt like it was in the refrigerator and they bagged it up.  I had to microwave it because the cheese wasn't even melted.  Sorry, but if you make a burger and the cheese isn't melted you don't know what you are doing!

On top of that their credit card machine prompts you for a tip....in the drive thru???  So even after leaving a tip I got a cold burger and fries when I asked for tator tots lol

They do make good ice cream, but I wouldn't get their warm food because it'll be as cold as the ice cream.  Stick to the Boise location if you want a good burger.  

I should have gone to Tin Roof Tacos next door, that place is bomb!!

I haven't had donuts this good in a very long time!  The glazed were light and tender as well as the cake ones.  I am not a fan of a lot of weird donuts and toppings.  If I am going to have the calories, I want to have something really delicious made by bakers that know how to make a quality donut.

I have had a very positive experience with PBT and would recommend them.  The staff is super friendly and pleasant.    

The only thing I find a tiny bit frustrating is that there is no local email contact (that I could locate).  Twice I have wanted to convey information to the local franchise and did not because I couldn't find a way without writing to  PBT Corporate.

Fast and friendly service and very helpful. Drive thru and dine in both available. We chose dine in and we were the only customers eating inside. Food is very reasonably priced. We ordered a couple kids meals, a couple falafel gyro meals, and some sides of pita and hummus. The food was good, just not quite good enough to entice us to return again.
Our family of 6 had a great time with the unlimited pass.  Laser tag was a lot of fun--we played 4 games and also loved the road track. Good safety precautions in place too.

It was about 9:50pm this past Monday night (7/9/18) and my son asked for dessert. On a whim I decided to get everyone in the car (teenagers:13,14,&15) and head over to Fanci Freeze for some ice cream. My son (14) has been here several times with his friends and really likes it, but none of the rest of us had tried it.  
We arrived at 10 & decided to go through the drive thru. My hubby & I were looking sharp in our PJ pants so we didn't want to embarrass our kids too much.  Looking back; it was a missed opportunity! #Momfail  Anyhow, we pulled up to the speaker and were cordially greeted by the cashier on the other end.  Since we haven't been here before we had several questions about available dip flavors, etc. The menu was quite impressive! We ordered:

Xtra Small swirl cone (me)
Medium vanilla cone dipped in cherry shell (hubby)
Small swirl cone coated in butterfinger (13 y/o daughter)
Small chocolate cone coated in Oreo (15 y/o daughter)
Small swirl cone dipped in Oreo (14 y/o son)

This cost just over $12. I thought the pricing was really reasonable. After placing our order it took just under 20 minutes before we made it to the window to pay. That's no exaggeration! 20 minutes. I was really surprised that it took so long to serve 4 cars. However, when we finally got to the window I could see where the problem lies.  The cashier at the window was again very nice, but she was responsible for way too many things.  She was taking orders, serving customers at the window, & also making the ice cream cones.  She had no help whatsoever. It took almost 5 minutes at the window to get 5 ice cream cones.  I do not fault her at all! She should have some help. This is clearly a management issue. 
The cones looked and tasted great! My husband didn't like the cherry candy dip on his ice cream.  He said that it tasted too artificial, but he really liked the ice cream itself.  I will definitely be coming back. I hope that they are able to make some changes to improve service.

Best laser hair removal in town! They are so professional and answered all of my questions. The rooms are beautiful, bright, and peaceful. Looking forward "moms spa day out" many more time! Worth it guys!!!

THANK YOU NICOL !! I found some good old fashion Idaho customer service at the Blind Gallery today. I was trying to repair a large wooden blind for my daughter and after a few hours decided to visit the Blind Gallery where we had purchased the blinds for our house years ago. I was met by Nicol Chandler, one of their window covering specialist, and explained my problem who advised that their repair guys was out of town until the first week of July. She then agreed to take a look. She spent approximately 30 minutes diagnosing the issue and then she repaired it for me and to top it off didn't charge me for her time or  a couple of small parts she had to use to repair the blind. I'm telling all my friends and family if they need blinds The Blind Gallery is the ONLY place to shop. Thanks Nicol !!
Great friendly staff.  Be sure to ask for your seared ahi "rare", because mine came very cooked through!

$12 buck Tuesday. A total rip off.     No Mini Golf as promised and we couldn't replace it with another activity.   We were told we could play unlimited video games......then I come to learn that we were limited to the games that didn't give tickets.     That left us waiting around for about 20 games that everyone wanted to play......


Bottom line, too many people, too many restrictions and too much money for too little game.   Never again!!
They need to try to keep unaccompanied older kids from running amok in the restaurant. Apparently, management is more concerned with fries on the floor than young children being knocked to the floor.

This place is a hidden gem! My husband and I stopped here for dinner and we were so impressed! Very nice restaurant with a full bar. We had excellent service and our food was delicious! We had the calamari appetizer and both had fish & chips. It was soooo good! This place is a must try in Meridian! Plus all day happy hour on Sundays!

Our daughter started out in recreational classes at Danik last year, and when team try out announcements were made, she wanted to try. She made it to the Level 1 team. On the first day of practice for the team, I drove my daughter to drop her off. (We were told that it's preferred that parents do not stay.) My daughter was 6, so I didn't feel comfortable dropping her off without knowing where to send her. We waited and waited in the sitting area, with no one coming over to instruct us where to go. I had to get back to work (practice was in the morning during the summer, and luckily I work from home so I could drop her off). Finally, I took off my shoes and tried to walk her over to a coach in the work out area. As I am walking with her, I get yelled at, "Are you a parent? You need to go wait over there." That did not sit well with me. I complained to the head coach later via email; turns out she was the one who I had the interaction with. 

To make a long story short, pretty much our entire time on the team went like that. We had very little communication with the coaches--it was all done via email, and never in person. Our daughter had some behavior issues during practice, and we were not told about it until months later. The woman at the front desk is not helpful at all and looks and acts like she hates her job. I'm not sure why the folks at Danik don't treat their clients better. 

To Danik's credit, they do seem to win a lot of competitions, so the coaches obviously know their stuff. We had a couple of personal coaching sessions, and that coach was so lovely and helpful to our daughter. But all in all, the communication is just absolutely horrible. We changed gyms, my daughter is on the team, and she is thriving. She enjoys it so much, and so do we. I have talked to more people (front desk, coaches) in just three weeks than I have in a year at Danik. Danik is just not the place for us. If your child is going for a college scholarship or wants to be in the olympics, then I would suggest Danik. If she wants to have fun, perhaps it's not the right place for you either.

My Experience with Axiom has been terrible.... If I could have given them less then 1 star I would have.

Buyer BEWARE !!!   I passionately dislike this business after my experience with predatory billing practices.

And The Meridian locations customer service is atrocious; when I called to get a 13 month old billing issue resolved, Cody hung up on me when I questioned how everyone in charge could be out of the gym until the first of the year, he would not even tell me who the manager was or how to contact their corporate office. 

Never a return call or email as promised!

Let me start by saying, I have been teaching (in NJ) for 7 years. So i have kind of a high bar when I take classes... I was visiting for the weekend to 'explore Boise' for a potential relocation... I took class on Cinco with a duo-taught class (first time for that) and a DJ (also first time, but always a dream of mine to teach to a DJ). These ladies were on point! They vibed together great, the instruction was clear, structure was smooth, changes were to the music, and the ride was challenging the entire way. 

I, personally, am not a fan of push ups and weights and screens (aka giant distractions) or any other weird things while on a bike. The screens were off. The other weird (to me) stuff did not over take the spin element. And everything was pretty amazing, the energy in the room was lit, and I cant wait to go back and take another class. (Side note: I took another class, at another spin studio, the day before and I wanted to leave within the first 2 or 3 songs. HUGE difference.) I didn't think I was going to like the whole chain/putting-on-a-show type of studio but I'm definitely in love.
Best nails in the State of Idaho & The BEST CUSTOMER SERVICE  we have been going to them for over 11 years!!

I visit this Dominos at least once a week. I have always been really impressed by the accuracy of my order, the quality of the food, the service from the employees, & the prices. 
 I have experienced both delivery & picking up the food myself.  The delivery drivers have always been super nice, clean, respectful, & polite. My food has always arrived very quickly & was still hot.

Great Sales Team Talent! We walked in and went straight to clearance, by-passing most of thefloor sales persons. We weren't surprised no one stopped us! It was just a few days before Black Friday but the deals had already started!
After glancing through clearance we headed back to the sales floor. It took about 15 minutes for a sales person to come over. It wasn't upsetting to us. We were having fun looking at all the floor sets.
Then we made a decision and it was time to speak to someone. That's when we met Juan!
Juan answered all of our questions and sold us a bedroom set and a mattress! So excited to return our Sleep Number bed! What was so impressive about Juan is that he was able to tell us information in a straightforward manner but without getting our hopes up. He wasn't pushy by any means and he didn't stand there trying to stroke our egos. Juan sticks to the facts and I respect his hussle!

Stopped in the Boise/Meridian area overnight traveling through the area.  We asked the hotel desk clerk for recommending a place for good Mexican food.  He got really excited and told about Corona Village.  His parents took him there when he was growing up and they still go and have a family dinner

After obtaining directions we drove a couple of Mike's away to Corona Village Mexican Restaurant.  It's off the beaten path away from tourist meccas.

We walked in a were immediately greeted with a smile then were seated promptly.  Chips and salsa and our drinks arrived within minutes, our dinners shortly thereafter.  

I ordered shrimp over rice with a white jalapeno cream sauce that was so good that I overate.  They give you an abundance of food.  Cooked to perfection.  I wished I could remember the name of the platter but it was soooooo good.  

The place was busy but the waitresses worked the tables like a fine oiled machine.  Never out of water, always offering to refill our drinks.

A nice touch was when the bill arrived, it came with two cinnamon tortilla chips glazed in a sweet red sauce and a dab of whip cream.  Sorta of a mexican fortune cookie.   

We left happy and fulfilled.  The price was reasonable , the food great and the service outstanding.

They used to be good. They have gone down hill for the last year. I ordered three items, yesterday,to go. When I got home with them two items were not what I ordered. I ordered a chimichanga del Mar and got a chimichanga vegetarian.  It was way over cooked and after two bites it went into the trash. Time to find a new Mexican restaurant.

Hopefully this was just not a great day. I have always raved about the food and service but was not thrilled today. I arrived for Happy Hour At 5:04. They were friendly but I stood around for a bit waiting to be seated. I got seated around 5:15-5:20 in the bar area as per my request and the waitress was nice and gave me time to make a decision. I ordered the Mule which arrived around 5:25 and I asked for a couple of minutes to peruse the Happy Hour menu. She returned a few minutes later and I placed my order and mentioned my cocktail was a bit too ginger which she fixed. I placed my order at 5:30 and waited 30 minutes for the sushi to arrive. It wasn't the time that bothered me but the sushi arrived room temperature with very little wasabi and nobody checked until I was done eating. It was not the stellar experience I have become accustomed to over the years. Sadly, although convenient, I will probably not be recommending Lucky Fins to my friends and family as I have in the past. May try again in the spring...
Super fun atmosphere especially in the spring and summer when the garage doors are lifted.  Service and everything ordered including the drinks were great!!!

A supermarket with a full beer. Let me repeat that A...SUPERMARKET...WITH...A...FULL...BAR. What kind of boardroom meeting bantered this idea about and decided to run with it? Well, however it came about, it works and is just one of the reasons that this supermarket works. 

This is not the only reason that this supermarket is so popular. The meat department is pretty amazing with some high quality meat.

If I had to point my finger at something negative is that the place can get crowded. Of course it is, the place is awesome.
Amazing school and staff is dedicated and caring. I would recommend it to anyone looking for a quality education

So far, Kameron has been one of the best appliance repair persons we've ever met. He kept in touch with us to make sure we knew when he was arriving. He was punctual and was prepared to look at our dryer immediately. He diagnosed the problem and tried to fix it on the spot. He was extremely knowledgeable and even cleaned some of the problem areas. He ordered the broken parts and scheduled to come back and repair it. He explained everything, he was very kind and thoughtful of our situation. I would highly recommend him.

Probably one of the best markets selection wise I've been in.  Seriously amazing deli, bakery, hot meals, and cafe area.  It's a treat to just wander and grab samples.   

Unfortunately I didn't even venture around the whole place, way too crowded and overwhelming.   After a very short time, the worse in people came out with impatience and a very rushed vibe.   We just picked up an adorable birthday cake here for a very reasonable price and hit the check-outs.  The bakery attendants were so nice and patient.  But that's the only calm in a very big storm of a store.

Unfortunately we got in a stacked two checkout lane and even felt the rushed vibe from the people behind trying to push past to get the the register in front.  

Fun to try but not for me to frequent regularly.

Wow! So glad I found this place. I called for a same day appointment as I had tweaked my neck and needed some relief. I was able to get in a few hours later with Grace. Hand down" Pune intended " she is amazing. Great communication on pressure and problem areas. Her energy is fantastic and she has warm strong hands. You can tell she has done massages for awhile and has her own technique. I highly suggest you give them a call for a great massage !

Stopped by for lunch today and grabbed a sandwich. There are a good number options to choose from. I opted for the Italian Meats sandwich.
The sandwich is served cold with freshly baked bread (the best part of the sandwich). The menu stated it is served with an Italian kettle sauce.....I believe that means mayo...fyi. The meats and veggies were ok. The meats lacked flavor and the sandwich was flat in flavor overall. The mayo was the most prominent flavor I felt. 
There are better sandwich joints nearby that I would recommend. 
Cheers Always!!

I can't explain how amazing Grant on the maintenance team has been to us. We have had a few minor issues with our apartment and not only has he gotten to things in a timely manner but he has also been so kind to us. He has at times gone above and beyond his job duties to help us out. Whenever I say "sorry we have to bug you about this" he responds with "hey! It's my job" OR "that's what I am here for". Which ya- that is true but most people wouldn't be so nice and friendly about it like he has been. I would 100% re new my lease next year here if we don't buy a home because of him and the way Indigo has a 24 hour maintenance team on site.

I am a Real Estate broker in Las Vegas and have used Tony Alder there for 20 years. Tony refered me to the Evergreen team in Idaho where I recently purchased a home.  Sam and Megan made it a wonderful and seamless transaction. I would highly recommend them and will definitely use them again for all my future business.
I've never been to this salon before and may give it a try again but would NOT see Martha again. All I can say is she was rude and not easy to work with.

First time coming here and I loved it! Jackie did my nails and she was so sweet. The place looks really modern and clean. They take all the precautions for Covid as well. I will be returning! I live in Boise and it's worth the drive to come to this nail salon!
Awesome breads, European specialties etc. We like the little sprats in jars. Like sardines but better. Also sausage and cheese. Need to go back soon!

I just got my nails done by Ashley B and won't go anywhere else anymore. Her talent and professionalism was unambiguous. Right when I came in she made me feel welcomed and helped me pick out the perfect color. The location isn't the most convenient to where I live but won't mind the drive out to schedule with her again.
Great surprise.   Had a wrap with halibut for lunch. Yummy!!!   Fresh, not fishy, with a tasty sauce. I will get it again.  Service with a smile.

Run, Run, Run from this business. They will take your money, give a piss pour excuse of an investigation and then ghost your ass. I hired him to investigate a person and then to produce a report. No report. 
I was told that investigators don't need to be licensed in Idaho so they can say they are investigators but are not really good investigators. Anyways, he sells himself as a Marine, all honest and true, but the owner is a crock!! Matthew, I hope you feel good about yourself lining your pockets with hard earned money from struggling hard working moms.

Excellent!

I have had my hair cut by all the barbers here and have never been disappointed. 

I highly recommend them!

Dr Anderson unfortunately put me in more pain then I was in when I originally visited her. She said that she must have adjusted something too much and was sorry. The problem is the extreme pain I was in and the fact that i had to pay to fix her mistake.
So good! I felt like the serving sizes are big and the chicken is juicy. The heat levels are good for every level of spice. The dirty bird fries are to die for. Can't wait to come back!

I have never worked with a management company that cared so little (absolutely zero!) about the community that they serve. If we get a response to an email (very rarely and usually only after follow up) the response is usually vague and useless. It's sad to see our beautiful community turning to trash because the management company doesn't care to enforce the CC&Rs. We purposely bought in a community with an HOA and CC&Rs because we wanted to live in a nice community where homeowners take care of their homes.

Excellent!

Old school barber action.
All of the stations are filled with competent professionals, I don't have to wait for any one of them, I can take whoever is available first and know I'll get a good clean cut including a beard trim.

I highly recommend them!

Been wanting to try a local donut shop instead of supporting a chain. This place did not disappoint! We went in around 10:30 on a Saturday and the selection was a little low but when I asked if they had the twisted donut, she said he was in the back making more. Everything tasted fresh and my favorite of all were the donut holes! So so good and I just love that they had them as an option whereas other places don't. The sprinkled donut was really good but not overly sweet which I really liked. The buttermilk blueberry donut was my husbands fave because it was nice and pillowy soft! The twisted donuts came out really hot and fresh and were so yummy!! All in all definitely recommend. Plus price wise I think it was really reasonable for everything we got, I believe it was around $11 or so. Will be going back for sure!

I hired Walker Painting to repaint the exterior of my house in Sacramento.  The job required extensive prep work and Craig and his team spent a substantial amount of time properly doing such.  My home is about 100 years old and as such presented additional challenges, yet Craig and his crew did a fantastic job.  The bid price was reasonable, all of the fellows on the crew were courteous and highly skilled, and now my house looks fantastic.  I have recommended Walker Painting to my mother who will also be hiring them to paint the exterior of her house too.  Needless to say, if you are looking for nice, honest people with integrity, who also offer affordable and highly skilled painting services, then I recommend these guys.

I really want this place to do well.  I'd initially thought it was a chain opening up its first location in our region, but it's way cooler than that.  Check out the "about" section of their website.  Cute story.

I'm a bit of a spicy chicken sammich enthusiast, so I've been eager to check this place out, and did so hours after they opened on their first day.  I'm trying to keep the fact that they'd only been open for a few hours in mind as I write this...

Friendly staff and one of the owners was checking on people.

I got The Cluck, which is a chicken sammich... I'm nothing if not predictable... and some onion rings.  You get to choose your heat level, there's four levels, and there was some description for each of them, so there may be some different flavors involved, but I wanted to see how gutsy we're being with our heat around here, so I just went for the hottest.

When the sammich came out, it had a pepper (jalapeno?) held to the top with a toothpick (toothpick with a cool chicken thingy on it, at that), so I popped the stem off and put it in the sammich.  Challenge accepted.  It was... not bad... Good chicken, nice batter, the slaw-type stuff was good, even my pepper was nice... I wouldn't say the seasoning was particularly flavorful, or hot.  I've had a few different takes on "Nashville" style, and... this one wasn't quite my fave.  Would I eat it again?  I mean... yeah... I would eat it again.

Now to the onion rings.  Well... look at 'em.  They're onion rings.  Little on the bready side for my taste, but I'm not the going authority on the perfect onion ring, and they did make a good vehicle for getting that delicious spicy ranch into my mouth... $5.99.... I'll get back to that.

So overall, it was... ok.  I'm curious to try the Dirty Bird as well as the Shrimp Po' Boy... but this has been bugging me.  I paid almost $20 after tax for sammich, o-rings, and fountain drink... and while it was ok, it wasn't great.  If the sammich had completely rocked my socks, I wouldn't even bat an eye at the price... seems a bit much... but they did just open, and maybe after some things get tweaked, Clucks will become a thing of glory.  Work on the seasoning, and maybe have a 5th level of heat where they really cut loose... I really hope they pull it together over time!

No soap at any of the sinks. Not even a dispenser in the men's restroom. Pretty ridiculous considering the word we're living in now. What's really disturbing is the question, where are the workers washing their hands after they use the restroom before they go back snd make food?  Disgusting!! I think I'm done going to Maverik.

If shady, back-alley, under the table bribes didn't exist this place wouldn't have a single positive review. Either that or previously unsatisfied customer are locked in a underground dungeon beneath this so called "family center" and forced exchange scraps of food for 5 star reviews. 
This place is hanging by a tread. They can do all the construction and renovations  they want but it won't fix customer relations. No matter how appetizing you make dog shit look you can never fool someone into thinking it's a proper meal.
The managment here cares so little about their customers that COMCAST often calls for tips and tricks on being more infuriating.
Between this place and the traffic across the street I'm not sure where I'd rather have my kids play.
Avoid this place and save yourself a headache no modern medicine can aleviate.

Laser tag 9/10.

We had a wonderful experience with the store and especially with Casey.  
When I met Casey,  well I was in full-blown buyers remorse mode.  The night before our mattress land experience, my husband and I had a very impulsively purchased a mattress from another store. Not only was it the most expensive mattress, it was a brand that I had never heard of and apparently most of the world had never heard of because I couldn't find a review online to save my life. I had to go back into the store the next day and cancel my order which of course made me feel terrible. 

As I drove away feeling guilty, I realized I still needed a mattress. I decided to look online to make sure I wasn't missing any mattress stores near me.  
There on yelp was my answer, Mattress Land Sleep Fit! 
Not only does the store have The highest reviews of any mattress store on yelp, the customers were writing these fantastic comments and stories about how great their mattress shopping experience was. 
So I called and spoke with Casey (the manager)
 on the phone.  Even the phone call was a great experience. I knew I needed to go in and let this guy help me.  Later that same day, I drove over to Mattress Land. 
Casey was Amazing.  He made me feel better about everything. Not only did he help us find a new mattress, he saved us an incredible amount of money and he used his personal and professional experience to get us into the perfect bed for us. He was patient, informative and we never felt pushed into anything. It was really refreshing to feel relaxed and comfortable about this purchase.  We left there feeling relieved and very confident that we made a good decision.  
If you are out looking for a new mattress, this is the place to go!

Literally walked in at 3:09 for my 3pm and she turned me away when there was NO ONE waiting in the shop. One gal was doing someone's nails and she said sorry ur late and it's our policy to cancel after 10 min.  I scheduled a sitter for this appointment. I tried calling to let them know I was close but no one answered. These young girls do not know good customer service. As a business owner they could have done better to accommodate. Plus they emailed me as a No Show. Unbelievable.

I designed a custom workshop shed. I paid top dollar. Every time it rained the floor got flooded due to the threshold of the garage door that was installed incorrectly from the start. I was told that the garage door was at fault. A rubber sill was installed which did not make any difference. The problem was the metal sill that was installed overlapping. The owner of the company after a few months did state that it was the wrong sill installation. Finally another sill was sent to me that did not work.at all. I asked for another sill that would work . I am still waiting... six months later, for a reply. Now my sub floor and floor joists have to be replaced due to the excessive water damage. I have to relocate my whole workshop and tools tools to be able cut out the damaged floor. I am so disappointed and totally frustrated. I could of purchased a Tuf shed and would of had no problems. I am sorry to say that would not recommend these guys to anyone.

When I used to go to downtown location I always got too many onions and quite large pieces in my Greek salad. Plus they seemed like leftover from the day before since the cucumber was soggy. Here it's fresher. But the onions are still too big!  I can pick them out at least. I like some onion in my salad, Just not as much or big chunks. And the salad is their best side I think. 
  The gyros are hit/miss. Mostly good. I often get the spicy ones with green sauce. And avocado. The condiments seem to be in clusters. All the avocado in one part, all the onion in another, etc. (and once again big chunks). I end up unwrapping it to make better. 
Baklava obviously comes out of a package--maybe frozen. I've gotten better or at least similar from Walmart. About 12 pieces there for $10. Gyro Shack's is $4 each. Skip it.  Not bad but a bit dry and not worth the calories or price for a 1"x1-1/2" triangle.

An honest review. 
Wahooz Family Fun Zone, sounds fun right? I thought so.
While browsing for things to do in Idaho we decided to check this place out. 
Driving up I immediately felt like we'd made the right decision. I almost felt a sense of childhood wonder as we saw all the different attractions. 
However as we entered the building it felt like we stepped through a portal into a B list movie of the classic family fun arcade trope, demotivated teenage staff slumming around too lost in thought to care about anything but the next TikTok trend. The animatronic rodent in charge of managing the place wasn't too impressive either. 
Not to be discouraged so early on we got our tickets and began exploring the facility. We figured that since it had just opened it was understandable that some of the attractions weren't open yet. The more we explored the less we found, mostly everything was either under maintenance or simply too understaffed to be operable. 
So we waited...
After 3 hours, and countless "soon, almost, any minute nows" later our spirits finally broke, nothing we came for open. They explained that due to a short staff, certain rides were on rotation, and as that reasonable as that is, it's completely unreasonable not to inform your guests beforehand which rides are out of rotation. 
The menu has been downsized and the food and drink options aren't too impressive either. 
Take the time to drive a bit further to any of the other Amusement Centers, I promise you won't regret it.
Overall this place just isn't professional enough to deserve your business. They didn't care about us, they won't care about you. 
Very disappointed.


Laser tag 9/10.

CycleBar at The Village is an incredible experience. I've been going consistently since February and have loved every ride. Having never done spin before I was REALLY nervous about going, or being able to keep up with the class. I don't really like 'group' workouts, but the environment in the studio couldn't be more amazing. With the lights low you feel like you are doing a private ride, but set to incredible music and challenging ride.

All of the instructors bring their ENERGY to each ride, and push you to grow and challenge yourself each time. The community that exists within CycleBar is another reason I keep going back every week. Everyone has their own reasons and challenges for being there, and it creates an amazing sense of teamwork and togetherness knowing you are pushing through the same hard ride with everyone else.

The entire staff works hard to learn riders names and help everyone out so you always have a great ride. I love the tech behind CycleBar as well. The playlists from every class is available to download right after the ride (And if you have a favorite song mention it to an instructor and you will almost be sure to hear it in a future class!). I love that the bike tracks your progress, and that as soon as the ride is over you have all of your stats from the ride.

If you've been on the fence about trying, just try! I never thought I would like spin, and it has become my sanctuary (mostly my time of peace away from 3 young kids lol).  Thanks my CycleBar family!
Just got done eating at Hugo's. Nothing special - kinda expensive for what we got. Fries over rated, sandwiches on the small side , French Dip (sad). Won't be back again, sorry.
Was looking at switching to this place and checked out the website. No prices listed. To me that means they gouge you once your in. Any honest place is upfront and doesn't hide the price of a haircut
Raymond from Lake Appliance Repair promptly showed up for a warranty call on my washer. He had it repaired in no time. Highly recommend

The mail carrier In my area are so lazy. The lady is always leaving notes in our box saying can't deliver the mail because trash cans blocked the mail box. Wow she couldn't deliver the mail, but had time to wright a not and put it in our box. I can't help where the trash guy drops the cans. Again today there were no cans blocking the mailbox.The other notes we have received is when a car or my truck is parked in front of my house, not blocking the mailbox. She left a note again. We have seen her not deliver mail because she can't drive up to the mailbox. 
The weekend guys have never had a problem.

At that time he was holding and is still holding my Tenants 800.00 security deposit and March rent of 900.00 that was to be released to us.
