After we did everything he asked, which included giving him my husbands SS# (supposedly for the IRS) and still not receiving the payment we called once again and this time was told it went out in the mail.  2 weeks have gone by and still nothing and now when we call no one ever answers the phone.  This ex-cop, should be thrown in jail.

First time to this location and we were giving 6 frozen cookies.  The kids could not eat them because they had to wait for them to thaw.  Once they did, they all did not like them.   

I would have been nice of them to tell us they were frozen.  We may have passed this time.  Once I drove back to ask why, they just said they were frozen.  

Thank you and think twice before visiting.
Free delivery. Drive thru. Nice people. Oh and they compound their own Meds which very very few pharmacies do.

Was arrested for drinking and driving after crashing into someone new 2017 car. I was handcuffed respectfully. The patrol car was clean and roomy. Overall a great experience 10/10 will get arrested again.
Gina Anderson is amazing! She has been doing my hair for years! She listens to what you want done and does it! Keep up the great job!!

I paid Trugreen over a week ago to fertilize my lawn.  The salesperson on the phone took my money, promised service within 2-3 days.  I called today because it still has not happened, and was told that no manager was available, and I would need to wait 24 hours to hopefully get a callback.  Terrible customer service, false advertising.

Really love their frozen yogurt here.  I am not a big frozen yogurt fan but I can eat a lot here. There are about 12 flavor selections here.  the toppings are good and fresh.  Many different "dressing" to top on.  Store is clean and the staff friendly and helpful.

Plus side, you can always take the treat to the outside and enjoy it if the day is good. Really enjoy their yogurt here
Morgan and Glenn were amazing, they were patient and worked relentlessly to make sure I got the compensation I deserved. I am so happy and glad I chose these guys.

I didn't get the notice that Tuesday's are $2 games. Showed up at 8pm and the main lounge was full so we were SO excited when Eric told us we would be in the private Z lounge without extra charge. The lounge was empty for the most part and we ordered our adult beverages. Our perfectly unplanned date night without our newborn daughter was about to change. In walks a family of 4 and what do you know..they were put at the next lane and so we got to share a table with this family that of course wants to talk to us. Man do I sound like a grouch but I'll tell you as I write this I would consider 2 stars for my experience especially after a $18 bar tab for 2 drinks. This next part is not so gravy to me: the reason the family was put next to our lane was so the cleaning staff could start early toclean the room. So we felt pushed out. Even the bartender grabbed my drink glass before I was actually really done with it and then came back for the water glasses right as our last game ended. This is NOT the first time I felt rushed here. I had my bachelorette party here at the Z lounge and it was the cleaning crew that made us feel rushed. I think next time I'm going to Big Al's. 
Update: DONT GET THE NACHOS!! Why do I come back? Came here for my birthday. We ordered beef nachos. Where is the beef? By the way Kimberly was amazing. She said there was beef in the center. Nope. Some supervisor came by and gave us free soda. I'll tell you, $20 for these nachos. No! Where's the queso? So mad. So disappointed. I'm done with this place. I'll stick to mini golf and the other attractions. No more bowling. And I'll even leave for food and come back!

We love this team!  I've done three mortgages in 2 years with them and each was a breeze.  I even sent my 84 year old mother to them and she needed no help from me at all.  They take care of everything!

I chose this location due to the fact that I did not have to have quarters. From the moment I walked into this place, I knew it was different.  I was greeted by a very friendly young man, who helped me determine the correct size washers for my loads.  I would have used four washers, but instead only needed three because of the various sizes offered.  He also helped me to determine the amount of money to put on my card - He suggested that I load my washers first and then determine how much I would need.  

This place is immaculate!  

The next time I visit Boise, I will definitely be back
My favorite place! Yum! The food is so good! I love the Diablo roll and the Vegas roll

It's September and I'm feeling like having Thanksgiving.  Holy cow - this sandwich is perfect.  Soft, flavorful, with the right about and savory and sweet.  

$8 for this sandwich and totally worth it.  

I didn't get the chance to eat it hot, bit even cold it was beyond delicious.  

Definitely worth checking out.

These guys are seriously the best! And might I add, the location on Eagle/Ustick is equally as stellar....so it's a matter of what's more convenient for you.  (I'll be sure to write a review about the other location too)

On my most recent visit to this particular location, I had just learned after a morning of car not starting,  AAA, waiting.....tech diagnosing battery bad, tech not having the right battery on his truck....that alas I needed to high tail it stat to get a new one. No stopping, just straight there were the instructions.

This Les Schwab is near my work, so I figured if there was a lengthy wait I'd be able to call for a ride and come back later. But behold....I pulled up near the entrance and before I could finish my internal debate to turn the car off or not, a tech was at my window. He sent me inside and drove the car right in. A few minutes later he confirms the battery was no bueno and I approve a new one. I was there maybe 25 minutes total when he called me to say it was done.  The best part....he apologized for the length of time because they noticed my tire pressure light was on and inspected the reason. Staple in my tire and to be certain it didn't have a leak,  they pulled it off and submerged it. Seriously?!? Service like that is few and far between and I appreciate it!!

Very poor service. I felt it was clear when the tech got here he didn't want to be here. He was here less than 5 minutes. He might not have been able to fix the problem but he was super rude about it. He shaped his hands and said nothing I can do about it and left. He said he would make sure they didn't come back, thank goodness.

Clean and family friendly. Staff is great and super nice. Food is great. Some nice pizza choices served New York style, Fresh and warm. They offer weekly specials as well as happy hour specials from 2-6. They offer beer, wine, and other spirits. You can eat in restaurant or take pizza home. They will make it fresh for you to take and bake. They have a patio area too. We will be going back for sure! Only reason it's not 5 stars is because my son mentioned they should have at least one tv on the wall. However they do play music which is nice and not too loud or obnoxious.

Worst service. Waited over an hr to place our order. I should have known when the waitress couldnt get our drink orders right. Waitress finally took our order and then came back a while later to tell us that she didn't put it in. Re ordered and she missed a person in our party. Came back and let us know she put it in the first time. Food came out and my order was wrong. Waited a while longer and still no food. Canceled my order that I still hadn't received  and they still had the audacity to charge me for my drinks. I will not be back.
Best nachos in the world. Whoever invented these should have a national holiday on their birthday

Alberstons Market Street in 5: It's the Target of Albertsons.

1st visit: I drove up, and then drove away. Parking? Nope. Mayonnaise. As in, mayonnaise a lot of people here. 

2nd visit: Found very specific puppy treats for my friends pup. Gawked at the gorgeous homewares and thought I was at Target for a minute. Had to Bird Box my way out of there. 

3rd visit: On a mission to get snacks for girls night. Got one item on the list, blacked out and left with a bunch of stuff I didn't know I needed. Like canned grapefruit vodka soda. 
Wait, WHAT??? 

It's about to get (more) ridiculous...
The ice cream aisle is out of control. You'll find alcoholic pints of Haagen-Dazs: Amaretto. Bourbon. Irish cream. Chocolate Stout.
Shut the front door. 

Local finds... Also, how do you spell bouji? Asking for a friend...
I appreciate that they label local items really well, you can't miss them. 
There are many local items available such as: Firesidemallows from Caldwell. Your friends will get hot chocolate envy when you throw in a couple of those bad boys. Lit & Co clean burning soy candles (from Boise) that are quite fantastic. Pints of STIL ice cream. Local bouji. 
Fancy.

Albertsons Market Street, you're just being silly right now...
There's honestly too much to write about and if I give it all away you wouldn't have an adventure. I suggest you go on a Monday or Tuesday to avoid chaos. You could easily spend a couple of hours exploring this place. There's a Starbucks and a bar. So you can get your drink on.
That's so extra. Stop it Target. Just stop it.

Just completed our purchase of a Kingsdown Bed that has more features than I would have ever thought came on a bed. Latex is the creme de la creme of beds. My wife and I are a Mutt and Jeff pair in terms of weight and firmness likes.We also like to have different head and feet heights and positions. 

Since we wanted a King and having the differences in our comfort likes, we looked at the split King, with adjustable positions. Also has a vibratory massage feature.

Daron helped us select the bed we needed and was patient as any salesperson could be. We used their computerized firmness selector to determine the firmness factor for each side. To be honest, this is not a cheap purchase, but one that helps in terms of our health as well as our sleep.

We did have one minor glitch in our purchase, however. Our current bed had a fancy headboard, foot board and frame with drawers under the mattress support. The delivery crew showed up and told us that the frame was not going to work as the new bed surface would be at least 4 feet off the floor. Since the Mrs is only 5 feet tall, this became a real obstacle.

However,  Daron, was a pillar of calm and said, I am going to come and see what can be done. So after work, he came to our house and looked at the frame. He saw that the inner frame and mattress supports and drawers could be removed and our new bed could sit inside the frame with no problems. He said, he would do the work as he had done carpentry before and had the tools to do it. He even took one of his days off and did the work. He arranged for the delivery crew to redeliver the bed after he had done his carpentry work and everything fit in like it had been made for the new bed. Now that is going the extra mile to complete the sale, in our opinion.

There is a no-risk 30 day comfort trial period and if things aren't working, they will exchange for a new firmness mattress. doubt if we will need it, but it makes things comfortable in more ways than one.

We highly recommend Mattress Land to anyone buying their next bed. Pricing is competitive. Service is top notch. Pressure is nil. Delivery is on time when promised. You will be satisfied.

Very good froyo. I tried the cheesecake and loved it. The toppings bar is all the usual suspects and were good quality. The pricing is a little high but that is expected giving the location.  We will be back for sure.

This complaint addresses two separate doctors at OGA. Because I have filed a complaint with the Board of Medicine, I have decided not to include their names. Either way, the experience with both the staff and medical doctors at OGA makes upset, and I want to prevent other women from experiencing the same lack of medical or emotional care from this facility. If I could give less than one star I would.

(DR # 1) initially established care for my pregnancy. During said appointment she did a pap examination. I did notice that the speculum was not packaged and on the table, ready for use. At the time I did not think anything of it. Shortly after the examination I started to experience bleeding from my vagina. I called OGA and spoke with a nurse who stated that spotting after a pap examination was normal, and to just keep an eye on it. By Thursday night I had started to bleed moderately and even noticed clots when going to the toilet. I called two separate time to inform the facility (OGA) about the bleeding and was told by the same nurse that after the pap, light bleeding was normal and to keep an eye on it over the weekend. I explained that I was not spotting, but bleeding and passing clots, using about 4 pads a day for the bleeding. My concerns were ignored. By Saturday 8/4/2018 the clots were large and the bleeding was now heavy. I went again to the emergency room at St. Luke's Meridian, and was told that the baby still had a heart beat and that due to the amount of bleeding my diagnosis was a threatened miscarriage.

While at the ER I did complete some blood work and a urine test. I reviewed my results on St Lukes My Chart portal. My urine results caused me concern due to the high levels of protein, ketones and blood.

Obviously I was worried and wondered at that time why a pap was done at my initial appointment, and wondered if the unpackaged speculum had anything to do with my vaginal bleeding and subsequent urine results. When I followed up on Monday I met with (DR # 2). She sat with me for approximately 5-7 minutes. She said that because the baby was fine on the ER ultrasound report, despite the fact that I was STILL bleeding, we would "wait it out" for 2 weeks and then check again. I asked if an ultrasound could be done to ensure that I did not miscarry over the weekend. She said no. She also said my lab work from the office visit on 8/2/18 was fine and there was nothing to be concerned about. I disagreed, stating I only started bleeding after my visit where a pap was done. I explained that I was bleeding heavily, going through several pads a day. I further explained that I had been passing large blood clots every day. I then asked about my lab work from ER, specifically about the blood, protein and ketones in my urine. (DR # 2) said she has not yet viewed those results. When she finally did look at them she everything was fine and that the protein and ketones in my urine was from the vaginal bleeding, but gave no explanation as to what the bleeding could be caused from.

She appeared to be annoyed with the questions I was asking and then made a comment that she would not give me "progesterone, dydrogesterone, or any other 'voodoo' medications out there." I was completely shocked with the "voodoo" comment. I responded by telling her that I was not asking for medications but for an ultrasound to ensure that I did not miscarry over the weekend. She said she was not going to do an ultrasound now, and that if things got worse or if I passed large clots to let the office know. I then showed her a photo of a large clot in the toilet that I had passed just that morning and she rolled her eyes stating, "you're the 2nd person today to show me a picture." She then said, "if they get any bigger than that, let us know".

I asked her what I should tell my husband is the cause of the bleeding. She again seemed exacerbated, stating, "tell him 30% of women bleed in their 1st trimester."

I went out to the hall way were "checkout" is located and there was no one there. I went to the front to schedule a follow up appointment, and the receptionist took me to the back again, stating that someone at the "checkout" counter would be with me shortly. I waited for 10 minutes before becoming so frustrated that I went back to the lobby telling the receptionist no one ever showed up to help me. I left the office without scheduling a follow up.

After my experience I decided to find another doctor. The comment (DR # 2) made about not giving me voodoo medicines, and the fact that I only started to bleed after the pap examination by (DR # 1), I decided to change my OB doctor. I did not feel comfortable returning due to the lack of empathy shown and how (DR # 2) decided it was acceptable practice to talk down to me and make such an off the wall comment. Even if she deals with patients with similar problems on a daily basis, we are all individuals and should be treated with dignity and respect.

When they first came out to meridian, their food was  tasty and I found that their prices were average with the same quality of competition. That didn't last long. Their prices stayed the same but their serving sizes dropped. I guess $25 doesn't get much anymore.

Great food and great service!
We went here while on a recent visit to Eagle.  The service was great. We were seated quickly, and our server came by soon afterward. We each ordered something different and it all arrived quickly and together.  Our server checked with us to see that we had everything we needed and to ensure that we were happy with our meals.  The food was terrific.  We also noticed that the Manager (or maybe the Owner) made the rounds and frequently helped out the staff.  We will definitely return!

I honestly can't figure out why I keep trying to give this place another chance. Last week we came to get dip cones and they were out of vanilla ice cream and some of the dip flavors - so we left without buying anything. This time we come and they're out of chocolate ice cream and several soda flavors. Seriously?? On top of being out of everything, the teens working there are handling money at the register and then touching food. My husband requested the kid to wash his hands before getting our ice cream and not to use the dirty serving ladle that the kid used to scoop ice cream out of the dip flavor then touch the garbage can with it. I think he got overwhelmed with the requests that were made that he walked away and went in the back and began putting his hands in his hair. That's when I just walked out because I couldn't handle watching the train wreck. My husband waited for 15 minutes and finally got our dip cones - which were made by a different girl who DID wear gloves. We watched the guy with 4 kids behind us get pissed and leave and the people in front of us were also complaining. This is ridiculous! We will be contacting the owner. This was the worst it's ever been.

I have used TruGreen for a few years, and have never had a problem till this year.  Not sure if there is new Management, but after having to micro-manage the applications three times.  Three times I was told they would show up on one day, and they would not show up.   After having to get a hold of the manager, who then contradicted everything the technician told me to do after the application was put on the lawn, he assured me there would be no more issues.  His name was Troy, by the way.  By the fourth application, I still had weeds, and got a phone call from Troy accusing me of running out of my house and telling his tech that she was incompetent.   The sad part is, I was out of the state when this alleged issue happened.   Then I spoke to corporate, they contacted the main manager who then gave me a number to contact him back on.   I got a local customer service agent, who then refused to transfer my call to the main manager Joel.   I finally got his number and left a voice mail stating that some how I have experienced the worst customer service experience I have ever had.  In the end, I contacted corporate again and they assured me this would be taken care of.   As of now I contacted Senske and I like the service.  The product and service at TruGreen are both garbage.

Came in over the weekend, left here very disappointed. The service was awesome but the restaurant itself was in very rough shape. The bathroom was disgusting, my water had ice cubes with that had residue (mold,mildew, gunk, etc.) from a dirty ice machine, and my fries had a long dark hair in it. When I told the server, she sent the manager over who was very apologetic. Unfortunately after this was corrected, the girl in the kitchen with the dark hair walked by me several times and glared. On top of this, I had a perfectly good view into the kitchen. I noticed several employees eating back there which is against code (I used to work in the food industry and this is a very big deal.) When paying the check, we were not offered any sort of discount regardless of the issues we had. Very very disappointed in the cleanliness of this restaurant and will never return. We both ended up getting sick and vomiting by the time we got home. 100% do not recommend this place to anyone.

Since my previous honest  review was deleted I will leave another. I will not be shopping at this store. Rude staff, humiliating customers. Used to be my favorite store, so sad. What happened Trader Joe's??

Honestly I can't say enough great things about these guys service!  If your looking for any help recovering your property don't go anywhere else but here!  Outstanding pricing along with the quickest service you will get no where else. We asked for help for recovering a vehicle and paying the little bit more for them to get started the same day was the best plan.  They got the vehicle back in less than 2 hours before it could be hidden for good.  Very knowledgeable and will give you straightforward answers to your questions, nothing fake!  

Again come here first you won't regret it!

These guys did really great work. I was replacing an after market keyless entry that was installed by another shop that had stopped working. They got the new security system just how I wanted. I also had them install a trunk popper, backup camera, and stereo in my car. Trax took the time to make sure that they integrated each component with the other car systems, like the lights, parking brake, and ignition, so that the final result was seamless. They also made sure that the wires were clean and tidy and there was no evidence of the changes. Travis was especially responsive to text messages and updates, and the price was comparable to other places that I had considered. 

The only reason I didn't give them five stars is because I didn't have a solid quote on the price. Without an agreement, I was kind of guessing that the final price would match what we had discussed through exchanging text messages.  I was a little worried that there would be a surprise fee or charge. Luckily, there weren't any surprises. Overall I was very pleased and I would recommend them to anyone without reservations!

It's easter sunday and none of the places we were headed to were open so we took a chance and tried Lucky Fin. Omg so glad we did!

The food was excellant! The server was knowledgeable and confident. The manager even stopped by the table and said hi. I don't know when the last time was a manager at any restaurant did that. 

Fyi: get the kickin' shrimp sauce and put it on the fish on the fish n' chip dish. Then mix more of that kickin' shrimp sauce with the tartar sauce and bam...Lucky fry sauce. You're welcome.

Amazing empanadas! We discovered their truck by chance one day driving around and loved what we brought home. The next time we went to their store and found out they have an even bigger selection there! Oh my! My tummy is growling just writing this.
Amazing! Every single time every single empanada. The owner is the kindest man and his wife is a delight.
Food flavor was good but 1 bowl and 2 bao is $16. Wouldn't be bad but very small portions!  Most likely will not order again.

This is such a great sandwich/soup spot! We ordered the Philly cheesesteak (SO tasty), the chipotle turkey sandwich (so fresh and delicious), loaded potato soup, and tomato basil (meh). The drive thru is super handy when you have kids and don't want to get everyone out but also don't want fast food. The service was fantastic and we'll for sure be back! I will say, they were a little heavy handed on the Mayo, but it didn't bug me as much as my husband!

I'm really disappointed in the food here. I came in on a week night and it was busy. I ordered chicken strips and fries and it was absolutely awful. The chicken strips were worse than Tyson out of the bag chicken strips, the fries were gross and flavorless. My total for chicken strips, fries, and a soda came out to $16. I was hoping this would be my new favorite spot because it's close to home, but I'll keep looking. It seems like most people go here to drink as there wasn't much food being served. Service was good though.

Not bad.  Fast drive through time and excellent customer service.  The only reason this review is four stars instead of five is because our order was incomplete.  I blame myself partially for not checking the bag before driving off.  We ordered two gyros both in combos with chips.  They gave us the drinks then handed out a bag.  I never considered the chips wouldn't be in the bag, so I just drove off.  To the crew at gyro shack keep up the good work, and use this little bit of constructive criticism to improve.

The decor is nice and the outdoor patio is also nice, a bit too cold today so we ate inside. Our waitress was great but the Bloody Mary was just OK. I had the Mahi Mani tacos which were very good but the Mahi was a bit dry. They do have a pretty good selection of beers on tap.

First thing to know is, even though it says on Yelp their happy hour runs all day on Sunday it does not. For some reason they discontinued that.

Next thing to know is their menu is a little confusing.  You can get 1 2 or 3 tacos and each has their price. Then you look at the Mahi Mahi and it shows +.99. This means you pay the $8.45 (I think that was the price) and then you pay .99cents for each taco. Something about the seafood tacos cost more. Anyway, a bit ridiculous since they should just list each kind of taco with the total price. Not a huge deal but it a red up costing me about $10.50 for 2 tacos (oh yeah...that's it, no side..just tacos.)

Although the decor is nice, it is very loud. Between the music and the crowd I wasn't able to have much of a conversation with my husband.

All-in-all, I think the prices are a bit too high for what you get. Based on that I think I'd come back when the weather is good enough to sit outside.

I rented from Morehouse for almost four years and never had any issues. They were prompt with any property issues and were always easy to get a hold of. I think a lot of these negative reviews are from people who didn't qualify to rent from them. Keep doing what your doing Beth and Ray you guys were awesome and I enjoyed being your tennant.
Very rude. Better off going somewhere else. If you have any issues while attending this facility get ready to have the blame be put onto you. Very embarrassing for being a "family center"

Horrible unprofessional rude af workers who can't get their sh@t together. Don't keep me in the loop about anything then act like its my fault they can't do their job right. Angry head biting overstressed drug induced employees. Y'all get paid hourly for your job I don't. I waste time and money being in your drive thru.
We have eaten here multiple times. They have some of the most flavorful sushi rolls in the valley. But also have great cooked items. Food has always been good and the service is great.

First time trying this place. We sampled an appetizer, salad , soup and sushi all washed down with a healthy sized bloody Mary.  Everything was super tasty. I love the way they toss their salad in the dressing of your choice, all greens were coated perfectly. The sushi roll was huge!!! The drink was lacking the alcohol and flavor for 15.oo. Over all it was a great dining experience and I'll for sure be going back.

Yes, yes, yes to all the pretty bath bombs and pretty-colored, delicious smelling, natural products. This business is all around amazing. Incredible products (that are honestly produced), ethical sourcing of products that benefit charities and communities across the globe, and friendly employees in their stores to educate you about it!

The second you walk in the store, expect your nose to be overwhelmed with lovely smells coming at you from all directions and your eyes to be overwhelmed by all the pretty colors of their products. But just wait until you go home and try out the products for yourself! I have yet to try one I don't like. The face masks? Awesome. And they make your face feel so fresh and so clean. The bath bombs? Obsessed. (Try out the sakura. It's kind of underrated because it doesn't give you a color explosion in the bathtub like some of the other ones do. But it smells lovely.) The lotions? Fantastic! When my skin gets dry in the winter, scented lotions tend to irritate it. These lotions don't! Bonus points for smelling good and being awesome for sensitive skin. I've yet to try their bar shampoos/conditioners, but I'm super interested in giving them a shot as I've heard great things about them.

Good smells, good products, and helpful customer service. Only have good things to say here!

I have used Lake Appliance several times and always found them to provide an excellent service. Today a very nice young man named Cameron arrived exactly when he told us to fix our dishwasher. Cameron was polite and friendly and had the dishwasher fixed in no time. I think the quality of the people reflects on the company that employs them, and every time, Lake Appliance Repair has sent out people who have been like Cameron. I highly recommend this excellent company.

The Reuben was good... not sure it was 12 dollars good. 
Staff was friendly, restaurant was clean, atmosphere was fine. My wife and I together had 2 sandwiches, 2 med fountain, 1 regular and 1 bowl soup. After tax and tip it was $34.36

The pricing was a bit of a downer that may effect my chance of returning, but that's just me. If you're good with the price then I recommend.
The sandwiches are good, however the French dip was very dry without the Au Jus that it was supposed to come with.

I have been on the phone for almost a week for a manager to call me back as I have new sod that has been laid out. I keep get told that someone will call me back with the next 48 hours.  No manager has called.  My lawn looks worse then my neighbors who hasn't treated their lawn. Our lawns were put in at the very same time.

We've come here a half dozen times and the food has always been great. Tacos are very good, burgers done right, crispy fries and homemade chips & queso. Today we had the devil's burger and chips & queso. The burger is grilled with blackened cajun pepper seasoning and it was done right; not too overbearing but enough to give it a bite with a light burned taste. Roasted jalepenos were under the melted pepperjack cheese with pico de gallo on top. All the flavors were in balance. The burger was done medium and the bun toasted. It was very tasty. The chips are homemade but were slightly stale. The queso comes with your choice of meat (price varies) and it is addicting. As always the undampened sound levels in this sports bar are high. There is a large outside dining area for those who actually want to hear each other's conversation in a normal voice. And there are a plethora of beers on tap. Our server Nicole was very friendly, attentive, and efficient.

They just lost a long-time loyal customer today. We had an Entertainment Coupon mobile app, and when we presented it with our bill, the manager became indignant, and didn't want to accept it. He gave us a sob story about him trying to run a business and make money. In my thinking, if you offer a coupon, accept it. If he's worried about making money, he just lost a valued customer over $6.00. Not a very wise business decision. The food is good, but we won't be back.

Tasty treat!  This review is only for the pastrami sandwich...it's so amazing that I can't get myself to order anything else when I visit Togo's.  It's very difficult to find any place that serves pastrami that isn't full of fat pieces or cut too thick.  Togo's pastrami is perfect and they don't skimp on the meat portions like most places.  Fresh veggies, soft and flavorful bread, a bit too much mustard but that's only personal preference. 

The place is always clean when I visit and the staff friendly.  This is my go-to place when the pastrami craving strikes!
It would be great if the cashiers worked as fast as they talked....  if I have three items,  then maybe I am in a hurry and don't have time to listen to the clerks day??

First off, I have to begin this review by saying I absolutely love Sierra Trading Post as a company. I've gotten many great products for fabulous prices. 

The reason for this one star review is solely because of one person. For today's review I'll be referring to them as R. They are one of the managers at this specific location. Here's what happened:

I bought my husband some Asolo boots online. They were horrible. He wore them around the block a couple times to wear them in a little. That's what you do with hiking boots. You have to break them in. You're a fool if you buy a pair of boots and trek out 30 miles the next day. So he wore them around our property for maybe a mile and the blisters they have him were terrible. Couple days later, tried again and they still weren't working. Definite no-no.

Husband cleans them up and takes them back to return them. I didn't expect a full refund, or one at all, maybe a store credit? Well, R was such a poopy head. Literally spat in my husbands face saying they couldn't take the shoes back because they weren't brand new anymore. No apologies, no nothing. Flat out rude, disrespectful and mean. Call me Karen, but this kind of service is unacceptable. It would have been absolutely appropriate to be kind about not accepting the return. You don't treat people like cheap garbage especially when you're representing a company. They also said we were past the 30 day refund when according Sierra's return policy online we have 40 days. 

Not sure if I'll be coming to this location any longer. I may just stick to online or, better yet, give my money to another company. Does this reflect my view of the company in whole? Not entirely. Will I be returning to this location? Nope. I understand not being able to accept the return, THAT'S FINE. It just money but oh God you don't got to be such a stinker. This was harsh. But hey. Don't be rude. Keep your spit in your mouth and don't act like your shit don't stink. Be kind. It's not that hard, is it?

We found this restaurant on uber eats and decided to try it out as we hadn't had dim sum food in a while. I would just like to say I wasn't very impressed. We got orders of dumplings. Baos and a teriyaki bowl. The dumplings were pretty good but the boas was lacking in flavor and the breading was very thick and over powered the meat inside. Teriyaki bowl was decent but way over priced for the portion size. portions at panda express are way bigger for about the same price. All in all I would probably not order from here again.

First time here for a late lunch. Food was below average. The mahi mahi tacos were very bland with no taste. The fish was dry over cooked and cold slapped on a cold mission tortilla with some mayonnaise on it. Good beer selection loud music.

They ran down my tree saplings. I caught it on camera. They apologized, said they would plant more and give us $25 for the headache. They never followed through. They ran our trees down a month later. They now ignore my emails.
Every cookie is soooo delicious!!!! I've ordered delivery twice and both times, the cookies have arrived warm. Yes, it's expensive but so worth it for those times you just want to indulge!

Moving to Idaho, I found they had yet to fall in the "Nashville chicken" craze as SoCal had over the last year when living there. When I heard Clucks was opening, I had to check it out. My first visit was rather slow, but expected with a new spot as everyone is adjusting, learning the menu, etc (about 25-30min wait for food, which did all come out hot and fresh). The second time I visited, service was much quicker, and food was still fire. I got the sandwich the first time and just tenders the second time. While the sandwich was good, I like to enjoy the crisp and spice of the chicken, and while getting the 3rd highest heat level, felt like it was lost amongst the coleslaw, bread, and sauce spread. The tenders packed some heat and I love the flavor. Both times I snagged the dirty bird fries which are by far my favorite. Clucks has the crispy style fries which I love at any restaurant. I'll continue to eat here as it proves to be one of the OG Nashville chicken spots in the Treasure Valley area #cluckyeah

Love the waffle fries OMG esp during my pregnancy! It was a craving of mine. The drive thru service is always exceptionally great and fast, despite being so busy all the time. I do wish they were open on Sundays, but everyone needs a day off every week. Thank you for great food and service!

Sally showed up and gave me great advice on my selection of pull down shades and window coverings. I was delighted to find out that my merchandise was going to be installed earlier than originally estimated. On delivery day the installer, Kaleb, arrived and did a wonderful job of installing my goods. This is the second time I have ordered from Budget Blinds and I have been very happy with both transactions. At such time there is a third transaction, I will be certain to call Budget Blinds.

Glad a quick and easy time, we went in knowing what we wanted and got out quick. I would give 5 stars but we did get the wrong product, apparently they labeled the item wrong from the warehouse. So we didn't get our product until about 4 days later. But  it all worked out and now we're rocking out with our new Polk sound system.

Came on a Friday night and it was busy but we got a table in about 25 minutes. Ordered the steamed clams (spicy but you ask for them less spicy) always a good choice when they have them in, lobster stuffed avocado, which was yummy, almost sushi like tasting, and the swordfish dinner special. Came with mashed potatoes a little drizzle of herbed gravy and squash sautéed.  When it came out I was underwhelmed, it looked small and not worth the $27.99  
The taste was great, buttery grilled flavor, meaty but light done perfectly in the center but a little over done on the edges.  I would order again but still think the price was a bit high.

I place a pick up order at 6:44pm....the app said it will be ready at 7pm. We arrive at 7:15pm and our order isn't ready. No big deal. At 7:55 pm it's still not ready and they told us the cookies we ordered are no longer available. We got a refund and left empty handed. Complete waste of time.

I realllyyyyy wanted to love this place. The inside is clean and modern and the nail technicians working there all seemed friendly. I love that they have great brands and newer equipment but my nails were just don't done as well as I wish they were. The previous color wasn't all the way buffed off and the nail color didn't reach the ends or sides on most of my nails. My cuticles were also clipped a couple times. Unfortunately won't be returning.

Updating this review to tell ya about their pastries and Americanos! 

The Macaroons: The lavender matcha macaroons (insert praise hands emoji). Reasons to try them:
1) They make these delicious bites in-house.
2) They are the perfect bite-sized treat, chewy, and they are sweet (but not too sweet). 
3) Last, they are slightly surprising! The contrast between the matcha and lavender flavors is distinct, but they so work together.

Americano: I ordered an Americano with steamed cream, honey and cinnamon. As I've shared in my original review, they use a locally roasted coffee (Form & Function), so they flavors of the espresso are delicious and enjoyable on their own. Add a little bit of frothy milk, dash of cinnamon, and a touch of honey to that and you are in coffee heaven. 

As always, this place is clean and well-kept. If you need a break from your office, want to get out of the house, have homework to do, or just want to cozy up with a good book and hot drink...come here!

I was looking for an afternoon dessert in Meridian, yelped it, and happened upon this little place that I had never heard of.  What a darling little place!  I got there at about 1:45pm and they close at 2:30pm, so the owner lady explained what items she had left.  She was adorable.  I told her I found her on Yelp, and she gave me a cookie for my first-time visit - it was this yummy buttery sugar shortbread cookie ... made with potato chips.  

I'm not a super fan of cinnamon rolls or sticky buns, but the one in the case really wowed me.  She said if I was going to be eating it soon, she would heat it up for me, but I told her I would eat it in about a half an hour when I got home.  She said to make sure to microwave it for about 35 seconds.  

She gave me the tour of the place - there are a lot of old family photos of her family (parents and grandparents), curio cabinets and hutches with old time dishes and jewelry.  The cuteness even extends to the ladies' room that is clean, spacious, and decorated all frilly and nice too.  

When I got home to sit down and enjoy this sticky bun, I wasn't super impressed.  It tasted day-old but it made sense because it was what was left at the end of the day and she probably had made it at 5am and it was sitting in the case all day (much like the ones that you get on the clearance rack at Albertsons and Fred Meyer).  It was good, but not super good.  But then I remembered her telling me to heat it up.  So, I popped it in the microwave.  Oh.  My.  Land.  Heating it up melted all the gooey stickiness, warmed up the pecans, and made the dough all yeasty and soft and delicious again.  It was like night and day.  And it was such a delicious bite.  

The location is sort of odd, I feel like I have driven by there 900 times and never knew it was there.  It's right on Main Street, but it's in the same parking lot with another business (maybe it's even connected to it) so it's easy to miss it.  But don't miss it!
Decent pizza at a great price. Friendly staff and a nice atmosphere really helped make this place somewhere I would suggest trying.
The apartment grounds are so pretty and the pool is so nice. Murphy H made the move in process very easy.

After my 30 day notice... things went downhill, quickly.  Property Management accusing me of changing locks, removal fees for items in storage BEFORE my arrival, demeaning e-mails, etc. The first 11 months were ok, but the last month of rude and disrespectfulness is enough for my rating to drop down dramatically

It's ok. Slightly cramped inside. Hamburger good, chicken strips meh, remind me of the ones you get fully cooked but frozen at grocery store and you heat them up to eat. All tables and chairs were filthy like people drip lots of ice cream and drop lots of food but the chair never get cleaned and tables do not get wiped down often. Fries kinda mushy. Ice cream and smoothies are good. Sodas are good.  I can see going back for some things but not others, and sitting down to eat only if not crowded and can find a clean set of chairs at a decently clean table.

We moved here from Oregon and were given Kathy's name as a good resource to continue our insurance coverage locally. I've contacted her right away and her & her team immediately started assessing my needs and preparing us for things to come after an out of state switch. Phone calls & emails were returned immediately, options, if any available, were presented and follow up was thorough and timely. Two thumbs way up in any way possible!
Was not impressed with this shop when we ate there. We thought with a name like E of S we would be treated to some gourmet sandwiches but they were very mundane.

This review is for Tangos in Boise! They are always outstanding! The owner is so friendly, proud and happy to explain his flavor combinations and make recommendations! The green chili, ground beef with bacon and the Bavarian are my favorites. Always hot and fresh- try them all!

I love all Trader Joe's. They have SO MANY staples and the vibe is always so great. I am stoked that this area now has two of them! And the new location is great because the parking lot is not a nightmare like so many other Trader Joe's :)

If you want to feel better about what you ate for takeout, this is a great option. I was initially thrown off thinking this was a happy teriyaki alternative, but it's more like a Korean BBQ inspired, protein/veggie on rice joint. 

The meat lives up to the place's name as you can definitely taste the flame broiled flavor. Their magic sauce is good and basically tastes like galbi marinade. I love their double hot sauce... it sort of reminds me of a spicy salsa verde. 

I also appreciate their approach to sauce application. It comes on the side by default so you determine how much sauce you want to put on your food. It's as healthy or semi-healthy as you want it to be. 

If you were initially thrown off like me, I encourage you to give it another take. It can get addicting.

They were pretty busy when we visited last week, but Kris did an awesome job helping us and walking us through all of the options available. I would recommend him as someone to talk to if you are new to sleep number beds and want the run down. We ended up going home and thinking it over for a while since this was a pretty big purchase for us. It was nice not to be pressured to buy on the spot. He made sure we were well-informed and took the time we needed to make the right decision.

If you are looking for a skilled mechanic with integrity, excellent customer service, and a personable atmosphere, this is the place to go. The shop is operated by Tony Zanders and family, and has won multiple awards, including one from the Better Business Bureau.

I've been looking for a good full-service, independent mechanic in the Boise area since I moved here over four years ago. Dietz Auto does a great job with my wife's Honda, but I could never get a good recommendation for someone to work on my Saturn. Recently a friend mentioned Heritage, and this is just what I've been looking for!

When a simple air-conditioner repair turned into a mechanical engineering puzzle (due to a poorly designed GM part), Tony and his crew were extremely accommodating and friendly. Tony himself gave me a ride home, and delivered my car to my house the next day while I was at work. Despite the extra effort, the final bill actually came in under the original quote (which was 30% less than the dealership, by the way).

They may not have WiFi in the waiting room or a Starbucks across the street, but I'll skip the conveniences to know I'm being dealt with honestly and getting a fair price.

I wrote a very large email to corporate, but it is too long to fit here so I'll try to keep it as short as possible:

Long story short:
TruGreen didn't warn me they were coming, didn't even tell me my service was being renewed this year, let my dog out, put my dog back in without properly securing my yard (the way my property was before they came with wired fencing, wooden boards, and small black metal gates - all of which prevent my dog from escaping under the gate), moved my trash cans in front of my gate that they failed to lock, and left a casual voicemail stating none of this in the voicemail. My dog's FitBit/Activity tracker let me know my dog left the parameters so I headed home from work ASAP and when I called TruGreen to see if they let my dog out, the Operations Manager, Troy, was extremely rude, making excuses, and sounded like I was inconveniencing him even though it was MY FAMILY they let out of my yard. Yummmoh!!!  Hot Pep!  Ceasar's Salad!  Nice Clean, the pizza was hot, delish!!!  I will be coming back. What I didn't finish of my slyce my daughter did!!!  Friendly people for severs, too!!  

I like this love local pizza joint!

Not 1, no not even 3 but 5 hrs I waited to get an aliment and tires changed. I have gone to different stores in Nampa, Boise meridian the result is the same but this store took the cake! 5 freaking hrs?! im sitting there in the store watching 22 other customers come in wait for 15 to 45mins and their vehicles are finished before mine. Holly crap! Not that Les Schwab cares but wont be doing business with this company again. Next time just say that it will take 5 hrs and the customer will appreciate the honesty and go else where. For waiting that long Les Schwab should offer discounts. I tell you what I am not happy.
Went for lunch and got looks like, leftover fry...and soggy  spicy chicken in my sandwich and servers are too busy dancing instead of focusing to serve their customers...
Although I couldn't say that they have super good soup, when combined with one of their half sandwiches and a cup of soup it's pretty decent. The workers there are very nice and polite.

I recently switched my CPAP supplier to Medicap. I was surprised to see that Braden from Everything CPAP had started here at Medicap!
I especially like to work with Braden because of his knowledge as well as his ability to be efficient with time. 
Something incredible happened at Medicap that I haven't experienced in years. I got a call from Medicap about 30 minutes before my appointment. The caller told me that Braden was running 15 minutes behind schedule. I was so grateful they took the time to call. I ended up stopping for coffee and didn't have to rush! Ordered shutters and blinds from Budget Blinds. It took longer than usual for delivery because of Covid, but we did not care....
Dennis came to install and what a delight!  He was kind and courteous, incredibly neat and tidy.  He even had a small shop vac attached to his tool belt! Every blind and shutter was 
installed perfectly and then he wiped the shutters and blinds down when he was finished! He left nothing behind and we are delighted!
We would highly recommend Dennis for all your window covering installations. We would give him 6 stars if we could!
Thank you very very much!

If I could give it no stars I would. For one, the girl that was helping us with are bowling shoes she was wearing booty hugger shorts at a family place were there are kids. I don't know why people are bitching I've been going here for almost 2 months and the salon is CLEAN, BEDS ARE ALWAYS WIPED DOWN, BATHROOM IS CLEAN, STAFF IS ALL AMAZING AND SWEET EVERYTIME TOU WALK IN, if you are not having a good day sit your ass at home and stop bitching. I am 8 months pregnant with a toddler, so foot maintenance is not on my top to-do. I went and I got my toes done at the end of June. We are now in august and my toes still look great (except the grow out part). I got gel and have had no chips or cracks. They seem a bit more expensive, but they are worth the price. Most quality pedicure I have ever received. Will return anytime I want a pedicure.
These cookies are the best!!!  Staff and location are also great.  The only reason I only gave 3 stars is the wait time.  Every time I have ordered for pick up I have have wait 10-20 minutes.

Bought a reclining 2 piece couch a couple months ago.  They delivered it and set it up.   After they left we reclined it and it got stuck in the reclined position.  It took a few days but they sent a technician out to fix it.  He added a USB port for free.   That was nice.  
Last weekend we decided to buy the EXACT same couch as we had company coming this weekend.  We went in, found our salesman and said "we want the exact same couch as last time."   Easy sale.  He put in the order and we went over and also bought a dishwasher.  $2000 later we were out of there.   We picked up the couch to save time vs delivery.  Got it home and the 2 pieces were TOTALLY wrong and didn't fit together at all.  I took pictures and texted them to our salesman.  Still haven't heard from him.  I called the store and (after being on hold for quite a while) they said they would re order it and if I wanted it soon, I would have to bring these back and pick up the new ones.   I asked if we could get some money off for all the inconvenience and she said she would give us a $75 gift card for their store.  REALLY????   Not happy at all.  They were less than apologetic and acted like it was no big deal that it was wrong.

Amazing and fresh seafood at affordable prices. I had four pieces of the freshest salmon nigiri I have ever had. I ordered the tuna steak with lemon dill sauce over rice and it was one of the best meals I have ever had at a restaurant. The only problem I had was waiting at the bar for my table. It took 20 mins to get my drink after it was ordered. They were really busy, but the drink was pretty good. I highly recommend this restaurant. I spent about $45 for happy hour sushi appetizers, dinner, and drinks for two.

No matter how much shit this place for political nonsense, I still love it! I'm a gay too! WHOA WHAT??? Gay and eat at this place?!?!.

Gina Anderson is a true artist and master of precision and perfection.  Ever since I started going to her for my hair, I can never go to anyone else ever again.  She is personable, vibrant, and a true sweetheart.  She knows exactly how to beautify your hair to compliment your face shape, personality, and give it that professional touch.  The first time I went to her, I couldn't help but cry tears of pure joy! I had never experienced a hairdresser that was capable of giving me the beautiful hair that I wanted, and it being even better than I imagined.  She knows how to give the perfect cut and color.  She is a balayage queen.

The Maven Loft is my new favorite salon!  When you walk in, you feel right at home. It has a warm, welcoming, friendly atmosphere.  It is relaxed, fun, and comfortable.  I LOVE the wash station.  They have the most comfortable reclining lounge chairs and foot rest.  Definitely a salon you must try out -- warning -- you will fall in love!  They have a wonderfully chill environment in beautiful Meridian.
After eating at Lucky Find in Boise I was all to happy to try the location I'm Meridian. The food was great. I was sad to see the manager and wait staff with their masks off and left.

Yummy burgers! The meat was great quality and definitely hand made. The burger was filling but not too filling, and was just pink enough in the center. The milkshakes there are pretty good too, I think it would be better if they came out in a tin can though.
Great Sushi and they give you the extra soy sauce without asking!!! Don't miss this place

This place is terrible. We went in ordered a couch it was suppose to be delivered, we got text messages and tracked it but they never showed up or even called. We called customer service (45 minute wait time too) they said they came by and no one was there which was a lie I was outside waiting. She was suppose to call us back to reschedule and never heard from her again. Called the store directly and they said it was never getting delivered today and gotten taken off delivery. It's been rescheduled for another week and they didn't tell us. Terrible delivery service and the customer service people don't care. After they make a sale they're done with you. Now we have no couch for a week because we got rid of our old one expecting the new one today.
This place is amazing!  It has its own food court inside with so many choices.  It has the nicest quality produce that I have seen in a store.

Wish I could give minus 1, walked in and sat at a table for 10 minutes, several bartenders and waitresses around with almost no customers but we never had a single person stop at our table. Apparently if your not "known" by they staff your not welcome.

Scheduled a 1 pm manicure. I arrived a few minutes early and they were able to see me then. My technician was friendly, efficient, and did a wonderful job! I had a French gel manicure done and they look lovely. I will be going back!

People often say if the option to give an establishment 0 stars existed, they would, this place deserves negative stars to detour as many decent people as possible. Even Casey Anthony wouldn't bring her kids here. Expect your day to be ruined by the lack of functional attractions, gas station quality food and truck station bathrooms. 
The staff here makes up for 80% of all Zoloft and Prozac sales, as their demeanor alone will give you depression. Corporate boot lickers that value the welfare of their overlord's wallets before the satisfaction of their own customers. 
And even IF by the grace of God, more than 40% of the attractions were open at any given time the level of mediocrity in the machine's is almost unfathomable. 
If you're thinking of treating your family to a nice time, avoid this place at all costs, take em to a freeway underpass and make friends with the homeless, at least then you might feel an ounce or humanity and adventure.

Laser tag 9/10.

We have been to Steve's for years and many times, but I see I have never reviewed this place. So here goes.

This is one of two of our favorite places to go for breakfast. We have never tried lunch. But they have great choices for breakfasts. The huckleberry pancakes and waffles are top notch. One pancake is plenty for me or my wife. I usually have a breakfast meat though, so that makes one pancake sufficient for me. This is one of the few places that does CRISP bacon right, thick, tasty and crisp. Their homemade sausages are good also. They can be taken home to cook there, if you like. I found the Italian sausage a little heavy on the fennel, but still very good. They also do the eggs as you order, not as the cook imagines you might like them.

We have also noted that over time their coffee has improved. Originally, we tolerated what seemed to be the standard low-octane Boyd's style coffee. We also almost always kidded them about this. But the last time this week, I noticed that I found their coffee more upscale and deeper in body. Good for them and us.

Service has always been fast and cordial. Coffee and water cups are kept filled. Seating is available as booths, tables or at a counter. Crowds are often the situation on Saturday and Sunday breakfast times and no reservations are taken. So be prepared.

My brand new GE Monogram Microwave had issues with the opening mechanism. After determining the root cause was the hinge inside the unit, Rich was able to install the new replacement door and now the release mechanism works as it should have from the factory.

Rich is a very conscientious, professional, courteous and precise service engineer and he represents Lake Appliance Repair in five star fashion. One doesn't know what to expect when opening a case with GE customer service and I'm happy to recommend Lake Appliance Repair with FIVE STARS.

Lake also texts and calls in advance of arrival so you never have to call and say "Where are you?"! Thanks, Lake!

Tru Green sucks! They killed our grass. We called them and they came out gave us an excuse saying that it wasn't them that damaged our lawn. Well then who if they are the only ones spraying it? After a while we called to cancel with them. So we cancelled and they still came out I told them to leave we cancelled with them. The person said well it's on my paper work to come here, I said no to leave. They left and we got billed by them after we cancelled and sent their people away.  Then they came back out really early in the morning today while we slept and did our yard. We have cancelled with them. But they will not take our cancel. Bad company and idiots working. If I could I would give them minus a bunch of stars. They don't deserve even one star.

3rd time I've been here with my girlfriend and the first two times weren't bad, decent service. This time wasn't the case. Waitress(short, dirty blonde, medium build) took 10 minutes to get to our table, I ordered an iced tea and girlfriend got a water. I was a waiter so I understand the feeling of your customer ordering nothing, but be professional. She dropped off the drinks, but never came back asking for a refill and never gave us the bill when there was only 2 lanes of people in the whole place. She's lucky I left 5 bucks cash there. Disappointed.

I wish it were possible to rate this company a ZERO.  Our HOA utilized TruGreen in the summer of 2020.  While their work was less than excellent the real problem occurred when they did the fall clean up.

I had the privilege of having an acrylic full set done by Sammie! Her artistry, attention to detail, and skill are unmatched! She made the appointment fun to sit through and made sure I was pleased with nails through the entire process. The entire experience was pleasant and I have received many compliments already!

Food is pretty good. I went there last night and my kids and I ate outside. The tables and ground outside were disgusting. There were used masks left on tables, the ground was sticky and stained. I doubt the tables have been washed in a long time. A good power wash is greatly needed.
Andrea is amazing. I've been seeing her for several months. She is a fantastic massage therapist, listens to my needs, and has really helped me to feel better !

I tried it for the first time and their soups were so good! There is no better place in the valley than this, I have been on the lookout for a good soup place and I am glad that I found out this gem. They also offer soups for trying before we can place the order!
After 30 minutes of being stuck on their phone tree and nobody answering a phone in the middle of the day on Friday I gave up
This place serves a variety of delicious food but I wouldn't consider it a seafood restaurant.

RC Willey Boise, we have been customers ever since they opened their doors here in Boise Id. They have always been great to deal with till now. We have a 2 year old mattress that we paid a lot of money for with a 10 year warranty. King size pillow top and after the first year it is like sleeping in a hole and have to clime out over a hump. Long story short we have called two times for warranty service last year and again this year and both times they say it is not covered under their warranty. WE have kelp it covered and looks brand new till you get into it. They told us we could call corporate. Placed an online order for delivery at this location, which is about 4 minutes from our home. Estimated delivery time was 45 minutes. The order took an hour and 20 minutes before even leaving for delivery. Once in route, it took 15 minutes to arrive. In addition, one of the pizzas that we ordered was incorrect. I ordered a medium pizza with extra alfredo sauce and cheese, nothing else. My pizza had no Alfredo sauce, and they added pepperoni. 

This isn't our first time having issues with this location, and we won't be ordering with them again.

My adult daughters and I visited the Meridian store today for lunch. This was our first visit. We arrived at noon and there was a short line in the deli section. We got in line and were served promptly when we moved up the line. We ordered several items from the hot deli and shared them at the table in the dining area. We were pleasantly surprised at the flavors. We enjoyed our lunch and topped it off with freshly baked poppy seed bread and coffee. Afterwards I browsed the grocery shelves as I enjoy learning about international foods. The staff were pleasant and gave us great service. I recommend this interesting store and deli. I give it 4 stars for our great experience.
I had the Original roast beef sandwich   and it was delicious!  Prepared fresh and served hot in just a matter of minutes.  Highly recommended

Do you love soup? I love soup and not just any soup. Variety. 

That's exactly what Soup Kettle Grille has to offer. Any day you go in there, they will have a completely different menu of soup choices. Of course, they have their staples daily like their tomato basil soup and chicken noodle. They have some creative recipes and the flavor is out of this world. Another awesome thing about this place? No matter how busy they are, you are  greeted with a smile, a hello and a we will be right with you. They have a small quaint location that is colorful and inviting to everyone. It is very clean and you can see everything they are doing in regard to food prep. All their items are fresh, local and good for you. They not only offer soup, but they have sandwiches, as well as large soup containers to take home for you and your family. They are very affordable and I would highly recommend to anyone wanting a cup of soup with a grilled cheese on a chilly day. It is family owned and they truly care that you enjoy your meal. If anything is not right, they remedy it right away and very accommodating. Go give it a try, you won't be disappointed.

This place is seriously 5 star. From the food to the service. It was a great experience. The lady behind the cash register was super nice and helpful. The lady that brought our food was so awesome also. I thought I had ordered the fries with the chicken on it, I think the cashier and I got confused, and I didn't get it. But I thought I did. I had told the waitress that brought our food, I double checked and that's when I saw I was wrong. She still asked me what sauce I had wanted for the fries. Blows me away!! I really wish that more places had people like this to work for them. This is a place I will definitely go to again. 

Now, onto the food itself! Oh. My. Goodness. The chicken sandwich was so thick and juicy. How often do you hear a sandwich referred to as that? Lol. The fries has a great crispness to them. And their spicy ranch!!!!!! Go here. Get all the foods. All of them.

Horrible experience . The food we did have was disgusting . Came in with a party of 6. Once they came to bring the food they let us know 2 of us wouldn't be getting what we ordered . Why would you bring out food for some of our party and what are the rest of us suppose to do ? The manager/owner was at the bar having a beer . He was already drunk so who do you complain to ? Wouldn't recommend ever , my fault I didn't look up the reviews on Yelp before I dined there 

Avoid at all cost not worth it !

November 2017, we went to RC Willey, looking for a recliner. My previous recliner was permanently stuck in the sitting position. You may think this is optimal but when you are getting knee surgery, like I am, it was a very painful predicament. Soooo, we went to RC Willey and looked at all they had. None seemed to fit me until we went to their clearance dept. There we found a nice electric chair for a good price of only $600.00. I found out that the only issues were that a previous customer had returned it complaining of worn cushions. RC Willey couldn't determine any wear to the cushions, however they replaced them anyway. At least that's what we were told. (no mechanical issues mentioned)

Fast Forward Three Months.................

The chair starts running sluggishly occasionally. Then one morning I get up to find my chair stuck in the sitting position. After three hours, it operates fine again. Another month passes fine, then in April the chair stops for good....luckily in the reclined position, but just as devastating.

Sooooo, my wonderful buy was actually VERY EXPENSIVE....Four months of use = $150.00 a month that RC Willey charged me to sit in a nice chair, for four months use. After that I am told to contact a local repairman (which I'm sure gives RC Willey a very nice discount for referring their "thrown under the bus" clients) so I can pay MORE money....just to be able to use my chair again.

THANKS RC WILLEY.......WONT BE SHOPPING THERE AGAIN.

The curb has great food for a bar and grill type setting. Restaurant quality food and affordable. Patio crew was awesome on a very busy Thursday night. Great vibe and team was working together to keep things flowing. Keep it up Curb. We'll be back!!

I wish I could leave negative stars for this business.

Because of Casey we were able to walk in the evening we were handed our apartment keys and walk out with the best bed ever and land in it the same night!!! Being that your bed is where you begin and end every day, it must be perfect for you, and Casey is the man to see for helping fit your needs.
