I have bought many beds  and even sold them in my time and wouldn't go anywhere else now. I highly recommend going there first to save the "dreaded bed shopping" you will have a wonderful experience!!!
I had the Bbq empanadas. They were so good & soft. My mother in law had the elpuerco, & enjoyed hers also. Next time I'll have to try their desserts empanadas.
jacob is so rad! always remembers me & helps me figure out what i need since i never remember! thanks dude!
This is my favorite fro yo in Idaho! There is no question how they won best ice cream in Boise! The customer service is amazing and I always feel welcome!

I am hoping these folks make it and I can upgrade their rating in the future. They are more than a 3, but not yet a 4 star. 

This a comfortable Mom And Pop kind of place. They serve Dawson And Taylor brewed coffee. But since it is served from a pump carafe, it wasn't as hot as we like it. I will ask them to zap it next time. They do have espresso drinks too.

Baked products ranged from cookies to pecan sticky buns. As first time customers, we were given a delicious butter cookie as a gift. Very good cookie and a nice gesture. In fact, their cookies are probably their best products. Try the chocolate quarter pounder cookie. 

They have croissants, including ham and cheese. But in all honesty, this item needs some work. Mine was under done and over-sized. Of course, I am comparing to Janjiu's croissants which are hard to compete with.

My wife had a apricot scone which she rated as good. It looked more like biscuit than a true scone. 

At 10 am they were out of cinamon rolls, so will have to try another day. I had a morning roll instead which I found to be very good. They also had pecan sticky buns available which called to me, but only so much sugar in one day.

We would come back for another try of more of their goods. We really want them to succeed.

Sushi has been very good lately. Kudos to whatever changes you made but it has been very good! I do miss the edamame with the habanero salt. If you can still get it, I recommend you put it back on the menu!!! The servers and bartender are great and I love sitting in the area next to the bar because there are lots of windows and an open feel!
Go to spot for the kids and family when we visit Idaho, always clean, we'll maintained, all day fun for fair price!

As you can see from my review from 2019, I have been going to this salon for two years. Up until this last time, I have had really good experiences. I have arthritis in several of my finger joints, and sometimes have difficulty relaxing if they twist and turn my fingers too harshly. A couple of joints don't have much mobility, and It hurts if they aren't gentle. The last woman (and it's not Kim, who's wonderful) did a fill on me. She was so rough that she sanded the skin on the sides of my fingers while filing my nails, caught a couple of cuticles with the grinding wheel, to where they became red and sore, and twisted my fingers right and left quite roughly.  I commented that she was rough, and she ignored me. Kept telling me to relax. I can't when I'm in pain. After I came home, I asked my husband to give me a hug. I'm now looking for a new nail place.

I recently tried Tango's via their food truck. I had just walked out of the grocery store and could smell the delicious aroma from their truck across the lot. It drew me in and I was so glad I gave them a try! I ordered one Molé empanada and was definitely blown away. Tasted just like our family recipe! The authenticity and the flavor was THERE! A few days later, I called ahead to order about 7 of the various empanadas for a small dinner gathering. They were fresh and ready upon my arrival, which was nice as I drove out from Caldwell. Nevertheless, I was very impressed!

I almost don't want to write this review, because I feel like doing so let's others know about some secret club and then it won't be a secret anymore. However, I also weighed in on the fact that it would be far worse, if no one knew about this awesome place and they closed.

And so......I would love to let you all in on my little secret. This is the place to go when you need to ship something.  The people who work here, which I am pretty sure are the owners, are always so helpful and friendly. Not only that, but they make shipping something a breeze. It takes me 1/10th of the time it takes me to ship the same package at an actual FedEx center. 

You can use any shipping carrier, which is so nice if you want to compare your options without driving all over town. 

And the best part.....I have never dropped in and had a ridiculously long wait.

So the cat is out of the bag! You can find them in the Albert son's shopping center on the corner of Ten Mile and Cherry in Meridian.
I had such a great experience here! We were a walk-in but they did their best to fit us in. The staff was friendly & very good at what they do! My pedicure was very enjoyable!

I am a regular at this restaurant (at least twice a week) and food is always great and service usually is usually (ok) tonight I took my mother to the curb and we were served by Alexis who was very attentive and gave us excellent service A+++ she was very polite and anything we asked of her she handled immediately. Very good server and we will ask for her everytime as she is an excellent addition to The Curb front of house. Thank you Alexis for such great hospitality

I went in and had the worst experience I could ever have at a place. The bar OWNER, who was drinking, was despicable. There was someone who was drunk, and her fiance suddenly came in out of nowhere and dragged her by her hair and threw her head into the wall. There were 2 men who came to this girls side but the bar OWNER excused the fiance by constantly saying it was excusable because he was the fiance. When I commented that I was about to call the police due to the OWNER letting this fiance into the back room where this woman was after he smashed her head into a wall.....she kicked me and my friend out of the bar as well as the other people trying to help this woman out. I've never been so shocked to see such despicable behavior as a person. I will never support this business seeing as how it's owned by someone who supports domestic violence. Please spread the word.

this establishment remains very clean and orderly. But the attitude from some employees at this establishment ruined my experience.  I ordered a mocha frappachino and a ham and cheese croissant. And a couple other food items and drinks for my children.. A worker named chole gave me attitude the whole way through as I ordered. At the end of it, she rudely commented are you done yet?. She made unpleased expressions at my children and I overheard her telling her other coworkers about these Mormon moms and their children. I did not hear it very clearly but I know for fact it was not very nice. I just wanted to enjoy the afternoon with my children, but people like her should not work in the food industry.

AVOID. This is the worst Taco Bell location in the area - it's been a terrible experience repeatedly. Spent over 30 minutes today in the drive-through and waiting at the window only to be rushed away once handed the food.  Was given the wrong food/messed up order. The parking lot is currently restricted because of construction so no way to go back in without parking in the next door. The food we received was low-quality and smushed. Phone # on receipt is same as here on google and is answered with fax noises rather than a person or voicemail. 

It had been a couple months since last time we came through this Taco Bell so we were giving it another chance today. My other poor experiences here include burnt food and incorrect orders. ... wish I would've read the reviews before trying this location again. :-/
This place was great!  No frills, just quality pedicures with very nice & fun people.  My gel pedi turned out perfect. Recommend that you call in advance as they only have 6 chairs.
Ana Flores, and her team were able to work with us for months until we were able to buy our first home. Always so helpful with all our concerns, highly recommended them. And they speak Spanish.

Purchased $3k of laminate through them.  Even though we discussed them removing the molding the salesman "forgot" to add it in and charged us an extra $200 after the fact.  RC willey then set an appointment without consulting us on the time for the carpet person to come and finish the job and promptly broke a vase in my home and messed up the trim that was perfectly done by the original installer.  Luckily, the original installer contacted us and will come fix it.  The only time I was able to get the flooring manager to call me was by complaining through email and asking for the store manager.  If you buy through them then you'd better hope you don't have any problems because they don't care.  I'll never purchase another item from them again. You can get a better price and better service at many different local businesses.

If I could rate this below one star, I would. We paid for the three hour birthday package and it was highway robbery. It was not organized, the room was not ready, they make you spend the first hour in a conference room with no music on before they will give you the bracelets to go play. We were all just sitting around with no food,  no entertainment and no idea what was going on. I asked to speak to the manager who wasn't helpful at all. This is the most embarrassing birthday I've ever thrown for my kid. There are a lot of bright lights here, but save yourself the time and money. It's a joke.

This is my favorite gym. The best part is the juice  bar! The protein shakes are so tasty! I've tried 3 so far and it's a toss up between Banana Nut or Chocolate Dipped Strawberry! It's a big gym and there's many different exercise equipment for both cardio and strength. The classes are great too-they are usually packed so get there early. The locker room is crowded but not a deal breaker. As a woman, I enjoy the women only workout room. There are many different benefits to using this gym depending on which membership option you choose.

The only reason they are getting a 1 star is because I have to rate something. Went there when I was visiting family and was absolutely appalled by this place. For starters a nail tech by the name of Ashley B. has no sense of customer service and referred to another black customer as "that black girl". Not only that while I was getting my nails done she was going off on how she was a part of the chocolate club I am assuming that means she likes black men? I understand that women gossip in this kind of setting but I believe it is totally inappropriate to speak about your sexual encounters at work with impressionable children around. Making generalizing statements like " all black men do not speak about their feelings because they have daddy issues." As well as speaking freely about the size of their genitals. She also refuses to do any kind of work on black women. In the society we live in it is absolutely atrocious that she is allowed to carry on like this in a work environment. I have been plenty of complaints about this woman yet she is still employed. What does that say about the establishment. This place may have a few good nail techs but this Ashley (or should I say trashley because that is how she displayed herself) is not one of them. I wouldnt suggest anyone with kids going there or they will get a fast track course in what she believes the black male body has to offer while putting down black women.

I love Chick-fil-A. Their employees are so polite, and their service prompt. I cannot recall a bad experience at Chick-fil-A. My orders met with exceptional service, great food quality/presentation, and reasonably priced.

Dont even think about it. They have a terrible reputation in the Treasure Valley. Even the guy at Lowes hardware knew who they were, having been associated with them in the past. Ray has no filter and talks down to everyone. Very demanding and overbearing. They treat you like you work for them. Will update at a later time as my situation with them continues and will explain in more explicit detail later.
Expensive but so good! When the have Oreo Cookie and Cake Batter I always get them! The sugar cookie is always really good. You gotta try it at least once. The 4 pack is a decent deal!
Sandwich was good. wrap was great. sauces were so much better than expected. I can't wait for more locations

I ordered the loaded baked potato soup and loved it!!! Its so heartwarming and made with quality ingredients! Then I tried the curry chicken soup and I was floored!!! It's divine! Thank you for putting out amazing food. I can tell you love your food and it's so great there isn't a place that compares!

The restaurant is located off Eagle road and is very easy to find. The restaurant has plenty of seating for a fast food restaurant and was very clean. The menu is straight forward and the staff were friendly.
I ordered the Cluck Nashville Hot and a medium drink which came to a total of $11.11. The chicken sandwich comes with slaw and pickles. The chicken was moist and the breading was super crunchy which is missing from most chicken sandwiches. The hot sauce was more mild than hot I felt but had a great flavor. The pickles were pickles. The slaw was the weak link for the sandwich......not the taste but the impact it had on the bread. If you do not eat the sandwich quickly, the very wet slaw begins to break down the bread. Sad moment when this occurs.
If you like chicken sandwiches, you have to give it a try. Given the price point and slaw issue, i cannot give more than 3 stars. The taste and crunch of the sandwich is awesome. 
Cheers Always!

This was my first time checking out Clucks chicken shop in meridian. As you walk in you totally get the vibe of a chain restaurant (you can tell the owners despite it being their first restaurant have eyes on being a chain/expansion in the near future). You can either order order at the counter or order it at your table (will deliver it to you). I went with the The Cluck; with their house made Nashville hot sauce (the sauce was very tasty and packed some heat!!). I think my only issue is the pricing; it's $10 essentially just for the sandwich no drinks or fries that seems a little steep to me (I'd think for $10-12 you'd at least get fries). My other dining partner ordered chicken strips; they definitely are not strips (look at the picture haha; two will definitely feed most appetites). Overall a fun vibe, great tasting food, friendly staff I'd come back more often with a few price adjustments overall looking for a spicy chicken sandwich, tacos, chicken/waffles chicken strips this is a great new addition to the local restaurant scene..

Tried this for the first time and can't say we would be back. For the price, we did not find the food amount sufficient. The tofu was probably the best of the protein choices in terms of flavor. The beef and chicken were possible, but sort of unexciting. 

The sauces are supposed to customize the bowls to one's taste preferences, but we did not find that they did the job well. The veggies are steamed and tasteless, so no help there in terms of taste. 

If I was going to go for this type of food, I think I'd regress back to Panda Express.

Cyclebar is not just a gym it is my community and my family. Every instructor is equal parts mentor, friend, and cheerleader. The staff is fun and invested in your great time on the bike. 10/10 recommend going at any time of the day, week, and year.

This place we just happened upon and have been back 3 times since! Their freshly made soups are to die for and I LOVE their grilled cheese sandwiches! Yummy! If you haven't been here yet, your missing out!

Fun store to walk through, they have options for furniture for every room and appliances. The prices seem reasonable, but the quality is not top of the line. This becomes apparent in the clearance area, where you can see on scratched and dented furniture most things are not solid wood all the way through. 

My husband and I walked through busy afternoon. We were approached by about 8 different sales people in the 35 minutes we spent in the store, each introducing themselves and then giving us our space. One Salesman pointed out that if you see a different color chair in a section of couches that is a different color option. Good to know! 

Ultimately we decided not to go with anything on this trip but we got an idea of what we like. Large selection and fun place to look around, but three stars for quality.

Kameron at Lake Appliance Repair saved our thanksgiving. Our oven went out and he diagnosed the problem, then miraculously found a part, went to west sac to get the part, chased down a truck to retrieve it, and came back the next day to install it. I cannot express how thankful I am for the effort he put in. This is our first holiday in our new home and we get to have it because Kameron was willing to go the extra mile. I would not hesitate to hire these guys again.

You can always tell the really good places to go by the line out the door and this is definitely one of THOSE places.

The tacos are incredible and the customer service is excellent. Considering they were super busy, I would have understood being a little neglected but not here. Our waitress was incredible and took great care of us.

The food is fresh and doesn't taste like it came out of a can or was heated in a microwave.

I had the Ponte Campecino...WOW! The bacon wrapped shrimp appetizer was ohhhh soohoo good and I definitely recommend them. The tamales are some of the best I have ever had and they are so hard to find but not a anymore.
We have finally found our favorite Mexican restaurant.

I'm surprised I haven't reviewed the Curb until now, we've be going here for over a year now. Usually pretty busy, and even being understaffed during Covid, the service has always been great. The bartenders are rockstars and know what they're doing. My husband says this place serves the coldest beers on tap he has found in the Treasure Valley. My mixed drinks have always been delicious. The chalk art here is AMAZING, we brought friends here just to see it. Props to that artist. Our food here has always been quality, however, there are are a few things that are overpriced for what they are (pretzel appetizer, for one), which is my reason for 4 stars and not 5. Overall, this is a cool place, and we will definitely still frequent here.

Kameron & Serg could not have been any better! They were on time, knowledgeable, professional & friendly. Lake appliance personnel were helpful when I called and got back to me right away. HIGHLY recommend this business & these employees! Refreshing to have professionals who know what they're doing!

If I could, I'd give this place a zero rating.  My grandkids love this place and have been going on and on about it forever.  I was in town last weekend, decided to take them, and was beyond disappointed!!! When we arrived there was not one sign, not on the front doors and not at the desk, explaining that they were under construction.  That they didn't have a snack bar or that ALL but one vending machine (that had only a few drink options) was working.  The restaurant was packed and the tables that were open were dirty and had dishes still on them.  And to top it off I was charged full price and STILL was NOT told!!!!  $65 and NOT advised.  I was told the game card was unlimited but wasn't told it was only on certain games.  So, the cards didn't work when we went to play games and I had to stand in line AGAIN to find out that only some games were unlimited .  I totally understand that renovations happen but not only was I never told but I was still charged full price!!!  This place sucks!  I will gladly drive to Boise and go to Chuck E Cheese instead.  This place is a fucking joke!!!

Not much to say other than I got my hair cut the way I asked for it, and it was done exactly how I wanted it. Cost was $20 without tip.

Unfortunately, I did have to wait an extended period of time for my name to be called on the list, but it was my decision to wait it out. This was due to one of three barbers not there due to illness.

All in all, worth the wait and money. Go there.

We noticed So Delicious today while driving around Eagle.  By the time we got to Meridian, we noticed another location of Sodalicious, I mean So Delicious!  I love the play on words and we were a bit hungry so we drove on through.  Well surprise, surprise this is just a soda shop with a few snacks offered.  Blah!  Who wants just a soda???  How about a grilled cheese?  A PB and J?  A burger and some fries?  Maybe?  

Something to go with that soda that could be lunch would have been nice.  I wish they had a bit of food items beyond cookies and popcorn but we ordered the soda that resembles a Butter Beer (cannot remember the name they called it) and it was really, really good!  Really GOOD!  A small was about $2.50. The next time we might order a few since my three kids sucked that sucker down fast and I only got a sip but man that butterbeer soda we ordered was SO DELICOUS!!!

Four stars for the soda but minus one star because we arrived hungry and wanted more than soda.

I love Idaho, the area, the people, the climate, what's not to love?  It seems like Albertsons built a flag ship store right here in Meridian Idaho.  The store is conveniently located near a major intersection with good access to the huge parking lot from any direction.  
Once inside, this store is insane!  It has several food options for made to order or buffet style foods, a full bar with dozens of beers on tap, a walk in wine cellar, the largest beer selection I have ever seen in a store.  The store has to be several hundred thousand square feet in size.  It has everything, a full pharmacy, bakery, custom meats, seafood, produce, Starbucks coffee kiosk.  The shopping carts have a holder that will hold your cocktail, microbrew, or coffee.  
The Bar area has dozens of huge flat screen TV's with every sports game on them.  The front of the store has an abundant amount of check stands.
This is by far the nicest, newest, cleanest grocery store that I have been in.

My husband has been looking for a good barber near us for a year. We found one who had good ratings and we needed an appointment to get the owner, who did a good job. But two appointments later he was getting a new barber who needed supervision and my husband's hair suffered the consequences. If you make an appointment with a specific person you should get the person you requested.... So  many weeks later we attempted to get my dear husband's hair cut. We decided on a Friday to search till we found one able to take him on the spot. No small feat  but he was getting scruffy. We live in Meridian and wanted one close to us. On Meridian road we found two. One near Cherry so we stopped. Barber was short a person and couldn't get Phil in till next week. So we found this establishment and decided to give them a shot. What a nice surprise,  Cam was able to take him immediately and he came out looking fabulous! Cam learned the trade from his father who learned from his father. It shows. Phil's neck was shaved, ears and brows trimmed up. Thanks to Cam Phil is handsome as ever. He will be back as long as when we make an appointment, Cam indeed cuts his hair!!

Looking for fresh seafood in Boise! Do not go to the Lucky Fin. I had one of the specials- bacon wrapped scallops. The scallops were tasteless, obviously frozen. My husband had fish n' chips- again very little taste. There was no fresh fish, in a fish restaurant!! Terrible food. The steamed clams were ok, but not served with bread to dip in cream sauce. The best thing was the French fries. it is hard to give this restaurant one star. Plus this dinner cost $55!
We got The Cluck and the Dirty bird. Loved them both!  Great service too. Everything was hot and served quickly. We tried the Nashville warm favor and it wasn't too spicy.
Great happy hour and well the sushi is not bad either.  Clean and lost of specials on q regular basis.
We tried this place while in town with a party of four.  Food was fine nothing to write home to mom about.  would. Not go back.

I am saving a 5 star for some additional visits, but for now these are great donuts and savories. 

A clean place, nicely displayed cases, with friendly help.  I took a medley of donuts, fritters, and sausage rolls. The thing that impressed me was the lightness and texture of the donuts, maple bars, fritters, etc. and sausage roll pastry. All great and very tasty. They even slipped in a few donut holes into my box as a gift which I didn't discover until getting home. The most impressive pastry today was the large apple fritter. Not thick or doughy, not oily, but the best fritter I have had maybe ever. Still lots to try, but I am game. LOL.

Haven't tried their coffee yet. So a coffee and donut the next time will fill that niche.

The owners are of Korean heritage. I heard them talking and could tell that they were speaking Korean. When I smiled when they were speaking, they wondered if I was Korean. Nope, I said ABC, but I recognize the language. 

I suspect the rating will go up to 5 stars after a few more trials eats. BTW, they have samples and I suspect they will let you try a piece of a donut or pastry. They can always sample out the remainder.
Yuck! This place is awful! If you don't wait 20 mins for your food and ice cream order to be wrong, you are one of the lucky few. Nightmare experience - I would never come back.
These are the best donuts in the valley for sure!! Much better than Guru or any of the other expensive shops around. Plus, they have a drive through which is awesome!

Yes! Fondue grilled cheese is amazing. Dip cute - and tasty! - grilled cheese bites into a tomato bisque that is incredible! 

The curb version of a Cobb salad- oh yum!! All the normal Cobb salad toppings but the change out cotija for shredded cheese! And let me not forget to mention the size of this thing. Huge. It's a real meal at a reasonable price. 

I enjoy the unique atmosphere here and the creative blackboard wall art. 

Service has always been helpful & consistent (this is my 8th visit here over the last 6 months or so).

I got the taco bell CLASSIC: a bean and cheese burrito. This burrito ruined my perception on mexican food because this burrito blew all other burritos out of the water and i realized that other mexican food places are missing out. Also garrett was very friendly.

This was my first visit to the gyro shack, I was the only customer (drive thru) and didn't have to wait long.  we ordered a gyro, a salad and two children's meals.  We ordered our girls the grilled chicken strips, with fries and milk. Upon opening our order , I was tearing smaller pieces for my girls to eat and noticed the chicken although it looked great was extremely hard, extremely dense and even difficult to tear. I took a bite and it was hard and rubbery-an awful, unnatural texture. I was so disappointed all of the strips were like this! Completely inedible!  The salad I ordered and paid for was not in our bag, and unfortunately the soft drinks we ordered were very light in syrup. Not a very good meal and eating experience for our family.
The gyro (made of gyro meat ) did taste good and the gentleman working the drive thru was nice. In all honesty we will not be returning to be disappointed again. 
-From two little hungry girls and a frustrated mom

Told my order would would be ready in ten minutes after twenty minutes said that the reason it was taken so long was the wings I ordered.  another ten minutes and they tell me oh sorry we forgot to cook your pizza do you want a refund?

Great! Super friendly upon walking in... my wife and I were next door planning our new house and we were exhausted.  Came here only to relax, and have a great lunch, and we did!  We'll definitely be back.

The reason we switched was due to such horrible customer service at Norco. (They had been giving us sub-standard service for years which resulted in less care & compliance with c-pap than Dr. had ordered. Don't assume Norco has a monopoly out there!!)

Medicap has been AMAZING. No exaggeration! They got us in right away. They answered our questions. They gave us what we needed. They called back to check on us. They loaned us a new mask to "try before you buy". They called us to verify when Dr orders were implemented. 
They even offered to deliver for free/come pick up the occimeter when the test was completed. They set a training & cleaning appointment to make sure everything was working correctly for no charge.

They have been accessible, kind, professionals, & things have been improving with correct use of medical equipment prescribed.

This was our first visit to Wahooz. I appreciate the many options offered at Wahooz. The facility is generally kept clean and seems to be well maintained. 

We had tickets prepaid online and just needed to exchange those for wrist bands. Our first encounter was with Mady. She exhibited an attitude with staff and just in general before we had the displeasure of interacting with her. She did not greet us or welcome us, instead she observed the print outs I had in my hand and extended her hand to grab them. Mady then grabs some bands and puts them on the counter. I waited for her to ask if we had been to Wahooz before and or explain how the bands work. Nope. I didn't pick the bands up wanting to see if this would trigger a response. She pushes them forward and says "these are for you". I am amazed she is able to maintain her employment with this kind of performance.

The employees we encountered were all pretty much lack luster at best. They all go through their memorized spiel in a zombie like tone and then tell you to have fun (though their demeanor says they could care less). If the staff has received any kind of real training it is obviously not ongoing and or effective. I could not identify anyone who stood out as a model employee or who exhibited any desire to actually be there.

We didn't see anyone who resembled a manager nor could I identify anyone who looked older than their early twenties. Therefore it's seems that supervision and guidance is extremely lacking. If this were my business, I certainly would not want to leave it in the hands of teens and young adults.

Bottom line, if I am going to invest time and money (definitely not cheap to partake here); then my expectation is to encounter well trained and personable staff. The environment demands an atmosphere of fun and enjoyment and yet the employees deliver the exact opposite. At the moment nothing is drawing us back to Wahooz any time soon.
We had a wonderful time. It was clean, the staff was friendly, the rides were all working & my daughter had a blast!

This was our third visit and we have given Lucky Fin a full chance. I agree with the reviewer that said he felt sorry for Idahoans if they believe this is seafood. On this visit I had the halibut tacos, which had absolutely no flavor and the halibut was dry and chewy. My husband had the all-you-can-eat snow crab ($30 - not exactly cheap) and it was flavorless also. Again, it is easy to be prejudiced because we lived on the Oregon Coast for several years and still return there as often as we can, but this is just not in the league of the ratings reviewers are giving it. The crab was 15 minutes in coming for the second round. Just sitting and waiting and waiting and waiting. My halibut tacos came with onions on them when I specifically asked for no onions. I pointed them out to the waitress and she seemed completely stumped. The only thing she could say was "There's not supposed to be onions on there". I guess that was good enough for her. She was not going to do anything about it until I told her again that I ordered it without onions. Later the owner?manager? stopped by to say "I'm sorry there were onions on the taco" and turn around and walk away. Weird approach for a restaurateur to solving a kitchen/server problem.  

In the past the service was OK, but this was the worst. The food has slipped downhill with every visit and I'm just sad that the "seafood" restaurant in the neighborhood doesn't even measure up to Red Lobster. We would really love to have a great seafood option. Best of luck to them, the downtown Boise crowd will be far more critical when they open down there.

This place has been a fixture in Meridian for over 20 years.  I would say that it is one of the best Mexican restaurants in the area.  The staff must be a family since they have been there forever and are always very welcoming.

Best case, I had a bad meal.  Worst case, I had a bad meal, and now have COVID.

I became curious about this place after reading reviews, and can't have a nearby Mexican restaurant that I haven't eaten at, so in I went.

COVID ops- As I was waiting to be seated, a mask-less Karen and her brood walked in, and more or less surrounded me.  I did not use the best judgement and just walk out.  My fault.  The better run restaurants are requiring masks when not seated.  Literally nobody who I saw come in or leave was wearing one.  We'll see in two weeks or so how big of a mistake this was.

Service- Nice.  Friendly.  Ordered my standard chicken taco and cheese enchilada for comparison, and got a beef tamale and cheese enchilada.  I'm weird about getting something different that what I ordered, in that I just eat it.  Maybe I'll discover a new fave dish or something.

Food- The salsa was ok.  I've had better and worse.  Both the tamale and the enchilada were smothered in bland enchilada sauce.  (League of Bad Enchilada Saucemakers strikes again!  Curses!)  The tamale itself was unremarkable.  It really fell apart when I started on the enchilada.  The cheese... was just... so... salty.  It bordered on inedible, but... well... bad cheese is better than no cheese?  After grudgingly finishing the enchilada, I went on to perform my "beanie goo" ritual, where I mix the rice, beans, and leftover scraps of entree, top it with the remaining salsa, and eat it with chips.  I got about three bites in and just asked for the check.

It's unevolved Mexican food (think Cafe Ole, but with lousy preparation.)
I'm very happy this service. Both technician are informative and respectful. Both technicians work well and solved the issues. They are great.

So so so HAPPY that they brought a Trader Joe's closer by! My all time favorite store ever! 
Cookie butter is a must from them! We go through them fast in my household! Prices are amazingly affordable! A few things you should try if you're a newbie! 
Stir fry chow mien. 
Scallion pancakes. 
Cookie butter (mentioned that! ) 
Hazelnut cookies! 
Everything but bagel seasoning ! 
Everything but elote seasoning. 
Veggie burgers! 
Watermelon juice! 
Fresh pressed juices! 
I'll update on pictures!
I love everyone at this amazing salon! Personable and very friendly. Artistic and experienced on new trends!!! Love you TOM!!!

TOGO"S
 Love your food but this owner/manager has to be dealt with she is taking the name down with the rudeness 
I moved to Idaho for the Bay Area and I was over joyed to find a TOGO'S here. this makes me sad to see and hear.

The sandwich was just a sandwich but holy crap the chicken noodle soup was amazing! It has green beens, corn, carrots, peas, tomatoes, potatoes, legumes, chicken and noodles. So much more than a chicken noodle soup. The mango smoothie (without boba) was absolutely delicious. The mixed green salad was fresh. I absolutely recommend this place and I'll be back for that soup.

This little unsuspecting spot is my new favorite! I was planning on bringing a box of treats to a friend and this gem was highly rated, so I thought I would try it out. 

The folks working were the sweetest!! I was given a rundown of all the items currently baked and ready to roll. Everything is large and definitely share size! But, that's honestly my favorite. So I sampled a bit of each of these. 

Everything is made from scratch and, boy can you tell!! The pastry for the danishes was AMAZING. I'll be dreaming of that for a while... 

And on your first trip in they give you a pecan shortbread cookie - made with potato chips! The owner's mother's recipe.

First time at Fanci Freez was spectacular! Enjoyed their hand battered finger steaks and onion rings! Those fingers steaks made me stop and taste and enjoy the food! The Georgia Peach soda was so amazing! We enjoyed wonderful service from Anahi he really went out of his way to make sure we were enjoying our food and overall experience!

The nicest Albertsons I have ever been in and we have traveled all over the US in the last two years. Idaho is our home state. We own a third generation little farm, a nice little family is buying. (Momma wants a bigger farm) 
If this Albertsons was in my neighborhood as it in my son's I'd use it 90% of the time. It reminds me of whole foods, taking their concept adding a bar/restaurant to the store (every store should do this!!) that you can buy your own food and drinks and sit at their tables or order from them. The Friday we were grabbing dinner a band was setting up. A lady was shopping w a beer, a group of any 20 from some office were meeting for Friday drinks/dinner, a couple were meeting up for dinner. 
Produce was amazing, fresh cheese, olives, bakery, sushi made to order, more hot and cold food than whole foods. Their wine dept is just amazing making bevmo look small. 
I don't think I've ever been more excited to grocery shop.

When we first went to Crumbl it seemed awesome.  Our subsequent visits have been less and less satisfactory.

With each successive visit, the staff seems less professional and the baking/prep area seems more chaotic and messy.

Our last visit, was met with the a worker (Candace) handing a box of cookies to a customer, then licking her fingers while standing at the service counter.  She then proceeds to handle cookie pans and other utensils, which thankfully had no cookies on them. 

She then puts on gloves, but still has not washed her hands after licking them, serves another box of cookies to a customer, and runs her gloved hands through her hair.  YUCK!!

I about left my cookies on the counter and requested a refund.  I can't imagine these actions meet health code.

Too bad this cookie company seems to be losing is polish.  Such a disappointments.

I have been using PBT at both locations in Meridian for about 2 years.
I had posted about the obnoxious staff at the Axiom location, they have been replaced with much nicer people.

Here is why.  I simply wish to go, spray and leave.  I do not wish to be subjected to the endless sales pitches that the staff is forced to make.  It is likely that the staff is commissioned based on the sales of the endless array of useless products.  As such, they are forced to annoy me with their sales pitch.  

I do not need the hassle, I want to be left alone.  I asked one of the staff why the pressure to sell.  She said, that they must make a specific number of sales or they will be terminated.  She said it is not "official" but others told her if she did not, she will be fired.  

Further, I have written to the "corporate"  email address that is so often portrayed here, no one ever responds.  I believe "Penelope" is a script that responds to reviews.  

I have attempted to contact the owner of the local store, I have found that is not possible.  The owners hides behind the staff and "Penelope".
