They did a warranty repair for my dishwasher.   The technician showed up on time and was extremely helpful.   Thankfully the repair was easy!   He asked about my other appliances and was able to clearly define the issue.  He also researched the part and let me know it was discontinued.   Just in case it breaks again.

Do not move in here unless you like tp play games with management. If your young avoid living here. They will nickel and dime you on move out. It's almost as if they are laughing in your face. HORRIBLE MANAGMENT. If you need a call back, don't expect to get one. Good Luck living here, I feel sorry for the hard working people just trying to get by on the huge rent increases, and small living spaces.

I had high expectations. The salon is dirty and unfinished. The person I had, Emily, just finished school and I love giving newbies opportunities because 90% of the time they try their best and are awesome. Well, this was not the case. 1. No nail soaking, 2. No cuticle cut. 3. No hand massage. 4.no cuticle cut. 5. No mail shaping. I just got a gel manicure and she started straight to color.  So I will not be going back especially since my gel chipped the next day which has never happened to me, ever.

I don't normally review tire places, but when I do, it's probably going to only be this one for as long as I'm living in Meridian. Why? Because I'll most likely have no need or desire to go anywhere else. 

I had noticed a slow leak in my front, left tire that I kept having to refill as it was flat every morning, but couldn't find where it was coming from. I checked yelp for a few tire places around town and saw mostly good reviews for this Les Schwab location. It was slightly further than two other places, but had better reviews. I went in today as a walk-in around 2pm and was greeted by an incredibly friendly lady who's name I can't remember but would say "oh yeah that was it" if I heard it. She took my info and keys after I took the car around to the front, I sat down for about 15 minutes, and like magic, they called my name. I went to the front, the gentleman told me the tire had a nail in it but they fixed it all up, and to have a great day. No, Les Schwab employees, YOU have a great day! Awesome job, incredibly fast, and everything you would want to see in friendly customer service. I'll be back here for any tire-related shenanigans.

It always feel weird when I rate something 5-Stars. The business really needs to be pushing top-notch customer service and relations to be able to earn a perfect score. While there are several Chick-Fil-A's in the great Boise area, the one in Meridian on Eagle is the location I frequent the most. 

PROs: 
Great customer service: The attentive, consistently friendly, and genial staff is always a welcome sight in today's go-go-go society. I have never had a poor experience with any staff at any location I've been with. *Story time from a visit: Was dining in and I dropped a box of Fries on the floor. Without even asking, within 15 seconds an employee had brought over an entire new box of fries* I couldn't believe how quick they were to ensuring my satisfaction.
Good Food: The food is very good, although at times I've had a varying size on the chicken breasts on the chicken sandwich. Sometimes you get large full pieces and other times you get the runt of the litter. Only fault i have.
Clean Locations: With the amount of people who visit during a day, Its surprising how clean the lobby is. They are very aware about keeping the dine-in area clean. 

CONs: 
Can be a bit pricey if you take the family out. Almost like a normal sit down restaurant at times.

NOT OPEN ON SUNDAY'S - This is a bummer when you get that chick-fil-a craving. It always seems to happen on Sunday.
Ordered finger steaks...$12 coating was still gooey inside...yuck! No salt on the fry's...I can't see coming back.

Cheerful and VERY helpful staff--very welcome in these tough times.  Brought a huge box in and was ready to be rejected (contents didn't fill it) or cut and tape it myself...but the terrific gal behind the counter happily took it from me and said she'd do it.  (Shout out to Workstation P0s2-2019!)

Will definitely be back--plus they have so much more than postal/shipping supplies and services.
Great fun with the family, good prices and as always entertaining!

I have been taking our fur babies for grooming for a few years.  Realizing things have changed due to the pandemic, we still continue used to take our Shitzu for regular 6 week grooming appointments. Our groomer was grat and then started slacking and even though we kept telling her that his mustache and beard needed to be shorter, it didn't improve.  We ended up asking for another groomer and she was amazing...but then she quit.  After that their schedules had to really be shuffled and it took 3 phone calls over a two month period to get our shitzu in again.  So we got a new groomer today and thought we were good.  When they called to tell us he was ready to be picked up, I said I needed to about 45 minutes because I had a meeting.  Unknown to me...they were now going to charge me $20/half hour for kennelling.  WTH.  So rushed down to get him and they asked us to sign a contract to not take him elsewhere.   Ultimately  we are done and already got a new groomer.  I really liked the owner and loved working with her but...I am sorry that u did t tell me in advance about a kennels fee or contract.

I have had great results going here but unfortunately nobody wears a mask each time I've been so I do t think I can drive all the way out there anymore to attend any appointments which  is sad because they have such a great and easy online booking system . However There is no receptionist at the front desk so it can make checking in and out a bit of a shit show Because it's a cramped small area and there's only one chair for whatever reason . Also , The  towns people don't social distance . They Just kind of love to come up and invade your space as they do so and it's very socially off . I know it's located In The middle of nowhere but it's still unfortunate that most of the ppl there are completely unaware of the fact that we're in the middle of a pandemic. Otherwise I would totally recommend .

When this store came to Boise, I had no idea what a gem had landed in our small city. This store really does have some awesome discounts! You do sometimes have to dig for them though, and search the store, but eh, if you have an hour to kill on a dreary winter day, hit Sierra Trading Post. Inventory seems to vary, so if you go on a day where the pickin' is slim, give it another try on a different day. I've scored some well-priced stuff that would have otherwise been very expensive. The employees are usually very nice and accommodating - so much that one of them gave us her personal coupon so we could get an additional %20 off. Employees really do make a difference in a store. I will keep coming to this place, for sure.

I have never been so frustrated with a company before. Bear with me, this is a long story. 
I ordered: A king bed, a chest, a dresser, bunk beds, and stairs for the bunk bed. 

Delivery #1: Received the bunk bed stairs, the WRONG bunk beds, and my bed. I was told the dresser was damaged and would be delivered later. 
*Sales associate rang in the wrong beds.

Delivery #2: Received correct bunk beds, but not the storage drawers that come with them, the chest, but was told my 2nd dresser was damaged again.
*Sales associate "didn't know" we wanted the drawers - they come with the bed. 

Delivery #3: The storage shelves for the bunk beds. I was told they would be on my delivery for after 5pm (when I scheduled it for) and they showed up at 7am - making my husband run late to work.
*Sales associate promised to make dresser and drawers arrive together. 

Delivery #4: Cancelled because I was told my dresser was damaged (the 3rd one!) 

I am done, I wouldn't recommend at this point ever.

Danik is awesome. I've seen a lot of growth in the last five years as their junior olympic programs have really grown to be quite impressive. This review focuses on the competitive team. Comparing gyms can be difficult, but if you're looking for excellence, Danik has consistently been scoring very high for years. One of Danik's main differentiators is that most of their best gymnasts were trained either exclusively or primarily at Danik rather than simply being recruited from other gyms once they were already good. Danik's coaching staff is tough in practice, but coaches care deeply about the gymnasts. Danik is for Idaho's serious gymnasts who want to be national contenders rather than just local Idaho stars.

Not good... as far from a traditional bao bun as it gets. All the fillings were nasty and I wish they weren't so expensive for these tiny little bao buns with nothing in them. Aside from the fact they weren't even decent, I won't be going back.

This is the most dishonest and unprofessional  clinic that I've ever seen.  There are no doctors here and the placed is run by nurse practitioner s with significantly less education and experience than a doctor.  The set up is that there is a nurse practitioner and a Medical assistant and this explains why they have long waiting times inside clinic even when it's empty, or why patients wait a long time to hear back on their calls and messages.  Worse yet, is the medical assistant has to do everything including taking x-rays with little training.  The medical assistant even do janitorial work and I saw one with a back vacuum....not surprisingly they don't last long.  I was seen four times in one year and there were three different MAs.  I was told once my appointment was cancelled because they had staffing issues and 'we're in the process of hiring'.
The facility will make you come several times for the same thing and do unnecessary testing to milk the insurance.  They don't like it when patients question their dubious practices or when you exercise your rights as a patient.  I asked to have the x-ray done by a licensed x-ray tech but Russell Swainston only orders the x-ray if done at his place by a MA.  In other words, he puts his personal and financial interests ahead of the patients right to choice or what's best for them.
Also, its not true that they are 'walk-in' because they will request you make appointment even for things like a lab, but that is not surprising given there is only a NP and one MA attending to patients.  The place is so badly understaffed, unprepared and inexperienced that people coming as patients here are asking for trouble.......for your own sake avoid this place at all costs!

Raul Mendez

Food is just okay. Our bowls were 75% rice and tasted like a microwave dinner. The baos are good but for the price of the meal, I am really disappointed. This place is definitely overpriced for what you get.

This was the fourth location I visited and there was a stand alone reason why it was the last...unbeatable service!  A phenomenal store, excellent sales (price) and even better service.  Shawn was the perfect person to deal with, never ever tried to persuade me on a mattress, gave full information along with his experience in the store offering feedback from other customers as well as sales vs. return history.  I never felt rushed, I was in the store for well over an hour, often in silence as I debated with myself.  Mattress price was never a compelling reason for Shawn as a basis for recommending the best fit; commission did not seem important and he never tried to sell me on ANY mattress regardless of cost. Out of all the retail locations I visited the information along and the sales approach used by Shawn was by far the most beneficial I received anywhere.  The cost is unbeatable, no doubt but above all the service was better than I could have hoped for, there was even an unexpected follow up call to make sure I made the correct choice.  Hands down, the best mattress location in the valley, I recommend it to ANYONE looking for honest sales and feedback, unbeatable price and outstanding service in every aspect!
We had the ultimate Bloody Mary, which was amazing.  Great tacos also.  We'll be back.

I can't say enough about the staff of administrators at this school. If you are looking for a classical Christian education this is the place. I'm very picky and I have nothing but good things to say.

My favorite roll in town! The mango roll ... it's spicy with a touch of sweet freshness- I love mango everything so of course I had to try their mango cake. Yellow cake, a mango whip buttercream inside with fresh mango and a purée on top- delish. The blt wedge was me trying something new today and I'd def order it again. They don't skimp on the bacon that's for sure. The only downfall to this place is the $ - drinks are $10/each and while on the small side it's a heavy pour (I had the berry mule) and lunch for just me- $50 with half my sushi and the cake to go. Waitstaff is very friendly, attentive and ready to make recommendations. Food is QUALITY and made to order, I've become a regular.

Got a coupon in the mail to try this place out to figured why not. They advertise a huge soup choice and they also do cold sandwiches and grilled cheese. You walk in and they do have a huge list of soups but only some are available hot th at day others are to take home and enjoy. The have a simple selection of grilled cheeses and cold sandwiches which to me is fine I hate an over complicated menu. Me and wife both got a half sandwich and free bowl of soup with the coupon. I wanted to try there chowder but apparently they ran out during there lunch rush and it was 20 mins untill next batch would be ready which was disappointing. I got the Buffalo chicken with there gouda and Jack grilled cheese and wife got there tomato basil with there meet ball grilled cheese. All the ingredients seemed fresh and soups were very flavorfull. It was an enjoyable meal all around and filling enough even getting the half sandwich. My only real problem was the price it was 7 bucks for a half sandwich and a drink add a bowl of soup and your over 10 dollars.. to me that seems like a lot for such simple food. But.i guess that's why I am not in the biz.. if you want a good bowl of soup check this place out for sure. Not sure if I will be back, for the price I think I can do better.

Craig and his brother in law did a incredible job in my living room, hallway, and living room. They installed baseboard trim through these areas flawlessly. Craigs suggestion of interior paint colors bone and whitest white were spot on. He also painted my fireplace color a black which contrasted well with the walls and ceiling. They were very meticulous in preventing paint spots using plastic sheets and brown paper to protect the floors and furniture. They completed the job in a little over 2 days , quicker than expected. Accurate, flawless and well color coordinated, could not be more pleased with the work Craig and his team. Leave your trust in Craig in helping you choose your color selections for interior painting.   Check out his website to see his spectacular work.  you will be amazed and will be a believer in his craftsmanship if you hire him on your painting jobs.

Ed Y.   Land Park Resident

So I'm on my way to the airport to catch a flight and I noticed a screw in my front tire. It's losing air so I pull into commercial tire. The one on Linder was busy so they called the store on Pennwood. They got me right in, took care of the tire, and didn't charge me a dime. I'm going to do all my business at commercial tire from now on.

We have bought many, many, pieces of furniture and rugs from R.C. Willey.
This time we bought a swing, a glider loveseat, and 2 glider chairs.
When we received them the 2 chairs were put together, however, the glider part was installed backward. My husband had to take them apart and redo them.
Then he opened the box to put the swing together. The box was pretty beat up. All pieces accounted for EXCEPT the bag with the screws, springs, etc. Okay, that made us unhappy, but we moved to the loveseat.
Opened the box, and guess what? No bag with screws, springs, etc. 
So now they have been in our garage for a week because we don't have the parts.
We called and were told they don't carry extra parts, and they would have to order new boxes from Salt Lake. Well, yesterday they came in and we were told we could come get them.
Really? Don't you think the company would want us to have the parts that we paid for and make a special trip to bring them out?
Oh no, we could come get them, or wait another week and someone would deliver.
We paid a bunch of money for this furniture. And it sits in pieces in the garage.
Not happy with any part of this.
Great Starbucks! The baristas are very nice and the place is very modern and clean. Mickayla was so sweet and even brought us our drinks to where we were sitting.
Great place never had bad service yet good pizza, with that being said "what the hell is even that"

We won a night out on the town basket which included a free drink coupon at Harry's - upon ordering the drink and many other items off the menu (so the drink coupon worked - we spent our money there) they owner refused to honor the coupon.  The donated to charity coupon.  Refused.  Looking at the obvious additional money spend and refused.  Walk away people.  walk away.

This store is so clean! The workers are very helpful and friendly! I love how kid friendly it is here too! I always shop here! There is also a lot of variety to choose from! There are sections of different country cuisine to buy too!

I'm so glad they're enforcing the mask protocol, which is both a legal requirement in the county as well as the right thing to do for the health and safety of the community. I'll only dine out at places where we can feel safe right now, and I appreciate that the hosts and management seem to take this seriously.

Tragedy. I was very happy with this Togo's location the first few days. The staff was (and still is) very friendly. Though, because of the increasingly irritating and upsetting behavior of the franchise owner/manager, I don't think I would want to go back to this location. The manager/franchise owner's behavior has gotten worse and worse since the opening weekend. She has not been nice to the guests (or the staff) since day one. She is unpleasant and very stingy about giving people stamps. The prices are terrible at this location, way too expensive for too little. The prices and overall quality (and quantity) of the food is much better in California. I decided not to go back to this location until recently, when I had received a coupon from Togo's for a free sandwich with purchase of a fountain drink. I decided to venture back once more, only because I had the coupon.
I got my sandwich and- after a very rude, very close study of my coupon by the manager-was allowed to pay for the drink. I handed over my money along with my punch card, thinking nothing of it. I was at Togo's, I was buying something, why wouldn't they give me a punch on the card? The employee member was cheerful and happy to punch my card and let me be on my way, but the manager hovered over her and snatched my punch card out of the employee's hand and pushed it back at me. Saying repeatedly to the employee "We never stamp for free sandwiches"  while not speaking a syllable to me. During previous visits I was told that the manager only wants the employees to give one stamp per customer per visit (not per sandwich, as it says ON THE CARD). I was purchasing something and was receiving a sandwich. Personally I would consider that a "visit" and feel I should have been allowed my one stamp. I do love the pastrami at Togo's but alas, the manager's terrible and somewhat threatening attitude has poisoned this location, destroying my desire to ever eat my beloved pastrami at this location ever again.  I'll only be eating Togo's in California.
I love this place.  They make the best burgers and the staff there is friendly and good at what they do.

I ordered a pair of Sony 3d headphones.  I could not find them locally or anywhere else on line.  They were sold out everywhere.  These guys had them.  They came very quickly in the mail.  No hassle service.  2 thumbs up.  Thanks.

Omg! I found my new favorite spot!!! When we walked in, we were greeted by Bella and she was just an absolute sweetheart. She explained everything on the menu and answered all our questions, and trust me, we had a ton. When we sat down, Cody brought us our food and he was so beyond polite and was very quick to help us with anything else we needed. The owners are SOOO involved in their business, every time I've been here, they are in the back cooking or in the front helping. It's awesome to see owners participate because most owners are never this involved. There are such good vibes in this place and I am SOOO happy we have a good chicken spot in meridian. It's my second time back this week! I am addicted!

We called to get a reservation earlier today and was told don't need one for the time we were going to be there. Get there and she said do you have a reservation and of course I explained I tried and was informed that I didn't need one. So now we have a 45 min wait! so sat at the bar. Ordered dinner and the couple that came after us ordered 15 minutes after we did and the go their food before us. By this time it's been 35 minutes and then asked where our order was? She went to check and said they are plating it now! Brought our order out another 10 min later. Food was cold and old like it was on the plate for a half hour or more. What a pain! Sent order back! Left with no food after waiting over an hour!! This sucks!

We stopped in on a Thursday night and had no trouble getting a nice table.
I had a large salad with chicken and it was a "B+"
My wife had some coconut shrimp combined with tempura shrimp. She gives that a solid "A"

A good spot!

BL
This place is amazing! If you are willing to pay for all the extras it's well worth the visit

This review is for a delivery made by Grub Hub.  There was a problem with items being left out and not delivered.  I contacted Grub Hub and they said that the bags were filled and stapled closed by Fanci Freeze prior to pick up.  I contacted Fanci Freeze and the gal I spoke to said that it happens frequently and there is nothing that they could do.  They weren't willing to take my name and pass it on to a supervisor in order to make this right.  So..... I paid $54 for lunch for 4 people and it wasn't complete.  Plus they forgot to send fry sauce and ketchup even though I asked specifically for it.

If I could give it zero I would.  Me and my wife ordered two milkshakes and a bottle of water for a grand total of $18! Absolutely ridiculous!  This was for 2 small shakes, but on the menu board it said we could only order large shakes. That didn't stop them from only giving us a small shake however! The milkshakes were terrible, they used the yogurt and ice chips and blended it together. So we did not get a creamy sulky shake but rather a rough nasty shake with chunks of ice still in it! 
- staff was friendly but I will never go back due to the product and price!

Love what this store is doing to protect their customers during Covid!!!! I now shop here frequently where before I'd only go for specialty items. This store is clean and all their employees super nice!
We have been very satisfied with our purchases of mattresses and bases, desk and appliances. Van in bedding and Dennis were very knowledgeable and helped with any questions or issues that came up.

We had a great experience even for my Mother's Day lunch. I had finger steaks and fries. Hubby had burger and peanut butter shake. We were the only ones who ate inside. The service was great once they realized we were there.
If you like a good happy hour margarita I'm pretty much any flavor this is the place. While you are at it grab a plate to share because operations are generous. Tasty!

Pulled in his parking lot for lunch and was immediately met by the so called owner who was casing the parking lot Who threatened to tow my truck didn't even care to say hi or ask if I was here for food and a good time. I got into my truck and left immediately screw this screw his place

Very disappointed, after looking at multiple sectionals and being told they wouldn't be here until mid July I explained to our salesperson that we need the furniture by a specific date. We walked around the store until we found a love seat and sofa the they assured me it would be delivered in a week. Fast forward to today and only my love seat arrived (after I got rid of my old furniture). I spoke to their customer service and they said the love seat wouldn't be available until mid July. Had I known this I wouldn't have purchased this furniture. The salesperson deceived me in order to make a sale, as the customer service agent advised that nowhere did it show that the sofa would be available in the promised time frame. I went down to the store and requested to speak with a manager, I was referred to customer service, when I advised I already called customer service at 0830 and had not heard back from them yet (1300 at this time) and Id like to see a manager. The lady lead us back to customer service, I reiterated that I do not want to speak with customer service I'd like to see a manager. I was told that a manager would not talk to me.

Just into Boise for the day and stumbled across this delicious deli. Don't leave without trying their soups from scratch ( borscht and a meatball - both wonderful). We had a shared plate of stuffed bell pepper and cabbage rolls. Both of these reminded me of how my grandmother and mother would cook. So yummy!

Now off to explore the grocery aisle...we will eat / shop here again!

Great pizza, once you dab the grease off. Staff is wonderful and funny. I wish they hadn't changed the interior though. I miss the art all over the walls now it's just... boring. But the food is what counts, right?

Sick and tired of constantly needing an appointment for a haircut? I was so I decided to skip the salon and try a barber. Heard great things about this location so decided to give it a whirl. 

Located in Meridian downtown this small barber offers a classic feel with a classic touch. I was immediately sat and started chatting with the several barbers as they asked what I wanted. Didn't take long you explain my go-to-do and the guy was off!

The haircut was clean and looked sharp. The neckline was perfect and the straight razor shave felt great. Would recommend again!

Hands down the best Laundromat I have ever gone to.  Helpful attendants, clean washer/dryers, plenty of choices for the type of loads you might need, lots of tables to fold clothes on.  You can't go wrong here!!

I visited the establishment yesterday at 3:00 pm 8-6-2021. I ordered a number 8 meal with tea. The menu showed $9.40. I couldn't hear the total and I ordered no extras. When I got to the window the young lady told me the total was $16.40. I asked why was it so much and she explained they had to raise prices and only sold large meals. She also mentioned that it was so they could afford to pay employees.
I know you might be struggling but without my business you will struggle a bit more. I won't be back.

Wonderful supplier of fish eggs, pickled: mushrooms, pumpkin, garlic. Matias fish. And many many more European / Russian based foods. At a decent price as well. They usually have all I want so I just stockpile it for next time I'm in the area. For that it's priceless. Look, they are not costumer service oriented ppl. I read all the bad reviews. This is a Russian style store. Including the ppl. It's not a Russian American one. They have yet to acclimate it seems to the way we are here. In a few years, I'm sure costumer service will be gréât. It's not right now. Just accept that and get your goodies and go and be happy. A gem.

OMG SO EFFING GOOD
Came here after visiting life church for the first time ( not sure if I'll go back to the church since the hubbys not a fan) but I will definitely be coming back here! I love restaurants that don't skimp on kids meals and this place did not disappoint! My son loved the popcorn shrimp meal! I ordered the shrimp mango tacos and they were fresh and delicious. The Vegas roll was good too if you're into that sorta thing. While I'm writing this review my husband is devouring the lucky fins platter so he definitely is pleased. Will be coming back soon!

Stopped in here Saturday morning around 9am with 4 adults and 5 kids!  We only had to wait a few minutes for them to put together a table.  For some reason, they shorted us 2 seats, but we got it all figured out.  

Menu has lots of combinations, so there should be something for everyone.  Kids menu options were decent and portions were HUGE!  Typically most restaurants include a kids drink with their meal, they do not.  Which suddenly made a $4 meal increase to close to $6, which seemed kind of steep.

They do have a gluten free pancake option, which I appreciate that their was an option.  However, it is kind of a cop-out in my opinion to offer a pancake mix I use at home to create this option.  Kind of made me feel like I was missing out on the total authentic experience of a "home cooked" breakfast.  Would have LOVED to been able to try the stuffed french toast.  (Jake's Gluten Free Market is just a few blocks away and bakes bread fresh daily hint, hint).  I did add on the homemade apple sausage, which was delicious!  

Wait staff was attentive.  At one point my little guy was getting stir crazy waiting for his food, she recognized this and brought over some crackers to appease him.

Portions were huge, probably a bit excessive.  Prices were a bit steep.  Paying over $50 for a family of 4 just seemed a bit much.

SlyceBox is THE best pizza in Meridian. They always toss up fresh and delicious ingredients in their pizza. My husband and I were super bummed when they stopped delivering but it wont stop us from RAVING about their bad ass pizza. Super cheesy, flavorful and scrumptious. 

SlyceBox is AMAZING!!!
Love the sweet host, servers, and bartenders.  I come here often because I always have a great experience with great food!

Ahh! So it took us 13 minutes (timed) to get to the window while waiting for two ice cream cones in the drive thru. Not sure if that's because they newly opened about a month or 2 ago but gosh to me that's a long time to wait. She handed us two cones and upon receiving they started dripping once we left the drive thru.. she didn't give us napkins either! Good thing I had some in the car but you would think they'd give you napkins in case of spillage. Personally I didn't find the ice cream all that great. I'm not sure this will be my go to ice cream place when there's many others around Meridian.

The food is really good here. I remember when this place opened, and started going there a lot because it's right by my house.
Here's the deal with The Curb. The food is good and there is no fault with the service. The Curb is blaring loud so you can't hear the person sitting next to you when they're screaming and it's just an after work meat market for the Micron middle management crowd. So the self-important d-bag who thinks he's awesome, runs his team like his own little fiefdom, and yes, is better than you, comes here to pretend he's cool so he can hook up with a girl that knows that she's pretty enough to land an arrogant young "stud" that if she plays her cards right, she won't have to work ever again. 
Think Bay Area Yuppies in the 1980's... Condescending, full of themselves, drinking and looking to show off. The only thing they're missing is the cocaine and the BMW... 
Like I said, the food is fine, the service is fine, there's nothing I can say about the staff, service, food or drink. It's a really good place. It's just that it's really loud and their clientele are mostly asshats. I'd rather encounter a fine steakhouse filled with hells angels, and it's kinda like that... except Hells Angels aren't yuppie D-Bags.
GREAT first experience at this location!  Thanks Victor, Raiden & Maria!!  Great food & even got to take home an extra gyro & a sample of Negranti Creamery sheep's milk ice cream! I will be back!!
expired overpriced products!!! if u love moldy bread and cheese this is the place for you:) terrible customer service not worth your time or money.

We ordered the family meal and the tiny containers might be able to feed one person. The combo meal we ordered for our son looks like it has more food than the meal we ordered for everyone. The menu is misleading, a family meal usually can feed up to four people on every other restaurant, this maybe can feed two. This is too many times we've ordered from the Albertsons Marketplace hoping that the food would be better, but we are left disappointed yet again. I'm positive that poor Door Dash has paid us back more than the completed meals we've received from Albertsons Marketplace.

The last couple times I've ordered delivery from here they've given me old, stale cookies. They tasted like they'd been frozen and were really dry. Frustrating because you pay an extra dollar per cookie for delivery and there are other fees as well. This last sat night I ordered from them and it'll be the last time. Bummer. My sodas have been flat/ had too much syrup before but the cookies being gross is the last straw. Lots of other places have always fresh cookies.

Over by my house.. saw it , but never tried until yesterday. 
I will be back.. only reason I gave 4 stars instead of 5 is my mango /banana smoothie didn't have any banana & boba beads  were in it ( even though I requested I didn't want any). But I am now a boba bead lover!  Even other places & just didn't like them. The smoothie was delicious & loved the boba... next time try another flavor with the boba
I had the jalapeño popper grilled cheese & tomato basil soup. The soup was to die for , & the grilled cheese was just okay. Not grilled enough on one side. Next time, I will try another one of their grilled cheese sandwiches. 
Would I go back? Absolutely! Even though couple of mistakes, the smoothie was absolutely amazing & the soup was pretty darn good.

I have never been to a Dr's office where I've felt this cared about. Dr. J and his entire staff is amazing. He cares about my progress and has explained every step so well.They always treat you like you are the most important person in the world. I will never go anywhere else for chiropractic care or massages.

Been to this chain before, but I can't say I would  go out of my way to go back. The burger was tasty enough, but the bun was terrible. Did not hold up and was too small for the burger and lettuce and tomato. Those were of good quality, but the bun made it a disappointment. Serves me right, a fellow Yelper who isn't into chain stuff or beef, might say to me. But after a long Dr. appointment, Hunger took over and we stopped in here for a late lunch.

The wife had a grilled chicken breast burger, but it was too salty for her.
The shared french fries were ok, but have had better.

Next time I have a burger out, I will chose wiser.

This place was awesome!! Kinda having a tough time finding a good pedicure tech! Yulina and Martha super sweet and fun they did a great job on mine and my moms pedicures!! If your looking for a place check out sassy nails and ask for one of these girls!!
Happy customer and going to be a returning customer!!

We love Steve's Cafe! The staff has been very friendly and the food is excellent! Our particular favorites are the corned beef hash (oh so good) and the Italian sausage. They really know how to cook the hash browns too...letting them sit on the griddle keeps them from being mushy.

If I am going to pay for breakfast, this is a much better value than the chains. It is nice to support a local business too.

I haven't found a need to go inside, yet, but I frequently go thru the drive thru to drop off my mail. It's easy, convenient & much faster as far as my ETA goes than dropping it in the mail slot at the local grocery. Thank you! The weather here can sometimes be debilitating, and I'm glad I have found a place to drop my mail off safely without having to bring both kids inside with me.

What a great place to do business. It started with a call Jerry helped me with tires for my motorhome. What excellent service from the first call to picking up my motorhome. I own a RV and Marine store in Lake Havasu City Arizona and was traveling needing tires. I was highly impressed with this store. Keep up the good work I will back for sure.

Love their food, love the atmosphere, and I love the people who work here!!
I have been here close to ten times, so that proves I'ma fan.
Sushi is hot  but good! Just a warning.
Their calamari and salmon are my favorites!
Get their seafood sustainably.

I didn't get the notice that Tuesday's are $2 games. Showed up at 8pm and the main lounge was full so we were SO excited when Eric told us we would be in the private Z lounge without extra charge. The lounge was empty for the most part and we ordered our adult beverages. Our perfectly unplanned date night without our newborn daughter was about to change. In walks a family of 4 and what do you know..they were put at the next lane and so we got to share a table with this family that of course wants to talk to us. Man do I sound like a grouch but I'll tell you as I write this I would consider 2 stars for my experience especially after a $18 bar tab for 2 drinks. This next part is not so gravy to me: the reason the family was put next to our lane was so the cleaning staff could start early to clean the room. So we felt pushed out. Even the bartender grabbed my drink glass before I was actually really done with it and then came back for the water glasses right as our last game ended. This is NOT the first time I felt rushed here. I had my bachelorette party here at the Z lounge and it was the cleaning crew that made us feel rushed. I think next time I'm going to Big Al's.

So we have been into Lucky Fins several times, the Meridian location is the one we go to. My wife is in love with their pistachio halibut, we look forward to going out. It's a little spendy but worth it. Well... we went in there tonight, I called and got reservations for 11 of us, we were there celebrating our daughters 20th birthday. Everything was good except when my wife got her halibut there was a huge hair across the bottom of the plate under the halibut. We called the waitress over and showed her the hair and just simply asked to get a different one. We weren't looking for a handout, discount, or a free dinner. We just wanted one without a hair. The waitress looked around the table like we were all crazy, she then asked my wife " are you sure that isnt your hair "? She was being very serious, so we said no the hair was under the entire fish and it wasnt my wife's hair color, but that's beside the point. I should have called for a manager right then and there, but we were all having a good time and didnt want to ruin my daughters bday.  The waitress finally agreed to have a new halibut made for my wife. Of course it didnt come out until we were all finished. Our bill was $150, I left her a $25 tip only because  my wife used to be a waitress. Anyways I dont think we will be going back there anytime soon, all because of a rude server.

Well, this store is big and new, but don't think we will be back for a long time. Right now,  too many people and too many small kids being allowed to become speed bumps in the aisles. Those damn little carts, sometimes two to the family plus a regular cart for the parents and it is like a rolling blockade in the aisles. I wanted to be the Proconsul in Ben Hur and order, "Ramming Speed", more than once. 

And with the "Lookeloos", just getting around was a truly painful experience. The help was doing their best to be kind and helpful, but I could tell some were also getting a little vexed at the crowd. I sympathized with them. 

We did some shopping, but except for some things that we know are in the new store, we will stick to our previous Albertsons haunts. As usual, Michele R. Has all the physicality of the new store described to a "T", so go read her review because I am not going to repeat. 

If you like crowds, then go, you'll love it.

The best way to describe CycleBar is that it is like the "fine dining" of workouts. You pay a good chunk of change for it, but it is absolutely worth it for what you get. I was blown away by the organization, energy, professionalism, and excellence that this establishment brought to the table.

I came here with a group of 20 girlfriends for a bachelorette party (we dressed up in 80's attire...because, why not make your best friend's bachelorette party themed?!). We weren't able to book a class all to ourselves for the day we had the party planned, so we joined in for one of their Thursday evening classes (they had a live DJ!!). There were about 40 people in the class altogether, yet CycleBar managed to get our group all clumped together in the room. I think that's what impressed me most about their studio, they go above and beyond with the little details: 

- Upon arrival, the owner walked me around and showed me where everything was located. 
- Each girl was given a CycleBar water bottle with their name on it (and a $25 credit that could be used to purchase classes/one of their packages).
- They even put a "Very Important Pedaler" on the front and center bike for the bride.
- They don't assume you know what you're doing (which is so nice for newbie cyclers!), their staff walked around the room and helped each person get their bike adjusted for the most comfortable ride.

Now all of that is just the first impression...then the class starts. SO MUCH FUN. Genuinely! You know you're having an awesome workout when you forget that you are working out yet there is a pile of sweat at your feet. The whole thing is one big experiential production--from the music they play, to the lighting in the room, and the biking sequences that go along with the music. Our instructor was Eryn, and she was (not exaggerating in the slightest) probably the best workout instructor I've ever had for any kind of fitness class. Her energy was contagious and so motivating. If you are dropping in for a class, try out hers, you will have a blast (and an awesome workout at the same time)! 

Overall: absolutely amazing! I would totally hop on board for a monthly membership if 1) It wasn't all the way in Meridian and 2) The cost wasn't so high. Like I said, CycleBar is the "fine dining" of workouts--which makes for a great treat every here and there, but on the reg isn't the most realistic/cost-effective fitness regimen.

After looking forward for some time to visit the actual store, I was highly disappointed in their selection and lack of items availability.  I have ordered items online from them previously and have been happy with the purchases and products but their retail location is seriously lacking! I asked for about 15 pairs of shoes in my size and they didn't have a single one.

C'mon, I know that there are a (very) few woman in this world with a shoe size of 14 but to have the entire insole department stocked with nothing but giant feet is ridiculous.
Highly recommend this office. The front office is always kind and professional and Braden is the best. He really cares about his patients and loves helping people.
In 8 minutes they buzzed my dads hair off in the worst haircut he's ever had and charged him $25.00 for it.  Yikes!  We WILL NEVER COME BACK!!!
Very tasty and well done deli sandwiches! The fries are fantastic as well, almost a cross of Jo Jo potatoes and steak fries. And good fry sauce and spicy ketchup. Fast friendly service as well

Nice park in a great location. Walking distance from The Village. To walk there from the village though, you do need to cross the street at a crosswalk. The park has lots of grassy areas, a basketball court, volleyball court, a playground, a small splash pad, a non-swimming lake, pavilions, restrooms, and a band shell.

I called in today and asked if they had anytime for walk ins and they said "of course, we close at 5:00" I pulled up at 4:40 and they were shut down for the night. I'm sure they do a great job with the hair cuts but I'd call and get an appointment.
This is not a clinic! Giving the flu shot in a place were hair flys everywere.Stick with what you do dont let greed get the best of you.

A neighbor turned us on to this deli.  Great place to grab a sandwich.  The bread/rolls are so fresh and flavorful...... this definitely separates them from other delis.  Add a great selection of meats, cheeses, and extras not to mention their fries which appear to be coated and then fried.  I'm making myself hungry writing this review and need to go back soon.

I order Lucky Fins a couple of times per month via UberEats.  I highly recommend their blackened fish tacos.  I've also served them to company and everyone gives them rave reviews.  Some of their dishes, including the blackened fish tacos, are served over a cheesy jalapeño rice that is seriously amazing.  I look forward to that as much as the entree.  

I occasionally order their mango shrimp tacos as well.  They're also delicious.  Overall, I highly recommend Lucky Fins!

Trader Joe's in Meridian 
I love the new location, which opened a little over a week ago. Even though the downtown Boise store is closer to where I live, I will be frequenting this location on Eagle road because it offers lots of easy parking and the store is 3,600 sq. ft. bigger, which gives it a much more open and comfortable feel. In addition to all of the products you will find in Boise, you will find some new ones, some of which I photographed.

Matt is unbelievable. Long story short, my girlfriend was keeping secrets from me and I didn't know exactly what they were. I met Matt at BSU, and he basically put me at ease finding out what she was keeping from me. On top of all of that, Matt was far and away the most affordable private investigator in the area!

So excited to have this new spot in Meridian! I am a chicken sandwich lover so there was no doubt that I was going to try this place out. My husband and I went for dinner on opening night and we were really impressed! 

We each ordered the "Nashville Warm" Cluck sandwiches and an order of the dirty bird fries. Not too spicy but definitely had a little kick. We thought the food was great! The sandwiches each had a great piece of chicken that was crispy and the slaw and pickle was a perfect addition. I wish there was some more queso on the dirty bird fries, but they still tasted great. 

The staff was super friendly and gave us recommendations of things to try on the menu. We had to wait about 20 minutes for our food but that's understandable since it was their first day open and it was quite busy when we went. 

We will definitely be back to try out some of the other goodness! :)

Don't expect what you are used to or what their website pictures show.  I got the orange chicken as I usually like orange chicken in all the iterations from various restaurants I have tried. But what I got was neither like any orange chicken I have had previously or what was in their picture on their online menu. What i got was a bowl of rice and two table spoons of hard dark meat most of which was in tiny fragments such that it felt like I was eating ground chicken rather than individually cut pieces. I can only assume this was what was scrap meat left over from nicer cuts of chicken. The sauce was somewhat sweat but flat and flavorless. I was so disappointed as I really wanted to love it and be able to support a local business (though to be fair it is a nation wide chain which I should have known before ordering.). I also ordered two boa - teriyaki chicken and cheese burger. They were very light and fluffy consisting mostly of dough with a tiny amount of stuffing.  The teriyaki tasted more like BBQ chicken (and perhaps I got the wrong one) and I don't personally like BBQ so I can't fairly judge that if it was BBQ by mistake. If it was supposed to be teriyaki it was a pretty big miss for me. I also tried the cheese burger boa as I thought it wiuld be fun to try something both very familiar (Ive had dumplings and Ive had cheese burgers) but also unique. Again the dough to stuffing ratio means you are going to get 90% dough so most of your bites will not include cheese burger. But the dough is nicely done - very fluffy and light in taste and texture. The cheeseburger stuffing is simple and the combination of both elements done well and simply adds up to a unique yet familiar experience. Just as the orange chicken skimped on the chicken leaving one to feel underwhelmed you may also find yourself underwhelmed with the amount of cheeseburger in your cheeseburger boa (teriyaki/BBQ??? Chicken as well). 

I am 100% certain I would never purposely order their orange chicken again or likely anything as it feels they skimp and short you at every turn. (Which I guess is to expect with some chain restaurants). Which is too bad bc the burger boa could have been really good if there had just been burger in them. So i guess... I wouldn't likely order boa again unless they were on a massive sale and I would certainly avoid the teriyaki chicken. 

A real bummer as I so wanted to find another place for yummy eats.

As far as Maverick gas stations go this is one of the nicest in my opinion.   The gas always seems to be quite a bit cheaper here over nearby places.   Solid selection of anything from beer to snacks of all kinds.
 
Pro:  still has the nacho cheese dispenser with the chilli one too.

Con:  the cheese and chilli dispenser are either empty or not working half the time.  

Don't hate me or think me petty.  We all have are vices and mine on fairly rare occasion is convience store nachos like I loved years ago in high school.   This is not the whole reason it gets only 4 stars but if you're reading this Mr. Maverick dude you keep thinking it is!

This grocery store is amazing!
They even have a taphouse.  You can order a beer and take it to go.  Shop as you sip a pint of beer.  Now that's my way to shop!  Just be sure to drop off the glassware at Customer Service or the bar before you exit.

Stop it. Just stop. I hate this addiction... but it hurts so good  Make sure to prep Saturday night as they are closed on Sundays. And it's not fun showing up with a craving, only to find locked doors. I've already claimed a free 4-pack by redeeming points. I'm proud of that, but also not lol. Cannot go wrong with the classic chocolate chip, but I wouldn't be mad if the Oreo was on the menu more often.

Glenn Godfrey with Craig Swapp handled my accident case and was great. He stayed on top of everything and got my medical bills paid as well as got me more money then I expected from my injuries, and it wasn't drug on forever. I would definitely recommend Craig Swapp and Associates.

I'm usually a big fan of this place but the last few times I have visited we've had terrible service experience. I just ordered a take out that was supposed to be 15 minutes to be ready but when I got there, I had to wait an additional 30 minutes for two rolls, unbelievable. No apology or offer for a discount or anything. The downtown location is much quicker with better service and I will take my business somewhere else from now on.

Everyone is very nice and attentive. To food is super tasty as well. I'm a big fan of their Carne Asada, and my wife loves their Mole enchiladas. The Jalisco Botana appetizer has great flavor. Can't beat bacon wrapped shrimp!

Lake Appliance is dependable and competent in their repairs. I've rarely had any issues and they've always made things right in the end. Their customer service is outstanding. Tammy in particular is the best and has always taken great care of our repair needs. Definitely recommended! Thank you Lake Appliance!!

Tango's is one of my favorite places. I've eaten at the Boise location and the Meridian food truck. The food is always delicious, and the service is kind. My favorite empanadas are the linguica (a type of Portuguese sausage), puerco (shredded pork, potatoes, green salsa), and rancho (chorizo, beans, cheese, and jalapeño). Their breakfast empanadas are also great.
Best fresh warm pastry ever.  I could spend hours looking and nibbling.  Friendly, knowledgeable and authentic.  Cannot wait to try my deli treats.

I enjoy the facility minus the new "Z" Bar & Grill. What a complete joke. The service was legitimately the worst I've ever had at any restaurant in my life. I couldn't get my daughter a spoon to eat her Dip'n Dots so they melted. I had asked for one and they never brought it. The place wasn't even busy... probably 20% full. I don't know who is in charge of that place as far as bar manager but you can certainly do better. You should seriously look into this. I will make sure to eat BEFORE I come to Wahooz next time.

Good pastrami and that's all that matters!

I have been looking for a good local pastrami and while I have found a place or two with good pastrami it was either too thick and chewy or they didn't have the correct bread and fixins, rye bread, pickle and mustard is all I want on mine. This place has really tender and tasty meat. Don't get me wrong the meat could use more flavor to make it perfect for my taste buds so I should only give them 4 stars but I am so happy to have found a decent fix for my hankering I have decided to celebrate by throwing a 5 star party.

And yes they do have other food too but who cares lol

This dealership is over priced on there vehicles but the main thing I had go bad when I went here was that the will only give you half of the retail book value on your trade in vehicle. I mean if your trade in book value is $10,000 the will only give you $5,000. Not your cars retail value of like $15,000 not $10,000 so going here you will loss have the money you could have towards your new car if you go somewhere else that gives you full value of your trade in.
Just a warning for everyone in Idaho
All the cookie flavors I've ever ordered have been delicious. I would come here every day if I could!

If I could give 0 stars I would. We purchased a entertainment center and upon delivery there guys broke a part and tried to hide it, I quickly found this and called and they ordered a new piece, I asked for a delivery after 4 pm and got 5 phone calls from RC Wiley in one day. Seems no one knows what's going on. They wanted to come two hours early while I was still at work, I finally was able to get home a little early and they replaced the broken part but it just made things worse and now I can barely close the doors on my entertainment center. I have never seen such a bunch of incompetent group of people. I am just going to return the entertainment center  at this point and go elsewhere. Let's not even get started on the extremely long hold times to just talk to someone in customer service, overpriced, incompetent. 

Update the store manager reached out to me and made things right the service tech that came out was amazing and a great help.

Yelled at on the phone because I asked for a refund. I was told I was buying 25mg and he reassured me it was. Got out of the store and it was 35mg. Refused to give me a refund or swap the product. Will never be going there ever again. Horrible customer service. Blown away:(

I set up an appointment, which was today, the previous day they changed the time which is completely ridiculous. Then they came, used our ring doorbell, which wasn't working. Instead of trying the regular doorbell. He left within a minute (I have it on my ring) l, then I called to see if he'd come back I was told nope. You lost my business and any referrals.

We had just moved to the area, were STARVING and fell upon this place. Glad we did!!

They had just opened and since they cater to a more beer/cocktail centered crowd they were basically dead - so ok with that!

The interior is fun, industrial and well maintained.

The waitstaff is very friendly, patient with kids and very attentive.

My husband ordered the nachos. Those are some serious nachos! He said they were really delicious, only wished they'd been served on a more fitting plate size wise. One half paying attention bite and you'd be a mess.

I ordered the southwest club. YUMMMM! This is your classic delicious club but with a kick! 

We ordered our three year old a grilled cheese. Huge portion for a kid his age, but good deal!

Overall experience was good, will definitely be back!
Hands down delicious cookies. Chip has failed me countless times in delivery times (1.5hrs) and missing milk. Crumbl is the way to go.

If the Meridian PO was to close it would be a public service.  I have never seen such incompetence in my whole life.  No wonder they can't make a profit and everyone is using alternatives to the PO to send items.  

Today I left a note for the mail person (our regular one who is awesome has been out due to an injury).  I also had two sympathy cards to be mailed and put them with the note.  When I went to pick up today's mail both cards were still in the mail box (along with additional mail) and the note was gone.  

In the past there have been several incidents when similar problems occurred.  Three cards were mailed to a friend in Boise.  All were Love Pop cards (same size) with the same amount of postage.  Two were delivered one was returned 6 weeks later with "insufficient postage".  At that time I was told it depends on the receiving PO to make that call.

I also received a phone call from a friend who has heard my many stories about the postal system (including a package from LA that was never delivered but tracked to Meridian and I was told it would be delayed - 5 years and still waiting) and she advised me that the Thanksgiving card I sent her on November 18th arrived on December 18th.  I have more examples but I believe these should suffice to make my point.

I wish someone could give me advice on what I  can do to stop this.  In addition to being a major inconvenience and I have to apologize for missing important dates, I also have to find an appropriate sized envelope and re-postage it - essentially paying for postage twice - unless I am able to hand deliver it.  I won't use USPS for packages because I can't depend on them and I have, on occasion, used FedEx or UPS if an envelope HAS to be delivered on time.

Their ad has had FRESH crab on the front page 2 weeks in a row.  I know they are hard to get but really!  The people's behind the counter have no idea what is going on and they are selling the frozen crabs for $4 more a pound.  The bigwigs need to figure it out or at least keep their people in the loop!

Amazing people! 
I was working with a previous lender and was having a horrible experience. I was then referred to Evergreen and started working with David. He explained the whole process to me, answered all my questions, and would even call to see how my house hunting was going. We only had a certain amount of time to find a house and get our loan processed due to our lease at our rental having to be renewed and the team at Evergreen made our dream of owning a home happen in a very crunched amount of time. Thank you David and Megan!!!

I went in to buy gift cards only and was told by employees to wait in the cookie line. The cookie line is to the front door. Here I am trying to support this new business by buying gift cards and they want me to wait until they wait on everyone else purchasing warm cookies first?! No thank you.

After reading fellow yelpers reviews, and being drama free at the dentist, Indigo chose to go to Blok & Co as a post appointment treat. 

Think of a fancy, snobby coffee shop, in a ritzy part of town. Blok & Co is it's fresh faced younger cousin with less attitude and better parking.

To go along with their less is more approach, the place is basically empty with the exception of ferns, tables and chairs, cacti  and a charming picture of a Highland Bull (I've named him Scotty) over the fireplace. There are games like UNO, Jenga, and playing cards. 

I ordered a chai latte (with almond milk) and avocado toast for Indigo. I enjoyed the chai latte. It had an almost fluffy airy cozy property to it. If your favorite sweater or cardigan were a drink, this would be it. 

The avocado toast was a genuine delight. I've got a crush on it. Simple concept, yet brilliantly executed. Indigo enjoyed it, she's a bit of a connoisseur. Compliments to the nice person who made it!

The place didn't scream kid friendly and it didn't scream no kids allowed. Due to its minimalistic interior, it didn't scream anything at all, which was refreshingly calm and quiet. 

Thanks to its sparseness, there was nothing really Indigo could get into besides the games (sigh of releif). The friendly patrons kept mostly to themselves and a few smiled at Indigo as she ran about the room. 

I appreciate the clean bright space and the line "Decaf sucks, and then you die." I don't have any tattoos, but if I did, it would be that line. 

Indigo gives this place 40 stars for delicious avocado toast and Jenga blocks!

Maija Karin Photography - No words can express how perfect she made our wedding!!! AHHHHHHHHHHH hahahahahahha I scream with honest excitement every time I think about it. Noting this address in Meridian on Yelp is correct for Tango's brand new location there, they are in "pre-opening" mode as of January 17, 2022, I'm puzzled by reviews posted as far back as 2017.  I wonder if the reviews may be for the Nampa location which Tango's closed a couple of years ago in planning to open this one to replace it and the Nampa reviews were carried over to this new location given it is considered the replacement of Nampa business.  Regardless, the bricks and mortar store in Meridian just opened as of 1/17/22  (owners originally hoped for opening in early 2021).  They are calling this pre-opening phase with take out only, order in advance and with limited hours and options for now.  (Note:  staffing problems.)  Here is what you might find useful to know before you go to enjoy delicious food made by these lovely owners who are originally from Buenos Aires, so they know Argentinian food, and started introducing Boise to it in about 2006 when they opened the original Tango's in Boise.  For the Meridian shop:

*Hours are M-F  3:00 - 7:00

*No dine in options now, carry out only.  Orders need to be phoned in or texted in advance and no later than 2:00.  208-447-0701

*Credit card payment only for now

*All 50 empanada options are available, but only empanadas at this location and for now no gluten free empanadas can be ordered for here.  Empanada menu is at the top of Yelp page. 

*When this Meridian location is fully open it will include an Argentinian grill menu too.

NOTES:

*This location - Near Big Lots and Albertson's, same complex, on E. Fairview.  is easier to access than the Boise location and they have a parking lot.

*The parking lot has ADA / accessible parking.  The building is level in for people who have mobility disabilities.

*These are fried empanadas.  If you're looking for baked empanadas you can find those in Meridian too, owners are also from Argentina and are in the kitchen making their delicious food, down Fairview a mile so so at The Empanada Club which has been open for maybe four years.
Love this place, I come here every week! The food is fresh and flavorful and all of the servers do an amazing job. Highly recommend checking out the weekend specials!!

My husband and I have made it a goal to get take out or delivery from a local restaurant at least once a week. We were not aware of Soup Kettle Grille before but are very pleased now that we tried it and it will probably be a regular for lunch. I had the half Cuban Sandwich and my husband had the Rueben. We both ordered soup to go with the sandwiches. I went with the Loaded Baked Potato and he had a Chicken Thai Curry soup. The food was very good and was delivered earlier than expected.

Sorry to say IT was the WORST food for mexican EVER, first The ICE TEA, What can you do wrong with ICE TEA, IT was grainey, Still see the chunks, Bottle powder, Terrible, Then I asked for CORN TORTIAs with warm butter, I got Flour tortia COLD with Hard cold butter, Then I ordered Enchilida, and taco, The taco came on its side on the plate with all the stuff hanging out, ( THE TACO SHELL was for sure store bought,) HORIBLE, fell apart on plate, The Enchilida, ORANGE SAUCE, HORIBLE, NO FLAVOR, Should have onions and be a good quality corn tortia with a red sauce so you can taste what is in side, Sorry Guys but it really was horible, NO FLAVOR and after pay $41.00 for our food, NOT worth 10.00. IF Gordon Ramsey from Hells Kitchen was there he would shut you down, OR Robert Irvine from HGTV Kitchens He would run you out of town, Get some Help, Do some good research on REAL MEXICAN FOOD,,,,,

I've wanted to try this place for the longest time as I am a soup fanatic, however after trying I am surprised at all the five star reviews. First off the environment is great and hip. Trendy music and very clean. The workers (I'm assuming the owners as it was a husband wife duo) were friendly enough and seemed to care about my order. 

I order half of a grilled cheese and tomato basil soup as well as a sugar cookie. It was together $10, so not terrible. However, some critiques. 
-The grilled cheese was ok, not outstanding. It was unfortunately not dippable into my tomato soup because it did not soak up any soup, maybe the grease I'm not sure. 
-you are not given any plate or tray to eat on, so your sandwich and soup you are eating on the bare tables. This may not be bad for some but for me it was a bit odd.
-the tomato soup was good, but I could get the same quality in a can.
Overall you can definitely tell this is a family run business. They seem to care about their restaurant but havent worked out all the exact kinks yet. Not sure again why there are so many reviews raving about this place, it was pretty mediocre in my opinion.

Craig and his crew are amazing. They painted  all of our kitchen cabinets white. They were originally dark wood with a western finish. They filled all cracks and weathered look scrapes to create a perfect smooth finish.  These guys are clean and courteous.

You guys KNOW I love to eat  Have you been to Flame Broiler yet?!  If you know I like to eat, you know I also like to indulge  BUT I also am not a big cook, I enjoy eating out, and if I can find a place that makes a wholesome, healthy meal--I'm all about it. VOILA Flame Broiler (aka Flame Broilzzz in our house).  you guys--I have to brag in them because it is SOOOO GOOD, actually healthy, and a place that I'll admit, we go almost bi-weekly. If they close, I'll starve. So anyway, you can get rice and meat bowls, salads,  vegetarian options... so many choices AND you get to pick between magic sauce (teriyaki), hot (buffalo), double hot (jalapeño garlic), triple hot (sriracha). You guys, I love love love it. If you live by me--let's go!!! If you don't, GO GET YA SOME Flame Broilzzz

I think crumbl cookies are pretty good and worth a splurge if they have super amazing line up for the week. We've gotten cookies a couple times from here and used the curbside option and had our cookies brought out in minutes upon our arrival. The cookies are seriously huge. We usually cut them in 1/4ths and share with a group to try out. I'm a fan!
I have called and called, but cannot get a real person to talk to for my dad's association dues, I left a message, let's see if they make an attempt to call back...Still waiting...
This place rocks! Shared back patio with the Roosevelt, fire pit, taco truck, pool table, darts, I mean.... Come on!

I was in dire need of clothes. I've been in England for 4 years and never found a store that I liked more than buckle over there. So I came into the store today I had my son who is 10 months old with me as well as my diaper bag and one of the staff members followed me around the store and kept wanting to take everything out of my hands and put it up on the counter for me. I understand this is their customer service but the way she treated me was out of the ordinary. When I went to check out I wanted to update my information in the system and she told me that she was already "in the transaction" and that I can do it next time I come in. Why not do it now? Is that not your job? The store itself is nice but will not be returning due to its staff.

Heard finger steaks were best in town and I'm a finger fart lover so I gave it a shot. I ordered online thinking it would be quicker. It was not. Then when I got to the window and got my order they missed giving me a fry. I was upset because I waited 20 minutes for my online order. Of course I didn't know until I got home and called them. They said I could come back with my receipt and get it. I was over it at that point. I just said maybe relay to your staff to be more accurate with filling orders. Next thing I knew he sent me a $5 gift card. He made up for it.

If you like large finger steaks with really good tender meat... this is your place. 
I however like my small and crispy. ‍
This place is nice! Very good food and great service! Kickin shrimp is bomb!!! Very clean as well. Would definitely come back again
Incredibly fun menu and great food. Happy Hour applies to the dining room too, which is very generous. Loved the Baja Stack and bourbon Bread Pudding. Great time!!

I need Patrick Morandi the ceo to contact me back about some horrible issues with your wahooz staff. If needed I'll post it all on here but i would like to speak to you 1st if possible. Thank you. I did try to contact you by phone and email and on facebook. Please contact me asap

To start, rather than greeting me by the name that was on my appointment, I was greeted by the service I was getting, which overall just set the tone for a poor experience. Once I sat down, Emily's customer service continued to spiral downward. I felt like I was inconveniencing her for being there, she really wanted nothing to do with me which came across extremely unprofessional.
None of the edges were cleaned up, several coats of the polish did not go all the way down to the cuticle so it looks blobby, and the color is still translucent. There were no other customers, she offered for me to come in earlier so I'm sure she was trying to leave the salon earlier and I could definitely tell. Overall poor experience all around.

I had a great experience at Sleep Number! When we walked in, Lee greeted us. I could tell that he was genuine right away. It didn't feel like a car dealership at first but it started to as things progressed. Buying a bed really is an investment. Most of us spend near equal parts of the day at work and then in bed. Ok I might sound like I'm still trying to justify our purchase, but yes I am! Just like a car, a bed isn't exactly the best investment. It's definitely a necessary one, especially since our water bed didn't have much of a 'return of investment.' Getting back to our experience, we did decide to finance. We tried to lower the cost of things like the delivery charge by going to pick up the bed ourselves but because we bought a California King (husband in 6'4") we couldn't pick up in store. Also we had to buy a mattress pad to keep the 10 year warranty on the mattress. It is a neat mattress pad-it can go in the dryer! We added to our purchase with extras like pillows and blankets. Adding pillows and things does lower the cost, the best way to explain this is to check their website. I really do like the faux fur throw blankets! Excited for our bed, more excited that I hopefully won't need the chiropractor as often!

I didn't notice any expired items, but there was a lady sorting through several baskets of why looked like expired items.
