In the exam rooms, everything is set up for the dog's (or cat's) comfort. There is a DAP diffuser (dog appeasing pheromones) although I think they have a different name for it. Basically it emanates the pheromones a mama dog exudes with her puppies and calms dogs of all ages. There was quiet music playing on a little box speaker (available in the lobby for $60) and all the cabinets are cushioned so they don't slam and startle dogs that might be on edge. They have non-slip mats on the floor so the animals aren't scrambling for purchase on the tile. 

I took my dog there just to establish a relationship with a new vet. I am so glad I came to this place - the vet happened to be the owner. He is awesome with animals and even better with people. Usually you find vets that are particularly good with one or the other, not both. He listened and did a careful, thorough exam on my girl. 

The first visit here is free so we paid nothing for that; however, I think I ended up paying about $200 for a package of bloodwork, urinalysis, heartworm check and fecal. We also bought her thyroid meds there after blood results came back and it was very reasonable - $25 for a 90 day supply. This was cheaper than Drs. Foster and Smith because I didn't have to pay shipping. 

Overall, I will absolutely most definitely without a doubt be back. Please, if you're looking for a new vet, consider this place. They are amazing.

Food was ok and experience was so-so. I feel it was a bit over priced and the service took awhile for drink refills. Was busy on a Friday night when we went so that might have been it. I tried the steak which was a bit pricey and was expecting it to be better for what I paid for it. Might try again if I get a gift card or something for Christmas .

I stopped in for the first time because I had to pick up a birthday gift at Sur la Table just across the way. I thought I'd have some pasta for lunch. I sat at the bar- about 1:30 on Saturday afternoon- and was surprised how busy they were. "The pasta must be excellent," I thought. The menu had calzone and pizza. No pasta. Whaaaat? I thought about going somewhere else but before I could decide the bartendress asked if I'd like to try a very good cabernet. "oh okay." It was good, so I looked at the menu again. Pizza is okay but I don't even eat the crust. I ordered a personal pizza with the garlic white sauce with pepperoni and mushrooms. I know. Wild, right? Anyway it comes and I have a couple bites and right there and then I promise myself never to have pizza anywhere else but here, and that I'll even drive from the North End all the way out to cow country in Meridian just to have this pizza- weirdly delicious. I even ate the crust.

Hunter/Trapper/American Indian atmosphere/charm. 
5 stars for having an ingredient list and for their staff's attempt to accommodate!However, if your dietary restrictions are many, this place will disappoint! For instance, they are unable to prepare naked ribs because of the rubs. And all the additional fats in sides are soy based. They also have trans-fat "butter". Really?! I thought everyone was up to snuff on that one. Aside, they charged me full price for a half glass of wine :(

Just off I-84 exit 46 is this delightful spot. The coffee was nice and strong, the menu full of delicious options, and service superb.  We chose the farmhouse hash and country fried steak.  The farmhouse had a tasty bed of potatoes and cubed off the bone ham with 4+ egg scramble then topped with homemade sausage gravy. The lightly hand breaded chicken-fried steak was hardy, a definite piece of steak. The biscuits were fluffy and completed our doggie bag. The price is right, get off the freeway and enjoy.

I used to love Los Betos but after today I don't think I will ever go back.  At least to this location. The location itself is FILTHY, the employees are rude and the guacamole on my rolled tacos literally looked like vomit.  I took one bite of a taquito with just lettuce on it and the lettuce smelled and tasted like it had been washed in toilet water.  I'm not exaggerating.  Needless to say, I spit out my bite, threw my meal away and won't be returning.

We are having a pool and hot tub and fire pit placed. Not a great experience at all. Placed our money down in Jan 14 and they are still working on the pool. They will come out and do something that you paid for and then you won't see them again or hear from them for 3-4 weeks. We have even had one of their contractors place a lien against our house because they failed to make a payment to them. When we do call them, they take a very long time get back to get back to us if at all and when they do, they have nothing but excuses. The people that shot the shockcrete actually were rude to our neighbors, splattered some in their yard and left a mess of trash in our yard. They even parked in their driveway! There is a hole where the pipes are and one of them is broken. They have not fixed it. Now when we run the sprinkler system, it floods and my dogs have taken to swimming in that versus the pool that as of now is still not completed. If you want hard deadlines FORGET it! They will give you dates but don't hold your breath, they will bust it 100% of the time. My neighbors take bets on when it is going to be done and now the HOA is threatening to fine us because the work is not completed as projected when we put in for the permission to have it done. Giving this company one star is generous. Please don't use this company.

I had the Cajun Chicken Sandwhich.  It was delicious, very greasy but I am bad so I like that.  Really enjoyed the server telling us about the sauces, My only complaint was the small portion sizes for the sides of Mac and Cheese otherwise it was enoyable.   They also gave us a very nice bottle of BBQ sauce before we left which I thought was really courtesy.  And the sauce really is yummy.

Not a bad little joint. It is open late - it is actually opened after 11 on weekends. My family and I recently moved to the area and we were looking for a place open late after a long day of unpacking. This was local to Nampa and right off the freeway. The location is easy to access. At 10:40 at night there were still a number of people eating and chatting, so we figured that it was a good sign. 

Our waitress, I wish I had gotten her name... was very friendly and attentive. I ordered the salad bar, which was okay. One main complaint - they didn't have any tomatoes? No tomatoes for a salad? What gives? However, maybe it was because it was late and they were out? What was there was limited, but fresh. I'll take quality over quantity. The rest of the salad bar was kind of like a taco bar with piping hot soups and chili and okay buffet fair. My son had the chicken parmesan and he said it was great. The husband had breakfast - sausage is excellent and their pancakes are tasty. My youngest, a toddler, had fruity pancakes with strawberries and didn't like it. The strawberries are the canned variety and not what we were expecting. 

Overall, we'd probably be back. I think that breakfast bar is probably better than the salad bar, but we will see. No real complaints, prices are average, and food is decent.
We are three people ordering delivery tonight.. It came promptly and was good if not great to eat....

Love how they have extra dough for the littles to play with before supper is ready!! Will be returning of course because of the fact my little can be entertained and not by coloring pictures and shared germ infested crayons!
Excellent food and service, comfortable ambience. I had the jalapeño popper frittata and was blown away - it works! The potatoes are also fabulous - crunchy, meaty diced red potatoes.

Wow!  This is some ridiculously good food.  I was driving by this place on my way to Panera for a little breakfast when I noticed a bunch of cars in the parking lot.  Checking Yelp I found that this place rates well.  Ordered the eggs Benedict and it was out of this world!
Completely blown away by the service and the amazing food.  I have found my go to spot for Asian food here in the Treasure Valley.
Was not very impressed. Service was slow. Food is unique. The beef was tastier than I thought. Not sure this was really my cup of tea so not sure if I am best to evaluative this genre of food.

I always put hot sauce on EVERYTHING! The Smokehouse was so flavorful that when my son passed me my favorite hot sauce, Green Pepper Tabasco Sauce, I politely declined. I didn't want to mess with the splendid blend of flavors that Moe Joes created for me fresh this morning! We are new to the area and have definitely found our new "GoTo" for Breakfast with the family. That's another point! This place is super kid friendly! We have 4 kids under 8 and felt so welcome from the beginning. We will be back!
Casual setting; excellent breakfast. Fresh ingredients & large portions. Customer service is great and the staff is friendly and courteous.

Food is all breading. A half inch thick of breading is not good. Look at the photo of the egg roll. And this is on everything we ordered.  We had breaded shrimp, and when you twisted it like a rag the oil just poured out.   

We ate nothing... My wife took it home and gave it to the dogs... The big dog would not eat. That was first. The little dog had gas for next three days...

People working there are nice. But do not eat the food. This is by far the worse restaurant we have ever eaten at.

When we need to, wouldn't board our pups anywhere else.  Staff very good and realiable.  Also, it's nice to have Intermountain Pet Hospital just next door.

PetLodge also has excellent Grooming services.  We've been coming here for years.   Our 3 pups always feel and look great.   Our  11yr old Great Pyr  LOVES having her "spa" treatment with Gina!  Prices very reasonable.

I live this place!!!! I went there for my birthday last year and they came out with three snowball sized scoops of ice cream with chocolate syrup. It is a little pricey but I think the food makes up for it. Devils spit BBQ sauce= goodness. Ive been to the omaha location and a montana location. I think the boise location has better service and for jonathan d hot food. Their burger are delicious especially dave's favorite burger. Dave's rocks!

AAAAAHHHHHH SNAP!  First review ever I wish I could give more than five stars. 

I likes me my country fried steak (cfs) and eggs - just look at my other reviews. Finding a really good cfs is rare indeed.  Finding an exceptional cfs is like finding a flawless diamond in a coal mine!

Without even the slightest of doubt, this was by far the BEST I've ever had. Golden crisp crust like a really good piece of fried chicken with an exceptional steak center. And no cheap meat here. I could actually make out the strands of meat much like a Yankee pot roast. ABSOLUTELY AWESOME. Everything I'd ever hoped a chicken fried steak could be. 

I might suggest getting the gravy on the side to save that nice crispy crust (as I will next time) and then dip the steak pieces in it. 

Good thing I'm just here on business. If I lived near this place I wouldn't be able to resist.

Had to drop one star based on my meal today. Got the cfs and eggs (duh). My over easy eggs were completely cooked through on the yolks. The salt on the steak and potatoes was EASILY three times more than it needed. Scraped a lot of the breading off the steak and just about sent the potatoes back.  Just ate the larger pieces the could balance out the salt a little better. In short, it was a really bad, disappointing meal.

Consistent quality is not what it was. Instead of looking like a piece of KFC extra crispy chicken, my CFS had a thin layer of flat crust. Very disappointed. Good meat inside though. Again, too much salt. Over easy eggs came with firm yolks. Still good, just not what it use to be.

Among the best pizza I've ever had. The menu prices are a tad high for a pizza place; however, this restaurant is consistent with other Grimaldi's locations as far as good design, layout, menu, and quality food. The main drawback is that some of the servers are rude and act as if the customer is an inconvenience. I am a very low-maintenance diner and I've still felt this way twice at this location.

SALT!!! 

Did I mention salt, good Lord! We ordered spicy orange chicken, pineapple flavored pork, pot stickers and chow mein. I had one bite of chow mein, one bite of pot sticker and one bite if chicken and I threw the rest away. It tasted like they dumped soy sauce over everything and then sprinkled salt on for good measure. Also the pork and chicken were mostly breading and zero flavor without the sauce. Disappointed that there are no good Chinese food restaurants in this area...

Oscar never fails to impress and the variety of vegetarian rolls he can create is endless! Went in on a Saturday night around 8 pm and the place was still relatively busy. Lots of good options to try on the boats (if you eat fish) and if not, definitely ask Oscar to craft a veggie roll for you - you won't be disappointed :)

Really good.  I had the smothered burrito (you can pick any meat and any sauce), it was great.  My husband had the enchilada stacker.  He wasn't as thrilled with his, but I think it was poor choice on his part.  Fast and friendly service.  Be prepared for a line if you get there late.  Will definitely try again!!

Horrible service Horrible drinks from the bar. Waitress failed to bring ordered items and still expected tip...  got more attention from my dogs at home. Waste of time and money won't be going back there again.

The food is pretty mediocre but the service was good so no problem there. It was good but not great. It was very packed in there though so maybe it's just me. The dessert was pretty good though. No problems at all except the strange music selection and how noisy it was. Overall though it was alright.

Every time we eat here it is amazing.  Granted I only ever get one thing... That's not even on the menu.. A steak pancakes, and eggs.  My wife gets one thing too.. the garden frittata she loves it!  One other thing that Is the only thing other than the steak and eggs that I have gotten is the farmhouse.  They use the freshest ingredients and they care about your total customer experience every time you are in the restaurant.  No other breakfast restaurant compares.  You have to try it!!
The food was okay. The waitress did a good job with a party of 25. Not the cleanest place. I'll probably not go back.

How the hell does Dead Robin hit the list of top restaurants in Boise. This place is everything that's wrong with our restaurant scene. The burgers are exactly the same as every chain restaurant in town. 

Burgers are way over priced and entrees taste like they were pre-packaged and dropped off by the Sysco truck: bland, white bread boring food. I refuse to believe that this is one of our top rated restaurants. If it truly is, this is a very sad place.

Very clean and bright environment. Friendly staff. My stylist was Ryan and he did an amazing job right from the beginning. He was very helpful and he knew his stuff! I never once had to ask him to fix anything. I LOVE my hair and he has gained me as a forever customer! 

I have very short, thick, curly/wavy hair and he made it very manageable and fun; he also helped through the steps of how to do my hair too. I highly recommend him for short hair and I'm sure he would do very well with long hair too.

Can't beat their 12-2 lunch buffet special for 7.99 all you can eat pizza and salad. 

Won't eat here any other time cause it can get expensive but a top option for lunch.
Very tasty authentic Italian cuisine! Very nice wait staff. Good food - good service plain & simple!

Don't come here after 9:30pm. Everything was broken done. I would have given them 1/2 star but yelp would not let me. I ordered soup and it never came. I ordered my steak meduim and it was well done!! The hours state you close at 10pm. To me this means everything can be served. While I was eating they asked me to pay the check so they can close down the register. Why don't they say we close at 9:30 instead of 10. Really!!
One of the best chain restaurants for eat-in pizza,   Great salad and pizza combo with great flavors and fresh ingredients.  Service is also very good.  A very well ran restaurant!

This was a really odd one for us.
I ordered a $21.00 plate of pasta and later was advised by our waiter that the restaurant doesn't make any of its own pasta. So I'm confused exactly what I was paying for! If its just "bought in pasta" that they're simply boiling and adding sauce, you'd think my dish would be in the $12-$16 arena, not $21!

We were seated at a table in the thoroughfare of the kitchen and restaurant tables - I don't complain at this as we didn't book in advance - so there was a constant bustling past by the vast amount of staff. It also didn't help that one particular waiter would repeatedly bark orders at other floor staff as he was passing our table, so our meal was constantly interrupted with "cokes on that table" or "they need more bread" and the like.
The owner himself just hovers, it's really uncomfortable. 
He came and apologised for the delay with our food...our food was on our table less than 15 mins after ordering. In a 3/4 full restaurant, I was unsure why he was apologising.
Our waiter I adored, up until 3/4 through our visit, when he became overbearing with the number of visits to our table.....4 in the space of 10 mins + 1 visit by another waiter asking to clear our plates before one of us had finished eating. This was a shame because at least 2 of those visits were from the direction from the owner telling our waiter to come check on us.

The food itself was poor to average. My pasta was dry (some would argue they can't be held accountable for that because they don't make it themselves) and the sauce was a little overbearing.
Both my partner and I spent the evening with heartburn, and my partner had an upset stomach in the night.
I can't compare this to other places in the area, but from an "Italian Restaurant" experience, it was disappointing for the price.

My son and I both had burgers - bbq and mushroom.  Neither of us was impressed, pretty bland and pretty sure it was a frozen patty.  I asked for mustard.  Pretty much any fast food joint has a better burger in my opinion.  Wife had the salad bar which seemed OK.  .  Best part was the banana split which our server initially said wasn't an option.  Service was pretty good.  Sizzler a better option in my opinion.

I have gone here twice, and the place has very nice service. They have good food selections and great topping selections. The store was very clean which is nice, and the staff was excellent. I asked one of the girls on shift for help making my ice cream cone, because the first time I attempted to it, it did not come out well. She did a very good job! Ice cream cones just taste better when they look commercial ready!
Food was wonderful will definitely come back! Would give it a 5 if the patio was smoke free! Please  make the patio smoke free so we can enjoy the beautiful fresh fall air.

You pay for the name and get pretty good food.  Look, it's expensive, in a new, trendy area that probably has sky high leases.  Regardless, the pizza is super good, the service was great, and the restaurant is very welcoming.

We had a small for two and a caprese salad which was plenty for us.  The caprese was fresh and our pizza, with ricotta, was spot on.

Also enjoyed a few glasses of sangria which was nice on such a hot day, just enough sweet with a good wine aftertaste.  

Hope this place sticks around, if you're willing to pay for great pizza, check it out.  Menu is straightforward and they focus on great ingredients and excellent flavor.

Why is this place so popular and busy?  Just for the family atmosphere?  Last time I'll ever go.  I used to like going for the steak fries which used to be hot, crispy, and fresh.  Now chewy and old tasting.  Fish, shrimp, and fries with no tarter sauce(like the photo) and no cocktail sauce which was needed due to the fish having ZERO flavor and the tiny shrimp were overcooked and dry with an awful batter.  Why would they put two large leafs of lettuce on top of the food unless they were trying to hide how bad it was.  Shouldn't you put the shrimp and smear of coleslaw on top of the lettuce leaves?  Also, why do they leave some of the tail and shell on the shrimp with no way of knowing that it's there while covered with the batter?  Must be that everyone loves chewing on shrimp tails and shell.  Could not have been worse.
I decided to get their brisket sandwich at the food-fest downtown today....what a ripoff! There was more bun than meat....the meat was dry too....not worth $7.00!!!! Booo!!!!

Self-serve. 
Over ten flavours. 
Sugar-free options available. 
Labels indicating: fat content (mostly all non-fat), gluten (mostly all gluten-free) and calories per ounce. 
Not all frozen yogurts are created equal, not at all. This ranks a solid 8/9 of 10 in quality of taste. 
After one visit in which I spent the afternoon driving around exploring Eagle....
Me: Honey, I found a frozen yogurt shoppe!
Him: .....I guess we can move here now?
This was a great place for a late breakfast for me and my sisters - mimosas, bloody Mary's, and fantastic food. I had the fiesta hash and it was so good! Definitely going back again.

phenomenal!!!! went there on a super busy night. had Levi as our bartender for a few drinks before we were able to get a table & he was AMAZING!!! We were taken to our table shortly after & had a guy named Cameron as our server. he gave exceptionally good service to us. by far the Best server we've ever had! the food was reasonably priced. no mistakes what so ever! knew what he was talking about 100%. we'll be sure to come back just for those guys! the manager Brad I think his name was, he came over to see how things were going. we told him everything was AMAZING! & that we'll be back because of the amazing service & that he was awesome as well. told us about upcoming promotions that offer amazing deals!!  super nice guy! was on top of everything. if you're looking for amazing food & incredible service go to Carinos in Meridian. you WON'T be disappointed!!!!

I have been patronizing this establishment for years (it's conveniently located to work) and sadly, have seen a significant decline in the quality of food they put out. I love chef Herman but today (Herman's day off), I ordered the Bonzai roll; yellowtail, shrimp and scallop with spicy mayo. No where in the explanation did it say "cucumber roll topped with the throw away garbage pieces of fish which somewhat resembles a seafood salad". I didn't want a cucumber roll. Thank goodness I don't have an allergy to cucumber because the description doesn't even say the roll contains cucumber. To their credit I was offered to return and they would make something else but with a 30 min. lunch, that was not possible. I know good sushi; grew up in So Cal and I know bad sushi. I am regretful that I paid for this, honestly. If I could have returned it for my $$ back I would have.
Service was marginal.  My food was decent but the chicken pot pie was horrible.  I get nauseous just thinking about it.
A very clean store, Fantastic yogurt along with plenty of flavor and topping choices for all! They also don't weigh it, so you won't have to break the bank! Will definitely come back again soon.

Went for lunch today, tried the layered lasagna. It wasn't that great, i just had lasagna at big al's that tasted so much better. The cheese tortelloni were also kind of unimpressive. The positives were the stuffed mushrooms, maybe the best I've ever had- so delicious! Our waitress was above and beyond recommending a wonderful appetizer and providing such friendly and excellent service. She has long brown hair and a tattoo of a heart on her wrist, sorry i do not remember her name.

Knock on wood but this store has always been SO GOOD to me. Every store associate has been helpful and they've ALL helped me at one time or another. I have spent thousands at this store. This evening James helped me find an item that wasn't on shelves, it had just arrived to the back to be restocked and he went and got it for me, a gift for our daughters bday. There's a woman that works customer service, she's always so cheerful, she's studying the medical field, shes often the one to dress up as Geoffrey - she's really cool and super helpful w returns/exchanges. Joy the cashier is always so pleasant, such a joy. And the women in the registry department as well as the men that work at this store, I don't remember all of their names but they all deserve recognition, everyone in this store is great! I LOVE this store and shop there often. If I could give them 7 stars I would.

Love the sauce choices.
Like all the naughty food.
Dislike the "Famous" schtick they do.
Hate the lack of healthier options.

Our "Famous Server" was pretty terrible; Forgot several things, got several items wrong on our order, we had to send things back... but the food was decent. NOT the best BBQ in town, but better than Mickey Rays (blech!). Buffalo wings are in fact NOT true "buffalo" sauce. It's more of a hybrid BBQ-Buffalo. Not impressive.

If you aren't into healthy and want some southern fried naughtiness and Texas toast, and lots of options... this could be your place!

Five stars in the context of the many, many Fred Meyer stores I've shopped at since back in childhood days with my grandparents at "Freddy's" in Portland when this was an Oregon family owned chain to the current time when it is part of the Kroger empire.  This store is only two years old, well stocked, well organized and best of all super friendly and helpful staff.  The biggest surprise was how good is their organic produce section.  Use it or lose it though, that great produce section.  I'm hoping this review might encourage more shoppers to check it out.

PRODUCE
Better than most Fred Meyers for breadth of choice.  They even had organic escarole and curly endive...no kidding.  Even the non organic options were plentiful with local and regional options for fruit and vegetables.  As example, the cherries were from Idaho (and delicious) and the basil was from Gresham, Oregon and the blueberries from a Willamette Valley Oregon grower.  

TRIVIA disgression:  Particularly appropriate for the local Idaho cherries sold here to be so good since the original Fred Meyer (who like my hubby was a native of Brooklyn, NY) started out back in the day selling cherries on the street corners in Brooklyn before moving to Portland, OR to start his retail biz.  How about that fun fact? 

CHEESE
Speciality cheese section is smaller than in other Fred Meyer's.  There were good options from which to choose but if I could wave a magic wand, I'd expand this section. Still we found the burratta we wanted to go with the organic tomatoes and basil.  

OTHER GROCERIES
My hubby and I are not so much commercial brand grocery buyers so on that score we look more to places like Co-Ops or Whole Foods for the organic, smaller brand labels we prefer.  If I were Queen of Decision Making for the FM chain, I'd expand their organic and specialty brand labels in processed foods, like canned tomaotes and frozen veggies and jarred jams and nut butters and even clearning supplies.  Yet, they do carry some organic labels and some regional speciality brands.  For example, they had Moonstruck  (a Portland company) chocolate bars on a great sale. 

HOUSEHOLD ITEMS
For household items like drawer organizers or buckets or hooks or potting soil or...the list goes on...it is hard to beat the all under one roof convenience of Fred Meyer. 

FLORAL
A good selection of fresh flowers and of living plant arranged baskets at super reasonable prices.  Also, they had "candy bar" arrangements in glass vases.  Cute.

SERVICE
The people here make this a good experience.  From coming in the door where we were greeted by a very nice guy named Mike who was handing out food samples to the woman at the cheese counter to the employees who asked "Are you finding what you're looking for?" as we wanted the hardware aisles to check out.  Including the manager who was inspecting produce and to whom I offered  a "helpful hint" for leafy greens and who took my suggestion graciously.  Good service culture is nurtured top down and grows bottom up and both are working here.

THIS N THAT
1) PARKING:  Ample amount in the lot.

2) ACCESSIBILITY:  Level in and throughout with ample aisle space.

3) TWINKIE LIGHTS:  Love the big bramble tree in the entry with LED strings.  Twinkie lights in my mom's vernacular.  They appear elsewhere in the store too.  Nice touch!

Gino's is my favorite restaurant in Boise. Boise doesn't really have any legit 'fine dining' spots, so I call Gino's my favorite restaurant, even though they fired my sister. Boise has had a few really good restaurants in the past- Sogno's, Amore, and, most notably: Desert Sage. Unfortunately, these are all closed now. Gino's is hands down the best Italian in Boise and also the best finer dining place, though Richard's is up there. I've yet to go to Red Feather, but it seems a bit cheasy. I've also heard that The Milky Way is good.

Absolutely fabulous! They catered my aunts surprise 70th birthday and the professionalism and craftsmanship was beyond my expectations!  They catered our event which hosted over 100 people; from the salmon, sapid shrimp, to the yaki soba everyone was satisfied.  If its your first time visiting this restaurant anyone of these dishes will leave you extremely satisfied and confident in your dining choice :-)

I've tried to give this nail salon a few chances and every time I do I regret it. The man who works there it is very rude and not gentle at all. I actually yelped when he tried removing an old set of acrylic nails because he wasn't careful. He doesn't completely remove previous gel polish before adding new and blamed me when I told him his previous application had cracked and chipped within a couple days. He acts as if I'm an inconvenience every time I go in there so I will not be returning. I recommend Glamour Nails down the road if you want friendly techs and good quality manicures.

I have been a long time fan of the location near Boise Town Square.  This location is newly remodeled and so worth checking out.  The sushi chefs are prompt but the best part is the portion of quality fish and presentation are hard to beat in town.  I have been here 5 times in the last month...sashimi deluxe and notable spicy tuna rolls.

A superb Italian restaurant with very reasonable prices.  There is a very large menu.  My favorites are the baked ziti with sausage and mushrooms, and the osso buco.  The stuffed shells are also very good.  The sausage is grilled on a spit and is excellent.  The osso buco is a little pricey, but it is one of the most succulent dishes I have ever had.  This is a small, intimate restaurant, and great for a romantic dinner.

I made the mistake of leaving my dogs here a few years ago. Both of our dogs were very stressed during their stay here and the staff gave our dogs toys to someone elses' dog. After going into the back several times to look for our dogs toys, they said that they couldn't find them. What had really happened, is they gave our dogs toys away and didn't want to admit it, they were trying to save face. When I confronted them about it, one of the staff members picked up a waiver of responsibility of belongings that my wife had apparently signed and started waving it back and forth, saying that they weren't responsible for any lost toys, or belongings. So she and I got into a yelling match, I said a few colorful, choice words and never went back.

My favorite place for fast, authentic-tasting Mexican food. To me, this location has been the best in Boise. The dining experience in the restaurant leaves a little to be desired, so we always take ours to go. The California burrito is excellent and always tastes fresh, the salsa is spicy, and the prices are fair. I'll keep coming back!
Not good! I think it has a trendy hype about it! I sampled many meats--nome were good!

Wow! Just wow! First visit here and will definitely be back. The must order is the Pulled Pork Slider appetizer. Those little gems are amazing and for only $8 you get quite a bit. The atmosphere was quaint, and the wine selection, while small, was fantastic. Coming back multiple times in the near future.
Went in for lunch and the service and food was exceptional as always, thanks to Robert, Karen and the rest of the staff for a great afternoon.

For a small breakfast eatery Mo Joe's sets the mark. I had the chicken fried steak breakfast. I highly recommend it if you are in the mood. My wife had the omelet and was pleased. Servings are good size and at an affordable price.

We love Paramount Animal Care! We have owned dogs for years and we chose them for our Golden Retriever puppy, Lucy. She loves going to the clinic and we have been very satisfied with her medical care and boarding. The staff is amazing, so warm and caring. The veterinarians are so knowledgeable and attentive. They listen to our concerns and make sure that we understand their plan of care. We are SO fortunate to have found such a wonderful place for our pet's care!
Double check your food before eating... Found a long hair in it! Manager handled situation properly... But so grossed out. Don't think I can ever eat there again!
I love this place! Great service and amazing food. Our waiter was on top of things and helped us build our own pizza. They have a great wine selection as well.

Holy crap, great salad in a strip mall. I got the pork salad, like most people recommended, and it was damn tasty. Huge portion in the large too, and I wasn't able to finish it.

I'll be back.

Our daughter turned 6 today and chose Fujiyama for her birthday dinner. The sushi was some of the freshest and tastiest i have experienced and Julie, our server, was such a sweetheart. They played a birthday video over their mounted T.V.s with Sofie's name mentioned, which was so fun!!! They also brought her tempura banana with whipped cream, sprinkles and a candle. I loved everything about this place!!

Definitely the best breakfast place we have been to in the area! The customer service is great, especially from Manager Mary. Everything we have ordered has been fantastic. Their biscuits are the best being nicely crisp on the outside and soft on the inside. The pancakes are fantastic as well! You can tell everything is made from scratch there. Highly suggest this as a breakfast place!

I'm in search of the best pho in Boise, and Mekong Fresh ranks at the top!  Great broth flavor, generous amounts of beef & meatballs and excellent, friendly service.  Need to come back soon to test out again for consistency but great first impression!

Been here once before and wasn't impressed. The food was bland and overpriced. My girlfriend has convinced me to try it again so here we are. Our waiter just came out and said "full disclosure" it will probably take an hour hour for your food. WTF? It doesn't appear to be that busy. Will check back in momentarily. Ok, I'm back. So it wasn't quite an hour......thank god!  Food was pretty good still a little bland for my taste but much better than the last time. My girlfriend loved her Shrimp Maria. James/Dante was very pleasant and we enjoyed his service. Will be back. No need responding Gino. Lol

I had a rental that was getting an interior remodel...  I originally thought I might just replace all the flooring from Home Depot or Lowes but happen to stop in at Great Floors in Meridian and glad I did.  4.5 Stars of my 5 star review goes to Heather Weiss who helped me through the process... Extremely knowledgeable, helpful and fun to work with!  Her recommendations were perfect and she went out of her way (going to the house on her own - twice to measure) knowing I had a tight deadline.  Thank you, Heather!  Overall great selection and price!
Ryan cut my hair today he's amazing! Looks so good I have long hair and came from Portland Oregon where I always got my hair done at Dosha no one has ever done such a great job:) super impressed!!!
Wow!!  What a lucky stop on our rv trip!  Moe Joe's food and service was exceptional.  Their vegetable hash...fantastic!  I give this restaurant a 5+ star rating!

I love coming home to my clean house after Merry Maids has been there.  I trust that they will do a really thorough job each time they are there.  And if I ever do have questions, suggestions or requests they are ready, willing and able to listen and work with my schedule.  They are worth it for sure.  I am never disappointed when Merry Maids cleans my house.

Dr Fineman and his staff love their work and this is reflected by their compassionate care and loving attitudes towards their patients.  I needed a vet to look at my ailing kitty.  We were leaving town for two weeks the next day and she was in dire straits with some type of skin infection.  I called my regular vet and couldn't get in (usually the case).  They recommended contacting Paramount and I'm so glad they did!  I was in Paramount's office two hours later and Dr. Fineman was awesome.  He was very professional, very compassionate and I felt very comfortable putting my kitty in his capable hands.  He offered several options to treat my kitty, and I ended up boarding her with his office to ensure she received her medication and that her condition was improving during my absence.  She looked great when we picked her up two weeks later.  We are happy to have found Dr Fineman, and we will be back.   ]
Food is good but not outstanding. Good service by staff but wait time for food seemed a little long.  Easy access from freeway, walking distance from our hotel

OMG! Best breakfast ever!!! Stuffed burrito with gravy  amazing!!! Moe Joe potatoes unbelievable....you can't eat just one!! Farmhouse with biscuit breakfast crazy good too!!! YOU HAVE TO COME HERE FOR BREAKFAST!!  service is awesome too!!'

This was the 2nd time we went, lat time the place was packed and while the food was good it wasn't "amazing."  This time around there was hardly anybody there so we got a lot of attention from our server.  We had a "meal for two" so the overall price was very good.  The St Louis ribs were excellent, brisket flavorful, corn bread was sweet and slightly crispy on the edges...so just right!  In fact the whole meal was great.  More than enough for even me (a voracious appetite) so we had leftovers.  
The atmosphere is awesome too, very much like a hunter's cottage. Better than Dickies for sure. Overall an excellent value and the food is better now than when they first opened.
I'm mixed with my emotions on this. The caprese salad was nice but the calzone was too full of ricotta and not enough flavor. Pizza was probably a better c
This is the best place to eat in meridian I will definitely miss coming here. My tip is just let them make u a roll and u will love it!!!
Friendly staff that always goes above and beyond! Very fun atmosphere :) I do wish they were open on the days the year around schools were on break too.

For inland sushi, I didn't think it could get much better than Fujiyama in Boise, however Fujiyama in Meridian exceeded my expectations.  Take the incredibly fresh, amazing tasting fish from the Boise location and put it in an upscale, elegant, and ambient setting with granite tabletops, leather booths in warm wood tones, and warm lighting.  The sushi bar is immaculate with a gigantic television that showcased picturesque photos of Japan and peaceful background music, to complete the experience.  
While the surroundings were nice, you can't forget the real reason you choose to dine at Fujiyama, which is the outstanding fish.  I choose sashimi to get the full, fresh, complete ocean-flavored experience in every bite I eat.  The presentation was amazing, complete with a lit ice sculpture of a fish and decorated with flowers, like a work of art. Every bite of each variety of fish was equally as fresh and mouthwatering as the previous, the only thing it leaves you wanting is more fish.  It's hard to describe the freshness and clean tasting fish without sounding redundant, only someone who has experienced truly fresh tasting fish could understand what "clean" tasting is, or perhaps someone who has had really fishy fish, like comparing black and white.
While our server was new, they did a good job.  They were friendly and helpful. Service was prompt and our needs were anticipated and well met, including water glasses that were filled before being emptied.
While Fujiyama Boise is closer to us, and you can't go wrong with the quality of fish at either location, the experience in Meridian surpassed my expectations.

This is also a pet Lodge.  Well we tell Copper it's a spa for dogs and that makes him feel better about getting dropped off.  We forgot to mention while he was there he also gets his shot all up to date. Opps.. Sorry Copper.   Great place for all your pet needs even lodgings.

Our party of five waited 20 minutes for a coveted outside table, worth it to see the hourly fountain show, and watch the evening lights come on in The Village. 
  Our server was attentive, but not overly so. 
  We shared a large house salad, which was better than most- with romaine lettuce, cherry tomatoes, green olive, red onion, roasted sweet red peppers, and mushroom with a vinaigrette dressing. It was enough for everyone to enjoy some. Then the brick oven pizza, which was delicious, hot, and large. The calzone was full of ricotta and delightful Italian sausage. 
 Leave room for dessert. Chocolate cheesecake  was sweet and rich, and the original cheesecake was more lemony, and delicious in a different way. The red berry glaze drizzled on the plate made us want more. Thanks for a nice evening!

The atmosphere at Gino's was very inviting and did offer outside seating. I was part of a large group of 16 and the staff that night were very accomidating. The owner himself made sure we were being taken care while we waited for our table.   Our waiter was very friendly and kept us informed if there were any delays. That night there were two other large parties plus multiple small tables, so a slight delay in drinks was to be expected.

My spouse and I ordered calamari for an appetizer and shared a lasagna.  The lasagna was amazing and pared nicely with the fresh, warm garlic bread and olive oil. We ordered tiramisu for desert and it was by far the best I have ever had.

The experience we had at Gino's was perfect and the location for us is great. We will be back.

I didn't know what to expect coming here, other than yelp. We ordered: kids pancake with bacon, country fried steak, and a breakfast plate (egg and hash browns). 

Everything was amazing! The country fried streak is hand made, not often you see or get that. The kids loved their food. Eggs were perfect and hash browns - all great
This place should be more crowded! Just had a delicious eggs florentine with beautiful berries on the side. For a great price! Service was good too!

We have tried Gino's about 6 times, and I can count 1 good meal, not a great ratio. Went to dinner last night with another couple, and 4 of 4 meals were bad. Fettuccini Alfredo - sauce was bland, chicken way overcooked and rubbery, and it wasn't even fettuccini, it was linguini! The meatball dish was overcooked with rubbery cheese that looked microwaved, and the beef with pasta was so overcooked it wasn't edible. The server did not pick up on the fact that 4 of 4 dishes were half eaten and we're all sitting there with disappointed faces.  We give up, we really tried to like this place, as its so close to our home, but the food quality is so inconsistent that we'll no longer be spending our money there. For what is delivered to the table, its extremely overrated and overpriced.

For those people who have declared a bad time at Rudys Pub and Grill:  If you see the staff running around,  it means they are busy and will get to you first come first serve.  Learn some patience and respect.  For those people who want a big table on a busy night, call and confirm.  You can't be that lazy right?  I love this establishment.  If you disagree go Nic and Nan yourselves.

So let me start with I've been here a few times now and it's normally wonderful. Unfortunately today was the opposite. To begin they're not open until 3. They close at 2. We got there about 1:50 and they were visibly upset that we came in. When I told them Yelp showed hem open until 3 she simply said "yeah, we know". The waitress was so short with us and and the experience very uncomfortable. They were also out of several items (milk, oj, country gravy). Normally we would have just gone somewhere else but they didn't tell us they were out of items until our order had been in for 10-15 minutes and the rest of the parties orders were being cooked. Towards the end 2:45 they staff hovered around the table and started clearing condiments while my mother and father (in 70's) were still eating. The food of course was delicious as always but sadly the experience was terrible for my family. I'd say don't go any later 12:30 if you want to be treated like a customer should.

I am never disappointed when I eat here but I always go for a burger and fries and am happy. The wife and kids are more adventurous and try many different things and the reviews on things are mixed. We have eaten here too many times for me to call out specific entrees but I suggest sticking to a classic burger and fries and you will be happy!

Took a friend there for dinner and drinks. Service was very slow, and the waitress spent more time at the bar talking to other staff than waiting on customers. Took forever to get our drinks and then waited forever to get waited on. We asked for extra Ranch and she forgot. We asked for catsup and she forgot. The sad part is they were not very busy. Usually they are a great place to go, but times are changing.
Love the new location in Meridian! Great food great service! Gino works hard to make every customer happy
We waited 40 minutes for pizza which at best was average, staff was nice but no where to be seen; save your money, go downtown Boise to Guidos for good reasonably priced pizza.

I was able to secure an appointment there on short notice and was greeted warmly by Rae who helped me get the right tires for my car. Jordan assisted me later and could not have been nicer. I decided to make a change to my order, and although they were super busy, everyone was super friendly and accommodating and treated everyone equally kindly. Highly recommend this place and won't take my vehicles anywhere else!

Great place for the family and KIDS that need OPTIONS. 

1. Choose your size of bowl

2. Choose your ice cream

3. Choose your toppings

4. Pay by weight

5. Enjoy

Still one of my favorite burger chains. Service is usually good. Food is pretty predictable with a decent selection and variety.  You can get beef burgers,  veg I burgers, chicken sandwich or salads.  The drinks,  non-alcoholic ones, are bottomless as are the fries.  You can get ranch or fry sauce to help all the fries go down easier. They have a full bar and a decent selection of beer on tap. Red Robin had always been a favorite place for me and my son loves it too. They have a good selection of non-alcoholic specialty drinks which probably helps my son like it, hey how can you not love strawberry lemonade?

Our service was excellent but most of our dishes were unfortunately drowned in cheese. I was not a fan of the minestrone, but I would recommend any of the calzones or the pollo maria with spinach instead of pasta.
Super bland food, tasted good after drenching it in hot sauce otherwise it tasted like air, they're way over priced for the quality food they serve, I wouldn't go back here

Perhaps the worst pizza we've ever had!  Ordered the white sauce with garlic, adding artichokes, mushrooms and spinach.  $24.00 The toppings were sparse and the cheese was thin and rubbery.  Yes,rubbery.  Crust was soggy. Almost inedible.  And no, I'm not having a bad day; an honest review.  We eat out often, this establishment is a big disappointment.  Better places to spend your dinner dollars!

Went here on Yelp reviews and we were really disappointed. Service was horrid- she couldn't remember what we ordered to drink and had to come back again. Then after we were served she never checked in or asked about our meal. Took forever to get our check- after putting our credit card on our table and making it obvious we were finished. And it's not like they were busy. She was just not attentive.

Hubby had the Kobe sliders and said they were mediocre at best. Fries were nothing special either. My chicken pot our was horrid. Thin tactless crust on top of what looked and tasted like congealed chicken fat. My stomach was killing me all afternoon. And the total bill with too was pushing $30- way too pricey for lunch. Would never return.
We eat here once a month or so. The food is good and the price is fair.  There's nothing spectacular about it but it's usually a solid place to go if you want take out

We picked up a pizza on our way home last night. Even after being in the box the crust was crispy and chewy. Fresh ingredients were obviously used and the sausage was not your typical sausage. Great flavor!  Will definitely go back and dine in.

Love this breakfast place!! Best eggs Benedict !! 
The staff is beyond friendly, even with my crazy toddler who loves to drink the creamers, they always came with more, it was our little hidden breakfast place when we first moved here 3 years ago, not really crowded.. now you most likely will be waiting for a table Saturday and Sunday.. anything you order is the bomb do yourself a favor and go!

If your looking for fresh delish sushi you need to come here! The new location off Locust grove and Fairview is amazing. The location has changed from Wingers at one time to a wing stop. To now this, and walking in is beautiful, from the huge Tv screen by  the sushi artist, to the seriously gorge bathroom, they really put some detail in this place! The staff is friendly, we went last night, and I wish I knew our waitress's name.. she was amazing! My kids had their IPads and devises, and she said " put them away" I was ready to hug her! I told them that so did my husband, she was all about manners and giving us extra pointers for what to order the littles. The sweet potato fries are awesome! I'm pretty picky! And I ate most of them! I had spicy tuna rolls, spider roll , yellow fin, all in all you can't beat this place!! It did make me feel like I was in Japan again! Hopefully the food stays just the same! Oh and the little candies at the front counter.. make sure you don't miss them.. watermelon , strawberry.. I thought that they were just cinnamon ones.. nope.. really good after sushi! Make sure to put this on your list of sushi places and Japanese food!!

Way to put up a big ole billboard right in front of my house where you DON'T deliver!  I'm in-between Cloverdale and Five Mile which is like a 0.25 mile dead zone for you guys right between your Milwaukee and Eagle Rd stores. Just extend it by that much.  Please. I'm frickin hangry.
Fun place.  The food is amazing and the atmosphere is always entertaining!  Music, friends and fun!  Thank you Doug and Kris for bringing such a great place to Meridian!

Fantastic Chinese food...been bummed for 12 years that there really is no good Chinese in Boise but no longer! Ordered a bunch of food for the family tonight to go...egg rolls, pot stickers, two kinds of noodles, beef with broccoli and chicken with veggies. Everything was very well prepared, fresh and not greasy at all! Only thing I wasn't personally a fan of was the hot and sour soup...was more sour than hot but I think maybe that's just a personal taste. Will certainly be back...best Chinese food in the treasure valley for sure!

Good Selection. Many toppings. Problem is the cost! You go in thinking you will get a small dessert and next thing you know your walking out less $30 for the small 3 person family you have.  Since when did frozen yogurt get so high on the hip of OVERPRICING people that it costs more than dinner.

Found this place while visiting from Southern California.    I was expecting coffee shop food but was pleasantly surprised. Coffee was great!  Menu has a lot items on it I have never seen. Food was good. Service was good.  Will be going back the next time I'm in town.

I love Los Betos! If U want good & cheap Mexican food, look no further! My 5 year old daughter loves their bean & cheese burrito! It's huge & she can finish it all! I like their carne asada & lengua taco. They have 3 different kinds of salsa; mild, medium & hot. They also have sliced radishes, pickled carrots & jalapeños! Yumm!

Greeted by a friendly host....  the food was ok at most.  I had the special ( scallops ) they were sandy.   The staff were not very friendly for the most part ... there clearly was an issue going on in the back as the older waitress would walk by and she was mumbling some of the issues to herself.  This was my second visit and sadly my last.

Really too bad. Beautiful pub and restaurant. Second visit when its not busy and the wait for drinks and food were horrible.
Older couple came in and the wife was slow walking with a cane. They were sat at the farthest booth from the front. The husband was upset and let the hostess know. They waited and waited, like all of us, and left without eating. They are batted 0 for 2 with us. Probably wont go back. Hard to imagine what it's like when it's actually busy.

We had an excellent breakfast.   First time eating here and we will definitely be back.  Stacy was a very attentive server and anticipated our needs.  I wish I would have taken more food pics.....but we were so hungry that we had to dig in

Never again. I have gone here for years. We ended getting a copy of Mario Maker as a gift and we bought one for ourselves. I went into the store to ask for an exchange, NOT A REFUND of the brand new sealed game. We could not find our receipt but we are club card holders. The cashier found it under the club card and confirmed the purchase. The assistant manager started treating me like a thief and acting very rude to me. I showed them my ID and the girl started the exchange process. The manager then came up to me and said she needed to physically take my ID. I told her this was not needed since the purchase was confirmed and that cashier had already verified it. I also pointed out that it said on the Toys R Us sign that an exchange or refund can be processed with one of the following 1. Govt issued ID, 2.  Receipt 3. Or through the Toys R US Club Card. She told the cashier not to do the exchange for me. I felt very uncomfortable handing my ID over to this power hunger manager. I took the game to a rival electronics store and explained the horrible incident. The manager happily accepted the game into his inventory (even though it probably was not allowed) and gave us a new game. TOYS R US, you lost a life long customer. Store I will not mentioned, you retained a life long customer. I will not mention the store in case it gets that manager in trouble. "No longer a Toys R Us Kid!!"

Welp...I'm always leery of the TRU stores with BRU sections as it tends to reduce a sometimes anemic selection as TRU sort of grapples for its place in the world without the aid of any catering to or acknowledgement of the collecting world. While I am not a collector of toys, per se, sticking to the latest and greatest "hot" toys is notably not working well, with various store closings in all states. This one seems new and it's in a mall selection, which probably guarantees a certain amount of store traffic. It is very clean inside, though layout and selection take a substantial hit. If there was actual competition around, I think this location but it seems like it is standing, for now, on that lack...mileage may vary.

Great food with a lot of depth of flavors! And an excellent wine selection. You will need reservations because a restaurant this good is popular!! The fish is fresh and the pasta cooked to perfection. Don't forget to dip your bread into their signature their  seasoned olive oil (which you can purchase up front if you can't get enough of it during your dining experience)

While looking for a special breakfast place for my birthday, I read about Moe Joe's.  Wow, I am so glad we found this fantastic restaurant.  It was definitely worth the drive from Boise.  We arrived about 10:30 AM on a Friday morning and were surprised to see how busy the place was.  However, we only had to wait about ten minutes for a table.  The menu is extensive and appears to have something for everyone.  I ordered a Smothered Burrito with Green Chili Pork Sauce.  It was fun to have so many different choices on my birthday.  The Burrito was fantastic!  It was so large I could only eat half.  I would definitely recommend it to anyone who likes breakfast burritos.  From the time we walked in the door until we left, the service was amazing.  Mary waited on us and she was a delight.  Friendly, very helpful, and so efficient.  She obviously enjoys her job and treats her customers accordingly.  We will definitely return to Moe Joe's and recommend it to friends.

This is really cool thrift store.  Super clean.  Super organized.  Super cause.  Friendly staff.  LOTS of stuff.  Really surprised with the shoe section.  Whoever does their displays has it together and knows what they are doing.  And no digging.  What I mean by that, is that I didn't have to dig and shuffle through items to find something.  I'm glad to see that Boise residents are respecting this cause and donating to this place.  That says a lot.

I have arranged a party for children here as well as attending when not part of a party.

Fun was had by all.

I mean, it's a venue for nerf warring.  Who doesn't like a good ol' fashioned nerf smackdown?

2 teams, all heavily and nerfily armed and strategically placed boxes to hide behind while positioning yourself to take out the enemy.  

Watch out for the little ones though...those spunky little suckers are fast and they show no mercy (believe me--I've tried...no mercy given).

It's $8.00 an hour for just about the most fun workout you'll ever have.  From 7-11pm on Saturdays they do glow in the dark wars for ages 8 & up for $9/hour.  And, on Fridays they do the same thing from 8-11pm for ages 13+. 

There are referees who have control of things and successfully kept me...ahem...I mean the children...from getting too crazy.

Get to it!

First let me start that this place is neat and clean.  Next our server was Jennifer and she was very attentive to our needs and was an excellent waitress.  The facility was not busy so the kitchen should not have been rushed.

I ordered the Chicken Alfredo with button mushrooms.  Cost $18.00 with the chicken and mushroom add-ons.  I was told by Jennifer that the Alfredo was an excellent specialty of the house.  When the dish arrived it was visually appealing.  That's where the compliments stop.  If it wasn't for the salt and pepper shakers on the table, this Alfredo would have had no flavor.  Period!  The sauce was runny and bland.  The noodles seemed to be of a commercial quality and the taste was far from authentic Italian.  Finally the chicken appeared to have been boiled to cook it.  Zero Flavor is all I can say.  I would never order this dish again.  I told the waitress that I have made Chicken Alfredo using canned sauce that had more flavor than this.

Now to be kind.  My wife ordered the Lasagna.   Even though it is made with ingredients that she is not used to seeing in her Lasagna.  It was delicious.  Now there is a house specialty!  The tomato sauce was fresh tasting and carried an authentic Italian flavor.  I tried a bite and it was obvious that I had ordered the wrong dish.  Oh well!  For the record it still was not the best Lasanga we've ever eaten.  That award goes to The 3D's in Black Eagle, MT.

I am a person that will pay for an expensive meal without complaints.  However, I expect that big buck meal to knock my socks off.  Today that didn't happen.  Also, I don't look for compensation for a poor quality meal.  That makes my reviews accurate and authentic.

This facility was OK, but came up way short of knocking my socks off.  To put it into perspective.  It didn't even get my shoes untied.  I give this review two stars because the service was great and the Lasagna was good.

Now for the record.  I have eaten in hundreds of Italian Restaurant's across America.  Such as Chicago, New York, Los Angeles, Milwaukee, St. Louis, Seattle, Portland, San Diego as well as many small cities.  So I believe that I carry enough experience to critique an Italian Restaurant well.

Sorry we won't be back. There is no need to try it again and be disappointed twice.

Fast, friendly and affordable! Everything on the menu looked delicious! I got The Skinny, two poached eggs, sliced tomato and avocado, wheat toast, and fresh fruit with a side of Moe Joes potatoes. Everything was light and fresh, no flavor was bogged down by overcooking or too much butter. Definitely returning whenever I come back to Boise!

It was fair. Probably won't go back as quality and taste of food nothing to be excited about. Fun atmosphere. Lots of families, a bit louder than we'd like for dinner. Wished we'd been on the outside patio under the heaters.

Horrible employee was rude, insulted my boyfriend and I and hung up on us! When ordering my boyfriend was told on the phone a different price than what the menu said online. After double checking to make sure we had everything right after ordering and things still not adding up we called back. He asked why it was more expensive and the lady told him they were old prices from 2013. When he said you should really update that and unless we pay for the prices listed on the site, cancel the order. She literally told him not to call anymore because he's "too fat" and hung up. Furious,I tried calling, asking for manager and she started telling me if I need to cancel my order there's a fee then cut me off told me not to call anymore and hung up on me as well.The woman insulted us, hung up on us more than once, told us not to call back rather than letting us speak with a manager.

Based on recent reviews, I was expecting the slowish service, and those reviews weren't wrong. We were seated in the front of the restaurant near the doors, and the other people waiting on tables stood against the wall not two feet from us; it was awkward, to say the least.

It was busy, yes, but our server was so rushed she barely even came to a stop when taking our order and checking on us.

As a starter we had the spring rolls. There were three, which would have been fine if they hadn't contained less than half the filling one would expect. 

My husband had the general's chicken, which was by far the best of all of our choices. The sauce was savory and spicy, and the breading was pleasantly crunchy.

I had the kung pao chicken, which left a lot to be desired. While the chicken and mushrooms were delicious, the dried chilies were not rehydrated at all and there were only five measly peanuts in the entire dish. 

My son ordered the pork chow rice, but they clearly forgot it, and he didn't receive it until ten minutes after my and my husband's dishes were brought to the table. When he finally did receive it, it was slim on the meat portion as well as the egg and veggies. It was by far mostly just rice.

After reading the rave reviews and seeing how packed the restaurant was (finding a parking spot took several laps around the building complex), I was hoping for a much better experience. Overall it was a big disappointment.

We got ours meals to take home. Very good food, and we got everything we ordered which has not been the case for the other Chinese restaurants nearby. It's a bit pricey fore the portion sizes,  the only reason I don't give it 5 stars, but that won't keep us away when we wont to pick up something to bring home.

Took my daughter for her birthday dinner. We have been anxiously awaiting the opening of this new sushi place and were not disappointed. Great atmosphere and friendly service. We shared the Maki combo and the Spicy Maki combo. I chose the salad with ginger house dressing. My daughter got the miso soup. My salad was good, I enjoyed the dressing but was sad when I sampled my daughter's soup. It was amazing. Loved it. We were also given a complimentary bowl of edamame. I don't know if that's standard or just a special treat but it was a great surprise. If I had any complaint it would be that I like some sauce on my rolls. That said, I've been places that drown the sushi in sauce to mask bad sushi. Given that option I will take it without. We will definitely be coming back often. Please support great sushi in Meridian. We need it.

Such good food! Coffee is good, they have mimosas! Service is a little slow, but by far, best diner food there is. Lemon poppyseed pancakes are the best, you can't find them anywhere else but there and they're to die for! I highly recommend eating here!
Went to this place for the first time tonight and will definitely be back! Food was delicious, portions were generous, service was great, and the kitchen was really fast.

Very disappointing dinner tonight for many reasons. Ordered soup, came out luke warm. Burger was fair. Fries were cold. Asked for new batch of fries, told it would take 4 mins for fries to be ready -10 mins later we told them to cancel the request. Server was busy but forgot to provide good service - drinks went dry. Worst part was seeing the cooks cleaning the equipment with food sitting on the line. The cleaning spray was falling on the food. The cook was standing on something and every time he bent over we saw a typical plumbers butt crack. My wife spoke to the manager to explain everything about the cleaning solution and the butt crack - all she did was laugh about it. Very unprofessional. Will not return. Too many choices in the Treasure Valley to accept poor service and poor food.

My wife and I celebrated her 65 B Day(a significant milestone).  The hostess was charming and seated us immediately by the window adj. the patio.  The busboy was right there with the water and bread. Our server was Eric-probably the.best I've ever had. Very knowledgeable about the wine. We had the Gino's mushroom and chuck roast over your choice of 5 pastas. The best I've had. Gino paid his respects and the rest of the meal was stellar. Finished with the Cream Brule & excellent coffee. We'll be back.

We tried Gino's based on a friend's recommendation & weren't disappointed. It was delicious! The wait staff were friendly & available when we needed them. Gino even came out to make sure our meal was how we wanted it. My only disappointment was that they'd run out of the item I wanted to order - after the waiter described it in detail. 
It's a little spendy but not too bad for a nice night out. I can't wait to go again!
Always clean place to eat and the food is fresh.  I like the nachos and quesadilla since they are less popular

This is a first... me, giving a high rating to an insurance company.  But these folks are wonderful to work with.  My husband needed an emergency surgery in April in Idaho Falls, and Blue Cross of Idaho was so efficient in their immediate billing/paying/postings, that we are already done in the accounting of his surgery.  This is amazing as I have had things draw out for months in previous instances where the services people (doctor, hospital, etc.) cannot get the insurance company to respond or pay, so they bill us again and again.  Not this time!  Done and done.  Since the Obamacare debacle started, I was leery in approaching any medical needs, but I am feeling very well taken care of at this point and plan to continue with this company.  Our local broker, The Bowen Group (in Idaho Falls), helped us choose a company, and I couldn't be happier with the results.

Your typical mission style burrito restaurant, but they do have some interesting options and it's all pretty good. My favorite so far is the sweet pork nachos. Ooooh they are gooood.

This is a great place for a quick lunch and a Mexican fix. The only down point is the noise. They have a lot of reflective surfaces and it gets loud fast. This doesn't out way the food though.

This is good for lunch & I have a routine lunch meeting here with about 10 people; they have a varied selection for many tastes and they're all pretty good.  It is a little too loud to have business meetings though.  I've also been in the evening with large groups and it's generally pretty easy to get a table / tables for 10 people and they have an adequate beer selection (although Brewforia down the street has the best beer selection in the Treasure Valley).  But, beware, the parking lot at Rudy's is not adequate and it gets very crowded in the evenings and hard to find a parking spot.

Traveling from Arizona to Vancouver, BC we stopped in Nampa for the evening. After searching for a non chain restaurant we settled on Gino's. We were not disappointed. Fun atmosphere and very clean. Food was good and the service friendly and efficient. If we stop in the area again we would definitely return.

What a great place! Not a place I would have discovered on my own. The front of the restaurant doesn't face Overland so it's easily missed. The wait time was a little long, but it was Sunday morning and we expected it. We had about a 45 minute wait and it was late morning. The food was great. Huge portions. The service was fantastic. We will be back.

Don't go to this location if you need a quick cup of coffee. We arrived at 6:21 am on March 8th and were behind two cars. It took six minutes to get the first car out. The attendant (scruffy face backward hat guy) took what looked like a quart of milk from the second car. Then began to chat for a few minutes. We could hear another employee on the back enclosed area talking on the phone. The attendant never stopped chatting with the driver and waited to take his money when the coffee was ready. We waited eleven minutes total to get to the window. We observed the employee that was on the phone go back into the shop to work. 
This location doesn't care about costumer service. They have a constant supply of people and could care less if you have a good experience. It's great to say hello and ask how's you morning but don't stand and chat for  eleven minutes and not move the line along. Fire the crew and start over.
Great family bonding i had a great time with my family my kiddos always tell there friends about this place

Good food happy atmosphere. We had the daily special and enjoyed it however the meat portions were pretty small compared to the salad portion. One of the employees came to our table a little too often for my preference and he looked over us rather than at us when he asked if everything was ok.

I have time to kill before a late flight back home and decided to drive off to find d something delicious for breakfast. Moe Joe's hits the spot perfectly. 

Walking in, it's a nice restaurant with a good mix of the old and new. The place looks fantastic all around. It's seat yourself, but they're waiting to bring you a menu and take a drink order right away, ask how you're doing, and other small chit chat. 

The house coffee is good. No cream or sugar gives a nice bite, but nothing too severe. A good medium blend overall.

The food, that's where it all becomes clear as to why this place has good reviews. The smokehouse is a fantastic mix of flavors. Two eggs placed on top of a hearty bed of potatoes, kielbasa and onions, topped with an interestingly flavored house sauce drizzled across the top. Everything inside complements each other nicely. The kielbasa adds a nice smoked flavor to everything and is perfectly cooked. The potatoes taste like they had been pan fried as a whole potato, then cut up and pan fried yet again. Absolutely fantastic crunch to the skins, but a perfect potato otherwise. Nothing was overdone or under done. The French toast on the side was 2 full slices of French toast cooked to perfection. Just the right amount of everything in their batter. Not too much or too little egg or cinnamon flavor makes this some of the best French toast I've ever had. 

The server was fantastic. Unfortunately, I didn't catch her name, but she was spot on the whole way through. Coffee refills whenever needed, water brought with it right out of the gate. Then she offered coffee to go as well, which made this place absolutely perfect. 

I'd recommend this place if you're looking for a perfectly done breakfast. They do breakfast and do it in a fantastic way. I look forward to my next visit here, whenever that might be. 

Total out the door, minus tip, $15.35 for the smokehouse with a coffee. Not terrible by any means and worth every penny.

The only reason I'm giving a 1 Star is due to the customer service at the front desk. When arriving to the location we had a party of 2. We waited 20 mins and found out 2 of our friends were coming as well. I talked with the front desk lady asi i think is her name. She said it would be perfectly fine only one table is a two person table the rest of them are 4 person tables. We waited additional 25 mins after that and are full party was not there yet they were 3 mins away. She had told me it is their policy that the full party has to be there when sitting down. We did get in an argument about the situation she basically told me off and ended are conversation with you can speak with my supervisor. I cut it off there. After are conversation the next people in line get are table she sat them down and they only had a party of 2 at the 4 person table that we were suppose to get. This is the worst customer services i have ever seen. And the way the hostess treated was fully disrespectful. I just can't believe this. Moe joes has lost a customer due to this situation.

They are the best italian restaraunt in the entire treasure valley... Chicken parmesana, Chicken Alfredo... Jenifer is the most wonderful Hostess you will ever meet.. 8 thumbs up... thats right 8 thumbs up......

In general I don't care for scrambled eggs or breakfast burritos...ever. So when my husband said everyone at his office raved about Los Betos breakfast burritos it didn't interest me at all.  But the next day he went there & brought 5 different breakfast burritos home, cut them each in half, and put them  on display on our counter. They looked and smelled good so I tried the bacon one. It was great! Then I tried the sausage one, the breakfast one, & the chorizo one. They were all yummy & jam-packed with flavor! We've now had them all many times & get a bunch whenever we have weekend guests! I never thought I'd EVER like breakfast burritos but Los Betos makes incredible ones!!
PS The chorizo ones are our fav with bacon as a close second!! :)

I had a terrible day and my friend and I drove to Rudy's to blow off some steam. We got a waitress named Dani and she made everything great again. Dani was first class all the way. She made sure our drinks were always full, and made sure our food was correct. My kid was sad because she thought Santa was gone for the year and Dani even played along to let her know that Santa was always watching and he'll be back next year. Dani gets 5 stars and Rudy's was great.

Good pizza but was very surprised at the $85.00 price for a small and a large with normal toppings.  Yes, we had 1 glass of wine , two beers and 2 sodas but the toppings (onions, peppers and olives on the large and bacon and chicken on the small) was a bit much.
I got food poisoning here on Thursday. The health department was closed for Veterans Day but I will be reporting them on Monday.

Fresh and appealing! Astonishing customer service! Wait is worth it! I got 2 different smoothies and the Skier bowl. The flavors were amazing and the staff was so helpful at explaining the menu and all the options
Great food, service, and prices. Busy night, but we were taken care of right away. We will be back again and again!

Amazing!

Being an Italian born American citizen, Gino's is as authentic as it gets. 

Truly a special dining out experience

If you want an authentic Italian food experience, Gino's is the place for you!

If I can give them a negative star for their service, I would. My family and I went in for dinner tonight. Our server name was Nicole. We had to repeat out drink orders a few times to her when majority of us were having water. We asked for a different server after she made a rude comment to one of my family member. Throughout the course of dinner, when Nicole walked by she was giving us dirty looks. When we were about to leave, she made a nasty look, sticking her tongue out and flipping us off.  At that point, it was a last straw. I went back in and spoke with Nicole. I told her that she needs to apologize and that this is unacceptable behavior for a server. She then uses profanity and calling one of my family member a B**ch. I told her that she is a server and we are the customers and you shouldn't talk to your customer like this. She then proceeds to tell us that she is not here to serve us and that she didn't need this job. I asked to speak with a manager. I told the manager wheat had happened and keeps apologizing to us. I told the manager that Nicole owes us an apology. The manager went in and talked with Nicole supposedly because the manager told us that she just quit and left. So, we left it at that. Since our car was parked right out front, we were able to see inside the restaurant. Just as we were about to leave the parking lot. We see Nicole still serving!!! So the manager lied to us so that they don't have to handle the situation anymore. Please if anyone goes to this place, avoid Nicole as a server.

So good! Huge portions and all fresh made and really good coffee too. The Irish Benedict was amazing and I haven't had anything I didn't like. Like all great breakfast spots, it gets busy on the weekend so expect a wait if you come in during peak times.

When we arrived at Red Pavilion, our call-in order hadn't actually been processed, so we had to wait another what they referred to as "only 5 minutes" once we arrived and found out that our order hadn't even been started  -- though the wait was actually approximately 15-20 minutes. On top of this, we still received our order WITH onions instead of without like we had requested -- TWICE.

We really wanted to like this place since it is located so close to our house, but we were extremely disappointed with the service. It may have been better if we would have been given a discount or something extra for the unorganized and slow service that we were forced to deal with, but unfortunately we were refused that even after we politely requested it. 

With all of the other restaurant options available nearby, my wife and I sadly have no reason to return to this establishment.

Absolutely the worst service I've had in a long time. For such an upscale restaurant the service was terrible. Asked for bread 3 times finally asked a different waiter finally got some. They brought our salads said they'd bring fresh cracked pepper and parmesan never did salad wasn't very good at least they took it off the bill.
