Wasn't busy at all but took 30+ minutes to get our food then when our meal arrived I asked for fresh pepper again I never got it so we will most definitely not be back

Great food - had General Tsao chicken, Mongolian beef, and gluten free orange chicken.  They were super accommodating to our youngest who needs to be gluten free and any menu item can be made this way.  We also had pork and seeds for an appetizer.  All delicious with good portions.  We did upgrade to the fried rice which was great.  Will definitely return.

Food and service are all pretty good but unfortunately the patio is the "smoking section" for this establishment. Sitting on the patio in summer is a great way to take in some fresh air while having a drink but that's pretty much impossible at this place. So disappointing because if it were not for that I would head back over and over.

Waste of time which is sad because the Shige downtown has been fairly decent for a number of years...limited "express" selection and somehow I ended up being charged $8 for a glass of boxed wine.  Will NOT be back!!

Good service. Wonderful food. Fair pricing. I showed up last weekend with a group of 9 including 5 kids. They were more than accommodating  on a busy Saturday. I really enjoyed the fresh chili component that they've added to several of their offerings.  The house made corned beef was also awesome in each dish it came with.The lemon poppy seed pancakes were a hit with the kids and the huckleberry? or whateverberry house jam was a nice touch. If you're staying at one of the Marriots  right around the corner, coming here is a no-brainer.  I'd like to go back and try a couple of their sandwiches....

UPDATE 1/20/18:

It's been a few months since my original review and we've eaten here a few times, so I have some new observations. On the positive side, delivery is super fast. Once it took them less than 15 minutes to deliver and the food was piping hot. Usually it takes around 20 minutes. Couldn't ask for better service. 

And now for a negative. Don't even think about ordering the pot stickers. They are revolting. They aren't made with wonton wrappers, but instead a kind of thick dough, and they are deep fried. The result is a very large, gummy, chewy, dry dumpling with a flavorless filling, and a sauce that is EXTREMELY salty. I happen to like my food salty, but this was too much even for me. Skip these and have an egg roll.

I can't seem to get them to make anything truly spicy. For example, if you order Spicy Orange Chicken, it's just Orange Chicken with a tiny bit of chili paste stirred into the same florescent orange sauce. No heat.

Overall though, we still order delivery from here because it's fast, cheap, and filling.

ORIGINAL REVIEW:

Looking for cheap, tasty, strip-mall Chinese food? Look no further!

Pros: This place is really clean and quiet. You could eat off the floors (but I wouldn't.) I saw the waitress cleaning the tables and the entire booth with sanitizer, so that's great. The lunch portion is large, at least as much as you expect from dinner, and the cost is quite low, at around $7 for three items. The egg roll is HUGE, easily shareable. I can usually eat most of my plate but I had over half the meal leftover. Easily worth the money. They deliver! Awesome.

Cons: I had to salt EVERYTHING...twice. And with salt, it tastes pretty darned good. But that really should be done in the kitchen. The spicy orange chicken was not spicy at all, but it was properly cooked and not dry or rubbery. Overall the food was piping hot but just on the bland side.

Bottom line: It was a decent, cheap lunch and I'd eat here again...if Qwik Wok was closed.

I love breakfast and I am always willing to try a new breakfast place. This was worth the wait on a busy Sunday morning after church.  The restaurant is clean, the staff is awesome and the food-wow!  I had the garden hash and it was stuffed full of great veggies, deliciously prepared-not too raw, not too wilty with perfectly poached eggs.  My husband had the Basque hash and it had really great heat to it-yum!  Both breakfasts were wonderfully seasoned! Their menu has a good variety of choices. We just moved to the area and I can honestly say I am happy to find so many great breakfast places to choose from.  Moe Joe's has hit our list for a place to return to.

Yummy food. Super fresh. Gluten free options. They easily customized a fresh fruit bowl for me.  We both had the Kayaker rice and veggie bowl which was very flavorful.  My husband enjoyed the lentil soup. I liked the gluten free fruit bread.  

Wish we had one new me!

I've been here four times now and gotten the farmer's scramble three times. It was excellent all three times. Full of flavor, nice and hot and consistent. What more could you ask for? I love this place. So inexpensive and so delicious.

Always shop here.  Wish they kept up fresh fruit and veggies more and maybe widened the organic stuff.    They get picked over fast and run out of veggies but, they will always look if they are stocking and you ask.   Always friendly customer service.

We are aspire members with candlewood and have been coming here for over three years. We booked a room earlier in the day on the 27th understandable that it was Memorial Day weekend and was grateful we got a room . We arrived late last night and was exhausted from traveling and the gal at the front desk said oh sorry we cancelled your room we are over booked . With credit to her we hadn't updated our phone number so she couldn't call and tell us. We sat in the parking lot and called IHG to try and find us another hotel and they told us candlewood still had a room available . In which my husband John told them well we are in the parking lot and the gal said no sorry we have nothing . We knew she was lying to us at the front desk and preferred cash paying customers for the weekend. We are so disappointed that we will not be back. So to all you aspire members don't try to come here when they have a holiday where they can make a buck . Too bad they are losing business from us in which they can make thousands of dollars from staying extended time.
love this place, good bbq, great staff, and love the kitchy kind of retro camping theme.

Best NY style pizza.  Great service and enjoyed the patio seating. Loved their caprese salad.  Large enough to share with 2-3 other people.  Calzones are excellent and extremely large.  Very nice wine selection.  We will definitely be back soon!

Love black rock , the seating is nice the pastries are good and the coffee is always amazing! The only things that bothered me when I was there for about an hour or two is the blaring music and the flies. I know you can't do much about the flies but the loud music made it hard to talk with the person I was with.

My family has come here a couple times before and it was meh - meh food, meh service, meh drinks. My husband was craving a burger so we thought we'd try it out one more time. Soo glad we did!!!! 
Morgan was extremely overwhelmed with the later rush of customers so her boyfriend, can't remember that man's name to save my life [if you read this I'm super sorry!!], helped her out. Immediately grabbed our drink orders and took less than 60 seconds to get them to us. After he dropped them off offered to grab our kids' order and our appetizer order. Kids came out pretty fast but our apps took a while - they were busy and he was honest it was taking a while because the cooks got busy really fast. Understandable, it happens! Apps came out - loved the pulled pork and chips. Pretzels were a bit over salty but it happens - I can brush salt off. Food came out for my husband and I and WOW!!! SO GOOD!! Fries were hot, burgers were delicious and perfectly cooked. Morgan stopped by a couple times to make sure we were okay - which we were. After we ate boyfriend came and socialized for a bit. Overall I would give 7 stars if we could. We'll always ask for them when we come back!!! THANKS YALL!!!!

I used to eat here a lot.  The food is major comfort good but really rich stuff, heartland style.  The Moe Joe potatoes are large cubed fried.   Hollandaise and gravy abounds and it smells like hash heaven in there.

It also has proper wait staff.  None of that downtown froufrou pour your own coffee and drink BS here.  The coffee is not gourmet but solid and dependable. Waitresses are cordial without being obtrusive.

Formal dress is optional.  Also rare.

So come on down when you can accommodate the calorie load.  Just consider skipping lunch and dinner if trying to fit into a smaller size.

I stopped by the other day with my daughter.  She ordered an iced Breve' - she said it was 'ok' but not great.  I always order a straight double-espresso to test a new coffee shop. I don't want to sound mean, but it was one of the worse shots of espresso I have had in a long time. It was very bitter and over extracted.  The open atmosphere was a little too loud for a quiet conversation.  They are still new so I will give them another try - maybe a black coffee next time?

Let me say first that we typically love the food and service at Gino's. Two weeks or so ago we made a reservation for a graduation dinner, party of 10. We could sit inside or outside.  We love the patio area, and when I asked for a table outside they went ahead and booked us. Today, during my husband's graduation luncheon, I received a phone call from Gino's. She said she just wanted to let us know that if it's raining, they don't have a table for our party. Uhhhhh..... what?! She said the patio cover is not solid, and if it were to thunderstorm they would not have a table to seat us inside. She asked if we could come at a different time, the answer being "no" (isn't that why you reserve a specific time?!) I asked, "So if we get there and it's raining, we just have to leave and find somewhere else to eat?" (With two little ones in tow...) Her answer, "Yeah, probably." My husband called them back and said they would do nothing else for us, and the manager was not in for him to speak with. We ended up canceling the reservation and, thankfully, another local restaurant in Nampa moved some things around for us.

I'm absolutely sick to my stomach over this. It was supposed to be a special occasion, and a lovely day, and instead the employee left us stressing for an hour (until we found another restaurant to take us) about whether or not we would be taking our family out for a nice meal. I'm beyond pissed. As amazing as the food is here, I can't say I'll be going back. If your patio seating depends solely on weather, then DON'T TAKE PATIO RESERVATIONS. Plain and simple. In my opinion, Gino's should have handled this differently from the very beginning.

Had a regular sized salad, half chicken half veggies. Overall total came to 8.50. For the price and the size I would honestly not recommend. Granted I didn't get the signature sweet pork smothered burrito that Costa Vida is famous for. But for the light eaters that still want to go out with their pals, the quality was good enough. Staff was friendly, dining room clean. Baller ass shit

I called four days in advance to cancel a reservation and was told that was fine and to wait three days for a credit card refund. After a week I started calling to find out about my refund and was told everyday that they would have to "look into it" and "research it". I could tell they were putting me off and so got our credit card co. involved and finally got our deposit refunded.
Delicious! Best biscuits and gravy I have found in the valley...and reasonably priced!

This was my first visit to Intermountain Pet Hospital. I saw Dr. Wick and his 2 assistants.
I would only wish that people in business here would be as wonderful as Dr. Wick, Sheryl and
the other girl (can not remember her name). He took almost an hour looking at our "child" and explaining in detail exactly what was happening. He explained it so that the "lay" person (me)
could understand it all. They were all very gentle with our pet and may I add understanding.
Dr. Wick did not push anything and takes into consideration your finances. In my life I have been to one other vet who was exactly like Dr. Wick. Dr. Wick is pleasant to talk with and so is his staff. I would highly recommend Intermountain Pet Hospital. Dr. Wick and his staff removed all the fears I felt about taking our girl to a veterinarian. What a great feeling to know he did not put me under pressure to do "this" or else. I was free to make my own decision.

Shige is a hole. BUT if you can get past the occasional boat blockage, the Bob Marley music and the long 1 hr commitment, you'll be back. They make some great tasting plates, but they're pretty far and few in between and you just gotta sit back, relax (again...the music) and relish all of the subtle pleasures Shige has to offer. There's just something about building a nice and thick, potent wasabi concoction as endless plates of sushi drift by that gets me excited. Maybe I'm weird.
Hands down the best pizza I have ever had! Every time I have visitors from out of state it is a MUST we order some IPC!!!!!

Delious food and the service was excellent.  Can't wait to take my daughter out to eat there.

Update: went to lunch just recently with a couple of girlfriends. The service was okay they were on the ball but the food was not hot. It just seems that once a businesses is running  for over a year sometimes they don't stay on top of things like they should.

Very nice place.   Bit small so expect to wait on busy days.  Friendly staff and great variety of breakfast foods. Good house coffee as well.   Moe Joe potatoes are really good but a bit on the salty side if you are on a low sodium diet.

We vacillated about whether to rate this a 3 or 4. The restaurant was clean, the food was fast and hot, and we had very good service. We did not try the coffee. There was a twenty-thirty minute wait for two people on a Saturday am. My husband had the biscuits and gravy. The gravy was flavorful and not too salty, the biscuits appear to be baked in a sheet pan and cut in squares. While we have no problem with using that technique we really felt like the biscuit was more cakey than biscuit like. I had the half order of eggs Benedict. The egg was cooked perfectly just like on a cooking show really. The meat and sauce were both good but it could have used a bit more of both on the English muffin. Additionally my husband ordered two over east eggs, the waitress kindly informed us on how they cooked their eggs and my husband changed his order to over medium. They were cooked just perfectly!

My wife is Japanese and if she says Asian food is good, it's usually fresh, well made and authentic. Mekong Fresh was all three. We absolutely enjoyed our meal there and honestly can say this is one of Meridian's best restaurants.

I had a "Vietnamese pancake", which is basically a breaded egg mixture cooked clamshell fashion over different seafood and meats. It included lots of fresh veges and was stunningly good. As a side, it included a mildly spicy rice soup. I could have eaten just that as a meal. 

My wife had a Thai dish that I can quite remember the name of, but they called it common street food. Basically, a spicy meat and vege dish with a cooked egg on top. It was very good. 

Having lived in Taipei and Japan myself, this restaurants really reminds me of some of the authentic tastes. They have fusion and Americanized food if you want it, but if you're looking for authentic, Asian food, this is the place.
Best one ever! Used to like big daddy's - This is my new FAVORITE - as far as Idaho goes anyway.  Try it!

I tried this place for the first time Monday night- getting the chicken chimichanga.  I liked it so much I had to get another one today (Wednesday).  For some reason, the chicken inside tastes a bit different today (different cook?  It's been sitting out longer?) but still very yummy.  I have been looking for something similar to authentic Mexican for some time and hate having to drive to Kuna to get a good chimi-fix.  Glad I found this place.  If the chicken quality/taste had been the same, I'd have given it 5 stars.
My new favorite breakfast spot. Delicious food every time, and fantastic service.
The bacon tomato benedict was fantastic and the mo joes potatoes were delicious. What a fantastic sunday brunch. Great service, too. Worth the wait!!
This is the best sandwich in Boise. They are always consistent and incredibly fast. I love the Vito w/ mayo and light Italian dressing. My kids really like it too.
I had the luau and sweet pork. Both had a very weird smell and taste. I mentioned it and they remade my bowl. It was just as bad. Definitely would not recommend.
Best blta sandwich I have ever had the bacon here is amazing. Wait staff was super nice and food was out quick

My daughter's birthday party was a positive experience. The website party sign up did was not functional. However, we were able to call and arrange the party. The were able to accommodate a big party just over 20 kids. The sign up and the briefing before the game was a bit slow to start. Once the game time started every party guest and particularly the birthday girl had tons of fun. After the play time the staff had already arrange the water bottles and plates for the birthday cupcakes. Overall, everyone had a great time. I recommend this location for  birthday parties or just for a rainy day.

This place never disappoints us! Whenever the kids have friends over for a sleepover we always go here. Everyone loves sticky fingers and wings. We also get the cheese and bacon fries. I wish they had potato skins. By far the best place for bone in and boneless wings!

Here is an update on 8/31/2018

This place used to have a 5 star rating like I wrote above. We had an AWFUL time tonight and my family will not be returning. I ordered a sticky finger all you can eat dinner and asked to add a house salad on because my son would eat it. The waitress told me we would have to pay for another meal because he could not eat my side salad. My son ordered the kids chicken strips and we asked that the chicken be tossed in amazing sauce. My husband ordered a sticky finger meal all you can eat as well. They brought me out 6 chicken wings with celery and my salad. No fries! My husband asked why I didn't get fries and she told us because if you get a side salad you don't get fries. I ordered a house salad to be added on to my meal!!! My son got chicken fingers not tossed in amazing sauce. (S not that back and waited 15 minutes for his meal) My husband got 3 sticky fingers and fries. That's right 3. I told the waitress I wanted sticky fingers and 20 minutes later she brings me a plate with 2 small sticky fingers. I ate those and my husband soon got 2 more and she said she would bring us more. 25 minutes later she brings my husband 2 more and asked if I wanted another order. I asked for more 25 minutes ago. At that point I told her no I'm done. So I ate 3 chicken wings that were brought out by mistake because I was starving. After an hour and a half we were done and starving. I asked for a box for the other 3 wings and she told me because we had the all you can eat I can't take them home. I was floored I paid all you can eat for
2 sticky fingers and 3 wings. By this point we paid our $54.00 bill for an awful dinner and  drinks that took her 10 minutes to refill because we asked for a refill. Good service is actually being served and this was not that at all. I have never been treated like we were an inconvenience until tonight by a restaurant. If you plan on going to this restaurant and want the all you can eat sticky fingers or wings prepare to stay all darn day so you can actually eat. Don't waste your time.

I went on Saturday night and, as the concept is still relatively new to W. Boise/Meridian, it was extremely busy. I recommend going during off peak times because it can be difficult to get a seat. Despite the crowds, U-Swirl is a great little yogurt place. I'm a big fan of anything covered in or flavored with dulce de leche and they've nailed it. As for the other flavors - they're all pretty good. I've tried about half of them in my three visits. As far as price goes, I think you get what you pay for however, it's not a bad idea to share. One cup can easily satisfy two people.

Stopped by on their second day open. 

Good things:  friendly staff, prices seemed reasonable, not an overly large menu. Is a very cool space with reclaimed wood on the walls and metal/wood furniture. Also give them props for using local bakery Gaston's for the bagels and the day we were there they had local food truck "Waffle me up" in the parking lot. Has a Drive thru if you're in a hurry. 

Not so good things:  the coffee really wasn't great. It was ok. I usually get an Americano when I go out for coffee, and that's what I had here. My husband had the drip coffee.  Was not as rich tasting as I like   - maybe it's a lighter roast or something. (I prefer Java Coffee house or Dawson Taylor drip). Did not try any of the latte/mocha drinks so cannot comment on those.

The price was the biggest reason for the low rating. I have tried a few of the other fro yo places around town, but we ended up paying twice as much as what we've ever paid at any of the others for barely any yogurt at all. There was also no magic shell, adding insult to injury. I'll say my favorite flavor was pistachio, but not worth what they are charging, as everything else tasted like all the other places, and the toppings weren't much different either.
I love their food. I have tried several different things and they all are delicious. My favorite is the pork salad. I love that the staff is always friendly and upbeat.
My brother and his wife love this place.  Its a great sports bar.  Lots of Big TV's, cold beer, new place etc etc.

Breakfast was really good here! Big, fresh and quick! Food came out hot and plenty of coffee with my cream. 

The bill topped it all off! If you're looking for good food at a fair price, this is it. 

As a frequent traveler to this area, I will come back!

The place is not open or even available for patrons.
The store is loaded with equipment and tools. Not sure if it's being renovated or going out of business.? But whatever the case, the owners should update the status, so people aren't wasting their time driving to a place that is not open for business.

My family has been coming here for a while now and we have had a fun time each time. (Mainly the kids). Went there last month for a birthday party and brought cupcakes for the kids and one of the girls up front at the front desk knew about em and gave us the ok, cool. Went there again last night (oct 26th) and did the same thing, again girl up front said it was ok. Everything was going good until I guess she was the manager came over and talked to us about the cupcakes. (We weren't eating them and was waiting to hand them out when we were getting ready to leave) and the manager I guess went off and was telling us rudely that we needed to rent the party room for an extra 75.00 because there is no carpet in there and the carpet out in the room we were sitting in was "too hard" to clean, and then walked off. Now mind you when all this has been said there were other people in the same area as us and it was a little embarrassing and UNPROFESSIONAL to do so. If she had pulled one of us to the side or a different area and explained it then, it probably would have been a little better. So now we won't ever be going back for anything. Like I said it was a little embarrassing and unprofessional, that's not how you run a business, it's bullshit. I don't know who the owner is but who ever it is needs to talk to his/her employees.
Food is fresh and good tasting. Really like the salads and tacos.  I would like to try more items but afraid to go too far astray from the salads

The restaurant had a nice ambiance. We were promptly greeted and seated within a few a minutes. Our party consisted of 3 adults and 2 children (10 &12). The waitress was very kind and asked us for our drink orders as soon as we sat down. We were given delicious bread with an infused oil. This was the most flavorful food we had during our dinner. We ordered a pepperoni pizza, fettuccine Alfredo with chicken, shrimp Maria, ravioli, and a meat lasagna. All the food lacked flavor.  I believe it needed a more robust flavor because the foods all tasted very bland. The waitress, hostess and host were all very attentive checking up on us making sure our water was never empty. Unfortunately we were a bit disappointed.

First they took away the "burgers and greens" salad,  NOW the Bonzi salad.  We come here,  yup, for the salads and those were yummy!!! Hate getting to love items and then they take them off the menu!! What's with that? Still have the same burgers though.  Writing corporate!!! Hate this,  won't be back

I recently got a Village gift card so I decided I wanted to try out a restaurant there. I convinced my boyfriend to come here due to the fact of my love for pizza. 

We got seated immediately, the waitress explained the menu to us, which was nice. She came back to take our order, and we only saw her two times after that. The first time: when she brought us our bill which was also the first time she filled up our waters. The second time: to bring our card back and end the night. While all of the other waiters were keeping up with their tables, she just stood around most of the time. 

The pizza was not bad. I'm used to eating Papa Murphy, Idaho Pizza, Old Chicago, so I was excited to try a New York Style. I was not disappointed with the outcome. Some of the only critiques we had was cheese was missing in some spots. It seemed like it was just dough, a lot of sauce, and some cheese here and there. I'm not sure if that's how the pizza is supposed to be, but that's what I thought. We ordered a large, and that was not enough. Granted, my boyfriend can eat a lot, so he devoured that pizza. 

Overall, the restaurant is nice. I loved the wine bottles hanging from the ceiling and just the decor of it. The pizza was good, not quite worth the money, but I'll probably go back. The waitress we had could use a little more work. But other than that, I enjoyed it.
Great place for cheap lunch. It's enough to fill your stomach with food. You get soup, choice of Chicken, beef, pork.

Who would have thought that behind Blimpee's and next to Verizon in a strip mall would be a really great, unique place to eat. Although the fried green tomatoes were seasonal (I'm here Jan 21) and the other item I wanted was only served on Fri and Sat the second choice was choice! The korean tacos did not have kimchee on the but the Kobe beef was really fabulous. Husband had the fried chicken and waffles and was extremely satisfied. I had the jumbalay stuffed peppers a true 4 star. All vet great!

River City Veterinary Hospital seems like home for our golden retriever, Luke.  He attends Doggie Daycare at least two days a week and we literally have to drag him to the car at the end of the day.  I love having the ability to watch him play on the internet via the web cams in the play room.  He is well supervised and obviously having a ball.  We have also kenneled Luke several times.  I'm not sure how well dogs can think, but in my mind he probably imagines that being kenneled at River City is like going to summer camp.  He comes home exhausted from all the playing.  We also love the doctors at River City and it's so easy to take Luke there when he already associates it with a fun place to be.  Great staff, reasonable prices and a safe, loving place to leave a member or our family!

This is a Korean fusion. The chef and owner of this family run business put their own spin into traditional Korean foods. It hits the spot. I have been to their Broadway location multiple times and am glad they got a larger restaurant with ease of access from the road and a good amount of parking. I had their spicy pork which was just the right amount of spice and cooked so tender. Others at the table got the bim bim bop and bulgolgi which were on point and tasty. If this is your first time eating Korean food get the bim bim bop with a meat. You wont regret it! The pricing is on par with the local area restaurants and a good bang for the buck. I'm not a small man and i always walk away stuffed. They now offer sushi rolls and a buffet. And i tried the sushi, its good

Absolutely fabulous!  This was an excellent experience. The seating both indoors and out are comfortable and accommodating. The decor is fun and friendly and the staff is as well. The food... LOVE IT!!!  The antipasto salad is quite expensive for the size but is a tasty experience. The pizzas were amazing!  We had the Brooklyn Bridge and the Quattro Formaggio (4 cheese). Even the kids loved this NY thin crust experience. 
Enjoy!!!

Terrible, I will not ever come back.  Waited 30 minutes to find out they gave our table away and we were told they also did not put us on the waiting list.  So we would have to wait another 45 minutes.   No apology just attitude from the hostess.  Called for the Manager and it was the same hostess pretending to be the manager.  I will never  go back..
The grilled pork chops and eggs weren't the best, i should've got the breakfast buffet.

I'm Chinese  ,I'm looking for a good Chinese restaurant in . I found it now. "Boiled spicy fish soup"----so delicious!!! The staff was attentive and nice.   
This place is affordable and quick.                                 I will be back!!!!

Wow! Just wow! My wife says "best breakfast" she's ever had. I had the chorizo hash, and it was amazing. Everything is hand made, the potatoes hand cut, the gravy prepared daily. Joe is a wonder maker.
We are alwasy impressed with the Great food and great service. We are sad that they will be closed for the summer. Once you open again, we will be back for sure!

The worst people in the world to do business with. They refuse to admit when they make mistakes and blame the negative experience on you. I was a customer of over 20 years until my run in with the owner Steve who showed me that he can't be trusted in business.  I will never set foot in their shop again. Dennis Dillon Power Sports, Woody's and Carl's Cycles have better service, better prices, more professional service personnel and a more positive atmosphere.

We tried this place for the first time today. I had the traditional eggs benedict (my favorite). The flavor was mediocre. The English muffin was too soft, the egg was overcooked, and the meat was just shredded deli lunch meat. My husband had the special "salted caramel banana French toast". It was made with sliced banana bread muffins...very flavorful, but not extraordinary.

The environment was underdeveloped and the tables and floors were dirty. I didn't see any one clean the whole time we were there and there were a lot of employees just standing around. It was good food but not enough to make us want to go back.

This was the worst restaurant that I've ever eaten at. Service was slow, food over cooked and under staffed. Waitress never came back to offer refills on drink until they brought check.  No one at main desk to complain.

I am obsessed with this place, although honestly I've only ever had one thing. You know how when you go somewhere and order something and you've never had anything so delicious, so you never get anything else? That's what happened to me and their Garden Frittata. No joke--I dream about that thing!! 

They use these amazing veggies, perfectly cooked eggs, and topped with some goat cheese. Just writing about it makes me want to go back right now to eat it again!! 

Go give it a try and get a garden frittata. You're welcome.

Pizza was good but way too expensive.  I get it, you are paying for the location and the ambiance, however, $140 for three pizzas, 6 alcoholic beverages and 2 salads and 2 cokes is a bit insane.

The "white pizza" was pretty tasteless.  The red sauce is quite good and the portions are large.  The thing is every topping is $2, and the base price for a small pizza is $16 or more.  

If you want a fancy pizza place and have extra cash, enjoy the red sauce.  A small is more than enough pizza for a family of four...  Just make everyone agree on toppings and get just one pizza, otherwise you will need a week of overtime to afford the food!

Broke a spring Sunday evening. Called them Monday morning and it was fixed Monday afternoon. Fast, friendly, professional service and a very fair price. Also included a 10 year warranty on the new springs. I would not hesitate to recommend them.

The pizza is fabulous. Although I am a more simple kind of girl and I like cheap pizza, I can totally appreciate Grimaldi's pizza!! We ordered a pesto pizza and WOW!! 

Also, they I have the BEST cheesecake that I have ever had!!

Not much to say that hasn't already been said.  Very very good pizza.  

Some have griped about price. When you consider location, quality and portions, then the prices are more than fair.  A small will feed 2 people with leftovers.  If you're on a budget, go to Pizza Hut. 

Note- if you add jalapeños, like everything else, you will get a very generous serving ;).

Happy Chinese New Year! Started the Year of the Rooster by eating at the Red Pavillion in Meridian. Awesome food, wonderful fast and friendly service. We've been eating here about once a week since we heard of its opening. We've loved everything we have tried. The Calamari is outstanding! A few of our favorites are the double mushrooms with beef, pepper shrimp, honey almond shrimp, and the iron sizzler with scallops and shrimp.

I'm a self proclaimed taco shop connoisseur and this place is average. The bacon breakfast burrito lacked everything except potatoes. Hardly any eggs, bacon, or cheese but it had plenty of potatoes. That's all I could taste. So if you're really into potato burritos this will be a 5-star joint for you.

This place just plain can't serve a decent baked potato. Waited 40 minutes and it came out hard as a brick. Even the waitress said they can't cook a potato. WE ARE IN IDAHO!  Not going back. Been there 2x now and won't do a third.

The food is priced for medium/high end. Their Kahuna burger and a small drink was $10.54 with tax. For that price, I expected hand made patties. What I received were those machine pressed and then frozen patties that I'm not a fan of. They remind me of when someone barbecues and they are using the same package of frozen patties they bought at Costco three years ago.

The staff is friendly and the layout is decent. They have only a single station for napkins, drinks, and condiments though. I was always in someone's way when I was trying to pick up items from this station.

The marketing gimmick is fun: "Go tribal. Eat tropic." Too bad eating tropic means eating not so good food that costs a lot, in this case.

I would try this place again, only if I heard they were making better food. I would not recommend this eatery as it is; at least not their burgers.

My husband and I love going to Shanaz for dinner. Our food is always above par and our services are usually nice, although we've come to expect it to be slow (even in getting drinks to the table). I've tried (and love) things that I never would have tried- fried green tomatoes, grilled pb&j, seafood gumbo... It's all drool worthy. The only thing I would recommend to make this place better would be a) getting better chairs/tables: they are too old/wobbly and uncomfortable and b) figuring out something about the draft/wind problem. I never go here without a jacket because it's always freezing. 

Improvements aside- still a 5. :)

This was the best food that I've ever had! It was so fresh. I had the shrimp and grits. Amazing!! Chicken and waffles were delicious! And that cornbread...WOW! The staff were all friendly and were great at their jobs. I'm a customer for life!

Ordered take-out, I was surprised they were willing to take our order because we called only 15 minutes before closing. (Didn't realize til we were picking up)

The food was good, typical Chinese take-out. It was ready quickly and my husband and I both liked it. It wasn't quite what we were looking for, after living near DC we got a little spoiled. But if we were really wanting Chinese take-out again, we would order from here. (If we still haven't found the style we prefer.)
I went to get a facial. The girl who gave the facial did a great job but the front desk was unfriendly and rude.

Definitely have experienced better. Lacks flavor. Overpriced for pizza. $20 for a large one topping pizza! Additional toppings range from $2-$5 each and the next thing you know, you've ordered a $35 large pizza!  Two large pizzas, a soda, three bar drinks, and one dessert ran us a $94 tab!  Tables are too small to accommodate the massive pizza pans delivered to your table. Watch out for the AWFUL mildew/moldy bar mat stink/odor slaps you in the face when you walk in the front door.
Love this yogurt shop!  Very fresh toppings, creamy yogurt, and adorable decor.  Like the fact that they don't weigh for price!!  Bethany was cheerful and helpful!!!

Ate here for breakfast on a road trip as we were passing through. Could not have been happier! All the food was amazing. The breakfast burritos are HUGE and tasty. So glad we stopped here. We prefer to stop places like this as opposed to chains and fast food. And it wasn't far off the beaten path, which was helpful for us! Would come back for sure if we were ever in the area again.

We love Gino's! The service is always great and the food never disappoints. Good food portions for the price and the atmosphere is good. I wish they had booths instead of so many tables but that doesn't detour us from partaking. Our take out is always hot and ready as well!
Good hot and sour soup, nice portion for lunch, service was very attentive.  Prices are very fair.  We will be back.

VERY CLEAN ROOMS! Continental breakfast was so-so.Hotel staff were very nice. 
Has weight room, jacuzzi,and free snow Nov to Feb. Traveled here in November and it was a welcome and warm stop on a cold and snowy road trip home. The room was very spacious and after a stop to a local store, we made great use of the kitchen. Would stay here again!
The food is really good. But the portion sizes went down and the prices went up. It's really hard to justify 5 wings for $8.50
Once again eating at Moe Joe's was excellent. I ordered the Lemon poppyseed pancakes and my daughter Smokehouse. AMAZING
The waitress was the high lite of this dinner. Great service and a personality to match. The food was average at best. Sorry don't really anything else to say.

Wow, what a breakfast. We waited about 25 minutes on a Sunday morning but I can't express how worth it it was. The corned beef hash was the best I think I've ever had. Awesome service and friendly people. We'll be back!

I'm giving this place 4 stars taking into consideration the taste of the food, price and ambience.  Firstly, the food, both my daughter and I had the Mongol from the lunch menu.  Consisted of fried beef with onions.  The dish was decent though bit too greasy.  Their brown rice was nicely done, fluffy and nutty with just the right amount of moisture.  Also came with a soup, I chose the hot and sour soup which was quite good, more in th vinegary side which I like.  I also ordered the chow fun and low mein to go.  Both were good but also bit too greasy.  I do wish they would use less oil in their cooking, don't know what is wrong with most of the Chinese restaurants out there but this is a common theme.  The price and ambience bought the review a 3.5 for food to an overall 4 stars. Except next time I would not sit in the booth.  It was very tight and uncomfortable.

Please don't go here. Are food was completely horrible. We waited over an hour for our meal and we're seeing people who were seated before us getting the dishes. Our waiter was a joke and always had an excuse as to where our food was. Never again will we try this place. Stay away!!
We love Grimaldi's!! One pizza feeds my family for 2 meals. We also get a Caesar salad and have fresh mozzarella put into it and my kids devour it. The service is also always great.

New location in a great atmosphere.   Kind of a best kept secret!   Once everyone starts coming in, it will be hard to get a seat!   Excellent food pairings and wine choices.  Definitely will be back!

We have eaten here a few times and have always had good experiences.  The food is always well prepared & tasty and the stuffed mushroom appetizer is a favorite.  One of the things we really appreciate is the cleanliness of the place.  Near closing time, we have watched the kitchen staff deep cleaning all of the stainless in the kitchen...even moving the appliances out to clean under an behind them.

Very Good Breakfast Buffet at 7.99  you can't go wrong!!!! The Breakfast Buffet was well stock with thick bacon, eggs, sausage, two kinds of skillet potatoes, biscuits and gravy, fresh fruit, yogurt , cereal, and you can even have ice cream. I would recommend you guys try it out for Breakfast and things on the  menu was well priced.
Their food is amazing! My daughter especially enjoyed their waffles. Fair prices as well. Definitely recommend you come here!

My husband and I were referred to Dr. Mark Fineman via Melissa at Northwest Pets. After our visit, we have now found our favorite vet for sure. Very reasonably priced and does not try to take advantage of you. Great with people and your pets, just like we heard! Extremely pleased, and will refer whoever we can to him! Genuinely great guy and vet!

Love, love,love this  place!  We have a 9 month old black lab who is full of energy!  She was so happy & tired when we picked her up from her free 1/2 day after her interview.  We then boarded her for 2 weeks & she came home happy & healthy.  I took her again today so I could go to the dr & do some Christmas shopping.  Just picked up 1 very tired happy dog. She gets her exercise & I can get my chores down without having to crate her at home.
First time here, will definitely be back soon. Great Sumatra coffee, wonderful food...had the Smokehouse hash and a pancake, new favorite breakfast place!

It was a great unique meal well prepared. I had the slow cooked pork chops and they were excellent.  The chop was fork tender and flavorful.  Very good gravy with a southern potato cake.  It is rare to get real sweet tea in Boise done with cane sugar simple syrup.  My wife had the gumbo and really liked it.  It had real shrimp and was very authentic.  Just the right amount of spice with precisely cooked okra.

This restaurant has excellent food with a menu you don't find behind every neon sign.  

A little hard to find, but worth the trip.  Will go back for the Jambalaya as a weekday treat.

We visited this pizza parlor for the first time last week with a large group of people of varying ages.  There were several selections of pizza ordered.  Our family chose a selection of Italian sausage, green peppers, mushrooms with red sauce and the usual mozzarella topping.  Others chose the pesto version with sundried tomatoes, anchovies, and mushrooms.  The pizzas are thin crust baked in a coal fired oven.  They were very good, flavorful, with a nice crisp crust with a slight char on the edge.  I read that some people experienced a black burnt crust and I had heard that from another person that dined here.  We didn't experience that, so I guess I would chalk that up to a restaurant being new and getting the hang of making pizza.  We all ordered salads and even the small sizes were ample.  

We would definitely return here.  It's a lot closer to us than venturing downtown to some other good pizza places.  It was a Tuesday as well, and the wines were half price.  Not a bad deal!

I've had a change of heart... I posted a lower review a while back but I feel differently now ha! The pizza is really good and always quality! But I will still say the prices are a bit high so for is its only worth it for dine-in but that's ok because their salad bar is awesome and you miss out if you order delivery!!

Pricey, but the best pizza in the area.  They use fresh, real ingredients and really can't compare anyone else to this establishment for best taste.  We usually get the Ham, Sausage and Mushroom pizza.  Also, their salads are great, and a large can feed 3, especially as an appetizer, to the pizza.  Note also, their thin crust is so good, we could eat it by itself and enjoy it.  I have to say, when they first opened in Meridian, their topping portion was very light, and I'd have rated 2 star, but they have improved greatly over the past 12-18 months, so we are back on a regular basis.

This place has traditional favorites that are made really well, or with an added gourmet twist.  Their club sandwich was probably the best club sandwich I've ever tasted--high quality meats, delicious bread, fresh lettuce and tomato.  We also tried the jalapeno berry pancake which was unique and surprisingly delicious.  The pancake had jalapeno and cream cheese baked into it, but the flavor was subtle.  The syrup was a raspberry syrup.  I highly recommend it, even though it sounds weird.  I will say that my chilaquiles was not very good.  It was very heavy on the beans and pork, with a puddle of pork grease in the bottom of the dish.  I LOVE chilaquiles, but I couldn't stomach Moe Joe's version.  It would have been better with much less pork grease and with the addition of some sour cream and fresh pico de gallo or salsa.

The restuarant interior is clean, plain, and comfortable.  The service was great.  I would definitely go there again.
Food was good. But don't come hungry, cause you'll be starving before you get your food. They need to work on their restaurant management from the kitchen to service.

Since they we're open until 11pm on 24 Feb 18.  6 of us went to try RR since it was around 9pm and not busy.  
1) Only took 10 minutes to be seated. :)
2) DIRTIEST RESTAURANT IN ALL OF BOISE! Food and trash from the front door to the bathrooms.  UGH!
3) We were served our appetizers with no cutlery or napkins. (Happens EVERY time we visit).
4) Waited ~15 minutes to get a refill.
5) 23 minutes to get our desert after we ordered.  I could see the waitress playing around with the rest of the staff instead of doing what she is paid to do. (Still gave her a 20% tip).
6) That was my final visit.

We will never know how the food is. We arrived at 5:30 and the unpleasant young ladies at the hostess podium informed us that since we had no reservation they would be unable to accomodate a table for two until 8:30. If you require reservations you should add that to your yelp description. We eat at restaurants almost daily and this was the worst experience we have had in a year or more.
Order the Italian nanchos!!! So good!  The food is way better than Olive Garden.
Great choice of rolls available. Fish is very fresh. Kind service & reasonably priced. Will definitely be back.

Went last night and had the Pasta Gino's which was good but not great.  My wife had the lamb shank which was amazing and well worth multiple return trips.

For an app try the salmon carpaccio.

Great food, friendly and knowledgeable staff . Atmosphere couldn't be warmer, with kids crying next to our table. Much different than a Silicon Valley business dinner. We started with a great platter of shrimps, calamari, tomato parmigiana. 

I had a nice tomato/garlic based soup that was not too tangy nor sweet. I then had an order of their veal eggplant parmigiana dish which were slices of fresh eggplant baked with medallions of tender veal in their own special tomato meat sauce and topped with mozzarella cheese, served with pasta. I had this with angel-hair with tossed beef. Ths was delicious, but way too much for me to eat in one sitting.

Great atmosphere since this was my first biz dinner here in Boise.

It was our first time at River City Veterinary  Hospital. I needed an appointment right away for one of my lil' girls and I was able to get in that day. The staff was very friendly and Dr. Liddell explained everything.  Even though we live in Nampa, River City will be our new veterinary

There is probably no wait now according to Yelp because they are out of their $10.40 16" tax special. Even though they make their crusts to order and personally invited me through my email, they chose not to make any more 16" crusts. Very bad business decision. There were 5 of us looking forward to pizza tonight. No more Grimaldi's for us. They should probably close for a day and have a manager/employee training session on discrimination against 16" pizzas.

I have never left a poor review, but I'm super frustrated.  I had an extremely tight schedule today as I'm traveling.  This left me know time for a proper conversation regarding my gel nails (hands & feet) today.  I've had my nails done regularly across the country (I travel for a lot).  Today's may have been the worst I've received.  It was clear the nail tech was new, but I was originally charged full price (which is higher than most others).  When I went to pay I showed the receptionist my nails & said I was not happy.  Thankfully she did provide me with a discount (about 20%).  At the end of the day, what I paid was still way too much.  The polish is not extended to the edges of my nails, several fingers have the polish "gooped" up & not smooth & the "drawn" flowers have me feeling a bit sheepish in my professional work.  I have contemplated posting this, as I don't want to make anyone feel bad & understand that everyone needs to start somewhere-but an expensive charge for what I received has left me underwhelmed & frustrated.
Il est cool comme resto de dessert. La glace est du yaourt et c'est bon.
My favorite place in town, especially on a Tuesday for Wings Night. Great wings; meaty; full of flavor. The wait staff is the best! Friendly, fun, sharp.

Red Robin did an amazing job in getting back with me regarding the concern we had with one of the wait staff. Especially the new manager at the store. He was extremely open and personable.  Very impressive.

I've tried this location about 4 times since it opened thinking each time it's got to be better...., it's got to be better and to be honest the food here is so disgusting and overpriced it's ridiculous. There tater tot's are randomly over seasoned so periodically you bite into one with so much seasoning on it it makes you want to vomit. The beans are always old and nasty and like glue. The food just all-around is terrible.....especially for the money.
This place is good, service was great, people were nice.... Love to spend my money at places like this. Thanks Team Gino!

Place looks nice and clean. Service was decent, but food was not that great. We ordered the pineapple shrimp tacos, and they were overwhelmingly covered in honey. Not worth $13.50. It says it's made with sweet chili pineapple salsa, but it's more like a honey glaze. Nothing salsa about it:( waitress apologized, but didn't offer to do anything about it.

It had been a while since visiting Fujiyama Meridian as we go to the Boise location because It's closer to home, but our meal at Meridian Fujiyama was well worth the extra drive.  First off, our server was excellent, top notch.  She was friendly, helpful, and efficient.  Our drinks came out quickly and never went empty, when ordering she made sure we got the best value for our money, substituting our favorite fish on our platter for our lesser favorites.  If I could give our service 10 stars, I easily would as this was the best service I've had a Fujiyama, as well as most other restaurants I've dined at.  What a treat to have great service on top of the excellent food.  I can't say enough how excellent the fish quality is at Fujiyama, both Boise and Meridan locations.  When you order rolls, you miss how incredibly fresh their fish truly is, and you can mask the poorer quality, older fish by the sauces, but you can't do that when you order sashimi, just fish, no rice, so you only get the best. You can taste the quality and amazing flavor.  I stopped eating sashimi everywhere else as old, fishy tasting, small cuts of fish is not appealing.  If I had the say, Fujiyama would easily be Best of Boise once again.
Really enjoyed the atmosphere. Were a lot of regular customers there on a Friday night, great service and fun place to eat out.

This place is simply amazing! We picked a gorgeous slab here and I still love to bring visitors here to marvel over the impressive selections they have. To call it marble and granite is an understatement, they are all fantastic pieces of art. Beautiful new location - worth a visit for many design ideas and staff is super friendly.

Moe Joe's!! My love for you is unreal. We dropped in on a whim on our weekend trip to Boise and I am so happy we did! The food was exceptional, all fresh, homemade and hot. Quite possibly the best biscuits and potatoes I've ever had at a breakfast place! (Order the Farmhouse, seriously ... Drool..) As if the food isn't reason enough to come back, the staff was wonderful. Friendly, efficient and so helpful! They even offered us coffee to go! (What?! Who does that?! AWESOME!) We went two days in a row for breakfast here because we were so impressed! It's pretty much all we've talked about since we've been home and we are counting down the days until we're back in Idaho for more Moe Joe's!

Home run on dinner tonight.  Bread and seasoned oil for dipping and a bottle of Barberra to start.perfectly prepared Vitelli scallopini and side said with homemade blue cheese dressing .  All very fresh.  Crime brûlée and raspberry cheesecake to finish.
Most importantly, our server Luke did an outstanding job.  He is knowledgeable of the menu as well as the wine list and works very efficiently.

Very helpful i did a business meeting there and wanted to do it before they opened for business they opened early and prepared the food which is amazing!!! Thanks again Joy Garden for all your help and special accommodations.

This was probably the best experience we've had. The food was amazing. We had chicken and waffles, garlic shrimp, fried pb&j, fried mac&cheese balls, and pork ribs. Everything was so delicious. The potato cakes and corn were delish too. Free cornbread for the table which was also amazing. Jennifer and her husband were a treat to meet and chat with. So fun to run into someone from your neck of the woods when you are on vacation in another state. When we are back in the area we will definitely be returning!
We love Gino's!  The food is amazing, excellent selection of artisan cocktails but make A reservation, they stay busy.
Service is slow to non existent. Fly visited our booth more than the server. Ordered fries as an appetizer but didn't receive them. I had to ask three times for fry sauce.

I am EXTREMELY impressed with this place. Would highly recommend to any sushi lover! Their menu is HUGE with so many assortments of fish with very reasonable prices! The service is fantastic; the people here are always super nice and ready to make your meal the best. I will be a reoccurring customer for all of my sushi fixes!

This is my new favorite Chinese place (in the Treasure Valley)! Wonton soup was great. The hot and sour soup is a little different here, but usually not my go to in general. I got the mu shu shrimp and would recommend it for sure. Spring rolls also tasted handmade, not frozen. Friendly staff and great portions. Will be coming back!
I have to say one of the best meals we had on our trip to meridian Idaho!  Great place don't  miss it! Mary was a great server. Make sure you take her so e almond  creamer !

Ok so after the start of trying to guess what was wrong with our waiter the food arrived the lasagna was large but cold, I did not want the waiter to spit in my food  so I just ate it. The chicken parmigiana was just ok and like 1/2 a piece I'm not sure what happened to the rest and the couple bites of mushy spaghetti  just really why bother... the tiramisu homemade as it read was so over iced that it was like a soft creamy cheesecake with no flavor... my wife had the pizza and it was decent so that's why the three stars folks

What a great play place for all ages! I loved the open play concept with slides, train sets, rock cLimbing, kitchen play set, and much, much more. I found this place with the help of the front desk from the hotel we are staying at here in Meridian. The staff at this play place is super friendly, kid oriented, and very hard working. Once a kid was done plating with a toy, there was a happy team member right behind them putting it back in its place! Super affordable and parent's admission is free! Thank u for a day of fun in a city I don't know! Would lOve to frequent this spot if we move to town!

I love this store!! They have everything!! I stopped there this evening to go to Chase Bank... and quickly picked up a few groceries while I was there. The store is clean and well organized so my extra task was quick and easy!!

Owner changed. Menu expanded. Pho in my opinion is not as good as it used to be. Broth is different and doesn't have the same taste. Price is about the same as it used to be which is about $10 for an entree. We ordered one of the chicken stick appetizers and couldn't finish it because it didn't look so appetizing.

Who cares about the yogurt i was extremely impressed with the customer service! "Natalie" was working and had no help another customer was being really rude and she handled herself very professionally and still managed to stay cool and be friendly with us! Im new to the area and we eat a lot of froyo in our house...tonights visit made long term customers out of us! ....oh and the yogurt was geeat! Lots of options and tons of toppings!

If you LOVE sushi this is the place for you. The  waiters were very kind. Food was good, would come again. I quote my dad " best sushi bar in Boise".  They have made this restaurant beautiful.  Hope you come to this restaurant. They also have green tea ice cream and fried ice cream.
Yuck, that is all.  There isn't more to say, but maybe that is just fast food.  Not a fan of any of it including the line, receiving the wrong order and plain food.
Every time I come here coffee is constantly tasting different. I even talked to a manager on Fairview and he even said this location always gets their shots wrong - good going.
This is the best shaved ice I've ever had outside of Maui! Super sweet. Doesn't taste like your eating ice cubes. You have to try it with the sweetened condensed milk and ice cream. Yummy!!!!

They have changed up the menu a bit. Don't like to discuss hidden treasures. If I tell us how great this place is then more will eat here and the chances of me getting a table decreases. Generous fresh portions

Stopped in on Friday evening, sat outside and had a great time.  The staff were great. Thanks Rachel for the "Rachel wings" and making sure we were taken care of. Heidi too you guys were the best! The "Larry's"

Found this gem today. These ladies know how to present their products in a way that show off what is there. They have something for everyone, both the quality shopper and the bargain hunter. My friend and I will definitely be back!

Definitely worth going out of your way for!! Once I tried their coffee, I haven't been back to Starbucks. My hubby & I couldn't be happier. Excellent coffee and amazing, fast service! No burnt coffee taste here, unlike Starbucks coffee. I'm a big fan :)

We were full-time RV'ers at the time we stayed here from 8/2016 to 10/2016. The staff here is quite friendly and helpful. The check in process was quick and they have different social events through the week if you like that sort of thing. Other than this point I cannot say that we had a great stay at this park. Reasons? 

WiFi was horrible. Although we were told they were upgrading it the day we checked-in, we were there a little over 2 months and it still was slow and kicked us off repeatedly. Had to rely on cell phone to do all online tasks.

They mow the lawn here every single Monday. This doesn't sound like a big deal really until you are the nightshift nurse trying to sleep while the 2 foot patches of grass are being mowed for 4 plus hours. My husband inquired because the grass obviously did not need to be mowed and was told that it was mowed weekly 'whether it needs it or not.' 

The spaces are tiny. You can hear everything happening in your neighbors RV all the time. Not fun. Many of the RV's are full-time here. This makes much of the park look more like a trailer lot than a campground. There just didn't seem to be a standard as to how people kept the area around their RV. Dogs barking were crazy too...

The road through the park is tiny and curves are tight. You come seriously close to hitting other RV's that hang out of spots on the turns. The camping area is right on top of a big blind turn. Not the smartest since many of the tenters have little kiddos that like to run back and forth to the restrooms in that area. BEWARE! 

The last point is just that there is a race track about 1 mile away and they have races most weekends Thurs-Sunday night. If you are a race fan you will love the walking access. If you are in search of a peaceful experience this is not it at all. You hear the cars going round and round until 11 or so each of those nights.

Great tasting pizza (we ordered the supreme) followed up with a great salad bar. For dessert we had the cinnamon twists with a bit of glaze on them and they were delicious. I enjoyed the food, the atmosphere and the staff.

Went for lunch because since we moved here 2 years ago and miss our pulled pork joint in Seattle so much we are trying to find its replacement. Famous Dave's is not it. I ordered coffee and the waiter asked if I wanted cream, sure, I don't usually but thought it might be nice, I got non dairy creamer with hydrogenated oil listed in it, cheap was my first thought.  Mom and I ordered 2 chopped pork sandwiches I got a side of Mac and cheese and she got potato salad. When the order came her potato salad was cole slaw and both our first few bites of pork were so salty I could taste nothing but salt, yuck. Once I got through a few bites it was ok but nothing special. Mac and cheese and cole slaw just mediocre and not worth the price.  There was no one to greet us when we got there so we had no idea if it was seat yourself or maybe serve yourself. The waiter was nice once he showed up to seat us and the manager gave us a first time packet with a bottle of famous sauce and take out menu.  I read the ingredients on the label and the first ingredient...high fructose corn syrup...oh joy I thought since I had tried the sauce on my pork, thought I could water down the salt.  This is not a restaurant that cares about its ingredients and appears to make things as cheaply as possible. I gave it a two star because of the staff...mom and I decided we would not go hear again...curiosity over this place is over.  My question is what makes them so famous?  Maybe the decor or nice fire place.

First things first:  the food is the highlight of K-Fusion.  It's as Korean as possible, while still appealing to an average American palate.  It's advertised as "fusion" so I can't knock it for being 100% authentic Korean, and it meant that my boyfriend could enjoy it since he's not super familiar with Korean flavor combinations. 
Why the 3 stars:  the business model and service just killed any chance that I could give this place more than 3 stars.    

The menu is haphazard mess of different boxes of appetizers, mains, sushi, buffet, lunch buffet add-on prices, sides prices, prices for sides with something, prices for rice, prices for... It's just nickel & dimed to death and incredibly poorly organized.  Add to this that the server we had told us that we could only get banchan (the variety of kimchis and side dishes that typically are brought to you with a meal, and included in the cost of your meal) from the buffet - but then said I could actually get banchan (which she kept calling "sides" and didn't understand what I meant when I said banchan for .99 cents a plate from the buffet - but then the food runner said I could get them only from the buffet, at $25 for the buffet & sushi price on the menu...  Yeah, confused yet?

We finally established that you can either get the all-you-can-eat sushi and "sides" buffet OR you can get your "sides" from the buffet for .99 cents each.  I chose the per plate price of .99 cents. The server asked me twice how many sides I was getting so that she could add them to our tab, and I told her twice that I would need to go see what the options were first since she couldn't tell me. 

The buffet was lacking sorely, especially for a Friday night.  The "House Special" salad is just spring lettuce mix with 2 bottles of store-bought dressing.  There were also sliced apples. The banchan dishes available were a cucumber kimchi, mixed vegetable pickle, yellow curry main dish, rice, and miso soup.   I dished a small plate of cucumber kimchi and of mixed veg pickle.  Before I could finish dishing the server came up to me to ask again how many plates I was getting.  I told her two and went back to the table. 
Adding to the frustration were the cooks who were talking about me as I was at the "buffet".  I know just enough Korean to know they were discussing the "African" in the place. It definitely didn't make me feel welcome.  If there's a way to say I felt like someone was worried I was going to shoplift a side dish because of the color of my skin, this is it.  It was all a bit absurd, and I considered leaving. 

I don't know if K-Fusion took on this pricing model because they had previously given banchan to those who ordered appetizers and there was considerable waste, but it was really disappointing.  We thought the cucumber was good (thick slices, marinated in gochujang, and I think some fermented shrimp paste) and the mixed veg pickle was bright and refreshing, with good firmness still in each veg.  The waitress confirmed that everything was made fresh in-house, including the sauces, and it showed in the quality. 

We ordered Bulgogi (1 of 4 ways to rate a Korean restaurant; the others being their banchan, bibimbap, and kimchi),  spicy pork, and the shrimp tempura app.  I tried to get the BF to order the bibimbap, but he was still scarred from the horrible one he got at Gang Nam and flat refused to try again. 

I was nervous because we didn't see traditional cabbage kimchi anywhere on the menu or buffet, but the server assured me we would get the first one free with our entrees.  

After the confusion the servers had with the food, and Korean food tradition in general, and terrible menu/meal structure I was a bit dubious of how good the food would be.  This is where K-Fusion won us over. 

The shrimp tempura were fresh shrimp with a deep golden and super crispy panko tempura crust.  The shrimp were sweet and cooked just right.  The ponzu sauce wasn't sweet, and added just the right counter note to the tempura.  It was the first bright moment in our meal. 

The Bulgogi and Spicy Pork were spot on.  My Bulgogi was made the traditional way, and I could taste that they didn't use pineapple juice to sweeten and texturizing the beef, but instead went with kiwi.  This makes a world of difference and is much appreciated.  The spicy pork wasn't too hot (it was actually pretty mild), but this allowed for all of the flavors to be tasted.  The rice was cooked well and a few black sesame were added. 

We were charged for the one kimchi they brought after we asked for it.  The server said she'd take it off, but we'd have to pay for the second.  We had to remind her that we were only given 1, after we asked for it...  She adjusted the charge. Ugh.

K-Fusion has promise.  It reminds me of a Korean street market food stand.  It needs more dish options (or specials), better educated servers, complimentary banchan, and it'd be a regular visit for us.  For now, it'll be an occasional take-out place.

Got around to lunch late. No problem!
Good table, prompt service, fair price.
Try the ziti, or beef sandwich.
You won't be disappointed!

My son and I had a delightful breakfast here this morning. I had the special the Smokehouse Hash can I just say YESSSS!!!!!! It was beyond delicious it was a   Meg Ryan, Billy Crystal When Harry Met Sally moment! Don't even get me started on the pancakes they were tender and cooked to perfection. I swear this is the best breakfast I have had in Idaho hands down. My son devoured the chicken Fried steak. If the clean plate was any indication he enjoyed his as well.

Our server was Amy. She was friendly, attentive, and on top of our every need. From beginning to end our service was awesome!! I normally don't hand out a five star review but I couldn't find one thing to complain about which is rare for me. I can't wait to go back and try a Frittata or Eggs Benedict. If your on the fence about trying this unassuming little gem don 't be. Put aside your judgements and do yourself a favor go cause your missing out!!!!
Usually an amazing place to eat! Still great food! The entire turnover in staff and brand new staff took 35 minutes to serve us.
Best of boise. My food has always been amazing i take my kids here sometimes before school foods always done in a timley manner can't complain at all homecoked food!

This place is probably the best place to get Chinese food in Meridian. We ordered take out, took about 20 min to get our order ready. The food was delicious while we were eating it, but after my stomach hurt pretty bad. Now this could be because of how fast I ate it haha. So yummy. We felt a little rushed when ordering because the greeter seemed very flustered and overwhelmed with a separate big group that has just arrived, but we tried to ignore it. I was bummed that they don't give you the wont tons and dipping sauce for free with take out orders, but we will just have to stay and eat at the restaurant next time.

Best breakfast I had in a long time. Wait staff is very friendly and coffee is great. I had the chorizo hash and wow was it good. My wife had breakfast for beginners and was pleasantly surprised. Make sure you get potatoes very yummy.

Seriously, we love this store. They are always helpful. And when we find something that is priced better at another store, they price match it (so long as it is the same item). We went tonight and purchased a new stroller. Andrew matched it to a $78 savings! At the register, Joy went out of her way to find a water bottle for our daughter -- as they had a promo going on that I didn't even know about!!
Great food and service. Some of the best in the area. The corned beef hash skillet and rocks.

Very nice people, and OK prices, but the food was really not good.

I went for lunch, had the orange spicy chicken and fried rice. The chicken came "some assembly required"...I got a box of sliced breaded chicken, and a tub of sauce that had an off flavor. I had about 3 bites, then chucked it...not worth the calories.

The rice was OK, but anyone can make fried rice.

Sadly, I will not be back.
We love this place, been coming for years!  Miss the original house salad though with cheese. Dressing rocks as usual
Dined in.  Thought I was in a day care with all the employee kids running around and screaming.  Food was okay.  Service was horrible
Green Chile (Chile verde) burrito was great! Low prices too. My favorite Mexican food joint in meridian. I'll be back

Not Keto but vegan just for a little change. Delicious!!!! Omg whoever thought to put  pepino or cucumber into a burrito was a genius!!!!! And their orange infused water was delish! My dairy free Toddler loved his almond milk smoothie and he didn't get brain freeze from drinking it  my new fave spot for sure!! We also got their spaghetti and my kids fought over who gets more. Wow factor! Even finished off the olives and they customized a Keto bowl for my diabetic dad. Mason helped us out and he was great at customer service which is what I look for when dining out.

My husband and I just ate here for the first time. I had the lettuce wraps and he had the spicy chicken. We were both very satisfied with our meals! Our waitress was named Monica and she had outstanding customer service!

my second try at a jimmy john's and it didn't disappoint! i love it here! nice employees, great food, amazing pickles! 

you have to try one! you will be hooked!

I won lunch for 2 from a local radio station.  My husband and I waited until Saturday.  Though there is a location closer to our home,  a coworkers daughter works at the Meridian location so we took a little drive.  The restaurant is clean, welcoming and comfortable, with the exception of the AC being a little too cool for us on the day we went. 
We each enjoyed a personal pizza with 2 toppings, salad bar and a soda.  The guy taking our order was welcoming and friendly, the drink station was clean and well stocked, and teh salad bar, while not offering as many ingredients as I expected, was clean and stocked.  One great surprise is that their blue cheese dressing actually had chunks of blue cheese in it!   Our pizzas were delivered to our table piping hot.  The red sauce has a bit of a kick (hubby had pineapple and pepperoni- I opted for the garlic sauce with chicken and green onion).  The crust was thin, but not to cripsy.   
Overall we really enjoyed our meal, next time I'll take a sweater, but we'll definitely return.

So there isn't any Chinese cuisine in the Treasure Valley that quite matches what you'd find in Seattle, Portland, San Fran, or Vancouver, but this comes the closest. I would also say this is the most authentic Chinese cuisine in SW Idaho. 

Second note, the service is amazing. I'm notoriously cheap and I left a 20% tip because of the friendly and helpful service from my waitress. Maybe it helped that I speak Chinese  and I asked for the secret menu (yes, there is a secret menu, aka 菜单) that she said is for "Asian people." 

The secret menu isn't too different from the regular one so don't feel too bad if you don't have the courage to ask for it but it does have some great Sichuan style dishes (very spicy) that I look forward to trying very soon. I ordered the Marpo Dofu 麻婆豆腐, literally "pockmarked grandma beancurd." Don't let the name fool you, it's the test dish I use to gauge Chinese food and this restaurant passed the test with flying colors with a lingering Sichuan pepper spice coating my mouth. 

I also tried a five spice pork and tofu dish on the secret menu which had a smoky flavor I hadn't tasted since I was in Beijing. 

Oddly enough the only thing here that was so-so was the plain rice. But that's okay, the fried rice was the best I've had in a long time. Also, the pot sticker (饺子) dumplings were handmade, skins and filling. That was a pleasant surprise. They also give you complementary won ton chips with a tangy sweet and sour dipping sauce. 

So bottom line: get your 屁股 here right now. If you're driving through Boise on I-84, stop here as it's right off the freeway next to the water park.

I finally got to try them out after being open a few months. Why they opened a store in the middle of nowhere is beyond me; lot of other great location options in meridian. If I really did like them it'd be a rare occasion since they are so far out in meridian(not even close to eagle road for crying out loud lol). The restaurant is part of a stinkers and is laid out really weird. The kitchen is way in the back which to me decreases efficiency seems like that wasn't give much thought. Service was SLOW SLOW..The guy working the counter was friendly; seemed like he was new needed more training on the register. I waited 20 minutes for loaded potato ole. The food was ho-hum; pretty pricey for what you get I'd say substandard no flavor nothing too spectacular.  I'd say just some frozen tips topped with taco meat and beans all from a can. They have some great daily/happy specials just not driving an hour to eat there especially for slow service and substandard food.

I'm am not a fan of pizza, however we passed this place and I caught a whiff and really wanted to try it. I am so impressed with everything about this place, pizza is absolutely delicious, and the service is incredible. Highly recommend this place, even if you don't like pizza, they will change your mind, they sure changed mine :)

Love this place! Took my family for the first time today and will be back! I love how they don't weigh your cups of yogurt and it is a set price! The chocolate & vanilla yogurts were smooth & on point! I loved the coconut flavor! The orange sorbet type was the best I have had from anywhere! The strawberry banana & pineapple were also very tasty! There was a good assortment of topping and the berries were fresh!  The staff was friendly, the ambiance was clean and fresh with fun pops of orange & a pretty backsplash! The wedding cake flavor tasted off to me, not sure if it was a bad batch or it was my tastebuds. Orange Leaf is now my #1 choice for fro-yo!! Can't wait to go back! 

Went back and I tried the cookies and cream it was awesome and I am impressed with their root beer float flavor!! Wow!!
Absolutely fantastic.  The food is incredible. Never disappointed when we go here. I think I gain a few pounds every time I have been there. It is a loud restaurant but very much worth it.

This place is a gem!  The atmosphere is wonderful and cozy, plenty of Italian vibe to go around.  The food - the appetizer bread is outstanding!  Could be the main course alone.  The pasta was perfect!  Tiramisu amazing.  I can't imagine this place serving anything less than outstanding.  Prices are somewhat steep, but you definitely get what you pay for and it's worth it!

Our server was Jennifer and she gave some of the best service I've ever had.  Very warm and inviting personality combined with professionalism and knowledge of the menu.  She truly made it a wonderful evening and made our experience over the top!

Overall, I highly recommend this place!

I had a very good lunch experience at Rudy's yesterday. The service was pretty good. Our server seemed a little flustered and wasn't very talkative or informative about the menu. She was prompt though,  so that was nice. I was very impressed with the street tacos though. They were on point! They had a decent tap list as well.
This is a great breakfast place. Food is good n the service is even better. N they r generous with their servings.

The best breakfast I have ever eaten! OMG! I would drive 6 hours to eat this- no joke! We ordered the Chorizo Hash and the Prime Rib Melt with their homemade onion rings. 
We are currently in heaven I swear- this food was made by Sweet Baby Jesus himself!

I was hoping this would be a good BBQ addition to Boise, but the recently opened Dave's was not a good experience.  Unlike the previous reviewer, our portions were fine, but the quality was not.  The corn on the cob tasted like it had been in warming water for 5 hours, the ribs were way overcooked, and the brisket was chewy and dry.  The service was good and the food came quickly - apparently too quickly.  It was on the expensive side.  We won't be going back.

To the owners, you need a serious staff change. In particular the employees on shift at 12:35pm on 8/18/2017. One woman is extremely condescending, one doesn't speak loud enough at all, and one was non existent on helping her co workers.
