And the first two women had no idea how to make a new wrap that you offer and were very rude to the gentlemen in front of me ordering one of them. 

If you can, avoid this subway at all costs.

I like Famous Dave's but only gave them 3 stars due the the inconsistency.  My favorite meals are their ribs, however they are sometimes perfect, fall off the bone, and other times a little tough.  I also  love their corn bread muffins, but once again they are inconsistent and sometimes burnt.  I would really recommend the pulled pork sandwich and Famous Dave's has a super delicious side salad.  They make their own dressing and it has a unique flavor to it which I love.  Another favorite is their Famous Margarita.  One pro of Famous Dave's is that they do pretty easy carry out for when you don't feel like dinning in.

Best Chinese food I've ever had.  I was so surprised to actually have TENDER beef in my Double Mushroom dish that I thought it had to be a mushroom!  Amazing!  My cousin was in raptures with his Kung pao chicken (which they made extra spicy for him) and said it was by far the best he's ever had.  Service was also excellent.  Love this place!
Thank you Spencer for coming out and taking care of the carpets and correcting the issue. We greatly appreciate it.

Anxiously awaited for, Fujiyama has opened in Meridian. The sushi was spot on, only thing I wished is that they also used some sauces, especially creative ones. The freshness of the sushi was excellent and I saw some nice looking platters and a boat combo pass by. Some areas to improve but they show great potential.

This location in Meridian, is the perfect example of how one franchise can be so bad and one so good.  This location is BAD.   We arrived for late lunch on a Saturday and seated promptly. They were busy, but not to capacity.  It was about six minutes until our server arrived.  She was pleasant and took our drink order then disappeared.  We sat and sat.  She brought no water nor utensils.  We sat and sat.  She brought our drinks, took our order then disappeared again.  Still no water or utensils.  I finally flagged her down and asked for water and utensils which she brought finally.  The Food: Terrible.  I ordered the Big Red Tavern burger.  For $8.79 one would think it would be something better than ordinary.  It wasn't.  Comparable  to a "fast food" burger for  $3.99. My GF ordered the catfish with steamed veggies.  Her portions were tiny and they gave her french-fries instead of veggies.  We brought this to the attention of our occasional server.  She was clueless about the meal, but brought the veggies, which were barely warm.  My burger was so small that I kept requesting the "bottomless steak fries" and took bites only intermittently.  The Food: Inconstant and mediocre.    The Service: Slow and slower.  The exact opposite of our experience at the Milwaukee location.  We won't ever return to the Meridian Red Robin for any reason.
This is one of the best Italian places in Idaho.  Very busy but meal was excellent.
Went to Gino's Saturday night. I had the most delicious salmon I think I have ever had. And the risotto was great...not too rich. My husband had Osso Buco which was a yummy as always.

F*ck bomb @$$ rockstar smoothies. The Human Bean and Dutch Bros do rockstar smoothies but I've been searching for a place that makes them better. So smooth, no unflavored ice like Dutch bros, no creamy residue like the human bean. Just wish they would give you the can of the rest of the unused rockstar like human bean does.

We decided to try this place out, since thus far our Italian experience in Boise and surrounding cities has been pretty good.  My family and I showed up and waited about 5 minutes to be seated while the hostess was chatting on the phone...  I understand he was taking someones order, but someone else could've picked up the slack.  When he finally got off the phone to welcome us the waitress "pretended" to have some interest in seating us popping her head around the corner and acting like she was concerned.   Our initial greeting to this place was, well unwelcoming, ALAS!, we soldiered on.... We sat down the waitress brought us some water bread and oil dipping concoction (which was phenomenal!) Then while we were asking about the menu she interrupts us tells us she has an order up and takes off.  5 minutes later she comes and gets our drinks...another few minutes she finally comes back with out drinks and to take our order...  Well this was not a great start to what is an allegedly great place.  I ordered stuff shell with Italian sausage my kids spaghetti and the wife fettuccine  with a ragu roast beef and prosciutto.  The food came out pretty quickly, which was a pleasant change in pace from what we where experiencing.  My kids loved their spaghetti they gobbled it up... and these little demons hate everything... all they want are hamburgers and gogurts.  My wife enjoyed her noodles, she even commented that they had a home made feel and taste to them,  but the roast was tough and the prosciutto non existent.  My stuffed shells had an obvious good flavor to them and would have LOVED them with one exception, I felt like they dropped a salt lick in it.  When I got to the shell without the crazy saltiness it was deliciousness melt in you mouth goodness...but it was ruined with the crazy amount of salt.... In any case I doubt well be coming back here...if your up for a drive try out cucina di paolo instead
Can here for a girls night and got wine and pizza. It was delicious - we had a great time and the wine/pizza were amazing!

The service was absolutely terrible this evening. I get that it is New Year's Eve but we waited almost 15 minutes for somebody to even talk to us when we walked in the door. We had a reservation but they didn't know if they had a table for us. Took a long time to order drinks... had two different people waiting on us. The lady was very in your face rushing the entire process.. took 35 minutes for our appetizer and soups to come. We finally got our food after being there for an hour and a half. The food was mediocre, some plates not hot at all. One of our friends soup was so hot it was almost boiling so beware! Good luck also fighting stomach bubbles

I was in town visiting my parents. My mother spotted this place at the corner of a strip mall in a business park on a Sunday morning. I'm glad we stopped in. By far the best meal I had my entire visit (we ate out 3 times a day for four days, no chain restaurants). I had the best corned beef hash I've ever had. Everything we had was great. Our server was so nice and had no problem answering our questions about the menu items. I would come here all of the time if I lived in town.
Come check it out!!

This new arrival to the growing number of barbeque restaurants here in Boise is called "Famous Dave's." My wife & I just moved to the Eagle Rd area from Nampa. When we first moved in, I remember seeing this new building along Eagle Rd.

Like pretty much everyone else, when I see something new coming to the area, I have to know what it is. One day while I was driving, I saw the sign saying "Famous Dave's barbeque. My first reaction was; "Famous, Yeah Right!" Being from Texas, I consider myself to be a barbeque aficionado and connoisseur. In other words, I live eat and breathe barbeque, and I know the real thing when I find it. The problem with barbeque is that everyone thinks they know how to do it, yet very few actually do. I have seen so called "Famous" barbeque restaurants come around before, but it seems that more often than not, they disappoint me. 

Well, this time, I have to eat my words. But if they were covered with one of 'Famous Dave's" barbeque sauces, Id be glad to. 

My wife, myself and my 4 year old daughter went to Famous Dave's on a Sunday afternoon after church. Now when I evaluate a new restaurant, that evaluation starts at the door. I expect the restaurants décor to follow the theme of the restaurant. In other words, if the restaurant is Chinese, I expect it to look and feel Chinese. If it's Mexican, I expect it to look and feel Mexican. If the restaurant is based on good Southern barbeque, I expect it to look, feel & smell like a barbeque restaurant from the South. 

Famous Dave's is a not a hoity-toity place at all. It is a simple place with simple, but southern style, decorations serving good Southern Style barbeque. The next most important part of my evaluation is the waitress or waiter. Our servers name was Lisa. She was hands down, one of the best servers I have ever had the pleasure to be severed by. She made several wonderful comments to our 4 year old and just made our experience very enjoyable. 

My wife had ribs & brisket. You have to know my wife. She just does not eat ribs. However, Lisa made them sound so good, that my wife just could not resist. The flavor of the ribs was even better than the brisket, which I did not think possible. The meat fell off the bone and was mostly lean. The smoky flavor of the ribs was undeniably hickory.

The melt-in-your mouth brisket had a deep smoky flavor and was very good. I did notice though that it lacked a smoke ring and that blackened crust. 

In addition to the Brisket, I also had the catfish. This was the one downfall to our otherwise wonderful meal. When I was in Texas, my main staples were Brisket, Mexican food, and Catfish. Now catfish in the South has almost no flavor of its own. That's why you usually find it coated with a flavorful batter, deep fried and then served with a good tarter sauce. So whenever I see catfish on a menu up here, I just have to try it, holding out hope that it will measure up to Texas catfish. 

I am very sad to say that I was again disappointed. The Catfish I was served went limp when I picked it up. Either it was not deep fried, or the person that fried it did not know what they were doing. It had a very flat, poor coating on it and tasted extremely fishy. My daughter had the chicken strips, which were also non-descript. The fries were steak cut, crunchy and had a good flavor. My pet peeve of restaurants here in the Boise area is sweet tea. Very few restaurants offer it and I have no idea why. These restaurants just don't seem to comprehend that sugar does not melt in cold beverages. Perhaps they did to go back and take that Science class again. If tea is not sweetened when it's still warm, it will never be sweet tea. Famous Dave's has real sweet tea. All I can say to that is Hallelujah! 

Finally a restaurant in Boise that serves sweet tea.

The other star of the menu was Famous Dave's' barbeque sauces. You can choose from Dave's Original Rich and Sassy, Georgia Mustard, Texas Pit, Sweet & Zesty, and my favorite, the Devils Spit. Now I could write up a full review on all these sauces, but I think I will leave them for you to try. The only thing I will say here; if you like it hot, try the devils Spit. It's not overly hot, but it did bring me to a full sweat. (Our saying in Texas is; "If it don't make you sweat, it aint worth your time!") 

There were a couple oddities that I found worth mentioning. Good southern barbeque restaurants serve rolls. Rolls should not only be served before the meal as appetizers, but should be around for after-the-meal sopping of the sauce. Instead of rolls, Famous Dave's serves cornbread. The cornbread was good, though a bit too sweet for my taste and it was served as cupcakes. This served to remind me that Famous Dave's roots are not in the South, but in Wisconsin. 

Up until now, my main barbeque squeeze here in the Boise area was Goodwood. 

Now that Famous Dave's is here, move out of the way Goodwood, there is a new sheriff in town!
My favorite was the Brussels sprouts.  The end tips were also super.  The service was friendly.

Hey Ryan C we're with you on this one! Pricey, wonky equipment you pay extra for, wasn't available; even after waiting 50 mins...hahaha! Management also needs to replace the punk, high schooler staff with inflated egos here.

OMG, this place is foodie nirvana.  We got the Nu Flavor Rolls, an appetizer that is off the freakin' hook, but not something I would normally order.  They were these crazy tempura topped sushi-style roll, with little tempura shrimp on top, avacado, jalapenos,cream cheese, and god only knows what else,  absolutely yum!  My hubby ordered the burger, which was topped with bacon, friend egg, lettuce, tomato, crazy sauce, and the burger itself had cheese melted right in the middle of the patty, it was the size of my kids head, and he did his best, but just couldn't finish it.  Delish!  My kid got the sliders, and consumed both of them!  (he is 5), then sat back with his hands behind his head with a big smile on his face.  I haven't seen him eat that much in a very long time.     For my main dish I had the shrimp with garlic chili paste sauce over  an insanely good potato pancake, this crazy carmelized corn in a sweet sauce, (also had the choice of green beans if you aren't into the corn) and  served with their wonderful cornbread.  I don't know what else to say other than I could not stop eating, and really needed to stop myself before exploding.   
 The service was excellant too.  Our waiter, Keegan was the nicest guy, who gave us the recommendation for the Nu Flavor rolls, which some other patrons piped right up to give their thumbs up too.  He really made us feel like old friends.  Last time we were there I had the chicken and waffles, and my hubby got the Korean tacos, which he adored,and they are only $2 a piece?  What?!  Seriously, one of the best places to eat in Meridian.  Wow!

The food was great, but the service lacked greatly. They had to run across the street to refill our sodas, and I finally got so thirsty I just ordered water, which came with 3 pieces of ices and three floating "unknown" objects.  Their sushi-boat concept is a cool idea, but they don't explain it to you so we didn't know how it worked until we had spent the money on rolls.  I'm not a sushi expert, but I guess I was supposed to know how it worked.  The service was slow, and there was nothing telling us what each roll was on the boat. I would NOT suggest this for a lunch-hour, you won't get in and out in your hour.

Slowly this place has been declining, just everything about it is no longer a good experience.  Short to the point here is my how they earned 2 stars from me... well more like 1.5. 

 A friend wanted Betos for breakfast so I obliged and upon entry I noticed the dirty floor just littered with scraps of food (so far not so good).  Service was quick and we recieved our food as in a timely manner, my first bite sadly was Luke warm.  It felt like parts of the burrito was hotter then others, flavor was okay as it was the breakfast one.  We also ate and recieved a show from a couple who obviously had no problems with pda in the workplace.  She was working the drive through and started kissing the guy right in front of everyone.  This was only trumped by the same man eating back by the window, dropping food and eating it.  I even pictured him taking a bit ole bite in the dining room, I understand people eat but do it away from your customers.  My friend and I both talked about it and if he would eat food from the ground then what would he serve US?
 
  They have some delicious food here but I would eat with caution. You have been warned

My family and I have been going to Gino's for at least 15 years.  When our children were young, Gino himself would come to our table and talk to us and ask how everything was and always complimented our well behaved children too.  Really meant a lot!  The food and service are phenomenal. Best marinara and pasta, bread and garlic oil  I've ever eaten...and I've had a ton of Italian food in my lifetime even in little Italy.  Some of the best servers in the valley work at Gino's.  Love this place!

I got the vegetable sushi and LOVED it. So delicious, and they definitely get points for authenticity. Great place to go if you're vegan like myself and want to have options for your non vegan friends/family/significant other.
The egg rolls here are amazing. I don't know if there is anything here not amazing. The soft noodle for the chow main is worth the extra money. This is a nice family location.

Ordered small Caesar salad with chicken for a light dinner. Lettuce was watery,  dressing was either watered down or seemed that way due to the wet lettuce. The portion of chicken was very small... 1/4 beast at best. Chicken was cold,  so was not fresh either. Ice tea came out only slightly tinted compared to water,  had to send back.

I just went to the new Gino's in Meridian this past week and wow was it fantastic!  They fill up quickly so totally recommend that you make reservations or go sometime before 6pm.

Italian food can be tricky...if you don't get it right, for me, there is no recovery.  Not an issue here.  I had the lasagna, which wasn't a traditional lasagna and I LOVED it!  It was filled with about 5 different kinds of meat and the sauce was fantastic.  Friends joining me had the meatballs and gnocci.

This is a definite "go back" establishment.

I have been a Rumbi fan for years! I typically order the South Sea's Chicken salad. I love the mix of soba noodles with greens and the spicy/ tangy dressing. 
I have also tried the rice bowls. I love the option of customizing your bowl. I usually opt for brown rice and teriyaki chicken. 
The Rumbi fries are the perfect side with any entree. It's a mix of sweet potato fries and normal fries, complete with fry sauce. 
I would recommend this place to anyone. It's a nice change from your typical burger!

3.5 star-4.5star

Difficult to rate.  I'll explain.

The park is VERY nice and well kept.  The staff is wonderful and happy.  The lanes are paved and curbed.  Nice green little lawns - well taken care of.  Nice location, but street modification makes getting here off the freeway a bit confusing if you've never been to the park.  No it is no problem.  The price is VERY reasonable for what they offer and the nature of the park.  Been in worse for more money.

Fairly quiet (they did have races close by tonight, but that shut down at a decent hour).

The facilities are immaculate!

A slight drawback is the pool is indoors- just not my thing, but the plus is that it can be open in cooler weather.

The real negative is the sights and the lanes.  Aaahhh!  You barely fit in the sites (40 ft 5th wheel) and have to intrude right up to our backyard neighbor's bumper to fit.  Also, they are narrow...quite narrow for the way you must park.  It is difficult to tell where your site ends and your neighbor's begins.

Also, while making the turn to get to our sight (and they are tight turns) I very narrowly escaped a complete disaster in the form of striking a motorhome's awning and MIRROR that literally hung out right to the street due to size and angle of the end site.

All in all.  We would ABSOLUTELY stay here again.  Why not?  Now we at used to the perks and the quirks.

Oh!  Did I mention there is a Starbucks about 2.5 blocks away!!

Disclaimer: I didn't get to eat here. Showed up at 10:30AM on a sunday. There was a substantial line, which is ok. But then I saw the waiters had prepped two big empty tables for a large party, which kept them busy and not catering to anyone else (there were I think three other empty tables). Once the large party was seated (about 9 people and some kids) there was still a large number of people waiting on the benches. An old couple said to take their name off the list and angrily  said they wouldn't be back. Fine, I guess, more room for me. But then the waitress seemed very flustered as to who was on the list and who wasn't. I was skipped over by three other parties who arrived after me even though I was quite literally standing next to the waitress. For a while confusion reigned supreme when I just decided it's not worth it and left. I'll give this place another shot later... after a significant cooling off period.

I haven't been to all of Chinese restaurants here in town but, I been to a lot of them. This place is my disputable #1 place in Treasure valley(other being in DT Boise). When you look at Food, price and setting, this place is Wonderful choice for any occasion for small to big groups. 
Every items are a great choice. We try to order at least one new items every time my family goes here.
It is the best in town for sure!
Good food.  Nice People.  The place is very clean, and I have not had a bad dish there in 4 times eating there. I recomend it.
This expierance left us wanting . surching for a good buger lots of frya and a retreat from the heat and noise ... Pick someplace els.
This is my second time here and I got the fiesta hash both times, I love it. This time the chips in it are not that good so that's why it got the 4 stars.
Don't waste your time or had earned money here. The brisket I had was not BBQ. Not sure what they do, microwave it or what but I left food on the table. Chicken was dry, I mean saw dust dry.

This is my go to for Mexican fast food and is a great place to grab a quick bite. The burritos are pretty good, decent size and a good price. They have a salsa bar with all kinds of salsa from mild to very hot. The meat is moist and not over cooked.  This is not a typical taqueria but more like a authentic version of Taco bell.

SLOW! I know good food cannot be rushed, but a 42 minute wait between ordering an omelet and receiving it is extraordinary. Yes the food was good but you better not have the whole morning open when going here.

Yes...it is a little pricey...but wow! Our breakfasts were awesome...all of them. Normally at least 1 in 5 plates is mediocre...but this place was 5 out of 5. BTA yum! If they have Banana Bread French Toast...GET IT!

Not sure what else to say...we loved it. Go there!

So disappointing. This location recently went "corporate" and the quality has decreased enough for those of us who were regulars to start bailing. My last visit included watching the kitchen cut open bags and pour soups and dips into bowls and serve. I don't think I had ever seen them use the microwave as often as they did that night. Not sure if we'll go back. Such a bummer!

Went in at 5pm for my 4 years old haircut. First time being to a sports clips and i do not think i will be going back. Very rude person who said i can't put you on the waiting list we have an hour wait and we close at 6. Didnt even apologize or offer the hours for the next day with out being prompted. My 4 year old said mommy thst lady was very rude. Sad when a 4 year old notices someone being rude. Wont be going back

Unfortunely, we had a terrible experience here. I wanted so much to enjoy the food and atmosphere but the service was so bad, it just couldn't be compensated for. I will also mention that Shige in downtown Boise is my favorite sushi joint in the area so that makes this an even more difficult review.  Don't waste your money or the two hours you will sit (hungry) here.

Call them first! You won't be disappointed. Our garage door was sticking and wouldn't go down and we didn't know why. We called and Paul set us up the next day. Kevin called that night to let me know when he would be by. It was snowing so he called that day to say he was running late. He came to our house after having already been on 17 calls that day! He was so fast and helpful. Turns out, all we needed was a chain greased because it was so cold. He didn't charge us for his time. This is the kind of service with integrity that I appreciate. Thank you, Hanson!!!

Great breakfast! Wonderful service! The host and servers were all friendly and helpful. I had the garden hash with poached eggs, which comes with toast. Loved the Marionberry jam. Good coffee. Such a delicious meal! Great price. I found this hidden treasure on Yelp and will definitely return next time I'm in town.

This one of our fav. restaurants to go to. My 5 year old loves their bread & dipping oil. We came for lunch today and everything was good as usual. We had Italian Nachos w/chicken as an appetizer, Spicy Romano Chicken, Grilled Chicken Bowtie Festival, and Broccoli Chicken Penne. We also had orange, raspberry and strawberry cream Italian sodas. We loved our waiter, Jessi. He was nice, attentive and catered to our needs. We'll be back!
The staff here are so personable and friendly, my favorite drive through bank in town. Never a bad experience and always giving me their A game, big kudos to this location !

My husband and I are breakfast eaters.  We love to have breakfast out on Saturday mornings.  Moe Joe's is our new favorite in the valley.  The menu is interesting and delicious.  I am a huge fan of the Chef telling me how the food should taste, as opposed to having me season with a ton of salt and Tabasco at the table, AND a really good pancake doesnt need to be slathered in syrup, it has great flavor all on its own.  Moe Joe's delivers deliciousness on a plate.  We have tried many things off the menu and have been impressed with each choice.

* My favorites are Donut's and a cup of Joe (for when I want sweet) , and the Farm House (for when I want savory).  

Go there now!  It will not disappoint.

Wow, the best breakfast ever. Fresh and deliciously prepared. Been coming here for a week and all I can say is that everything is made to perfection. Looking at the reviews I can see why it's the best place in Boise for breakfast and lunch.

We have been here many times. Why I am not sure. Well, maybe I do know why. Johnny Carino's is close by.

We live in Meridian, so coming here is convenient. But just like in life, the things that are the most convenient are not always the best. 

Often its the hard things to get to that are the best and most rewarding. Such in the case with Johnny Carino's.

Its close, so we can get to dinner, and then back home with very little effort. But, and this is a awfully big butt, you will find much better Italian food elsewhere.

Like I said, we have been here quite a few times. Each time, we tell ourselves that it will be our last. But I guess its a bit like going to McDonalds, or seeing that bad boy down the street.

You know that its not good for you at all, but you just cant help yourself. Or its like that movie that you went to see at the theater that you hated.

Even though the movie turned your stomach, you just could not leave the theater. Maybe I was because you were determined to get your moneys worth no matter what.

Maybe it was just another example of those bad things in life that we crave. Whatever the reason, you stayed and watched that horrible movie then told yourself afterwards that those were 2 hours of your life that you would never get back.

Johnny Carino's falls in this same category. While I would not say that I hated the food, I would not say that it was good either.

I will say that the potato soup is very good. Its a creamy soup with potatoes, bacon, and green onions. Its always the highlight of our meal. But when the appetizer is the best part of the meal, that is a good sign that something is wrong.

Every time we have come here, there has been an issue with our meal. On the last trip, my wife had the chicken fettuccine. It had little to no flavor at all, so my wife sent it back.

On another trip, the chicken was not quite done. On yet another, we found a hair in our food. I wont go on anymore with that.

My daughter always has an Italian Soda. These are good, but pretty easy to do, so not a fair evaluation of a restaurant. 

I have had the chicken Parmesan here as well. It is ok, but no where as good as others I have had. For what you get, the prices are a big high.

Every time we have come, there are very people here. I would not be at all surprised if they dont make it much longer. I suspect that now that now that the Village is open, many places in the Meridian area are feeling the economic pinch. 

Personally, I dont think that the restaurants in The Village are that great, and they are over priced, but I am sure that the rent there is astronomical. The village is a fun place to go though. I look forward to eating at that place that is above the theater and writing up a review on it. 

Well, I suppose I had better get back to this review first.

The inside is old and tired. I often take flake for being too critical. To these naysayers I say pooh. 

Those of us that write reviews like this as hoping for the best, not the worst. We are always searching for good quality restaurants that are doing a good job. The main reason though is that I hope that Johnny Carino's will read these reviews, take them to heart, and improve.

Reviews, and Constructive Criticism is a restaurants best friend. At least it should be. If a restaurant owner and manager wants to stay competitive, and in many cases stay in business, they need to be reading what their customers have to say and making changes that will help them keep their doors open.

For now, if you want good Italian food, I recommend Olive Garden. They are not perfect either, but then again, there is no such thing. I would like to say that we wont be back here, but sometimes in life, you just dont the time or patience for better. So its quite possible that we will be back.

I have driven by this strip mall 10 times and kept noticing the sign for this restaurant.  My friend was in town visiting and we wanted to try something different and I remembered this place.  The location is very unassuming and you might even pass it by because it is in a strip mall, but that would be a mistake.

If you are in the mood for good southern cooking with a flare, then you need to give this place a try.  They deep fried pickles and macaroni and cheese balls are a must and if you go on a Friday night, they have Gumbo - the good stuff you can get in the south.  

The service was great - the chef even came out to check on us a couple of times!  They also do catering.

I pass this place all the time, always eyeing the drive thru. Today in hopes of feeling better after drinking too much on super bowl Sunday I hit the drive thru for a bacon, potato, egg breakfast burrito. It was really dry, I ordered a soda which tasted awful. Service was friendly and the price was reasonable. I may have just had a bad experience. Definitely worth trying again.

Love Gino's!! We first went to the restaurant when we were visiting from the Bay Area and since we moved to the Treasure Valley it has become one of our favorite places to go. 

The food is wonderful, very fresh and the service has always been friendly  and efficient.  They have a wonderful seating area outside and nice ambiance inside.

This restaurant is one of many that tend to follow a pattern:

Add sugar to a bunch of meat, add a ton of carbs and a few vegetables and voila authentic (insert ethnicity here) cuisine. 

Rumbi is yet another chain that in many ways is matches Costa Vida, Cafe Rio, etc... The formula is the same. Sweet pork, teriyaki chicken,  honey orange mixed with rice. Add a small amount of veggies. Load a plate with enough rice to feed a small Vietnamese family and your have "authentic" island food. 

The sauces taste like they came from gallon plastic jugs. The meat tastes like it was emptied from food service bags. The seasoning is just enough as to not offend the American palate. This is massed produced sugar meat with basic roughage and rice. 

When are Idahoans going to stop paying into the pork swill franchises with their predictable menus and support real restaurateurs? When we do, we'll see more places like Kahootz in Meridian.
Kahuna burger is just as good as a banzai burger from red robin. The sweet potato Fries are nothing to write home about. The regular fries are actually awful. Great service tho.

I order a couple fish tacos, one on flour tortilla and one on corn. I got there about 8:35pm and although they close at 9pm, the crew was in the middle of breakdown, grills were being scrubbed, etc.  My flour tortilla was burned and crispy, nasty.  My corn tortilla fish taco had a decent flavor but when I opened up my taco to squeeze my lime, I couldn't find any fish.  The tiny chunks of fish blended in with the shredded cabbage.  Not worth $8.  One more thing.  As my girlfriend was finishing her nachos, they decided to throw something on the grill to scrub it and it made the whole restaurant smell disgusting.  I felt bad, I rushed my girlfriend out of there so my clothes wouldn't pick up the nasty smell of burnt smell of the grill.  I have to be honest, I am SO TIRED of going into a restaurant near closing time an experiencing people sweeping around me, people spraying chemicals on tables next to me and for the whole kitchen being broken down before closing time.  OWNERS OF RESTAURANTS, PLEASE LISTEN.  If your establishment closes at 9pm, then start the cleaning after 9pm.  Someone who comes at 8:30pm doesn't get a discount on your food to feel rushed, unwelcomed by your minimum wage employees.  I am so tired of bad customer service.  When will a restaurant step up and make people feel like they are getting their moneys worth with good food and service.  Employees begin to break down as the manager or owners have instructed them.  If you close at 9pm, then just plan to be cleaning from 9-10pm.

I love Red Robin and their food, we will return, but NOT to this location!!  There is somebody by the name of Deann or Deanne, she has been in the bar both times we have been there lately. The first time we sat in her section, she had nasty attitude which immediately encouraged us to leave her section and sit elsewhere!  
We returned at a later date to the same location, sat in the bar area, and got horrible attitude AGAIN and realized it was the same B.  Unfortunately she was the only person in the bar area so we stuck it out. Not only her attitude, but her service was just as ridiculous!!
Maybe she should realize that the fries Red Robin offers as "bottomless"  aren't coming from her personal stash or something.  I am sure there are plenty more for her after her shift.
Also Its not a chore to serve us, it your JOB.  Find a new one if you hate it so bad. 

Twice isn't an accident or just "having a bad day" she needs to get it together if she is going to work anywhere in the customer service industry!!!  :(
Best pizza in the world. We get pepperoni with fresh tomatoes on after its baked. We crave this constantly and probably go once a week. Oops

Three words:  Braised Boar Shank.

Enough said - try it.  I've never tasted anything like it.  And it is truly unforgettably savory!
This is my favorite breakfast place. Pan cakes are delicious and the menu choices are a plenty. Many more options other than eggs and sausage.

It was ok, very typical not bad at all just not great, flavor wise. Portions were good.
I would go back.

How sad and what a shame.  My wife and I have been going to this restaurant and their other location on Milwaukee almost every week for the last four years and have loved it.  This new location is not quite as good as the other though.  Went there today on Valentine's Day and I was told that I could not order their lunch special due to being a holiday.  The Sushi/Sashimi combination that I wanted to order is $14+ so not a cheap selection.  I explained that we were loyal and regular customers and would appreciate if they allowed us to order it and was told 'No'.  My question is....What holiday is it?  Is it the same for MLK Day, Presidents Day, Arbor Day, St. Patricks Day etc?  Our lunch bill each week is around $40 which is not a small amount for lunch for two people and it's $40 that they will no longer get from us.  The manager on duty said that she was not allowed to okay this order and wanted me to wait until she called her boss.  All for an additional few dollars or less.  How short sighted.  It's not the amount that I would pay for lunch but their stupidity and not appreciating loyal customers when there are so many restaurants that would love to have our weekly $40.

This was our first experience at the Meridian location, and unfortunately it will be our last.  We have eaten at the Portland, Oregon locations several times and we always had fabulous service and food.  Sadly, this was not the case at the Meridian location.
We arrived around 7:30pm on a Thursday evening.  The hostess was very friendly.  She asked if we preferred to be seated in the dining room or the lounge.  Since we were on a date, without our children we chose the lounge.  After being seated we waited more than 15 minutes and nobody came to our table.  Several servers were standing at the bar and made eye contact with us, but still nobody came over. Eventually, since we had children that were with a babysitter and we had to get home, we left. The same hostess that had seated us watched us walk out the door without saying a word.  Later in the evening my husband called to inform the manager of our experience.  The most unfortunate thing is the manager "Famous" Wes absolutely did not care.  He did not apologize or invite us back. He did not say he would give the staff any feedback. He gave some excuse about them changing shifts.  I have spent several years working in the restaurant industry, and in every establishment I have worked in you do not ignore customers.  If there is going to be some delay in service, you inform your customer. If you notice a table has been left unattended, you go figure out who is supposed to be taking care of that table!  Also, if I were the manager in such an establishment I would want to make sure I corrected the problem. After all, the customer is who insures you get a paycheck!  Wes...you my friend need a lesson in customer service! We will not be back.
The food was ok and the service was extremely slow for being there right at noon and being one of only two tables with people in the restaurant.

Ordered a large pizza with a bunch of toppings.  One of which was onions.

One would think the onions would be caramelized or at least, oh I don't know, cooked.  Completely raw.

Was not filling at all, way overpriced, and just not very satisfying.
For a fast food taco restaurant it's good the meat taste fresh there are pretty quick and the lobby is always clean

I would give this place ZERO stars if possible. I am a regular customer with a pretty standard order. Wanted to take my girlfriend here Saturday night. We sat at the bar and before I could even order my standard Diet Coke (this place has Diet Pepsi), got asked for ID in a condescending obnoxious tone. I am 33 almost 34. Obnoxious. My girlfriend did not have her ID on her, but I had a photo of it on my phone. I had sent it to her a couple weeks prior. Obnoxious bartender girl on a power trip wouldn't let us sit and eat at the bar. I could deal with that but not her obnoxious attitude. She had a definite chip on her shoulder, glad she enjoyed her 30 seconds of power. Well, her rudeness has cost the company a good, long-term customer.

Again, stellar service from the bar top on a friday night. Continuing my "let's try something new" I tried the salmon sandwich.  If you like or are craving fish, it definitely satisfies that craving. I wanted sushi but the boyfriend wanted burgers. Let's just say we both got our fix. 
Campfire sauce and bottomless fries always a plus, I've said it before. Again my good experiences outweigh my bad, so I can't say anything bad about the place.
I highly recommend the Mad Love or the Wiskey River burgers if you want deliciousness
Great service, just another brick oven pizza. Was good but not worth the money you have to pay for each topping you want on it.

I hate it when the person who is charged with removing plates, etc...walks past your table 12 times and is actually disappointed that you have not rushed through your meal so you can leave and they can seat the next wave.

Food was good, but the occasion was ruined by the consistant feeling that you have to hurry.

I never stayed in a place that doesn't make up your room everyday. "We are an extended stay hotel we don't offer that" I was told. I asked for fresh towels never got them. So basically $117. A night for just a bed. Yea I've been ripped off. Stick with best westerns you know what your getting.

Ok, what is all the fuss about this place?  Ordered two tacos today, one fish, one shrimp.  $7.45 for the two.  Yikes.  But wait, gets better!  First she dumps the frozen shrimp and fish on the grill, dumps a bunch of sauce on top -- ok -- then dumps a huge ladle of oil on top.  It just kept running all over the grill.  It was pretty gross.  Then I get up to the register and she charges me $8.15 for the two.  Huh?? Apparently, if I order two tacos with rice AND beans, it's $7.45.  But ala carte, $8.15.  Soooo, I paid MORE for NO beans and rice.  Yup, confirmed by the owner who was standing nearby.  He said that he only owns the place, the pricing is from corporate!!!  So, if he were smart, he would ring it with rice and beans, the HOLD THE RICE AND BEANS!  Genius! Going to Qdoba from now on.  Much better prepared.
Pretty delicious old school Italian. My husband went bananas over the boar shank. I think they could stand to add a few vegetarian options to the menu.
Best breakfast I have ever had and the service was great! I will be back here next time I'm in town.
Delicious, great service, and beautiful patio! The manager Jerry was so attentive to us and they also had great servers. The pizza was phenomenal and the cheesecake was great too! We'll be back!
The best little hidden secret in Meridian, Idaho. Best breakfast food ever. I recommend it to any one looking for a nice locally owned and ran cafe. We have eaten there about 6 times.

I love this shop for many reasons.  They are extremely nice and helpful there, they have a wide price range for yarns, and a decent selection.  I can rarely go in without buying something.  My only beef?  I always want more yarn.  More, more, more.  Went in looking for a white or off-white DK or worsted weight yarn, and could only find one in mostly acrylic, which is less expensive but I don't really like acrylic.  So, keep growing, little shop!  Get me more yarn!

Best breakfast I have had in a very long time.  I had the chicken hash. I have never had anything like it before.  It was 5 star. My husband had the smoke house hash and thought the same thing.  Good service.  If I come back to Boise I will definitely go back

This is a great Fred Meyer store. I always have friendly and helpful checkers  every time I shop.I always find what I need, the store is clean and well stocked. I like the selection of organic items and  vegan/vegetarian items too. Wine selection is excellent. The garden area has healthy plants and the products for birds are pretty extensive. Overall, a wonderful store.
My favorite Chinese place by far here in Idaho. Always delivered fast and always hot and fresh.

We came here on my son's 4th birthday and even though I told 2 hostesses, and reminded our waiter 3 - 4 times, no one came out to sing to him. After we ate, our server was MIA so I  told another server and still nothing happened. A while later, our server came out and sang to a table near us (someone else's birthday), but it still didn't jog his memory that there was a little boy waiting for his moment at our table.

Then we received our bill. So I went to find a manager who eventually brought out half-melted ice cream and the staff FINALLY sang to my son. We never got an apology or explanation from our server. The whole ordeal took way too long and I was shocked at the poor customer service. We definitely won't spend another birthday meal here.

I also dislike the iPad-type device at each table, begging kids to tap the screen. Our server wouldn't remove it, so it became an un-fun parenting moment for me. Kids these days need LESS screen time - not more.

Grimaldi's chain location in the Boise area is in the Village at Meridian.  They have a location in the northwest corner of the main fountain area with a large patio.  They make thin crust pies with more or less traditional toppings.  They have a nice sweet sauce and put ample cheese on the pizzas, with a chewy crust that has some solid yeast flavor, so you know that it's proofed over time.  The place is decorated like you would imagine a nice Brooklyn family restaurant would be in a TV show, not a knock, it's attractively trite.  The pizzas don't come out super fast, so this I'd recommend a salad to help you along.  They have a great caesar.  They have a full bar and a decent wine list.  I would say one of their large pizzas with salads, would feed 3-4 reasonable appetites.  If you are looking to eat here I would block out at least 1.5 hours and see if you can call ahead or get a reservation on a weekend as it gets busy.  Once seated, I have had good service here without fail.

Where one could complain is the prices.  If you go in thinking of this as a pizza joint, you might be a little steamed when you get your bill.  If you think of it as an Italian restaurant specializing in pizza, maybe a little less so.  My wife and I are usually in to this place close to $100 by the time we have salads, pizza and a bottle or few glasses of wine and tip.  You can certainly get by for less at some other pizza places in town with at least as good pizza.  You are paying for professional servers, a nice atmosphere, people/fountain watching, and the ability to walk to your movie at the Village. Certainly cutting out the wine and the salads can bring the price down considerably.  

I recommend Grimaldi's.  Being blessed with great pizza options in Boise and having somewhat sufficient self control to not eat pizza three times a week, we only get to this place a couple of times a year, but I'm thinking I'm due for another run.

Recently, while in the Boise area I stayed at the Candlewood Suites - Meridian three nights and was pleasantly surprised. Parking was a breeze, the staff was very courteous, my room was spacious and included several extra amenities (i.e. kitchenette, DVD player).   

The facilities included a fitness room, jacuzzi, laundry room and mini-store. I priced a couple of microwave dinners at their mini-store, and their prices were quite reasonable. I understand a light breakfast is served in the morning and is included, however, I usually have large dinners, then pass on breakfast while on vacations.  

Candlewood Suites is conveniently located just east of S. Eagle Road, about 1/2 mile south of I-84. I was able to drive to downtown Boise in about 10-15 minutes. For nearby restaurants, there are several fast food and full restaurants on N. Eagle Road, just north of I-84, 5-15 minutes from the hotel.

In summary, I must give Candlewood Suites a 5-Star rating because of their friendly staff, my comfy room, and great amenities for the price. And, amazingly it was very quiet too.

The next time I'm in the Boise area, I'll be sure to book my stay at this particular Candlewood Suites. And next time I'll be sure to bring a couple of cartons (48 hours worth) of Ben & Jerry's to place in the room's freezer!  

Candlewood Suites Staff, Thank you for an enjoyable stay!

The wings were soggy. It's disappointing when you choose aplace and end up with the product at home that you're unwilling to eat but that was our experience and is an experience that I won't duplicate again. I don't to say the size of the wing was a little bigger than what I would expect- maybe steroids

Very good authentic Mexican food! I was pleasantly surprised this unassuming restaurant kicks out some legit Mexican food. As a Californian traveling through Boise, I have a pretty high standard of authenticity. This place did not disappoint! I had the Camarones y Carne Asada platter. Perfectly seasoned, loads of grilled veggies, good salsa bar and huge portions. I'll definitely be back.
Great service, buffet was good. Bbq chicken was ok, ribs were not the best. Pilaf rice was clumpy a bit.
Came for breakfast and it was delicious, great and reasonably priced. Recommend for breakfast.
If there are more than 6 people in the restaurant.. LEAVE! The their staff can only handle a few patrons at a time.

Wow! The breakfast here is good!  My wife and I have been two or three times and have never been disappointed.  

Their hashes, pancakes and other items are delicious and if you like eggs, this is the place to go.  Last time I was there I asked for my eggs sunny side up and they were perfect.  

This little place is popular and depending on the day or time you go, you might have to wait, but it is worth it! 

By the way, be prepared to take some home for later because the portions are big.
Super friendly staff always ready to help with a smile. I had the chicken and shrimp over noodles, was so good! And the  sweet potato fries were yummy. I also suggest the mango salsa.

I had not been here in a very long time. Since I was in the neighborhood and was starving, I decided to have a quick/light meal. I was in time for the lunch menu. I was seated in the bar. The hostess helped me choose between what would suit my tastes, and what was most requested.  I tried the Roasted Garlic  Potato soup,  and it was very filling and delicious. I had the Spicy Shrimp and Chicken Penne Pasta dish. It was pretty quick but very filling. My server was very nice, and was kept pretty busy.  I will be back.

I love this Pizza! Get any pizza you can't go wrong.   have done dine in and delivery. They have a really great lunch special. It's very busy around lunch time for that reason. I highly recommend their chicken bacon club sandwich.  It's serviced on homemade bread. Check out special of the month or the lunch specials.

Best lunch buffet around. All you can eat pizza and salad bar. Great local flavors. Also good lunch specials. Dont overlook the sandwichs too. I like to get the saladbar to go also. Best salad bar in town...any location.
Great place!!  Stand out customer service from Natalie! Food was outstanding. Had the nachos and the turkey club.

I made reservations and the hostess seats  me in the bar at a high table. This is not a good beginning for a nice meal.  The waitress was great.. The food was good until they put tasteless wood filler parmesan cheese on top of my dish.  I will not return..

Right out the gates...I love this place. On the busiest nights they maintain the quality, and everything tastes and looks fresh. They take the time to make their own chili pastes and yellow curry, I'm big on quality sauces and condiments.

The owner is always super friendly and remembers me and my family whenever we come in. Little things like that go a long ways.
One of very few places with healthy, tasty fast food. I like the rice bowl (with brown rice), though pricy without a coupon.
Yes Yes Yes! Very hearty and Delicious food. Not the fastest place but As a breakfast connoisseur I recommend this place to everybody.
Fast and delicious! We had the dinner for two... hot and sour soup, crab stars and shrimp sticks, mandarin chicken and the Mongol with fried rice.

Stopped here while visiting Meridian for the first time. The Village (where this restaurant is located) is beautiful! The atmosphere is exactly where you want to spend your evening. Well lit, with great music, lots of people, and an awesome water show display. 

Our server was terrific! Food was delicious! We ate a white + garlic style pizza, with spicy chicken sausage and spinach. Yum, yum! Full bar and decent canolis too.

Came here for Mother's Day and wow, I want to come every week just til I've tried everything on the menu. I had the chicken hash bowl special and it was amazingly tasty. The biscuit was the size of a slice of bread and twice as thick and came with, I think, homemade jam. The hash bowls all look amazing.

My wife and I have tried to find a good Chinese restaurant in the Boise/Meridian area without a lot of success. We tried Red Pavilion and were happy to say we agreed this place will now be our go to Chinese food. We had sesame pork appetizer, double mushroom beef, and angel hair beef noodle. It was all great. I appreciate that they didn't overfill the vegetables with celery. I absolutely despise when the chowmein or other dish with veggies mixed in is mostly celery. I dislike that particular veggie, but it also comes across as incredibly cheap when used as filler. At any rate, the atmosphere at Red Pavilion also happens to be very nice and clean. I'd recommend the place.

This is an update to my previous reviews of Famous Dave's BBQ. 

Its  been 3 or 4 years since my wife and I have visited Famous Dave's. They have improved a lot. In my previous review, I noted a very incompetent wait staff. I am happy to say that now, the wait staff seems pleasant and knowledgable. Our waitress called herself Famous Joe. 

My wife and I responded with; "What are you famous for and is your name really Joe?" She thought for a few seconds about this. She did say that her name was Joe, but said that she was not sure why she was famous.

I didn't ask, but my assumption is that all of the wait staff are referring to themselves as famous. I though it kind of cute. Corny but cute!

Famous Dave's looks like a log cabin. A rustic look like I really approve of. It gives the restaurant a nice rustic Texan look. We noticed the same bottles of BBQ sauce on the table along with a paper towel holder similar to GoodWood.

We looked at the menu, which looked all new. I was happy to see that they now had a couple new bbq sauces. The 1st one is a mango sauce that was rated as hotter than they Devils Spit. The 2nd is their hottest and is a Habanero bbq sauce.

I asked the waitress why these 2 new sauces were not on the table. She said that the Habanero one was way to hot and had to be kept in back. The other is a sauce that they make in house.

The waitress was nice enough to offer to bring be out samples. The mango sauce was very good. It had a very nice balance of heat and sweetness from the mango. If she had offered, I would have bought some to take home.

The Habanero sauce was pretty hot, but I didn't think it was that bad. I prefer flavor in my sauce, so I stuck with the Mango BBQ sauce. I highly recommend it.

I have ordered the Devils Spit Burger several times to go. In my opinion, its the best burger in town. My only complaint about the burger is they use sweet pickles, which I really dislike.

This time, I decided to try the brisket again. The last time I tried it, it was fatty. For anyone that has read my reviews, I prefer my meat lean with no fat at all.

I asked the waitress about this and she assured me that it would be lea. My wife ordered the Rib Tips. When it came out, I was pleasantly surprised. The brisket was lean and tender. It had a mild smoke flavor and was dark in color throughout.

The brisket had a good flavor, but I prefer a more smokey flavor in my brisket. If I were to compare their brisket to GoodWood, Im not sure which would win. I would have to go back here several more times in order to compare. The best thing about GoodWood is their consistency. its too early to tell is Famous Daves can meet or exceed this.

The steak fries was flavorless and bland. I left most all of them sitting on the plate. The brisket was sliced and served over a piece of bread. I think it had been toasted, but by the time I got it, it was a soggy mess. Texas Toast would be a better choice served on the side and not under the meat.

Along with my brisket, came the same bad attempt at corn bread that I had in years past from famous Dave's. Their version of Corn Bread is more like a very very sweet cake that you would have for desert.

My wife's rib tips were just ok. They did not have a good smokey flavor either. 

We might return some day. I do enjoy the hamburgers.

The service was exceptional.  I was greeted by friendly staff who were eager to help me with my car battery. The battery was tested and determined to be bad. A new one was purchased and installed within 20 minutes.  Thanks for the great service.

I have been using Les Schwab for over 20 years.  These guys are top notch every time I've used them for repairs and replacements.  Today I had a blown tire that Travis L F took care of.  He was dripping sweat, covered in brake dust and dirt from working all day in a hot garage.  I was upset about my tire issue and Travis handled me professionally and took care of my issue the Les Schwab way.  I will never go anywhere else.  Thank you Les Schwab and thank you Travis for your professionalism and hard work.  You'll go far with that attitude and dedication to your job.

I had the Lemon Poppyseed Pancake and Farmhouse Benedict. Delicious gravy, crisp hash browns. Hand-formed sausage patties with perfect spices. The pancake is very light with a lingonberry jam on the side. 
The ambience is nice, I didn't feel rushed, and the food was wonderful. 

Awesome experience. 

Yay, Moe Joe's!!

The reason I gave Three Star reviews is because I generally have higher expectations for Italian restaurants. So just let you know that my review for this place isn't at a typical level. For a more formal and special occasion dinning experience. The Italian dish here doesn't live up with my expectations. Though the atmosphere. oh Mamamia. It's definitely one of the best in town. Price is far less expensive than other upscale Italian restaurant I've been to. Overall I had a memorable experience here.
Great head massage and towel wrap.  Great value for price.  Highly recommended for men.

I am so happy I have SB here in Meridian! My girl Jordan, she absolutely knows what she's doing. I've followed her here from when she was in cosmetology school and am so in love with what she's able to do at this salon! The atmosphere is fantastic and no matter what I go in for, I always leave super beyond pleased. I moved here from northern California where I went to the same lady at the same salon for years and haven't been able to find anyone that could match or top her till I started going to SB. You pay for what you get and I am definitely paying for top quality.

I was feeling too lazy to cook last night, so decided to phone in an order to Costa Vida. That was probably the worst decision I have made all month. 

I typically leave pretty positive reviews, but everything about my order was terrible. I can't speak to the service here (though it seems as though it would be negligible even if I were at the restaurant since it's line-order style) so this review is based solely on the food.

I got a pork chile verde burrito with black beans. I asked for extra cilantro and jalapeños because I like those things in my burritos. I am pretty sure I got sweet pork in my burrito because the meat was cloyingly sweet. If that's what their chile verde tastes like, their food is even more disastrous than previously though. Aside from being sickly sweet, it had no character. It pretty much tasted like boiled pork tossed in simple syrup. I also got pico and lettuce on the side, which was basically some wet tomato chunks on a few strips of lettuce.   

My girlfriend got sweet pork enchiladas with rice, beans, and lettuce/pico. I decided to try her black beans because I was so disappointed in my burrito. They tasted like what I can only imagine boiled rabbit poo would.. only less flavorful. I think she was happier with her meal than I was with mine, but I couldn't tell due to the waves of disgust and disappointment that were drowning me.

The quality of food was so low that I can't believe I had to spend real money on it. For what I got, I'd consider using monopoly money a bit pricey.

Maybe it was an off night. Maybe I am spoiled because I have had good Mexican food (though calling this 'Mexican' or 'food' is kind of a stretch). Maybe it's Maybellene. Regardless, I will not be coming back.

The guys at Calebs Chopshop are awesome. Great conversation and the best guys haircut I have had in Idaho. Friendly and funky. If you need a real guys haircut by experienced and fun barbers then you have found nirvana. It's hard to find a shop that puts guys first and this one does it in spades. Travis is super. Jeremy has skills. Caleb wasn't there but is talented also. Make sure to visit the shop and have a great cut and some good conversation.

I have worked at SB salon and Spa since we opened almost 3 years ago. The salon itself is beautiful, tranquil, light and airy! We all love what we do and really try to bring our clients requests to life. We are a little family that really enjoy each other and it shows through our fun, daily atmosphere!
Love this place and the price is great to I seriously come once a week its my favorite place its not fancy but I enjoy it
Yesss! Their food is fresh and delicious!!! Not always consistent in how they prepare it, i.e. missing sauces. Love this place though, yummy and friendly.
Food was really good.   The server and service was excellent.  I had a dinner special that was pretty good.  Steak needed to be cooked more. The price wad fair maybe a little high.
Drinks were good. Service was good. Only had chips and salsa but good wish they didn't have multi colored chips. But overall o recommend it!!!

The Eagle Island store is our first stop for just about everything from groceries to hardware, garden to fuel and it is convenient to our home in Meridian. It is clean, has convenient hours, nice wide aisles and great selections. The store products are as good as the expensive national brands and this is one stop shopping for us!
GREAT find. The food is delicious with lots of glutin-free options available. Very creative selections. The place is very busy but an attentive staff moves everything along quickly.
So far so good receive service right away atmosphere is really nice with the dark glad the bar waitresses are super sweet so far so good

What happened to red Robin?  My last two visits. Will be my last two visits. I think this is the most tasteless gourmet hamburger Ever. And bathrooms were filthy The tables were sticky. You could go on and on but why just don't go back

We used to come here often. NOT ANYMORE. Avery, the tall, white, Brunette waitress helped us. We see her there all the time. This time, she ruined our experience. 

My fiancé asked a simple question about the food, and Avery literally told her in a very rude tone, " What?! I don't understand your question, I don't understand you. " Rude as rude can be. 

I then asked her instead, same rudeness, same response. We both work in customer service and was very nice to her. They weren't that busy, yet she was overwhelmed by 3 tables and a simple question. Keep your Bitchness at home Avery. 

You guys lost regulars.

Great experience.  From the bread to the salad to the entree to the dessert.  Everything tasted incredible.  Sea food lasagna may have been the best lasagna I've ever had and the salmon appetizer was incredible.   The appetizer was a few minutes late and Gino and the waiter apologized numerous times ( we didn't even really say anything about it).  

Staff was excellent. 

Can't wait to go back.
This place rocks!  Great food, good service and worth the minimal wait.  Upscale environ but reasonable prices.
Really good!! Loved the selection of non-pork meat options!! Had a little wait but it was totally worth it! Will most definitely be coming back.

Had the unfortunate experience of seeing Riley at this salon.  Before I even get to the hair, let me just say that she had to be one of the most unwelcoming, coldest stylists I've ever been to.  Ever heard the phrase "resting b**** face"?  Yeah, she's the poster child of all resting B faces.  It's like it would physically pain her to smile.  I had already made up my mind that I wouldn't be coming back to her before she even got color on my head.  If you're reading this, you should seriously be embarrassed of how poor your customer service skills are.  You don't belong in a "high-end" salon, at all.  Maybe Supercuts is hiring?  It's not to late to try college...

So I needed my regrowth touched up.  It was just an all over color so super easy.  Too bad she was really sloppy with the way she applied the color.  There's a very specific way you apply color, based in whether you are going lighter, darker, etc.  Needless to say, she didn't do it right.  I'm sure she knows the right way to do it but she clearly didn't care.  She didn't even bother to part my hair cleanly or properly to make sure the color application was even.  Don't even get me started on all the color she left all over my face.  

She never even bothered to check my color before rinsing, and it could've processed for another 5-10 min, or I should've been placed under heat.  The color was uneven and there are definitely spots she missed.  The cut was mediocre, at best.  More laziness with her lack of properly parting my hair for the cut.  Topped of my a lazy blow dry where she didn't even bother to smooth out my hair or the cowlicks in my hair line.

Maybe it could've been fixed?  Who knows... I didn't ask because I just wanted to get out of there.  Her attitude and overall energy were so negative that I was willing to pay for a bad cut and color just to get away from her.  I ended up going to a salon downtown to have it fixed, which they did a beautiful job of doing (I won't say the name of the salon, so that you know that this is a legitimate review of Riley, and not an attempt to market for a competing salon).

I have no idea what possessed this person to think she belongs in any kind of service industry.  Her lack of technical skills is only overshadowed by her overall poor attitude and crappy customer service skills.

2 stars for the salon location, decor, and cleanliness.  0 stars for Riley.

My husband and I enjoyed our meal at Gino's. really, more than enjoyed; we savored every bite. I had a fettuccine noodle dish with pancetta and smoked mushrooms and he had the seafood lasagna. Both were outstanding. Also, the atmosphere and decor are soothing and the waitstaff is friendly and helpful.

What a disappointment.  We asked to be moved to a booth, away from a high traffic area where I kept getting bumped by passing guests and waitstaff, only to have both the 1st and 2nd requests ignored.  There were at least 8 open booths.  Said they were waiting for a clean one as most were dirty.  Staff did not follow up as they were cleaned.  Waitress did not follow up either, although she was nice.  Kind of slow on the beverage refills, though.  Also, one out of 3 meals was incorrect when delivered. Also alerted host that it was our daughter's  birthday., nothing was done to celebrate the occasion.  Food was OK.. not great. Wished we would have just stayed home.
Sushi was great, and I really like it. The ramen was below average, but I won't let that affect this review too much. Will be back again to try more of the sushi rolls

Let me preface this review by saying nothing I write is meant to be negative.  I am writing this only to hope your restaurant lasts for a very long time.  It makes me so sad to know how many Korean restaurants have opened their doors to only go out of business shortly after. 

First off, my husband and I walked in to your restaurant noticing what looked like a make-shift daycare on the entire left side of the facility.  We happened to notice four children and a middle aged woman go to the area that looked like the daycare.  As we waited to be seated we were kindly greated by the server who sat us immediately.  As one of the previous reviews noted below, the restaurant does seem to nickel and dime you for every little thing on the menu.  With the pricing as high as it is already, you would think they would just include some of the items they choose to price out separately.  I will have to note that we did get free side dishes.  However, I was extremely disappointed they didn't provide any kimchi as a side.  Really?  A Korean restaurant with no kimchi?!!?

The food we ordered was fabulous.  My husband is not quick to provide his opinion on places as he is a very go with the flow kind of person,  but he did note how much he enjoyed the food.  Disappointingly, the entire time we were eating we heard the children in the daycare area screaming and playing the xylophone as loud as they possibly could.  It was difficult to enjoy a peaceful dinner when all we could concentrate on were the noises coming from the make-shift daycare. 

Also, the training for the staff is very poor.  Unfortunately, it takes a wait staff a lot more training when the restaurant is foreign.  Our waitress, bless her heart, was trying so hard to help guide us through the menu.  However, she had not a clue what she was talking about.  Also, she could use some training on customer service as well as her comments I overheard to other tables were just odd.  I happened to see the owner walking around a few times, but never did she stop by the tables to see if we were enjoying ourselves.  The restaurant was very slow, which should have allowed her time to say a friendly "hello" to a few of her guests.  

Overall, we really enjoyed our meals.  Just hope the ownership would take a little more pride in the restaurant and pay a bit more attention to small details that would knock this place out of the park!  Super excited to see the outdoor grills coming soon.  Was a bit sticker shocked on the pricing for the outdoor grills, but hope to try it out and say it was worth the price.  

Good luck K-Fusion!

My family LOVES Grimaldi's Pizzeria!  We've tried several different pizzas and salads and we enjoyed them all. We're signed up for the free birthday pizza on their website and always look forward to celebrating there. The crust is delicious and toppings are awesome. Service has always been great, and our favorite place to sit is on the patio near the Village fountain.

I arrived about 10:45 am and their lunch menu is not served until 11 am.  I asked the waiter if it was too early to order off the lunch menu and he said it was not.  That's nice.  I had the hot corned beef sandwich with french fries and coffee.  Service was prompt and good.  The coffee was very good.  The sandwich was delicious, however, there could have been a little more meat on it, especially considering the price they charged.  French fries were very good.  I think they were made right there and they were seasoned.  In all my bill came to $13.24 and with the $2 tip it was $15.24.  (Just a bit high I think for lunch.)  I probably will be back to try some other things.

I love this place! We found it one night in Phoenix and I was super excited when I heard that they had put one here in Meridian.

It's definitely a pricier lunch, but well worth it. I've always ordered the half bowl and I usually have left overs. Think of Mongolian, but with rice instead of noodles and more tropical/Hawaiian flavors than straight up Asian flavors. They do have the noodle option with your bowl, which I'll try out next time. They also have burgers, tacos and salads too, however I've only had the rice bowls.

Staff is really friendly (sometimes over the top as Christy  M said), and the food tastes excellent.

Gino's closed its doors in downtown Boise.......not enough patrons.
They are moving to s a strip mall location in the burbs and probably will have a tough time with there price points and demographic., 
good luck Gino...

Came back again and it's still amazing. Cinnamon roll French toast is a must try. Coffee is made strong and served hot.  Breakfast potatoes are some of the best I've had. They also started offering lunch options but breakfast is too good to pass up. Service is always friendly.

I ordered take out of two family platters one was bowtie and the other was the spicy chicken Romano. Those were both really delicious. But they only gave me two pieces of bread for the family of 6. I also ordered the spicy nachos which lacked the sauce that they normally  put on them and it did not taste good at all.

So the more I learn about the portion sizes the more their rating drops.  Went in again and experienced the same thing as my complaints from 2013. A little gun shy on asking for more meat as I then get charged even more if I ask for more meat.   But I did complain to the manager this time.  The manager was nice said they go for 2oz  of meat. How ever the manager did not say that I was wrong and let me get you a new one.  He defended his business in a nice way.  Fixing my Enchilada may have saved Costa Vida from a long review.  But this practice has now been going on for years.  There is no doubt they purposely serve less meat as a cost savings method.  My daughter must have had 3 oz of meat in each of her two tacos. My Enchilada however only had maybe, a 1/2 ounce. There was so little meat like it was not even one bite of meat.  Costa Vida does not weigh it so there is no consistency. It is guess work. Costa Vida is saving a lot of money over short changing everyone on their portion size.  I went to the butcher and had him show me what 2oz of shredded pork looks like. Wow I was amazed about how much it was.  Everyone should do this with their butcher.  It was a lot of meat. If I had had that much meat in one enchilada i would be fine. CHECK MY  RATINGS  iI have 4 times the amount  of 5 star ratings then one star ratings. Like over 111 Five star ratings and some 25 one star ratings.  And I never rate a restaurant on food taste as I believe everyone is different.   I believe Costa Vida is running a scam.  They are short changing us all.   I will try to post some portion size pictures on my next review.  In the mean time everyone needs to start complaining.  1/2 oz is not the same as 2oz.  Some might say do not go there.  Yet the food is great. The service is great.  However the business practice of serving size, must be brought to their attention.

The first time I went to there food was ok. This is my second time to be there but the quality go down. The clams not fresh at all. I didn't eat my food。I told them clam not fresh but they didn't take care it. I didn't eat but I still paid. I will never go back . You have good business but you can't go down your quality . If you keep doing it not going to keep your business.

I started out my morning by dropping by this new coffee shop. Beautiful and comfortable insude. I was greeted by friendly, enthusiastic staff. I ordered my coffee and was served up expeditiously...and with a huge smile from rhe barista. Overall a great vibe. Plus today just happens to be free mug day as a grand-opening promotion. The first 100 people receive a free Black Rock travel mug. I'll be back...with my friends in tow!
Shrimp and grits, cornbread, jamaican salmon, chicken and wafles...its all amazing...
Id like to say they have Horrible customer service, but that would require someone to be present at the store. No wonder Toys R us is going TiTs up. Sad. Ps you wont be missed
Really disappointed that you didn't have any Minions movie party stuff.  You did however have slim pickings for Despicable Me, a movie that came out five years ago.

Stopped for breakfast due to the great reviews. Service was poor. Slow to take order and when food arrived it was wrong. Waitress left the plate on the table and was gone so long the food was cold. When she finally offered to correct the issues my dinning partners were all most done with their meals. Did not get to eat. VERY POOR SERVICE!!!!

Rudy's has long been my "go to" spot when I want to watch a sporting event that I'm not able to watch at home. They have really good food and usually- very attentive staff. Last night - not the case. Sat at the bar for over 5min while I watched the Bartender completely ignore me. When he walked toward me finally he somehow continued to ignore me and fetch a draft for someone, even though I was seated right in front of were he poured the beer from. A simple- "hi- ill be right with you" would have been all it would have taken to keep me waiting. But nope- just kept ignoring me. I bar tended for over 15 years and typically "over-tip" out of habit. Too bad for this bartender . I also own a small business and hate to have to leave a family owned establishment and support large chains like Buffalo Wild Wings- but that's what I did last night. Rudy's also was not busy and the bartender was not slammed - just oblivious and completely unworthy of holding that position (last night). To be noted- this BT was not the typical BT's that I've seen there before over the past couple of years. Those guys have always been great; and for that- I will return and try them again. Ownership should know that they lost out on some income last night that would have been so easy to keep. Hope the other guys are working on my next trip back to Rudy's. Walked into Buffalo Wild Wings- got acknowledge and served within seconds and they were three times as busy as Rudy's? Hope I can post a positive review on my next return to Rudy's. The Wings at Rudy's are waaayyy better than Buffalo Wild Wings- I had to settle last night.

Let's be clear, this isn't a five-star hotel that you'd spend a special night in.  I often stay at four or five star joints when I travel on business (they are company approved after all).  Given that, if you're looking for a reasonably priced place to get a good night's sleep, stay here.  

My wife and I were on a long drive across the West back to PDX, and we needed a place to sleep as we rolled through Boise at 11:30pm.  I was blissfully surprised.  Candlwood Suites was SUPER clean.  The staff was totally friendly.  They allowed my dog for a nominal fee ($12.50 for the night).  The room was pleasantly appointed (nothing too fancy) with a small kitchenette, very comfortable bed, and quiet hallways.

The breakfast (included in room rate) was plenty, though nothing fancy.  Free WiFi, fine location.  All this for a very reasonable price.  Thank you Candlewood Suites.  I was impressed at the value for my dollar, and how clean your establishment was.

I'll put this on my list and stay here again any time.  I gave it five-stars based on value for my dollar.  This isn't the Ritz, but I didn't need one.  I needed a clean, quiet, comfortable, friendly place to stay for about nine hours, and you provided that and more!

Just stopped by for a quick cut and really enjoyed my time.. they got me in quickly and the cut looked amazing!!! The VIP was the way to go. Came out with less stress just from a shampoo, sounds silly but it worked out that way.. Will be back again. Even to pick up some hair products. Thanks guys...

This place is amazing! All fresh and delicious. Came here twice with large groups and they were very accomodating. Service was on point. The chilequilles were omg omg the best thing ive ever tasted. Seriously the sauces tasted obviously from scratch, someone put heart and soul into their recipes for sure. The pork was mmmm perfect! My dish was pleasantly spicy. My 2 yr old loved it so much he didnt even care how spicy it was. My 4 yr old daughter loves the oatmeal here. My 6 yr old son went in looking forward to eating a "giant cinnamon roll" and he was not dissapointed and devoured every bite. The sourdough was real and i feel like thats hard to come by these days and was toasted perfectly! Also the homemade jams are a tasty addition to spread as well.   We will be back for sure.

Exceptional customer service all around. Gino's friendly staff are very knowledgable and genuinely interested & determined to providing the highest of standards in customer service to each & every customer. Gino's exceeds most restaurants when it comes to service and cuisine.
