One draw back that I must mention; is that it's always extremely busy and crowded on weekends. Making it all the more exciting.

I would recommend visiting Gino's on the weekdays Mon-Thursday to avoid a crowded restaurant. 

I give it 4 stars

Really great seafood (cabo) tacos.  Stuffed full of lots of good stuff, and comes with their special rice.  I am a big Hawaiian food fan, and have never had anything like it before--coconut flavored with some black beans mixed in.

Husband had the pulled pork plate, which he said was exceptional.

My main complaint is that I didn't see mac salad on the "sides" menu, otherwise I may have tried some!

i had called in a to-go order on a saturday around 3 for a 5pm pick up. upon arrival i was told my order had been lost. i decided to have a beer while i waited 48 minutes for a new pizza to be made. no compensation was offered and i was told that they had a lot of to-go orders that day. this was my first and certainly my last time in to grimaldis. over rated pizza for $30 and terrible customer service.

This place has the best soul food I have had outside of the French Quarter! 

We came in as a party of 8 and everyone loved their food.  I had the gumbo and it was delightful.  The stock was rich and flavorful, the seafood was plentiful and it was gone way too soon. another member of the part had the Jamaican Salmon which had all the flavors which make Jamaican food such a Caribbean favorite. The fried green tomatoes are just like the ones I had in Savannah, GA.  The ultimate in soul food is the Chicken and Waffles!  Crispy crust and the juicy steaming hot chicken contained within are just the beginning of the flavor sensations as the waffles are just as good.  When combined, they produce the perfect taste sensation.

Highly recommended!

Best breakfast in the TV!!!! My husband had the jalapeño pancakes and I had the cinnamon roll french toast and it was one of the best breakfasts I've ever had! Great service even if it's a busy weekend morning they always have a great service!

Stopped in to get pho with pretty low expectations, but it was really really good! So excited to have a good pho place up the road! Another plus was that we ordered it to go and it was packaged really well so no leaks. ;-) We'll be back!

This is one of my favorite breakfast joints in town. Everything is made fresh and the portions are huge. Unique dishes then just your original eggs and bacon, or French toast. Go in and try them. You won't be disappointed! :)

This place is extremely recommended! I absolutely love the coziness and the welcoming atmosphere! The pimple there are all super friendly and caring! The place itself is filled with coaches and comfy loves to Sit and it's amazing for group outings!

Tried Wingers today for lunch. Wingers is one of those sports bars/restaurants that doesn't bill itself as one. It's that modern/sterile atmosphere that cannot offend anyone - especially with a tv broadcasting sporting events in any direction you look - not that's a bad thing.

We were welcomed by a hi-octane hostess (funny young lady), seated promptly. Our server, Annie (who was super great) was there with in minutes with a fresh bowl of popcorn (an endless supply). When she discovered it was our first visit she made sure we understood the menu and all the options available. Did I say she was great? She was!

So, service was excellent - now the food.  My wife ordered the chicken wings - with the drunken BBQ sauce made with real molasses is bold, smokey, and twangy with fries and I ordered the Baja Deep Tacos (2) - Grilled Mahi Mahi, mango slaw, fresh strawberries, pico de gallo, cilantro, fresh house made guacamole, and shredded cheddar jack cheese. 

The wings were messy, just like they should be - wife would not let me post her picture for this review - lol. She loved them. My tacos were good and nothing to complain about, but they were not outstanding.

Would we come back - definitely, if for no other reason than the service!

Horrible!!!! Not only did the lady burn me 4 times for having the drill to high but she didnt shape my nails at all or buff them smooth. I got up and left halfway through my service when none of the knew how to paint my nails. Her we are 1 week later and my nails are breaking and lifting and catching on everything.

Not only can you get healthy eats but it's  also very good and flavorful. My companion had the Quarterback pizza with gluten free pizza crust. I had a salad with rice and beans that were warm and topped with carrots, avocado, lettuce and walnuts. I highly recommend this eating establishment.

I live dangerously close to Gino's. I absolutely love the food here. So fresh and has amazing flavor. My mom grew up on the east coast and says how is is just as good as many family owned places there. The staff is always friendly, and the flavor keeps us coming back each time

The pizza was good and the customer service was great but very pricy for lunch. We got 2 beers each and 2 personal pizzas. For $90 I could of had dinner. For those that want to if the pizza was good, it delicious for a New York style pizza with a good soft crunchy crust and it is really thin like a real New Yorker style pizza. I wish there was a combo style pizza so I wouldn't have had to create one.

Never eaten here, but wow! The crust is thin & crispy & the toppings were amazing. Loved it! I got the cheese pizza & added bacon to it. Something you can do at an added cost. And that is where they can get you, unfortunately. Build your own pizza, but really adds up fast. Standard pizza (depending on sauce) is around 8-10 dollars for a 12' , add in's start from there at $2 on up ( depending on what you get). I also ordered the Don pizza to go for my fella . Meatballs, sausage , pepperoni & absolutely delicious! Next time, I will try the dessert trio of cheesecake, cannoli & tiramisu. Too full to do this time.
 I did have a $5 off coupon to use , but waitress forgot to add it:(. She did say I could use it next time.. will there be a next time? Yep:).
 Loved it, the restaurant was beautiful, our waitress was awesome, pizza was amazing, sangria was refreshing. Only thing, pretty expensive. If you want a nice night out & little extra cash, definitely worth it! 
Not giving 5 stars only because of the forgotten $5 coupon, but otherwise, terrific place.
Expensive. Pho was good but at $13.99 (20% tip included, lunch menu) for the large pho combo, I won't be back. No pho is that good.
Really yummy food but be ready to pay the price, this place charges you for water, you can get just as good food for less than this place will charge you!

I'm on the fence on Gino's, but I want to be fair and will update my review after a dine in experience. It came under recommendation from a friend and we decided to call In a take out order tonight. We grabbed a margarita pizza, which was okay and a lasagna. I enjoyed the lasagna, but the wife said it tasted like the microwave box kind. We were in disagreement since I like to think I know a thing or two about Italian food. It was also cold when we got home and the microwave just doesn't add to a good meal. The owner greeted me when I walked in and was very friendly. We will see what happens when we dine in....

I moved to Boise about a month ago from Portland, Or. So, I've been on the hunt for a new breakfast spot. My wife is from New Mexico and when I saw this restaurant use green chiles I knew I had to come here. I wasn't disappointed. I ordered the smothered breakfast burrito and a pancake and my wife order the build-your own-omelet. The burrito was one of the best I have had anywhere...from Texas to North Carolina or Pdx to Boise. Also the coffee is really good. My 24 month old daughter gives the fruit bowl and pancakes rave reviews.

Rachael has been our server both times. During our 1st visit she was excellent and friendly. We may have returned because of her even if our food had merely been good. On our second visit, Rachael recognized us as we entered the door even though it was two weeks later and she was excellent again. 

My wife and I will be returning fairly often I think. Later, when the in-laws come to visit from N.M. I will be bringing them here so they can eat breakfast filled with green chile love just like they eat back home.

Poor service wrong prices at checkout Winco has fresher food at great prices this Fred Meyer is a yuppie place for plastic people. We bought 5 mushrooms at 2.99 a pound. The clerk charge us $2.47  for 4 ounces I questioned this while we were still in the store a clerk near by said if they can't afford our mushrooms they should go to Albertson's this is not Store I will ever return to we spent $32 on their over priced sushi

Jimmy Johns is very good BUT THE DOWNTOWN LOCATION IS NOT.  The music was so loud we could barely hear each other.  We asked if they would turn it down and they said NOOOOOO  Never will go there again.  The other area locations are very good and the hosts nice.

So happy to not have to drive from Nampa to Mountain Home to get our Taco John's fix any longer. We were heart broken when we lost our Nampa location and were there to greet the new location on opening day. So happy to see how busy they were. Even in the midst of chaos, the staff, especially the manager were EXTREMELY nice and patient (even when the computers crashed) and made the experience well worth the wait. Bring on the taco burgers, potato ole's and cheese sauce!!!!
Yummy breakfast.  Clean and friendly.  Got the farmers hash and it was delicious. Big servings size here at Moe Joes and I left a happy camper.

I donno. This place overwhelms me. Also, it's mostly plastic toys. Can you imagine how a kid feels?! Crazy stuff. They have good staff that is always hard to find and not always very knowledgeable (like Home Depot) and a wonderful match price to even mega Amazon prices. as long as it's shipped by Amazon. They have in store the big stuff but if you need parts and extensions... well, those you will need to get online. Separately. For me. Not a time saver. Better to just get everything online and ship it to me. I think I still go to store Just when I need an urgent pickup or to see an item. Wish they had better quality toys ie not just plastic garbage. Oh well, that's my job as a parent. To pick what's best for my kid. I think he will avoid this place for a long time if I can help it.

This is the best Chinese restaurant I've been to in The Boise/Meridian area. Two words: Sesame Beef. You have to try it. Mouthwatering, yummy goodness. The staff is always helpful and friendly. Fast service too. Can't be beat!

This is a great place for a pop up meeting or a work lunch that isn't too far away from the office and isn't going to cost you a fortune. Staff is really friendly food is excellent and atmosphere is a lot of fun. I took my team of eight here and we had a really great spontaneous team lunch and got a lot accomplished in the process. Our waitress was fantastic our drinks were never empty and our food came out hot and tasty.
First time here!!! Very happy. Had the Body Builder bowl & Mtn Biker salad.  We're all pleased. Great flavor!!

I have been bringing my chinchillas to Dr. Konsella for years. She is very knowledgeable and thorough at figuring out tooth problems, behavioral issues and nutrition for small animals. I started bringing my black lab here after a skin condition was making her so itchy she was miserable. I had tried a couple other clinics in Boise and none of them could figure it out. Dr. Roth is one of the best veterinarians I have ever met! Not only is he nice and funny, but he really knows his stuff. My dog's skin condition was solved after just one visit and over a year later, she is still itch-free. I won't bring my chinchillas to anyone except Dr. Konsella and my dog and cats won't see anyone except Dr. Roth. 

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

Found River City on Yelp. So glad we did! We moved into the area last month and need a vet. Our 4 year old Lab Buddy broke his nail and it was pointing upward. It was Friday night and needed an appointment asap! They scheduled us quickly on Saturday and took care of Buddy!
Why in the world can't every breakfast diner serve the garden hash?! It is seriously the best, and any vegetarian or someone who likes fresh healthy fare would delight over this meal!

This place is literally so good. They have a pretty big menu for a breakfast place and the wait wasn't too bad for a Saturday morning. I got the House Club without ham and it was delicious! The French fries and potatoes they serve have a really good seasoning too. The service was super good and pretty quick and friendly. The restaurant itself was pretty small, which is probably why they had a wait, but its worth it. I would highly recommend trying Moe Joe's!

Decided that the pizza last week was so good, I tried them again.  I mentioned the topping the first visit were a little light.  Problem solved this time so I added a star.  Nice to see a place willing to rectify a past issue.  I recommend.

Great food great service great ambiance.
Both servers working during this visit were friendly and very attentive. Restaurant is tastefully decorated and booths are comfy. I would come back just for the service so the fact the food was fantastic is a guarantee you won't be able to keep me away. The Szechuan Shrimp and Scallops had me wanting to lick the plate clean the sauce was delicious the shrimp and scallops were cooked to perfection (a hard thing to find in Idaho). They even managed to cook my side order of plain chicken perfectly. 
I would like to thank the owners and staff for bringing such an awesome place to town.

Went on Easter with a group of 6 plus an infant. Fabulous customer service, especially for how packed it was! Everyone was really happy with their order. I think a couple items were a little too heavy on the pepper, like the potatoes and biscuits and gravy. Other than that everyone enjoyed their meal and the whole experience!

Wow!  I'm in love with this place.  Just had our first meal here, and we had it to go.   Ordered the sweet pork burrito, with black beans, and mild sauce.  The flavors in it were amazing.  A friend told me that their sweet pork was life changing... she was right!  I will definately be going back.  If you like sweet meats, you'll love this!

This place is somewhat inferior to the one on Cole Road (read the review for that also), both in access to other places and other convenience elements, but also to the actual room itself. It's not a major drop, but notable. The usual double-flush toilet element and shower that likes to reset itself are all present, but the tv channel guide is annoyingly not. Room is also slightly smaller, as is the table, but I slept well here, so not too much of complaint. Overall, a very strong contender, but not quite up to the level of the other place. They still do a very nice job overall and all of the amenities are here. Very good, but a couple touches from great.

Went here for Father's Day and we were expecting it to be crowded but they got us right in. Our server greeted us right away, he was extremely helpful with getting the correct menu for my food allergies, he was friendly and prompt! This dude was awesome! He refilled our drinks BEFORE we hit the bottom, he put in our food right away and it came quickly. Can I just say how hard it is to find good customer service in Boise, and at Red Robin of all places?! You go in to a chain and you automatically make your assumptions, but this place rocked! If you dine at this location ask for Zach. He was prompt, friendly, and attentive. I will rave about this place!!! And I'll be going back. Way to go Red Robin.

This is a solid Chinese restaurant.  The dinner room and atmosphere is very much dated and not to pleasing.   But I can recommend it for some take out.  Kung Pao beef, egg rolls,  and some of the chicken is pretty good.  Being that this is a family run business and the people are very freindly.   So it's close to home and convenient.

Food was excellent, reminds me of how the Hong Kong in Nampa used to be back in the day (but better)! Was also told they have a separate authentic Chinese menu by the waitress.
Fast service (especially for a fairly busy Saturday night), very friendly wait staff.
This will be our new go to place for Chinese food!

My Bride and I went there and have found our go to Chinese Food. Awesome food and service.
We have tried several others in the valley, this is the BEST!
We will continue to go here.
I will definitely recommend this for the best Chinese cuisine.
I've been here a couple of times. It's worth the wait on the weekend.  The food is fantastic,  very flavorful,  large portions and reasonably priced.  Also,  the staff is friendly and attentive.
Pizza was pretty good not worth what we paid for tho  very nice place and nice waitress  waited about 45 minutes for the pizza too overall probably won't be coming back

Went on a date night to Famous Dave's.  We were happy when we got there because for a Saturday night it was not busy.  We were seated right away and then the waiting began.  Our server took about 10 minutes to come over.  I would not complain except the restaurant was virtually empty and there were servers standing around the restaurant.  When our server did come over she was polite.  The drinks and food did come much quicker after that. I was, however, a little irritated that thr table behind us got prompt service from the same server and we did not.  Something was off about the pork.  Overall was disappointed in the service and food.  This was the second time we have eaten here and the service was not great either time.

I definitely suggest checking this place out! I had a wonderful pedicure about three weeks ago, and decided to go back for a gel manicure. Not only was it quick, it was really well done! The place is very clean and the staff is very friendly.
Great food and even better service.  Ask for the traditional menu and you will not be disappointed.

We have been to Rudy's many times. Always great food and service. The mushroom bisque is the best, and can be a meal in itself. Get there early because it fills up fast. Great place to meet old friends and take new ones. We have family in town and took them there for drinks and stayed for dinner. They rave about it every time we talk to them.

Had high hopes for this restaurant and went in the first chance I got.  

Rounded up my husband and one of my children, and off we went, because we LOVE good Chinese food and have been looking for a "go to" place.

Ordered "Spring rolls" and "Pork and seeds", for starters.  Spring rolls were greasy,  with only a little cabbage in them.   Pork and seeds was, well, pork and seeds, and they did the job of blunting our appetites nicely.  We then ordered 'Chow rice' with pork.......what?!?  Plain rice, fried, with pork bits in it.  Okay, so these folks are literalists, let's just hope that "The Mongol" that we ordered doesn't turn out to be........

But the 'piece de resistance', (and the reason that I am bothering to write this review), was the "Shrimp and scallops something-something", (also the priciest dish we ordered).

Now, I am a sixty year old mother of five who has been cooking since I was ten years old, and I have cooked all manner of cuisines-and cooked them well.  Except for the shrimp in this dish,it came out RAW and doused in 'straight up' full strength soy sauce, to cover up that fact.  Our server handled the situation well, quietly taking the dish away, but a few moments later, a loud mouthed woman came up to our table and explained to us that WE had failed to tell the server that, yes, indeed, we wanted our food COOKED.  You see, her OTHER customers LIKED it the way that it had been served to us and that in the future, could we be so kind as to mention to our server that we actually want the dish cooked?

Understand, gentle reader, that when I use the term "raw", I don't use it figuratively, or even hyperbolically, I mean it literally, as in "No vegetable was warmed in the making of this dish".

On the up side, "The Mongol" was well prepared, and quite tasty.....:-/

C'est la vie!  and the search goes on...

Wow, how can I have such a different experience then most here?  My chicken was dry and over cooked. The Mac and smoked cheese was scorched. The server was snotty and rude.  Maybe this was an off night but I can't image how the difference between my experience and other comments can be bridged. Are there two Gino's on this corner?

Man I love this place!!!!  The service is always exceptional, especially on our last visit!  They are always eager to please and super attentive.  The food is equally amazing!!  I am a huge fan of the California Chicken Burger but everything else is pretty darn good too.  This is a great place to go if you have kids because they give out free balloons and coloring pages with crayons and it's always lively so you don't have to worry about them being too loud.  They have a full bar too which is nice for a burger joint.  YUM!

It's Taco John's. You either love it or you hate it. The burritos have gone down in size in the last 35 years.  That doesn't bother me, less is better these days and the price is right.

For me it's a comfortable old friend. There are way better taco places in the valley for sure but I still have a soft spot for this one.

If you're going to eat here, stick with the tried-and-true.  Small super burrito combo with fresh Oles is best for newbies. Tell them to make oles fresh for you and go moderate on the seasoning. They may not like it but they'll do it.
I like the concept but I think that if they were to have the "adult living room seating" separate from the play area it would be less cramped and chaotic.

This is an amazing place to eat I took the girlfriend one time and we both just fell in love with the food there we definetley will be going back as much as we can. The staff was nice the food came out faster than most places I've Benin to  decent pricing
Excellent Service! Wonderful Food! Husband loved the wings! I had a spinach chicken salad. Wonderful house made vinaigrette!
Tried this fro yo place with my sister and totally loved it! Awesome amount of yogurt options plus tons of toppings!! So awesome!

Just visited the subway for the first time and let's just say I'm pretty grossed out, not by the cleanliness of the store but by the cleanliness of the employee who made my sandwich. He looked like he just rolled out of bed and into a pile of dog/car fur, there was dog/cat fur hanging off of his cap over my food he looks like he hadn't washed his shirt in a while, since it was covered in animal fur. He mumbled everything he said to me I couldn't understand him had to make him repeat several times I was highly grossed out and really don't want to eat anything that he touched and I didn't feel comfortable offending him while he's hovering over the sandwich condiments.... I am disgusted and will not be returning to this shop again

We went to Gino's for our anniversary dinner   I ordered the chicken parm with gnocchi.    I didn't say anything when he served me the halibut special.    Oh well.     It was great...... Just like everything I have ordered in the past at Gino's. Our server, Austin , was very attentive.    Sara, his bussr, was a delight.  I have been to Gino's on several occasions.   You can not go wrong.  Always good.

A very busy lunch time but you would never know it. My wait was under three minutes to order. The service was outstanding! I had to change my order and Kiersten was full of smiles and a willingness to make whatever updates I needed. A breath of fresh air! By the time I was done making my salads to go, Adam & Kiersten had my pizza all packed up and ready to go. If your looking for a pizza joint well you can find one just about anywhere. Now if your looking for family, fun, loving atmosphere, with pizza and great salad I suggest you head on over to Idaho Pizza Company!
Excellent food!~ Great service!~ Gino's is by far the best Italian in the Treasure Valley!~

I'm a professional graphic designer and have worked with printers for over 25 years. Jason and Beth are very helpful and know their stuff. I know when I set something up properly, I will get what I wanted. They help me with finding the best price too, even if it means I tweak my design a little bit to fit within a standard size. That's appreciated by me and my clients!

When I stopped in this morning with a complex order for 11 people, the staff were amazing fast, positive, and organized.  They definitely went above and beyond by separating our drinks hot from cold, labeling our drinks with names, and giving us drink holders without having to ask for one.  They are amazing and should be commended for the great job they did!

First time at Costa Vida and I'd choose this place over Chipotle any day. The salad was amazing. In particular their home-made and  home-pressed tortillas that sit at the bottom of the salad made me very happy. Chipotle uses Pre made tortillas and the difference is night and day. 

I ordered the cilantro lime dressing and wish I would have ordered the jalapeño cilantro ranch once I tasted my sisters! They only describe it as ranch but it is much more than that. And surprisingly lower calories than the other. 

Fantastic lunch spot.
Good food, friendly and helpful staff. I'd definitely go back nice time I come through town.
Solid Chinese food, the entire family enjoyed the meal. Service, Quantity and Quality were all amazing.

have had two good lunches there.  3 of us split a large pizza and the large spinach salad.  Salad was really well done and very tasty!!

Server was Brittany, and she did a great job!
I live in Boise, but regularly drive to Meridien to go to this store.  Great selection, knowledgeable staff and friendly knit groups.  Local and regional yarns, as well as national brands.  Love it!

This is the first time ive been here, i was visting Boise with some family and OMG this place is great, I normally do not eat pork but the sweet pork salad is to die for!!!  I would rather come here then chipotle anytime..  Will be eating here again...
so good and great value. this one does daily specials which are reasonably priced and tastes like mamacita made them

Delicious and a much needed addition to Meridian. I've eaten here twice once take out and once in house. The service is great the food is amazing the decor is warm and inviting. I will definitely be back

I'll be fair here: the service was decent and the atmosphere was okay. Other than that, this would be a 1-star review.

First, they don't list sides on their menu and their menus don't fit on the table. I got stabbed in the eye with the drink menu getting passed around.

Second, the food came out REALLY fast..almost too fast. Especially for being there at 5:30 on a Wednesday evening. And they were decently busy.

Third, the coleslaw tasted pretty rancid. The tots were dry. The fish and chips were pretty scary. The ribs were dry and uber fatty. I ate because I was hungry but was sick within 10 min of eating. 

I won't be back, but I could see where this would be a good place for drinks and apps. Just avoid the entrees.

We took a trip to Moe Joe's for Sunday breakfast. Around 10am it was busy, but not packed. There was a wait, but only for about 10 minutes. I thought it was a nice that they had coffee available while you wait.

The breakfast menu is expansive, and the hardest part was deciding what to order! I don't think you could go wrong with anything offered since everything was delicious!

I can't wait to go back to try some more of their amazing offerings.

If you have to wait 40 minutes for a table and only locals hit up this place, you already know you have found a gem!  

It was totally worth the wait.  SO worth the wait.

I had the amazing Basque Chorizo Pepper Hash, hubby just had a short stack.  This has to be one of the most flavorful, decadent and savory dishes that I have had for breakfast in a long time.  There was a perfect mix of Chorizo, crispy/soft centered potatoes, chilies, peppers, tomatoes and cheese.  I had scrambled eggs on top, but next time I think I'll go over-medium.  I do believe that it needs a creamy element, be it sour cream, egg yolk or a sauce, but that may just be personal preference.  Hubby loved...and I mean LOVED, his pancakes.  I have been married to this awe-inspiring man for 23 years and he rarely, if ever, cleans his plate at breakfast.  He literally licked his plate...every nibble was gone.  GONE.  That never happens.  Not to mention, the jams are fresh and homemade tasting.  Let's add on excellent service and you have a winner.  Can't wait to go back and yes, still thinking about how good this food was a day later.

So...Matt, the manager, based on my prior review contacted me to make repairs. They've given me a new kegerator and because it was smaller did a very nice repair on the opening it sits in. Nicely done guys. Thank you.
This is a family favorite!  Yum!!  When we ask our children where they want to go for their birthday dinner they always say Costa Vida

It wasn't  the best food, the chicken was mostly breading, but the fried rice was alright. The main reason my family and I decided to order here is because they deliver, which they delivered our food fairly quickly.

This was basically one of the worst dining experiences I've had  we went here for the wings, because of their name we thought, hey! This place should have good wings! Wrong! The wings were so salty we couldn't even finish them and the garlic Parmesan wings smelled like they were rotten! We would not recommend this place and will not be back. Plus the order and waitress took forever and then got our order wrong twice! This place is not worth the price at all.

Chad did a great job with our 2 year old's haircut! He was very friendly and efficient so our toddler didn't have time to get squirmy or impatient. The quickness didn't affect the quality of the haircut either, it turned out really nice with an obvious attention to detail. I feel like it's hard to keep a longer haircut without looking too shaggy or dorky, but Chad totally nailed it!

We called to see what the wait was like and was told there was plenty of tables, came in to a packed full house with a wait. Granted it's breakfast and that's unpredictable so no big deal there that's normal. But we were waiting, with a group of 3 that walked in right before us, and then a couple of 2 that came in 15 mins after we had been waiting- a table for 6 opened up and a few smaller tables. We had a party of four, after the 15 mins and opened tables the party of 3 got sat at the big table and then the older lady skipped us and sat the party of two that just came in and told us that the smaller table could fit the smaller party. Well if that's the case and your reasoning for sitting us last, then, why didn't you sit us first at the table of 6 and skip the smaller group before us of 3? The bigger table accommodated us just like your reasoning for sitting the smaller group in the smaller table before us. Just irritating after waiting when you hoped not to, then skipped your turn after waiting to people who had no wait at all and given a reason that made no sense. Our younger tall waitress was polite and did her job efficiently so I might return with my family because of her. Prices and food are good

Pizza no!

I have an update for this place for the pizza. Do not get it. I ordered a pizza with extra sauce. When I arrived I got extra cheese and hardly any sauce. I asked if they could redo it and I actually heard the waitress asked the cooks how they made my pizza and I heard them say extra cheese. Then she said it was supposed to be made with extra sauce and hey backtracked. The guy was rude and said he didn't want to remake It and if he did he would still put the same amount of sauce on it. Way to please the customer?!!! On top of that we're all the looks between them as if how dare I ask to receive what I ordered. The manager should take care of this and teach the take out side to show the same type of professionalism as the dining are. I don't pay to catch an attitude. 

Dining yes

The very best food I've had in the area- hands down. They have a great ambience, great service and delicious food. Their bread is super good- has garlic and herbs baked into the bread, and their dipping sauce goes so well with it: garlic, olive oil, and pepper flakes for a kick.  My favorite meal here is the lamb shank.  It tickles your palette in all the right ways. There's so much goodness about the dish- basil, garlic, San Marzano tomatoes and gnocchi. Let me tell you how I never even knew I liked gnocchi until I experienced this creation at Gino's. They are like light velvety pillows. I'm not even a big pasta girl and I adore these. The dish is slow braised, tender and moist meat. I wouldn't change or add a thing to it. It's about $30, but you are given a Generous portion. Easily 2.5 meals. The service here is great- they don't come every 5 seconds, but also don't disappear. They have mastered the right amount of contact and top it off with delicious and fresh tasting food.

Stopped in for dinner on a Wednesday night. Had made a reservation just in case but don't think it was needed.. Took a while to get greated at table once we were greated server was very good and constantly check on us. I got the special which was a shrimp scampi linguini.  It was OK nothing special and wife got chicken Alfredo and was very blah. . Both meals were just ordinary. . Best thing was the bread at the beginning. Probably won't ever go back as food not worth the cost. Also place seemed super loud and the tables are right on top of each other

The breakfast bar was so wonderful. The service was so wonderful. How many times can I say wonderful. I'm going to dedicate a song It's a Wonderful World to this restaurant. You may find it at 
http://www.facebook.com/revlawchill
Photos, video, and laughter may also be found at that address.

Came back because I got a bogo coupon. Won't go back. The brisket was cold and dry. I had to complain to get some fresh meat served to me. That time was pretty good. But I hate to complain just to get what I pay for. Won't go back. Goodwood BBQ is much much better.

My family eat here often! It is amazing! Everything I have eaten is amazing! Yes the line might be almost out the door some nights but it's so worth the wait! The crew members are always so friendly and nice even when they are swamped. The food is always consistent. One time my sweet pork salad wasn't how I like it but I'm pretty sure it was a communication error on my part! I will keep coming back!

Worst service period. The restaurant is in the process of remodel. Service was by far worst experience.
Long wait time and cold food.

I went in because I had a reception problem that just started a week and a half ago. Two employees recommended a new SIM card to restart the network. But a lazy tech name Tony came over and said it wasn't fixable because of lack of antennas in Eagle. I tried telling him it just started a couple of weeks ago but he didn't want to listen. What sucks for them I was also going to buy a wireless home system from them also. But with that kind of customer service I'll pass on Verizon. Also now I have a out to cut their service because I can't get calls at my house. Sprint, ATT, T-Mobile here I come.

I travel a lot all other the country and eat out way more than the average person.  I love Yelp and it has provided me with great guidance all over the country.  I try to avoid chains at all costs.  There is a JB's near where I live and its better than this one.

This JB's was one recommended by relatives in the area who I met here for dinner.  The waitress was very nice, the salad bar is about average on the cold side and slightly above average on the hot side.  I ordered the all you can eat shrimp and fish. The nice waitress advised me that I couldn't get a "to go box on the special".  That was nice to know.  The fish was an interesting cut and I couldn't identify what it was (white flaky, fish tasty).  It was battered in something like Aunt Jemima pancake teflon.  It looked okay, but was a bit chewy.  The shrimp was a bit too much on the breaded side and likely fell out of a box in the freezer.   My relatives ordered standard fare, pork chops wrapped in BACON!! wow!  Seems like an oxymoron with two veggie sides, corn and mashed out of a box taters and gravy.  Anyway they said everything was good.    The rolls looked good, but I didn't eat one and I love rolls.  Hmm?

We were told that we could have a trip to the ice cream bar.   Wohoo!!!  NO CHOCOLATE?  This is America, Baby!  Well they did let me put all of the chocolate syrup on my strawberry ice cream.  And Oreo Crumbles and Cookie crumbles and Chocolate Jimmie Doodles (those are the little chocolate sprinkly things).

It's an okay place, probably really good on the breakfast side, but they have a standard truck stop menu and it tasted and looked like it.  I won't be back.  But for the steak and tater crowd, have at it.  Waitress gets four stars for friendly and good service!

Gina was amazing with our Pom, who looked horrible and he looks that way because he does not like to be brushed and in our household, he rules the roost! :)  Gina did an amazing job inspire of Carmello being somewhat Piranha when he was being groomed! I would take our dog back here without a doubt! He looks beautiful! THANKS!

Moved back to Boise Valley and found this surprise. Sunday's are for relaxation, this place for breakfast starts it off right. Varied menu and great service the only thing you need to do is guess wait time. Saturday's and Sunday's can get busy quick, go early or close to noon.
Lunch is a stellar deal! All you can eat specialty pizzas, drink, and salad for $7.49. Quality, combined with quantity, cannot be beat!
I really enjoyed this place! Great food and friendly staff here. Prices are decent too. The General's chicken was fantastic. One of the better Chinese restaurants I've tried here in town.

Famous Dave's is a chain and is nothing special. I would say, like most the other reviewers have, the STAFF was the high point of my experience. The place was packed while I was there and my food took about 3 minutes (half a beer) to get to me. 

Needless to say it came too fast and was cold and not impressive. I did enjoy all the sauces they provide to mask the taste of the below par food. I enjoyed mixing and matching their BBQ sauces. 

While some have said Famous Dave's is expensive, IT IS, but not comparatively. Try and enjoy a meal at one of the rib shacks, either in meridian or eagle and you will spend way more than you would have at Famous Dave's.

This place is decent at best. The service is definitely good and the place isn't shabby but they food isn't anything to scream about. I would say it's average; I had the kung pao chicken/fried rice and it wasn't spicy, fresh, or all that tasty. The potstickers are definitely the same ones I purchased at Costco the other day.

This place is a solid, delicious sandwich place.  It is a very big chain and does a nice job.  The California club is very good for lighter fare and doesn't slow me down in the afternoon.  They are as fast to serve your meal as they advertise.

I'm not a coffee drinker in the summer but the fruit smoothies are out of this world a fair price for what it is but you might have price shock and wonder if its that good the first time you buy one but after you drink it you will want more in the winter when I was drinking coffee I had the milky way it was so good I bit sweet but I wood double shot it and I was flying high for the morning.
Service was great...very friendly staff.  We didn't have to wait long for food. Restaurant was clean... Including restroom. Food was good. We would go back. Great atmosphere.

We went this past Tuesday night and the service was great as usual, but the food was not what we have experienced in the past.  The meat lasagna was awful - could not tell what the meat was.  And, I had the lobster ravioli which included two large, very "ripe" smelling shrimp.  We have eaten at Gino's many times, but this visit was not so hot.  I was also very shocked at how empty the restaurant was - sometime indicative of issues.  I'm sure we will be back, but were were definitely disappointed this week.
Chicken was over cooked and chewy. The atmosphere is cool and would be a great place to watch football, I just won't eat

I was visiting a friend in the area and she recommended this place. It was amazing.  Great food, wonderful staff and atmosphere.   This wasn't like any Italian restaurant I have been to before - it was better!  So worth the money.
Irish Cowboy sandwich is my favorite. Always Yummy!

I like this pizza house as always consistent...  salads are very fresh.  The only thing is I wish they had a few lower priced specials...just a bit...   WE do appreciate their nice wait staff and freshness...

We were directed to Gino's as the best place to get Italian food in Boise area.  We were not disappointed.  We went there in a Tuesday night without reservations but we were seated immediately.  Our waitress, Jessica, knew the menu completely and was able to answer any question we had.  She was a gem!  The complimentary bread and oil served before the meal was full of chopped garlic and other spices.  If you love garlic like we do, you will love it. For my entree, I had the Penne Arabiatta with Shrimp and it was a large serving and very tasty.  Spicy but not too spicy for my taste.  Husband had baked spaghetti with meatballs.  He was not as enthusiastic about his entree. Said the meatballs tasted "different".  We weren't going to have dessert until we asked about Creme Brûlée. Jessica torched it right at our table with a propane torch. We shared the dessert and we were surprised to have cherries at the bottom of the dish. Very good.  If we lived in the area, we would sure go back to try other selections. It

This place was rated highly on yelp so I decided to try for breakfast while in town. My colleague had traditional eggs Benedict and a short stack. I had the sausage, cheese, and spinach scramble. All was delicious! The coffee was also great, having had 3 cups while there. Amy, our waitress, was friendly and helpful and made sure we had everything we needed. Definitely check it out!

The spring on our garage door broke suddenly at the house. I called and spoke to Paul, and he worked me in right away. The workers that came out were friendly and efficient (done in about 20 minutes). They also answers my questions and explained what they were doing. All this, and the price was reasonable. Ticks all the boxes for me.

Good pizza. Great views of the fountain if you are seated right. Kinda pricey, as you choose a crust and sauce then everything you add to the pizza is extra. Great occasional stop, certainly not a regular on the rotation.
HUGE fan of Pristine thanks to one in employee. Brody was very helpful in setting up my new hot tub.
I'm not the biggest fan of the new location but, the food has always been good. The veal shank is one of my all time guilty pleasures.

Love this place!  It's a perennial choice for celebrating those great victories in life -- straight A's, winning a race, being done with finals.  The food is nearly always perfect, and when it's not, they take care of it to make it so.  The Royal Red Robin burger's my favorite.  The bottomless sweet potato fries, however, are a major dietary problem, 'cause I eat too many of them.  :)  

We've had a lot of really good servers at RR, but last nite as we celebrated my wife's birthday, Patrick was great -- perhaps the best we've ever had.  Very attentive, but gave us our space.  

If you haven't given RR on Eagle Rd a try, you owe it to yourself!

I can not comment on a haircut as I did not receive one even though I had a confirmed appointment.  My appt. was with Danielle, who did not  bother to contact me to cancel but just switched me to someone else.  That person informed me she can't cut short hair.  No one else had enough time to cut and dry it before their next appt.  I left as very disappointed customer and I will not be going back.  I went to the same salon and two diiferent stylist 15 years before I moved.  I was hoping to find the same proffessionalism here.  They missed the mark before getting to the starting line.

So anticipating my return to Boise and my favorite restaurant. We arrived at 8:30 so it was not too busy. Unfortunately our waiter somehow was. There were six of us. Delays in just getting water, drinks, menus...We had to ask the young lady pouring our water for Gino's delicious bread. When he finally took our orders, no offer of side salad or soup was offered. Worst service experienced at a nice restaurant in a long time. This is not how I remember Gino's. To add insult to injury, a generous tip was pre-added to our bill.

Overpriced and awful! I rely heavily on reviews of other yelpers, so I was shocked at how bad our experience was given their high reviews. The only highlight was the oil and bread. The mushroom soup was terribly bland. I mentioned it to the waitress in the context that I had to add salt and pepper to give it a boost and she acted as though I had offended her, grabbed the bowl stating "I have never heard that! Do you want minestrone or lentil". I felt like a naughty school girl being scolded. I could then hear her in the kitchen talking about it as though it were unheard of, making me incredibly uncomfortable. She brought me minestrone, and it would have been good had it not been loaded with broccoli, which was all I could taste. The main entrees took over 30 minutes, and there was only 2 other tables in the restaurant. My FIL's sandwich was burnt, the calamari was on the small side and average at best. My husbands dish had large pieces of roast that were dry and my MIL's special of the day lacked any flavor or finesse. It was the worst Italian I have ever had, and don't tell me I wouldn't know, I've eaten Italian all over the U.S. And ITALY itself. My extended family and I will never go back. Ps, those other two tables....one was asking for a manager at the end of their meal and the sweet old lady at  the other table was complaining about the mushroom soup of all things. What a waste of money.
This is , hands down T H E.  BEST  Chinese in town. Bar none !!!  Appetizers are super. Lunch is great and they have a family menu that is GREAT !!! You won't leave there hungry, just satisfied !!!
Go here for the delicious salads. Made right in front of you, totally fresh ingredients, large portions, and soooo good. Be sure to get the Ranch style dressing and the shredded pork salad .yumm!!

Had a bad experience here. I stopped in for my very first time and inquired about their "green juice." I asked the gal working the counter if the vegetables were organic. She didn't know. Really? I walked out without ordering because she was completely uninformed and useless. Poor management and even worse training for this hire. Good luck as I shall never return.
Great Service .. Great Staff ... GREAT Experience ... Go See Nick !! He listened to my needs and sold me the Phablet that fit MY Needs .. Thanks .. Big Mama

My wife and I do not normally get New York style pizza, but we wanted to try Grimaldi's since we had heard good things. 
We decided to go with the Quattro Formaggi with pepperoni added and it was really tasty. A couple of notes - I will need to go back and try a pizza that has a sauce to get a better feel for their pizza as the 4 cheese without any pizza sauce was a new thing for me. That being said, i feel like it really speaks to the cheeses and their quality that the pizza stood up so well without any pizza sauce. This could however be partly due to us adding the pepperoni. I would recommend this combination as we both felt the pepperoni added a nice touch to cheese and maybe some of the grease from the pepperonis made up for the lack of sauce. Service was solid, nothing extraordinary, but we were sitting there for a while before we got our pizza
Gotta love the friendly environment and great help you get with this team!  I used to think spending less was best as all batteries were the same, not true!  Go to the best, forget the rest!
Ok ..... omg been here twice. Some of the greatest food I have had and I have been to some of the best restaurants in the US.  They take great care of you.  Will be back!!!
Way overpriced. Slow service. Food not great. Order came out wrong. Spend your $ elsewhere.

I drive past this place daily and have been wanting to give it a try. Went there at 2:30 pm Saturday- place is closed and completely dark inside. Says they're open noon to 9:30 PM. So we went to Sa-Wad-Dee instead. I guess this place didn't need our money. Sa-Wad-Dee was absolutely fabulous!

We had an excellent experience! Staff was friendly, they offered samples, it was pay by the Cup and not the ounce.. we were encouraged to fill her up!! There was a great verity of yogurt and toppings!!
I would highly recommend this establishment to anyone!!

It's perfect for an after meal treat, a date night or just a place to hang out and enjoy a visit while you have a healthy snack!

I enjoyed corned beef hash. It should be noted The Corned Beef is sliced and not shredded the breakfast had the freshest of ingredients including fresh onions fresh potatoes fresh farm fresh eggs. My girlfriend had the short stack of buttermilk pancakes with fresh fruit

We came in for lunch and order from lunch menu. Reasonable price with just right amount of food. But I experience hair on my nigiri and ask for a new one, No need to be exaggerated. Staff apologized but I expected more than that to be honest. Our staff quite confused with our order but the food still come out right. The restaurant is clean in overall as I seen. We ask to substitute the California roll to yellowtail roll but they will add $2 extra which is funny for me when the yellowtail roll is cheaper than California roll. So we just stick with what we got. The food was mediocre. Im gonna look for a better Japanese food restaurant.

Nan: Okay. Where shall I start? Food? Service? People? I can't wait to get this review done. 

Nic: Boy, you're on a roll today. You can't really say anything about the people that come there. So talk about the food.

Nan: Alright. The food. It sucks. 

Nic: Wow! Okay, at least you're honest. What did you not like?

Nan: The salads are meh, the fries are meh, the soups are meh.....it's all meh. We've been here four times now, and I really don't want to come back. I don't mind so-so food, but it's just boxed food, isn't it? I mean, open a box, throw it in the fryer/oven/microwave or slap it on the grill/flat top, and you're done. Where's the home-made food? Where is the creativity? 

Nic: I'm thinking people don't go to this place for that kind of food. They're here for the beers, of which they have quite a bit on tap, hanging out with friends, watching some sports on the tv screens......

Nan: God, I hope they're here for the beer. Because after drinking enough you don't care about the food. Or the service.

Nic: What was wrong with the service?

Nan: Don't get me started. 

Nic: Sheesh. Okay. Here, have a beer.
Cool little neighborhood pub.  Food is good.  Drinks are good, maybe a little pricey but still great.  Pretty fun place to spend the football playoffs.

I'm Italian, and used to my mom, Nonni, and Nonna cooking away, so I'm pretty picky with my Italian food. My in-laws live in a tiny town with nothing but fast food, so they always want to eat out somewhere great when they come visit.  My FIL can be very fickle, as he's an amazing cook himself. Gino's has exceeded our expectations every time we go. It is the only place I will ever order veal. A-may-zing! The creme brûlée with cherries is to die for. My only...constructive criticism...the bright yellow on bright purple table clothes & napkins. Ick! But the great service, outstanding food, and visits from Gino himself make up for it!
My family LOVES this place! Wonderful! Wonder service, great tasting crust. Our absolute favorite!
Long wait on a weekend, food is fine, but nothing near the quality as Goldies. Oh Goldies the promised land!
Very nice ambiance outside by the water fountain. Staff was very attentive with a made to order Pizzas that were out of this world. Highly recommend

This was our first time in Idaho for us and we decided to stop here for lunch.... so glad we did. I loved the sticky fingers chicken and the heff beer was delicious.  Our server Becca was a sweetheart, she had our order quick and whatever we needed she was right there.

Wings are pretty much my favorite food on the planet, so naturally I couldn't wait to try Wingers. We decided to go during the awesome special for all you can eat wings so we could try all the different sauces. Started off with Classic Buffalo. Wtf!!! It was so incredibly spicy my eyes were watering. My mouth was on fire. I asked the waitress if they gave me the wrong sauce by mistake and she said, "I have had some complaints, maybe this is a bad batch of sauce".  Then why are you still serving it. Between my husband and I we tried 5 of the sauces and rubs. All were terrible. The sauces were all incredibly thick and syrupy. Sickly sweet or unbearably spicy. The park rub smelled and tasted like feet. The chicken itself was mediocre at best. The bone in wings were fine, but the sticky fingers were disgusting. You would bite in and it would be tough and rubbery. Zero quality control and nasty sauces. Won't go back.

The pizza was terrific but very very expensive. $18 for a 18" pizza (that does not feed a family of 5) with no toppings, toppings are an additional $2-$4 each!!!!!

Great pizza just way to expensive.
We love Joe's for a hearty breakfast. Plan on waiting in line on a Sunday morning. You won't be disappointed. The food is excellent and the service is  great as well.

Wow, this was the best restaurant food I've had in a long time. The employees were very polite and we got our food fast. I got a rice bowl with no zucchini, luau pork, the regular teriyaki sauce, and brown rice. It tasted not to salty and tasted genuinely from the tropics. I would strongly recommend you eat here.

My favorite breakfast spot. Everything is fresh and delicious. Service can be a little slow when they are busy but it is worth the wait. The BTA eggs Benedict (Bacon, Tomato, avocado) is my favorite with half order of French toast and country potatoes (not to be mistaken for yucky hashbrowns).

We made reservations at Gino's for my MIL's birthday and it did not disappoint. I ordered the baked ziti with sausage and mushrooms, MIL had the lamb shank, and husband had the veal saltimbocca. It was a tough decision because they have a lot of delicious sounding options on their menu. I believe the marinara sauce on my dish was the best I've ever tasted. I enjoyed the house salads that we added before dinner (I think the dressings are made in house). The desserts were pretty good, but not outstanding. However, the coffee that came with dessert was cold. I think we would go to Gino's regularly, but it's SO far away from our house in Boise.

Amazing food and hospitality. I love the ribs, potatoes, and collard greens. Come here when you can sit down, relax, and enjoy the laid back service style. You will not be disappointed by the quantity of food, the free flowing sweet tea, and the love served up by the family that runs the place.

Just checked in Hampton Inn and wanted something to eat real quick. As I walked over, there was a Del Taco with a packed drive thru and Los Betos with a few cars in front. At first glance, I thought they were closed as you can't see inside due to the tinted windows. 

Ordered a grilled chicken burrito and chips. The burrito definitely wasn't the best. Maybe the grilled peppers and onions were overcooked or something. It just wasn't right. To top it off, the chips were stale. 

Not sure how the rest of the menu is like but didn't impress me at all.  Would consider Del Taco over this place.

Met here for a couple beers and a turkey wrap before our softball game last night. The service was good, beer was cold and the wrap was fine. Pretty busy little place. Looks like many other strip mall pubs in the area. Our server quickly rang up our separate checks so we could get to the game. Nice place.

This was a great place that my dad enjoys on lunch break. I came from out of town and its first place I wanted to go to eat and I'm so glad we did. I didn't have a bad piece of sushi!! They make it all fresh so of course you have to wait lol. The cute little boats are a neat idea and they were good to place sushi all around the room so you got to try all the different plates as they floated by. $1 and $2 is a great price per plate, I only wish we had this in Orlando!! I definitely recommended this place!

The food tastes great and it's great for you. The food is fresh and not processed. The owner is super nice and has obviously put a lot of time and thought into this business. It's great to have a truly healthy clean option when grabbing food on the go.

Used to be awesome. Was my favorite burger place. Unfortunately the burgers have smaller meat than before and so now a burger just tastes like bread and the toppings. Also, second time in a row they forgot an order at my table. Burger was cold. Cheese not melted. Two times poor food and I'm not coming back. Bums me out that they changed. Five guys here I come. Better burger, half the money.
Good selection of delicious froyo and staff are always super friendly! Pistachio is the best. Yum.
Amazing vet clinic! Everyone there truly cares about the animals and always know what my pets names are. The prices are responsible and worth every penny to have my fur babies in such good hands.

Delicious breakfast spot, although food expands beyond basic breakfast. The menu was designed by a chef with good access to local items. Our waitress, Stacie, was informative and efficient, and friendly beyond just restaurant information. All six different menu items experienced over my visits were delicious, fresh and beyond the average fare. This could be a frequent go to place, if I lived in the area.

Had such a great experience ! Stopped in around 10ish after a looooong hot day. To our delight, we met our server Karen ! Super sweet, super attentive just all around super ! We were excited to try this new Wingers after a couple of sub-par experiences at the one in Nampa and this location did not disappoint !! We ordered the battered asparagus appetizer and they comped it because they felt it took a little to long to get to us. Frankly we didn't even notice that it took too long. My boyfriend got the ayce wings, i swear he's going to put them out of business i got the very yummy queso burger and we both got the amazing garlic fries. LOVE LOVE LOVE this place will def go back and ask for Karen's section, she rocks !!!

We love coming to wingers, especially if there is a sporting event we want to watch. I wanted to watch the cubs game, my boyfriend wanted to watch the ducks game. They made sure we were able to watch both. There are a ton of tvs and they are very accommodating. Their drinks are out of this world!! I've had quite a few different cocktails on their menu and have yet to have one I don't like. They also have a ton of beers on tap! We have never had bad service. However every time we sit in Annie or Kat's section our drinks never run dry and all of our food needs are met promptly. We definitely make a point to have one or the other. The last time we were in, Annie was our server and she really went above and beyond with her care for us. I highly recommend this place if you're looking for a relaxing environment with excellent waitstaff and great tasting food.

So I loved my pasta, it was so yummy. The risotto and fettuccine Alfredo was perfection. My actual favorite part was a tie between the creme brûlée and the free bread and olive oil they give. I am not sure what was in the Olive Oil but it had a little kick at the end. Made it better then any other I have had. This is a must visit to anyone who visits Idaho

I had a chicken pasta with a vegetable from the broccoli family. this place was great. My brother had the special: Pork steaks with risotto (details I do not remember), it was delicious! Service was very well done, they did not rush you, leftovers they bag for you and fairly well trained in etiquette as a server.  Dessert! oh can not wait till we go back, they have the best tiramisu! They use a private baker and contract outside the restaurant, apparently this person does catering, no shop!!! It is the best in the Area!
The best place overall we have been to thus far!

5 stars, as promised. Excellent all the way around on last visit. Yippee!
----
The first time I tried the Red Pavilion, I was like "I HAVE TO REVIEW THEM. YES." Then I face planted into my food and forgot to take photos. That process has repeated itself several times. Just so you know. I'll get my nitpickery out of the way first: the only reason I didn't give five stars is because there have been some small mistakes. Very minor, like lite veggies instead of no veggies (I know they're flavor! But bean sprouts are sneaky and masquerade as noodles, and nobody likes that! Unless you like bean sprouts. Which I don't. If that wasn't obvious.). 

Service is always fantastic, and they do get to know you, which is something I really appreciate. They're also super quick. Which is nice when you're in a hurry to devour the whole kitchen. Somebody back there knows how to prep! I don't think we've ever waited over ten minutes or so for food. Despite the snappy food delivery, they don't rush you along. The atmosphere is nice, and modern. Dark brown and red work well together. 

The food itself is fantastic. The end. 
Haha just kidding. I could probably talk about it for far longer than is necessary. Are you surprised? No? Moving on. I've been looking for a good Chinese place for what feels like a thousand years, but is more like ten. I know, everybody has their favorite around the valley, but I never stumbled over The One--the one you go back to every time someone says "I think I want Chinese tonight." Being something of a weenie, I prefer my Americanized fare, and I'm never disappointed. Favorites are the cracked pepper pork (okay, with some veggies, but only for flavor!), the lo mein, and chow rice. 

However, if there wasn't enough awesome to be found here already, they actually do have a separate menu with authentic food. Everybody who orders from it seems to enjoy it, though I haven't personally. And probably won't. Because weenie. 

So, all in all...eat here. I will probably adjust them up to five stars next time, as by then the instances of perfect service and food will have far eclipsed the nitpicking.
Ribs on Rib Night were great. Brandon a good and attentive bartender. Nice vodka martini.
I LOVE Korean,  This was not Korean....more like American stylized after Korean food I guess thats why they call it a fusion.  was it bad food....nah...it was very delicious

I was really excited to see a Chinese place opening on the south side of Meridian.  So excited in fact, that I insisted that we eat there tonight even though we have gift certificates to another restaurant that we know we like.  We were sure that it would be packed at 7:00 on Friday night but were able to get seated immediately.  The restaurant is nothing fancy but clean and pleasant and the menu and selection looked nice.  We skipped appetizers and just ordered dinner, then sat back to enjoy time as a family while we waited for our food.  And wait we did.  I have never waited so long for Asian food, almost an hour. When it finally came it trickled out of the kitchen.  First mine, then a couple of minutes later, my daughter's.  Then a few more minutes and the waiter brought my husband a dish he did not order with an offer to let him "upgrade" to that dish without extra charge!? He sent it back in favor of what he did order.  10 min. Later he received the dish he ordered and the waiter asked if he could get us anything else.  Um... 4 people ordered food, only 3 dished came out. Yes you can get us something else, the rest of our food! 10 more min. And my son finally had his dinner too. The food was good And fresh but wasn't so good that we will be craving more next week.        I left feeling mildly disappointed. I had such high hopes for The Red Pavilion. If we go there again it will be for take out.

I love the Milwaukee location, so I was super excited to try out this new spot. My expectations were blown right out of the water. The interior is gorgeous, and the atmosphere is soothing. The sushi is top tier and we tried one of the new lunch specials, the Fuji A, and we fell in love. The staff is so friendly, and were very attentive. Perfect for lunch, date night, or whenever!

I finally got to try Moe Joes after many months and a few attempts (they're ALWAYS packed).  We had a group of 4 and it was only a 20-25 minute wait for our table.  The portions are HUGE! Be prepared for leftover or share with a friend.  

Everyone at my table ordered breakfast and I opted for lunch.  I wish I hadn't because the breakfast food was delicious and I wasn't overly impressed with my chicken sandwich and fries. I'm not a huge fry fan as it is but they use real potatoes and slice them for fries which made them less crunchy than I prefer. I will admit that after tasting my friend's breakfast potatoes I ordered a side of my own because they were DELICIOUS!  My husband ordered a breakfast burrito enchilada style and it was ENORMOUS.  He's a big guy and he barely ate half of it.  Everyone else had nothing but good things to say about their food.  

One of my biggest pet peeves when it comes to dining is public restrooms.  Moe Joes has one bathroom for each gender.  On a busy Saturday morning/afternoon I would expect the employees to clean the restrooms and check them more frequently.  The women's restroom had wet toilet paper stuck to the seat and it didn't get cleaned during the time we came and left.  Both times that I used the restroom I had to wait because it was in use and one of those times it was a male employee from the kitchen.

Strangers to Boise, yet Yelp Boise was good to Mr. B and me.  Moe Joe's gave us good, solid memories of a meal we would like to repeat.  This is the kind of place that every hungry traveler (me being one of those types), every non-local, hopes to find for a satisfying breakfast.

I trust my friends.  And if they say the Garden Hash is good, I say, why not.  The two of us shared.   A huge plate came out, two eggs topping a large serving of artichokes, sautéed cherry tomatoes, zucchini, bell pepper, chipotle, mushroom, melted swiss cheese, and avocado over a raw spinach bed.  I had to nix the garlic only because  Michele R said it was strong, and I did not want to be burping the remainder of the day in the small confines of our car as we made our getaway toward new adventures.  That would not have been pleasant.   

Let's not forget their beautiful (Idaho) breakfast potatoes.  A great temptation here.  And I had essentially sworn off potatoes.   Right.

And the Chicken Fried Steak.  Possibly one of the best to have ever crossed my lips. It was not  mine to share, but somehow a chunk with the most amazing gravy magically appeared on my plate.  I shall have to thank the CFS gods, or was it really Mr. B instead? 

Lucky locals!  Not only is the menu creative and appealing, it is clean, spacious, upbeat and welcoming.  The prices are most reasonable.  My tummy says, "Hey Yelpers, you certainly got this one right."

I shall keep this one for my bookmarks.
Its a knockoff of bullritos or Chipotle or any of the other build your own burritos place.... It ok food Id rather go to Bullritos
Way over priced. Pizza was good after sending it back because it was cold. Much better options around Meridian, Boise, Nampa for less$$

I've been to Gino's a number of times.  They used to be in downtown Boise.  The old location was a little more romantic, but the new location is much more convenient (for me anyway).

I almost always get the boar shank and it is awesome!  I feel like a caveman when I'm eating it.  It is served with gnocci, which is incredible.  So much so that I started making it at home.  It's a serious pain to make it, so I stopped and only get it when I go to Gino's.

The food is great, Gino almost always comes by to say hi, you can't go wrong.  Excellent place for dinner.

Great food and excellent staff. I like that Gino comes by and says hi every time I visit. I have been here many times and I have always had an excellent experience. The calamari is great and the Boar. I ha the stuffed peppers last time and they were excellent too.

Fast service and clean food. 
As small as this place is, quality of the vegetables and meets were excellent. No dried out tips or fat handing off the chicken. 
Their Curry beef was so tender, it was amazing. ( please note that their curry is dry powered curry, not soup base)
Orange chicken was crunch and great!
Kung Pao Chicken could use little
More spice but, it had a lot of peanuts. 
Steaming hot rice and all those food, it was joyful. 
Also, please note that when I say"clean" it is how they keep the place clean. I got here as lunch was ending. Server lady actually cleaned every chairs back, seat and handle.  That is clean!

Have you ever went over to Famous Dave's to eat
And the food just ain't no good?
The macaroni's soggy, the veggies mushed,
And the chicken tastes like wood

With a hip hop the hippie to the hippie
The hip hip a hop, a you don't stop the rockin'
To the bang bang boogie
Say up jump the boogie to the rhythm of the boogie the beat

We came up to Idaho this week and stayed here for 5 days.  7/2018 ,  Overall the staff was great and friendly.  The sites could use some revamping, Maybe make them a little wider and deeper  for the back in.  You feel pretty on top of one another.  That is not the reason for only 3 stars however.  The pool was indoors, it was very hot and stuffy, maybe some skylights that open would help.  The spa was out of service.  So if your spa is out of service then drain it.  It was full with a funky looking film floating on top of the water.  Not safe with kids around.  Also the WIFI was just ok, Upgrading the WIFI is a must with the amount of people that stay there.  Also some better signage to find the place would help.  I would definitely come hack again as we have family in Nampa.  Overall, very clean, well maintained and good staff.  Hope this helps.

Good portions. The lunch specials are great as well. Best Chinese in the area. We are newer to the area and had a hard time finding decent Chinese around, especially coming from California. I would compare the taste to a P.F. Chang's but the price is much lower.

That I know of, Shanaz is the only full blown Soul Food restaurant in the area.  

Sure, there's a food truck that touts itself a soul food sensation.  

And, yeah, there's yet another food truck offering Southern inspired eats (some of it bordering on Soul food)..

But, a full blown--sit down, here's a menu, and some corn bread for you to munch on while you wait--Soul Food joint?

This is your one and only option.

Thankfully, it's a good one.  

Bring them your tired, your poor, your huddled masses and Shanaz will feed them fried peanut butter and jelly sandwiches and mac & cheese balls fit for the tattered prides of kings.  The powdered sugar dusted, waffle batter dipped, fried peanut butter and jelly has the indulgent taste of stuffed french toast.  The decadently rich mac & cheese balls will have you moaning during their consumption and sighing with satisfaction afterwards.  

This is a sort comfort food that will leave you feeling fat, sassy, and with the inexplicable urge to hug the chef.  

My one and only complaint was that the menu is a bit limited and left me wishing for a few more options.

Other than that small complaint--a fine meal that will leave you feeling as content as your grandmother's cooking always did--will be enjoyed by all.

Get to it!

We had the Carmelized Pork Vermicelli Noodle dish a.k.a Bun Thit Nuong.  It was Fabulous!  We also ordered Pad Woon Sen a.k.a Glass Noodles with egg and chicken.  So Delicious!  I am so glad to have found fresh authentic amazing vietnamese food in Meridian.  This restaurant has new management.  I hope they stay!
Delicious food! Amazing fruit bowl! And the waitress was very pleasant and friendly. The only thing I would say is to back off on the salt with the farmer's hash.
Great Pho! Almost didn't come because of the Yelp reviews, but they are so much better than 2.5 stars! Def will come back.

We worked with Gene on purchase of MH, great person to deal with, and service center is great with great people like Brandy, Lance, Steve, Nick, and all others whose names I can't remember, mechanics like John and great superstar Brandon, and all others that need to be mentioned, I wish I had list of everyone that made our experience great. Thank you all for everything!, we will be back if not for service, but just to see all of you! Thank you!
Traded in a Yamaha R1 for a used harley they took in on trade. Had a great experience. My work schedule is crazy so they made sure to make it a fast process!

Just ok pizza for the price.  $14-16 for a 'small' pizza- which to be fair is quite large.  If you want a pizza with a lot of toppings, you're going to pay out the nose for it.  $16 for just the pizza, add between $2-$4 for EACH additional topping.  It honestly didn't taste that great.  I make better pizza at home.  The salad was just so-so as well.  Much better places to eat in the Village than this.  If you want great tasting fire brick oven pizza try Flat Bread Neapolitan pizza in Meridian!
Excellent pizza and the flavor was so good, amazing atmosphere as I really enjoyed the outdoor patio seating by the fountains, and very attentive staff. Only downfall is there is no lunch menu!

What a pristine campground! Pulling in to registration you are greeted by a gazebo and bubbling fountain. The campsites are all very tidy & clean. The grounds are well-manicured. The clubhouse boasts of a social room, game room, indoor pool (with hot tub), and a laundry room. The bathrooms and laundry are clean and well-maintained (there's even an iron available for community use). The only reasons I am giving this KOA 4 stars instead of 5 is because 1) it didn't come across as a family-oriented/kid-friendly (the playground was minimal and no activities for kids) and 2) the wi-fi was pretty bad (signal was weak and I kept getting kicked off randomly).

I enjoy Famous Dave's for several reasons: the service is always great! The wait staff and bar staff are happy to serve, as well as knowledgeable about their menus. The food is delivered promptly and with a smile. The food is incredible, their sauce options and variety on the menu always keep me interested and intrigued to try something new. My favorite aspect though is the healthy options they have, and the willingness that they go through to ensure that you are getting what you are looking for, and the availability and ease of substitutions to fit the dietary requests.

The olive oil and roasted garlic that comes with a nice Loaf of warm bread is a nice touch.  The is a solid Italian restaurant.   I recommend the fire sticks for an appetizer. (Not spicy at all)  The main dishes are all just ok for a weeknight family dinner but not the best for a romantic night out. If that makes sense..  Service was only fair.  Had to ask for refills and food came out at all different times.  :(
Really great service and everything with the food was really good. Planning on coming back soon to try more of the menu.

Yes I agree with the other review. I like their coffee very much , Starbucks is getting boring. 
The flies is a big issue for me , I like to sit and enjoy my drink with any pastry but with flies is hard to enjoy. They need a fan at the entrances.

First time here and was not sure what to expect, as ok I  pizza. It was great watching the hand tossing of pizza crust in the air, like the good old days. Loved the brick cooling taste of the crust.  We got a half and half  Pizza with light sauce which was perfect for each side. The crust for those who do not know is on the thin side, but NOT like cardboard or pita chips. It is soft for bending and chewing.

Our server Brooke was great with knowledge of wines and the tastes of every item (they have to taste or sample the wine and food).  One good thing is we were not rushed at all. Brooke brought out drink refills without us having to hunt her down.

With the people outside, watching the waterfalls, and the personnel who work here ... we are coming back and you should give them a try.

Jimmy John's Rocks!

Plus they will deliver a single sandwich to my office.

My wife and I have been coming here since 2014 and I just noticed that I hadn't given my love to my favorite breakfast place. Where do I begin is it the food, the staff? It's both I've likely eaten 45 or more breakfasts here and have never been disappointed. The eggs Benedict is some of the best I've ever had. And their hashes are to die for. From savory to sweet the menu aims to please. The house is packed on weekends so either get here early our be prepared to wait, but you won't be disappointed because anticipation makes the meal all that much better.

Food was good for a little local place. They could use a little more space to seat people and the environment could be a tad bit cleaner but the flavors of the food were good. My son LOVES their grilled cheese.
Servers really need to step it up from the hostess to wait staff. Place had at max 10 tables and could not manage. We had our dinner serve an waited for another wait staff to get us silverware!

This place is pretty delicious! My husband and I came in tried the Asian fusion tacos that were filled with tender pieces of meat and a vegetable slaw- amazing!  We also ordered the macaroni bites which were consisted of deep fried breaded pieces of macaroni accompanied by a homemade sauce (my mouth is watering guys! ) We then split the waffles and fried chicken. I have not tasted a more perfect , more crispy fried chicken ever in my life. Our waiter was the owner which was friendly, his wife was the cook She later came out to greet us. You can definitely taste the love she puts in her food. I totally recommend you stop by! I must warn you though when you leave you will smell like a fryer. But you probably won't care because the food is so yummy!
These guys saved my job today!  My battery died and I desperately needed to get a new one ASAP!  They went above and beyond to help me out.  I can't thank them enough.  I will be back!

The food was really good. But the service was a little bit lacking. Ask to get the table wiped down again and was just handed a napkin. The price is rather expensive though. 30$ for two people for breakfast. I did get a mimosa but for $4 I expect a little bit more than I got. But again the food was very good four to five star Worthy.
I run about 6 phones and a few devices threw Verizon for my business. I have had great experience with a gentleman by the name of Russell Phillips. Always a phone call away and great advise.
