We love Costa Vida!!! We been coming to this location since they've opened! We came here today for lunch. My daughters shared a Large Sweet Pork Salad and I had their daily special, which is Sweet Pork Enchilada w/drink! Everything was good! Love their refillable Horchata! Sure, their lettuce was not in the perfect condition since we spotted a few brown pieces in our food, but it happens, especially during this time of the year. Despite that, I still give Costa Vida five stars ! That's how much I love Costa Vida! Till next time!

This is a good find. Small and packed with people but attentive by the staff. Usually a wait during brunch time but if your a single rider like myself, you'll get seated quick! Had the Chicken Fired Steak. Well cooked, good breading and juicy. The gravy on top was delicious and the potatoe side was also crispy and well cooked. Love that they offer both strawberry jam or marionberry with your toast. If you are down here, walk on it with an appetite because the plates are big.

Love this place! Took my family for the first time today and will definitely be back! I love how they don't weigh your cups of yogurt and each size is a set price! The chocolate & vanilla flavors were smooth & on point! I loved the coconut flavor! The orange sorbet was the best that I have had from anywhere! The strawberry banana & pineapple were also very tasty! There was a good assortment of toppings and the berries were fresh!  The staff was friendly, the ambiance was clean and with fun pops of orange & a pretty sparkling backsplash! The wedding cake flavor tasted off to me, not sure if it was a bad batch or it was my tastebuds. Orange Leaf is now my #1 choice for fro-yo!! Can't wait to go back!

First the good things:  Our server was friendly and it wasn't expensive.

Now:  We ordered 3 breakfasts (eggs benedict, a version of eggs benedict, the chilaquiles and some pancakes for the table - people here recommended them).  We sat for 30 minutes waiting for our food without our server checking in or giving us an update.  Finally, when she was busing a nearby table, we asked her what the delay may be.  Turns out they had to make the hollandaise and that was taking some time.  She brought the pancakes to keep us from getting hangry.  

The pancakes were under cooked.  I would not eat them again, they just weren't anything to rave about. The hollandaise was creamy but had no flavor.  They forgot the lemon juice and cayenne.  I ate it, because I was hungry and it wasn't disgusting.  The chilaquiles was equally flavorless.  It had so much potential but tasted as if someone had dumped canned adobo sauce over tortilla chips and tossed on some onions and jalepeños with some bland chicken.  

In general it was just a bland mess.  I would not return here.  I'd rather brave the lines and crowds at Goldy's downtown than waste my time here.
We had a nice meal at Fugiyama.  We had a most amazing , friendly server.  I think her name is Sofan.  She is wonderful!
Always a great experience. Great staff make the experience less stressful. You leave feeling confident your pet got the best care.

Gluten free deliciousness.  I was beyond happy with my breakfast. Ordered a combo plate that included a gluten free pancake. I wish that I could have eaten the entire meal but the serving sizes were too big. Our side of fruit was incredible, local fresh produce and again, more than I could eat. My husband got an omelet, it too was just perect. Service was spot on, we never had to wait for a coffee refill. Wish there was one in Vegas.

Had a great celebratory meal here with my parents. Splendidly surprised to find some good Italian in central Idaho. We all ordered variations of veal which were cooked to perfection- each one. Veal parm was fantastic, plenty of flavor bursting sauce. There was a side of pasta, which we added alfredo to. it was glorious. The daily special veal chop, bone-in, was excellent, and the vegetables were sautéed perfectly. The veal Saltado was also very good, but the pasta could have used something different for a sauce besides the browned butter reduction to vary it from the meat. All in all, the meal was great. The only reduction on rating is due to the cost- which is more a reflection on the economy in Idaho and not the restaurant. We each had 3 entrees, along with 4 drinks total, for $115. Modest by many cities' standards, but difficult for some in the area.
Love it! Best coffee and customer service around. Puts the competition to shame. Everything is good on the menu!

Here we are two years after my last review and Red Robin has definitely improved. The staff has settled in, the kitchen seems to be more consistent, which means the food has improved. Honestly, the "cup" of soup is still a joke but the rest has worked itself out. The burger selection is on point and the other options are excellent. There are no pasta options anymore! Keep that in mind if you liked their pasta. They still have Kraft mac and cheese for the kids but that's all you expect in the pasta department. Overall, the menu is good with a wide variety of American food type options and the quality of service and taste has gone up. We will add Red Robin back into our family friendly rotation!

I have used Dave's prior for large catering events and have done well. I recently used for job for 850 and they not only failed but failed miserably.  They were late, sent only 3 people, no paper plates.  Have no idea what they were thinking.  Then they took no responsibility of there lack of execution.  All they said sorry.  We actually had to help them serve.  My event was over and they were still serving.  Would not recommend for any type of catering.  You have been warned.

Yum! Great coffee, we had soy decaf mochas with coconut flavoring. They were delicious. We don't like super strong coffee, and their coffee was perfect to our tastes! If you're looking for a super strong coffee, this is not your place, you'll like Starbucks better.

LOVE me some ReStyle! 
Always find AMAZING items. 
Great stamp card program.
Friendly/Funny Staff
Usually has good music playing
Has the BEST sales in town
Definitely my favorite thrift store in the Boise area.

Food....Fantastic.  Service a bit slow but we could tell they were short handed tonight (February 9th).  Did I say the food was great?  I had the stuffed peppers and my wife the salmon.  We haven't tasted this kind of Southern food in Idaho ever and I don;t expect to any time soon, well until I return likely within the month.  I hope business is good enough to justify an expansion sometime soon.

Our favorite breakfast place! Fresh squeezed oj, great coffee, super service (esp Sam!!). My favorite - the Veggie Round- egg whites, avocado, spinach, tomato and cheese on an English muffin, and it comes with a bowl of fruit and toast. WOW! G loves their oatmeal with fruit and nuts. Most of the servings are fairly large, so go hungry. We go during the week, as weekend wait times can be long since they don't take reservations.
Hands down the best pizza around the Boise area! Love this place. It's not cheap, but it is oh so worth it. Great from start to finish!
Best pizza near by! if your in the mood for pizza, but this isnt open (say its sunday or 2 am) check out Pie Hole just down the street

This place is fantastic! Where do I start?

We went there recently for Father's day and the line was out the door. Luckily we had good timing and we were seated in 10 minutes.

I ordered the eggs florentine, my finance ordered the pancakes with with the coffee syrup and his mother ordered the jalapeño pancakes (yes Jalapeño )

Egg Florentine: Blown away. The hollandaise sauce was done perfectly. The egg was poached to the right balance of soft and sturdy enough to stand on a layered english muffin. And the big surprise was the roasted garlic. It made the meal. I devoured my breakfast with such satisfaction. Delish

The pancakes with Coffee was good! The pancakes were 'cake like' as I like it. Thick, moist but crispy on the edges. The syrup did not have the strong coffee taste i expected...but nonetheless very good

The Jalapeño pancakes were the biggest surprise. What a creative dish! You would think an odd combination to add Jalapeño profile to a pancake but it was brilliant! There was cream cheese folded int the middle of the pancake balanced with the Jalepeno and the syrup made for what I would say is my favorite breakfast item there.

Meridian finally has a great breakfast spot! I can not wait to go back and try out the rest of the menu.

There was one thing that did surprise me and that is the lack of espresso drinks. So if you want a latte or espresso with your breakfast, bring it with you. Our server told us that the owner is working on getting an espresso machine. Hopefully that will happen soon!

I am confused why no one has reviewed Gino's at their new location in Meridian. We went tonight for dinner and it was just as I remembered it from when they were in downtown Boise. For starters we had the calamari... absolutely the best calamari in Boise or Idaho -  trust me, I know my calamari. 
I had the lamb shank and my husband had the red snapper (tonight's special). The lamb had simmered for 6-8 hours and you could tell! Meat was falling off the bone - the gravy infused with its richness. I am not a big fan of the run of the mill spaghetti-smeared-in-red-sauce Italian. I think that kind of easy Italian lacks imagination and flavor. I *only* like the way Gino's does Italian. The red snapper in white sauce was light and flavorful. Oh, last but not least - our server Josephine made the dinner even more of a pleasant experience... she was like an aunt, checking in, making helpful suggestions and making sure we enjoyed our food.  
We finished with coffee and tiramisu which was rich - yet still delicate. Serving size was just right as well. 
I so miss them in Boise. I will never get over the loss of Gino's, Mortimer's or Milky Way but if you get a hankering for Italian - drive over to Meridian. It's worth it. As my husband put it, "I will never again attempt to make Italian at home again... why bother when Gino's is here?"
Excellent food and big portions. Almond chicken is amazing! Price is fair. Waitresses are polite. Location is ideal for us suburbanites :)
They are quick and convenient much better than the Milwaukee location and not as. Crowded
Good gets a 4-5 service is a 1 at best. Probably why there's NOONE eating inside. Not friendly at all and you get the feeling you're annoying them by being there.

Costa Vida is a good, solid Mexican/American chain fast food restaurant.  The salads are very good, the pork Burrito or Enchiladas are also very good, as well as the nachos with the same meat.  Try the fish tacos as well.  

Sometimes the consistency is a little weak, youll get different quantities of meat each time you go and the pico is sometimes a little lukewarm.  The gal at the counter is going to really put the pressure on for a dollar tip with a big smiling "please sign at the bottom!"

My fiancé and I came for dinner here for the first time tonight, and I must say I am so pleased we did! The food is amazing and Jing, our server was incredible! She greeted us right away, was extremely patient with all of my questions, and had our dinner out in record time! Jing was extremely sweet and pleasant during our entire dining experience. Our meals were delicious and the serving sizes were very generous. We will most definitely be returning!

Was our first time and was not impressed. They had 4 people working standing around talking upon entering and not one greeted us. The service was horrible, and the food was average, would advise people to stop by another sandwich shop maybe cobys, much nicer people and way better sandwiches. I'm saying good bye and good luck jimmy.

My love affair with RR stared long, long ago. Since then, I've had many ups and down with this place in different locations. I'll always keep coming back. Unfortunately, this was not the best of times. 

My group and I showed up right at opening for an early lunch and were the first people in. We sat and ordered quick enough and our server Jannel was very sweet. Really, the only problem was that we only got one order of fries. We chose to RR for a mass French fry intake, and in that regard we were let down. Big guys at the table who all ordered entrees were made to split single baskets of fries. Out second basket came after our check had been paid. Not what we had in mind when we we thought of a satisfying meal.  

The burgers were delicious as always, the environment was great and the staff was friendly. But for a group of eight, first thing after opening, I would hope to have better service. I would still recommend this place and I'll still go back. Could have been better this time around though. Oh well.
The atmosphere is beautiful the food was delicious the company was great the waitress is amazing her name is RC and if you haven't had her as a waitress yet you're missing out.
Ordered from the Allergen menu. Staff was attentive and knowledgable. Good stuff.

Been going to Gino's since I was a teenager with my parents. Now its a place I love to go when I'm craving good Italian. All of the food is top-notch from the homemade salad dressings, the sauces and of course the pasta. The service is always impeccable, although sometimes it can be a bit slow on a busy night but I guess you could just call it relaxing. I am gluten free and love that they offer gluten free ziti, although I'd love to see more gluten free pasta options and maybe even some bread to dip in their delicious oil! There really is nothing to compare with Gino's in all of Idaho.

We stayed, courtesy and generously of his sister, at Candlewood Inn and Suites. It's an extended stay place, and we spent 3 nights there. The hotel was nicely set just off a main highway, but close to mostly everything and the airport. We checked in at 11:30pm, but the front desk was wide awake and eager to help. If we could get up by 9:30am, we could take part in their free (or paid for by the room?) breakfast. Even with the time change, that wasn't going to happen. They hadn't met Mr. V yet. breakfast starts at 2pm. 

They had a lot of parking spaces, and the lot wasn't enormous or required much walking. 

The bathroom was quite possibly the same size as the bedroom, and there was a small little kitchen that brewed me some coffee the following morning. Though, they had yet to meet me, as I could've drank the entire pot. Mr. V went to check on breakfast the next morning, and while it was over, they gave us piles of food - bagels, eggs, toast, yogurt, fruit, cream cheese, and juices - that they didn't want to throw out. He came back with a big tray and a big smile, and was happier than I had seen him in awhile. Apparently, scrounging for food and winning will do that to a man.

Overall, a good place - typical hotel with their limestone bathrooms and white sheets. But it did what it was meant to do. And we were in Boise.
Nice to have Sarah back behind the bar. Great food and drinks as always. Best beer selection in the area.

We yelped places for breakfast in Meridian where we have never been and saw Moe Joe's. We decide to try their breakfast since the ratings were great! The wait was about 10 minutes. The young man who seated us was very friendly and professional. Our waitress was great as well, nice and proficient.  The food was delicious and correct. I liked that the food was not soaked in butter/oil. We will be back!

I am always so pampered going into SB Salon. Jen my nail tech has always made me feel special and amazing. Her quality of work is constantly great. April S. Is an amazing makeup artist and her services are comfortable and relaxing. I highly recommend SB Salon (Jen and April) and their services

Since we live in Middleton and work in meridian we go shopping here all the time especially since they have a starbucks!! It's a very clean and welcoming store. The only times I have ever had problems ware first time I went in it took me forever to find the clothes section because it's on the complete opposite side from the home goods. The two are separated by the groceries... That didn't make much sense to me... Also sometimes their prices are a bit on the higher side so we don't do heavy shopping here just quick things that we need. They do have really good produce though that is definitely worth the money!

Although I didn't get to experience the restaurant,  I did get to taste the pizza. Bought a pizza for take out and was not disappointed at all. Just fantastic. 
When I did go in I was met by the hostess and she immediately checked on my order and introduced me to the one in charge of orders. Very courteous staff and I wish I could have stayed to enjoy the atmosphere I was observing. Will definitely come back and stay for my next visit.

Okay-- we are so happy we found this place! Once you are inside you forget you are in a strip mall. Restaurant is tastefully decorated, quiet, and the servers are polite and attentive.  Food was delicious and portions are big!

I went to order take out and it was a simple order...needless to say the rice was over cooked and had no flavor. I never made it out with my soup and had to go back to pick up.  Chicken was ok but tasted old or cooked in old oil...spring rolls were very good!

Would rate 6 stars, if possible... 
Awesome pizza, bar none... fav stop for a sit down pie... wife loves the white sauce with chicken and veggies!! Also great with a Stella!
Awsome atmosphere and sit out on patio is a must!

Food is OK usually but I've had a few issues with staff being rude. Tonight I went in and my to go order was incorrect. They argued with me about what they thought I had ordered and made me purchase the incorrect order.  I don't think I will go back again.

It seems to be a hard task to find a true Italian restaurant that doesn't butcher the food. Coming from a true Italian family I can tell you, you won't be disappointed. Such a great place with great food.

Es uno de mis restauranes favoritos para desayunar tienes un buffet de ensalada y un menu variado ademas el servicio es muy rapido t las meseras muy hamable.  Yo vivo en meridian y me encanta ir a este restaurant cada ves que puedo.

After 5 visits over the past year, I feel it's time to actually write the review.  Our group meets here, so it's unavoidable that I'm going to eat here.  Sadly.

Let me start by offering that the service is usually good.  The staff is attentive, and alert to your needs.  Unfortunately, that's not enough to justify a two-star review.

Item's I've tried:
= Mac and Cheese - bland, the side order is laughably small.  In fact, everyone in our group jokes about how small it is and the face on a person when the little dish is placed on the table.  Don't do it.  
= Side Salad - again, it's small, but it is fresh.
= Brisket - I would compare it to British Toast, dry and flavorless.  Sad.
= Burnt Tips - over cooked (or under sauced), yeah, I know, burnt, but they shouldn't be dry.
= Ribs - the dry rub is tasty, but it seems they are cooked the day before and reheated.  The meat is dry when there is still some fat visible.  How do you do that.
= Dinner Salads - this is where you should focus your thoughts.  The dinner size salads are good portions and the dressings are good.  But, I'm not going to a BBQ joint for a salad.
= Beer selection - there is something for everyone, and the beer isn't priced through the ceiling like most chain restaurants.

Bottom line: if you are looking for a beer and salad, then give it a whirl.  But, if you are looking to enjoy some BBQ, find another option.

Was pretty excited to try something new, wow was I disappointed.  I really like street tacos and reading the ingredients, asked for no cheese and placed my order.  I also saw a garlic lime sauce on there, who knew it was mayonnaise and sour cream based? Yucky, to say the least.  The young man behind the counter of course got the order wrong and the back had to make them again (no cheese dude!).  When I took my first bite, I knew these were going to be disgusting.  Also have to mention they were stone cold and just freshly made!   Reordered without sauce without cheese and paid for them again.  Again, 2nd order was stone cold, all lettuce in the bottom, and the meat (what little of it that was there, less than a teaspoon) was flavorless AND it was shredded beef, not chopped like real street tacos.  Tater tots are tater tots no matter how you fry 'em up, nothing special, even worse when cold (not even the slightest but warm AND my grandson who is 5 wasn't that impressed.  What 5 year doesn't eat tater tots?).  Best thing, was the soda!  Kept worrying all night if my family was going to be jockeying for the bathroom.  Don't waste your time, unless you like awful food.

Its almost on par with Eggetc, back home [in KC], except the price point is way, way higher. 

Coffee is better than most, breakfast is quick to come and great flavored. 
Their biscuits and gravy is rather phenomenal--and that's my "Go To Judgement" for a breakfast place. Light and fluffy bread and lite, non-greasy gravy. 

Fruit bowl was insane. Tons more fruit than I've ever seen offered. Wife and kids food was great as well. 
If it was 10$ cheaper, I'd be way more apt to make this a weekly Sunday outing, but I can't justify 200$ a month. Lol.

Let me start off by saying I really enjoy their food & beers. That being said, the service was horrendous. And visiting on Halloween weekend meant most of the staff was dressed up in some awful way. I think I spotted a girl dressing as a offensive linemen, what seemed to a "walk of shame" that somehow included a shift at work, and a handful of other idiots looking entirely unprofessional. I get it, it's fun to dress up once in awhile, but leave that trash for your parties afterwards. 

Service was real bad. 4 of us waited 15 minutes for our sodas despite the joint being half empty on a Saturday afternoon, and our waitress continuously had to make multiple trips because she kept one hand in her pants pocket. Food took another 40 minutes to arrive(All you can eat sticky fingaz) in which we never saw our waitress for refills of drinks or popcorn. 

The sticky fingaz, were great. All the sauces my table had, had elevated spice levels from the last time we visited, which was a good sign, however their portions of "2" extra fingers is a real pain in the ass for those of us wishing to eat in upwards of 7,000 calories a meal.
one of my favorite places to eat everything ive ever ordered was beond good defenitly a five star here just need a bigger place the wait is a killer

My husband and I ate here for the first time today. Little to no "ambiance," but the service was quite efficient, even though the place was very busy. My loaded hash browns (today's special) were pretty good, although perhaps a little under-cooked. My husband had better luck with his Farmhouse breakfast.
Gino.  Another great and tasty meal!  Great penne with sausage. Thank you!  See you soon!

My husband and I just moved back to the area and our Golden Retriever (just 7 years old) became very ill. I was in a rush to find a good vet, I had no idea what it could be just what I had learned googling his symptoms. Dr. Bingham has been amazing through all of this!! Answering a million questions I had and being quick and aggressive with the treatment protocol. Our boy was diagnosed with cancer, lymphoma in his bone marrow after ruling out EVERY other possibility... I am happy to say he is in remission and we are done with treatments next month!! I am very glad I chose to take him there.

This is my favorite breakfast place. They have by far the best mimosas in the treasure valley. This is the one place where I actually get factory potatoes instead of hash browns, because they're not bland, they are crisp and have just the right amount of seasoning. My favorite meal was the maple bacon fried chicken, but alas it is no longer an option (bring it back). I settled instead this time for the chicken fried steak. The biscuits and gravy is also a classic here. My last server was fantastic, wish I remembered her name. She was very prompt in her service and more importantly she seemed like she actually was excited that we were her customers. Great job!

We are back in Boise and to our favorite place for dinner.  The service is always excellent.  We had Taylor, Jessica and Christina as our waitresses on different days and they were all superb. The food was consistently great. My compliments to your restaurant. Keep up the good work!!!!
Good, Good Good!!  We live in Meridian and it's great to have dining choices on this side of Eagle Road.  Service is great and we always see the owner checking on guests.

I like everything here except one hostess who walked us to the table, dont know her name, long hair and little bigger than other hostess. wearing dress showing her back. She is not friendly with fake smile and snobby. Food, waiters and owner are all superb. 8/8/13

The food was delicious. The decor funky and fun. The decor added to the joy of the night. The server acted as if her mind was anywhere but with our group. Had to ask repeatedly for water, napkins, sides that we'd ordered with our pizza. Most of our pizza was gone by the time the sides arrived. Loved the outside seating area. We will try it again on our next visit to the Boise area.
Wonderful.  Food to die for. Wine was outstanding. We will absolutely go back. Our waiter was very attentive and made good suggestions. We had a great time
Sarah provided fabulous service. I love the sticky finger salad. The interior is great. We will be back.

Quick take out time. We ordered  Drunken noodles which were delicious as well as the red curry. Sweet and spicy. As is normal with Thai food, it is not cheap but they do have a great lunch menu from 11-3 for $8. If you like good Thai food, you will appreciate this clean and friendly place. We will definitely be back!

I can't say enough about IPH. We had a medical issue with Maxwell, our 12-yr old Kerry Blue Terrier. The service we received from Drs. Shapero and Bingham as well as technician Amanda was incredibly professional and caring. They explained all the options we had as well as all procedures available. They were kind and understanding. We have two other doggies and we will continue to seek and utilize their services, based on the care they demonstrated with our beloved Max.  I love these guys. You will too.

Gotta love bottomless fries.....and if your kids like mac-n-cheese...well holy cow all you can eat mac-n-cheese!!!!  I have an utter and total disdain for anything non local....Red Robin is one of the few and RARE exceptions.  They aren't a GREAT burger but they have some good ones.  My kids love it for the all you can eat fries and mac (which they NEVER get to eat)  so its a sure fire way to eat on the cheap with an ok burger.  This particular Red Robin take a minute to bring you your food....well almost an hour at least.  I came in today with the wife adn kiddos hoping for a quick meal and ended up spending almost 2 hours there. I mean sheesh its not like they have to go slaughter the bull.... in anycase not bad food wise but not great either

I won't be returning to this jiffy lube....ever. 
I agree about feeling 'sold' but they couldn't handle the task at hand let alone up-sell. 
First off, I have gone to jiffy lube (different location) since I can remember for my service and I ALWAYS get full synthetic. When I pulled up I asked for them to do whatever was in the computer from last time. When I went to pay for my service I noticed there as no up charge for the synthetic. That was because they put regular oil and readily admitted that they didn't look at the previous service. Then asked me what would I like them to do?! My response... Fix it!! Oh but this one doesn't  carry Pennzoil, although the signage (and even the sticker they put on my  vehicle) states they do. That's the short version of a super 
 frustrating experience. 
I'm glad there are other locations in the valley. 
I feel like two stars is generous but I am trying to give a little credit for fixing the issue as best they could.

Re*Bath did a full remodel on my master bathroom.  I was impressed that, as quoted, they did the whole job in five days.  I'm talking gutting the whole room and starting over - Wow!  The estimate/planning process was a comfortable process and I thank Damon for his time.  Every day was choreographed down to the minute.  Re*Bath technicians Curtis and Kevin worked tirelessly every day (alongside outsourced companies (i.e., plumbing, electrical and drywall)) and met with me at the end of each day for updates and progress reports.  Although there were a handful of small imperfections, the end result after completion was exactly as I had planned.  It's a gorgeous room now!  Thank you Re*Bath!  I look forward to hiring Re*Bath again in the near future for a kitchen remodel!

The service was good, everybody was nice. There were quite a few flies where were sitting, but they weren't a very big problem. My meat was dry and tough, mediocre at best. The fries were really bad and tasted like they were cooked the day before. The barbecue sauce was good, but was necessary to make the meat edible. The meal was decent, but I'm in no hurry to go back.

We've been here several times & always have good food. The coffee is great, too. Unfortunately, the seating process is inefficient & disorganized, which causes delays... Couples seated at 4-tops & 6-tops, etc. I've watched customers walk out due to the delays. The service is always friendly, but it & the kitchen speed is hit or miss. If you aren't on any timeline & have time to spend, it's a great place to eat.
Everything about this place was not good.  Food was not fresh, bland and pretty much awful.  Don't be confused by references to Siam Thai which used to be around here.  This place is not that place.

I absolutely love this place! Although the lines can be long, the food is worth the wait and warrants a large crowd. The steak is my favorite, but the other options are also good. The sweet tortillas are amazing ... as long as they're still warm when you eat them.

Love this place! Tons of choices. Loads of toppings. Atmosphere is fun and festive, bright and cheery! Prices are a little high but that's to be expected with frozen yogurt. Also they'll let you try it before you buy it, which is great.

2 stars... What, not Moe Joes!  Yep afraid so, I was so excited to try this place based on reviews but no one could predict that MOE'S Margin Of Error would have me looking for a Means Of Escape (get it?)

  A group of us went to brunch and this place came up and the 4.5 yelp rating really drew us in, seriously was coming with HIGH expectations.  From a sales and marketing background I immediately was nagged by the half finished decor, the identity crisis in the menu, (so many Mexican dishes am I at an American breakfast joint or a Los Betos? Really.. chilaquiles! It's hard to even find this at a authentic Mexican spot yet it's at MOE'S lol.

  Wait time was decent as it was not very busy at all, we did come around 12:45-1pm which is an hour away from close but I'll get to that in a min.  When our food came here is our EXPERIENCE.

  Meat omelette/potatoes/toast $8.99- The omelette was seasoned well, Egg was cooked, cheese however was not melted (how did this happen?)  The potatoes were a shock to me due to they were STONE COLD, overly salty, and we were not informed it wasn't hashbrowns.  What really pissed me off was my toast, I felt insulted when it arrived and was just BURNT... where are the standards! 

  Buscuits and Gravy 3.99-  I decided to splurge on some B&G being a connoisseur and master cook of it myself.  I was dissapointed as my first taste was ice cold and the flavor was meh, it was also served on a square "buscuit" but had the texture of a garlic bread loaf.    

  Don't worry it wasn't just my food that was cold a few of my party needed plates remade as well.  Some good points were the French Toast and the Eggs Benny recieved some rave reviews from my guests after it was reheated.  

  All in all it sucks when I have an experience like this ESPECIALLY when a place is rated so high, the server was just oblivious to anything.  She handled like 5 complaints yet didn't think to have a manager come by, I'm also willing to bet we recieved colder food bc they close at 2 and we got what ever was left from the breakfast rush. I'm giving this more than 1 star bc after talking with the manager she did take off my B&G, I also recieved a gift card awhile later.  It was a bit too late as I did not appreciate her response to my complaints, how do people you pay to cook food professionally burn toast and then serve it??  I may give this another shot but I doubt it.

As a Boise local of 28 years, Yen Ching has been and always will be my go-to for Chinese; however, now that I reside in Meridian, I have been looking for something with that Yen Ching caliber but closer to my home. I. HAVE. FOUND IT. Red Pavilion is insanely delicious and cooked with quality ingredients. I picked up 4 entrees (2 chicken, 2 beef) along with some chow mein and fried rice to feed 6 adults and a few toddlers. Not only was this plenty of food for our group but every one of us agreed that this was the best Chinese in Meridian. I'll be back soon to actually dine in and will update my review then.

Came here with some coworkers one Friday night a few weeks ago after a long day. The first of our group arrived around 5 and the remainder trickled in by 630. There is a happy hour, but I unfortunately missed it as I got out of work too late to take advantage. The place was busy, but no so much so that we couldn't keep confiscating tables to make room for our growing party. Our server was Erin (I saved my receipt) and she did a fantastic job at managing folks that had been there a while as well as the new arrivals.

I ordered the chicken tacos and a glass of petite sirah. All in all a tasty and filling dish. I really wanted to take part of it home in a doggie bag, but I was afraid they would get too mushy to eat later. They definitely had a kick to them, too. Thank goodness for my wine. Reasonable prices for the portions and quality of food. I'd be curious to know what it's like on a game day, as it seems to have the right kind of atmosphere for that. I wouldn't necessarily go out of my way to come here, but for a night out with friends/colleagues, it did the trick.
Ordering delivery is terrible!! This is the third time I've gotten my food and it's been missing parts of the order!! I'm so done with this place!
This is the best pizza I've had in years. The last time was in New York City. Incredibly delicious, authentic NY style. The very best. Excellent service. Outdoor seating available. We shall return!

This location has horrible service. It seems like they are ALWAYS short staffed or something? We asked for fries to start with while we waited for our food and they never came. After waiting 30 minutes our burgers finally arrive and we requested our extra fries we already ordered and our campfire sauce. When the fries came our waitress brought us 1 sauce. 1. It took another 15 minutes to flag her down to get more! She seemed put off by us and was a little rude. This isn't a new experience for us at this location. I just thought maybe we hit them on a busy night? But to always seem short staffed and always have bad service? This was our last time visiting eagle road Red Robin.

Superb meal! Superb red sangria! Superb service! We'll be back. P.S. I'm gluten-free and very satiated with the Cesar salad and a wonderful shrimp/spinach dish. My hubby had the traditional Chicken Parmigiana - it was huge and we both have leftovers. Nice music and conducive atmosphere ;)

This was out first time ordering from here, which we did only because it was more convenient than our usual place, but that status is now in serious doubt. We only ordered take-out so can't comment much on service, but the sushi was excellent. The fish was very fresh and the rolls themselves were enormous. The prices were also very reasonable, especially for the quantity. We will definitely be back.
Fast, friendly, Professional Service. I was greeted quickly and with a smile. I got to relax in the lounge while they worked on my vehicle.

One of the best breakfasts EVER!!!  The Farm Boy is amazing, their bacon is fabulous!  Our server was super helpful and kind, A+ on service.  One of our favorite parts was the Moe Joe potatoes, my husband said they're the best potatoes he's ever had... and I have to agree.  We can't wait to come back!

They were also amazing about substituting on the kids meals so my children could have exactly what they wanted.  Can't say anything other than A+!!!

Worst meal I ever finished. Nothing particularly bad but nothing particularly good either. Food was edible, wait staff was average, restaurant was loud, background music was barely audible and the appointments were cliche. I eat out to enjoy the experience and there was simply nothing to enjoy.
It's alright food but not the greatest. Id say it's overrated but good, not the greatest and not the best proceed

I was going to get an oil change done on my truck this morning, but when I pulled in I was greeted by the sound of a manager and an employee arguing and cussing at eachother. I was going to leave when I heard this because the manager in question began using racist and sexist language  (i.e. the n word and the c word among others) and physically assaulted the employee. If that is what management thinks is an ok way to do business then they don't need my money. The way the manager spoke to that employee was enough to turn me off jiffy lube for life, but hitting an employee. Jiffy Lube, I hope you have a good lawyer because I'd file a lawsuit if it were me, and I encourage that employee to do just that.
Fantastic authentic Italian on the pricy side but appropriate for the type of cuisine served highly recommend for a romantic dinner that isn't a typical chain spot
Incredible seasonal pizza and finished with cheesecake!!  Food was even better than expected and the bar was already high because I have eaten here before. The service was great, thanks Kristina!

I had a craving for some frozen yogurt, which I didn't think existed in Meridian. I Yelped it and lo and behold *insert choir singing here* U-swirl came up. No way! So exciting!

I liked the watermelon sorbet and the original tart yogurt was also good. The other flavors were just okay. Their toppings are the standard toppings and should definitely added to your yogurt treat.

Yay for yogurt!

Wasn't too impressed. Went in this afternoon and got a caramel mocha, which was decent. I really liked the look of the place, but the ordering process was awkward and nobody seemed very friendly. I sat there the whole time drinking my mocha and kept swatting flies away, even though the garage type door was closed. I understand that having flies in a building is common, but this was a freakish amount. It wasn't a very relaxing or inviting place to sit and enjoy my drink. I kept over hearing very loud conversations between the employees and wish their was some music to distract from that.  Not really sure if I will be back.

My girlfriend and I go here frequently because of the awesome food and service! My favorite thing to get is all the Benedicts and the breakfast burrito! Really friendly waitresses that deserved to be tipped well!

I would like to give 3.5 stars for our first visit, but that's not an option. 
The good:
Great cornbread, crispy, juicy fried chicken. Potatoes with gravy were a little different but good.
Friendly staff.

Not so good:
Waffle was soggy and bland, chicken was too salty for my wife, when I don't have to add salt to something, it is probably a little too salty for most.
Greens were a little bitter according to my wife (she loves greens, I don't). They did say that their regular waffle maker was down, and they were using a backup. We did notice another customer that seemed to have the same issue with the waffle. 

We will try this place again, the good really did outweigh the bad. We checked out other items that other customers ordered, everything looked good.

Had the garden veggie hash with side of pancake..delicious but slightly heavy on the amazing fresh roasted garlic. Pancake was light and fluffy and good even without syrup! Hubby had the Basque chorizo pepper hash and he thoroughly enjoyed it. The seasoning on the potatoes was outstanding. A very flavorful meal! Might be my new favorite Boise breakfast...Have to try the chicken fried steak and jalapeno pancakes just to make sure.

Can't get better! 
$4 mimosas 
 killer corned beef hash 
 hollandaise FOR DAYS

Server Mary ran this place like it was her own - incredible knowledge and service! Sweet family place with a wait on Sundays but totally worth it.

I like Italian food.  And I admit there is another good Italian restaurant in Boise.  However I had the opportunity to have lunch at Geno's this week.  I have to tell you it was excellent.  Geno's varied menu even for lunch really brings home an excellent Italian restaurant option in the Treasure Valley.  
    Every Italian restaurant offers a minestrone soup, which I'm tired of.  Gino's regularly offered Lentil soup is a great option if the soup of the day doesn't temp you more.  All in all a fantastic choice.
This is a family staple for us. We've always had great service both in the restaurant and with delivery. The food is very good, and you get large portions for a very reasonable price.

This place is the best. We came here last May when looking for a house in Star. Came back in Oct after we finally sold out house in. California. The service and food sets the standard. Rick the manager is the man. You will never get a bad meal here.

This place serves up awesome burritos and tacos.  You can't go wrong with their breakfast burrito.  It's huge and an extremely reasonable price!  I can only eat half at a time.  Also the carne asada burrito is another excellent choice.  The meat is so tender and the guac. adds to its greatness.  If you want value for your buck and a satisfying meal, go to any of their locations!

Love this place! I've had dine-in and take out and have NOT been disappointed! My go to is the dinner for 2 and we love the dumpling soup! We are fried rice connoisseurs so we love their fried rice and their entrees are awesome! Being allergic to walnuts I found their Honey Almond Shrimp to be my go to and I LOVE IT! Highly recommend!!!

Very dirty restaurant.  The staff NEVER (I mean never) brings cutlery or napkins.  

I didn't want to sit in the bar and the boy sat us in the worst booth next to the front door.  I could tell he was mad when I said I didn't want to sit in the bar, but the service is lacking when we go in the afternoon to early evening.  We stopped frequenting this establishment months ago, I just now decided to finish my review.  I hope I don't get sued.

Unfortunately the amount of boats you have to eat to get a decent amount of sushi makes the deal not a cheap option. At most all you can eat sushi places it is about $18 at lunch and for dinner its about $25. That may seem pricey but if you think that when you order from a all you can eat you get a couple of rolls at a time which normally have about 8-10 pieces per roll. I know when we go eat we eat about 3-4 rolls and a couple of orders of nigiri ( we skip a couple of meals to fit it all). So that's about 30-40 pieces not counting the nigiri. Divide that by two ( you get two pieces at a time for a $1 at Shiges) and that's about $15-$20 already maybe adding about $5-$10 for the nigiri that is $20-$30 ( which they had no nigiri on the boats the entire time we were there).
       So now you can see the prices may look the same during dinner time at shiges vs. all you can eat  but during lunch its obviously not. Adding to that the quality is completely different...Shiges use a ton of rice and very little fish in their $1 sushi vs. IOU uses more fish and a normal amount of rice. IOU you can choose your rolls and nigiri where at Shiges you can ask for something there but it is not a full roll and no nigiri. So I guess it depends if you want a few pieces of sushi for $1 then this place would work and you can order rolls for regular price which are slightly pricey but we ordered one and the rice vs. fish ratio seemed better and tasted fine. Do not go to stuff yourself up with sushi you will spend more then you would at your typical all you can eat.
      Something I would like to mention though is they have the best customer service from any place that I have gone to including non-sushi places. Customer service is very important to me considering I go out to eat nowadays as a treat and don't like having to deal with bad customer service. So yes I will go back to eat maybe not for the $1 boats but for a quick roll or order from the Shige Teriyaki which they will deliver over if you rather have that ( which the food there is very good).

It looks nice on the inside, well done! Nice size patio too. I liked the popcorn service to start, that was enjoyable. We ordered the beer battered asparagus and won't again, it was so heavily battered you could literally feel the grease ooze out inside of your mouth and was evident on your fingers when picking it up. The batter was arguably thicker than the asparagus itself. My burger was good with the house sauce and so were the sticky finger wings and fries. Service was super friendly, just questionable about the order of service - no plates or silverware for the appetizer but when we asked for both we received plates only, then waited after entrees came out for silverware because we still hadn't received any. Don't get me wrong, I'm certain we'll be back - at some point.

This was the best mandarin style Chinese food that I have had in a long time. Passing through Boise on my way home and found this place on Yelp. What a great place. We had the dinner for 2 with egg drop soup, honey shrimp and crispy beef. The shrimp was great but we loved the crispy beef the best. The wonton chips were the kids favorite. Definitely a worth while stop in Boise.

When our party came in we were promptly seated, greeted by our waitress and given large cups of cold water. The restaraunt feels warm and the decor is cute. Although the service we received throughout the night was great! On the down side there seemed to be about 3 flies inside the restaraunt that kept landing on our table. We found that to be so annoying and disgusting. Upon receiving our food ~ ravioli, Alfredo, Pizza, lasagne, pasta Maria -it looked delicious  but tasted very bland. Our plates lacked salt and seasoning. Everyone in our party agreed! Very disappointing will not return.

I had the Traditional Eggs Benedict, and removed the ham but it was plentiful. I could have used more hollandaise but it tasted pretty lemony like the traditional but I was put off by the odd tasting oil they use on the grill/English muffin. 
The eggs were cooked right, and the potatoes were plentiful in large chunks deep fried, I believe. They were seasoned with an adequate amount of salt and pepper. You also may choose fruit which was melon, blueberries, pineapple and strawberries. They serve breakfast all day, at least on Saturday, they did. The staff was very friendly, food came quickly and the place was clean.

Our waitress RC gave us recommendations to get us started and was spot on! She knows Moe's Joe's well! 
We enjoyed eggs Benedict and a couple different hash dishes that were amazing! The entire staff was so friendly! We WILL be back! Thank you for a wonderful meal and experience at Moe Joe's!
Caribbean chicken and shrimp w Caesar salad I could eat every day! It is a party of flavored in your mouth! My daughter dreams of the chocolate  lava cake.

Love the place since they opened.  The food is legit! Little pricey for some dishes but still worth it! Owner is super nice. Glad to see they are always busy no matter what time of the day.  That's the restaurant you wanna go.  Their broccoli beef will be your safest call which will be out of your mind! If you want some real Chinese food, go check out their traditional menu and ask for some advice.  My husband's favorite is the spicy numb fish( boiling fish)   Will always come back.  And this is the place you wont wait too long for your food :)

I love this Costa Vida location! Their service is impeccable! All employees are super upbeat and kind. The food is amazing- I always go with a small chicken salad, and it's the perfect amount of food! There is such a good variety of choices, and the lunch specials are unbeatable! I highly recommend to anyone looking for a great experience all around!
Foods great but the customer service can suck at times

I've been to Moe Joe's at least half a dozen times in the last 4 months and usually have a great experience, but my last visit was a disaster. I took my in-laws here the day after Christmas, after bragging about how great it was. The wait can be long, but I've gotten used to that. Our wait on this day was relatively short, 15 minutes. Once seated, things went downhill quick.  We are a group of 5+ a high chair. And we're  given a table right next to the door. No problem, except the people waiting to be seated are pushing up against us just to have some space to wait. My husband was bumped by multiple people and purses. And my father in law was privy to everyone's juicy conversations. One patron who was waiting was there to tell her friends she was pregnant! How exciting. 
Our waitress was Mary. She seemed less than thrilled to be working the day after Christmas, and it showed. We placed our order and didn't see her again until our order came out- an hour later!!!! In the mean time I had to flag down another waitress just to refill our coffees! I finally see our waitress placing plates on tray and it looks like our order, but then I see her grab a bite of something while she's back there in the kitchen! Maybe some bacon? Possibly off one of our plates?! Completely unprofessional, and gross. So our food finally came out and 2 of the plates were cold, completely cold. 1 lukewarm, 1 perfect, and mine was so hot I couldn't even eat it. The one time she did refill our coffee, she spilt it all over the table. That was pretty much the final straw for me. To be so careless with a hot beverage around an 8 month old child is ridiculous. We never received any explanation for the wait, or even an apology. 
Finally the check shows up and Mary, our waitress wants to make small talk and stand around our table. Maybe hoping to redeem herself? Or to make sure she gets a tip?  It was sad, and made it seem like she only cared about the money. 
I think I will be taking my business elsewhere for a while. I only gave 2 stars because our previous visits were good. If you want good service here you have to show up at opening, on a weekday, otherwise forget it. I'll be headed to sunrise cafe in meridian next time.

I heard about Rumbi a couple of months ago and finally had a chance to make it in. As i walked in I was warmly welcomed by the ambitious staff.  The beautiful blue-eyed worker (Sallyann I believe) recommended an organic tofu bowl with bali flavor and a mix of rumbi rice and brown rice. I was astonished at this delicacy. The bali sauce had added a wonderful touch of peanut flavoring to my bowl. MMMM DELICIOUS! Not only was the food great, the staff was so accommodating. Sallyann brought me out some chips and salsa along with some of rumbi's hot teriyaki sauce. This added the perfect amount of flavor to my meal. I was quite happy with not only the food quality, but also the warm-hearted staff. Thank you so much Rumbi's for the great dinner. and thank you Sallyann for your great recommendations. I will most definitely be back with friends.

Loved our sever she was toooo sweet! , we also loved the fried mac , corn bread , and ice cold water she brought to us in a frozen bottle it was amazing ! I hate going places and getting warm gross water with my meals , so yeah it is worth mentioning lol ! I got the stuffed peppers , but want chicken and waffles next time lol !

This is the second time I've been to this place and honestly the experience has been no better than the first time this time the staff decided I didn't want my torta because I also ordered tacos the chicken is soggy will Carnitas is dry and tortillas are falling apart overall not a good experience I won't be coming back

Get the stuffed mushrooms!!!

Had chicken parm and the person I was with got futtachini Alfredo.  We had salsa as well.  It was excellent. 

Our mushroom appetizer was excellent. 

Staff seated us quickly, background music wasn't too loud, our waiter explained specials and menu options. 

Overall an excellent experience.

Super Friendly, accommodating, fast service, Low Prices. Staff explains pros cons of different tires including stock tires that came on my new car. They had my tires in stock ready to go. Other shops had to order my tires for next day service. The final price was about 20% less expensive than the next shop AND it was for a national branded tire not some gobbledygook named brand I've never heard of. I looked up reviews of said tire- and it was a winner!!  

I recommend this shop to all my friends.

First time here, nice atmosphere. Had veal piccata, real veal with angel hair pasta, side green salad was extra. Others had calzones, big!
Server was ok, not engaging. When asked to split alcohol separate from food he didn't and charged the one card. When asked about filling in the cannoli, he stated ricotta but forgot to say it was chocolate! 
I would give it another visit next time in town.

I have contaced this company/retailer a couple of different times and I either get no return phone call, the run-around and left on hold, or I fail to find anyone at this place who seems to know much about anything they sell when I take the time to visit their store.  They offer no services unless you buy a spa from them.  Not sure what this place is about and they sure don't know much about their own business or products.  Unknowledgeable staff, even at "management" level!  Other reputable places in town! Don't fall for the fancy building!  Doesn't mean they know their stuff!
Loved everything! Server, food, wine, owner, cute house, it was all an amazing experience. We will definitely be back!
We ate breakfast at Moe Joe's today. It was great. My husband created an omelet and I had the Basque Hash. Very yummy. Highly recommend you eat there.

Pretty disappointed in this location. My wife's order came out with guacamole after specifically asking for none, not a big deal on its own, but none of the food was really that good either. All sort of bland and seemed like the cook staff just didn't care and threw some stuff together. The waitress and front staff both offered good service though.
Fish tacos were very good! It's a healthier version of  Hawaiian food no spam in sight!
What a great lunch! I had the sweet pork salad, the special of the day, which made for a pleasant surprise! The help was friendly and very fast! I really enjoyed my experience there!!
Went in for Vietnamese, but was taken over by a local Thai restaurant. Food was terrible, salty, greasy, and slightly over priced. We ended up throwing it in the garbage.
Decided to give this place a try... it's pretty good for the most part... my big issue with this place is the staff... they were very loud behind the bar.  ( daycare environment )

We went for Trivia night with our friends and it was a great time. Our server was great, she worked very hard and we all appreciate her! I would give more stars for these two items if I could but the food was horrible! The chicken was like jerky, so dry with no flavor and it was supposed to be habanero honey dry rub. Not an ounce of heat. The asparagus fry appetizer was so greasy we didn't eat many and they were served with cold queso, very odd! Will go again for Trivia but not the food.
We came 20 minutes before closing and I thought they might turn us away, but instead they were warm and welcoming. We enjoyed a delicious dinner and appreciated there late night hospitality.

My boyfriend and I got delivery, It was all that I wanted it to be. Though it took an extra 30 min to come after the restaurant closed, we were looking at other delivery options when out of nowhere we get a knock on the door and it was them. Very delicious food, just know that if you want any sour cream, guacamole, fixings....it's extra and has to be requested.

We were very disappointed in the service and the food. We paid $50 for 2 take out dishes. The portions were so small. I got 8 raviolis. The food was cold. The calamari was way too chewy, the lobster ravioli is served with a red sauce. Typically lobster ravioli is with a cream sauce. We got 7 raviolis. Again, the food was cold. Overall we will not go back. The food is way too expensive for the quality and portion s

I started going to this Fred Meyer, honestly, because of proximity to my house. We've since moved and I still make it a point to go here. It is as good as it gets for a grocery/department store. 

The helpful, approachable staff is absolutely great. They make it a point to ensure you find what you need. Other reviews cite a certain arrogance about them that, in the time since they have opened, I have never even remotely experienced. 

The prices on their food and other items they carry is on par with, if not below, what I would expect from a non-Walmart/Winco type store. 

Like many grocery stores, the freshness comes with what they are able to get, but what I have noticed is that they will not necessarily sacrifice their commitment to the place they live for availability. They are reasonable and quality.

If you are looking for fresh, delicious, homemade, filling food and good service, go to Moe Joes. I only write reviews for excellent food. I loved the house made hash. Full of flavor. (Took Home almost half and enjoyed it the next day.) We were visiting friends, wavered between two restaurant choices and picked Moe Joes based on Yelp. When you go, you have to look for the restaurant on the side of the building in the business park.  You will see plenty of cars!  Thank you, Moe Joes!  Ps. Try the Marion berry jam.

I made my way to Taco Johns during the Grand Opening. It was nice to see that I'm not the only one who loves the place. The street tacos were awesome and the Potato Oles are always amazing. Staff was super friendly!!

This is my favorite restaurant for bacon eggs Benedict! Everything about it was great. The taste the smell. However I did not enjoy the potatoes. They were sour. I am not sure what they seasoned them with. Next time I will skip those. If you want to impress someone bring them here!!

My husband and I decided to grab some dessert here and have a little date night. The restaurant was clean and inviting and it smelled amazing! We looked over the menu and prices weren't too bad. Ordered our dessert, and were actually a little surprised at how long it took to get it considering it didn't need to be cooked. My husband ordered the dessert trio, and I had the New York cheesecake. They were all just okay.  We both wished that the cheesecake crust would have been a little more crisp because they were basically soggy and room temperature like they were sitting out for days. The tiramisu tasted great, but again very soggy. We wished they would have also been served chilled vs room temperature. We both were a little disappointed in the dessert, but the pizza coming out looked and smelled amazing which is why I am still giving a four star review. We will definitely be back to try the pizza and will update review when we do.

Quality food,great service, pool table and shuffleboard (although would prefer it to be in the back corner vs at the front entrance when we are trying to shoot... What more can you ask for! Even the house salad was delicious/ the bell peppers and feta were an added bonus! Fresh guacamole and salsa on the huge (1/2 order) nachos ($2 off Monday's)!  oh and the house wine was affordable! Like the food specials- can't wait to try wing Tuesday and Rib Wednesday next!

Recently moved to the area & this has become our favorite breakfast place. We drive past several options to eat here. The food is delicious - big fan of the skinny egg meal & the pancakes. If you want to splurge, the cinnamon roll is worth your while! The best part about this place is the coffee. If there is a wait to be seated, you can enjoy coffee while you wait. Genius.

Love This place. It has a warm comfy feel, especially the bar/dining area. For a chain the recipes are in my option quality and tasty. They have daily and lunch specials. The servers are friendly and well trained.

Good soul food - not sure I could say great soul food.  I had the chicken and waffles and they were good.  But it just seemed like everything could be a little thicker. 

I associate soul food with oversized portions. Big, thick waffles.  Big chicken breasts.  But they don't sell those here. It's sort of petite portions. I left satisfied - but not full, which I'm not accustomed to for soul food. 

Just make your waffles more stout and use bigger chicken  - i would even pay more.

This review focuses on the sushi at Shige Express. Two words: fast food.  Much of the sushi rolls here follow the notion that more is better. It seems that there are 2 kinds of sushi fans: those who prefer simplicity and those who prefer complexity. The boat offerings ($1 per plate) lacked variety and appeal. The majority of sushi contained shrimp or cooked fish and a mayonnaise-based sauce. My date and I found ourselves mid-visit without anything to eat. 
PROS:
--Sushi chefs were relatively friendly
--Ample seating

CONS:
--Too few servers on duty. I ordered Miso Soup and never received it, probably because the one server was overwhelmed.
--Disappointing sushi rolls. The rice was not short-grain and wasn't true sushi rice (also not slightly sweet which is key). If you like your sushi to pack a punch and leave you with a gut bomb, you'll probably like the decadent offerings here. I ordered a roll for $10.95 which was described as having multiple types of fish, avocado, and roe. Nowhere in the description did it state that the entire thing was deep fried. It arrived looking like a funky burrito. The two sauces drizzled atop over-complicated its flavor profile. That raw fish I was looking forward to? The deep fryer cooked it. Also, the avocado made only a brief appearance--I could hardly detect it.  An overabundance of rice (probably to cut costs) made the price unreasonable. 
--Sushi boat offerings lacked appeal and variety. 


My search continues for authentic sushi in the Treasure Valley.
Oh my. ... the cornbread is the bomb!  Seriously worth coming for.  The seafood Gumbo great too! Love this place.  And the pork sandwich.

Nice atmosphere and slow service.   Menu is very bland and food is a bit pricey for what you (don't) get.  Spent 15 minutes looking over the menu to find anything we wanted to eat. They are really hung up on putting their sauce on everything.   Wings are scrawny -- Very scrawny.  Went to Goodwood the next night and had wings with  meat (and the best BBQ sauce).

Waitresses was a dingbat.  Didn't know menu.   When we would ask about something on menu she would disappear for 5+ minutes to get answers.   Lots of hype and lots of disappointment.

This place is OMG good!   Ordered several items and all were out of this world!'
I found this place on yelp and the food is some of the best in town.   They live up to the reputation of four and-a-half stars.  The location is tucked away and if they could get more signage on the street they would be so busy you could never get in.  It was dead when we ate there and I normally have the rule that if it is not busy don't eat there.  This is an exception to that rule.  They have been in business for several years so they must be doing OK.  I just tried it and will be back very soon with some more friends and family.

I am sad to report Gino's with so few stars. I am finding that you either have an amazing experience with the food, or you have a less than expected experience, mine was the latter.

We came here for a large group b-day dinner. Gino's was wonderful with setting up the night and walking the b-day boy back to the table to surprise him. They played along and that is what helps makes a place great. 

I ordered the Chicken Maria which lacked flavor. It was very clean tasting and the more I think about it, I am pretty sure this is a healthier choice at Gino's. I ended up pouring the dipping sauce all over and it made it a pretty amazing dish. Don't be scared, try it!

My boyfriend ordered the Pesto Gnocchi with a grilled chicken breast and it just tasted like rubber chicken and pesto. Something I could probably make at home with ease. So I am thinking we both ordered the wrong thing for our taste buds and I hope to try something different next time.

The other end of the table loved their food but we all ordered differently so I think the love you feel for Gino's and the food depends on what you order.

Service was shotty but good. Our server interrupted her time taking our order twice so she could run food. I understand she was busy, it just seemed weird. Almost every time she was at our table she only asked half the people if they wanted refills. So she frequented our table about 3 times every 5 minutes.  It was hard to enjoy the people around me. 

I want to come back and test drive some other food!  After reading the reviews I thought I would be blown away but I left feeling a little disappointed. I have hope and I will be back!

First, let's start with the dirty plates and utensils. Yes, had to have our waitress replace everything. As for the meal, I ordered lasagna. I am not sure it was lasagna. It came in a small dish covered in cheese all over. I could not taste the meat or pasta. Gino did come over and ask how my meal was and I told him. He gave me a look like I had no idea what lasagna is. This place has gone down hill and Gino needs to get back to what good Italian food is. Two stars because the salad and beer was good.

Thanks to Yelp we found this amazing treasure! Can't begin to express how amazing and delicious this food was! Amazing breakfast! Try the jalapeño huckleberry mimosa!!! The Garden Bow is so filling, tasty, and incredible! Go try this place!!!

Had a very nice meal here.  They have certainly fixed any service issues they had as we were quickly seated.  Food also came out quick. We had bulgogi and a spicy seafood noodle dish and both were good.  The spicy noodle had really good flavor.  The server did not know what banchan was but he compensated by being really attentive.  They did bring a couple of small kimchi plates, but would have loved to have had more and more variety.  But overall, I think these guys have really improved since they opened.

I eat at JB'S  once or twice a week. I'm a fan of their breakfast buffet. JB'S is a 20 mile round trip from my home but its worth the trek .. I can eat what I want and get my fresh fruit . The staff  always has
 a smile on their face and always willing to give you the best service..Thanks JB'S.
Visited from out of town and made a fan out of me. Friendliest staff and great fountain drinks?????  Tasty food too.

First time visitor, eggs Benedict devotee, so I tried the BTA (bacon tomato avocado) Benedict. Best non traditional eggs Benny I've ever had!!! Worth 5 stars by itself but service, atmosphere and price also excellent. Will be back to try the rest of the Benny options...

My boyfriend and I love this place. The first time we went, I had the fish tacos, and that's the only thing we've ordered since. They are sooooo good. It's cozy, but spacious. If you don't know what to try, get the fish tacos, eat them over the coconut rice so that the juice drips into it, then eat the rice. Delicious. This is our 'fish taco place,' and we will be buying many many more.

Service was a bit slow tonight. Wait time was pretty good. Server was nice, but a little slow to refill drinks. Italian nachos are Always good as is the bread and olive oil with roasted garlic.  We had the new spice rubbed steak with smashed potatoes. I was underwhelmed. Skilletini would have been my mainstay choice. Good value though.
Great Midwest chain now in Boise. The bread and fast service are amazing. I absolutely love Jimmy Johns.

The menu looks amazing. Excellent wait staff, very clean with cute decor. The first time we ate there we ordered two of the hash dishes. My daughters veggies hash listed many wonderful ingredients including garlic, which we love. However, we didn't expect to find about 20 whole garlic cloves mixed in. This overpowered the dish making it almost inedible. She ordered sunny side up eggs and got over medium. 
We decided to give Moe Joe's Breakfast Eatery another chance a few days later. Today we ordered the BTA Benedict and the Lemon Poppy Seed pancakes. I give the pancakes a 5; super fluffy with crispy edges and a delicious tangy lemon glaze. Unfortunately the poached eggs were over cooked (not even a little runny yolk) and they apparently think hollandaise is supposed to consist mostly of mayonnaise . It was thick and tasted a lot like mayo. We had to scrape it off. The breakfast potatoes were excellent; crispy and nicely seasoned. 
So, great menu poorly executed. Sorry Moe Joe's; we gave you two chances!

My wife and I love Red Pavilion. It is all made in house so it tastes a little differently than all other Chinese restaurants, but it is amazing! They have the best quality food! And their prices are extremely reasonable.

Food was absolutely delicious and the portions are HUGE, and this is coming from a Texas girl! 

I felt like we waited a long time for our food, granted it was worth it. Also the ambiance leaves a little to be desired, but overall a very good experience.

A returning customer here. I love their burgers, and the fries, and the beer they have on tap. I am more of a bar top kind of person, and the service has always been great and quick. I wish They would bring back the Buzz Buzz burger!! Delicious.

This place was a first & to start off, the service was AMAZING! Tasha was our waitress & got us some yummy coffee while we looked at the menu. The fruit was very fresh and my Irish Benedict was delicious. My favorite was the biscuits & gravy; they were so soft & flavorful! Overall it was a great atmosphere & service which means we will definitely be back!

You will get ignored here. A 3 star for me, is a 0 to some. 

Food is decent. If you stand in line after ordering over the phone, have a voice, otherwise you'll wait all day. They disregard people who are quiet in line, standing next to the hostess table. They assume you're waiting for a phone call or something. As if awkwardly standing there is normal. 

If you order from a table, you'll have to yell at the staff. Unless you get every single little thing you need right out of the gate, bring your voice, because you'll be yelling.

Went in the other day for lunch. The mushroom soup tasted like dirty water with no mushrooms in it. The Ragu looked like dog food with dry and chewy chuck roast. The server was very pushy and we can hear her talking about us in the kitchen. There were 3 tables but it took over 30 minutes to get our food. Way overpriced and way overrated. We will never be going here again.

Stopped in one evening for a Salted Caramel shake.  Use the drive thru.  Staff were friendly and quick to whip up my frozen delight.  Drive thru area was well lit and clean, employees I saw were also neatly groomed and seemed happy to be there.
I just moved to Boise and this is by far the best food I have ever eaten it will be hard not to come every day.

I am a breakfast lover. This place has a decent concept with fairly unique/interesting menu. I had biscuits and gravy with spuds and bacon (some of my favorite b/f items), they skimped on the gravy, and the bacon was lower quality than I expect. I thought the food was OK, but I think a little over priced (3.5 star). I thought the atmosphere was weak (3 star). Service was weak, super slow and people who arrived after us were served before us then we got the wrong bill (2.5 star).  I won't go back, you can eat at Goldy's and get a better experience for an equal price.

My husband received such a gross burger there... looked like a hockey puck. Had them re do it and it still felt and looked like a hockey puck.

Service can be good.
Food can be good.
Great service. Had my sons and husband hair cut by Lovelee. She did a great job. Got both of them in quickly with a walk in. Great prices too.
We went to Wingers & never got waited on. It was 3:30 on a Monday and there were maybe 10 other people in the entire restaurant. No one even acknowledged us. Horrible!!!! Never going back.

I love pizza and I think this is the best pizza in the valley.  The wait was responsible for a Saturday evening but we choose to sit at the bar anyway.  The bartenders Alex and Brad helped us through the menu and did I mention it is the best pizza in the Valley? Loved the place!

We waited for approximately 40 min for us to get seated (2 adults 2 kids), after 30 min of us waiting, I asked the guy in front, how much longer, he assured us that we are next, and should be another 10 min....after that 10 min has passed, we noticed the the 2 big groups that came after us were already seated. When my wife confronted the server he lied and said he was "buzzing us", we never recieved their "buzz" eventhough we were sitting in the lobby. Not coming back here again, I guess their locals and regulars come first. I'm so frustrated by this experience. Our kids were super hungry and cranky that didn't help the situation.

On a side note, the food was great and the wait staff was nice and attentive.
I had a great meal and the price was right.  Not very many people there when I went so I was worried.  No problem, the food was great and the people were awesome!
Excellent restaurant and I love the atmosphere. Best Italian food I have had in the treasure valley.
I've eaten here a bunch of times.  Food is fast, staff is friendly and it is yummy.  Pricing is good and I can't think of anything to gripe about, so that probably makes me a crappy yelper.  Oh well.

I tried it again because I need another BBQ restaurant.  The food was worse this time.  I had a lunch 2 meat platter with ribs and brisket.  I got two scrawny end ribs which were way overcooked with little meat on them.  The 3 small pieces of brisket were tender, but the texture was like bologna.  I've never seen anything like it.  Both ribs and brisket tasted like charcoal cooked meat with liquid smoke rubbed on the outside.  There was no smoke ring, and there was no smell of wood smoke inside the building or outside.   The potato salad was very good.  The corn on the cob was waterlogged.   Skip this place if you have taste buds..

We have this place the benefit of the doubt and gave it a 2nd try... and I'm SUPER glad we did!

Our first visit was a train wreck (we sat at our table for 15mins before even being welcomed, given menus, or water... service was awful and negligent overall) but the food was memorable enough that we felt compelled to see if time had worked any of the kinks out. And sure enough -- it did!! 

We had the veggie hash and a build-your-own omelette with potatoes and toast. Both had rich flavor and were filled with yummy vegetables (squash and artichoke are not commonly offered at breakfast joints)! And when they say, "roasted garlic," they mean it! While cloves! Woo. We didn't need to add salt or pepper which was nice. The potatoes were PERFECTLY crisp, and the wheat toast was hearty and dense with nuts and seeds which I love. (I also spotted others getting what appeared to be a cinnamon swirl toast and I had a little bit of order envy!)

Coffee was good (enough). 
Service was a huge improvement!
Food was actually pretty wonderful, diverse, and unique. 

Great new addition to Boise breakfast!

My wife and I went there for date night dinner and had a great time.  We had such a great time and enjoyed the food so much we decided to bring kids the next night so they could enjoy it too.  We waited 30 minutes to be seated.  It was a Saturday night so no big deal.  But after we were seated we waited another 25 minutes without anyone coming to help us.  We finally left.  Would've liked to rate them higher but the Saturday night experience was pretty bad.

We came here on a recommendation. We were a little hesitant because we have two picky eater kids and usually try to stick to what we know they like. 
We are so glad we found this place. My husband had the Chorizo hash and it was so delicious. Cooked perfectly with lots of flavor. I had the lemon poppyseed pancakes and put Marion berry jam on it as suggested by our waitress. So decadent. I was very pleased. 
What we were most excited about was how much our kids liked their meals. Our 2 year old son is a picky one who usually only sticks to meat and eggs for breakfast. He is not one who likes any sort of potatoes normally. We got him the kids eggs,bacon, and potato thinking he would just ignore the potatoes. We were wrong. He loved the potatoes. Our daughter got the kids pancake and gobbled it up. 
All in all it is a place we will for sure come back to.

We love JBs. It's basic truck~stop fare, but the buffet is plentiful (if not heart~healthy), and the help is attentive and nice. Two secrets, the banana split fills a dinner plate, it's not on the menu, so the server loves to get creative with it, and it's $4.00...if you're old like most if us and you sign the receipt, you get 10%. Tip well my friends.

The owner at Chapman screamed at me that it is not his responsibility to inspect or even look at my property. As an out of state owner I relied on them which was a very bad decision. My properties were not maintained and my tenants felt bullied by Chapman. I believe I lost thousands due to their poor management.
This is being extremely generous and not mentioning what I would really like to say about this owner!!!!!!
Horrible excuse for Chinese food. Literally the worst I've ever eaten- frozen or otherwise.  Not sure about the high star reviews. It made me want to cry.

Stayed here again and booked a PULL-THRU hoping to avoid the tight & short spaces.  We have to pull out first thing in the morning.  Well....the pull through is by far the longest I have ever stayed in (+), but it is also very narrow.  I couldn't swing he 40' 5th wheel to make a straight shot because of the "extra" parking offered to the permanent dwellers impeded part of the road space to do so.  Thus, I had to pull in at an angle and then after parking, kids out, jacks down, discovered the slides were NOT going to miss the power box which is in the pull thru itself instead of off to the side.  I had to maneuver three times to get enough space and ended up with my tires on the site sidewalk to allow enough space.

Awesome length on site, but dropped a star for narrowness.

It's a good thing Los Betos is open 24/7 because you never know when you'll wanna get into it with the cashier.
