It was 4:02 AM - I was feeling political and I had a lot on my mind so I headed in to grab one of their famous wet burritos. I have to admit, having dealt with some myself in the past - I wasn't entirely confident in trying them again. But I wasn't disappointed! As soon as the mushy salsa and warm beans exploded in my mouth and headed north (up my nose) I was in heaven. As I ate sloppily over the counter I tried to illicit a reaction from the cashier or eavesdropping kitchen staff. "How about those immigrants?" I said, food spilling from my mouth. With no response I clarified "All of em. Any type. Any point in history. I'll never understand it!" Still nothing.... I gave up and took my seat across the room. I began to think: maybe they have just as much right to this country as I, an ocean citizen (I was born in the ocean). The burrito was great but the side of rice and beans proved problematic. The beans were really greasy and I got all my foundation in my food (I put it on my left hand because I'm self conscious). All things considered. I'll definitely be back. And though I found a hair in my burrito, I also found an appreciation for a rich and vibrant culture!

Worth the wait -- but it's sad that we had a 45 min wait for our food after ordering.  Sausage gravy was AMAZING, not fancy but just done right. Perfect blend of spicy, salty, creamy, savory....  All our food was good.  Just a shameful wait, with no apologies or explanations.

This is our favorite local sushi spot. They have many traditional and creative sushi rolls that are well priced. Also, I eat gluten free, which they accommodate thanks to gluten free soy sauce and wasabi. Many rolls contain snow crab instead of imitation crab filler and I have asked for many rolls to eliminate tempura or swap out imitation crab and they have always been so kind and accommodating. And they are open on Sundays! No "All You Can Eat" option

We've been coming to Rumbi since they opened. We love their Luau Pork Rice Bowl w/ spicy teriyaki sauce + stir-fried veggie and their Kahuna Burger w/sweet potato fries, they're so good!  Although we noticed that the quality of the food is not as good as the previous times we've stopped there. Keep up the good work Rumbi!!
Great food and wonderful staff! I highly recommend the burrito and the frozen yogurt! Both tasted amazing! Plus they have free infused water.

The garden hash was delicious! I made it vegan by taking off the eggs. Perfect combo of veggies and very filling! The coffee infused syrup is super good too. Jennifer was a very attentive waitress. I will have to go again when I'm in Boise! 
Everyone else in my party loved their meal too. Even the gluten free stuff was delicious.

We were invited to the friends and family night we were treated like royalty.  Great atmosphere,  fantastic service,  the music was spot on oh and the food.... The best New York style pizza ever. Infact I would bet because of the deep New York history everyone else is trying to copy them. The coal brick oven is impressive which makes the pizza crust perfect.  The house salad was amazing and so was the cheese cake. The crowd noise was annoying but that is what you get with a full house. I have got to say well done, I will return ready to try something new.

I was in Boise this week and stopped here to try it.  Holy cow was it amazing.  I came back two days in a row.  The meals are hand made, huge and so good!! Don't miss this gem.  If I had it in my home town I would be a daily visitor.

Excellent food. Great tasting coffee. Huge portions. Worth driving across the Treasure Valley to get here. Perhaps they ought to consider adding staff on the weekends. 
A bit difficult to find as it is on the end of a strip mall.

The food here is good but the service is HORRIBLE.  Sat in the Bar area on a Wednesday night.  DOn't know our server's name receipt just says Bar Pm B.  First my husband ordered a beer and the waitress checked his ID...well honey you looked at it you might have noticed too it was his birthday today.  Major fail up front.  Then it took over 10 minutes to get a beer.  The food was good but he was asked if he wanted another drink when his food came and he did...well finally she remembered AFTER he was done eating.  She was MIA for over 10 minutes at one point and she was the only server around.  Finally when we were done eating and had been done for about 10 minutes we finally went up to the bar and paid and left.  She got a big fat 0 for a tip and I really hopes she learned from it.  The tables around us were very upset too.  One table asked for Ranch dressing before their food even came and she did not get it for over 20 minutes.  What a scatter brain she was!

The staff was nice but thats about the only good thing i have to say about this place. I use there B.B.Q. sauce at home and its good but there meats are way over cooked the baby back ribs where burnt and nasty food. The food was over priced. I wont be back or reccommend this place to anyone.

This place is awesome! The waitress had a great recommendations and I took a chance trying it. I can't remember what it was exactly but it had sausage and the potatoes mmmm it was so good. I was so glad that I took her advice! Always a great place to eat!
Best Chinese food I've had in the treasure valley by far! Prices are more than fair and ample portions.  Will not disappoint

I got lunch today from Rumbi, and I was beyond unimpressed with my chicken sandwich and a "mix" of sweet potato fries and regular fries. First, the sandwich was comparable in looks to a sloppy burger slapped together by a teenaged employee at Wendy's. The chicken was thick on one end, thin on the other end, making the sandwich hard to hold and eat. The two anorexic (irony?) slices of bacon that were glued to the bun were obviously of the futuristic micorwavable-in-30-seconds type that lacked flavor, texture or substance. The bbq sauce that came as a side was thicker than glue, and tasted more like corn syrup than anything else. As stated on the menu, the fries are a mix of sweet and regular. When I think of "mix", I picture a somewhat equal proportion of each item mixed together. Not the case. I dumped out the greasy bag of fries to find 3 overcooked sweet potato fries mixed in with a handful of thin, overcooked regular fries. The regular fries were overcooked to the point of resembling the texture and crisp of a potato chip, and a bad one at that. 

The meal was disappointing, and the price paid for this regrettable meal is irriatating. Save your money and order off the dollar menu at McDonald's, where at least you get what you pay for.

Took my family on a Friday night. Pizza was delicious! Unfortunately it took over a half hour to prepare. Worth the wait, but if i knew It would that that long, I would have gotten a salad or not come so hungry.

We ended up here the other night with three other colleagues. Two had been here before, and two of us (including me) had not. I didn't really know what to expect, but the two who had been to this place before described it as a Polynesian soul food kind of a place. Whatever that means! All of us eat out frequently for work, and therefore we know a thing (or two) about good food  or at least, we think we do.

One of the dangers of traveling (and eating out) a lot is you run out of ideas on where we should go to eat. For my friends and I, anything different is good, and different, delicious and friendly is like hitting the trifecta.

We didn't exactly order our meal but instead instructed the waitress to bring us whatever she thought we would like. Complete chefs choice. Like keep bringing the food and we'll tell you when to stop. Many dishes later, I had somewhat forgotten everything we tried, but for sure it was all somewhat unique and all delicious. Most of it was in the style I would call comfort foods (like smothered pork chops and black tea pork with sesame seeds and rice). Other dishes were on the fancier side. But mostly I had the impression of honest, delicious, memorable home cookin'.

I can tell when I'm in a place where the owner cares about their food and this place had that vibe.

All of us had a great time, eating, drinking, and laughing. We ended up closing the place down. Never did we feel Ike we were being rushed out the door.

Great food, friendly people, unique choices. It was such a pleasurable experience that I'm sure i'll be back!

Not a fan... The menu and ordering system is strange, and the topping selection is lasting. If they don't provide any signature pizzas they should have a plethora of toppings to choose from. And forget about if you want some ranch with your pizza... The salads were a redeeming quality as is the location. As for myself and my friends, we will not be back.
Had a pleasant experience at Discount Tire.  Super customer service from Rae. Thank you for taking good care of me and my car.
this place lives up to the name; Grim. the pizza was border line disgusting. Guidos is half the price and five times as good. Flatbread is even better. wouldn't ever recommend this to anyone.

We purchased The Don - Very good pizza but everything is a la carte. Our server was great but the wait for food was almost to the lengthy side of time. It had a good strong hint of New York pizza. It lacked the New York dough, it needed that NYC water! Wish they had a smaller options on salads. Overall really good experience
SUPERB breakfast!! WOW! We had a party of 10 so I got to sample everything which makes me the expert now.  I will definitely be back!
I love Costa. The sweet pork is to die for and their tortillas are superior to Cafe Rio. Their food is addictive. If you haven't been  , you are missing out.

Four stars for the delicious pizza. Really, really tasty. We got a pepperoni and an Idaho Supreme. The best we have had since moving here! Our kids loved the pizza twists! Yum. (Plus, for people who like to dip crust in ranch, like us...the ranch dressing was perfect.)
Zero stars for the loud, sarcastic and very unkind conversation between the manager and an employee about another employee. It was easily audible throughout our meal and intrusive to the enjoyment of our family dinner out. A manager ought to have a little more self awareness/ awareness of customers/professionalism. 

But the pizza was great. Maybe takeout?

We had our yellow lab neutered at 6 months old. I'm always a little apprehensive about using a new veterinarian, so I had to take a moment to praise Dr Bingham and his staff. The experience was great, people cared about the animals and my dog came out of surgery and healed very well! Thank you all for your commitment to our Lab.....

My friend and I went in for pedicures. All and all my pedicure was good and my tech was nice. But definitely not worth $50. No question about it. Additionally, the girl giving my friend's pedicure was insanely rude. Not in a way where she just wasn't friendly, she was straight up making comments about her body. It was the most awkward experience. Won't be returning.
The food is consistently yummy. Even when the line is long the staff is always hustling to get everyone their meals quickly and politely. Very family friendly. No complaints from us!

I came in for a hair appointment.  Sarah was really great, thank you for recommending her.  I had to cut 8 inches of my hair off 6 months ago due to damage and I was really nervous to try someone new.  Sarah was SO GENTLE...and I'm super tender headed.  My color came out fabulous and she helped me make a plan that will get me where I want to be (healthy strong long hair).  I am very happy.  :-)

Really nice place with lots of seating and great selection of beer. The staff is nice and friendly, very professional with good knowledge of their products. I like the fact that we ordered garlic fries and onion rings which came to us in 5 minutes of our order. Our wings also came pretty fast which really surprised me. My wings were good and they were bigger than the wings you would get at Buffalo Wild Wings. I got the rebel naked and honey habanero rub naked wings. The rebels were good but not spicy at all nor was the honey habanero wings. If you are looking for spicy wings, this isn't the place for them but the do have good flavors. The onion rings are awesome here, nice crunchy with the onions melting in your mouth. The garlic fries are a little strong in smell but my wife loved them. If you are near by you should give them a try!
Amazing atmosphere, delicious food and very welcoming staff.  Doug is an incredible host - will definitely be back again soon!

The waitress was nice, but there must have been a meltdown in the kitchen. It took forever to get our food. The waitress apologized for it taking so long, but then when she brought it, it was awful. The ribs were burnt to a crisp, I mean black coals. Obviously the kitchen tried to cover it up with sauce, but it was bad. The fries were undercooked and the macaroni and cheese was runny. How do you mess up macaroni and cheese?! Oh well. Won't be visiting this place anymore. There are too many other good barbecue places in this area to want to even give this place another try.
I have lived in Boise for 8 years and I haven't found a Chinese restaurant that has really good food. This is two thumbs up for sure!

Delicious! We used a coupon, two for one, and ate hardy. We will finish our tasty leftovers tonight. The prices are excellent especially with a two for one coupon. The lady who took our order had a sweet smile and servant attitude. She helped us and another couple regarding questions.

I say, great food, budget prices, and pleasant service. Also nice and quiet--perfect for conversing.

I tried Johnny Carinos new Tri Tip French Dip today. It was wicked good ! It meat was tender, good flavors, not chewy on a soft sourdough roll with caramelized onions.  The Au Jus was perfect in my opinion. I dipped my samdwhich and my fries in it. Speaking of fries. Fresh. Hot. Crispy and a large portion of fries come with the sandwhich and salad.  My server Josh S was quick. Helpful. Polite. And the manager Mike W. came out to see how I liked their new sandwhich they added on the menu ! Great food. Great hospitality.

Fabulous, pizza was amazing, thin crust, tasty and quick. Service was fabulous !!! Nicole rocked and was right on top of things.  Knowledgable of wines and offered tastes. We loved it, got to chat with manager! Totally recommending!!' Everyone, try it!!!

I'm very impressed with the food and staff! Today is the first time I stopped by for take-out. I ordered BBQ Pork, Potstickers, Chow Rice with Pork, Lemon Chicken, Honey Almond Chicken, and Lo Mein with Chicken. I also had a cup of Won Ton soup while I waited and it was the best I've had!! I loved everything I ordered especially the Honey Almond Chicken! I've never had it before and it was soooo delicious! No breading just a nice flavorable Honey sauce with slivered Almonds. The gal that waited on me was very helpful and patient. The place is very clean! Even the menus were clean....not sticky! I will be ordering again!! I hope they join up Boise Food Delivery and Uber Eats.....I live between Kuna and Nampa, so it would make it more convenient to order from them. 
If you haven't tried them yet, do it! You won't regret it.........
Warm and inviting atmosphere.  I'm back to conquer the Smothered Breakfast Burrito.  On my last visit, food won, but will today be different?  Stay tuned for pics of the massacre.

Wow! There was a wait, but it was totally worth it. Where do I start?
The service was great and everyone was really friendly.
The menu has some interesting choices, and the random one that we picked (the Irish) was so good!
You can substitute pancakes or French toast for toast in a meal for $0.99, effectively giving you two meals.
The coffee tastes REALLY good.
The bathrooms were super clean and incredibly funny.

We would stop back in a heartbeat!
The service was really slow and they were out of Bloody Mary mix.. bummer

Rudy's has a great relaxed vibe that I truly enjoy! The staff is very professional yet relaxed enough to where you can let your guard down and be who you are!  I highly recommend Rudy's to anyone looking for a great meal and good drinks!!

I used to love this place but the last three times I have gone there my coffee was burnt, and full of coffee grounds. How do you mess up an Americano? And they seemed VERY confused when I asked for a dirty chai tea latte. It was by far the worst chai tea I've ever had. Pretty sad cuz we used to come here several times a week

I love coming to this place for their Fuji Mountain rolls. My favorite!!  My husband likes to see all the neat plates that other tables get to try next time. They have a lot of neat options for sushi lovers!

The food at Costa Vida is decent. Not a fan of the rice or beans but the tacos and enchiladas are delicious. The sweet pork is a tasty choice. I was extremely impressed with how careful they were with my gluten allergy.   The building, however, was extremely hot. Plan to take your food to go. It was incredibly uncomfortable even to wait in line. And the ice machine is always down. Not a fan of getting ice out of a bowl that strangers hands have been going in to. Gross. Food handlers card 101 says no, no, no!

First off just have to say I love Dutch! Normally the coffee is great and the employees are kind. They are willing to make everyone feel like they are important even if it's just a minute or two a day. For the past few weeks every time I have been to this location I am disappointed. I don't mean to be that person that posts a review on yelp but something needs to change. My coffee never tastes like it supposed to.  Some of the employees at this location, mainly the night time staff, don't listen when I order and are often rude.  I'm  shocked at the level of poor service.

Best Consignment Store EVER!! In town from San Diego and found them on yelp. My mom, sister, granny, and I had an awesome time for a few hrs, then came back to be sure we didn't miss anything. The store was so organized and easy to browse through. There were many Large dressing rooms and mirrors. The decor of the store was beautiful. And I came home with a new wardrobe. It was perfect. I'm hunting for something similar now that I'm home but may not get so lucky. I will be back every time I travel to see my family in Boise that  i can count on. :)
Great breakfast spot. Super clean and the staff is so welcoming. Had a really good breakfast and the kids were happy too!!!

Look out for Wednesday nights.  What a great time and fun energy.  Friends treated me to a birthday night out and we had a blast.  Great band that played for hours and kept the place dancing.  I ordered a very good bottle of Cabernet and had the Duck Linguine which was perfectly flavored and very satisfying.  My wife had the scallops which I had before and they were large, juicy, and full of flavor same as before.  Our server Todd was very accommodating and worked at offering great service.  This has become a great regular place to go.

Excellen service, great atmosphere and the best breakfast this summer! Hand made sausage patties are the first indication that Moe Joe's takes serving great food seriously. And the food here is seriously good. Perfect poached eggs and potatoes are home made too. Did I tell you about the jam? My oh my, Moe's is a major contender for best breakfast in the Treasurer Valley.
The people working the counter are helpful and the waits are very short. Only 4 because of the state's messing around taking forever to process titles.

We had a great 1st experience. Sat at the bar and Shannon helped us. Super friendly and helpful. She made some great suggestions. 
I could see why some of the other reviews complained about service just watching some of the waitresses, like they'd be pained if they had to crack a smile. 
So glad we got Shannon! Thanks! We'll be back, and sit at the bar again.
Multiple visits and the service is always friendly and accommodating, and the food is delicious.

My BTA (bacon, tomato, and avocado incorporated into a classic eggs Benedict) was really good! The hollandaise was great, and it complemented the tomato perfectly. The avocado was perfect on top- sliced so thinly that I had some in every bite. The coffee was good and refilled frequently, and I liked the small pot of cream they placed on the table to stir in it. Service was great, even on a busy Sunday morning. Apparently the toast is also delicious, according to my family. I'd recommend this place for a tasty, reasonably-priced breakfast or brunch.
This is a nice breakfast place. Portions are huge and high quality food. My favorite was the lemon poppy seed pancake. They were busy, but service was fast and everything was flawless. I'll go back!

We were craving brunch, and this was my first time at Moe Joe's. We came in on Saturday about 10am. Every seat was filled which always gives me a good feeling! It's a tucked away small mom & pop shop & very casual ambiance. They have a few benches in the corner for us to wait for our table. We browsed the menus & we were seated in about 15 minutes. 

The menu is very extensive & I had a hard time deciding what to order! I decided on the Smoke House with out the mushrooms. It was SO delicious. It came with toast, and they had an excellent sour dough. I couldn't even eat half of the plate - so I took the rest home. 

I will definitely come back! I can't wait to try other things on the menu!
Amazing food! Great customer service! We will be returning often! Thanks Red Pavillion!!

The food here is good. Probably among the best in the area.

What isn't good is the service my fiancee and I experienced on our visit here. Upon checkout, the female server asked me to my face in front of my fiancee (who is wearing a rather large sparkly engagement ring) "Is she your sister?"

...

Really? 

Unprofessional. Uncalled for. Insulting. Not coming back. Megone.

Update: apparently this placed closed. My visit was in fall of 2016

Everyone there is knowledgable, honest, friendly and polite. I felt like I mattered and that they really cared about finding the right plan for me. The gentleman that helped me introduced himself (I feel so bad because I can't remember your name! It started with a T) and took his time to explain everything. I never felt pressured to purchase or sign up for anything that I wasn't interested in. Customer service can be a really tough industry to work in you all are doing a great job! Thank you for making my visit so enjoyable and painless. I will absolutely be back!

My husband and I recently moved to Idaho from Hawaii and I was craving Chinese food. We ordered the Veggie Chow Fun, Kung Pao Chicken, Chicken Fried Rice, General's Chicken and Spring Rolls. It was just under $50 for everything which I initially thought was a bit pricey but the helpings were really generous. The food fed 5 with enough for one of us to have lunch tomorrow. It also came with a huge plate of white rice and we have a ton of that left over as well. The service was also rather timely. I placed the order and the gentleman said it would be ready in 15 minutes! Needless to say, we'll eat here again. 

So why only four stars? It's silly but 1) I wish they delivered and 2) the prices for each dish weren't listed on their website.

So yummy! My friends and I family styled it-We got the smothered chorizo burrito, donut and cup of Joe, and the smokehouse with poached eggs. My favorite and my friend's was the smokehouse! My other friends fav was the donut and cup of joe! Just the right amount of sweet! Will definitely come back again to try more off the menu!

After being checked in we went to room to shower after a long drive, The shower sprayed water all over the bathroom over the shower curtain and on the walls in the other side of bathroom covering the floors with water, due to a leaking shower hose. We had to use all our towels to mop up the soaking wet floor. We asked for fresh towels and we told we had to carry all our towels to the front desk, they wouldn't bring us towels even though there shower was not working. We asked to get the shower fixed and took us going back for a second time get the shower "fixed" The maintance guy showed up and ended up making it worse, causing water to spray different area of the bathroom including the electrical outlets. Our other issue was the heating system didn't work. We had to keep the heater set at 75 to prevent the system from blowing ice cold air, anything below 75 was cold air.  Overall a very poor experience staff was not that helpful would not recommend this place

Ate at Gino's a few weeks ago with my wife and another couple. Food was very good, service was great, and the owner made sure he stopped by and thanked us for eating there. It's a little deceptive from the outside, looks like a strip mall restaurant. Inside, very elegant and spacious. I'd highly reccomend Gino's.

Wow!!! This place sucks!!!!  Someone buy these guys a dictionary!!!!! My jeweler had these guys make him a sign.  I came out looking great ....... One problem!!!!! They don't know how to SPELL!!!! A sign company that can't spell!!!! F n amazing!!!  They spelled JEWERY instead of JEWELRY!!!  Then when we noticed and tried to have the sign re made they said no!  We asked for our money back and they said no!!!  We never received a proof nor approve one. This place sucks. Very unprofessional. I spoke with a business neighbor and they had the same problem with business cards and receipt books with incorrect spelling!!!!
Excellent selection, great toppings, super helpful and cheery staff.  Really nice people in a great environment for the kids, they love the yogurt!!!
Seriously the best breakfast in town and their lunch menu is incredible.  Having tried many breakfast joints, moe joes is at a totally different level.  The place is busy and they deserve to be.

Usually I'm not a big fan of buying spaghetti I'm a better cook than most places I eat. But guys night requires my son getting to pick the spot. 
Tonight Carinos was on top of it. The food was hot and fresh. We had their wonderful bread and olive oil w/ garlic (I always add balsamic vinegar), calamari, and skillini.
All was really good. But what made the night was our server Christel. She was friendly, prompt, and attentive. Some of the best service I've had in a while. 
A great night!

Dr. Miller and the entire staff at River City are amazing! They took great care with our dogs, and answered all of our questions. There are many veterinary offices much closer to our home, but everyone at River City is so great, we have no problem making the drive.

This fantastic hotel is going to be my home for next 2 weeks until my apartment will be ready. The location is very convenient and the services they offer is very generous. They have a full kitchen with a stove, fridge, kitchen utensils, dishwasher and everything where I can cook fresh meal for my 3 yrs old. I loved the free Washer and Dryer service and the complimentary breakfast service very much. The rooms are very clean and the beds are comfortable. The staffs are very friendly and helpful especially Operations Manager Wendy goes beyond to help you and make you feel like home. I highly recommend this hotel as it is one of the best and very affordable.
Awesome food, great service!!!  Fantastic spot for breakfast.  The biscuits and gravy are huge.  Bring an appetite, you won't leave hungry.

Great outfit, great people.  Paul was super helpful on the phone.  He always got back to me quickly and had intelligent answers to all my questions.  Kevin and the installers do a great job too...this is definitely not their first rodeo.  He adjusted the door perfectly, the new opener is fantastic, and I am very pleased with the entire process.  Give these guys a call!

Gino's is my favorite Italian restaurant in the Boise area and I have been there many times.

Service: Service is always friendly and knowledgeable.  I have never had bad service at Gino's.

Food:  I love the food here.  It has a unique flavor and it over the top rich.  I almost always get angel hair pasta with Alfredo sauce and sausage.  Awesome flavor combo.

My wife usually gets chicken parmigiana and the chicken is always crisp.  A lot of places end up soggy breading but it's always crispy at Gino's.

If I have not stuffed myself silly at the end of the meal, I will order their Tiramisu.  I love their Tiramisu. They are one of the few places that I have been to that does it really well.  

My only complaint on the food is this.  When I first ate at Gino's, it was still downtown and I got  veal saltimbocca and it was amazing.  I loved it.  I got it again when I first went to the new location and was very let down.  The flavor of the meat was overwhelmed by the spices and cheese that was folded inside of the meat.  The meat was a little dry and was missing the super smooth rich fat/flavor.  When I first had it, it was all about the meat and it's flavor, the second time it was all about the stuff inside. I have not had the courage to try it again since then.

Next time I go back, I am going to give the veal saltimbocca another try.  If it's awesome like the first time I had it, then they will have earned back the 5th star.
Sweet Potato Fries are the best I have ever had!   Also,  try their Rumbi Rice. It is sweet with a few beans in it.

We dined here with neighbors on New Year's Eve and since we had never been to this restaurant before we didn't know what to expect.  First of all the location is close to our home, there is ample parking because it's in a small shopping center, and the atmosphere of the place is very warm, quiet, and inviting.  There was soft jazz playing in the background.  I had one of the specials of the evening which was grilled lamb chops and risotto.  They were cooked perfectly, medium rare.  My husband had veal parmesan which was also very good.  One of our party had the Hagerman trout special and stated that it was excellent.  We all shared the fried calamari appetizer and enjoyed that very much.  The service was very efficient, friendly, and we felt unhurried and relaxed in this dining environment.  We would definitely return.  On a note:  the portions are ample and could be shared.  We ended up taking some food home.

Stopped at a place in Boise down the road from work, but they were booked so hunted for a place closer to home.  Found Caleb's online, stopped by, and the one barber I saw was cutting a kid's hair and chatting with dad, while the other 3 well-behaved kids were chilling on the Bel-Air couch.  I was told someone would be out in a minute that could get me done.  I waited about ten minutes, then a fella rolled out of the back.  I got his attention, sat down, and he went to work.

I'm basically bald.  Ok, not totally, but in my eyes I just don't have enough hair to be worth cutting.  "Shave it", I told him.  "It's ok, I know I don't have much to work with."  That's what I've almost always done, simply because I can't look good with hair on my head anymore.  That's what I thought.  He told me he'd work with what I had, we both had a laugh, and he went to work.

I wasn't facing the mirror the entire time, just looked at all the awesome car memorabilia in the shop.  Old license plates, etc.  A nice mini-mecca for car enthusiasts.  My barber was pretty meticulous, and took his time.  In fact, it almost seemed like he was trying to make me look good.  But come on.  Really?  Me?  He also did a beard trim after the hair cut.  I'm hairy, what can I say?

End of the story?  I have a haircut that I love.  I don't feel like a bald dirtball anymore.  I have a well-manicured beard and a haircut that my wife LOVES!  Never thought it possible.  My only complaint is that I don't remember the guy's name who gave me the cut.  I got the impression that he may not be there all the time, but I'd vote for him every time.  I'm going to try to get a standing every two weeks appointment so I can keep this look and keep my wife.

Thanks to whoever you were.  I'm thoroughly impressed.

Shanaz was referred by a collegue.  I travel way more than I should all over the country and don't eat at chains if I don't have to.  There was only four of us the entire 2 hours we were there (we closed the place down).  We ordered the macaroni cheese balls and two korean tacos.  Cheese balls were good, cooked just right. I'm not a big fan of that kind of stuff, but they were good.  We got an order of the jalapeno corn bread.  Excellent.  The korean tacos were Muy Delicioso.  I would suggest that for two dollars, they could be a bit bigger or charge slightly less.  The salsa for the tacos was kick your hiney hot, but I like it that way.  Idahoan's would probably weiney out.  Then my friends ordered the hamburger, split an order of the pork chops/mashed potatoes and I ordered the gumbo stuffed bell pepper with the shrimp.  

All were excellent!  We cleaned the plates off.  The service was excellent,  I felt sorry for the nice young lady waiting on us since I know she was trying to not hover but at the same time checking on us. 

This is a gem and I hope it stays in Meridian.  I worry that there are too many steak and tater folks there.  My only complaint is the size of the glasses.  10oz of ice tea isn't enough.  She kept pouring though.  I would suggest something like a 20 oz glass.

No dessert menu? I would think there are a couple of good southern desserts that could be added.

Try this one and you will not be disappointed.
Love the pizza! The crust is perfectly thin, pepperoni is crisp and the sauce is sweet and delicious!

I'm not one to shill out 5-star reviews.We love visiting  RED PAVILION .... 
Food: The food is great. From  combo fried rice (ask for a side of HOMEMADE CHILL sauce!) The SPICY CALAMARI  is our favorite . The orange chicken is very good. Seriously, we have never had anything bad!

Atmosphere: the music is always bumping and gives it a chill vibe, and the lighting is dim to make it feel intimate and cozy. 

Service: the service is FANTASTIC.  They're always friendly and know our orders so well。

I loved the owner, Gino.  He came right out and checked on us personally.  You can tell he loves his restaurants and his guests.   The chocolate mousse and creme` brulee were magnificent.  The entrees were very good as well although a little pricy.  All in all a fun family experience.

Just okay!  The waitress didn't have star quality.  She really didn't care about our experience.  Kinda Sad.  Has potential.  But nothing about Denny's.  Food was just bland.  Prices were okay.  But forgettable nothing would make me come back.
yummmm....it's just like Yogartland. It's kinda of over priced but they've got to make money too. I was verryy satisfied.
Food was good and priced well. We didn't get our appetizer though. The server literally threw the check on the table without stopping.

My favorite Italian joint anywhere I've tried. I've been here a bunch of times and it's always good. The appetizers are great, the entrees are great, the service is great, and the desserts I've tried are great too. 

My only annoyance is that they won't serve a Caesar salad because it's "not Italian and is Mexican". I know it's Mexican but I don't care. I'm not positive but I don't know that most people would consider ranch dressing "Italian" either. A really odd thing to be told instead of just saying they don't have Caesar...

Aside from my silly gripe they are the first place I recommend for amazing food. Very impressive place.
Great food, great service. When I asked the waitress what she recommends she told me about this jalapeño bacon infused cream cheese topped omelet that was super delicious!

Excellent menu, better than average service, a great lunch buffet.  My wife and I go here every home game for Boise State Football because of the large and plentiful TV's there and the staff accommodates even the very late games, after midnight.  Highly recommended.

So disappointed. Talked this place up to friends from out of town. Called way in advance to make reservations, arrived on time and waited for 45 mins outside while our hostess proceeded to act like we didn't exist. Should've just stuck with our usual and hit Barbecoa.

I am pro Grimaldi's pizza, and I will return on an evening when I am eager for some calories and pizza alone.  What I won't do, is return for an evening when I am looking for an outing, that involves alcohol.  Their wine list... it is just so underwhelming. And they are an Italian place! They have potential to have an amazing wine list which makes it even worse!! 

Italy makes some of the best wines in the world, and there are PLENTY of Italian wines that are very affordable, so that isn't the problem.  Unfortunately Grimaldi's has fallen under the presumption that to provide affordable wines, they must be supplied by the big huge distribution companies whose affordable wines, is also just plain bad. 

In my last outing there, I happened to come in for some pizza on an evening that was half off wine night.  Suddenly a $40 bottle was $20 and it was silly to not get one for my fiancé and I to share at our table. I was unfamiliar with the wine, but I thought I would give it a shot as it was a grape I knew I liked, from a region I knew I liked.  Long story short, we each took a sip.  And then a second to be sure our first impressions were accurate.  And then we literally gave the bottle to our server to take home with him.  It tasted like over extracted, grape juice that had been transformed into a Vanilla-Coca Cola from too much oaking. 

This was the second time I had been there, where I had to actually teach our server how to open a bottle of wine.  How are they not trained? In both situations I asked  both servers, and they said they were trained for about 20 minutes on wine when they started.  And in both situations, after watching them struggle for a few minutes, I saved them the embarrassment and took the bottle of wine from them to show them how to accurately use the foil cutter.  And how to effectively open the bottle.  Because they had no idea and they were shredding the cork to pieces.  

I wasn't upset with our servers in the slightest, because it isn't their fault.  But I will never understand how a restaurant doesn't take enough time to train their staff.  I've already taken care of 2 of  your servers for you. So you can mark those 2 off of your list, and hopefully catch the others up to speed.  Then after training, hire someone who knows about wine to create a better list. Or just contact me, I'd be happy to come over and do a little in house lesson myself as it really doesn't require much time or effort, and it saves your employees a lot of hassle and embarrassment.

1/2 star at best. Went once and never again. Sushi was subpar and limited. Had to sit there FOREVER for a somewhat better selection to be made and placed on the boats and it was all disappointing. The idea of sushi as an "express" meal is a fail.

It could be a biased review, I can't help it that my genetics altered me lactose intolerant and now my daily cravings call out to frozen yogurt. It takes some enzymes & probiotics and everything is hunky-dory. 

This should supply you with the fact that- why would I eat something that could be harmful unless it was ABSOLUTELY DELICIOUS?! 

This could be comparable to yogurtland- except U-swirls staff are outrageously friendly and the atmosphere is like you're in candy land.

This place is a joke. Unprofessional. The lady working there is Incompetent of doing anything. She messed up my complete order and tried to argue with me to convince me that's what I wanted. I never received a mock up of the product before the ran it. They had the few orders mix matched. Had to do it a few times to get it someone right. Misspelled words. It was pathetic. I finally cut my losses and the headache and went somewhere else

Compared to food ate in Hawaii, it was really good. We had a mixed plate and a noodle bowl both with luau pork. They tasted really good and were pretty big portions. Came out to about 10 dollars a plate though. Burgers are about 8.

Oh man this place is one of my staple lunch spots!  Food is outstanding and always fresh, paired with any of their delicious sauces.  I usually order the chicken rice bowl with the Bali sauce.  The restaurant is always clean and the service prompt and friendly.

If you're looking for traditional island or Hawaiian food, I can't say this is it, but don't let that deter you.  Rumbi has me returning frequently for amazing food!  Another perk is their email club which sends out bogo coupons monthly along with other deals.

I REALLY wanted to give Gino's a good review because the food is great but the owner is not respectful to his customers.  We had a wedding dinner this spring and when we originally met with the manager of this restaurant (months before our event), we were told that we could have a section of the restaurant from 4:00 to 6:00pm for our 70 guests.  Unfortunately the restaurant wasn't prepared to feed that many people because it took one full hour after everyone ordered to get our food out to us.  Therefore, we weren't able to leave at 6:00 as planned but instead everyone left at 7:00 since our food was an hour later being served than planned.  The owner came out all hot-headed and told the DJ to turn the music off stating that we were bothering his other customers and he WANTED US ALL OUT.  I was so appalled.  Here we were paying $2000 for food for our guests (not to mention the alcohol many of our guests purchased for themselves) and that's the appreciation Gino showed us.  None of our guests were loud or obnoxious whatsoever.  I will never give them business again because of this and they certainly can't handle a large group.  For Italian...DaVinci's in Eagle, Carino's in Meridian are my recommendations with excellent service and the food is much better too.

First time trying this pizza place.   It took an hour and a half for delivery, however it was game 7 of the NBA playoffs, so that was not a problem.   Pizza was really  great,  but lacked a fair amount of toppings I'm my opinion.  However, the pizza was so good, I will try them again. I recommend this place for a good meal

I had a Fire Island Noodle Bowl.  The flavors were very savory with a nice amount of sweet to counter-balance.  The noodles were overcooked and forgot to top it with a fresh lime wedge (as pictured and described in the menu) but I took the dish to go and the noodles would have been better had I eaten them there.  Overall it was a delicious dish and made me not want to put my fork down.  I'll be back!

If you don't mind poor service.  This is the place.  Food is good,  prices are reasonable. The staff is poorly trained,  if trained at all. There are ways too get around a backed up kitchen,  but not this place.  Order your food to go,  and you'll be ok.  Make sure to ask for napkins and eating utensils.  Good luck
.
This pizza is the best in the state ! Pizza Hut and dominos don't taste as good as this place :) everyone is always friendly and doesn't have an attitude ! Love the food :)

The pizza is good but not great. Both of our pizzas were slightly burnt on the edges.  Cheese was great and toppings we had were above average in taste and quality. 

The problem: unbelievably expensive!  Our family of 5 had two pizzas, 3 lemonades, and 2 beers. Total tab with tip was $85. 

One pizza was plain cheese and one had 2 toppings ($3 per topping!).  We did have 3 slices as leftover but they don't reheat well. 

Have not gone back due to cost.

A friend and I went in tonight for dinner. The restaurant was very clean and it smells like really yummy BBQ! The service was great. The waitress was attentive and quick to take our orders. She also told us to try something from their buffet. The salad and the house dressing they have is a must! And the kimchi was tasty! The food was amazing! For appetizers we had the dumplings. Then, we had the Bibipmap (I'm pretty sure that's not the exact spelling, but close enough) and the Beef Short ribs. If you're not sure what to order, try those two. You won't be disappointed! We paid $38 for the appetizers and 2 entrees. Their food is decently priced. They also have lunch specials from 11 to 2 during the week. About $10 to $12 for something like a bento box. It looked like it had a lot of food for the price. I would definitely be back! If you want to try Korean food, I suggest you try this place.

I live and work in Meridian, and I enjoy trying new and interesting places.  Shanaz is located in a strip mall that I frequently eat at, and my only criticism of the place is that the signage is terrible, so I passed by it many times without ever considering going in.  The sign says "Shanaz Home Kitchen and Catering" which I assumed meant "boring traditional homestyle meals of meat and potatoes."  

This place would be SO MUCH more popular if the sign actually told the customers what the restaurant is: awesome southern food!  There is nothing else like it in the area, and the food is delicious.  I have only been for lunch, but the Korean tacos are amazingly balanced and savory, and the pulled pork sandwich I had was awesome.  Presentation of the food was great too, something that is often overlooked.

I would totally go to this place more often, except I forget that it exists due to poor branding, which is a shame and the only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5.
This place is the BEST! Food is worth the wait!! Fresh, high quality ingredients. Fantastic food and mimosas. Will be back soon!!

Delicious food and HUGE servings. I'm pretty sure their tortillas are home made. We were in a big group and we all liked what we ordered: cheese quesadilla, carne asada taco, torta, and burritos. All hot, spicy and very good.

Came in with my husband and family for his birthday dinner on a recommendation from a friend. First off, the banchan they serve is bizarre. They had cut up hot dogs served with cabbage, rotini noodles in an unidentifiable sauce, and then the usual spicy cucumber, which was fine. The rest of the banchan was unrecognizable. We all ordered a little bit of everything off the menu, mine being the rainbow roll. I have eaten plenty of sushi in my time and have tried every sushi place in the area (Boise, Meridian, Eagle, Nampa, Star, etc.) and will eat sushi even from Winco, Albertsons, etc. However, the sushi I was served was inedible. They put a strange yellow mayo across the top of the roll that was awful and the California roll portion of the rainbow tasted canned with stiff rice. The fish on top of the roll was cut rather poorly and didn't taste quite right. I ended up sending it back and was offered another roll of my choice, but couldn't stomach to try another so I declined. The manager was not sure what to do with that situation and ended up only comping us 50% of the cost of the roll, despite that only one bite had been taken. The miso soup is tasteless and abysmal. Teriyaki chicken was okay. My brother and husband's grandmother ordered a spicy seafood noodle and there was literally five pieces of seafood in it despite the cost being pretty high. Bimbimbap looked pretty good, but I did not try it. Overall, we were so disappointed in the food completely. We tried to order something from each part of the menu, but nothing was good. We will not be back sadly.
This place was awesome! Amazing breakfast and great staff! Can't wait to get back over!

As far as authentic, fast food, mexican goes this place is excellent! The tacos are delicious, light, and inexpensive. The chimichangas are also great. The bfast burrito with carna asada added is amazing and HUGE but won't leave you feeling greasy afterward. It's worth a try!

Snake River has some of the most knowledgeable staff in the valley. They have a wonderful selection and repairs are very fair. I've been a customer since they moved in to the old farm store years ago and I have never had a bad experience with them.  They are never pushy with sales and if they don't have a part you are looking for they have no problem calling other bike stores around the valley to help you find it.  Just a friendly, honest staff.

went today for a smoke & pepper burger. asked for the burger to be well cooked no pink...came out almost raw half way through. i love ciabatta bread & the bun was not ciabatta. way to soft & had a strange taste. steak fries are standard frozen fries & my spiked freckled lemonade was so weak i couldn't even tell it have alcohol in it at all. i wasn't looking to get a buzz, but come on. they did replace do my burger. so that was good & the meat was nice & charred on the 2nd one. much better flavor this way. they were a little busy, & our server wasn't very attentive. had to flad him down to report the under cooked meat & to get fry refill, because my plate only had about 8 fries on it. my son like his burger. his was cooked through. but he even commented on how small it is now since he last bought one. this has been only 2nd visit in about 20 years & they were  expensive as F back then & now even more so. if i don't go back for another 20 years i'm fine with that. don't waste your money BK burgers have better flavor cost less & the same freak'n size.
Excellent sandwiches!  I don't think Subway can touch these guys!  Ice cold produce, fresh cold cuts, insanely fresh bread!  Seriously, the bread is the best part!

Locally owned and operated. This is a great place to watch some sports or get a drink after work. A well above average neighborhood bar and grill. Even has a large enough dining room for families. This trip I had a wedge salad and beef skewers with chile garlic aioli. Everything was done well and the servers were great even with a busy sports crowd on a Saturday. The Irish Cowboy Sandwich is a favorite for me.

I've been here several time thinking it will get better but it never does I always end up  disappointed this last time I ordered 3 carne-asada burritos and order of rolled  tacos well did not get carne-asada and the rolled tacos were over cooked. If anyone knows where to get good Mexican  food let me because it's not here...

Dr Mark Fineman is an excellent veterinarian. We started seeing him for our basic vaccinations. Then we had an after-hours emergency for which he graciously met us at his office to perform a minor surgery.
Dr. Fineman has a passion to help all animals. In addition to caring for his patients, he also gives back to the community by providing care to dogs from a local rescue. 
Whether you are looking for a vet for the first time or are not happy with your current vet, please give Paramount Animal Care a call. You will  be happy you did!

2nd update:  soooooooo glad I went back to get them fixed!  The second time around the  nail technician Megan trimmed my cuticles, got the gel on right and my nails look fabulous!  I didn't want to call and complain, but I am glad I let them know because after getting them fixed today I am now likely to return since this time they came out wonderful.  Also ask for Megan, she is fantastic! 



1st Update to my previous review.

Gel mani was on Friday , by Sunday everything was peeling and lifting and Sunday night everything had come off. I called the salon and let them know that they didn't need to do anything about it in terms of giving me another  service but I called to let them know maybe the gel had gone bad and that they should throw it out. The lady said that shouldn't have happened and insisted I give them another chance and they will redo the manicure so I have an other appointment this Wednesday, not quite  a week after from the original appointment to give it another go.  I sincerely appreciate the excellent customer service and her willing to make the wrong a right.
Super good, authentic Chinese food - nothing like it in the Boise area. I would eat here every day if I could.
Spent $79 on takeout, there was no sauce on the nachos, no oil for the bread and very little food for the money spent. Eating at locally owned from now on.

They did a lot of bragging how their pizza was NY style pizza. They also bragged that you will not want any other pizza once you try theirs. It was good but there are other pizza joints in town that are just as good. 
The pizza was cooked too long. The crust was very crunchy. You could not fold the crust to eat it. The sauce was good but seasonings had to be added. I love a pizza place that knows how to season their sauce before it is cooked.
We will come back mostly because of its location.

The manager Corey was a one man show as he was in the middle of restaffing. That didn't stop him from being fast and efficient in all aspects of service. He analyzed our plan and our equipment. We were able to get a better phone than we thought, changed our numbers to Idaho numbers, activated our iPad to receive data, changed our AT&T plan and my bill will stay almost the same! Outstanding work and great service. I will only go here for my AT&T/Cell phone needs!

The best ribs I've had in town!  Juicy, tender, with a great dry rub and a half dozen bbq sauces to choose from.  Their steak fell short, but the mashed red potatoes and fries were good.  If you are in the mood for ribs they are top notch.  Wednesday night is family night and they have discounts for kids and their mascot running around.

Intermountain Pet Hospital is the most efficient, caring, and informative Veterinary service I have ever used.
I also used their Lodge services and was very happy with the care my pet received.

I have always been given accurate information in regards to my pet's situation and the choices available, without pressure to choose one over the other, but what worked best for our family and our pet. The care was above and beyond the best!

I recently had to have our beloved pet euthanized. We were able to do this at home, making the incredibly difficult decision and situation, much more comfortable for us and our pet. Several changes had to be made in scheduling and no one ever was exasperated or angry about this. Dr. Miller and the technician that cam to our home were the most compassionate, kind and loving individuals to deal with. I thank them so much for their respect for us and our pet. Again they went above and beyond our expectations.   Thank you so very much!! 

I would recommend either location of Intermountain Pet to anyone who wants the best care ever!

Joy Garden is our go-to local Chinese take out food restaurant.
The food is quality and ready to go fairly quickly, and always warm. The service is friendly and the family that runs this restaurant always greets you with a smiling face.
My favorite dish is the Kung Pao Chicken, and the partners is Beef and Broccoli. Always tasty! For the portion size they give you, the price is perfect.

I don't understand the hype of this place. If you're a true coffee drinker this place is not for you, If you enjoy corporate or big franchise coffee, it's the same. The staff is very nice and friendly, this is why they get 2 stars, but the coffee? No thank you. I ordered 2 breve's and they were made in about 30 seconds.... not ideal for me. It was bitter and it wasn't foamed well at all. I honestly went so I could determine if Boise got another great coffee place or if it was the same old drive thru experience you can get anywhere in the valley. Sorry to say it is defiantly the latter.
Quality has gone UP! Great huevos rancheros and French toast.  Don't go at peak hours and you can quickly enjoy a great breakfast!
Awesome food and staff. Priced well for the portion you get. One of our favorites places to eat. Love the chicken or steak salad. The horchata with Rootbeer is to die for.
Touché Wingers.. good food, good service... good bar attendant Sarah with great expertise and service!

Ate here with my wife, and it was a treat. We shared the baked ravioli and fettuccini alfredo. Both were very flavorful without being over done. Didn't leave feeling gross, which was an added benefit. 

Jessica was our waitress and she was incredibly friendly and really seemed eager to make our dinner delightful. 

The only thing I regret is not eating here more.

This place is delicious. Big portions. Hubby and I shared the Farmers hash with sourdough toast and a half order of biscuits and gravy. We did not leave hungry and there was even hash to spare lol. The wait time for the table and food after we ordered was about 15 mins each. The severs were super friendly and always made sure we had coffee and water =) after getting our food they checked to make sure everything was good. If we lived in the area this would be a regular spot for us. We will be sure to come back next time we find ourselves in Boise!

Literally the best breakfast place I have ever eaten at, and I have eaten at a lot. Not so much on the pancake/griddle side but I hat they have is excellent. Where I find my pleasure here is in their homemade hash, especially the Chorizo hash. Great people, good atmosphere and excellent food. They make a decent cup o coffee also.

Ate here today with my 11 yr old. I ordered an omelet and after several bites discovered a six inch long grayish blond curly hair that was definitely not mine (i have straight brown hair) right on top of my omelet. I called the server over and showed her the hair and she seemed apologetic and a new omelet was brought out fairly quickly - without hash browns. Those came 5-6 minutes later. By then I wasn't interested. My meal was ruined and I got nothing comped and no discount. I still tipped well and said nothing but I feel this review is justified. Also, a kids breakfast is $7 and is one egg, one bacon strip and hash browns. I spent about $22 for a hairy omelet and kids meal. Never again.
So bartenders could learn customer service. When a to go customer arrives and pays for their order asking them if they'd like something to drink while they wait would be good business practice.
Sitting here with a 15 min wait, many empty tables, hostess says, "we don't have enough servers".. really understaffed!
Service was great and the food came out quickly. However, it was lacking in quality. Maybe ok for a college town?  Just your standard meats with prepackaged sauce poured over it.

If you are really hungry, don't come here or be prepared to wait a while. There were 3 other people in the place for lunch and our food took forever to come. My husband said the Chicken and waffles was good. My shrimp Po Boy was just ok. Probably will not be back....
Place is clean and service was fast as nobody else was there on a Sunday at 5pm. The food is definitely not a upgrade from Taco Bell so if you like that faire, this is comparable.

Wow! A great surprise. Not exactly authentic Mexican food but who cares. Highly recommend the sweet pulled pork in any fashion you like. Guacamole hits the spot. Surf decor, water feature, sleek interior. Does not feel like fast food joint here, it is Beyond that.
Well I can't say anything good about it because I'm out of town and didn't know that they are closed on Monday! And it's getting a 1 star mostly because I'm hungry as crap!!!

I've been here about 5 times now and just have bad luck every time!  I got the gnocchi alfredo with chicken last night.  The gnocchi was overcooked and the alfredo was flavorless.  The chicken was also flavorless and dry.  My boyfriend got the crab and marinara.  He said it was okay but was up at 3:30 am sick to his stomach.  So, for $85.00 I will be going somewhere else where I know the food is great! The service is great and the owner did come around to check on people.  I didn't want to complain because I know he'll chew out the kitchen staff.  My bad I guess!  Needless to say, we will not be going back!

Moe Joe's food was delicious! I've been twice and had the Chorizo Hash and the country fried steak both with a homemade biscuit and marion berry jam. It was out of this world!

Both times as I pasted through Boise, Mary was my server at Moe Joe's Eatery. Mary was extremely pleasant and remembered me from the past visits. If you get a chance to stop in at Moe Joe's try to sit at Mary's station, you'll get amazing service.

Thanks Moe Joe's. I'll definitely be coming back the next time I'm in the area.
Good food. Not spectacular, but it has a great community vibe and the service was excellent.

My husband and I had a spur of the moment dinner at Gin's.  We didn't have reservation, but got seated right away!
We started off with a bottle of Three Legged Red wine!  AMAZING wine from Wala Wala Washington.
Our server, Erik, was very attentive. He gave great dinner recommendations. He knew the menu.
You won't go wrong here!
Best in the Treasure Valley - order the potstickers for appetizer and honey almond shrimp - yum yum
Always polite and friendly. Each time I buy tea, I like them more and more. When your In line- they'll get your order and when you pull up to the window, it's ready. Quick and easy.

My daughter made reservations there as follows:   motorhome for three nights; trailer a joining for two nights and one tent for two nights. The confirmation email gave the motor home two nights with no mention of the other needs.  A phone call told us that the park had no other vacancies on the days needed.  After explaining that there were vacancies when the original reservations were made,  we were given complete reservations except for not being adjacent sitesm.

The park it self was like a sardine can, but was clean and the outside staff both friendly and helpful.

My next stay in Boise will be elsewhere.
Couldn't make a egg, bean, and cheese burrito to save their life. Apparently it's complicated.
Amazing......I am from Seattle and flew in for a wedding. Running late Justine gave me a great blowout and did a Fabulous job. I love my hair.

I like the fast concept and the quality is good, but I can't deal with the over use of the mayo.  Damn. It always comes layered thick like I am putting up wallpaper.  I have asked for lite or no mayo and still get mayo.   The other thing that weirded me out was the number of employees doing meaningless tasks in the middle of the day. It was like 230pm or so and we were the only ones with 7 employees and the manager. Got to wonder of they are making labor costs.   Anyways. In a punch for fast sandwich this may be the place but stay away from the mayo.

Convenient location for west meridian!! ...that's about it though, unfortunately. I take no pleasure in leaving bad reviews, but between the food and the prices, this was just no good. I'd probably prefer Applebee's, and I don't even like Applebee's...
Maybe I'm just picky, but when I pay over ten bucks for a meal, I expect better...

Was there for a late lunch and I found hair in my food.. the server was very quick to address the situation and grab me a new plate , they were very quick about getting me a new order on top of removing the burger cost off my Order .. kudos to the server for keep a friendly manner with me even tho I can sometimes lose my cool ... will deff be going back again awesome speedy service ..
Los Betos is a great fast food authentic mexican restaurant.  Great tacos and breakfast burritos.  The service is sometimes hot and miss, but the place is clean and the food is good.

I'm giving this KOA one star only because 0 is not an option. This KOA by far is one of the worst I've ever stayed in. The jacuzzi is still broken and the water in the pool is cloudy. Gross. My husband made a reservation for a pull through 7 months prior to our arrival date and we we checked in, they gave us a small pull through that we can barely fit our 27 foot trailer and truck. And if that's not bad enough the site is next to a trash dumpster. We smelled trash the whole time, on top of having people constantly going to drop trash off. When we complained to management and KOA corporate, no one cared. That's the KOA attitude. Beware about wasting your money on a KOA membership.
This place is a great little place awesome food that is only outdone by great local wine and entertainment
One of my go-to places for brunch when I'm in town. Had the chorizo has and it was delicious! Great flavor, right amount of heat.

First visit last night and was the first time the food and service was decent in the Village.  The food was good but on the high side for what you get.  Server was ok and pleasant. The menu is very limited and price can add up quickly.

Service was poor and slow. Sunday ~10:30, about a 15 minute wait to get a table, then another ten minutes until someone brought water, then another 7 minutes until our waitress stopped at the table. It took close to thirty minutes to receive our order (for two). I'm waiting to get a credit card back as I write this review... Garden hash was primarily potatoes, garlic (there was easily two heads of garlic cloves) and cucumbers, other ingredients listed on the menu such as mushrooms and avocados were totally non-existent. The French toast was just toast with butter and powdered sugar. The portions were large and filling, but the food was mediocre. The decor is also odd and mismatched.

Yum! Quick service, fresh food and friendly people.

We were driving by on a snowy day and decided to stop on a whim. The food was excellent. I had the lemon poppyseed pancakes and one of their 'lighter' options of eggs, dry toast and tomato. My husband had 'the smokehouse' and it was delicious and seasoned to perfection. Everything was great. The wait staff did an excellent job of being attentive without being annoying.

Will definitely go back!

If they had an awesome hot and sour soup, they would have gotten 5 stars from me. They have great food overall with a great price. Next I order there, I'll upload some photos. If you're looking for great takeout that doesn't disappoint, order there. We did the family combination and had leftovers for a few days!

"I'm trying to free your mind, Neo. But I can only show you the door. You're the one that has to walk through it."
Morpheus, from The Matrix.

Do yourself a favor and bust out of your usual restaurant stupor; only you can choose to do it.  Wake up your taste buds from their unconsciousness, go ahead take the red pill and then head to Shanaz Home Kitchen to sample the best food in Boise! There I said it, I mean wrote it.  Don't call bull_ _ _ _! It took me 4 months of CONSTANT eating out at some of Boise's better restaurants and also some of Boise's more appalling restaurants in order to find The One.  I for one am going to stay in Wonderland because I know how deep the rabbit-hole goes.  Usually I am not so dramatic, okay that's a lie, but whatever, you must try the food at Shanaz!  I can only show you dear reader the door, you have to walk through it. Read on.

Shanaz is the type of restaurant that you go to for the food. Oh the food, the food.  So freakin' good. Once you taste the Fried Man-N-Chees Balls, how can you deny their seduction? These are described on their menu as follows: "Need I say more?" That's it.  Well, here's my attempt to describe, the "more" - these are tasty, fried, chees-y elbow macaroni balls of pure gluttony, which I'm pretty sure they serve in heaven.  When you are in foodie heaven, i.e. Shanaz, don't worry about getting fat or the amount of carbs you are about to consume, just enjoy. You get 5 of these per order and they are HUGE BALLS.  Calm down ladies, there is more than enough to go around.  Shanaz's signature sauce is the accompaniment; I have no idea what it is made of, just go ahead and dip your Balls in it and enjoy a little spicy sauce with this very filling appetizer.   

Next you must try the Jammin' Korean Tacos.  I wanted to get the Fried Green Tomatoes, but they didn't have them available because the chef wants only the best ingredients. So, we got the tacos and were amazed, I mean blown away! Each bite of this taco appetizer is a flavor sensation; the tastes are distinct yet completely complementary. Spicy, garlicky, and infused by a whole host of Asian flavors I cannot name. Atop each white corn tortilla is beef which has been marinated in a garlic oyster sauce; then the menu says the beef has been tossed with a brown sugar sesame soy sauce (don't worry they are not sweet!). On top of the beef is an Asian slaw which is your veg selection for the evening. Then as if that weren't enough to make this great, another spicy Asian sauce is served alongside.  Is this what true love is all about?

 "I wanna tell you a little secret, being The One is just like being in love. No one needs to tell you you are in love, you just know it, through and through." Oracle, from The Matrix.

Having thoroughly enjoyed the starters, we were really excited about what was to come next; we ordered the red bell pepper filled with jambalaya. You caught me, I lied again.  Using the word filled is such an understatement - the pepper was not only jam-packed with rice, chicken and Andouille, it was overflowing onto the plate! I think there was as much of this Southern flavored goodness in the pepper as was on the plate, so generous, and only $10.  Wow! The taste of the rice was really authentic, down home Southern spiciness and totally satisfying. In addition to all this there was a side of okra and corn! Okra in Idaho - I would've never thought that I would string those words together in a sentence, yet it's done.

When our server recommended the seafood gumbo I thought she had forgotten what day of the week it was - Tuesday for the record.  Let me explain, the menu says the seafood gumbo is only available on Friday and Saturday but when I confirmed that it was in fact Tuesday and the gumbo was available, I felt like I had won the lottery! Of course we had to add that to our order.  Again, the flavors were intense and completely authentic.  The chef knows his stuff!  The gumbo has shrimp, okra and again the flavorful Andouille sausage.  What really makes gumbo impressive in my mind is the richness, thick consistency, and depth of flavor that comes from stew.  Home run once again with this version at Shanaz.  Thank you, thank you, thank you!  If that were not enough, our entrees came with piping hot cornbread!  Sweet, but not too; crumbly and the perfect crustiness around the outer edge.  Did I mention you get a whole skillet of corn bread! Well done, perfection yet again!  

Our server was friendly and had such an easy going demeanor that she made you feel welcome right from the beginning.  There are community tables for chatting up the other devotees, err customers.  Very convivial.  

"Have you ever had a dream, Neo, that you were so sure was real? What if you were unable to wake from that dream? How would you know the difference between the dream world and the real world? Welcome to the real world." Morpheus, The Matrix.

Do NOT Order to go from this location! Burger Fries and a milkshake ordered online. Website says 13 minutes till pickup is ready. I showed up 10 minutes after I ordered expecting another 5 to 10 minutes wait in case they were busy. They were not busy when I showed up. Went up to the counter to collect my order and it wasn't ready yet which was fine so I sat down to wait. They brought me the milkshake I ordered almost immediately. A milkshake is not an appetizer, it should be made 30 seconds before the food shows up in a to go. I have been sitting here for half an hour in my food still is not here. So now it has been 40 minutes since I ordered online. People who sat down after me have ordered and received their food already. My milkshake is now completely melted and nothing but flavored milk. What am I supposed to do with this now? Take it home and attempt to re freeze it and then blend it again? Burger is cold. Fries are old. Burger tastes good as always which is the only good thing about today however it was cold when I got it home (5 minutes away)

Over priced mediocre food.  The atmosphere was very "chainy" as I expected.  The servers were very friendly. Its a shame they are wasted on this mediocre establishment.  Specifically, the meats were either not of good quality or not prepared properly.  Either way it was a disappointment.  The sides were not a welcome addition to the entre in that they were just plain bland.  Don't waste your time...there are better options.  In fact, I can't recall ever having worse BBQ than I had at infamous dave's.
Family friendly! Good wings! Good finger steaks! And great service! We love going to Rudy's because we never leave disappointed and the food is always fantastic.

We had our club meeting there last night.  The management would not quiet
 down or control the children in the game room.  We asked several times.  The manager was not even apologetic.

Love the layout of this store. It feels like you're shopping at the anthropology of thrift stores, the decorations are so awesome and the layout is fun to browse with. Bright and welcoming. Workers there are friendly and helpful. This is a fantastic place to by fabric, too. Very good prices and lots to look through. Thank you for having such a great store! I will be a regular shopper here. :)

The owners at Snake River Yamaha are dishonest people who will lie right to your face. I have done business with them since they opened in 1996 but I will never set foot in their store again. The owner used his vehicle as a deadly weapon to force my family and I off the road. When I got out and confronted him he stank to high heaven of booze (or worse). I threatened to call the sheriff on him and the stupid idiot was so drunk he didn't recognize me and told me "I am the sheriff". Even though the sheriff department says he has a breathalyzer built into his ignition,  he apparently got somebody to blow in it for him so he could drive down the road recklessly like the alcoholic jackwagon that he is. He lied to the sheriff and blamed his poor wife for driving (she wasn't the driver). He lied and said he never told me that he was the  sheriff  (impersonating an officer). He lied about only having one drink as allowed by the terms of his probation. And he refuses to this day even to acknowledge,  much less apologize for,  driving down public roads in a drunken, reckless manner, endangering the public at large. He fooled me for 20 years into thinking that he isn't a total scumbag. But now I know him for the dishonest irresponsible control freak that he is. Which is why after 20 years, I can no longer say Snake River Yamaha is worthy of my business. Or any business.

Worst customer service I've come across. 
We visited the babies r us section of the store and waited around for over an hour while the one sales associate helped out one person. Not once did the lady ask if anyone else needed any help. We were honestly planning on spending a lot of money here but after that I think I'll order everything online from Amazon or another site that's not associated with toys r us

This is the place for party supplies & more! They have plenty of theme choices even costumes & games. The only place I get balloons pretty much. They do carry tons of stuff but I remember I needed someting but they didn't have it, so definitely call or plan your party ahead so you can order online. I needed some gold tissue papers today to make Pom poms with & they do have them, the downside is in one pack it only has 3pcs of tissue & it cost $.97 which is a lot compared to the normal tissue paper I get at the dollar store which has 25-35 pcs. Sometimes you just do what you gotta do.

Fantastic thin crust pizza! I love how you can build it yourself if you choose! The portion sizes are very generous as well. The personal size pizza is plenty large enough to feed 2 as well as the salad. Everything was seasoned just right as well. Great wine selection- all wine is 1/2 off on Tuesday's as well! I'd definitely go back!

Recently went back to Famous Dave's with my wife a couple of days ago.  Have eaten here many times since they've been here and at other Dave's across the U.S.A.  It has always been about average, but this is the last time we will go here.  The Brisket was flavorless and on the opposite side of the spectrum, my wife's St. Louis Ribs were so salty they were almost inedible.  No excuse for this type of inconsistency, lousy cooks or quality control, don't know what it is, but we will continue with Goodwood's and get better quality and tasting food.  Quite honestly Dickey's is better and a whole lot less.  Too bad, because I really like the place and the ambience....just lousy food.
We come here often and use a customer card that records our purchases. Tonight, the card offered $2.00 from purchases that accrued on my account!!

This is a great place to sell your clothes. I always make a good amount of money on clothes that were too nice for Goodwill that I didn't want to spend the time selling on Craigslist or eBay. Simply bring your clothes in and they will sort what they need/want. Wait several weeks (or months if you are patient) and call to check your balance! I haven't shopped much here, but they do seem to have cute things and lots of designer purses and shoes. Tons of jewelry too that is reasonably priced. Definitely need to check back often as the high-demand items are gone in a flash.

I can't believe that I'm giving this restaurant a 1star rating, and it's not because of the food. Rather it's due to stupid business planning. 

I travel all over the U.S. and love coal fired pizza. I came all the way from Mt. Home to try this place and was told when I arrived  (4: pm ) that they have regular maintenance between 4 and  5 pm. And they wouldn't be able to cook anything. 

First of all make your maintenance from 3:30 to 4:30. To many people get off from wok at 4:30
2nd I'm not going to wait an hour or more for dinner. 
3rd I might of stayed if they would of offered 1/2 price hors d'oeuvres  or drinks. Come on do something to retain a customer. Why would I want to wait. Besides offering 1/2 pricing between your maintenance hour doesn't cost you anything.  Or instead of one large coal oven, have two smaller oven's and over lap the maintenance times so there's no waiting.  It's a no Brainer to eliminate the dead cooking time. If I decide to come back I might edit my review later if I ever get some food.  So off to Luciano's on Orchard Ave. 5 star and no waiting.

I remember a better famous Dave's. Very disappointed.  meats were dry, caked with thick layer of brine (salty) and black (charred?) dried paste. Meat was dry, my sons bbq was a tad less than jerky. Won't be coming back. 
Waitress was nice and pleasant 

Guess something happened.  New management??

Very disappointed. Visiting family from out of town & wanted to try somewhere new. The reviews seemed good, we decided to have breakfast before we headed home.  I asked if they had cream and she said they had half & half (prepackaged cups on the table, not the same as cream or real half & half). My husband had ordered a side of bacon, it was mostly fat & very thin. The minute we walked in the first thing we noticed was how dirty it was, tables, floors...We were kind of in a hurry and didn't want to look anywhere else. To top it off I had a curly black hair in my breakfast. UGH. She took it off our bill still resulting in a 20 dollar tag for coffee, one breakfast, and a side of flimsy bacon.  Anyway, spare yourself. Nothing beats Addie's downtown.
Pork was ok, the chicken and the beef were great. Love the tempura shrimp asd on as well.
