I'm going with 3 stars because I love the menu, the atmosphere is appealing, wait staff extremely friendly, and prices not *too* bad. Why not a 5 star then? Because I ordered a salad (their Sassy BBQ Salad) and it had potato sticks in it. At first I had no idea what they were. I kept getting these skinny sticks of crunchy in my mouth... at first I thought they were cabbage or something. No, I'm not stupid. =) Seriously, it's hard to identify them after the salt has been "wiped off" by the surrounding moisture of the dressing and other veggies. I asked the waitress what they were and she told me. Potato sticks. In case you don't know what potato sticks are - they are potato chips shaped like skinny little french fries. Reading their menu online I do see that there is mention of the potato sticks in the description... and I guess I missed that. I was looking at the picture in the menu and never imagined there would be such an odd ingredient when I ordered. I was more focused on whether I wanted pork, brisket, or chicken as the meat portion of the salad.

Anyway... the potato sticks were a huge turn-off. And as long as I'm yelping I might as well share that the pork was very fatty. If you like to order healthier things (while the rest of the family goes hog wild on BBQ!) then you better know in advance what is in the items and how to customize stuff out.

Worth mentioning: Best corn muffins ever.

Disappointed in the management here. 

We are big Chipotle and Baja Fresh fans, and those restaurants are pretty close. We decided to give Costa Vida a try. 

The first sign you see on their window advertises their app and if you download it today you get $4 off today. 

Well, that didn't work. No credit was loaded by default. The girl at the checkout was so nice. And she went in the back to talk to the managers and I could hear her advocating for me for about three minutes. She saw me go to the App Store, and download it, register. She tried her best. But of course, the managers did not feel like it was their responsibility to come and explain to their test, so they sent her back as a messenger. Nothing they can do, she said.

Tip for managers: interface with your customers. 

Well it turned out OK because the employee who was helping me found a way to get about $10 off my order. She shuffled around some coupons and entered some codes. But it was clear that the managers decided that if the app wasn't working right, it was out of their hands. 

Also, unlike the other two restaurants I mentioned previously, this restaurant does not have vegetarian options that cost less than meat options. If I want a vegetarian entrée, I still have to pay for the meat. 

Lastly, they go so fast when you are ordering that before I could say I didn't want cheese, they already put cheese on my burrito. I said it would be OK if they just tried to scrape it off but the employee was so visibly angry she literally threw the plate. 

Something is weird with this location

This is a terrific breakfast joint. There's usually quite a wait, but it's worth it.

The garden hash is my favorite. It's spiced perfectly, and the home fries beneath the veggie mix are always crisp on the outside, creamy on the inside, and perfectly savory. 

The pancakes are HUGE and absolutely delicious.

The reason I'm not giving 5 stars is because one time my husband ordered the eggs Benedict and had to ask the kitchen to remake his eggs four times... and at that point gave up and resigned to picking at hard yolks. Every time I've ordered their eggs over medium they've been flawless, but apparently they can have a hard time poaching correctly.

I'm new to town and been here twice.  The wait staff is friendly, attractive and helpful.  The food is much better than I expected at a place that is a sports bar/pub. 
I'll be back often!!

I take my dog there a few times a week for doggie day care,,,yes I said doggie day care and yes the dog is spoiled.   He loves that place!  He is always happy go and he is very tired when I bring him home which means he must  have a ton of fun with all of the other dogs.   I wonder if the dogs compare notes to see who is the most spoiled?
Overpriced to the max, but the pizza is really really good.
Have been here at least 20 times. Love the staff and the food is great. Get the Bahama Mama Soup. Unbelievable.
Small but unique menu.  Casual, no pretense (although some might be in order!).  Had black tea marinated pork over rice, excellent.
Second time we have tried this place. Cold yes cold refried beans. Service fine. Quality of food? Well I would rather of gone next door to Subway.

These guys consistently prove that Costa Vida can run with the big dogs. The service was fast and helpful along with a wonderful product. 

I'd take a sweet pork salad or burrito over Chipotle ANY DAY OF THE WEEK. Over rated *clap clap clapclapclap*

Overall:
I was pretty impressed overall with this restaurant the food was good friendly service and lots to choose from on the menu

The Food: 
I order the volcano-blackend fish which was incredible in terms of taste. the salmon was cooked perfectly and was very clean with that comes an order of fried rice which I really liked because it is very different then anything that I have ever taste it has beans in it which set it over the edge and the caesar salad is awesome also. I have been coming to this restaurant for a long time now and my favorite part about it is that everything they serve has a very unique taste. 

The Service:
I have never had a bad experience with the service here i very much appreciate the awesome help that i get from them and they are so dang nice. Perfect.

The Price:
Other then the great food and great service the price is just a little bit steep at $12 which it should be more like a $9 or $10 meal. with that i am very happy with this place overall.

So delicious! It was the first restaurant we visited in west Idaho and we were not disappointed! I was so impressed with their green chili Huevos Rancheros. It was as delicious as the green chili I have had living in Albuquerque. The decor is super cute and staff was friendly and helpful. Such a great start to our move to Meridian, ID.
Rice bowls are big and flavorful. Fun place for lunch or dinner with the family.
My cheese enchiladas had unmelted grated cheese in them. Not melted at all!  Ice cold food and sauce. Horrible beans and rice.
Omg my new favorite breakfast place in the valley. Believe me I know food, you won't leave dissatisfied or hungry, enjoy. Ps everything is good!!

Always great food at a great price. Fast service and consistent. The free pickled carrots at the salsa bar are amazing. Big portions for a small price and 24 hours. Can't beat it. One of my favorites. Tonight had the super nachos. They were good but nothing compares to their carne asada and breakfast burritos.

Always a good bet when you pick moe joes.  A local favorite, the place is always packed, and with good reason.  The service is friendly and attentive, and the food is great! Your best bet is to stick with the least healthy choices, being the entrees smothered in their delicious sausage gravy.  If you want healthier choices there  are a few to choose from, but definitely not as tasty.  Today I opted for the tastier option and went with the breakfast chicken enchilada, which is different than the name sounds.  A golden fried chicken breast sits atop  a corn tortilla and is topped with Ranchero sauce, Pico de Gallo, jalapeno cream sauce, avocado, and an egg cooked however you like.  The chicken was nicely fried, crispy outside, juicy and tender inside and well seasoned crust.  The 3 sauces/salsa all came together nicely to provide the creamy, spicy, fresh component.  I didn't think the jalapeno cream sauce was all that spicy, so adding hot sauce to it added a little extra flavor and heat.  If that wasn't enough food, it comes with a side of nicely browned and tasty, country- style moe Joe potatoes.  Overall the meal was done very well, just needed a bit of salt and hot sauce to meet my taste.   Great place for a great breakfast, and if you're not a breakfast fan, like myself, they serve the lunch menu for breakfast too!

Awesome sushi!! First time there and first time in meridian. They made a special roll for us that we asked for. Super nice staff and clean. We like sashimi and it was fresh and cold. Just perfect. Only here for a week and we will be back before we leave!!

We ate at Gino tonight . I ordered the Chicken Maria with Penne Pasta and it came with spaghetti. The problem we had was it took about 45 minutes to get our food. When my entree came with spaghetti and not Penne Pasta our waitress offered to have another one made to go. I surely didn't want to wait another 45 minutes. By the time the food came I was ready to box it up, I ate a little and had her box it up. Our waitress tried to accommodate up by giving us dessert. I would of rather had them take off my entree since it wasn't what I ordered and tasted like it had been sitting for awhile. The bread was also burnt. Our waitress was very apologetic which was positive she was a little frustrated also with how long it took. Most of the staff needs to be more friendly. I have called to see if I can eat their on a Friday or Sat night when they are busy and they are very cold and make you feel stupid for calling them because they are full. I am sure their are other places that would be a little more happy you called and respond politely. We are the paying to eat their.

My husband selected our dinner location, and he chose Shige Express in Meridian.  I was hesitant based on my past experiences here, but was pleasantly surprised at how much they have improved!  Maybe it was mostly due to the sushi chef (didn't catch his name -he wore a slouchy beanie and was AWESOME), or maybe because it was a Thursday afternoon instead of a busy weekend - whatever it was, the dining experience was greatly improved!  We arrived right at dinner opening, and while we waited for the sushi to be prepared for the boats, we were asked for our drink orders, offered miso, and even apologized to for the wait for the sushi.  The boats were stocked with a good selection of both white and black plates (unlike past times when it seemed like there were two roll selections over and over). The host/waiter made sure our drinks were filled, so that was a welcome change as well.  The sushi chef seemed keen on making sure his dining patrons were satisfied as well.  I will now be going back - for now, I am sticking with 4 stars - if they remain consistent with how they were today, I would consider 5 stars.  Thank you, Shige Express, for stepping up your game!

RUDY'S bar and grill.  Fantastic place to grab a burger or steak with friends, family,  and Co workers.! A quick beer and as always please drink responsibly!  What's even better and totally makes a Tuesday worth it is...? Any takers? Well it's the .65 cent wings on Tuesdays.  Absolutely delicious and at this price you can gorge yourself I'm yumminess for cheap!!! Great selection of drinks on hand to go with the scrumptious food...! Come on in and stop by.

Good option if you're looking for a local, casual café.  The service is friendly and the food is a step up from the big chain restaurants.  The menu is also a bit more creative than the standard breakfast faire.  I felt like they don't put a lot of emphasis on the décor.  If they work to make the environment more comfortable, new and inviting, as well as increase the boldness of their flavors, they could be excellent.

Best Italian food in town. I love this place. If you are looking for a great environment along with great food then this is the place. Gino is always walking around calling the kids by name. Awesome place.

Stopped here on our way home from Nevada because of the Yelp reviews and we could not have chosen better! Really friendly staff, an excellent menu and the breakfasts were fantastic! If you live in Boise or are driving through make sure to try Mo Jo's for breakfast or lunch

Finally a pub in NW Meridian, well needed and overdue.  Full bar and rotating draft beers.  Food is above average for a pub and is consistent and good.   I love that they built this out to be a place for families to come and eat after a soccer game, FB game etc, but also have the pub area for just sitting and having a drink with friends.   Staff is friendly and fun and works hard to insure you are delighted.  They need more food specials, currently only M-W and no food specials for happy hour and food prices are a little high for what you get. 
 Parking is a issue on busy nights, but this place is a go to and I keep going back.

Go for the breakfast buffet or the ice cream sunday buffet.  We used to go on group dates here back in high school for a fun ice cream eating competition.  Always had a blast.  They don't like large groups however.  Breakfast buffet is the best in the valley.  After years of being away I tried it again and must say, it hasn't lost a step.  It's awesome.  Full selection of almost everything you could imagine and they even include juices for you.  You'll love it.

Great place to stock up all of your groceries when you need.

Indeed, after 45 minutes or so, my cart was full of things we needed. Freshly sliced lunch meat, cheese, bread, condiments, pancake mix, syrup, eggs, buns, and of course copious amounts of snacks and treats.

The layout was very similar to most others i have been to,  but this is a bigger store.  It's clean, it's big, it has plenty of parking, and it is convenient to our location to get groceries home and in the fridge.

This place is just like Cafe Rio but I think Cafe Rio is better. They are tight with their serving sizes of sour cream and guacamole.
The chicken tortilla soup is very good though and the size portion on that is decent.

Each plate is hit or miss, but the general chicken is truly great. They can't make soup to save their lives, just a warning to lower your expectations. We're talking 1 wonton in a whole large wonton soup!

I can't express to you about the horrible service this place has to offer. Went in for dinner and get some wings  and the bartender with the man bunn was a dick... Fire him please! Service was slow it's not like it was busy about 10 people in the whole place.

We walked in at 8:45 pm and seating was, seat yourself. Sat down in a booth and didn't get greeted for 20 mins. My husband got up, about to leave. The server (Lauren) finally came by with some menus. Only because we were starving, we decided to stay. There was another table that her and another server were interested in. They stayed and chatted with them for so long, that when we had our food, no one was there to ask us how our food was until we ate most if it. My fries were over cooked and rock hard. When I was able to tell our server, she went back to that one table. Stayed a while, I finished my burger and everyone else finished their food as well. When Lauren finally came back to our table, she realized she forgot the fries. Asked me if I still wanted them, pointless since everyone was ready to go. No adult refills. She refilled one the kids' drinks before our meal came, but never came by to offer nor available to ask for a refill. Very disappointed and will not be coming back.

Not a bad restaurant but not for me. 

Grimaldi's is the newest food offering in The Village, sporting pizza, salads, calzones, and desserts. Everyone in the party I went with enjoyed the food (especially the dessert) but to me, Grimaldi's is merely ok. 

I am going to sound like a grumpy old man when I say this but there is such a thing as having too good of service and Grimaldi's is guilty of this. Our waiter was great at first but then he just would not leave us alone. I am all for having my drink consistently full but over-bearing waiters that don't let you enjoy your food are a pet peeve of mine. 

As for the food, it was nothing special. That is not saying the food was bad, it wasn't. It just wasn't worth the price they were asking. This seems to be a trend throughout most of The Village's eateries so I wasn't too surprised when my bill came. I ordered a personal sized calzone (which was a very good sized portion) and when it came it was good but not thrilling. Grimaldi's is trying to be a little like an upscale Old Chicago but Old Chicago's food is better and cheaper. Having said that, I do like Grimaldi's ambiance and decor better.

One thing I will mention again is that everyone in my group loved the desserts they ordered. The cheesecake was an especial favorite. Overall, I think other people would probably enjoy this restaurant, it just wasn't my kind of place.

I stopped in today for a quick salad to go. I understand that it was the busy lunch hour. However, the salad bar was not taken care and there was a few of us waiting for several items to be refilled. There was a young lady that refilled one item, but didn't come back to refill the lettuce bin that was completely empty.

Based on other reviews, I expected a wait this Saturday morning and was pleasantly surprised that my wife and I were seated immediately. I guess I got lucky because within minutes the place was full. The menu excited us with a wide variety of dishes I had not seen at other breakfast places.  I tend to judge breakfast on a restaurant's sausage gravy so I ordered the farmer's hash. A huge portion of crispy/tender fried potatoes covered with lots of ham, mushrooms, onions, cheese, sausage gravy, and two beautiful, perfectly cooked, basted eggs. The gravy was not the average floury, pasty white stuff that other places serve, but the "real" stuff, almost a light tan in color. Yummy!  My wife went with the donut and a cup o' joe. Not what you would expect, this is really 3 huge, fluffy pancakes with a hole in the middle to suggest a donut. They were lightly glazed and covered with almond slices. The "cup o' joe" was a coffee flavored syrup that my wife raved about.  The food came out of the kitchen promtly and the service was outstanding. Coffee was hot and fresh and refills were nonstop. All the people working there seemed to actually want us to be happy and return soon. I can't wait to go back and try both the omelettes and the benedicts!

Rumbi is right by my work and when we want to splurge a little for lunch we get the blacked salmon entree..so super yummy! Their chicken bowls are good too. Their employees have always been friendly and quick

Anxiously awaited for, Fujiyama has opened in Meridian. The sushi was spot on, only thing I wished is that they also used some sauces, especially creative ones. The freshness of the sushi was excellent and I saw some nice looking platters and a boat combo pass by. Five visits later, excellent!

My family ordered breakfast on a Sunday morning and it was horrible. I'm convinced everything is frozen and not made there. Afterwards husband got very sick, vomit and diarrhea. First and last time going here. Should have known with them having coupons to this place. Beware!!!
Pretty good. Lots of selection and bottomless fries/root beer floats - you can't beat that.

This is the real deal. Delicious breakfast served. Generous portions. Friendly efficient staff. I ordered the Fiesta Hash breakfast. Biscuits on the bottom were warm and not soggy from the toppings. The pork had a delicious flavor with just enough heat. Melted jack cheese with eggs and sliced avacado on the side. It was more than enough for 2 people so make sure you have a big appetite or spilt with a buddy.

This was our first visit to Gino's Restaurant but it won't be the last. We felt very welcomed and attended to by the staff and the owner. The service was excellent and we appreciated having the owner stop by to check on us during the meal. The food was generously portioned, reasonably priced, and delicious. We especially liked the unique glass lamp coverings and the soft lighting made the restaurant atmosphere very pleasant for dining.

Not too bad of a place to stay if you are in town for business. Friendly staff, nice kitchen area in the room (which includes dishes, flatware, glassware, pots, pans and cooking utensils), free laundry and a decent gym and spa. Only reasons for the 4 stars and not 5 is that the room smelled like someone used a gallon of bleach to clean the room. Everything stinks of bleach. Had to open the window for a bit to air it out. When I went to bed my first night, the sheets wreaked of bleach as well as the bath towels. Also, Id skip the continental breakfast, unless you want a grab and go quick meal for the road. There was not any kind of breakfast meat or eggs available. Just pancakes, cereal, yogurt, fruit, toast, muffins, bagles, coffee, juice and milk. Other than that, everything else at Candlewood was great!

Wow, excellent foid. You can't fake freshness. The veggie hash was amazing as was the pancakes. However with a place like this how on earth do you not serve fresh squeezed orange juice. Seriously do yourself a favor and add it to the menu.

Nothing special, just another chain restaurant. To the other poster about knocking chain restaurants. It does matter, because I've never had a chain restaurant meal that was very good. They don't have any leeway to offer anything other than what corporate approves. Everything is shipped in frozen so that every restaurant tastes the same, which equates to bland average food that you can get anywhere. If that's what you like, then by all means go there. Not my idea of a good meal.

It always cracks me up when people travel to another city, and then they eat at a chain restaurant to get the same bland crap that they can get in their own home town. Much better food can definitely be had for better prices.

Best pizza in town. I have been to several locations but the one in Meridian is so welcoming and has a great hang out feel. Pizza and service is always excellent. Highly recommend it. I am a big fan of piping hot pizza so for lunch I choose the special to have my own personal mini pizza made rather than the all you can eat pizza special. Although good and their pizzas keep coming I enjoy my pizza fresh and I can taste the difference. This place is locally owned which is another reason for the 5 stars. Brings me back to the days of being a kid and the treat it was to go to a pizza place with video games.  If this place had Wi Fi it would be the place to hang out.

Food was ok. Bang mi sandwich was kind of salty. Pho meatball was good but small portion for price. Sad part is the waitresses new nothing of the menu or the type of food they serve. They didn't even know the culture which is sad, if you are going to serve food, you should know what you are serving. Overall restaurant was clean and there are lots of Laos food to try.

There is a bit of a wait but it is worth it. Ihad the traditional  Eggs Benedict with the potatoes and was very impressed. The sauce on the Eggs Benedict is very delicious. All and all very good food at a busy place.

My fiance and I had an absolutely delightful stay at Candlewood in Boise-Meridian.

The bed was very comfortable and provide a really good night's rest which is important as a touring artist on the road. I always appreciate the comfy beds. 

We also were able to cook some food and save a few more bucks with the kitchenette in our room! That was super awesome! 

The bathroom was also great. The shower pressure was perfect and as a bonus the shampoo, conditioner and soap in a handy pump that made it super convenient! 

The staff was very friendly and helpful. The hotel was switching internet services and they were very cool about having me sit in the lobby till 2am finishing my work and projects. And the hotspot was fast and reliable! 

WE'd definitely stay here again!

Just your basic chicken teriyaki bowl.
What disappointed me the most was I substituted noodles instead of rice for a dollar and it was just spaghetti noodles... wasn't expecting that.
I'll get the brown rice next time.

Jimmy Johns is my fave sandwich chain.  If you work on this side of Meridian, this is your freaky fast go to place.  The only down side to this particular JJ is the location.  It's a little tricky to get to the store if you are northbound on Eagle.  You have to flip a u-turn to get into the parking lot.

Went there for lunch today for the first time, and will not ever be going back, the food is way overpriced for the quality, and even ordered what the drive thru lady recommended, almost 10 dollars for 3 streettacos, greasy potatoe things and a large Pepsi, the only thing good was the Pepsi, save your money and go elsewhere
Oh my word! This place has amazing breakfast! It is  not your normal breakfast eatery. They come up with uniques and savory dishes..and some that are even healthy! Highly recommend!

Just tried this place after thinking about it for awhile. So happy I did. Really great menu, lots of bowls, salads, kids foods. We loved our half chicken teriyaki bowls. I couldn't even eat all of mine, it was so big. The flavors were so fresh and delicious. They make everything from scratch even their sauces and salad dressings.

Delicious on our way from Seattle to Vegas I was looking at breakfast places , when I saw the Irish Benedict it became a waypoint within seconds. So happy we went it absolutely lived up to my expectations. The corned beef was so good! Since my husband didn't want to miss out on trying the corned beef and I knew sharing wasn't happening if it was as yummy as I hoped, he ordered the corned beef hash :-) both so good. Wish I got a mimosa instead of the Bloody Mary it was too spicy but that's just me. Wish we lived closer.
Very good experience wings and burgers were delicious. Amazing selection of beer! Wait to sit was longer but the awesome staff made up for it. Very friendly.

First time here and all I can say is OMG was that amazingly good!!!!
I had the smokehouse with egg over medium and my mom had a custom inlet with mushrooms, ham and cheese ... wow was it good. I will definitely be telling friends and family about this place
Best breakfast in the area!  If you visit on a weekend, be prepared for a wait.  Food and service are always fantastic!
love this place. We stumbled on to it and yummy!!!! It's worth the wait if you come at the wrong time. Coffee is fantastic. Staff is friendly and takes good care of you. Definitely with going to.

This was a great place to take my family to celebrate my new position at DMP.

Great food, great atmosphere, top notcch service, we willl be back again and again.

This is by far one of the top East Coast Style Restaurants in Idaho.  The food is authentic and delicious, the service is excellent even the bussers make sure you are taken care of, and the owner, Gino always stops by to say hi and make sure everything is perfect.  The Wine Guide knows his wines and is happy to discuss wines with you.  My husband and I will definitely be back.

I just moved to Boise and me and my husband wanted to check out Meridian. Got on yelp to look for a good place to eat. We decided to come here to Moe Joe's, and we are so happy we did. I got the egg white round off the "lighter" section of the menu, but I'm a pancake enthusiast so I had to try them. I got one of the traditional pancakes on the side and OH MY GOODNESS it was yummy! Melted butter, warm maple syrup, and fluffy pancake heaven. I didn't even touch my egg white sandwich(that will come home with us). Husband had smokehouse hash and it was delicious as well. The bacon and sausage were very good, and the eggs were cooked perfectly. 

Service was great, too!

went for the 1st ti;me for my son's b-day (december). did go to the new one on fairview & locust grove. very pleasant service. they gave us tons of time to prowl through the menu & did not make us feel bad for taking forever. that was awesome of the staff. we got 4 items the sushi appetizer sampler, north port & the #43 (i think)i forget the name & a california roll, . everything tasted very fresh & clean. it was very simplistic & did not wow me. i do not mind simplistic at all. it just did not blow me away. the pickled ginger was very good, the wasabi was good, did seem a darker color & a little dryer then i am used to, but tasted fine. i will not say anything was wrong or bad, because it wasn't...there just wasn't any thing to say wow about. price wasn't bad.

Local fine Italian dining. The atmosphere, service and food can't be paralleled by another business like it in the area. What's even better is how consistent and reliable it is. We are always impressed by Gino's! 

Food: EVERYTHING on the menu is excellent. From the free basket of bread & garlic oil dipping sauce you receive upon ordering, to the side salad (which is BIG, no less!) and chalk FULL of greens and fresh veggies, to the main courses, you will NOT be disappointed. Their cream sauces are creamy, their tomato sauces are rich, and the meat is always cooked to perfection. Don't mind the price... it's worth it. OH--AND THE PIZZA! The pizzas are big and topped with hearty chunks of your specified toppings. Ask for mascarpone cheese on the pizza... it takes it to a new level! DESSERT-Try the mousse! It will look small when it comes out, but it is rich and the big flakes of chocolate amp it up to a new level. Best mousse in the valley!

Drinks: They have a full bar and mix excellent cocktails. Their white Russian is especially delicious. The only issue I have with their drinks is that their hot tea is served from a tea pot, but the pot only holds one serving of tea. I had to have it refilled (which wasn't a problem) over three times while we ate in. It wouldn't have been a big deal, but each time I had to ask for a refill, which was tedious. Bigger teapots maybe? And this is just me being picky!

Atmosphere: Dark, cozy and romantic, Gino's is the perfect spot to celebrate a special occasion or take a date. Enjoy Italian music, dim lighting, and an ambiance that is truly rich!

Service: Excellent service. Gino will walk around and personally greet you and check on you while you eat. As for our servier, I typically order a la carte at restaurants, opting for "healthy" side items, and upon trying to do so at Gino's was dissuaded and our server recommended the Shrimp Maria, which is shrimp and fresh vegetables sauteed over pasta. I subbed spinach for the pasta and it was a meal that I will ABSOLUTELY return for. I'm grateful that the server had enough knowledge of the menu to suggest something comparable to what I was already going to order but was a huge step up from just a la carte sides. Kudos! 

Happy Hour Offerings: n/a

Healthy Hack: Ask for the soup of the day and order a side salad. Or try ANY pasta dish and sub spinach for the pasta.

Tips: Make a reservation!
visiting from Colorado where the Dutch Bros is non existent.... always enjoy good coffee and EXTRA friendly personal service!

It's a great place for a busy  mom that has to buy decent veggies, light bulbs , and potting soil in one stop.   They have a lot of workers, none of which smile and ask if you're finding what you need.  The sushi making guy was the friendliest in the store.   He makes a great spicy tuna roll. ( and smiles the entire time as he's making it )

I like this place, it's uptown, good pizza and good ambiance. I went  there on a non-busy time, so the wait was not bad. I ordered the calzone which was amazing and the marinara sauce even better. My kids did not like the pizza much, unfortunately their family raised them on probably Little Ceasar's and they don't have much appreciation for certain thing. But I really liked it and it had been highly recommended to me. I definitely want to go back and try different pizzas and some specials.

We have eaten here three times in the last year.  We have had good meals and good service and poor meals and poor service at this restaurant.   The service two nights ago was very polite, but that doesn't help if you have to wait an hour and a half to be served.  We watched two other parties that arrived after us be served long before our table of six was served.   My wife's Eggplant Parmesan was made of a lot of cheese and tomato sauce with almost no egg plant.  And it was too salty.  Her pasta side dish was undercooked.  My dish was the Misto Mare, with shrimp, mussels and clams over fettuccine noodles.  The shellfish we're really good and fresh.  The fettuccine was one layer thick in the bottom of the dish and undercooked.  Some might say we don't understand "Al dente", but we are both Italian.
After waiting a long time to be served, my wife went into the kitchen and talked to the cook.  We were comped desert as a result.  This was our experience in our last visit, but in the restaurant business, you are only as good as your last performance.  Improvement is needed here.  We'd hate to lose a restaurant that has had a good reputation in the past.

I'm new to Idaho. I was told that Dutch Brothers was the coffee house of choice here. This is my third visit to this location.  The girls are so friendly!  Big smiles and they got the order right. There very fast !! I'm very happy with my new coffee house ! 
Great job ! Everyone in the early morning hours at this location. 
Lm

My husband and I had such a great experience at Shanaz. We have missed the excellent food so readily available in larger metropolitan areas, and this was a great find and truly a treat. 

We started with the Jammin' Korean Tacos and just about melted in our chairs. The portion is small so each person should have their own taco. I ordered the Smothered Pork Chop. My husband said it was the best tasting chop he had ever had. The gravy excellent. My husband ordered the Honey Stung Fried Chicken Dinner. The waffle was like dessert. Our sides, corn bread and marinated cabbage were also excellent.

We were so curious about the other dishes that we spoke with the couple next to us. He ordered the Jambalaya Stuffed Peppers and loved it as well.

The atmosphere was perfect for our family too - casual and pleasant. We brought our very busy 21 month old and we felt comfortable having him there and occasionally got out of our seats to walk around and let him explore. When we arrived the waitress quickly brought him some orange slices which kept him contented while we ordered and waited for our food. They served him in a plastic cup (thank you!) and when we asked for another plate, one that wouldn't break on the tile floor, they quickly obliged. 

We will definitely go again.

Randomly came across this place on Yelp and figured I'd give it a try. I was craving a breakfast burrito and boy did it blow all my expectation out of the water. It was everything I could have asked for in a quality breakfast burrito. I just got a traditional egg, bacon, cheese, potato burrito with no sauce on top. The choice to use Monterey Jack cheese was 10/10 and the potatoes were seasoned SO well. It was a HUGE burrito for a reasonable price too. The atmosphere is cute and inviting. The wait was short on a Saturday morning. I really think this is a Meridian hidden gem. I will definitely be back whenever I need to fill my breakfast burrito craving.
Moved here from San Diego and was goin through taco shop withdraw until now. Super yummy and reminds me of home
My favorite breakfast in Boise!  Love everything here and especially the coffee in the waiting area.  Must come back as much as I can!

Long wait time for food. Food was not great. Lack of Italian feel. Prices are expensive for what you get. Small portions and very heavy wine taste in everything. Not real brick oven pizza, gas baked. I don't know that I would ever go back and I wouldn't really recommend this place to friends and family.
The food is amazing and staff are very nice.  Love that it's close too.  Everyone should try it!
Had my hair cut, colored, and a massage a few months ago.  Can't remember anyone's names.  The atmosphere is so calm and quiet there.  I can't wait to go back again.

Bear Chinese food in Boise/Meridian area. After moving here from Seattle, I was looking for an authentic Chinese restaurant. I tried a few places but they were pretty disappointing. This place, however, really satisfied my cravings. I recommend asking for the Chinese menu for the most authentic experience.

Drove from Nampa to come try the restaurant, and was closed at 4:55pm on a Thursday.  Posted hours show they open at 4:30 for dinner, but the entire restaurant is dark.  No signs posted on the door saying they'd be closed today or any notification.  Yelp! says they're open right now, but that is not the case.  I will call ahead next time so it doesn't happen again.

Decent. Not authentic but more americanized version. Which means kinda blah to me. Nothing special taste wise. But place looked clean, busy and will definitely be back to try other dishes that everyone rated so highly. Maybe I got a dud dish. 
I had the lunch menu. Sweet and sour soup had too much lemon?! Taste was not right. Was happy they had brown rice. And the almond shrimp was good. Nothing to blow your mind but all in all, ok
By far the best food, wine and atmosphere! I don't want to share this gem with anybody, but it's too good to keep a secret.

Good if you're in the area, not worth going out of your way for.  

Tastes good, fairly pricey-- a 20 oz mocha will run you $4.75 (about the same as Starbucks).  

If you're going to this location, enter heading East off of Chinden or going South on Linder.

Purchased a Newmar Bay Star motorhome from Bish's in January. The salesman, Chris Y, was very professional and knowledgeable about the products that they sell. He spent countless hours with us before we made our purchase. I also have high regards for Terry, the sales manager, who was upfront and fair with us during the negotiating process. Their service department had our coach looking great and ready on time despite very cold and snowy weather. Their pre-delivery inspection found things that needed attention that I doubt we would have ever noticed. We recently decided to purchase a much larger motorhome, and if they had the unit in stock that we wanted, we would have purchased it from them. The purchase from this other dealer, not in Idaho, has not been a pleasant experience, and we regret it!
Dank dank and some more dank. Sweet pork burrito smothered with guac and pinco, bless up  chipotle who?

If you haven't been here yet, then it is MUST!!! The food is delicious! I had the pulled pork with rice, with a side of coleslaw and mac salad, everything on my plate was absolutely yummy! My boyfriend had the kahuna burger which was good also. I'm pretty sure everything on the menu is tasty! Definitely will be going back soon. I do wish there were more locations, like maybe in Nampa! It would be a perfect place to grab lunch or quick dinner. The restaurant was nice and clean with plenty of friendly staff on hand, ready to help you.
Love my potato ole's and the breakfast burritos are very good.  Price is very reasonable and service is always quick

Pizza is really good and fairly authentic New York style but also comes with New York style prices.  Restaurant is clean and spacious and they have a really nice outdoor covered patio area (with heaters if it's chilly) and the service was good.  Decent wine selection too.

This is one of my most favorite restaurants to eat at, especially for a date night!  Where do I start?  

I recommend making a reservation if you plan to eat here on a Friday or Saturday night, as it can get very crowded.  Upon arrival, the hostesses are always polite and friendly, and that continues over to the wait staff.  I've even seen Gino himself going around to tables to make sure everyone was enjoying their meals.  Great customer service!  I went there once for a special birthday dinner so we ordered wine, and our server was very knowledgable about their wine and made a great recommendation within our price range.

The atmosphere is nice and relaxing, and both classy and casual at the same time.  I see people dressed up and I see people in jeans, and neither seem out of place.  Lighting is nice and dim.  Tables are a little close together so it can get a little loud, but not so loud that I can't hear the people I'm talking to.    

The food is awesome!  I have been here a few times and gotten a variety of dishes.  Veal shank with mushroom rissoto, chicken parmesan, and pesto gnocci were the most memorable, but I can honestly say I've enjoyed it every time.  The red sauce they use on the chicken parmesan is the best I have ever had.  To finish, I make sure to get the tiramisu, which is always moist and rich, a perfect end to the meal.

Price is about what you would expect - $15-$20 for pastas, $25-$30 for specials, so unfortunately I can't eat there too often.  But it is definitely great for special occasions!

I have been there their chicken is been rah I've got a to go order of their spaghetti and meatballs and there was paper in there meatballs I have given it a couple different tries and each time it's just been pretty bad it was really good I don't know what happen I don't know if there's a new chef or whatever but the last couple experiences have been horrible their chicken Parmesan is always wrong their chicken is like rubber

ANOTHER YUMMY BREAFASTQUEST LOCATION! My first time here and it's a tasty place for good eats! The Ham steak with breakfast is just the right size. I'm full but not uncomfortably full. The eggs, perfect sunny side up. Good wheat toast, too. And I love your hash browns. Great coffee! Excellent table service.
Yummy family owned breakfast place. Portions are a good size. I probably could have shared and I eat a lot. Great flavor. Gets busy for a good reason. Will be back when we come back to town for sure.
If I had my choice of Mexican it be here. Sweet pork best. No four stars as some servers are stingy on meat. Always ask for more.

I'm not sure why Shige has so many negative ratings. Given I don't eat fish, I can't really comment on that aspect, but as far as their vegetables and rice goes, everything is very fresh! We went in a little over a week ago (although I'd consider myself somewhat of a regular) because I told my sister who was visiting from out of town about how good it was. Oscar was AMAZING and made us four different kinds of vegetarian rolls, all of which were extremely delicious. He totally deserves a red coat instead of a black one!!! 

The pricing was very reasonable (4 rolls, 2 large bottles of Kirin and a Heineken was only ~$35 before tip). Considering it fed three of us pretty well, that's a bargain in my opinion, especially for such delicious food. They flavor the rice here and I think that's what makes it such a great vegetarian option (but really, in general, I think most people would appreciate the extra flavor). ALSO, sometimes the rolls can be a little loose, but Oscar did an amazing job of rolling them tight so the insides weren't spilling out. I'll continue to go back and anyone on the fence should come give it a try if you haven't already - or don't, more sushi for me :)

By far the best pizza outside of Italy that we have ever tasted! The pizza Margherita is authentic!
The service we had was impressive!  We will make this our pizza place from now on! Tuesday is 1/2 off wine day!

I wish I could give a good review. Never got a chance to try the food. Almost two hours of waiting after being seated was a little long wait. Arrived at 4:30, placed order at 4:50, and left with no food at 6:15. Takeout orders are apparently the priority. Staff looked dazed and confused. People seated after my family began receiving food and they had larger parties. Sorry Red Pavilion but you only get one chance to impress me. Not impressed.

As good as it gets! These people are the best! Always going above and beyond. A car part was late on it's warranty by one month and one day and Sarah called the parts dealership and worked it out for me. Can't thank you guys enough! They're getting rave reviews from me and I'm sending everyone I know over to them.
Thanks again!

Ate here for the fist time last night.  It was a Monday evening so it wasn't busy.  Service was timely, friendly and efficient.  The food was pretty good.  Came out hot!  I had the crab and shrimp pasta.... It was decent the sauce was kinda bland.  We also had the penne sausage, it was also lacking something.  We definitely enjoyed out visit and will return again to explore the menu further.
We ate here while visiting from out of town. Took a chance based on the Yelp reviews, and we are so glad we did! The food was fantastic, and the service was terrific.

I had to put my little baby to sleep there the other day. I wanted to say how much I appreciate your doctors and assistants kindness through the whole ordeal. 
I was absolutely devastated and I could tell the doctor and assistant that were with me were very sympathetic and understanding. 
Even though the euthanasia cost some money, they didn't seem focused on the money and more on the comfort of my angels passing and extending a generous amount of comfort to me and my loss. 
And just today I got a card signed by the doctor. It's a very sweet gesture. And I love how they understand how hard the loss of a pet is. I can't wait to go pick up my clay paw print of Andre. Although my heart is broken, I couldn't of asked for a better place and way for my beloved Andre to move on. 
Thank you, Intermountain Pet Hospital. You aren't just a business seeking money. You have very nice people who can relate to the worst part of having animals.
Sushi was below average and Ramen was horrible.  Sushi chef could not understand me when asked about different kinds of sushi available.  Did not know what Scottish Salmon or Bluefin Tuna were.

Finally Chinese food in Meridian/Boise worth five stars!!! Great food and service in a clean place! We will definitely be back! Update: We have brought others here and also ordered takeout all of which has been equally delicious!
Another great haircut! We decided to go a little shorter and it still looks awesome, highly recommend!

Our pups LOVE this place! My husband says "You wanna go play with the other pups today?" and the girls go bonkers! I love the doggy cam so I can look in on them from my phone and the staff is superb. Great place to take your fur baby for some fun!

Good quality pizza. Service was fast and attentive. Would go back if ever in the area (which I probably won't be). 
If you're stuck out in the middle of nowhere (aka Meridian, ID). EAT HERE!
Nothing short of amazing. Way better than Panda Express.. I ordered the Mongolian beef and was blown away. I wish they delivered!

If you're looking for authentic, cheap takeout, this is the place. The prices are ridiculous and portions are even better. Get the combination plates where you can choose "2 from above one from below" kind of deal and you won't be disappointed.

The food was a little overly fried, but it's honestly what you kind of have to expect from a place like this. 

I recommend the pork fried rice and sweet and sour chicken. The curry chicken noodle dish is very good as well.

First impression busy area, parking is really frustrating with people who don't know where they are going and are stopping in the middle of the road. Once I got in, place was packed for a Wednesday and waited for someone to greet me. The wait wasn't too bad, 10 min. Once I got seated, I was greeted, I kind of felt like I was being rushed as I got my menu and was asked if I was ready to order before I even looked. Once I ordered I kind just did some observations, my waitress never came back to see how I was doin until my food got to me. I noticed this one waitress kept goin to her tables and it seemed like she had more tables than my waitress. I thought she did a wonderful job and being engaged with her customers. I order the country fried steak with the potatoes. Also a side of bacon and wheat toast. Toast was really good and loved that they had fresh jam, two different types as a matter of fact. One was sweeter than the other, can't remember which one. The bacon was crispy but I wish it was thicker and tasted more burnt. The potatoes was my most disappointing part was that it was fried and I was hoping for more of a roasted breakfast feel for potatoes. I should of just got hash browns instead. My country fried steak was pretty good especially with the gravy. I wouldn't mind ordering that again. I also got orange juice and it was really sweet. Really surprising that it was so sweet but good. Kind of weird to me this place felt hidden since it is almost right across from the griddle. I would try this again and try something different. One thing is, you won't be leaving this place hungry so bring an appetite!

Great coffee. Great Service. Really good food. 

This is my third visit. Each time my husbands has had the chicken fried steak with his breakfast. The first time was outstanding, tender and flavorful. The second time was bland but tender. The third times was tasty but tough. So, hit and miss on the food.

I have tried something different at each visit, so I do not have the comparison level that my hubby had. I ordered the corned beef hash on my first visit. The best I've ever had. Second time was the stuffed french toast. The best I've ever had. The third time I had the hash brown bowl. Good, but over-cooked. The over-easy eggs were well done. The cheese was burnt on the edges, and the hashbrowns were slightly blackened. Even my husband's english muffin was slightly blackened. (now I'm thinking maybe the chef was rushed, hence the tough steak and over-cooked everything. But, hey, everyone has an off day.

Went back today. Greatest stuffed french toast I've EVER had. With fresh peaches! 

This place jsut keeps getting better and better!

Thanks to the Yelpers before me, I was convinced to try this place for breakfast.  

It was an easy find and on my way to the office.  Walked into a very clean place with friendly staff.  

After reviewing the menu I decided to get me the Breakfast for Beginners with sausage.

My breakfast was out pippin' hot from the kitchen.  I always dive into the potatoes first and I was happy.  It was crispy on the outside and soft on the inside.  Next I took some eggs with the sausage.  Wow, the sausage was so good , it had the right amount of seasoning and I couldn't stop eating it.  Everything else was good.  The best part was the portion of the dish, it reminded me of Hash House A Go Go...huge portion.

The next time I'm in Meridian this will be a definite stop for me.
Great place to get to know people. Very good staff that's friendly and there for the customers. The food is a step up from typical bar food.
it's a great Red Robin. lots of options on the fries, sides, sauces & burgers. easy to go dairy-free, veg or vegan. service here is hit or miss on timeliness & attentiveness but ALWAYS FRIENDLY. :D

Convenient location in The Village in Meridian. I haven't had any issues with parking, but I usually go on a weeknight or early Saturday. The staff is friendly. Belinda cut my hair and listened to what I wanted and made some suggestions.I was happy with the result.

Terrible customer service. They don't seem to have a clue what's going on with your account, don't offer respectable resolutions, and then don't follow through with what they promised. Do your banking elsewhere, with a company that is better organized and can provide better customer service.

I just got a puppy a week ago (Bento) and this is my first time owning a puppy so new mama fear is in the back of my mind constantly. I had noticed that he and a soft lump on his tummy, what I googled said it was an Umbilical Chord Hernia. I contacted River City via Yelp and they answered me within the hour! When I finally had a chance to call them they knew who I was and what I was calling about and they had informed me that they had saved a spot for me to bring Bento in the very next day! How thoughtful was that!? The staff immediately fell in love with Bento the moment he walked in and they showed us the doggy daycare and let Bento meet one of the smaller dogs. Bento took to them quickly as well, giving each of the staff well deserved puppy breath kisses! When we went into our exam room our Tech was so loving a gentle with him he let her do her exa, with little complaint, the worst part for him was the stethoscope - definitely thought it would've been the thermometer! He was such a good boy, he met Dr. Harsch who was also very gentle and caring toward Bento and gave him his first shot with ease. He also explained the Hernia issue so that I could understand it for Bento's health, he didn't talk down to me which is refreshing and beneficial for a doctor and patient relationship! Bento and I can't wait to go back for his next appointment in 3 weeks, Thank You River City Vet for loving on my pup as much as I do!
Great selection of breakfast options.  The service was excellent and my kids ate all their food.  The omelette was filling and the strawberry jam was the best!

caesar salad with extra parmesan. crazy good. 

and the pepperoni pizza is totally on point. no grimaldi's quite lives up to the original - under the brooklyn bridge, but they're still amazing. this location is no exception.

Very good food. Next time we will order it spicy because that's how we like it. We enjoyed Spicy Mandarin Chicken, Crown of Brocolli (beef), and Flaming Boar (pork). None were spicy to us, very mild. Loved the soup, appetizer, entree combo option. We will be back

Terrible service. Waited at least 20 minutes without even a greeting. Didn't even get the chance to try the food.  We got up and left. So bummed as this is a very nice location and the establishment is beautiful on the inside.

I love this place! I recently moved here from Santa Barbara and have been missing really good authentic fast Mexican food..... I found My Place! Friendly staff, prompt service and super delicious food.  I especially love the salsa/condiment bar!

This Dutch Bros is terrible! The people they hire at this location do not listen to your order and are more concerned with getting back to their conversation you rudely interrupted by wanting to give them $7 for coffee. I love Dutch Bros coffee but this location has some of the worst customer service I have ever experienced.

Food was decent but the atmosphere and friendliness was off the charts. I had the ribeye special and it was good but I had to ask for steak sauce-so not great. The wine was delicious and I enjoyed my time here thoroughly.

Love Gino's.  Gino is a great man and is almost always there to greet you and say hi.  Food is a little pricey for Italian, but when its served on time and its good quality its worth it.  I've had a few visits where quality and service was below average, but my guess this is simply a result of a employee who was only there a short time as Gino simply won't put up with poor service and poor quality food.  I love the atmosphere of the place and in NW Meridian it is the go to for a full service dinner meal.   Patio in summer is nice too and is situated to block the late afternoon sun.  Bar is really too small to be called a bar, but is quaint and nice to sit at on a slow night.  
Gino keep it up and hold your staff accountable and keep the bar raised high from them.
Recently moved to the area and tried two other salons with disappointing to "meh" results. Found Jessica at SB Salon based on other yelp reviews and am very pleased! Jessica rocks!

Third time coming here, never again. Drink service was terrible and I walked up to the counter to pay since we never got a drink refill or a ticket. Wasabi was brown and crusty, lots of empty boats. We ordered a roll and ate off the meager selection of boats. Left $50 poorer and still hungry. One highlight was the taco (octopus) salad. Grabbed several plates of that.

I dined in with my mom for a late night dinner. I had the salmon, my mom had a wedge salad, and some wine. Both meals were absolutely delicious. I love lemon on my seafood, so I asked our waiter, Dylan, for some extra lemons, and let me tell you, Dylan gave me a heaping amount of lemons. Dylan really went above and beyond every request we had. After our meal, we enjoyed a nice conversation with Dylan. Such a nice young man who deserves a raise or a 100% tip every time. I will definitely be back. The manager even stopped by to ask how our meal was!
Make sure to ask for Dylan!!!!!!! Dylan was awesome.
I love Grimaldis! I love the coal fired pizza, the atmosphere, and the dough they give kids to play with while they wait!

The pizza is always good but this location has consistently screwed up on their pickup times for pizza. They always blame the phone person or the kitchen or someone else but they can never get their act together. They tried saying they need to add an extra 10 minutes to my original  time but I was already 10 minutes past that, when I pointed that out they had no excuse other than they're same lame answer somebody else messed up. The manager never take responsibility they need to clean up their system but this is been a constant problem and they're going to lose my business.
What a wonderful surprise!! The quality of the fish was spectacular. The menu was a nice range for covering folks who don't eat sushi. The sushi was great!!
Yummy breakfast choices, everything nice and fresh. Good pricing, friendly good service.
Moe Joe's has some spectacular breakfast choices. My wife had heard about them from a coworker, and we decided to give them a try. We've gone back twice. Delicious.

I had to edit my review after our last rrip here.  The food was awesome as usual, but the service left a bit to be desired.  The food should not be served before you are given any silverware with which to attck it.  My husband commented taht his beers were not ice cold as he remembered them to be.  What happened Dave??

Strap on the feed bag, you won;t walk away hungry.  Their food is the closest to the BBQ I'd get when I was in Texas.  The variety of meats, and sauces makes each trip a new experience.  Their corn bread is awesome, so are the numerous sides from which to choose.  My husband greatly enjoys the 22 oz beer option.

Visiting family in Meridian, one can imagine the numerous circumstances (and freezing temperatures) that would warrant a last-minute dash for a takeout order minutes before closing time. Such was our experience. We literally made it there right before closing to pick up our order, and the entire staff was very friendly and didn't make us feel unwanted at all. We grabbed our food and took it home. I really enjoyed the wings, but there was no promised ranch dressing to dip them in - which I'd chalk up to our tardy pickup. The pizza itself was really good and I'd love to come back for their buffet next time we're in town. Recommended!

We ate dinner here last night.  The service was good. Our server was friendly and efficient. The portion size was good.  I really enjoyed the chicken MooGoo. It was flavorful without being too salty or having too much garlic. I'd definately eat here again.
Very clean, good place to stay fo the night. RVS everywhere, no real private space, dog area is very small, but very friendly staff and the park was very clean

This was the best Chinese meal we've had in a long time. I grew up in Los Angeles and lived in San Francisco and have eaten in a lot of Chinese restaurants. It's rare to find a good one, but this one makes it. The menu is small and leans toward spicy dished, but they will make them mild. The meat is good quality and a good amount. The dishes are complex and the sauce is just right. We had a combination meal at the back of the menu which included soup, spring roll, and entree for 26 bucks for 2. Also, no MSG. Jean was a wonderful waitress who moved here from China 5 years ago. She was fun to talk to, efficient, and helpful. Great place
Best Thai food in the valley.  Their Pad Thai is fantastic and that alone is worth the trip.  But make sure to save room for their sticky sweet rice.  Best I've ever had.

Great place!

This is my first night out of three nights and I am already impressed! 
To start they paid the cab from the aiport to here, then they allowed me to check-in early. Right after, they treated me to a decent breakfast. They have a decent complimentary breakfast. Great service. Very nice people!!!

We frequent this place regularly, as it is very close to our home. The staff has always been kind and inviting, and the food is amazing! My personal favorite is their Eggs Benedict(all varieties!). They use a chipotle hollandaise sauce that is out of this world! My husband loves their hashes, and has yet to find a variety he doesn't like. If you are looking for an excellent place to get breakfast, check this place out!
*** Note to staff and owners: I apologize a MILLION times for getting you mixed up with that other establishment. I'm not sure how that even happened!! Thank you for reaching out so that I could fix that situation. Please don't hate us, because we LOVE you. Also, sorry I hadn't written this review before, I'm surprised that I hadn't! You guys are truly the best!

Waitress was very energetic but brought us our salad with the wrong salad dressing but only checked on us once ( it was not a busy night as it was a Tuesday ) before we asked for the check. Pizza was good but not great as it was undercooked and the bottom was not crisp. No need for us to go back after our first experience there.

Great food! Three of us had very different orders. Biscuits and gravy, best I've ever had, including family homemade. Bare burrito, delicious and healthy. Chicken enchilada stackers, shows off the cooks expertise. Jalapeno berry pancake for dessert, so delicious! Don't miss this gem! Closes at 2pm!

Food, service, Gino coming by the tables, atmosphere was great! We will definitely be back!!

Ordered the Oso Bucco, fettuccini with sausage, stuffed meatball mushrooms, and cannoli! Cannoli was to die for, Oso was very good but had alittle too much red sauce over it, Alfredo wasn't as rich as i would have liked but still good. 
Menu was very large and we plan to go back for many more selections.

Service was good.  Food was very disappointing.  The tomato bruschetta had a very distinctive fish taste, not sure why since it's just tomatoes, garlic and basil.  The Alfredo was very bland, ribeye tough as leather on a medium rare request.  The food is served extremely fast and makes one believe all of it is either warmed up or microwaved.   We will not be back, as we both got sick after.
Delicious lunch! I had the potstickers and hot and sour soup. The wait staff were nice. The food is good and hot and fast. Rice was perfect!

What a packed place! We went on a Sunday and waited about an hour for a seat. It was nice out so we enjoyed sun bathing. Once we got seated, the service was great and we had our food in less than 15 minute after ordering!  Portions are huge so come hungry!
Love love love. I always judge a place by their eggs benny and this is by far one of the best I've had. #eggsbennyexpert
Nope... Not a fan. Food is average, restaurant is average, service is average and just not sure why you would pick this place with all the other options out there.

I frequent this place because it's across the street from where I work. Great food, great prices. Seniors I've spoken with, sharing our dining experiences, have agreed with me, adding that the senior discount offered is part of what keeps them coming back, in addition to the quality of offerings and excellent service. For under $8, you can have the "all-you-can-eat" breakfast buffet or lunch/dinner soup and salad bar which includes a baked potato bar and ice cream sundae bar. The breakfast buffet is a weekday offering, from opening to 11 A.M.; there's a weekend brunch buffet offered for just under $10. All food, including fruits and vegetables, are always fresh and abundant. Not a bad experience yet.
Famous Daves, a place we have eaten at dozens of times, the service tonight was poor. No chips, no water refills. Disappointment.
Had lunch here yesterday. Great food and great place to enjoy a meal with friends or family. Will be back again soon for dinner and a few good beers.
So good! Nice portions, yummy food, and awesome service. I had a breakfast burrito with sausage gravy. It was amazing.

Good Chinese Food Restaurant.  Good Service, friendly people and the food is consistent and good.

I will often have the beef broccoli, cashew chicken, mandarin chicken, and/or today I had the Sour and Spicy Orange Chicken.  It was very good!

Maybe you will hate it, but maybe you will like it, I recommend trying it!
Really good food here. I got a burger with sweet potato fries and could not have been happier with it. Staff is very friendly and helpful. The restaurant is well kept and clean.

My favorite restaurant of all time. I have been eating there for years and have never had a bad meal.  Gino is a third generation restauranteer from Naples Italy. He has Americanized the menu a bit, but not as much as other  wannabee Italian restaurants.

The food is spectacular.  If in the mood for steak, the Filetto with Black Truffle Risotto is awesome. The Boar Shank rates very high.  My personal favorite is the Sausage Rapini (but you have to like Rapini!). Gino makes his own sausage! Don't miss the Tiramisu for dessert!

The wait staff is well trained and friendly, they have an excellent wine list. 

I choose Gino's Grill over Gino's as Gino usually cooks on that side (they are right next to each other, slightly different menus, but you can order from the other menu at either place).
Our large group ate here last night. The service we received was excellent. Our server was Alicia. She was a kick in the pants!  The food was good but the service made it worth the trip.
Love Wingers ! Annie is absolutely incredible and really makes the experience . We come to wingers because of her!!

We ordered take out from there tonight. Pizza was good but it didn't taste like there was any sauce. Veggie was good, lots of garlic and cheese and lots of veggies, didn't taste like there was any sauce on it but overall good flavor. The other pizza as pepperoni sausage and mushroom and slightly lacked some toppings, slightly scarce. For two large pizzas they only gave two pepper packets and two Parmesan packets, certainly not enough.
Good food, very attentive service - our coffee cups stayed topped up!  Large portions, fresh ingredients. We had about a 20 minute wait on Sunday morning.

Tried again, I don't know why... i warned the people I was with but they insisted I was wrong. now they know I was not;    this place is just nasty. no one should have to pay for this kind of service and if you think this is quality food.  try a TV Dinner from wally world . I am thinking you will love it.
   I can't even understand how this place has a following at all. the foods just not good.. del taco is right across the parking lot, You will have a way better meal at that place than this one. I wonder if all the los Betos are the same.

This was our first Chinese restaurant in Idaho so, maybe compared to the others, this is stellar. Let's keep it simple and break it down into pros and cons. 

PROS: Ready quickly and the chicken was tasty and the portion was decent. 

CONS: The soup was in a shockingly tiny container. Literally four spoonfuls. The "egg roll" was bland and almost hollow because there was so little filling.  We got a spicy and a medium version of the same dish which was not marked on the box. We had no idea which was which until halfway through.

I'd consider trying again but I'd skip the combo plate.

Always absolutely enchanted with each dish! Gnocchi is like fluffy soft pillows of deliciousness, any type of shank is awesome, the mushroom risotto is divine, lasagna di mare is fantastic and of course any pasta is great! Gino himself comes around making sure everyone is happy and taken care of and enjoying their meal. If you want great Italian, look no further!

Do not buy into Red Robin's stupid loyalty program. You are supposed to receive a free burger in the month of your birthday. I had signed up for this loyalty program and ordered a burger thinking it would be free, but I guess since I had not updated my profile settings, the staff said I would have to wait 24 hours until I could redeem it and charged me. The manager and server were unhelpful. I was at Red Robin then and had no plans on coming back later in the month. With this lousy customer service Red Robin can keep their stupid birthday rewards as I have no plans on coming back.

I have been here a couple times and both times I was pleasantly surprised! The food is very fresh and I love the variety of options offered. And while it is a little pricey, I am definitely willing to pay a little extra for fresh ingredients. The pizza is my favorite, so full of flavor and the crust is amazing! One thing I did notice was there was only one girl working so it did take a little long to get all our food as she had to simultaneously make it and take other orders. I will definitely be back!
Our new favorite!! Just close your eyes and point at the menu and whatever it is will be awesome! Very unique and extremely friendly. The burger may be the best in the Valley!!

Great service. Jack and Justin both went above and beyond expectations to help me with my new iPhone. Setting it up, syncing and answering my novice questions. All this without making me feel like a techno-idiot. Will be doing all my AT&T ordering with them
This is a favorite with the family.  Best pizza in town with great service and consistent quality.
This place was delicious! Service was speedy and pleasant. Yummy hash browns and sausage!

The staff-Amazing...Food-Amazing...Drinks-Amazing...Lanes-Amazing...if you're  looking for a good time on a budget this is the place to go. Whether you're  going out on a date or taking the family out for some good times this is the best place in town.
Always a sure bet to find things you'll love.  From clothes to shoes to accessories.  Their displays are always adorable and they only sell great brands and the store is organized so well.

Great Breakfast Buffet!!!  We love to come here with the kids!  The wait staff is very friendly and helpful. The breakfast buffet is great, well stocked and lots of variety. We have been here early in the morning and later in the morning and the Buffet is always stocked and hot!!

By far the best pizza outside of Italy that we have ever tasted! The pizza Margherita is authentic!
The service we had was impressive!  We will make this our pizza place from now on! Tuesday is 1/2 off wine day!

Rich makes this store great.  Every time I have gone in there he is awesome and super helpful.  I had a ton of questions about my bill and he lowered it about $50.  So not only was he helpful, but he worked at making another satisfied customer.  Can not say enough good things about him.

I'd give it a 3/5 on sushi taste and a 4/5 on service. I tried two different sushi samplers. On a few rolls the sauce was overpowering of the flavor of the different roll components. For the sashimi, the fish tasted fresh and clean. I've tried every sushi place in Boise and would put this one at number 4. The other positive thing is that there is a hibachi menu for non-sushi lovers.

Omg this place is a hidden gem. What I mean by this is the location is a little hard to see from the street. A coworker brought me some food to go and it was absolutely delicious. I decided to go back the next day and take a date. I wish they had more locations because I'm only visiting Idaho right now. The menu is full of breakfast options you don't find at other restaurants. The serving sizes are large enough to fill you up good and every bite is delicious. We were served by Hannah she seemed to really enjoy her work which made the experience really good. They have different flavor mimosas so you can even enjoy an adult beverage with your breakfast. I told Hannah I wished they had more locations so I could share this experience with others back home. They have indoor and outdoor seating. The atmosphere is nice but it's really the food you have to try. If you want to try something different for breakfast give this place a try your tastebuds will thank you.
Fresh orange juice is amazing and the breakfast is great.  Everyone is friendly and I highly recommend this place for breakfast.

Had the traditional eggs Benedict with a side of fruit, fantastic!!!!  The fruit bowl was strawberries , raspberries and blueberries.  Most places will serve you some unripe melon. 

I will absolutely be going back.

Very good italian food in Meridian, ID

Good ambience and fast service, the food was standard fair but special enough and delicious. Took my wife for our anniversary and we both had a wonderful time.
Awesome traditional Mexican food. Just as fast as Taco Bell or Del Taco and more authentic than most local sit-down restaurants. You can't go wrong with this place. The Idaho Burrito is epic!!!

I couldn't have asked for a better experience. This was the first time I had to take my dog to a Vet and I was scared of going somewhere she would have just been a patient. But not here. Everyone treated her like a queen. They loved her, took time to care for her and explain to me everything that was going on. 24hrs after leaving I was a little concerned with her progress so I called and I spoke with a nurse who put my mind at ease. Every person we encountered here was kind, loving, and helpful. We are so grateful for the kind souls and loving people at this wonderful River City Veterinary Hospital. Thank you all who cared for my little Roxy!

I went in recently with my fiance and we both had the fiesta hash, I gave 2 stars because the service was slow and both our meals came out cold, and the prices are high, I like that they had some unique items on the menu, the waitress was very friendly I'll give them that, but it's hard to enjoy a cold over priced meal. I may try them again when I'm feeling a little rich.

Good food over priced. 2.50 for soda if there's a next time I'll drink water. But maybe consider pricing toppings based on what their going on instead of a flat rate. Because the amount going on a personal or a small is less than on a large. Doesn't make sense.
Love this quaint Italian restaurant with friendly staff great food and you just gotta go there if you live anyplace near Meridian ID.  Outdoor seating in good weather.
Don't want to be sued.  Not saying much just giving one star in my opinion based on my experience.

The first time we went to Gino's, not long after they opened, our experience was amazing. This week we were really disappointed. The menu seems to be far less interesting (everything is pasta in red sauce) and the quality of the food was just ok. Our service was very good, but having remembered the menu and our dishes as superb, I'm not sure what's happened. I don't think we'll be back.
Amazing pasta!!  Great restaurant.  Gino even spoke Italian to me when I asked him.  :)
What a great meal. The server was fun & gracious. The motif relaxing. The experience was a big surprise. We will return to Ginos soon.

Quick service, I had a screw in my tire and they fixed it very quickly for free. I called ten minutes before showing up and they didn't make me wait at all. Much appreciated and I'll definitely return for any tire needs that come up.

We went for lunch and the ambiance was nice and the food was priced well. We tried the Mongolian beef and Kung pao chicken. The flavor of the food was great but everything was a bit oily. We also had some lettuce wraps and came to the same conclusion. We might try it again sometime to see if maybe the kitchen was just being a bit heavy handed with the oil today...
Not fresh at all they took the juice that was already made out of the fridge. The server was rude. Overall I would not recommend this place.

The food is good no doubt about it.  I always like to get combo platters to try everything and have yet to be dissapointed.   75 bucks for a family of 4 though...this usually makes me go down the street to Goodwood or even further to Eagle.  I was born and raised in Texas and if BBQ is going to be expensive it better be better than just good.

5 star food like holy wow mind blowing still recovering from how delicious. Very refreshing to be reminded food could be that good. I got the smokehouse hash but all of the different hash varieties looked amazing. Can't emphasize enough how good the food was. 2 star service though :/ Totally worth the food though and definitely won't keep me from coming back.

We always give an eatery a "second chance" because things just happen in the restaurant world.  But sorry Moe Joe's...unacceptable BOTH times having to wait 30-40 minutes when there are only 4 or 5 tables being served DURING THE WEEK.  The wait staff seems more concerned with side work than keeping your coffee cup filled and the cook had to be "fought with" (as explained by our waitress) over a side of toast because it wasn't included on that particular menu item even though I "paid for the side order".  I sent an email to the owner because that is how you strive to improve your business but losing customers is apparently not of importance to the owner enough to bother with a reply.

Definitely the best coffee I've had in Idaho! The atmosphere is great for hanging out with friends, doing some homework, and even for business meetings. The staff is very helpful and friendly and they definitely will have my business from this point on!

Great food.
A bit of a wait but worth it!
Maybe call ahead.
I'd suggest the chicken fried steak.

Classic Boise pizza restaurant. Everyone that ever eats pizza here falls in love with it. A little bit more expensive then your typical pizza hutt or dominos but is worth it. Love the cheese covered bread sticks. There cheap and you can order 12 or 24. Few games for the kids which is nice but they are old.

We had a big event planned for our daughter and did not want to leave our Siberian Husky alone for the whole day and night.  We looked into several boarding places and decided to reach out to Camp Bow Wow.  The staff is very friendly and being that this was our first time boarding, we had a lot of questions.  Our husky had to interview. We prepped me in front of a panel and suggested that he write his resume in Calibri font 11.   Unfortunately, some interviewees still use Wingdings and Comic Sans Serif.  We took him to his interview and left him there for three hours. We did tour the facilities and it is very clean and organized.  The staff is very attentive and professional.  We picked up our husky and he just didn't seem right. Not sure what happened as we we watched on the cam several times during the 3 hours but did not see anything.  His trademark curled tail was not up and seemed sensitive.  All of this passed within a couple of days and when the Camp called, I did express my concerns and worries.  That faithful day for our event came and we dropped him off early Saturday morning.  He was excited to go and seemed to have a great time playing with 7 other Huskys throughout the day. We were able to check on him with the app.  On Sunday afternoon, we picked him up and he was fine. There was no issues with the tail as it was curled and he was is regular playful self.  We trust Camp Bow Wow Meridian with our Husky and have recommended them for other friends and neighbors.
