If you have any questions, concerns about your pet, please feel free to discuss it with them as we found them to be very open and honest.

I'm happy to pile on the accolades here. All the good stuff reported by Michele R, Carl Y, and others goes for us too. The food we had was not only better than any other place we've tried in the area, it's better than some of our old regular haunts back east. Everything tasted freshly made, not syrupy-sweet or greasy. The decor is simple, but clean and tasteful (with no TVs!). 

Is it truly authentic? How the hell would I know? It tastes good, we're happy, and this is now our go-to Chinese place. 

And yet. Note the missing star. That's due to a few quibbles that had nothing to do with the quality of the food. They are not major and are easily addressed, but meanwhile are enough to shoot down that fifth star. (If I had a half-star to give, it would be yours, RP!) So, perfection being the elusive beast it is, we must offer these comments.

Here's the main question I have for management: Is there an employee bonus system based on how quickly you can get patrons out the door? We were barely seated (in fact, we may have still been in the parking lot) when the server asked for drink orders. Sure, but first you have to tell us what you have. A little chalkboard appeared with some beer listed. A small but decent selection. But we like wine and while we weren't expecting a sommelier, we did expect a little more choice than "red or white." But hey, no big deal, wife gets the mystery white, I take a beer. (An aside, are there "Wine Drinkers Matter" t-shirts?) We had to ask twice for water.

The friendly server guided us expertly through the menu and took our dinner order (before the drinks arrived). The first courses arrived within moments, it seemed, but we were hungry so that was okay. What was not okay was the entrees arriving about 3 bites into the appetizers. And barely halfway through the entrees came the check. Well, at least she didn't hover waiting for the cash, which we've seen in some places. Anyway, a suggestion for management: if people stay longer, they might buy more, say another round. More food. It's not like there was a line outside the door. We were in and out in 30 minutes. Everything was delicious, but if we only had time for a drive-thru, we would have gone to a drive-thru. I mean, why bother to have seats?

Speaking of seats. If you're tall, don't get a booth. Uncomfortable and tight. Coach-on-United tight. Go for a table.

That's it really. Nothing that would keep us from going back. We'll wear our new t-shirts next time, take a table, and if the servers don't get in better sync with the kitchen, we'll jussssttt orrrrrrder moooooore slowwwwly.

The worst hotel experience ever!!!! Do not stay there.  Customer service is horrific,very unprofessional and incompitant. Very disappointing and ruined a good vacation. We we're checked into the wrong room Number somehow and lost in the system they thought that somebody was in a room without pain and called the police while coming back from dinner three police officers meant I was thinking that we had not paid for room it was the most her thick and embarrassing experience I've ever had do not waste your time or money and save yourself embarrassment

Love this place! The special today was Chicken fried Porkchops! It was to die for! And the potatoes were perfectly crunchy .
I couldn't decide Between the REAL corned beef hash or the cream cheese stuffed pancakes with Jalapeño Berry syrup.... But guess what? The waitress worked with me and I ordered the CBH with the pancake I wanted instead of toast with a VERY reasonable add on price. This is definitely my new favorite breakfast joint. 
Mary, our waitress was wonderful and so was our entire experience.

This was by far the best sushi restaurant I have been to. They were not only very hospitable but generous with their portions, The presentation amazing, and the conversation with the sushi chef fantastic! They treated us like royalty. I would go back again in a heartbeat because it was by far the best restaurant I have been to. And I am a connoisseur of sushi!  A great place to go to!!!

So my wife and I made a reservation at Gino's for my 30th birthday on the 19th of June for the patio. They were really awesome though the whole process from making the reservation to the actual day of the party. 
On the day of the party we showed up 5 minutes early and they took us right in and sat us at our table, there were about 20 of us. We brought an ice cream cake and they put it in the freezer wile the party happened. We had our appetizers, drinks, and main courses and they were all delicious. I had the veil which was bomdigity! Our drinks never got low and our server was absolutely amazing. Overall the party was a success! Thank you Gino's for making this day so perfect! I would recommend they establishment to anyone. They food is awesome, they drinks are a little spendy, but  the atmosphere is perfect and intimate. At the end of the night our waiter brought out the cake, everyone sang happy birthday, and the waiter sliced up the cake. An epic conclusion to and unforgettable night. Thanks again Gino's!!!

Waited to be seated.  Waited to be acknowledged. The waitress after 8 minutes had not made an appearance. No water.  Told manager that we were leaving and no response. There were only two other tables waiting for their order.

stunned, within a month of opening, owner has the most successful knit night in town, and kicks the thursday night knitters out.  says she only wants to cater to new knitters on knit night.  then the next day back pedals to SOME people, but not others, so clearly, she wants to hand pick who comes to her shop on knit night, and who doesn't.  we're welcome to come shop on other days, but not come knit on her published open knit night.  high school anyone?  geesh,

Got a coupon so decided to give it a try.  Had the rice bowls, steak, chicken and pork. My favorite was the pork-very very good.  Very surprised and delighted with their food.  Large portions and the rice was perfect .  My 12yr loved it-he had the noodles which I tried and liked.  I appreciated Rumbi putting the sauce in a cup on the side (not drowning the meal in it). Not sure if its a chain but I will return and gladly pay full price.
Authentic Italian  food, service and atmosphere is great! One of the best restaurants around! Highly recommend!

I'm rating this for both my husband and I.  Our one, and only complaint would be, Moe Joe's is in need of more booths!
Excellent food & service!!! Today we arrived a few minutes before closing. The waitresses and staff were as pleasant, as if, we were their first customers of the day!  
I had the same thing I always do...scrambled eggs topped w/cheese, and GF pancakes.  Their gluten free pancakes are the best around, and I've tried more than a few places.  The syrup is always heated.  $6.99 (plus $2-GF)
My husband ordered The Farmhouse.  Homemade biscuits topped w/2 sausage, 2 fried eggs, covered with sausage gravy and their house potatoes. $8.99
Don't want to leave the chefs out of this....everything cooked to perfection. Thank you.
If you want ambience, this is not the place to impress a date.  If you want fabulous food at a reasonable price...What are you waiting for?  Get in the car and GO!!!
This was the best tire buying experience, ever.  In and out, fast and easy.  Courteous and no up-sell!  Just what I needed.  Highly recommend this place over all others.
Sooo good! We discovered this place by accident when we moved here a year ago!!! Would definitely recommend it!

I was expecting a lot more when I came here based on all the reviews. The place looked closed and fairly run down. The food was fairly decent. I had a baked ziti which tasted very fresh but it could have been baked more with a bit more cheese and less mushrooms. You could really tell they used fresh herbs and the basil flavor was real good. Overall I would go here again to try the lasagna and baked lentil dish, but I can't give it a 5 star rating.

Like everyone seems to agree, the service sucks.  seems to me this is enough to make it bad. 
  i mean, if they can't muster the energy to be great customer service people, what do you think they are doing to the food? 

  I have eaten better food at a taco truck. in this place I feel like the people are lazy and it made me wonder just how lazy they are about cooking this stuff up and how much they really care about what I ordered and cleanliness.    I do not like that feeling.
Our favorite delivery! Food is always good with generous portions, hubby loved the leftovers.
Really loved this place. Great service and fantastic food (I personally have had the Chicken Parm and their New York Pizza). I love when Italian places have great appetizer bread, too.
Had a great time! My kids can't stop talking about how much fun they had. Staff was friendly. Thanks for the memories.

Great new location! The food was delicious and the fish fresh as usual.  Had the Super Dragon, Jason, Crazy Dancer and Treasure Valley rolls along with Mix Poki, and miso & edamame.  Everything was flavorful, beautiful, and Yummy! Our server was super friendly and helpful. So happy to have this closer site, cant wait to come back.

Challenging company to work with
We contracted in November 2012 with Pristine Pools to remodel our backyard pool deck, automatic pool cover vault and coping.  The project was estimated to be completed in 3 months.  At their request, due to other projects, they started the project in January 2013.  The demolition crew was very aggressive and sloppy in their tear up and removal of the existing concrete decking.  They broke brick planters, created errant saw cuts and gouges in our home's existing brick walls, broke pool and sprinkler piping, etc., none of which was included in the scope of work. The project was delayed by cold weather. Getting Pristine back on the job to remove the debris took several weeks once things warmed up.  We had piles of broken concrete, pallets, dirt and rocks on our grass well into March.  Once they got started again, it took several more weeks to install the paver blocks.  Their technicians spilled excess mortar and debris into the empty pool, which required aggressive clean up, again, not in the scope of the project.  After several weeks of no activity or communication from the assigned Pristine project managers, I had to escalate to the Owner.  In spite of his continuous promises to complete the project within weeks, it dragged on though the summer.  Pristine had challenges getting their subcontractors to make time to complete work on our project and repair the damages inflicted by Pristine and other subcontractors.  The deck replacement, replacement of broken planters, repair of brick walls, repair to piping, etc. was finally done in August.  The final billing/reconciliation drug on until mid-September.  A 3 month project turned into 8+ months.  While the end result turned out great, it did take much more effort that we expected on our part to keep things moving towards completion.  Pristine presented themselves as the premier pool construction, remodeling and project management firm in the Boise area.  For the $40K + that we spent with them, we expected them to deliver a quality product on time and within budget.  I will not recommend Pristine Pools for any construction/ remodel work.
Update January 20
The Owner asked to meet with me to discuss ways for them to improve their business.  I appreciated the opportunity to share my thoughts with him.  It takes courage to find out where you are weak and where opportunities to improve may lie.  I wish them well in their business.

Quick service! We ordered at the drive through next door, and my wife went to get blended Rebels to cool us off on our sunny summer drive. I pulled around to wait for her to discover that she was already headed back to me! My rebel didn't have quite as much ice as I am used to, but it tasted just as good.

We're glad we ignored the posted Yelp calendar because they are in fact open on Monday from 7 am. Awesome creations. Make sure you go hungry. The food is spectacularly creative and filling. Definitely a repeat favorite.
We just spent $30 on two sushi rolls and now we are heading to a different sushi place. So disappointed in the taste and presentation.

New Les Schwab on Ustick Road near Eagle Road.  I was only stopping in to ask about making an appointment for brake service.  A service tech came jogging up to my car as I was parking (this isn't always the case at some other locations) as they advertise.  Talked to the technician and was reassured no appointment was necessary for a tire change over, alignment and brake service.  I have much better luck with Les Schwab than other tire shops here in the Boise area and I've tried a few.
Kids had a blast here. We ended up coming 2 days in a row when our vacation got canceled and we had to find things to do.  Coming back with my work team to have a throw down.

An oasis in Idaho! I really enjoyed our stay at this Candlewood Suites! Both our room and the facilities were clean and easily accessible. My favorite perks of a great hotel were included: kitchenette, fitness center, whirlpool spa, and FREE laundry services! Free apples and oranges were available in the lobby. They also offer a "Lending Locker" that's filled with conveniences from blenders to board games, to scissors and tape. Our kitchenette was well-stocked with cutlery, kitchenware, pots and pans, a toaster, microwave, and fridge. Their "Cupboard" convenience store also offered a wide variety of snacks, both little sweets and things like toaster streudels you can make in your room! And their free coffee was always hot and tasty. The folks at the front desk were friendly and accommodating. The bed felt comfy and had two styles of pillow - soft and firm, which I thought was a pleasant touch, especially for somebody who experiences back problems. I also really liked the J.R. Watkins soaps in the shower. The shower gel smelled great and left my skin silky smooth, while the shampoo and conditioner did the same for my hair! I also liked the blue tones of the hotel's interior. 
Candlewood Meridian is an excellent and refreshing stay for people who are on the road and love access to kitchens! Also, for the budget-conscious traveler, you can save money by cooking in the kitchenette, utilizing the free laundromat, and having healthy real fruit snacks! Highly recommend this comfy, clean, quiet, and convenient hotel! Thank you for a lovely stay!
Excellent food & waitstaff. First time dinners will definitely be back. From our appetizers to our main course all delicious & filling portions. Can't wait to try something new the next time we dine.

My first time at a Rumbi. I ordered the Fish Tacos meal and Tempura Shrimp appetizers. Everything was super. Tacos were fabulous and the shrimp made me want more, many more. Generous portions and obviously very fresh ingredients. I will definitely come back for more.
Best breakfast in town. Portions are huge. Love the fresh oj. Will be back. Give it a try

We tried Shanaz originally at the Boise Music Festival. We had the Korean Tacos and they were so good we decided to visit their Meridian location. The restaurant is located in a strip mall on Main Street. The Jazz and decor is pretty kitschy and southern. Roosters everywhere. The kitchen is slow. But that could be good or bad. If you are in a hurry it will make you crazy. But otherwise it means the food is being prepared fresh. 

The food... The Korean Tacos are amazing.  Perfectly prepared beef with a hoisin glaze. I'm getting Diabetes just thinking about them. The pork were not as good. That said , they were still incredible. And if I hadn't tried the beef first, I would have been stoked. My girlfriend liked the pork the best. The Salsa that comes with the tacos is crazy good! Nice and spicy! 

The Nu Flavor Roll with salad is awesome. 

This place is great

I had high hopes for a memorable breakfast on my last morning in town. I narrowed it down to the cornbeef hash or the chorizo breakfast burrito. I was in the mood for something spicy so I went with the chorizo breakfast burrito smothered in green chili.  I am not sure how they did it but it was the most blan chorizo I have ever had. I almost sent it back after the first bite thinking they gave me ham. The eggs were undercooked and runny in the burrito. I know some people like runny eggs but they tend to give me an upset stomach for the rest of the day. The last think I will gripe about is the  mound of green onions piled on top of the burrito.
My goto please for Chinese food. We have eaten there and had taken out. Word of warning, their food is somewhat hot but they will tone it down If you ask. Great food and nice people. Give them a try.

Although the food was good, the service is very poor. I was told my to go order would take 25 minutes, it took 55 minutes to finally get. The managers are very disorganized and don't allow the other wait staff to take orders, handle money or credit cards. They definitely need someone to handle to go orders, other than the two msnagers.

Our first trip to Famous Dave's was a delight. I love the "Devil's Spit" BBQ sauce. The food was just awesome and the selection of sides was very good. There was something for everyone. Our group of 12 ( 6 adults and 6 kids) ordered two rib platters, salads, and the large Garbage Can Lid Feast. You get an unlimited platter of home made BBQ chips. The chicken, ribs, and pulled pork were good but everyone went for the beef brisket served with the Trash Can Lid so we ordered another platter of beef brisket. Should have ordered two more because it went fast!  Don't pass this BBQ up!! If I were to find anything to complain about, and I'm really thinking hard here, is that the salad didn't come with any tomatoes. They have a glutten free and kids menu.  We'll be back.

Fabulous! The best chicken burrito since we moved to the state.We have tried the Meridian location a couple of times and yes, I'm a fan. If you have read other entrties, you can tell that I'm a bit of a culinary snob when it comes to my Mexican food and that I am always on the search for decent burritos and enchiladas. To my surprise, Los Betos was great. The chicken burrito was moist and tasty, just like in Southern California. However, carnitas are a bit dry and the chorizo burrito is almost indistinguishable as anything other than a  breakfast burrito with a bit of chorizo hidden on some eggs and potato. Overall, I will be back and continue to try items on the menu because I know that they CAN make great food. Some of it is just off the mark. Oh, and their horchata is pretty darn good!
I love this eatery! I come here for healthier breakfasts and really enjoy the great food and friendly service. The only downside is it can get crowded and have a very long wait to get in.

Staff is great and the food is excellent.  Even with a long line, you're through it and eating quickly.  - YUMMY!  Only bummer is during busy time seating can be difficult even though there's a ton of tables.

1st time here. we decided to go here after looking at reviews on another site & checking out the menu. my son wanted to try the maple bacon fried chicken, which they don't make anymore. lost the 5 rating because that is what we wanted to try. anyway, i got the farm house. did like it quiet a bit & i can never get my biscuits to turn out right, so i like theirs very much. & have plenty left for dinner tonight. my son got the smokehouse & i stole a bite, very good &  i will get this one next time we go, so on the whole both meals were good & only real issue i had was my potatoes were way over cooked for me. if i remember i'll ask for them to be a bit softer next time.  the iced tea didn't do much for me & my son's sprite was way over carbonated. i do agree with the long wait times, because the locations is TINY, but since my son & go out to eat to take our time & sit & chat it works. we did end up staying till almost 230 & no one was pushing us out the door. :)  it's priced & quality comparable to ihop & the portions are much larger.

I was sooooo excited to try this new coffee spot I had seen cropping up everywhere.. Sadly, there is nothing special about this coffee shop.. no drinks that stick out. Coffee is mediocre at best. Aside from the hip design and decor, there isn't anything to brag about. Dutch and HB still dominate. This shop needs to put in some serious effort in order to compete. ... Especially with all the pre-mature shops they're building.

This is our families go-to pizza place in Meridian.  Some people will tell you that Flying Pie is the best Pizza around.  Others will say Smokey Mountain.  For me, Idaho Pizza beats them hands down.  I love the sauces on their pizza, and their crust is always done just the way I like it.  My favorite is the Sawtooth Special, which is their meat lover's pizza.  I like to get it with anchovies on it, and it is so delicious.  Their salad bar is great too.  One thing that I love about this place is the great service.  The staff is constantly working to keep things clean and neat, and everyone is always really friendly.

Idaho Pizza Company has a great family atmosphere, with a little game room in the back, and a large dining room (or maybe two rooms) that can be reserved for private parties.  There are always kids of all ages there, and often there are different clubs or organizations having some kind of dinner there.  Tonight there was a birthday party for a cute little one-year-old!

Oh my this place has gone from barely mediocre to down right shameful. I completely agree with the other user who said if there are more than 6 people - LEAVE. You won't get served and/or they can't seem to make enough food to get out to all the hungry people. Went in for lunch, they open at 11:30 - we got there at 11:45 and were the first ones there. It took another 20 - yes TWENTY minutes before there was food on the boats. After 35 minutes I decided McDonalds would have to do. I am sorry to say were just done.

Rudy's is a favorite of ours because we can have a great meal and then go catch a movie at Majestic Cinemas. A great date night without having to drive across town.  They are always busy due to the fact that they serve DELICIOUS food! When the weather is nice I recommend using the patio! Burgers and Lettuce wraps are delicious! Shuffle board is FUN! They have a great drink menu! Wait staff have always been very fast and friendly.

Went to the Red Pavilion again on Valentine's Day (unplanned) and was seated right away. The food as usual was great, but the soup and food took longer than usual to be served. One of the best Chinese food places in the valley and will continue to patronize the restaurant.
Just plain gross, either hit up a Mexican restaurant, Taco truck, Taco Bell, Taco time anything but this place it's disgusting and the employees didn't seem like they wanted to be there.
Bust burritos around!  These are monster burritos chucked full of meat and veggies. My go to is the California Burrito and the Mixed Breakfast Burrito.

I work at Lowes just across from the parking lot from Costa Vida.  I have eaten here probably over a dozen times in the last 3 months.   I have never had a bad experience here!  The food is great, the service is always friendly and the prices are very fair.  I have the Costa Vida app and it's very easy to save money with it.  I got a message from them saying to come in for a free dessert for my birthday.       Key Lime Pie is addictive!!    Best Key Lime Pie I have ever eaten!    I love this place!!!

This restaurant has some of the best Chinese food anywhere. This is our second night in a row because we couldn't wait to have it again. Fast service, fresh ingredients, food seasoned to your taste and a very friendly staff. We have been to China many times, order Chinese food all across the nation and this ranks at the top in taste and cost comparison. Better to order the hot and sour soup by the big bowl with two small bowls and take the leftovers home. Same price as two small bowls of soup. We had the Szechuan Scallops and Shrimp with Chow rice. The variety of vegetables was incredible and the scallops / shrimp were cooked lightly to perfection!  All simply amazing. Enjoy!!

I only gave a four star instead of a 5 due to the long wait for my to-go order. I ordered at 2pm for a 5pm pickup and got my food around 6pm. However it is Christmas Eve and everyone had the same idea as me to get Chinese food. In the hour I waited, I got to chat with some pretty cool people also waiting and it ended up actually being a good experience. 
As far as the food is concerned: WELL WORTH THE WAIT. Boise doesn't have many great Chinese places but this place is legit. Even with the enormous amount of orders, the quality was still great and we were happy as we sat around in Christmas jammies stuffing our faces full of food we didn't have to cook. From what I understand, the food is generally very quick so I look forward to testing out that theory in the future. I know that I will most likely be there again next Christmas making friends! Merry Christmas!

Great food and health!  Not many places you can eat at that give you good healthy choices and also have information through out their restaurant on the health benefits of the foods. Breakfast, lunch dinner foods.

Dinner here was amazing! Incredible food, pleasant service. Food cooked to order! Sabid Garlic Shrimp, Fried Catfish, Chicken & Waffles were all great. Unique sides. And ate desert first by sharing an order of Deep Fried PBJ!

By far the best quesadilla I've ever had!  My husband ordered the chicken shrimp and steak quesadilla for me and i was not expecting it to be abything special.  It is seasoned with something delicious.  We will be returning and 100% recommend you try it too.
Nothing to write home about... it was basically a very expensive bowl of rice. The amount of meat included was a joke. We won't be returning even though the rumbi rice was decent tasting.
Great lunch spot, loved the fish tacos and yummy tasting coconut rumbi rice.

We came here last night with a party of 10. Waiter was amazing. And very patient with the group. I personally had the baked ravioli which was amazing. Everything from the sauce to the melted cheese on top was perfect. They don't have a kids menu but offer a smaller portion sizing of any pasta on the menu. Will definitely be a go to Italian Restaurant for our family.

I love brick oven pizza!  So if your looking for a solid brick oven pizza then give Grimaldi's a try!  The atmosphere Is great.   Our sever tonight "Jen"  recommended the White garlic pizza half pesto.   We went with her recommendation and glad we did!   Pesto was good and the white garlic sauced pizza was awesome!     And the spicy chicken sausage is a must try!   The anti pasta was a hit as well.   We were surprised to find out that Tuesday nights are half price wine night!  This is not your average pepperoni pizza place!  So when you try this place for the first time try something different.... You will be glad you did!

Big portion, but cold, i ordered a pastor taco, not even close to be al pastor taco, just pork with red chili sauce, this guys thinks that the kitchen's grill is good enough to warm the place, but no it was like 60 degress.

As other viewers have mentioned, tart yogurt has swept the nation, though not so much the Treasure Valley.

And to be honest, I tend to like it all, but some is definitely better than others.

Flavor: As I mentioned in my checkins, the dulce de leche tastes like dulce de leche.  Ohh, yumm.  My son loves the coconut.  And, the tarts are pretty good.

Selection: Quite a few selections and the ability to swirl.  Right up there with the best.

Toppings: A good selection.  You'll probably find what you are looking for.

Service: OK.  They tend to want to give you the sample.   Just give me the sample cups.

Seating: Not usually something I would mention.  I don't really like.  Looks cool, but isn't really conducive to talking.

Price: Comparable to California.  Nothing cheap.  Though, they do offer a punch card and sometimes run coupons.

Go and try.  You'll like.

Moe Joe's is truly a hidden gem in the Treasure Valley.  Having driven up and down Overland Road countless times; I could easily understand missing them. I saw their sidewalk sign many times, but finally decided one afternoon to turn off and see what they were about. DANG! They were closed. I should have known since it was after 4 in the afternoon. However,  I could still look up their sign in the window listing their specials. Now I couldn't wait to come back.

I took my fiancé to a nice Sunday brunch the very next chance and we were not disappointed.  It is not a large place, but it was clean, colorful, open and very friendly. We were seated promptly and began drooling over the menu. I chose a Smokehouse Hash from their specials. My fiancé ordered the Garden Frittata. I was thrilled to find out I could substitute the toast for pancakes; including their Doughnut and a Cup of Joe pancakes. The hash was full of country potatoes,  sliced smoked sausage, bacon and was topped with an egg; and every bit cooked to perfection. The Doughnut and a Cup of Joe pancakes are outrageously good. The pancakes themselves were light and full of flavor covered with glazed slivered almonds. But the coffee infused syrup really made this dish over the top. It can not be missed. My fiancé's Garden Fritata was equally special. Filled with fresh veggies;  I was grateful for even a meager taste. The fresh and light flavors made me wonder if I chose the right meal. Their house coffee, really capped off a great meal.

We can not wait to return. The menu has several very intriguing items that are simply not found in less adventurous breakfast restaurants. I should also mention that the service was excellent as well. My fiancé and I would highly recommend this unique establishment.

I have been here twice and both times the food was yummy and the employees were super sweet. My first visit was just minutes before closing and I didn't realize it. We ordered and then were given a heads-up. We felt so bad but she was really cool about it. She let us eat, didnt make us feel rushed at all. The quality of food and service did not suffer even though we were there right at closing time!

This is TRULY authentic Italian food. I cannot count how many Italian places I've tried around the country, probably close to as many times I've been to Gino's. :) 

First of all, the service is absolutely fantastic. Very knowledgeable in regards to wine and regions of Italy where the ingredients in the food hail from. I have had everything from veal to sausage to chicken here and I'm NOT A BIG MEAT FAN in general. I'm one of those jack-vegetarians... but every time I visit Gino, he hooks me up with that Italian food that makes me want to start greeting people with cheek kisses and conjure an accent. Not to mention Gino is such a nice man. Him and his wife own Gino's (and Gino's brother Tony started the pizza/wine place Tony's downtown - INCREDIBLE) and you can always find Gino cooking in the back, never missing a beat when he sees a familiar face, he comes out from around the grill and talks to you for a minute and asks how the family is (even though he's not tight with them of course :) 

The decor of the restaurant side is dripping in rich colors, murals can be seen on the wall and the linens on the tables are always a crisp and pressed white.  But the ambient lighting makes it the perfect place to go on a romantic date or even a business dinner...either way, you are sure to impress the company you keep with Gino's. You'll immediately feel extremely catered to and you'll never feel bad about being picky about how you like you food - they expect that from their customers because they themselves are picky about how they prepare it. Upon entering Gino's, you'll NEVER be served by a bubblegum popping blonde hair bimbo, annoyed if you ask for extra lemon or if you want to change up the original recipe. 

Consequently, I love Gino's. It is the B-E-S-T. HANDS DOWN!!!
The staff is helpful, caring and informative - I feel like they give my puppy the best care possible.

I just recently moved from San Diego to Boise and to say I have been impressed by the majority of the food here so far is incorrect. That is, until I found Shanaz! Shanaz offers southern soul food at its finest. The atmosphere upon walking in is cozy and inviting. We were immediately greeted by Shanaz herself and her husband JD popped out of the kitchen to say hello. They were so warm and welcoming, they instantly made us feel like part of the family. 

First our drinks came out in the cutest southern mason cups and then it was time to test the menu. And at first glance, I was immediately taken back to my home, my family and my childhood. Each dish is something I can say my grandmother made. And then elevated! 

We first ordered the Mac n' Cheese Balls which came with a homemade sauce. They were golden, beautiful, and perfectly crisp yet delicately smooth.  We then had to go for the fried chicken and waffles. We just had too. And if that plate was any indication of how they do business, I'd say Shanaz has a bright future ahead of them. It consisted of a buttermilk waffle rubbed with homemade strawberry butter, nested beside JD's crispy fried chicken (which has been marinating in buttermilk for 24+ hours, just saying) served with 100% pure maple syrup. 

It is clear these owners care about comfort of their guests and quality of their food above all else. I already can't wait to return to try their seafood gumbo!

While visiting family we found ourselves ready for dinner and over an hour wait at every other restaurant at the Village.  So our decision was made by the ability for the place to seat us. We ending up picking up a seat at the bar.

The Service: Our server was occasionally slow, but this is to be expected for a busy Friday night. What was wonderful was every request was accommodated with a smile. The service was really wonderful.

We ordered the strawberry salad and the pizza called the Godfather.  Meaty pizza with meatballs.  Thin crusted delicious dream!!!  I really enjoyed it. The cocktail menu was full of delightful choices and there was a good choice of beers and wines.

Overall, I would be happy to return to this place. But be mindful on holidays.  Everywhere around here was packed.

Always amazing food, and staff is so kind and friendly! Great place! We sat next to the fireplace for what seemed like for hours, and weren't asked to hurry up, or anything, the chicken fried rice is amazing! And the calamari is always awesome!

This review is from copper the dog.  I love this place! I'm able to play with all the other dogs and sniff... Well you know.  The staff is very freindly!   I had to go today  to make sure I get alone with all the other dogs!  I passed with flying colors.  Now a can be dropped off any time for the day or over night!   I'm a happy camper!

My sister and I stopped in to Fujiyama for the first time recently. She lives in the area and had always noticed the restaurant, but never taken the time to check it out. As soon as we walked in, we were greeted by the friendly staff, who seated us promptly. She had the salmon lunch special and I ordered the teriyaki chicken bento lunch, which came with two egg rolls, California roll, and rice. Both of our lunches also came with miso soup (DELICIOUS!) and a salad. I highly recommend the ginger dressing because it was fantastic and made my taste buds very happy. The hot tea was also steeped to perfection. Both of us though our meals were excellent.
The food was visually appealing, the portions large, and everything tasted amazing. Plus, the prices are incredibly reasonable. I live in California and have been to a number of great Japanese/sushi restaurants. I have to say that Fujiyama is right up there with them, if not better than many. 
I highly recommend Fujiyama. My sister has already put it on her list to return again soon and I look forward to my next Boise-area visit to do so as well.

We were looking for some good local sushi and I wandered in here. I tried the Idaho girl which is super fun because it is chef's choice. Friendly staff and delicious sushi. This will be our go-to for our takeout sushi in Meridian!

Incompetent employees. Hostess had attitude. Waitress was a dingbat. Bartender dropped the ball. Obviously the management hires the girls based on how their booty looks in tight jeans (they scored GREAT on that!), and not their service or people skills. Way overpriced. $6 for a flipping glass of beer? RUFKM? Food good, but not that good. Too many restaurants in this valley for me to ever waste another dollar at this one. Should rename it "Infamous Dave's". Will never go back.

Had the salmon carpacchio, was quite good.  We both had veal dishes, very tasty, slightly too much olive oil, ?could have been reduced more.  Chocolate torte with marionberry, very good.  Only restaurant in the valley that does not blink when you ask for a slice of lemon peel with your espresso, which by the way was perfect.  The pinot grigio we had was also quite good.  We had not been in years but we will return.

Not a bad neighborhood bar.  The staff is friendly and the foods not bad.  The decor is nothing to write home about and the TV's are not as a big production as the big sports bars in the area.  Limited beer selection but they do have a full bar.   I think this place is more of nice neighborhood bar that appeals to women and the menu is interesting.  The service has always been pretty good so overall I would recommend giving this place a try.

Unfortunately, for a pristine location and an advertised high end spa, I was not impressed.  I was here Friday for a gel mani and spa pedi.  I'm posting this review Sunday morning navies I'm still bothered and really want to go somewhere else now to have my mani redone. 

First of all, great things about this place:  I really liked friendliness of staff, atmosphere is very relaxing and spa like, very clean area, love the interior look, everyone spoke English, customer service was great, parking was easy, I enjoyed my time spent getting a spa pedicure and gel manicure. 

My pedicure was very relaxing and what I typically want of a spa pedicure. I could almost write two reviews because my pedi was so great.  

I had a different person for a mani though. I got a gel mani and at first it seemed normal in that she put the gel on there the the color, then the design. All normal, color and design was perfect. However then she just put lotion on and called it a day. 

Hmm.  So I've spent $105 for a fantastic pedi and a crappy mani.  My cuticles were not cut or trimmed or pushed back.  

So I'm rather disappointed that I spent all this money and am not happy with the result.  I probably will not be returning. Too expensive for not a great result, when I can go somewhere else and spend less than half of this and get a better result.

I enjoyed my rumbi rice bowl with luau pork but as a person in the restaurant industry, I wasn't impressed by how it was made or the ingredients used. Two adults and two children cost us $51. I thought "this is gonna be amazing" but turned out I was the only one that liked their meal and again, it wasn't fantastic. Just ingredients thrown together to make a rice bowl. Only thing going for rumbi is that nobody really does Hawaiian food around here. However, the noodles are spaghetti noodles not the type of noodles traditionally used in Hawaii food. It was a taste bud disconnect that my wife simply couldn't get past and the aloha tacos with the chicken option were pretty but the mango in the vinegar based pico was a poor choice. Also, the chicken was frozen breaded chicken cut into chunks. Essentially, meridian has a new casual dining option with a unique taste that differs from what we usually expect but the menu at this point appears to be based on a wanna be chef throwing together different frozen ingredients from a Sysco or us foods truck and mixing it with pre made sauces. If my wife rated this, it would be a one star but I did appreciate my meal as it was different than the burger option we were looking for when we stumbled upon this place. Side note: only two of the four people in my party ate more than 1/3 of their meal

The food was OK. 

I had the unlimited wings and the first order is 6 wings. Then they have to follow corporate rules to only bring 3 at a time. It took an average of 12 minutes per additional side of 3 wings. It's like they are banking on being inconvenient to order more so you leave early. 

Won't come here again.

Tasha was outstanding. Very busy this morning. Big portions. Split the a hash between two people because of the portions. The mimosas are fabulous with fresh squeezed OJ. Seating outside is limited. Beautiful day.

Absolutely amazing! So healthy and so many options above just salads. I had the pizza and it was delicious. Their juices were so yummy too. Definitely recommend this place 150%! Can't believe I found something so unique and special in Meridian, Idaho!

My garage door broke last night. They were at my house first thing this morning. Service was fast, friendly, and reasonably priced. This is the second time I have used Hanson and will not hesitate to call again.

I came here with high hopes on having at least a decent meal. When I arrived not only was the wait staff rude but the food was awful. I had to send my pasta back due to it being over cooked and spiced weird. Luckily I didn't have to pay for that, but my friend order the all you can eat fish and shrimp which was very bland and unpleasant PLUS there was a hair in her food!!! When we brought this to their attention they didn't take it seriously and charged us $20 for the meal she didn't even eat. I have never been so disappointed, and I've had a lot of bad experiences.

I've been here a few times and every time I've had problems. I've asked to have it fixed and it's still wrong. I went inside to make sure they get it wright to just hear the cook and the two girls talk crap about me in Spanish. I guess they figured I don't look like I know Spanish. This treatment is disgusting! I've been to Mexico many times and understand Idaho doesn't know what Mexican food is supposed to taste like. This place is worse than del taco! It taste like school lunch food with a attitude. Never again! Just go to the taco trucks they are better and have good customer service. Campos meat market off of Orchard in Boise is better too!
Decent selection of Organic produce and other products. Friendly staff and clean store.

Went to Gino's to celebrate my Birthday. Had a lovely glass of Rose but that was the only thing I enjoyed. The table we sat at needed repairs done to the chair legs. I ordered a shrimp and lobster ravioli, it was  awful! Shrimp was very very over cooked and not edible the ravioli could not have had any lobster in it. Maybe crab with a K? Not sure. I left the restaurant hungry. My husband had lasagna and he did enjoy his meal. I do have to say the servers were very attentive and took great care of out table.

So glad BRCB is in now in Idaho! Cool atmosphere and great coffee for a really reasonable price! Quick service with both drive through and walk in options. So glad they are opening multiple locations! Will definitely be back!

Since my wife is Chinese and I spent several years in China myself, we know Chinese food and appreciate when it is good, very good. Although, not the truly authentic Chinese, but the Americanized version of it (but with elements of authentic), we have truly enjoyed the dishes, and service, we have ordered here. It is now our first choice when we think of going out to eat Chinese food. Nice outside patio seating area on a nice evening too.
Amazing!!! Have been to two other places here in Idaho; they were horrible! This place has superb quality fish and fun chefs. We will be back.

Not thrilled with eating my food out of a tin foil pan, using plastic fork and knife, in an echo chamber dining area, trying to talk under strange pop/hip hop music.

Seems that this place wants to present itself as a fast Mexican Grill. The serving - assembly line person was really quick, so that she spilled chicken chunks into the pork, or whatever, and grated cheese onto the floor. The cashier was quick to charge me a little extra for something I did not actually order or receive. Those tin pan food  orders look all very much alike. Sometimes being fast is not appetizing.

Maybe that would be easy to overlook if my food had been pleasant. My wife loved her sweet pork burritos with guacamole & sour cream. I had a raspberry chicken enchilada - which made me sick to my stomach. I don't know if it was the raspberry pepper sauce, or the pico de gallo, or the funny "Minute-Maid lite" beverage, or the bland parboiled rice. Or whatever. 

No refried beans. And no traditional tomato salsa. Really. And for all you goofy gringos out there who don't know what a real salsa is... It sure aint pico de gallo.

I got the California burrito and it was huge and delicious for $5 - anywhere else would have been like $8.25. Not sure how this could be anything less than 4 stars. When there are Mexican people making the food AND eating there, you know it's going to be cool. For sure will come back!

We went to Famous Daves last night and hi dee ho cowboy, it was delicious! I was skeptical because of the average of 3 stars but I have to say, we all loved our meals. The ribs were fantastic (the rub was incredible) and so was the chopped pork. The coleslaw and corn was delicious too. I've had barbecue all over the country and this really stacked up.  I'll be back.

This is the best hospital, I have been to two others in Boise and Meridian and this one by far is the most experience, knowledgeable employees I have ever dealt with.  Thank you so much for the surgeries he did on my dog I am most grateful for you guys.  I will never ever go to anyone else

I wish I could give this restaurant more stars but I can honestly say that every experience I've had here has been nothing but disappointing. If our experience was a one-time, isolated event I would chalk it off to the night and gladly return but I have eaten here three times and have gotten the exact same treatment each time. We arrive and are told to wait for 20-30 minutes. (On a busy night this makes sense but when you can look into the restaurant and clearly see many open tables as well as clearly bored waitstaff this seems unnecessary). When we finally arrive at our table we wait for the waiter (no pun intended) then wait for our order then wait for the drinks then wait for the food....the entire process literally took almost two hours and we have had children with us on each occasion. They have no children's menus and after waiting for our food for well over 40 minutes they came over with an excuse about a take out order taking precedence and finally brought some bread out for the kids who were starting to come unglued...after all was said and done we ended up spending WAAAAAY too much money for this experience and promised we would not be coming back.
Best breakfast I've ever had! PERIOD! The place is spotless clean and the food just tastes amazing! I just want to know who the crazy person is  that didn't give this 5 stars!

We had been meaning to try this place for a while but hadn't yet. We stopped in on a whim tonight without reservations and they worked us right in.  The bread and dipping oil were delicious as a starter.  My husband ordered the lentil soup, also very good. He ordered the salmon special and I had the baked ziti.  Both were outstanding.  The service was wonderful.  We highly recommend this place and we'll absolutely be back!

Love love love this place!! Service was ok but the staff were friendly! Food is absolutely delicious ranging from mild to spicy (but the spiciness wasn't as expected and that's OK because the food is good).Go try it out sometime you won't be disappointed!!

I lived in Texas for 13 years and I bake, a lot...these were the best Mac n cheese balls and cornbread I think I've ever had. Yes, they were that good. My daughters grilled cheese and fries were even excellent. Other child had sliders and they were good too. 
While the shrimp really weren't jumbo the shrimp was excellent and the potato cake was too...although mashed potatoes might have been a better way to convey the delicious spicy buttery sauce to my mouth!  Side was a marinated cabbage that my husband first described as kimchee. But was more of a sautéed cabbage with pork and amazing. 
Husband had jambalaya stuffed peppers. That was really good as well. Ice tea and lemonade were plentiful and kept coming. I was only disappointed there wasn't bread pudding, key lime pie or other southern dessert to cap it off...then again that saved me from myself!

I was very jealous of the guy sitting at the next table with the giant bowl or gumbo and pan of cornbread to himself!  Saw another table wisely share that giant bowl between them.

I'm from Arizona and almost lost it when I saw this place here!! Reminds me of Home! It's so good!!!!! The Rolled Tacos are amazing!! Get the "Rolled Taco Supreme!!" Their service is quick, they're super nice!!

I went here because of the high ratings, and I'm here to say how very disappointed I am. The food doesn't taste horrible, but it's so off and too salty! I ordered 6 carnia Asada tacos (two orders), one with no side of beans and rice, and the other with. One was supposed to have green hot sauce on it along with the usual cilantro and onions and the refried beans came very spicy, and the rice was bland, and no sauce came with it! The taco meat was so very salty that it defeated the purpose of the taco itself. They came with lettuce when I asked for them not to, but the cilantro and onion were in a cup on the side. The tortillas were so very dry. It says it's not very pricy but they are! For six tacos and a burrito, it was a little more than $40!! I won't be coming back. The girl who took my order even read the order back to me, and so for her to get it wrong, just adds to the dysfunction and distaste of the place. We have had much better Mexican food in town, and this is by far on the bottom.
Highly recommended. The Farm House is my favorite breakfast. Get there early and you won't be disappointed.
I like traditional hashbrowns seems everyone is doing chopped up with peppers and onions and I'm getting tired of it.
Have to have dinner at Ginos any time I am in Boise.  Great food and service.  Worth the 2000 mile flight!

From an ultra critical Italian food guy: Gino's is FANTASTICO!

It's not about good vs bad food, it's all about authenticity. Gino's takes it right out of the Boot (Italia) and puts it in front of you on a plate in little Meridian, ID. Gino's is bar none THE restaurant of choice when me and my wife come to Idaho to visit my family.

You can fly to Napoli, or just head over to Gino's. Same thing. Buon Appetito!

Gino - carissimo amico! Fino alla prossima, stammi bene!

Had the ribs (with baked beans, cole slaw, potato salad and corn bread) and the gumbo.   Potato salad out of this world.  It opens with a burst of onion and finishes with a cool custard-like cream of egg and wonderfulness.  Ribs were smoked right, super sweet, fall-off-the-bone deliciousness.  Beans come in a cute little Pyrex loaf pan and the corn bread baked to perfection, drizzled with honey butter and in it's own 5" cast iron pan.   

Kudos on the gumbo, great broth, with shrimp,  Andouille sausage, crab, okra and onions.  A small amount of white rice completed the mixture for a gumbo like I've never tasted outside of New Orleans.  Yummmmmmm!!

Came in here with a few gals from work when we were in Boise for training.  Overall the atmosphere is very casual and laid back which I can definitely appreciate after a hard days work. The menu isn't very extensive - your typical bar/grill fare. If you are looking for something relatively healthy better hit the door and go somewhere else. I opted for the angel hair pasta with olive oil and tomatoes - seemed to be the healthiest thing besides another boring salad. My entree was good but of course didn't look as appealing as the burgers my coworkers were enjoying.  If you like burgers definitely try one here. The ladies were raving about how good they are. 

If I'm back in Boise I might stop back in.

Excellent!   The is nothing else to say!  My new favorite.
Service and food is great, been there a number of times now and we have never been disappointed.
They don't take all credit cards!  Bummer I will not be dining there again due to the fact they don't take American Express.

I love the fact that Red Robin caters to food allergies!! Good on you Red Robin!!! We visited on Mothers Day as this is where my wife wanted to go...............lucky me, a cheap date! The service was good, upbeat and, as always, the food was pretty tasty and timely. I was surprised on the price though, as it was a lot more expensive than I remember. Come to find out I ordered a special burger..........would have been nice to know it was THAT special when I ordered it!
This pizza is really something special- The crust was perfection! Very nice view of the village's water show from the patio.

I had a good experience at this red robin so I thought I would share. I think people can be harsh on chain restaurants because there is a level of expectation from the commercials.

I have always loved red robin since I was very little and this is no exception. they did great.

we sat in the bar- during lunch- but we got lucky because we came in before it got too busy. the server (I wish I had gotten her name!) was so sweet. she talked to us like she knew us! brought us fries before our food to share and asked what sauces I wanted. I love that!

I ordered the teriyaki chicken burger on a wheat bun. it was- and always is- tender and juicy and flavorful. it's always been my favorite. sometimes I get the hamburger version. it's consistent.

my mom got a grilled cheese with bacon. she is a grilled cheese fanatic- she orders them everywhere we go! it was a good one- SO much cheese. she ordered a salad with hers. 

happy with this red robin and we will be back!

Delicious! The staff is really kind and the food is amazing. I like that they have unique items on their breakfast menu. It's a good sign that Moe Joes is always busy and usually has a wait. One of my favorite breakfast places in town.

Little disappointed.  We came in for a drink and appetizer at the bar an hour before our movie.  Got our drinks promptly, but it took 40 minutes to get salads.  We ended up being rushed and unable to finish, as we didn't want to be late to the movie.  The servers and bartenders seem disorganized, like no one is really sure want their fill job description is.  I really want to try their pizza, and will go back mid week when they are better suited for a smaller crowd of patrons.

I decided to bring my family from out of town to the Village and show off the awesome food scene Boise has to offer. I had been to Grimaldi's once before and had a good experience. The ambiance is fun. The pizza is good--great crust, fresh ingredients but today the costumer service left much to be desired. 

We walked in around 2:00pm on a Thursday, it didn't seem busy at all.  There was no one to greet us at the door, we waited 3-5 minutes for someone to even come greet us. The hostess comes, doesn't make eye contact with any of us. She mumbles something for us to wait for them to clean up a table. We wait 10 minutes. She sits us down, then our waiter comes. He didn't greet us, didn't smile, didn't introduce himself...asked what we wanted for drinks. Most of us ordered water, that took another 10 minutes. Some other guy brought our drinks. Then I see our original waiter at the bar, I tell him we are ready to order. He says, "oh I got caught up doing something else". By then, we had waited almost 25 minutes to only have water on the table and no one had taken our order. We politely expressed our dissatisfaction, which changed things a bit. They promptly brought our Ceasar salad and promptly after that our pizzas. Some other guy (the manager?) brought the pizzas, he was nice and attentive and individually dished each of the children at the table a slice of pizza. He was trying to make things better, but we were already not impressed. 

It was very disappointing and in all honesty disrespectful to customers who gladly come to give them their business. This is how great places go out of business. They start neglecting and not putting emphasis on good customer service. The pizza might be good but when customers are not treated like their business matters then customers stop giving them their business. It shouldn't take much to be friendly, engaged in what you are doing and on top of things when that is what you are getting paid to do. I still left a tip but I would have been much more generous if we would've been treated like we mattered from the beginning.

For fast and convent food this place is a good one. I ordered the grilled shrimp tacos and they were great. 
The shrimp were plentiful and cooked for my order with the golden toasted tortilla. The flavor was sweet and yummy. With a side of black beans and lime rice a perfect trio. Don't forget some sour cream for the black beans to make them just that much better. Guac for the shrimp tacos and leave off the mess of lettuce. A little drippy messy but the sauce and taco is soooo worth it. Licking the juice off your fingers good! 
All this for just under $10.
We love this place. Unfortunately we eat here way too much. The crew is always hustling and it is always clean. Sweet pork salad is the BOMB!

We went here this morning which was a Sunday at about 10 am for breakfast. When we walked in we saw they had a buffet. Which we never go to buffets but this particular restaurant happened to be having a Sunday breakfast buffet to our surprise. I really wish I would not have said we will just do the Buffet. We ended up paying almost $50 for 4 waters and food that was barely touched. The food tasted as though it had been cooked for hours in the back and they just kept filling up the buffet. The only thing my kids ended up eating was the free ice cream, my husband had half a biscuit that was rock hard with some gravy. I took a bite of bacon was done. Don't waste your time on the buffet. Order fresh from the menu.

So fast you'll freak? I thought I would put it to the test. I ordered around 11am to catch them before the lunch rush. I work less than 2 miles away. You figure that it should take less than 5 min to make the sandwich and less than 5 to deliver it. That would be freaky fast. Alas, it took about 16 min to get my sandwich. That is a good delivery, just not freaky! That sandwich was delicious. Maybe they should call it freaky delicious.

I am not sure what's going on here, used to be a good hamburger restaurant, however the restaurant is filthy. I understand this is a family restaurant. Restrooms haven't been cleaned for some time, zero water pressure, soap was empty, floors haven't been mopped for some time in entire restaurant. After our table had been bussed still had food all over it. We were seated in a booth by back by restrooms and the booths are filthy. Blinds on window are covered in dust windows aren't clean blinds are falling part. JUST GROSS! It's obvious the owners don't care nor does the managers and employees.
Nothing but appreciation for this dealership.....Mike Goff is a true professional always going above and beyond my expectations.

This location has exceptional service. Friendly staff!
Great lunch special and good sushi.

This is a wonderful place that I highly recommend visiting. The food is terrific as is the service. I love the menu which is pretty vast and includes standard favorites as well as wild out there specialties that were fun to try and quite tasty too. I highly recommend the hot chocolate which is delicious but the melted marshmallows on top really add a nice touch. I went with a party of 4 and we all tried each others breakfasts. Two of our party got pancakes, one was just a chocolate chip pancake, the other was the cream cheese stuffed strawberry jalapeño flavored dish. Both were absolutely terrific. I highly recommend the pancakes! Any pancakes! I ordered a pork hash and the other member of our party ordered a frittata. The frittata was wonderful and flavorful. The hash was the least tasty meal of the bunch. I give this place 4 stars because of two items. The potatoes in he hash were quite soft and soggy mainly because it has been sitting in too much oil for too long. I also gave it 4 stars because the waits will usually be long, because this is such a good place, but when you see people coming after you and being seated before you, it tends to irk you in a big way, which happened to us. When asked why, the hostess explained they had someone with a dog and they had to be seated outside, and once they set up a some chairs and tables outside, these folks were immediately seated despite the fact that others were ahead of them in the queue that may have been open to being seated outdoors.  I do recommend this place on the whole though, because the food and service were exceptional.
Hands down the best fast casual organic, health conscious place to eat in the Treasure Valley!

Esta fue mi primera visita, pedi los huevos benedictos con papas de la casa, los huevos estavan ricos pero las papas tenian mucha salt mucha pimienta , mi madre no se las pudo comer, senti que el servicio del mesero no fue muy bueno ,talvez porque nosotros teniamos ninos porque las demas mesas estavan teniendo un mejor servicio.
Best Italian food you will find anywhere! Gino's is amazing!

Red Robin is going the way of Chili's.  Lowering the quality and jacking up the prices. Had the fish last night. It was over battered, burnt, and the fish quality was much lower. It was gray and yellow,  chewy and greasy. I'm tired of these games. After 25 years last night was my last trip to Red Robin.  The service was amazing, the food was simply disgusting. I went home and threw up.

Stopped by here today in search of a healthy lunch. Ordered one of their bowls with chicken.  Was disappointed that the chicken was frozen. The owner was extremely generous and not only refunded me the money for the bowl but gave me a nice cup of his delicious lentil soup so I wouldn't leave hungry. Excellent customer service and if you stop by I highly recommend the soup!
This is a blend between Kohl's and Target with grocery section. Or, another way to look at it is... it's a really nice Wal-Mart with name brand apparel.
This place just opened but is AWESOME! I love Carmel machiattos and this was better than what I get at Starbucks- and CHEAPER! Will definitely be going here instead of Starbucks from now on!

New to town, I put the word out that I was looking for hair cut and color.  A friend recommended SB and I called and got in really quickly.  I was very impressed with the ambiance and style of the salon.  Their choice of product (Bumble & Bumble) and lines they sell up front are high quality and I love them in my hair.  I left the cut and color up to the professionals for the most part and could not be happier with what Jessica did.  I tried to attach before and afters.  We will see if it worked.  I'll be back for some nails and brow wax!  Under $100 for full color and a great cut?  I'll take it!
Outstanding sushi!!! Ask for the crazy dancer sue!  It's nice to go for sushi where it's fresh and more varieties of fish.  Thank you!

Recently relocated to Eagle & was searching for a vet to care for 3 dogs. The receptionists at this office are top notch - kind & organized. Made it possible for all dogs to be seen on the same day. We had the pleasure of seeing Dr. Troska & in the short time we have been here, two of our dogs have needed additional care to address more complicated health issues. Dr. Troska was able to quickly diagnose and recommend a care plan that has made our dogs healthy again. Very pleased with this veterinary office & would recommend to anyone.

I really enjoy the sweet cornbread it was fresh-baked from the oven served on cast iron like cornbread is supposed to. The waitress was ridiculously nice. I do plan on coming back but I honestly would not call this southern food. It's more like a southern Fusion there's influences Cajun to Mexican too Japanese. There's no doubt that the food is good. It is definitely worth the good reviews but when I saw the sign southern food I expected to walk into southern soul food not Fusion so I was slightly disappointed.

Great happy hour! $3 wells, $2 off craft beer pints and house wine. Great selection of happy hour food items. Got beer battered asparagus and sweet chili wingers. Sarah the bar manager was great. We had a couple problems with the check and not only did she correct it but gave us a free drink coupon for next visit. Large bar area with both booths and high bar tables and lots of big screen TVs. Will definitely be back!

Excellent.   Best in the valley.  You gotta try the Mongol Beef or the Honey Almond Shrimp!!!!!

Great service and atmosphere also.   Our first visit tonight and most certainly will 
return again.   They do Chinese right all the way. 

Five Star indeed.

Attempted to eat here, never got the opportunity. 

We entered on a busy evening (for a weekday). Two people were ahead of us, they were seated fairly quickly by the hostess'. We (party of two) said, we are a party of two, one of them, said ok we will be with you soon. We stood, waited, while the hostess' ran around doing who knows what, not making eye contact with us in fact ignoring us. Then two people came in after us and they greeted them and added them to the list. I walked up and said, excuse me, why are you adding them to the list when we arrived first and you haven't collected our name, but you collected theirs? All we got was a terse, unapologetic, confused and snarky grunt of a response. They both played ignorant that we had even been standing there, in front of them for 5 minutes. They did not offer to rectify the situation, we were so disenchanted by the whole experience, lack of follow thru, and attitude that we turned around and left.

Great place for a great filling breakfast. I would rate this as one of the best places in the Meridian, Boise area. And Joe the owner really knows how to make great tasting meals. A five star rating. We will be back!!!

Omg. So good!!!! We stopped by for lunch and ordered the pork and beef Korean tacos. They are sent from Heaven. We also ordered the Nu Flavor Roll... Good lord. So much flavor. The service was great! Our server was very sweet and accommodating. The hours are different so make sure to check ahead of time and the food takes a little bit of time but well worth it.
Wide selection of quality yarns.  Disappointed by no coffee...the Brew?  Feature great yarns from NW producers.  Don't live close enough to try their classes, but I certainly would.

I returned with my wife for a second visit.  Coffee was very good.  Food was good with plenty to eat this time.  My wife had the breakfast burrito.  It was huge, but not very spicy for being a burrito.  I had the 2 egg breakfast with a ham steak.  The ham steak was great.  The service was prompt.  Total breakfast bill came to $20 because I had a coupon.  We'll return to enjoy this place again.

It's good to be back, I was here last Christmas weekend and back this weekend. Mary and the rest of the staff are simply wonderful! Best customer service in town by far.  The food and drinks rock. A must in Boise!

First visit and will be back here to try the chicken and waffles next time I am in the area....the Korean Tacos and Nu Flavor Roll?  What can I say? Hands. Down. KILLING IT.  The flavors were all spot on.  Tacos are small though so order a few.  The special salsa is perfect. 

Hawaiian punch out of a jar? Check.  Vinegar (peppers included) at every table?  Check.  This is an ethnic fusion staple for the Boise area.  Recognize!  

As I was leaving I saw a shrimp po' boy coming out and started salivating...despite being so stuffed I was barely shuffling toward the door.
Awesome food!!! It was a good time. There was four in our party and everyone of us were excited to come back again.

This place surprised me. For a fast foody looking place it was fresh, friendly and delicious. Healthy options such as brown rice and sweet potatoes, plus grilled meats instead if fried. Taste was unique, unlike a typical burrito or hamburger joint, and very large portions. In fact you are better off splitting a full order bowl with someone or packing half for takeaway. It's a little more than you'd spend for a Subway or something, but your getting a LOT of food. Try the jerk chicken bowl with Rumbi rice, its delicious.

I've already been to the Boise location several times. Today was my first time here, and I was pleased to see a few different flavors. They had my beloved raspberry pomegranate sorbet, but also lemon and key lime so I mixed myself the sorbet equivalent of rainbow sherbet.  

I also got some coconut sorbet for my sons. We used to get the sorbet mix at Costco, but the only flavors we really liked were the coconut and the raspberry lemon so this is a great alternative.

I was disappointed I didn't get vanilla at this point  but that ended as soon as I dug into my "rainbow" sorbet.  So good.  Besides, having something else to try gives me another excuse to go back. I even have a punch card now.  I don't remember being offered one at the Boise location, but hopefully it's valid for both.  

I do expect to visit the Meridian location more often since it's closer, but I wouldn't rank one location above the other. Both are great.

So after eating here at least a 1/2 dozen times my opinion of Joe's cooking only improves. Real scratch food and not a microwave in the building! I came here with my beautiful wife for her first visit recently. She had the corned beef hash and I had the basque chorizo omelet. Her first bite literally brought tears to her eyes. If food is good enough to cause an emotional reaction - well you get the point. It does get a bit loud when its busy and it seems like they are getting busier every time I come. The service has always been friendly and sincere. I rarely downgrade a restaurant for busy servers unless I'm treated downright rudely, but that's never been the case here. The secret is getting out!

After standing in line for 30 minutes in a lobby full of 60-80 OUT OF CONTROL kids, we were told we'd have a 30-40 minute wait, because they were out of equipment. Chose not to stay in a lobby of choas. Went somewhere else instead.

I like to try something new each time we go.  Everything is excellent, honestly! 

If I could change or suggest one thing it would to be to have specials.  So if I want French toast it would come with bacon instead of it all being al la carte ir have a pick two option so we can have a little of this and a little of that.  

Overall though, portions are large and food is excellent.  Just would like combinations.

My wife and I went here soon after we moved to Meridian. It was better than some of the BBQ places we have been to in Northern California. Food was good, wait staff good. But some of the choices of BBQ sauce I didn't care for. The hottest sauce was to hot because you couldn't taste the meat, or anything else for that matter. Other than that, if Goodwood is to busy..... then this place is OK.

OK the stingy meat thing is getting ridiculous.  I asked for more meat and the lil Mexican girl gave me another piece of meat the size of M&M.  I said, "Really?"  She put more on after that and then made sure the cashier was told to charge me more for extra meat.   Now if you going to serve it that way then I guess you need to get the scale and start weighing it.  As pouring a bunch of juice into your enchilada is not the same thing.

Don't let home office tell you any different; there IS a destination EV charger at this hotel (in fact two), right by the front door. We almost skipped it when the guy at the Reservation Center (wherever that is) said "no, no charger there." We decided to believe our Tesla app instead of him and checked it out. Now we are fully charged and off after a perfectly nice night in a big room with a real kitchen, handy laundry, and a great price. I love the "borrowing lockers", where you can borrow items people rarely travel with, like games. 

Candlewood would be smart to advertise their charger availability to electric car drivers.

I took my two daughters here today, on a Saturday evening with wishful thinking that they could get us in and they were so accommodating!  We just missed their rush and while a salon down the road had turned us down because it was close to closing these awesome techs got us in.  We got great pedicures and even eyebrows waxed and I was impressed by the attention to detail!  They could have rushed through but took their time and made us feel like regulars.  We will be now!  Toes and eyebrows look AWESOME thanks to Awesome Nails!

Love idaho pizza. Awesome staff, always super friendly. What I love best about this place is its consistency. Not the greatest pizza, but very good and always the way you expect. Not one complaint about idaho pizza.

First of all, I would like to thank Brad, the owner, for extending the invitation to Webster Construction, and all his subs, to enjoy a meal tonight. 

We arrived around 7:35pm, and were put on the list to be seated. I was told it would be about 20 minutes, and the hostess informed me of how busy they've been. We sat down and waited about 30+ minutes, but that wasn't too bad since we saw how busy it was this evening. It was PACKED. They awarded 50 people through Facebook, and had friends and sub contractors for a VIP training night for their staff. 

Once we were seated, Sally was our server. She promptly got our drink order and went over appetizers with us, and we selected the "wings and things". It came with 4 wings, 4 sticky fingers(breaded chicken strips tossed in sauce), and some onion rings. All of the food on the plate was delicious. 

My wife ordered the Alehouse Burger, and I ordered the Bacon and Chedda Burger( yes that's how it's spelled). Our food arrived and Sally asked if we wanted a box for our appetizer we couldn't finish. What a great idea! Our burgers were both cooked the way we ordered them, well flavored, and on a great buttery toasted bun! They were quite good. The fries were also really good. 

We then ordered the Cookie Zookie for dessert. Fresh big cookie, vanilla ice cream, whipped cream, pecans, and chocolate drizzle... wow was it good!

I can't believe how good the staff did tonight. It was sooo busy the whole time, and no one seemed to skip a beat! The food all looked good around us, and ours was definitely delicious. Everyone seemed to be having a great time too,... customers and employees. Lots of TVs to watch the NFL draft, NBA playoffs, and other sports on too.  

Brad went above and beyond with this VIP event tonight. An appetizer per table, an entree per person, and a dessert per table! Wow, what an amazing way to show your appreciation for everything. We will definitely be back, and we will also be telling our friends about your fine establishment.

Famous Dave's revival.

I just enjoyed my first Famous Dave's steak, and while a bit unevenly cooked was outstanding. It carried an authentic barbeque smoky flavor throughout and was a juicy steak.
My wife and daughter shared a rack of St. Louis ribs, and although my daughter (age 8) indicates they are a "bit spicy" I think she may have eaten more between the two of them. My wife also indicates they were "very meaty."

If you saw my last review of hardship I feel that I am obligated to let you know this review takes place under "discounted" circumstances. A family member reached out on our behalf, and the store's lead manager reached out to us to attempt to make up for our past troubles. Also I moved my "food review" to the top because that's really where a restaurant excels. 

Last time our service was very "sub-par." Tonight I have noticed it is spot on, and extends beyond our table. Server presence is as expected, and I am impressed by their attention to detail. Corrections to kitchen mishaps are being resolved proactively. The manager that replied and that we saw face to face at least three times during the night was described as "being a very happy man at his job" by my daughter.

TL;DR
The service feels like it made up for two times
Management presence was beyond phenomenal ... before and during our visit.
Food was outstanding. Good ol' American barbeque

This place is obviously good. There's always a line when I drive by. The earlier you can go the better, that way there isn't much of a wait. If you're wanting a savory breakfast this is the place to go. The meats, the hash, the potatoes, all the goodness! But I didn't give it 5 stars because they don't have much when it comes to sweets. They have cinnamon rolls and poppyseed pancakes. But if you're wanting berry French toast or crepes or anything sweet, probably best to go somewhere else.

Study's is middle of the road. Have eaten there twice, last time my French dip au jus was cold. Take a sweater and plan on being chilly there. Also, do not plan on being asked if you want a second drink. They cut you off at one. Because I do not feel as if they care about customers, I won't return.

Great place for "real" food, Hawaiian style :) Not true Hawaiian, IMHO (I'm a Honolulu native), but really tasty "fusion" style tropical food. I recommend the luau pork bowl with teriyaki sauce - perfect. Get the full size bowl and save half for tomorrow's lunch. Also, they do a lot of BOGO coupons, so keep your eyes open.

Came to get some fries, and the guy at that took our order and greeted us at the window gave amazing customer service. His name was Frisbie, and he told us a quality joke & made a quick yet quality conversation. This may be irrelevant to others reading reviews, If anyone even does, but it was just a really nice change of pace going through a fast food drive through and seeing someone that doesn't make it apparent they hate their life. I'd like to see that more often, fast food counts too  frisbie, if you're reading this- can't wait to hear your music!! Thanks for being a cool dude

This place gets rave reviews and my wife and I live a few blocks down and it took us forever to eat here. We weren't impressed. Neither one of us liked our meals and it's prices were steep in my opinion. I've only been once though to be fair so I'll give it another chance.
The bottomless fries has turned into a very small portion. I didn't even get enough to equal a small fry at McDonalds. And then the replacement takes forever

came here to check it out because we had stopped by the adjacent hospital. tried various bowls and it was pretty good. However the ratio of rice to toppings was way off and therefore I found it to be over-priced. You pay for chicken and you get like 2 cubes, so not worth it. They charge 50 cents per cup to have flavored water with cucumber or lemon, all other places give it for free!
