The food itself is a 2 star at best; sorry Im comparing this to places in southern California where Im from and this is just the standard of eating. Then the owner comes up to us and tries to sell us hard on how this is the best antioxidant rich cancer fighting food. I understand that is his vision but to come up to us 3 times and just go on and on and on is really annoying. I do think it is a healthier option than many of the immediately surrounding places though. Bottom line: if the place was more chill as in not in your face about all the antioxidants, anti inflammatories, etc, that the water was free, and the ratios of veggies/meats to rice in the bowls were less obscured I'd give it higher stars.

It's a Monday night and were hungry and excited to go to Genos in meridian because we have had such great experiences at the old one downtown.  We did not make a reservation but figured we would get in no problem. When we first walked in the gentleman working the host station did not say one word to us. After a couple of awkward moments I say "just two of us; we did not make a reservation ". Then he replies with "would you like a bar table or table in dinning room?"  We chose a table in dinning room. Before the kid could say a word a very professional lady roiling silver ware right behind him yelled something at him. I am not sure what she said but instantly the guy changed his mind and he told us we could only sit in the bar area. Ok, this is at eight o clock and they serve dinner until nine thirty. Come on, I know you want to go home but this is no way to treat almost paying customers, just a little effort is all we ask. You are getting paid, correct? 

        So after that we finally get to our little table shoved all the way in the corner of the bar. Which is completely empty with one or two people sitting at the bar. I am thinking to myself, "wow they really want us here!" The host gives our menus and says a server will be right with you. This is were the fun really begins,already I am  mad about the great service we got coming through the door. I start my timer on my phone to see when the first person comes to greet us with some more stellar service. we were shoved In the corner but I can clearly see the bartender chatting up a customer and an older guy walking around behind the bar and a server on the floor. I will say this, if I am treated like a human and made to feel welcome I will wait fifteen minutes for a server to come to my table. It just takes a little respect. On this particular night I was treated like trash and made to feel below a human. so after the fifteen minutes of silence with out even a  hello or will be right with you, it pushed me over the edge. We left pissed of and told the kid at the counter that no one ever came to our table. As you can imagine he did not care at all. 
        This is no way to run a business, like I said we were very excited to come to the newish Genos and give it a try. Now every one I see or talk to about it will hear how horribly overrated this place is.  Geno it makes you look like garbage when you let people like that run your establishment. Hard to imagine the guy that use to walk around to our tables and ask how everything was would let someone like these two  run his place. I will never be back. If you Want good service and great Italian food go to alivita in down town Boise. Five stars on any night of the week! Believe me If I could give zero stars I most definitely would.
My wife and I eat here often.  Fresh, "clean" and healthy besides being GREAT tasting.  Would recommend it to anyone.  Great value for the dollar as well.

Favorite pizza in Treasure Valley.  I run more so I can eat more of their pizza. It's crazy good!  Service has always been great and the food always prepared well.  All pizza is not created equal. I am more than happy to spend an extra $5 for a GREAT pizza. I think the wine selection was pretty good too...

As you can see reviews are so subjective. Our experience was great (my husbands yelp account) we drive a large Rigg, tow a Jeep and found our accommodations excellent. Easy in, easy out and a nice clean space. A tree, grass and a picnic table! We also had a great neighbor. All that aside, we headed towards OR into the smokey areas and turned around. I called the KOA Boise Office in a panic knowing we had no reservation and we would have to completely "remap" our entire trip! Shirley in the office calming said come back, she will get us in, not to worry! Thanks Shirley for the great customer service! I hope others are as fortunate as we were!

Have read some kinda of bad reviews about this place. I think some reviewers can be overly sensitive to things. Over the course of a year, I travel for about 6 months for my job. I am currently here at this hotel and have been here for almost two weeks. 

PROS:

- Newer facility. Nice spacious rooms. If you are like me and stay at Candlewood Hotels a lot, it is on PAR with the other ones. 

- I like the laundry facility. Lots of washing machines. I think there is 6 plus a oversized one with as many dryers. The other Candlewoods and hotels I have stayed at only have had 2 machines and in a small room. This is a large laundry facility.

- The spa looks really nice! First one I have seen at a Candlewood. Haven't had time to use it yet, but looking forward to doing so. 

- The staff here is very nice and helpful! I had an issued with my key card (I think I scratched it), the attendant at the front desk came up and he changed the batteries in the electronic lock. 

- Price is pretty good. I think its at $90 a night. 

NEUTRAL:

- Parking lot was very icy, but it was -2 out for about a week at night. It was like this every in town though.
Food was what we expected service was below average, was at the 8:50 on a Saturday night so I understand probably was a long night but still the service was below par for sure

This is a must visit place if you like Chinese food. We ordered Beef schezwan and Mandarin chicken ... both were delicious. We also ordered pot stickers from appetizer menu. The overall quantity is a lot , so you may skip appetizers as well. 
I hope to visit this very soon!

Delicious! Everything has been very tasty here. I usually stick to the tacos though. One thing I always do is ask for an extra side of the aioli sauce to add to my rice because it's a little dry and that sauce is awesome!

Rudy's is a great place to join your friends for lunch or after work. The food is consistent and they do have a full bar. In the evenings, parking can sometimes be a challenge. The ownership work hard in their business and it shows.
Food is average Italian.  Service is always slow so be patient. Geared towards locals for sure.

The review I had given previously for Rumba Island Grill was removed, evidently because I did not give enough detail.

My wife and ate lunch here for our first time and we were both very disappointed.  She had a rice bowl, which she found to be unappetizing.  The meat was not fresh, but was something that had been frozen and then heated up.  I had the fish tacos, which were very watery.  There was probably about 1/4 cup of fluid that drained out when I tried eating them.  This water, or whatever it was, flooded all over my plate.  The rice was very bland.  We even had a $5 off coupon which we got for signing up on their web site and still the lunch bill for 2 with drinks was $17 and we could not eat most of our meal.  Certainly can find better food for our money somewhere else.

Take a step back to the 50's! I love the kitschy feel of this classics bowling alley. They have a lunch special every Wednesday from 11-1pm:  a hamburger, fries and drink, plus 2 hours of bowling for 9 bucks. Not a bad deal, and the food is decent. Classic fun for the whole family!

Four of us stopped in for breakfast last Saturday a.m.  First visit.  Service is excellent, and the food is delicious.   I ordered a half order of the Traditional Eggs Benedict and Fruit in place of hash browns and toast.  I had plenty of food,  The benny had fresh, shaved ham on it, and I received a big generous bowl of fresh berries and thin-sliced canteloupe.  Very nicely done.  I like that they are attentive without hovering right over the table.  We enjoyed a relaxing, delicious breakfast.  Bottomless cup of coffee, with the first one poured within 30 seconds of when we arrived.   True sign of a professionally run breakfast biz.   Keep up the great work, you guys!

What is up with all the restaurants closed down in Boise???  Its literally like last restaurant standing or in Gino's case 1/2 standing cause this spot originally had to locations next to each other and one is now closed.  
Very solid Italian food, great variety of pastas, a little veal, a little lobster ravioli, but the homemade garlic, chili olive oil, mmmmmmmmmmmmm!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!  I really could have just ordered a glass of vino, had some bread and this secret homemade spicy olive oil concotion.  Its so goood, they even sell it by the bottle to take home!!!  
This a a medium size dining area and would imagine it gets busy witha a dinner crowd on a friday or saturday night.  Service was very good, i take that back Boise very good.

We tried this new place today and it is awesome! Very Friendly staff and awesome food...Great for breakfast and lunch and terrific menu too!
Make sure you stop in and check it out...

I just ate here for the first time and have to say it was amazing!!  I had the pulled pork sandwich with a side of fried green tomatoes and fried pickles.  I figured I was going to be ordering a typical pulled pork sandwich (stringy pork soaking in a vinegar bbq sauce), boy was I pleasantly surprised at what I got.  The grilled pork with the sauce is large chuncks and tastes wonderful.  The staff was super friendly and welcoming.  I have to agree with John V. and his review.  I will definately be going back to this place!!!

My family and I were visiting Meridian and decided to eat breakfast here because of the awesome reviews. It lived up to all of the positive things previous reviewers have said. The service was great, the servers were very nice, and the food was soooo delicious! I have a few family members with Celiac Disease, so gluten free options are a must. We were pleased to find out that most of their menu is gluten free and they also offer gluten free bread, pancakes, and French toast! Highly recommend eating here! We will definitely be back next time we're in Meridian.
It was convenient, fast and tasty. The concierge staff could have been a little more friendly. I got a chicken club and tater tots and they were good.

In town on a long business trip. Wanted Chinese Food, I read about this place on YELP - good reviews. I had carry out - General Chicken. 

PROS:

- The General Chicken was very good! Sometimes chicken from Chinese Food can get really tough to eat. Not this, it was cooked perfect and the sauce was spicy enough not too over powering.

- Pricing was great! Not cheap but not too expensive. 

CONS:

- The Wonton soup was very salty, I couldn't eat it. Some people like it this way. 

These types of restaurants are either a hit or a miss. This place is a good one and I would return on a future trip.
Decent north of the border Mexican fare.  Can't go wrong with the usual suspects like Carne Asada burritos and the like. The price is good.  keep in the mind it is what it is.
Best pizza I've had in a long time. Love the atmosphere and service.sitting on the patio let's you watch the water show. One of my favorite places.
I have been to this store 5 times.  I have received outstanding service every time. It's worth driving the extra distance to this store.

Picked up my hats today. Work looks great! A bit pricey though. I have 50 hats on order and was going to pay for them and the 8 they did for me up front to get their bulk pricing and I was told no. $10 a hat that I supplied was too much. Not willing to pay $500 for 50 hats I'm going to give away. Been in this town over 40 years and I try to keep money local, but I may have to shop around for this next job. Other than that,  satisfactory work.

Update 11/20. Total redemption. Jason stepped up and killed this time. Work quality was never an issue but service and price were. The new hats are awesome. The turn around was super fast. And the price was way better. Anyone can do a good job, but not many can come back from a poor experience. Dream Gig did! Highly recommended!
The corn beef hash is very good. I've tried other items on the menu which have not impressed me. The servers are very nice though.
Great to have Taco Johns back in the area. They have been slammed and the food quality suffers. Hopefully once things settle in, the quality will pick up.

Wow!  What an awesome anniversary dinner here tonight!  We had Matt, the same wonderful server that we had the last time we were in, back in the winter. Gino always comes by to check in on us, as well as all the other diners. We love this restaurant and will be back soon!

Great pizza, one of the best so far I have had in the area. They were quick to have our order ready for takeout and even though I wasn't of fan of any of their specialty pizza's we custom made one which was really good. Less greasy than say Flying Pie and the crust was a little harder which I like. We had the pepperoni and pineapple, our favorite. Pineapple was just the dole canned kind, but wasn't bad. Their cheesy twists are a must! A little doughy, but still delicious!

I like Chinese food but we seldom go to different ones coz we stay on our fav place. First time here. Greeted promptly, place is empty, there were just 3 customers pretty much. Waited a bit for our food, I believe they cook fresh coz I can hear them chopping & cooking. $8 for a fried rice & two special entree is great & large servings too, I took home more than what we ate. I think the food was too salty though, I understand it's Chinese food but it was a bit much esp with the rice & chow mein. Server was nice but she seems got irritated I think when I got confused ordering but she did ask if she will just come back. Btw, I came because I had a $6 coupon which took my bill down! Entertainment coupon book for the win!

A group of 15 met here for dinner. Nice atmosphere, great service. Bread sticks and salad were great, and everyone seemed to love the family platters we ordered: eggplant Parmesan, spicy chicken and shrimp, and chicken fettuccine. We also ordered two pizzas and those were quickly eaten up as well.

I once loved this place. My girlfriend and I loved taking our one year old son there to eat but after our last experience I don't think we will ever be returning. We had a really rude waitress that kind of made the whole experience suck. She wasn't very polite to us and she kept just forgetting about us all together. So after that awful experience I decided to sadly end my relationship with Grimaldi's.

OMG, this place is fantastic. My husband and I had the Korean Tacos and Fried Mac & Cheese Balls for appetizers. This was a great start to a wonderful meal. Had the Jambalaya Stuffed Pepper and the Garlic Shrimp for our entrees. This place is a Mom and Pop place and you can taste the love in their food. After speaking to Dominique, the charming daughter that waited on us, she let Mom know that we liked it spicy and our dishes were given a little extra kick. Going back on Sunday for their brunch. If you like good home cooking with a Cajun and island influence get to Shanaz before they close for the summer. You will not be disappointed.

Delicious brick oven pizza! Signed up for emails and got a free 18in pizza for my birthday, only had to pay for a salad! Definitely a little more spendy then your average pizza place but it's worth it! (Sometimes the pizza can be a little burnt & crispy but it's still great!)

This place is amazing ! The food was out of this world . We went there to celebrate our daughter getting into college and we had a great dinner. I do however recommend making reservations before you go .
This hotel is really nice! Great service at check in. The room is clean, bathroom is nice, and there's a full size fridge!! I'm very happy that I chose to stay here.

Good enough pizza. Good service. Cleanliness=gross. I was a little disappointed with the cleanliness. When we sat down the table was covered with the remnants of pizza from the table before. So was my seat, the entire bench really and my napkin. I watched the guy walking around getting the tables ready for the next customers next to us and he was just taking one brush with his hands leaving the crumbs where they are. Im sorry but I don't want to see what kind of pizza others had. It's gross. Please clean your tables better next time.

Phenomenal home style soul food fare. I took a pretty lady and we both absolutely loved it. I had the burger and dare I say, it was one of the best burgers I've ever tasted in my entire life. So much flavor and color it was amazing. Their signature sauce kills and made me want to hug my stomach and just sit there in food nirvana for a bit afterwards. 
The BLT, that said pretty lady ordered, looked amazing as well. Their menu had me torn up between four or five different things (How do you say no to fried macaroni and cheese balls?). I will... no I MUST go back.

We visited yesterday with a livingsocial deal and it was amazing!  The service was excellent, and we got a ton of food for two people for $16.80.  The Rumbi fries and Rumbi rice were really good.  Next time I'm getting the pulled pork bowl, it is the best entree meat.

Very good food, a little bit pricey, but very delicious. The service was terrible. I was with a large group, and as I understand they have to meet everyone's needs, they did not. Many people were not asked if they'd like drinks and the server was never over to ask how our food was once we'd received it. The manager was not in sight to inform him. I would go back to a different location, but not this one. The service ruined it for me.
The best pizza ever. This has become or fab pizza place. Sitting outside watching the fountain was great. The waitress was very friendly and the food came out quickly in spite of being busy.
Antipasto was decent. Tiramisu was average. Pizza was okay but it was pricey for the quality pizza. Service was okay.

First time visit and experience will bring me back again and again. We came Fathers Day, arriving early, or so we thought, to avoid the rush. Obviously a very popular place we've learned. Food was great and service very friendly and attentive. Try it, you'll like it.

Great customer service. I bought an iPhone for my son's graduation. Meranda helped me out and was very knowledgable about the process of switching phones. She went over the options for plans with me and found the best priced one for what I needed. I highly recommend this store and Meranda is the best!

We ate here a month or so ago.  Our waitress was very nice and tried hard to provide good sevice.  The appitiser was okay and the main dish was decent.  The problem was with the kitchen.  We waited and waited for our meal.  People that came in after us had eaten and we're leaving before we were served.  Our waitress kept checking on our meal as we watched heaping plates of food being delivered to other tables.  The kitchen had placed our order in the filled pile without filling it.  Once the waitress figured out what happened our meal quickly arrived but was skimpy compared to other people's orders.  A minute or two later the table next to us who ordered the same dish was served a skimpy plate.  It looked as if the kitchen split an order to get us served quickly.  There was no apology or anything from management.  The poor waitress was very embaressed.  We will not return not because of the food but because the staff sucks, except for the waitress.  I hope she didn't share her tip and finds a better company to work for.

Fiancé and I went here back to back nights after working out. I got a rice bowl with chicken and pork, and then steak and pork. The portions were large, and the sweet potato fries were great!  Will definitely be back!

I'd like to consider myself a regular of Moe Joe's - I eat here about once a week, usually on a weekday before I go in to work. I've got my meal down to a science - breakfast for beginners, consisting of two eggs your way, your choice of moe joe potatoes or hash browns plus your choice of toast and jam (including gluten free toast for an extra dollar). You can add bacon, ham or sausage for few dollars more. For breakfast, I like this lighter option - there's still a ton of food with this dish, and I never leave hungry. 

I have an intolerance to gluten, and I was happily surprised to find out that most of the menu is gluten free, including gluten free pancakes! The donut and cup of joe pancakes are delicious, and an awesome treat for someone who normally can't eat fancy flour-filled breakfast dishes (but oh boy am I envious of that cinnamon roll french toast). On the weekend, when I'm feeling something heavier for brunch, the rest of the menu is also amazing, offering up breakfast classics, a large choice of hash and frittatas, and a handful of Mexican inspired breakfast dishes. One memorable dish is Chilaquiles - chili verde pork, chicken, eggs, and black beans piled high on top of a plate of tortilla chips. My husband loved their maple bacon fried chicken and country fried steak. I have yet to try any of their lunch options, generally because all of their breakfast choices speak to me more. 

I do have one critique - sometimes I've found their dishes to be underseasoned. I will say this seems to happen more often on the weekends, when the place can be jam packed, with hoards of people waiting outside the door. This has happened a hand full of times now, but it isn't enough to stop me from coming back, week after week. All in all, I fully enjoy my time spent eating at Moe Joe's. The wait staff are friendly and attentive. The building is small, but the high ceilings make it feel a lot bigger. It's warming up now, and there's a small patio area out front. This place is my go-to breakfast joint.

I've tried this location about 4 times since it opened thinking each time it's got to be better...., it's got to be better and to be honest the food here is so disgusting and overpriced it's ridiculous. Their tater tot's are randomly over seasoned so periodically you bite into one with so much seasoning on it it makes you want to vomit. The beans are always old and nasty and like glue. The food just all-around is terrible.....especially for the money.
Love the building, ambiance and decor.  Annie was our server, she was great!  My husband is annoyed that we were charged an extra 99 cents for cheese bread with our salads.

I saw good reviews and wanted to try it. The service was haphazard and impersonal.  We missed lunch ($7.95) by 30 minutes so we had to order diner ($11.95) so it totaled about $25 with no drinks.  The chicken fingers (part of the diner) were the basic minimum and the egg roll another basic minimum with a small amount of cabbage in it.  We had a choice of 3 different rices, so we chose the one the waitress suggested (chow rice).  It was a large portion but minimally a cheaper grade of rice,(sort of bland).  The main dishes were reasonably good. The decor is nice but we were seated about 8 feet from the area where they put the dirty dishes or should I say throw the dishes.  Some of the sounds coming from there actually startled me, several times. We decided not to return.

Some of our dishes were good, others weren't. Wouldn't come back. Prices are good not great. Open 24 hours though. Some one in our group got a taco, but it come with basically only chicken. Avoid this place unless it's 3AM!
Great place to buy good quality clothes and brands like Talbots at great prices. Very well organized and friendly ladies who work there.
Absolutely delicious pizza! We will definitely be back next time we are in town. Great service, and a nice casual restaurant....
OMG!  This is extraordinary.  Fish so fresh!  Service wonderful!  I will always visit this place every time I come through Boise.  Watch the diners' plates for pleasure parade. Wonderful wonderful!
Very good! Service was great, food came quickly and was nice and hot! Fruit was fresh, not junk out of a can and the coffee was good.

I've rerated my review.  Finally got in to try the pizza.  Excellent pizza and service was good.  Manager made sure we were taken care of. Only thing that I would gripe about is the ice tea was on the weak side, No ranch dressing,  which they claim that that isn't real Italian,  well neither is catsup,  but 100% of the restaurants have it. The same goes for there reasoning on Canadian bacon. Come on ( it's pizza) give the customer what they want.

Thank you guys for your patience with my confusing order. So many others turned me away and instead of being like them you guys sat down and actually helped me figure out what I exactly wanted. Beth at the front is so sweet and so helpful answering all my questions.  You guys are amazing and there's nothing more to say other then a huge thank you. So THANK YOU again very much.

Good old italian restaurant, with lots of options for you to choose from. They allowed my parents to customize their own pasta, which is always a plus. 

Fresh bread to start, and the dry chili, oil & ginger dip that came with it was pretty amazing tho. I got the pasta al granchio with penne, it was alright; you can't go wrong with a simple italian dish. 

Our waitress Allissa was really nice tho! & the wait staff were all really friendly.

Food is almost always consistent, prices only ever slightly raise, the waiters are typically consistent for a commercial restaurant...some better than others but never a "bad" waiter. Always a great place to find a juicy huge burger for a great price along with their AWESOME Steak Fries and sauces. Milkshakes my kids (and significant other) LOVE, their salads are huge and yummy, and their BLTA Croissant is a perfect pick for a lunchtime meal. Great for groups, great for kids as it's loud in general in there and cleanup of spills/mess is easy due to their stained concrete floors and smooth table tops. Always a great "Go-To" as they have something for everyone. I "wouldn't" recommend for a romantic date night or important business meetings due to as I said the noise level and high traffic rate can be quite distracting. Cheers Red Robin, keep it up!

Ate on a Sunday morning around 10 so there was a wait. We had omelets which were only a step up from Denny's.  The potatoes could have been warmer. We did have good toast and strawberry jelly. The breakfast burrito passed us and looked huge. If you go I'd try this.
Super nachos with ground beef! You won't be sorry you tried them.

Went to Red Pavillion on a Monday evening after comparing reviews for other Chinese restaurants in the Eagle-Meridian area. Based upon ratings, we decided to go to RP.  We made reservations and were seated as soon as we walked in. Our waitresses were attentive and knowledgeable.  My wife picked the Mandarin Beef and I had the Szechwan Spicy Chicken. Both meals were delicious. The Szechwan Chicken may have been the best Szechwan meal I've ever had. Being from California, we have thousands of choices of Chinese and truly the Red Pavillion may be one of the best Chinese restaurants we've ever visited. Throughout the meal, the ladies checked to make sure we had everything we needed. It was truly a wonderful experience. We highly recommend the Red Pavilion.

My husband and I are visiting our kids in Idaho and we decided to go out to breakfast. We hit the jackpot. We got the corned beef hash and shared it and we still brought leftovers home. The potatoes were crunchy on the outside and soft on the inside. Perfect! The hash was probably the best we've ever had.... And we have had a lot. 
You NEED to go here! Very reasonable prices. All home cooked. Loved every bite!
The brisket was way fatty and the food came out too quick. You could tell it was microwaved. Pretty expensive for what you get.
Great food and always great service. Waiters always know excellent wine pairings. The owner typically comes around to talk to people to see how their food and service are.

I considered giving this place three stars, but used my better judgement and gave it two. 

Pros
The wait staff was nice enough. Clean restaurant. To-go orders were prompt.  The bread and olive oil was fantastic together. I loved the fresh garlic in the olive oil. 

Cons-
The food had minimal seasoning. The cook forgot half of our order. The food just wasn't appealing. The sauce was more of a paste. 


Will we return?
Probably not.
Great prime rib French dip and Philly cheese steak. Outstanding service. Try it for lunch.
Great haircut, free neck touch ups between hair cuts, friendly service! Dennis thanks for beautifying my boyfriend! $21 covered a cut and shampoo!
Jimmy John's.. want a fast tasty sub sandwich...This is the place...  Simple and fast sandwiches.  Did I mention FAST!.... insanely fast..  Second only to COBBY's  but fast and good.

I have always loved Ginos and it is the only place in my opinion other than my own kitchen to get good Italian food!
I am so sad that downtown has closed and find the new location to be a very odd choice
It was always the place to go on a date or celebrate a birthday then go onto a movie or another event or dancing downtown not the case anymote.
I will still dine there but not as often
The meats are always great. Fresh bread but the Lasagna and Raveoli are my favs
Rumbi; your burger and sweet potatoes fries are the BoMB! Better than THE Counter ANY DAY of the week.

This place is definitely 5 star Boise Chinese food. Of course, I'm not comparing it to the Chinatown fare from SFO or NYC coz that would be extremely unfair! One of the better Chinese food places in Boise for sure. We've been there a few times and the food has been consistently good. They do have Americanized and more authentic food, both, so depends on what you get. The hot and sour soup was OK but the Szechuan food is pretty awesome. It is a little spicy and they had even thrown in some Szechuan peppercorns, which I love! Both the chicken and beef was nice. 

The ambience is better than most other Chinese places around Boise. Clean and modern. We've never had  problems getting a table though it does get a fairly crowded sometimes. Would definitely recommend!

I've never had a bad experience at joy garden. The egg rolls are like nothing I've ever had before.  Service is always fantastic and the cuisine always top notch. Why do you take out or dine in one of the best oriental places to eat in town!
I like the archer juice and salsa and kayaker bowl. The owner is nice and passionate about health.

Food was good, service was GREAT! Was helped by a couple different servers, and both were super helpful and friendly. The sushi chefs decorated our plates with beautiful designs. I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a pleasant sushi experience.

I ordered the balsamic vinaigrette grilled portobello mushrooms and a margherita pizza. The mushrooms were great, not overdone, and perfect mix of flavors. The margherita pizza was a dream. The crust was the perfect crispy on the outside, soft on the inside, and they make it brick oven. The sauce was incredible--not too sweet or heavily spiced. Definitely tastes homemade. The basil was incredibly flavorful and fresh. The ambiance was perfect, we sat on the patio. The music was great. The service was excellent, with attentive staff and friendly waiters. The owner himself came out to check on us and nearby tables--I really really liked that. Would come here again. It's fancy enough for a romantic dinner or business, but casual enough for daytime eats. New fave Italian in the area.

Nice new breakfast spot. 
Food and service was good. A little on the pricy side for the sizes of the portions. Coffee was very good and we had very good service. Nice and clean too.
The restaurant is rather loud with music coming from somewhere that I'm guessing could have been the kitchen. In the span of our breakfast we heard obnoxiously loud rap, heavy metal, country and pop music - all it thumping loud. NOT what I want to be listening to in the morning. It actually will cause me to consider going back.
It was very clean and that is incredibly important to me. The pizza was hot and  delicious. The service was outstanding and the people were very friendly.

We came in last Friday night Sept 9th.  Probably worst Italian food we've had, ever.

The good:  Décor, ambiance, bar and minestrone soup.  It is bad when only 1 food item is part of your good list.........

The BAD:

Bruschetta:  Stale and chewy crostini.  Not sure how they cooked the crostini to get that texture but it was not what you typically find.  Thinking it may have been baked not grilled.  The topping was even worse.  Under ripe tomatoes with TONS of garlic.  Note to the owner/chef....there is more to this dish than those two ingredients.

Mozzarella Garlic Bread:  Seriously the dipping sauce (if you can even call it that) was tomato puree from the can.  No flavor and cold

4 Main Dishes: 

Rotolini Melanzane.  This was one of the server's top reco's out of close to, no joke, 100's of items on the menu.  So gave it a try.  Zero flavor besides the 2lbs of cheese on top.  Eggplant was chewy and not sure there was even prosciutto on it due to the obscene amount of cheese.

Rigatoni with Sausage/Mushrooms.  Sauce tasted like canned tomato paste/puree (think they used the same stuff from the bread).  Zero flavor and again HUGE amounts of unnecessary cheese.  Note....think they are using the cheese to hide bad cooking.

Veal Piccata.  My dad wanted Veal Marsala but the server said that they don't always have the necessary ingredients to make it as it is not a regular menu item.  Really????  You only seriously have over a 100 items on the menu but can't make a Marsala sauce that every other Italian restaurant has on the menu?  Pathetic considering just how big the menu is.  

4th Main.  Can't remember as my brother had it.  He only ate half which isn't a good sign for him.

All this on top of waiting a very long time for our meals even though we were in later in the evening and most remaining tables had completed their main courses.  No idea what took so long.  And to top it all of the server gave some mumbling apology with the bill about things happening in the kitchen that never should.  What?  So he knew it was bad but did nothing about it while waiting or with the bill.

Terrible all the way around.  Won't be back next time ever again when we visit.

I love their salads and their volcano salmon is a great deal.  You get a ton of food when you eat at Rumbi's.  I like their ice tea too.  Can't go wrong with their menu choices.  Fun decor and very fast service.  Sign up for their emails and you get coupons sent regularly.

garbage service. can't comment on the food because i'm still waiting to get it an hour later.

update: the food was garbage as well. there was a fresh curly hair on the food too.

Food here is amazing and always tastes great. Been here multiple times and will always go back. No matter how busy they are the wait staff is good. Only giving 4 stars because although it still tasted good I ordered my eggs over medium and they were over easy but the food was still good.
Wonderful place! Great food, very classy environment. Prices were reasonable and they had quite a few different choices. We for the sushi platter which we really enjoyed.

Oh goodness, this was my first time to this restaurant and it was pretty incredible.  I really liked the decor, rustic, but very clean and inviting, down home feeling.  Lots of knick knacks to look at while we waited for the rest of our party to show up.  The server was to us in minutes and took our drink order, leaving us with the menus.  After about 10 minutes our other stragglers showed up and it was time to order.  We were all looking at different menu items, but finally decided on the All American BBQ Feast (serves 4-6).  It has chicken, ribs, pulled pork, corn bread muffins, beans, steak cut fries, and we ordered mashed red potatoes.  

Let me first rave about the chicken (a whole one to boot). It was probably the best tasting BBQ chicken I have ever had.  Hot, juicy, smoky deliciousness.  Perfectly cooked, definitely not dried out.  Then the ribs... St. Louis style, come dry but you can add your choice of sauces at the table.  Yummy sauces!  Ribs were perfection, chewy, smoky and not dried out.  Pulled pork, only had a small bit of that, though I will pass on that in the future.  I guess I have never realy cared for it, and this was no different.  Tho my daughter-in-law loved it.  Corn bread, hot, moist and wonderful.  The baked beans were super good too.  Bacon, onions, brown sugar, molasses, vinegar and the beans were not mushy, like the kind you find in cans.  Yummy!!  The steak fries were amazing.  Crisp on the outside, soft and tender on the inside. PERFECT amount of salt and that is so hard to do, most places under season, Famous Dave's nailed it.

Server paid good attention to us, came around often enough, but was not intrusive.  Table was a mess with saucy napkins, but we left with an enormous doggie bag and have every intention of returning.  This is a place to bring out of town guest!  I'm hooked on this BBQ.

Tried out this place based on Yelp reviews and so glad I did. :) They take walk-ins, super friendly and clean, good prices, and great chairs. So, if you need a pedicure, try
them! :)

The service was absolutely horrible. The food was good of course. But I felt like I wasn't even wanted there. He barely checked to see if we needed anything until after we were done. I had to get up and get my own sweetener for my tea.

As a seasoned Yelp critic I pride myself on dining at only the finest of establishments and holding them to highest standards humanly possible. Now that, that, is out of the way lets begin the review...

It is Friday evening in "downtown" Boise and the night life is a bumpin. As I approach the parking lot I notice there are only two cars parked. "Are they remodeling the Robin?" I thought to myself, as it is very odd for such a fine establishment to not be packed to the entrance. Normally I would have made reservations, however this was a last minute decision. As I enter, there is a young man blowing up balloons. Normally I would say "yeah blow all the balloons you can" however he was filling an empty room with balloons. When there are more balloons than patrons... you have a problem. I stand there waiting for him to get up when a young lady appears and ask if we have been helped. I replied "No, I've been watching this kid blow more balloons than a clown on tour" so it was at this moment I was finally seated. Instead of a human helping me I had this robot etch a sketch thing take my order. I own a Razr flip phone so I am out of touch with all these fancy gadgets. I finally figure out the hieroglyphics key code in order to request an order. My burger was good. They skimped super tough on the fries which confused me since the entire place was basically empty. When I order unlimited fries I never want to see the bottom of the basket. I stared deeply into the checkered lining paper for 10 minutes before a refill was brought to me. I had to practically beg for more honey mustard. That stuff is the dank. 

Will I return? Probs not as I have had better service at Oil Can Henrys.

We were really sad when our favorite Chinese restaurant closed four years ago. We have been looking ever since and finally four years later found something even better. The fried rice is Amazing! The portions are a lot bigger if you eat in the restaurant rather than do take out. We also love the spring rolls. The service is fantastic.

Seriously?! How is it possible that this food magic has existed so close to me & this is the first time I've been invited to the party?!? I ordered the garden hash & is SWEAR it was as if it literally came straight from a garden; FRESH spinach, baby tomatoes, zucchini, whole roasted garlic cloves....and more stuff than I can remember. There might have been mythological Goddess sauce or something not mentioned on the menu.  The red potatoes are delectable, eggs cooked perfectly & they subbed Hollandaise for the Swiss cheese without charging me extra (I hate that!). Also, the whole wheat Berry toast is worth the trip alone...thicker slices of chewy whole wheat bread all full of nuggety goddness!! I can't wait to come back again. Just be sure to come a little early...there's been a line the whole time I've been here, but it goes quickly enough!! The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because I, personally, like a cozy, quiet environment & this is a fun, bright awesome breakfast place environment...go figure! Also, they have wifi!

Been here twice, first time was awesome!! Second time after bragging to my husband about it, it wasn't good, the biscuits and gravy came out like it was under a heat lamp (literally cooked on top) but when you took a bite cold. We will try again tho.

I am a long time Gino's and Gino's Grille fan. I used to drive to Boise to eat there now it has moved in about 1 mile from my house.  YUM and that screams disaster for any of my personal dieting plans as I will want to go so often.  My husband and I sat outside and started off with a beautiful fresh salad with blue cheese dressing.  It was a lovely presentation and was so good.  We both had Gnocchi Quattro Formaggi (four cheese) as our main course.  We added fresh parmesan so really it was a five cheese gnocchi.  So delicious.  The bread is fabulous and is served with oil with a bit of a kick.  GREAT service and wonderful atmosphere.  We will be back soon!

Really good food and very nice people who work there! I've been pleased each time I visit. I've only been there three times and plan on making more visits. 

I love how they change up the decor. I enjoy the music they play. It almost has the feel that you're in someone's house. Definitely a good feel. 

Keep up the good works!

And, on my last visit, I noticed the sushi on the other side of the building. Who knew!?!?

This place is awesome!!!
Excellent food consistently and outstanding service! The portions are huge 
We were in town for a week and have eaten here every day.
We will be back for sure the next time we visit Boise
Great fast service! 4 new tires and alignment done in less than 2 hours! Clean and warm inside:)

The drink menu was very limited and the taste was not impressive. I could make a better margarita at home. There was a mojito listed on the menu but  were told they don't make those. 

We ordered a full rack of baby back ribs and a brisket. The ribs were burnt beyond recognition. The brisket was okay.

Who would come here for "naked" ribs ?

I switched to this location from the location at Fairview and Eagle due to the fact that this location is closer to home. Got right in and had a good haircut the first time by Denise. My hair is not easy to cut, but she did an awesome job! Thanks!

The food and atmosphere here are great. The owner comes to your table, and offers to custom make things pending on your preferences. Everyone was very polite. Restaurant is in an old home, however has multiple tables both inside and outside and seems to be quite a large restaurant for what you expect. That is very tasty. We had duck and lamb chops, both were excellent!

I'm going to start by saying I wasn't feeling well this morning. But my eggs weren't right the potatoes weren't great (overly salty) toast was eh. Water refreshing. Customer service was great. All in all worth a try.

Worst customer service I have ever experienced in my life. Spent over $15,000 on an outdoor kitchen. Kegerator broke a year ago. They found the code is under warrantee all Pristine had to do was order a new one and replace the broken. It's now been 6 months since the new one was ordered. Haven't heard from them. I've spoken with Jake and Matt several times. Matt said in October, "I will get this taken care of." Now December and I'm calling again since no results or responses. Further I sent 2 emails before phone calls and no responses to those either. 

AVOID THIS COMPANY AT ALL COSTS. THEY DO NOT CARE ABOUT YOU OR THEIR PRODUCTS.

It was amazing food.... Very filling! Our service was good. The problem with our visit was it took 50 minutes to receive our food. The wait to be seated was not very long, but I feel I wasted my time waiting for a meal.

Thanks Moe Joe's!! 

Your food is delicious!  Hands down, The best breakfast in the Treasure Valley.  My son Cameron and I have made this our go-to place for fresh biscuits and an awesome breakfast burrito!  The Coffee is the bomb!

Not only is the food wonderful, but the service is even better!  We had Taylor about the last 4 times and she is is so friendly and sweet!  Not to mention fast and always gets our order right!  She deserves a raise!!  



Thanks Taylor and Moe Joe's!  We will be back again...and again.....and again!!!!

-Chip & Cameron

We love to come to Idaho pizza for lunch. Their buffet is always a plus. Usually if you want a specific pizza made or a special request, you can just ask and they'll make it for you. 
However, some flavors they only make half a pizza, like Hawaiian. Then you ask them to make a full pizza and they say "Hawaiian isn't popular enough". I say that's bogus, because EVERY time I see it, it flies off the budget line. 
When we went, I seriously kept getting told that they were mailing a Hawaiian pizza. Then the worker would come let me know and I kid you not, by the time I made it up there it was gone. So this time, Michael could see that I was frustrated and he had them make a full Hawaiian pizza and he then actually brought the whole thing to our table Because 3 of us were wanting Hawaiian. 
Great job man.

This would have been our first time at this restaurant , upon arrival we were greeted poorly by a blonde waitress . She seemed annoyed with us even showing up. Before we could even ask if there was available seating she said there is a wait firmly. Then we asked is there seating at the bar? She replied yes. She walked us over and said OH there is only one seat. We said ok then how long is the wait? This is the part that surprised me she said 3 hours, yep you herd right 3 hours. We then proceeded to leave were she was happy to escort us out.

I love me some Taco Johns!!!  Not authentic Mexican by any stretch, but just tasty food! Potato Ole's? Shoot yeah! Churro? Can't go wrong! And dip anything in that heavenly cheese sauce and it is delicious. Most everyone there is friendly and really accommodating. And Mountain Dew!

Came in early with the family for breakfast before heading to church. We weren't in a rush yet pleasantly greeted with prompt friendly service. I had the half order of eggs florentine with fruit and was not disappointed. Very tasty so I'll order the full order next time. Their special (I think) for that morning was strawberry short cake French toast. We think the French toast was actually short cake batter poured into a round mold and cooked. Super sweet but crazy good! Eating a whole order will probably give you diabetes. All the food was very good. The service is great and the interior is better than what the exterior presents. Our server was fantastic at keeping my coffee full and even offered a cup of coffee to go. What a great thing to offer.

I've been to Idaho pizza many many times, but today was the first time attending the all you can eat pizza and salad bar.  The salad bar delicious and the pizza constantly coming out fresh and tastey. My only advise is to make sure you get there before its a madhouse of people.
Good food (I recommend the curry chicken), always great service.

This place has the BEST meal called the "Fiesta Hash" it was amazing!  Great service by Taylor and the entire staff!
Great place for a Sunday Brunch.

Last time we will ever visit this establishment.  Food took over 1 hour to get to the table.  Granted we were with a large party but they were aware of table.  Ordered the flat iron steak at over $30.00.  Steak was inedible, cold.  Not one apology for was made and owner didn't come and apologize and avoided our table. Service was so so.  Each time we come it is the same thing, mediocre service and horrible food.  Never again.

Divine wine cork and Fork is our sanctuary.  The food is the bomb, we have had the Tuna, Shrimp, Beef, Chicken and everything in between.  Sometimes off the menu they have select items such as Lobster and Duck.  We just can't get enough of having a cozy place to relax and enjoy a nice wine.  They have a bottle wall and also a menu on the table.  If you like something a bit more upscale they have a library that you can ask to see some special selections in.  If you have a favorite and want an occasion a quick call ahead can have it waiting for you.  The staff has been outstanding and if you go in more then once you most likely will be called by your name.  Doug the owner fills in everywhere, he's in the kitchen, mingling with guests and occasionally singing with the entertainers.  As of this writing they are having live music on several nights a week.  Sitting close to the entertainers is fun and very involving for the guests.  During the summer as weather permits they have a huge patio for a lovely evening.  I have not went to the cigar room, but I hear it's nice.  They also have plenty of room for special parties. If I was to open a restaurant this mixture of food, friends and fun would be my goal. I applaud you and will be back to your door soon.

A group of coworkers and I decided to visit K-Fusion for lunch today, as we'd heard good things and seen their lunch specials online. 

Unfortunately, they don't have any lunch specials at the Meridian location--only the Boise one. That bumps up the average meal price to about $12-15/person instead of $8-12. Not a deal breaker, but something we all would have appreciated knowing in advance. It took us about 15 minutes for a waitress to come around and for us to discover that information. 

On that note, the overall service was consistently slow. It took us at least 15-20 minutes to get an order in, and while the food came promptly, it was another 10 minutes before the check was delivered, another 10 or so to pick up our cards (I ended up just finding the waitress to give them to) and yet another 10 to get our cards back. For a lunch joint, they need to work on speeding up their service or hire additional waitstaff. 

The food itself was quite tasty. The portions aren't huge, but they are satisfying. The teriyaki chicken was a table favorite and the dumplings made for a good starter. I'm not sure the prices justify what you get, but I don't really have complaints about the food itself. 

In summary: I'm not sure I would go back (especially for lunch) unless I knew I could be done in an hour, and if I knew I could get a good lunch special. There are plenty of other restaurants in the area that can serve a group more quickly and provide equally good (if not even better) food.

Greeeeeeeasy. My burger was so greasy. Fries were good, but my burger left me hurting for sure!

The waitress was super nice though, so there's that...

Great big burritos and chips. I would recommend if u enjoy watching your food being created in front of your eyes. Only downside is the line is usually long so it may take like 10 minures to get your food.
Good cheap mexican food. Nuff said.

This place was dirty, no one acknowledged me or said excuse me when the pushed in front of me and their "dressing rooms" are a hole in the wall with a narrow sheer curtain to shield yourself. Totally not worth the trip.

Not impressed with K Fusion. This was my first time and it was me and 2 other people in the restaurant and like 8 employees running around. I took the buffet bar from what the menu said would have some good options. I get to the buffet line and it has only about half of what the menu said it would and most of the labels out of place and on the wrong item. The rice was dry and not very sticky. The tea tasted funny so did the soup. They charge $16 for the buffet and it's not really worth it, if you don't eat everything on the plate they will charge you for that as well. I gave it 3 stars but leaning towards 2 stars. I would recommend trying it but that's about it.

We went to wingers around 3:30/4 tonight. We were very disappointed; my husband had the wingers burger that didn't have any flavor and his fries were not crispy but thick, soft and starchy.  We had the fried asparagus which was huge and tough. The food just wasn't the quality it could have been.

the most random thing i discovered on my way back to the midwest.  an italian restaurant that had some of the best italian i've ever had.  

come to think of it, the other great italian place i love is in seattle and is called Perche No, and it's owned by the Wongs.  yep - you read right.  but they make a damn fine italian meal.

gino's is authentic, down home, real italian.  filling, too- i had a lot of left overs and couldn't take them home because i was traveling.  however, come on an empty stomach and just fill up on this great stuff!!

the staff was a bit over attentive for my taste, but the food was great.  and better over attentive than under attentive, i guess.
Moe Joe's serves a generous breakfast. Good coffee. The patio seating is a definite plus.

We moved to DC about a year ago and I still miss this place.  This was my absolute favorite place to go.  The salads are awesome as is everything else.  My favorite is the sweet pork salad. YUM!  My wife and I have been hoping for something like this out here but have still not found it.

I am a Red Robin fan and have been for ten plus years. The service must be a "Sunday crew".  My server whistled a high pitch sound while moving about the bar area. The bar tender was using profanity and ignoring customer while tending to the bar. When I came in around 2:30 pm. Myself and other customers were waiting for a clean table. Four tables had old food and dishes on them. I'm not sure if there was a buster for tables. The server also dropped his tray very loudly and seemed all disoriented. I'm surprised because I have heard he standards are held high for service here. Note to self not to come here on Sunday.

I don't even know where to start. Red Pavilion has amazing food! We went in with a party of 12 for lunch on a Sunday and they quickly got us set up, no problem. The service was fantastic. Our group is learning Chinese and as soon as we spoke a little to our server, she spoke to us the entire time in Chinese. The portions are huge!! If you get any of the noodle soups you will probably be taking some home if you don't share. Ask about the "authentic" menu. It's a separate menu with more authentic dishes (although their main menu is great too!) I ordered the homemade beef noodle soup from the authentic menu. It's the best beef noodle I've had in the States and took me back to my time in Taiwan. The broth was excellent and the portions of beef were generous, super tender, and absolutely delicious. They have awesome lunch specials and even those portions are huge too. They are also very accommodating to personal taste. If you want less salt, a different kind of meat, or tofu instead of the chicken your dish normally contains, they'll do that for you and happily! The best Chinese food in Boise.

This place is a fraud! I went in for garlic fries after craving them all week. I recently visited Wingers in Elko for the first time. My garlic fries in Elko were saucy and delicious with chunks of fresh sautéed garlic and yummy aioli. This place claims to have the same garlic fries and truth be told they were regular fries in plain ol' seasoning salt and the portion was a joke! $6 for a handful of crappy fries. Never again will I be visiting this spot.
One gets plenty of food at Gino's and the wait staff is very prompt. The menu can be tailored to your liking which is a huge plus.

The service was very slow. 1 waitress in the bar area. She ran her rear off and did a wonderful job. Drinks were so so
 The food was average. Won't be eating here again soom.

The server jessica very good, accomodating and polite. Food over all as usual is great.....except for my ny steak which was rare and unevenly cooked which I ordered medium. Sent back and it was rare again on one side and the other side charcoal.  But heres the kicker;  The manager comped me half of the steak meal of which I ate about half and the rest was trash and taken away. So I ate roughly 40% and comped me half the meal. Have anyone ever seen a half comp  at a fine dining restaurant for a pretty bad mess up . I found it rather insulting personally. Bill was $107 and I tipped accordingly $20. But I'm dumbfounded at the "comp"

I only gave this 4 stars because no one is perfect. I am a Boise native so I know how unappealing most of the Asian restaurants around here are. My husband is from Seattle by way of the Philippines so we have had some really good Chinese food and this place is the best Chinese restaurant by far in Boise and I'm pretty sure we have tried them all. The food is always fresh always tastes amazing the service is impeccable even on a Saturday night when the place was completely full!

Great place. Good pizza for very attractive price! 
It was quite there. Unfortunately no wireless connection and that would make this place 5 starts.
Bottom line, clean place, good pizza and quick and friendly service

I created a Yelp account just to review this Red Robin. We love coming to this restaurant, but it is always a debacle to get things done right. 

Servers are pretty attentive however the hosts up front  don't know what a patio is, and are very confused when you ask to sit outside. They also look like they are solving world hunger when you ask for a table for two or more. lots of head scratching and staring at the little dry erase floor plans. There are plenty of open tables but they always act very surprised that you are there to eat and want to be sat at one of the many open tables. It's like waiting for VIP entrance to a club. 

We were here last night to get some dessert, this first picture cracks me up because it is just so ridiculous. Our dessert, which was a brownie, was still frozen and I could not even get a spoon through. So it boggles my mind how the ice cream on top was melted on a frozen dessert.

We complained, and got a new dessert however my new dessert looked like a bird. The whole thing was a mess and we took one bite and asked for it to be taken off our bill which they gladly did.

It's unfortunate how good the food is, but the experience is always laughable.

When famous Dave's 1st came to Boise, I thought it was pretty good. But I visited a few more times just to make sure. Im now convinced that my 1st visit was a fluke. Their version of Corn Bread is a sickly sweet Corn Bread Like, but not like real Corn Bread, Muffin.

The Brisket is very fatty and had a lot of gristle. The servers didn't seem to have a clue what they were doing. The only thing that seemed to stay consistent was the sauce. Their sauce is Ok, but the sauce over at Good Wood is better. The meat is much better too. Now that I think about it, dont waste your time herel, go to Good Wood.
Costa Vida has some of the best Mexican food in the area. They have great daily specials and has a good price. A great app as well that lets you gather points to have free meals! Great restaurant!

Went here for a date nights, so good! The bread to start out with is amazing! I ordered the ravioli and couldn't eat it fast enough! My husband ordered the chicken parm and that was yummy too. Great service plus wonderful food makes for a great place!
Quick service, no waiting, personal service, better prices than Costco. Greg and Jake are awesome.

These guys really know customer service and the rest of the place is clean, spacious with plenty of bays. The work here is spot on. I live 30 miles from here, will make the trip again...very worth the drive!

My boyfriend and I came in after work. The place wasn't busy at all and the service was very slow. The waitress wasn't friendly at all. The food was bland and lukewarm. Overall disappointing experience.

Very nice ambiance and friendly staff.  We started off with some delicious bread and olive oil mixed with herbs that was excellent.  My girl ordered the baked Ravioli and she liked it.  After reading the reviews, I was going to order the lamb shank but I am such a big fan of Marsala that I skipped the lamb shank and ordered the veal Marsala.  What a mistake.  The veal was flavorless and so was the pasta.  After adding tons of salt, it was still bland and I was really disappointed.  Gino came by asking if things were OK and later I regret not telling him.  I will be going back to try something else but I was very disappointed with my meal.  :(  I really want to like the place.  I like having a nice Italian restaurant in Meridian.  Next time I go, I will be ordering the lamb shank and will write another review.  3 stars for nice ambiance, friendly staff and good bread and Raviolis.  I hope to go back soon.

We recently bought a house in Eagle and our real estate agent gave us a gift certificate to Famous Dave's as a "thank you".  I like good barbecue, but my son is the real connoisseur and is known far and wide for his own cooking.  Anyway, we were looking forward to a good dinner.  Well, I can't say it was bad, but it wasn't that good, either.  I guess if McDonalds did barbecue, Famous Dave's style food is what I would expect.  My son wasn't nearly as impressed.  I don't see any reason to return.

The pizza is great. I'd give it four stars. The reason for three is because their phone line is constantly busy - I understand you're a popular choice during peak dinner hours, but this is the 21st century: no business should be without a proper phone system. That means no busy signals. Someone should always answer, and at least tell me there is a wait. You should have hold music or tell me about specials while I hold on the line. IPC has lost my business numerous times because of this inconvenience and I'm pretty sure they've lost others' as well. 
Aside from that, no complaints. Solid pizza, great lunch buffet, friendly service. 
Fix the phones!

This was a pleasant surprise. Seattle transplant here. Like many transplants, I CRAVE the food of my youth. Asian is always appropriate. After reading other reviews here, and trying many places, I figured the $7.95 lunch special was worth trying. And I was not disappointed! The food was well made at 1:30pm, the fried items crispy and the non fried items not greasy or overcooked. My party all loved the dishes (note: while I didn't try it, my family loved the Americanized dishes, especially honey almond shrimp and chicken). The meal started with fried won tons and a sweet sauce to dip in. Egg drop soup was brought out quickly, and had lots of vegetables that are in season (impressive). Meals were brought out very quickly, and plated simply. I thought the fried rice was just the right amount of salty (barely at all), and my chicken with nuts was pretty tasty (and NOT deep fried, which I prefer). Taste was better than expected, ambiance was pleasant. It was very clean (until my kid destroyed the floor and the table). The servers and the hostess were quite kind and attentive (and there were several other parties there). We didn't order of the Chinese menu, but enjoyed our dishes. Several hours later, none of us got that yucky feeling that you sometimes get from Chinese food. A win! We will be coming back here when we need our Chinese food fix from now on.

Holy delicious, Batman!

Went here for the first time recently and loved it. I had the butternut squash ravioli with sage butter sauce (or whatever it was called) and it was amazing. Very light, fresh, and tasty. I was stuck between about four things on the menu and was so happy I went with that one.

I don't remember what everyone else at the table had but they all said it was great. I had a cannoli for dessert, which was a pretty standard cannoli but it's hard to mess that one up.

Highly recommended, I'll be back here again.

Stopped by with the family for Friday dinner and the food was very very good. We had the Jammin Korean Tacos, the Chicken & Waffles and the salmon and don't have anything to complain. The staff was very friendly too. Only knock on them is they are so tiny. Hope they do well and get a bigger spot in a better location.

You don't realize how good you have it until you go somewhere else and realize how far good service and care go. I started going to River City about a year and a half ago when I adopted my first dog (who admittedly is a handful and can be aggressive) and they have always been very patient, warm, and accommodating. 
Since I started going to RCVH, I've moved twice and adopted another dog, so I tried going to another vet closer to my new home and it wasn't the same. I was actually disappointed with how detached and abrupt the doctor at the other place was with my docile dog and knew there'd be a problem if he treated my aggressive dog. RCVH takes their time in making sure they provide the best treatment and you understand what's going on--which makes a world of difference when your dog's health is concerned and surprisingly, is missing at most animal hospitals. Case in point, RCVH is well worth the commute for me and my pets and I won't be going anywhere else for a long time.

Decent service. Brand new car and was asked how my windshield wipers were working. Would have appreciated the thought if i didn't feel so "sold". Everything that was done was satisfactory but no great customer experience. A gal also getting her car serviced was in the waiting room. She told me when I walked in she thought I was an employee coming to sell her another service.
Amazing breakfast!!! I had the jalapeno popper frittata,  my husband had the B.T.A, and my son pancakes.  Our waitress was very attentive and nice. We'll definitely be back!!!

Seriously one of the best Salon+Spas i have ever worked at. I absolutely love the atmosphere here in the salon. The staff here is like a huge family and i feel like i am not going to work, i am going to my second family. I am stuck here. Will not work anywhere else. Stephanie is a wonderful person to work for, and for that i am grateful.

Pizza was alright but spendy $2-$4 extra a topping is a joke. Salad was good. The menu is very limited. The services was painfully slow. We watched our server talk to the other employees while rolling silverware for 10 min after we had finished our food before she came over to ask us if we were ready for our bill. Yes I actually timed it. The hostess was busy chatting it up with other servers standing around... just an idea maybe the hostess could make herself useful when there is no one to seat so that the servers can actually help their tables.
*Hidden gem in Meridian* Absolutely loved it! Food and wine were delicious! Charming decor. Would return in a heartbeat!

New to Boise Idaho area. I have heard that there are not that many good Chinese food restaurants in the area. After researching we saw that this restaurant had good reviews. I would concur with most of them. The food was tasty and served quickly. Prices were good and overall I will rate it highly. Have to come back and try some of the other dishes though.
Delicious. Great bread. Great Alfredo. Great chicken. When we moved here several people recommended it, and now we know why! Delish.

For Boise, it's a legit place to eat.  As someone who has traveled...  It's ok.  I wasn't overly impressed with anything.  We had potstickers, spring rolls, won ton soup, egg drop soup, General Tao chicken, Ruby red Chicken, and hu nan street fry, steamed rice.  We really liked the egg drop soup and general Tao's chicken.  My ruby red chicken was still cold in some of the chicken pieces.  Overall it was ok.  

Atmosphere is great, plenty of seating and great lighting.  Outdoor space is nice!!
Everything is sooo good the chicken and waffles is finger licking good. Also the black tea pork  I try something new every time I come. Come see for yourself.
Our go to pizza place for when we get babysitters or just just don't feel like cooking! Great fast and friendly service! Yummm!!

This is my weekend indulgence! (Usually to-go style, because they had about 20 people waiting outside last time I was there)
Love the garden hash, and since I'm not a vegetarian, I usually add a side of their sausage patties, which are scrumptious! There might be a side of Hollandaise sauce involved as well ...

That a great evening with my wife. I had salmon and my wife had Duck. The salmon was cooked very well and the yogurt dill mango sauce excellent. My wife's duck as she put it haven't had duck this good in decades. We had 1 appetizer and one dessert to share and bottle of wine for under 80. Very good price for very good dinner. Everyone was friendly.  
Highly recommended and we will return.

It was my mother's birthday and I made reservations for 10 people at 7 in the evening. We got there a little early and our table was ready, we were greeted friendly. We got our drinks but only one person knew the menu and the food. That is one of my biggest pet peeves is that staff members know nothing about the food or culture. When we asked, the staff members did not know what we had asked and we had to wait for the main waitress to help us. She was very knowledgeable and also gave us the secret menu to look at. Luckily the beer kept coming and we were enjoying ourselves because I was hungry. My wife and I got the dinner for two which was an awesome deal. We both got an appetizer which was a spring roll for me and fried shrimp for her. The shrimp was pretty good and they were actually good size. My egg drop soup was fantastic, and my wife's wonton soup was ok for her. She said the broth was salty but the noodles were good. our main entree came and the iron deluxe sizzler looked great! my generals chicken was very good, not a lot of sauce, nice, crispy and tender chicken meat. The iron deluxe sizzler was excellent, very good flavor on the sauce, tasted great with the rice. There are some other main dishes I would like to try, so I am going to go back and try the rest of the menu. To me this is one of the better Chinese restaurants around with their other locations in McCall and Mountain home, they give a very authentic flavor. I think the Szechuan dishes could be more spicier because it was more mild to me. This restaurant would get 4 stars from me if the staff knew what food they served and if the spices were a little more spicier. I will definitely go back and you should try it. Who knows you just might find something to fall in love with!

My husband and I have the breakfast bar because it was fast big mistake, the bacon was so burnt, could not even chew it, the sausage links are pretty dry and over  cooked.  The melon was way over ripe, we should have remembered how bad it was from a year ago.
GM Dillon was very understanding and helpful.  He quickly resolved my issue to my satisfaction.

Food was good. Sushi presentation was nice, however could tone down a bit on the rice. Sushi is rice, but not 1/4 to near 1/2 inch. The kid wolfed them down though, so did I.
 The corn appetizer it different in a good way. If you have a picky eater child this is perfect. Wife stated the Japche with spicy pork was very good. The waitress recommend this due to her love if noodles. Service was good, was good to see a different culture diner.
The appetizer were very fresh, the cucumber kimchi, bean sprouts, and cabbage was tasty on the pallette. Will be coming back due to the uniqueness, service and food. I just hope they can flourish in meridian.
I never had anything like it, the rice was sweet and delicious from the oil they cooked it in. a little small but absolutely a place to go back to.

We dined at this location and found it to be outstanding, not only the quality of the food but also the service. Our waitress Jannel was excellent. It is nice to get such excellent service. We will certainly be back! We highly recommend this place!!!

Yes it's pricier but you get what you pay for. Half off wines on Tuesdays? Awesome. Delicious pizzas. We walked in and were told it was 45 min wait even though there were plenty of vacant tables. Maybe they're understaffed? This could explain why the bartender seemed so pooped.
Great food and service. Love the ambiance and decor! On the pricey side, but worth it!

Sushi fans of the valley, this is a must! This was my first trip to Fujiyama and was worried this location was a bust. There have been a few restaurants that have tried to make a go of it and failed. However, this place rocked my socks off! Upon entering, the atmosphere was impressive: soft music and lighting, great decor and very clean. We were seated right away. The service was superb. We noticed they had dumplings, one of my favorite things to have, which is tricky! They can be amazing or a disaster, not a lot of middle ground there. These knocked it out of the park! So yummy!!  I had the combination of spicy sushi- tuna, salmon! Delicious! The price was reasonable for the amount of sushi. Overall, the best sushi in town! Can't wait to go again!
Clean snd comfortable. Service was quick and cheerful and the food? Amazing down to the fortune cookies.

I'm a big fan of fish tacos - and Rumbi's Cabo Fish Tacos are always great.  Was glad to find a Rumbi on my travels to ID this week.  Dare I say, I think these are better than our Rumbi back home in AZ??!

I am from California and recently came for a visit. Since we have little kids, a newborn myself, we ordered sandwiches every day we were here. The sandwiches are really great, I especially like the whole grain bread. I ate the turkey and roast beef sandwiches, both were really great. I am going to miss this place when I leave tomorrow, they need one in Temecula California area! Ohhhh and they are quick too, we were close by and they were often here in less then 15 minutes. Highly recommend.

Finally - a really good Italian restaurant in the Greater Boise area.  The food was excellent, service was great, nice ambiance -- a totally delightful dinner experience.

But beware -- all of this good stuff comes at a price -- reservations are definitely required.

Worst delivery ever.  Ordered Spicy Chicken/cha yor and doesn't remotely compete with Dong Kahn or Pho Nouveau... Smelled sour with too much grease and gristle, and I cannot imagine ever ordering again.  I had to write a review because I did not want others to be fooled by the existing 'good' reviews.  I think I'm going to be ill.

This is a very popular breakfast place! We drove by twice during breakfast time on a Saturday and the line was out the door. Came back at about 12:45pm and were seated almost immediately. I ordered an omelet with a side of fruit (mixed strawberries, pineapple, blueberries, and oranges) and it was great. My husband had a breakfast burrito and said it was great as well. Service was very fast and friendly. Overall, we were in and out of there in less than 40 minutes. Highly recommend!

Worst Pad Thai I've ever had, the 'pancake' dish had no flavor unless you dipped it in the sauce and then it was so so. Service was very friendly and the cha yor was good, tho not as good as Pho 79 on Glenwood.

I've had worse but I've had a lot better too.

Came in today, said i need an alignment done.
I explained i worked in less than 5mins and that id be back to grab my vehicles during lunch. The (girl and boy) at tge desk said yes that will work. I just went to grab my car and they are closed! No call! no heads up! NOTHING! My house is 20 miles out! Also MY CAR WAS UNLOCKED IN THE PARKING LOT BY ITS SELF! Less Schwab made it vary clear, that they do not care for the customer, and their vehicle! I have vidio proof that my car was unlocked! Vary displeased! Fed up with Less Schwab treating me poorly everytime im in. Hope it gose out of business, and they get something more descent in, INCLUDING the employees.

Just because you put it in a tortilla doesn't give you the right to call it Mexican. I guess someone has to be the worst in the nation. This place just might be it. 

Walked in with my wife. There were only two other groups there, but all the tables were filthy. We sat at the least dirtiest table. I should have known this place was bad when I saw about 200 premade Taquitos sitting in the open on the back shelf. Seems like my order was pre-made and they just dropped it in the deep fryer to heat it up. My wife ordered the  Burrito. About halfway through eating it grease or oil started seeping out the bottom of the burrito. When she gave it a squeeze a stream of oil came out. She took the burrito to the counter so she could show the cook. The cook shouted in Spanish that he was busy and had no time to talk about the order. I look at the lady behind the counter and sarcastically said, "you guys don't care do you?" She just shrugged her shoulders. 

We threw our plates in the trash and trudged through the dirty floor never to return.

We walked in and there were only 4 other people there. But we loved the boat idea so we gave it a try! It was actually really good! The waitress was a little rushed but she was nice. Overall decent food for a good price to get that craving out of the way and not spend a fortune. They had good tunes on too! I'd recommend and take my out of town guests here too!
Good food at decent prices. I would reccomend it to anyone. The restaurant is also very clean.
Fun atmosphere, quick service, incredible staff. We had a ton of fun, and will definitely be coming back.

I'll preface this review by letting you know that while I do enjoy sandwiches, I'm typically a Subway salad person. I love the convenience of the Subway on Chinden/Linder and like that they're hardly busy. Subway might not be a fancy joint or serve high-quality food, but I don't go there for that. I go to get a better meal than I could get somewhere like McDonald's or Taco Bell but for roughly the same price. It's all about convenience and this one delivers!

Food: My favorite menu item is the Meatball Marinara with lettuce, spinach and jalapeno. I also love their flatbread pizzas and sandwiches. However, I typically always order the salad because I know I can get a low-priced meal that's LOADED with veggies without all the calories. The Chopped Salad is great because the portion is typically SUPER HUGE and you don't get charged extra if you want a crap-ton of veggies. I say a "crap-ton" because literally my salads are giant. Tell them you want a lot of veggies and they'll take you up on it! 

Drinks: Self-serve soda fountain.

Atmosphere: It's a typical Subway! I usually take my food to go because I don't like smelling like Subway after eating there. Am I the only one who notices the after-smell that sticks to your clothes? 

Service: Always friendly and upbeat.

Healthy Hack: The honey mustard sauce makes a great salad dressing because it's one of the lowest calorie options! Want to work on portions? Ask for any of the toppings on the side so you can control how much goes on top!

Tips: Ask for lots of veggies! There's no extra charge.
