These two stars are for the lady at the deli. I encountered her last night while getting lunch meat, and from the beginning, she had an attitude. She made me feel like I was bothering her. Then, my fiance came and was being helped by the other employee, and she rudely said two people can't help the same family (which I understand) and walked away from me! She left the other employee to help us and she didn't even finish my order with her. Her attitude was horrible and the way she walked away from us was unprofessional. I love shopping there, but I WILL ask for someone different next time at the deli.

Wonton soup was the best part of my meal but I've had better. I got the fried rice with beef and chicken. It was rather bland. I had to put multiple packets of soy sauce to get some kind of flavor. The Mongolian beef was decent but after 2 days in my fridge the meat turned black and hard. It makes me wonder what kind of crap people are feeding us. I will not go back. I will keep searching for another decent Chinese place. This is not it. Next.

This is a chain restaurant and it's pretty obvious. The food lacks character and there are all sorts of weird promotions and gimmicks. The tables have a tablet thing that you can use to pay, order drinks, flag your server, etc. If I wanted to order from a machine, I'd get my meals from a vending machine. It's not that this location in particular is unsatisfactory, rather, that appears to be the trend I've seen the last couple times I was at Red Robin. 

As I said previously, the food lacks character. I got what was billed as a spicy burger. It was not. It was a thin meat patty with some incredibly salty 'fried jalapeño medallions', their 'ghost pepper sauce' (which is glorified ketchup), and some lettuce, tomato, etc. The fries were okay, but you should really order them well-done or else they'll come out wobbly and mealy. 

My girlfriend got some chicken tenders which tasted as though they'd been fried in really old oil. They had a weird bitterness to them that was pretty well masked with the dipping sauce.

The best part of the meal was the onion rings. Those were pretty darn good. 

The service was okay, but our server seemed more interested in getting us to use the tablet thing than actually taking our orders. To be honest, I got the feeling that this is a chain restaurant desperately trying to stay afloat but really just grasping at straws.

The open tables at the bar all needed cleaned.  The waitress couldn't find a cloth.  Waited 10 minutes for a table, another 50 minutes to get food. Service and cleanliness of this location  needs a lot of work.  Food was to order and good.
Second visit, and they came running again. Work was performed efficiently, tire change over and brakes. I was in the shop for under 2 hours. Fantastic service. Thank you!

Gluten Free is hard to come by, this was AMAZING! The only short fall was the hostess or lack there of. We went on a Friday night and it was packed. There wasn't anyone taking names or any organization on who was to be sat next.  I had the Nutty Chicken combo amd I ate the WHOLE plate. DELICIOUS!!!
I neglected to add a picture of my dinner,  Duck and Asparagus over noodles. Light cream sauce, very flavorful

Friendly staff and amazing food. I had the smothered breakfast burrito with bacon. It was so big that it was breakfast the next day too. Great value for only $9. this is a must try place. We will be going back for sure.

I love this store. I'm within walking distance and I walk to the store 3-4 times a week. The store is clean, the staff is friendly, they have a great rewards program, and they sell everything. Love it!

Best Italian Food in Boise!!! Great service great food!!! Highly recommend!! Steaks, Veal chop, lamb chop are all excellent with mouth watering risotto!! Then the pasta is to die for. My wife is partial to the raviolis, try them in pesto sauce. The absolute best margarita pizza!!!

Very excited about this place! It's just down the street from us so we rode our bikes here! Super cute,we were surprised at the size! Didn't look big when we drove by but seems as if they expended and also have a really good sized patio, where they had live music tonight (friday). Service was really good, very friendly and informative! We got artisan bread for an app and sirloin steak with gorgonzola mashers. Very yummy! The only thing was, the food wasn't hot enough. Still very tasty tho. We'll be back!

This place was packed on Memorial Day. I figured it had to be good. Someone else chose this place as he had been there before. All I can truly remember is that their servings are large. Not much in the way of atmosphere, and no privacy.
The Meridian red Robin is worth the drive from Nampa. The service and the meal were great.

I have come here countless times and got the force rolled tacos with rice and beans on the side. The rice and beans added on only ever added 50 cents the price. Today I got the usual but was charged SIX DOLLARS for rice and beans. I asked why and the employee acted clueless and just said "we don't do that anymore". They've already raised their prices on everything multiple times without improving the quality of their food. On top of this, they completely overcooked the food. It's really too bad but I'm never eating at this place again.

We go here only for breakfast. I am reviewing only from that perspective and with wife and kids in tow. They do a good job. The buffet is what we generally get. Best thing is you can be in and out quickly and it's not crowded as many other restaurants are at this time. Great for kids. Have daily specials, staff visits table frequently. You can even buy and take home a fresh made pie. Been going here for years and have never had a bad experience.

Gosh this place WAS so good!  And now ... it feels like it is in thrifty mode!  Got what we always get...a Mediterranean salad!  We had to send it back...There were few cukes, only a half dozen olives (we had to dig for)... almost zero feta!!  So sad....
Others have commented but I had hoped it was wrong....  not sure WE will
Ever go back!

The very first time I ate here, I really liked it. I had a french dip... but the second and third were much different and also a year later. The fries tasted like they fry their fish in the same oil so that was gross. Reminded me of bowling alley food a little. I like the environment so I'll give it another try and get a different menu item. Just don't get the chicken strips or the club.

Hank and Joule (my JRTs) tell me that they enjoy this place.  Well, actaully they say they prefer one of "cage free" facilities that they also go to, but they understand that Pet Lodge is closer to my house and a lot less expensive.  

They particularily enjoy the "suite" option, where they get their own room and I can bring their own bedding and toys.

The staff here really, really, really like dogs and are very excited to see Hank and Joule.  When they come home they are always in good shape (sometimes they stay for up to a week) and not too stinky.  ;-)

We always try Pet Lodge first and if not full (which they often are, so book pleanty of time in advance) then we prefere Pet Lodge over other options.
Good food and very friendly service, but you should plan on a wait to be seating on a weekend. I was very impressed by the staff with the way they dealt with a very busy Memorial Day.

I have eaten here a couple times with friends and been very happy with the food and service. Gino's gets five starts because it is definitely the best Italian place in the Boise area. Unfortunately, they've moved from downtown to Meridian, but definitely worth the drive.

Everything I've tried here has been excellent. The Calamari appetizer is a must, and they offer three different kinds of gnocchi, which is often hard to find at all. This trip I had the angel hair pasta prepared with garlic and oil with pine nuts - so simple but so delicious. If you're looking for Italian in the Boise area, you've got to go to Gino's.

Ate here while visiting from out of town.  Pizza was good, we ordered two personal sized with our favorite toppings.  The salad bar looked just like any other pizza joint salad bar (I didn't try it but everything looked fresh). Pitchers of beer are always good.  I did order the wings and they just weren't good.  Gooey, squishy chicken skin (why? you have a hot oven to cook the pizza in - put the wings in and let them get crispy!) and weird sauce.  One of our party wanted wings, these aren't the wings you are looking for.  Go for the pizza and beer, avoid the wings.
Red Robbin was my first choice for a burger. I showed my state issued ID card and the waitress refused to serve me a beer.

have been in meridian for eight years and have found very few good restaurants in meridian.  shanaz is one of the very good ones.  food is very unique and very good.  am working through the menu and discovering more good food all the time.  

the only negative comment i have is they close during summer months which requires I suffer withdrawals from the very unique cuisine at shanaz.
Lemon poppy seed pancakes are to die for.. definitely a new spin on pancakes and it was fantastic!

I am really torn on this place. I have been here 5 times. Each time was a totally different experience. The first time spice pallet and cook was perfect. They were not busy and really made a great dish. I was really excited to get a Kung Po seared perfect with the right spices. Man was it great! 

The other time's not so much. The dishes were cooked to the time constraints of a busy kitchen. Better food when not so busy FAR worse when REALLY busy.

I am not sure what I would rather have, an average dish prepared to the cook's best abilities or little better dish knowing that if the cook cared he could have done a far superior job. I almost lean to the average dish. That way I am not disappointed when I know it could be so much better.

Here in town for a two week business trip. I ate here twice. The first time I had the beef brisket. The second time I forgot what I had. 

PROS:

- This place has Kokanee beer! A lot of places out here doesn't have it, this place has it on draft.

- The staff was very attentive. I didn't have to wait very long. 

- The food was what I pretty much expected. 

- Very clean bathrooms. 

(Neutral) 

- The food was pretty much what I expected. 

Summary:

I can't really think of anything bad to say about this place. It's what you expect from Famous Dave's or these types of restaurants. If you like BBQ food, or can't make up your mind where to eat, this is a safe bet. I would probably come back here.

It's been awhile since I last posted any sort of review, here, on Yelp. "You really should post a review, one of these times," I've been telling myself. Of one of the many local places and local chain restaurant addresses I've visited in the Greater Boise area since moving to Idaho. After a time, going back and reviewing a place I'd visited months ago or a year ago is disingenuous, as I won't have a clue about what might've changed since that visit, for better or worse. I've even talked myself down from reviewing a place I'd meant to review after a visit three or four years ago. Is it even open, anymore? That dish I may have loved might now be shit. The poor service may now be terrific. You can't do a review miles down the road; it must be fresh.

"Don't sit on this one," I begged myself.

Idaho Pizza Company has a number of outlets in the Boise area. The one my family frequents is in the heart of Meridian -- this particular joint. In a small strip shopping center of four or five storefronts (or even three) on the eastbound side of Fairview. Walking in, you'll catch that familiar whiff of pizza parlours known to every American going back to when they began to really take hold in this country, which is when- In the '60s, sometime? Which hasn't escaped this restaurant, with its wonderful choice of piped-in music to my ears, anyway -- the pop and "British Invasion" and Motown hits of the early- to mid-1960s, give or take a couple of years either way. That music and that pizza joint oven smell are about as American as you can get, even when the music and the food aren't completely American at all. It's representative of a slice out of time when our lives were spent hovering about such places. I came into it on the tail end, as the early '70s came along and I was just a little boy in someone's tow. But the music, the game rooms, that smell, and the din of all that and the customers of a place like that cemented the experience into my soul as being completely, utterly Americana. Bubble gum and muscle cars and Stingray bicycles and pinball machines and pretty, giggly high school girls who, then, were "older women" to me.

It takes me awhile to snap out of it, the reminiscence of bygone times, real or how I imagine they were. Especially in a place that's well set up and nicely decorated. Comfortably decorated. Decorated as a pizza joint should be decorated. With a strong hint of nostalgia.

We're greeted warmly. There are signs with various house specials written upon them. The prices are about where I'd expect them to be at any pizza parlour. We're seated. We're served by a bubbly server who does her job well, making sure we've got everything we need, clearing away our debris. But we were there for the pizza. We've had it before, but it was the first time I'd eaten in. It was a delightful, clean place, but I was there for the pizza. And it didn't disappoint. My favorite is always some manner of "Supreme" or "Combo" pie; I ordered an "Idaho Supreme". It was what any pizza like it should be. A pizza is made by its crust, however. No matter what you put on top of it, the crust is what either makes it or breaks it, and Idaho Pizza Company puts out a crust that's not to thin, not to thick, and a wonderful mix of crisp and chewy that appeals very nicely to me.

There are specialty pies like one with Bleu Cheese sauce and "Hell's Chicken" -- something I imagine to be akin to Buffalo Chicken -- with jalapeños that I really must try, someday. There's a barbecue chicken pizza that I think I've had, before; it was magnificent. My sister loves a vegetarian pizza. They've got a good one of those, tried from experience. The crust is what does it for them. I really like their crust. Bottomless sodas and iced teas for those dining in; I must have my Coca-Cola when scarfing down the slices. There's a salad bar, but I didn't have time for it, and there are sandwiches offered as well. A lot on that menu that begs I come back to try a little more, a little more variety. But I couldn't switch myself up, tonight. I had to cave to my ol' standby, the house "Supreme", when I saw the gingham table coverings and heard Del Shannon begging me to "Follow The Sun". That's what pizza is to me. It's- It's a slice of America that even I'm too young to truly recall. But I love a place that helps me pretend it.
Cool people and good drink selection,   the pot roast is very good and I will be back

I used to be a Goldy's fan for breakfast until I discovered this place. The food is so delicious. You can definitely tell the owner puts a lot of love and care into the presentation and quality of the food they served. Too bad I don't live in Boise anymore. I have yet to find an awesome breakfast place comparable to Moe Joe's and it makes me sad. :(
Amazing coffee and people! Definitely a place I'll keep going to every single day. It's the best north west coffee I've ever had!

I am sorry to say that this was the worst Sushi Bar I have ever been to.  It looked like they  cut the top and the bottom of the Maki Sushi roll and put the scrap Sushi's on the boats.  The boats had poor choices of sushi, including some Octopus that probably have been going around the conveyer belf since early am... Ofcourse, if you want the true fresh fish Sushi such as Tuna, Salmon, Roes, it will cost $3 and above for 2 pieces.  Did not care too much about the atmosphere of Shige Express either.  The chef's acted like we were bothering them on their lunch break..like it was a hassel to be serving the customers.  When asked what each sushi dishes contained as my husband has allergies to shrimp, he had to ask another chef for he was not sure what the sushi contained!  When asked about another boat, he didn't know it contained a  Chicken dish.  Not very kid friendly  place either..my 12 year old felt uncomfortable and wanted to get out ASAP.  Did not know until we paid our bill that we could've ordered from Shige Teriyaki menu.  We will probably never go back to Shige Express again.

Very Happy with the knowledge and care I received at Ada West.  I saw Juliann Visser and I think she is fantastic.  She took many bumps off me and had them tested for skin cancer.  Juliann called me a few days later to let me know the results, and I thought what great follow up.  She is my dermatologist of chioice from now on and I think anyone who chooses her will be more than pleased

The food is delicious, the service is quick and always smiling back. In addition to your standard soda fountain they also have some tasty Horchata to settle those yummy jalapeños. Daily specials and a loyalty smartphone app are also pluses! Thank you Costa Vida & staff!

My wife and I ended up here on accident one evening and were thoroughly impressed. The ambiance was totally unexpected for the location and really set the mode. The service was great and made you feel as they were actually there to severe you, at one point all the servers were between tables and instead of standing around talking they were at the bar cleaning wine glasses. It is that kind of management and work ethic that has probably made this place so successful. As for the food..................two thumbs up. I traditionally don't order ravioli's at Italian restaurants as they never serve you very many. Here they bring out a huge plate that anyone would have a hard time finishing. All-in-all, this is a great restaurant that provides a great experience and great food. I will return!

I like this place in regards to RV supply houses. I normally go to Campingworld. I'm thinking I like this place better. Call ahead, they don't have as much stuff as camping world but in my case they carried what Camping World was out of and it was cheaper at Bishes. The guy that runs the back counter is a fountain of information too. I would giver them 5 stars but I have never seen an RV supply house that has as low of process as online shopping.
My first meal in Idaho. Had half of bacon and the other half pepperoni. Big slices. I'm not too big of a fan of thin pizza but this was decently good. Dessert was great as well.

Friendly staff. Extra shots they dont charge. Great coffee. I just love going to Dutch Bros when I'm feeling down. The staff brighten my day. Even didn't have money in my account ( my son got into my account and drained it), and they let me come back and pay on the next day.

Great fun for the kiddos. Clean, well run for the most part. Upon walking in though, I had to endure the two workers talk about a job that needed to be done rather than greet me (you know, the newly walked in paying customer). The big kids zone has some quirky rules on ages, disappointing my 5 yr old (unless I stand there and watch) but the 6yr old is okay by her self? I say make it 7 and older and get it over with. Food and drink is fairly priced. Free WiFi (that is nice). Overall, again, great place.

I've lived down the road since they opened and wish I had stopped sooner. Much better than the Griddle, just down the road. 

So great to find a country fried steak that isn't frozen.  Wish I had know that the potatoes weren't hash browns but they were tasty and well seasoned. Sourdough toast was fresh and well toasted.

It's nice to find a place that actually cooks food and doesn't just warm up the franchise fare.

We've ordered take-out pizza from a couple of different pizza places here in Meridian and I have to say this place takes the cake! Pizza was hot, excellent crust (not too thick/thin), loved their sauce. We ordered a combo, the Idaho Supreme - excellent.

Pretty much what you'd expect from a fast food Mexican joint. But they are much more authentic than your run of the mill taco bell or taco time. That being said you do pay more for the authenticity. I really enjoy the carne asada fries and the Idaho burrito. Their hot sauce is made there on site and is very good. The only complaint I really have is the drive thru service can take a while.
Compared to a lot of the other locations this les schwab has their act together. They are very professional and do their best to be helpful. Thanks for a great job!

The breakfast at Mojo is exceptional.   The portions are large and the potatoes are out of this world      We enjoyed our breakfast so much we returned for lunch !    I had the grilled chicken sandwich impressive!    Full of flavor didn't disappoint 

It's a small place so be prepared on weekends to wait

Still sitting here in the lounge area after our meal...

We showed up at about 7:30 on Friday, it was packed. We could wait 15-20 for a normal table, or sir in the lounge... glad we chose the lounge because we got Jess as our server. The BEST server yet at Red Robin. 

Our order got messed up, she didn't even skip a beat and made sure it was corrected, promptly, and without any kind of attitude. Then we had some crazy changes we made to our food and drinks... she handled it all with complete understanding. We weren't trying to be difficult, but I'm sure we came across that way. She didn't flinch and gave us the best service we could ask for. 

If she's not already someone that trains staff, she should be. 

When we come back, we will ask for her section for sure!

In reality 3.5 stars but there isn't that option. I'm writing this the following day so I don't allow the good atmosphere cloud how I felt about the food. I started off my meal with 2 appetizers, the deep fried Mac and cheese and the Korean tacos. The Mac was good but the accompanying sauce was bland and didn't do much for the Mac. Now the taco was another story altogether, a perfect combination of flavors that hit on every note. Then came the main entree if you're serving seafood gumbo make sure it has ample seafood and that it's fresh. Here was this wonderful broth filled with rice and sausage okra chicken with 5 old shrimp and 2 pieces of crab. Now I ate the shrimp hoping that the next one I tried would be better than the last but the all had that close to turned flavor that old shrimp have. This ruined what should have been a wonderful gumbo plus why wasn't there any fish in it? The saving grace to the meal was the service was first rate and the dessert the waitress recommended was to die for. Chocoflan a chocolate cake with Flan baked into it one word amazing! I will go back because the flaws in the meal weren't enough to discourage me.

We've been waiting 45 minutes now for a waiter or waitress to come to our table. No drinks, no response to our call server button. At this point we are just waiting to see how long it takes them to notice us.

Before I try a new restaurant, I always check with Yelp, particularly the "bad" reviews. In the case of Gino's Italian Ristorante there were a few. There was a bit of apprehension in trying it, but our friends made reservations (6 pm) and were very enthusiastic about the place. AND they were right to be! Gino's knocked it out of the park for us.

We were seated immediately - 6 p.m. is a good time for reservations - there were maybe 6 six tables filled at the time. Within 30-45 minutes it was full.

Our waiter was Cameron (that's his middle name - Jeffery is his first name and he has a twin brother Nick) and he was a delight - fun, informative and very attentive. 

We had a delightful bottle wine (my wife isn't a wine drinker so she had a Gino's Paradiso cocktail), to accompany our bread and oil. Once again, Cameron was very helpful.

And then there was the food. We ordered Pollo Parmigiana, Chicken Alfredo, Baked Ziti and Shrimp Maria (mine). All were well prepared, beautifully presented and, finally, absolutely delicious. Again, kudos to Cameron.

Desserts? Of course! Chocolate Mousse, a Dark Chocolate raspberry tort, and one other that I can't remember. And all delivered by a smiling faced Cameron.

So for Gino's Italian Ristorante stars abound!!!!

Deliciously delicious.  Our breakfast was the best meal of our trip! The service was excellent too.  Smokehouse and the cinnamon french toast were what we had, but every plate that went by looked awesome.

When my husband is "hangry," we head to Carino's. He loves the bread and olive oil, and if you visit Monday-Friday, you're able to score on some great lunch deals. Carino's, when they underwent their name change, drastically reduced the size of their menu so they now have fewer offerings, but they're all still great. We love to sit in the bar area and enjoy a good meal!

Food: The chicken parmesan is very good. My husband LOVES the bread and dipping olive oil. I think their soups, especially their Italian chili, are very good. Their margherita pizza and caesar salads are also good! 

Drinks: n/a

Atmosphere: The bar area, though not big, is really nice. It's where we normally choose to sit. It has TV's and booth seating and normally is not busy, which we appreciate. The rest of the restaurant feels cozy and warm. 

Service: We enjoy sitting in the bar because the service is fast and reliable. They often seem to have high turnover at Carino's, so your service may not be super exceptional as they might be a new server, but go in with an open mind!

Happy Hour Offerings: M-F Food (pizza and appetizer) and drink specials.

Healthy Hack: Try the Italian Chili as a side order to an entree. I get it as my meal while my husband eats the entree. 

Tips: n/a
One of the best breakfasts I've ever had!  Great service too!  And the biscuit - heavenly!

I was visiting from Cali in the 3rd week in June. Yummy pizza, great salad bar & great beer selection on tap. I will definitely come back the next time I am in town. The staff was all super friendly, helpful and nice, too.

Very disappointed with my meals at this steakhouse tonight. My clucks were dry and the burger was bland. AND WE DIDNY GET VERY MANY STEAK FRIES. which are my favorite part by the way. And our server was slow.. what a shame.

Fantastic pizza and great staff! Brad, the bartender, was amazing! Will be back soon for sure. This is a must for all! 
petersod@slhs.org

Don't listen to the bad reviews full of typos & misspellings. Poor grammar = poor judge of quality. 
Excellent barbecue, service, value, decor, music and margaritas (garnished with grilled pineapple!)
Try it!!

I stopped in here looking for a motorcycle trailer and didn't expect to see such an incredible amount of inventory for for motorcycles and gear.  I didn't buy anything from here, but the staff were friendly and answered my questions.
Staff has no knowledge about their inventory.  We gave Pristine several opportunities for our business and we were time and again disappointed at the terrible service.   Avoid!

I've eaten here about 15 times since they opened.  I love it!

Course I don't eat BBQ... but hubby does and he always leaves satified.  His favorite sauce 'Rich and Sassy' we even have at home.

I always get the chicken fingers and between that and the sides of fried apples, corn bread, corn on the cob and cole slaw, I'm always too stuffed to get dessert.  

The waiters are very friendly.  Make sure to go around 6pm if you don't want a long wait...
This place reminds me of the place my parents would take me as a child.  Great food, although not what I'd call traditional.  The service is great and the food is amazing.

We stopped going here because the place looked and felt dirty. The customer service was horrible too. 
After not eating here for at least two years, we decided to give it another try to see if it had changed. To my surprise, the place was extremely clean. The wood floors had been refinished. As we were eating the hostess was cleaning the front door windows. 
The food was great again and the server was exceptional. 
Good job Famous Dave's. We will be back.

Worst service waiting over 20 mintues to have our waitress to take our order. She made eye contact four times took other people's order after they showed up after us. This isn't the first time i had a horrible experience at this place the first time was the same but waiting for over a hour to get food never got it. This place will never get my business again cause of their piss poor service.

Love this place  everything I have guests from our is town I being them here for breakfast. I love the hash and the Benedict options. 
It's a bit of a wait but worth it. 
Great mojoes potatoes too.

This is my favorite pizza place. I am from the North East so I consider myself a kind of pizza expert. I always get the red sauce with the ricotta, pepperoni and spicy chicken sausage. The ricotta gives it such an awesome extra texture. I am also active duty AF and my first week back last year I ate here twice. I leave again this month and I'll be look forward to it again! There are a couple of negatives. 1, the soda always tastes horrible. I dont understand why. Maybe it is the carbonation. But soda isn't good for you anyway. So I just get water. 2, if you pay in cash they don't give you exact change. If your bill is $28.26, give them a 30 you will get $2 back. I would like my .74 cents back. But they don't have a normal cash register that carries change. Only 2 negatives that I see at this place.

This place is great. Food was excellent and the wait staff was amazing.  We attended the valentine's day dinner and we enjoyed all of it. 

Highly recommend if your around meridian stopping in.

I travel alot in my RV. 
This is the Best place I have been to so far.
It made Me want to stay longer. 
The Owner saw me waiting 20 minutes for a Taxi and gave Me a ride to the Restaurant. 
How awesome us that?

YEP I LOVE THE SWEET PORK SALAD!!! Could probably eat it everyday!! The ranch here is worthy of awards too...so together on the sweet pork salad...well...my mouth is watering just thinking about it!!!!

Excellent place for breakfast. I had the smothered hash brown special and my husband had a Hash special with smoked sausage. Both were excellent.The servings are large. I had pancakes as my side. They were good even though I don't usually like thick ones. My husband had wheat toast which is more of a multi-grain with seeds on top (yum). It was served with homemade jams which were great. We were concerned going on a Sunday morning that we would have to wait. but we beat the crowd by going before 9. The service was great and the decor was nice. I recommend to anyone in the area. Looks like they have a lunch menu. We will have to try it next time we are in Boise.

Great service, fantastic food, our new favorite Chinese restaurant!!! We've eaten in and also had take out several times. Last time I ordered water to go with my meal. Myself and the wait staff both forgot the water. As I was buckling up to leave the kind waitress knocked on my window with the water and apologized for forgetting.

We've been to many Boise vets over the years, and River City is our favorite. Our standard vet is Dr. Harsch, who remembers our dog and has great rapport with animals and humans. We have visited other vets within the office and always had a good experience. 

Our favorite things: 
-Open Saturday and until 7 pm weekdays. No excuses, and plenty of scheduling flexibility. 
-Friendly staff with good communication.  If we call and talk to someone and come in later, we can expect any employee to know why we are there (no re-explaining required). 
-Indoor kid playground. Very nice if you have non-fur children with too much energy. 
-Daycare and boarding has 24/7 webcam. 

Our less favorite things (noteworthy, but not at all an issue):
-Office is a little out of the way. 
-The groomer books up FAST.  Set those appointments early.

We were downing our $1 per plate sushi one day when we noticed that there was another restaurant on the other side of Shige Express. We asked about it and we were told that they serve "soul food fusion". Soul food fusion in Meridian? I was definitely intriged. 

I finally got my chance and I was very pleasantly suprised. This place rocks. 

We started our meal with the "Nu Flavor Roll". I don't really know how to describe it other than delicious. 

I had the crusted salmon on dirty rice. It was perfect. The wife kept picking at the rice on my plate. She had the ribeye and it was cooked and seasoned to perfection.

The seating is pretty cramped and the restaurant is very small, but the food makes you feel like you're in a high end restaurant. This is not what I would expect from a tiny restaurant in a Meridian strip mall. I hope yelpers get behind this place and spread the word because I'm in love!
The service and the food was terrific. The third time eating at Gino's. Looking forward to go back.

I have been to Red Pavilion at least 4 times and each time the service and food is as good as it was the previous time.  We love their pot stickers, their sauce is delicious.  Love their fresh fried wonton skins, warm and fabulous in their sweet dipping sauce.  The honey almond shrimp is just delectable.  The sauce has a hint of honey mustard, the sliced almonds are generous and the shrimp is prepared/cook perfectly.  The server is familiar with us now and we just quickly run the items we want for dinner.  She is pleasant, upbeat and attentive.  We sit in the same spot every time!  We love that.  We have been monthly for the past few months, so we will continue to patronize this establishment.  Yummy!  (left overs are good too!)

Superb new "Burnt Butts" made with blackberry sauce!  Brisket is a must as was the salmon.  Terrific food, but sort of odd colors and fabric on the seats, had a kind of New Mexico/Arizona sort of vibe, not bad, just out of place in Idaho.  But the food was GREAT!!!

I have taken our dogs so many different places. We are done shopping around! They remember your pets name and truly care about the health of your animals. They are so knowledgeable and give you the options that you have for treatment. So pleased!!
Their space is so clean , of course it smells like dog, but compared to some of the other vets I have taken my pets to it is clean and well taken care of.

Unfortunately last year our sweet Chua and Teagan both got fatal illnesses and we had to put down, which is unbearable, they were our babies!  But the staff was so loving and helped us through the tough time.  They had a nice room with a couch and doggy bed that they allowed you to spend as much time as you wanted  with our dogs before and after.  They sent us a card with our babies foot prints a few weeks later.  They truly are so thoughtful.  

Thank you for making such a hard decision a little bit easier!

Very disappointed in Les schwab. We bought new tires for our Jeep from another tire place. My husband called and gave them specific tire measurements on the tires we  bought and that we needed them changed out. A quote was given 137$. When we got to the store we were then told it would be a 100$ more than what the quote was by phone. Left there  went to Discount tire and it was 77$.  So we will not be recommending les schwab to any family or friends. Discount tire has all our tire buisness.
My boy is done with his chemotherapy!! On his last treatment day Dr, Bingham and the vet techs were so excited and congratulating us. Everyone signed a card and Rocky got a special cookie.
Where has this place been all my life!  The service was stellar, the food was fantastic, and the cocktails were generous!  I can't wait to come back!

Great local spot with an amazingly varied menu. Went there twice during our 3 day visit to Boise. Great customer public relations on day one. I asked for iced green tea. The waitress said they did not have it on the menu but she would be happy to make it for me. And she did! Food was great too! 
Wait time for a table can be long depending on timing and day of week. But worth it! Would go again!

I have found Chinese food that is totally worth it. I have been looking for a really good Chinese restaurant and this is the place. 

The fried rice is just as good as I had in Taiwan. The Pot Stickers are juicy and tender. 

So glad to have a place that is worth the money and time.

As a property owner I wish I had read the other reviews on here before selecting Chapman for my rental.  So many hidden bad reviews in addition to the one you can see.

Confusing accounting. I am sure they owe me money but am getting the runaround and impossible to decipher statements.

Over $5500 in repairs made even though we were only told $1400 on a $50,000 property that earns $700 a month in rent, I will never pay them back.

Do not trust them, their contract allows them to do whatever they want with your property.  Does that include hiring people they know to do unneeded work? Guess I will never know.  

I am going to take the other reviews advice and look up criminal records and the Better Business Bureau. So disappointed.
The food was alright for the price, the fries had no seasoning and were pretty floppy and bland.

I would first like to say that I am a manager of a different restaurant and I WAS having a wonderful day. Then we decided to have dinner at Gino's, that's where my good day turned into an awful night. As we entered Gino's Italian restaurant in meridian Idaho the hostess smiled and greeted us as she should then took us to our table. On the way not one employee smiled at us other than the hostess they all just looked miserable. She seats us all but touching the table of a family beside it. No big deal I just had to slide our table further away so my wife would stop bumping the lady beside her, servers have sections I know, but every table near us was available and clean. Our server Todd greets us and grabs our drinks. This guy knows the menu well and seems nice, we soon found out that's where his skills end and his inattentive skills begin. Todd brings us bread and already by this time my ice tea is empty;  sorry I was thirsty... and I still would be if it was up to todd. Now we are ready to order, Todd knowing the menu as well as he does has no problem walking us through the Italian names and ingredients. Putting it into layman's terms if you will. We both choose a dish as does my son and as Todd leaves our table he stops to check chat with a table closer to the kitchen. I couldn't hear what the guest asked todd but I think everyone in the area heard his answer, he said " HAHA yeah like I'm gonna support the guy doing rails of blow." I'm pretty sure if my 9 year old son would have asked me what rails of blow is? I would have come off my hinges. Two other children under the age of 12 within arms reach of us by the way. Extremely inappropriate, and I'm guessing by the awkward silence that the guest at the table wasn't talking about committing felonies. Dinner was served and the food was actually really good, normally I'd never complain about having so much chicken in my Alfredo but I love noodles too. When I ran out of noodles and had a plate full of chicken and sauce I stopped eating and waited for my server Todd to check on us.... no Todd, and still no ice tea. Time goes by and a man comes to the table asking if I need a box so I said yes, just giving up. I asked him if I could get some extra noodles in the box as well. Then Todd shows up and asks if we would like dessert. We order dessert mostly cause I was still hungry and cold chicken from my unfinished meal didn't sound good anymore. Dessert shows up and still no ice tea. At this point there isn't even any ice left in the tea glass. Todd explains to us that the whip cream blew up on him so my son's dessert is on the house because it doesn't look as pretty as it should. Todd said it's  just easier to give it to us for free then to make a new dessert. I'm cool with free anything so we except it, who wouldn't take free dessert. We finish dessert and the bus boy clears our plates and I finally break down and ask if he could grab a tea pitcher and fill my glass. The bus boy brings back room temperature tea in a pitcher and fills our glasses. No ice : ( So desserts gone, my moods shot and we wait and wait and wait. I'm looking around and we put our jackets on and gather our things, I see todd coming out of the kitchen chewing something hanging out by the computer talking to other servers, I assume he sees our jackets on and our sour faces and brings the check finally. We pay and I went from the best tipper in the room to the 10% guy every server hates. 10% was too much but I just don't have it in me to stiff anyone. As we walked to the door the friendly host said her goodbyes and complained the whole way home. P.s. I read some other reviews and my chicken Alfredo was 22 dollars not 12 dollars like Kyle C. posted and they charged me 4 dollars for the noodles I waited for until my dinner was cold. I'd like to thank the hostess for being the only person in the restaurant that knew how to do her job. A Manger should have been touching tables to make sure people aren't treated like this and if it was my place I'd be calling a mandatory front of house employee  meeting. We won't be dining at ginos again any time soon. This is the only complaint I've ever posted about a fellow restaurant. 3/25/2015.
Great dining experience! The wait was minimal.  Waiter was awesome and food was delicious! We will definitely back!

Great KOA. Very friendly and clean park.  We arrived after hours and found a very helpful night man who helped us get settled in. Filled our propane tanks in the morning and were on the road.  Thank you.

Some friends and I met for lunch. We had not been before, and it was halfway between Nampa and Boise, so it was convenient.

When I walked in, I thought the sushi boats were a cute idea. Then I realized a couple of pieces were $1 & some plates with a piece of tuna were $2. I could see how lunch could add up really fast. We opted for sushi combos, but I was not overly impressed. I still thought the plate was overpriced compared to other sushi places in the area. 

Overall, the place is cute, but did not seem like the staff was great about cleaning off tables or tidying up. The restaurant appears to have regulars, and while the service was quick for us, I'm not sure I would return.
I went to Gino's on my anniversary with my wife.  Definitely expensive but the food was worth it.  Amazing food!

I had high hopes for this Ristorante and was sadly disappointed in 2 out of 3 entrees that my party ordered...I give it two stars for the service but the chicken parmeasan tasted like a chicken nugget smothered in salty canned sauce with a ton of melted cheese on top. The ravioli with lobster, ricotta and lemon zest plus 2 prawns floating around in another nondescript sauce was equally uninspiring and not freshly made. 

Please don't review this business if you received a freebie for writing this review, or if you're connected in any way to the owner or employees.
The food was excellent, with lots of choices! The service was great! I highly recommend it!
Once again, great pizza. The best stateside. Will eat Grimaldi's whenever I'm near one.
Went here on a recommendation and we were not disappointed. The food was very good and the service was excellent. Good to find a very good Chinese restaurant in Meridian/Boise area.
We go there a couple times a week, at least. great service and the food is good also.
...Absolute rubbish...tired old fish...wasabi that glows in the dark...this restaurant falls flat...keep on heading towards the ocean...

First visit to Fujiyama's in Meridian. The atmosphere was very nice and the service was very good. I had the Teriyaki beef and it was excellent and Sharmini had Teriyaki chicken and the meat was a bit chewy but tasty. Overall a great addition to Meridian and we will be back.

We were in need of quick service and this company delivered. They were the sixth company we called and the only one who said they could come out today. They said they'd be here between noon and two and the door was fixed before 11:45.
Loved how they have such comfortable couches with foot rests...sat and chilled with family way to long. Cool place to hang out and frozen yogurt and service was top notch!

ANOTHER YUMMY BREAFASTQUEST LOCATION! My first time here and it's a tasty place for good eats! The Ham steak with breakfast is just the right size. I'm full but not uncomfortably full. The eggs, perfect sunny side up. Good wheat toast, too. And I love your hash browns. Great coffee! Excellent table service.

Nice little spot for soup on a cloudy day (or otherwise). The Chicken Pho I ordered was good. The broth was flavorful and bit on the spicy side which I liked. The place was clean and staff helpful. Will come back.

I am from Chicago and understand what real Italian Food is all about.   I also know the difference between Chicago style pizza and real Italian Pizza (both are great).  

We visited Gino's for the first time and will be back.   The service was outstanding, the waiter took his time explaining things and recommended a great bottle of wine.

We dabbled with Lasagna, Clams & Mussels, shrimp, soup, pizza....All were A+.

The atmosphere and lighting are spot on, very comfortable but yet elegant setting.

The owner was nice enough to talk with us and ask how the food was, I think it is important that we go back to eating at Family restaurants and get away from chains.

This was a ton of fun. It was affordable and a great workout. The only reason they did not get 5 stars is due to the officials that regulate the game. They can get a bit snippy and short tempered. With that said, it was still a ton of fun.

I finally had a chance to stop by Moe Joe's today and had brunch. It's kind of out of the way for me but I'm glad I made the stop. The place was very busy even for a weekday. The waitress was quick to get us seated though. The menu was what I would call your traditional breakfast eatery style menu and so after perusing it I quickly decided to try a Benedict. I believe you can tell a lot about a place by the hollandaise. My husband chose the steakhouse hash which he was really pleased to say was made with real roasted beef. I had ordered the eggs Benedict Florentine which I was a bit curious as it was to include whole roasted garlic as well as mushrooms. It sounded a bit overwhelming but I figure "why not"? The food came out fast and hot. The eggs were cooked to perfection. This is a BIG deal to me when you go to a place that specializes in breakfast. Nothing will drop a star faster than eggs not cooked to order. The eggs Benedict was yummy! The roasted garlic was not too garlicky at all, it actually gave just the right amount of garlic and sweetness. The spinach was cooked well and the quantity was perfect. The hollandaise was very creamy and smooth. I like mine a bit more flavorful but this hollandaise was well done. My only criticism would be the potatoes served on the side were freshly fried but the potato themselves I could tell were not fresh. They get that kind of chewy texture to them. They were by far not bad potatoes but I know they could be better. That's why it's called being a critic right? Ha! I would definitely recommend Moe Joe's to my friends and family and I can imagine the wait times on the weekend have to be super long. Get there early!

My favorite breakfast place in Meridian. The food is always top quality made from scratch stuff, the portions are generous but not insane, and the coffee is really really good. Some of the best drip coffee I've had! It's a comfortable fairly quiet atmosphere and the staff is always friendly. They aren't the easiest place to find but it's worth hunting for right inside the entrance to the El Dorado business park off Overland.

I had lunch here yesterday with my family and I probably won't return.  First of all the place is just an open room with some tables and booths.  It was not obvious that there was anyone to greet or seat you, so a passing server told us to sit anywhere.  The food was just ok.  My husband and I shared a reuben sandwich with fries which was mediocre, the corned beef was tasteless and dry, sauerkraut  tasted like it hadn't been rinsed and drained, and the sandwich was greasy.  Someone else ordered grilled chicken on greens with an Asian dressing which was very salty and overdressed to the point that the greens were soggy.  The person who ordered the grilled salmon with mashed potatoes and broccoli on the side was very happy with his entree and it looked good.  So I guess it depends on what you order at this place but it is far enough from my home that it would be almost an inconvenience to come here.  Maybe for people who live and work nearby and go here often it is a different experience and they know what to order.

I've ordered lunch here a few times. Their wonton soup and lo mein are good; which is why I gave them three stars.  Their service is poor though. The lady working the front can be a bit rude and today I'm pretty sure I was overcharged.  I ordered a to go order of chicken lo mein, which is listed as  $6.85 on the menu.  They charged me  $9.17 and didn't give me a receipt afterwards.

Shige Express became increasingly disappointing with each visit. I've been there a total of 4 times. I'm not going back.

I understand Shige is supposed to be a place to get cheap sushi; therefore, I did lower my expectations. And kept lowering them.

Generally, I'm happy with little boats of "okay" sushi, as long as they come round consistently. I'm hungry. I know I'm not in for, say, Happy Fish - or any sushi place on the left or right coasts.

Each time I've been here, the "okay" (never delectable) sushi was put out inconsistently and harried-ly.

The service was less than stellar each time. We've had to ask for: 1) wasabi (!); 2) wasabi that wasn't weirdly stale (?); and, 3) napkins and chopsticks. Often, twice, with response by a frantic waitstaff.

Twice, I've been told, "We can only go so fast!" by a sweaty, out of breath, irritated chef or sous-chef. And that's when following up on a special order (why even have them on the menu?) that hadn't arrived after 20 minutes. Once, the chef seemed to understand I was irritated by his response, and attempted to hug me at the end. Really? I prefer my chefs distant, focused and fabulous.

The staff is awesome!!!!! Very good with the kids.  They change up the games every couple rounds. Capture the flag.  Elimination. Commander. Etc.....   We have been coming every Monday for 3 weeks.  One parent per kid plays free.  Our new place to get energy out!!!!#
Best breakfast or lunch around. Very creative menu. Wait staff is excellent and service is top notch. The only disadvantage... They are not open for dinner! We love this place.

Really wanted to like this place, and maybe they have dishes they do better but the chow fun, general chicken and hot/sour soup were mediocre to flat out bad (looking at you, chow fun).  Like mall chinese food, really.  Bad mall chinese food, at that.  But we ordered take out and maybe they have dishes they do better.  Is it worth going out to Meridian for this?  No, but we'll give them another shot when we're in the area.
Service is very slow.   I know it's Red Robin but really it doesn't need to be soooooo slooooooow

The store is brightly lit and very nicely presented. All of the clothing seemed to be in really good shape. Great brands like Ann Taylor, INC, White House black Market-which I love; just expect prices to be at least $20 for an item if it's not on major markdown. I have a personal preference for only new with tag items, and they don't have a new with tags section. That was the only bummer. They play really nice Christian music in the store.  They are very selective for items brought in for consignment (they have turned away new with tag designer items from me); however , their selection seems to be current, trendy, and decently priced- if you don't mind spending $15-$25. They have 15% coupon online that you can print off and use also! It's the only consignment store I've found to my liking in the area so far. I would recommend it.
First time at Costa Vida & we loved it!! Everything is fresh & delicious! They even have gluten free options. Love the casual SoCal atmosphere. Staff is very friendly. Will be back for sure!!!

We have been long time red robin fans. My kids are addicting to their fries. This location is always busy so if you go on a friday or saturday night plan on waiting 30+ minutes just to get a table and another hour to get food!
Incredible find. Discovered some fantastic new wines. Todd is an amazing sommelier, server, host The owner is an amazing chef who uses only the freshest ingredients. Will definitely be back again.
Best breakfast I've had in the Boise area. Prices and portions are great. The potatoes they are awesome, eggs Benedict are spot on. Staff is very friendly. I'd go here again, and again and again...

I ran over a bolt and dropped off my car to see if they could replace the tire. Instead they repaired it and fixed something else that was wrong too. They were extremely nice and fast! Will definitely go back here for any tire needs and already told everyone I know of my wonderful experience here.

A scam. These weird people don't have the sense to be embarrassed by terrible service.  The 2 ladies suddenly disappeared, leaving their brushes and the work undone.  Even what little they did was hardly worth the effort.  Their boss came out so I gave her the brushes, pointed to the untouched windows and oven. The tub with scum just as it was.  She thought it was fine, and I'm no type A personality.  These are people that might be good doing something else, but they are in the wrong business.  I find that abusive to people that cannot protect themselves from scams.  They insisted the bill be paid in full. What the heck?  They didn't even touch 3/4 of what we agreed on.

I will definitely be coming back here regularly. The atmosphere was pleasant, the service was good, and the food tasted amazing. 

For an appetizer I had the "calamari". I learned from another Yelper, Michele R. that it's actually cuttlefish due to the size of the rings. However, personally I enjoyed it and found it to be the best I have ever had. It is a matter of your preference.
 
I had the Mongol and chose to have it served spicy. It had a very good kick and delicious flavor. It had a cumulative effect, but it was quite tasty. What I liked best about my meal is that it wasn't overly greasy or sweet. It also had plenty of vegetable along with the beef. 

Brown rice is an option along with white rice.

The place is brand new, so it obviously clean and pleasant. In addition the decorations were well done. The paintings on the wall were beautiful and makes for great ambiance.
Their Freckled Lemonade is AMAZING!!!!!!!!!! Great fries and seasoning to put on them!!!

There's a reason why Moe Joe's is so well-rated, well-loved, and absolutely packed during peak breakfast times. IT IS DARN GOOD! What complaint do I have about Moe Joe's? NONE. ABSOLUTELY NONE. Except come on, people... why do you have to make it so crowded when I want to go? :) 

Food: I am absolutely impressed by the food at Moe Joe's. I ordered the oatmeal (which is what I ALWAYS order at breakfast joints), and this oatmeal is up there with the best. It's served in a big dish (at least 2 portions!) and is topped with raisins, almonds, granola and powdered sugar. It's so good topped with a little extra maple syrup. I love that their oatmeal is made with water instead of milk... so much healthier and easy for us who don't do dairy! My husband ordered the Beginner's Breakfast and added a side of pancakes. It was big, huge, and so good. Their breakfast potatoes (red, cut up, pan-fried seasoned potatoes) were the crowning glory to his already-amazing meal. We both were exceptionally pleased.

Drinks: Normal breakfast drinks. Great, hot coffee! 

Atmosphere: The atmosphere is very plain and simple. But that's all it needs to be! They have a few booths and some smaller tables if desired. I think a little background music would be nice, but that's just me.

Service: They were on their amazing-service game when we went in. Fast, friendly, and very helpful.

Happy Hour Offerings: n/a

Healthy Hack: Get the oatmeal with a to-go container! Dairy-free friendly and a HUGE portion.

Tips: They close at 2pm, and if you go after 1pm, you'll likely be sat right away. Very fast service when it's not busy!
Best Mexican food chain in my opinion. Has great burritos and other Mexican specialties. I'm giving this a 4 star because it can be inconsistent at times.

Delicious. Great service. The Fiesta Hash was incredible! Great place for breakfast, brunch, or lunch. Their red potatoes have the best seasoning and their biscuits are cut like cornbread and taste amazing! Will definitely come back.

Our first time here and it was great! I got the Farmhouse Benedict and my wife got the Traditional Benedict. We were both happy. The ice tea was perfect and she liked her coffee. A real good first impression.

Worst Los betos in the valley, starts with girl order taking stopping mid order to talk to the other girl about something she's doing on her phone glad everyone thought it was funny but me, who had to repeat my order because she forgot where we were at. The food - enchiladas with cheese not melted great lack of effort from Mexican restaurant with Mexican employees to think this is what we came for. Cleanliness - vacuum set the entire time in the open while floors looked like they had never been vacuumed. Music blaring from kitchen with Spanish radio from an FM station controlled by the one cook with shirt un tucked and hat turned backwards. Just not what we come to expect will only visit state street location. Meridian location clean it up and get a manager who cares.

We drove Seattle to Las Vegas and we stop here both ways! 

I hardly write reviews! But this place, the food is delicious, friendly waitresses...

The quality of the food is excellent, great price. I wish in Seattle, Bellevue, Redmond or Kirkland Had a restaurant with a America breakfast like that!

I thought this was an okay Italian restaurant, but definitely not the best I've ever been to. Maybe it's a lunch thing...

Came here with coworkers, got seated after a bit of confusion (the inside of the restaurant looks REALLY small). The bread was nice because it was freshly baked, but I felt like it took a while to get our dishes ordered and things settled. And then after that it took a while to get everything cooked...

Anyways, I got the Eggplant Rollatini, which wasn't too bad. I felt it was a bit salty on the sauce - but you've got your eggplant with your standard red sauce, some cheese, and a nice bit of prosciutto. It came served with house ragu on a pasta of your choice (I chose penne) and a side salad - all okay, but nothing was stand out amazing.

Maybe I gotta come back for dinner... but definitely worth another shot for lunch.

If you want some good ole BBQ then you owe it to yourself to try this place out. They have been known to fill you up and send ya home with leftovers. If you are dining in for the first time the staff is very helpful in making suggestions and recommendations. Along with touring you through the variety of BBQ sauces. I had heard good things from friends and family who have eaten there so I tried it out. Glad I did. Its a hopin' place with lots of stuff on the walls the keep you visually entertained while you wait for your food, which usually is less than 15 minutes. I keep it on my rotation for good food and good service.

Great Night! A partner and I took about 40 employees to a family style dinner at Carino's and it was a wild success! Great food, wonderful service and a relaxing atmosphere. We will be back to treat our staff again!!!! Totally recommend the Lemon Rosemary Chicken paired with the Robert Mondavi Private Selection Cabernet Sauvignon California. Booya!

Service was great for a Friday night and our waiter Andrew was great. Not many people in the place at all. I had chicken Marsala and wife had another chicken dish. Chicken tasted like it was made of rubber. Have eaten at there other store in Twin Falls a year or so ago and don't remember it being like this. I don't know if they switched where they buy the chicken but it was not good at all. Until they can step it up we will not be back. Our friends had some clam dish and said it was not very good. Another friend had chicken Alfredo and said it was tasteless and chick was like rubber. Would not recommend at all

I absolutely love this restaurant. Everyone is friendly and the chef is prompt on sushi delivery despite a large demand for only one chef. The sushi is good along with everything else and I will continue to come back. The only problem is it can be a bit slow when there are more people, so just don't go on a Friday or Saturday night ;)

Pros: the staff was great. Very nice and got us checked in quickly. The pool was indoor and heated. The showers were clean. 

Cons:  you are packed in like sardines!!!

So I ordered the lobster ravioli and was pleasantly surprised.  However my son ordered the chicken Milano and it was undercooked and we had to send it back.  The bread was warm and fresh and salads were also decent.  My wife ordered the lemon chicken and it was also good.  So sort of mixed reviews here...service was good

This is by far the worst Italian food I've had in years. I try to not leave bad reviews, and find the positive in each location so let's start with the positives:

The staff, including hostess, bartender, and waitress were very good. Service was definitely the biggest plus. 

Other positives? The bread at the start of the meal was delicious. Just don't ask for a second basket because it will set you back an extra $4. 

Onto the not so great: the food. The food was downright disgusting. This is not even an exaggeration, I actually threw up in the parking lot when we left. Twice. 

I had the rib eye which I had asked for medium rare. This was well done, at best. I could have sawed off the sole of my shoe and had more tender meat. 

My wife ordered the Alfredo. Nothing awful to say about this, just exceptionally bland. Sauce was pretty runny. 

But hands down the worst part of the meal was our appetizer of bruschetta. Something normally so simple, yet so rewarding. Not this batch. I've never had what I assume was expired fish in my bruschetta. It smelled like the ocean puked up the ingredients to this dish onto the beach, and then 3 weeks later they were scooped up and put on some toasted bread and served on a plate. Not appetizing in the least bit. 


The final mystery of Gino's is the speed in which your dishes arrive. Within about 4 minutes of ordering our food, it was on our table. How you can cook a steak from raw to burned to the point you might get cancer in 4 minutes is beyond me. This occurred at every table around us. I've seen enough episodes of Kitchen Nightmares to know this was either done with a microwave, or pre-cooked much earlier. 

The faces of every table near us screamed of a similar experience. I can't imagine this place gets much of any repeat business, unless you've permanently removed your taste buds with a curling iron that is. 

Needless to say, we won't be going back anytime soon. Unless of course I'm in need of getting ringworm again. I'll spare the details of the rest of the night, but let's say it was about as colorful as dinner.

I'm can't speak for delivery, which is what most of these reviews were about. BUT! For dine in this place is great!!!! We usually order the #10 for two adults and two small kids and have PLENTY of food. We take home about three to-go boxes and it warms up great later! We are always greeted when we come in and the place is usually quiet and fairly empty (don't let this scare you!) We have been here a handful of times and each experience is the same. The food comes right away and is always fresh and very tasty! We are so happy we finally found an awesome Chinese restaurant to dine in at! On another note: their fried rice!! AMMAZINGG!! I am surprised at the reviews stating it tastes weird. We love it!!!

Heidi went above and beyond to help my husband and I with an issue with collections. It was nice to finally have someone care about something that can negatively affect us and she resolved it for us in just a day. We really appreciate it. 

My husband and mom also both see Laura and only have great things to say about her. Thanks for taking care of my family.
Chicken and waffles are a must have. Also try the Ain't yo mamas hash, fried mac n cheese balls, and I'm pretty sure the rest of the menu is delicious. Time will tell, we will definitely be back

Came here with friends yesterday and ordered the chicken club with no chicken (I don't eat meat) I was fine with whatever else came with it but our server and kitchen worked together to make me something awesome and sautéed some veggies for me! This is how a kitchen should be! Our server was super awesome too (she worked in the bar area - had dark hair). Will be back again even though I don't eat meat! Haha

Ordered pick up, but ended up with the wrong order :( Pro Tip: Check it. Got the Teriyaki Chicken & Samon rolls, rolls were delicious and nice & fatty meat. Would recommend miso soup! Teriyaki Chicken was average meat& sauce, no grill marks either. Restaurant has a nice theme and vibe to it with sushi bar seating included. Would recommend dining in to enjoy this feast.

Have visited this new location 3 times. Always a nice experience - great food, the sashimi and sushi are fresh with the perfect amount of rice on the sushi. The ambiance is cozier and more intimate than the Milwaukee location and the service is quick! Great moderately priced sushi house for Meridian!!

So, so bad. Our service was atrocious. We came in around 1 on a Sunday for some lunch and football. We ordered 2 bloody Mary's, which were bland. We then ordered sliders, and a bleu burger. We waited a fair amount of time for our food, and then received it and our order was wrong. We would have mentioned it to our waitress, but she never came back to check on us, until well after we had finished our food. The burgers we did receive, were over cooked and dry, and the cheese wasn't melted. When Danielle finally returned to our table, we requested boxes and the check. We were going to pay with a card, but it took her so long to return AGAIN, that we opted to pay in cash just so we could get out of there without another 30 minutes passing. We will not be back.

Wonderful location in The Village. Great place to walk around before or after. Food was ok, nothing special. Prices were a little high for what you get, especially for Idaho. We ordered pizzas. They charge by the topping. So it doesn't take much to be paying a whole lot for a pizza before long.
Great restaurant! Clean, wide variety menu, fast and very generous portions. Friendly service. Sure I will return. Taste was great and food was hot. Will go go back to explore the entire menu!

We stayed here eight days in early October while waiting for our new apartment to become available. This long term stay hotel provided exactly what we needed, and did not have extras we didn't want nor need.

No provided breakfast or afternoon bit with processed foods, wheat, or fattening tidbits, but yes to a kitchenette area where we could prepare our own meals.

A nice hot tub like spa to sit and enjoy after a day exploring our new city. 

Great FREE laundry facilities given we needed to do lots of laundry as we had been traveling for quite some time. Did I mention FREE?

Strangely enough, a PRO for us was not being bothered with room cleaning each day. They clean like once a week. I mean really, this made this seem like a SHORT TERM apartment vs. a LONG TERM hotel. Sort of a practice run toward where we were moving.

The staff was friendly, suggested copies of Boise Weekly, gave me maps of the bike trails, and went out of their way to be helpful, but unobtrusive.

Exactly what we needed and wanted!

Wow! We are passing through Boise and needed some good food. So impressed with this place. I am a member of the big eaters club and I could not finish! The hashes are incredible. You have to come here. Now!

Back on the road! The staff at Bish's did an admirable job of repairing a seized axle on our trailer. It took longer than we'd hoped but they got the job done and Rich kept us appraised of their progress. And to top it off they checked all the other bearings and probably saved us more repairs down the road. Costs were not cheap but it was a relief to deal with professionals that worked hard to get the necessary parts for their mechanics to do the work.

Been a few times but always seem to forget it's there...went the other day for lunch and will now make a point to keep it in the front of my mind.

The food is excellent...the menu has a great variety and everything we had on our table the other day for lunch was fantastic. The mushroom bisque was fantastic and salads and sandwiches were great.

Really solid neighborhood pub/grill!

Ada West is a quality operation.  The staff are consistently helpful and friendly, from the phone support, the reception, the medical staff and check out, all great.  The doctors are highly efficient and yet willing to discuss whatever is necessary.  The care sends appropriate for the concerns presented, I have seem great improvement with conservative treatment. I strongly recommend this group.
Everybody there was so polite, friendly, and eager to help. It made it an enjoyable experience!! (: The food was very good and we'll prepared. Fun times!

Good taco shop fare...exactly like the taco shops in San Diego, except lots more room to sit inside. Reasonable prices, good selection, good guacamole for the rolled tacos. If I were in San Diego, it would be one of my top 3 taco shops. Here it's #1, since I haven't seen any competition.

I recommend it when you want fast-food taco shop fare (rolled tacos, carne asada burritos, chile rellenos).

Foods pretty good the veggies were a tad covered in trace amounts of burned food off the skillet and you have to buy your chicken separate from your veggies which gets quite expensive!  The waitress was a sweetheart but barely spoke a lick of English which costed me an additional 12.00 bucks because she couldn't clarify what the hell was going on.

The waiter wanted us to sit in a very dirty table that had some type of sauce smeared all over the seats and crumbs on the floor and table. 

The next table was just as dirty.

Finally found an acceptable table that we wiped down ourselves, but then they forgot half of the ingredients in my husband's burger and put the wrong ingredients in mine. Who thought they would forget lettuce tomatoes or onions? 

It was a slow day and I don't want to know what it's like when it's busy.

First time there, will not return.
It's a hole in the wall, that much is sure. Taste-wise it wasn't bad. The service is slow, which makes sense because you literally wait for the boats to come around with the Thing you want. Deece

Worst pizza ever. I tried it lukewarm when it arrived, heated a piece in the oven and finally heated another piece in the microwave. All of it was terrible. I ordered their traditional with extra mozzarella cheese and it tasted like a cracker. I couldn't taste their self proclaimed "secret recipe tomato sauce" probably because their sauce was made from the juice of one squeezed raw tomato. Probably some water was added so it covered the whole "pizza."  Never. Ever. Again. Gross.

The outstanding staff!!!! Cleanliness of the facility and how the fur babies have so much fun!!
LoLa runs to the doors lol   Its a great feeling knowing she has fun with her friends and socializes. Thank you Camp Bow Wow

The food was just great I had the salmon and my fiancé had the country steak, our son had the spaghetti and meatball. The meals overall were fulfilling!! The baked potato was delicious and the tartar sauce was so good and I normally hate it. Everything tastes so home made and delicious. My fiancé really enjoyed their white gravy and mashed potatoes. Our son also enjoyed his meal and my side of chicken noodle soup. You will not be disappointed with their food. We took a banana pie home and that as well was delicious but too much whip cream.

Be prepared to wait on the weekends. We had a party of 2 and had to wait almost an hour. Luckily, there was a pumpkin patch nearby that we could scope out rather than standing around in the chilly morning.

The food itself was very good and the portions are generous -- I had enough for a 2nd brunch the next day! I got the garden hash with a side of the pork chile verde because I wanted the best of both worlds. I loved the amount of veggies and goodness that were in the hash, as well as the flavoring of my pork. I also indulged in a specialty mimosa (i believe it was pomegranate that day) and very much enjoyed that.

Ate here for the first time today and my first experience exceeded all expectations!  The pizza is phenomenal!  Delicious tender crust -- a must for New York-style pizza.  I arte at the bar and Brad, the bartender, gave me better service than I have had table side at other restaurants.  I'll definitely be back... next time to try the white pizza!  Great addition to the Village.  rich.wright@milliganevents.com

The food was fantastic.  The service wasn't so much.  Servers were pleasant and attentive but our food took a long time to get to our table. Our server did apologize for the delay.  So perhaps this is an anomaly or perhaps its relation to Shige restaurant, which has always had crappy service is the reason?

Food was tasty, spicy, can well proportioned.  Actually had no room left for any dessert.  

Black Tea Pork was great.  A bit sweet but not overly so.  Kind of like teriyaki but less sweet and think.  Side of sweet corn which was great.  Not sure what they did to that corn but it was really good. 

Stuffed Pepper Jambalya was nice and spicy.  And the roasted pepper was roasted to perfection.  If you like mild Jambalya that is not overly hot with spices but spiced for flavor this is the dish for you. 

I will give this place another try.  Hopefully the service will improve on my next visit.

Went in today for breakfast. Jake, our server was awesome! Very kind and attentive! I got the sunrise breakfast which is you typical breakfast. Everything was amazing! My husband got the stuffed French toast which was delicious! Really sweet too! Overall It was a great breakfast! Thank you Jake!!

While I am a huge fan of Shige's in downtown Boise, I have not had a good experience at the Meridian Shige Express.  Each time I have been here, the chef becomes preoccupied with to-go orders, leaving plenty of empty boats.  Whether the place is near-empty or nearly packed, getting a drink refill is an exercise in determination and patience.  The good thing is the price ($1 white plates or $2 black plates).

I used to enjoy eating Famous Dave's Bbq and since it had been quite awhile, I decided to order their All American  Bbq Feast. It came with a full rack of St Louis ribs, a whole roasted chicken, a half pound of chopped Georgia pork, and sides of corn on the cob, Wilbur beans, coleslaw, roasted pecan Brussel sprouts and cornbread muffins. The high points of this meal were the friendly  lady that took  my phone order,  the beautifully seasoned, very juicy chicken and the awesome, cakey, moist cornbread.  The other sides were fine though nothing special. We were totally disappointed with the chopped pork. It was extremely dry and tasted like very much leftover leftovers. The ribs were mediocre as well. I enjoy ribs with a bit of "tooth" but they should be tender enough to pull the meat off the bone cleanly. Based on price and my experience I can't recommend Famous Daves.

This is the second time I have ordered a delivery from this store and they've given me the wrong order each time. I order a Veggie with no tomato, ez avocado and basically all of the freebies and I get a plain Veggie, with tomatoes, no avocado and the fountain drink I ordered was flat. The delivery gal seemed like she was in a bad mood, but now I'm thinking maybe she knew my order was screwed up and was trying to bug out. On the bright side, Im not getting food poisoning, but its extremely annoying to pay for and tip on food that isn't right at all. Not ordering from this Jimmy Johns again.

Warm beer. Rotten food. Rude management. 

They served us 4 warm beers(sent the first two back) then they give us nachos without any toppings on it. It was just chips and about 6 lbs of guacamole/ sour cream. I ordered a pulled pork sandwich and the coke slaw was rotten. You could smell it over every other smell on the table. The manager was mad that we complained about how terrible the food was. She stormed off and then a few minutes later our waitress came by and just told us to leave.

Always forget to take a picture before we finish the food. Whoops. This is our second time at Moe Joe's and, again, we are leaving satisfied. Started with a cinnamon roll. Icing had an almost orange flavor to it and was sweet. The actual roll had good cinnamon flavor and the texture was flakey. Not the greatest cinnamon roll but did its job to satisfy the craving. The short stack is two pancakes and they were fairly good sized. Not a lot of flavor, basically your run of the mill flour-based pancake. They were golden and fluffy but just fell flat on the flavor profile. Half order of biscuits and gravy was probably the highlight of this meal. The gravy was well seasoned, great texture and not overly greasy. The biscuit was unlike any we have had before and was awesome. It was crispy on the outside but still doughy on the inside. Now to the chicken fried steak. Same gravy as the biscuits and again it was really good. The steak has a fry that looks crispy but ends up being rather bready and soft. Side of Moe Joe potatoes was well seasoned and had a good fry on them. Lastly, the donut and cup of joe. Coffee flavored syrup was interesting (not good or necessarily bad) and the candied almonds gave it a good texture. Cindy, was fantastic. She was accommodating, friendly and on top of things. If this review was based solely on the service we would give it 5 stars. 
      All this being said, Boise is a tough place to find a quality breakfast. We rate Moe Joe's in the top three though.

Emailed for information and an appointment on Dec 21 and was told he would contact us after the holiday. Holiday's over! No call, no email, just nothing. I'd give a zero if I could because zero is just what I got.

The best Chinese food in the Treasure Valley. 
The staff is always friendly and the establishment is always clean. Their food is great. It is a must try

My first experience with Shanaz and I have to say I was quite impressed. I have been wanting to try this place ever since they opened and since my favorite soul food place that was on Broadway closed. Shanaz is kind of tucked away in a strip mall off of Main Street in Meridian across the street from Meridian Speedway.
