I get the feeling that if I asked for "no potatoes," it would look more like a taquito. And the service isn't that pleasant, but it's a fast food place for Pete's sake. I'm not coming here for good service.

I'm a big fan of taco trucks. And I'd have to say with the exception of a couple of those trucks, they're a better bet for quality for cheap Mexican than Los Betos. Or any carnicería like Campos that has their own taquería.
Simply the best pizza we have had in Idaho. The service is outstanding too.

The gluten free taste like cardboard... yum (not). The server bought the gluten free pizza's then waited to bring the none gluten free pizza's making it super awkward to eat in front of everyone else.

My husband and I went here for date night since we enjoy trying out the local joints. The place is very cozy and the staff is friendly.  My husband ordered the Filet Mignon (was on special) and I ordered the Crab and Salmon sliders.  My husband's Filet was cooked perfectly and was very delicious.  My Crab and Salmon sliders were ok but weird.  Now, I know they were going to have mango in the patties and there was also going to be a Thai Chili Mango salsa on it but there was so much going on that I could not taste the Crab and Salmon patties.

  They had a small but varied wine list and ended up getting a bottle of the Rosato sweet red wine and it was delicious.  Probably best for after dinner wine.  It was interesting that they had only 2 wines from Italy considering a majority of their artwork was almost all of Italy that I could tell.

Overall the place is small and inviting and a good place to get some friends together and relax for a glass (or bottle) of wine. Just be warned that some of the menu items have some unique flare. Especially with peppers.
Ok,ok,ok. I hope you haven't found this place. I want it all to myself! The Smokehouse hash is to good to describe! Don't go there! Why am I yelling?!?!! Oh yeah! Cause' Moe Joes!!!!!!

Please do not be swindled by this company like I was!  I have been a member for 6 months and have had 2 very horrible introductions.  The first match was met in the bowling alley lounge as we thought about bowling but discovered that league was bowling.  He was leaning back in his chair from the time I walked up until we left.  He did not offer to buy me a beer, a soda, even a glass of water!   The second was an engineer that actually bought me a cup of coffee but, anytime I was not asking questions about him there was an awkward silence.  I have made many mistakes in my life but this is definitely one of the most expensive, stupid ones!    Back away now while you can!!

Never eating here again! We were seated quickly but it took a while before anyone ever came over to offer drinks. I had asked our waiter what he recommended and he said he had only tried one dish which he said was basically short ribs. I decided to order the Sushi "Side Bar" buffet. $24.99 a person. Only 4 sushi rolls to chose from. A California roll, Philly roll , spicy tuna roll and something else that was unrecognizable. There were a few side dishes to chose from but what was supposed to be hot was cold and the cold dishes were less than mediocre.  One of the side dishes was cut up cold hot dogs and I think celery. All the wait staff rushed around super busy never making eye contact so we couldn't get anyone's attention just to get our check. My husband finally got up from our table and walked up to a waiter to ask for our bill. Very disappointing experience. Never going back .

I just had the worst manicure and pedicure ever! My toenails were cut too short. Amber did my manicure and did a half-assed job on my nails. She didn't bother to cut or even file my nails evenly and my cuticles weren't even trimmed appropriately. The service I received was not worth the $90 spent.
Great customer service. They are about your business in the long run so they treat you very well to keep you coming back

I have Lunch here a couple of times, once dinning in and another doing take out. I have tried the Mongolian Beef and the Sweet and Sour Chicken for Lunch. Both times, tasted great along with tasting fresh. Most of the Chinese restaurants that I have been too, the food sometimes can taste greasy or taste the MSG in the food which I end up feeling it later. This place does not have that problem. I would recommend trying this place out, they are quick to make your order, so if you have a short lunch its a good place to go.
Just okay food, nothing to call home about. Plus side is they have all of their gluten free items clearly marked on the regular menu. Service can be a little slow at times. Nice casual atmosphere.

This is a popular and great breakfast spot.  The food is good: non-processed food is important to me. Service is excellent too.  Everything we have had at Moe Joe's is delicious.  

The only reason I knocked it down to four stars is because it's not an eatery you just pop into. Every time I've gone to breakfast, we've had to wait anywhere between a half an hour and up to an hour.   It seems Moe Joe's needs a larger dining room to accommodate the crowd, (but that's a good thing, right?).  I just don't like waiting to eat. ‍

We love Paramount Animal Care!! Dr. Mark is the absolute best! You can tell that he really cares about your animals. This is really important to me because I want to feel like someone else sees how special they are to us Their scheduling and availability is always been great. They've even worked us in, in an emergency situation once which I will forever appreciate. The other vets I've met there are great too and all the techs are total animal lovers and so friendly and capable!

I was pleasantly surprised when I walked in. In all honesty, I expected a complete greasy spoon. It was not. I was seated quickly and Mary the manager came over to take my drink order. When I told her that I had never been there before, she was awesome in telling me the important things about the menu. She also listened to a good concern and gave me a suggestion. My food arrived hot, timely and nicely presented. For breakfast, I want things overlapping. The food was very good. Definitely order the Moe's potatoes. Mary came back and checked on me a couple of times. (Most servers ignore a person eating alone.)

My experience was great!

Just ok,  coffee machine in lobby is a nice feature.  Clean linens, older room style.  *ADVICE*,  if you can't stand the HVAC at night, which goes off and on based on motion detection.  Hold the power button and the blue down arrow on the thermostat until you get the 'BP' message.  This bypasses the motion detection for 24 hours.  Once I did that,  the HVAC they have is awesome, especially in continuous run mode.  Stay away from the Japanese Hibachi joint next door, yuck!!!

When I arrived I was greeted promptly and sat. Very few people in the restaurant so I didn't have to wait. 

The waitress gave me suggestions of what tasted good and let me know how spicy and not spicy items were. 

I had the spicy tuna combination. Great amount of food for the price. It filled me up and I still had items left to eat. 

The staff was very friendly helpful.
Great cut by Jeremy today.  I really appreciate the work, great atmosphere in the shop.. I shall return.

My favorite pizza place!!!! Always have great service. Love the atmosphere as well! Even my 5 year old daughter loves it. One time a pizza came out a tiny bit burnt on one side so they gave us that one and brought us a whole new one. Excellent service

My family eats at Red Robin at least once or twice a month.  So I feel confident in saying that we have seen this particular location slide a bit in the quality of service, quality of food and accuracy of our orders.  It continues to be on a downward trend.  The last couple times have been particularly challenging.  If you stay with me, I'll tell you about two specifics examples.  The first one has to do when we order shakes.  When we dine at Red Robin, we always order shakes.  My wife and I each get a monster shake and then ask to split them so we can share with our kids.  In the past, they would bring us the shakes in two adult and two smaller/kid sized glasses, looking pretty, with straws, spoons and extra napkins.  The past few times we have ordered shakes, we usually get a glass and the extra in the metal tin; and are missing either spoons, straws, or both and always have to ask for extra napkins.  Maybe I'm spoiled or my expectations are unrealistic, I think shakes should always come with a straw and a spoon; when children are involved, you should always bring extra napkins; and when sharing is involved, you always present the shared shakes as you would present the normal shakes, and reserve just dropping the metal tin of extra shake for the individual orders.  My second example, and the last time we ate at Red Robin was a to-go order, which we like to do from time to time, since the restaurant can be so crowded and busy.  I called the restaurant's phone number to order and they now have an automated answering system.  I selected the appropriate choice to place a to-go order.  The phone then rang and rang and rang and rang, for approximately 2-3 minutes; so long that it rang back, or I was sent back, to the original automated message.  So, I again selected the option to place a to-go order.  After a few rings, someone appeared to answer and put me directly on hold, as I began to hear nothing other than music and no one ever introduced themselves to me or asked me to be placed on hold.  I find this incredibly rude and one of the worst things to do to a customer calling in.  I played along, and sat on hold for more than 10 minutes; I looked at the timer on my phone before hanging up.  I decided to call back.  This time I selected the choice in the automated system to speak to a person.  (Sorry if I butcher the spelling of names from here on in my story)  Elaina answered the phone.  I tried to tell her my story.  When she heard me say 'to-go' she immediately cut me off, talked over me, didn't let me finish, and said she would be transferring me to the bar.  Being talked over and transferred off before finishing my statement is another of my major pet peeves, as a customer.  It shows a basic lack of respect and tells me I'm not important, just a disruption to your day.  When I was transferred to the bar, I was put back on hold.  I held for another 3 minutes.  As I was contemplating hanging up and driving to the restaurant to place my order, and share my grievances to someone in person, Melissa answered.  I finally got to give my order.  In all fairness, I did call at around 18:10; so I'm sure they were busy.  I don't think busy excuses basic common courtesy.  When my wife returned home from picking up our order, it was wrong.  The quality of food was okay, not what I would expect, with barely cooked fries and a burger that wasn't cooked well done; though wasn't pink, which is the choice you get, pink or no pink.  Unfortunately, having our orders wrong has become a habit; we now expect it.  Luckily, it wasn't anything we couldn't just pick off or do without.  When this particular location first opened, it was shaky.  Then they seemed to improve and we loved dining there.  Now it is becoming a place we don't enjoy going.  We have been having issues with Red Robin locations is other places, cities, states.  We have been told it is because of corporate changes.  I can't tell you what can be attributed to changes; and what is just a basic lack of customer service and pride in your work.  All I know is that with each dining experience, we are thinking more and more that Red Robin is not a place we want to frequent.

Great breakfast- I had the garden hash and loved it- there was a great variety of vegetables in it- zucchini, tomatoes, spinach, mushrooms, potatoes, and roasted garlic- delicious combo. My husband had classic egg Benedict- he makes amazing eggs Benedict so his standards are very high-he said it was good but not extraordinary. 
  Our server was attentive and made sure our our order was right and our drinks full. We will definitely be back again- great restaurant and lots more items on the menu to try.

OMG. This place is a real gem! We ordered the smothered pork chop, stuffed pepper and the fried Mac n cheese and every dish was out of this world! Plus the people are great. We will be going back often.

It's our daughter's birthday and she raved about the Boise location, so we decided to visit the Meridian location on their grand opening.  We arrived at 5pm and were the only ones in the restaurant. I checked Yelp and it said that they opened at 5:30pm but yet their doors were opened and the sign said OPEN. Two young under 20s greeted us. It was peculiar that they were not Korean but okay. It took some time but our server arrived. He was a hulking mass of man who dwarfed his iPhone as he took our order. He had a hard time pronouncing the dishes and navigating his iPhone to take our order.  FYI. My daughter was able to say the dishes more proficiently.  The prices are staggering. I was fairly familiar with their location in Boise and their prices seemed to be reasonable, but it appears that they added a Meridian surtax to all the prices at this location. A sushi buffet is $24.99. Plates are 13-17 dollars and there are no sides.  Working in the Silicon Valley, there are plenty of Korean restaurant located in one of the most expensive PER CAPITA areas in the world but their prices are more adorable than K-Fusion in Meridian. This is an issue that needs to be addressed. There was no silverware or chopsticks available or napkins. We ordered the Korean fried chicken but sadly the sauce is extra. The chicken is already 7.99. The food was good but not spectacular. There was some spicyness to the dishes that was missing. The amount food plate wise was average especially considering the prices. I understand that it was opening night and I know what it is like to open a restaurant but ultimately here's what they need to fix. 

(1) The staff needs to be trained  to say the dishes in Korean and know who they taste like. 
(2) the ordering system needs to be done on something else besides an iPhone 
(3) tables and sections need to be drawn out and assigned to the staff properly
(4) Assess the proper cost of the dish relative to the the price on menu. ( I should have to pay additional 4.00 dollars for a plate because I choose to go to the Meridian location ) 
(5) Introduce some specials or have a Karaoke night on Tuesday especially with KPOP to bring in a younger crowd but realize that they can't pay 13 per plate.  

Wish K-Fusion all the best. I want them to stay as I believe they can become a destination location.

Almost didn't go to this fabulous restaurant because of the last couple terrible reviews on yelp. I couldn't find the other place I was looking for. The servers were great, the chicken parmigiana and baked tortellini were scrumptious.  Everything had an individual taste and I'm very glad it's what I found. Do yourself a favor and enjoy this great food and atmosphere.

This is by far the best canine care we have ever had. We had to have our beloved beagle put down last wi tee and they came to our home and made it as respectful and peaceful as possible. I would recommend them to any pet owner!

Chef was nice and friendly so there's where the 1 star is coming from. The sushi was horrible. Too many mayo slathered  and deep fried rolls. The tuna tasted way old. Mackerel was tougher than boiled chicken. I don't believe there is a concept of freshness. Kids loved the boats though. I won't be visiting this location again.

Food wasn't impressive, cost over $20 for two people, it took far too long for our order to be finished (over 15 minutes for a burger and a ricebowl), and my burger was lukewarm. There are too many quality meals for two in the sub $20 to even consider this place.
Great experience shopping for a new trailer with Jesse @ Bish's. The environment and Jesse's expertise made going in and out of trailer after trailer fun and interesting.

Jist found this place after flying in from FLA.
Great pancakes!! Best I've had in years!!
Great Chinese food. Everything is authentic and tasty. We had pepper pork, moo shu, almond shrimp and almond chicken. Service was excellent too!

Good job installing on time. The quick service was the major benefit. Customer service was ok. The invoice wasn't clear on the breakdown of charges. I feel like that was for a reason. There was a large tear out and install fee which is often free with other carpet stores. No option to tear out the old carpet ourselves to reduce costs. So I feel like this fairly low end carpet I selected ended up costing me as much as really nice carpet elsewhere. I knew the total cost up front at least and I went for it anyway just because I was in such a hurry. I recently had nice carpet installed in my own home by another store so I have an idea of what I felt like the cost should have been and this was probably 50% more at the end of the day. So I probably won't use them again. I'll take that extra week and shop around and get clear bid statements.
Yep, it's chain food, but pretty good stuff. Always good service.

Read the review on this place and decided to try it. My wife and I were not disappointed. We came around 3 PM on a Saturday so there was no wait time to be seated. The food was very good, served hot and promptly. We started with the Wor Wonton soup which was excellent. We then had the beef and broccoli dish accompanied with a shrimp and vegetable dish along with fried brown rice. The servings were large with the wor wonton soup alone being a meal itself so we had plenty to take home, which we enjoyed again that evening. We would definitely recommend this place. Seating is sufficient and the rooms have nice decorations pleasing to the eye. There is even a fireplace in the middle of the restaurant but today being  a wonderful Spring type day, it was nice and warm without the fireplace, the service was very good with the server being attentive to our needs and checked on us every ten minutes or so.

Well, their pizza is pretty good. Expensive, but good. We had a pesto w/ grilled chicken artichoke hearts and spinach. It was tasty. The service was attentive to say the least. My issue was our bill was roughly $30 (and some change). My friend and I split the bill, I paid $15 cash and she paid the remainder on her card. When she received her receipt it was for $21 (and some change). To me that is a sketchy practice... We didn't throw a stink about it and just let it be his tip. Just a fair warning, watch your transaction amounts. You can always compare reciepts.
It is hard to find good Chinese food in South Meridian. I found this place and have been multiple times and like it every time.

You can't really mess up pizza, it wasn't too bad honestly but what did suck was the waiting time and the attitude of the staff. We had to wait 20 minutes to be seated even though we called ahead, and there was plenty of room in the area with the bar, but she didn't offer that (could have been reserved but probably not). You pay per topping and it took probably 30 minutes for the pizza to be prepared and cooked. Wasnt the worst but for the price I expected better. I feel like people enjoy the vibe of the Village more than the actual food.

I'm so happy we came to this doggy day care. I love that the dogs do not ever stay in a kennel unless they need a break or nap time for older dogs. They cater to all needs and have only social interaction which is good for all dogs. And cameras so you can check online and see your pup in action! They did really well clipping nails and bathing my pup as well. Definitely buying a set of camping passes soon!

I have been an AT&T customer for 18 years, but recently came to an impasse relative two phones I bought. Without going in to the details, AT&T had a technical issue on which to stand, and I had a moral issue. We all know how moral issues usually turn out... In this case the store manager listened carefully, represented my position to a senior manager, and came up with a very fair settlement. The crux was to stick to the technical terms, or render a fair decision that was an investment in the relationship. I have to admit that I was pleasantly surprised when AT&T rendered a decision that not just maintained our relationship, but made it better. I commend the manager for taking the time to hear my points, and representing them well to his superior. They have earned my trust!
Amazing and loved the location once inside! Its the perfect neighborhood spot I don't want them to move! Phenomenal food!

Ordered take out red Robin this past Friday night 8/10/2018 the burgers were hard and cold way over cooked usually dont get cold food wasnt even that busy yet. Forgot our extra fries no seasoning called to place order. Service is going downhill lately not sure if we are going to go back. Called specifically so our order would be correct it was right but cold and overcooked almost like they sat under the warmer way yo long and dried them out.

The pizza is actually pretty good here. It's a bit overpriced but MAN IS THE SERVICE BAD. I'm not talking about the waiters although both times we've gone they don't really check up on you either, but what I'm really getting at is the time it takes from when you order to the time it gets out to you. I'm not being over dramatic when I say I've never been to a place where it takes longer. You sit and sit and sit. Oh and they'll bring someones meal out and they'll be done by the time someone else's gets out to them. I'm being a food yuppie on yelp right now... what am I doing with my life
Great food, great service. Lots of options including some healthy ones. Had to wait but not too long. Would come back again and again if we lived here.

Just to clear this up. They have $$$ as a price range listed on yelp. Clearly $7 for a turkey club and a coke doesn't warrant $$$. Yes way better than subway. We each have our own taste. So rank it as you see fit.
Lot of yogurt flavors, even more toppings. On the pricey side but that's okay for small kids because they don't eat a ton (or shouldn't) anyway. Lots of seating or take it to go.

Love Red Robin and specifically this clean and upbeat location!  We were welcomed at the door by one of the managers, Jose.  He was absolutely one of the highlights of our day!

Our hamburgers were perfectly prepared and the bottomless parmesan & garlic fries were awesome!   The freshness of the vegetables and buns put this meal over the top!  Everything was exceptionally tasty!

The manager Jose is extremely impressive.  He made us feel like we were his only table, although there was a full house of happy diners!  I really like this restaurant and I plan to return for another awesome dining experience when in Meridian.  I highly recommend that when you visit, say hello to Jose, he's awesome!!!

My daughter and have tried this location 3 times now. While I love the downtown Boise location, this one has been a disappointment . Every time we have been there, we always waited for the chefs to make enough rolls to keep up with the demand. The rolls are very basic, and come smothered with mayo. The service is also very poor. It might be ok for the casual "sushi" fan, but we won't be going back.
This is my kid dreams come true. Fill a cup with a mixture of flavors and then top it with WHATEVER TOPPINGS YOU WANT without having to pay more. Thank you for making Meridian a better place.

Since discovering this place 3 years ago while in town on business, hubby & I have returned each year and been delighted every time. Our recent meal may have been best yet.

 Laura, our server, was professional, friendly, informative, all around perfect. We enjoyed wine before the meal: Hubby had Chianti and I had an Italian Zin-blend, recommended by Laura. Both glasses were wonderful. The warm table focaccia bread and garlic/pepper infused olive oil: yum. Salad: yum. Tuscan soup: yum. By the time our entrees came, we were pretty full, but we gave it a try.  Hubby's smoky boar shank with gnocchi was a bit salty for my taste but he liked it. I had one of the nightly specials: Parmesan crusted veal chop, frenched, with cherry tomatoes, balsamic vinegar, mushroom risotto & other yumminess. How can one go wrong pairing flavorful tomato bursts with balsamic? I know you are full, tummy, but just a little more.

 Despite our efforts, most of our entrees ended up as to-go boxes which ultimately ended up on a Southwest Airlines flight where they received some well-deserved attention. A steward stopped to watch me try to slice my veal (that was before I gave up and just picked up the frenched bone with my hands.). I looked up expecting that she was going to confiscate my useless plastic knife but instead I got, "Oh, my goodness! Did you get that at the airport?!!" Veal envy. I understood. Heads were turning from rows 36, 35 & 34. And so, I apologize to the nearby passengers & crew of SW Flight 6521 for enjoying a 5-star meal as you wolfed pretzels.

I've been here twice now; both times I got take out. A bit disappointed with this place. Their food is good but both times I found little pieces of wood in my food. They don't give you ketchup packets for takeout and this time I didn't get and syrup for my pancakes or plastic silverware. The potatoes were a bit over cooked and the pancake wasn't a circle for some reason? 
Prices are decent and the place has been busy both times I've been in.

Coming to Fujiyama is a treat for our family. Every time we come for lunch or dinner, we love how nice everybody is and how delicious the food is. 
Prices are affordable for the quality of the food and the atmosphere is amazing!
Highly recommended!!

We ate a few spicy tunas and California's, and at one point we didn't eat everything on the boat. So the chef did not made anything new for about 15 minutes, as if they wanted us to just leave. We were there as a family of five and left hungry.

This might have been the best corn beef hash I have ever had and I have had a lot of them. They make it in house and it is larger pieces instead of the ground up kind. The potatoes as a base were perfect with the eggs and hash. I only ordered water until I saw a waitress feeding oranges into a fresh squeezed orange juicer. I would definitely go back and if you like corn beef hash you need to try this if you are close.

Visiting from California. The yelp reviews were helpful, my brother and I liked it very much we ordered cinnamon roll french toast and country fried steak we shared both dishes TASTY FOOD I LOVED THE cinnamon french toast. 
SAM was our waiter he was very very nice and helpful!!! So we came back and brought our family to enjoy these tasty home made breakfast.

Another fabulous night at Gino's. We went early and the place was already packed. Luckily we had made reservations. It was homecoming at one of the high schools. So much fun watching the kids all dressed up having a great time. We had the stuffed mushrooms...even the mushroom hater in our group said they were delicious. The Shrimp Maria was a huge portion and everything was cooked to perfection. The wait staff is fantastic and attentive. Never been disappointed in this place.

Typing this while I eat my room temp soup that I waited 2 hrs for. Normally happy with them but it took 6 calls to see where my food was and then driver lied saying he just picked up food...it is cold. Called in and told she would call driver..never heard back. $40 not well spent.

This is a great place for kids ages one to seven or eight. Lots of mock-play things like a grocery store and dress-up. The jungle gym is pretty large with slides and climbing areas. We went to a birthday party a while back here and it was very organized and structured, they served healthy snacks, had face painting and play time. It is incredibly busy on the weekends, so much so that it is almost unbearable so go during an off time if possible.
Ok breakfast, nothing special to write about as far as food goes... service was great and food was adequate, one piece of advice - don't order the spicy beer, it's awful.

Their hours of operation are limited and their website and organization is horrible.  On their voicemail they give you the hours they are open.  We planned a drop in birthday party for my son and his friends based off of the times they stated on their voicemail and website.  We made several attempts to make calls and leave messages to verify.  Since they don't answer or return calls when they aren't open, we showed up Wednesday night when they said they opened, just to be turned away because only 13+ years of age was allowed to play that night.  We headed over to Jump Time and saved the party.

Amazing customer service.  I came here with my 85 year old mother who was  locked out of her voice mail.   We had spent 3 hours on the phone and computer trying to solve the problem. With no success. We finally decided to go to a Verizon store, and Ryan provided amazing service.   He helped us get to the bottom of the problem and fix it within 15 min.   He was kind and patient with my mom who isn't a native English speaker.   We will definitely go there again.

Terrible terrible food. Some of the worst food I've ever had in my life. No flavor, no pizazz, nadda.. I'd rather roll the dice at an Applebee's for "better" tasting pasta for the lesser of two evils. And I wouldn't feed Applebee's to my dog. We ordered almost $200 in food to go for 5 of us, we threw half of it away after we ate enough just to get by without going hungry before bed.

My favorite Mexican food around, it might not be super fancy or have dozens of options but the flavor is there and that's what matters most! I would suggest the Idaho burrito or the fish tacos to anyone.
Try another business, this one provides terrible customer service over the phone. Coming from a potential customer calling to ask a few questions - pretended like he couldn't be bothered. No thanks.

Great food, great ambiance, great service. My partner had a seafood lasagna that had generous portions of seafood. The pasta is made on site and it is delicious. The wine was wonderful as well and I was offered a tasting before I settled on a particular wine. The service was downright delightful. A must-visit in Meridian.

We boarded two opposite type dogs for 5 days and could not be happier with the experience and the treatment of our animals. Aspen is an introvert and did not want anything to do with the other dogs. After two days she was running around and the staff gave her the human attention she craves. Sadie on the other hand could play all day long with every dog. I almost had to drag her out of Camp Bow Wow. Would definitely recommend and will return when needed. Professional staff and a clean facility make this a 5-star rating.
I love the pineapple friend rice! The lunch specials are great too! Very authentic! The service is awesome! I love the peaceful environment too!
Nice setting, decent portions and good price. Food is excellent but just too much sauce on the food. Service is pretty good though it takes some time for them to get to you.

Doughnut pancake is legit! If you're confused by its name, it does not come with a "cup of Joe", it's not referring to coffee but instead the coffee flavored syrup that comes with the special doughnut pancake. Smothered breakfast burrito was big and super tasty as well, but would've been better if it had melted cheddar cheese inside.

I give Red Pavilion a solid 3.5.  The restaurant is small but airy and not at all cramped. I like the modern décor especially the boxy lamps suspended from the ceiling. The wait staff is very attentive and friendly.
We ordered the combo lunch: sweet and sour soup, chow rice (fried rice), ruby red chicken (sweet and sour), and an appetizer of spring rolls.
Pros: quality ingredients and freshly prepared dishes.
Cons: soup had too much soy which interfered with the sourness. Some chicken pieces were over fried and tough and the sweet and sour sauce became gelatinous upon cooling.  Fried rice was too light and bland. 
The meal was satisfying enough, but just missing an element in each dish.

Great food, service was phenomenal. Food was fresh and cooked to perfection. Coffee was strong and tasted excellent. Sky was the best waitress I have had in quite a long time. Definitely would recommend. Portion size was too much for me but perfect for my boyfriend.
Its good when you want some heavy taco shop food. The portions are good and food is decent. Forget about the service, they are not known for their service.
Paul is an experienced professional. Installed my new carriage door it looks great and sounds even better. He goes the extra mile to see that you get a quality product.
Food was good n fresh.   One of us had an over 55 omelet with hashbrowns sausage and a biscuit.   The other was a club sandwich with fries.   Service was good and price was reasonable.

Looked for something different close by and settled on Red Pavilion.  If you don't care how bad your service is, then know I would have given three stars based on food alone.  The taste was good and quality/freshness up there.

Upon entering I first noticed a lack of signage requesting patrons seat themselves, wait, go fly a kite or.... A couple were in front of me waiting to order takeout.  They seemed exasperated and actually caved to the poor service by ordering drinks to sip while waiting!  Three staff were visible, though two entirely ignored the growing number of customers while the third handled a phone call.  

Once off the phone, that person handled the aforementioned couple and then - 12 minutes and another lengthy call later - I was finally asked what I wanted.  I replied that a menu would be nice, which garnered a few chuckles from nearby customers.  Ordered a basic combo for takeout - I keep things simple the first time visiting a new eatery.  Having read reviews and their website, I noted they offer a military discount.  When I was finally being rung up - now 30 minutes into experience - I mentioned the discount.  The person who had spent all the time on phone overhead and stated "there is no discount."  I noted that I had just viewed their website where they proudly proclaim to offer such, to which she offered no explanation, just repeated "no discount."  Had I been on the ball, I would have replied in my best broken english "no mo business for you," but I instead made mention of how horrible it is when businesses falsely advertise and had there ever been such a policy then they should have edited the website etc. when they changed the policy.

Discounts are nice, but proper service is far more important.  Red Pavilion managed to offer horrible service and no explanation for not honoring their policies.  While the food as noted was decent, poor service and lengthy unnecessary waits are two things that I do not tolerate.  The service was so poor and wait so long in this case that I definitely will not be giving them a second chance.

The best breakfast place I've found so far in the 208 area!!! Hugee portions and the best menu selection I've found! The staff was super nice and the prices are reasonable. Both dishes were AMAZING and I have yet to find any breakfast potatoes that even compare to theirs! Moe Joe's is a must!

This place was delicious! I happened to go when it wasn't that busy, but service was still excellent. The servings were bigger than I was expected, which was a nice surprise. Great food, good service, nice atmosphere. I'd for sure visit again.

I've been here a few times and it's always great! I love their fried zucchini and their "clucks and fries" meal. The last time I was there I got the prime rib dip with onion rings on the side. The onion rings were fabulous, the sandwich was okay. Don't get me wrong, the meat on the sandwich was DELICIOUS. But they soaked the sandwich with some kind of sauce, not sure what but it had an odd taste I wasn't fond of. The bottom bun actually got soggy pretty fast from the amount of sauce. So, I wasn't that thrilled with the sandwich on the whole. Still good though, and the service was excellent. I would still go back, but I would order something else!

When I first started shopping here, I thought this was 5 stars. It's slowly gone downhill. My main complaint is that they took out the childcare at Freddy's. I used it a few times a week to go shopping, and I spent a lot more money than I would have otherwise, because I was child free and could shop without distractions. The produce molds quickly, and the grocery prices are higher than nearby Walmart. They are often out of my favorite items too. The employees are very nice, but it's not worth it to come here anymore unless I need to order a cake or go clothes shopping.

Super disappointed tonight with our order. I called to order one pizza for delivery and was quoted 80 minutes (which is fine, I know they have long delivery times.) I was still ordering and trying to say that I needed one ranch but was hung up on. I called right back and spoke with the same person and he said that he already rung my order up and that my ranch was going to be .50, "would you like to pay with cash or card?" Uhhh.. I do not want my debit card ran for .50. My medium pizza was 19 dollars and they can't budge to give a free, overpriced ranch as well? On top of that annoyance, my pizza was delivered cold. I don't mind paying extra for good food but it definitely should not arrive like there were 7 deliveries ahead of mine and my pizza was just sitting in someone's back seat. Gross. It's going to be a long while before we return if we even do.

This is the worst fast food place I have ever been. They are extremely slow, and they mess up my order every time. Not only that, but when they give you your food it is always incorrect or something missing!

Haven't been to Wingers in several years. I love their Original Wing meal and sauce. I braved Eagle at 5:30 pm. This speaks volumes in itself. We made it unfortunately after happy hour which is over at 6 pm. Fine we will still order drinks. My hubby orders a beer and I a cocktail. My cocktail is delivered in a timely fashion. Hubby's beer doesn't make it so quickly. 20 min. later I have to go to the bar myself, due to service being non-existent, to get the beer. Bar tender forgot. Dinner arrives shortly after and is flavorful and hot. Our server, unfortunately, went MIA. She apparently had completed her task of delivering food and was no longer needed until time to deliver said check and please don't forget to tip me for my lack of service. So, if you want to go based on food I'd do take out. 
I'd give it a 2.5

So-so Pizza. I've come to enjoy thin crust, brick oven style pizza. This just came up short. We ordered the Brooklyn Bridge, Quattro Formaggi and The Don. Should have know better with the Brooklyn Bridge, as it has a ricotta sauce. I prefer less ricotta and more mozzarella in Lasagna, so we'll chalk this up to a bad choice. Shifted with anticipation to The Don. Surprisingly little flavor, even with 3 meats. The Quattro was...a cheese pizza. I was in town from Spokane, which is not exactly a culinary hotbed. However, I can think of at least 6 places that have better pizza. I'm sure Boise has better as well, just have to go search for it.

Basque Chorizo Pepper Hash omg! An explosion of flavors! I'm in food heaven. Huge portion. Jalapeño added extra kick. Represents Idaho with Basque chorizo and of course Idaho potato. A must have!. For extra $0.99 I had pancake. Did not regret was light and fluffy; extra large. Daughter ordered same thing, but had the toast. $27 w/o tip seemed a lot, but huge portions, only ate half. Morgan was waitress, really nice and attentive. Really popular because there was a lot waiting after we left. We sat outside and got in right away. Will definitely eat here again

* A recent visit made me very happy. They have a large menu board for ordering and I didn't see a kids menu area; however I asked if they could do a kids bean and cheese burrito for my son and they did. It was reasonably priced and perfect size for my son!

For Mother's Day this year I told my hubby that I wanted my favorite coffee... and a steak breakfast burrito from Los Betos! I'm totally serious. He got me what I asked for and I had an amazing Mother's Day breakfast. 

The steak aka carne asada breakfast burrito is my favorite for breakfast. On normal days that I swing thru the drive through I either get a bean and cheese burrito or their new Idaho Burrito. It's a spin on the California burrito (which is good as well). Meat, cheese, fries/potato, sour cream, guac and salsa goodness. It's the best!  

No place is perfect and I've had an experience here and there that didn't blow me away. Over cooked eggs once, and today I was almost half way thru my burrito before I saw any sour cream and guacamole. It was still a delicious dinner and I'll be back again soon!
Went there for a Saturday brunch and the food was SOOO GOOD!!! I will definitely be back. Try this place out rather then one of the big guys(denny's) it is So worth it. Big Fan!
Great Food!!!  Don't let the category keep you from eating here, you can add a protein to your dish if you'd like.  Also, the pizza is great for sharing at lunch:)

Love this place!  Very relaxing, modern, and top of the line products and facility. Everyone was so welcoming and friendly. We brought in wine, and they provided glasses and re-poured when we got low. Prices were very reasonable for what you get. I had the pedi with the paraffin treatment and it was amazing. Had a very great experience. I will go back and bring friends!

I was born and raised in Southern California and have been missing my good Mexican food saw this place as I was driving in to Del Taco and read the reviews from those who know and so I thought I'd give it a whirl (being a lover of Alberto's - a reference for my So Cal peeps!). 

Right away I walked in and heard a Hispanic family talking to their kids in Spanish and the gentleman after me ordered in Spanish, and with the music playing in the kitchen area...I knew I was in the right place.

So I ordered my usual order - carnitas with beans rice and cheese (my friends growing up used to tease me for "ordering so white") and the chorizo, potatoes, eggs, and cheese breakfast burrito.


VERDICT: 
Fan-friggin-tastic!! THAT is what Mexican food is supposed to taste like! 

The tortillas are great, the ingredients were great.

If you want REAL Mexican food and not that American stuff they serve at "Mexican restaurants" go here.

This place is very inconsistent. Sometimes everything is good and sometimes you get a dry, old, funky, stanky, soggy diaper burrito. Flip a coin. All bets are off. They should change their name to "Lost Bets" or "Caca Asada" or "Huevos de Muerte". Unfortunately they've become consistent at being inconsistent. Factor in long wait times and questionable cleanliness. I gave my dog my mystery burrito and it gave him a bad trip and the runs for three moon cycles!  No quiero mas chorro! Better off buying a McMierda or going to taco smell.

First time here and it is very delicious especially their cornbread. Omg I recommend this little gem of a place my soul feel good with this food. And I gotta say great props on the waitress she was very sweet and welcoming. I'm definitely coming back.

I moved here from the bay area and am on the hunt for great pizza. Our first night here I ordered the Stampede BBQ chicken pizza delivery and it was very good. When you go to the restaurant, it's huge, perfect for a big party or little league gathering. Salad bar has LOTS of options and the staff is very friendly. Pretty fun family-friendly place.

Denizens of the Treasure Valley, this will be one of the more unusual reviews I have written.  Suffice to say I was very satisfied with my food and experience at Red Pavilion, but that having been said... I am not sure if or when I will return.  And the answer to that is an age old saying, "Happy wife, happy life."  Read on to see what I mean.

First off, the service is spot on.  I actually have never sat down to eat IN the restaurant itself, so by service I am referring to the take out.  Both times I have gotten take out here it has been ready right on time, prepared correctly, and with all the needed extras such as chop sticks, soy sauce, etc. right in the bag.  I pay the bill and I am right back out the door in minutes flat.  This is very helpful when you are picking up food with a squirming toddler (or two) in tow.  But everything was accurate and fast on both occasions, so bravo.

So that brings me to the food.  The entrees I had on both occasions were excellent.  I have had their Chow Fun noodles and honey shrimp.  I know, neither of these are the most "authentic" dishes in the world (although I think the chow fun was pretty darn close) but they were both prepared very well and had excellent flavor.  For those of you craving a more authentic experience though, they do also have a "special" menu, just ask your server about it.  As I have only done take out here and am not familiar with the offerings on this menu, I have not been able to sample them for myself.

Why will I not be returning then?  Three words.  Mu Shu Pork.  This is one of my wife's absolute favorite dishes and she is very particular about it.  If a place does it well, they have pretty much earned a customer for life.  If she does not like their interpretation, she probably will never return.  Unfortunately, Red Pavilion's mu shu fell into the later category.  I was pretty disappointed considering I really loved my food and thought I had finally found a "go to" Chinese place here in town.  Oh well, the search will continue.

Bottom line folks, if you are looking for a solid all around Chinese experience, Red Pavilion will do you right.  I say give 'em a try.
The food and service was excellent !!!! I came here for lunch with my coworker the service was excellent and I recommended the place to my other coworkers too!

My wife and I eat here occasionally, it's pretty good but not truly worthy of 4 or 5 stars. I did however really enjoy the calamari.  As for the true Italian feel that a name like Gino's should evoke, well that was missing.  Still all said it's a good place to get food that's on par with other Italian restaurants

I don't get out to The Village very often, but I was attending a baby shower and the expecting parents were registered here. 

I went on a Saturday afternoon - bad idea. I'm not a huge fan of crowds, so it certainly was not my cup of tea. 

When I arrived, I quickly located the registry station (the layout of the store is awesome - especially for how large it is) and was surprised to see there was only one self-use printer. There was 3 or 4 computers, but as one of them was occupied by an employee, it was clear those were not up for grabs.

There was about 5 ladies in front of me, but it was clear they were in two groups. I got in line and waited. And waited. For whatever reason, the first group couldn't figure out the printer. Just when they got their things and walked away, and the second group approached the screen, an employee greeted me and let me know she could print a registry for me. 

I sat across from her and waiting for ten minutes as she tried to figure things out. I'm not sure if she was unfamiliar with the system or if it wasn't working correctly, as that was not communicated with me. 

After finally receiving the printed registry, well actually two copies for some reason, I set off to find the baby goods. 

As I mentioned, the store is very well laid-out and things were very easy to find! It took me less than 5 minutes to find what I wanted and get checked out.

Stay away from this company.  We bought a house and purposely gave ourselves extra time between closing on the house and leaving the rental to clean the place from top to bottom.  We spent entire DAYS cleaning the bathrooms, kitchen, fans, bedrooms, walls, etc, only to receive a check back for ~$200 of the $900 we deposited.

Among the charges were carpet cleaning ($200, and we were told SPECIFICALLY to not have the carpets cleaned, because they would "take care of it"), "general" cleaning ($300), "general" maintenance ($75) and "administrative" fees of $125.  Aren't administrative fees part of the expenses of running a property management company to begin with?

If you have the choice of renting a house and you HAVE to go with this company, don't bother cleaning anything when you leave - they'll just charge you for it anyway..... and don't ever hope on getting your deposit back.

I order a pizza for pick up at 7:25, was told 30minutes it would be ready. 8:15 FINALLY get my pizza. Get home and realize they forgot the ranch. While eating my pizza I notice a long dark hair, not just on the top but baked into my pizza. It was disgusting! I couldn't eat any of it after that.

I've come to Moe Joes for breakfast twice (having never seen the yelp reviews); mainly went because the location is near work. First experience was not memorable food wise, and I did not like where we sat, on a table closest to the front door where people like to stand and crowd around while waiting to be seated. Second experience makes me not want to go back. Their 'biscuits' are not biscuits. It's baked sheet bread (biscuit like) and its cut in a square similar to a piece of cake from a cake pan. Resembles Italian bread for dipping in olive oil, not a biscuit for gravy or breakfast. And the house potatoes I had were terrible!!  My husband liked his (smothered in ketchup- anything is good with ketchup), but mine were way over cooked, dry, and salty. It looked like they dumped the last of the potato remnants onto my plate, half of it I could not eat. IF I give Moe Joes another chance, perhaps I'll try something sweet instead of savory; it seems possible that their pancakes or French Toast might be a safer option since those are hard to mess up. Disappointed even more now after seeing all the reviews. Server was nice, but we had to ask a different waitress to fill our water since our server never came back to refill.
Highly recommend their sushi! Order the sushi boat, which comes with an assortment of sushi and sashimi.

Taste like you would expect from a quick line served Tex-Mex joint. Not bad, nor great. All of us Californians definitely need to get over the fact that Mexican food out here is not the same no matter where you go. So if you're from California and trying to find the same stuff we had back their. Stop looking, it doesn't exist haha!

Do not go to this place. There cost profit is too high, when the very same products meaning the percentages are the very same. Unless you look like you have money dont count on service. When i went in with my work clothing on because i was doing some repairs ( I am a woman and i have my own shop) they just stared at me. A friend of mine who is retired U.S. Army went in to drop some serious cash and was ingnored, even with a request for service, so he went some where else. Its the ratios and percentages you have to watch for, because expensive doesnt always work, and everyone in this valley has a computerizedn water analysis set up. An the water balance kits are sold everywhere as they are the same. The wherehouse that sells the same chemicals and parts to everyone is here local. I have a suggestion for chemicals and needed supplies as i recommend them to all.

This place has really good food, but because it has such a large selection not everything is their specialty. I had a Thai cuisine (Pad kra phao moo sub)  which has phenomenal taste. My wife had Tao chicken, which tasted okay, but the breading wasn't that great. So if you choose the right options you'll find this place quite pleasant.

They offer brown rice as an option. Which is always nice.

For an appetizer I had the Cha Yor, which was a fried spring roll with lettuce, cucumber, and a peanut sauce. It was very crunchy and had a great taste.

The atmosphere was pleasant. It was tasteful and charming. The tables weren't  too crowded either. The service was prompt and the waiter was courteous.

My husband and I decided to have the Pavilion Triple-Double. We were each able to have the meals of our choice and it was under $30. We ended up taking a meal each home, the amount of food they gave was astronomical. 
It was also the best Chinese food either of us have ever had. 

I can not recommend this place enough. You should go.

GO HERE!!  

So good. Smokehouse is amazing, my wife loved the Alaskan eggs Benedict. Fresh squeezed OJ!  Great service.

I was taken here by friends and we did have a great time and I appreciate them, however this was pretty sub-par Italian food. I had bolognese and it was the flattest, least flavorful "long simmered" sauce I've ever had. The watery sauce tasted like a quick meat sauce I could throw together in 20 minutes. It was served over dried spagetti. The over-dressed salad was fine but I was sure disappointed in the pasta, especially at this price point. My friend got a seafood lasagna that he said was ok but the top was WAY over-broiled. I wish I could say this meal was better, especially since the poor locals we went with consider this the best Italian restaurant in the Boise area.

This was the most unfriendly restaurant I have been to in a long time. We arrived at Gino's a little before 5PM. There were 3 hosts ( or 3 people at the host stand) to great us. Instead of greating us or even asking how many people in our party they immediately asked of we had a reservation, we did not. Upon hearing this the host seemed to get a bit of an attitude and said that it will be a bit of a wait while he figured out where he would be able to seat us. The words used were fine, not great but fine. However it was more the way he said it. My husband and I just felt like a major inconvenience. We were about to leave when he grabbed some menus and said he would take us to our seat. This is when we realized, the place was not full at all in fact they only had 3 tables in use. We sat and were given water from a very pleasant young man who let us know the name of our waiter and that he would be over in a moment.  The waiter was fine, not top notch by any means but he brought us everything we needed. Again though we just felt like we were inconveniencing him. We didn't order alcohol and we didn't order anything super fancy but it just felt like the moment we said we did not want an appetizer he decided we were not the people he wanted at his table. 
The food was fine, overpriced but fine. 
When we left an hour later (right before 6pm) I noticed that only 5 tables were in use. Really makes me wonder why we were made to feel like we were putting them out by not having a reservation.

Absolutely the best breakfast food I've ever had in my life! Get the Moe Joe's potatoes! I've never had a dish here I was disappointed with. It does get VERY busy on Fridays and Saturdays. Wish they had a bigger dining room or more locations!

The eggs benedict and mimosas are fabulous!!  The atmosphere is a little cramped and the wait staff often seems frazzled but there are certainly plenty of reasons to revisit this establishment when you get a breakfast craving.

Dined here with 3 coworkers tonight. Service was very good. Enjoyed a variety of salads/ apps and shared 5 specialty rolls. Everything was wonderful!  Great value. I would absolutely enjoy sushi here again in the future.

Fantastic shop and great owner.  Good selection of LOCAL and REGIONAL yarns as well as other movers and shakers.  The store is bright and inviting and well laid out.  They keep everyone up to date with great newsletter and an active facebook feed.  I felt very welcomed and comfortable in the store.

Good and fresh sushi. Slow getting the food out. Came in and ordered to go and no one was in there at the time, one table before I left. Took over half an hour to get sushi/sashimi and lunch special order

Great coffee and friendly staff. That being said on occasion you can plan to wait a bit. They seem to be busy at all times of the day. I guess it's a testament to the quality of coffee. If you're really in a rush go to the walk up window. You can usually get your coffee much faster than the long drive thru. After trying many of the different coffee shops around the treasure valley I keep coming back to Dutch bros based on quality and service.

Why does the food have to be so good?!!  I am NOT a pizza person; except, for ICP. Oh my gosh the food here is so good. And they have the best ranch around!   The lunch buffet is not only a great price but also so yummy with lots of different pizzas. The pizza is always cooked perfectly too. Every time we went to Smokey Mountain Pizza it was burnt and I didn't like the crust at all. 

I actually wear my family out on pizza because I want to go so often lol. And as a bonus Wednesday is double punch day! Anytime we have family in town we always take them here and they all love it and ask for it next time they are in town.

So far so good receive service right away atmosphere is really nice with the dark glad the bar waitresses are super sweet so far so good. Hamburger I ordered was app salute Lee the most delicious giant hamburger I've ever put into my mouth

Amazing and delicious food! You will not be disappointed!
Staff is friendly and overall great service. Menu is reasonably priced as well

SIMPLY AWFUL 
Came here at my daughter's choice. Ordered the Chicken Malano.  Served a mass of mushroom fettuccini with a congealed blob of cheese ? on top and underneath some rubber chicken w ham and a layer of greasy melted cheese. Did not look like the description of what I ordered and frankly the presentation was unappealing.  I began with a bite of chicken and was not motivated to go back for a second bite.  Ate some of the thin ham with the salty mushroom fettuccini then left 3/4 of the meal. My daughter asked for plain spaghetti with olive oil and parmesan.  They were very stingy with the parmesan and there was a weird herb taste she couldn't identify.  The bread that came with the forgettable oil dip was...also forgettable. Restaurant was blaring music, with that and the bright lights the atmosphere was unpleasant. Our waitress was okay, the bellini and the perengrino good but no plans to ever go back. I just keep thinking how many other wonderful restaurants there are in Boise I could actually get a good meal at for the 50$ I wasted at Johnny Carinos.
Great place to meet up with friends for a drink.  Great outdoor patio and spacious inside with good views of the foothills. Great service, haven't tried the food yet.

It's the staple, what can I say?  Best burger in town.  I hate that it's a chain, but it's just terrific.  Any burger you put an egg on is always going to be good, and the Royal is amazing!  

Today was the first time we actually had to wait for lunch. I guess they were low on staff.  However, when we got seated, manager came to apologize for the wait, and our server was 100% perfect in all categories!  Lilya was Ukrainian, with a slight accent, and an ideal demeanor for the job she has. Smiled the whole time, and well deserved of the tip we left.  We now have someone we will ask for from now on.  Couldn't have asked for a more pleasant experience.  Thanks!!

The food is phenomenal, the only thing that bothered me about this experience is that the server wouldn't look me in the eye when asking a question, quite the opposite she would look out the window while talking. She came across as abrasive and somewhat rude but the food is great, I received service promptly and would come back at any time!!

First time here. We just moved here from California & was looking for a good breakfast place to frequent. We tried coming here a few weeks ago but the wait was too long, 30 min. So today we tried again. Even though it was a busy Sunday morning once again, our wait time was less than 5 min. Once seated we got our drinks within a few min. They have really good coffee! The staff is very prompt & friendly. Our coffee cups were never empty! The menu has a lot of delectable dishes to choose from! I got the Garden Frittata & my husband got the build your own omelette. Both were delicious & generous portions. Their potatoes are very yummy also. We are for sure going to make Moe Joe's our go-to breakfast place from now on! Check it out, you will not be disappointed!!

Oh my. First off the "manager" is a joke; she is the heavier lady. We stood at the entrance for 5 min before she told us to sit wherever. We sat at the table for another 5 min before I had to stop someone to get menus. Once we finally got our waitress she was very kind and we have no complaints with her. We got our food and everything was good except I needed more Au Ju; the amount I got to start with was so measly. Our waitress said it would be an extra charge. I said no, I don't want it as I should not be charged for Au Ju, no matter what but especially since I had hardly to begin with. I asked for the manger and explained what happened from the start of the sitting issues and what not. Never once was I rude. She instantly said "no problem you don't need to come back." And continues to say they have enough customers and she didn't need us. We were dumbfounded. She was instantly rude when I was just trying to explain how we felt as customers. All she had to do was give me more sauce, as again it was nothing to begin with. But no she instantly got rude and nasty. She then proceeded to say another nasty comment when she brought our bill so I said fine, will just leave (as a joke) and she was like I'll just grab your license plate and call the cops. Jokes on her, we have a temp plate right now lol. We legit had to make her leave our table because she was being so rude. Well I think she complained to the kitchen manager (Brian) so he came to our table. Listened to what we had to say, apologized and took care of our bill. In no way were we looking to get out on our bill. I just wanted decent customer service and some more Au Ju sauce so I could actually dunk my sandwich. I appreciate Brain for his wonderful service. That lady manager needs to go. She was nasty and has zero care for Moe Joes. I promise none of this is exaggeration. The picture of my Au Ju is after I ate maybe 1/2 of my meal.

Wow! Great food great service. These guys were pros. We had very little wait time to be seated. I understand why they are busy now. Our waitress was the ultimate professional. She showed why she is deserving of praise. She must have checked on us 5 times during our meal to make sure everything was OK and to see if we needed anything. That just makes me want to come back. Oh yeah the food was awesome too.

I ordered the chicken pesto ravioli presentation was great taste was good but it was cold my server took it back, and she brought it back it was hot but the flavor wasn't there anymore. My daughter got the kids pizza I gotta say her meal was so much better then mine

Rig Pick Up
We went to take delivery of our new rig.  As part of their normal process, they assigned a tech to walk us through our rig from front to back, down to up.  Josh took a long time to explain everything newbies needed to know about RVing.  He was patient with our questions and provide a lot (TON) of tips and tricks.

Came in at 6:00 on Sunday night. Waited 2-3 minutes to get greeted and went downhill from there. 
Hostess sat us brought us water and bread and said someone would be with us shortly. 
6:23 rolls around and no sign of waitstaff at are table.  No one acknowledged the two us once seated. We got up and left. 
Will never go back.
Been to every Chinese restraint in Boise, this place is top of the list! Generals chicken was perfect service was great

Tart yogurt is now a standard in every major USA city right now, its nice to see it trickle down to smaller cities like Meridian, Idaho.  I am aware this is not the only yogurt place in Meridian/Boise area but I appreciate any and all places.

U-Swirl offers a punch card for every 10 you buy, get one free. Also U-Swirl recently had an ad in the Boise paper for 4 oz free, which meant my $4 yogurt was only like $2! They had over 10 flavors and only 3 were tart and many were sugar free, low-fat or non-fat and all were gluten free.

Ok, perhaps Dave's isn't the 'authentic' type BBQ you might have in mind, but really, they do have a great selection and serve up great tasting food.  I have never been dissapointed in any of the Dave's I have ever visited, and the few times I've been here, the service and food has always been good.

Like a lot of chains, I've been to Dave's in several states, and the quality has always been the same.  I have to say that's a good thing for them, as one expects a certain quality to be as good, if not better, than the last one.  I only hope that Dave's maintain's the quality that they serve now as they will 10 years from now, unlike a certain Italian chain I used to love that has someting to do with an olive.

I have to commend the manager for having his crew always being very friendly and accomodating.  My wife and I will definately make a point to come back and visit when we can.

One thing else we noticed was that, even though we were sitting in the corner of the bar area near a speaker, it was much quieter than a restaurant we vistied a few nights before.

Ate a late lunch here and it was excellent! I had the baked ziti and my Mom had the chicken sandwich and fries. All was very yummy!
But the best part if their fresh bread and garlic olive oil mix. Excellent!

Absolutely love this store! Schwabb can kiss my a$$! You won't feel slimed after leaving this store.
Revised- So I go here often. I try to bring all my work vehicles and trailers. First, there isn't a lot of love for how much I spend here. They wanted to charge me for a rebalance on a trailer today. They said I only bought 2 of the 4 tires there, so I had to pay.
Second, the Assistant Manager Rick, has serious attitude issues. Every time I see him or have to deal with him, his is rude. Fortunately there are a lot of nicer people there to somewhat make up for him. One employee told me, he's been with the company way too long. He told me MANY complaints have been filed about him. Anyway, they are building a new store out by the airport, gonna give it a try. I'm kind of over doing business with the Eagle store.
BTW, I've spent about $8000 this year with them. That's a lot of tires!!! If this doesn't work out, I'll search for another store that appreciates my business.

This place has its good and bad points. It's not the best place I've ever eaten at, but it's also not necessarily the worst either. The house salad and vinaigrette left a lot to be desired. The chicken penne Gorgonzola was also pretty good, but not enough to make me really say "wow! over. All in all a good place to eat, but could be better. Average in every way.

I met a friend for a late breakfast Sunday before noon, there was a brief wait but it's always worth it. Our server was friendly, attentive and accommodating. I'm doing a no carb/sugar eating plan and the eggs, sausage, avocado with coffee was done perfectly. My friend had a hash/scramble and pom mimosa .. we love Moe Joe's!

We live less than 2 miles away but haven't been there in a while. It seems to have been dropping in quality with every visit but we decided to try it out again. My meal was a "combo" of cheese tortellini and chicken ravioli (which is actually cheese ravioli with some chicken tossed on top). It seriously looked like a plate of dog chow when it was placed on the table. By far the worst Italian meal I've ever eaten in a restaurant. $16 for????? My husband's meal was every bit as bad. We packaged our leftovers but didn't bother to bring them home because we knew there was no way we would eat them. By the time we were done, we had spent $45 and wished we had just gone to McDonald's for a Happy Meal.

I first saw Dr. Burr over twenty years ago in my early twenties. Both my mom and her sister had melanomas and underwent surgery and treatment so I thought I should get my skin more carefully checked. I think I ended up with Dr. Burr by coincidence as a choice driven by my insurance. I'm glad I did. Dr. Burr is extremely aggressive in terms of treating and testing suspicious moles. We removed I think four moles and it turned out that two were abnormal. I'm grateful that we caught those. 

Through the years I've had regular skin checks with little concern. For a period of time, I switched insurance and had to change dermatologists. The doctor I saw had a much different practice--it was smaller and more personal and the doctor had a very patient, gentle bedside manner. He did not test or show concern during any of my skin checks. When my insurance changed again and I could go back to Ada West, Dr. Burr's practice had grown significantly. Right away, we caught and removed several abnormal moles (and some benign) that left untreated could have developed into cancer. For someone with a family history of melanoma, it was a little alarming that the itchy/growing moles that another doctor wanted to watch turned out to be problematic. 

Dr. Burr's practice is very busy. I've seen reviews that complain about this. He has a lot of practitioners (I've seen two different PAs and they were great). The waiting room is large. It's a little noisy. The front desk staff is very busy. They have always been professional and friendly. If they see a patient who has something suspicious, they remove it and I suspect that this does get them a little behind sometimes with their schedule, but I'd prefer a thorough dermatologist than one who rushes through patients to stay on schedule. Also, I have had the experience of the PA bring Dr. Burr in for a second opinion (thank you) or Dr. Burr bring in other colleagues in teaching moments when he's found something suspicious. The culture in the office is all about learning and they nearly always have medical students there training. I like this. There is a real drive to get things right and I believe that Dr. Burr has a mission in life that his patients are not going to have cancer on his watch if he can help it. To me, this is more important than having the world's most zen waiting room or warm and fuzzy receptionists., although they do seem to keep making strides to address these kinds of issues. I noticed at a visit this week that they've re-organized the space a bit and things flowed easily. 

I have found all of the practitioners to be warm and kind. Dr. Burr has his own good sense of humor and I love his high-energy style. I have a high level of trust in this practice and appreciate their skill and care.
I absolutely love this place!! And the green chili (medium) sauce, well, I could drink this stuff by the gallon!

We thoroughly enjoyed the gumbo, fried catfish dinner and the chicken and waffles. Coming from a family from New Orleans, I can't say enough about the gumbo. The flavor is a incredible with the right amount of heat. It is nothing short of amazing. The fried catfish came out piping hot, perfectly cooked and crispy. The fried chicken and waffles was wonderful with exceptionally flavorful chicken, juicy and succulent. 

If I lived closer, I'd come more often and crash their family reunions. Thanks for a memorable meal.

We absolutely love this place!!! The employees are awesome and take great care of their customers! On August 23rd we were in there having their amazing wings, dinner and a couple of beers, our server was Maegen, she was totally awesome and really took care of us! You can tell Maegen really likes her job and definitely puts the customer first and she was alot of fun as well, thank you Maegen for the great food, service and for being so fun! We would also like to give a big shout out to the General Manager Seth, you do a really great job taking care of customers, employees and making sure everything is running smooth and everyone is happy, this is why we keep coming back so thank you and keep up the great work!

It was a good vet, we loved our vet he was a great person, he treated our Savannah's really good. Always informative and was always trying to not do more then he had too, it helped a lot to keep the cost down. 
The place was very clean and comfortable. Staff was nice and everyone was very respectful of our space and of our animals space, didn't try and forcefully hold or touch them.

What a nice find last night! Great food, great wine and great music!Owners were very visible,and engaged with the patrons! One small complaint, I would have liked a 'Red wine glass' with my red wine! May seem picky, but love a big glass with my Red wine! Will definitely be returning!

I stopped here for a late lunch and ordered the Tom Yum soup and the garlic and black pepper from the lunch menu. The soup (ordered with chicken) had delicious flavor. I thought that the garlic and pepper (also ordered with chicken) didn't have as much flavor or spice (I only ordered two stars though) as I have enjoyed elsewhere, but it was still good. The portion size was adequate for lunch. The lunch also came with a small bowl of egg drop soup, which was fine. 

Their full menu is quite large and very diverse. Service was very attentive. I would definitely stop again if/when my travels bring me to the area.

SO, SO GOOD. We try to stop here every time we head to Boise. We order ahead of time and it's always ready to go. Their mandarin chicken and teriyaki beef is to die for. We've never been disappointed at this location OR the other in Boise.

The service was great, loved the free bread (loved that it was free, not necessarily the quality of the bread), and the soup was delicious but the chicken Alfredo pasta wasn't my favorite. Wasn't bad but wasn't great for the cost. I would go back but I'd probably get a different entree
Good food. Only complaint is they don't surround their bottled sodas with ice so they're always warm.

I seriously, don't even know where to begin with this review... I had been to Gino's a few times prior to this event date and it had been okay. On December 12, I took my BF to dinner to Gino's. He'd never been there. We ordered appetizers, salads, entree's, bottle of wine, etc. I wanted him to have a very nice birthday dinner. 

It took a little while for our entrees to come out. He ordered a seafood dish, I had the chicken piccata. We start eating and I immediately noticed something was "different" with my dinner. It was fairly favorless and the most strange texture. Not wanting to cause I scene, I took a few more bites and struggled to swallow them. When my BF asked how my meal was, I gave him a bite and said, "tell me what's going on with this chicken?" He didn't even get a full bite on it and had to spit it out. We figured out that my chicken was raw. It was disgusting! That is a texture that I'll never forget. 

We called over the waiter (Tyson, I believe) and told him about it and encouraged them to take a bite of it. He asked what else I would like and assured me they would take that dish off the bill. He came back with my new entree a bit later (just fettuccine alfredo). It was fine. 

The executive chef came out and apologized, I think. He spoke so quietly, I couldn't hear a thing he said. I just assume it wasn't apology. Our waiter proceeded to come back and tell us that he was taking some partial blame for the raw chicken because he ordered the wrong dish for me originally. Then, when the BF's dish came up and my dish wasn't correct, the kitchen tried to hurry my correct dish along. FAIL!

I was so nauseated that I really didn't touch my fettuccine and our evening was ruined. Thanks Gino's! I doubt we'll be back.

Michelle, I wholeheartedly agree with you!!! It wasn't a cheap dinner and to have that experience.... YUK! The chef's half-hearted apology, which we could not hear, was almost comical. We could tell he wasn't happy about having to come out and say it.

Also, we told friends about our experience and they had the same issues - food either being too done or not done enough. They stopped going for the same reason.
Way understaffed and they need a more friendly host to seat people. Always liked their food but more staff training would be good!

A friend and I decided to try Johnny's on Saturday May 13, 3017. I had the angel hair pasta with pesto and sliced chicken, she had angel hair pasta with alfredo sauce and Italian sausage. My pasta was great, my only complaints would be it could have used more basil, less oil and a bit more chicken would have been nice. My friend's dinner was inedible, even after requesting additional alfredo sauce. The sausage was to dry for her to eat and the pasta looked like it had been sitting under heat lamps for quite a while. It had the dry discolored look to it and after trying to mix it up there wasn't enough sauce to coat the pasta. She didn't eat any of her pasta dish. 
      The service was great! The staff all looked and spoke appropriately. They were attentive with out being invasive. The atmosphere was great and the prices were reasonable. Had the food actually been palatable Johnny's would have been a viable alternative to Olive Garden.

Where to start....   This place is exceptional, and I couldn't think of anything not to like here.  You walk in, and the atmosphere says "Family Style, Home Cooked".  The waitress was super friendly and the service was great (we heard later she is the daughter of the owners, thus reinforcing the truth that this is a family place).  Ray Charles, Steve Wonder, and Ben E King are playing softly in the background, and sweet smells drift in from the Kitchen.  We haven't even eaten anything yet, and I love this place.

We started off with cornbread cooked in a little cast iron skillet.  I have to confess, that I am a cornbread junkie, and fancy myself as quite the aficionado when it comes to this line of baked goods.  This may very well be the best cornbread I have ever had.  I've had other southern style cornbread that is dry and lacking in taste, and I know that some people love it this way.  The cornbread at Shanaz however is sweet and buttery.  It is soft and delicious, and I can't wait to go back just for the cornbread.  Yum, yum, yum!

I ordered the Jambalaya Stuffed Pepper, and my wife got the Fried Chicken & Waffle.  We traded bites back and forth, and we both agreed that both dishes were delicious.  The Fried chicken was cooked perfectly, and the Jambalaya was, well, amazing.  The spices tingle on your tongue as you eat, and the sausage was soooo flavorful.  I love it all.

I can't wait to go back to try some catfish and gumbo, but beware; we were told that the seafood gumbo is only available on Friday and Saturday (as I recall).

So what more can I say.  This hidden gem in Meridian served us up a perfect dinner, and we enjoyed every bite.  We will be back.



[  One shouldn't use big words when a singular unloquacious and diminutive linguistic expression will satisfactorily accomplish the contemporary necessity.  ]

Everyone loves Gino's my daughter said so we went back for the third time...we had not been to Gino's for 3 years.  Really nothing has changed.....the design, the decoration and the service were all very good.  I really enjoyed the bread and olive oil.  The green mixed green salad was nice too....so what is the downside?  The entrees and our complaint from previous visits.
