My daughter had the seafood special, 4 large scallops.  She said they were okay but like every time they cannot seam to serve hot food and at $29 I expect more.  I had a seafood stew that had little taste and it too was luke warm.  The cost of that was $24 which I can live with but given the tasted and "cold" presentation, we will pass on Gino's.
On our previous visits, my wife was not impressed with her entree if I could remember what it was and my Spaghetti Bolenese was chewy pieces of meat and tasteless sauce.
Others may enjoy Gino's but the entrees lack flavor and always luke warm.  That combination makes Gino's a no go for me.  If he could only learn his sauces and present hot food!
So after reading the reviews most of Gino's is good except the food....good salad, bread and wine do not make my dinner a good dinner.
Food sucks.  I do travel for a living and eat at many, many fine restaurants, too bad Luciano's is the only decent Italian.

We went tonight for a dessert following dinner. My family loves this place!! The flavors are potent and delicious! My boys love to go and pile their cup as high as they can. Since they charge by cup size rather than weight... they have the best deal around. The price include frozen yogurt and toppings.

The pizza is decent.
Having had the original in NY, there is no difference. It's the same pizza.

Probably the best chain pizza you can get. It is not artisan, certainly not, but it is definitely a step above the usual mass market pizza chains.

ABSOLUTE BEST OF THE TREASURE VALLEY! Seriously though, Moe Joe's is the best breakfast/ lunch place I've ever eaten at. Everything my wife and I have eaten has been amazing. You can not go wrong with any of your choices here. 

Do yourself a favor and come a little early as it's usually busy but never to crazy of a wait. The staff are some of the best in the business and it has this great local feeling to it. 

Our server, Tasha is the BEST!! Happy mother's day Tasha!

It has many options, mostly delicious comfort foods that will truly fill your belly (plus some) like chicken fried steak, french toast and burgers.

It's also has slightly healthier options if that's what your into.

Don't be worried because everyone in your family can find something they will like from young to old. 

Hungry yet?!?! The farmers hash and french toast are unreal!!

My first time trying to come here didn't work out because there was no parking. Even the dirt lot behind the business was full. 

So glad I tried it on the off business hours. I feel like the curb takes up a bunch of the parking lot. 

My friend and I shared the dinner for 2 and went home with enough for another meal each. It was so so delicious and I can't wait to return! Service was friendly.

Actually a 2.5. Wings are marginal. Hit and miss. I ordered fish and chips and they were good. Crispy batter, juicy fish, hot, tasty. 
Service was good at first then nothing. She checked in about 3 times in :45. The hostess was great. 
Only sports on the 20+? screens which really solidifies it as a sports bar. 
We've gone to two now and probably won't waste our time returning. 
Cleanliness: fair. Could be cleaner. Food still on the table when we arrived. Crumbs and gunk. Windows were dirty. Floor looks grungy and not recently swept.
Kids ordered chicken strips; dry and not crispy. Spongy.

Aye, I'm walkin' here! Walkin' over to Grimaldi's to get some za, that is!

Grimaldi's is a high-end chain based out of Brooklyn. They do coal brick-oven pizza with olive oil and such, very similar to that classic, Italian style.

Place looks fancy-shmancy. Waiter was super nice. Even made sure we didn't pay extra for a pizza that was nearly the same as a cheaper version. Pizza was $20 but was pretty small. We got a half margherita / half Brooklyn Bridge which is a sausage and red peppers. Took roughly 15 mins.

-Margherita-
This is good pizza. That brick oven style gives the pizza a nice crunch and that nice charcoal taste. A lot like Allegreza's and not excessively sooty like Flatbread Neapolitan. Lot's of sauce, much more than other places. PizzaTom and I like that. Cheese is very light. Not much of it and it looks more white than yellow. Not sure if it's just regular mozzarella or something else; tastes good but not the focus.

-Brooklyn Bridge-
Still really tasty but the extra ingredients don't add much. Would have just preferred more of the margherita pizza.

-The Verdict-
Classy place. Excellent ingredients and well composed pizza. Brooklyn Bridge is nothing special so try a diff special or just stick to basics. Great place to take out that special someone you swiped right on accidentally, but eh whatever worth a shot.

4 slices out of 5

I purchased a new full size spare tire in June 2017. In July, I had to use the tire, and noticed my car wobbled at certain speeds.

In July, I purchased a new tire to replace the blow-out, and I asked them to check the full size spare due to the wobble. They found a defect in the spare, and replaced it per their warranty at no charge.

For both visits, I did not make an appointment. They were courteous and the service was quick.

I used to be a customer of Les Schwab Tires, but got a better price from Discount Tire.
Second visit for Larry.  Everything went great.  Dr. Winchester and all involved with our visit were great.  Thanks to all at Ada West Dermatology.

AWESOME PASTA! AMAZING! Excellent customer service! Had the BEST Ravioli! If you want excellent pasta with a seafood flair this place is to die for! Great bread too!!! First time here and if I am ever in this neck of the woods again I will DEFINITELY be back!!!!!!

I really appreciate how quickly you can get in and out of this place. Coming from a different state and use to long lines and unfriendly employees I have always experienced friendly employees and great service here. Even though it looked busy I was in and out of here in 10-15 minutes.
I ordered yellow curry chicken with fried rice tonight, very tasty Chinese food in Meridian Idaho so far.

I was in to town for a class and found this place using my iPhone map. What a treasure! I have had sushi all over the place and this is the best I have had in Idaho by far. The sushi chef is happy to make something special and does not disappoint. The salmon miso is bright and fresh. The best miso I have ever had including super fancy SF and LA places. Super friendly service. I highly recommend.

I met a friend here for breakfast and I was not disappointed!  Apparently their menu is new from what's on their website.  I ordered the chicken hash.  It was chicken, eggs, artichoke hearts, zucchini, cheese, and some kind of tarragon aioli over Moe Joe's potatoes.  It was so delicious!  I had enough left over for another meal which heated up really nicely as well.  They also offer fresh marionberry or strawberry jam to go with your toast....yum!  I can't wait to come back and try something else!
I have worked with Chapman Properties for several years now. I have been very pleased with their professionalism. I would recommend and do business with Chapman properties anytime.
Best breakfast in Boise! We come here at least twice a month, Everything is delicious and such fair prices! I highly recommend any one of there hashes!

This place is quite lacking other than their beer selection. Wings were nasty... we ordered them extra crispy and they still came out in maybe four minutes. Obviously microwaved and very rubbery, they even tasted funny. We left them. We also got the garlic fries with the aioli on the side which had completely separated/broke, but the fries were alright. The server was attentive and efficient but it was obvious she didn't want to be there. Nice looking place on the inside and big TVs but not worth trying the food. There's better places to check out. I might come back for the beer or to watch football if someone else suggested so but I certainly won't be in a hurry.
Great brunch spot in meridian.  The food stands out from most traditional breakfast spots in the area.  Great deals on mimosas, friendly staff and always a great experience.

Always a joy to stop at SRY. I've bought a motorcycle from them in the past and been in and out dozens of times - enough to know that these guys do care about their customers. They always treat me like a friend, their inventory is always worth checking out and I've never had a single complaint with their service or "attitude" or anything like that.

Great place for breakfast. Some non traditional items on the menu. Leave you wanting more after yo have been here. I had the fiesta hash which was really good. The menu had a wide variety of things. They open kind of late for a breakfast joint. Other than that great place to eat

Woman at the front desk (brown hair) is extremely unfriendly and was acting like she was pissed off that she was working.... who wants to interact with that. Didn't give any type of quote time or information on how long the wait would be. An hour into sitting in the waiting room I've seen 5 different cars get worked on before my simple flat tire. 15 minute fix and situation at every other Les Schwab.... unfortunate that this branch isn't providing the same quality as other locations. 
This is the only time I've been here so they may be better with different staff but don't come on Monday afternoons.... big yikes
Eh so so. Was a fun place to hang out w friends. Food was ok. Service was ok. Shuffle board table was really nice though. Nothing about it makes you hate it our love it.

Great car was makes the rigs look very clean and the included vacuum are nice too great suction to get all the funk outta your rig. Only reason for 4 stars and not 5 is when signing up for their "vet protect plan" ($30 wash for $20) great deal  they charge you $30 to start you off then "refund" $10. Then supposedly the system will only charge $20 monthly after that (haven't had a monthly charge yet to know if it works like this or not). Wife's been going here for just over three weeks and still no refund to our card. We've talked to three people so far the latest being today to solve the issue. We'll see if it happens this next week.

The best Vet I have ever been too. Dr Mark and his staff go above and beyond and truly care about the well being of your pets. I trust what they say and have had nothing but positive experiences with them. I absolutely recommend them!

Great bowling experience and food. The staff and team are very helpful. They have made some improvements recently and it shows. Good electronic scoring systems too. Nice to see some lanes that are still well maintained and a staff that cares. 

One of our families favorite activities!

Sooo goood the veil,chicken or egg plant  Parmesan is mouth watering. There lamb,veil or boar shanks are also so worth it I've had many deferent entrees there never had a bad meal. Service is always good.

We were in town visiting my daughter for family weekend and she was craving sushi.  We found Fujiyama on yelp and It was not a disappointment. For what it's worth, we live in the San Francisco Bay Area and the food here was on par with many of the restaurants in our area.  I highly recommend this restaurant.

I came here on their grand opening day! This is their 1st Black Rock's Idaho coffee shop.  They offer a free 16 oz drink all day! They have something going on for the whole week for their grand opening special; like a free drink today, 2 for 1 tomorrow, random give away on Sun and such. The line sure was long but it moved quick. I got their Jackhammer, which is coffee w/ Irish cream, vanilla breve w/6 shots! I loved it! The coffee is not bitter and it's not too sweet! This is my new "to go" to for a coffee! I'll be back!

I heard great things about Shanaz, so I couldn't wait to check it out. We ordered the Nu flavor roll & korean tacos to start. The roll was very tasty, but would have been better with soy sauce to mix with the wasabi, but overall still delicious, & it was huge! (large enough to share between several people) The korean tacos were the best part of the meal... There was a perfect balance of sweet, spicy, & citrus. Wonderful! We ordered the black tea pork & shrimp over the potato pancake. The pork was way too sweet for our liking. I think it needed some spiciness our citrus to balance the sweetness. I wouldn't order it again. The shrimp was great,  & had awesome flavor, but overall a very heavy dish. The potato pancake had great flavor, but was very greasy. I asked for cornbread, because we weren't brought any. It was wonderful, crispy on the outside & moist on the inside. I will definitely return to try other menu items!

Recently moved to Meridian and decided to try out Gino's Italian Ristorante.  Wish we had found it sooner!  Loved the atmosphere, soft music, and ooh la la... the smell of fresh Italian cooking!  The bread and dipping sauce is to die for, cesar salad divine, and food excellent. Our server Sandra provided outstanding service.  A new local fav for us!

Awesome care for my beloved Golden retriever who needs regular meds for siezures. They have trained the staff how to deal with dogs having siezures. They call me with any issues. Most importantly, my dog loves it!

We were in town visiting for a concert. I'm not sure if we picked the worst day ever to eat here, or if it's always this slow, but the wait for food was ridiculously long. We lost track of time, but it was at least 30 mins, and that's being generous. Our sever did great keeping our drinks filled while we waited...forever. Once our food came, it was good. Husband's gravy had a skin on it, like it had been sitting under a heat lamp for a bit. My scrambled eggs on my garden skillet were dry on top as well. But once we got it all mixed together, the flavor was amazing, and all cooked well. Our daughter had blueberry pancakes that were so good! The portions are HUGE. Easily could've split a meal with someone and had plenty to eat. But who doesn't love leftovers
Colleen George is my stylist and she is wonderful and knows her stuff!  I would not ever consider anyone else to take care of my hair styling needs!  Colleen is the BEST!
Loved It! Great food. We had orange chicken. Honey & almond chicken and pepper pork. It was all excellent.  Good service too!

This place was great. My wife adopted a 3 month old kitten and instantly fell in love with her. The kitten was spayed at the Caldwell, ID animal shelter and developed a hernia, along with a respiratory infection and wasn't feeling well. At the time, all we knew was that kitten had a large lump where her incision was and could have been a bad infection (especially considering the respiratory infection) .  Being that the kitten was adopted/spayed at the shelter, they were to cover the cost of any visits/complications for two weeks with the shelter vet. My wife called and scheduled an appt. with the vet at the shelter and when she arrived, she was told that the vet had left for the day and that nobody would have told her to come in at that time. The shelter made it sound extremely urgent over the phone and to get the kitten in immediately. They had no care or tact when discussing this with my wife! 

After a quick google search, my wife stopped in at All Valley animal hospital and was met with an unsupportive and rude staff. She sat there for over an hour without being acknowledged. We understand being busy, but at least acknowledge a customer. 

After sitting for over an hour, she made the best decision to go over to RIVER CITY! When she walked through the door, she was greeted with kindness and support. Being that customers are probably in a vulnerable state with a sick animal late in the evening, kindness and understanding really goes a long way. 

The vet and staff at River City were extremely kind and honest. The vet explained what was going on (hernia and respiratory infection) and gave great advice on what to do. River City could have easily convinced us to shell out hundreds of dollars,  but instead were honest and provided what was needed. 

The vet told us that the hernia would require surgery, but to save money it would be a good idea to schedule an appt. at the shelter as they will cover the cost and it is not a complex operation. She provided my wife with antibiotics and a schedule for the respiratory infection and explained what to watch out for. 

River City told us they could do the surgery for around $300, if we needed to use them for it. They are fair, kind, understanding and very reasonable on their pricing. 

I would recommend them a million times over!

Thank you for being so great River City!

We tried out Moe Joe's Breakfast Eatery today and were extremely satisfied.   They make their own jams and syrups.  The food wasn't the same diner food you find everywhere (but it was available), it was creative combinations with a kick.   The service was a excellent , and it was Saturday during the rush.   I highly recommend this place if you are a breakfast lover like myself.

For Verizon fans from elsewhere the service may have been great.  Here in Boise, however, it sucks. Northwest of Eagle Road the reception is spotty at best.  Almost all of Hill Road is a dead zone.  Linder and Floating Feather, down to Eagle road is almost hopeless.There are other spots, but those mentioned above are the areas where I travel most and where I need the service.  The help in the store is great, but the service is horrible.

Humph!.... so, before I input our impression, may I say, we LOVE Grimaldi's.  We have been to Brooklyn, and several others and have always loved what we had. . . and tonight... here in meridian Idaho, my bruschetta's were served on toast tips, rather than grilled with olive oil and then topped with fresh ingredients - bread warm, topping cool,ours on cold toast tips were cold and without body.   Our pizza, was suppose to have hand pinched sausage, dabs of ricotta... our question was -where's the sausage? Where's the ricotta ... where's the stuffings?  And to top off our experience...my pizza was served with the question of 'would you like garlic powder or oregano '?    I'm pretty sure our eyes popped out of our sockets.  Lol.... what?  We asked.   This is Italian good, which comes already seasoned and is an insult to the chef to add anything but cheese to your food.   This is not the Grimaldi's pizza I have come to know and love.   There was No semolina on the pizza's crust bottom, and the pizza tasted ordinary and to be truthful,  flat and flavorless.    Sooooo disappointed!     Dessert we had Cannoli--- a simple, traditional Italian dessert.   Our Cannoli filling tasted like sweet, Sweet frosting rather than subtly sweetened ricotta.    On a good note, salad was fabulous and generous, customer service fabulous.    I won't write them off this trip, after all this could have been tonight's working crew... but I also won't be arranging my whole trip around a visit to Grimaldi's in meridian. ... a very 3 star pizza tonight!

I have heard a lot about Gino's from several people so we went to try it out. We made a reservation which is a must on the weekends and they got us right in. Our waiter was super friendly and quick. The owner made sure we were comfortable and happy too. 

My boyfriend ordered a seafood lasagna which he loved and I had chicken fettuccine alfredo. Mine was creamy and pretty good but a bit bland. The bread and dipping oil they gave us before our meal was delicious and our house salads were good too. 

I would definitely come back and try something else. It's definitely one of the better Italian restaurants around here.
Wife and 5 kids all had a great time. Friendly staff. General Tso chicken was really good. We ordered it mild for the kids and they really liked it. We've gone back and plan to continue.

Red Robin used to be a decent place to take kids for a meal. The last three visits however, things have really gone downhill. Service is almost non-existent. No one even comes by to refill water. Hamburgers can no longer be ordered to taste---"probably no pink" seems to be the answer and at that, even requested with a little pink got it medium well. Hurst not what it used to be.
Horrible customer service and condescending sale staff. This is by far the worst Toys "R" Us I've ever been in in my life and will never shop here again!

Excellent place for breakfast! The ham, potato and gravy skillet was big and better than expected. I'm not sure how the potatoes were prepared, but they were the best potatoes I've ever eaten. Its not too big a place and it was crowded for breakfast. Definitely worth the price and wait. We plan on going back often!

Edit: came here again the next weekend to give them a second shot, waited 15 minutes and was ignored while a couple got seated before me because they were friends with the host. Disappointed and definitely won't be back.

What is there to say about Gino's except you'll never be content with any chain Italian restaurant after you eat at Gino's. The food is simply unbelievably good and the service is good.  Asiagos was my favorite but has since been replaced.
Very impressive gluten free menu. Nice little place. Unassuming from the outside. Wonderful and friendly staff. We expect to come here many times again. Oh, and the food was very good.

For my first experience, it was not the best. Service by Lauren was great but most of the dishes were still dirty, the Italian margarita was uncomfortably sour and their signature calamari tasted as if it was just pulled from the microwave. The bread and oil was probably the best part of the whole situation, very soft and delicious. I ordered the spicy shrimp and chicken with a side of the jalapeño green pepper alfredo sauce. Honestly looked like a microwavable dinner but the side of sauce was unique and actually good. I am not in a rush to get back to this establishment, maybe if I get another groupon deal.

After trying numerous sushi restaurants around the Treasure Valley we found the only sushi place for us. True Japanese style sushi without drowning in sauces. Super fresh fish, generous portions, and beautiful presentation. Staff was super friendly and the restaurant and atmosphere were perfect. Everything was immaculate and tastefully decorated. If you're looking for excellent sushi in the Boise area look no further. I would give a 6 star rating if I could!
Absolutely the best breakfast spot in town.  Everything I have tried is fantastic.  On occasion I've ordered two menu items because I couldn't decide.   The hash that has the prime rib is incredible.
Awesome food and fast service .  Homemade and creative food choices

The service was good when the waiter came by but the ticket times are off the charts.....I have been sitting waiting for pizza for literally 45min (after the salad). My salad took over 20. Only 1 other table in here, no excuse for this lack of consideration for the customer.

Time is money and they won't be getting either of mine again.

So this place has really good breakfast and our server was great. We went early Saturday morning and the place was full with a few people waiting when we left. The food fresh and flavorful. Only regret is we don't live near this place so to go boxes weren't an option

Food is great and worth coming back. However, don't expect much in regards to service. Sometimes they are quick seat you at a table and then forget you. I left my table after sitting awhile with staff walking past me.
The Idaho Twists were delicious!! Also ordered the Idaho Supreme and it was pretty good!

I have been very impressed with Cope Collision Center!
They are friendly, fast, and do an excellent job.
I have had to take my vehicle there two different times and have been very satisfied.

Great little breakfast place!
Food was excellent, fresh and served nice and hot!
Our service from Haze was friendly and prompt! We will be back for sure!

We arrived at 6:45 on a Friday night.  They were fairly busy, but not all tables were filled.  After being seated, our order was taken fairly quickly and we received our soups and complimentary chips right away.  Then we waited for 55 MINUTES for two entree items.  As we were sitting near the kitchen, I figured out what the problem was:  Not enough help in the kitchen, and a huge focus on filling phone in orders instead of the patrons in the restaurant.  I watch more than 10 take out orders go out the door before our food was served.  The last restaurant that operated this way is now closed for business, so the owner needs to pay attention to this issue.  If you can serve the patrons who have bothered to come out in the cold and snow to have dinner in your establishment, then either be take-out only or resolve your kitchen issue.  I give a 4 star for food taste and quality, and a 1 or 2 stars for service.

I had a last minute change in plans and the staff was EXTREMELY understanding and managed to let my fur-child come to boarding two nights early. I would definitely recommend Camp Bow Wow to anyone looking for a good place for their fur-children to stay while they're out of town.  Being able to check in on my dog via the cameras helps ease my borderline crazy anxiety about leaving my fur-child without me while on the other side of the country.  The staff genuinely cares for the dogs and it shows in how my neurotic 95 pound dog that thinks he's a lap dog reacts to their building.  :)

First time here and we will not be back. We got an order of 1/2 nachos and the sliders. The only thing that was good was the sliders. The fries were cold and stale. The chips on the nachos were stale and we had hardly any toppings and they were cold. The picture is the after of our nachos and each chip we had was never full of toppings. Our waitress never asked how our food was and we never saw her after we got our food until she brought the bill (dropped and ran). We ran out of drinks at the end and she walked by our table many times. Extremely disappointing. Also not a fan of the atmosphere or the seat yourself. Really bummed we waisted our money here.

What a shame. This is the second chain I have gone to. One in CA. And here ID and both do not honor senior citizens and the one in ID does not have sprouts. I guess I won't be going to these chain any More.

Been there several times since they opened and I always enjoy the pizza and Mediterranean salad.  Service is usually very good as well.  Also enjoy the patio area overlooking the awesome fountain at the village.  I would say it is the best pizza in town and a real solid chain restaurant.  Some may consider it a bit expensive, but the high rent and quality ingredients makes it a costly place to operate.  Worth every penny.

I'd heard good things about Red Pavilion having fairly authentic Chinese food. I take all suggestions like that with a grain of salt.  Or perhaps I should say MSG. I don't mind good Chinese-American food and that's what I got here. 

The decor is modern and comfortable; don't expect the same tired "Chinese" decorations you see at other restaurants serving Chinese food. I appreciated the lovely art on the walls!

I went with the lunch combo. You get to choose a soup, a rice and one entree from a list for $7.95. All in all, it was a decent amount of food for the price. My hot and sour had a good taste but was too gelatinous. So much so it made eating it a bit unappealing. I went with the chow rice which was a fairly typical fried rice. My entree was Kung Pao Chicken. Might be one of the freshest tasting examples of the dish I've had in Boise. Could have definitely used more peppers though. 

If I'm on the far West end of Boise again, I'll give it another go! Was pretty busy there on a Sunday at lunchtime so they clearly already have regulars!

I went here with a large group of work associates for lunch last week, and it was good.  I got the Bulgogi, and the beef tasted really good.  I think because we were with a big group, we got served a bit differently.  We got lots of kimchi, pickles, and other side dishes that were just delivered to the tables and we all sampled lots of different things. I can't say that I like kimchi very much, but the beef was really good.  The service was really great, as the staff was very friendly and helpful.  So all in all, it was not bad.  I may go back sometime to try some to the other entries.

[  What's the best part about living in Switzerland? 
...Not sure, but the flag is a big plus.  ]

Servers are rude and took forever to get somebody over to our table, as a matter of fact we had to flag down another server to take another order. Gave us attitude for doing so. Burgers aren't that special anyways

This little place is fantastic!! My son got shrimp blanco, and I got the iron quarter sizzler, and they were phenomenal!!! They have a nice and varied menu. Something for everyone. And you can't bet the price for all the food they bring it the table. I recommend the fried rice and the sweet and sour sauce. The service is prompt and delivered with a smile and a cheery attitude. Wonderful can't even begin to describe this great, quaint eatery!
Great service every time super nice staff and the burgers are amazing!!! I got this burger with three cheeses in it amazing!!!!! Delicious onion rings as well and nice cold beer! Def coming again!!!

I took my grandson Luke, who is six, to Dart Warz yesterday.  When we arrived a party was just leaving and when Luke and I got to the floor we discovered that there were just the two of us against one of the "Dart Zone Warriors".  I was disappointed and thought that this was NOT going to be much fun.

How wrong I was!  In the first few seconds of the first game I saw the Dart Zone Warrior, Morgan, lift what looked like a tommy gun and send 5 darts a second flying at me.  I ducked behind one of the cardboard castles and heard them thunking into the wall behind me and also into the castle I was hiding behind.  It reminded me of tracer rounds coming at me in Vietnam.  (Yes, I am a certifiable geezer, much more than six years older than 50...)

"Oh peachy," I thought, "we are going to be massacred by a guy with super guns, how freaking exciting."

How wrong I was, again!  Morgan put down the super gun and picked up a single shot pistol, still an upgrade from what Luke and I were using as it shot fast and flat, compared to our arching slow bullets.  Next time we go, I will upgrade to the flat shooting gun for Luke, and seriously, did you think I would not get one for me?  

Morgan then put on a half hour display of great fun and camaraderie as he both won and lost games.  Always he fist bumped my grandson and I and complimented us on how well we played the game.  Once, after I had been knocked out of the game, I watched him sneak up behind my grandson who was sneaking up on him.  Literally within a foot of him.  He snuck as Luke snuck and when Luke finally saw him and darted away he missed Luke who then turned and shot him to end that game.  I did not ask, and I am sure he would have denied it, but I know Morgan missed on purpose, right?

After a half hour, more kids showed up to play and Morgan stayed on the field to help his team and the kids on Luke's team were often cycled to Morgan's team, but always Luke and I were left to be his opponents.  Morgan seemed to know without being asked to leave it that way.

You can see from the picture below that Luke, who is normally a little quiet, was ecstatic and beaming after our hour was up.

I have been to Dart Warz several times with all three of my Boise grandchildren and my son, twice for one of my grandson's birthday parties, which were always a LOT of fun.  This time, thanks to Morgan's fine understanding of play, it was the most fun I have ever had there.

Thank you!
The people were very nice. it was a bit crowded and busy but a good stop over while passing thru.

Great little breakfast place. Our waitress, Mary, was awesome-cheerful and helpful to us (since we'd never been there before) in explains the menu.
A nice walk, under 10 minutes, from our hotel. Early bird menu- great value with a generous helping.

We'll definitely go back when in town.

Emanuel was fantastic at the Verizon store off of meridian road. He was super kind and patient and saved my bf and I a TON of money. We were able to get the xr iPhones with no down payment. We also got a $400 trade in with my bf's old phone and $130 in trade in that we were able to apply towards our new phones. Emanuel is an excellent example of how to treat customers as well as up sell without forcing us into anything. He built our trust up and we are so glad he was there to help us!!! Thank you Emanuel!!!

Not a fan. The pizza is decent but they nickel and dime you for every topping. Their wine collection is garbage and in typical restaurant fashion way over priced. I hope I remember to never come back. Good pizza in Meridian can be found elsewhere.

Costa Vida never disappoints! It doesn't matter which location I frequent, the food is well worth it!! Go hungry and leave full!! The salads have a generous amount atop a warm freshly made flour tortilla. The tomatillo ranch dressing is a must try! Don't just take my word for it, stop by and see the crowded dining area, others agree!!

So there is but one thing holding back a 5 rating for Costa Vida and that is lack of beer and margarita's.  Add that, and it is the best place I've eaten in a long time!  The sweet pork burrito has this juicy goodness that is still with me.  It is a sweet pepper sauce that I can't place other than it pleases the pallet on the front and back end.  WOW is the understatement.  The beef taco was fantastic too.  It is odd to have loved the food so much and have so little to say.  Go for lunch, go for dinner but by all means GO!  It is just a bunch of fun to go to and you won't miss the beer or the margarita!

I am visiting from Alaska. Sitting in my hotel room I was trying to decide where to order from. We have Red Robin in Alaska but the food isn't great. However, I decided to give this one a try. And OMG! Everything was absolutely perfect. I had quite a few specific requests for my food and it came out exactly how I like it! I am so happy I decided to try it here. Thank you, Red Robin!!! I'm going to post this review any website I can find. :) 

*I ate everything before I could get a picture.. YUM!

This is by far the best pizza I have had in Boise for us... thin crust.. burnt.. great sauce.
You have had th rest now.. get th best"
Great local place to grab an early morning breakfast or brunch with the family!  Speedy service greating you with a smile and excellent food menu!

We stumbled upon this gem yesterday evening and I'm so glad we did. Service was great and the appetizers (artisan bread and pesto/mozzarella/basil flatbread) were delicious. The real star is the wine, of course. We tried a flight of three reds and I can't wait to go back and buy a bottle or two!

In terms of Chinese food this has been my best experience in Boise. The Honey Almond shrimp/chicken is a favorite of ours. Also, the Mongolian Beef is absolutely phenomenal. If you eat in they bring some yummy fried deliciousness to start the meal. The ambulance is nice, tables can be a little tight if you order several items as they come on big plates. Portions are okay for the price. They have take out too which is nice. Always friendly service!

Been here a couple of times and confident to give it 5 STARS.  More of a up scale Chinese place to eat. Dish are somewhat traditional but with a upscale flare. Service Great, food hot and fresh. Notice that everything was clean.

I'm not from Idaho but I am so happy I stopped and ate at this place! I usually use yelp to find yummy places to stop and eat at along the trips I take and they're usually alright places. But I can say this one is definitely a 5 star breakfast restaurant. We ordered 6 different meals and every single one was DELICIOUS! Make sure you come hungry because the servings are bigger.

We have just become fans of The Village in Meridian. Naturally, I am now inclined to sample all or most of the food available there. Grimaldi's was our third food venture here. 

Our first mistake was expecting to get in here (or anywhere for that matter) on a Friday night. Our wait was around an hour. No big deal as we poached some chairs by the fountain while listening to the live band playing. The whole area was packed. 

A phone call to my cell phone informed me our table was ready. We were hoping to sit on the patio, but were seated inside. It was so loud inside that I couldn't hear a single word our hostess said.  We had to speak loudly at our table to carry on a conversation. 

Our waiter took our drink order and explained the menu. Wood fired pizza, salad and wine make up the menu, though they have the standard soda/iced tea offerings. All pizzas have a base price and you pay between $2 to $6 for each topping you want. A large with red sauce was $16. With 3 basic toppings it ended up being $22. Pretty pricey for a pie IMO. However, the thin wood fired crust reminded of the old Flame Neapolitan Pizzeria we had in Eagle. Thin and chewy with some char on the edges. Very delicious.  There were a couple different salad selections to choose from that come in small (serves 2) and large. They also had an antipasto plate. Large list of wine on the back of the menu, which can be seen on their website. 

Our server, while nice, left my iced tea glass empty for a long time. We had to ask for refills. However, he was quick to keep coming back to try and take our plates away. He asked me if I was finished while I had half of a slice if pizza in my hand. It made us feel rushed like they were trying to get us out of there to turn our table over. Confusing as there were several empty tables in the restaurant by this time. Either way, it made me mad, so we stayed and chatted (with raised voices) for a while. We were never offered refills again. 

I'd have given two stars if the pizza wasn't as good as it was. I was told the Caesar salad I paid for was really good (I didn't get to try any as it was taken away before I could sample it). If I do go back, it will be on a weekday. While $22 seems pricey for a pie, I'm willing to pay for good pizza, and this stuff is pretty good. Our bill was $39 before tip. Not too bad to fill up four people and have a slice to take home.  Just wish our service experience was a little better.

What is it that makes a restaurant worthy of five star review.  My wife and I were discussing this as we visited Gino's tonight for our Valentine's Day dinner.  Consider this...  We have been going to Gino's regularly for at least the last 15 years, if not longer.  We loved them when they were in downtown Boise, and we have been going back regularly since they moved to Meridian.  I have sampled many items on the menu, while my wife often sticks with her favorite dish (the Beef or Lamb Shank with the gnocchi).  While some dishes are better than others (in my opinion) and sometimes things are better one evening compared to another, we have never left disappointed.  More often than not, we leave there talking about how good the meal was.  The Atmosphere is nice, the service is always great, and Gino typically checks in to make sure that things are good.  When we want to go out for a nice meal, Gino's has been our go-to place for some time.

Tonight, we started with the calamari (amazing!), then I had the Flat Iron Steak special (very good), and my wife had a seafood dish (sorry, can't remember what it was called) which was excellent.

So, when a restaurant has proven itself consistently over the years, and continues to deliver great food and service, that's when it gets five stars from me!

I highly recommend making reservations, especially on holidays or special occasions, since the place always seems busy when we are there.

it was super easy to eat a low-carb meal. just didn't get the sauce or the rice. Subbed in beans and veggies. It was really tasty. And their bathrooms are so clean that I would review it just for that. Also their staff is super friendly and accommodating
service was bad and the waitresses kept playing with there hair waiting for the food to get done it totally disgusted me wouldn't eat there again

A large family group of us has gone twice now and both experiences were the same - mediocre food, TERRIBLE wait, barely adequate service.  Husband's salmon was way overcooked.  The wait time on both visits was horrendous.  They said 10 minutes and each time we waited closer to 45 minutes.  Won't likely be back.

Was in need of some assistance with some of our Verizon products. Associates were very rude and disrespectful, Rob (solutions specialist) especially. When asked a question, some of the associates laughed. Not pleased with this location and will not be returning.

Outstanding food and service! We Had the half order of the tradition Benedict, a single pancake and country fried steak with mojos. Delicious!! 

Only thing that was ok-ish was the hot chocolate, tasted like generic mix. Food was amazing!

I jdiscovered a nail in my tire the afternoon before a big ride where I was going to a rally where I would some old riding buddies I hadn't seen in over a decade. They didn't have the tire I needed but mounted the tire a found at the shop next door. 
  I had never been in before and they were very busy. The Yamaha factory demo semi was there giving demo rides and the shop was very busy. I came after 3:00 pm and they were able to get my tire mounted. 
  The shop next door? I have spent well over $1000 dollars on gear and tires in the last year but they couldn't manage to take care of me.
Best pizza in Idaho, however it is very high priced. The lunch buffet is fantastic and a better bang for your buck.

this place is pretty solid. we had yellowtail, tuna, california roll, as well as gyoza and boise spring roll appetizers. but the best of all was the eel and cucumber hand roll--very good. my husband spent many years in asia, and has higher standards for sushi than i do, and even HE said he'd be happy to come back. he also liked that the tv was small, and only on one wall, and the music was innocuous. i have to admit, i'd rather not be listening to crap pop music, myself, and i was thankful that fujiyama didn't inflict it on us.

Still awesome !!! Went last night with friends. Had the special of the evening, a prosciutto and arugula pizza. Outstanding !!!! They had a few wine selections by the bottle that were 1/2 price also. We found a nice Melbac for $16.00. Also had the spinach salad which is a meal in itself. Can't say enough good things about Grimaldi's.
The best vet ever helped us through a difficult time. Dr Wick was the best he will be missed dearly!

I like the white pizza so much I'd like to take it behind the junior high and get it pregnant. I mean you need to have an attraction to garlic but it's amazing.   Every pizza that we've tried there has been so good. And a large Caesar salad is enough to feed six

Went here for lunch today, we had the lunch special soup rice and entree. I had the Honey Almond Shrimp and my husband had the Beef Mongol, it was delicious! Can't wait to go back, staff was friendly and helpful!
Pretty good food. Very long line. My Baja bowl had no tortilla and no sauce so that was disappointing. I really liked the queso and chips.

Good place to stay. We had a very bad experience at Camping World in buying a new rig. The staff was very understanding in me venting to them.  That alone would get my return business. They made me feel better. Thanks

I stopped here to get a tire fixed that kept losing air. The staff was friendly, fast, professional, rotated my tires, and did it all for free with a smile! I highly recommend this business! Good customer service is rare these days- and these guys are doing it right.

I have never awarded a single star until now.  My wife and I went there for lunch today at about 1:00 PM and stood for several minutes waiting for someone to appear and seat us.  They were not busy and the kitchen crew saw us and kept on chatting among themselves.  A fellow came in while we were standing there and we looked at him and just shrugged our shoulders.  Finally I turned to the fellow and announced that I guessed they simply don't want our business.  Then we left, never to return again.

So I don't leave Yelp reviews, but these guys went above and beyond for me. I was in town for a couple days and I wanted to have some decals printed for my truck. From the first phone call to the finished installation took 24hrs and the results are exceptional. Robin worked with me one on one and proceeded to make sure we got the design to fit my truck perfectly. When installing her husband went to great lengths to make sure everything was centered and leveled properly. 

Also I found out that they are willing to ship. So excited to be able to continue working with them in the future from Wyoming!

Overall I am extremely satisfied with their client care, and final product.

Fantastic atmosphere, great service, and perfect family friendly activity. This place is not your typical nasty dirty bowling alley. There is a great atmosphere, and it is an affordable activity for any day. Had awesome service from the staff and will definitely come more!

Well I have to say that my three half to four  stars is simply because our personal reason for staying was for the internet and it just so happened that the internet was down the night we stayed. I would have given them a better review if they would have answered one of the three contact numbers listed when the issue arose -  but they did not. 

On the other hand, the staff was friendly, park was very well maintained and they had all the amenities you could want. 

I have stayed at quite a few campgrounds at this point (we travel for work in our camper van) and this was not my favorite shower experience but it definitely did the job and I didn't feel like the area was neglected. I would suggest to the staff to add a seat in the shower and use some CLR to make the appearance of standing water on the small pink tiles go away (it just made me feel yucky) but other than that it was great. They even offered you a little area to put your shower soaps in while in the shower area itself and it wasn't one of those annoying coin operated or timed showers like some places have. 

We did bring our dog but given the time we stayed and the circumstances (work) we were not able to play in the K9 camp areas. I did notice the doggy disposal sites around the park though. 

Another cool thing about this park was they actually had a jacuzzi, not just a pool, plus a gazebo with a lit fire for people to sit around. This perk was real cozy especially arriving around 8:30pm with the rain, the fire pit just gave you a sense of relaxation and coziness that I really enjoyed. 

I was able to check out the laundry facility even though we did not use it - it was nice. $1.25 for a wash and .25 each ten minutes you dry. Not bad. 

Again, with some CLR in that bathroom and N internet connection I can rely on I would stay again. 

Hope this review helps.

Deeelicious! When you decide to finally check this place out, have ANYTHING with the sweet pulled pork. MAJOR YUM. I like the burritos (they're huge) and the salad (that my boyfriend also loves. and that's saying a lot!). They also make handmade flour and wheat tortillas right in front of you which are delectable. The workers are fast, and give you good portion sizes. The only reason I docked a star is because the food seems to be really sauce-y and not many fresh veggies :/ 

FYI: Students can get the special prices all the time with their student ID.
Everyone is always so friendly and happy. Bailey loves going there so she obviously has a great time. They offer everything in one spot and the prices are really good. Thank you
Came for the Wings and the games on the big screens. The excellent service was a pleasant surprise. The food was good and the staff was very friendly. I would return here again!

This is our second time here and it was really good again! Hubby had the Blackened Salmon Hash and it was delish with just a bit of kick from the chipotle hollandaise. He was also impressed that the orange juice tasted fresh squeezed. I loved my half order of eggs Benedict: the ham was thick slices from a roast ham, not the pressed stuff or deli meat - sooo good! The hollandaise was tasty and the egg was poached just right - I pretty much licked the plate. The hot cocoa was good, but if you're ordering it be sure to clarify what a "campfire marshmallow" is to you: I'm a golden brown marshmallow kind of girl but I got charred. 
Service was great: our server, Tasha, was very friendly and helpful and solicitous. We got drinks right away, she brought extra sauce, and she was nice enough to put our small order in ahead of a table of six that came in at the same time as us, and she was upbeat and a joy to interact with. 
If you're looking for a great breakfast at a great price (the two of us ate for 30$ and that includes oj and hot choc) - look no further! We will be stopping again on our next trip.

Restyle closed this Overland location a couple of weeks ago, as I learned today when setting up a donation delivery.  They will be opening another store in a few weeks time on Glenwood.  In the meantime, their store on 625 Vista Drive is open for donations and shopping.  Nice people.  Good cause supported with proceeds.

I am not giving this place a rating at all but it forces you too. We tried to go to dinner last night before going to the movies. Walked in the place was busy with our 10 people waiting to be seated. I was completely invisible to the hostess and there were two of them!!!! After waiting about 10 minutes to be acknowledged there were no tables so we asked about sitting outside. Well she was gone for another 5 or more cause we couldn't wait any longer in order to have enough time to each prior to our movie which we gave ourselves over an hour just in case they were slow. It wasn't worth our time to sit and wait for her to come back. The service is awful here I am so tired of giving them chances. How hard is it to seat 2 people any where? We are no longer going to Red Robin we will find a better place to go and we used to go here once a week on our date nights. You guys just lost a good customer with your poor service. Hopefully comments are read and make some adjustments.
Frank the tank eats here, and I know for a fact that tank only eats the best chicken fried steak.

I have been to Divine Wine a couple of times. I love the service and the fun environment. My first visit was on Halloween and Rocky Horror Picture Show was playing on the television. I like the variety of wine. The people here are happy to serve you. Sometimes there is a live band playing. This is the perfect place to just sit, have a glass of wine, and people watch.

Finally made my trip to here this morning. Ordered the Basque Chorizo Pepper Hash and B.T.A Benedicts for take out. The attendant was so sweet and welcoming. Food was freshly prepared and extremely tasty. And the portion size was HUGE! Probably the best breakfast spot in Boise-Meridian Area. Will definitely return again!

If I could give it 0 stars I would! This is the second time that I have been here and after today I will not be back. the spicy tuna roll was easily the worst sushi(if you can even call it that) I have ever had. Mushy rice and a tiny piece of Ahi that you could barley see let alone taste. There was nothing else in the roll either so you get a full mouth of disgusting rice for $10. We also ordered the teriyaki salmon which was overcooked and again the amount of salmon was laughable. The service was awful as well. Don't waste your time, money, or craving for japanese food on this restaurant.

After an extremely frustrating night of searching for dinner a solution came from the simplest of concepts. We tried ordering a pizza online from Piehole...le sigh, someone called 2 hours after we placed the order and asked "did u try an order a pizza?" Yes, two hours ago. "Do you still want it?" No thanks. Next up, New York Giant Pizza. Call, order and "sorry, but you are 1/2 a mile out of our delivery zone." Okay, I'm done with pizza now. I don't even want to think about it. I ordered Jimmy Johns online and it literally showed up in 5 mins. It tasted great. I am full and happy :) 
5 stars for saving Sunday night!

My FAVORITE breakfast spot! Tasha is amazing, she has been our server EVERYTIME! When we have been in she always remembers us, especially my drink order. The food is over the top delicious and you can't go wrong with anything you order!!

We received a coupon in the mail for a free haircut. We've been in search for a new barber, so we gave it a shot, after reading good reviews. 

OMG the lady who cut my kid's hair did a horrible fad. You can see vertical lines on the side of his head and the bottom of his hair is not a straight horizontal line. I understand he is a wiggly kid but this haircut does not make me want to return. 

Thank you for the coupon and the opportunity but we will not be a return customer.

Omg omg i am gluten and dairy free and this is my favorit spot to eat. The prices are comperable to others but the service and delicouse food you recieve send it directly to the top of of my list. Mind you i have ben a chef for 15 years and rarely take the time to wright a review. I love this place is the bottom line anything you order is going to come piping hot and delicious

Ordered 20 wings through grubhub. Delivery was great and wings tasted fantastic. Big problem, they shorted me 2 wings. It seems trivial but when a man orders 20 wings and he's shorted 2, on a take out no less, he expects all wings to be accounted for. Not that difficult. Its 20 not 26865 to count to.

This is not a convenient vet for us but we love Dr Troska and Dr Harsch and the other vets that we have seen, so we make the trip . I like that they let us know how much services will be before doing what needs to be done. We took our elderly amstaff here before she passed and they were great with pain management and end of life services and doing what was best for her and us. We now have a year old and a new puppy and we are just as happy with our experience here. Totally worth fighting traffic to get here.

I really enjoy this place,     when I come here I want a non-fussy,  easy going place to sit and eat.   Not a high dollar place either.  For about ten bucks you can get a great lunch and actually not be hungry half an hour later.

This place is pretty good. I looked to get their sticky fingers and their Mahi Mahi tacos. The place has many many televisions so if your game is on, you can catch it there. Staff are very friendly. Next time I will try the bone in wings since that is what they are more known for. If you want a place to chill with friends with decent food head on over to Wingers.
Best service I have had in a long time. Highly recommend the original Philly.  Owners are hard working and do a great job of making you feel at home.

Atmosphere:

The atmosphere is always similar to this chain. The Italian wamr cozy feel. Perfect for a date night, or a large group. 


Staff:

The staff was pleasant. Our estimated wait time was 40 minutes for a group of 4; however, we were seated in 20 minutes. BONUS! Our server was a bit scattered brain. He forgot to bring us our drinks, he forgot to refill the waters. He did, however, checked on us a good amount of time; even if he did forget our drinks on three occasions. He was helpful with giving us his expertise regarding the menu.  



Prices:

The price is about around 15 bucks a person. 


Location:
Across from the Village.  



Parking / Venue: 
Plenty of parking, its in the shopping center. 



Food:

I got chicken parm with spaghetti noodles and marinara.  The size was at normal compasity. The noddles were awful! It tasted like it had been taking a water bath for the past 10 hours. No flavor or freshness, tasted like pure water. The marinara sauce was a bit soupy, I'm assuming from the water noodles. The chicken parm had a good crust, and minimal flavor. Overall, the food was flavorless. Could use some herbs and spices. 

Specialities / what "they" are known for?
 
Italian food.  

Star rating:
2 out of 5


More importantly Would we ever go back? 

No, I don't think so.

My friends and I went to Red Robin to celebrate my boyfriend's lacrosse championship win. We were all very excited and were ready to have a good night. As soon as we got to our table, our waitress barely gave an introduction and was kinda short with us. She definitely stereotyped us as the teenagers who don't tip. Little did she know that all of us at the table work at a restaurant so we know the importance of tipping AND customers service. She took forever to get us our drinks and take our order and when we needed refills, she took 18 minutes just to get them for us (this is not an exaggeration, we timed it). When she finally brought us our drinks, I asked about the other 2 drinks (she forgot to grab) and she immediately gave an attitude. In the 18 minutes of us waiting, she had taken another tables order of whom were adults and got drinks for another table of whom were adults. She would walk past our table and avoid us and when we got our food, she didn't even ask how everything was looking or if we need anything else. The most disappointing thing is that her section wasn't even busy. 2-3 tables were filled so she was ignoring us to ignore us because she didn't think we would tip her. My boyfriend and I are trainers at our work and customer service is KEY to a good experience. Other than that the food was good. Unfortunately, our crappy waitress put a damper on the evening.

Just back from China three years ago she was constantly checking for authentic food. This is the closest restaurant to us and to her providence. Spicy is hot and noodles are to die on. Fresh veggies and proteins with spices to send you to the moon

This is my favorite place to eat in the Boise area. I love the food here, so delicious! I have tried a couple of things from the menu but I cannot stay away from the corned beef hash. I have tried the corned beef hash at other places in the Boise area and this place is by far the best! Also the homemade biscuits are to dye for with the homemade jam! Thank you for the delicious food!

Having been a MM customer for more than a year I would recommend their service. We have had a team leader for all cleaning. Tammy knows little things unique to our house and works with us on schedule changes.

Ajza loves this place! It is very family oriented and Ajza can be a kid . They have her favorite food and the waitress is always patient as she orders her own food.  I love their choices in salads and I'm glad they have a healthy choice. They do take some time to get your order as they are always busy. We had a 30 min wait. But we waited.
I had a great breakfast there, but an hour later I was pissing out of my ass for the remainder of the day

My family went out to celebrate my daughter's pregnancy. There were 7 of us. I have never written a bad review, until today. The dinner and services we experienced were the worst we have ever had. My daughter's pizza was completely doughy,my shrimp and pasta raw. I have been sick for five days. Our waiter forgot to take all of our order, and had to return three times. He never returned with coffee refills after asked several times. Our pregnant daughters steak was disgusting,and she had also been sick for days.save yourself and never eat there. After complaining to the manager, we were given 10$ off our meal that none of us ate. I ate two bites and am stll paying for it.

Jerry and John has no time on their schedule but were nice enough to squeeze us in to look at our refrigerator that had gone out. They were able to get us back on the road and we really appreciate their making time for us when we needed it. Thanks again! Rick and Linda Denning

Welcome back to the Treasure Valley the best fast-food Mexican restaurant chain. There were once four locations in Boise alone but they went away. The last location in Nampa, which had been there for decades,  closed two years ago.

Welcome to Meridian. Tacos, Taco Bravos and Potato Oles are back.

Order them with hot red sauce and superhot green. Leave the mild sauce for the kids. This is the first location where I've seen a hot sauce bar. Besides the three sauces mentioned above, they also have a chunky salsa and jalapeno slices.

This is nearly next door to Rocky Mountain High School, so you might plan your visit when the students are in class. Otherwise, you may be waiting in line.

I first encountered carinos while living in Texas. I moved to Boise until last year they had a location near my house in Boise. Carinos like a lot of chains has fallen on hard times; the one in meridian has survived (less crowded than restaurants at the village). I used to visit the one by my house 1-2 times a month. Honestly Boise has only 4 Italian restaurants so even though it's a chain it's still got delicious Italian food. I've read a lot of the bad reviews; it's definitely had its struggles and lots of menu changes. So tonight I was in meridian and had a coupon for free Italian nachos, how could I pass that up right? lol. My two favorite dishes are the spicy Romano chicken and the bow tie festival both feature unique and flavorful sauces. One of the new features is you can build your own pasta bowl choose your sauce and protein. It comes out a little cheaper than the standard option; comes with a salad. Yeah I know soup isn't an option anymore bummer salad wasn't anything special the dressing is hit or miss usually(garlic ranch). Tonight it was a little watery. The Italian nachos were huge and more flavorful and packed more heat with the addition of the green chili jalapeño alfredo sauce perfectly offset by the flavor of the pepporchinis. The service was awesome; super friendly and attentive!!! Tip-I usually take half of the pasta home; ask for a side of sauce to go cause the pasta will usually dry out when reheated makes for great leftovers if you snag the side of sauce. Don't let the bad reviews scare you Carinos can put out some flavorful Italian dishes!!
Oh-so Carinos will be undergoing a makeover this summer; will be changing to a more tavern feel. The bar area will expand and offer 50 taps with $2 Tuesday's. the menu will stay the same and fire sticks will be back in the menu.

This place is easily the best sushi in Meridian. I was so excited and a little worried when they came to Meridian because I LOVED the House location so much. They are just as good as the other location ( You can't argue this I see the same chefs here I remember from there.) Give it a try its amazing.

I really like this Veterinary hospital. The doctors here are great and are very knowledgeable and friendly. They take care of the dogs and try to make sure they're as less stressed as possible. I have taken my 3 dogs here for a couple years now. You can trust that you're furry friend will be taken care of!

5 stars to 2 stars. Moe Joe's you changed over the past year. Your potatoes are different and not as good. The corned beef hash used to be the right amount of crunch and flavor, now it is either over done and like jerky or excessively fatty. The farmhouse breakfast was a favorite and now it just doesn't taste good.

I think you need to go back to what you were serving a year or two ago because whatever you changed is noticeable. We used to visit once a month but now I don't have an appetite for your food any longer.

Ordered take out for a quick meal after a busy day. Good menu, very nice employees and I love the remodel of this former coffee shop. I'm looking forward to next time when we dine in. 
Lots of options for food, however their online menu doesn't list everything they have to offer, the price of anything or the cost of extras. For one dinner combo plate (general's chicken, fried rice, a side and two eggrolls), a small order of Hot & Sour soup and an order of Creamy Crab Stars was just under $25. The side for the combo plate my husband chose Won Ton soup, which was an additional $.50 and it their wasn't much to it. The website said the combo plate came with two eggrolls, but he got one eggroll and a few small pieces of fried chicken strips. The General's Chicken was good, but not spicy. They did ask when I placed the order if we wanted it mild or spicy and since it was our first time there I went with mild. Good flavor and a decent size portion, but it needed the spicy.
The Hot & Sour soup was good as were the Creamy Crab Stars (crab Rangoon). As with most fried food, they probably would have been much better eaten at the restaurant rather than after a 15 minute drive home. Their hot mustard was my favorite part of the meal - unlike any other I've had and wonderfully hot.
There are quite a few things on the menu that I look forward to trying and will definitely be back. This is one of the cleaner and nicer looking Chinese food restaurants in the area. A little on the pricey side when I think of what we get elsewhere for the same amount of money, but I'm willing to spend a little more when dining somewhere that I don't question the cleanliness of.

Excellent new addition to our neighborhood!   This upscale restaurant delivers on great food and very good service.   Had a filet and the wife had chicken and both entrees were out of this world good!  My prime filet was as good as Chandlers...yes I said it... Chandlers.   My life is going to be beautiful.

Friendly service
Big portions 
Fair price 
Clean establishment 
Parking available 
Food was fast, hot, and fresh 

Verified badass spot

I'm a complete foodie and the food here was fantastic. They have a wide selection of Benedict's and scrambles over potatoes (many options) as well as all the normal breakfast stuff and mimosas for that extra special breakfast. They made our kids chocolate chip pancakes even though we didn't see it on the menu. Service was so great. Our little ones stayed in their seat the entire time because they loved their meal. Very rare for us.

I need to come here more frequently, even if I don't need a haircut!  

Mandy's gentle touch while cutting and massaging will have you almost drifting off into sleep!  I did have to ask her if I snored.

Always ask for the Triple MVP, it is well worth the price!

Mandy is a great asset for the Salon!

Truly the worst dining experience I have ever had. Cold soup. Chewy calamari. Red wine came out white. Entrees were so cold they had to be returned. Johnny's combo was simply horrible. Giselle our waitress said "sweet" 16 times. This experience was not sweet. $100 that I will never see again. Wait, i will need to spend another $5 for the Pepto bismol on the way home. Close your doors now before you damage anybody else's evenings.

Loved this place and it was all because of the service.  Sara at the bar was unbelievable!  She was funny, timely, and a bit of a smart aleck all wrapped into one package!  

Food was great, they did really well on the wings and I'd recommend the garlic fries as well.

I'm pretty happy with everything we experienced, but the 5 stars is because of a great lady.

Give it a try, they have good food and if you're lucky enough to get the service I did, you'll be back!
Good selection of sushi and friendly service, we always have a good time here. This is our favorite sushi spot in the valley.

Dr. Harsh and his staff are amazing!! We have been a client of Dr. Harsh's for 10+ plus years. He has been there with us through our dogs lives. Dr. Harsh is very kind, professional and personable. He is very knowledgeable and we appreciate his honest advice. RVC is a little pricy but our family feels that Dr. Harsh is worth every single penny.
If you want salespeople who won't give you the time of day, this is the place. Rude and pretentious. No thanks!

Place was well cared for and facility was clean. It is really crowded and like staying in a parking lot and located behind a tire store. We drove away without staying because we got an RV spot near snake river!
All I have to say about Moe Joe's is amazing breakfast and fantastic service!  Eggs Benedict is the dish to order!!

I'm writing this because we went to Carino's last night and our food was taking a long time to come out. W e were seated in the bar and  our waiter kept apologizing and telling us he didn't know why it was taking so long. He was very nice and friendly kept our drinks filled and bread coming. Finally  our kids his pizzas came out but our meals still didn't arrive for some time. Finally he came back to inform us that he will be taking care of our meals that night and would only charge us for our drinks. Needless to say we left him a very large tip!!  I continue to be very impressed with the service we get at Carinos and their amazing staff!!

My wife and I celebrated Christmas Eve with a nice dinner at Carino's in Meridian. The food was very good, the pasta cooked perfectly, the meatballs and sausage and red sauce were great. Very nice meal, very nice experience.

But what made it an over-the-top nice experience was our server, Kamie. She was stellar! She patiently walked us through the menu options, told us about the available specials for that evening, even on a holiday, and was super nice and very courteous. One of the best!

My wife and I were both surprised at how high-quality a chain restaurant can be, with food and great service.
Love it! The breakfast buffet is my favorite but I love the salad bar too. Always fresh fruit and veggies. Definitely recommend!

Camp bow wow watched my dog Ellie while I was gone over the weekend! She had so much fun playing while she was there. She came home so tired :) probably my favorite part about camp bow wow was that they have the puppy cams so I could watch my dog play during the day while I was gone :)
Grear customer service at window. Food was fresh and tasty. The oles were not over salted like other taco johns I've been to. I would recommend.

Nice new option at this intersection! Great service and overall good food.They do need to rework their potatoes au gratin....tasteless. :-(  Happy hour great touch! 

Hurry and start "reservations"! Saw several people just leave due to wait.

I like the atmosphere in this restaurant and the service. They also serve cocktails and have a nice wine selection. The food is mediocre at best. When you order Spaghetti Bolognese you should get fresh pasta with fresh meat sauce on top in the middle of the pasta and freshly grated Parmesan cheese. Instead it was a huge bowl of old pasta mixed up in meat sauce and Parmesan out of a can. If they can't even do an especially easy Italian dish you can imagine the rest. This is not Italian food. It's fast food with no taste.
We had a great first experience here. The service was excellent and the food was good. We enjoyed the overall vibe of the interior. We will be back for sure.

Stop by this place! Went here today for lunch because my husband and I have been wanting real Italian food. You know it's real when they have anchovies in their Caesar salads. I kept saying "sooo good" after every bite! My husband ordered the Misto Mare and it did not disappoint. Seafood was fresh and sauce was perfect. However, I would suggest more pasta on the plate. Even my 4 yr old son ate good! He had the spaghetti and meatballs from the kids menu, which was a huge portion and his review "one hundred good!" Our server noticed a happy birthday hat we had and brought us ice cream after our meal! Thank you Gino's Italian Restaurant for a memorable birthday lunch for my husband! We just moved here and already are loving our area!

I'm not sure how I've lived here almost 5 years now and I've never rated this place. 
Let me just get to the point; this is by far, and I mean by far, the best breakfast spot in Idaho. That's right, Idaho. I've eaten breakfast all over this state from Caldwell to Idaho Falls and Twin Falls to Sandpoint and Moe Joe's blows everyone out of the water. 
Now, Goldy's is a solid second but it's tiny, hard to get a table, and you smell like breakfast the rest of the day. 
Anyway, you can't go wrong with anything you order, the staff is awesome, and definitely order the breakfast burrito. You won't be disappointed.
i have been to ada west dermatology a couple of times. they are very efficient from beginning to end. nice office. the dr was very good but quick, must be very busy.

I travel all over the country. I eat out all the time, seeking the the best in local flavor. The Garden Breakfast Bowl and Jalepeno Berry Pancakes were the best breakfast I have had ever in my 48 years on this earth. Best EVER.  Put this on your bucket list, it's that good.

My boyfriend and I worked with Frank Glodowski, he went above and beyond for us. Even though things ended pretty messy. I would always recommend Frank to anyone looking to buy or sell a house. He was a lot of fun to work with and he was an amazing realtor all around!

Still five stars. This place has two locations. I called the other night to ask how late they were open so I could pick up some meds for my dog. I was told they were open til 8. 

7:30 I roll up. I am the only one there but I can see the woman behind the front desk. I get out of the car and try to open the door...but it's locked. I walk to the other side and am confronted with the same problem. Did they close early? 

The woman behind the counter rushes over and opens the door. Her name is Kim and she is awesome beyond all words. The other location gave me the wrong closing time - this location is only open until 7 but since she was there anyways waiting for someone else to pick up their animal she saw me and let me in. She could have just said she was sorry, they were closed, come back tomorrow. But she saved me an extra trip and gave me my meds, and she did it with a smile and conversation. She was not at all put out by the fact that it was after hours and here I was, buying medication for my dog like it was the middle of the day. She was so friendly and so kind! 

So...here's my follow up: come here if you need a vet. No, seriously. No one is paying me to say this (however, if you want to, I am certainly not going to throw your money in the trash). They are amazing. If I didn't have two dogs, I would go out and get one just so I could come here. Bonus: delicious coffee right next door.

Robert/pharmacy absolutely went above and beyond the call of duty in the customer service department. His display of respect and honesty is nothing short of excellent.  Thank you Robert for your hard work and time.

Anonymous
Bland food, low quality chicken cuts, and no juices in the servings. King Pao chicken didn't taste like any normal Kung Pao. The only thing that tasted recognizable was the white rice.
Ordered a large Italian Sausage and Pepperoni Pizza and split it three ways. The flavor was delicious and tasted very authentic. Highly recommend.
Wow we stumbled on this place and it was fantastic! Pizza was amazing, very fresh and full of flavor. Service was incredible, definitely recommend it!

Nice addition to the area.  Cool atmosphere and good coffee, but access from roads is awkward and they are still working out things from the grand opening.   Lots of areas to improve on but I think they can turn it around and have faith they will make this work and be a great place for coffee

I will never go to Les Schwab again.  I take my payments in or mail then in and they post them to other people's accounts.  It takes months to find out and then you have to find the checks to prove you made the payments.  This is a scam that has happened to me at more than one location in Boise and Nampa over the past 10 years.  I keep moving to different locations but they all seem to do the same thing.  Then, when you come in angry about it, they report you to the credit agencies as late because your payment got applied elsewhere.

Been here a couple times before and the food was good and service was great but this time not so much. Our waiter took a long time to take our order and then we waited over an hour for our food. We watched other patrons who were seated after us finish their meals and leave before we received ours. 10 minutes before we finally got our food our waiter chimed in with a weak "hold in there it's almost done" then left again while he cracked jokes with the other tables. No refills on our drinks until we got our food either. Then when our food came, my dish was a steak and he made the excuse that because the steak was so thick that's the reason it took so long, ummm the steak was practically rare in the middle really over an hour to cook?? It never takes me that long to cook a steak to that level. I think someone dropped the ball somewhere. I did enjoy my meal but my husbands meal was drowned in sauce and the chickens texture was off pudding. 

Furthermore, there were no apologies, just a bunch of excuses and no offer of more bread or free desert(which Places like Olive Garden would have done) or anything to comp for our waiting and poor service. No one asked if we had to be anywhere else, luckily we didn't but I sure didn't want to spend all evening there. Gino didn't visit our table either even though we saw him visit all the others. We felt unwanted and invisible and this was a special night out to celebrate my birthday with my husband. We were not happy and don't plan on coming back soon or at all. Very disappointed.

The pizza is generally good and so is the salad bar. Waiting almost an hour for a pizza when it was not busy not acceptable. Watched people who were here 30 mins after get there pizza before us. Order was basic only one pizza. Not sure we will be back

Katherine, the masseuse, is the BEST. I am new to the area and am use to The Red Door or Thai massages, but hands down- Katherine gives the best massages. She knows what she is doing and will give time and attention to getting out knots.

This is a real gem of a Chinese / Asian restaurant in our town here in Meridian.  They have a huge menu with high quality cuisine at a very reasonable price.  

I would highly recommend the Red Pavilion Mandarin resturant. Staff was very courteous and quick. The staff made my wife and I feel very comfortable. They also kept clean stations and retrieved used dishes and platters as they were used.  We will use them in the future without a doubt.

My wife and I had attempted a late lunch in March of 2018.  We ended up walking out because after waiting several minutes with no one ahead of us in line our presence was never acknowledged by a host or hostess.  I wrote a review saying we would never return.  Well, we were in the area on February 28, 2019 and at my wife's urging we gave it a second chance, so here goes:

We arrived a little after 1:00 PM and were promptly greeted and seated.  Our server arrived promptly and we ordered a glass of wine and a draft beer.  The drinks arrived promptly and we then ordered food consisting of spaghetti and meatballs for my wife and a meatball sandwich for myself (I figured that if you can't get a meatball right in an Italian restaurant you've got a problem).  As it happened, the food was served promptly with my wife having nothing but compliments on the pasta, sauce and meatballs.  My sandwich seemed a little dry and I requested a side of sauce which was promptly provided.  With my sandwich I also had their truffle fries.
