The fries seemed to be prepared from fresh potatoes, rather than frozen, and were very tasty. For desert my wife ordered a cannoli which I sampled and it too was very tasty.  I should also mention that their fresh bread served with a small cup of olive oil, garlic and spices was flavorful and quite enjoyable too.

Overall, we were impressed with both food and service.  We found the ambience to be very pleasant as well.  My only concern on a going forward basis will be with consistency.  We hope they keep up the good work.

First off, the service was outstanding, and we loved the waitress. Buuuut.... the food was salty and kinda too spicy for breakfast food in my opinion. I was shocked by the level of spice and salt. The innovative breakfast food was so exciting and i really loved the items we had without spice, but some of it was way overwhelming. Maybe just a quick friendly warning? Other than that, you guys are awesome!
If you are starving I guess this would work. The chicken was like rubber not impressed at all will not be back.

Jim is definitely honest.  Our property manager paid him at the time he did the work on our rental and then we sent him a check.  He promptly cut a check and sent it to us to reimburse us for our over-payment.  That took time and effort to cut the check and put it in the mail.  And his work was great.

I have been going here sense they opened. I always have sat at the bar. At first, I was disappointed with the bar service. 
They now have a new bartender that is amazing! He's name is Wes, and I really hope they keep him! I have been satisfied with food. I love their hot wings and sauces! Glad they are building their team of awesomeness! Way to go
Wingers!

It's pretty impressive to see how a school can be transformed into a church.  But they did it!.   Moreover, they have a separate and secure section dedicated to kids teaching, and each classroom was age appropriate with plenty of adult help.....it was well organized and structured, and the kids had their own music time.  The staff was very friendly and welcoming.   When we walked pass the coffee and donut table (bonus points) to enter the auditorium, we were greeted by smiles, and handed a bulletin to take notes, and they had pens and bibles if needed.  The teaching was straight from the bible and it was not watered-downed in an attempt to not offend anyone.  You will definitely leave there impacted by Gods word and will desire to learn more.  Its a solid biblical church.

Moe Joe's is very obviously the best breakfast spot in the Meridian-Boise area. The menu is diverse and affordable, the service is friendly and prompt, and the food tastes amazing. Every time I go I pick what I want to try the next time I go in. The line out the door speaks for itself.

Been way too long not reviewing red pavilion. This is the best Chinese we have found in the Meridian/Boise area to date. We were introduced to red pavilion by our dear friends @laurenslatest. They have since moved and took a piece of our heart with them, but the good news is they left red pavilion behind. The service is always great and the food is consistently delicious. 

We normally get takeout and it's always packed so plan for about 45 min. The food is exceptional and has never disappointed us. We have dined in twice and it was a pleasant experience...even with two little bobble heads to wrangle. 

There are cheaper places but I have yet to find a place that gives you this quality for the same or less. Our go to Chinese take out...all others have been a compromise.

The beef selections here are outstanding. The menu is relatively small, focusing on appetizers, sandwiches, and a small amount of salads, entrees, and desserts. Portion sizes are reasonable with pricing to match. Sports bar theme with about a dozen draft beers but half of the restaurant is sit down booth and table so all demographics of people can dine here (and do). Service was friendly and responsive.

This is where you go for a fantastic breakfast! My girlfriend had the corned beef hash (I have never tasted such homemade corned beef hash, amazing flavor and cooked to perfection!) and I had the Chorizo Frittata, which was very flavorful and not  heavy! This is good food, not greasy fried junk, and they serve reasonable portions for reasonable price (not this piled high plate of slop you get from those other places that try and impress you with the massive amount of food you get). This place impresses on flavor! Friendly staff and no wait (at least when we were there!) highly, highly recommend! Unfortunately we were just passing though town otherwise we'd be eating here all the time!

Had wanted to go here for awhile, but always soooo busy, finally got in at 8 on a Sat with no wait ( but when we left at 9.. insanely busy!).  I had the garden hash & toast with Marionberry jam. Absolutely delicious. Loved the veggies in the hash & the potatoes (Moe JOES) were delicious! The jam was to die for. Little on pricey side, but definitely will be back!
Service is slow and food was mediocre. Avoid the steaks. Salmon was OK. Food prices are much too high. Not bad if you're just drinking wine.
Disgusting disgusting DISGUSTING!!!! Their service was just as terrible as their food, and the place was filthy!!!

We try to go here every time we are in the area and have the time to wait for a table.  Of course we are usually there on a busy weekend.  The food is delicious and the staff are terrific!  We love this place.

Ok, I travel a lot, and end up eating a lot of pizza in my hotel room.  I gotta say, these guys have amazing pizza! They also get the finer points of underpromising and overdelivering! They said I would get 6 twisty sticks with my order... omg, these sticks are the size of baseball bats!  They told me an hour...knock on door in 30 minutes! Awesome job guys! Thanks!

If you like dry tasteless Mexican food this is the place for you. I ordered the same burrito twice and had bad experiences both times. They don't bother putting the sour cream or guacamole on your food, or if they do it's undetectable. I've had 2 bad experiences and I won't be back for a third.

Wow - called to order take out at 830 was told they will not cook anything with chicken because they want to close in 30 minutes and they would have to throw anything left out.  Order another protein or they can't take the order.  The young lady in charge was very certain the preference was not to take an order for 4 and repeated they are trying to get ready to close in 30 minutes?  Very certain they were ready to leave by 9 based on my call and probably others.  Hopefully, whomever owns the franchise location in Meridian reads yelp reviews and does a bit of additional training on service, business hours and what that means for employees and customers.

My salesman Chris Ybarguen was great. No pressure just tons of specs and info on the camper we were looking for. Brought a battery out to turn on the camper lights too. He handled our purchase exactly the way I wanted. Ask for Chris when you go to Bish's.

I bowl a lot, 2-3 times a week, in the Boise/Meridian area and this is hands down the best alley. Their lanes are maintained well and the vibes are perfect for hanging out. It's pretty obvious that this alley is set apart, all the serious rollers join the league there.

I stopped by today to pick up a couple burritos. After ordering I headed to the restroom. Unknown to me, as there were no signs or cones, they had just washed the bathroom floor and hallways.  I hit a puddle of water and down I went!  Hit my head on candy machines, along with my foot and arm on other foreign objects. 

There was no manager on duty and only one person seemed to speak english.   I was extremely upset and hurt.  There was no offer of help (calling ambulance etc). Even after I'd fallen, they made no effort to mark the area with any type of caution.  My food wasn't comp'd or any type of kind words.  

At this point I was past angry    I requested the managers telephone number and I was given a false number!  I came home in tears. My husband spoke to employee and she lied and said she had moved the cones too soon. That floor has "just" been washed and there were no cones to serve as a warning. 

I have never been treated this badly.  I will NEVER NEVER eat at the los Betos on Eagle again and if you don't want to walk into a hazard I suggest you don't either.   Lots of other better choices around
Had a BLT. Was too dry, or over toasted. Didn't realize I had an option to choose a side and was just given fries which I didn't eat. Food was average. I would return and try something else.

The customer service was wonderful when we can in. Our severs were nice and helpful. The only reason this place gets a one star is because the serves were so nice. The pizza was terrible at best. The middle of it was soggy and the flavor was none existent unless you dipped it into a marinara sauce they provided. We also got a calzone which was similar and was just as mediocre. If you want to go get pizza, you are better off going to blaze or to flying pie because their quality and price is much better. It took 45 minutes for one 12 inch pizza and a calzone to be made and brought to our table. I purchased a wine for 11.99 a glass and you can go and buy a wine bottle for $9.00 on the website. What a joke. I will never recommend this place due to the lack of flavor and overpricing this place boasts. Go to dominos. At least they have flavor in theirs.


Update: Josef has responded this review and due to his professionalism, I will gladly give this place a try. Especially since the service was so wonderful when I ate here, I have no problem spending my money. I wish good luck to this place and I'll come back in the future to give this place a chance to redeem this review.

This location is definitely up to par with Dutch Bros! The staff is all really friendly and outgoing. They were also accommodating with our coffee selections too. Also, our car was a big fan of the choc chip muffin tops!

The service was sub par. Took a while for the waitress to get to us and it wasn't busy. We were there at 3:30 on a Sunday. She got our food wrong and we had to sit and wait for a good five minutes for her to check on us to tell her it was wrong. The food was just okay.

I would give zero if it was possible.  My step daughter ordered bone-in wings and they brought her boneless wings. We pointed out that her order was wrong and the waitress said that they would bring bone-in wings right away, but the she could nibble on the boneless ones until her correct order came. So, she started nibbling on the boneless ones and another waitress came up and ripped them out of her hands and said that she couldn't have them unless she planned on paying for them in addition to the bone-in wings.  So we waited for her wings to come and I tipped well - it wasn't our waiter who did this. We were turned off. 

We went back two weeks later and there was a sign on the door that they were having a company celebration and that they weren't seating after 7:30.  My husband arrived at 7:15 and they seated him. My daughters and I arrived at 7:20 and met my husband who was leaving (at 7:20). After seating him, a waitress asked him to leave saying that the kitchen was closed and they would not serve us. We went back in to see if the would reconsider because it still wasn't actually 7:30 and they wouldn't.  We aren't going back.
As always, the food was great. The service was quick. It's different than just burgers.

They get two stars for spacious, clean dinning. 

Food took forever to get, was cold, severely under seasoned and just blech.  

I asked for sweatner for my tea and got it 20-min later.  I drank my tea and got a refill after i finished my food.  

Was asked if i wanted chips, salsa, and guacamole and declined.  They brought my tacos with chips, salsa, and guacamole AND was charged for it.  Noticed the server didnt write any of our order down... would recommend they take some notes next time.   

Not worth the bytes the pics would take up on my phone.  Certainly will never return.
Love the food, service, and atmosphere. Definitely make reservations it's a popular place.

Husband and I were looking for a place for dinner. We saw Mekong Fresh and since it was new we decided to try it. The young waitress was helpful by telling us about what dishes she liked and what we may be interested in. We had the Lettuce Wraps...very tasty concidering they could have less noodles and more meat on them. Fried egg rolls were good. Nothing out of the ordinary. I ordered Phad Se Eaw with chicken, since they were all out of Banh Mi. The sauce was delishious. Not spicy at all and very filling. Husband ordered the Pho Combo. It should have had tripe in it, but it didn't. He was let down on not having that adventure. The waitress tried to ask the kitchen about it but said that there was to much of a language challenge. Non the less we were very pleased with our food. It would have received 5 stars if the Pho would have been correct and if the service from the kitchen were faster. The waitress  was great...she worked the entire floor. We will be going back!

Took our family to Dart Warz yesterday for our son's birthday and had a great experience! The staff was very welcoming, the facility was very clean, the Nerf gun selection was very good, and the price was very reasonable... the most important part though was that my son had an amazing time! He said that "Dart Warz was cool and awesome!" We will definitely be back!

I've been to Gino's many times over the past few years and the quality of the food just isn't what it used to be. We went to Gino's last Saturday for my birthday and my husband ordered the boar shank like he normally does, but unfortunately it was not heated through and he did not finish it. 
I was looking forward to their lobster ravioli, but apparently they took that off of the menu even though everything else on the menu looks the same as it had in the past. Instead, I had the filet mignon, but the balsamic cream sauce was too sour and I couldn't taste the flavors in the meat which was very disappointing. I didn't finish the risotto either, it was like mush and all I could taste was the balsamic. My daughter had a pasta dish which she said was okay, but didn't want to take home the leftovers. My son had calzone and said it was good.  My husband mentioned that Gino had retired/or sold the restaurant (not sure if this is true) but if he did, I'm wondering if that's why the food wasn't up to par. I wasn't impressed when we ate here last fall either (I had the veal piccata, but it was very tough), but I thought it was just an "off day" in the kitchen.  With wine, our dinner for 4 came out to $155 before tip. Normally we would also stay for espresso and desserts, but I didn't want to spend any more money here.  I still gave Gino's 2 stars instead of 1 because their breadsticks and garlic oil dip is still very good (although they are starting to skimp on the garlic and red peppers in the oil which makes it soooo good).  I will probably come here again for lunch sometime since it is nearby, but never for a special dinner.

Dined last night and was greeted with warm friendly service which extended to the waiter and bus staff. The Caesar salad was very good with nice portions. Unfortunately the main dish of veal scallopine with gnocchi was tiny in portion size and  bland to the extreme.  I was very disappointed in this dish for $25.  The lady had the baked ziti which was nothing special.  "It's like a store bought sauce poured on noodles" was her reaction. 

I had high hopes in finding a good small business local spot but unfortunately ran into disappointment on the main dishes.

It's taken 20 years to get great Chinese food in Boise and this is it! We're working our way through the menu and everything has been fresh and delicious. The spicy chicken (?) is my favorite so far, followed closely by Mongol beef. The lunch combo is a fantastic deal

Oh my lanta! The sweet pork smothered in red sauce burrito here is AMAZING!!!! Never disappoints and for those of you who like tres leches cake!!! It's sooooo good!!!! And if you haven't tried it try it here you need it in your life like yesterday! Very nice workers too!

I would never recommend northwest tax to anyone, after the experience I had. I also never write yelp reviews... but I wish someone had warned me before I hired Dan Welker.  I paid Dan $1650 to get help with my taxes that my tax guy never filed in 2009.. I called and emailed continuously to get answers.  If you are lucky enough to have someone answer, the secretary will give you an excuse as to why your tax agent isn't available.  Once they get you to sign papers and give them money, it will take weeks to get them to respond to your calls, or email you back.  Maybe I just had a really bad agent.  Like I said, I normally never write reviews... even if a place really bothers me... but this guy has me thinking I was being scammed.  I still have absolutely no idea what he did for me, that I couldn't have easily done myself in a fraction of the time.  I hired him because I had no one else to turn to for answers, and they took advantage of me. I still can't believe I paid that much money to have someone not return my phone calls and not let me know what was happening with my case.  My tax issue is still unresolved, and I hired this guy in 2014.  Basically, I paid almost $2000 for this guy to get me on a payment plan with the IRS.  This company, in my opinion, is just a huge scam to get money out of people who don't know any better.

Went here for lunch with my daughter and her two babies, ages two and seven months.  We chose this place because we wanted soup and salad for lunch and it was near where we were shopping and knew they have good bread and soup.  We immediately were greeted and seated soon after.  My two-year old granddaughter was tired and being " two". She also knows that when she goes out to eat she gets a cup of milk with s straw. The waiter came to ask for our drinks and I immediately asked if he could get cup of milk.  I might of seemed a little rude because she was whining and I was tired.  Thankfully our waiter "understood" and milk was out promptly, even though he was busy with other customers.  Both my daughter and I ordered the soup and salad lunch special.  I had the Italian chili soup and my daughter had the potato soup.  Bread came first, then our Cesar's salad, then the soup.  All were very good.  We did order from the child's menu a cheese pizza, but Olivia was too full from milk to eat, so my daughter and I picked from it and decided it was just okay.  We were pretty full.  Overall Johnny Carino's is a good goto chain Italian restaurant that is, like other Italian chains, consistently good.  The chain restaurants, in my opinion, will  probably never be a four or five star, but if the service is good and the food is hot and prepared well, it's a solid three stars.  I'll be coming back!

Good breakfast place. First thing I noticed was the great 70's rock music. 

Food was solid. Not sure about the tab. Showed a built in tip then got the bill after the credit card and showed a different price. Walked away shaking my head. I received some one else's tab so had to get the correct one.

Very nice!  Casual but nice.  Good food, the service wasn't as good as the first few times we went.   I recommend this place.  I would give it a five star if the service had been better.  Waitress gave us the wrong specials and we went to order the special, only to find out they didn't have it.  It went down hill from there.

Came here for my birthday! The food was delicious but it took a long time to get our food. We had a big group of people and I called ahead for a reservation but they sat us very awkwardly and not all together. They did bring us edamame to snack on while we waited and gave us all fried bananas for dessert, on the house but we all waited a long time for our food. Everyone in my party enjoyed their food though!

Overpriced, greasy, poor service. It's tiny as well and they refuse to take reservations, so you could be in store for a long wait. There aren't many competitive options nearby so I'm sure they'll have plenty of business but I won't be a repeat customer. A major disappointment considering the Tavern at Bown Crossing is really good.

I'll keep this short and sweet. I popped in for my first and last time. I sat at the bar table for a good 5 minutes with no acknowledgment. I sat and watched other patrons come in, get service all while the server was eating her Chow Mien at the table behind me. I will never go back!

I loved Fred Meyer Eagle Island until today. This is a message for the manager, Charity,  who was tonight, around 10 PM. I understand you were tired, and the cashier was tired, as well.   You told  me very sarcastically, "well, that's how the world works, and that's how Fred Meyer is going,  online", when I couldn't download the app,  you made me feel stupid in front of my daughter and the other customers waiting in line. All the previous experiences I had with the personnel  were great, until I had the misfortune to meet you..I hope you check your manners next time, you should try to keep customers coming to the store, not pushing them to go online.

This review is based solely on my experience with Walgreens' order online, pick up in store service.

Walgreens often has really great promos that you can pair with an app coupon, order on their app and then pick it up at the store for free (no shipping fees).  I did exactly this recently and was able to get (2) sets of Ziploc Twist 'N Loc containers for $1.11 each.  And since I pass by this Walgreens location often, it was super easy to just pop in and pick up my order when it was ready.  

Only it wasn't super easy.

I arrived at the store and went over to the photo department (because that's where you pick up your online order).  I waited for about 5 minutes and no one came to assist me - even the girl that was right next to it putting things in the refrigerator section.  So finally, I sort of looked at her and the other associate who was working on an endcap not too far behind me (there were no other customers in the store) and said "hellllloooo .... is there someone who can help me with an order?"  The farther lady came over, and as she walked behind the counter, I told her it was an order online pick up in-store item.  She proceeded to look through the photos.  She asked me what size.  I told her it was an item, not a picture.  I guess a picture is an item so that's my bad for not being more clear.  

Then she went over to the pile of boxes.  There were about 4 there.  I told her it was a small thing and should be a small box.  She quickly found it and then walked over to the register.  She seemed to play with the register a bit and then it became obvious that she had no idea what to do.  So, she called over the associate who was nearby at the refrigerated case.  She came over and they were both punching things on the screen, guessing, "let's try this ... " and not getting anywhere.  All while the lady was holding my already paid for package in her hand.  I asked if I could just have my already paid for item and leave - it'd been 20 minutes now - and she said no, it has to be released.

So, she paged for the manager.  And the other girl told her that they weren't supposed to because she was pumping.  So, then the first girl tells me I'm going to have to wait until she's done pumping to get my order.  I have no issues with women being able to pump in the workplace, good on Walgreens for accommodating her, but what I do have an issue with is how does only one person in the store know how to release an online order?

Now there's someone at the front register, so the second girl went over there.  And it's a return - that she doesn't know how to do.  The manager comes out and the girl grabbed her to help ... knowing full well that I was over here at the photo counter waiting to leave with my package.  The manager finishes there and then comes over, and the girl tells her that she needs to release my order.  The manager took the package, asked for my ID and handed me my box.  That.  Was.  It.  There was no computer nothing that needed to be done.  Just verify the person and give her the box.  I was hanging out at Walgreens for a half an hour because someone, 2 someones actually, didn't know that to "release" an online order you check the ID and hand them the box.

Super frustrating.  

It's a clean store.  Easy, convenient location to get in and out of.  Great deals and a fun seasonal inventory along with household supplies and food.  And they have smokin' hot photo deals on the regular.  However, they need to make sure that more people know how to do more things.  Especially buy online pick up in store, that's gotta be something that more and more people are doing.
New Management? New employees? Not only was the service and speed and freshness phenomenal but this is the best Jack In the Box I have had in many many years

My favorite breakfast eatery. Well worth the wait. Great service. 

The food is amazing. I recommend this place to everyone. It's unfortunate they close at 2pm. I would go there for dinner if I could.
We love Moe Joe's. Everything we've tried has been delicious. My mom loves it when we take her with us... her favorite is their biscuits and gravy. Wonderful friendly staff too!

I've been going to Ada West Dermatology for a number of years and have always been pleased with the care I have received.  The people on the front desks are pleasant and I never have had to wait very long to be seen. Dr Pitt is very professional and personable and I believe he really takes an interest in his patients. I would highly recommend him.

My husband found this little place. It was packed on a Monday morning; which says a lot! This place had great house potatoes and delicious hot chocolate with real marshmallows that are roasted. I will be coming back here for sure! I admired their sourdough toast and their jam. The portions were large and I took some home for lunch.
Worst service ever. Had to remind the waiter after 30 min about appetizers then waited another 30 min for the meal. Got up and walked out!
Came in and got new tires right away!  Very friendly and educated.  Great price on tires!!!!
Rewriting my review,  I have been able to try the pizza and I have to say it is very good. Staff is friendly
I've never eaten here until this year and now I've been 3 times in 2 months. If you're over off of Overland this has to be in the conversation for places to eat. It's really really good!

Wonderful pizza! Clean fresh fast friendly service. Our waitress Cain was excellent. She informed us of some Grimaldi's history which was pretty interesting and made the pizza even more tasty. I recommend a wine and classic pepperoni pizza. Pizza took about 20 min...drinks were refilled...We will definitely revisit.

My family and I tried this place out at the suggestion of a neighbor who has what I think is pretty good taste when it comes to good restaurants. 
Overall the food was OK, I would rate it about a 3.75, the service was pretty bad.
They seemed to be disorganized and distracted. Every person going in every direction with food coming out at various times to different tables everybody was getting their food in waves. 
Our drinks were not refilled right away, we asked for napkins that never came, we asked for an extra plate because one that was at the table was dirty and they simply scraped off the food and said there it's good. I don't think so.
The place was packed so they're not going anywhere soon but I don't want to be one of the sheeple that just settles. I'm looking for that great Chinese food experience here in the Boise area where we recently relocated to. We came from California so we're trying to adjust our expectations.
We're finding that in Boise Chinese food lacks freshness and flavor. Rice is always gummy, vegetables don't seem to be cooked at extremely high temperatures but rather sautéed which makes them limp and colorless.
So far we've only found about three places out of all the restaurants we have tried where the service is really good. Sure, everybody's apologetic but nobody wants to fix it. And there are signs up everywhere for help wanted.
I would rather pass on this place to return and keep trying other places.

Ate here last night for the first time and will never return. I ordered the cauliflower steak and it came out black and charred. How can a chef think that is ok to serve? Inedible. I returned it but it came so late I put it in a take-out box. Very disappointing evening.

We can't enough good things about this place! It's the BEST Wingers restaurant we have ever been to! The General Manager, Seth and our server Sarah took great care of us on a very busy Friday night! We come here for lunch on a regular bases and get great customer service then to but to receive the same level of service on Friday night just shows they truly care! The food came out hot and is always delicious!

We went there recently for my mom's birthday, it was our first visit actually eating there.  We had tried walking in previously, but were told by the hostess they had so many reservations it wasn't worth waiting.  Not the best first impression, but we were willing to give it another go, this time with a reservation!

Food was okay, nothing memorable, but it was decent.  Service started well, but deteriorated into long waits and forgotten items which was disappointing.  For the price, I'd rather go downtown to Alavita!

Ugh, who knew I'd love coming to the Village so much?  I love this space because it fronts the water fountain, and on a beautiful day like today, sitting on the patio with a glass of sangria is divine.  I also come here lots because of the play area, which my son LOVES (as do i).  But the reason for the updated review?  The kale chopped salad - it's light, refreshing with the lemon vinaigrette, and totally filling thanks to the kale.  This with the white sangria might be my go to summer treat.  So GOOD!  Service has always been great, to boot.  :)

Took my 2013 cougar in for warranty work Brandy was awesome she got everything done that needed to be done got everything covered under my warranty and I was very happy she definitely knows her business and knows what she's doing great job!!!

There's so much good to say about this new restauraunt. Do you enjoy healthy organics, go here. Do you like to juice and drink smoothies, go herr.  Do you like to meet the owner of a restaurant that you dine at, go here.  Prices are high if you normally eat fast food or at places that don't have organics.  Also, portions are small compared to your maybe your chain restauranrs.  They have a kids menu! Water is in containers with lime in one, cucumber in another, etc. Healthy and tasty and refreshing.  They even make their own bbq and is available on each table or you can purchase your own to go.  Yummy.  Ambiance is clean and bright and couldn't even hear the music. Just an all out great not normal not fast food heart health conscious place.

When I came back to my car after getting groceries this morning at Winco there was a note on my windshield to see my rear passenger tire. It was flat as a pancake!! I buzzed over to the nearest gas station to air it up and then went directly to the Les Schwab across from the speedway. 
Years ago I went here to have a flat repaired. My blazer was loaded to the gills with camping gear and kiddos. The flat was irreparable and the spare was no better. However, rather than selling me a new set of tires, which, as a single mom there was no way I could afford at the time. They gave me a take off tire that was suitable. Did you catch that....they GAVE it to me, no charge! It only took them less than 30 minutes to get me in and out that morning. What could have really put a hitch in our camping plans was barely a hiccup thanks to Les Schwab!
I was equally pleased this morning. The shop was busy but the front end folks were quick and efficient and still quite friendly! I was in and out in under 20 min. They plugged the hole left by a small nail and again didn't charge me! I hate the tires that came with the Forrester when I purchased it and as soon as they are worn enough to replace I bet you can guess who will get my business!! Fantastic job, Les Schwab! You have a loyal customer for life!!

Had a great experience with Dr. Mark Schwendiman -- he is efficient and thorough, yet takes the time to explain and answer questions. I went to him after watching him on an excellent follow-up with my husband (who had blue light treatment).
The new location is really nice. Very clean and the rolls were delicious! Great service.

In the military we don't really get taken care of when it comes to our medical health. This is not the case with Ada West Dermatology. High professional and very courteous. The staff was very inviting and friendly as well as making my experience with them better then what I hoped it would be. With my military time frame the staff was able to work me into the schedule with no problems thus giving me the freedom of having my procedure done in a very timely fashion. I highly recommend them in the future for your personal needs. Thank you so much for take the time to care for my needs.

An excellent church, filled with great people. They have a kids ministry that provides the kids with great Bible preaching, and goes from newborn all the way through 5th grade, so the parents can actually sit under the solid biblical preaching and not be interrupted every 5 seconds with their kiddos. I love calling Compass my home church.
Excellent food, large menu, food portions are huge! Great ambience, clean facility, and friendly servers.

This place was recommended by the salesman at Kendall Ford for Finger Steaks. They were pretty good. Reminded me of gator bites without the kick. Kind of like chicken fried steak bites.

The place was open with a good assortment of TVs with sporting channels on. Also they have an outdoor eating area that is pet friendly.
How can you not love ICCU?  I have been a member for a long time.  Never one complaint.  Excellent customer service, friendly and always helpful.

Went there to take advantage of their Veteran's Day deal.  We used to enjoy going to Red Robin, but this trip was not like previous times. It took over 30 minutes to get our meals, which included cold fries, a Black and Blue burger that was more blackened than blue, and smaller than I remember, and finally a Red's Tavern Double that could have doubled as a cold fast food value meal burger. I asked for more fries, and  they came out cold and flavorless.  If I would have paid for the Tavern burger, I would have given an even lower score.
Best in town they get pretty busy but worth the weight. I drive all the way from Boise 20 min each way just for there food!

Chris has taken super good care of us several times when shopping for a toy hauler and a class C RV. He's very knowledgeable and easy to work with. I shopped at multiple dealerships and Bish's was the easiest to work with and definitely the most professional. I didn't feel pressured or forced to make instant decisions like I did everywhere else. And following an unfortunate change in events, Bish's took care of us without any difficulty. They have definitely earned my business back.

Went for dinner and was pleasantly surprised.  I wasn't expecting much after checking reviews online.  When we walked in we didn't get greeted right away even though there were 4 people standing to greet us, they were taking and didn't make eye contact right away it was awkward.  Looking around I get what others say about it not being very pleasing to the eye inside.  Not a big deal to me if service and food is good.  Our waiter ended up being very friendly and he was fairly attentive.  I got the special which was salmon on your choice of pasta with a red pepper cream sauce.  It was very good, probably one of the best pasta dishes Ive had in a while which was surprising.  I'd go back for sure and have the same meal.  If you can make it past the door and past the decor the food is really good.
Fabulous night, great food, great music by Tom Taylor. Food servings were huge wine was great. A true Gem in the city.
Everything was excellent and our server was very entertaining!  It can be a little noisy when families are dining, so if you like things quieter, it might be best to go later in the evening.

I would give this place three stars for the food and 5 stars for the friendly helpful staff. 

Seated promptly with waters in front of us right away! They brought out complimentary Chinese "chips and salsa" while you wait for your order. We had the dinner for two for $26.00. It comes with choice of soup, appetizers and two main dishes. We thought that was a good way to try a few things for a decent price. 

We ordered the won ton and hot and sour soups. Both were nothing special. The broth in the won ton soup was different and tasted good but looked oily. The appetizers were both fried and not what we would normally order but we didn't have much options. Fried shrimp and spring roll. They were just okay and I wouldn't order them again. 

Our main dishes consisted of crispy broccoli and beef and Kung Pao chicken. We were told the Kung Pao was spicy but we didn't find it at all spicy. Even our daughter later that night who hates spicy food, gobbled up the leftovers with no problem. Both dishes lacked flavor and when eating them together, they really tasted similar with their sauces. I would also not recommend the upgrade for the fried rice. It was lacking in flavor as well and nothing special.

Overall we were not blown away but huge shout out to the staff for really being attentive and friendly.

This joint is always busy, so go early! Not much waiting room either, so be prepared to huddle or wait outside. They do provide coffee while you wait for your table and that's a huge bonus. The food is always good and there is plenty of it! My hubs and I have been a few times now and they are always short staffed, so while they try and hustle, service can be slow.

Delivery takes too long (usually quoted 1.5hrs!) and pick-up still takes 45min, but the pizza is wonderful. It is not nearly as "heavy" or greasy as Flying Pie but full of flavor!

Our favorites are the Cascade Chicken (chicken and mushrooms and tomatoes and green onions) and Robbie's Creek (no meat- just tomatoes and fresh garlic sauce and YUM). They have the garlic/olive oil style sauce which we love and even the veggie-suspicious kiddo happily eats both. 

Highly recommend! It's nice to sit there as well but it gets a bit crowded, and we tend to do pizza when we want to relax at home but not cook.
I love this place! Very tasty food no matter what I have ordered.  I look forward to many exciting meals in the future.

Seared USDA prime steaks and enough butter on the baked potato to make it just right.

Also plenty of less-expensive options. Au gratin potatoes are good. The aioli on the pork loin sandwich is awesome.

We had no issues with service or with being seated.

Give it a shot!

Didn't care for it, won't go back. I went here about a week ago and they had a good crowd on hand and all. The service was ok, but I thought my breakfast was just so-so. Mainly they put too much seasoning on the hash browns. And they don't need to put near that much on. In my honest opinion, I'd rather go to the Griddle, Le Peep, the Sunrise Cafe or any of the other breakfast restaurants in the region.

I was really looking forward to checking this place out so I went one day for lunch. They have good options for lunch. Good sized menu. I was greeted promptly but they didn't seem very interested in my business. I was in a hurry as I only have an hour for lunch and it took my entire hour to get my food so I ended up having to take it to go. They gave me a box with no utensils and no napkins and it took way too long I won't return if I'm in a hurry.

The portion sizes are good. I personally thought the food was very greasy. The hot peppers were still dry, they hadn't hydrated them before putting them into the meal so that was kind of weird. Crunchy chili peppers are not really my gig. The food was obviously not homemade. I was not impressed and forage farther afield for other Asian options.

Wonderful breakfast restaurant with a ton of options. Everything is made from scratch with high-quality ingredients. The coffee is great the service is even better! Favorite breakfast restaurant in the area!
I ordered a sandwich today for delivery. I am not kidding, I had the sandwich in hand 8 minutes later! The sandwich was awesome as always!

If you need a local bank this is the one for u. They always have convent location and anytime I have had to go inside the staff is super nice and happy to help in anyway they can. I really can't ask for anymore from a finacial institution then this. Glad we made a move to ICCU.

I love that they have different areas throughout that allow kids to play in creative ways.  I prefer this place over some of the other indoor play placesin the Treasure  Valley because kids don't get drained by one type of activity.  They can climb,  create,  relax and take a snack break. It can be a little crazy on Saturdays,  so weekday afternoons are perfect for us.

Traveling west we stopped for a much needed, high quality breakfast. This is the place for vegetarians, meat lovers and all around flavor. I ordered the special bacon-wrapped asparagus Florentine. So buttery and lemony hollandaise sauce!!! Husband ordered farmhouse hash.
While the food is your basic bar food, the cleanliness is getting worse every visit. I do not think this has ever been cleaned? It's the window by our table.
Absolute best dr appointment I've ever had and I'm 73 years old. From reception to dr himself, all very kind and professional. You need skin looked at, here's where you want to go.

Closed on Sundays. Pls update info!
Good pho. Had the duck pho. Would prob just get the beef next. Good broth. Quiet lil place. Looks clean. Will be back

Great place to stay! They have thought of everything. A little kitchenette and you can make your own meals. We shopped for some groceries and found it was reasonable to simply buy some of the items in their little convenience store. A gym with everything you need and not too small, huge indoor spa, and free laundry room. The bed is uncomfortable for me so I'm taking a star but once I got the right amount of pillows, I finally got some good rest. Would definitely stay again.

Service horrible. Ready to walk out. Been here for 10 mins without so much as a server visit. 
Do not come here. Worst RR I've been to

This is my favorite thrift store in the area.   There are lots of thrift stores, so that's saying a LOT!   Here's why it's so great:

- Very organized.  I love that they use big vinyl records to mark the sizes on the rows of clothing.  Very visible!
- Very reasonable prices and, if you regularly check their Facebook page, they have specials fairly regularly.
- Big store with lots of selection.
- Generous shopping hours.

I also love that their income is used to help rescue, immunize, and spay/neuter needy animals.

The place smelled like stale water or almost sewage. It took 50 minutes to even start making our pizzas. There were 5 people hanging out in the bar area to include what seemed to be 2 managers but it wasn't easy to get service. Mushrooms were still raw on the pizza. It was good but still undercooked. Overall there were a lot of workers but also a lot of them standing around. I would not recommend it. You can get better pizza and service from Albertsons across the street.

I looked at RV's in three different states and countless dealers- from the 'big name' companies and many of the smaller ones as well. 

Bish's was head and shoulders above the rest. So much better it's hard to put into words...but I'm going to try and break it down from start to finish. 

Sales: Jesse was my sales guy, outfitter, whatever you want to call it. Incredibly friendly and knowledgable, and upfront about things in a way I hadn't seen anywhere else. I had a mile long list of questions and he took them all in stride and communicated constantly throughout the process. His patience with my lack of knowledge was extraordinary. Finally, he didn't make any attempts to jerk us around on the pricing- once again, he was upfront. Anyone thats spent time looking at window stickers, also knows they're nowhere near reality. We said that in order to buy, he needed to get us a price we *couldn't* walk away from- he went and delivered. 

Finance:  Mike made the finance process incredibly smooth. Did it with an appointment, and he took great care with our limited time. 

Parts:  Jeff (I think), is a godsend. He's the parts guy all other RV dealers wish they had, but don't. At the time of sale, he talked me out of a more expensive fifth wheel hitch and made the effort to get me something better and saved me several hundred bucks. Then, gave a TON of guidance on parts; particularly solar stuff. He's passionate about what he does and it was invaluable to us. 

Finally... the title girl, Cynthia. The person that tends to be invisible and quietly keeps the wheels turning. My title/tag situation (out of state) was an absolute NIGHTMARE. But EVERY time there was a problem, she was there to fix it. (Important note, the problem was the state of Florida, NOT Bish's). Her support long after the sale, and long after most dealers would continue to assist was truly remarkable. She delivered in a stunning fashion- I don't think I've ever met someone so willing to help me. Ever. We're talking lifetime here. If she ever needs a cheerleader, she's damn sure got one here!

And finally, we had a problem on our way home with a window. Called, and they referred us to a different Bish's. Maintenance guys were expecting us when we pulled up, and we were back on the road an hour after calling, and a half hour from the time we rolled into the parking lot. 

Overall I had a fabulous experience with Bish's and am 100% happy we chose to make our purchase here rather than someone else.
Ordered a bunch of food to go and it was delicious! Best Chinese food I've had in years.

What I love about Intermountain is they almost always have a cabin available for our two mini Schnauzer fur babies.   Both of them don't seem to mind going to the lodge and sharing a cabin.  Great way to give us all a vacation.  Prices are reasonable and the staff are nice.  Super gentle vet care with less stress for all.

River City Vet Hospital is top notch! We are so happy with the care and quality service we have recently received. The entire staff is professional, honest and kind. Our dog just had surgery to remove a benign lump on her stomach, as well as get spayed, and she was seen by Dr. Cuthbert. We were extremely pleased in her bedside manner with us and our pup, as well as from her vet techs. The staff at the reception counter are also very efficient and helpful. Pricing is also very reasonable and we love that they are open 7 days a week with evening hours as well. Their staff also called us to check in on Lux's recovery progress and to make sure everything is going smooth. I highly recommend River City Vet Hospital and Dr. Cuthbert!

The experience was not totally satisfactory. I requested a color chocolate-burgundy or similar, and the final result was black-black-black!! The cut was good but not excellent. I spent 100 USD for something I did not like. My appointment was at 6pm, my request was very simple, cut and simple color. I think that the stylists or employees are very desperate to end their work day early. Therefore, I recommend do not to have schedules or last appointments at 6 pm, and so provide better service with higher quality in the times that are best for you.

Outstanding breakfast spot. Their breakfast potatoes are great, I had the chorizo fritatta, one of the best breakfast meals I've ever had. Service was fast and friendly, and they kept my coffee cup filled.

I love the staff and doctors at Intermountain Pet Hospital. My pooch is always in great hands there. The vets and staff are very patient with scared sensitive pooches like mine. However, they take their time and get him the proper care he needs every time without pushing him to fast when he's scared. They give him loves, treats, and patience.

On the other side of things is the Pet Daycamp...my dog loves it there! They send you pics every day and I trust that he's in good hands every time he goes.

We enjoyed the food however the cleanliness of the establishment needs to be addressed. Also some of the items came out to us lukewarm although we were one of 3 parties total in the restaurant. We would love to make this one of our regulars but please, clean the floors, dust everything, clean the menus, even the walls had sticky mess on them.
BUZZ was the best, sat in the bar for lunch- great service- quality food- will definitely be back

3 of us went to the Meridian Johnny Carinos tonight. First we received our salads. Took 10 minutes to find someone to ask for silverware. Then 1hr and 30 min later we received our food. My husband ordered Ravioli with tomato sauce and meat balls, he received cheese ravioli with a cup of meat sauce to put on it. My son ordered bow tie festival with no onions, he received a lot of onions. I ordered baked tortellini with Alfredo sauce , I received meat sauce. My husband ate his but we did not touch ours. They never offered to make us the correct food. They did ask if I wanted Alfredo sauce to pour on top of my meat sauce, really?? They then bring me a bill with everything on it. Once I pointed out that all 3 of our meals were wrong they didn't make us pay but really??? This is the 4th time this year we have had a bad experience but 1st time I haven't had to pay and 1st review I have ever written. Will not be going back!!

Love this place!!! I'm never up early enough and ready in time to go there. When we do Actually go there, they are so busy that we usually just don't wait. The lines are way long! And for good reason! But my two little ones love this place and we keep trying. Today was a great day!! Was headed somewhere else and that place was close and looked across the street and saw that there was hardly cars in the parking lot. Fifteen minutes to closing. Tick tock tick tock. I decided to just try my luck and go in and ask if they were still seating customers. Mind you...I normally don't do this because it's close to closing and I know most small restaurants don't like that. The manager said YES!!! So happy and glad they did! It was a mommy/daughter(s) day for me. I am so thankful to them AND I got brownie points with my girls!! Thank you!!!!!

I ordered a tuna fish sandwich, chips and a drink for delivery tonight and it came to $12 and change (incl $1 tip). There were maybe 4 tablespoons of tuna fish on the 8 inch sandwich. Seriously, I could not taste the tuna one bit. Next time, it's Hugo's or Cobby's for sure!!!

I eat at JB's about 2or3  times a month. I love their buffet breakfast and their dinner. JB's breakfast buffet is really good. It has an assortment of everything I like and for dinner I usually get the Fish and Chips which is very good. Overall this is one of my favorite places to eat out.

Just had our master bath converted from tub/shower to walk-in shower. Re-Bath made the entire process easy and stress free. Salesman Neil was no-pressure, honest and easy to work with. Project was done exactly to our specifications. Cannot say enough about Casey and James, the installers. They were GREAT! Finished in record time, cleaned up all the (small) mess, and were courteous and pleasant. They were nice to our killer chihuahua - even though she wasn't very nice to them. Was Re-Bath the least expensive option? NO.....but you get what you pay for. We are very happy and our bathroom looks great.
Drive through was closed when me and my hood rat friends where hungry.... that ain't it chief

We've eaten at Grimaldi's several times and it's always been really good. However tonight we ordered through Doordash and the pizza was lukewarm (which is expected when getting takeout I suppose) but the worst part is a small piece was missing! I'm assuming it happened at Grimaldi's (unless our Doordash gal carries around a pizza cutter with her in the car). I will never order from here again. I should have gotten off my lazy butt and picked up fresh, hot, melty cheese pizzas from Guido's which is our normal go-to pizza joint. Also, it said free delivery, but apparently there's hidden costs. Not sure if the service fee is going to Doordash on top of their delivery (which said free), but $73 for 2 large pizzas seems a bit excessive, no?

This Rumbi is very clean, has excellent staff and I might add the best music selection around. I especially enjoy the reggae. The best meal has got to be the rice bowl with veggies and fish. Definitely recommend to all hungry travelers! Keep it up Rumbi!

I have now visited the Tavern five times (3 lunch and 2 dinners) and have enjoyed EVERY visit!! 

Food has been very good except for the pot roast nachos....unfortunately dry and tasteless. The halibut risotto special was fabulous! 

Service has always been good. My favorite server is Ashley by far!!! Professional, thorough, friendly!! She is the best!!!

Can't wait for the Tavern to accept reservations!!!! We often go elsewhere at night because we don't want to wait. Hurry up with those reservations please!!

I stopped in and they were busy. I needed my tires balanced and they asked if I could leave the tires and they would send me a text when they were ready. They were very courteous and took great care of me.

I was originally going to 2 star this location. Our first time in and we get sat and we wait 17 minutes before our waitress Trisha acknowledged us. When she finally comes over we make a comment about what took so long and she goes "I'm serving a big table"  I go to say well ask one of the 4 people standing around to get a drink order going, but before I have a chance to say anything she goes "do you want someone else to serve you" so I gladly took her up on her offer. She was beyond rude and snotty. Then Stacey becomes our server and she was great! She kept repeating how sorry she wAs and that the other lady was new. That's all fine and great, but attitude and respect isn't something made over night. Trisha was a snot, putting it lightly. The food is ok nothing to do cartwheels over. The Bloody Mary here though are AWESOME!! Perfect mix of sweet and spicy!! Stacey and the Bloody Mary are what makes this establishment more than a 2 star.

Due to numerous and severe food allergies it has been a long time since I ventured out to have pizza. Most often it is my soy allergy that keeps me eating at home and not in restaurants. While visiting friends in the Boise area, we met them for lunch at the Meridian Idaho Pizza. I had planned to visit while we were there but not to eat. However, the pizza smelled so good and I was unexpectedly hungry so I took a, usually foolish, chance and ate a piece. Delicious!  I waited a bit and tried another piece. I was pleasantly surprised when I had no allergic reaction whatsoever. None while at the restaurant and none later. Idaho Pizza, I don't know what ingredients are in your pizza dough and toppings, but Bravo!

Have never left a bad review before but this place deserves it! I was in a hurry and hungry so I thought I would give it a try. First off everything in this place is filthy dirty!!!! Disgusting, I stayed bc I was hungry and and thought to myself I'm not going to judge the food before I eat it. I should have gotten up at the point when I saw the wasabi and ginger that was going around and all the boats have been there so long that it had formed a dark green crust over most of it. When I asked for fresh wasabi and ginger he happily obliged by taking one of the little white plates on the boat that had the crust formed on them and handed it to me I ate two of the black plates one of which was something fried I had no idea what it was and it ended up being cold chicken and the other was a roll which was fine. I ordered the bonsai roll which turned out to be so disgusting I left most of it on my plate. I couldn't wait to leave and almost couldn't stand to touch the door because it was so dirty on my way out. I'm crossing my fingers I don't get sick!

Met a buddy for breakfast 9:30 AM Friday morning.  Was able to slip in and grab the last available table and within minutes people were waiting inside and outside, at least a dozen.  If people are willing to wait outside in 20+ degree weather this place must be good... 

My buddy was late so I had plenty of time to peruse Yelp reviews and tips... now I was getting jazzed.

Cindy, our waitress was top-notch, extremely friendly and kept that much needed coffee cup full with steaming hot liquid of life.

I followed the advice of a fellow Yelpet and substituted toast for Cinnamon Roll French Toast for an additional $2, so worth it!

Will drop in again...

New sushi place in town?   $1 sushi boats!   We had to try it out immediately, so Dad & I had a late lunch at their Grand Opening.

We got there around 1, and all the boats were empty.   It's OK, we don't mind waiting for a good thing.   There were three sushi chefs in the peninsula surrounded by the boats, and they got cranking!

The chefs asked what each diner liked, and made sushi accordingly.  Some they handed right to us, and others they placed on the boats.  In addition to sushi, $1 items also included seaweed salad and tako (octopus) salad.   For those not into the 'boat' offerings, they have a full menu.

Service was very good on our first visit.  My soda was kept full.

Subsequent visits have left us disappointed.   Their service has gone downhill, and they've been out of various items like seaweed salad, out of tako salad, etc.   Guess we'll keep getting our dollar sushi at Sakana or hitting the AYCE spots Yoi Tomo or IOU.
Food and service was good,  but why does everything have to be sooo salty.  The miso soup was too salty

I got a flat tire yesterday after all tire shops had already closed so this morning I went to Les Schwab to get the tire patched on my way to work. I showed up 5 min before they opened and the mechanic, I believe his name was Skylar, came to my car door a minute before opening to help me. He asked me how long I had before I needed to leave for work, I told him 20 minutes and I was in and out in less than 15 minutes. I got a quote for all season tires for my other vehicle and the service representative and the mechanic were both awesome! There was no charge to patch my tire because they were able to fix it! I've never heard of not getting charged before. I will be back soon for new tires on my other vehicle and for future oil changes! Thanks for the quick and professional customer service!

The food was great !  The service was terrible
We ordered appetizer - never received it 
The wait for our meal was too long -they served fried chips until our food came.
When the food did come - it was tasty and hot 
They didn't bring us our utensils to eat with until we had to get up and ask.   Service is not the best - sad.  The restroom had no paper towels ..
Sweeping the floor as we were eating - won't go back - three different people brought things to our table - didn't know who was our waitress.
Thanks but not going back !

Poor Community involvement!
I have always enjoyed Idaho Pizza Company, but when I tried to set up a visit/tour for a local girls group, I was totally ignored.  I called and left over 4 messages for the manager in charge of such an event, and was repeatedly told he wasn't available.  When I asked for his schedule so that I could call back at a better time, not one of the people I spoke with could tell me his schedule.  I finally called when this manager was on site and working.  I was told to call after the lunch rush, which I understand, so I complied to calling at the time requested by the employee.  When I called back, the same employee told me that this manager was busy with a report and didn't want to take my call.  WHAT???  If I was the general manager, or owner of the Fairview location and new this person was refusing to talk with a local group to build a positive image of the brand.  I would question his decision making and business acumen.

Update: Once I was able to get in contact with corporate, setting up a field trip was a simple and enjoyable process.  I did have to change to a different location to accommodate my needs, but that didn't effect my experience.  I appreciate the care that was taken to ensure my positive perception of this business.
Visited for the first time. This is an amazing Italian restaurant. I definitely recommend the pesto gnocchi with shrimp.

My family is so grateful to have this new church in the Treasure Valley! The pastor and his family are so kind and everyone else is warm and welcoming. We love the high view of God displayed through the expository preaching and we cannot wait to see how God will grow our faith and our family through this church!

The best breakfast in Boise. Hands down.
Nothing comes close to the quality and quantity of food you get at Moe Joe's. I highly recommend any of their hash. They are huge and every single one is good. My personal favorite is the smokehouse.

Camp bow wow is amazing! The staff is always so friendly and welcomes our dog by his name when we walk in. We occasionally leave him for day care and he is always exhausted when we pick him up! When we board him, they even brushed him every other day for us! They offer many services including baths and nail trims. You can also watch your pups from the app on your phone while you are on vacation, it's awesome! Would definitely recommend

After having lived in the South for a while, I learned to really appreciate really Southern BBQ.  There are a few BBQ places in Boise and I think I have tried them all.  Famous Dave's comes in at second to the Roadhouse off of State Street.  The atmosphere is very southern when you walk in, but it's very loud in there.  Between the loud music over the speakers and the banging sounds coming from the kitchen, it makes it a little hard to enjoy your meal.  The meal all in all, wasn't bad, but it definitely wasn't the 'bama cooking I was used to.  The Sweet Tea is to die for.  I got my order to go and the employee taking my order didn't know they had sweet tea.  She thought all they had was iced tea.  If you are going to work at a BBQ restaurant, management needs to make sure their employees completely understand was southern cooking and drinks are all about.  I will definitely be going back to try one of their bbq baked potatoes though!!

We're new to the area, and have two Australian Shepherds, both adults and both with issues. The older one has severe anxiety, and doesn't trust anyone. The other one is a rescue, who is deaf and visually impaired. 
Everyone at River City Vet was so nice, warm and welcoming.  Each staff member not only greeted me, but the dogs as well.
Both the vet tech and Dr Puckett took the time to sit on the floor with our dogs, throughout the entire exam.
I have to say, their initial exam was by far the most thorough exam any of my pets have ever had.
There were fresh water bowls and treats in various areas of the office, even coffee and water for us pet parents.
Both dogs did so well, they ended staying for a few hours at the doggie daycare...which they loved! 
And to top it all off, I received a phone call from the vet the next morning asking how each of the dogs was doing (they had shots, blood work, etc).
Highly recommend bringing your fur-kids here.
Traveling through the area and had the best breakfast ever! Eggs Benedict cooked perfectly, sauce is generous and tasty and the mojo potatoes were wonderful! Can't wait to come back here#
After I wrote my review the district manager Kasey called and they took care of us and all the issues that we had.  We are very grateful for the amaing customer serivce that he showed us!

Today I saw Dr. Gregory Wells. He, the resident he was training, and assistant, were very thorough and professional. The office staff was efficient and I had a very short wait in the waiting room, and exam room. Very time efficient. My experience was great, and I would highly recommend Ada West Dermatology.

Grimaldi's is one of the newborn eateries located within The Village at Meridian, and the inexperience shows -- mostly in the service -- not in the lack of it, but to the point of being over bearing.

When you step into the inviting doorway of the grossly over staffed Grimaldi's, expect to be greeted by a warm, masculine decor and at least 6 or 7 eager-to-please teenagers in a glorious chorus of "welcome to Grimaldi's" at the reception desk. 

No worries though; one of them will quickly take the reigns and escort you to your table, all the while chatting up a storm not loud enough to hear through the ambient noise of the restaurant. "[Something, something] here before? [Something] Grimaldi's [something, something, something] brick oven [something, something]..."

As you walk past the 10 pizza makers, all awaiting their turn to use the oven, and doing all you can to make sense of it all, your journey may remind you of helplessly sitting in the back seat of a SUV, while watching the driver navigate the narrow and winding road. Yet somehow, there's a level of trust that your safe arrival is imminent.

You are now seated. Unscathed.

"...[something, something] wine, beer [something]... your server will be with you momentarily."

Enter the server (stage right). Enter your selective hearing (stage left).

"Hi, my name is [Something, something] first time here? [something] Grimaldi's [something, something, something] brick oven [something, something] wine, beer, pizza, salads [something] may I get you started with something to drink?"

Now from this point out, count on your server (poor kid, whose first food service job is this one) and the other service staff (bless their hearts) to visit your table an ungodly amount of times.

All combined, this is what you have in store. They will bring your beverages, take your order, bring your appetizers or salads, ask if you want freshly cracked pepper, check to ensure that you're enjoying your meal (all standard practice for the most part, I know; it gets better though)... 

(Let the "ask" kicking commence.)

...ask permission to refill drinks, ask you again how your appetizer tastes, ask to make sure you're okay, ask to clear some plates, bring out your pizza, ask if this is the right table for this order (yes, it is.. praise the Lord), ask how the pizza tastes even though you haven't touched it as you wait for it to cool off, ask how it tastes now that you're actually eating it (amazingly, like a pretty decent brick oven pizza and not air, as you had originally tasted), ask if you want a refill on a drink that wasn't touched since they last refilled it, (holy run-on sentence, Batman), ask if you want garlic and/or oregano as pizza condiments now that you're more than halfway finished, (no matter how much you avoid eye contact) ask to refill your drink again, ask if you want dessert (no, thank you), ask how you're doing, ask if the meal was enjoyable, ask if you (finally) want your check, bring you the check, ask you if you would consider filling out a customer satisfaction survey, ask if would consider joining a newsletter, collect and process your payment, ask you to have a wonderful evening. 

This is where you will need to hop the fence, make your escape and be grateful that, though you were nearly asked to death, you made it out alive!

Yes, folks. Over a dozen visits (I actually stopped counting after 15) to one table in a single seating is a little excessive, don't you think? They're obviously taking the approach of mass-training their staff at the moment, but I surmise that labor costs will quickly catch up to them and that ship will eventually be righted.

Now in the midst of all of this, there is a bit of good news. I think. 

The antipasto appetizer was acceptable, and though I've had authentically better brick oven pizza in the past (2400 miles away, in Virginia), I would happily consume a Grimaldi's pizza again.

However.

My recommendation? (Don't ask.) Given the current circumstances, I highly suggest waiting to go there. And hopefully, by the end of August, back-to-school, a better trained staff, and an ideal (lower) number of workers on-hand will coincide with an overall more pleasurable dining experience.

Ate here for the first time today. we ordered a large pizza and decided to order half of  "the Don" and half  "garden" pizza.  we had no idea that we were going to pay $10 extra because we did 1/2 and 1/2.  The Don was the most expensive pizza at $25, the Garden was $23.  Instead of doing the right thing and just charging $25 for a whole pizza, they charged us $23 Plus $10 in toppings that the Don has on them. WTH.  $33 for a pizza that should be no more than $25 is just insane.  We tried to explain to the waiter that makes no sense and they refused to change the bill.  Pizza was decent, but not the best.  We won't be back.

Poor Community involvement!
I have always enjoyed Idaho Pizza Company, but when I tried to set up a visit/tour for a local girls group, I was totally ignored.  I called and left over 4 messages for the manager in charge of such an event, and was repeatedly told he wasn't available.  When I asked for his schedule so that I could call back at a better time, not one of the people I spoke with could tell me his schedule.  I finally called when this manager was on site and working and was told to call after the lunch rush, which I understand so I complied to calling at the time requested by the employee.  When I called back, the same employee told me that this manager was busy with a report and didn't want to take my call.  WHAT???  If I was the general manager, or owner of the Fairview location and knew this person was refusing to talk with a local group to build a positive image of the brand.  I would question his decision making and business acumen.

*This review is a little late but I really wanted to write it, to thank Johnny Carino's...so here it is. 
My husband and I got married back in January. Due to life's speed bumps, we only had a week to plan and execute our wedding (which included 30 guests). It was stressful...but the staff at Johnny Carino's made it a little easier for me. They were so kind and patient with my requests. I have to say that I always expect the experience of delivered food to be lesser in some way, but the food was DELICIOUS!! 
Bonus points: I am lactose intolerant, which always makes eating out a bit frustrating because the only safe bet on a restaurant menu is usually a salad...but they had really tasty, dairy free options that I could enjoy. 
Thanks again Johnny Carino's, for making my special day a little more enjoyable!
Pretty gross when you open the ranch to put on your taco salad and there are 2 hairs in the container just staring at you. This place is unsanitary and disgusting. Sick.

I have been looking for a camper since January of this year. Visited every Jayco dealership within 100 miles of my home here in Phoenix. After dealing with snobby salesman, i prompltly decided i'd rather buy a lightly used Jayco from a private party. After months of searching, i decided to browse the internet one more time, in hope of finally finding a camper. Low and behold, i came across the exact model i was looking for. This meant driving 1,000 miles to Meridian, Idaho and let me tell you, it was WELL WORTH IT. Paul Casteros was awesome to work with. He made the buying process very easy and stress free. There were a few hiccups with the camper that were out of their control, but Paul and his manager Chris did not hesitate to make it right. I HIGHLY recommend Bish's RV and have already refeffed two people to them. Other dealerships could learn a thing or two from their customer service. Thank you guys for making my buying experience one to remember!

This is my parent's favorite place to eat! We normally get the family feast which comes with a ton of food at a pretty fair price. The meat on the ribs literally falls off the bones it's so tender. My mom normally doesn't like ribs, but this is one of her favorite dishes. We tried the spicy Mac & cheese for the first time and it was one of my favorite dishes. The cornbread muffins are to die for. Extremely quick service & we can bring the bones home for the dogs. The wet wipes brought at the end of the meal are a plus too.

We waited for almost an hour for our food to start coming out. There was a 20 minute difference between the time out first meal and last meal were delivered. So, by the time my husband received his food everyone else was finished eating. Our side dish of Kimchee was never delivered however they tried to charge us for it. As we left the servers were asking people to come back later because the kitchen was so far behind. Overall the food wasn't too bad but the portions were small for the price. I doubt I'll give this place another try.
Food was not good at all. The eggplant parmesan was soggy and the marinara sauce tasted citrusy. The hostess also did not smell good either. We will not be coming back here.
Closed. They might want to update their web page and fb page instead of wasting time looking forward for their food.

Love the job Curtis and Eli of Re-Bath did on our tub. Our old one was cracked and discolored. When we ordered our bathtub and surrounds we were told it would take up to 6 weeks. It only took a little over 3! They came this morning and finished by noon! Fast, reliable and great service.  We won't hesitate to call them again.
Drive through was closed when me and my hood rat friends were hungry.... that ain't it

I can't speak for the entire chain, but this particular establishment is not one I would recommend. I waited entirely too long for curbside pickup, only to find that my food had been cooling in a bag by the glass door since before I arrived. I was told they didn't see my car, despite being parked in the curbside pickup parking immediately outside that same door. 

I asked if they would be willing to re-make the food fresh, given the long and avoidable delay, and they said it shouldn't be necessary. I explained that 30 minutes in a box isn't kind to nachos and one of the staff wordlessly and without eye contact snatched the bag and wandered off to the kitchen with it. I asked the remaining staff present whether he was going to re-make the food, reheat it, or what...and how long I should expect to wait for this. They didn't have an answer. Rather than roll my dice on a grumpy employee unwilling to communicate his plans, I drove to a nearby establishment that I know I could trust to provide quality eats without the mistakes, excuses, and grumpy demeanor.

I even tried calling to provide some more detailed feedback to a manager, but after an overly long wait on the telephone, I gave up on that as well. Thank you, Meridian Johnny Carino's, you've spoiled my good memories of eating here over the years. Too many other restaurants doing it right - I won't be back.

Went in tonight a little after 8 and our group of 5 was seated near the back of the restaurant.  There were several other groups seated around us, so we weren't hidden.  We walked out 20 minutes later, and the staff (who had been standing around near the bar area) just watched us go.  We never even got water.  Terrible service.  There was one waiter taking care of the other tables, and he was very busy.  No one was helping him... they were all too busy standing around.

Thank you to Dr. Brett Bingham and staff at Intermountain veterinary Hospital On Overlund Road in Meridian Idaho for treating and saving our little leo. They made time for A special procedure and were able to remove a huge cheat grass seed out of one of his lungs. Any further wait could have caused major complications. We will refer Intermountain veterinary hospital and Dr. Brett Bingham and staff to all of our friends and fellow dog owners. What a find!

They KEEP cancelling these damn Uber Eats orders and ENOUGH is ENOUGH I've had it. If this problem doesn't get fixed oh my lord will i just be such an upset person like at this point are you even trying to compete with Olive Garden?!?

Every time we come here, we really have a great great time and food and delicious wine, specially on Tuesday that any selection of wine, is half price and as a result, it makes amazing the experience at Grimaldi's. I highly recommend it !!:)

Always great. Can't get enough. Every time I go I am so impressed with the quality and originality in their food. Staff is great and welcoming. we're always recommend and we'll go back and back and back
We had a significant awning issue develop on the fwy.  Walked into the service dept on a busy Memorial weekend Day. They had us back on the road in 15 minutes. These guys are quality professionals!

Very busy spot, means locals are willing to wait for a good meal. The best breakfast food!!!! Omg ordered the pigfarmer, farmers bowl, huevos rancheros, bta benedict and the pancake flight with donut & joe, blueberry muffin and lemon poppyseed.
We loved everything. The menu was difficult to manage because everything looked so good. Portions were huge so sharing is recommended. 

Best pancakes were : lemon poppyseed (mom &dads choice) & donut hole coffee (kids choice).
I loved the flavors in the families plates but preferred the pig-farmer plate. 

The biscuits are not the traditional round biscuit. They are huge squares and the 1/2 order of biscuits &gravy is huge and shareable. 
The wait staff was super  friendly and attentive. Food came relatively fast considering how busy it was. We will definitely be back.
Everybody loved what they ordered and had no plate envy. So that being said, it it looks and sounds good to you, odds are you will not be disappointed!!!
Bon apetite!

Great tasting coffee! I recommend only using their drive thru. My main complaint with this location is that if you order from inside the store, they take a really long time to give you your coffee. I counted at least 5 cars pass through the drive thru while I stood there waiting today.

Very discouraged with the Meridian Red Robin. We have dined at Red Robin's in New England  & No. California. This specific "Robin" comes with poor Service, servers who don't care  and a "Management Team" second to everyone  ! 
Be a long time before we return,  if ever !

Moe Joe's is a surprisingly delightful little breakfast place in Treasure Valley. The seating area is not very large- but don't let that fool you! They come through with serious flavor and quality in their food. My party of 4 ordered the Smokehouse Hash, Loaded Hash, French Toast, and I tried the Farmhouse Specialty. Everyone was happy with their food. The Farmhouse was a grilled biscuit (crunchy and a little tart- really good!), sausage patty, cheddar cheese, eggs and gravy. The gravy was the perfect thickness and saltiness. The house potatoes were also pretty good. 

I think this is the best breakfast I've had in the treasure valley. Very impressed with their food!

The waitress: 5 stars
