The Ambiance: 5 stars
The wait time for the pizza: 1 star (waited 30-40 min on a non busy afternoon)
The pizza: 1 star. Very thin crust. Like a hard cracker. Good if you like that kind of thing. Too thin and tough for us and tasted like it could have been cooked from frozen

We have been looking for a new veterinarian since we moved to Eagle and had the very good fortune of meeting Dr. Fineman at Paramount Animal Care. I cannot say enough about this very talented and caring doctor. He's extremely knowledgeable about recent developments in treatment and will never treat your pet using cookie cutter methods.  His diagnoses are accurate and based on sound medical evidence and he will not prescribe medications with out thoroughly explaining interactions or side effects.  He also LISTENS. Dr. Fineman suggested a new Rx for our dog's chronic issues that no one ever mentioned before. He most definitely puts quality health care above the profit motive...can't say that for all the vets we've had in the past!
The staff members at PAC are also very kind, considerate, and professional. I've had so many negative experiences at doctors offices, with surly front office staff, that I will no longer frequent those businesses. At PAC you will find the most friendly and courteous staff who go out of their way to make your pet comfortable and welcomed. We've dealt mostly with Sarah, Mariah, and Cheryl....all exceptionally talented!  Cheryl was even able to trim the nails of our one pup who does not like his feet touched.  He was so calm when he came back to the waiting room and I was in awe.
Dr. Fineman is also very involved in various animal rescue groups and organizations. He even took in a little kitty who someone heartlessly tossed in a dumpster and found a new home for the adorable boy! We feel so fortunate to have Dr. Fineman and his staff in charge of our critters' care.

Beautiful restaurant! Met up for a late lunch on Saturday. The place was fairly full but still open seating. Booths are comfortable. Sat near the bar. Three tv's had games playing and we were happy!! 

Had a couple good burgers. They are about 1/3 lb patties. Cooked to medium as we requested and well seasoned. The BBQ bacon burger had crispy onion strings and gave the burger a nice crunch. My son had the jalapeño burger. It had a lot of raw jalapeño on it. Prime Rib sandwich looked great too. They have a nice menu with many options...but not too many. 

We will be going back!!

Sure Boise offers up several Italian restaurants to choose from, each with an event of authenticity. But what if there were somewhere that had more than an element. What if they were the WHOLE package of Italian cuisine?! Gino's is it. A brief two weeks in Italy has yielded an insatiable craving for the fresh pastas, breads, and of course, wines of the countryside. It is with this in mind that I can confirm that Gino's is different from any other regional Italian restaurant.

Had lunch today here. Good Italian food. Loved the warm bread they serve with the meals. Wonderful chewy texture. Salad was crisp, fresh and served refrigerator cold. Pasta was nicely cooked. Sauces complimented the dish. Had the tortelloni. Nice and cheesy.

Ordered family parmesan plater through Uber Eats.  It was completely burnt to a crisp and there was no bread or oil.  Called the restaurant and they said it was Uber's fault?? They did say if we drove to the restaurant they would make us a new player.  Really!!

My son and I dined at Wingers in Meridian, Idaho.
We definitely got a great value in the amount of food for the price, with plenty of take home leftovers to spare.  
We had the boneless chicken breast strips in buffalo sauce and also honey habanero rub with ranch dressing, which was a taste sensation, with a sampling of various dip sauces like Thai Basil, original house recipe, and bourbon bbq.  Our Server, Claire, was outstanding, very attentive, knowledgeable about the menu choices with good suggestions, and friendly, always checking in on us.  We were visitors from out of state, and this was an excellent experience, tasty food, abundant servings, with warm hospitality.
Very good flavorful food. Good atmosphere. Good service. Liked the paintings on their wall. Wish the spicy stir fried came with vegetables but still very delicious. Will come back again.

Have to say service was ok but pizza was bland.  You know there's an issue when they bring peppers, garlic powder and herbs to put in your pizza.  I always thought a pizza comes ready seasoned but I guess I'm wrong.  What threw me was when the table left next to us they took out a card and scraped everything onto the floor and set the table again.  Didn't wipe down and didn't sweep up the floor just set it up and sat another couple.  Was very shocked and wouldn't go back.

I would give this place a zero star if possible. The understaffing is at an all time high. It's our fault really, we have been here with several of our friends three times in as many months.  Each time the service is horrible, friendly, but really bad.  We wait so long for our meals, it does not taste good, we are ignored constantly, and it's just an overall bad experience.  I would not recommend this place to anyone, we certainly will not give them anymore chances or be back.  Too bad :(

The food was OK, not the best Italian I've eaten but I am in Boise. I think what I was most frustrated by us that we were charged when we asked for extra bread with our meal. When have you ever had an Italian restaurant been charged for extra bread when it tends to be a mainstay of Italian meals?

Wonderful Jimmy Johns location! They have a very fast drive thru window and they also deliver. Most of the time the service is very fast, it's rare that it takes longer than 30 minutes for delivery. Fresh meat, cheese, veggies and the bread is like none I've had before.

I contacted these guys to do my dogs' nails after having them "groomed" at another vet the previous week. The groomer didn't do my dogs' paws or nails and these guys are close to me so I called them. 

They were able to get me in the same day and suggested I get one of my dogs' nails done every two weeks until the quicks were grown backwards a bit. They were quick and efficient. 

When I went in, the atmosphere was frazzled, like everyone was just slightly overworked. Maybe they were overbooked. I didn't get warm fuzzies. Don't get me wrong, they weren't unfriendly at all. They just weren't as welcoming as the other vet I'd gone to. 

Apparently they needed my dogs' vaccination records for baths (?!) Since we just moved here from out of state, we didn't have everything unpacked yet and our lame vet from back home didn't have us in their system. So we had to skip the baths. Bummer.

They were quick and efficient and got us in and out fast. From the time we checked in to the time we were all done, it was about 10 minutes - not too shabby considering it was 2 dogs. 

One star off for pricing. It was $38 plus tip for both dog nail trims. I later found out there is a place in Eagle that will do it for $10. $38 is ridiculously steep for a nail trim. I spend a lot of money on my dogs and I don't mind doing so at all but I don't lose sight of what's reasonable - and this price wasn't really reasonable. 

Despite the good points here, I won't be coming back because of the pricing. Some people are fine with it, but I just don't see how they can justify that, especially considering grooming isn't their primary function or money maker. There are people who accept it and that's totally cool! I just don't happen to be one of them.

Recently visited on a weeknight around 6ish. The place was about 25% full. We were seated immediately. Then the waiting began... It was hard to tell who our server was. Several looked at us as they walked by but none cared to take a moment to check on us. We sat, waterless, with only our menus for 15 minutes before even getting our first visit from our server. (I started keeping track after 5 minutes because it was getting pretty annoying)  He did apologize saying he was busy. We gave him our entire order, as we had ample time to look at the menu, and off he went. Took him about another 10 minutes to come back with our drinks. Again, the restaurant was not very full and there were plenty of staff on the clock. It was about an hour from the time we sat down to getting our food. The server apologized again and thanked us for our patience. He then said he would talk with the manager to see if he would comp part of our meal. 
The manager came by and said," I heard you had a bit of a wait for your meal." 
To which I said," Yea, it has been quite a slow experience in general." 
He then asked," Was the food worth the wait?" 
I replied,"It's pretty good."
Then he said,"Okay," smiled and walked away.
Here is where I have the biggest issue. I have quite a few years of experience as a server. I know people have "off nights" and things just don't seem to go your way or you have a high maintenance table. I'm pretty forgiving when it comes to servers. When a server asks a manager to comp a table because he messed up, it is the manager's responsibility to redeem the experience for the guests. This manager showed his true priorities in that moment. Had we chosen to cause a scene and make a big deal out of it we probably would've been comped. However, guests should not have to resort to such tactics. A manager should simply own up to the mistake and do what needs to be done to compensate. Instead, he chose to save the company a few dollars over taking care of his guests.
The only redeeming quality of the evening was the food. I ordered a pesto ravioli which was quite good and my friend got a spicy alfredo pasta which she enjoyed as well. We were considering desert until the experience with the manager.

I will not be returning...

Just had an amazing lunch at The Tavern. Service was great (thanks Shannon), as was our meal. Two people recommended the Beef Dip, and it didn't disappoint. I had the Carne Asada Salad. At first glance I thought the meat was over done, but if it was, the flavor made up for it. It was so good that I pretty much ate it without dressing. And did I mention tons of meat!  Can't wait to go back for dinner!  About time we got a nice restaurant in this area.

Love Love Love this place - the food is delicious! 
Service can be a bit delayed but it's expected as popular as they get.

Unlike the other reviewer I've consistently had a great experience with Pristine Pools I think you just need to talk to the right people.

I had two severe Algae blooms in my pool within a month, I was so frustrated I was ready to give up and take down our above ground pool completely.   I was trying to solve the problem myself and wandering around walmarts pool section I was so discouraged...  It looked like I was going to need to spend $100's of dollars on chemicals to not only clear up the problem but keep it from coming back again.

I took a chance and called pristine pools, the salesman I talked to said to bring in a water sample and they would test it for free.   I went down and both their pool techs were on call, he talked to me for a few about my problem but he admitted he was no expert.  He got one of the techs on the phone and we chatted for a minute while the tech was returning to the store.

Once the tech got in he tested my water and I told him about my problem.  At this point I was very discouraged and looking around the pristine store and how nice it is I was bracing for impact.  I thought for sure I was going to be told I had to buy $200 worth of chemicals and be way oversold to fix my problem.

I have to give a shout out here, Rory is fantastic.  I have an above ground intex pool and he has always treated me the same as someone with a 50,000 gallon in-ground waterpark.   He advised me to simply start over, drain the pool, bring him back a water sample and we would go from there!   I was shocked, I was seriously waiting for the bill..!  I felt like I had to buy something so I picked up two reusable filters which cost less then the paper one time use ones they sell at walmart.

I did as he said, emptied and refilled the pool then returned with a water sample.  Asking for Rory again as I'm starting to trust him he analyzes my water.  "Chlorine is low, PH is high." he says.  You need this and hands me a $8 bag of Acid PH reducer.  Use half the bag and bring me another sample.  

I go home and put in the amount he stated, waited 24 hours and take them back a sample.  He says "you're good to go."  I'm seriously concerned about having another bloom so I start asking a bunch of detailed questions about maintenance.  He never gets irritated with me, he explains a solid answer for every question and not once did he try to oversell me.  

I bought a testing kit so I could monitor my PH and Chlorine at home since he told me all I have to do is keep those levels within range and I'll cure my Algae problems.  He even wrote his cell number on the lid so if I have any more questions I can call anytime.

It's been about 3 weeks my pool is still crystal clear and all it cost me was $8+$10 + the filters which have already paid for themselves 5x's over compared to the walmart ones.  I'm so pleased with Pristine and Rory I felt compelled to share my experience and I will be going to solely Pristine for all my pool needs.

Great job!  A+

This place is the best breakfast ever! I'm not just saying that because I was hungry. Although I was. I had the egg Florentine and it was super good. It came with scallop potatoes. I got the full size and it was a lot! Which I was glad for. The taste is amazing. I also got some pancakes which were to die for. I tried my friends food and it was bomb too. The price is reasonable and the amount they give u is great.

Awful! Cold, stale, tasteless...just gross. I could keep going... But I think you get the point. We sampled tacos, burritos and the potato oles, which I thought were their claim to fame. Wow... It was all bad. Not even deserving of a second chance.
This is the best Chinese food I've had so far in Idaho! The service is great! They even had a menu in Chinese that our student from China could order from. I highly recommend going here!

I had high hopes for this place based on what the menu looked like. I ordered the orange chicken with rice and what I got was rice topped with the small baby sized chicken pieces (some were just fried breading balls). 

I often wonder what the person preparing the food was thinking "yes, this looks like a fine portion of minced chicken pieces, serve it up". 

I think if I was serving food I'd say "this looks awful, the person paid $9 buck, do it over". 

Oh well, I guess you gotta try something once. How I wish I would've gone next door to costa vida :( next time!
I live in the Bay Area and when I come to visit family here in Idaho, I never leave without coming here. The best pizza.
For those of you worried about the amount of business Ginos will get way out here, never fear.   The place is always busy.   Great food, great service.

We decided to go out to dinner tonight. My wife suggested we go somewhere new.  I yelped Eagle area restaurants, and the Tavern at Eagle Island came up. Having been to the Tavern at Bown a time or two, I suggested we try the new one. GREAT DECISION. Phenomenal Brussels Sprouts & Chorizo appetizer. Solid wine list--stuff you don't see everyday, for the most part--and perfectly prepared entrees (their specialty is prime beef of all cuts). Add attentive service (Ashley was awesome), and it's a total winner. We'll be back. Nice job on Day 1, team Tavern.
Wonderful food and service. The fruit that came with my breakfast was fresh and delicious. My eggs were cooked perfectly. This place is a hidden gem.
I walked into your sales room on 5/6/19, passed 4 employees, and no one said a word to me. I was going to buy a camper for my pickup.
Nice store, easy to get into and easy to get out of.

You'll want to order ahead for carry out or clear your evening for dine in but it is totally worth it! 

Generals chicken is amazing and I love that the chicken pieces are bite size not strips. The orange chicken sauce is the perfect blend of sweet and savory. These two dishes are rather similar and they always ask if we want to try something else lol  I love it. It's that extra kind of service that makes me tip 20% on a carry out order. 

Always friendly service and yes it does take a bit and yes they are pretty busy most days but dang it is totally worth it!

The food was incredible! It was very fresh and flavorful. We ordered the chicken pad thai, chicken satay, golden fried squid and fresh spring rolls. Our 19 month old abs 3 1/2 year old couldn't get enough of the pad thai. We ordered online for pick up to take back to our hotel. The whole process was quick and easy. We'll definitely eat here again the next time we're in Meridian.
The owner here is an absolute delight and a phenomenal chef. Will come back here indefinitely.

Right off the bat I will say that I am a fan. In case you didnt gather this from the star rating I gave them.

Guess what I have when I go to red Robin? yeah, you guessed it, a burger. Well, I did have the Fish and Chips a couple times.

So I will review some of the various things that I have had here. I did like the fish and chips here with an exception.

The exception is grease. They seem to be very hit and miss with this. Sometimes you can get their fish and chips and the grease is minimal. Sometimes you will get their fish and chips and can barely see the fish for the grease.

Ok, so maybe that is a bit of an over exaggeration, but sometimes you have to do these things to make a point. The point being that there was just way too much grease.

What I hate the most if when I complain to the server. Often what I get is; "Its fried. Grease is what happens when you fry things."

I even heard this from a manger once. A bit off the subject, but I hate these sorts of comments. I was in a BBQ joint once and the Brisket was very fatty.

I asked the server if there was any leaner and she replied; "That is the way brisket is. Its always fatty." I almost came out of my seat!

Needless to say, I have no been back there since. 

Back on track. I dont get thier Fish and Chips anymore. Its just too risky for me.

I have had most of their burgers. These are often hit and miss as well, but this is pretty common when you are hiring cooks and not paying them much.

My norm is the chili cheeseburger. In fact, the last couple times I was here, I had the Banzi Burger and had them turn this into a chili burger.

Even better is if you replace the mayo with mustard. I know it sounds weird, but there is just something about the acid in the mustard which really plays well to Chili.

I love their chili here. It peppery and very flavorful. The only thing I wish they had was a version of the chili without beans.

My main advice here it to not look down. On more than 1 occasion, I dropped a crayon (My daughter is 10 and we often play Football with crayons on the table) under the table. When I looked under the table to get it, I was disgusted

There was food and trash all under the table. So when you go Red Robin, enjoy the food, but dont look down.

Food was great although they got two of the 4 orders wrong.

Environment was a little loud but not unbearable.

Service was great! She took great care of us and accommodated our special requests.

Prices have increased but they have everywhere else too...

I started coming to this location when they opened and I have always had a wonderful experience.  I live in Emmett, so every store has better prices then our selection in Emmett.  After coming for almost a year, I realized that I had found a store I could finally fall in love with.

The staff is approachable and only on a few visits were they hard to find.  They always help you out and will go out of their way to make sure you were completely satisfied.

The grocery selection is varied and very easy to find.  I know that my daughter, who LOVES hot dogs, can get then here for almost three dollars less that the place in Emmett.  Money saved!!

Thank you, Fred Meyer to your commitment to excellence and thank you for a wonderful management staff and crew here.
This is one of my favorite breakfast / brunch restaurant in Idaho. Great food Great service Great location ( lots of parking).

Worst food experience in my life.  First of all, the service was miserably slow. We watched as tables came in after us and got served before us. It took 55 minutes to get our meal. Mine came out with the wrong side and none of the veggies or jalapenos I had ordered on my burger. So essentially, my burger came out with only guacamole and mustard. The service was way too slow to bother and tell them so I ate the burger as is. The waitress eventually brought out my steamed broccoli (my missing side) which was only half steamed and came with nothing to put on it, lemon? Butter? Something please! So I ate my crunchy, half steamed dry broccoli for sustenance only, it was not tasty. Lastly, the air conditioner was blowing full blast straight directly above us. We literally sat there huddled in blankets from our car for our whole meal. Then my receipt comes and I'm charged for the extra jalapenos I didn't get. I take the moment to tell her not only were my jalapenos not on it, but none of the veggies I ordered. She removes the extra charge, and apologizes for the other missing items, but does nothing more.
We go once a week for lunch. Love the sushi chefs and sushi is delish for great price at lunch. Thank you, Shige!

I like that this place is right on my way home from work.  I can call in an order, and the nice people there have it ready by the time I drive by.  So convenient!  The only drawback is that the food isn't good.  The family has mutinied and made it clear that this is no longer an option for me.  Sigh...

They're definitely right though.  My last order was sweet and sour pork, Mongolian beef, and chicken with pea pods.  The staff wisely put the sauce for the sweet and sour pork in a separate container, but the dish still wasn't good.  The coating on the pork was very doughy, and the bright pink sauce tasted like it came out of a bottle (which it probably did).  I was especially disappointed by the Mongolian beef.  At other restaurants, strips of slightly crispy, spicy beef are stir-fried along with green onions.  Their version had what looked like canned chow-mein vegetables with rubbery bits of beef mixed in.  Tasted nothing like Mongolian beef.  The chicken with pea pods had a slightly better mix of vegetables, but the chicken was also rubbery, and the taste was very bland.  The steamed rice and the fortune cookies were both pretty good though. :)

I gave them a second star because they're nice people and run what appears to be a clean kitchen -- I just wish the food was edible.

After a long drive in, it was nice to pull straight into a clean site. We were guided into the spot by an employee, who helped us get into the fairly narrow site with room for our slide out. There was a clean but small indoor pool which was the perfect temperature for a hot day. They have fantastic home cooked breakfasts Saturday morning for only $5. Every staff member was friendly and helpful.

My step-sister and mom took me here for my birthday dinner and it was beyond AWESOME :). I cannot wait to go back.
The seared duck was very tasty.  My mom even tried a bite and liked it-she is not a duck person so that is an extremely high review!!!
So yummy and the little waitress she works so hard I can tell and is slaw has smelling and greeting us love it
This has been our favorite Italian restaurant that we have found so far in meridian. Legit delicious food. Definitely recommended!

We went twice: the first time the service was offensive. Long wait, snarky rude server, but fairly good food. The second time we went for the food and ate in the bar where the bartender was a delight. The bar food was outstanding and we didn't have to have contact with the table staff.
Great church... Dynamic worship and solid Bible teaching. Charismatic but not crazy... Dress is casual and music is contemporary and has lots of variety.

I've gone here twice to get my nails done and the first time I got gel polish and the second time I got regular polish. Both times my nail polish  started to peel off a day or two after getting them done and both times I had a couple polished nails wrinkle up right away. I've gone to other nail salons and this has never happened before. The staff is really nice but my nails only last a couple of days. I will not be going back.
Food and service have gone way down hill sinceReally sad to see this place settle into mediocrity.

This evening my adult children and I came in for dinner to celebrate my daughters birthday.  I had brought in some coupons that I bought for a school fund raiser. The coupons were  $5.00 off per check with purchase over $20.00  We were all having separate checks and they only allowed us to use one coupon. After talking with Matt
the General manager (very young and arrogant, i might add) he would not make an exception. There was 10 of us and our combined bill was well over $100. Being in the customer service industry I could not believe his attitude!  The food was good but not excellent. Chelsea the waitress on the other hand was excellent!!  She could teach her General Manager a thing or two about customer service!  Since I'm not coming back to this location I passed out my remaining coupons to those in the waiting area.

This is an amazing hospital ! Brody our Maltese got a bee sting in his paw,as soon as we walked in the staff rushed him in ! I filled out the paperwork while they attended to Brody.
It was 9pm but they did not hesitate to help him. Dr, Sparzo has a sweet touch so Brody was not afraid at all.
THANK YOU DR. SPARZO & YOUR WONDERFUL STAFF ! I need to add that a couple of weeks our other dog Sammy also got a bee sting, it was during business hours at our vet, they charged us double + what River City Vet charged us, and we "were a client" we will never take our dogs to another hospital Brody (although not a client, at the time) was treated with priority and kindness 
THANK YOU !
RV's are packed in way to close, nothing nice to look at in the campground itself and cable does not work (plenty of channels though using the antenna). Would never stay here again.
Love this place. Expect a bit of a wait but worth it. We split a senior meal and it is more than we can eat. Best corned beef hash I have ever had and biscuits and gravy amazing. Go eat here!

Excellent food, great service from Sam our waitress 
Great amount of food for the price. We will definitely come back here again

Stopped in today to have a new TPMS sensor installed in one of my wheels. The staff was very friendly and helpful. Gave an accurate estimate of the wait time (it was a busy Saturday morning). 

Two techs worked on my car. One replaced the sensor and rebalanced the wheel. The other checked the air pressure on the other three tires and checked the torque of the lug nuts. They worked together to re sync the sensors. Was only $15 for the service.

Very clean and well organized waiting area. I'm very satisfied.

I love everything I've ever eaten at Moe Joes. I also like their coffee and their fresh squeezed orange juice. On par with Goldie's, and The Griddle, and sometimes similarly difficult to get into at peak times. They are only open during peak times. It's worth the wait.

Love this place. Expect a bit of a wait but worth it. We split a senior meal and it is more than we can eat. Best corned beef hash I have ever had and biscuits and gravy amazing. Go eat here

Went back again yesterday and I swear it was even better than the last time.  Fiesta Hash is the best breakfast ever. Can't wait to go back

Potential hotel guests; do not opt for this hotel unless you're used to staying in 1 star establishments.
You'll find rooms that are smelly (like smoke and cigarettes, even in non-smoking rooms) dirty and unkempt, very shady individuals staying long-term, possible drug interactions out front, and largely inept staff. 
We were given a room that smelled like cigarette smoke and the sheets on the pull-out mattress were dirty and had not been made.
They did switch us to a new room, but it was also tired and visibly dirty, with crushed lamp shades, warn carpet, long black hairs in the shower and on the shower curtain, and the joys of parking lot noise. 
They also have a DVD rental area...BUT NO DVD PLAYERS. What? Oh, I'm sorry, I forgot to pack my DVD player...
Overall this "hotel", is way past its prime and needs a complete overhaul: top to bottom.
Great breakfast spot! The food is made fresh and delicious. The service was excellent!

Seriously the best brunch spot in the Boise/meridian area. I contemplated not writing a review because I want to keep this place a secret! There's typically a wait on the weekends BUT it is soooo worth it. Everything is made from scratch, the service is outstanding... if you like corn beef hash... this place is utopia. Can't express it enough, this restaurant is awesome.
Had a great glass of wine and a margherita pizza! Thanks Haden for the great service and suggestions! We'll be back!

This place is freaking amazing!!! The food always tastes freshly prepared and the service is great. I only wish I could actually branch out and try other dishes but the veggie hash is so top notch, I dream about it for days before getting it.
simply awful wings.  my wife and i were ill for hours afterwards.
I was so not impressed at all! I had a pedicure and now after the fact I read the reviews and I'm terrified that I will get an infection.

Our first experience with this vet was amazing! The staff of super friendly and helpful and I love that they are so good with my dog. Most vets we have ever visited are always scared because he's a pit bull but Dr. Sparzo was great with him. She was not afraid to touch go near him or touch him. She played with him and it was a great experience. We previously saw Dr Uthbert and that visit was just as pleasant. Kelly was the tech who helped explain our doggies treatment and she was awesome! We live almost 40 minutes away but don't mind making the drive because the each experience is AMAZING!

I took my wife here for dinner. First time at Gino's and we were not disappointed. A rare gem tucked away, the atmosphere was pleasant. 
 The wait staff were very professional and gave excellent service. We were not disappointed with the menu. Portions we're generous and quite authentic. The salad and bread, hit the spot!
 I will recommend this spot to everyone, reasonably priced and worth a visit.
Surprisingly had exactly what we needed. The service was great! Good supply of anything for a party and more.

We came in to our local store recently asking for information and were blown off just because we weren't planning to spend money.  So you lost a potential purchase of four or five iPhones, once we had our questions answered.  I have found that this location is very annoyed when you come in wanting help and they you aren't in to buy.  We shouldn't have to pay to received customer service.

The employee today at this Verizon location in Meridian Idaho was very patient and professional in very helpful. I would recommend this Verizon store to any 1. If you need help in deciding on a new phone or the current phone packages  Or even just phone accessories they have a huge selection.
This place has SOO many options that it's almost overwhelming, but everything that I've had is super good. Especially the banana bread French toast!

We love this place!!!! Food is so delicious, some of the best bbq around! Decore is like a hunters cabin and plenty of space. Large portions and good prices, especially considering the quality of the food. Kids menu is great and my picky eater son says their burgers are the best. 
Always have large amouny of beers on tap and wife loves the strawberry lemonade! Highly recommend!

Ate there last night. Good service but the food was not all that great. Our dish was served cold and the pasta was over cooked. We rarely eat here and now I remember why.  Next time we will stick with Olive Garden.

Christmas Eve and locked out of our house due to our own negligence. We were going to visit a friend who is terminal; needless to say we were distraught. When we discovered our dilemma, we called AM/PM Lockouts & Locksmith. The representative was calm and reassuring; he was willing to meet us at our home to render assistance after our visit.  Upon returning to our home, we were able to get in. However, his willingness to help us on Christmas Eve was beyond the pale. Even though we did not procure his assistance, I would recommend his services simply based on his willingness to help on an as needed basis.

Another Meridian "secret". It is the best Chinese food in the valley. As a company we go for work lunches and we have never had a bad meal. Literally every dish is good. They treat you right, the prices are good, and the food is delicious. You won't be disappointed.

We've eaten here regularly since Joe opened... our breakfast visit this morning was very much a disappointment. The entire staff here seems 'on edge' and unhappy as of late ~ the whole dining room was treated to Joe's yelling in the back/kitchen area (which is always the case with every visit). We waited about 20 minutes for a table. Our server appeared fairly quickly but did not know the answer to our question about a particular menu item. He meekly replied "no, I don't 'think' we can do that", rather than actually go ask and get a definitive answer. We had to specifically ask for straws, silverware, and napkins. ALL three of the two-person parties who were seated and had ordered after us, mysteriously received their food before we did. I ordered extra-crispy hash browns, eggs poached medium, and well done bacon. All three items arrived under-done, exactly opposite of the order. Hash browns were only lightly browned on the top side and hadn't even touched the grill on the under side ~ definitely not as requested. My cooked 'medium' eggs were runny and cold. Bacon was mostly still 'white' and translucent. Gross. We should have asked for a full replacement of all three items, but did not. Our server did voluntarily bring us different bacon. We did ask for a 'poached medium eggs' replacement, which then eventually arrived (long after our other food was cold) fully cooked and rock hard. Ugh. We just let the hash brown issue pass and didn't eat them thinking it would be futile to ask that they be made correctly. We received our bill ~ yup, they charged us for the two replacement/kitchen error eggs. Our server had not specified to the kitchen staff anything about 'crispy' hash browns or bacon so they were unaware of our request. The receipt did indicate the word poached 'medium', so the kitchen had indeed failed to get that right. The second set of eggs on the receipt was entered by our server as poached 'hard' - the kitchen cooked them accurately that time although that was NOT how we'd ordered them (poached medium, again!) at the table. Epic fail all the way around ~ poor food delivery/timing execution, lack of order accuracy, food quality, and the extra expense charged to the customer for errors that were theirs, not ours! The most disappointing aspect of our experience was finding out that our server was actually the (shift?) manager of the restaurant. 'Managers' should require more of themselves...

I was in a rush and an employee by the name of Judie help me the entire visit in the store to find the best deals for what I was looking for. I truly appreciated her customer service and that is why am taking the time to write this review. Thank you!!

I had the opportunity to have lunch here a couple of days ago and thought it was definitely a great addition to the area. They got extra brownie points by bringing my coffee in a warmed up cup ! Great food and loved the waitress who continually checked in on us.

Wonderful evening at our new fave spot!  Great appetizer platter with salami fruit cheese bread olives went perfect with the Memory Loss Red wine  - ribeye steak and veggies cooked to perfection, love this place!! Ben our server was entertaining and awesome!  Well done!

Spectacular service and food. Visiting from out of town and have already been here 3 times because of the service and great food. The wife and I normally like to explore the different restaurants wherever we go. This place just couldn't keep us away. Country fried steak= A+. Probably one of the best I've ever had. Blueberry muffin pancakes are TO DIE FOR! These are a can't miss. Breakfast burrito is top notch! Mojo potatoes are also the best I've ever had. The CBH is an A++ with the chilies they use in the recipe.

Wonderful breakfast restaurant with a ton of options. Everything is made from scratch with high-quality ingredients. The coffee is great the service is even better! Favorite breakfast restaurant in the area!

The food is amazing! We got the huge plate of nachos (Mexican pyramid) and a chicken cordon bleu with fries and it was all so yummy! 
Also, absolutely love that there is a patio in the back so we can have our dogs here

The seemed like nice people until we signed paperwork.  We had very minimal changes to the plan and the plans needed redrew. Now I feel very put off and lied to. Were 6 week after sending the plans in for changes and I was just told a few more weeks. I chose them for what they said they could do and they are not living up to anything yet. I'm sure this will get edited I just hope it's for the better.

This place was perfect tonight. We were greeted with friendliness right away. That set the stage for the evening. 

Fresh sushi. Tasted great. Even complimentary edamame!

Continuing our Tour of Boise Eats we consulted Yelp and decided on this little tucked away spot. 

Since this was our first time here it is hard to say if the wait we experienced was typical.  I thought I heard someone saying that they were short handed, though nobody apologized to us for the wait time.  From the time we walked in to the time we got our food was about an hour.  Granted, it's a small place, and it was a Saturday during brunch hours. 

We ordered the Smoke house hash, and potato frittata, and both were great, though the hash was the better of the two. It was an ooey gooey pile of crisp potato chunks, meats, eggs, cheese, and a sauce that reminded me of Utah's version of fry sauce. 

The potatoes are awesome. They are cut homestyle sized and more than likely deep fried, which is fine by me because there is nothing I hate more than soggy and limp breakfast potatoes.

Have you ever heard of Marion Berries? Neither had I, but they brought out a Marion berry jam that was pretty decent, like a black berry, very mild. 

We were very pleased with our meal, and luckily we weren't in a hurry so the wait wasn't a big deal.

We were looking for a casual place with simple homemade food and this place was within walking distance of our hotel. We were delighted to get just what we wanted. 
The food was fresh and portions generous. My friend had a mushroom Swiss burger that was half a pound and a pile of crisp, hot fries. I opted for breakfast with eggs prepared perfectly, good breakfast sausage that was not greasy at all, and half of a Belgian waffle, light as a feather, with strawberries on top.
We declared both meals delicious and our server was prompt, friendly and attentive. We didn't try the salad bar but it looked very good with 2 soups, chili, taco fixings, baked potatoes, fresh bread and muffins along with the usual salad offerings. Nice baby leaf lettuce, all kinds of fruit and everything looked great. 
Our check was under $20!
I hear the breakfast buffet is very popular - we might try it in the morning.

It's not bad, but not amazing either. Just like their menu names that are slightly different from other Chinese restaurants, the food tastes slightly different than what you'd expect. Spicy Mandarin Chicken is great though. Broccoli Beef: the meat was good but our broccoli was basically raw. We tried several sides and were not impressed with any. All in all, I'd go here again for the Spicy Mandarin Chicken, but not anything else.

We had dinner here tonight and were really pleased. Quick service and the food was delicious. I had their bacon wrapped sirloin special ($9.99) and it was perfectly cooked and very tender. We also ordered the sourdough burger and chicken strips all were delicious. Great food for the price!
I came in with a nail in my tire. The guys were so nice and very fast. Plus found out it was free! I will always come to this location for the friendly service in a timely matter! Thank you!

Hands down favorite Chow Mein ever. And the Hit and Sour Soup is the absolute best; when you're sick it's like magical medicine. Never dined in, always call for pick up but every time I see inside the place it looks warm and welcoming and the staff is always super nice and helpful.
Loved it! It is a mixed menu with both Thai and Vietnamese. Food was very good, and our server was awesome. We will definitely be back.

I mentioned to a friend, "what was that place that you ordered Chinese from last year (2017) for your Christmas Party- it was so good! Let's go there."   The fact that I remembered catered food at a friend's party more than a year ago, says it all.  This food is WAY above average.    Despite it being in a congested area of Meridian (aka Meridifornia) and in a strip mall with hard-to-find parking, I'd venture out here again, because I have more menu choices I'd like to explore.   I'll definitely be back!

Really delicious food, but our experience was marred by the fact that we were not offered any compensation after the waitress spilled boiling hot soup all over us and our table. We by no means were upset with the waitress, and we know accidents happen, but the manager should have intervened! My son was soaked from t-shirt to shoes, and it literally burned his abdomen and my husband's hand. All four of us were spilled on, we had to change tables, and head right home to change and wash our clothes after we ate. Although the sweet waitress was very apologetic, the manager absolutely should have offered to apologized, and not charged us for our meals.
When I return, I will get full orders of what ever I decide to order. The food is fantastic and the wait staff very friendly!  This is a must return to place!

Like many of the restaurants I have reviewed in Idaho, I want to say that this place isn't especially out of the ordinary. They're just a solid breakfast spot, cookin' up solid breakfast classic (with a few twists). However, they totally stand out and aren't nearly as ordinary as, say, IHOP or even Egg Factory. Their food is seriously, seriously tasty and their service was definitely above average.

Our waitress was friendly and attentive, refilling our water and coffees more than a few times. She also had the good sense and courtesy to not bug as all of the time, but make us feel very well taken care of. She was very polite, too.

The ambiance is somewhat odd, with American Southwest colors, interesting architectural features and odd art / knickknacks on the wall. But it's a big, wide-open space and was comfortable noisy (not awkwardly quiet). The morning we were in, folks were raising funds for a local man who had been involved in a motorcycle accident, so there were a lot of bikers and concerned family friends.

The food itself rocked out. I have the BTA (bacon, tomato, avocado) eggs benedict and my wife had the bare burrito (no tortilla, all of the protein and flavor). In short, they were exceptionally good! The benedict had a lovely hollandaise sauce on it and the eggs were masterfully cooked (just runny enough). The addition of tomato and avocado, which can be executed poorly, was done up just right. And DEAR LORD are their potatoes legit. Don't leave here without trying their house fried potatoes. The bare burrito was exactly what wifey was looking for: no tortilla, lots of proteiny eggs, pico de gallo and avocado. We also split the French toast, which we agreed wasn't anything too special. We are excited to come back and try the jalapeno berro pancakes!

This place lives up to the hype, but still doesn't go as far above and beyond as Goldy's. That said, I think this is easily my number two breakfast spot in the state, so get your butt down here swiftly and frequently!

Stopped for lunch here, and ordered a smoky ranch off of the lunch menu.  It was a small, burnt burger,wrapped in a giant foil to make it look bigger.  Service was slow, and to top it off, I was overcharged by $2
Food usually good. Had special and ordered only to find out that they didn't have cocoa for velvet pancakes.  Really!  I would say not managed well. Really disappointed. Hope it's not a trend

Our favorite sushi and teriyaki restaurant. Food is good and the menu gives you so many options it's difficult to choose. Service is friendly and fast. They are very attentive and revisit our table often to see if we need anything. Love the Bento Box choices!
Great meal. Excellent service from our waitress, Julia.  Wingers never disappoint!  We will be back soon!

There are just some restaurants that I struggle to write a review and this is one of them.  I think I am coming to understand that the restaurants I keep coming back to but have a hard time reviewing is because of inconsistency.  Red Robin is just that.  I have had some really good meals here and there have been times where I leave and say, I would be ok not coming back for a while.  Red Robin has gone through some changes recently when it comes to the decor and feel inside this place.

Unlimited fries if you order a menu item with fries.  Their campfire sauce is really good and when the fries are hot, they taste great.  I've been here too many times were the fries are either great or stale and cold.  I know from others including myself that feel like the waiters and waitresses get annoyed when you ask for more fries.  I don't know what it is but I have felt that from many employees here over the years.

Burgers are ok, sometimes it comes out hot, other times luke warm.  Keep in mind, that is my soap box, I like food hot and drinks cold so take my comments with a grain of salt.

If I had a major complaint which isn't a bad thing for Red Robin is the place is usually packed and super loud.  Don't come here if you want to have a conversation with your table.  With their recent remodel, it seems to be more packed, less elbow room and a lot noisier.  Overall, just an average place for me and good place to come if unlimited fries sound good.

P.S. Ask for garlic parmesian fries.  They are really good.
Really really REALLY great pizza. Amazing crust! Salad bar is okay, not fantastic. We will definitely order from there again

Disappointed again at the lack of theme selection.  They had ZERO new Star Wars milar balloons and very slim pickings of new Star Wars items.  Next time I will plan ahead and order all party supplies online.

I had some large cysts on the back of my neck for years. When I eventually got a job with health care, I looked into having them removed. I went to a family practitioner and asked for a referral for not just a dermatologist but one who was skilled in surgical procedures as well. I was referred to Janice Neilson at Ada West. A minimally-invasive method was used to make incisions into my skin and extract the cysts. With the help of both Ms. Neilson and a resident there named Som (who had stronger hands and fingers), my cysts were drained at first and then the sacs were removed piece by piece until they thought that everything was taken out. Much wringing and kneading of my neck occurred to drain the cysts and then push out the sac, so I admit that it was painful at times despite the local anesthetics. But I was told afterward that the method done to remove the cysts was far cheaper than if they had to use a scalpel and slice me open to remove them (read: surgical procedure). Considering one of my cysts ended up being the size of a golf ball, I was quite happy that they were able to do what they did with the method used. And my wallet thanks them too.

First time to Grimaldi's. Loved it. We started with a carafe of wine, half price on Tuesdays! Out table opened up not 5 minutes later. We ordered the antipasto plate to start, nice selection of mozzarella cheese, salami, olives, roasted red peppers, and bread. Then we shared a small spinach salad ( small feeds 2 easy), and it was excellent. We then had a small 12" pizza, with a few toppings. It was a thin crust, and very tasty. 
We will definitely be back. Wait staff was very courteous as well. Highly recommend.

So we have been going to Mo Joe's ever since it opened for ten or so years I think. First time I had their breakfast (never have had lunch here) I was hooked. This became one of our favorite breakfast joints.  I never seem venture out and try new things because their basic Mo Joe breakfast of two eggs, Joe's potatos, bacon, and I always have had their pancake instead of toast,  has been my goto breakfast. Their pancake was, in my opinion, the best buttermilk pancake in the valley.  There was something special about it, and I craved it every time we went out to breakfast.  Fast forward to 2019.... I have to say, ever since they remolded their place their pancake recipe is different.  To me, it's lost that buttery vanilla taste that was soooo good in the early years.  Also their bowl plates they use is a bit weird when eating a fried egg, especially when trying to cut it with a fork to eat it.  More recently they changed from the normal sized pancake to a short stack pancakes which I think when they did that, the recipe changed. Anyway, my husband and I went to breakfast here with my daughter, son-in-law and two grandkids.  My husband ordered his usual, Mo Joe's egg breakfast ( 2 fried eggs, hash browns, bacon and toast). My daughter and son-in-law ordered some hash dish and I ordered the pancakes with one egg.  Basically, my meal looked like my granddaughter's meal but my egg came on a separate plate.  No biggy.  It wasn't that expensive.  I was hoping that the last time I was here that it was an off day and they would bring back  the way they used to make their basic buttermilk pancake in the past. That didn't happen.  Although my food was good, it just wasn't as good as it use to be. Everyone in my party enjoyed their breakfast, and I liked my pancakes, but it's not the same.  I think I might have to order the eggs Benedict the next time.
Great food, awesome service! Very affordable- we love this place! We eat here at least once every visit to town

Everything I've ever eaten here has been amazing. The service is a bit on the slow side... but it's so worth it I didn't feel like I should take away a star for that. It's just such gooooooood food. I'm eating their cinnamon roll right now. Which is gigantic. Try it out people!
Gross in every way. Food is nasty. Processed and uninspired. It took 40 minutes to get 2 salads. Bad salads, at that. Dirty tables. Don't waste your time.
Expert work with a variety of colors, stamps and styles. Much more interesting and professional looking that the old-fashioned stuff!

Had our Christmas party here last night and the pizza was great, with lots of toppings, the salad bar was well stocked and clean and the employees were very accommodating!  I liked that the hot wings had some zing to them and they carry Sockeye IPA which I really like!

Horrible customer service. I went in today to get a screen protector put on my phone and was told I would have to sign in and wait for 6 other people to be helped first. I asked if someone could just do it after they freed up since it takes 2 minutes to put a screen on (I even had the new cover, so didn't even need to take up time buying one). I was told NO. What struck me as most odd was, why couldn't the woman who was signing me in or the second employee standing around with a tablet to sign people in do it? Maybe since nobody was getting any money for helping me, they just didn't care. I won't be back.

Dad & I went to their Grand Opening today.   Wow, what a gorgeous store!    We were treated to lots of samples and we were greeted by several staff members making sure we found everything we needed.

We'll definitely be regulars here.
Wonderful place to have breakfast. Large portions and friendly staff.  Food was tasty with lots of choices. Loved it there and would go back again!

Was passing through the Boise area and this place got good reviews. We were seated right away and our server was Johnny on the spot. The coffee was good which normally drip coffee from some places is very bitter but Moe Joes must use a good brand. We both had the egg bacon breakfast but I had the potatoes instead of hash browns and they tasted great. The toast seemed homemade or they get it from a bakery with homemade jams. The only draw back was my husband complained about the bowls they served the food in. He said it was hard to get out, I didn't have an issue. I think it's a left handed issue. Definitely wouldn't mark them down because he has a hard time eating. Thumbs up
I love the food. Jay is such an asset to their restaurant but I cannot stand to eat here. I have a headache when I leave due to the acoustics. It's so loud and  obnoxious

Yum every time.  Service is great, food is great and abundant.  Pancake specials are always different and with a great syrup created just for them.  Busy, local place. Expect to wait during normal breakfast hours....but lunch is just as good.

Didn't even have a chance to eat, went in for lunch and although the restaurant had plenty of open seating and the people in front of us got seated right away we were told that we needed to wait 15minutes, when I asked why and stated there were plenty of open tables why do we have to wait the hosted became rude and said they didn't have enough servers.. we won't be back there...

The Italian Nachos are soooooo delicious.  A little spicey due to the Jalapenos, and a meal in itself.  I always order the eggplant parmesan. It's my favorite. Meals come with salad & bread so you won't go home hungry!

Zurchers is great! If only if I had just come a couple of days earlier, most of the stuff I needed they had already ran out of. I'm in town for a graduation so we came for last minute stuff but that's ok! The customer service was great and the place is clean.

Really great food! Nice atmosphere once inside. Outside feels a bit like a small strip mall. Only four stars due to the high prices. $100.00 for two kids meals and two adult meals of which one was a small personal pizza. Again, great food, but spendy.

Killer find near our hotel. All of the normal boring dishes and tons of unique choices on your favorite breakfast foods. Feel free to have bacon and eggs but I enjoyed my chicken, egg white and artichoke hash. Lots to choose from if you are a breakfast lover. Good service, good coffee, indoor and outdoor seating if you come during one of the few nice weather weeks here. Hahahaha.
A lot of hype brought us here and it was just alright. Probably more authentic than we were expecting but it was pricey and nothing too fancy. We like supporting local but not sure we'd be back.
Crowded and noisy... higher priced than comparable. The Griddle/ Terries and even the Bear always much better!!

I just threw a birthday party for my 9 year old son who LOVES nerf guns!  We had a good mix of boys and girls who came to the party. I think it was one of the funniest birthday parties I've ever had for any of my 4 kids!  Grown ups and kids had a lot of fun!  The only thing I would say could be better.... was the party hostess. I wish she could have been more assertive and efficient in the party room with keeping he momentum of the pizza and cake. But even though it was a little lacking there..... I would still have done it all again!  Thanks dart Warz for being a very memorable experience!

Just want to say this was my first visit to wingers, I just relocated to Boise. I am giving a 5 star review not because the food was great.....don't get me wrong it was good but the server was fantastic!!! Brittany made our visit unforgettable, I will always return to a place with great service before going back to a place with unbelievable food and service that's just ok....the restaurant is clean, big bar area and nice atmosphere but again our server made the experience the best!!!! Thank you!!! So if you are wanting good food and great service go find Brittney, she's the best! I will be back to see her!

Wow, I cannot believe the negative reviews here on Chapman Properties! Are they talking about the same Chapman Properties that took care of my property for over 13 years?  Chapman have always been very attentive and responded very quickly to any questions that I and.  Any repairs needed, they took care of it right away and always provided me detailed invoices.  I would highly recommend them.

What a great team. 
The facility is nice and fun to be in, but the team there is amazing. 
I had an educational tour with Lucas Hull, and Haustin Roth. 
They were not just knowledgable, but friendly and funny. 
I have been to at least 10 RV shops across USA, hands down this is the best team anywhere.

I will likely not be back after my first visit. I went in with a group of four. After ordering the meal we waited for what began to feel too long. It was. The waiter then informed us something went wrong with  the grill so our order would take more time. I think we waited in total an hour. I would have been ok, but then got the check and they charged me $6 for a small piece of grill chicken I asked to be put into a Caesar salad. I paid $15 for a Caesar with chicken. The place is nice, but not nice enough to make me wait an hour for an overpriced Caesar salad and then earn more than two stars.

Came in for a late lunch we were seated next to a table that had all kinds of food on the floor. Look around and no body even stopped to clean up.  Went to leave and the hostess was seating and talking on here cell phone

We called ahead to make reservations for 6 people on a Sunday night and David the host told us they don't accept reservations but if we arrive before 5pm we should get a table no problem.  We arrived at 4:45pm and proceeded to wait for an hour without ever being seated.  At which point we decided to leave, when we informed the host at the front about o it long wait, he very much could care less.  Never will go there again.  By the way, the bat rooms were disgusting and dirty.

This is my dermatology clinic of choice (4 years plus) and Stephen Frelly is my absolute favorite dermatologist (PA).  I always feel relaxed and "special" when I go once a year (or more often if needed).  Above all, I feel confident that I am receiving the BEST dermatological care.  All the personnel at Ada West Dermatology are friendly and welcoming.  I highly recommend this clinic for any dermatological needs.  Yes, the wait can be long (15-20 minutes) but it is well worth that wait for the top professional services provided.
This has become my go to for a wash. It's rarely busy and everyone is friendly and helpful. No sales pitch for upselling and no stress.

Worst customer service ever! When I signed up with them the guy told me I should not be using my phone as a hotspot for streaming and should get a jet pack. After consulting my son who knows my situation and that I am streaming on my laptop... I even had my son on phone speaker while talking with this guy and we both told him it would be for streaming. The guy was like yeah this is what you want. Well month two and I can't use it. Apparently there is a cap on how long you can use its data even though I have unlimited. I go back to the store to talk to them about it and a guy who WASN'T EVEN THE ONE WHO HELPED ME, stood there and said "I told you it wasn't for streaming"!  The girl that was working there today when I went in even said they stopped selling them in the store bc there were so many problems. All they would say is that you're not supposed to use it for streaming and you signed a contract. JERKS! I would not have bought it if I could not use it to stream!  Don't listen to anything they say. I called customer service and a supervisor told me to talk to the manager about canceling the account and have them waive the charge. I talk to the manager and he says he can't that customer service has to do it. What a freaking joke.

We have taken our dogs here for over 11 years. We are always happy and our expectations are met. It's comfortable, through and clean. Staff is friendly and accommodating as well as kind and loving to our sweet babes.

Prices are simply too high at Fred Meyer. We usually stop by Fred Meyer to purchase the two or three decently-priced advertised items. (Unfortunately, these are often out-of-stock.) What's amazing is that Fred Meyer has stores right next to each other with drastically different prices! The store at 5425 Chinden Blvd. (Garden City) has much lower prices than the store at 1400 W Chinden Blvd (Meridian). What's up with that? These two stores are just 7.3 miles apart!!

Carinos is not one of our regular places to eat but go there 3 or 4 times a year.  Food is what you expect from a chain, mediocre food, so so service.  Tonight was no exception except that service was worse then usual.  Server had no idea what to do.  We had to move dirty dishes to other tables, wasn't offered pepper or Parmesan cheese with salad or entree.   Made mistakes in two of bills and then took forever to get them fixed and paid.  
This probably be last time we go.  I was expecting mediocre food but the horrible service was the final straw.

This is definitely one of the best Italian restaurants in Idaho. My opinion better than Luciano's and Louie's by far. The filet minion with mushroom risotto is excellent!! The staff and owner are very friendly and accommodating. The chefs cook everything to order and is all authentic. The decorations are perfect especially for a date night out. Full bar with a great wine selection. They have a outside area perfect for our nice weather.

When we arrived we were the only customers in the restaurant.  Waitress was on the phone taking an order and she dropped off menus to our table without saying anything.   Then a large family came in and she went to them with menus and took silverware and napkins to them and took their drink orders.   She was coming to our table but the phone rang and she took that call and went in the back to take two more phone orders.   We got up and left!   Terrible customer service, not enough staff and not good ambiance.  We will not be going back!
Excellent shrimp chilliquillas. Very good flavor. Love the hash bowls will be coming back soon.

I recently purchased a new set of tires from this location and I couldn't be happier with my experience! It started with one tire showing some wires and the technician met me where my car was got a spare on for me in order to get the car to their store (in the rain!). Not 2 days later I got a flat (damn screw) and had to leave my car in a random neighborhood and uber to work! I was so stressed about it and Les Schwab sent out a technician and he found my car (without an exact location) and called me when the new tire and wheel well were replaced! I didn't have to even leave work.. and they offered a complimentary adjustment if it felt "wobbly" since he couldn't drive it to check. HIGHLY RECOMMEND LES SCHWAB. 

Thanks again, for saving me multiple times!

I just moved back to Idaho from Oregon and  Dr. Jennifer Cook was my doctor.  She is awesome!  The office check-in ladies were friendly and efficient.  One gentleman was in training, and they were so patient with him.  He was smiling and not at all nervous.  I am always disappointed when I have to wait a half hour or more to get in to see a doctor.  The timing was perfect.  I have referred my sisters (2) to Ada West Dermatology and I know they will be making appointments soon.  I would recommend this clinic to anyone searching for a dermatologist.  
Linda B

Boy they're not kidding when they say freaky fast service! I also really love that they don't have a minimum order for delivery, as usually when I order it's just for myself because I'm too lazy to cook. The portions are good sized, delivery service very prompt and prices just right. 

I ordered the gargantuan one evening when I thought I was starving and going to die and it was enough to easily feed two big men... They aren't kidding when they call it gargantuan! Happy to order there anytime I want a decent sandwich. The pickles are awesome too.
We love this place! The pizza is always great and the service is super. Have not had a bad pizza or server.
Service was outstanding. Even though we were the only diners on the patio Lisa made sure that we were not forgotten. Well done!!   Food was also very good!!
Portions were amazing!  Staff was very friendly and engaged.  Owner came and checked on us and went through the upcoming events.  Sounds like fun evenings, just not our type of music .

We ordered quite a few different dishes tonight (trying to support small business during quarantine).  

The food was fair, very run of the mill, nothing tasted fresh.  The vegetables were overcooked and the shrimp was old, tasted frozen, thawed, frozen, thawed then cooked.  It was not good.

There are other Chinese restaurants which are much better.

Great spot for some Chinese American cuisine. We got the Mandarin Chicken and Honey Almond Shrimp. They were good! I'd be willing to try different dishes if we were around again, mainly because everything looked pretty good. The Mongolian Beef was almost our 3rd dish but by the time we got halfway through it was clear we'd be full. Good portion sizes! Most of the service was really good.
There was only one issue with service: there was one server who spilled drink all over the floor, and then just walked away and kept working. Made other servers deal with it, and didn't seem phased at all. Not cool..

Calling and calling the phone number... No answer.  What!??  Closed for the summer??  Bummer... Wanted to try the chicken and waffles.  Poor job communicating.  Please have a voice message on your phone.

We were in the middle of a road trip and husband had been here before while working in town. He said they had the best pancakes. We were driving through Idaho and barely caught them before they closed at 2. We ordered take out since we were counting down minutes. We had a burger with fries=excellent, lemon poppy seed pancakes and jalapeño berry pancakes... everything was excellent. They let us sit on the patio to eat with our dog while they were closing up. Best meal on the road so far!
I'm sad to report that Famous Dave's in Meridian has closed.  Many people don't care for chains, but I really liked this one. I'm sad to see they are closed and I'll miss then. :(

I like the idea of supporting a local credit union. I love banking w/ them. I been going to this branch since they've  opened. They have friendly tellers & they have a kid's corner so my kid can keep herself busy while I am doing my thing! ATM located outside the bank. There were a few times that their ATM were out of order. That's my only bad thing about them.

Because my husband is Chinese, we go here often.  He says that they have the best Chinese food in the area.  I like the food very much as well.  The menu reflects the more authentic Chinese experience.  The service has been good each time, which is as important to me as the food.

**My initial review- 
We had our first visit at Intermountain Pet Hospital last week. The staff is great and very friendly! From the initial phone call to arrival, it was by far some of the best customer service I have had from a business in quite awhile. Very pleased with our overall experience and would definitely recommend them.
*** I would like to edit my review based on my recent experience and interaction with staff today. I purchased a "puppy package" a year ago to which it includes "all core vaccines" I was told by the receptionist I was cleared to come in a month early to vaccinate my dog because I am getting a new puppy. I confirmed my package was still in effect and that it would cover all of my visit costs and vaccinations for today. 
When I arrived today, I waited longer than necessary while staff tried to get to the bottom of the miscommunication. A staff member by the name of Veronica finally came in to explain the puppy package only included the first three sets of shots. I was told I would be responsible for all vaccines and visit totaling over $100. I declined and left. The paper I took home explaining their "puppy package" today, still lists "all core vaccines" within the first year. Perhaps it should be edited to only three initial sets of vaccinations for further clarification from unexpected members like myself, who purchase their packages. It was also explained the packages have changed since then because of issues with it not being clear. Despite what the new package offers, my package should be honored based on what I purchased and its coverage a year ago. 
Not one staff member tried to offer some type of solution to make their mistake right. I planned on bringing my new puppy in as well. I will be looking for another vet! I have referred many pet owners to them and won't be doing so in the future.

I've been to Moe Joe's on a couple different occasions now and they have never disappointed.

My first trip here was for breakfast. I ordered the The Traditional, which is their basic Eggs Benedict (fine) but the star of the show was the side-order cinnamon roll. Their cinnamon rolls are huge, warm, and perfectly delicious. They are a complete breakfast on their own. They also serve a cinnamon roll french toast--which, given the pure awesomeness of their cinnamon rolls, I feel certain this would be A-mazing!

The second time I came here was for lunch. For lunch, I ordered their Avocado Melt, which our (friendly, prompt, and overall quite lovely) server immediately responded to my order by saying: That's my favorite thing on the menu!

Jackpot!

Fresh avocado, tomato, perfectly caramelized onions, smothered in melted Swiss, with a lovely layer of garlic aioli sandwiched between two ample slices of sourdough--it was a flavorful wonder. All sandwiches come with a choice of fries or salad--I opted for the salad and was glad I did. It was beautifully fresh. Even my dining companion (who had opted for fries with her sandwich) commented when she saw my plate, "Whoa, makes me wish I'd gone for the salad!"

Truly, their food is a cut above what one would expect from your average diner. They clearly display an attention to detail and an eye for fresh, quality ingredients.

Get to it!!

Loved this place...until tonight. The waitress charged one too many beers on one of our checks- when we tried to explain it to her- she got frantic and wouldn't let us explain what was going on...told us she's frustrated with us and we didn't want to pay for our stuff....we come here every other weekend and I don't have an issue paying for the food and drink we order....so I'm not sure I'll being going back. The "manager" didn't do anything to help us feel taken care of- the waitress was nasty and kept saying we just didn't want to pay for our stuff...so yeah I'm not going back...nor would I recommend anyone to come back. We work at a fairly large place nearby and I will be making sure all of our co workers know that it's not a good place to go.

We just ordered carry out from this location and were extremely disappointed. When we got home with the order, not only was the food quality poor, but we had an extra entree that we did not order. We ordered the Chicken Parmesan and the Chicken Milano. The Chicken Parmesan was overcooked and had no Parmesan on top?? The spaghetti portion was small and the dish was lacking in sauce. The Chicken Milano was not much better. The entree was bland and I would not order it again. I had looked at the menu and had seen several items that sounded delicious, but after this experience, we will not be returning to this chain restaurant.
The old guy that walks around asking if he can clear your tray was rude to me because I was listening to headphones working on paperwork while eating my lunch.

My wife and I have been here 3 times; the first time everything was wonderful - the food was great, hot, and served in a reasonable amount of time.  However the last 2 times, we found that the service has deteriorated significantly.  After we sat down, it took 15 minutes just to get water, and at least 45 minutes before we got our food.  The food was cold and the restaurant was only about half full - not real busy.  I hope they are able to get their service back to where it was at first or we will have to find another "favorite restaurant".

As usual, the food was amazing. BUT the service at this location was horrible. Our server completely disregarded any of our concerns.... as she simply made us wait as she took care of a larger party. Not happy.

This location was good when it first opened; today however, it is nothing short of gross.  An employee was vacuuming when we walked in, but quickly stopped--& so did his cleaning efforts (seriously he needed to keep cleaning).  When our food was up, my husband's chorizo & eggs was burnt & my machaca breakfast burrito was 90% potato, no egg & a very small amount of beef & sliced tomatoes... we won't be going back to this location.
We love this place! Very awesome place with great food and service. We have been a few times and plan on continuing to go back!

I absolutely enjoyed my food.  My mom got a classic burger and she said it was gross.  

Our waiter was very friendly and when we came in I had just got out of surgery and he was very understanding what I needed. Which was scrambled eggs and toast. He had them make 4 eggs but only charged for 2.

I hired Merry Maids to clean my new house top to bottom. The 2 gals were here for 7 hours and I spent several hundred dollars, but yet they did not clean my fans, oven, or plant shelves. After I called to let them know these were missed, the lady told me the cleaners cannot clean anything that requires them to be above 2 steps on the step ladder. There was no forwarning of this rule nor any money refunded for the items not cleaned, even though I was specific upon the consultation that I wanted these items cleaned.  For the amount of money I spent, I expected everything to be cleaned.

I don't care if you don't have a car and your uber ride costs $69 to get you here, this is the best breakfast/brunch restaurant I have ever eaten at. The selections are numerous, including gluten free toast, pancakes, and French toast. The coffee is always good and the food is almost indescribable...almost. The jalapeño frittata will change your life; imagine a drug that stimulates all of your taste buds, makes you happy, a doesn't hurt the wallet much. That drug is Moe Joe's, and I'm addicted for life.

We visited this restaurant on some recommendations of reviewers.  It's located in Meridian off of Overland in a strip mall---a space that once belonged to Moxie Java.   The interior has of course been refitted with booths and  done in colors of red and dark tones.  I liked that there was some modern Asian art on the wall instead of the usual lanterns and lacquered furnishings that are found in other Chinese restaurants.

The menu is well organized and there are pictures of most of the dishes which is helpful.  We ordered iced tea and water and then a dish of fried won ton skins with plum sauce to dip was placed before us.  Unusual---I've never seen that before.   We chose an appetizer of spring rolls---three which were hot, crisp, and filled with fresh vegetables.  No sauce, so we asked for some hot mustard which was furnished.  I used the plum sauce from the won tons and enjoyed that better.

Entrees were Mongolian Beef,  Honey almond chicken, and Sezchuan shrimp and scallops.  the Mongolian Beef was tender, tasty, with fried scallions in a mild pepper sauce.  The honey almond chicken was battered, fried, and the sauce was light with a sweet/savory touch.  The shrimp and scallops were in a spicy sauce with red dried peppers and bell peppers---very flavorful but definitely on the hot side.

My  complaints about this restaurant are that it's far from my house, about a 25 minute drive in  a lot of traffic, the wait staff are very pleasant but the server we had must've been new because we had to keep asking for extra flatware, extra plates, and sauce.  I was curious that chopsticks weren't offered because I really prefer to eat with them.  The extra plates were dessert size so it was hard to have much food on them.  I guess that this restaurant isn't familiar with people sharing orders.  Also the booths are small, the table doesn't really accommodate many dishes, so it's not the most comfortable dining experience.

Still for those who live and work in the Meridian area it's a good dining option.  I liked the food, the staff was very pleasant, and if we happen to be driving in this vicinity again we would probably stop in for a meal.

What an amazing place. I'm from Wyoming and have struggled to find the perfect place for eating out. This is a gem of Treasure Valley. I can't wait to come back and make this my regular restaurant away from home.

If you're going to use curbside service, plan on waiting... and waiting... and waiting at the curb.  My order was supposed to be out here over 25 minutes ago! If I hadn't already paid, I would leave and go to McDonalds.

If you have a party of 5 or more, like we usually do, I highly recommend doing a call ahead. We just found out you can do this up to 20 minutes before your arrival. Every time we come here, we wait at least 30 minutes (if not 60), while parties of 4 go ahead of us. They need to figure out a better matrix for sure. It's the only restaurant that this happens to us. Also, we get so squished in the tables, that we're almost on top of the next table. Like their chair backs up to an inch of our table. 
They have yummy food, of course, so we do enjoy the occasional visit.

Slow service... Not very knowledgeable sales people. Always seems rushed at this location. Went looking for a new phone he was telling me about tablets and how they are great baby sitters for my young kids. Bought a phone later that week with someone else. She sent me home with the promise of my phone accessories in the mail in a few days and my new phone still in the box. Didn't set it up or take it out or anything. I am back 3 weeks later with nothing being sent to me and waiting for another hour with 2 small children. Sucky. I will drive the extra few minutes to go to the location by the mall.

More update- the service has sadly gone downhill for this place. I called in a to go order and they told me my order would be ready in 15-20 minutes. I arrived 30 minutes later (allowed extra time just to make sure it was ready) and to my dismay they had no record of my order and never even put it in the system. So I had to wait even more. This hurts my heart- I really loved it here but the service just gets worse and worse every time I come and try to give it another chance.
