When you pay the higher prices for a meal you expect higher service.

Pizza no!

I have an update for this place for the pizza. Do not get it. I ordered a pizza with extra sauce. When I arrived I got extra cheese and hardly any sauce. I asked if they could redo it and I actually heard the waitress asked the cooks how they made my pizza and I heard them say extra cheese. Then she said it was supposed to be made with extra sauce and hey backtracked. The guy was rude and said he didn't want to remake It and if he did he would still put the same amount of sauce on it. Way to please the customer?!!! On top of that we're all the looks between them as if how dare I ask to receive what I ordered. The manager should take care of this and teach the take out side to show the same type of professionalism as the dining are. I don't pay to catch an attitude. 

Dining yes

The very best food I've had in the area- hands down. They have a great ambience, great service and delicious food. Their bread is super good- has garlic and herbs baked into the bread, and their dipping sauce goes so well with it: garlic, olive oil, and pepper flakes for a kick.  My favorite meal here is the lamb shank.  It tickles your palette in all the right ways. There's so much goodness about the dish- basil, garlic, San Marzano tomatoes and gnocchi. Let me tell you how I never even knew I liked gnocchi until I experienced this creation at Gino's. They are like light velvety pillows. I'm not even a big pasta girl and I adore these. The dish is slow braised, tender and moist meat. I wouldn't change or add a thing to it. It's about $30, but you are given a Generous portion. Easily 2.5 meals. The service here is great- they don't come every 5 seconds, but also don't disappear. They have mastered the right amount of contact and top it off with delicious and fresh tasting food.

Did some research on having my LARGE 3 piece sectional cleaned as well as my downstairs carpet after being demolished by a dog we were taking care of. I was being quoted ridiculous amounts of money - up to $500 and when I contacted Sean with Valley Carpet Care his prices are beyond reasonable. $150 for it all. He had excellent availability and i love that he is a family owned business! His son and Sean were very quick and efficient and moved all our furniture back to its normal placement. Our sectional looks brand new and so does our carpet. Highly recommend for both reliability, price, and simply supporting a family owned business.

Finally checked this spot out and certified badass breakfast. The portions were wild, really enjoyed their red potatoes and how they do their biscuits. 

Tbh only thing I didn't like was how our food was served in these pseudo bowls. Hard to cut the food and kinda didn't like how some of the food was served on top of each other.

However the food kicked ass and the staff was super nice! They screwed up one of our orders but we're super apologetic and hooked us up with a new order free of charge.

We will be back

I love costa vida, but if you order through a third party you will not get what you are expecting. Third party is EXPENSIVE and I only do it when I have to, but it sucks when you get your 20$ salad and it has half of what you receive while in store. Just a thought, even though we aren't there watching you make it, doesn't mean you can half ass it and say it's good.

Tonight was date night and a coupon brought us in for dinner. I'd say this night was not off to a good start walked in to find 3 groups of people standing around waiting for the host who was nowhere to be seen. About 5-10 minutes later he comes walking up holding menus guess he was wiping them off which seems odd at 5 the beginning of your dinner rush. He did apologize which is a nice touch yet not necessary when you have a system in place fir your dinner hour which they clear did not on this night. The next snafu was the wait for a waitress; I literally turned on the timer on my phone cause we hadn't seen her yet after 5 minutes. We ended up waiting 15-20 minutes for her to show up. I don't know if I have ever been apologized more to at a restaurant in a while. She even said sorry we are understaffed which I was like why are you telling me that? Clearly the managers here are dropping the ball and the service is suffering. The salad had brown lettuce and the bow tie pasta was umdersauced (more oil than sauce). Clearly the flavor and service were off tonight; did enjoy the coupon buy two meals get 2 free yet it was a very disappointing visit think after this experience it'll be a while till we visit again (if the food and service were better it'd be more often).

The customer service was wonderful when we came in. Our servers were nice and helpful. The only reason this place gets a one star is because the serves were so nice. The pizza was terrible at best. The middle of it was soggy and the flavor was none existent unless you dipped it into a marinara sauce they provided. We also got a calzone which was similar and was just as mediocre. If you want to go get pizza, you are better off going to blaze or to flying pie because their quality and price is much better. It took 45 minutes for one 12 inch pizza and a calzone to be made and brought to our table. I purchased a wine for 11.99 a glass and you can go and buy a wine bottle for $9.00 on the website. What a joke. I will never recommend this place due to the lack of flavor and overpricing this place boasts. Go to dominos. At least they have flavor in theirs.
Do not under any circumstance buy anything from this outfit unless you like getting ripped off

Worst experience ever! I simply asked for 2 Idaho burritos one of them with out sour cream. When I pull up to pay they try to charge me for 3 and the young light skinned Mexican chick with long hair and a visor stands their and still has the nerve to accuse me of lying and saying I never ordered that.. long story short they argued about it for a couple of minutes gave me dirty looks and the girl at the window called me a very inappropriate name in Spanish to her coworkers (not knowing I knew Spanish myself). To top it off my burrito wasn't even rolled it looked like they just threw it in the bag and my burrito still had sour cream. Please if you want a burrito there are better options in the treasure valley and won't have to deal with terrible customer service and being gossiped about in Spanish.

I absolutely LOVE Capital Church. This loving community welcomed me with open arms years ago and I can honestly say my life has forever been enriched and changed because of this local church! If you are looking for a biblically sound, anointed, and spirit-filled church to grow in I would encourage you to check out Capital Church!

PHENOMENAL! The food is so fresh, not your average greasy mediocre breakfast place. They have a fabulous menu. I've had the Idaho potato nacho hash and the Irish Benedict, both one of the best things I've ever had! The staff has been so friendly and helpful every time. Definitely a must have.

I had a very good first experience when Gino's was in Boise, and my second visit years later at the Meridian location was okay ... and just okay.

The most recent visit in January 2019 had some great highlights and an incredibly dim lowlight.

The good: amazing stuffed mushroom app, bread & oil, cocktails, awesome service from Lori.

The bad: very bland gnocchi with an even more boring red sauce that tasted of canned tomato paste, salt, and not much else. My pork dish was fine but my friend's pasta with smoked porcini and pancetta was probably the worst dish of any kind I have had at any restaurant. She should have demanded a replacement but she thought maybe her taste was off. The three others who tried it agreed it had an acrid, chemical taste that we theorize is the result of a batch of burnt pancetta and/or porcini. The chef clearly didn't taste this one before sending it out.

Our party of four will most likely never return, as a kitchen charging  what they are paying so little attention to what is coming out of it doesn't deserve repeat business.

Tonight I phoned for curbside service for the first time. I phoned at 5:10 and said my husband would be there to pick up in 35 minutes. He arrived right on time, went inside to pick up the order and was unceremoniously told to wait in his car. He waited more than 15 minutes of waiting without so much as an acknowledgment.  When he went in to complain they said "well we're busy". 

There are a lot of restaurants in Boise. We won't return to this one

We bought a brand new Hummingbird travel trailer in October last year.  From the day we picked it up we had issues.  This RV should have never been allowed to be sold.  It's been in their shop for over two months getting an entire laundry list of things fixed.  It's a lemon!  I will say I'm thankful for its warranty, but it's very frustrating to have so many issues on a brand new RV.  The service team has been very good at updating us on the status of repairs.   The salesman however never once contacted us to apologize.  In fact every time I've been in the dealership he is "gone".   Go figure!

I'm si in shock right now. I got a sandwich to go, called the manhandler, it was almost 13 dollars, it has brisket and hot sausage on a bun. The side I got was potato salad. First of all that was the worst brisket I've ever had.it was cut in these little squares and seriously tasted like some kind of meat you get out of a can. I live 10 minutes from there and it was ice cold, the bun was stale and the potato salad tasted like that Reisers brand you get at a supermarket deli. The whole thing is in the trash. I will never go there again and never recommend it to any one. I never write reviews let alone bad ones. The worst!

Gabe Johnson made my our experience extraordinary. He was working by himself in a busy location. He was professional, upbeat, positive and made sure he abided to cleanliness standards. Hats off to you young man for showing your great work ethic and extraordinary character!!

This has been my go to neighborhood pub for years. The wings and mushroom bisque are the best in Boise and the service is always personal and top notch.

This is definitely a place where everybody knows your name.

On game days be sure you get here early or you'll have a hard time finding a spot to sit.

Insider tip: Heidi is awesome get her section every chance you get.

There are specials Monday - Wednesday each week, Tuesday night is wing night and worth the trip. The rotisserie wings (ask for them extra crisp) are the perfect wing.

Plenty of taps and a full bar so you won't go thirsty. 

Great for business lunches too.

Don't drive by this place without stopping in, I've eaten here more than a hundred times and never had a bad meal.

Fast service.   Honey almond shrimp was delicious. Use the shredded cabbage to cut the sweet and provide a wonderful crunch. Ordered Pavilion lo mein loaded with goodies and cooked to perfection. I recommend to anyone looking for Chinese/Asian cuisine.

I'm normally leery about going to new restaurants but was way too excited about this going in. I was surprisingly impressed with the service for how packed it was. The space isn't huge so when there's a wait you tend to have to either wait outside or sneak over to flatbread to have a drink like we did. Food was delicious! I'll be back.

We had a great experience with our burritos   legit carne Asada loco & carnitas! Great flavor & GIANORMUS size! Hot sauce was on point! I like it haute. Did not disappoint. Had a chipotle base with a beautiful Chile finish.

We'll be back.
Fantastic service with a smile. Free loan car and prompt service with great communication. Would not hesitate to use them again.

Rudy's is a great place. The servers are always friendly and the food is great. It's also kid friendly if you want to bring the family in. There is a full bar and pool tables and a good selection of drafts.

Here's the thing...I work near here and wanted to give them a second chance.  There used to be a really snotty chick that worked the drive thru and I thought the guy would be better.  I ordered a bean wet burrito.  Not a hard order to fill by any means.  Last week they gave me a steak wet burrito although it was supposed to be bean.  This week they gave me a chicken wet burrito instead of bean.  I confirmed with two people through the drive thru speaker and again at the window.  Got home and found the error.  Called them up and they said they'll give me one on the house.  Long story short...eat inside to ensure your order is correct.

Need a good burger? Tavern at Eagle Island is the place! It can get really busy at dinner, indicating the popularity and good food, so go at off-times and lunch. Drink menu is great. Service has always been exceptional!

I would give this place more stars if i could. As an avid breakfast fan, I'm a harsh critic. I love hash. LOVE. And this place has the best corned beef hash I've ever had. Great waitstaff as well. If you're in Boise, this place is THE place for breakfast.

*update* I will say I messaged them on Facebook and got an extremely quick response from the owners I believe. They went in that day and had a meeting with all parties involved. They asked to give them a second chance and we will because we only had an issue with 1 employee and not the food. We may update again after our next visit. But I do really appreciate the response from the owners. 

Oh my. First off the "manager" is a joke; she is the heavier lady. We stood at the entrance for 5 min before she told us to sit wherever. We sat at the table for another 5 min before I had to stop someone to get menus. Once we finally got our waitress she was very kind and we have no complaints with her. We got our food and everything was good except I needed more Au Ju; the amount I got to start with was so measly. Our waitress said it would be an extra charge. I said no, I don't want it as I should not be charged for Au Ju, no matter what but especially since I had hardly to begin with. I asked for the manger and explained what happened from the start of the sitting issues and what not. Never once was I rude. She instantly said "no problem you don't need to come back." And continues to say they have enough customers and she didn't need us. We were dumbfounded. She was instantly rude when I was just trying to explain how we felt as customers. All she had to do was give me more sauce, as again it was nothing to begin with. But no she instantly got rude and nasty. She then proceeded to say another nasty comment when she brought our bill so I said fine, will just leave (as a joke) and she was like I'll just grab your license plate and call the cops. Jokes on her, we have a temp plate right now lol. We leg had to make her leave our table because she was being so rude. Well I think she complained to the kitchen manager (Brian) so he came to our table. Listened to what we had to say, apologized and took care of our bill. In no way were we looking to get out on our bill. I just wanted decent customer service and some more Au Ju sauce so I could actually dunk my sandwich. I appreciate Brain for his wonderful service. That lady manager needs to go. She was nasty and has zero care for Moe Joes. I promise none of this is exaggeration. The picture of my Au Ju is after I ate maybe 1/2 of my meal.

We had a lovely Valentine's Day dinner.  Sushi was fresh, lots of variety, Dinner box was a great choice for me had everything I love, teriyaki and tempura plus a generous salmon roll.  Great server, good prices, we will be back!

I have been going to Ada West Dermatology for about 3 years now and each time I have had a good experience.  Today's visit was one that I never experienced before. I had a mole surgically removed today from Dr. Funke and Jennifer and was a bit nervous of the procedure since I am pregnant and didn't know how the anesthetic and medication would affect me or my baby.  They both thoroughly explained the procedure and the after care well. I felt very comfortable and the procedure flew by because we were just talking the whole time about our families which took my mind off what was going on.  I wouldn't expect this from any doctor but Dr. Funke called me at 7:30pm...a Friday night to check up on me! She really went above and beyond her job scope with the phone call.  I will continue definitely go back because of Dr. Funke!

Tonight we stopped in at this location for some ice cream.  My son, whom is allergic to peanuts and tree nuts was looking at Flavors when he found one of his favorites, Gold Medal Ribbon.  Excited to get some ice cream we asked the young man behind the counter to scoop from the back with a fresh scoop to be safe.  The "Manager" kid tells us he will have to get special permission to scoop from the back and goes to make a call, I presume to the owner or actual person in charge.  Meanwhile another family enters the location behind us.

When the manager kid sees the other group he loudly tells the two other young people working to "help the NORMAL people in the second group".  Needless to say but I a now very angry and would normally have gone over the counter to address his rudeness.  Instead I asked my family to go outside with me and get in the truck.  Then I go back inside.

Rude manager kid finishes his phone call and comes back to the front counter to tell me he was told he cannot scoop from the back as it would damage the integrity of the ice cream.  Really? The integrity of the ice cream.  Meanwhile the two other young people working there have apologized for their colleagues behavior.  It's nicely as I can I tell manager kid that his behavior is not very accommodating, rude and that we will never return to this particular establishment.  

By the way, the Eagle Island 31 Flavors has always done this for us and when we mention that to manager kid he says "well, the other location is a mess" so if you work there or it is owned by a different party, you may want to let your sister store know you don't appreciate them trash talking you.

I found Paramount Animal Care on yelp after calling another Vet who could not accommodate my Charlie for a nail trimming because they were to busy. I must say I am so Happy the last one didn't work out! I have nothing but great words for them. I walked in at my appointment time was greeted from a very sweet front desk lady, Tech came right out smiling looking for Charlie and within 10 minutes I was on my way home. Thank you, Thank you, I have found my forever Vet

What happened to Johnny Carinos?  It used to be one of my favorite restaurants.   This restaurant had really gone down hill.  The service was horrible.   There wasn't even anyone waiting in the lobby.  The hostess and 2 waitresses just kept walking by for 20 minutes.   I finally had to ask for bread.  Then I asked who our server was.  We finally had to just walk out.  Not recommended and avoid this restaurant is.  We had great service at their competitor across the parking lot!

Had a great lady that cut my hair and set a follow up appointment to finish shaping it.  When I returned she was no longer there and someone took her place.  I was surprised by the amount of hair left in the chairs that were not cleaned prior to her wanting me to sit in them.  That's gross.  Then the sink was acting up so it went from cold to scalding on my head.  Emina did a great job on my hair, initially, but there was a lump of hair in the back of my head I asked if she could correct.  She decided to take thinning shears and instead of correcting the back, completely thinned the left side of my head making it uneven and choppy.  After going home hair continued to fall out for several days leaving me miserable.  I had to go to a different salon (Whimsy A) and the lady was shocked at the different lengths on each side.  She said the left side was so short she could only try to blend it so it wouldn't look as uneven and choppy.  She did a great job but now we have to wait for it to regrow so it can be shaped, once again.  When I called to cancel my next appointment with Emina, I told the lady I would not be back and she didn't care.  I then told her why and again, no real customer service.  I won't go back to SB.  This was not a salon experience and it's no wonder the place was fairly empty.  I do recommend Whimsy A for anyone who wants a professional cut.

my boyfriend and i went in and were taken care of by shelby! she did an amazing job making sure everything was exactly how we wanted. food was amazing and the ambiance was great! thanks again shelby!:)

By far the best chinese food we have found in years.  Food was off the charts good.  There were 4 of us, we ordered 6 dishes cause we just could not decide.  Not one disappointed!   
Only reason I didn't give 5 stars was because of the service.  Lots of waiting for stuff we asked for.  ie: napkins, refills, chopsticks.
We were given 2 menus when sat down.  We asked what the difference was and no one could seem to tell us. hhhhmmm..........
Saw a ton of take out orders going through the place.  I understand why now.........get amazing food, but you don't have settle for poor service.

I really don't get breakfast places around town. This is not much different from the rest of them. I don't think Any of them deserves more than three stars. The variety of food is OK the quality of food is less than OK the taste is not great. Really never understand how they get so many great reviews. Nothing too special about this place another breakfast joint. Apparently over the weekend they are very busy so call ahead to be added to the waitlist. Only off for a black coffee with creamer's. No lattes

I took my husband here for his birthday and it was very worth it. There was a little bit of a wait but since we were ok with sitting in the bar area we got seated quicker.  We got a glass of a Chianti Classico, a cocktail called an Italian Cherry Blossom and a white sangria. They were all delicious and perfectly balanced. For dinner my husband got Saltimbocca which was veal and gnocci and he said it was perfectly cooked. I got the Tortellini and it was also cooked perfectly and wasn't too heavy on the cream and the noodles were perfect. 

We were very happy with the service as they were all very nice. The only reason why I do not give a 5 Star is because out waiter never introduced himself, was a little awkward at first cause we weren't sure if he was or waiter or not. Also we were seated right by the bar, which is not the problem, however, one of the bartenders was very loud and even though everyone else was busy he stood there watching the basketball game and yelled random things at the hostesses.  I'm sure he is a good guy but he just seemed very out of place.

I found out later that it waiter was Nate and he was great. We will be back again.

The service was rude and not helpful. We waited at the front ready to put our name on the list but no one was present for 5 minutes. Then two ladies showed up to help us. They greeted us without a smile or friendly expression. Then they told us it would be a 2 to 3 hour wait even though half the tables were empty. It was the weekend and therefore they should utilize more of their tables. We decided to leave because the environment was not welcoming.
This is my new favorite breakfast place! I will be back often. YUM. I got The Loaded with a side of Lemon Poppyseed Pancakes. Best decision ever.

DO NOT GO TO GINO'S if you enjoy cookie cutter predictable commercialized mediocre Italian food!!! You're going to be disappointed if that's what you're into. IF however, you appreciate a great relaxing atmosphere, a thorough knowledgeable wait staff, phenomenal food and wine then Gino's is for you!!! I have gone about 5-6 Times now and have always had a wonderful time. I'm a creature of habit so I get the spaghetti with ragu baked with 2 AMAZING meatballs covered in cheese.... put it this way, my mouth is watering just writing this. If you love yourself at all treat yourself to an experience at Gino's!!! You will not regret it.

I love everything at Rumbi but the Sweet Pork salad is the best salad in town. It's loaded with goodness and the pork is incredible. The bowls are a must as well but upgrade to a Rumbi rice. Beans and rice are delicious! I only eat zucchini here too. Teriyaki sauce is the best. I could drink it here!

On this visit my waiter was totally arrogant, I asked for balsamic vinegar and he said no (he wasn't kidding) I asked again and he got it for me. I wanted grated cheese on my soup and he said it was already on it but must have sunk to the bottom so I couldn't see it. He finally came with some cheese. I was looking for a TV camera. I was sure this was some kind of put on but he was serious. There is more but that's enough for now.  Food is not consistent. One time the Alfredo sauce is thick and creamy next time it is watery. Minestrone soup is flavorable and another time bland.  If you go there I wish you good luck and hope they have a good cook that day. I won't go back.

I just moved to the area and was hesitant about bringing my cat to a new vet. I went to Intermountain and was so happy with this pet hospital. The staff was BEYOND friendly and knowledgeable. They made me and my baby feel comfortable. The doctor helped us quickly and provided us with an affordable solution. The office was clean and tidy. 
This will 100% be my new permanent vet. 

Thanks guys!
Probably one of my two favorites Grimaldi's and Tony's in the side of Egyptian Theater

With so many other options, I would pass on this place! I ordered their mango salad, the lettuce seemed like it came from a bag, the bowl was too wobbly so that every time you stabbed into their dry, hard lettuce it tipped the bowl over. They give you a small cup of dressing which is not nearly enough for the unappetizing lettuce, the chicken was old, not fresh and practically no cheese. No wonder they give everyone who orders a $5 off your next order coupon!

Bugs! My husband and I had lunch here today. Sad to say that despite the food being good, and wait staff being friendly, we had bugs (larvae, not sure what) in our water, and dirty cups. From what we could see at least 3. But we didn't find them until after we were done with our meal so who knows if it was in anything else. We also ordered a pot of hot tea, and drank several cups. We told our waiter, they stepped aside to contact their manager via phone and when she came back she handed us a free coupon for next time, with a small apology. We are so queasy we won't be back. A report has been made to the health inspector. Might be a dirty/ moldy water spicket or something more serious

This place was so good. The mandarin chicken is great and everything came out so fast, not to mention the service was just awesome! They were so friendly and quick. Try the special menu, I like the green beans and tofu!

This was our first time here and it happened to be the Chinese New Year..unknown to us at the time..lol. However, it started off with my attempt to get my name on this list. Quite comical. Then once seated it was over 10 minutes before anyone checked to see if anyone had taken our order. Food came fairly quickly. Tasted good. Server only checked once, never refilled water glasses. The staff was very disorganized and confused and not a good system in greeting and organizing seating. I'll either do take out or go some place else. May try again when not so busy.

Delicious food and excellent service!  Husband and I came here on my birthday for a healthy meal.  Everything tasted amazing!  We ordered sashimi and seared salmon which were perfect!  Also had one of their salads which was surprisingly so good!My husband enjoyed everything as well.  We know we will be back.  I wish I took pictures of the food, but too busy eating.

Kind of odd experience at this store. The staff was very helpful, I believe I was speaking to the manager, not sure his name. Very helpful laying out the options for I Phone's. I let him know I wasn't buying today but would be back on Sunday. I had turned my current phone over to him so he could check the memory.

I walked out of the store to do some other shopping and then had to take a call in my car. The manager came out of the store walked right up to my driver's side windows & started peering in my windows and when I rolled them down he said he was looking for a customer that was in there earlier.

I was still talking on the phone and just said, "That was really weird."  I kind of expect the Sonic Bell Hops to come up to your car and give you window service but this happening with a Verizon Phone store was a new experience.  

Any of the rest of you have this happen at this or other Verizon locations?

Odd.

This was a great little brunch spot for my mom and I!  Mom had a classic two egg breakfast with bacon eggs and hashbrowns.  She said it was delicious! I had the Philly cheese steak hash, to die for!  Big portions, great prices. I also highly recommend the peach Mimosa!

Today was our first visit & all 3 of us loved it. Excellent rueben with perfectly cooked sweet potato fries. My husband had Caesar salad with grilled chicken. Our guest had Kung Pao calamari (Tender & well seasoned ). We all thoroughly enjoyed our meals. Service was outstanding and atmosphere very comfortable & well designed. A lot of attention to detail from menu options to design of the interior. We plan on returning again soon, 3 thumbs up!

I visit Betos multiple times every week!! They have the best burritos in town. I always have excellent service, but today was a lot different. I asked for green sauce for a total of three burritos!! I was only given two!! Their green sauce is my favorite, and I am really disappointed that I got cheated out of my green sauce. I even mentioned that I was fine paying for extra. Betos, if you are reading this, please don't be so stingy with the sauce!! Two green sauces is not enough for three burritos!! Really disappointed.

We had high hopes after reading all the reviews. Things did not start well beginning with our server Aubrey. She seemed very distracted, couldn't get our order right even after several tries. She would come back to table and ask if things ok and we would have to ask for part of our order that had not been delivered. My husband ordered the meatball calzone with lacked taste and was just bland. NowI'm not a, like it spicey kinda gal, but when I tasted it there wasn't much taste at all  much less a wow factor. I ordered the four cheese pizza and it was same issue, everything just tasted bland, no punch when taking a bite, no pizazz. W had eaten at Louies last week and my husband had a meatball calzone there and it had the wow factor, so this was very much a disappointment. Sitting outside on a hot after noon for lunch, way past lunch crowd, I ordered a sangria. Usually they are crisp and fruity. Mime tasted like red wine with soda water added to it. Strange.   While we were eating our lunch we watched another server clean up table next to us and he just flipped the table cloth over. The patio floor was a mess with spilled food on it and pieces of dropped food not cleaned up. After watching the flip over the table cloth routine it made us wonder what else were they skipping on in the food prepartion and cleanliness. The caprese sald we ordered was very gook but the bottles of vinegar and olive oil were sticky, which made me thing again they have not been washed. Our lunch was on the pricey side 78.00 without tip.  We won't be back, there are so many other Italian  and pizza restaurants to settle on just mediocre with an expensive price tab to go along with it.

We were in Boise on business, and were recommended to eat here. I'm so glad we took the advice and had dinner. Best pizza I have had in a very long time. And the service? Danny was our server and he was a delight. Funny, knowledgeable and in-tune to our needs. Came by our table often enough to keep our needs met, but not so much to be over-bearing. Honestly, just a fun, delicious experience that makes me want to go to Grimaldi's the next time I'm in town (and a little jealous that there isn't one in the PDX).

This is a sorry excuse for a restaurant. The food is AWFUL and it really NEEDS a deep clean.
I've tried it more than once maybe thinking my expectations were too high, but no, this place is REALLY bad, won't be going back 
Rating for me is negative infinity

This was a so-so visit.  The wait on a Saturday morning at 11 AM was minimal.  The atmosphere is loud and conversations echo in the small space. I constantly felt rushed due to how quickly the serves scurried about.

Don't count on being blown away with the eggs or French toast.  The eggs were obviously from a carton and had been sitting in a warming dish waiting for the next order.  It surprises me that the owner prides the restaurant at being everything made from scratch, but doesn't crack the eggs.  The french toast was basic and not sweet at all.  The menu advertised sweet batter....but the toast without syrup was blah. 

Overall, this was not a place I'll be visiting again.  There are many other breakfast places in the area that I would rate as top notch.

We were having a surprise party and ordered food for it at Costa Vida. Everything was perfect. The food was ready at the time we agreed to pick it up, and it was delicious as always! Love this place, the food and the great employees that make it work! Thank you!

From our first visit many moons ago to now, the food has been exquisite and the service awesome!

Please try to get Jessica as your server!  You will be  awestruck from her culinary knowledge and more so from her personality!

Her recommendations were right on!  You look at a menu and pretend you know what you desire.  She then cultivates your desire to an extraordinary dining experience!

Hold table 25 for us!

Took Larry to see Dr Winchester to remove a mole.  Dr. Was great and we were in on time and the procedure for what it was went smoothly and we couldn't be more pleased.  They called that evening to see how he was doing. Good job Ada West Dermatology staff and Dr. Winchester.

They don't even care about cross contamination my sandwich, which was strictly ham and cheese, had the bread smothered in guacamole. To make it even worse the bread was harder than my aunts constipation. The delivery guy was great don't get me wrong, but man that sandwich was lower quality  than the first movie ever made. My manager also ordered and they have forgotten his drink two times in a row. Really not very cash money of you.

Excellent coffee, great employees! Wish there were locations in Seattle! After seeing some pics on Yelp, I'm wishing we would have gone inside to check it out instead of just hitting the drive through. The barrista was very friendly.

I love the bar atmosphere and most of the food is really simple and good. The 3 star is based on the fact that you cannot enjoy outdoor seating on the patio ever, unless you enjoy the smell of disgusting cigarette smoke wafting in your face the whole time. So I don't go very often in the warm weather. I guess it's more of a winter place for me.

These guys are awesome! Before we bought the car someone hacked up wires, added a subwoofer, and terminal head with a butterfly wingnut!? I know crazy stupid stuff. So my girlfriend's daughter was having trouble with her car not starting and after looking at that mess I asked these guys for help on what to do by camera and video I took. (The car was dead at the apartment) They listened and recommended some things for me to get it going. It worked and I brought the car to them to redo all my work and double check everything. It looks great, now starts every time, cant thank these guys enough!!

Visiting town and wanted sushi. We passed by this place and decided to go in. Our chef, Sin, at the sushi bar was super nice. He made the experience for us! He gave us a free mini appetizer and asked us what part of the fish we wanted for our nigiri. Great food and fish as well. When we come back to this area we will definitely be coming back here! Thank you Sin!

I bought a used Ducati Diavel from this place. I am from out of state. Jeremy was the salesperson who handled my purchase. Jeremy went above and beyond to make the purchase possible and as easy as possible. He was very quick and efficient handling the paperwork and shipping the bike. Jeremy sent pictures of the bike before it was shipped to make sure he sent the bike as it was described. I had a very good experience buying from Snake River Yamaha. They are experienced and courteous when handling sales. I would definitely do business with them again and I would definitely recommend them to my friends and family.

The place was packed and with good reason.  May be the best breakfast joint I've ever eaten at. (I'm 59).   The potatoes were especially good.  The toast was excellent.  Coffee was fresh.  What else can I say.  I'll be going out of my was next time I'm in Boise to visit again.

Service horrible. Ready to walk out. Been here for 10 mins without so much as a server visit. 
Do not come here. Worst RR I've been to

UPDATE: we left at ten minute mark. Complained to the Mgr on the way out but she didn't really seem qualified to fix it. And she must have just come in from a smoke break because her breath and the air around her was toxic. I literally could not stand there and carry on a conversation one more minute. She wasn't the only one with hygiene issues. 
Anyway, we will not be back to this one.

I've lived in Hong Kong, Taiwan, and China and this is some of tastiest Chinese food I've had in the states! Mostly familiar Canton classics, but some dishes from other provinces as well. I feel like lots of Chinese joints here are greasy and gross, but our food here was fresh. Do yourself a favor and get the honey shrimp.

We went here the other night and sat in the bar/lounge area. I don't remember the name of our server but he was the best. I really haven't had any bad service at this restaurant, and ALWAYS the best mud pie!!!!

We had a good experience with Idaho Wood Sheds.  They wanted our business and matched and then exceeded a competitor's price.  The shed was built as promised, on time, and without issue.  We are happy with the end product and would not hesitate to recommend Idaho Wood Sheds.

I understand that Les Schwab can be on the high side For tires and automotive services.  But the customer service in this particular shop is outstanding!  When you have a flat tire they take care of you right away with a smile..  For free!  It truly makes me think of them for replacement tires even though they are more expensive.  I'm willing to pay more for customer service.
Fourth Time poached eggs are over cooked.  I know it's a skill,  but come on!!!! Fruit Bowl, very sparse!!! Sad,  It's Our Favorite Place

Bowie and Darby love staying here when daddy and mommy go out of town. They get to play outside and 
They get to stay in a suite together. They also get extra love and care. And are always happy when we pick them up.
Love the Veggi Section in the menu!! It's wonderful to have some great veg options and this is the perfect spot for a lunch or dinner indulgence! Two big thumbs up

Terrible service. My family were here a week or so back. The place was not to busy yet by the attention we received they seemed understaffed. There were 7  members at our table and our food came out in waves. My youngest boys were done eating before some of us ever got our food. Our drinks were usually empty, and we could hardly complain as our waitress  was not ever nearby. The "limitless" soup and salad would have been nice except that once she dropped off the first round, we did not see her again until see was bringing out the first wave of food, which was 15 minutes later. At that point it still took several  more minutes for her to return with our drink refills. The rest of our meals were still a few minutes away. They used to be so good. Wtf carinos?

I come to this location every morning on my way to work. I get a cold brew with 2 extra shots. This morning, I pull up to the window and my drink was already made and ready. Im not sure of the girls name that made it but, kudos to her for having it already made, awesome .

Great authentic Chinese food in the Treasure Valley! They have 2 menus; 1 is the normal 'Americanized' Chinese food menu, and the other one is Szechuan menu. Of course we went by the authentic Szechuan menu. Szechuan is famous with their spicy food and since my kids are older enough, we ordered 2 spicy food and 2 normal. We had (spicy) salt and pepper pork, (super duper spicy) Szechuan fish and veggies in a bowl with habanero sliced spicy soup, beef chowfun, and green beans and chicken dish. They were all DELICIOUS! The salt and pepper pork was cut bite sizes, battered, and deep fried. The chowfun was good, a bit too oily. It was made not spicy at all. The fish in a bowl was sooo spicy. It was good, we did not need any hot sauce for that. It had sliced habanero in the soup. Steamed fish fillet with beansprouts, cut up napa cabbage, celeries all in a spicy soup. I could not sip any soup bec my tongue was on fire. The last dish was the greenbean and chicken, with mushrooms and onions. It was very tasty! Friendly staff and we came at the right time, before the crowds came in. We told them to stay authentic. We will come back to try more.

First time here. Had a pickup order for work. I was really excited for my Irish Egg Benedict. Got to work. Hollandaise sauce is good. Corned beef is good. Eggs are hard poached...really over cooked. That ruins a Bene.  Fail.

Yummmmmm! Had to get some potatoes while in Idaho. Their breakfast potatoes are to die for! Had a simple breakfast with my husband it was quick clean and delicious! There jam with toast hit the spot as well. If you're ever in town again will definitely be back

The service is great but the food is bland my husbands fettuccine tasted like a hot dog. I asked for angelhair and they gave me bow tie and they did that the last time we were here as well. Definitely could use some more seasoning in their food. Used to be way better was definitely disappointed

I have always heard great things about this place, and maybe it was a different loation, but I was sorely disappointed. We ordered chicken alfredo, a steak platter, and tradition meatballs and spaghetti. It was the most bland food we have ever tasted. We were really hungry, and still o ly took a few bites before deciding it wasn't even good enough to finish. The meal didn't taste bad, but I could have made a better tasting meal from the walmart discount rack. We spoke to the manager and he didn't seem too concerned with righting the wrong. In the end, the waitress was the one to discount the meal. I still think we shouldn't have had to pay for the food because it was SO below what you'd expect from an Italian restaurant. The only bright spot was the waitress. She was great at ger job and quick to help. I will never go here again..

Atmosphere is clean and simple.  Service was friendly and efficient.  Food was excellent.  I'm not sure what the soup was, but the broth was both light and rich-tasting with vegetables and rice threads.  Cashew Nut was mouthwatering--tender chicken, vegetables perfectly cooked, rich brown sauce, and a nice bit of spice from red pepper (no spice rating; this makes me thing one ought to consider the spice ratings a little under scale).  And the Sticky Rice with Mango!  Fresh mango served in the skin and prepared for easy eating, with coconut sticky rice that tasted of dreams.  I will be back.  I will send my family.  I will suggest it to my friends.  I highly recommend it to the readers of Yelp.

This is the best place for Italian food ever! Can't go into a lot of detail. It's wonderful. There's nothing wrong with the place. Just go there! I'm from Virginia Beach and I look for the best. This is the best exclamation
Meh The food was OK but I certainly do not understand with all the five star ratings are for a strip mall restaurant

I'm really bothered by some of their pricing practices at this location. Routinely (and I waited till it happened 3 times before writing this review), they will put sale price tags in front of non-sale similar products to make you think they are on sale. When you get to the register, you either don't notice they ring up at full price, or you don't want to wait 5 minutes for a price check.
This is consistently the case with the soda isle. Let's say Pepsi 2 liters are on sale (like they were today). They will literally COVER UP all the other full-price labels of the other drinks so all the way down - Pepsi, Diet Pepsi, A&W, Sprite, Mtn Dew, Coke, Dr. Pepper - all show the sale price. You need to look closely at the tag to match the SKU or product code to the original label, or look closely at the tiny printing to make sure you are buying PEP2LNR instead of PEPDT2LNR (the DT means Diet). They did this on the endcap products as well where the sale item doesn't even exist (but all the non-sale sodas do) and in the front of the store, where stacks of non-sale sodas brightly display the sale price for a different product.
This is maddening, makes it take much longer to: verify the right item; find the actual price on the covered up items; and see if the item you want is on sale.
There's no doubt this is done on purpose - it makes an entire aisle look great, everything's on sale, just pick what you want... when in reality only the product that covers 8 inches of space is actually on sale.
Nice ambiance and feel for breakfast.  Wait staff was great.  My meal was good and I will return.

Very fast and friendly service.  Everything we tried was great and we are generally picky about our Sushi.  Just moved to the are so we followed the reviews and were not disappointed.  We will be back.....often.
Best breakfast I've had in a long time..the farm house was so tasty.  Service was fast and friendly
We had an excellent meal. For just being open there were no snafus. Waiter was great and prices were reasonable.

as i try more of their fare, it's entirely possible i'll give them another star, but at only one visit, i'd say this place is doing a-ok so far.

seated earlier than the host advised, we got prompt and attentive service. everyone in our party of 3 was happy with their meals. my fiesta hash was so far the best mexican food i've had since moving here. my son got the bb hash, and my husband got the chicken fried steak with gravy and eggs. the portions are so generous that the two pieces of toast that come with the plates wind up as overkill! only my son, the bottomless pit, was able to eat it all.

you definitely get your money's worth here. it's a well run restaurant.
Long wait but so worth it for the food.  Clean, friendly great place to go and eat. Breakfast places in Boise that are actually really good are far and few between. Love this place!
Great place and very quite.  The wait staff was very polite.  I ordered spicy tuna hand rolls...which were amazing.  I'd recommend them.  Very flavorful and the perfect amount of spicy.

From the start: Our server, Halee, kept the glasses full, the smile on her face, and paid attention to us. Such a change from the usual around here. I ordered the Tavern Burger cooked medium. That is exactly how I got it, wow! I have been trying to get a burger cooked right for 15 years in Idaho. Garlic aioli was great, the bun was delicious. Toppings were fresh. I don't care for the steak fries, too big, a nice twice cooked fry would be better, but the burger was so big I didn't have room for them anyway. I never thought a twelve dollar burger would be worth it, this one was. Most places want to serve you a ten dollar burger cooked to hockey puck consistency, dry and underseasoned. My gal had the same experience. Everything was just great! We will be back once a week to try something else. I have to try the Reuben, I haven't had a good one yet in Boise. Thanks Tavern, for renewing my faith in the possibility of getting a good meal, you guys rock it.

UPDATE (2nd Visit): Came here again for the second time. Here are some additional points I'd like to touch on, this is just an addition to my initial review.

I said it before, I'll say it again, this place gets PACKED on weekends. They actually don't allow reservations anymore on the weekend (could be viewed as good or bad, up to you). We (party of 2) came at 11AM on a Sunday, got put on the list, and actually sat down at 12:00PM (60 minute wait). This was just for 2 PEOPLE! Ordered food at 12:05 PM, received it at 12:35 PM (30 minute wait). I wouldn't have been as upset as I was if it wasn't for the fact that a party of 4 sat next to us 5 minutes after we sat down, and they got all their food prior to us. Apparently Moe Joe's is actively trying to expand their operations and get a bigger restaurant, so the wait issue should be resolved sometime in the future, but I'm still taking a star away for this.

If you're planning on eating here on the weekend, I'd say come here after 12. They close at 2PM, and from both the times we've visited this place, right after 12 is when all the tables are cleared up and there is literally no wait.

Food was just as good the second time around as it was the first. If you're ordering a breakfast meal that comes with toast, I'd HIGHLY recommend substituting the toast and paying an extra $2 for their Cinnamon Roll French toast side. TRUST ME ON THIS ONE. You can also substitute the toast and pay an extra $1 for a pancake, which was also very tasty actually, but that French toast side is just unreal. I included all pictures of the food (meals, French toast side, pancake, etc) for reference. 

INITIAL REVIEW (1st Visit): This place gets SUPER packed in the morning on the weekends. We came here on a Sunday around 12:30, and only had about a 10 minute wait. Inside is a little small, but feels cozy and modern. Good lighting, especially if you sit next to the front windows. Can get a little loud at times, just depends if there are a lot of kids eating.

Their menu is very unique, and has lots of breakfast choices. Since this was our first time, we decided to get The Smokehouse Hash and Garden Hash. Both were VERY tasty, and super fresh (Garden Hash especially). The portions were just right, I have a very high metabolism and can usually just keep on going on food, but after eating The Smokehouse Hash, I felt just right. I also ordered a side order of fruit, and it was fresh as well. It's a good dessert option in my opinion, but it didn't look as good as someone else's fruit cup that they posted a picture of on here. Mine didn't have the melons, or as much blueberries.

There's plenty of parking here (it's kind of in a business / strip mall type of area where there's shared parking between the businesses). Service was good, no complaints really.

I feel like this place is very unique, in terms of the food and the way it's presented. I REALLY enjoyed this place. Although Steve's Cafe will always have a place in my heart, I feel like Moe Joe's is tastier / healthier. You do get a better bang for buck at Steve's Cafe (they really give you a lot of food), but Moe Joe's really is something special. 5 stars EASY & YOU BETTER BELIEVE I'M COMING BACK HERE...

Was just in there on Monday, President's Day, today is Saturday and I have already had two acrylic nails break. I've ever had this happen before. The service wasn't up to par either. Disappointed and won't return.
Gino's immediately made us feel welcomed and seated us right away.  The servers were friendly and warm, providing great service.  We enjoyed the tasty food and look forward to our next visit.

If you like $10 tomatoes with mozzarella on them for an appetizer and 90% crust with some tomato sauce and some cheese in what is the sorriest excuse for a pizza, this is the place for you. 10/10 would not recommend.  And I never write reviews so you know it's worth the visit.

Some of the best Chinese food in the area. Most of the dishes rival more expensive restaurants such as PF Chang's.  I would give the food 5 stars.  Only reason for 4 stars is the take out process is not very smooth.  It does not matter how far in advance you order or how busy or slow they are, once you show up to pick up, you will wait another 15-20 min.  Almost feels like they don't make the food until you show.  However if you want Chinese, it's worth the wait.

Fabulously made over, the only thing reminiscent of the Sand Man is the sign.  Great management making an effort to make this hotel a place to stay in Meridian!
OMGosh - such comfy brand new beds! Walking distance to the water park and pinz bowling!!

I had all home locks rekeyed couple years ago and received outstanding service.  Price very reasonable.
So glad I kept this business phone number handy.  Recently, had an issue with the bathroom door not opening.  (so glad that no one was stuck in the bathroom!)  Called Jim and he came out to resolve the issue right away!  
Would highly recommend this business!

We love this place! We've never had a bad experience here, and the service is always top-notch. We tend to drift in after the rushes, so I can't speak to any wait times. We've never had to wait for a table. We always get plenty of food, and it's always delicious. I really enjoyed the salmon Benedict on my last visit! If that's something you like, I highly recommend theirs.

A great place to board your pet. Very friendly staff, and they send daily pictures to let you know how your loved animal babies are doing. Very clean and great amenities offered that you can choose from to make sure your pet is well looked after. Very comfortable leaving my 9 year old German Shepherd. Happy to see her belongings were actually given to her while she was in their care! Thankful for an honest boarder.

Unfortunately today Famous Dave's pulled me from my review hiatus. While the food is average to above average for commercial BBQ the service was deplorable. The general service during our meal was sub-par. Out of a party of five one person received a drink refill. Requests for condiments resulted in another condiment being brought to the table. The ultimate issue is when it came time to pay. The server did not apply my gift card to my order. After bringing this to his attention he took my card to correct the issue. He returned, and had applied my gift card to another tables order and also used my card to pay for the remainder of their order. I've now overpaid my order and paid for another table, I have not heard from a manager, the server has taken my card yet again and I have written this review while waiting over thirty minutes for the issue to try to be resolved. Good news is another server just came and refilled my drink for the first time. I'd like to let you all know the conclusion of my evening, but the time for polite language has passed.

Ok I can't leave you hanging. My card was repeatedly run until I was broke. The waiter returned to let me know that they had figured it out and that they would run the card for the right amount once the funds were available. I was very disappointed that all of this happened, and we were kept waiting forty minutes without hearing from the manager. I couldn't leave broke without assurances that I wasn't buying dinner for the entire restaurant and requested to speak with the manager. After clarifying with Drew that there were charges on our card that were for other tables he assured us that all charges would be voided and only our charge reapplied. A heated discussion between my wife and the manager regarding the excessive amount of money unavailable to us resulted in the decision that all charges would just be voided.

TL;DR
Poor service
Inexperience
Manager presence and issue resolution non-existent

I have had much better in Boise.  We took my granddaughter for her birthday and she was very disappointed.  Prices are way to high for the amount you get and there is no flavor, it was very blan. 
Gino wasn't the nicest either when we told him we knew his brother.  He avoided us the rest of the night.
We definitely won't be going there again.

Normally, I have great experiences at IPC, but the Meridian location was a serious ordeal. A family had accidentally spilled their drinks with FRESH ice cubes all over the carpet. I almost sprained my ankle fumbling on one with my heeled boots. I immediately told the attendant who completely negated the ice by complaining, "It was THAT lady!!" Unbelievable! Not only did Ashlyn place blame on the customers, but ignored a fall risk after being notified of the liability. She failed to pick up any of the ice cubes. I spoke with the manager, but nothing  was really done about it. The owner of IPC needs to know about fall risks and train their employees of the seriousness of safety. I even warned Ashlyn that my son is disabled and if he trips and hurts himself, I could potentially sue. No response. I almost hurt myself! No apologies in sight from Ashlyn with the exception of utter disdain for my visit.

You pay an office fee of $78 just for them to LOOK at your beloved animal, they tell you "Yeah your pet is definitely sick" (no shit that's why you're there), then they say to find out why they're sick they have to do tests, but they don't know which tests to do so they want to do like 5 (each costing over $100), you pay for the most recommended test, when it comes back normal and you're hesitant to keep playing the guessing game they scare you with the cancer word, when you can't afford any more testing they say if you can't afford care you should euthanize. Thanks for nothing and taking my money.

Humph!.... so, before I input our impression, may I say, we LOVE Grimaldi's.  We have been to Brooklyn, and several others of the Grimaldi's restaurant s, and tonight... here in meridian Idaho, my bruschetta's, which the bread is supposed to be fried or grilled in olive oil, which adds flavor and balance to  your dish.   Here we were served our bruschetta dry toasted bread referred to as toast tips... and they were cold.  The toppings were delicious enough, though sparse... and the traditional tomato basil needed more garlic and more basil.   Our pizza, which was a Brooklyn, had teeny tiny little pieces of sausage, and the ricotta was also such teeny tiny little droplets... all over the pizza.   And then it was served with the question of 'would you like garlic powder or oregano '?    I'm pretty sure our eyes popped out of our sockets.  Lol.... what?  We asked.   This is not the place I have come to know and love.   The pizza was bland, and lacked flavor.    There was No semolina on the crust bottom, and the pizza tasted ordinary and to be truthful flat and flavorless.    Sooooo disappointed!     For dessert, we chose an Italian classic-- Cannoli!   The Cannoli filling tasted like sweet, Sweet frosting rather than subtly sweetened ricotta.    Again-- disappointed.   On a good note, salad was fabulous and generous, customer service fabulous.    I won't write them off this trip, after all this could have been tonight's working kitchen crew... but I also won't be arranging my whole trip around a visit to Grimaldi's in meridian. ... so though the food was pleasantly presented, and good, it wasn't fabulous like Grimaldi's have always been....a very 3 star pizza tonight!

These guys are seriously amazing. My dogs have been going here for the last 5 years and they always do an amazing job but today they went above and beyond again! My friend and I scheduled a play date today for our two dogs to meet and jokingly said we wanted them to be boyfriend and girlfriend and asked for pictures of them playing together. They totally ran with the idea and we got an email from the manager kourtney saying she had put a little something together for us at pick up. They printed pictures and made a marriage certificate for our puppies, seriously the cutest thing ever. I highly recommend taking your dogs here and hats off to you kourtney for being amazing as usual, my dogs love you!

Long story short Marbella was referred to me by a friend. Got in touch with her to have my hair done. She was booked for quite a while. So she booked me with another gal in early August and booked me in early October for my next appointment. 

My appointment with Kayla in August was great, loved her and my hair. I met Marbella at this appointment as well. 

Left work early for my appointment in early October and got to Paradigm and waited about 20 minutes before learning that Marbella had forgotten my appointment. She had no recollection of it. I get it mistakes happen but her lackluster attempt to correct the situation was horrible. Rolling your eyes at me while you deny knowledge of my appointment doesn't make you want to sit in a chair to share an appointment with someone. She made me feel like I just picked a random hair place and walked in and claimed to have an appointment. 

I left bewildered and messaged her when I got home, she read my text and did not respond until the next day. She must have seen our texts from months ago. She was slightly nicer but... reconfirmed that she could have done my hair and someone else's hair at the same time. I standby that it is not typical or acceptable to either person paying to get their hair done to share an appointment. It is already a lengthy process. Very little was actually offered by her to correct her mistake. 

In between my appointment with Kayla and my missing appointment with Marbella my friend had seen Marbella and didn't get what she asked for and also had less than stellar customer service. I would have gone somewhere else to see Kayla but I would never go to this salon again.

Horrible customer service. I called in to make sure my party of 6 could be seated, and they said no problem. When we arrived they turned us away and were very rude to us. It seemed like they were uncomfortable with the fact that we had two children with us. Not family friendly, rude staff, never going back.

Great breakfast!  I hate to admit this but I could not find this place initially. It was on the SIDE of the building.  

With that said, we (I took my wife with me) totally enjoyed our meal - it was a nice dining experience!

This is not the first time we have dined at Gino's, but certainly left a bad impression. We made reservations as suggested and were seated at the end of a row sticking out into a common walk area by staff and patrons... there were FIVE other available tables between our section and the other waiters section. 
We felt very rushed to order and our food came out almost simultaneously with the appetizer. Our waiter John never offered us the specials, however we could hear him offering it to the table seated next to us. My husband had ordered a glass of wine and when offered another glass he was only 1/3 done with his current serving and John simply came and topped it off instead of bringing another. We are paying for a full glass of wine... not the top off. My husband veal was overdone and rather thin, hardly edible, which overshadowed the other pasta plates which were excellently executed. Next time we come we will ask for Cam, he was thoughtful and did not rush us at all. In fact his section had patrons there before ours and were still there after, ordering drinks and coffee well after their relaxed and well timed meals.

I literally ran in this store cause I discovered I needed two (2) new front tires hours before a long drive to California and less than an hour before an appointment in Boise. They understood my plight and in 20 minutes my tires were paid for, replaced, and I was driving away. I've NEVER had such amazing and quick service! A HUGE high five to all that got me to my appointment early!!!
Great atmosphere and a decent beer selection. Good luck finding a parking spot. I had to park down the road and walk.

Yes. I'm a coffee snob. It wasn't always this way but being a snob now the regular cup of coffee just doesn't do it for me. Hey, I didn't say I'm a foo foo coffee drinker with swirls and tons of vanilla syrup either. So what's the deal.  Here's what it is. It's all in the bean. Yeah that's right the bean and how it's roasted.  Not all coffee is the same and everyone likes their coffee a certain way.  I know you guys want to know how I like my coffee and I'll tell you, I love it dark and bitter. Some of you may say that it fits my personality, and on some days, you're right it not only fits my personality but my soul.  For the rest of the days, I think it balances my overly positive attitude and keeps me grounded ( coffee pun ). I like Blackrock because it's not Human Bean or Dutch Bros. While those guys are ok, it's not me and my personality but most of all, I'm not fan of added sugars to my drinks. 

Most of all, the staff at each location is genuine and really knowledge about coffee. 

Okay. What's my drink.  Here it is. 

Large Fuel ( 5 shots ) sub coconut milk no vanilla 

Told you.

If I could give this place zero stars I would. The wait was way longer than stated. There was no clear management or method to seating people in the correct order. It was dirty and they couldn't keep up with cleaning. 

The food was soggy and no flavor or burnt undertones. They forgot our fried rice and appetizer till after we finished eating and asked multiple times for it, never refilled our drinks even with trying to get their attention. If you think this is good Manadarin food you've obviously never had good Chinese food.

Late breakfast today, so we headed to our neighborhood favorite spot, Moe Joe's.  This place is very popular, especially on Saturdays. If you want a weekend breakfast, plan on getting there early or plan on waiting a while.  At 10:30 a.m. today, we had a 30 minute wait, but that was okay for me.  My wife and I both ordered fried eggs over-medium with bacon.  They cooked the over-medium eggs just right...  Not too cooked and not too raw.  I got the regular hash browns, but my wife got the house specialty "Joe Potatoes" (sorry, I can't remember exactly what they are called).  News Flash:  The specialty Joe Potatoes are much better than the regular hash browns!!!  Our bacon was nice and crispy, just the way I like it, and the strawberry jam on the sourdough toast tasted homemade.  My wife got the pancake, and she says she thinks Moe Joe's pancakes are one of the best in the valley.  So, for a standard breakfast fare, this place really does a great job.  Add to the fact that it's in our neighborhood, it's a natural choice for us.

[ At the tee box about 15 yards in front of us were some ducks waddling by. I teed off and hit the ball fairly low and came pretty close to hitting one. My dad said, "good thing he ducked to get out of the way." ]

Went to Wingers today for a work lunch. This is probably the 4th time I've been here and I just don't like the food. I had a a decent bbq chicken salad last time so I ordered it again and today was BAD- chicken tasted like it was burned but it was so rubbery I couldn't get past the first bite. The reason they still get 3 stars is bcuz our waiter was really great and the fried asparagus appetizers as delish. Oh and the ranch is better than most.
We've been here a couple of times, and it's always great! You can't beat the craft beer selection, and make sure you have Kyle help you in the bar. He is top notch!

Ordered potstickers as well as the General Tsao's chicken with brown rice. Overall, the food was great! The potstickers had a good filling, and the chicken had a nice crunch too it. However, the service was lacking a little. It took 5-10 minutes just to get a table and the server came by my table only once outside of bringing the food and the check, even though it was not too busy of a night.

We were so excited to try Grimaldi's after it being recommended by local family.  We arrived 40 minutes prior to closing.  I asked the hostess if they would still seat for dinner. In a whiny voice I was told that they "close in 40 minutes".  I said ok, but can you answer if you still seat. She replies again in a whiny voice "well, we can, but we close in 40 minutes."  I replied ok, we would like to eat there and could we sit on the patio (where 3 groups of people were eating). She looks at the patio and says in a whiny voice again: "No, no, we close in 40 minutes and you can't sit out there."  Part of the charm of this establishment and others is that they all have patio dining around water fountains that are lit up at night.  We called a different restaurant at the same mall location and were happily seated and served.  

*Note: my husband did call and ask to speak with the manager to let him know how they are treating customers and losing business. He was apologetic.

Every time and I mean every time I go to Red Robin it is an ordeal of some sort.  My word of advice is make sure you have a lot of time!  The variety of dipping sauces, camp fire being my favorite, make up for the long wait, however.  You can't find anything like it elsewhere.  Burgers are good and the fries and even better. I give a 2 stars because of the consistent wait times.  There is no reason for an hour and a half needed to grill burgers and fries.

Been coming here for years now. If your looking for a place that isn't a chain and always taste better than places like that come here. Don't like mushrooms but family always raves about the mushroom bisque. I'm a fan of the sandwiches though. Nachos are good too. Never had anything I didn't like here. Very accommodating if you don't like something they'll make it right.

The parts department is amazing. Went to the competition next door and they were rude and didn't have the part. Went to Bish's and Phil helped me find the right parts in about 5 minutes and I was on my way. I'll be back for all my RV needs.
This was such good breakfast, we will definitely return and our waitress was top notch!

I went in for a pink and white full set. The salon is very visually pleasing; very fun and bright. The location was so convenient for having a fun girls night. Unfortunately, my manicure went terribly. 

At first the nail tech tried to convince me to get regular acrylics as they were cheaper, but I insisted on getting the pink and white service that I had requested when I booked my appointment a week in advance. This should've been my first sign. I spent the next two and a half hours watching in complete horror what was happening to my nails. It was clear that the tech was new, however she was extremely nice and kept insisting that she would come back to fix her mistakes. After a while I kind of accepted the fact that I wouldn't be happy with the service, and finally said they looked okay, accepted a discount "for my patience," and left. 

I spent the rest of the night hoping that j could find someone to "fix" them, but by morning they were already beginning to lift. I knew they would have to come off and be completely redone. A 2.5 hour manicure that didn't even make it 12 hours? That's just insane. 

I gave this place three stars because they were incredibly nice and reasonable when I called to complain. Within five minutes of me sending pictures of my nails, they called to offer a full refund and a coupon if I wanted to try their salon again. I declined.

Called ahead of time and they said that since I already had gel on my fingers it would be $20 for new polish and set. Ok. The woman who did my nails and the woman that helped me spoke MINIMAL English, and I wasnt able to understand. During my polish change, while she was shaving down my nail, she hit my cuticle and I jumped. She then grabbed my hand and continued, hit the SAME SPOT, and it started bleeding. She didnt apologize, but then grabbed some left over cotton and put alcohol on it to put on the cut. Then brushed over it with the duster used to dust the shavings from peoples nails. Finished the polish removal (never been so happy to complete a manicure in my life), and got up to the cash register to be charged $28. She initially didnt show me or tell me what I was being charged until I asked TWICE. She just insisted I pur my pin in. I asked why it was $28 and she said they added a $5 fee on top since I came from a different salon initially. Had to have another girl come over to translate for me and then she tells me the initial lady added $3 to the $25 because I had told her to tip herself $3. SHE LIED. I ended up paying $25 and walking out LIVID. My nails are awful, hand has polish all over it and my pinky is cut. DO NOT GO HERE

Been going to this Idaho Pizza for years now for the lunch buffet. I go at least once a week sometimes twice and always meet 1 or 2 others there to eat with. It is usually pretty good but the quality and really gone downhill. They cook the pizza too far ahead of time then keep them in a warmer, not good for the pizza at all. I really noticed when we went to the new Idaho Pizza in Nampa near the car lots. SO GOOD! Pizza is cooked fresh and put on the buffet line right from the oven. They also have dipping sauce for the bread sticks, smart. All Idaho Pizza locations need to take notes from this one. I work in Meridian most of the time so I will be taking the drive to Nampa to this Idaho Pizza from now on.

Gino's is an authentic Italian restaurant.  Great food, wine and the ambiance is nice as well. It is our to go to restaurant when we are feeling like Italian food. 
Service is great too!
Okay, are Jimmy peppers like, really expensive? Because, whenever I ask for "extra" I get 5. This is my story. Please review and grow from this feedback.

Friendly people - genuinely!  Treated with respect and truly interested in helping us find what was right for us. Tim Sharp and Art Vargas took time to listen and then to explain in depth the answers to all our questions as well as educate us on even more. The one phrase that we heard over and over was "we want you to be absolutely sure that you are getting exactly what you want". This ensures repeat customers which is what we will be!

Absolute slowest service ever. Avoid this branch at all costs. Good credit union, terrible branch. Staff has no clue how their loans even work, and were super rude and inconsiderate towards me. Shame on you.

Food is decent. Ordered a lasagna, surprisingly better than Louis down the road. The only thing this place has going for it is the breadsticks, which they know we will ask for more so why only give 2 breads when 3 of us are sitting there.. anyways ordered a chicken Alfredo, as well, chicken came out rubbery and thin. The pasta was good but overall seeing that just killed my appetite. Honestly the food is rated a 2 but I rated this a 3 because of the feeling you get being around friends and family. Yes it's like anywhere else but, it's a good at home feeling here..: as long as you choose a booth.

Had a great experience.  Front office staff pleasant and efficient.  Doctor (PA) Steve was funny and easy to talk to.  Took care of a few brown spots on my face (with freezing spray) at no charge!  The nurse was  also efficient and had a great sense of humor.  I'm glad I chose Ada West Dermatology.

This is the best place to bowl in meridian.  Friendly staff, fair and competitive pricing make this my favorite past times.  Go hungry and try one of their succulent burgers paired with a craft cocktail from the bar and indulge in an experience that will leave you wanting to come back again and again.

Fresh organic produce.  Artisan cheese section.  Both with increasingly interesting array of options as two key reasons this Fred Meyer has moved to "second chair" replacing Boise's Whole Foods in our affection.

KROEGER'S WANTS TO 'EAT WHOLE FOODS' LUNCH': 
Metaphorically speaking, that lunch eatin' thing.  That is Fred Meyer's parent, Kroeger, started to execute a a plan a couple of years ago to up their game in organic produce, brands of natural specialty foods and artisan cheeses to try to attract shoppers who might otherwise spend grocery dollars at Whole Foods.  It worked for us.  We used to shop Whole Foods once every week or two and largely for the organic produce, cheese and the limited amount of animal proteins we consume.  But once the CoOp opened in Meridian and this Fred Meyer, close to home, upped their produce, natural foods and cheese game, using the CoOp as primary shopping and this FM as second chair, we probably shop at Whole Foods but once a quarter now and largely for animal proteins.

GREENS N THINGS:
The organic produce at this FM location gets better all the time. Mostly NW sourced and along with the usual suspects of things like onions, potatoes, peppers, leaf lettuces, scallions, celery and carrots they have a growing (no pun intended) selection of  less usual things that we love like Romanesco, Spring turnips, Breakfast radish, Escarole and others.  If you hit it on the right days, the organics  are uber fresh.  And very often lower priced for as fresh or fresher product than competitors.  If I could wave a magic wand I'd up the options for organic fruit but most fruit is more perishable than green produce and if consumers don't buy it, Fred Meyer won't be able to carry it.   Buy it or lose the options, folks.

OYMPIA PROVISIONS IS "IN THE HOUSE" @ CHEESE SECTION:
The guy who manages the specialty cheese counter, Mike, is a very nice man and savvy about products carried.  You may not find the breadth of selection through Kroeger's buyers that you will at Whole Foods, but still a good set of options and prices on brands like Seattle based Beecher's are great.  They also carry the accoutrement to go with cheese like good artisan crackers, including Beechers, and cheese friendly confiture.  (Try a fig jam with gorgonzola dolce or quince paste with manchego.)  Mike also just started carrying Olympic Provisions charcuterie including dry sausages and pate at the cheese counter!  Once you taste these you'll understand why the Portland based darling brand has such fans everywhere. A loaf of bread, charcuterie, great cheese and fruit and call it dinner. 

LIMITATIONS: 
Alas, you'll need to look elsewhere for good bread since Kroeger doesn't allow for the location to bring in local bakers like Acme or Gaston's.  Fred Meyer also lacks a good deli or good sources of humanely, sustainably raised animal proteins.  Plus they will always carry the plethora of processed foods that make up the Standard American Diet.  While I consider that a major drawback, I understand most people eat it and so it goes.  But they are doing a pretty good job of growing into an organic and natural foods source too.

THIS N THAT:

1) See my original for parking and accessibility.

2) BARGAIN FLOWERS: Here I'll offer a floral note.  A pretty decent floral department but the trick is to look in the "marked down" section (on the wall near the "quick check out" registers) where on some days they'll have pretty fresh bouquets at deep discount that you can "edit" to use for a dinner party or guest rooms and the flowers will be at their prime and looking lovely if you only need them for three or four days.  (As for the guest rooms, who would want guests staying longer than that anyway?)

Hot water is a must to run a restaurant properly. Apparently, the management staff at Johnny Carino's feels that hot water is only needed sometimes or when the restaurant is slow. Your management staff really needs help in dealing with unhappy customers. And to the GM that called me.
