I hope you did pass the message to your chain of command that I wanted to talk to someone above store level. You all apparently did not get that part of the message when I asked for someone above store level to call me. Also Mr. GM, your guests do not care that you took the night off because you worked the last 2 weeks straight. That is the nature of the beast if you work as a restaurant general manager. It is your store and the buck stops with you. If you are so quick to make up excuses why something when wrong I can see why your restaurant was operating like a grease fire Friday night, and your staff acts lost in times of stress during a rush. Employees follow leadership or lack there of.
Our go to place for good Chinese food. Only wish it was closer to us. Always enjoy there daily special whatever it is.

I am a  breakfast guy and most of the time get disappointed when eaten breakfast at restaurants. I am picky about my gravy and other things. Long story short this place is well worth it. Great food, great portions, great flavor and good ingredients. Will definitely be going back this Sunday after church

Just left Grimaldi's at The Village. Thank you for taking care of us Madison and making menu suggestions. Started out with the Caprese which was fresh and a perfect starter. We ordered The Don pizza (meatballs, Italian sausage and pepperoni) which was a great balance of meat, cheese and traditional red sauce. Nothing better than a brick oven crust and yours was nice and chewy with a great smoky flavor. 

Thank you to Mike, the manager, who came over after hearing it was our first time there, and wanted to make sure everything was satisfactory. Guess what Mike...you earned some new patrons today. Thank you for going above and beyond!! I'll be back just to buy your made in house cheesecake-it was delicious. The texture was perfect and that berry sauce had just the right amount of tang! Again, THANK YOU!!

I got 2 garden wraps total was 20$ the wraps had hardly anything in them. For 10$ a wrap I expect to see more full of veggies. I won't be returning to eat here because of this. Way too expensive for what you get.

Friendly service- tasty dishes- bright atmosphere

Have been here a few times, this time ordered the chilaquiles- yummy- but wish they made their own tortilla chips vs using chips from a bag. Large portions given. 

Will be back for a quick breakfast.

Called in an early reservation and were seated at one of the best tables around the perimeter of the dining area. It's always worth a quick call prior to walking into any restaurant!

Revolving service staff makes a difference and Gino's executes this well.  Having a pair of attentive, cordial, and menu-educated servers made the meal service flow smoothly through all courses. The meal was well timed and plates were delivered and cleared quickly just as we finished. Our kids felt welcomed and treated equal to adults. 

Cuisine was both good and great. Excellent charcuterie selection and at a real steal of a price at the tail end of happy hour. Real deal Caesar dressing which had a perfect balance of acidity and richness. The Alfredo - ridiculously delicious - you just need to try it. 

Lasagna was good, however, the addition of ham was interesting. Manila clams had a flavorful broth but unfortunately had some grit. The one letdown was the carpaccio. The subtle taste of beef tenderloin was overpowered by a pool of lemon and cheese. To present the beef cleanly with a spritz of lemon may allow the flavor to come though. 

Overall many highs and a couple of items that are more personal preference than "lows" to this experience. I look forward to trying seasonal specials this year!

My husband and I switched to Ada West because it was covered by our health insurance. We both were super impressed with the efficiency of the business. When I went today for a baseline exam, Jennifer Cook gave me a very thorough exam, head to toe. It was better than any I had ever had in the past. Front desk personnel were friendly and courteous. I barely sat down and was called back to the treatment room.  I have absolutely nothing but positive remarks for my visit.

This place is legit ! We went on a saturday and the staff was very quick and very friendly.  Our food was served quick and was nice and hot.  

Appetizers: pot stickers were perfect. Thick. Great flavor and the sauce they have u put on them steps up the flavors. Shrimp sticks were very lightly dipped so u get to eat actual shrimp versus having all batter and no shrimp. 

Entrees: General Tsao chicken was lighlty breaded as well, very tender chicken, awesome flavors and there was a ton of chicken on the plate. We brought half of it home there was so much. 

The Mongol was a beef dish unlike anything I have tried before. U can tell the beef is top end !! The flavors of that with the peppers and onions and crispy straws they put on it, We couldnt stop eating it. Also a ton of food. We brought some home. 

This place is the best chinese/mandarin style food in the valley.
Love the friendly service! Great coffee but sometimes it's too hot to drink for awhile. Regular employees seem to have it down.

Wow!

We were in Boise for one night on a work-related basis and were in the mood for Italian. The concierge at the hotel recommended Gino's first thing. 

I never expected to find Italian this good in Idaho, but I was pleasantly surprised!  I had the baked mancotti. The cheese filling was creamy and smooth. I really don't like when the filling is dry. The sauce was delicious as well. It was perfectly seasoned and a little sweet. It had a very fresh tomato flavor, too. Hubby had the chicken park and I believe it was probably the best he's had. Large portion sizes too! 

Great dessert menu...the creme brûlée is amazing!

The service and ambience was good, the pizza was awesome. I'd suggest grilled chicken, anchovies, mushrooms, black olives and jalapeños on a white with garlic base. Only downside is that it's a little over priced !

I'm visiting from LA and my friends raved about this place, and I really liked it. We don't have these where I live but the food was pretty good. It's like a classier and bigger Buffalo Wild Wings. They were training a new girl, so everything took longer and server was a bit slow when we needed refills and extra napkins. We ordered the rebel wings to start and I'm a huge fan! Sweet tang and a spicy kick at the end. They were crispy and the sauce was great, I'd for sure order again. I ordered the bacon cheese burger with bleu cheese as the cheese, they asked if I wanted some red or no red. The burger meat was a bit dry and the bleu cheese didn't even melt, burger also was dry overall. I eat bleu cheese burgers a lot so this one wasn't quite up to par, however I took half of it back to where I was staying and had it for lunch the next day and it was better with the bleu cheese all melted. Bacon was perfect in the burger. The fries I could eat all day, they are a cross between a regular French fry and a steak fry, perfectly season. I ate with a side of ranch and it was perfect. You can also make it a combo by adding wings, I tried the buffalo crispers, it came with two in the "combo". Pretty standard taste and they weren't that crunchy, ranch for me was perfect! Also had a Blood Orange Hefeweizen and enjoyed it. Overall good experience.

If I could give zero stars I would. These ppl seem like they're on drugs. Conning ppl for money and asking them to pay in cash. They told me I was getting dip nail polish and gave me gel that chipped after only a few days and then refused to fix it for free!  This place is a joke and will crash very soon. Not to mention their work was the worst I've gotten anywhere!  Very lopsided mani pedi leaving me with hangnails, etc.

I totally recommend Valley Carpet Care. Sean did a great job on my carpets, and they look like brand new. He was right on time, moved what ever need to be moved. And was less money than he estimated me over the phone. So with that I'm giving them 5 stars.

Wingers certainly up'd their game, their new eatery on Eagle Road near intersection Ustick & Eagle; I had the Wings Lunch upgraded with onion rings absolutely THE BOMB came with 5-6 wings and slaw, went washed my hands cruised by the bar discovered they had 52 draft beers on tap, by the way the place was clean as a whistle no ordors, staff friendly I don't give out 5 stars much but Wingers gets it this time!

I have been wanting to try this place for a while.  I drive by it all the time and finally made the stop today and I am thankful I did.  I love the feel of diners and this place didn't disappoint.  You walk in to an array of pies and cinnamon rolls at the front counter.  We decided to try the breakfast buffet and we were pleasantly surprised.  It had a wonderful assortment of bacon, sausages, biscuits and gravy and a lot more including a wide variety of fruit and juices all for $9.99.  A lot of buffets have fruit but most places the fruit is tasteless.  We were pleasantly surprised that their fruits tasted great.  Our waitress was terrific and had a really upbeat personality.  All in all, we were very pleased and will be coming back to try other things.

TLDR;

Digiorno pizza (the frozen pizza brand) tastes better than Grimaldi's. Save your money and go somewhere with better staff, and better vibe. Idk it's trying to be fancy? Who knows. Just.. know there's better pizza places.


Cheese cake is good though. 




I've been treated better at a McDonald's drive thru. 
I was with a group of 4 people, celebrating a 21st birthday. 

The Waiter was useless, impolite, didn't offer dessert just gave us the check seemed like he just wanted us to leave. Which i don't understand why we were really just eating dinner enjoying our time, we're not being rowdy or rude. 


We all wanted to order dessert it was awkward telling him "umm?? We wanted dessert ?" After he just gave us the check. wish we went somewhere else, it was plated so ugly. 
The prices don't reflect how the pizza tastes. More money doesn't mean better. Idc if they flew in ingredients from Italy, when something just isn't good... it's just not good. I thought it needed salt it was very bland . They have a heavy hand on the sauce which i personally don't like but some people love sauce. I just ordered a cheese pizza.

I work near Rumbi in Midvale and I get a to-go order 2-3 times a week. I went in today to pick up my order and the staff told me my meal was on them today to show appreciation for my business. How kind of them!! My food is always yummy and the staff is always really nice - especially Kenzie. Thank you!!

I have eaten at quite a few spots in the Treasure Valley. Few come close to MJ'S . The food is delicious and the servings are big. Prices are worth it and affordable. Service is great. Don't pass thus place up. The location is not easy to find. It sits back off - just south of  Overland

We came In last week on National Burger Day - $5.99 burgers.  I ask them which burgers were the ones on sale and she was happy to explain all my options. So friendly and helpful even though she was sort busy and obviously taking another waitress.  When I asked for another basket of fries, knowing I was already getting a good deal on my burger and felt kind of guilty ordering extra, she didn't make me feel awkward and was very encouraging. The waitress was great,  and I remember her helping me before and was the same.  I definitely recommend the restaurant,  and the lovely staff!

This place killed my buddy's dog. Young dog about 3 years went in for knee surgery all seemed to be OK untill she started getting sick and they ended up having to do surgery again on the knee. They informed them she was good after supposedly monitoring overnight they brought her home again and she still was I'll and lethargic and also slot of drainage from operation almost the entire time come to find out after the fact the test results showed she was septic and they never informed them until it was too late. Dr and owner admitted it was their mistake and they can't turn back time and oh sorry. Really it's a life and they didn't even offer to pay cost of cremation or the necropsy. So if you value your family members like I do these are good things to know. Especially since they posted poor reviews on the website but the funny thing is only positive reviews are on there

It's obvious to those of you who've read all our reviews we have a bit of a bias towards New York style pizza. So when it comes to our reviews of more traditional, Italian style pizza, readers may want to keep this in mind.

That said, let's get to the review.

The first thing you notice about Gino's is the upscale atmosphere. You get the feeling you should have made a reservation (and honestly you might want to on a Friday, this place was hoppin' considering it was the middle of the week when we went!). Thankfully, you don't have to. We were greeted with a lot of very friendly staff, and treated to a couple baskets of very, very good bread and oil. Much like Luciano's, the bread was worth it practically on its own.

We ordered a half Margherita and half Bianca. The Bianca is an oil-based pie with carmelized onions, goat cheese, artichoke and spinach. While waiting, we were joined by Amy Atkins from Boise Weekly, and her photographer, Patrick Sweeney. Believe it or not, when you make it a personal goal to review every pizza place in the Treasure Valley, it just might land you a small spot in a newspaper insert! Amy and Patrick were really cool, and keep a look out in upcoming BW papers sometime in April (though you should be reading their paper every week, the Weekly is great!).

Anyway, after maybe 20 minutes, the pizza arrives, and we dig in:

-The Margherita-
Excellent. The sauce is spread well, and offers that well-blended, juicy texture that just pours itself into your mouth. The cheese is appropriately doled out in globs while the chopped basil completes the piece. There isn't anything that "wowed" me about it, but it was perfect in its design. Nicely done.

-The Bianca-
I liked this one a lot, I'm a sucker for any kind of "fluffy" cheese when paired with artichoke. The onions deliver a hearty flavor, while the spinach keeps the slice grounded. A sort of pizza that makes you feel close to the the earth. I'd like to come back to it.

-The Verdict-
This one's kinda tough. Honestly, at Gino's, it's effectively perfect. But there isn't an oomph that makes them stand out. They're very clean, very professional, very friendly, and very good. But when you're taking a hard, exclusive look at their pizza, it's great, just not quite anything special.

Highly recommended for that fancy dinner date, or if you're in the need to impress the associate publisher of a local newspaper.

4 slices out of 5

Our new favorite Chinese food place. The food was incredible, not mushy or slimy like some Americanized Chinese food can be. We ordered one  lunch special with hot and sour soup, chow rice (fried rice), and the Mongolian beef. All items were amazing - the soup was well balanced, the mongolian beef was tender and had incredible depth of flavor, the rice wasn't over cooked or salty. My husband ordered the Noo noo Noodles - ramen meets Pho! It had shrimp, beef, noodles, fresh vegetables, etc. and all of it served in a fresh and aromatic broth. We will be back and we will bring others!

I have been to other Japanese restaurants in Boise but this one is really the best. All the food is very fresh and excellent. I love to come for lunch and get the chicken bento box or shrimp tempura both are excellent and a great lunch value. My friend got the salmon and vegetable lunch and it was very very good. Highly recommend for highly quality and quick/tasty Japanese. I have never been for dinner but I'm sure it would also be great.

Basically never going back, taken my family many times over the last few years but after the horrible experience we're done. If you wanna pay 80 for 2 pizzas and 4 drinks that the waitress proceeds to spill all over your wife and kids... the Grimaldi's is the place for you. Accidents happen naturally but not a word from the manager.... still felt inclined to tip and did... that that the last visit for us.

I would give 6 stars if that was an option. Totally worth a bit of a wait (which I hope they don't start doing reservations and jamming up tables). I had one of the best takes on the classic Old Fashioned and seared Ahi which was a 10. My wife got the filet mignon- and no joke you could cut it with a fork. Absolutely the best steak I've had in years. It was perfectly cooked, perfectly seasoned and the sides for both our meals were fantastic. Exceptional service, great ambiance and food is off the charts. This is our new date night go to and a for sure spot anytime we have out of town guests.

Loved this place, very tasty eggplant parm.  I also enjoyed my salad with excellent blue cheese dressing, and the deserts were great too!  Our table shared the spumoni ice cream and creme brulee.  My girlfriend's mom had the lamb shank and she loved it.  

The service was great, and we loved our meal, we only spent a few days in Boise but and we really liked this place.

So, my son earned his Black Belt today in Tae Kwon Do and he asked to go to Carino's for a celebration dinner.  Things didn't start off well as my party was squished into seating not meant for as many people as we had with us.  When I tried to get us reseated into appropriate accommodations, we were told that we couldn't because they had reservations for prom.  The restaurant was nowhere near full.  I was given a lot of attitude and excuses.  I was offered a manager; who never came over.  My wife kept me from pursuing the matter.  It was interesting to be made to feel like my celebration was less important than someone's prom; or that my money was not as good as others.  The rest of our experience was okay; in that, the food was fine and our waitress was nice and attentive.  Overall, what should have been a wonderful celebration was just an okay time.

I have eaten at one of these in vegas so I was excited when I seem they were putting one in the village. There location is right in the middle of everything at the village and they have indoor and outdoor seating. I decided to get a large pie and wife got a calzone. Got our food and everything was good the pie was very good the calzone seemed a little dry but could have been the combination of ingredients that my wife got. My biggest complaint isn't he price.. 50 dollars for a large pie and calzone with 3 toppings and a soda is rediculous. My pie being a special was 25 bucks which isn't horrible but my wife's calzone was 24.. 24 bucks for a calzone is outrageous in don't care how many toppings u put in it and she did 3. With tip your looking at 60 bucks for a pie and calzone.. come on now... next time when we go we will just be getting a pie and that's it.. I am sure we can get out of there for around 30 which isn't horrible for a good pie..

I brought my not running 44 year old (yes, 44 years!) XT 500 to the shop and asked if they could make it run. They didn't even laugh at me. They explained what I would probably need in the way of parts and the cost (and didn't try to pad the estimate with a lot of extras I didn't need). Within a few days, the guys had it running like it was brand new. I couldn't be more satisfied. Did I mention they didn't laugh at me?

Thanks, guys.

My family and I came in this evening to celebrate my sons birthday.  We were a large party and right away they helped us get a few tables together.  They were quick with the service and were very kind and accommodating to our large party.  They even came by and sang Happy Birthday to my son and presented him with a mug and some candy.  I can't tell you how much this meant to us and to my son.  He received multiple gifts of legos today but when we asked him what his favorite part of the day was, he said receiving the mug from IPC!  Thanks so much, we will be back!

First... The food was. Good... But the service was terrible and it wasn't even like a busy Friday night anywhere else.... It took 10 min to get water and finally get our drinks ordered..... It took another 10  for them to even bring bread out and it came out with our appetizer.... Drink only refilled one time... The waitress didn't bring out one single plate... Not one... Not the apps not the bread, not the salads, not the main course not the dessert.  And she didn't clear off a single plate... And it wasn't just us it was everyone she was serving.. I finally had to ask a bus boy if he could clear some of them so we had room to eat. Waitress was repeatedly on her phone.... Would walk by us, ask a table next to us if they needed anything, but wouldn't even refill our dang waters... I'm aware everyone has bad days.... But when your manager or another staff member is bringing almost every single item to your whole section.... There's a problem....

We recently ate here with friends who loved the chicken fried steak (their go to b-fast) and were "regulars".  Looking over the menu,  much looked tasty from the descriptions but the prices were a bit higher than we expected.  
Jumping in with both feet we opted to order both the Huevos Rancheros and an special omelette respectively.  When the food arrived appearance was OK except for the omelette which had a brownish tint to it and the potatoes were average.  Diving in further with fork and knives we quickly found the taste to be MIA, both on the Huevos (no spice, flat and even with green salsa it was a lost cause) and the omelette which had a peculiar taste.  I am afraid we are no gos for a return to Moes, finding the overpriced menu and the lack of top shelf food a see ya stamp from us.  Good service - plenty of attention to us and the seating was socially distant and comfortable.
This place was delicious! The food was fantastic, the service was amazing! The atmosphere was so friendly and fun! We have a family of food allergies and they were great to work around it!

Everytime I visit here, I'm always satisfied. With there $7.99 salad bar, to there homemade French dip that was a special that day for $6.99. I was able to peacefully work on homework while enjoying my nice lunch and beverage before returning to class. I will always look to go here if I can't think of somewhere to eat, because it's always good.

Came here for the 630 The FAN NFL draft party. This place is awesome! The food is delicious and affordable. Their happy hour is AMAZING with $3 beers and $5-$6 appetizers. Plenty of parking, attentive servers and clean facility. If you're looking for a place with great food, great service and reasonable prices this is it! Definitely stop by when it's game day...there are TVs everywhere!

Out of 450 Yelp reviews, not once have I complained about the temperature of food that I've been served. Until now.

I ordered a combination dinner with the decidedly un-Chinese-named nutty chicken. It looked pretty good when it came out, but my confidence quickly ebbed when I grabbed the first of three added chicken tenders. 

They weren't hot or even warm. Barely room temperature. Probable health violation. 

The nutty chicken was better, with "better" a relative term. It tasted like a dish at a shopping mall eatery held for hours in a warming dish sitting on top of hot water. It definitely wasn't cooked fresh. Otherwise, it would have been hotter.

The taste of the dish had little flavor and although they claimed they would pump it up to a hot spiciness level, it wouldn't have made a newborn baby cry. 

The fried rice wasn't anything special. The same for the hot and sour soup.

I had seen glowing reviews for Red Pavilion, so I was doubly disappointed by my experience here. I'm guessing the people who speak so highly of them have never traveled to Asia and have no idea what real Asian food is all about.

Probably the same people who voted Taco Bell the best Mexican eats in the United States.

If I could give it zero stars I would. I ordered two small create your own. Mine was suppose to have sausage, mushroom, basil and garlic. It only had sausage and mushroom. Shame on me for not checking. Breadsticks were dry hard pieces of cardboard. 
I would have been better off with a store bought frozen pizza.
Great food with huge portions.  I had a hash bowl, my wife enjoyed a eggs benedict and the pancakes were amazing

We purchased an Intact Sol Dawn from the guys at Uncharted.  They went out of their way to make sure that our experience was a good one.  They answered all of our questions and they gave us a great orientation to our trailer before we took off.  I highly recommend buying from Uncharted!

Good food. Always nice staff and they are wearing Masks.  We came for lunch and had a few apps.  They were all wonderful.  
The seating outside is great too!

Moe Joes is my absolute FAVORITE breakfast place!!! The service is AMAZING and the food is the best bar none. Very large portions and the prices are very good. I really can't say enough about the quality of food and how great the service is! 1,000% recommend!

Rarely go to RR and now remember why.  Was there last night and ordered French Onion Soup.  What I got was soggy bread , gobs of cheese with beef broth pored over and some onions - truly the worst I've ever had

We made a reservation for my birthday at 5:00 for 10 of us. 7:00 rolled around and we were still enjoying ordering drinks, food, and visiting; we were told we needed to leave because they had a reservation at 7:00. Fine, have your reservation but at least let us know at the beginning we only have a 2 hour time limit. Put a sour taste in our mouths. Won't be back.

do not use fred meyer on linder and chinden road. on 03/2/20, attempted to use bill pay as usual. the transaction on fm side said "declined", the monies were there, and were deducted from my account, it showed on all my bank accesses, that it was taken out and sent to fm. fm said since they had stopped the transaction and the monies were returned the transaction never happened. no monies were ever returned. fm said it was my bank, and nothing they could do about it, since it was my banks problem. they also stated it would take 5-7 days to figure it out if it had been their problem.
this was not necessarily a calm conversation either.

Took our dog in for a foxtail in her paw. The staff and vet were so helpful and kind, and their friendliness was deeply appreciated. And I felt they were more affordable than I expected. I will definitely be using them in the future.

Let's see. I have no idea how the food tastes because I've not been able to eat there. I hear it's very expensive, friends paid $57 for a large pizza. 

I came last week with 5. Told 30 min wait. Waited 30 mins. They never called us. We left. Called today and made reservations for 7 at 630. We arrived at 625. They told us 30 mins when we arrived. 

So...let me get this straight. Walk in 30 mins. Make reservations also 30 mins?  Really. This is unprofessional and unbelievable. Go away Grimaldis. You don't belong here.

******Revision: Ok. We made it in at 30 mins! I was surprised. Even more surprising? The food was awesome! Great pizza. And the manager was very gracious and comped us 30% off our bill. More than nice. 

Expensive at $20/ person but great food, great service (our waiter hooked us up) and great Sangiovese.*******

One of our favorite places to eat! It's tucked back from the Main Street, so you have to look for it. Once there, it's amazing. Order anything and you will not be disappointed!!! Chilaquiles, Shrimp and grits, jalapeño berry pancakes! You have to try it.

My Samsung Galaxy 5 phone chews through battery charges like a dog with a meaty bone. On my epic 3-week roadtrip, Yelping at every opportunity, this was a real "bone" of contention.  I thought I could cure my problem with a new battery.  So after discovering that my phone provider only carried phones, not batteries, I headed over to Interstate.

They carried what I needed, just *not* at that store.  Buuuut....they could get one, even two, for me by 4:30 the same day.  How could I say no?  $29 a pop.

And sure enough, at exactly 4:30 pm my phone rang with good news, the batteries were ready for pick up.  Wow, what service.

Unfortunately,  I still drain my battery within hours regardless.  I probably will have to give up Yelping. Yeah.  When pigs fly.  

A customer browsing through the racks of batteries and accessories, grinned at me and nodded.  His comment? It is " ...like a mouse in a cheese factory."

Yeah.  I guess it is a good store, if you like batteries.

The food was good not the best but would have given 4 stars if the waiting area was not so small. There were multiple people waiting for their takeout order, almost shoulder to shoulder. I felt very uncomfortable. They should offer to bring the order out to the customer if more than 2 are waiting because the space is so small or let people stand further in the restaurant. Parking was also an issue, it was really crowded for some reason. Might go back to eat there after Covid restrictions are lifted but i was just too uncomfortable to go back before.

Don't come here if you have a large family.  Wouldn't seat us or accept take out..  Place was empty.  No rational reason not to, but told our order would throw off the kitchen so they had no room.  Really?  No customers in there and wed throw off the kitchen?  Ok, goodby.

Oh man.  This place is TASTY!  If you like biscuits and gravy, definitely give it a shot.  Omelettes are good too.  Hefty, and loaded....

Oh yeah, coffee and OJ is good too.  

Service was perfect too.  

My taste buds are happy and my bottomless fat gut is full....

Nap time. 

We'll be back fo sho....

Fell in love with their Brooklyn Bridge pizza, their Kale chopped salad and their white and red sangria. Visited this place twice within the same week because it was just awesome. 
Service was good and fast.
Amazing food, absolutely love the corn beef and hash!  Great mimosa's.  You gotta go but be prepared to wait a bit.  Word has gotten out!

The absolutely best chicken fried steak in the area! The gravy is phenomenal on anything here! Also I had toast with what I think was Marionberry  jam that was delicious. You can tell everything here is homemade and made fresh to order. Service was friendly and fast and I will definitely be back when I'm in the area!

Absolutely the worst service and execution for a pizza place. I can understand messing up a delivery once. But they screwed up my last three in a row thru DoorDash. So today I decided I would just order online and pick up to avoid any problems. I ordered my pizza and arrived 40 min later, when I was told to come to store. I arrive at store and everyone there looked confused when I told them my name. They asked me "did anyone tell you about stoking the wood fired grill?"  I said no. They said well we are in the process of cleaning out our grill so your pizza will be another 30 min.  Trust me don't waste your time with the Village in Meridian location

Best pizza in the area, hands down! It's dangerous that Grimaldi's is so accessible to us, because I *try* not to eat pizza too often, but this pizza is hard to resist! What sets it apart is the cheese. It's not your normal shredded mozzarella, it's the real deal, fresh mozzarella. Smaller pepperoni, that gets crispy along the edges. You know what I'm talking about, the best kind of pepperoni! No need to look further, you've found the best pizza in Boise!
Service was terrible and food was not what it used to be. After 25 years will not be retuning. They are struggling and will not be in business long.

I've been to this establishment before and the gentleman was very rude and did a horrible job on my nails. I've not been to them in probably a year so today my daughter and I tried them once again. I asked him for ombré  nails And showed him a picture of what I wanted them to look like and this is how they turned out.  Obviously he does not know how to do the ombré. So instead of telling me he can't do it he just attempts it and they turn out like crap.  To top it off he was extremely rude again. Stay far far away from this establishment. He goes too fast because he's the only one doing nails So in turn your nails don't look as good as they should if the place is busy
Fast, courteous, and very reasonable prices.  Highly recommended, we will be using them again for more projects around our home .

Would NEVER recommend this company, they have been horrible to work with, they condone their men to use flattery on another man's wife. How arrogant and narcissistic is that? Little chauvanistic? 
They tell you that what you say to them on the phone will be confidential, when discussing the concerns about a realtor, only to find that the person your discussing is sitting in the room and your on speaker phone. Nothing but a bunch of lies. Then they take what you've said and turn it into all these things you didn't say. 

 They're juvenile to say the least. They've made buying our house a horrible experience. 

Do not use them, there are plenty of other company's out there.

This is the purr-fect place to bring your fur babies for their wellness checks and keep them up to date on their vaccines. Due to COVID-19 it is curbside service. Took our two girls in and staff was super friendly and efficient. Dr Ben Davis examined them and prescribed meds for one of my girls who'd had an ear scratching issue since her last visit with her old vet in our birth state and developed another issue since moving. Dr Davis called us while we waited in our vehicle and told us his recommendation and we took our fur babies home. I gave her the med, super easy liquid, and she has not scratched her ears since! Also, while waiting, a woman drove up with her dog who was pulling at the lead to get in the door! Her mom said, "She loves doggie daycare."

Came by tonight for dinner and to watch a game.  Forgot to take pictures of our food till we were almost done, that being said, there was very little left to take a picture of. Haha

Atmosphere: somewhat loud, but great for watching a game.  Any game!  There are TVs in every direction so literally any game you want is on! 

We got the nachos, wings, and tortilla soup.  
Food was excellent.  Nacho cheese was a little spicy, but overall very tasty.  Wings: we got original amazing and dry rubbed garlic parm.  Original sauce was sweet and spicy at a very tolerable level.  Very good.  Dry rub was tasty but left the chicken very dry.  Still good, but probably won't do that one next time.  Soup was awesome.  Got that with a side of sour cream.  It was a perfect fall soup and satisfying!!! Would totally get that again! 

Service: was great!  Waitress was very attentive.  Drinks were full before the glass was empty and I appreciate that.  

Cost: totally reasonable! 

Only downfalls: 
So loud I had a headache when we left, not from alcohol, haha, but again, you expect noise at a sports bar, so be prepared for that. 

Dry rub chicken was super dry. 

Plus side: 
Good bar food
Great service
Every game is on.

Wingers has been a favorite restaurant of mine for many years, it never disappoints. If there has EVER been an issue (which is SO RARE, maybe a couple times and we go there OFTEN) the General manger goes above and beyond to make sure there is a solution. The food is always amazing and the staff is always great. We always bring friends or family who come to town and they always love it as well. It's definitely our go to spot!!! If it was up to my 4 and 8 year old daughters, this would be the only place we would eat!! The wings put BWW to shame in my opinion.

We've heard great things about this place. Unfortunately we weren't down for the 25 minute wait while there were so many empty tables and 5 staff members at the reception desk. For a Sunday evening we expected more. Hopefully they can work out the kinks and we can give them a try another time. Luckily Panera was just a parking lot away... their southwest chicken soup was amazing!!

Excellent communication using daily text updates.  Convenient.  No hassles.  Required almost no time or thought on my part.  

Car looks and works great again. 

I would use COPE again.

If I could give this place 10 stars I would. Best mandarin restaurant in the Treasure Valley. Excellent service with even better food! Very much enjoyed the won ton chips with sweet and sour. I recommend the Broccoli Beef and General Pork. You definitely get your money's worth and we basically got four meals (two leftover meals) for $30! We will definitely be back!!
Best breakfast by far. Best food and the service is spectacular. Every time we are in town we will be coming here.

This is my favorite bowling alley in the Valley, but it's not fancy, glitzy or even too terribly clean. Lol. I just feel like a bowling alley should be lived in. There should be a story breathing across the lanes, generations of laughter bouncing off the wood paneling and countless stories told over beer and fried food.

This place is big! It probably has 30 lanes? Plus pool, arcade games and rows of dart boards (in the bar). They recently updated the scoring system and it has all sorts of cheesy options to choose from. My crew chose the selfie option. We all took stupid pictures and then the system puts funny glasses, hats, noses on you. It was fun. 

They have a full bar so you can get bottled or draft beer, liquor or wine. But again...this is a bowling alley so you're getting well liquor and cheap wine. And the snack bar is full of all the fried food you could possibly want! 

We had 8 people playing and we only bowled one game. We rented shoes and it came out to $11/couple! That's a screaming deal. And made all the sweeter by all the laughs and cheers and jeers.
Amazing first impression. Ridiculously nice Customer service! Was my first time going. Almost filled a punch card in a weekend, it was so good!

I am disappointed. I bragged you guys up!!!  Then...  you failed!!!!.

"The sad depressing old ladies and the big gals".  As per the 10 people I sent over..

They were ignored and felt as if the place had a "click".  So very sad...  ....

I am embarrassed to havryalkedave heard this place up and hear that it was a fail..   

Her ride of the "old " and get some new personalities in that place!!!!!!

So far this place has been the best breakfast place we have found. It's a bit of a wait but completely worth it. The food is super good and they have the single best OJ on the planet!! Full 5 stars all around folks!
One of my favorite breakfast places. Wish they would get a bigger location but happy to see they are usually always busy.

Easily the Best Chinese food in the valley.  Have enjoyed everything we've tried and will keep coming back!  There have been a few instances when the wait for food was a bit longer than it should have been.... like the night of Chinese New Year.... but otherwise no real complaints

Visited this week, our go to place for breakfast, its way better than Cracker Barrel and we haven't tried Black Bear Diner yet. 
They've got a new menu with a lot more choices to choose from. Food is fresh and good quality for the price, but the omelettes are over cooked a bit, so I always have to ask them not to over cook, and they still overcook them. 
We love their fried potatoes, rye toast with Marion jelly, fast service, great staff, great ambience with classic rock, makes for an overall great dining experience.

Went in today for lunch, waited 1 and a half hours for 1 pizza, our waitress rarely checked on us, sat with empty drinks for 20 minutes. Expressed our displeasure and were told it was because someone placed a take out order... will never return

We went in for a tire rotation to find out we needed all new tires. Jordan V. helped us and had all 4 tires replaced in 20 mins. He was super helpful and gave us options along with recommending a place  to get the alignment fixed. Will definitely be going back.

Gino's is a place that my husband and I have been going to for many years.  We don't frequent Gino's because it is a bit pricey, so we go on special occasions or when we have an extra 100 bucks to drop.  My review for Gino's is based more off of past experiences than this current visit.  I am giving them five stars  because the majority of my experiences here have been excellent. I am the type of person that when I find something I like at a particular restaurant, I'll order it over and over because I crave that meal when I got to that establishment.  With that being said, Gino's Lamb shank is the best!   The tender meat that is braised for 4 or 5 hours in some red sauce with wine and served with gnocchi is mouth watering.  Unfortunately, on this visit the  beef and lamb shanks were out so I had to order something different.  Before the waitress came to take our order, I was eyeing the veal piccata and decided order that.  My first bite I got a punch of lemon flavor and I was excited to dig in more because, for me, a lemony dish should taste lemony.  However, beyond that, the veal wasn't as tender as I would of liked it and overall the dish lacked in other flavors. It was a bit bland with the exception of the lemon taste. My husband ordered their special, halibut with risotto.  I took a bit of that and instantly had menu envy! Soooo good!   The service, my salad, glass of wine, bread with spicy garlic olive oil, was all excellent.  I don't think this was an "off night" for Gino's, as far as my meal was concerned, I think in the end I wasn't a huge fan of the veal piccata. Gino's will always be a five stars for me, and I'll be coming back sooner than later to get my lamb shank!
Grew up with Taco John's in Montana, love love love it. Super Potato Oles and crispy tacos. Yum!

Excellent execution of sushi. The service was impeccable. I look forward to going back. I took my sister and brother-in-law who have been to a lot of sushi places and this one was one of their favorites. It is not pretentious and is very good.

Holy Amazeballs Batman!

This place is incredible. My new favorite restaurant in the Treasure Valley. 

My wife and I had such a great experience here. The food is incredible and the service was excellent. 

We highly recommend Gino's.

I ate here last night  with family and I should  give it a 1 star but based on how friendly the manager was and apologetic I gave it another star. They were pretty busy  which is  fine but our waitress literally did not even come over and take our drink order for 10 mins and when she does decide to come over doesn't apologize for the wait or anything. By now we know what we want so we order dinks and food all at one time. After another 10 minutes the manager comes by and asks what we are waiting for and we explain we have been waiting for waters and drinks from the bar for over 10 minutes. He gets us our waters right away and informs us our other drinks will be right out. Some other person brings out my wife and daughters and my son in law  and are still waiting on 2 beers. After another 5+ minutes our waitress who we haven't seen tells us she can't serve the beer we ordered in a pint? I literally just shook my head and told her just bring out what you can serve it in. You would think she would run over and get it but no another 5 minutes and wish I could make this up they only be brought out 1 and took another approximately 3-4 minutes to bring out  mine. You can add up the time but what a joke...

The food finally  comes out after almost an hour and my wings are cold! I signal over what looks to be  another manager and I inform her that my wings are cold and she  says in a very sarcastic  way are you sure there all cold? Really? No I am making it up...she takes them and in another 5+ minutes there back and literally taste like they have been microwaved. I was sure hoping this would be a great food option in Boise but I guess not. It pains me to say and I would never recommend BDubs to anyone as place to get wings  but in Boise and this place even Chili's would be better.
Horrible service, just horrible.  I was on the phone for over an hour without getting a simple matter resolved.  Replace this store and its worthless employees with anyone from sprint!

The one star is only for the pizza, which was pretty okay.  But the customer service is AWFUL.  It's Sunday night and I'm not in the mood to cook so I placed a order for pick up.  I arrived 30 minutes later to get my food but there was nowhere to park so I sent my son in to grab our pizza, chicken wings and my salad.  A few minutes later he comes out with two boxes and a white bag, which I assumed contained my salad.  After we got home I realized the bag didn't contain my salad, just ranch dressing for the wings.  I'm mildly irritated because it's Sunday night and I have stuff to do to get ready for the week.  But mistakes happen so I'll live.  I called the store to let them know I didn't get my salad and I'd be back soon to grab it and the guy on the other end of the line says "okay, no problem."  Uhhhhh, "no problem"?  I think you mean "sorry".  I would certainly hope you don't have a problem with me driving back to get the food I paid for that you didn't give me.  In fact, offering to deliver it would probably have been nice.  I drive back to the restaurant and hop in line.  There was ONE cashier working the front desk and juggling someone picking up an order, a large group of guys asking for samples of the beer on tap and another person in front of me waiting to place an order.  There were a ton of people in the back....the back can't spare an employee to help out up front?  After waiting at least 15 minutes, the cashier finally got to me.  I explained that I was unhappy to have to stand in line so long after having to make a second trip to get my complete order.  I did get an apology at that point but it was too little, too late to put me in a better mood.  Then, just to extra irritate me, as I was trying to put together my salad at the salad bar, another employee kept sticking her arm across the ingredients and getting in my way.  She was literally leaning in across me!  Why??  All because she was shuffling the tongs and spoons around in each salad bar ingredient!  She couldn't have waited until I was done?!  I finally stood back and just stared at her waiting for her to say "oh, I'm sorry, go ahead".  Nope!  I don't think she ever saw me.  Here's a tip - when you have customers waiting 15+ minutes to get a cashiers help, maybe your employees would be better utilized at the front vs rearranging the positions of tongs and spoons in the salad bar area.  Just an idea!  Food was okay but we won't be back.

Love this place! Their ingredients are fresh and they are always so kind! My immune system has completely failed me this winter so that's why I've been in so much. Their orange immunity juices are the best. They taste so good. I always get my daughter a small smoothie. It's nice cause they have a smaller size just for her - they actually call it the kids size. The prices are high but that's to be expected at any juice bar. Before I left today one of the ladies let me know I could download the app for rewards. Love them! They are my go to spot!
They are OPEN for dine in!! Food was amazing as usual, we had chicken fried steak, B.T.A. Benedict and two kids pancake meals. Friendly service and compliant with everything covid.

This place needs new management and fast.  We had a horrible experience a few weeks ago.  The hostess took our name and after 40 minutes people that came in after us were being seated.  When we brought it up she looked at us like we were speaking a foreign language.  THEN, tonight we tried ordering through Grub Hub.  A gal called and indicated they were out of lasagna. We replaced it with ravioli.  Our food never showed up. We called the restaurant and the same gal indicated that she accidentally canceled our whole order.  What's worse is she said the order had been sitting there and we could come and get it.  If we wanted to pick it up we would have ordered it that way to begin with.  I'm so frustrated with this place I will never eat here again.
DELICIOUS! I would recommend this place for anyone who is having a crave for quality Chinese food. The service was also great!

This is my new favorite breakfast restaurant!  I am going back just as soon as I can. I ordered the simple two egg plate which comes with potatoes. The potatoes were excellent!  I added their homemade salsa. What a treat. We split a pancake and it was yummy. My poached eggs were just the way I like them. The waitress was friendly and kept the coffee coming, too. There is plenty of parking and the restaurant is very clean. 

It is not fancy. But you've got to try it. I live 25 minutes away, but it is now my first choice for breakfast!

Welcome to the world of Bio-Hacking! Restore Meridian is a new business that offers a well rounded take into the realm of Bio-Hacking and self-care. They offer multipe different services and packages for a wide variety of options. 

I went in and had to try the full body Cryo which reaches tempatures of -240 degrees. It was definetly a life experience to try something new. I was very pleased with how well my body reacted to the cold healing and had to sign up for a package membership. 

shortly after this I fell and hurt my knee and was pretty banged up. Restore offers cryo healing that is isolated so I went in and took advantage of the isolated cryo. My knee pain which probably would have lasted a good few weeks felt great and within a day or two the pain was mostly gone. I wont say its a miracle cure, but for the first time some time in a long time I noticed a difference. 

Since then I have done the stretch, the IV Drip (twice) and the compression pants. They also offer the Infrared sauna, Red light therapy, and have a esthetician. 

I would defiently recommend people stopping by and checking out the facitly. It's very clean and well run. The employees are some of the best people you'll meet.

We finally made it to this diner! It looks really nice and updated inside. They have a great variety in their menu, and my kids were happy to see Kraft mac & cheese on the kids menu! Drinks aren't included for the kids FYI. I noticed they have a salad bar (which will reopen when the COVID restrictions are gone). We all enjoyed our dinners, and the service was excellent. They also took our expired coupon. We'll definitely be back!

My wife needed some serious stress relief so I scheduled an appointment for her with Vonnie. We were new to her, but she was very accommodating and made us feel comfortable right away. When the massage was done my wife said it was the best massage she's ever had, and she immediately asked me to schedule some more appointments for her. Vonnie was very tuned in to what was needed, and was very professional and provided an amazing massage. I'm glad we were able to see her quickly, and that she was so friendly and comforting.

These people are crooks!! They were very nice in the beginning and said all the right things. ( we'll take care of everything for you). It all started to go south when they did the old BAIT AND SWITCH. We gave them 3,000k for the blue prints and paperwork. Then they gave us the Homeowners check off list. And the Pre-construction checklist to have completed before they even start on the house. If we would have known what we were required to do we would have never agreed to the contract. We lost 3k and walked away from these scammers. Please ask for those checklist!! Theirs a lot of hidden costs on those checklist. On top of that the 3k was just for paperwork. I didn't even get the blue prints for my 3k. Please be careful !!!!!

The best chicken and waffles I have ever tried,  and it was in Boise, Idaho!  This resturant was a big surpise for me and my girlfriend. We are from socal, and we are honestly spoiled when it comes to good food,  espeically good ethnic food, but the korean tacos here is absolutely exceptional. The restaurant is a small mom and pop style spot what looks to be run by the lady server and her husband.  She seemed very proud of their food and she should be. The corn bread is outrageously good and overall the food is just simply outstanding. Thank you for the great food experience Boise!

Exactly what we wanted! Anniversary breakfast. 
Great service from Shelby. Yummy and generous portions. We ordered the jalapeño popper frittata and the farmhouse with side of jalapeño berry pancakes. Yum! Will definitely return!
Very poor service. One waiter doing the job of 4 because 3 waitresses stood around and visited with each other. Had to ask for everything even the menus. Turned out to be a 2 hour meal.

Vonnie is the best hands down. It's not typical for me to go to the same masseuse more than once or twice because they're just not quite good enough. Vonnie's energy is perfect. She has a cozy studio and is so friendly. She is intuitive in listening to your requests and what your body needs. I highly recommend her.

Wonderful place for lunch. Quick service. Their lunch specials are very affordable and high quality. Their chow rice is the best fried rice we've had in Meridian. Try the Honey Walnut Shrimp. The Won Ton Soup is delicious as well.

We love River City and Dr. Harsch! Our dog Stella has always received the best care and healed so easily from her spay. She always gets treats and trusts the vets and vet techs because they take the time to build a relationship with the pets and clients. Also, our kitty Lilly got very sick and they got her in that day, taught me how to give her proper at home care and reassured me that it was not my fault she was sick. They have always been welcoming and caring. We are going to try out doggie day care for Stella soon too!
Best tax accountant in Idaho and very knowledgeable! Recommended highly! And very affordable......
Great food first tine there, very friendly staff, all the food is made from scratch and you can tell, great food at a good price and great wine selection

I just had the Yuppie roll and it was delicious! When I came to pickup my food the staff was super sweet to me. The lady that served me thanked me for coming and told me that I was giving a salad and miso soup. Both that were giving to me were good. Salad was just salad mix with sauce. Simple but good. The food was much appreciated. On my way out the sushi chef thanked me and said good-bye.

Please come and support these guys during this time of crisis. They definitely deserve it!

We love Moe Joe's! My two favorites are the lemon poppy seed pancake if you want sweet, and the corned beef hash if you are wanting savory. If the wait wasn't so long I'd give it 5 stars. They should buy the whole building!

Great breakfast and great service! We had the Hash Bowl and Pancakes, both were amazing. The only suggestion I would have is switch from Hunts to Heinz ketchup, didn't have to use but saw they had Hunts lol.

I went in 40 minutes before closing on Saturday night, per online. The hostess advised me the were almost closing and said no. If she would have stated i am sorry we have changed are hours and we know close at 9:pm, that would have been fine. We have just left another restaurant were we sat for 20 minutes, and was never greeted so this was disheartening..feed us and take our $.

Just moved into town from New England, we had a great local pizza place as well as a (famous?) Frank Pepe's, so I was eager to try out some pizza here and a co-worker suggested Idaho Pizza. Now, I know there are different styles of pizza (at home the local place was thick and Pepe's was thin), different types of crust, sauce, cheese, crunch, etc. Goodness my husband and I didn't care for Idaho Pizza. Not to say others might like it, but to my husband and I it was not our cup of tea and I believe 'cafeteria food' was said. We ordered a veggie pizza and it didn't seem adequately roasted, the cheese wasn't that great, the tomatoes weren't cooked at all but thrown on top after? What are these shenanigans? Glad we tried it at least but we will not be returning and if someone brings one over I won't partake, like Dominos, Little Caesar, Pizza Hut and the like.

Also, some people mentioned the delivery time: they quoted us a full 2 hours but it arrived in 1. Usually in my book it takes 35-45 minutes for pizza delivery, though the places my husband and I loved didn't deliver, not one of them (however when I visited my nieces and nephew we'd order pizza from different places so that's what I'm basing it on).

Lastly, we did speak to another co-worker that said Idaho Pizza was more known for its salad bar, but if you're known for salad and 'pizza' is in your title I think you're messing up somewhere.

This is probably the worst Chinese food place I have ever ordered from! I spent $45 on an order for take out for sweet and sour chicken and spicy orange chicken and got 3 orders of chicken with a side of sauce.

If you haven't been here yet, you need to go ASAP! This is hands down the best Italian food in the Boise/Meridian/Nampa area. My parents have loved this spot for years, but it's a little farther out in Meridian than my husband and I usually travel, so it wasn't until about 3 weeks ago that we decided to try it out. It was well worth it. Our server, Isaac I believe his name was, was amazing. He brought fresh bread, made sure we never ran out of our drinks, recommended dishes, and was a very likely, personable guy. 

The owner (I believe he was the owner) stopped by our table twice just to make sure we were happy and everything was great. Just a quick, friendly stop and then left us be. I love that kind of customer service, and love seeing owners who care about customers. 

My husband had the veal parmeasean, and I had the shrimp maria. Both dishes were absolutely phonomenal. When the bill came, it was only a little bit more than what our bill usually ends up being at Olive Garden, and so, so much better. I would highly recommend this place to anyone who loves true Italian food. I wish I would have taken photos of our dishes to share, but they didn't last long enough before we dug in!
One of the best places in the valley for breakfast. The food, atmosphere and the service are all on point. Been here many times and have never been disappointed.

I can't rave enough about my love for Dutch Bros. Coffee. Every trip to this part of town, has Dutch Bros. on the agenda.
On a suggestion from the staff, I went away from my usual and opted for the Toasted Mellow (breve). It did not disappoint. It is actually now my favorite drink and I order it a few times a week.  Thank you Dutch Bros. You and your staff rock.
Taryn at this location was very unhelpful. Some of the worst customer service after they lost our ballon order. Terrible.

They put our name on a list to bowl as soon as the league bowling is over.  Upon checking with the desk over an hour later,  ( cause there are quite a few open lanes).  We find  out, they decided to cross your name off the waiting list because they see you have an autistic child with you. Never once did they even check to see if we still wanted to bowl. When asked why they didn't call our name, or send the text that a lane is open, they had no excuse nor were they even apologetic for skipping us.

I am not a customer of Pioneer, but recently sold a vehicle to one of their customers. He made the purchase, using a loan through the credit union. The loan officer failed to follow through on deadlines. She didn't even follow through on simple things like calling the Meridian branch to let them know ahead of time that I was coming into the office to have the VIN inspected. 

The e-sign email they sent to me didn't work. I ended up just going into the office a second time and sitting in the lobby while they worked on the paperwork. 

On the other side of the transaction, their customer was completely frustrated. I think he thought he'd lose out on the vehicle because of the comedy of errors from his lender. 

I definitely do not recommend this credit union.

I contacted Merry Maids through their website in the evening of June 8th.  On the 9th I received a text wanting to schedule a "quick phone call call to go over services we offer and pricing."   The earliest time they had for a "quick phone call" was noon on June 11th.  I was ready and waiting for the call and had declined a visit from a friend so that I could learn what needed to be discussed that couldn't have been posted on their site or put in an email.  I texted at 12:13pm since I hadn't heard from her.  At 1:06pm I received a reply that they had some technical difficulties and want to reschedule our call for Monday.  I am sure we have wasted more time back and forth trying to schedule the "quick chat" than it would be to actually have a quick chat.  I am moving on since I doubt they can clean efficiently if it takes so much effort to arrange a quick chat.

My boyfriend and I go to Moe Joe's all the time and have never had a problem until today. It is generally my favorite place to go for breakfast and the woman we usually get as our waitress is as sweet as can be. So I don't want to rag on the restaurant as a whole, however, today was a much different service than what we our used to. While I will accredit about 25% of the issue to the fact that they were busy, it does not make up for their rude, low-quality service. When we got there, the host at the front was very friendly and told us it would a 25 minute wait. We said No problem and went outside to enjoy the sunshine as we waited. About 20 minutes went by and I saw a couple groups go in and decided to go check what our wait time was. When I walked in the same host greeted me politely and said, "sorry we are a little behind it will probably be another 15 minutes." I again assured him it was no problem and went back out to join my boyfriend. About 10 (of the supposed 15) minutes went by and I saw more groups go in sent my boyfriend to go check how much longer. Upon getting up to the host stand the polite, young man was no longer at the front and was instead replaced with MARY THE MANAGER. My boyfriend (who is incredibly polite and rarely ever gets annoyed by things) walked up and asked about how much longer we had on our wait. After giving MARY THE MANAGER the check in name, she replied with "I called you already." He responded very easy going and said "Oh I'm sorry we were outside we must not have heard you. She then responded with, "Well that whole group outside heard me..." ROLLED HER EYES, huffed and said, "I guess I'll try to figure out something." Now I won't even go into detail about the fact that it took forever to get our food, our waitress lacked any sort of people skills, and she checked on us all of three times (once to place our order, once to bring our food, and want to bring our check). The real issue here (in case it was not already apparent) was MARY. I completely understand being stressed out and as I mentioned earlier, they were busy and had my boyfriend come up to her acting like a jerk I probably would of sided with her. However, when a customer comes up asking ow much longer on the wait, politely, after being given a poor time estimate by one of YOUR EMPLOYEES and you have the nerve to be be rude about it because you "called already [us]" that is poor management to a T. Maybe get a better system for notifying your guest, rather than making them wait around for wrongfully calculated amounts of time only for you to halfheartedly yell their name and then claim that you surveyed the other guest to see if they heard it (as if that makes any difference what so ever.) If that is the type of people working at Moe Joe's, let alone the type of MANAGEMENT that works there, I can assure you we will take our business to The Griddle from now on.

Open during COVID nice! And pizza is good  just over priced one XL large witch is the some as a large every ware else coast $27.00 delivered. Pizza Hut is cheaper is you live in Middleton Idaho and delivery is faster. If you are having a party save some money.

Positives- extremely friendly workers. Laundry facility was clean. 

Negatives- spots are ridiculously tiny. Out of the 8 KOA's we've stayed at on our trip, this is by far, the least private. It made getting in and out of the spot very difficult. Bathroom facilities could be cleaner. Not kid friendly- no playground. 

Suggestion- allow more than one family to sign up for the pool/spa. That space is large and allows for at least 2-3 families to enjoy the space while social distancing

I wish I could review the food, but we left after a 20 minute wait to even be offered a drink, and the woman working helping several people that picked up orders, as well as answering two calls as she was taking our order and cutting us off to answer the call. So rude :(

My brother ordered us food from this place on door dash and highly recommended it. Halfway through eating my salad I noticed a giant dead moth in my food. It made me instantly sick to my stomach. Never eating from this place again and neither should you.

My friends and I came in towards closing time and our server Amanda was super nice/friendly. She gave us the perfect amount of time for us to figure out what we were eating, offered us refills anytime our glasses were getting low. We are shared two small pizzas (which was perfect for the 4 of us). The kitchen did a really good job of getting the pizza out in a good time. Pizza was super good with the diverse seasonings and the crust was just crispy enough. Of course we had to have some dessert so we decided on the tiramisu which was AMAZING! We will definitely be back.

We just had the best experience with the service staff. We were on a long RV trip when our house battery stopped working. In desperation we stopped at Bish's RV. I spoke with Robert in service who went out of his way to help us in a pinch, even though they were extremely busy. Now we are back on road In this 90 degree heat with AC again!!!! Thank you so much. 

The Thomas-Conlon family!

Dr. Ennis is really an amazing man! He has been supportive yet tough to help me get my numbers into a very healthy range. It is with his help that I have turned my numbers around and I no longer have risk for diabetes Etc. The office staff is friendly and helpful as well. You come in during Christmas and there's Christmas music playing and the door is open because they know it's cold outside. It's the little things that really make you appreciate your doctor in addition to their knowledge. This doctor and staff go the extra mile!

I've been smelling the food from this place when going to rocket car wash next door and it always smells great.  Finally stopped in and it was super good.  I liked my wife's teriyaki chicken better than my spicy chicken, but it was still good.  Egg rolls are great as well.

The wait wasn't as bad as others are saying and the food is worth it.  The staff were super nice as well.

Ruined our Father's Day. 

My husband has his favorite breakfast meal here, and we always order Take Out (we have kids and it's just easier this way).  When I called Father's Day morning, I kept getting a busy signal.  I called a few more times, and still busy.  So I decided to just drive down there and order the Take Out (daddy really wanted his Father's Day Breakfast Meal in bed!). I understood it was Father's Day, was probably super busy, and I had no problem waiting even up to an hour if need be for the order.  The lady inside flatly told me they were no longer taking any Take Out orders. WOW. I then realized they just decided to take their phone off the hook to avoid calls (how about a voice messaging letting customers know?).  That would have saved me a trip, a lot of time, and a disappointed Dad. Joe Mamma's just opened up on Eagle and we are now taking our business there.

I had been wanting to try this place for awhile. To make it short we were there forever cause I waiter took forever  to ever return to the table. The pizza was good and had good flavor but I just have a hard time paying 30 dollars for one pizza. We had to end up ordering 2 to have enough to feed our family and spent 60 on two pizzas.
Only the BEST pizza in the whole world ! Their cheesy bread is to die for.   John and Leah are the BEST !!!

I love SB salon. My nail tech is Jen and she does amazing work. I've been going to her for about a year and I'm satisfied every time. Would definitely recommend her as she can do just about anything and does amazing artwork also.
So far have only visited the bar, where they make good drinks indeed.  Hope to dine here soon, staff is friendly and atmosphere is nice.
Clean juice goes above and beyond with their service and ingredients. Brook the manager truly cares about the customer experience. Love it there !!

I had the veggie hash bowl with two poached eggs.  It was in a word, perfect!  I received a beautiful bowl of delicately sauteed veggies
- Tomatoes (not some diced nonsense, but crisp cherry tomatoes)
- green chilies, spinach, 
- artichokes (half a heart)
- zucchini (cut into small quarter'd bites)
- mushrooms, avocado, 
- roasted garlic (multiple pieces of wonderfully roasted whole cloves)

Keep in mind this comes with the option of a dense, thick home-made whole wheat toast.  Perfectly buttered with a delicious something-berry jam.

I wanted to go back and ask to kiss this "Joe".  One hell of a great breakfast.  

I'll be back (with Arnold Schwarzenegger accent)

This place is great. Authentic Japanese sushi chef knows what he is doing. Fish, rice and miso is all fresh and the assortment of fish is impressive. The cuts of fish were very thick my husband and I had appetizers soups salads and main entree for 40$- can't beat this place for a date night. Speed of service, friendliness of staff and attention to detail makes this place our new go to.
Very personal friendly staff. Love the atmosphere. Made me want to continue with the upgraded cut.
Prompt reply with a great estimate. Service was timely, friendly and carpets looked great!

You might see "Jesus For the People" or "JFTP" around the building, on t-shirts and even on cars. This is not just a slogan or a statement, it's a mission. This means no exclusive categories exist in God's world. This vision for the people is: no one is excluded from God's promises. Jesus is for the comfortable, the successful, the hard working, the desperate, the destitute, the addicted, and the abusive. Jesus is for everyone. 

God's church has a mission, and Capital is just one unique expression of it. In our broken city filled with people in search of significance, we have the BEST NEWS.  We've been found. Jesus has fixed us. We are included. Jesus is calling the church to embrace his "for the people" vocation. That is what Jesus specializes in, and this is why we are a church for the people; because Jesus is always and forever for the people.

Have used IWS twice now. Prices were better than StorMor or Tuff Sheds. Also better construction......Studs on 16 inch rather than 24 inch like the other shed companies....Everyone was easy to deal with.......assembly guys arrived on time and worked very efficiently. No problems. Cleaned up their mess and were a pleasure to deal with. Would definitely use IWS agsin.

Every time I visit the village, I see this restaurant. I have wanted to visit for a long time, so my wife and I finally decided to take the plunge and try it.

Before I start the review, I have to say something. I never give 5 stars, though in the case of this place, I really considered it.

I have been eating pizza...well all my life like most of us. Pizza is a part of most everyones diet these days.

I used to eat Pizza Hut a lot, but not anymore. Ok, I admit it. I do still order fast food pizza like Pizza hut when I am in a rush and on a budget.

But this place..OMG is all I can say!

Now like any place else, it depends on your taste, your budget, and what you get. My wife loves THE DON. When I first came here, it was what I had and I was not impressed. It is good, dont get me wrong, but I just didnt think it was that great.

Then I came back the next time and I ordered the "Quattro Formaggi", which translates to "4 cheese". 

Now I have to have me some meat, so I add meatballs. When I got it, I was in Heaven! 

Ok, maybe not heaven, though I have to wonder if maybe all the best restaurants will be there. After all, even Jesus loved good food and wine. So maybe there is a Restaurant Heaven. If there is, Jesus take me now!

Anyway, the 4 cheese with Meatballs is now my Go To Pizza. It is good. If you have not tried this, you gota go. Seriously, Go Right now. No Kidding. Get!

When I get mine, I tell them to leave off the Olive Oil. For me, it makes the pizza way too oily and greasy, so we leave that off on both ours.

One more thing I will say is that the pizza here is expensive. For a family of 4, we pay around $50 to eat here. So if you are on a budget, be careful here. But its the old saying. 

You get what you pay for. 

If you enjoy cardboard pizza, go to Blaze or get some fast food pizza like Dominoes, Pizza hut, or one of those.

If you want good pizza, this is the place for you.
Jalapeño Popper Fritatta....what breakfast dreams are made of! Great little spot to grab a fantastic breakfast in the TV!

Drove all the way from Seattle to Meridian to buy our InTech Sol Eclipse. Jay made the experience easy and fun. He listened to my concerns and went the extra mile in finding me the right trailer. Highly recommend this place and Jay!
My s/o and I decided to try out a new place for date night and we couldn't have been more pleased! The service was great and the food was even better!

I brought my car in for a patch in a slow-leaking rear tire.  While I was waiting, I overheard an older man talking with one of the team -- he needed, but could not afford, a new tire.  As he was on his way out, the team asked him to wait and began calling all their other stores in the area, hoping they could find the older man a cheaper used tire... but they were unable to locate one.  Instead of letting the man go on a bad tire, one of the managers donated him a brand-new tire for free.  (additionally, they didn't ask me to pay the standard $25 for patching MY tire)

I tell ya - this is what I love about Boise.  Eric (manager) and Zak (team member) acted out of sheer kindness to help this man... and for that they have forever earned my future business, and hopefully the business of anyone who takes the time to read this review.

Best of Meats aka BOM is a new meat-centric Boise-based food truck that serves Japanese charcoal grilled meat. They offer appetizers, mains, desserts and drinks. I visited for the first time on 11/12/20 and ordered a Grilled Platter. Platters come with two skewers of meat, seasoned rice, cabbage and house sauce. I wanted the beef tenderloin but they were out. I ordered one chicken thigh skewer and one pork tenderloin skewer ($13). That week, everyone who ordered a platter received a free Glazed Donut Ice Cream dessert. One of the owners heard me mention that I was bringing the food back to my office, he generously threw in two more skewers of meat for me to share with my coworkers. I and my three coworkers unanimously agreed BOM deserves a 5 star rating. I am no expert when it comes to Japanese charcoal grilled meat but the meat was high-quality, flavorful and tender. It was served on top of a generous bed of rice and cabbage with a delicious house sauce. The appetizers which consist of two meat skewers, would be perfect for those following a Keto,  Paleo or Gluten-Free diet.

First and last... my nails started chipping less than a week after getting a gel manicure . The lady that did my feet was so sweet and my pedicure looks great, I believe her name was Emma. My manicure was terrible, the del did not last a full week, started choking and lifting on the sides, also the sides of my nails were not even painted. Their color selection wasn't that great either. Such a shame, the place was nice and clean and Emma was great.

Why does this have to be such an inefficient process. If could give this DMV negative stars I would.  9 windows and only 3 girls working the desk. And it isn't about the COVID hysteria because two of them are working side by side at the desk. I thought it was because they needed to be spread out. 
I hate coming to the DMV and today was no different. The wait is terrible. 
You use to have 30 days to register a new vehicle and now you have 3 days from purchase, but you can't get an appointment that soon so they charge you for being late if it's after 3 days. Thanks you guys are awesome!

Recommended to us by our realtor after a new home purchase, we couldn't be happier with the product and service we received!  When I scheduled the appointment with Blind Source they were flexible to accommodate my schedule and after 3 estimates it was quickly clear that Blind Source would be able to provide exactly what we were looking for.  Mark Wilkins was knowledgeable of his product and very patient while I made decisions.  Other businesses in the area were offering great product and service as well but ultimately it came down to these key factors:  1) Immediate estimation provided; 2) while pricing was competitive, it included a lifetime warranty WITHOUT having to upgrade; and 3) installation was only 3 weeks out vs 4-5 like other estimates we received.  Installation was fast and accurate and just in time for the Christmas holiday and we've been enjoying them ever since!

My fiancée and I were very disappointed coming here for what was meant to be a nice date. I commend our servers who were very friendly and attentive. However, the food was nothing short of offensive. The beef ramen in particular was a disaster. The meat appeared to be reheated, it was dry and hard and strange looking. The broth was gag-inducing, it tasted like rotting beef. The egg was over cooked and again, gag-inducing. The $21 bento box featured sushi with light grayish rice that fell apart immediately and while the other items weren't offensive, it was not worth the price. Even our Philadelphia roll tasted off. We wanted to love this place but left hungry and disappointed.

Super nice and clean facility.   Bids great job with our fur babies.  Be sure to inquire about various boarding prices such as doggy daycare,  one on one time, etc. which may result in add fees.  We will be going back.

LONG wait. 30-45 minutes. Understandable since it's brand new. They let you call ahead and come in and pick it up which I did but still had to wait about 10 minutes once I was there but at least I didn't have to stand in the line which was OUT the door.
Difficult to find a place to sit and eat. Parking is crowded.
Anyway the FOOD- i got the chicken/veggie/rice bowl.
It was disappointing. Chicken was mainly black and there was ONE piece of broccoli.
I'm hoping it's just because they're so busy.
Staff were all great and very friendly.
We got invited to the soft opening at "The Tavern" tonight!  WOW amazing food.  You have gotta come check this place out!!

Love love this place. Being from the east coast were you can get real authentic Chinese and Asian cuisine this comes so close . 
The Chinese food in Idaho is just horrible . 
Their authentic secret menu is to die for .
Their regular menus is just so so good . 
Highly recommend this place .
