What a wonderful experience!! I chose to get a gel pedicure and a gel set of nails.  Husband and wife team make you feel so special. Like most places they are struggling right along with us.   It is very safe and sanitized.  If you are looking to pamper yourself this is definitely the place to be
I've been getting my nails done here for months and it's always been such a positive experience not to mention their work is amazing! Wendy is my absolute favorite for acrylics

One of the best massages of all time. Vonnie greeted me with a smile and I immediately felt welcomed. Her home studio is very clean and comfortable. She has a uniquely pleasing technique which can be relaxing at times and firm with some deep tissue when needed. With Vonnie it's all about the massage and she is very skilled and knowledgable and appreciates communication as to what is working. I will definitely schedule with Vonnie again, I think I found my massage therapist.

Excellent service everytime and last night they definitely went above and beyond. I saw my tire light came on at 5:30 and store closes at 6:00. I drove there to see what was causing the leak, it was a nail. The advisor offered to fix it that night even though still had a large amount of cars ahead of me and they closed soon. I was so thankful as my work schedule is very busy this week. Thank you for staying late and taking care of my tire...from Traci Jackson

Horrible service! Our waitress was not attentive at all! Salad had very little dressing. We could never locate her to bring us more. Had to go ask the pizza maker for more. Then the pizza finally came but was missing cheese. I ordered a cheese pizza but it was mostly sauce. When it came time for the bill the waitress was nowhere to be seen again. Just a very bad experience.
The only positive is the crust was some of the tastiest I've ever had.

It seems a major of people like this place.  I still cannot taste the attraction except for their tortilla chips which are thin and crisp but past that I've never enjoyed anything I had here.  The only other thing is that it is open 24 hours so I guess I can get my chip fix at 2:30 in the morning.

Had dinner there this evening and really enjoyed our time.  I had the Shrimp Maria which was above average to excellent in presentation and flavor. I enjoyed it with a glass of Alaskan Pale Ale.  The perfect pairing!  Their bread is to die for.   The place is pretty spacious with patio seating to boot.  Love the high ceilings.  The service was excellent, notwithstanding the fact that it was a busy night.  The wait was only 10 min.

Wesley & Sarah are my people!
I love everyone here actually. The food is yummy and they help me with my special food order without rolling their eyes lol

The restaurant is beautiful and very clean. The staff knowledgeable and friendly. The food is some of the best Mandarin I've ever had. We are passing through but will definitely be back when we are here again.

I won't be taking my dog here for boarding anymore.  The staff is nice, but don't follow through with instructions, and then blame the pet.  My dog has anxiety when we have to leave town for a few days.  I gave the staff permission to give him half a sedative each day, to keep him calm.  When I got home, they said he had been guarding his food (he's a husky and they do that sometimes). And that they felt "unsafe" with him there.  Mind you, I have kids and they know that if he hasn't eaten his food yet, you leave the bowl alone.  He also had stayed there a couple months prior, with the sedative, and got a glowing report card.  "Ranger was great.  Everyone loves him."When I asked if the staff had read the notes and given him a sedative, the reply was "I will have to take a look at that."  Which meant that no, they hadn't read the notes.  A professional boarder knows how to deal with these situations.  Take your pet elsewhere.
This place is great! The employees are friendly and the space is kept really clean. I haven't tried the juices but the smoothies are very fresh and flavorful. I will return!

Amanda is an incredible provider! She takes the time to listen to you about what is going on and thinks outside of the box. My husband has had ongoing issues for years that many doctors and specialists have not been able to figure out and Amanda found a solution for his problem after the first visit. She really cares and it shows. Her office staff is also very attentive and do an amazing job.

This location works super quickly and the line is never a problem. Food is consistently good. In comparison to cafe rio, I have always preferred costa as I like their tortillas, beans, and rice better. Overall as expected plus they have Cholula and horchata :)

I went to this salon about a week or two ago and was very disappointed. I have attached pictures of what I asked for and what I received. I contacted Bailey the same night as my service and she said she would re-tone it. While I appreciate her trying to make it better, my hair was not lightened enough for toning to fix it (I have contacted a new hairdresser who gave me this info). I booked the soonest appointment I could which was 2 weeks out. The original toning washed out in 2 washes (using a color safe shampoo and conditioner from biolage so this was not the issue). Making an appointment is very hard as she does not work after 4pm or on weekends. I made my original appointment while on winter break, but now I am back to school full time and working 2 jobs so an appointment during those hours is impossible. I am now unable to get to that appointment because I couldn't get the time off and there is no way for me to get back into the salon to have it fixed. Even if I could, I feel that the amount of time it takes to re tone it would not be worth it as the color seems to be low quality that washes out so quickly. 

I expected a lot more from a salon that charged more than double what I would have paid else-where. You do not get what you pay for here.

Not sure what has happened the last month or so but the food quality has really suffered. This used to be one of our "go to" options for food, drinks, and sports but that's no longer the case. We've had 3 bad experiences food wise in a row. Might still go and watch a game and have a drink but not for food. Nachos, salad and sliders were all below par. The service is still good  though.

A poor excuse for Hawaiian food. Or, food in general actually.

I ordered a bowl with kalua pig - not sure what their menu calls it, but its pork and shredded - with veg and no rice...wanted to allot the carbs toward the mac salad (which we'll talk about later...), my bowl came out with mmmmaybe 1/4 cup of meat atop some steamed vegetables that was SWIMMING in hot water. Seriously. I'm guessing I had over a cup worth of vegetable water in my bowl. The veg were so soggy and unappetizing and with the lack of pork, I was immediately underwhelmed.

Onto the mac salad. Traditional hawaiian mac salad is amazing and in my opinion should not be tinkered with. This was beyond gross. The pasta was so undercooked it got tacky and stuck in my teeth. No flavor, the sauce with it was alllll wrong, and it was just sad. 

We had hungry kids with us and decided to stop here on a whim - like other reviews said, their menu looks awesome and tastey, what you get in reality is a far cry from tolerable.
While it was fresh and tasted somewhat good, they do not have prices listed on the menu. The small smoothie was $8.75 once I checked out. How do you justify that price for a 16oz drink?

Thank you!  As the wife of a network engineer who works late into the early hours.  Your open hours give us yummy food options even at 1:00am as I write this.  Having my husband head home and stopping to pick up an early morning dinner is so appreciated :)

Today I ordered Red Robin burgers through DoorDash delivery.  One of the family members put in a special request for "plain and no cheese" on the burger. Another asked for no onions.  They did the no onions one correctly. Unfortunately the plain request came with everything.  It was not edible.  I called and spoke to the manager named Manny.  He made it right and actually personally delivered it to my house!  Now if that's not 5 star service, I don't know what is!  Thank you Manny the manager, you have restored my faith in extraordinary service!!!

My family and I went here after church on Sunday after reading some positive comments and I'm sure glad we did!  The food was excellent - I had the mushroom bisque soup that I would go back for in a heartbeat and the tuna and cheddar sandwich.  It was so good I ate the whole thing (which was huge!)  My husband had the philly which he said was excellent and my daughter just had the mini corn dogs (sold as an appetizer) so I added a side of fries and they didn't even charge extra.  Our waitress was super pleasant and we felt very welcomed without masks.  Definitely will be visiting this place again!

The last couple times I've visited Dutch Bros the staff has been more interested in visiting with their friends then working. Sitting out the window chatting it up with "customers" is becoming excessive. Placed an order and had it hand delivered to me but couldn't get on my way due to chat fest with car at window. I liked Dutch Bros for the friendly, fast service. Hasn't been that fast and friendly lately.
Love this place! The food is fabulous and the service is great...only 4 stars because the wait staff do not wear masks, they wear face shields that cover very little of their face.
I wish this place was back to the quality it used to be. The only lasting impression I have is the Pitt in my stomach after we ate dinner.

Gino's ALWAYS serves incredible food from a menu that itself is mouthwatering. However, the staff is just as five-star as the food. During this take-out-only time, when restaurant staff has to be going through times at least as tough as their customers, for this customer on a particularly stressful day, Gino's staff went out of their way to make the day a little easier. Not enough room for details, but their effort was sincerely appreciated. We'll be happy customers of Gino's for a long time.. thank you.

A few months ago I was referred to Paramount  Animal Care and Dr. Fineman, by my financial advisor. At that time I had already selected a veterinarian after moving to Idaho from other state.

Without going into details, I was not at all happy with the vet or the staff , of the office  I was taking my kitty boys to see.

I have two kitty boys, a black DLH named Bradley and a Lynx Point Siamese mix named Brodie.They are very spoiled and mean the world to me. 

Brodie has terrible allergies and was having a horrible flare up. His eyes were red, itchy and oozing. He was constantly rubbing his eyes and wasn't eating well or resting much either.

Last Saturday, knowing I wouldn't ever return to the previous vet, I called Dr. Fineman and he saw Brodie and I within the hour. 

Dr. Fineman did everything right for Brodie. He stained his eyes to make sure Brodie had not scratched his cornea's and when the tests turned out okay, prescribed eye ointment and also recommended increasing the dosage of Brodie's antihistamines. No other vet has ever recommended increasing the meds and I have to wonder why,  as with that and the ointment, within a day, Brodie's eyes were almost back to normal. He started eating well again and  resting more comfortably too. 

Dr. Fineman even called me today to see how Brodie is doing. Now that is excellent customer service and a sign of a caring doctor. The prices are very reasonable too.

I highly recommend that you take your pets to see Dr.  Fineman, he is excellent.  I have over 20 years experience as a veterinary hospital technician and  manager and I feel I know a thing or two about what makes a good veterinarian!

I came in this morning for a fill.  My nails looked nice but a lot thinner then normal. Was told it was okay. Not wanting to argue I left. I went home and showered within an hour of getting them done one nail cracked and 3 others were bending. Just left there after asking them to maybe build up the sides for me (totally ready to pay more then the $35 I paid at 9am) and was told no.  That my nail was not broke.  They will put one coat of top coat on it if I wanted  The guy told me to be more careful and dont hit my nails.  I will not ever go back there.  Customer service sucks.

They have great selection, products and service, BUT ever since C-19, no phone service really. Will tell you that they'll call you back, but do not.  Can't help, too busy, not enough people, BUT like everywhere else, it's not their fault.  The employees are nice, very helpful and do try to be diligent in their work for you.  It's always best to go in.  Ask for Zack N. He is the best at explaining things and if he doesn't know, he will find out.  The service desk,  Torrey E., he's very hood at what he does because I grilled him. Lol. He hates me now.  No really, they all are great and Susie, thank you for the email for my "Anderson Jack Thingy's".  You all deserve a raise!   Buy the Jayco Eagle  HT!  It's heaven!!!!

Wingers is our go-to place when we know we'll have a great meal and an effortless dining experience. We can always get seated rIght away, whIch can sometimes make all the difference. Our server tonight, Brandon Y., was fantastic   We always have great food and great service.

You mentioned in you original comment "that a wrong part was ordered to fix a window seal and that job was never completed ".  I replied and say it was not, yet I was charged $99 for that.  I also said I put a call in to the service director about this and to see if he would refund this amount also.  He was busy with the move to the new facility so I asked the person I talked to to let him know and to get back to me when he had time.  I have never received that call.

This salon is nice, super clean, with friendly staff.  Tons of shellac colors to choose from. I had the 'diva' spa pedicure which came with a sugar scrub and hit rock massage for $35. Nan is a perfectionist so my polish turned out great.

Looking for any good Asian restaurant in boise is kindof , but this is very good.  Egg foo young is highly recommended,  also sizzling beef.  
Service is friendly.  We will continue going back trying other dishes.

If I had to sum up this place in one word, that word would be "oof."

I've been here twice.  The first time wasn't bad, for me at least.  I had the jalapeñosomething ravioli, which was interesting.  The other table (yes there were two occupied tables that night, hint hint) had their order screwed up three times.  They were seated an had drinks when I walked in, and I was almost done eating by the time they got their food served correctly.

This time, I had a craving for chicken parm, was driving home from work, and didn't want to drive the extra ten minutes out of my way to go to one of the good Italian places.

The bread and oil:  I'd eat it again.  Sure.  Wasn't bad.

The McCaesar salad:  The dressing was bland.  It was like ranch dressing but without the spices, and is the excessively creamy, anchovy-lacking version that I would expect at a non-Italian restaurant.  Remember the McDonalds "salad shakers?"  Yeah.

The chicken parm:  Depressing.  Chicken parm is one of my comfort foods, and if you're going to serve me a bad one, you might as well slap me and run over my puppy too, because I'll want to cry.  First, the red sauce tasted like ketchup.  There was a thin... like, wafer-thin bit of mozzarella (or some kind of cheese) that I really couldn't taste as I endured my dinner.  The crust was a bit salty.  The chicken was criminally bad.  Some of the bites I grudgingly took felt more like I was chewing some kind of "chicken product" rather than chicken.  By far the worst chicken parm I've had in my life, including that which I've had as chicken parm sandwiches, and also including one that I completely screwed up at home.  Congrats.

The pasta:  The chicken parm is served with spaghetti, which is also covered in the bland sauce.  I looked at it.

The bill:  twenty one dollars for an awful meal and a diet coke.  I'd have been better off eating Taco Bell or... anywhere.

Oh, and it took 5 minutes for my server to acknowledge me, and there were mebbe 5-6 other tables.  Had the food been any good, I prolly wouldn't remember that.

Red Pavilion is the BOMB!

My family eats here a couple of times a month and we've done so for at least two years. A local friend who knows her Sichuan (Szechwan or Szechuan, if you prefer) cuisine recommended RP as having very authentic offerings.  We just know that we love the food and adore the staff.  We always receive great service and a very tasty meal.  The place is always spotlessly clean, too!

We love the soups, Creamy Crab Stars, Manchu Lettuce Wraps, any Lo Mein, Hunan Street Fry, Honey Almond (chicken or shrimp), and Mongol Beef.

Become a regular -- these guys will treat you like good friends!  Seriously!  Go there now! :-)

They always have what I need for the most part but the customer service is NEVER there. They are rushed, annoyed, and make you feel incompetent when it comes to balloon bouquets. I already knew they were slammed they kept saying that they lost there seasonal help and are understaffed so I told them I would give them plenty of time to blow up my balloons and I'll come back. When I did come back three hours later I was handed the balloons individually (all 50+ balloons)I asked for a bag to put them in and was responded with a annoyed look. Normally they ask if you need help out but because they were drowning they just sat them there with a bag for me to put in... maybe she was going to do it but after she helped other people. Not sure what's going on there but they need help in the customer service and some attitude adjustments.

It took 12 years to find a Chinese restaurant that we could even tolerate in the Treasure Valley. There were a few ok options, and lots of bad ones. We discovered Red Pavilion last year when we moved locations and have been mostly happy with it. 

I have oddly never dined in here. I have only eaten take out because of "Hungry" and "Hurricane". But one day, I WILL enjoy their modern decor and can maybe comment on the service. 

I have liked everything that I have eaten here. My favorite is the Mandarin Chicken and the Chow Mein. I think my Chinese preferences are pretty vanilla. I always get the big dinner combo, because I can get the cream cheese wonton appetizer (and then eat them in the car on the way home and tell my husband that the restaurant must have forgotten to pack them) and "Hungry" can eat my soup and half my entree (Seriously. She's 4). Hubs likes the Kung Pao Chicken and Honey Almond Shrimp. I have to sneak a bite when he isn't looking, because deep down he knows I ate the wontons and doesn't want to share. But my quick bites have been delicious. :) Overall, it is a good option in the Valley.
Great quality food, highly recommended... Nice touch with having a separate traditional menu!

This salon/spa has a suoer cool vibe. Its clean and current. I was so so lucky to find my new girl Sundi. She gave me the most incredibly rejuvenating massage. I am a hair stylist of 24 years so you can imagine the knots. Her magic hands made me feel like a new woman. She has amazing technique as well as a natural intuition to find all the sore spots. She has such incredible energy about her, I really enjoyed her service.
Then I spoiled myself and had her give me a facial as well. She gave me  the signature facial with the most awesome aroma therapy. I trusted her and she figured out just what my facial concerns were and addressed them as needed.  My skin felt so soft and was so glowy after. Now I am ready to take on the holidays. Thanks so much Sundi! I will definitely be back and will be telling my friends!

We took our dogs there they both had allergies and ear infection like things going on from the weather change from moving , we have spent 10,000 already to get the one dog diagnosed with life long skin allergies , with that being said we told them that they made us get an appointment just to tell us the same thing which I mean I understood since it was first time seeing them . But now she needs more of the skin medication and they will not give it to me her owner because she needs to be "seen " "again " meaning we need to charge you for an appointment because we don't make money on her meds ! So we need to come tell you the same thing you have paid10,000 dollars for just to get our pockets deeper! The staff all of them are not knowledgeable they always have to find out and call back . Or they loose your info ! Not a reputable vet AT ALL THEY DO not care for the health of the animals they are just another vet taking money from people who love their animals and the veterinary clinic knows that and will charge you just as if it were a human patient ! Best of luck to owner and pet here at this location .

Hmmm...We are moving to ID and these homes showed up in our realtor search...Good thing I know to check out builder reviews and saw these. Lexar shows up in a few in my parameters including one currently under construction in Caldwell...Complaints aren't even addressed here and there are 2 additional 1-star reviews that the company got filtered.(Click not recommended reviews) below to see them...always important for yelp...Ya, me thinks I'll not be buying anything Lexar built...Bad reviews like this from others here definitely makes me think that the fit and finish even on completed homes could possibly be nightmares undiscovered until later.....2 independent home inspections would be in order before I would consider it at this point, and that's not going to happen.

When we walked in, there were more staff than visitors in the restaurant. They seated us immediately and told us our server would be right with us. We sat and watched all the servers wandering around visiting with each other for about 15 minutes without a single one of them coming over to even offer a drink. We finally got up and left.

This restaurant has everything going for it. Huge portions of really good food (the halibut is to die for), very friendly and attentive servers, great decor that allows for social distancing and lastly fantastic cocktails. Hope they keep on doing what they are doing.

Have been to the Boise location dozens of times over the years. Always had a good meal, and great service. Daughter and I decided to try the Meridian location.....and........it was fantastic !! Very generous portions, excellent quality fish, friendly, attentive service. Will go back !!

My kids LOVE this place! We went  for a birthday party this year and had a blast. My husband has gone out on the floor with the kids and was smiling the whole time. 
I do have to say I was pretty disappointed when we drove up there from Eagle the day before Boise schools started to find it closed. They changed to their fall hours before school even started! I had a car full of very disappointed kids. It was still summer!!

I called Pristine over a week ago to see if they could service a fountain we have at my work. The back light had gone out and we were calling around anywhere and everywhere to have it fixed. I called Pristine around 2 in the afternoon on a weekday and the phone rang and rang but no one ever answered. I called around to a few more places and then called back hoping to reach someone. I finally got a hold of someone but they weren't sure if our model of fountain was something they could service but they took down my information and said they would have someone call me back ASAP to let me know. I just received a phone call today from someone and they didn't even have the correct information. He called saying he understood I needed help with my hot tub and asking how he could help. I get people get busy but over a week later is ridiculous for a call back and then they can't even take a proper message and have no idea what my problem is or how they can help. Needless to say I found someone else to fix my fountain and I will never be calling or recommending this company to anyone I know. If you are looking for someone that is knowledgeable and can perform tasks in a timely manner I would look elsewhere.

Wow! I just left this place & everything was going great. The hostess greeted me she answered my questions because this was my first time here. As I was leaving I asked for chili sauce not knowing there was some already in the bag. The hostess is my witness  & the guy sitting in front of me. The owner ran up to me as I was leaving and took the chili sauce out of my hand saying that I already had some in the bag. Damn if it were a problem I would have paid for the damn sauce. Not only was the owner rude to me but I also found hair in my food. I work in food Service and I would never treat my guest like this. Next time I'll just go to happy teriyaki. I hope this message gets to the lady that was rude to me.

We were greeted by Brittany at the front desk who was sweet as mama's homemade pie. rooms were clean with full size pillows which our road weary heads appreciated. The breakfast was good by 2021 standards. Jimmy Dean sausage sanachis.and mini waffles. Uum, uum, good. Lay that syrup on there you'll love it.

Found this place because of the good reviews on yelp. 

We ordered the cinnamon roll French toast with candied almonds and donut glaze as a table starter. It was so incredibly delicious.

The birthday boy ordered The farmhouse which had sausage and gravy and moe joe potatoes, my son got the grilled ham and cheese and I got the BTA Benedict.

Everybody enjoyed what they ordered. I also enjoyed a $4 pomegranate mimosa that rounded out the meal.

The service was great. The food was off the charts awesome. We can't wait to come back.
I called Sean last minute to get my carpets cleaned and he showed up the next morning and did an amazing job! Super quick and well done! My carpets look and smell fresh! I recommend him 100%!

I am from out of town and it looked tasty... honestly I was dissapointed..taste average but got the most microscopic serving ever of guac that was $1 extra wtf...even with chipotle they pile it on...I'll go to the other local place across the street from now on.

New to the area and in search of our new Chinese place - not sure this is it.

So we live in Kuna, and again are new to the area, but it appears our choices arent overflowing. I'd seen this place on the way home so husband and I decided to give it a go.

In total we ordered the Mandarin Chicken, General Tsaos Chicken, Mongolian Beef, Pork Fried Rice, Chicken Chow Mein & Crab stars.

The Crab stars had great flavor but were under cooked. If they had been fried the right amount of time they would have been stellar.

The fried rice lacked any kind of flavor.

The Generals Chicken was good, it's the battered recipe. However I've definitely had better and as a general statement could have also been more flavorful.

Husband liked the Chow Mein, the Mongolian Beef and the Mandarin Chicken, I didn't try them. He did say the Generals Chicken was the best, which leaves much in my opinion to be desired.

Total for everything came to $55, which for the portions we received is a pretty good deal.

We'll definitely try it again, I hope next time they can bring the flavor :)

Really good food but the service and experience was pretty rough.  From the length of time we waited to be seated (when there were several open tables that just needed cleaned), get waters and be served to the quality of service and cleanliness of the restaurant.  It may have just been a bad day for them but I hope they can shore up some those items because, again, the food was delicious.

The services are still great, but they've had a ton of turnover and a new manager.  Policies have changed, and no verbal or other communication was given.  We needed to cancel our membership and in the past had 30 days from our last payment to use our credits.  They changed it to 30 days from when you give notice, even though you have to make an additional payment that falls within the 30 days.  My husband and I had several credits to use and booked services.  When we went to check out last night we were total that our credits had expired and we had to pay- not cool.  Not only did we lose what we'd paid for, but had to pay additional on top of that.  Read all the fine print!
So this is probably one of if not the best Chinese food in the Treasure Valley. Tastes great and is super good for take out. Good service and nice atmosphere

I've been the the Tavern quite a few times and let me tell ya it's legit. I've never been a fan of crazy mixed drinks but each time I come here I try something different and so far most everything has been excellent.

If you need party supplies immediately, there really is no better place to get them than Zurchers. This is a very large, chain store that carries all the things you'll need for just about any party theme: wedding, all birthdays, luau, retirement, big games, etc. 

This particular store is pretty convenient. Though it is located along the death trap that is Eagle Road, there are lots of other stores in this strip mall so you'll be able to get a lot of other errands done without leaving the parking lot. Which is great, considering the impossible task of trying to turn left. 

They are very well organized. Each aisle is grouped into themes and the large sign hanging from the ceiling will tell you exactly what is in each aisle. The workers are always very friendly ("Welcome to Zurchers!") and usually available to help you find what you need. They have lots and lots of balloon choices and the helium is usually available. It is thee cheapest place to get balloons filled that I have found. About 1.15 if you're buying one of their balloon and .87 if you're bringing in your own balloons. They also have tons of Mylar options. 

A few hidden gems... 1. rolls of colored craft paper. Super convenient for special wrappping or poster projects. 2.  A whole aisle of disposable serving options (bowls, utensils, platters) 3. Costumes. They have a decent amount of costume options, which is really nice when you need to dress up outside of Halloween.
This is the best veterinary service I have worked with. The administrative staff and professional staff are all very friendly to both animals and owners.

We love Moe Joe's so much. The food is incredible. The vegetable hash is everything you are hoping for... it satisfies your vegetable servings for the day, while still providing the rich, delicious tastes of breakfast. And the biscuits! Do yourself a favor. Replace the bread in your meal with a biscuit and ask them to toast it. Mouth explosion! 

The other amazing thing about this place is that it is very family friendly. They offer lots of kid friendly choices, the wait staff is great with kids, and they offer coloring pages. They are fast, courteous and my order has never been wrong. 

The only downside is that this place is a bit small so you have to wait a bit to get to your delicious food!
Not worth the 20$ but the flavor was good. Small portion size for the price and it really didn't standout.

Food was just ok! 
Waiter was the worst waiter ever! 
Never asked to refill our drinks. 
We had to flag down a waitress to go find our waiter! 
Overpriced!!

I told the bartender that we weren't happy!

I wish I had asked for the manager and make everyone there aware of the situation
I need my check adjusted please. 
We wasted a lot of time there waiting for the waiter.

I am very seldom giving not-so-good review. I have to this time. It is ruining my nice weekend but I have to let it out....
Drive-thru is supposed to be quick. It took at least 30 minutes waiting just for 3 breakfast burritos....on Saturday morning! It's not like it is a normal biz day morning. And no apologies for the delay. Food is better be good.

Ok...the breakfast burrito was good, with the green salsa. Maybe next time I just have my husband get the food, and I wait at home.

Here I am again...back for some more...I am buying for the office today on Labor day. I am glad they are open 24/7...even on holidays. Bumping up the star.

From age 25 to 28, I visited every Toys R Us I could find!  I was always on the hunt for Transformers and when I found the right one, I even did a happy dance. 

A handful of years later, I visit Toys R Us for a different reason.  I am now a parent and the Baby's R Us side of the store has been a life saver.  Sure, visiting this place still crushes my soul a little bit every time I visit but it has what we need. 

We've had both good and bad experiences here.  We've found greatly helpful employees and we've also found those employees who have no clue where they are at. 

Again, focusing on the Baby's R Us side, we love the vast selection and immediate availability of products.  We've even had to order stuff but it wasn't broke when it arrived.  

Sure Walmart and Target have cheaper prices on some things but I'll take variety over cheap prices when it comes to my child.

Avoid this car wash. They double charged me for a car wash; $22 for a car wash is absolutely ridiculous. They would not refund me the extra charge although they said they would. Very dishonest business.

Love their food.
Wait staff is pretty good, but then again I am a good tipper so ymmv.



Please don't come here.
It's already too busy

Last night I came home from work to find that my labradoodle had eaten all the Christmas goodies from the kitchen counter. I immediately called my current vet only to find out they were already closed for the day. Once I called Intermountain Pet Hospital I knew I had found our new veterinarians office. From the woman I spoke to on the phone to the amazing girls who greeted us when we came in, & of course the Dr, this place will make you feel like home. Dr. Shapero went above & beyond to make sure I understood everything they were going to do to help my Henry, & he also checked in multiple times to give me updates & make sure I was okay (it was clear I was a hot mess over my baby). I can't say thank you enough to Dr. Shapero & the staff at Intermountain Pet Hospital!! You all made an extremely stressful evening go as seamless as possible & for that I will always be grateful.

I've taken my pupper Lucy here a few times now.  The wait times are reasonable.  The front staff is really nice, very knowledgeable about local stuff for dogs to do... should they get bored and say "what's up today? Can we go do something fun and different? I'm bored with the same ol walks...".   Oh.  They don't talk.  Well, maybe it's just my dog.  It's the way she looks at me I guess.  

Anyway, we've seen two vets there, the head honcho and heather.  Both very thorough and caring.  I know my girl is in good hands when we go in.   

One time she went in for dental.  Dr Mark called me to say she needed several extractions.. be warned the bill will be around $1,000.  Okay I said. That will be hard on the ol pocketbook, but do what's needed for the best care of my precious Lucy, I said.  Oy!  I come to pick her up and all she has left are two bottom fangs and about 8 teeth in the waaaaaaaay back of her mouth.  That will be over $2,000.00 please!  WHAT???!?!  I was told it would be half that!  

Be careful with your pocketbook here...  it may get picked.  But hey, they did a great job and now my Lucy has the best breath in the whole family!

Thanks for taking our dogs overnight while we were on the road and needed to visit family. They were well taken care of. Only comment would be that not all services were available (grooming) , as schedules were already filled.

Horrible service , clueless staff , food was not warm .... And i still had to pay.

Do not waste your money on this establishment.

I just bought tires about 2 weeks ago and I had an issue with them and brought it to the attention of pretty much all the employees. When they see a white Subaru drive up I'm sure they were shaking there heads but at the same time they never showed any sort of irritation. My car would pull to one side really bad so we think it's a radial pull so they replace it no questions asked.  This happens like 3 times and every time they replaced it no questions asked. So I've had 7 tires in 2 weeks put on my car and the whole time every single person I talked to had the greatest customer service and all the management from the bottom to the top guy, and I've talked to them all we're great. The best customer service I have had in a long time.  So I've read some reviews and don't understand why some are so negative so I look into there other reviews of places and the majority of them are negative too so people don't let the negative reviews discourage you from buying tires here.

I no longer recommend this location and will be looking for a new resort that cares more. This used to be my go to location for vet care, exercise, boarding, and grooming. However, their pet resort just can't be trusted. My poor dog has come home multiple times with very torn paws and their staff failed to monitor as instructed. I know others with torn feet too. Management's response is that they haven't been able to resolve the environment (concrete) and that my dog just isn't a good fit for them. Sad accountability (especially when they tell you the next day when you call concerned that they noticed something during his bath but didn't relay that to the owner). Management seemed more frustrated by an upset owner rather than the health of my dog. Please don't take any dogs here that can't run on concrete or that require observation.
My Mother's Day meal pick!!!!! The whole family is happy! The kiddos especially love the honey walnut chicken!
Outstanding! From the drinks to the bread to the lasagna di mare! Highly recommend eating here..

From our first visit many moons ago to now, the food has been exquisite and the service awesome!

Please try to get Jessica as your server!  You will be  awestruck from her culinary knowledge and more so from her personality!

Her recommendations were right on!  You look at a menu and pretend you know what you desire.  She then cultivates your desire to an extraordinary dining experience!

Now, tonight we had Cameron and apparently Gino only surrounds himself with the best!


Cameron was knowledgeable and on top of his game!  Food as always was fantastic and Shrimp Maria is an absolutely go to dish!

FOOD CHALLENGE HERE!  
$ 1寿司プレート ($1 Sushi Plates)! 

41st person to review Shige Express in Merdian, Idaho on Meridian Rd next to Sarah's Bagels. This is my 460th review. This is the sister location of the Shige and Shige Express in Boise on 8th. 

Whats better than Sushi? Trying many different types at once, that's what! Here you can get a plate of sushi for $1. The white plates are $1 and come with 1-2 pieces. The black plates are $2 and also come with 1-2 pieces, but these are more of the nigiri sushi and the more expensive ingredients. You can easily stack up a bunch of plates so in some cases it may be cheaper to order a roll and you can order other things, too, and still grab from the trough of water. There are a few other things that you can get off of the boats, too, such as stuffed mushroom and peppers. I am not too sure what else, if anything. I wasn't there long. 

You don't have to order it this way, but if you want to try many different types and flavors this is the way to go! Sit down at the semi-circular table and lift plates off the wooden boats that pass you by. Keep in mind if you're one of the first people at the table that everyone around the table has to eat, too, so don't take too many at once-- they'll come back around and you're always first for the fresh stuff. 

If this isn't your thing, sit at one of the sideline tables and order from the menu. This place is small, but it's an Express-- quick service. 

AS for the food challenge I mentioned, I/we didn't attempt, but if you eat 55+ plates you get the sushi for free and your photo on the wall (bragging rights!), but if you fail you pay double! Ouch!! 

They are closed midday like many other sushi places, which sucks for me who is usually grabbing lunch at about 2, but I get it. 

友人を楽しむ (ENJOY FRIENDS). :)

Terrible experience! Had an appointment at 8 am to get my dog spayed, yet they kenneled her for 7 hours & she went unfed for 9 hours before they finally took her in for surgery. Afterwards I was told to reach out with any questions, yet every time I called they said they'd call back by the end day but didn't. Each time, having to call several days in row to get my question answered. My puppy's suture split open & they didn't get back with me for TWO days! Also, both times I had an appointment & still had to wait over 20 minutes to see someone. Wish I never gave them my business & I'll never go back!

Great burgers!  Rueben sandwich was awesome. Great beer selection. TVs all over.

Waitstaff was very attentive. Great atmosphere!

Not a huge fan of the new place. The prices are more expensive than the last company, plus you get less. They have fresh food and it tastes good, so that's nice. But after ordering a wrap, I won't be back. It took the employee about ten minutes to make, even though we were the only customers in the store. She was busy talking to her coworkers, completely stopping every few seconds to look towards them and chat while we were waiting. She could barely fold or properly cut the wrap. For $10.00, I was not very happy getting a wrap with barely any filling, including forgetting a few items that were listed under the ingredients. Since it was not made properly, it was messy to eat but not because it was too full. I understand if she was new, but having to wait that long and having forgotten items because she was distracted talking with coworkers is what made this frustrating.

The Boise area has fewer great Asian restaurants than I'd like. Red Pavillion is one of the best ones west of downtown. Their ramen is satisfying. Their Szechuan menu has some pretty great options that don't skimp on Szechuan chiles. And, if you are looking for Americanize Chinese food, they will happily serve you some pretty great versions of that. 

Quick tip, lots of things get jalepenos or habaneros added if you ask for it spicy. If you'd rather have chili paste added, they are happy to bring it to the table. 

Service here is quick and efficient, and the wait staff is super kind.

My under engine guard came off and Les Schwab put it back in place until I can reorder the part.  They were so quick and efficient.  They always have the best customer service.  Tom helped me today and gave me great advice on how to replace it for the lowest cost.  Thank you so much for being such a great team!

Have enjoyed a few different menu items here... the teriyaki chicken bowl, the beef yakisoba bowl, and the katsu. All delicious! They are still new and have a few operational kinks on wait times, but love the food!

Although the food was quite yummy and our waitress was amazing (Haze)  the hostess was very rude.  She didn't greet you, smile, and acted like she couldn't be bothered.  When we arrived there were at least 6 empty tables.  We were told there would be a 20 minute wait, even though there were many empty tables, half of them dirty.  A couple came in after us and they were told 25 minutes, very rudely. They were basically excused...they left :( There was a large party of about 12 people who patiently waited for a table.  The hostess just threw menus and silverware on the table.  She didn't even put enough chairs for them. The customers did it themselves.  The hostess might have been having a bad day, but she didn't make it enjoyable for the guests or a fun place to enjoy a yummy  breakfast. An attitude check was in order.

I've been coming here for about a year and i have never had a bad experience. The staff is wonderful and i always leave feeling amazing!! Definitely would recommend them to anyone and everyone-family friendly too!

I am more than happy to give five stars as I found a good chinese eatery!! I was lucky to find it being a chinese food lover. Boise doesn't have good chinese place. I ordered the chicken rice stick noodle and mongloian beef, it is probably the best I had. The place is filled with people,which tells the quality of food. I loved the beef, it was tender and spicy. The waitresses were awesome and made sure that everyone is taken care of. I will be visiting over and over again!!

The food was well priced. I was expecting a huge barbecue and they were cooking on a smaller grill so I was a little bit skeptical.  No need to be!

I have a chicken thigh combination. It was delicious. The rice was great, the cabbage slaw was incredible, and the chicken thighs were full of flavor! $11 is a total good deal for a food truck lunch like this!

For what it is.. It's amazing. It's nice to have basic rolls at an inexpensive price to satisfy the sushi cravings w/o spending a whole lot of money. I enjoy being able to choose from different types of rolls. 

The ambiance is ok.. Service is ok.. But I don't go for either the service or ambiance. I'll go again when I crave sushi. 

I must say.. They do not have spicy rolls.. They'll put spicy mayo or Sriracha, but still not spicy.
Food is right on, good solid service, great portions and very good food.  Even was a little cheaper than I expected.  For sure will go again

THIS IS WHAT 5-STAR LOOKS LIKE!

1- Service, from when I walked in the door until I was leaving left nothing to desire.

2- Dat bread.  I'm going to make some assumptions here.  My first assumption is that Dat Bread was made on the same day that I visited.  It was so fresh and moist, and it was served with a garlic-and-something infused olive oil to dip it in.  I could've just had the bread and left.. no, don't do that.

3- Dat red sauce!  This is my next assumption(s).... it was made in house earlier the same day.  Nothing can make/break an Italian place like the red sauce, as... well... everything I tend to order is drowned in it.  I could've ordered shots of the red sauce!

4- So, the special was (if I remember) a halibut parm with a bunch of other details that I forgot.  I had chicken parm on the brain when I walked in so I was like "GIVE ME ALL THE CHICKEN PARMS!!111!!1!"  It was prolly the best chicken parm I can remember eating in my life, and I was still like "man, I should've got the halibut parm."  So basically, my meal was excellent, but I was left wanting the thing I didn't order... so I'll have to go back, right?

K, it's been like 10 years since I had a good indie Italian place to go to, so I'm pretty excited, but even scaling it down to as if I'd had dinner at another amazing Italian place in the past less-than-ten-years, I'd still be raving about the amazing meal I just had.

Oh, I'll be back, and I'm getting whatever special is running next time... be warned :-P
Love love Moe Joe's! By far my favorite breakfast place! Haven't had a bad thing yet !

There's nothing exceptional about Joy Garden. It's very similar to every other Chinese-American restaurants in the Treasure Valley serving up greasy, over-salted, super unauthentic food (Panda Garden, Golden Star, Mandarin Palace, etc). That being said, the food isn't bad! Just don't expect anything special. 

I called in an offer for delivery for Combination Dinner No. 1 ($9.05). This included Pork Fried Rice, Mandarin Chicken with Sweet & Sour Sauce, Egg Foo Yong and Fried Shrimp. I was in the mood for a hefty meal so I also included BBQ Pork & Seeds plus Special House Salad ($6.90 for both) to my order. Delivery was speedy for being rush hour. I only waited about 30 minutes and the food arrived still hot! 

The food tasted just like every other Chinese-American restaurant I've tried but I enjoyed every single bite! The fried rice didn't taste like it had made in grease as old as the sun. It was delicious and a lot of flavor. The egg foo yong, while quite unappealing at first glance, tasted great! Again, very flavorful and freshly made. The chicken and shrimp combined well with the sweet and sour sauce. I love these dinners because you can rotate between choices and every bite is different! A bite of chicken, now rice, and salad, back to chicken, it's so much fun especially when it all tastes good!

Overall I would order from Joy Garden again. Yummy food and impressive delivery!

I love this place! My first time there was after I had heatstroke from helping a friend move. Everyone is so great, and I love that they focus on preventative health, but have lots of great way to help you heal after work-outs or surgeries or just exhaustion. I always feel healthier and immune boosted after my appointments! I have used the cryotherapy, red light therapy, IVs and Hip compression and it's all helped so much!

Mandy is the best. She always smiling, always takes care of me. Communicates with me, and asks me what I want, though she already knows. She never assumes. Great conversationalist.  I waited 90 minutes for her today, but no complaints here.
Been here twice now and WOW!! Amazing food! Great wine list! Wonderful service!!! We will be back often!

First time here, total score. Had an amazing breakfast burrito and BF had the fresh veggie garden hash. Literally everything on the menu sounded great. Huge portions, great prices and service, and the food was fresh and delicious. This place does get crowded, so prepare to wait, but the friendly, efficient service is a pleasure. Can't wait to go back.

I went out tonight hoping for a nice dinner at one of my favorite burger joints. Walked in and no one greeted me. After I finally got seated it took about 10 minutes to even get acknowledged and then it was not my server, but at least someone came and asked me if I wanted something to drink. When my server finally arrived she apologized and told me that she had a bigger table that she was dealing with which is fine, I know you're busy. My is that the restaurant was 95% empty and it took so long to even be acknowledged. 

She was pleasant, took my order and left. Sometime later she brought my salad and left. I saw her about 15 minutes later with my burger and she didn't ask me if I wanted another salad or anything. My drink tasted foul and I would have liked the opportunity to let her know  so that I can have water that was drinkable. She just dropped the food and left. 

Never saw her again until it was time to pay. She never asked me if my food was okay, never asked me if I would like another dinner salad. Nothing. Nada.

There were less than a dozen customers in the entire restaurant and bar. How is it that you can have at least 6 or more staff members out front and no one even bothered to look my way for so long. I realize that singles aren't as big a tip for you servers. We do give a higher percentage overall generally. And it would be really, really nice to be treated like we count as much as your bigger tables.

had a coupon for buy one get one free so decided to come in and give it a try- SO glad we did! 

I got the luau pork bowl with veggies and white rice and a side of jalapeño ranch. my dad got the teriyaki chicken bowl with white rice and veggies.

the cashier was really nice and helpful with what to order. the inside of the place itself was really cute and clean- very kid friendly! they even had lilo and stitch playing on a big screen...great place to bring the family. 

the food was very fresh and flavorful, I was really happy with it! also a very generous portions. really looking forward to coming back.

This place makes me nostalgic tummy rumble!!

Ok, if you're looking for authentic off the boat Chinese then move on! If you're looking for flavorful, fried, tacky booths and decor American Chinese then rejoice as you've found the place!! 

Don't get me wrong, I'm a foodie and love me some fancy and authentic Asian cuisine but anyone who can't get down with some fried deliciousness paired with BBQ pork and egg flower soup then we probably can't be friends.

Ordered here for the first time last night, got it DELIVERED! This is huge for me, Portland has NO Chinese that delivers and it's just wrong!!

I'm 37wk pregnant and really just wanted a tub of pork fried rice. We ended up ordering the Special Fried Rice, Fried Shrimp, Fried Wontons, Spicy Orange Chicken and Potstickers. It was everything is dreamed it would be! 

The fried rice was delicious. It was actually fried, which these days seems like impossible to find. I loved the amount of veggies. I would have liked larger shrimp and more pork, but overall tasted great.

The potstickers were also delicious. A tad dry, but I also don't like to dip my potstickers in anything so if you do then it probably wouldn't have been a big deal. The stickers were well cooked, crispy but not chewy or hard. The filling was a well seasoned pork mixture and also cooked thoroughly.

The Wontons were, again, delicious. There were probably slightly over cooked but it didn't take away from anything. The filling was really good. 

My husband ate the Orange Chicken. Not sure how it comes in the restaurant but the sauce came on the side. This wasn't a bad thing at all, actually makes for a less messy transport and you can decide how saucy you want your food :) the sauce is the jelly kind, I know some places differ. I did take a bite, it wasn't too spicy but had a good kick. I thought the chicken was cooked well and the sauce had great orange flavor. The side of rice it comes with is silly though... For an entire order of orange chicken you get less than a cup of white rice. This really should be changed, I did see a previous complaint about it. Next time we will just order more.

The fried shrimp were also delicious, but I mean how can anyone really screw up fried shrimp!? They were cooked well though, the batter was cooked thoroughly and not dried.

Delivery took about 40min and food arrived not only got but the fried stuff still crispy! 

So far, this has made its way to No. 1 go-to quick fix Chinese for us!

For our trip to Boise, we made the decision to bring two of our cats. These two travel well and are bonded and super needy.

We didn't have a large budget, but we found this reasonably priced one bedroom.

The room had plenty of space for the cats to run around, a kitchenette for cooking and keeping leftovers, a nice large couch for cuddles, and more. It was perfect for our needs and what the cats needed.

One of my favorite things was the little magnets that you could put on the door that said you had animals in your room so that staff would know. I am an anxious person and worried about how they would know and if someone would mistakenly let a cat out even if we put the "do not disturb" sign up, but my anxiety was put to rest knowing that this animal sign was there.

This hotel had everything we needed, in a good location, and for a reasonable price. PLUS! They have laundry and it's FREE. Yes, FREE!

If you're in Boise and need a place to stay with or without your cat or dog, this is a great place to go.

Accessibility: While I am uncertain of the specifics, I did see many accessible rooms equipped with doorbells and low peep holes. The front door is an automatic door and there is a good, large elevator to the upper floors. It may not be possible to access the Cupboard since it is a small area.

I went in for a tire rotation, my tires are 3 years and 1 was replaced last year because it blew and couldn't be fixed. They didn't want to give me much for the warranty and I had to fight for a fair price which was eventually given to me by the manager. After this year's rotation they told me I needed new tires and new front brakes. 
Tyler was extremely rude and told me it would be 600$ for new front brakes. Then he told me I wouldn't get much money towards new tires from the warrenty.  He didn't not seem to care when I told him one of the tires was only one year old. I have only driven 30,000 miles on these tires that have a 50,000 mile warranty. I called Midas and got new front brakes for $170 and I feel like they will honor their warranty better than this company.

Extremely disappointing meal.  I ordered the Veal Piccata, and it had so much lemon in it that I COULD NOT eat it!  I'm not sensitive to sour flavors - I actually like them (I usually add a bit of vinegar to my soup), but this was so lemony it actually chafed my lips.  There was no other taste but lemon!  The server came by and asked if all was OK, and I told him that there was WAY too much lemon in the sauce.  Then another person came by a bit later and collected the 99% full plate.  All with no response from the management.  I've had other meals here that were good, so this was a real surprise.  DO NOT order the Veal Piccata!

My husband and I have been here many times and we've always gotten their sushi rolls, which have been pretty good. On our most recent visit, my husband decided to try their ramen. Huge mistake. It tasted terrible! He got the tonkatsu with shoyu and it has a very fishy/off taste. He took about 2 bites and couldn't eat anymore. That night and most of the rest of the day he was really sick! We will definitely never be going back.

I really love this place 
The WonTon soup is sooo good 
Mongolian Beef is so awesome 
The waitress is so very friendly 
I  found this place last year while visiting 
my Son and family!!!  First place I ate this 
year

Went in to purchase a new phone and was told they can't sell me one since I didn't have an appointment.
Guess I will give my money to a store that wants it.
Their loss!

Tyler was an excellent guide through the delicious and varied menu. Flavors that dance and sing on you on your tongue. We loved the lasagne and Butternut squash ravioli, fresh and made in house by inspired chefs who are artists with food, not overdone but Just Right!! Comfortable dining room, tables and padded chairs with beautiful windows so we forgot we were in Meridian. We will be back and bring family!
Excellent brokerage! Top notch tools and service! The owners care immensely and focus on making it an attractive place for top agents.

To be fair, I haven't really used the insurance yet so I cannot comment on my coverage or lack-of; but I did call them to ask about costs of specialists and after being transferred twice and explaining my situation to multiple people, I was hung up on. 

It was like the man didn't want to answer my question or didn't know the answer and just hung up. I thought we were disconnected at first but afterwards it became obvious he clicked off the line and he never called me back.

By this time I had been on the phone with so many different people I didn't want to call back and go through the whole process again. I'll be calling back though, and I will make sure these people give me the answers i'm looking for

OMG the food simply sucks here completely, fully and  to the extreme.  First off I ask for a thIck shake and it's runny, then they forget my burger all together.  Topped off with fry sauce that tastes like bbq.

Went there thinking they would have overhead campers, but wandered around the lot and could not find any for sale. Only salesman seen was leaving the lot on a test drive with a motorhome. Gave up and left.

I'm almost completely sure this location has now been three different wing places. I feel like someone isn't learning from the failed location business model. That being said, I've really enjoyed all the restaurants that have been here, Wingers included! 

The service was fine, kinda typical. Our waitress was very nice, and the greeter at the door was especially friendly and welcoming. There was one waitress who was assisting or copiloting our table who was kinda rude, but I'm not writing this to get people fired so let's just say she was a pinkish blueish half dragonfly half lasagne looking thing. Which arguably you could say looks like the Blue Man Group after a shrapnel explosion, but I digress...

They have all you can eat wings! Well sorta! They have all you can eat boneless wings, but they call them sticky sticks... or juicy slabs... or finger lickers, or sticky meat bars, or some name that makes you feel slightly uncomfortable... I can't quite remember. But they were really good! My family and I particularly enjoyed the Whiskey BBQ and their home sauce... awesome sauce? It's the first sauce on the list. Thanks to the "all you can eat" deal, we got to try everything! I didn't much like any of the dry rubs, but everything else was yummy! 

This is a big open family friendly place, so come on down and eat some all you can eat slime stickers! There's a parking lot obviously because this is Meridian/Eagle Idaho and not a major city so that should be obvious. And there's a Wing Stop close by if you're feeling redundant after your meal.

Reviewer #109                                 3-stars "A-OK"

I looked at the reviews of this place and I felt like it was a must try. As someone who is seriously watching every calorie in, this place has great low carb options-- protein and veggies with a little sauce (sauce never hurt anyone... or did it)?!? 

Walking in the place seemed small, nice, and clean. Everyone was friendly. The order taker came almost immediately, pen and notebook in hand, ready to take my order. She was new and I thought it was sweet that she was so attentive, but I didn't get the menu open yet. Another server brought fried wonton chips and sweet and sour sauce. They had three different servers on staff and every few minutes one came over and asked how we were. The young ladies were trying very hard for excellent customer service, and I would never be rude, but it was way too much. I counted 11 times someone came to our table that wasn't our waitress. Again, great customer service, but too much. 

The food came. It was a nice portion and had good flavor. To me, it wasn't anything special. I ordered the double mushroom and I had 8 mushroom pieces. So, the original mushroom must only have 4? I substituted the steak for chicken. I had my choice of dark or white chicken, which was nice; I chose white. The chicken was moist and very good. I ate some and had plenty to return home with. You're also given your choice between white and brown rice, but I skipped the rice. My dining companion got the mongol beef and thought it was very tasty. He would rate the restaurant a 4.  

On the wall hangs their shirts that they have for purchase. If you're a big fan, be sure to buy one.

All in all, I would give this place a 3.5. There wasn't anything special. the customer service was too much (hard to say because they were amazingly nice and helpful) and the food didn't rock my world (double the mushroom people!). However, many of my favorite yelpers rated this place higher than I; therefore, I vow to visit again and give it another chance. If you're trying for a healthier lifestyle this place has many options.

Today I went to the Verizon store to add another line to my account. Also discussed additional charges that were charged to my account. Alex the mobile team associate was super helpful. 
I recommend this location to help you if you need for all of your Verizon needs. Ask for Alex...he will take care of you!

Bleh, the most disgusting pizza sauce I've ever had in my life, pizza was cold (cheese wasn't hot and stretchy) and crust was tough and bread like, not the typical chewy crust with a little crisp like you expect from a good pizza. Will not order from here again.

We went to Carinos as we used to go there when we lived in Twin Falls and liked it.  Boy have they gone downhill.  It was on a Saturday night at 7:00 there were no cars in the parking lot, which should have been our first clue.  We were seated quickly, slow waitress- when she finally arrived we ordered drinks, as we had 2 small children we wanted to order quickly, but she disappeared.  We finally ordered and the food was very slow, as there were only 6-8 table with people it should have been much faster.  I order chicken parm- absolutely terrible!!!  Burnt and so hard I could not even cut it. My husband ordered the skillitini, it was also awful, greasy and the sausage was inedible.  Since we never saw our waitress again until she came with the bill and wanted to know if I wanted a box, at which time I stated NO did not want the awful food, she seemed surprised, I requested it to come off the bill. Even the kids would not eat the mac & cheese- now that's bad when you ruin mac & cheese. Will never go to this place again, might try Twin Falls again when we are there, but sadly they are going downhill at a rapid pace.  Sorry to see a once good place go soooo bad.

What A FARCE!  My auto was not very dirty, so I thought I would give Epic Shine a try.  I had a coupon for a free basic wash.  When my auto was finished and the tow was disconnected, I couldn't believe my eyes!  The windshield, hood, windshield, rear window, side windows. The entire auto was covered with water.  There are NO TOWELS to dry the auto by oneself at the vacuum stalls.  So, I drove home hoping to get there before the water dried and I was stuck with spots.  No luck.  The car was covered with spots!  I tried to use my own slightly dampened towel to remove the spots with very little success.  It now looks worse than before Epic Shine!  Plus, my towel was covered with grit, dirt and grime.  So, save your money and time and choose a car wash that actually dries the water from the wash and cleans the exterior.  I will!
Food was wonderful! Prices were great!! Sit in Kolbey's section he'll take care great care of you!

This new Fred Meyer has it all.  Great one stop shop with an amazing produce department, including organic produce.  This store has a variety of departments that cater to my needs such as a great deli, health product section and a very helpful meat department.  I have always experienced great customer service from every area.  I appreciate the store is very clean, organized and well designed.

I have experienced more than one occasion that they are out of items on particular days as they have shipments coming in on certain days.  At times, the produce department may not have particular items due to a busy weekend.  Other than that, I have been very happy with Fred Meyer and will continue to make this my go to store.

Delicious food! We had the hot chocolate to start off and for our breakfast items we Chicken Fried Steak and the BLT Benedict and it's been the best bite of breakfast we've had in Meridian. The servers are warm and friendly and service was quick and easy. I will definitely be coming back here with my wife and I look forward to bringing all my friends and family here when they come to visit!
Overrated. Peppers in bowl were still hard , no flavor. Its kielbasa not breakfast sausage
Did a fantastic job!  They were quick but very thorough and made sure everything was perfect!  We are very pleased with workmanship and professionalism!

FLORAL REVIEW ONLY. 
Flowers are horrible. DIED after 2 days. The younger gal was very rude and attitude for days in the floral department while helping me with balloons on May 13 around 11:30 am. I've never been treated so rudely by someone EVER and I'm not some old fart complaining for no reason. They should can her but I know help is hard to find these days , so they wont.

Reviewer no. 12

Okay, so I have an addiction... I know I need to break it, but it's oh-so-good and the staff is super duper! 
I get an Americano (black coffee) add cream and sweet-n-low and it's only $2.75 and about 50 calories. I can get my kiddo a not-so-hot chocolate and my dog a treat (FREE, YAY!), too! 
I like the Bros mainly because of its people. Seriously, I don't know how they hire so many amazing people! Save some for us that need good employees!! 
Lots of sugar-free options! Google search, Dutch Bros secrete menu-- lots more fun stuff like the BOB Marley, Ninja Turtle and much more! 


Keep up the GREAT job!

Although I live in Utah, I visit family in this area often, and we have a thing for pizza. Consequently, I've eaten at a lot of pizza places on the Boise/Meridian/Eagle area. I have to say that Grimaldi's probably makes the best pizza around. I haven't tried anything else they sell - just pizza - so I'm giving them five stars for the quality of their pizza. The crust is always thin and crisp and a bit blackened from the coal-fired cooking method, so that may not be everyone's cup of tea, but it is how I like my pizza. It's of the more expensive pizza places around, but it's worth it every once in a while. Try the margherita pizza - it's our family's favorite!

The seemed like nice people until we signed paperwork.  We had very minimal changes to the plan and were told the plans needed redrawn.  Now I feel very put off and lied to. Were 6 week after sending the plans in for changes and I was just told a few more weeks. I chose them for what they said they could do and they are not living up to anything yet. I'm sure this will get edited I just hope it's for the better.

If I could give this place zero stars I would. The wait was way longer than stated. There was no clear management or method to seating people in the correct order. It was dirty and they couldn't keep up with cleaning. 

The food was soggy and no flavor or burnt undertones. They forgot our fried rice and appetizer till after we finished eating and asked multiple times for it, never refilled our drinks even with trying to get their attention. If you think this is good Mandarin food you've obviously never had good Mandarin. 

Also I got horribly ill after eating there so I will definitely be calling the health board

Tried this place while visiting family and OMG it was amazing!!! It was hard to decide what to try but I went with the chilaquiles and my son had the banana bread French toast. Holy cow it was delicious!!! Also got a side of Brussels sprouts because if they're on the menu I am ordering them... I'm still thinking about them every day and it's been over a week since I've had them. 
Service was great too!! Highly recommend this place and will come back every single time I'm in town!! Can I interest you in opening a location in California?!?!
Professional and courteous service beyond expectations. I highly recommend Discount Tire.
They wouldn't let me pick up an order that was called in,  I had to order it a second time and then they made me exit the drive through, and wait at the back of the drive through line.  Very strange

They made quite possibly the best breakfast I've ever had and I don't exactly live under a rock. It's too bad I don't live in Boise because I'd come here weekly. My girlfriend worked as a chef and also said this was the best breakfast place she's ever been.
Excellent foods at reasonable price.Service was great and ambiance is lovely.Highly recommended.

Wasn't my favorite being pregnant I was craving pasta but this wasn't it. We ordered pick up that was fine however for the price I expected a lot more didn't satisfy my craving which was a bummer because I had heard good things.
It was a nice place and friendly staff. I wish the spa wouldn't have been booked but it was very quiet and clean

We are on the hunt for granite for our kitchen and bathroom. They guys here are so helpful. Their job is essentially to educate us on the different granite they have and give us a price range for each. They are very knowledgeable about each type of granite and give suggestions based upon what you are looking for. Francini's has the biggest selection of granite and quartz by far! Their showroom is a bit chilly, so don't forget your jackets when you come. They have the floor organized so that the least expensive slabs are to your left and they gradually get more expensive as your progress. They have chips of stone that you can bring home and live with for a bit so that you can make you decision. However, you do not directly buy pieces from them, you go through a fabricator and have them buy the slabs for you. No appointment is necessary for browsing their showroom.

I had Hannah Henry, and she is SO DANG SWEET! 
Upon walking in, I immediately love the vibe here- clean, modern, modest and appropriate. I came for a cut and a blonde and they have delivered! They provide snacks, water- even wine or coffee! And I tell you what.... That is really nice to have when you are sitting for 4 hours 
Sweet women work here and they strive for attaining what you want. 
Please visit this place!
Sean was great am from California and want to have my daughters carpet done in Idaho. We were about to set up something right away. Did a great job.

Yum!!! I passed through town while traveling and discovered this gem. This place is so good and they have gluten free options that are actually awesome! I got a takeout including a make-your-own scramble with corned beef & Swiss with their amazing potatoes, and I had mini gf pancakes that were the best gf ones I've ever had. The lady who took the order gave me great recommendations and was super nice & efficient! I wish there was one of these near me!

Expensive for the quality of food. I've had better pizza. There's no kid menu. Not recommended for children. 
Service was poor if you ask me. There were servers standing around. Our server acted like she couldn't come close to our table, at one time she stood behind me while talking, I had to turn to see if she was talking to me or the table next to me. I won't return to this restaurant.

New to town and decided to try out this Italian restaurant. The venue offered a smaller more intimate place to dine. Therefore on a Friday evening at 8pm it was still pretty packed. The sit down wait was about an hour wait where as the bar area provided open seating immediate. Very impressed with the service and the food. My husband had the traditional spaghetti & meatballs and I had a spicy penne pasta with sausage. Both had amazing flavor and the portions were decent sized. It is a bit on the pricey side, however it was well worth the cost. The only unfortunate side to not providing a 5 star review is due to health safety of handling the food that I witnessed. I personally have history working in the food industry and know basic health and food safety laws that need to be practiced. Servers should never handle food without using proper gloves or without a serving utensils of any kind. Therefore, don't handle food with your bare hands even if it's garnishments to the public people. It's just plain unsanitary.

Delicious Chinese food!!! Great service they were very busy but on the ball the whole time. We enjoyed everything. The wontons however in wonton soup need more meat inside little too much noodle but it was very busy and everything was delicious!

What a great eyeglass store right off E Overland Road. Professional Staff immaculate office. I went in for a minor eye glass repair and was helped out right away....my glasses look new !! No charge!! I will be back and I know you will like this store.

They are the most rude people ever the messed up on my nails and we're hurting my nails and they didn't care. This are the worst my nails have ever worked. Never come here . My girl didn't even know how to do a j on my nails. Looks like a five year old did this

Learn from my experience and don't waste your money.  I hired Re-bath because I was told the entire bathroom would be completed in 3-5 days, that they use all in-house people, and would repair any mold or plumbing problems that would be found.  None of these things were true.  The project began on October 1st and was completed on October 29th.  I had a great quality, but outdated bath.  Now, I have a poor quality bath that drips for an hour after using, it is too loud to use if someone is sleeping, and they have ruined the wall texture, door molding and got paint and drywall spackle all over windows, etc.  There were multiple instances I was told they would be there, and they didn't show and times they showed when they were not expected.  The plumber and drywall people were outsourced.  I was aware they were outsourcing the tile and the tile subcontractor did an excellent job.  They didn't even caulk around the tub until I put up a big stink - then they caulked with a white that doesn't blend with the tub or the flooring.  They painted the doors and trim with a roller for masonry, so it has lumps everywhere.  EVERYTHING must be redone.  I have already hired someone else to fix what they ruined.  There is $14K down the drain.  The $14K was supposed to be for tub, tile, wall and trim texture and paint, sink, counter, and toilet.  They charge high end prices for low quality work and materials.  They didn't keep any of their promises.  I kept my floors, vanity, mirrors, etc since they are much better quality than their materials.  They removed the copper pipes that were in great shape and replaced with PVC.  The fixtures were supposed to be chrome, but they are plastic with a chrome colored coating.

My favorite sushi restaurant for many years now. I'm pleased they are so much closer to me in Meridian, it makes ordering delivery a breeze especially during COVID where I am doing as much as I can to avoid unnecessary outings. The Chef & Server Creations are the absolute bomb as far as deliciousness goes. The KC Roll is my hands down favorite, it has never disappointed and the Heavy Metal is a close second.

Love how everyone is so friendly and helpful from the moment you walk in. I started going last March when I slipped aNd missed  a step on a stair and thEy got me back to normal.  Now I go back monthly to just make sure I am still great and will add a massage as needed to help. Dr Ricks, Massage therapists, front desk, and all other employees are the best! Highly recommend you visit them.

We come to this Wingers all the time, not only is the food great, but we experience the best service! We had had Kyle as our waiter a couple times now and he is so personable! Love coming into the restaurant  and being seated in his area. Best service in the valley.

If I could rate a zero or negative star, I would. The phone service was terrible & disrespectful. Every single thing we ordered was wrong somehow.

 We ordered an Ultimate Porker which is ham & bacon, no bacon. Requested no cheese, we got cheese.  Ordered & paid for bacon on a Club Lulu, no bacon. Ordered a Veggie which is supposed to have avocado, no avocado.

When we called to complain they argued with us, told us not to eat yet (we'd already waited more than 20 minutes) because they had to come & "inspect the sandwiches to make sure we weren't trying to get extra bacon & then consult their staff".  

My son had to leave for work & couldn't wait to eat. When we told them that, whoever my husband spoke to said he didn't care & if they didn't see the sandwich to prove us wrong, they wouldn't do anything.

This was their second chance & they screwed up royally.  Not ordering from them again.

***After waiting 45 minutes for someone to come "inspect" the sandwiches, we had to call back.  Turns out someone remade the sandwiches & dropped them on the ground in front of our door without knocking or ringing the doorbell.  There were instructions to leave the food on a table right next to the door. We have no idea how long they were out there & it's almost 100° right now.***

Stay away from happy hour..ghost town and they have three beers on tap
 Coors light,blue moon and perroni.that says it all
