Been here a lot come with my daughter quite a bit, used to eat here for lunch at least once a week. Food is good everyone loves the sweet pork salad I always get the sweet pork burrito smothered. One thing I don't like is that they rush you through the line like cattle and are very quick and inconsiderate on their helpings. At the end of the line they ask you if you want any extra, don't forget to ask what comes on it or they'll skip giving you the sour cream. Guacamole is extra served in a thimble sized scoo, always a rip off. Fortunately there's a lot of coupons out for this place and the sweet pork itself is amazing.

The agent told me that it would take an hour and it took just that. They didn't try to Jerk me around an up sell. They did everything straight forward and I couldn't be happier. Honest and great work and I will be going to them for all my tire and wheel needs. No more les Schwab. Thanks guys.

I have been a fan of discount tire since I first walked into one many many years ago. I was very happy when they came back to the valley after being gone for a while. There always super friendly and prices are always right on par. I have no complaints. I have no issue going out of my way to stop in at this DS for what ever tire needs I have.

The receptionists at the front desk were thorough and professional. They answered all the questions we had. The best part of my visit was the encounter with the doctor she was very knowledgeable. I couldn't ask for a better visit. I would definitely recommend this clinic!
Great wings . Way better than BWW or Wingstop . Can't wait to go back .  The original Wingers sauce was out favorite

After reviewing about how good the pizza was here decided to check it out. Came in the afternoon eat and do some work on the side, but learned there was no public WiFi. Also didn't feel welcomed by the employee at the counter.

A favorite date night location for my wife and I, a cozy layout and an improved menu make this my go to Italian restaurant here in Meridian. 

Menu: Recent menu changes paired down their offerings quite a bit, which I'm sure came as a relief to the chefs and keeps standards high. It includes both traditional and Americanized Italian menu items. You can't go wrong with any of them. My favorite is the smoked boar; pricy but well worth it. Wine selection is amazing as well. No complaints there. 

Food: Every time we go, my wife and I continue to be impressed by the quality of the food served here. Everything comes out hot and fresh, no telltale signs of "Chef Mic(rowave)" to be found anywhere. Everything is made fresh and it shows. We're usually impressed enough by our dinners that dessert usually follows. There's nothing that I can honestly say you should avoid here. You could throw a dart at the menu and hit an item that you're sure to love. 

Service: prompt, professional, unobtrusive, polite. The owner can be spotted working most busy nights as well seating guests and making recommendations or just ensuring that everyone is enjoying themselves. All the serves we've had seem to have at least a good basic knowledge of the wine offerings or can quickly find someone who does. "I don't know" isn't something I've heard here when I have a question. 

Overall: Full marks! You can't go wrong here and I highly highly highly recommend Gino's for a romantic evening out.

Updated review 1/25 
We came again a couple days later and this time we each ordered steaks. I ordered the 6 oz filet with garlic mashed potatoes and the veggies. My hubby ordered the flank steak with au gratin potatoes and the veggies as well. My dish came out really good but my steak was not cooked to my liking (med well) so I had them send it back just to cook It a little bit longer. It came back like they had flash burned it, I was a little disappointed to say the least. It was still not cooked to how I wanted it, but it was also charred to death on one side. My husbands steak had come out immediately burnt on one side and he said all he could taste was the burnt steak. So probably won't be ordering a steaks from here again. Another thing I noticed was our waiter was kind enough to bring us bread to eat meanwhile we had waited for our meal, they didn't do that the first time we visited so I'm unsure if they do that all the time which is a bummer. Their sides were yummy though so I'll give them that. One more thing to add is that our waiter this time was a REAL salesman, he knew how to add up your check that's for sure lol he kept saying "and would you like to add a side salad with that" or "that peppercorn gravy would be a nice addition to your mashed potatoes" haha so just beware, your check could be $183 later :/ so with that being said I'm going to keep the rating at a 4 for now. 


1/23/20 
So we arrived around 5pm on a Thursday and it was semi packed. They have roughly around 12 booths, 6 tables and a bar from what I could tell. The vibe I got is definitely that of a modern tavern, it was a little dark but it had some good enough lighting. 

For starters we ordered the hummus with pita chips and cucumbers. The hummus tasted a little different than what I expected from a hummus, this one had somewhat of a cumin flavor (which was not our fav). The cucumbers tasted somewhat "dirty", I wouldn't order that as a starter again. 

For our meals, I ordered the tavern burger and added bacon with a side of steak fries. The burger was one of my favorites that I've tried around the treasure valley, had so much flavor and the bun was yummy! My husband ordered the French dip with steak fries as well and a side of ranch/fry sauce. He said the French dip was good but I kept seeing him put salt on it so I'm assuming it wasn't salted. We will definitely be back to try other items on the menu because everything sounded so good!

We LOVE this church! We are getting solid preaching from the Bible while our kiddos are being taught & loved In their classrooms. We are so thankful for the people there & how welcoming everyone is! We can't wait to be there every Sunday morning!
Best breakfast and yummy mimosas.  The food is amazing, must have is the lemon poppyseed pancakes.

After searching several carpet retailers, my last visit was with Jan Stanley at Great Floors.  Of all the stores I searched, no other retailer carried the incredible amount of selections that Great Floors did.  Jan was extremely helpful with the entire purchase experience.  Jan even delivered the 10'x11' area rug to me on her own time and in her own vehicle!  I highly recommend Great Floors and will return again!
Always fantastic food and service. We love the seasame beef, General Tsao chicken, fried rice and crab stars. The prices are also very reasonable.

DISGUSTING "BUSINESS" If I could give this place zero stars I would! Almost all of my gel polish came off of my fingers and my toes after two days and the woman was so rushed and the man seemed very rude and unprofessional! Never, ever go to this place. I went back hoping to get $45.00 refunded for failed services and because I couldn't tell what the lady was saying on the phone when I called to discuss it. When I got there she tried blaming it on me and wouldn't refund my money. I told her the reason people get gel polish is so that it lasts which you would think they should know? REGULAR NAIL POLISH WOULD HAVE LASTED LONGER! There is a very legitimate reason that this place does not have good reviews which... I told them as well as a few other things!! I have filed a complaint with the BBB and from the reviews on here as well as  Google they should have a health inspection too. Shady people!
Very good. Clean place nice staff. The sushi was beautiful and tasted great. Will be coming back.

I have to share and brag a bit. We went for dinner and cocktails last week. Not only do these guys carry the beat bourbon selection in the Eagle area (to include Old Forester Birthday Bourbon) , they also had a chipotle Ribeye that was the absolute beat steak I had ever eaten. Management is the key to all Tavern Restaurants. They always make you feel like part of the family.

Amazing service! The sushi was delicious! 
We are pretty damn picky with our sushi and that was some darn good stuff. 
We got numbers 19, 28 and 46. (rolls)

The eel one was so delicious.   I see another trip there in our future.

Even though it was lunch time, I can't pass up gluten free pancakes! They were delicious. They also make gluten free French toast. The hash browns were just ok. My hubby had a chorizo frittata and he said it was great!

Just took home our new RV and we couldn't be happier with how we were treated! From our salesman Hayden to our finance guy (sorry, can't remember his name but he is Hayden's brother) I have never felt more comfortable in making this large purchase. I also had conversations/help with the front ladies, Shar, Crystal, the parts department and the young man who went through the motor home after our purchase. Every single person we encountered at Bish's was a delight! Thank you to Bish's owners for such a classy organization!

I was given a gift of a Massage with Vonnie from a friend and I was a floppy noodle when I left! Just the way I like to leave a massage. 
Vonnie asked questions before we started and paid attention when I asked for longer work for my feet. As a "larger than life" lady, I sometimes feel uncomfortable when the tables are designed for slimmer folks. Vonnie made me feel comfortable and also provided a stool for me to rest my arms on instead of dangling over the sides, while face down on the table. That is going above and beyond IMHO. 
Thank YOU Vonnie.

I've been looking for decent Chinese food in Boise/Meridian for a LONG time. Found it :)
I ordered to go and picked up on the way home from work, next to the Curb Bar so parking can be a pain but- I only waited 2 mins for my goods.
I ordered Singapore noodles and Pavilion fried rice- Ruby Red pork (sauce came in it's own container without me asking which is appreciated).. came with a container of jasmine rice. The Singapore noodles needed a touch of spice/heat which I'm guessing they would ask if I was dine in but I loved them- huge shrimp and tender pieces of beef. The Ruby Red pork is their version of sweet and sour pork- pork was breaded perfect and in small enough pieces that it wasn't awkward to eat- the only reason it's not 5 stars is their version of seeet and sour sauce is thin, not runny exactly but too thin for my liking and def more sour than sweet which would be fine but then it's missing spice in my opinion. The fried rice is their house fried rice and again, huge shrimp and pieces of beef but really light on soy sauce (you get a bowl of jasmine rice with the meal) and you can tell me to add it but I liked it cooked with the rice, not a pour over. Overall I recommend and will return.

Got take away, sashimi was good, rolls not so much. Tempura shrimp was cooked in old oil and unfortunately even the non shrimp tempura rolls had the taste of old oil. Threw out over half of my $50 order.
Very friendly service!

Go to this salon a lot because of the go 4 times and get $10 off. They have some great days and some what the heck days even if you go to the same person. This will be my back up place from now on I think.

This place is a dump. The icemaker in the building we were in was turned off. We asked them to turn it on and the next morning it was still off. I went to make coffee in the Keurig and opened the lid and there was all kinds of white scum floating. I tried to clean it and after cleaning it, it still didn't even work. I spilled some water on the floor so I took a towel to wipe it up and the picture I'm attaching shows how absolutely filthy black the floor was. If you like noise, this is the place for you. I don't know if it was a nearby bar or the waterpark but there was loud thumping music which went on until 11 PM. One of the worst days I've ever had.

Tonight's experience was amazing.... We have now been there 3 times and have never been disappointed. Tonight our waitress Amanda was the best ever!!! From start to finish she took care of of us all the way :) Love everyone there! Thank you so much :)

12 hour trip to see my son. My maintenance light came on in my car. I just got my oil change last week back home at jiffy lube, so the light shouldn't be on. Either they didn't reset it right or my oil could be low. So I located the closest jiffy lube and stopped in.
James came out to help me. He was awesome.  He checked my oil and it was fine. He even reset my warning light. I was off and happy to know everything was ok. Great customer service by James. Thank you
Excellent gluten free menu. The Mongolian beef was great! Huge proportions. We did take out and it was ready and hot.
The food was below average and expensive  considering. Very mediocre, the service was not up to par either. Basically  an $80.00 night for my husband and I amd 2 children. Not worth it.
This place is super good and offers gluten free and msg free options.  We don't have celiac disease so I can't say if it would work for that but it worked for us!  Lots of food and great value!
My dog Afton loves coming here! Daycare, exercise, grooming, and vet appt all in one day. They make it easy! Such a comfort to know there is a place like a River City Vet with such caring staff.

I was looking for a place to grab a salad for dinner, and this came up on Door Dash. While not the worst salad, it certainty wasn't worth the $15 it cost. It was primarily lettuce, with one onion slice, separated into rings, maybe a tablespoon of feta, and a few olives, and a few slices from a tomato and a cucumber. This is what I envision lettuce farmers eat when times are tough. Who else would ration a single tomato, onion, and cucumber across ten to twenty salads? Granted now I know better to order a pizza, next time. Maybe, if I ordered in person, I would have known better. I think that's one of the issues of ordering on Door Dash instead of being present at a restaurant, it's hard to gauge the feel and expertise of a place by looking at a menu. Note to self: Cross reference with Yelp before ordering!

I was referred to this clinic because my PA transferred here. I have always liked and trusted him. I was told to have a 'pre-melanoma' mole removed from my leg at the previous clinic who said not to wait until next month. I was going to have it done at the old clinic until they wanted me to sign a waiver stating I had to indemnify them for malpractice and they wouldn't do the surgery without me signing it. With medical records in hand I saw Dr Burr this morning and had the surgery. He even offered to burn a few unsightly moles from my back free of charge, and he gave me a prescription for troublesome acne. They were efficient, friendly and knowledgeable (I suppose, I know nothing about dermatology). I am pleased with this clinic and hope to continue my dermatology care with Dr Burr and PA Alec Ahrets. The ladies at the front desk gave me the codes needed for my insurance to estimate my out of pocket, and I had no pre-op nonsense to sign. Thanks Ada West Dermatology!

This delish teriyaki spot is relatively new I see so you'll see reviews from when they were working out the glitches (my guess, makes sense) but best bet is to download their app. A bit faster to go pick up and some discounts and freebies that way. We discovered this gem a few weeks ago and constantly craving it  ever since. It's soooo fresh and the flavor of the teriyaki is perfect! We get the chicken bowl with brown rice custom veggies!

Tried this place with the husband over the weekend. Our waitress was very nice but the service was so slow and it was not too busy. 

The portions were small for the price and did not include anything. My husband had lasagna and I had a gnocchi dish. We did get a complimentary dessert from our waitress for the service being slow, a cannoli which was pretty good. Bottom line is I would not go back. Too many other options with better food, service and cost for what you get.

What the heck happened to Moe Joe's ?  My wife and I always have always made a point to have a meal here when we have driven down from Fruitland, but we haven't been here since the whole "virus" thing.  Wow, HOW DISAPPOINTED we were at this visit...  Don't know what has happened, as they were social distancing so there wasn't too many people in the house and a lot quieter than usual, which we actually liked.  This review can't be blamed on being too busy as they certainly weren't, but maybe they lost some cook personnel or something.  My "Great White" omelette was actually cool in spots and felt like it had been microwaved where you get cold spots in the food.  The very small fruit side looked like it had been set out overnight with how dry and ugly the strawberry slices were.  My wife has always loved their blueberry pancakes with side of bacon... gross now... the pancakes were not done enough and barely any blueberries and sauce on them.  Bacon, again, felt like it was microwaved.  Coffee was "stick to your ribs" strong.   Had to get a couple of refills of the tiny pouches of cream and sugar just to make it drinkable and had to ask again for salt & pepper.   
Our list of restaurants is very small since we moved to Idaho, and just very disappointed about this visit.  Not sure if we'll return or not... can excuse wait service that comes and goes, but poor quality of food is a deal breaker.

We had carpet installed by Capell. His installers were very talented, fast and friendly. Matt was very helpful working with me to get this setup while I was out of town. He had a great selection and answered many questions for me. Also provided good advice. We will be using again soon to do our stairs. Thanks for providing a good experience!

We found out we were moving to Cali with only a few weeks notice. My dog, Sophi, needed a physical & a few shots before moving. I called around but no one had any openings on a Sat. I called River City Vet and they were able to get me in on the same day. Their staff was very friendly and helpful and they even gave me a new client special, $25 physical. Dr. Sparzo was very gentle & caring. I would highly recommend them for all your furry friend needs!

My husband and I have had the worst experience with this company.  We used the Meridian location.  My contractor started off our experience with losing our file and all of our information.  Once we started from scratch I had to call him constantly and check on him and explain everything over and over.  Once our carpet was installed it was the wrong carpet.  He failed to explain to the subcontractors that our home was build on concrete slab.  This set back the hard wood install for weeks.  They still are not finished.  I left a message for the manager "Marv" and have never heard from him.  I would not recommend this company to anyone.  Do yourself a HUGE favor and shop around.  You can do better and will be thankful that you did.
Pretty good food. I've had it twice now for to go orders and both times it's been pretty good. I'll be back!

Great shaved ice place for Idaho! Great flavors, ice is soft, ice cream is soft, and cute little sno cone shack. Perfect on a hot summer day. I got coconut and lychee with the macadamia nut ice cream and I would order that again but excited to try more.

I don't leave reviews.... but this needed to be said. i've heard great things about Gino's since i've lived here so my boyfriend and I decided to go try it out last friday night. The drinks were fantastic and our server was super sweet and awesome! The food however... was terrible. I ordered Bolognese  and my boyfriend ordered the 3 cheese tortellini. Our food came out luke-warm and the sauce on mine looked like it had been sitting in a vat all day long. I choked down 3 bites and was finished. I will say, it was a large amount of food and had it been edible It would absolutely have been worth $16. My boyfriend received his plate, the amount of pasta was not even covering the bottom of the bowl. $16 for 4 bites of tortellini??  Not to mention our food came out sub 5 minutes after we ordered. If you're not going to cook it as it's ordered than at least act like you did and wait a minute to bring it out.... we politely asked our server for our check and got out of there as soon as we could. We were hoping for more, and won't be going back.

I frequent JB's because it is one of the only restaurants near my house and I LOVE their salad bar!  I even know which day they don't serve chicken noodle soup (the bomb) so I don't go on those days.  Anytime I'm sick and don't feel like making my own soup I go for theirs.  I could live off of soup, salad and a baked potato... Their salad bar has all of these.  On the weekends they have an amazing all you can eat breakfast buffet.  My mother in law swears by their salmon (I've never had it) but she prefers it over many high end restaurants.  Overall the quality and the price can't be beat.  You can add salad bar to any entree for a very low price and I highly recommend it.
Super yummy! Fresh and delicious California rolls! Friendly staff and nice environment.

We drove all the way down to Red Robin Meridian @ Fairview & Eagle Freeway (from south Meridian) and were pleased to see the parking lot was almost empty at 5PM on a Saturday! Score! So we went inside and the place was pretty much empty, so we were expecting to be seated right away. Instead we were told it would be "thirty to forty-five minute wait". What the hell? We asked the girl why, were they short on wait staff or something? No answer, just a dumb look back. We left and I'm pretty sure we won't be wasting THAT time again. Red Robin is good but NOT THAT GOOD.

Best Italian in the valley. You won't find people like Gino anywhere else. As an owner, he comes up to your table and genuinely thanks you for your business. Wow! The food is handmade, and the flavor is amazing. Gino's is a must try!

We order our food it got delivered it looked so good and it tasted so much better. It was fresh and delicious. I did or an other roll the Rock N' Roll but I never got it. It bit disappointed on that one I was looking forward on eating it. Our server never came back to check on us after she dropped the Rolls. I had to go to the front to get teo boxes and she did charge me for my roll i had to get my roll out of my ticket. But over all the food was good.
I don't live in the area but every time I come to visit I make sure to schedule an appointment here. Great shop, vibe and talented barbers. It's always a great experience.

Great fried rice, excellent sushi, friendly service! The menu offers a wide variety of sushi rolls, offered either as dinner entrés full rolls, or smaller appetizer portions. We opted for the second option to try a variety of rolls and liked them all. The fried rice was also very good.

My wife liked the pizza but I thought it was too doughy.  Good pizza, all in all though. Someone told me it was the closest to Round Table but it doesn't quite make it. The Hell's Canyon topping was good and hot, though. 

I think if I got it next time I would have them cook it longer to crisp it up some. I think that would do the trick.
Great food great service we ate sushi it was fresh and great staff clean restaurant. I will definitely be going back wheel I'm in the Boise area.

Bish's is amazing! I was blown away by their entire staff and would highly recommend this place to all of my friends and family. They will treat you right! From the buying experience down to the parts and service, the employees really care, you don't feel like all they care about is the sale at this place.

Celebrated my anniversary here and enjoyed our meals very much. Service was great -- as was the food. I had the Lasagna di Mare and my wife had the Melanzana Rollatini (eggplant Parmigiana) and both with a House Salad. We also shared a Raspberry Cheesecake; it was excellent.
I can recommend this restaurant!    Really good pizza, and I had a side salad with fresh romaine lettuce and other vegetables in it.   I'll go back !

This place is awesome.  Not only is the food and atmosphere good but they have Gluten Free.  Just ask. My family loves to go here for their pulled pork.  I like the grilled chicken tacos on Gluten Free tortillas.  Got to love it.  Go check it out.  They also have a rewards card.  Get one.  The food is great and the time in line is always short.  If you are crunched for time and need to get something good check out Costa Vida.

Reviewer # 260

One of the questions that comes up on Yelp is how many times do you visit a place before you review it. There is no right or wrong answer, and mine just depends. If I am traveling then I will probably only visit the establishment once and therefore the first impression it is. However, with this establishment I had high hopes. The many positive reviews and photos convinced me th that this place is going to be epically good. Well, I didn't get that. 

Visit number one-- I was excited to eat here. I am a food guy and like good portions. The inside was small and everyone is rather close together-- ok, cool, no biggie-- I won't fault them for that. The food though was nothing like I saw, read, or imagined. So, I left there thinking there is no way that this place is bad. Too many people like this place. It's got to be a one off-- I have to go again. 

Visit number two-- the same as visit number one, but this time I got bad service, too. It actually got worse. 

Visit number three-- I have to write a review at this time. This place is just OK. To me, nothing too special. I tend to trend with other peoples thoughts on places, but this place didn't do it for me. 

I will go a 4th time one day, not in the near future, because I see potential and I really want this place to be what the reviews and photos show.

I wasn't feeling to good because of my neck and hip. So I reached out to her and she got me in on short notice.  She was friendly and patient and listened to my concerns. Her massage was awesome. I left feeling good. I would recommend her to anyone.
Our favorite Pizza place in Meridian.  The Don is out favorite .  Great outdoor seating when weather permits also

I have visited this restaurant many times never disappointed when it was located on 8th downtown Boise. Gino was always personable and the service outstanding! 

Then, in eager anticipation my husband I looked forward to visiting the restaurant once relocated to McMillan and Ten Mile.  WHOA...very, very bad service!...and the food was poorly prepared.  My husband's steak, ribeye, was charred and tough and my filet mignon with risotto was cooked beyond 'medium'...Gino was not there to supervise. The staff could care less. The waiter (know the name - won't mention) was rude.  And to boot the bill was nearly $100.  

I would like to see this business do well, but after making a phone call, the service hasn't improved.  I don't know what else to say except I am very sad for Gino as he is the core of this business and if he's not there, the staff doesn't seem to care.

If you're looking for a clean, professional Vet clinic that offers all services (general pet health, grooming, daycare, boarding, and a vet hospital), then call and schedule an appointment here. I was impressed with their professional friendly staff who obviously love animals. The Vet listened and offered advice without trying to sell me.

Don't ever have to come here again.  I ordered the War Won Ton Soup and it's definitely not authentic.  I took one bite and it was horrible and the wontons were very undercook and doughy.  The when put it in a to go container they cheated me a half of the soup.   The cracked pepper pork is nothing like the picture.  It's basically the pork from the sweet and sour and it's in a batter with pepper.  When I mentioned it to the manager she tried to play it off as the same. The rice was not even edible as it was crunchy rice. I explained to the manager that the cracked pepper was nothing like the pictures she started to cry, and 3-4 minutes of crying and silence. It was very weird. Then she accused me of not wanting to pay even after I paid for the bill.  Then she even actually had the audacity to ask for a tip.

My partner and I were very sick that evening and the next morning.

I took our cat in for his vaccines.  This was our first visit as we had just moved to the area.  The visit went as expected.  The next day, I received a phone call asking how my cat was.  I stated that he appeared sore, but I expected that to resolve.  Shortly after that, the vet called himself to check on our cat.  He prescribed some Metacam for the cat.  When I went to pick up the one dose, there was no charge!  I so appreciated everyone's care and concern for my pet.  I am very happy with River City Vet.

First time here.
Nice atmosphere. Open and airy. Clean. Cozy booths and also open tables in center.
Haze, our server, was super sweet, friendly and very knowledgeable of the menu options and food offered here. She always  made certain our  coffee cups and water glasses were full.
I ordered the Salmon Eggs Benedict and it was very nice in appearance and presentation and tasted delicious! The poached  egg was cooked to perfection for  me! And, those Moe Joe House Potatoes....awesome! They're more unique in flavor and apearance  than your normal hash browns or breakfast potatoes. Very flavorful seasonings on them. I loved the combination. 
All in all, we were 100% happy with our experience  and meal here and will definitely return!

I came here and ordered 6 burritos for the family. Driving home my son started freaking out and we looked down and there was grease leaking out of the bag down his legs. When we got home we opened up the burritos and they were so soggy because they were soaked in grease. Before going here look at this picture. We threw away $40.00 in burritos due to all the grease. I do not recommend Los Betos unless you want a gut bomb!!

What can I say???!?!? I love big burritos! I know I need to not... but I do! Betos is really good and provide nice sized portions. This used to be my go to place for my quick big portion Mexican food until I found Natos, but Los Betos is a great place as well. 

They are fast, friendly, have a salsa bar, and some games inside. I, personally, like the country burrito, which has bacon, cheese, and potatoes. it is located next to a Del taco and a McDonalds off the busy Eagle Rd.

I don't think I can put into words how unprofessional PJ Chapman is and the business practices of this company are a joke. Stay away, especially if you pay rent on time and cause no issues, you will be wronged. Horrible move in conditions and now I am being footed the bill. Read your lease very carefully, they are shady horrible greedy people.

I've been in the store twice. The staff there is less than friendly. I'm a regular consignment store shopper (Epic before they went out of business, Ricochet, Recycled Room, Kidz Again, etc) and I've also consigned items. These other locations everyone is really nice and personable. I've never purchased or consigned with Renewed Expressions but based on the clerks at the store I won't be back.

Law was our server for a group of 8 on Easter Sunday morning.  Once we got the order placed, the food arrived promptly and at a great temperature.  There were clean plates all around the table.  Law separated the checks and got everyone's order correct.  

Great job, great food, highly recommend.
The first times we went for lunch it was average, but lately the quality has gone down the hill. We don't care for this place anymore. It's just an affordable lunch, but not the best quality.

They don't tell you the whole truth when talking about cost. I just went there for my dogs vaccinations and they pushed getting the flu shot for our dog as well. I asked how much it would cost. They told me $23 for the flu shot and I wouldn't pay that till I came back for the booster in 3 weeks. I asked if we would have to pay for another office visit when we came back in 3 weeks. The answer was no because we wouldn't need to see the vet it would only be a technician visit who would give our dog the shot. When we came back this week for the booster shot the technician took our dog in back for less than 2 minutes I didn't even get to go with. Then they charged me $49!!! I would never have gotten the damn shot if I had known the real price!! This is not the first time they have done this sort of thing either. Bunch of bs just trying to get more $$$$ out of you!!!

WARNING!!! PLEASE READ!!!Never in my life have I been so appalled. I have never had a more disgusting experience at any restaurant. Where do I even start, the amount of health code violations that applied to this restaurant were astounding. First of all the employees had the waiting list all mixed up and kept losing the list because it was on a sticky note. Not once not twice but three times myself and the other customers had to sort out who was first so that the employees could rewrite the list. One employee in particular was especially rude and disgusting in general. The employee brought the wrong food out to the customers seated behind us and when they complained the employee responded that it was their favorite food and refused to bring them out what they ordered! When they brought out our drinks instead of holding them from the side of the cup they held the cups from the top of the glass and didn'. The employees pants were sagging low and they kept touching their face, nose  and hair while serving food. Perhaps the worst thing I witnessed during my experience at the red pavilion was when the employee was supposed to be cleaning off the table they started eating the food off dirty plates that were left by previous customers! After that all I could think about was leaving the restaurant. As I was leaving I walked past the kitchen and it was horrible! The floors were dirty, random assortments of boxes crowded the kitchen and it was overall dirty! I later looked up the health code violations and I wonder how this restaurant is still in business! I now feel sick so please if you value your health and don't want food poisoning do not go to the red pavilion!!!

Went in to the deli  for lunch  with my wife.  Stood there looking around for  five minutes, never were helped, greeted or acknowledged in any way despite the fact that there were at least 11 employees visible behind the counter and only 3 people in line.  It looked like everyone was  stocking, chatting etc and only one guy working the counter.  Terrible performance from a customer service perspective.

We were greeted by a hostess who just stared blankly at our group of 5. When I said, "Hi, there'" she immediately said that I'm helping this family out and I will return. When she did, she ignored our group. The other hostess told us there is a 30 minute wait time. I'm Asian and I'm not sure if this was a racial thing. We went back to our truck when we spotted Lucky Fin Grill. That restaurant is AMAZING! We will not frequent Red Robin based on their tactless hostess.

It's really good for the area. Large portions and very fairly priced. The white rice isn't the best but I keep going back because it's consistent and for sure one of the better Chinese places in town. Not  a good place for a date but ordering takeout here always hits the spot.

Jasmine did an AMAZING job with my 14 y/o sons haircut. He has very thick, coarse, and wavy hair, which he had been trying to grow out, and she new exactly what to do to make it look nice! She listened to our requests and made my son feel like a million bucks when he walked out - and that is very important for a teenager! :) Thank you sweet Jasmine for rocking a really great haircut for him today! We will be back!

First thoughts:  The savory smells emanating from the kitchen made my mouth water from the moment we entered. A sign from heaven, this was the prelude to a wonderful dining experience.  I didn't drink but must have been "under the influence" of the olefactory kind, because I failed to take even one picture of our meal. That is so not like me.

We were a group of four "friends" from Yelp who had never had the pleasure of meeting each other in person until we came to Boise the day before.  That alone made our experience very special. But I knew we were in for a treat, as my Boise friends are Italians (one by birthright and one by association) who really do know good food.

The restaurant is lovely inside, a fine place to dine with friends you want to impress, dimly lighted, warm and inviting, yet casual enough to feel very comfortable. They can accommodate groups of all sizes, and even have beautiful patio dining outside.

We each chose pasta dishes that night: 

Pasta Pancetta - I get giddy when I think about my smokey, thinly sliced pancetta and mushrooms in a cream sauce. I chose an angel hair pasta so the pasta did not overwhelm the sauce.  I like my pasta more done than my real Italian friends, so it was perfect for me. And I got to keep my kneecaps intact in spite of my obvious indiscretion.  I need this dish again!

Lasagna - Mr. B's lasagna had a combination of meats - chuck, salami, ham and prosciutto. A not-so-common combination, he thought perhaps for the first time in his life this had too much meat. But the flavor was excellent. And the portion size was generous.

Our companions had beautiful dishes as well. One a large bowl of vegetarian pasta, but the other, of special note, was the Seafood Pasta.  It was so beautifully plated; the large bowl was surrounded with mussels in their shells, and in the middle a generous cluster of clams who had given out one final, big sigh as they plunged into the red sauce, plus two gorgeous big shrimp.  It was a showpiece.  I did not hear a peep out of Mike until he had completely de-shelled all his shellfish then proceeded to obliterate his dish.  He likes his spaghetti al dente, which is exactly what he got.  

There was a large, full bar, so our group enjoyed both wine and bar drinks (very well poured). 

The evening was leisurely, no pressure, no rush. We enjoyed our meal most definitely, and appreciated that, since it was mid week, the restaurant was not inundated.  The service was excellent, and was further enhanced by a personal greeting from the very Italian owner.

Friendly vibes, beautiful food, excellently prepared, perfectly seasoned, and reasonably priced. Most definitely make reservations.
They have good customer service and will help you out. But don't go unless you have 3+ hours to kill just for a new set of tires.

I come from California where Satans Demons run the DMV and I thought things would be different here. Well... JOKES ON ME! 

   I was 3-5 minutes off the ridiculously early cutoff time for registering vehicles (which is noon by the way) and the lady asks if I had appointment and rudely tells me cutoff time is over. I love this place it's really good and Emily

Got a great cut today from Dena and look forward to coming back! I didn't think my thinning hair could pull off the kind of cut I wanted but I'm really happy with my results!! Dena did an amazing job.

My wife and I wanted to re-carpet much of our house and gave Great Floors a try.  We were helped by an associate, John Shoemake. Everything about the showroom visit and purchase  on 12/27/20 was fine.
I chose a date for installation, 1/7/21.  John told us that we would be called the evening before installation with the time the furniture movers and installers would arrive. We did get that call, and were given a 7 am move time and 10 am install time.  With this confirmation,  we did as instructed and moved all of the small stuff to one room, disconnected electronics, etc. It was kind of like camping in our own house. 
Everything seemed to be on track, but quickly and repeatedly went off the rails. 
Nobody showed up.  We waited until the store opened at 9 am to call John Shoemake.  He said he called earlier to tell my wife that they had not received the carpet... except a check of our call history showed he never called. 
Since we wouldn't get carpet that day,  John agreed to call the crews to have it installed on Saturday,  1/9/21. He said he would call to confirm either way.   No call.  No movers or installers showed up.
We called John again and told him that the next day he could reschedule for was any day BUT Monday 1/11/21 since we had other commitments that day. 
Imagine our surprise when installers showed up on Monday morning.  After camping in our house for 5 days,  we canceled our other plans,  just to get this behind us. 
The installation (done by Brett  and Blake) went well. They did their own furniture moving since nobody sent a moving crew. Brett and Blake told us that John hadn't even called them until Saturday evening. 
After the installation,  we called John's supervisor,  Morris Weatherford to let him know about everything that happened.  He was very apologetic and promised to get to the bottom of the multiple schedule failures, failure to keep us informed,  and condescending attitude my wife got from John. He called back later that day and told us John was out of the office,  so he couldn't get more information.  Morris offered to send us to dinner at Goodwood for our trouble,  which we accepted.  One month later,  we still haven't received the Goodwood gift cards. (Update- Morris called the day after this review and committed to sending the card.)
This will be the last time we go to Great Floors.  Horrible internal and customer communication.  Confirmations that don't mean anything.  Broken promises.  Steer clear!

She said I didn't even have to show her where the floor was so scratched as it was all over. She immediately said she would take care of it. She supported her customer from the get go. Well she asked the manufacturer for a new floor. Before they would do that, they sent out an independent 3rd party expert to examine the whole mess. Well his report came back it wasn't the floor rather the BONA polish I was using. The polish was all scratched up and not the floor. Well BONA took no responsibility. When I think polish, I think something light. No wax but just a little sheen. Turns out their polish is acrylic. Then they tell me I can't walk on it for 24 hours after polishing. What am I supposed to do? Pack my family up with pets and stay in a hotel just so I can use their polish? THEN they don't even sell the remover in any store. You have to special order it. Well after 5 days on my hands and knees with their floor stripper, and just about killing myself doing it, the ACRYLIC--like your nails ladies, is gone. But what I really want to say, is Nicole was talking me through it the whole way. She makes "Great Floors" look good with outstanding customer service. She referred me to a great guy that helped me get the last 20% of ACRYLIC off the floor. She helped me in any way she could. If I ever buy anything to do with flooring again, I'm going to Great Floors 100% because of Nicole. I KNOW I'm going to get outstanding customer service from her and I trust her completely. She is the "GREAT" in Great Floors!  I hope they appreciate her. I have never had such supportive customer service.

So let's go back a little, i lived in NYC and Grimaldi's is so famous there. Every time I was around Brooklyn Bridge, I wanted to eat from here but did not wanna stand in a long line which went around the block. Geezz.. (my head : not gonna happen)

3.5 stars 
We sat down at the bar around 5:30PM on Friday, January 10, 2020. The restaurant was packed and was as loud as you would expect a bar to be on a Friday evening.  

We ordered beer, water, buffalo chicken sandwich with tots, and the beef stroganoff. The bartenders were busy and seemed to have a few regulars at the bar top that they kept chatting with. Our food arrived much quicker than we expected for how busy it was. 

The tots were typical and plentiful! The Buffalo Sando had a very thin filet, so that was a bit disappointing. It was good, not great, and really messy to eat. I ate all of the sandwich, but I would not order it again. 

My husband really enjoyed the Beef Stroganoff and we can see why that is a favorite. It came with sour cream on top and two pieces of bread. The beef chunks were tender, mushrooms melted in your mouth, pasta cooked perfectly, and the sauce was amazing. It was not your typical bland beef stroganoff! 

Overall, we enjoyed our visit and will go back.

Wow!!! We are so impressed with the service and quality here. We just moved from Austin and nothing has quite lived up to par in town before this place. J J treated us like family and gave us great recommendations!

My wife turned me on to this place. I was very hesitant because she has recommended other fast food Mexican to me that I did not like at all.

One that she likes a lot is Baja Fresh. I will write up a separate review on them later. But to sum up, if you like Mexican that is mostly rice and beans and very very little meat, you will like Baja Fresh. 

I have yet to try Qdoba Grill, which is another Mexican Fast food, but I am not expecting much there either.

I also went with my wife to Chipotle Mexican Grill and was very unimpressed. All of these places use way too much rice and beans with way too little meat. This is of course how they make so much profit. 

Making a burrito with Rice and Beans and a couple pieces of meat in it is very low costs for them to make. So the profit margins are high.

Ok, back to Costa Vida. I am a fan of this one. On a side note, I think it is pretty sad when the only decent Mexican food I can find anywhere in the Boise area comes from a Fast Food joint

I am from Texas. In Texas, just about every other restaurant is Mexican, so this type of food is a staple of our diets.

When I came to Idaho, I desperately craved Mexican food. I have been here 10 years now. I am still craving good Mexican food.

Costa Vida as a much better menu than the other Mexican fast food places I listed. Unlike the others, they have Enchiladas, and Quesadillas. What all these places are missing are Tamales. 

The only reason I can think of why these places dont carry Tamales is that a good tamale is not easy to make.

I had the Enchilada with Shredded beef. The beef was tender and I only had to spit out one bite of it due to gristle. 

So on my spit-o-meter, they get a 1. 

That means that I didnt have to spit out much, so they did good on this scale. The flavor of the beef was very good. I was impressed as to how much flavor there was. It was difficult to describe it. So all I will say here is that you should try it. 

The one thing I will say as a real negative, is that they dont have a salsa bar. They have a few bottles of hot sauce that on a shelf by the soda machine, but thats it. 

I dont like to use bottles that others have used. Sometimes you have to, but I try to avoid it. You just never know when someone used that bottle in ways, or in places that they should not have.

When I ordered my Enchilada, the lady making it asked me what sauce I wanted on it. I told them I wanted the hot stuff. She put what they had on it in the amount that she chose to use. A huge negative in my book. 

I want to choose how much, or how little salsa is on, or in, my food. When I tasted the enchilada, I could taste very little heat. I am from Texas, so I like it pretty hot. Everyone likes a different heat level, so to leave this very important choice in the hands of someone that is not me, its not good. 

On the heat-o-meter, I give them a 3 because they said that this was their hottest one and didnt give me the choice of how much I wanted.

Like I said earlier, its very sad that of all the Mexican Restaurants in Boise, its a Fast Food Mexican place that wins.

I also had a taco, which was not that good. The flavor just was not there. I suspect for those that are less of a flavor junkies than I am, it will be fine.

The one thing that Baja Fresh has over this place is there salsa bar. Baja Fresh has a really good Habanero/Mango Salsa that I really loved. 

If Costa Vida would put in a bar like this, they would be my go-to place for Mexican food. But I am continue to search for a real Mexican food restaurant that has good food.

This is seriously the best sashimi I have found in the valley to date. I am a 3-5 day per week sushi consumer typically, but since moving to the Treasure Valley I haven't been able to find a good place for a sashimi lunch.  Fujiyama hits the spot, and does it with a smile.  I am warmly greeted every time I arrive, the sushi chef at the bar knows my order in advance,  and he even prepares little extras that he shares wit me while I wait.  It has be come my new spot for sushi lunch and I am shocked it is not busier during the weekday lunch period.  I have only been to the Meridian location so I  can't speak for the other but this one is awesome.

You can walk in and get a table without a wait any day of the week and have a great lunch.  I would highly suggest local support for this great spot!
Wow!!!  This place is great. Awesome atmosphere and great bar and food. Service was amazing.
What an awesome breakfast place. The staff are super friendly, the meals are well priced, and the food delectable. The owner is also considering adding keto diet items.

This spot was super close to where I was staying so I decided to give it a try. Let me tell you I am glad I did. If you are in the area for breakfast then you have to try this place.  The first time I split the smokehouse hash with a side of pancakes and cinnamon roll French toast. The smokehouse hash was incredible and the best breakfast hash I've ever had. It had huge amounts of bacon and sausage as well as chipotle sauce which added a strong smoky flavor and the moe Joe's potatoes were seasoned excellently. The pancakes were very fluffy and delicious when doused in maple syrup and butter. The cinnamon roll French toast was a sweet treat and had good cinnamon flavor. It was so good I came here a second time and got the salted caramel banana French toast instead and it was out of this world. The walnuts were sweet like candy and the banana bread French toast was so moist while topped with a delicious caramel sauce.

I hate to have to write this, but I can't voice how disappointed I am with this place. I spent a lot of time researching vets, as this was my first time at home, and I had such high hopes for IPH. The initial exam went alright, the wait time despite having an appointment was pretty long, but that's pretty normal for the medical world. My tortoise had a lump on his behind, and I was told that the doctor wasn't sure what it was, so she would take a couple photos and post them on the VIN to hopefully get some second opinions on how to proceed.

I received a call a few days later, and was told what the general consensus was. I was once again told she had never handled this exact scenario before, but when you have an "exotic animal" your options in "experts" are limited, so I felt comfortable. I had to call back soon after and ask to have a beak trimming included. Her response time was incredibly fast during the time it took to get the complete bid put together. When I called a couple days later to schedule the surgery, however, I was informed she was taking 3-4 weeks off of surgery, and couldn't be scheduled until near the end of June. Weird, because she had never once mentioned that during our initial appointment, or in any of the follow-up phone calls. 

I didn't want to wait that long, so I asked if it would be possible if their other reptile person handled it. After being put on hold I was assured that was fine, and we booked it. A week later, we had a little money issue at home, so I pushed it back another week just to be on the safe side financially.

I called nearly 2 weeks ago and asked if the original doctor could call me, as I just had a couple last minute questions. Never heard from her. I couldn't get calls fast enough when she was trying to book the job, but once it was booked communication was non-existent. Fast forward to last night. I've been getting everything ready for his surgery on Monday, and I suddenly received a call saying the original doctor wanted to be the one to handle the surgery and to call back so I can reschedule. I called and asked if there was any specific reason. Hey, if she's more knowledgeable with this kind of thing or he isn't qualified, I understand waiting. However, the answer every time I asked was that "she just had more history with it and more knowledge of the situation." That answer was repeated to me 3 different times, and then I was offered a surgery date in the middle of the day a week and a half later.

I explained that there really was no history, as he had been in one time, nor should more knowledge be a thing since the doctor herself had stated multiple times that "she had never seen anything like this before." The doctor had gotten second opinions on what people thought it was based on the photo, and said she would remove it just like a normal tumor. In my opinion, there is nothing in this situation that wouldn't allow her to just communicate with the other doctor to remove the mass as normal. I had already gotten time off of work for this (which I couldn't change 6 days beforehand), I had been assured in the beginning that the second doctor would be able to handle it just fine. The feeling I got from this whole situation is bad enough that I've had to cancel his appointment and get him into a new doctor somewhere else. I really was hoping that I had found a vet who cared more about patient care than money or an 'exciting case,' but that isn't the case with staff here. 

I'm extremely disappointed in the fact that, instead of being okay with another doctor just making sure he's taken care of, this seems to be a pissing match between who's patient this rightfully is. This doctor isn't more qualified, she didn't successfully diagnose him, she hasn't been seeing him for years. Instead of asking if there were any concerns that could be addressed, the receptionist sounded like she couldn't get off the phone with me quick enough. The excuses I was given are unacceptable and I'm off to find a doctor who genuinely cares more about their patients than money in their pocket and calling dibs.

I've always loved coming to this restaurant until tonight. Food was good as always but service was terrible. Our server Andrew was probably the least attentive server ever. Was here for over two hours.. it's not like the restaurant was incredibly busy, their was several empty tables around us. Will probably not be returning after tonight. Very disappointing.
I have never tried Korean before this. Plates were small. The food taste good but is not a good portion for its size. Not going back again.

Don't pay upfront.  I spent $4000 with the hope of getting better.  5 months of hard work and dedication proved that it didn't help.  Paying upfront made it not their problem if I wasn't feeling better.

How hard is it to make a FLAP JACK?! This is the second time in a row that I have gotten the WRONG drink! This looks NOTHING like what I ordered and have no time to go and get it corrected! PLEASE PAY ATTENTION TO DRINK ORDERS!
We worked with Jesse and had a great experience. He is honest and knowledgeable and very good to work with. The new location and inventory were very good and we are happy with our new rv

I usually try to stick with small local cleaning businesses, but since moving to boise, I just couldn't connect with anyone, and I don't use services that pay their workers under the table or less then the minimum wage. I was pleasantly surprised to discover that merry Maids was a similar price structure to what I'd been paying to a very good independent service I used before in Bend, OR. I naturally expected a professional company to be much more expensive. I wasn't sure how I feel about having a service instead of a person, but the benefits of having multiple cleaning teams means that my house is always done on schedule, I don't have to re-arrange my schedule or go without service; which is really important, since I also work from home.
The professionalism of everyone from Jaime in the service center to the various teams who have cleaned for me has been outstanding. If I'm there and with a client or on the phone, I don't even know they are there.  
I appreciate the time that Cindy took with me on our initial intake to really understand what I wanted. 
I saw another reviewers comments about fluff and waste, and I disagree. It's nice to feel appreciated. I drink from my merry maids water bottle proudly and feel happy to come home on Fridays to a card from my cleaning team.

The incredible ladies of Paradigm are all crazy talented and have this superpower to make you feel so beautiful inside and out. I have never left this salon not feeling pampered and in love with my final product whether going lighter or darker! Amazing women in an amazing salon!

The Rumbi Rice is not good. We got this catered to our work last week and everyone was very unsatisfied with their food. The meat is very bland and if you order a rice bowl you will basically get some gross rice with tons of red beans with some plain meat on top. 

No thanks. My first impression was that I may or may not have been eating dog food... That's the best way to describe it.

Seriously awesome; we are coming back.  Hubby ordered Cinnamon french toast. It is a dessert for breakfast; really good. I ordered a Hash Bowl, Smokehouse; absolutely loved it.  Great food quality and taste.  It was so much food, I took the leftovers home for my teenagers to eat later.  This isn't an organic, granola, hipster place; it's tasty farm food put together with great taste. The atmosphere is chill, casual, and friendly.  My husband and I left feeling fat and happy and like we robed the place- amazing tasty food for two for about $22.

Just experienced the rudest, worst sales associate.  Instead of working with us to find something in line with what we're looking for she was judgemental and condescending.  We will not be going back.

What a wonderful restaurant.  It is my girlfriends birthday and I let her decide. I pointed this place out and she wanted to give it a try. 

We were greeted and sat down immediately.  They had a small dinner menu, but it was just right .

We had the fresh halibut and a blue cheese burger. They were both presented well and were delicious  

The service by Matt was 5 star 

We are just here looking at homes . 

I highly recommend this place.

Been taking my dog here for years, my family has been taking their animals here for years too. Brought her in for an ear infection, the vet right away made it seem like she didn't have an ear infection but wanted to run "additional" test, I could not afford these test and told them that. A month later I came back for some bumps on my dog and they brought up those test from my last visit that I declined, saying I had to pay for them. 1) I declined them 2) I never got results of them, negative by the way, but never called to let me know the results 3) demanded I paid for these test even though the vet tech remembered me declining these test due to lack of funds. 

All in all this pet hospital is extremely expensive to begin with and honestly made me feel like I was being loan sharked. If you just moved here from out of state find any other vet hospital.
Long wait. Five tables have left and nobody waiting has been seated. Really screwed up front desk operation. Four tables have left out of frustration. This place sucks!
The food was amazing!! Huge portions. Great staff. Glad to see there wasn't much COVID paranoia. Will be back!

Sadly, one of our pups passed away today. Dr. Fineman could not have been more compassionate, understanding, and kind. He met us at his office at 4:00 am to minister to our guy who has had serious chronic issues for years.  I could tell that his love of animals runs deep as he treated our guy as if he were his own.  He conducted himself with such grace and dignity that we felt comforted during the most painful moments in a pet owner's life. We will be forever customers of Paramount Animal Care.

I planned ahead today and ordered Grimaldi's at 5pm for a 6:30 pick up. I even stopped in earlier just after 6  to see if they could expedite the order however the hostess said the order will be ready by 6:30. I show up 30 minutes later and the waiter tells me that they are "backed up" and my pizza would not be ready for another 35 more minutes!!! The dude straight up lied to me. They are not backed up. They weren't even that busy! They COMPLETELY FORGOT MY ORDER! This past year I've ordered a lot of take out to support restaurants but this has got to be THE worst experience I've ever had. What made it worse was seeing the disappointment in my sons face. If you're planning on ordering take out, save yourself the time and energy. Order from Blaze or better yet from Big Al and play a few games while you wait.

I will have to say that this veterinarian shop is great. I am a new dog owner and wanted my mind at least. So I went there, no appt and never been there before and they actually fit me in. I couldn't believe it. Thank you guys for helping out me and Tüske.

If you're looking for a smoothie that's actually good for you and not packed full of sugar, then I suggest giving this place a try. They use all organic produce to make their smoothies, detox juicing, and any of their bowls or wraps. I got "The Healthy Heart One" (smoothie) and The Avocado Toast, which was pretty good. Definitely worth checking out if you're on that health kick, but want to try something different.

Food was very good service was great!  We had wingers salad needed a little bit more wingers sauce but was brought as soon as mentioned. Grilled cheese sandwich was great. Chicken strips just perfect spice. Perfect stop off!

Really glad we found this place. We are from out of town and I was really craving some good Chinese food. Their service was great, the food came out quickly and it was delicious!  I would highly recommend their Cracked Pepper Shrimp...YUM!!

As I have read from others experience as well as my own, do not take your RV here for service.  I took my motorhome in for a long list of repairs.  I have a Newmar motorhome and they are a authorized Newmar service center. First of all it took them 8 months to give me back my coach, yes 8 months!  Of the 10 items to fix only 5 were actually done right.  The other 5 were either not done or not done right.  They eventually refunded me for 3 of them.  The other two worked when I tested it out before leaving but soon after they stopped working just like before I took it in to them.  Problems were from slideout issues, awning covers, windshield leak, and window and door seals.  My bill was over $4000 ( $1000 which I was eventually refunded ) $500 of the total bill was for time they spent trying to fix a problem but was unable to figure out the issue.  I could have taken my coach back but I live 250 miles from Nampa, Idaho and I didn't want to give them another 8 months!  If you like your RV and want things done right, stay away from this place!!!

Great juice!  I got The Glow juice and The Cali wrap.  Everything was really good except maybe the price...... it seems a little bit expensive but the quality of the food and drink is probably worth it.  Just might not eat there as much as I would like to.
Really good food. Even though they said they had limited staff, the food didn't take too long.

I was driving cross country on my Ducati and had the rear tire go out. In desperation I went to the shop 5 minutes to close and these guys sorted me out. I get terrible keeping the crew late but everyone was so nice - thank you Kirby and team! You saved my bacon!

Today I got a flat tire on eagle, totally sucked. Luckily I was right across from discount tire. So I come here for a replacement...They didn't have my tire size so they sold me 2 smaller ones for a little over $150. Cool easy fix so I can get back to work.  Well driving to work I had CRAZY shaking so I come back in, they rebalance the tires and say if it's still happening see a mechanic. NO it's because I have two different tire sizes.  Then I realize my glasses which are less than a week old and were over $300 are missing, so I call and they say they don't have them....Kinda fishy how they can just disappear? When I know they were in the vehicle. Anyways lesson learned,
don't do business here!!! Now I am basically out $150 for a set of tires I can't use and a pair of glasses. :(
Really yummy food but unfortunately they don't allow dogs on their outside patio. If you take your dog there they make you tie the dog up on the outside of the patio fence.  Deal breaker for us

Our FAVORITE place ever!!! 
Chef is a breakfast GENIUS!!
The biscuits are to die for!!

The best sushi that we've had since we moved to Idaho. And we are sushi snobs!  It compares favorably with the best sushi that we've had in So Cal.  Big rolls without an enormous price tag. Our daughter took me to supposedly the best sushi restaurant in downtown LA and it wasn't as good as #FujiyamaMeridian. We are delighted with this find and will come back soon.....maybe tomorrow for breakfast.

We found a nail in our tire (two, actually!) so I found the highest rated tire shop the shortest distance from our house and drove over. They got me right in and were able to repair the tire - for free! They were fast and friendly and I will definitely be back to buy my tires from them. P.S. This a chain I have used in other states, too, and have always been happy with them.
First visit while visiting the Boise area. Employees are friendly and the store is large with everything you could imagine. Good prices, will be returning and .asking this store a regular.
We've had Darrian twice at the Meridian Wingers and she is fantastic! The food is great, and we love late-night happy hour!
We love this place! Good food, great service... popular place so we must not be only ones that think so. Delivery is good choice  as we like to avoid the crowd in the restaurant.

Love Restore! I come here aften after leg day and use the compression leg sleeve. These help my legs recover fast enough where i can do a HIIT run training the next day. Staff are super friendly,  and Jordan is does great work  stretching me out when my hips and neck are tight. Can't forget the cyrotherapy.  Super helpful with recover.

Picked up breakfast over the weekend. Chorizo breakfast burrito and chicken fried steak. Burrito was very hearty and tasty; chicken fried steak was battered , not too heavily but I prefer breaded. Gravy was not bland which is a plus and mojo potatoes are always good!
Even in pickups MoJoes delivers the goodness!

This vet scams people. We got a quote for our dog to get spayed and then after the procedure they double the price and we didn't get any extras. They are running a scam and trying to take advantage. We have talked to others that this has happened too. It looks like legal action will be in their future since they refuse to refund any partial monies.
Another fantastic meal and great service. Accommodating to my limited palate for a non meat eater and quick service. A great place that also believes in our freedom to move about freely!
I really enjoy this place, the beer is good the whiskey is better and the food is awesome! The staff is incredibly friendly and willing to help at the drop of a hat. I try to eat here once a week.

I want to thank the owner and our server today for turning my experience around. I had ordered an item that was over cooked to my taste.  I asked for extra condiments which were provided and ate the entire meal as I was hungry but the food wasn't what I expected from my past experiences at Gino's. After the meal, Gino asked how the meal was and when I explained he comped my lunch. He didn't have to, I was prepared to pay after all I ate all of it but he listened, cared about my experience, and made my day. Thank you. A rare and very appreciated experience in today's world. I'll definitely return!

Don't order delivery from here, I just paid 44 dollars for nothing,  they forgot my salads and egg rolls, and only gave me 3 shrimp when both my meals were supposed to have them, save your money and go to panda, total shit hole!

Unresponsive sales representatives that are difficult to work with. We were a cash buyer all ready to go and could not even get an answer out of sales rep or GM. I am glad this company didn't end up with our money.

Tonight was a perfect example of how you need good food AND good service to get a good rating. The food was delicious, but the service was awful. We had two different waitresses for some reason. Our son's food came out 10 minutes before everyone else's, which wouldn't be horrible except we had no utensils (or napkins). So he sat there waiting and his food was cold by the time the rest came. We were back in a corner and couldn't get anyone's attention. Our glasses were never filled, even though two were emptied before the food arrived. Nobody checked on us until we had been finished for awhile, sitting there waiting for the check. So unimpressed, which is sad because the food is good. I guess it's takeout or nothing. Who hires these people?

Very pleased with all aspects of our experience. Flooring looks beautiful, installers did a wonderful job. Great job working with us getting it done out of town. Very good pricing at all levels. Personal attention is excellent & continual communication throughout project very much appreciated. Than you for a great & flawless experience!

We are repeat customers, we had a good experience and great customer service. Chris Ybarguen was the sales manager for us today, he was great and very knowledgeable in explaining the signing process and the products. He got us a good rate on our loan and he was able to get our monthly payment down even with the best warranty/benefit package.  We really appreciate his help and professionalism in making our buying experience easy and not so painful.  Thanks Chris, also Jessy, who was our salesman, and Scott who did our orientation, and everyone else who gave us great customer service.
Great hostess and food, got there early because it was Sunday morning and glad we did.  We have eaten here for the past several years as we have traveled to SLC.  Highly recommend!

First visit to River City vet with a new puppy. With everything going on with covid 19 I was very impressed with their method of operation. Very professional and simple curbside service. Great employees doing everything they can to care for our pets in this trying time.

Terrible customer service. Found hair in the ice cream and had to string it out of a child's mouth. I was told by the employee that this is normal and not a big deal. The owner/manager I was informed by the employee didn't want to speak to me until Monday. The manager/owner called me back later and explained to me that it was his personal number and he didn't feel there was a reason to talk to me if is employee's were in the store to take care of it. Afterward threatened me that he'd turn me in for harassment since I threaded to reach out to the heath department. 
I've been to this location several times and never had this happen. So disappointed with all the Covid stuff going on to find hair in ice cream. Some of us don't even want to leave the house and these are the fears we have.
Great food, and a nice selection of beer. They have a full bar as well. The staff was very pleasant and attentive. I will definitely be back.

We will not be going back to Carino's. The only good thing about eating here was the service. It used to be such a great restaurant, but now it's under new management. I really think it's going to fold in the next year, if they don't get their act together. We've been faithful in eating there once a month but no more. Tonight, I was told we couldn't use our reward points for a free appetizer (which we've earned by spending a lot of money and which should be separate from any coupons) with our coupon. That's the first time I've heard of it. The Italian sodas were awful, and, while the ravioli tasted the same, there was practically no sauce (which I paid an extra $1 for) and the bowl wasn't even half full.  This restaurant used to have the best tiramisu in town, but tonight it was dry, bland and grainy. We didn't even finish it. Don't be fooled by the face lift of the interior. The stuff that really counts, the food, isn't nearly the caliber it once was.  Next time, it'll be Romio's or Olive Garden.

Waited an hour long and just ended up leaving not even that many people there either just ignored

Came back ordered a half decent steak was a little overcooked for being medium but it was pretty good service was great but waiting can be atrocious

This is one of the first places that we ate when we first moved here. Very good food, ample portions and friendly wait staff. This business has the "Curbside To-Go" figured out. We have never been dissatisfied. Great job! Keep up the awesome business ethic.
Food was great. However it took 1 1/2 hrs on a Tuesday to get 4 rolls. Will come back again but when it's not busy.

This place sucks. My husband and I were starving from driving all day and figured we would call ahead so our pizza would be done when we arrived (we were going to get there at 830 and they closed at 9 so we didn't want them to have to stay late). The woman on the phone rudely refused and said they could not accommodate us. We got there and there was a large party ahead of us. We ordered our pizza and waited 45 minutes....still no pizza. My husband went and asked our server about a time frame and he looked dumbfounded. He had given our pizza to the large group!!! By this time it was 915 (they close at 9) so they had turned off all their ovens and started cleaning. They had to turn everything back on and make our pizza. They brought us our pizza in a box as if we wanted to take it to go. They brought us a "free cookie" as an apology as my husband brought up they forgot our breadsticks. They didn't bring us plates and we had to eat our pizza on napkins!!! The whole time they were very rude and didn't offer to refund our pizza, breadsticks or make any further attempt to rectify it.

We love this place for breakfast they have a very healthy selection and really good Mamosa's.
Next time we go we are going to try the steak fingers. Highly recommend this place. Yummy!

Kriss I think was our waiters name. Excellent service and he was very knowledgeable. He knew the menu well and was very accommodating. This place is excellent and the food done perfect! I live in California but pass through here on business. This place will always be a stop!

This review is because of the fantastic service by Shandriel. She was possibly among the best servers I have ever had.  I was with my three year old.  She was friendly and was very helpful with the menu.  The thing that was most impressive was how she was on top of everything.  As we were running low on napkins she showed up with more napkins.  My water was always full.  She was on top of all our needs the entire time making the experience a fantastic one.

My first time at this place.  My parents eat here often.  Nice sports bar type atmosphere.  Good drink menu, and food menu.  Enjoyed the Bruce Burger tonight.  Delicious!  Tammy was our server, and was very attentive.  Drinks and food came out in a timely manner.  What also caught my eye, was a young buster named Jordan.  Great work ethic, courteous, always busy, or looking for something to do.  Great experience for the first time.

Went here for the first time and really enjoyed our dinner. The bread for starters is so darn good. Husband and I shared the meal for 2 which gave us a sharable item, 2 entrees and a dessert. Wat more food than we needed but we wanted leftovers for lunch. We got the pepperoni pizza as the shareable to also share with our daughter and it was really good. We then got the chicken parm and the spicy chicken & shrimp pasta but easy spicy. They were both so good! The whole time we just kept saying how much better this place was then Olive Garden. 

My dad got the normal chicken parm dinner which came with a salad. Not only was it a good portion size but it was a good looking house salad. The croutons were amazing. Crunchy yet soft and very flavorful. The blue cheese dressing was perfect also. Great flavor but not too strong. 

We then got the dessert and we decided to get the lemon cream cake as to try something different and dang was it good. We are not really dessert people as it can get to sweet but this was perfect. Not to much lemon flavor but also not too sweet. We ate the whole thing (which is huge). 

Overall we all left super happy and will be back for sure.

My wife  i have eaten  here several times.  It's good, cooked to order, and they can accomodate gluten free !!  Lightening fast delivery and its hot!  Nor sure about all the bad reviews in here, some of them ring false to me.  We love the ginger chicken, general czo's chicken.  We did not eat any of the breaded stuff... egg rolls, etc.

Went with a group of 4 people. I ordered from lunch menu. Had wanton soup, chow rice and mongol beef. The broth had no flavor but the wanton in the soup was tasty. The chow rice had a few peas, a small amount of sliced carrots and 1 piece of scrambled egg.  Mongol beef was just ok. Loaded with white and green onions and a tiny sprinkle of white noodles. A member of group had Red Ramen soup. Very disappointing. No flavor. Not ramen noodles, more like spaghetti noodles. She asked for egg and she got a fried egg on top. However one person in group had salad and was happy that romaine lettuce was used and dressing was tasty, however nothing but lettuce and dressing. So as far as food was concerned the general feeling was that it's just ok. Probably won't go again. On the plus side: parking was good and wait staff was nice.

This is a true and honest 1 star review, due to the fact that management rectified the situation, which you will hear about later. It was a chilly Monday evening and my baby sister just brought our mother to Boise, so I could take her to the airport bright and early at 3AM on Tuesday morning. We planned to make an evening out of their trip since all three of us have never been in Boise at the same time before. So needless to say we were very excited for this special dinner. Our mother is never in town so naturally we let her pick what kind of food she wanted. After hours of discussion she finally settled on Italian food. My sister and I weighed out options making a decision based on star ratings, location and traffic flow. 
We arrived at Johnny Carino's at 6PM and were promptly seated in a booth per our request. The waitress was nice and brought out the free bread, oiled garlic and took our drink orders. Unfortunately, the oiled garlic had very little herbs and toasted garlic, at this point it was just oil in a saucer. We placed an appetizer order of the Spinach Artichoke Dip, along with our entrees around 6:05PM. Our mother ordered Chicken Classic Fettuccine, and my sister and I split the Shrimp Classic Fettuccine, because we were so looking forward to our Spinach Artichoke Dip, which is our favorite. It's now 6:15PM and our entrees are being served! What madness?!
