The pasta was obviously carelessly scooped out of some sort of heating containment dish, that was not doing its job well at all since our dinner did not come out hot. My mother's dish had 6 pieces of thinly sliced chicken, almost looked like lunch meat. Our split entrée came out pre-split and importunely contained only 7 pieces of shrimp, 3 of which landed on my sister's plate, talk about unfair! The sauce was bland despite the waitress's addition of cheese and our additions of freshly grounded pepper corns. The sauce laid on heavy and lumpy, atop limp overcooked noodles. Finally, our appetizer came out at 6:30PM, thank the heavens because we were still hungry since no one was eating their entrees. I immediately dug in.. only to find a watered down mess. It came out hot, but again so bland! It was so watery we were unable to scoop anything onto the free bread or chips. The waitress must have been embarrassed by our meal as much as we were, since she never once stopped by to fill glasses or ask us how our meal was. We got up and went to the register to get the ticket and pay, since the waitress would not look me in the eye. I let the cashier know about our experience and she went to talk to our waitress to get the bill. They comped the entire meal, which we did not even eat. Hence, the 1 star given.
Who knew there was so many things you could do with eggs? I appreciate the attempt to be safe during this time. Great work folks.
Not very clean place.  Poor customer service and bad co-worker vibe.  Sorry I came in.

Great Floors in Meridian treated us pretty poorly. Their bid was reasonable, but I guess we did not understand the industry terms or something. They replaced some linoleum with new snap together wood flooring. The floor looks great, except they added underlayment under it so we step UP from carpet to the new flooring. 

We tried multiple times to get them to fix it, even offering to pay for part of the expense. The salesman kept changing his story, blaming decisions on the "Big Boss". We talked to the store manager and he agreed that they would fix it. But the story kept changing. Finally we receiv3d a bid for $800 to "fix it".

Finally we told the salesman to just send us an invoice for the balance due on original installation and we would pay that - and never work with them again.

Bjohnson

DR Mark Schwendiman and his staff were very caring and took their time. The lobby and waiting room was very comfortable and the check in staff was very helpful and kind. There web site with all the paperwork was helpful also. Had everything filled out and the check in was very fast.

Love breakfast, and loved Goldy's - especially when it was in Hyde Park. The location downtown is just too tiny and parking is difficult especially on Saturdays. However, over in Meridian is this GEM of a breakfast and lunch joint. Home made everything. Corned beef is to die for. Eggs perfectly cooked. Home made hollandaise. Even brewed iced tea rather than the fountain crap! There is only one thing I didn't like about my visit: they don't offer a "No Screaming Babies" section - but that's hard to find in any restaurant that serves breakfast!

Great service and great food. I especially liked the Farmer's Hash. Another person in our group had an omelet and loved it. The place can get a bit busy, but it is worth the short wait. Definitely will go to this place again next time I'm in the Boise area.

Oh yeah this place is good.. Good sized portions and its not all vegetables.
Their Honey Almond Chicken is Killer.
Pot stickers, not so much, but everything else is really really good.

I've only been to Ada West Dermatology once but it was a very good experience.  Everyone was friendly, there was quite a line when I arrived but they moved everyone through in a timely manner. I didn't have to wait long before they called me back. I saw Dr Schwendiman and he was wonderful. He took the time to answer my questions and I never felt rushed. Overall it was a very positive experience and I would highly recommend Ada West Dermatology.
Excellent flavor in both our breakfasts. It was healthy and wonderful service. We will be back.

Love JB'S!! Great service and a good salad bar. It's clean, inexpensive and dependable. They have a great breakfast buffet too. I just love the fact that I ALWAYS get smiling, prompt and friendly servers when I go in. The portions are good sized so you usually have food to take home. And don't forget to get a brownie to go...they're HUGE and so yummy!

I've been a customer of Idaho Pizza for 20 years.  Today, March 1st, I stopped at the Meridian store on my way home to get pizza for myself and my two grandchildren.  As has been my custom since the beginning, I placed my order and then ordered a beer while waiting.  IPC rarely gets the order out on time and anything to make the wait less annoying.  This time, I was instructed to produce an ID.  I'm 73.  I look 73.  I feel 73.  It's been 50 years since anyone wanted to see my identification.  I looked and felt both shocked and insulted.  The woman behind the counter pointed to a sign stating that any alcohol sales must be accompanied by an ID, REGARDLESS OF AGE!  I don't know where this requirement comes from - certainly not from Idaho state law.  This is also the only IPC store with such a requirement.  I thought it was cute... when I was 21; now being required to show an ID to buy a beer is condescending and an insult.

As far as the pizza went, I order three items - they only got one right.  Plus, the Idaho Supreme pizza smelled and tasted odd.  Certainly not what we're used to.  Just this store?  Maybe.

Very impressed by the service from Bish's! We drove 7 hrs from out of town and were 2 hrs late upon arrival. They were so patient and flexible with us and helped us quickly get everything in order so we could take our brand new rig camping that very day. Our salesperson Mark was great to work with and very responsive! Chase helped us with the paperwork and was very knowledgeable and gave great and honest advice, no frills. Jeremy and Shaw helped us with parts and the walkthrough... definitely wanted to give a special shoutout to these guys. We had an issue with the wiring in our car but they put 3 people on it and worked as quickly as possible so we could make it out in time. Had our 9 month old with us during this whole process and they were so kind and considerate and even let us get situated in the trailer so we could let her nap while they worked on our car. Thank you to everyone at Bish's! We'll definitely be back to upgrade for our next rig... it's worth the trip. Cheers!

I had not spotted this place but after seeing it mentioned on our neighborhood app Next Door, decided to give it a try. I placed a take out order for Moo Goo Gai Pan and a couple of Egg Rolls.  Both were ready when I arrived to pick them up.  The egg rolls were the biggest I've seen and one of the best I've tasted- crispy on the outside and full of excellent flavor! The Moo Goo Gai Pan included lots of vegetables but included lots of chicken too. There was easily enough for three meals.  I was surprised at the small amount of rice included but it wasn't a problem - I can make rice, too.  Those egg rolls make another trip essential the next time I crave good Chinese food!
First time Here!!! If you haven't had breakfast here, YOU dont know breakfast!! Great food and service!! Thank you Hailey n Tasha!!

Very disappointed in this hotel. The room smelled really bad. The bed was caved in the middle. Also, we booked a queen room and they gave us a double. We asked twice if we could get moved into a queen, but they insisted it already was a queen, so we were stuck in the double room. Won't be staying here again. Worry spending more money to get a nicer room.

Hello Taco Lovers! Whomever was making the Street Tacos today NAILED IT! So so so good, I'm considering returning for dinner! I love street tacos and wasn't disappointed here at Taco John's in Meridian. 

The drive through team did a fantastic job as well, very friendly, no confusion, there were several cars ahead of me and several behind, totally time from order to driving off with my yummy tacos was about 7 minutes. I really appreciated their smiles and speediness.

Thank you!!!! 
A Street Taco Lover

No one ever answers the phone. 99% of the time you have to leave a message. They also have issues with billing. I've had to contact them twice now for not adding payment to my account when I already paid it.

Hidden Treasure!!!

This little unassuming treat is a splendid discovery. There is no big sign out front, and you can barely see them from the road. Two doors down from a bar & grill in a series of businesses, kind of like a strip mall with several small buildings. However, it is worth the effort of finding them. Not quite what other Chinese restaurants serve. They are actually Mandarin Cuisine, which seems to be a few steps above the other offerings. Very fresh veggies, skillfully cooked meats, minimal salt, and sauces that do not overpower. If there is breading, it is very thin. So far, everything my wife and I have tried has exceeded any expectation we foolishly had. Their calamari was tender, and not rubbery, with minimal breading, and comes with house-made chili sauce which is a perfect blend of heat and flavor. The Iron Deluxe Sizzler is a must-have! Scallops, shrimp, beef, chicken & veggies served up on a sizzling pan (think fajita-style Asian), which you can spoon over rice. I could go on and on. Even their soy sauce seems to have more flavor and less saltiness than others. The menu they provide is American-style Mandarin, which is wonderful. However, they also have a menu of authentic (non-American) food upon request!

Skip the boring "Chinese" food others offer, and find what you've been missing! Great friendly service, clean/comfortable environment, honest/fair prices, fantastic food experience! Give them a chance to open your mind to what Mandarin food offers. For me, I cannot imagine ever going back to Chinese buffets or Americanized chains.

Desperately trying to be something its not... good pizza. The hormel logo on the bottom of the menu should have tipped me off this was nothing but a dressed up corporate chain but alas I did not listen to my gut.

Margarita pizza... large... 19 bucks. Which is steep.

Edge crust was good. But that's the kindest thing I could say. Sauce was sour and lacked flavor. Basil was dry. And for the love of all that's holy... if you are going to claim a margarita pizza as your signature pie please o please use fresh mozzarella. But alas...  hormel.

Spare yourself. NY would send this pizza back to Boise in a heartbeat

Typically a reasonable place to eat. Food you can count on. No waiting. However, "Let the Buyer Beware!" Last night we saw a new addition to the menu - a Two for...dinner option. Compared it with the normal Monday good deal, 1/2 price family platters and chose to have it. Big mistake! No deal at all! Didn't see the fine print! "Johnny's Meal for Two
$20.99 per person" Nothing on their menu is worth 20.99! Don't have this option. Do the math.

I arrived for a late lunch and was greeted by a host.  I opted to sit at the bar as I wanted to catch some of the college football games.  The restaurant was very nice which I would describe as a slightly upscale sports bar.  It's not very big, but they did a good job with how they used the space.  Plus, there's a nice patio area outside, perfect for the warmer seasons.  Food:  I had the Carne Asada salad, but the steak was lacking seasoning. Supposedly, they season it with salt, pepper and the house butter sauce. I tasted none of that.  Pricing:  fair.  Service/staff:  According to the receipt, my server was Jason (bald guy with goatee).  Sadly, he wasn't friendly and seemed like he didn't want to be there.  I don't believe I saw him smile once.  He checked in to see how I was doing maybe two times during my visit.  On my way out, the hostess (a different one with long hair in a ponytail) started to make eye contact, but then suddenly looked down at her iWatch as she said "thanks for coming" in an almost-friendly tone.  If I were to make one single recommendation, it is for management to focus and improve on their employee's customer service skills.  My plan is to return to The Tavern another two times to try other items on the menu and to see if I notice any improvement on service.

Some of the best brunch food of my life. I live for the lemon poppyseed pancakes, but really, everything we have ordered has been so good. It's a very warm & friendly place, and we love going here in the mornings and to the comic shop next door. A true treasure of the Treasure Valley

HORRIBLE. Employee argued with us over what we ordered after giving us the wrong stuff, refused to give us the right stuff, & double charged our card for the order mistake and continued to call us stupid and crazy & in the end never gave us our correct food after charging us????

Gluten-Free In Boise!!! Best kept secret in town- 90%of the menu is Gluten free!  I'm in town from California and didn't think I would find anything but the standard egg scramble- WRONG! I got the chorizo frittata and it was delicious. Also served with my gluten free bread (and yes- they also have gluten free pancakes!) Neat and tidy local place with great service:)
2nd time here, excellent breakfast, love the skillet bowls!  This time had to try lunch, got the finger steaks, wow!  So tender, light breading, some of the best I've had!
Best Chinese food in the Valley. Every visitor we've taken there agrees. Huge portions and great flavor.

Probably one if the worst experiences I have had at a bowling alley. The ladies at the bar and in the kitchen were super snotty, close minded and would rather spend time talking to their buddies than help any customers. I'm likely never coming here again and neither are my friends and coworkers. For the bartender, use a phone to look up recipes... like most bartenders usually do, instead of playing on facebook.

This is my first time in Idaho. Just here for work. So I ordered breakfast close to my hotel room. I ordered the shrimp and grits and biscuits with gravy. What I got no where resembled anything close to what I ordered. As opposed to standard grits, they were a fried cake form. Too much breading on the cake and no seasoning on the grits at all. The only flavor was from the tomato sauce on the shrimp which was basically a bunch of paprika. The biscuits weren't biscuits at all. More like toasted bread. The gravy had the flavor of sausage even though there was none. Being from Louisiana/ the south I should have known better to order those dishes and I regret it. Just stick with the pancakes and French toast.

From start to finish this was a great transaction. We moved across country and needed the carpet installed tomorrow and they put it in tomorrow! (J.J. sales person, had already measured)  I purchased carpet that was in stock and it was nice quality carpet. The installers were friendly and efficient and did a great job. Two days for 2100+sq.ft. for new pad and carpet install! J.J. even showed up while they were installing to make sure we were happy!

Never been here before. Lady who took my order was useless and couldn't tell me either make your own or pick combo and can adjust order, so I got stuck with a tasteless #12, had hardly any avocado spread, which was tasteless. Lady was rude. They don't offer to toast bread. This is just like subway, PUKE!! No bread options like subway, only tasteless french bread. Skimp on meat too! Tried charging $0.52 for ranch to make this taste better lol NEVER going back!!!

Admittedly I am not a regular customer to the Red Robin chain of restaurants. I found the COVID protection they are taking more than adequate.  The service was courteous, prompt and our server was friendly and helpful.  My salad was gigantic and fresh. Not a tinge of a brown leaf anywhere. I may be turning a corner on becoming a RR semi regular!

My husband and I ordered two salads to go when we got them they were not cold but actually warm, a lot of the lettuce was white with brown on it. It was half the size we normally get but still the same price.  Called the manager and he talked a lot but did not really listen and said he would check into it. We were just so disappointed as we have been going there for years, but that will be the last time unfortunately.

This is my new favorite place to get my nails done! I used to go to Hannah's by Winco in downtown Boise, but now I will gladly drive to posh to get my nails done. They were so accommodating and got us in at 6:30 even though they close at 7. The workers were so sweet and talked to me and my friend and were gentle with my feet and hands. Everything was very clean and sanitary, and I am so happy with how my nails look. I won't go anywhere else!

After my last review, the store owner reached out and sent me some coupons for complimentary 2-scoop sundaes (what I ordered and had an issue with last time).  We went in this week to use those.  I really appreciate him doing that and caring enough to do so.  The sundae I received this time was the same size as last time - but he had explained that they use smaller scoops for the sundaes than if you ordered an ice cream cone, so, fine.  The girl this time put more whipped cream on my sundae though.

I hate to say something bad when I am grateful for free ice cream, but this Baskin-Robbins was filthy.  The floors, the tables ... and they weren't busy and there were at least 2 girls working.  Look at the photo I took of the ice cream in the case ... it doesn't look at all appetizing and kind of goes with the overall look and feel of this location.

Unfortunately this is just not a location we'll be returning to though I appreciate their effort to keep our business.

Absolutely the worst experience. After being what we felt was over charged for our food we waited for over 10 minutes for our food and we were the only car in line. Food was literally tossed at us . We had to flag her down to request our receipt and wouldn't you know Surprise! Not one, but BOTH receipt printers were down. So we were unable to verify what we were paying for. Got home and of course no napkins and when we opened our roost fries it looked NOTHING like the picture ad. It was a whole chicken tender on top of cold fries and congealed cheese sauce. Jack in the Box used to be our favorite fast food place but we are done. You think paying these kids 13-14 an hour they would be professional, quick and accurate but it feels like the complete opposite

Love this place. Expect a bit of a wait but worth it. We split a senior meal and it is more than we can eat. Best corned beef hash I have ever had and biscuits and hravy amazing. Go e here

Went back again yesterday and I swear it was even better than the last time.  Fiesta Hash is the best breakfast ever. Can't wait to go again.

Sorry to say I ate here this morning and it was tasteless. I had half a bacon and tomato and avo benedict.  The hollandaise had no flavor, english muffin not toasted, bacon way overcooked. Hash browns were crispy on one side and not cooked on the other.  Absolutely no flavor in this whole meal. I will come again because it is usually so good but....our server JJ did a great job.

We recently adopted/rescued Bella. We demo'd another doggie daycare the same week we tried Camp Bow Wow. First impressions are important and we certainly took note of and appreciate the modern facility when we arrived. The staff was very friendly and helpful and it seemed there was enough staff to properly run the business and take care of the dogs entrusted to them. Since we need to board Bella for a few days and it's stressful for us and her, we were very interested in the accommodations; which turned out to be very nice. The facility is very clean and the people seem to know what they are doing. We appreciate the vast service offerings and plan to take advantage of them. If all goes well after boarding Bella for 4 days, I'll give Camp Bow Wow 5 stars.

If you haven't tried it yet, you're missing out! Everything we had was so delicious. We had the clams and the sauce was the perfect hint of spice. I had the French dip which they use  Wagyu beef it was so good! The Ahi Tuna was nice thick cuts and scratch made brownie sundae was the perfect ending! Service was amazing as well! Definitely will be back

We had a very enjoyable lunch here after church this past Sunday. Lots of people brunching and sipping mimosas. We chose to sit belly up to the bar as we feel we get quick attentive service most places. Boy, we sure did here too! Our bartender/server Matt was on fire! Not only was he friendly and fast, watching him fill the drink orders was entertaining. Not in a bottle flipping way, but just seeing him work so efficiently in and around the bar, interacting with other guests, cleaning as needed, it was just fun to see. 

I am not a big eater, and I was just craving a cool crisp salad, I ordered just the side house salad. It was everything I'd hoped for (loved the better than average balsamic vinaigrette dressing) and even though it was a "side salad" it was plenty and I couldn't even finish it all. My husband loves Club sandwiches and we overhead the guy nearby say it was the best he'd ever had, so done deal. He loved how they perfectly toasted the bread, he could taste the quality in the meats and said the produce was fresh and delicious. It is definitely a solid choice.

Something else we noticed while there, was how hard the owner was working alongside the other team members, whether that was the hostess or a cook, he was definitely pitching in busing a table, running out drinks or getting needed supplies from the back. It really says a lot. After our first experience at this location, there was no reason not to go with five stars. We will definitely be going back. Thanks Tavern!
This is one of our favorite pizza places. The staff is always friendly and hopeful. "The Don" is my husband's favorite and the margarita is mine.

This is the worst store ever.  They refuse to give me a refund.

They damaged my home.

The installers stated derogatory comments about sex girlfriends and other information. 

They left for over an hour half without telling me.  They arrive at 930 left at 1130 came back at 130 and left at 330.

Dumped trim in a pile unmarked and damaged wanted to reuse it

Salesperson said installers would work around me and my pets.  Installet stated he hated all dogs.  Left 2 doors open to the street for a vision impaired and deaf dog.

Ripped hardware pit of walls instead of unscrewing it.  Damaged additional trim and tried to hide it.  Pulled additional items off the walls not needed to be removed.

Put trimwork next to bone china.  Now they are ignoring me.

We are visiting the area from Reno and got into Boise just in time for breakfast. After searching Yelp, we came across Moe Joe's and based off of the reviews, we decided to give it a try... and we are soo glad we did!! My husband is a chicken fried steak addict and he said it was definitely in his top 5 favorites. I am a sweet breakfast lover so I went for the Wheatberry French Toast and it was delicious!! Our waitress Kim was very attentive and super sweet. I would definitely recommend Moe Joe's!!

We LOVED them.  Showed up on time- professional- and followed through.  Remodeling our house has been a nightmare- and the easiest thing was our bathroom because of Rebath.  My only complaint is that they cannot do my entire house.  : )

We had a large party and a decent wait time but it was definitely worth it! The menu options were hard to choose from as everything looked so good! Everyone at the table lived their choice - this place is a must stop for great food and great service!!

As long as I can remember i have always had access to a Baskin Robins and have never had a bad experiance.  

Over the past 20-years i have visited the Fairview and Locust Grove B&R quite a few times and have always felt welcomed.  I enjoy their options, although wonky at times, always creamy and delicious.  

This year i was able to introduce my daughter to her first Daiquiri Ice scoop, mine ws 40+ years ago.  There's something conforting about tasting your childhood memories and sharring them with your own kids.  Love yah B&R!

Great family place. They bring pizza dough for the kids. When we're together will order an assortment of salads and share. Which one is the best? By then  the pizza makes its presentation. The other night tried the calzone and cappuccino. The Calzone entree was tasty with extra sauce.. Had the cappuccino for dessert. The ambience is delightful.

Love this ORGANIC JUICE spot. They have everything healthy and clean from warm food to their great tasting fresh cold pressed juices. They make it simple to choose with straightforward labeling. Love the Green and sweet Green... and you have to get the White and make chia seed pudding with it... add some fresh berries and it's a great breakfast!  Staff are very friendly and helpful!! Thank you!

Excellent yummy ready to go back for more! 
Today tomorrow any day of the week!
You might even run into a celebrity!

Spankin' new building which is home to the first Treasure Valley location of Portland based Block Rock Coffee.  (Tip:  Another with same local management opening downtown soon).  The greeting by people who work here is robust and warm.  If only the coffee was as good.  The coffee was mediocre for our palates and lukewarm in the cup, the service behind counter,  friendly as it was, could use some process tune up and training and the interior was not an inviting place to linger.  This could be generational for sure.  In other words, "It's not you, it's me."   Constructively offered (I hope) observations follow.  I would sure like to see this place succeed with the right audience even if I'm not a member of it.   One and done for me to be a Black Rock customer.  

BACKGROUND
Portland is a coffee-crazed city (no worries, I am one of crazies for the beverage myself)  and there are lots of great coffee options there.  Black Rock is likely middle of the pack for Portland options but it seems they are expanding elsewhere, although whether franchising or locally managed branches of corporate owned I don't know.  Note the following snippet from the main Black Rock website.  "No person is an island. No matter how many friends we collect on our devices, there will always be a longing to truly know others and be known. At Black Rock, our aim is to fuel that fire by being more than a coffee company... we are a people company."

LOCATION VIBE
As warm and welcoming as is that Black Rock statement and as friendly are the staff at this location, there isn't a single thing about the interior here that would make me want to linger in "community".  The vibe is all cold industrial meets rustic of concrete floors, hard wood tables of various heights, uncomfortable chairs of the same and high exposed ceilings which bounces off sound, including too loud music, which made it "HUH?" loud on a day when there weren't more than six customers in the place.

The chairs and tables are too tightly spaced; if it were even half full it would be as if a sardine can.  That there was trouble getting even the furniture in the space  without people to fill it was evidence by chairs askew in front.  And there is the oddest location of a multi tier shelf with merchandise branded materials, like t shirts and coffee travel cups, that stands in the middle of the space as obstacle course.

As much as we tried to linger and enjoy our coffee and sweet treat, we only made it a few minutes before out of there.  And tossed out the coffee on the way out the door.  We'll get back to that.

SERVICE
The staff gets highest marks for friendliness.  But the signs up on the wall for coffee beverages are far enough away with small enough print to be tough to see and when I asked the person helping us a pretty simple question of what was their darkest roast that day the response was "We drip our coffee."  Yes, and what is the darkest?  "Not sure" was the response.  When I asked who made the pastries in the case (some so high up off the floor that even on tip toe one can't see the top of them) the same response of "Not sure".  The good news is this person finally asked for help.  But there seemed to be more staff than needed behind the counter and a little chaos in the mix.  

COFFEE
For the record, in my limited experience with Black Rock they do three coffees.  Pearl = light.  Old Town = medium.  Steel Bridge = dark.  But I couldn't remember the names when I was at the counter and there didn't seem to be any signage to help point a customer in the direction.  Nor did the person behind the counter have the information.  Regardless, whatever it was that was poured in the cup was pretty mild and also not very hot.  A few sips and it was time to break up with the cup and let it go.

EATS
For the record, the pastries in the case are from Gaston's bakery.  A good thing.  At mid afternoon there were lots left to choose from.  Including an entire row of raspberry danish and marionberry scones on the top shelf of the display case.  Which might still be there since one literally couldn't see the tops of them up so high and had to ask "Umm, what's up there?"  

THIS N THAT:

1)  PARKING:  Private lot and on both sides of the building.

2) DRIVE THROUGH:  Yep.

3) ACCESSIBILITY:  One parking spot back side of lot, clear path of travel to and through door, all one one level, some seating accessible, loo is too.

4) LOO:  Two and both unisex.  

5) LOCATION TIP:  Look across lot you'll see back of Homestead Grill.

We had a good experience here.  They accommodated gluten free no problem.  And it was delicious.  Not sure about the negative talk.  My experience was positive and we ate the leftovers because they tasted good!
Ashley is amazing. Love the ideas she gives me, she has a great and sweet personality. Prices are great and we always look forward to my appointments

Got here checked in unloaded all our stuff hauled it upstairs no elevator went in our room and it was occupied walked down stairs to get a different room and was given a room in a different building

Already a pretty bad experience but now have to add more to it


So we get all of our stuff and go into the new room and instead of the 2 queen beds we asked for and have a room with one king bed and a full size pull out bed we have 5 people with us already planed on one of use sleeping on the floor but 2 adults do not fit on a full size bed but it's already almost 2 am so we just did the best we could for the night then first thing in the morning we go to the counter to get a different room with the 2 queens  we already paid 350 dollars for and they tell us there are no clean rooms available but they will call us when one is available no worries we can wait but then they ask us to remove all of our stuff out of the room we are in so they can clean it so we have to spend most of the day doing our site seeing and driving around with five of us and all of our stuff that would normally have been left in the room without a doubt the absolute worst experience I have ever had at a hotel I would recommend everyone avoid this hotel!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

This was a great spot that was decently priced. The atmosphere consisted of great music and an actual mix between genres. I'd just mention that the booth seats are a bit tight and I have a smaller frame, so if you want to be comfortable, I'd recommend sitting at a table.

Ok this place is something else. We drove out from Boise to eat here. The reviews made it sound so good and we tried 2 other great places the last few days for breakfast. We figured we would keep it going. 

Had a seat and no joke 3 women came up to us in 2 minutes to offer us drinks. A 4th said she would be our waiter and another served us. I love feeling cared for!

The menu was a good one. Not too overwhelming but had some great options.

I opted for the $8 2 egg breakfast with hash browns crispy with lemon pancakes with poppy seeds and a lemon glaze for a $2 increase instead of toast. 
Oh my goodness! I ate the eggs and perfect potatoes in 5 minutes flat. I moved onto These pancakes. They were to die for!! I ate all 3 of them minus a glad I gave mom. She was too full to enjoy it after eating her eggs with sausage and potatoes with biscuits. 

The waitress was very sweet and kept checking on us in a nice way. The customer service in Boise was amazing. Overall great trip and some great potatoes and biscuits! 

Oh and pancakes! They had like 6 signatures ones. One was coffee syrup. It's the lemon glaze that did it. I will be back next I visit mom for sure!!

We're new to the area, and have two Australian Shepherds, both adults and both with issues. The older one has severe anxiety, and doesn't trust anyone. The other one is a rescue, who is deaf and visually impaired. 
Everyone at River City Vet was so nice, warm and welcoming.  Each staff member not only greeted me, but the dogs as well.
Both the vet tech and Dr Puckett took the time to sit on the floor with our dogs, throughout the entire exam.
And I have to say, their initial exam was by far the most thorough exam any of my pets have ever had.
There were fresh water bowls and treats in various areas of the office, even coffee and water for us pet parents.
Both dogs did so well, they ended staying for a few hours at the doggie daycare...which they loved! 
Highly recommend bringing your fur-kids.

Been a weekly customer for last couple of months. Decided to upgrade from chain pizza. 
Unfortunately we'll probably be returning to chain pizza after tonight. 

If you want your order wrong, a longer wait than told,plus a different price and teenagers with a menial grasp on customer service then yes I recommend this place. 

My order was taken over the phone for pickup repeated back to me correctly and given a price. 
Sadly when I showed up the employees working seemed to be afraid to approach customers and ask if they need help or telling customerS who go through the wrong door with at least two red signs saying exit only that there are people in front of them. There must be a hierarchy I'm not aware of. When it was finally my turn to pay a different amount than I was told because I guess the guy mumbles my cashier told me, I waited for my food. Well at least for the cashier to tell someone to get it or check on it while she helped the customer behind me. She did run right back to check on his missing order though so again class system I'm obviously not a part of. The other cashier apparently decided that putting together silverware packs (I'm assuming, I didn't ask) was more important to get finished than approaching the customer staring  directly at her. So she finished her task and then it was my turn. She found my order just fine but unfortunately light sauce didn't translate to the cooks and garlic bread sounds like garlic twists on the phone. 
So subpar service subpar food. 
 
Definitely going to save at least $20 at a chain place and get a drink with it in the future.

We are staying at a hotel in Boise and decided to order from here for dinner. We ordered three minestrone soups, a chicken Caesar salad, bread, fried ravioli, and stuffed mushrooms. The food was terrible. The soup had very little vegetables or beans, it was mostly broth with a layer of oil on top. They sent calamari instead of fried ravioli, which none of us eat. The mushrooms were cold, watery, and rubbery, with very little flavor. We also received no napkins or cutlery, but we didn't need it anyway, since everything but the bread went in the trash. Waste of money!
Best Chinese we've found in the TV! Super friendly, good menu choices and always fast for Togo!

This place is a joke. I have called 3 different salesman about diesel motor homes and trade in for my camper and each one says they will call back and then they don't. Finally found one who gave me details on one of the motor homes and he told me they sold it at auction... then I decide to stop wasting my time and go to the meridian location. I was not greeted by anyone not even the receptionist. So I walked out to the lot to look around and there's the motor home that supposedly was sold at auction. I walk back inside to talk to a salesman about it and find a bunch of bro's watching YouTube videos in there little sales pit. Extremely unprofessional. Camping world is next door just go there.

Depending on the food you order, some are great and others meh. I LOVE their scillitini dish and it's the only reason I come back. My family ended up ordering a to go order to pick up on Christmas Eve - called 24 hours in advance. We go to pick it up and they have no record of our order. We waited an extra half hour to get the food. The manager was great (I think his name was Mark) and comped us our food. Great, I believe in second chances. 

I did another to go order for two people and called 3 hours in advance. The staff member I spoke with on the phone said it wasn't a problem. I go to pick up the order at 5:30. The hostess said she would go check the order, came back, and told me it would be out. Okay, I stood there for about 10 minutes before another staff member, this time the one in charge of the to go orders, asked me "would you like to make a to go order?". Not only did they lose my order AGAIN, but no one informed me of it. I had to wait an extra 30 minutes to get my food AGAIN. I'm not sure if this is a system ordering flaw or a staffing problem, but it's pretty ridiculous. I would not recommend ordering any to go orders from here.

Downgrading from 4 stars to 3 after multiple scheduling issues. First scheduled in a day provider was not going to be in.  Then rescheduled.  Then called to come in at original time.  When I showed the provider was indeed out.  The. Rescheduled but not without incident

Sorry, but with gas being four bucks a gallon and a 70 mile round trip I can't afford to make three trips in hopes of seeing a provider once.

It was an ok experience. The staff were fantastic. But the price point for the food.. wow.. we ordered 2 personal pizza's, 2 salads and 1 beer and the ticket was over $60.00. And to go to a "pizza" place and spend that... wow. I had sticker shock. The food was decent, nothing specatular for that price. 

Yes we had left overs for the next day, but if I knew it was going to be that much I may have re-thought eating there.
A solid dinner. It's very good. Highly recommend it.  Locals in the area recommend it.

Nice facility, but that's about it. One of the veterinarians here really likes to pressure and manipulate you into giving your pet very expensive exams that are not necessary at all. Greedy and crooked, watch your wallet and your pet.
The pizza was just ok and both the cheese cakes, strawberry and Oreo, were both awful. We do like our cheese cakes but have never tasted any that bad. We won't be ordering from here anymore.

No bueno! Just had dinner at the red robin on eagle rd. In meridian. We all had burgers.. my wife asked for no pink on hers, and it came out extremely pink. I had the royal burger, which comes with an egg on it. The egg whites were uncooked. Not just a little uncooked egg white, but still translucent raw egg white. Completely unacceptable, this is how people get food poisoning. Also while we were still there we overheard the party behind us had issues with there meals and had to send some food back. This is unfortunate on many levels. My family really enjoys red robin, it's a place where we can eat out even with my daughters celiac disease. Also,  I am a red robin share holder. This has me rethinking my involvement with the chain. I feel that I must mention that our server Shelby was top notch. She did her best to ensure that we had a good meal. It's too bad that the chef can't seem to get it together. This is also a reflection of poor management in my opinion.

Unfortunately I was underwhelmed with Gino's.  The only reason I'm giving them 3 starts is that we did have exceptional service and I enjoyed my wine and desserts.  I called on a Monday to schedule reservations for my mother in law's 80th birthday on a Friday.  We ended up being a group of 8 and they were happy to accommodate us at a table in the back so we weren't in the middle of the restaurant.  

The most disappointing thing about our meal was the appetizers because they are WAAAAY over priced in my opinion.  We ordered stuffed mushrooms that ended up being 6 smaller mushrooms on a plate as well as a plate of asparagus (nothing special).  Compared to most restaurant appetizers we were very unimpressed and would never order them again.

I didn't order a salad at first but after tasting both the house salad and the ceasar salad I opted to add a house salad.  You can't go wrong with either... especially when they let you add TONS of cheese!

Several of the people at our table ordered fettuccini alfredo with either chicken or shrimp.  I had the chicken alfredo with fettuccini noodles and wished I had opted for a different pasta.  My husband ordered a wood fired pizza (he's not very adventurous) I enjoyed the piece I ate from his leftovers but it gave me terrible heartburn.  For the most part everyone at our table agreed that they were not very impressed on their entrees and would prefer the cheaper version at Olive Garden.  

Okay let's talk about the good stuff... DESSERT!  Everyone at the table ordered various desserts and they were the best part of the meal by far.  I sampled everything except the crème brule.  What I did not eat of my meal I made up for in dessert lol.  I ate my fair portion of cheesecake, chocolate mousse, and tiramisu.  If I go back to Gino's it will only be for wine and dessert.  I'm not going to lie, I would have a hard time choosing between them so that in itself would be a meal for me.  

Although we didn't feel the meal was worth the price our service was EXCEPTIONAL.  From the phone call to place the reservation to the server that waited on us hand and foot it was a great experience.  Our server did an amazing job considering the size of the group and she helped many of us first timers with selections.  I give her credit for helping me find a new favorite wine (Angelo Negro Bierbet) a red served chilled.  I never would have selected it on my own but I have already placed an order online so that I have it on stand by at home.

We came in and got asked if we made a reservation or on the wait list. Said no was told a long wait. The next time we wanted to go we went to their website to get put on their wait list and their website said they don't participate in the wait list feature.

The only mad thing about this business is the amount of time you have to wait to get your dinner (50 minutes).  The salmon was done well, but the veggies were so large (and no knife to cut them), watery and tasteless. The egg roll was good.  The only outstanding thing was the chocolate chip cookie.
Always enjoy my meals here. Maggi and Ana were on the spot with their service and super friendly!

First timers here and we were very happy! We had the tempura asparagus to start and it did not disappoint. Nice environment and great service. John R. gave us the best experience & was such a friendly guy. We will definitely be back!

Unfortunately when buying my vehicle the loan was done through PFCU.  This joke of a banking business charges $17 to make a payment over the phone. But mind you they don't have hours to allow you to pay in person.  Once I refinanced to my normal Credit Union, they charged my loan another $900 for lack of proof of coverage for a month, which they didn't notify me of.  But they only charged it when they received the pay off check! Basically if they are going to lose the loan, they will screw you any way they can.  They are now holding the title hostage for another $900.  Lessoned learned, will never do business with them in the future!

Mike's customer service was wonderful! I do not live at the residence that he treated but he made the effort to notify me prior and after the work was completed. He asked if everything was to my liking and if there was anything else I needed. He also said to contact him for any other future requests. This is nice because I have had this company perform work at our rental for several years and no one has ever contacted me before or after the treatment. I appreciate that! Thank you, Paula

Ordered the Brooklyn Bridge pizza (added mushrooms and fresh garlic.) Pizza was soggy and basically tasteless. Had to add salt and red pepper. Could not taste the garlic at all. We had the waiter check to see if they added it the garlic and he said they did. They did compensate with a free dessert.  Which was appreciated. But disappointed! In the pizza.

We have enjoyed Wingers in the past, but this last experience was terrible. We had it delivered though door dash, so I understand if things are a little cold or a little soggy, but the whole order was so bad. We got a family meal with sticky fingers, fries, and mashed potatoes. We ended up getting rice somehow, and what looked like one big scoop of mashed potatoes. They tasted like they had been sitting out for the whole day. They were super gummy and gross with a crusty film on the top. The sticky fingers also tasted like they had been sitting out. Some were very hard and chewy, others were rubbery and grisly. No one in my house wanted to finish their plates. We were so disappointed and still hungry!

Just happen upon this googling breakfast places ~ first off the line super long ( COVID distanceing ) but we got right in , was suppose to be a 15 mins wait ..not bad .. we were sat and drinking coffee in less than 5 .. menu is awesome .. so many things to choose from; ) 
Hubby had a steak hash bowl with red potatoes and I had 1/2 biscuits and gravy . This is a definite go back to anytime we are in Boise ! Looking forward to trying lunch next !!

Wanted to try somewhere new for a change and saw several good reviews on Nextdoor, so we decided to try Joy Garden.  As far as the food, it was okay Chinese, but nothing special.  The portions were big, but the flavor somewhat bland.  There was only one person working the counter and seating people and serving people and cleaning tables, plus taking orders.  So, the service was slow, but not horrible. The atmosphere was okay, again nothing special, kind of what you would expect for an American Chinese restaurant.  Only two other tables in the place at 1:15PM with a couple of takeout orders happening as well.  Prices seemed a little high, but given the size of the portions, I guess it was a wash.  With so many other restaurants popping up in the Treasure Valley, will most likely not be back unless everywhere else is really busy.

We've been traveling across the country and stayed in two separate candle wood suites. We have a dog and cat with us. The two hotels were perfectly fine with our pets. We called ahead told them that we have a dog and cat and they said no problem. We booked the room drove our last two hours of the day and arrived at this hotel. Went inside to check in and the employees told us we have to DECLAW OUR CAT to be able to stay at any candle wood suite hotel. We just stayed at two other candle wood and had absolutely no problem. They refused to book us and we had to go find a different hotel. I cannot believe they're telling people they have to have their cats claws removed to stay with them. These animals are peoples babies not just pets. These employees need to be retrained.

So the food is average, I mean burgers are good but slightly overpriced. Beer is cold, and fries are hot!   Problem is staff, bunch of rude waiters and waitresses with no personality.  I am literally ordering my food from a person with the personality of a dumpster fire.  

Now the helping had that bring your food are are amazing. But the waiters and waitresses that deal with people should be trained or maybe not deal with people.  Wash cars?  Mow lawns?  Maybe bus tables.  But please for the love of God, stop working with people!

Love this place! Tons of choices. Loads of toppings. Atmosphere is fun and festive, bright and cheery! Prices are a little high but that's to be expected with frozen yogurt. Also they'll let you try it before you buy it, which is great. My favorite is the raspberry froyo...yum!

Had a great buying experience, but the service and finance workers are awful. We have a warranty through here and have attempted to use it three times. Every time we call to make an appointment we NEVER can reach someone. You leave a voicemail.... NO ONE CALLS YOU BACK. Come to find out the service workers kept telling me I had to use the warranty at Bish's and YOU CAN USE THE WARRANTY ELSEWHERE. 

The secretary suggested I come in to the service department in person to make an appointment.

I tried to do this and apparently my "tongue to bumper warranty" doesn't cover what I need fixed (siding and sealant) and if I wanted something fixed it wouldn't be until late September or Early October...

I then attempted to ask for more detail on my warranty and what is actually covered. The service workers were unsure and then referred me to ask the front desk to speak with a finance worker.

They said two men helped me when I bought by trailer earlier in the year. They said one would be available to help me shortly. The man that walked up was NOT the same person who helped me earlier in the year. The finance worker that helped me was John. He was VERY UNPROFESSIONAL. I spoke with him about the warranty and what was actually covered versus what I had been told by Chase (the finance worker we bought the trailer with). He said I was playing he said she said and couldn't give me a clear answer to where their explanation fell short. Instead he said Chase "probably didn't interpret your question the way you thought." I eventually gave up trying to keep the warranty and decided to cancel it.

I called the company that the warranty is through. After speaking with them. I learned that MULTIPLE PEOPLE HAVE BEEN CANCELLING WARRANTIES BOUGHT THROUGH BISH FOR THE SAME ISSUES. Also, THEY ARE REACHING OUT TO THE AGENT THAT WORKS WITH BISH DUE TO THE FALSE INFORMATION PEOPLE ARE RECEIVING.

Really delicious pizza.  We had an interesting dinner last night.  We love to sit outside, enjoying the atmosphere of the surroundings.  Our pizza was taking quite a long time, so we continued to talk and talk and talk.  We have eaten at Grimaldi's many times and have never waited so long.  The manager came to us and apologized sincerely and took full ownership of the problem and graciously comped our meal.  We did not expect that, but it felt really good that there is a business/people who would own up to their mistakes.  We will go again as I am sure they addressed the problem and you just can't stay away from a lovely relaxing place with a slice of pizza and a glass of wine!

I had pre-cancer squam cell on my ear June 2019. They removed it and billed me 300+ Dollars. They said they would in-house finance the balance due for 90 days with no interest. I agreed and have until September to pay it off. By July 20th, I have a Bonneville collections company calling me all hours of the day and night for the 150 left on my balance due. I called and talked to Heidi and she advised because I was a week late on a payment, I am in collections. Now my credit is ruined and I am suddenly paying interest for something i was supposed to settle with them by this September. Don't go here if you finance anything and I think they over-charged compared to other Ada Dermatologists.

I have lived in many places and have tried plenty of Italian restaurants, including in Chicago. For Boise, this one is pretty good. The tiramisu is amazing and I love the bread. The pasta sauce could use more tang, but it is still really good. I am pretty impressed and will come back.

Great food at reasonable prices. The menu is extensive and we found the wait staff to be very attentive and accommodating. Based on other reviews, it seems like some others do not find this to be the case, but if you're willing to go during off-peak hours or just not on the weekend (think week-nights), I think you'll find the service is fast and facility is clean. 

On a scale of never coming back to definitely coming back, I'm resolutely leaning towards coming back :)

It was a long wait but worth it. My coffee cup was never empty. Our waitress was very pleasant and attentive. I had the corned beef hash it was very fresh with a lot of depth of flavor. Can't wait for our next visit to Meridian to visit Moe Joe's again.

I'll add pictures when I can but I just had to leave a review and say this place is honestly incredible!! Some of the rolls come with a crab, tempura, jalapeño salad thing that is seriously out of this world. The service is beyond kind and personable, they're always accommodating, and I couldn't imagine a more people friendly atmosphere. Their selection of rolls is vast and the hand rolls are a perfect ratio of fish to rice. I wish they had an all you can eat option but that's the only thing id change because they're completely top notch. Already have gone back several times and always eat too fast before remembering to take pictures. Going back this evening though so I'll try to remember!

I didn't have the heart to say anything when I was there. I have never left a nail salon wanting to cry more than I did today and I have fairly low standards about my nails but these are just awful. Please don't go here.

Very good and friendly service. Kolbey was attentive, friendly and professional. The 2 stars are for the food which was terrible. The nachos were awful. Soggy, queso tasted like canned cheese product, not enough toppings. Worst nachos I've ever had. 

Our server deserves 5 stars. The food deserved -2 stars.
Quick to get an appointment as a new patient quickly got us into a patient room once we arrived. Staff was very friendly and very thorough

Best delivered pizza you can order "forget the others"
Always fresh, hot & yummy! Check out there locations for in-house service & salad bar.
We Love this place!  Great Food especially the Saltimbocca. The bartender makes my Gold Cadillac from Poor Reds!  Grazie!

DO NOT STAY HERE! Horrible experience!! Services were not rendered! Would give them no stars if possible. This hotel is run by absolute idiots who are scamming people for money. There website was also false advertising "pet friendly" till recently, as they changed it after my experience! They are not pet friendly and only allowed dogs but won't tell you till you check in. Before they made this recent change to there website, they were deceiving customers and falsely advertising!! They have a prejudice against cats and will kick you out of your room and threaten to call the police because of it. They purposefully watched me on camera bring my cats into my room so they could charge me instead of stopping me and telling me I could not bring my cats in. After getting into room, they came to my door and told me to leave immediately or they would call the police!! They even threatened to charge my credit card $650 per cat! Unfortunately I did get charged the $650 once even though there pet deposit is $300 for damages. Thankfully they didn't get the chance to charge any more as my bank flagged the first charge that I'm currently fighting. They also took my money for the two rooms I booked, however Hotels.com did an investigation and is refunding my money back for the rooms when they saw the hotels website did reflect pet friendly and was falsely advertising as stated. This hotel is a complete joke and is trying to scam people!! Cat owners be aware and do not take your fur babies here!! This is one of many reviews I will post about my experience, I am not done with you Quality Inn!!! You will not get away with this robbery, false advertisement and threatening of customers! -_-

if i could give this place a negative five, id give it a negative ten. beyond worst experience ive had. I heard nothing but good things about this specific location only to find out upon arrival that i had been lied too. our server, sarah, who believe is also a manager? smelled. So. Bad. She leaned over to hand us drinks, wreaked of hangover and even her hands smelled as they passed by my face. already a turn off because of her stench. But her service was far more disgusting. I mentioned the southwest cobb salad she said "yes you SHOULD get the salad" i knew right then she was gesturing my weight, im over 300lbs. I know when someone is suggesting, especially rudely, that i go with a healthier choice. The beer was flat, and she told me it was because she DIDNT want to change the keg OR get someone to do it. i watched her pick a hair out of my salad on the way to the table. 
-10/5. Would NEVER go again.
We came for Happy Hour to give them try and it was great! So happy to have another beautiful sit down restaurant close to home! Great service and the food came out quickly! Welcome to the hood!

Went here last night with the fam - it's alright. I thought pizza was kinda meh. 
They do have a salad bar and they require you wear gloves (provided) to use it. That's good at least! The only lettuce though was an iceberg mix with a tiny bit or romaine. Would be nice to have more options as far as that goes - where my spinach at?
Anyways, just being picky there.
All in all it was just okay. Not stoked. Not disappointed. Just meh.

Extremely convenient drive through during covid. My dad likes their mochas. They make a good latte and my daughter likes their hot chocolate. Star off because their pastries leave a lot to be desired.

I wish I had tried this place earlier in my trip. Fantastic fast food Mexican. Tacos are fried, which I love. Rice is great, chips and pico were awesome. My sister got the rolled tacos supreme. They looked amazing, and covered with carne asada on top. I will definitely come here every time I visit my mom!

I ordered the house burger,  Server asked if I wanted it pink in the middle or cooked through.  I said cooked through.  My burger was burnt and dry.  The lettuce they served with it was warm and wet.  Disgusting.  The only reason I gave two stars is server was good and refilled our beverages without being asked.  Otherwise, it was not good

Capital is the place for anyone looking to find a better connection with God and their local community. Don't worry what your story is or used to be, this church does a phenomenal job of assisting anyone and everyone with their walk in faith.  I highly recommend you go check out this church, not to mention the music is breathtaking to say the least :)) #JFTP
I just bought a 1200 sq ft home and had great floors take care of installing new vinyl and carpet! Smooth floor transitions and they got it done so quick. Thanks!!

Gravy is some of the best ever tasted. Must get. 
Oatmeal some of the best I've had too. 
I definitely would recommend this place for breakfast anytime in the Nampa ID area. 
We will back back. 
Oh, and we are from the San Francisco Bay Area!!

Reviewer #51                        4-stars                                   YAY! I'm a fan! 

I've driven by this place literally hundreds of times and I've never noticed it, and if I did, it wasn't memorable. How I ended up here was something of a fluke. We were going to lunch on our lunch hour and decided to go to the Griddle in Meridian. When we got there, at 12:30 PM, there was a note on the door that they closed early for a staff appreciation day. Well, shoot, we don't have much time and we gotta get back to work. Surely there is some food nearby that isn't fast food (Sonic). Low and behold there was Rudy's Pub and Grill. 

When we walked in we noticed that there was lots of space and go quality seating, an outdoor seating area, a pool table, darts, a full bar, and more! 

We had a very nice attentive waitress. We explained that we were just going to share a meal and asked if we can sub fries for a salad and they did at no extra charge (bonus points). I ate the salad and my dining companion got the Philly steak. The steak was real steak and not the thin stuff I'm used to seeing on Philly's. He seemed to really like it and gave it two thumbs up. 

I took lots of photos, so check em out! I think this place would be pretty cool for an UYE, or OYE for that matter, since there is lots of space, a full bar, lots of good food, and POOL!

Horrible customer service! We went in to this location get a business account set up. We had already upgraded our personal accounts at another Verizon store and they gave my wife a $600 credit towards the iPhone 12. However, switching over to the business account would wash the $600 dollar credit my wife had gotten for upgrading on our personal account. Corbin the manager told my wife that her iPhone XR max had already reached its near street value of $100 because she had $75 already applied to it thus far and it wouldn't be worth anything to apply that credit to the business account. At our surprise knowing that the iPhone XR max is worth more than $100 street value, we were naturally upset and offended for a few reasons. My wife wanted to purchase her new phone outright and exchange the xr max with a credit applied when we upgraded our personal account at another store. She was told that wasn't how they do the exchange and would apply $600 credit in total over time each time she paid her bill. She would have gladly listed her phone on fb market and paid for the new 12 in full. They talked her into just doing the credit. Now we are at Corbin's store who we've spoken with extensively over the phone before coming in and knowing our situation he said he would do all that he could to help out and we also spoke about what phones we currently had (the 12's). I was making payments on mine, not a big deal, she had a perfect trade in. When he told us that her phone had reached its street value all, but $25 of it. We weren't happy, we were surprised and when we started questioning it and explaining Verizon just stole $500 dollars from us, he started getting really upset and talking over us and wouldn't let it go. We were trying to say that we aren't mad, but that doesn't make sense and he kept going on about how he's trying to help us and it's not his fault. Right before we decided to get out of there we said we could have at least sold it for $500 online. He replied, "you won't get anything more than $75 dollars for an iPhone 8". That's when we understood that whatever he was talking about, he clearly didn't listen us the entire time we were talking about how she had just upgraded her phone and we were concerned over her losing her $600 credit. We were right back where we started except now we are all upset and would rather not do business with Corbin. I hope he feels better "winning"
I get "VIP customer" sales robo calls from this company even though I haven't lived in the Boise area for many years and I have never owned nor shopped for an RV.

Sometimes the service can be a bit slow when it is busy but it is worth the wait. The ruby red chicken is delicious- it's our go to. The crown of broccoli and soups are also great. It's the best Chinese food in the Meridian area.

I have been coming here for about 4 months now. Each time there is less barbers and a longer wait. Today the manager didn't show up until 9:15am when the shop is supposed to open at 9am. We had to sit and wait 15 minutes for them to check the register and turn on all the TV's. If the business is supposed to open at 9am this means you are ready for business, not get there at 9am.

It's been a year and in the last week I've gotten a text message, a flyer in the mail, AND an email about how it's time for my tortoise's yearly checkup. I had told the office twice back when this situation happened to remove me from their patient list, as I wouldn't be back. In case my last review or those phone calls weren't clear, I won't be back. Stop sending me stuff.

Overpriced used clothing and the attitude of the owner and employee were just down right rude. I asked the owner a question and she acted snotty and put out. Was never acknowledged when I entered the store and when I asked for help with something, they acted out out. Will never return to this shop nor refer anyone to it.

Food was delicious!!! I would go here again. Service was very friendly but a bit slow. They were short staffed due to the pandemic. So I can not fault them for staff. Tempura and Chicken was delicious. The starter salad and miso soup came with the combination. The dressing on the salad was homemade and tasted great.

We had the worst service and the food wasn't that good either. 
We waited a month and decided to try it again, sorry to say, it was just as bad. 
We won't be going back.

The worst salon in all of Ada county - I set up all my bridesmaids and myself for pedicures and manicures/full sets/ and fills. Stevie wonder could have done my nails better. We paid 100plus and received a 8$ job. The techs were rude and all charged differently. Our appointments were at 12pm we didn't leave until 5pm we were and hour late to rehearsal. Two of the techs tools so long the girls missed out on their pedicures. My nails fell off 3 days later and my sister in laws were already lifting the day of. None of the techs knew how to paint a design or a straight line. One of my friends fingers were all painted and the tech told her don't worry it will come off sooner or later. We left furious I will never be back and save your self the trouble don't bother booking an appointment or even trying this salon you will be disappointed. I called when I got back from my honey moon and asked if they could make this right and the owner said there is nothing they can do. Good luck and hope this review helps.

Always friendly, reliable service and consistent quality.
Can't beat pizza when you just want the night off in the kitchen and bring a huge smile on my husband's lips!,

We typically get 4 toppings: salami, garlic, olives and shrooms. Simple and good!!

okay so I seen a big huge black spider and instantly knew I needed to call some one to come get these things. so having heard all the Comercial I call the guys. they answer the phone politely and promptly and assured me they could take care of the problem. I asked them about fogging the crawl space and she said no problem they would notated on the invoice. they set appointment between 3-5 and I told them that I wouldn't be there till 330 they said not a problem the would put that on the invoice. well he didn't call till 3:10 and said he got done early so he had came over and has waited as long as he could that I needed to reschedule. so the next day another tech came. when he got here I asked him if he was going to do crawl space first or at the end. he told me that they didn't do crawl spaces and only done around the edges of the house and base boards. this I told him was not what I was told when scheduled. he told me he is not responsible for what a call center tells me to get me to sign up. I further questioned him and then he told me that it was illegal to fog crawl spaces. Which is not true in idaho. so I told him he could leave and I would be using someone else.  long story short don't believe what the salesman on the phone says. go with someone local that you can trust to do it right the first time. read reviews and ask questions

As a loyal Les Schwab customer for nearly 20 years, I never had a bad experience until I went to the Eagle and Ustick store.

1.  Not long after they first opened this location I stopped in for a usual tire rotation and alignment check for one of our cars.  I dropped it off around 9:30 in the morning. There were only a few other cars in the bays and it was not busy.  The lady at the front desk said they would call when it was ready, no problem.  Around 4 in the afternoon that same day I still had not heard from them.  Finally around 4:30 PM I called and asked for a status update.  The individual told me that my car was ready to go and they "just forgot to call me".  Really?  When I picked it up I noticed that the alignment was not done, but I decided not to pursue that since they did not charge me for the work.  They must have "just forgot".

2. My wife's car wouldn't start one morning and it had to be jumped almost every time.  Assuming a battery problem, I drove it to this location since it was the most convenient to our house.  After a few minutes of waiting, the tech came out and told me that the battery was OK and it was most likely a starter issue.  We later took it to our mechanic, who found nothing wrong with the starter, but replaced the battery and it started up just fine.

3. My truck started making very loud groaning noises over rough roads and even small bumps.  Figuring that the shocks needed replacement, I took it in. Later they called me and said it was ready to be picked up.  When I drove it home I noticed that some of the noises had disappeared but that louder and more distinctive annoying sound was still evident, even with the new shocks installed.
So I took it back a week later to have it re-examined.  I ended up dropping it off late on a Friday because we were behind schedule.  This was a mistake on my part because by 6 PM they called me and said they wouldn't be able to get to it and asked if I could leave it overnight, which I obliged.  The next morning the tech called me and said that they "could not duplicate the noise".  When I asked them to try again, he called back a short time later with the same result. Unconvinced, I took it over to the Meridian Main Street store (where we had been regulars for years) and the tech there said that the ball bearings needed to be replaced.  The work was done and the noises went away when I picked it up.

4.  I decided to give this location one last chance and dropped the truck off for a tire rotation.  An hour later they called to say it was done.  When I stopped in to pick it up, the desk attendant said that my shocks were worn out and needed to be replaced.  I reminded him that I just had them replaced at their location a short time back.  In response he said, "oh well we can't really tell since they are darkened and appeared old."  That was the last straw.

It is sad to write this review because not only is this store so conveniently located, but I always believed that all Les Schwab Tire stores are created equal.  Based on these experiences at this location, this was definitely not the case.  Fortunately, the Meridian Main Street store has never disappointed and has always provided the award-winning quality service and trust that Les Schwab prides itself on.
Came in after work for a much needed fill. Nails look decent, however it was $36! Didn't have any special designs or anything, seems really high!

The food is amazing.  And I don't feel like I need to hit the gym for two hours after eating.  Dang healthy, and bursting with flavor.  Brown rice cooked perfectly.  Great customer service.  Got the two protein steak and orange chicken.  Excellent.  Egg roll cooked to perfection. Will be back many times.
Sad that this place is closed, they had great food, and when I drove the 140 miles to town, i would stop and eat. Is there anywhere in the area that serves something similar?

great party supplies and I usually have great service.. Today I was met by rude condescending sales associates at the front.   One lady needed help finding an item and was snapped at when she couldn't find the  item instead of helping her find it she said we are out.     another person was reprimanded  for not picking up their balloons on time.   The only nice person was the new cashier in training.
Don't,  just don't.  Flavorless and expensive.  I hope I don't get sick.  I would have been better off at McDonald's.

Best Tire Prices and people in the area. October 2017, at the Point S Tire store I was quoted over $100 more for a set of Nokian All Weather tires than at Discount Tire. The reason given was that they - Point S - do much more than sell and install tires. Well, I only wanted tires so...

I recently had to have a tire replaced because I had a nail to the sidewall. I had purchased the warranty when I bought the tires ($20/tire) so they ordered a new tire at no charge to me and installed one of their top of the line All Seasons to use 'till it came in. Always pleasant people - I definitely recommend them if you need TIRES and don't want to pay for other service you aren't shopping for.

Years and years of Gino's and never a fail!  A few noted the prices being a bit high.   When you cook with real ingredients... it costs more.   As a frequent traveler and one who has been to Italy numerous times- this is as good as it gets in Idaho!   My favorite story- Daughter at 8yrs old asked if their raviolis were as good as Chef Boyardee...  I said ask Gino!  As he walked passed the table and greeted us, I said my daughter has a question!  She asked and his reply-  I'm not sure...I've never tried them!  (With a smile and wink.)
Great food. Good portions. Good prices. Definitely try the pancake flight. Very good flavors.
This is some good, consistent Chinese food. They do a very good job on their noodle dishes. I always get quality when here. Service can be slightly slow but overall the food is good.

This "mom and pop" breakfast and lunch spot provides a good option for eats if you're in Meridian.  'Joe' is the same person as Joe Momma's in Eagle.  He is no longer part of that business (divorce settlement, I'm told) but for context of what to expect here, you can see the roots in 'neighborhood place' orientation and menu too. The food here is better, imho, than the other venture and the interior is brighter and there is somehow a feeling of more welcome for me by the staff here, so of the two this is my choice.

LOCATION & VIBE:  Tucked at the back of a Meridian strip mall, it's not visible from the main drag and a little hard to find on the first visit.  It is worth finding.

Bright space with high ceilings with exposed duct work in new industrial style space.  Big windows in the front and on one side.  Some booths line two walls, tables and chairs the other and still a few more tables and chairs down the middle of the room.  Enough space between them to avoid "sardine can seating" and room to navigate from tables to loo too.  I also love that when there is music it is barely noticeable and on some days, like today, there is no music.  Better yet for conversation to take center stage.

SERVICE:  Friendly and efficient.  Sometimes there are delays in food coming out of the kitchen, like today when the place was about 70% full on a weekday late morning.  But that seems to have to do with limited cooking staff not with any lack of attentiveness by the servers.  One (or two) cooks can only do so much at one time.  The servers clearly enjoy their work and have a lot of pride in the restaurant and want their customers, their guests, to be happy.

FOOD:  Garden Hash from the "Specialty Hashes" section of the menu, is a new-ish add and my current favorite.  It includes tender nuggets of roasted garlic cloves in enough quantity to repel a vampire - so you know if you want to ask at order for them to adjust quantity.  It is delicious with 'just so' freshly cooked fresh veggies including spinach, peppers, zucchini, mushrooms and artichoke hearts nestled on a bed of Joe's potatoes along with Swiss cheese and fresh avocado.

I'm normally a hash-browns-kinda-gal but Joe's style potatoes could make a me a convert.  Also worth noting the dish comes with two eggs of your choice and they get my "poached, hard like golf balls" just right every time.  (Harder to do than you think.).  The dish is ample enough size to expect to ask for a 'to go' box unless you're an Amazon-appetite-eater.

I also enjoy that Moe Joe's offers the opportunity for half orders of eggs Benedict (they have about half a dozen options on the menu) which is swell since I can never finish a whole order.  I'll also suggest if you order a Benny here that you ask for some lemon wedges on the side as in the vernacular of "different strokes for different palates" the hollandaise is much lighter on lemon than I prefer.

My husband likes the early bird breakfast offerings of a handful (or so) for $6.99 that is offered only until 9:00 a.m. (Tue - Fri) unless you are over 55 in which case it applies all day.   He's way old enough to take advantage of the all day time frame and he often chooses the pancake option from that menu.

Moe Joe's makes their own  biscuits and you can substitute a biscuit for toast with your order.  I recommend you do that.  And when they ask if you'd like Marionberry or strawberry jam, they bring it to you in a container, not in a sealed package.  Nice. 

Still, not all is perfect for me.

Coffee is just OK and since it is served from carafes, while one's cup is always kept filled by the really nice servers it is often warm not hot.

They don't have an option for real maple syrup.  I don't mind paying more for it.  I would like the option to order it.

The cinnamon rolls while homemade are a bit doughy and under-baked in two tries. 

But on the whole, I'm a fan.

VALUE:  Two breakfasts + two coffees = $25.00 "minus" for us most of the time.  Good value.

THIS N THAT:

1) PARKING:  Mostly more than ample in the strip mall lot except at peak breakfast hours on weekends.

2) ACCESSIBILITY:  Accessible parking (two spots laid out just right with one van accessible) in the lot.  Level in the door and throughout.  All seating is standard height.

3) ALLERGIC TO LONG WAITS?  Simple antidote is to avoid weekend breakfast hours.

Very good lunch today with my family. I had the guacamole bacon cheese burger with pepper jack and fries. Man it has been a long time since I have had a great burger. And the service was amazing. Our waitress brought us refills with out us asking.

Every time I've been I've thoroughly enjoyed the experience. The gnocchi, the veal saltimbocca, the lasagna, and if you want to spend a little more, the boar shank, are all incredibly prepared dishes. Five stars for the food alone. However, the service is also very attentive. My glass was never less than half full, empty plates were removed quickly and our server was knowledgeable and entertaining but not overbearing. Five stars for service. Overall, a great place.

Moe Joe's is on our breakfast joint rotation. The food here is pretty darned good. 

Breakfast:

The corned beef hash is superb. Crisp potatoes, loads of house made corned beef, onions and cheese topped with eggs perfectly cooked to order. The Smokehouse Hash is to die for with loads of sausage, bacon, mushrooms and cheese. It's almost too much.

The pancakes are the best I've ever had. Light, fluffy manhole covers of delight. The "Donut and a Cup of Joe" is two pancakes with a drizzle of glaze and a small cup of coffee flavored syrup stuck in the middle. Coma inducing. Toss in a side of ham and you have breakfast for a small third world village. 

Excellent chicken fried steak. Joe Momma's is still my Treasure Valley standard but this is a very good rendition.

The pork green chili sauce on the Huevos Rancheros doesn't really do it for me. 

Biscuits are good but Joe Momma's still wins out on that count. 

Lunch:
