My wife loves the Moe Joe's Club piled with chicken breast, ham and bacon. My favorite is the Prime Rib Dip which is loaded with thinly slice griddled prime rib and plenty of Swiss cheese to hold it together. It's accompanied by a tasty au jus. 

The french fries here are marvelous. Tender and crispy with plenty of seasoning salt and black pepper. If there's a downside, it's that they sometimes over season the fries and they come out too salty. 

Service is very friendly but sometimes the kitchen can be a little slow. All in all, this is a reliable place for a good meal.

COVID-19 Review:
Looking for a new breakfast option? This place is definitely worth trying. The food was delicious and the staff was very accommodating. I ordered the Blackened Salmon Hash, which was very good, a little bit on the adventurous side for breakfast but still really good. My girlfriend got The Farm House, that she really liked, and after trying a bite for myself, will definitely be the meal that I order next time. Both meals were a generous portion for a very reasonable price. If you're looking to order a mimosa with your meal, then you must try the Jalapeño Berry Mimosa! Overall I was very pleased with our visit, but I recommend sitting outside, as the inside of the restaurant was humid, kind of smoky, and we were bothered by flies until we moved to a table outside.

The Brooklyn pizza is to die for. If you like ricotta cheese, you will fall in love with this pizza. The crust is not too thin and very fluffy. I got the 8" and it was the perfect size. Unfortunately i wasn't able to bring home any leftovers since my plate was empty! I also shared a Mediterranean salad. It was a great compliment. I love the atmosphere and the service is always great. Cant wait to come back!

We had a really good meal at Tavern tonight. Almost all of us got the dip sandwich (I personally had the sweet potato fries as my side). Everything was very tasty, the service was good, and it's a nice, casual atmosphere. The only reason I'm giving 4 instead of 5 stars is they skimped on my fries (big time) in a previous to-go order during all the covid closures. If I were to order to go again, I'd just be sure to check the order. Overall good food and we'll be back.

River City Veterinary Hospital has such wonderful doctors and staff.  I have yet to be disappointed in any service we have received there. The staff is so friendly!  The facility is very clean and welcoming! We have our dog on the wellness plan there and it is perfect for pet care. I feel the cost for services are very comparable to other veterinary offices. But the service there is awesome! Thank you River City Vet!

BlindSource did a great job in our house. After buying our house, we decided to upgrade all the blinds. We have some tricky windows and BlindSource came up with some great solutions and resolved all of our unique requirements. They came back whenever we had a question and resolved everything for no extra charge. I would recommend them to everyone.

If you're going to use curbside service, plan on waiting... and waiting... and waiting at the curb.  My order was supposed to be out here over 20 minutes ago! If I hadn't already paid, I would leave and go to McDonalds.  Apparently you are required to call them when you get there. No where on the curb side sign does it state that. 40 minutes and they kept walking past me without saying a thing. 40 minutes my food sat in there getting cold. NEVER again!

Posh Nail Salon is awesome. Hailey is great she's very professional and friendly. She is genuinely interested in your ideas and your finished product.   I have been going to Hailey at Posh for a few months and I am very happy with everything she has done.  I had a pedicure for the first time Friday and Hailey wasn't available, the attention to detail was fantastic, my toes turned out perfect!
Thank you for a great new Nail Salon!!

All I wanted to do was to cancel my insurance because they are VERY expensive and they hardly pay for anything (except prescriptions).  I called Blue Cross and the rep gave me her name (Misty) and told me to send her an email with specific info about my insurance and she would cancel it.  The rep never followed through and Blue Cross took almost $1200 out of my bank account to pay for the next month's premium!  I sent an email to the rep and got an out of office message.  I contacted my agent and she was told by Blue Cross it would take 10 days to refund my premium!  Blue Cross is all about making money and will do everything they can to take all you've got!  We found another private service that charges only $200/month and I get personalized services.  Bye Blue Cross, it's not me...it's definitely YOU!

The Eye Site failed miserably to see the opportunity to attract a new customer. I called to ask if I could schedule an appointment to get my Silhouette frames adjusted. With COVID-19 running rampant, I didn't want to take a chance by showing up in case there were restrictions in place with the number of people allowed in the office.

The receptionist was in the process of scheduling me an appointment. She tried looking me up in their system, however, I explained that I had recently moved to the area, and I had not purchased the glasses or frames at their shop. She told me that because I had not purchased the glasses from them, I would have to pay $15 to make any adjustment to my glasses.

The fact that they are charging anything to make a minor adjustment to my frames is ridiculous. Then, I considered how much they charge for this adjustment which would probably take less than 10 minutes--highway robbery! So, when it comes to renewing my prescription in 6 months, I will remember how 'The Eye Site' wanted to nickel and dime me with the fee they charge to make a simple adjustment. I will be happy to spend more than $650 for a new pair of glasses and frames elsewhere. Buyer beware!

You can either wander aimlessly in the heat or wait over half an hour for them to take your life story and finally decide what you are worthy of being shown.  Complete waste of time.

p.s. I am aware that sales people have been trained to ask lots of questions.  I just wanted to see some trailers, not sit around waiting for eternity.  And what if I want to see one that Bish's hadn't deemed appropriate for me?  And why can't the sales people answer how much a specific model costs?  The paperwork can be handled later.  Bish's lost a sale.  We went directly to Dennis Dillon and were treated with professionalism and with respect for our time.

Our experience at Bish's in Meridian was exceptional, with all the help we received from our salesman Craig and our "walk through" with Marshall.  We're newbies to RV'ing, so the extra care was much appreciated!!!  Thank you, and we look forward to a continued positive relationship as we bring our RV in for winterizing and any necessary maintenance.
All the best, Jeff & Steph
Good food, good service, but a somewhat small menu and a little overpriced. It is worth a visit and I will be back.

Went on a Friday evening in the spring, and sat on the outside patio in view of the Village's fountains.  Made for a nice date night with my husband, as do most evening trips to the village in general. 

This is a chain that doesn't feel like a chain, and has really good pizza.  We got "The Don" with the addition of olives, and the meatballs were the best topping on the pizza, not that any of the toppings were bad, the meatballs were just really good.  

Service was ok.  Could have been better- and our waitress didn't really take any time to explain, answer questions or even tell us the specials.  While it was better than the eatery on the other side of the fountain (YB), it still cost them 1/2 a star. 

Would I come back- yep.  Would I bring people? Yep.  And that's ultimately what matters. 

The only reason it lost another 1/2 star was the lack of appetizers that we wanted to eat - but then, in theory, you have room for more pizza and desert- which we took home and wasn't worth the $6 extra (so skip it and head to another spot in the village if you need sweets).

When you have tables open you should set customers.. I've been to this place two or three times, they will have several tables open. They will not set you because your only two people not 4 or 6, I personally think that's ridiculous. 

I'll be at Bardenay's every time. They've got it figured out. 

Better food!

I contacted Idaho wood shed's via their website and received a prompt response with a quotation. I had a few questions as well as a specific request to have them build a shed that could match my house. They were able to accommodate all of my needs and had availability to complete the project in a timely manner. They even called me and were able to install it a few days ahead of schedule. The crew showed up on time and was respectful and courteous. This company is well ran and every process along the way you could tell you were in good hands. I highly recommend.

Shared breakfast with my husband.  Hash and French toast both yummy.  Would absolutely come back and recommend.  

Menu offers a lot of interesting choices.  Good enough to possibly revisit for breakfast tomorrow!
Yum, yum, yummy! Very friendly, great service. My coffee stayed full! The corned beef hash was fabulous. The eggs Benedict were great, can't wait to go back!!!

If you have some medical condition where your taste buds are hyper sensitive and anything that has any flavor leaves you in agony, then this is the place for you.  It's 5 ingredients assembled in a bowl, salad or tortilla and accompanied with a side of syrup or ranch.  

Wasn't enough Sriracha and soy sauce in the place to make it palatable.  Steamed vegetables, re-heated dry chicken and enough rice to choke a mule.  One of the worst meals I've ever had.  No wonder the place was empty.  If you like this food you need to reevaluate your life and try something outside of chain restaurants.

I love this place. It has everything a local bowling alley could offer. Booze, darts, bowling, pool, and food! And the best part? This place won't break the bank. Their costs are very reasonable...even down to the booze!!!

We usually go a few times a year and they are always packed but always able to accommodate us. They now have these awesome graphics for bowling where you can take a picture of yourself that shows up on the screen and when you bowl it randomly puts a fun clip art filter on your selfie. So much fun!!!

Seriously...check this place out for an alternative to downtown Boise.

Every experience here has been professional and they always update me on my car and things that need to be brought to my attention. 
A more recent experience has left me wanting to write this review.

Having gone above and beyond the last time I came in, they have my hooked as a long time customer now.
Standard Jack in the Box experience.  Convenient location being located adjoined to a gas station.  Been here several times, always consistent.  Friendly employees.

Came in for a refreshing juice in between shopping at the Village. Beautiful building. Fabulous menu. Lots of thought put in to I ingredients and so fresh! Tons of staff on hand. Great concept. 
I'm not sure what happened as it was empty...but the service was totally inattentive and cold. I think a delivery guy in front of me had an order, which we are all used to. 
But with just me and him and seven people on staff...to get a simple juice took over 10 minutes. What were they all doing?? Chatting amongst themselves?
Again, the place was empty.
When I finally got my 12.99 juice it was mostly ice and gone in 5 sips. 
This is a franchise with a great idea!!! Don't mess it up by not training your staff or gypping thirsty people. 
Note:  I also felt the warm vibe and intentions of wonderful things shared on the store walls, like a prayer jar!!! Wow!! But it didn't match the annoying peeps who were hired. 
The AC felt great...but the chilly vibe of snobbery I didn't enjoy. 
Just saying...as a business owner...customer service begins with a warm smile. Be kind. Be aware. Thank you customer. It's not high school. And for those reasons I'm out.
One of the best places in Boise and meridian to get sushi. Great service and food but you cant go on Monday.  They be closed. I keep trying but forget they are not open on mondays.

Went there for Mother's Day brunch. My daughter and I ordered crab eggs Benedict, and an order of a biscuit and gravy. The eggs were hard boiled not poached as they should be. I sent mine back. Got a second one and again the eggs were hard boiled. The biscuit and gravy were cold.  The server was great. 
If you have eggs Benedict on the menu you should know how to prepare them correctly. Very disappointing. Won't be back

Service was excellent (thanks Courtney) but food was nothing out of this world. We tried the WTF appetizer combo which gave us a taste of a few items. The Thai chili sauce was 8/10. Their signature sauce was 7/10. Nachos that came with the combo 5/10. 
We also got a Salad and soup combo 5/10. The tortilla soup was not my favorite...I've had wayyyy better. We gave it a try but not sure I will be coming back anytime soon.
Great quality, but insanely slow and overpriced. The one in the Village is better than the one in Eagle, which is like CRINGEY bad.

5 stars for the awesome food! The service was just ok but the hashes were unreal good. There was a bit of a wait on a Saturday morning as you'd expect. It's not a particularly intimate space so be prepared for noise. Just get a hash and enjoy
Rudy's has become my go to for some good food and friends. Generally sit at the bar staff is always friendly.
My dog Afton loves coming here! Daycare, exercise, grooming, and vet appt all in one day. They make it easy!

Do NOT bring your backyard chickens here. They do claim to treat chickens but they KNOW NOTHING about chickens. They totally screwed up the treatment of one of mine and I'm pretty upset about it. After spending around $800 on this chicken she ended up dying anyway. She had a swollen leg which we googled and looked to us like scaly leg mites. We brought her to the Vet because we are new to this and recognize we are not Drs and thought for sure they would know. She said nope I don't see any leg mites, just an infection, gave her antibiotics, the swelling got worse. We brought her back, another stronger round of antibiotics. The swelling got worse. Let's do a radiograph! What's another few hundred $?? Okay we did that. It showed nothing. One week later she dropped dead. And not only that, 2 of our other chickens dropped dead too! Had an experienced neighbor come look at the situation, sure enough, mites!! A Vet who claims to know ANYTHING about chickens should have been able to recognize a mite infestation, especially since they're visible to the naked eye and the chicken was brought in 3 times! Apparently it's extremely common and preventable, they should have known, 3 sweet young chickens wouldn't have had to die. I will never bring another animal here.

Good sushi restaurant with great service. My son and I have tried this restaurant out twice for sushi. Both times we were pleasantly greeted by the staff and sat down immediately. The service is super friendly, attentive and quick. 

The sushi is good and consistent.

Fujiama is by far the best sushi restaurant I've been to in Boise. My favorite used to be Sakana, but Fujiyama has now taken the top prize. If you ever get the chance, please try this place out the staff are fantastic the chefs are awesome and Sin the lead chef is amazing!!!

Best cabbage salad EVER! 
My friend ordered the Chicken Teriyaki lunch and it was cooked and great. Here's where the problem lies...I ordered the Chicken Yakitori and it came half cooked ( meaning STILL RAW)- the server set it down on the table with a measly little blue flame fire and told me to finish cooking it. What? 
The fire burned out- it was still raw when i looked inside the piece of Chicken. It terrifies me that some people would have eaten it uncooked and most likely would have become ill. 
I understand Sushi is raw but Chicken should never be raw. I will go back for more salad though.

I wish I could do zero stars. Since Obamacare, the mission of Blue Cross of Idaho has been to defraud their policy holders of benefits to which they are entitled. My most recent nightmare with them relates to durable medical equipment which per my policy is covered and "subject to deductible and co-pay". This means that if my deductible is met, and I need to replace my DME (which I do), I should only have to pay the co-pay amount which is 20%. How do they get out of paying that benefit? Why it's simple and a scam! You can no longer "purchase" DME. You have to "rent to own" the equipment over a period of 10 months. Here's how that works out for a regular Joe. Say you finally meet your deductible in November and your doctor says you need to get a new CPAP machine. You go to their authorized provider (there aren't very many) and you set up your "rent to own" scam paperwork. The cost of the equipment is about $800, so your first payment in December (20% of the cost over 10 months) is $16. That sounds great, right?!? I don't mind paying $16 a month for 10 months but that's NOT the deal. Oh no...not by a long shot. Your January payment rolls around and it is $80 so you call your provider and say "WTF!" (or maybe you're a little more polite). Then it gets explained to you that Hey, it's a new year and a new deductible so your benefit no longer applies. You now have 9 months of payments at $80 a month. So this equipment, which you need to stay alive and is supposed to be covered by your policy now becomes nearly 100% your financial responsibility. IT"S A SCAM! The only way BCI would ever fully meet their obligation on this benefit is if you satisfied your deductible in January. I know some people do, but most of us don't and that is why BCI sets it up this way. If you have ANY other choice, take it!

Given how packed this place usually is, I was expecting a rather tasty meal.  What a disappointment.  Had the Tavern Carne Asada Ensalada--the "Wagyu" beef was tough, overcooked and flavorless.  Very little roasted corn, and the lettuce was mostly stalk instead of leaf.  The menu itself was uninspiring, with half of it burgers.  Their website says happy hour is 3 - 6, but it's actually 4 - 6.  Doesn't really matter, as there was nothing on that menu that I wanted to try.  Having been to the Owyhee Tavern (same owners I believe) recently, which was very good, was expecting a similar experience.  Nope.
Great dinner loved the experience. But, get there early or you will have a long wait.

I have an issue with the value of what you get for your money at this particular location. 

We ordered a 2-scoop cone - and got gigantic, classic-shaped scoops of ice cream.  
We also ordered a 2-scoop sundae.  The photo on the menu of the sundae shows large scoops over and above the rim of the cup.  The scoops I was given were so tiny, like the size of a golf ball.  I asked the girl if these were the same scoops as the ones on the cone and she said no, that they use "sundae scoops" .... which apparently are about 1/4 of the size of the cone scoops.  I'm sorry, but the amount of hot fudge, whipped cream, nuts and cherry do not make up for the small amount of ice cream you are giving up when getting a sundae instead of a cone.

I submitted for a punch on my punch card that I received at the Eagle Island location and noticed that this location is not listed on it.  So, perhaps they have a different owner because I've never had an issue with size/value-for-the-money at that location.
I don't typically go to this location, just happened to be in the area.  I wouldn't make an effort to return, and if I had to, I guess I'm not getting a sundae, that's for sure.

(I'm not allowed to post a photo from their website showing the 2-scoop sundae, but if you go to their website https://order.baskinrobbins.com/menu/sundaes/generic and scroll down to the photo of the 2-scoop sundae, you'll see what I'm talking about.)
All I can say is yum!!!!!!! Love this place, the beach club is my favorite.

This is without question the worst Subway I have ever been to. One person working?? While there is a lobby, drivethru, and delivery going??? Who owns this place??? Insanity. Needless to say, instead of waiting 40 minutes for a sub full of what appeared to be brown lettuce, slimy lukewarm meat, and freezer-burned veggies, I just drove down to John Smith's Subs who had three industrious people working, delivery drivers coming and going rapidly, and I got a real sandwich in no time.
I love Grimaldi's Pizzeria especially on your birthday. You can get a free 16" pizza (dine in only). Love their crust. Great atmosphere and customer service is great.

This is my favorite location and it is not the closest one to my house! They make the perfect peach green tea and angel breve. The kids who work there are friendly and super fast. I do feel bad for them sometimes because it seems like this location is extra tiny compared to the newer ones and they seem packed in there like happy little sardines. Remodel coming soon?

we came in and told the server that we had a movie at 9 PM and they said OK then 45 minutes ago by and all we had got was a pizza and a salad. We then reminded the waiter that we had a movie and he went back to talk to the people to hurry up the pizza he then came back to our table and told us that the pizza would take another 40 minutes and that they hadn't even put it in yet because there are too many to go orders. While we were sitting there not one to go order had come in and picked up the pizza. Then after the whole situation the waiter ( who was a nice guy ) came back and told us that he couldn't  take care of our salad and drinks then we asked to speak to the manager about the situation so the manager came out and she was super rude and had a nasty look on her face and said that we could just leave in a very nonchalant tone and was overall very rude. we have come here multiple times before but never has the service been this bad if I could give you zero stars I would. I do not recommend

I normally never post about an experience, today was disappointing.  My husband and I have been coming here since they opened in Meridian and have nothing but great service and food.  Today was horrible 

The bartender was overwhelmed and could not keep up with the drinks and the customers at the bar

Ordered the Benedict which is normally great.  As it was delivered to me the waitress laughed and said the eggs are there they just fell off.  It looked like soup. 

Not sure we will be back

They built the shed, so low it would not open. The door hit the patio it was next to. The employees accepted a healthy tip without a word that I couldn't enter the shed. The owner said he would fix it. A couple weeks and several phone calls later they do. They give me a bill for the "fix!" The lack of responsibility seemed childish to me. I own a business and would never behave this way. I was offended. Don't be surprised. Nice shed inside I see now.

I love Idaho Pizza Company because their pizza is just a little bit different than the traditional "chain" pizza places. Their prices are subsequently a bit more than other places. However, the best deal is the $5.99 all you can eat pizza and soda lunch buffet. They usually have about 10 pizzas on the buffet at a time. My only complaint with this is that 95% of the pizzas on the buffet are more of the gourmet type...chicken and garlic, barbeque, spicy chicken, etc. It's like pulling teeth to get them to make a traditional cheese, hawaiian or pepperoni pizza. You'd think that they would make more of the traditional pizzas since they cost a lot less and they are always gone from the buffet as soon as they put them out. But, maybe someday they'll learn...

We waited behind one car in the pharmacy drive thru for over 25 mins and sat on hold for 13 mins to get ahold of someone to help as our car was blocked by 2 cars behind us at this point. Awful service and a lack of care that this is a drive thru not a sit and wait line.

This was our first time at Tavern at Eagle Island.  We arrived at 5:30 on a Thursday.  The restaurant was busy, we were told there would be a 25 minute wait...we waited 15 minutes and we were seated.  We had the Brussel Sprout appetizer, the Blue Cheese Chicken Salad and the Thai Chicken Salad.  Everything was really good. The chicken had really good flavor and was tender.  The rest of the items in the salads were very fresh.  The portion was just right for a meal salad. Our server John was very helpful with recommendations and was attentive through out the meal.  Prices were reasonable.  The only negative I would say is because the restaurant is small the noise level is fairly high when it is full of people.  We will definitely be back!
Save your pet and yourself heart ache.....don't use them! All about the money....could careless about the pets.

I posted this review under the Garden City Fred Meyer and I also wanted to include this one since it was involved!!


I came in to get a bike that they have on sale in their ad but they don't have them in stock and Tim in sporting goods came and helped me and was willing to check the back and he even started calling nearby stores to see if they had them in stock and while he was calling I myself started calling stores and when I called The store on Chinden and Linder The guy that answered the phone was rude and seemed annoyed that I called him and he told me he didn't know what bike I was talking about because he doesn't know what's in the ad I told him it was a men's cruiser and again he acted annoyed that he would have to go and look shame on you guy at the linder store if you don't want to help people you should get another job and way to go TIM for going above and beyond to help the customer
So even though the Garden City store didn't have it but I still give them five stars to where I give the guy at the Linder store One star only because it won't allow me to do zero stars

I really don't want to write a bad review during this time, but this is the third time in a row that this location has messed up my order ridiculously. I ordered a Beach Club unwich and received a turkey sandwich on french bread with no avocado. The last two times I haven't had avocado, and have had to eat the sandwich like a salad because the lettuce wrap was practically shreds. Slow down, brush up on customer service and make things right.

The quality of service has massively decreased since ownership has changed and the old staff was discharged.  This last time, after pulling down a bottle of wine from the wall and handing it to be corked, the waitress forgot to bring it back for 30 minutes leaving me sitting there with my date. I literally had to go find her and it still took another 10 minutes before a different staffer brought the bottle over. Next, the waitress forgot to put in our food orders and we had to remind yet another staffer of our order as she disappeared into the ether.  He advised us that only one order had gone in and my date's order arrived long before mine.  The food was average and somewhat cold.  We were told we would be comped the final price of wine and ten bucks off the food, but it appeared on our bill anyway.  This was on a very slow night with about 5 tables going.

This is the second time something like this happened. The previous time it took me actually going back behind the bar and bringing the the same waitress referenced earlier over to pour me a glass to get served.  At times the staff just vanishes going God knows where.  It is as if no one working at Divine presently has actually worked at a restaurant or a bar before.  I'm not a huge stickler, but this is literally some of the worst service I've ever had anywhere.  If I didn't know better, I'd say the new owner is getting ready to sell the place or close up shop altogether.

Divine used to be a great place to get a drink on Friday nights, but I won't be back. It's over.

One star is too high for this establishment. Originally my wife and I went to Bedrosian's since we had used them in other states and were very pleased with the product and service. Little did we know that in Boise, they are only a wholesaler. We were given a list of places we could order their tile, Great Floors being one and closest to our home. We placed an order (which took over an hour for some reason) being promised our tile would show up on a given day, which was a couple days before our project was to start. On the day our order was to be in, I called Great Floors in the morning and they had no idea where our tile was. It took all day for them to tell us Bedrosian's didn't have it in yet. The next day I had to leave town so the associate at Great Floors called my wife and informed her the tile had "arrived". Well it had arrived at Bedrosian's, not Great Floors. My wife was told she'd have to go pick up the tile at Bedrosian's because it would be a couple days before it would be delivered to Great Floors. So my problem with Great Floors is they lie. The original salesman ensured us the tile would arrive on the day we chose, which it didn't. If we wait for it to actually come to Great Floors, it'll be 4 days late so his "promise" was way off. Also, my wife felt the associate on the phone talked down to her and was rude. While we will eventually get the tile we ordered, in my opinion this is a very unprofessional establishment.

We love breakfast at Moe Joe's.  From the terrific food to the terrific service to the reasonable prices and nice atmosphere you cannot go wrong, and you won't leave hungry as their portions are generous!
This is the BEST Burger in town. The Roasted Sirloin soup is amazing. They just need Boo Koo Beer on tap and it would be perfect.

They are my favorite solid surface supplier.  We have had a great working relationship with them for years now, and appreciate how well they take of our customers.  They have a large inventory and it is nice to be able to look at all the different slabs.  Keep up the great work!

I recently built a new home and had Blindsource do my window coverings. Their price was really fair. They met me onsite to pick out the color and pattern of the roller shades. They had the brand name I wanted, Hunter.  We walked through each room of the house and discussed the covering needs of each. They didn't try to convince me to put coverings on Windows that didn't need it. When it came to the install their installers were quick, polite, and well trained. I haven't had any issues and I don't have any complaints about the process.  My expectations were exceeded and would highly recommend them!!

This morning my mom and I decided we wanted to find a new breakfast spot. So we hopped on yelp and Moe Joes was the first place to pop up & look promising. It did not disappoint! I had the Irish eggs benedict. It included house made corned beef hash, perfectly poached eggs and hollandaise sauce.  The breakfast potatoes on the side were everything I could ask for in a breakfast potato. We split a pancake and opted to try the maple espresso syrup and it is pretty great. If they sold it at the grocery store I'd be buying it. Everything was served pipping hot, and I couldn't spot a speck of dirt or grime anywhere in the restaurant. Definitely a fan and will be back! (:
Hey Red Pavilion!  We love you so much, but please, please remember to  put hot mustard, soy sauce and fortune cookies in the to go bags!  I will give you another star or more if you do.
Garlic sauce chicken was delicious!  Light and tasty with perfect portions!  Got it to go so I can't say much about the service but the food was amazing!
Not what it used to be. Customer service is awful. Won't be coming back. Better options in town.

Ordered a little John but got this Vegetarian sandwich, I received no receipt from the confused old lady  , and the schlep behind the sandwich counter looking like he was doing recreational Mary Jane handed me the sandwich, and was oblivious that I had paid for Chips. Seriously SMFH..I always buy my sandwiches here and have them delivered to my office but this shit is ridiculous. I am actually waiting for the sandwich and can't get it right.
Michael added floor recepticle, hungvery heavy mirror, outside garden hose (2) holder, 2 outside shelves.  I'm having him back!!

So delicious and clean!  I got the Cabo fish tacos with Rumbi rice. The fish in the tacos was perfectly cooked and seasoned and the rice has a great flavor and is really creamy and rich from the coconut milk!   They also have a selection of hot sauces and sriracha which is always a huge plus cuz I can't live without sriracha! The bathrooms are super clean and smell great. I'll definitely be a repeat customer here.

Horrible... horrible... horrible. The communication is lacking at this store. I checked in and the two workers on duty continued working with two other customers. I understood that I needed to wait... but after an hour and 40 minutes, I'm done. I'm reconsidering AT&T as a whole... because whenever I need service, they waste an entire afternoon and sometimes never get the job done.

Food was great, tables were clean, disappointed in the drink fountain and ice area it was filthy, told two employees about it and was brushed off without a response even when I went back and purchased bottled beverages instead of using the fountain dispenser,,, disappointing but it's kinda gross.
My wife and I ordered online and picked up iness than a minute! The food is tasty and delicious! Can't wait to make this our regular place from now on!

It takes a LOT for me to be impressed by a salon, but Canvas Salon leaves me smiling every time.

For starters, this is one of the cutest salons I've ever seen. It's newly renovated, super chic, and it has everything you could possibly imagine. A complimentary drink of choice before I'm seated? Don't mind if I do! Purse hooks? Awesome! Relaxing loungers while you wait for your toner to set? Yes, please!

Everything from the talent the stylists have to the music they play to the dedicated 'after' photoshoot you get helps set this salon from any other I've been to.

I definitely recommend following them on IG to see which stylist suits your personal style the best. They have gals that are amazing extensions, color correcting, going to extremes (ex. Platinum blonde), and providing Victoria Secret bombshell-inspired curls. If you've ever wanted hair you've seen on IG, these gals can make it happen.

I previously gave this spa a 5 star review over a year ago, however the customer service there has tanked significantly. I went in with a friend for a pedicure: the man who did my service was rude and seemed annoyed to be working there. He put his phone on a stool next to him and turned on a YouTube video, blasting some show in a foreign language.  I thought this was my appointment, not his lunch break.  The video was loud and irritating to me. Never even asked what pedicure service I wanted, just did the basics with no massage to speak of, which is my favorite part. He slapped some lotion on my legs but I don't consider that a massage. When it came time to scrub my feet he pulled out a bottle of Ajax dishwashing soap and used that to scrub my skin! I expect if I am paying for a service they should use products that are made for skin, at the very least, not some cheap dish soap they picked up at the dollar store. And they made a big show downstairs of putting on plastic covers in the pedi bowl for sanitation but we were taken upstairs and there was no plastic covers anywhere. This place is not worth your money.

WOW!!!!  I had to start out by saying that.

Moe Joe's has it all.  I had the shrimp and grits and got a corned beef hash bowl (to go).  The food was perfectly cooked (the corned beef literally dissolves in your mouth), large portions for great prices.  Tasha, our server, was a beautiful breath of fresh air.  Huge, friendly smile!!!

Also, one thing that was very clear to me right off was that the entire restaurant was immaculate.  So important!!!

Try this place.  2 things are for sure... you will be glad you came and you will be back.

Love, love,love this  place!  We have a 9 month old black lab who is full of energy!  She was so happy & tired when we picked her up from her free 1/2 day after her interview.  We then boarded her for 2 weeks & she came home happy & healthy.  I took her again today so I could go to the dr & do some Christmas shopping.  Just picked up 1 very tired happy dog. She gets her exercise & I can get my chores down without having to crate her at home.  


Our black lab is no longer a puppy -- she's 3 years old now and still going to Camp Bow Wow.  We can no longer say those words in our house because she literally jumps in the air -- all 4 legs off the ground at once.   She loves playing with her friends.    Did you know dogs have friends?  They take such good care of our Daisy.  She's exhausted when she gets home but content.  

We recommend Camp Bow Wow often.

My new favorite go-to take out and delivery. The first time we ordered the food was delivered hot with generous portions and reasonable pricing within 12 minutes! The second was a take out order with equal promptness. Food quality has been consistent. The egg rolls are the best we've had locally, and the entrees were very tasty with good balance of quality cuts of protein and vegetable variety. We're definitely planning to order again.
Vonnie is a wonderful massage therapist! You won't regret booking an appointment with her to simply de-stress and relax!

This experience seemed to have a good start.  The thing is I really didn't realize what I was signing up for.   They had put me into a contract, one that I didn't even sign.  The signature showing on the pages they later showed me is not my signature and I had never seen the pages before.  I cannot believe how much time I have wasted, my valuable time.   I signed for a background check and payment authorization from what I understood.  PUTTING A FALSE SIGNATURE ON A CONTRACT IS ILLEGAL.  After I cancelled(before meeting anyone), pretty much right away, they said since I said the first match can call me, they said that counts as an introduction, and I will have to pay off the full balance.   No one explained this process to me nor did they tell me I was in some kind of a contract.  I have already paid them $300 upfront, which is more than enough for the small amount of time with me, they put what I didn't realize was a loan into collections.   STAY FAR FROM THIS COMPANY!  I am going to talk with a lawyer and work to get this off my credit and report this company for fradulant behavior.  Save your time and meet someone out and about, at work, through a friend...etc.

I went back to give this restaurant a second chance and was really impressed with improvements across the board.  The food was delicious and the service was much improved.  I plan on going back soon.  Updating rating from 3 to 4 stars.

We love Los Betos, but you need to know what you're in for. If you want fabric napkins and perfectly put together plates, this is not your place. If you want big portions of Americanized Tex-Mex and good flavors, you should check it out. We consistently get chimichangas and burritos that fill us up (or make for leftovers) for the whole family. They have ah-mazing pico de gallo and hot sauce that pleases that avid hot sauce person in our family. The drive thru option is fantastic right now, and we've never not been happy with our order. Also, two words: breakfast burritos. Amazing. Give this place a try next time you need a quick Mexican food fix - it is leaps and bounds better than the establishment they share a parking lot with.
The staff appeared to truly care about my dog and his daycare experience.  So friendly, caring and very clean facility!

We were looking forward to trying Shige. We had heard good things but were really disappointed. We ordered via Door Dash and got the food fairly quickly. Our salads were inedible and looked several days old, the soups were barely half full. Nothing tasted very fresh, which isn't what you're hoping for with sushi. We love to support local, but we were really bummed and won't be back.

We ordered from this location  through Uber eats our food came completely cold. Red Robin delayed the order on top of it we couldn't even eat our food how dry it was never ordering again from this place.

Great experience buying my trailer! We have bought at least 5 trailers over the last 30 years.
Best experience was at Bish's!

We've used them a few times.  They were the  only ones willing to clean just 2 rooms and not charge for the whole house.  We moved into a brand new house and our dog had an "accident" (stupid dog) in my wife's office.  We called and they were out within the hour and it came right out.  Sean also recommended a product for pet stains and it worked great the next time the stupid dog left us a present.  He's got a customer for life.  Anyone want a stupid dog?

Wow, what a waste of time and 21K. I purchased a used 2021 Jayco 183 RB trailer from Bish's on October 11, 2021. It has been a few little things and now the slide will not open and close we have since had to cancel two camping reservations and the trailer is in need of what could be a significant service. We didn't get t use this trailer once. 

Diamond club is a waste of time, you get a call center that can't tell you the time let alone assist with any issues. service after the sale has been non existent with a every attempt unsuccessful. 

Dealers that are willing to sell garbage will continue to do so. They will clearly sell you a trailer that have not taken the care to properly ensure works properly. If they sold me crap, they will do the same to you.

Food looked amazing, wait staff were all pretty friendly, place is super cute looking, food was absolutely amazing! Delicious! Potatoes were perfectly cooked and everything was seasoned perfect. They also have good coffee and the water tasted filtered. Perfect experience.

Really delicious food served by attentive, friendly people who are super accommodating. The hash bowls are outstanding -- especially the blackened salmon hash bowl. Some of the best biscuits and gravy I've had in a restaurant. I haven't tried much else on the menu because I love the blackened salmon, but one of my companions raves about the omelettes.

First time here and it has been one of my favorite biscuit and gravy dishes I've ever had. Wow it was so delicious. I bookmarked this spot because I'll definitely be back! You have to try The Farmer breakfast with over medium eggs! I'll be back!
Submitted an appeal to which the medical provider submitted zero/no response. Of course they side with the medical provider. Cancelling my policy forever with these spineless cowards.

Found this Corner cafe while traveling thru Boise.  Lucky me.  The food and service is top drawer.  Great selection for breakfast and the coffee is delicious. So good I had to get a refill for the road.

Gino's is no longer in Downtown Boise, and is therefore dead to me.  

There is no way in hell I will drive into the suburban depths of Meridian to eat at this restaurant.  The food is good, but not that good.

Made the decision "Gino's or Asiago's tonight?" a lot easier... Asiago's FTW!

I came to JB's Restaurant for work. I had the JB big salad with chicken and it was fine not great but not bad a normal salad. They do have a buffet here that actually looked half way decent. My other patrons got burgers and chicken tenders and they looked pretty good. Overall, the service was good and the food was decent and may go back for breakfast cause the people across from us got breakfast for dinner and it looked good.

Went to their soft opening. Restore located right next to Zuppas. Beautiful inside, clean, bright. Staff is exceptional & friendly. 
My husband had a session of Cryogenic Full Body Bath. You go into this stand up pod and it fills up with cold air. This cryogenic bath helps with inflammation and helps your skin to produce more collagen.
My session was a PBM (aka Red Light Therapy). You stand in between two slabs of red lights. Completely safe to look at. Warms up a light. Helps with insomnia, sex drive, mental clarity. I was in there for 12 minutes...you get a bit warm, not sweaty like if you say in a dry sauna. 
My daughter, husband and I did the Stretch!! OMG...it was amazing. Before doing the stretch with Jeff, I was having lower back pain. After 15 minutes with Jeff - my lower back pain gone. Felt absolutely terrific. Normally when my back is hurting I head to my chiropractor but after stretch at Restore with Jeff - I may not be going back to chiropractor. And the stretch is affordable $39 for 30 minutes...can't beat that price. 
Restore Hyper Wellness has compression sessions, IV Drip (liquid vitamins), hyperbaric chamber, cryo body & facials, cryogenic bath, Infrared Sauna, PBM and so much more. 
The staff & nurses are all certified. 
I 100% recommend you try them out. You won't be disappointed!!

Gino's is a hidden gem. I've never had a bad meal here. The staff is always professional. The meals are prepared with care and they use quality ingredients. There's always a wonderful special on the menu. The place usually fills up so we try and go early.

I can't believe that I spent $6.25 on ONE PIECE OF THIN TOAST with a smear of avocado and 1/3 of a boiled egg. If I would've known that it was only one small piece of thin toast for that price, I would've surely purchased something else. You can continue to try and justify their outrageous prices and portion sizes by saying that it's all clean ingredients, but that's nonsense. They need to keep searching for the appropriate line between their "clean ingredients" and a normal, rational portion size and price. Next!

Dr. Ennis and his staff are definitely 5 stars in my book! I went for my first visit today to transfer my care, and he spent about 35 minutes thoroughly going over my file, asking great questions, and making sure I understood everything. He made sure I had all of my questions answered. I feel so much better about my condition, being in his care.

Went there for breakfast when we first moved to town.  The service was prompt, the food was good, and it was affordable.  The only reason I didn't give if 5 stars was it was a long wait and they didn't come out and call a groups name so they skipped over them because of it.  Otherwise for us, all went smoothly.

I was really surprised with how good their food was! I looked at the menu and had no idea what to get so I picked a burger. My boyfriend and I were skeptical about the pineapple on our burgers but it was amazing!!!!! Definitely one of the best burgers we have had.

This is the 3rd time I've called for pickup and was told it would be 35-45 minutes. Showed up after the expected time to be told it was just going into the oven. As I wait I see customer after customer experience the same thing. 
I've lived here my whole life and grew up coming here. Always been great. The influx of out of staters and COVID may factor in but better expectations should be set.

Wow. We really should have considered before giving this place another shot.

An hour and twenty minutes later....

They delivered food that is not even close to Asian, never mind being edible. The salad was smothered in ranch (ranch from an Asian restaurant?!), and what was supposed to be mandarin chicken was a deep fried meat (not sure it was chicken) with a disgusting side of syrup. 

The egg rolls were three inches wide and one bite didn't even help to determine the ingredients, just the fact that it was a greasy mess. 

The fried shrimp were disgusting and finding the shrimp in the mess of fried batter was nearly impossible.

The "soft noodles" that we apparently paid extra for were greasy but the only thing we ate more than two bites of.

This was one of the worst take outs and waste of money places we have tried sadly.

Absolutely worth the wait.  I was riding through town and stopped here on my way out.  It was crowded so I knew I made a good decision.  Staff was friendly and recommended the Farm House.  I had my eggs over easy, with the potatoes.  It was fantastic.  From the biscuit up to the gravy everything was perfect.  The portions were huge too. I'll definitely be back next time I'm in town.

Decided to drop by after reading the glowing review in The Statesman.  The good--it's a teriyaki place.  Nice to have another spot with relatively healthy and tasty options.  The place has kind of a cool vibe to it.  The not as good--they seem to be struggling with the crowds.  No one answered their phone at all despite multiple attempts, it was a 25 minute wait for walk ups when I visited during the lunch hour, and my take-out order online was a few minutes late.  The just ok--food was fine but I was expecting some kind of unique flair.  My entree was fine, but I can think of a couple similar, local chains I'd probably prefer.  

It's nice to have another healthy option.  I'd go back when it calms down a bit, but I won't be rushing in for a return visit.

We have had a lot of problems with Francini's in Meridian. 

We wanted marble countertops in our kitchen, but we were concerned about staining and scratching. The Francini's salesperson assured us that quartzite was stronger than granite and unlike marble, quartzite was more resistant to water and scratching. It was also a lot more expensive than marble. We purchased two beautiful slabs of Tahiti quartzite that look just like marble for our fabricator to cut, treat, and install as countertops.

After installation, we noticed the staining almost immediately. The countertops were soaking up water like a sponge. Splatter from the kitchen sink, or steam from opening the dishwasher door after a cycle would lead to big gray stains on the countertops. It looked terrible, but thankfully it was just water. We contacted Francini's and they told us that it was natural stone and it could be porous. They suggested treating it again. The fabricator treated it a second time. The fabricator told us that they had never seen quartzite that was as porous as ours. It behaved like marble.

Francini refused to help us because they offer no warranty on natural stone. They recommended a third company to come in to poultice most of the existing stains and to apply their proprietary finish to the countertops, but Francini's refused to pick up any of the costs associated with this. The third company also did some scratch repair on the countertop because our countertops scratch very easily, like marble. They encouraged us to contact Francini's because our countertops weren't behaving like normal quartzite. 

I asked Francini's for documentation about our slabs because they behave like marble. They said they don't have that documentation because materials vary by lot and by where they come from on the hill. 

I asked Francini's to split the costs of the additional treatments I had to have done on the countertops right after installation. They refused because they offer no warranty on natural stone.

Francini's does not stand behind their natural stone products.
Love this little place. The butternut squash ravioli is heaven on a plate. Staff is generally nice and attentive.

Seriously people! Stop going to this place. They don't care about you or getting your order correct. Don't give them your money and your business. 

Ordered to go. Got home and no burrito. Drove 20 mins back. Got "a" burrito. They gave me all bean. I paid for steak. This is the third time this has happened and clearly they and the franchise owners don't give a crap. 

The only way they will actually give good service is if we all stop going there. Could they suck any worse?? Not really! And they ripped me off...bean for steak?? Really??

Costa Vida you suck!

I stopped by here on their third day of operation. I don't think I'll be coming back... their coffee was good I'll give them that... but the ambiance was not what I would recommend for anyone that's not a super athletic and hip. 

The flies in the establishment drove me crazy. They have a pull up wall that is rather cool, but there is no fan to keep the flies out. 

It was "random" give away day. I was there 30 minutes and we didn't get anything, which is fine, but every (literlly) person in there got something except me and this other larger person. When asked it was completely random. Then the next skinny person got a branded item and not the other fella or I... right in front of us. Almost as if they don't want us to represent the brand. I decided to stay a few and contine watching and 12 additional skinny people got stuff and not the other heavy person that came in. In fact, there was no hi... how are you... nothing. Wasn't event invited back. 

I'll stick to Dutch bros who helps the community and provides excellent service to everyone.

We were staying in the area and thought we would check this place out for "happy hour". It was great and we went back several nights. My husband loved the fish tacos. My favorite was the beef skewers - so tender and juicy. The well drinks were priced right and the beer was cold. We will be back!

Hubby & I went for lunch yesterday. Slow service. I ordered the French Dip and it was not very good I hate to say. The meat was kind of thick and had a lot of gristle. The fries were really good. Hubby had a chicken salad and that was pretty good. 

The bar seemed fun. I would go for drinks and appetizers but I was really disappointed with my sandwich.

I know they just opened not too long ago so maybe they're still working on things.

Absolutely the worst experience in a restaurant my family has ever had. My adult son rated it the worst pizza he had ever had. Our meal started with dirty water glass. Our bread dishes were both dirty with someone's else's food on them. Waited almost an hour for one pizza. Taste like a frozen pizza. I think the toppings are put on after it's cooked. Spoke to the Manager who didn't seem at all concerned. My wife watch a waiter picked up trash on the floor and never change their gloves. Please support other restaurant that deserve your money. I didn't feel the management care if I spent my time in the hospital from COVID 19. Please have a safe night and take these negative reviews seriously I wish I did.

During this crazy time of RV sales, I was fortunate to stumble onto Bish's RV of Meridian during my search for a Jayco Jayfeather. After contacting them through their online inquiry form, I was introduced to Mark Carter via email response. Mark is courteous, professional, and hardworking. This was my first time going out of state for a vehicle, so I had some anxieties around the situation (I'm located in CA). Even though I wasn't quite ready at the time, Mark still spent his time to go over the process and my options so that I would be well-informed and comfortable when I was ready.

Once I was ready, Mark and I discussed my deal on a build-to-order unit direct from the Jayco and I put down our deposit to get the order going. Unfortunately, Jayco (and other manufacturers) eventually hit major supply chain delays. This pushed my expected delivery out by 2-3 months. With limited options, my wife and I were ready to cancel.

Fortunately, we found a similar floorplan produced by Sunset Trail that was at a Bish's located in Lincoln, NE. Mark and team offered to transport it to their dealership if we wanted the unit. We decided that we wanted the unit and we proceeded with the deal.

The entire process from beginning to end was smooth despite issues outside of their control. Everything was incredibly simple. I couldn't ask for more!

Thank you to Mark and the Bish's staff for a great experience!

I love this Los Betos! They're much friendlier than the one down on Fairview, they'll take the time to explain about menu items so that they make sure that you get just what you want. They offer suggestions occasionally and I love that because then I know what's good. 

The drive-thru is kind of weird here, you got to go all the way around the building before you get to the window. There's a sign in the window that I just love that says your food is guaranteed to be good but if you bring it back after you've eaten too much then they aren't going to give you a refund or make you something else because if you've eaten that much it must not have been that bad LMBO!!

$2 tacos all the way for late-night munchies! They're so quick and so filling. I could never eat more than two and I'm stuffed and I have a good appetite. Enjoy!

I want to love Dutch Bros but I just can't.
I can't complain about anything free for me, even if it's now restricted to a small that they didn't even have to give me apparently, because I don't get most apps so they can't glean ALL my personal info for maybe a free drink once a year.
& I choose not to make a deal out of being young & foolish & making inappropriate jokes (he'll learn over time & I don't feel the need to parent anyone else today),

but my daughter paid $3.75 for a small iced caramelizer that used to cost $3 & it was 3/4 ice today!
$3.75 for a few ounces of coffee drink.
No one asked if she wanted it iced or blended either, or if either of us wanted whipped cream, & it's partly her own fault for not advocating for herself because she did think of it, so hopefully it will help her speak up next time.

But such things are part of the reason why I don't  frequent overpriced coffee/drink stands of any brand, in general. Besides my caffeine oversensitivity lol. But there are plenty of low or no caffeine options & I still go rarely (once a year or maybe twice) because it's just not worth it.
I value living a basic life where I don't need or even want much besides God's agape love through Christ, prayerfully the unmerited love of others, and basic food & shelter & clothing.
I am abundantly blessed so I'm being gracious with 3 stars.
Absolutely favorite breakfast place. Great food, massive portions, reasonable price, and wonderful service!
Really good breakfast! Servers are kind and attentive. Good coffee! I haven't tried them for lunch but sure enjoy their morning meals! I recommend.

We were shopping for a Christmas tree last minute and weren't sure if there were any left. David in the paint department checked for us, and sure enough there was one lonely tree left and one tree stand left with a block of ice in it. He gave us a deal we couldn't refuse, cut the base of the tree, and hammered out the block of ice in the tree stand for us. He made our Christmas and went above and beyond customer service. We hope he has a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year. God bless you and your family David.
Last time I was there they had a very affordable buffet for under $10. It was a Sunday and we only had to wait 10mins. Food was great, service was wonderful.

Fantastic experience. Me and my girlfriend loved this place, we've gone a few times and it is well worth it. We haven't fried the party times yet but the show and presentation of the sushi, soup, and tea is fabulous. The hot tea has been perfect each time and is one of the best teas we've had in America. And the sushi is fantastic, the seaweed isn't too tight or chewy, it definitely tastes fresh from the vegetables to the meats. The rice isn't over or undercooked and I know I said it once but the presentation of the rolls just says it all. 
P.s. get the eel sauce

I stoped by at 11:45 on October 3rd to order a couple taco and was told they were closed by the woman who was working...I was very upset because I live right around the corner and come to this jack in the box quite a but...I work at a resteraunt and I get off very late as well so not only was this inconvenient but I happen to know that you are not supposed to close until you are officially closed! Thanks but no thanks and I will no longer be spending my money on this location if this is how customers are treated.

I was visiting Idaho this week and decided to search for a local massage therapist. I came across Blissful Massage owned by Vonnie. I have had hundreds of massages and she was amazing. I could immediately tell how much passion she had for helping people. Her personality was very calming and her massage was one of the best I have ever had. I highly recommend visiting her in Meridian, ID.
Their California burritos are the bomb. Try them! You will enjoy it just as I do. My dad would always buy this for me.

Just moved in and wanted to get the carpets cleaned before furniture arrived. We called and set up an appointment 72 hours in advance and they were able to fit us in. With a fair quote and availability, I went with Valley Carpet Care. Sean arrived before scheduled, set up and started right away. When finished, he charged me less than originally quoted. With fast service, quality work and a great price, I definitely recommend this company and will use them in future! Thanks Sean!

I normally start with the food first... but let me tell you how amazing Shelby is. Literally one of the best servers of my entire life. She was fun, helpful, bubbly and a superb server. I am in from out of town and next time I come back this will be the first stop for sure! 

Now to the food... the family ordered a good variety, breakfast burrito, eggs Benedict, garden hash, Idaho  potato nachos and more that we didn't get pictures of. The wife ordered the jalapeño berry mimosa which was awesome! 

I highly recommend hitting this spot for sure. Tip Shelby extra and tell her to keep up the good work!

Great service and they were transparent about the wait time as the food is made to order. We had the Mad Spicy chicken & orange Chicken bowls with veggies and noodles. Heavy on noodles.  Knowing this on our second visit we used the convenient app & ordered an extra side of chicken and veggies. I am not a lover of the bird but I love this chicken..so tender and the sauce is tasty and is not too heavy or sweet which is common with teriyaki.  The veggies were crisp and tasty..I happen to love the cabbage and glad there were not big chunks of carrots. I didn't need to drink a gallon of water or worry about garlic breath after my meal.  We walked away satisfied but not too full. We used the app which made it much easier and got a BOGO on the bowl.  If you want to eat there get there by 5pm. It's very busy and located at the busy Chinden/Linder intersection. We will be back to try other dishes.

The BESTTT sushi spot in Idaho. Their tempura is to die for, I would eat here everyday if I could. Friendly employees and most experienced, authentic sushi chefs! I love all their food and I recommend this to all the sushi lovers.

I love this place. I go there for lunch often and the garlic fries with campfire sauce are so yummy! I also love the fish. They have a lite menu also and I enjoy the burger wrapped in lettuce with avocado. I prefer sitting in the bar area. It is actually quieter and the staff there is super attentive and always friendly.

TERRIBLE TERRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE!!!! 

Drove out of my way for this restaurant because a friend of mine that lives in the area recommended it so I was excited to try this place. 

On there website doesn't say anything about NEEDING a reservation on the weekend. We came in on Saturday night and they basically implied we needed to have a reservation for the evening. Then said well we have a few tables and can probably seat you in 5 minutes. 

I have two young children a 1 year old and a 3 year old and they only could seat us at high top table. When waking back to the high top table I look and see normal table available. Basically told me that weekend is hard with reservations and they could only give me this table. 

There booster seats don't have straps and they don't have high chairs high enough so basically I had to risk my children getting hurt or falling to sit at the high top table. They couldn't adjust anything to try to seat us at a normal table (the many I saw open) and give one of the people that had just adults in their party a high top table? 

Terrible service and no help in accommodation. Guess this business doesn't want my business. I'll be sure to let all my friends with kids know they don't like to work with you and your situation with kids and aren't a kid friendly restaurant since that's they way they were acting. 

Won't be back!

i went there for true first time.  i just moved from renting a guest house that had chickens and mice and i found out my dogs were getting bitten from mites so i fled.  apparently they had invaded my belongings when the owner got rid of chickens and poisoned the mice.  i got attacked and went twice to emergency where they finally put me on ivermectin.   i went to ads for a follow up where the doctor didn't even scrape my skin or diagnose me.   he said not to scratch and charged me $79. if you saw my arms you might think i had leprocy.  i now found out i am healing from rickettsiapox.  an infection from these mites. my home has been identified with them and is being fumigated. this doctor didn't care or listen.   i will NEVER refer anyone to them. i also won't pay them.

My favorite Chinese restaurant in the Boise/Meridian area! So many yummy options, great portion sizes, lots of seating so you never have to wait long, and the food is just as good if you call in and order to go.

Kasey was a joy to work with. My dad and I walked away with two new phones and I personally went along with the package deal for a wireless charger, a case, and a screen protector for my S10 5G. 

It's a quiet, clean store; the specialists were are kind and happy to assist. Kasey also went the extra mile to help me conform to my new phone as I'm departing from the contentious land of the iPhone Battery BS+...

Even if you're not sure what moves you want to make for a new phone, I recommend coming here and asking questions as our experience was pleasant and informative.

Give Kasey a raise, or at least a hug and a high five.

Took a couple friends to Los Betos for breakfast burritos on the way to the lake this morning.  We ordered 3 breakfast burritos and the woman taking our order and serving us at the window was VERY rude!  She only got the first 2 orders to begin with.  I made sure she added the 3rd burrito.  However,  when we got home EVERY burrito we ordered was WRONG!  
It's not too hard to mess up... One bacon, one sausage, and one breakfast burrito with NO meat.  Very disappointed because we were bragging to our friends how huge and delicious their burritos were.

We called around and a spay costs $175 - $250. We were told by your place that $250 was the very high end of being charged. As you can see on the invoice I have attached, we were charged $437.52. This feels like price gouging.

Amazing service until it wasn't. They misdiagnosed a car I was going to buy or thinking of buying. Turned out the car needed thousands of dollars of work underneath from front to back. Ruben, the guy that inspected it said it just might need some struts and shocks because they were original and 3 new tires, but it turns out that it needed absolutely everything plus a fouth Tire. This was found by the tech that pulled it in to fix the struts and shocks. I would have never bought this car if he had not misdiagnosed vehicle. I'm still waiting for them to take off struts and shocks and tires off my bill. They come to me for a lot of things and a lot of work, but they need to comp me the rest of the way because this is 100% not my fault. I have been a customer for well over 20 years and my family as well, and I feel like they should stand by their motto " Doing the right thing since 1952." I'm still waiting to hear back from corporate headquarters about the rest of a refund. Hopefully this will be resolved without me having to take them to court.

I put my 2019 Reflection 297 on Consignment at Uncharted Recreation. Jacob assisted us. They did a wonderful job communicating with us as offers came in.  In less an 3 weeks and during the COVID-19 lockdown, our trailer sold and we received our price. 

Thank you to one of the owners Rob, for being truthful and having a great staff.   You have my recommendation.

This is apology for how unattractive my review behavior was previously when I was hangry.  And I'm going to use this to mention a don't-miss-it seasonal pizza that will be off the menu in March because sometimes one regrets not having had the advance chance to know of fleeting delicious things.  Read on. Prego.

FIrst the apology.  Look at me stomping my review feet last Fall when I discovered for the first time that Grimaldi's re-stokes their coal fired pizza oven in afternoons daily and so no pizza can be ordered after 4:00 or served before 5:30.  Daily.  I was perturbed that the first world sort of problem was only learned by me after we went in the door at 4:00 hungry with pizza on our radar and unable to order it.

Now I know better the OOS oven hours to put this in perspective.  I mean I had it in perspective before.  The lesson is don't write reviews when hangry. 

So this is a 'do-over" review given we have been in Grimaldi's twice in the last two months to enjoy delightful mid-afternoon service (thank you Connor) before the ovens shut down.  And on this most recent visit was also the happy discovery that Tuesday is half off bottles of wine day so we could order a full bottle for less than the price of two glasses.  We got to sip wine (no, we didn't drink it all, we left some for our server to enjoy post shift) and enjoy the warm space on a cold winter day while we listened to the "old Italian neighborhood" classic songs from Sinatra, Dino, Sammy et al to which my old Brooklyn - Italian husband knows every word (and with which I would sing along had the wine bottle been finished).

But we came for the Seasonal Special pizza - Onions Braised in Red Wine, Italian Sausage, Fresh Basil and Mozzarella.  It was one of the tastiest pizzas enjoyed during  five years of Boise area living.  As high praise I suggest this was a pizza that could make Tony's Pizzeria Teatro (arguably the best in the Valley) proud if it came out of that oven.  Perfetto all around for just enough toppings and not too much and just right crust finish with just right coal oven char.

Is there a new manager in charge of the kitchen or was it just good fortune to have the seasonal pizza perfecly done on that day?  We may need to try it again before it departs the menu in March to find out.  It is one to put on your "to eat" list too, I think.  And as tip - leftover slices taken home hold and heat well but have no fewer calories as leftovers than if you ate it all there. 

A reason to leave room while there for 
dessert is the cannolli which is filled just before being delivered to the table and very good here - the best of any in the Boise area based on our 'research' - and is nicely shareable by two with a Illy Americano.  

But if I could change one thing, I would move this concept-chain eatery out of The Village so parking and getting to the door was easier.  Village Parking is a bear. The darned parking problems are the only reason besides the numbers on the bathroom scale that we don't go to Grimaldi's more often.  

PS - Grimaldi's now has a liquor license to expand beyond wine and beer and a full bar will likely be launched sometime in Spring.  See what you can learn if your all the way through a long review?

Not going to replace other Teriyaki places I like to go to in town. But, it's fine, and close to work. I'm sure the wait time for food will get better as the initial flood of folks from opening cools down.

Save yourself the frustration and just go to a different location. 
I used the online pick up order tool on their website and everything went smoothing from choosing my pick up location to adding my balloons to my cart. Where I ran into the issue was at the curbside pickup. When at the online check out it prompts you to pick your location and time of pick up ( so I picked the soonest pick up time , 2hrs). I drive to the store at my designated pick up time, pull into the parking lot , call the pick up number & the employee on the phone can't find my order in their system ..... She proceeds to tell me she needs to put me on hold to find my order. I wait on hold for a couple minutes...... still can't find my order . She asks me if it could be under another name , I answer no. I sit and wait a little longer in silence and I proceed to tell her I ordered online 2hrs ago and I sit and wait for her response. It takes her a minute to find it but then she responded with "oh um we didn't get to your order". Which in all honesty , I think someone wasn't doing their job and didn't  check their computer system for incoming online orders. ( I mean they had 2 hrs to fill a couple of balloons). The employee assured me they would fill my order as quickly as possible. I ended up sitting in the parking lot for 35 minutes while they filled my balloon order. It is super irritating when someone makes a mistake and doesn't apologize or even try to make it right in any way. I'm not asking for free balloons but when you spend $60 on a balloon order you'd think they're would at least say sorry for the inconvenience on their part. Super annoying.

All I can say is the place is AMAZINGLY AWESOME!! Great food and good portions. I saw this place on the local news as one of the best places for breakfast in the Treasure Valley and it did not disappoint!!!
The food was amazing!I go to this restaurant with my friends every weekend.My girlfriend told me this is her favorite.It is highly recommended

I refuse to even give this place 1 single star, I only am because it won't let continue without its. They have the worst customer service and are always rude. There are only the 2 employees (husband and wife) and could care less if they lose business. Today is the first time I've been there where I actually had a wait and it was only because someone had made an appointment. I simply asked how much longer it would be before I could get in for a pedicure and the man threw a fit. Started throwing things and told me that I didn't make an appointment so I had to wait and he didn't care how long. I got my daughter and left. He's honestly lucky I paid for the horrible toe nail painting job he did on her toes.

My favorite breakfast place in the Boise/Meridian area. I always get the eggs Benedict. Servers are always super friendly and accommodating. The only downside is the actual restaurant is smaller in size so seating can be limited and wait times are longer but the food is always worth the wait!
Very nice drinks and calamari appetizer along with great seafood pasta meal for my wife and I had pizza.  It was all fantastic.  Service and ambiance is very nice and we will be back.
Worth the drive from Boise. Had the skinny egg and it was amazing. It was served with avocado, tomato and toast. The toast has an amazing berry jam. I also highly recommend their Mimosa.
I love that they offer salmon. The sauce was very good and the veggies were not soggy. The ability to place an order through mobile app was easy and convenient.

The only bad thing about this place is that I went there with my ex who's a major tool but the food is great I enjoyed steam clams good glass of red wine and the view of all the beautiful people was amazing excellent customer service can't complain about anything except for my ex who is a major tool

Really friendly and attentive staff in a nice atmosphere.  Pies are great as well, I do recommend. The only negative is it takes a really long time to get food, like literally 1 hour from order to eating.  So go, but be prepared to wait a while,

I recently boarded my dog there for the first time as my usual place was booked.  I was pleased with the friendliness of the staff and found the facility to be pleasant and clean.  I was very clear when I booked her stay that she was dog aggressive and could not be trusted to be  near any other dogs. Amanda assured me that they do board dogs with this issue.  When I arrived at the time frame I called the day before to confirm, they were not quite prepared with a suite for her and a staff member referred to her as "mildly dog aggressive", when talking to another staff member. Of course this was concerning to me and I again made it clear about her behavior towards other dogs.  After this discussion, I felt every effort was made to assure me that every precaution would be in place for the safety of all concerned. A.J. in particular spent as much time as I needed and asked me to share helpful tips with him regarding her play and general personality traits. I would hope this feed back would be taken to make improvements in communication among staff and preparedness. I called many times while I was out of town during her 5 day stay, and was pleased with the staffs helpfulness in getting an update of how she was doing.  All in all, I would recommend River City to anyone in need of a dog boarding facility.

Stopped in for a tasty breakfast the other day since I hadn't been in awhile and was pleasantly surprised that the menus had been updated with many new selections..I noticed the highlighted Blackened Salmon Eggs Benedict with Capers. The sauce was awesomely delicious with Moe Joe potatoes as well as my Rye toast with the Marion Berry Jelly..Hope to visit again soon for another Blackened Salmon Benedict, it tasted so good.

Blue Cross of Idaho exemplifies the worst of hypocrisy and TERRIBLE coverage.   

Preexisting conditions may be a requirement to cover under the law, but, from my personal experience, BC Idaho will nevertheless stiff you on vitally needed RX medication for the condition if they deem it too costly....without regard for the pain, suffering or well-being of the member.    So the condition is resultantly not covered!         

Blue Cross of Idaho is also doing away with their PPO plan for individuals (those who don't belong to group plans, but must instead buy from the "marketplace") effective Jan 2017, creating a barrier to any direct specialist access, since often hard-to-obtain referrals will now be required.   In fact, BC Idaho members were sent a patronizing newsletter last month telling us how ignorant we are for not realizing that all medical care should go through a primary care doctor first!   

All the more insulting, since my own primary doctor wouldn't accept this plan to begin with.   

When calling Blue Cross of Idaho for customer service help to obtain urgently needed medication for a severe pre-cancerous condition, I was ignored for days, then told the doctor's request for the medication (which I've taken for years) -- supported by the requisite pre-authorization forms -- was likely "fraud" related, and would require a special investigation by a Blue Cross of Idaho fraud investigator.    Over three weeks later, the medication, which has no "formulary" equivalent and must be taken daily, remains denied!        

Only a shameful, disgraceful insurer would berate a member for being sick and needing healthcare.   Yet this same company has the gall to advertise its alleged concern and advocacy for the well-being of customers.  

If you're healthy, don't need to see specialists, and don't need costly medication for serious medical problems, Blue Cross of Idaho will gladly take your money.
