But when you're sick and need the coverage you're paying for, you'll find, as I have, that you're left to rot, and treated horribly by this miserable company...which operates like something out of the Third Reich.     

Try the Regence Blue Shield for much better customer service.  I believe they offer health plans throughout the entire state of Idaho now, including keeping the PPO (direct specialist access) plan for individuals that Blue Cross of Idaho is dropping.    

Blue Cross of Idaho is a disgrace!

I am still searching for a descent Chinese restaurant in Idaho.  Although this is not an authentic one, I would give it a 3.5 star rating, if I could, and here is what I think.

Service is friendly without a doubt.  The furniture seem to be old but it's fine.  When I looked at the menu, I was in doubt if I was at the right place for some descent food.

On the menu, there is a section days "Cantonese Specials.". They are mostly Southern Chinese cuisine including Cantonese.  They are confused with "low mein" and "chow mein.". In Cantonese, "lo mein" is the soft noodles and "chow mein" is the pan fried noodles usually comes with gravey.  (In Mandarin, chow mein is the soft fried noodles).  On the menu, you can see pan fried noodles under description of chow mein and also under one of the lo mein dishes.

On the back of the menu, it is "American Dishes.". It has steaks, fries, salad, sandwiches, and etc.  Made me think of those restaurants called "Chinese Thai restaurant.". Not a bad idea especially if there are people (specifically little ones) in your group who may not like other cuisine.  I am not sure how good they will be, but here is some options.

If you want to order any vegetable dishes, there  are almost none.  Every dish is cooked with meat and vegetables.

I ordered a Mongolian Beef and spent an extra dollar to upgrade to fried rice.  The portion is huge.  I think the fried rice itself world stuff me.  The fried rice was authentic Cantonese fried rice and tastes pretty good (a bit on salty side but I don't usually eat lots of salt, so it may be ok for most of the people).  Mongolian Beef is not authentic but tastes good.  Mongolian beef usually is cooked with lots of green onions and bamboo shoot slices.  But this dish has EVERYTHING.  Water chestnut, onion, celery, cabbage, bean sprouts, carrots, bamboo shoots and mushroom in addition to beef.  The sauce doesn't taste like Mongolian beef, but it tastes good for whatever it should be otherwise named.  Think of this way, my mother doesn't cook named dishes everyday, sometimes she would just stir fried something and make her own dishes.  I guess this is like that.

I love Boba drinks, so I had to order a red bean smoothy with Boba.  Surprisingly, not too bad at all.

Well, if you would like to taste what you expected on specific dish, you may be disappointed.  But if you are here for some Chinese food that somehow taste descent, this may not be bad one.  At least, it is better than a couple of Chinese buffet I have tried in town.

My wife was raised Italian eating homemade meals by her grandma who immigrated from northern Italy along with her father and she loves this place. I was not raised Italian and love this place. Everything tastes fresh and homemade, apparently they don't make their own pasta in house but just about everything else.

Slow service and waitresses were clueless. Had them run outside to chase me down to pay while my husband was standing at the cash register to pay. They said they didn't realize we were together. I guess they have random people sit together all the time and place their drink orders together?? Also the chefs could not keep up with the boats, table orders, and take out orders. Granted, they were busy telling the waitresses what to do next so they couldn't stay focused. Watched a couple wait ten minutes to pay for their dinner. They were only able to pay after the chef instructed a waitress to take care of it. Overall bad experience and won't be back.

We had great dinner at Grimaldi's last night. I invited my sister and brother's family but did not have reservation (Friday evening). We did not have to wait long and they could sit all 11 of us in comfortable long table. The interior is nice, wine bottles lights and New York pictures on the walls.  We ordered all 3 different large pizzas, red sauce, white garlic, and pesto. All were DELICIOUS!!! 3 large (18") were perfectly enough for all of us, 6 adults, 4 youths, 1 teenager.  We will come back.

I did a 7 month stint in Meridian for work and this was my spot. Every two weeks on the gel mani and every four on a regular pedi. I love the folks that work here and they were always SO NICE and funny. Prices are oh so reasonable and they have one of those loyalty cards. You know, after so many visits you get $10 off. 

When I moved this was not the first place I tried, but this was the only place I found that would soak off my gel by wrapping my nails in foil not make me stick my whole hand in a bowl of acetone. Oh, and they always do my eyebrows and lip waxing and aren't afraid to tell me when I need it if I am trying to skip...gotta love the honesty of a good beautician. 

Whenever I move I get antsy over having to find a new nail and hair spot and it's going to be hard to find a place in WA as awesome as Awesome Nails!

PS - wish they accepted AMEX (I like to rack up those points). You can't have everything though...can you?
Always great service and delicious food! The Noo Noo Noodles and the War Wonton Soup are my favorites! I swear if you don't feel well it's like medicine for the body and soul!

Enjoy there pizza and the atmosphere of outside with the water show. But the last two visits have been disappointing. Both times the bar tender was our waiter and waiting 12min to get acknowledged while people who sat after us and were already ordering is a problem. After 50min we finally got our food. When we got the check the bartender/waiter told us when we were seated did they tell us of the deal on mondays?? We looked at him and were like you seated us... he forgot and was like that's right well when you see the check it looks weird because of the deal... my fiancé almost NEVER looks at the bill but glad he did. The waiter over charged us $10 instead of what we ordered. When we mentioned it he looked at us like he was caught and didn't know what to do. My fiancé made it know to him that no one likes to be cheated and that he should really pay attention to what he is doing... kinda shocked in fact that he never offered to change our bill all he did was apologize...!! I was upset my fiancé still paid the bill even though it was wrong but he just wanted to be free of the restaurant since we felt like hostages for the last hour and twenty minutes, For one medium pizza.

oh my heck!! great Italian food and fantastic service...start with this garlic heavy oil dip with soft homemade bread, perfectly light breaded calamari to amazing food...we have Shrimp Maria, Spaghetti Bolognaise, a pizza and Shrimp pasta Gambara...all were amazing and service by Tyler made it a great evening!  me new Italian spot.

They didn't include half of my order when it was placed for delivery.  I'm disgusted by the wait staff tonight who all should be fired.  They suck and should be charged for theft of services.  Fuck you staff.

0/10 for service tonight

So this is one of those little hole in the wall places that has a line every weekend morning to get in to. And it's good. Definitely have had better food & experiences elsewhere. 

My experience ... went in during the week for a late breakfast so it wasn't very busy. 6 tables maybe. We had to ask for silverware. We had to ask for water. We had to flag the waitress down to give her our order. Food was good but certainly wasn't something I'm going to rave about either in taste or size. 
Would I go again? Probably. If you're buying, sure. :)

The guy who did my nails was extremely rude and my nails look horrible. And to top it all off they charged me $30 for a fill when the sign clearly said $15 for a fill. I really wanted to give this place a chance but I am definitely never going back.

When Red Pavilion opened in mid 2016, a little over two years ago, it was connected in ownership to a Chinese food eatery with the same name in Mountain Home.  At the time my husband and I thought this Meridian location was by far the best Chinese food in the Treasure Valley.  We had multiple meals here, lunch and dinner, by ourselves and with others to share them

Roughly a year-plus-ish into operation, while the restaurant names stayed the same the two eateries now had separate owners.  And sometime in the last 8 months-ish the food quality, service and maintenance at this Meridian restaurant have all taken a turn to downward trajectory.  Our last 3 meals in that time have moved from marginal, to poor to downright unacceptable when we were there a couple of months ago with friends in tow at lunch.  It was so bad an experience we said we would be hard pressed to go back.  And we have not.

Every place can have a bad day.  But three is a trend in the wrong direction.  Updating the review is overdue.  They lost our business for lukewarm food, not only with too much oil (which has always been their challenge to fix here in particular for noodle dishes) but drowning in sauce and served by people who seemed indifferent.  Not to mention the entire place seems in need of a good spiffing-up.

Can this BE the same restaurant we liked so much once upon a time?

Love the location!! So close to my home. I wish their patio was a bit more shaded, and the wait is usually really long, but great place nonetheless. I do also hope they get a bit more variety in the menu, maybe specials.

Absolutely the best breakfast I have had out at a dining establishment in a while. I travel and eat out many times a month ... This place has it all going right. Great service, friendly staff, amazing coffee, the best pancake since my moms. I saw the other breakfast items going by and thought, "wow they have a great breakfast menu" I highly recommend this establishment! Way to go!

Such a great little bar and grill. Service was friendly and efficient. Wait time for food was reasonable. My husband and I ordered chips and salsa for an appetizer. Nothing too special, chips just a bit stale and a basic salsa. Presentation was good though. 
We both ordered burgers and fries. Fries were HOT with a crispy outside and a soft inside. Burgers were so good. Juicy beef, soft bun that wasn't soggy, and plenty of toppings. 
We will be back!

Perfect meal in a perfect outdoor venue.  Staff was great, food was really special, and we'll look forward to Boise just for breakfast here.

Our only complaint is the 111 hour drive to get there.

Couldn't imagine anything they could do better.

Whatever you do, do NOT order DELIVERY!! After going through postmates due to the other delivery service being closed, we ordered three separate meals of the triple-double entree meal, (6 entrees), and only received 1 of the 3 separate orders. After contacting the driver and postmates, the lady preparing orders at the door claimed the driver was extremely late while shooing him out the door assuring everything was there (lol). Could have been a bad day but to take advantage of a delivery company while also only including a small portion of the $100 meal is not okay in my book.
We had a large order with a wide variety. It was ALL amazing.  We definitely will return.

Poor service. Had a table of 11 people which I get it not a small table. Yet we asked 4 times with 4 different employees to get us more fries that are supposed to be endless but apparently not for us. Had a milkshake get ordered, was over 30 minutes later we had to ask again before it got to us. Waited well over half an hour just to get our check. Very disappointed. Will not return.
Our waiter Kolbey was amazing! He understood the meanu and was able to help us with our decision on a keto friendly meal and drink. We will be back to see him again.

Been here 3 times over the last year and it was disgusting every time. I used to love this place which is why I kept telling myself it was what I ordered. Last night my boyfriend got the lasagna and I had the ziti. The sausage tasted so bad in both. It was like eating a can of Chef Boyardee but with the grossest meat ever. We were both up all night with heartburn and stomach aches. Never again. Don't let a big sticker price make you think you are eating quality. Sick.

Went here little over a month ago. My friend had had a little baby and this was my meet and greet with tiny Brody lol.

We were supposed to go somewhere else but ended up here and glad that happened. This place was fantastic! 

I thought because of the yawwwwwn, the viRUs! that going to a restaurant would suck, be depressing, but nah, this place was great. My first experience there was a 5 star one for sure.

The food was tasty af! I had a salad, not too shocking. I'm super picky to begin with and salad is what I usually get, but glad I tried theirs. It was one of the best. The chicken too was actually tasty and tasted like chicken rather than some processed crap like the chicken I had at Buffalo Wild Wings lol.

Our waiter, wish I could remember his name. Older gent, was the waiter we all need to have a great experience. He was on top of everything. He made sure my friends drinks were always topped off and always made sure I had fresh water....yeah, I'm a boring date lol. This wasn't a date though haha! But I don't drink ..usually lol.

He made sure our food was good and cooked right. He was great with my friends kids. He was just a great guy. He kinda reminded me of a waiter you'd get in a super nice restaurant. Yeah, I've been to a few...probably had chicken every time too or pasta lol. 
Anyway, we all have been to super nice restaurants and the waiters and waitresses are always super attentive vs regular restaurants where yeah they're usually nice, but let's be honest, most only care about that $crilla! How much tip they're gonna get haha! 
Those restaurants where they're super attentive and seem to be genuinely interested in you, what you want, and just all around seem to love their job. 
That was this guy! He was awesome. 

He deserves a promotion!

Aside from that, prices were great, friends loved their alcoholic beverages and all loved the waiter and the food.

Place is super clean. Had giant TVs all over with the game on for all those who actually still watch football hahaa! 

In the area? Try it out! It's a great place. You'll love it.

Cheers!

When I say I searched long and hard for a decent Chinese restaurant in Boise, I mean pretty much my entire life. Growing up in the area, I've tried numerous eateries, with many of them never coming across my mind a second time. However, Red Pavilion will remain in my memory box for anytime I'm craving Chinese food that won't churn my stomach with grease.

After the electricity went out during a rainstorm, rendering our kitchen useless, my husband and I stopped in Red Pavilion. It was just one of the first places that came into mind that I'd been wanting to try. Never big eaters, we shared a plate of Hunan Pork Street Fry (tender pork strips wok tossed in Szechuan chili sauce, $10.95) served with a size of white rice. 

The meal was excellent. The pork was well seasoned, very flavorful as were the veggies. It was just the right amount of spicy to add a satisfying kick but not leave my tongue begging for mercy. Also, the serving size was plenty! One plate filled my husband and mine's tummies for the night. 

Other great aspects were the cleanliness of the entire establishment (squeaky clean), the speedy, kind waitress (deserved a great tip) and the complimentary chips before dinner (YUM!). Even though I only tried one dish I feel that Red Pavilion definitely earned this 5 star rating! Going back with a friend next week to try some more goodies.

I used "Crazy Frog" and they were apparently bought out by Terminix and I continued with them for a year.  

I would not recommend Terminix  to anyone.  They do not notify you that they are coming, or if they are there ( I was home and no one said they were applying anything). they included two photos with their summary and you can see 2 cars in the driveway.  

You have no idea what they are using or what they are treating for.  I have a dog and when "Crazy Frog" was doing the quarterly treatments, they let me know when they would be there, knocked on the door when they arrived, explained what they were apply and allowed me time to get the dog inside. I get no return anything from this company when you get a hold of them.  

I have Terminated Terminix.

This was such a fun relaxing atmosphere, I'm traveling from out of town and it made me feel like I was in a home town cafe with big plate options, I got the loaded hashbrowns and it was incredible! The waitstaff was attentive and knew the menu front and back she gave great recommendations and I really appreciated that! The prices were very reasonable for the portions we received.

Have eaten there ~10 times. Food and service always very good. But, if you are looking for a covid concerned place this isn't it. Staff only use masks if/when near customers. Even then not consistent. Manager never had his up. Guess he thinks nobody notices if he's in the back. If manager won't lead by example no one else will care.

Used to love this place growing up. Went back after a few years and I'll drive the extra distance to Cafe Rio from now on. This has happened 2 times in the row, the first time I gave them the benefit of the doubt but after the second time I'll never go back. Very stingy with their portions inside my enchiladas and I got a side salad that was literally 3 bites. The horchata tasted like glycol. I used to always defend this place but Cafe Rio is far better.
One of the best Sushi places I have had in Boise ! The Godzilla and calamari is super delicious. The ambiance inside the restaurant is super chill and relaxing.

Wife and I went there for lunch and really enjoyed the meal.  Clams were tasty and Brussel sprouts were too.  Brussel sprouts could have been done a little more, but still really good.  I had the special which was Halibut fish and chips.  Excellent, fish and chips.  Good selection of whiskey.
We love the crew at Paramount Animal Care. Our dog loves to go visit there. They are friendly and welcoming. They communicate wonderfully. They have taken care of all of pet needs urgent and yearly.
Best breakfast spot in the valley! The food is phenomenal and their customer service and staff is among the best I have experienced!

Excellent breakfast!  The Smokehouse hash bowl was delicious. Perfectly cooked eggs and potatoes. Don't know the sausage brand, but yummy. Generous portions. Friendly staff, good coffee. Heartedly recommend trying this restaurant.

While visiting the area during our house hunting, we came here on our first night in. 

First impression was that they keep this place clean! Which is always a plus that shows that the employees/managers take pride in their place of business.

Upon sitting down, we requested to be moved to another booth to be able to see the Monday night football game easier. Without hesitation or resiliency, they bussed another table and got us re-situated, awesome! Then we were greeted with two baskets of tasty popcorn to keep us occupied while looking through the menu. We had the pleasure of meeting Kyle who would be our server. Great, funny guy, good with adults and great with kids, if possible, I would recommend him to be your server.

The table decided to share a basket of the garlic fries which definitely supplied enough for four people. We indulged on their margarita Monday's and they did not disappoint!

We all collectively chose wings and some of the sticky fingers. We explored the honey habanero, Tennessee rub, original awesome, tai chili, and teriyaki and all flavors satisfied!

Overall great service, great food, great drinks. Overall very happy with our decision to try this place out!
Wow -  excited to see I use to drive and hour to eat in Ontario- there breakfast is awesome there pastrami is awesome by far best sandwich  shop I've ever been to - PS breakfast is awesome

My boyfriend and I went there last night after being told it had the best calzone's. We were greeted by a great wait staff who told us there was about an hour and a half wait, which we were okay with. We got there at 8:30 and the place looked full. It was a shame that the best food served was the bread and house salad before our entrees. I ordered the Lasagna which was awful. I have never not finished a plate of food because of taste. My boyfriend had a meat lover's calzone (not exact on the name) and it too was not great. A calzone is supposed to be super cheesy but there was not enough cheese and everything kept falling out. Not to mention the marinara was ice cold. I understand that it is supposed to be served at room temp but the sauce felt like it came out of a freezer.

You can't call these guys and get a delivery under 1.5-2 hours ever! Doesn't matter the time of day, or day of the week. When you ask why they always have attitude and say it's just the way it is. I'm not the pro, but as a business owner I would maybe hire some more drivers and figure this problem out! All other Idaho pizzas in the valley we have dealt with are so much more reasonable and apologetic when the wait times are long (weekends)

Wings are one of my favorites so I was excited to try a restaurant that specializes in wings. I also like spicy and got a dry rub that was 3 flames which means it was spicy. My husband got the ranch dry rub. We also ordered garlic fries and onion straws. 
The service was good. The portion sizes were large but what I wanted to review was that the food was extremely salty. The onion straws were so good the first few bites as were the fries, but then the saltiness became overwhelming. The wings were not spicy and so salty I couldn't even finish them. 
Needless to say when we got home, we were drinking water the rest of the night. 
My overall impression was "it's Okay if I do not go back there again". 
Sorry but I just think you should know how salty the food is.

Tried Wingers tonight with hopes of having a good family dinner. There's one pro here: decent beer selection. 

After that, it goes down quickly. Our order had more issues than we could count. Our custom flight came with two different beers than what were ordered with no mention of being switched. My fish and chips (photo) were not only the smallest pieces I've seen, but the batter was raw, chewy and oozing rather than crispy and cooked well. 

My wife has a gluten allergy and ordered menu items without gluten. What came however had gluten. 

My wife's beer was wrong and the replacement beer never showed. 

Our server was new but was given our entire dining area of the restaurant and was way overwhelmed. 

Unfortunately we won't be back.
I appreciate everything about Capital Church! Friendly community, dynamic worship and amazing messages week after week!

I am a  breakfast guy and most of the time get disappointed when eaten breakfast at restaurants. I am picky about my gravy and other things. Long story short this place is well worth it. Great food, great portions, great flavor and good ingredients. Will definitely be going back this Sunday after church.
Awesome food great service - very picky on my Italian food this place we stumbled on visiting Idaho have been there twice in 5 days lol

We had such a great experience shopping for a motor home with salesman Dave W.  He was knowledgeable, asked pertinent questions and showed us only what we'd expressed interest in.  We found "the one" Jayco Greyhawk. The buying process was a bit more challenging as we wanted to do our own financing and that I'd definitely not what the dealership prefers.  When we got to the dealership to pick the motor home up, the troubles began.  The RV had not been "gone through with a fine tooth comb"- the door lock on the coach was rusted and the key didn't work, the armrest on the passenger seat didn't work... in hindsight, we should have left the RV there for them to fix, but alas, we'd paid for it and wanted to take it home!  The service department was a nightmare to work with and the worst part is that NOBODY calls you back... the customer service is terrible, because nobody calls back! Being in the service industry myself, it's frustrating to be treated so poorly and ignored.  Phone calls are easy.  Returning phone calls is easy- if it weren't for Dave W., Marnie B, and Crystal T., we wouldn't ever return to Bish's.  We love our motor home, but we sure hope nothing goes wrong with it and we need (further) help with it.

Good food. General Tsao's chicken was actually spicy unlike all the other places in Boise I have tried. However, it was because they added habanero peppers. I loved the heat but it changed the flavor profile. Not exactly what Peng Chang-kuei had in mind. But the best I have had around Boise.
Really delicious food, good sized portions and a good value. The spicy chicken wasn't too spicy, very well seasoned and not fried. The fried rice was very tasty too.

Made a reservation for a lane for 2 hours of bowling for my husbands birthday on a Friday night.  We arrived and were squished into a lane that other parties had clearly taken over with their shoes and food and drinks spread completely into our lane so we asked to change lanes to the other side of the alley which was empty. They moved us which was much appreciated! We had fun bowling, lol, some times the scores were calculated incorrectly like counting as a strike when there was still a pin standing and some other funky occurrences but we had fun nonetheless! The drinks are cheap and we had a great time celebrating here!

These guys are great. Matched the best price I found on new wheels and tires for my truck. I did have an issue with one of the wheels getting scratched but they quickly owned up to the error and made it right. Some of the best customer service. I'll definitely bring them all my tire business going forward.

They won't let anyone in to shop.  So I waited and waited...months.... finally they let people in to shop.  I asked for the newest iPhone to compare with other iPhones they offered.  do you know the guy never told me that the 12 was about to come out and sold me an 11?  now i have to wait at least 2 years for the newest iPhone in order to save enough money to purchase.  I have learned a valuable lesson... always ask if a newer version is about to come out before purchasing a new phone.

Visited on 2 different occasions.  First time, we had the title to register our out of state vehicle and arrived on 1/4 at 7:30am. We were the 13th person in line and the entire process took 1.5 hours (.50 waiting outside before they opened and 1 hour inside).  If you are registering an out of state vehicle and you have the title, all you need is a license and bring the car for a vin inspection. Process was great!  We also have another vehicle with a lien holder and that took a little longer.  You need to request the title be sent to the Idaho dmv with a specific form, once received you can then register. We did this scenario today and arrived at 2pm and we're done by 3:20pm!  Glad to be done with this process but they were both a breeze!
Excellent company with great customer service. Work was very High quality. I would use them for any future flooring needs. Went above and beyond!
Great company. The quality of the workmanship is excellent. High quality materials were used. Fast, efficient & friendly.
Our server Anthony was a rockstar!   The Alehouse nachos are delicious.  It's a great place to come and just hang.

Neat place!  Menu had some great selections, but we narrowed it down to the boar shank and old school lasagna.  Both were a served hot and with a smile. The shank was tender and delicious.  Lasagna was very good- no complaints... but it was a bit pricey with a couple of drinks.

We mostly came for nigiri and none was on the boats. The chef didn't know the terms for some of what we were asking for, and didn't know what he had in the back, but we eventually got our order placed. They didn't have most of what we wanted but we ordered what they did.

There were only a couple of diners in the restaurant, and it took 15 minutes to receive our first drink. We asked for hot sake to start and cold with the meal. They brought out cold sake, so we asked again for the hot. The little boats floating by the entire time were remaining mostly untouched. We eventually caved in to our hunger while waiting another 10 minutes for our order. I suspect that was the plan, as nigiri had started making its rounds a few minutes after we started grabbing the oddly inspired rolls.

Both orders of sake came with dirty cups. Our food order came in two pieces, in a strange succession. Lightest fare was given 10 minutes after the heavier selections. We tried to wait, but gave in again.

Enough to satisfy two people came to around $30, excluding sake. It was surreal, in a schlocky way. Won't be going back. I won't even bother going into great lengths on the food. It was edible but thoughtless.

As we left, I took a glance at the business cards and noticed Shige isn't a business owner. One of the waitresses confirmed that's the case, along with the express in Boise. Explains a lot, but Shige... why would you keep your name on this?

Came here on a Sunday early afternoon, we were a party of three, and had a wait 45 minutes. They have an app, that showed us our place in line and it notified us when our table was ready, so we waited comfortably in our car. 

I had the avocado melt and it was so delicious! The garlic aioli really made the sandwich. We had super fast and friendly service. Even with another 45 minute wait, I'd definitely come here again.

One of the best breakfast spots I've tried. The Togo meals are always great and well prepared. I even received a call to ask if I needed anything else for my online order. The staff is awesome!! The nacho hash is my go to!!

We had a bad experience at another local dermatologist's office.  They referred us to Ada West.  Not only were they prompt, friendly, and fast, we actually saw the doctor.  Seems strange but after a couple of years at the previous clinic we NEVER saw the doctor, even when we asked.  He, along with the PA, provided great information, asked better questions, and overall cared more about my kiddo than the previous doctor ever did.

Opening Day!! I've come here all week for lunch and dinner during the soft opening. Dave and Denise and great people who care about good and good for you food. I'm the type of person who shops at Whole Foods and is very particular with my meals. It's always hard to eat out and eat healthy but it's SO easy here. Come here for a healthy meal alternative! 

Items I've tried: 

Bowls: 
Bodybuilder
Kayaker
Skier

Pizza 
Running Back

Salads:
Marathoner
Tried to upgrade all of our phones plus get two new iPads. One associate came over and said to come back another day. They can't help us tonight. Loss of revenue. Wow I'm shocked.
Great pizza as we had this chain in our previous town. Slow to cook but very much worth the wait. We love this place and also enjoy the setting in the village.

One star service. A man applied Callus Eliminator, a chemical exfoliant, then scrubbed my foot with an abrasive sponge. It was painful and he had to remove the Callus Eliminator. He was distracted and talking to his coworkers instead of focusing on the task. I left with  polish dripping off one side. Terrible experience!

I have gone to Gino's twice now and the first time it was just okay, nothing memorable.  The second time I couldn't even eat the food and was $20 for nothing.  The Alfredo had zero flavor and the noodles tasted like what you'd get from a box.  My friend sent back her food and didn't seem to get any sort of remorse from the staff.  Our waiter was nice however.  As an actual Italian myself, I don't get why everything thinks this is the real deal but alas for people around this area who don't know better its not.  Personally I think Olive Garden is better and that's saying a lot.

The only thing good here is the free bread! Everything else is ick. 

Am I a california snob? Maybe. 
Is the food not good regardless? Maybe.

We went to Moe Joe's this morning and it was delightful!! The interior was open and casual. The service was amazing and I love the free cup of coffee while you wait for a table ( this place gets packed on the weekends). The food here is fresh and delicious. We got the garden hash and the smothered breakfast burrito. The garden hash had a ton of fresh veggies, garlic, potatoes, avocado, cheese topped with two fried eggs. This hash was awesome and everything tasted so fresh and clean. The breakfast burrito was amazing and it was smothered in a pork chili verde sauce and cheese. The burrito was stuffed with eggs, sausage ( you can choose your meat) potatoes and cheese. The burrito was HUGE and was insanely good. Overall, best breakfast spot in the Boise/Meridian area.

Checked in online, showed up when prompted and some dude walks in and says he "was" checked in online but "missed" his appointment Ashley R who is AMAZING told him sorry he missed his spot and he would need to check back in and come back (as she should, great job Ashley) then the dude chases down another employee and she proceeded to take him back immediately although I was next in line and 2 others that had been waiting watched it happened I had already waited over 25 min (15 min beyond the estimated wait) not only was this poor service to everyone that had been waiting but you have lost my business, not only do you have an online check in process for a reason it gives ample leeway to remain on the list and still be able to check in, once someone looses thier spot from that list all the times get adjusted and expectations are set for and at the time you had 9 other customers there with expectations, you hurt 9 customers to service one late slacking customer.

Hats off to Ashley R Though for being the ONLY ONE to acknowledge smile and say hello to every single waiting customer and following the proper protocol.

I'VE NEVER BEEN TREATED SO HORRIBLY IN MY ENTIRE LIFE!  I will NEVER EVER STAY AT ANY OF THESE HOTELS AGAIN!   THESE PEOPLE ARE CROOKS AND HAVE NO COMPASSION!  

I booked a hotel room online two weeks in advance for two nights last August 14-16.  I have booked trips for more than one night, even though I really stay for only one night.  I have done this for several years at other hotels without a problem!  

I do this because I'm prone to blood clots/strokes.  I usually travel by car, arrive at a hotel early enough (before the usual 3:00 PM check in time), so I can immediately elevate my legs in bed at the hotel before visiting family, etc.

I'm a senior citizen, on minimal retirement, I've had several bouts with blood clots in both legs so my doctor has put me on blood thinners/coumadin off-and-on for the past 20 years.

I spent well over $300 on this particular trip for the 3 day/2 night visit.  I was trying to visit my daughter, her 4 young children, her husband who has Multple Sclerosis and can't help with chores or the kids around the house because of his disability!

When I booked the trip online, I called the hotel and the online company (Trip.com) to let them know that I would be arriving late but could not give them a specific time (I never do because many times I have to stop my car on a long-distance trip to take a break and elevate my legs....it all depends on the swelling).  

The hotel rep gave me no indication there was a problem with the arrival other than telling her I could not give a specific arrival time.  When I arrived, I was told by the manager that it was their policy not to honor the commitment because if I arrive late, I forfeit the room, even though I called both parties to let them know.  I told the manager that in fact I'm arriving one day early so I could elevate my leg in the hotel room....that I really only needed the second night's stay because I knew I wails still arrive before the 3:00 PM normal check-in time.

He not only didn't honor the late arrival but told me I had to pay for the second night even though I was hours early and already paid for both nights online!  
So, I lost my money, couldn't visit my daughter/family (she has no room at her house)....I could only visit her for a few hours because I had no place to stay since I already spent my hotel money.  I soon returned home which was hundreds of miles away!
Always delicious. Fantastic place for breakfast. Service is fast and friendly, portions are hearty and food is fresh and tasty. Breakfast potatoes are the bomb! We love this place.

Due to my arrival time in Boise I made it to Moe Joe's more for lunch than for breakfast and yet I was still really happy with my meal. While I wished I had the interest in a cinnamon roll because they legit sounded delicious I was more in the mood for something savory so I ordered a Prime Rib Philly. Made with prime rib, topped with mushrooms, caramelized onions, bell peppers and Havarti cheese, this thing was dang delicious. It could have been the thinly sliced prime rib, it could have been the fact that it had Havarti cheese, but truthfully I think it was all about the bread they used as a bun. It was the perfect combo of soft yet crisp and it 100% made this sandwich.

The service was friendly and fast and the prices were definitely reasonable for me. I would not hesitate to head back here again if I find myself in Boise at any point in the future. I will hopefully, be there for breakfast cinnamon rolls that time though!

My husband and I went here yesterday. It was absolutely amazing! Best pizza I have ever had! We had the 16" Brooklyn Bridge and I ate half of it. If anyone knows me they know I almost always bring home leftovers, but I could not get enough of this pizza. We'll definitely be going back.
Just ate there tonight for my husbands Birthday!! Very good service and delicious food. We will definitely will be going back. If you want good service ask for Tyler.

Recommended a quality AT/Street tire.  Sure, why not?  Maybe 1/2 hour.
Good price.  Left confident I didn't get ripped off.  Courteous and well informed just as expected.  Been buying tires from them for decades.

Ok. I don't know why the big craze over this bland overpriced food. The chicken is dry, the pork and shredded beef is greasy. Their sauces taste like they came out of cans. Long wait to order. Several employees standing around while our food needed to be finished while sitting there getting cold. VERY EXPENSIVE. I have gotten better "Mexican" food at Chipotle and Qdoba and that's not a compliment either. I ordered nachos with shredded beef. What I got was a huge pile of chips melted in one lump from the cheese. I literally had to cut them up with a fork and knife. TBH, Chili's would have been cheaper and better food. Anyone who eats here and loves this food doesn't know what good Mexican food is.

Very positive experience starting with the front desk, to the designer, and then to the installation. Good options for all budgets and very well installed. I appreciate how quickly, quietly, and cleanly the blinds were installed. Thank you Blind Source!

This is a tough one to review. On the one hand the staff is organized and The property is well-maintained. It's reasonably priced and pretty much what you would expect for a KOA in the middle of a urban community. On the other hand RV'ers should be aware that there are quite a few live in's at this campground. That's not all together a bad thing typically but the location is in a relatively economically depressed area. It's not the ghetto or anything but it definitely has a tinge of sketchiness to the feel.  All that being said it was a fine place to spend the night as a waypoint to get to the next destination.  I'd like to give it 3 1/2 stars for the staff and cleanliness of the grounds, but I couldn't quite give it four stars due to its location and lack of amenities.  Honestly, I don't think my wife stepped foot outside of the RV.  If you set your expectations appropriately, you'll have a fine experience and utilize the campground for what it is.

Little video review here if you're interested in getting a feel for this campground https://youtu.be/WrFpRtO198U

First of all: Tasha. 

Our server was Tasha and she is everything you want to see in this world: caring, sweet, a pep in her step, and REAL. Of all the servers my thick thighs have sat in front of over the course of my lifetime, Tasha is in the top 3, no questions asked. Ask to be seated in her section, you'll be happy you did.

Second, the food. One word: fresh. Everything here is incredibly fresh and filled with authentic flavor. I had the Basque hash and side grilled biscuit and my husband had the burrito, chimichanga style with sausage gravy (stop judging, it was legitimately our only meal of the day mmkay?) And every bite was delicious. Despite the portions being generous, we weren't left feeling 'stuffed' in an icky way. All around, incredible food, even more incredible service, and a guaranteed delicious meal. 

Also, do yourself a favor and get the mimosa carafe. If you just get one you'll feel like an idiot when you go to order two more. So, carafe it up.

No pizza this visit. I was heading to the movies and I had a little time to kill. I have had the cheesecake at Grimaldi's before and I had a craving. I had seen they had a seasonal offering of Caramel Apple. I decided to get a piece to go and yes I did-I took it into the theater and ate it during the movie. Sometimes it pays to have a larger purse. Honestly, I don't know if I could have carried it in or not but I wasn't about to have some teenager tell me no. I'm a cheesecake rebel of sorts I suppose. (Mental note: they don't have plastic ware so you have to steal a fork from Calle's but I had a taco there so I don't feel guilty about that at all.)

Anyways...the cheesecake was dense and perfectly cooked. It had bits of tart apple throughout. In all honesty I was missing more caramel flavor. This would not hinder me from getting it again and don't let that comment stop you from ordering it. I still give it five stars for texture and flavor. More caramel would have taken it over the top for me. Yes I got it to go and maybe in the restaurant it would have had more of a drizzle over the top OR I could have asked for more if I had stayed and had it in. So I'm not faulting Grimaldi's on this one. 

Sorry no photo. I think the people around me wouldn't have appreciated it.

I should have believed the bad reviews. We stayed down the street at the KOA and were happy to find a strip mall full of food options. The night before we had delicious pizza, so on our way out of town we decided on Sushi. There was a small group of people having lunch, and a couple singles here and there so we sat at the bar. 

There were only two people working out front in the restaurant. A waitress who had no filter and joked about customers as they left, and a "sushi" chef who shared the same attitude. As I was eating I couldn't help but wonder when the last time they cleaned their bar was. I am used to sushi places being pristine, but even the menus had food smears on them.

The food itself was weird on top of everything. The sushi boats were made up of deep fried whatever, plus sauce and fake crab thrown on. The vegetable roll had pickles and lettuce, which as far as I know isn't typically Japanese. This place was definitely an experience I would rather forget.

Horrible customer service! We had wasps nest in the eaves of our house so we called for an additional service to get them treated. They squeezed us in only 12 days after calling and after arriving, the technician refused to get the nest stating "its high enough up there that they won't bother you" and left. When we called to reschedule (which took 30 minutes on hold) because this was unacceptable practice, the technician didn't even bother to show up at all on the day he was supposed to be there. No phone call, no confirmation, no contact. After another 30 minute phone call on hold, we decided to cancel... if I could give 0 stars I would!

This place was worth the wait in July, the rolls tasted great and lots of rolls to choose from, they serve Miso Soup & Salad before the food is brought to the table, their Hot Sake was great as well, we'll definitely be back to enjoy the food and great service!
This place was amazing we ordered way too much food the portions are huge. We fed a family of four and easily could've fed 3 more. Food was delicious!

My dog had a spot on her back with hair loss and she was itching it. At first we thought it was ringworm but our dermatologist said it was not when we went to check out the rash on my husbands arm. It was spreading on our dog so we came here to get the right treatment for it. They recommended a test to see if it was bacterial (over one hundred dollars) and then to do a test for fungus second (over two hundred dollars) if the first test came out negative. After the first test the vet came back saying they did find a little bit of bacteria but that she still recommended the fungal test because it could be both! Why didn't she say that in the first place. We asked what we could put on her for both and then that's when she recommended a medication that would treat both. We didn't like that she was recommending expensive tests that were not necessary. When she could have just told us about that medication to begin with. So we bought the medication from them without having to do the fungal test. We could have avoided the first test as well.

Absolutely do not recommend Bish's rv. Nothing but a headache, and these are very dishonest people. Back in September of 20 we bought a used rv that was supposedly in good working order. The toilet leaked, the drivers side arm pull was broken, and the generator was broken. Our rv was in the shop at twin falls since we didn't want to keep driving to Boise where we bought it, and they kept saying they don't have people there that work on generators... Then after the rv has been there for 3 WEEKS we found out they never bothered to winterize it, even though we asked these inept "professionals" to do it 3 separate times.  Now, we are finally on our first big trip and our blinkers don't work. I understand this is a used rv, but we have literally had to fight with them every step of the way on what we were told was an rv in good working order that had been "inspected". I'm not looking for a lightbulb to be repaired, we're talking big, functional repairs that needed to be made. And we had to argue with them about not charging us, on top of all of this. We wouldn't have BOUGHT this rv had we been told up front all the issues it has. The inspection  is a joke.
This place has amazing breakfast options with generous portions! We will definitely be returning!

My husband and I stayed in the Quality  Inn on Meridian Road in Meridian. The room was clean and it seem to suit our needs. However we were there for a week. Our sheets were changed once. When we inquired as to why they told us they didn't change them after three days because we had left personal items on the bed. That was absolutely untrue.The toilet backed up and when we informed the desk they left a plunger in the front of our door and told us that we should take care of it. When we complained we were told that this apparently was not our kind of accommodation. If that meant hygiene and some standards of service were expected, I guess they were correct. The old adage that you get what you pay for is certainly true in this case. Definitely would never recommend this hotel to anyone traveling.

If you ever are looking for a a food spot start with the places that don't look super fancy or are hard to find. Moe Joe's breakfast eatery is definitely that spot. We are from out of town and hungry and looked up breakfast spot and took a look at the menu and when you are able to say "that looks good, that looks good, that looks good." It's probably safe to say it's gonna be  good. And well it was damn good. 

All the favorites you'd want plus some twist on things. Like the pancake flight which is highly recommend. The staff was friendly and nice. There can be a wait But isn't terrible. If anything go next door and check out the comics and stuff. Or get a coffee while you wait. 

Pro tip - get the pancake flight and share it! The jalapeño pancakes and jam is awesome!

I bought an ice cream cake for a friend's Birthday on Saturday, July 26. I have enjoyed B+R cakes many times and always though they were superb. This cake was dry and the ice cream felt and tasted like it had been aerated to increase bulk and perhaps make it easier to spread.
The three people who were having the cake agreed it was nowhere near as good as they had enjoyed in the past. This cake was comparable to a supermarket frozen cake at one third the cost. Very disappointed indeed.
Great food and great Service.  I love the variety of food on their menu! Everything I've had is delicious.
Never disappointed when we eat here. Friendly staff and clean. Food is great and fresh. So glad that Meridian has a Fujiyama. Love this goodie!!

If there was a negative 10 I would rate them negative 10. I had been ordering online groceries for delivery for a few months. Aug 2 they couldn't complete something in my order that they have always included. I asked for customer service to call me about it. Was told they can't call out but not why. So the next day I called customer service 800 number. They gave me a case number and said they would call back in 24 hours. Might be a glitch in system. Well my info is in that system so I needed to know. A few days later I called again. It will take longer. Called again today over two weeks later. They were still working on it. I told them I wouldn't order thru them unless they responded to the situation and if my business matters they will get back to me. I was not asking for refunds or discounts, just answers. Customer service shouldn't take two weeks. I am tired of their run around. I highly recommend you DO NOT shop online for pick up or for delivery unless you are willing to wait more than two weeks for a problem to be solved. Oh wait, it is still not solved.

No pressure in sales dept, I like that. 
RV industry is not like the car industry and this staff balances all the aspects of a rolling house very well. The service dept is very chill - I have tried to come in for some things for service and been told how I can do them myself if I wanted to, there is no high pressure sales on buying up service packages that are really just expensive inspections.... I still buy the inspection anyway when I don't have time, but I know the crew is honest with me and I have faith in what they tell me.

Ordered delivery. Everything was mislabeled. I'm very allergic to pineapple, and because of your laziness I ended up with that hamburger.  If I hadn't noticed, I would have been extremely sick. You are going to kill someone with your negligence.

Steinmetz Steinmetz reviewed Gino's Italian Ristorante & Bar -- 1 star

I tagged along with my friend who is moving to Meridian last week and her realtor was kind enough to treat us to lunch at Gino's.
