I acted polite as possible, and even gave the man a tip. He didn't have change for cash on him, personally, so he told me to go to the bank next door. I told him I would just pay with card, then Square charged me $2 for a service fee, which of course he didn't tell me about. As I left, Ace wouldn't even turn around to acknowledge my existence. He responded with "Cya", after I told him to have a great day.

As far as the haircut goes, he managed to give me mostly what I was looking for, despite never asking for clarification at all. He would have shaved my hair off if he could.

Great fresh food for lunch, I had the appetizer and the platter, both chicken and beef and it was delicious. Let's just say it's one of the best places I tried grilled chicken or beef. The flavors of the sauces and coal was very surprising as I was used to deep fried food truck foods. Definitely recommend this place. Make sure you save to room for ice cream donut, which is out of this world.

I scheduled an appointment on Tuesday for Thursday at 7:20pm. After hours appointment $$. They called today and had to cancel that appointment and ask if they could work us in at 4:30. Sat in the parking lot for two hours to get worked in. They screwed could not be seen after all. What a waste of our time. Of course they apologized for the mistake but wth.

We've driven by a million times and stopped today for the first time. Service was excellent. Very friendly and personable. Sushi chefs are top shelf. They made great recommendations and tasty rolls. Priced very reasonably. We will be back again. Soon.

I probably shouldn't tell you about this place but yet here I am...

Located pretty far from the center of the city is Moe Joe's Eatery. Moe Joe's is located in an area that is a bit hidden and not seen easily from the road. This is a good thing or else the line would be longer. Expect a wait if you don't get there close to opening. While I always struggle to wait to eat, this place is worth the wait. If you don't wait, I am jealous.

Like all other breakfast joints, I can't decide. The worse part about this place is food is flooding out of the kitchen and each dish I see and smell I want. I want that, I want that, I want that... no crud, I think I want that. The best thing about this predicament is, I know no matter what I get, I will love it. 

Top right now is the smothered breakfast burrito. I obsess over green chili and I can't find anything close to it in Idaho, this place has it, but it is red, not green (beggars can't be choosers when you are obsessed with green chili). I LOVE green chili. I would eat it for all meals if I could find it more places.

Also top is, I love it when people join me and I talk them into getting a pancake and they let me "try" the pancake. (What they don't know is I have "tried" this said pancake one too many times and I know what it tastes like, it tastes like the best pancake I have laid my taste buds on).  

Full stop - see you there.

OH, NO! What happened to this wonderful, special place? This was our go to restaurant when in town. We would brag, even home in CA, about this wonderful restaurant. It was ideal in every way: service, food and wine choices/knowledge.
Something bad happened. It has changed dramatically.

Let's start with what is still right:

WINE: Although there are fewer by-the-glass wines available, Gino's seems to still be making good choices. The downside is that the wait staff does not appear to be educated on the wines. When we asked for recommendations, it was clear that we may as well flip a coin. The waitress responded with statements like, "That's an Italian wine". Thanks for the insight. And she never followed up to ask if we liked our choices. 

FRIENDLINESS: The staff is still friendly and energetic. 

Now for the things that have gone noticeably downhill:

AMBIENCE: No more white tablecloth dinner service. Instead, customers eat on a table imprinted with a colorful Aztec styled design. When I inquired, our waitress said that the white tablecloths were getting soiled. Yes, and . . . ?   Not what I expect from an upscale romantic Italian restaurant.

FOOD: So disappointing. One of the big issues is that the new chef overdoes the sauce. Overdoes is an understatement. I have no idea whether my expensive filet and risotto were good because they were drenched in bad sauce. Same for every other dish we ordered at dinner and 2 days earlier, at lunch. I am a sauce person. I like sauce. But this was ridiculous. 

The appetizers of stuffed mushrooms were obviously burned. When we said we wanted to send them back, the waitress looked down at the black crispy mushrooms (see photo) and asked WHY we didn't like them. Owners: Please educate your staff.

I'm so sad to find that my fav restaurant is no longer the restaurant that it once was.

Unfortunately this place has lost a star each of the last three times I've gone.  I won't be back.  In this last round my wife's lasagna was cold in the middle.  The cheese bread also came out cold.  They are understaffed and have been so for a long time.  I understand there's COVID issues and hiring food service help is difficult now but you're still paying and tipping for cold food and long wait times.

I really wanted to like this place. The servers were so kind and attentive, but the food was just "okay"...although the sushi is a death wish. I'm giving two stars for service and the steamed dumpling things. I'm giving zero stars for sushi. 
I don't know if it's just me, but I need my sushi cold. This sushi was almost warmer than room temp. My body could be playing tricks on me because I ate warmish sushi and my mind is going a little crazy about it, but I am currently sitting on my toilet while I write this. 
It could be ebola that has me crapping my brains out but I'm going to venture that it was bad sushi. Send help.
These guys are absolute studs!!! Friday night crew is the best in the biz!!! Get down here and throw them some extra money, they deserve it!!

The ice cream is great but it's a little expensive for how small the scoops are. The service was really friendly though and the guy working the counter was generous with the coupons for next time. I appreciated it.

We used to love Red Robin but our last 2 visits were awful. Poor service. Inattentive waitress. Fries were barely warm. My burger was blackened on the outside but RAW ON THE INSIDE. A new burger was brought. Nephew's burger was also raw. No burgers were removed from total bill. Manager didn't check in so I wonder if she even brought anything to his attention. We won't be back.

Wow! And Wow!! Treasure Valley - this place is a hidden gem! 

This place has amazing food! Delicious and very generous! Priced right too. 

We ordered several dishes last night - they told us it was a lot - A LOT of food. We responded - ok, no problem. It's okay. 

Then - they started bringing the dishes we ordered! 

Dine In. Take Out and Delivery. 

Seriously - if you like Chinese food and want to try a new place - try Joy Garden!

Amazing staff, out of this world food!! I am gluten sensitive & this place will make anything gluten free & the pancakes are so good I can't find the words. They are light & fluffy & unlike any other gluten free pancakes I have tried. My husband lived his regular pancakes too. We have gone twice now & gotten their hash bowls w/pancakes & will continue to go back.

Delicious! Our sweet waitress made a recommendation- and it was so good! We made a second trip and it was just as good! Again our sweet waitress took great care of us- offering food recommendations for us. We will eat here when ever we are in town.

I never knew Meridian had a KOA RV Park. My in-laws from out of state came to visit and stayed there. It was nice, clean and well taken care of. The park has laundry and electrical facilities onsite. It's better than going camping and roughing it out in the wilderness. Neighbors were friendly. My in-laws had a great time and said they would be back again!!

This place came recommended to me by several people who had nothing bad to say about it. And they were right. This place is top notch. It deserves to be stand alone and not in the corner of a strip. 

If you like Fettuccine Alfredo (come on, you know you do) Gino's kills it for only $11 a bowl. Add chicken, Shrimp, or vegetables for only +$1. The dress is casual, but could easily be nicer. Our server Malea was attentive and the bartender was quick and friendly. Their taps fit their menu well and the owner engaging to us. If I'm ever that deep in Meridian again I would definitely go back.

THE WORST!  Avoid Blue Cross of Idaho.  Blood suckers.  They have ZERO care about you.  Terrible insurance.  Terrible company.  Terrible leadership at said company.  Nice customer service folks though... too bad you tend to talk to them a lot because BCI has their heads in their posterior ends so often.  NO insurance is better than BCI insurance.
Food is good, price is fair, waiting is ridiculous, only you plan to eat three hours breakfast, then you should try.

We bought our RV from Gene Tilby in November 2016.  We picked the one that we wanted and went through the signing.  They told us it would take them over a week to get it ready for us.  After the week, we picked it up from Lucas (who did very well on the walk around) but Gene was nowhere to be found.  When we text him questions he sent us to his service department via text, told us if we had any issues such as the DVD player not working with the surround sound to contact service.  We went back and forth with him telling him the issues and telling him he should be handling it as he was our salesman.  We had to bring the RV back after only having it for a few days because the CO2 detector kept going off and the heater was not working properly and the DVD players main sound was working only intermittently.  It took them more time to fix that when they had already had it for a week before we picked it up before!  They told us at the walk around that they had tested everything and cleaned everything so they obviously had not since they had to rewire the entire furnace.  Then the DVD intermittence on the main sound was not fixed still.  Gene told us that if we found something to replace it with they would take care of it.  I went out to find the equivalency (which they don't make exactly the same one anymore) and it was over $500.  Gene said they wouldn't pay for that and that they found a similar used one on eBay and that they would no longer pay for it.  So, they went back on what they said they would pay for, when we had questions for our salesman we had to fight with him to get him to take care of the issues, again he kept telling us to talk to service.  Overall it was not a good experience at all.  I was friends with Gene for many years before I bought this so if he is willing to allow his friend to be treated this way imagine what it would be like if you were not his friend or acquaintance.

I felt compelled to give a review on this bank because the only other review was a special situation.

This bank is awesome, nothing but great customer service EVER.  The entire credit union as a whole has been great, and has always gone the extra mile for me.  I have moved all over the country, and am still able to receive amazing service from a small credit union in Idaho.  I will not change banks unless I absolutely have to, even though I have to mail checks from California and deal remotely with this wonderful credit union.  A representative at the Meridian office even personally gave me a phone call to let me know the large check I mailed to the office wouldn't be available for withdrawal for 3 days.  Most banks would just let you figure that out on your own!

Pioneer Federal reminds me why I stop using the services of the for-profit banks, and I hope I am never forced to change to a local credit union.
Racism? Thumbs up this review if you get notes of discrimination in their service. Especially in the AM.
I am new to town and have officially found my breakfast spot! Service was friendly and food amazing.

So I was back in the Meridian, ID store and the usual technician that I prefer to take care of me was not there.  I asked where he was and was told he was no longer working there.  I thought that was strange so I asked if they knew what happened.  They said he was let go due to a customer complaint.  I considered this very unlikely as this technician was always polite and hard working.  So I asked a few more questions.  Found out most of the entire crew (except one; maybe the one who staged the false accusation) disputed the accusation and the technician was not even given a chance to defend himself let alone possibly make an apology.  Also found out the regional mangers said let him go.  Really?  Is this how you run your organization?  Come on Greg.  Don't you have the guts to defend your crew and try to find a solution?  Shame on this organization.  Taking my business to where they treat people with respect.

The sushi was great,  sashimi was amazing.  Rice in the sushi not mushy,  perfectly cooked.  The rolls were tight and didn't fall apart when picked up by chop sticks. The fish tasted very fresh,  not fishy or gummy. The portion sizes were great and sashimi sliced thick,  very generous.   Service was very fast and the staff was very attentive.  I've never been disappointed here. I always highly recommend.

The food was amazing, but the real stars are Sheena and the wait staff. Sheena was so friendly, and checked on us often, she was quick with refills and even helped my indecisive ass pick an entree. 10/10 will be having more date nights here
This was an all around disaster.  The sushi was mediocre,  my wife's dish was inedible. This place is off our list!

The breakfast of this place is freaking amazing it's a little overpriced but not too bad honestly it can't get expensive with the larger group but their griddles are amazing. The portions are usually large enough to fill me and I met big eater. I live on State and Glenwood and travel all the way across town to go eat breakfast are sometimes definitely a great book breakfast joint.

I visited this wine bar last night with my wine club. What a great place! Nice decor, great ambience, friendly not snobby sommelier, and...a large wine selection with good pricing. I will difintely return!
This is literally the only place I have encountered still forcing people to wear a mask inside despite literally no other business doing it. Also, the owner is super creepy.

Service and food was great. Had a really nice feel in there. I felt like I was in a far away place. I would have liket to hear some Italian music in background. Food is outstanding and I'm Italian. Hard to find good Italian on in northwest. They're doing it here.

Hubby and I have been thinking about getting a travel trailer for awhile. Decided to take a nice day to go look. We were very honest that we just started looking and weren't sure what we wanted. They asked a lot questions about what we liked to do and what our budget was. With that being said...just because you have a certain amount to spend doesn't mean you want to spend that much. We were shown 1 travel trailer. When we asked price we were just told it fit within our budget. We asked a handful of times the actual price and they wouldn't tell us. We asked about used inventory and he said they had only a few but they were crap. He wouldn't show them to us. Our sales guy asked if we were ready to do the paperwork to take it home. I explained again that we just started looking and would not be buying today. He proceeded to walk 10-15 steps ahead of us back to the showroom.  My husband and myself both drove out of their lot saying we'd never go back again with a place that won't tell us the price and with a sales guy who seemingly had a temper tantrum when we wouldn't buy after looking at 1 travel trailer.

When this place first opened, my husband and I were extremely excited. We had been wanting some authentic Chinese food for a while, and this place really delivered. However, if over time, the quality has dropped someWhat. The real problem with this place is the horrendous service. Every time we go back, it seems to get worse and worse. 

Last night, it took us 25 mins to get our water, another 15 mins for them to take  our food order, and the food took an HOUR to come out. We also ordered appetizers, which they brought out literally two minutes before our meal. Doesn't that defeat  the point of appetites? To top it all off, the food was COLD. 

If it took an hour to get our food after ordering and it's seven sitting around long enooigh to get cold, couldn't they at least have brought it to us? 

They also got 2/4 of our dishes incorrect, but god forbid they come by to ask if everything was ok- or to fill our waters. I left extremely incensed. Having said all that, the food is still good, just quite greasy. They've also cut back on the vegetables a lot. If you have a hankering for Chinese food, I'd still recommend this place... just make sure it's To Go. And maybe expect to wait an hour.

Excellent food and atmosphere. We've been in several times and it's one of our favorites. Excellent salads soups and burgers. Love the Tomato soup. Also the French dip was great along with the brussels sprouts.

After looking online, we tried this place, after craving some good Mexican food. We were extremely satisfied with the food. It was fresh, and had an authentic Mexican flavor. If you're anything like me, you're picky about your carne asada and carnitas! Well Los Betos has the best carnitas that I have ever had, and I have had some of the best out there. Hands down, this is the place to go. This is our go-to for Mexican food.

Karissa was a wonderful stylist. I was able to get in the same day I called for an appointment. Shampoo, cut, and dry was very reasonably priced. The salon itself is beautifully designed and decorated. Very comfortable atmosphere . The Canvas Salon will be my go to place in Meridian

I have spent dozen of wonderful evenings at Gino's. My history dates back to their downtown location. They set the bar for fine dining in Idaho. The menu is exquisite. The wine selection is unmatched. Chocolate mousse and table-fired creme brûlée are second to none. Make a reservation (if you can get one) and enjoy. Cheers.
Delicious!  Great selection of breakfast plates that are outside the box.  Will definitely return

Sure Boise offers up several Italian restaurants to choose from, each with an element of authenticity. But what if there were somewhere that had more than an element. What if they were the WHOLE package of Italian cuisine?! Gino's is it. A brief two weeks in Italy has yielded an insatiable craving for the fresh pastas, breads, and of course, wines of the countryside. It is with this in mind that I can confirm that Gino's is different from any other regional Italian restaurant. It is in fact, Authentic Italian.

I would absolutely never return here. We first walked in the table was so disgusting only one big enough for our party of 5. After the 7 very slow minutes of washing the table (that was still very sticky after), it took an additional 18 minutes to come get our drinks. The phone orders were more important than the customers inside the restaurant. So we would here the "ding" our food was done 15 minutes later our food came out cold on top burning hot on the bottom. The  food had more breading then anything! The menu shows drinks are $2.00 and refills are .50 cents. Come to find out only soda is .50 cents. We had to walk up and ask for our refills and extra napkins. There was 5 of us and we got 4 extra napkins. I'm completely baffled how this could be the highest rated Chinese food in Meridian! I might be used to big city Chinese food where the portions are large and the price is cheap. If you wanna spend $75 dollars your better off going to P.F. Chang's and getting adult sized portions! DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME OR MONEY HERE!!
Very decent traditional Italian food great customer service great selection on the menu been there several times I always had a great experience
Wow! The burgers here were SO GOOD! And the sweet potato fries were just as amazing, if not better. I will definitely come back to get my burger fix!

If I could give 0 stars I would. I do not usually write reviews but this needs to be heard. Many woman wait till the weekend or there next time off from work, school, kids...to come to get there nails done and relax.  This was my worst experience I have had, I recently came to posh for a fill, my normal artist was busy so I thought I could come for a fill just this once. I will never go back, I spent 60 dollars on a fill and had no fancy color or design. Not only was the price outrageous but it took 2 hours, and the whole time the owner was answering the phone and complaining about how many clients she had while taking on more. Even though the waiting area was so full that all the chairs where taken and clients were standing and waiting. While she was answering the phone she made my nails so thick, I couldn't even get them off once I got home. Not only that, but she also made me bleed. This is not a relaxing time off whatsoever. Do not come here, I would not suggest this place to anyone.

I have my new auto loan through PFCU and I needed to make my first payment & also needed help setting up my online /app username & password. I went into this branch and was greeted right away and helped quickly. 
They made it super easy to make my first payment & she helped me set up my online / app access. It was a nice quick trip to do something I was dreading to do after seeing the other reviews for this place.  Overall great experience.
Best fast food in the state. Consistently good. Unfortunately they have WAY too many " Equipment failures". Get it together guys.

Grimaldi's - a pizza place - takes the pizza oven(s) 'off line' every day from 4:00 to 5:00 for re-stoking and they do not serve pizzas - daily - after 4:00 until 5:30.  Alas this was a new learning for us this week.  It seems knowledge worth passing along.

And this we learned when told by the nice young woman at the entry counter when we walked in at 4:20-ish for "linner".

"Did you want to eat today?"

"Yes."

"Pizza?"

"ABsoLUTEly." (In the word and emphasis of the unforgettable Tony Soprano.)

"We don't have pizza available again until 5:30."

Seeing just one other couple at a table we said, "Oh.  Sorry.  You're closed?  Your business listing said open."

"We are open. We serve salads and other things now.  Just not pizza."
  
So while Grimaldi's PIZZERIA posts "open" turns out one cannot actually order PIZZA there daily beginning at 4:00.  Pizza can then be ordered again beginning at 5:00.  But will not be available to be served until 5:30.

OK then.  Explains why there was only one other couple inside.

My Brooklyn born and Italian neighborhood raised hubby can display his Sicilian heritage when he is hungry and feels hoodwinked...umm not fully informed.  So he started to be a bit, well, Noo Yawkah with the nice hostess until I stepped on his toe (metaphorically speaking) and reminded him she didn't set this policy.

He was feeling irked because we were there to redeem a "free pizza - eat in only" coupon received from Grimaldi's for birthday recognition.  "Free is Best" is his joking motto, although he is really a "You get what you pay for" kinda guy and the irony is he is one of maybe a few who don't object to Grimaldi's higher than other chains prices for their pizza because he thinks the quality of their crust is worth the cost.   And he was definitely feeling frustrated because we both so dislike The Village Mall (yes, two of only sixteen who are not fans, I guess) and parking is such a bear there that after the effort to park, well...

For perspective, we know this is a first world problem.  To find Grimaldi's - a pizza place if I didn't already mention their primary identity - shuts down their pizza service for 90 minutes every late afternoon into early evening.  (I'm pretty sure most people don't go to Grimaldi's thinking "oh boy, I can hardly wait to order a salad".)  

But I think my hubby is right in this much; Grimaldi's ought to post on their website or Facebook page or even the old fashioned way of sign on the window or maybe even on the "free birthday pizza" coupon they send of the daily re-stoking of pizza oven(s) making pizza unavailable after 4:00 until 5:30.  So their customers know before they walk in the door. 

When he shared that recommendation with the nice hostess she pointed to a tent card perched on the far corner of the entry counter with this information printed on it.  This, we were told, was how Grimaldi's let customers know - once they were in the door and asking to be seated. 

OK then.  My husband - who has been known to beat the proverbial dead horse in the way a Brooklyn Italian guy can - says now you know too before you go that the Pizzeria doesn't actually serve Pizza between 4:00 and 5:30 and you can save yourself the hassle of parking at The Village to find out after the fact.  "Prego".  ("You're welcome".)

Not impressed by their lack of caring about masks, covid, germs etc. No customers are wearing masks and half the staff wasn't wearing them properly anyways. The girl who touched my food just had her hands on a dirty broom, her nose, and a bleach rag before putting the finishing touches on my food. YUM! 
food is always delicious. sweet pork all the way.

We called at about 4 on a Saturday and the owner was at our home in less than 15 minutes. He was quick, pleasant to talk to and have us a good suggestion to not have this happen again (our door from the garage to the house hits our laundry room counter and pushes the lock on accident). We will definitely keep his number!

We've been looking for a goid Chinese food restaurant ever since we moved here and I can honestly say we have found our favorite place. The food was spectacular all of the ingredients are fresh and the portions are large. We were only 1 of two couples in the restaurant and felt the service was very slow however the food was worth of the wait we will definitely be back. I highly recommend Joy Garden if you are looking for a great authentic Chinese food. I would also recommend the ginger beef dish which was amazing

Great staff and helped my little "Buddy" feel comfortable; just moved here to Idaho and he was scared and nervous after the move and going to a new Vet.............not one problem and thank you! So friendly and helpful! I will return there with Buddy for sure!  Dr. Puckett was very kind and took her time asking and answering my questions and concerns.  I'm a fan!

I can't say enough about how good Vonnie was. I was experiencing severe pain in my neck and also had some lower back and hip pain that all came out of nowhere. I wasn't sure if I wanted to go see a Chiropractor or a masseuse and decided to start with a massage. After researching several places, I came upon Vonnie at Blissful Massage aka Boise Massage Blissful. She had all very positive reviews so I thought I would take a chance. Boy am I glad I did.

Vonnie greeted me at the door, reviewed my specific areas of concern, explained her method of treatment and took me into her massage room. The room itself was very inviting, lights dim, candles burning, scented aroma in the room and calm music playing.

Vonnie got right into her routine with exactly the right amount of pressure in all the right areas. Long strokes to elongate my spine and deep pressure in the trouble spots. Always checking in with me to make sure I was comfortable. She also incorporated Hot Stones which she used with expertise and felt awesome. The only other time I had anyone use the stones all they did was place them on my back for a bit and then remove them. Vonnie used the stones as just another technique and it was very effective.

Vonnie practices out of her home which may concern some people but please don't let that stop you from seeing her. She has a separate area of her home set aside for her business and she's worth going there for. Tied for Best Massage I've ever had.

Extremely disappointed in the service Dept. I would give ZERO stars if they were available.

I brought my bike in for some service work based upon their reccomendations of what work needed to be done. I am from out of town and had a limited amount of time to get this done. Upon bringing the bike in for my scheduled appointment, the parts were never ordered! 
Now I have to wait 3-5 days for the parts to arrive and setup another appointment, arrange transportation to and from and deal with this headache. One of the managers (Craig) said they would cover the cost of next day air, so we shall see if they can redeem themselves or make the situation worse.

Update - Craig was able to get the part in next day and fixed the same day. No discount for their mistake and my inconvience, so upgrade from ZERO to the 1 star posted. I doubt I will be coming back here in the future.

We would give this zero stars if we could. We have used Choice hotels for almost 10 years and as a Gold member we would expect better customer service, particularly in light of a pandemic. We cancelled our reservation 71 hours our time (70 hours Meridian time) and Thomas, the manager, refused to refund our motel price. His comment, " Read the fine print before booking", was his response when I said we unable to travel. I requested Grace, leniency since it was SO CLOSE to the 72 hours. We did cancel THREE DAYS prior to arrival. "POLICY IS POLICY". I asked to speak to someone above him. He said, "That's not possible".  I have always wrote, the few that I have done, positive reviews. This will be the first negative review. Choice hotels agree that it is unusual, but since it's a franchise, their hands were tied. They suggested we called back and ask again, and speak to the general manager. As you can see- we did and with no compromise. We will stay in Boise the next time we fly in to visit our daughter and there will be a lot more times! Our business is not valued there- we even told them we travel there a lot to see our daughter. Their loss!

I recently moved up here from Colorado but, before I did, I was in a bad hail storm that did a lot of damage to my new truck. I wasn't comfortable with any of the body shops I had visitors in CO, so I waited until after my move to get it repaired. I'm glad I did. I found Cope on Google and chose them do to their great reviews. They were polite and professional, keeping me updated daily via text on the progress of my repair. They only had the truck a little over a week and, when I got it back, it looked even better than when I bought it! I would recommend them to anyone looking for professionalism and quality in an industry which sometimes lacks both. They are great!

This company does not do what it advertises and says it will do.  It is very expensive and the matches that it provides you with are so bogus and not even close to what you put in your profile.  I believe they just find someone who is in your age range and set them up with you and call it good.  They sure do not examine your profile and match you accordingly.  I had three matches with them and all three were so not what was in my profile it was like night and day. 

This company is a total rip off and very expensive and a waste of money

Stopping in on a whim... just before a long drive... i decided to get my oil changed.  They took me in immediately and did a once over on everything from fans to wipers...  The cost was reasonable, the staff was friendly and knowledgeable, and everything was done as quickly as I could have hoped for considering I was running out of time for my trip.  I definitely recommend  this Jiffy Lube!

One of the gentleman at les schwab (can't remember the name) worked on and replaced the drums on my classic. Did a phenomenal job and helped me get the car on the road for the first time in over 25 years!
Dr wells is great. Great location, great staff. Whenever we come in they are quick to greet us.

Good food and service, the reason for the 3stars is price. If you have kids it is a bit pricey for what normally a 9 to teen would order. Quesadilla cheese only 4 average slice $7.00.. 
Baja Bowl steak "good taste " average size, leaning to small on steak portion, $10.00. 
Want extras, Small size Guacamole $1.00.
In the Meridian and the surrounding area you can find better value.

I love how healthy clean and super tasty this food is. The chicken is so tender and I love that I can customize the veggies anyway I want. It's super busy it's first days open. Cant wait till the crowds come to a normal flow and I can come regularly.

We took our family of four for dinner, We all ordered  sticky finger dinners with a side salad, even a dessert to share after. The food was delicious the service was excellent.
My only complaint is we all left still hungry, the bill was $82 I think this is a bit much especially to leave not full. My teenagers are not in a hurry to go back. 
I feel like there food portions are very small. I remember the old Wingers gave you so much more food. They were also out of potatoes which  was a bummer.

Very impressed with the service, the decor, and the freshness of the sushi. Particular highlights were the gyoza's, Treasure Valley roll, and the Smokey Tempura roll. Best service I've had whilst in the Boise area bar none!

Came here for Mothers day with a large group. Daegan was an amazing waiter. He was running around the whole time making sure everything was perfect. The food was great as always. Would highly recommend!

Eggplant sandwich amazing!
Italian Burger, my boyfriend loved it. 
Beat service I've gotten in a long time. 
There's so many options, it's worth it!

Also best truffle fries!

Wow! And Wow!! Treasure Valley - this place is a hidden gem! 

This place has amazing food! Delicious and very generous! Priced right too. 

We ordered several dishes last night - they told us it was a lot - A LOT of food. We responded - ok, no problem. It's okay. 

Then - they started bringing the dishes we ordered! 

Dine In. Take Out and Delivery. 

Seriously - if you like Chinese food and want to try a new place - try Joy Garden!

The food was okay but not that great, I also ordered a mimosa, she gave me one glass with barely any of the flavor I asked for, I asked for more and my waiter acted super annoyed the whole time we were there. I couldn't even finish my food.

Party of 2 !!! Not thaT hard yet hostess sat another couple who just walked in after us first...look down first to see if  someone is waiting how stupid can you be!!!! That right there changed myy mind aboUt eating a full meal there we had two drinks and left

This is the worst possible place to do your shopping among other things. Last year in December we had an incident where somebody had inadvertently thrown one of the baskets into our brand new car afterwards we went ahead and reported to the store director and the assistant director who will remain nameless at the moment. Needless to say they promised us that they would go ahead and take care of everything in full with their insurance as soon as the holidays have passed but they were not honest and did not keep their word in any way shape or form because by the time January had to come around they went ahead and let their insurance company know that they had said no such thing that they were not going to be covering the cost of the damage done to our car. If they had never promised us we would've never expected it which is what made this such a horrible situation so of course we had full coverage insurance but at the same time it's just the point that they actually went out of the way to be manipulative and lied to us about the whole incident. We would not recommend ever having to go to the store with her be for shopping or anything of the sort due to the fact of the director and the assistant director.

First time going here my wife and I were craving calzones.  Very disappointed.  Very expensive calzones lacking in flavor despite having multiple fillings.  The crust also alternated between soggy (too much grease) and burnt patches.  The sauce, however, was very good and came in a generous amount.  I'm not ready to rule this place out but I will have to hope for better results with other menu items.

OMG!!!! I ate at a Famous Dave's in Minn/St Paul 15 years ago and was not impressed so never went back, never bought the sauce, figured it was another chain that lost its edge. I am not afraid to admit I was WRONG! Famous Dave's on Eagle Rd near Lowes is AWESOME! The baby back ribs were perfect! Smoky, meaty, with a crusty edge yo the sauce (can you say fire roasted marshmallow just shy of burnt?) YES! Yes! YESSSSSSS! The curb muffin was so hot, but again a sweet crusty top and moist deliciousness inside, yes, I nibbled all the muffin from the paper. Can I say it..... Boise's best kept secret. And if the food wasn't enough, a manager type stopped to see how everything was! Get out! Great Service to boot! We were there on Saturday at 6:30! Don't miss this place!

This place deserves a 0!! We stayed recently due to a soccer tournament that was a stay to play and had limited hotels to choose from. The hotel was out to get us the day we checked in due to the fact we had teenagers in our party. On check out day, I was unknowingly charged $200 to my credit card for damages in one of my rooms. (This was done after I checked out) No communication was sent to me about these charges. I only noticed it while looking at my credit card bill. When I contacted the hotel, they said we made a hole in the wall. I asked for proof and what room the hole was found in. She proceeded to tell me the 1 room that the coach was in and not the teenagers. Only after contacting the hotel 3 times did I get a picture of the hole. It could have been from any room from the dump of the hotel it is. Needless to say the time frame in which the picture was taken and when I checked out is not feasible. When I finally got a response from the GM Shawntae, she couldn't provide me any more evidence that it was in our room. She immediately gets defensive and states she wouldn't lie about this. Then her story gets even better when she says she tried to contact me via phone and email. I asked for her to forward the email that got bounced back but she couldn't do so. She also said she got busy helping with breakfast after taking the picture and wasn't able to try calling me again. Well, I checked out after 10. Breakfast was long over. So caught herself in a lie. When we finally had a phone conversation, she blamed the damages on the teenagers that were staying in the room. Well, it was the coach in that room, so her plan didn't work. Come to find out, after reading another yelp review, another guest was staying in the hotel at the same time and they were also charged $500 for damages to a desk that they didn't do. Something shady is happening at this hotel. I contacted Choice Hotels Corporate and they said they believed these were false accusations and that we needed to be refunded, but they were unable to process and that the hotel would need to do that. The GM Shawntae is refusing to refund the charges. I have asked for her bosses contact information but she hasn't responded with it. If you are the owner of this hotel or the boss of Shawntae, I highly suggest you get in touch with me. Corporate has filed a claim against your hotel and I will be in further contact with them about this.

Staff was AMAZING!  All the way from the initial consultation I guess I'll call it ... even though I already knew what I wanted ... the manager guy who checked me in was genuinely interested ... asked all the right questions ... never told me not to put the oversized tires I wanted on my 4runner ... offered to even try it before they proceeded with the full install.

Now I have 34in tires on my rig ... with no issue ... all the staff putting them on were absolutely amazing too ... offered nothing but encouragement even though I and they knew I would have slight rub ... nothing a little bit of angle grinding and razor trimming didn't solve.

I've used Discount for YEARS AND YEARS and truly believe they are the best in the game ... this was by far my best experience I've had with them.

BOISE IDAHO DISCOUNT TIRE FTW! (Or meridian ... I don't know what town it's in ... lol ... it's close to the border of both
Amazing food. I had one of the hash bowls. It was so much food that I had leftovers. I love that they have gluten free options. Great service.

Breakfast had never tasted so good! I am not sure what they do to their eggs but holy shmokes, those things must have been gotten from chickens on cocoaine because they are amazing. Overall great place to take freiens or famIly.

Pam and I have gone to the Tavern about 3 times now.  The food the service the drinks all fantastic.  April was our waitress the first two times just fantastic tonight Caridad was our waitress also just fantastic.  We both had the filet mignon it was the best filet we've eaten. My hat's off to the chief.

What a great breakfast!!

Pros: Everything except the Cons. 
Cons: not open for Dinner!

First time caller, regular listener!  I'm going to make this my go to for breakfasts and lunches. I've not noticed this place as it's tucked back away from the main road a bit. But man it's worth the effort to find. 

Take a regular breakfast, stir in some creativity, fresh ingredients, a heavy hand for large portions and the finest fresh veggies and best tasting meats and you've got a top notch place called Amir Joe's. 

Prices are very reasonable. My wife had a "pick 3" for $7.99 if I recall correct. She had a large hash browns, small (their words. More like large) ham and cheese omelet and a biscuits and gravy. The biscuits appear to be pan made and are light and airy, but oh so delicious. 

Some of the best strawberry jam with my sourdough toast and my hash brown bowl was made with red potatoes and jalapeño peppers and chorizo. Dang it was delicious!!

Did I mention the Bloody Mary made with Sake?!  Yummy good!!!  Give it a try, and when you do, give me a nod...I'm the guy in the corner drooling over the menu, trying to decide what to order this next time.

This review is not for the food, but for the snot-nosed arrogant little hostess at the front. One of the rudest, most condescending individuals I've ever dealt with. Had to leave the restaurant before I lost my temper. Won't be back!

Terrible service! Trashy unprofessional bartender and server all because our table of 7 wanted divided (3) checks. Felt like I was back in college and being treated like I was at a trashy low life bar. Bartender was clearly trying to back her unprofessional server (telling us to go home when we were speaking to the manager) because the server told us to "figure it out" with one tab... after asking for separate tabs. Bartender tried to get in my face, right next to the manager. Where do you find these people??? Jail?  Strip clubs? Dive bars? Goodness, this is a family restaurant and I could not have imagined if my kids were present!! We asked for waters, received none, had another table try to defend the server when we were leaving newscaster the server obviously complained to them. I'm sorry, you don't get mad for separating 7 drinks, that was it...7 drinks for a table getting a night cap. And she was frustrated enough to be more rude and give us individual checks instead of asking how we wanted them separated, she wouldn't let us speak and just stormed off!! What a lazy and entitle 45 year old child of a server (looked old, but who knows how old she was). I'm so shocked!! Please read my DETAILED review on Facebook if you would like to know the full story=) these are just snippet of the night we had here.

And to the person commenting below. We spoke to the ONLY manager on duty, so yes you did not witness anything and only know your staffs "story", so you are either the bartender, server or someone else trying to point fingers instead of taking responsibility for the wrong doings of people who should clearly not be in the industry. And personal insults are not being passed, these are observations of your staff. She is just proving my point at her lack of professionalism and immaturity, she clearly doesn't remember the night.... one mutual friends first question to me was "did she seem drunk?" That says it all Nicole!
The food was quite good but the cost was too high and the wait times make me not wanna go there. The green chili is super good though. I just don't enjoy expensive breakfast
The food was decent, nothing great or over the top, but your typical bar food.

Agree with other reviewers, good size portions provide leftovers.  Very nice atmosphere and friendly staff.  We got to sit by the fireplace on a cold evening which was nice, and we couldn't finish our pot of tea completely before another was brought out.  Only feedback was that the honey almond chicken was light on the sauce, but when we mentioned it when boxing up our leftovers, they brought out a small container of sauce to take home.

Went there again tonight. Service was not as good, nor was the food. Also, the new non-Korean speaking waitress was a disappointment. Their prices have also gone up and they have taken to adding an automatic tip to the bill. I won't be back. Very sad.

Wonderful service and delicious food. We went on a Thursday and it was pretty busy but we caught a lull and were seated right away. We ordered a sausage bowl and the two-egg breakfast. Both had large portions and were very tasty. We upgraded the toast to biscuits & gravy which was better than most we've tried although just a bit too peppery. Is that rosemary? The biscuit was great. Everything we had was very good, service was just attentive enough and we never had to ask for refills.

Worst service customer service ever. Manager was arrogant and uniformed. We had over 100guests staying in our party with this establishment of which none will ever use again. Rooms had stained carpet and were not very clean. We were In Idaho(from Oregon) for a baseball tournament for 3 of our grandsons and there families and a fifth birthday for a granddaughter who's brother was playing ball. A friend visiting my wife for lunch had a issue with hotel and some damage to a sprinkler, they turned it on us and required us to leave the premises escorted by the police with no refund and a extra $500.00 charge. So we paid a $1000.00 for a one night stay. Then we're required to leave for something we had nothing to do with. We returned home in Oregon not seeing any BB games and not celebrating our granddaughters 5th birthday. Very disappointing.

The guy taking phone orders tonight does not like his job LOL He was very rude, monotone and is not happy 4 whatever reason. Maybe he should be doing dishes instead of talking 2 customers?! Just a thought... If I was managing, I wouldn't want this guy taking orders. Bad 4 business! But then again, who am I?! Just a random pizza lover that will prolly go elsewhere next time...

Hands down five stars for customer service at this location.  Every sales person there seems to be top notch (I spent some time observing the interactions between other reps and customers), but a huge shout out to Alex Hood who sold my husband his new phone, and helped to port us all over to Verizon from Sprint (we'd been happy with Sprint for years, but Verizon does have better coverage here in Idaho). Not only did Alex do an excellent job in explaining all of the anticipated charges, so there would be no surprises when we got our first bill, but he also patiently helped me troubleshoot a problem that came up with the promotional trade in our husband's phone - the problem was not a result of anything that this store was responsible for, but when I sought his help in contacting customer service, he patiently spent over an hour on the phone trying to resolve on my behalf.  Unheard of!  Will definitely be back when my daughter and I are ready for new phones.
Great office and staff. They are always organized and efficient. I never have to wait long for my appointment and get in and out in a timely manner.

One of the best, if not the best, Italian restaurants in town! I love the atmosphere. The place is very open, but not too loud. The service is always great, and the food is consistently fabulous!!! They have a wonderful patio area they open up during summer. 

The only thing is for me...it's a bit out of the way. I live on the east side of Boise so it is a bit of drive - 40 minutes sometimes. I prefer their old location which was downtown. But this is the one place I know I can get a good authentic squid/calamari salad!! 

If you haven't tried it, this is a MUST!!

Fantastic!  One of my favorites in Meridian! Love the mu shy & fu yong!! Always fast & friendly service! Always busy so we get take out a lot!  My kids adore the mandarin chicken but we get it mild. Love that I can ask for whatever spice level I want.

Rick and his team are great! My stupid car has issues with the TPMS sensor and Rick and his team have been a pleasure to deal with every single time I've had tire issues or needed new tires. Thank you!

I really like how they have soy sauce and teriyaki sauce on each table here! The portions are generous, wasn't much of a wait time either during a busy lunch hour. The atmosphere is nice with Tv's and booths. The medium bowl was a great portion for my daughter and I to split! I love how they serve tofu here making it an easy meal for us, vegetarians. Staff was friendly and didn't charge us for small water cups or an extra bowl for sharing which was SO great because other fast food establishments in the area tend to nickel and dime me for simple requests.

I'm just going to go ahead and start off by saying I wouldn't recommend Terminix to anyone. With that being said, the employees I did have contact with were all very kind. This is a review strictly based on the product, it doesn't work...at all, it has actually caused us more bugs than we had before (or ever for that matter). 
The end of May a very energetic, young salesman came to our door and convinced me (my husband was not on board) that the product worked wonders and would have our house bug free in no time. We have a two year old son who is obsessed with bugs right now and a yard that has tons of spiders, pincher bugs, wasps (and elder beetles but that's another story) so I was sold on the idea very quickly. I should have been much more wary when the salesman told me "he didn't know the terms and conditions and I could just read them in the email after signing up". Huge red flag and really dumb on my part for agreeing to anything. Anyways a few weeks later (June 1st to be exact) Nathan, another nice young man, came out and sprayed our house for the first time, the whole process took about 15 minutes. He told us not to go outside for 30 minutes as he didn't want us breathing in the fumes, another red flag considering the salesman had told us "you could literally drink the product safely". Anyways, Nathan told us to "give it a few weeks" he had told my husband that the pincher bugs, beetles, etc. needed to eat the product and then the spiders would eat those bugs and die. I guess it made sense however, a few weeks went by and all we saw was an increase in bugs. So I called back the week of July 1st and told a young lady what we were dealing with. She told us she would have another person come out and spray our house a second time free of charge. I was hesitant but agreed. On July 8th another kind man came out and sprayed our house. He didn't say much but did tell me that the product doesn't do anything for box elder beetles, which I would have known from the beginning had I read in the terms and conditions. Anyways, after waiting a week and seeing absolutely zero progress with the bugs outside and finding more spiders inside than I have in the few years we've lived here I decided to call and cancel our service. I spoke to a girl named Allison who was extremely helpful, understanding and polite. At the end of our conversation about cancelling I asked her if she wouldn't mind voiding the $90 cancellation fee since the product didn't help at all and actually made things worse, she told me she would send an email to the managers who make those decisions and they would be getting back to me with a decision within 1-2 business days. I never heard from anyone. We were still charged the cancellation fee and my husband won't let me live it down. 
If you're on the fence about using Terminix I'd say run, far away, it's not worth the money and definitely not worth the headache you're about to put yourself through. You're honestly probably better off DIYing a bug repellent on Pinterest, I heard dawn dish soap and water in a spray bottle works great

Don't do it!! Don't go. Nothing worse than a disappointing dinner for my birthday. 

Service: Okay but not what you would expect for what they are trying to be as a restaurant. 

Ambiance: Not a romantic quiet dinner, eclectic   tight space that is unfortunately very loud. 

Beverages: I had water but my husband had a white sangria. Was served in a water glass, very strong. Which I guess is okay since it was $9. 

Food: Ordered calamari for our appetizer, decent but very salty. Soup was also a bit salty, salad was a basic salad nothing special. My husband ordered a veal dish with a brown butter sauce and it was served with spaghetti noodles. Flavor was mediocre, not a lot happening in the dish. Not something I would order for $26 . I decided to try the pancetta, mushroom alfredo. Here is the where it ruined the experience  for us. My pasta was not done, and yes I understand good pasta is al dente, this was just under done crunchy pasta. Mushrooms were just complete mush, not a great saute mushroom. Pancetta, Ha ha you mean 2 inch strips of bacon. Some delicious pancetta would have added a delicious salty addition to this pasta which it needed. Instead I had an earthy dirt tasting pasta that I didn't even eat more than 5 bites of. 

Overall: If you are expecting a high quality delicious Italian dinner, this is not the place I would recommend. They are pretending to be something they are not. If you are going to charge like an upscale restaurant you better serve the highest quality food you can. Disappointed. Waste of $100.
Great food, but terrible slow service. We got there early on Friday evening, place at that time was half empty, but we still suffered through terrible slow service. Poor management.

I wish I had read the Yelp reviews before we came here for dinner. 
We arrived at about 7:30pm on a Wednesday evening. The restaurant was empty. There were only 2 occupied tables. We were seated and greeted shortly after by our server, Kelly. We told Kelly that we would need a few minutes to look over the menu since it was our first time eating here. She have us the time we needed & even dropped off some of their house made chips. The chips were delicious.  They were warm & were seasoned perfectly. We ordered:
2 meat plate with brisket & baby back ribs, Mac & cheese, fries, and a side salad with bleu cheese
Chopped pork and grilled pineapple taco & a baked potato with butter & sour cream
Both meals included a cornbread muffin

The good:
The cornbread muffin was delicious! Super moist and slightly sweet. I could have just eaten. The butter they serve is the perfect temperature to spread it onto the muffin evenly. It wasn't too soft nor too hard. 
As I mentioned above, the house made chips were great 
The house BBQ sauce was really good
The French fried m

The bad:
The brisket was brownish grey. There was no no evidence of a smoke ring or BBQ grill mark. There wasn't much in the way of flavor and the meat was pretty tough. 
The baby back ribs were also pretty tough. 
The Mac & cheese was a disgrace!!!! It was served in an individual ramekin and it looked like noodles sitting in soup. The color of the cheese sauce was off white and it has corn and diced jalapeños in it. Nowhere on the menu did it state that there was corn and jalapeño in the Mac & cheese.  It wasn't edible at all. 
The baked potato was just blah...I'm not sure how someone can make a baked potato underwhelming, but Famous Dave's managed to!
The pork & pineapple soft taco was tasteless. The pineapple was totally dehydrated and had zero flavor. 

I can honestly say that I don't see myself ever eating there again. It's too bad because the restaurant has a really cool theme and is nicely decorated.

The wife and I went there after hearing from a friend.  WOW !!!!! The food is excellent, and the service.  The dining area is spotless and cheerful.  The sweet tea is great.  My wife is a strict vegetarian so it is difficult to go out and find her good food.  She usually settles for a vegetarian burger.  She saw a vegetarian sandwich listed so she ordered that.  Was she ever pleasantly surprised.  When it arrived at the table it looked wonderful.  She tasted it and her eyes rolled back in her head because it was seasoned so nicely.  She gave me a taste.  Wow, it was wonderful.  Then I looked at my dish.  I had ordered the Large Garlic Shrimp on potato patty.  The presentation of the food on the dish was second to none.  It came with a small dish of corn.  Our food came with freshly baked corn bread.  Delicious! The flavoring was gorgeous.  The lady cooking in the back is the mother of the two delightful girls waiting the tables.  She really has a talent for seasoning food.  This has to be the best Cajun food we have ever eaten.  We highly recommend this restaurant for your dining pleasure.  And the prices are very reasonable for what you get.  Hopefully I can upload the pictures we took.

On par with Albertsons, Ralphs, Vons... But every attribute is better! So I guess it's not on par! But this review must go on! This is an everything type of store: food, drugs, home improvement, even clothes! Prices are very fair, there are good sales, and they have a great rewards program. 

They are community based. They involve themselves with the community; doing things such as hiring local staff and working on community projects. 

The parking lot is huge. There's fast food nearby and a Starbucks inside. If you're local, this shopping center may very well become your weekly go-to.

With all the five star reviews I was looking forward to handing out yet another, but Alas it just wasn't meant to be.

This place has no doubt seen it's fair share of patrons and it shows. Things are looking beat up. I hate to see owners let things fall to the wayside. Tables, chairs, decor, paint, window coverings, all these are such easy things to maintain to keep things looking fresh and declare pride of ownership.

When we arrived the cleanliness factor was also on the poor side. Food strewn over the floors and multiple flies elated about it. None of the employees seemed interested in solving that problem, nor was anyone tasked to do so during our entire meal.

We chose the lemon poppy seed pancakes, breakfast burrito with side of Ranchero sauce, and the traditional Benedict with side of Moe Joe's potatoes. There isn't much to praise here except to say the poached egg was cooked well and the Benedict as a whole was good, but we would have preferred a thick slice of ham instead of the deli style slices. The lemon poppy seed cakes were good as well, but on the small side and overpriced IMO. The Moe Joe's potatoes were overcooked and more like under seasoned chips. The burrito with chorizo was lacking flavor as well.

Others had mentioned generous portion sizes and delicious food however that wasn't our experience. Perhaps this depends greatly on the time of day and how well stocked they are. At these prices everyone should enjoy the same quality and quantity of food. I would not come back based on the experience we had on a Saturday afternoon.

Lastly, our server was friendly and attentive and performed well considering the type of establishment.

Great food and good-ly portions.  Nice hash dishes with plenty to share with another.  The pancake is plate size and tasty.  Full menu.   Most always a line, but rarely completely full.  Seating is for far more than they usually staff for, so when you're seated - you can count on timely service and food.  I really enjoyed the food.
Average pizza, but great facility, service and salad bar. The pizza reminded me of a more expensive frozen pizza, which isn't a bad thing. Very affordable!

Save your money. The rolls are overpriced, the food is not good or worth it, and the service is ridiculously slow.  We went during our hour lunch break and didn't even get to eat. We had to ask for it to go. Won't be going back. There are much better sushi spots in town.

Went in for help with my convertor. After speaking with someone, they directed me to another individual who was a tech. He asked me about my problem, when I informed him of my issue, he simply stated "I don't know, sorry". Didn't offer any other help or suggestions. Apparently doing nothing and collecting a paycheck is his only skillset.
We have stayed here a number of times. The facilities are professionally maintained and look great. The sites are level, attractive and easy to access. The staff is friendly and helpful. Kudos!

By far the WORST nail salon I have every been to. I almost never leave reviews but this place is awful. The guy was extremely rude and couldn't do anything I asked for. I settled on a matte maroon color with coffin shape, not too challenging right? The shape is nothing like coffin, they are extremely chunky and uneven, and there is polish all over my hands. Now I have to spend another $60 dollars somewhere else just to get them fixed because I'm embarrassed of how these look. Also on the off nail I wanted GOLD CHROME, not sparkles. And he put matte over the "chrome" which I just assumed he would know NOT to do that. Ugh.
Impeccable service and delicious food. Our waitress Rachelle was the sweetest human ever. I signed up for Yelp solely to rate this restaurant. It's that good.

So my fiance and I live in southern California and came out here to house hunt and vacation and wanted to try a sushi spot..this one had the appeal cause we love revolving sushi bars and these floated on boats!!! What a great idea! Yea, no.. walked in and we were the only ones there. nothing was fresh. They put spicy mayo on everything. With all that time they could at least clean the rice out of the river. Then we saw that it's attached to a soul food joint...SMH. Didn't eat there, but wouldn't expect much. The staff was nice and they had great vibes, but if you want sushi in Idaho, this isn't it

This is probably the worst of all the Freddie's in the entire Treasure Valley.  Not because of the prices or the employees, they are truly down to earth.  No, it's the customers that shop over here, many from Eagle, that think they are classier, better looking, and "richer" than the other folks that shop here.  Don't leave home without your coupons, Freddie's is more than grateful to honor them.  Don't dare shop here without having every single hair is place.  They (the customers), look at you as if you just stepped off of planet mars.  As for the Starbuck's, it is the same.  We absolutely prefer the Starbuck's  in Eagle.  My husband and I refuse to go in, pay Starbuck's price and end up fighting with other shopping carts for a place to sit.   

Again, cannot say enough nice things about the employees at this store.  They are workers, not folks from Eagle or CA that were born with a silver spoon in their mouths.

We have been great Verizon customers for years.  We have used this store, including post Covid in January buying a new watch.   I checked the website to see updated Covid policies and there was nothing that indicated an appointment was needed.   Upon arrival there was a guy in the parking lot screaming about masks and how they wouldn't let him in because he didn't have a mask.   Upon trying to go in the sales representative came out and told us we couldn't go in.   I don't know if he was rude because the guy was yelling, but he was very unkind.   The situation then escalated quickly.   He became very aggressive and rude.  He told us he had no appointments available.  I tried to explain we have traveled two hours.    He then raised his voice and told me they had no employees.   I asked for the store number to make a complaint.  He then yelled at me.  "Make a complaint about what, that you can't schedule an appointment right."   His customer service was awful!!!!!  I will not use this store again.

In my opinion, there are three really excellent Italian Restaurants in the Boise area. Luciano's in Boise is quite good, as is Alavita in Downtown. However, when all things are considered, Gino's is Meridian is 'pound for pound' still the king in that town! Having eaten at all three many times, here's how I can best describe them and my rankings. Alavita has the best 'fine dining' food. It's first class across the board. Luciano's is the best 'Italian' food, meaning that most of the pastas I've had there I prefer to the other places. But Gino's has the best of both worlds. Excellent 'Italian Food' along with some very good 'fine dining' selections and specials. Our last time there, we had the Halibut special and the Seafood lasagna. Both are absolutely incredible, and that speaks to what I'm saying! To be able to execute a traditional dish and a special fine dining dish at that level makes Gino's stand out! And now, with Exit 42 you can get there much easier. Go eat there first, then try the other spots as well! Highly Recommended!

We came at 6:30pm on a Friday nigut. We lucked out on grabbing a table just as another couple was leaving, the place was jam-packed! Though every seat was taken, the service was prompt considering, and our food definitely didn't feel rushed. We split the Reuben and the Bleu Burger. The meat on both were done very well (tender and juicy). I was impressed and would order again.

Look at this beautiful work of art. This is not your typical chain pizza restaurant. It's clear that they take their product seriously. The sauce is perfect, the cheese is delicious. The crust is perfect. I could not have asked for anything more. This is authentic and the real deal. Will absolutely order it again and recommend to my friends. 10/10.

As I have read from others experience as well as my own, do not take your RV here for service.  I took my motorhome in for a long list of repairs.  I have a Newmar motorhome and they are a authorized Newmar service center. First of all it took them 8 months to give me back my coach, yes 8 months!  Of the 10 items to fix only 5 were actually done right.  The other 5 were either not done or not done right.  They eventually refunded me for 3 of them.  The other two worked when I tested it out before leaving but soon after they stopped working just like before I took it in to them.  Problems were from slideout issues, awning covers, windshield leak, and window and door seals.  My bill was over $4000 ( $1000 which I was eventually refunded ) $500 of the total bill was for time they spent trying to fix a problem but was unable to figure out the issue.  I could have taken my coach back but I live 250 miles from Nampa, Idaho and I didn't want to give them another 8 months!  If you like your RV and want things done right, stay away from this place!!! 

So the new service director did call me and offer to make things right.  Since I live so far away we agreed upon getting a refund for what was not completed or fixed properly.  
As stated in Megan's reply it was 5 months not 8, my mistake as it was 3 months more before I got my coach back as it was at a Spartan service center getting the speedometer fixed.  And no freightliner did not replace the speedometer, they charged for diagnostics but couldn't figure out the problem.  You also mention the bedroom window seal not completed but yet I was charged $99 for that.  I did put in a call the the service director to refund me that amount as well. 
It seem Bish's RV wants to do what's right and have made some necessary changes in personnel so their service department will conduct business according to the companies standards.

Original Review: 2/12/2016

What is it that makes a restaurant worthy of five star review.  My wife and I were discussing this as we visited Gino's tonight for our Valentine's Day dinner.  Consider this...  We have been going to Gino's regularly for at least the last 15 years, if not longer.  We loved them when they were in downtown Boise, and we have been going back regularly since they moved to Meridian.  I have sampled many items on the menu, while my wife often sticks with her favorite dish (the Beef or Lamb Shank with the gnocchi).  While some dishes are better than others (in my opinion) and sometimes things are better one evening compared to another, we have never left disappointed.  More often than not, we leave there talking about how good the meal was.  The Atmosphere is nice, the service is always great, and Gino typically checks in to make sure that things are good.  When we want to go out for a nice meal, Gino's has been our go-to place for some time.

Tonight, we started with the calamari (amazing!), then I had the Flat Iron Steak special (very good), and my wife had a seafood dish (sorry, can't remember what it was called) which was excellent.

So, when a restaurant has proven itself consistently over the years, and continues to deliver great food and service, that's when it gets five stars from me!

I highly recommend making reservations, especially on holidays or special occasions, since the place always seems busy when we are there.

----------

Updated Review: September 13, 2019

Quick update:  Gino's is still 5-stars for me!

Full update: My wife and I spontaneously decided to drop into our favorite Italian Restaurant on a Friday night, and we were so happy to learn that they had a table available!  I ordered one of the specials; a Halibut dish, and my wife ordered Veal Picatta.  All I can say is that my Halibut was memorably delicious.  The fish was served on a bed of Risotto, topped with some sprouts.  The presentation was beautiful. The outside of the steak was seared until it was crisp, and the inside was flavorful and tender.  The flavors that came together when sampling the fish, sprouts, and risotto together we simply a culinary delight.  Summary for me:  It was a wonderful meal.  Gino's hit another one out of the park.
We just walked away with a huge smile on my face and a BRAND NEW Travel trailer never bought anything new in my life Bish's took great care of us!

Well my spousal unit placed an order to pick up. 

I arrived and waited my turn at the door. When I said I was picking up my order for delivery, the gal asked for my name and phone number. And instead of going to retrieve my order, greeted the couple that just walked in behind me. 

She proceeded to take menus and drink orders and left me standing at the door. I felt totally disrespected and ignored. She didn't say she "will be back in a minute" or "let me seat these folks and I'll check". Anything?!!

Still waiting 10 minutes after the time they said my order would be ready to pick up as well. 

To be totally honest, I'm hoping the food is fantastic, but the quality of my experience so far has me thinking that I won't be back, just based on the service!
It's my one-stop for everything! The only reason I'm giving 4 stars and not 5 is that the mixed fruit (berries) have had mold the last couple of times.:(

Pretty good.  I hoped to have a more in-depth conversation that didn't feel rushed but I was happy to get in.  Period.

I'm one if the people that have a common issue but react uncommitted to standard treatment.  I was happy to get a new option and also have the PA suggest there might be a second problem and get a test ordered for that.

That's better than most Endos did in the past
Best pizza in Idaho!!! Great service and delicious salad bar. Wonderful family dining experience.

I love this car wash, was t too hard on your vehicle, did a good job.  I like all the bonus things they offer for free!! Mat washer for free did a great job, loved the rags to dry your car/truck.  Vacuums worked great!!! I will go back for sure

This store is beautiful and really well taken care of! Definitely feels like you're walking into a boutique instead of a used clothing store. 

Prices are a bit higher than other places, but the product is superior. (My only issue was seeing SHEIN tops for $12+ when they're usually under $5 brand new.) 

Most items seem dressier. This is a great spot for work clothes if you're in an office! Definitely where I would be shopping if that was my current lifestyle. 

I did walk out with a couple cute tops for under $30 - and they both look brand new to me. As did basically everything in the store. 

One thing I'm not a fan of is their buying practice. You consign an item, and if it doesn't sell in 45 days you 'donate' it to the store. You can't collect your items back and don't get paid until they're sold (you get 40% of the sale price). This does change if your item is sold for over $50. 

It's a great shop! I'll definitely be back.

Ordered on line at 9:09 and had a confirmation to pick up after 9:40.  Arrived at 9:35.  Waited until 9:58.  People who walked in after me were seated and served before my food was ready.  Got the standard COVID short staffed excuse.  If your going to take orders out of order then that excuse doesn't work.

Do what you say you are going to do and recognize customers doing takeout that their time is just as important as those in the restaurant.  Or don't offer take out - you still take my money so I should be just as important.

By the way the food was cold too and unimpressive.  Fifty minutes for eggs and toast doesn't cut it. Especially for $30..

If this was a one time thing I wouldn't bother with a review, but this is every time.

I used to be a HUGE Shige's fan, but after my experience today in the Meridian branch, I will never go here again. When we arrived at about 12:15, we sat down and there was the chef behind the counter doing his thing and he was friendly and great. I was disappointed by price change in fish, considering the $1 white plates were all primarily made up of faux shrimp, lettuce, cucumber, and rice (ie. the cheapest ingredients they have) and the $2 plates had a single piece of sushi with a small amount of fish in it, but we still tried to find things that looked good. The boats were not kept stocked, despite it being their lunch time. The chef disappeared from behind the bar at about 1 o clock and did not return for the rest of our duration, despite 95% of their boats being empty. I commented on this to the waitress, who did not even keep our water filled, and she told me she could get me a regular menu so that I could order something off of it and then proceeded to count our plates in front of us, despite me being clear that we were not done eating. I do not come to Shige's to order a roll that costs $15 that would cost me $6 if we ate the same amount of food off of the boats. Me and my two dining partners felt bullied into leaving and that they were trying to force us to order something off of the menu. Sad thing is, when we normally come in here, we usually spend about $60 on boats alone and probably would have again if they hadn't given us such poor service and practically pushed us out of the door. We all left hungry and dissatisfied, as did quite a few people around us.

Usually I am very pleased with my meal. I usually go to the Draper location in Utah. Today I went to the West Jordan location. I was charged more than usual. So prices have gone up. I ordered a full rice bowl half chicken half steak. I got it and the quantity of food in there was the same as a half bowl. I mentioned it. I was told they got a new manager so the portion sizes have been reduced. What?! Okay so I pay more for less. I will never go there again. And if that manager is making bad decisions like that good luck! Normally when I go in the draper location it has plenty of customers. This location has one other customer. And then one of the employees eating decided to belch extremely loud. He thought it was comical. I thought it was disgusting. I don't recommend going to this location. My meal was not worth the 13.00 I paid for it.

I read many of the negative posts for this restaurant and felt the need to post something positive.  

My daughter and I ate there tonight.  First, the service was amazing.  We never had to ask for refills because the server was on top of it. 

The Mama's spaghetti dinner is literally 3 servings of pasta!!!  I personally had the Chicken Scallopini and it was fresh, tasty and hot. Usually I can finish a dinner but I had left overs.  

We also tried the zucchini fritters and I was surprised that they looked like French fries but they were tasty and not greasy. 

My only negative thing to say was the Caesar dressing is a little sour tasting but overall the meal was great and I would go back again.

I cannot say enough good about Camp Bow Wow, Meridian. They are courteous, prpfessional, pleasant, caring and loving. When my dog and I went for our interview, I took the full tour. Very clean, spacious. Sugar Rae just boarded for 4 nights, I watched her a couple times a day on the webcams. She always was interacting, walking around, sniffing butts, you know normal dog behavior. I love that when I go visiting, my dog gets to go to camp! Camp Bow Wow! We will be back. Very good care of my buddy!

BCI is not helpful and changed their plans to force you to go to a GP first!  They could not even tell me if a specific provider was in-network so I had to call that provider and they confirmed that I did not need a referral and they were in network.  Why could they tell me and BCI couldn't!!??  This is to stifle care and reduce costs by making care less accessible.  I can get into my GP in maybe 2-3 weeks.  Horrible service.  Looking at new plans, although few and far between.. Good ole Obamacare... ugh... NOT!  No choices, no service!! That is how you reduce healthcare costs at the expense of Americans!

Ate here today for lunch.  Had the Pork and Seeds with hot mustard.  Very good but watch the mustard - it is hot.  Also the Mandarin Chicken with white rice, excellent with just the right amount of sauce on the chicken.

Food was disgusting, tasted like someone took old dog food chewed it up spit it out and warmed it up. Had a burrito and couple tacos. Legit will never come here again. Floor looks like no ones vacuumed it in years. If you're from California and want legit Mexican food just don't try it in idaho. I've been to almost every Mexican spot around meridian and they all taste the same... like ass

If you're looking for a salad, good grief go to a salad store. This place is about Pizza. Not just any pizza but a style of pizza prepared in a way that most people around here aren't used to if they've ever even heard of it. 
This is Pizza in the style of Naples, sort of. It's New York style Pizza. Years ago I was in New York and 1 thing you want to do in New York is go try some of the great, traditional pizzas.
