Grimaldi's is one of those and it's one of the originals. There's Lombardi's, Rays, Grimaldi's and a handful of others. The thing that makes them special besides the pizza is the cooking. COAL FIRED BRICK OVENS, that's right coal. So if you're of "the woke" persuasion, just go to Domino's and eat the box. This place ain't for you.
This was a place, where the line was too long to get in when I was last in New York City... kinda like Lombardi's.. the lines are long because of their long history and colossal reputation for the best ingredients.
This is a New York style, thin crust pizza, that is best done with simplicity in mind. Just one or two toppings is the way to go. I love their pepperoni pizza, or a simple sausage and mushroom. No Hawaiian, no tofu, just the finest quality pepperoni on a delicious thin crust and cooked in a traditional coal fired oven. The coal oven is key! So before you turn up your nose because your salad wasn't perfect, or because you want to shut down the coal industry and hate the idea of anyone using coal, remember what you went there for... a taste of a tradition that's been cherished since around 1905. 
It's Pizza in a style that few can do properly, and many actively seek out. A new generation of Grimaldi's family has taken over and decided to share their traditions with a number of select locations in the USA. So if you don't want to go to Scottsdale Arizona, or to New York itself, try to appreciate something special. A coal fired oven making you a quality New York Pizza.
Be thankful that you've been given this opportunity, or as my friend from Brooklyn would say,.. "it's real pizza. Shut up and eat it before it gets cold"...

It's the only pizza I will eat at my house... and keeping in mind what it is, it's worth it for you to at least try it.

I always enjoy my visits and food/drink from Clean Juice. Great selection of high quality options where you can really see what is being made and how it is being made. My favorite are the bowls. The taste is spot on with great presentation and really solid nutritional profiles. Great option for meals or post workout.

We bought a new Jayco trailer from them. The prices were great but even better was their customer service. This is my third RV and the first one from Bish's. They have a customer for life. Kudos to Dinko in sales and Nathan in service. It has been a very positive experience.

I would like to give a HUGE 5 Star to Luke in the service department.   I needed to be on the  other side of the State for a Very Important Event for my son.   Luke came in on a Saturday to check in my unit so I could attend.  Thank you, Thank you

I used to go to Wingers some time back when they were on Fairview. The location there was dark, drab and uninviting. Im happy to say that when they moved to the new locale off Eagle by Fast Eddies, they improved 1000 fold.

Its now more of a sports bar. I counted at least 15 TV's. The restaurant is clean and feels welcoming. I loved the look. 

My daughter and her new boyfriend, came here with me for a date. She is 16 and still goes on dates with her dad. How lucky am I?

When I went to the old location, they had pretty dang good burgers. As time went on though, they burgers, as well as the rest of their food had gone downhill. Im sure that is why they decided to move. I applaud their discussion.

I had a garlic burger. I love garlic, so just like in that movie Jerry Mcguire, they had me at "Garlic". The burger was pretty good on 1st bite and even on into the next few. It was juicy, flavorful, and smoky. When I looked under the hood (Aka lifting the bun and looking at the meat), I saw the garlic parmesan aioli. it had a good garlic taste, but looked a bit odd.

The burger is called the Garlic Breath Burger. A good name is everything. When I hear a burger called Garlic Breath, I expect that when I eat it, I will have Garlic dripping from my pours. The garlic flavor was ok, but I did not think it anywhere close to that strong. On my 1-10 scale, I would give the burger a solid 6.

After a few bites, the garlic flavor diminished and well as did the juice and smoky flavor. The fries that came with the burger tasted frozen. They had no flavor at all.

My daughter had Chicken Tortilla Soup. Do you remember that old commercial "Wheres the Beef?. Well, this was the same except in this case it was" Where or where did all the Chicken go". There was no chicken anywhere to be found and almost as little soup. My daughter told me the soup tasted curdled. It had very little flavor other that this. 

I would come here again for a burger, but if you make he mistake of ordering soup, you will need to learn the phrase; "NO SOUP FOR YOU"

I realize purchasing a camper/ trailer/ RV can be taxing and overwhelming, but this place is excellent.  The staff is so kind, helpful, and friendly that they make the experience worth your time.  

The facility is very clean and the staff is friendly.  We worked with Pat Silva, and he was incredible.  The finance staff is very nice and respectful to all customers.  

If  you are in the market for a recreational vehicle, please stop here they are great.
I really wanted to love this place but my nails look worse than they did when I walked in with a two week grow out from acrylics.

I've had açaí bowls from close to 50 different juice bars over the last decade. This was honestly one of the worst, period. In their defense we do live in Hawaii and we have some of the best. The Açaí blend didn't taste like anything. I had the nutty bowl, the base has cacao, banana, açaí and almond butter. Only 2 topping choices are banana and strawberry or banana and strawberry. No raspberries, blueberries, mango, pineapple, papaya , etc. No other toppings such as honey, agave etc. I guess I'm a little heated because the last juice bar in this exact location was Revitalize a couple years ago and they were honestly one of the best. Easily in my top 5 out of 50. It just amazes me  the difference in quality between 2 back to back juice bars in this location @ the Village. The employees should start looking for new jobs because this place will not last long unless there's a huge change for the better....or maybe not, if the population in Boise prefers sub-par juice bars.

First time I have dined in at a restaurant in 3 months. The tables have plenty of distance and staff all wore masks. That's the best I can say. Service was slow, no follow up by waitress so certainly the 'bottomless' soda and fries didn't happen. All of our fries were cold in delivery, almost done eating when warm fries arrived. Brownie in the brownie sundae was stale and hard.  Too many great burger places around to have to put up with this.

Red Robin is one of my go to spots for when I want good food. They're always friendly and work hard to make sure the customers are happy. Tonight Kiana was our server, she even remembered the dipping sauces my boyfriend and I get from a previous time we were in. That's real customer service! And the food is always amazing as well!

The good:
Friendly staff
Good portions and nice presentation.
Taste of food was good.
Seemed clean.

The bad:
Waitress messed up order--not horribly--but she should have written it down.
Chicken delivered instead of beef
Soup was barely warm
Main course was barely warm
Rice was barely warm; ordered white, got brown--but she caught the error about halfway through the meal.
Slow on drink refills (not busy inside--but may have been very busy for pickup or delivery).

It is worth one more try in a few weeks.  If the food is piping hot, it's all good.  If not, we'll keep looking.

One of the best massages, if not the best massage I've ever received.  Vonnie was super welcoming and really listened to my requests.  Her techniques were some of the best and she used hot stones as a great massage tool.  I would highly recommend giving Vonnie a call if you're in need of a high quality massage and are in the Boise/Meridian area.  I will definitely be back when I return to Boise!  Thanks again Vonnie!

Horrible management!! We were warned via very unprofessional signage (imo) of the "labor shortage" and the wait times this will incur. Now, we spent 3 hrs eating appetizers dinner and dessert. This was at the pace of service not my family mind you. I said NOTHING about wait times and am not complaining now about it. Just pointing out the resources they did have with staff was not utilized properly at all! After inaccurate order delivery, poor quality and astronomical wait times FOR EVERY ASPECT PF SERVICE FROM SEATING TO CHECK DROPPING. Now the real reason for this review is......the manager. She was clued in to what was happening in our corner or restaurant pretty quickly and besides being snarky rude unapologetic and barely helpful she did absolutely ZERO to remedy or even even show basic appreciate that we CHOSE to use out discretionary funds of over $100 w/tip at THIS restaurant instead of its MANY a competitors on this mile of eagle rd. 
To cap off an already crap visit that was marred by the staffs palpable attitude in which made my table and 2 others around us feel like a burden and all walking on eggshells to the extent the couple behind me wouldn't even order drink refils. That was annoying and again, made us feel poorly and regret the $$ spent but my family and another had expressed frustration with food temperature and quality let alone service to no avail. Yet.... The 60+ WHITE MALE that was setaed near us complained in the first 20ins and had his meal paid for and attentive service. 
I guess you have to be WHITE MALE to be treated worth any level or semblance of effort.

Our first Interstate battery died after less than one year, it was replaced.  After the second one wouldn't hold a charge, they refused to replace it, saying, "there is nothing wrong with the battery."  We took the vehicle to Husky's Auto Electric, who confirmed the battery was bad.  We will never by another Interstate battery, period.  They do not stand behind their products, and were dishonest in their assessment of the second battery.

Very busy for mid-morning on a Tuesday but worth the wait which was about half an hour. 

Tried their Chilaquiles which has a very delicious pork verde sauce.  Served with eggs over chips.  I did ask for extra sauce as there wasn't enough to moisten the chips and could have used a little more cheese. 

Service by Shelby was with a smile, high energy, and happy to be there.  

Will come back.

Never been here, and my impression was its an artisan pizza ria, with hand made meatballs, and pizza straight like you're in NY, but, um, no. Bruschetta was something I could have made in my kitchen, with cheap bread, and just some diced tomatoes tossed in top. Very unappealing to the eye. Not to mention, I've never been anywhere that gives you small containers with oil and balsamic to pour over it. There was only enough oil and balsamic for one piece, so I had to ask for more. Got charged $4. Nice. 
Got a side of meatballs. Came out and immediately knew, I wouldn't be back. You can tell they are just frozen little balls. Ate one, bout puked. Straight up told the server these are terrible, had him take it away. Pizza was nothing special.

I don't want to discourage people from going to small businesses but this place is not good. They were very friendly but unfortunately that didn't make the service or food better. It was by far the worst sushi I have ever had. I've bought pre-made from supermarkets that was better.  We ordered soup before the sushi that didn't show up till after the sushi. Blah blah, no need for long story. It was just a bad experience and the food was very low quality. Sorry.
When we arrived we were told 35-40 minute wait. After an hour we decided to take our business elsewhere. Let's hope they clean house and turn this establishment around. So sad...

It is extremely hard to skip out on a place that I have trusted for so many years that is extremely close to my house.  I decided to bite the bullet and went back to this Les Schwab first for tire rotations and then for a major shock repair.  I could tell that things have definitely improved since my last dismal experience.  What impressed me the most was on a Saturday almost a half-hour after closing time, an employee who was on his way out took the time to stop and help me get my truck back, which I had dropped off earlier that day.

My confidence and faith has been restored.  No longer do I have to make the aggravating drive to Meridian for the Les Schwab quality service!  Great job to everyone!

The deal on wings made it worth the stop. The waitresses are much more concerned with pleasing the regulars at the bar, which makes sense.

Wish I could have gotten takeout
Awesome service and great food best phillys in town love the mushroom soup it's the best!

This has to be the best breakfast I've ever been to! Everyone is courteous, make you feel like family, and the freshly squeezed orange juice is to die for. Come here to eat, you won't be disappointed.

This place has gone downhill. I ordered the carne Asda torta. Very little meat, unripe tomatoes, bread over toasted
This place used to be one of my favorites. What happened?
Another fantastic experience at Fujiyama. They never cease to impress. If you get a chance, I highly recommend coming here for the best sushi in the treasure Valley

This is in response to Jalene's review of today.  We were actually in Famous Dave's at the time, and things did not go as badly as portrayed.  I assumed, by the manner in which they left, they'd be leaving a bad review, & I was right! 
We weren't gawking or eavesdropping, so I don't know everything play by play, but the customer service was not nearly as bad as she's portraying it.  
Their family came in & the staff was accommodating the gentleman in the wheelchair.  They were doing their best to seat their family & set them at a table.  There was some comment about a higher table & not sure what all was said, but it was a friendly discussion & everyone seemed to be happy about the resolution.  
We never got any chips either, but we didn't throw a hissy fit about it.  Based on our visits in the past, I think it just depends on the server, if you ask, they'll bring em.  
This family was not even there 15 mins, maybe 10 mins tops, after the seating situation was resolved.  So, to say that another family came in, got seated & got chips, while they were ignored, is not accurate.
I'm guessing they didn't get service as quickly as they'd like, it happens, it's happened to us at restaurants before, so they left.  But they were NOT sitting there for 15 mins ignored.
As far as the restaurant, the food is good.  We've never had a complaint.

So disappointed after a year was excited to come here onion rings cool fries cool bathrooms dirty. Told manager about food said she would take care of it but did nothing she could of at least remove the onion rings from bill. Won't be coming here again

Dr.Mark and the Paramount Animal Care staff are the only ones I trust to care and treat my cat. Dr. Mark takes the time to talk to tell me about what's going on with my cat and provides quality, professional  advice I can trust. They love the animals as if they are their own.

Does not honor rewards coupons sent my the rewards program. 

I tried to order online the the rewards email I received. I then called the restaurant and ordered by phone. I was told to bring in the email and they would honor it. When I arrived I was told I needed to login to my account in order to receive the $4 dollars off your next purchase of $10. They did not honor the rewards email or the email I showed them. The manager did not even bother to come out and talk to me. Keep sending out a server. I have since deleted my rewards account and have unsubscribed to the emails. I will not be eating at Red Robin ever again. I don't care which location. If they do not honor what they send out. That means they are not a trustworthy company.

I am glad I continued trying this place before writing a review.  My first couple experiences, I couldn't figure out why the stellar reviews.  I think it was the 3rd of 4th time, I had a great experience and had another one today so I thought I would write the review.

From the beginning, I was totally impressed with the decor and feel of this place.  Very nicely done.  Comfy tables and chairs with a cozy fireplace.  I haven't seen it lit yet but it does give off a nice ambiance.

I am still wondering why I didn't get enjoy the first couple visits.  The last couple visits, I tried a few dishes that really stood out and it changed my perspective of this place.  The dishes I really enjoyed were the General Tsao Chicken, Spicy Mandarin Chicken, Honey Almond Chicken (comes in Shrimp too) and their fried rice. These dishes were terrific and I highly recommend them.

I have always received excellent customer service by the staff.  Food is out promptly and I really appreciate a free appetizer to snack on while waiting for your meal. I think their pricing is fair and I am really thankful for a new Asian restaurant in town.  If you have eaten here and didn't enjoy it, continue trying different items until you find something you like.  It happened to me and I am glad for the great reviews on Yelp that lead me to continue giving this place a shot.

My co-worker comes here often and brought a few of us to shop around. I quickly noticed they had few items in small sizes, so I picked through jewelry as everyone else finished browsing. They each managed to find at least 2 - 5 items.  

They get points for cute ensembles on display. 

Nothing spectacular, and whether you find anything is a toss-up. The only things I saw which caught my eye was a pair of Jimmy Choo heels for $24, but they didn't fit.  Also saw a few Banana Republic / Gap shirts, Jessica Simpson heels, and Nine West sunglasses. 

The dresses aren't cheap, and I'd get nicer earrings shipped from Hong Kong on ebay for maybe $3-5. Shirts are around $7-15, depending on what you're getting. If you like this place, they have punch cards. 

If you want to consign your things, they'll show it for 45 days and give you 40% of the selling price. 

I gave Renewed Expressions a try, but I won't be back. I'd recommend trying TJ Maxx or Marshalls (or even.... ROSS) for comparable prices on NEW clothes and a better selection.

Cute place. Great ambience. Dinner time there will be a wait. Suggestion: when asking a potential diner if they'd like to wait, it would be super helpful to let them know if the signature pizza is available. Our waiter let us know that the "basil didn't make it on the truck today." Wow. It seems to me that if basil is a main ingredient on your main dish, you'd either figure out a way to get said basil, or let your patrons know before adding them to the waitlist that there is a menu change. Just a suggestion.
Other than this minor detail, the service was nice. Waiter was great. It may be awhile before I can convince the super finicky husband to try again.
Service was very mediocre my last visit and waitress seemed very unresponsive since I was a single customer

Really solid fast Mexican food here. The mixed breakfast burrito is my favorite breakfast burrito in Boise.

The food quality overall is very good and everything is cooked fresh so it always tastes great too. I really like that they are open 24 hours because you can always count on a good meal. Their drive through service can be a bit slow and the food sometimes runs a bit to the greasy side even for Mexican.

The people really make the place, they are always friendly and willing to do whatever you like to make your food the way you want it. They have a great salsa bar and you can get it as hot as you like here!

Los Betos is rapidly becoming a Boise institution and I'm glad for that!

Awesome atmosphere! Modern decor and unique artistic touches throughout. Drinks for the coffee lover and people looking for something a little different. Lots of flavors to add to rockstars for those who are into energy drinks. Great location- next to a highway, a main thoroughfare, close to shopping, near a high school, and nestled closely to subdivisions making it a perfect place for those late night study sessions a little closer to home.

Bish's RV in Meridian, Idaho has had our brand new Jayco Hummingbird trailer for THREE MONTHS. They're supposed to be doing warranty work. We call and get the same run around that the materials have been ordered, but never show up. Buyer beware!

I would rate the service as pretty good (hence the 4 stars) but the food has always been fantastic! I prefer them any day of the week over other Mexican fast food places. The portions are huge and the prices are very reasonable. I always order either the Carne Asada or Carnitas burritio or the Legua (tongue) tacos. I always joke and say Im Mexican by marriage (my wife is Hispanic) and I eat a lot of Mexican food. So as for fast Mexican food this place gets my vote.
Great food, service is slow though. I've only been there twice and same experience each time. The wait was a bit long too.
The best sushi place in Boise area. Prefer Meridian location, but food and service are the best at both locations. Highly recommend. There are no rolls we didn't love. Decor is very nice as well.
Gave us the wrong order, when it was time to pay they gave us the wrong bill, service was terrible.
One of our favorite places to stop and get a quick bite. Jay walks around the tables taking care of every one of your needs- you're bound to have a good experience.

I'm very disappointed in this frozen yogurt shop. I walked in and the gal working was really nice and friendly. She explained how it works and as I walked over to look at the flavors, I was so disappointed. All they had was chocolate, mint, Vanilla and peanut butter ect. There was no variety. The only fruit flavor there was was not even yogurt. I tried a couple flavors but they were all horrible! Too sweet, not that flavorful and blah. I would love to see fruit flavor yogurt and tart flavors, something other then "ice cream" flavors. I ended up getting plain chocolate and it was good, just not what I wanted.
New to Idaho and found this salon that was able to get me in pretty quickly. Erin did a great job. And didn't have to wear a mask!

Awful company, I would never use them if I owned or had to rent again.  The company is incredibly shady and unprofessional.  Communication is extremely poor.  When the house was for sale, I heard similar complaints from the realtor about the company being a pain to work with.  I'm an extremely patient, easy, and responsible renter and I've never left a poor review for anyone I've rented for until now - and I've been living in cheap rental units under $500 for 10 years, so I've dealt with a lot of these kinds of companies.

The first day I walked in the place was completely flooded, because their maintenance crew had turned the heat off completely in January and a pipe froze.  It took a month to move into my place, 3 months later and a lot of nagging they finally caulked the toilet to the bathroom floor (really simple thing that should have been done before I moved in, or at least on the first request).

My refrigerator broke and it took them 3 weeks to replace it, and a lot of nagging.  When I finally wasn't getting any response from their maintenance supervisor I emailed PJ who said that Pat (maintenance) suddenly left the country and I had probably called his house phone (nope, it was the number he had texted from - definitely a cell).  

They painted my house at one point without telling me while I was out of town, moved all of my stuff stored in the shed and didn't put it back, so I came back to a yard sale outside my door.  

Of course I haven't gotten my security deposit back - because I left my key in the locked apartment instead of their lock box.  Apparently that warrants a $425 deposit??  I have filed a Consumer Complaint against them.  I'm not counting on my deposit, but I would be happy if they went out of business.  Ethical and respectful business practices go a lot further than scamming low income renters.  Its a shame this guy ran his parents company into the ground.

WOW! Did I walk into a designer store or a thrift shop?? The prices were insane high for used clothes! We are talking about $15-$25 for a used pair of jeans that weren't even a high end brand! INSANE HIGH PRICES! Good selection.... If you are size 00 to 5!! Seriously!? Anything over a 6 or so was in the back in a little hidden back room and it was mostly junk! Junk that was priced the same as the stuff in the front!

We went here for the first time in a long time. The 20-minute wait was okay, but then they expected us, a 70-year-old couple to wait outside in 100 degree heat. Wouldn't let us sit inside on a bench.  Wonder if they would have been willing to pay our hospital bill if we'd stayed.
One of your employees has been very rude. He has messaged me horrible, nasty things. People who work with the public shouldn't act the way he's been acting. I'm never coming to this location.

The waitress we had was really sweet and did a good job. But the food was absolutely terrible. It was not seasoned at all. Very bland and basic. The best thing we had there was our son stated tots that came with his meal. I had the sourdough burger and my husband has the bbq bacon burger. Not at all appetizing. Also had the salad bar and it was very small. I would not go back.

I normally love Black Rock coffee but recently there has been a big turn over of employees and now my drink is always made incorrectly.  I'll repeat what I ordered when I grab it and they say that's what I have but it hasn't been right in a while now.   Everyone is always super kind but I think management needs to go over the basics of making the drinks again.

Average pizza at this location, nothing special.  Restaurant seemed slightly dirty and disorganized.  Staff didnt know what specials were offered.  With all of the pizza restaurants available, I would expect them to be better at what they do.

We loved it so much the first time that we had to come back before we left town. We were lucky enough to get Shelby again and she was just as wonderful today! She did a great job taking care of our massive 12 top, everyone was happy with their order. 

We ordered the Idaho Potato Nachos (mine) and holy cow, I didn't realize how freaking amazing they were going to be. Unbelievably good people! The bacon and jalapeño were just so good together. The wife went for more of a lunch option with the philly which was also great! 

I cannot wait until next time we come into town so I can come back and try more of their wonderful food!

The best sushi in town. Always friendly and helpful. They take time to prepare your order perfectly. They are very artistic and the presentation is wonderful. Always enjoy our time and food and service. Recommend 100%

This place is close to mah hart n' mah sole. Best breakfast burritos I know of in Idaho. Get it smothered in gravy. Most things in life are good smothered in gravy. Trust me on this one. Get the breakfast burrito. (Steak or Corned beef) and get it smothered in sausage gravy.

These guys are amazing! Highly recommend them for business taxes. Worked with them for two years and never had a problem. The office staff are friendly and kind and they work late into the night to get things done.

Stopped by to see if my sunglasses could be repaired. I was met at the door during this challenging time in health by the most friendly and smiling optometrist. She didn't promise that my glasses could be repaired. I waited outside while she worked her magic...YES, she repaired my glasses. BUT the most important thing here is that I will definitely return here for other services because the friendly, kind customer service made my day. I drove away smiling because of it! Kudos!

This is a sorry excuse for a restaurant. The food is AWFUL and it really NEEDS a deep clean.
I've tried it more than once maybe thinking my expectations were too high, but no, this place is REALLY bad, won't be going back 
Rating for me is negative
Love Costa - Cafe WHO lol - great team, great food, fresh as always, service was great friendly staff
Yet another incompetent group of morons. Forgot my chicken strips you idiots. What a joke of a place.
It was very clean and all the food was delicious. They have really good Biscuits & Gravy!

I had been taking my pets here for years. Unfortunately the service I had been getting changed dramatically. From feeling like they really cared for you and your pets well being, we started feeling like just a number on a sheet of paper. With the last visit almost taking an hour to be seen... we decided to take our " furry children" somewhere else.

Horrible service.  They sure spray the tables down, but it's like they forget to wipe them up before seating you so bring your own towels to dry your seats.  Did not get refill on drinks.  Waitress barely visited are table.  They sure like to mingle and sit around while tables around us stay dirty and unclean.  When she did we had told her that they messed up are dish and their was mushrooms in the dish she apologized for it but then never said anything else or removed it from our bill. Will not return.

Overall a great experience and evening! There were 11 adults and 8 kids in our party. The staff accommodated us well and took great care of us all.  We enjoyed various dishes from burgers to breakfast, pot roast to chicken fried steak. 
Also a big shout out to ELIZABETH for diligently treating us so well, and also Vanessa who served with a smile, too! 
Delicious food and terrific service and staff!!
Will definitely be back

Mike & his team helped us with two projects (the second one was insane but they figured it out, haha). They show up on time & the results were outstanding. Mike is very kind & easy to communicate with. We look forward to using them for future projects & recommending this company to others!
Great place to bowl with a group or just a date night. I have been to birthday parties, school trips, and Christmas parties there.
knowledgable and comprehensive care.  I've been a patient for several years now.  First for thyroid and pre diabetes interventions, now for peri menopausal symptoms.  great care
We were going to try them. Plenty of open seats but a 25 minute wait with the hostess sitting in a booth. Walked out.
Service is exceptional here. Cozy atmosphere and cannot go wrong with anything you order. Great wine/beer selections. This should be a footprint that restaurateurs strive for!

Another excellent find for the Italian fare that we stumbled upon today merely because we were in the area for a Volleyball tournament. It's probably a good thing we live over 30 miles away or I'd be overfed and broke. 

It was fairly early when we stopped in, about 3:50 on a Saturday night, and there were only a few patrons inside. However, by the time we finished our meal, including dessert, it was around five and people were starting to emerge out of the woodwork. I think I'd suggest reservations for evening just to be sure you have a table. 

Our server, Jennifer, was awesome, even if she jokingly gave me a bad time at the encouragement of my wife!  Jennifer knew the cuisine very well and her suggestions were on target for our first time here. The menu is quite extensive, and you will most likely have a hard time deciding what to choose. 

We started out with stuffed mushrooms for appetizers, and these were nothing like what we've ever had before. A slightly breaded mushroom making a crusty outside with delicious marinara sauce, cheese, spices and sausage on the inside. You can also choose meatball if you wish. These were $9 for six of them, but very well worth the price. 

Almost forgot, the bread with the most heavenly oil and garlic mixture started us off. Mouth watering. They have two styles of bread, one during the lunch hours and a sourdough during he evening hours. With our arrival, we got a mixture of both and not one complaint from us. 

I had the vegetable alfredo for a main course while my wife had a dish called Pollo Maria, so named after the mother of the owner, Gino. Both were entrees were amazing.

My wife was pleased rwith the selection of wines available, and again, Jennifer knew excellent choices for my wife to have during the pre-dinner samplings as well as her main course. I had to be a good boy due to Doctors orders after surgery!  I had the iced tea which was great. None of that stale tea taste here. 

For dessert we had a creme brûlée and a chocolate/Marion berry torte. Why do they make such tempting things to eat!! You won't be disappointed if you save room. 

Not sure if this happens every night or if it was due to the weekend, but the owner was there, dressed like a true Italian (he'd have made my Italian Grandma proud!), and was a hands on-making sure things go smoothly person. Made it a point to make contact with everyone to ensure their meal experience was going well. 

There is a small bar area to sit at with about six bar stools, and forgive Meir I'm wrong, but I believe there were four 4 chaired high top tables directly in front. I believe the tables are to be seated by the hostess also. The bar area is just inside the door and to the right behind he hostess. 

Warmer weather allows for the outside seating area to be enjoyed, and he italian music will keep you smiling during your time here.

Frustrated with the rude staff in the pharmacy.  I shared this with Allison, and she told me to go ahead and share.  My prescription got rejected from my carrier, which has been covering my prescriptions for over a decade with Walgreens.  In fact, I just picked up a prescription a couple of weeks ago from them.  The staff didn't want to work with me and figure out why it was rejected, and when I said that I was going to take my business elsewhere, she told me to go ahead and do it.  They also refilled the wrong prescription (1x a day instead of 2x a day, as the updated Rx is supposed to be).  My insurance covered the 1x a day a couple of weeks ago, but bounced back the other one.  This is a mistake on their part and they didn't want to fix it.  They lost a long time customer.
Open when everybody else was closed. Fast as fuck. Good was awesome but they forgot the cheese quesadilla. I was looking forward to that cheese quesadilla.
Closed. They didn't pay rent and will not be opening back up. They have been evicted. Please don't go here.

Correction to my 8/31/17 review.  Brandon Roundtree is the Business Manager.  He provided pricing support to Chris and Mike throughout the process.  We were making a few changes that kept this team after hours and did not feel rushed by any one.  Not something we like to do as everyone likes to get home on time.  Again, great folks and great place!

We went here for an impromptu (we didn't want to cook) dinner and were so pleasantly surprised. My husband had the Beef dip sandwich and said it was the best he has ever had. I had the Carne Asada Ensalada ( salad with steak). It was very good. We shared the tempura asparagus spears appetizer. My husband is lucky I shared. They were so tasty. 

Johnny was our waiter. He was very attentive and helpful, plus super friendly. We had a great meal and the atmosphere was lovely. We will be back. There are more items on the menu we want to try.

It's been a couple years since I was last at Gino's, however I was pleasantly surprised the food and service were still top-notch during a recent visit. My wife and I enjoyed a great meal together, thanks to our hostess getting us a table without a reservation (recommend making a reservation if possible), and our waiter was very attentive. Awesome neighborhood restaurant in North Meridian. Highly recommended!

This is a fantastic restaurant! The atmosphere is great and the service was spot on! They offer a great food and spirit selection! We had a table of four and ordered a chicken dish, burger, steak and a french dip. It was all amazing!! It's a smaller intimate restaurant that has a lounge feel so conversation with people at our table was easy. TVs are strategically placed to watch the game. This is a great addition to Eagle and a much needed nice sit down restaurant. We will for sure be back.

We ordered Costa Vida with delivery from GrubHub, the food was great everybody was happy with it there was 14 of us. GrubHub delivered on time was very nice would also give them six stars. We had a great food great day great company.
I love this place! Always my go to quick bite! Healthy, great flavor, fast, clean and friendly staff! Has vegetarian options too! I will always support costa Vida!

So good! What more can I say! Eggs Benny was delicious, Cuban was wonderful and breakfast burrito and omelet were great! We will
Be going back! Staff was friendly, prompt, and accommodating to our substitutions we needed for  a special diet. Busy place, now I know why. I would recommend them, we will be back! 
Yummy!

Once you're in they're pretty friendly, efficient and So far they've been helpful in balancing hormones and offering good advice/prescriptions. 
However, getting them to call you back or answer the phone is borderline impossible. So frustrating when you have a followup question about doses or administration of medicine.

7/31/21 about 5pm. Service was terrible, very, very slow envethogh restaurant was mostly empty. Placed order that was advertised on TV. 5 for $15 that included a steak. Someone came out to tell us they no longer offer that special and added they have no steaks in the business.  Ok, we re look at the menu finding that they have a steak offering in the menu. We choose the dinner for two. We pick identical meals, (pizza, entree, side and dessert). We get the pizza fine, then entree comes and both are not what we ordered and not even the same. So after an hour waiting, a different person came out apologizing, fixed one meal and I decided to just eat what I was given.
Summing up, most likely will not be back. If no stars were avail, they would receive none.

Food is always good at the red Robin, but the service is not good you have to wait an hour to an hour and a half just to eat because they've closed down most of the place the bar is not even open and people are waiting in their cars to be able to eat, what a sad situation for a good burger place in Meridian Idaho

When you're in the mood for that something more than just a burger and fries this is the place for you.  You will pay a little more than you will for a combo meal at the fast food chain burger shop, but the quality and quantity of food is worth it.  Nothing is deep fried.  Everything is fresh and you can choose. From a fresh sandwich, soup, salad, or hot dog.
As good as it gets. 1/2 off wine on Tuesday. Best pizza in Idaho!

Greg (the store manager) is extremely helpful. I came in to order a set of Michelin Premier LTX for my Edge after being turned away from Costco due to a back order. Greg got the tires ordered with the ETA of Friday (I came in on Monday) with even a better price that what Costco had quoted me. I was a little bit skeptical about the ETA since Costco couldn't get them ordered. Friday came and I got a call from Greg saying that the tires are at the shop. I come in the next day and out in 30 mins with a new set of tires. After talking to Greg, it turned out that he couldn't order them from Michelin due to a back order, so he started calling other vendors and found me a set. So, thank you Greg for his service and also to his staff for a quick service.
The dough is lighter than most in the area.  The sauce is great, the toppings are flavorful and the artichoke bruschetta was awesome.  Really a great place to eat. No complaints.
Solid place to come. Nice clean. Fun. Great place to watch a game. Good food and good beer.

I've boarded my German Shepherd here for 3 vacations and multiple times for day camp. Every single time I've come in for drop off, pick up or called with a question I received great customer service. 
I often check on Chase through the webcam and it's always so nice to see the caretakers petting the dogs, giving them a side pat or a quick gentle ear rub. I truly feel like my dog is cared for and not just being babysat. 
Usually when we leave Chase decides to not eat for the first couple days. When I called to check on him they told me they hand feed him and got him to eat! I was so happy they went the extra mile to care for my pet. Plus, they end the call with, "feel free to call us anytime with a question."
I honestly believe Chase enjoys being there. He puts the breaks on when we go to the vet but when we pull up at CBB, he pulls to go inside with excitement.
Carino's has always been good to us.  The food is excellent, and I really enjoy the atmosphere.  The wait staff is very attentive, and we eat there about once a month.
Great food and atmosphere! Service by April is the best. She knows what's good and took great care of us! Don't drive by and look like we did for too long. Stop and enjoy!!

We went to Red Robin for my sons birthday, per his request.  The two asthmatics in out party were forced to wear mask for the 30 foot walk to our table.  Apparently, that is corporate policy.  At least the masks could be removed once we were seated,
It has been a while since we had been at Red Robin, but the burgers seemed smaller and definitely weren't as good as they use to be.  I don't think we will be coming back.

they are liquidation sales next week here in meridian,idaho  toys r us
hope they can find a buyer or it going to be close

The food portions are massive here! The garlic fries were great with a almost sauce over them. I've had their garlic fries at a different location and they were a little bit different with actual garlic. I'd prefer the more actual garlic over the sauce but still good. I ordered 3 of the salmon tacos thinking I would eat them all but the tacos were so big there was no way and on top of the chips. Great meal if you are starving on a long road trip.

Wait was 40 min to dine in. Ordered salmon, way over cooked and very dry. Ordered vegetables and it was 99% cabbage, which was bitter.
They cater to online orders.
Need Flame Broiler back!

The good: our server was friendly, attentive and efficient and my steak was cooked perfectly . The bad: my wife ordered the Tavern Chicken and it was tasteless and chewy. My side was a baked potato, yuck !! How can you screw up a baked potato? It came out room temperature, with a few pieces of blackened burnt bacon that you couldn't chew, buried in butter with, what looked like, a little Taco Time cheese under the butter. For a $70.00 meal it wasn't worth it, we won't be back. There are so many more delicious options a few miles away.

Always had great service and food before but ordered over $100 worth of food and they crammed it into one box that was just folded not even tapped on the bottom and it made it about 3 feet into our door before spilling all over the place. Annoying but the worse part was when we contacted the store their response was " I've never heard of one of our boxes collapsing."
Well now you have and you lost a loyal customer too.

I've been here twice so far and it's a great place and close to home!  Great prices on drinks and a large menu - last Friday there was a lot of items temporarily unavailable but still a lot of options.  Service is pretty good. Good place to take a group to please everyone palates especially if drinks and beers will be involved!

Go someplace else!!   Got my nails done there on a Friday afternoon. The guy, the husband to the lady that is the primary person up front was sooo rude to me, it was unbelievable.  Did not speak or acknowledge my hello, just glared at me.  Was just almost hostile to me while he did my manicure. I guess he was mad I was just getting a manicure and not an expensive service.... If you don't like to do manicures, don't offer them as a service you do!   Never once said 'thank you, kiss my rear, or goodbye' when I left.  3 nails were chipping by Sunday.
HORRIBLE, HORRIBLE PLACE!

Place is awesome !!!

The food is great, reminds me of being on a tropical island 

Mark

My neighbor buddy and I take turns picking up the tab once a week for lunch and we've found ourselves back at Red Robin quite often I love the  their Banzai Burger - incredible flavor.  The garlic fries with dippin sauce - so tasty.  We were seated in Lori's section the first visit and she made us feel like old friends so we've stuck with her. Something special about a person like her that knows your beverage of choice and almost has it on the table as you sit down. The manager is a heck of a nice fellow too. This is as upscale a restaurant specializing in burgers as you will find!

Excellent staff and the food was as good if not better. Had the traditional eggs and hash, was not overly cooked or seasoned. Wife had the California Benedict and had to stop her from licking the plate in the middle of the restaurant.

Very disappointed in Meridian, ID Red Robin. My daughter wanted to go there for her 11th birthday (she always picks Red Robin). It was very busy when we arrived. They told me that the wait would be 40-50 min. I gave them my name and number. After about 70 minutes my dad asked how much longer it would be and we were told that we weren't on the list! One of the employees tried to say the did call us (which I know they hadn't , I had no missed calls on my phone and we were all sitting right there the entire time listening for my name). Another employee told us it would be about another 40 min but then after the man who took my information the first time told them we had already been waiting for over an hour...they said we would be seated next group to be seated. We had a group of 6 so I completely understood why they proceeded to sit a couple, and then 3 groups of four but then they sat a group of 8 I was no longer understanding. What was supposed to be a 40-50 min wait turned into a 90 min wait. I understand that people make mistakes but there was no effort made to try to right their wrong. Our waitress, Keana was polite. The food was fine. But our overall experience was awful.  Horrible customer service!

We have been to Moe Joe's at least a dozen times over the last couple of years. Consistently great breakfast dishes, regardless if you're in the mood for something sweet or salty! Their biscuits and gravy are the best in town - both are made from scratch and those biscuits are divine. The pancakes are fluffy and filling without the chalky consistency you sometimes find at breakfast joints. The restaurant itself is pretty cramped, and it can get quite cold in there during the winter. Parking can be a challenge when the place gets really busy. If you're willing to deal with those minor things and possibly a long wait, then you won't be disappointed with your Moe Joe's experience!

We are regular visitors at Grimaldi's and have even had our favorite pizza from Grimaldi's delivered to our house. We always have a great experience. It has a great atmosphere and the service is always reliable. We like the 'small' salad that feeds 3 people or get a large for the whole table. Our favorite by far is the Brooklyn Bridge pizza with ricotta cheese and fresh basil. They also have wine specials during happy hour. The patio is great in warm weather but we have braved a blizzard for a family reunion there! This remains a top fave for our whole family!

I started going to Karlee for my hair coloring when she was still in beauty school. I followed her to this salon, and her skills have only gone up! 

My first balayage with Karlee was the later part of May. Before then, my hair had been processed twice from virgin Asian hair. I had a coppery balayage. 

Karlee lightened my hair dramatically, but without compromising the integrity of my strands! She was careful to make sure that my hair didn't look damaged. I initially went in wanting a silver balayage, but anyone that has done research on hair coloring knows that silver is a hard color to achieve, and is only a demi-permanent tone. 

Taking the balayage that I had with Karlee (first image) I began toning at home occasionally with purple shampoo and got a beautiful beige/lilac color! Depending on how frequently I toned, it would either be more beige or more lilac. 

But the most important part about this is that Karlee knows how to BLEND like a master. I had my balayage from her untouched from May until October. The rootage did not look unnatural, it always looked fresh. The middle pictures were taken during the summer, at different points. You can see how the color varied depending on how much I toned it. Even Karlee was shocked at how well the balayage held up, the picture in the salon chair was her work of curling (I had her curl my hair for senior pics). 

The last picture is my most recent color! I went in wanting rose gold and got exactly what I wanted! Karlee also brought up the lightener and told me that my hair was ready to change to a different tone any time I would like, without applying lightener again!

Lastly, Karlee's pricing is AFFORDABLE. Balayages are $60 and if you want to tone your hair but not lighten it in between processes, it's only $15! 

Quality hair with a quality girl, once you have Karlee do your hair you'll never look to someone else! Check out her Instagram: @karleepenacosmetology

Have been going to Dr. Ryan and Dr. Ana for years along with my family.  Always feel satisfied that I am treated as an individual and not just a name on today's schedule.  From the front desk to the exam assistants to the lens/frame crew...top notch all around.  There's a reason we keep going back and it has to do with the way they all treat us.

This is by far my favorite Italian restaurant in the treasure valley. I have been to a few but this one has the best flavor, atmosphere and service. Both pictures I added are from this past summer when it was still warm and enjoyable to sit outside. Their appetizers are seriously all good. Loved their calamari the best!

Went to dinner with the family for the first time here. We sat in the bar area as they were very busy. Jessica, the bartender, was our server. She was incredible! Spent so much time helping us navigate through the wonderful menu. We felt so taken care of and everything we ordered was exactly how she described. I can honestly saucy this was the best service we have ever had anywhere, and we are foodies! Highly highly recommend!

The service dept was not very helpful & kinda condescending. The sales & financing end was spot on.Dinko (Sales) & Chase (financing) we're both very helpful, courteous & honest. Would love to have dealt with them the whole time. 
As soon as service happened.. oy.. didn't clean the units ( even though they said they did), but there definitely was evidence quite to the contrary. When we had problems, they were dismissive & kept our motor home 2 weeks & didn't replace or for that matter even ORDER our replacement parts for our warranty work. Yep, still not fixed. Ryan tried to be helpful , but don't think the problems with service are his problem. Thinking that is just their policies. 
Won't be back to Bish. Not because of sales  or financing. Service is a problem. If you spend that much money you would think they would be better at well.. service
My all time favorite Japanese restaurant in Idaho. Everything is so fresh and has SO much flavor. You're missing out if you don't make it here.

Wingers is a great place to go for lunch..  Though I haven't been here before, this is my 1st experience at wingers. I gotta say its fantastic. And even thats an understatement. 

The quality is pretty darn awesome. I recommend this place not just for the food but they also offer a great deal. One thing they do I give heavy props for is give you winger certificates for donating to JDRF which helps kids with diabetes I. I added a picture of it. 

Come here you wont be disapointed at all

I was really surprised with how good their food was! I looked at the menu and had no idea what to get so I picked a burger. My boyfriend and I were skeptical about the pineapple on our burgers but it was amazing!!!!! Definitely one of the best burgers we have had
Guy did a half job trimming my beard for 8 minutes while drinking coors at noon on a Saturday. Won't go back.

I am delighted with my blindsource buying experience from styles and colors to fully installed -  my blinds and shutters are beautiful, high quality and all function exactly in the way I hoped and expected.   They were ery patient with me - I had them come back twice, they delivered my blinds before the estimated date, the shutters followed in the time frame they promised, and everyone I dealt with from Sales to Installation was terrific.
My husband and I tried it for dinner tonight and loved it! Our waitress Tammy was great and reccomend beef skewers and sliders and man they didn't disappoint!! We will be back!!
New to area & this will be a go to place for dinners. They won ton chip were excellent. Delicious & food sized portions. Staff was very friendly & prompt.

While I love their bacon brussel sprouts and shrimp Maria, the bulk of their menu is salty and just not very good.   The bread is very poor quality with weak taste.  Overpriced for the quality.  The quantity of the dishes are good, but the quality preparation is lacking. 

There are better Italian restaurants around the Treasure Valley that deserve our business.
They have pretty good Chinese Food.

I've picked up several Door dash orders from here before. We usually went to Fujiyama down the street but lately their service has been horrible for dine in as well as for dashers picking up. Decided to try Shige and it's now our favorite. Great friendly service and great portions. I had a bento box and a order of rolls. My spouse had two roll orders. All tasty and fresh. This is now our sushi spot. The dipping sauce for the pot stickers was delicious (I ended up using it all up on my rolls).
I had the Spicy Chicken bowl. They were stingy with the chicken, generous with the rice and cabbage.

Blue cross of Idaho has no mental health coverage and has denied coverage for my daughter. Now she has tried to kill herself because she can't get the help she needs! Absolutely ridiculous that they don't consider mental health worthy of medical treatment!!!

Vacant apartment. Out of state owner. Maid unsupervised. Estimate over $300. Suppose to scrub kitchen/bathroom cabinets/door fronts. Suppose to wash baseboards/spot wash walls/shower surround/tub and stone fireplace hearth. It appeared nothing was done. Thank goodness I have a great property manager who inspected the apartment at the end of the day. Manager notified me and Merry Maids that work was poor and/or not done. They sent somebody else out to redo the work as written in the estimate. I own other rentals in Boise and not sure if I trust Merry Maids to get the work done and not rip me off.
The food is so good... when you actually get what you ordered. This location is always getting something wrong and I'm constantly having to go back. Not super impressed.
Really good food. Nice servers. Clean. Nice set ip inside. Reasonable prices. More than just chicken wings... lots of stuff.

Hi, I'm 9 years old and I'm on my moms account. I love spaghetti and Gino's spaghetti is the best spaghetti I've ever had! I think Gino's is one of the best restaurants in the world! I would take a picture but I ate it all.

Wow!! Talk about a smooth transaction. I was calling around to consignment lots attempting to have them sell my RV and I ran across these guys on a Google search. Knowing the value of my RV, I was pretty insulted when the big guys in town were offering me about 65% of its value IF they could sell it. They obviously were going to list it higher and pocket 25-35%. After a five minute phone call with Rob, the owner, he made me an offer upwards of 85% and actually bought it straight from me!!  Awesome and friendly service, totally professional and easy to deal with. Cannot say enough good things about the way they do business!!! If I wasn't moving, I'd make it a point to buy my next RV here!!

Came here for a late breakfast around noon when passing through Idaho on our way to Portland, Oregon during a cross-country road trip; we've had three weeks worth of Yelpers best-of breakfasts to go off of, and after last night eating at one of the highest rated restaurants in Boise & it being a total flop, we weren't expecting much...we were so lucky to have found this place! Hands down best breakfast we've had in weeks. Loved the mixture of southern comfort and Hispanic flare in their menu, something which we see a lot in Florida, done so very right here! Our waitress was amazing, she kept the hot coffee flowing, filled up my to-go mug and even both of our water bottles. She made great suggestions, such as trying the biscuits grilled with some marion berry jam, something I had never heard of! We ordered two more biscuits this way for the road! I ordered the Garden Hash; I had seen photos of it on yelp, and it lived up to its reputation. All the veggies were fresh: artichoke, zucchini, avocado, tomatoes, mouth-watering roasted garlic cloves, and perfectly cooked potatoes...the portion was so large too, I was completely stuffed and satisfied! My boyfriend ordered the Corned Beef Hash, which had its own flavor funk too it that must be the Hispanic influence! The spuds were crispy and well seasoned, and the portion was also so big he couldn't eat it all! Quality and quantity were both on point. The service was phenomenal. We will be dreaming about this place!

This place was spot on. The decor was warm and inviting, the staff were great and the food/drinks were delicious. Or server was Andy and he was very knowledgeable and attentive. My husband had the flat iron steak and I had the capalini and lobster. Steak was come perfectly and my fish was delicious. 

We then for dessert and it was not a huge portion but it was perfectly sized for two people to share. 

My drinks were tasty and well balanced. We will definitely be back for more!

I've been wearing glasses virtually my entire life and have been to my fair share of eye doctors along the way. Dr. Ana Nielsen, her husband and the rest of the team at The Eye Site are all delightful and make the trip to the doctor a breeze.

I was in and out in roughly 45 minutes. Their updated technology helps expedite the appointment, produces more accurate results, and is more comfortable for the patient.

Dr. Nielsen is incredibly professional and friendly. If you're in the market for a new eye doctor, I highly recommend checking out The Eye Site.

This week we ordered the Italian nachos and they arrived completely dry and the chips were burned.  Sent them back and they came out like they should (with some sauce!).  Then we waited an hour and a half for our dinners to arrive (on a Tuesday night).  I ordered the ravioli and it came out with five raviolis, the cheese all completely burned, and the tops of the noodles all dry and burned ($13!).  I called the manager over and waited for another 20 minuted for him to arrive.  When he did, he was so rude and wouldn't even look me in the eye or down at the table.  Very weird.  He said that's how the food should be and pretty much blamed it on me, said we shouldn't have a stroller in the restaurant, and then deducted the food from our bill.  We will never be returning to this location (mostly because of the management).  Do yourself a favor and go get a Stouffer's frozen pasta from Wal Mart right up the road instead of wasting money on this horrible food, or enduring the rude management.

Patty is ridiculously disorganized! It shouldn't be this difficult to give a business $$. We had to call, send emails, leave messages, and call again just to get bids finalized. When requesting documentation of the bid, scheduling, information regarding the carpet and LVP's warranty, I cannot tell you how many times Patty told us, "OH! I was just about to do that. Give me a minute and I'll email that to you." Yup! You guessed it, we would never get the requested information until we went into the store and requested it in person. At the beginning of this process (6 weeks ago) we requested a bid to re-do all of our counter tops. As of the writing of this... No bid. 

NOT impressed.

My husband and I ate here before covid and really enjoyed it, but lately, it's just disappointing. Tonight we ordered the pot roast nachos, salmon Nicoise salad, and chocolate cake for takeout. The pot roast nachos were okay, they were basically the same nachos we make at home in the oven. Good but not special or interesting. My Niçoise salad was so disappointing. The lettuce was wilted and brown, there were no potatoes, the vinaigrette and salmon were bland. I ended up throwing most of it away. The chocolate cake was fine but not great. It tasted like an Albertsons cake. Overall it  a very disappointing dining experience. For $40, I would expect an edible salad and better than average nachos and cake.

I had to update to 5 stars for this restaurant! Their food is dangerously delicious. My whole family sits at the table and theres a chorus of "oh my goodness" and "this is too good!" The service on mothers day was excellent, which included two different manager types stopping ny the table to thank us for coming in and wishing my wife a happy mothers day! This is now our go to restaurant in the treasure valley. Highly recommend!

I love the breakfast buffet on weekdays. Its great on weekends also but it cost $2.00 more. I go particularly for the blueberry pancakes. Their bacon is delicious with them. For protein I have scrambled eggs with mushrooms and cheese sauce. I certainly splurge when I go there and eat too much, because it is so good. Fresh fruit and lots of other items are available, but Blueberry pancakes can't be beat. If the food available isn't warm enough or it looks old, just mention it and the staff jumps on it right away.
Really love this place! We hadn't been in awhile and we've gone twice in the last month now. Great food, great ambiance, and great service. Everything you want in a restaurant!

First time doing acrylics and Hailey did an amazing job with a French Ombre with sparkles with coffin shape.  I had to move someone the next day (emergency), and none of them broke or chipped.  I am so grateful!!

I have been to this Jack in the Box location a handful of times. This location is joined with a gas station and does a great job of still having a drive thru with no traffic problems. With that said, this is a typical Jack in the Box and i do not have too much more to say about this one specifically. I think the loaded fries are the best item and they taste very good. The burgers are decent, but they are a little pricey for an average burger. With that said, the burgers are still great but there is some intense competition from other places. Also, there is often good deals but only for one burger at a time ($5.99 for chicken sandwich meal for example). Oftentimes those deals are for obscure burgers i have no interest in eating. I have encountered a problem where sometimes i will ask for no ice and they will still give me some. I still think this place is a little underrated and if it was a little cheaper this would easily be 5 stars. I understand the location doesn't control prices so that is a Jack in the Box problem all together.

We enjoyed a delicious takeaway meal on our 38th wedding anniversary. We had an assortment of tempura dishes with miso soup and salad. It was so good, and will be our go-to restaurant for Japanese food!

Did take-out.  Very easy process, which was appreciated.  The actual food was very meh.  Eggs Benedict was fine, but mediocre hollandaise sauce.  Blackened salmon hash was not very blackened.  Biscuit was fine, but the big rectangle shape seemed to make it less biscuit-like in consistency.  Basically, our food was fine but nothing to write home about and not worth making a special trip.

Ok, gave this place another try and SO happy we did!! Our first visit must just have been due to recent opening mishap or something.

Food was really good, I mean this is now our top choice for Chinese! 

Everything had great flavor, was super fresh and our to-go order was processed timely.
My family and myself have ate here a few times and always excellent food and service. We came here with only take out available due to COVID and excellent service as well.

I always get the best care. I get in quickly. Wait time is brief. Explanations are clear. And they take time to answer questions in away I am satisfied. Professional, friendly and prepared to handle anything.  I'm very thankful for the care!

At 230pm on 02/20/2021 we decided for the first time to stop by at Grimaldi's, sounds promising right. At the entrance we already was notified than oven doesn't work till 4pm, so no pizza.  We still decided to spoiled ourselves with the hot liquid and gorgeous atmosphere because of the cold weather,at least maybe we are able to have a wonderful hot tea/coffee with italian dessert. We start ordered  and we found out that not so much variety of the tea they have, actually only one type(black tea) that's all, so my 6 y.o child unable to have caffeine- free hot tea, we ordered apple juice. Ordered wonderful hot latte/ cappuccino again was a big mistake for us because coffee maker  doesn't work. When  we ordered  assorted dessert trio the waiter told us they run out of chocolate canolli as well so we replaced on something else what's available. Well conclusion of this unique visit- huge disappoinment. Grimaldi's- big name and zero expectations. It's definitely our first and last visit.

Sat at the bar and ate. Drinks were amazing! (Had the huckeltini) food was amazing, service was amazing, even though they were swamped!

Will be back for sure!

Ordered through the app on opening night and food was ready when I requested. Everything we had was delicious and we really appreciated all of their gluten free options! Teriyaki Madness is definitely going in our regular rotation.
Didn't even eat. We understand they are understaffed but when we are there for 20 minutes and every table around us had been waited on that is unacceptable!
A hidden gem in meridian.  Great food and service but you need time to wait as more people figure out how nice and cozy the food is. Try the corned beef bennies!

My daughter needed to have her skin looked at before school started. Thankfully, they could squeeze us in with a provider before we see the pediatric dermatologist. We saw Theresa and she gave us lots of tips and tricks to help clear her skin up. We did have to wait a bit for our appointment but they are super popular, especially before school starts. I'm glad to have such a wonderful dermatology team to go to so close to home.

Fabulous buffet for lunch and authentic pizzas for dine in, takeout or delivery.  My favorite is the Cascade Chicken and Garlic.    The sweet twists are an awesome dessert -- better than cinnamon rolls!

We waited a very long time for the most overcooked pizza I've ever seen. The toppings were cooked into oblivion so it tasted like salted cardboard. We've had this pizza before so it must be a chef problem.  I don't mind the expensive pizza as long as it's tasty. I know for a fact that I could make a better pizza because it couldn't have been worse. No way we're we going to wait that long again for another pizza! Black Friday at lunch time.

This place employed the old "scare tactic" method of recommending repairs. This occurred  on multiple occasions in one visit. They also slightly damaged part of my coach they weren't not working on.  Upon return to discuss, they tried the "flip n bounce" - blaming me! And wanted to bill me?!?  I advise staying clear of these fellas!  I will not go there again.

Easy and quick. It's usually not to crowded here. 
With that end of town getting more populated I don't expect that to last

when you call you will be talking to a call center who is going to tell you everything you want to here or validate the questions and concerns you express. however when technician shows up the story will be different. first he tells you they dont fog or spray crawl spaces. which is contrary to what call center says. secon when questioned he says its illegal to fog crawl spaces. which maybe in some states some where but not in idaho. then tells me that they can do the reat of application andni could hire someone else to fog crawl apace. what i thought it was illegal. why pay two companies to do 1 job. umm thanks but ill just go with 1 doing it the right way the first time.

We were staying nearby at the Nampa Holiday Inn Express and spurned the free continental breakfast because of COVID and desire to support a local business. Yelped this cafe, and were pleased with the outcome.  We got there early on a Sunday morning at 0900 and were seated quickly.  Tables are spaced appropriately, and our table and bench were sanitized prior to seating us.  The menus were not single use, and I didn't check to see if wiped down. Free hand sanitizer on entry, staff masked. 
My husband was very happy with his Basque hash, and marbled rye bread, but also because he is a coffee snob and was pleased that they served Cafe D'arte coffee. I had the salted caramel banana bread French toast.....yummy.

Dr. Harsch is excellent we have taken our new pup a couple of times now for his new puppy shots. Him and his staff are so caring and make Blue feel so special. They give lots of treats and he doesn't push shots or treatments on us. He explains why he thinks we should do something or why we shouldn't such as neutering to early. I have nothing but good things to say and will refer anyone to him! We can't wait to
Try out doggie day care!!

Thought we would try Johnny Carino's after church today since we were across the street at the Village and it didn't look crowded and we hadn't been there for at least a many years.  Entering the restaurant there was maybe two tables with customers, this is a Sunday, where is everybody? Sat down at a very sticky wood table top booth, we were given the menus and both my wife and I were shocked by the prices. Everything is $16-$20 for basic pasta. I ordered the tri-tip dip, waiter said it came with a choice of salad I ordered the Cesar. Apparently they don't have Romain so they served it on iceberg lettuce and it was not a good combination. The waiter also said it came with fries, which he said were surprisingly good. The meal came the fries were comparable with Burger King, absolutely no seasoning or flavor, did not eat them. The tri-tip dip was served on a Walmart style hoagie roll which as soon as you touch it in the aujus  it becomes mush and falls apart.  My wife got some sort of Parmesan chicken which she said was OK.  We both realized why we did not like this place a decade ago when we tried it, and obviously why no one was in there eating. And, to top it off after we got our salads there was like a half hour wait for a meal. You can see the cook, no one's eating in there, yet we had to wait a long time for lukewarm terrible food. Many places in the valley to go to for Italian Food, do not risk coming here, be warned.

I was there yesterday. Pizza was OK but only slightly warm and it was way too expensive. Every item you want to put on your pizza is either $2 or $4. Needless to say, if you want something that is loaded with your favorite toppings, expect to pay a huge price. Will not return.
Service was pleasant. Atmosphere was nice. Sushi was bland and tasted like grocery store caliber. Won't return.

I arrived after 7am and was allowed to seat myself in the dining area that is large and inviting. My server, Kim B., is absolutely awesome. She was friendly, upbeat, and just made my day (breakfast and attitude are the most important start of the day, right?)

Ordered a coffee and Chicken Fried Steak. I forgot to ask for the gravy on the side, which I usually do, so it's my fault that the gravy made the fried steak soggy on the top.

I can't say that the Chicken Fried Streak was the best that I ever had (see my other reviews) but it is definitely not bad. The food came out very quick. I went to wash my hands and got something from the car and the food was waiting for me when I got back. Food that is cooked so quickly but not botched up is definitely an A+ ! So if you are in a hurry but want decent food and not fast food, I highly recommend this place (disclaimer, speed might be different during peak hours or different times).

There's free guest wifi, which is great because I had to get some work done while having breakfast. My server was very attentive but not intrusive/disruptive.

I am a breakfast junkie and love traditional sit-down breakfast-focused restaurants. This definitely met my expectations.

Last but not least, I want to add that their menu is diverse but not overwhelming. The breadth of options is just nice and I am confident there will be something for everyone in your party.

Stumbled across this place Saturday 6-26-20 while looking for a breakfast spot. We were seated on the patio, nice experience, forgot to get our servers name, but she was amazing and everything was spot on, and she checked in on us the right amount of times. Food was incredible from the MoJo Potatoes, to the chicken fried steak. The cfs was unique, as it's coated in a batter instead of the typical breading or panko style.  Swap your toast out  for a grilled biscuit, amazing. The Mimosa's are killer as well. We will definitely stop in next time we're in Boise.

Don't order to go from them unless you go through everything and make sure they aren't ripping you off. I ordered the classic Caesar salad with chicken. This is a $15 salad and is supposed to come with black olives, red onions, and Roma tomato. It is in a side salad box no bigger than my hand. No olives, tomato, or onion. Such a joke for $15. Every time I order here it is always wrong. Not sure why it's so difficult to read a receipt and give your customers what they are already overpaying for.

Absolutely the worst service and rudest manager.  We were seated at 8:00 pm, and it wasn't busy.  Our waiter came over 45 minutes later to tell us that our pizza hasn't been put in the oven yet.  We asked our waiter (who was nice) to have the manager comp our one Cesar salad and 3 soft drinks.  The waiter came back and said the manager said no.  We asked to speak to the manager, and she came out rudely and said "you don't want to pay your bill"? We didn't get to eat dinner that we waited for an hour to not get.  She rudely said fine and stormed off.  I do not recommend this place.  This place needs new management.

Amanda is the best PA ever!She answers all my questions and is very caring. When I need a referral she referred me to the best doctor and I was very happy with that doctor too. I was lucky to fallow Amanda and now her patient in her own practice.

The family went to Idaho Pizza for dinner.  Part of the family ordered Pizza which seemed to be fine.  As for me and another we ordered a sandwich.  I had the Albuquerque Turkey, and the other person had the Ham sandwich.  I don't write reviews very often but when something is this bad you have to say something.  Both sandwiches were awful due to the meat being dried out and more like shoe leather.  Extremely tough, like the cook forgot about it on a hot stove with no moisture.  Learned my lesson, hope this helps anyone wanting to get something other than pizza.  BTW/ the salad bar is very basic.  Don't expect too much.  They did keep it restocked with the items that were there.

So I went in at about 6:45pm and the restaurant was pretty much dead. The only bad part was waiting 20 minutes for a table before I wised up and asked to sit at the bar. Mental note, so that next time. However, my server KD was absolutely fantastic, served everything in a timely manner, my Sticky Fingers Salad was so delicious and she kept refilling my little popcorn basket and my tea. The food and service made me want to go back even if I have to wait 20 minutes to sit at the bar

Love the popcorn while we were waiting for the food. Our food was great. 
Onion rings were crunchy and delish. 
My southwest salad was very tasty and fresh. The dressing was a bit too sweet on the grilled chicken. 
We ordered 12 original wings for the entree. Wish my tummy could hold more wings, they were delicious. 
My server, Shelby was very attentive and friendly.
It's my family favorite restaurant to go to.

Pretty good (and fresh) lunch spot for Boise. Is it going to win awards? No. But it's a great bowl of food when you are looking for lunch - and it's a nice change from Subway! 

The lunch bowls come in two sizes, and be warned - the large is large! Unless you have a massive appetite, I'd order the smaller one. The restaurant is clean, the people are nice, and the food seemed fresh. I'll be back!

By far my favorite pizza place of all time. The food is amazing and i have never had a bad experience there. The service is always good and the staff is very friendly. It is kid-friendly as well- my younger family members always look forward to playing with the dough they give out 
There's both outdoor and indoor seating, so if you have covid concerns there is plenty of options- i believe they even do takeout :)
Doesn't exist at stated address, no sign or stickers or anything. Don't go to the address expecting to find the truck, or a brick and mortar. Super sad panda
Heard about this place from someone on the radio and decided to check it out. My boyfriend and I loved it. Really cool idea with the boats. Place was clean and friendly. Definitely going back.
I like the way you operate, with someone in with the dogs all day. The place is clean, well kept, and for me, convenient to home and work.

Excellent service!  Clean interior!  Delicious dishes!  The veggies are fresh, the meats are perfectly cooked.  Red Pavilion is my favorite Chinese restaurant in the Boise and Meridian area.  I have even tried the Ted Pavilion in Mountain Home and found the food and service equal their Meridian restaurant.   Nuff said!!

Extremely rude hostesses. They looked very cliquey like our entrance into the restaurant was disrupting their conversation. 
The one who brought us to our table was probably the worst. The entire restaurant was empty except for a group of men in the bar area, so we asked if we could have the bigger table three tables down so that we could have more room to spread out with our baby and all the stuff you have to haul around. She proceeded to lecture us about how seating works and that she would now have to search for a server to walk three more steps to our table and appeared really annoyed and frustrated with us. I've been a bartender in a restaurant half of my life-I know how seating works and what a hostess' job entails. There was no one in the restaurant. The server she asked had no problem with it because she didn't have any tables considering the restaurant was EMPTY. I didn't appreciate being lectured by a 15 year old girl on a family outing.  This girl had zero customer service and it was really uncomfortable the way she treated us. As for the  server, she needs a lot more training.
