She made my husband get out the beer menu again to find the beer he wanted and tell her the "tap number".... he gave her the brewery name and the beer name, and she needed more information to make it easier for her? 
If you pride yourself on being a bar with tons of craft taps then you should really educate your staff on the beers, customers shouldn't have to do all the work for you. That's why they are having dinner in a restaurant. 
We definitely won't be returning, the food was okay but the service really sealed the deal as we were treated like crap. I'd rather go somewhere with mediocre food and get treated like a valued customer.
Bummer!
excellent Salmon Skin Salad. EEL sushi was very tasty.  This is our "go-to"  place for sushi.  Very friendly service.

Enjoyed working with Blind Source. 
They were really professional. 
Great price. Great quality. 
I especially liked that you can customize the color of your shutters to match the exact paint in your house. 
Amy, Dallin and Patrick were awesome to work with.

Not a reliable business. They were way off target despite my giving them very clear criteria. After three dates, I stop using them and tried to get a portion of the amount I paid ($4,500) refunded. They simply refused. I should have known better. These use matchmakers located in California to come up with the perfect Idaho dates. Makes no sense.
Been going to Gino's ever since it was in down town Boise. Was worried when it changed location but it hasn't skipped a beat!

First time here the other night, the wife loved the burger, I had wings they were a little salty, next time I'll get them naked, the onion strings were very good, the slaw was good too and the popcorn was a nice touch.

Regina Collins is an amazing realitor She worked with us in everything and communicated very well everything for us. There is only five stars otherwise I would give her 10 she is the best. I have worked with lenders and realities and she is definitely at the top making her customers a priority and showing that she truly cares about you and your purchase the whole way threw. I would highly recommend her to anyone I know. Thank you Regina Collins for everything your awesome...

I can only give this restaurant one star because I've never been able to get a meal there so far. That's not because I haven't tried, but it's either a lost order of long wait time of over 45 min. I'm sorry, but nothing is worth a 45 min wait. 

On opening day, I downloaded the app, placed an order.  When I arrived and was told that their computer system crashed and my order wasn't there. Instead of making it right and filling my order, which we had on my phone, I was told I'd have to wait in line for over an hour to get my food. I was also told my lost order would be refunded the next day. Well, that didn't happen. I returned and had to speak to the manager and after two weeks my account was finally credited. As I was waiting to speak to her, I overheard her say to the cashier to tell people they were an hour behind on orders. So of course I didn't place an order. 

I know they're new and kinks need to be ironed out, so I'll give them a month or so and try again. Or I'll just keep going to "The Flame Boiler" where I've never had an issue.  Good luck!

This is the spot! My son was terrified of getting hair cuts until Jeremy! He talks to my son like a little man and listens to him when he's talking. The atmosphere is cool and all the barbers are great! Definitely recommend!!!

Loved Mike! He was so professional and got right to work. He did about 7 things for me and when he left you wouldn't have known he was here because he left my house as clean as when he came.  I will use him for any handyman work I may need! He already has work lined up from my neighbors! I'll be getting the word out about his work to everyone here in my neighborhood...Thanks again Mike!

Very slim selection of motorcycles!!
Ohh yep let's blame it on Covid again.
They promised for 2022 will have more selection.

This has been hands down the worst experience I have ever had with a dealership. I cannot believe how dishonest and shady this company has been with my purchase. In July, I placed a deposit, early in the month, on a specific 5th wheel trailer. Later that month I went in to purchase and that is when everything went south. The dealership did a bait and switch and actually gave me a completely different trailer than I had put a deposit on. I didn't realize this until I got it home and started seeing small defects that had not been there when we originally agreed to purchase. I checked my old paperwork and matched the VIN numbers and turns out they were different units, although the same model. When I called them out on this they made an excuse about the landing gear not working on the trailer I agreed to buy and did a last minute switch. Real question, why wouldn't you inform your buyer? After speaking with the GM about this, they told me there is nothing they can do since Bish did not get any "Monetary gain" from switching. Over the next few months we used the trailer and would constantly fight with the fridge and its inability not hold temp or even pull down. I took the trailer in 6 weeks ago now for the refrigerator, after looking over the notes it turned out that the fridge has parts on order from before I even purchased the unit. They somehow "neglected" to even tell me this also. I cannot believe how shady this company has been in withholding information. I actively try to deter people from using this company, I cannot believe how much information was withheld from me. Everything seems to come out in time and show their true colors. In conclusion, I would highly recommend looking elsewhere for your RV needs.

I've had several visits  and the staff here were always friendly, helpful and committed to helping me be pain free.  I love all the treatment options and full service they provide. They do a great job of adjusting to what I need each visit.

Beware. Appointments don't begin on time. I ask if the procedure I needed was covered by my insurance prior to my appointment. 

The second time I had the procedure done it was coded differently and they requested that I pay the $200 difference! There was a lot of back and forth calls made by me between 
Michelle in billing and my insurance BCBS. Finally talked to someone else and was told that they'd change the billing code.

4 months later I get a bill from collections!!!

I was initially very impressed with Camp Bow Wow; the staff seemed friendly, the place was clean and they really seemed to care for the dogs. All things you want to see in a boarding facility. We paid extra for a suite so that we could see our dog on the webcam, so our dog stayed in the suite. Two days into our four day trip I noticed that I wasn't seeing our dog in the suite and I called. They said well your dog tore up our suite and messed up the Sheetrock so we had to move her. I asked if my dog was ok several times and they said yes and just kept telling me how bad she tore into the wall. I asked why they didn't have the area protected with vinyl or something and they said they did but only four feet up. Well considering my dog is an 80lb. Golden she's much taller than that. I called back the next day and again they told me that my dog messed up their wall, I said I'm sorry that happened but in reality they should've had the room better set up for all sizes of dogs and I again asked if my dog was ok they said yes. My husband went to pick up our dog and brought her home. To my shock she had skin and hair missing around her mouth with a puncture in her lip and her paw nail was all messed up at the bed and had dry blood all around it (even though I paid extra for a bath). Needless to say I was very upset. I called and spoke to the owner and she said that they didn't notice anything and then said well her injuries weren't life threatening but if I wanted to come in she could show me where she tore up the Sheetrock. I was livid at this point... First of all, the room should be a safe environment for all sizes of dogs, meaning protection over the Sheetrock much higher that 4 feet. My dog doesn't tear up stuff at home but she was scared and alone. Second of all if they would have called me when this happened and told me her mouth was raw, missing hair with some scratches and a puncture along with her nail bed is messed up but we've cleaned her up an moved her to a safer environment it would've helped me understand a bit better. With her injuries she had to of had blood on her when they came in. My perception is they were more worries about the Sheetrock than my dog. Not to mention they constantly squirt the dogs with water spray bottles whenever they get close to the walls or gates when they are in open play. Not the place for us and I would have given this a zero if that was an option. Luckily it's been healing well with the help of Doterra essential oils diluted heavily with coconut oil.
I have to give this restaurant 5 * for their customer service.And the foods is excellent especially their breakfast.Highly recommended.

Just visited Verizon in Eagle, Idaho, where their employee, Rett, was so helpful in resolving my issue. He was kind, funny, and quickly corrected the problem that had been so vexing at home. Thank you, Rett.

Came to try Gino's for my girlfriends birthday and was sadly disappointed. Food had taken about 45 minutes to come and when she finally got her plate there was a piece of hair in the shrimp, not very appetizing especially with this whole pandemic. Sad to say Gino's was a horrible choice for a birthday dinner for my girlfriend.

The food was good but did not feel worth the price. I would much rather stick to an Olive Garden. 
Food: 3/5

This place feels like the humane society, at least to my husband and me. He didn't even want to leave them there for the free interview day. 

We have one large and one small dog that they split up, making each of them more anxious. Watching them on the monitors when we got back I could tell how stressed they were. We found a different place in Boise that has a much calmer atmosphere and didn't split out pups up!

With the massive amount of people moving into the area, why isn't Ada county spending some of the new found tax $$ to hire more people? It used to be pretty simple to walk in and within less than 10 min be back out the door. I'm at triple that already & still waiting.

Waited forty minutes for our takeout order of XL Vegetables. Tried to phone it in but no one answered the phone.  Cost $11.45 a piece. Finally received our food and when we got home we were horrified-- about 4 stalks of broccoli in the dish with some chopped cabbage and a few strands of zucchini in a light sauce. Came with copious amount of rice. Of course we didn't want to go all the way back to return the food but What A Rip Off!!

I had ordered tires for my car and not realizing, my back tires were a different size than my front tires, which I had ordered four of, and of course, it's Friday, 3:30 appointment, I'm going out of town the next morning for a very long toad trip with semi-bald tires that needed to be replaced a month ago. 
I arrive at my appointment and our sales guys (Jordan) checks us in and discovers all this. He went above and beyond in such an extraordinary way, it was straight old-school-customer service at its best. 
He called the Boise store, gets the size tires we need for the back, drives there to retrieve the tires - keep in mind the time and day - Hence traffic - 
and my car is complete with four new tires within an hour and a half. Please go here. Support this store. Their customer service won't disappoint. 
Meridian store, thank you.

Totally appreciate the excellent customer service from the management here at this ship shape Koa! We pulled in off the highway at 10:30 at night with our 26 foot Uhaul moving across the country.  Wanting a safe place to park and put a tent up.  They accommodated us and we were overwhelmed with relief!  Nice and quiet and safe!  Nice hot showers!  We can't thank you enough!
Great local spot and selection of adult beverages from whisky to beers. We've had almost everything from fish to steaks and a lot in between. All very good.

Sorry excuse for customer service. If you have a problem we were told, "Call your RV manufacture, (Jayco) to have them tell us how to handle your slide issue!" What the.....so if we buy a Chevy at a local dealer should we contact Chevy or the dealer that sold us the car? Wow very poor customer service from a Jayco authorized dealer. They never forget to stick their hand out for the $140.00 p/h labor rate though. We have a faulty slide that continues to go awry. 3Xs we have had it in for service. They claim it loses it memory so while we are camping we were told to bring our slide in every couple of days so it doesn't forget. Whatttt the heck! Am I the only one that thinks this is ridiculous? Jayco didn't even agree with this but Bish's seems to think this will cure the issue. Very frustrated right Now!  Oh and if the slide binds again it will cost another 140.00 just to check it out. WOW

I just live the food and the service at Ginos!   We will continue to go there for dinner!  I try something new every time and they have not disappointed us at all!  If your in the area pls go and try them. You might want to make sure you get reservations on Friday and Saturday
Not the best service. The server was pretty rude to my girlfriend. And that really  unacceptable.

What a Gem of a Restaurant and Bar. First Class Service,  The Best Food, Great Portions and Price ! 
It's our new  "Go To Place"

T & M Anderson  -

a whole lot of MEH about this place. i'm genuinely surprised it has stayed open through all the covid times and whatnot. 

came in for happy hour, to which they let us know they didn't have one. well, ok then. we ordered a couple appetizers and a bottle of wine. the wine was cold, so they get the star for that.

the first appetizer we got was the fried zucchini. the server informed us they were "normally" cut into strips but the chef felt like slicing them today? LOL. ok lady. they were greasy, soggy, and sad.

we also ordered the "15 minute wings"- which they say are worth the wait on the menu. they did not take 15 minutes, so I have no idea why they call them those. they were the saddest wings I have ever seen. tiny, meatless. they brought a few sauces for us to try. all bottled, sad, and gross.

also, they brought us a loaf of bread when we sat down which was also stale, dry, and gross.

our bill was $70. $70 for this!! I laugh out loud just thinking about it. the bottle of wine was $27.

they should just replace this restaurant with an olive garden. it's already all set up for that faux italian vibe. i'll be back when they do, because johnny carino's is just not up to par. don't waste your money.
Went to Moe Joe's for the 1st time today and had an excellent experience. Staff was friendly, food was great, and mimosa's is always a plus!!! Will definitely be returning!

I have been here a few times; there are just so many great pizza places in the treasure valley. Grimaldi's is a chain located in the trendy village in meridian and they  offer coal brick oven pizza. Tonight I was by myself; service was a little different. I walked in and was told I had to wait even though there were several open tables; "servers could get caught up". I ended up being sat in this corner table by the bathrooms and the bar/employee area. That's kind of annoying; the other two people after me were seated in the dining room.
So the ambience is very NY; lots of cool old NYC pictures probably one of the coolest parts of this restaurant. The red checkered tablecloths and the brick walls are another great were also a great idea.
My server was leticia; she was very friendly. If you haven't been here before she like all the servers will walk you through the menu even giving helpful suggestions along the way. Usually I get a personal pizza; it's a good sized pizza. Tonight since I joined their email club I get to enjoy a large 18 inch pizza with one topping for free!! I opted for a half pepperoni half bacon. The pizza: They use little circles of pepperoni lots of those all over the pizza; the cheese isn't the cheesiest that I have seen-I think it could actually use a little more. The sauce is applied very lightly some spots you taste no sauce. The tomato sauce I am not a fan of; I can't really describe it maybe a little sweet with not an overwhelming tomato profile. Now crust is the best part of your pizza experience(crunchy soft chewy with the marks of the coal fired oven on the bottom); of your looking for NY style pizza with a great atmosphere/ambiance this is the place..
Oh don't forget desert or share it at that table. They make their cheesecake right there in the restaurant; I ordered one of their seasonal selections Carmel apple cheesecake absolutely sinful-outside of the Cheesecake Factory best cheesecake in town..

My boyfriend and I stopped by for a date night and both got the bbq bacon cheeseburger with sweet potatoes fries. It was really good! Only thing was that it was slightly greasy but it does have bacon and onion strings so I can see why. The ranch dressing is also great! Wish this place was a tad bit bigger.

One of my favorite spots to get pizza! The margarita pizza and the Brooklyn bridge pizza are our favorites but their calzones are also amazing. A little pricey for pizzas especially if you build your own but worth the price. Sign up for their reward program and get a free pizza the month of your birthday!

Tried this out from Facebook recommendations in a local group I'm in. Great and solid choice for food. Wanted to leave a review because of the comedy at dinner we encountered. I ordered an iced unsweetened iced tea and got back this super dark iced drink. I took a sip. IT WAS SOY SAUCE. My husband ordered a beer. IT CAME WARM. Genuinely like picked off from the shelf warm. He had to place it in his water for an ice bath because the server was running around with her head chopped off and barely came to tend to us. Will be back because the food was good but jeez... that was a first.

Big problem is portion size. You just don't get your money worth.  The sushi rolls are small compared to other sushi restaurants.  We ordered sushi to go with salmon skin salad. Small amount of salmon but the worst part was they forgot the dressing. Was supposed to be ginger dressing but got nothing.
Excellent mandarin cuisine and too both. Service, highly recommend! Good take out and dine in options and they Taylor your dish to your liking

It's expensive for rice and veggies and veeeeery skimpy with the teriyaki sauce. Pretty much only taste like dry rice and vegetables because they give you such a tiny amount of teriyaki. 
teriyaki probably shouldn't be in the name if they're not going to give you an adequate amount to make your food taste like teriyaki.
probably wouldn't go back. Probably would go to Mongolian instead or you can have an adequate amount of sauces.
I got my food to go, and I had paid for two eggrolls that we're not in the bag when I got home .

Let me say first I love the pizza here; that alone is worth the visit. My review is mainly in regards to their service. I came in on Monday around 5pm to place a walk in carry out order. Their take out system is completely flawed relying on an already taxed one bartender to take all your take out order plus all the drink orders and bar customers. So I stood there for 10-15 minutes then when I order she tells me over an hour for a pizza (90 minutes-on a Monday night??). I then ordered a slice of cheesecake she comes to me about halfway through waiting and said they were out of my cheesecake (at 5?? How does that even happen). To me their service misses tonight between wait times and being out of product are not okay. I'd suggest ordering ahead don't walk in otherwise you'll be waiting a long time. This wasn't a Friday/Saturday night dinner rush this was a Monday night to me that's a big miss. Lots of other pizza places in town you don't have to wait 90 minutes for a pizza.

1) Yogi Berra  2) West v East  3) Brooklyn, Baby!  4) Value  5) Friends  6) Flies   All relevant to our first visit to this Grimaldi's, an offshoot of Grimaldi's in Brooklyn.  Not a franchised store, but outpost of westward expansion by this privately owned business. (Joe Ciolli is current CEO.)  The business plan installs Grimaldi's in up scale shopping malls.  Hence, The Village mall location.   Good pizza means we will go back - in our case in spite of the mall location.  Although after Treasure Valley fly season has ended.  But I'm getting ahead of myself.  Flies were at  the end of the list.

YOGI BERRA:  True story.  Yogi ordered a pie at the counter in a Brooklyn pizzeria and headed to a table.  The guy behind the counter hollered out to him, "Hey, Yogi, want this cut in six pieces or eight?"  Yogi replied, "Six!  I could never eat eight!"

There was wild laughter in the NYC audience where Yogi, himself,   shared this.  You get it.  Right?  Ta Dum. 

That story for New Yorker Yogi comes to mind as original Brooklyn Grimaldi's had but one size of pizza.  Now chain Grimaldi's offers three sizes: Personal (12"), Small (16"), Large (18").  We ordered 2 smalls for 4 people and each couple had 1/2 a pie to take home.  And in what is typical for Brooklyn service, pies are cut in 6ths.  Next time we'd ask the kitchen to cut them in 8ths because now we know a small is perfect share to size by 4 lighter eaters if salad is ordered too, as we did. 

WEST v EAST COAST:  Noting some reviewers complain about absence of ranch dressing for pizzas and need to order toppings separately, that is absence of "special combos" on menu, that is not a failure of Grimaldi's but a difference in expectations on West v East Coasts for pizza. My hubby is Italian American born and raised in Brooklyn,  His expectation is you have a cheese pie (red sauce and mozzarella) or a white pie (olive oil and mozzarella) and if you really MUST add something you select from a traditional list of toppings.  When we moved from NY to SF he was appalled, the right verb, to find ham and pineapple pizzas.  And even for me, native Oregonian, the concept of Ranch dressing for pizza seems awful.  Regional expectations differ.  Grimaldi's leans East.  And traditional NY-Italian. So-youse-know.  

BROOKLYN, BABY!:  Grimaldi's pizza here is coal oven baked, just as at the original location. That produces a different crust outcome for texture and edge toasting than a wood fired or gas fired pizza oven. Some folks complain about the 'burnt' crust edges.  Different strokes for folks used to gas pizza ovens perhaps. I think Grimaldi's has it right.  They use water specially formulated to resemble Brooklyn water in the dough.  There are people who swear this water is the secret ingredient that makes pizza crust (and bagels) made in Brooklyn the best ever. (They do not serve the Brooklyn water to drink, thank goodness; I can say from experience drinking it is no treat.)    

VALUE:  Toppings are first quality - sauces, cheeses, meats and veggies all.  We thought it a good value that two 16" pizzas with five toppings between them that served four people with half left over to take away clocked in at only $42.   (16" = $14 - $16 red to white and toppings range $2 to $4). 

FRIENDS:  Pizza is always more fun to eat when friends are present and so it was today to have friends along who had eaten at Grimaldi's in Las Vegas and who have traveled in Italy.  Whether this is Italian style pizza or Brooklyn style pizza we agreed it is good pizza.  We also all agreed we would have enjoyed it more without the...

...FLIES:  We sat inside specifically because it is fly season in the Treasure Valley.  But the darned things were buzzing inside too given how sneaky they can be getting in as people come and go.  This is no criticism of Grimaldi's.  It is a heads up that flies are an issue this time of year in most places in the Treasure Valley - flies abound from roughly early September through mid October if history holds.  

THIS N THAT:

1) AMBIANCE: Light and bright; lots of windows, lights inserted in wine bottles hang from the high tin ceiling, red checked table cloths. High perch seating in bar along with a couple of standard height tables. More standard height table seating in main dining room and out on patio that is along a fountain. Great music on the sound system. Alas, a TV or two in the walls. Tables tightly spaced at walls, not quite so bad in middle of room. 

2) ACCESSIBILITY: Level in and throughout main dining room.  Chairs too tight in some places for wheelchair access.  Wheelchair access in bar looks dicey for space although there are a couple of standard height tables there. The ADA, 26 years old, requires EQUAL access be provided to tables.  No excuse to get it wrong.  Patio seating looks accessible.

3) SERVICE: Young servers were friendly taking our order, delivering our food, filling our glasses.  The manager thanked us for coming in.  Bravo.

We've wanted to visit this place but due out COVID, we have been cautious about crowds.  I've heard great things and was excited when we found that we could get delivery through Boise Food Express.  Red Pavilion nailed it.  My daughter has a particular palette, but I convinced her try their Lim & Lime Chicken instead of her staple of Panda Express orange chicken.  She loved it and with the other food we ordered, it opened her palette to try the other items we ordered.  Personally, I felt like I was transported back to China with the taste and smell of the food.  You've got to try this place!

I don't know much about cars and such so I've always just wanted to drop it off and have someone take care of it. I'm not always sure that trusting of people but at les shwab I'm always impressed with how transparent they are and I've never been upset at the outcome.
$1.50 extra for Carne Asada and it taste like squirrel! Save your money go to the Taco John's in mtn home.

Unfortunately we had already suspected that our 17 year old cat was in kidney failure. The staff at Paramount is kind and let us hold the cat before having to have her put to sleep. They wrapped her in a blanket almost like a baby. Gave us all the time we needed. They gave her a sedative before bringing her to us, but it just calmed her. She still knew we were there. We were offered the option to take her home and give her subcutaneous fluids, but the vet said she would not likely last more than a couple of weeks if that. We have gone the home subcutaneous fluid route before with a cat of ours and it was miserable for all concerned, including the cat. They also made a paw print for us to remember Loretta by. The only bad part was that they were on the experience side of things. $100 just for mass cremation with no ashes returned. At the animal shelter it's only $10. There are two places that specialize in pet cremation where $75-$100 will get your pet cremated with the ashes returned if you wish. But even though Paramount was expensive, I will be taking my 15 year old dog there to see what can be done to help her arthritis. She's definitely not ready to be put to sleep yet the way she runs around at her age is something else.

We use River City for Pet boarding, and for daycare when she needs a play date. 
Our dog, Piper acts like a kid going to Disneyland when we tell her we are going to daycare.  She absolutely loves it.

I have a gentle 7 year old Lab as well as a knucklehead 10 month old Lab. The techs and vets treat them so well. The older one had some dental work and they were so lovely to her. The follow up phone calls were very helpful. The reception staff are always friendly & helpful. 
I've also used the grooming services as well as the boarding. Pups always come home smelling pretty & silky smooth after a bath & brush. They come home from staying for the weekend happy, worn out, and healthy. 
Don't pass up River City Vet, they are truly wonderful.

Our waitress was new and did a great job. However the rest of the staff took a long time to greet us and seat us.  There was very little communication amongst the staff to hekp each other out with a full house of customers. 

Good was good. We had a couple different types of their specialty Eggs Benedict (BTA, Irish, Tri Tip), biscuits and gravy, and two different hashes.  The corner beef on both the Irish Benedict and hash was delicious.  The biscuits and gravy had a unique taste, I think it was because they butter and toasted the biscuit before they put a classic sausage gravy on it. 

It was a solid breakfast.  When we got there they were pretty busy and it was a bit loud but as the crowd decreased the sound level was much more enjoyable.

It was the last day to use my 'free burger on your  birthday' card. RR is one of those places I go to because it is pretty much consistent every time; The burgers are good, they will bring you hot fries and keep filling your soda throughout your meal. 

Service was a little slow today, hence my four star review. Food was as expected. Just kind of a 'ehhh' experience this time.

Worst service I ever had. First time there and won't be back. Host said it would be about 15 minutes for the pizza to come out which is totally fine. We got sat, ordered our drinks, and food. 30 minutes later the server still hasn't checked on us. We had to ask someone else for a refill. 15 minutes after that she comes to tell us our food should be out soon. So my boyfriend and I waited about an hour to eat while a family of 4 who sat after us got their food before us and was helped multiple times. Pizza was good, but $4 extra for each topping, which they are very stingy with. 
We also ended up boxing our pizza to eat it at home since they don't give out hot sauce or ranch unless you order their buffalo pizza or salad. 
I do not recommend eating here, there is a taco place right next door that I wish I would have gone to instead.

Went here for my birthday today and they ruined it.  I ordered the Tavern omelette and didn't realize that the potatoes comes with onions.  I'm highly allergic to this onions. All they did was put my omelets on a new plate where the potatoes and onions was touching the omelette.  I asked for a manager and his response was I didn't even think about CROSS CONTAMINATION.  When he walked up to the table he used the word "Hay what's wrong".  I'm not a horse or cow.  No apologies from the manager.The sad part it was part of my birthday festivities.  The manager didn't even asked to replace the meal.  So I didn't eat.
We love wingers!! Our favorite server is Kolbey. He is so attentive and professional.
Great customer service and help me save a lot of money! Definitely recommend and will be back for more tires

Idaho Singles is NOT the way to go if you are serious about finding a match. I paid for 8 matches at an outrageous price, but when you're looking for "the one," you think it's worth it. IT'S NOT WORTH THE MONEY YOU PAY AT IDAHO SINGLES.  The first four matches were so off the mark. With the 5th match, I didn't even get a phone call but was told that is considered a match since I agreed to meet the person. So with three left I wasn't holding my breath. I actually got two more matches that were not horrible, but not great either. I didn't even get the 8th match that I should have had. This company misrepresents themselves as a personal service that is working for me. Instead, it was someone in another state matching me up with people that didn't match at all. I asked for someone with a faith in a higher being and they actually matched me up with an atheist. What the heck?! Seriously, save your money and hit the local spots. You have just as much a chance to strike out without paying all that cash to someone else. Go on a mini-vaca instead!

This is the best breakfast I've had in a restaurant in a long time. Food was awesome - great taste and presentation. Service was great even at a peak time (10 am Sunday). Staci Y was the best server. Highly recommended!!

"I can't help it. I love sweet pork. It feels wrong in all the right ways. Pork is savory and delicious, candy is sweet and makes you smile. And then they had a baby, and then they put that baby in a quesadilla, with cheese, and rice and beans. And then I ate it! Do you hate me? I feel bad, and my stomach feels like it's gonna burst." - Shakespeare

This is such a fun place to eat with lots of mouth-watering choices. I really like the ambiance of this joint, while it is often crowded there's lots of seating and a cool waterfall glass statue thing a'ma'thing. 

The staff here is REAL friendly, they asked my mom and I a few times how we were, it made it feel more like a restaurant experience with how attentive they are. They have horchata which is awesome, but I wanted green tea and their green tea machine wasn't working. 

Sometimes they having surfing videos on the TV's. And sometimes it's not playing anything. I feel less than neutral about it... I'm not sure how to feel. Like if my Mom gave me a hug then left the room without making eye contact. It just leaves me with an off vibe, like... Did I miss something? 

They have great queso dip! I couldn't stop eating it! I have a problem! Or it's just really good! Or both! 

Anyways if you don't like pork, sweet or not, or queso... I don't know what to get here which is maybe why I gave it 4 stars personally. Then again, their mango sauce is great on a salad. Hmmm... Explore. Then call me and let me know. My number is 555-555-5555.

Honestly just okay, its super loud and the food was nothing special. I see what other people were saying about them being confused. We tried 5 different food items and nothing was mind blowing for what we paid we could of went some where amazing. I however will mention the cheesecake and the whiskey gravy was pretty delicious.
El loco gold and silver prices no one else has a fat ass BURRITO and the staff is not scary but kinda like no smiles get stoned like everyone else in the service industry be a big kid

The food and portions here are delicious and HUGE!!! We stopped in one night for dinner and couldn't believe how much food we got for $11 each! The service was really good too. Can't wait to get back!

Wow Wow Wow.  If you've read my other restaurant reviews you know that my wife and I always order a Calamari appetizer if it's on the menu.  I have to say the Kung Pao Calamari appetizer at this place is off the charts great and the best we've both had!    
We each had a hamburger for our entree and both were excellent!!!!   The bun was so light and flavorful that we looked at each other and said "whatever they used or made is awesome"   The steak fries were great and crispy.   I had regular steak fries and my wife had the sweet type.   
When I looked at the menu online a desert item caught my eye.  We don't usually order desert but I had to try the three berry cobbler with ice cream.  The wife rolled her eyes as if to say She was already full and had no room for desert.   Well, we shared one order and believe me we both made room for that whole tray of yummyness.   It was exceptionally good.  
Great job Tavern!   We will be back.

Awesome and quick service! Just what I needed to help me though the Spring Forward daylight savings time and losing an hour sleep. I had Army Reserve Drill this weekend and woke up at 5:30 AM which is more like 4:30 AM before daylight savings time. 

Super out of it, I knew I needed some coffee to get me though the day. I saw this Dutch Bros close to my home and though I'd get some coffee from there. Pulled in and got a medium caramel latte and was though the driveway in a minute. As always, the "broista" was super friendly and because I was in my military uniform, I received a discount. Very happy with my order of coffee and loved the customer service I received. I'll definitely come back again when I need my coffee fix. Thanks Dutch Bros! You're well on your way to adding another member to the Dutch Mafia.

Thy are really nice guys and say all the things you want to hear. but when I called to have them fix some stuff with the house that was under warranty .they just keep putting me off ,and giving me the run around it is very frustrating to have a new house that is falling apart and they don't care enough to fix it.i would not recommend them to build a  house

I wanted to have new carpet and tile installed throughtout my home.  By chance, I stopped at Great Floors.  The sales staff was friendly and helpful.  After selecting my flooring, I worked with J who was very patient with me as I changed my mind about some of it at least three times.  Once the material was ordered, J called with an installation date.  However, due to an accident that I had, I had to trust that J and Santiago, the installer, would take care of everything. Two months after the flooring was installed, I was finally able to go home to see my new floors.  It was wonderful to come home to see that from removing and replacing the furniture to replumbing the necessary fixtures and cleaning up had been accomplished by a great team.  Thank you staff of Great Floors for doing such an incredible job.  I couldn't be more pleased with the result.
Bonnie M.

This was our first trip here. The portions are huge and it is a fun environment, we had to wait a long time because we did not have the app where we could've registered from home. Highly suggested. The food was fine, but nothing to write home about. Given its popularity, I'm sure there are some delicious dishes we have not tried yet.

While I can't speak about the pizza here, they arguably have the very best salad bar in the area! 

Not only do they have a lot of ingredients available for you to turn any salad into a meal but it's clean, fresh & continuously being wiped down & refilled. This location has a mini kitchen right next to the salad bar so refilling it is literally only a few steps away. 

Lunch special for this spectacular offering is only $6.99 & includes a fountain drink. Ask for a lunch special punch card - buy 10, get 1 free!
Tip: Wednesday is double punch day - 2 punches on your card for each lunch special.

Had a free burger for my birthday- and that is why they get one star.  Everything else went downhill from there.  The check in person must hate her job because she was rude.  Our waiter was so focused on the large party next to us that we sat there for a long time ( we almost left- we should have) before he took our order.  Bottomless fries? They must be so bottomless they don't exist.  Our waiter said he would bring out fries early.  That did not happen.  He was more concerned about the other table. Bottomless macaroni for your kid?  Not if there is a big group next to you.  It was a sad, disappointing experience.  I would like to tell you the birthday singing and dessert made up for it.  But that didn't happen either.  Maybe we needed a group of at least ten for good service. If you want to eat somewhere where people tell you they will do something and then they don't follow through- Red Robin is the place for you.

This place is amaze-balls!  I mean THE BISCUITS AND GRAVY WILL CHANGE YOUR LIFE! I'm visiting but lord knows I wish I could wrap these sweet wonderful people and their chief in my suitcases and take them home with me! Lol Everything and everyone were awesome! Authentic comfort food straight from the heart. Heck even the lemonade is homemade and fire lol

Delivery is very fast. I got it in about 20 minutes piping hot. Now the the rice was bland and dry I had to add salt and some hot sauce. I had the chowmein with crispy noodles and the noodles were so  greasy they leaked through the bag. The chow mein was tasty but seemed to have more onions than anything. The food was what one would expect from a strip mall Chinese place.

Four of us ate on the patio at Gino's last night, this being our first time in about 15 years. The service was the worst we've ever experienced anywhere. We arrived at 4:30, so there weren't many customers there yet -- only a couple of tables in the dining room and us on the patio. A waitress brought us water, and then left us alone for 45 minutes without taking our orders. In the meantime, another table of four was seated. The same waitress took their drink order, served them drinks, and took their meal orders.  We continued to be ignored. Finally, the waitress took our orders 45 minutes after we were seated. Another waitress diligently filled our water glasses multiple times during our wait, which we appreciated. The food was good, but due to the horrible service, we won't be back.
My first time here. Chicken katsu is ok but vegetables and rice too little cold and warm I don't like it. All young need to stop play around and talk much. Never come here anymore. Sorry!

I have absolutely love them for years I've had multiple car loans with them. I have two cars with them right now that I would like to pay off. And this may be a new thing because I was able to pay it off with no issue in the past but they will not allow me to pay off my card over the phone or online. I have to either go in in person or download an app FaceTime them and show them a check in my hand. To me this is absolutely ridiculous.
