I explain this was my bathroom not a shared bathroom.  The Re-Bath representative explained their policy that a spouse must be present, so they could not do an estimate.  Two days later, a regional Vice President of Sales contacted me.  I explained this was bathroom was solely for me and I owned other houses.  The Regional VP of Sale reconfirmed their policy that the spouse needed to be present.  I inform him, I had already choose another contractor to remodel my bathroom.  
I gave them one star, because they were polite. Sorry folks I cannot work with a business that cannot deal having your spouse always present.

This is charming cozy little place with clean tables, linens and comfortable seating.  A friend and I took advantage of the Groupon brunch deal to try this restaurant and we will be back again!  The mochas were wonderful, rich and balanced!  Nice breakfast spread with big fluffy biscuits and homemade sausage gravy, crepes, waffles, eggs benedict, homemade cinnamon rolls, fruit, meats, quiches, chunky country potatoes and other goodies.  They offer mimosas and a great wine list.  We will be going back again with friends and family in towed.  I'm picky as I do restaurant inspections, as well as managed and cooked high end catering.  Cozy, comfortable, clean, yummy, welcoming, relaxing, quality.

The food was decent. There was some things there that are a great price for $1 a plate. That is if you want to run to the toilet after eating here. Everyone was friendly but about halfway through my meal my stomach was already getting very angry with me. Chef was awesome to talk to but was not worth the food poising that followed...

Bacon breakfast burritos are a hit or miss with these guys. Bacon is most of the time under cooked so the fat is gross. And I have had burritos with chopped up ham to make up for the bacon on multiple trips there. Glad I'm moving back to where they have their original restaurants so it will be better quality.

Definitely my go-to spot for breakfast/brunch in the area. I love corned beef hash, but only when it's done right- none of that canned nonsense! Moe Joe's corned beef hash is incredible- thick cuts of corned beef on top of the best potatoes, and I think over easy eggs are the best on top. 

Btw- get the Moe Joe potatoes over the hash browns! Hash browns are ok, but Moe Joe's are small, chopped, crispy potatoes that are perfectly cooked. 

French toast is solid- done traditionally, so no surprises! 

Cinnamon rolls are MASSIVE.
Perfect first stop for the day.  Staff is very friendly.  We had a sassy waitress that was hilarious.  Food was awesome.  Definitely coming back.

My wife and I were gifted a $30 gift card to Idaho Pizza Company from our realtor so we wanted try it out for our date night. There was a good amount of cars filled in the parking lot so that was a good sign for the business. We went in and ordered at the counter and we were given an order sign and got to chose where we sit. The decor was nice and very Idahoan with an ode to the outdoors and pictures of old Idaho. It was a nice touch to the Idaho themed restaurant. 

We got our order within about 15 minutes of ordering. We got the small Idaho Supreme Pizza which was perfect for just the two of us. It was delicious! Delicious pizza wasn't on my radar when I first moved to Idaho but I'm glad I found it here! With good food and a fun, homely atmosphere, this would be a nice place for me to bring my family when they come to visit.

I'm definitely coming back again and would love to try out the lunch buffet next time.
I had a great experience with Dr. Nielson and his staff.  Friendly and not pushy.  I would recommend The Eye Site to family and friends.  Check out google for more reviews.

I love coming to this salon. It's so relaxing!  Julia does an excellent job on my cut and color. I have to go every 5-6 weeks for a root touch up for those pesky grays and it's important to me that I can trust my stylist.  I also get a balayage twice a year and she does a phenomenal job. The products they use are amazing.

We came here before a movie to get a bite. Definitely a locally loved spot- it was busy! We shared finger steaks and tater tots. Even as busy as it was, we got our order in, drinks refilled, and got our meal fairly quickly, probably because it was only one thing. Pretty decent finger steaks, I would compare them to a fast food version. They seemed to be fried in good oil (not bitter) and the tots were hot & delicious. I think the only way to ruin a tater tot is to have it cold, but this wasn't a problem. This seems like a place people mostly go to get drinks and hang with their buddies, and the food isn't the main centerpiece. But it seems well-loved and I could see why. Very lively atmosphere!
I would go back here and try more, prices were decent and service was great.

The food was good, it was just the customer service they didn't do well. It was pretty packed but there was plenty of workers. Our server only came around a total of three times, one time to take our order, one time to check on us, and then to give us the check. He constantly went by looking at us and never offered a refill on water or soda. Good place over all.

Made my booking then was told they didn't have a pet room. Ok, I went and stayed at Motel 6. That night I discovered 2 charges from quality on my card, next day two more charges... Oh the manager is so sorry, he gave us a comp room. Next day we wake up to 1 charge and 1 pending. Manager arrives at the motel, and now 4 charges. Manager is a complete ass, rude and inconsiderate.  They have $330 of my dollars and refuse to do anything except give me a receipt showing they shouldn't be there. Oh, did I mention he called the cops on my lady accusing her of smoking drugs when it was a cigarette... His staff screwed up, no biggy. Manager should own it, and try to make it right. He refused, and tried to find any way to weasel out of it. Do you self a favor, DONT STAY HERE unless money isn't a issue for you....

If there was a negative 10 I would rate
Three weeks and a few calls I am still Waiting for a response to my service problem from 8/2/20. Apparently glitch I. Their system has been escalated to IT Dept. I finally removed my card info since no one can tell me if my data is safe. Will be removing my preferred shopper info as well. Now shopping Albertsons for delivery. Albertsons charges a delivery fee but won't allow tips for delivery people so it is a savings. Hopefully they pay delivery folks more. I hope fm eventually gets around to try customer service and responds to my concern. A month is too long to get a response to a legit concern. Don't use their delivery and I wouldn't recommend being a preferred customer as I am not confident in their data being secure since they can't respond to what they called a "glitch" in the system.

Ok, I know good Asian food is hard to come by in this area, and I never hold high expectations for any delivery Chinese food, but this was horrible. 

Placing the order was a challenge- everything had to be repeated 2-3 times at least, and I tend to speak fairly clearly. On the phone we were told 45 minutes. It was an hour and 15 minutes. The food was lukewarm and tasteless and the order was incorrect. We had ordered the Mandarin Chicken and got what is supposed to be sweet and sour. Deep fried chunks of chicken with a disgusting highly sweet gel on the side. We also ordered Kung Pao chicken that had a decent among of heat...and a ton of oil. The fried rice was weird- I can't even tell you why it tasted weird but the rice itself was a weird shape and texture and very tiny, and the additions (it was a basic fried rice) were bland and overcooked. The noodles (soft noodles) were about the same. 

We threw most of it away and ate other things instead. What a waste of time, money and taste buds.

Ginos was one of my favorite restaurants.... but the quality has really gone down hill.   The Alfredo which used to be so heavenly tasted like I was at the Olive Garden... and the food today soooo salty.... not what used to be....
Delicious, be prepared to wait or check in on yelp. But definitely worth the wait. I do wish they would bring back there kimchi hash though.

First and LAST time to this place.  It didn't appear to be very clean, but we decided to give it a try and not judge by appearances.  We chose to sit at a table and order rolls because the boats did not look fresh or appetizing.  When I sat down my chair almost fell over because a leg was bent or broke.  My cup had something sticky on the rim and the tea wasn't very hot or good.  The first rolls that were brought to us were so dry it was like having sawdust in my mouth that tasted like old fish (yes, I'm worried I might be sick).  I wanted to cancel the other rolls that we ordered but the chef was almost finished making them and we figured we'd see if they were any better.  They were, but just marginally.  I'm so disappointed and irritated that we were only offered an apology, not a break on the bill for horrible food.  With so many other wonderful places to eat in the area, don't waste your money, or risk getting sick, at this place!

This is NOT the first time my wife & I have had the LOBSTER RAVIOLI. In the past it was alway very good.  This time it was the worst LOBSTER RAVIOLI we have ever had.  They forgot to add the Lobster to the ravioli.  We opened several of them up and they were filled with CHEESE.  "NO LOBSTER".  Whats going on?  If I could give "-0" star thats what I would have posted.

One of our most favorite Chinese restaurants! The special chow mine is to die for!! It's family owned and the main gal works the counter, is a waitress, answers phones etc. she is a hustler. They aren't usually the fastest at serving the food but it comes out hot and fresh. The sweet and sour chicken always has a nice crisp layer and is never soggy. Totally worth any wait. Fast isn't always the best.

Food was awesome, as always.  Even though they were really slammed with dining in and carry out, we were seated and served timely.  While everyone must have been stressed, service was top notch.  Thank you.

Nice to have these guys back; I remember eating at the Gandolfo's on Overland ~7-8y ago. Good sandwiches, pretty hefty, and a fair price considering what you get. If you are tired of Jersey Mike's, give these guys a shot!

LOVE Ginos. Inside does not match outside at all. Don't just walk or drive by - go in!  I have gotten a few different dishes and all have been good. I always leave very very full... portions are good size and desserts are good too.

I don't care how good the food is here: I just left without my meal after waiting 1.5 hours for a single rice bowl. Unfortunately they just opened so you might want to try this place in a few months when they have their act together. This length of a wait time is unacceptable from even the best eateries. The staff seemed nice and apologetic, but it was a rough opening. Next time I'm in town, I will try again because I love teriyaki and their food looks good.

I have never had such a poor experience with a restaurant in my life. Altogether I've spent hundreds of dollars at this Red Robin and it continuously gets worse every time. I typically order delivery and always get the chicken strips or some chicken entree, and every time the chicken is hard and chewy. My fries are always cold and unsalted, and they never include the sides of sauces that I specifically ask for. I have talked to the management here about these problems and I have given them multiple chances since then, and I will not be giving them anymore. This place is simply not worth your time or money. If you are a big fan of Red Robin like I have been in the past I would suggest going to a different location in the area.

This used to be our favorite go to restaurant for special dinners, birthdays, out of town guests, etc.  We didn't go often but we did go several times a year, for many years.  However, I must say that the last few visits have been disappointing.  Both the service and the food are not what they used to be.  Maybe the original,owner is no longer involved.  Our most recent visit was probably our last. Slow service, forgotten requests and disappearing waiter. Food was half and half: the Misto Mare was excellent. The lasagna de mare had way too much cheese broiled on top and was dry - whoops! Someone get the lasagna out of the oven! I expect better when spending $100+ for dinner. 
Unfortunately this has been a developing pattern, or maybe we have just been there on their few random bad nights. I suspect the former is closer to the truth.
The person that helped me was a manager a the towne square mall,boise,id . very nice and got me taken care of. very happy, satisfied , no hassle.:-)

The service here is never good some of the girls there seem very snobby and typical high school drama I go there to eat not to hear them discuss their problems more wiping tables so you can go gossip in the back. Also some servers really need to learn how to take orders. I asked for something extra on my plate and he told me he would have to ask his manager and he came back and said the manager said no and I said seriously even if I pay extra? And he said well yeah if you pay extra you can...... ummm duhhhh I would expect to pay extra I wasn't meaning free. Definitely has never worked retail or been a salesman. It's a restaurant not McDonald's and even McDonald's now a days isn't afraid to up charge for sauce. People go to a restaurant to spend money serve them what they want and rack up that bill! Other than that food is pretty decent along with their drinks but I would never go out of my way to go there. No wonder it has dropped down to one location standing.

Nice gem that we found while visiting daughter in Idaho. My wife and myself are pretty familiar with what constitutes good Japanese food and this place has Good Japanese food!
The staff was really friendly and if you have a child that is celebrating a birthday you really need to take them here. They put it on their big screen, very nice!

Get the Idaho burrito, it is great.  It's your typical 24 hour Mexican food place that is great for when you're starving late at night for whatever reason.  My only concern is the cleanliness of the salsa bar.

STAFF IS SOOOO AMAZING !!!!! Well the 2 dudes that were working there each time I happened to go. I hd never been there before and was able to talk it out with the barista and get perfect fun recommendations! I got 2 diff coffees (think one was a "nick special" lol cant remember... but they will know what it is if you say its one of the dude workers specials lol ;).    Mexi mocha SO good

Went 3 days in a row it was so good.  I had breakfast there all 3 days.  I had the breakfast burrito, and Benedicts.  All were incredible.  The potatoes are the best and the food was so good with big portions.

Amazing service! Everyone was so happy and friendly. Great food options definitely my favorite breakfast place in Idaho now. I had the hash bowel and a side of the biscuits and gravy (big portions) great price. Coffee was good as well.

We used to eat here at least twice a month, and the food was always great. As a retired couple, their rewards program enabled us to get some money off after a few meals and the service was excellent.  This last time, with new management, the food was terrible and either overly spiced or not well cooked, the service was deplorable, and the tiramisu was so dry and tasteless (they must have changed the recipe) that we couldn't finish it.  They wouldn't honor our reward points either. The server told us they were now using cheaper ingredients to cut costs and were not offering as many of their tastiest dishes as they used to.  Don't waste your money here.

My husband and I went to Bish's last Saturday to look at Class A's.  We met Joe Rodriguez who proceeded to tell us about a few of their coaches. After listening to our needs he took us to see the Newmar Canyon Star 3911. What a beautiful coach, ADA compliant and one that met all of our needs, plus some. After showing us the coach, Mr. Rodriguez spent the next couple of hours answering all of our questions and showing us every inch of the Newmar. We made it clear that we weren't quite ready to sell our home and hit the road, but there was no pressure from Mr. Rodriguez. He simply said that when we were ready he hoped he would be able to be the person to assist us. We were both so impressed with Mr. Rodriguez and his 'sales style' that we do hope he will be around when we are ready to 'pull the trigger' on our next home.
I have gotten my nails done here twice and both times I was so impressed! They are so nice and welcoming and the atmosphere is amazing. Clean and beautiful little salon!

This is one of my favorite breakfast places.  Can't count the number of times we've eaten here.  The servings are enormous so plan on sharing.  We typically split the chorizo bowl with mojos.  It's delicious!  I also love their jalapeno berry mimosas and the maple fried chicken is fantastic.  

The service is touch and go.  Sometimes it's great, sometimes it leaves room for improvement, thus the 4 star instead of 5.

We visited the RV sales to look at a class C travel trailer, and we're met by a salesman that didn't introduce himself didn't ask for our names, and then proceeded to tell us there were no classes on the lot but we're free to go look around, so he went to look around, and found five or six class C's that we were looking for, of course there's no information on any of them, so makes it very hard to be on your own. We then asked how much our truck could pull, telling the salesman what it was. And he said we would have to call Dodge to find out how much it would pull, I would think that a salesman would know that, or could look it up, or even offer to look it up. So won't be going back, we told him that it could be a year out, maybe that's why! Poor service, especially when we found ones we were looking for!

This is one solid, Bible teaching church! SO thankful to have this new church in the Treasure Valley! The kids program was the best, everyone was so nice and the kids had a great time. (We have 6 kids, they all loved it!)The youth group is on Wednesday nights so my 12 and 14 year olds are excited to check that out. Excited to go back on Sunday!

This place should get 10 stars it's so good. Service is great the girl who served us was extremely friendly and helped pick out great choices. Portions are large, I left stuffed and fueled for the day. I recommend the hash bowls. I'm sure all are bomb but I got the farmers one. Craving it as I write this review it was so delicious. This place is a real treat!

For the first year or so after it opened, Red Pavilion was hands down, in our experience, the best of a pretty mediocre lineup of Chinese restaurants in the Valley. If that sounds like faint praise, it is. But we grade on the curve here and the food alone seemed worth 4 stars, good enough for us to overlook some of the restaurant's significant but utterly fixable shortcomings.

After three visits in the past few months, we can't escape the conclusion Red Pavilion has joined that pretty mediocre lineup. The service remains haphazard -- apparently it's always everyone's first night on the job. And now the food quality has deteriorated, all the way down to mall food-court level. We haven't really liked anything we've ordered on those recent visits, including some things we previously enjoyed. That careful, freshly-prepared appearance and taste are gone and the dishes seem more like they've been served up from a steam table or reheated. Soggy pot stickers, greasy noodles, tasteless meat. And I'll spare you the details, but we also didn't feel too well a few hours after our last visit.

I'm sorry to have to contribute this update, as we had very high hopes. The place seems to remain popular and maybe we just got unlucky three times in a row, but there won't be a fourth. We're done.

Wow!  Absolutely terrible customer service.  I don't even think it qualifies as service at all.  It seemed like the two employees I interacted with were pissed that I came in to buy something.  

The first guy I interacted with was so lacking in personality that he just seemed to care less that I was there.  He hands me a form to fill out.  Says "here". Like I am at a doctors office or something.  

Then after picking out the ONLY white quartz that they had in stock they tell me they can't sell it to me.  Because they are only a whole seller.  

I tell them that my countertop fabricator instructed me to come in to pay for the slabs so they say they have to call him first.

So I don't understand why people don't like government offices. This would make most people very happy. Walked in this morning to the self-service kiosk push the button and is soon as my ticket came out it called my name and I got the extreme pleasure of having James help me again. Last time I was in a few months ago he help me with an out-of-state title transfer and was outstanding in suggestions and tips on how to make the process smooth and easy. Today was noDifferent. I walked in he greeted me with a smile I told him he would help me last time he thanked me for coming in again within five minutes our transaction was done he help do some changes to the name on the title and we were out the door. Great service as always from a great location a hidden gem in Boise Ada County
My boyfriend and I just recently went here, the food was amazing and the waitress was very kind and patient. 10/10 recommend

I came into Meridian on a visit and found Gino's. It was very good food along with a Chianti by the glass that was delicious. We had a variety of foods Veal, Margarita pizza and seafood lasagna. All delicious. I highly recommend this place.

I transferred from another vet's office to Dr. Fineman, when I felt the other place didn't really care about me or my pet personally (and they had multiple vets). My dog was sick on a Saturday, and they told me I'd have to wait until Monday before I'd be able to get any help from them. Dr. Fineman, on the other hand, told me to bring her right in and he made space in his busy day to examine and treat her nausea and vomiting. Dr. Fineman gives me personalized attention each and every time I take my poodle to him. He's a really good doctor, an excellent communicator and a fine person, no pun intended.

Worst customer service with horrible snarky attitude from Taryn! I went in Saturday ordered balloons for my 5 year old, said I would be back at 7pm. Cashier was beyond flustered but apologized took our balloon order, talked me into buying extra stuff. Sunday morning (they are closed Sundays) I wake up freaking out that we forgot to pick up our order (mind you I am 7m pregnant with #5) so I easily forget things. Anyway after many tears and being mad at myself we hot balloons,  no big deal I will call Zurchers Monday and surely they will help me by explaining or something.

Call Monday and I am greeted with a not so pleasant tone of Taryn... I explain my situation and tell her I no longer need the balloons that I paid for and asked why no one called before they closed. She puts me on hold forever, comes back and says it's because I was a walk in they didnt call me, So... basically telling me it's my fault. The cashier didn't take my number down which I swear she did, but still. Anyway she I could come get my balloons that I no longer need or nothing she doesn't care but they will not refund me. Cool cool, dont care about a refund.  I then ask if she could do a fresh order and she huffed and said absolutely not.... lady just work with here, that's all I am asking. It's not hard to be a nice person but she was rude the entire time which just made things worse.  

I will not be going back to this store or any other Zurchers after the horrible service (attitude) from this one person. My business will be going to the other store who went above and beyond to help me last minute to make my child happy on his special day.

So frustrated! We placed an online order this morning. When we got home, we discovered we had been given the wrong thing. Instead of the Country Fried Steak we had ordered, we got some nasty, shredded meat thing that was covered in peppers, white cheese, and eggs. I have had orders wrong before. I am usually pretty patient with that, as human beings we make mistakes. The problem came when I had no way to get ahold of them to let them know about their mess up so that they could fix it. I called the number over and over and it continued to say that the user was busy. My husband said that he had noticed the phone was off the hook when he went to pick up our order but hadn't thought much about it. We paid $14 for something that we didn't even try because they got it wrong, had the hassle of trying unsuccessfully to get ahold of them, and ultimately have no recourse because their customer service is so poor.
This is the place to go if you want everyone who came after you to get served before you. Food is fine.
Good food but slow service. Ordered through their app and it was 40 minutes before it even left the store.

Beware of their ridiculous policy for new patients! I now have to pay over $1k out of pocket for a physical because of this office! I was supposed to be a new patient and missed my first appointment due to a last minute work meeting last week and called in to reschedule. Just got a call from them a few hours before my rescheduled appointment that because I missed my first appointment, it set a "bad precedent" and they wouldn't accept me as a patient. Cool policy. You really showed me. Super great integrity and super awesome to cause more issues for new patients out of "principle." And instead of letting me know last week when I could've rescheduled with another doctor's office before my insurance ran out this month, they tell me the day before my insurance ends. And now since I can't get an appointment with another doctor before my insurance runs out tomorrow, I now have to pay out of pocket over $1k for a general physical until I get new insurance! Unreal. Normally offices charge a small no-show fee if they really want to enforce it. Never dealt with an office like this that denied new patients because they didn't like that they missed an appointment. Unprofessional and a ridiculous policy. Don't recommend!

This is a nice, clean place to come to. My pedicure still looks great after a week! It wasn't very relaxing though, because the lady doing my mani pedi was on the phone most of the time. Also there was no massaging during the pedicure. I would give it another try though, because they just reopened....

I booked this low cost motel through priceline and hoping they could check me in at 1:00pm after an all night drive. To my disappointment Quality Inn was going to charge me $25 fee. They would not provide the customer service to allow me to check in. I am in this area once a week and will not book at quality inn in meridian again. Sorry.

They put in gold granite when we ordered white! They refused to admit it was the wrong granite despite the fact they got the kitchen granite right (white) but the bathrooms gold!! They wanted us to pay for the replacement of their wrong doing!! Be careful!! Pick your own slab so they can't lie!!

Unfortunately no gluten free options, but they did have multi non dairy options. This location can be a bit tricky to get in & out of too- but the people where friendly & the coffee was outstanding. I will be back
The wait was long but the service and food made up for it. Sarah in the bar was an amazing server and cared about us as customers.

When I arrived at the clinic, I could not lie, sit or stand without killer pain. I received relief after the first visit. The care I recieved was amazing. Everyone in the office is amazing! They are caring and professional. I've never had to wait for treatment either.  Being new to the area I was worried if I would be able to find someone as good as my last chiro. After only one bad experience, I found Dr Rick's and his amazing staff. I'm so very happy and recomend them 100%. If I could give more stars, I would.

Went here the other week for the first time and had really high expectations but left slightly disappointed. Walking in they asked if we had a reservation which we didn't. The restaurant was pretty much empty. We were seated at the bar but it felt like we were inconveniencing them either way. The bartender served us which was one of the good parts about this visit. She was awesome! So friendly and on top of things even though she was also working the bar! Thumbs up to her. Now the food is where the 3 stars comes in. The website boasts authentic Italian food, everything tasted pretty eh, no freshly grated parmesan, only powdered, noodles didn't seem super fresh. It was just disappointing. I am not an expert in authentic cuisine but I except a lot more, it tasted like something you could get at a chain. I will try again because maybe it was an off day but the only food that was really tasty was the bread and the olive oil.
Love the food, but be prepared to wait. When they say 20 minutes for take out, that usually means an hour.

I have to somewhat agree with Cody L's review.

I was going to Jeremy for a few months up until he changed his schedule to only include weekends, I work weekends so I had to find someone else.

I know some guys like the whole barber shop hangout thing, but I prefer to get in & out with a fast fade.  I won't include this guys name out of respect and because people like this just make their own life harder than it has to be, and I don't want to make it even harder.  So lets just call him 'Royal Flush'.  

I was referred to "Royal Flush" for a fast fade.  I called Royal Flush and asked him if he could cut a fade in 15 mins, at which point he replied that my question was silly & retarded, no he couldn't, and that's like saying you're going to McDonald's and you want a burger in 5 mins, can you make my burger in 5 mins or not?. 

LOL... I couldn't make this sh!t up.  I replied, "Okay thank you for your time and hung up".

* If you want to try this place out I would suggest asking for Jeremy.
When I asked Jeremy if he could cut a fade in 15 mins, he said that he would give it a shot but that he didn't want to sacrifice quality, which is totally understandable.  Jeremy went above & beyond, was very professional & friendly, and was cutting a clean fade in under 15 mins.

In my own opinion, I think Jeremy could do much better at a more professional barber shop.

Terrible - service was non-existent.  Had to find our own napkins, then asked for silverware was told they didn't have any - I asked in the whole restaurant - they said yes no silverware in the entire restaurant, about 5 minutes later a knife was brought to the table.  Birthday celebration was never completed.      Food was mediocre at best and don't be tricked by the "bottomless" sides they never came back and asked about refills.  Kids didn't touch their meals and no one asked if something was wrong - not sure if food was bad or kids were just being picky.  Check is electronic, we asked to pay with cash, they said we had to find our server to pay in cash.  Server never appeared so we left cash on the table.  Been years since I've been to a Red Robin and as long as I remember this visit I will not go again.

Ok,  I'm a realtor,  see all kinds of vendors,  clients needs at the last minute etc!  A client (cutest mature lady) backed into her garage door the day it was listed..she was quite upset about the accident (& was unable to close her garage door) so I referred her to who I usually use.  It was a Friday they were unable to get to her the same day so started looking for someone else. 

Called Hanson's, they were friendly and was able to be at her home in a few hours.  The arrived, we're very friendly AND treated her  very nicely AND fixed her door for WAY less than expected..what is better than that!?
Had the  make your omelette. Ham and chicken. Prepared perfectly. Service was excellent. Highly recommend them

Went to look at toy haulers and maybe an rv or two. We had to meet with a sales person to even look at anything. They wanted to know what we were looking for and when we stated a toy hauler and the length and amenities we currently have and want to keep on a new one, we were told we don't have any of those here in stock thanks for coming by. Good bye. No would you like to browse something else?, maybe we can check on getting one ordered?, let's see what we have coming in, nothing. 

I won't be giving them my business even for parts on my current trailer after that interaction.
Moe joes potatoes CANT BE BEAT! I love a savory breakfast and this place always hits the spot with their juevos rancheros.

I was in the urgent care and felt that the room I was in was not very clean. Every tool, device, and item that was used on my pet was used without gloves and sat on the surface of the counter which was covered in animal hair that was not my pets. I could hear the staff chatting obnoxiously behind the doors and paid an outrageous price for simple services. I know this is not a human medical facility, and with the price tag that your charging people you'd think you could Clorox wipe the counters and store medical tools in a sanitary way. The staff was a bit disorganized and there were several different people involved in our process. Having less hands on deck a more one on one contact would be preferable especially in situations where the outcome is poor for your pet. I am greatful for the urgent care hours but definitely plan to establish care for my pet elsewhere.

My wife and I have tried many Chinese restaurants over the years, but this is definitely the best Chinese food we have had. In addition to excellent food, with generous portions, the service is superb. This restaurant will be on our regular rotation. The Mandarin Chicken, Nutty Bird Chicken, and Mongolian Beef were fantastic! Prices are excellent as well.
Outstanding food coupled with amazingly friendly service is a winning combination.  You won"t be disappointed.
The food was delicious. They were extremely busy so we had to wait awhile but we'll worth it.

This place was pretty good. We came here for lunch and there were some flavorful options. 
I ended up ordering the salmon salad which has capers, olives and salmon. The salon was freezing n cold anD really  salty which was a  little disappointing but otherwise prettyy good.
My husband got the jalapeño burger and it looked delish. He finished the whole thing and it was pretty big. I did get a bite of his sweet potatoe fries and those were really darn good! 
I ordered our almost 3 year old the cheeseburger kids  meal which he didn't even touch but that's not because of the foood and just because  he's a picky eating 2 year old. 
I'd come back once I'm not pregnant for a glass of wine and some apps.

So we arrived around 5pm on a Thursday and it was semi packed. They have roughly around 12 booths, 6 tables and a bar from what I could tell. The vibe I got is definitely that of a modern tavern, it was a little dark but it had some good enough lighting. 

For starters we ordered the hummus with pita chips and cucumbers. The hummus tasted a little different than what I expected from a hummus, this one had somewhat of a cumin flavor (which was not our fav). The cucumbers tasted somewhat "dirty", I wouldn't order that as a starter again. 

For our meals, I ordered the tavern burger and added bacon with a side of steak fries. The burger was one of my favorites that I've tried around the treasure valley, had so much flavor and the bun was yummy! My husband ordered the French dip with steak fries as well and a side of ranch/fry sauce. He said the French dip was good but I kept seeing him put salt on it so I'm assuming it wasn't salted. We will definitely be back to try other items on the menu though because everything sounded so good!

Good place to get some shank.  I had the boar shank and my wife had the lamb shank.  The boar shank was the better of the two.  The meat is very flavorful and tender and is served bone in as the name implies.

The shanks are served with gnocci as a side.  The gnocci had great texture and flavor.  Very good.  

The wine list was even surprisingly good.

Great place to spend an evening on the deck.

Dr. Amanda Dozier is AMAZING! If you haven't made her your Primary Care Physician something is wrong with you!?!?! Dr. Dozier is smart and takes the time to listen to her patients.  She is able to take care of your whole family, from young to old...so call her today!
As a physician, I have no hesitation referring patients to her from my practice, because I trust her and her team to take great care of them. She is my PCP and she should be yours too! :)

Just starting our search for a 5th wheel toy hauler and stopped at Bish's today.  Kurt Dykstra showed us what we are interested in and we found it!  Kurt is extremely professional and knowledgeable.  We didn't make the purchase today because we didn't expect to find the perfect 5th wheel so we weren't prepared to finalize, but we will be heading back shortly to finish everything!  Go to Bish's and ask for Kurt!
Found this place by chance. Great chicken fried steak, nice people. Get there early to avoid lines.

We eat out a lot. I read on "next door" this was a good place to eat. I have never before seen the health violations that may have happened during our dinning experience. We actually saw an employee who was cleaning a table take food off a dirty plate and with their fingers pop it their mouth. This same person continually touched their nose and hair, then brought our drinks and food. Do not even look in the kitchen!  Gross. The overall service and restaurant were a hot mess. Never again!

COVID-19 update: They are still open and offering carry out. The sweet lady who checked me out and handed me my food was wearing gloves. You can pay with cash or card. 

I tried two new things this time. The honey almond chicken and the sticky rice balls with red bean paste. Both were amazing. The honey almond chicken was crispy and had the perfect amount of honey glaze. Not too sweet. Plus it came atop crunchy cabbage so I got to eat a serving of vegetables. :)

The rice balls were delicious! The outside was crisp, and the inside was soft and gooey. There is a slight sweetness to these, but not overwhelmingly so. I don't know why the red bean paste works here, but it does!
I like heathy clean food  and this place was exactly that! The meat was cooked perfect and the sauce was amazing. I got the spicy chicken and teriyaki beef. It was a clean and nice atmosphere.

The service was excellent with very friendly staff. We went on a whim on a Tuesday, which was apparently "kids eat free day", so that was a nice bonus. My wife and I both had chicken rice bowls with spicy teriyaki. It was super delicious and the serving size was great for the price (especially since drinks were included with the rice bowls at no extra charge). My wife had a Caesar side salad too and said she really enjoyed it.
Love the food and staff are so friendly.  I've come for lunch and breakfast and live them both.  Actually the best BLT I've ever had.

My first visit, I tried their Basque Chorizo Pepper Hash with Cinnamon Roll French Toast
The Hash bowl was surprisingly good. The Chorizo slices, pepper, poached eggs, and potatoes all in that one dish complimented each other.
The Cinnamon Roll French Toast was delicious, but with its high in sugar, I was good eating 1 out of two slices, and save the last slice to go

My second visit, I tried the Corned Beef Hash again with Cinnamon Roll French Toast. Whereas the Basque Chorizo Pepper Hash kind of took me by surprise how delicious it was, the Corned Beef Hash was more of an American traditional breakfast feature. It was expectedly good

First night eve going to this hotel, Got here super last last night, the cheapest room was 215$ and that's fine. The lady at the front desk was extremely rude & our hotel key didn't work for about 5 times & she didn't seem like she was happy to help. The shower had left over pubes from someone prior & the bed had crusty blood on it. The alarm clock wasn't even set right so we were unable to make breakfast, just a over all bad experience there's way better hotels out there.

Chapman used to be great till dad died. Now they don't care about anyone or thing but making money. They have tenants who have to run electrical cords from one part of building to rest of building. BeCouse they will not up grade electrical system . People living with bug infestation . Having to live with part home wide open because of fire and they haven't cleaned debry to rebuild. Dad Chapman is rolling in his grave. Heard of slum Lord Chapman is way beyond slum
Great sushi spot! The fish to rice ratio is great and the fish is always fresh. Would also highly recommend the gyoza appetizer to start with!
The best bfast place in Idaho!! Downright awesome!! The service was perfect, the omelet was awesome and the biscuits are superb!!

The company has stated that the have discussed the issues with the installers to correct the installment issues.  The company states they will refund me in full.  They apologized and said this was a rare issue in their company.  
This company has resolved this issue.   I want to thank them.  Unfortunately I cannot delete the review so I completed an update on this issue.

This was the first breakfast spot we tried when we moved to Treasure Valley almost 4 years ago.

The food is not only delicious but the service is welcoming and quick. There is a warmth to this place that makes you feel at home!

We have fond memories here because we ate breakfast before I went into labor with my first baby and we came back with him a few weeks later for our first meal out! We even had the same server who now always remembers us. 
It can get busy on the weekends, so keep that in mind! And always, always, get the cinnamon roll. Swoon!

I placed an order today (January 22nd) at 1:02pm for 4 sandwiches, called and spoke with store manager Nick at 1:30pm for a status check, he advised me they're running behind. Called again at 2:03pm and spoke with Nick again, I asked him to cancel the order as it's been too long and I'll drive over to pick them up myself. I also asked for a credit due to the long deliver time, he advised me he wouldn't issue as credit, he stated life happens and to get over it.

We bought a beautiful Torque Toy Hauler in March of 2021.  The locks to the generator and outdoor storage quit working almost immediately.  We went in to Bish's Service Dept to order the parts.  They told us it would be December before we could get the part.  I have called several times, most of the time you can't even get somewhere to leave a message.  I have left several messages for Tim asking for a return call.  Nothing has happened!
The thing that is really upsetting for me is my dear husband passed away unexpectedly in July.  They know he passed away and they still are not helping in anyway.  
They are good when it comes to their sales - but their service lacks in every aspect.  As I am talking to others, I hear that their service is terrible.  I totally agree.  It would be nice if they would take care of their customers after the sale.  We have a warranty on it as well. 
If you buy from them don't expect them to take care of you after the sale, they won't.

My experience with uncharted recreation was awesome.  Jacob W was outstanding.  It is nice to have someone who cares so much and not pushy.  He is very polite and I met all the others that worked there and things just kept getting better and better.  This is the only place I will buy from.  Thank You uncharted for hiring the best in the best.  thank Jacob from the bottom of our hearts sue and donna

This is my go-to place.  I have been to many, but finally find the right nail salon.  They do such good work!! Done with care.  They take time to do a job very well done, and it shows each time. I highly recommend this place. Very friendly too.

Could not manage to squeeze basic information about a rig I was interested in from these people either through email or over the phone, but they were sure anxious that I make an appointment to drive 400 miles to see this RV in person.

Too many motor homes out there to waste my time with these people.

These reviews are not indicative of our experiences. We have selected Joy Garden as our preferred Chinese food restaurant and they have never disappointed. Their staff is very friendly and the food has always been very high quality, not the heavy oils that others have stated. We have kept with Joy Garden because of their great offerings, and their ability to provide outstanding food, service, and variety. We have had them provide food for a variety of friends and tastes, and they have never disappointed.

Came in last night for Mother's Day dinner with my family and you were out of almost everything. spinch dip and zucchini coins/fries  tortilla chips
Pretty disappointing. nothing on the menu sounded very good once i found out you were out of a lot of stuff. Oh and no pepsi products like the last time we came in.
Dont think ill come back to this location :( been a few years since we were here and probably the last time for a long while.
And in meridian were the mask mandate is gone but they wont let you in unless you wear a mask. Very pathetic
Never got a refill on my lemonade as well

We stopped by to check out the food options and were really excited!  The owner is extremely passionate about providing healthy fast options.   

Items we have tried so far include:

Pizza - Quarterback

Bowls -Surfer bowl, Kayaker, & Bodybuilder

Swimmer dessert

So far the gluten free pizza is one of our favorite choices.  The food is tasty and we look forward to trying more menu items!
Great food! Good service. Get the Irish cowboy!

We have become quite the regulars at this location because the food is always great, and the service is even better. We like to sit at the bar to watch our sports and the bartender, Becca is always more than accommodating.

How many times have you ever been issued a full refund of your deposit and the Manager had a smile on his face when he gave it back to you? Rob, the owner, said on our initial contact that his major objective was to find the coach for me that fit, and fit at a price I would feel comfortable paying. We settled on a Wildwood 277BHS, a really nice coach, and we negotiated (peacefully I may add) a price acceptable to both of us, including my trade in...however, after a few days thought, I brought my tape measure over to check a few details and discovered that the coach I had selected would not, in the end, accommodate my needs...Rob couldn't have been nicer about it, and simply said "keep coming back, they change 'em all the time!"...all in all a "5 star" experience! John G

OMG...I was losing hope of finding a great sushi place in the Treasure Valley. Stopped in for a quick lunch, resigned that this was probably just another mediocre AYCE joint. WRONG! 

I didn't have time to try much, but had Miso Soup and the Sashimi appetizer, both were excellent. 

So much of the miso soup you get is really basic and unsatisfying, hardly worth a second thought, not the case here, it was noticably good. 
 
The sashimi was so beautifully presented, other patrons came over to inquire what it was. Portion sizes were generous compared to other places I've been in Boise, and quality was first rate. 

I am very anxious to see if they do ramen and rolls equally well next time so yes...I will be back. 

If you value quality over sheer quantity, this is a must try!

I've been going to Awesome Nails for several years now.  They do a professional job on my nails and I've never had a nail break between appointments. They are always ready for me at my appointment time, the shop is clean, staff/owners are friendly and respectful.
I was sad to witness a caller who was verbally abusive making unrealistic demands. The caller was yelling and using F* words.  Nevertheless, staff stayed calm and respectful to this caller. This business deserves 5+ stars for fantastic service.  
I highly recommend Awesome Nails!

I'm a property manager, so I'm always on the lookout for companies with not only high quality products/services, but high quality customer service and communication as well. That being said, Capell is my go-to company for any of our flooring needs. I rely on their judgement to let me know what needs to be done. They get it done efficiently, they do an amazing job, they communicate what's important, and they have competitive pricing. All-in-all, highly recommended!
Yelp is predatory but Pioneer rocks. The best credit union in the treasure valley for a small town feel and excellent service

I have been a loyal CBW patron for many years. Last month I had an issue with abuse by one of the counselors that I witnessed while watching the camera. To their credit, they addressed it and I gave them a second chance. Today I picked up my dogs and was told that my older Golden that takes meds for seizures did not get his regularly scheduled dose the night before. He was also wet from a bath that I didn't order because when you went to his kennel in the morning, he was sitting in pee. He is housebroken, never has accidents, and the ONLY time he releases his bladder is during a seizure. According to the mgr. "he was a little dazed" when he came out of the kennel. You contacted my vet to find out if he should get the post seizure meds, and finally told me about all of this when I came to pick him up at noon.  Your solution was to suggest that for my next two scheduled stays that I move to the location on the other side of town where the staff is more well trained? Had he received his seizure meds on time, he likely would not have had a seizure....very frustrating, particularly in that I sort all the pills and put them in containers labeled for each dose. This entire incident was a train wreck from the beginning.... 
You have lost a good customer....no more chances.

We've been going there since it opened. The food is excellent! Really, it is very good food. And the family that owns the establishment are very nice people. But my major complaint is that the lady that runs it tries to do everything and the customer can sit for a long period of time while she helps people at the counter, answers the phone and takes the orders, speaks in loud Chinese to the cooks, waits on tables and then buses the tables too. Recently, their special chow mien sounded really good so when we were leaving the place we were visiting, I called and ordered food. I was told "10 to 15 minutes" (because I asked) which would be just perfect. It finally was around 45-50 minutes AFTER that time I finally got my to-go order and left fuming for probably the last time. I don't wish those nice people ill, but COME ON! MY TIME IS IMPORTANT TOO!

Decent sushi (not the best but pretty good) and some of their other dishes are good as well. I enjoyed their nabeyaki udon and my husband is a fan of their beef donburi. Service is always good and the restaurant is very clean.

First time here! We did take out. We had Mongl beef, Kung Pao Chicken, Hot and Sour soup and a Veggie Lo Mein. The Mongl beef melted in your mouth. We ordered it hot and spicy and it was perfect (hot.) The Kung Pao Chicken was also incredibly flavorful.  Veggie Lo Mein was delicious. Loved the noodles. The soup was great as well. What we expected. Definitely will be back!

Please don't there if u have dark hair. They only know how to work with blonde hair. They don't listen to what the customer ask for and there hair dye is cheap. It fades real quick. Save your money and go to a real salon.

Service was decent but the food lacked flavor and was way over priced. My family and I used to come here all the time but I think this was our last visit. I've never had a more bland fettuccine alfredo. Really disappointed in this visit but like I said the staff was nice enough.

Cand by right when they opened -- many places were closed on Sat! Open 10-2, spent two hours narrowing it down to three options. Derek was courteous and helpful even thought there were many customers. Selection was beautiful and loved how things were sorted by price/material.

I don't usually write reviews but I felt compelled because of our terrible experience. I went here with my husband and our 2-year-old based on great reviews and what a disappointment. I can't say anything about the quality of food but I can tell you the service is bad. We didn't eat here because we ended up leaving. After sitting for half an hour, we didn't even get water. No apologies for making us wait. What kind of restaurant doesn't offer something to drink while you sit there? I understand they only have one waiter but come on, if you're going to charge such high prices for food at least be courteous enough to give us water! 

I saw the staff taking care of a large table because that meant more money. I watched the waiter take a phone call and a to-go order when someone walked in and he took care of other customers but us. Seriously?! It was like we weren't there. If someone offered us something to drink and said, "I'm sorry we're really busy tonight" perhaps we would've stayed and tried the food people are raving about.

They also need to update their prices on the website because it's different from the restaurant menu. We spent $50 somewhere else where the service was excellent. If you're hungry, do not come here because the service is poor unless you want to wait... you'll be thirsty and starving!
They did a great job on my custom coffee bar! It turned out exactly as I wanted and Eric was super patient as I got the final touches down. Highly recommend!

I'm not going to day too much.. I'm getting tired of doing long reviews.. This place is the shit. The food is on point, the customer service is even better. You'd seriously be missing out if you didn't give this place a try.
Evan was so mean to me and my friend for no reason, I don't know who spit in his drink this morning but he ruined our day.

We waited a very long time for a seat but the food is good. They could definitely squeeze some more tables in the space they have? Maybe fire safety restriction? I don't know but we waited like an hour. Pretty decent breakfast food though.

Reality check. My horse has gotten out of pasture several times, gone directly to FM to eat his favorite produce that they throw out. Been caught "red hoofed" on all occasions. Funny to catch a horse munching on thrown away produce by a ACS.

First time coming here, and being Italian, my new favorite place. Food is amazing, reasonable price. The waiter was amazing. He made my night and was still amazing even when we were here after closing. I can't believe why people would even rate this place lower than 5 stars. Amazing!!!

REALLY good food!  The service was great and the food was delicious.  Plates were big, you can definitely have 2 people sharing a plate unless you want to have leftovers.  We tried the pancakes lemon poppyseed seed was the winner for us but the other 2 had a great flavor too.  Our party had Huevos Rancheros, eggs Benedict BTA, the Pig Farmer, farmers hash bowl and biscuits and gravy.  Everyone in our group love their food, great flavors and extremely good size portions of food.  Will come back again.  Our server Haze G was great and funny, she also give us some good recommendations, thank you
This place is a gem!  Love the food and the prices are not that bad!  If you have a chance go visit them and enjoy their amazing food.

I paid close to a 1000.00 for them to do a move out clean plus walls/windows and let me tell you every person who's walked into the house has said the same thing which is that it isn't very well done for the cost.. there was several things they said they couldn't do which is cool and all but I feel like for what I paid the house should be amazing and it's just subpar.  I am giving them 2 stars because the ladies who came to clean were very nice and came back after I complained of a few things.. even the landlord was unimpressed with their job.. It's also annoying how many survey texts I have received, one should be enough..

Hands down the absolute best sushi in the Treasure Valley! We have made the rounds over the years and finally determined that Shige's was the very finest, consistently good every single time!  Unfortunately for Boise, but fortunately for Meridian, Shige himself and his staff have moved over to Shige Express in Meridian, bringing their expertise and yummy menu with them.

Our absolute favorite is the hamachi sashimi which is always delicious and never disappoints. Other faves are the Five Star roll, the KC, the Dynamite and the Bronco rolls. Everything is really good here, and I highly recommend checking it out. We are blessed to have such great sushi away from the coast!!

We took some friends here who were visiting from out of town. We all had the breakfast  Balls bowls they were fantastic this is my new favorite restaurant the best breakfast we've had in a long time I don't know way more restaurants haven't thought about making breakfast bowls I had the vegetable zucchini mushroom onions tomatoes garlic it was just fabulous

Dr. Jennifer Cook and the team here are the best! It's a well coordinated office with great customer service and most importantly great care! Thanks Ada West Dermatology for always taking such great care of me and my family.
