Service was outstanding. We were greeted and shown to a table and had water in the first four minutes. The waitress took care to explain details to us. Though my teens enjoyed their chicken fettuccine and shrimp Maria, I had lentil soup and it was disappointing. The lentils were crunchy and the soup tasted like marinara sauce. The real disappointment were the truffle fries. Piled high on a plate they were soggy and slightly greasy. The cheesecake and tiramisu were an outstanding finish. Meal for 4 was 145$ with two drinks and desserts.

What an excellent job!  Very professional, friendly, and helpful.  My request for a quote was answered promptly, communication was great, and my carpets look amazing.  It was everything I wanted and I look forward to using their service again.  My mom was there during the cleaning and was so impressed that she is now switching carpet cleaners to use them too.  I chose this company out of 10 other companies on Yelp and I'm sure glad I did. Thank you!!

I always come here when I am in the mood for some Fresh-Mex!  Certainly one of my top picks in the area.  My grandson Trevor loves to get the Sweet Pork Salad, he says it's "totally the BOMB!"  The food here is always fast and fresh so I always find myself making my way back.
Prompt service, at exactly the time promised.  Free rotation.  Comfortable wait.  Could not be more pleased.
me and my friend came in and we left satisfied and so happy with our waiter, vanessa. she was so energetic and conversational and i hope she gets those stiletto nails i recommend

I had the blue cheese hamburger, and my wife had French dip,both were excellent and I mean excellent ,the buns were perfect. I prefer brioche buns but they had potato buns,one of the best burgers in the valley.We sat at the bar and the service,as usual was excellent.
Everything  is reasonably priced,and very well taken care of.I give this five stars If they had belly dancers!

We were pleasantly impressed with this place.  We were sat right away and our drink order was taken within minutes.  I had noticed that people had reviewed that the service was a bit excessive.  the waitress did take my drink twice to refill it when it was 9/10ths full.  this was solved by moving my cup to the inside of the booth.

We ordered some pot stickers and lettuce wraps. The lettuce wraps were very good as was the presentation.  The pot stickers were very light on filling and the filling was mostly cabbage, they tasted more like a vegetarian spring rolls.  I would give them a 6/10.

We ordered The Mongol with chow rice and both were very nice and very flavorful.

I would list this place as a positive "yes" on whether I will return.
Apps are great, pizza is great and our server Sammie was great.    I highly recommend!

Definitely reconsider if you want to dine in. They definitely do not know how to clean. Carpet is a disaster, dust everywhere. Soda refill station, you can tell does not get cleaned as often or as well as it should. The thermostat that's mounted on the wall is caked with dirt. I can only imagine what behind the counter and kitchen area looks like. The food is good and I'm sure I will eat there again. Maybe stick through the drive through. The drive through window has to may added papers that are filled with misspelled and bad grammar as well. I'm sure if the food stays good I can look past that.

We picked up our motor home yesterday and I can't tell you how incredible the entire staff was.  They treated us so well, from finance, to the inspection, to parts.  They are incredible.  

I realize this can be huge, but please look here, they treat you so well.  I referred our neighbors to this dealership as well.  

Thank you so much for a great experience.

We were staying at the Marriott Courtyard next to Moe Joe's and decided to get breakfast here. I was a little hesitant to go here because we had a flight we had to catch and there was a wait. But we got in within 10 minutes. Our waitress Hailey was a fantastic waitress. Our food came out fast and it was so incredibly good. We got the Idaho potato nachos hash, the eggs Benedict, and smothered burrito. Everything was delicious and fresh.

I just moved here and had not yet gotten a new vet for my dog. She somehow hurt her eye and it was swollen shut. All the vets I called wouldn't be able to fit me in for another month! (Due to being backed up from Covid). However Paramount fit me in the very next morning. They charged an emergency visit fee which is just $30 more than their regular fee. Due to Covid I just had to drop my dog off and wait for them to call me whenever they were finished seeing her. They were very friendly with her and made me feel comfortable leaving her there. The vet Mark Fineman called me about an hour later and gave me the update. He was extremely friendly and thorough with the information. Great price for everything and great care! I'll definitely bring my dog back here.

Just visited Ada West today under referral from my primary care physician.  It was a nice office but I could tell they were running behind judging by the large amount of people in the waiting room.  The office staff was short and rude upon check in.  I filled out my paperwork and turned it back in to one of the staff that seemed perplexed as to why patients were handing her paperwork.  Uh, duh..that's your job.  

Waited a while longer and then was seen for a whole 15 minutes by one of the PA's to check my moles.  I go to check out to schedule a surgery and nearly choked to death on the fact that they wanted the whole cost of my visit right then and there (well over $100) even though I have the best health insurance in the valley, that pays in a very short amount of time.  

Apparently the gig is that you pay them the whole cost of your visit, surgery, etc and then they take their sweet time billing your insurance and issue you a reimbursement.  I'm not sure about the rest of you, but I sure as *&#$ can't afford to pay over $500 out of pocket PRIOR to something taking place, and then relying on that money to come back from an office that I have no prior relationship with.  How do I know that they're not going to pretend they never received my money, receive my insurance money, and go on a vacation to Fiji?  Maybe I'm in the wrong line of work, Ada West Dermatology is one of the biggest, yet legal, scams I've encountered to date!  What a racket!  I will NOT be back.

My husband and I come here quite often.  The food is always really good.  We have tried the wings several times, but we love the burgers here.  My husband likes the Drunken Pig. It's a burger topped with pulled pork.  I prefer the standard Alehouse burger.  The meat is always cooked to perfection and it seasoned really well.  The burger can absolutely stand on its own without having to add a bunch of condiments or veggies. The garlic fries are a definite favorite.  The hubby says that they are the best garlic fries he has ever had (and he grew up in the Bay Area of Nor Cal, so...)!  The cookie zookie is to die for! It's so delicious.  It does take 8 minutes to bake, but it is worth the wait!! Seriously. 
Our experience with service has been hit & miss.  Most of the servers are great, but we have literally been forgotten about more than once.  Management is awesome & they are working on the issues with service. 
It's definitely worth coming in and having a meal.  The prices are reasonable and the atmosphere is great for the whole family! I'm sure that once all of the bugs with service are worked out I will be changing my review to 5 stars!

I go there most years for my birthday and my family members' birthdays too. They have awesome California rolls and shrimp! They have amazing service. They have a cute little slideshow that plays a song for you on your birthday if you inform them that it's your birthday. I love this place! You will not be disappointed!

Marbella is an absolutely amazing stylist!   She always knows exactly what is described and surpasses all expectations!   Her color is on point and so vibrant.  The time and love she puts in to all her clients is fantastic.   She styled my daughters hair for her high school dance and it just put the beautiful icing on the cake for her experience.  Marbella is so thoughtful and kind every time I see her and really listens to the clients wishes.   The whole salon is amazing!   Marbella and the rest of her staff  their customers!  If you need that extra beauty pop that you've been looking for this is the place!  #paradigmrocks

Another great dinning experience. My husband and I are fairly picky foodies. This is the second time dining at at The Tavern and we were not disappointed. The service was amazing. Andy our server, had a great personality and was very attentive. The food was delicious. We will be dining there again.

2 for 2.   Just sad because we love the wings and the atmosphere but the service is just terrible.    Come on on guys... step it up!  Get your servers on point.  Don't make me sit for 20 minutes before anyone talks to me.  I really want to like this place but I want you to like my business.

This used to be where my cats would go. The staff is friendly but they aren't straight forward with fees. I had to get my cat a rabie shot...when I called and talked to one of the girls - I asked what the cost of the visit would be. I was told $35. But they billed me $126. I told the front desk girl what I was told previously she stated that the extra was an exam fee. She explained that by State Law an exam has to be done. So WHY wasn't I told about it when I originally scheduled my cats shot?! This wasn't the first time this has happened. Finally decided it was best to find another vet.

Ordered tires online and scheduled an appointment online.  They didn't even move my car off the parking lot until 30 minutes after my appointment time.  It took almost 2 hours to put my new tires on.  A waste of my time.

This place is frustrating because some days it's a four star and other days it's a 2 1/2. Some of the servers are fantastic and a few of them are not. I realize finding help today is difficult, especially in the Treasure Valley area of Idaho.
Atmosphere: fantastic
Food: really good or really bad
Service: hit and miss
Parking: fair
Price: expensive, $37 for a burger and fish and chips with sides of fries and a soft drink. That's a $24 meal all day long. 

Today we ordered the fish and chips and the burger. The fish and chips were not on the menu but I asked and they said they always have fish and chips. They're probably using a scaled down menu which makes sense. My wife ordered the tavern burger with the sweet potato fries, which are always good. Today however she got a half order of fries and they said they would bring the other half back out. Normally this is not a problem except for the service being so hit and miss the fries didn't show up until the end of the meal. If you say you're going to bring fries out then the expectation for the customers is that they will be out within 3 to 5 minutes not 10 to 15.
As I mentioned, I ordered the fish and chips. They came out soggy and the fries were under cooked. After a few bites I could not continue. I had already received my flat sprite, which tasted like a cheap lemon soda. I thought to myself "he goes another cruddy experience". I mentioned it to the server and she took it back to the kitchen. Four other tables nearby got their food before my food came right back out. However, when they did come out the server explained that the batter that they used had the wrong beer mixture. My guess is they used an old stale batter but I have to say these were some of the best fish and chips I've ever had. This time they were cooked perfectly and the crispy batter was amazing. The fries that came with it were fully cooked and OK. The only negative here was that they brought a small plate of fries out just before the remake of the soggy fish and chips. Had we received the second fish and chips, the full plate of sweet potato fries, which did come towards the end and were delicious, and the great service this would've been a four-star experience. When the food is good it's really good, but when it's bad it's really bad.
Not sure I want to venture back here until they get the kinks worked out. My complaint is that they are inconsistent with the food, the service is great... Half the time, and the staff in the kitchen don'tt seem to be very experienced. When people have to remake their food you bring it out right away as a full complete meal not in pieces and parts. I realize that they're trying to make us happy, and they ultimately did in the end, but it took a very long time, And a few touch and goes.

First off the waiting area was a good size. We had a party of 6 with a baby. They got us in quickly but crammed us into a booth. I thought it would have been better a table so that way we weren't elbowing each other. The wait for the food took way too long. My Idaho potato hash plate was way too greasy for my liking and won't be ordering again. My husband liked the smokehouse hash, which is why I decided to go with 3 stars. My nephew ordered a simple eggs and hash brown and the eggs were way too runny and gooey, felt bad because he didn't want to eat them. The other good thing was their cinnamon roll French toast, and their orange juice.
Grimaldis did well correcting a problem that we had with dining.  Good and service was great.
This place is so good! The hash browns are amazing! The prices are reasonable and the toast and jam is unbelievable! Huge fan!

Who gives a positive review of a fast food restaurant? This guy.
 
Ok, this little location is awesome. First off, everyone is incredibly friendly - polite - and service focused. Now the food is the food, it's not prepared by Boddy Flay or anything. But it is always good. Mainly, this review is for the crew of this location. Not once have they gotten an order wrong, made me wait, or neglected to be friendly. In some of these places you can easily overhear employees complain about something, or have inappropriate conversations. Not here, the staff is always on point. Keep up the great work!

I've eaten here 9,10 times and it's always been very steady. I like how friendly the bartenders are & how speedy they serve you - it's also a very clean restaurant. For the area - I think it's in a great location and is never too loud. Great work being done at this restaurant - food is also very good and steady! Usually never over-crowded, which is nice!

We've been coming here for for decades -- but we may not come back.  Food AND service quality have decreased significantly.  Our party experienced: a botched order; one person had to ask for a fork three times, waiting patiently between each request while everyone else was eating - then, was given a dessert fork (not even a salad fork size) for a meat dish; multiple requests for water, and one person's after-drink came so late that we had all finished dessert and waited an extra 30 minutes for him to enjoy it.  Fish was chewy (over-cooked), boar shank was dry, pasta over-cooked in several dishes.  Also, a 20% gratuity (or a service charge, according to the IRS) was automatically charged to the bill. This is stretching the % (most establishments are 15-18%) and number (most start at a party of 8), AND for the medium-level ambience, medium quality and service, very off-putting.

Update:  Called Gino, as requested in his response to my initial review. Though he was not in, Austin told me he was instructed to talk to me and find out more about our experience. I added deets like, this was for a 40th birthday (and we said so at the time), more detail about food, and that the service and food were so far below expectations that several of us actually wondered if Gino had sold the business and someone else was changing things around. Austin listened politely and said he would make sure to talk things over with "front end and back end" staff members.  He also noted that Gino wanted us to know that the service-charge IS indeed 18% and not the 20% I'd written above. So - it's 18% for parties of six-plus.  Frankly, the more I think about the experience, I think even THAT was too high -- I think I over-rated food and service as "medium" in my review above. Still, good that they want to improve and are willing to listen, but with so many new choices in the area, we probably won't take the chance with Gino's again.
This location. Is always above and beyond.  The food is amazing.  The service  even better.   Always clean and decent.    Love this place.  Will be one of our regular  spots
Only have had take out.  Every time it's spot on. Honey Almond Chicken is the best.  Gluten free options for nearly everything.

Finally drug the ol' Ball & Chain down for a really nice dinner here at Tavern.  We were served outstanding food by a really excellent waiter named Johnny.  I had the surf n turf special which was absolutely a-mazing and the Missus had the lobster tail on pasta (capillini?)... we also hammered down some of the asparagus tempura app which also exceeded expectations.  We love this local place and were so happy to see them not only surviving, but thriving!  Great to see all the happy, smiling faces enjoying dining this busy night!
Great little local spot great customer service decent food. Good selection of beer fun place to hang out with family and friends

They cared about our dog, and they cared about us.  Our big girl was very sick, and they took the time to talk with us when the other place that we went to wouldn't.  

We will not take any of our future pets any place else.  We were able to let our girl go with some peace of mind because of the service that we received here.

I'm obviously odd man out on this but I was highly disappointed after seeing all the reviews. Coming from an area that was filled with Asian and Chinese restaurants this Lacks big time in both food quality, Beverages and customer service. The jasmine tea we ordered tasted like water. It had a yellow coloring but literally tasted like it came out of the tap and was heated up. Food portions are big but are lacking in flavor. I'm glad that they don't use MSG but they need to add some more spices. Heat was good because I like my Chinese food spicy. But my overall feel of the place was that I left not getting anything close to what I walked in for.

I'm so thankful to have found Julie and the Cavnas Salon. Julie is an amazing stylist you takes the time to invest in her clients. I always leave feeling satisfied knowing Julie has taken the time to cut and style my hair as requested. She's the best! All the girls working are so friendly and helpful as well.

WOW. This place is so delicious. Huge portions and some of the best breakfast food i've had. I ordered the carnitas chilaquiles and the carnitas was crispy and perfectly cooked! We also got the smothered steak burrito and it was massive! The wait was long we waited about 45 minutes but it was absolutely worth it!!!Shannon took care of us and she was great! Definitely will be back.

The only truly Asian restaurant I've been to in Idaho that is not Thai. That being said, these people actually know how to cook Mandarin Chinese food. Is it San Francisco worthy? No...but darn close. At least you don't have to order "special" chow mein to get something edible. Try the Nutty Chicken - awesome fresh-wokked veggies and great sauce.  In every other "Chinese" restaurant we've been to in the Treasure Valley, the fried foods taste like doughnuts, because they must all use the same kind of sweetened breading. This place does not. The sweet and sour pork and chicken taste the way they should. We will go back many times!

Not too impressed.  The staff is amazing, the drinks are cheap, and the bowling specials aren't bad.  The lanes however I am not impressed with.  The mechanics constantly got stuck and the lanes are poorly taken care of.  They only way I'm going to come back is if they figure out how to actually oil a lane or if I have enough drinks to not care.
Love the Meridian restaurant! Love the food and atmosphere. Staff is always happy and nice.
Speedy service. Our little dog loves the technicians. The inoculation was over in less than 5 minutes. The staff is very helpful.

Follow up. Even after requesting a call from their manager, I have heard nothing. I also started receiving emails, telling me that Ranger was due for vaccinations and a veterinarian exam. If this place is going to ban my dog, why would I use them as a vet? They are clearly clueless.

Amanda is amazing!! Always listens and keeps you well informed of the treatments. Whole staff is great from calling in for appointment and getting seen that day WOW!!!! To walking out, Sawtooth Family is my families medical office.

Do not go here. They push you through like cattle and don't spend the time needed. I pointed something out last year to Dr Burr and was told it's a scar. This year I point it out again and he says it's skin cancer. Biopsy comes back as cancer and I set up an appointment to have it removed. I called twice to make sure it was going to be a mohs surgery because it's on my face. I was told yes both times. I showed up today and got back to have the surgery and asked dr burr if it was a mohs procedure and he says no. I asked if I could get the mohs procedure and he states that the dr that does the mohs has 1 1000th the experience he does. Very unprofessional.

I have been here inside and love the place love the food, but I am giving 4 stars because I placed an order online - I received a confirmation email that my order went I. And would be ready at a certain time - 30 minutes after I placed my order for curbside pick up.  I paid via credit card.
A little after the specified pick up time no one came out, so I called in.  Sitting right outside the door.  The nice young lady said the order never was put in-so she put it in at that time with a "rush" on it - it was done quickly - and all is good
Just call to confirm your online order went in!

This is my second time here and this place is great.  I've learned to get there no later than 8:30am for breakfast because they fill up fast.  Service is great and the food is delicious. 

In these crazy times we're in they are also experiencing staffing problems.  So I'm always patient and very nice to the staff they do have.   

Just don't be in a rush when you want to come here and enjoy this great restaurant.

I have visited this Costa Vida location several times since moving to Meridian. I've been to quite a few Costa Vida's and this location is my favorite. 
The store is always well kept & clean. The food is always fresh & delicious. They even have an employee walking the dining room checking in on customers too ask how the food is & if we need anything.  He even asks to take your tray and empty your garbage from the table. It's a really nice touch. 
The reason that I only gave 4 stars is the size of The portions aren't consistent. One day you will get the correct amount of meat & the next day you get hardly any meat.  Another thing that bugs me is that chips and salsa do not come with your entree. I have a family that consists of 3 teenagers & 3 adults. When we eat there it costs a minimum of $70 to feed the herd. It is a bit of a slap in the face to need to spend another $8 or so on chips.  I hope this policy changes soon.

Updating review.  Last year after my appointment the gals at the front desk insisted I make an appointment for the next year.  I did and scheduled that day off from work.  I got a call last week saying my doctor would be on vacation at that time and I would need to reschedule.  I took this day off from work for this appointment and to reschedule it would take 3 weeks to get in.  I scheduled a year in advance and they call me 3 weeks before to tell me this?  I told the gal that called me that I would have to call back at a later date when I could figure out a time to make it in.  She then said "so you want me to cancel your appointment"?  No I don't want to cancel my appointment, you cancelled my appointment!!!  What the heck.  I do love Juliann Visser but I think its time to find someone who can make time for me.  I guess they have gotten so busy they can't accommodate those who they have to cancel on.  This is not fair in my opinion and they should have been more accommodating, aren't I the client?

Super crowded,  super busy! Happy hour specials must be fantastic!   Staff was super friendly, service a little slow but understandable with EVERY table full but still were great and VERY friendly.  Didnt really "eat" just had appetizers but were very good.  

Will be back!

First impression - restaurant was empty, hostess seated us quickly without a greeting and the table was sticky

We ordered our food and during our wait 2 more families came to dine in the restaurant. Both families ordered and both families received their meals BEFORE us. Once our food was served, it was warm and tasteless. The sweet and sour sauce on our over fried chicken looked like it came from a jar. The "special" chow mein was hard, not seasoned, and the only items included were onions and cabbage. The fried rice was also hard and not seasoned, but VERY greasy! We will not be back!

This is a beautiful KOA and very convenient to everything in the area. The staff was very friendly. The sites were level and clean. Lots of friendly dogs - oh and people too. We had a great stay here. Sites were easy to negotiate and large enough for both of our vehicles to park.

Excellent food! Superb & fast service. Best Chinese food place around. Nicely fried and freshly made you can taste the quality in the food. Some Chinese food taste greasy soggy and rubbery but not this place!

Emily was able to see my daughter on her birthday. My daughter has been bugging me for coloring her hair for a couple of years, I finally caved. Emily did a spectacular job! I cannot express how happy we are with her service! I'm truly impressed with how well she did with my daughter's fun colors!! I will definitely be coming back to her for not only my daughter, but she gained a future client from myself as well!

Very aggressive "greeters" once you get to the door, not even the door.  The guy did not want me on one part of the sidewalk but could speak to me only when I was standing on a certain part of the sidewalk.  Mind you we were the only ones there.  They abruptly told us that we needed an appointment. No problem there, it is the delivery of the message.  We made our appointment for the Nampa location to avoid these 2 men who have instant power with the new rules of Covid.  It doesn't give you the go ahead to be rude to people. So much of that going on in customer service these days. The Nampa one was aggressive too but not as bad as these two gentlemen.

I love this Red Robin!! The staff is always super nice and the food is yummy! I like to get their fish they do a great job and their sweet potato fries are really good too. The food is always hot and they have never messed up any of our orders. They're doing a great job with Covid here as well I feel totally safe going and eating here. I was so pleasantly surprised by the short wait when I went in tonight. They estimated 10 minutes and it was only a few. Because of Covid they have you wait in your car. It was pretty chilly when I was there that's the only critique I would have.
St Louis ribs were amazing and the beef brisket was off-the-hook good!  6 of us ate here and everyone loved it. The waitress(s) were fabulous and attentive. Will definitely be back.

Worst experience!! Went there about 5:30 for dinner with my Wife & 5 kid's even know there were several tables open inside & out & the host said he would seat us outside in 10 minutes he sat us inside 30 minutes later so after a long wait we ordered 3 pizzas & 7 drinks. We had all finished our drinks with no refills offered & told twice our food would be up in 10 minutes well 55 minutes after ordering our food 2 out of 3 pizzas finally came both completely burnt top & bottom & they never even made the 3rd one!!  Tried talking to the manager but she was about as clueless as they come so Needless to say we walked out and will never return.

We love this place, the waitress was very friendly and helpful. My son says it's his favorite place because of the boats. The chef is an authentic Japanese sushi chef and uses all authentic ingredients. He was always happy to make dishes from the picture menu my 10 year old requested and was thrilled a kid loved all types of sushi. It turns out he was the owner after our 3rd time there we learnt.
This is such an amazing restaurant and the service is better than perfect! Food is extremely delicious and the helpings are huge! Bring your appetite!!!!
Love love love coming to Gino's for all our family big milestone celebrations! Excellent food, great staff, beautiful location.
Never gets the order right. Workers are rude.Do not go there unless you want a horrible time and to get frustrated.
Service was slow, which was a bit expected as they were very busy. Food was good.. our waitress seemed a bit overwhelmed but delivered the order correctly.

Reasonably priced, but extremely slow. I had a simple 30 minute RV winterization scheduled at 2:10 pm. Arrived 40 minutes early (1:30) and staff said they could accommodate me early. 

Not a word from staff. Finally, around 3:00 (after waiting for 90 minutes -- 3x the estimated appointment duration), had to ask staff where the RV was. No one initiated the conversation or told me it was delayed. Poor service. Left the lot around 3:30.

One of our favorite restaurants. We like the food. The meal specials, lunch or dinner, are a good value and we find everything tasty. When ordering spicy selections they ask for your choice of mild, medium, or spicy. I like that.

We love coming to Fujiyama. Always sit at the bar to watch the sushi and rolls being prepared.  Super nice staff, attentive service for refills and extra needs.  Beautiful food designs everytime!   We decided to spend our New Year's day dinner there and were not disappointed!  See photos.  Always good and fresh, better than fair prices and fun!
love love,love this place great bunch of peeps! remembers me,my pup zeus,zeus loves these girls,guys.keep up the great work!

Not one but kid friendly you will need to watch the video to u set stand why there not kid friendly 

https://youtu.be/SwOYOjJuATI

This was my 1st experience with Merry Maids. I initially just called them for a one time clean as my regular housekeeper was going to be out of town. I called and I think it was the next day, Stephanie, the General Manager came out for a consultation.

She was so warm and kind. Once she started telling me all of the extra services that they provide (oven cleaning for a deep clean appointment, changing linens) that my housekeeper did not, I was intrigued. I was already thinking about looking for a larger company to handle my household, and I must say, they far succeeded my expectations!

Today Kasey and Amanda came for my initial deep clean (I opted for a deep clean as we recently moved in to the home) and they were nothing short of amazing! I am a perfectionist. The hard work and detail that these ladies provided me with today was incredible.

They were very friendly when they arrived, introduced themselves to me and shook my hand. This sounds simple, but I promise you, so many people these days don't do this! They kept communication open throughout the day and let me know what was going on, what's still needed to be done. They let me know when they were going to take their lunch break. This experience was not at all like past experiences with other companies. I honestly couldn't be happier. So happy I made this decision!

If my regular cleans are like this, I'll be in heaven and I'll never switch companies again!

**I just posted my review, then decided to read some of the other reviews on here. I don't even know what some of these other people are thinking! I know that everyone has a unique experience, and I obviously wasn't a part of their phone calls or cleans, but after my experience today, I don't believe one of them. I've been having my homes cleaned by companies and private people for years. Merry Maids provided me with way more services than my previous company, and for the same price I was paying! I know how hard it is to clean a house from floor to ceiling because I keep my house pretty clean and organized already. The reason I opted for a deep clean is, like I said, because we recently moved in to this home. At first you don't notice how dirty the cabinets are, etc. You're busy moving in and getting settled. My previous private party never touched any of these things. I typically just need a good dust and floors, with a kitchen and bathrooms. I do have a large house, I do have a lot of cabinetry, and they made all of this shine. I WAS informed that they will dust as high as they can reach and all of that. This is all very typical and normal business practice for a cleaning company. The ladies today were so communicative with me throughout the day. They even did more than I expected. I have a certain old appliance that had a marking on it that I couldn't get off. Well Kasey did. I'm not sure if some of these one star reviews are legit, or if they just are the people that you can never please. I'm thrilled and honestly invite any one of them to come have a look at my home before and after a cleaning. With 2 kids and 4 dogs, I promise, you would be amazed also.**
Stopped in a couple of weeks ago. Good social distancing and wait staff were appropriately careful. Food was delicious. I'd recommend it.

Worst Chinese food I've ever eaten. The mandarin chicken was awful, dark meat, bland sauce, and some pieces were raw. I had high hopes for this place, save your time and money Panda Express is way better.
Good froyo! I like how they don't charge by the weight but instead charge by cup size. Desperately needs to add Mochi to their topping bar. Five stars if Mochi is added

Very interesting... Within 24 hours of posting our previous negative review, low and behold Patty called. Patty spoke to my wife, so I was not party to what was actually said. Somewhere in the conversation Patty brought up the topic of the bid for our counter tops. My wife nicely side stepped and declined. Within a day or two of that phone call we received a large envelope containing information regarding our carpet's warranty, our LVP's warranty, and our installers warranty. Not to mention a letter from the store manager thanking us for our business. We are grateful they made the effort, however it should not have taken such a negative review to initiate action on their part.

We would also like to clarify something. John the installer and the other gentleman that worked with him were absolutely TOP notch! There were some difficulties when it came to the tear out and those guys did everything they could and then some to make everything come out right. We are EXTREMELY pleased with the work John and his helper did!!

This place has the worst customer service I have ever experienced. First of all, half of the items in their store are "special order" which means it is non-refundable. They never once said "special order" means non-refundable. Apparently EVEN IF THEY MESS UP it is still non-refundable. This sounds more like a scam than a business that cares about customers.

My wife and talked to the sales rep and stated we were specifically looking for LVT tile. The sample they had on the sales floor was not currently in stock because it was a new item. They ended up ordering long planks that look NOTHING like tile. They look like plastic strips of laminate. When you go to a store like this you pay more than a typical box store. You should be paying for the service and expertise which they offer none of. 

We knew that the wrong size was ordered when we picked it up, but we were told we had to talk to the sales rep. who was not there. We tried to return it the next day and no one could help us. We called a "manager" and he said it would get taken care of and he would call us the next business day, but he never called back. We finally called back 7-days later and the original sales rep. was even less help. All they could say was it was non-refundable and wouldn't take any accountability. NOTHING on our sales receipt said anything about it being a special order or that is was non-refundable. If we had known it was non-refundable, we would not have let them order it. Even then why would they think we wanted long planks when we came in looking for tile for a small bathroom? 

I am so glad we started off with small order first. We are in the planning stages of remodeling our entire house. If we had trusted them and ordered more we could have been out $1000s instead of a few $100. Nevertheless, I will never set foot in this store as a customer again, I will tell everyone about our experience every chance I get.

Wow,  EXPENSIVE  12" pizza.  
$11 for the pizza (traditional, plain pizza)
Artichoke adds $4.  
Bacon adds another $4. 
Chicken adds another $5.
Garlic adds another $2. 

Never have I paid $26 for a small 12" pizza.

Just imaging what the "extra" items would cost for a large pizza!!!!

Plus $10 for a "SMALL SPINACH SALAD.  Salad was also disappointing Dressing was not very good. Expected a better spinach dressing.  TOTAL bill as $38.16

We bought a brand new Jayco 5th wheel from Bish in Meridian in July last year. We've had issues ever since. Your team worked hard to get it ready for us to take away for the winter last year and I applaud that. However, it seems like the moment we left the lot the last time they forgot who we were. We've emailed. We've called. We've texted. NO RESPONSE. Derrick the financing manager was good to help us at first but that was mainly with financing issues. But even he stopped responding. I talked to Jayco directly about fixing some problems. They worked with me directly on one small issue, but everything else they insist on going through the selling dealer - Bish. But we are way down in California and can't drive it up there for service. We've got a broken gray water tank that's going to cost a bunch to fix and we have to eat that cost because we have to pay for it, submit the claim to Bish to get reimbursed. Since Bish won't respond we are stuck with over $1000 in repairs. They sold us on the "Diamond Club" but it's worthless. If you can't walk in their doors and make a stink they don't give a rats ass about you. If you live near a dealership and will be around it, go for it. You'll probably be fine. Melissa was wonderful, very friendly and professional. Portions are plentiful and flavorful. A Great Place for Breakfast as we did not have lunch there - Yet.

I stopped here on the way home to grab dinner for my family. I order mandarin chicken, chicken fried rice, and chicken lo mein. My kids love Chinese food and there is never any left over. They did not even finish their food. The mandarin chicken was mostly breading. The noodles were very greasy. The customer service also was very poor.
Best Chinese food  I have had in three years or maybe ever. Service was spot in on. If I lived in Boise I would come hear every weekend. Super flavorful and super fresh.

The effort housekeeping services in the Boise area go to, to appear to be customer focused and friendly boggles my mind. Is the industry that competitive out here? Merry Maids didn't even clean my house; this review is based on the phone call, the site visit and the pricing. Based on those experiences, this company will not receive my business. My phone call began with me expressing interest in their services. Before I could ask a single question, this company wanted my name, my email, my phone number and my address before I determined they were a fit. They were so concerned with their marketing and sales pipeline and filling out those CRM fields, they ignored the needs of the customer. Then they insisted on having to make a house call before even booking a service. I pressed and asked what would they need to see in person that I couldn't answer over the phone and they harped on high quality, every house is unique and therefore each service should be customized. So then I book that appointment and all she really does is make tick marks on a form. She mentioned deep-cleaning, which I said I didn't need because A. it's a brand new house that we've only lived in 5 weeks and B. the house was cleaned by another professional cleaning service 2 weeks prior (I'm trying out a few services before signing a contract for an ongoing biweekly service), but by the time we get to discussing pricing, she's telling me I'd have to do a $255 deep clean then the price would go to $144 ongoing. And for a one-time trial clean, it would be $400. WTF!?!?!? That's four times as expensive as I was paying in CA, for a larger house. I actually responded with a "that's ridiculous". The service I used two weeks ago charged $117. So far, the cost of living in city of Boise has been far, far, far less than that of our previous home, in the San Francisco Bay Area, with the exception of house keeping. I haven't figured out why, but I have accepted that I will have to pay more, but $400 is robbery. This company is willing to forgo almost $4K annually from a contracted client by pricing their one-time so high. This rep should've walked out with a feeling that I was not going to be a customer, however, a few days later, I received a thank you card in the mail. "Thank you for taking the time to meet with me yesterday you have a beautiful home please let me know if you have any other questions". I'll try to move past her lack of punctuation, but where's the uniqueness, the customization? She could've mentioned that Merry Maids is just the service I need to solve any of the needs I expressed during her personal visit or addressed the sticker shock I clearly expressed; but no... I just got a plain Jane generic. And this is what I mean by the appearance of customer service. She's checking off box on her list of things to do for prospective clients but it fails in the execution. Maybe they have to charge so much to cover the expense of driving somebody out to learn what can be discovered in a phone call and for postage and greeting cards? And Merry Maids is not alone; to a lesser degree, I'm having similar experiences with other services I've researched. I just think of other home services -- plumber, electrician, gardener -- you explain what you need over the phone, they provide you a rough estimate, you agree and book a time, when they arrive on site, they further evaluate and fine tune the estimate, you shake on it and then they get to work. boom, bang, done. All the empty fluff Merry Maids threw my way was just a turnoff. I just don't need -- or want -- that in a home service.

We had the flooring in our living room, hall, and main bathroom replaced.  Our salesperson, Kenna, was very friendly and informative.  She communicated with us every step of the way and was understanding when we elected to wait until after the holidays to go ahead with our project.  Bill came out to measure and was thorough and knowledgeable.  As a former installer, he had an eye for details and took extra time to carefully measure the differences in existing flooring to be sure the new underlayment would be correct.  Our installer, Santiago, was friendly and professional.  Our job was not large, but we were never made to feel that it was insignificant.  Kenna called afterward to ask how it went and if we were satisfied.  We will definitely use Great Floors in the future.

I love Red Robins food.  What I don't like is when they advertise bottomless fries and it's like torture trying to actually get more fries.
That being said, we decided to go into Red Robin for dinner last night since we hadn't been in a while.  Restaurant didn't seem very busy, however, it was going to be about a 15 minute wait.  Ok, go to sit down, and they tell us to please wait outside, while it's raining and cold.  Then we were told to go sit in our car. Boo Red Robin.  Remember ... if your mask is safe, why do you have to worry about others around with their masks on as well?
Lots of room for social distancing. Lots of things on the menu! Friendly staff. Must go back and try more!
I would highly recommend this company for my friends,Scott was very professional and worked efficiently! I very like my new carpet! Wonderful

Goodbye, Johnny Carino's. I'm breaking up with you.

You have been my favorite Italian restaurant for over 10 years now. I've been a loyal customer and have loved both your food and your service. But the recent "corporate changes" (according to my server) mean that I no longer get what I want, and you are charging me more for the privilege of eating at your establishment.

Here is what I experienced yesterday:

Plain olive oil with a splash of pepper and plain bread that tastes straight from the microwave 

COMPARED TO BEFORE: Olive oil loaded with flavorful spices to go with the fresh buttery, garlicky bread that comes to the table
***
Soup is now $4 additional (on top of the current lunch price of $15.30); I declined it. Right before my meal came out, they decided they could give me soup for free at lunch after all and brought me some watered down potato soup 

COMPARED TO BEFORE: Choice of quality soup or salad with the meal
***
Lunch size portion (1/3 of the dinner portion) and charged $15.30

COMPARED TO BEFORE: Lunch price for chicken Parmesan $7.99 (half the dinner portion); dinner price about $12.50.
***
1-2 Tbsp of sauce underneath the chicken; butter on the noodles

COMPARED TO BEFORE: Loaded with sauce on the chicken and pasta
***
I had to ask two different people to get my drink refilled

COMPARED TO BEFORE: Attention to details like my empty beverage glass

By the time I finished my lunch, I was $25 poorer and had no leftovers to take home. I could almost hear the whisper of corporate voices saying, "save money, save money, save money."

Sorry Johnny. You're just not worth it anymore.

Don't come here if you're hungry or thirsty. And especially not if you have a child.

We waited for half an hour for anything... something... not even an offer for water was made. 

Thought we'd try it for the Gumbo and fairly decent prices... WRONG!! Prices wen't up on average $2 from the website to the menu in the restaurant.
Oh, they might want to put a time limit on the Lunch portion of the menu as well, It just said "Lunch Menu". No cut off time was given, so when I inquired about the Po Boy, the waiter said "we're no longer serving lunch"... well THANKS FOR LETTING ME KNOW ON THE MENU!!

Yelp needs to offer "negative stars" because 1 is more than this waiter and establishment deserve.

My wife & I have gone to Ada West Dermatology for 20 years and always had excellent treatment and service.  In fact, we began there after another dermatologist could not solve my fungus problem for years.  Dr. Burr at Ada West solved it in 10 days!  The staff and their service is efficient, friendly, professional, and courteous.  We have referred family & friends there, who have all reported very favorable thanks and comments to us.  The office is beautiful, modern, clean, very well-equipped, well-staffed and definitely one of the very finest of any medical facilities we've experienced.  Dr. Burr's work is especially very top notch.  And, we have felt that from his staff, which confirms to us that he first hires great people and then trains them very well so that they all meet his high standards and customer service excellence.   Its very evident Dr. Burr keeps himself up to date on the latest medical procedures and we consider him highly knowledgable and skilled.  Added to that is his fun, friendly, genuinely empathetic personality and his obvious great pride in providing quality patient care.  He even calls us at night after a day's procedure to check how we are feeling!  He has operated on me 3 times for cancer and always carefully exams me for possible problems from head to toe on most visits.  He has treated me via cell phone pictures of my roseacia problem that I have sent him from Arizona.  He even asked him my wife's procedure was doing when he saw us at a public place, and then stepped into a back room there to check it out.  How many doctors would do that?!   We are in our 70's and have, therefore, seen many doctors and been to many medical facilities over the years in several states and countries.  During that time we have left some doctors for bad treatment or service that was provided. We consider the Ada West facility, treatment, and staff among the very best we have experienced and would (and, have already many times) highly recommend it to our family and dearest friends.  

Dick & Lawana Johnson

A small, cozy Italian restaurant with a large menu, great service, and delicious food!

I've been with this credit union off and on, since I was a young child. I closed my account when I moved out of the area but reopened it several years later while visiting a relative who had moved back to Idaho. Now with about 30 years more experience with banks and credit unions, I can say with expertise that this is the worst of the at least six or so credit unions I have joined. I didn't want to leave out of sentimentality, but this credit union has been substandard for too long.

The majority of the customer service people are terrific and bright, however, the core function of a financial institution requires good record keeping. This is where PFCU fails epically. Whatever they have running the backend is non-functional causing both the customer and customer service reps to have access to bad or incorrect data. Transaction postings are noticeably much slower than at other institutions. There are huge (remember we are talking about financial transactions) discrepancies from their posting dates and those of the other party. My experience here spans both direct deposits and check posting dates from multiple parties.

PFCU is the only credit union that I've seen that charges a monthly "ID Protect Fee." It's $1.99 per month, but which and how many other credit unions do this? My current other three credit unions do not and never have under any circumstances.

This is the best Chinese food I've had in the Treasure Valley! I really love the salt and pepper pork, general's chicken, the fried rice, and egg foo young. I have never dined in but the takeout service is always fast and friendly. It can be a bit expensive for the portion sizes but I say it's worth it.

I decided to give this 4 stars because one visit was incredible and the other was disappointing. 

Let's talk about the good:
The food is tasty, the servings were great and the staff was incredibly accommodating. I would definitely come here again! 

The other visit. 
My friend and I went and it was busy. We waited close to 40 minutes for our food, and you could tell it had been sitting in the back a while. The servings were small and the staff was busy. 

Maybe go when it's not busy? 

I hope to go again and review by rating, I really want it it be like the first time!

Ordered the mongolian beef, and to mimic what a previous yelper wrote, it was horrendous. It was just plain disgusting. I didn't even eat it. DO NOT ORDER THIS.  I took 1 bite. it was a pathetic attempt at Mongolian Beef. There were WAY too many vegetables and the little bits of meat were flavorless. Oh and if you are like me, and are super excited about great Chinese rice, don't come to this place either. How badly can you screw up rice? By giving it to your patrons in a thimble. No joking. They put it in one of those hot mustard/sweet and sour sauce bowls that are tiny. Then when I courteously laughed at the inhumanely small portion, and asked where the rest of the rice went, she said it would be $1 for more. 

Ridiculous. Never going back, and now I'm hungry for actual dinner. Likely to hit up Taco bell.

You can always tell by the "wait" line if a place is worth the wait and this place definitely is worth the wait.  Our server was exceptionally good.  She was very friendly, always had our coffees filled and was a true pleasure.

The food was FABULOUS!  My husband had the chicken fried steak which was the best he has ever had, and yes, I took a bite or two and wow!  Finally, a chef who knows how to use spices to perfection.  I had the Irish Benedict and, once again. WOW!  The corned beef was the best I've had in a very long time.  That is not the easiest to prepare but when done like this....awesome!  Their home potatoes, even without onions, or peppers, and what seemed like was going to be just plain and boring...was anything but....they were delicious and cooked to perfection.

I have to also recommend the Mango/Strawberry sangria, with fresh (and I mean perfect too) strawberries and mango, it was absolutely delicious.  We have definitely found our "favorite" breakfast/brunch place and will definitely be back.

Was in a pinch to get my makeup done for my engagement pics after my original MUA had to cancel the week of the shoot and Karyssa really pulled through!!! Amazing MUA and really made me feel beautiful and confident!! 10/10 would suggest her to anyone!!! She is also very friendly and personable and made me feel very comfortable through the entire session!!

What a disappointment. We called ahead for the waiting list. We were told 40 mins and waited over an hour. We were taken to a dirty table. When our waiter came he took drink orders.  We waited 20 minutes and he hadn't come back for our food order so we left cash for my drink and left.  We asked for the manager, Manny, and after we told him what happened he said Oh and turned around and left!  We won't be back anytime soon

We are here for two days visiting from Bend Oregon...... this was the best breakfast I have ever had..... EVER!!! 
Do yourself and your family a favor and stop in ...... we will be back Tomorrow!!

There needs to be an option for negative stars.
I was with a bday party at the Meridian Idaho location on Sunday, Dec 19, 2021. The party started at 11:30 am and the restaurant opened at 11:00am. The hostess was as rude and unhelpful as she could have possible been! Arrangements had been made WEEKS PRIOR to get in at 11:00 am to set up.  Pizzas were to be started as well at 11:00 so they would be ready when all the kids showed up. They left the mom (with cake, presents and balloons) standing outside for almost 30 minutes in 35 degree weather using some bs excuse that their ovens were cleaned the night before. Apparently you can't open a door with just cleaned ovens. Finally one of the cooks let her in after he saw her standing out there forever. Thank you to him! Drink order took FOREVER, 2 of the 4 pizzas took FOREVER, the manager couldn't be bothered to even come and apologize for the horrible treatment by the hostess. And to top it all off, they added the tip to the bill!!!! 
I will never go to Grimaldi's again! They lost the business of someone who has frequented their establishment quite frequently! And as someone who grew up working in the restaurant industry, this is unacceptable! I have seen people fired for a lot less than the way that hostess treated a PAYING CUSTOMER!!!

Worst experience in a restaurant. I was seated and waited 20 min to see a server, I had to ask for one. I had to ask where the menus were. Was given the wrong appetizer. I had to get up and ask a hostess for silver ware. I had to ask the hostess for a refill. Shift supervisor was at the hostess desk with 5 hosts the whole time, didn't help the server at all. Clueless to what was going on in the restaurant. We waited 45 minutes to get one burger, a kids mac and cheese and a kids alfredo pasta. A manager came over because we just wanted to leave and offered a dessert but wasn't able to converse at all. Don't waste your money here!!!

A Re-Bath salesman came to our home and used high-pressure and highly-manipulative techniques to try to get my husband and I to commit to their offer the night of the estimate.  The presentation took 2.5 hours and clearly was not altered at all even though we were trying to hold/entertain a 2 year old who we had to keep up past her bedtime because the guy just kept going on and on.  Most of this presentation was spent watching a powerpoint of information I already knew about the company from researching them on the internet.  From the beginning the salesman seemed more interested in interrogating us over other options we were considering and giving me his opinion that other remodeling companies we had received bids for (and we didn't give him names of companies because that felt awkward) were not trustworthy or respectful because they were taking a couple days between taking the measurements and the final bids.  He asked me "how does that make you feel that they didn't respect your time enough to give you a number?"  I thought to myself "it doesn't bother me that a company understands that remodeling a historic 1947 home's bathroom requires a little more thought than taking measurements of surface materials and plugging it into a 10 cell pricing chart (like Re-Bath did) and it definitely isn't good business practice to make a major home improvement decision without investigating a few different options.  The salesman wasted so much of the presentation trying to bad-mouth who he assumed was bidding on our remodel I finally just said that I'd prefer to focus on what Re-Bath had to offer. It was clear to me from the salesman's behavior he must have received some extra incentive for signing a person up the day of the presentation.  He was clearly angry with me when I told him we would be taking a week to look at all of our options before making a decision.  He actually said, "so you've just been wasting my time, then?"  

Additionally, I can say that while these look like good quality immitations of stone/tile work it is not worth paying over double the cost of even higher-end tile/grout systems (Re-Bath bid us $8400 for JUST the shower).  Re-bath materials have less resale value regardless of what a Re-Bath salesman thinks of these products and when most people end up staying in their home for 10 years or less... this isn't smart investing and in the end that is what you are doing every time you improve your home.

On a final note, while I am not LDS I found the following conversation that occurred at the very beginning of the meeting unprofessional and offensive.  The salesman and his "trainee" were talking to us about our daughter and baby on the way.  Making conversation I asked each of them about their kids and the trainee said he had five children.  The head salesman then adds something like "yeah he USED to be LDS and you know how that goes" giving me eyebrows.  Now I realize that this guy has noticed we have a wine rack in our living room and a coffee pot in our kitchen, made an assumption we are not LDS/mormon, and now is making a comment to me about a religious stereotype?  Not appropriate and I wish I had ended the presentation right then since this was my first red flag of many -- seriously too many to list out here!

Great salad bar, always a lot of people hear, you wait in line to order them find your seat.  LArge group private rooms too.  Pizza is just ok in my opinion.  We've also had the lunch buffet which is pretty good but very crowded especially weekends.

We love Moe Joe's! My two favorites are the lemon poppy seed pancake if you want sweet, and the corned beef hash if you are wanting savory. Update: they have changed how they cook the corned beef and I don't like it as much. But the hashes are all delicious!
I had a lovely lunch at Shige Express. The service was quick and friendly. My food came out quickly and was delicious. The vibe was very low key and mellow which is just what I like for lunch

Spouse and I went here last night. We both got chicken Alfredo w:/ chicken. Both plates were very bland, and kinda weird but my wife's portion was double the size of mine....but regardless I had to put salt and pepper at least on my plate due to the lack of flavor. Our server was very good, and helpful. 

I told my wife this place is up against lucianos in Boise....unfortunately lucianos won tonight by a long shot.

We came here because we heard this place has some awesome biscuits and gravy ... and they DO!  My husband had The Farm House, our friends had the Biscuits and Gravy, I had the Alaskan Benedict. The biscuits were huge but light and fluffy. The gravy was a delicious, savory sausage gravy (not tart) and it was not too thick and not too thin. We arrived by 9:00 am on a Sunday morning, so we were able to be seated right away. By the time we left, people were milling around outside, waiting to be seated. The service was great and the dining area was nice and spacious.
Delish! Fresh food and fabulous Vietnamese Cuisine! We will be back for the Pho! Yum-o

We are about two weeks from closing and have been soooo happy with our experience! We first met Co-owner Sheridan ay a home show. We were impressed by the 3D home tours. Almost 2 years later we started our home buying process. After a nightmare first go round, we fired our realtor and called Sheridan. He restored our faith in the home buying process and quickly earned our trust. He turned us over to Trevor while still staying in our loop in the background and we have had just as much trust in him as we have in Sheridan! They have been so patient with us as first time home buyers and listened to what WE wanted and made sure we stayed on that path and didn't settle!  We are so excited to finally get our keys! If you are looking for a home go to Epic..... you won't be disappointed!!

My #1 Chinese restaurant for the Treasure Valley Boise area. The food is not heavily over-sauced like many Chinese places do. Joy Garden has by far the best cashew chicken. It has become my go-to place for lunch during business days.

This review is very over due. We had started our vacation of seven weeks in August and we had no hot water in our motorhome. On Aug. 21 ST. after the eclipse we tried to find an RV repair place open and able to repair what was wrong with our water heater. We read reviews of Bish's online and decided to give them a try. We arrived at their new facility and their repair shop was very full but the gentleman said he would see what he could do. He came back and said if we could be there at 9:00 AM the next morning they could work on it. We had no where to go as we would be leaving the area after the repair so they said we could stay in one of their spots with electric overnight. Not only did they get the water heater problem solved but also installed a new water pump and had us on the road before 2:00 PM.on the 22 ND and all at a very reasonable price. Everyone was helpful and courteous. It was such a pleasure to deal with this company. It was clear they take a lot of time to train all of their employees to be knowledgeable and how to deal with the public. The only thing I am sorry about is not living close enough to be able to use them for all my RV needs, it would be a long drive from California.

If I could give no stars I would. We walked in---not one table is in the restaurant. Totally empty. We have a party of 9 and it's 1pm on a Sunday. The hostess stood there staring at empty tables; then took 10 minutes to PLACE MENUS on a table. Then proceeded to tell us it'd be a 10 minute wait. Huh? Four other parties waked in after us. She told them it'd be a wait. ? There's not one table there and 5 employees standing there staring at us. We decided to just turn around and leave. If the service is this awful before sitting down, there's no way we want to stay!

My husband and I enjoyed a meal at Gino's last night. Service was excellent, and the meal was superb. From the foccatia bread and Gino's  original dipping oil, to the delicious main dishes, the meal was wonderful.  We enjoyed the Sausage and Mushroom Ziti, and the the creamiest, most flavorful, Fettuccini Alfredo.  We will be back again with friends!

Our usual sushi spots were closed so we decided to try Fujiyama...it proved to be a notch above mediocre...
Greeted immediately upon arrival and shown to our table (BTW...this is a converted diner, not that it matters, but not typical Japanese restaurant).  Service excellent and prompt.
Ordered a usual sushi/sashimi dinner and one specialty roll...Sashimi was ice cold and I could detect ice crystals in the tuna slices....not the end of the world but it made me wonder about the age of the fish...
Miso soup was excellent (and I've had horrible in the past...) as was the attention received by the wait staff..
All in all a decent restaurant..clean, reasonably priced and good wait staff...probably will return but not go out of my way when we're in the mood for sushi...

My daughter said she ordered the beef bento box but didn't expect it to be steak. The best she's ever had.
We ordered a variety of things because we figured we might as well try it and see. Agedashi tofu, tempura shrimp appetizer, the beef bento box and the sushi and sashimi plate. 

The box and plate both came with soup and salad. We each ordered a different dressing and shared. They were hard to distinguish which would be better. :-)
I'm including a number of pictures so you can see just how fresh the fish is. The roles were decent size with not a ton of rice on them. Tempura shrimp was absolutely outstanding! 

This is going to make my top 3 list for new Japanese restaurants in the Treasure Valley.
Delicious food! Great atmosphere. Excellent service. Not a ton of things were gluten free, but I still had a great meal. Would love some gluten free garlic bread tho!

Just a caution if you're on a fixed income like I am, this may not be the veterinary service for you. I went in for what I thought would be a $20 nasal vaccination, and they insisted my dog have a complete physical exam ($55), even though she'd just been examined in July following her spaying. I wasn't told about the extra expense, and I wasn't told I wouldn't have my regular vet examine her either.  I love the level of care my pet receives normally here, but some of us are on limited budgets, and $75 is a whole lot different from $20.  I felt there was a lack of communication, and I felt gouged. I will have to do without something else next month to pay this off.
Great food really nice flavors and portions. Orange juice tasted great along with everything we ordered.
Is this place still open?? We went during the posted business hours and could not find the food truck. :(

They literally kicked us out of the restaurant at 11:25 (they open at 11:00) because their cook arrived 30 minutes late for work and didn't have the pizza oven turned on. Initially someone let us in to wait for the oven to heat up, then Ashley the manager came and told us we would have to wait outside in the cold 25 degrees, and she didn't know if or when they would be open. Terrible, terrible customer service! And what a rude person to have as a manager.

You must try the lemon poppyseed pancakes here... Delicious! Actually all the food is good. The portions are huge so come hungry. It gets busy and there is often a wait, but the staff and kitchen move at a good pace.
Loud. Service was horrible. No one checked on our table. No drink refills. I had to wave down the hostess to get them to bring the bill.

I called ahead and asked if they had lanes available said they had plenty and no leagues going on. Showed up an hour later and they said they were "over booked" on lanes... sat and drank a beer for a 30 minutes while there was maybe 5 lanes being used, asked another employee if they had lanes available and he said they have limited lanes but some available... Employees were disorganized and had little interest in helping us. Bar staff was much more helpful. First and last time we come here

Really terrible! First, we sat at the drive-thru for a long while before anyone took our order, then we sat at the window forever waiting for the food. We get to the hotel room to find that my cheese enchilada was filled with cold, unmelted cheese, the taco shell was so old and gross it was difficult to bite and chew. After a bite or two, I gave up and threw it away. The refried beans were very bad too. The only part of our dinner that was edible was the rice. It would not recommend this place at all. Go to Del Taco instead.
This place is the best sushi bar in town. Always fresh fish and a wonderful variety of sashimi, nigiri and rolls.
Always have to wait in line FOREVER.   you need 20 minutes when visiting this location

My husband and I stopped in for lunch on Saturday afternoon.  The restaurant was busy but not loud, our hostess put us in the back away from kids that were in the up front area.  We originally thought about going to Homestead, near our home in Eagle and so very glad we choose Wingers.  Homestead is loud and sometimes you cant even have a conversation its so noisy.  Wingers was a very pleasant experience, food was good and our server, Skye T. was outstanding!!  She was there just enough, always had our water and tea filled, explained a promotion Wingers had going for a donation, just an overall extremely efficient server.  Thanks Skye!!

Horrible. I ordered bacon cheeseburger, added mushrooms and onions, no bun and garlic fries. Didn't say anything about my dirty plate (dried on food). The burger had 1 - yes 1 - mushroom. After 3 bites, found a hair in my burger. The waitress came over. I said I didn't want anything. I was credited for the burger but not the extras. She came back and actually said that I did eat some fries!!! I ate 4. Then the manager came over (Eli I believe) and I said he credited me for the burger but not the rest and what was the problem? I said it was all together. He was confused and I had to add it for him. He was extremely rude. Not my fault my meal was on a dirty plate, missing some items and had a hair in the hamburger patty. Horrible food, horrible manager and horrible customer service.
Food is always great. We've been doing a lot of takeout trying to support local businesses and Ginos is one of our favorites.

First time we went in the entire restaurant smelled like sewer so we left without ordering. I figured I would give the restaurant a second try since we received a gift card and they give you a "free" pizza on your birthday. We went in to get our free pizza and since we did not have an email code we could not get our pizza. The price online did not reflect the cost on our ticket and they would not honor a birthday pizza without a code that supposedly takes a week to get. Pizza was mediocre at best and service was ok. Flying Pie and Idaho Pizza Company are much better choices.

These guys went above and beyond for my auto repair, and also customer service! They worked hard to diagnose, and once done, kept me updated promptly and the repair was more than promised! I can't stress enough how wonderful these guys were to me and my car. I will recommend to friends and family for anything auto! Thanks you guys so much again! If I could give more than 5 stars I would.

Oh my gosh, I couldn't be happier with the work that Eric and his team did. He did an amazing job, was so easy to work/communicate with and completed the house rapidly (without losing any quality of the work done.) PLUS, they did this during a crazy heat wave. On top of that, his pricing was some of the most competitive out of all the bids we received. Could not recommend them more!
Found a new brunch place. Had a 10 minute wait but worth it! Tasha was amazing!  Must see!

Had the pleasure of dining here on Christmas Eve. The food choices were awesome! The service was quick and the staff was very friendly..My girlfriend had French Toast, which tasted great, cooked to perfection, I had an omelette with jalapeños, shrooms, avocado and havarti cheese, their awesome fried potatoes, wheat toast with marion jelly from Oregon, tomato juice and coffee. An awesome diner in Idaho just up the street from Dutch Bro's. We'll definitely be back next time we're in Idaho.

Newish eatery with same owners as Tavern at Bown Crossing and Owyhee Tavern.  Knowing the mode of those others and assuming similar menu and food quality here we went in with expectations set on low side of mid range.  But even at that the experience undershot the mark.  Neither ambiance nor eats would bring us back under our own steam.  If others suggested meet up here, we'd suggest alternates.  We left with a sense that if Applebee's were a kindergarten kid who ascended to third grade it would be this eatery.  We are big fans of supporting locally owned restaurants but this isn't one we'll choose again.

LOCATION: The highly visible intersection corner in a strip mall at the border of Meridian and Eagle - this is the venue as Blaze Pizza, Fred Meyer, CupBop Korean and Flatbread Neapolitan Pizzeria among others - near a slew of housing developments is likely a prime location for the owners to have selected to bring in the demographic of diner they're looking for and as alternate to the sea of chain eateries in this area.  They will likely be packed at peak times once their audience - maybe Eagle Bardenay fans and folks still 'California dreamin' - finds them.

VIBE & SEATING:  Dark space  with brown paint paneled walls and windows only at far end.  Tight booths on the opposite side of the room from the bar, high step up tight booths in the bar - which is the location with a sense of light - and three'ish small tables right inside the door for those who require table seating or prefer it.  Music of not unpleasant '70's - 90's mix but set too loud, 3 TVs showing sporting events scattered around the room with none easily visible from many of the booths on the opposite side of the bar.  And in the mode of "what WERE they thinking" in a business where focus is on bar / liquor / beer sales they have but one stall loo each for guys and girls.  Imagine the logistics on a busy night.

EATS:  Maybe the chaos is to get people not to notice the food is just ho-hum.  The lunch menu of appetizers ($8 - $15), sandwiches & burgers ($12 - $16), salads ($8 - $13) with a soup or two ($6 bowl).  The folks who ordered the tomato basil at an adjoining table left it uneaten as they said it was so bad so it waved us in another direction for our lunch order.  The two dishes we chose were enough to eat but sort of C+ at best - clams were chewy and salad drowning in dressing. 

Dinner menu is similar to lunch but expanded to include other things (like steak & chops $24 - $45 or poultry and seafood options $17 - $28) and with some specific to the Eagle location in the "Tavern at" series.  (Owners said they design each Tavern menu to include some things unique to the location.) 

Dessert menu is straight out of Sysco Sweet Things offerings (literally) and about half a dozen at $8 in options like Mud Pie, Flourless Chocolate Cake, Berry Cobbler...

If you're interested in seeing all the menus, here is a link.  https://www.tavernateagleisland.com/menu

LIBATIONS:  Full bar service (it may be sad commentary that the cocktails were the best part of our meal), beer and a wine list that is laughable for the laziness or ineptness to have omitted vintage years on the vintage offerings including among them high end wines. (Bottle prices roughly $22 like Sycamore Lane Chard to $350 for Opus One.  Limited number of wines by glass about $10 - $14.)  What audience of customers would order a bottle of Leonetti Reserve Cab ($260) or Pepperbridge Merlot ($75) without knowing vintage year?  And if our experience with the very nice but not fully trained servers was any indicator, they wouldn't know wine information either if one asked.  Happy note is that coffee is Stumptown and served hot.

STAFFING:  Servers were pleasant and trying.  The hostess was working hard to bus stables as customers left, sweep floors under tables and still answer phones and seat customers by going up on her "tip toes" to try to keep an eye on the distant door where customers entered.  Suggests owners are cutting staffing corners.

ACCESSIBILITY:  Barely mere minimum for accessible seating here and awkward for sure.  Were I a person using a wheelchair, I would note that all of the booth seating in the dining room and all of the high step up booth seating in the bar is not usable and "you are not welcome here" in design.  Only three small tables in the odd traffic pattern entry space seem accessible.  The bathroom is accessible but soap dispenser set above the 48" max reach range of law and code.  Only accessible parking spaces in the lot are at the far end of the sidewalk. 

SERVICE HOURS: Open straight through from lunch (11:00 I think) through dinner (starts and 4:00) and have a Happy Hour beginning at 4:00.  There were plans to introduce brunch on weekends in October.

I was so excited  to treat my boyfriend to an early prime rib Valentine's Day dinner last, but was sadly disappointed. Instead of the champagne my boyfriend opted for a Elijah Craig and they were out, the salad came, many pieces were wilted. We ordered clams for an appetizer several shells were either empty or didn't have much to eat, the clams we were able to eat were old tasting.  I looked forward to the prime rib  and lobster  , but as I pulled the lobster from the shell it was not cooked, slimy in spots, our server said he would bring us new tails, but returned our same tails freshly microwaved. The prime rib was to be cooked medium rare, but more on the rare side. It was not served with horse radish or au jus, you have to request it. Our server was friendly and apologetic, the champagne was tasty. Our bill was $149 for this meal, I was thoroughly disappointed,  Unfortunately I didn't take any photos, but should have.

Want a dirty environment to eat and some greasy food? Come here. Inside of the restaurant, the floor looks like it's never been wiped. Outside, there's beer  cans and all kind of trash in the bushes. The teen host in the front doesn't even properly greet people. We left and ordered for takeout. The food is so greasy and full of salt, you might get a heart attack after. BTW, black and blue burger came with no mushrooms, it's just bread, lettuce, beef patty soaked in mayonnaise. Very impressive experience, will never go to a Red Robin again.

What a creative menu. If you're looking for options to do things your own way, favs, or anything else you gotta give moe joes a try. At first glance it may not seem like there are any vegan options, but with some creativity you won't be disappointed. I ordered the garden hash bowl, no cheese, no butter, eggs on the side for the table mates. The veggies were so fresh and flavorful. With a few dashes of hot sauce this mix with your toast was completely satisfying. The staff was friendly, but a bit on the slower side even with a non busy room. But I have no real complaints. If you're visiting try this place out. If you're a local STILL try this place out.

After using them for over 4 years suddenly we started getting infections in our toes after having pedicures. My mother in law ended up with 4 infected toes and my daughter had two get infected! They are not cleaning properly or something. Beware if you have diabetes or are susceptible to infected toenails!!

We are in town visiting family and this was our first time here. I must say the service we received from Abbey was phenomenal.
