She was so attentive to us and was at our table with refills before we even thought to ask. She was very sweet and nice to the children. Although the wings weren't the best (could be cooked a bit longer and all the way through) Abbeys service made up for any food issue. Also The Dodgers game was on and they won so all around great atmosphere and service. :) we left HAPPY!!

The food at this Italian Restaurant is usually good, however, you can no longer depend on the quality.  If they have just prepared the minestrone soup, it is not so good,   Takes several days for it to simmer.    The wait staff is "STELLAR!.  Just how or WHY they put up with Gino, is beyond me.  He is an a__.   Were it not for his great staff, many of whom have been with him for years, we would not go back.  The staff must make good tips, because this place is NOT CHEAP!  Dinner for 2 and a bottle of wine, with tip was in excess of $100.00.

We went in on a Tuesday & they informed us we would have a 50 minute wait!!!!! Seriously? They said they were having a hard time staffing yet we went across the street to Applebee's, and they had plenty of help. Plus, there were two hostesses at Red Robin & neither of them were doing a darn thing!! Maybe one of them needs to be a server!!!

Frauds. They sell a certain type of clientele, which they do not have. It's true that an out of state office does the matching. Their first two attempts to match me were outside of all of my minimum requirements. When I declined (if you don't go on your first match, you are eligible for a particle refund), the rep tried to text me the person's phone number to void the contract. I said no, and she became very upset stating that she was being audited by her boss and absolutely insisted I go out with this guy. I said no, stated I would like to cancel and get my refund. To which she replied, okay, read your contract then and hung up. The contract does not detail how to cancel, only that you're eligible, and now I am hitting a brick wall with contacting them again. Truly the most shocking and poor business practices I have encountered.

I was so disappointed with delivery from Red Pavilion.  Supposedly the order was just picked up but the food was barely tepid at best. Sauces were in separate containers rather than on the meal.  That made the meats as hard as little pebbles.  Once we had excellent egg foo young from here.  I have ordered it twice since.  It seemed to get progressively worse.  This time besides being cold, it was tasteless.  I ordered a shrimp one, assuming the shrimp would be inside.  They were plunked on top and tasted not quite cooked.  I discovered cold honey walnut chicken is disgusting.  The chicken in the ruby chicken was.so hard it was practically inedible.
I suspect much time will have to pass before I try food from here again
  Makes me sad.
Food was very delicious, restaurant was very clean and the service was good. I would totally return again, and again!

Do not recommend. At first glance this place looks cute and buzzing with stylists. Unfortunately they are unprofessional, inexperienced and overpriced. Several reviews say stylists talk among themselves and ignore clients while doing whatever they want to their clients hair regardless of what the client wants. There's a lot of toning to cover bad highlights and color turns yellow quickly. This place is a big disappointment and waste of time

We had to check this place out.  We checked in on a typical Saturday morning   around 10:30 am. They took down my number and texted me back when our table was ready.  The place was packed and busy.  We had to wait for about 45 minutes to be seated.  While we waited, we were next door at the comic shop drinking coffee.  

The restaurant had a nice welcoming vibe.  Pretty relaxed.  There's lot's of food items to choose from.  These were the food items ordered:

My son ordered the Egg Florentine Benedict - for those wanting more veggies in their eggs benedict and hash browns.

I got the Chicken fried steak with eggs and hash browns - ordered it with a biscuit.  This was a large portion.  Great flavor. Perfect combo with the biscuit,

My husband got the Reuben- delicious and prefect!  French fries were crispy.  I love the seasonings they add to their fries.  Sweet and salty.

We also ordered some drinks:  Mimosa and hubby tried the spicy red beer.  

The mimosas were delicious!  I was able to try 2 flavors, jalapeno berry and the pomegranate.  Both were yummy!  The price as well are reasonable. Service was great!  

A definite spot to come back to for breakfast or brunch!

Update:
 Spoke with GM of Twin Falls location today, they seem to want to fix it AGAIN... However, the toilet flooded- which was some that had supposedly been fixed, and it is still broken in the same spot, which tells me either they didn't bother to test it by filling the water tank after they supposedly fixed it, or they just don't care. There is also a broken pipe along the toilet now, which caused the flood. GM seems to think this is our issue, stating we can't return the RV, and we own it now. DO NOT do business with these people, and don't get your rv worked on by them. Shoddy work, poor follow through, and a don't care attitude.


Absolutely do not recommend Bish's rv. Nothing but a headache, and these are very dishonest people. Back in September of 20 we bought a used rv that was supposedly in good working order. The toilet leaked, the drivers side arm pull was broken, and the generator was broken. Our rv was in the shop at twin falls since we didn't want to keep driving to Boise where we bought it, and they kept saying they don't have people there that work on generators... Then after the rv has been there for 3 WEEKS we found out they never bothered to winterize it, even though we asked these inept "professionals" to do it 3 separate times.  Now, we are finally on our first big trip and our blinkers don't work. I understand this is a used rv, but we have literally had to fight with them every step of the way on what we were told was an rv in good working order that had been "inspected". I'm not looking for a lightbulb to be repaired, we're talking big, functional repairs that needed to be made. And we had to argue with them about not charging us, on top of all of this. We wouldn't have BOUGHT this rv had we been told up front all the issues it has. The inspection  is a joke.

My husband and I tried to get dinner there the other night . There was 1 other couple in front of us and they said it was a 1/2 hour wait. There were several empty dirty tables and 3 girls standing doing nothing. None of them smiled or attempted to clean things up for the customers waiting. We walked out, none of them seemed to care paying customers were waiting to be seated.

They are very nice on email responses, but horrible on phone.  The lady who sends the email replies doesn't even know she's the same person who answers the phone "let me see who sent you the email", uh, it was you.   She did not know if floating shelves constitute part of a remodel, most likely because they want you to spend as much money on I'm sure cheap fake cabinets.   I don't even know why I wasted my time thinking about this idea.  Most likely because every business person in the Boise area, ignores, does not show up for appointments and doesn't know good product.

We have had several loans with PFCU and have always been supremely satisfied. Their rates and service are 2nd to none and we will never go anywhere else. 
Shout out to Janda at the Meridian branch. She stayed after closing when I showed up without an appt at 4:00. I walked out at 5:40 with a loan for my wife's new car. She fixed the mess created by a dishonest car dealer and gave us an amazing deal. Thank you Janda from the bottom of our hearts for your great service and commitment to your customers.
Been really good food until a dinner the other night. Overall pretty consistent restaurant with good ingredients and a diverse menu reasonably priced as well
Food is delicious and portions are large.  The staff is super friendly and a pleasure to be around.  Try the jalapeño popper frittata, you won't be disappointed!

The nicest wine bar in the Treasure Valley. Great Food, Nice Wine Selection, Friendly Staff, and the owner Doug is always available to assist in wine selection,  Decor is tasteful, patio is spacious, and you can find local talent playing on most weekends,  They have a weekly wine tasting which is nice, especially when accompanied by appetizers.  Went last weekend with some girlfriends and enjoyed a dinner of tasty duck,  try it, you won't be disappointed.

Was leaving the gym and needed a little caffeine boost so I stopped by this shop and it was so yummy! The manager who was on shift was also super kind and personable and made a great caramel blonde latte ;) will definitely be driving thru again
Prompt and fast service!  Food was deliciousl!  No sluggards here Super clean and neat!

The Smokehouse Hash...AMAZING! I've been here twice and have yet to be disappointed. The homemade jams with the toast make an excellent side to the already incredibly Hash. I've never waited more then 30 minutes here on a weekend as they have a great location with a decent amount of seating. One of my favorite breakfast restaurants in Boise!

Their pizza and atmosphere are the closest comparison we have found to Round Table, which I miss so much. Reasonable prices, friendly staff and great salad bar! We eat here once a month with a group for our club meetings. Never disappointed!

Definitely reconsider if you want to dine in. They definitely do not know how to clean. Carpet is a disaster, dust everywhere. Soda refill station, you can tell does not get cleaned as often or as well as it should. The thermostat that's mounted on the wall is caked with dirt. I can only imagine what behind the counter and kitchen area looks like. The food is good and I'm sure I will eat there again. Maybe stick through the drive through. The drive through window has to may added papers that are filled with misspelled and bad grammar as well. I'm sure if the food stays good I can look past th

We spent $19 (+tax and tip) on a 16" plain sausage pizza.  The crust was as thin and stiff as a saltine cracker.  The sauce was barely there, like a thin coat of red watercolor paint, and the cheese was equally sparse.  What was there tasted fine, but it was a poor man's version of any real pizza, and certainly not worth the money.

Excellent breakfast!! 

So we tried coming here a few months back on a Sunday and the wait was way too long with kids. We came here this time on a weekday and got right in :)

Both husband and I ordered the Farmhouse breakfast. It comes with eggs, sausage patty, biscuits, gravy & hashbrowns. 

Eggs, cooked over medium, we're done perfectly. The gravy was well seasoned & perfectly thick and tasty. The sausage patty tasted homemade, yum! The hashbrowns were cooked well, both crunchy but also soft, my favorite! 

The only thing I would change was the biscuit, also the reason for the 4 stars. The biscuit was airy and lacked density. I like a buttery, dense biscuit and the only way to describe these is they lacked substance and flavor - I'm glad they were smothered. If I had one of this as a side I wouldn't have eaten more than a bite :(

I loved that they offer flavored creamer for coffee.
Delicious breakfast burrito. The pork green chili was amazing.  Staff was super friendly and accommodating.  Even got me a coffee to go when I said I had a 7 hour drive ahead of me.
Unreal Alaskan Benedict! Salmon was cooked perfect, not over seasoned, and prices were surprisingly low. Don't let the location deceive you their kitchen must have a 5 star chief!

Stopped here for lunch without knowing a thing about it, and it almost instantly become what will surely be our go-to spot when we're craving some Chinese food. Decor is very nice, clean, and comfortable, with friendly and helpful waitstaff. The three of us had lunch specials, mandarin chicken and honey almond shrimp. Yum! So good! And the fried rice was perfect, in my opinion. I'm getting hungry just writing this review. Give this spot a chance!
We've been to the Tavern on a few occasions now & It's been great every time. Food is always good, staff is always friendly & the place is always clean.
A-ok, my husband loves this place. I can't seem to find a favorite. Very saucy kids won't eat. Staff friendly.

We stopped here for dinner on New Years Eve.  They were extremely busy so I am not sure how a normal evening would be for them.  We waited probably about an hour for our food.  The food was good but not great.  The waitress however was very nice.
I was seated facing the back door and had plenty of time to look around as we waited for our food.   The door and the floor were really dirty and looked as if they were not cleaned very often.  
All in all, probably not enough of a draw for us to return.

To James D's 5 star review kudos for Mike Vineyard, who is the owner and handyman-in-chief for iHandy, I add "ditto" based on our multiple experiences with Mike (who is, by the way, a USMC veteran and also was once a member of Ada County Sheriff's Department) for a number of handyman jobs across the last few years.  Reliable, skilled at the work he does, trustworthy and the guys he had working for him on a couple of the jobs are the same.  Mike has done ceiling fans balancing, installed towel bars, cleaned dryer vent, sanding and painting of exterior door moldings, cleaned gutters and fixed a gutter leak, lubricated garage door moving parts, cleaned all the exterior window frames and sills...and a host of other things.  Just as importantly, when there was a job Mike thought too big for us to cost effectively use him to do and thought we needed to contact a cabinet specialist to best get it done, he said that too.  It is just as valuable when a skilled handyman knows when to refer out to others.  (Not unlike a General Practitioner in medicine knowing when to refer a patient to a specialist.)  We appreciate Mike Vineyard's competence and his integrity.  And that he is such a nice man to have around is icing on the proverbial cake.

This was my first visit to the Red Pavilion and I am impressed.  Hungry for an early dinner, decided to give it a try.  I was promptly greeted and given my choice of a table.  The menu is quite adequate and not overloaded with choices.  I enjoyed hot and sour soup, free chips with a dipping sauce, and the Mandarin chicken with came with rice.  The soup was delicious and full of good ingredients.  The chips came with a dipping sauce that was sweet, but not too sweet.  Before I could finish these, the main dish was presented.  Of course, they were not busy because it was early.  The Mandarin chicken was a very large portion and done to perfection.  I was able to take half of it home for a second meal later.  The manager, Jing, was courteous and professional.  She made sure I was happy with my meal.  I enjoyed visiting briefly with her about her life in China.  So after this pleasant meal I know I will return again another time.

Well to start, I always avoid going to sport clips. However this time I was desperate after my normal guy cancelled. This place is fine, mediocre at best. Not to bash on the stylists, they all work hard. Just tired of the mediocrity. Stylist was not friendly, didn't really match what I wanted. I know it can be hard with types of hair and style and all that but you can at least get close. I always feel like they're just getting people in and out. These types are shops are directly responsible for the rise in mens barber shops. Fine for a pinch, but if you have time, schedule at a real salon or barber shop.

Returning to a sense of normalcy is difficult.   The Covid experience at Johnny's was delightful. 

Great spacing for social distancing, the service was good and the food was delicious.

While ordering, the person on the phone was anxious to hang up

Food took an hour

Was room temp
Fried rice and vegetable lo mein were both sub par

Chicken was fine

This place was good. We ordered our food to go and just ate in the parking lot. My husband ordered some kinda potato nachos and I had sausage and a side of moe joes potatoes. The taters hit the spot!!! Don't skip out on those for sure!!! This was a really good breakfast spot and honestly I'm not a huge "breakfast food" fan!! I'm sure we will return!

There is nothing awesome about this place. I took my friend there for a birthday pedicure. I called to make appts the day before. When we arrived both male and female (Ann) seemed hostile and unfriendly. We chose the Awesome Deluxe pedicures which were supposed to include a clay mask and a cooling mask along with scrub and paraffin dip. We tried to question about the masks when it appeared they had skipped them but were ignored under the guise of  a language barrier. When I went to pay and questioned the fact there was neither mask included in the service and should not have to pay for something we didnt receive, we were yelled at by both male and Ann and they blamed us for "not noticing" when it was done because we were talking. Um, no, we noticed and tried to bring it to your attention.  Very dishonest business practice. I will never go back.

Walked in to get a look at some of the Class C's and Class B's on the lot. Approached by a salesman who seemed immediately irritated. After explaining what I was there for, he scoffed and gestured to the lot door and said "they are just up front there.  They run about ninety-five thousand dollars," and walked off without another word. 

After walking out to look at some of the RVs, was approached by another salesman who had loud rap music playing from his phone.  As he stepped into the RV we were in, he made no motion to silence the music on his phone and instead just talked louder over it.  We asked about seeing the inside of the RV parked next to the one we were looking at, and he shrugged and said he wasn't sure if it was a client's RV or even if it was for sale, and that it was definitely locked.  He left to find the key and never returned for the half hour we were on the lot after that. 

We looked over some of the used inventory, but most of the RVs on the lot had not even been vacuumed, much less fully cleaned before being put out for display.  We left hoping we hadn't picked up any bedbugs.

I would not shop here again, much less purchase anything from here.

We had Chapman for a few years and then began learning of all the things they were supposed to do and were not.  Dropped the ball again and again, didn't hold tenants responsible, didn't maintain the properties.  Obvious dead spots in the yard where the sprinkler head broke and they didn't fix it.  I can go on and on, but maybe most of all, when we separated from Chapman, the owner lied, made promises and then never came through and kept changing the books even though we had the proof.  Nothing happened until I initiated court action.

MUST EAT BREAKFAST SPOT. Probably the best breakfast I have had. I got the veggie hash with sausage, and banana pancakes. Mimosa were amaze. The mango was our favorite. New Boise breakfast spot for sure!!!

Delicious salmon corn chowder. 
The French dip had generous tender meat. The sweet potato fries were amazing!!! I highly recommend!!!

I visited Bish's RV in Meridian today. Honestly, I wasn't very impressed with my experience. I went by myself to look at some camper layouts and get some information and a feel for their services. I had a hard time getting anyone to help me. I went and looked at several 5th wheels on my own, which was fine. But I was pretty appalled by the condition many new campers were in. There were so many with broken cupboard doors, broken lights, warped shower walls, garbage left in them & also someone used one of the toilets & left the evidence. Gross. I understand that there are some things that happen in shipping. But this was ridiculous. Almost every single camper that I looked at had something wrong with it. I wish I was exaggerating. i had a sales guy open up a camper and expand slides on a camper I really wanted to look at (and probably the camper that I wanted to see the most). Again, it had some pretty significant damage in shipping. But the sales guy ended up sending me to look at another camper floor plan after this one and I never saw him again. I went and looked at several others that I wasn't really interested in just to look at the different options. There were several other people that I saw around the lot who had sale people assisting them. It actually made me a little mad because no one seemed to think my business was worth tending to. Probably because I was a a woman looking by herself. Thats certainly how it felt. And when I went inside to get more info on the campers I had some interest in taking more information home with me, I had to go and hunt someone down. I did have a gentleman give me his card with some brochures and talked with me briefly. But there definitely wasn't the interest in learning more about my needs, budget, etc. I went to Camping World, which is next door, yesterday and they were so much more responsive and interested in my business. Needless to say, I'd be hard pressed to spend a large chunk of money at Bish's. My husband is going to probably be with me next time we visit...if we visit. Someone is going to get a piece of my mind if they think my business is worth more just because he's with me. Guess what? I'm the breadwinner. My opinion matters. Big mistake, Bish's. Huge!

I get the privilege to have Jennifer Cook once a year for a check up. Jennifer is very thorough and makes sure to answer any questions or concerns I may have with great detail. I highly recommend Ada West dermatology. The front desk lady's are all very friendly and prominent.

I will start from the beginning of all of this. We just recently moved to Idaho and the home we bought was clearly a rental. I put in a quote on Yelp and Eric reached out RIGHT AWAY. Came over, did a walk through of the house with us as we explained everything we were looking for. He explained he was a little short staffed and could have "some of his guys" come over to prep for a week and then could come by a week later. 
Fast forward, it's his 2 kids that are coming to prep the house... okay that's fine but there was never a set schedule. We would tell him to come by at 8, and it would be closer to 11 every day until they finally showed up...
When it come to painting, we asked him if he could finish all of the painting in 3 days. HIS EXACT RESPONSE WAS "yes absolutely." So we decided we would just book a hotel and give him the whole weekend to knock it out. Yeah, 6 days later it was finally done. Noted, we asked for the same color on all the walls and ceiling. No accent walls or anything crazy. 
When it finally came to Eric being done, I've never been so disappointed. 
1. There were areas of the home not even completed!!!! My husband had to go back through and basically repaint parts of the bathroom. The paint is also now peeling off the walls... 
2. THE DRIER WAS BENT! We literally just bought it the day they were prepping, so it was brand new!! Hadn't been used yet, so very clearly was dented from them denting it. 
3. Over spray everywhere. I don't expect it to be immaculate, but at the same time we had to scrub every corner of the house to get the excess paint off the counters and floors. 

Anytime you try to question he blames it on "being short staffed." HOLD YOUR CHILDREN ACCOUNTABLE THEN. Also, they aren't the ones that painted the house so that's on you... if you are too short staffed (just like the rest of America) then take some damn ownership and say you can't handle taking the job on. 

Now that my husband has touched up everything, it looks "decent," despite the fact that I still have a dented drier..."

Four of us went to lunch here on Friday at noon.  The restaurant was not crowded so we were seated right away near the kitchen. We work at a business in the Village and were hoping for an hour long lunch.  Three servers walked by several times and we were totally ignored.  Since we were near the pizza oven the manager on duty was only about 10 feet away from us.  It took more than 10 minutes for our server to come to our table and only after I had to flag someone down and say we hadn't been helped yet.  Since we were on our lunch hour we ordered drinks and meal at the same time.  The 4 of us split a large salad and a 1 large pizza.  Our drinks and salads came out an appropriate time later.  After 1 hour we still had not received our 1 pizza.  After clearing our salad plates, our server never made another appearance at our table.  Finally we asked how much longer it would be and also asked if we could have more water and a glass of wine.  She went and checked with the kitchen and manager (10 feet away) and came back to say it would be 5 minutes.  She then said the white wine someone wanted had not been chilled.  My friend asked if she could then have the other Chardonnay option at the same price as the one that was not chilled. Our server again said she would go talk to the manager (10 feet away).  When our pizza did come out it was not completely done.  Soggy crust, toppings ran right off the top.  Our check was brought out and we showed our village employee IDs which gives us a small % off our food.  She again said she would need to talk with her manager.  The manager never once came to ask how everything was or apologize for the lateness of our lunch and the un-chilled wine, even after finding out  we could be "frequent flyers" since we work in the Village.  We have given this restaurant three chances and all have had similar outcomes. Our server was friendly and a nice person but obviously the level of leadership in this restaurant is severely lacking.  I understand mistakes happen (not putting an order in) but given the terrible example of customer service exhibited by the manager... we are done.  I hope you all have a better experience.

I ordered a coffee through drive through this morning, the girl at the window did not fully close the lid , the moment she handed me the coffee, the lid opened and hot coffee spilled all over my legs and my car seat. They gave me 2 free coffee voucher but didn't apologize at all, the whole time they act like they don't know what happened and it was not them. I always go to this spot for coffee, but this time they gave me the worst service ever. At least be a decent human being apologize and own up to your own mistakes. Will not return!

There is a mask mandate in Ada County and with our county getting worse with covid it's disappointing to see this restaurant not protecting thier customers.  so many people walking in with no masks and going to buffett with no masks and they are not enforcing it.  Time to let central district health know what's going on.  Profits over safety

I met a friend for dinner and we weren't rushed through dinner. I had a caesar salad and gnocchi in a light pesto sauce with shrimp the meal was excellent. I would highly recommend Gino's to anyone looking for really excellent Italian food.
BEST breakfast in town. I'm not a breakfast person but I am a Moe Joe's person. The Benedict with whole garlic cloves and Moe Joe potatoes. Yum.

Tonight was one of the worst experiences I've ever had coming here and we go there quite often. Yes it was busy being that it was around 630 and dinner time. But I've never been treated so rudely before by a waitress here. She came and took our order twice because the first time she thought she could remember our orders which I thought was impressive, but 25 mins later comes back and says "umm so yeah I forgot what you guys were ordering so let me grab this napkin and write it down". Also to top it off we waited another 20 mins to cash out and had to walk up to the bar to pay and our waitress cashed us out eventually but also had some friendly words of F*** off after she gave us our check after we paid. Very dissatisfied with her service and almost makes me want to never come back here again even though we enjoy the cold beers and great food. The others servers were very helpful when we needed things for our table being that our waitress would go sit at a table and chit chat for 10 mins or so and just forget we existed. I would still continue to go here as long as I never ever have her serve me again.

Being from CA and about 2 hrs from the border I've had some pretty great Mexican food. Betos didn't disappoint! The breakfast burritos are huge and incredibly fresh! The salsa bar is LEGIT with 5 to choose from and pickled carrots as well. I cannot wait to return for lunch to try more of the offerings. This place gets 5 BIG stars!!
The food was good and the service was decent. It was busy, but overall good experience!

Although the food smelled great, we encountered some of the RUDEST staff we've ever experienced. From the gal at the front desk to the server... we walked out before even ordering. There was a wait over a hour long in addition to that. Really wanted to have a great dinner with my husband. Very unfortunate.

We visit the area regularly for family and a breakfast or two from this place are always the best food we eat while we are there. We have tried a ton of stuff on the menu and it has all been great. The lemon pancakes are  a family favorite. Sometimes the wait is pretty long but it is always worth it.

I was in Baskin-Robbins tonight! Very very disappointed with service.  There were two employees at the time. They were quite busy. And one employee seemed to be doing all the work. There was an employee with pink hair that I watched literally get up from a chair, wash her hands as if she was going to help the other employee, but than she just stood there doing nothing to help her coworker. This is not okay in my mind. The younger girl helped me and was very polite, and she was doing the best she could to make sure the customers were being helped as fast as possible. The other girl shouldn't even work there.  She was getting paid to do nothing.

Leaving another review.  At this point I have been a member since Feb, almost 8 months!  I have still only had 3 meet-and-greet, cannot even call them "dates.". I have called several times and asked why I am not getting any meetups, "We have someone we're working on for you to meet", baloney!!!    DO NOT BE SCAMMED BY THIS COMPANY!   I paid $4500 for meeting 3 unattractive men that they drug from the bottom of the barrel.  I could have paid for a trip to Aruba and had a much more quality time.    Bad, BAD CHOICE!!
Water was pretty good, would recommend. I really do enjoy water, it reminds of simpler times.

ordered the Chirashi Bowl through Uber Eats.  The rice was way to sweet and inedible.  They forgot the side of spicy Mayo.  To top it off there was a huge black hair in it!  Nauseating.  Don't waste Your money.

While the quote from Company was completely inline with the other quotes I received, I chose Eric because I feel like we connected and he was just a really nice guy.  Fast forward to the actual job - not a great experience.  The prep work wasn't done well because there was tons of overspray everywhere.  Eric's punctuality was severely lacking.  All of the cobwebs in the corners of my 18 ft ceiling we're sprayed over instead of wiped down.  All in all, I feel like I received a lazy job.  Enamel trim that wasn't supposed to be painted was sprayed over with an eggshell finish paint because that was easier than prepping/covering. No nails were removed, no holes filled, total lack of attention to detail.  Not much clean up after and the job wasn't completed to my satisfaction.  Finally tapped out instead of wasting any more of my and his time.  Probably could be a good painter but needs to focus on the job and be more thorough.

My son requested Dart Warz for his 8th birthday party recently. He has only been one other time, also for a birthday, and he was certain he too should celebrate his birthday here.
I researched the package options and compared to other options at other establishments in town. Not necessarily apples to apples on the type of entertainment , but I'm a bargain shopper; so I was more interested in cost and offerings compared to other popular entertainment options. I happened upon a Groupon  ($100 savings) and called to make sure it would meet the package I wanted, before purchasing it. It was a go, and so I bought it. 
For $150 we got 1.5 playtime for 12 kids, t shirt for bday boy,  party room with host and parents allowed to play too. You better believe my hubby and I were not going to miss out on taking out kids with nerf guns. So much fun! And I have no shame,  because those kids are ruthless!
Party host was attentive and helpful. 
I do feel they assume during your briefing that you understand the purpose of the game, and just cover rules. I learned later on my younger son (5 who had never been before) when recapping the day, that he had no clue he was supposed to be trying to shoot people on the opposite team. He was too busy looking for a target, he couldn't find. Poor guy!
I also think their provided nerf gun options  that comes with entry are lame. It's obvious most everyone upgrades or brings their own gun. It's almost pointless to choose a provided gun.  I would also check the nerf gun you bring will have a good supply of ammo made available. One of the boys that came to my sons party,  brought a gun that seemed to have less ammo readily available for him to use. People were hoarding it when they would find some.  As we left, I did notice an employee carrying in a new, small supply of them. So maybe it's just a matter of asking, if supply seems low?
Overall,  a great place to bring a group for an afternoon of entertainment.  I'm sure we will be back!

After a few more visits, I have bumped them up from a 4 to a 5 star place.

They are keeping up the quality and service, if not improving upon it. No waits for coffee refills. First, time we have gone on a weekend at prime time. Hit it just right as we beat the Sunday rush by about 5 minutes. And the bacon was excellent and cooked to the crisp, as ordered. Shredded hash browns instead of cottage potatoes was a nice change. 

They redid their menu just recently. Prices have gone up a bit, but not unreasonably. I mean $2.50 for a side of great bacon is hardly highway robbery. A place needs to keep up on the cost of business or we won't have it to around in the future.

Still one of the best place for breakfast in our book.
I can not believe you consider yourselves professionals and allow a client to walk out with her nails looking like that!! Shame on you! The worst part is you argued with her and refused a refund.
Great food and drinks. Loved my Boursin chicken with au gratin potatoes and lemon cocktail. My husband has a Guinness and burger. He loved it too.

A cool little pizza joint in Meridian. I wasn't very hungry so I got a plain pepperoni pizza- simple. 

They did not disappoint. My pizza was great, and I loved the service. Our waitress was friendly and exceeded my expectations. 

I would suggest- to the buissness owner-add pre sweetened iced tea as an option. I had to request sugar for mine. 

Overall, 4/5 would reccamond.

Was seated right away but then sat more than 10 minutes which gave us more than enough time to select our order as we moved the menus to the end of the table as a hint. Finally the server showed up only giving us time to order drinks, coke and water, which 5 minutes later came out wrong but the server left before we could even notice. We waited another 10 minutes before catching a bus boy for the missing water. When the server finally returned we were asked about an appetizer which we ordered only to have the person disappear again before we could order entrees. Eventually the appetizer came out but was delivered by someone else and so again we had no chance to order entrees. By the time my coke was empty she showed up to take our order, 40 minutes after being seated. And again left before I could ask for refill.

The Parmesan fries arrived drenched in heavy garlic sauce making the soggy fries very unappealing.

The sticky fingers and crispy pork ribletsboth were pretty good though, greatly helping to salvage the crappy night.

Horrible first experience today at the Chinden location. I asked about swiss water decaf and they seemed annoyed at the question and then I ordered a breve latte, and they felt compelled to call it a breve, which is actually just half and half. I pulled up and they looked at me like I was inconveniencing their day. Not ever going back. I'm sticking to my go to which is HUMAN BEAN!!!!!

The location at 2959 N Eagle Rd in Meridian, ID delivers to us. 
Tonight's delivery order took a full hour to reach us. Extra meat paid for was not added to sandwich. We have ordered several times from this particular location, and they always seem to have difficulty getting things right.

Before this location opened, we drove through at 8151 W Fairview Ave in Boise, ID. Our food is always correctly prepared and ready when we reach the window to pay. 5 stars to the Fairview location.

Update 2/4/2021 - Since writing this review and talking to management, service speed and order accuracy has improved. I will upgrade from 2 stars once we see if the improvements stick.
First time here and we will be coming back. We stopped in for lunch and it was clean and service was friendly. The food was great.
We always enjoy eating here. Service has always been great. I love there salads. There pizza is good. I like sitting outside on there patio.
I could probably eat a pencil eraser less rubbery and awful as this stuff. Felt like chewing on leather. Wasn't even that good tasting either.

I've been here twice and they are 2/2. Love the food, great staff, and I always leave extremely full. They food I've had has been delicious. Normally not a breakfast out kind of guy but when I do, this will be my go to spot. Want to check out lunch sometime too. 

I've had the chicken fried steak which was massive and very tasty. I've also had the farm house which was also very tasty. I like that they have regular hash browns as well as "Moe Joes potatoes". Both have been very good. Recommended this place to some family and they have also enjoyed it. Cool place and a great sp

They had the Rv that we wanted and traveled from Oregon to Idaho to pick it up. We had an appointment scheduled  a week in advance to pay for the trailer and sign paperwork, waited 4 hrs in the showroom for that to happen and once we handed the check over, Bish's was through with us.  Calls to them regarding warranty work promised to us have gone unreturned.  They suggested that our old Rv could be sold through their consignment department.  That vehicle went on their website with no photos and incorrect information.  After almost 3 months we are waiting for their finance department to send the title to the bank so that we can register the vehicle in Oregon..more phone calls unreturned!

Went in to see a doctor on something very private and a little scary to me and probably would be to most.  I am not going to put it online, but its been kind of devastating and something I have been going through for 4 weeks.  The office itself is very impressive, but don't base your experience on that---doctor was very uncaring, forgot to give me my lab sheet to get the labs she wanted, but when I looked it up what she was wanting me to get, it had NOTHING to do with what I am going through? I felt like I walked into the room knowing much more than her???? I brought her everything I had been taking to make her job much easier, but without examining me, asking questions, diagnosed what I had and then said "yeah, it could go on for 2yrs...." NO SYMPATHY whatsoever, no options and I will not go there again---you are a number.

Thought I would try this place after seeing the recommendations from complainers of other places. I was not impressed. 
Got there just after opening. Waited for a couple customers to warm up the staff. Upon entering it took a minute or two for someone to great me. The servers can't see the floor from behind their work station.
When I was seated I ordered a coffee and asked for what they were famous for. The server made 4 recommendations. 
When my server went back to get my coffee, she and the other server started bickering and arguing over tables and customers. This actually continued until after my breakfast was served. Mind you, I was on the far end of the restaurant. 
I ordered the Farmhouse Hashbrown Bowl. It was too salty. On a good not, the marionberry jam was delicious. 
I much rather go to the Griddle

I hired Eric to do a multiple project job in August of 2021. It was close to a $20,000 job and I gave him half down. The first red flag should have been when it took almost a month to paint my exterior and there is trim color on the base and base color on the trim all around the whole house. Not to mention, the plastic covering my NEW windows got sun baked onto the window frames from being on for so long. I gave up showing him the little things that needed to be fixed out there because of how long it had already been (completion date for exterior Oct 8th)! But I do need to mention after the first big rain fall this season, the exterior paint is already chipping and flaking! And it was his kids that "prepped" my home too!

 Moving on to the inside, it was a sloooooooooow process, full of excuses in regards to why he was late showing up and always early to leave with minimal work being done. As of November 18th, when I had to fire him, the job was MAYBE 65% done. That is including all the botched work he did that needs to be fixed. Some examples of that botched work would be, starting from the beginning of the interior, 1) Eric brought back paint chipped master bedroom doors,that continue to chip with a single touch of a fingernail, 2) 4 chipped pieces of rigid vinyl flooring, and the floor registrar was over cut, in a 10x5 master bathroom. Which he  just continued to lay flooring and not replace the broken ones as he installed, so now we have to redo, 3) Eric edged out some doorways that I had trim removed from and there was texture over spray everywhere! It was on all the surrounding walls, windows, ceiling, AND furniture! 4) we have mismatched door trim and baseboard through out the 4 bedrooms. There is actually baseboard around 3 of the bedroom doors! Not to mention, my husband had to demo the 3 bedrooms to keep the project moving for my kids to get their rooms back. My husband had to also fix all the paint of the trim and baseboards in the rooms  too. Cuts are not tight either! 

So fast forward to the beginning of November...we still had not started the flooring and trim/base in the kitchen, main living areas, main bathroom, closets, or hallway. Let alone all the fixes that needed to still be done that Eric said he would "get to". He had reassured me this job was going to be completed by the end of October because he knew I had family coming in for Thanksgiving. But, that did not happen. 

He is now threatening to take me to court if I don't pay him more money, on top of the half deposit, plus two draws he received. I was dumb to give him the second draw, but I gave it to him in hopes he would move faster and get my home completed. Instead, I received an inappropriate text in regards to him being drunk and that's why he was a no show once again! Therefore, we fired him. PLEASE do not go down the same path we did and do not hire Eric!

My 16-year-old daughter got a flat on her Mustang while it was snowing Saturday December 11th. I rushed over to help her and got the spare put on. I took the tire with the flat over to Les Schwab at 5:10. A boy came out and informed me that they closed at 5. I asked if I could just use the compressor. This kid looks at me and says "Our compressors are off for the night". I look over at the open bay and can clearly see someone putting on a tire using an air impact gun - using air. So I walk over and politely ask, can I use one of your hoses to put some air in this tire. The man says "I can't help you, I'm taking care of someone else" and walks away. That's the kinds of experiences I have had here.
One thing I like about this place is the value of the tire and their warranty service

Folks, Shige has been doing this for over 45 years!!  

You want sushi your way and a great way you must go here!!  Shige is the master of sushi!  Yes, the ambiance is just ok, but you come here for the sushi and a humble, caring sushi master from Japan!!!

I will not eat sushi in Boise anywhere but here! Get it made your way with no pre-mixed crap, this is as good as it gets!!

All around solid wing, burger, and brew restaurant. I've been in a number of times and have received good service,  good food, and a nice environment to watch a game - or pick up food during the pandemic! They did a great job doing curbside pickup and keeping employees and customers safe.

I thought I would try this because I LOVE cafe rio and heard this was close. So I went and used their coupon and let me say I will absolutely never go back to a Costa Vida. The reason being is that I've bitten into chicken that wasn't completely cooked. And that was twice!! Plus their steak isn't that good. Their portions aren't as big either. They are very similar but I would much rather go to a place that I love than to go here.

I went to Ada West after my dermatologist from St. Luke's passed away.  Service was good, but it was obvious they are very much about money.  They want full payment up front, prior to submitting to insurance.  I convinced them to wait for insurance to pay first.  It took them a long time to bill insurance and once insurance came through they wouldn't wait for my flex ben account to pay the remaining balance.  Costs are more expensive than St. Luke's so you might want to find out what they are charging before you have the service.  Ask about the lab fees, which were rather high compared to what I was used to paying.

I switched over to Ada West from a clinic downtown as this was closer to my house. I have not had one single positive experience at this clinic.  The front desk staff is short and rude. Not a pleasant place at all.

don't go here, they have no idea what they're doing. we discussed what we had in mind but the stylist clearly didn't value what we had to say as she ended up doing something different. i wanted to treat my mom for christmas and get her extensions done but now i feel awful as i see she is not happy with her hair. waste of over $1000.

Another sterling job by Jim.

Installed 3 new double deadbolts and not a grain of saw dust left. My wife smiled at his cleanliness. He wouldn't install the Chinese Toe Popper Mines, so I'll have to do those (Joke!)

Came on time with all the right parts and finished up the job quickly. Second time we have used him.

Called all afternoon to do take out order-phone was either busy or they would not answer. No way to order on line!!!!
Get there to do a takeout order 50 minute wait for takeout to be ready.
They were slightly busy but had tables empty!!

The menu has a really good selection, I had the cajun chicken club and it was amazing. We also ordered calamari and clams as appetizers, both were great. Our server was one of the best servers we've ever had & the food came out promptly. Overall a really enjoyable experience & would recommend to anybody!

I received a bill dated 12/7/15 due 1/7/16 and on Christmas Eve I get a notice that they sent it to a collection agency. Really!? I didn't even get time to pay it. And I have two forms of health Insurance. I will never go back to Dr Visser if this is how they treat patients. How disappointing.

This place was soooooo good! I went for brunch after church and I got the veggie bowl with sausage and it was delicious. It's tough going out to eat with little ones but this place made things easier with an awesome kids menu. My son got the French toast and I took a mom bite ( mommy tax) and oh my goodness it was soooo good! The best part about this place was I accidentally left my debit card behind and they kept it safe for me until I could return to pick it up the following week. 10/10 will definitely be coming back!

This is one of our favorite Mandarin restaurants in the Boise area.  The plates are huge, the food quality is very good.  They will ask you how you would like your dish prepared. Hot? Spicy? Prepared Gluten free?  All the chicken dishes have been tasty and plentiful.  My husband loves the noo-noo noodles soup dish.  That bowl is so large and filled with shrimp, vegetables, beef and noodles - it could feed a small village.  This quality food is reasonably priced.  As for service, they are friendly and efficient.  Even though they are busy, you are in and out in a reasonable timeframe.  Thumbs up for this restaurant!

I want to love this place, but it has been hit and miss.  We originally went to the Owyhee Tavern downtown Boise for Brunch and loved the food, ambience and service.  At the Tavern at Eagle Island the service and food has been uneven.  Our first time we came for brunch the Denver Omelet with fried potatoes was excellent!  The second time we came, it was like there was  a party in the kitchen with loud clanging of dishes, laughter and no one paying attention to the customers.  I had ordered an Irish Coffee and by the time it came, it was luke warm and the whip cream was non existent.  The service that day by the way was terrible.  TODAY, I wanted to have the delicious Denver Omelet I had earlier.  Instead of green peppers in it there were green chilies (just NOT the right flavor) and the fried potatoes were barely warm.  Our server (who is always the same one) in my opinion, could be a little more attentive.  He did not come by to see if everything was ok.  I do like the touch of the nice fruit served with the dish, but, if we do the Tavern again we will go downtown.  It's further away, but we like it better.  I will say we love the Kung Pao Calimari that we order as an appetizer later in the day.

My wife and I go here a lot. It's a nice diner. The prices are reasonable, the staff is friendly, and the food is okay. In my opinion the food doesn't stand out, but it certainly isn't bad. 

Their salad bar is fairly decent. There are a lot of options for a salad. The fruit consists of bananas, strawberries, and melons. They have two soup options, potatoes, and a few other sides. The ice cream machine is available with the salad bar as well. 

I usually get the seafood special which comes with a salad bar and shrimp. The shrimp is breaded and tastes decent. I used to hate their fish, but the newest version they have isn't that bad. 

If you are looking for low priced clean American diner, it's a good option. Compared to a lot of commercial diners it is as good if not superior. But like those other establishments don't expect the food to stand out. You won't hate it, but you won't write home about it either.

Service and food are meh. I came here once in the fall last year to watch football with my gf and we were two of maybe 5 people at the bar. There was one bartender and I couldn't tell if she was in a bad mood, acted normally like that, or would just rather spend her shift talking to her friends on the other side of the bar. We got our food after a bit and had to ask for new avocado since the ones in our plate were literally black. Food was ok the first trip. 
Tried it again this week and wanted to give it another shot since they have a wide beer selection. Sat at the bar with my buddy and the bartender was nicer, but same wait time...not many people at the bar and takes a while to get service or your check, even after making eye contact. Food was worse this time and my buddy said his Alfredo looked like a 4th grader made it from a box. I wanted to like it, but there are better places to go for sports and beer without having to feel like an inconvenience or get iffy food. 
Water and silverware don't come standard apparently, at least at the bar.

A newly opened Chinese Restaurant in a newly decorated location, this is a nicely setup dining venue; located in a small strip mall next to The Curb Bar and Grill. Parking is plentiful. Seating is standard height tables. A clean and nicely setup dining room.

Being an ABC (American Born Chinese) originally from the SF Bay Area, I know good Chinese food and cooking from the normal Americanized fodder found in most of the other Boise places. In fact until, the Red Pavilion, the bar was set by a good Panda Express or PF Chang's. IOW, not very high. But Red Pavilion, has raised that bar and  is the best in the area. Please keep in mind that our 5 star rating is based on the Boise area, not against a SF Bay Area or Seattle roster of Chinese Restaurants.

On this visit, we had their pot stickers ($6.95) which were freshly made, tasty and nicely shaped and sized. There were 8 of them and plenty for the two of us. A nice dipping sauce accompanied them.  Next we had a dish of their beef chow yuk ($7.95), the wide rice noodle fixed in the Cantonese style. Authentic in taste and stir-frying style and not overly sauced. This was followed up by brown rice (white is available also) and a dish from their special more authentic menu with about 20-25 other dishes not found on the normal printed menu. We had their garlic flavored pork, tofu and mushrooms stir fired ($10.95). Excellent rendition and again not overly sauced, a common failing in Boise Chinese places. Our only suggestion was to put more garlic into the seasoning or even some fermented black beans. But that is our personal tastes for this type of dish. We washed it all down with a Tsing Tau Beer and hot tea. We had leftovers for another lunch.

But before quitting, we noticed the Sesame coated fried rice balls with sweet bean paste filling on the Special Menu ($6.95). Known as Gin Diu, they were freshly made and authentic in every way. Not too big, 8 of them were a good dessert for as many as four people. But two of us ate them all with gusto.

The owners are a young couple and she was very cordial and fun to talk to. We had a lot of laughs trying to mesh her Mandarin pronunciation with my quasi Cantonese. She speaks English, but there are certain dishes or words that the Chinese words only convey the thought and our pronunciations are just different. I asked about certain dishes and she laughed saying, she didn't think she could get American People to eat those. She did say though that if we call up a day or two ahead, they would make roast duck or a roast a whole fish for us. Done deal we said-we will be back. Other dishes to try are the broccoli and beef.  We are going to also ask about some black bean asparagus and pork stir fry. .

This place is our place for authentic Chinese Food with good and friendly service. We told them we will be back and were glad to have them here.

What I like about Wingers the most is that they are consistent.  My hubby love love loves the wings!  He'd eat there everyday if I'd let him.  I had the grilled chicken taco's which were not only tasty but very filling. I'd definitely order this dish again.  
Now on to the dessert - one word - Wow!   We tried the chocolate chip mint pie which is called the Asphalt pie and The Cookie Zookie - which consist of a Chocolate chip cookie with ice cream)

We happily waddled out of there satisfied and beyond full.  Service is friendly and accommodating!  Well done Wingers!

Acting on a referral from my Primary Care Physician and wanting a second opinion I went to a "specialist." I had called ADA West Dermatology, spoke to the Billing Dept., to get a price on the fee for an appointment.  They couldn't tell me, so they gave me an insurance code to check with my insurance provider to get a cost.  Along with diagnosis (after a one minute exam the opinion: benign) I was treated for an on going skin condition.  I was floored at checkout, when I saw the amount they charged me for their services!!!  O.M.G!  THREE TIMES the cost of my P.C.P!  They handed me a standard credit card receipt. I paid and left in shock.  I had to call the Billing Dept., and request a detailed statement of charges. After making a second trip and reviewing the statement, I noticed the code that they have me was absent and a different code used. The actual apt./exam was $24 more than my P.C.P.  Where they got me was the keratosis burning. Apparently 15 is the magic number to reach the maximum charge (according to the Billing Dept) and I had 18 (although some weren't even visible to the naked eye and I brought this to the Dr. attention to no avail) so imagine that. Over $200 was this charge! WOW. For the EXACT SAME treatment my P.C.P. administers included in the price of an exam!  No wonder the word "collections" is included in some of the reviews here.  Obviously there are circumstance where dermatologist is warranted and specialist care mandatory.  If you have top tier health insurance and cost is not issue?  Then by all means. But for the rest of us self insured, under insured, retired or on a tight budget?  I would go elsewhere.

Very solid establishment and even though we had to wait a little bit due to being short staffed it was still worth it...walking in you immediately feel how homey this place is and the local vibe of all the regulars is pretty awesome...came here this past week on a trip to Boise and was really impressed with not only the food but the service as well... 

For breakfast I had the Basque chorizo had with green chilies, jalapeños, tomatoes, and cheddar cheese atop Moe Joe potatoes with two eggs any style and toast...I asked for a few more peppers so was pretty spicy and well worth the burn. My wife had the 2 eggs and bacon (yes she's a creature of habit) and really loved them as well. What was great is the homemade jams that accompany your toast which really made this place just a little more special.

The food here was great- the steak sandwich was great. The kids Mac and cheese was fantastic. I wasn't a huge fan of them having a weird serial killer show on when we came in, but they changed it to sports when we asked. Didn't want our toddler watching someone being beaten in whatever crime show it was. The service was very nice and friendly, but there were long inconsistent gaps in waiting for water to be refilled and waiting for our check. Maybe 2/3 of the tables were full, so they just seemed like they weren't on it with getting things done in an efficient way. They were pretty accommodating with kids, had a good selection for kids menu and kids drink cups. 

We will be back because the food was good- but the service could definitely be better.

We got a chance to try the local Grimaldi's Pizzeria this week. Having been patrons of the Summerlin, Las Vegas shop, we felt we could make a good comparison. Since we favor the thin, crusty style of New York style pizza, Grimaldi's seemed a good place to go.

Michele R. described the layout, service and seating well, so I'll concentrate on the food. 

We appreciate the ordering style at Grimaldi's as it more closely matches what we ran into in Italy and we hear on the east coast of the US. Somehow, the combo ordering more common in the west produces overloaded pizzas where the crust loses out, often ending up soggy. In our opinion, the crust is at least 50%, maybe more, of the satisfaction of eating pizza.

We had a small pizza bianca ("white pizza") with pepperoni, mushrooms and black olives. We prefer the pizza without tomato sauce as my wife is sensitive to the acidity in tomato sauce. So where they offer a sans tomato sauce pizza is a plus to us and Grimaldi's does. Our pizza arrived in a timely manner and as ordered. We enjoyed the pizza, but would have more clearly stressed our preference for pretty crusty pizza with some char on the edges. Having read some of the past reviews, it seems some felt their crust was too charred. Perhaps the pizza makers are over-compensating, but next time we will more clearly express our preference. The ingredients were first rate. We might suggest a slightly less salty pepperoni, but that is just our preference. The LV Grimaldi's always did it "just right" for us, so we will just have to be more clear on our next order up here. We had plenty to take home for another meal. 

Since it was lunch, but pizza without wine seemed uncivilized to me, I had a rossoto (rose style) italian wine. Very nice, not too dry or too sweet, and not too high alcoholic content. Just right for driving within the lines afterwards.

We chose to eat inside, figuring since the annual invasion of the flies had started in Boise, patio dining might be a constant battle. But, we found the flies had decided inside was pretty nice too and it was a battleground inside too. Having them as dining companions seems a bit much, so we'll wait for the first freeze to decimate them before returning.

Overall, we'd come back, but as an after thought, we would say that Guido's pizza is just a bit ahead in total score on NY style pizza  (for take-out Guido's would probably get our nod). But for dining in, we would chose Grimaldi's over Guidos for the ambiance, cordial service, and dining with friends.

We tried going in on a Saturday, but there was a 2 hour wait and they said we should make a reservation next time. So we decided to try again Tuesday and make a reservation. The phone went straight to voicemail, but I left my phone number and asked for a reservation. We went in for the reservation and they said they don't check messages until the next day. No where in the voice recording mentioned that. We finally got our table and the bread was great and we really enjoyed our waitress, but the food wasn't amazing and was pretty chain restaraunt tasting. It was okay and may or may not be going again.

So many good things at Moe Joe's!! First our waitress was awesome. Made recommendations that we followed and it paid off. Never be afraid to ask 'What do you like to eat?' It was a busy late morning but we didn't feel like we waited too long to be sat or to get our food. Outside dining was nice! 

Lemon Poppyseed pancakes were awesome and nothing like anything I had tried before! That glaze was delicious and just tart enough. 

The Farm House had great flavor with that grilled biscuit topped with a sausage patty, cheese, eggs and gravy with potatoes on the side. Yum!

Dr. Miller did my teeth too and now I am just as sweet smelling as my sister Zoe. Everything came out as good and I am shaking off the anesthetic goofies. 

Highly recommend tooth cleaning for us dogs and they treated me like the King I am.

Just had one of our dogs undergo tooth work. We have always been so leery of having our dogs put under anesthesia for this. But after seeing our Zoe 's tooth condition in one area, we had IPH do a full inspection. Yikes, she had 11 teeth that needed to be removed due to abscesses and bone deterioration. 

Now it sounds we are the most awful dog parents extant, but we love our dogs. Would do anything for both of them. But, we thought her teeth were in good shape. Dr. Miller showed us the X-rays and she was in dire need. 

Well, long story short, Zoe came through well, and the care and operation was excellent. Yes, it was a big bill, but the skill and care was worth it. They have a tech or Vet who monitors the sedation. 

We our scheduling our Jeff next for cleaning.

Gino took the time to say hello and check on us and our server was amazing i feel it could simply not go to a 3. The service was awesome. Hostess was a little bland could have smiled and did not offer us a high chair. I got the impression this place isnt as kid friendly, no kid menus, but we got them a pizza and they loved it. The veal was good as well. I got a pretty flavorless dish but i think that was just me i cant even remember the name

Food? Amazing
Atmosphere? On point
Service? Sad to say, awful. Just waited 10 mins while our waitress sat down and chatted with another customer, and obvious friend, after asking if we wanted a refill. After her lovely conversation was over, she asked again if we wanted a refill... Just... What?

I hate this because I love this place. The food is amazing. The customer service tonight was horrible though.

Ok so as I mentioned in my first review, I've gone back twice now after exciting nights filled with liver damage. One and a half of those times, Los Betos has hit the spot. The first time I went, I ordered far too much and can't even remember what I got, but I know it was like three burritos and some other madness. It was decent I guess. This last time I went, I got a few burritos and a quesadilla. I got a bean and cheese burrito and some kind of asada burrito and a seafood quesadilla and other crazy madness. It was all REALLY good this time. The asada was really freakin good actually, and I went in with no expectations. I'm happy that my hangover spot has upped it seasoning and cooking game. Now I'll be back again FOOOOOORRRR SHOOOOOOOOOOO!

I work next to the place so I order here quite a bit. They are always fast and you get plenty of food for what you pay. Some days the music is a little loud and it is hard to have a conversation. Also go9d luck finding parking on a Friday or Saturday night.  But overall it's a good experience

My husband was recently in an accident. We chose Cope Collison because it has been in Meridian for 57 years and their reviews are awesome! We had a wonderful experience. The body shop technicians as well as the front office staff were so friendly. They provided us with great updates on the progress via phone calls and email the entire time it was in the shop; which was not a long time. When I went to pick it up, I was shocked because I didn't even recognize the truck! LOL!  They detailed it and washed it inside and out!!! I recommend Cope Collison to anyone that wants to have their vehicles worked on by a company full of employees with Integrity!

So so, the decor is really nice. They have a decent selection of condiments which is good because you will need them. We ordered the Pho with chicken and it was bland even with the extras they provide with the dish.  We also had the Beef Skewer which was dry and chewy with a generous amount of fat still attached too bad I'm not into chunks of chewy fat unfortunately the portion of edible food was not generous. Interestingly we didn't want the skewer, what I had requested was a dish they had a picture of on their menu of pork stew which is what I asked for but for some reason they brought skewers. Cleanliness was also subpar, the menus were dirty to the point of having sticky food stuck on them and the table and Floors also had food on them. It would have been a little more understanding of they had been busy but there was only one other customer and the employees were just standing around. It may have just been a fluke so plan to give them another try at a later date

Stay away! Terrible facility and even worse customer service! They kept our money even though we asked for our refund 5 minutes after checking in!! The two hotels in the other side of the freeway are WAY better.

Well we finally found a happy hour. Not that happy though. Ordered the nachos, hummus, and satay. As expected they were small portions but to be fair the nachos did state that. However, the nachos were heavy in cheese, good, but there was maybe 3 pieces of pot roast and very little of the rest of the toppings. Hummus was really good. Now the satay.... good size portion. Out of the three pieces one was over cooked one was cooked right but was mushy and super though to eat. The other was OK. Pieces were very thick. I don't recommend this at all. 

Place is really fancy and has a lot of potential.

Hailey was a phenomenal server. I thought the entrees were all delicious. The servings were HUGE, so go in half with a partner! The only complaint I have is that my food came out lukewarm. The mimosas were delish and they definitely do NOT skimp on the champagne!

Horrible to get ahold of. You can call and leave several messages, email twenty times and you're lucky to get a response months later. We had water leaking in our rental destroying the hardwood and we couldn't get ahold of anyone to fix it, when we finally got someone to come look at it, the property manager shrugged it off and said the owners were selling the home so not to worry about it. We ended up purchasing the home from them and the homeowners had to pay much more to fix the issue than they should have. If we were able to get ahold of property management the leaky dishwasher wouldn't of damaged the flooring in the first place. Now they won't get back to us in regards to refunding deposits on the home. I don't recommend them for renters or for those seeking professional property management as we've had several other issues with them as well.

It's an insane bias I have built into my DNA that I automatically think less of and expect less of a restaurant when it is located in a mini mall or strip center as an attached tenant build out and NOT a stand alone building. I am delighted to report that Gino's has gone a long way in disproving my own stereotype.
Honestly if I could give 6 stars Gino's might be the first recipient of such an "honor" which is saying something coming from a person who has a visceral reaction to suck cliches as "I'm giving it 110% effort".
Keeping it very simple, this place was awesome in my opinion. Not only was the food fantastic but the service was absolutely spot on. 
There was only 2 of us that night but when our food was ever so delayed in coming out, the owner came over to our table to apologise....Now I am a believer that dinner is NOT just a meal but if done right, it is an experience. And trust me please, we had a delightful experience. In fact, according to us the food came out in perfect order, just when we were ready for it.
My colleague had the lamb shank and I had the special flat iron steak, cooked to a perfect rare temperature.....
Our waiter was great. The hostess was welcoming. The bus staff quiet and quick and the owners visit was a treat in and of itself.
I plan on going back and have saved it as a Meridian favorite.....mic drop.

Since it has opened this Freddie's has gone to being Krogerized and from a 4 star rating to a 2 star rating by yours truly.

Since my u[date a year ago, things have really gotten pathetic here. Shelves are often not stocked, even with the Kroger private label. Trucks never seem to make it on time,  exacerbating the problem. 

To be honest Winco is going to clean their clocks when it opens across Chinden, both in price and stocking. Hooray.
Love the egg rolls and the sauce! Mmm yakisoba is good too!! little on the pricey side, but worth it..

If I could I wouldn't even give this place a 1 star.  My daughter and her friend went before homecoming and it was a so unacceptable.  Polish was all over their fingers and hands. Nails were not shaped.  I can't even describe the French tip nails it was so bad.  Awesome nails did not fix their mistake or refund us. They said they don't work for free.  YIKES.  
PS.  Forgot to mention...their power went out and they still saw it as the customer's responsibility to pay for their service. wow.

Well, since we ate here 2 days in a row, it's only fair that I update my review. 

The food is awesome. My wife enjoyed the Smothered Breakfast Burrito. It comes with your choice of meat and choice of sauce. She preferred the sausage with red enchilada sauce.

I love the Loaded Hash Bowl. Everyone "loves a big bowl of hash!" Yes, portions are generous. 

Our server Shannon tells us that Joe makes everything from scratch. I guess it's time for us to branch out and try some new dishes.

Dr Amanda Dozier is now my husbands and my primary provider, we are so pleased  with her , she will listen and is efficient and respectful with a side of  bubbly personality. We are on a path to healing ,thanks to her genuine concern.  We know her time is valuable and she always manages to give us quality time at our appointments.  Her staff is Fabulous! Great office vibe!!!!!

Inedible. This review is for delivery through Door Dash.

We just spent $40 on pizza that EVEN our dog wouldn't eat. 

We ordered the Brooklyn with extra ricotta and sauce. GROSS.

It was extremely sour, FUNKY and burnt. 

$50 down the drain (tip, tax, etc...) 

See ya.

Re-Bath did a complete remake on our bath, only issue was getting the correct counter top in which took two orders from them to the manufacturer. The actual work was indeed done in one day, I watch closely to see about corners being cut but all the work was correct and beautiful. We have received many compliments on the new bath. We are extremely happy with the results!

Not the best food ever... My kids craved this so we stopped.... Horrible service and small portions.... The food was salty and my kids did not care for it... They ate it since they were starving... Not sure I will be stopping here again when traveling. Not the worst food I have had but I am not a fan  do not get the sweet n sour   the orange chicken was better for sure

I have to say, this us probably the best Chinese restaurant I have tried in Meridian/Boise area.  However, still a bit disappointed.

They offered 2 menus.  One of them has more specific Szechuan cuisine, and dishes Chinese people like more.  I looked at both and ordered Garlic Shredded Pork which was great!  I also ordered Chow mein with pork, stir fry rice noodles, and my favorite Chinese vegetable dish - dry sautéed greenbeans to go.

They are alright.  The greenbeans dish is good, but I realize they use lots of soy sauce in every dish, including my greenbeans dish.  So at the end, they all tasted the same.

The service was descent.  I was not offered the fried wonton skin chips.  Not sure if they forgot or they thought I was too Chinese to have it?  I love those chips!

Parking is kind of hard, especially during lunch hours.  The shopping center has lots of 30 min. parking spaces, but many stores such as tanning salon and restaurants.  How many people do eating or tanning in 30 min.?  

Regardless, this is by far the best Chinese food I have had since I moved out here.  Perhaps, I will try other dishes next time to see if there's still lots of soy sauce.

Quite possibly the most grody and janky place I have stayed at in my twenty-some-odd years on Earth, if that can be considered a description.

Anyway, some time ago, my family and I went up to the Boise area to visit relatives. My dad had free hotel points, so he chose this place. My gut told me to tell my father to pick another hotel, but he reassured me that this hotel was fine.

Well, the mop bucket with the dirty water in it next to the front door was a huge red flag. This mop bucket was the start of a long, three nights in Boise. Here's what happened:

- The wood floor was coming apart, with pieces of the floor loose.

- One of the housekeepers left a bottle of bathroom cleaner and a dirty rag in the kitchen area.

- The furniture and televisions were dusty.

- One of the blankets we were given in the room was filthy. When my mom went to the front desk to get a new blanket, they gave her a scratchy, small blanket with a weird, brown stain that I suspect was fecal matter.

- Toys and Legos from a previous guest were left under the sleeper sofa.

- The shower head was rusting.

- Breakfast was stale. While the muffins, cereal, and coffee I had were fine, my dad had toast and eggs, and he said that they were stale.

- Shady people hung out outside near our room (we were on a ground floor room near a side-exit). When my mom brought this up to the receptionist, he replied with "They work here. I'm sorry."

The place was so bad, we were very close to checking out and spending the rest of our trip at one of the Marriott properties across the street. It felt like we were in a horror movie a la "Hostel" where guests at this hotel would be brutally and systematically tortured by a group of crazy people.

The only pro about this hotel is when we finally left the place for the next leg of our vacation.

I was debating whether or not to rate this place a 3 or a 4 and decided to rate it a 4. I like the menu as it wasn't the same type of menu offerings as other pizza places. I had the prosciutto and arugula with added garlic, mushrooms and artichoke hearts - basically a $40 pizza including a 15% tip with water and lemon to drink.

Imho I felt that the toppings were on the sparse side when compared to my favorite pizza place, but pizza was good. Service was good. Would I come here again? Probably, but I would rather go with my favorite pizza place hands down or another local pizza place (not a chain) before Grimaldi's. Just being honest.
Amazing breakfast!  Service is typically on point!  They are a popular place so plan on some kind of wait

Zach Newbolt and the entire team at Bish's rv were honest, informative, and a pleasure to work with!
if you are in the market for an rv and want excellent communication and honesty Bish's is the call!
We love Mojoes it's our favorite breakfast place . My family All have a favorite food. Mine  is definitely the jalapeño popper omelette. Thank you Mo joes.

First time at this place I had the lady (the wife) do my fill first without the final filing and polish. She had an appointment walk in. Then the man (the husband) did my pedicure. Then the husband finished my nails. He barely filed them before he polished.  I kept telling him the edges were rough and sharp.  He kept getting irritated at me with each nail I pointed out. He kept barking at me and telling me that it was my cuticles and to put lotion on later. Like seriously? The wife left to get their kid at school, so I couldn't ask for her help. We finally got to a place where I was "ok" with my nails, knowing I could soften the edges a bit more at home and knowing I won't go back. 
BUT, that night (Friday), one nail chipped, then the next day three more. Ugh! I walked in Monday morning to explain what was happening. The lady was nice and said to grab my color and she'd fix them, but sat me down with the guy (I guess she had another appointment). He started barking at me, telling me that I worked too hard and chipped the polish myself. This was my fault, etc.
Ilit into him and told him that watching TV and cooking dinner isn't working too hard. I've had gel nails done for years and have actually done construction work and have never had 4 nails chip,  let alone in less that 24 hours!  He is extremely rude and confrontational and does poor work. I will never go back here!

We love Moe Joe's! Their biggest downfall is the long wait times for a table due to popularity on the weekends.  The have a great system to track place in line now, so that helps. The food is amazing! We have also tried the red beers & mimosas and enjoy those as well. The jalapeno   berry is my favorite. Service is also great consistently.

I have been spoiled my whole life (63 years) with killer, the bomb, all that and a bag of chips, awesome, etc. Chinese food. Do you know the urban dictionary has 405 words & phrases for the word 'good'? I digress.

Been in Meridian, Idaho for 8 months now and am struggling to find da kine Asian and Mexican food. Well, finally found excellent Mandarin Chinese food and bonus, it's close to home.
