I got the Pavilion Lo Mein (not on menu), which is basically the house special noodle dish. It includes chicken, beef and shrimp. The Moo Goo (chicken & veggies), Honey Almond Shrimp and steam rice. Everything was so flavorful and had it's own unique taste. Some Asian places have a tendency to use the same sauce for multiple dishes - don't like that. One thing, though, the rice. Chinese rice is usually very dry - theirs was more like Japanese sticky rice. Not quite, just threw me as all. Also, their menu is a bit limited.

The prices are, well, pricey. That will prevent me from going there often, but the food came out very quickly. Got take-out, but next time will try dining in. 

Note: If you follow my reviews about food, most times I don't have photos. This place has a lot of photos already from other reviewers, I thought it redundant. Anyway, I ate it before I started writing this. I'm too honest for my own good.

I thought the sashimi and roll I had were bomb.com. Excellent food. I would've liked to not have to ask for eating instruments, but that's an easy thing to overlook. I didn't get any pictures, but I'll be going back! I did think some of their rolls were overpriced, but there was enough to choose from that was reasonably priced.

Very surprised by this find. 

We went for a birthday celebration and I was looking for some good Japanese food without the show. This was recommended and we figured we try it out.

Server was attentive and asked what we liked and offered suggestions. We ordered two appetizers and several plates. Everything was delicious and serving sizes were large. I immediately decided I would return. There wasn't much business so I hope they survive.

One of the best choices we ever made when moving into this area was making ICCU our bank for just about everything. But what we want to give them a high-five for has been their loan department's efficiency thru the 3 houses we have bought here. 

In one case, we wanted them to issue and close a loan in 3 weeks. Now most people don't realize that 3 weeks is warp speed to initiate, appraise, vet the borrowers, and approve the loan. So why the need for speed, you ask? Well, by closing before the April 15 deadline for the homeowner's property tax exemption on about a $100K of assessed value. We asked if they could meet that deadline and they said, Yes.

The fact that we had made ICCU our checking and cash savings institution made it easy for them to vet us.

In the last month, we saw a nice, smaller house that would meet our maturing needs. With the competitive market for house purchases now in place, we made the decision to buy before we sold our current house, so as to preclude being a "contingent buyer". That required us to ask if ICCU would find us credit worthy enough to loan us on the new house before we sold the current house? If they said yes, we would make our offer post haste. 

Mark G., the loan officer at the Ustick branch gave us a quick yes and started the paper work post haste. We bid, got it that night and ICCU finished our loan and closed the purchase in a few days under 3 weeks, beating their previous time. They are a great outfit to do business with.

To close out the tale, we sold our house a few days before we listed it (due to our great RE agent, Lynnette G of the Meridian Silver Creek office on Wells)and will be in the clear and not owning 2 houses. 

Thanks again to Mark G. And ICCU for making this possible.

Went there for date night yesterday and the food was so good. We started our dinner on with macaroni and cheese balls with that special dipping sauce- recommend it! Hubby had the burger and fries which were filling and tasty.  I had the sanguid shrimp over potato cake served with an amazing corn dish. All food came out piping hot, so much that we had to wait to eat it. Sweet tea was a must have as well as the cornbread. Can't wait to take my family to this place when they visit.

We called a few places to compare prices for having our cat neutered. They were the first have an appointment available but they said they cannot provide a price until the doctor exam the cat for $1 as a new client promotion. We got there. Before they look at the cat, I was handed a paper showing $400+ for the operation, which is more than double the prices quoted from other places. They could have told me that so I won't waste my time.

When they first opened it was a nightmare, but none of ot was their fault. Since they've fixed the bugs in the system, it's much quicker and still delicious. The crab Rangoons are quite tasty. The only thing I don't like it the veggies. They all taste like the cabbage since I'm guessing they're all cooked together. Otherwise it's good. Will be back for sure.

Arrived 10 minutes for our (my husband and I had back to back appts) 3:30 appt and filled out the plethora of paperwork. At 3:55, we were informed that our doctor was running 45 minutes behind! Do we want to reschedule? Ah nope! Would have taken about 2 minutes to call BEFORE the appt time and ask if we wanted to come later or to reschedule at that time! Colossal waste of OUR time!

This place was CRAZY. (There are other reviewers who mention bickering/unprofessional wait staff so maybe our experience is common). 

Let me start off by saying I'm thankful to all the people who went to work. Many of the restaurants during our trip to Idaho had signs on the doors and were closing early due to "staffing shortages". So, to the employees of all the Idaho restaurants, thank you for working. 

That said, if you decide to come to work maybe just take it down a few hundred notches. 

We sat down at Moe Joe's and our waitress came over, chewing gum and seeming a little peeved. It was early-ish and not very busy. (It got busy later as we sat there.) She grabbed our drink order and came back asking if we were ready. We weren't yet, we have young kids and yelpers, if you're a parent then you know everything takes longer with kids in tow. Anyway we just wanted to sit for a second and put cream in our coffee and look over the menu. Fam, I'm not even kidding when I say we had only been there maybe 10 minutes and she had asked us probably a dozen times if we "were ready yet". 

We were clearly still reading our menus and sipping our coffee. It was really intense and really rushed feeling. Our sons asked us if she was ok and my only response was she probably just wanted to turn tables quickly but dang we had just sat down. 

The kicker was about 10 minutes later when our waitress walked passed taking a tray of water cups to another table and a customer accidentally bonked into her. The water went flying and spilled on the floor. 
The customer was mortified and apologized multiple times but the waitress just stood there and then hustled off behind the little wall where the kitchen is. (It's an open concept with an unattached wall blocking the kitchen and dining area. You can clearly hear the employees back there.) 

Most people have spilled something in their life. It's no big deal and this was just water. Which made what happened next insane. 

The waitress was behind this wall when she started raising her voice and saying, "It wasn't MY fault! That lady slammed right into me!" It was awkward and the people at the other tables were just looking around at each other. The waitress came back out but never cleaned up the spill, other employees were left to do that. (With some weird powder stuff that puffed up all into the air. Our son was coughing for a bit after that. What happened to an old fashioned mop?) 

Anyway, What the waitress did though was bad mouth that poor lady who accidentally ran into her and said sorry like 5 times, to every table she went too. Here were some gems we heard her saying to other customers, "I never spill stuff! She ran right into me." (This one we heard multiple times.) 
"My hand is steady with the tray. I never spill!" (This one a couple times.)

This put the diners in the uncomfortable position of having to comfort the waitress by telling her it wasn't her fault. Which was really painful to listen to. It's a restaurant and somebody spilled water, so what? It's a common enough occurrence. The whole atmosphere was full of anxiety and stress and rush. 

After all this, the food was an afterthought and just so-so. The hashbrowns weren't spiced at all and the french fries and breakfast potatoes were overly spiced with salt, pepper and garlic. So much so that my son couldn't eat them. The pancakes were fine. At that point we didn't care about the food though, all we could think about was getting the heck out of there. 

Side note... This place is very echoey and loud so if you have special needs kids definitely bring your noise canceling headphones

In all honesty, I was Super excited to get my nails done because my birthday was in six days. My mom's friend had recommended this store because the nails they did on her was fantastic. So I decided to go in with my mom and just double check. So when I went in I asked to do a certain style and they were okay to start with. But then my mom came to check in on me to make sure I was okay. They started yelling at her for not having a mask and by law if you have a health condition and let the establishment know they cannot do anything. So my mom understood the first time and was going to leave then the lady continued to yell and kept telling her to get out. Finally we both left because I refuse to be treated this way let alone my mother who has health conditions who can't wear a mask.

Let me start this by saying the service was fine and the chef really seemed to care that I enjoyed my food. I really don't even want to leave a "negative" review, but I feel I should give others an honest opinion of the food. The food tasted and looked like the stuff I got at China Grand Buffet, but I paid the price of Fujiyama. I got the sashimi appetizer plate and two rolls. I was blown away by how small the sashimi appetizer was and equally disappointed with the taste for what I paid. The rolls were the exact same as I have tasted at China Grand. I would honestly go to China Grand, pay half the price, and eat more just to have a better experience. I'm sorry, but there's far better options within just a few minutes drive from here. But now that I've completely disrespected them, that me say that the atmosphere and chef were excellent.

My universal axles on my Tacoma went out yesterday so I did some price comparing. When I called Les Schwab they were very respectful and honest, and with awesome prices compared to the competitors. Tom worked on my Tacoma and did a flawless job. He showed me the parts that went out and explained every nook and cranny of the system. Not only did he replace the parts for a great price (which took all day), he UPGRADED my universal axle system to make my truck more reliable and properly lubricated on the joint! H#ll yes I'm coming back! Thank you guys for your hard work.

-Colton

Outta town and decided to grab something to eat! Stop here because near the hotel! Order a soda and its flat so i ask for a bottles coke, no problem 3$ so i pay and ask for the money back on fountain coke! I say thank you and as I drive off I hear her yell out the drive through window "THANK YOU DONT COME BACK"!!! Wait WTF...you sell me a flat soda and I buy a more expensive one and you say that???? Skiiiiirt and back up and she wants to start yelling and shaking her dumb ass head saying yeah because she has to pay for my soda??????? Who the F does that to a paying customer??? Food sucks donkey balls too!!! Dont waste your money just because its the only dumpster dive open!!!!!! At least the bottled coke was good!!! Unbelievable...shithole

Don't bank with these guys. If u try to call the bank you have to leave a message and hope they call u back. They make many many errors and u have to double check everything they do. Even then they often don't do it right after many attempts. Poor service.

We've been going there since it opened. The food is excellent! Really, it is very good food. And the family that owns the establishment are very nice people. But my major complaint is that the lady that runs it tries to do everything and the customer can sit for a very long period of time while she helps people at the counter, answers the phone and takes the orders, speaks in loud Chinese to the cooks, waits on tables and then buses the tables too. Recently, their special chow mien sounded really good so when we were leaving the place we were visiting, I called and ordered food. I was told "10 to 15 minutes" (because I asked) which would be just perfect. It finally was around 45-50 minutes AFTER that time I finally got my to-go order and left fuming for probably the last time. I don't wish those nice people ill, but COME ON! MY TIME IS IMPORTANT TOO!

Our "go to" breakfast restaurant! Love everything I've tried. Their menu is unique choices that you don't find elsewhere. Blackened Salmon Hash, The Great White - which is egg white scramble with chicken, cheese & zucchini. Friendly staff, clean & creative decor.
Excellent food and service. I could eat there every day, but I wouldn't know what to do with all the leftovers (huge portions)..

Won't redo everything Michele R. has so aptly done in her review. Don't think I could anyway, she is in a class of her own here. 

But we find the organic produce is priced more attractively here  than for other stores.

The store is usually very clean and most of the time the help is very friendly and accommodating, especially the Produce guys. Took and washed out the sand and dirt on curly leaf and Romaine lettuce we wanted to buy. 

Like most popular markets, some times or days. it looks like they have not had time to fully restock, but not a big deal. Our favorite store to shop. Too bad I can't give 4.5 stars.

Ordered delivery got right on time 
Salad was outstanding. Pizza wasn't very good at all dry and little toppings. Asked for extra sauce and didn't get it at all. Not worth the price just a so so pie.

This restaurant is tucked in behind dickeys barbecue off of Overland, hard to see from the road. Popular place although we didn't have to wait to be seated. We had a very long wait for our food but Worth it, looks like everything is served in bowls large portions really good food.   Good tip as you can substitute toast for their specialty French toast's for a dollar extra.

Went today for the first time. I ordered both the shrimp and the chicken Pha Tai and two orders of spring rolls. The restaurant is very pretty, looks clean, fresh and modern and the hostess/waitress was friendly.

 I got my food to go and started to drive home. Halfway home I realized that there was no aroma coming from the food. It was as if there was no food in the car. I got suspicious of the flavor of the food with no smell coming from it. I don't go out to eat often and when I do, if I spend $40 I want good portions and fresh delicious food. I pulled over and opened the dish and still did not smell anything. It was almost all noodles. There were, count them, 5 bean sprouts, one fourth of a lime and a tiny bit of sad looking peanuts in the corner. No cilantro, no piles of bean sprouts and oh, by the way, good luck finding the meat. There were 4 small shrimp in the one and a small piece of what they were passing off as chicken. The noodles were over cooked, there was almost no sauce and it was tasteless. Absolutely nothing on it that would give any flavor, hence NO good aroma.

Now on to the spring rolls. They looked soggy and floppy like they were made yesterday. However, the resturaunt is not busy. There was NO ONE in there. They have time to make a fresh spring roll. The sauce they gave me had the consistency of water. When I asked what it was she said that the owners don't tell her. 

I will NEVER go back. They offered me something else on the menu but I said no, gave them my food and asked for a refund. I then went to the store, got all of the stuff to make Pha Tai myself and went home and did so. DO NOT GO HERE.

OMG! Best breakfast ever! Food is nothing short of amazing. Our server, Trish, was so nice. Fast, friendly service. The servers all seem so happy and it contributes to a great overall experience. 

Come early. Rain or shine, there will be a line. It's that good.
BEST PIZZA EVERRRRRRRRRR!!!! The cheese pizza, cheesy bread, and sun valley veggie pizza were amazing. High quality ingredients and outstanding customer service.
This is a great place for families and children. They catered to the all the children in our party. We were sat right away & the food was prompt but tasty. TYSM 4 being AWESOME!!!
Yum! They have great food here & it is worth waiting for if need be! Large portions and great service make this a go-to breakfast spot. Give it a try!

I received a Yelp highlights email and this restaurant was rated so highly that my family and I decided to go there for dinner the very same day. We are very happy that we did. We have a few kids who are picky and truthfully mom and dad are picky too. Everyone enjoyed their meals. My husband had the best sashimi appetizer he has ever had. My three-year-old had sweet potato fries and a soda. My daughters shared a California roll dinner which is 18 pieces of California rolls and a miso soup. We ordered a few extra miso soups at 2$ each. I had the vegetable sushi roll which is only on the lunch menu but they said you can also order it for dinner. We also got hot tea and plum wine and lots of soda which were all very good. The special rolls are around $17 each but they present them so cool that they look like dragons and lizards. There was a large group at the restaurant who were celebrating a birthday. the restaurant has a large screen TV in the lobby that they played a happy birthday song on so that the whole restaurant could hear. My kids thought that was super cool. They also have cute little chopstick helpers to put on the chopsticks for young kids. My family was very pleased with our dinner and we will be back again.

Wings used to be a cheap bar food but this was actually the most expensive restaurant we went to in Idaho. At $1.60 per wing(the most economical option), I wouldn't recommend eating here unless you have plenty of money to waste.

I tell you what the last time stepped into a Red Robin was about a decade ago.. and that wasn't by choice. The food was always bad and the pricing always seemed a bit off. 
Wow! What a change! I mean the interior looks a bit like a TGI Fridays but man they ain't fooling around with those burgers! I don't know what happened in the last decade but the food has seriously improved!  
The service is always extremely nice and friendly at this location. The service is also really slow. It takes forever to get a beer or drink (may be a issue with the bar) and that really sets a bad precedent for the meal. When I sit down and give a drink order I should never EVER have to wait 10-15 or sometimes 20 minutes.. that's ridiculous. 
All in all I love these burgers and I will frequent this and other local locations often.. but I may bring a flask haha!

Teriyaki Madness is part of our regular places.  It's close in Meridian, there's options for my wife and lucky me, there's a vegan option. The best part is that our food is always freshly prepared and served hot. 

It seems simple, right!?, hot food hot. As you may know if you're a regular diner, that doesn't always happen.  We have about ten visits under our belt at TM and there hasn't been a time yet where our was wrong or cold. 

I order the Medium bowl with spicy tofu and brown rice with veggies.  

I don't add any of the teriyaki sauce but I have heard that it can be addicting. I can't comment since I am not sure what is in the ingredients and quite frankly don't want any surprises. 

The staff is friendly and they bring your order out to you. 

PRO-TIP: download the app to redeem points and subscribe to thr email.  There are specials and deals fairly consistently.  

I redeemed enough points for 4 free bowls that's equal to $36.  

Their messaging inside on the posters and table tents is kinda fun. 

If you haven't been,  check  it out

We came here for lunch, great experience and a very good price.  If you like a little more heat they will accommodate your request. Friendly service and very attentive service.  I would definitely come back and try some dinner selections.

This place was amazing! Definitely the best Chinese  food I have found in the boise meridian area! Every single thing we tried was fantastic! We did family style so tried a little bit of everything. The only thing I wasn't crazy about were the pockstickers. They weren't bad. I just didn't like the dipping sauce they came in. Other than that. Awesome food! On top of that the waitress and waiter were so friendly and on top of everything!

When we first moved here 2 years ago, we arrived late at night. In the morning nothing for the kitchen was unpacked and we ended up going here. It was exactly what we needed after such a long drive. Everything was delicious and they have great service. We've been going here on and off ever since and would recommend it to anyone!
One of the best breakfast places I have found in meridian. Food has always been excellent and service was amazing will keep coming back.

My wife and I recently purchased a new toy hauler from Kurt Dykstra at Bish's RV in Nampa.  He was friendly and courteous and  knowledgeable about the product answering all our questions.  And after the sale he was able to put me in touch with the service department at the Idaho Falls store -namely Jeff Olson and Chelsea Kelley and they took care of a problem we had after picking up the unit in Nampa and traveling to Rigby.  Both Jeff and Chelsea were so kind and courteous and attentive to our problem.  Shout outs also to Ephrem and Jon at the Nampa store.  Ephrem handled the paperwork at time of sale and was also kind and courteous -Jon was our walk-through guy and did some extra things for us - he was exceptional! All in all a good experience purchasing an RV!

It's with a heavy heart that to had to fire my Dr at Ada West Dermatology  today. Not for anything he did wrong but for the total disrespect for people's health shown by the check-in process and the state of their lobby. Is was like the Lord of the Flies in there. Then when trying to discuss it with the office manager I was told that they were not going to "live in fear". When I tried to explain the science and studies behind why their lobby should be better controlled I was told "oh we're not going to get into that". And then I was told I could take my business elsewhere if I didn't like it. Those poor receptionist are standing shoulder-to-shoulder! One of them didn't even have a mask on while she was talking to some 95 + year old patient! Unacceptable. You're a healthcare organization you can do better.

All this hospital wants is to steal your money, they don't care about your animal. I brought my rabbit in a few weeks ago having digestive issues. They did a fecal test and told me that nothing came back on the test and gave a medication that "should work" (all costing me over $200 for no answers). The medication was just a band aid, it fixed the issue for a week and it came back. I called repeatedly asking to speak to the vet when the issue came back with no answer until the 3rd call. The only response I was given by the receptionist is that they can refill the same medication that didn't work the first time or send the SAME fecal test again to see if different results come back. Of course I didn't come back here and made an appointment with a different vet (most of which are booked out for a few weeks). While waiting for the appointment I made with a different vet my rabbit went into GI stasis and passed away. If the vet had cared to uncover the true issue with my rabbit this all could have been prevented, but all they wanted was more of my money to run the same tests that didn't work the first time. Don't waste your time here they don't care about your animals, they let mine die telling me his issues weren't concerning but now he is gone.

Aright first of all, all I gotta say is this place is incredible. Food is amazing. Just the presentation of the food leaves you in awe. The taste is just the icing on the cake. Absolutely amazing. Also Danny Miller is an absolute gem. Fantastic waitress. I'd suggest everyone give this place a shot. Just wow.

Good overall. NO ALCOHOL of any kind served (just be aware). Seemed that the dishes we had all kind of had the same sauce base and were just a tad on the salty side but that may just be my taste buds. The fried rice was a bit on the bland side. Service was very good and the food served piping hot. I'd give it a 3.5 but the service and piping hot food pushed it up which I don't normally take into account. Might be back again.

11/10 recommend. Everything was delicious from the complimentary bread and oil to the Diet Coke. IYKYK. We got the stuffed mushrooms with peppers, lasagna, tortellini and butter squash ravioli and added pancetta per the servers recommendation. It was all so good and unique! The environment was great too whether for date night or family dinner. Loved! Can't wait to go back.

If it was possible to give zero stars I would have. after we signed the contract, where we had minimal changes to the floor plan, it took them two months to get the plans redrawn and submitted to the city. When we asked what the delay was they claimed that the architect was on vacation for a couple of months and hadn't got the plans redrawn. Once they said they had submitted the plans, I called the city and found out that was not the truth. Anything that you get signed for, changes or anything else, Make sure you get it signed and notarized as they will deny everything as soon as the contract is signed. We had problems with many things during construction. One of the things they did is that they put the fireplace in the wrong room. Anothet was, after it took them forever to get the siding done, I had to remind them that the siding on the front was supposed to be stonework. Their reply was " good catch ". They then installed the wrong fireplace and we had to have them come out and remove the incorrect fireplace and replace it with the one that we had paid an extra for, which we were fortunate to have had written on the contract. We were told " this is the fireplace we put in all our houses ". To which I replied "maybe but it's not the one I paid for". We've been in the house close to a year now we still have an exhaust fan in the master bathroom that does not function at all; (they had put the wrong tile in the whole house and had to replace it so that we had bullnose tile) and when they did so they smeared something odd in the walk-in shower. They haven't been able to get this off of the tile. so we still have the tile issue as well as the exhaust fan. When they came and replaced the fireplace with the correct one, they had to remove the electronic off on switch for the electric fireplace because the wood burning fireplace doesn't need it. The patch and the hole are still in the wall in the family room. I can't tell you how many times they would say that they would meet us on the job site to look at stuff and no one would be there for hours after our appointment time.

Had dinner here and really enjoyed the location and food. Our waiter took good care of us. I will say, the food seamed a bit pricey but everything was very good. Parking area is small so be prepared to walk a bit if nothing is available near the restaurant.

Great restaurant! The service is always very attentive and friendly. The food is delicious and consistent. The menu has a good variety of sushi and other traditional Japanese dishes. My favorites are the Sukiyaki and Tonkatsu!

Quick, fast service and pretty good pizza. We felt like needed to season with bit of salt (unusual for us but..). It passed the folding test, folded in half easily. Great mozz cheese.  We had 30 minutes to get to movie,  they were quick to get us in & out!

Love love LOVE Fujiyama!!!! The staff is always friendly and attentive. Their sushi chefs are AMAZING! They make anything and anything, even if it is not on their menu. I am a HUGE fan of their Eastern Dragon and spicy scallop handroll. My sister ALWAYS gets one of their signature pokes. My children can be picky so the bento boxes are perfect for those stubborn turds. 

I come here at least once a week for lunch with my sister! Shhh.. don't tell my husband

A friend and I met for dinner at Gino's this week. The service was good and the food was amazing! I think I've found my new favorite Italian spot. The pasta was fresh and flavorful. The wine was tasty too! I would definitely recommend. We will be back soon!

I desperately want to give Costa Vida a higher score but I don't think that it would be an honest review. 

To start off I've been going to Costa Vida for almost 3 years now. I've tried many of the dishes and have a good idea on what I like here. The location is clean and lively. It can get loud so conversations might be difficult. TVs show b-roll of the same surfing montages. Bathrooms are generally clean. 

Let's get down to the actual stuff we care about. Costa Vida can either be described as Mexican or Tex mex. Both would be appropriate. The main problems is also costas strongest aspect. The sweet pork is amazing. One of the best meats I've had. The other 2 options feel dry and bland. I feel like the only meat selection is sweet pork. Most the dishes are similar. The salads give you the biggest variety in textures. 

After the meal costa has a bad habit of sitting in your belly like a big ball of uncomfortableness. 

Deserts are fine. I recommend the cinnamon tortilla.

There seems to be more and more yogurt options around town these days.  All in all, each one is pretty similar to the next.  Basically you grab a bowl and peruse the different yogurt options.  If you would like to sample a flavor and employee will serve you a small cup of however many flavors you would like.  You choose your flavor(s) and then run down their array of toppings (fruit, candy, brownies, cookies, syrups you name it).  Then you put it on a scale and charge you based on how much it weighs.

Great concept, but seriously dangerous!  I mean you could easily end up with a $10 dessert if you aren't careful.  The cup size they give you is one size fits all, so it's so easy to overfill with out having any real concept of how much you've just swirled into your bowl.  It also is easy to choose too many toppings adding the weight on quickly.

The store is also clean and there is always a great selection of flavor options.  I do like this particular location, as they offer a chocolate sorbet.  I tend to find most places only have fruity sorbets options, which are good, but even those that limit their dairy intake love us some chocolate!  :)

They do offer a frequent buyer card, so if you visit enough you can earn yourself a free treat.  They also have a yelp offer, giving you a discount on your order if you check in!!

Stumbled upon Gandolfo's on my way home from work one day. Saw the drive-through and quickly pulled in. I was excited to see they had corned beef on rye: the sandwich I have been looking for since moving to the area. I was pleasantly surprised! The corned beef was delicious and the marble rye was good (I have yet to find a great rye bread in the valley). The only negative is that the menu did not mention cheese and there was cheese on the sandwich. A proper corned beef on rye does not include cheese. :)  If the bread were a bit softer and more authentic rye (and ditch the cheese), it would be the perfect sandwich.

I hadn't had a massage in about four months when I found Vonnie and decided to give it a try. She was very welcoming as soon as I walked in the door and comfort was a priority for the entire visit. The massage room was clean, warm, and welcoming and the massage itself was absolutely divine. I can not decide if my body feels more like a wet noodle or like it's floating on a cloud but my muscles feel loose and relaxed. It was definitely a much needed hour and a half of self-care and I will be booking with Vonnie again!

My boyfriend and I went in here for him to get a haircut. The immediate response was that the barbers were very cocky and they did not come off as friendly. We asked for a regular cut and they charged us $20. The haircut turned out nice however they trimmed his eyebrows without asking him and they somehow managed to cut his eyelashes off one eye. I don't know the exact man that did the job but the entire environment wasn't welcoming and neither of us are pleased with the surprise cuts.

My wife and I have been receiving massages for years and recently moved to the area. Needless to say we were a little apprehensive about starting over with someone completely new. After researching thoroughly we tried Blissful Massage. Both of us were a wreck from the stress of moving and moving in so we were both in pretty bad shape. Vonnie was absolutely amazing and completely professional. Her techniques really work and it was probably the best massage I've ever had and I have had many. Vonnie spent extra time with each of us and even spent time giving me some exercises to do at home to help with stretching. Vonnie is fantastic and we're both going back at least once a month. Only selected five stars because there wasn't six or seven.

RELIABLE. RESPONSIVE. PROFESSIONAL.
I would highly recommend Eric and his crew.  He is thorough and pays attention to details.  I hired him for an interior and exterior paint job for my rental.  He went through the whole house and made necessary repairs (damaged window sill, broken siding, cut out drywall...to name a few) before painting.  He finished on time and the place looks like a new house.  He also went the extra mile to help me replace the kitchen counter, smoke detectors, linoleum flooring, window blinds and many more.  He can do it all...he took care of everything for me.  He's courteous and always gives me updates on his progress.  I would definitely hire him again and again because he's dependable and gets the job done.

The service was great, friendly, efficient, and some of the best we have had in Boise. The food  good, served hot and out quickly, the restaurant clean, but the manager was rude. We tried using a groupon  twice, once with a soccer team wanting take out, a huge order and the manager said we couldn't use a $20 groupon, by the way we paid $11 it wasn't free, but a low discount for a big order. So we decided we would try it for lunch. They had a special which we ordered three plus $20 from the main menu,  after the meal, the  manager refused again, not politely may I a add, he ask if I understood him! He ask  if we knew coming in there was a special I said yes and stated we ordered from the main menu also! Not an apology, not even I hope to see you back, just a smug, contrite, manager refusing the groupon, not focused on the customer or the big picture. Will we have our Christmas party at Johnny Carino's- no, Did he cost the company money on the soccer meal- sure did 14 players and family, Rude to a nice family having lunch- he was and we will not be back, giving the groupon  away with a warning, could have been a great way to try the restaurant, but not worth saving a few dollars.

Excellent
The Irish Benedict with its grilled onions and corned beef topped with their oh so tasty Hollandaise sauce is perfection. I ordered it with the fruit instead of potatoes and they don't mess around, the serving size was generous to say the least and filled with good stuff like blackberries blueberries cantaloupe and strawberries. 

The cinnamon roll was soft and scrumptious topped with a generous amount of their homemade icing.

The BLT was also a hit served on a lightly toasted super soft bun.

OJ, fresh squeezed and delicious

Went to this place when it opened and I never got my food because they were so busy, I walked out after an hour and a half having not received my food. So I walked out. However, this trip was an incredible redemption story, that truly deserves a 5 star review. The staff was on point and fast, and the food.... Oh my goodness it is delicious. This is a must try.
This place was so good. They have such an amazing breakfast. You get so much food. It is a new breakfast place that made it on my top choice to go out to eat.

Service was SLOW. Took an hour and a half to get appetizers, which were meh. I felt the appetizers and entrees were over priced for what served. I wasn't impressed, and doubt I'd go back. Our waiter, and the hostess were polite, friendly, and professional though

The sweetest girls work here. We went three times during our visit from CA. The coffee is so so good! We tried the iced vanilla latte, Carmel blonde, cinnamon latte, and hazelnut latte. Lol yes we went a few times like I said! My favorite was the blonde half sweet hot! 
Second would be iced vanilla latte. 
Oh we also got a kids smoothie and it didn't disappoint our little one! 
I am obsessed and can't wait to come back and try more fantastic drinks. 
Thanks!
Great service, huge portions, beautiful atmosphere! The wait to get in is often very long, but that just shows how good the place is.

While everything did not go perfectly and the timing was definitely off, the end result is good and there was one person that really made everything right. Dave Wilkens was a star. He apologized for the error and then made it right, quickly and efficiently. He was professional and hospitable. Thank you Dave for doing a great job. We really like our shutters! If you are going to use Blind Source, ask for Dave.

Worst Customer Service experience EVER.  Do not do business here. Promotions are promised, not followed thru.  WATCH YOUR PAPERWORK CLOSELY BEFORE YOU SIGN ANYTHING. Store manager Allen challenges us as a customer as to what actually happened even after speaking with his employee who claims they "don't remember".  Not a single effort to make right what was clearly done wrong. Will never do business with these people again. You are better off calling Customer Service and doing your transactions over the phone on a recorded line. What a joke. I have never written a negative review in my life...we were completely duped on this one. STEER CLEAR OF GO WIRELESS.

I have never had good experiences with Walgreens and have always chosen to go elsewhere. But I thought I'd give you them one last chance. Fail. This is the slowest pharmacy I have ever been to. I waited in line for 30 minutes only to be told that my prescription that I was told was ready, was not. I was told it would take 30 min to fill. When I came back later in the day, I had to wait an additional 45 minutes. There wasn't a long line ahead of me, they just move at a glacial pace. I'm not sure if they are playing chess or napping, but they are definitely taking their sweet time to do their jobs.

Sometimes things just don't work out.  We've been trying to get to Red Pavilion for more than a year and last night it felt like the stars were aligned.  It was a busy Wednesday night but we were seated promptly and thr hot tea was very promising but alas it went all down hill from there. Our server was new but cheerful and enthusiastic but somewhere during the order processing and the delivery of our meal things fell apart.  My wife ordered a combo and I ordered a Tofu dish. I needed to know if there were any animal or milk products in my dish. Our sever checked and gave us the okay.  We also ordered an appetizer of spring rolls where also deemed vegan safe.  After that there was a considered about of time that went by. Two other tables, a two top, who seemed to be regular customers were attended to very quickly and received their soup and salad very quickly. The four top had already several dishes delivered. Their last dish, a sizzling plate of meat arrived and the folks in Kuna could have heard it.  We received a salad bowl of Wonton chips and Sweet and Sour sauce.  Neither bowl or ramekin matched the restaurants decor and looked like 'emergency dishes' to placate diners who were waiting.  While I appreciate the effort, it was never explained why we received the chips or why there was a delay for our order. Our spring rolls arrived and they were hot and moments later my Tofu bowl arrived.  The picture is attached. I am not sure what to call this. It had massive amounts of Tofu and seemed like a soup. I did ask for it to be spicy but it was not spicy.  The worst part was that my Tofu dish was barely warm and in some parts of the bowl, it was cold. My brown rice didn't look fresh. My wife's combo plate was severely lacking and it was barely warm.  We did have to ask for silverware and we trudged through our dinner feeling underwhelmed.  We didn't take anything home and paid the $40 dollar bill and left.  

I don't know what happened but I have two working hypotheses. 

1. The customization of my dish to be vegan was not welcomed in the kitchen and we were instantly known as 'those people'  

2. We stood out since we were not regular customers and the regular customers received preferential treatment. 

I don't know and rather don't care at this point what was the reason, we felt like we were not welcomed and we'll choose to go elsewhere for $40. 

I want to be clear that my wife and I have over 70 years of restaurant experience between the both of us and most of that was in leadership roles so when we know, we know. 

I wish Red Pavilion all the best in the community just don't expect my wife and I to be back.

Trendy, modern coffee bar with pretty unique decor and amazing atmosphere. The staff is very kind and quite friendly. 

I always order my typical small vanilla latte and every now and then will try one of their pastries. In my experience, they typically run out of pastries once it gets busy in the afternoon but that doesn't take away from the fact that customers still swarm in for a little boost me up. 

I really like their benches and furniture. Extremely elegant and has that brand new feel. Lets not forget about their cool swag and merchandise which is definitely on par with the trendy styles and outfits in today's culture. 

By the way, their background music selections ranges from "Livin' on a Prayer" by Bon Jovi to "24K Magic" by Bruno Mars, just a little bit of everything for all generations! 

Every now and then when the weather gets hot, flies can get inside and can be quite annoying. Not sure what the store can do to remedy this but it's good to be aware. Parking is a bit tricky but simply follow the signs and you'll be alright. 

Honestly, this is a trendy spot I recommend everyone should come try!
Interesting food.. It's really not Hawaiian vs Caribbean.. no spam, no saimen etc.

They can't even make appointments correctly.  I called to talk to them earlier this week and they locally cannot make their own appointments.  I called again and tried to get them to come out on doing 3 bathrooms.  They asked it it was insurance and I am dealing with insurance on ONE of the bathroom but told them I was not asking them to deal with the insurance company.  The gentleman then said he was not sure they could help me.  If you can't figure out how to take a check, I don't want you doing work on my home.

As of May/June 2021 you'll probably have to wait 4-6 weeks for your turn on his "list" but he is responsive via texts and keeps you updated. Did an overall nice job. He was able to match up the mold of some other curbing that he didn't originally do. Others that I called didn't seem to need the business and didn't even return calls. Concrete curbing might be a good business to start as he seems to be the only game in the Boise area that can respond and produce work.

I went to Grimaldi's to get and AND ENJOY my free birthday pizza.  They have one of the best birthday programs around - free 1-topping pizza - when you sign up for their emails and they don't send many, but you get the one a week before your birthday to come in for the pizza.  And it's the normal, big pizza that can feed 3+ people.

I was going to knock them on the delay because it seemed like it took a while to get our food, but the place was relatively full with one large party and another larger party.  Our waitress was pleasant and attentive enough.

I ordered my 1-topping birthday pizza - meatball - and it was delicious, and well worth the wait.  We were seated right in front of where they make the pizzas so we know they weren't just standing around doing nothing.  The pizza is wood-fired, so it's got that crunchy crust and some charring on the bottom, but not so much that you get that burnt taste; they do it just right.  The cheese doesn't appear to be abundant, but it really is - and the meatballs are just the right, delicious amount too.  

We also ordered the Caesar salad to share (me and my daughter) and it was gigantic.  Just a ton of salad packed in to that bowl with the right amount of dressing, croutons, and shaved parmesan on top.  It was $12, and we had enough for ourselves first and seconds, and then we took home 2 boxes, each with pizza and salad for our family to enjoy.

It's really good pizza at a good location at the Village at Meridian close to parking and the center where you can people watch and see the fountains.  We'll continue to be Grimaldi's fans.

Hands down our go to spot for froyo!

I have no clue how others say they pay less at other places, where you pay by weight. Unless....maybe you don't like to add lots of toppings?!? 

In the case of my family,  we LOVE our toppings! It's so nice to give my kids a cup and tell them pick whatever you like, and not have to cross my fingers that they won't load up on a pound of gummy worms and cookies. 

They have a great variety of flavor options and I feel their topping selection is not too shabby; considering it's a flat rate. I like the overall taste of it, too.

This place is a total win for my family! We come often enough, we already accumulated enough credits with their rewards system to pay for our last outing all together. BOOM!

This is a review for June 21/2021. We came here to start off the day for my birthday. We seated ourselves as the sign said which is totally fine. Our waitress brought our menus and drinks right away, great. Then we sat...and sat...and sat... watching our waitress and other waitresses serve the other patrons. Tables that showed up after us got their orders taken and we just sat there waiting. We gave them 25 minutes and I even made eye contact with multiple waitresses several times. We were never served. We got up and left and as we were leaving multiple waitresses told us have a good day. We were very upset. Not coming back.

I would not recommend this property management to anyone. My experience with them was a very negative. They falsely advertised several items on their site. They admitted to knowing about the mistake, however did not mention it when we talked about taking the property. The owner was not sympathetic in the ordeal and essentially shrugged his shoulders at their mistake and continued to hold the deposit. After a month of back and forth with the owner, we finally got most of our money back. He started by saying the entire deposit was non-refundable, then $200 was non-refundable, finally $75 was non-refundable. We went on to rent through a different property management and it was a much more pleasant experience. Please, please, please go elsewhere if you want to avoid headaches.
This  place exceeded  my expectations. Everything was beyond delicious . Staff was friendly . Definitely recommend if you are a pasta lover .

DIRTY! When you go there just look at it with your own eyes. Trash in the landscape around the restaurant. The floors inside are filthy. As soon as you step in the restaurant look straight down at the carpets then take another couple of steps, look at the floors. Broken crayons, food, and bits of paper and trash all over. Absolutely filthy floors! Then look under the tables and the tables around you. Multiple tables had the old dirty dishes from customers who left and actual food on the floors. Disgusting. This review should be for the health department not shutting this place down. Ok last but not least, what's up with the angry teen male they have sitting people. Both times I've went here there is a rude angry teenager sitting people. No greeting, no hello, no come this way your seats right here. It was this angry young dude grabbing menus and walking off. By the way if your new to this place you are supposed to follow the emotional angry teenager to your table. My question is, who's the manager?why hasn't the health department shut this place down, why hasn't Red Robin's corporate sent a person to see this????

Geez, this is getting to be a once a week treat. 

Tonight, they had asparagus on the special menu and they cooked it for us in a traditional manner, stir fried with pork and fermented black bean seasoning. Don't know how they would do it for others, but the black bean seasoning is most traditional. The asparagus were tender and not tough.  Another thing I noticed that adds to their authenticity, is that they know how to slice the veggies so they are not huge or uneven sized. You can tell a good Chinese wok cook who keeps his veggies small, for quick and even stir frying, and does not let his dish swim in excessive sauce. Compare the dishes at other places and you will see the difference.

This time they also served us family style with chop sticks and rice bowls, no plates. Had the Salt and Pepper Prawns which we also excellent. Finished up with the Jin Duis again.

As it was a Saturday night, the place was hopping. Glad to see it. I predicted a long time ago that all it would take is one good Chinese and authentic restaurant in the area and it would be a great success. I think they are proving this.

So first , let me say that Luis, Jen and Trace were awesome, professional and accommodating. There were four of us there for dinner yesterday at 5:30. First, they accommodated my request to sit where the A/C was not blowing directly on me. I have fibromyalgia snd the cold is very debilitating for me. I ordered the ribeye with mashed potatoes, and broccoli (w/ an add on of shrimp for $1 more.) They had gotten really busy and when we got served, everybody else had great looking food but somehow my steak was scrawny and over- cooked. I proceeded to eat my shrimp while I waited for Luis, our waiter to return. He came by snd was so apologetic since I had ordered medium rare. He took the steak back and I continued eating my shrimp and some of my potatoes snd broccoli. I took a little while but to my surprise, he came back with a second complete plate. Jen came over to check on things snd this ribeye was perfect. I had finished my other potatoes and broccoli as well as my shrimp, then out comes Trace bringing me fresh shrimp. I told him I had already eaten the other ones snd he said. That's Okay! Enjoy!  I will definitely go back often. It was so nice that they valued us and gave their best even though I had only asked to have my steak replaced. I will definitely go back for another steak ( oh...if you haven't tried it, the chicken bowl is healthy and great also.

Thanks again, Luis, Jen snd Trace!!! See you soon!

Last January, I purchased a spa and was told it would take just a few weeks to get it in. I called after 3 weeks and was told it would be in soon. Long story short, I didn't receive the spa until 2 months after I paid/ordered it!! They gave no apology and no reason for the delay. Recently, I went in to get a filter and was told I could order it and it would be in the next week. I went ahead and paid for it and now it's been two weeks, no filter. I called today and was told it was being ordered today. What kind of customer service is this?? I will not be going back, ever!

I would not recommend this place. I wound up having to go back three times in a two-week period. The first time the gel nail polish bubbled.  The second time the gel polish just peeled off. When I went in today to get that one nail repaired instead of telling me it was going to take quite a while because they were busy they just let me sit there for 30 minutes. They DID tell other people who walked in to come back later.  So I of course figured I would be next soon. They never told me could you come back later. They just let me sit there thinking that I would be next. 

When another person came in and they took her, I left! Not a good business practice. I would never go back. They were almost rude.  I did call a few minutes later and asked TOMMY if he could do the nail repair (my husband and I had gone there for years)  if I came back and he said "NO I am busy.  You didn't call first so you have to wait.  Come back later".  I asked him why he didn't tell me that instead of letting me just sit there and he said "You call first". 
YIKES..
Camp Bow Wow is the place to bring your fur friend. Its clean, well staffed, and my dog gets really excited when she knows she's going there. It is also affordable for a whole day, or half day stay.

We had Alex Hood sell is a plan and two, yes two high end phones. The deal was but one, get one and get two $200 gift cards. He have us a receipt that did not show everything and was lacking clarity due to lack of ink in printer he told us to wait to bring our old phones in for two weeks and if we wanted to return the cases we got, to do that before 14 days. We were very clear on the tips he have us. WHAT HE FAILED TO TELL US, was that you had to read your receipt, find the code and enter on the web site before a certain date to get the two $200 gift cards. HE NEVER SAID THAT, or we would have done that right away, as soon as we got in the car. We would have jumped on the site and entered necessary items from receipt. HE NEVER TOLD US THAT IS WHAT WAS NEEDED. He only said, it would take six weeks to get cards. So we waited. Called and found out we missed the date and Verizon could not help us. We visited the store and Alex, got all kinds of promises that he would send in a request for the cards, explain what happened and keep us in the loop. THAT NEVER HAPPENED EITHER!!! Never sent me emails on the progress of the request. We called Verizon four times. They will credit our bill $200!!!! WRONG ANSWER. DO NOT USE VERIZON STORE IN MERIDIAN IDAHO AND DO NOT TRUST VERIZON!!!! I'M DO MAD. WE were with Sprint 16 years but had horrible connection service, so we switched. Totally regret!!!! Thanks ALEX!!!!!

Gino drew us in with his biography. My family is also from southern Italy, and we have yet to find really good Italian food in the valley. 
I started with a Negroni, which was perfect. The focaccia was the beat I have ever tasted. So light and fluffy, and perfect with the garlic and olive oil dip. Unfortunately, that's where the perfection ended. I ordered veal piccata, and my hubs ordered chicken parm. The beal was cooked nicely but didn't have much flavor. The "piccata" of the dish was bland and very oily. I didn't taste lemon, garlic, or capers. Not even salt and pepper. I didn't taste the chicken parm because the thick, heavy slab of cheese on top was too much for me to bear. 
Maybe next time we will go for cocktails and give the dessert menu a try. We usually give a new place two tries, so if we go back we will go for two different entrees. I am hoping we just ordered the wrong thing.

"Who'd a thunk it?", my Italian-American-Brooklyn-Born and Italian neighborhood raised hubby asked mid way through a delightful evening at Gino's.  "A 'from the neighborhood' Italian restaurant in Meridian, Idaho."

We entered skeptics given the location. We left fans of the friendly greeting, "all people are welcome" vibe, stellar service and delicious food.

VIBE & SEATING:  Old school neighborhood interior. Red tablecloths over black. Soft lighting. Perfect dinner music at a low enough level to invite conversation. Windows on the side wall. Sparkly lights against one wall. 

The restaurant is all standard height table seating (that works for all diners) and enough spread out to be comfortable. Sadly, the bar is all high perch tables (which MS prevents me from boosting up on to).

The folks dining at Gino's on this night (almost a full house on a Tuesday) were mostly locals to include people of all ages and walks of life.  From families with small children, to people in work duds suggesting a farming life, to people in business attire, to couples in dress up, to jeans and sweaters like us.

Gino, who greeted customers at the door and stopped by the tables, has a hint of an accent suggesting New York as one time home.  (Turns out, he is originally from Naples and made his way to Boise via some time in Brooklyn.)

SERVICE:  Lara, our server, and Sara, her assistant, were a stellar team. Lara knew the menu well and could answer questions. She advised my hubby when he was torn between two different Italian wine options.  Lara paced food delivery perfectly. Sara was on the spot for offering freshly grated cheese or black pepper and kept our water glasses full.  Both women struck the just right, gracious balance between friendly and professional.

MENU & FOOD: The menu is multi page, from soups and salads, to antipasti, to pasta and risotto, to specialty classic baked options like eggplant parmesan, to grilled and braised meat dishes, to fish and seafood, to vegetable sides, to pizza.  There were options that would work for omnivores and vegetarians. Prices range from about $6 to $25.

Our choices:

*Fresh fish special was expertly grilled and served with delicious roasted red bell peppers and mushroom risotto.

*Braised lamb shank served with gnocchi.

Both meal entrees included salad with house made dressing and with low prices for this high quality at only $25 each.  

We chose cannoli @ $5.50 to share for dessert; house made and with shells filled just before arriving at the table.  Save room!

LIBATIONS:  Large and well crafted wine list with bottles and glasses at reasonable prices and tilting Italian -  as it should.  Also a full bar and specialty cocktails. Hubby enjoyed Italian red @$8 / glass for generous pour and I had a luscious Sgroppino (persecco, vodka, housemade lemon sorbetto and fresh mint) @$9. After dinner espresso @$3.

VALUE:  Wonderful meal for two, including libations, salads, entrees, dessert and espresso clocked in only @$76.50 before tax. Had we selected pasta options, our bill would likely have been around $55 and if pizza, even less than that. Affordable for everyone depending on choices. 

THIS N THAT

1) PREVIOUS LOCATION: Gino's was once in downtown Boise. He moved his restaurant to this Meridian strip mall about five years ago we learned. Smart that was, given how much the area here is growing with neighbors who need to eat! 

2) PARKING: In the strip mall lot. There are wo entry doors into Gino's from the lot. Take the one to the right, not the one marked "deli".
 
3) ACCESSIBILITY: Level in restaurant and throughout with standard height table seating. Accessible loo.  No accessible height seating in bar, unfortunately.

Service department is very expensive! Repeated calls to both service manager and general manager are not returned.  They are "unavailable " when you call. They simply don't, or won't discuss anything. Just wanted to discuss what I think is an excessive charge.  Once they got my money they simply ignore any complaints or discussion.

I took my 12 year old Pomeranian-sheltie mix here yesterday for a wellness check and to make sure she's healthy enough for teeth cleaning.  She's in great shape so the cleaning has been scheduled for next week.

Lucy is a bit of a chicken when it comes to new smells at vet offices.  I've never seen her so calm at a vets office before.  At one point she actually snoozed on the floor! What?!  I love that she's so calm here.  It means a lot to me that she isn't terrified like all the other vets she's been to.

I'm welcoming a new pup into my family mid November and I also need to make sure Lucy won't pass anything on to a new pup.  And baby Finn will begin his life with me in good hands at Intermountain Vet Hosp for his future veterinarian needs. So glad I found such an awesome vet!

Always slow. Decide to close on random days and then don't turn off the drive thru or put closed signs out so you are waisting your time waiting for someone to take your order when the restaurant is closed.

I have never been so disgusted with someone's behavior. My 6 year daughter and I were shopping for her baby sister and needed help so a very nice young lady was helping us when her coworker came up and introrupted me to yell at this young girl and was using VERY foul words. I asked her to not talk like that infront of my daughter and she LITERALLY told me that as a customer I have no say in how she treats her employees. I made a complaint and found out her name is Char and I truly hope that she gets in some sort of trouble because that was not ok and I will not be coming back. Disgusting

Do not put money into this credit union.  When your family die they withhold any social security money illegally.  This just happened to a friend of ours and he could not get the money out to pay for his mother's burial expenses.  Use any other company in Charleston over these morons

I went into the Meridian Verizon store on Eagle road at 3pm on Sunday to purchase a new phone for my son. There were two employees not helping anyone, most likely they were waiting for late appointments. 
I was told by the check in person that I could wait, but there was no guarantee that I would be helped because the store closes at four. So they passed up a cash sale for a phone because of not wanting to possibly work after 4pm? Is the franchise owner aware of these policies? That's poor business ethics in my book. 
The Meridian Verizon eagle road store has lost a customer and hopefully more after reading my post.

We went to Rudy's for our first time on a Monday evening around 6PM. They were already getting busy. The Waitress was nice and efficient. The bussing of the table was efficient. The beer I had from the tap was cold. That is "the good". Now for the "so-so"....I had the $15 BBQ brisket sandwich. It came on a humongous focaccia bread. It was so big that I had to use a fork to try to eat it. There is no way anyone can get their mouth around it. It was lukewarm and the cheese was not melted. Furthermore, the brisket was super fatty...I mean mostly fat than meat and was sliced thin as if it came pre-packaged. The BBQ sauce was so over-the-top sweet like it was mostly honey. The onion rings were pretty good as was the dipping sauce for them. My wife ordered a hamburger and fries. Her comment was "it reminds me of a Disneyland burger". Nuff sed. The place was lively by 7PM and it was obvious that most people were return customers so perhaps there are other menu items bringing in the crowd. As for us, we won't be back. Life is short and many eateries to be explored.

We were big fans of the old Wingers location in Meridian and were sad when it closed.  When we learned they would re-open at the former Cheerleaders site in Meridian, we were excited.  I believe they only opened on May 1, so when we went it had only been a few days.  Often it takes a while to "work the bugs out" so we hope things will improve.  

The good - Great location, nice décor and far more room than the old location.  

The bad - The wait was over 20 minutes (on a Thursday night?) which was puzzling as they had plenty of empty tables.  Once seated, the waitress was prompt and pleasant and took our orders, simple stuff, a couple of burgers.  And then we waited, and waited.  It was now later and most of the peak crowd had gone so this was puzzling.  

Finally when the meal came, we wondered if the cook had paid any attention to the order.  Asked for swiss on a burger and it had cheddar.  Wanted the burger well-done, no pink, and it was closer to medium with pink.  The old Wingers was noted for it's juicy, saucy, even sloppy burgers and these were pretty plain and dry.  

Bottom line - we liked the old Wingers so much we want to believe things will improve.  We like the new location, but management needs to tune the service and the food to better resemble the "good old days" at the former Fairview Rd in Meridian location.

I will try to make this a short review so people will read the whole thing. It is very much the same review the table on either side of me this night may have written. So maybe take this one as a times three.

I would like to call this review, the good, the bad and the smelly! 

My wife and I stopped in Friday night for pizza.  Having been to Grimaldi's before I knew what to expect out of the pizza. Not really my favorite Kind of pizza, you know, with the thin cracker like crust but I knew what I was getting into there.  

The good. Although it wasn't exactly the flavor I expected when I ordered, The pizza had pretty good flavor. You could taste the mushroom a little bit.

The bad.  It became clear after being in the restaurant for only a short time nearly every employee was either preoccupied or just did not have their head in the game. The The hostesses were confused by their job, clearly not knowing when or where to seat people even though it was not a busy night.
We heard servers apologizing all around us. A common quote from the servers, was "oh I'm sorry I forgot".  I even personally got an apology. When I decided to order a beer before the pizza came. I just flagged down our server or really just waved my hand a bit as he was sitting behind the bar watching TV and we were at a high top next to the bar. He came over quickly once he saw me and asked what he could do for me. I ordered a beer. As the server walked away, I believe he stopped at another table for a second and then went behind the bar again. I watched him as he poured a beer then gave it to the person on the other side of the bar. At this point he sat back down for some more TV.  After a few minutes (I think I waited for commercial so I wouldn't bother him) I started to walk towards where he was sitting and when he saw me he met me halfway. I asked him if he was going to get me a beer. He told me he had and then looked at my table and said "oh I'm sorry I forgot". 
The pizza did not take an extremely long time to come. That was excellent. Knowing that Grimaldi's pizza is more like a cracker, one of the extra toppings I ordered and paid for was extra cheese (just trying to give the cracker/pizza a little bit of body). When the pizza came It was hard to tell there was cheese at all. I also ordered the Kalamata olives.I really forgot I ordered olives on this pizza until the last piece when I saw one. But I could taste the mushroom which was very nice.

The smelly.... this part would almost be funny if I didn't have to live through it! Luckily we were nearly done with our pizza when we noticed a sweaty man in sweaty sweat pants and T-shirt laughing and joking and sharing photos or something on his phone with the host and hostess at the front door.  Shortly after noticing this man he made a beeline for what I would assume was "the back of the house". This path took him right past our table wafting us with body odor. I don't mean "just body odor" I mean BODY ODOR!  By the time he made his third trip past us we were just desperate to get our check and leave. As we were walking out I questioned our server as to who that man was. He seemed a bit unsure but said yeah I think he's like an investor or superintendent or owner. He also said yeah he was at the gym. I didn't stick around for much more conversation as I was afraid captain sweatpants might make pass number four. 

All true! And the pizza was OK.
Super refreshing on a hot day, great flavor selection, and the portions are HUGE.  Friendly service to boot.

One rotton apple tries to ruin the bunch!  I LOVE Los Betos.  Eat there at least once a month.  All the OTHER locations are great, my main location is fairview.  But this eagle location customer service SUCKS.  I've only had 2 bad experiences at a Los Betos and both were at the same drive thru almost a year apart.  They charged $4 more than their menu stated and then tell you its your fault.   This time I tried to order my 8yo chips and cheese and they would only sell me $10 steak nachos, which as a couple of 1 star reviews down testifies, tastes like squirrel.  

Move some management from fairview over to Eagle.  They could learn a thing or two.  I'll avoid that location like the plague now.

My husband lives their Cajon Chicken sandwich, so we do to -go at least one or twice a month there.  We finally had a chance to sit down for a lunch date a couple of weeks ago.

The interior decorations seem a bit different than other ones we have been in CA, but it is very nice and cozy.  I like how it doesn't make you feel crowded at all.

Needles to say, husband had his usual Cajon Chicken sandwich and I ordered a special meal combo which I could pick 3 tacos (I remembered I picked the shrimp and fish ones) and it came with freshly baked corn bread and a huge full-size baked potato.  They were delicious!  

The staff members are always friendly and helpful, even when the orders are for to-gos.  We only wish they have one in Boise.

After getting some dismal news from the dealership on needing a new set of tires, I was able to have my car taken in and checked. What was going to be a $1200 small hole turned into a free flat tire repair and a boatload of stress lifted off my shoulders. Service was great, tech showed me the spot and was back on the road in no time.

Loved everything we had  
38 Luck luck*

44 Smokey tempura roll*

Spicy girl


49 Kevin's signature *

And a few others...

Way too much salt on everything :(

The service was great, and the dessert was good, but the food was absolutely salted to the max, disgustingly. If you have a heart condition and eat here, you will probably need to go to the hospital afterwards.

The price of the entrées was reasonable, but the drinks and dessert were ludicrous expensive. The meal for 4, including one glass of wine each, and three desserts, to share, was $160.

Totally recommend Valley Carpet Care. Sean was super friendly, hard working and did a great job on our couches! It was my first time cleaning our couches in two years (YIKES!) and he didn't even bat an eye when he found endless treats underneath our cushions. Haha! Thanks again for a great job! We will totally use his services again in the future!
Friendly staff and excellent service.  As an established patient, I greatly appreciate the ability to view their online appointment calendar and quickly book a time that fits into my busy schedule.

There is a nice ready to eat food counter directly ahead of you once you enter the store. We especially like the sushi counter that always has veggie sushi stocked, but there are lots of choices for grab and go meals. You can also pay at the food counter if you are only buying prepared meals so that you don't have to go across the store to the check out lines. Sometimes we will grab to go lunch at Fred Meyer and then go to a near by park for a picnic if the weather is nice. The food counter has utensils, chopsticks, condiments, napkins, bags, etc so it's very convenient.

When my dog was not feeling well and it lasted a few days, I called a couple vets that were recommended by friends. Both of them did not have openings  any time soon, but both suggested Intermountain. I wanted to avoid a 24-emergency vet since they are so costly, so called Intermountain. They had a cancellation for a slot later that afternoon, so I took it. Dr. Beil did the exam and talked about different tests they could do next. What I liked is that he discussed each test in terms of how costly it could be and the chances of it finding anything given my dog's symptoms. He was transparent by sharing what tests/treatment he thought made more sense. And what the final decision came down to was to start with 3 medicine prescriptions and hold off on any other tests for a few days. So that is what I went with and my dog started feeling better after 24 hours and back to normal in 2 days. Some vets will try to upsell more expensive tests, but my experience here was quite the opposite.

Clean, aesthetically pleasing, friendly employees, and tasty coffee - I can dig it.

I rarely find myself out on this side of town, so I've only stopped in here a few times, but each time I've stopped in I've had a great experience.

I've tried a few of their specialty drinks and have enjoyed those. However, if you're not one for sweet drinks, I'd recommend requesting half the flavor. Or, if you like a strong and robust cup of coffee, go for the drip! It's simple, full of caffeine, and does the job!

Lovely dinner last Saturday night ... food was great, as always, but our wonderful server, Sandra made our dinner more special.  She was very professional, knowledgeable, on-top of it yet relaxed .. great sense of humor ... we're pleased we got her to serve us.  Two at our table had boar shank, and I had the special of clams with a lemon cream sauce w/linguine ... yummy! The caesar salad is huge .. and, delish.  I especially love the tiramisu, and my adult son loved the chocolate mousse ... the birthday spumone was tasty, too! Thanks, Sandra .. and thanks Gino for the great food ... and, hiring such a great gal!  Give her a raise!

I realized my initial review is pretty outdated, so I'll take a moment to update. 

Of the numerous pizza options in the Treasure Valley. Id still say IPC  has some of the best tasting pizza. Additionally,  they are one of the only pizza joints that make a pretty decent gluten free crust. I also enjoy their extensive salad bar.

Pricing is slightly higher than other options, not outrageous but definitely slightly elevated.

On the pizza front, they typically check all the boxes. Occasionally an order gets slightly askew, but they are always apologetic and do their best to make it right.

The deficits at this particular location are the communication and organization at the service counters. I've noticed in the past several months with the increase in to go orders that unfortunately these deficits have only amplified. 

 The pick up area is small and cramped, forcing people to scatter around outside to wait for their pizza. Then the staff gets frustrated when they call out names and no one comes because they can't hear them be called. Then customer gets frustrated at wait and gets back in line to see if pizza is ready. I've also noticed the signage is confusing on where to go to pick up, people aren't 100% sure what to do and then get irritated because there doesn't seem to be a clear,  orderly method. 

Staff is borderline friendly,  but I feel like they are more on the edge of overwhelmed and doing their best to remain positive. 

The estimated wait time for a pizza to be ready seems to be off kilter in the past several months.  I've adjusted how long I wait before driving down, expecting it to take about 10 mins longer than projected and I usually still have to wait another 10-15 on average. On the flip side I can't help but imagine the one time I don't arrive on time, my pizza will have been sitting there waiting.

I guess good pizza comes to those willing to wait! And most the time I prepare myself by trying to order well ahead on when I actually want to eat, and mentally preparing for the pick up experience. When I'm not ready for it all, then I usually have to opt to go elsewhere.

I do love the pizza, but unfortunately sometimes its not worth the experience of getting it. 

I think overall the location just might not be set up properly for the functionality of the restaurant.  Obviously not an easy fix and I'm sure they are all trying to do their best during these times.

Hello deliciousness! MoJo's has the best chicken fried steak I've ever experienced. Flaky, hot, cooked just right! This place is a popular one so anticipate a wait when going during prime time. 

The good news is you can get a great latte next door and bring it in with you when your table is ready. This place is family friendly, comfortable and lively. Services is quick/organized and the coffee pour is strong! Highly recommend!!

If you are hungry, be prepared to pay a lot!  They use clever and deceptive pricing and wording. My "lunch special" was the Real 'Que Sandwich Special for "6.99". I got the brisket and chose potato salad for my 1 side. Tasted fine but tiny sandwich and potato salad came in a tiny bowl. I thought it would be a pretty good sized sandwich and since we didn't want to fork out another 7 - 9 bucks for my husband to get something I told him that I'd split my sandwich with him and order a side of fries. (Normally at other restaurants we go to - this would be plenty to eat for both of us, especially with an appetizer.) BTW--we HAD to order an appetizer because the kids were starving. (no bread to eat while waiting) We got the chicken tenders for $7.99. For that price you'd think you'd get a lot. There were only 5 strips. For a family of 4 and a baby this was definitely not enough. Why don't they serve rolls or bread to snack on while you wait? I don't know. Our favorite restaurants all have free bread or rolls. Son got the platter and combo special. He got St. Louis Style Ribs for $7.49. He only got 3 ribs and wanted more. But I guess his was the best deal because he got a corn muffin (was really good, corn on the cob (he didn't like it and he loves corn), AND 1 side. Service was good and I thought the food was pretty good but definitely too expensive for what you get. I've never complained about small portions at a restaurant ever in my life so what we got or lack of really shocked me. Don't think we'll be going back.

Ryan is seriously awesome!!  I tend to be a bit neurotic and I want my sandwich to have the same amount of meat, cheese, & toppings in each bite. Generally, that means that once I get home I have to take apart and reconstruct my sandwich. Well, not today! Ryan takes pride in making sandwiches that look and taste great.  He took his time and was really friendly too! Ryan should be a trainer! If all of Subways "sandwich artists" were like Ryan, I would be a very happy girl!
Excellent, knowledgeable service.  Full staff is friendly, professional and kind. Thank you for being our neighborhood Vet.

Lately, or is it just me, it seems like Fred's is going downwards. More likely, being "Krogerized ". Lots of missing items they used to carry and less choice. If you don't like their private brands, you are going to notice it when you want a certain brand of ice cream or type of Nancy's yogurt. This has been happening more and more lately. If Kroger's is trying to cut it's way to more profits by cheapening what Fred's built up, then they deserve to lose the business. 

Also, it seems like they are having trouble keeping help. Almost all of our favorite employees have disappeared. Did they get hired away by Albertsons for the soon to be opened Meridian store? Which, I must admit that I am looking forward to.

I had been very disappointed to not find good Chinese food in Boise. Well, that is all over now. Red Pavilion can hold with the better restaurants in Alhambra, San Gabriel and Irvine CA. They know their clientele at Red Pavilion, so two menus are available.
