The first is their main menu, with popular dishes found in your normal Chinese restaurant such as Sweet and Sour Pork, called Ruby Red Pork, Kung Pao Chicken and Honey Walnut Shrimp. the second menu is geared more towards authentic, non-Americanized dishes and should be requested by any one who likes interesting dishes. either way, though, the flavors are spot-on and the quality high.
Complimentary won ton crispy chips with a sweet and sour sauce for dipping began the meal.The War Won Ton soup was unusual but delicious. Instead of the usual pork and chicken based soup, this used a beef broth, chock full of veggies, beef, chicken and shrimp. The won tons were obviously handmade and had a nice texture to the noodle combined with a flavorful stuffing. The main dishes were both excellent. Beef Chow Fun was a surprise, the handmade noodle were hand cut just like at 101 Noodle Express, with great texture. The beef was generous and the sauce tasty, with the waitress suggesting it spicy, an excellent option. 
The final course was from the special menu. It was fish Filet with Pickled Vegetable. This was definitely not a dish I had expected to see here, usually only found in the "real" restaurants in LA and SF. It was delicious, the slightly spicy broth filled with tender fish filets, pickled Chinese vegetable and tofu squares. Spooned into a bowl over white rice, it was a dish that was worthy of ordering again and again.
Red Pavilion has definitely filled a void in Boise cuisine. The service was great, with attentive and friendly waitstaff. It is nice to find a place that can be depended on to make quality Chinese food, fresh and with authentic flavors.
My insurance 100% covered my visit but they did not check it correctly and instead charged me $350 and won't refund me until the insurance pays them.

Sorry but their coffee is flavorless. The staff are pleasant and efficient which is why I gave them 3 stars instead of 2. My wife disliked her latte and they replaced it promptly, and clearly the staff know a lot of the patrons. I got a premium drink, the Blackout, and that was probably a mistake because it was really sweet. The flavor profile was just off. I like peet's and sbux though, so Black Rock might appeal more to folks who like a milder roast or something.

We came on Sunday around 12:30 for brunch. John had one other table than ours and took 22 minutes from when our food was delivered to come back and ask how it was. The food presentation was awesome but it was poorly seasoned. Denny's or IHOP's breakfast tastes 1000 times better than this. We couldn't get a refill for our mimosas or just some salsa to make the food flavorful. This was a very disappointing restaurant experience. I would not recommend this to anyone. Up there with one of the worst restaurant experiences I've had.

Knows his trade and takes pride in his work. We had three walls with damage filled, textured and painted, and they look wonderful! The color matching was much better than I had hoped for, with an older house. I wish I had before and after pictures to share.

I've been seeing an endocrinologist for my thyroid for more than 15 years now, and I have to say that until I started seeing Dr. Ennis, I always came home from my previous doctor to see if my insurance had any new options for me. I wasn't getting horrible care, but I never felt listened to, or like my doc was willing to work *with* me when something felt off. If the numbers were "normal," then my concerns must not be valid. 

Dr. Ennis (and his partner, Jamie Ruiz, who specializes in female hormone replacement therapy) is fantastic, and exactly the kind of practitioner I had been hoping for. He really listens, asks questions about symptoms I had never been asked before, and wants to treat how I'm feeling, not just the numbers on the page. And, in maybe the biggest shock of all, he's always on time for appointments! 

I've been a patient at this practice for several years now, with no plans to leave. I'm thrilled with my care and recommend Ennis Endocrinology to everyone I know who needs an endo.

I've been eager to try Moe Joe's with all the positive things I've heard and now I know why!  

Restaurant is clean with friendly staff. Wait was non existent at 9am on a Tuesday morning however it seemed like there may have been a wait developed by about 930. 

I had a hard tome deciding between French toast or pancakes bug the banana bread was calling my name and I have no regrets about that decision. Easy 10/10. I could have gone for a slightly larger portion but I tend to like more than most. 

Idaho nacho bowl was amazing. Like a good ol loaded baked potato in a breakfast bowl. 

Can't wait to go back and try more!
Sorry, we wanted to love it but all we had was burnt taste in our mouths when we left.
We love them!  Service excellent, quality awesome, responsive time great!  I highly recommend! We

Camri, we see you! On a very busy night you were hustling. Other servers had time to stand about, dance, and chit chat. You never stopped. 
Thank you for your wonderful service.

I have been to Gino's 3 times and I am still on the fence about this place. This last time we arrived at 7 PM with a couple from out of town who wanted Italian food. So since it was close to our place, we dined here. For a weekday night, it was pretty packed. One thing about Gino's, it is nearly impossible to hear the other diners in your party when the place is full. Also, the other tables are nearly in your pocket and sardines may have more room in their can than we did.

The server, Alyssa, however, was very good. Took our orders, accommodated our questions and kept the delivery of the dishes on pace and correctly served. She was the highlight of the evening.

We had an antipasto plate, a soup-Italian Wedding Soup, the butter squash ravioli, an order of frutti di Mare, and an order of penne arrabiatta. Finished up with a cream brule  shared. The soup was a bit too heavy on sage for most of us, but the meatballs were ok. The pasta recipes were done al dente but the flavors were not always on key. The wine a Va Piano, 2009, Columbia River Cabernet was excellent, however, and very fairly priced according to my VaVino wine app.

But the size of Gino's menu always makes me hold my breath. It is hard to imagine that any place can do that many dishes well. For example, the pasta dishes were al dente, but the sauces were unrefined for my taste. I have eaten Italian pasta over a good portion on Italy and there the sauces have less of a feel of over-abundance, but  more refinement and dedication to the local tastes. It appears that Gino's interprets American tastes to be one of abundance (large servings). However, our server was gracious in letting us split the pasta dishes to more ideal serving sizes.

It also appears that when the place is packed, the kitchen seems to struggle to produce good renditions of the dishes listed. As an example, the penne arrabiata sauce was more like from a can and without any real feeling.

In the end, we might go back, but there are other places in Boise for excellent Italian food and where the atmosphere is conducive to good conversation.
Yummy!!! Great food awesome service ! Quick and so wonderful. Fun staff and warm atmosphere!

I only docked one star because it's ALWAYS 15-40 mins to sit and usually another 20-30 mins for food. While it is ABSOLUTELY worth the wait,  I wish they would expand or open a second location (if the owners reading this, pretty please?) 

Ok, onto the food! 

The chimichanga breakfast burrito is BOMB (totally worth sharing), the eggs Benedict's flawless, and the chicken bacon maple tastes like chicken and waffles just in the chicken strip... yummm... we've been there about three times now, and next time we have an excuse, we will be back! I want to try the doughnut pancakes with "coffee" syrup! Hmm... 

The atmosphere is relaxed, slightly yuppie, and the food is worth the wait time. Waitress is friendly, coffee cup always full, and sometimes apologetic about this waiting (no worries, trust that people aren't mad at you! You're busy, and the food is popular!) 

Anyways, long review short; Try it. Love it. You won't be sorry :)

THE WORST, the salesperson had no idea how to communicate with the customer, the store manager questioned "Merry Christmas" and they overcharged for the project $750. Got $700 back but still waiting for the flooring...

Perhaps Christmas wasn't the best time to have a first time visit! Overall we had a great meal, just as with the world today, the place seemed rushed with possible help issues and doing their best to keep up. Soup was like warm, and due to the holiday, the combo items were off the table.

However, the food we did order tasted amazing. The appetizers were good as well, but admit they were smaller than other places we've eaten. We need to come back on a normal day when it's more relaxed!

I have been here no less than 10 times.  I have regularly done a girls pedicure day here and I have always loved it.  Then I visited on 11/21/2017 and this is what transpired:
I came in and wanted a full set. I wanted my nails long & ballerina shaped.  I have had this length and shape done here before so I had total confidence in the guy doing my nails.  As he did my nails I was pretty distracted since Thanksgiving was the next day and I was the one cooking dinner. 
So, fast forward to later in the evening and I notice how uneven my nails are.  They are different thicknesses, the length was a mess.  There was absolutely no uniformity. At this point I decide not to stress about it and then just go back on Monday to talk to him and get them fixed. 
Monday morning I head over to Awesome Nail to get my nails fixed.  As I decide the issues and show him what I'm talking about he starts telling me that the nails are supposed to be really thick & uneven due to the length, style, & shape of the nail. I know better than that. He starts reshaping my nails. I quickly realize that there is no way he is going to be able to repair my nails and make them look how they are supposed to look. So I tell him that he can just go ahead and cut them short and square.  
He proceeds to cut them and reshape them and as he is getting ready to put the gel color on again he tells me that he's going to charge me $15. I was shocked! I asked why I was being charged for him to correct his mistakes. He said that I needed to pay for the gel polish. I  was so annoyed! I had spent $50 getting my nails done initially and now I'm paying another $15!?! I paid $65 for nails that look nothing like what I wanted.  
I will never go back here again.

I don't like to leave bad reviews but I have visited this location 3 times in the last 5 years and each time I left dissatisfied. Last night myself and my four year old son came. We arrived at 5pm so not a long wait, drinks came quick and food about 20 later. We ordered as soon as we sat down. Having a young child you learn not to waste time. Half way thru my dinner my drink was empty and no one ever stopped to ask if I wanted a refill, than I finished my dinner and wanted more fries as they give very small servings, and again no one came, maybe 25 minutes after getting our food my son said he was full so than I wanted a to go box, we waited and still no one has stopped to check on us, so I grabbed my own to go box from the counter in the bar. Thankfully I paid at the machine on the table or likely no one would had came for that either. Short story, after receiving our food we never saw anyone again. This happened all three times I have been there. I leave this review to remind myself to not visit this location again.

It would be sad if you didn't exclusively use Andrew.  He is a really good guy and agent.  Never met anyone like him really. He's been there everyday for the last 4 days.  Shoveling mulch moving pallets and trash, the house cleaner got shifty on us so he showed up with rags and cleaners and cleaned it again himself....wtf.  he is an agent that earns and deserves 6%.  I dont feel bad at all paying him the full rate.  He has gone above and beyond and deserves the referral and recognition.   Just think you should know I don't think there is any better. I've sold 5 houses bought 6 with different agents.  Andrew has surpassed all expectations and has become a friend and life long go to guy for all my real-estate needs.

We must have been coming here for over 6 years and this is still the best breakfast and lunch place in Meridian. Try their build it yourself omelets.
The food is still excellent and cooked as you ask (e.g. crisp bacon and hash browns). Portions are large. The coffee is also excellent and your cup hardly ever sees the bottom dry. The service staff has changed over the years, but all have been attentive and friendly. 
Their WuFlu adaptations include a 50% capacity reduction, complete wipe down of tables and menus and no condiments left on the table, but delivered after ordering. The clean the bottles each time they are used. Masks are worn by all service people. They have a small patio dining area also.
Great place!!!!

Worst experience I've ever had at a restaurant. My to go order was both 15 minutes late from when it said it was going to be ready and missing items. When we called to correct the order the "manager" gave us cold, thrown together food. We paid $50 for mediocre food. Sad to say we will never be back. And we have convinced our friends to do the same.

Moe Joe's is more than meets the eye. A rather plain looking building and interior but an amazing menu. From pancake flights, to their incredible buttery flat biscuits, to the standard egg breakfast everything on the menu has been beyond my expectation. Their wide selection of omelettes are where I continue to find myself ordering from. If you head to Moe Joe's make sure to have the biscuits with Marion berry jam!
Tim in the service dept was extremely helpful, great attitude, funny! It was a pleasant experience as far as a service dept can go. Thanks for being a big help!

Sitting in the restaurant next door and two of the Verizon employees are outside smoking cigarettes and then they just flip the butts into the parking lot littering this charming little mall area. Learn some manners

The food is great but it's hard to enjoy good food when it's SO DIRTY. Booths were sopping wet after being wiped and our server payed NO attention to us. Our drinks were gone and never asked me if I wanted/needed another beer. The booths had food in them and the floors were very dirty. Good food but heck I'll just go somewhere else

A place I'd easily drive by and never notice, but sure glad I stopped in. We heard about this joint from a friend and we'll definitely be back. The food was incredible. Pictures attached are of Mongolia steak plate (spicy) and the spicy mandarian chicken. Both were tasty and extra spicy.

Update 12/8/17: Hate the f

This is about our 10th time here since their opening last spring and realized I haven't given a review.

While they have a lot of bad reviews, mostly for service (or lack of), I really like the place for numerous reasons. We've never had bad service. We've never had a bad meal. Food and drink has always been good and priced fair. I love the spaciousness of the place. You're not packed in like sardines. The patio is nice as well and very spacious. Maybe next year they will fix it up a little and put in some flowers. 

Normally I would do 4 stars but I really want this place to succeed and hopefully they will work on their service.

FTR!! Woot Woot!
This is the newest location of Epic Shine. It's located near the intersection of Ten Mile & Franklin. I stopped by for the first time today (6/13/18) to redeem a coupon that I got in the mail for a free Carwash.  My car was horrifically dirty. 
There is a lot of construction going on all around the location, so getting in & out can be a bit of a hassle. I was greeted by a nice employee named Cazi (sounds like Kamikaze)   I handed him my coupon and he happily eat me up for my wash.  The coupon was for the cheapest wash. Cazi didn't attempt to upsell me or attempt to get me to sign up for the monthly unlimited wash membership.  Actually, I ended up asking him about the monthly membership.  The prices for the monthly membership are as follows:
$20:month for basic wash
$25/month better wash
$30/month for their best wash
They don't charge any fees to set up the account & you can cancel at any time without penalty. They are running a promotion that gives you one month free.  So I paid $30 today and I will not be charged again until August 13th. 
They have a lot of parking bays with vacuums on each side of your vehicle as well as cloth towels to dry your car. 
I was really impressed by this business.  Everything was clean and well organized.  The employees were helpful. Once all of the construction is done I will probably end up bumping up the review to 5 stars. The only negative is the lack of easy access.

I made an appointment and said I would be there in 45 mins to an hour. I drove from the other side of boise to support this business that I have been to many times before. The man that was in here was super rude and clearly is doing nothing. I wasn't late I was within the frame of time I specified. He is just lazy and doesnt want to do anything.. He has always been standoffs and rude I only come here for his wife.. and so that our daughters can play.. I will never ever come back. I have given this business several chances and I have been disappointed in several occasions. see attached pictures!

From: rmsfritz
This is my second night at this hotel and it has been a nightmare both nights. The first room had a terrible chemical/smoke/musty smell that made me start coughing immediately.  The next room they assigned was at least as bad. Then they moved me to a different floor which was okay. They did not offer to help me move or even make any attempt at an apology . This happened from 10:30 and finally ended at 11:30 at night. Still no apology today. We asked for a blanket last night and were given a thin sheet.  Tonight we used our keys but the door seemed like it was barred from the inside, even though the keys resulted in a blinking green light. We asked the desk clerk, Janet, for help. She immediately asked if someone was inside, to which I replied "we hope not!"  She tried with the same result then went downstairs for a different key. It finally worked and she said maybe we used the wrong keys, although she insisted last night we return the previous room keys.  We then requested a real blanket again and she said they don't have any. She tried to give us a mattress cover instead, but finally gave us a sheet blanket. We asked to borrow a coffee pot and she replied that she would get off in 25 minutes and couldn't we wait. I replied "Oh, come on, we've had two terrible nights now!"  Then she did get the coffee pot.  It was 10:20 at night when this began and is now again almost 11:15. And again, no apology of any kind was given. At no time were we rude or disrespectful. I expect a sincere apology and a significant refund for this inconvenience and incompetent, unprofessional service.

This place is expensive and I have not been happy with the care they've given my dog. Do yourself a favor and find another vet. Two times my dog had to have a procedure done and both times I had addition problems with what they did. Staples not staying in and having to have them put back in. Just terrible and then recently my dog had his teeth cleaned and is in pain as a result. But if you want to see the doc about it, you must pay. I've spent a fortune and it's not worth giving my hard earned money to these people.

We went Saturday for breakfast,  10:30amish, was pleasantly surprised about how full it was and even more impressed how it was constantly pretty full and food was delicious. I had the California (with avocado) eggs benny...I asked to have cooked medium so no gooey whites and it was done perfectly & even a great looking avocado & portion. I was a bit disappointed they didn't have hashbrowns until tried their red potato mixture..didnt miss the hash browns a bit! Husband had chicken fried steak,  which he gages many restaurants on. .delish, not too much breading and very tender.  Also..I know toast is not the star but it was really good, enough for me to ask what brand it was(didn't know for sure other than wheat berry and they order it in).  Had whole grain plus whole sunflower seeds etc. Waitress was quick and very friendly..Will be back here soon!
Their food is ok. Wasn't that impressed. I'm eating plant based and they didn't have a lot of choices.

That's Amore!  Oh man, absolutely in love with this place.  We are new to Boise and the Meridian area.  We had a friend visiting from New York City and they saw Grimaldi's and flipped out, insisting we visit and have some pizza.  My wife and I have never heard of it.

The location is great, right in the middle of The Village with outdoor seating.  We ordered two pizzas, The Brooklyn and Margherita.  Both were amazing, the crust is perfect NYC crust, thin and crispy.  Their coal fired brick oven is no joke!

Also on this visit I discovered Sockeye Brewery Porter which was amazing!

We bought a Sprinter 5th wheel at a very good price from Char Ann and Chris (who is no longer at Bish's). Char Ann was great. She knew the specs on the trailer we bought and they put a deal together in an afternoon. We went back a week later to pick up our new trailer and the trailer had not been washed, cleaned inside, or had the Ultimar coating applied. There were also a couple of items that needed repairs that had not been done. So we left it and came back 5 days later. It was done except for the Ultimar and UV protectant. We went ahead and loaded our gear into the trailer on Bishs' lot with the help of Char Ann and Chris, took it home for a few days then returned it again and finally got everything done. We definitely love the trailer and feel like our outfitter Char was in our court. But we do hope Bish's gets on top of the issues with their service department. Their new facility is gorgeous and the crew there without exception was very nice to work with. Having said that it was very frustrating to wait a week to pick up our new trailer and then find that it was nowhere near ready. And if you purchase the Ultimar coating make sure it's applied. Overall we are happy with our new trailer.

Not a Avery organized establishment. Tend to keep you for more than 40 min if you order in person. I suggest you order through the phone as they take clients through the phone holding on to clients who are actually there waiting for the food.

I like the chiropractor himself but I received a massage from there massage therapist and I have to say it was the worst massage I've had. I showed up 5 minutes early to be considerate of her time and be there when she was ready for me. She came out 5 minutes late at get me (and she didn't have a client before me) I then had to undress and by the time the massage started it was 10 minutes past my appointment time. She only really massaged my back/hips and then everywhere else she just rubbed lotion on. She finished and I looked at the clock and it was 3:52. Ended 8 minutes early. I was supposed to receive a 60 minute massage but clearly did not. She was a very nice lady but I will not be back for a massage.

Fuck this place. It is impossible to get to talk to a real person here. I hope this place gets burned to the ground with all the employees in it. Sad excuse for a Verizon store. I spent over an hour trying to get a hold of them to answer a simple question and the dumbasses couldn't do it. Fuck this place. You would think as a phone company they would be good at answering the phone. Not the case at all I literally will never ever go to Verizon for any kind of help ever again. Lost a customer and I hope everyone chooses somewhere they can actually get some real help. Again, I hope the worst for this company. I hope it burns down with everyone inside

Super positive experience as a walk-in customer.  We were instantly greeted by the first employee we passed upon entering and a salesperson was brought over to help with all our questions-and we had many!   Lisa Kelly was our sales person and we definitely recommend her.  She is knowledgeable, patient, and personable.   She helped us narrow down our ideas into a flooring material that we could check out and take a sample home.   Now to decide!

I had a 10 a.m. appointment, and got there about 9.45, I was given a clipboard with my information (I was already a patient) before I could get much more than my name, a nurse came in and called me by my nickname. Led me back to a treatment room, filled out more information and verified what I had given on a previous visit. Dr. Wells came in and seemed very glad to see me and asked about my recent surgery. He examined my skin lesions and reassured me that all looked well, then froze off some bothersome lesions, I had been sent by my surgeon post surgery and treatment because he saw a spot he didn't like. Dr. Wells did a punch biopsy after Ashley had cleaned and  deadened the area. A Stich later and I was told how treat and told when results would be forth coming. I was out of the office by 10:25 and on my way home. I was asked at the desk if I usually paid my co-pay up front, and I did. There was no pressure to pay all the bill up front. I have had several visits and the staff has always been friendly and warm.  I was originally sent by my primary care physician and then by my 
Cancer surgeon.  I would not hesitate to recommend this office and Dr. Wells to anyone.

After spending what felt like weeks reviewing various veterinarians for our French Bulldog I finally settled on Paramount. Dr. Mark and his staff are friendly and empathetic.
Outside of routine pup maintenance we brought our pooch in for some allergy issues and for a pretty severe back issue. I've always felt that Paramount valued our time and wanted to figure out the best possible way to help our dog (both remedy and cost). 
I can't recommend them highly enough. If your pets are your family then this is the place to give them the best care.

I kept telling myself that this is out of their control but they chose to put their location at a very busy intersection--right at the corner--and the patio is almost non-enjoyable. It's sooo loud. It butts right up to the Linder/Chinden intersection so there is a ton of traffic. A handful of beers on tap but nothing that jumped out as special. They do have a full bar which is nice, tho I didn't try any cocktails. I had the walrus hazy ipa which was ok and the citrus mistress ipa which was tasty. I didn't try the food tho I did see a table order a plate of nachos that could feed a family of 5 which was impressive. If the patio is going to be enjoyable they really need to get either a wall or some other kind of sound deflection/dampening.

This was some time ago, but I went in to get my hair died a dark, burgundy color. I came out with bright red hair with some smudged on my forehead. It looked like my head was bleeding. The color looked good, but it was NOT what I asked for. I even showed her pictures on my phone of what I wanted. I don't remember the name of the stylist I had, but she wasn't very friendly. She didn't really talk to me, and I don't think I saw her smile once. I don't know, maybe she was just having a bad day, but I did not feel like I was welcomed. Also it was expensive.

Sherry and I were headed to Goldie's in downtown Boise when she remembered this place was on the way.  She'd always wanted try it but it always had a long line snaking outside the door, and not seeing a line as we drove by we decided to give it a try.  We now understand the reason for the lines.

The host checked us in, told us there was going to be a 45 minute wait, and handed us a small pager. We enjoyed complimentary coffee while sitting on one of the benches in the waiting area and planning our attack on the ample, varied and reasonably priced menu.  20 minutes later our pager went off and we were led to our booth by the host.  Sherry was pleased that despite the cold and wind outside, it was toasty warm inside.

Sherry ordered the Egg Florentine Benedict while I opted for the corned beef hash.  Both were served in oversized deep white dishes.  And both were outstanding. My corned beef hash was the best I've had anywhere (topping even my previous favorite at The McCall Pancake House), and Sherry's Egg Florentine Benedict was as good as she's had in Idaho, and our waiter James was friendly, efficient and attentive.

This will be our new go-to breakfast place, especially when the weather is warm and we can wait in the sun outside.
Delicious local and a staff who really seems to care and appreciate your business!!  Great location with lots of parking
Since Covid this store has been useless to try to work with.  No customer service and piss poor attitude to customers.  If you don't have an appointment they don't even want to talk to you.

Definitely better than I thought it would be. Stopped here for lunch with a buddy, and we weren't disappointed. The servers were attentive. The soup came out piping hot. The food was tasteful and solidly cooked. I'll be visiting this place again.

Had egg flour soup, Ruby Red Chicken and fried rice.

I was pleased with the spacing. Service was so so. But what I was not pleased with was the fact that the majority of the servers that wore masks had them under their nose. Including the food preparers. That totally negates wearing one. And the ones constantly adjusting theirs with out sanitizing after? Yuck! Let's spread those germs every where you touch. Including serving us our food. I understand, they are not pleasant. I work in an industry where masks are mandatory. Wear them all day. Every day. So I did not feel safe dining there and  will not return until this crazy virus is controlled.
And just like that, found my new favorite treasure valley sushi. Everything was amazing, service, roll size, and price! Yay me!
Great service and food.  From the cocktails and bread to the dessert menu, everything is delicious.  It's mine and wife's regular getaway from the kids.

Do not go here on a weekend. Maybe on a Monday midday. We had a 15 minute wait for a table on a Friday, not bad. The hostess could have been more tactical in sitting my family at a low top vs a high top since we have little kids, but whatever. 

We ordered our food at 615 and by 730 we had our third visit that the food was coming any minute, we got some bread to hold us over. Our little kids suffered because they were so hungry. Practically laying on their chairs and we played every possible restaurant game I could invent. NO crayons or colors offered.

 As we sat during this time frame I saw two other tables lay into the manager about the wait and they walked out. We did the same. Looking around I saw that their pizza oven is, in my opinion, too small to serve such a large restaurant. They were losing the battle before it even started.

I usually do the Click List service where you place your order online and drive up to pick it up and they bring it out to your car - and that service works well and the customer service there is amazing.  

But sometimes it's good to go inside the store to see what else you're missing; seasonal items like Cheerios with heart shapes and Hershey Kisses cereal.  And clearance/promotional/markdown are missed if you aren't there to see what they have.  They had Frozen marshmallows in pink and blue on the clearance shelf for 50-cents.  There's almost always something marked down in the meat section.  This time there were coupons on meat that was already buy 1, get 1 free, so you'd get some money off and then a free one - that's a deal.  There were markdowns on various types of chicken too.

They have closeout items with white and red tags here and there - be on the lookout for those because they don't quite stand out, especially in the frozen section.  

Fred Meyer has a good rewards program where you can earn a quarterly $ rebate to use on future purchases and accrue points to save money on gas.  It used to be every week, but it's not quite every week anymore, there is a Free Friday Download where you download the coupon for an item and get it free.  Last week's was a box of Nuprin ibuprofen - which they were either out of stock of or didn't carry that brand.  My daughter went to ask at customer service if there was a substitution item for it and was told they don't substitute the Free Friday items.  They have ALWAYS substituted if a Free Friday item is out of stock or not something they carry.  So, I went up there to ask, got a different person, and he said "of course" and let me get a box of Kroger ibuprofen that was similar to the quantity and strength of the original Free Friday item.

It drives me crazy when they go super fast and are aggressive with your groceries at the checkstand.  I had one of the managers handling my order this time and she beat the heck out of my pasta and bread, and the other lady who was bagging my order put the cereal boxes on top of the bread.  I pulled it out and smiled and said something like "probably not a good idea to put cereal boxes on top of bread ... " - - she didn't say anything or seem to care.  Meh.  All that being said, most of the customer service from the hundreds+ visits I have made to this store have been good.  It's just like any other business, sometimes depending on who or time of day or how busy they are, your particular interaction with them may not be stellar.

Jim was a lifesaver after we locked ourselves out thru our own stupidity. Hint: don't lock all the doors as you leave for a trip and then lock the key in the house as you leave. Worse, we didn't discover our dunce-move until after returning from the trip at 4 PM.

Called Jim and he was there in 15 minutes and had the door open in less than 5 minutes. And the charge was only $50 for the visit. I think that is very reasonable for such quick and professional service.

Plus he cut me a free key to hid in my car next time. Can't beat his service and "here to help" attitude. I'll use him for everything having to do with locks and service.

I find myself at Los Betos about once a month.  It's always a good meal and I know what to expect.  The people who work here are always very friendly and accommodating.  I have been here quite a few times and I always make modifications to what I order and they ALWAYS get it right!!  I appreciate that they are open 24 hours.  There have been several times where I needed to eat at 2:30 in the morning and Los Betos was there for me.  
They have killer breakfast burritos & they offer the full menu all the time.  The food here is authentic and delicious.  They have several different salsas available as well as pickled veggies, jalapeños, and limes. The only negative is that they charge for tortilla chips.  I hate having to pay for chips when I am spending $45 on food. The $2 charge for a bag of chips seems like a slap in the face.  Ok, rant over....anyway, I still come here regularly, so clearly, it's worth it!

Oh my. What an amazing little spot. Not that little. Came here on a Sunday because so many restaurants had lines to get in. This place deserves to have a line but isn't back to it here yet. Not sure what it is. Maybe that person who didn't want cold wine and had to have a happy hour. Sheesh. 

This place earned the 5 stars. Amazing food and such a bright spot in our day today. 

Started off with some absolutely perfect warm fresh bread and oil and spices to dip. I had flashbacks to a little Italian restaurant in Boston. Mmmmmm. Amazing. 

I ordered the lasagna and it was really the best I have had In decades. Perfectly cooked and seasoned. I ate it before I could share with my family. Oooops. 

My wife got the shrimp scampi like she orders at the OG. (Not the original gangsta but that other Italian) and this was FAR better. She doesn't eat as fast so I was able to try hers. It was awesome. 

My son had the pizza. BBQ chicken with pepperoni is. Best he has had. We have leftovers in the fridge back at the townhouse and we are planning to throw it all out and take these leftovers home and eat later. The portions here are large. 

Love it. We will be back. You gotta try it. AND you don't have to stand outside in the cold and wait for that Texas place to allow you in.

Love this place. Cameron super friendly. Food is awesome and tasty. Portions are moderate. Price is fair. Quiet and nice ambiance. Exterior does not do justice to what's inside when you walk in. Would recommend.

This is my neighborhood bar, I love the people, the food, and the atmosphere.  Is it perfect every time?  No, but they know who I am, treat everyone with respect, have great food, and provide very good service. Love this place and through all the craziness right now, I'm proud of what they're doing.

I'd you could give this place a half star.....I would! We didn't even make it past the checking when we decided to cancel. This hotel offers Pet friendly rooms.....to dogs. No other kind of pets are allowed. My daughter and I were traveling through and had her fair guinea pig with us. She is in a clean cage, vet checked, and very loved. They told us we could not bring her in. It was 100° outside. So....we cancelled and gladly got a room at LA Quinta where they love ALL pets......pet discrimination really....."Guinea lives matter!!!" 
Needless to say, we will not be staying in any hotel in this chain again!

I took the family out to dinner and we thought we would give Gino's a try. We like Italian, and this is pretty close to the house.  As in other reviews, first impressions are underwhelming with it being in a larger strip mall, but inside it's pretty satisfying.  Kind of casual, but still nice.  People dressed casually. 
 No table clothes, and mostly stand alone tables, no booths that I could see, but generally appealing.  It was a Wednesday, and I didn't make a reservation, and is was busy.  The hostess was able to seat rather quickly as we came later than three large groups that were mostly finished.   Lucky!   They give you large heavy menus in leather books.  If you look at the menus in the photos people posted, most dinners now do NOT include soup/salad, and all the prices are higher by quite a bit.   It has a separate bar area w/TV. 

Food:  The food was good.  Better than I read of other posts, and we had some of the same things.  My Chicken Piccata was very tender and tasted great.  My son had the Alfredo, and really liked it.  Daughter had pasta and shrimp dish and was good.   Wife was traveling, so we'll have to come back.  

My salad was fresh made before the dinner shift, with all dressings on the side.  It was good, but pretty standard.  

Very extensive wine list.  Many by the glass.  I had the Chianti ($9), or course, it was nice, light and good with my meal.  

Service:  Our waiter was pleasant, but I did feel rushed the whole evening.  I really don't like to feel rushed.  She checked on us a few times before we ordered dinner, but typically you get drinks going, then come back.  Nope, came back twice, as we all were chatty, and no drink order and I had asked for a wine list so, it was clear we were drinkers.    She quickly took our order, still never asked if we wanted drinks, so I asked to order the wine before she took off.  Quick smile, and rushed off.  (There was plenty of staff there that night, and even support staff for tables).  Later she must have asked us 3 times to clear our plates when we were not done.  I was a waiter before, and if your table is going slow, you let them enjoy at their pace, not yours.    This aspect was the biggest downer of this outing.  The service needs a bit of polishing.  After the dinner was initially dropped, a SUPER nice support guy came around the table with the cheese, he was outgoing and really pleasant.  As we left, a lot of very pleasant goodbyes were exchanged which is always nice.  

I gave 4 Stars for Food.  But really only 3 on this service experience.

Worst food I've ever eaten...even worse than the spoiled horse meat I ate in Russia.  I swear the shoe leather meat I was served had been dried in pounds of salt and then reconstituted in soy sauce...PUTRID SALTY food.  For a $14 meal, I've had superior military rations out of cans.  The "Tempura shrimp" sucked as well...greasy as heck, burned in oil, and batter tasted like it was from Walmart.

An inner sanctum of dark and basically uninviting ambiance. The cooking left a lot to be desired and was expensive for what we got. A salmon bisque so thick and pasty that the spoon stood up by itself. And so salty, we sent it back. No apologies or suggestions for a better choice.

Splitting a sandwich was no better. Small, but we still left some on the plate. The brioche bun fell apart as we tried to eat it. Yuck!

Don't think we will return.

Over Priced! It's ok pizza, you're left wondering why it's expensive. Make sure you read the menu description carefully! We ended up with a pizza with no sauce! When we asked for sauce on the side we we charged for it, which was expected! Pizza at the village is going to cost you but it may not satisfy your pizza cravings.

Ordered and picked up to go-(last night) had pot stickers-YUM, MOO GOO Chicken, YUM...heading back for lunch RIGHT NOW!  My car smelled so good!! 
Service was sweet-absolutely worth the drive-the wait-whatever!

I've been here twice and they are 2/2. Love the food, cool staff, and I always leave extremely full. They food I've had has been delicious. Normally not a breakfast out kind of guy but when I do, this will be my go to spot. Want to check out lunch sometime too. 

I've had the chicken fried steak which was massive and very tasty. I've also had the farm house which was also very tasty. I like that they have regular hash browns as well as "Moe Joes potatoes". Both have been very good. Recommended this place to some family and they have also enjoyed it. Cool place and a great spot.
Such a friendly place with HUGE and tasty portions. This is the cleanest restaurant I have been to as well. You will often see all of the tables and chairs outside to really get the place clean.

Red pavilion was probably the best Chinese food in the valley. But now my five star review has now changed to a one star review. So sad how the mighty have fallen. Once I dreamt about this Chinese food but now all I feel is disgust.  Last Friday I ordered takeout, got my usual order but couldn't even pallet the flavors brought forth. Over the last couple months I have been noticing the food quality falling at a rapid pace but sometimes it hits and when it does hit, it is amazing but so far and few between. I have finally given my final review on this location.

I was very excited about my appointment, and everything went good until they started to file my nails. The woman that did my nails cut very deep into my actual skin while filing. On my behalf, I should've said something but I brushed it off because i didn't realize how deep it was. 

The woman filed my nails so hard that my fingers are sensitive to the touch. I definitely would not recommend this place unless you want cuts all over your fingers.

Phenomenal!!
My favorite is the garden hash but these guys do great breakfast! They stay intentionally stay small to keep the quality.
There is no service. The lobby is closed they don't answer the phone and don't serve walk up costumers .  But hey McDonald's is right across the street. Sorry for trying to support local.

First off I travel a lot for work and stay at all choice hotels so I decided to try this Quality Inn. But WOW this is the WORST one ever! On first arrival the front desk lady was okay nothing special or super welcoming and friendly (pretty much how all the front desk people were the whole two weeks) Once I get to my room I do my normal check of the bed, bathroom etc. While checking the bed I found that the top cover had weird stains all over so pulled that off, next the pillows had dark ring stains all over on the actual pillow not the pillow case, the hand towels next to the sink were used looking and dirty and lastly the toilet looks like it hadn't been cleaned in a couple weeks bc it had the toilet stain all round that needed to be scrubbed off. Oh ya and the remote didn't work w the TV so I had to go down stairs twice to get a remote that would work. I called the front desk to get new stuff and that never happened. Basically the room was "fluffed" and that's about all. Next the ice machine in down stairs didn't work at all but they kept saying it was bc ppl fill there coolers... don't really believe that bc I won't at 6am and couldn't get ice and came back by 4pm and couldn't get ice. So you have to walk across the street to the other building in hopes that, that machine has ice. Also they were in the middle of paving their parking lot so no parking and not even ADA for people to arrive. After all of this no discount, no help, no care. This Quality Inn hotel should not be apart of the Choice brand bc it is giving them a terrible rep and makes me want to start going other places. This place is way to expensive for the issues you get when you stay here. Do not stay here the rooms are not worth the money or are the employees. P.S. the rooms also have terrible smells bc of the AC units not being cleaned had to buy air fresheners for the room.

I'm from out of state, but I was told to come to Idaho Pizza Company from a friend who is local to the area. We tried the Sun Valley Veggie pizza and it's the best I've ever had! I'm picky about my pizza, but this is hands down the best company ever! I can't wait to return to Idaho and try all the other kinds!

The lady at the drive-through is super rude and very impatient and if they don't want to take orders they shouldn't be open. I felt like she had no patience and didn't want to be there and her kid was running around the store insideNo one wants to be treated that way as a customer

What a major disappointment. First, the help was sleeping on the booth seats when we came in for an early light dinner. We should have said, later!

But the real coup de grace was the food. Poorly done. First the good part, the house miso was ok. But from there it went downhill.  We ordered an Ebi hand roll and it was not done with a single shrimp, but with Pacific salad shrimp. Ordered some Japanese pickles and the waitress did not know what they were. Oh-Oh.

Then we ordered some shrimp tempura with vegetables. Guess what? The shrimp were (it appeared) pre-frozen. panko "battered" medium shrimp. And, and the vegetables were not tempura fried, Just old, tired and naked. Finding good tempura around here is a sorry search.

So another strike out for us. Hate to give one star reviews, but this warranted it.

As a person who is looking out for what is put in my body and looking for healthy alternatives for eating out, this place nailed it right on the head. I was able to meet the owner and he explained to me why he opened this place. He had done specific research to put in our bodies what it really needed to fight cancer and disease. His menu is full of super foods that your body can use as "superfood heroes". I got the Kayaker bowl that was filled to the brim with color, flavor and foods typically I would never eat. The restaurant has an ambiance of fun with colors. The staff is extremely nice and it's in a central location to Meridian. I went in to get my food to go and waited less than 5 minutes from transaction to food in my hands. Another thing that I love is the fact that it is healthy, but it's not expensive. It's very well priced for what you get. It is well prepared, clean and left me wanting more, which means I WILL be back.

Been about a year since our last update and we are glad to see there has been no fall in their quality or variety of dishes. Their calamari appetizer is great and the mopu tofu is very authentic, smooth and creamy. They will make it as spicy as you want. The red pork sweet and sour was quite good, not cloying or stiff. The Jin duis (sesame balls) are unique for this area and done authentically.

We find their seasoning is refined and cooking style to our liking. 

Service was very good as we ate an early Valentines' day dinner. Bet it is crowded later. 

This still rates as the best Chinese place in the area
This place is the Bomb.. Great Food. Great service. great mimosas.. You must try this place.

I continue to go back for their pizzas; yeah normally I try to avoid the chains yet they simply know how to put together and deliver a quality consistent ny style pizza. This time I went with a buddy who has two kids; they actually slapped down a big old hunk of pizza dough for the kids to play with while we ordered and waited for our pizzas. The kids had a blast!! It was one of the neater kids experiences I have seen in a restaurant. We ordered a half cheese half ham and mushroom. The pizza came out quick and we ordered the 16 inch it was the perfect size for us. I love the flavor profile of their sauce not too watery perfect blend of fresh tomatoes and spices. It's perfectly applied to the pie so many places you have to ask for extra sauce they put the perfect amount on each and every time. Did I mention their pizzas and slices are huge? Haha I love the char on the crust and they are so huge you just fold them in half like typical ny style pizza. I am not a huge mushroom guy yet I found it perfectly complemented their ham not being a typical mushroom guy I found the amount of mushrooms to be just right not piled on like other places. I love the ambiance and feel of the restaurant the brick walls to all the cool ny pictures on the wall. If you are looking for authentic great tasting ny pizza sure to fill your appetite this is the place (a fun entertaining family place too)!!

Always a good standby when the family gets together. Seating is accessible for a scooter/wheelchair which I always appreciate. Stopped for an early dinner with a party of 7.  Staff was friendly and efficient. Food was good and beer and wine were cold. Prices are fair. Not too busy so we were all able to converse without yelling.

Great service excellent ribeye special $19.99
Just what was needed after two hours
On a plane and coming back from that C word place. What a pit...
Great salad bar. Excellent ice tea.
Bathrooms clean. 
Great job crew 6pm Monday 11/15/21
Thank you!

After reading the reviews I've decided not to visit this clinic.  Staff is the first impression, it's been repeated that this staff has issues with concerns, billing, and rudeness. All above indicate an unprofessional office staff. Which leads to red flags regarding the Doctor's services I'd receive.  New search.

I can't say enough positive about this place! I brought my son in today to get his hair cut. When I walked in I was impressed by the overall look & feel of the shop.  Knowing they specialize in men's haircuts, I wasn't sure what to expect. But, it's great.  
They have large flat screen tv's on each of the stylist stations playing sports highlights & the decor is like being in a locker room.  It's super cute....er....I mean manly! 
The pricing is totally reasonable & you can get a haircut, hot steamed towel, massaging shampoo, & scalp treatment for only $23! I wish I could get my hair cut here! Lol.
Heather L was the stylist who cut my sons hair. She did an awesome job! He has a TON of thick hair & she made it look great! She was very precise & clean with the cut & style and was also able to thin it out quite a bit to make it more manageable. We have found our new go to place for his haircuts!
I highly recommend this location of Sport Clips! They are great!

Went in on a Saturday. Super busy and not a lot of tables but if you don't mind the wait, it's well worth it. The hostess was fairly accurate on the wait time which was about 20 minutes. Fortunately they have a self serve coffee bar so you can have a cup while you wait.

We shared a breakfast, the farmers hash, which was heavenly and the portion even at 1/2 was filling. They didn't offer to split the meal for a buck like other restaurants do or even bring us 2 plates but they split he meal for us which doesn't happen often. A very nice service since we usually split meals. The biscuits are my new fave!!

Will definitely be going back!

Above and Beyond. 

This Discount Tire location has never disappointed through the many years that I, and my whole family, have frequented with our 5+ vehicles. Today I went in for a 2:15 tire rotation. The website asked for customers to come ten minutes before their appointment. I was there at 2:05, and I was driving away from my appointment with shined, rotated and balanced tires at 2:30. 

Five stars because there aren't six.

Decided to try Tavern for a weekday lunch and was pleasantly surprised to see if fairly full. I was excited to get a nicer dining option in this area and the food did not disappoint. My wife and I each got a burger - Impossible Burger for her and BBQ for me. The burgers were large, well cooked, and the sides (fries, salad) were very solid. 

The decor was nice, we especially liked the booth seat material and Edison lightbulbs throughout. The staff was attentive and friendly. Looking forward to trying the drink menu, it looked like a lot of great craft cocktails. 

Unfortunately Tavern lost a star for the slow service. We were sat directly after a large group so I'm sure that was partially to blame, but it was nearly 45 minutes from being seated to getting lunch. 

The food and location will definitely warrant a second trip.

It is not like French Dips at famous 100 year old Downtown Los Angeles restaurants, but for the price of $6.50 it goes a long way to making the grade.  Even with all the warnings about how long it takes to make a good sandwich and even with two cars before me, it wasn't that long before I had my order. 

I shared the sandwich and a Mac & cheese with an "expert".  The report was "pretty good, better than a lot of others".  

With the enormous list of options, this will have to get a repeat and another and another.

If you have tried this place, i would be interested in reading your thoughts and comparisons to others.

For now, this is the king of the hill.
Very disappointed.  This place is BLECH! ... I've had better sushi at a truck stop in Bakersfield.  No.  Just no.  Ick

Should be named Wishes RV as I wish they would take care of their customers. Their sales team was good and the experience was fine... service since the sale well different story. Trying to get service to answer the phone or return calls is like banging my head against a wall. First about 3 weeks ago went online to schedule an appointment and never heard a thing. Then I call and go to voicemail and get no call back. I can't imagine what keeps them in business when the customer service is so bad... probably won't ever buy there again. Was told by friends how bad they are and now I see.
Called and was seen the same day!!! Amazing staff from check in until I walked out. Well informed and worked together for a plan of treatment. Thank you

Very very impressed. We were walking contemplating stopping in for lunch and the guy cleaning the floor mats (had no idea it was the owner) told us to come in and get a buy one get one for being first timers. He didn't have to give us a special discount but it was very cool. He told us what to order and while we were eating he brought us some fresh sweet potato fries. The food was great and fresh. All of the veggies had color. Seeing the owner cleaning the mats instead of an employee says a lot about a business and they now have ours. Thanks Rumbi!

I love costa Vida. Always have and always will. It's delish and my favorite style of Mexican food. The prices have definitely been raised and it costs just as much as a sit down restaurant now. It's atleast $23 for two people (not including drinks or extras). Last time I was in, the girl put the tiniest amount of rice on my salad so I asked for some more and I got charged like $2 extra. I get it, my fault for asking but I feel I just got the regular amount. Other than that I have had pretty good experiences at this location. Always busy in there
Best shop in Meridian. Detailed personable and very skilled all hair types. Barbers can get busy call for an appointment.

I have been passing by this restaurant for over a few months now and had a curiosity to check them out.  It was past lunch prime time so they weren't busy. The food here is pretty delicious and not bad at all with their portions, flavor and price.

The place looks like your typical casual diner.  Started off with hot house sake and beer. 

Then for food, we tried out their Chinese specials where you can choose a few items from their selections. 
- Kung Po Beef, Spicy Orange pork, pork fried rice and pork chow mein.  This combo was a lot!  All of the food selected were delicious and tasty! Noodles has a great bite to it. Not soft.

We also ordered:
Shrimp Pea Pod - shrimp and veggies, you can't go wrong if you love shrimp like me. Veggies cooked to perfection and not soft or mushy.
Special Fried Rice - I love the variety of ingredients it has in here and delicious!

With this much food, we had more left over to bring back with us.  This is definitely a place to come back to if I want some Chinese food.  Of course, I would want to try other dishes they have on their menu.

Another year has gone by since my last update and this place still sets the pace. Still a 5-star menu, service and cooking.

In the last year, however, I have had to pick and chose my diet more carefully and my places out to eat even more so. Moe Joe's meats that criteria. Now being on a more salt restricted diet, I found that these folks do not add salt to any of their dishes that are cooked to order. Hooray, you can add some for yourself or none at all.

Also, they will make things to order, As an example, they made me an "early bird" omlette with only 2, not 3 eggs, and only half as much chopped ham and cheese. No toast, eat as much or as little of the potatoes as you like and it worked for me.

They still serve fresh fruit, no preservatives on it. The oatmeal is still good, but I have them hold the powdered sugar over the top and limit the slivered almonds. Lots of big fresh blueberries though is great.

Unlimited and good coffee is still the rule.

The have done a bit of remodel inside, but it seemed to work and gave them a few more seats.

On a Tuesday night, I walked away from the Grimaldi's inside the Village. I had bruschetta, small pieces of bread covered in a mixture of small savory tomato cubes, and slices of cheese with some basil as a seasoning. There was also a variant that had artichoke instead, but that caused it to be a bit too sour. One of the recommendations of the chef was their Margherita pizza, a pizza drowned in sauce with thin crust, and an occasional island of cheese. For dessert there was a cheesecake that had an amazing taste, that almost had the texture of ice cream, dotted with Oreo bits. 

 One other thing I noticed was that the music was there but not noticeable and had a song choice that reflected how the restaurant had changed New Yorks's culture. The restaurant layout was in an "L" shape with paintings of various New York musicians along the walls. There were mostly just people talking amongst themselves and enjoying the food. The presentation of the food was a nice touch and kept the table from getting covered by the food. The bathrooms were clean for the most part, but the sink wasn't bolted down properly and would shake when you turned it on or off.  The food was also affordable. 

 The service was excellent and the food came out quickly. They followed all the coronavirus guidelines and even when our server was occupied, another server came by to check on us. In conclusion, I had an overall average experience at Grimaldi's and was satisfied as I walked out

Going to  this wingers many times but lately something has change with  food
over this last month. Being a family with gluten free and Keto  Diets it was one of my family go to restaurant . The wait staff was very busy  so get help or need address in a timely was not easy, but the food in which we love in the past was not good. It made me think kitchen neglected  is quality or  Kitchen staff need to be retrained.  Both people of our party who order Keto food had big errors: one chicken lettuce wrap was to come with garlic  aioli  sauce   that was missing,  Second was bigger error most of the time when order the sunrise burger it really good  ,but this time the egg was not edible requested from staff member new egg that was not burnt  they did not pass the info to our waitress  then the new egg was over cook as well and most of the party finish their food.  just ate without  the egg most of the time egg is cook with runny yolk not cooked hard  and it was miss the mayo too.
The big issues was Gluten free person got  reaction from eating something with gluten  this was health issues.
So in short the service was ok and the food was very sub para  not the quality we have gotten in the past. I hope it just a one time thing but will be sad to see them not fix  these issue . Really hope they  staff read this and fix the issue  because sad  if we lose favorite .

I have wanting to try out an Italian place close by.  I heard about this place by word of mouth.  We came here on a Sat round 1pm.  As we entered, we were seated right away as they were not busy.  The ambiance and decor of the place is really nice.  It's casual and welcoming.

Our server, Janani, provided us with water and complimentary bread with their olive oil/garlic dipping sauce right away.  Their bread is crunchy on the outside and chewy soft on the inside. A perfect match wit the olive oil/garlic dipping sauce. It was so yummy, I ask for seconds!

We ordered:

White Sangria Cocktail- All I can say is that this is a Yummy one! Not super sweet, just perfect!

Calamari Fritti - The best ones that I have tried around so far.  They were perfectly seasoned, crispy and very flavorful. It also came with 2 kinds of dipping sauce.  

Misto Mare pasta- which is like their seafood pasta.  Very flavorful.  

Quattro Stagioni Pizza - The crust if perfectly cooked.  Not too thick nor too thin. The right amount of toppings with the sauce. Delicious!

Overall, we had a great time enjoying the flavorful dishes and yummy cocktail.  Our server is very attentive and friendly.  Though the food took a bit longer to get served, we enjoyed the ambiance and was able to munch on their house bread while we waited.  Definitely a place to come back to and try out other dishes on their menu.

I guess customers are used to and okay with them shutting down ovens for 90 minutes each day at varying times. I am not. I realize it is a concept issue and not due to local management. The founders devised a concept that stays open all day but does not serve pizza (it's a pizzeria!!) for at least 90 minutes sometime that changes in the middle of each day! The first time we encountered this it was a Sunday at 3pm and they said it was shut down for pizza from 3-4pm. It wasn't back up until about 4:20pm. This last Sunday, we remembered this shut down time and raced to get there by 2:30pm. And we walked in and were told this day it was 2:30 to 4pm. As much as we like the pizza, we will not keep trying to time when they serve and when they don't. I am shocked that a concept could be developed and grow to the size of Grimaldi's with this huge issue. Why not just close in  he afternoon? Open for lunch, close for a couple of hours and open for dinner. At least customers won't be having to time their visit to get pizza at a pizzeria.

Hands down the biggest waste of time. Will was great as a person, but is either new or does not give a shit. 4+ hours to be added to an existing business account. We hit every issue possible while watching numerous customers fly in and out. Every time he asked for help it was solved in minutes. But by himself took forever. This was the worst experience I have ever had with phone service. If I didn't think that reversing my purchase was going to be like pulling teeth, I would have just stayed with my existing company.

Don't let the looks of this place fool you. It's a pretty standard strip mall location with predictable decor... but, the food is far from basic. 

Everything that came to the table was PHENOMENAL!! I had the Idaho Potato Nacho Hash Bowl. Wow! It was nice and spicy. I ordered it with potatoes, which were cooked to perfection, and scrambled eggs. Then a side of toast and homemade jam (choice of strawberry or marionberry). There was so much food! Plenty came home to be second breakfast. :) 

The smothered burrito looked so good! I think the rancheros sauce is where it's at!! Whatever you get, definitely add some of that. 

We did an order of the salted caramel banana bread French toast for the table. It was really tasty, but too sweet for me to eat much of. 

They had spicy red beer and mimosas on the menu, but we skipped those today. I'll definitely be back to try those though. :)

Such a great place for brunch!!! 

When my husband and I first moved to Boise, Moe Joe's was one of the first places we tried (based on our yelp find). We not only had an amazing breakfast, but that breakfast was large enough for us to enjoy for lunch as well. 

Since then, Moe Joe's has done some work on the interior to expand and add more tables. That being said, there is still a line out the door. Of course the weekend are always a busy time for them (especially when church service times are over). If you're looking  to truly have breakfast there, I recommend getting there early if you're not one who enjoys waiting. I will say though, it's worth the wait. 

Since my last visit with Moe Joe's, I have been obsessed with hot cocoa with toasted marshmallows. You absolutely do not need to be a child to enjoy their chocolate treat.

I waited a long time to get an appointment with these people. I live far away from their location. At my first appointment, I was 4 MINUTES late due to road construction. They could not see because of that. The second appointment I was late 8 MINUTES  because of an accident on Eagle Road, I called them while I was waiting for traffic to get moving the little gal told me to keep coming. When I arrived they told me I would have to reschedule. The receptionist said she would call me if they had a cancellation. Weeks went by. I called to see when they could get me in many times. No one ever answered the phone. I left several messages. No callback. I called my Dr. that referred me to them. She called and they said because I was late they would not see me. That didn't bother me as much as not getting a call letting me know that. I would never recommend them. I can't tell you how upsetting it is to not even get a  courtesy call telling me that. I wasn't going to post but I saw others say similar things.

I so badly want to give this place 5 stars....but its a fairly new, so I want to see how it matures and grows first. I have to say a SOLID START!!! I ate here for the first time last night, and its located in a charming old home...which makes for a fun unique atmosphere! The staff was very friendly and accomodating....although at times they seemed a little overwhelmed or unorganized. It is a new place, so I'm sure they are just working out the "kinks". 

Now on to the wine and food....you walk into a "wine wall" with many bottles of wine to choose from! Don't want a bottle??? No worries they sell a ton of wine by the glass! They also have a high end wine cabinet if you are looking to splurge! THE FOOD IS EXCELLENT! I had the ribeye special, and it is a very rare occassion that you get perfectly seasoned, perfectly cooked beef!! Another at our table had the filet and said the same thing...PERFECTION!!! We choose a Malbec to compliment the beef...and it couldn't have been a better pairing! 
I'm excited to return and have some wine on the patio...I also want to try some of their seafood selections...So Divine Wine YOU WILL SEE ME AGAIN...congrats on your solid start...CHEERS!!!

It was alright. Mostly booths and I prefer tables so I sat at the bar. Nice attractive suburban restaurant and bar space, efficient if quiet bartender. I ordered a Reuben with steak fries. Reuben came with mustard instead of thousand island or Russian dressing, so the sandwich lacked that sweet undertone. Fries were good, not as big as what I normally call steak fries but good flavor and texture, not greasy. Bloody Mary was tasty but not that big and kind of spendy. Stool was pretty uncomfortable but bar stools are usually uncomfortable. Might try it again sometime, not in a rush though. If you're local to the neighborhood it's probably a decent option.

I take my Doberman here when I have to run into Boise for errands. He ends up staying the night usually because it's better then him being locked in a kennel while we are out. He loves it so much and the best part is when I pick him up and he sleeps for about 3 days after and doesn't chew anything up or terrorize anyone haha. I watch him on the cameras and the staff is always playing with them and monitoring them. It's a great place for dogs to socialize and get their energy out. Ghost will always come to Camp Bow Wow. Thanks staff !

Not pleased at all. When I walked into the doctors office, the receptionist were extremely unfriendly and I would describe it as snobby. They were obviously all about money and acted like they were better than everyone else. My appointment was at 9:15 and I didn't see a doctor until after 9:45. I would understand if it was the end of the day and they were running behind, but first thing in the morning?! They acted like my time wasn't valuable and they weren't concerned with patients needs. I will not be returning.

I've only been to one other veterinarian in the area, this was my second place I have taken my dog to. My dog didn't really know it was the vet so he wasn't on high alert which was really nice, the staff was really nice and friendly. I think the best part of the trip was meeting Dr. Harsch! He really looked at my dog and did a full through examination unlike the other place i had been to. He really heard what I was asking and gave me loads of information and for that I am very grateful! My dog seemed to love it there too! He did awesome!
The pizza was pretty good. Customer service was great! The place was very clean and cozy inside. I like the wood feel to it. The garlic bread was good- not very garlicky though.

Been over a year and a half since my updated review, so thought an update is due.

This is the best place for breakfasts in the area, bar none. It has been spectacularly consistent in food quality and service. We like their coffee in terms of strength, body and taste. Several other places make good breakfasts, but their coffee sucks. Boyd and Farmers just doesn't cut it.

Weekends are still crowded, but weekdays are great and it is just busy enough to let you know the place is good. They have added a little patio off the front to add capacity.

The day's special today was a Chicken Fried Chicken breast, boneless. So good, crunchy, tender with a faint hint of maple syrup and cilantro in the crusting. (Cilantro? Gasp-I can hear some who know me.). Served with potatoes, two eggs and toast, it will fill you. Try it.

We have been going to Johnny Carino's for years, but since the remodel and the change of the environment at this restaurant it no longer is on our list for family nights out! Based off our last visit it solidified that for us. The bread is the highlight of Johnny Carino's. We got our bread but the service was so slow, our waitress showed no personality, never would check on our table for refills of water or bread. I was given different silverware, had to contact another waiter/host to give me clean ones since our waitress never came to our table. Those of us who order a caesar salad tasted sour and we were worried about how sour it was. Once we finally ordered my ravioli was so spicy I could not eat it, I was offered a tomato sauce to ease the spice. So 10 minutes later they brought me cold tomato sauce.  Was not impressed with the service or food. I am giving them one star because their bread is always the best part. But I am not planning on going back with my family anytime soon.

Confirmed information about 2 employees at Fred Meyer at Chinden and Linder with Coronovirus 19. Worked in produce.

People believe they are getting "fresh" produce. From their shipments, you ought to see what gets thrown out. All of it goes into the trash. Their shipping is out of Washington.
KROGER/FRED MEYER  want you to see how good their advertising is.

February 20th, had six massive seizures, Respiratory and cardiac failure. Left hospital about the 24. I wanted to go home, they didn't want me to. I begged, to go home. I  am still struggling. Right leg damage from seizures. On Friday I have to have some surgery, so....
It seriously hurts to walk.

I went in to Fred Meyer, April 15th at 9:45p., they fully close at 10:15 now. I have felt sick and in a lot of pain, so I went late in order to not be shoved around or run over. Within minutes i was being asked to leave the store with what I had. It was so aggressive that I began to get nauseous and dizzy. They, the 2 women, suggested that I leave with what I had, and come back tomorrow. I just wanted some coffee items, bread, not many things. Just to painful to walk
I told the one dark haired heavy set woman to just stop...she called the manager "Claire". It got worse after that.
I left with 6 items, and never ever wanting to come back. I just wanted a loaf of my favorite bread.
I like others have tolerated the issues from FM. I lost a $340 bill transfer into their system. I watched as it came out of my account and never went to Idaho Power. I was given one excuse after another, ONE week later, Kroger Corp office sent $340 to my account. I was shocked. Would like to have "heard" an apology. Then to include from the .25 to .35 price increases, a staff member argued until I proved it, then nothing more said. Asking when they would receive any "clorox"...response was "when they make more and deliver it"...ok...so I went to WINCO( a friend that works in Fed gov said they were finding all they needed at WINCO, after getting tired of FM.
I found toilet paper and towels. Clorox and Pine Sol, even more.

WINCO I am so glad your coming to my area.

When I first moved to Meridian I was told about a fun place called The Divine Wine bar and restaurant.  But as one gets busy you just tend to forget until I read an article and review of this place.  I hadn't realized that they served food also.  This place is absolutely great!  My husband and I shared the meat and cheese appetizer platter, the 3 meat tacos, and a  Mozzarella and tomato salad.  We also had wine, beer and dessert!  All yummy!  Kudos to the cook!  All the dishes were prepared as a  gourmet dish and also the prices were very reasonably priced.  
The staff - Alana and Manager Venus were friendly, knowledgeable and very attentive.  We were able to sample a few wines as well.  To top the experience- there was a one guy band who played popular music.  There was a little area where a couple could dance although I'm not sure I would consider it a dance floor.   The  outdoor venue was beautiful!  

We were so impressed with our experience that we made reservations for next week as we will be bringing out of town guests.  This place is not to be missed!  Who knew?  This is now one of our favorite places in Meridian!

Be nice if i coulda have got some service! Cant be because im not white!!! So far idaho sucks!!! The people in this town are rude! Every single place i have stopped and stayed just rude! Sat alone at my table for 9 minutes with a glass of water!!! Maybe it was my LA Rams beanie or my LA tattoo! Maybe it was because I didnt sport a gun in my waistband!!! All you Idahoans or whatever the F u call yourselves wont have to worry about this LA native coming here again! Sucks because I took the time to google a good breakfast spot and drove my white ass over there only to be embarrassed at a single table in the center just flipping the menu over and over!!! Not even sure why I waited 9 minutes before I walked the F out!!!! I was a server for 15 years and heres a tip for the dipshits who work there...IF YOU THINK SOMEONE IS WAITING FOR ANOTHER PERSON TO JOIN THEM YOU SHOULD ASK!!  ALSO WHEN I CHECKED IN I SAID PARTY OF 1!!! Im a good tipper too YOUR LOSS

This is about our 10th time here since their opening last spring and realized I haven't given a review.

While they have a lot of bad reviews, mostly for service (or lack of), I really like the place for numerous reasons. We've never had bad service. We've never had a bad meal. Food and drink has always been good and priced fair. I like the spaciousness of the place. You're not packed in like sardines. The patio is nice as well and very spacious. Maybe next year they will fix it up a little and put in some flowers. 

Normally I would do 4 stars but I really want this place to succeed and hopefully they will work on their service.
It's not very good, staff wouldn't let a 8 year old boy play pool WITH PARENTS AROUND, exclusively because he's under 14...

Sad news today, January 18, 2022, that Gino Vuolo died after his long and courageous struggle with cancer.  From the announcement on the restaurant's FB page.  "It's with a heavy heart that we have to sadly inform you all of Gino Vuolo's passing early this morning," the restaurant wrote. "Gino and Tia have poured their heart and soul, not only into their restaurant, but into the community that has loved and helped support us over all these years."  

Our first visit to Gino's was before we moved to the area, maybe as far back as 2014.  From that first visit to every time we were in afterwards, Gino treated us, as he did all his customers, like friends.  And in particular with my husband who, like Gino was, is Italian and who grew up in nearby neighborhoods in New York.  It was amazing what Gino would remember about his customers from visit to visit.

The restaurant struggled during the couple of years of his illness, during which time Covid also intervened to make staffing and running a restaurant even more difficult.  We last saw him when we were in for a lunch several months ago, he came over to say hello and talk about another chemo treatment he was starting the next day and to share about the challenges of being a restaurant owner during covid times.  

What a nice man he was.  For the sake of his memory and of his family, we hope for success for this restaurant, of which he was so proud, in the months ahead.

Been here for breakfast and lunch. Food is very good with nice choices. Nice touch is the fresh fruit, real fresh fruit, bowls as a side. Cottage fries are excellent. Prices are reasonable and they will do half orders on some dishes. 

Service is usually prompt and friendly, but sometimes a bit slow in coffee refills. Coffee is better than Boyd's, but not Illy. 

Pretty crowded for weekend brunch. Weekdays not as hectic. 

Location is hard to spot from Overland, but look for the archways on the side street they face in to.
