WAS a pretty average Toys R Us, As of April 2018 location is going out of business, Everything on sale.

Cindi and I were hoping for something as good as the http://www.islandnoodles.com/ we get at the McCall Winter Carnival.  While Cindi enjoyed her barbecue chicken salad, my beef and chicken noodles with spicy teriyaki sauce did not live up to my expectations, especially given the nearly $9 price tag.  Neither the noodles nor vegetables had the seared smokey flavor I expect in a wok-cooked meal -- they tasted more like they were boiled or steamed.  And while the sauce was good, I had to ask for two extra portions, and even then it was lost in the watery broth that filled half the bowl.
Fast and pleasant service.  I had the veggie hash bowl and it was outstanding!  Large portions.  I'd definitely go again.

Our sales person David Bobbitt was a great deal of help in purchasing our carpet, and worked with us on when we could get it installed, I guess that is why we have been a repeat customer so many times. 
   Our installers were here on time and very efficient, and worked quickly, 
looked like a professional group of men.
   We have had friends that have gone to other places and had to wait three months to get their carpets installed and that wouldn't of worked for us because we already had the furniture moved for the painter to do his work.  We are very thankful for you staff, and we will be back again.

First time in and am from waaaaaay outta town to eat and visit with Evan. 
The server recommended the Man Eater sandwich and it was ridiculously good (I'd add more sauerkraut next time) and what a great portion!
The price points are on point. The quality of each ingredient is very apparent with every bite.
Evan said that you locally source just about everything and it really shows. 
My family and I will definitely be back in to try more menu items!

This is about our 10th time here since their opening last spring and realized I haven't given a review.

While they have a lot of bad reviews, mostly for service (or lack of), I really like the place for numerous reasons. We've never had bad service. We've never had a bad meal. Food and drink has always been good and priced fair. I live the spaciousness of the place. You're not packed in like sardines. The patio is nice as well and very spacious. Maybe next year they will fix it up a little and put in some flowers. 

Normally I would do 4 stars but I really want this place to succeed and hopefully they will work on their service.

The staff was nice and the place seemed clean. But the food and drinks were pretty bad. 

We ordered:
Blood & sand (cocktail)
Caesar salad
Minestrone soup
Lasagne
Veal Saltimbocca

The cocktail tasted like it had old canned orange juice in it and was definitely not mixed by someone who is an experienced bartender. The Caesar was the best thing we ate but still it was just - meh! The minestrone soup tasted like a can of tomato sauce with some vegetables boiled into it. The veal saltimbocca tasted old and/or was poor quality meat and the gnocchi tasted like it came out of a plastic package from the grocery store. Once again the lasagne was smothered in what tasted like tomato sauce straight from a can. But that wasn't even the worst part about it! 

Two people at our table order the lasagne. The first one came out and was placed in front of me and it actually looked pretty good. I was sharing with my husband so we had both dishes in front of us in addition to the soup and salad because they did not course out our meal. They brought the entrees right after the starters. Then the server came and took the lasagne from in front of me and gave it to the other person who order it at our table. Then about 5 minutes later she brought out a significantly smaller lasagne (about half the size of the first dish) and it looked horrible. The cheese was barely melted and it looked slapped together. Well it was. When we mentioned it to our server she said the kitchen had forgotten about it and so they just slapped it together quickly to serve to us. 

Like I said the staff was nice but the service was lacking. Very disappointing that we spent $90 on a terrible meal.  Hopefully you'll read this and not make the same mistake.

Ordered delivery through Postmates, and have nothing bad to say about the delivery, which was very fast. 

Unfortunately, the order was horribly packed by the restaurant and the food itself was pretty meh. 

I ordered the General Tso's Chicken, which was packed in a clamshell styrofoam container. All of the very liquid sauce ran out of the clamshell and got all over everything else in the order, including the spring rolls, which were packaged in a paper bag and got totally soaked and were soggy and inedible by the time I received them.

My chicken was just dry pieces of fried chicken with no sauce on them, since it went all over the inside of the bag. 

Something with this much liquid needs to be packaged in either a styrofoam cup with a lid or those cardboard Chinese food cartons, or basically anything that doesn't have big, gaping openings in the sides. 

The veggie lo-mein was bland and greasy and the hot and sour soup tasted mostly of salt. The fried rice was also bland and greasy and had barely any veggies or eggs in it, and no onions, which is partly why it was so flavorless. I can make better fried rice at home by scrambling an egg in some leftover rice.

I hope that eventually with all the people moving here from out of state we can get some decent Chinese food. This ain't it.

This spot is right down the street from us so we decided to give it a try. It is soooo good! I legit ate it so fast, I forgot to be the above and beyond elite and take photos. Whoops! 

I got the spicy chicken bowl with fried rice and veggies, it was very very tasty. It didn't have really any spice that I thought it was going to have but everything was delicious. My husband got the steak teriyaki with noodles (yakisoba style I believe) and the steak was a no go.. he also felt like it was too many noodles which made the meal feel heavy. The gal told me that yakisoba style meant they throw everything together in a wok and mix it up, it added an extra $1.99 I think and not sure if it was worth it. He said maybe next time he will get what I got because mine was better. I'm just that good at picking meals!  

We will definitely be going again!

If it was possible to give zero stars, I would absolutely do so.  I have eaten here on three occasions now and can say with out a doubt, I will not be back. The only way I would ever consider is if I learned it was under new ownership and the place was completely overhauled.

Of all my experiences, my most recent was by far the absolute worst which leads me to believe this restaurant is on a land hill slide downward. Which I am totally bummed about, because the concept could really be so much fun!

Never greeted upon entering.  My husband and I sat ourselves at the sushi bar.  The place was fairly busy at the bar, only a few open seats remained.  We chose the last two together.  Upon sitting we noticed our sushi place mats were sticky, tattered and just in need of being thrown out.  We flagged down a server and asked for drinks.  The server NEVER came back to ask if we wanted to order anything off of the menu, nor did she ever give us a menu to look at.  So we started choosing items off the floating boats.  Tasted a few that were all right, let a slew of unappetizing ones float by and finally asked the sushi chef if he had a menu.  He handed up a tattered up piece of laminated computer paper and NEVER returned to ask if we wanted him to make anything.  My hubby then decided to take a chance on a boat we had previously passed up, and literally spit it out into a napkin and grabbed my hand before I put the other piece in my mouth.  He said it was the most disgusting thing he has ever tasted and was almost certain it was rotten.  

I at one point excused myself to use the restroom.  Upon entering, I noticed the previous patron did not flush. I reached to do so and discovered the entire flushing handle was completely gone.  Like totally broken off and a giant hole in it's place, gone.  Lacking options, I lifted the tank lid to see if I could pull the chain and the inside was totally broken too.  They are lucky I only had to go number one, because I had no choice but to add to what was already there.  I am pretty sure this whole situation is a health violation.  

When we left, we were the last people in the restaurant and we still had to ask for our bill.  I will without shame admit I put zero in the field for a tip and came home to eat a bowl of cereal because I was still so hungry.  That is an absolute first for any meal out, let alone a sushi restaurant. 

Not good.  Seriously, not good at all.

Indigo and I met our friend Helen for lunch. It was a gorgeous day so we dined al fresco and enjoyed the nearby fountain and music. We decided to try the Quattro Fromaggi pizza and it was the best decision of the day. Then we had the dessert trio ( strawberry cheesecake, tiramisu, and -leave the gun, take the- cannoli). All were fantastic but I am partial to tiramisu so that was my favorite. The service was great as well, the waiter was very courteous (moved a table so I could get by with the stroller) and didn't seem to mind that we chatted a bit after we paid. 

Bonus points for the best high chair that I've ever seen at a restaurant, I'm seriously considering getting one to use at home. 

Indigo gives this place 15 stars (+ 5 more for the fresh strawberry that accompanied the cheesecake).

beware.  this bank will keep your families social security money when they die.  it has now been 6 months since my mother died and they are withholding my mothers money.  money that she choose to have deposited into this financial institution.  social security says that she was owed this money and they will not return it without them becoming involved.  this is costing me time and money to attempt to recover my mothers money. ridiculous.

We ordered take out at Red Pavilion yesterday.  When we called they said it would be a 45 minute wait.  We showed up 50 minutes from the time we called thinking that was plenty of time.  Little did we know what we were walking into.  When entering the restaurant it was already extremely crowded with 2 different people yelling at the staff and storming out without their food.  Without thinking too much about that, we let them know we were there to pick up our food and they said it would be a few more minutes.  20 minutes goes by nothing, 20 more minutes goes by and nothing, another 20 minutes goes by and we say something, they respond with "your order is being boxed now".  How convenient.  Another 10 minutes go by, with a total of waiting in the restaurant for our take out food that was supposed to take 45 minutes, was an hour and 10 minutes so 2 hours total from the time we ordered.  They also so kindly put all the chow rice in one box for 4 people to share, pretty sure we didn't get all our rice.  They did not offer to comp any meals or apologize for it taking so long!  In fact, when we complained about how long we waited and we said we are not sure if we want to the food anymore, they took it out of the bag and took it back to the kitchen.  Didn't care at all! I should have stormed out with those people from the beginning.  I will never eat at Red Pavilion again as they don't care about customer service or communication.

I don't usually gush about anything but Hokulia Shave Ice was the best shaved ice I have ever had. I've been around when it  comes to shaved ice and I've had some really good ones, but Hokulia takes the cake. You can select as many flavors as you please and the size of the smallest serving was HUGE. Not only was the shaved ice itself good, but the service was outstanding. I went to two locations in Ada County, Idaho and was greeted by very attractive, smiling young ladies who seemed to enjoy their job. My only complaint is that they don't have locations on every street corner of the world. If you're in Ada County Idaho or a city that has Hokulia Shave Ice, try it. It's the best thing you will ever do.

This is your typical 24 hour Mexican taqueria. If you are from California or anywhere on the west coast and enjoy these types of establishments you will be right at home. It's nothing special inside, cold, and only slightly clean. However the kitchen turns out fast inexpensive Mexican dishes and fresh made salsa bar delivers yummy red and green salsa.

My go to is the Idaho burrito which is just a renamed California burrito given the state they are in.  Carne asada, cheese and french fries, yum!

I give it 4 stars where most give 3 stars because simply my expectations are more in line with what Los Betos delivers.
Not the freshest I've had.  Cheap though and fast service.  Not too many people here but it was a Friday afternoon.  Friendly staff but felt out of place.

Fantastic gluten-free Chinese food. They make all entrees fresh so they were able to make everything gluten-free and they even have gluten-free soy sauce. The rice sticks were fantastic, the honey almond shrimp were amazing and everything we ordered was wonderful. We can't wait to go back

This is such a five star place and I feel bad giving them four stars! But let's start with the good first:

I had the corn beef hash brown bowl. It comes with 6 oz of homemade corn beef with two eggs over-easy on top of hash browns. You get a choice of bread with it as well (will come back to that one). 

The corn beef was delicious and looks like it had a chopped poblano pepper mixed into it which gave it flavor but was a bit too spicy for me. So it was a delicious breakfast by default!  

The bad: 
I am gluten free so I asked if they had any gluten free options since I didn't see gluten free Mentioned on the menu except for the gluten free pancakes. They did have gluten free toast and I happily ordered it. The toast was very dry, even slathered in butter and didn't taste that good so I didn't eat it. What I didn't know is that there was an extra charge for the gluten free toast. If I had known, I probably would have just left it off.

So it's a pet peeve of mine, GF has become mainstream, don't know why restaurants keep charging for it.

The semi-bad: ok the rating was only going to be three stars but I know this next bit is not really their fault but an overall issue with restaurants in general right now.

The.      Food.  Came.  Out.    So.    Slow.   

Our server was great and you can obviously tell she was hustling but with the lack of people wanting to work in service jobs right now, it was obvious they needed more help. So I didn't rate them a three but kept it at a four. However I probably won't be eating out here anytime in the future. Too crowded (even for 10am on a Friday) and not enough help.

Holy cow! This place serves up some of the best breakfast you've ever had! So glad Yelp lead me here! This place is BUSY so plan on waiting a little bit. It's definitely worth the wait however! Be sure to get the fresh squeeze orange juice too!! Yum!

This place was far more impressive than I expected. The atmosphere is clean and cute, and we were sat immediately.

I loved the basque chorizo hash, and the pancakes tasted like heaven. I don't love pancakes (I find them to be bland) but these were fluffy and sweet and perfection. Don't even get me started on how impressive their country fried steak was. So crispy and the gravy was to die for.

The coffee was good and the OJ was fresh squeezed. We will probably take the time to stop again on our way back through Boise!

I had to leave my car for several hours today to have a flat fixed. So why, you say, would I give them 5 stars for having to wait? Because the fact that they even got to it with the load of cars they had today was amazing to me. It appeared that every car in Meridian and environs was there to have their studded tires put on. 

Now since I have a Subaru, I haven't switched tires for years. I just wanted the not so slow leak fixed. The guys in the bays said it has been like today since the snow last Thursday. I sympathized with them and asked if it got a little exhausting to be get there at 0700 and not leave until the cars were done? Yes, he said, it will be after 2000 before they are done tonight. So working in that cold for over 12 hours gets my "At a Boy/Man."

This is probably the newest Schwab store around here and has the obligatory free popcorn, free WiFi, and clean rest rooms. And to boot, they didn't charge for the tire repair. I don't think I have ever paid for a flat repair from Schwab. Great policy.

I would dock a half point if there was a 4.5 score because they, like so many businesses in Meridian and Boise, they haven't plowed the sidewalks on their property. Isn't there an ordinance requiring sidewalk clearing in so many hours? If not, there should be. But there isn't a 4.5 stars, I think a 5 star is still warranted.

Walked in to try and change service from another carrier.  Literally 2 customers in store with 3 employees.  Manager asked if I had an appointment, I said no, she told me I would need to schedule an appointment.  I asked her why she couldn't help me, she replied she needed to back up and support her team.  Very poor way to help a potential customer.  Verizon needs to assess this store and their customer service plan.

I've eaten here about 3 or 4 times over the past few years. The entrees are pretty good...but not "great." In all honesty, I'd give it 3.5 stars if that was an option.  Most of the food is tasty enough, just not good enough for me to crave. As for the desert, I was very unimpressed. The second to last time I ate here, I ordered a creme brûlée, my absolute favorite desert. I hate to say it, but it was terrible - I couldn't even eat it (a lifetime first for me).

We have been to this restaurant half a dozen times and this place never disappoints! The sushi is amazing, fresh and the presentation is beautiful! Service is also great and attentive! Highly recommend for sushi lovers!

Never do business again with these guys!! Service guy was a complete joke, rude and could care less about my issues. Had a couple questions and he couldn't even answer 1!!!To many other dealer s who want your business in town.

I think this place is good for what it is, American Chinese. We got a bunch of different things but the best were lim&lime chicken, honey almond shrimp, and the mongol. Typical prices, nice atmosphere, good service. If I was closer I would probably do takeout

A fiver for Uncharted Recreation not because we bought anything or found what we were looking for but because we met Dougie and he was super helpful and nice.

We have a travel trailer that needs a new vent fan for our stove.  Hoping to find a part at Uncharted Recreation, we asked Dougie about it and he said no, they don't sell parts but directed us into another direction that was much better for us.

Then we started to talk and ask him some general questions, learn a little about our trailer, a little about the town, he was a very nice guy and helpful although he knew we weren't going to be spending money that day.  Well we left with his card and will keep him in mind for the future because when you meet a salesman who is not all about the sale but building a relationship with customers that is rare and something to appreciate.  I will recommend this RV dealership and Dougie any day.  Thank you!
Such a great local pizza place! Husband & I ordered over the phone, ready in 20 minutes on the dot! Pizza was SO good! And they have ranch to die for  highly recommend

What a great experience!  We needed some electrical help and Mike sent us pictures of different options of products he recommended and was able to tell us what would work best for what we needed.  He showed up when he said he would and was very efficient in the work.  He was great to work with and I have and will continue to highly recommend him!

I have been going to Shige's downtown and now here in Meridian since it has opened (closer to where I work/live).  The staff is great and Hiroshi and Herman are as good as it gets for sushi!  I have been around the world and had sushi at the most expensive places in the US and Shige's Meridian is right up there with them!

I have heard the feedback on two fronts: 1) Service 2) Ambience

Service- Yes, I think unless you are a regular there, they can improve the "introductions". At the end of the day, they have a full menu (not just the boats) and if you ask for it, they can probably make whatever you want however you want it!  (I have food allergies and am very picky, and they always pull through for me!).  They are continuing to improve this and are just a great group of people (the owner Shanaz is awesome and cares and caters to her customers!)

Ambience- Yes, they need to update some simple things, but for the price and quality, it cannot be beat locally.

Again, just remember, ORDER WHAT YOU WANT!  The boats are not the only option!  Enjoy it and have fun!

This company may be small but its very professional. Michael likes being a small business owner but you treats his customers as if they were his biggest national account. 
We had a small kitchen floor repair job. He was very accommodating to our schedule and worked quickly.
A month later, we noticed that some of the flooring had traveled. I call Michael up and he made it by 2 days later. He was in and out so quick. The thing is, he even took the time to recaulk the baseboard in the pantry after he tapped the floor in place. I mean, seriously, who would have even known? 
The dedication to quality and workmanship Michael has is refreshing. The commitment to, and eye for the small details is hard to find these days
If you have a small job, please consider Ihandy.

This is about our 10th time here since their opening last spring and realized I haven't given a review.

While they have a lot of bad reviews, mostly for service (or lack of), I really like the place for numerous reasons. We've never had bad service. We've never had a bad meal. Food and drink has always been good and priced fair. I live the spaciousness of the place. You're not packed in like sardines. The patio is nice as well and very spacious. Maybe next year they will fix it up a little and put in some flowers. 

Normally I would do 4 stars but I really want this place to succeed and hopefully they will work on their service.

Been coming here for over 4-5 years and it is still
The best breakfast place for breakfast in Meridian. 

Great menu and fast and friendly staff. Coffee is pretty good and cups are kept full. No more carafes on the tables, but attentive staff keeps cups full. 

Again, if you like to eat lighter meals, look at the early bird menu selections. For seasoned citizens, the early bird menu breakfast is good all day. 

We have had little to no wait except on weekends.

Stopped on for some brunch on our way though Idaho.  We asked for recommendations and they did not disappoint.  I had the Jalapeño Berry Pancakes with cream cheese.  Wow to say the least.  Really delicious.  My guy had Chilequillas. Nachos with Chile verde Pork. We both highly recommend either one.  The waitress was amazing with her food choices and service.  If you get the chance to stop in... do it. You won't regret anything.
One of my faves if not my favorite pizza place. We normally take out but today we ate in. Good salad bar. Fast, efficient service.

I can't believe we only just tried this recently. New favorite breakfast spot with the kids! Plus when you wait for your table, you can walk around the neighboring comic book store! Always a great time.

I want so badly to love this place. It's close to my house, just the right level of upscale, and offers a pleasant atmosphere and wait staff. 

The problem? The food. It's atrocious. I see the chef in back with reading glasses on, looking stressed as hell with 25 minute ticket times and garbage food coming out. 

Garbage? What do you mean? I mean coconut shrimp that looks like a crab cake and tastes fishy. I mean Mac and cheese that looks like soup. And a yam side that is a microwaved pulverized sweet potato cut in half and no salt. Poor thing. 

Again; I hate to write this. This was my second visit after a lackluster performance month ago with my parents. 

Oh and last -- they are slow. The wait staff is nice about it but food takes forever to come out of the kitchen. You'd think it wouldn't taste so awful with the time it takes.

Oh, Carino's, what has happened to you?  We used to go to this restaurant a lot.  It was our go-to.  The food was always good, the service was always great, the place was hoppin'.  We went there a couple of months ago, waited at our table for a half an hour for someone to come and offer us water or say hello, no one did, so we walked out.  A server stopped us as we were leaving and I told her that no one had come to see us so we were leaving .... 
We decided to try it again this week as we were looking for a soup and salad kind of meal.  The place wasn't busy at the lunch hour.  That should have been an indicator.  If a restaurant is not busy at peak lunch time - there is a reason.  We were seated quickly, and the server came by to greet us.  She was a really nice girl, but honestly she couldn't do anything right.  She forgot everything.  You'd ask for more bread, you wouldn't get it.  You'd ask for more soup, you wouldn't get it.  We received our bread and appetizer, and had no napkins or utensils.
For our appetizer, I had earned points through their Pasta Points program, and ordered the Italian nachos with no peppers - we aren't fans of heat.  The appetizer came out with the full jalapeno and pepperoncini treatment.  It was delivered by someone else, so we flagged them down and asked them to get us one as we had ordered it.  Our server came by to apologize for forgetting and said it wouldn't take long.  It didn't take long.  But in addition to making it without the jalapenos and pepperoncinis, they also made this one without the tomatoes.  We didn't send it back, it was just annoying really.  Some things shouldn't be that difficult.
We ordered the all you can eat soup, salad, and bread for $7.99.  The Caesar salad had a ton of dressing on it.  (I remember this from before.)  So much that it's so sour to eat.  But I did.  And I also ordered the potato soup.  This soup.  Not good.  The potatoes were cooked inconsistently.  Some were overcooked, some were undercooked, and some had that mushy gritty not good texture.  And it was soupy, but in the watery unflavored kind of way.
I don't know what happened to this place.  It appears that they have lost business because of it.  They don't have a lot of people working, servers look to have too many tables to handle in addition to other duties, the food is not the quality it once was, the value is not there, the bathrooms are not maintained, oh, and the salt and pepper on the tables is the little McCormick ones that you buy for a picnic.
Skip this place altogether.  It's nowhere near what it once was.

I have never had a good experience at this credit union. I bank through a credit union that doesn't have a location near my home, so I go to pioneer for account maintenance because of their shared branching program. every teller I have worked with has been rude, unprofessional, and condescending to me. they act like it's such a huge inconvenience for them to log into their shared branching system when I come in. I will definitely not be stopping by soon. if they do not like shared branching customers, they should stop supplying that service! every staff member needs a course in common courtesy! so disappointing! DO NOT bank here!!!

Employees are extremely disrespectful and unprofessional.  They used swear words at my son and were standing behind the counter making fun of him and his girlfriend.  Not only did they say swear words, but accused my son of using illegal drugs which is NOT okay.  We will never be back to this location!!

We stopped here on Thursday to enjoy my free birthday pizza which we have done since they opened. I always enjoy the atmosphere here and love that it's always warm because of their big brick oven. I'm  one of those people that is always cold so i love that it's nice and toasty. Our waiter was nice and efficient. After ordering our drinks he asked if we would like water and we said "one water" and he brought 2 warm waters! It was funny! We then ordered a house salad to share (their salads are huge!) and got 2 different dressings on the side which was fine but not what we ordered. The pizza is very good but gets soggy in the center really fast. I don't know if this is normal but it's normal for them. Their pizzas are VERY juicy and messy but good. Unfortunately every time we come here there is always a family that has crying children. Not their fault but it always happens so we don't come here often.

Damn it, Los Betos! I have been to both Boise locations and thought those ones were pretty darn decent, but tried this one for the first time recently. Went to the drive through and didn't want to cook at ALL for a full day, so I ordered three things: The Los Betos Breakfast Burrito, Carne Asada Chimichanga, and a simple Bean and Cheese Burrito. When I got the bag, a smile immediately went to my face because if there's anything I love about picking up things from any Los Betos, it's how HEAVY it is! YEAH PORTIONS! Went home to dominate this Mexican feast, set up shop on the couch, started digging into it all, and was slapped in the face by my old friend, Disappointment. 

Let's start with the Chimichanga. First off, it was lightly fried, which is fine I guess, but there was barely any crunch. It had the outer casing of a thrift store baklava. Have you ever had a thrift store baklava? Of course you haven't cause that's not real, but if it was, it had that consistency. Inside, the carne asada was cooked well I GUESS, but the flavor was BLEH. Tasted like salt had a brawl with a thrift store hot sauce and salt won, but you could still see thrift store hot sauce trying to stay in the fight. Just not good. 

How about the Los Betos Breakfast Burrito? This let-down may have partially been my fault because I am picky about hot dogs. This specific breakfast burrito had your normal egg, potato, cheese, and maybe something else, but the "meat" was chopped up hot dogs, which was STUPID of me to order but if you're going to put the name of your establishment's name on a burrito, it better be one of the best things on the menu. It was NOT. The hot dogs also tasted like they got into a brawl with salt and salt won. Big ol' salt theme going here. The burrito might have actually been decent if there was no hot dog in it at all, or better yet, sausage or bacon, which I might have to try another time. But no, the hot dog honestly made the whole thing not great at all. Even with their green hot sauce that I enjoy a lot poured on, I felt like it truly couldn't be completely saved. 

Ok, bean and cheese burrito time. It's hard to go wrong with one of these staples of Mexican food. Actually that's not true...I've had many EH B&C's...let me rephrase, it's not easy to find a GREAT bean and cheese burrito, and after trying this one, I will have to continue my search for the best one in the area cause it's NOT HERE! Just like the theme seems to be from my order on this day, they should have called this their bean and cheese and salt burrito. It really sucks because I could taste the good flavor in there somewhere, but there was just SO MUCH DAMN SALT! WHAT THE CRAP?! I hate to say it, but this was the best of the three things I ordered, which really speaks to how this day's meal was. 

So the theme of this place was SALT, and I was super disappointed. I still, for some reason, gave it 2 stars because, like all Los Betos locations, I LOVE the quantity. I will avoid this particular location 99% of the time, however if I do end up back here at some point again, it will only be because it's the closest Betos to where I live now and I still drink alcohol sometimes.
Holy Japanese Sushi. Best ever, my wife and I have been looking for a good place to have sushi. Went to Fujiyama's and what a phenomenal experience the spicy tuna rolls were phenomenal

I really enjoy the expository preaching and simplicity of this church. They don't add anything that could distract from the gospel. Pastor Ben speaks very clearly and the sermons are on point. The people here were not pushy or aloof but they did approach with gentleness and wisdom. I will definitely be coming back!

This is a solid breakfast spot that is definitely a go-to spot for many on a Saturday morning.

Met here for a Saturday Breakfast Club get together with fellow yelpers. Our group was pretty large, 15 of us. We thought we made reservations, but somehow there was a mix up and so. ..a bit of a wait. Not much room inside for a party that big to wait, but the hostess was well.... A good hostess and brought coffee while we waited.

Considering our group size, we were tended to very regularly and our food came out pretty much all together. 

My favorite was my hot chocolate. Came with roasted marshmallows on top. Yumminess! 

Their cinnamon rolls are gargantuous and looked amazing! I opted out as I am gf, but I didn't see anyone complaining. 

I ordered an omelette which came with potatoes and a side. It was delicious. One side option was the french toast which I picked and gave to my kids. It was the perfect amount and gave no need to order a kids meal.

Wish there dining area was a bit bigger. They seem to be consistently busy enough to warrant a bit more space. But I also understand the balance of keeping overhead low. 

I am not out often for breakfast eats, but would return again; fo-shure!!

Good food for takeout. We had difficulty ordering over the phone as they had trouble explaining their menu to us. We had a wonderful meal but the ruby red (sweet and sour) chicken was cold on arrival home. The cold ruby red chicken keeps them from a 4star rating.

I was looking for a sit down restaurant & found this... looked like it was based on a similar model to Chipotle's.  So figured I'd try it!  Boy was that a mistake!

I got their Sweet Pork enchiladas, which was the daily special.  While it was nicely done the "sweet pork" was too sweet & not much was in my meal.  The staff also doesn't listen to requests or answer questions about options.


My husband got the steak burrito & asked for the spicy red sauce and it was bland...even the hot sauce didn't make it more exciting!

The chips were nothing to write home about.  Everything is served in aluminum trays & plastic utensils, that break too easily.

On top of that, it was more expensive than my favorite sit down Mexican restaurant.  So not a good value for a mediocre meal.  I won't be returning.

I'm not sure what happened to Red Robin but it's not my fave burger joint anymore. We were seated on the patio as requested but soon found ourselves stomping ants. Lots and lots of ants. There's this stuff called bug killer. Use it! And it was kind of dirty out there. I know it's outside but some soap and water and some big killer would go a long way! Dirty outside, dirty inside. Our waitress was great. (I swore I was going to get her name but I always forget.) We ordered the A1 Peppercorn Burger and fries. Fries were excellent as always and the burger was ok. I don't think we'll be back in the near future. Too many other options.

We came in to buy a trailer and had an amazing sales experience. The salesman (can't remember his name, younger brunette and awesome) was FANTASTIC. He went out of his way to help us find exactly what we were looking for. The only issue we had was with the finance girl. She seemed to forget how to do her job and was in my opinion rude and unprofessional.  She made both my husband and myself feel uncomfortable and offended us several times. I understand the logic in bringing in young semi-attractive girls to work on the money side but maybe train them before you set them lose. We signed the final papers and then 3 times after that were sent an "oops I forgot to have you sign......" email from her. It was annoying and left a bad taste in our mouths. Overall a good experience management and the sales team were top notch.....finance however needs training. When you are dealing with hard working people don't insult our "measly income "....just saying

The Eye Site has been great, especially with our kids. Everyone here does a great job but I especially appreciate how good they are at helping us quickly find glasses that will look good on us. They are always straight forward with me about pricing. The glasses and contacts I have bought here fit better and last longer than the glasses I used to get from Costco.

Went here for lunch. Most of the sauces, desserts, meatballs, etc. Are made in-house. 
Gino's is not of a dinner place and I understand that the lunch menu is smaller and cheaper than the dinner one, but I have never had such a tasty and classy lunch for $10.
The decor and service are very good and I get the feeling that the chefs are native Italians.
Great place, will go again.

Sherry had a hankering for Asian food after a sweltering bike ride on the Nampa Greenbelt, and a Yelp search led us to the Red Pavilion. Who can pass up 4 stars with 207 reviews?

We opted for the Pavilion Triple Double which included two salads, two soups, two appetizers, and two main courses.  Unlike many of these specials, each of us got to choose our own dishes.  I had the hot and sour soup, spring roll and 'The Mongol' with fried rice, Sherry had the hot and sour soup, spring roll, and off-menu green beans and beef in black bean sauce.

The hot and sour soup was a disappointment with too much sour and not enough hot for me.  Sherry thought it was thickened too much.

The spring rolls were tasty, crispy and uniquely served in a stand-up dish on a bed of shredded cabbage.

My 'The Mongol' was flavorful and *hot* just the way I like it with tender slices of beef.  Warning - pick out the little chili peppers before you start eating. 

But the star of the evening was Sherry's off-menu green beans and beef with red bean sauce.  It was perfectly seasoned and the green beans were the perfect compliment, seared on the outside but still firm and exploding with flavor.

The only other disappointment was the service.  While our server was friendly and helpful (she recommended Sherry's off-menu main course), I had to go hunting for chopsticks, and my water glass remained empty through much of the meal which would have been a 5 alarm emergency if Sherry hadn't offered me hers.

I enjoyed working with Eric on painting our fixer upper. He's so skilled at refinishing cabinets. I'm 100000% positive that had I had someone else do the job, they would have told me to tear out and replace all the cabinets. Our budget was tight and I appreciated that he made a miracle out of them. Gave them life again!

Eric is very responsive and reliable.
The job took longer than anticipated, but luckily we weren't in a rush and it wasn't a big deal for me. I rather have someone skilled and who pays attention to detail than someone quick and in a hurry to just get the job done.

I'm going to ask him to come back in the Spring and paint the exterior of the home after our roof and siding is replaced. I hope he enjoyed working with me as much as I did with him.

My family and I were sitting outside the fountain at the Village when I smelled the delicious aroma of pizza coming from Grimaldi's. Being pregnant and driven my my nasal senses, I walked into Grimaldi's to order a pizza for takeout.

I ordered just a 12" pesto pepperoni pizza and was pleasantly surprised to find that the crust was exactly how I prefer: Thin, crispy yet chewy, and the pepperonis were mini and smoky. I assumed the pesto sauce would be under the cheese but it was actually on top. The pizza had excellent flavor and texture and I would definitely come back here.

Gino's absolutely made me fall in love with Italian food all over again.  It's one of two restaurants run by Gino and his wife - the other being Gino's Grill across the way.  It's located in the big building/parking garage off 8th and Main.  It's kind of small, but in the Summer you can eat on the patio.  

But the food is AH-MAZE-ZING!  Gino hails from Italy so you know it's very authentic.  The lasagne is to die for as it has several types of Italian meats and cheeses.  They constantly have specials like lobster stuffed ravioli, lamb dishes, or seafood pastas.  I've been there several times with friends and everyone always loved whatever they ordered.  

Gino's makes for the perfect romantic date or a good place to go for a family dinner.  Also make sure to say hello to Gino, he's a character and loves to take pictures!

Idaho Pizza company is actually really good honest pizza. I order from them exclusively when other cheaper options are around.  But I have a hard time rating them a 4, but I feel guilty of the 3 I am giving. It's probably a low 4 or high 3. 

So why the medium rating when this is my exclusive pizza joint? One draw back is the absurdity in the pricing scale. It almost feels like you are shoe horned into buying larges every time because the medium is nearly the same price. I ordered a medium yesterday and it comes to ~$17. And a large around 19. When you can order pizzas for 5-10 from competitors. So why do I order ipc? I think it's childhood nostalgia of what a good pizza looks and tastes like. 

They offer a killer lunch special, but the good pizzas are almost always gone so you have to wait for a replacement or try one of the different types that look like they've been sitting for a while. 

The local store is friendly and seems family oriented. I rarely go in to eat,  usually order delivery. 

Delivery times are usually quoted 45-50 minutes but I've had most deliverys arrive at the 30 minute mark. 

Overall I enjoy IPC, but it's a personal indulgence. If I have a group of friends over it's really not cost effective to order from them. Will look at the coupon deals I get in the mail from a competitor.

After several failed attempts I've finally gotten the opportunity to enjoy a breakfast (2) at Moe Joe's. Every attempt I've made during a weekend was fruitless as the wait time is just way too absurd for breakfast so we usually go somewhere else. But this time we went on. Tuesday because I needed to know the hype behind this joint.

First off I wouldn't classify this joint as a hole in the wall. It is a bit tucked away in an area dining isn't too common, but the location itself is clean and with modern decorations. 

The food itself has been nearly one of the best breakfast meals I've had in awhile. Definitely has a home cooked taste to it. I opted for the build your own omlete with hashbrowns and replaced my toast with a pancake. Lots of food but worth it!

My biggest gripe is the wait times, but you can't fault them for having awesome food people will wait for. Go early on a weekend or go on a weekday.

Denizens of Treasure Valley,  I don't make it out to breakfast very often.  Most breakfast fare (outside of a good poached egg) is pretty simple to make on your own, and you don't have to bug the waiter to get your bacon extra crispy (or extra soggy, if you prefer.)  But when the opportunity came up to finally attend an event with some fellow Boise Yelpers, I had to jump on it and head over to Moe Joe's.  So I just want to take a quick second to thank Ophelia for organizing, and getting the chance to meet everyone else who attended the "Breakfast Club" event! :)

That said, I have to start off with some negatives.  Moe Joe's really isn't set up to handle a large group like we had.  Despite having made prior arrangements for the event, it still took about 20 minutes after our prescribed time before we were seated.  I understand not every restaurant is equipped to handle a dozen people at once, but I have to say Moe Joe's kind of dropped the ball on this one.  I'd still recommend the place for a casual breakfast by yourself or a friend, but if you're bringing the whole office or something... I'd say "pass."

The food itself was well worth it though.  The cinnamon rolls (thanks again Ophelia) were as good as advertised.  My son plowed through most of the one we "shared" although I did get a bite or two.  The coffee was good, better than your usual "diner" fare, and refills were prompt and plentiful.  I got the Enchilada Chicken Stacker for my entree, and I enjoyed it... good portion size, good flavor.  The only "complaint" would be that I think I wanted more of that yummy cream sauce.  That was good stuff.

Bottom line folks, if you're looking for breakfast in Meridian, Moe Joe's will fill the bill.  Just don't plan a family reunion brunch there. :P
I love this place it has top notch pizza and breadsticks and it's cheap. I always feel bad when I get the buffet because it's really cheap

My hubby and I came here for our Anniversary.  I can't believe in the 4 years we have lived in Meridian, we have never been here! Totally been missing out!

Very nice atmosphere, and friendly wait staff.  They have an outside patio too, which looked nice.

We didn't have reservations, but got a table. I got the impression reservations are strongly suggested. I think we just got lucky.

There drink menu had a great variety of options, many of which sounded worth trying. Also an extensive wine list.

We ordered the caprese appetizer, which was very good. I am a sucker for fresh mozzarella and tomatoes. Wish there was a little less salt and some balsamic, but it was good.  Both our entrees were very good. I had a eggplant dish, which was almost like a lasagna. Came with a side of pasta, which they give you several noodle options. For an extra $1 you can get gnocchi. Love those little potato pastas! Hubby had a chicken pasta, with all kinds of goodies in it.

They give you a fresh basket of focassia bread and dipping oil, which was delicious.

Very authentic Italian! We will totally come back. Hopefully with enough room for dessert next time!
Great place to stay for weeks affordable. Alex from front desk she's amazing, friendly, helpful and pretty.
I eat here multiple times per month over the passed few years. Can't go wrong with their food. Consistent quality and friendly staff. Portion size is a great bang for you buck.

Great food in a typical small town diner. We always go for breakfast after our daughters soccer games. I love the country platter- not a meal for dieters obviously. Their cinnamon rolls are amazing and hubby enjoys their pancakes. The only thing we have ever been disappointed with was their blueberry muffin- small and tasteless and a waste of a side item. Everything else is great. Excellent prices for the amount of food you get, service is always super speedy and we never wait long for a table- even when we come in with a huge group of two families. A hidden gem that the regulars appreciate.

But don't come expecting a fancy breakfast- just excellent diner type food.

I was so excited to have a Pho restaurant moving in just down the road... but sadly it wasn't quite right yet. I know they are a new launching restaurant and that almost always means kinks to work out, so I am not giving up on them yet!
The Pho noodles were excellent, but a little strong on the flavor of the broth, I enjoy a more light flavor that I can doctor up depending on my mood though.  
The tables in the seating area were way too small, so much so that a party of four regularly sized individuals seriously cannot sit comfortably at the table. But the dining area is lovely (just needs more comfortable seating). 
The service was the biggest disappointment as they were too busy chatting in the kitchen and not paying attention to their customers. At one point I had to express "excuse me" loudly to get their attention. 
I will go back, I am excited to see how they grow in the area and improve what they offer.
Over-priced for average food, and small-ish portions.  We were really disappointed. It's worth driving a little further downtown to PF Changs, and skipping this place.
My mother and I have eaten here three times and each time had the pleasure of having Ashley as our server. She is a great! I hope we continue to dine with her!

Krissy is awesome! I hired her to come to my hotel to spray my bridesmaids, mom and mother-in-law for my wedding. She showed up on time and did a fantastic job. Most of them had never had a spray tan, and were a little nervous they would come out orange. They had no reason to be nervous, they all came out flawless! I highly recommend contacting Krissy for a spray tan! She's mobile which makes it even more convenient. Thanks Krissy!
Nothing extraordinary. Food good, not great. Prices average. Service ok.

I have to say I am slightly surprised at all the bad reviews for this place. I thought it was just fine!
came in for lunch on a tuesday, pretty quiet in here but I don't mind- less wait!

you order first and then sit down- there is a pretty extensive menu with thai food as well as a bunch of vietnamese dishes on there...let's be honest, if you're coming to a PHO restaurant- ORDER THE PHO! people complaining about their curry kind of make me laugh- get what they specialize in.

I ordered the beef pho for $8.50 which is great deal because downtown the same bowl is $15. the beef was very tender and flavorful, the broth was hot and perfect, and they gave you all the usual accompaniments like the basil/lime/jalapeños/sprouts for the top. coming from orange county where there is pho on every corner- this place is the real deal.

the server was whatever- he got tipped $1 because he didn't do much. I don't mind. 

I like this place and I would come back again for more!

I've gotten a pedicure here four times now, and each time is more delightful than the last.  The staff is always friendly and helpful. I'm always offered a bottle of water to drink, and made comfortable in the massaging chair before my pedicure commences. The staff is very conscious about everything they are doing, I'm never worried that the water will be too hot or my nails cut too short.  My nails are always done to perfection and I get a foot and calf massage to boot. The salon is clean and tidy with a television to watch or a magazine to read, and the owner and staff are relaxed and fun,  making the time there enjoyable. Will defiantly be visiting again and I highly recommend this salon.

Fabulous and personable service but didn't enjoy the jungle princess beef or the honey walnut shrimp at all. It all seemed to taste the same, the filet mignon in the jungle princess was the highlight.  Very large portions though, took home for hubby to enjoy later (he wasn't with us on our tryout of this place.)

The miso was sooooooo salty(more so than typical)  and I wasn't a fan of having cilantro in it, I like it more traditional, but I guess that is Asian fusion :)

The atmosphere was nice, but definitely felt chainy (ETA:  is it a chain or not?  I didn't check their website) , that is ok to me though.  Now, we came early and on our way out,   the wait would have been extensive.

The kids choices were the best-- they each got a bento with edamame, noodles, chicken and a sort of sweet and sour and wonton chips plus a bag of m&m's....they were in heaven.  On  initial approach I wasn't sure it was a kid friendly place, but it was, and our server took extra care of us as a result.  Very nice in that regard!

EDITED after reading other reviews:  Don't come expecting a PF Chang experience, definitely not, you will be disappointed.  It is definitely fusion --american meets asian subtypes.   There is meatloaf on the menu as their top menu item!  I think if/when we come back, we will be trying that meatloaf, because my server and most adjacent servers were recommending that as their favorite to the diners.

I will still most likely give the place another try, and will update my review accordingly.

The people were nice and they accepted my friend and me as walk-ins yesterday, however the woman who did my gel manicure obviously rushed. She used too much polish and I ended up with bulbous nails that are already peeling a day later and they aren't even dry underneath! Not only that, she didn't paint close enough to my cuticles so my nails look grown out. I'm embarrassed by the state of my nails now. I was down in Meridian visiting, and now I have to get my nails redone before my next trip.

Overpriced, tasteless, and sloppily made. Burger was nothing special and the beef patty was definitely previously frozen. The chicken sandwich patty is processed and tastes like the frozen ones in bags you can buy from any grocery store. Spent over $20 on two sandwiches with fries and a drink and we're still hungry and not satisfied with the food. Fast food burgers and chicken sandwiches taste so much better and are cheaper.

This was my first time in this Ulta and I was not impressed and probably won't go back. I was in the area where all the high end makeup is and walked by multiple employees and didn't get a hello, can I help you find anything, nothing. I would much rather drive to sephora then go here again.
I really want to love their food, but the veggie option is so boring. Just broccoli and cabbage. Would love to see some snap peas, bok choy, carrots, bamboo.

The portions were quite generous (I ordered the chicken teriyaki w/ pork and was only able to finish the chicken), and the chicken teriyaki is delicious. The mango bubble tea was also great.

Dinner cost ~$10 and the bubble tea ~$4.

Pip's crew washed and 43' motor home today after a year in storage and about 3,000 miles.  They did a great job!  No streaks or water drops anywhere. They even used window cleaner on all the glass as a finale!  

Will definitely use Pip's on a regular basis!
This place was only ok. The furnishing is really nice and they played good music, but the food was not worth the $50 check! The food was to the level of only ok Chinese take out.

I've driven by multiple happy teriyaki restaurants and finally decided to try it last week. Very friendly staff, delicious food, and a wonderful atmosphere. We had the chicken Katsu and I woulddefinitely get it again!!!

You guys have the best burgers!  I called in and placed an order (for 4 people) to be picked up and Natalie was awesome from start to finish, her customer service skills were outstanding, of course every order was different and she still got it correct.
Over priced food has very little to no flavor. The dressing is so thick you can barely get it on the salad. Would recommend if you wanted a quick boring unflavored meal other wise go some place else.

Our second visit since moving to the area. Busy but not overwhelming . Friendly manager greeted us as we entered . Good food like the 1st time . Wish they would have  more desert options ..all in all can't beat the price friendly people fresh food and cleanest buffet type place I've ever been to.

Ok, So I guess I messed up. I usually do my research before I hire or buy anything, But because the guy came to my door and he started talking his game I never really looked them up until after I was dissatisfied with their service and saw all the negative reviews.
Frankly, I can do a better job at getting rid of my weeds. I pay $50 a visit for literally 5 mins work. Ive paid for 3 visits and I have weeds all over my yard. Either the stuff they use is not good or the guy spraying it is not doing a good job (probably both). I really have no experience in any of their other products. They have always been nice but when I called to cancel they never asked why. To me that's sort of a red flag as well, If your good company then you'd try to save the customer or at least see what the problem was.

I won't even give this place one star! However I had to select one. My 17 year old daughter went into this "envy nails" salon tonight 01/02/2017 for an $18.00 FILL and got butchered and nails full of unfiled glue then charged $30.00! Don't spend your money here. Wish I could post the pictures I took. No happy ending here!

This sonic is horrible. Incredibly slow, always gets your order wrong, never gives you sauce when you order it. Today was the final straw for me. We pulled up to a stall, waiting 10 minutes for someone to answer the red button. An employee came out and told us that stall didn't work. It would've been helpful if there was a sign or cone or something to tell us this. So we pull up to another stall, a guy asks us what we want and as soon as we start ordering he says hold on. 5 minutes later someone walks up and hand writes our order. Food comes out 15+ minutes later but only half the order. The receipt has the whole thing but they only brought us half. The kid apologized and went back, brings us more food but still wrong. Finally a few minutes later he brings us the right food, with completely raw bacon. Not slightly under done, completely raw. Disgusting.

Ordered the Pho noodle soup with steak. Excellent - authentic with fresh basil, bean sprouts, lime on the side. Someone in my group had the Vermicelli with chicken. Really tasty with side of fish sauce, chopped nuts, all the traditional trimmings. Another in my group ordered the rice bowl with steak. It was a huge serving of white rice and a nice portion of grilled steak with veggies.
They've only been open in this place one week. A lot of people were in there eating, no one was disappointed. Gotta try the spring rolls next time! Plenty of choices to please anyone on the menu!

I know there has been some ownership transition here and a name change in the last year but I am a big fan of chicken/steak and rice.  During the transition there seemed to be some inconsistency but now I feel they are back on track.  I have had bowls, plates, Masubis and other stuff there and I have liked it all.  My favorite plate is the 3 meat plate and its totally worth the $10.  They have a lot of great sauces to chose from.  I believe they have Wi-Fi and the place is inviting.  I believe there is a current special for a Teriyaki Chicken or Steak bowl with vegetables.  Check it out if you are in the area.  I am thankful there is somewhat of a healthy place to eat in Meridian and I hope they stay open for a long time!  Love the local shops.
WE love it here! Super nice poeple and the best pop corn! Prices are low and they give refills and free pop corn salt! We will never go anywhere else :)
Love the food here! It's soooo good every time. The service is fine. Not great, but I don't like an overly attentive wait staff so I'm a happy girl. Yum!

This was THE WORST service and food that I have ever had. We arrived on a Saturday at about 5:50 and the place was vacant...I thought this was odd but oh well. We ordered 15 minutes after getting there and our appetizers were not brought out until 1 hour later and the first meal for our group was not brought out until we'd already been there for an hour and a half. Even more, our server was no where to be found and so when we tried to ask another server for help she yelled and said " I'm not your server. I'm trying to do my own thing here." Attitude much? The whole thing was a joke not to mention that when our food finally came it was ice cold. Yep, that's right. Ice. Cold. My noodles were colder than my ice water...that's saying something! Plus, even after being there an hour and a half I still had not been brought silverware so I was unable to eat my cold meal. Needless to say this was the worst place. Avoid it at all cost, do not go there. I'd give it no stars but unfortunately that is not an option.

This Sonic is the worst we have ever been to.  Service is slow, they often don't have what you order, and they routinely mess up the orders.  It seems that new management is really needed at this location.  Hopefully, they get things fixed soon.

I don't understand how they're going to stay in the business , If you're looking for Vietnamese Ph this's not the real ,,,  they need to have a real Vietnamese Good cook Ph ,,,, if there named business Ph

I like the staff here, the gym is always very clean and it is set up in such a way that you can get around to all the equipment you need. They also have a lot of class variety to offer and a great cardio media room.

2nd time to Ling & Louie's gotta say this place is awesome!! Devon was our server he was outstanding always attentive and very friendly. Noah the manager was very friendly came over a few times to see how everything was going and just so personable we felt very comfortable there. The first time we went we had Caleb serve us and we great as well. We highly recommend this place food was delicious but the service was great!!

Louie's is simple italian at a reasonable price,  feels like a 3.5 star kind of place.  We had the combination plates which got us two pastas, a pizza and salad for less than $12.  Nothing mindblowing about the pasta, just good, solid food.  The pizza was really good, with the sausage being the standout.  Even though it's out in the sadness known as the eagle road area, we'll keep making the trek from Les Bois every few months.

Ordered the general tso's, it tasted like barely warmed up frozen, tasteless chicken. I wouldn't be surprised if it wasn't even chicken. Probably the worst tasting Chinese food I've ever eaten. Went straight into the trash.

Goldy's prices NOT Goldy's quality!  

    It's been a great deal of time since my last visit and a friend mentioned she was in the mood for it so we went.  The place was packed which is always a good sign to me, parking was a nightmare as usual but that's another story.  We walk in and of course join the herd of people standing and waiting for a table, nothing like being on display for everyone that is already seated. 
    The people coming in behind us were honored people were holding the door open BUT little did they know those people were just waiting in the door way lol.  The wait was only about 10 mins and we were seated, so off to a good start.  
    It was after I opened the menu I had to be reminded I was not in downtown Boise but in Meridian.  I couldn't believe the prices matched that of Goldy's for every plate (meal)  was $10-12.   As always I don't mind paying but now the standards and expectations are higher, to my dissapointment the food was luke warm, and the hashbrowns were barely cooked and still white.  I LOVE HASHBROWNS...Don't they know breakfast is the most important meal of the day??? And apparently the most expensive meal too.  After our two meals, a kids meal, tax, and tip it was $38 down the drain.  Oh well 

 ***Bottom line the prices don't match the quality, the wait staff is too busy go come check on you beside your order and the check.  Hope sunrise is able to bring that small town feel back that made them so successful.    (Pictures to come)

Just called ahead and asked if they had time for 2 manicure pedicures if we came in now and they said yes. when we showed up 5 minutes later, they asked us to pick polish and then came over said they had made a mistake and could only take one. Totally unprofessional and possibly discriminated against, as one of us is male and we are both plus sized. The girl had a smirk on her face and didn't seem truly sorry at all. That fine....we have 4 people in our home that gets nail services regularly and we can take our money and business somewhere else!

DE-LISH.....have had Pho in many cities and this is some of the best I have had. We had cha gio, spring rolls, teryaki chicken rice plate and three different types of pho.  The place is cute, the service was super friendly & enthusiatic and the food was ALL Delicious! Will be adding this to our list of fav neighborhood restaurants!

Pips is the best. Professional,  honest and VERY on time. They just completed our 32 foot motorhome and it's showroom fresh. They do our other vehicles as well and I wouldn't have anyone else. Hardworking, honest, thoughtful and go over and above. Spencer and Jacob are  idaho gems. We are retired and they have simplified our vehicle needs at a very reasonable price. You will be very happy.

Came for a good burger and onion rings.  They were out of onion rings and the burger was below average. I should have read the reviews before I ate here.  I still like to give every place a chance and I was sorely disappointed.

Pretty good variety of Asian inspired dishes...kind of reminds me of PF Chang. Ahi Tuna based dishes are what they are known for - try Black Orchid Ahi.

Prices are about 10-12 per dish. They have a sushi bar and some people prefer to hang out there. They serve saki.

Tai Mai has a coffee flavor. I though that Mai Tai is supposed to be fruity.

Mongolian beef is my favorite for main course.
Great Phó, and the owners are very kind. This place is a go-to for the family and I regularly!

This place is terrible.  They do not cook their dishes fresh.  They either buy their dishes frozen then microwave and serve lukewarm over steamed rice, or they're re-heating leftovers and serving lukewarm over steamed rice.  The pho broth is overkill with cardamom. Steak is chunky rather than sliced paper thin...which is needed to cook in the steaming hot broth.
Absolutely love this place. The staff is friendly and welcoming. The food is fabulous and the prices are reasonable.

Update- spoke to the owner who proceeded to make a million excuses also telling me I must not know anything about Pho because it is their specialty. I know this much: It tasted like shit and the employees were rude, place was a dirty shithole and I'm out 38 bucks and at least an hour of my life dealing with this bullshit place..DONT GO!!!!

Wow, never had such a great version of chicken marsala,  served over ravioli!  The sauce was spot on,  creamy and full of artichokes and mushrooms.  The chicken was cooked perfectly.  
Included with a delish side salad and garlic bread.  Yum!

Nice decor, the wall of water is a nice feature and it's close to my office so it's a great, comfortable place to take business guests that's not too loud. We've tried sushi, pad thai, meatloaf, walnut shrimp, jungle woman (?) and it's all been quite good and they also have some good deals on the happy hour menu which are available  in the dining area and bar.
This place is disgusting and dirty. We got there when the theater opened, went to our assigned theater where there was hair and food covering the seats. I couldn't wait to leave.

Not the newest or most modern of cinemas but for my money, the best place to see a movie in Meridian. The Village Cinema certainly has more amenities but the leg room there is most uncomfortable. Much better at the Majestic. 

Don't rely on movie apps for movie times. We have missed a couple of shows over the years when the actual starting time was not what Moviefone said it was.

love the food but this space should be a take out only.  I sat with my family to eat our lunch while hungry patrons watched us intently as they waited for their take out order to be completed.  No escape from their peering eyes or their kids who were running around as if it were a waiting room.

Tried the new Meridian location today and wasn't disappointed - food was excellent and service was fast and efficient. The original BigJuds in Archer still has the best atmosphere but I'm glad to see this location close to work.
Best teriyaki In town!!!! Amazing friendly staff. It's an awesome mom N pop shop. It's a little spendy. But they give you enough food to last you the rest of the day!!!

There has always been at least one toilet out of order at this Walmart, but now the entire men's bathroom is closed.  The women's bathroom also has broken toilets.  If they can't keep the facility in order that the public sees, what does the back warehouse look like?
My favorite bar in Meridian! Has a nice vibe and the beers are the best in town! You can also get food from flatbread next door which is super good :) Trivia nights Wednesdays are busy and fun!

I love this salon! The staff are always friendly and accommodating, and they are consistently clean and comfortable. Every now and then I do get the uncomfortable side conversation in another language, but it's not as bad as at other salons and they make up for it with obvious effort to chat with us. They always remember my name too, which I appreciate. I'll be back.

Scott is a great Dentist!!  Very friendly and accommodating. He is great with the kids as well. The office has all the latest and greatest ( this is huge for me)!!  

Highly recommend this office to anyone looking.

I've been to this sonic many times and it has almost always been a pleasant experience. But the past time I went we had to press the button four times and waited at least 5 minutes before someone took our order. Then they forgot to give us our fry sauce so we pressed the button again, waited another 10 minutes, and then waited 30 minutes for the fry sauce to come out for us and it never did. We had to go inside and waste our time and ask for our fry sauce and finally got it by the time our food was cold. KEEP IN MIND that there were only 8 cars parked and ordering, and no one in the drive thru so they were not too busy to take care of our order. AND they have trash taste in music
Best Boba in Boise/Meridian!  Just wish it was closer to where I live.  Great atmosphere, menu and prices.

Good stuff for a great price I eat here about 3 times a month. The best value is with the daily bowls. They have beef and chicken for 6 bucks and Pork and spicy chicken for 7. I just had orange chicken and just like the bowls the chicken is soft and juicy unlike the bowls the Orange chicken is coated in batter that is light and crunchy. I am told they make their own sauce and you can see the Orange peel in it. The chicken is also hand battered in house which scored them extra points in my book I'm not a fan of frozen food from a bag like you often see these days. The food is not drop dead delicious but it is above average fresh well priced and the place is always clean with a friendly staff

I LOVE teriyaki. Ive been waiting forever for Idaho to get a good teriyaki spot. I grew up in Oregon where they had it all over the place, was sad when I moved here to,find none until happy teriyaki came along. Yum yum Yummm
I live in Nampa and drive to this location specifically. The Nampa one I've gotten rude service and they don't offer the teriyaki in bottle in the restaurant. I like to,drown my dishes, yes I'm horrible. Haha   
The meridian location is awesome!!
Always super nice, and good food.

I started going to H3 pets when I walked in, from a bike ride, with my Great Dane.  I wanted to get quality, non-processed dog treats.  I usually go to big, well known, pet store corporations for those soft 'bacon bites' dog treats.  The owner or manager gave me 4 heaping scoops of randomly, fun flavored of treats for free to try. They gave me oatmeal cookie, peanut butter, cheddar liver flavor, and the coolest one for when my dog has an upset stomach was the 'charcoal' dog treats.  I tried their dog food but it just didn't work for my Dane, and that's not to say it isn't high quality.  The staff is genuinely friendly in a laid back way.  Oh yeah and the prices are definitely not marked up and are super reasonable.

1st time here and had an amazing dinner with the family. The vibe was great, the food was epic and the service was top notch. I want to really thank Laura for  the amazing service! I will ask to be in Laura's section next time I make it in - I suggest you all do the same.

These gals are the best best best!!! They can do anything and won't gouge you! Plus they are so sweet! My daughter loves to visit and play with the fashion plates they have at the front table. Kasey and the girls will be getting all my business for any sewing project I have!!

I'm from SoCal visiting friends in Meridian.  Everywhere I visit, I like to try to find a noodle house.  It was lunch time and there was only three other parties having lunch.  I ordered the #9 Beef Noodle Soup.  The flavor was good.  Worthy of another visit to the resturant.  However, The service seemed slow, the noodles were soggy and for $10 I would expect the portion to be larger.  Overall I would come back.  Soggy noodles is an easy fix.  3-1/2 Stars

We went here on Friday evening after work for dinner. We were seated right away, no waiting, which was great. The server was very nice and friendly. I ordered calamari for appetizer, it was really good and great size for a family of 4. Then we ordered 6 rolls of sushi and 1 noodle from the menu. I also ordered a bowl of rice and chicken soup. It was really simple but so delicious! More like comfort food especially on a winter day.  The sushi came so quickly. They were good size and tasted good. Rice perfectly cooked and seasoned, fish did not taste fishy, veggies were still crunchy in the rolls. The noodle my husband ordered did not come soon enough though. They either forgot to put the order in or took few tries to make it. In my opinion, it should have taken them short amount of time to cook the clear glass noodles, if cooked too long they would break apart. Anyways, it took them almost 45minutes, we were done eating and then it showed up. They could have used more flavors/seasonings in the noodles too. Overall, it was good dinner.

This place has wonderful food. Teriyaki chicken and beef served with steamed veggies and steamed rice: a classic combo that they do well. They even have a spicy variety. Service was great and the cashier/server was very enthusiastic and friendly. Prices are acceptable and the restaurant itself was clean and pleasant. If you want a quick and quality teriyaki bowl and you are in the area don't shy away from this place.
Unfortunately the service was terrible and the food was cold and bland, had high hopes but was very disappointed.
I had the beef teriyaki meal. It comes with the usual beef, rice, and steamed veggies. Meat was very tender.

Pretty impressive variety.... sun dried tomatoes & alfalfa sprouts as a choice, very fresh fruits and veggies. The lemon chicken soup was fantastic, 2 bowls worth of fantastic. Pineapple was sweet.... One of the cleanest salad bars I've seen & can't beat this price for the selection.

I was happy to find this place and have something different instead of the regular fast food joints.

Was it the best Teriyaki I've had? No, but it was very good, especially for this part of the country. I've had better in Seattle and other big cities. 

Service was friendly and the food was satisfying and plentiful. Overall a good value. I wish we had Teriyaki this good back home.

I stopped here with friends (local) for dinner around the April 2012 time frame.  It was late (for Idaho folks I am told) at about 8PM on a Friday, but this place was open (many close early so this is not NY or LA for sure).
We were greeting and had a table ready to go.  The food was fine but nothing too spectacular but not bad or distasteful either.  The decor and ambiance was good and mostly subdued other than the "gong" at the bar which seemed to be a highlight to many.
The food arrived fast but there were not too many people left in the place anyway.

The price was a bit high for what you actually get but not by much.

My friend likes the place and goes often.  I would not be opposed to returning the next time I am in the area.

The fire display outside the restaurant was perhaps the most memorable feature.

Service today around 3pm was lousy. The place was rather empty yet they still took 50 minutes to bring us our food. The server messed up my husband's order and she never refilled our drinks. Even the table next to us made some comments mirroring what I have written here.

I can't say enough about how much I love getting facials with Ashley at Amber Rose. She is so sweet and kind, and she really does a wonderfully relaxing facial. I always leave feeling cleansed, calm, and glowing. About to make my next appointment just in time for the holidays. Ashley always gets me looking my best and gives my skin exactly what it needs!

Our dog eats a certain type of Diamond dog food that few owners feed their dogs. When I called them,  they didn't have any in stock. When I was about to say thank you and hang up, the employee said they could have it for me in less than an hour. 

The "scoop your own" (that's what I call it) dog treats are the bomb. Mix and match which ever dog treats for $1.00 per scoop (as of December 2014).

I can't say I'm too impressed with this place. The owners really need to spend some of their money on updating and cleaning. Even if they painted and cleaned it would make a big difference. Some of their booth seats have rips. I don't like the fact that their fortune cookies sit out in a large box and don't come in an individual wrapped packets. I never eat them. I don't feel like there selection of veggies and meats is huge. They do have a good selection of sauces. You always have to ask for rice instead of her asking if you would like a side of rice. I don't know of any other Mongolian restaurants in this area or I'd go there.
The owners put a lot of thought into the atmosphere and even more into the food. Home made sauces on chicken and pork. You can't go wrong when you go Hawaiian!

Great service by our waiter John. Food served in a timely manner and he stopped by and checked on us appropriately. Food was delicious and there was plenty of it in regards to the family style ordering.  We will be back!

I ordered the steak and vegan pho, I wasn't a big fan of the steak broth but I really loved the vegan broth! Overall everything was good. You order at the counter and then they bring out the food to your table.
We have been using Kris for a few years now and always have amazing results! She is such a great person as well. She is always professional and always on time and I highly recommend her.

Absolutely fantastic, I ordered the teriyaki chicken rice bowl, and it did not disappoint. The chicken, pan seared to a golden brown perfection, the broccoli and cabbage wasn't to soft nor was it to hard. With little tidbits of mushrooms here and there. All on top of your standard white rice, drizzled with teriyaki sauce with the perfect mix of seasoning sprinkled over the top. 
Serivice was quick and friendly, although I probably shouldn't have I ate the whole thing and enjoyed every delicious bite.

My husband and I decided to give this place a try on a Sunday morning at about 10:00 a.m..  The place was definitely busy but we were able to find a table right away.  We didn't know that it is a seat yourself type place so we were standing up at the front door for about 3-5 minutes before my husband finally decided to go up to the counter and ask about seating...I guess nobody bothered to tell us that we were supposed to seat ourselves because maybe they figured we were waiting for a different table than what was already available.  Anyway, once we were seated we ordered our food and received it about 5 minutes later!  It was pretty good too!  I had a California scramble (eggs, bacon, jack cheese and guacamole) and my husband had the bicuits and gravy.  This place isn't anything fancy but they serve a nice hardy breakfast in a jiffy!!  That's my kind of place!

I've had Village Coffee a few times, and their product is good! They make yummy coffee and also can sling a really good London Fog tea-latte.
