This might be trivial to some, but my main reason for giving it 3 stars is that I just can't get over the smell inside the area it's housed in. Village coffee shares quarters with Rice Works & Calle 75 Street Tacos. Each of these things on their own are SO good, but housed in one area together- it makes a really unpleasant smell.

Like I said, it might not be a big deal for some, but I think the reason it bothers me so much is because I love coffee for the experience of it- the taste, smell, atmosphere, etc. When I walk in to a coffee shop I want to smell freshly ground espresso, not a confusing and unpleasant concoction of scents. 

If you're looking to grab a cup of coffee and go, then Village Coffee is great. However if you're looking to linger and hang out, I wouldn't recommend it.

I don't even know where to begin. I can't say enough about h3 pet foods and everyone there especially Beth!! Wow they are so knowledgeable and kind and very patient with any questions you might have even if you have a lot of questions like I did. Beth spent a lot of time answering all my questions and it was not wasted. I will never go to another pet food store again if I can help it!! I highly recommend to anyone in the area to take the extra time no matter where you live to make the trip to h3 foods. You won't regret it!! Again thank you to everyone at h3 from me and Al Pacino he is  looking and feeling great!
I recently bought a car seat for my boy so he'll be safe and comfortable on long trips and they even put it in the car for me so I would know how!! It was easy but that is customer service there!
Very clean inside the rented space as well as the driving pathways. Easy set up in person. They have an after-desk-hours kiosk. Long open hours. Proper drainage pathways. Anti-theft type locks.

I will be in tomorrow for Easter dinner. Recent reports have been stellar I see. I've been here in the past; multiple mistakes decided to not go here again. I'm being 'treated' to dinner so I will report any improvements. Giving a 5- star for now: I'm very optimistic they will meet expectations. Stay tuned!

Love this movie theater. We go there almost every Tuesdays when it just cost us $5/ person! The only thing I don't like is they charge 50 cents if U want to put some flavor on your popcorn it used to be free.
Quik Wok's delivery is so fast(15 minutes early!) The guy on the phone was so generous! I've always loved their food, but the delivery made it even better! Thank you for awesome service

The Cardio Cinema is hands down the best work out concept ever! I get to work out in the dark and watch movies while I do it! The screen is movie theatre size and the sound is great (they've even turned it up the one time it wasn't loud enough). I've seen an array of film genres, current and classic and I love it!! PLUS they offer responsible child care for up to two hours while you work out! I appreciate the limited # of children they accept to keep a higher employee to child ratio, and you have the option to wait until other parents pick up their children if they are at capacity. Can't wait until they add more classes to the schedule!
Great teriyaki chicken, spicy teriyaki chicken, and teriyaki beef. Fried rice is good, not great, but an excellent value for a full plate and quick meal

Fantastic service! And I have more insurance for less!
Steve is the utmost professional, he know his stuff and will get you the most bang for your buck. I'm very happy!

Our server was AWESOME! Especially since there wasn't near enough help. What manager scheduled one bartender and server on a Friday night.  
Took a half hour to get our drinks.  Server went to the bartender several times to try and get them sooner to no avail she was just to busy.
Food was excellent like the new recipes on some of the appetizers.
This would have easily been a 4 star review had there been enough help.

This place sucks compared to the other ones service was horrible he dropped all my vegetables while cooking my food so I only got a bowl with noodles there very picky they don't want you getting a second bowl for your sauce and there's signs saying don't push your meat down in the bowl and there more expensive then other places won't be back to this one ever!

I LOVE this place!! Jeff is beyond helpful anytime I ask a question and Linda is always so sweet. I order Raw food in bulk and buy Kangaroo kibble. They're always so great to work with. I've sent friends and family here and everyone has sent me a message saying how helpful and nice they were. 
Also...anytime I have an option to support a local small business I choose to do so.

If you like japanese with a smidgen of korean fast food. This is the place for you. It's located in the village surrounded by much better options to eat. The teriyaki chicken was alright. The time it took to get it was not alright, as we waited 20 minutes for "fast food". The wontons came out at the same time as the food even though they are classified as "appetizers". 

Not a place I would go to again or tell anyone about. I experienced it now time to move on.

I don't give out five star reviews that often, this place was a hidden gem. First glance, it looks like it's going to be another low ball Chinese Food place, but don't let that deceive. 

PROS:

- I had on two different occasions, the spicy chicken teriyaki and the orange chicken. The chicken is cooked perfectly and is not tough.

- The spicy is just enough heat. AMAZING egg rolls

- the price was perfect! Around 10 dollars.

CONS:

- They do not take AMEX


I was very surprised on this place. I will eat here again when I am back in Boise.

Wanted to update with another 5 star review. This time i tried the 4 hour solution. A-MAZING!!! Same great tan but only took 4 hours to develop and i could shower and not worry about ruining clothes or sheets. AND i was able to attend an event same day that evening with a perfect sun glow!  It's been 2 weeks and it was hard to tell where my natural tan kicked in and where spray tan faded away! I did have a little blotchiness under the boobs/upper torso area after a week but nothing awful that a good loofa couldnt erase. Im not sure i can ever go back to old solution and wait like 12 hours for tan to develop before showering!?! If you haven't tried Krissy or the 4 hour spray tan, I HIGHLY RECCOMEND BOTH!!

Nothing spectacular here but in Boise good Chinese is nearly if impossible to find.   Specials are very aggressively priced and the food amounts will rival "Claim Jumpers" if CJ did Chinese cuisine.   Food is a generous 3/5 stars but be prepared if you get the specials, I believe absolutely everything on the plate is deep fried except the two pieces of BBQ pork.   

We keep going back and will continue to do so.

Had the Sizzling Salmon. It was amazing. Sweet with a little bit of a spice kick. Loved it.
Prices were very reasonable.

This was my first time getting a spray tan at home and Krissy did an amazing job! She was prompt, the set up was super easy, and she made me feel very comfortable the entire time. The results lasted for my entire week in Hawaii and looked very natural but noticeable.
The Best!!!  My husband and I got the Drunken Chicken and the Chicken Fried Rice...best ever!

Louie's has been my favorite Italian restaurant in Boise since they were located downtown; up to that time, my favorite was Noodles (where The Reef is now). The quality at Louie's is consistently outstanding and I always receive good service. They have the best lasagne I have found. The menu prices are a bit high though considering that the serving portion sizes appear to have been reduced.

Imagine a train wreck that you can't stop looking at. We went here Father's Day evening and were surprised by the 25 minute wait which is pretty unusual but expected for Father's Day. We get seated and wait probably 8 minutes (literally) before our server even acknowledged us. In fact the hostess walked by our table and seemed horrified that we hadn't received drinks and actually apologized for the server which was nice but an apology isn't going to get the meal started. Fast forward a couple minutes and we have our drinks and food ordered at the same time-Plenty of time to look over the menu. I see and hear a lady get up and walk across the dining room to track down here server to ask for refills. That's embarrassing. A family gets up and leaves complaining about the '2 hour ordeal'. Another family walks out complaining about the price/quality ratio. Another family leaves without audible complaining. Before our food was delivered there were 4 tables that needed to be bussed. When we left there were the same 4 tables that needed to be bussed. The food wasn't bad but the Alfredo sauce definitely needed help-standing butter in the dish of fettuccini. The calzone was good. The service NEEDS HELP!  On our previous visit the bread served looked like it was sat on it was so smashed and flat. The same visit we waited for what seemed like an eternity to get refills. My wife's salad came without nothing but lettuce and cheese and when we brought it to the waiters attention (probably 15 minutes after it was delivered because there was no check back) and she couldn't have cared less. Long story short, average food but terrible service. Management please spend some money, time or both training your staff. The service is what will keep us from coming back. You raised the prices pretty substantially and the service doesn't reflect the prices. Olive Garden and Luciano's are beating you in both service and quality. It's not too late to turn the ship around. Remember there are plenty of other Italian restaurants in the market-you don't have a captive audience.

We waited quite some time, after the hostess sat us, to wave over a passing waitress to help take our order. We weren't in her section but she didn't waste anytime putting a rush on our order and notifying the manager of the delay. The manager came over to apologize and gave us two free appetizers. Nice save! 

We had the pad thai and the surf and turf which were quite good just a little overpriced for what it was.  We also had the ribs which had a pretty good flavor but we found ourselves pulling splinters of bone out of our mouths while attempting to eat them, they too were quite overpriced for what it was. 

Would I go back? Yes. I'd give them another shot.

Denizens of Treasure Valley, there are times when "gourmet" is the furthest thing from your mind.  There are times when white tablecloths, folded napkins, and chandeliers are the last thing you want.  For times like these, we have places like the Hungry Onion.  I found this place because I began frequenting the Big Star Coffee shop just up the road.  They are some of the best "grease bomb" burgers I've ever had.  It has the old vintage "drive up" feel and really nails a good ol' fashioned "grease bomb" burger.

That said, it does create a couple of caveats, but if you know that going in, I think you'll be very satisfied with this place.  So it is drive up service... no inside seating, and the service is a bit on the slow side for burgers and fries.  So if you've got a car full of grumpy toddlers, keep on driving.  This isn't the place to stop.  Also they are very much "grease bomb" burgers.  There is nothing healthy about what you will get here.  But if that's the kind of burger you are craving, this place will absolutely satisfy.  Oh and the fries are HUGE portions.  I got a large not knowing how "large" it would be, and had a hard time finishing it myself.  The small will more than suffice for a single person.

Bottom line, when you are looking for an excellent (and totally bad for you) burger experience, pull into the Hungry Onion.  You'll be lip-smackingly satisfied.

Ok..First time ever getting a pedicure and I gotta tell ya....WOW.  They clean your nails, soak your feet, scrap the icky dead skin away, and lotion you up while you relax in one of those massage chairs.  Super friendly environment as return customers where greeted coming through the door by their first names.  Not sure I would like it, and I didnt.  LOVED IT. I will be back!!

Love Tina Lee and Tina! Both these ladies put my nails on Perfectly! I Love my nails thin and realistic looking. That's exactly what I get from both these girls! Thank you so much! Love my new set!!! Beautiful!

Very first visit on 4/22/16 (Friday) 6ish- with a party of 6+high chair

Told a 40min wait- and got seated 35 min later. 

Food took over 30min to get served 

Service was slow- but hope it gets better.

Burgers were over cooked- although we weren't asked how we liked them cooked. 

2 from our party fell ill after leaving, until the next day. 

Didn't get any dessert- might be the only thing we get if we go again Was hoping for something better. 

Bacon on my burger was the best thing on it- Ranch dressing was delicious.

Worst service ever. They have delivered to my house 3 times, and the fourth time they call me and say they don't deliver to my house anymore... This was 45 minutes after I already ordered. Lost my business! Zero stars would be more like it.

I don't usual review but after my experience here was an utter disappointment I felt the need to share. I ordered to go and when I opened my order there was barely anything I would have eaten... my chicken pho came with beef broth, my spring rolls were sloppily rolled and coming apart, also I have never been anywhere where they put beef, chicken, and shrimp all in a roll together, but that's just me. We also ordered sweet and sour chicken, there was nothing sweet about it... The only thing that was semi decent was the egg rolls. The staff here has a lot to learn about customer service, 2 teen boys who were short with customers and not engaging at all.

Sometimes even the best planning has a hole in it.  On our way back from downtown Boise, our son got really cranky so we just had to find something near our hotel.  That's how we ended up at Louie's.

Service:  2/5

This was the first meal on our trip that got off on the wrong foot.  As we walked in the door, there was no one at the hostess station.  We stood there for a minute, then this lady who was sitting and eating in the bar area finally came over and asked us if we needed a table.  Now I get that we all get breaks, I don't begrudge anyone that.  But if you're going to take a munchie break "on the clock," do try and be a bit more attentive while you are doing so.

Our waiter was not that impressive either.  He was slow taking our order.  He brought our pizza after bringing our main meals.  It was generally not impressive service all around.  At least we didn't have to wait for our check at the end.  That's one of the things that irks me most when they drag their feet on bringing the check.

Food:  3/5

Again, this was the first meal that really left me feeling unsatisfied.  The salad seemed like one of those "straight out of the bag" deals.  The pasta dish I ordered was very uninspired; bow tie pasta with grilled chicken and onions.  My wife was happy with her chicken Marsala, and I did enjoy the pesto and sausage pizza that we ordered.  It was serviceable food.  Nothing was inedible or improperly prepared, but overall there wasn't anything about their food that impressed me at all.

Overall Impressions:  3/5

The decor and atmosphere was actually the most impressive thing about the place.  It looks and feels like a good Italian restaurant should.  But frankly that will only raise your expectations a bit higher than they should be.  My advice would be to stick to the pizza.  It seems to be the only thing they do at anything above an average level.

If you are really looking for Italian food in the Meridian/Boise area, I'm sure there have to be better places than this one.  I can't really give it a good recommendation.

What can I say, Leif is AMAZING!!! He was the photographer for my engagement shoot and as well for my wedding, and the photographs are absolutely beautiful. I have gotten nothing but compliments on them. I'm just one of those people who don't like getting their picture taken, but Leif made me feel so comfortable and at ease. My husband, who is way more camera shy than me, says he's never felt more comfortable than he has with Leif behind the lens.
Leif was always prompt, and worked really hard to make sure all the pictures I requested were shot. He goes above and beyond to get amazing photos, and has a great eye. I've also gotten glowing compliments from other vendors who worked with him at my wedding.
I can't imagine working with any other photographer from now on. Definitely check out his website and blog, you'll be blown away!

This was a great experience, the food the service. Haily was great, her service and recommendation were right on. The food was so full favor and the menu has variety of great choices.  The ivory Pearl roll is to die for, a mixture of different ingredients that makes a perfect roll.

Ordered the #6 Pho. I always taste the broth prior to putting any fixin's in and the broth was really good. Not the best I have ever head but really good. Pho comes with all the regular accompanying bean sprouts, basil, lime, jalapeños, etc. 

Ordered a chicken pho sandwich that had excellent flavor with a super crispy bun.  

Service was quick and friendly. 

Not sure what was with the other reviews but this isn't a 1 star review place. 

Give it a shot and decide for yourself.

Great place for feeding a family with little kids. Selected our food so they could eat quickly. Had good selection for salads and soups.  Pastas, pizza and potato selection was also good. 

Manager and hostess were very helpful getting us set up.  Would have liked more hot tea options (only black), juice instead of soda for kids and more fresh fruit. 

Everything seemed fresh which we were concerned about based on other reviews.

First off, this is very unusual Of me to write a poor review. But, after my experience at the Linder sonic, I could not help myself. I ordered a breakfast burrito, and a slush. The burrito took 15 minutes and the slush was so melted I would call it syrup in a cup. When I finally received my burrito it tasted horrid. The cheese was not even melted, the tater tots, well they were the only good thing about the burrito. If I were the people of the Linder sonic I would feel poorly, and hopefully they can change my experience the next time I'm in.

On The Spot Cleaners is on the spot.  Fast, friendly, courteous, and usually done early.  I love this place, because I know when time is limited, I can count on them.
06/22/18 Today, I went in for a pickup.  They had misplaced a pair of slacks.  They called a little while later.  They were found.  When I went in to pick them up, the owner gave me a $10 off coupon.  Awesome business!  Thank you.  You really are "On the Spot!"

Got my work pants hemmed and got them the next morning!!!Quick and fast and not as expensive!!! Nice lady but english not as good but she understood what l wanted. l would go back to her to get my pant hemmed.
First time we have been here. We had a excellent lunch and excellent service. Our waiter was great was there anytime we needed something. I highly recommend

I had to come here for a sad event, so I really wasn't looking forward to it. I tried to find a hotel that wasn't too expensive but that had some of the amenities I was looking for. We arrived in town and immediately checked in with no issues. The front desk area has snacks, frozen food and sundries and free fruit. The breakfast is tremendous for being free at a hotel. Fresh cinnabon rolls, pancakes, eggs toast etc. 
The pool and hot tub are 24 hour, as well as the gym. They keep the pool area clean and warm so you can go anytime (in my case, some night swimming to clear my head). The hotel is situated closeby to local restaurants and a walmart if you need to get anything you might have forgotten on your trip. 
The beds are super comfortable. Probably the best mattress I've slept on away from home.  
 I had a room with a jetted tub and it was so nice to be able to soak in it before my long drive home. This hotel is a gem and I'm so glad I know it's there if I ever go back to Boise.

The food was good enough. But the place was super warm and stuffy (probably trying to save money on the A/C). The food took forever and then I noticed that a large group that came in AFTER me was actually served first. Later the owner (or the guy walking around in the back kitchen area) came and sat down with the group. Not a good way to run a business. I won't be coming back.

The ladies here are quick and efficient. The establishment is clean and professional as well. Of the many customers I saw getting pampered, all of them seemed happy. 

My wife used the waxing services and they did a great job, quickly for a walk-in.
easiest gas station in town for all your needs...car wash is the best in town and drive thru window...oh yeah..thanks guys

I like it here because they close a lot later than everyone else, which is very convenient. But massively, massively full and wait times are horrendous. I really don't want to download an app just for this? But...... Oh well!

45 minutes wait on lunch hour when we were literally the only people there (that should have been a clue). When my boyfriend asked what was taking so long, he was told "we had to make rice". Shouldn't that have been done before opening??! Tasteless food. Won't be back.

Had an unfortunate experience here yesterday, while the food was very good- initially- I discovered the very unfortunate use of MSG. I have migraines and msg is one of my triggers. You really should list that you use this ingredient on your website, your menu, everywhere! There are enough people that also have extreme sensitivities to this particular ingredient- had a wonderful lunch only to become extremely and violently ill about an hour or so after eating here. Was really hoping that this would be a great restaurant, unfortunately, it is not.

I have not eaten here for dinner (I live across town and work in the area) so I hit up Louie's for lunch A LOT. As far as salad, pasta, and pizza bars go Louie's is the best in town. The salad bar is excellent, and includes any topping you could want along with fresh fruit. The pizza is also some of my favorite pizza in town. The price is around $6-7 which I have no problem paying. If you are looking for a solid lunch check out Louie's.

Mike is hands down the best real estate agent I have ever worked with.  I have been investing in real estate since 2001 and have worked with many different agents, many good and some bad, so when I say THE BEST, this says a lot.  Our family relocated to CA from UT for work, and Mike was the calm in the storm for us.  He was very patient in taking time to help find the right house in the right area for our family.  This was a big move for our family of 8 and we were looking for the right home and area that would make the transition the easiest for our teen, our 11 year old, 9 year old and our triplet 4 year olds.  He is very knowledgeable about the entire Bay Area and its surrounding locations and was always able to offer objective insight for each home, which schools to look for, which areas to avoid and which restaurants to try.  When we finally found the right house, it was a short sale, and he was the force that kept the sale moving through that strenuous process.  If you are in the market to either buy or sale, Mike is your guy!  We will be using him for sure in our next transition on both sides!
Nice warm atmosphere but the coffees are literally the worst you will ever have. You're just paying for the location. Get some Dutch Bros. and then come in here to warm up. You will be glad you did

Went out of my way to try 'Ohana Hawai'ian BBQ and I was disappointed.  The plate lunches were over priced and you get half the portion size when compared to other Hawaiian joints in Boise.  Food wasn't bad but the cost and volume was a real letdown.  Will not return.

I am updating my review due to outstanding customer service coupled with a strong history of serving outstanding dishes.  I was disappointed with a meal a couple months ago.  The restaurant responded beyond my expectation and won me back as a loyal fan.

I was seeking out places to shop for my 7 month daughter in the area as we were visiting Idaho and I came across this place via Yelp. I am super glad I came in. I ended up buying two small toys, and many clothing items for me daughter for when she starts wearing 18 months. Great deals that met my requirements. Super clean and organize which met my requirements. Friendly folks working, as well. When I come back to this area, it definitely will be my go to with my daughter

It's your basic teriyaki joint. The tv with ESPN on was a nice touch. I had shrimp fried rice and it was pretty darn good. The staff was friendly, the food came out fast. If I am ever in the area again, I'd eat here.

Showed up 5 min before the kitchen closed.  They took oir order and were very helpfull in explaining what were favorites.  When our food arrived to go as ordered they brought us an extra side of rice and to go cups of water and ice.  Great job!!!!!! Food was amazing!!!!!

I went about a week and a half ago for a banh mi and threw in a side of egg rolls. Based on the wait time and other reviews, they are going through some growing pains, but acknowledged this and were apologetic. 

The sandwich was tasty, though, and the egg rolls crispy and good, served with a side of a spicy chili sauce. 

Went back tonight for the Pho, this time the order was prepared in a very good timeframe.  Got the steak and brisket.  Needed a bit more fresh basil, but the meat was very tender and the broth was well done.  Added a side order of shrimp and pork spring rolls, those were very good, served with a side sauce akin to a bbq sauce with peanuts.  Different but good.  

They are a 3.5 star restaurant, I round them up to 4 stars for being close to my home and for being open 7 days a week!  My wife and I order Pho a lot and get frustrated with the lack of options on sundays and mondays.  ;)

Arrived at the Village Coffee on a Saturday morning just before opening at 10 am and the machine were not ready for us as much as we were for them. We didn't have to wait long before we were sipping on their salted caramel mocha. What a delicious drink it was so rich and creamy.  

The area has multiple wooden tables and chairs and a nice comfortable seating area in front of a fire place. We found ourselves talking for two hours sipping on our drink before moving on to other stores in the Village.

Each time i drive by, I always think I should give the 50's cafe a try, but haven't gotten around to it.  Decided to try it today since it was nearby and lunchtime, and I was glad I did.  I always love 50's style diners, but often leave disappointed by the bland and poor quality food, but Ed's leaves little disappointment.  The French fries were great!  The lightly battered fries were perfectly golden with good seasoning and the fry sauce served to compliment rather than cover the taste of poorly flavored spuds.  My french dip was tasty served on a soft French style roll with gooey, perfectly melted Swiss cheese and plenty of sliced roast beef atop.  The pickles that came on the side, once added to the sandwich, provided a great vinegary tang to contrast the beefy, salty, but not overly salty au jus the sandwich was dipped into.  I also sampled a bite of their chicken fried steak which was the classically cooked 50s style version, which was more like a battered and fried cube steak, with a creamy gravy on top.  While the gravy itself wasn't spectacular, once combined with the fried steak, it came together nicely.  The ice tea was home brewed, the service was good, and the food came out hot, quick, and was reasonably priced; under $10 per person including a drink.  While menu is slightly limited, I will definitely come back as there's still plenty of options to choose from.

Convinced the whole family to try Vietnamese. Pho 779 was a hit! Altogether we tried Shrimp Pho, Steak Pho, Grilled Chicken Sandwich, and Sweet & Sour Chicken.
For making everything by hand and when ordered, the food came out faster than I expected. You could taste the freshness in every bite. The plate of herbs & veggies allowed you to make each dish personal.
Even though we were having a late lunch, no one was able to finish their meal. We sampled each other's food and liked it all. Even the kids enjoyed every bite.
Also - try the Vietnamese Latte. It's fantastic.

The room was comfortable and clean. The breakfast was, hands down, the best hotel bfast I've had in a while. The pool area and workout rooms were well maintained and the staff were so kind. I would definitely recommend this hotel.

Haven't been to Louie's in many years, and thought we would give it another shot. I remembered the food being so-so.
Upon entering, the decor was nice, but worn. You could tell this place looked really good when it was new, but now showing its age.
We were greeted by a very nice young waitress, and seated. Our table was very wobbley, but decided to make due.
We looked at the wine list and ordered a bottle of Pinot Noir. The waitress came over and apologized ahead of time that she wasn't very good at opening wine bottles. I could tell she had not been trained very well, if at all, so we helped her. Not her fault.
We then ordered. A anti pasti plate that consisted of all the usual items. It was large, and could have been a meal in itself. Everything tasted.....ok. Nothing special.
We then received our salads which were good with house dressing. By this time, we were full.
I ordered bake rigatoni with meat sauce, and she had meat raviolis. Both were ok... See the theme here?
So, in closing, service was good, food, and decor were just ok. I will say that the prices were very reasonable. 
If you want a big portion, at a reasonable price, this place will work. For finer Italian, look elsewhere.

Food was pretty solid. Service was atrocious. Portions were much bigger than I remember(and bigger than other local italian restaurants, thankfully). And someone kept bringing me baskets of garlic bread, so I can't complain too much.

I have been here many times wth my husband or friends.  We always got good service and liked the food so I felt like I could recommend it to our club for Christmas lunch this past Saturday.  It was embarrassing.  Everyone thought the food was ok but the service was lousy.  I guess the waitress thought that since there was an automatic 18 % gratuity on our bill that she didn't have to even try.  I won't be recommending this place again.

The appetizers,the crab won tons and calamari were awesome!  The entrees were only so so.  I've had better at a neighborhood Chinese buffet for a much lower price.  The table was tiny and cluttered with menus and chopsticks. The service was only ok.  I would come back for drinks and appetizers. ..maybe.

We visited on a Saturday but it wasn't very busy.  Service was slow. Food was average but the portions were huge.  My son said the pizza was good because it was "tasteless".  We took home leftovers but it will probably be a while before we return

4/11/15 - The owner reached out concerned about the level of service and I appreciate the contact.  I upgrade my review to 3 stars.  We can certainly all have an off service.  I ate all the leftovers and think I might have enjoyed them more than the original.
The pho they serve is okay, their service is slow, and the environment is awful. You know a restaurant is excellent when you're a minority and this restaurant does not have that.

First impression: very clean, spacious, and reminded me of being in a mechanic-like place. I've eaten at Big Jud's by BSU before and really liked it! 

Today, I ordered a mushroom burger and was really satisfied! The portion size was pretty big! The large tots were huge! Fried to crisp perfection, with yummy fry sauce to go with it. The huckleberry milkshake was delicious! 

All in all, highly recommend this place!

I have to update my review simply because we have continued to come here but the place has gone downhill.  
They have a front gal taking our order who looked like she just rolled out of bed barely brushed her hair or teeth.  She acted like us being there, ordering food, was a cramp to her style.  She was openly rude and lacked any semblance of customer service skills.  We are waiting for our order and I am seriously afraid of what she might be doing to our food.  Do yourself a favor.... avoid.  At least until the owners decide they want their business to survive and chooses to hire help that does not damage or ruin their business.

Update: 1/27/17 we were saddened to find this great family restaurant closed tonight. My kiddos were especially upset since they enjoy getting to pick their own food. I know the owner Bryan worked tirelessly and it is a sad thing to have to close your doors (had that difficult experience myself). 

Hoping all the best for Bryan, his family and their next adventure!!

------
(Previous)

Great place for feeding a family with little kids. Selected our food so they could eat quickly. Had good selection for salads and soups.  Pastas, pizza and potato selection was also good. 

Manager and hostess were very helpful getting us set up.  Would have liked more hot tea options (only black), juice instead of soda for kids and more fresh fruit. 

Everything seemed fresh which we were concerned about based on other reviews.

Stopped by for dinner last night. Tried their Louie's Loaded Nachos, Pan-Seared Pot-stickers and the Spring Rolls from their appetizer menu. I didn't care too much for the Nachos probably because of  the Wasabi which just didn't seem to fit in with the other flavors. The potstickers were just so so but the Spring Rolls were amazing. Wished I did three orders of those instead of the other items. They started shutting down kind of early for a Friday night.

Basic staples on the menu.  Prices a but high for what you get.  Food decent,  place was clean except the bathroom needed some attention.  
We had Burgers and the wife gave it a 7 out of 10. Mine was a Dbl but had much smaller patties than the wife's single.  I rate it a 5 out of 10. 
Service was good,  except our order was messed up but that happens. Overall,  it was good,  not great.  Might have to try it for breakfast which it looked like most folks we're ordering even though it was noon.

Krissy did a fantastic job!  She was prompt and friendly and really knows what she's doing.  She was in and out of my house in 25 minutes, including set up, tan, and break down.  It's my second day and the tan set in and it looks great. Very even and great color - doesn't look orange at all.  I got the one that sets in after 4 hours.  Amazing work - I'll will use her again!!
This restaurant has the rudest wait person "Maria" . Most unprofessional individual. Maria! If you have to hand pick your customers, it's prabably time to retire. Worse service person ever!!!!
Amazing facial looking forward to my next one!!!!!   One year later, Amber Rose skin care is amazing!!!!!  Thank-you!!!!!

My husband and I had our wedding reception here. The food was amazing, we ordered family style. The chicken marsala was authentic New York Italian and trust me I use to live in New York.  The service was beyond amazing. While we were cutting the cake, the server sang an amazing Italian love song and yes, in Italian!!! You absolutely cannot beat the cost for a reception here. They only charged us for the food and tip! Absolute perfection! I highly recommend to budget conscious brides and grooms.

I took my kids to the meriduan Applebee's mon night. Not very busy. Servers were persistant in getting the dinner order and were nice. I hadn't been there in a while. After spending some time looking through the menu, basically wanting to just leave. We decided to just stay so we didn't have to drag the baby back out into the cold. We were told that the 2fer appetizers were half the size as the reg, once we got the regulars, I was like dang how could the 2fers be half of that? The menu was a failed attempt at being a fancy resturaunt, as was the food. For the price I will def go to Red Robin next time. I miss the old Applebee's, higher quality, better taste, so it was worth the price. Very disappointed.
I wanted a big salad with a ton of fresh veggies & that's exactly what I got! Had a cup of soup which was also tasty. The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is the super annoying music.
I've been going here for years. It's a great place for an inexpensive haircut. Everyone is super friendly and they all seem to enjoy their job.

Amazing authentic Italian cuisine! Great customer service. Appropriate drink pairing choices. Quaint Atmosphere. 
In town from Bend Oregon, we decided to try Louie's. We were a party of 7. 4 adults and 3 kids. It smelled like Italian heaven the second I walked in. We were told it would be 40 min before we were sat. Fine. Games at the front and a man walked up with little cups of crackers to keep the kids busy (a plus from the start). We were seated within 20minutes. Our server greeted us right away and went right into explaining the menu. Because I'm originally from Idaho and had wanted to try this restaurant since I was kid; and now finally having the chance, our server gave us the background of the restaurant. She walked us through ordering just as if we were in Italy and an Italian was bragging of their homemade pasta. The servers recommendation of Italian draft beer to start our dining experience was SPOT On! . Dinner consisted of  
baked manicotti  Best EVER!
Crab Ravioli 
Clam chowder
And A few other dishes were ordered and loved. 
The kids Mac N Cheese-was tasty. AND accompanied by ' ripe' fruit!! 
I spent the entire weekend of our trip wishing to return for the amazing meat sauce AND the above par customer service. I recommended Louie's to many people this last weekend. I never menetion names; this experience is totally deserving worth the applause and name drop.... Rachel YOU ROCKED!!!!! 
Rachel truly set the entire experience setting my pallet up for the most amazing authentic flavors. 
Cheers to Louie's and your special staff! I already can't wait to return!!! And I'll always ask for Rachel(I hope you will always be around) 


My only complaint is the time it took for the food to come from the kitchen. However, our server kept us entertained and filling us with knowledge.

Holiday Express Inn was wonderful. We were on our way to visit family in Oregon and decided to stop in Boise. We didn't get into Boise until after midnight and every place we called was full. Holiday inn had 3 rooms left and the front desk lady was so kind and helpful, she gave us a better rate than was online. The room was nice,the toilet seat could have used a scrub but overall clean and orderly. The morning breakfast was really nice, everything looked delicious and there was something for every kind of eater.

If your looking for a good pedi and the best massage you need to check out this place! I have been seeing Q and Linda for over a year now and they are both amazing. Q always seem to have some special nail color or design for me. I have been to many other Nails places before and have found this is the best place to come to. They treat me like family and I always love coming back. My nails always look good and they don't chip or like other places I have been to. If you needing a new nail place come check out this place, you won't regret it.

This is a updated review.  I hadn't been here in over a year so I thought I'd try again.  I'm glad that I did.  The calamari and crab wontons were still awesome.  The sauce that they drizzle over the calamari is the best. This time I also tried the long life chicken and rice sotto, which was really delicious and satisfying.  It has just the right amount of spice.   The service was great as well. Our waiter, I think his name was Talon, was great.  He was friendly , attentive, and helpful.  The table we were seated at was much better than last time.  The food came out in a timely manner and was fresh and hot.  The only reason that I can't give them 5 stars yet came down to the entree.  I ordered the shrimp lo mein,  which was prepared well just really under seasoned. Overall it was a really tasty meal though.

First time experiencing a spray tan and it was overall a success. It was the best experience ever! Kris is the best!!! She's incredible at what she does and has a really down to earth personality . I loved how warm and welcome she was. I definitely recommend her.
It's close to my house and the service is always very friendly. The atmosphere in the movie theaters are as good as anywhere in the valley!!
Gold gym it sucks! I'll try to talk to the manager, I guess she just ignore my call.. I'm really disappointed

Coming from Las Vegas where the locations had closed down I was excited to move here and see a souper salad!  This location was way better than the Vegas ones! All of the food was fresh and even though they were closing soon after our arrival they still continued to put out fresh items. My family of 5 including a very picky 5 yr old were all satisfied with the variety and left With full bellies. The server was very sweet and kept our table clean. I feel bad we didn't think to bring cash to leave her a tip. We will return. And will definitely bring extra to make up for that. I also love the high chair had a real tray a which helped keep the mess to a minimum.  My only complaint is my kids were charge $8? My 3 year old hardly ate that much but hey the amount they waste I understand the price. We will be back. Thank you for the fresh food and smiling service!

This location is a pain in the butt to get into.  If you're coming east on overland towards the store you cannot turn left into the parking lot.  You have to turn left at Stoddard and then turn left again into the narrow alley behind the store.  Went there on 8/16 to buy school supplies and it was the worst school supplies setup I've ever seen.  They were completely out of two items on my kids' list and things at two separate ends of the store so we had to go back and forth.  Luckily Walgreens had the other items, I don't have time to wait for them to restock.  They definitely were not prepared as a new store.  One good thing is all the employees we passed were very nice and helpful.
Excellent food! Burgers are juicy, fries are fresh, shakes are tasty!!! Excellent service every time!!! Also offers a military discount!

The service was horrible but the food was good (the only reason I gave two stars).  First they brought me a hot mocha when I asked for a iced mocha.  Then the one and only time we saw our waitress was when she brought us our food.  I had to ask a passing waitress to bring us our check.  Then we she never came back I had to go in to the cashier and ask for it and they gave me the wrong check.  They finally found our check and apologized for it "being crazy today", yet the restaurant was barely half full.  I gave a medium size tip when I should have gave nothing.  We won't be going here again but will still go to the Nampa location because their service was stellar even on their busiest day of the year with no excuses.

Great friendly service. Was greeted by our server as we were taken to our table. He was on top of everything; filling drinks, clearing plates, and making recommendations on food. The food was average to slightly above average.

I cannot believe how nice this Walmart is! Yes, I did say a nice Walmart! It is minutes from my home and I have made it my go to shopping location. It is SO clean and we'll stocked. My favorite thing too is that if you need help there are actually employees around to lend you a hand, and they are happy to do so! I can't praise this store enough. The managers are Cleary working very hard to break the stigma of Walmarts

This will be a short and a rather unfair review. A couple of weeks ago I had a really bad cold and nothing sounded appetizing except some kind of noodle soup. Decided to skip my Jewish nature and go with Vietnamese. My lovely and exceptionally caring wife, stopped a Pho 779 and got an order of Pho to go. It was wonderful! I can't say that it cured my cold like chicken soup might have, but it did take care of my craving (in fact there was enough for two meals).

Now the reason this review is unfair is because I was sick and taste buds were rather affected - I an say that it was good and look forward to trying it again. Also because I stayed home and had it delivered, I can't comment on the restaurant itself.

To the family to see The Peanuts Movie, excellent movie, very family friendly, no vulgar jokes. I which they made more movies like this.

But, this is a review about Majestic. It is a good movie house, clean great stadium style seats.

The still have a matinee showing that is relatively affordable, but like every movie house very expensive snacks

After looking all over the place to find a room, I ended up here. It was the last room available. The person behind the counter was friendly and offered me a discounted rate. She probably did not need to discount the room because the amenities are great. the room had a king bed, tv, and jetted soaker tub. They fed me breakfast, and were always polite and professional. I stayed an additional two days after. I would definitely stay here again.

My sister and I walked in on a Sat morning. Was assisted right away. I was in need of a fill and my sister got a full set. Both technicians were very friendly, professional and made us feel comfortable. Clean and cute salon!
I highly recommend this place for breakfast or lunch. Good food, economical, friendly and fast.
Corporate hypocrisy at its finest. They sell bicycles but will not install a bicycle rack outdoors to secure a bicycle while you shop.

Back with an update on that family heirloom piece.  Just FYI, it is a traditional Chinese wedding skirt, all silk, heavily hand-embroidered.  And it's almost 100 years old.  It had some loose stitching where someone had tried to maintain pleats. They were all over the place (and even in different colored thread). I'd asked that the stitching be redone.
When I came back for it, Casey explained that the better alternative was to do something less than what I'd requested.  She was right of course-- came out beautifully! And with far less risk or wear-and-tear to the fabric. And of course, less cost. How often does THAT happen?!?!  WOW. Love these guys (and btw, every time I'm in there, someone is fitting a beautiful dress...obviously a lot of people trust As You Wish for their most important work!).

Very good beer basement in downtown Meridian.  The owners designed and installed pretty much everything in this location by hand.  Gotta love the entrepreneurial spirit here. 

They have a popcorn machine. That's about all the in-house food.   Otherwise, you can order food from flatbread across the street.  Flatbread rocks so I don't feel bad for you.

I really enjoy Sunrise Cafe (several locations but I usually go to the one on Main St. in Merdian), Breakfast there is always good and reminds me of being a guest at a B&B. My favorite is the Hamburger and Eggs for mornings and the Chili-Cheese Fries in the evenings.

Overall, it was pretty average. Nothing to write home about and pretty limited in any type of meat selections from the buffet. Be careful as they really ding you for the soda or milk drinks. Restaurant was clean and staff were nice.

We were visiting family who recently moved to Boise. We decided to have a girls day and went out for manis and pedis. We chose this place out of convenience because it was so close to the house. The manicurists did a great job. Equally important to me, they were very interactive. They were very entertaining and worked very well together. Can't wait to go back.
Have been there twice recently. Good selection.  Ice cream dispenser has been broken on both trips which is part of the experience.    No discount offered when this happens
The food was fine, service was awful. Trash was everywhere. Very prejudice against my friends nationality.

From Day 1 this has been the best place to workout at! I love everything about it! Welcoming and friendly front desk staff, incredible Coaches, clean facility, motivating and challenging workouts! OTF is the best!

We enjoyed the ambiance and the food. The restaurant has a real Italian feel. We started off with the bruschetta. It was pleasantly different than some other bruschetta we have had. My husband had the eggplant parmesan. He said it was really good. The marina sauce has a hint of roasted pepper. I had the baked gnocchi which was very rich and delicious. Our server was Kenneth "Matt". He did a great job. We will definitely eat here again.
What a great place! Sara was calm cool and collected on a super busy Sunday morning and gave us amazing service. We will definitely be back!

The atmosphere here is charming. Service was great and the food was tasty. I felt like the prices are a bit high, as you can get mostly the same food at other restaurants for less money. I had the chorizo burrito with hashbrowns. The hashbrowns were absolutely delicious and reminded me of waffle house (yum!). The burrito was good, but not mind blowing. My mom had the corned beef hash meal. I tasted the corned beef hash and was not a big fan. But the home fries and biscuit/gravy were delicious. Overall, I would eat here again if I'm in the area and need breakfast.

This is hands down my favorite coffee and boba place. The atmosphere is sooo cute. The customer service is awesome. I haven't been to a place like this in idaho before, only in california. But all in all, I highly recommend this place. Great flavors and great selection '

It was hard to find anything that was edible. The kids had fun though. Understandable since the food was about on par with the school cafeteria. 

How do you make salad and soup bad?!? I would not recommend.

Excellent food,  fair prices,  good-sized portions and very friendly staff - what else to ask for?  I've been back - and back.....

Happy Teriyaki is well worth driving out of your way for - you must go now, it's calling you!

Delivery is quick. I have ordered mandarin chicken from them twice now. Come to find out they don't know what "Mandarin" means. They only have sweet and sour sauce for their breaded chicken they call mandarin chicken. (Not deep fried). They are the only delivery for Chinese in the area. Wow, I miss quality take out.

Don't waste your time. Although they may give you better prices on repairs, they have terrible communication. I ordered a repair and have had to call them a dozen times to check on the part that I needed for my phone. 3 months later I'm told they can't get the part and tell me to go elsewhere. They say they'll call you back and never do. Very unprofessional.

I was seeking out places to shop for my 7 month daughter in the area as we were visiting Idaho and I came across this place via Yelp. I am super glad I came in. I ended up buying two small toys, and many clothing items for me daughter for when she starts wearing 18 months. Great deals that met my requirements. Super clean and organize which met my requirements. Friendly folks working, as well. When I come back to this area, it definitely will be my go to with my daughter.

The identity crisis here may best be conveyed by sharing two things to start.

First, this is Asian food in the way of PF Chang's meets Applebees.  The menu which is multi - Asian themed (and that means Japanese including Sushi, Thai and Chinese) includes a dish of Mussels in Green Curry Coconut broth served with "parmesan garlic bread".  Seriously.  I am not making that up.  The remainder of the menu has similarly...ummm... interesting combos.

Second, one might note while L&L tries to market itself as a hipster hotspot, on our happy hour visit we walked in to America's "Horse with No Name" playing on the sound system. That '70's tune alone suggests a different tone.  We also heard Sting (in his Police days) and Beatles (in their Hey Jude! days) and Michael MacDonald (post Doobie Brothers days).  A mix set at a nice level to allow conversation and tunes we consider great music but it is not mixed for the hipster set. It is my era music.  I like it.  But I am old enough to remember what the teacher told my gradeschool class on the day President Kennedy was shot.  

Not a bad for an AmerAsian-fusion-chain-formula-food chain if that's what you're looking for.   (For example, other  locations in Anchorage, Scottsdale, Dallas and Minneapolis.)  But if you're looking for authentic Asian food...nope.   If you're looking for hipster vibe...nope.  And if you're looking for attentive service...nope.  A 'hat trick' of disappointments perhaps.

VIBE :  The space is divided into three parts.  The dining area at the front which does seem more Applebees for layout and which had a fair number of kids with grandparents and parents in tow arriving for early dinner.  The sushi bar area which is booths along the walls and chair height (yahoo) seating at the bar with comfy chairs.  And the cocktail lounge which is a jam packed labyrinth of all high bar height tables and stools.

We chose the sushi section and settled in to order.  Applause for ample space between tables and booths.  Also, the waterwall in the sushi bar is 'zen'.  Which is a good thing as service is irritatingly indifferent here.

SERVICE:  Met at the door by friendly host who was going to lead us to the enpty front dining room until we asked for a seat in the sushi area.  We were given happy hour and dinner menus both.  Table service was S-L-O-W.  Whether that was our server or the kitchen I don't know.  But since it was just 5:00p and maybe one quarter full in total I assume it was not back up in the kitchen.

We ordered cocktails.  One arrived spilled over the rim with a big mess on the stem and glass.  Acknowledging this is truly a first world problem, one would expect a clean up or fresh drink to avoid sticky fingers.  Nope.

My hubby who is a generous-tipperX2 in most cases has a hot button that leads to that not being so.  That button is pushed when a server is indifferent to follow up and follow through when we're at the table but then has a big "I'm so glad you came in!" moment when they deliver the bill.  As here.  But the low tip reflected the lousy service.

FOOD :  Happy hour good deal offers a couple of sushi rolls at about half price.  Inexpertly rolled but fresh ingredients.  The potstickers are not the best.  We also shared an item off the menu listed as one of the most fiery in a red curry peanut sauce.  But it was tame.  And while we were expecting lots of veggies in in the ratio of veggies to lo mein style (although called yakisoba on menu) noodles, that dish was about 6 parts noodles to 1 part veg. Dishes were also very salty.  Just saying.  Set expectations low and you'll be good to go. 

For planning purposes this is not a place worth saving calories for dessert.  So you can spend them on a cocktail.  Which is largely the same thing here given house cocktails are so sweet.

LIBATIONS :  Unexpectedly decent if plebian wine list by the glass.  A buck off on wine at happy hour brings the Ste. Michelle sparkler in at under $6.00 which is a good deal for pairing with Asian flavors.  The house specialty cocktails were interesting and in good sized pours but leaned very sweet.  That said the Spice something that had chopped jalpeno in it along with white tequia and pineapple juice was worthy to recommend.   

VALUE :  Happy hour food items run about $4 - $6, dinner menu items about $6- $15, drinks about $8 - $9. 

THIS N THAT:

1) PARKING:  In lot.

2) ACCESSIBILITY:  Level in and throughout.  Standard height seating in restaurant and sushi bar.  But although it has Civil Rights law (ADA)l for 24 years, did not see one place for standard height seating for disabled customers in the cocktail bar. That is segregation. 

3) SPECIALS:  Free kids' Bento box with every adult entree on Sundays.  Seniors over 60 get buy one entree get one half price between 3 t0 5 (?) every day.

I ordered from their 2 for $20 menu, my main meal was chicken penne pasta. When it arrived it did not have penne noodles. It turns out no longer carry penne noodles? It is just on the menu, go figure.

Arrived to the front, before opening the door we could smell old grease. Decided to give this place a try despite the grease smell. The fries are cut thick,which was ok but they were layered in the old grease and not very hot. Very disappointing.  Then later the cheeseburger arrives. Later meaning about 15 minutes or so.  The bread was way too thick, the burger very disappointing,  it really didn't have any flavor and was very,very dry. Establishment was clean,  waitress was nice, food not so much. Sorry but we will not be revisiting anytime soon.

What can I say.  I love Zamzows.  I love it whenever I can patronize a local business and get superior service and products compared to the corporate run nation-wide chains.  That is why Zamzows is my go-to place for garden products, and anything else they have (such as propane).  I'm not a "pet" person, so that aspect of the store doesn't interest me, but it is still fun to take my granddaughter there to look at the birds, the bunnies, the fish, and even Cloe, the store's cat.  The staff there is very knowledgeable whenever I need help, and always happy and friendly.  

Today's trip was to pick up several gallons of "Thrive" (which I highly recommend for tree and shrub fertilizer) and some grass seed.

 To be honest, their prices are a bit higher than Home Depot or Lowes or Fred Meyer, but I still make the choice to go there when I need to pick up things for the yard or garden.


[  I hate jokes about German sausages.  They are the wurst.  ]

Oh wow. I'm still sick from eating here!  The only reason I took the time to not only write a review, but also add the business is because this place actually is part of the restaurants listed on the highway (along with Carls Jr, Taco Bell, etc).  It truly is the worst Italian/pizza I've had (if you don't count that thing they served as pizza during high school lunches).  The lasagna was absolutely inedible.  The pizza was greasy greasy greasy, which isn't so bad if it tasted decent.  Which it didn't.  For the first time since a high school cafeteria I couldn't eat a pepperoni pizza.  I would rather have frozen over this stuff!  The fettuccine was mediocre,  there was a dish with mushroom, chicken, artichokes, and ravioli.  We just ate the chicken, mushrooms, and artichokes and left the ravioli.  If you go here PLEASE for your own health do not eat the salad bar.  From walking by the pathetic thing I couldn't help but notice the strawberries were the lovely color of pale pink! 
I guess I may be being a bit harsh.  The garlic bread was actually pretty good, and I'm glad for that or I would have starved!

The WORST. I have been in there 3 times now and each and every time the employees treated me terribly. Today, I went in and asked for waterproof makeup, the girl recommended PUR foundation (which isn't even waterproof)- when I asked her to show me a brand that my friend recommended, she said "we don't have any more testers of that, have you tried it before because it's really thick" I told her that I had tried it before and liked it and I showed her the ones her store had and she just said "yeah but we don't have any testers" and walked away. Completely unprofessional and very unhelpful. NEVER going back.

I was comparing different hotels in the area when Shareese sold me on my stay almost immediately with her customer service and can do attitude. I am a business professional so when I see business done correctly I make a commitment on site. This was amazing as it saved me so much time researching other hotels. She never said a bad word about the other options available to me simply just assured me that I was in the right place. What an amazing experience.
Friendly staff, clean rooms, great breakfast...pretty much the same experience we learned to love from Holiday Inn :)

i stayed here for 2 nights (end of Feb 2014). great hotel, under 2-years old, very spacious hallways, rooms are of great setup. bed is very average, very stiff, but pillows are comfy.
air conditioning does not work so good or quiet, it can be left on but cold air blows straight at bed, it should go a bit up or down.... and it is kind of loud, but can get used to....
rooms have nice couch and a coffee table!!! ...small refrigerator and microwave!!!!
there are 3 computer stations, and you are not limited what you can do, these computers kind of slow, but you can surf, type, scan and print (black--white).
I love about this property that there are no cameras on every corner, you feel "free"!!!! -no one is watching you everywhere in the property like most of other hotels, no big-brother"!!!!
location is good and quiet, around hotel there is almost nothing, but if you walk 5-10 minutes you get to few fast food joints, and a bit farther there is a mall....

Love me some Ling and Louies...and would have given a 5 star.  However, came in around 4:45pm on Sunday, July 17th and waited up front to be seated for about 5 minutes.  Had to ask the bar tender if we could be seated.  She ended up seating us right next to a table full of employees that were just sitting and talking.  The bar tender saw that the hostess was sitting with this group of employees and let her know that there were several other people waiting to be seated.  There was definitely no sense of urgency.  

Besides this small mishap, we love coming to Ling and Louies and enjoy the atmosphere.  We have always had great service, and hope someone can teach the hostess that was working some of the work ethic that the others uphold.

Really a 2.5, but since it is likely we will pass on this establishment in the future, I rounded down.  We stayed for lunch after a movie and 3 out of the 4 people in our group decided to order from this establishment.   It was lunch time and the server was nice.

 Teriyaki chicken over chow mein was way overly sauced although we appreciated that it was cook fresh.  Chow mein was $1 extra and the noodles and meager "chef veggies" which were included in original menu seemed overcooked and wasn't special.  Simply put the noodles were put in place of white rice at a surcharge; it wasn't true chow mein. No cabbage, no celery, no scallions, no nothing extra, just the same sauce poured over the teriyaki chicken.  Too much sauce.
Sweet and sour chicken served with "chef veggie" over white rice.  There was enough fried bits of chicken, but the guest commented that the sauce was not sour enough.  It did not appear that this dish was overly sauced and the guest said it was good.
The "special", fried potstickers with ponzu sauce was also ordered.  That guest ate only 3 out of 6, so that tells me they weren't fabulous.  I tried one and the outside was nice and not overly dried out from frying, but the inside was overly mushy.  The sauce was good.

The guest that ate the sweet and sour chicken said they would return, the others said they would pass.  Too many other options to choose from in the village dining area.

If this establishment made their chow mein, actually chow mein and used less sauce, I would try the establishment again.  Right now, no.

I did Carside To Go, ordered the Fiesta Chicken Salad & Tomato Basil soup. For 2nd time in a row ordered I got home and no chicken or dressing. Seriously! I called requested all funds to be refunded & I wouldn't be returning. Manager did refund money. Never again will I order Carside To Go.
Awesome! Worth every penny! Great service and great food! We will go back for sure! My family of 4 shared a burger and still had leftovers for another meal! They do not disappoint!!

We decided to try some place new. Big Juds meridian seemed like a fun option. The resturaunt was half full and the 4 waitresses were struggling as if it was crazy busy. This was a Thursday night. lots of dirty tables sat around the entire time we were there. We waited about 10 min before our waitress came over. She took drink orders and meal orders at this point. We then waited about 20 min for our drinks. then another 10 min for our food. I ordered my burger with no bun, it came with the bun. not a huge deal so I just took the bun off. then realized I didn't have any silverware at the table. I patiently waited for the waitress to come back as my kids and husband began eating. my husband got finger steaks and needed cocktail sauce so he also stopped eating and we waited. The waitress never came back. my husband finally got up and asked another waitress for a fork for me and cocktail sauce. she gave him some sauce and said she would be by with a fork. another 10 min passed and my kids were done eating. our original waitress still never came back and the second waitress still never brought the fork. so my husband got up and tried to find a fork. no tables had silverware and no waitresses could be found. another 3 min pass and the second waitress asks if I ever got my fork. I said no and she runs and grabs one. by this time everyone else is way done eating. and some random waitress comes by and asked if we needed boxes. my husband for the check and she gives it to him. we paid and left our original waitress literally was never seen again. I almost wonder if she quit and walked out. The food was mediocre. it basically took forever and the service was horrible. I will not be headed back.
It was a beautiful place to be and service was great, my coworkers and I went, i wasnt a fan of the food but my employees loved it.

So after leaving my last review I decided to give them another try, the food is always good. We went on a Thursday night at about 7:30. The speed of service and food delivery was much faster than I had experienced on my last visits, not sure if that was because of the day and time? We ordered edamame appetizer which our waitress kinda threw on the table as she ran by? Next came our sushi rolls which were placed on the table by another gal, she didn't take the time to notice we had no plates or soy sauce platters, but luckily another man came by, noticed and brought us tableware and apologized. Our entrees came out soon after, food was good and plentiful (we all took home leftovers) all in all much better experience, unfortunately it seems like they are always a little understaffed or the waiter/waitresses seem stressed out. It's amazing to me that I can go to a coffee drive thru and spend 5 dollars and be treated as an important customer but at a decent dining establishment I spend over 100 and am treated like an interruption of the wait staffs work, certainly don't feel like they care one way or another if I return! They seem to do just fine without my $$ so unless someone makes me meet them at this location I won't go back. I've had a couple of occasions where friends/family suggested this place and I try to steer them to another restaurant, I just don't like to feel like a burden when dining out!
Great service, this is our second time here and it's been consistent.  Clean, friendly, quiet and delicious food.

I ended up here after another less than Legends dary establishment quit serving their menu at 8pm.   The dinner was fabulous, staff incredible, and beer and wine selection perfect.   I have a nice slow late night dinner, never felt rushed, and thoroughly enjoyed my evening.  GRAZIE!

Today was our first visit there.  We sampled the tempura shrimp, beef teriyaki, chicken teriyaki, egg roll, and gyozas.  Food and service were very good.  We plan to make this a regular place to visit.  Nice to see Koreans there too!

Food was ok. Service was subpar, and they started closing an hour before they closed. Literally vacuumed under my table and were changing out condiments while we were eating. There are far superior places in Boise to spend your money.
Louis was great! Been here twice and I've enjoyed it both times. Great pizza, great pasta, and fantastic service by the staff. The manager even sings a nice Italian tune every once in a while

My wife and I visited the weekend after they opened. We entered the crowded restaurant and were told it would be an hour and a half before we could be seated. Expecting a long wait, we put our names down and took the beeper. 90 minutes later we were still waiting while people who had come in long after us were being seated. My wife asked how much longer we'd have to wait and the hostesses had skipped over us on the list. They promised us the next available table and we were seated within 5 minutes. Once seated, we ordered an appetizer (Loaded Nachos) and drinks. The nachos came and went; they were mediocre at best. Our waiter never returned to take our entree order, so my wife flagged him down as he proceeded to walk by the table. He apparently didn't realize we had waited an hour and half for dinner, but was happy to take our orders anyway. My wife ordered the F'n Loaded Sliders. The filet mignon in them was quite good, but the buns were burned black on the inside and the fries were far from memorable. I ordered the drunken chicken. The waiter had a problem lighting the alcoholic sauce, and when he did get it lit, it burned for roughly a half second before the flame went out. He then tipped the plate while setting it down on the table, spilling the sauce all over the rice. The chicken was cold and drab, and my rice now tasted like rubbing alcohol. Overall, an absolutely terrible experience. We'll never return.

Burgers good. Fries nicely done. A bit bland but salt fixes that. The shakes - awful. No flavor at all. And not creamy.  The service was not great.  Friendly but slow and it was not busy. The girl taking an order on the phone dint even nod in our direction. Will I go again. I might try again but I won't get dessert.
I always go with the surf and turf sizzling plate...great! Can't speak to other dishes but they all smell good.
The Pho was fabulous!!! Chicken teriyaki too. Service needs some work,  but love the food!!

This is definitely a nice hotel for the price. $89 a night and you have a little mini  kitchen. "2 burner stove top, full size refrigerator and a microwave" 
We had a great stay here. The staff were all friendly  
My only complaint is that the bathroom wasn't really all that clean. (Isabel) cleaned our room and i think all she did was wipe it down. I went to use the blow dryer and when i pulled it off the holder there was makeup all over it. Thankfully the front desk had some Antibacterial wipes. Also, our ice maker has ..i don't know what.. all over it...

Mike Walters is the the best lender I have ever dealt with. I have used him twice for home loans and couldn't be happier with the way he conducts business. Always ready to tackle any problem that arises with the loan process. He got us the best rates and went out of his way to save us money in fees. A double bonus is the fact he is a real estate agent as well as a senior loan officer and provided well needed advise in all areas of the home buying process. I would highly recommend Mike for anyone looking for a agent or loan officer who will help every step of the way.
                                                                                                         Marilyn Daulton

This is the first time going to this restaurant. The entrace looks real nice. I was greeted with a friendly person that sat me down right away.  The server came to me and ask if i had been here before. She explained the menu and i ordered a sushi and a meal on the menu. When i received my meal the Mongolian beef looked real good except the rainbow roll looked as it was made at the grocery store..  it looked fairly small. I would of assumed for the price i was paying the roll should have been a little bigger. Over all the meal was pretty good.  The thing that i didn't like was when the server put down the check before i was even half done with the meal. I felt i was being pushed out of the restaurant. There was a desert i saw a customer that was sitting in front of me i wanted to try out but since i felt being pushed out of the restaurant. I didnt stay. If i come back to boise for work again i might give them another chance.
2nd time eating here with the wife. All 4 meals here have been either very good or excellent.  Tried the sushi bar this time. The California roll was excellent!

Outstanding business that far exceeds its competition.  They have a great selection, a friendly staff, and the nicest bathrooms you'll find at a convenience store.  I love this business.  It is a model for the ideal convenience store.
this place is so cute! super friendly staff, well decorated, and a lot of options! there's stuff for traditional and for those wanting to try something new.

Restaurant is easy to get to and has a ton of seating and parking. Service is minimal just fyi. You walk up and order at the counter and get the food delivered. After that, you are on your own.
I ordered chicken pho. The broth is clean and flavorful. The bowl was accompanied with cilantro, basil, lemon, jalapenos, and sprouts (tradiotional) . The restaurant also provides plenty of condiments to flavor the bowl as you please. My least favorite part of the soup was the chicken. It was pre cooked with a lot of pepper it seemed. It would have been better if the meat was also just chicken breast thinly sliced like other pho joints do. Next time I will skip on the protein(which I won't miss).
If you are looking for a good bowl of Pho and are in the neighborhood, definitely worth a stop. Not my favorite in town, but I enjoyed it and will be back.
Cheers Always

We went a few times in the first month Ling and Louie's was open and I wasn't sure if I was going to be a fan.  The service was always great and my husband instantly found a dish he loved, but I had to skip around the menu before finding something I really liked.  The Firecracker Chicken is my favorite followed closely by the Combo Fried Rice with chicken and vegetables.  Make sure to order "combo" if you want both meat and vegetables, otherwise you get chicken and rice - that's all.  They have a great strawberry salad if you are looking for something light.  I also like the Meatloaf and the wasabi mashed potatoes are out of this world!  Now that they seemed to have worked through the new restaurant syndrome, the food is consistently hot and good.  This is one of my new favorite restaurants!

Since I moved here from Hawaii, I was searching for a restaurant just like this one(Happy Teriyaki) The price was very reasonable and the food was delicious, I will definitely come here again more often
Krissy is wonderful! My tan looked beautiful for my nieces wedding. I can't wait to have a special event again so I can get a tan. Highly recommend Krissy!

Nothing wrong with the theater but DO NOT purchase tickets online. I wanted to avoid standing in line for tickets so bought them ahead of time. There was, of course, a convenience fee, but I was fine with that. My tickets were emailed to me on my phone to take to the theater. Unfortunately, they don't have the ability to scan the ticket code off the phone. I had to stand in line and give them the credit card I used to make the online transaction in exchange for the regular paper tickets. So, I essentially just paid more than everyone else for my tickets.

Life long Louie's customer.  The only negative thing I can say is they don't have their downtown location anymore.  That was my favorite place.  

Louie's Pizza, hands down the absolute best pizza in the world! Hands Down!! So many amazing qualities in the pizza itself.  The crust is the perfect texture, thickness, taste.; it's amazing.  The sauce....I don't know what is in that sauce....but never had anything like it.  If you go with their deluxe, you won't regret it.  It is always a treat when we get to go out their and pick up some pizzas.  I get depressed when I finish the last piece, every time....because I know it will be a while until the next time I get it.  (Like I said, open up another downtown location!!! Our family alone will keep it in business!)

Excellent meal.  Lettuce wraps are much better than PF Chang's.  Fried rice was seasoned perfectly.  Shrimp Kung Pow was great but the highlight was the jeweled beef.   OMG. Delicious.  We will be back for sure.  Server was very attentive and friendly.  Nice atmosphere.

Hard to get into the lot off of the busy street and very little parking available. Fries came 15 minutes before the burger. The burger was mostly bun and had little taste. Fries were very greasy and tasted of old grease. This was our second visit, first one being 12 years ago in Boise. I guess we thought the new location would be better but it isn't. Wont be going back
Cannot beat the quality for the price at Sunrise Cafe. When I am in Idaho, I make sure we have as many breakfasts as possible there!! Love it! Everything is really good.

The folks from ENVI were super easy to work with and came on time, and were very personable.  I even was glad to connect with the reps Brett and Jared for future services!  Awesome company, easy transaction and people!

Really? 

Came in with an appointment and they took a walk in before me, whatever I have patience and understand they are busy. Although the lady doing my nails did them really fast... too fast. 

I'm sitting there drying my nails and the lady who did them left for the day, I look down to see nail polish on my fingers and I had no idea how Long to dry them! 

I dried them 15 minutes and left. Well I ended up smudging my nail polish in my car and now I'll have to go get them Redone. 

Poor customer service.
I have visited  Happy Teriyaki several times and always enjoy the food. The spicy chicken is very good.  Melanie was our server the last visit and she is very personable and attentive.

Wow. Fast Eddy's has blown me away with their business mindset. It is so nice to see this type of business philosophy in Treasure Valley. I wish all businesses would put forth 100% excellence in everything they do.  This place has impressed me with their buildings which include 5 star restrooms, car and RV wash, patio seating with Internet and convenience store with drive through. Their convenience store has more than average items including wine. Their selection of sodas, Icees and milkshake machines are amazing. The place is always over staffed with friendly and uniformed people. Tonight, the one on Locust Grove and Overland opened which includes the impressive convenience store and lube and oil shop. One thing that turned me on to Fast Eddy's is there desire to think of the customer. One of the only places I know WHO DOES NOT charge for air or water for your car and car tires.  Because Fast Eddy's has thought outside the box and made it about customers I try to bring all my gas and convenience needs to them. It's time businesses think of putting forth quality and great customer service back in their business plan. It will pay off in the long run. This is located about one mile north of the new Ten Mile exit. Do me a favor. Stop by here and walk the convenience store and check out the bathrooms. They are the nicest bathrooms I have ever seen.
