I wish these stores would pop up all over the U.S..  I am supporting this business and I am glad that the Eddy family are locals. I always tell people about this place. Thanks Mr. Eddy for doing everything with excellence!

I just moved to the area and I'm a breakfast guy so I've been looking for my "spot" since I arrived. I think I've found it. I don't need much, all I require is good food, a counter to enjoy my breakfast and a wait staff that understands customer service. Ed's 50's Cafe is all of the above and more... Delora and the ladies make you feel like family. The food is delish and the seating at the counter keeps you engaged in conversation. And as a bonus, they allow me to keep a bottle of Tapatio behind the counter. Tapatio seems to be a rare occurrence in the restaurants in and around Meridian.
All in all, I would give six stars if I could!

Stopped by Applebee's in Meridian, Idaho on Eagle Rd. early Monday evening as a party of five for dinner.   We were led to our our table immediately by a very courteous hostess. My husband and three boys took their seats--I mentioned to the family to order me a water-- as I proceeded to head to and use the restroom.    After returning to the table and glancing at menus.  We deliberate about our dinner choices and wait for a waiter/waitress.   We've now been there for over 10 minutes and not so much as a "hello" much less a drink order.  At this point,  my husband is pretty irritated.  A man that looks like a manager whizzes by and my hubby gets out a quick, "How are you?" to get his attention.  The man, in full speed towards the kitchen,  responds, "I'm freaking FAN-tastic!" He exits the kitchen w/ a plate an a couple of other wait staff holding the same.  We watch them pass by back into the kitchen...we try to catch someone's attention.   By now, another 10 minutes have passed.  Too little,  too late.  My husband had lost his patience and felt he would not allow our money to go towards poor service, or should I say, the lack of ANY service.  Needless to say, my kids and I were disappointed ... it's been years since we've been to an Applebee's.  The place wasn't even packed and happy hour was over!  Thanks for nothing.  Hopefully the one back home in Phoenix, AZ will NOT be like this one.  This one is Deserving of ZERO stars.
Yeah that place blows, stay away.....
Seriously good.  So glad we tried them out. I tried the shrimp and steak.  It rivals a really good Pho place in Nampa.  We also had the chicken Asian sandwich which was delicious!

The place looks like it would be good, Like some secrete awesome place that will live forever and be awesome every time you go.  It's not though, its really gross. 

  seriously , the food is way over stated, the burger I ate was nasty. I say ate, i took 1 bite and I regretted swallowing it. it was dang near a 5 buck burger, the Big Hungry.  get real.  its supposed to have ham on it, it was so thin you could barely see it, the burger tasted like it has perfume or something on it.  really. I'm not kidding it was real bad..  i have not ate at McDonalds since 1981 and I would eat there before I went back to this place.    try it once if you don't believe me, i am sure that they make most their dough off people that tried it 1 time.   They must have a lot of family that keep them in business and have no taste or something. its really that bad.  and the lady that came out to hop.  rude and when I told them the food was bad as nicely as possible they didn't offer anything to try different or anything like that.   Just oh!  I'm sorry and walked off. Incredible.

I have upped my review from three to four stars. The cleanliness if the showers is improved and the equipment is in better repair.  Great value gym for the money with a good client base. I'll keep renewing.

Very clean salon, well organized, very kind staff.  The pedi chairs are very clean, all have working massagers, and the bowls are kept sanitized.  I watched closely and observed everyone wearing gloves and using sanitized tools.  They have a huge selection of gel polishes, and a modest choice of nail polishes.  $38 for a pedi/mani - I will definitely come back!

This place is about as basic of a hotel as you can get. No frills at all.  First the staff was great. Everybody was friendly and treated us well.  The room is very basic a bed, a TV, a fridge, and a bathroom - not much else.  The breakfast was OK, a little on the plain side.  The worst part was our room.  It was on the East side of the property facing the freeway exit.  I don't know if there was a motocross the weekend we stayed but I've never heard so many motorcycles racing their engines at all hours of the night.  That plus the fact that the walls are pretty thin and we could hear our neighbors again at all hours of the night.  Our friends that stayed on the West facing of the property didn't seem to notice the motorcycles.  So if you stay here make sure you get a room facing West.  It's probably cheaper than a hotel with more frills.
I had lost some weight and she was able to tailor several pairs of jeans exactly to my liking very fast

I used the manual car wash bay for a quick and cheap car wash. I was careful to read the "Credit Card 8 min, $5 min". So I intentionally used my debit card instead. I did a quick car wash and tried to hit "Stop" when I was done. But the timer didn't stop and kept running. I drove away with the timer still running. I drove around front to explain to an employee that I used a debit and I was charged for time I didn't use. He said the minimum applies to all card transactions. I reminded him that's not what the sign says. I asked if he could make it right. I'm not asking for all $5 back but something to make it right. He said no. 
I could have just driven through the Auto Wash in the next bay for the same $5. 
Very disappointed in customer service for not making this right.

I bought a Groupon for $10 for $15 worth of food.  We ordered something, I can't remember the name but it was something funny like dancing lady, hula girl beef, or soemthing like that.  It was good but I'd give it a 5 out of 10 stars.  The first few bights are really good but then I started to feel sick. Something in it was too overpowering.  When the waiter brought the bill we showed him the Groupon AP with the barcode and he said we don't have a scanner.  He took my phone to his MGR and they took 10% off the bill.  I told him it was not supposed to be 10% and explained the Groupon and he said well sorry my MGR is busy so you will have to pay tonight and then come back tomorrow to get your money.  I was pretty ticked but came back the next day, waited forever for the MGR who is apparently the bartender as well and he said, sorry Im busy, the best hting I can do is give you a $5 gift card.  MGR are supposed to be around to take care of these situation, not be running the bar.  I'll go back again to use the gift card but after that I think I'll pass.  The custoemr service was poor.

I also don't know why people give this place bad reviews. We've been therhere 2 times and it's clean and service is always great. The owners/workers are courteous and best pho I've tasted in meridian so far. The thai iced tea is delicious too. Will definitely visit again to satisfy my pho cravings.

Today I got a text from Senske saying I am scheduled for lawn service this week. This is the second time this year they have scheduled me in the middle of Winter. I called them last time and told them that fertilizing a lawn in the middle of January was not a good idea and to make it for the end of March or beginning of April. I guess they think that this is March. Well I have now told them they are FIRED and do Not recommend them at all!

Ok, there's a lot of hype about their Firecracker Chicken. I found it ok. It didn't send me to the moon or anything, but it was acceptable. This was my first visit & I don't know why really; the location is not my favorite and I don't hear enough about this place to keep it top of mind.

We were going to an event in Nampa with good friends & decided to stop enroute. It was a pleasant enough place to visit with friends and have a good meal. The meal was a quality one and the service was also good.

I wouldn't hesitate to go here again.

I love H3. They have the raw food that I need for my cats and they are always very helpful when I have questions. We'll stick with them even though there's a place closer to me in Nampa that carries the same products.

Meh. It was just ok. Paid for the upgraded $30 but it was nothing special. I've had better pedicures at other salons. I was also frustrated to find out they did not take cards. We had made an appointment and it would have been nice to know they were a cash only place before the end of our pedicure. I dropped it an extra star for that.

I went to Ling & Louie's a few days ago as I am staying in a nearby hotel in Meridian for business.  I sat at the bar, as I was alone.  At first the bartender was friendly and attentive.  I ordered a glass of wine, some potstickers, and lettuce wraps.  The food came out very quickly.  It was okay, not really good.  The potstickers had a funny fake taste to them, and the chicken in the lettuce wraps was not really distinguishable as chicken.  Like I said, it was just "okay".
The service then went downhill.  I attempted to order a second glass of wine, and finally left in disgust after failing to make eye contact with, or attract the attention of, the bartender.  I tried for 26 minutes!  Mind you, there were only 2 other people at the bar.  One guy with a full beer and another man being ignored.  The bartender was busy pouring drinks for the table orders, unloading/loading the dishwasher, cutting fruit, you name it!  I had to ask a passing waitress to get my check for me as the bartender was still busy ignoring everyone.  He was only about 10 feet away from me too.
I travel every single week for work, andI can overlook a lot; terrible service is something I cannot forgive.  I will not be back.

This place used to be so much better but has gone down hill. The service was so slow, it was almost like or serve forgot about us. Our good was not hot (and three ice cream was softened). And when did this place start using plastic dishes? The chicken parmesan was not breaded. At least they had done guy come sign happy birthday in Italian. He was pretty good.
Krissy does an amazing job with her spray tans! Not only do they turn out perfect, she is very professional, nice, timely and efficient. I've gone to her twice now and will go nowhere else!

Haven't been to Louie's in a longtime. I went today for their Sunday brunch. 
There was a wide variety of different dishes. 
It would have been nice to have a sign in front of the buffet items that told you what was in them. 
Bacon was so crispy it broke when used the tongs to pick it up. 
They made fresh omelettes while you waited. 
Dessert station had lots of choices.

The food is very average at best but if you are into all you can eat salad that is the best part.  Dessert not good and the pizza and tacos bar were less than stellar but for the money it's ok in a pinch.

The food is good and the prices are reasonable. The delivery service is typically abysmally slow. Apparently there is only one driver who delivers one order at a time. While the online ordering site suggests 30 minutes to one hour times, the reality is usually an Hour and a half to two hours. Do yourself a favor and pick it up yourself, but give them at least 30 minutes for that (and still be ready to wait in the restaurant).

Extremely old and rundown for when I came here... Wouldn't really complain, but because there was dirty water dripping from the ceiling into people's food, I have to say something. Food is great, but the building needs maintenance. I remember their fries being really good. I came here with my boyfriends grandma, who recommended the place. The people who say directly behind us had the water drop on them, but they were quickly moved to a different table even though they were pretty busy.
I have been eating Louie's Pizza for 40 years.  It is still very good.  Crust thin and crispy.  Was disappointed to discover they have removed Basque pizza from the menu since our last visit.

I've been using Sun-Kissed by Kris for a few years now and I'm always happy.  

She is more than convenient: she works with your schedule, and comes to your house.  She makes you feel very comfortable throughout the process, and always leaves you with a great looking tan.  I highly recommend using Krissy; I know I'll be using her throughout the summer.

Not at all impressed with quality of food. Ordered mandarin chicken expecting something like orange chicken, got something that resembled sweet & sour chicken but the breading was mushy and falling off the meat. Kung pao chicken lacked flavor, had no spice, the chicken in it (the few pieces that were in it) tasted like it might have been boiled. 
It was convenient that they deliver, but will not order from them again.
Went to eat dinner with a friend. Waitress was nice, food was good, and place was clean. Atmosphere was good. Nice bathrooms. We will be back.
I'm not much of teriyaki fan but this is an excellent new place.  Good food, good service at a price just right!
Booked a birthday party for 21 people. The staff pulled it off perfectly. Especially our sever John. He even sang happy birthday in Italian! Definitely recommend.

Oh my tasty!
The three meat plate and chicken Katsu feed a family of 5. 
Excellent food and friendly service.

We asked to speak with someone in home improvement. We couldn't hear him and he gave my wife attitude over the phone when we asked if they had any specific fans. He didn't even bother to look. This is why no one shops there anymore.

Dinner at the bar while here for work - so my criteria might be different from a local. Friendly bartenders, generous pour, perfect level of attentiveness. I had Tom kha gai to start and it was as good as you will get anywhere. Maybe very slightly over salted and I am a salt fiend, but delicious. Dinner was shrimp and scallops sizzling platter. Great seasoning, veggies nice and crisp, and scallops were cooked perfect. In this not expensive price point especially, I highly recommend.

I've lived in Boise for more than 30 years. Louie's has always been around. They moved into Meridian about 10 years ago. I grew up in a large family so it was very seldom that we ate out. When we did we would go to Louie's for pizza. At the time, I thought it was terrific.

Going back to Louie's after all these years I think my expectations were set way too high. In reality, this is Boise Italian food. The menu is based around bland average food. The portions are large but the taste is bland. 

If you want a pizza and exceeds the quality of Pizza Hut this is your place. If you're looking for fine Italian dining don't stop here.
Food is ok.  Not the best.  It was not busy and the service was slow.    I was disappointed with the fries.   They were soggy

The rainbow roll was not consistent in size all the way across.  The fish didn't look fresh but it tasted okay.  The fish was not sliced properly or professionally.  I wouldn't order it again.  The Pad Thai was just okay, nothing great and I would not order that again.  I will give them one more try and go back for happy hour.  The calamari looked really good but I didn't have it. The place was packed so they must be doing something right.  I may have just ordered the wrong dishes.

Loved it here. This restaurant was just as good as their other restaurant in Boise. Love the food and the atmosphere here! The burgers are wonderful and the fries are tasty too. I tried a huckleberry shake for the first time here and it was fantastic!
The food is always good, but service was lacking tonight because they were shorthanded.  The manager made it up to us very generously,  so we will be back. Hopefully this was a fluke.

I'm very confused.....this site says dogs are not accepted, however, we were here for four nights with our Yorkie with no problem.  There were two other small dogs on site during our stay.  We were not charged extra, nor did we have to sign a pet liability agreement.  

Most of the staff we dealt with were very friendly and helpful, but the manager seemed to be a little grumpy.  

We enjoyed the fresh breakfast every morning.  One morning there was bacon and scrambled eggs, and another morning there was sausage and scrambled.  There were biscuits and gravy, as well as two waffle makers.  There was a nice selection of breads and dry cereals.  

We were there in the "off season" (December), so prices were really low ($65.00 for a double queen room).  The room was clean and there were plenty of fluffy towels and a nice, hot shower.  The WiFi worked well and there was a good selection of channels plus HBO on the TV.  

Location was easy to access from I-84 and is just 10 to 15 minutes from Boise.  There were many fast food establishments within minutes, and many within walking distance.  

We will definitely use this facility again.

I travel to Idaho on business a lot and this place is close to my hotel so I go there out of convenience. I always sit in the bar area, and I always get very slow service from the same bartender. He loves to chat with people and not wait on his tables. One time he stood and talked to someone for a very long time while standing there holding my glass of wine.  I almost got up to grab it but he finally stopped talking. And is wasn't about an order.  This past week I asked the female bartender to bring me a small bowl for my wasabi and soy sauce, and she stopped to talk to someone on her way back.  I watched her roll the bowl around in her hands. She touched every part of the bowl inside and out after using the cash register. Not going back. Too many other great options down the street.
We eat here every time we are in town. I have tried the other resteraunts in town, this is our favorite!

What a nice friendly place. Came here with my 5 year old granddaughter and what a nice time we had. Everyone was so nice. They have a little chair for kids so she could be comfortable. Pedicures were great. Lee did my toes but I bet anyone would be good. Very relaxing.  I'm visiting from out of town and would definitely come back.

We went to this place last weekend and I fell in love. I am a big salad bar fan so this was heaven. They also had soup of course and a few other goodies like bread, chili, nachos, spaghetti, and ice cream. We used a coupon but it is very reasonably priced at $6-7 per person before a drink. Its a long drive from our house in Boise but we will definitely make a trip over there again!

Strange menu.  If you like Hot and Spicy modern renditions of traditional Asian food, then you might like this place.  If you prefer more traditional Asian cuisine (like my wife and myself), then this might not be the place for you.  Caters to a younger crowd (20's-30's).  Good service.  Pricey $$$.

Great burgers, even better onion rings!!! One of the oldest burger joints in Meridian, this place has stood the test of time and has the taste to prove it. Try it out and enjoy the feel of an old drive in.

Ceasar salad was so watered down I couldn't taste any dressing. The lettuce was chopped into tiny pieces. Odd for a non-chopped salad. Eggplant Parmesan was subpar; tomato paste sauce, flavorless, tough eggplant. The ridiculous amount of cheese tried to help, but just made it gooey. The waitress served our food, asked if it looked good & disappeared until she brought the check. I assume she knew my meal was unsatisfactory, since it was practically untouched. She didn't stop long enough for me to express my dissatisfaction. This place used to be SO great. What happened??? I won't be back.

Start with the positive, friendly and courteous staff. . Food served timely.   We ordered chicken pho and chicken pad Thai. Neither of us cared for the chicken itself-brown meat only dry and not separated from cartilage and such. 
Pho broth good, but probably beef based. We ate at 4pm and were the only customers from start to finish, so one would think the place would be clean. Nope. The dining area looked like a wet mop - never rinsed and not swept - was used to "clean" the floor. Obvious dried spillage. Behind the counter was kept except the floor. The women's bathroom appeared to have never been dusted, dirty toilet and floor. I ate there literally when they first opened, but gave it a second try - both experiences were the same.

Greatest! She does an awesome job! Even, beautiful color. My sister and I did the 4 hour solution for my wedding and it was perfect! If you have never tried a spray tan Krissy is where you start. It's 2015, get out of the sun, put on sunscreen, and get spray tanned! You will love it now and in 10 years when you don't have all the wrinkles you would have had haha!

One star is pretty lucky... the CUSTOMER SERVICE here is horrendous. Probably the worst I have ever experienced in a restaurant. The guy at the grill gives you dirty looks while making your food (both times and to other people while we were there). The lady at the register is polite but then doesn't give you what you asked for. We've come here twice. The first time we didn't know better and the second it was too convenient to pass up. Damnit. The one off of Milwaukee and Fairview is 100% better!! Take the drive. Spend the time. It's worth it.  This place is garbage and they should learn some manners.

Great hotel! If you're looking for a modern and minimalistic place to stay, this is it. Clean rooms, friendly staff, and excellent amenities. The location is right off the I-84 so you're very close to almost everything in the Treasure Valley. This isn't a typical Hilton and as another reviewer has mentioned does feel like an upscale dorm; however, I feel as though it maintains the Hilton standard that most Hilton hotel chains have.  Overall, it was a nice place to stay & I would definitely stay again.

This place needs a new cook!!

We had General Tso Chicken and Mandarin Chicken delivered tonight. What a mistake!  The chicken in the General Tso was dry, overcooked & chewy. Quite disgusting. If I had that meal in their restaurant it would have gone right back to the kitchen/garbage.  The Mandarin Chicken (we paid extra for all white meat) was properly cooked. The pork fried rice was a little dry but edible. Overall, they get a D rating.
Wow, this Burger was great and the Fries are awesome, so much food, my Sweet Guy and I shared our meal and a great tasty Chocolate Shake too. Loved it!!

I'm not one to shill out 5-star reviews, but the service here is always so fantastic that I just can't leave anything less. We LOVE visiting Ling and Louie's any time of the day (especially during happy hour) and enjoy many things on their diverse menu. Our favorite time to go is Sunday's after church... It's hardly busy and we always get our food very fast. 

Food: The food is great. From the Uncle Fu's combo fried rice (ask for a side of Mongolian sauce!) to the miso soup to the Kung pow beef to the sushi. It's all good! The crab crunch is our favorite sushi roll. The orange peel chicken and Pad Thai are also really good. Seriously, we have never had anything bad! Maybe take a pass on the wonton nachos, but try the banana cheesecake dessert for sure! 

Drinks: Try the strawberry margarita. 

Atmosphere: the music is always bumping and gives it a chill vibe, the TV's are always turned to sports, and the lighting is dim to make it feel intimate and cozy. Sometimes the music can be loud in the bar, but we like it!

Service: the service is FANTASTIC. Dylan in the bar always takes good care of us. They're always friendly and know our orders so well, they don't even give us menus anymore! 

Happy Hour Offerings: Daily food & drink specials! 

Healthy Hack: ask for a dish of cabbage instead of rice with your meal. Try the soups... They're very flavorful, big portioned and good! 

Tips: show military ID for 10% discount. Ask for Dylan in the bar! He's the best.

Don't bother to come here if you want good Chinese food. It doesn't even taste like it's cooked properly. They have terrible service as well. The waiting time is really bad. I'm not coming back here ever.

Showed up 2 and a half hours before their listed closing time and they had already locked the doors for the evening. We had driven 35 minutes to meet friends there and were not pleased that they wouldn't let us in, when it was clearly listed online that they should still be open. Will not be returning.
I like that it's quick and simple. They are very nice and helpful. The food has been very consistent every time I have been and I wouldn't come back if I didn't like it. I would recommend this place

I hate leaving bad comments to places especially fast foods and/or restaurant but this Sonic in Linder is not worth of your time. Rude people, slow service and employees always have an attitude. Go to the one in Fairview Rd. Or the one in Overland Rd.!

Very poor experience. Rude and try-hard ladies who could care less about doing their jobs. I've been to many sport clips and this was by far the worst experience I've had. I'll be going back to the location on I-35 where they don't assume what you want and buzz all of your hair off without asking how you want it.

For the most part everything went over well. However, when I got my items back, one skirt from banana republic was ruined with multiple holes in it and a ribbon with crinkled flowers for a silk dress was all flattened out and frayed. Other items look ok, but seem to have been harshly treated. I hope they will compensate me appropriately for this skirt, but I doubt it. If they do I will update this post appropriately.
Staff was very friendly with great service. Food  and price is good and comparable with other Mongolian Bbq joints.

Not a bad little find. Sort of a trendy fusion joint serving up some interesting eats.  Thank get the feeling it might be a local chain but none the less, it's pretty decent.  Everyone around bar seemed to be enjoying their food, from soup to sushi.  My house specialty stir-fry wasn't bad either ;). 

I'd definitely come again - good food, good variety and friendly service.

First time trying it as we are here from out of state. Burgers are a good size and the onion rings were beer battered mmmm. I cut my burger in half and almost right away found 2 hairs in the meat patty. Had to be when they formed the burger as I had to pull them out of the meat. The other half of my burger had one. Might try this place once more before putting it on my never again list.
These guys rock- the staff is super friendly and helpful and the equipment is well maintained.
I have been to 2 others in Eastern Idaho and they are all amazing! They make great burgers. Make sure you skip th chain and go to Big Jud's!

I have been ordering here since I don't know how long and I have never had so much problems ordering I mean what part of add soup do u not under stand and to argue that it is more when hello I already know this may never eat here again bad service and dumb people like I deal with that all day at work I should not have to deal with it when ordering food just saying

Well let me start off by saying that it we hadn't been to any Applebee's in over a year for the same reasons that this review is being written at all... Let me also say that our server was outstanding past that this will be the last time I at least (my wife will comment before the end of this) will ever go into an Applebee's where I am paying ever again. So to start things off we ordered the mozzarella sticks as an appetizer then I ordered the "4" cheese Mac and cheese I pit the " around the 4 because well let's face it I couldn't taste cheese at all it was totally over powered by the honey pepper sauce which was so overly sweet that it overpowered the entire dish. Now I know this isn't in the right order but I am going to jump back to the mozzarella sticks which arrived at the same time as my entre which meant that the cheese was cold, which you've ever had fried then cooled mozzarella sticks you know taste awful. My wife ordered the brew pub pretzel bread sticks and beer cheese sauce which was delicious except the dish she received her cheese sauce in was not cleaned properly and there was so little sauce it was not enough for the four breadsticks, at this point we decided to speak to the manager, after waiting 15 minutes to get the attention of anyone in the restaurant admittedly there was only two servers and a bartender, the manager arrived after I had been making eye contact with him repeatedly and attempting to call him over I stopped him as he walked past we informed him of the lack of sauce to which he responded that the breadsticks only come with 4 ounces of sauce. Now my wife and I are both culinary trained and have worked in the restaurant business a combined total of just over 10 years 4 ounces of sauce equals one ounce per breadstick each breadstick was just over a foot long you tell me if you think that's enough because it wasn't by the time she reached her third breadstick there was none of the cheese sauce remaining. We also mentioned to the quote unquote manager about the cold mozzarella sticks which he took off the bill. We then arrived at the end of our meal and after some debate decided to have dessert the triple chocolate lava cake otherwise known as a chocolate molten cake was fantastic. All and all I would not recommend this Applebees whatsoever to anyone unless it is for dessert.

This is my go to for date night, or for a tasty happy hour when I'm on that side of town. It's a little pricier but if you want a fun and delicious take on Asian meets American I highly recommend this place. Depends on who's working on the level of service you get. There are a few young girls who make it obvious they hate their job as much as they hate split ends.
Just as great as I remembered. Steve "doesn't like pasta" but thought the lasagna was amazing. I loved the ambiance, the fountain and the food.

Food is good and fresh. Waitress is very kind and attentive, however the cooks are always in a poor mood. Every time I try to ask a question or I have a request, they act like they don't hear me and do what they want and ignore my questions. The guy today slammed everyone's empty dish and then they speak Vietnamese the whole time with the other cook the whole time that I am standing there. This is the main reason I usually end up at Mongos down the street.

I didn't think to much of this place until I actually went and tried it. The Mexican corn soup is on point and the wife loved the lemon chicken soup. They also have a variety of dessert breads that were awesome. Great job souper salad.

I have never been disappointed with Envy nails. My mom and I go every other month for a girls day having a mani/pedi and it's perfect. The employees interact with you which is hard to find. Perfect place for a girls day out! Prices are really good too! Super friendly! I always recommend them and look forward to every time.

My buddy invited me to go see Modest Mouse with him and another friend. I'm not that big into Modest Mouse, but the plan was to stop at Barbarian Brewing before popping over to Hawk's Stadium (which is right nearby and where the show was being held). If you know me at all, beer and a chance to hang out with one of my best friends wasn't something I'm just going to pass up.

I had not eaten dinner yet and figured we would stop and grab something to eat after the show. This is when I point out that I was mistaken: they already ate. Luckily, there were a couple food trucks at the stadium. That's when I spotted RiceWorks, and remembered that I have passed by them a couple times and really wanted to try their food but never had.

I ordered the general's chicken-which is one of my favorite dishes when we get Chinese food. This is the best general's chicken I have ever had. The chicken isn't covered in flour and batter like a lot of places. See the description from their website: "Embrace your spicy side. Lightly battered and seasoned tempura fried chicken Wok'd in a house savory ginger soy sauce and fire oil. 1-5 star spice levels allow you to control the spice the way you want it!"

Splendid food that made the concert that much more enjoyable. Plus being a bit boozed up from Barbarian might have helped. Highly recommend grabbing some food from RiceWorks if you are at the Village in Meridian, or happen to come across their food truck.

I have only been to this restaurant 3 times.  And I will never return.  The first time I came in with a friend near closing time.  The female bartender  was very polite.  The second time I came in with my three year old daughter for dinner.  I can't remember our waitress's name, but she was very attentive to my child, and I had great service.  The third time I came in was last night (9/7/11).  I sat up at the bar with a friend.  When I got there, a male bartender was engaged in an elaborate story.  I sat down and soon realized he was slandering one of my dear friends...who was a top regular at this location.  She has M.S. and forgets things often and has a hard time with recollection.  If it weren't for this friend raving about the restaurant, I would have never gone in. The male bartender proceeded to slander my friend, even after I acknowledged that she was one of my dearest friends.  Every word from his mouth was obnoxious and unprofessional. 

He then proceeded to mock a situation where a customer complained about him earlier that night.  The customer had ordered an Arnold Palmer and felt as though this bartender had questioned his manhood when asked if he would like vodka in it. The male bartender then continued to call him "a pussy bitch" and openly said he could "fuck off."  He then proceeded to slander the company, saying that your company was "a piece of shit."  A random waitress who was off duty (the one who served my daughter and I) chimed in!  She AGREED with him and out loud said, "Yep.  This company is a piece of shit!"  

At this point, I'm thinking--"where are the managers??  How can you get away with such unprofessional employees?"  I watched in horror as the male bartender slandered, mocked and judged EVERY PERSON who walked in that door that night.  I'm sure I am next on the list.  I will never return to such an embarrassing establishment, and I've made sure EVERYONE  I know is aware of the events from last night.  What a shame.

Great job and about the same I slways pay.. truck looks terrific
He is my go to guy now

Cleanliness of the showers is very poor.  Visible hair and debris present always.  Pair of used latex glove sat in the corner of one stall for 10 days.  Lots of little things.  
The weight equipment is if good variety and well spaced.  Assortment of free and machines plus good stretching/jump rope/warmup area.  Equipment is in used but good repair.  
The am classes like spinning look awesome but try to get a spot is a joke.  I tried to get in for a week but finally gave up and stuck with my basic membership.  
It is Saturday at 6:05 am.  I am waiting outside the gym with 29 other people.  Looks like the opening person is not here.  In fairness this is a first time that ever happened.  Hopefully she is ok and just overslept.  After waiting 30 min (they were supposed to be open at five today) looks like no gym for me today.  (Update: It has been 6 months with no missed mornings  so I think they have got their act together)
Good gym.  Poorly cleaned.  Needs better janitorial. They have made some improvements.  Staff in morning is very nice.

I would not recommend this establishment. Food was so so and the service was terrible.
I ordered take out went fine. Cane back to pick up. There was 4-5 services w 4 tables total. They walked by me waiting 15 times all looking at me and just kept walking. Waited 15 minutes for pick up. They forgot drinks and deaserr that I'd already paid for. There were other unhappy payrkna waiting as well while staff just walked by and looked at us

was good until they forgot 3 of our 9 orders. then they acted like they didnt even care. not even a discount or an im sorry given , had to take the kids to mcdonalds so they could eat. abosolutely the worst service i have ever gotten....and i eat out alot!!!!

Not sure why everyone had such high praise for such a mediocre buffet style restaurant. Everything we tried was stale and had little flavor. I also felt ill for hours after eating here. Not suggested...

This is the worst Sonic location I've ever been to. When they first opened there were issues, but we figured we'd give them some time to work out the kinks. Every time we go we swear it will be our last. However, it is a very convenient neighborhood location, so every few months we try again only to be disappointed. Today it took 30 minutes to get our order. They did bring the wrong order 3 times during that time frame. By the time we got it the fries were cold and drinks watered down. It seems the owner doesn't care. It is too bad as it really does give Sonic a bad name.
I have a great time here.  The staff and owners are awesome.  I always get greeted with a smile and great food.  My favorite is the chicken teriyaki.  Always a winner.
3.5 Almost like a PF Changs but not quite up to that level. We went for the Happy Hour deals on sushi and appetizers. It was good and I would go back again, but it's not my most favorite place.

We had the best server, Talia.  She was perfect.  The happy hour apps are a great deal.  For entrees, my husband got a seafood coconut curry that was right on the money.  I got some loaded sliders (which we saved for later because his dinner was more than enough for two).  Fifty bucks at this place is a nice date.

The interior and exterior design is really nice, but it seems to be another wanna be of PF Changs. I went there when they first opened up. My food tasted like it was burnt. The fire was too strong for the food. Its unfortunate this is a really nice place with not so good food.
The new owner is very friendly. I enjoy my pampering sessions here and my gel polish always lasts. The ladies are all very friendly and accommodating.

Nice little burger joint. Very good service. I ordered the pastrami burger and a water. The drink glasses are huge. The burger tasted great, and the pastrami had great flavor. Generous toppings as well. The only downside was that there were only 2 thin slices of pastrami. It could have used a little more, even if they wanted to raise the price by $.50. The place is nice and clean, with high and low tables plus some booths. They have a 1lb cheeseburger special on Mondays that comes with large fries and a drink for $13. I'll be back with the wife to split that meal.

The service here was great, everyone was friendly and everything was quick. The atmosphere was great and the menu looked very good. We tried the sushi out and it was decent. For some reason it left more to be desired in terms of flavor, though. It wasn't bad, but I won't return for the sushi, maybe I'll give the rest of the menu a shot.
Horrible service. Employees smoking outside the front door the last few times we have been there. It has really gone down hill. We used to really enjoy the food there.

This was my first experience in an Applebee's in quite a while, the restaurant has been updated and so has the menu, the new modern style of this Applebee's is appealing. The overall restaurant and restroom were very clean. Our server Ashley was very kind and speedy, one of the better servers I've had in a while. It was good to see the manager walk around and be active in the front of house experience. She took care of a table behind us in a very professional manner. The food was good, and the service was great, good overall experience! We will be back!

It's a gas station and more.  I do not come here for the gas or the snacks I am all about filling my growler. They have a variety of beer and at least one cider available.  They rotate different beers,  so what you had a month ago might not be available when you return. If you do not have the standard 32 or 64 oz glass jug  growler they may not be able to fill it.  We have a metal keg style growler so they fill theirs and then pour it into ours.  Today we broke down and bought one of their growlers so no more re-pours.

I am so grateful I found this hotel for the night.

During our road trip we found ourselves stopping for the night in Boise, a new town for both of us. During dinner we did a quick yelp search and decided to go with this place. It was worth it.

When we got here there were quite a few technical difficulties with their computer systems; first with the room vacancy system then with the payment system. The hotel staff handled it very politely and professionally. We wanted a room with a king but they were all out, so they decided to give us a nice two queen instead with a complimentary gift from the gift store for our patience through the series of slightly unfortunate events.

If I ever come back to Boise I will be staying here at the Holiday Inn Express.

The service was horrible the waitress acted like it was inconvenience to even wait on us. We complained to the manager several times of the lack of service. Sitting for 30mins and not even having a water to drink. I was very disappointed. Watched a beer get serviced to out table by mistake the waitress came and took it back and sat it back on the bar served it to another table. Needless to say this beer had been drank out of. The manger denied that issue said it was dumped. I told him that several people at out table seen what had happened. The waitress never check back to ask us how out food was. I had to get my self silverware napkins etc.. I was very disappointed with the service. I have asked for the district manager name and number several times and I get a song and dance, and no info to file a complaint with. Worse place to eat and the service was even worse! The manager should not be a manager if he can't handle a complaint.
Great place to visit. Not a crowded place which was really nice. Great service and an excellent experience. Went and saw pitch perfect 2 with my other half and it was amazing.

I like this place. It's male friendly and felt like I got a great service for the price. My stylist knew men's hair and gave me a great experience. The shampoo and neck shave was a nice touch. Definitely recommend.

We wanted to love this place....since we moved from Seattle and are accustom to great international food choices. 

Sadly our delivery arrived missing key ingredients (sweet & sour sauce for the "sweet & sour pork", sesame seeds for the "pork & seeds", etc.) 

Overall the food was OK, we'd order again if desperate for a late night delivery....but we wouldn't let the delivery guy leave without checking EVERYTHING next time! 

Lesson learned.

Definitely better then any chain burger spot, and a big fan of their fried pickles. Great family spot to bring the kids to as well. Never had a bad experience, but the 5th star is for over the top food. Wouldn't hesitate to take friends and family though.
fantastic service and fantastic food...Never disappointed with The Jud... Great place to get your burger fix.

man, I have a lot to say about this place. I REALLY enjoy the food, but have to post that I don't get their sunday kids eat free strategy.  Why offer it if you don't want people to come in to take advantage of it? My kids LOVE the place, which is why I've put up with the embarrassment as much as I have. 

I have 3 kids under 12, and one who is 14, and they keep getting stricter and stricter.  I don't know if the pressure is on the servers to discourage people taking advantage of it, or whether the servers do this on their own, but its weird.  

Used to be kids eat free sunday was honored all day.  Now, when you come in from 11-3 with kids they all seem to have a sour look on their faces.  Twice I've been semi-questioned because my daughter looks older than the age limit.  Well, she's not.  And today, they kept telling me that I couldn't get 3 kids meals free because my son is not an adult.  Well, he's 14, ordering an adult entree, that makes him an adult.  They did honor it but it was odd.  

If they don't want to do kids eat free, thats fine -- just cut it out altogether, don't make it a hassle.

A great local favorite!   Good food, good prices, experienced staff. On Veterans Day, they offer free meals all days for veterans and active duty military.  If visiting or you live nearby, this place deserves a try!

The majestic is not the newest Theatre in town but they still do a good job on keeping it clean and up to date.  Tuesdays is $5 night at the Majestic.  Everyone is very friendly and helpful.   Concession are very good and popcorn all ways fresh.  They have a place to add different type of seasoning to your popcorn including EXTRA butter...  Super bad for you I know..  So good...

Walked in at 2PM and saw 4 tables occupied out of about 20. I noticed there were about 6 tables that still needed to be cleared & was going to give that to the place having a busy lunch service. (though one would think by 2pm, that there would not be that many dirty tables)

I was greeted with the smell of pho broth, a good sign I believe. I ordered the pho with brisket.  The broth was, so far, the best I have had in all the places I have already tried.  They do not use any added MSG, which is a plus for me.  The broth also arrived piping hot, another plus. 

As I waiting for the soup, I noticed one of the two servers talking to a customer saying that she did not get paid for working there.  Her "real" job was doing nails, someplace down the street.  The tables that needed clearing were never touched while I was waiting for my order.  Since it was well past the lunch rush, I found it a bit odd that the used dishes were left to sit.  

When I left at 2:35pm, there was now 5 more tables to be added to the 6 tables that needed clearing.

I booked a movie party here for my eight year old son. They came highly recommended after asking community for comparison with other theaters. I was extremely pleased.  Everything went perfectly. It was the most stress-free birthday party I've ever done for my kids and we've done twenty with my kids. We will definitely use them again and recommend them to all my friends.
I like taking my kids here for a quick and cheep lunch. I always get the teriyaki bowl and my kids scarf it! Very nice staff and always helpful!

I have tried Ling & Louie's at least seven times since they have opened.  I have always had  great food and service there and on occasion, a few people in my party did not a particular entree.  My wife has found her favorite entree and that is the fire cracker chicken and mine is the filet and shrimp platter.  I think that they have gotten past the new restaurant jitter problems that most experience during the first two months of business.  Many of the bad reviews are from when they just opened and that is not always a good representation of what the restaurant will become.
Great location, awesome building and the food and service continues to improve!

Earlier this year, I cold called this place from seeing their Ad online. I saw the bad reviews but then knowing every other place has issues, I decided to give them a try. The service guy 'Hau' came out and diagnosed our TV. He found the problem and transported our large flat screen (10yr old & paid $3800 brand new) in his van to his shop. The repair costed $400 and when checking around, this is about right for what it needed. They were a bit slow on the repairs, and when we went to the shop to follow up, they had several TVs being repaired. They are just very busy and I have no doubt any other place would be the same. After a couple weeks(waiting for a part), he brought the TV back and it worked fine. Several months later (this week), the TV had other unrelated problems and I called Hau and he came out and sure I had to wait a couple hours, but he told me and advised when he would get here. Hau remembered me and told us it was another problem due to the age of the TV. Hau didn't charge me for his service call this time and he made some great recommendations and was very nice and realistic. If I decide to scrap the TV, he may come back to pick it up. That would save me a lot of trouble of hauling this heavy TV myself. I would use this repair service again. People just need to understand that this is a busy place and they do the best they can. If you want superior, on time, etc service, then perhaps you should take your TV back to where you bought it and/or get an extended service plan. My TV lasted 3yrs longer than expected for its type. I have no complaints other than having to wait, but then again, you wait at DMV, the Post Office, the bank, many stores, etc...I gave 4 Stars because they repaired my TV right the 1st time, came out a 2nd time didn't charge and made some excellent recommendations and answered all our questions about the new TVs out there all while being polite, while we were aggravated about having a non functional large TV. Thank you!

We were in town visiting my brother and decided to stop in for lunch. Everyone was very pleasant and friendly. Sometimes it's difficult to get the staff to check on you but here they are all constantly checking on you. They deserve a great review. The food was tasty as well! You can't go wrong eating here!

We had a great experience!  My friend was in town so we went for pedicures.  Her two daughters came too.  They were ready for us at our appointment time and the girls got the same treatment as the adults!  Everyone was friendly and the salon was very clean.

I really enjoyed my first visit here. The spicy tuna was quite good, and the service was outstanding. Thanks to Brett for the sushi and Boston for the service. I am looking forward to returning soon to try some of the other menu options.
I'm SO glad that these guys set the pumps so they'll actually FILL my tank without me having to swipe my card twice - and get charged extra CC fee.  Awesome, I'm going to use them for now on.

I hardly ever get my nails done but I was in a pinch because it was a couple days before my wedding and I had completely forgotten about my nails. Yikes. So I called around and looked at reviews online and I saw this place. I wanted to try it out so I called them and asked their prices and if they were available day of. They said yes just walk in. I wasn't able to get to the salon until an hour and half till they closed. They said they could still do my nails which I was so thankful for. So they told me I would have to wait 10 mins. That was fine I didn't mind. Well 40 mins later they get started on my pedicure. The lady that did my pedicure was very nice. 
I showed a picture of what I wanted my nails to look like and I wasn't picky about what color my toes were. The picture for the manicure clearly showed acrylic fake nails.
So I got the pedicure done and all was good until I started getting my manicure, the lady started doing my nails as a gel manicure on my natural nail. I stopped her when she got to finger number 3 I  asked if she was going to add the fake nails on she said no because I'm getting a gel manicure. I said no I wanted fake nails. She tried convincing me that the gel nails would like fine and I should keep them. I said no because its my wedding and I wanted different nails. She said she would have to charge me if I wanted to change them, and I said no I wouldn't pay for them if that was the case. Well she got all huffy and rude because she had to start over. While she was doing the manicure she cut my cuticles to short on most of my fingers, it was very painful for days after.
During the rest of my manicure she hardly spoke a word to me and only talked to her coworkers. I felt extremely awkward the rest of the time I was there (2 and 1/2 hours). And when I was paying she looked like she expected a really good tip for her service.
I can admit the acrylics and pedicure were done well but the manicurists attitude was horrible.
This was our first time visiting Big Juds and we had a very enjoyable experience.  The food was very good and the service was outstanding!  Cassandra was our server and she was very attentive.
Firecracker chicken was recommended to us by waitress and it was cold and very dry,  looks like a nice place but the food is not up to par
Love the fresh flavored. Service is great! I love that the good is not over sauced, therefore giving you a full flavor of all the vegetables and meats.

This is My favorite secondhand kids clothing store !  Yes they are picky about what they take when you turn items in but that's because they have high-quality items for a very cheap price ! 
 I've bought my son many almost new Nike shirts name brand sandals and swim gear for just a couple dollars apiece !

With movie theaters working to draw in the crowd, Majestic Theatre has been consistant and reliable for many years. 

+1 star for the generally lower prices than Edwards and Cinema West (The Village movie theater) of both tickets and food (3$ refill popcorn bucket is popular for frequent returns)

+1 star for the efficient and friendly service of the different workers. The treatment is in dedication for movie goers to have a great, relaxed, and clean movie experience

+1 star for the atmosphere in comparison to other theaters. While not as large or including of as many perks as other theaters in the valley, I find the seats to be most comfortable,  the concessions among the best for traditional movie viewing (though pricy as usual in theaters)

+1 star for the lack of crowds ever in the lobby or theater areas. While consistant busy with cars in the lot and people in concession lines, Majestic is rarely crowded and parking is relatively easy to find

-1 star for the lacking cleanliness on some occasions. While bathrooms remain clean, theaters are sometimes not as swept or mopped of sticky and popcorn as they could be. 

Great, local place to watch the newest movies. Just came from there after The Village theater was sold out of the show we were going to see and it was another good experience at the movies with family.

The idiots who work here seem to not understand the English language. You can give them any number of descriptions of how you want your hair cut - even the most simple of cuts - and they will still find a way to mess it up. Do not go here.

My server, Jennifer,  was excellent.   She communicated my order to the cook perfectly, and I was served the best meal I have ever eaten at an Applebee's anywhere.   Kudos to the kitchen!!!  Tamera offered incredible hospitality.

So happy I found Kris on yelp...I've been spray tanning for a while and have to say getting sprayed by Kris was one of the best experiences I've had. Same price I've paid for other tans BUT Kris comes to your house and easily sets up a tent so you can stay in the comfort of your own home. And she arrived 10 minutes early to leave time to set up. She was so personable and that made it an even better experience. She did a few techniques that no other spray tan service offered. Very thorough! I waited to review to see how the tan developed as well as how long it lasted and finally usually my worst part of spray tans...how it fades. I'm happy to report the tan was very natural. Dark enough but not overdone. Never would have known it was fake...not orange or oompaloompish at all! I didnt have ANY wierd dark marks around my feet or wrists. Today is day 5. The tan is starting to fade like a natural tan would BUT without big blotches like my other spray tans normally do. I will definitely be calling Kris again anytime I want that sun kissed look without all the skin damage! Thanks for making me look great in a bikini in Palm Springs at the end of October!

One star for the server who was new and very nice.  

We were past the normal dinner hour, about 7pm.   We were with a party of 11, and the restaurant was not crowded at all.  Drinks and water came out quickly which was nice, and our orders were taken in about 15 minutes, but we are a family who hadn't seen much of each other in a long time so we were getting caught up and it was okay.  

However, (and we started getting really hungry) about 8pm and there was no food for anyone.  My cousin and I got our salad then, but no one else had food.  By the time the food arrived, about 8:15, four of our group needed to leave with their food to go because it was so late.  

The hamburgers looked delicious, but I am gluten free and couldn't have that.  My husband and uncle ordered a chicken dish and while it looked good, that's all they got.  A single chicken breast on a bed of grains and a few vegetables.  My husband was still hungry afterwards.  Everyone else ordered steaks of various types, and most were satisfied.

Then came mine.  I ordered the 9-ounce sirloin with a baked potato.  The potato, while large, was about half done, and with a cold, shriveled look, like it had been sitting under a warmer for quite a while.  My steak I had ordered medium rare, and it was definitely medium-well, but at least with good flavor, at least I think it did, on the two pieces I was able to chew.  It was tough and sinewy.  I wasn't going to say anything because it was late and I was tired.  But my husband insisted and they brought me a new steak.   

This steak was rare.  Cold, and less tender than the first one.  I gave up.  

Then, they charged us for both steaks.  Needless to say, will not be returning to this particular Applebees.  Good thing I don't live near here, because I love the Applebees near my home.  

A big fat YUCK.

Went in on 12/23 a Tuesday night. The service was sooooo bad! They have these new tablets to take your order and get refills but that's no excuse to stop giving service. Food took forever to get to our table and came out cold. You could tell it was sitting in the window for a while. Nobody came to check on us to see how our food was or clear dishes. We waited to see how long it would take for someone to come by but it was taking so long we had to give in and push the stupid tablet to call for service. When we said something about it the server was not very apologetic and the manager who was standing behind her while we were complaining didn't say a word to us. We will stick to the to go portion of this place cause the service sucks.

I've never been to a cell phone repair/accessory store anything like this one! It is so clean, so stylish, and the selection is absolutely wonderful. All the employees are super helpful and friendly. I came in to get my phone screen fixed, and left with a phone that looked brand new, and bunches of new accessories for it. So happy with my experience, THANK YOU Tricked Out!
Golds Gym in Boise is...  "where it's at"! Want to get a focused workout using great equipment - this is your place.

Nice salon. I was a walk in and they got to me right away. Prices are reasonable. Service was good. I upgraded to the Signature Pedicure. I liked it, however, as a word of caution they do use oil to moisturizer with the Signature. I left still feeling very slippery (I could hardly walk in my flip flops) and wished I had brought a towel to help prevent any oil stains in the car. It didn't look like the other pedicures used the oil. I was also very impressed that they had a child's pedicure chair and pricing available. Looking forward to coming back with my daughters sometime!

Finally real terriyaki in the Treasure Valley!! I visited Happy Teriyaki for the first time  last Saturday and am so glad that I did. I moved here from Seattle and have been looking for a place that serves what I call "Seattle style teriyaki". I have found it at Happy Teriyaki! I ordered the spicy beef teriyaki for the whole family and everyone absolutely loved it. The portions are huge and most importantly the flavor and consistency of the meet is perfect. My family and I will definitely be regulars here. I also had the pleasure of meeting the owners and you can tell they put their passion for good food into their menu selection. Thank you.

Something is up here. Called their phone and message said they were open. We drove from Boise only to find a sign saying they were closed until further notice. Wish they would have changed their machine to match the sign...hour lost and still hungry!
Steak phö is great. The menu is huge with a great selection. Soup sandwiches noodles and even deserts. We will definitely be back.

We got a couple of cheeseburgers, tots, fries, a Korn dog (yes, spelled with a "k") and a raspberry shake. The food was so-so, definitely wouldn't come back for it. The car hop also seemed like she absolutely hates her job. :(

This has been my go to breakfast place for about 20 years...( the majority of my life) the food is delicious, service is wonderful and although it's very out dated... I'm happy that it never changes. Although it's old school it's homey and CLEAN! Love everything on the menu
Very new Walmart. Clean. Above average service.  Good parking and access.  I have never had a bad experience here. Good donuts for cheap.

A guy from perx came to my home. They have been less than polite. They have tried to switch me from my current provider. They don't seem to notice my no soliciting sign.  I have always been very polite to them regardless to their attitude towards me. I would avoid Perx after my poor experience.

Extremely clean, friendly, and efficient. They do beautiful work! Tina is wonderful!! From what I've seen all the gals who work there do a good job. I highly recommend this place to anyone who is looking for a place to have their nails/toes done.

We had arrived for our film extremely early, so there was plenty of time to walk around the grounds in the searing heat. I started to crash soon thereafter and I saw someone carrying an iced coffee and thought that there might be a shop on the grounds or somewhere nearby. We went to one of those standing directories and saw that there was one in the center of the complex. 

We walked and the cool air blast is what was needed. I instantly perked up and ordered a nonfat iced coffee and my GF ordered a cinnamon bun and a water. The seating area is quite large and Village Coffee and Calle 75 Street Tacos share the space. They have large wooden tables and chairs and it is comfortable. Service was great and it was what the doctor ordered. 

Oh, and from one of the newspaper profiles on the place - I believe Chuck Norris' stunt double works for the company in some capacity. He's either a partner or he's in charge of buying the coffee beans.

This places doesn't even deserve ONE star. Absolute trash. We ate 2 bites out of our food and told them how unsatisfied we were and they said sorry and proceeded to charge us full price. The food has no flavor, shrimp taste like dishwater, the fried rice is completely bland, tastes like white rice with freezer burnt carrots and peas and raunchy scrambled eggs. Not to mention, the bathrooms smelt like sewage, not just like someone just went #2, like the something is wrong with the sewage system. All around, this place is ratchet.

Was excited to go b/c we saw the sign on the building for 1\2 price sushi during happy hour. We didn't realize we only got to pick from a small lists of options which turned out to be lots if rice and not so much fish.... Service  was "relaxed" . Our original server left in the middle of our visit without mentioning someone else was taking over or who that was.... Probably won't really need to go back and will keep exploring around.

I ordered online, was given an 1 hour 15 minute wait time.  No problem I thought.  At the 1 hour 12 minute mark I got a call from them and was told it would be at least another hour.  I cancelled my order and was told my refund was 5 days out.

Salad bars are definitely lacking in this town.  Enter Souper Salad - a great, HEALTHY option - I'm glad they've survived so far!  

The name says it all - the focus here is on salads and soups, and they do a great job of it.  Lots of veggies, fruits & proteins, and a variety of pre-made pasta salads.  There are always 5-6 soups on hand (including vegetarian and vegan options), and fresh bread.  There is also a smaller taco, baked potato, and pasta bar (I've never tried any of it - it looks like a lot of processed crap).  It is a little spendy, in my opinion - if we both order sodas, it's a little over $20.  Subtract $5 if you drink water.  

Love this place - wish they'd build something similar in E. Boise so we could visit more often.

Kinda disappointed. I was closed as a "model home" that is a good deal I believe. All the devices free, five year contract sucks but it's better than not having a security system. However I was informed the credit check was a soft check. I asked multiple time to ensure that because of my home purchase. After being reassured multiple times, I come to check my credit score a few weeks after and what do you know a hard inquiry in my credit which almost put me in the hole on the home. Not a honest thing to do. And definitely makes me never want the service in any new home I get again.

The stylists are friendly, they provide a quality service, the location is clean, and the price is acceptable. My most recent stylist was a singer. I looked up her music on Spotify and she was pretty good. Another stylist I had liked similar movies as I did and we had a nice conversation about movies while my hair was being cut.

Ordered the chicken pizza, it was fantastic. 
Our server however was very sloppy and unfocused. Lots to improve there.

Souper Salad's Meridian/Boise location needs to reopen, pronto!    It brought the legendary Texas salad bar restaurant here to Idaho, and was always a cool and relaxing place to be with healthy food choices.  You could work for hours on a laptop and be left alone, or pop in for a quick lunch.   Considering how far away it is from the cluster of Souper Salads in TX, the quality was amazingly good - including the homemade soups, and the hard to make signature fettucini corn parmesan pasta.

Hope people will start a movement to bring this much-needed restaurant back.   People loved this place - and I miss it!
First time eating here with our family.  Service was good and the food was quite tasty.  We'll certainly go back again to try more things.

My husband and I had been here once before and thought the food was fair, although neither of us liked the sauce on our dishes.  We decided to come here again on our engagment anniversary because I had a Restaurant.com gift card to Louie's.  We ate our meals and then presented the certificate.  The waiter took it and then came back to the table with it and said they woud not honor it because the owner had not agreed to be on Restaurant.com.  They did discount our meal about $3 but overall we had to pay the bill out of pocket since they would not take the certificate.  Food is just fair and service was okay, considering it was Friday night.  We just thought it was bad customer service not to honor the dining certificate.

12/23/15  I want to ammend my review as I appreciated the excellent customer service of the owner reaching out to me via direct message to clear things up.  He explained to me the difficulty they have had in regards to dealling with Restaurant.com, explained to me how I can contact them to get a new certificate for a participating restaurant, and even offered for my husband and I to come back and try again.  This all meant alot to us and should definitely be considered when chooseing where to dine.  I also hear the pizza is great here and look forward to trying it myself!
Nice clean theater, convenient location, good prices (for a first-run movie theater), and friendly staff.

Amazing!!  Can't wait to go back again.  Best and most unique fried rice I have ever had.  Unlike most places in Boise spicy does mean spicy but not overdone to preclude enjoying the masterful pairing of flavors.  My wife had the firecracker scallops with noodles and I had the firecracker chicken tacos and we shared the calamari appetizer.  Can't wait to try the sushi and many other dishes on the menu.  One of the best food experiences in 10 years of living in the Boise area.  My new #1 restaurant!

Love this gym. Cardio cinema is fabulous! Work out in the dark AND watch movies?? Yes please. The daycare is solid and I appreciate that they limit the number of kids allowed. Took my first yoga class today and it was super challenging and rewarding. I hate working out, but this gym helps me want to do it.

Really surprised at how good this was!   Quick and fresh Asian.  Ordered the General Tso's and was very pleased.  Fresh lean cuts of chicken lightly fried.  Ordered 2 stars spicy and it had some kick to it.

My daughter and I went in and got a mani and pedi. It was good during. Atmosphere was good. we waited 20 minutes after our apt time, that was frustrating. 1 week later the "GEL" decoration was coming off my nails and one of my daughters gel polishes came off a finger.

I've taken my son here for a haircut a few times. I've never had an issue with this place. However, when I took him this time it wasn't pleasant at all. None of the girls that worked there smiled once and they were very unfriendly. I was pretty bummed out that we had this experience. I did like going to this location since it's closest to my home, but now I think I'll drive the extra miles to go to the Nampa location.
Watch out in n out burger! We are from San Diego and these are hands down the best burgers we have had in forever! The fried pickles were delish

Big place, excellent service, good value, so-so execution.

A cavernous room with Italian street motif and a fountain in the middle, the ambiance was decent enough. My server, Journey, was friendly, professional and very efficient. Their house wine was not bad and a good value at $4.75 per glass.

The prices are fair enough with the Veal Parmesan and a side of pasta coming in at $17.99, including soup or salad and garlic bread (which was not obvious from reading the menu). I asked for and got Bolognese (meat) sauce on my penne, but the pasta was not drained well and made the adjacent veal quite soggy. The veal was a bit too thick and chewy, so it could have used a good pounding before being breaded to make it more tender and appear larger. The sauce was OK, but would have probably been better had it not been watered down by the poorly drained pasta.

CombatCritic Gives Louie's Pizza and Italian Restaurant 5 Bombs Out Of 10 ... More Bombs Are Better!

Eh. The steak pho is OK, but there's much better to be had around town. The green curry chicken was flavorless. Not sure what part of the chicken was being served, but several pieces were inedible. The egg rolls were very good & fresh. Very expensive - $30 for two people for lunch We probably won't be back.

Yesterday I drove through the new sonic on Linder in Meridian Idaho. I ordered a large order of onion rings through the drive thru. I want to stress that the manager dressed in black was standing at the window when I picked up my order. I pulled away from the window and stopped and looked at my order my onion rings were burned the bottom side that have been left in the dryer too long with black. I drove around Sonic and pulled into one of the best car hops slots and press the button as I was not going to wait in line again. When they came on the Speaker I expressed my dissatisfaction and they were very polite about telling me they would replace the onion rings. When the young lady came out to the car I expressed my concern with the fact that someone inside serving had to know when they picked up the end rings with the tongs and place them into the bag that they were serving burned food and they willfully did it anyway and with this I have a problem. I'm very understanding about accidents I have no understanding about willful course quality service. The young lady apologized took the burn bag and gave me the replacement bag and left I backed out and started to pull away a second time opening the back to look and see that this bag was burned worse than the first batch. Extreme willful neglect and poor customer service. You would think that someone would look at what they were serving to a customer would already complained once about poor quality instead of blindly grabbing another bag answering I'm the same old slop. This is willful poor customer service times 2. Please be sure and look at the photographs attached to this review.
Every time I come here the food always tastes good! I love this place. Fresh sushi all the time!

Pretty decent beauty store, I like how they have drugstore brands as well as premium brands.

The coupon situation is kind of a nightmare, they almost always have coupons available but you can only use it on certain items, which seems to be less than half of the items in the store. Almost every time I try to use a coupon, I can't. 

The associates at the store are super friendly and very helpful. My mom was looking for a specific product and the lady on the floor helped us find the product, plus other alternatives of different price points.
Our cashier was Ariel and she was so stinkin' friendly and sweet!

It is a pretty good Sonic.  I have noticed a couple of negatives they might work on though.  Pretty slow service, the garbage has been full to overflowing the last three times I've been there, and in their outdoor seating area there was a glob of milk shake sitting on a table for over 24 hours (yes I do notice these things.). Some employees are very competent and friendly though.

I went back this morning (6-16) both issues I mentioned before have been addressed.  Excellent customer service too.  There was a mix up on my order, and they were sure I was ok before I left.
Mushroom Swiss burger is amazing. Hand cut fries are to die for. Service was nice to. Love the pictures on the wall. Overall the envoirment is nice and food is great I will be back.

Got a pedi and the final product is fantastic!  With gels and the $35 massage pedi my total was $55, without gratuity. I liked the sugar scrub and the minty leg mask. The lady that did my pedi was good! Nice massage and she didn't scrub too hard with the pumice or nip to close to my little piggy cuticles. She was jjuuuuuusssttt right.

I don't mind that the ladies were speaking their native tongue. They had a radio station that played tons of songs I knew the lyrics to so I sang to my hearts content while the ladies spoke to each other. The ladies were friendly. 

The location is lacking in that you need to be headed south on Eagle to avoid dealing with all the traffic. They don't take debit or credit which made me do a double take.... Who doesn't take a card or at least have a square in this day and age?? Be prepared to shell out $1.95 at the ATM plus the cost for service and tip If you patronize this business.
So the slushies have become like the other sonics and the candy add ins are all at the bottom. The food is now ok, nothing to rave about.

This used to be my husband and my favorite date night dinner spot. I loved it so much that we went there for Mother's Day. We waited 25 minutes with not one person coming to ask for a drink order (there were only 9 tables being used...noone beside us). So we left, I was super sad as I love this place. After not going there since that day we decided to go there this Saturday. We were seated fast. But the waitress was less then happy to be there. She didn't smile, didn't joke around and complained everytime she was at our table. The food was okay. We got our appetizers after our main course. Which yes..quick service but we felt rushed. To say the least we were kind of sad about this experience

3 stars because it's a great place to purchase kid's clothes, but it's not a great place to trade in your clothes. It seemed they only wanted the items that were new and still had the tags on, despite the rest of my items being in excellent condition and current with today's baby trends. The same employee helped me with the drop off and the pick up of the unwanted items. I indicated to her both times that I was new to the process and wasn't sure how it worked. She never explained anything to me. However, other employees were very kind while I waited for her to find my unwanted items. I'll still continue to shop there but you're better off reselling your baby/kids items on Craigslist or Facebook.

***three star casual dining***
Expectations were perhaps too high. Appetizers ordered didn't come out until after entrees were served. Kinda pointless as appetizers. The soup was tepid, obviously forgotten out. The flavor can only be described best as it tasted like my dog smells when he needs a bath. I get the idea of "fusion", but funk stays on the dance floor!  The wontons were also tepid and a not very crisp as they'd been hanging around with sauce drizzled over them. What happened to teamwork people? I know another server had to have seen the food sitting there with the order tickets. Most of the entrees were served by another server, but the sushi was served by our designated server. It was good sushi (which is expected). There wasnt much for the little kids...everything was either naked or spicy...nothing inbetween.
The desserts were tasty, but not so much that I'd return for the lack of basic dinner service. The food was alright...but again nothing so grand that I'd return for. Three stars for sushi and a clean environment and quite music. Loose two stars for lack of service.

My go-to place was sold and now there's a guy doing the spray tanning. It was awkward, so when vacation rolled around, I wanted something new. I was hesitant, more so when I found out this business is mobile and she comes to your house. I've got to tell you though that it was simple, there was no mess at all in my home (self-contained tent catches overspray). Krissy was right on time and professional. Best part? Ok, there are actually two: First, she's got a fast-process solution ($10 more) that can be showered off after 4 hours. So nice. Second, this may have been the most natural and best aging tan I've ever had. And I wasn't gentle with it either -- snorkeling in ocean water, in and out of the pool; no matter, it aged beautifully. It takes a lot of practice and a special sense of artistry to spray on a tan that looks natural and doesn't get splotchy as it ages. Krissy is fantastic!

I had breakfast at Sunrise Cafe this morning. The location is great, parking can be challenging since it's mostly street parking. By the food was good, our waitress was awesome. We always had plenty of coffee and water. Definitely recommend this place if you're look for a good breakfast!
i love sunrise the chef salad is amazing. the server was so sweet. breakfast is great and the staff is so friendly

Thought I'd give this a shot after a friend recommended it.  I wasn't impressed.  

When we first walked in, we were greeted by some friendly staff.  I made the mistake of saying we'd never been there before, and got a long lecture about how a retired baseball player married an Asian chef and they created Ling and Louie's. Cool story.  The hostess spent 8 mins explaining every dish on the menu.  Every dish.  Even the meatloaf.  Who orders meatloaf!?
