So I order the Black Orchid Tuna as an appetizer, and the firecracker chicken as my entree.  While we waited 25 mins for the appetizer to come out, it gave us a chance to google Ling and Louie's.  Turns out that whole Baseball player / Asian chef story was made up by some guy in Arizona.  Either the hostess didn't know, or she was a great actress.  I don't go to restaurants for the back story.  I go for the food.  Does anyone know (or care) how PF Changs came to be?  
So I could nitpick the appetizer.  It was unevenly cooked, but it tasted great.  The Asian slaw that came with it was spicy and complemented the tuna pretty well.  I should have stopped there.    
Another 25 mins later, and the entrees arrive.  I was not so impressed with my firecracker chicken.  Way too much sauce.  The rice beneath the chicken was mushy and drowning in this surprisingly bland, yet very hot sauce.  Tasted like burning.  The chicken itself was dry as bone and had an odd breading. 
When we went to pay, the hostess (not our very nice waitress) took the folio and returned it without a receipt to sign.  It took another 15 mins to track her down to see if she'd even swiped my credit card or not.  
As we left, they offered punch cards for returning trips....I promptly threw mine away.

I've eaten there many times.  Today, well I'll think again before going.  I just sent this to their corporate via their own website:
"I received an email and coupon for the Labor Day Weekend from your Souper Fresh Club.  I've received these many times in the past and have enjoyed the coupons they often provide.  This time. however, the only store in Idaho refused to honor it.  Two complaints here.  1) while it is true the fine print said not valid in Boise, the only store in Idaho is in Meridian not Boise.  That's misleading!  and,
2) your third-party email marketing firm, Fishbowl.com (fbmta.com) offers email marketing based on a number of criteria in your mailing list.  You could have easily not sent this email to those registered in my zip code - for that matter, any Idaho zip code (83XXX) - that's also misleading.

Lastly, regarding the store itself.  I've eaten there many times and always had good service.  Today, they had more business than usual and the only employee I saw was the manager/co-owner who took the stack of dirty plates that had accumulated.  I never saw a server.  Poor service is the understatement for today's visit.  We did see the manager/co-owner and she was pleasant and did take the dirty dishes."

I had an excellent experience with Amber. Every facial is customized and she really goes above and beyond to make her clients happy. I have had a lot of facials all over the world. Amber knows her stuff. Go and enjoy!

I've tried this restaurant 4 times now, hoping it would improve on service without fail they have been extremely slow in the service department. If you like waiting 10 minutes to get a glass of water then another 10 minutes if you want to order anything else.....then wait for it, wait for it, so slow....I really wanted to give them several opportunities but unfortunately my experience has been the same every time! Slow slow slow service! Don't go here if you only have an hour...you need at least two hours just to get fed. I actually enjoy not being rushed when dining out but when you're entire table is sitting waiting with no drink refills, wondering "how long does it take for the waitress/waiter to come back?" It's a bit much! The food is good though once you get it...be prepared to wave down someone to bring your bill as that seems to take extra effort for them as well!
Great Meridian landmark.  Little higher prices but the food is good. Shakes are awesome and the serveice always comes with a smile!

Definitely the best bar in the state of Idaho.  The bartenders are amazing.  David is my favorite bartender.  He knows a lot about the selection on tap and definitely likes to help you pick the best option for you.  I've never been disappointed in his suggestions.  The selection is incredible.  Last time I was in there I believe they had about 50 on tap.  The cool thing is that they aren't all from the same brewery.  They feature 1-3 brews from the same brewery instead of the full selection, which, in my opinion, gives you the best choices.  Trivia night is awesome.  They also do tap takeovers where they have certain breweries featured and you can usually get a brew or two out of the beer rep there for that night.  I hear they are getting an alcohol license so it might get a little crazier(in a good way).  Make sure you leave a dollar for the wall!

The service is terrible!  The Pho is weak and the noodles taste like the kind in the package you get 10 for a dollar!  Most of all... the wait for your food.  
When I walked in on a Sunday, (Father's Day) one gentleman was finishing up his lunch and left.  I was the only person in the restaurant.  
I went to the counter and ordered my food.  The person at he cashier was yawning.. and said "sorry."  I ordered spring rolls and pho.  They only have two kinds, vegetarian and beef.
I ordered the vegetarian.
It was 12;15 when I sat down, and kept waiting and waiting.. I mean, how long does it take one to roll a spring roll?  At 12;35 20 minutes later, I went to the counter and told the cashier to cancel my spring roll order.  It was taking too long.  She said, "It will be out in a minute." They already had my money, so I couldn't leave.   Just then a woman came out and said I'm sorry it took so long, but we make it fresh all the time.  20 minutes????  While I was sitting and waiting for my food... the three or four teenagers in the restaurant were having their own conversation, which dominated the entire restaurant... laughing and teasing, the gal was moving her head up and down tossing her hair like a rock star in the back where I could see from my table.  One of the help people came out before my food came out with a plate of food for HIM and sat at the table to eat.  He didn't have to wait for his food. 
Then the rock and roll music came on full blast....  I waited again another 10 minutes!  A make waiter came out and said sorry for the wait... 45 minutes to get my food. I was the only one in there... again the woman came over and said sorry, but we make everything fresh when you order... 
Just then a group of 4 people came in to order. I almost went up to them and said, "Don't order here, you'll be waiting a long time since there are 4 of you!"  They ordered.  I was sitting in back of them, so I couldn't see what they were eating or drinking.  
After my lunch I needed more. water.  I looked up at he counter and there was one of the waiters sucking down a big glass of coke leaning on the counter.  Some service!  I got up to leave and left half my lunch... I looked over at the table where the four people were sitting and they all had big bowls of Pho.  They had to have gotten theirs in 5 minutes... they were all eating.  Maybe because they were Vietnamese, they had better service.  They didn't have to wait like I did, for them to make it "Fresh overtime!"
What a waste of my time and money to go in and enjoy a bowl of Pho.  My advice, is to not go here.. they don't serve their food on trays, they deliver your food with their fingers half way in your plate.  Have no conception of customer service, and the help there needs a high degree of restaurant training and lessons on serving food.  Do not go there.  
Tai Basil in Meridian is the place for good Pho.  On Wednesdays, they have Pho night and it's two dollars off a bowl of Pho.
Pho 779 does not deserve one star.  they need to get rid of the chitter chatter in the back room, the teenagers having their own loud conversations and laughing while you are sitting there waiting for your food for a half hour is ridiculous.  They should be wiping down tables, or cleaning windows or other things to enhance the restaurant, instead of having a good time in the back with the cooks.

They do great pedicures there but when you walk in there isn't no sign on door or the person that you sign in with doesn't tell you that they don't take credit cards . But when you go to pay then they say cash only. They have ATM machine in there place! 
They need to have sign! Customers were un-happy for Mother's Day!
They would got a better rating if they had a sign!

We definitely enjoyed our dinner here tonight. A great family atmosphere but also spacey enough to make it feel private. We had a very attentive server and our food came out very quickly. The food was amazing. Lots of flavor, quality fresh ingredients, an overall great experience.

Since there has yet to be a Fast Eddy's built in my part of town, I only stop in occasionally when I'm in the area.. I like it.. ALOT.  Clean, bright, spacious and well organized,  Fast Eddy's is a convenience store lovers DREAM.  So many choice in pre-prepared food and beverage.. AND a Growler station!  No matter what I'm looking for in terms of a 'quick grab' I can find it at Fast Eddy's.  The staff are always well groomed, personable and quick to smile- these are people who actually seem to ENJOY the work they do, and that makes a LOT of difference.   Look out Maverik, Stinker and Jackson- if Fast Eddy's moves into Boise you are going to really have to up your game.  SO MANY BEVERAGE CHOICES.. CLEAN MACHINES.. what's not to love?

One of my favorite burgers for years. Other franchise hamburger establishments have bombarded the area and I've tried them all yet still come back. You have to try the fries or tots too. Thick and greasy And all swallowed with a huge soda
Oh and to see one of those 2 pound burgers go by is something to watch. I've split one of those with 4 people and the flavor is still amazing just like the regular burgers

Worst dental experience EVER!  Watch out for the master up-sell and a completely messed up scheduling system.

I came for a $59 cleaning and walked out with $500 of half-done dentistry.  My teeth hurt so badly I didn't want to return and the cleaning was lousy.

Even prior to my first appointment, I received multiple calls, confirming different times and dates for my appointment.  After my first appointment, the same thing for my next appointment.  Apparently the right hand and the left hand don't know what they're doing at this office. Probably because they outsource their calling from California. 

They even continued to make appointments for me after I left and without my permission and, of course, hit me with a barrage of reminder calls and emails. 

Then I heard from someone that they are a corporate owned dental clinic (dentist doesn't even own it, just an employee) and so they may not even be legally operating.  Wow.  What a mess of a place!  Beware.

It would have been two stars except I did enjoy one of the five things we ordered, the jeweled beef with rice noodles. The hoisin ribs were my least favorite, the walnut shrimp was ok, the sizzling chicken and pork was tasty. The lettuce wraps we're ok, strong gingery lemony flavor, I liked it enough, except it came with a measly 4 pieces of lettuce. Yikes. 
The bar was noisy but the energy level was good. It could be a good family restaurant and a great hang out for watching a game. The wait help we're very friendly and I felt welcome here!

It is a pretty good Sonic.  I have noticed a couple of negatives they might work on though.  Pretty slow service, the garbage has been full to overflowing the last three times I've been there, and in their outdoor seating area there was a glob of milk shake sitting on a table for over 24 hours (yes I do notice these things.). Some employees are very competent and friendly though.

I thought it was a solid 3 stars.  Service was good.  It took awhile for the food to come out, but we had requested peanut free due to allergies, so I think that was the reason for delay.  We would rather have the food a little slower than be exposed to peanuts.  Food was ok.  Nothing really good or bad to say.  I wouldn't make a special trip for it, but if driving by, I would try again.

Although, I seen some very bad reviews about this company, I tried to give the company a chance due to that the reviews were so outdated. In chance that the company had changed their ways. However, I've found out the hard way and confirmed the old reviews. This guy is so unorganized and unprofessional. I would not recommend him. 

First off, Upon dropping off my TV to the shop, his shop is so messy and unorganized. Parts and equipment were all over the place. I could barely walk into the shop without stepping over things. 

Secondly, upon inquiring how much to repair my 50"  TV, Hao, the owner, wanted to charge me over $200 in labor costs just to swap out 3 boards (which only took a few screws and a couple of cables to disconnect and reconnect). I determined this by checking out how much parts cost online and subtracting the part cost from his quote.
Bottomline, I was being way over charged for a TV that was about 9 years old at the rate of almost the cost of a new TV.

However, I still wanted to give this company a chance since how I was able to work out an arrangement where I provide the parts and he just does the labor. Saving me $165 in repair costs.

So it was still worth it for me to take a chance on this company, but then it turns out their reviews where spot on. One, it took Hao, the owner, 2 days just to get the new boards installed after I dropped them off. Then, by his own admission, he said if I didn't hear from him on the day I was to pick up the TV, that this would mean everything was good to go and to show up at 3:30pm to pick the TV up.
So I drove to the shop at the designated time, in traffic, as agreed upon, and he wasn't there!!! But what really upset me was that when I got there to pick my TV up, I found out that my TV hadn't even been worked on yet. He had over 2 days to work on it and still no boards where installed. 

Finally, when I got a hold of Hao, he stated he would get the TV done that day and drop it off to my home so I wouldn't have to come back. (A little late for a gesture like that since how I had to drive in traffic just to show up on time.)
In any case, he told me he'd be at my home by 6 pm that day, but he didn't show up until 6:45pm.

So bottomline, I would not use this guy to repair your TV's. He totally lacks professionalism and obviously doesn't know how to organize and plan his time.

Legendary burgers, great fries and friendly service. This place is a local icon. We often go as a family or group and have the combo meal where you get an epic sized burger that you cut in slices like a pizza, 2 baskets of fries or tots and 4 large sodas. With 5 of us we still end up with a box at the end. You should also try the milkshakes.
Best place in town. Any pinterest design I find, Julie will copy. Can't ask for better service and work. Friendly, clean, fun and great atmosphere. Like coming in every 2 weeks, needed or not.

I must be on a teriyaki kick lately....I've had it three times in the last two weeks, so it gives me an opportunity to compare.
The food here is freshly made and expertly prepared. We had the teriyaki chicken, rice, veg, and tempura shrimp combo. However, I thought the teriyaki sauce was too sweet and thin and the tempura coating too thick and floury tasting. 
HT is good for a quick lunch, but there is nothing here that would make me go out of my way.

What a delight.  Definitely an old-school rustic, homey, and bustling diner where jeans and flannel shirts were the order of the day. The wait staff was prompt and exceedingly friendly.  It seemed that in many cases the staff was on first name basis with many of the diners -- always a good sign -- especially if they treat you the same way like they did.

Coffee, menus and water were on the table within a minute of choosing a table.  I made the mistake of ordering the breakfast ham with bone in and, as a result, needed a to-go bag because the portion was so large.  The food arrived within a few minutes of ordering.  My wife's eggs Benedict was served with shaved ham (not the typical McDonald's style ham oval you typically get at most restraunt) and was very good.

We ate on a Saturday morning so the customer mix was all over the place with many families.  

Portions were generous and the price very reasonable.  Personally I prefer this to any of the other so-called a-list locations like Goldy's (good but over-rated) or the Griddle (good but over-priced).

Let me start with this:I went to the meridian location this evening. Huge mistake. It is very clear that maybe only 2 of your servers had any sort of training at all. Where do I start? First, no high chairs. Ok, no big deal-it's not like you're location is right in the middle of a bunch of neighborhoods. But we did get a booster seat for our 14 month old.(take one to dinner with only a booster seat and let me know how it goes!) Our waitress stopped by and took our entire order. She walked away and shortly after our order was taken she took the 3 other tables next to us AT THE SAME TIME. That is only killing your kitchen staff. Literally after about 15 minutes we had to flag down another waitress that was bringing drinks to the tables next to us and ask for our drinks. Ok great-we got our drinks. Food for the tables that ordered after us comes out before ours-no big deal. Eventually our burgers come out....but no tater gems. We immediately asked when the burgers were brought out where they were? Oh they'll be a couple minutes. I think this is the only restaurant in town that thinks that a burger and fries should be served in separate courses. 10 minutes later we got them!!! Yes! Basically like a dessert now! The waitress did say "sorry about the wait on those but they will be free." Well she was wrong. We were charged for them. I wasn't going to stick around and question 3 bucks when my 14 month old had just sat In a booster seat without a strap for the past hour. Some battles are worth losing. And this business will lose plenty of customers with the type of service we received tonight. Management:if you think this review is an outlier of the service that took place tonight, I urge you to contact some of your customers tonight. I know I wasn't the only one that left your new location disappointed.

We stopped here because our regular place was closed. Had a 10 minute wait for a table so we sat at the bar and ate. The food was typical Applebee's and the drink prices were way to high. Don't think we will be stopping here anytime soon. Must say the bartenders were wonderful.

Had the Shanghi Shrimp and Scallops. YUM! We had a nice waitress, just took a little bit longer than expected to be greeted and to be given our check. Several tables were filled with dirty dishes. It was curious that several employees walked by dirty tables repeatedly without picking up the dishes.
Food was wonderful. Waitress was even better. She kept our coffee hot and made sure our orders were perfect. We will definitely be back!
Jayme is awesome she is the only one I let cut hair, make sure you ask for her. She will listen to what you want and make you look like a model.

Had a craving for some Pho. Glad I came here. The broth was amazing. Beef was tender staff was friendly and knowledgeable. Next time I'm
In town totally going here again.

I've been there twice and have tried 3 menu items. Very fresh and tastes great. Spicy chicken was amazing. Try it out even if you don't like spicy food. It was not that hot but very flavorful. Very friendly staff and great remodel from the ole Port of Subs.

Update:
Dropped from 4 stars to 2 stars due to service.  Still great food.  When I found out they had a punch card, the lady said they only hand out punch cards on Tuesday only.  I couldn't figure it out so I asked why and the lady said, I don't know.  I told her it didn't make sense so you should consider changing it.  I finally got a punch card. It had 3 rows on it.  The top row was for dinners, middle row for bowls and third row for the bubble teas.  I had ben going there daily if not every other day.  I had filled out my dinner row 8 out of 10 punches, I bought 9 bowls and already claimed the 10th free and had 6 out of 10 bubble teas.  I was doing pretty good.  Well I went in there on  a Tuesday to get another card to start and the lady came up to me and said, we give out punch cards every day now.  I was happy as I had to time things to make sure I had a punch card.  Anyways, I ordered a bowl and when she told me she handed out cards every day, she took my card and where it was marked dinners which I had 8 out of 10 dinners, she cut off with scissors where it said dinner plates and checked the 9th (dinner) row as a bowl and said we don't give away free dinners on your 10th anymore.  We only do it for bowls.  I had bought 8 dinners and I asked her if she was going to refund me my $2 extra dollars for 8 plates and she said no.  She stamped my 9th dinner row and said next time you get a free bowl.  That was the last time I went there.  I gave my card with a free meal on it to a friend and have not been back.  I do miss their food but will be going other places due to their lack of integrity and service.

This sounds so small and embarrassing to write up but our society in general is failing to provide great customer service.  Restaurants think they can charge a bunch, offer mediocre food and service and that they are doing you a favor.  I have chosen to reward restaurants that have it together and not promote those that don't think like that even though I miss their food.  :(

Well another great job by Pips. Rv sparkly clean and shiny and so is the car. They are so reliable, considerate and know their business and their products they use. Appointments made and they are always right on time. If you don't or aren't able to care for your vehicles Pips is the one to call. They are reasonably-priced and you will be very, very happy with the results.

Geez- where is the Louies love? I have to take issue with the other reviews here- the food is great. Louies is one of only two decent local italian places in the Boise area. The sausage, peperoni, olive and mushroom pizza is one of the best pizzas on earth, as far as I am concerned. The lasagna is as good as any I have ever had. The other stuff- fettucini, ravioli, etc, is pretty good, but not necessarily amazing. The only reason I am not rating Louies higher is the atmosphere. Dear lord is it bad- there are no booths, and the chairs could not be more uncomfortable. The dining room has an outdoors in Tuscany motif, complete with scenes painted on the walls. The tables are some kind of corian material that does not at all go with the "feel" of the old world Italy that the rest of the dining room is after. There is a pretty nice patio, but it sits on Fairview ave, right near Eagle road. It's the busiest intersection in the state of Idaho. Not very "tuscany" out there. The service is always good to great. The food is consistently good to great. The atmosphere not so much. If they woudln't have closed the downtown Boise location, they would have probably earned a five, in my book. Get the family style meal- great value, really good food. Just get it to go.

Ordered a double cheeseburger meal. Drove home ooen up surprise chicken sandwich. Drove back to get correct orser and the people acted like i was annoying them that i brought it back wanting the right meal. Offered me only an expired coupon for a free hot dog and I laughed at it and guy said well thats all I can do. I know its gast food but holy crap they want $15/hr

If u want to use self checkout and have the worst experience EVER be sure to always go when *Stephen* is working. He will always go out of his way to be rude, Lazy and be a down right jerk!  This was our 3rd experience with this guy and each time he really stands out by far as the worse employee ever!  So hey......self check out guy 6/10/2017 @ 5:15pm.  You are a horrible person and should not be allowed to work with the public!  We gave u a pass twice because everyone is bound to have a bad day. But NOPE.... U ARE JUST A VERY BAD EMPLOYEE.  Don't worry I will be back and treat you the way you treat us EVERY TIME!  JERK

We made an appointment to get pedicures but they didn't get to us until 45 minutes after our appointment time. Made us sit with our feet soaking in cold water for 45 min (I timed it) while they were with other customers. Then my friend got her pedicure and I didn't even have anyone start mine until hers was done and her toes were drying. Just a little annoying. Pedicure was just ok...barely scrubbed the bottom of my feet and barely pushed back cuticles. nothing great. Seemed rushed like they just wanted to get it done and onto the next.

Good burger!
Well seasoned with a generous amount of fresh beef and a tasty fresh bun. The only detractor for us unanimously was an excessive amount of sauce I like mustard but I'm not a fan of my burger swimming in it. Unlike other reviews our beef was not over cooked but it was on the verge of it. 

Today I was on a mission to taste test burgers and we made it to 7 burger joints. I think the only mistake we made was not having all the burgers outfitted the same. Small differences like house sauce vs mustard and ketchup and whole onions vs  grilled onions or no onions can adversely affect the taste. The thought was to order a cheeseburger from each place with nothing added or taken away just their signature burger. For that reason I am reviewing each burger as a stand alone and not head to head. Next time I think I will put them head to head with the same fixins.

I decided to check out the crazy grand opening boy was it crazy. I really dig the new location. I liked what one reviewer already pointed out they have adjusted a few things to give a better customer experience i.e. a customer waiting area for take out, a hostess and you pay at the table. There's another reviewer on here that griped about ordering at the table clearly you haven't been to the one downtown big Juds seen how they operate plus it must be working because they are always super busy-busier than any five guys or smash burger I have been to in Boise. The waitress was super friendly despite being super slammed was on top of the table. My buddy and I got the $10 big jud special I hadn't had their 1 lb burger yet. The bun was excellent I didn't know what to expect for a big bun lol and the burger was great as usual. They have the best burger in town the crowds alone say that. My only complaint was the tator tots were overdone which makes me sad because their tator tots are the best!! Though with the massive crowd it's understandable the kitchen was a little overwhelmed and details like that were overlooked. I am happy there's a new improved big Juds in my neighborhood I will be back as should you if you live in the area!!
I love the drinks and burgers as well as the prices are reasonable. But their marina sauce for their cheesesticks is soggy.

Have been to Pho 779, 3 times now and the service and the food just gets better each time I go. Their food is fresh and delicious.  I love the rice pork and kimchi platter. If you haven't tried it you should try it at least once.

The best facial I've ever had, and I've now had 3 and plan to have them as often as I can.  As a mother of small children & a business owner, I have very little time to care for myself.  An hour with Amber makes me feel like a Queen!  So relaxing, the overall experience is *Above & Beyond*.  It's more like a facial-massage combination.   I recommend Amber to any & all, she provides consistant greatness.  Thank you Amber!!

I drove 20 minutes to go pickup this meal and 20 minutes back home. When I got home I noticed they didn't put in the side vegetables: basil, sprouts, cilantro. I called and they said I could drive back to get it but I didn't want another 40 minute commute. They could have offered to refund part of my meal, an IOU for another meal, pretty much anything and nope nothing. The girl who helped me was barely 16 years old and when she answered the phone she was talking to someone in the background. Horrible customer service. The manager should have talked to me. Not the girl who forgot it to begin with. She basically would relay what I was saying to the person in the background. So basically I paid full price for 2/3s a meal. I will not being going back and suggest others don't either. My business will go to Pho Tay. It's worth the extra drive.

Great place to eat. Portions are large and priced reasonably.  I had the chicken yakisoba,  lots of chicken and fresh vegetables.  My husband had the shrimp tempura delicious,  nice and crispy, not greasy.  We also had their egg rolls also fresh and delicious. We will definitely come again when we are in the area.
Food is under-flavored and stale tasting. The soup is watery and lifeless. Tastes like everything had been sitting around way to long. Definitely won't be back

.I see some similarities here to the original Big Jud's on West Boise Avenue. Brushed metal tables, red naugahyde seats, great burgers and fries menu. What's missing here is the Wall Of Fame. That's where you could get your picture posted for completing the Big Jud's challenge in 30 minutes. Its not even advertised here. These walls and floors are nothing fancy.
.This is definitely a sit-down-and-pay-your-waiter establishment. There was a drive-through built for a previous business, but it seems to be now used for employee parking. Anyway, not much traffic comes through this quirky parking lot.
.The mushroom burger I had was delicious. They promote Double R Ranch Northwest Beef. It was cooked evenly through, but not blackened. Only wish that it came with tomatoes.
.Say, why do they advertise every sandwich on the menu as "custom burgers" while the kitchen and grill are out of sight? Any food joint could use this gimmick. Custom pancakes. Custom roast beef. Custom prime rib. Custom gyros. Yeah, right. Custom prices?

We went there today while in town for thanksgiving weekend!  The broth was perfect, beef was tender.  There were a couple of rude customers causing a scene and the staff were very friendly and still smiling despite the rude people.

Decided to try this place during our usual weekend trip to the Boise area. Food is your typical sub-par American chain restaurant style food. Not impressed for the price. WAY better local places to eat in Boise/Meridian in my opinion.

Always great service! I've been coming to this location for over 2 years and have always received  friendly service. Every stylist I have had has been attentive and always does a great job. Sometimes there is a wait but that's expected during peak hours. For a $20 haircut I don't expect concierge service with a personal masseuse but they definitely deliver at a reasonable price.

Ok, what do you expect from a cafe named "Ed's 50's Cafe"?
Well, Ed's 50's Cafe delivers exactly what you likely are expecting...
Check it out...
Black and White checkerboard tile flooring.
James Dean and Marilyn Monroe posters on the wall, along with Elvis, and a collection of vinyl LPs.
Photos of lots of local hot rods, and model cars on display.
Display boards with shoulder patches and pins from Police Departments around the country.
BSU Football memorabilia at the check-out counter.
How can this be a bad place?  I love it already, and I haven't even sat down.

The restaurant staff is bustling around, and I quickly guess that this is a family run place.  Ed is in the back with an apron on, frying up eggs and pancakes, while a friendly Mrs. Ed (apparently) seats us at our table.  Our waitress comes over, after some good humor banter with her mother (Mrs. Ed, who apparently runs the joint), and lovingly mutters that she wants to escape, and asks us to take her home with us when we leave.  I tell her that she will need to help with yard work at our house, to which she readily agrees.  :-)

Again, I ask, how can this be a bad place?  This place is a great home-town burger/breakfast joint, with super friendly service, and a great atmosphere!!!  There are couples here for breakfast, along with mothers with daughters, families with kids.  I see that it is listed as one of "Idaho Chariot's" favorite spots, so you know there will be lots of old-guys talking about old-guy stuff (roadsters, tractors, John Wayne, politics) as they sip their coffee and eat their bacon.  As I glance around, I see several old-guys here with their friends, or with their dads, or with their families.  This is a place that I want my sons to take me to when I am an old-guy!!!

But "What about the food", you may ask...   I'm getting there....

For me, the essences of breakfast is defined with simplicity.  If you can't do simple, there is no way I'm going to order anything special later on.  My first visit to any breakfast spot always results in the same order from me:  Two eggs over medium, hash browns, two pieces of bacon, and sourdough toast.  Now while this is simple, you would be amazed at how many place screw this order up in one way or another which results in me never coming back.  For me, this order is a Pass/Fail sort of challenge.  If the egg is slimy... ...fail...  If the hashbrowns are not cooked enough...  ...fail...  If the bacon is bad...   ...fail...  Things like jam, coffee, juice, are all niceties, but if they are off, it won't be a fail.

To bring this review home, I'm happy to report that Ed's passed with flying colors.  The food was all cooked very well, and we enjoyed our breakfast greatly.  My wife said her pancake was "average", but that does not deter me in any way.  

This is a great local spot, wonderful atmosphere, super friendly service, and great food!  I will definitely be back.

I'm waiting to see if "Angel" (our waitress) will make it over to our house to help with the spring yard-work or not.  That would be awesome!



[ What did the Buffalo say when his male child left for college? --  Bison ]

I always get a great meal at this particular store. Being on the road I eat all kinds of terrible for that is bad for me. For some reason this place always excels in the fast food. Good job and kudos to the crew.

Good Lord but they feed you to fill you here.  And the food is great.  The staff is friendly and efficient, the menu is huge, and the decor is so full of tchotchkes that it's a fun greasy spoon sort of place good for the whole family.

Stopped by to fill up truck when on a road trip. They have the cleanest, nicest bathrooms here! Usually gas station bathrooms are disgusting, covered in filth. I'm giving a 5 star because I've never seen a gas station bathroom so clean

I found the burger to be thin and very dry. The onions rings we mostly batter. The chocolate malt was good. The plates were to small and they don't give you a dish to put ketchup or fry sauce in so if you are sharing fries or rings you are double dipping with someone.I won't go back, to me it was not worth $25.00 bucks! Oh and way too much sodium was used.

I dropped my tv off on dec. 27 2013 I paid the $25 fee for the estimate I was told that they would call me in 3 days and if they didn't that I could call them . Of course I had to call them , they quoted me a price of 350.I agreed and he said that it would take about seven working days . When I called their mail box is full and the line gets disconnected . Long story short NOT When I called to set up at time to pick it up he stalled for more time . I was supposed to be at their shop @ 10 a.m.  at 9:30 He called and in a halting voice said that he didn't know how to say it but My tv WAS working but when he plugged it in to make sure it made a pop and the screen went dead he then said that he replaced the internal fuse and it did it again He thinks the power supply is bad . (MUST HAVE HAPPENED WHEN HESHORTED OUT A CONNECTION ) Any way I am schedualed to pick it up tomorrow it only been about a month .stay tuned . I am not trusting this company.

Dogs are no longer allowed!!
Hopefully this review will encourage them to update  their information online! I am disappointed to see the change because it was the only dog friendly bar in Meridian. 
This is a great go to pub! I enjoy the atmosphere and the beer selection is top notch! The bartenders are always super nice, and knowledgeable.

Great spray tan! Kris is so personable and made me feel comfortable standing there naked while she sprayed cold tanning solution all over my body. The tan lasted a solid week. It is so convenient to have her come to your location.

We love going to Rice Works during the summer after strolling around The Village. I have tried a few different items but my fav is the ninja chicken, a bit on the spicy side but that's why I like it!! I love how the area completely opens up, very unique set up. If if like spicy, give these guys a try.

I had the Mongolian Beef. Its very very good. Made with Filet Mignon. I have never had this with this meat before. its really good. But the portions are very small.

After my wife and I ate here, we had to go home and make something else to eat. So if you are really hungry, Id recommend either some other place or a different dish.

I hope that their other dishes are not this small.

Its for this reason that I felt I had to downgrade my star rating.

The place looks more upscale. The atmosphere seems more upscale. But then there was the menus. They are laminated place mats. I would expect to see this sort of menu at Denny's, not a more upscale restaurant.

The other thing I noticed while I was at this restaurant, was that there was a lot of staff, and they were all just hanging around. Some were sitting in the booth just up from us. 

Surely, in a restaurant like this, there are things that the staff could be doing instead of just sitting and standing around.

Amber is the BEST!   She is a expert in skin care.  Amber has made a HUGE difference in my skin.  Her facials are customized to what your skin needs.  The products she uses rate high on my list, her knowledge of what and how to use has left my face feeling amazing.  Thank-You Amber!!!!  I look forward to many more treatments with you.  You really have changed my way of skin care for the better.

There was a hair in my salad. I know they were busy but the salad bar was bare and messy.  The food quality was poor and not much variety. All in all it was a bad idea for dinner :( I just left feeling ill even after only a few small portions of salad, Mac and cheese, and fruit.

Horrible. I have a meeting tomorrow, and found myself in the area and decided I could use a cut. First I was told it would be a fifteen minute wait, which easily turned into over forty, and then after being seated and describing a simple man's haircut, the look of pure horror came over the "stylist's" face. Even after showing her a picture on my phone of myself with shorter hair, the hairdresser just kept butchering it until I finally told her mid cut to make it manageable so that I could leave and go to a better place. She quietly tried to salvage her disaster-piece, then without even removing the cut hair from my  face, told me I was done. I was charged the total amount, without so much as a subtle apology. Unless you're going in for a military cut, or getting your kid's hair cut, I don't suggest ever even stepping in here.

Love Dr. Cron, professional and gets straight to business. He has a great sense of humor and bed side manor. He's gone out of his way to help see us when needed. I couldn't have asked for a better family doctor. My family has been his patient's for over 16yrs and he has done an awesome job and he quick.

We ordered 3 sandwiches to go...It took over half hr to be made & it wasn't crowded..The sandwiches were good & the price was good. But just a bit too long to wait..The Place on Franklin has your sandwiches made by the time you sit & wait. hoping this is just because they are just newly opened..
Nice place for pedi.  Clean place, friendly service. Nice designs on my toes. Wonderful!!

I ordered a club melt and they served me a sandwich with the deli plastic they use to pick up the meat in the sandwich. I ended up eating half of the plastic and discovered the rest in my greasy ass sandwich. Would not recommend

Throughout the years I have yet to find a biscuits and gravy that is better than the Sunrise Cafe's! Their biscuits actually have an authentic homemade biscuit flavor; not dense or hard as hockey pucks like most other greasy spoon breakfast spots. Then there is the gravy....perfect consistency, seasoning and balance of sausage. EVERY. SINGLE. TIME. 
Absolutely nothing hits the spot like their Big Biscuit Breakfast. It's a halved biscuit with each half topped with a thick sausage patty (that I swear they make there too), an egg cooked to your liking, and then that amazing heavenly gravy poured on top! Oh yeah, and it comes with hashbrowns too! The PERFECT breakfast. Well, unless you are my husband who swears by their chicken fried steak.
If you need to satisfy your sweet tooth then get a cinnamon roll. They are huge and you can order a half of one which is just one made smaller. They serve it with a runny frosting and a lump of butter on it that all just melts into gooey goodness. 
We have been going here for years and have never been disappointed. The quality is good and the serving size of the food is just right. The staff have always been friendly and have been working there for years. They show their team spirit on game day by wearing their BSU garb. The inside has really improved over the years once smoking became banned in restaurants, but it still has that greasy spoon hometown charm that you would expect. 
If you are new or visiting the area then get yourself to Sunrise Cafe in Meridian. If you live in the area and have never gone here then you are truly missing out.

Liked the clean and new-ish condition of the clothes. Great prices on name brand stuff if you're into that. The reason for the moderate rating is their buying program is very harsh and, well, rude. As well, they didn't make it clear that after you drop the clothes and they look through it to see if they want anything (which they pay nearly nothing for- you might has well give it to someone in need) but they donate the clothes to their church/ religious program within 24 hrs. This was a while back and I notice now they have a sign saying that now.

The workers are always extremely friendly. The environment is always very good. My coffee I always get is Americano but not room for cream but chai. I have gotten some of their other drinks and smoothies and I'm never disappointed. The owner is even sometimes there and she is very nice and a lovely woman . if you're in for a kick her husband also is Chuck Norris's stunt double haha

The Holiday Inn finally got it right. This hotel was was top notch. Room was spacious and the King bed was too die for!! The continental breakfast was fresh and hearty.  We had a little mishap with the billing but Beverly worked it out with the 3rd party we booked it through. Customer service by Beverly and the other staff was great. Will definitely stay again.

The pho is terrible! So disappointed! The noodles were mushy, the broth tastes strongly of cloves so it tasted sweet, the meat was nothing but huge chunks of fat, and overall was just horrible! The egg rolls were terrible too. If you want some awesome pho, go to the baguette deli in Boise. That's the best I've had around.

A friend and I visited this restaurant after I happened to see an ad on Facebook.  The picture of the Stump's smoker on their web page is what set the hook and reeled me in.  Hawaiian barbecue?  I'd never heard of such a thing.

Well, we were both impressed.  I had the Kalua Pig and Cabbage for $6.95, and my friend had a Teriyaki Chicken Rice Bowl special for an unbelievable $4.95.  The food was fantastic, with just the right amount of smoke flavor.  The Hawaiian sauces at the sauce bar are amazing (I tried them all), the portions are very generous and the prices are very reasonable for barbecue.  Kana and Keoni are friendly and treat their customers like family.  Keoni even took my friend and I back to see his 'girlfriend (the Stump's), and shared much more about his cooking techniques than a typical barbecue die-hard.

Even though it's a 45 minute drive from where I live, I'll definitely be back.

This hotel is new,  clean and updated. The rooms are the littlest rooms I have ever stayed in on a Hilton property. The walls were paper thin and I could hear everyone's television walking down the Hall.  The bed and the TV were big. There is absolutely no where to put your luggage besides on the floor under the bed (No thanks) or on the tiny desk that is shoved in the corner. There is an open Pipe to hang your clothes on but no closet or dressers. Speaking of the desk, as a business traveler this desk is no where near adequate space for me to work on. It's like a High school classroom size. There is no microwave in the room and the fridge is tiny, I could barely fit my waters in it.  The breakfast was actually horrible, there were not very many options and what options they did have they ran out of and was not restocked. Not any healthy options to choose from and there's only a waffle maker or toast, no other hot breakfast and everything else is very carb loaded. The hotel lobby is adorable and they have a pool table, games and lots of places for you to sit and relax.  This hotel would be ideal for someone who is staying one night. I feel like for those of us that travel for work or for extended periods of time, more than 1 night in this hotel would be too much because of the lack of space, no microwave, small fridge, small desk, no luggage space and awful breakfast options. Ending on a good note it's clean, new, and up to date.

Went in for the first time to get a no chip manicure and pedicure...very average. The main reason I won't go back.... is the rip off when you go to pay, in my case $50 and are directed to the ATM they have installed in which you are charged and additional $1.95 service charge plus you can only receive your cash in $20 denominations. This is absurd, I will not go back, instead I will go to one of the thousand nail salons in this city that accepts credit/debit cards.

My favorite local spot for a movie.  Normally I would give this place 5 stars as they use to differentiate themselves by offering free popcorn seasoning but recently took all the powdered seasonings away. Such a bummer, I loved the Ranch powder for the popcorn.

i ordered on line home health supplies - walker and toilet risers.  was told they would be delivered 1-24-18.  just tracked packaged and it is just now shipping.  guess it won't be here on the 24th which is today.  so sad - this is a necessary home health requirement.

I brought my clients here for the first time. When we walked in, the place was nearly empty and I noticed many staff just standing around, yet there was no one at the front where I assume we wait to be seated. We just stood there waiting. Different waiters saw us and nothing. I actually had to go ask someone if we were to seat ourselves or wait for someone. Someone finally came to show us to our table but she was not friendly at all. Didn't say hi or apologize or even acknowledge us besides to follow her to the table. I was very frustrated. Our waitress was much nicer and very attentive. The food came quickly and was delicious. Aside from the lack of good customer service, this place was good and I'd come again.

The lettuce wraps are amazing and the pot stickers are good as well! The Pad Thai, chicken and rice soup, and Shrimp Lo Mein are some of the better dishes. The biggest down fall is their sushi! It's bland, over priced and incredibly slow! Prices otherwise are a little high but not too bad all things considering. Service is mediocre, it's not terrible but it it isn't anything great or commendable either, waitress left our party sitting for almost 30 minutes after dropping off the drinks before we had to flag her down to place our order and then once the food was delivered we never saw her again until she dropped off the bill.
Great service and good food.  Love the decor.  Coffee a bit strong but love you can get lunch anytime!
I really like this place. I always try to hit a movie at Majestic when in town visiting family.

Artichoke Chicken Fettuccine Alfredo this is the ONLY thing I remember from this place.  Trust me though it is SERIOUSLY worth remembering.  I have not dinned here in probably 10 years, but I will never forget how great their Chicken Artichoke Fettuccine Alfredo was!  I have not yet found a replacement that will match the quality and flavor of Louie's. 
The ambiance is romantic!  Beautiful stained glass window.

This place doesn't even deserve one star. Got us in late for our appointment. Told us they had kid pedicure chairs and they did not instead they moved the kids all the way forward in the adult chairs. When we went to pay the lady in front of us was able to pay with a card. When we went to pay they told us we had to get money out of the ATM. They had the card reader hidden on the floor out of sight. ATM charged a 5$ fee. There was also no sign on the door that stated cash only.

We took a chance on Louie's last night. We were very pleased with the food and the service. The Italian sausage was as good as I've eaten anywhere, even in Italy. The wine list was limited, but we were able to pick a decent wine to compliment our dinner choices.

Avoid this place.  It is simply not well managed.  The manager was there and it is still not working.

Slow service, screwed up my order.  Items not prepared per sonic recipes.  Kids working in the back are just not trained.

This place is absolutely AMAZING. I went with my mom and younger siblings on our way back to Utah, and wow. I was blown away. First of all, my siblings both wanted the coffee shake. That was served right away, and the taste was amazing. Afterwards, I ordered their daily special, the bacon-egg salad sandwich. I'm so glad we went on the day they had that, it was so good. The eggs were chopped finely, and bacon was spread very generously throughout the sandwich. Next, my mom and sister ordered burgers. I tried them, and again, I was amazed! Cooked thoroughly, and almost tasted like a burger from in n out with pizazz. My brother ordered the french toast, and from the smile on his face and the "mmm" escaping his mouth every time he took a bite, I assume that was good too, especially because he's a picky little guy! Their onion rings were the absolute best i've ever had, aside from my grandmothers, which are homemade, so if that doesn't say "Yum!" i don't know what does! Lastly, the service was awesome. The waitresses were extremely nice and customer-oriented. We got there around 1:30, and when 2 came around (they close at 2:30) they gave us a friendly "hey, we close at 2:30 but please take your time." By 2 though, we had already finished our food. The rest of the time we spent exploring the little establishment where they had cute decorations from the 50's. When we went to pay, the waitress was so funny and kind when checking us out and I couldn't be more pleased with this place. Definitely wish there was one in Utah so we could visit more often!!!

I loved Krissy's work and personality! She did such an amazing job- I have never had a spray tan and she went over everything she would be doing, before and after care (prior to the appointment and also at the appointment), and did a great job! I was worried I'd come out orange but it looks absolutely natural and I love it! 
Highly recommended!
I wish I would have chose a different tv repair company.  Lesson learned I guess.  These guys need to learn a few things about customer service.

My gf and I have ordered delivery a handful of times and here's my thoughts... The taste is decently good and I guess it's reasonably priced.  But to cut straight to the point,the only items worth ordering are General Tsao's Chicken, Fried Rice, and Chow Mein. 

For example : 
The 16 oz "broccoli beef" we ordered consisted of literally 3 tiny strips of beef, a couple pieces of broccoli and a whole mess of carrots, celery, water chest nuts and whatever else. 
The 16 oz "Mongolian beef" was the same.  A whole mess of frozen veggies.

I'm not exaggerating.
It's blatantly obvious they're cutting food cost so they skimp on the meat and serve you up 95% veggies. 

So if you must go here, stick to the Tsao's chicken and fried rice.

We came here after a long time between visits.  We had the spaghetti with meatballs, cheesy garlic bread(not on the menu) and a great Italian soup.  I was excited to hear they had the best Italian beer (Peroni) on tap.  Food and service were great and the beer was cold.  Wine selection by the glass was a bit weak.

Rudy was very helpful! I've been to ultra hundreds of times both here and in California. I was really impressed with Rudys customer service he asked if I needed help after browsing for a minute or two but was still looking around and normally I'd have to hunt down a sales associate after letting them know I wasn't ready but he came back after a few minutes to check in. He wasn't pushy and didn't hover, definitely knows his stuff and made sure to find the right shade of foundation for me... thanks again!

I use to like this place until the adult supervision became non-existent. Drove up to their establishment, crossed the hose that lets them know we're there. Five minutes went by, no biggie... When they didn't acknowledge our existence I figured they were just busy. When they brought other people's food out I thought they'd at least give us a smile and a "we'll be right with you". We only got but a glance and cold shoulder. After they walked out and then back in a few times, I decided I'd let them know that you don't just leave customers hanging and to at least acknowledge them. As I was telling the young woman this, she rolled her eyes and proceeded to say "I know" a few times. Well, if you know, then you just don't care then. Furthermore, they ask you for tips instead earning them the old fashion way. When I asked them in the past why they ask for tips, they replied "oh, because you can't add them after we charge your card". Ok.... I don't remember asking people tips in my job EVER! I too work for a locally owned business. I see this one failing if they continue to conduct business the same way. I know I'm not going back. Too many mistakes like this show the character of the people running the business. I may be wrong about the owners, but they have too much faith in their employees without someone there to manage. If there was a manager there at that time, they need to be trained or let go. This is like my fourth review on Yelp in roughly five years, I felt as if this was a good enough reason to show my distaste for such attitudes from a locally owned business. 

I went to jack in the box. Customer service CAN make less appealing food taste better. Shape up hungry onion. There's no bail out for the small business when things are too far gone.

I wasn't very impressed unfortunately. I spent about 20 minutes browsing the hunting and camping sections. Only one employee even acknowledged me.

They didn't have much of a selection for rifles. It was mostly shotguns and a few bolt action rifles. I guess Dick's focuses on other departments? I did see a lot of clothing on the racks. 

I don't plan on going back. Sportsman's Warehouse down the street on Eagle has a wider selection. Oh well.

We came in on a Sunday morning, and felt as if we had "found our place." The service was absolutely amazing. Even the interaction of the servers was kind and fun. If I had to describe this place, it would be "love, food, and fun." 

I can't wait to go back.
I love the food, the best teryaki chicken around. the staff at the location in the village at meridian are always helpful and are some of the friendliest people. all summer this was my splurge

We pick this place because it's close to our house. We've seen the star and the review so we prepare. The food doesn't taste bad it just come out slow if you are in no rush Or not super hungry you can try this place. It's only one table of two people before us in that place. Doesn't seem to have any to go order. And just us for three people. It takes about half an hour to get our food. It's a nice place spacious,clean and nice staff. We order 3 bowls of pho soup. The kids love it and wanna go back. One thing I can say they should be faster and a little bit bigger portion. I'm not eat a lot but for my 16 years old he want to have a second bowl. Give this guy a chance and they might pick up their pace.

CAUTION DO NOT USE MODERN AGE PAINTING!

If you want paint on other ares of your home besides where it is supposed to be then Kyle Williamson of Modern Age Painting is the one to call. Kyles web site is smoke & mirrors because his professionalism and workmanship is much different than he states. Kyle destroyed our house in Meridian and Kyle also painted many ares of our roof & other places not to be painted. I had another contractor out to review for a new repaint next spring and he said "The paint job on our house looks like kids painted it". I would stay clear of Kyle Williamson and Modern Age Painting for any of your painting needs.

It shows in both the woman's attitude as well as her workmanship that she does not care about your clothes or what you want.  She refused to taper my pants appropriately.  And so gave me something half way between a skinny jean and a bootcut, with uneven sides to each leg, and one leg was twisting noticeably to the left (this only happens when too much is taken from just one side of the pant leg, rather than evenly from both sides.  But I was paying for her to take in both sides).  After dropping off the pants the first time, I tried calling to tell her that I would bring in a pair of my other jeans to match to; so, to wait (because I sensed something wrong with her careless attitude, that it wasn't going to turn out well).  But no one answered the phone, despite multiple calls.  And the voice mail box is full.  So I looked at her hours online and planned to get there right when she opened, which would have been about 7 hours before the pants were supposed to be done.  I was worried about not waking up in time, so I couldn't sleep the entire night.  I dragged myself over there exhausted at 8am, and come to find that she was closed (her posted hours on her door are an hour and a half later than what's online).  Un-frickin-believable.  So I run errands to make use of the time, though all I want to do is go home and sleep.  And when I return, that's when I see the problems with the pants.  I asked her to fix them.  Though she gave a variety of excuses she ultimately said she'd widen the bottom and take it out from just the outside (so to compensate for the twisting).  On my way home, I called to make sure that she would do what was necessary so the twisting wasn't there when I returned.  But no one answered the phone.  I called another time.  But still, no one answered.  If the one leg is still twisting when I return, I'm not paying the extra money she quoted for bringing in both sides (one side had a more reinforced seem; so she quoted more to take in both sides).  I'll have to bring my pants elsewhere to be fixed.  Being that I'm going out of town tomorrow, and these pants were intended to go with me on the trip, I'll be all the more disappointed in this experience.

* I just now updated the hours on the yelp listing, so they are more accurate.  I could only remember the mon - fri ones though.
Came in from out of town, stopped here and was very happy we did! Staff was wonderful!!! Chef included, came to check on us. Did was delicious, couldn't recommend this place any more highly!
all I can say is 83 is the best.we have been going there for a couple years now and these guys always bend over backwards to help out.thanks h3 you got clients for life
Food is consistently good. Love the chicken and rice soup. And  I know it's weird but the meatloaf is to die for.   Orange peel chicken is also a mainstay. Waits are never too bad.

Visiting  from out of town.  Greeted with professionalism was able to walk right in and sit down.  The gentleman  who did my feet was great,  the lady who painted my nails was great,  but when I politely ask the lady can I get help getting out of my seat she was rude as hell instead of her helping  me (mind   you) she wasn't busy she told the gentleman to help. So that's why I give this place 4 stars instead of 5.

Have been here a few times now for breakfast and its always great. Great portions as well as quality food. I really hate to write this review because I love that I can walk in almost anytime and be directly seated but ... to be fair to the restaurant, they deserve it. :) 
Daily specials are always great!
Food is just ok. The workers were not very friendly but if you are looking for average food this is the place.

Applebee's used to be pretty darn good, until Applebee's started to completely change their menu. Hence,  I am greatly disappointed. Visiting from Tacoma, WA. I won't be eating at Applebee's for a while including the Tacoma locations.

We are here in the Nampa area visiting our son and LOVED this place!  We had chicken lettuce wraps for appetizer and they were excellent and the sauce was just sweet enough and just spicy enough to be sooooo delicious. My husband had the Buddha's feast with chicken and the asparagus and green beans were perfectly al dente and he loved it. I had the Mongolian beef and it was the best I've ever had. For desert (and the only reason we had ROOM for desert is because we forced ourselves to save half of our entres for supper) we had the banana, caramel, strawberry, spring roll with vanilla ice cream -- so deliciously decadent!  Highly recommend! Already thinking about going back before we leave the area and head south.

This place is a joke. I went Tuesday December 22nd, when we arrived with a party of two they told us it would be a 20 - 25 minute wait. After sitting for 30 minutes I asked how much longer they told me another 20 - 25 minute wait. We walked out. Exactly a week later, Tuesday, December 29th we went there for a family event. We actually got seated this time, however the table was so small our entire party couldn't fit in it. We asked for a different table. We got moved over to another table. Everything seemed to be in order. We got drinks and appetizers. We told our waitress we were waiting for one more which they arrived and the waitress never came back. We waited for another 10 minutes and finally the waitress came back. Took our orders and left. She brought our salads and about two minutes later someone else brought our food. Some people didn't even get their salads yet. They said they would take our food back until we were done with our soups and salads. Once that happened our waitress disappeared once again. The manager even walked by and asked how everything was no one said good I shrugged my shoulders. And she said "okay" and walked off. She walked by our table 2 more times seeing all empty glasses, pitchers, and no food. She didn't do a thing. We waited another 20 minutes ( keep in mind they brought the food out once, we know it's done ) and finally we got our food. They said they remade it but it sure didn't taste that way. We also asked for more bread. The waitress forgot and by the time we asked again everyone was finished with their food. I have no idea how this place is even around. Mediocre food and terrible service. Just keep driving down fairview and go to the village or Johnny Carinos.

Hostess Delora greeted Sherry and me immediately as we came in the door and asked where we'd like to be seated.  I commented to Sherry that based on that greeting alone, I knew we were in for a good experience.  I ordered Biscuits and Gravy, Sherry ordered the Walnut Chicken Salad on the advice of our waitress who was very friendly and attentive.  Both meals were reasonably priced, generously sized, and very tasty.  As we were preparing to leave we asked our waitress how long she had worked there, and she said she had worked for the family in various restaurants for 25 years.  The owner clearly cares for his employees, and it shows in the way they in turn care for their customers.
Best teriyaki ever. Portions are big and the price is cheap. Every time I come to meridian I make sure to stop there for my teriyaki fix.

Husband & I were visiting ID & staying in Meridian.  Got back late & was driving by this place so we decided to try it.  Reasonably priced for the large portions that they give you.  I got Pad Thai which was good & was enough for 2 people.  Hubby ordered a meat dish, entree + 2 sides, which was also enough to feed 2 people.  Service was a touch slow considering we were pretty much the only customers there as we arrived about an hour before closing.  

We'd definitely go back but unfortunately I don't plan to be in Idaho again anytime soon.  If I do go back up, I'd like to return & try some other dishes like the crab rangoon.  Overall, we had a decent experience & good food.
What a joke waited for 1 hour and then were told it would be another hour and a half then they said it would be 5 days before we got our money back from the credit card company buyer beware!!!

Unfortunately we were not very impressed with our food, the service, or the seating area. The food did not have much flavor and the service was slow to almost non-existent. It would have seemed a lot less cluttered if they had a more closed off storage area and cleaned up items taped to walls and windows.

Love this location! I love that we sat down.to order instead of the counter like the other location. I didnt know they had fried pickles. Omg best fried pickles ever! And ive been on a search the last year for the best. Also the ranch was sooo good i wanted to keep eating it. The fries were exactly what you should expect any fries to be in the potato state, perfectly fried and fresh. Everyone loved their burgers. Only issue was hubby ordered a double bacon burger and didnt get bacon, but i got the avocado burger and just gave him my bacon so it worked out anyway. I added grilled jalaleños to my burger and it was so yummy and i love that they used fresh jalapeños. Even our out of town guests who dont seem to eat full meals often each ate every bite of their burgers.  Everythinf was delish andnthe service was fabulous. We will most definitely be repeat customers.
Really inexpensive considering all of the options. Some of the salads and pastas were not of my taste so that's why I rate 4 stars. Don't forget the tacos and baked potatoes

Want the most out of your workout? Then check this out! I lift several times a week, but nothing pushes me as hard as an Orangetheory work out. Just going 2 times a week combined with my current lifting schedule has shown transformation and breaking that plateau we all hit. The first class is free, so why not?!

The cuts are somewhat reasonable I guess. The problem is that you have to be there right when they open (standing in line prior to open) or right before close. Otherwise you need to block out an hour or more of your day in preparation for the wait time. The wait times are not warranted by the work.

I like having sports on while I get my hair cut.  My girlfriend isn't really that into watching sports on tv so it's nice to get that time to myself.  That being said, whoever is in control of the remote rarely seems to get that we want to actually watch a sporting event...or at least I do.  Sports Center is cool but a lot of the other sports talk shows don't really seem to fit the jist of the place.  ESPN is a decent go-to but there are a bunch of channels and especially during baseball season, you can probably find a game to put on.  Seriously, this is my biggest complaint and while it seems small, it's one of the main reason I go to Sport Clips.

I also like when the stylists are knowledgeable of the services you offer...and actually offer them.  I enjoy the MVP service but sometimes forget to ask for it...or don't know when to ask for it.  The last couple times I went to your store on Eagle and Fairview. The women looked at what I got before and asked if I would like to do the MVP again.  I used to go the the one on State St and 18th and they never asked...and half the time there was something wrong but fixable with the tvs (wrong channel, channel guide open the entire time I was there, etc).  The Eagle Rd training seems to be better.

Also, the last two women did a fantastic job.  I LOVE scalp massages and my previous trips I didn't really get one.  The last two trips were WONDERFUL!  Again, whatever you're doing at the Eagle Rd shop could possibly be used as an example for other stores on what to do right (with again, a little more attention to what's on TV).

I like a lot of the new upgrades like the waiting room chairs.  The check-in system is ok but it seems like every time I go in there's something new to figure out and that's pretty annoying when there are other people in line or waiting to pay.

I'm eating here right now, and I am enjoying my food.  I ordered the chicken phó with a Coke, and it tastes great. I would have made it five stars, but I could have used a wee bit more chicken in the phó and limes auto-included.

I have eaten phó at many restaurants throughout SoCal and beyond, an it's as good as those places.  I am not sure what the hassle folks were giving this restaurant.


You order and pay at the counter, then they bring out your food.  I brought my Game Boy to amuse myself while I waited (pictured :P), and I wasn't able to get too far into playing when they brought my phó out.  It came with the usual additions, but o had to ask for limes, which yielded what would be considered "extra" in other restaurants.

The broth was beef-flavored and savory, quite nice.  The noodles are cooked to perfection, also.  The chicken is the star, though.  It is tender and well-flavored.  I wish there was more, though, which would make it an even better value.  

While I was writing this, Colleen the owner was walking around checking the restaurant, and I introduced myself.  She was friendly and warm, a nice woman.  

The employees she hires are younger and in high school, but the young man who took my order was real polite and friendly.

I say give them a try, and see if you like it.  I whole-heartedly recommend the chicken  phó

Pretty darn tasty. I had the Bleu Bacon Burger and it had a lot of flavor to it. Also had the union rings. They were good but extremely greasy. Good burger joint. I'm sure I will be back in the future.

Ambiance - check. The decor of Ling & Louie's is clean, very pleasant, with huge booths to stretch out in or cozy up in a smaller booth for more intimate time sharing Ling & Louie's amazing foods.

Wait staff - I LOVE it when the wait staff in any place where I am going to eat are happy people who seem to be really enjoying their job

Service - perfectly timed. We enjoyed our Edamame and plum wine and soup in a very relaxed manor before our main course.

Portions - OMG, to us, the portions are huge! For under $4 the serving of Edamame was enough to satiate our taste buds and the bowl was still 3/4 full when we had to just stop popping those green pods in our mouths. My beautiful bowl of Evil Jungle Princess Chicken seemed to be a bottomless bowl that I could not make a dent in! And the taste is a perfect blend of spicy and sweet and savory that keeps pulling you into the bowl for just one more chop stick full of flavor ... mmmmm. My partner indulged in New Wave Pad Thai and had to really work at TRYING to finish what he was served .. of course the taste made that job so deliciously tolerable  - hehehehe :-)

Menu - If you love Asian and fusion and that little bit of signature innovative difference in foods you will so love Ling & Louies! For example you can have Mongolian Flatbread and Siamese Spring Rolls to start and then Tom Kha Gai or Evil Jungle Princess Beef or Chicken or Wango Mango Chicken or Ling's Meatloaf or F'n Loaded Sliders or Beijing Duck Noodles and on and on and deliciously served. 

The manager is so personable and well, I'll just shut up and finish eating!

One star for the portion size. For ~$10M for lunch and without drinks, we were all served kids' meals sized. We were all still hungry afterwards we all had to go to McDs to get burgers. However, the food is good and place is really nice. Awesome ambiance and friendly service! Most likely won't go back again.

We moved to Idaho after living our whole life in Hawaii and this place makes a pretty good plate lunch! The only difference is having the cooked vegetables instead of mac salad. The chicken Katsu is excellent, always fresh and the sauce is Ono! Not the fastest service because everything is cooked to order but it's all good. Now if I can only find a place that has Lau Lau.......

Unfortunately I have been a member at this gym before it opened in Meridian.
I had an bank account change so my payment didn't go through and they now are charging me late fees. GM Mike was willing to help me get late fee taken care of and account fixed. All I want to to is fix my account and get late fees waved but now a girl named Jenny calls me and decides she didn't want to listen to me; poor customer service skills as she told me her job isn't customer service...!!! So in not willing to wave late fee; not sure I want to do business here.

Other than my house, this place is the closest and most authentic Hawaiian BBQ food you can get in the Treasure Valley.  The plate lunches are so good, and full of flavor.  The BBQ chicken has the char-smoked grilled flavor of Kiawe wood.  If you don't know what to order, try the Mix plate.
A lot of the ingredients are imported from Hawaii, and that's part of the reason why the food tastes so much like food from back home in Hawaii.  It's a small family business, and the owners share Hawaii's true Aloha spirit with the Treasure Valley community.
I haven't gone since September, and I read one of the reviews about it being closed.  I hope this place hasn't closed down.

SO FUN! We had so much fun here! We coordinated a Wedding Room Block; the staff was very accommodating with this process and helpful when guests booked after the deadline.

The place is SO GREAT. Every inch of the hotel is whimsical and well-designed. My sister commented, "If you made a hotel--this would be it!" What a compliment! Bright, delightful spaces, furnishings, walls and decor. 

The lobby handled the chaotic kids extremely well. They were content with the pool table, games, and swinging chairs. 

The complimentary breakfast was DELICIOUS. It had more than a typical continental breakfast, and again, the dishes were well-designed and thoughtfully displayed. 

I loved that hot water and coffee were available 24/7. 

The pool was easy to access; the hot tub had plenty of room for all the guests.

The SOAP was a great conversation starter! LOL!
Beds--SO COMFY!
Refrigerators in every room!! What?! 

I loved the thoughtful furnishings; a great use of the small space. I could easily sprawl my things out on the little counter to reorganize! 

Everyone in the wedding party had a GREAT time at Tru. We'll be looking for other Tru hotels for our next family reunion!

Let me start off by saying I would have given 5 stars had the price been a little less. She did give a multiple dog discount which I must say was great! I had her do 3 dogs all under 35lbs and 3 cats 2 of whom were declawed all were friendly and nonaggressive so I'm not sure how she would handle that. Sh washed, dried (some were a little damp but that's because they were harnessed in so she could dry them with a dryer), ears were cleaned, nails trimmed and a fragrance was applied. You don't get to pick the fragrance but it smelled nice and was not overpowering. This was all for (including the discount) $300. What got me was...it was $55 regardless of dog or cat (and from my experience cats are less expensive), regardless of if she clips nails (which one of my dogs didn't need along with two of my cats), and if they need deshedding, and regardless of if they need matt removal (which two of mine did but was included anyway), and regardless of if they are cut (none of mine were but again it was included in the price regardless). That is my only reason for a 4. Besides that, She is friendly, great with the animals, they look great when they are done and aren't in bad moods. She was on time almost to the minute! The grooming was done promptly and thoroughly. The matts weren't combed out, only shaved off, but for the time it would take to have it combed out I don't really blame her, anyplace that would have cost more. She didn't just do one bath, she did multiple if needed to get them completely clean which I do like. All in all a great experience and great service. Everyone is gleaming (litterally), smells great, clean, not dropping hair everywhere, ears cleaned, nails trimmed (and she used a grinder not those horrible nail clipper!). She is friendly and when a cat got out even helped me catch him. Arrived at 9am left by 12:20pm, not bad for 6 animals. And, of course you can't forget SHE COMES TO YOU!!!! All in all I would recomend her, if you can afford it (though lets face it all grooming costs alot at least if its worth it), and I would definitly use her again. I called on Monday night and she was here by Friday, not a bad wait time.

Food was pretty solid. Service was atrocious. Portions were much bigger than I remember(and bigger than other local italian restaurants, thankfully). And someone kept bringing me baskets of garlic bread, so I can't complain too much. 


Second visit 1/4/18
Food still great, service still shitty. Waitress spilled a bowl of soup at our table and never even bothered to bring napkins/towel or even help cleaning it up.

The food is not great, but not terrible. What was disappointing to me was that the menu is kind of tricky. It says bowl- $5.95, and then the two flavors of pork and beef are listed. Well if you look closely, those flavors are an extra dollar, and the chicken bowl (not actually listed on the menu) is the one for the $5.95 price. I know I just read it wrong, but it seemed a little tricky.

It's also built to be counter-order, but unless you're ordering to go then they have you sit down, which takes longer and you have to tip. Not a big problem, but we were looking for something faster when we visited.

The boba drink was delicious!

Okay if you liked the Big Juds at BSU, you will love it here!
Service is Super, the food is Great!
Thank you for opening into Meridian!
I discovered this place while making a delivery nearby.  Now, I have breakfast here Every time I'm in town.  Great food.  Friendly staff.  I wish I could come more often !
Applebee's has gone down hill recently, not that they were ever very good. Stingy portions, poor service, poor atmosphere.  Find basically anything other than an Applebee's.

Signed up and got two of my friends to move gyms and join after me. Was promised to have a month comped for each friend ( two months ). Got charged for both months and a random $70 fee. Which was not my annual I paid that upfront. Contacted manager/ owner. He refused to reimburse my account with the months I was promised would be covered since I brought new members.
