Said he would comp the next two months. Switched banks and being contacted of why they can't pull this months monthly fee. Which should be COVERED. I have received several calls and text messages. Meanwhile. Both people I referred are dealing with charges and account issues. This is a wonderful gym to join if you want your accounts overdrafted for random charges or charges that should be covered as promised. Would recommend this gym to anyone who loves paying overdraft fees or enjoys having random sums of money pulled from account at unexpected times.
Friendly staff, nice selection of cardio and strength training equipment, great classes.

We're relatively new in the Boise area and still looking for good Chinese/Asian.  Tried Ling and Louie's last night.  I'll keep the review simple.  The food was adequate, but nothing special.  The service was slightly south of adequate.  If you're OK with an average experience, I guess they're OK.  We'll continue our search for something better.

Just brought a TV here today, after getting the run around from Blossom Hill TV,  TVS Repair, and Lee's Tv & Vcr Repair (BHTV was referred by Comcast, the others I found on Yelp). A+ Universal TV is the only place that had a storefront, called me back within 2 minutes of calling, and were open during their business hours. They were clearly working on a lot of TVs, so he said it would take 2 days to hear back about the $25 diagnostic check up, and I will update when we hear back. I'm just glad they seemed like a legit TV repair shop.

They did a nice job here and my nails look great. They do not take credit/debit cards so be prepared with cash. Also, the lady that helped us was very sweet the put a lot of pressure on up-sells, etc. All in all a fairly good experience.

First time we came here their machine wasn't working and so they were only taking cash. Frustrating so we left, who carries that much cash these days? Second time my husband just went. He ordered the orange chicken, pork Gyoza, and Katsu and brought it home. The orange chicken was pretty good, the Gyoza was a little over cooked and hard, and the katsu slices were itty bitty. It all tasted ok, and it was nice to see such a variety of Asian food, but definitely not as good as less expensive Japanese and Chinese food places in our home state of Utah.

I've never had a bad experience at Zamzows. They are always so helpful and ready to answer questions and greet you with a smile. Recently I appreciate their willingness to show me how to get the things I need that fit my budget. Thank you Zamzows.

We came at lunch hour.  The front door is wide open, on a very chilly day.  Because the door is locked. Waited 30+ minutes and never received our food. More people poured in. The poor girl at the front is vastly overwhelmed by the 3 orders ahead of us. When I finally ask for a refund and get a look at the kitchen it is a single older woman over a 6 burner stove. They are not set up for speedy preparation. She refused to refund and instead quickly boxed my food up. Poor service and we didn't get to eat.
Delicious options at mostly reasonable prices.  Fast service once we ordered.  For dinner and a show, or at least a bit of technique learning, sit at the sushi bar!

So far "not so good".
Service is slow. Glad I didn't include a tip.
Easy to see why the place was empty.
Salad rolls are small and only come with Hoisin sauce. And the Pho is small at a large price. And far from the best. 
The owner needs to travel to Portland and see how it's really done.

First, (and this is often underappreciated), when I call, they answer the phone. When you're looking at your beloved vehicle and it is smashed, that matters BIG TIME. Furthermore, I can always be fully confident that the person who answers will be both friendly and knowledgeable. I've had to process several claims over the last few years, and each time it has gone very smooth due simply to this office's consistently excellent standards of customer service and knowledge.

I most recently worked with Andrea, who helped me to navigate a complicated claim on a complicated day. She not only saved me time and money, but also saved me from massive amounts of frustration. She was able to streamline the whole process for me and did a lot of the legwork that I would otherwise have had to do myself.

Finally, Steve himself is a good man. In terms of my insurance, I only insure 2 cars, so I'm not a massive client. But I'm treated like a CEO by Steve and his employees. When my past claims caused my rates to go up, he personally took the time and initiative to reach out to me and let me know and try to help keep everything affordable for me. I didn't ask him to call; he just did. I won't forget that, Steve. Top class.

The place is moderately busy most of the time, my grandma loves this place.. Older people in general like this place, so a younger crowd feels a bit off inside unless your at the bar, and those few games they have in the corner just don't do justice anymore. Haven't tried the bar, though I might here soon, of course that will be another review but I gave a three star because one of the most popular Italian dishes is not good here. We got the lasagna and every time we do we regret it, we order again thinking hopefully this time, it will be better, I'd honestly rather eat and enjoy frozen Stouffers lasagna from the store. Poor communication i guess had us paying for another side dish we didn't really need. Wanting to complain to a manager, but leaving you feeling like you can't since the whole room will have eyes on you.. Then again my family really likes this place for some reason. Even though mostly everything on the menu is over priced. The only thing they have going for them is they're pasta.
Meh. Average food, not a lot of flavor, and service was extremely lax. The atmosphere is really loud as well.

We love Best Western anytime we need a place to crash for the night!  This place goes down as our favorite one out of the many we have visited in the last 8 years... 
Very cute look inside and out. If felt clean and fresh.  I loved the corner suite we had and that we could bring our four legged friend!  
Check in and out was efficient and easy.  Breakfast was hot and well maintained. 
We thought we left something behind and called to check.  They took the time to personally check the unit and then ask the other staff to look and then even called me back to give me an update.  
Great service!

Very disappointed.  This is not the Ling and Louie's that it used to be.  My wife and I used to come here with a couple friends every couple of months or so.  When we went there last night, I could tell something was up.  The bar that used to be in the center has black plastic shielding around it and says "Sushi Bar Coming Soon".  The menu was a little different too, although many of the same items remain.  I asked our server if it is under new owners, and yes, it is.  My wife and I ordered pot stickers.  Usually pot stickers are served with a nice tasty sauce but this sauce was simply soy sauce with an extreme amount of salt.  Far saltier than regular soy sauce.  We only had a 3 of the six and had to stop, and my wife loves salt but we just had to pull out of eating any more.  I ordered the surf and turf and it came sizzling as usual.  I also upgraded to fried rice as my side.  The fried rice was not fried at all and was less than lukewarm.  It was steamed rice with scrambled egg mixed in with a few other things.  I honestly had never seen non-fried fried rice before nor fried rice without soy sauce added during the cooking.  We were seated at the second booth outside the kitchen and were treated to hearing the cooks carrying on and dropping the f-bomb.  When our server came back, I just told her that this is not the Ling and Louie's that it used to be and that we were really disappointed.  I asked if we could just leave.  Upon getting up out of our booth I told her I don't think this place will make it through the summer.  Let's see if I'm right.

Typically I like Walgreens.  They have great deals on milk and often on laundry detergent.  But their pharmacy leaves much to be desired.  They're the closest pharmacy to my house and they have a drive-thru, so I'll probably continue to use them.  That said, they are very slow.  If my Dr. faxes over a script and I show up an hour later to get it, it's still sitting on their fax machine and hasn't been processed yet.  Every time.  This is getting really old.  Yesterday the insisted that they hadn't received my sons prescription, even after I'd called the Dr. office and had it faxed over twice.  Today they told me that they had contacted a Dr. Johnson to confirm the refill of amoxicillin - I've never heard of Dr. Johnson and this med wasn't a refill.  Very frustrating!  Kudos to Pharmacist Walter though, as he listened to my dilemma and called the correct Dr. himself and got it all straightened out.  So I guess I'll give them one more chance.
We stop in on a trip through Boise for a sweet treat. Chocolate soft serve ice cream cones did the trick.
A very excellent place for Sunday Brunch. It seems to be a secret as it isn't very busy.  Affordable Sunday Brunch buffet.
I go out of my way to come here because of the excellent facility and staff. Incredible customer service everytime ~ so friendly, warm and accommodating !

I've only been here once, but the boba was amazing! I got the green tea, peach, with mango jellies and it was probably the best boba I've had! They don't skimp out on the jellies! Super cool atmosphere, very modern! The staff was very nice and worked fast! I would definitely recommend! Also, the strawberry milk is sooooooo good! We got a mini sample of it and it is to die for!

We saw a kid on the side of the road with a sign Souper Salad. It's been along time since we have been to a good place for soup & salad. Well I guess we will still have to keep on looking. The price was 13.84 with senior discount, 2 ice teas for 3.98. Total with tax was $18.47. This was a all you can eat buffet. 
The place was clean and bright. The selection of salad and soup was very limited. The soup I tried was watered down and was bland. My wife liked what she selected. They had a toco bar but the meat was grease. I think I will pass on returning.

If you need a seamstress or tailor, look no further. I've been using the services of As You Wish Clothiers for a few years now and can't imagine going anywhere else. The quality of their work is impeccable and for such reasonable prices! I moved to Denver a few months ago but was not satisfied with the tailors down here so when I went back for a visit, I visited As You Wish Clothiers with a couple suits too. They have tailored several suits for me and you can never see evidence that the suits were worked on. Their craftsmanship is truly outstanding.

Waited over an hour, when the hostess had told us that there was a thirty minute wait. Server was pleasant, but food was mediocre at best. My daughter's food was served cold. Disappointed and probably will not return.

We are not sure what has happened in the last few months since we were last at an Applebee's, but things all around have definitely declined. The first red flag was the small number of people there on a Friday night. I also noticed that the menu had vastly fewer items this time around while the prices have increased.

My wife and mother-in-law both ordered Caesar salads and a three cheese pasta dish. The lettuce was wilted and clammy and not covered with enough dressing. It was almost as if the lettuce had passed its expiration date. The pasta dish was only average for the price we paid. I had the butchers cut which consisted of pieces of meat mixed with mashed potatoes, mushrooms and dehydrated tomato slices. Like the pasta dish, it was good but not good enough to justify the cost.

The service was also average. Our server was nice but seemed to be sluggish. She forgot my drink the first time around, even though we all ordered sodas. A different server brought out my wife and mother-in-law's food but not mine. Minutes later our server came around and asked me where my food was. I felt like I was not only put on the spot but puzzled as to why she asked me that question instead of the kitchen staff.

With so many better and more valuable food alternatives just yards in every direction, it is very unlikely that we will be back.

Man this place was better than expected!  It shares a space with a taco joint and a coffee bar so I wasn't sure how the quality of food was going to be.  This place was great!  I ordered the chicken teriyaki and yellow curry and both were outstanding!  Everything was super fresh and cooked to perfection.  The sauce portioning was not too much or too little and the amount they gave you for the price was great!  Staff were friendly and helpful.  This will definitely be one of my regular food visits when I'm at The Village.  

Also, another great feature about Rice Works is that it's great food for a decent price.  Most restaurants in the village are going to be $12 and up for one plate, not including drinks and tip.    Nice to have an affordable and delicious alternative to a more expensive sit down restaurant.

Mike is very knowledgeable and professional. He did an amazing job for us! The home sold in record time and we received a great offer within days. 

Our thanks go out to Mike and his team. The stager he hired made some wonderful suggestions to make the house very appealing.

We have eaten at Louie's many times, but it has been a couple of years since we were last here. 
The service was good, and the. food was also good.   I would have preferred fresh or frozen artichoke hearts with my grilled Salmon, but otherwise the flavors melded well. My friends also were quite pleased with their entrees. My one real complaint is that the salad was so drowned in dressing that it was overwhelming. I couldn't eat but a little.  Ask for the dressing on the side!!
Good, but not great.

El servicio es bueno el lugar se ve limpio y un ambiente agradable. Yo pedi chicken teriyaki tenia buena presentacion pero le faltaba sabor como si la salsa estuviera muy rebajada con agua. No les recomiendo los bubble tea , mi amigo pidio uno pero la tapioca estava muy dura.

I was obligated to 1 star in order to post. About once a year we try this place again, just hoping we won't get disappointed/pissed again. The service has gotten even worse now that they have the presto servers on the table. They somehow figure they will only help you if you put on your call light. 5 employees standing around the bar including the manager, watching sports, while our light blinks asking for attention..  6 tables in the place have customers.  Red Robin across the street may have obnoxious birthday singers but it beats Applebee's hands down. Waiting in line at Texas Roadhouse is the same price as here and at least you get peanuts and attention from your server.

I love going to this place when I am in the village! When you don't want to wait for a table at a restaurant this is the place to go. The outdoor seating in the summer is so nice and the food is delicious! They make great yakisoba noodles and the teriyaki chicken is amazing!!

The haircut was extraordinary, as was the hairstylist. The stylist that cut my hair was Amber and she was the most friendly person there. When I sat down in the chair I just felt a warm atmosphere overcome me. Usually when I get my haircut I'm nervous that the person cutting it won't cut it how I'd like it, but I didn't feel that today. 
Not only was the atmosphere welcoming, but the haircut itself was great. She did it just how I wanted it and made a total of 0 mistakes. So If you ever go to this SportsClips, ask for Amber to cut it. 100% recommend!!

I went here with my family yesterday. We saw this place had opened when we were nearby, and we love pho so we had to check it out. First off, the service was great. The staff was really friendly. My daughter ordered a soursop boba smoothie. One of the owners came out and showed her what the soursop fruit looked like, since we had never heard of it. It was cool and a really nice experience to have some background and story about the food. 

My daughter ordered vegan pho, I ordered beef meatball pho, and my husband ordered chicken teriyaki rice plate. We all loved our food, and loved each other's food. The tofu in the vegan pho had a great texture and flavor. The beef pho was delicious! The portion was just right. I was absolutely stuffed. My husband loved the teriyaki chicken so much, he wanted to lick his plate. 

I'm so glad to have a place like this closer to home. I will be coming back again and again!

Just tried Urban Fox Coffee & Boba for the first time and am very happy with my choice. I had the Nitro Cold Brew and it was amazing. My friend got the thai tea with boba and hers was equally as yummy. They have asian style dessert bread and homemade strawberry milk that both sound like a nice treat, but we didn't try those today. I will definitely be coming back to support this small business. The interior is very clean and simple as well!
Awesome local business, kind people, willing to go out of his way did his customers, and always fair pricing. Support local businesses and families.

If your looking for some good Americana this place is the place to go.  Screw Dennys, screw IHOP come here.  This place has become a regular for my family since moving to Idaho and we freaking love it.  Low cost right around 30-40 for a family of 5 always busy and the food is always good

Always one of my faves for Italian. The best smelling restaurant in town! Lots of seating including a nice patio weather permitting. Always good service. Good menu options without being too overwhelming. Sometimes less is more!! The only thing I wish they had but don't is Happy Hour specials.

The menu needs a little more of a selection my hamburger was alright I've made better hamburgers myself does't compare to any of the little Hamburger joints I'm accustomed to out in Southern California were I came from the finger Steaks were a little dry would i go back no unless a new owner improved the quality of food.

We stopped by for our favorite, the chicken bowl. Very good as usual but disappointed when we were informed there would a 75 cent charge each to get our drink in a paper go cup. We may consider other options. Normally would consider them 5 stars.

The food is awesome here. I was surprised at the taste and quality of the food. The staff  was extremely nice and helpful with what to choose on the menu. The yakisoba noodles are the best I have had at any asian restaurant.

I love this place and I really just want to keep this a secret for just myself! Found some really cute items for low prices! Discovered that I can actually bring back items and exchange them for something else! Employees were pleasant, always a bonus in my book! There is even a play area for kids! The BSU game was on the TV in the back by the dressing rooms. There's a decent maternity collection however the bread and butter here is the kids clothing. I can't wait to come back! Kids Again also sells toys and furniture, I was impressed to see 2 power wheels "vehicles," one that was about to be purchased.

I was really excited to eat here and finally got my chance and what a disappointment.  We had 6 people in our group and we got right in on a Friday Night about 6:45, which made me wonder.  We sat down and the service was not personable, I then saw several other servers wearing nonslip shoes, and two female servers did not have their hair up as they entered the kitchen.  I thought if management didn't care about those things what else is going to be wrong.  I made my way to the bathrooms and they were clean, but as I went back to my seat I saw a prep cook without a hat or hair net.  The food came out, I had the Walnut Shrimp, the Calamari and  edamame beans for the appetizer.  The Beans were way over cooked and were so mushy, the calamari was chewy, and the Shrimp was not fresh.  The server took all of our plates and left the uneaten bowl of edamame beans on the table and did not inquire as to why we did not eat them.  Over all I felt a real lack of caring from the staff as evident in all the violations they racked up and the quality of the food, I also got the feeling that well.................Ling and Louie's Just doesn't care.  I will give it two stars for atmosphere and a cool waterfall that spews fire out front, however,  I will not be back, save your money and if you feel like Chinese order egg rolls from Jack in the Box.

Staff was friendly. 

Food quality is poor, take your money elsewhere. The burgers tasted like anything you can make at home and very dried out.
They are always very nice and professional. The place is very clean and they all seam to take pride in their work.

My favorite place to stay when in Meridian-- clean, updated, pet friendly (with fee), comfy pillows and bed, and spacious rooms. I also like that the rooms are well lit. A lot of hotel rooms tend to be dark which makes me wonder if they're trying to hide how dirty they are. Not this place though. It's right next to the highway, but I didn't find it to be too noisy. Breakfast was standard. Parking is sufficient.

Went here on a Saturday night and was very impressed. Friends ordered sushi and they loved it. I ordered the Mongolian Beef. It was awesome, but the portion side was a bit small. The worst part was I left still hungry. Maybe it was an off night by the cook, but if I'm going to pay $15 for an entree, I hope I at least get full. I'll be back because it was really tasty.

Not sure where to even start with how exceptional Leif's work is and how incredibly awesome he is!! When looking around for photographers, he stood out to us with his professionalism. He was quick to respond and made us feel comfortable throughout the entire process. 

After our initial meeting, we met Leif for our engagement session up in Fallbrook (the package we selected came with a complimentary engagement session). Again, he made us feel so comfortable and really knows his stuff! He met us at 5:00am so we could get the sunrise into our shots (his idea) and we absolutely loved them! Not only did he capture some amazing shots, but he bought us breakfast and a mimosa to break the ice and calm our nerves.

From the day we signed the contract to the day of the wedding, there were so many occasions where we recognized how grateful we were to have Leif apart of our lives! He sent us small, but very thoughtful gifts and he created a timeline for us that made sure we would capture all the shots we really wanted. 

On our wedding day, he really captured our special day! One of my initial concerns was only having one photographer, but I can say Leif is all you need. He got shots from every angle and had so many great photos to choose from. I never saw him running around once during our wedding, but he captured lots of amazing candid shots. (which is what we love). We can honestly say, he is the best photographer around and if you're looking for someone, Leif is the man!

Full disclaimer - I am not a millennial!

Rooms are really snug.  There isn't sufficient desk space in the room for a business traveler and there isn't a space for clothes  - just the ones you can hang up.  I had difficulties figuring out where to eat dinner, so I ate on the bed. It has a modern dorm room feel.  

It was unsettling to have a staff member opening up my door without knocking to show a guest my room.  

The hotel is fairly loud for a new hotel.  With the fan off, you'll have a hard time sleeping if you sleep light.

The shower is nice.  Beds are comfy.  TV is big with full movie package (HBO/MAX/SHO).

Overall, not a fan of this "tru" family - rooms not right for the business traveler and rooms far too small for leisure stays if you have more than 2 in your party.
Enjoyed the sushi.  Also tried the pad thai on another occasion.  A bit overpriced.  Will go back.

I just started working out at Gold's.  

What I like:

+ I work out with a group.  There are four of us and we do circuit training.  There is always room for us to get our workout done.  There is a nice open space toward the back where we do our workouts.  Other people work out in that area as well but thus far everyone has been courteous and accommodating and we're all able to share the space well.

+ The cardio cinema is awesome.  It's a little theater (dark like a theater) with a movie playing on a large screen.  There are treadmills and ellipticals you can train on while you watch a movie!  They have a schedule on the wall outside the theater that allows you to see what is playing that day.  There is even a massage chair in front if you want to chill out with a massage and movie after a workout.  Awesome!

+ The monthly dues are entirely reasonable.  As of the date of this review, they're offering $10/month if you want to sign up for a year, $15/month if you prefer a month to month option.  

+Their machines (treadmills, ellipticals, & etc) are all well maintained as is everything in their free weight area.

+ I love their row machines!

Overall, a great workout with reasonably priced monthly dues.  It's not the most convenient location for me, but since I work out with others and this location works for them--I'm happy to make the trip!  

Get to it!

I was overall pretty disappointed in my experience but am giving them the benefit of the doubt. Burger was tasty but hated the presentation and felt it was a little small compared to other gourmet burger joints. Fries were burnt and super greasy. Went to one of their other restaurants all the time in college and had high expectations for this one.  Service was ok. Drink was giant sized.

I originally gave them three stars but never got a response when I sent them an email.

If I could rate it a zero. I could. The meat was cut into huge pieces so I wanted a lot but enough noodle to go with it. A worker came behind me and shoved his hand in my face and pointed mumbling something in terrible English very rudely. I then got swayed away from the meat and went to the noodles and sauces, I started adding my sauces and adding a lot of hot and spice. About towards the end and I wasn't even done with my sauces the cook came over and just took my food immediately away when I clearly wasn't finished... not even saying a word how classic a cook? Mind you the same employee who was rude to me earlier kept glaring me down as I paid for my families meal. Came home and all my spice was gone and no flavor. Same with my wife's whom she put just as much spice as mine and didn't get hers taken away mid-saucing. 

Gets worse every time we go. Either close down or hire better restauranteurs.
Food was pretty decent. I would not order sushi from this place ever again, it wasn't good. The other food is not bad, just nothing special. I go here again, but pass on the sushi.

My first time today. Was so friendly and really took the time to make sure everything was nice and clean . Definitely Better than most. My ONLY complaint is they took me off  a little too early and they aren't fully dry. But I will definitely be back!!

Tried around 2 flavors of boba hear, and I wasn't liking it so much because they were all too sweet (and I have tried lots of different boba before this). Wish they would have an option to reduce the amount of sugar because it would taste so much better less sweet.

Service is a little slow but my food and my husband's was delish!!! I had the honey chicken and he had sushi and seefood pot. For appetizer we had the calamari and is very different to what we had before, but we enjoy the little kick of spice it had.

The room was comfortable and very clean for our family of 5. The staff was super nice. We enjoyed the hearty complimentary breakfast every morning.

Breakfast consisted of eggs, biscuits, gravy, and breakfast meats. An automatic pancake machine was available and fun to use, although the pancakes were just ok. They had cereals, fruit, milk, yogurt, coffee, hot chocolate, tea, breads, muffins, hot cinnamon rolls. We were very happy with the breakfast and staff. Very friendly and helpful. 

The pool was clean. We visited in the summer, so the pool area was very warm.

We LOVE the blinds on the room windows. They did an excellent job at keeping the light out. This was a huge PRO for us because of the time difference for us; we slept in. Wish more places had blinds on their windows.

The one CON I have is that the dresser drawers are VERY SMALL and there were only 3 of them. The outside of the dresser makes it "look" like they are large but when they are slid open, they are actually very small. This was my only disappointment of the entire stay. 

Overall we had a very pleasant stay with a friendly and helpful staff.

I wanted to go here because I use to go there all the time for pharmaceutical meeting and have had the best food. I went with what was on special and that was the spaghetti for 9.50 well I didn't know it was all you can eat cause first off it said it on a board 9.50 for spaghetti it didn't say all you can can spaghetti and the second our server didn't even bother to tell us the specials today and after I ordered it he still didn't bother saying anything about it. I am a server and I would have approached my table with all the specials for that day I am really upset that I didn't get more spaghetti and I could have.
Average sushi nothing exciting but the atmosphere was good and the service could  use a little work.

Absolutely love this place, it's my favorite place to go when I go out for breakfast. The cinnamon rolls are amazing and I am not a huge cinnamon roll lover but they have mastered that. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a good breakfast place they are usually super busy so there may be a bit of a wait but totally worth it.

I gave 2 stars because the kids working in there were nice...but, the place was filthy, no clean tables, the food was really bad. Beef yakisoba had a strange perfume taste, and the beef was worse. We couldnt even eat it. They exchanged it for us, and we chicken pad thai instead, it was a bad goopy texture and sickeningly sweet. Do not recommend this place. 25.00 for 2 dishes we couldnt even eat. Waste of money!

This place is delicious!!! I loveeee the tacos... All of them. So goood!! I am Korean and this place fills my Korean food craving!! They are really friendly and the portions are a good size!! This place is one of my favorite in Idaho and definitely worth fighting the traffic on eagle road!!
I enjoy stops here for meals.  Nothing marvelous as far as I'm concerned but I've never had a bad meal.  Maybe I should give them 4 stars.  Maybe next time.  :)

First timers... Had high hopes for a great burger but.....Service was ok, waitress didn't follow through with our request. Burger is over rated. Very dry, at least it was covered with mayo or it would have been hard to swallow. Won't be back any time soon.
Kris was fantastic! My tan looked great for vacation. She was very informative and best of all made me feel very comfortable.
Love Big Juds, always good food, always friendly staff! My favorite are the Ortega Chicken and Ortega burger!
Great!  Dr. Fredriksson was very professional. He was able to successfully diagnose and treat my condition!!!

Good food and selection if you happen to be on Main St. and your hungry for breakfast.  Very friendly staff, and service.  My GF was please with the ability to customized her breakfast.  The interior is quite dated, but on par as old time neighborhood cafe atmosphere.  Reasonably priced.  If we happen to be on Main St. at breakfast time, we may stop in again.
Professional, called last minute, squeezed me in before back on the road, with 5 th wheel, 4 people on it for an hr and 1/2

I found Krissy in fall of 2011 and I absolutely love her! I am a health conscious person and know the dangers of sun tanning (indoor or outdoor ) so I prefer to get my glow by spray tanning.  I used to go to a salon to get sprayed but then I found Krissy and I haven't been back since. She is awesome. She is super flexible, has a great personality and her tans are flawless. She has always made sure that she can fit me in (weekly) and she genuinely cares if I am happy with my tan. I'd recommend her to anyone.

The service was good, but the food was subpar.  I went with some friends for happy hour.  My wife and I ordered sushi and was not good.  I tried my friends Asian nachos and they were not very appetizing.

After reading the Yelp review, I decided to go in for a fill and repair while I was in Boise on vacation...every bit as nice as the majority of reviewers said!  Prompt service, clean and well-run salon...would highly recommend!

I don't know how this place only has 3 stars but I'm just driving home from there, well my wife is driving while I write this review, but this place was excellent!! Everything we had was exceptional especially the service, which was provided by Crow at the bar. I had the firecracker, which I really enjoyed a lot, my wife had the walnut shrimp and Vegas roll, which she enjoyed as well and my parents I believe they had the lo mein and scallops and shrimp which they really enjoyed as well. already can't wait to go back. We would all highly recommend this place and when my parents come up here again to visit from California this is the first place they want to go eat at. And go to the bar and make sure Crow is there, best person we have ever had to serve us and my wife and I go out to eat quite a bit so that says a lot to us

It's Father's Day today, so I knew they were busy and probably didn't feel like dealing with fussy nitpicky diners like me, but I called Sunrise this morning after a very poor experience at another local restaurant and decided to order something for pick-up.  I am doing the ketogenic diet, which makes it tough to go out for breakfast especially, but when I called, I got a hold of (I think) Mandy, who immediately said, "Let's do it," after I explained my order might be a pain in the butt.  I ordered the Chorizo Benedict with medium poached eggs, no muffin, and no hashbrowns, and I have to say, it was one of the best meals I've had since I've been eating low carb.  Who knew?  Keto at the Sunrise?  Groovy.  I'll definitely be back.
This js the nicest walmart around & hardly anyone is ever here! I drive from nampa to this walmart or stop in on my way home
They have brownies now !! Just what I wanted a chocolate dessert option . I spoke and you heard! Good going souper salad ,

I recently tried this establishment as I've been looking for a modern Asian restaurant on par with the places I ate back home in the Bay Area. The ambience was nice and the staff was courteous and fun (the only reason I gave them 2 stars). The food however did not live up to expectations first as mentioned previously the I opted for the noodles instead of white rice and for an extra up charge they were not special just bland except for the flavor of the generals chicken sauce the dripped onto them. The chicken was over breaded and over cooked and the sauce  (I asked for medium heat as my stomach was not feeling awesome that day) was face melting hot. I know that every restaurant has its "off" days so I may consider trying them again and if they step up the next time I'll amend this review. Their gyoza did look tasty.

4 Star for the Pho, surprisingly good! Good rich broth, meatballs and steak were tender. Served piping hot with your favorite fresh herbs and bean sprouts. Skip the banh mi only a 2-3 Star. Tried the grilled pork- pork was fatty, but good simple seasonings. Sandwich was light on the veggies which were hardly pickled, making the whole thing quite dry. Instead get the egg rolls. They were crunchy, good flavors and nice dipping sauce.

Absolutely the worst Chinese food! The fried rice was undercooked and crunchy! The egg Foo young was tough on the outside and almost runny on the inside and it had a horribly rotten taste to it. Don't waste  your money!

This is, by far, the cleanest and most modernly decorated HI Express I've ever been in, and we are Priority Club members, so we've been in a LOT.  I trust that Holiday Inn Express wherever we go will follow the standard that is set by the hotel chain.  Wherever you go, you're guaranteed that a standard will be followed.  The breakfast area in this hotel is gorgeous.  High ceilings, modern tables and chairs - it's well put together.  ALL of the rooms are suites, which means there are two queen beds, and a couch departed by a partial wall.  We were greeted by a very friendly and polite receptionist, and I even was able to grab the kids a cookie upon arriving from the front lobby.  This was nice because they were tired and hungry.  I think our room was $129.  Nice!

Remarkably good, even considering the price. Had a Groupon, but I'd say paying full price would still be good considering quality. All the food is prepped fresh for you, which is great.

I went with my family on a Sunday. We had a sweet & sour chicken, chicken Korean tacos, and egg rolls. All-in, it was ~$18. The rolls were fresh and hot, Vietnamese-style with vermicelli and veggies inside. The tacos had a *lot* of flavor, and were a big win, spicy, with Korean-spiced chicken and kimchee, The S&S chicken was fresh and hot, with a little sauce drizzled on, and extra served in containers on the side. The S&S chicken had broccoli and cabbage with it, instead of the more conventional green peppers and onions and pineapple, but was still tasty. And the portion was really good-sized...would fill a guy up for sure.

Good: Location, people, atmosphere, food quality.

Needs work: Not much...no complaints, really.

I'd definitely go again, it's a win.
Visiting family in Boise and they took us to this cute little diner.  It's a favorite of theirs.  Good food and friendly service.

Eaten Pho (pronounced Fha) for nearby 20 years, at hundreds of shops and a few gifted friends homes (Laotian and Vietnamese).  Most recently I've lived in the Bay Area where Pho restaurants are like McDonald's almost; there everywhere.   Anyway, you get the point.  

This is the worst Pho experience, EVER.  I was so hopeful, and now utterly disappointed.  Cold, tasteless broth, clumpy noodles, don't go.  Not worth it.  Hit Pho Le in Boise.

I have gone here plenty of times because I don't know any other good haircut places and they have messed it up every single time if u want a good haircut or even decent I recommend not even thinking about this place

Went here as a kid... decided to see if they still existed. They have expanded!!!!!! The waitress was super friendly to my son. They both kept making it easy for me and dad to enjoy our meal. Still tastes like it did from years ago. Delicious.  Will be back when I'm up that way!

Great Places, Nice and Clean and Great Services!!! 5***** whenever my family need something done for their nails and getting ready for any big event they always come here. The customer services are also very good.
Love the owner, she's super friendly every time we come in. Good teriyaki with lots of options. My whole family is happy when we make it over here. Recommend.

Les runs this place and he is amazing! Super honest and just wants you to walk away happy, not scammed out of your life savings! Went to another shop and they wanted to charge $1,300 to replace everything around the problem I came in for. Les took a look and found the REAL issue and fixed it for only $200! I've never been so happy with a mechanic. He takes the time to explain everything to you, and is fully upfront and honest about the repairs. My car drives better now than it has in years!! I won't go anywhere else!!

Love this place! The staff are friendly and treat you like family, the food is delicious, hot, fresh, and decent portions. My favorite is to get the chicken teriyaki bowl with breast meat and fried rice. We also love the egg rolls and bubble tea with tapioca in it! My mom, daughter and I can eat here for under $20 and we love it!!

We aren't from the are and drove around for a long time trying to figure out where to eat. We thought we'd try something new and it wound up being horrible, so we left before we even ordered after my husband had a flat, tasteless beer. We are always up for Applebee's and it seems to be a fail safe when we are out of town, so we just decided to stop in and try it out. The service was excellent from the hostess to our waiter. The food portions seemed huge for Applebee's and we were more than satisfied with the food quality. One of the better Applebee's we've been to (the ones in our town are usually really sub par, but we've been happy in different states at different locations). The only issue was that the appetizers came out and literally 45 seconds later our dinner came out. But this seemed like a trivial and easily fixable error compared to the quality of the restaurant overall. I'd recommend this Applebee's for affordable and decent quality food to anyone. I was very happy.

I'm new to the Meridian area. My husband and I were driving down Eagle the other day and I spotted Envy Nails. I decided to pull them up on Yelp and read the reviews. (There's always a nay sayer in the crowd, so I decided to read all the reviews.) 

I decided to be my own judge and I was pleasantly surprised! 

Quyen (pronounced Quinn) was the person that did my nails. I've just recently let my acrylics grow off and removed them and now I just have Gel manicures. She did a Perfect job! 

Very Happy that l found this place and Quyen! She's was so sweet and warm at heart.

This is my new Go To Nail shop! Loved it!

Do yourself a favor and go to Envy Nails and request Quyen! She will take care of you and will do whatever you want to your nails! (I like mine thin and narrow) and that's exactly what she did! 

Great Job Quyen! Thank you!!!!

Bobbi

1st visit & not bad at all. i went for the happy hour sushi, appetizers & drinks. happy hour on sunday? yes. so cool. i started with the potstickers. good but didn't blow me away. the dumpling dough was a little thick to me, flavor was mild & i couldn't tell you what the filling consisted of. i had 2 crab crunch rolls, very good flavor. meant to try something else but i liked it so i ended up getting 2. :)  i also tried an asian pear martini. yum. it tasted refreshing & light. every time i drink one it doesn't seem strong at all, they always hit me after i've finished them. martinis are sneaky that way.  my son got the sunset roll. it was fresh had more pieces than i expected (not part of the happy hour selection) & ling's meatloaf. it was different. i didn't dislike it, it just isn't something i'd order on my own. am glad i got to try a bite of his. it was something new & interesting to try & that is a good thing. both meals we around $25, so not bad at all. & i finally have found a  happy hour sushi place. will go back again.

They really have great bubble tea smoothies. We ordered a strawberry and honeydew with black tapioca balls.  I can't wait to try the jelly squares instead of the balls.  Not a bad price either since one place I went to the bubble tea coast around $6.00.   Also, I ordered spicy teriyaki and really enjoyed the dish.  Not too spicy for my taste or my two year old baby girl.  However, our family does like spicy dishes.  We now come here on a regular basis.  Clean, fast, and very friendly.  Can't beat that.
My favorite nail salon. They have new Polish and lots to choose from. I've gone other places where the polish Is chipping within a day or two. Everyone is nice and great service.

Kris is the best! She has done spray tans for my husband and I before our last two vacations, and they turned out amazing. So natural looking, and you instantly look 10 pounds thinner. Everyone we met was like - how do you get your tan to glow like that?! Had to confess that it was fake! :) I had no streaking. No funky knees or ankles. No discolored nails. Kris will come to the house, and she's in and out for both of us in about 25 minutes. She sets up a little tent in our living room. And like everyone else - I was a little nervous getting naked, but it was literally no big deal at all. Kris is just such a professional!  After about 30 seconds I forgot I was naked! I think the most amazing thing is how much my husband loved his. He's not the type to do something like a spray tan, but I doubt he will ever go on vacation without one now. Men can't spray naked (very wise safety precaution for female spray tanners), but if you want to minimize tan lines, we read online in a body building forum to just buy tiny men's brief underwear and modify. Roll them down as much as possible, and then bunch up the back so it looks almost like a thong. Pro move. We did the fast developing solution and only had to wait 4 hours! I was freaking out while waiting the first time because the bronzer looked really streaked, but have no fear, once rinsed all was fine and it developed into a flawless deep dark tan. Thank you Kris!

Nice little hangout bar, cool beer choices, IPAs, wheats, hemps, ales, and porters! Lots of different choices. The vibe is really laid back, the owner is pretty nice. The locals there are all friendly. Got a nice projector tv for games. Lots of things they do throughout the week like trivia giveaways and some of the beer companies come down and do giveaways also. If Your ever downtain Meridian, give this Haus a try!

I went to Amber Rose after reading the reviews on Yelp.  Finding a salon in town to get my eyebrows waxed was difficult- so I was happy to discover them.  Everyone is very friendly and they do a great job on shaping my eyebrows.  Highly recommend!
I am never disappointed with the food here.  Workers are very welcoming, food delicious, prices and portions very good, and wait time reasonable.
Hit or miss. Service is usually ok. Bahn mi is good when they have bread. The pho is not too bad. Wonton soup is awful though. Still waiting for a great Vietnamese spot in Meridian

Louie, what even is this? Your place looked really good, but then you really didn't deliver... or delivered too much???

Louie started his first Italian establishment in the 1960s with nothin' but a nickel and a stick a gum and he paid off his loan in only 6 months and- you get the point. This place looks nice. Like a fancier Buca di Beppo, where you got roman statues instead of pictures of the Pope dancing. We got a half margherita and half Louie's deluxe. Cost roughly $15 and took 20 mins. Reasonable prices and times.

-Margherita-
I mean, they are really stretching the interpretation of a margherita. To quote PizzaTom: "It's more like cheesy bread than a pizza." This margherita has little to no tomotoes/basil. The cheese was good but this was far from a classic Italian pizza.

-Louie's Deluxe-
This is like an 'everything' pizza where Louie said, "you know what, that's not everything. We still got some more ingredients in these tubs here, let's throw them on." This thing has got: canadian bacon, pepperoni, sausage, mushrooms, onions, olives, bell peppers, diet dr. pepper, one whole pineapple, a new car (volkswagen), and an entire 14″ pizza from Wise Guy Pizza pie as toppings. Why a pizza ever needed so much junk on it is a mystery to me. We picked this as our pizza to taste cause it has Louie's name in it, but we really could have picked any of the others on the menu and had a better time. I don't get why they decided this sensory overload of a pizza was their signature dish.

-Verdict-
I mean, the margherita cheesy bread was not bad. Don't get Louie's deluxe. It's a big mess. I recommend this place if you don't like pizza but you do like both extremes of pizza deconstruction.

2 slices out of 5

Got our first chance to check out this newly opened place right off Eagle Road and it was a mixed experience overall, but good enough that we'll return in the future.

The good:
- Very family friendly and good kids menu for $5...Bento Boxes that my son loved and seemed like he barely put a dent in it.

- Good noodle dishes and spring rolls. The noodles we got for lunch were the highlight...good flavor, good amount of veggies and well executed.

- The chicken soup was probably the best item we had at the table...great flavor and perfectly spiced!

The bad:
- Miso soup was under "misod" we felt...just lacked a depth of flavor you like to see in Miso soup.

- The firecracker chicken dish sounded great, but the seasoning was off...just felt like they dumped hot oil over the top of it and called it a dish. With some adjustments fo the sauce, this would be a good one.

So for a lunch joint on Eagle Road, it was good and had a variety on the menu which we'll continue to sample as we go back in the future.

I read a review for Ling and Louie's and I decided to give it a try.  I really liked it!  At first I was skeptical and I really don't usually like fusion restaurants, but the food was really good at lunch and the price was very reasonable!  I'm going back next week and I will give and in depth review of their menu!

Favorite beer spot, great selection and awesome atmosphere. Several taps always rotating, and they aren't afraid to take a chance on the lesser known/smaller breweries. Highly recommend for a low key after work drink

Tastes like canned marinara. Definitely frozen tortellini. You can do better with tortellini from Albertsons and Prego. The chicken marsala tasted barely of marsala. I basically got marsala soup. What happened to the fabulous Louies of downtown Boise?

Vehicle washed and detailed at fast Eddie's car wash. My car looks and smells amazing! The employees were very professional and very polite. They opened every door for me. Service like this is hard to come by these days.

Atmosphere: very nice.  Service:  very good.  Appetizers: Good, but there are local restaurants that make it better (Lettuce Wraps).  Dinner Entrees: (Drunk Chicken, Pad Thai, Popcorn Chicken) While visually appealing the taste of the food was boring, and after several bites, the taste resembled that of a frozen TV dinner.  The chicken in all entrees had a consistency of cardboard meaning it was very dry and chewy.  We did not finish our meals, not even our 8 year old son who eats almost anything.  He asked to never come back because the food was gross.  (No comments on alcohol as we didn't purchase any).

So decide to come here for Easter brunch. Call a few days before so they don't take reservations I was going to be there before noon they said it should not be a problem. We showed up table for six was told an hour wait which ended up being two hours. Food was mostly cold and mediocre scrambled eggs were unedible. The whole experience took us almost 3 hours, blah.  To top it off it was $20 per person, no way worth it!  We all decided we would not be back.  No photos because it's a buffet, a bunch of food thrown on a plate nothing to look at.

Fairly disappointed this evening at the service at this restaurant, typically my family enjoys eating here and have had no issues but this evening we had regretted selecting this location for dinner. We came in and sat and after ordering did not receive our dinner until about 35 mins after ordering - it's not the wait that's disappointing but yet the fact that we watched 5+ customers walk in and order food to go and walked out with their food, every one of them before we received our food and once we did no apologies or acknowledgement of the long wait on the food. It's one thing if someone calls in to order a pick up and it was ordered before we got there but people coming in and ordering to go should not be getting their food before the patrons sitting in the restaurant waiting on their food especially with such a wait. Food was great as always though so I appreciate that.

Everything we tried here we really liked. We had the Beef lo mein, orange peel chicken; potstickers and tried a California sushi roll.  The Sushi tasted really fresh, Lo mein was a little spicy but flavorful, and the chicken tasted of good quality. Can't wait to try this place again!

Super friendly service, lots of choices (incl dairy & gluten free!)  also lots of light, live plants, many places to sit- & yummy coffee, tea, spritzers etc!... & did I mention plenty of parking, chill music, very clean

Great place to sit down and grab a bite. Atmosphere is very casual with a large salad bar that has every type of major green that you might want. There is also another food bar with soups and sides. The self-serve bars are the stars of the show and they deliver, all for $9 per adult! Also, chicken breasts are available for $1.70 each and they are tender and juicy. Try! You won't be disappointed.

I have been coming here for 6 years and will never go anywhere else. I love how they greet everyone who walks through the door. They are friendly and always personable. They always remember events going on in my life. Ask about my family. You can tell they care. I will throw new and crazy ideas at them and they master it every time. Nails are never streaky, bumpy, or uneven in length. Jean, Que, and Linda are the absolute best. Jean is amazing with filling nails. Quick and efficient. Que gives amazing massages when getting a pedicure. And Linda will never sell you short on spot on designs and ombré's. Never a silent moment (unless you want it to be for relaxation) with any of these guys. They are great to chat with. I would recommend them to anyone.

Had lunch around 11:30 on a Saturday. The service was very good - my wife had questions about calories (I know, it's a burger place...) and our server was very helpful. 

The burgers were excellent - very tasty, cooked just right and huge! Prices are very reasonable. Overall an excellent experience.
Well maintained and clean, service was prompt , and kept on top of our needs. Food and selection was good, prices average for this type of lunch.  I would return again.

Delicious food as always. But ridiculous price for their "express coffees." Paid $4 for a 12 oz cup of crappy coffee. But the food came out fast. Took only about 5 minutes to get to my table. Got there Big Biscuit Breakfast with perfectly cooked over-medium eggs. Highly recommend.

Was used to Souplantation in CA. This is not that great place but pretty good though. The servers are new almost every time, that I don't like. That tells me the pay and/or tips are lousy. Food is usually fresh and yummy, soups are tasty with at least four to five kinds out. I do wish they would have at least one always be a veggie option.

Krissy is very personable and made me feel completely at ease for my first ever spray tan. I was very happy with the results and will definitely call Krissy again the next time I'm looking for a little color.

The wife and I went to get some grub after the movie. We decided on Riceworks. I had eaten there, but she had not. My wife picked out the Teriyaki Chicken (good choice) and I picked out the ninja chicken. 

The teriyaki chicken is a generous bed of white rice, topped with sliced chicken breast, veggies, and some house teriyaki sauce. The array of flavors is plentiful. I've had that before and would for sure have it again. 

Then I had the ninja chicken. This was a bed of rice topped with tempura chicken, tossed around in some spicy sauce made in house. This is also served with a mixture of veggies and some ninja sauce. 

Then give you an additional side of sauce for your meal. 

I liked the ninja chicken it was pretty good. However I decided to ask for a side of teriyaki to mix with the ninja. The mixture of ninja sauce and teriyaki was excellent. There are not any words to properly describe the taste. It was like there was a party in my mouth amongst my tastebuds.
Not impressed. Not interested in supporting a business who treats staff horribly, and still serves mediocre coffee.
Clean rooms, no traffic noise, friendly staff, yummy breakfast with many choices. Would stay there again!

This was my first visit to Ling and Louie's.   It was during Happy Hour so we were able to sample some cocktails at a great price---$5.   I had a Mojito which was very refreshing with some tropical notes.  We also shared an order of edamame---another bargain at $5 and a good healthy way to start a meal.  They are simply steamed, served in shell, and coated with sea salt.

One of my friends chose the meat loaf entrée which comes with wasabi mashed potatoes and it was a hit.  I need to try it the next time I come here.

I chose General Ling's chicken which was a medley of crispy chicken in  a sweet sauce served over brown rice.  I would've preferred the rice separate as is done in most Asian restaurants.  There was a bit too much sauce to my liking.  

My other friend chose the Drunken Chicken which comes flamed tableside with a dipping sauce.  Again, there appeared to be a lot of sauce and as in my dish small pieces of chicken.

There are a lot of selections on the menu.   There are noodle dishes plus the more spicy Thai influenced offerings.  The dishes are indicated with a symbol indicating the spicy factor.   It's also good that a choice of rice is available.  It's a place definitely worth another visit and an opportunity to try some other dishes.

I stopped in here on my way home from work one night and Wow! The staff was quick to greet you and they got me right in. The owners are so sweet and do an amazing job. They just recently became open on Sundays too. Their prices are good and you will never leave there disappointed!
Love this place for breakfast or lunch. Old fashioned good service with simple great food. Have been here many times and have never been disappointed.
Super great staff! If your looking for affordable dental care this is the place. They were able to get me in without a long wait. The office is super clean. I look forward to my next visit.
Wow~ the black tea boba is so good! Love this place a lot. U can take nice pictures @UrbanFox. Nice and kind people :)

Finally!! We have a coffee shop in The Village!! I am ecstatic!!

Great coffee.  Lots of options including Coconut and Almond milk. Wifi. Great setting with high tables and a fire place to cozy up to.  

My only complaint right now, is that they don't open until 9:30am.  I'm sure that makes sense for them as businesses are just starting to fill up The Village office spaces, and until they do, they might not be super busy in the early ams.  But selfishly, I really hope that they open around 6/7am in the near future.  If and when that happens, The Village Coffee will have a guaranteed weekly customer as I am walking distance and I need a break from my home office. This place would be ideal!!
Okay food. Dirtiest restaurant I've ever eaten at though.
Totally awesome work out!! Facility  was absolutely impeccably clean.instructors were so wonderful I highly recommend this club.

Not the newest or the most advanced, but this location does contain very nice amenities.  Onward!

Location: 3 out of 5
About 15 minutes from the airport.  Give yourself extra time because the highway is under construction.  Once you get to the Meridian exit, the hotel is literally right off of the highway.  Right turn off the exit, right turn at the first light, and right turn into the driveway.

Customer Service: 3 out of 5
Probably one of the more lackluster customer service experiences I had in the Boise area, but that's probably because overall, Boise has very friendly people.  The person who checked me in was kind enough.  Made small talk, made sure I got everything ok, and we even joked a little about the fact that lots of people try to bring their pets into this location (no joke...they make you sign a separate piece of paper saying that if you have a pet and you're caught, it's an extra fine).  After that I didn't really see anyone around the front desk until I checked out.  I think they just sit in the adjacent office, and it's easy to contact them via the front phone, but perhaps I just like a personal touch.

Rooms and Amenities: 4 out of 5
My buddy and I got a 2 room suite.  Not a bad gig.  This location is showing a little age, but not anything atrocious.  The main "living area" had a larger couch, a sitting chair, tv, mini fridge, mini microwave, and sink area with coffee maker.  The bedroom we got had two queen beds, tv, desk area, etc.  Bathroom was fine, but be aware that the toiletries are non-boutique and "regular."  There's absolutely nothing wrong with that.  Maid service was great - every night we would return to a properly cleaned room with new towels.  Mini fridge temperature was good enough to keep water and sports drinks, as well as beer cold.  On a side note, the TVs were the older ones with curved screens...

Hotel Amenities: 4 out of 5
I didn't get to take advantage of the free breakfast, but I could smell it cooking every morning.  I did, however, use the pool and the hot tub.  It's very neat how it's indoors, and with the windows open, there's always a layer of steam escaping.  The pool was heated, and the hot tub was super heated.  Very comforting, if there's not a lot of children there.  Unfortunately, on the one time I went, there were a few children there, and although they weren't obnoxious or rude or ill-mannered, children are just by nature, louder when they are swimming or playing in the water.  I must note that the hot tub was also quite deep - sitting down, the water came up to my chin.  Haha.  I noticed that the place also had a workout room, and one lone computer in the main lobby area.  At no point in time did I see anyone use the computer, probably because the hotel provides free wifi at decent speeds.  

Pricing: 4 out of 5, I think.
I got this through southwest vacations, and I suppose that the package price contained a very good discount.  The listed room rate for the two room suite with two queen beds was 220$.  Guffaw.  By my calculations, the discounted rate was somewhere around 100 - 120 per night, which I find very reasonable for what we got.  Highly recommended if you're in Meridian, and not a bad drive from the Boise area if you want to save a few bucks.
Breakfast with grandson was delicious. He told waitress they should have the pumpkin pancakes all year long they were so good. Great amount of food and service was great. Good home cookin'.

The boba tea was delicious and the service was amazing. The interior was decorated very modern and artsy. I love this place so much, it is my new favorite boba shop. Also their strawberry milk is homemade and it is delicious!!!!!! 10/10 recommend

My roommate and I tried this restaurant shortly after moving to Meridian.  They have good food and very reasonable prices.  They have huge portions as well.  Sometimes there is a bit of a wait, because they can be fairly busy, but I haven't had to wait overly long.  It has a very friendly atmosphere and they are always very welcoming of people.  You can always hear the chef singing along to the island music they're always playing.  My favorite meal here is the Teriyaki Chicked, which comes with rice and macaroni salad.  It is flavorful and filling.

LOVE.  Casey Hess (owner and head magic-maker) and her niece Anna are fantastic. (There is another woman there too, but I haven't met her...she's always working!  :-D )  They are warm, and have that "relax...we are here to help you" vibe.  Anna helped me with two Chinese-style wedding dresses that need altering, and was fun, straightforward, and terrific in the "customer service" end of things. Not to be corny, but I felt that I'd known her for a much longer time than what I spent in the store!  Her attitude and manner were professional, and yet fun-happy, and comforting.  Everything was completed on time, and at a wonderful price.

Today, I brought in a 95-year old family heirloom that needs handwork -- I was very apprehensive about doing any work with it at all because of its age and material.  This time Casey was on it, and once we discussed the issues, she made me feel confident -- and far less worried. (I'll report back on that piece!)

I am always in need of alterations (I'm short legged), and am so glad I found Casey and Anna!  They really make you feel like you are the most important customer they're working with at that moment, and that they will take care of your piece as if it were their own.

Came back to Meridian and went to RiceWorks...  let's just say my memory of the food was far better than what I was served.  The generals chicken was okay but at over $9,  don't waste your money.  Coming to the rolls....  just awful.  I appreciate the hot temp but when you bite into the roll,  just grease on grease...  unless you smother it with sauce,  you can't eat it.

The guys at Fast Eddie's service station are awesome!! I can't say enough about these guys.  I work close and take my jeep there for it's servicing and the guys are clean, professional and go above and beyond.  Very good work and if I could I would have all my work done there.

My overall experience has improved since my initial review. The amount of meat I've been given has increased to the point where one meal would likely satiate two people or give you enough leftovers to make another meal out of it. So the value has increased. I tried the spicy chicken that was recommended to me and was pleasantly surprised by how much I liked it. My desire to see a Korean spin on things came through as there was a definite element of gochujang (a vital condiment of Korean cuisine) to the spicy sauce. I asked about it and it was confirmed. Is it the same sauce they use to make your meat "hot and spicy" for 50 cents extra? While I'd certainly say it's spicy, it's not hot at all (mild for people who like heat, moderate for heatphobes). But it has some of that sweet/sour fermented funkiness that gochujang brings.

While I still bemoan the generic offerings and would never touch their gyoza again, I feel they've earned a bump-up from 3 to 4 stars.

Are you searching for the islands here in the middle of sagebrush rangeland? Well drive almost as far as the Owyhees and discover a little lunch/dinner counter next to an Arctic Circle and dream on. If you have trouble finding this place, not that it's now called "Ohana", not Kana Girl's. Must be new owners or management.

It's not worth going out of your way to get here, but if you go to high school nearby, I bet this place is a mecca for off campus lunchers.

After a loooooong wait of island time, we got Styrofoam containers with huge portions of mixed plate of pork, beef, chicken and Yaki soba. Three people could probably split the mixed plate. All meats were excellent without any condiments. If you want a little sassy sauce, try a little Red head temper hot sauce or Kickin wowsabi (mayo w/ horse radish). 

I'd pass on the mayo salad with a little macaroni in it. Fat with a little starch is not good for your tongue or the rest of your body.

I'm disappointed to be giving such a low grade to a fairly cheap meal with nice staff, however my latest experience really soured me to this place. I found one of those yellow and black pill bugs in my noodles yesterday. I assume that it must have been in the cilantro leaves I put in my bowl. I asked for a discount on the meal since I hadn't been able to finish and received about 7 apologies but only 20% off. The staff was very sorry about it but I'm disappointed I didn't get more of a discount for something that would have resulted in a failed health code rating.

The food here isnt anything special. My wife and I have been here twice both times she had gotton sick. The only good thing i could say about this place is the bartenders make good drinks and the service is good. Other then that i cant say i will be back unless its for a drink.

Visiting from California with family and we ate here. It was a great experience. Danielle was an amazing server! She was funny and gave us excellence service. The food was amazing! I wish we had a Ling and Louie's in California!
Louie's is the dopest! Their food kills it every time. My favorite spot for Italian food. Their food is unbelievably cheap for being as good as it is.

No strong feelings. It was fine. Appetizers were good, lettuce wraps and dumplings. They say the beef entrees are made with filet mignon, which I believe, BUT the meat portion was very skimpy in proportion to the noodles and vegetables. Like 4 or 5 small cubes. I had Kung Pow and it was not very spicy. Tasted fine, just, meh.

I have been looking for a good place for a pedicure in the Eagle area for some time and have been pretty much disappointed in the services offered (or the prices charged for same).  I have been spoiled by the outstanding services provided by a Happy Nails in southern California. Anyway, I drive by this place a lot so I decided to give it a shot. I called for an appointment and they told me I could come in right away. I did so and was very pleased with the service provided by Kelly.  My feet were not in shall we say pristine condition and she was great and didn't complain a bit about how hard she had to work to get them into better condition.  She was very pleasant and made my stay there most enjoyable.  The facilities are excellent; much, much better than what I found at the Two Rivers Spa (with very uncomfortable seating and overpriced).  

My only complaint about Envy Nails is that when I went to pay, the woman at the counter basically insisted on me paying cash.  I offered to pay by credit card but she was not to be deterred.  She even told me there was a nearby ATM machine if I needed cash.  I thought that was a little cheeky and I would have preferred being told that they don't take  credit cards before going in.  My guess is that if I had truly insisted paying by credit card they would have relented but I didn't want to make a huge deal about it.  Just be alert to this little "detail" if you go in there.  

All in all, I recommend this establishment.
Absolutely horrible. The worst Pho that I've ever had in my life. The broth tasted like vinegar. Way too many noodles. Stay clear!!! I'll never return.

I really like coming here! They are always so friendly, helpful, and CLEAN! The staff are usually busy making sure everything stays as fresh and warm/cold as they can. Their soups are pretty great! Food is nothing to rave about, if you want great food, I wouldn't choose a buffet to begin with...

Alright, since I started working in a nearby building, I was dying to try this place out. 

Win: I was greeted immediately after walking in the door. I ordered the Bulgogi. 
Miss: The cashier, obviously new, had no idea what it was so I translated: "Korean Beef". 
Win: She was sweet and efficient. 
Miss: The cashier forgot to send my order to the "kitchen" and noticed her mistake about 5 minutes later. No biggie.
Win: They apologized and sent me a tray of free potstickers (which were delicious).
Win: The Bulgogi was GREAT! Not what I had in Korea, but damn good. On par with what I would get in the Bay Area of CA.

Overall, this place is great. Quick, cheap, tasty, and really friendly. I'll be back often.
Worse pedicure I have ever had. Polish was on my skin!!! Nails weren't buffed before polished either. The polish had two coats but looked like one. Very disappointed. Won't go back.

I came here again on Friday and had to write an updated review. I am upgrading from four to five stars because the service and quality are so consistently fantastic.

I came in close to the end of happy hour on Friday. I was a little worried that we might miss out on the agreeable prices because we were so close to the end of happy hour. I should not have worried, however. Our server was at the table within a minute or two of sitting down and was able to get our happy hour orders in to the kitchen with time to spare. The rest of the evening, our server was attentive without being overly so (i.e. asking us questions halfway through our first bite of food). I really appreciate good service and, for a pretty casual place, the service here is incredible.

The food continues to be of high quality and full of flavor. My table ordered calamari and a spicy tuna roll as appetizers. The calamari was great, as usual. The spicy tuna roll had terrific quality fish, a pretty good kick to it, and an unconventional twist; asparagus. At first I was hesitant about asparagus in that roll, thinking it would be overpowering and way too crunchy. I was pleasantly surprised to find that it was neither. It was steamed (or cooked somehow) to perfection; tender with a very slight snap, no mushiness at all.

I ordered the Seafood Hotpot which I highly recommend to people who like the combination of creamy, spicy, and seafood. This dish was loaded with seafood (something like 8 mussels, 5 scallops, and a bunch of shrimp and salmon) and had a really nice smokiness to it. I ordered it with brown rice, and it was just perfect.

My only complaint is that I filled up on the appetizers and couldn't eat more of my dinner. Really, that's the best kind of problem to have since it meant I was able to enjoy the remainder of my hotpot for lunch the following day. 

Service: A
Food: A

We stayed here driving through town. We picked this hotel for a few reasons:

Large, free breakfast - there we so many options that I was overwhelmed as to what I wanted. They had delicious cinnamon rolls and pancakes!

We had our dog with us and they are pet-friendly!

Our room was large, quiet and the bed was very comfortable.

This hotel is a bit out of the way but an easy drive into downtown Boise and worth it to pay less than some of the pricier hotels downtown.

A very fast check in on thanksgiving day just before 3pm and the associate was extremely friendly. He offered me a military discount that reduced my rate by A LOT on a day I didn't expect to check in.

A pool, gym, mini library, and breakfast in the morning. It was perfect for my quick overnight stay. The room was clean, and spacious enough with a sofa, and dining table for two. There was also a Keurig with k cups and bath and body works product in case you forget hygiene items. 

Checkout the next morning was equally simple and fast. The young lady was so friendly, if I'm ever back in the area, I'll definitely come back to this location.

I came here all the way from SoCal on a trip visiting Boise, Idaho for the first time. My family and I decided to go in here because it was really hot. I wanted to try the Italian soda that they had here and I wasn't disappointed. I got the peach-flavored Italian soda and it had everything that I wanted. It was the perfect amount of sweet and really refreshing. I needed that boost, especially after walking around shopping when it was 100 degrees outside. Also they gave me a tiny chocolate espresso bean which was yummy. I will definitely be coming back.

One of my favorite places in the valley! Very friendly knowledgeable staff. Went at dinner time and only had a 15 min wait and then the food came out quick. I had the Drunken with tofo from the Wok section of the menu and it was superb! Also addicted the their edamame! Price wise is great... got 2 alcoholic drinks, 2 apps, and two dinner for $56 before tip! Def a must try!!!

Limited on delivery options in Meridian. Decided to give Quik Wok a try one last time...never again. Food came 30 minutes late on a Tuesday night. (as opposed to a busy weekend) When I called to ask where our order was, the guy who answered said "we're not busy, it left 7 minutes ago" This was an hour and 15 minutes after it was ordered and paid for online...when it finally arrived, had to nuke it to heat it up.

Food is good, price is right.  The seating situation is a little confusing. . .With seat yourself, someone from your party has to continually roam the restaurant looking for a place to sit and someone else has to "guard" your place in line.  Not as clean as a restaurant should be.  Bathrooms are particularly scuzzy.

Good food, even better atmosphere. I've been going here for 15+ years and have a great experience every time I go. If you go for breakfast say hey to the old timers and become a regular! You won't regret it

I've thought about trying Ling and Louies for a while, but have just now gotten to it.  They specialize in wok cooked asian-fusion so i decided to try an option cooked from the wok.  I forget the name, but my dish had stir fried asparagus and mushrooms with your choice of protein, chicken, beef, shrimp, or scallops.  I opted for beef.  It comes with rice or noodles but I was able to substitute extra veggies for $2.00, to keep it low carb.  The meat and veggies were cooked in a spicy red chili sauce.  It was well seasoned and the wok cooking added nice almost grilled flavor.  Portion size was adequate.  The service was great...our drinks never went empty and the meals came out promptly.  Service was quick, but not rushed feeling.  Prices are a tad higher than a traditional Chinese restaurant but still reasonable.  Overall a very good experience.

Good customer service! The people here were helpful and genuinely nice. The food was horrible tho..it was dry and didn't have much taste. I would have liked a slightly bigger serving but for the price I paid (I shared the 2 for $25 with my hubbs).. I gave it 2 stars because I ordered thru the car side service and waited forever until I tried the door and found it locked. I walked around to the front where I was given my food which wouldn't have been bad except I had my 3 kids in the car and had to take all 3 in with me as there wasn't an adult in the car to watch them. All in all I wouldn't recommend this place
It was my first time checking this place out as it just recently opened up. I loved their latte that I ordered. And super friendly staff :) I loved this place! Will be coming back again sometime.
I took my daughter in for a pedicure and it was so relaxing! They even do a hot stone massage with it! Very nice and clean place. Reasonably priced. I'll definitely be back!

I just ordered from here tonight. I ordered online which was very convenient and easy to use. They delivered my food in 25 minutes and the expected wait time according to the website was an hour. The food was hot and was priced reasonably. The flavors were a little bit different than I am used to from other chinese restaurants. But really where ever you go, not just chinese, the flavors will taste different at any restaurant because each restaurant makes it different. So I'm not sure why everyone is complaining about them on here because I was very happy overall and will return or order again!

Just opened like 15 minutes before we got there and the quality is amazing. We've been to other sonics and the screw up the candy slushies this one actually had candy through the whole cup. We drove by and realized it was actually open so we pulled in and the drive though was actually fast. Hopefully they keep this up!
Came here with the family and pleasant lly surprised at the flavors if the general chicken.   We will Def come back here.

Dishonest business practices.  Their billing department is a subcontracted company that has no authority in helping with the issue, and when you try to contact the out of state member services you get lost in an automated system that offers no help.  Be warned, if you sign up, good luck getting them to stop billing you.
