Awesome night here!!! (: The waitress Jamie D was amazing, and made our experience that much better. She was very nice and went above and beyond for everything. Always made sure our drinks were filled, and that my families every expectation was met, but they were exceeded! 
Thank you Jamie we will be back!

I love this location! There are so many fun and unique selection. This is a great place to buy a gift for anyone. The staff is super helpful and helped me sign up for discounts on my phone to get a better deal on our patio furniture. Excellent customer service!

Saw this place while driving down Meridian road. Went for breakfast and the food was great. The chicken fried steak and eggs are very good and my wife said the French toast was delicious. The service was excellent and the decor feels fun with all the pictures on the walls. The prices are very reasonable. Highly recommend this diner

I almost always need help finding what I'm looking for because there are so many different areas in this store, but I have never once been asked if I need help.  Today I was in to spend $60-$120 on basketball shoes, but with no help, I left the store empty handed.  I guess they don't need my business.

The Salon is nice and new, but the quality is lacking.  I felt like they were trying to up sell.  My nails need to be re- done after 3 days, and for the price the quality should be better.

I wish I would have read the "filtered reviews" before going to this salon, Yelp seems to filter negative reviews of this salon.

Gotta try their coffee vanilla smoothie! The smoothie isn't blended on site, but instead comes out of a soft serve machine. Probably explains why it was extremely smooth and creamy, but I appreciated the fact that it had real coffee and not just artificial coffee flavor it in it.

There are those times when you need a pedicure, right now.  Not in an hour, like right now.  And you need it done correctly, in a clean and professional environment.  This place is your answer!

I'm a sucker for a good pedicure, I will be back!  No deceptive hidden fees, modern decor, nice massage chairs!  Friendly staff who listened to my preferences!
Great people and food just right combination of spices and rich sauce makes you crave more.
Sometimes you can find quality stuff here, I always look here first for dance shoes, winter coats etc and you can find nice stuff but for the most part the clothes and shoes are extremely worn!

They are extremely over priced, i didn't like the way the polish looked so i went back the next day, they were trying to charge me $18 but at first told me come back tomorrow they have no time
For me today once i said i was leaving town they got a lady and she said 18 dollars. I can give you better places to go that would accomadate if you didn't like what they did!!! This guy Vu right off the free way off meridian exit behind jimmy johns does way better work and only charges 15 to 20 dollars!!! These people will talk about you in their different language and do not accommodate. I may pursue this further it is ridiculous

If you're looking for a light and healthy lunch, this place is for you.

Many different lettuce options and endless salad toppings and dressings. Every time I've been here things have been pretty fresh. My favorite soup they have is the tomato basil and it is 70-80 calories per serving!

They also offer a few bread options, spaghetti, baked potatoes, pizza and mac and cheese so it is also kid friendly. For dessert they offer a sundae bar.

The manager here is super nice and attentive to the guests. Definitely a nice family place.
Good "home style" breakfast. Staff very friendly and attentive. Will definitely come back.

Went for lunch and felt like having sushi, I realize this isn't the usual place you would go for sushi but it sounded good at the time. My girlfriend is new to sushi so we decided to give it a shot. Our mistake as they have many other items we have had before that are far better! The sushi roll was super small and thin, and the shrimp tempura roll just fell apart since it wasn't wrapped tight enough. You can get better spicy tuna rolls at Fred Meyer! So our bad for even ordering sushi here but was at least hoping for something decent. We sat in the bar area and the service was above and beyond, as usual! Chris took excellent care of us and made the visit more enjoyable.

Made an appointment Friday afternoon for sat morning. Arrived on sat and waited while others walked in after me and were helped. Seems they may have not wrote down my appointment or they just over book. Either way it's unprofessional. The salon was run down looking and dirty.  Went to another clean salon and was helped right away.
Great service and good tasting food. Been to this place for lunch a number of times. Liked the flavors and the freshness of the vegetables in the dishes.

This restaurant caught my eye as I was driving out to Nampa. The restaurant boasts authentic Hawaiian food so I grabbed my Hawaiian co-worker and hit it for lunch.

I ordered the poké for an appetizer. It was amazing. I followed it up with the Lau Lau. It was pretty good but I know nothing about Lau Lau. My Hawaiian co-worker said it was pretty decent. 

Unfortunately, the entire restaurant was being managed by the chef. The waitress/ cash register girl had a meeting with her parole officer so the place was nuts. One of the customers started running the cash register and got things going but service was very slow.

We had mixed reviews from the group. Overall I was very pleased with my meal.

This was our first time eating here and we really enjoyed our dinner.  We were a group of 8.  My wife and I ordered the Family Style Meals menu.  We both ordered our Raviloi, Chicken Marsala and it came with a family style pizza.

The Raviloi and Chicken Marsala was great.  The family pizza was delicious.  The restaurant was very clean and the restaurant is very family friendly.  It appeared to resemble something you would definitely see in Italy or Mediterranean Sea area.

I enjoyed the sports bar area.  The sport illustrate magazines were cool to see.  The only issue we had was our granddaughter meal was delivered midway through our meal.  I think the waitress skipped her order.  It eventually came.  Better late the never I guess.

I've used Kris a few times now for spray tans (before my bachelorette party, vacations, etc.).  She always does a great job and the tan looks so nice and natural!!  She comes right to your house and it just doesn't get any easier than that.  She is very down to earth and easygoing, which makes me feel relaxed and comfortable.  She does a great job and I highly recommend her!!

Nice to see an additional Big Juds location, now in Meridian.  It was always a bit of an expedition all the way to east Boise for one of their outstanding burgers.  The tradition of excellence is carried off at this new location without skipping a beat. Modern, clean and comfortable with outstanding service. And it goes without saying, if you arrive at traditional lunch or dinner times, there will be a wait.  The two best burgers in the Treasure Valley are located in Meridian now. And Big Juds is one of them.
Best Local Pho!!! We eat here almost every week. The flavor is consistent, and portions are perfect (large) I recommend this place to everyone!

Food was delicious, I had the level 3 generals chicken. So good! Employees were super friendly and helpful. I was probably being complete pain in the butt, and they didn't seem to mind one bit. I'll definitely be back. Side note: my friend had the ninja chicken and it was also amazing!

I came here for the first time to study. It is a super cute place with outlets to charge your phone, free WiFi, and nice soft music (nothing loud and crazy thank goodness). I ordered a mint mocha which was so yummy! I definitely will be visiting here again.

I booked three nights with hotels.com without a problem.  The problem started when I want to stay extra night.  I booked a room for a extra  night with the hotel instead of hotels.com .  I was charge for two nights.  When I saw the charge on my debit card I asked them to remove the extra night.  The next morning I checked out and asked for a receipt.  The front desk didn't want to give me a receipt but  eventually did .  The hotel still charged  me for 2 nights  even with my receipt says they only charge me for one .   I tried to get the hotel to correct it on three separate occasions .  They admit they made a mistake but have yet to credit My debit card.   I will never stay the holiday in express again  !

This place is pretty good the pho only comes in one size which is typical for the state the pricing is good the people are very nice they have ingredients on the table which I like I gave 3 stars for the extremely long wait time we waited 35 min today so if your wanting to come on your lunch break I wouldn't recommend it I've eaten here three times now and it has been a long wait every time

It gets 3 stars because of the sweet potato waffle fries. They were extremely good. I had the bacon cheese burger and I would give it a 2.5.  The bacon cheese burger is simple enough that you should be able to get a good idea of the overall quality of the burger. Compared to a place like the Habit, the meat was sub par and overall it wasn't all that great. I want to be able to taste the meat, it is a burger after all. The bun is big and the meat patty wasn't all that thick so it basically over powered the burger. The bacon was very good but that was about it. For $13 (with tip), I left feeling disappointed. The service was very good by the way.

Enjoyed lunch last week, thanks to a sharp waiter named Hugh, attentive service and his refreshing off-the-menu cucumber and mint water, which compensated for the small lunch portion of pad Thai. However, yesterday's return visit was a disaster. All three entrees were lukewarm and the service (by a waitress with x-rated micro short shorts) was nowhere close to warm and friendly. We would have complained but the waitress was dealing with the complaints from the booth behind us.
Add dead flies on the windowsill, dusty shutters, and slooooooow delivery of our meals and we agreed as we departed: never again.
Can it be that P.F. Changs is the best Asian in Boise?

Leif just did our family's Christmas photos and the whole experience from start to finish was fabulous! There were a few challenges we were dealing with:
a. my children are 2 and 4 so getting them to sit still and look the same way it pretty much a job on its own and 
b. I wanted to do the shoot inside my kitchen which means lighting is kind of an issue
Leif handled it like a pro! He captured so many amazing pictures of our family. And the images have such a beautiful glow to them. His use of equipment is so skilled. He captures pictures like you would see in a magazine. Brilliant!!
It seemed to be mostly stir fry / wok type entrees on the menu. There is also sushi, which was only ok. I agree with other Yelpers - this is  an Applebee's type American Asian fusion place.

Great food at family friendly prices.  They also have boba teas. 

Try the spicy chicken teriyaki. Don't let the name fool you its not that hot.

I've recently moved here from So. Cal. Orange County, to be precise. Home of Little Saigon, with the most Vietnamese (and Vietnamese restaurants) in the US. A Pho spot on every corner. So when I say that Pho 779 is the real deal, I know what I'm talking about. 

The banh mi sandwiches are really good. My suggestion is the combo of grilled pork and pork roll, sliced thin and sort of like ham without the saltiness. Chock full of tasty meat, picked daikon and carrot, cilantro and jalapeño on a really crusty but light baguette, it's the perfect lunch.

Really good pho, the broth is tasty and filled with your choice of meats (or chicken too), noodles and onions. A plate comes alongside to add fresh sliced jalapeño, bean sprouts, cilantro and fresh basil. Meal in a bowl!

If you like spicy, you'll love the Bun Bo Hue. Really! Just seeing the rich, fiery red broth, you know what's coming. The soup, pork-based as opposed to beef-based like pho, is rick. The noodles are thick and chewy, with a nice bite. Nice pieces of meat and other goodies float in the broth. The side plate of fresh bean sprouts, basil and jalapeño is great for adding more flavor and texture. This is a Happy Meal in a bowl for spicy food fans.

The spring rolls are good, with a nice peanut dipping sauce. 

Service is good, you order at the counter and they bring the food to the table. For those who complain about service being slow, the food is made fresh and it takes a few minutes. In other words, chill!

Overall, I really liked the food. They are doing the food right. Check it out....you'll enjoy it
I just rented a 10x10 it measures 9.11x 9x4 just sayin... helpful staff and clean with good freeway access.  I will be out of state so service going forward is unknown at this point.

This place is what it is - a solid "American" Italian pizza / pasta place.  Standard huge menu, mostly Alfredo sauce based, nothing really all that inspired or traditionally Italian about anything.  I ordered a Negroni, and they had no idea what that was.  Had to look it up and show them.  Why the four stars then?  Two things - no false advertising, and absolutely outstanding service. 

About the food.  They aren't billing themselves as an artisanal, traditional, blessed by the Dali Lama organic, etc. type of place.  You walk in, think "this is what most of America thinks Italian food is", and that's that.  I was hosting a going away party for my boss here, so were ordered a few fried apps to start.  They were fried perfectly, the calamari (while certainly frozen) wasn't freezer burned, they hand-breaded the fried zucchini, and the fried ravioli was decent.  Everyone loved it all.  

For my entree, I ordered the house-smoked salmon over linguine.  Alfredo sauce over everything.  The salmon was actually pretty damn good, and the pasta was, well, it's defining quality was that it was warm and covered with Alfredo.

Service.  Back to the Negroni.  I gave Sean, our server, some crap about not knowing what a Negroni was, him working in an Italian restaurant and all.  Rather than copping an attitude, he brought me their best attempt, and said "this is on us, if you like it, we'll make you another". It wasn't the best I had, but again, he wasn't selling me a story that this was a 'hand crafted' piece of art.  They were being honest about it.

He also knew exactly how the house smoked salmon was made (wet cured, hot smoked) which shows they train the servers right at Louie's.  On top of that, he was just one of those guys that made everyone feel comfortable and made sure we were having a good time.  

At the end, while he could have done the whole "gratuity included" thing because our party was large enough (I asked, because I didn't see the fine print on the receipt) he said "I don't work like that".  Power move, and more reason for me to come back.  

Some places you'd go to eat even if there were complete a-holes serving you because the food is that good.  Some places you'd go back to because you know you're going to feel welcome, have a great time with your friends, and feel like family.  Louie's is the latter.  I'll be back.

AVOID THE SELF CHECK OUT!!!
The self checkout scanners do not scan gift cards easily (customer service even admitted it) and the machine freezes if you enter more than a single bill (cash).  The woman working the self checkout said that she can't enter gift cards manually by the card number (even though customer service said you can).  Overall they have very under-trained staff.
The Buddhas feast was ok - nothing really special.  Meat was a bit chewy for "filet mignon".  Husband had Drunken with chicken which tasted great.  Will have that next time and skip the beef.

I would like to give these guys a better rating but the morning crew (11:00ish)almost always gives me my Diet Coke without the limes being squeezed. When I order lime in my drink I want it squeezed or you cannot taste it and I pay extra for it. So I have to dig them out with my fingers and squeeze them myself. It ends up all over my car and me. Lazy morning crew. All the other crews are great.

This store was so busy on my recent visit.. at least 5 people in line.. phones ringing and regular customers trying to talk to the clerk, Andrea. It was my first time in there and I needed a laptop and misc items packed and shipped. Andrea handled everyone and everything so quickly and with complete organization, professionalism and most importantly, with friendliness!!  Great store, great employee.. Keep her around!

Ordered 2 M&M blasts and 1 peanut butter cup blast. They mixed them up and put M&Ms on top of the peanut one. I'm allergic to peanuts! I got a few bites in before I realized it. Now my tongue is tingling and my lip is swollen! this location NEVER gets the orders rights. I once ordered a diet Dr Pepper and got sweet ice tea! They need some serious training and maybe some people who actually care. Won't be going to this location anymore.
I would give zero as is hard to review a place that isn't open when it says it will be. Disappointing to say the least.

Food was very average. Ordered the teriyaki chicken and BBQ beef. Both were dry and bland. Maybe the food truck has better fare. Probably won't be back unless we need a quick bite to eat and there aren't other options. I was looking forward to creative food truck cuisine, but ended up with boring mall food court food instead.

Husband and I went there for our anniversary yesterday. There was no wait time for a table as there was only one other table being used in the entire restaurant. I thought this would be a good thing, because the food would arrive quickly. I was wrong on that one. The food takes a while to get there, much longer than it should since the other table had their food. The chefs were literally only cooking for our table. We ordered a mozzarella cheese stick appetizer and a family style dinner. The salad is an iceberg salad mix with extra grated carrots. The cheese sticks were good, but it took awhile to get both the salad and cheese sticks. The entrees we choose were lasagna, and manicotti. The lasagna was burned. I'm wondering if the reason it took so long is they forgot about it in the oven.I must have gotten the edge of the pan, but it also had no sauce and a lot of sausage. The pizza that comes with it, has a lot of sausage as well. The sausage is well ground and burned. I thought it was bacon bits at first. The manicotti was the best part. It was rubbery, but at least not burned. The meal costs $15.50 per person. It wasn't worth it for the quality of food. I need to preface this with my husband doesn't complain about the food of a restaurant. We just never go back, so I am unsure if they would have fixed this. The waitress didn't ask if we liked the food, otherwise I wouldn't have been able to help but say something. So I will never know if they would have offered a different choice or to redo the meal. I was surprised that she didn't ask me whether or not I liked it as the entire meal went untouched except for a few bites of each entree.There are so many other excellent Italian restaurants to go to in this area. I would choose one of those first.

This place is negative stars and so happy it will be closing.. We waited to have our order taken 20 minutes, and then another person came. The employee skipped me and went to the people who came after me. I asked the employee why she took their order since I have been waiting 20 minutes. She was almost crying telling me that she is alone and can't handle the pressure. Five minutes later she started yelling at all the customers saying the credit card reader is broken and she can't take any orders. We all knew it was BS since she had just finished charging a customer.

This place is to be avoided at all costs. There are so many great burger spots in the Treasure Valley and this is not one of them.

I began searching for a photographer for a photo shoot idea I had for my salon... I came across Leif's style of photos & I knew right away it was what 
I was looking for! Super creative and great colors. I was setting up a fashion forward shoot with models and Leif had never shot models before but I totally trusted that he would be able to capture the look and that he did!! I was so pleases with the photos that I am scheduling my next session with him and I know the end result will be Amazing!! I love that he is not a typical t-shirt and jeans beach photo taker!! LOL:) But creates a unique setting and shot that is perfect to capture your personality.

The food wasn't terrible, but wasn't great either. I had steak pho which tasted ok, but they skimped on toppings and the basil was so wilted is was barely recognizable and the bean sprouts were slimy. The service was seriously lacking. I never once was asked if I wanted water or anything else to drink, and I had to ask twice just to get a fork. Then they forgot to put in my appetizer order so I waited 40 minutes for spring rolls, which came long after my entree. I won't be going back.

Dr. Eaton was very professional in the manner in which he administered to my family.   The staff, was friendly and I was surprised to find an atmosphere that was professional yet healthy In Spirit and mind.  

I almost felt like I was part of the Dr. Eaton family.

Disclaimer: this review is regarding their happy hour only.

The happy hour, for some odd reason, has become a lost art. Rarely do I find a place that does both drink and appetizer specials, but maybe I'm eating at the wrong places. Barbacoa does an amazing drink special (BOGO), but their food is still pretty expensive, making this a rare treat for us. Cafe Ole does drink (BOGO) and food specials, but I'm not a big fan of their food.

Now, I've put off eating at L&L's because of sooooo many negative reviews. I still haven't tried their entrees, but their happy hour had me so stoked and satisfied. To be clear, the specials aren't that amazing. $1 off draft beers and slightly cheaper appetizers, but something happens psychologically that makes this seem like such an outstanding deal when everything, including sushi, is discounted. They had Kirin Ichiban on tap, which is awesome (as most Japanese imports are skunky in the bottle). Their draft beer menu could have been more extensive, but it's not that kind of a place.

To eat, we tried every type of sushi roll on the HH menu, as well as the lettuce wraps, calamari and edamame. In my opinion, edamame is never worth talking about; it was edamame. Period. The lettuce wraps were totally solid and reminiscent of P.F. Chang's (although I've only eaten there once, so I'm no expert). They were exactly what you'd expect; the filling was meaty, salty and a little sweet... and you dish that out in pieces of iceberg. The calamari was the star of the show. It had not only the rings, but the little clusters of tentacles that so many restaurants leave out, but we enjoy. They are tossed in a sweet and slightly spicy sauce, placed on a bed of (very mild, not overly mayonnaise-y) coleslaw for crunch, and include a spicy (sriracha?) mayo dipping sauce. It was perfect, especially with bites of the crunchy slaw.

The sushi was all just decent. Nothing blew me away, but I was happy to be eating sushi that didn't suck. If I had to choose a favorite, it was probably the crab crunch of tempura shrimp. If I had to choose a least favorite, it was probably the boston.

So, for what probably reads like a three-star review, we were totally super happy, enjoyed our HH experience and will definitely return.

What a cute coffee shop. This shop has two other little restaurants in the same building. Which makes it a really fun environment. The seating is really neat and the huge fireplace is inviting and makes for a great place to visit or even read. Michaela and Kristen helped us and were wonderful and very friendly. My coffee was delicious. This coffee shop is a must when visiting the village. Warm drink = Warm thoughts.

I'm giving this place three stars because the food is just ok.  The service was excellent and fast, but I felt everything was just too sweet.  I got the drunken chicken and it had fried chicken pieces, which I was expecting non deep fried since it was a "wok" piece, i should have asked.  I got the fried rice but couldn't tell it was fried rice because there was so much sweet sauce on the dish there was no distinct flavor difference in the rice and the rest of the dish, which was disappointing.  The pot stickers were good, I wish the sauce was more acidic and less sugary.

This is a pretty good place. I was torn how to rate it. I think 5 stars i just not enough. My rating for the Sunrise would be somewhere in between 3, which is Ok and 4, which is Im a fan. 

So would that make my rating  "Im an Ok fan?"

I have been here about a dozen times over the last few months. I try to not write a review based on just 1 or 2 visits. Any place can have an off day. God knows I do . :)

I think the 1st thing to note is the place itself. The decor leaves a lot to be desired. It is small and rather dingy. It reminds me a little of a truck stop diner.

The seating here is Seat Yourself. I am not sure if I am a fan of this sort of seating. Very few places do this. Though it seems that of the ones that do, they are mostly breakfast houses. 

If you come late for breakfast on a Saturday or Sunday, you might not be able to find a table. Its usually pretty crowded.

The food here is good. The bacon is always crisp. The hash browns are crisp. The pancakes and light and good. The eggs are usually good. My only real complaint with the food is that when they are busy, it might not be as hot as it should be.

My other objection is one that is common to pretty much every breakfast place that I have been too. When I get scrambled eggs, they are cooked like its an omelet, then at the last minute, they are cut up to resemble scrambled eggs. 

I have not had anything bad here yet. The service is good. Sometimes they get a bit slow, but this is due to them being so very busy.

I do recommend this place. I just wish they would get a makeover.

Waitresses are always rude and place isn't very clean. I once had old lipstick on a cup and when I informed the waitress she was rude instead of apologetic. Food is good but not worth the poor service.
Great food and service!!! Will definitely be coming back!!! I know some other people are complaining about wait time but we waited only about 10 minutes.
Best nail salon in Meridian! Ask for Daniel or Vince. Thorough, gentle, personable. Love this place!!!

Classic greasy spoon locals diner open for breakfast and lunch.  Several locations throughout the Treasure Valley. I think this is the best one. There's one 10 minutes from my house but I'm willing to double my drive time if I'm feeling like a stick-to-your-ribs diner breakfast. 

Practically every breakfast food you can dream of is on their menu. Decent lunch menu offerings, too, but I can't recall ever ordering lunch here regardless of what time I was in. Service is spotty at times, but they've always been friendly in my experience. Yes, it's a little dirty and outdated, as are the others I've been to. But that's part of being a greasy spoon diner, I guess.  Sunrise has been around for as long as I can remember, and that's saying a lot for a restaurant in our area.

Big Jud's..  New location! And I have great news.. Food seems to be as good as the other location downtown! Unbelievable burgers fries!  I think they have the worlds best tots! Just sayin..  Not sure about the vide in this new location.  Kind of sterile and blah.  But it just opened so maybe they will change it up a bit. Just needs something.. ( doesn't feel like a good ol burger joint).  But with that said its all about the food! And it's AWESOME!

Went for dinner on my Birthday, and it was about what I expected. PF Changs type of atmosphere, but I think the prices may be slightly better here.

We started with the Ahi Tuna lettuce wraps, and they were great. Wife had Honey Almond shrimp that she thought was fabulous, and I had the New Wave Pad Thai which was also very good.

A couple of negatives I have is the dessert, which was a chocolate lava cake and not very good. It was rich but not sweet, kinda strange. The other was the service, our waitress disappeared for a loooong time. I was about to give up on her and flag someone else down to bring us our ticket. I hope next time that doesn't happen again.

Overall we will definitely be back, as that is my wife's new favorite dish.

I stopped by for happy hour on a Saturday to try their mojitos and snack on something. I had their signature mojito on menu which tasted like they had zero alcohol. I had two in a short amount of time, still no trace of alcohol. I love potstickers so it's had to get that wrong for me but I didn't enjoy them here. The filling was dry, almost like they had thawed and been frozen again. With so many great options in the area... it's safe to say I won't be back.
Best nail spa that I've been to in the Treasure Valley! Very clean, pleasantly relaxing and great service!
Do not order or go to this restaurant. The food tastes awful and we do not recommend it at all. We ordered quite a few options and everything was awful.
A little pricey but the food was really good. You have to try the crab wontons appetizer it was probably my favorite thing!

So strange. About 2 years ago we decided we didn't care for this restaurant however as time goes by you think your going to give it another chance. 

Overall the quality and the ambiance of this restaurant is fantastic.The wife and I visited about 2 weeks ago and the service was amazing, The food was amazing, and we left thinking about future family visits to the restaurant.  (Spaghetti and Bolognese, and I can't remember what the wife ordered)

Then in Wednesday we brought our grand kids for the children's specials.
So disappointing. The kids ordered chicken strips and curly fries. My Fettuccine Alfredo was good and when finished I tasted one of the kids meals (4 and 9 yrs old). I was thunderstruck! The chicken was over fried just short of burning and dry as a desert, Then I tasted the fries, you can tell when second rate potatoes are used, there is an unpleasant aftertaste almost like they weren't cooked thru.  I couldn't believe the restaurant would serve this to children except that someone in the kitchen probably thought kids wouldn't know the difference.

The last issue was with the waitress. To young, seemed to be more interested in herself, said she would not want kids. etc. etc., in front of the kids !

I don't think my wife will allow us to recommend to anyone after this experience.

Overall our experience over the last couple of years is that inconsistency of service and food is this restaurants downfall.

Good Luck!

I havent been able to find any other place to cut my hair in this area that does an allright job. I tried to find a barber in this area that does military cuts and havent found one yet. I dont understand why fading is so difficult to find in texas. Of course if im close to a military base there is no problem. As soon as you get into these city's outskirts no one can fade. I was happy to find a place that i can atleast get my hair lowered. This location is not always great i have been in here when its busy and they tend to grind out the customer but sometimes that effects your haircut. The barbers are varied, some have little experience and others have a ton. If you have the time choose your barber i suggest it. If not be clear on what type of haircut you want. Good luck

I need to offer a new review. Sometime later they got the Sunday thing figured out and this became our defs to favorite restaurant. Fabulous staff who anticipated our needs and over time we just loved coming here. Awesome food.

This is a great little wine shop. Enjoy a glass or two of wine, or pick up several bottles of whatever floats your boat. They even have a decent beer selection. Customer service is great, and it's just a great place to stop by and enjoy a glass.

So as I mentioned in a previous review, the "all you can eat" buffet is a guilty pleasure.  We try to fight it, we try to deny it, but every now and then it is just irresistible.  It can be even more irresistible when we are tricked into thinking it is more healthy than the usual buffet.  Enter Souper Salad.  You won't find piles of fried chicken and french fries here.  Instead they focus almost solely on................. soups and salads, as the name would imply.  But does that mean you'll walk away feeling any better about yourself afterwards?  More than likely not.  The bottom line is Souper Salad pretty much fails to impress.

It does live up to its namesake well enough, but the offerings are distinctly bland and unimpressive.  In terms of salad, you have a selection of greens to build on, along with a wide variety of toppings and dressings.  In addition they have a selection of other cold salads like potato salad, pasta salad, seafood salad, etc.  It is an impressive selection but................... it really isn't any wider or better than the salad bars at any other conventional buffet restaurant like Golden Corral or Chuck-A-Rama.  They also offer special seasonal salads that rotate, but again, so do other buffets.  For a restaurant that wants to focus solely on salads as its focus, I would expect something more impressive in this regard and it just.............. isn't.

In addition to the salads they do offer pizza, pasta, and baked potatoes.  And for an additional fee, you can get grilled chicken to add to your salad.  Once again this is no different than what a larger buffet can offer you, and without the added cost for the "extra" protein.  The food itself simply isn't that good.  I was not impressed with any of the hot food at all.  The soups, pasta, etc. were all decidedly bland.  Again I understand that a buffet is never going to offer the highest quality food no matter what, but basic seasoning is somewhat fundamental and to me it is a reasonable expectation at even the simplest of restaurants.  

The bottom line is that there isn't anything that Souper Salad does that another full-service buffet doesn't do better.  The only reason I can think of to go to Souper Salad specifically would be if ALL you want is a ton of salad and don't want to be "tempted" by the broader options at other buffets.  But even if that is the case, if it is salad that you are really craving... I would say go to a quick service deli or casual restaurant that could prepare one of much higher quality than Souper Salad could give you.  Overall this place is just very hard to recommend.

Loving us some Ling & Louie's.   A good place for lunch  and a very good menu (I recommend the meatloaf sliders).  There lunch specials are priced right and offer a great variety.    Took a few months after opening to work out the bugs but the manager has been very proactive too ensure people come back and that simply means they care and want to grow their business.

Waited long time for food. Waited over 30 minutes for dinner past salad. While watching 4 people standing doing nothing. Waited again for check to be picked up paid cash because I was not going to give my real name.

Not returning to the restaurant

Terrible service. I ordered a thai mai and the thing tasted like inhaling e cigarette juice. Totally syrupy and disgusting. Didn't drink any of it and sat it on the edge of the table for them to take away, which they would never acknowledge and never did. Never even refilled my water even though I had a completely empty glass. Food was subpar at best. Don't go here.
Excellent value, selection and sauces.  Everything was very fresh with good presentation.   The staff was attentive and friendly.

My kids & husband love Souper Salad! I like to go there because you won't get sick and get bloated after eating there. You can get coupons when you sign up for their loyalty program. Their selections of fresh salads with various toppings are impressive. They have alfalfa sprouts, bleu cheese crumbled, sun dried tomatoes & chopped pecan on their salad bar! Their soups are tasty also! I like their Lemon Chicken, Mama Mia, Vegetable Lentil & Beef Stroganoff soup! Also I like their garlic bread sticks, pumpkin muffin, pico de gallo and of course their soft served ice cream. I don't mind paying $7.90 (without the coupon) per person to have a fresh meal. You most likely to pay about the same or more anyway when you go somewhere else.
Clean, affordable, and what you can expect from a hotel.  I'd come back and I'd recommend it to anyone. Also lots of shops near by!

Seeing I posted a photo for this place my friend Carl Y, who knows my husband and me well,  sent this note; "I find it hard to believe that you would try this? "  I can scarcely believe we tried it either.  In the future were this standing between us and starvation, we might go back for the vegetarian bean chili or the soft serve ice cream.  Otherwise, starvation would seem the better path.  And if you read no further than this in this review, here's a tip or warning.  Do not try the mac n cheese which is in a tall hot counter container.  The flaccid macaroni was more bloated than the Federal deficit and looked as if it had been sitting in the watery, maize yellow, soupy broth passing for cheese sauce since the Clinton Administration.  The last one.  Not the one likely to come.  

THE GOOD THINGS
But there are good things here.  They are in the cleanliness of the place, everything was clean and well tended in the seating area and on the salad bar.  And in the friendliness of the charming young woman who checked us in and who was also busing the tables and cleaning up all with top notch customer service skills.  She is too talented to be working here.  High five stars for her.

THE AWFUL THINGS
The food is awful.  And since this is a food buffet (that noun typically is enough to wave me off but in I went), this review is for the food.

The produce was relatively flavorless.  It all tasted as if in cold storage too long and all items tasted pretty much like the other items.  When cherry tomatoes taste just like grated carrot, well then... There are a score of salad dressings to drown the salad with and it looked like most were doing that.

Ditto for woeful fruit.  Seasonal offerings like grapes and watermelon and pineapple were absent flavor at all.

There are pasta salads on the salad bar too.  The tuna with rotini salad tasted exactly like the fettucine with corn salad.  (Noting there were likely 16 kernels of canned or frozen corn per pound of pasta.)  Which is they both tasted like commercial mayo. 

On to the soups.  A handful of options, one of them vegetarian, and while the two we tried weren't gourmet, they beat a can.  If they are in fact made fresh daily as the signs suggest, the starting point is canned items being combined.

There is a taco bar.  Which was low on ingredients.  But we'd wouldn't eat the mystery meat and nacho sauce anywhere so didn't try it here either.

Now for the pasta section.  A little gummy, held over too long, spaghetti to which one could add marinara or meat sauce.  I tried the marinara and it would be better than some jarred options.  Were it not that the spaghetti wasn't edible.  As for the mac n cheese...well, see the opening comments.  There ought to be a "consume at your own risk" sign on that.

The soft serve ice cream which passes as vanilla was pretty much devoid of flavor but it was icy-creamy consistency and they offered caramel and chocolate sauce to go on it.  "Bad calories" says my best friend's husband, as something you eat that you know aren't worth it. That would be so for this, but it was among the most edible of the options.  It would stave off  starvation if needed.

PRICE POINT
$7.99 regular / $7.29 if over 60.  Beverages extra.

ACCESSIBILITY
Parking lot has accessible spaces.  Level in the door.  All on one floor.  Many standard height tables with ample clear space.   Wheelchair users would need assistance with plating as all food service is at standing height.  There were a good number of aged seniors here, several of whom seemed regulars, as well as moms with multiple very small children in tow.  I imagine that's why the owners realize the good access works for every one of their customers.  A good thing.

Wow! This place was great. I think I came here when it first opened and was disappointed in the service, but was really pleased at this visit. My wife and I ordered the ahi appetizer, and it fantastic. The meat, sauce, and coleslaw were a perfect combination. I had one of their signature dishes, the Evil Jungle Princess, and that might be the dish that keeps me coming back. My wife ordered the Pad Tai and it also was quite tasty. Definitely going to be back more often now. Happy hour 3-6 and 9-close and Sat and Sun from 11-6.

This place is pretty good for the price. I went for lunch on Thursday and saw lots of senior citizens there. This could be the reason I felt many things were under seasoned or not seasoned at all. On the good side, great breadsticks and soups. Super thin crust pizza was great. Salad bar had lots of options and some I haven't seen at other local salad bars. Taco and spaghetti bar looked appetizing but I was too full and needed room for dessert. Strawberry shortcake was pretty good. Little brownies lacked sugar and ice cream tasted icy not creamy.
Overall it was decent for around $20 for 2 people but I'll bypass this place in the future...or at least till I can get the senior discount.

My husband and I had dinner at Margherita Pizza tonight.  We thoroughly enjoyed it. We got a margherita pizza and a pepperoni pizza. We took home what we didn't eat and are looking forward to lunch tomorrow!  The crust was just the way we love it.....on the thin side.  The owner's daughter is just adorable and it was so fun to watch how attentive she is to the customers. Great work ethic! Take out is always a great option, as well!  Try this restaurant, you won't be disappointed!

Food is alright been here a couple times but i ate the korean short ribs taste is good but meat is overly tuff and made my wife and I not feel so well which is unusall for me because i have a stomach like a garbage disposel and nothing usually phases me. I will probably try it again just to see if it was a fluke but not any time soon. When i do it will be purely out of convience of being near by.
Great place to get your dry cleaning done! Love that they offer same day as well. They are quick, efficient, and my clothes always look great! Thank you for consistent service!

We have been waiting a long time to eat at this establishment,  heard really good things and would have loved to at least try a burger. We get there and the hostess asked for a table or a booth so we chose booth. Sat down read the menu deciding which burger we were going to try. Found what we thought would be really good and waited for someone to take our order. At this point no one has been back even to get our drink order. Seen someone headed our way and he stopped at the table before us. Then left and came back to the that table a couple times, never even looking at us or said a word. Sat there for a good 15 to 20 minutes before deciding we had enough and left without any of the staff even noticing. The worst experience I've had at a restaurant. Will not go back! Went down the street to Rudys and was greeted and had our order taken in the first few minutes we sta down.

I have come to love Dick's Sporting Goods, as they tend to have a good selection of merchandise everytime I've visited the store.  I used to shop at another store all the time in Oregon, but this was my first visit to the one here in Idaho.  It's a bit of a drive to get here from where we live, but since we were in the area, it was worth the TWO stops for my wife to find her shoes.  (She didn't want to buy right away, so after a long day, we ended right back here buying a pair she saw much on the FIRST stop).  Well, it WAS her birthday, so being the good husband I went along with a smile :-)

I would definately shop here more if it was to be closer, but I will probably come here if I have an item in mind and know that they will more than likely have it.
I may be biased because I work here...but I don't care. Best zamzows and the place to go for great knowledgeable customer service and safe and natural pet, lawn and garden products.

Great little place. Family run. Here on a Saturday night and had a quiet dinner. Pizza was thin crust and very tasty. They are personal size 12" pies.   Easily split by 2 people.  Fresh toppings on each of the four we ordered, but we could have done well with 2 to 3. 

Not the usual pizza. Totally wonderful!!

We went here the other day for lunch and it was pretty good. The inside is nice and clean with some cool art on the walls. We ordered the chicken teriyaki, egg rolls and pork udon. It was all pretty good but the sauce was a little sweet for me on both the noodles and the chicken. Overall, I might go back if I was near and wanting some teriyaki.

My boyfriend and I went here for dinner on a Friday night. I was willing to try it out because I've never been to a fusion Asian place, and I was willing to overlook the new business syndrome of being slowly serviced.

We had to wait about 15 minutes for a table, which wasn't bad compared to how busy they were. When we got to our table, the waitress presented a card with her name, which was great. We ordered drinks (Arnold Palmer limade & tea) and an appetizer (edamame). The edamame was a very large serving and was presented to us about 5 minutes after ordering. I didn't like my limade, so she made me a lemonade AP and didn't charge me for it! 

We ordered our food, and it got to us with the average waiting time for entrees, which was great considering it's a new place and they were very busy. I ordered chow mein (I asked to make it with just veggies, no meat) and my boyfriend ordered a beef noodle dish. Not only did it taste great, it had more veggies in it than I've ever seen in a typical Asian dish. My boyfriend loved his meal, and we ordered the banana roll for dessert.

This a great place to take people who aren't very into Asian fare. They have lots of Asian dishes as well as American dishes with Asian touches, like wasabi mashed potatoes and ginger glazed ribs. It's very Americanized, but maybe all fusion grills are. The decor was nice, the people very friendly. There are no vegetarian dishes so you have to ask them to make it so. At the bottom of the menu, they say they can sub tofu, but in my experiences with Asian cooking, just because it has tofu doesn't necessarily mean it is vegetarian. That's all I can really think about for a suggestion, is to say "vegetarian options available" or add a veggie submenu.
Sun-Kissed by Kris - She is amazing and yes as everyone has mentioned makes you feel very comfortable and the tan always looks great!  No reason to ever go anywhere else :-)  Thanks Kris!

A little pricey but potentially a healthy meal. You are charged by the bowl size. Your goal is to cram as much meat / veggies / noodles inside as you possibly can. Bowls start at about $7 for a small.

There's free white rice served, so if you want to get the most for your money, fill your bowl with meat / veggies and avoid noodles. Then, just eat that stir-fry with the rice. 

There's over 10 different sauces / oils to choose from.

I'm hesitant partly because cleanliness concerns, but I guess because everything is cooked, that mitigates some concerns.

We visited the State Street location last weekend around noonish.  We ordered breakfast.  i got the Basque scramble with 1/4 biscuit & gravy and home fries.  The chorizo was great in the scramble and the biscuit and gravy good.  The gravy was a bit light on the sausage, but I love a ton of sausage in my gravy.  The home fries were EXCELLENT.  I would definitely recommend them over the hashbrowns.  SO got chicken fried steak with pancakes and hashbrowns.  My home fries were better.  The pancakes were good and the chicken fried steak very good.  Highly recommend this place as one of the better down-home breakfast places in Boise.

I had the chicken teriyaki and gyoza. Large portions for a very reasonable price! The chicken was tender and drizzled with plenty of teriyaki, and the sides of sticky rice and stir fried cabbage were good. But the star was the gyoza. Hands down the best I've ever had. Crispy on the outside, tender and flavorful on the inside.  This is my first visit here, and I'm definitely coming back!
Very friendly staff, but when there are 6 stylists working and only 4 people ahead of you, the wait should not be an hour and a half.

The only reason they got a one star is because on of my son's hair cuts turned out amazing.  However my other son's hair was completely butchered.  Of course I saw it after she styled it and now I know why.  When he got out of the shower and his hair was dried I was so pissed.  she full on gouged his hair in several spots and left long hair that should have been cut and it isn't even at all.  Of course today was picture day so I had to get creative to hide the mess she made.  I am so so so pissed.  I don't know that I will be back.  $16 for a kids cut is a lot more than most places and to get a shitty hair cut pisses me off.

Super Tune!
I had a vehicle problem. I decided to go to Super Tune! That was the best decision I have made in years!
Les was honest, straight forward, and to the point. No white washing and selling of unnecessary services. 

I can't thank him enough!
One of the best 1 hour workouts you'll ever have! Friendly staff, amazing trainers, and awesome members! I'd recommend this to anyone

I was skeptical of spray tans before and yesterday was the first time that I had it done. All I can say is wow! My tan looks so natural! Krissy is very easy to work with and she answers all of your questions so you know exactly what to expect and how to properly care for your tan! 

Called on Wednesday afternoon and was able to get an appointment for me and a couple of friends for the following day. She covers the tri-valley area and will drive to your location, which makes her service so convenient!

Thanks, Krissy!

Rude, horrible customer service. The cooks look like they hate their life with a passion. The quality of the ingredients is very poor. They have their cheap stuff laid out first so you can fill up on that and then few fresh veggies at the end. They are always rude about your portions and examine the punch cards for at least a minute to make sure you didn't somehow make your own little MG to stamp on there for a free lunch! I honestly don't know how this place is still open. Location? Hence my two stars instead of one. It's close to my house

After working late - I asked the teenagers where were we going to eat.  One of them recommended this place.  Crazily enough I had no idea it even existed.  I totally enjoyed it and will most definitely return. I got the chicken strips, with onion rings and a caramel shake.  The food was prepared right then, and so hot I had to be careful with it!  Onion rings were awesome.  I shouldn't have to say it (but in this day and age you have to) they were made with real onions! One of the kids got a burger and just from the size of the wrapper it was a good size and she loved it.  The place does not look like much - but it was good.  And on top of all that a friendly car hop checked back on us to make sure we were still good!

I'm so frustrated.  I want this restaurant to be everything it aims to be but three visits and it is just not adding up.  The last two visits were take out - called ahead, friendly staff, but both times something is missing - and it's not just a side of this, it's the sauce for the Bun/Vermicelli noodle bowl or the accompaniments for the Pho.  Ugh.  I'm super disappointed.  Not sure I will venture for a 4th attempt.

We were on the road and a cousin suggested this place. Good choice. I had the Satay Trio which was 4 skewers of meat-shrimp, steak, and 2 chicken. With peanut sauce. Delicious. My partner had the Cashew stir fry with flat iron steak. Again delicious. It was delivered in 12 minutes and we were walking out the door in 30 minutes. On the road this was as fast as going into a fast food place but with far better food. Tyler provided excellent service. We will be back when we pass through Boise again.
Ok the reason I give it 3 stars is because of the service because the food was really a 2. I have to give props to the staff for being prompt and friendly.
Staff Were nice.  Had a very pleasant dinner.  Waiter was very attentive.  We had three different entrees, food was plentiful and tasty.  Dessert was HUGE...

Had a wonderful experience here. The place was clean and bright and there were so many color choices. I walked right in with my mother and we were both able to be seated in a pedi chair. Had a fantastic pedicure that felt incredible!  Loved the hot stones and the paraffin treatment. Linda was so nice and did an exceptional job. This will be a place we return to again.

We are from Sacramento. We where in town and our friends invite us for dinner at this place. We order there deal 2lb hamburger it came with 2 large drinks, large fries and 2 larger ice cream ONLY $28.00. The food was great and also the services. Thank you!

I have a huge history with these guys starting when they were selling out of a truck at a call center I worked at.The food is bomb. So damn flavorful. I thought maybe it was preggo hormones but once they moved to the village it had been over a year and taste just got better. I use to eat here everyday with my little punch card lol i respect the owner and admire how far hes come. No joke this has been the BEST asian food Ive found in Boise!
Great food, once a cook was very rude to me because I overfilled my bowl to his liking. I've been back since even with that bad encounter, but the food is great there non the less!

Although this place is set up as an order at the register then sit down, I was pleasantly surprised when I was politely asked to have a seat and my server would be right with me. The service was super fast and friendly. I ordered the chicken teriyaki plate with gyoza.  The chicken was good as was the steamed cabbage. The gyoza was just average. The gyoza filling was bland and appeared to be a chicken and rice mixture--most likely pre-frozen. I will come back for the chicken but will pass on the gyoza. If you are looking for a reasonably priced, quick meal, look no further.
Good service. Food had good flavor. Reasonably priced. I will definitely come back again! Iiked the Bahnmi sandwich, will try the pho next time.

We have been looking for good pho for a while now in the Boise area and my husband randomly found this restaurant through a google search. Good pho is hard to come by in this area and we were pleasantly surprised by the soup here. I love pho and they had the flavors we were looking for. The service was a little more relaxed than I am used to in Boise (slower, no checks for drink refills, small tables with wobbly chairs, dirty tables) but we will be back because of how much we enjoyed the pho. My husband asked for cilantro and they brought him some but it was not something that came out on the main tray for add-ons.

I really usually love this place but it seems to have fallen off a little. I found a red, coarse looking pubic-like hair in the mayo of my club sandwich! I seriously gagged. I can't ever eat here again. I don't even think I can eat a club again...

Great selection of beers. They have great weekend specials. Sunday Bloody Mary day you build your own. The have great appetizers and if you want food from Flat Bread they will order it for you. Staff friendly it our local hangout now.

Purchased an in-ground basketball backboard at Dick's for Christmas.  Paid extra for the installation.  First scheduled date got moved because of rain.  I accepted it.  But, I was given a 3 hour time window for two days later.  No one came, I finally called the installation company and was told the installers would be 3 hours late.  I couldn't be home.  So they had to reschedule for a week later.  They came and installed the base.  Then nothing.  No one called to tell me when they would be back to put in the pole and hoop itself.  I had to call and email them.  I am now being told them may be able to squeeze me in this week.  I called Dick's was told they would try to help, but they really have no control.  Right now, I regret buying a hoop from Dick's and paying extra for the install.  It would be better to pay more somewhere else.

I was happy to see that have come to the Boise area after eating in the Las Vegas location a few years ago. I just hope that it will make it here since it is pricey for this area. That being said, you won't go away hungry! We had a terrific dinning experience last Saturday night with friends.

This is one of the most reliable restaurants I have been to in the greater Boise area. I am a huge fan of Asian-Fusion style food, and this place is one of my favorites. Happy hour specials are terrific (try the calamari and the lettuce wraps!) for both food and drink.

Let me start by saying that this place is about two steps above PF Chang's in terms of quality. While the price and variety is comparable (maybe slightly more variety and marginally less expensive), the real motivation to return comes from the food itself. 

Here's what I have had great success with, and would highly recommend to anybody visiting (especially if you like spicy food):

1. Calamari appetizer -This stuff is the bomb.com. It comes with a creamy/spicy sauce and some lemon wedges on a bed of cabbage slaw. Boom-shaka-laka. It's terrific.

2. Lettuce Wraps - These are probably the best lettuce wraps I have ever had.

3. Blackened Chicken and Pork - This is a dish I ask for extra spicy. Like extra extra spicy. I think they put something like 6 thai chiles (chopped) in my dish. It comes out of the kitchen on a sizzling cast iron skillet, and it was so spicy that half the restaurant and the entire kitchen were choking on the fumes. I feel bad that it was such a spicy cloud of steam, but at the same time, I am not sorry because it was so delicious. It was so hot that i was tearing up. It's hard to get food that's spicy enough to do that to me, so I am always very appreciative when I find some. The flavor is spot on, too. The broccoli is tender, the other veggies are perfectly cooked, and the chicken and pork are very flavorful.

4. Seafood Hot Pot - This is another one that is nice and spicy. It comes with a great variety of seafood (mussels, scallops, shrimp, salmon) in a creamy curry soup. I recommend the brown rice with it. It's a little pricey but well worth it.

You should eat here. You will not be disappointed*.


*I can't guarantee that, but if my experiences are anything, you're going to be very satisfied.

I travel to Boise every 6 weeks and I literally look forward to dinner as I drive.
Always the ahi salad and tonight I added the pot stickers.   Great and consistent.
Avoid this place! Service is the worst. Drive through isn't quick...it is a 20 minute commitment! Torture!

The General Chicken is top notch. Sauce was awesome, not to thick with just the right amount of heat. Absolutly would recommend this place to family and friends. Haven't tried many other dishes, but I'm sure their just as good. The food was prepared fresh right in front of me- and it's a lot of food for 9-10 dollars....I haven't eaten better Asian food in Meridian / Boise....
Well done RiceWorks!
Great little place in the village, and a quick and easy place to grab something to go as well. The Ninja bowl has a nice kick to it, definitely recommend!

I love Linda at Q Nail Spa. She is the best nail tech I have ever been to. I drive past several Nail Salons nearer my home, to have Linda do my nails. She's that good!  I'm sure the other's there are good as well, but Linda is my fav.

What a terrible experience. I went with this company because they had some good reviews and I had a blowout that wasn't done correctly last year, so I didn't mind paying twice the going rate to get good service. I had a great conversation with the owner/manager (?) and he assured me the guy would walk me through everything and explain things. I was happy to pay extra to get real service and know that I was in good hands. Or so I thought. I waited home all day and finally got a call that the guy was coming in 10 minutes. I looked out the window on my way to the bathroom- no truck. I was in the bathroom for a few minutes and saw a guy getting back into a truck. He drove away before I could get out to him. I get my phone and call him but he won't come back out to show me he's done the job. I told him there were more valves in back. He told me he hopped the locked fence! (And he damaged it. The gate is no longer even. It's sagging on one side and I'm pissed.) I asked him why he didn't ask me for the key. He asks me if I was even home, like he didn't see my car parked right in front of the gate he damaged! I asked him why he didn't just knock. He just gets evasive and I tell him to have the manager call me. I call up the company and I tell the receptionist how upset I am at this experience. She says she will have the manager call me. That was 3 days ago and apparently they don't feel a situation like this is worth responding to because I've had no contact from anyone in the company. 

Last night my pipes froze and I had no water in my bathroom this morning, because the skirting is still off, waiting for this company to come back out. Since I didn't know if the job was done, I had to hire someone else to come out. It's a good thing I did. He did say the water was mostly blown out, even though we did get a good amount of water coming out when he blew it. But he also found that the tech didn't fully open the valve or the other bleeder screw (?) on the backflow. And since it is brass, he said it would likely have cracked with build up. That would have caused an even bigger problem between me and this company. 

I really wanted to find a great company I could rely on year after year, to do my winter blow-outs and spring start ups. But when a company gives you such terrible service, can't even knock on your door so they don't have to damage your property, and won't be bothered to call you back to discuss a very obvious issue- what is there to say?


UPDATE: 11/12/18 I just received a call from Chris. He was very apologetic and seemed horrified and upset that his tech damaged my property, gave such poor service, and only did half the job. At least there is some care given in this company. They need to respond to customers right away, instead of a week later. But at least he wanted to make this right for me.
Usually love this place but it has fallen way below expectations today. Service was way below par. Food in buffet was cold,

Love this new teriyaki place. Service was excellent and their menu has a lot of options. I tried their chicken teriyaki which included a big portion of teriyaki chicken, two scoops of rice and some steamed vegetables. My only disappointment was the steamed vegetables. There was one tiny piece of broccoli and a few pieces of shaved carrots. The rest was all cabbage, which I wasn't crazy about.
My husband had the chicken/beef teriyaki combo. He liked both but preferred the chicken in the dish. He also upgraded to the fried rice and said it was just okay.
We will be back. It's sad that there are so few teriyaki places in this area, but I'm happy we've found this place.

I've come here to shop but never to trade in. I knew some of the clothes I brought in had not been sorted. The girl said "that's what we're here for!"They seemed very appreciative of my trade and treated me kindly. The processing was fast and the amount they gave me was way more than other mothers quoted me. Every experience in the store has been above and beyond customer service. I am tired of bringing good quality things to other stores only to be treated crappily. I am coming here first from now on to shop and bring my trade-ins.
This is a cute lil coffee shop and the people that work there are very friendly. They're boba is very good and the teas compliment them really well! Would definitely recommend to a friend.

It was exactly the same as every other Applebee's I have been to.  When you travel in the USA, it seems they are the only place open between 9PM and midnight.   It's corporate food but very consistent. The 7oz steak is a good value.

AMAZING!
     My boyfriend and I come here regularly for our date nights and this night was a little bit different. We walked in to our theater to notice the picture was glitchy and would frequently freeze until it completely froze. I let the crew know what was happening and they apologized and fixed it in the matter of minutes! We enjoyed our movies as usual and as we were leaving the manager who solved all of the problems- Khloe I believe - gave every viewer a voucher to come back and experience another film with no problems. 
      Great team work with the crew working tonight who helped save our night. We will continue to come back.

What a fun place to eat out!  Yes, I've had better food at other places, but it was tasty.  We got a kid's meal there for one of our boys, and it had those edamame beans as one of the sides.  He loved them, which was a pleasant surprise.  The wait staff was attentive and courteous, and we enjoyed our dishes.  I look forward to going back and trying the Wasabi mashed potatoes and Asian Meatloaf.

Dr. Michael Daines fixed my broken clavicle. After meeting with him the first time I was convinced he would be my guy. He was very educational and informative during the appointment, did not pressure me into surgery. My break was a complicated, high impact exploded bone. He explained the surgery took longer than normal but the post operation X-rays look VERY good. He did an excellent job and 10/10 would recommend to family. 

The office staff was great, they helped me understand and process paperwork for my insurance. It was overall a great experience.

I used to use Chewy.com,  overpriced.  H3 has the food my dogs require
(Kangaroo) at a lower price.  Super friendly, knowledgeable and really 
care.  No more wandering around the big box pet stores with uncaring employees in search for food they never have.  I don't care about their hours.  If you love your pets you'll get there when they're open.

I was out in Meridian one Saturday when, between my son's basketball games, we went looking for lunch.  At the behest of my mother, we wound up here.  First, let me say, it's a buffet.  Buffets are generally not my cup of tea.  So, they had an immediate strike against them (I appreciate that some love the buffet type meal--just not my thing).  

This, however, is not your typical buffet.  Instead of oodles of mac & cheese spilling into jello salad and the ham carving station, they have exclusively soups and salad (well, and baked potatoes if you so desire--which I did).  The salad fixings were surprisingly fresh and varied.  I didn't have any soup, so I cannot comment on that.  I did have a baked potato, which was fine--but, it's a baked potato, kinda hard to get that one wrong.  The place was clean and well organized, and, to top it off, very reasonable (less than ten bucks/person for all you can eat).  

A word of warning:  we came right before the lunch rush and easily found a table; however, as we were leaving the line of people waiting for a table was stretching well outside the door.
 
Bottom line:  If you're in the mood for salad and don't mind a buffet--they have it for you, fresh, and reasonably priced.

In a word: BAD. 

Just for background, we lived in SoCal for the last 28 years before moving to the Boise area and as such, we know good Vietnamese food.

We arrived at 5:50 PM on a Thursday night.  The place was not busy, perhaps 5 other people in the whole place.  We ordered water for 3, a smoothie for my daughter, a beef pho for my wife and a vermicelli bowl for me.  We paid for our food and sat down.  After sitting down, I noticed that the tables and floors were not clean and that there were dirty dishes on several tables.  15 minutes later, we still had not gotten our waters or the smoothie.  I got up and asked the kid working at the counter if we could please have our water and he said, "sorry, we are backed up at the moment."  I said, "backed up for water?"  He said, "yes," and looked down at the counter and was writing on something.

About five minutes later we got the waters, but still no smoothie, which I asked about when the other kid working there brought them.  He said, "sorry we're backed up right now."  My wife and I were just trying to make the best of it with our two kids so we didn't complain.  Roughly 10 minutes later, the kid brought the smoothie for our daughter, but still no food.  The food came another 10-15 minutes later, the garnish dish for the pho was wilted and looked old, but at least the pho was hot, as was my vermicelli bowl, but that is supposed to be a COLD noodle dish.  On that note, the usually lovely fish sauce-based liquid that is supposed to be at the bottom of a vermicelli bowl, was missing, but the noodles in my COLD noodle dish were indeed HOT!

By this point, I just wanted to ask for a refund and leave, but we were hungry and made the best of it.  Note: making the best of it is for roughing it in the woods, not at restaurant!  My wife asked the kid if there was supposed to be sauce under the noodles in the vermicelli bowl and the kid looked confused and said, "they must have forgotten it."  He did return promptly with it, but it was so sweet, it was far from delicious or authentic tasting.  My daughter enjoyed her smoothie, for a 6 year old, it was probably very good, although too sweet for my wife and I.

When we left, the dirty dishes on the other tables still had not been cleared and wiped off.  Adding insult to injury, the loud obnoxious rap music playing overheard was annoying and added to the unpleasant experience.

If you want slow and bad service in a dirty restaurant, Pho 779 is the place for you, otherwise, run, run, run away!!!  I wouldn't go back if someone else was paying.  And if possible, I would rate Pho 779 at negative 5 stars.

Jon was our savior in the desert. We were passing through on our family RV vacation and our generator that produces our AC went out in 97 degree weather. We called Jon and he immediatly came out to meet us despite other business's being closed already. He went straight to the problem and didn't dilly dally or try to take time with meaningless small talk, it was fixed in under 20 minutes. Well worth the price, would call him again in a heartbeat.

I love this store!! Everything they sell is in new/almost new condition. It's very well organized, the staff is very friendly and prices are extremely affordable! I recently bought my daughter's entire fall/winter wardrobe here, including shoes, for only $50. I would have easily spent $300-400 at the mall. Not only does this place help your wallet but it's also great for the environment to buy used! 

I've also traded our used toys for store credit and that experience was just as enjoyable!

I am new to the area and had been looking for a children's store just like this. It's like once upon a child, but 10x bigger and better. The prices are extremely reasonable, and the store is kept very clean and organized. Things were labeled and sorted very neatly and it made it easy to find exactly what I was looking for. Will definitely be going back!
The staff was friendly and helpful. The store had a great selection of products. Would shop there again.

Large, clean theatre with comfortable temperature. The lighting was good -- which helped for bathroom trips during the movie. The concessions and movie tickets were priced as expected. I liked that the large soda had unlimited free refills!!
Best pho I've been able to find in the Boise area after looking for so long. Fast service.

Very clean property and unit. In a great location on South Eagle.

Friendly staff that is pretty easy to work with.

Better price than most on same size unit.

Simple entry instruction.

Overall pleased and would recommend.

Great food and quick! I have dined in and had delivery from Quik Wok, and have never been disappointed. The negative posts are crazy, I have never had a problem with their delivery service or on site staff! Great food and good prices, delivery has always been quik!

I came in to spend a good $500 or so on a PS4. Waited for about ten minutes and no greeted me or anything so I stopped someone for help. Guy said he would send someone with the keys. I went back over to the gaming systems, waited another 30 minutes and left. The entire time, 10-15 different employees walked by me and no one said a word to me. Not only did they not get my business tonight, they will probably never get my business again.

Do yourself a favor and check it out. I stopped by and picked up an original milk tea with boba, one of my favorite drinks wherever I go, and it is so incredible! It tastes like the boba might be sweetened with a touch of honey. So good. They also have the normal and specialty coffee menu, other boba, lychee, etc. menu, and some pretty neat kids drinks (for example, fresh strawberries in milk!). The place is clean, tastefully decorated, and the staff is super helpful and friendly! Definitely a new favorite.
This place is amazing. The server provided great service and the food was perfect! The flavor was sweet and savory with a perfect amount of spice on the General Ling's chicken!

I thought to myself, "hmmm, a chain restaurant, can't be that bad." Boy oh boy was I wrong. I used the fancy IOS app and ordered some steak and shrimp dinner with a parmesan sauce all over it. I pulled up to the car hop area and a perky server helped. Arriving at home I dug in. One bite of the steak and I thought to myself, "Wow, that was a tough bit of steak." Bite number two and three yielded the same results. The shrimp and vegetable side was good. The entire steak was disgusting. I wonder if it was really even steak... but I digress. I will not be dining at this place ever again. Meridian would be better off to have this place close down if this is the food they are serving to everyone.

This was our first (and last) time here. If it is your first visit, beware that the sign on the building is just GROOMING. Nothing else. We called a few days ago and were told to bring our dog by between 8 and 10am. We dropped the dog off early morning. It was 7 1/2 hours later that we were notified the dog was ready. We tried calling multiple times to see what was taking so long. No answer. No text response. Nothing. When we got home the dog was obviously very thirsty. So, I'm not even sure if there was water. Well, we will not be back. Oh, and the price was a bit higher than we are used to paying.

This place is really good! Finally tried it and I ordered the Drunken chicken. Filling, satisfying, delicious, flavor packed, sweet and savory, I can go on and on. I really enjoyed my meal and will be returning. Didn't get to see much of the inside of the restaurant since my husband and I dined outside. The service was great and friendly. A must try :D

Between the great customer service from Haena, (the owner) and the amazing boba and coffee. This is the best place in Idaho for boba tea. I'm originally from California and this place meets the criteria of California boba tea. The boba is soft and squishy and the drinks are non powdery. The owner herself is from San Francisco and she has blessed us all with amazing flavors! The coffee is clean and powerful. As a Starbucks barista and a former boba tearista this place would get a million stars if I could!

For a Sonic, it's a good one! The best part about this place is the convenience to Rocky Mountain High and the surrounding neighborhoods. They have easy, fast options and should be treated as such. And honestly, for a Sonic, it's really nice--especially the way the store and layout is designed!

Food: Yum! Everything is good so far. I'm a huge fan of the peanut butter cookie dough Master Blast. Yum!

Drinks: n/a

Atmosphere: What's cool about this Sonic is that the side has a giant raise-up garage door for a wall. So when the weather's nice, they'll have it open! They have indoor AND outdoor seating, car-hop seating and a drive thru. Seriously, can't beat it for a Sonic!

Service: Each time I have been, they've been prompt, friendly and reliable. I'm pleased. Remember, it's honestly mostly high school kids working, so for what it is, they do a great job.

Happy Hour Offerings: They have weekly specials advertised on their sign board. Make sure to check both sides for deals!

Healthy Hack: n/a

Tips: n/a

Came here just cause it was nearby. Staff was friendly well at least the one girl who did my pedi... I actually had conversation with her.  I wouldn't go back only cause I like the one near my house called Diva Nails on franklin and Orchard.

Louis is good, not stellar but good, Italian food in a casual, friendly environment. They are very consistent and the family dinners are a great value.  It is a place I love because I know what to expect and I know I will leave full of good comfort food.  Oh, and they have good ranch.  Always love a place that has good ranch.

Try the lobster ravioli, or family dinners with some added seafood dishes.

Sub par .. Missed the bar. 66 dollers after kids refill charges a peporpni charge of 15 cents meatball up charge with spaghetti and a charg for bread when i paid for brichetta ... Unexpected 80 bucks after tax and tip wont be back and i have ben a xhef for 14 years.

This review is as much about the new Tru brand as about this property.  We visited recently with our 8 year old daughter, and had a nice stay.

I am a long time Hilton customer, and was excited to try the new brand. I have enjoyed the Aloft (by Starwood) properties, and I think Tru is a sort of combination of that mixed with Hampton. I really liked it.

First, it is affordable.  The prices were basically comparable to a new Hampton.

Second, the lobby is great. It has a nice area where you can sit, and the breakfast (basically a Hampton breakfast) is easy and decent enough. The snacks for sale were tasty and presenting in a nicely-organized display.

The rooms are not large, but are well organized. They have everything you need.

Staff were friendly, and staffed at a level of a budget hotel. 

Try it out, I bet you will like it.

I generally like this store but I wanted to return a dress that was given to me as a gift. Tag still on it, but no receipt. The manager shrugged and said there was nothing she could do, not even store credit with a very unhelpful smirk. Beware if you buy anything or receive anything as a gift from this store/company and aren't on their annoying "perks" program, you will be totally screwed.
