This is an excellent traditional Italian spot with great service.  There are two rooms for groups and parties and the service is excellent.  I had the lasagne which was really delicious.  Salad was ho hum with iceberg lettuce and a sprinkle of cheese, but overall I really recommend this spot.

ZERO STARS!!! STAY AWAY!! Trust the other zero star reviews!! Horrible staff!! Horrible wait!! Horrible food!!

Husband and I went to eat here last night. We were standing in line to order behind a table of 3 and a table of 2. We both ordered the #9 pho (steak/meatball/tendon/brisket), an order of crab Rangoon, and both got hot tea. We were told we couldn't use our buy 2 drinks & 1 entree, get 1/2 off second entree since we weren't getting COLD drinks. What?? Our total was $28 and change.

Find a seat, takes 15 minutes to get waters, another 10 min for our hot tea. STRAWBERRY HERBAL TEA BAG. Was not told it was flavored OR herbal! Tea was served in different size mugs (one was clearly size and a half of the other). One mug looked dirty on the outside, but who knows. 

I asked about our appetizer in which one young kid responds "yeah, it's on its way." About TEN minutes later, the table of 3 receive their appetizer and a veggie plate for their pho, then pho is delivered. I ask him again about our appetizer since I knew the table of 2 ahead of us didn't order one, "it's coming." The table of 2 then get their food along with two sandwiches for the table of 3 ahead of them.

FORTY FIVE minutes after we ordered our food, the kid brings us utensils and a veggie plate "for 2" for our pho. I asked if we could get more veggies, he rudely replied he would. I then look at the veggies closer and realize the herbs are wilted and brown at spots!! The sprouts looked old and sat in a wet bag for too long. Two people (only people who came in after us) who ordered to go about 20 minutes AFTER WE GOT THERE JUST RECEIVED THEIR FOOD BEFORE US! We are literally the last table to get food (no appetizer or entrees yet!) and they got food before us. I was livid. 

I take the veggies up to the counter and show the kid the wilted leaves and gross sprouts. I told him these look old and we want a FRESH plate. He snarls "ok" while giving me a hateful look like I ruined HIS day. 

I walk back to the table where my husband can see me fuming and gets up to leave. I grab my purse to follow. Half way to the door, a lady comes out from the kitchen and starts apologizing, I tell her we have not received ANY food and that the staff kids are rude. She asked us to sit back down and our food was ready to bring out and blames the kids and their service! No refund was offered, no free dessert, etc. Mind you, this was FIFTY MINUTES AFTER WE ORDERED! I was so angry! I told her "you already have our money, all we had were two tea bags, we don't owe you anything, and we will never be back." 

Zero Star Staff: young kids who I think were stoned out of their minds or need to go back to school to learn more. The entire time we were there, they kept trying to deliver food to the wrong table, brought water to tables who already had waters, etc. The girl acted like a hot shot who wouldn't make eye contact. The boy was just rude. We were never told how long the wait would be, and never received an apology for the wait (until the manager came out). 

Zero Star Food: after 50 minutes, all we got was wilted mint and soggy old sprouts. 


Wouldn't trust this place one bit to eat their food after our experience. Best $28 they ever made...free money (minutes two tea bags)!!!!

What a perfect way to end our trip to Boise. Mom and I needed breakfast before we got on the road to go back home and we saw this little 50s diner when we had stopped at the store the night before and after checking reviews decided to stop in on our way out. It didn't disappoint! Perfect atmosphere. We used to listen to 50s music together all the time so the decor was awesome! The booth was super comfy and the staff was beyond friendly! From the person opening the door as we walked up to our server to the staff cleaning the tables. Everyone greeted us and thanked us for coming and told us to have a great day on our way out and thanked us for coming in. 5 stars for service alone.

The food was on point! I came in expecting to order breakfast but when I saw the melts in the menu I had to order lunch! Mom got 2 eggs over easy with hash browns and sausage with rye toast. A simple breakfast but this simple breakfast is so easily messed up at other restaurants. The eggs were cooked perfectly and while I prefer my hash browns a little more on the crunchy side my mom loved how they were cooked and the sausage was delicious and a totally different type than she was used to and not too spicy. I had the turkey melt and it totally hit the spot! Bread perfectly grilled and buttery, cheese melted to perfection and the tomato and turkey were fresh and delicious! The server was honest in her suggestion when I asked whether I should have the fries or tater tots and I went with the tots. Perfectly crispy and crunchy!! I was in heaven. Even the pickle slices that came with the sandwich were crisp which usually are slimy and limp at other places. Everything about my meal was perfect and the prices were reasonable as well. 

The final test is always the restroom for me and they passed with flying colors. Neat and clean! 

Thanks for a great morning send off we will be back next time we visit for sure!!

Wandered in here on a rainy, blustery Tuesday in search of a little warmth and caffeinated kindness.  I'm so glad I did.  Village Coffee is serving up some seriously divine and completely guilt free coffee. 

Why guilt free?  

Their coffees are all 100% free trade, organic, and nonGMO.  AND (!!), Tuesdays are discount days in The Village and so the Tuesday I was there they were offering their coffees at buy one, get one half off!

They have plenty of seating and even have a lovely fire feature you can sit by if you so choose.  Plus, in finer weather, there is outdoor seating as well.

Bonus reasons for fandom:  

They serve BOTH a Salted Caramel Mocha and a Mexican Mocha!  How to choose?  Both are like Autumn in a cup.   

They have some particularly tasty looking cinnamon rolls (I was just there for coffee but would definitely like to give the cinnamon rolls a try next time!).

And, finally, you can order ahead, my people!  Just bop over to their website coffeeatthevillage.com and click "order online" and they'll have your swirling cuppa goodness ready when you get there!

Get to it!
The food and the price are fantastic! I'm so happy we came here today. The employees (owners?) Where so sweet and friendly. I would reccomend this place to everyone. Thank you guys so much!

I was super excited to come her, the young man at the counter was super rude and rolled his eyes way too much. service took forever.  By the time it came, my toddler was in full melt down mode. The food was ok, just not good enough to warrant a second visit.

Stayed here last week and I was so impressed I needed to write a review!! Everything was so nice and clean and the beds were very comfortable. The room was quiet and I was on the first floor. The continental breakfast was the best I've had and my kids loved it! The staff was all very friendly and welcoming. I'll be recommending any friends or family to stay there when they come to town!

This place is amazing. Great Food & FAST COURTEOUS RELAXED Friendly service !! They also honor Veterans with a discount. Found a new  favorite place. Our server " Emma" was really all the above. She rocks !

My husband and I went there this evening and the girl wasn't very friendly to start. We ordered calamari and edamame and our meal and a drink. The edamame and calamari came the calamari was so tough and chewy you couldn't even chew it we had to spit it out. The bowl of edamame was mainly Brown and I don't know who in town ever serve Brown edamame and it tasted disgusting like it was old and rotting. We ended up canceling our order and leaving it was very disappointing since we really like this restaurant and haven't been there in quite some time. Not sure if my husband will ever go there and eat again.
Great place for breakfast! Kind of a Meridian staple as it has been there for so long. Due to the hours of operation they have developed, haven't been there in long time.

They have lots of clothes that are clean, mostly up-to-date and priced well. You have to go often as the good stuff gets picked over fast. They don't pay as much for your clothes as other places in the area but its still a great place to shop.

The most beautiful, innovative, and highly artistic photos I have ever seen!  Every single shoot he does is unique and done with love.  I highly recommend him for any photo shoot.  Not only is he talented, he is a super nice person.

Krissy is wonderful! My sister in love and I wanted to get a tan for her bridal shower and Krissy came to her house and tanned us. the tan was amazing and it lasted a very long time. It also wasn't orange it's was like we came sun kissed from a tropical vacation. We also continued to us her for the wedding all of us girls got tanned. Thank you so much for the exceptional service.
very professional, nice ladies.  Good color selection. Envy Special Pedicure = sugar scrub and ice hot tingly mask for your legs! Felt sooo gooooood!

Looks like you love it or hate it here. Put me in the "love it" camp!  I lived in Meridian from 1977-1979 as a kid and we must've driven by this place a million times. I think I asked to stop about a million times, but I was denied every time. So I needed to finally check that box, which I did today during a road trip from Seattle to SLC. It was actually really good, on par with all the great small town burger drive ins.  Don't expect anything more than an old place that's casual, comforting, and friendly, and you won't be disappointed.

We ordered pizza for takeout tonight for the first time and we won't again. The pizza was just gross. The sauce and cheese were nothing special and the crust tasted like cardboard. I could tell we weren't going to like it when I looked in the box and was proved right when we tried it. Wouldn't recommend or come back

I am very disgusted at the "wannabe food critics" and "freeloaders" who complain, threaten the owner with a poor review and ask for their money back which happened right in front of my husband and I. 

A VERY rude and LOUD couple (you know who you are) ate most of their food and then essentially blackmailed the owner by staying he would leave bad reviews if she did not give him a full refund. The couple claimed they would not be petty and leave a review but low and behold they certainly did smear their name. Twice. 

First of all this is a very clean and well ran establishment. My husband I go quite often. We have been to Vietnam and their Pho is absolutely authentic. The broth is delicious and perfectly seasoned. You can taste the complexities that a slow cooked broth possesses. 


Most people leaving a mean review most likely didn't know what they were ordering. If I order something and I don't like because of my own personal likes and dislikes it IS NOT the establishments fault. 

Support a local business and if you were expecting Top Ramen because that is what you think of when you think of noodles and broth then go buy some for ten cents and leave your two cents off this page. 

Support local business and most importantly a hardworking family run business. Spread positive and don't be negative because it's ugly to watch. 

Watch Bambi and learn what your mama's should have taught you "If you don't have anything nice to say... don't say anything at all. 

I would give them ten stars if I could, if you want authentic Vietnamese Pho made with love this is your spot. We will most likely see you there at some point!
Had some sashimi, Kung pow with beef and shrimp and the banana Carmel spring roll for dessert. It was all amazing!

As a new place, I'm very impressed! The cafe itself looks very aesthetic and open. There is a lot of natural lighting and comfortable seating, perfect for a study session. Their pricing is pretty decent and there is a lot of choices of boba and coffee to choose from.

Family owned Italian restaurant serving great non-chain food.  In addition to great food, also great service.  Met Lou tonight and he made sure we were taken care of and the food was right.  One of my extended families favorite restaurants.  We've been enjoying their pizza for years, and hope to continue to!
Excellent service every time! Able to print, get copies, and ship packages easy peasy

Expecting a little more chicken was a bit dry for me. 
Although quick and nice staff and service 
Will give it another shot!

I get the whole high school kids need a job thing or whatever but I truly feel like this establishment in particular is run by actual retards. Get the wrong food, takes forever, and this buster dude playing cashier just acts like we don't exist when we walk in. I'm genuinely mad and hate myself for having to go through such a terrible place. It's no wonder that people rob this place because they know that they'll get away with it because who is gonna stop them? The slow dumbasses that work at sonic? Yeah right.

Coming from someone who does her own nails and is VERY picky with my pedicures, I was blown away at how well they did. I walked in on my lunch break (11:30am), and luckily beat the 12pm rush! I was super observant and noticed everyone was treated equally, and all of their nail techs did a good job. Their basic pedicure is $30 and includes a foot scrub, small leg massage, and hot stone rub. The deluxe includes a paraffin foot treatment for $40. I've been to several nail salons in the valley and they treat you like dirt and are very "in and out." Q Nails took their time and made you feel valued. I showed the girl who did mine a photo that I found online and asked if she could do a design. She very happily said of course! And let me know right away that would be a $5 design charge. When I was finished she told me to take my time relaxing and using the massage chair if I wanted and to let her know when I was ready to leave where she followed me up front to pay. I'll definitely be back.

Leif is PHENOMENAL to work with!!!! Leif took amazing photos for our wedding and he is very professional and talented! He makes you feel very comfortable (esp since I hate taking photos!) It was a joy to have him be a part of our wedding day - he will capture the moments that are important to you.

Fried egg rolls were excellent!  Pho (I had the sirloin/brisket) 9.95. Hmm. Broth had a taste I'm not familiar with.... nutmeg or cinnamon I'm not sure... broth was cloudy not clear.... probably won't be back.... I would get the egg rolls tho! Also, temp if my soup was warm, I like my soup hot....

We were quite disappointed... we expected more from a Hilton. Our room was quite small and felt like we stepped into an ikea showroom. There was a small walkway into the room and around the bed. The shower pressure made for taking twice as long in the shower. The TV size was nice but the navigation of it was not user friendly. One of our deciding factors was the free breakfast they offered but unfortunately we could now see why it was free. The bananas were brown, the English muffins and bagels were hard and they were constantly out of coffee and even when they did have it, they had no sweeteners for my diabetic husband. We will be traveling back and forth to the Boise area frequently and will not be returning nor recommending anyone.
Nothing to special.. burger kind of dry. Bun kinda dry... tried it probably wont eat it again.

Omg. This place was amazing and not at all the type of place I'd find in Boise. A true gem among stones. 

The decor and ambiance of the place is sensational. I felt transported to another place instantly upon entering the doors. The waterfall behind the sushi counter is just beautiful. 

The food. I ordered the Honey Walnut Crispy Chicken, the only place I have seen this dish elsewhere was at an - until now, unmatched chinese restaurant that was in Orlando. It wasn't presented and tasted phenomenal! 
I ordered a pear sake that accented the meal well and was very smooth. My daughter ordered the duck and noodles. Having never had duck before, it was an instant hit and her new favorite meat, I believe. My husband had the Orange chicken, and he is quite the critic when it comes to chinese food; picky but critical. He gave it 9 out of 10, which is quite high.

The staff was warm and welcoming. Our waiter was funny, attentive and efficient. Overall our experience was a fantastic one! Will definitely make this place a regular go-to! Thanks for the great food and service!

This Ulta Beauty location offers all things beauty.  They have Lancôme and Clinique.  The have a full service Dermologica  private skin room. They also have a full service RedKin salon.  They have Prestige line cosmetics and everyday mass cosmetics.   If you need some help with color matching your foundation and color.  This is the place to go.  The crew is friendly and eager to help
Thank you Krissy! It turned out great! NOT orange :)))) I love it!
Wife and I were told that we should try this place out.... glad we did! Big juicy burgers and awesome fries. A little spendy, but worth it.

Leif is amazing!! We had him for our engagement photos and our wedding day. We couldn't have picked a better person to photograph our big day. He is not only is quick to get back to you about any questions, he also make sure your needs are met in every aspect. He capture our day just perfectly and was fun and easy to work with. We highly recommend him to anyone looking for their wedding day and/or engagement photographer. He is creative in the way he takes his photos and is amazing at capturing the moment. We decided to only have 1 photographer to help with our budget, and it looks like we had two since he capture our day in so many angles and visions.
Great place. Conveniently located. Pet friendly. Clean and comfortable. What more could you ask for?
If you want the best hamburger, fries and ice cream meal in town, you won't be disappointed or hungry.  There's not a lot of seating, but its worth the wait!

Had dinner here tonight and it was a really pleasant experience. The lettuce wraps were very good. Portions were huge. I had the jeweled beef and it was ok. My friend has the honey chicken and she said it was good. There was no wait. The booth was clean and comfortable. Our waitress named Talia (I think) was phenomenal. She was fun and friendly. She did not pressure us to hurry and was attentive without hovering. I would definitely go back again!

This place has been a fixture in Meridian for more than 50 years. 1960s type drive-up service (there are a few picnic tables too, but no inside seating). Great classic burger joint. Very close to highway for those coming to/from eastern Oregon.
This much more pizzeria than Italian Restraunt. Service pretty bad, I would not not go out of my way to come here.
I was in yesterday a missed placed my phone the employees were so outstanding in trying to help great news I found it Thanks Cindy and Monica I also have found my favorite Walmart too
Great service and wonderful place to meet friends. Coffee is just so so but organic and so I'm glad about that.  Coffee is hot!  Very nice.

The best of the best! We go here so much the staff know us and even know our order. I love the pepper seared beef and the potstickers! The staff are really friendly and the manager, Caleb is awesome! Highly recommend!

You already know what to expect here, but this review is for the new location on eagle road (re-located from near the Franklin mall area). 
The new location seems to have more space, it's well organized, and they seem to have a larger in-store furniture selection now. Also, I have had good customer service all 3 visits. (Even with s return). I would suggest signing up for email coupons also- there have been done with significant savings
Amber is the best! Super knowledgable, sweet, calm and soothing. I loom forward to my facials with Amber as a point of relaxation and tending to my skincare health. Highly recommended!

Awful. I was looking for delivery in Boise and I will NEVER eat here again. Ordered Crab Rangoon, some mushroom noodle dish, and a spicy shrimp dish. The mushroom noodles and shrimp were absolutely inedible. The shrimp smelled rancid and was undercooked, I was scared to even try it. The mushrooms were tasteless and the noodles were absolutely mushed and over cooked. I ate one bite and was disgusted. The saddest part though was that the crab rangoon - obviously from a frozen food section of a grocery store - were so bland I couldn't save them with obscene amounts of the jelly (sweet and sour sauce) it came with. 

I thought about calling and telling them how bad they were but didn't want to risk them trying to send me more food. Copying and pasting this review everywhere I can because somehow I missed how truly AWFUL this was. (Oh, and over an hour for delivery less than a mile away from the restaurant.) I'll eat my $35 dollars next time rather than wasting it on this.
Absolute perfection. The service was outstanding.  The restaurant is still relatively new and so they had numerous new employees training.  Everyone was so polite.   The food was also delicious.
Please update your hours online! This is third time we have driven to your location and the place is closed.
They charge for refills of soda..but give you 90% ice. Come on guys, who charges for refills?

I just called (3/7/2020) to see if I was able to make a reservation over the phone... I cannot believe how rude the girl was who answered the phone (Elaine) she was super unprofessional- didn't say hello, didn't say "thank you" didn't even say "goodbye" just slammed the phone up on me when I asked if I could make a reservation for tonight (I couldn't apparently because I had less than 7) I asked what the current wait time is and she acted like I was asking her to give her kidneys. What a joke. I doubt we'll be going there for dinner.

We went for family dinner on a Sunday night, because kids eat free with each adult entrée on Sundays. The kids got really cool bento boxes and they could pick each item in each section of the box. I got a veggie sushi roll. Husband got a fried rice entrée. The veggie roll was a little more expensive than what I'm used to for a veggie roll. But it was tasty. Husband didn't like the fried rice. The music doesn't really fit with the atmosphere, but I think that is intentional. Service is good.

Late lunch, nice looking place but it ends there.
Worst Chinese food we have ever had, old noodles, tuff meats, awful...
We gave them a 2nd chance and sorry we did...
Waiters both times had to go take smoking breaks out front door after ordering and before serving our food. Smoke lingered back inside with them.
TV blaring, TV is on table for employees to watch.
You have been warned...

We take our basset hound and terrier mix to Jay all of the time!  Our girls are our babies and Groomingtails treats them just like their own dog.  Our dogs always come home happy, smelling great, and looking fantastic.  I would highly recommend them.

They got me in quickly bc they were dead. However, the woman doing my nails did not seem interested in doing my nails. She did a crummy job, and then when another customer walked in, she rushed through finishing my nails and left me for the other customer. (There were 2 available employees that could have taken that customer). My nails look mediocre and I am very disappointed in the results. I won't be back.
The wait time there is horrible and the last haircut that I got there certainly wasn't worth the wait.
if you've never had Hawaiian food before this place is pretty rockin.. If your already a fan and have your favorite then this place will definitely do in a pinch

This place is easy to wall past, I did it twice. It's in a square with a taco spot and rice spot. I ordered the Chai Tea Latte and it was good. Not great but good. It earned points for having a Chuck Norris calendar and smiling staff. Oh and they are fast. Like really fast.

We called an order in at 11:30 a.m. to pick it up at noon. Giving that they had an hour to have it ready we expected to be in and out. Nope. Waited for 30 minutes, got passed my multiple servers when finally one asked if I had been helped, she went to check on my order then I didn't see her again. Finally it was ready, the lady quickly handed it to me and was gone before I could ask for anything else. The Pad Thai was pretty good but I wouldn't go back or recommend it to anyone purely on customer service. Or lack there of.

This place is still working out the kinks, but still hopeful that it'll do well in the future as it seems to have good potential to do well.

Drinks: had the Irish Doe which was quite refreshing so I give it a 5/5 for what it's worth. Not entirely sure it's Irish but it was good nevertheless. Also ordered a Guinness which was standard, nothing really to say about it.

Food: Started off with pretzel bites, and like how everyone else stated it only came with 6 small pieces. The flavor of the cheese sauce and pretzels were good, but paying near $1 per bite wasn't worth the price.
For our main course we had ordered the LLT and Boxty and Steak. The flavors were overall good, however we weren't given the option to have the meat cooked to preference so both the lamb meat and steak came out well done. It would've been better if the meat was cooked to a medium, in my opinion. Also the pickled onions went well with the Boxty and Steak and I wish I could've had more per bite. 

Staff: they were understaffed so service was slow. (Only two people working aside from the kitchen staff on a Friday night). Despite the slow service, the staff is friendly and they genuinely made an effort to accommodate and I'm hoping it gets better with time. 

Looking to update this review in the future in hopes of them doing well in the future. (:
Gym is good! Childcare is 10 star worthy! My daughter absolutely loves the team there. I was nervous to leave her during my workouts but they make it so much easier!

This was our first visit and I read reviews while we waited on our food. Someone mentioned the portions were small, and I have to disagree. The portions we good, but the food was outstanding!  It was very fresh and cooked perfectly. I highly recommend this restaurant.  The pear martini was excellent. Try it!  You won't be disappointed!  Outstanding.
Very nice interior and delicious boba tea! Definitely worth a visit and be a regular.

Our cats have enjoyed being spoiled but H3's great food products for about 5 years now!  We wouldn't think of going anywhere else.   Our cats fur is soft as silk with a beautiful shine and the litter box doesn't need cleaning quite as often because of the high quality food H3 provides.  Always there to answer any questions we might have.  Love this store!

Revised review:

Thank you, Louise's for contacting me about this issue! It says a lot about the business when you care enough to correct a situation. 

Our next visit was top notch! Great food, good service.... Everything I expect Louie's to be. We'll be back.

******

Oops. I asked for a table away from the live music (it was too loud) and we were seated at a table in the corner. Must have been forgotten because that was the last contact we had with the waitstaff. Even though the table next to us was served we sat there with our menus and nothing else - not even water. 

We left without ordering.

I have been highly disappointed in this place.. I've been back thinking it was just the time of day.. But each time they mess up my order.. Have super long wait times.. And honestly have crummy customer service.. Highly disappointed because I love the food.. But not when its messed up... Just wow..

I wish I could give them no stars but Yelp won't let me do that. Last summer a different company operated Senske but they recently got bought out and there are now TERRIBLE, DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME & $! 
1. The automated call service said they were coming multiple times and they did not show up. We called the office and the woman on the phone was very unprofessional and had no idea what was going on. 
2. Eventually after several calls they came out.... but did a terrible job! They didn't even touch our side yard or get an even application throughout the yard.
3. We tried to make it right soooo many times but all they cared about was their bottom line. 
DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY, I give them an F-

I joined OTF in the winter to get some cardio in before the summer.  The workouts are awesome and the trainers are great.  The equipment is top notch.  

However, after a few months it was very difficult to get into a class.  They filled up so fast and I started having to schedule a week out.  Then if I missed a class they charged me for it when plans changed.  

Well I went to cancel with it warming up and wanting to do cardio outside.  But it is taking a few months to finally cancel.  The billing program they have is a complete rip off and borderline scam.  They just keep on charging my card month after month even though I wanted to be done long ago.  Be very careful signing up unless you plan to be there for a long time and even then good luck getting into a class.

We haven't been to Louie's in over 15 years . We decided to give it a try as we remembered it to get really good Italian food . 
We ordered the calamari to start . It was very cooked and didn't even come with a piece of lemon to soften the coating . My husband said they could be used a croutons in his salad . 
My daughter ordered the spaghetti with meat sauce and she loved it . 
My husband ordered the gnocchi with three different cheeses on it . He said it was so filling that he only could eat half . He said it was good . 
I ordered the pappardelle with had assorted mushrooms and sausage. It was good other then the sausage was over cooked . 
Each entree comes with choice of salad or soup . We choose salads with caesar dressing and it was good . 
We weren't given bread but I think you can buy garlic knots . 
Overall the service was good .
The meal was okay except for the calamari. 
Hate to say it but we won't be back . It really wasn't worth the 15 min wait we had

It was a struggle for me to find a decent boba place here in the Treasure Valley and this place has so far been the best! Whenever I go here I get the green tea milk tea with boba and it's pretty good! The boba is nice and sweet and has a perfect texture. I'm from Las Vegas so I knew coming here I wasn't going to find a place quiet like the ones I'm used to there but I'm happy I found this place to satisfy my boba cravings!

This sonic location was the bit out of our way but we did go there every day while we were visiting in Meridian Idaho. the customer service here is top-notch it was a pleasure seeing Randy in the drive-through every day. We are looking forward to returning and visiting this location. Drinks were always perfect.
Love! Love! You need to visit this cute local shop. The coffee was good. The "lids" are a nice touch. So thankful for a good boba tea location. #bobatealoversunite

This is my first Yelp review. I find Yelp quite helpful when deciding where I want to spend my hard earned money for some decent food, however, I feel so compelled against the food at "Quik-Wok", I feel forced to write a review.
Again, I am not a foodie, Just a normal joe with a decent palette 

This place deserves absolutely no stars. I honestly BEG all of you to never eat here. Me and my fiance came to Boise from Spokane, WA to go to a concert and decided to rely on delivery, since we usually get amazing food in Seattle whenever we visit. Not only did it take OVER 2 HOURS to get to our hotel, When it got here, we only got through a few bites before both dropping to the floor with some strange form of food poisoning. I've eaten at some dumps in my time, but nowhere I have ever been to could even come close to how absolutely horrible their food is.

I ordered the "Hong Kong Combination", One beef broccoli, and some crab rangoon.
ALL of the noodles in the order were an uncomfortable combination of completely uncooked and then overcooked noodles. I honestly don't know how someone can even make noodles that bad. It must take skill 
The Broccoli beef was completely bland, With all of the beef tasting like some sort of mold.
The crab rangoon was actually the best part, but that honestly doesn't mean anything. The wonton skin on the outside was literally rock hard and the inside made me sicker than I have ever been from food in my life. 

This food was a complete waste of 40 dollars and we HAD to throw it away, to escape it's poisonous quality. 

I would like to close by saying that I am not writing a biased review as so many people do on here, The food was honestly that bad. PLEASE DO NOT EAT HERE. It will save you money on food you are just going to throw away.
Great Gym, the owner Mike really cares about his members, thank you.

As you'll see by my profile I almost exclusively review pho places, I eat it at least twice a week. Having eaten at Vietnamese restaurants all throughout the Pacific Northwest, I feel relatively qualified to give this review. Hopefully management reads it and reacts.  

When I walk in at 11:30 today I was ignored for roughly 5 minutes. Left standing at the front without any acknowledgement whatsoever. The two lady's working the front we grumpy, and not personable. Not what you'd except from a new restaurant trying to build a good reputation. So, management, step one. Train your staff to be pleasant, or hire new staff (Side note... I heard one lady refer the the hoisin as the "brown sauce" ).

I eventually just asked if I could sit anywhere and I was looked at like I had 3 heads....apparently I was supposed to walk up to the counter and order....my bad. 

I had the beef pho (#8) and it was ok. The broth was good as was the beef, not mind blowing, but also not terrible. I would give the pho a 3/5. Some more tips for the owners:

-More than one size option. 
-Chili paste at the table. 
-The basil on my side plate was wilted and old, use fresh basil. 
-The lime on my side plate was the size of quarter, would have been nice to actually get some lime juice. 

If you made it this far, and are looking for great Pho, go to Pho Le on broadway, it is easily the best in Boise if not the PNW. It's worth the drive! 

I will try this place again as it's close to home and I'll be interested to see if they react to any suggestions. More to follow.

I posted a nice review of the new Ling & Louie's last week, but for some reason it was deleted, along with every other positive review for this restaurant. I've posted many reviews on OpenTable.com, and never had one removed (good or bad). Very odd. 

In any case, since leaving the review last week, we've eaten here one more time (three times in all), and had another very nice dining experience. My review hasn't changed, however, we're adding the "Sizzling Surf & Turf" to our list of favorites. Each time, we've received great service and delicious food. 

I have to disagree with another reviewer's comparison to P.F. Chang's. The two restaurants are independently very good, but for different reasons. Although there are a few similar dishes (i.e. lettuce wraps and Mongolian beef - which are great at each restaurant), L&L is more Asian-fusion, and far more family-friendly. A quick review of each menu (online) shows that the prices are very similar, with L&L being a little less than P.F. Chang's in many cases. 

I sincerely hope this review stands, as Ling and Louie's is a fresh new addition to the Boise/Meridian restaurant scene, and is definitely worth a try!

Coffee snob fully satisfied!!! 
The short & sweet is really good. Very sweet but very smooth and not overpowering. 
Pastries are delish. 
My husband had a plain latte and loved it.

It's a gas station that fills growlers! Nice clean gas station that has all the typical gas station stuff. Snacks  drinks and adult beverages. They have wine and beer, they fill your growler or you can buy a new one if you forgot yours. The selection changes often, they have an iPad in the store that has an explanation of the beers, you can also check online before you stop in. There is an automated car wash at this store too. All in all it's a pretty nice clean place to grab your gas and snacks before your next road trip.
Love this place. Pile it high and live it up.  Great selection of veggies and fresh meat
Great, local coffee shop! We had several drinks and all were amazing. The service is top notch as well.

My boyfriend and I love this place!  It is very inexpensive and clean.  The salad bar has pretty much everything you can imagine to put on your salad.  The side dishes, hot dishes, and soups are OK too, but simple.  Overall, if you want a couple of plates of delicious salad, this is the place.

We ordered take out for 2 on a Tuesday night.  My wife tried to order a vegetable only, happy bowl and was told they would have to charge $2 extra for that?  The fried rice was stale and flavorless.  The spicy chicken was dry but spicy.  The best part of meal is the gyoza teriyaki sauce which we received 1 small portion of with our entire meal.  At least we got to eat dinner without cooking, but we will never eat here again.  We feel they put as little effort into making food and valuing their customers as possible, which is why we will never be one again.  Prices are ridiculous for the food received.  Save yourself the dissapointment of eating at this establishment.
Great place to go for lunch! The food was good and they had a nice selection. Potatoes Mac and cheese yum

Not recommended due to terrible service. Ordered for delivery, they showed up and didn't give us the right order after it took over an hour to get there. Called back and they didn't get it right after the second attempt. Called to talk to a manager multiple times, they never called me back. Terrible customer service and follow up.

Had a great experience at Big Jud's Meridian! This was my first time at this location (I've been to the original Boise location twice previously). Service was wonderful, drink order was taken when we were given our menus and drinks arrived quickly in very large glasses, which we loved. 

The Bacon Cheese burger was exactly as I remembered it; delicious!!  My husband and I shared a small fry (about 1/2 lbs of fries). They were great, but I noticed they came out unseasoned. Our table had salt and pepper so we seasoned ourselves. Personally, I prefer the tots over the fries, but my hubby prefers their fries. Overall, rest first visit and we plan to come back more!
Kris arrived right on time and was an absolute pleasure to work with. I highly recommend her services! :)

Heard so many good things about this place so we decided to have lunch there. We both had the special of the day which was fish and chips. It was so bad neither of us could finish our meal. 

We tried it once and that was enough. Will never go back.

I really hate giving bad reviews but this was a bad lunch.

This is a very good old-fashioned diner with daily specials.  It is tucked away in a cluster of businesses with limited.parking. 
Good food. Good wait staff.  Will be back.

Amazing workout experience, from the staff to the coaches!  I attended 2 classes while working in Boise, first class was with LeeAnna, 2nd workout I had was with Shannon.  Both coaches kicked ass, super energetic, very positive, and made you push yourself.  The staff was excellent, very friendly, with high fives and checking on me if I'm good.  This is my spot to get my after burn effect when I'm in ID.  Definitely would recommend this location.

Finally - a new restaurant in Boise/Meridian that isn't a sports bar, burger joint or massive chain!  We've eaten here twice for dinner since their opening last week, and have been very pleased both times.  We're especially hooked on these items:

 - Mongolian Flatbread (appetizer)
 - Spicy Ahi Tempura Roll (appetizer)
 - Loaded Sliders (entree - made with filet instead of ground beef - YUM)
 - Seared Ahi Salad (entree - refreshing and delicious)

Here's a tip:  Save room for the Banana-Caramel-Cheesecake Spring Roll dessert - even if you have to take it home.  A friend told us about it and said we had to try it.  Boy, was she right - we fought over the last bite, and we almost never order dessert.   

The only issue we experienced during our two visits was with the Louie's Spare-ribs:  really good flavor, but they were just a little too cold upon arrival.  This will surely improve, once all of the new-restaurant kinks are worked out (it was the first night they were open, after all).  The wasabi mashed potatoes that came with the ribs were amazing, though.

Overall, L&L has a hip, upscale atmosphere, worthy of dates and clients, but is still appropriate for families.  Very nice seperate full-bar area, too.  Delicious well-priced menu with great service.  We'll be back for sure!

The facility is nice and clean but I have had multiple bad experiences here with either bad customer service or just no customer service at all. 

I've come to accept I'm not Walmart's target shopper, is rather pay more for a higher quality product and experience and am not nearly as price sensitive as their regulars must be to tolerate bad customer interactions.

They are a new hotel in Meridian. The staff are friendly and helpful. The rooms are equipped with stove, microwaves, sink, fridge. The bathroom are decent size.  Free wifi. I slept amazing after a 12 hour drive in the bed.

I went in here to get a haircut.  I signed in with one person ahead of me.  45 mins later and at least 2-3 stylists doing nothing, I decided to leave.  I expect to wait when its busy.  I don't expect to wait with no help.  It was the most ridiculous thing I've seen.  Rather then confront them, I just left irritated.  Of course, they knew i was there.  I will never go here again.

This is a great store at the Village at Meridian--found out it was almost brand new.  They have great accessories and helped with my Boise State son's phone---great service.  This store knows what they are doing.  Highly recommend.
These people are great at getting you in when you need to go in and always return phone calls.   I do believe they know what they are doing.  Couldn't be more please with this office.
Aaaaamazing junk food, drive in style. Served HOT.  The onion rings are perfect. Hamburgers...yum. right downtown old Meridian Idaho.  Good stuff Maynard.

Friendly atmosphere with casual and classy vibes. Great selection of beers, plugs at all the tables for laptops, and knowledgeable staff. Cement and wood trim, good kitchen selection of standard bar food.

This was my 1st time at Ling & Louie's, and it was for my birthday. The food was the best I remember having for quite some time, just in general. Malory was our server, and she was very pleasant. So you know, they don't offer anything special for your b-day, except wishing you a warm, happy one!

Specifically, since 1st timers, and wanting kind of a sampling, we ordered California rolls, Philadelphia rolls, pot-stickers, crab won tons, and split the Lo Mein with beef. We would reorder everything, except the Philadelphia, only because we like different ingredients/flavors more.

Why I gave 4 stars is because there is room for improvement.
1) There was no one front of house when we arrived at around 4 PM, and we had to wait for someone to arrive, greet and seat. It wasn't long, but not good that front of house is ever vacant.
2) The booth seats need to be reupholstered ASAP...hubby had to sit on cracks, which immediately downgrades ambiance and customer experience.
3) Regularly dusting blinds should also be done more often, as ours were caked.
4) It did take a while for us to get our check, so coverage between 4-6PM should be increased (See also #1.)
5) We could hear chit chat from behind the food prep counter (i.e. who one employee hired to kill his crab grass), which should never happen.

We'll definitely at least order take out there in the future, and if in-house again, hope for an even better experience next time!

This woman is down right awesome. 

Just made the move from San Francisco to Livermore (crazy the things we do for love) and Krissy has quickly become a staple in my beauty routine. The solution she uses is natural and not orange. However, I'm most thrilled that I talked her into getting the "Rapid Tan" solution... where you can shower three hours after getting sprayed! This is pure gold to me, because the one thing I have a hard time with is sleeping with a spray tan on. I love it. Went back to SF last weekend for a bridal shower and my girlfriends couldn't believe that my tan was sunless! So natural! 

Thanks, Krissy! See you soon!

This place is wonderful!  Very clean and has an extremely pleasant, clean smell! Truly very dog friendly!  They welcomed our dogs with a reasonable dog fee.  There's a nice doggie potty area just outside of the hotel to the side.  An extremely nice kitchen area and a nice bathroom too!   Plenty of chargers for all of our electronics!  We will definitely come back to this hotel and we highly recommend it!

Sherry and I stopped in for half-priced apps during happy hour on a Sunday night.  We ordered a wedge salad, boneless wings, chicken wonton tacos, and a sangria to share.  While the wings were tasty and spicy, the green goddess dressing served with the wedge (they would not substitute blue cheese) ruined it, the wonton tacos were unremarkable, the sangria, while good, was mostly ice, and the service was very slow.  Overall a disappointment.
Kids Again provides a decent store credit option for consigned clothes and toys. Selection is a bit more sparse above toddler sizing but there are some great deals on brand new with tags items.

The hotel itself is really not that bad. It has a decent fitness room, a decent sized pool, breakfast in the morning and the front desk people were nice. But the room smelled SOOOOO BAD. We were pretty sure it came from the A/C unit so we turned that off and opened the window as far as we could, but this is not the first time we've had bad smelling rooms at Best Westerns. We thought that in addition to the A/C unit it's also the cleaning products, because it was a similar bad smell to the last few Best Westerns we stayed in. For this reason I would not recommend staying here because you'll have to put up with the smell all night and it ruins the rest of the experience. C'mon, Best Western. Get it together.

The rooms are nice, indoor pool is great, and I would've rated it higher except for one major problem. There is a serious shortage of parking because they share a parking lot with the Motel 6 next door. When we asked about parking, we were told to park across the street at Winco. It was a hike all the way down to our room on the opposite side of the building. Also, the walls are so thin we were woken up by the people in the next room having a normal conversation.
I had the swimming duck and it was swimming YUCK! They spilled vodka on my plate and lit it on fire but not all the alcohol burned off so it tasted like some one dumped vodka on my food it was gross!

Didn't stand behind their work. =(
Took my truck in to have my drive line carrier barring and u-joints replaced, $450 later thought everything was great.
I was within the one years parts and labor warranty, I noticed a vibration and a pin/metal on metal noise.
Thinking it was my drive line I took it into Les he looked at it and said my transmission was going out and charged me $45.
This would be a very costly repair so I got another opinion. The second mechanic found the rear u-joint was bad (one that Les replaced) He greased it up and my metal on metal noise was gone. I then called Les and told him what was going on he said he knew the parts were good and it was not the u-joint. He said if it will make me happy he will put a new one in so we scheduled it. The day I showed up to drop my truck off Les said "He wouldn't waste his time working on it and he knew his parts were good"..............Then fed my BS about it not being my u-joint again. Well I tried to get him to honor his work and make it right but he refused. Took my truck back the second mechanic u-joint changed out my vibration is gone and truck back to normal. Sadly I ended up paying for the u-joint 2 times and another $45 to Les feeding me BS about it not being the u-joint he replaced and gas driving to and from his shop.

I will never be returning and would never recommend Friends or Family to Super Tune.

Better late than never! Kris is fantastic! Kris gave me the most natural looking tan for my wedding day. I was more than happy. I had her do my tan before to test it out and per her recommendation she told me to pay attention to what day following the tan I felt like I had the perfect color, which was day 3. We did my tan 3 days before my wedding which was great. No unnatural color, no streaks, no spots. Highly recommended! On top of that she travels to your house which couldn't make it any more convenient. Using her again this week before my sister wedding!

Both Perx security company and Perx pest control are the best in the Treasure Valley! Cody our tech for the pest spray was awesome to work with and very informative of the process! The company is local and overall have had a positive experience both with my security alarm and pest control. Would recommend either service to people who need a reliable and affordable option!

Stop looking for auto detailers, you have found the right one.  I am relocating from San Diego to Eagle and needed to have my SUV detailed after two trailer loads and 3000 miles of driving.  Jacob worked non-stop from 8:00 AM to 4:30.  He made my Tahoe look new again.  He also washed another truck and my trailer. You will not find a more diligent worker who really cares about making your vehicle look perfect.  I plan on calling them regularly for keeping my cars looking like new.  You will very happy.  Plus booking on line and the confirmation was perfect.

I have no idea what you guys are talking about... I've been there a couple of times a year ago and both times the food was great! The first time we ordered a sun-dried tomato and basil pizza. Everyone thought it was amazing. Second time I'm not sure what we ordered, but we also got the dessert (a picture of which i posted here). I think whichever pasta we ordered was a little dry but besides that everything tasted good and dessert was delicious. We got a table in the outside seating area and the whole experience was really really nice. Maybe you just went there on a bad day. Every place has one of those.

The general manager mike is amazing he really took the time to speak to me and addressed all my concerns with patience and professionalism. Very impressed with all their staff and the cleanliness and new machines!

This is my favorite theater in the Boise area. It's not the newest or prettiest and it doesn't have the amenities of some of the newer theaters in the area, like VIP seating, alcohol, cafe, dinner, etc. but most of us don't need all of that right?  I go to other area theaters and appreciate those amenities sometimes, but I usually walk out with the same complaint- the seats aren't comfortable. Too short, too rigid, or conforms to one body type (not sure what that body type is, but it's not 125 lb female). I end up squirming throughout the flick. Oh, and the worst offense?  Squeaky!  100+ brand new pleather seats all rubbing together anytime anyone moves is distracting. 

Movies nowadays are longer and longer in duration so I appreciate a seat that doesn't offend my body. The Majestic provides a clean, comfortable place to watch a movie on the big screen. The seats are soft and deep enough to sink down into without getting lost and they're quiet!  

Other important PROs:
Nice staff, good popcorn, clean, convenient show times for movies about to exit the theater, and convenient location.

We love Pho and the sandwiches. Decided to try this place out yesterday and back today to try something else. The food is amazing and fresh! The bread on the sandwich was perfect. The veggies on the sandwich are lightly pickled and delish. We will be back.

I would like to give this restaurant more stars but as I was waiting for my pick up my order.. a woman I can only assume was a manger was loudly berating a bartender in front of customers, it was very unprofessional and cause many patrons to feel very uncomfortable. Regardless of what the bartender may or may not have done that was unacceptable way to handle it

Still would rate this place a zero. 
Susan of 10 years - customer service I only asked to switch money out into larger bills. 
Horrible fucking attitude and after she was done counting it all she said was "here you go."
Like your guys' employees fucking suck with "customer service." The way she looked at me and the way she handled it was just fucking rude. 
You guys won't do shit about it either right? Fuck you walmart on your shorty responses on customer complaints. 
And I still shop here! How sad.

I don't normally complain about food, because I love food! But.... 

My boyfriend ordered me food at Quik Wok in Meridian for delivery at 5:05. All that was ordered was teriyaki chicken and crab rangoons. With tip total was 20 bucks. Website says 1hr delivery time and left a phone number to contact with any issues.

6:25 rolls around and still no food, so I call the number on the screen. I asked about my order and the guy could not locate it with name or phone number. So I give him the address and order content and he puts me on hold. A minute or so later he comes back and says he found that order and address but it has a name and phone number that isn't mine or Jay's. Then he tells me it's for cash, but I paid with card. He continues with an apology and says it's starting to cook and will be there shortly.

At this point I was upset because we are close to an hour and a half and it just started to cook so I wouldn't receive it until 7 PM. I asked about cancellation and he said it take 7 business days for a refund. I asked to speak to a manger at that point...

Manager answers and I explain my frustration. She apologizes and tells me they are very backed up and that's why the website says to call for delivery time after you place it. I still had the website pulled up and read to her what it says, which was nothing of the sort. It stated that its take approximately an hour. She then tells me I'm looking at the Boise website and the Meridian one says different. So I tell her I am on the Meridian website, because it says it on the page that I just read her and she continued to argue and tell me I am wrong. I decided I wasnt going to waste the time arguing over what I clearly can read and ask about my food. She said it will get to me when its ready. 

So after two hours of waiting and rude customer service I received my food (with no fork or napkins). The crab rangoons were pretty delicious, but the chicken was gross. I was able to eat 3 pieces, because the rest was fat. I picked it off and ate some of the rice before I discovered that most of was rock hard. 

Needless to say I got over the fact they were rude, and decided to wait because I was hungry and didnt want to wait 7 days for a refund. Food and service was awful and I do not suggest ordering take out from them.

Gave me sound advice on various things I wanted to change on my wedding dress. Alterations were done for much less then what I was quoted at other places around the valley. They got my dress altered and back to me fairly quick.
We went here for Mother's Day. The ambience was lovely, waiters very friendly and food delicious! You can really taste the quality and tenderness of the steaks. We'll definitely be back!

Not very good at all. The server was great, but the food was terrible. The spicy tuna rolls were so hot that they lost flavor, the fried rice was basically rice soaked in soy sauce and the miso soup was a bit on the salty side. There are far better Asian restaurants in Boise.

"We had PiP come out to wash and wax our 36' RV. They did a great job! Their pressure washer broke down, but they just hooked up the hose and finished the job, no problem. They got it nice and clean, waxed and ready to be stored for the winter. Thanks guys, nice job! We will surely have you back."

I'm so glad I found Krissy on yelp and will be calling her for any of my tanning needs from here on out. I used to go to Spray Soleil in Pleasanton, but after my last visit the tan i got washed off really fast and left me pasty on my vacation, so I turned to yelp and luckily found Krissy. She charges much less than i was paying at Spray Soleil, and you don't even have to leave home. My tan was by far better than any I'd paid for prior, and the service was quick and easy. Krissy was super friendly and made the experience totally comfortable, and was nice enough to leave a sample of a tan extender lotion. I will definitely be a repeat customer and highly recommend her services.

Wow isn what i can say about my first experience shopping here! I went in looking for a specific brand of dog food, and while they had the brand it was a gigantic bag that i did not want to commit to buying that much yet for my newly adopted senior pug! I believe it was the owner who helped me and he was so knowledgeable and easily suggested another brand of food in a smaller bag to try! He let me know that thy have a 100% satisfaction guarantee and if my pug doesn't like the food we can bring it back for a refund! He also gave me a loyalty card where every time we purchase a bag of dog food the card gets marked and our 12 bag is free! I then asked for suggestions on dog bones and was educated on the different types and what's good and bad! They also gave me a big bag full of different treats for my dogs for free! I absolutely suggest this locally owned store, they went above and beyond my expectations and you can tell they are true animal lovers and want nothing but the best for our beloved animals! Thank you so much for the fantastic experience!
My go to place.  Always guaranteed good service and well prepared plate.  Drinks and happy hour  are great as well.  Staff is helpful and pleasant.

Wow!!  We tried this new pizza place for lunch!  What a pleasant surprise!  Service was awesome and the pizza was delicious!   I had the pesto chicken pizza, with thinly sliced zucchini and red tomatoes!  It's well worth supporting this new restaurant
Best happy hour for sushi. Great service and cool vibe. Just wish it wasn't all the way down Eagle rd. But I highly recommend.

My wife and I have eaten here twice now and definitely won't be returning. The first time the food was mediocre. The only thing that made it worth the price was our happy hour discount. The service was also decent. As a result we decided to try it again with some friends. This time we were far less impressed with the food. My wife works at a Thai restaurant and I know what good Thai food tastes like. The Thai dish I ordered was close to $20 and I wouldn't have paid half that for what I got. On top of that my wife ordered fried rice with her meal, not only did the waitress fail to tell us this option was extra, but when her meal arrived it was white rice and not what she ordered. This wouldn't have been a problem to fix if our waitress had been around. After taking our order we never saw her again. Somebody else brought our food out and another staff member set our checks on the table about half way through the meal and quickly walked away not even giving us time to ask for anything. Our waters never once got refilled. Not once were we asked if we needed anything. Our waitress never even came back to let us pay. We took our checks up to the front entrance and had to flag someone down just so that we could leave. We agreed as a group to never return.

Kris was amazing!! I tested her out for my bachelorette party and she was fabulous. I'm fairly pale, and she did a great job at making me look very natural. I was also very nervous because I'm not comfortable in underwear in front of other people, but she made me feel better and chatted to keep me distracted. Everyone said it looked like I had gotten some healthy sun. I booked her for my wedding, and will definitely use her in the future!

We love going to groomingtails. 

It's the customer service that continues to bring us back.

When the owner sensed that we weren't happy with our last grooming appointment he made an offer that was hard to refuse. 

 thank you for going the extra mile.

I have been coming here since it was $2 a garment. I understand as everything else increases in price so do they. Always get great service and they do a great job. Highly recommend them if you're in the area.

We always enjoy visiting Ling & Louie's. This time we took our daughter and her family. Our son-in-law requires a gluten free menu and found a wide selection of gluten free menu items to choose from. We all enjoyed our meal  and I especially enjoyed the tender beef in the Mongolian Beef dish. There were no leftovers to box up and bring home. Friendly and helpful waitstaff. The children's Bento boxes were appreciated by both grandchildren.

Saw this new restaurant going in and had to give it a try. I have to say that we really enjoyed it. Amazing atmosphere and amazing staff tending to your every need. If you've never been here before, make sure you come hungry. Don't load up on the salad bar, which is amazing, because they're walking around with numerous types of beef, pork, chicken and shrimp. You're going to want to load up on that. We ate a ton of jumbo shrimp and filet mignon.  The Parmesan crusted pork loin was incredible. Vincent the manager is a great guy and stopped by our table several times to make sure everything was perfect.

I was hesitant on another first time nail salon experience, seeing as L.A Nails was my last :/....... yikes.... but this was on the opposite end of the spectrum. The lady was SO nice. She did an amazing job and did not harass me about the way I like my nails shaped, and glady put blood dripping off the tips, even though it's November. TOTALLY CHILL atmosphere. VERY calm, casual, relaxed environment, filled with people who do not hate their lives. Refreshing and necessary! Even though I was not looking forward to L.A traffic on Eagle Rd. with a bunch of a-hole drivers, it is SO worth the drive out of Boise, and into the cluster muck traffic becomes. I left feeling beautiful and positive, and isn't that the ideal feeling in a nail OR hair salon experience? No complexes developed. Also. Tina. Tina is the nicest lady ever.Painstakingly detail oriented which really floats my Virgo boat :D.

What is not to like about this place? This is always my go-to for the unique gift or household item I can't find anywhere else. When I am looking around town for a item, I don't know why this isn't my first stop because this is usually my last stop and it always has it. Prime example: I searched four places on Saturday for a sushi mat, yup, found one here in a mini kit for $3.99. 

I love this place too much! My dining room table and high top chairs are from here. I think some items are high priced but join their club and get coupons! I bought each of my chairs and table with a 30% off coupon. I love their coffee and foreign food and wine in the back. I love their lamps and rugs and couches and curtains and chairs and dishes and silverware and coffee mugs and stickers and and shelves and pictures and patio furniture and... and... and now I just need to win the lotto so my whole house can be World Market-ized!

The only reason I put 4 stars over 5 is because often their sale prices don't ring up and you have to be that person that questions while holding up the line. Doesn't happen every time I am shopping there but it happened to all of my chairs. It got to the point that I just paid the extra 10% that wasn't ringing up to just not be the woman holding up the line.

No matter, I love this place! Everyone is always helpful and fun.

I don't recall ever giving a hotel five stars and for this place I just can't be honest giving it anything less. It is clean, the staff is friendly, breakfast is decent, coffee is hot even in the afternoon, beds are comfortable, the halls are wide, there are excellent sitting areas and much more.  My wife are currently in a three day stay and I would sure come back.

Husband had surgery got a whole 5 min with him before taken back. Was not able to be in room while they put in iv or woke up. This is not right at all. They should not have to wake up to only a strange face. I never have why does he. He was so pissed and also no pain meds after surgery just use tylenol and ibuprofen and if that does not work go to the er. Thst is wrong why should we have to pay for an er bill because you failed to give him anything at all. With His surgery a numbing spray would of been amazing that is all but no. If a loved one cant be in the room during wake up we cant adviocate for him if something goes wrong. He also has no eyes to make sure he is being properly cared for. He was not Being cared for at all like we would of liked to see. Nothing lferd for his pain while in paitent at all. No question of his pain scale. IUI GET YOUR CRAP TOGETHER. I will also be writing a formal complaint too not just behind a keyboard.

Had Andy do some sheetrock repair for me, he was very courteous and efficient and most important "trustworthy", he is very detail oriented and makes sure you are totally satisfied with his work. I have total confidence in him to complete any future tasks around our home...HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!

All the drinks are delicious here!!! I love this place!!! If you love boba, lychee, popping boba with a refreshing drink, then this is the place to be. The place has a very relaxing feel and the customer service is outstanding !
Our family loves to eat together at Louie's!  Their lunch and Sunday buffets are our favorite!
Prompt accurate diagnosis and treatment, especially when you are far from home, make this a great experience.

I have eaten there twice. Last time was a call in order, which I still had to wait for awhile to get when I got there. . The pho is great. It comes with lots of side bags to add to your pho to specialize it he way you want.

I had a great experience here. I came in for a cleaning, and everyone was so friendly and accommodating, and explained all the procedures in detail. The dentist himself was the one who greeted me and led me inside. The office is brand new with top notch equipment. And the price for the cleaning can't be beat. Highly satisfied!

I believe in this group of trainers and therapist above all others in the valley. Not only have they been a big piece of my sons athletic success but they have also helped the professional fighters I represent get prepared for competition.  I would recommend R&A to anyone looking for an athletic  edge or in need of highly trained physical therapy.

Two stars  for their hot fudge milkshake... one for everything else.  Their hot dogs are way too salty.  I wonder if their burgers are also...   people who work here are all very young.  I wonder who manages the place?  Are these kids left alone to manage it themselves?  Curiouser and curiouser...
I've used Krissy for over 2 yrs now and couldn't be happier with her work. The tan is natural, long lasting and perfectly blended.  She's my go to gal for a beautiful tan.

After a disappointing first experience, the manager invited us back. Tonight not only was the food amazing, the service was impeccable. James was an attentive and charming server who made sure we wanted for nothing. The endless array of meat was all tasty and cooked perfectly. The salad bar was well stocked with anything you could possibly want. the atmosphere was romantic, and it seemed as if the restaurant had figured out its flow even down to the tiniest details. We will definitely be back and are so excited for this new addition to the valley!

This was my first visit to Riverbend Family Dental. 
I did all my paperwork online and scheduled my appointment online. 
My appointment was at 730 am. When I got there I was greeted at the door by the dentist. The office was clean and bright and very welcoming. 
They took me right back to the exam room. The exam was fast and quick but the Dr took time to show me the digital xrays and we came up with a plan. He answered my questions and made sure I understood what he was talking about. 
The whole experience at Riverbend Family Dental was a pleasant one. Will be back for sure.

This is one of my favorite pho places. Great costumer service and love it every time.  I ask for extra noodles and they always prepare it to my own taste. Wouldn't go anywhere else for pho. Highly recommend.

I wish I would have read the reviews here first. I asked for a 6-hour move out cleaning. A three-man crew ended up being there for 3 hours. When I showed up an hour into the process, two of them were already "taking a break" in their car.  

My wife and I had already cleaned both bathrooms and two of the bedrooms ourselves and we had marked that these did not need not be cleaned. During the walk-though, they took credit for cleaning these areas. Unfortunately, the rest of the house looked like crap. They swept, cleaned the laminate flooring in the living room and kitchen, and wiped down the appliances. I'm not sure they actually did anything else and I spent hours cleaning up after them. 

As an insult to injury was I got charged for a 9-hour job even though I had requested 6 hours.  I shouldn't have to babysit a cleaning crew or review everything little thing on their walkthrough list.  When you pay for a service you expect an honest return. I wouldn't allow these people back on my property if a return was offered for free.
I have been there twice , I got tons of clothes for my little girl . The customer service is really good ,I really like this store.

I came here not that long ago and the food has good taste. A little to much spicy, but other than that , great. The waitress however, didn't like the attitude. The energy was just off and I guess since it was a big party, I get it. Feeling overwhelmed and possibly working all day, but you just have to give it your all this your shift is over. Hopefully there's another restaurant in Cali, I'd like to give it a go once more.

Came in Saturday for lunch and it was fantastic. My wife and I had the manicotti, Lasagna, and salad. All the food was top notch and the service was also. I do not know why people waste their time going to other Italian places in the Boise area when this gem is in the Treasure Valley. We definitely will be back next time we are in the area.

I went there because I had a gift certificate. I won't ever go back and I encourage anyone considering giving them business to go elsewhere. I got gel polish done for upcoming Christmas parties. The woman who did my nails barely spoke english. I felt I couldn't communicate exactly what I wanted, and during my visit her and another employee spoke in their native tongue and I was ignored. It was an uncomfortable situation to say the least. 

I have had gel polish in the past. The lady who did them here used gel overlay and gobbed it on over the glitter.  When I put my hand under the light it BURNED! This has not been my typical experience. When I quickly took my hand out from the light, the woman doing my nails told me to put it back and then started talking to her coworker in their language and giggling.  The finished product was thick and uneven when comparing my hands against each other. My nails were tender for 2 days!

All the ladies in my office (we all got gift certificates here) had terrible experiences. There's about 6 of us who went there in December. One had their gel polish chip on multiple fingers within a day, went back to have it fixed, and it chipped again within a couple days. Another colleague got a pedicure, had the same language barrier issue and was left sitting without being told if they were done while the woman helping her took a new customer. Please take your business to a place that has quality work, cares about their customers, and is able to communicate effectively!!

I had an issue with my water heater recently. I noticed the problem at night and didn't want to risk the heater leaking all night. I called Roto-Rooter and they sent a plumber out. He offered to replace the water heater that night . The heater was only a year old so I wanted to wait until morning to see if it was under warranty. When the company who installed the heater came out in the morning they noticed that it was not a problem with the heater at all. It was the cold water intake pipe leaking. So they replaced the pipe which took about 5 minutes. My issue with Roto-Rooter is that they should known it was only a pipe. I paid $287 for the tech to come out. During that time he offered to replace the water heater twice. It makes me wonder if they were just trying to sell a new water heater. So I paid $287 to Roto-Rooter and they did nothing. I ended up having to pay the company in the morning $150 to fix the pipe. The way I see it that's $150 I wouldn't have had to pay if Roto-Rooter had fixed the pipe. I called Roto-Rooter twice and expressed my concerns. Each time the manager was not available but was going to call me back. I never received a call back.

UPDATE:7/22/16 2nd time being at BigJs...

I had hope things had changed.... Sadly... Much of the same. Walked in @ 7:15pm...3 other parties waiting before us. I made eye contact with many servers that came up to the hostess area- no one greeted us for about 6 min. 

I knew it wasn't a good sign when they sat us at our table in the back- every table we passed had Zero food. 

Took about 45min to get served mushroom bacon burger. Meat completely over cooked and dry. Fries under seasoned and Greasy- 

Ranch and Onion rings were fantastic. 

We may come back if people from out of town want to check it out- or we will have to try their Milk Shakes. 

Sodas are still humongous.  



ORIGINAL REVIEW:

Very first visit on 4/22/16 (Friday) 6ish- with a party of 6+high chair

Told a 40min wait- and got seated 35 min later. 

Food took over 30min to get served 

Service was slow- but hope it gets better.

Burgers were over cooked- although we weren't asked how we liked them cooked. 

2 from our party fell ill after leaving, until the next day. 

Didn't get any dessert- might be the only thing we get if we go again Was hoping for something better. 

Bacon on my burger was the best thing on it- Ranch dressing was delicious.

They lure you with old school appearance, cool sign and name. You think "OHHH! old timey burgers and fries served curbside, like by a car hop!"

What you get  a slobby disinterested server and an unseasoned frozen burger patty filled frozen fries. Despite the name of this place, i couldn't  get an onion slice for my burger.

"but you sell onion rings!" I protested

"they're frozen" she retorted/

Of course!! Was I thinking!

Pretty pricey and not that great. Hubs says he prefers Panda Express. OUCH! 
The noodles in my dish and my husbands dish tasted charred (like they were cooking in a wok that something had burned in?) 
Flavor was greatly wanting. Wishing we had went to yardhouse instead. Sorry to leave such a poor review, maybe we caught them on a bad night..

Dr. Eaton and his staff were very pleasant and professional to work with. I was able to get two appointments (initial consultation and then the actual root canal) within a week of first contacting the office -- essential! During my root canal I had no pain at all, and the whole procedure only took 40 minutes from me walking in the office front door to walking out again with it all done. This was two days ago -- still no pain! I would recommend Blue Creek Endodontics to anyone.
I love bringing my Corgi and my Chocolate lab here. Everyone is so nice, the prices are fair and I don't worry about leaving my pups. Hands down the best groomers around!

I ordered milk tea, rooibos tea, and condensed milk latte and they were all delicious. Boba was perfectly cooked and chewy. I also tried sweet toast...sweet buttery heaven. I am gonna come back tomorrow. :)

I have been to this restaurant a few times while visiting my parents in Idaho and we have always had a very pleasant experience here! The food is amazing and we never have had a bad waitress/ waiter. Tonight we had a group of 8 adults and 4 kids under the age of 2. We really couldn't ask for better service. Our waitress, Ashley, was super friendly and fast. We always had full drinks and did not have to ask for anything. Also, they delivered the kids meals first, which is so nice for the parents :-) We love this restaurant and will definitely continue to come and dine here!!

DELICIOUS!!!
Come starving because the salad bar and meat selection can be overwhelming and very filling.
All the options at the salad bar were fresh and delicious. All the meat was cooked perfectly, seasoned well, and just all around delectable.

Good experience. I had a septic tank emergency early morning. Roto-Rooter changed their schedule to meet my needs and came out with in a 2 hours of calling and cleared out the problem fast so I could get on with my day.
Horrible customer service. Sherry the waitress is rude and snobby. Food is great, but needs better management.
AMAZING. went here for a duluxe pedicure, such incredible and unique services. A great energy for my feet, for an unbeatable price. This place does not disappoint !!!! Highly reccomend
They always make you feel like your more than just another client. Very friendly, and so good with our dog.

I was actually very disappointed with this place. I was told that this location was better than Nampa's (which I haven't tried). 
Lets start with the service. With a name like HAPPY Teriyaki, the guy at the counter sure wasn't at all happy to be there. Literally drops the check on the table and runs, then picks it back up and doesn't even stop. Doesn't smile or talk at all. It was just really awkward. There was a girl working in the front with him who was sweet and she was working hard the entire time. 
I think the food was a little pricy. The teriyaki chicken was good, not great. That's okay though. The rice was.....interesting. Haven't really had this kind that I can remember. 
I probably will only come back for the bubble tea.
I got the Bacon Bacon burger and have to say it was the most flavorful burger I have had! I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a good meal!

Sunday brunch review only..  I will start by saying $10.99 for Sunday brunch is more than reasonable,  and a large Variety of breakfast lunch entrées to select from.  The omelette station and huge selection of desserts are also included.  

When entering the Restaurant this Sunday morning there was about 5 people behind the counter and all were very nice and welcoming when we Arrived at noon two hours before the buffet closes.
