So here's where things are kind of disappointing.   Overall presentation not appetizing,  Quality of the food not the best, and the Combination of wings and clams was just a bit odd.  Louise is known for their pizza but I was unable to get any on this Sunday. I'm not sure why they didn't have more people working on the buffet and less at the counter.. So not sure I can recommend  Louise for Sunday brunch. Sorry.. 

I will say we have been to a few private banquets and the food and service has been very good in the past, and also the takeout is very good as well.

Dude. favorite store lately. 

High Five to Brian, who rang up my order this afternoon. 8/23/20. He was SO SWEET and helped me with all my member coupons and the free bag. His customer service was great so mostly this review is for him! Haha! 

I found MORE than I needed (as always) in the store today. Planters, Baskets, Food, Little Fun Kitchen Tools. ETC You can find everything in here! And the $9.99 velvet throw pillows in a RAINBOW of colors? YES PLEASE! 

I'm always so thrilled to come in here and see what's new. Their rewards program is freakin' BOMB! Check it out. Find something beautiful and unique. Its def. worth a stop!

We had pizza in Napoli last May and have been trying to find a restaurant that was something like it.  We had to travel from Dallas to find it!  This quaint little place is spot on and I swear I was back in Italy.  Perfect crust and sauce.  Too bad we have to go back to Texas.

The service Is not bad, but twice my Husband and I went and felt like we didn't get the full meat rotation and the meat we did get was a bit over done for our taste. The salad bar is very nice and has something for everyone.

I will start off with the good stuff first.  It is very clean and even with a large waiting list it goes pretty quickly.   The Hot Towels was nice.

Now this is supposed to be a place for the 'GUYS" to go.  They don't do color so don't expect a full service place.  As I sat there I noticed they something called an MVP level this is a shampoo, cut, head and shoulder massage.

So okay I get this young lady who cuts my hair and she clearly did not know how to handle a head full of cowlicks like mine.  Then they take you the back where you sit in a chair that's shakes and they call that a massage chair (NOT!!).  You lay back and your head goes into a cradle for the wash part.  It is hard and very uncomfortable. The lady washed my hair and I keep waiting for the head massage when all of a sudden she is done.  Then I realize the VERY light circles she was doing as she was shampooing my hair was the head massage.

Then you go back to your chair and they get this small vibrator and run it over your shoulders for like a minute if that long.  That was the relaxing head and shoulder massage.  So it was no wonder 99% of the guys kept saying no just a hair cut.

Your first visit you get the MVP for the price of a regular 19.95 hair cut and that is about what it is worth.   To me TGIF which does color and none of the massage stuff is better and when you get a shampoo at TGIF it is not uncomfortable like Sports Clips.

Not worth the time and effort.  Don't bother.

Ordered delivery,the delivery pace was pretty good. The food was literally aweful. Ate a total of 5 bites before i couldnt drown it in soy sauce enough i gave up.. Just, never again. Terrible, id take frozen food over this any day.ive been to 4 countries and 26 states. Ordered kung pow from every single one. This is by far the worst. A reminder, I ordered kung pow chicken as i usually do. There was literally 2 pieces of chicken in the whole thing. The rest was broccoli and penuts. Order at your own risk. I will say the Asian Nachos are pretty great, the only thing i would change is the wasabi sour cream, but that could be just me im not a fan of anything mixed with sour cream. You should definitely try the nachos.

Went here recently to celebrate a new job and was very disappointed. The server was awesome and very friendly the food however was subpar. The salad was very bitter tasting. I has the spaghetti and meatballs with the marinara sauce. The sauce was watery and bland and the meatballs were tough and over cooked. My wife had the lasagna same watery sauce and burnt on top. The one upside was the garlic bread.

Can we put negative stars?? This place needs it.

Arrived at 5:50pm on a Saturday. Was mostly empty which was odd for this time of day on a Saturday. Ordered after about 15 min. A group of ten but with the empty place we assumed we'd have no problems. About 6:50 the first two meals came. At 7:00 the next two came. Then at 7:05 the next two. 4 people still waiting meanwhile the food is cold for those who were politely waiting assuming food was coming out. Two tables seated after we order led had their food first.

Food wasn't great so it really was hard to say it was worth the long wait. Last dish to come out was cold??? Kids meal with mini burgers were briquettes. He wouldn't touch Em. Our server was continually awol. The other server was rude as heck when we would ask for help. When trying to get a check so we could finally go we got: "I'm not your server. I'm just doing my own thing."

The only consolation was the manger who seemed to really try and do damage control. But the experience was just not a good one.

Avoid this location for the poor delivery.

If I could give 50 stars I would! We are leaving for our Honeymoon in Bora Bora in the morning, my wife realizes that she missed her spray tan appointment, at 8pm I call Kris ( having never used her before) and ask if she could possibly help us out, within 10 minutes my wife is getting a spray tan!!

This is probably one of the best places yet in the Boise area. The service is fantastic and the salad bar is immense with huge variety. The way this works is you come in, sit at the table, they place the napkin on your lap, you basically tell them you want to participate at which time they take your drink order and you proceed to the salad bar to begin. There is another plate sitting at your table that's empty but there is a little disc that's Red on one side and green on the other. When you desire some sort of meat, which is constantly delivered by the skewer carrying waiters around the room, you simply turn your disk to green and they'll stop by and tell you what they have on their skewers. It's all fresh and tastes fantastic.
It's about 45 bucks a head for adults, $25 per child if they do the meat. It's only about $15 if they do just a salad bar and a drink. Suffice to say that our family of five came out of there with a $250 tab.
DOH!!!!
The only way that I could reconcile that high tab was that we don't do it every day, once a year probably, and the boys had a fabulous dining experience.

Super cute! Very modern and "Millienial", but my 40 year old Gen Xer self very much appreciated the thought that has gone into this new chain! The staff here was AMAZING!! The rooms aren't very big, but you're comfortable, I like how they have the soap dispensers ass I imagine it very much cuts back on waste. LOVE the hot coffee 24/7 and when they found out it was my Birthday that day, I even got a free goodie from the snack bar!! 

PS-If you're staying at Tru, you get a discount at Boise Fry Co!!!

The staff is courteous and friendly. However the food is really lacking flavor, other than the fish sauce, the only herb is cilantro. Big disappointment! No basil, all the classic ingredients are missing.  We ordered vermicelli and two rice plates. Sorry to say, it does not taste like Vietnamese food at all.   If not for the chili sauce and Hosin sauce to the rescue the food would have no flavor. I am an Asian from So Cal. The food just does not measure up.  It's time to move on.

This is a great little spot that I hope survives due to location and it's somewhat different cuisine.  The staff is super friendly and welcoming, I really enjoyed chatting about how the concept came about.  Their menu is on the lean side but I'll chalk that up to having great food based on what I ate.  The lamb sandwich was very flavorful and filling.  Whiskey selection looks like it's a work in progress but they've got the staples an Irish themed bar should have.
It's worth a try, stop in, have a pint and a bite with what seem to be really great people who want to provide great food and service.

Horrible!!! We were starving and decided to try out this place. I'm giving them 1 star because the service was great but not the food. I asked what was their popular item and she said the hungry man's burger..so I order that for me. I also order their chicken strips dinner and chicken sandwich as well as their mozz sticks. Took the Oder to go..usually this places give you lots of fries and their burgers are gigantic!! Not this place!! the burger was tasteless, chicken burger over cooked and chicken strips well done! you get about 12 fries with your order and same way...tasteless! Prices are a little high for what you get! Will not go back!

Groomingtails is the best. 

They work great with Patton (my 3yr old Cavalier King Charles Spaniel) and groom him perfectly. Whether it's a summer cut that's shorter or letting his feathers be a bit longer Jay is always conscientious to ask and perform for a super reasonable price. This is the only place I take Patton now.

Such high hopes. Totally disappointed. Been here sitting at a table for over 30 mins. Have asked for food menu multiple times. Still no menu. Not crowded but feels like they're packed. It's because they literally have one server, poor girl. She says she can't find a menu. Not sure why. Whoever owns this place is loosing money big time. Friday night and no turn over.  No sales because no server. Just got my first beer only 40 mins after arrival. So...we'll drink our beer and get out for some food since we can't order without a menu. Don't go. Waste of time.

Being a vertically challenged person, I am always in search of pants with crazy short inseams and places that specialize in hemming. So, recently I needed three pairs of pants hemmed as quickly as possible for an upcoming trip. Fast Alterations came up in a Yelp search and I figured, "Hey, speed is part of their name," so I called and was able to come in right away. In the past I used two dry cleaners near my house who occasionally had a tailor in house. That was a bit of a pain because neither one really kept a regular schedule and you couldn't expect lickety-split service. Fast Alterations has regular hours and is conveniently located just past Zamzows on Overland Road if you take a left off of Eagle. It comes up pretty quick once you take the left and it's a house, so look out for the business sign and turn into the driveway when you see it! One of the drawbacks to the location is that it doesn't have a parking lot and if the driveway has other cars in it, you will eventually have to back out onto Overland Road to leave. (Unless you can stealthily back in if there isn't any traffic on Overland!) What would be the living room has been converted into a front office area with a dressing room and a counter. I was able to try each pair of pants on while the (owner?) marked them. I asked about whether or not she could keep a drawstring on the hem of one pair and she simply said, "No, I can't do that." No biggie for me, because I didn't really use the drawstring. Each pair cost 10.00 to hem and they were done the next day at the same time I dropped them off. They also have same-day service if you are REALLY in a hurry. The other thing that you have to keep in mind is that you are not going to get sweet-as-honey service here. It is a cultural thing. The lady that's there is professional and to-the-point (although she did discuss the weather and give me a smile when I came to pick up the pants). For the most part she is not incredibly outgoing... She is very matter-of-fact, and that's totally fine with me because I have three pairs of pants that won't drag on the ground that I can now take on vacation!

My father and I came to RiceWorks to try something new near us. He had the Korean BBQ beef and I had the Ninja Chicken. Needless to say, we were blown away by how good the food was. The Ninja Chicken was the right blend of spicy and sweet, the Korean beef was amazing. I think we found our new Asian food hangout!
Amazing beer selection!! Great customer service & Atmosphere. Good place to relax with friends or family.

This a "fun sized" hotel. Rooms are small as is furniture. Everything seemed so small and uncomfortable. Chairs and bed were hard. Felt like we were sleeping at IKEA. My kids swam in the pool and ended up very sick. We will NEVER stay here again. Sad because it is so new. But totally obvious that Hilton is skimping.

Food is good, portions are generous. Had a steak overdone, sent it back. Server was great about it, they reduced the meal to half price and manager checked in with us to see if things were taken care of to our satisfaction. They went beyond what we expected and that kind service will bring us back again.

I'm a Burger King fan...usually.  This one doesn't seem to have the friendliness I've found elsewhere.  Also, I was told they NEVER have decaf coffee.  First time I've run into that.  Guess if you don't want the caffeine they figure you're either too stressed or too old to bother with.
Best restaurant in Meridian.  From customer service to food, family that runs it has got it down

Sorry, but hoping it's a new restaurant hiccup. Nice waitress, but when first thing up is to go over what isn't available is a bad sign. We ordered pretzel bites and for $6,we had 6 bite size pieces with a Tablespoon of beer cheese. Maybe a 1/4 to a half of a small pretzel.  In hindsight should have just sent back and enjoyed our beer. Very clean and great Irish beers. Hopefully they can connect the dots and not turn people away with the experience we had.

Nicely decorated place. The waitress was great. I didn't like my food, but I think I was expecting something different, plus I am not a big veggie fan so I didn't like digging through my food to get rid of the offending mushrooms. I'm sure they have awesome food, and my hubby loves his meal, I just need to ask better questions about whats in  it, and I was expecting different kind of noodles and flavors. I wanted stereootypical food and they were outside the box, so not their fault.

This place is very good and very fast! The waitress was really nice and attentive. I had the Asian Caesar Salad with shrimp and I will definitely go back for more, the only problem was that there were only 4 pieces of shrimp for the size of the salad. They have really good happy hour deals on drinks, sushi and appetizers. Overall a good place to eat if you want something good!

This might be a little harsh as I am used to the wide variety of amazing boba shops in Orange County but I think the drinks at Urban Fox are too sweet. The strawberry black tea didn't taste like it had any tea in it and it was very sweet. The lychee jelly only adds to the sweetness and makes it hard to drink. The Thai tea was better but still was pretty sweet. The boba isn't a great consistency as it was too hard and not chewy.

One star because I called in my order, and waited 15 minutes for a dinner I didn't order. I called the manager after getting home and was put on hold. I later emailed the management and no response in anyway. I won't be back.
I like the fact that this place delivers and I like the location but the food is just horrible. Nothing I have tried there has been enjoyable.

I stayed at this new hotel for my first trip to Idaho.  Location is great, right next to the Villages of Meridian. Front desk staff was very friendly, and the bed was VERY comfortable.  Also, love the full size fridge in the room.  Extra bonus: had a great view of the mountains from my room! Will definitely stay here again

Awful customer service. The owners and side kick Jade treat only the regulars customers with some level of kindness. These people are rude and the gel manicure is $ 10 higher than other salons in the other. Gel peeled off in 2 days. Save your money.

Always a great tan! I've gotten one for my sister's wedding and it photographed beautifully. I just got another for a trip to Vegas. I'm naturally super pale, so this color is great on me and doesn't look orange at all.

This is our first time eating here. And we will not be back. One of the cook is super rude and have bad attitude when asked something. They conveniently did not wear a name tag. The lady in the cashier is very nice and accommodating. The cook poured half a pitcher of water to the "cook" food. I told the lady in the cashier how the cook is very rude and have a bad attitude. Poured a lot of water out of nowhere. I asked her if she would eat the food if it looks like my original bowl; she hesitated but she said no she would not. So she kindly told me to get another bowl and re-cook the food again without a lot of water with a different cook. I ended up telling them not to put water at all. The 2nd cook told me if I wanted no water to say it in the beginning. WELL other Mongolian place i go to, I never had a problem where the cook poured half a pitcher of water without adding any sauce like that..  and  how am I going to tell the supposed professional how to cook and do their job. If I ever came back, I definitely only do it due to the lady and the other cook. Sadly the workers is not wearing a name tag so I can't tell you who to avoid. I also added side by side comparison to my "new" food and my husband's unchanged food. The difference is night and day. I give this place 1 star for the kindness of the lady.
Poor poor customer service. Put an order in on the app and when I went to pick it up they tried to argue with me and said it wasn't ready. Only ordered 2 sandwiches.
Nice atmosphere. Friendly service. Good food. Reasonable prices. Nothing to not like.
Best brow bar. Lane did our brows this time and my daughter and I loved our results and will definitely ask for her next time. Thanks, Lane, for the great brows

Not a thing I can complain about here! Lots of parking, friendly hostess, clean restaurant including the bathrooms, amazing waitresses and waiters, beautiful environment, amazing prices, terrific food, and the list goes on! You cannot beat their happy hour deals! This place has amazing sushi!  Better than some actual sushi joints! Haven't tried a roll I don't like yet! They have other great dishes too, including sides like the soups! Amazing and super cheap drinks every time! I have also dined at the bar area too, which was also a great experience. They have amazing choices for kids, and they taste great too. They have great dessert options. My only complaint is that I wish they had a location out in Caldwell/Nampa area! Asian food out here sucks, and it would be so nice to have a Ling and Louie's out here!
We had no idea what kind of protein we were eating from their happy hour menu (chicken?, tapir?, emu?). First and last time there.

It has been cold as all get out with Snow and Ice and super slick roads.  No way I am driving in this stuff, so I walk on over to Ed's, greeted as if I was a long lost friend and seated in a nice booth all by myself.  Coffee was served within about three more minutes, and my order taken just a couple more after that.  And yes, they were actually fairly busy, so service is something they just do.

I will be coming back more often now that I know how good their lunches can be.

Eggs Benedict  that is all I have to say.  They best "EVER"...My husband had steak and eggs and I am not a huge steak fan, but it was delicious.  As for service, well our first visit was fantastic.  Our waitress was bubbly and on point with coffee and water, she had dark hair and a couple tattoos on her arm.  She was legit and we really appreciate her service.  The second time (2 weeks later) we went back and sat at the same table.  We were approached by a "older" waitress and she was not on point at all.  So disappointing to have such a great waitress and then someone that just didn't want to be at her job.  I use to waitress and I know that customer service is so important.  She just didn't give a crap that Sunday and her tip displayed our disappointment.   We  will go back and ask to be sat in the other waitress section and enjoy both service and the cooks delicious eggs benedict and steak! . :)

This is a great place to eat if you like Mongolian. The environment of the workers make it especially great for me. They remember me every time and always make sure to say hi and make me feel welcome. Even when it's been a month and a half I walk in and they all greet me and remember me. The food is good too. So that's always a plus.
Walgreens is pretty consistently average.  Most stores have a lock on the bathroom which is really annoying.  I didn't check this one but it is my pet peeve.

Some of the most bland and horrible Chinese food I've ever had. Ordered the beef and broccoli when I came out lukewarm at best. The spring rolls had no flavor at all consisting of noodles lettuce and a flavoerless shrimp.  If it wasn't for Siracha, it would been the worst place ever.

The one good thing was the service. very friendly staff.

Replaced a 59 1/2 inch by 59 1/2 inch window in my dining room. The previous windows were 17 years old and had a broken seal with vapor and moisture stains. It was replaced by an Alsible to series window with low E and Argon gas.

Mark and Morgan came and gave me an estimate, measured the window. He was very prompt and professional. The company called and set up a date/ time to install it. It took only one hour to replace the window. He has years of experience and made it look easy. Im very picky and the workmanship, courtesy and professionalism of this company was excellent. I love my new windows.

Thanks so much!!  The car looks amazing and like brand new again!
And so nice to just have them come to my house!

Super accommodating and kind. Prices are great and they even rushed my order. This place is the real deal in regards to seamstress and tailoring. Located in old town meridian it is easily accessed with ample parking.

Passed this place a hundred times and decided to try it out.. wish we would have gone to Main Street Burger a few minutes down Main st in Meridian. Primary word to describe my burger: sloppy. So much sauce dripping out the sides that the bun gets soggy. The patties are super thin, which can work if you have some nice char on the meat. This patty was grey and had no flavor, I actually added salt to mine. My 3 year old wouldn't eat more than 2 bites of the slider we got him and he's not very picky. Only saving grace was the crinkle cut fries that were fresh out of the fryer and the fry sauce was pretty good. I wanted to like this cute little drive up and we may try their desserts in the future (hard to mess that up) but unfortunately first impressions are everything when you have so many options.

The quality and attention these folks take when preparing your food is second to none... for a quick serve Asian food establishment I have not received better service or accommodations than at Rice Works. Food is outstanding and service is excellent. Thank you to all who work at Rice Works!

Just had my Dad's 95th birthday party at Louie's. It was absolutely  perfect. The staff and chefs outdo themselves to please their customers. The Sunday brunch is fabulous whether you want breakfast or lunch or both at the same time! Then after that there is a huge table filled with all sorts of desserts. Wonderful. The price is so reasonable. They even made a special cheese  pizza just for my 5 year old twin grandsons. Please visit Louie's. You won't be disappointed.

I just joined Gold's Gym and I think it is a great gym for the price. It is a little small but they have great equipment and keep the gym super clean!! Also they have a cinema room which is a great way to get your cardio in on a hot Idaho summer day!! Overall, if you need a cheaper but clean gym then try Golds it's great.
Got the 8 oz steak and Mac and cheese and fries. Tasted like a hungry man frozen meal. Made me shit my pants while I was on a date

We just had a great experience here!
Not only Jay did an awesome job and my pup looks so cute now, but I love the fact that this place doesn't lock puppies in the cages/crates.  Puppies play together before and after their grooming.  will definitely come back!

I found it serviceable for the most part, although my experiences at the now-defunct Shige Teriyaki were superior in terms of quality and selection (I would go early in its existence when Shige himself prepared the food on Mondays). However I do think it's a step up from Yokozuna Teriyaki if you're looking for this kind of food in Meridian.

I was satisfied with the tender quality of my pork. My chicken katsu had a little too much breading on it, but the meat did come out moist. The tempura batter wasn't quite as light and airy as I had hoped, but for a fast-food option it was passable. Thumbs up for offering cubed rainbow jelly as an option for the boba tea. I think all of the other places in town only offer tapioca balls, so offering jelly is more in line with the Chinese and Korean tea houses and boba bars I was used to.

Heed well the prior warning about cabbage in the vegetables. If you don't like cabbage, you will not like what they offer and lose value out of your meal. Apart from some slivers of carrot and a couple small broccoli stems, it was all cabbage.

Everything generally hovers around the $7.50-$9.50 range minus a drink. The portions are so that you should be satiated provided you like cabbage. A bit pricey for a regular lunch option but better as a dinner.

Criticisms:
-- The option to make your meat "hot and spicy" for 50 cents (used to be $1) was a waste. It's tough to recall another time in life where a sauce labeling itself as "hot" had no registering at all on my palate. What's funny is that the Sriracha sauce and chili paste they have available for free near the soda dispenser have more of a kick. This one's a head-scratcher. I think they should just do away with this option altogether.

-- Unless the tofu they purchase is being molded into molds dating back to the Ming Dynasty, I'm not sure why the tofu options cost as much as the meat options. Not when nowadays you can get extra-firm organic tofu from WinCo for $1.25. Unless they're buying super-cheap meat from a supplier, but let's not try and think about what that would entail.

-- Awful gyoza. It sucks that I'll be leaving the area without ever having had gyoza that were more than barely passable. Deep-frying is their regular cooking method, and typically I'm not a fan of that. Twice I tried to get mine pan-fried and both times I was denied. The first time was understandable since they were prepping a large catering order, so I opted to hold off. But the second time was during a slow time of the day, and the woman smiled and apologized but couldn't offer any reason why it couldn't be done (I'm assuming they have a pan somewhere in the back to use). I decided to get some anyway and regretted it fairly quickly. Thankfully it was only $3.50 for six small pieces. Plus the amount of dipping sauce they supply was pathetically small, so low in the small deep cup provided that I could barely squeeze the gyoza into the cup. They should use some sort of shallow dish for the sauce instead.

This doesn't affect my rating at all, but the options presented here are strictly by-the-book. This is where Shige Teriyaki would've beat them handily. Shige had options like oyakodon, galbi, unagi, poke, and grilled squid. This business is run by Koreans, and they don't seem to be trying to hide that fact given the sign written in hangul near the cash register. So why not challenge the palates around here a little and put a Korean spin on things? Like offer gochujang as a condiment next to the Sriracha or put a lettuce leaf and a scoop of ssamjang next to the rice? You're Korean; where's the squid?! Put your cooking skills at home to good use at your job and you may open up newbies to a whole new world and gently introduce them into how awesome Korean cuisine is.

I love this place ! My mom and sister go here every other Sunday. I go here for special occasions. They never let you down. They really take there time and do a good job . It's 30$ for a full set and it's worth it. I recommend to go here. They do a wonderful job!

Okay, I LOVE the whole mobile tanning idea--big high-five to whomever invented it. Krissy from Sun-Kissed by Kris came to my home, set up her equipment, and gave me a very natural looking tan in about a 20 minutes. This was my first airbrush tan and I was a little nervous because I was preparing for an important event--I did not want to look orange or "overtanned"! I was kind of amazed and very happy with my tan and Krissy was very professional, answered all my questions, and was funny and personable. I probably won't mobile tan a lot, but when I do, I will go back to Sun-Kissed by Kris. Highly recommended!!!
Reclining, heated seats. That is all. Enjoying a movie in comfort is my idea of fun! Great theater. My favorite in the area. Clean, luxurious  and friendly customer service. Five star perfection.

This is the best one around. The others don't compare to this one. The spicy teriyaki chicken is amazing so spicy but great flavor. This one also has a side salad with the best dressing I've ever had. Definitely my favorite Asian food in all of Boise and meridian

Have been a customer for years ! Never had a problem, until Sunday afternoon Jan10. We complained about the chicken parm as it was loaded with gristle ! the waitress asked if she could remove it and get another...she did....a few moments later the manager came over and asked if there is something wrong with your wife's food ...why are you eating it ? I replied I am eating my veal parm . I found this offensive and rude ! By the way the veal parm crust was burnt . I kept my mouth shut...but was ready to walk out . Why would I go back ? Who needs a place where your not made to feel welcome !? The waitress was nice !
Ok this place is amazing!! It's like a blast from the past in really cool place to eat breakfast it's not too expensive but like it's Worth all of it and just go and give it a try

This was a good spot, wait was 30 minutes but understandable for a new place.

We sat in the north east corner of the restaurant and it was super loud, not ideal but with current conditions, you take what you can get.

Initial greeting was great and drinks came out quickly, food took about 28 minutes which I found to be on the high side, looked like a ton of to go orders but should have been better staffed if that's the case.

Food was good when it came out, huge portions, be prepared to eat or take some home.  The French toast looked fantastic, made out of biscuit batter I believe, daughter enjoyed it very much.

Scrambles were good and the bacon lives up to the hype.

Check it out, hope they continue to do well!

Had my first facial w Amber today, and it was FANTASTIC.
I felt pampered and relaxed and my skin feels great.
All of the products she used were so aromatic and felt wonderful on my skin!
I can't wait to return for the next time.
Highly recommend!!

My favorite restaurant in all of Meridian. I have been in town frequent for business purposes and the food is delicious and comforts me. The few times I ate here I was greeted with a smile and the service was very attentive when dining in. My favorite dish is the teriyaki chicken and I would recommend it to anyone to give it a try!

I returned to Q Nails today with a friend for pedis. I had been doing my pedis at home all summer but wanted a treat. Q was my nail tech, yes that is his name. He is wonderful, funny, charming, we talked about earthquakes, volcanoes, etc. (He is very knowledgeable.) He trimmed my nails, scrubbed my feet so nicely, then gave a full foot and leg massage. Then the hot stones! Mama, Heaven! Then, a hot towel, ahhh. My nails were polished to perfection! My friend loved her pedi, too! And, these are the best massage chairs in all of Boise! Go to Q and ask for Q! I will be back soon!

Asian Infusion type restaurant. I like their spicy California rolls and their happy hour prices. I get the Tom Kha Gai soup for $4 and add rice to make it a meal. As usual a lot of these restaurants don't use chicken thighs or dark meat, but rather thin slices of chicken breasts for their chicken. It seems like in Idaho.. a lot of restaurants do short cuts with cheaper ingredients. 
Spicy Seafood Red Curry!! It was really delicious, except for the fact that they put the rice underneath it. I think $19 is a bit steep for this small little pot especially when it's filled with rice. 

Other than that the food taste good here.
We went there, unlike the claim that they wear masks is NOT true, nor do they social distance.  Even when we asked the server said "no we do not". We did not feel safe and left, just a heads up.

Chelsea at the drive thru is great !! She makes me want to shop here. 
Krissy/Kuna

This pub. What can I say? Good beer on tap, a ton of Irish whiskey, great music, amazing atmosphere... and the owner is a bad ass chick (truthfully, I want to be her when I grow up). Just an all around good spot for a fun but chill night. And we made new friends (see photo). Highly recommend.

Yup yup yup this is a great place. Our first "My Place " was in Des Moines , Iowa. So I knew that the low star rating was bogus. We love the kitchenettes. I brought my electric skillet in and my eggs n teriyaki Spam! Lol. Cinnamon bread and peanut butter. So breaky will be easy. We are truck drivers so have a lot of that cooking stuff already. We just like to get out of the truck for a piece. We r here two days early so here we are to plant ourselves. 
    They do have a nice pantry for items to buy including tv type dinners if u are in a pinch and don't want to go out. Several items even ice cream. They have dish network with HBO too. So plenty of Chanel's for those of u that stay in like us. The Mall across the street has everything. High end and low end stores. Plenty of foodie places too if u want to eat out.

Excellent location.  Easy on and off 84.  Easy access to the entire Treasure Valley.  Lots of restaurants in walking distance.  Full size refrigerator, large microwave, cook top, sink, etc.  Room is comfortable.  Only bit of advise,,, There are no ice makers in the hotel.  Your freezer has one, but you MUST turn it on as soon as you get in the room or you will have nothing ;-)

Let's just say... I'm a phó connoisseur. I travel quite a bit and always look for a good authentic Vietnamese place to eat. So far, ths is the best one I have found. Although I haven't tried but a couple in the Boise area. 
These guys have only been open about a week and a half. At first, it seemed a bit Americanized to me because the menu did not list the dishes by the traditional Vietnamese names. However, they did offer tendon in one of their Phó choices. ...which was a good sign. The other good sign was that fish sauce was readily available on the table as a condiment. ...a sure sign that the place is run by Vietnamese and not Chinese folks trying to "attempt" Vietnamese, which is what I have found in most places in Idaho and Utah. 
The meal was good. But the tendon could have cooked a bit longer and the brisket sliced a bit thinner. 
Overall I was happy with my meal and will come back again. As I said before, it's the best I've found in Boise so far. 
Give it a try!

Tru By Hilton (Meridian, Idaho)

Here's what I like about this hotel...
-It's new and very clean
-Nice staff.  Great service
-Free breakfast & coffee
-Located close to the airport 
-Mini fridge
-Pool table at the lobby
-Cardio room
-Affordable 

Here's what I don't like about this hotel...
-Rooms are small and cramped
-Small desk. This is not a great hotel to get some work done.
-I have never had a good night's sleep here

I have stayed at this hotel around 10 times this year only because the company I work for keeps booking here. I'm a fan of Hilton Hotel. I'm just not a huge fan of this one.

In a world where movie theaters have become increasingly grand, or at the very least, a feature in an overall grander establishment (ie: The Village, Boise Spectrum, Edwards in Bodo), the Majestic has a bit more of a classic movie theater vibe.

This is not to say that the theater is lacking in sound quality or screen size or that it isn't comfortably appointed. It is. But, more to say that while there may be dining and drinking options nearby, the theater stands solitary on its own property with its own parking lot. 

This, of course, has it's benefits. You can park nearby. You can drop a carload of teens off right at the entrance to the theater and watch them go right on in.

Sometimes, having a theater part of a mall, shopping center, or downtown dining district can be a bit of a hassle if all your looking to do is go to the movies. 

When I'm truly just looking to simply see a movie--this is my go-to spot. First run films, comfortable seating, typically offering a little elbow room (ie: not over-crowded), and of course the usual popcorn, candy, soda offerings that one expects without the parking hassle? Yes please.

Get to it!
Always so helpful and very friendly staff.  Prices are good.  Always the best treats and will help you calculate how much food for your dog.

We recently moved into a new home in Meridian. I needed to build the fence in the backyard. Meridian Fence was recommended and we had a great experience. I have 2 dogs, so not having a fence was a major inconvenience. Jesse was very accommodating in getting our project going quickly even though they were very busy. When the fence was stained I had forgotten to cut back the grass and there were a few spots that needed touch up. Someone came out and took care of it. I felt the price was reasonable too. Great communication and service. I would highly recommend working with Meridian Fence!

Place is small, service is friendly, and the menu is simple in a good way. The chicken teriyaki was pretty basic and good. The Yaki Udon with shrimp was tasty with thick tube noodles. What I'm most excited for is the bubble teas. Unfortuantely, they were out of green tea bubble tea, so I went with the vietnamese tea bubble tea which was a bit sweeter, but nice. Happy Teriyaki seems like a good place for lunch moreso than dinner. I definitely want to come back for more bubble tea and to try the one with the jellies in it.

Service started slow but improved
The food was amazing
Huge portions and yummy
The drinks were excellent
I had the maple bourbon pecan mocha and it was really good
Then we tried the lavender mimosa and it was refreshing 
Appreciated the owner checking on tables to make sure things were great

***FAST EDDY'S IS NOT CLOSED***
I certainly wouldn't call Fast Eddy's fast. 
They are an awesome place to go for beer and wine. They actually have Roscato, which is not in every store. As far as I know they have Mac and Jack's beer at this location. They do not have banana bread beer and I wish they did because it is so so good. Sometimes they have sushi, but I try to avoid food from a gas station.
I love the fact that they are on the way to work, but I do not want to come here for gas anymore. Why oh why does it have to be so hard to pump gas? 
To my knowledge when you are getting gas for your car you simply put your card in, select which fuel you want, and then fill your car. Does it work that way with Fast Eddy's? No, it does not. You have to pass four quests before their pump lets you fill your car. 
The last two times I have gone there to get gas the pumps were malfunctioning. I go to one pump it is initializing set up; they tell me to go to the next pump. I do that and it happened again and then at the next pump. I finally found one to use. This happened again on the second visit and this time they had me come in to pay first, which caused a further inconvenience. 
I voiced my disappointment to the poor girl behind the counter who has zero control over how their gas pumps work. Why does this happen every single time? I am always having issues with pumping gas at their station and I cannot wrap my head around it. I've been filling my car for years and I suddenly have a problem at Fast Eddy's.

I do not recommend this place if you are Gluten intolerant. I went there last night ordered something that should that was labeled GF and should have been GF. I have had nothing but issues this whole Am. Please make sure Harp that you are not cross contaminating when cooking  and if it's says GF on your menu please make sure you understand what GF means to those of us who can't have it. This is a real issue and not a fad for most of us out there. The consequences are severe for most of us. I will not be returning to the Harp to eat again.

We went there for my Husband's birthday and the service and the food were exceptional! It's pricey and worth every single penny! We had a wonderful experience, glad we have a place like this in the valley!

A perfectly acceptable chain soup-and-salad bar, surprisingly the only one of its kind in the valley we have so far. Like Ophelia, I'm not a buffet person either, but I did enjoy going to soup-and-salad bars like Souplantation and Fresh Choice from time to time when I lived in areas that had them. My overall memories of each of those places do trump Souper Salad, but that's not a huge knock. It is kept very clean (impressive given the circumstances), and there always seems to be an employee hovering around the options to make sure they stay well-stocked.  

The soups have tasted better than I thought, though the options have been on the standard and predictable side. Stuff I gave a thumbs down on there would be their rather bland and cheap prepared salads (I've had a Crab Louie salad with fake crab and pea-sized shrimp, and some sort of "spicy" jalapeno salad with jalapenos that seemed to have been neutered from having either taste or heat), mac and cheese (a bland gooey mess), lasagna (cheap and falls apart easily), and pizza (though the pizzas always suck at places like this). The four alarm chili is more like one alarm-- I wonder if it's like that at all of their locations or if they purposely level down the heat in a spice-phobic area like Boise. But with the exception of the mac and cheese and the pizza, these things get rotated in and out and aren't always available.

There's a coupon available on their website that reduces the price for going. It's also reduced on Tuesdays for the whole day.

If the prepared salads were tastier and more creative, I'd be tempted to go there on a more regular basis despite it being a bit out-of-the-way for me.

My daughter and I come here every month for gel mani/pedis. They do a great job and our nails last the whole month. They're also reasonably priced and clean. We don't do walk ins any more because they can be pretty busy sometimes but we can generally get an appointment same or next day.

Food was mediocre. Plating presentation was inconsistent. Staff were friendly but seemed to still be figuring things out. The meat and cheese tray wasn't great and we wouldn't recommend it, not worth $12. We also had the corned beef and cabbage which was okay could have been seasoned a little better and the cabbage was a bit overcooked. Hoping that they work out the kinks in the next few months, it will be a fun little pub if they can.

I generally don't eat at Applebee's because I don't enjoy their food. We recorded a gift card for Christmas this year and after a long day I running around decided it was worth a shot. It wasn't. 

Our server was a sweet lady who had just started. She didn't know much but tried hard. I know what it's like to staff something new and try hard, but she needs a lot more training. It took her three trips to the bar to tell me what beers were on tap. I ordered a beer and she talked me into the large one, not a hard sell because I like beer. Moments later I heard the table next to me order drinks and their server encouraged them to order two smaller ones as they were on special for happy hour. I wish I would have known. 

The beer was tasty, that was about it though. The food was not great, I could have easily done better clumsily stomping around my own kitchen. They goofed up my daughter's order and had to send it back (see attached photo of ugly Mac n cheese scraped from the bottom of the pan). My son's pizza bites from the kids menu was a hoagie bun with sauce and cheese melted on top. He'll eat anything that looks like pizza and didn't finish it. After a tip, a tab for $60 was not worth it at all. Go across the street and eat at Red Robin.

How this place stays in business is beyond me.  The food is terrible! It's like microwave food.. worse than something you'd get in a drty dive bar! Their drinks are so watered down it's ridiculous and they're not cheap! $10+ for a crappy margarita. Needless to say, I won't be going back.
Excellent bulgogi and a good option for fast food that is healthy. Food truck under a roof!

Good for the business but Meridian's restaurants are getting so busy, it is kind of hard to dine at certain times.  Big Jud's is one of them.  We got there and their waiting room was packed with very little standing room.  While we waited 20-30 minutes multiple parties opened the door and turned back around to go somewhere else.  If I hadn't been with another couple, we would have probably done the same.  Restaurant was packed and very loud, not my preference.  We ordered some burgers and tots and they were just ok, nothing really stood out.  Only in my opinion, not worth the wait for an average burger.  I hope they do well with this new location.

I have been going to this nail salon, giving them chance after chance to be nice, for over a year. They are some of the rudest people. They are nice to you if you get all of their services. I only want my toe nail polish changed. I can take care of my own feet. 

Today was the last straw. The pregnant owner barks orders at the other girls who work there. Nail sweatshop!

Yum yum yum. This place is delicious. Yes, it is expensive but you taste the quality and every single penny is worth it. The staff is incredibly friendly and accommodating.  They are genuine and not overly pushy which is nice. The quality of the meat is also exceptional.  The sirloin was to die for, I honestly could have spent the whole night with just a skewer of that. I suggest making a reservation or going after the rush. We had a 7pm reservation and by the time we left it was fairly quiet. I can't wait to go back once I've saved up some dough. Haha

One of my favorite restaurants ever! The meats are amazing, juicy, and delicious. Definitely come hungry because you will not want to stop. Perfect place for a date night and dessert is included on the weekends.

As far as movie theaters go, this is one of the best in Boise. Prices tend to be cheaper than at Edwards cinema downtown, and the staff is, in my experience, friendly and competent. Theater quality is so-so, sometimes I walk in, and there is still garbage in the seats or on the floor, but more often than not, they are adequately cleaned between screenings. In two or three theaters, there are rows of up to three seats coming out of the floor, though not enough to impact your comfort much. Ultimately, I would recomend this theater to anyone looking to go see a movie. You will be pleased by the courteous staff, usually reasonable prices, and well-maintained theaters.

This is a brand new place off of Eagle Road in Meridian. They have beer and wine along with Coke products, teas and vitamin water. We tried out the Formaggio pizza. It is a 12" pizza with 5 different cheeses. It was pretty good but was extremely heavy on the flour. We also got a glass of a red blend wine from a company I was not familiar with called Firefly. It was a medium bodied wine and was a very good red blend. 

The waiter was very nice but you could tell that he hasn't been doing this for very long. 

I see much promise in this place and am willing to give it another try a couple months down the road when they get more settled.

Food is amazing & that's the only reason I have 2 stars. The people that work here are horrible. I just went in at 7:38 (they close at 9:00) and everyone stops what they're doing to look at you and CLEARLY upset that you came in an hour and a half before close. They were mopping the floor and got irritated we walked in an already mopped area?? I work in a restaurant and this is nothing like how you're supposed to act. They're lucky their food is good or they would have zero business.

Very comfortable and well-maintained theater with reasonable theater prices. (~$9) Just to give you a scale of what you're going to be walking into in terms of concessions: $4.50, 20 oz. Bottle of water

I wouldn't recommend this company to anyone!  Had some questions regarding my bill and, Shauna the Office Manager was very rude.  Customer Service is very important.   Since September 3, I've been charged $320.00.  My contract States when my service and billing is supposed to be done.  But they have their own agenda and according to Shauna, their way is correct and the customer is confused.  I'm looking at my contract, so I am not confused!!.  And spraying inside the house has never happened!  So actually they need to reimburse me $150.00.  One star company with very bad customer service. .  DO NOT USE THEM

We did pick up some clearance items.  Store bright and clean.  Cashier very helpful.

But the reason we went in was an ad in the paper.  First day of ad, half hour after opening they were completely out of stock.  We were told that the ad ran last week and the store ran out at the start of last week.

Went here for the first time. I'm an elderly senior and it took me awhile to get seated. Once seated it was very good and prices not bad. Staff was very friendly. Only complaint is they sure seem slow getting to you. I would recommend.

I only wish they gave more rice with the meal. One place I've been too gives rice underneath the meat to. Other than that this place is amazing! I always get the teriyaki chicken with rice and have never been disappointed. Their bubble tea is amazing too! It's a great place to eat if your craving teriyaki, not badly priced either.

Great food. Awful service. I can appreciate an overworked server who's busting their butt however it wasn't that busy and the service we received was subpar. It took a while to order our bottle of wine and appetizers and then took much longer to receive both of them. Those of us who ordered salads didn't get them til after we'd been served our entrees and then reminded our server our salads hadn't come out. The server spent more time sharing music he's created than giving us quality service. I'm leaving 3 stars because the food was worth 5 stars whereas the service was 1. I will be eating here again but will order takeout.

I did a TON of research over the last year before we decided to have Hubble build our home. We talked to at least ten other builders, went to every single parade of homes houses last May, got bids on what we want, talked to multiple realtors (who don't work for Hubble) and learned a lot. Here is the short and the long of it. Hubble did a big rebranding a few years back. They upped their quality standards company wide but never rebranded their name, which may hurt them since a few years ago their builds were bottom of the line basic. The realtors I spoke to said NEW Hubble builds are amazing! They are at par with higher priced builders and even have some things you wont get with those higher priced builds. For example they seal up your crawl space and have a fan to help circulate air and keep electricity costs down (we're from Seattle, we really appreciate a greener house). 

Some other things I have liked as we've made this decision to pick Hubble, their floorplans, customer service, and helpfulness in getting a mortgage company (we used HomeStreet. Don't use an outside banker, they'll expect you to get a construction loan then a mortgage once the home is done whereas Hubble will build your home and then close with a regular home loan. Saves you some $$). One thing about Hubble's floorplans, they don't have very many (bummer) but their floorplans make much more sense than some of the other builder's floorplans (cough, cough, CBH. For some reason they think having a coat closet on the first floor to be unnecessary and a 10x10 bedroom to be perfect for a growing child. Hubble's rooms and storage space is much more spacious). 

Another thing, with some other builders realtors I kind of felt like I was talking to a used car sales person. They were obnoxiously persistent. I get an email a few times a week from CBH and even the occasional phone call. With Hubble, it is family owned and operated. The realtor we used is the step son of the owner and then they've got siblings and cousins etc working a lot of the administration. 

We are at the beginning of our home building experience with Hubble and so far it has been very positive. I will update this after we move in and then can expound on the whole process.

I normally go to a different salon but they did not have time for a full set so I came here instead. My nails came out great, but completely the wrong shape. I asked for the coffin shape and recieved an almond shape. I expected to pay $25 for an acrylic set as that is what the website says. I was then told it was going to be $40 because of the shape. She told me it was $5 for shape which would be $30 so I told her I wouldn't pay more. I was not interested in the gel polish which was pushed on me the entire time. The lady who did my nails was rather rude and pushy. I was jerked around to say. I was also not impressed with the cleanliness of the salon. I didn't see any cleaning of the brushes or files. I saw dust from acrylic all over the with stations and nails on the floor. Will not be returning though my nails look great

Pretty good as far as salad buffets go. The usual salad selection as well as some premise pasta and misc salad which were good. The bread was good, too (mmm, carbs..) and there were baked potatoes, a taco bar, as well as a pasta and sauce station. I would visit this place again for lunch. I was bummed that there weren't any more high chairs so my son had to sit in my lap. All in all the place is "good", not great or stellar or even bad. It's slightly above average and just good.
Nice hotel overall! Some weird things though: no cups in rooms so you have to buy the water bottles, breakfast not very fresh. But other than that it was great

This was the worst service I have ever had.  My family waited forever for drinks all we had was waters and my kids sodas.  We got the them the same time we got our food! Once we got our food she did not check in with us once until then end and then asked if we wanted anything. It was not busy our waitress had a piss poor attitude. We won't be back!
Shane W. makes this company look bad. Unprofessional and sends eerie, threatening texts messages...
Two stars are for the location. Bland noodles And overly seasoned chicken. Disappointed at the prices as well. A walk up taco truck help yourself feel with high end restaurant pricing. Won't be back.

Great Food (it's the reason why we go in the first place)! Not sure about some of these other one star " reviews" where people are posting negative reviews focused only on "fear" masks etc. 

As somebody that continues to travel GLOBALLY all through the pandemic, I found all of Biscuit and Hogs common sense practices to exceed all my expectations on health and safety. This is a great place to go eat, enjoy some coffee and leave the maniacal BS outside the front door. Wait staff is always respectful and conscientious of "distancing".

We go here for the food, NOT the politics! If you're a germaphobe get your food to go, you'll be happier and so will we.

Don't waste your time, literally! Waited an hour and a half to be seated, 30 minutes later ordered food. When food came it was cold, dry and dead! Worst brisket I ever had in my life, cold eggs, cold food! Very greasy as all hell!

Honestly we are not usually fans of Walmart as l they are usually dirty, cheap feeling and bad customer service. However , this Walmart is actually very nice. It's usually pretty clean, organized and usually good customer service but they could still be improved a little. We do 90% of our shopping at Walmart now and like that the prices are usually better than other stores. Sometimes they are out of stock of everything and that is annoying but when everything is in stock we don't really need to go to any other store.
Tried this place for the first time. Very disappointed. The staff was fairly nice, but the food was awful. Too expensive for the quality.

I go to this Sonic pretty regularly for their Morning Drink Stop promo where until 10am large drinks are 99-cents.  On this particular evening I had been running errands after work and it was nearly 8pm and I realized I hadn't eaten dinner.  I remembered the Carhop Classic promo I had seen on their readerboard so I stopped in to see what that was about. 

I asked about it, and does it have this on it, can I have that on it, and the order-taker girl was super patient and friendly.
$2.99 Carhop Classic includes Quarter Pound Double Cheeseburger or Crispy Tender Sandwich with medium Tots.

I'm not really a fan of tots and they let me sub for French fries.  And I was able to add lettuce and onions to my burger at no additional cost.  My burger ended up tasting a lot like a Burger King Whopper - for half the price ... and with fries.  The fries weren't that great.  They were the thickness that I like, but they weren't piping hot like I like.  I ordered a chocolate milkshake (which was delicious), and got the added treat of Sonic mints at the bottom of the bag.  

I'm a little surprised by the reviews for this location as I've never had a problem.  But, everyone's experience is different - and mine here have never been bad.

Would have given five stars but our waiter was real awkward. Would ask how are doing and then just stand there for a bit really strange! The food however was pretty good we had the shareable plate. Tons of food for the price two entrees a small pizza and soup or salad plus yummy garlic bread! The pizza was delicious but I feel like they held on to the pasta until it was ready and it came out kinda cold...
Called Roto Rooter for a clogged drain on a Sunday. Tyler Larsen was at my house within 30 minutes of my call, and he was fast, thorough, and professional. Great service, would highly recommend.
Pretty great food and so many options for all. I love the atmosphere too. The servers are usually really attentive and alert.

Katera is amazing!!!! She was so welcoming and so friendly when she gave us our food! We come to this sonic a lot and she by far gives the best service!! She needs a raise or something! She is so nice and knows exactly what she is doing!!

This is a very good theater. The theaters are very, very large and clean. The lights outside are fun and can be seen from the freeway. The price isn't as bad as Edwards-- they don't charge tax like Edwards is doing now. On Tuesdays you can get in for $5! 

There isn't a club card so no freebies. Large parking lot and lots of restaurants and coffees and such in the area. Just like all the big box movie theaters the drinks and popcorn cost more than one makes in an hour... or two!

The workouts are amazing and different every time,each class is guided by a coach, so you're never guessing. if you're like me and like to not have to think (or guess) about what to do at the gym....this is the place for you! Every coach is helpful, nice, and awesome! I can't say enough good things about Orangetheory!

Sorry, Dick's. Due to your corporate virtue signaling, I will be taking my business elsewhere. I still have plenty of choices where to spend my disposable income in the Treasure Valley. I'll make sure to patronize those businesses who still fully support the Second Amendment.

Took a group here last Fri night, had to wait a bit but that's ok for a table for 6. Great experience, 2nd review means it's consistent and all enjoyed.  Only complaint is the cost, quite expensive, more so than PF Chang's and the rolls are really good but on the high side.  You will spend $50 per couple easily, and that's w/o drinks.  A lot of money for a group or a family like we had, especially if your the one flipping for the bill.   Great for a couple as you can get an appetizer and share a couple dishes and be plenty full.

After moving to Meridian, I needed a new place to groom my upper head area. I had never been to a Sports Clips before but love sports and am fond of clips so I tried this place out. I liked that I was able to look online to see wait times before I went and that dictated what time I wanted to go. Once I got there, I didn't wait TOO long until I was seen by Amber. She was very sweet and let me know that since it was my first time there, I would get the MVP thing which was the haircut, a shampoo, little scalp massage, hot towel, and that's it I think. It was lovely. She kept a great conversation the whole time as well and, most importantly, did a great job with my hair while listening to what I was looking for and making great suggestions. I now see either Amber or Jodi depending on who's in, and they both do an awesome job. As long as I am in Meridian, I'll keep going back here! YAY HAIR!

Quite simply, the very worst food I have ever paid to eat.

The food was laid out in the opposite order of what you'd expect for a Mongolian BBQ. For example, the meat was about a third of the way down, and the bean sprouts were at the very end of the line - after you've already filled your bowl with stuff like these nasty, soggy snow peas, and clumpy noodles. 

I ladled on about 4 times more sauces as they recommended and my food still came out with zero flavor. Plus, the vegetables were still raw and barely warmed up after being on the bbq grill. Once the meat was done, they pulled it right off and into the bowl. 

The meat was very tough, too.

I wish I could find something good to say, but unfortunately, I can't.

The waiter was nice, however. I just won't be back.

Krissy is the best! I am a very shy person, but with Krissy I was fully comfortable to even get down to my birthday suit! :O

Her personality will make anyone feel comfortable and I love how non-intrusive she is and how helpful she is.

This was my first experience and definitely will be back!! Give Krissy a go!

I went with the family on a weeknight; had a coupon for ~$6/ea. We are used to Souplantation in SoCal.

Overall...very friendly and efficient service, clean, decent quality. Soup selection was a little sparse, salad bar was smallish, but had everything we wanted. 

Nice treats: Strawberry shortcake makings, gingersnaps, taco bar.

Wish they had: Clam chowder, sourdough.

We will definitely be back. Good reasonably priced eats.Friendly staff who hustled, as well!

Louies offers Italian food with a family touch.  They have been in business for decades.  I love their salad bar buffet lunch, where pizza and pasta are included.  Try adding a soup to the lunch for a few dollars more--they make the best soups!  Lou always says hi to us when we come in, and takes the time to visit with his customers.  They cater as well, and do a fantastic job with this service. This is one of our favorite restaurants.

Just finished our first cut for our 7 mo poodle mix today. We looked for a smaller shop that would be sensitive to our puppy's anxiety. We adopted him 3 weeks ago so he's been dealing with separation anxiety. We spoke to the owner and he felt comfortable so we scheduled our visit. The owner was there right at 8 which gave me enough time to get to work so that was great. On pick up I paid before I saw the cut. After I paid I was able to see my puppy and his nails were not cut and the hair around one eye was cut but the other was not. I guess he was trying to bite so he was not able to cut the nails. I wasn't offered a discount on the service. I was able to drive 1 mile down the road to Dawgs House of Grooming and they were very patient and carefully cut my Nervous Nelly's nails.  I was able to fix the uneven hair around the eyes at home.  Grooming is tough!

I'm very surprised by the low reviews; I have been to Rice Works twice and have had nothing but great service and delicious food. 

Anywho. 

Rice Works is new in the concept of The Village at Meridian, in that the building is shared by another restaurant, Calle 75 Tacos, on the other side. The building is walled by glass that's easily opened up for warmer temperatures, and inside, the seating is comfortable; you can lounge at a table or a couch and people watch, or enjoy a cool fireplace. I really enjoyed this style of restaurant. Cool, casual and relaxed. 

The food is very tasty and varied; I tried the Bulgogi (Korean BBQ beef) when I first went there and I loved it. While I've not had authentic Korean BBQ in Korea, it was definitely some of the best I've had here in the US. Next time I tried the Korean fusion chicken tacos and I was not disappointed either. The spice and the flavor had a nice kick and perfect crunch. 

I love how this place has a bit of (nearly) every Asian food; Bulgogi and kimchi from Korea, bento style meals from Japan, Cha Gio from Vietnamese cooking, and Chinese chow mein and General's Chicken. If you or a friend is hesitant about trying the Korean food, there's plenty of other Asian food to nom on. Well done, Rice Works.

This establishment has great potential however we leave disappointed.  Service was marginal, staff felt more compelled to have a social hour at the hostess stand, and to top it off we were served raw egg.  The server tried to explain it was sunny side up, however it came out with the whites completely raw, not sunny side up.  My wife opted for no rice and she was offered additional veggies instead, when the ticket came she was charged an up charge for said veggies.  What a disappointment, other reviews are also trending in that direction.
Wonderful business to deal with. Everyone went above and beyond from the owner to the craftsman. Very reasonable prices and their work is gorgeous. Hard to find combo these days.

If you have taste buds, dont eat here. Everything we ordered was bland to say the least. We got the #10 cart. A bit of everything. Nothing was good. I really miss Hong Kong restaurant in Nampa. Ill be making that drive for Chinese from now on.

I was so excited to find out that a new Vietnamese restaurant just opened near where we live. I checked out Yelp beforehand, and was pleasantly surprised to see that they had bun bo hue on the menu and couldn't wait to try their version. We stopped by for lunch and ordered the spring rolls, my son had the BBQ pork ban mi, my husband ordered the pho #9 which has everything on it, and I found out that the bun bo hue was no longer on the menu. The girl at the counter said they took it off the menu since no one ever ordered it. I wasn't too surprised since this is Meridian, Idaho, so I ordered my 2nd choice, the vermicelli noodle bowl with grilled pork and spring rolls instead. My son and husband ordered boba drinks as well but the drinks here were very watered down and nothing like the creamy boba drinks they are used to getting. I don't think the person making the drinks knew what they were doing since it came last, about 10 min after we were already eating. Now the actual food review: The spring rolls were not cooked through. The pork was still pink and slightly slimy when you took a bite- of course we didn't eat them. Next, my son's sandwich was not BBQ pork, but a pork of some kind with pate. Also, it usually comes on a crispy baguette, but this was a briefly microwaved hoagie bun. He didn't like it, but ate it anyway since his sandwich came about 10 min after my husband's and my order did. The #9 pho with everything on it was a serious disappointment. The broth was so bland that adding hoisin and sriracha didn't even add much flavor to it. They didn't bring any lime, basil, or bean sprouts which traditionally comes with pho, but we weren't sure if they knew that or not. It had some tendons but not the soft melting kind you normally get, and he only had 2 kinds of beef and no meatballs. Lastly, my vermicelli noodles were actually hot. Usually they're cool and comes with lots of lettuce and carrots but this was mediocre topped with partially cooked spring rolls on top. I really wanted to like this place, and maybe it's too early to be critical, but my husband actually said it was the worst pho he has ever eaten. We have been fortunate to have good Vietnamese food in Seattle and Portland and are always searching for some place to get decent Vietnamese food (or any Asian food for that matter) in Boise. I'm going to check out Pho Le since another reviewer said they have good Vietnamese food and I'm still craving bo bun hue! For those of you looking for a yummy ban mi, head to Baguette Deli- the house special is my favorite sandwich and my family swears they have the best boba drinks. And for those of you craving pho, you can buy the pho broth concentrate, fresh pho noodles and meatballs in the refrigerated section of your nearest Asian market (there's 3 that I regularly go to since I can't find everything I'm looking for in one store!). Grab some cilantro, Thai basil, lime, bean sprouts and jalapeños, and voila! - pho at home!

Dr Loveland and his nurses are great. The scheduling staff are incapable of consistently keeping record of appointments made. On top of that, when confronting them about their scheduling errors, they hung up on me twice rather than correcting the problem they created. Not sure I'll be back to this establishment. Weighing the patient care vs the shoddy staff.

First thing, the staff here is awesome. The rooms are spacious, clean, and have the amenities that you want in a room. Refrigerator, microwave, reading lights for your bed. My wife and I loved our stay here, and would suggest it to any of our family or friends that are visiting Meridian or Boise. Breakfast is included, and there are places that deliver to this Holiday Inn Express. And there are also some restaurants that give you discounts for staying here. We will definitely be here again if and when the need arises.

I recently had lunch at Ling and Louie's and loved it. I had California rolls and it was the best sushi I have had after a long time..I love Sushi. My husband had the pan seared chicken with fried rice and it was really good too.
Small portion though for the price of Lunch. It was $12.99.. It had 4 little thin pieces of chicken and some fried rice. Maybe adding few veggies might be good idea.
Overall very pleasant experience.Ambiance is great, friendly service.

Horrible.  I made a 1:30 appointment.  I called at 2 o'clock and they said they'd be there at 3.  By 4 o'clock they said they were on their way.  By 4:15 I just cancelled.  What a waste of a Saturday.

Korean tacos! Korean TACOS! During Treefort I cannot eat anywhere else but RiceWorks. The Korean tacos are composed of Kimchi, cucumber, and marinated chicken. 

These are the best Asian fusion tacos I've had in the valley. The kimchi is what makes these tacos a tasty treat. It's spicy enough to tickle your tongue and lips without reducing the taste of the chicken that I think is marinated in a sweet soy sauce. 

The combination of the juicy chicken, cucumbers, kimchi and hot sauce spank your mouth with taste and texture. These are fun and tasty tacos that I highly recommend.

I am a customer and I paid over $200 and I finished the stamp card and at the end you get a free large drink and I ordered three drinks because I only had two stamps to get to the free drink so  of course I ordered three drinks as if the last one was a free drink they told me  you can get the free drink later so I said its fine so I paid all three drinks and I got nothing for free they told me that I can get a free drink later on but I would have to pay for these so they give me a Nother stamp card so as usual I paid for it and then they messed up my drink I ordered a clear tea and they just gave me regular iced tea so I told them that they messed it up and they told me okay well you're going to have to pay is $1.80 so I can get the drink that you wanted so the point is that he messed up my drink more than once that wasn't the first time he did it and they make me pay for the drink that they messed up for so I took the drink and I went to tell my mum so my mum came and she took the drink out of my hand and she gave it to them and told them thank you and they took a He said you're welcome we still didn't get a refund for that drink and to be honest they always mess up my order and they make me pay for it and they didn't even say sorry he should have Took my drink and gave me the drink that I wanted said sorry for mistaking YOUR drink I do not recommend their customer service very terrible this used to be my best placed to go now I can't even go or talk about it because they were rude and I do not know customer service it was terrible experience

I had a decadent dining experience at Ling & Louie's. My zesty Orange Chicken dish my have changed my life. But good food alone doesn't warrant my five-star review, my server Savannah really made the night!

Soda tastes dirty. You have to pick through the veggies because some are no good. Noodles are dry and sticky. Meat is weird, sliced, and frozen. Employees dont explain how the place works, you're kinda on your own and they hardly speak any English so it makes it hard on knowing how to do it. And how they cook it is very unsanitary. I'm from Vegas, this is a HUGE disappointment. I can say if you ever go to Vegas go to Genghis Grill! It's kinda the same concept but it's actually good and the employees are so nice

I had some food delivered to my place from this place and when I got the food I realized that the pasta was very undercooked. It was as if someone threw the noodles in for a minute or two with low heat and threw it in a to go box. It makes me wonder if they would do the same thing if we got the food there.

This place has been so amazing. They have been working with my daughter on her pain. After going to 3 different places to help her knee we found this place. The staff is really caring, and the appts times are really flexible. I needed the flexibility to have them work our my daughters school and cheer times. I would Highly recommend this place to anyone.
Great coffee and boba tea! Also, staff were incredibly nice. Highly recommend this place if you want to chill out with excellent coffee and boba tea.

While in Meridian, I got a recommendation to go here.  We were seated as soon as we arrived.  The decor was very nice and the place was spacious.

Taking a look at the menu, it was an asian fusion spot.  On a hungry stomach, you can find something to satisfy your taste buds, they have meatloaf on the menu for those who don't want to deal with the fusion.

I ordered a grilled chicken salad, I didn't want to explore in the asian fusion section.  My boyfriend loves fried rice and decided to get an order of that.

Our food arrived timely but the taste was "alright".  The restaurant is still new and I can see potential.

Friendly staff and you don't sit around forever waiting for your check or refill.
1100 am ... 1 register open. 25 card only registers. Literally 10 employees walking around aimlessly. WTAF???? Its like this everytime we visit the store.

Food was excellent! The McKinney Wedge salad was fabulous, and the lamb stew the best I've had. Yes it's fairly new and may have had some growing pains, but the food and atmosphere are wonderful. If you want an Irish pub and not a chain restaurant, try the Harp!
We stopped for quick lunch at Village inn Meridian.  Yellow curry freshly prepared and spiced just right.  Teriyaki chicken excellent.  Everything fresh and well prepared .  Great spot

They actually sent me a bill for $70 for services not rendered, my pipes freezing, and needing to hire someone else to come and finish the job their technician screwed up? 

I suggest everyone who has a bad experience to report to Consumer Fraud, the BBB, Rip-off Reports, and every possible reporting agency. That is what I'm going to do if they don't clear up this bill.

This place has great food and prices.  Plus  the service is outstanding. The griddle had Goldie's have nothing on this classic diner.  My wife and I drive from Nampa every weekend.  Sure the place is rough around the edges, but it's worth it.  Plus they have farmer brothers coffee, the best diner coffee IMO.  


Responses to negative reviews: The seating isn't confusing.  You walk in and take a seat.  If the restaurant is full you wait.  I've never had to worry about my spot in line. I've never waited more than 5 minutes.  The place could use a deep cleaning, but it's not nearly as bad as some of these reviews make it sound.  I've been to several diners in the area, they are all similar in that regard.  

If you love classic diner food and atmosphere this is the place in the treasure valley IMO.
Place was nice. Room was clean.  The long term residence are the issue.  They smoke week and act like the own the place.  Annoying.  I'll avoid these morons and stay elsewhere next time.
Food was decent.  Service was ok.  Noticed that if you were a regular you got outstanding service.  Kinda disappointed...my husband really wanted to try this place out.

This was our second visit since they opened. The pho was very good the first time, but they have clearly made major changes because the food was amazing. Very filling, hot, fresh and reasonably priced. The gentleman behind the counter gave prompt, polite and personable service. The restaurant was not busy, and the confusing array of multicultural decor led to a conversation that was as pleasant as the soup. 

Please consider an all-you-can-eat "phomotion". Thanks for an excellent lunch.

We spent 3 nights here and thought the rooms were great. The room was clean, the beds were comfortable, the facility was maintained, and the staff were friendly. The room did have an odor, somewhat, but we acclimated (for the lack of a better word) in about 15 mins... LOL! The complimentary breakfast was minimal and didn't offer as much as other Best Westerns that I've stayed at before. It's close to a lot of fast food, or if fast food isn't your thing, grab something from WinCo across the street and pop something in the microwave.

What I didn't like was that EVERY SINGLE NIGHT trucks with trailers were allowed to take up to 7 parking slots to accommodate themselves. Parking is LIMITED and if you're not parked in the lot before 9PM-10PM you're sh*t outta luck on a parking spot because of inconsiderate parking hogs. You're basically forced to park in the shopping center parking lot and walk across the street (they say they have permission to use that lot, too). Management needs to force these parking hogs to park in the shopping center lot. (-2 stars)

Next door (too close IMO) is Motel 6. We all know Motel 6's are notorious for attracting a sketchy clientele and they did not disappoint.
