What Motel 6 won't you see a beater with it's hood up and being tinkered on in its parking lot by a couple of meth heads? This isn't Best Western's problem; it's just something to consider before booking this place.

I liked this place, but will never stay at this location again because of the parking and its proximity to Motel 6.

This place is top-notch for a budget-conscious Asian-American restaurant! Prices are just right and the food is stupendous! Had the General Ling with Yakisoba noodles and grilled chicke and I didn't not want it to end! Service was friendly and fast. The restaurant has a dark, cool atmosphere with a waterfall that trickles away in the background. If you are in the mood for Asian-American food and want a quality experience, I can't recommend this place enough! Menu is extensive and full of great choices.
Incredible pizza, delicious dessert, friendly & courteous owners, and warm, inviting family-oriented atmosphere. This is probably going to become my new favorite pizza place.

If I could recommend any bar it will always be this place. The food, BOMB. 
The drinks, TASTY. 
The bartenders (especially Jonathan), the BEST. 
You will not be disappointed in going here.
The tater gems are crispy! The avocado bacon burger was yummy! Accommodating for my request with no bun. Quick service, clean place. Featured on Man vs. Food for their 1lb burger.

I went for an early dinner couple weeks ago. Good atmosphere and service was fantastic. Salad bar is very good. Meat? Lots of it was over salted and surprisingly tough or overcooked. Frankly for the price I prefer the other churrasco in town; same quality meats, bigger meat variety and a lot less money.

4 stars because it is very affordable, no contract, no BS gym...everyone is there to work out. Cardio cinema is awesome. All equipments are in great condition, a lot of varieties, a lot of free weights, dumbells, barbells, and never have to wait for anyone on machines. They also do have showers, but no pool...hence, no 5 stars.

I have been going to see Amber since she opened her lovely business.  As a local health provider, I also frequently recommend her to patients of mine with skin care issues. Amber and her team are smart, experienced, and able to adjust their treatments to meet the needs of the person in front of them. 

When I go for my own skin care, I always feel relaxed and pampered. Most importantly, I leave looking forward to my next visit.

Excellent pet salon!! I have been taking my dogs there for years. The husband and wife owners are great. They are always there to greet us. They are always good to my dogs, AND cat :-) 
My husband and I like that it is just a nice, clean, friendly environment and the prices are great!
This is a Great cleaners. They are  awesome and their prices aren't any higher for normal stuff. I moved away or i would still be using them.

I was looking forward to the recliner in my room as stated but sadly no recliner so no other place to sit except full size not a queen but more like an extended twin bed. Even though a full kitchen, really no use as no silverware, cups or plates. The full size fridge was nice with the ice maker. Room is smaller than other hotel rooms. Definitely way overpriced. No one greeted at the door like it also says. Lobby smelled of smoke even though a non smoking hotel. Pet fee is $10.60 per night. This is more like a low version of super 8 and should cost no more than $65. A night. The staff were friendly and lots of green grass for dogs but no poop bags, no pool and no free breakfast. But you can buy breakfast and have it delivered to your room for about $4.95....  I guess it is better priced for weekly and monthly rooms.  Maybe they got the recliner.  Friendly staff. Green Grass, Front Door Parking.  But where's  my recliner?

Technician (Bob) was great, thorough, and responsive to questions but the scheduling with office staff was awful. We have dogs and need to be home when the technician arrives to keep the dogs inside. We rescheduled to assure we could be here, however, the company would not communicate the schedule changes with the technician. After repeated attempts with the same results, I've given up and cancelled.
Really good meat selection and tasty. The salad bar is exceptional (try the lobster bisque) and the service sets the bar really high! I highly recommend this restaurant.

You will NOT find a better grooming experience than at Groomingtails. I have been going there since the early 90s and have ALWAYS been completely satisfied. My dogs have always been treated with such tender care. Can't say enough about how much I recommend them!!!

My wife and I went here for a large business meeting. We had a ton of fun and the food was really good. I think it's best to go as a large group and share food so you get to try more things, because the menu is kind of hit and miss. The highlight was the excellent service ask for Vince. He made our night.

I bought a Groupon for 1 preventive treatment (we chose exterior). I used their website to schedule my appointment but they have some issues with that system. I called to confirm the appointment a few days later when I hadn't heard from anyone and they didn't have my request. They were still able to get my appointment on the books for the time I wanted but I'm glad I called before the date I wanted it done. 

Joe came and did our initial appointment last week and explained what he was treating for and what we should watch out for throughout the year. He was on time and did his job quickly but thoroughly. We signed up for the quarterly treatment program they offer and I hope the great service we received will continue.

I enjoyed the pork dinner but like so many non-chain places the owners seemed a little tired of it all. The food was delivered to us in styrofoam even though we stayed.   Plastic forks. Sauces were good but nit original. Good rice. No sit down service. Rather counter ordering. That's OK but they could make a lot more mimetic they had servers, darker, warmer atmosphere, carpet. Did enjoy the food though.

I visited with Dr. Pellant for the first time just a few weeks ago.  Since then she has called my home personally to talk to me, talked with other doctors about the best treatment plan for me and has been just amazing.  It's a little bit of a drive for me.  35 minutes, but she's worth it!

I had such a good experience I actually contacted corporate so they could pass on the praise. One of my coworkers had a child and I stopped to get them a card  and balloons, the balloon was a little low but not so much it was a problem. The employee proactively paged someone to refill the ballon and when that person didn't know how took the time to go fill it herself.  Very good and unexpected customer service that exceeded my expectations.
I am so happy to be able to know I can freely  eat at this place and NOT wear a mask and see the waitresses faces!! I will support any place that supports our freedoms!

The waitress seemed surprised we were there.  We were the only customers there at 6 on a Wednesday.   Service was fine but not great considering she only had one table. Food was substandard at best.  Panda Express across the street would have been gourmet in comparison.   I had the Wednesday special. The mandarin chicken really had no chicken in it just extremely overcooked batter.  I couldn't even eat the chicken wings as they were again extremely overcooked.   There was a salad that came with mainly indistinguishable ingredients.   We will never return.

We walled out. 

We walked in and waited at the hostess station to be seated. A table very close to the hostess station was getting food from 2 servers and a manager. Another party came in behind us.

While the table was being served, another server that was apparently off walked by us on her way out the door. Nobody even acknowledged us other than the server that was off. She excused herself as she walked out the door. The manager did make eye contact but walked away after assisting in dropping off the food.

We really like the food at Applebee's but the service sucks.

Our toilet  clogged over the weekend.  The toilet was backing up into the tub, so I knew it was beyond what I could solve with a plunger,  liquids, etc.  I had never used Roto-Rooter before.  Late Sunday evening, I went onto their web site and requested the earliest possible appointment for Monday a.m.  I am always skeptical when requesting service on a web site ; especially emergency service.  I was contacted by email at 7:30 a.m. Monday with an appointment time.  Still nervous, i called in to the local Roto-Rooter office in Boise to confirm.   The young lady I spoke with was friendly and very professional, which I found reassuring.  She had my appointment right there and we agreed that I would receive a phone call twenty minutes before the technician arrived.   This is huge for me, because I was able to go to my office 15 minutes away and continue working, instead of sitting around home all morning, waiting.  Just like clock work, I received the phone call.  The technician (Todd) arrived on schedule, and was professional in his demeanor.   His work was skillful, clean and efficient.  Todd took extra care with our bathroom, floors, etc, which is important to me, and I didn't have to ask.  He was on site for two hours.  Our clog was really bad.  Todd had to remove the toilet and run an auger 30' - all the way out of the house plumbing.   At my request, he also repaired our toilet which had had a leaky valve for a long time.  I am giving Five Stars to Roto-Rooter.  I highly recommend their services for tough drain clogs, and courteous, professional service.   It was well worth the $$ to have our drains back in order, and our peace of mind.  Thanks Roto-Rooter!

Chuck Best, Boise ID

Gross. Seriously, no flavor and over priced.... also onion GALORE. That is the buffer veg of choice. I will not be going back here again. For what you pay you hope for the best.... way to have hopes dashed.

First of all this was my first visit to L and L's.
Nice atmosphere.
Decided on then General Ling (grilled chicken) with brown rice.
It was basically inedible because the entire plate was literally "swimming" in the "sweet spicy" sauce which was basically nothing but overwhelming sweet in taste. It tasted almost exactly like Mr Yoshidas sauce they sell at Costco though not as flavorful. Just sugar sweet nasty. Nothing spicy or hot about it. I asked for a side of Hot chili sauce to help the palatability.
I was very hungry and on a time schedule so just decided to eat it. Was like eating chicken and rice and a few vegetables in a brown sugar slury. 
Now, when the server finally came back around and asked if I liked it,  I did inform her and showed her the giant puddle of sauce I managed to strain from part of the dish. She reported to manager and apologized. Apparently the reason I was given was because I ordered grilled chicken and it normally comes with a breaded chicken so "it didn't soak up the sauce".  I find that interesting since I asked if the chicken unless noted as crispy was grilled. "Yes" was the answer. 
In spirit of full disclosure offered an "app card". I'm traveling on business and though work in Boise regularly and wanted to give this place a shot against PF Changs, epic fail.  I didn't accept the appetizer card as no intention of coming back.They took $ 3.90 off instead and the unappetizing meal cost me $ 12.35 with tea.

Went to Louie's in Meridian today for a friend's birthday lunch.   The service was slow but I know that everyone is short handed.   But I literally had the worst lunch I have ever had in the 42 years that I have lived in Boise.   
I ordered a Caesar Salad with Salmon since it is very hot out this week.   Usually you get a nice grilled piece of salmon when you order this anywhere else.   I got a sad bowl of lettuce with some small, tasteless flakes of salmon.   Truly awful.   I won't be going back.  Ever.
Ian S. came at the scheduled timeframe and was very knowledgeable. He made sure all our questions were answered and the lawn/house was treated appropriately.

Gold's Gym (Meridian, Idaho)

I'm not reviewing this Gold's Gym as a member. I was in town for a few days and purchased a 24-hour pass.  My review is based on my experience, not the member's experience.  That being said...I really liked this gym.  It's equipped with a lot of cardio machines, benches, free weights, squat racks, a deadlift platform, and dumbbells heavier than 100 lbs.  I liked how this gym is very spacious and clean.  And during the times worked out here, it appears people do re-rack their weights.  The gym manager at this location should be proud.  I don't dabble in a lot of the machines so I really can't tell you if they're good or bad.  What I can tell you is that this gym uses some of the best brands in the business very similar to the first-generation Hammer Strength and Life Fitness models.  As for price, I paid $10 for a 24-hour pass.  This was good for a workout in the morning, the evening, and the following morning.  Will I be back?  Can't Wait! Yeah Buddy!

Facials are my favorite indulgence- and time spent at Amber Rose skincare is not just soothing for my skin-but for my soul.  Amber is the real deal and worth the wait for the magical moment when our schedules match up. She is beyond passionate about Osmosis/ the amazing natural skin care line she carries.  I especially loved a pumpkin enzyme peel she had back in the fall- but the cleanser I get to use at home is so full of essential oils that I am transported back to the zen of the Facial each time I use it.  I cannot recommend her enough- she is such a gentle knowledgeable pro.

Made reservations for a Saturday night the weekend of Christmas for a party of 9.

Friendly service! 

Children's popcorn shrimp bento box was DELICIOUS! As was the consensus of the other dishes at our table. 

Crab Crunch roll along with shrimp tempura roll were a bit bland. Rice seemed soggy/pasty. Could have just been a bad batch. 

Overall would like to try it again!

I love the food but it's winter....TURN Off THE AC!!!!!!  We have been here three times in the past month and each time it has been uncomfortable to the point that we had to put on our coats.  Unacceptable.

This place is kind of a joke i placed an order for their food through uber eats and i order the shrimp Pad Thai and THIS is what i get (refer to the picture)... So unless you want to have to use a microscope to find the shimp you ordered and pais 3$ extra for dont get the shrimp pad Thai

If you are looking for a place to stop in. Get a drink some gas and wash your car you have found it. This place has everything u need. They says have a huge assortment of beverages and even a growler station for all you beer nuts. They always have plenty of pumps to handle the volume of cars. They have 4 car washes. 2 self serve which 1 is equipped for rv's and big trucks and 2 auto were u can choose between brush or brushless wash. Sometimes parking for the convenient store can be scares but then u just use the drive thru to get your beverage and off u are. Clean, refueled and your thirst quenched..

I am thrilled with my choice to go with PERX for my pest control needs and I would give them 10 stars if that was an option!! This company is affordable, professional, polite, and most importantly they get the job done right the first time. The technician went above and beyond to make sure that we were well taken care of and that our property was sprayed to perfection. Even more, they were able to get a technician out the same day that I called to sign up! These guys are awesome and I would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a pest control company.

Two stars is generous for this one. Food is mostly good, but the service...oh the service....
Straight. Trash. 

The two waitresses working today had the worst customer service I've seen in a while. They will seat you and that's about it. 

We tried to order pork fried rice and she told us we couldn't because they only do fried rice with no meat, yet pork fried rice was on the menu. 

Both waitresses passed us by 15 times total and never noticed that our drinks were empty...or that we were ready for the check.

Also if you have enough time to talk crap and give each other looks about your customers....you probably have enough time to refill a drink.

Anyway food is probably good to go. Service needs a lot of work.

Great food and excellent service! The car hop was cheerful, prompt, and checked back in a timely manner. My bill was less than $10 so I gave her a $5 tip for great service. She asked me if I was sure I wanted to give that much to her.

I love the Majestic Theater.  Comfortable seating, nice staff but the best part is the concessions.  Believe it or not it's one of the few places you can get refills on your enormous bucket of popcorn and large drink.  If I had my choice only place to go to watch a new release.

Best place in meridian/Boise. Rice always great, steamed veggies always great, chicken or shrimp always perfect. If you love spicy food I'd suggest the ninja chicken. My go to, I go everyday when i come back to visit meridian/Boise. I live off state and still do the drive.. so worth it.

I don't often review hotels unless it's to warn others of bad ones. I've been a professional pilot for over 40 years and I've averaged about 7 to 8 nights per month in hotels over the entire period. You can do the math, but I've spent a few years of my life in hotel rooms. I was Hilton Platinum for several years up until I retired. In many cases, a hotel room is just another hotel room - any differences between chains are simply distinctions without any meaningful differences. If you've seen one hotel room you've pretty much seen them all. I wasn't expecting much with my stay here. It was my first night at a Hilton Tru property and it hadn't started off well. I had flown into Portland Oregon to pick up a car I had bought. The airline connections sucked and I had already been up for 12 hours when I started the 6 "hourish " drive to Boise. I wasn't in a particularly good mood when I tried using my Hilton app to book the room using points. It wasn't working so I called the hotel directly. The person answered the phone with something along the lines of... "How can I provide you with 5 Star Service?" When she told me the because of system upgrading, they weren't able to book my room using points I snapped back with "then I guess you won't be able to provide me with 5 star service today. (I apologize for being a jerk.). A little while later I used the app to book the room at a very good rate and I'm glad I did. What can I say? Most hotel rooms rate 3 stars if they're merely good - clean, comfortable bed, and a good tv. If they're exceptional, I'll give them 4 stars. I reserve 5 stars for the "best of category" rooms I've ever stayed in. This property was one of those best of category rooms. Clean rooms without carpeting - I hate hotel room carpeting, I can only imagine the grunge that's in those carpets. Bright lights if you want them - dimly lit hotel rooms have always annoyed me. The bed was comfortable. The room was quiet in spite of being next to the elevator. The breakfast was good and the facilities were very nice. All in all, much to my surprise, this was the best hotel in this category that I've ever stayed at - hence, my 5 star review. I suspect you'll be seeing more properties like this one. I sure hope so.

Not impressed. Was there and met owner, who did a good job for the first round. The owner left and the guy that took his place was horrible. We sat at a table and ran dry next two rounds and had to go up to bar to get his attention. Also when we wanted a glass of wine he poured it and put it on the bar for us to come get it. Seriously?  He couldnt walk six feet? Then back to chat with his buddy at the bar. There were 7 people in the place. Again, not impressed.

I am a 69 year old male with really thick, yellow, hard toe nails.  The girls always seem to cringe when I come in for a pedicure.  But . . . . they are always polite and do a good job on my "difficult" toe nails.  And I appreciate that greatly.  Thank you all.

Applebee's has gone down hill recently, not that they were ever very good. Stingy portions, poor service, poor atmosphere.  Find basically anything other than an Applebee's. I am not a fan of this place.

The reason why this isn't four stars is because we had to wait close to an hour for our order tonarrive. The flavor is wonderful, but that wait is something else. The gal at the counter did bring us ice water while we waited, and she was very nice.

I've been to other Texas de Brazil restaurants, specifically the one in Irvine, CA. This one lacked intimacy and the romantic vibe of the one in Irvine. Service was excellent, but the harsh surroundings made it seem more like a cafeteria than an upscale restaurant.  I will say the salad bar was excellent; but for the price I expected a darker, more romantic vibe for a date night out.

We've enjoyed pretty good food from HT for a few years now. This is the first time we've been to the Ten Mile location and I can't imagine we'll be back anytime soon. I'm not a hard nose when it comes to wearing masks BUT if you are cooking and serving food to the public during a pandemic of a very infectious virus then you should absolutely wear one. The young lady at the register is wearing one but the two cooks in the back are bare faced Wake up HT, you've got a few other reviews pointing out the same thing.

BOMB. So good. So fancy. in the best way. Worth every penny we paid. Service was fantastic and definitely felt like we were treated with respect and served well. Fantastic food. Will definitely be back.

So I decided to update my review.  I love this place.  Super consistent with excellent bowls and plates.  My favorite is the spicy chicken bowl or dinner plate.  Not too spicy but then again, I like spicy food.  Wait staff is always friendly and prompt.

This by far is probably my favorite spot so far. The food and taste brings it close to home for me. Most places I've been to here in Idaho haven't really been appealing to me. I usually stick to the ninja chicken.
The dining experience was great we had the lasagna and manacoti and it was delicious one of my favorite italian restaurant in boise

I found Krissy on Yelp, and I am soo glad I did!!

I was nervous to get an airbrush tan at first, but Krissy made me feel completely comfortable. She is very knowledgeable about airbrushing and can even do a good contour. She won't go too dark if you have fair skin (like me). 

I used her by myself the first time, and since then many of my friends and both of my sisters have used her. They all have been very satisfied and will be using her again!

She will definitely be my go-to for a good tan, as well as all of my friends and sisters. Call her!! You won't be sorry.
Awesome nail salon! Great prices, great pedicures, and really nice staff. They were able to fit us in even though we were a walk in and they have wonderful spa chairs.
I like this walmart. Their displays are always so creative. The store is clean, too. It does close at midnight, however.
Great staff, nice heat in the spicy chicken bowl. Crisp veggies and stove hot. Plenty of food for one.  Great place.
I love this place! The ninja chicken is the best! Quick service and I love that the workers are always having a great time doing their jobs!

Krissy is amazing!  I was lucky enough to find Sun Kissed by Kris on Yelp about a year and a half back, and since then she has sprayed me for many special events, including my wedding.  Krissy is so personable and makes you feel comfortable.  In addition, the tan looks so natural and is long lasting.  Thank you Krissy for the amazing results!

My 16 year old son had A 4pm appointment on Monday, they kept telling him just A minute, just A few more minutes, etc.  Finally at 4:38 I went in to see what was going on and they said that even with an appointment you still have to wait.  Didn't get out of there until 5:15.  Haircut was decent but not sure I'll return.

I have gone to many places like this before and had a horrible experiences this place was a breath of fresh air clean organized the staff were so kind and helpful I had a ton of options for what I needed I also brought clothes into use for store credit and they took everything except for a handful of small things I will be coming back here again and again I will no longer be going to savers or Idaho youth ranch due to the fact that they are dirty understaffed and too expensive. We need more places like this!!!

Yes, I know I've said in the past that I don't like going to chain restaurants, but here I am, leaving a very positive review for one.  I've been so more than one "Happy Teriyaki", and in general I would say they are Ok.  Places like this are great in a pinch, when you are rushed, or you are tired, or it is late, or you simply don't feel like expending a lot of energy to get a decent meal.  When "Wednesday Evening" hit this week, Happy Teriyaki was my immediate thought.

The restaurant is very close to where we are currently living, which was the main reason why I went there.  I got take out with a variety of stuff for  DW and I to share, and I've got to say, we were very pleased with the results.  

The Hot and Spicy Chicken was hot and spicy (not at all too hot, but nice flavor), the Grilled Prawns on skewers was great, the fried rice was flavorful, and the Gyoza was fresh, crispy, and yummy.  

For a fast-food take-out dinner, our experience here was great!

True Story:
My friend Tad went bald years ago.  On a recent trip to China I brought him back a special comb.  He, always carries that comb with him out of habit. 
He just can't part with it.
This place is nothing like it is in Vegas half the amount of servers and the service is just not the same I will not be back! Was not a good experience food is fine but just not what I expected.

I have mixed feelings about this location. I've gone back numerous times and had various experiences. The 1st time, service was decent, but once I tried the Pho, the broth was lacking. It was not terrible, but not as flavorful as I expected. The 2nd time, service was great, broth was better, and it was served quickly. The 3rd time I called in an order to go, my got my food quickly and left. I arrived at my destination and opened up the food to enjoy my meal and all the fixings were not there. So, this place is hit or miss. I would rather go to Little Saigon in Nampa. I will go back, it is a new restaurant and they may still be figuring things out. My review may change in the future.

The wait time was crazy. But it was worth it. The food was really delicious. I highly recommend the chicken fried stake. My only issue was that the portions are huge. This would be a great place to share food with someone. But everyone at our table got our own plate and ate until we were stuffed. We still had half of our plates left. That seemed to be the case with most tables. It was unfortunate seeing so much food go to waste.

Any chain restaurant that has the same friendly faces for years and years has to be doing something right.   They are always spot on with the orders and fairly quick drive through service.  

Food has always been to expectations and they do a great job of finding out if you would like to add cookies for 99 cents!   

I'm pleased to return here two or three times a month.

We heard about this place on the radio, decided to check it out and we're so glad we did!! Delicious food, big portions, nice atmosphere and excellent service. We will definitely be back!! A new favorite!

I went here while visiting a couple years ago and absolutely loved it. I spent months trying to find something comparable where I lived, but nothing ever compared. Luckily, my husband and I moved here a few months ago and I can have it any time. I crave it pretty much on the daily and if my husband would let me, I would probably get it at least twice a week. I'm a picky eater, so it's hard for me to find places that I'm truly impressed with, but this has easily become my favorite place to eat. I highly recommend it to anyone considering.
Went there to get a fish cleaning clamp board and got a great deal there.  The employees were helpful and it was easy to find what I was looking for.

Outstanding Job! 
The work on my large fifth wheel was exceptional! The guys were professional and made sure they attended to every detail. Since our rig had been sprayed with hard water irrigation water from a previous stay at an RV park it had some really bad hard water spots. The rig looks brand new again and I am so extremely pleased with their work. 

The scheduling process is truly simple and straightforward. Pricing is exactly as described on their site. Once scheduled you receive an email with an option to add it to your calendar. For a working person this is a huge help. 
I would highly recommend this company! 

In fact I am going to schedule our truck next!
Great place for a nice hometown breakfast of eggs bacon or sausage and hashbrowns. Waitresses are efficient and friendly.  Not as busy as some breakfast eateries and just as good! :)
Really expensive and provided unsatisfactory customer service. If I could go back I would definitely not use them again!! Proceed with caution.

When first entering the restaurant is very beautiful and open. The receptionist greeted us and seated us almost immediately. The server at the time took a while to get over to us because she had other tables. She came by to say she would be right with us.  Then we ordered our drinks and for being only a few tables in there it took awhile to get our bar beverages. The salads were pretty decent and the Male server Making them did a really good job.  However the meat selection was very minimal.  Only maybe 3 different meat choices came by and we had to request another meat to be brought. The meat itself was not very tasty,  over cooked and dry. I've eaten at other locations and have loved it.  The service was ok.  For being a slow Thursday night, I would of expected better service!  For that price,  I did not feel that the meat selection was great at all. Our bill was over 250 dollars ...  I would not try this location at all again.

"Sometimes you wanna go where everybody knows your name, and they're always glad you came.." (Cheers theme song).  Seriously that's the type of vibe and song that played in my head when I visited with my two puppies. The staff here are friendly and definite pet lovers.  It really came across that they cared about our experience there.  They were super attentive and playful with my dogs. They were interested in their names and ages and breeds. They give us 1:1 attention to help pick our treats. They even called people from the back to meet and greet my babies. Their prices are also resonance for the treats. We got duck feet for $.99 each.  Those same duck feet would cost us $2.50 at Petco.  They have delicious smelling vanilla, cinnamon bully sticks.   They smelled wonderful, and my dogs LOVED them.  This place will be one of our regulars.

My all time favorite place to get Boba! Everything I've gotten so far has been so delish! 
I've gotten the Black tea peach mango with strawberry popping boba & lychee jelly . Black tea pineapple peach with strawberry popping boba & lychee jelly. Coconut blende milk tea with strawberry & mango popping boba. (My kids fav). I wish they would have put the shaved ice Mango! I would have loved that too!! Employees were so sweet & informative! Please bring one to the Canyon county area.

We love Dr Cron, our entire family has been seeing him for many years. He has a great sense of humor. He is very straight forward in his approach and has a great bed side manor. We are staying with him in his move from his prior practice. I recommend him to anyone that is looking for a cool doctor!

We really enjoy Happy Teriyaki!  We come here often when we feel like having a light, quick, asian meal.  Chicken Teriyaki, Hot & Spicy Chicken Teriyaki, and Grilled Shrimp Teriyaki are our typical order.  We have always ordered "to go", and the Chicken dishes always give you enough of a meal to have a left-over lunch the next day.  I love left-overs for lunch!  The place is always very clean and neat, and the service is wonderful.  The people here are super friendly, and super helpful.  When I was here last, I  changed my mind on my order after I had already paid, and I asked for them to change it (something that is kind of out of character for me), and they were more than happy to adjust my order to meet my request.  They are awesome, and the food is great!  We'll keep coming back.

[  A deep sigh is the defining characteristic of a good Dad joke...  If it gets a laugh it might be confused with a real joke. ]

I loved this place. Having recently moved to ID, I was in search of a good pedicure, a clean place, full of friendly people. I know, I am rather high maintenance, however Nicely nails met all my needs and more! It was a $30 pedicure that included the works and customer service that bordered on friendship. This place is a MUST and my new home for Nails:)

Amazing food with outstanding flavor- ordered the balsamic chicken. Enormous portion. Complimentary garlic bread was also great. The side salad was disappointing- 90% iceberg lettuce with one stray pepperoni and a handful of croutons and carrots- however the "house dressing" was wonderful. Our server Aubrey was great, but the hostesses were less-than welcoming. The restaurant could use some music and more comfortable seating.

Amazing customer service, food, drinks. Loved this place! Had the eggs Benedict & best I have had. The sauce was amazing, ham cooked perfectly & eggs done just right. 
Had their huckleberry mint mimosas & while I wasn't a huge fan of it , it was just all right. 
Our waitress was very sweet & personable. She made us feel right at home. 
Definitely will be back ! Want to try their burgers. Sounds amazing

I really like their food, especially the Yaki udon with chicken. Their fried rice is okay but not great, needs more flavor. Their prices are decent. Their Thai tea bubble tea is different then I've had it before, it's frozen like a slushy instead of iced. Overall great place, nice people, and some good food.

Just to start out I will say I hate getting my hair cut. I hate waiting and it always just seems like a waste of time for me. I should really shave my head. That being said i usually hit up one of the local sport clips but figured I would try out LJ as I was close by. The self check in is super nice as u don't have to wait for someone to stop what there doing to help u. The waiting area is nice with 4 TV's and nice comfy chairs to sit in.only prob is the TV's are mounted a little low so your view can be blocked, also there is only like 8 chairs so if it gets busy u might be standing. The pricing is kind of confusing as they have a menu in front of u as u sit down "in a nice oversized barber chair" but no prices for anything. I got the normal haircut then was asked if I wanted a shampoo which I agreed then asked for a hot towel which I love. The shampoo was super long I mean it lasted a good 20 mins I feel like. My hot towel was ice cold by time it was done. After that back to chair and got a hot towel on the neck then a straight razor neck shave which was nice all and all it was 24 bucks for everything which is typical but I was there for over an hour and half. Mind u I wasn't in a rush and enjoyed the scupl massage but wow 90 mins seems super long for me when I waited maybe 20 mins to get started.. I will probably go back and just make sure I have a little more time set aside next time.

Granted we love Italian food and try places from CT to ID to FL to NV. This place bottom 10%.  We ordered sausage and ziti for 7 year old grandson and sausage was crazy hot.  I love hot food.  Tasty hot.  Not crazy red pepper hot.  No one liked it.  Wife had an Alfredo with no flavor.  Honestly I forget what I ordered but thankfully subsisted on the garlic bread which although the first order was cold and probably old since we were early dinner diners, the second order was great.  The salad edible but the dressing far to vinegary to be well ranked.  Avoid and go to Guidos
Nail tech was very rough with handling my hands. Also cut my finger with her nails when pushing the cuticles back. Other wise the color looks good. Will not be back here

very impressed, this place made my anniversary. I had the f-ing loader sliders, tender steaks with grilled onions, bacon, butter toasted bun and just the right amount of sauce. I finished off with a great banana cheesecake dessert item and a mojito to wash it down. you have to try this place.

We are 55+, and this theater gives us a discount! Good theater with all the current movies. It is clean, comfortable, and just wonderful for us! We don't need frills, heated seats, etc. We come to see a movie!

I take both my large German Shepherd and my Labrador to this shop and they do an excellent job! The owner Jay is always a pleasure to deal with and his employee Kerry has done both the haircuts for my dogs and done a great job. I recommend this groomer for everyone!
Unassuming from the outside, but very good food and service. Can tell it's a local favorite.

What a delightful treat! Urban Fox is a welcome respite from the Big Box chains on Eagle Road, offering a clutter-free hipster vibe and delicious coffee!

The owner has a heart for the customers and has gone above and beyond with every detail--from the stunning meeting table to the specialty drinks that can't be found at any other coffee shop in town!

Urban Fox transports me to Downtown Seattle or San Francisco--but with plenty of parking!! ;)
Patty's been cutting my hair for three years. She is super friendly and simply does an amazing job every time. I highly recommend her !
Amazing food and service! I love eggs Benedict, but many restaurants don't get it right - The Original Sunrise Café was on point!

Ordered via Door Dash. Order arrived quickly but honestly I was shocked how bad the pizza was. No flavor,  very little cheese or sauce, and looked like it had been under a warmer all day. Disappointing.

We were really looking forward to this as we hadn't been in about 3 years. The only other location we'd visited was in Las Vegas, unfortunately the Boise location fell way short. We were seated promptly but it took quite a while for the server to greet us. When he finally arrived and took the drink orders it took about 10 min to receive them. Because of COVID we weren't aloud to get our own plate at the salad bar. It was another 20 min waiting for that to arrive. The gouchos starting arriving shortly after but with a good 10-15 min in between each. We were visited by about 7 different choices in that time span. Finally we were asked if there was something specific that we wanted and when we told them only 7 had come by they said there were 15 total. We never saw the others the entire time we were there. Our reservation was at 6 and we didn't leave until 9. We weren't full because we were just too tired of waiting. We won't be back and won't recommend it. There are too many fabulous steak houses to waste our time and money there. So disappointing.

This place is so yummy! The service has always been amazing as well. Take in or to go the food is always good. We get the spicy chicken teriyaki but mild and add teriyaki sauce and it taste soooo good! The veggies are always so yummy and cooked perfectly. I wish they had a punch card it would make going there all the time a little bit easier lol.

Jarrod and Madi at the front desk were extremely welcoming, friendly, and professional. They made me feel very welcome and were knowledgeable about local restaurants and activities. Management- give these people a raise- or at minimum a fancy steak dinner. They are awesome employees.

Overall the hotel was great for my business trip needs I will definitely be coming back.

This lady that cut my nephews haircut forgot to cut one side off....leaving one side shaved and the other unshaved. I didn't notice toll I got home because prior I was talking on the phone and when I glanced at it, it looked fine. I don't understand how you forget to shave a side? It wasn't even busy for that to happen and her to feel rushed. 20$ out the door and I will never be coming back to this place again. Only reason it gets two stars is because I got a decent laugh out of it.

Don't expect much out of this hotel. Standard amenities are missing. No coffee maker in the room. The room is tiny. It's only a space to sleep essentially. No bottles of shampoo or lotion that you can take with you, instead you use bottles that thousands of other people have touched. The TV hardly worked. The trash truck arrived by 6am two of the three nights we stayed to empty the dumpsters, and it was insanely loud. I realize the hotel probably can't control this, but it might be worth it to make a call to ask for a better time to empty the dumpsters. Definitely woke us up from what could have been a restful night of sleep that was desperately needed after a 15 hour drive. It is considered a minimalist hotel, which wasn't very clear when we booked it unfortunately. The bed was very comfortable, which was a plus, and the room was clean. I'm glad I brought my own shampoo, body wash, etc. Sadly we won't stay here again.

The food and service here are always on point... You can ask the server for a specific cut and they will ensure they bring that over as well... drinks are a little pricey, but very well made! The salad bar is also really good; Fresh, a ton of options, and well prepared.

The food was very fresh, service was excellent from Hailey.  Only problem was coupon for check-in was for AZ not ID. Idaho coupon is for $5 off. Only way to find this all out is to sign up on home page and give them your e-mail for advertising. And the LingLouies website doesn't work very good took 3 tries to find out coupon for free lettuce wraps only applies in another state. And then the coupon for $5 off is only for your next visit in Idaho. The Manager was sweet and honored the lettuce wraps coupon for Arizona. Thank you all for a nice night out!
Picture in your mind exactly what you would want in an old-school drive-in. This it that. Good burgers, low-key charm, a bit nostalgic.

Very cool modern spot that specializes in coffee and boba drinks. It has a very nice atmosphere and very friendly staff. There are not many outlets and only located near the back of the place. They have a great selection of flavors to choose from along with some baked goods to go with your drink. They are open later on Fri and Sat but closed on Sun. Recommended if you're looking for just boba tea or coffee and super fast wifi speeds!

I used to love getting my nails done here, and something must've happened the past two years. It is not the same at all. 

When I visited, I was placed with 3 people to do an acrylic set. That's right, 3 separate people. One to cut and file my nails, one to apply the tips, and one to put on the acrylic powder and nail polish (sidenote: I was also left with the cuticles that were partially filed off left attached to my fingers). The result was horrifically misshapen nails that were way too thick. To top it off, they made it very apparent through their interactions that they wanted me in and out as fast as possible. The third person even chastised me for not keeping my hand relaxed...

Do not waste your time or money. You will receive poor and low-quality service. I hope they can return to the great work they once did.

This is a great little hole in the wall cafe.  Easy to find.  Right off the freeway. The food was good.  The bacon was great.  Oh how I love bacon.  They have a lot of old school vinyl records up on the walls  (if you don't know what records are ask your parents. Or maybe even your grandparents.)  (I'm old)  

The one thing better than the food is the service.  These ladies were happy to be serving all of their regulars. Hugs and gifts and laughs. Made me want to come back and become a regular

My husband and I decided to stop in, and were pleasantly surprised. Very flavorful, good prices, awesome quality, and great service. Everyone has always been friendly and helpful with suggestions. We have now been there a couple times and it was consistently good each time. The Ninja chicken is great but super spicy. I also really enjoyed the Korean beef. Will definitely eat here again.

When I spotted the smoker out back I knew I had to try the brisket. Little bit of a wait for weekday brunch for 2, about 10 minutes. Not a huge place but definitely huge portions! Brisket came with 2 eggs, potatoes, and a choice of side. I opted for fruit. The portions were definitely generous and I especially loved that the fruit included a good mix of things (melon, blueberries, raspberries, strawberries). I've had a lot of excellent brisket, so this was a little underwhelming, but still well-cooked. Not my favorite seasonings I've had on brisket. The eggs were cooked just as ordered. 

We'll be back to try more- definitely a fun place with delicious food.

My first visit to Louie's and I have no complaints. It was a Tuesday so Lasagne was the day's special and it was delicious. There was a salad before and enough lasagne to take home a lunch portion for the next day. Our server, Brooke, was attentive and helpful. I look forward to dining there again.

Food always sucks here!  You would think warming up a precooked chicken patty for the correct amount of time, isn't too much trouble for their cook.  But obviously math and counting is an issue.  Instead you get a chicken sandwich that isn't even edible, and is hard as frisbee, and all the skin is falling off. You should show those images on your menu instead!  For the prices you are charged, and for the time they take to get you your food, fully cooked shouldn't be a problem.  I need to stop eating here out of convenience, and start making better choices than this inedible garbage they over charge for!  Management needs to step up their game and actually manage!  Check the quality of food, check the quality of job the employee is putting out!  I won't return here.

Coffee was good. The people were nice. I asked for a water with my order and they only have bottled. I was just annoyed they don't provide water to paying customers. The coffee I bought was a luxury, water shouldn't be. I always get a water with my coffee, so I won't be going there. Probably a small issue to most and I'm sure they won't miss my money, seeing as it's in a middle/upper class white area. You know it's not because they can't afford to offer water. They're just taking advantage of their demographic.

Nothing is better than a cold beer, awesome food, a great staff and Shot of Jameson to warm the soul! This was my experience at The Harp! I noticed the owner makes sure that her drinks are accurate in the traditional Irish ways! Never had myself a better Irish car bomb than I did at The Harp! You need to make The Harp a regular stop!
Nice and clean and cool on a hot summer day.  Comfy sets too!

Kim was great! I scheduled an appointment for 10am and she was at my house right at 10am. Her grooming trailer is top of the line! She is very professional! I will use her for all of my future cat and dog grooming. My cat and dog loved her and they usually hate everybody! Her prices are great and she also takes credit cards which is nice. Call Kim! You won't be disappointed.

Oh my.... where to start.... cool place, could be a fun place to hang out. We just happened to make it a point to visit when there was a slow train wreck happening. 
First and foremost it is important to acknowledge that the server was obviously new to the industry. He has a lot of try, so points for that.

Now, for the carnage... It's a seat yourself joint and three of the available five tables hadn't been bussed, so my husband and I sat at a small clean table. After approximately 10 minutes the waiter asked if we wanted something to drink. I ordered the Bee's Knees, a gin and lemonade cocktail, and my husband had the Smithwick's. The Bee's Knee's was more the Bee'd Ankle's.... meh.  


After perusing the limited menu we decided what we were going to have. While we waited for this young fella to come and take our order I checked Yelp to see what others had to say.... I also had time to check the Yelp reviews against the menu.... read the details of each offering, looked through the drinks again, checked google for the difference between a Half & Half and a Black & Tan, researched Bass and Harp beers, wondered if I was going to want dessert, watched some college football, you get the picture...

When our server did come back I ordered the Corned Beef and Cabbage. No one had reviewed it. And we wanted to see what their version of a Charcuterie Board would be like. After that the server tried to leave but I pointed to my husband and told the server that he wanted to eat, too. My husband ordered the Irish Mac & Cheese. It was supposed to have a mustard flavor to it and green onions. When it finally arrived it had neither, but I digress.  He also ordered a side of baked beans.  

We got our entree's first, minus some of the ingredients listed on the menu. The corned beef and cabbage was ok. The Irish soda bread was really good, though! The Mac & Cheese would have been tasty if it had the green onions and if they would use actual cheese instead of a cheese sauce. It was really bland the way it was served.  

Eventually my husband got his equivalent to Van Dekamp baked beans, in a scalding hot bowl. And finally we got the charcuterie board. According to the menu it was supposed to have meats, Irish cheese, assorted fruits, and nuts.  For $12, we got 8 pepperoni slices, 4 chunks of honey dew, 3 strawberries, 3 Genoa salami, 3 Soprano meat slices, and some small chunks of 3 different cheeses. It wasn't worth it. And I wanted the nuts! 

We had to ask for a second round of drinks. I had a Harp Black & Tan. It was pretty to look at and I'm sure it was what was to be expected as far as taste. 

I hope that the server we had gets better at what he's doing. His attitude was top notch. He had a smile. He told us that the normal cook was in the hospital. And he verbalized appreciation of our understanding. I used to be a waitress, when we were still called that. It amused me, but also made me want to help this lad, seeing that he could not multitask! Two hands = Two dishes to the sink. No wash cloth in hand to wipe down the dirty tables. Very disorganized. I hope this place is around long enough for him to get the hang of it! We will go back to see if there have been improvements!

This was our first time here and we loved it! Our server Ariah was wonderful! Everything tasted great! We had Crab wontons, orange peel chicken, Tom kha gai, pad Thai and Vegas roll. Delicious all around! The chicken was not like regular orange chicken. Way better!

I love this boba/coffee shop!  They have really refreshing and light tasting milk tea, not overly sweet like some places.  I LOVE how I can adjust the level of sweetness in my milk tea...I order 50% while my kids order 75%.  Nice!!  I like how their tapioca balls are firm and chewy, not gooey and sticking to my teeth. Their employees are all very kind and accommodating.  Idaho finally has a great boba shop!!  :)
Their hot chocolate is so creamy...my kids love that, too!

Leif Brandt is awesome to work with. Leif shot both or wedding and our engagement session. He is professional and gifted at what he does. 
From our first meeting he was open to our vision and what we wanted. 
He asked the right questions to deliver the best photos for us.  He was thorough and caught every moment. 
Leif was a class act and left everyone at it wedding feeling special. 
All of our vendors loved working with him as well. 
His work speaks for itself. Awesome!!!

Food was okay. The customer service was terrible. I went in with my son and a friend and the employees didn't seem very friendly. We asked if there was any way we could substitute the veggies for something else and the employee said we could for fried rice and charged us a dollar for it? We had no idea until they bring us the check. Would've been nice to know. I guess the employee thought differnt. I got a bubble tea as well and wasn't very pleased either.  The bubbles were disgusting they were not flavorful like the other bubbles I've tried from another restaurant. They also charge for more than one flavor? That's bull. Definitely going to stick to my usual and favorite teriyaki place.

I really enjoy the hog style fries and their servings are huge.  However I will not be returning to the restaurant during Covid.  Our waitress did not wear a mask, and since the place was very busy and noisy she kept getting right in my face to be heard and hear me over the noise.  We only saw one server wearing a mask. The bar area was completely packed, social distancing was not happening.

I came here to meet with a colleague to get some work done for a workshop we were leading the next day.  We picked this place because they had internet which would allow us to work.  After a little trouble connecting, the internet was quick and allowed us to get all our work done.  The selection of beers will satisfy any taste.  The bartender was very helpful with making a selection.  I just wish they had more Idaho beers on tap.  I like to get a taste of the city and state that I am visiting when I'm out of town.  Overall, a good place grab a beer that has internet.

I tried it for the first time today and I loved it! All their boba drinks are dairy-free and they have plenty of plant-based milks to use in your drink. The staff is really nice and my earl grey boba was delicious. I will definitely come back and try the coffee

The food here is subpar.  Relatively overpriced for the bland food; definitely not worth what is served.  My reservations have been overlooked many times and when I have come in they have stated that they do not have a table available even though I have had a reservation for weeks in advance.  This place (prior to COVID-19) seemed to cram as many people as possible without regard for prioritized reservations.  Whilst I appreciate the values of a family restaurant, there were many small children running around the restaurant and climbing the seats like monkeys.  I recognize this is not under the control of the management here, but it really does ruin the atmosphere.
I drive 1hr to see Dr Higer. Great staff everyone was wearing a mask. You can even check out from room.

I loved this place as soon as I walked in. Let me start by saying that I love foxes and I even have a fox tattoo. Unfortunately I was accidentally pulled in because of a misunderstanding on a enter to win post through Instagram but I have to say that they redeemed the mistake and took good care of us. How awesome in the first place that they care for their customers well enough to have such large and great giveaways!! Staff was great, knowledgeable and most importantly, made us perfect coffees. I love the comfort ability of the store itself, it's spotless and beautifully decorated. Easy in and out and what more could you want, whether you just want to grab and go or enjoy a coffee and lounge around for awhile. Thank you guys again! I am glad I was brought in to try out your store!!
Horrible service and the pizza tastes like cardboard! Had me waiting for over a hour for my order

We've always been very pleased with our experiences at Louie's.  Unfortunately last night our experience was lacking due only to the poor service.  The food, as always, was exceptional.  I tried a new item on the menu (smoked salmon on penne)  and it was to die for!  However, our server  was horrible.  She never smiled...not once during entire evening.  We were not told about any nightly specials....which I realized as we left when I saw the specials board.  We ordered an appetizer which we never received.  We mentioned it when they brought the main course and they offered to bring it then but it was too late then for appetizers.  No apology was offered.  The waitress (unfortunately I didn't get her name...nor did she introduce herself) made us feel rushed as she failed to ask us how we were enjoying our meal and dashed past us.   I can appreciate she was busy but she could have been pleasant rather than surly.  Also we wanted dessert but we had to grab her as she rushed by even though we had been looking at the dessert menu for some time.  At the end of the evening we had to ask for bags I in which to put our to go items from first the waitress in training, then our surly main waitress and finally the bus boy...who was the only one all evening to quickly and pleasantly serve us.  

We will go back to Louie's I'm sure...I just hope we don't get that same waitress!
Been here a few times and first time posting on yelp.  Food is decent a little pricey but we like the fusion style
Enjoyed the food, loved the Forbidden Dragon drink! Ask to sit in Mel's section if you want GREAT,  warm & ultra friendly service!
Ample parking, large theater with comfy seating. Snacks and drinks are very overpriced. The theater and restrooms are clean, staff is friendly.

I've been wanting to try this place for months but it's pretty far out of the way for me but I had the extra 20 mins this morning before work so I stopped in. It's a cute space, bright and clean. I went specifically to get Boba- it's what they advertise, it's what they do. Well apparently they don't do it until after 9am but they open at 8am. Disappointed I ordered iced coffee that was pretty good but I could have stopped at any of the 12 other coffee locations (that have a drive thru since it was snowing) if my intent was iced coffee. I'll come back another time but def not at 8:30 in the morning.

I came in for the Happy Hour sushi.
I ordered the Spicy California Roll, and the Spicy Tuna Roll. 

They were definitely spicy! Great job!
Very comfortable rooms and good rates for reward members.  The staff was super friendly!  Steve was super helpful.  And the pool and hot tub and exercise room are now open!
great service, unfortunately her English isn't the best but she is fantastic,fast and the price is great

Our first time. Went with friends. Service was very accommodating, friendly, and on top of everything. Explained how everything works and drink specials. Food was fantastic. The salad bar was fresh and appealing. The waitstaff was quick to come around with different types of meats for us to try. And there to remove used our used plates. Manager came around to make sure all was good, if he could get or do anything for us. He also, took our dirty plates. Dessert was something else, hard to decided what delicious item to have. Ended up taking it home. The restaurant was about half full for a Wednesday night. It's a special treat, as it is pricey. But for what quality you get it's fair. Definitely recommend! Will be back.

Will never eat here again I have called in orders numerous times and they are always 10 minutes later than what they estimate which is understandable tonight I called they tell me 20 minutes I show up 25 minutes after I place my order after waiting for close to 45 additional minutes I'm told maybe five more minutes when really the kid had no clue how much longer it be. I had to leave due to work and my break being over they didn't even offer to refund my money

Probably won't be coming back ever. Food was cold and undercooked. Asked for crispy hash browns and they were uncooked on one side and almost burned on the other side....tasted like soggy potatoes with little flavor. The 1/2 waffle came to the table ice cold...almost like a frozen waffle that didn't get heated....seriously, it was ice cold.

Friends, its not worth the time.
Wait time: 30-60 min to be seated
Kitchen to table time: 45-90 SUPER SLOW!
Service: 1 out of 5. (1=worst) (5= best)
Not very guest friendly or fam bam friendly.

I love this location. It's a little farther from me than my local ones, but not too far off the freeway so as to be inconvenient. I typically have been there for lunchtime only as that's the time of day I'm closer to there, so I cannot comment on dinnertime service, but every time I have stopped for lunch whether inside before restrictions or to go, the service is pleasant and prompt. Food so far has also consistently been made right and is a decent portion for the price.

This restaurant is worth coming to. Everything is tasty and delicious! The "gauchos" and server are friendly and really attentive, even the manager tended to our table. The staff made our dining experience very enjoyable and made us feel comfortable and important. The food reminded me of my visit to Brazil, but with excellent service. You get a glimpse of what dining is in that country. The ambience is classy and clean, but you can come in casual. Great drink menu too!

I stayed here for three nights. The bed was extremely comfortable and the room was nice and clean. I found the funkiness of it all a little unsettling though. Wasn't fond of the lobby/breakfast area. I prefer traditional hotels. The hipster who was at the front desk on arrival was slightly condescending and he made me feel uncomfortable. The breakfast was pretty yucky too. Eggs tasted as if they were made from powder and the sausage was inedible. No exhaust fan in bathroom, and the pool area looked a bit raunchy. Also the traffic outside was very loud and I felt I was at the Daytona speedway. But since the bed was so comfy I didn't have trouble sleeping. I'd like to add that housekeeping did a phenomenal job. Would be a fun getaway for kids I think. I'll look elsewhere for future visits to the Boise area though. Just set in my ways!

The food was awesome.  The bacon bacon  burger and the steak sandwich both fantastic sandwiches.  The bacon jelly they make is just sweet enough without being over empowering.   Very clean place.  The only reason it's a 4 star is the waitress I think was having a rough night and didn't have a great attitude.   Ignored us a couple times when we talked to her, but still got us everything we asked for eventually.
Employees very nice and knowledgeable. They have a huge selection of Pop Sockets if you are looking for something special

Was a fabulous experience!  Prompt response to online Yelp Quote, great with covering options (can do just exterior, just interior, etc) & explaining prices- then a Professional Crew showed up on time & ready to work the day of the appt.  I definitely plan to use this service again.  They got out almost everything... 

Update:  lost a star as I've tried to contact thrn repeatedly to book jobs on others car... to no response...

Well we ate at this location a few years back and wasn't pleased - figured we'd give it another try since it had been awhile. The service here is what keeps us away. We pre ordered and although the food was ready to go we ordered drinks when we got there so the shakes wouldn't be runny on the hot day. As soon as we got the food I ordered soft drinks to have with our meals and ordered shakes as well. She went inside and didn't come back out, expected to pay and have the soft drinks given to us to have with our food - but instead I sat waiting at the door to pay while she made the milkshakes. 10 mins later my family is done eating and no longer even needs the soft drinks we ordered and ended up having to wait for me to eat therefore eliminating the purpose of pre ordering the food. Anyone in the food service industry should know drinks come out with the food, specialty items can be delivered afterwards - she didn't even seem to care about the clearly mistaken judgment - no apology and just seemed irritated by my request to no longer serve us the soft drinks we didn't need anymore. It's too bad but save yourself the disappointment and go right up the road to Main Street Burger - consistent food and family style service.

Five stars all the way.  If you want daily maid service, breakfast and a workout room, don't stay here.  But if you want a clean, spacious room, comfortable bed and friendly staff, here you go.  Less than 100.00/night, and thisclose to the Village, great restaurants and shopping.  Couldn't be more impressed.  Keep it up!!

Needed a last minute hemming done for my dress, they got it done early even! Turnaround is about a week, they finished it a day early. Very good value and great work. My dress looked perfect, just as I wanted it. Definitely will be coming here again!

This Sonic location just can't seem to get it together. The kids working there seem to be trying, but things always seem overly chaotic there. I think my order has only been correct ONE time. I have been charged for another customer's order. I have received the wrong order COUNTLESS times and it is always just drinks! Never food!  The management doesn't seem overly concerned. I did speak to them once, but after it obviously didn't matter to them (apparently bringing their error to their attention was an inconvenience) so I didn't make the effort again. We continue to give it a chance since it is close by, but tonight.... 1 out of 5 people in our group got the correct drink order. Just drinks! Not really something you can easily check and how hard is a chocolate shake to get correct? The receipt read correctly so I have no idea what happened.

We celebrated my wife's birthday and she loves Sushi.  She picked this restaurant and made the reservation.  We were greeted and seated promptly and our waitress was very nice and informative.   My wife had a martini suggested by our waitress. We ordered the Calamari appetizer....... it was very very good!  Wife ordered Sushi and I asked for assistance from our waitress.  I'm picky and not very fond of vegetables. She was very patient and willing to assist me in my selection.  I informed her that I like seasoned flavorful beef meat, fried rice and noodles, carrots, onions and peppers.  She knew exactly the dish that would suit my needs and she NAILED IT!   Our dinner was fantastic and when she asked if we would like dessert we said sure.  That dessert was worth the price of admission by itself.  It was a three piece ensemble of pure magic.  Don't skip the dessert!!!!

Went to breakfast here and wait over an hour for our food and that was after the waitress took our order.  We were told she was busy taking orders over the phone, the computer went down, the kitchen went down briefly, and then we were told our order got lost.  When the food did arrive it was cold and the muffin and cinnamon rolls were old and stale.  Eggs were rubbery and the potatoes were undercooked.  This used to be a good place for breakfast but there are many other restaurants with better food and service to spend your time and money.  We will not be back here.
Had a great lunch with good friendly service from Tina. Easier than home cookIng corned beef and cabbage. Better than home Black and Tan.

My cats have been on Primal frozen food since they were little guys. When I moved to Boise the only retail store that had Primal was H3. So even if H3 was lame, I really didn't have much choice. However the staff is so darn helpful, the store is super clean and it's well stocked with all the best pet goodies and their prices are competitive. Props. Now there are other retailers who sell Primal but I'm sticking with H3. They lose a star for location, but don't let that stop you from popping in and picking up something for your fuzzy friends.

Don't waste your money!  $45 a person just for dinner, not including any beverages or desert.  Visited Dec 23rd had reservations place was 1/3 full.  Sat at table for 10 minutes before serve ask for our drink order then 10 minutes later finally got them.  After another 10-15 minutes waiter show back up to tell us how it works, salad bar them the meat servers come around to give your choice of meats to eat.  As the servers would come out of kitchen the would hit the closest table and by the time they would get to ours there wasn't much left or no at all.  Quality of meat was poor, so salty you couldn't eat much of it.  3 of us order desert, well that was a mistake, terrible not house made, think out of a box from the freezer.  I had creme'burelle, bad rendition of vanilla pudding they didn't even fire the top sugar crust.  Two others had key lime pie which was ok.  2 hours later this experience was finally over and $360 I could of spent at a real steakhouse with prime beef cooked to order and better ambience.  I have been to another location in Fort Worth Texas and didn't have this bad of an experience.

I hate to do this. But I got here for my thai milk tea about two times a weeks. Usually customer service is bot bad. They are busy but usually have been friendly when they take my order . I've been here about 15 times and I always tip. 

Last week I went in with my dad who is visiting. He got the mango smoothie and then we got two thai milk teas. They were great as always.

But today we went in and got the dame order.  Two thai milk teas and 1 mango smoothie.  The mango smoothie was only filled 3/4s! I went back and asked them to fill it all the way please. One if the girls said no, it's because you don't have boba. But I said I came here last week and you filled it all the way. Are you serious??? So the guy that was there made it right and gave us a small cup to make up for the kissing smoothie. She actually said no and then turned around oissed off. Are you serious ?? I even left you a tip and you refuse to fill the cup? Well thank you to the guy who made it 3ight  I have a picture of the 1st time we went last week but unfortunately not of the one from today  might not go back do to this event and how poorly that girl treated us

We came here for lunch and did two of their lunch specials. An 8" pizza and soda pop for $10! I ordered the pesto pizza and it was AMAZING!  We also ordered a side of their cheesy breadsticks which were delightful. The restaurant was very clean, staff was friendly, and we got our food in a reasonable amount of time. We will definitely be back!

BAD!!!. Nail station was very unsanitary, full of debris from previous manicures. She used dirty files, tools and this disgusting brush she would pull out of the drawer to brush my hands off that was caked with debris that only left more dust on my hands. She also used such an old buffer it was disinigrating on my nails.She also handled my nails/hands very roughly twisting them around to work on them. She also was impatient about me choosing a glitter color to go on top of my set that I just settled for none ( I asked for pink in the beginning and she tried to put on silver.) The shape is good but my nails have little flecks of dust and bits stuck in them bc of her dirty work station. They will also talk smack about you in vietnamese, which was easy to tell by their tone and use of English words like "glitter."

Yeah I'm reviewing a gas station. But Fast Eddy's is more than a gas station, its a one-stop place for gas, booze and anything else you need quick. The inside is huge and immaculate. The employees are super-friendly and they even have a drive-thru if you are feeling lazy.

GroomingTails is the best grooming place out there! I take our golden lab and our maltese there and they both love it. Jay is as good as it gets for grooming. He does a great job, is quick, very affordable, and our dogs are very comfortable there. What else could you want? This is where I tell all my friends to take their dogs. 
Customer Service- 100%
Quality- 100%
Price- 100%
Ease of getting appointment-100%
My dogs love it-100%

Best groomer ever.

Very bad experience with them so far. I'm very supportive of local business， bit their service and customer service is horrible. Salesman is hired part time who you can never find after you take their business. They also mislead you at the beginning thG you can cancel anytime if you don't like it, but in paper or what they call 'agreement", there is a tiny section that says cancelation fee $130! After the first service, I got spiders all in my house, they told me don't worry, just continue using us, you'll be fine.  When I called up the manager Shanon who told me she is the only one who runs the business, she was nice till I brought up the concerns and issues I have and I wanted to stop the business, she became a 180 degree different person, very unprofessional and basically you have no way out but to pay the money. Worst experience ever! Please stay away from them when they knock on your door!

I was in town from California and they were able to squeeze me in for a sore bicep muscle that had been bothering me for several months.  After a treatment of dry needling, which is not allowed in California, and cupping, my arm felt much better, better than it has in months.  The facility is clean, everyone is very friendly, and they offer many services beyond physical therapy, including sports training, personal training, massage therapy, nutrition.  It's a great place; two thumbs up!

This was the first time that I came here. I got a small Taro milk tea with lychee poppers. Cost a little less than $5. The tea itself is pretty good. It isn't as good as Boise Boba, but this is definitely a close second. The place itself is pretty cute. Has bar style  seating in the middle of the place. - couch, a couple of comfy chairs. It's cute.

I called on the phone ahead of time to get a quote. I gave them all the information and the quote was $66. When we went in to the store they said it would be $116. When I asked why the difference they had no explanation or apology. I will never go back to this location.

After trying unsuccessfully two times to eat here, our party of 8 finally succeeded. It was mediocre at best.

The hostesses can't seem to get their stories straight. One told us they didn't take reservations. Another said only for parties of 7 or more and yet, a third said they'd take reservations for any number. Figure it out, guys.

I had the drunken chicken. While the vegetables and sauce were good, the chicken was of McDonald's and other grimy fast food quality. Not the least bit impressed. My husband's beef and broccoli was lacking also. 

My drink was never refilled.

I doubt I'll be back. For as much of a hassle as it was to go, I expected something a lot more savvy and impressive.

This lovely place is a delight.  If you are a lover of sweets, coffee, or if you are a high school kid. Then this is the place for you. 

Open the door and you are met with a chic decor and a warm smile.  Walking up to the counter, your eyes are fixated on the 2 screens displaying coffee, boba and desserts.  Now I'm a fan of Boba. Wait.. let me correct that! I'm a fan of the Lychee boba. Lychee... Yum! 

Now I'm not sure if it's good that staff know me by name, or know what I'm about to order when I walk in (I think I may need an intervention). But it does represent staffs attentiveness to their customers.  

The coffee is delicious, and the  desserts are a bliss to your taste buds.  Combine the taste of desserts, drinks and service, the Urban Fox doesn't disappoint.

We asked for no tomato and no lettuce. yeah we got a ton of tomatoes and lettuce.  we are allergic two tomatoes and now my sandwich has tomato juice on the chicken.  we are road tripping to California so there's no time to turn back.  so thanks for the sandwich.

I love this food and would eat here daily if I didn't mind gaining weight. I'm from N.J. and this is the closest I've come to the real deal boardwalk sub.
I also greatly appreciate the mask  required as it respects employees and customers.
pro virus people can always go elsewhere!,
First class experience from the beginning to the end. Everyone was great and everything ran smoothly. Easiest root canal ever! I highly recommend Dr. Eaton and Blue Creek Endodontics.

A new server made the drink delivery and order taking a little disjointed, but soon another server with super powers showed up, efficiently and pleasantly reviewed our orders for accuracy, and showed up quickly with our food and missing drinks, which were all outstanding. We were also comped a dessert. Wow.

We sat outside, and I am glad that we did. We have been trying very conscientiously to stay healthy and from all appearances, the mask requirement is not being enforced. Although there was separation of the inside tables, too close for comfort for my tastes.

I work at a coffee shop, and consider Urban Fox to be some of the best in the valley, whether you're looking for coffee, tea, or boba. They are taking excellent Covid precautions and their staff are exceedingly friendly and good with names every time I go in. Great quality for the price- I have literally never had a bad drink at Urban Fox.
This food is TO DIE FOR. The staff at the eagle location are always so friendly and very accommodating!

There dont seem to be any bathrooms in the coffee shop itself but there are around the area! The person on register on dec 13th at 8:15pm was so sweet! The gal who made my coffee was so fast i hardly even had time to sit down before it was ready! They also give a cute chocolate covered coffee bean with every drink! HOW ADORABLE!

I've been a Sport Clips customer for the last decade, so that's what I'm comparing Lady Jane's to.  They provided a decent haircut (my style is not too complicated) and a nice variety of different service level options (more than Sport Clips). And the waiting area is superior to the folding chairs at Sport Clips.  But the pricing is steep compared to Sport Clips... too steep to justify the nicer waiting area. I'll probably stick with Sport Clips.

I will NEVER shop at Zamzows again!!! Worst experience at the Zamzows on fairview with store manager Ken Cabanero. Went in to purchase a bag of dog food, as I am a loyal customer to Zamzows. I was paying for the dog food with $50 bill the store manager had the audacity to accuse me of having a counterfeit bill!!! I explained to him that it wasn't, and to verify it with a counterfeit marker. Ken Cabanero would not, and offending myself in front of a line of customers. I finally did purchase the bag out of sheer embarrassment, and after I calmed down I returned to the store to return my merchandise!!! The store manager was not at all apologetic, nor willing to handle his mishandling of the situation. Zamzows is a great business but their choice of who's managing their stores needs to be reconsidered. I suggest you invest in $3 dollar counterfeit marker so you don't lose more customers!

New, clean, very comfortable. They have a small store to buy essentials and snacks.  The staff is very friendly. This is a new chain. I will use them again in the future.
In the same square is a delicious restaurant, Lucky Fins.

They quoted me a price over the phone as well as onsite, and then charged me more.  This was not a disaster location, it needed a once-over of everything, plus scrubbing in bath and kitchen.  Yes, It needed cupboards emptied and fridge/freezer emptied, which should take how long to bag up items?  Well apparently for these gals a really long time.  Yes, they did a decent job everywhere and it looks great, but I guarantee I could have done it myself in less hours than they spent.
