And they showed up with no garbage bags!!  Thank goodness the trash had been picked up the day before because they dumped everything straight in it, which I think is very unprofessional.  Then they asked if I wanted trash cleaned off the driveway, I said yes, and she said well I cant because your can is full.  I had to come back myself the next day with bags to get the rest and keep the trash from overflowing because garbage man won't take it without the lid down.  Guess what I found in the trash?  The cloth shower curtain that goes in front of the vinyl one, which she said she would throw away for me, apparently they threw away both.  They forgot to vacuum one room which I had to have them go back over.  

If you think you'll get a good deal going with these guys, you may as well just go with the pros for the same price. Then you won't have to show up and finish it yourself, while getting overcharged.

Love Mongolian but this location is the worst one I've been to. Their ingredients were low and had clearly been sitting out for some time. Their staff was pretty unfriendly and I ended up getting charged twice because the guy on the register didn't know how to work it. Food was fine but probably will not visit this location again.

I was referred by a realtor to TJ and then met Kyle during the initial job overview. I was under a time crunch and requested that they accommodate my request at the earliest possible time. This happened around 10am in the morning and Kyle called me at 4pm and told me that they would start painting at 6pm the very same day. 
Both TJ and Kyle arrived on time and started on the job right away. They started painting again next morning at 6am and finished painting by 9pm. So in little over one day they finished painting my entire outside of the house. 

They did a great job and I am very happy with what they have done for me. I would recommend they to all my friends based on my experience. 

In short, men of their word, hard working and more importantly they are accommodating.
So good! Fresh and delicious. I usually get the orange chicken happy bowl with a side of gyoza, and it's always really good. The service is friendly and welcoming. Highly recommend!

We had to grab something quick and easy at the Village so we picked this place.  It's nicely located by the fountain.  Staff members are very friendly, but we are disappointed with the food.

The price is alright.  Mall price.  I am not going to complain.  We ordered the small Benito teriyaki chicken and Karen BBQ beef.  Perhaps it's the healthy chicken, so it's dry.  Lots of pepper seasoning and sauce (supposed to be teriyaki sauce but tasted like overly sweeten soy sauce). Beef was tough but the sauce is NOT Korean BBQ sauce I expected or we usually would have.  It tasted more like Chinese or Korean bean paste sauce which we use for noodles (or I call it Chinese Spaghetti).  Anyways, not what we expected.

I probably will not try this place again.

I'm pretty picky when it comes to boba, and I'm well known among my friends as boba-obsessed. I'd been pretty bummed by the boba options in the Boise area, so I wasn't expecting much when I tried Urban Fox for the first time. To my delight, I've never been disappointed by their drinks. Not only are their drinks delicious, but their boba is of excellent quality. The boba balls themselves have been the perfect consistency each time, which is hard to say of most places! I most recently picked up a taro milk tea with boba (which is my signature order), and the taro drink was one of the best I've ever had! Many places make their taro overly sweet and taste almost buttery, but the this taro milk tea was subtle and perfect. The adorable decorations and furniture inside are just an added bonus! This will continue to be my go-to boba shop in the Boise area!
The portions are huge, absolutely delicious food. And huge plates, I could not eat all that I ordered. I will definitely be back.

We loved it! The portions were huge; I felt like my pho was the never ending bowl of noodles. The vermicelli pork and egg roll bowl was delicious too - we did have to ask for more of the sauce but after that it was perfect . Our kids enjoyed their fried rice and service was funny and comfortable.
Les is an amazing mechanic with reasonable prices. He communicates every step of the way and there are no surprises when he is done with your car. He is very friendly and honest.

I've lived in Boise my whole life and never eaten here. We ordered to go and picked up ourselves. They were so efficient and had our order ready exactly when they said they would. Super friendly  staff! I have honestly never written a review before but I was so impressed with the quality of food I had to log on and give these guys some props. We ordered 3 rolls and some kids chicken for the children. The sushi rolls were so creative and all of the ingredients complemented each other. I will absolutely be back and recommend this place!!

I called to set up a salon appointment ASAP! I had toned my own hair and left it on to long and turned my hair orange! I panicked!! JULIE B SAVED MY HAIR!! I walked out feeling confident and liked it more than the original balayage a different salon had done!! She was honest with me and did exactly what I was looking for! Seriously could give her a million stars! I will be going back just for her!

My husband and I decided to try the Meridian, ID, Applebee's this past Sunday afternoon. Unfortunately, the male server was everything we had hoped we'd never have to experience. One could tell he just was not a nice person. He took our order for a stir fry that included "top-sirloin" pieces. After a long while, our dishes appeared. Right away, we noticed the cook had forgotten to put the "dumpling sauce" on or in the stir fry. It took at least 5 minutes to spot the server, and we notified him of the error. He didn't say the usual, "I'm so sorry," but took away our dishes to have the sauce put on. After a long while, our dishes came back with the sauce, but they were not hot! We never could spot him to alert him to this error, so we just ate the food. The "top sirloin" pieces were tough and chewy, but there was no chance to complain. When the bill came, husband put cash on the tray, and included a 20% tip. The server took away the tray with the money, and never did come back offering us our change. We never saw him again, and we finally left, feeling that it would be a long time before we will go back to the Meridian Applebee's.

This is one of the my favorite place in town. I came in town with my family for memorial weekend, my friend recommended this pizza place. This is 10 of the 10th, Best pizza, unbelievably and unusual   ingredients and best service. I'll recommend it to everyone. Next time I'm in town, this is my lunch and dinner place.
Thank you guys.

This was my first time going into Ulta today. I went to the one in meridian in stead of going to the mall for my makeup because it's closer. I walked in with my one year old in my arms I went to go get my bare minerals makeup, both powered foundation and mineral veil. They were out of my skin tone on the floor, the chick working in that  area was doing some girls makeup and wouldn't acknowledge me and I stood there awhile. So I had to go find someone to pull one from the back for me. Then I tried finding the mineral veil and asked the chick doing the girls makeup where to find it and she pointed me to a used one they use for testing and went back to working on the teenager girls makeup. There was none in stock on the display. So I had to go find someone again!!! who could get me one. She was a very unhelpful, snobby cake faced worker. So disappointed and felt very mistreated.

Been going here for over 10 years. It used to be my favorite place for breakfast. It's very popular and is often very busy. I don't know if my tastes have changed but it's just not as good as it once was. I've noticed the change over the past few years. 

The food is okay, used to be great. I've noticed it's not very consistent as it was the first few years I frequented.
New phone number: (208) 297-5141 if you are looking to call them.  Love the place. Great service as well.

The food was fresh and hot and I liked the presentation: food was served on nice platters, which was a nice touch for a fast-casual place. We ordered the yaki udon, which had lots of pork in it, but the sauce was a little sweet for my taste. We also had teriyaki chicken, which was fine. Portion was big and cooked properly and came with the standard rice and salad. Definitely fits the bill for a fast, reasonable lunch.
We love the coffee and Boba here.  Cute atmosphere and super friendly staff.  My favorite drink is the red velvet with cream cheese foam...it is amazing!!!

Please know that I never write bad reviews for restaurants. But I was so appalled at my food from this place, that I needed to write an honest review for those who don't know what they are getting themselves into. 
This was 100% the worst Mongolian grill I have ever been to. I tried really hard to have an open mind, but either I have experienced overly incredible food before, or this was seriously just that bad. 
The cooks wouldn't respond to anything I said (I'm guessing there was a language barrier, and so I'll give some grace for that. I don't expect you to speak English in order to live in the US). And when they placed my food on the grill, they let most of the juices and flavors from my bowl escape off of the grill and drain away, and within 30 seconds they refilled the bowl with WATER and added it to my food. They also let my food's juices(waters) to mix with another customers- what if the other customer didn't want my spicy sauce?? (Not that it matters, because you couldn't taste it anyway.) When it came off the grill, the food was completely flavorless and the noodles were a little undercooked (when I had asked the cool to cook the noodles well done. Again- language barrier?) 
I had to go back to the bar and pour in some more sauces to get a little flavor in there. Even then, it was pretty bad. 
My friend got some crab in hers, and it was nasty and rubbery. Not okay. 
And if you look at the pictures with this post, you will see that they don't have the cleanest idea of what a restaurant should look like. 
I am have a stomach ache from the food, and a bad taste in my mouth. I'm so sad and disappointed. Please just do yourself a flavor ( ;) ) and go somewhere else to eat. 
Redeeming qualities: 
-Our waitress was decently sweet. 
-The meat was cooked. 
-The water wasn't horrible for a restaurant.
My family and I see Dr.Marissa Battaglia and she is amazing! She really cares about your needs. I have referred my friends and family and they feel the same way!

I'm sort of surprised Ling and Louie's only has a three star rating on Yelp.  It's not the best restaurant I've ever visited, but it's pretty good, and certainly better than three stars.

We recently visited with a party of eight, and everyone at the table was impressed.  Their sushi is quite good (we especially liked the spicy tuna roll) and every entree we sampled was delicious.  The ambiance is very nice, the service is adequate, and the price is reasonable.  The portions are a little smaller than some places, but still adequate to leave us satisfied.

We especially like their kid's meals and feel they deserve a separate shout out.  They do a Japanese-style bento box  which is very cool.  Kids get to choose from several options for each square of the bento, and I appreciate the variety. The food is fresh, healthy, and delicious--a real rarity on the children's menu.  I appreciate finding a restaurant with things I don't have to feel bad about ordering for my kids.

We'll happily eat here again and I think they're worth a try, in spite of some of the less-than-stellar reviews I found here.

Mike W. did a  great job helping us through the process of selling our  Hollister home.  He advised in listing price and adjustments, having open houses, communicating with the selling agent to help the process go forward to completion.  Thanks, Mike.  Ruth & Darick

I saw the checklist for move-in/move-out cleaning and was impressed by the thoroughness it promised. Unfortunately, my dreams of moving into a clean home were crushed. After paying for 6 hours of cleaning, what I got was not a deep cleaning of an empty house, but more like a quick half-a**ed wipe down of whatever was more or less in reach.  Soap scum was caked on bathtub walls. Nothing above arms reach from the floor was touched. Cobwebs were everywhere. The garage was not swept out.   3 girls coming in to clean turned into 1 that was in a big hurry to leave. And so it goes. If you are OK with a cleaning worse than an hourly motel room is cleaned, then Boise Housekeeping is for you.

April did my mani/pedi today. I live a few hours away but always com to NicelyNails when I am in town. I love the way April paints my nails ombré. Tina is wonderful also but she is usually booked. If you haven't tried this place you should.

I highly recommend family-owned Italian style pizza and pasta joint. The pizza is delicious with tasty, fresh ingredients, staff is friendly, and the restaurant is clean and inviting. They have 12" and personal size pizzas that they cook fresh in their wood burning pizza oven. They also have a couple pasta dishes, salads, desserts, and beer and wine. I recommend the pesto pizza and the tiramisu

Used to work up stairs. This was our hang out. Food is incredible, people are great and drinks and made with a friendly touch. Evil Jungle Princess Beef is the go too, but salads are incredible (and I'm a guy), and sushi is worth driving across town for. I have tried most the menu and they won't let you down... even the meat loaf!

Our home was being invaded by earwigs...hundreds and hundreds pouring into our covered back patio every night, dropping on my family from the ceiling, crawling up our legs and pinching us. I finally broke down and called Envi yesterday, 7/5/17. The gal who answered my call said she would pass my number along to one of their techs and to expect a call, which I received within 20 minutes. I spoke to Dustin who was friendly and he was able to get me scheduled for the same day. I was told Ian would be my tech and he would be here between 4-6. 
6 came and went with no call from anyone saying they would be late. (In my opinion, if you are running late, it's just good business to contact your next client). I was finally able to reach Dustin and he informed me Ian was en route to my home. He showed up at 640. I must admit I was a bit annoyed.
Ian, however, was quite friendly, did not hesitate to listen to my concerns or answer my questions. He was patient, even with the late time and 100+ weather and took his time to really douse my trouble areas.
So far a pretty good experience and plenty of dead earwigs on my patio this morning. My only complaint is not being called or notified they were running late. I did opt for the quarterly service and will update my review as time goes on! Thanks Envi for the same day service, it is much appreciated!!

They were responsive and helpful when scheduling a consultant to come out to give me a quote for tree trimming in mid-August. They then requested a 50% down payment before even scheduling the work. This should have been a warning and I should have backed out. I paid the 50% ($300) and then did not hear from a scheduling consultant until more than a month later. I called close to five the day before to ask if I could expect them at a specific time or time frame, since I do have to work and they could not. They did not arrive at my property until 3p and proceeded to remove a tree that was not on my list of work and did not trim back one of the trees that was on the initial list because the neighbor was not home, but they are still charging me full price. I will be asking for a discount considering all of the work on the initial invoice was not completed. I would not recommend them for tree trimming. No one should have to pay a 50% down payment before the work is even scheduled.

I went in for a simple request to my sons Halloween costume. I understand the quality of the material is cheap (it was 20$ on amazon) but I explained how much he loves it and I just wanted a simple panel sewn onto either side because it was too small around his midsection. The lady who was there was argumentative, combative, and said she doesn't have anything that would work. I told her just plain navy blue would be just fine. She proceeded to tell me that it wouldn't look good. Again, I told her it's more about his comfort less about how it looks. She then said it would be at least 2 weeks until she'd even get something that MIGHT work, into the stock. And she said how they have so many boxes to undo in the meantime (Um, ok?). She then asked if I wanted to leave it over the weekend to see if she could even find something that worked. I told her no thank you. 

You're telling me an alterations shop doesn't have a simple navy/blue/light blue (i wasn't picky) piece of fabric that they could sew into my sons costume on either side?! Craziness. She seemed to be "above" my request and made me seem like a waste of time. So I went elsewhere. I dont know the lady's name but she had long hair and was not the most pleasant to work with at all.
We are very pleased with Andy work .  . He is prompted, polite young man. Very affordable services. We will continue to call him to do work in our new house

After I moved to a new-to-me home in Nampa, I contacted several contractors to do some exterior work on the home.  I didn't hire this company for a number of reasons but they keep calling me soliciting business (from a "private number" so I can't block them).  Be warned - once this company has your phone number, you'll never get rid of them.  Do business with them at your own risk.

I have had manicures and pedicures in Houston, San Diego, Oklahoma, Portland and Washington. I cannot in good conscience recommend this establishment for either quality or services. 

My niece came with me to get her bridal day treatment. Nothing fancy. Just a basic manicure and pedicure for a special day. Her service was done sloppily in the same time my pedicure was completed. The top coat on her manicure was applied past her cuticles and untidy. 

Form of payment requested: is far from what most businesses would consider above board. I sensed a problem from my niece at payment. My niece was instructed in a sort of hustle with, "We prefer cash." Well, most humans in today's suburban society do not carry $100 cash. She didn't have $65 so the business told her they own an ATM and she "could" get cash there. At this point, I sensed an issue and asked, "Can I help?" Upon hearing her dilemma as she was heading toward the ATM in a daze I told her, "No, we're not using an ATM. That's an extra charge. Absolutely not." The business then asked if I could write a check. Incredulous, I said, "No." Who, I wondered carries a check book anymore?!?

I am happy to report this business DOES have a credit card machine because when I balked at this woman's demand, she promptly and surreptitiously offered to run our cards from some where near the floor. Well now, I thought, "That's shady." 

Driving back home I asked my niece, "How did that feel to get hustled for your inexperience and youth?" I was happy to protect her from this establishment's predatory practices.
Excellent service, great ambience and the Guinness Lamb Stew was amazing, I am already looking forward to coming back to get another bowl

Whenever I'm in town visiting my parents, I take clothes that I need altered here. Jeans, slacks and dresses mostly. The lady that runs the place is Korean and her English is limited, but good enough. I mean, it's not like I come here to discuss the nuances of the current political climate or anything. Like others have commented, she can seem a little bit cold, but like I said, I don't come here for fuzzy feelings; just getting my clothes fixed. The bottom line is that she does great, timely work and I've always been pleased with the results. There is a dressing room here so that you put your clothes on, tell her what you need done, then go about the rest of your day.

I generally like this store but I wanted to return a dress that was given to me as a gift. Tag still on it, but no receipt. The manager shrugged and said there was nothing she could do, not even store credit with a very unhelpful smirk. Beware if buy anything or receive anything as a gift from this store/company and aren't on their annoying "perks" program, you will be totally screwed.
Might have had a bad experience but DoorDash and grub hub gets first priority so if you walk in to eat then you're going to wait for awhile... order online or over the before ....

Went there tonight, family of ten, and it was outstanding. They will seat up to 6 adults and kids. Our server Nicole could not have done a better job. She handled us like we were a party of four. She was out in front of everything a party of 10 could want or need. Drinks, plates, extra napkins, etc etc, she absolutely rocked. She helped us order and let us know they can do family style. Perfect evening.

We stayed at here the past weekend while in town for our sons Football Tournament and I am really learning that Best Western is the way to go. You always see someone cleaning and the customer is great. This hotel was very family oriented which I loved. The staff were always available to help with anything, always greeting us, always cleaning and working hard. This was one of the best pools that I have seen at a hotel in awhile. It's a large pool and large jacuzzi!!! So many hotels offer this amenity but they are small. This best western pool was a great size and it was always being cleaned! (Love that) they have a outdoor patio to sit on too. 

Our room was the perfect size!! Definitely a must if you have kids. We had the Queen suite, that has two beds and separate living room area with 2 couches. Also a door that can close and close off the living room. 

We do carry a BLACKLIGHT with us when going to hotels and we found nothing!! I'm telling you Best Western has been great for us this year. Very clean. 
Thank you Best Western!!! 

They might not be super fancy but they are CLEAN!! Customer service is Also always great and the rooms are a nice size!

Very disappointed. Excepted a bid of $1000 for a full day of pruning and thinning. Paid $500 upfront. They guys showed up unannounced at 10am, as I was leaving. When I got home at 1pm they were gone and left a bill for $500 on the door. I called the Co 3 times that day, but didn't get a call back for a couple days. After 3 months it is not resolved. They are willing to change the bid to $625 for a half day. I don't consider 3 hours a half day and feel like they don't care if they did a good job, they just want to collect the money.

My son's school was having it's annual gala and since I just had a baby I was feeling less than beautiful.   I've always believed a fat body always looks better tanned.  Luckily I just heard about Sun Kissed By Kris.  The owner, Krissy, came to my house with a big brown tent and a wealth of knowledge about how a sunless tan works.  At first I felt a little self-conscious about my body  but Krissy had me quickly at ease.  The process was quick and easy and the results were fabulous.  After my shower the next day my tan was beautiful and natural.  It really gave me the confidence I needed to rock my sexy black dress at the gala.  I will definitely use Sun Kissed by Kris when I go to Palm Dessert in May.
Beef teriyaki was mediocre. Meat was tough and not that good. I would not suggest this to anyone looking for a tender meal.

Came here for lunch during my first day here in Boise. I went with a group of ladies after getting our nails done. We arrived at 11:15ish and the doors were still not open. There were 3 parties waiting outside, but a couple minutes later a girl came and opened the door. I asked her why the door wasn't open when it should of been opened at 11, and she said "We're open, we just didn't get to opening the door yet." What? I don't understand, but I brushed that off after sitting down and approached by our super nice waitress!

I had a Thai Mai and New Wave Pad Thai. I asked to make it a little more spicier than sweet, and it came out soooo good! There were shrimp, chicken, beansprouts, carrots over the noodles. It was REALLY good! Everything about it was so good. There was a big chunk of chicken left that I really wanted to eat, but I was so full, I honestly couldn't finish it. 

Ordered the Cloud cake with coconut, strawberries, and macadamia nuts. That was pretty darn good too! Wanted to try the banana spring roll one too..

But the waitress was very nice, she found out someone from our table was getting married the next day and gave us the cake for free and took time to take a couple of nice pictures for us at the front door. Wish this place was in AZ!

Quik Wok has been my favorite Chinese restaurant basically my entire life. I love the sweet and sour pork (sauce on the side), fried rice, soft noodle chow mein and the egg rolls. I miss the old egg rolls which were double the size, and less greasy, but they are still good. Every time I'm in town, I try to visit!
This is VERY good for idaho-pho.  Broth is beefy. Plenty of add-ons.  Friendly people here

Omg Jay did such a great job on our puppy! I didn't want to drop her off at a grooming place and have her spend half a day in a crate so this mobile service is super convenient. She looks and smells amazing and it was all done in about an hour. She loved Jay so much she cried at the door after he left. Highly recommend!

I love this place! The decor is beautiful! The staff is very friendly! I love the boba here too! Their drinks are delicious! They had a anniversary event at Urban Fox and I won a glass tumbler! Thanks so much! I am definitely going to be a regular!

Hubble homes is very difficult to work with. We spent over 350k on our home and are having issues and getting the "warranty team" to help us not an easy task. The paint, gutters and grass was not installed when we moved in and it made it very difficult to get the installers in when it came time to. They just showed up one day and it caused us delays in our work schedule. I would reconsider buying Hubble in the future.

I put off going here because I assumed it would be just as expensive as buying new, as is the case for many resale store. This store surprised me with good prices. LOTS of clothes, especially if you have a girl. I've gotten shirts for a dollar for my little boy, brand new Gap shorts with the tags on them for $4. They also have Maternity clothes for cheap, some books, lots of toys, and other gear like baby baths and swings, etc. There are coupons in the Entertainment book also. I've sold clothes here, didn't get much money, but it gave me money to spend in the store which was great.

Third time ordering lunch here and 2nd time not giving me what I paid for. Those aren't good odds if you ask me.  When paying almost $60 for 3 sandwiches you would think they could at least spend the time to make them correctly. It's not like they were difficult orders. 1 sandwich was plain, meat and cheese only. I'm beyond frustrated. When calling to complain I'm told I can get a regular free sub on my next visit or a refund.  I will take the refund as I don't plan coming back anytime soon. You're a disgrace and ripping people off!

Dr. Nikola scoped my knee yesterday morning. Everything went well. It was a very smooth process, and the staff was helpful, amazing & friendly. Before I went home, I was even given a homemade chocolate chip cookie baked by my surgeon! It was delicious, and then I was rolled out 2 meet my ride. Shelby was great as well, and she has awesome bed side manner. Overall, despite having 2 get surgery that I put off 4 years hoping it would heal on its own, my surgery went as planned, and now I am in recovery! (8

I have had my fair share of bad spray tans in the past and I am glad to say I will never have to go through that again now that I have found Krissy. 

I've used Krissy a few times now for some weddings I had to go to over the summer. I was uncomfortable at the thought of getting an airbrush tan because it seems a little too close for comfort. I immediately felt at ease when I met Krissy. She is very professional, while also being friendly and easy to talk to. 

I would highly recommend her to anyone who wants to have a nice, natural looking tan any time of year. Thanks Krissy!

I've moved twice since I got my PO Box at this store, each time further away and I won't change, not because of the inconvenience of changing address etc., but because of Ted (the owner) and Andrea. 

I know some will find it odd to rate a UPS store but I've used many packing and shipping places over the years and the service here tops any other in Boise. They are fast, efficient, they will stay late if I ask and am running late. They call me when I have packages and they always remember me and make me feel like I'm an old friend every time I come in.

You can be sure that you'll come into this store often and there will be a line and no one complains. It is worth the wait to get the service. Pricing is in line with what you'd expect at any store of this kind. They are continuing to add services regularly so whether you need shipping, materials, mail service, faxes, or a PO Box, you'll find it all here.

If you are wondering if it is worth the drive, no matter where you live in West Boise or Meridian, this is the store to choose!
Despite the one of the sinks at the men's restroom on the Frits. The staff were nice and laid back especially when I almost lost my phone in one of the theaters. I even have time to get concessions

I'm glad I went before reading all the negative Yelp Reviews.  We went at a friends suggestion and it's just good, old fashioned burger joint food.  Perhaps it's because of all the new equipment and reopening, but everything we ate was fresh (including the great fried Zucchini), a basic (but really good) grilled cheese, and my husband loved his BBQ burger and Chili cheese fries.  It's not "gourmet" its just good food.  We will be back, and while it does take a while- that's sort of the norm when something is being made to order.  If I wanted fast food- I'd go to Sonic.
Love this little place. Reasonable pricing and decent teriyaki. It's a bit slow but that's because each dish is prepared to order. They're really nice too. Try the spicy chicken teriyaki!
Ok this was a seriously great sub! Heavy on the meat and light on the bun. We'll definitely return now that there is a location near us.

We came in right at closing (unexpectedly) and the three guys that were on crew, Devlin, Carsten and Shane, were so awesome! Great customer service, fun attitudes, super quick service, and as always, yummy food. We love Rice Works, thanks for always being consistently awesome!

From the time you walk into the facility until the time you leave,  you are treated with warmth and respect.  I came for physical therapy for tendonitis, and am very happy with my choice. The facility is clean, appointments are prompt, and everyone is friendly, you are treated as a valued client and not as a number, a refreshing change. I highly recommend Rock and Armor for your physical therapy needs.

There was three people working, and I was the only customer there. It says honk for service sometimes can't hear bell, so I honked once after ten minutes, it took another customer showing up, honking twice, for someone to pop there head out and another employee to come out. It took 30 minutes for someone to take our order. The employee didn't apologize for the wait and was very rude to my partner. I will not be eating here again. This place has gone so downhill in the last year definitely needs new management.

I do not just take my dog to any groomer. I have been a nervous wreck since I moved, put down one fur baby, and put the other in training. Taking her to the usual groomer would have been more stressful. Maybe mobile grooming is a good idea.
Jay is very cool with my dog. For the most part she did not bark. This by far was the best hair cut for my schnauzer. Typically I get her back with razor burns, but no razor burns here. Jay was affectionate with my dog and gave her a special treat for after.
It was expensive, but he is mobile and it's less stressful for my dog.

What a great place ! inexpensive and so much to choose from. We had never been here before and were so pleasently suprised.My daughter was so excited that they had pineapple soda! Everyone was pleasent and warm .We will be back !!

I have been here twice and both times the food is excellent! We'll get to that a little later. Now if you are wanting to eat here, make sure you come as early as possible or else you can get up to hour and a half wait for dining. It's still worth the wait but just be forewarned. Both times the waitresses and bartenders have all been great. The hostess is friendly and always has a smile. The place is a little bouchée with the gold spoons, Ford, and knives but overall very clean. I love the menu, it nice and simple, easy to find the great dishes they offer. My favorite so far is the The Hogg. I love the bacon here, my wife says it's too sweet but I think it's just right. Be careful for what you order because the portions are huge for the price. Their Mac and cheese great! The brisket will sell out quick if your not here early enough. Food may take a while but I really enjoy the atmosphere that this restaurant brings. We had shots and IPAs even though the selections for beer wasn't very many, the beers were still awesome for what they had on tap. If your around this area you also know there are 3 other breakfast joint nearby, don't sleep on these guys, you gotta come by and try it yourself!

Even though I enjoyed the Brown Rice! Jungle Curry and  Firecracker Chicken, I wasn't wowed enough to want to go back. And even if I wanted to, I'm not sure I could navigate the ridiculous Eagle Rd. turning situation. Oh forget it, let's go to that place with an easy entrance to the parking lot.

This was a great little coffee shop with a creative twist serving Boba and special teas.  There's also shaved ice like you've never tasted before. I got the mango but the strawberry looks delicious as well.
The coffee was really a welcome surprise. It was smooth and delicious. This is a great little stop on the way to a movie at the Village or headed home after a long day.

I absolutely love taking my two silky terriers here! I trust Jay completely, and I know my dogs get the best of care. That's so important to me, because my 3 yr old dog had a stroke when he was just a pup. So I worry about any additional stress or anxiety triggering another. The boys are both high anxiety dogs and they both do really well with Jay. 

My mom now brings her silky terrier, Chandler, here all the way from Hacienda Heights. Grooming Tails is a reliable and safe groomer, I highly recommend them!

I was in the building for a coffee meeting and this place was one of a few establishments within the same building in the Village.  I thought that was a cool concept.  I read the reviews and decided to try the Ninja Chicken as it was recommended in some of the reviews.  The employee also suggested it so I thought I would try it.  It was nice and hot when the order was up and the taste was pretty good.  The rice seemed a little stale but the veggies and chicken were fresh.  I think it would have been much better with fresh rice.  I will go back and try something else next time.  I really appreciated how quick it was along with friendly service.

Great atmosphere for casual breakfast, lunch or a great happy hour. Fresh food, friendly, fun staff. The restaurant is clean and the staff attentive. The coffee is decadent and unlike coffee drinks I have had any where else. The fruit tasted just picked and my Eggs Benedict was delicious (but more than I can eat. I highly recommend it!!!
They have a wide variety of entrees to choose from. Their kid meals are pretty tasty and reasonably priced.

Eagle Smiles is the only dentist office I will go to and recommend to friends and family. 
Dr Thompson is awesome and very skilled at his work. He makes you feel comfortable and at ease while getting dental work done. The staff is friendly and answers any questions you may have. 
Thanks Eagle Smiles!

Rarely wait in lines at this location which is standard at all the others I've been too. 

It's a bit smaller and quicker to get around in compared to the other locations in the valley.
Another win from my fellow Yelpers. I came here while on vacation and came back every day. It's nice to frequent a local establishment that lives up to the reviews.
Quick, friendly, knowledgeable. I would much rather go hete than the er anytime. You see a np but they're great
Everyone here is super chill and friendly. And It has a good atmosphere to relax in.  For me it's the best place around:). If your a bit particular like me ask for Hanna she is super good!

Kris did an excellent job yesterday! My Spray tan looks amazing. She is super sweet and makes conversation easily. I was very comfortable and pleased with her service. This will be my new go-to mobile tanning provider. Thank you so much Kris!
I asked for extra tomato on my sandwich and got the smallest little tomato slice known to existence.

Food is ok as far as flavor goes. Portions are good and the meat quality is also good. Overall it's worth the price but I think the meat should be marinated at least overnight before grilling. The teriyaki sauce seems to be bottled, they definitely didn't make it themselves. I've had better I guess it what I'm getting at, but hey I'm an islander so I rate to critique. In a pinch if eat there again but it wouldn't be my go to for real teriyaki.

i liked the reviews for this place and the photos looked really good so i thought i would give it a try- i am so glad i did!

the restaurant is very clean inside with a big TV and a giant menu. you sit down to order with the waitress, unless you're ordering to-go. the employees were all very friendly and fast- i liked that. 

i ordered the shrimp tempura/chicken teriyaki combo. for $9.95 it comes with 3 large shrimp, a great sized portion of fresh grilled chicken smothered in yummy sauce, 2 scoops of rice, and some sauteed cabbage/carrot/broccoli mix. everything was super fresh and so flavorful. I was really impressed with this place!

took me 38 minutes to drive the 3 miles there, sit down and be waited on, eat, and drive back to work. if you're on a lunch hour, this is the place to go! i told them i would be back and i meant it. 

very happy with happy teriyaki!

Very disappointed to drive 20min to find that the entire staff -  including cooks - decided COVID was no longer a concern and were NOT wearing masks (website says that they would be). This was my favorite brunch spot in the valley. Hope to return when staff decides to align with Ada county safety measures.

I can't say I've had the same experiences as some of the negative reviews here. Lady Jane's has consistently been a great cut with amazing service. 

Some remark on long wait times. Maybe that's fair compared to Supercuts but that's because you're not being rushed out the door. I spend at least an hour in the chair every visit and I love it. Attention to detail, a bit of pampering with a extended scalp massage, neck shave and shoulder rub. Stylists are extremely friendly and personable.

I return every 3 or 4 weeks to see Hanna. Beautiful young woman with a great personality but more importantly a desire to give you the cut and experience you want. You can tell she takes pride in her work and isn't just trying to put butts in the seats. 

A longer wait than some? Maybe (they do take appointments however)

A little pricier than others? Sure but that doesn't mean expensive or unreasonable. 

Worth the trip? Damn straight.
The food is great and the service we received from Danielle was amazing! She was fun and really made our dinner memorable.

My first/home studio is the Orange Theory in Lehi, UT. I can really only compare my experiences between the two locations since being in Boise this summer.  

The workouts are the best. I come daily if I can / if I'm not too sore, but the workouts are the same across the country, no matter what location you're at that day. The trainers are just as lively, energizing and motivational across the board. They like to play more 90s music which I dig. 

Meridian seems much busier. More classes fill up, so I have to sign up for wait lists much more often. Luckily a lot of people drop, but sometimes it's last-last minute. 

Lehi gives you the option of where you want to start the workout when you check-in (treads, rowers, weight floor). Meridian does not. They usually tell you where you're assigned when you check-in. 

Meridian's studio has less room to do floor exercises by the rowers. You have to stagger or move away from other people to avoid running into people. I am always so thankful for the generous airflow that help keep everyone pushing forward. 

The workout is worth it, hands down. The facility is always clean, and the staff are friendly. I have never felt so strong and had this much endurance in my life = life-changer.

Pretty good Italian place. Nice size portions for the price! Will definitely return. The server didn't ask if we wanted more bread, so not sure if you only get one basket? The lasagna I had could have been warmer, but it was still good.
This single location is as good or better than any other coffee shop around - regardless the brands!

Placed an order online only to get to the restaurant and they hadn't even started my order. Another guy there said it happens all the time. He was a Grubhub driver and says they never start your order until you get there. This is ridiculous given the fact that my food was paid for in advance. Food was greasy and not very good. Will never order from here again. I will be going to Red Pavillion from now where the good is always amazing. Quik Wok, you suck!!!

Worst customer service of any gym in the valley, DO NOT GO HERE! There are a lot of options, these guys over promise and under deliver and when you try to cancel you have to jump through so many hoops it's unreal!

I have a love hate relationship with this store.  I really want to love this store as it carries a lot of the brands of cosmetics I love, both high end/drug store, it is a large clean store, and the employees are less self impressed than those at Sephora, and much more willing to help.  My 2 biggest complaints is I would say a good 80 percent of the time I find their stock to be very low.  Especially anything that is new or has a lot of buzz around it.  I would have to guess that this has to be the buyer is not ordering enough product to meet the demand.  But it isn't just high demand products, many items have very low stock as well. I expect this to happen from time to time, especially with a new store, but this a habitual issue. 
  The other issue I have is the last time I went in there were a lot of promotional displays that were blocking pathways and this was made worse by three female employees congregating right in the middle of the walk path to the registers and exit while they laughed and joked, completely obvious to anyone else around them.  Too many promotional displays really start to create congestion and deminish the shopping experience.

I have been there a few times and the last time I went the service was awful. Sat at the bar and was ignored for at least 20 mins until we finally asked someone if we could get drinks. Had to ask another person to take our dinner order. The food and drinks are really good, but the service needs help or they won't make it.

I would give a 5star review just because the food was great but.... service is crazy slow and the waitresses aren't all friendly. I DoorDash as well and I always have to wait for the food. But definitely an awesome birthday breakfast. The pancakes are huge and melt in your mouth!

I have eaten at a lot of places recently in Boise, ID. When I travel there for work. They have been by far the best service my colleagues and I have received. The food was superb, and the waitress was extremely kind and recommended a dish that was amazing.

Came in for a bite to eat before a movie at the majestic and was seated right away.  Once seated it took almost 10 minutes to have our server come over and say hello, by that time we knew what we were going to order.   You could tell by only 2 servers/ hostess that they were under staffed.  
Ordered the finger steaks with tots and boy were there a lot of tots!   Food came out pretty quickly and looked alright.   As I said there were tons of tots fried up perfectly and the finger steaks were varied in size from tiny nugget to a real finger steak size.  Some were way over done and a couple were cooked alright.  Flavor was good ( I also dip in BBQ sauce sometimes too)  but over all the experience was ok, it's obvious that the lack of staffing-everywhere- has affected service and perhaps quality too.
Excellent food, wonderful flavors with flavorful seasonings.  Very attentive servers.  The lamb chops were on point!

Price:  high for the quality.
Food:  Meh, actually quite boring.
Service:  Slow and inattentive.

Now I know this is a burger place BUT can I say their simple tator tots were awesome. Super crunchy outside and soft center. My husband and I got a large order to share but with burgers I think a small would have been a better choice for two people-unless you are teenage boys with bottomless pits for stomachs.

Hickory Burger. Delicious. Sweet Baby Rays BBQ sauce, cheddar, crunchy onion rings, lettuce, tomato, thick cut bacon. I would say the burger itself was perfect BUT I prefer a more pink center. The meat was NOT dry at all, it was juicy. Call me picky if you will...I just LOVE a perfect medium burger. 

My husband very rarely will get the same thing when we go to a repeat restaurant. However, he had the Bleu Bacon Burger...AGAIN. Bleu cheese, Swiss, bacon and mayo. 

Bonus with Big Jud's - PEPSI products!!! 
This was my first visit and I'll go back!!

AWFUL!!! Do not go here. 
Booked an appointment online for today. 
Arrived on time and after waiting for 10 minutes the girl with the appointment book walks over to me and asks my name...Says sorry you're not on here you don't have an appointment. When I showed her the picture of the appointment confirmation on my phone she said sorry we can't help you!

Ain't going to leave unsatisfied or hungry here? Foods awesome and portions are large! Hog heaven? Gotta admit that the service is exceptionally good! Why wait when a one time stop at this breakfast beauty will keep you satisfied a few days!

I hope their service is better than their driving. One of their trucks nearly hit me today and was completely unaware. When I called the company to complain the driver was the one who answered and did not take my complaint seriously.

Absolutely delish! Shared the farmers scramble with my hubby and there was still leftovers! And neither of us are dainty eaters. Loved the little bits of pork belly in the scramble and the sausage reminded me of British style sausage which I adore.  The home fries were cooked and seasoned to perfection. My husband's bloody Mary was quite good as well. We will be back for sure!

Heard great things about one of their technicians, Travis, and requested he spray my property. The gal who answered the phone, Shawna, said he can't come to my place since he only does initial new client treatments. Then I asked for someone who can spray the inside since Ive been paying for both inside and outside and spiders are starting to come inside, she said its not a big deal and the outside is typically all that needs to be sprayed, she then argued why they didnt need to come inside even though I am paying for that service and seeing spiders. Their customer service is extremely poor and one of the managers Joe got frustrated and yelled at another worker in front of me making me think this is a very unprofessionally ran company. I'm stuck in a contract for another 3 months and will then be looking for better options. I heard some of the bigger name companies out here are great to work with and I am looking forward to being done with this company.

Highly recommend Groomingtails!! The convenience alone was worth it! My puppy looked so nice after his grooming appointment!! He has never been professionally groomed before and seemed perfectly fine after the experience. His hair was thick and heavy and now he's clean cut and ready for the summer heat. Thank you for taking such good care of my puppy!
Been there three times. Love the Pad Thai. What other people were eating looked delicious

This place is NOT worth the hype. The noise level is over the top, bar drinks are disgusting and take forever. I have gone twice and both times the waitress's were very forgetful and spent their time chatting at the bar area. We won't be back and we don't recommend.
Oh my gosh! This place is amazing! I can't wait to bring my husband. Great customers service. Amazing yummy incredible food!!!

Do not even bother... have not been here for a while & I am pulling out of the parking lot with out even having what I ordered. The ladies bathroom was filthy, so I asked for my money back before my order arrived. My first sign should have been that there were no cars out front, and it was 12:55pm when I pulled up.
My favorite spot! They always have delicious local beers on tap and they have the best staff in the valley!!!

I was sad to learn Q and Linda were no longer there, but I was able to chase them down so if you'd like their new salon information let me know.

What I do know is that I have only ever gone to this salon since moving here last October and I acquired a nail fungus from this salon. The practices are not sanitary and I was fortunate that both Q and Linda used their personal instruments to ensure they were properly sanitized. 

Over time, my services were always rushed because the nail techs were double booked. The techs also never get breaks to even eat. The nail techs there are not equally qualified and I would never go to anyone besides Q or Linda. 

The owners of this salon are also very money hungry and it shows. I used to love this salon, but I would never recommend it anymore. Nail fungus is nasty and difficult to get rid of...it's unacceptable.
Best sporting goods store in The Valley by far! Great products and nice people working there!

After going to two Dentist with no results, the third dentist suggested I see Dr. Eaton at Blue Creek. After 6 months of on and off pain, a fractured tooth and sinus infection caused by the bad tooth was found. After All this time it took 10 minutes for Dr. Eaton to diagnose the problem and put me on a course of healing. Thank You Dr. Easton!

As far as the food, not so great. The nachos are probably the best thing on the menu, but I had a chicken & noodle dish that was SUPER salty. I will say that the Thai Mai drinks are pretty good.. They are pretty generous with their booze which is hard to find these days! Okay place for appetizers and drinks.

This is shop is a true gem.  Ilene is amazing and really knows her fermented grapes.  She has curated boxes of wine for both of my parents for birthday gifts, and is always spot on, impressing my siblings and my parentals! Stop by or email for advice or a curated selection just for you!

Cute trendy decor inside with TVs. Large portions & good food. Delicious special coffees (you have to try the S'mores!) and smiley service from our waitress. Couldn't find nutrition facts (although I'm not sure if I would want to know...) and there was a 25 min wait for our party of 3.

Hmmm....  Trying to figure out how to rate a Mongolian BBQ place...  One of the things I like about Mongolian Grill dining is that you, as the patron, and the one who selects the ingredients, spices, and such, play a huge part in the overall success/failure of the meal.  That said, I think I'll try to point out the good things about this place, and point out a couple of things that could be better.

The good:  The place is always clean.  The veggies, meats, and other raw materials always seem fresh and clean to me, and I've learned how much of what kind of sauces I like and what proportions of veggies/meat/noodles works best.  This is the closest Mongolian BBQ place, relative to our house, so we often go there when we want a quick take-home meal.  The cooks always do a good job, and front counter staff is super friendly.  The prices seem ok to me, especially since we always get things "to-go", which means I will have two or three lunches worth of left-overs after my dinner.

Could be better:  They give you a tiny amount of rice.  It's almost funny how small of a chinese-food-box they have for rice, but it only holds a couple of tablespoons of rice.  Maybe rice is viewed as optional, or not desired, since they provide the noodles.  Still, I like rice too, and it would be nice to have a bit bigger portion.

So all-in-all, this place is pretty good.  We'll keep coming back, and will be hoping for more rice.



[  I have decided that I am going to look for another job.  I can see myself as a mirror inspector.  ]
Rachel  the Manager was amazing she made me feel very comfortable, I needed a place to stay because my house is being remodeled.  Thank u Rachel for your kindness and hospitality I will be back.
Love love love Urban Fox! They have Earl Grey Boba Milk Tea which other Boba places do not carry and it's out favorite. They are always very friendly and fast!

I absolutely LOVE this location. I have a ball python and a Golden doodle so I always have things to buy. My pupp loves her elk horns, toys, and treats all at a reasonable price. Thanks to their helpful advice, my ball python always has a clean shed. Their staff is so knowledgeable and always willing to answer any questions. Thank you Jim and your crew!

We came into town at 3:30 am and the receptionist was AWESOME.  She seemed to understand that we were wiped out and cut us a break on the room (because we were so late.)  I called around midnight and she reserved the room without having to use a credit card.  She was gracious to our two tired puppies and gave them treats.  The room was excellent, and the breakfast was good too.

GREAT hotel, large rooms, very clean, stocked well, decent size TV and the beat part, when I booked a king size bed I GOT A KING SIZE BED! What?! It was fantastic!! The breakfast was a typical hotel breakfast, cereal, waffles, juice, toast, pastries, bacon and eggs - but! The eggs weren't swimming in liquid! It was a definite plus for sure. 
The front desk was friendly and helpful and the parking was a breeze. 
We will be back!
Great food! I would recommend the Brussels sprouts and the cauliflower. Both were amazing and the service was great
Restaurant is freezing cold. Even in a jacket. Coldest dining experience I can remember ever having.

I ordered the mozzarella sticks and the baked manicotti. The mozzarella sticks were okay, they were not crispy anymore because of the box they put it in but they were still okay. The baked manicotti was meh... the cheese was pretty solid in the middle and the cheese on top made it hard to cut into. Over all it was an okay experience. Would maybe order again but wouldn't get delivery.

not very good at removing calluses. Barely rubbed my feet with a scrubber. I asked her to do it again to remove calluses. She did it but again being very tentative. I finally asked about the cheese grater style, she told me it would cost $5 more to use callus removing solution and cheese grater callus remover. Not impressed! I was willing to pay and again she barely touched my feet and just seemed really untrained as to how to handle the tools of the trade. 

She also let my fingernails soak in acetone while getting my pedicure, after 20 minutes I finally took them out because my skin was beginning to burn and it was uncomfortable trying soak fingernails while balancing the bowel on my lap and getting a pedicure at the same time (switching feet with a bowel in my lap ). 

I only had a polish removed and no new polish put back on. For all of this I was charged $50. Their prices list that a manicure and pedicure are $40 together. Plus the five dollar charge of the extra callus remover should've put me at $45. When I asked about this she said it cost an extra five dollars to soak off the gel polish. Even when I pointed out that I hadn't had any more polished put back on she told me that that was how their pricing worked. So I had to pay more money for her to do less work on my fingernails than a regular manicure. 

They do not have a station for drying toenail polish. So in the dead of winter with regular polish on my toes I had to leave the salon with flimsy salon flip-flops.

I will not be returning.

I was sadly disappointed when I asked for a butterfly lemonade with mango popping boba and they told me they could not put boba in lemonade. I then settled for a mango black tea with strawberry popping boba but they were out of strawberry popping boba. Finally, I asked for a mango black tea with mango popping boba. They gave me a large instead of a small which was nice, but I was pretty disappointed. The tea was yummy but the boba were wrinkly and didn't have that pop to them.

Not the best choice in Meridian.   The 14 day trial membership is contingent upon you being able to meet your "salesman" on THEIR schedule.   It's just not a gym that is inviting.   Salesman was either not available or you go days without a response to your emails.  There is no sense of urgency to accommodate new customers.  There are plenty of other choices in Meridian.  I have been a member of Golds in other areas in the US.   This location seems disjointed and poorly organized.   I just wasn't impressed.

A little background before my glowing review of MYPLACEHOTELS. 

I was traveling from Idaho to CA last week.  I stopped at a rest stop in Oregon knowing I'd need a place for the night and knew I'd make it to Boise area.  I selected a (different) motel in garden city sight unseen reluctantly because they accepted pets.  Drove up to the (different) motel in garden city and almost died, it was horrible as was the area everywhere I looked there were less than desirables who looked like druggies.  I had a non refundable reservation at that motel so decided to just go in and hope for the best.  The best happened they didn't accept cats, only dogs and miniture horses (serious!). They cancelled me wooohoooo!  

I had seen the MyPlace Hotel off the freeway doubled back and went to it.   
Upon pulling into the parking lot I was instantly at ease,the property was clean and no dirtbags in sight. I was greeted at the front desk by a gal who was very professional and friendly.  She booked me in and gladly accepted my cat.  When I went into the room I was taken back, it was beautiful like being in a homey studio apartment. The kitchenette was nice, the refg was full size.  The bathroom sparkling clean (Rosa was the house keeper), there was a recliner and a very comfortable queen bed with plush pillows I normally don't use pillows, I used these! A plush comforter.  Big screen tv with great channels.  
I slept so well that night knowing my car was safe in the well lite parking lot and I was safe in a quality hotel with competent staff. 
I have already recommended this chain to others and will book them again when traveling, I hope to see more in Oregon and some in California very soon. 

You won't be sorry, book here !

Well, service was good although the server nor the kitchen knew what brisket was.  I ordered a burger that was suppose to have a slice of brisket on it.  For those of you who don't know brisket is the cut of meat that is part of the breast next to the ribs of your beast.  It is slow roasted to where the outside has a nice crispy char and the inside is delicately tender and juicy.  I know right?! Why get something so awesome on a burger.  What I got was chopped bbq with the consistency of paste. I will poste a pic.  Once I scraped it off the burger was good.  I did bring this up to the server who sais she didn't know what brisket was but would ask the kitchen who response came back that yes it is brisket that they just chop up like chopped BBQ.  I had to knock this down a few stars for false advertising, but again it appears that they just didn't know and maybe the people out west don't know what real brisket is. ???

Quick and fast service with great food. This place has the best Teriyaki in town. 
My favorite is Spicy Chicken; Korean "Go Chu Jang" based spicy sauce is amazing! 
Bubble tea is also awesome.

On July 25th I came in to have a beer, happy that A friend and I could have a drink someplace. 
There was a girl behind the bar, she seemed very bothered that we and other people were in the bar. She was very interested in what was on her phone. The beer selection was amazing and the atmosphere was beautiful. 
The hop haus is a clean and very friendly place, but the female bartender who was working was a stick in the mud. Going to the bar again but if I see the girl who was working on Saturday July 25th I will turn around and leave.
Awesome tasting pizza. Crust was soft and crispy on the outside and the cheese and sauce was great

Not a good place. I went there to use their tanning bed service since it's the closest to my work.  They put me in Room 1 which worked pretty good. I paid after the session and decided to go with their unlimited package for $39.  When I went in the 2nd time, they put me in Room 2 (even though Room 1 was empty).  They control the timer in that room so the bed turned on while I was still applying my tanning lotion and the bed has old bulbs so I did not get any color. Even though they offer the unlimited tanning, they don't like when you use it so they discourage you from coming in by sticking you in Room 2. VERY unfriendly staff also.

Love this place. Upscale and sophisticated without being fussy at all. Been twice. Excellent service both times. The food was beyond excellent. There was a sauce on the potatoes that was so good. I couldn't place the flavors. It was a hint of horseradish--not hot, not horseradishy. Such a special touch on flavors. And, of course, the bacon was above anything I've had. So perfect.

The employees here are very rude, when you order they stare at you and when you ask for something they give you a very aggressive voice Tone! They don't wear their masks all the way up, no gloves while cooking either. But I do recommend their Sweet and Sour Chicken!

Worst nail salon experience I've ever had!  Check out past reviews on YB (Yellow Book).  These were consistent with my review.  My daughter and I (I was visiting from California), went for a girls day outing in Meridian, Idaho.  We were relaxed and happy and looked forward to manicures and pedicures.  This nail salon kept changing the price from what we were quoted when we first inquired upon arriving.  They asked both of us 8-9 times if we wanted gel nails.  I politely declined every time.  After being asked numerous times, my daughter relented.  My manicurist obviously was mad because I wasn't making her more money so my manicure went south really fast!  She barely touched my cuticles because she only spent a second on each and that's not an exaggeration!  The massage was minimal and no quick dry!  I left after the mani!!!!!

My yakisoba was REALLY good. Fresh, lots of perfectly cooked vegetables. Staff was friendly. Two stars because no one working was wearing a mask. It's irresponsible considering how many cases there are in our county right now. It's such a shame because it's so delicious and I want to try other things on their menu. But I work with special needs kids and if I put myself at risk then I put them at risk, so I won't be back unless they start taking this pandemic seriously.

I do not live in Meridian but was there over the weekend. I was in the mood for pizza so of course I turned to Yelp. There are so many place out there but based on the fact this was wood fired pizza I decided to try it. Man am I glad I did! The crust is absolutely amazing. Slightly crunchy on the outside then chewy on the inside. The sauce was also amazing. I sent a picture to my wife and told her that when we move next month we are definitely coming back. Seriously this place was great. I also loved the fact that his is a family owned business. If you are looking for a giant cheap pizza, this isn't the place but if quality is more important than quantity then you must try them.

Not so much the food..it was as expected. The manager was horribly unprofessional and was verbally abusive to a child returning food and then to the entire family when they objected to the treatment. Absolutely unacceptable. The whole dining room witnessed the shot show displayed  by the "manager". Shame on you Burger King for giving such a person a role of manager at your store.

I absolutely love this place! I spend a lot of time here, maybe too much time... lol. They have helped me in a lot of ways as well. I do a lot thrift shopping but I have to say this is one of the most organized locations I have been to. The team here is very helpful and right now, I love their Halloween selection. They are always so well-stocked as well.

Pre paid for many lawn and tree services last fall. All items are related 'App' (applications) numbers and are not planned for with dates. Also, terms they use when you call and their billing statements are different than the written contract. When I call for questions the rep does not have access to the contract to discuss being 'double billed' on pre paid items. Asked to speak with a supervisor but one was not there and it'd be '2-3 days' for one to call me back. I've never received an update on what specific services have been completed and what services are remaining on the pre-paid contract. I suppose part of the reason is nobody, amazingly, in the office seems to have a copy or manages outstanding contracts. I've received service text 1-2 days before an application but it never says for what specific 'application' and never with a general timeframe. I've asked for both and it's never happened yet. Last service the persons arrived unannounced while we had other landscaping going on and they had to reschedule. I was told it was my fault I was removed from the service text notification. Bookkeeping is extremely poor. Would not recommend long term, prepaid, multi-service contract with Senske in the Meridian Idaho area unless the above issues are resolved.

The company sent two workmen out to remove water damaged siding and replace it with new siding.  When they started pulling off the bad siding, it was apparent that a lot more siding was damaged than originally thought.  They called the owner who had originally given me a quote and he offered to replace the additional siding  for a very small increase in price.  This is where many contractors would really sting you as they have you over a barrel.  The job was quite difficult because most of the damaged siding, including the additional, was located all around  the utilities where they enter the house.  The workers did a good job despite the difficulty of the circumstances and were done in a matter of a few hours.  Cleanup was completed very effectively.
This was a small job for this business so I was flexible on the scheduling.  They called me the day before they wanted to come out and it worked out great for me.

Really poor communication. Tried to make an appointment to establish care with a new doctor and since one of my symptoms overlapped with COVID they aid I needed to be seen outside. I was absolutely fine with being seen outside for a new patient appointment. 40 min before the appointment they called for some intake and said my covid swab-appointment was all set up. What?! That was never talked about. My symptoms have been going on for a while and I told them I've already had a covid negative test, seen at urgent care who did not recommend another COVID test and I have no other covid symptoms. I was very clear I didn't want to waste my time with another covid test. I asked the nurse to kindly call back and confirm I was going to see the doctor vs a covid test. She called and again confirmed it I would see the doc as a new patient outside and again verified I don't have any covid symptoms. So I got to the doc parking lot and waited in the outdoor section to be seen. Then the nurse comes the window and instantly demands I have to take a COVID test or the doctor won't see me. She is quite salty and rebukes my questions which gets me super frustrated. I could not have been more clear and total waste of time. One star bump only for the friendly and kind receptionists.
Awesome new breakfast spot! Your missing out if you haven't tried. Great service and food. Eat and take home for sure.

This was my second visit to Primary Health in the span of 3 days. Nothing dramatic... just for a flu shot for myself. A little late in the season, but accomplished nonetheless. 

I came to this location last year for my flu shot as well, and both times were very easy. They already had my records and my insurance was current. They did not have to collect a co-pay so check-in was a breeze. There was two other people waiting and they were called back quickly. I waited about 7-8 minutes. 

The waiting room is a very typical set-up. Uncomfortable (but nice and wide) chairs, a random cooking show on the TV and an assortment of magazines. My oldest kiddo accompanied me (for hand holding during the shot, of course) and she was pretty jazzed about the double water fountain. So there you go. 

A very nice nurse took me in back and the whole thing lasted about 30 seconds! :) I prefer to get my flu shot from a nurse, rather than at the pharmacy and I've had great experiences at PH!

This is one of my favorite places to eat when I am in a hurry. You can call in an order and it will be ready within 10 minutes! Customer service is great as well and the prices are nice! I always get the spicy teriyaki with white rice and steamed veggies! It's amazing!
I get a shellac manicure here twice a month. They always do a great job and have awesome customer service. One time my shellac peeled and they fixed them in a jif!

I just went back to Harp today, I am sad to say that my Corn beef and Cabbage are cold and tough and the bartender  was drinking behind the bar.  My black and Tan was not poured correctly.  I live everything about this place except it's consistency.  I hope they read this and learn from it,  I will go back but if it is the same I will not.

Best calamari in town, it's our favorite spot for sushi, the kids meals are delicious (my kids actually love them and enjoy attempting to eat with chopsticks), every meal I've tried has been delicious, and the service is wonderful.

It is rare to find honest mechanics - John is one of them. He helped us troubleshoot an issue with our generator not starting over the phone. We were scared to follow his direction because we are new to RVs but he said "if I come out to do this for you, it'll cost you $200" so we buckled up and put our hand in our generator - well a few mins later we had a working generator again. Can't emphasize how rare it is to find someone that isn't trying to rip you off and willing to give you free guidance over the phone. SO THANKFUL!

I was in desperate need of a gel pedicure, so I figured I'd stop by here since there were only two customers in at the time. I'm guessing she's the owner, but she seemed to be extremely irritated that I had walked in even though they were just sitting in the massage chairs watching tv. She told me to walk behind the chairs where they do the nails and told me to pick out a color. Their colors are very limited and all seemed dried out. It didn't feel right to stay so I ended up leaving. I had a feeling I wouldn't be happy with the finished product and didn't want to settle for a color I really didn't want. Decided to take my $40 down the road to Nails Plus where I know I won't be disappointed, I'd definitely rather wait 15 minutes there than pay for a poor quality pedicure.

This is one of my favorite places ! 
I ordered a chicken curry, this afternoon,and didn't realize it was spicy! Not their fault, but it sent me into a coughing fit ! Danny was great, he whipped me up a new meal with teriyaki instead . Now that's service !

Super tune is the BEST! The owner Les is our go-to mechanic because of his honesty and extremely fair pricing. He's quick, and does an excellent job on everything we've needed done. It has been wonderful to find a reliable mechanic we 100% trust. Will never go anywhere else!

This coffee shop is located inside a little building in the Village it shares with an Asian fusion place and a taco spot. 

The atmosphere here is open and inviting. I usually sit in a little corner right behind the area where they make their drinks and they bring it right out to me. I don't expect them to, but they always do so as a result I always tip. 

The coffee is pretty good. I always order the same thing everywhere I go - white mocha with amaretto. Thank dog Idaho likes amaretto; it's hard to find at coffee shops in California. My mocha is always right on the verge of too sweet, but not quite there. I should probably just ask for an extra shot of espresso or one less shot of amaretto. I'll do that next time and update on the taste portion here. 

The employees: super awesome friendly peeps. They always have a smile for me and a little bit of small talk. They always seem busy when you walk in but are quick to come help you when you're ready. 

The pastries, as is the case with most coffee spots, are mediocre and overpriced. Save yourself a few bucks and buy an entire dozen giant muffins from CostCo, then wrap them individually in saran wrap. Boom. Done. 

Overall, definitely a decent place. I come here several times a week to work since there are less distractions here than at home. Yes, I said there are LESS DISTRACTIONS at the outdoor mall than there are in my house. So now you know why I am always reviewing coffee places. 

Come here for the coffee, stay to watch the Bellagio-like fountain out front. Or people watch. There's always some interesting people here.
Cindy is the best she did the perfect finish on my nails, i just love it , good job!!

Great place, hearty portions and the food is great! First time here, the wait was long, but we managed to snatch a spot at the bar, which was a plus. The bloody mary was very tasty and house made - they have giant party sizes too! The bacon is thick cut and delicious, and the french toast biscuit was so unique and bomb! Potatoes were okay, but your bread options are plentiful. The portion sizes were enough to share, which I may do next time. Vibe is fun, everyone is enjoying themselves and having a good time. Unless these negative reviewers are interior designers or Michelin chefs, I'd give this place a try yourself. It's nice to have a local spot that's always crowded - always a good sign!
Highly recommend! Friendly service and my dog who gets anxiety over travels and strangers was great with them ! Setup future booking which is super helpful for  those of us that live busy lives

Not impressed. Went in this evening for a pedicure for myself and my 7 year old daughter. They seemed incredibly annoyed we were there. We arrived at 5:30 and were out by 6, when the door clearly states they close at 7. My pedicure was rushed, she didn't even remove any of the dry/dead skin around my toes. Then she charged me full price for my 7 year olds pedicure.. We will not be back. Ever.

I always request Mario for my bug service. He is very thorough and always so nice and professional. I have used Senske for years and their products work. Even though they are guaranteed, I almost never have had to call them back for a re-service. If my memory serves well, I have never called them back for add'l bug service b/c of Mario's thoroughness. And only once have I had to call them back for my lawn and that was in the beginning when I bought this home where the yard was one of the worst lawns in the universe-- turned around to one of the best b/c of Senske. I've had neighbors state they assumed I would have to completely resod my yard and have asked what I did to help it. I tell them about Senske's bug service at the same time.

What can I really say about this place?  It is like most of the Mongolian bbqs.  The place has the usual items to choose from and the night we went was a good night where most of  of the containers had something in them.  I must admit that I wonder where they get carrots that appear black in the middle.  It's the only place in the world I have seen this phenomenon.   I do like the control these places offer however, this place didn't bring our rice or drinks until we had been eating for 15 minutes.   

I still enjoy this place and will return again.

Was eager to try this and was pretty unimpressed.  Met a friend for drinks and apps and there is really no reason to visit.  Nothing special for beer or drinks.  No specials to speak of.  Couple of items unavailable.  Apps were nothing special either.  Meat and cheese plate was underwhelming, pretzel bites equally as uninteresting. The seats (except two by a fake fireplace) are horribly uncomfortable and cheap feeling. (I don't care that they're cheap, but if they want us to stay you have to have a mildly comfortable seat with some padding).  The place looks clean and new but had little "Irish" feel to me other than the requisite Guinness and Harp trinkets. Very bright which is OK in a deli but didn't lend itself to an Irish Pub feel.  I just see absolutely no reason to go here with so many other options nearby. Just wholly underwhelming, boring, and uncomfortable.
Server was very nice.

i loved urban fox!! they had such cute decor and such a nice environment but best of all, their customer service & boba tea was exquisite. the mango boba was splendid and after i sat down, the girls working brought over little cookies & this amazing strawberry milk which tasted like heaven. i loved it & will be coming back :)

We've had a wonderful experience working with Will Laverde at Hubble Homes. We originally were looking at another builder but didn't feel comfortable with them after they changed the terms. Our agent suggested we talk to Will at Hubble. Will instantly made us feel comfortable and has been so easy to work with! He took us on a few tours and we LOVED what we saw! I really appreciate all that he's done for our family and the time he's spent helping us.  This is our first home and first experience building so we had a lot if questions! He's always been so quick to respond and even sends me updates on the house via text pics. (We're out of state). I LOVE that!!! We close in a few weeks and can't wait to move in. Thank you for making this experience so fantastic! I'd highly recommend you look at Hubble Homes!! The service, floor plans, pricing, finishes, locations, etc are all incredible!
