Margherita Pizza is a new, family-owned spot, nearly hidden in a sea of chain restaurants. Everyone was friendly and helpful, and the food was delicious. Two of us shared a veggie pizza and it was plenty with the salads we each had. Try this place!

Folks, there is a brand new Phó restaurant in Meridian! They just open their door last month. They're located on the Kohl Plaza, behind Walgreens.
We came in at 4:30 for a late lunch. We were the only costumers there. You go to the counter to order your food, pay, and after that they will deliver your food to your table. 
We ordered a bowl of beef Pho, a rice dish that comes with a piece of pork chop and a fried egg, and Iced Vietnamese lattes. I was so excited to come and give this restaurant a try, but I was sadly disappointed. That was the worst Pho that I have ever eaten. The broth is just tasteless, but I can't pin point what ingredients are missing. Probably most of them because the broth lacks flavor. I don't even know how they can screw up the broth that bad. 
The rice dish was a disappointment. When I took my first bite of the rice I found chucks  of dry/old rice. I wasn't too happy with paying $9 for old rice and a dried pork chop. 
My iced Vietnamese coffee was actually made from Starbucks's coffee beans. It doesn't taste like Iced Vietnamese coffee what so ever. Very bland, doesn't have that strong coffee taste like  Vietnamese coffee is supposed to taste! 
I really want to like this place, but I sadly won't be back.
The best Auto repair place in Meridian.  Bob and his son always make us feel welcome and they give us the best experience possible.  They are so kind and so reasonably priced for the service we get.
I love the original boba here, it is my favorite drink of all time. Also it is a nice place to study and relax. It's the best boba I've ever had!

Excellent food! I'm from CA and very happy to have found this place. My husband and I got the surf and turf with the wasabi potatoes along with the shrimp tempura and spicy tuna sushi rolls. It was delicious! We will definitely be frequent visitors. Happy hour is 3-6pm or 6-9pm mon-fri. Danielle was our server-attentive, knows her menu, and awesome! Thanks for a great first impression!

A group of us ate their this morning, friendliest staff you could ask for! Love the food, had the Brisket and eggs, coffee cups never got lower than half full!

Our warmest compliments to Biscuit and Hogs staff!

Se Y'all real soon!

Went for breakfast this morning. The food was amazing, portion size was crazy huge but it was just over priced, especially for breakfast, which will prevent us from returning often. $17 after tip with no drink is a bit much for any kind of regular visit. But for a fun treat, and a cool atmosphere, I enjoyed it.

Side note: none of the staff was masked up. Didn't bother me but first place I've seen that right now. Made me double take.

We had a group we understood the oven isn't really big but it's a fire  oven  we had the bread sticks which is actually cheese pizza with no sauce. But you get a dipping pizza sauce which was delicious. Salads are nice good different lettuces  dressing tasty
Now your pizza is cooked to order and came-out delicious we had several different ones all were good!! We also tried the desserts the apricot pizza was bomb. I advise anyone to try just remember it's a small family owned place
My favorite coffee shop here! Its SO cute inside, and they are really nice. The lattes are delicious and I love the plain croissants...nice and flaky!
Love their Bargain breakfast choices, cheerful servers (thank you Payton!), GREAT Keto hash browns and traditional diner choices. Close, free parking. Try this, you will be back!!

3:00pm on a Friday, we decided to go for a quick meal, which we don't usually do because of covid. But thought it would be quiet. THERE WAS A WEDDING PARTY going on in their part room. And 3/4 of the guests that came in walked past a huge sign that said MASK REQUIRED!! WITHOUT A MASK
No one told them to put one on. Problem is, there were probably 30 people in the room when we left having only eaten 1/2 our meal. Wanted to get out of there. Not going back if that's how lax their mask and group rules are. I know they need the money, which is why we took a chance, BUT if they are going to put our a sign saying mask required, FRIGGING tell the guests to put one on. I have no words for the gathering in the party room. Pathetic. Not going back.

After numerous phone messages from them all day that my prescriptions were ready they gave me attitude about the way my doctor had written the dosage on one and said I didn't need a refill on the other one. Mind you these are prescriptions my doctors had called in that week. WOW I left with no medication at all. Unprofessional and rude.

The desk is teensy and the chair doesn't work for the desk.  THERE IS NO IN-ROOM COFFEE-MAKER! How can I function in the morning without coffee??? The hotel kept texting me asking what they could do to make my stay better. I replied, "you can get me an in room coffee maker!" the reply was that they were not able to help me. So my reply to them was at their hotel sucked. When I went to the front desk and ask the tattooed millennial to get me a coffee maker, she said that she would look into it but later nothing happened and when I asked her about it again she said there was nothing she could do for me despite my asking her to ask one of their competing hotels or partner hotels to cough up an in room coffee maker! Do not stay here. This hotel sucks!
I personally liked the stylist that cut my hair. I previously went to another haircut business that gave me a bad haircut. The Sports Clips stylist gave me a great haircut with no lines!

I would never buy a Hubble Home again.  I had heard they were better than Cory Barton so we went with them.  FIrst,the good:   Value was there as well as an amazing group of floor plans.    They were fairly responsive on any warranty followups.   So I won't add any dry wall or electrical screw ups because they fixed them to my satisfaction. 

Now the bad:

1) landscapers did not rake the rock in the front yard or put topsoil down and it is very lumpy and prone to weeds.  Not much I can do but pull it all out and put new sod in.  The backyard which was done by someone other than contracting for Hubble, was what I would have expected and done right. 
2)  I paid for the 90% efficiency furnace and while it gets warm and cold when I want, it is the cheapest furnace out there.  We have continually dust problems and I had an HVAC guy come out to figure out what was wrong and he said , "your furnace is the cheapest they make and you will have problems within 5 years".
3)  Paint, both interior and exterior appears to be one coat thin.  Any nick or mark results in the paint coming off.
4)  I asked for the deluxe kitchen but they wouldn't let me put my own sink in and the sink is way too small and shallow for most uses.   The kitchen faucet leaks and when a warranty guy came out from a plumbing company, he said the faucets they put in were the cheapest out there and I should think about replacing them.  
5)  Outlets and hose bibs....don't even get me started.  Other than the kitchen, there is a serious lack of outlets.   I don't know what code is in Idaho but Hubble did the minimum.   They only have 2 hose bibs and they are on the side of the house and if you want to wash something, you need to pull the hose over the fence.

This was my first spec house so it was a learning experience.  I would spend the extra on a custom house next time.    

Jeff L.

I ended up with two pre-op appointments -- the first was the standard one-week-before-surgery visit, handled really well by PA Hodaka A.. He was knowledgeable, caring, and took the time to understand my case.  Better than I did, in fact!  He had gone through my various test results, and was comprehensive. He noticed something that I hadn't wasn't aware of. Hodaka said he would clarify this item with surgeon Dr. Daines, and get back to me before surgery.  He also made it clear when I should call in if I had not heard from him.  

A day later, despite full confidence in Hodaka, I just decided I wanted to talk this new issue over with the surgeon myself. I called in to requested a second appointment with Dr. Daines, and even with the short window, I had no trouble scheduling (a big A+), with a kind and understanding phone person (another A+).

By the time of the visit, I was apprehensive, taking a surgeon's time for this.  Dr. Daines' nurse put me at ease, and was well informed of my case.  Next, the FIRST thing Dr. Daines said when he walked in was, "I am GLAD you came in! I want to talk to you...." very positive, enthusiastic, very engaged.  He had talked with Hodaka, and clearly was ready for all my questions. He gave me options, and opinions. Where I could easily have been "talked into"  more complex procedures, he gave me confidence to continue on our original, more conservative path (8 weeks later, I am 200% happy with this decision!).  I also received an additional quick exam of areas to be operated on, and more on what to expect at surgery.  

Dr. Daines' open and patient-focused manner is enormously impressive.  His style of communication takes (extra) effort. In my appointments, he sits down, eye to eye, listens hard, hears the goals, and converses with me like I'm the most important person in the room. We may think we patients are entitled to this, BUT (!), we all know there are far more providers who are NOT this way, and many who are even the opposite. I've experienced other providers who look at a computer monitor more than at me -- and while I understand that, it makes Dr. Daines' approach very positively distinctive (in my appointments, someone else took notes for him, so no deficit there). 
  
The surgery itself seemed to go exactly as hoped.  Treasure Valley Hospital and its team were great (see my review there).  Dr. Daines came by, big smile, and everything (that I can remember  :-D) happened as he had described...including, almost to the minute, procedure duration.

Post-op:  everyone is different....but I was amazed at how "easy" my recovery was. I did follow post-op instructions very closely. I had non-urgent questions a couple days in, and my call was returned within a day. Minimal pain, and (now 8 weeks later) less-than-expected scarring. Again, EVERYONE IS DIFFERENT and your results will vary.  

I had a post-op appointment with PA Eric M. Also excellent -- well informed about my case, very thorough, and as in all my previous appointments, caring.  For my questions that were quite specific to working out,  Eric very appropriately directed me to a physical therapist for more info.  

I am really pleased with all aspects of interaction with various members of West Idaho Orthopedic.  I am especially happy with the results of my surgery, and would not hesitate to go back to Dr. Daines' and his team for future orthopedic issues!!

Driving down the freeway going 70 ... see a senske truck slowly drifting out of his lane. I drive up next to him and he is TEXTING with headphones in. I honked at the guy to get his attention and he didn't even flinch. Not sure how they would feel about that

I recently ended my service with this company, after ~1 year. I liked the cleaner they sent to my house, but the stories I heard regarding interactions with the owner raised some red flags. When my cleaner left, I took advantage of the transition to go in a different direction. I went with this company originally because the price was right; other companies I vetted were charging way more than what I was paying for the same-sized house in the much more expensive SFBA. All of our conversations were via email; Kelly initially responded from a company email, but as soon as there was a misunderstanding, Andy responded to my emails from a personal gmail account. I received a trial cleaning within the week, and the cleaner did a solid job. When I shared the feedback, Andy even called her one of his "favorite employees". Fast forward a year; my cleaner is resigning. I work from home so I'm in the house when the cleaner is here, and her work was regularly interrupted with phone calls from Andy. Toward the end, I was told a story of how Andy showed up at a client's house to confront her. About what, I don't recall, but what stuck with me was that a teenager was home at the time and freaked out enough about Andy's presence to call his parents. The thought of him ever showing up at my door scares me, because I just can't come up with a reason why. My cleaner gave her two weeks but it wasn't until after those two weeks were up that I received a form letter in the mail with a "dear customer" and how "valued" I am, with details about my replacement cleaner. I would've expected a phone call, a check in; it was just so impersonal, a contrast to the nature of a cleaner, who knows the littlest details of every corner of my house. So when I emailed to cancel... that's when I received the phone call, with discount offers to keep my business. Two months after I moved on, I'm still in their database, and received a random "thanks for contacting us" form email. The cleaner turned out to be a gem, but the business itself doesn't have the stability or professionalism I need in a company.

This place used to be so awesome for affordable AMAZING quality NAME BRAND and designer Childrens clothing but something changed six to nine months ago, and now I'm seeing a lot of cheaply made new clothes and less than great quality used clothing. (Target and Walmart brands, some gap and old navy etc) Hoping if enough of us customers speak up they will switch it on back! I used to spend lots of money here to outfit my grandkids-

Indigo and I were in search of a new coffee place, and after a quick yelp search, we found a new favorite!

Urban Fox Coffee & Boba is a delightful drink shop. There is coffee, boba, baked goods, sweet toast, and sparkling fresh lemonade which is a treat. Indigo especially likes the little animal cookies the nice ladies who work there bring her. 

The place is clean and inviting with its plants, fresh flowers, several low tables, a few cozy arm chairs, outdoor seating, and charming decor. There is a high chair and booster seat available for the little ones as well.  

Indigo enjoys their fresh made strawberry milk and I love their green tea milk tea with boba & green tea lattes. Milk alternatives are available! 

The most important element of Urban Fox is the fantastic people. Everyone there is genuinely kind and welcoming. They were so impeccably cheerful and thoughtful that Indigo and I returned again two days later. 

We don't always go to the same place twice in one week, but when we do, we go to Urban Fox Coffee & Boba! 

Urban Fox is a true gem with refreshing drinks and exceptional service! 

Indigo gives Urban Fox 100 stars for cookies, strawberry milk, and fabulously fun people!

By far my favorite HI Express I've stayed in and I've stayed at many locations this past year. New hotel, nice decor, 24 hour pool, spa and fitness center and very nice staff. We were upgraded to a king whirlpool suite and it was awesome! 2 tvs, big jetted whirpool (3 person ish) with a separate sitting area, double sided fireplace, huge shower, 2 sofa beds and a wet bar. Would definitely recommend to others.
Soggy basil and sprouts. Broth was not good, it tasted like dirt. Will not return. Ahh darn cause I really love my pho.

Seriously awesome food. The burger was huge, no, it was ginormous. The cups are bigger than anywhere else too. Service was fast and friendly. No complaints. Oh, and the burger was still juicy even though it was huge.

We really like going here for lunch when we can. The Friday special - chicken fried chicken is really wholesome and a favorite. The prices seem to be good- especially because they offer daily specials, food is pretty standard, servers are always polite!
Very nice establishment. Very fresh ingredients. Portions are perfect and the flavors are on point.
I'm in heaven as I devour the Deep Fried Mac n Cheese.  I have found a new habit!  No sauce needed ... perfection!

Went back to Q Nail Spa after a few years.  I was looking for a nail salon open on a Sunday and they were nearby.  I walked in hoping they could take me as a walk-in for a pedi and they said it would be a 20-30 minute wait.  So, I said I could wait, and I waited....and waited.  50 minutes later they finally got started on me.  That was a little frustrating but the gal who did my pedi quickly redeemed herself when she gave a nice long (although not very agressive) leg massage that even included hot stones.  Overall the pedi was average, she wasn't as thorough as the lady next to me as far as cleaning up my cuticles and all that but it turned out looking nice and they do still have very nice massage chairs.

This place was terrible. Our pho was really bad. It tasted as if there was n entire container of cinnamon in it. When I asked for a refund we waited for almost 20 minutes before anyone came out. I was told the owner would be there in a little bit. I said I had to go back to work and the girl just shrugged her shoulders and said "too bad you need to wait". I will never go back here. It was also dirty.

We went to brunch on a Sunday morning. It was busy but normal brunch crowd busy. We were there for almost 2 hours and it was terrible. The only time our server checked in with us is when we had to flag her down (which was about 4 times). She forgot to bring my drink twice. She only checked in with ONE table at a time; it felt like she couldn't multi-task for more then one table. We waited about an hour for our food (the kitchen was swamped which happens but no one checked in with us or let us know what was going on which happened to other tables near us). We were fine waiting but when the food came out it was warm-ish; it felt like it had been sitting there for a long time and not under heat lamps. The food was good just not hot. I felt bad sending it back because they were so busy but in hind-sight I should have. It just wasn't good cold.

Additionally, we saw one of the bus ladies clean a table that was next to us. She just swept all the food onto the floor in front of the table and never went back to sweep it up so it just was a really dirty floor. It was really gross to see so much food/mess on the floor as we were eating. 

This was the second time I've been here and the first time was really good so I'm hoping it was just a fluke but it makes me not want to go again. It was such a disappointing experience

Got a sweet foam cold brew coffee and was sadly disappointed. It was super watery with no flavor. Tried to even add some sugar to it but did nothing to help it. It was too expensive for what I got. The inside had a cools vibe so bummed the coffee was bad.

Food wasn't that great. Husband ordered the bargain meal. He said his food was bland, lukewarm and the cinnamon roll was microwaved. I ordered the vegan havarti omelet. The omelet was good with nice flavor asked for no cheese, it came with cheese. Also ordered vegan sausage; tasted like rubber. Meal was expensive for the quality we received, should have been on par for the cost at $35.00. Only reason for the 1 Star is for the flavor of my omelet. They had flies which wouldn't leave us alone while trying to eat. Waitress did not ask how everything was. We ate because we were hungry. Unfortunately because of the quality of food we won't be back.

Ate here last night. Covid still has this place les than 1/3 full at peak dinner time. Staff were friendly, and our waitress Maura was very attentive. Like other Brazilian BBQ joints I have been to over the years, you can't eat quickly. You have to wait several minutes for the traveling meat carvers to get to your table. The meat was nicely cooked and seasoned but the portions are so small, 2 bites, and then wait 5 to 10 minutes for your next morsel.  I can't enjoy a meal like this, homeless shelter style!  Just because the carvers make it to the table, doesn't mean you are getting a morsel, they often dashed off without serving everyone at our table. They needed to make their rounds faster!

This place was my favorite in town, Too is her name I think?she always made my nails perfect and pretty but  this time some other lady did my nails and I wanted to try dipped nails for my wedding and it was the worst service, I they were too thick and sloppy just a really bad job...very disappointed I I'll not be going back after speaking to the manager about fixing my nails and was very unpleasant and she hung up on me saying "I don't have time to argue with you" as I explained to her this is my wedding nails: anyway waste of $35 for sure service and horrible nails. I would NOT recommend this place.

Louie's has pretty good food and a fun atmosphere, they really go full-out with the Italian villa theme. We have been twice and enjoyed ourselves both times, once for a birthday and once for a business dinner. We tried the stuffed mushroom appetizer and though it was a little on the spicy side, I really enjoyed the flavors. The mozzarella sticks were just ok, probably frozen. The marinara sauce was the best part of that appetizer. I got the artichoke chicken fettuccine and my husband got the Italian calzone. We both enjoyed our food, and they brought garlic bread to the table with our meal. Good service, good food, didn't blow us away but we enjoyed our evening. On my first visit I got the plain fettuccine Alfredo and wished I had stuck to that, didn't care for the overpowering artichokes.
Restaurant was cold. We moved tables and was still cold.   All the food wad pretty good.  Service was good too.

No matter what time of day I come to this location ALL of the handicap parking is taken.  As disabled, I cannot walk very far without loads of pain, so more often than not I have to keep coming back until I can find a reasonably close by parking spot.  Sometimes it takes days if retuning at different times of the days.  If I'm in need of something quickly, I just go to Albertsons or Target where there is always close by parking for disabled folks like me.
Enjoyed our stay here with our kids. We were pleased to have pull out couch and 2 beds in room. Clean, comfy, quiet and good breakfast.
Don't go here. This place has terrible food.  Sausage was cooked yesterday and then just reheated today. It smelled like old grease when it came out.  Hashbrowns are stiff as a board.
Just your basic overpriced mall Chinese food. Nothing special. The wait time always seems longer than it should be. You'd be better off walking a little further to Kona Grill.

Okay atmosphere.  Food is mediocre.  Wilted, browning leaves of lettuce in salad. Alfredo looked alright when served but when warming up leftovers it's saturated in grease.  Better Alfredo at Marie Calendar's.  Lasagna is served at room temperature.  Been there; done that, won't go back.  Rather stay home, make, cook and serve my own lasagna and chicken alfredo.

Good food..great service. .and a wonderful manager. .she has trained her crew to be very efficient and personable which is hard to find these days. It was a great experience for my wife and I to have breakfast here. Ed...if you read this you have a gem there. ..you should give her a raise and praise and hope she stays with you.

I have wanted to try LL for quite some time. My neighbors love LL and just never seemed like the right time or day. Well one fateful 5:00pm Friday rolled around like the inversion fog during Winter and we found ourselves waiting for a table. Keep in mind that we are a party of 4, two adults, 16 and a 12 year old. One adult is carb counting. There was a party ahead of us, about 6, and they eventually left as parties of 2 were constantly walking in and getting seated. Shortly thereafter, we were seated. My first impression of LL was that this is not a family or casual restaurant. This is a date night or perhaps a singles looking for another singles or maybe that place where co-workers go after a long week at the office. We kinda felt out of place. Mind you that's not LL's fault. The first guy asked if we had been here before and we said no. He was gracious enough to walk us through the menu and then our server came. She too was very professional and made some recommendations. Our son is very picky. He was not sure if he wanted the California rolls as they were to come with a sauce that at this particular moment eludes me. My daughter ordered the duck with noodles. Not sure why, perhaps she was channeling her inner French. My wife who is counting carbs struggled to find anything that didn't have rice or noodles. I ordered the sliders plus an appetizer of sushi.  The Bit O Mexico sushi was phenomenal. The cilantro, avocado and yellowtail were perfecto. My sliders looked great and the beef was seasoned snd seared correctly. My daughters duck had an odd flavor and she regretted ordering it after the second bite. My wife's dish was not what she wanted. Albeit I'm not sure what she could have ordered.  All in all for 87.00 for the four of us, it just wasn't for us. In retrospect, it's not that we dislike LL, it's just not for us as a family.  Ultimately, there's nothing wrong with the service or the food.  In an alternate universe where my wife is not counting carbs and we are in our 20s, LL would be a weekly visit.

This is a great place. Shitty bartender though. we told him the food smelled good. We asked what they were cooking and he just said it was food. No energy, no excitement. It seemed like we put him out and he was not having a good time. He gave me shit when the wings I ordered for the wrong type. Etc etc etc sad as I will not be going there anymore.
I like to visit this store. It is always clean and has a good variety. Everyone has always been nice and helpful.
Made a last minute decision to get a pedicure. Walked in and was seen right away.  The gal did a great job. I am looking forward to returning again.

Like everyone else so far who has reviewed this company, the customer service is terrible. The technicians don't know much at all about what they are applying, they are just dragging hoses and spraying. They know nothing about lawn issues or what to do to fix them. They schedule times but they are more suggestions than actual appointments.

Calling into their office to discuss anything is nearly useless, the people are unfriendly and gruff, hardly who I'd want working for my company. In fact in all the times I dealt with them the only person who was friendly was the woman I spoke to and cancelled my service. When she asked why I was cancelling she wrote a note about why and I said I'm not sure why I'm bothering I doubt anyone is reading any of this anyway and she said "I can't disagree with that." That pretty much sums up the attitude of this company.

If you hire them, don't expect anything special and do expect that you'll fire them sooner or later. Go to Zamzows or any place else and save yourself a bunch of headache and grief.

HIGHLY RECOMMEND for breakfast/brunch. My family and I stopped in, and quickly found 3 seats at the bar where we were joyfully greeted by Jenny. She is SO awesome! Her recommendations and service were absolutely on point. You HAVE to get the Mango Mingo(shareable) for their cocktail experience. I ordered the Breakfast Sando, and it was a perfect combo of everything they offer. Their bacon is to die for! The portions are generous, and our to go boxes were full. Bacon, brunch, Jenny, and their Mango Mingos made our day

Jay did a wonderful job with Hogan, our 13 yo Labradoodle.  This was our first experience with Groomingtails; it was easy & pleasant for dog and owners. Jay even applied nail grips to our guy which will help with his senior rear legs and moving around on hardwood floors!

Thank you, Jay!
Well that was terrible. Skip this place for sure. Tried the egg rolls. The should never have been served to me. Burnt with no flavor whatsoever.

Very good.  Meats were plentiful and came around often except for the filet which we only saw once.  Disappointed in the salad bar.  We have been to the location in Las Vegas and it's at least twice the size with many more options.  I think the Treasure Valley deserves the same as Las Vegas so please step it up.  Speaking of which, there was only one choice for a sushi roll and it looked so bad I wouldn't even try it and I risk  them at a local Chinese buffet.  I hope they are just warming up and will increase the options at the salad bar.

I was excited to get spray tanned for my upcoming Hawaii vacation and called Krissy after hearing rave reviews about her. Called and left a message and never got a call back :/ I am hoping this was just an oversight, but it is hard for me to want to support a business that cannot even return my call.
My salad was wilted and slimy. My husband ordered the shrimp scampi and it was hardly any food at all for $17.50. My pasta was really good. Probably won't go back.

I am so surprised that there are so many good reviews for this place. I DoorDashed so I can't speak of the service and the atmosphere, but the food was not good at all. I got the potstickers, which were just ok, and the Evil Jungle Princess Chicken. First of all the description of the dish says "fresh vegetables" and all there was was a couple of green beans. It was greasy with no flavor besides a slightly burn smoky flavor which was just gross. I ordered it on jasmine rice and the rice was over cooked and soggy. I would not eat here again.

My husband and I love love love this place, from the best traditional Italian food in Idaho, to the great staff. Nothing says hospitality like the owner introducing himself with a bit of food, pride and family history. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, not to mention the amazing smells waffling from the kitchen, every meal has been delicious, and the special touches of tradition are wonderful.
Great environment, great equipment. Communication between staff is poor. Trying to tan is a joke at this location. Not very nice staff either. Hope your experience is better!
This restaurant is always fantastic!  Their family style meals are great for big groups as well as small groups. They have so much to offer from vegan to meat eaters!

Seriously way overpriced for mediocre food and service. I was expecting it to be amazing food but it was just bland. The salad bar was a joke and a mess. We won't ever go back. If you want a great experience with great food of this type I would visit Tuscanos Brazilian grill. Way better food service and prices. 
Our waitress was slow and when one of our kids couldn't decide on a flavor of drink quick enough she just walked away and never even asked the 2 other kids. When we finally got her back at our table she was annoyed we asked for drinks for them. 
The meat servers were hard to understand and it seemed like if everyone at the table wanted to try a meat they were annoyed they had to walk around. For the money we spent which was well over $350 I expected friendly service at least. We really just felt like we were an inconvenience to them.

Had Treasure Valley come out and redo our whole home with James Hardie Siding, brand new Pella Windows and doors, a brand new roof from Owens Corning and they finish it up with a beautiful brand new paint job. The crews were very professional and clean did a  wonderful job.I recommend this company to all my friends and family for any exterior work they need done. The office staff was very knowledgeable and answered any questions or concerns I had.  The communication process for my project was very smooth And timely with very little bumps.  This is a top-notch company that is locally owned and operated right here in the beautiful state of Idaho.
Love love love Big Juds!! Mushroom chicken sandwich is the best!! I always bring visitors here to get a great burger and tots!!!

If you are wanting a loose form of Italian "fast food" you should still reconsider.   Unfortunately 3 out of 4 entrees were incorrect, and only 2 of the 3 salads, with the exceptionof being warm to the point liquid was at the bottom.   This is amazing being we only ordered 2 salads.  I'll start there..  1 dinner salad was correct. The ceasar only had lettuce, nothing else.  Wow.  Not sure where the 3rd one came from.  The Scampi Arrabiatta's rigatoni was beyond overcooked to where it turned into a "pasta glob".  Also ingredients that were asked to be held were there (onions and olives).  2 of the 3 Chicken Parmesan' had no mozzarella or marinara, with breading that was undercooked and was laying on an orange liquid.   The spaghetti sides also were overcooked to where the spaghetti was melting in the soup.  
To top it off, ordered stuffed mushrooms.  They were not present (but the charge was of course).  
We called Louies to discuss returning the meals.  They said we needed to contact Doordash to make it right, as if the delivery service was responsible.  We were offered a $30 gift card for a +$100 meal only 1 family member ate. We have 3 dogs that did not eat the chicken!   
Strike 3.  
If you expect authentic Italian cuisine please do not dine or order from Louies.  Refer to other reviews and make an informed choice.

Who in their right mind books a root canal and follows through without a great deal of anxiety? Not any more. It took me 3 cancellations before I finally committed. I'm 64 and remember dental surgery when it was powered by hamsters on a rusty wheel. I'm a big fat sissy and get nitros oxide to do the paperwork so imagine my relief today getting a root canal. Pain? Zero! Anxiety? Zero! Professionalism and explanation of procedure? 100%. Fear no further friends. This is about as painful as a haircut. Great staff and Doctor. Get going and WORRY NOT!

Kyle and his team did an amazing job painting the exterior of our home. I would highly recommend them to family and friends. In fact, if and when we decide to do the interior he will be the first call.

Kyle came by about 10 days prior to the paint job and gave us some paint color options, recommendations, and support. He was very responsive  throughout the weeks leading up and during the project. These guys pay attention to details. I even saw Kyle using a tiny artist brush to touch up areas. They worked 12 or more hour days for three days straight and we had a finished product that we love.

Thank you to this group of guys that took good care of our home.
Andy is fantastic. Quality work and he is extremely knowledgeable. I highly recommend him for your home repair needs.

Just happened to catch "WINE SHOP" out of the corner of my eye which made me pull right into the first available parking spot. Hubby thought we were looking for our turkey - ha - foiled again! First I thought it was just a wine store and expected the prices to be inflated.  I immediately saw one of my favorite wines and was surprised at the price which was comparable to the big wine displays in the local groceries and I didn't have to scan 15 shelves to find a good wine.  So that was a nice perk.  Then I turned the corner and lo and behold, there was a nice little bar and an obvious bar stool waiting for me and hubby.  Both enjoyed a nice red and shot the breeze with the gentlemen behind the counter who was super nice and knowledgeable, not just of wine but the entire area.  Sorry I forgot his name - but I was drinking wine.  Being a newcomer to the area, this was a very nice way to spend the afternoon - wine and local information!  Will be back as I understand Friday nites can be fun!  But I will definitely be back because of the friendly service and decent prices for wine. Not to mention this place has my sense of humor with all the signs.

Was greeted with a friendly smile and quick check in. Big room and bathroom. Pool and exercise room was open and clean. Breakfast was more than decent. They had biscuits and gravy, a couple waffle makers. I wish they had boiled eggs, but they had more than just continental, which is a plus. I will stay here again.

Beautiful atmosphere, great service, and DELICIOUS food! We ordered the pot stickers, Rainbow Roll, Alaska Roll (subbed for raw salmon), and the seafood hot pot entree - everything was to die for. So glad we found this place!
Best place in town!!!  Great employees! Fantastic food- bar atmosphere is SUPERB!  NO DRAMA!!  Honey walnut & blackened chicken and Pork skillet- FANTASTIC
Krissy came to my house and spray tanned myself and four girls for my wedding. It was super easy and quick. She did an excellent job and everyone was thrilled with the results.

I have had Roto Rooter to my house twice and I have never been disappointed. I have an old house and it has some old plumbing which is creating issues. They are affordable and they take very good care of me and my house.
     About two years ago they came over because of a faucet in the bathroom that would not shut off. They were over right away and replaced it as quickly as possible. The people that they send are incredibly nice and helpful.
     Last weekend, I had noticed an odor in my house. I suspected it was the drain to the kitchen sink. Right Now Heating and Cooling had told me that there was a drip there and someone had placed a plastic lid under it. I was completely unaware, but I have my suspicions of who actually knew and did that. It wasn't me because I do not ever go under the house.
     So, I called Roto Rooter because they did such a good job on my faucet. I was shaking because at that point my room mate had said it was sewage even though I knew that it was not. 
     They sent two nice young gentlemen to my house. They assured me that everything was going to be just fine. They poked around the house and found that the drain to the sink was set up incorrectly and it had fallen apart. They also had me call City of Nampa to check on the new water meter that was possibly failing. Additionally, after years of telling people that the new water heater made the low water pressure worse these guys fixed it! They just opened the valve all the way and my water pressure is back to it's old self. 
     They had to come back the next day because they did not have the tools that they needed. They arrived earlier than expected and had the job complete in an hour. The drains are working one-hundred percent better. 
     They also asked about spraying bleach under the house for the mold. They used the resources we had in the house and placed the box fan in the crawl space. 
     I am glad that they were available to fix my problems and alleviate any concerns that I had. Roto Rooter is affordable, fast, and convey a professionalism that goes above and beyond.

I have had my eye on this place since they opened just a few months ago. They are in the Village, which is a great place for new restaurants. The Village gets a ton of traffic and rightly so. Its a beautiful outdoor mall that is great for shopping, or just hanging out after a hard day at work.

There have been some hits, and some misses though, when it comes to restaurants opening here. I have been a fan of Tucanos ever since they opened some time ago. Tucanos is a very nice Brazilian steak house in Boise.

I dont go there very often because they are expensive. Well, Texas de Brazil takes expensive to a whole new level. I will get more into that shortly, but first, I need to address the positives.

The inside of Texas De Brazil looks more upscale than Tucanos. In fact, our server mentioned this when we said that this was our first time. The servers here are called "gauchos", which is a term given to skilled horsemen in southern brazil, and other parts of the world. 

The decor is more on the fancy side. Texas de Brazil is way smaller than Tucanos, so it is more intimate. If you have been to Tucanos, you will find that things here work pretty similar. Being that they claim to be more upscale though, I would have expected more. 

For example, at Tucanos, you are given a wood block that is green on one end and red on the other. Tucanos is all you can eat, so when you want more, you turn the block with the green side up. When you are done, you turn the block to show red.

Texas de Brazil is also all you can eat, but their idea of fancy is to use a small piece of cardboard that is red on one side and green on the other. 

Since I had been to Tucanos several times, I had expectations in my mind as to what the food would be like. I expected lots of steak, chicken, fish and hopefully brisket. The brisket at Tucanos is my fav as is their grilled pineapple.

The concept here is the same with endless meat coming out on vertical skewers. I am sorry to say though that this is where the comparison ends. All the meats I tried tasted the same. All of them tasted like old grease. 

The texture of all the meats was also very odd. I smoke a lot of meat, so the closest I can think of to compare this too is meat that has been cooked with a ton of fat on it, and fat side up. When meat is cooked like this, the fat melts and drenches the meat for the entire cook. 

You end up with meat that taste like greasy fat, and looks like my hair when I have not washed it in a week. The longer the cook, the greasier the meat will get.

You no longer see the nice grains of the meats. Instead, you are left with a glob that you know is supposed to be meat, but now, you are really not sure what it is. 

Tucanos meats are very very good, and do not taste like this. 

Unfortunately, Texas de Braxil does not have brisket like Tucanos, nor do they have that yummy grilled pineapple, but after tasting their other meats, I was glad they did not.

The last point I want to make here is the price. If you are on a budget, you wont want to come here. The all you can eat buffet is over $40 a head. There are 3 of us in my family. We ordered 2 drinks and had desert. 

Our bill came to a whopping $180.

I read a lot of positive reviews for this place. To that, all I can say is that every is different. Some like it hot, some do not. Some like their meat closer to well done with little to no fat, for others, the fattier and greasier, the better.

If you can afford it here, and feel like this is the type of food that you might like, give it a try. 

For me,  I will be heading back over to Tucanos.

Don't be fooled by the 3.5 star rating. This place is excellent! The food is good, solid Italian food. This was our second visit and both times the service was top notch. The manager is very attentive and pleasant.
The regular and gluten free pastas are awesome, as well as the appetizers. This is our go-to place for Italian food.
Great meats! It's a great date night spot. It is similar to Tucanos Brazilian grill, but a bit better quality. Salad bar is great if you love cheeses.

Excellent job Meridian Fence and Nate Southern!  Nate took the time to discuss my options and offer great suggestions onsite.  

The quality of the vinyl materials is great, unlike the neighbors down the road whose vinyl fence slats fall out all the time.  We opted for the 2 tone vinyl with 2 - 8 ft swing gates. 

The foreman on the job was terrific to work with and the crew was polite and hard-working. 

Prices were very reasonable as well.  They know what they are doing!

I'm in town for 24 hrs and needed my work clothes cleaned same day. They were able to get them cleaned and ready for pick up by 5pm. Super friendly service and a great price. Will use them again when I'm in town again. Thank you and Merry Christmas!

Since we discovered this restaurant, we have been back 3 times with different servers each time. The first two times were fine with the shaky service but the food being worth the awkwardness and having to request everything we need. We thought we had found our secret delicious pho spot.

Tonight we went and unfortunately had such a bad experience we will not be returning, no matter how good the pho was. We walked in as usual and the young blonde server asked for our order. When I placed my order I stated, " Can I get the meatball and steak pho," as I normally order, and apparently under her breath she said, " I don't know, can you.." I did not hear this (my husband did) but did hear her say something and asked her to repeat it but she declined, saying she was trying to be funny. I brushed it off and continued our order. My husband wanted a unsweet iced tea to drink and she asked him no less than 4 times what he wanted and still go it wrong when she repeated our order for us. We paid and took our seats, waiting for our food to come out. After about 10-15 minutes, the pho came out, then the appetizer we ordered, but still no drinks. When she brought the pho out, she set the tray on the table and said, "I don't know which one is for which person." There were three of us. She passed them around and we correctly exchanged the bowls and asked for our drinks. Over the span of 10 minutes we waited for her to bring one water out at a time and then had to remind her for the iced tea again. When I needed more water I went up to get it myself because she never came by to check on us or ask if we needed anything else.

Normally I am not super critical about poor service and worry more about the food, but this experience was extremely frustrating for all of my party. Unfortunately this restaurant has great food but the service and eating area itself is so bad, I am unsure they will be able to be around much longer. I think if the owners or managers could fix the issues everyone seems to be having, they would have a good shot at being somewhere great to eat.
Everything taste so good! But yelp  only shows the Arizona address. The one I went is at meridian, Idaho.

Envy Nails looked great but the only thing envious there are the girls working

If you want to talk smack, go ahead. PRIVATELY. Thats shop talk 101 It doesn't matter what language you speak, bad etiquette is APPARENT no matter what.  


only pro for me was the location 

Cons:

i had to ask them to remove the polish from my skin around the nail
had to remind them for the clear coat
nicked cuticle bc they only use cuticle softer for feet (on the bottom)
no help with shoes
no timer for nails to dry
and no signage explaining they prefer cash




just go elsewhere

We appreciated the awesome, friendly staff, liked the eco-friendly vibe with the squeeze-bottle toiletries, and thought the decor was cool. The bed and bedding were wonderful and we slept really well. The breakfast could be improved a bit with better eggs (one morning the hard-boiled eggs had definitely expired) and creamy oatmeal (it was consistently like cement). Other than that, it was a great stay!

Went there for breakfast, around 8:30 on a Monday, not super busy. The first issue was the 10-20 flies that were on the window and kept landing on our table, gross. When the food came out, there was a black hair on my son's eggs, all of the biscuits had cold gravy, and my daughter's eggs weren't cooked as she had ordered. (They had to wait while their plates were remade.) The potatoes weren't great either. The gluten friendly pancake was good- but not worth $8.25 for a side. Definitely don't see what people see in this place. Will not be going back.

This man is truly a handy man service. Can do most anything and if he hasn't done it he figures it out. Handy Andy built a fence gate for us with the appropriate hardware and from the back side you can hardly tell a gate is there. (The measurements were correct). He also built an 11x7 wood shed we had delivered by Lowe's. No issues. Done perfectly. You need something done, don't have the time, call him. Reasonable hourly rate. Oh, one last thing. He managed these jobs dealing with my wife. Seriously, woman out there can trust him. He'll do a good job and won't take advantage of any inexperience you may having in dealing with home service providers. I communicated with him not once, during these two projects. 
I'd hire him again.

This place is just incredible. The workouts are effective. They are creative! You never get bored. The trainers push the students. And the members are one big family. It's truly a community, unlike any other I've seen!!

Great food , great beer, great service. We went for lunch. Our server was handling the whole restaurant at the time and she was prompt with everyone. They had a small lunch menu of about 7 classic Irish dishes. Entree size is on the small side but very filling. We ordered 3 entrees for 2 people and could not finish the third. They had a really dark beer on nitro (how do I say that...nitro brew beer?) Anyway if you like dark beers, it was amazing. Their sides are on the bottom of the menu. I highly recommend the soda bread. The restaurant had a bar feel but there were families with kids in there as well.
My piece of meat in a bowl was pathetic.... take lessons from Carla Jr! Their low carb burgers are the BEST!! Oh... my wilted brown lettuce in my side salad just went in the trash.

This is the best location. Seat yourself. Cozy ambiance. Great customer service. Yes, you will wait a bit on the weekends for your seat and your food, but the quality is INCREDIBLE! The scones are insanely delicious.  Only complaint is our waitress seemed overwhelmed and kept forgetting things we had asked for. Other than that an excellent experience and our new favorite Sunrise location.

This was my first time at Ling and Louie's. My boyfriend and I ordered off the Louie's favorites section as this is usually where the restaurant shares their specialties. We ordered the Shanghai Shrimp & Scallops and the Blackened Chicken and Pork. It promises to come to your table sizzling on the plate like fajitas. It came out like any other dish, which is not the main problem. However, upon the first bite, there was much that was left to be desired. The meat dish had baby slices of shredded meat. It was very hard to tell there was meat at all. The scallops were decent, so that merits the one star. But the sauce on both was putrid. It seriously tasted like they microwaved a few lean cuisines. We asked for extra veggies instead of rice and while we were charged for it, I doubt any were added. After a $50 food bill, we left still hungry and unsatisfied.

A lovely new hotel, with a comfortable bed, but the road noise and a/c spoiled the nights stay. Staff good, pool refreshing and we had hoped for so much more. The principle thing about any stay is sleep and that sadly was not good.

Went in for lunch today for the first time. Best country fried steak! Also the bacon is so delicious! Anyone that can make this pregnant momma to be happy gets a 5 star review! Also our waitress Terilynn was amazing!

Cooks were VERY rude. We were just trying to put our sauces in and we did maybe one scoop of a sauce and they were automatically pestering us to be done. The cook would ask "are you done" we would say no. And then we'd put another scoop of sauce in and he would ask again. Like learn better customer service please. Anyways. We just stopped and got our meal and now it literally doesn't taste like much. Will be going somewhere else for good Mongolian.

Huge, delicious burgers!! Two of us shared the Mushroom Bacon Burger (Added BBQ sauce) and a Hickory Chick Burger. It was National Tot Day so we also got a free small tot. The burger and chicken were both cooked perfectly! The toppings were delicious and everything worked well together for each burger (nothing made us say "ew, they should've left that out! Haha). The tots tasted store bought but were still good. The fries tasted hand cut and were amazing. Their fry sauce is also amazing! We will DEFINITELY be back when the burger craving hits again.
Yum yum yum. Wonderful service and even better food / drink. Do yourself a favor and go get a Bloody Mary and Benedict.

I've been taking my Cockapoo (Nickel) to Groomings Pet Spa for over 3 years now. They ALWAYS have done such an amazing job with her. Everyone is super friendly and they take their time making sure she's looking fabulous when i pick her up. I love the little touches they add like theme Holiday scarfs. Nickel loves going to see Jay and his team for her scheduled sp treatment :)
Service has been great through the past year. Big fan of the italian done mike's way. Great having a sandwich option that offers gluten free bread.

Another fabulous dinner date at Ling & Louie's tonight! We started the night with some delicious cocktails! My mule seemed extra crisp tonight. My husband and I shared the Double Dragon (tempura shrimp, cucumber, avocado, topped with shrimp, deep sea crab and spicy aioli, ($15). It was absolutely fantastic! Following that we shared a plate of the Singaporean Street Noodles, which I believe is a rather newer item! The name caught my eye - my mother was a native Singaporean, so I grew up eating authentic cuisine. You also NEVER find Singaporean dishes in Boise so this was a pleasent surprise! I thought Ling & Louie's did an awesome job recreating this popular dish. They incorporated many veggies and meats common in true Asian cuisine. The shrimp, albeit small in portion, was excellently grilled and spiced. Way to go, guys! Thanks for giving Boise a chance to try Singaporean food!

Had to post an update. I have been coming here and loved the humongous sausage stuffed mushrooms. I have posted pictures from 5 months ago a d then to ight so you will see how large the sausage stuffed mushrooms used to be versus the ones I received tonight itty bitty. The service used to be wonderful however I sat here for 40 minutes waiting for a simple drink and then asked where my mushroom appetizer was to post an update I have been coming here and loved the humongous stuffed mushrooms. I have posted pictures 5 months ago you will see how large these sausage stuffed mushrooms used to be versus the one I received tonight itty bitty. The service used to be wonderful however I sat here for 40 minutes waiting for a simple drink and then asked where my mushroom appetizer was and she said they come really fast and I told her after 40 minutes that's not considered fast for an appetizer. Weighted another 20 minutes after ordering my to go dinner and asked for a side of marinara for my itty-bitty mushrooms still waiting for the marinara sauce. The service has a really gone downhill. I will chalk this up to just a bad night. waited another 20 minutes after ordering my to go dinner and asked for a side of marinara or my itty bitty mushrooms still waiting for the marinara sauce. The service has really gone downhill. I will talk this up to just a bad night and will give them another try because I have been coming here for so long and this is the first time I've had such a poor experience. I will update if and when I return.

I'm from Houston so I'm definitely spoiled when it comes to boba. I know Boise only has like 2 or 3 places that sell boba when Houston probably has like 30-40 places, but Urban Fox is the best place for boba in Boise. Their drinks are good and so is the boba (which is definitely the most important). Their boba is soft, chewy, and sweetened just right.
Service was great! Food was pretty good! The cashier recommended great meals! I would go back :)

Great staff, good food (minus some salt) but my complaint is CLEANLINESS. The bathroom was gross, floor in the main dining area is dirty, and the tables were not clean. There's also these filthy metal containers on the tables holding utensils that.  I almost asked for clean silverware because I didn't want to use what was on the table but didn't want to be rude. I had the vegan pho bowl and it was very good but too salty. The staff was very friendly and the service was great.

We didn't mind waiting 40mins but then it turned into an hour. We've never been here before and we loved the environment and the staff was nice. Drinks were good & the food portions were great but we were not a fan of the food. My bacon was burnt & bitter & although my husbands pancake were huge they were so dry. You couldn't even pick up a piece to eat without it crumbling.

I previously rated this restaurant a 2 star because of the service.    The owner and management team reached out to me to discuss the issues.   They showed a lot of integrity in making the situation right, they went above and beyond.    The service now matches the quality of their food.....5 Star
A piece of Koreatown LA in Meridian, ID.  Great boba drinks, friendly staff, and a great place to sit and get some work done.  I'm so grateful for this spot!

I went in to purchase perfume for my mom as she likes a certain perume I can only find at Ulta, macy's or now Amazon.  I want to support local business so I purchased here but when I purchased they wanted my phone number which I'm not giving out as I don't want to be on a marketing list and get texts all the time.  The sales lady didn't like this and proceeded to tell me I will not be covered if the bottle is broken.  I told her will keep the receipt and will take the risk. They seemed very agitated as I wasn't giving them my phone number.   All in all a bad experience.  Next time I will just purchase on Amazon and get twice the size for the same price.

Stopped here on a road trip from Salt Lake City to Portland. Was pleasantly surprised to find such a clean and comfortable gas station along the way. They had everything: wine, cheese, gallons of milk, Krispy Cream donuts, sandwiches, cheeseburgers, etc. None of it was the standard crappy gas station food either.

Went to dinner there during Happy hour on a Sunday afternoon.  We had 2 appetizers and shared a platter of their General's chicken.  Food and service were great.  Went to pay with a gift card and it came back as almost half of card had been used.  It was the first time using and we told them that.  Something was very screwy but they believed us and let us keep remaining balance on card and gave us a another card to cover the missing portion.  No wonder we love going there.  Always great food and service.  Love their Asian nachos.

I recently took my truck through the auto wash bay, the auto wash malfunctioned and began banging against my truck repeatedly, at first I was only worried that it would Crack a tail light, I quickly realized that it was much worse when I saw the cracked weld at the rear of the bed. As I pulled it the manager "Chris" was there and he came over to see what the problem was I showed him and he gave me the owners info so I could get it taken care of, I called Steve Eddie to try to fix it, this guy is a class A jerk! He told me I was a liar that there is no way his machine could do that cause it was recently serviced and that I could take it up with his lawyers
Here I was trying to politely solve the issue and this d bag had the audacity to call me a last and refuses to handle issue of outdoorsy damage that his machine caused. I was terribly disappointed cause I have been a loyal customer fir the years and traveled right pay a maverick country store to go there, never again will I have any business with this low life operation

I had a great lunch at Ed's 50 Cafe. I had a regular hamburger fries and a large chocolate shake. The prices are very reasonable. Food was delicious and the server was friendly and attentive. The photos of old Hollywood and classic cars on the walls are so fun to look at. I do recommend Ed's and I will be back.

New Irish Pub, just opened 2 months ago. Family owned and operated. Friendly staff and very good food. We had the Shepherds Pie which was delicious and filling. Their soda bread was flavorful and cooked perfectly. Stop in for a meal, you won't be disappointed.

Oh my goodness!! Wow did we ever need this place to eat!!! We came for a late lunch but had dinner 
I don't know anywhere else that makes authentic Irish grub and the Whisky!!!

This place is a pretty nice little pub. The staff are fun and friendly and the drinks were great.  I also ordered some food. I got the sausage rolls. They were...well...they could have been a bit better.  Unfortunately the roll was doughy and the sausages we still cold in the middle. One of them was still frozen in the middle. I was extremely hungry and they were still tasty so I ate them lol. I also ordered the potato soup and that was delicious. 

We will be back for St. Patrick's Day!
One of the best breakfast places in Idaho! The portions are huge so you can share a meal for two. I've been to many breakfast places in my lifetime and this is definitely by far one of the best!!

This place is a step back in time such memories !! They maybe busy but
always make you feel welcome 
Old fashion food made with love 
And so so delicious !

We stopped in at 4:00 PM on a Sunday hoping to have a nice Irish meal. Unfortunately all the main entrees were unavailable because they had been overrun on Saturday night and ran out of ingredients. Okay, they are just getting started and still getting a feel for how much they need to order so I can forgive that. We settled for the Brie bites appetizer and the pretzel bites. The Brie bites were completely undercooked: the phyllo dough should have been crispy but it was doughy and the cheese inside was not melted. The waitress sent them back to be recooked. The pretzel bites were overpriced for the portion size of just 6 bites. In fact, my husband went to Wetzel Pretzels after we left to get a properly- sized portion of pretzels. We will give them another try because I want to try their Shepherd's Pie so, hopefully, they will fix the problem areas.

This is my second visit... first ordering food. The ambiance is a casual contemporay Irish theme without being in your face. The owner (Jamie sp?),and her staff, are attentive without being overwhelming.

I am posting this review,which I rarely do, because I have just had the most amazing Bangers & Mash.

The sausage is locally sourced, and custom curated for The Harp (as I understand it). It arrives fork-tender and is loaded with flavor. Simply stated; it is the best sausage I have ever had.

Not to be out done; The Harp's culinary staff paires this amazing charcuterie creation with simple,yet equally amazing, mashed potatoes and County gravy.

The potatoes were light,fuffy,and moist...while retaining a homestyle chunky texture. The gravy was full of flavor without trying overpower, or compete with, the unspoken star of the show... the sausage.

This dish, as a whole, is simply wonderful. It would not be near as good if one component was removed. Sausage, potatoes, and gravy. It sounds pretty simple, yet The Harp has elivated this blue-collar dish to something truly special.

I will be coming back for this one again!

We had the turkey sandwich with fried pork belly for dinner. The pork belly was awesome. They have a great food menu, and their Bloody Mary/mimosa menu's are fun. The employees were all friendly and had terrific smiles. We will definitely be back. 

We really appreciated the whole experience.

We live in McCall and tried for over a week to get someone local.   We finally had to bite the bullet and pay the extra $350 to get someone from Boise area to come up.    
Root-Rooter used a water pik and got the job done very quickly.   Great service.  The technician's name was Matt.   His # is 162.   We were very pleased.  The promptness made the extra travel fee worth it.    

That being said if anyone is looking to go in to plumping, McCall needs a plumber.  Everything is so booked out.
St Paddy's day celebration here at The Harp starts tomorrow 3/17 and goes for 4 days.  Entertainment, drink specials, food specials, etc.  I love when I find a good Irish Restaurant!
Actually at the Emmett location. The food is GREAT!!  I'm really impressed for it being semi-fast food. Better than Panda Express! And no, they didn't pay me to say it.

I had high hopes for this restaurant.  It has pork belly bacon afterall!  While the bacon was delicious, that's where the goodness stopped.
The service was unbelievably slow.  Everyone we asked for took a very, very long time to arrive.  Butter for my dads toast (which should have been on the toast in the first place), jam, coffee refills, bill... all took so long it was difficult to enjoy our time there.  
Out if the three of us, only one person at our table semi-enjoyed their food.  And worst of all, the plate sized pancake had no flavor.  It was bland... and repelled the syrup rather than absorb it.  We might give this restaurant another try because of the bacon.  We'll see.

Great food and great service in restaurant. Tried calling multiple times and different days to order carry out. No answer and message machine says full (not that I would leave a message). Says you can order online but once online says unavailable. Again dine-in experience is great, poor convenience options.

If I could give Hubble zero stars I would. I live in a Hubble home and am the President of the HOA for our community. The amount of complaints I receive from homeowners about the workmanship, communication, sub contractors, broken promises, follow through and the like are unbelievable. 

In addition to fielding all of these issues from new and existing homeowners our community has several concerns about common areas that we can not resolve with Hubble as they refuse to communicate with us. We have called and emailed continuously and get nowhere. As long as they are selling new homes they don't care about anything else. 

As far as my own home it was not purchased new so I had no say so in the building process. The quality of work and number of small repairs that need to be done are quite bothersome. Anytime I try to upgrade or fix something I learn about a new shortcut that was done during the building process. 

I would never buy or live in another Hubble community.

I was told one price over the phone today and I liked the price she quoted so I booked 2 pedicures and 1 acrylic nails for my kid, and when the service was done got changed a different price by 10 dollars more, not sure what that is all about...

My husband got his haircut and beard trimmed with Katrina and I gotta say.....she is amazing!!!! My husband's hair looked way better than where he's been getting it cut for the last 3 years. Besides his hair looking amazing, Katrina was so fun to hang out with and talk to while she was cutting his hair!! She is definatly who we will come to from now on. I highly recommend her to everyone!! She definatly knows what she's doing

We are diamond select customers and stay at a lot of Best Westerns every year.  They are generally very good and predictable. This property was no exception.

They gave us a complimentary upgrade which is always appreciated.  The room was very nice and the rate was pretty reasonable (for a BW).  Staff was super as expected.  Pretty decent breakfast.  The hotel was located just where we wanted to be.

Best Western property owners don't always follow BW Corporate guidelines but this hotel owner does and, in fact, goes above and beyond to take care of their customers.  As an example, we booked our stay for two nights.  A Sunday and a Monday.  Apparently the room rates are different on weekdays compared to weekends.  We didn't notice this but the clerk who checked us in did... and on his own initiative lowered the higher rate to be compatible.  Not a lot of money but obviously creating a huge value proposition for us.  If all Best Western properties treated their customers like this hotel treated us, Best Western as a brand would benefit greatly. We hope the property owners see this review and reward their amazing staff accordingly.

We will probably be back in this area again and if so, we will be staying at this Best Western again.  If you like Best Westerns you will like this hotel.
It just feels weird, going into someone's home business to have them alter clothing. Slight language barrier, definite cooking smells, just not my cup of tea. I will keep looking.

It is refreshing to deal with a professional, reliable and hassle-free security company.  I've dealt with others in the past and find Perx to be the quickest and most responsive on customer service.  Max, my sales representative, is trustworthy and very friendly.  I was going out of town for a week and wanted to get the alarm system installed and operating before leaving.  I called one business day before my trip and they finished the install the next day in less than an hour!  The system is easy to operate and love the mobile app!

Leif is AMAZING! He genuinely took his time and worked with our family, He captured timeless moments with our children. He is a true Artist dedicated to his passion it reflects in his work.  Thank you Leif for your wonderful support to our Military family Your art is a true gift.

I stopped at this one because my normal Happy teriyaki was closed. This one on ten mile rd obviously doesn't care that we have a viral pandemic that is making people very sick and dieing. The staff were not wearing masks and didn't clean their hands between customers. I wanted to leave as soon as possible as I felt I was in danger of getting I'll.
Horrible experience.  Save your money and go to the griddle up the road.  Hostesses don't know what they're doing expect major delays if you have more than 4 guests.

I have always had a positive experience when coming here, I took my clients out to celebrate them closing on their first home here in Idaho  The customer service was great! The food was amazing. The only thing that makes me give this place a 4 star  is that the meat really didn't start coming out until the end. We got pretty full on the salad bar and potatoes, and after we finished that plate the meat started to really come out. Overall, still a great experience, the ambiance was right; and my clients really enjoyed themselves. They had never been to a Brazilian steakhouse!

Well I am disappointed with my visit here so I will be returning back for sure. I've heard so many good things about this place! I was impressed with their happy hour for sure! The waitress was very nice just super forgetful. I ordered a steak and I ordered it medium and it came well done with a bunch of fat on it so I asked if I could swap it. I waited longer for my food and also my salad I ordered with it was forgotten so towards the end I just asked to take off a bunch of forgotten stuff off my ticket before paying. Originally I was wanting a delicious meal with a desert but I was afraid to order that afterwords. My friend also ordered a side and never received it so the waitress apologized and brought him two yogurts which is not what we wanted. My drinks took a while to arrive as well but at least those were well done! Sadly it was not very busy and there looked like there was plenty of staff. After a while it looked like it was getting busy so we ran out before anything else was missing or forgotten. By looking at the menu and the place it looks amazing! I know my experience should have been better so crossing fingers the next time!

Loved this place...it's clean, airy...and the employees are very friendly.  The mushroom cheeseburger was very tasty...portion size was filling.  Had the tater tots which were very good....crunchy on the outside..soft and moist on the inside.  Hope to go back soon...want to try some other items on the menu.

LOVE this place! My husband and I have never had to wait for a table, the service is friendly and fast and the food is wonderful. Both the pastas and pizza is exactly what we've been searching for at an Italian restaurant, and they have delicious garlic bread that you can tell is made in house. I'm so happy they use finely ground sausage on their pizza, it's way better than big chunks of sausage you usually see. The portions are awesome and their fried ravioli starter is yum! Every time we've been here, our servers have been on point and even box up our leftovers for us before we leave. This place is totally at the top of our list for date nights. Can't wait to try the desserts next!
Food is good with enough variety that if you leave hungry, that's on you.  Not gourmet, but they don't pretend to be. Our server, Maya, was a delight.  Great place for a satisfying lunch.

This shop is darling! The decor, the staff, and their drinks all make this shop the kind of place that is easy to keep coming back to.

The decor/vibe: PLANTS EVERYWHERE (oh, my happy heart), plenty of windows letting in lots of natural sunlight, wooden tables, white walls that give it an open feel, and a few pictures of (you guessed it) foxes on the walls. Subtle tunes in the background. This is a great spot for a coffee date, or to do camp out and tackle some work.

The drinks: I ordered their taro boba tea. To my surprise, their "milk tea" is actually non-dairy. I tried their boba tea on a relatively cold yet sunny spring day. After getting my drink I drove in my car, opened the sunroof, cranked up the heat and pretended it was 20 degrees warmer. This made for a magical boba experience. Back to the tea, taro comes from a starchy root similar to the potato. It has a vanilla/nutty flavor, and for some reason has a purple/lavender hue to it. Being the creature of habit that I am, everywhere I've tried boba I order this flavor. It hasn't failed me yet!

The staff: This family-run shop has some of the kindest employees working here - they'll strike up a conversation with you while slinging you a fabulous drink. Check 'em out!

We went to for calamari. They've been out for 3 weeks. It was a little let down but the food and service was excellent! We were surprised it was HH on a Saturday. We had pot stickers, pineapple chili shrimp, crab wontons, dynamite roll, and the double dragon roll. Tanner recommended the double dragon and it was fabulous! We've been to ling and Louie's many times and we will be back! Thank you for the lovely dining experience Tanner and bartender (sorry didn't catch your name)

Went in on a Friday night because all of the other restaurants in town were packed.  We were seated right away, which was nice considering we were hungry.  Our server was friendly, so this star goes to her.  

I ordered the apple sangria, and they sent out the cherry lime instead.  The drink was strong, so I shrugged it off and said nothing.  Husband and I ordered an appetizer, which never arrived.  Our food came about 40 minutes after ordering, and by this time we were starving.  I mentioned to the server who gave us our food that we had never received our app.  "Okay," she said, "I'll get it right out to you."  Ten minutes later and still no app.

Halfway through our meal a charming manager walks up and asks how we are doing.  We told her again that we never received our appetizer & she said she'd get it right out to us and comp it on our bill.  Well, the app came out after we were almost finished eating our meals, but they still charged us for it.  We said nothing because by this point we just wanted to get the heck out of dodge.

The food was incredibly gross.  I got a chicken sandwich, which was so overcooked that I literally had to rip the bite off in order to take a bite.  My husband ordered a steak that he had to saw through with his knife just to cut.  

Fast forward a week or so:

A few days ago we decided to order to-go because I was sick and didn't feel like cooking.  Our food was inedible.  I got the siracha corkscrew pasta with the firecracker shrimp that was not spicy at all (My two- and three-year-olds ate it without complaint).  There were four pieces of shrimp laid on top of a ridiculous amount of pasta that was covered in what looked and tasted like watered-down mayonnaise.  The "veggies" that were supposed to be in the dish were miniature diced pieces of zucchini and such, but they were so small and such a small portion that it couldn't fill a 4 oz. jar of baby food. 

My husband has ordered the steak which, alas, was a let-down once again.  It was inedible and hard to cut through as well.

I think we are done with Applebee's for good.  Or at least this specific location.
It's so nice to have such a great gym with functional training in the area. The staff and trainers are prompt, friendly, and skilled in their training. Very appreciative. Thank you
Wish the staff wore masks. I love this bar, fun atmosphere and amazing stew! I'd give them 5 star  come more often If the staff wore masks.

The room was clean and usually that's all I need to be happy. We relaxed for a bit, then crashed because we had an early alarm set. 

When my husband and I got in the bed and didn't have room to move at all, we knew we were in trouble. The so-called "Queen" size bed was no bigger than a full. We never would have booked this hotel had we known that. 

Following a virtually sleepless night, we checked out. When asked how the room was, I started explaining. I was rudely interrupted with an abrupt, "All our beds are Queen. All our beds are Queen." 

Had I just received an apology, some sympathy, that would be one thing. I have no tolerance for people who do not even try to take care of customers. 

We certainly will not return here.

This is hands down the best "chain" subs place on the market!!!!! We have lived in 3 states and have been anxiously waiting for Jersey Mike's to make its way to Idaho!!! I love all of their subs hot and cold, they have the best bread, lots of options! My favorite is the #43 Chipotle Cheesesteak. It's the best cheesesteak sandwich you'll find in the valley!! Can't wait to be a regular ! Welcome to Meridian!

I did love Ling & Louies but the past 3 times the  food was just mediocre, service was crappy and just overall not a fantastic experience. It seems over the past couple years it has gone downhill, which is too bad as the food was good in times past- just not recently.

Dang. Where do I start?

I got a root canal at 8 a.m. on a Tuesday after having my wisdom tooth removed a couple weeks prior. I wasn't super excited about this procedure but just wanted to get it over with. 

Dr. Eaton's office looks like a rustic hunting lodge. He wears cowboy boots and Led Zeppelin was playing in the background. 

He is very kind and explains everything. It was super easy and painless.

What can I say? I am looking forward to my next root canal!

First of all you snowflakes out there who gave them a bad review because they don't wear mask can take a hike. Stay home if you are scared. The food was exceptional. Probably one of of the best dinners I have had in a long time. They have board games and fun things to entertain the kids. Chicken waffles exceptional!

Been here several times and generally enjoyed it.  Noticed they were not mask wearers which is concerning so I ordered delivery thru door dash one item was missing because restaurant forgot to give to driver so she had to go back and get it.  We all ate at different times and the food has gone way down hill and was so cold I had to warm it up in the microwave.  The fries were all undercooked and inedible.  Not worth the $50 spent and was very disappointed.

Guys this is the best endodontist in town.  

I just went to his office as a last-ditch effort to save a tooth that other dentists had called "unsavable" because of the type of post that was in it and the way it was cemented in.  But Dr. Eaton did it! I was prepared to get it extracted, but he got that post out and re-did the root canal.  I'm super grateful for his preparation and willingness to give his best.  Plus his customer service is on point. He gets my strongest recommendation.

First off, I got sick from eating here last night, so that sucks.
