I ordered the salmon with 2 sides like the picture on the menu shows, but the waitress didn't tell me that a side salad and grilled veggies were both an up charge. So it was $21 for just my meal!! At Applebee's  The food was not great either.

The burgers are delicious and the fries are amazing. The portions are large however and our waitress was kind and guided our first time ordering with suggestions that were reasonable and not just trying to upscale us. It feels like a fast food burger place on the inside but the quality of the burgers are beyond reproach.

$9.95.  Ordered Patty Melt, but w sour dough bread. Bread nice and crisp, not soggy.  Tots were crisp.  Everything came hot.  Only con was the fake Swiss. 

Service was very, but not overly, friendly and attentive.  

Everything on menu was $8-$10.

On 7/10/21, I treated KM to a celebratory birthday dinner at Texas de Brazil, a Brazilian steakhouse. It was our first visit and exceeded all expectations. Texas de Brazil offers  a prix fixe menu all-you-can-eat meal for $44.99 (drinks and desserts are extra) that features a wide variety of perfectly seasoned and cooked rotisserie meats that are brought to your table by servers dressed as gauchos. 

Upon being seated, we were asked how we like your meat cooked. All of the meat brought to our table was cooked exactly the way we like it. You signal when ready for another serving by flipping a coaster with the green side up, which means "Yes, Please." Red side up means "No, Thank You." I recommend you pace yourself by turning the red side up after you have three different types of meat on your plate. You can request favorites be brought around again. Most, but not all of the meats will be available. For example, the evening we went they had leg of lamb, but not rack of lamb. Even so, there are plenty of options to choose from. Our favorites were: Ribeye and garlic ribeye, Filet mignon and bacon wrapped filet mignon, Top sirloin, Leg of lamb, Bacon wrapped chicken breast, Bacon wrapped jalapeños and the Beef short rib.

Texas de Brazil's specialty is meat, but that's only part of the experience. Upon arrival, your will be brought Brazilian Cheese Bread. This was my first time trying it and I can see how addictive it might become. It's small gluten-free rolls (made with rice flour) with a somewhat springy texture and a mildly sweet cheese flavor. After taking your drink order, you will be encouraged to visit the large salad bar and hot bar. The salad bar has a mix of the kind of items one would expect, as well as a number of specialty items. KM got a mix of the two; I focused on the specialty items. KM raved about the Blue Cheese salad dressing and offered me a sample. It tasted like Roquefort, which is hard to find. It was delicious! My favorite items from the salad bar were: Cornichons, Smoked salmon, Couscous Salad, Prosciutto, Shrimp Salad, Cucumber Salad, Salami, Manchego Cheese, Potato Salad and Pineapple Carpaccio.

While enjoying the salad/hot bar, we were brought family style garlic mashed potatoes, as well as some small deep-fried bananas dipped in cinnamon sugar, which serve as a palate cleanser. KM wasn't overly impressed with the deep-fried bananas; I loved them. 

Manager extraordinaire, Perry, checked on us throughout the evening. Every business needs a Perry, someone who cares as much about the business and customers as the owner themselves. Perry was warm, welcoming and made it clear he wanted to ensure that we had a wonderful evening. He was sincere. 

Originally, it was our intention to order dessert, but after close to three hours of leisurely dining, KM was too full to consider it. I asked for the check. Knowing it was KM's birthday, Perry insisted we order a dessert, even if just to go, on him. Who could turn down an offer like that? We decided to stay and ordered a slice of the Chocolate Mousse Cake ($9) to share. It was the best version of that dessert I've ever had. To my surprise, as we were enjoying the cake, Chef Jesse came out and presented me with the most wonderful Citrus Crème Brûlée ($9), also on the house. Everything about it was perfection. The citrus flavor was subtle yet enhanced the desert. The flavor and creamy texture was as perfect a crème brûlée as I've ever had.

We were in for one final surprise. Taking a look at the check, I was surprised to discover that we had been given the Hero's Discount. Texas de Brazil likes to say "Thank You" to the heroes out there by offering a 20% discount on dinner and lunch prices for military members/veterans, law-enforcement, firefighters, nurses, EMS and teachers. The offer is valid with a badge of ID. I don't fit into any of those categories and was quick to share with our server Brandon that a mistake had been made. He assured us no mistake had been made and said sometimes that discount is given to other guests as a way of saying "Thank You." I made sure to leave a very generous tip. 

In addition to providing a wide variety of delicious food of the highest quality in a beautiful setting, Texas de Brazil offers unparalleled hospitality and service. I truly cannot  remember the last time I received service of that caliber. KM and I have celebrated a lot of birthdays together, but we we both agree that this was one of the most enjoyable. We're already planning our next trip back. Texas de Brazil makes it easy by providing a $20 discount when you sign up for their EClub.

Highly Recommended!!!

This. Location. Sucks. 
3 drinks. Waited at the stall for 15 minutes before calling them asking where the hell my drinks were. "Oh I'm so sorry. I'll have those right out"
Nope. Still waited another 5 minutes to get them. Every. Single. Time. We come here it's a wait. Why is that?!?!

Wonderful business all around! Great service from the owner, installers & even the office staff. They ALL went above & beyond to make sure we got what we needed. They offer quality products at reasonable prices. You won't be disappointed!

I was really excited to try this place out as we're huge fans of Tucanos but needed to wait for the right event as it's $45 a person plus tax, tip and $3 for a soda (with zero refills). I was expecting to be blown away. Instead, I was a bit bummed I spent $50 more than Tucanos which has, in my opinion, just as good, if not better food. Most of the meats were just bland with little flavor. The salad bar was pretty decent (chilled shrimp, lobster bisque and potatoes were awesome). We did get exceptional service all around and had no problem with choosing a 20% tip. But for $125 for two, there's lots of better (and cheaper) options in town. Was fun to try something new as a treat.

I've been to Dr. Battaglia several times and each time the care is consistently terrific.  The Customer Service Reps treat you with respect and once they have your insurance info, they check you in and set you up in a CLEAN waiting room.  The bathrooms are immaculate as well.  I've never had to wait long, although sometimes waits can't be avoided.  I have no doubt that the CSRs would know what to do.  The nursing staff and providers are give respectful, quality, efficient and thoughtful care.  I also use the State Street PHMG and I like that my records seamlessly are at either place.  I also like that the providers and nurse help you keep those records up to date.  Follow up and checking out is easy and medications are usually already at my pharmacy before I get there.  Oh, despite the fact that there are magazines and television for you if you might have to wait, there is Wi-Fi, although I've never had to use it long.  In the past 10-11 years, going to the doctor is no longer a chore since Primary Health Medical Group is in Boise.

Urban Fox, a new coffee/boba place in town. Stopped by Urban Fox without much expectations I but was blown away! Who knew there would be such a great boba and coffee place in Boise?! Tried their sweet toast, milk boba tea, rooibos grape fruit tea and the sparkling ade and they were all equally delicious ! The toast matched especially well with coffee. I know they just opened but I sure hope they do well so that I can continue to enjoy their delicious and creative drinks and dessert. A true hidden gem in Boise!
Blended or over ice, it's super tasty & just right, excellent flavor (not too sweet).
I love the chicken lettuce rolls! YUMMY! So good. And my Friend got a sushi roll and it wAs fresh and flavorful! Very nice waitress with great attention to our waters!

Just tried this place today. I had a regular hamburger & it was really good. My husband had the jalapeño burger & was impressed that they used fresh jalapeños which added to the heat. 
The fries are fantastic!

Ha Yelp says "many businesses are doing their best during COVID and to consider that when writing a review" this business was not doing their best- not a single employee was wearing a mask. I'll spend my money elsewhere.

None of the employees during my stay (two females) were wearing a mask. Last time there was a male employee at the desk and he was wearing a mask the whole time. It made me feel comfortable enough to stay in my return trip. With numbers as high as they are in the United States and especially here in Boise (220,000) and 283 cases today then the highest safety should be taken when dealing with customers. I had to ask several times for masks to be used when handling my food. Otherwise this hotel is very nice for the price.
I walked out after 20 minutes of no service. It was like they had one person running the entire place. He came up took the money from the lady in front of me & went to the back.

If you're wondering what getting a mani-pedi during a pandemic I'll shed some light. They don't want to overcrowd the salon, so only a few appointments are allowed at a time. They requested we wear a mask the entire time, and they had some clean ones available had we not brought our own. I was completely pampered with my hands and feet getting done at the same time, and it was extremely efficiently done.

Meridian Fence came out to look at fence replacement for my home.  It's been over a month with no quote provided.  I have called them multiple times and still don't have a bid.  Further, no one will give me a timeline on when I can expect it.  Now it is mid-July and all other fence contractors have booked up for the summer.  I understand companies get busy, but if you are too busy to even provide a bid, then be honest and let people know rather than string them out and cause major delay in getting much needed work done.  Very unprofessional.

Overall, I'm not a big fan of this place, no matter how many chances I give it. Tonight, I got the sweet n' sour chicken - rice bento. The chicken is very lightly breaded, which might sound like a good thing to some, but in this case, it isn't. They have changed the taste and texture of the chicken so much that it tastes nothing like how you would expect sweet n' sour chicken to taste. Additionally, you get very little vegetables compared to the amount of rice that you get in this dish. 

All in all, this place just doesn't meet expectations. You're better off finding an actual Chinese restaurant or Korean BBQ restaurant and giving that a try.
Second time going here. First was for breakfast second was for dinner. Drinks were yummy especially the pickle ball. And the club sandwich with fries was also very good!!!

This was my first time at this location and I have to say that I prefer this location to the other. The atmosphere and size is very comforting. Thankfully I got there about 11:30 on a Saturday and they weren't busy, but as we were setting there the people came. 
The waitress was top notch and very attentive. The food was to perfection, honestly. I got a crispy BBQ chicken sandwich and it was large, not messy, and super tasty. I recommend only ordering a small fry or Onion rings. The large is a whole pound of fresh cut fries (cut right there on site) and way too much for one person (or share). 
The cost, to me, is a somewhat more costly than say Red Robin (not too bad). You'll pay about 8+ for the burger and then your fries are an additional cost. 
You get free ice cream on your birthday!

You can go to Albertsons or Fred Meyer and save a dollar per bottle, but you won't have the customer service that you receive from Ilene .   She knows her wines and always gives great suggestions.   She also has a great selection of Idaho wines.   Help support your local businesses when you can  ,

WOOOOOW!! Is all I have to say! Literally amazing food and HUGE portions, my husband was sitting there in awe when his plate came out lol. If you're  a Bloody Mary lover like myself. You'll probably have to wipe a tear from your eye when you have a sip of theirs. They put bacon jam in it and bacon salt on the rim!! I had to order two because I was in love!  Our server was so sweet and helped us with some suggestions since we're traveling fro out of town. Thanks again!!

We arrived a few minutes before check-in, we were able to check in without a problem. However, the king mattress in the room was very uncomfortable and made for a very difficult nights sleep(unfortunate). My wife (who has had back surgery) ended resting in the chair that was in the room. Breakfast was typical hotel fare, nothing to write home about. The staff, however, was friendly at check in; check out no words were spoken as my wife handed in the keys. The customers were friendlier than most of the staff.

If you want to catch COVID then go here, no social distancing, NO ONE ESPECIALLY STAFF WEAR A MASK, no gloves, no hand sanitizer or sanitizing in between customers, no limit on capacity, germs flying everywhere... I'm sure the kitchen crew don't wear masks , who knows who has COVID since it takes 3 days to show symptoms so you go there germs flying everywhere someone unwillingly has COVID and coughs
And you get it, nice, then the cycle begins... Now if they were following COVID rules, you would be less likely of catching it there.. They obviously don't care about there customers, just want $$$$... NOT A RESPONSIBLE BUSINESS AT ALL, the worst I've seen... They don't care about there community all they see is $$$

***This Yelp review is for Shawntae!***

She gave us excellent customer service & was the most patient and knowledgeable associate we've encountered with our many years of staying at any Holiday Inn! 

Her impeccable graciousness is one that is very hard to find! 
Even when having to put me on a brief hold while helping another guest, she returned with an upbeat attitude without missing a beat. 

We look forward to staying at this hotel, as we really only chose to stay here because we were so impressed by Shawntae! 

Thanks again!

It's been awhile since I've written a review and have been feeling that yelp itch. I visited ling and Louie's many times several years ago, but haven't been back since today. I figured this would give me good clarity on the restaurant for a quality review. 

The first thing that is noticeable is the decore. It's very sleek and modern and uses several antique pieces to give a nice character charm. Reminded me of a pier one. The only complaint I could see was how dark it felt inside. 

The menu was smaller than other Asian inspired locations, but I don't think that's a huge problem. They did feature sushi rolls which I didn't remember from my earlier trips so that's a bonus. I order a lo mein dish for the group and generals chicken for myself. It was very delicious with a good amount of spice too feel it but not be overpowered by it. 

After this last trip I definitely plan on revisiting again as I really enjoyed my entire meal. I haven't tried the American portions so I don't know how good those are. Enjoy!

The food here is horrible. The sweet and sour chicken is really sweet pork. All the other food we ordered tasted nasty. Not worth any amount of money. DO NOT ORDER from here unless you like crap. 
 Not only was the food nasty BUT the order was messed up and didn't want to go back so we thru it away.

My client needed more than one support person for their appointment. The nurse refused to let us all in the room. On the previous visit a different nurse was very rude and grumpy. I'm not impressed at all with this group. There are other doctors out there. I will be recommending to my company we find other urology services.           Sabrina, RN

Fantastic! The menu is unique with a great variety of dishes to choose from. The sushi is very good always  fresh. The calamari is by far the best in town! We love Calamari and will not order it any where else. I have never had anything  here that wasn't delicious. If you like Asian food this is a must do in Boise.

Deals in bad faith. My wife and I traveled to Idaho to look for a home. We decided after searching for days, to have Hubble build us a home. Working with the property sales agent we bought a bigger lot to accommodate a 2007 sq ft single story home. After getting all of the financials in place and ready to go, on the last day before the final step to start construction, I received a phone call, telling me that Hubble was refusing to build the home. I was informed that the lot was too small for the house. The only option was to purchase a bigger, more expensive lot for the house. I asked why they sold us the current lot when I was told I needed the current lot for the house size. Hubble never answered the question. Hubble refused to negotiate on the new lot, saying "take it or leave it". They messed up and left us hanging at the last minute and tried to push us into a more expensive lot.  Truly a second rate operation.

Quaint little underground pub. They've got an impressive selection of beers on tap and are happy to offer samples of any of them. Here's the best part - they'll mix them as well creating the perfect beer just for you! 
Free popcorn is a nice treat but even nicer, you can order food from one of the nearby restaurants and have it delivered right there. How great is that?
We enjoyed an entertaining game of C.A.H. which they had, along with a few others.  
Great place and will definitely be back.

I went for manis & pedis with a friend and left with a half assed manicure, bleeding cuticle, and no pedicure. They said they could fit us in, but after the terrible manicure my friend was already half way through her pedicure and I was told I had to wait for other people to be serviced. I paid and left with no pedicure and these people had the audacity to ask my friend to pay for me (a second time). I won't post about her experience which was just as bad....

The pork belly potatoes and hot sauce are a must have!  Bacon is phenomenal as well.  Definitely add yourself to the waitlist at prime time so you're wait isn't too long.  Overall, this is one of my go to places.

I haven't stayed here yet, but I will be in February. I am so looking forward to stay after calling and talking with Ashley the general manager. She was very helpful into getting rooms for my husband and mother and myself. She checked for the best price ever. She connected me with Hilton reservations that helped for even a better deal. Ashley is so friendly and caring it was like I was talking to a good friend. I look forward to meeting her. It will complete my trip to know someone is there to greet us with a warm welcome and take good care of our stay. You're the best Ashley can't wait to meet you.

Went here once with a coffee craving and wasn't very happy. I got a Vanilla Latte and it didn't really taste much like vanilla, was kind of bitter and flat tasting. Props for the cool bean/chocolate thing on the lid and at least the coffee wasn't watery like Dutch Bros. Lastly, their smallest size is a 12OZ which is much too big for me and puts their cheapest drink at least $4.50... Pretty expensive if I'm going to throw 1/3rd or more of it away. About average for a specialty coffee house.
I love this place they have the best drinks and atmosphere to go on ladies date and have a good time the food is delicious and never disappoints.

A couple of Kirin beers, bowl of shishito peppers, plate of lettuce wraps and a spicy california roll.  Brunch at the bar along with the Rams game on a Sunday.  Definitely the thing to do.  Now these are folks who know how to do Happy Hour - 7 days a week.

We stayed here when we were visiting my niece in Meridian and were pleasantly surprised. When we made the decision to move to Idaho, we first checked here for the price of a three-month stay, then checked other animal friendly hotels in the area, discovering My Place to check all the boxes that we needed. Other hotels were not as lenient when it came to pets, which was another determining factor for choosing My Place, so we were able to bring our small dog and two cats. 

Because it is an extended stay hotel, it has a full sized refrigerator, two-burner stove, a small sink, and decent cupboard space. They offer plates, cups, small pots/pans, and silverware for a price, which came in extra handy during our stay.

From the front desk to the housekeepers, everyone is very helpful and friendly. Hot coffee is abundant in the lobby, and the snack bar is impressively full. The pet area is always clean with waste bags provided. Of course, there is always someone who doesn't pick up after their pets, but that is not the fault of the hotel. 

The location is great and close to everything. It's not the Ritz, but it's comfortable and clean. I definitely recommend My Place to anyone visiting the Meridian area!

Ordered 3 kids meals all burgers with fries, a #2 and a #4. We each got a shake to drink. After a long wait, 10+ mins, they brought out 2 kids meals, one with tater tots, 4 shakes and 2 limeades, the #2 and #4, one with burned fries, one with soggy.
Everyone passed the buck, we dealt with 3 different employees. All 3 of which kept forgetting the condiments. 
They never rang up the 3rd kids meal, so by the time they actually got all our food, the rest of the family's food was cold. This is the 2nd time at this location.

This place is beautiful! It wasn't very busy when we went which was really surprising. However, the meat was delicious and the quality was fabulous! The salad bar was huge and had so much variety and was oh-so-good!! The staff were all so very nice and too very good care of us. The place is higher priced but due to the better quality meats it was worth it. 

We will definitely be returning for your meats and spreads and we are hungry for more!!!

The food was good, but our server was extremely rude.  I ask for a box to take home the rest of my meal, I ask if she could box it up and she said, "no do it yourself".  Also, I felt the price was high for what we received. All the other staff was very nice, but this server was out of bounds.
Heritage is a dope, quaint basement bar. The bartenders are very chill and appreciative of your business. They are working on an expansion, and I'm very excited to see it coming soon.

Today I visited this establishment for the last time. While its a restaurant I desperately want to like as the food is good. It keeps coming up short or worse do to atmosphere and customer service. 

Today as we entered the restaurant with our almost 11 month old boy we where shown to a seat and not offered a  highchair so we had to go find one on our own, This is not a huge deal but as we have come 2x and it has happened both times it does begin to show a bit of the problem with training. Not a huge deal but is worth mentioning. 

The waitress who was nice took our order, and for the second time the avocado was missing from our Avocado Burger salad's. Though this time when we mentioned it to the waitress she at least brought out 2 servings. On the last visit we where told to make due with one as there was a little extra in it(Not a great feeling when you pay for 2). 

This is where my real problem begins. 
As we sat eating, We could hear the cooks talking in the back what started with simple profanity and upset me on its own, it quickly became quite vulgar and very unappetizing language. For instance I now know the grooming habits and smell of a cooks current girlfriends private parts(This is me trying very hard to explain what I herd without being rude and it was quite a bit worse.) . I understand that I am a parent and therefore a little more sensitive to what is going on around me but this is not something I would have accepted even if my kid was not there. This type of degrading talk is simply not acceptable in the earshot of customers and children and probably shouldn't be said at work at all. 

At this point I started to get upset so I stood up to check if anyone else was in the restaurant. Perhaps it was another customer and I was wrong unfortunately for them there where no other customers in the restaurant so it was 100% employees talking. 

We quickly packed up and paid on the way out the door. I will not ever be coming to this restaurant again. If I could could give 0 stars I 100% would. 

A note: I did not ask to talk to a manager because if there was one in the store I would have been even more mad then I currently am and my child does not need to see this.

I had high hopes for this place. Front staff for the first few nights were awesome. To be clear, it was the staff of 11/30-12/1 that were the biggest issue. I would avoid this place like the plague. Here's the list: 1. Phone in room did not work. Let staff know on day #1, never fixed. 2. Asked for towels and tp from housekeeping directly outside of our room, told she was out. Had to go to the front desk a day later because it was never remedied. 3. All cable and internet stopped working on a clear night, when I went down to the front desk (as I couldn't call because the phone didn't work) I was told last time it came back in 10 minutes. Wait for it.... it didn't. This is not customer service. If you want a fancy motel 8, this is your place. Won't be back. Ever. We love BW+, we are members and have stayed at locations nationwide. This one is literally the worst out of 25+ stays. By a mile. Thanks but no thanks. GARBAGE HOTEL. STAY AWAY.

Comfortable bed. You can hear the neighbors.  They do not "housekeep" if you stay more than one night.
So, no beds made, no clean towels and NO cups in the room. Makes teeth brushing fun.
Breakfast boxes had stale hard boiled eggs and bagels, totally inedible.
The key card system is slow and hard to get into the hotel at night.

This is by far the best clinic I have been to!  Dr Cron and his staff are so warm and welcoming. The office is beautiful and inviting. Even my anxiety about my blood draws was calmed easily by Margo. They really listen to you and provide the best solutions for you personally!
Such good filling food I would highly recommend. Didn't have too good of a Bloody Mary but there other drinks are very good
Glad to see more Pho places in Meridian, but I'm sad to say this is some of the worst Pho I've  ever had.  I'm hoping I just caught them on a bad day.  Going to give them one more shot.
Beautiful, clean, new, and takes covid seriously. Friendly and helpful staff. Wouldn't stay anywhere else in West Memphis.

Today was one of those days... I work just down the road from the Walmart gas station and I forgot my lunch, so I only have a 30 min lunch. I decided to go to the Walmart gas station and get a sandwich or something. When I pulled up, I reached for my wallet and it was not there. I remember putting it inside my tool bag so I didn't have to carry it around the job site. I went inside because I still had my phone, I was going to use my Apple Pay. I asked the cashier and she said, nope and listed off all of the other ones that they accept. So I went back to my car and pulled change out and I ended up having enough for a sandwich. 
I was just frustrated because there are so many people out there who have iPhones. Why wouldn't Walmart want to change it up and add Apple Pay to be accepted. 
Just seems like it wouldn't be a hard choice. But I am sure there is a reason why they don't.
Terrible customer service. I ordered 2 chairs for in-store pickup. The store cancelled my order, without notifying me. I found out ten days later when I called for an update on the order status.

We took our Maine Coon cat there while visiting my Dad to be groomed for the first time.  We got the lion cut and couldn't be happier!  They did a great job and took good care of our big cat!!  Wish we lived close by so we could bring him once a month!!  Will bring him back next summer!

Went for dinner with my wife and a buddy...enormous portions, quite generous, and a good beer selection. Waitstaff was not 100% knowledgeable on what was on tap, but was friendly and cool about it, so no big deal. Seemed like they had house-smoked brisket and bacon, which was a big win. 

I could definitely see coming back...more of a "guy" vibe, what with all the BBQ and generous plates, but good food.

Re: Covid, if you are all freaked out about people not wearing masks, then maybe this isn't the place for you. If you prefer to feel a little more "free", then have a seat and enjoy the food, beer, and hospitality.

After visiting for the Grand opening week I can sum up my experience in one phrase.. Well oiled machine! While I agree with it not having the mom and pop feel, this location has a more industrial look that is perfect for the area and demographic.  

Atmosphere
   The layout is a relief as it separates the waiting area from the business of the dinning room, the old location mixed these two. You weren't sure if you should help bus some tables or maybe take an order. (since you always felt in the way.) 

Service-  
   Our whole experience lasted less than 40 mins and keep in mind the place was packed out.  Everything ran efficiently, we were checked on multiple times through out, and MY FAV thing is they take your payment at the table!  No more do you have to go up to the register and congest the area once more feeling in the way.  

Food- 
  It is the same high quality ingredients and exact menu as the other location, which does not dissapoint.  I was actually shocked by the presentations of the burgers, they looked like they were carefully put together.  I opted for the pastrami burger with melted swiss and slices of pastrami, while my friend got the classic hickory burger with bbq sauce, onion rings, bacon and all the toppings.  While the burger was flavorful both my friends and mine seemed a bit dry, just a little less cooking and thus could have been a 5 star experience. 

Price- 
   We paid less than $20 all together for  quality burgers w tots/fries.  A great deal considering what McPick oatmeal GMO concoction you get from McDonald's is just a few bucks less. 

Cleanliness-  
  Everything in the place is immaculately clean and polished.

This is an interesting score for me, I usually try and visit an establishment a few times to get a baseline reading so I know what to expect. Every single one has been so widely different than the others it's really hard for me to give a 100% accurate score. Im stuck between 3/4 and giving the benefit of doubt by listing as a 4. 

Overall the food quality has been swingy. The food at times is literally the best sandwich I've had in a long time. Other times the meat is dry and bland. I Personally order the cheesesteak so my opinion of food is limited to that one sandwich for now. Every time I order I hope that I get to experience the great tastes, but it's hit and miss.

The staff is mostly pleasant. I've witnessed a few interactions with other customers that I would have corrected if I was a manager on staff. There are ways to be compassionate and still express your point. 

The App is good for ordering but the single time I used it for delivery it took over an hour to get delivered and my sides were not included. The driver (who I believe is doordash) said something I couldn't comprehend about not having everything, but I was never notified prior from Jersey Mike's. Maybe they could have called me and asked for a substitute item rather than leaving me with something I didn't ask for a s still charging me.

I'd like to say I'll go here again, but I'd like to see some stability.

I had my first taste of Happy Teriyaki a few weeks back after my Wife had been telling me for years about their quality (I had the spicy chicken and it was great). However, we wanted to try the 10 Mile location and it was outstanding. I ordered the beef, but asked for it hot/spicy, it was tender, flavorful, and loaded. Everyone in my family got something different (Orange Chicken, Katsu, and Teriyaki Chicken), each meal was great! After the meal we had a chance to speak with the owner, you can tell she takes great pride in her restaurant
In time of COVID-19, this store is doing it right... things spread out more, sanitizer offered in strategic locations, & aisles flow well... so easy to keep spacing.
It was much easier and faster than going to urgent care. I went twice. Second time I got a cortisone shot and the Dr was great.
Updated review. 4 stars last time 5 this time. Had beers and sushi last night. All was good. Sushi was fresh and beers were cold.

Not what I expected. Pictures on the Internet makes it look a lot better than what it really is. When somebody flushes the toilet I believe the whole floor here's it. The same goes with taking a shower. Kids running down the hallways. The continental breakfast was not very good at all. I could have went next-door to Motel 6 and probably save myself 100 bucks and there would not have been any difference between the two places. Also for some reason they charged my credit card a room for somebody that I have no idea who they are. That was real sketchy. I had to go to the front desk to let them know and they did reimburse me but just the simple fact that they did that was not cool. Last time I will be coming here.

Hmm. After looking at the other two reviews, it makes me wonder if I went to the same place. Overall, I had an excellent experience which says something in this day and age when medical appointments make me feel more and more like an number or a form - but not here!  I can't comment on the negative optical shop experience because I didn't use them but the medical side of the office and the overall management was really great!  The optician was personable, funny, and super-efficient.  Dr. Rammell is so easygoing and I didn't feel rushed at all. The office/lobby has a nice feel to it - Coffee and cookies for patients, videos to pass the time, and a front office team that is welcoming. Thanks to the whole team - you clearly are working together for your patients (I know a few medical offices that could use your help)!

Our party was looking forward to a happy evening of catching up.  Sat at a vacant table and waited. And waited. And waited. Got up, walked to the bar and sat on a stool and waited and waited and waited. Went back to table and waited. Finally the waitress arrived, couldn't find any menu. Seems she was the only waitress there. Waited some more, got our drink order finally. Guinness is very very good, top notch but the wait was way too much at any standard. We decided to pay and leave. We were hungry and this is just not gonna cut it. Good luck
Always good finds at Goodwill. If you are not overly picky about the state of the clothes or shoes and don't mind wearing used stuff, this place rocks.

Stopped in around dinner time, waited in line where it looks to place all orders. After standing in line we were told to find a table. Sitting there 10 min i walked up and they then acted like they forgot she sent us to dine in. I asked to place our order, she came over with menus but we then placed it. We got the food out, it tasted bland no flavor. Those who think this place is great has no clue and hasn't been to other real teriyaki places. Hoped the bubble tea would come out around the food but didn't, had to ask for water to swallow my half eaten dinner. When we were expecting the check is when the teas came out. So disgusted would never go back even if it was free. Bad service, dining room had tables of leftover plates laying there for some time and the food is equivalent to a tv dinner quality. Stay clear.

Started eating here in 1999. Seems every year the quality of the food goes down and the price goes up. At least you could top the bowl with cheap noodles. Not only are their prices high but they have now posted a small hard to find sign, warning people that if they stack noodles three inches high, they will be charged the price of the next bigger bowl. They already charge $8.55 for a small bowl. We were accosted by an old Chinese woman about the height of our noodles. Then when we ate the food it was bland. Even if you ladle the recommended sauces, the cook pours the contents onto the flat grill and all the sauce and flavor runs right into the drain. The cook then squirts huge amounts of water from a bottle all over the cooking food. The result is a tasteless mess. Save your money and go to the China Buffet east on Fairview in Boise.  Always delicious and no old greedy woman eyeballing everybody's bowl contents.
I bring an elderly man here from a retirement home. He's had a stroke and can be difficult to understand.  The stylists are always patient and kind.  Truly appreciate their demeanor.

Had dinner here for the first time last night and was very impressed with our meal.   
The service was very good, atmosphere was very Italian (I'm married to one) and my wife said the Gnocchi was very fresh and very good!   
After having pizza at a number of places in the area, I think we found our favorite.  It was authentic, fresh, flavorful with the PERFECT crust that made you want more!   Just give me a side order of crust please : )
My only complaint is they aren't closer to home. 
They are certainly on our pizza / Italian dinner rotation from now on.   Great job!!!!

This is not the kind of place I would normally go, simply because I don't like all-you-can-eat style and I don't like the cafeteria like atmosphere. However, I was with a colleague and this is where he wanted to go so I was game to give it a try.

We got there slightly early for lunch so almost no one was seated and eating when we arrived. The hostess got us started and seemed pleasant enough.

There is not much to say about the salad bar. Typical salad offerings, plus toppings, and things like cottage cheese, pasta and potato salads, etc. It looked quite clean, but again, we were one of the first people in there for lunch. Also, everything looked fresh and the items that were supposed to be kept cold were cold.

The hostess came by after we had started eating and made sure we could find everything. She also took our used plates away and came by at least twice during our meal. Good service for what I was expecting and once again, she was very pleasant.

I tried the bow tie pasta with sun dried tomato and it was surprisingly good. So was the potato salad. Also tried the beef noodle soup which was also quite tasty, but on the salty side and not quite as hot as I would have liked. I tried the cornbread but did not end up tasting it because it was cold (like they recently took it out of a refrigerator or even the freezer). The salad is, well... it's just a salad. Don't expect anything more.

I was surprised that they also had baked potatoes and tacos here as well. I did not try them. They also have the desert stuff. I had a small soft serve ice cream and it was as expected.

So still not a place I would frequent very often but it is inexpensive and you can certainly get your money's worth if this is the kind of lunch you are looking for. Souper Salad is definitely not a high end soup and salad place but it is less expensive than the fancy alternatives, so I guess it all evens out.

Loved my tan!
I had Kris come to my house (awesome) for my tan for my wedding!
She was super nice and made me feel relaxed to strip down and bare.
My tan was beautiful for my wedding and everyone said how I was glowing!

thanks Kris

Absolutely amazing. Everything was great. From the service to the side/vegetable buffet to the skewers of meat being carved at your table. 

Each meat was well prepared and absolutely flavorful. You're able to taste the rock salt they use to prep the meat with each bite. 

Our service from Shannon was absolutely stellar. She was attentive and ready for all of our requests.

The only complaint I would have is with the ambiance. It's very loud in the restaurant and there were a number of loud children, which that takes away from the "fine dining" experience. Acoustics should be improved.

Drove down to Biscuit & Hogs in south Meridian for breakfast this morning, because they don't require their employees to wear masks. A bit of a wait to be seated, because they don't take check-ins online or over the phone, but it was great food and atmosphere. #MasksOff #MasksOffIdaho #MaskOffAmerica #CommieVirus2020

Went for the first time for Teriyaki and was so Amazed  Great food, good portions, good customer service. Will definitely be back for more. I had the Spicy Chicken Teriyaki with rice, and my boyfriend had combination plate we loved it !!!!!

In general  everything  looked  nice.   It  was   just   sad   to find  a  crumb  of  green  frosted   cookie   on the white  bedspread.  O.o  and   later   to  find  a  cellophane  wrapper  in the corner  of  the room.   The  shower.  oh  my.   tiny  little  one  inch   pan  made  of  wood?   and   a  oval  shower  curtain   square  peg  round  curtain.   harsh.  bad  design.  The bed   had an odd  base.   wood  sticking  out.  One  guard  missing.  ??

Eh. After removing all of the things I like fro. The menu no reason to come back I guess. I prefer Applebee's five years ago. Nothing wrong with service or restaurant, just the corporate food choices are not interesting. Even chips and salsa are difficult for Applebee's now - salsa tasted like stuff in the crap can, and to touch it up someone lost a salt shaker in it. Inedible. Downhill from there. Guess another 75 million menu makeover is due. How about making good food that people would want to spend money on?

I like the service at this place if you can do a chef special for sushi that never disappoints just tell them what you like and what you don't like and they make up a roll that is soo good I haven't had a bad dish here yet sometimes there's a wait for a larger party
Great spot! The Brie Pastries, Irish Farmhouse Soup, and Shepard's Pie are all great dishes. You have to love that awesome Irish feel as well!

One of my buddies told me about a bucket full of Bloody Mary and I had to check it out. I did not get the chance to try the Bloody Mary as there was no way I could finish it by myself so I will have to try it next time. I got their manmosa and it was oddly yummy! Pbr and oj was a nice combination. We got their steak nachos and their chips were thick and crunchy and so perfect! Their prime rib steak sandwich was the best! Perfectly seasoned and cooked and so tender! I ended up just eating the steak bites by themselves. Their sweet potato tots are so sweet, crunchy and scrumptious bites of goodness! They have a really good happy hour menu and their drinks are awesome! Can't wait to come back again!

I am not one to review places but we had such a horrible experience here I needed to comment! 

The WORST patient care ever. 3 appointments cancelled. One 10 min after we ARRIVED to the appt, 2nd cancelled an hour before, 3rd was a telehealth at 4:10 pm. I called at 3:45 to confirm information and see how to set up teleheath. I called at 4:20 wondering what was going on/why we hadn't been called yet and again at 4:50 wondering why we still hadn't been called. The doctor had left and they had multiple excuses that didn't make any sense "oh he tried to call, oh the number didn't work, oh he was running late, oh you guys never called us". Front desk staff sent our confidential test results to the wrong email, told us the wrong price for a test, and overall treated us extremely poorly. this place is THE WORST! When I talked to them expressing my concerns they didn't even care and were very rude to us. Do not go here.

OMG!!!! This had to be one of the best breakfasts I've EVER had! Have been wanting to check this place out for a while and stopped in a few days ago. The food and service were TOP NOTCH and we can't wait to try more of the menu. HUGE portions! We ordered a breakfast burrito and a Bacon Bacon burger. Soooooo delicious! One of the best burgers we've EVER had.

This resale experience was very meh. I am happy with the outcome of my credit although customer service was kind of shotty. Every time I have been there the employees have all been in their own little world. 
No one explained to me how it worked when I dropped off or picked up my items. 

I was under the impression from a previous review that they tagged everything they wanted to buy from you and when you came back you could decide if you wanted to sell it or not. 
When I came in 90 percent of my items were already being put out on the floor by the employees. I wanted to make sure I was getting a fair deal considering I had never-used high end items and If I was only getting a few bucks for them I figured I could just take them home and resell them elsewhere, but it was too late.
I feel like a lot of trust goes into this system. I literally have no proof if they took anything without me getting a credit for it. 

I like the deals in the store, so I May shop there again but I probably won't bring more than a few items in at a time to resell in the future.
Very professional, courteous and downright nice! That's how I describe Dr Eaton and his staff.

Brody wishes his friend Kim with PETCCRUZ mobile dog grooming a very Merry Christmas. He wants Kim to know he's sorry for being such a pain in the behind, but know for sure he would not want anyone else to give him his bath and cut his hair.  All of us at Brody's house are very great full that Kim is our friend.

MERRY CHRISTMAS

Absolutely LOVE Q Nail Spa! Friendly staff, great prices and fantastic work! Linda is wonderful! I can go in after a long, stressful day at work and she makes me laugh every time! She is fun, funny and does an amazing job! Highly recommend Q Nail Spa and Linda!!!

If you're looking for a dose of normal and amazing food, this is your place.  If you're worried about social distancing and mask wearing, go somewhere else and for goodness sake, shut up on here!  Giving one star because no one is wearing masks is petty and shows how tasteless you are.  The wait staff is friendly and always willing to offer suggestions.  Breakfast or burgers, both are amazing.  Get the side pancake.  It is tasty and you will have leftovers for days.  The Farmhouse is a winner and the Bacon Bacon Burger is equally great.  We appreciate an owner and staff that welcome people who want to be responsible but also move on from all the nonsense.  I have been several times and am still covid free (shocking, I know).  Please support this great local business.

I 've got to say even though the gas is some of the most expensive in town, the convenience store is awesome with a huge selection.  There are always a number of employees at the check out so waiting isn't an issue.  And the restrooms are worth the stop alone.  Probably the nicest, cleanest restrooms in a gas station in Meridian!

Not a bad place to eat, caterpillar roll was tasty, a little different than I'm used to but it's Idaho sushi with a twist. 
The yellowtail tuna was fresh so that was a plus. 
If your into craft beer their selection is great. Probably about 60+ beers, the majority is IPA, if you're into that, this is your place.

Sunrise Cafe was a delicious place to  eat brunch today! If you like pumpkin, several items including muffins, pancakes, french toast have pumpkin The food was very good, the portions were generous, and the service was excellent!

Situated on historic Main Street in Meridian, it is worth a visit.

Highly recommend.

Had such a nice mani and pedi at Nicely Nails yesterday!  I got a gel manicure with Vincent (Tan) and then I got the royal deluxe pedi with another really nice man. The place was clean and very comfortable inside. Even the lady next to me in the pedi area was raving about Nicely Nails. That's a great sign! I definitely found my new nail salon

Fairly clean room. On our 3 night stay, had to go to the front desk for soap and lotion. Never replenished. Coffee was replenished once. Bed barely made. Didn't look like toilet was cleaned. It's a nice hotel, but housekeeping could be much better. Outside grounds were kept fairly well. Lots of cigarette butts by entrance.

We just tried Louie's on-line ordering and curb-side pick up in support of the COVID-19 restrictions. The on-line ordering system was intuitive, and easy to use, although it would be nice if their daily specials were represented. Everything was complete and the quality of the food was very good. You will likely need to reheat some items. I think we will be trying them again in the near future.
I found the best sandwich. The Big Kunna.   Its has hot peppers but don't like them mushrooms and gr peppers & cheese. It is the Best with Sea Salt Vinegar Chips

I love Groomingtails!  they work great with my dog and put him at ease every time. I have tried many other groomers and none have compared, I am so happy I have taken my dog here and will no longer try anywhere else!. I would recommend everyone to go here and you will love it!

I have always been a huge fan of Louie's 
pizza because the pizza toppings are always fresh & delicious & they know how to make a loaded pizza! I have never had them mess up my takeout order & I have been eating their pizza for 20 years. Tonight I had dinner inside with my family. Our waiter was so kind, very professional & was an excellent waiter! I was pleasantly surprised how clean the restaurant was & COVID aware they are. The Chicken Parmesan was really good as well as the Fettuccine Alfredo. I would choose Louise's over Olive Garden any day.

Modern Rehab was a life saver. I've suffered from migraines since I was a teenager. They have gotten worse and worse over the years as I'm now in my 30's. I reached the point where I was so sick of taking prescription meds and over the counter meds for my migraines almost daily. Nothing helped me. I was to the point where they were so bad, it was difficult to even take care of my little ones, let alone function at all.
I decided to give Jamie at Modern Rehab a try, as I had heard amazing things about him and his PT clinic from a few friends that had been seen by him for varying conditions. I was actually at 2+ weeks of constant headaches and migraines, where I had to take medication every day for those 2+weeks... This was the worst I had ever been, and for the longest duration. I was at my breaking point. 
Everyone at Modern Rehab was so friendly and welcoming. Jamie (The Physical Therapist) spent so much time and energy working with me. He worked on me at the clinic, and sent me home with a few exercises to do to strengthen some neck and back muscles that he had concluded may be causing a big problem, in turn causing these horrible migraines. I did the exercises during my visit with him, then did them again at home that night. The next morning/day you can imagine my absolute shock when I had ZERO headaches or migraines all day! None! I couldn't believe it. I wanted to cry, because unless you suffer from migraines, you can't comprehend how debilitating they truly are. Then came around the next day, I did my workouts again in the morning and the afternoon.... And again, another day with no migraines! And now I am already on day 3 of no migraines, and no headaches. I am in complete shock. 
I am so thankful for Jamie's wonderful expertise and his gift for physical therapy. 
Needless to say I am very much looking forward to my next appointment. 
Thanks Modern Rehab!!!

Went with my cousin to get our nails done here. Not only did they up charge a ridiculous amount for three diamonds but they rushed through like they didn't want to be paid. Overall very disappointed. They're only getting two stars because my own nails are good looking. HOWEVER when working on anyone, you NEVER try to rip off their old gel polish, that's a great way to rip a nail off.
The aspect I appreciate most is the ability to customize my meal. The food is healthy, fresh, quick, and delicious!

I had the worst nail experience here. I had their coupons on my phone, the lady that sits at the first station informed me, after my pedicure, that they needed to be printed out to work. After my nail service for acrylics was done, my nails were uneven, one hand shorter than the other. The shorter one to short already to even the other hand up. I asked for white tip and there was barely any left, so they will be grown out in a couple days. I paid full price for everything, plus the add ons, the lady shrugged her shoulders and headed to the back, while the girl who did my pedicure cashed us out. She apologized for the unsatisfactory service,  but said she couldn't do anything cause that was her boss.. Horrible customer service!

I love this place. The main reason I started going is bc of no masks! However I was pleased cause they always do a good job & the place is beautiful. No matter who does the service, it's always good. Plus I like their radio station.

Why no fish n chips. Sat at our table for a while before we even saw a waitress. Menu is very small and does not offer many choices. Ended up leaving because I could not find anything I'd eat but plenty for my less fussy husband. I do want to go back for cocktails and desert.

From reviewing all the comments I'm still wondering if this is the same Hubble Homes.  We did get off to a slow start due to changes in Hubble agents but as far as construction and final product of home we are very pleased.  Everything per contract was installed and may even look better than model home.  A few items were not ready for our walkthrough due to inclement weather but not an issue.  Excellent quality of work and installation.  Construction crew and Hubble agent Katie are very professional and knowledgeable about their product.  Willing to go the extra to answer questions.  All in all we have no complaints.  Very happy with selecting this construction company to build our home.

I don't know why there are so many negative reviews! Yes, they would rather you pay in cash but it doesn't warrant a negative review. Sheesh! 

I love Julie, Jojo and the rest of the ladies! They are always so nice and open to squeezing me in! 

Jojo is my girl! She is so sweet and funny. She puts up with my pickiness and never complains or tells me no when I show her my newest Instagram nail idea  I have been getting my nails done for years and she is the first nail tech where I havent broken a nail. *Knock on wood* I use my hands a lot, pulling kids out of carseats, dishes, sporting events, etc.. its expected to break a nail here and there... I still havent in the last three months

I understand that there can be a language barrier at times but you just have to be patient and take your time explaining what you want, just like most other Asian owned salons! 

Anyways, I highly recommend Envy! It is my go to for nails!
Open, fast, freindly. Dinning rm open,  every other booth/table closed off. Comfortable feeling. Will be back. Used app in store. Yippy Skippy.

We have tried this place twice. Once for breakfast and once for lunch. Everything is average; the food, cleanliness, and service. It also has a weird vibe. It's like the owner can't decide if it wants to be a college bar or a rustic diner. Either way, prices are too high for the quality of the food. I don't know what it is, but there is just something missing. Could be great.

Ok, I have to disclose something up-front here.  I am NOT a gamer.  I do like board games, and card games, especially in a family "game-night" situation.  However, I appreciate seeing aspects of people's lives that they take seriously, and pursue with passion.  Phoenix Fire Games caters to that group of people who simply love games.  

I went to Phoenix Fire Games to participate in a team-building activity with my work colleagues.  Several of the people that I work with are seriously into a variety of games, and coordinated several different group games, and we had a lot of fun.  Phoenix Fire Games provides tables for rent where people can bring in their own games, and spend the afternoon/evening with family and/or friends.  The people working there were friendly, and the place was neat and clean.

It was a fun afternoon.
Loved our dinner with Doordash from Happy Teriyaki! The food was warm and tasted fresh for an easy weeknight dinner meal. To be honest, Happy Teriyaki is one of my favorite spots for a cheat meal.

If you're willing to wait an hour to be seated, you will not regret it! There's a wait for a reason! We came after a hike with a hunger needed to be fed! We ordered the breakfast tacos and the Nashville hot scramble. They do not play around with their pancakes! They're about the size of a medium pizza and as thick as a waffle! Their home style potatoes are perfectly cooked and flavored. A little crispy, a little soft! Their tacos are crazy messy, but so dang yummy! Love this place!

Just wanted to take a minute and give these guys some praise.  I've been there twice now and both times I left feeling like I was actually CARED for.  What a concept right?  Everyone I interacted with seemed like they loved their job and genuinely wanted to help me, including the reception desk.  Highly recommended!

DO NOT STAY HERE!!!!!! I stayed here 2 nights in October 2020. My reservation was for 286.81 the hotel charged me 308.81. When I alerted the manager he said they had taken off my aaa discount and he was unsure why but that he would refund the card. After a couple weeks of the refund not showing up I contacted the hotel again with documented proof there was no refund and also an updated invoice showing that there was no refund. They have refused to make this right. They have said they refuse to give me my 27 dollars back. This hotel will rip you off. Do yourself a favor and stay somewhere where they only charge what they quote you

I ordered from their website and was given a 3 hour pick up time from the time I ordered. I decided to call to see if it was really going to take that long and I was told that they had a packed house and a 2 hour wait. Just when I was thinking okay I totally understand, the girl on the phone said that pick up orders weren't a priority. Doesn't make sense that someone who's already paid for their food and gave a tip before even getting anything was told I wasn't a priority. Very very bad customer service...

This place is great, it's probably one of the only places you'll see people from Treasure Valley wait for brunch (because most people who live in the Treasure Valley would rather go someplace else than wait, this isn't Portland). The name of the place is the theme of the place, stick to your ribs biscuits and gravy, which seem freshly made, and of course bacon and all those other wonderful things that come from our favorite breakfast animal. The portions are extremely generous. Of course, they have your favorite breakfast cocktails, like Mimosas.

The place is extremely crowded, and as I've mentioned, people from around here aren't quite used to this level of busyness in a restaurant. My advice if you are finding your waitress is inattentive and giving you an attitude is to try being nice to her; cordial, friendly, and appreciative and see if that doesn't change. Also, reflect that gratitude in your tip. You would be amazed what a positive attitude on the part of a patron can do to improve service almost instantly. Judging from the people around us, that lesson hasn't quite sunk in. It's a busy place people, but it's good, so be good back.

Had knee problem, I saw Arthur Nease PA at DOC and was told I had severe DJD with Patella-femoral disease and received a cortisone injection. I was told this is not a cure and that it is progressing, if the cortisone shot wears off to call and would schedule surgery for Patella replacement. He said no need for MRI as it is very obvious what the problem is. 
My PCP sent me to a St. Luke's ortho Dr. about a few weeks later. He had the Xrays from DOC sent over as well as doing more. He said I do not have Severe DJD nor do I have Issues with my Patella. He showed me the xrays that were done from him.  I told him what was said by the PA from DOC, he then showed me the xrays from DOC and they were completely different from what I saw in the DOC office.  I was also told that the injection I received should have never been done as it would not help me. I had an MRI done and I have a torn meniscus and I am scheduled for knee Arthroscopy to repair it and not a replacement surgery as told I was needed. It is my belief that I was mixed up with some other patient and was given false information that was very stressful and an unnecessary injection.  I plan on taking this further, but have not received a call back from their clinic as of yet.

My family and I stayed here over a very hot weekend in Boise, specifically the Meridian area, and the indoor pool saved us as we had 8 kids under 10 to entertain. The eatery was awesome, and the Continental breakfast was plentiful with a wide array of breakfast foods for all walks of life. The game area even had an extra large version of Jenga to play on the patio, along with billiards and other games for children and adults to play. Thank you for a fun experience!

Truly our favorite Italian restaurant their service is fantastic their food is always fantastic we actually just had my husband's 60th birthday surprise party there they allowed us to come in early to set up we had a whole private room it was a wonderful time and a wonderful experience we highly recommend this for any event that you're having they are fantastic
A little expensive but they were super fast and did such an amazing job! Exactly how I needed my dress

I had high hopes for this place...but my kid is just the wrong size! I have a 14m/o and there was hardly any 12-18 month clothes...if she was 0-9 or 24+ it would've been great. Prices were good, was hoping for a tad cheaper.

Environment was very pretty for a modest priced menu. Although I was a little lost on where to start on the menu, but I am a bit picky so most things just did not catch my eye. I ended up ordering the double dragon roll and it was very good. I usually indulge in big meals but I was quite satisfied with the size of roll and even had a couple pieces left. I tried sake for the first time and was really impressed. It was very light and almost refreshing to sip with my dinner.  All in all it was a good small meal to end my day, my only complaint would be my server seemed to never hear me right multiple times through my meal.

I took in a pair of trousers that were extremely long, I searched for a tailor and this popped up! Decided to give it a try and was really pleased with the affordability!  I called in beforehand to make sure that there tailor would be available, the drive was worthwhile! Very smooth and professional service, I paid a bit extra for dry cleaning. I'll definitely be back for dry cleaning or the occasional tailor needs!

I've been here twice now because it's right by my work and I was limited on time. Both times I have been disappointed in my gel manicure. They always get the polish around the cuticle so it starts to peel on around day 3. If you're going to spend $30 on a gel manicure please don't waste your $ here.

Gluten free pizza is NASTY! 

Went with 2 others, one loved it, the other wasn't impressed with their food (gluten eaters). Waiter was nice, but seemed overworked trying to get our cups refilled, check, whatever took more time than should.

We went to Louies with a good sized group after sledding. We called in advance and booked their private room. We chose menu items ahead of time. Everyone loved it! Best Lasagna ever. It was all ready for our hungry group. When we walked in the aroma was wonderful and the meal that followed was fabulous! Excellent service as well! It has a homey comfortable atmosphere. I would not chance one thing! Thank you Louies! We left full and happy.
Submitted an order online and went to pick up and the location was closed. No indication online or at the location they would be closed today. May change the review once a refund is processed.

Fantastic!! The food was delicious! I had the grilled salmon and it was wonderful! I would absolutely go back! We got there before the dinner rush started so the dinner wait was not too bad. But if you have a super hungry group I would get an app to hold them over. I think they do serve garlic bread ahead of the meal. The app came super quick (garlic knots) and were fresh baked and yummy! Beautiful dinning-room!

This was the worst hotel experience of my life. I had made a reservation on line a week prior to arrival and stated that I was traveling with my pet bunny and I had a confirmation code. Upon arrival I was turned away from the hotel due to my pet. They are unprofessional and are liars.

Props to their marketing team. The website & Instagram pages are beautiful and really convince you that the place (could) be tasty. The interior of the restaurant looks exactly like it did a few years back..... when it was a sports bar. After placing our breakfast order, I became hesitate on the quality/taste of the food when I saw the table next to us receive their food. Literally the pancakes are 14" in diameter and you get 2 in an order. They are trying to make up for poor food quality with huge portions and for the love of god somebody teach your homeboy in the back how to make scrambles eggs ‍

I've never been so full in my life. Better quality than the other Brazilian chain in town, and with better service and and extensive wine list. Salad bar is smaller than the other place, but everything on it is top notch quality. The food comes out fast and furious, so come hungry.
The best skin care experience I have had yet! Her gentle products worked wonders for my skin as well as the microcurrent. Amber is very kind and cares about making your skin the best it can be!

I have eaten here for many years, but not for some time as I no longer work close to the grill so I never make the time to come during the week and normally I am with my wife during the weekend and she is not a fan.

I like this place.  I get to choose how the flavor will be with my selection of vegetables and meats.  The staff has always been polite and this time was no exception.  

The food is never outstanding, but it is good and it is filling.  I always wish I had chosen a larger bowl when I am done, but ten minutes later, realize it is good that I did not...

I will be back.

Last night my husband and I had dinner at this Applebee's. We've eaten here a few times, but it's not our "go to" restaurant. In the past the food has been good, but not great and the service acceptable. What a different last night!  They were very busy and we had to wait a bit to be seated. The host and hostess were kind and professional. When we were seated our table was right across from the front door, so it was quite cold anytime other customers come in and held the door open too long and it was a very tiny table. That was the only drawback. Our server, Ronnie, knocked it out of the ball park!  Absolutely incredible, attentive (but not hovering. which we both hate), perfect service.  He was polite, knowledgeable and professional. Even when I accidentally spilled my soda, the whole staff was quick to jump in and help Ronnie clean it up before it got all over our clothes.  Then there was the food, which was excellent. Hats off to the chefs last night!! My husband loved the nachos we had as a appetizer. I would have enjoyed them, too, except they were drizzled all over with sour cream, which I can't stand. We'll know next time how to order.  My husband had a steak and I had the double crunch shrimp. It was the best I've ever had at Applebee's. Hubby's steak was good too and he said his baked potato was cooked to perfection. Great job everyone. We will be back for sure.

I really like the varied menu, and service is the best. Had the Chicken Happy Bowl with fried rice yesterday . All kinds of goodies in it, plus they have the best teriyaki chicken. Katsu Chicken also a favorite. Good portion sizes for good price.

Wish I could give less than 1 star... went through drive thru and the girl in the window was completely rude. I understand fast food job sucks but wow.. second I got the chicken sandwich and it had no condiments in it at all, only chicken lettuce and tomato and once I took a bite it was hard to chew and dry. It tasted like the chicken was cooked last week and sat in a heater. Idk what this Sonics deal is but a 1.5 rating is just sad.

Amazing location easy to get off and the interstate. Jaime is an amazing Physical Therapist. I have been to many physical therapy clinics this is the first one that I feel finally knows what I need to do to get back to my normal life and activities.

Had lunch at the eagle location today, and I was very pleased I had the riblets knowing that they are usualy pretty salty so i will skip them next time. How ever there appertizer sampler was awesome there sliders where excellent and the won ton tacos are the bomb. My wife had the club sandwich which she really enjoyed server was quick and attentive. Definitly want to go back and get some more of those sliders and wont ton tacos.

I'm kind of surprised that no one has left a review for this repair shop. 

Before we moved, my husband would take his car there whenever we needed something done and they were always honest with us. It was almost shocking since we were used to being ripped off and told we needed a laundry list of things done to our car which were totally unnecessary. I really appreciate that this place isn't out to scam a buck like a lot of other shops. The owner seems like just an all-around nice guy too. He even drove my husband home when he had to leave the car at the shop. 

Bottom line: Great customer service, great price, great work. Highly recommended!

I've been coming here for probably 10 years. Shopped dozens and dozens of times. And honestly, I've never had a bad experience. They have a great selection, nice staff, and never had any issues. I really like this store.

Definitely not a place to go to celebrate an occasion.  The management must be extremely horrible just seeing how the staff treats it's customers.   We went to celebrate a birthday, only because this is were the 83 year old veteran wanted to go.  The staff should no signs of warmth or even common decency.  The food was tasty once it arrived, that's the only saving quality.

This was our first experience at Sunrise as we have only lived in Meridian for about a year. What a great hidden gem! We were promptly acknowledged when we arrived and once we ordered, our food came out fast. I ordered the Biscuits and Gravy and my husband had the Chorizo Benedict which were both delicious! Our server was very friendly and genuine and she kept our coffee mugs full. A great experience, all around. We will definitely be back to try the pumpkin pancakes with our daughter next time!

I don't know what the deal is with this place, but after 16 years of wearing corrective lenses then having LASIK (performed out of state) 14 years ago, I now need glasses for an astigmatism. I went to the ladies in the optical department to order frames and lenses. The frames came in a few weeks later with the wrong prescription, which I was told was the lab's fault. So lenses had to be reordered. 2nd time they came in a week and a half later, they are still wrong. Now it's been well over a month without the glasses I need and I'm having to take off work AGAIN to be seen by the doctor to fix my lenses for the 3rd time. In the 30 years I've been going to the eye doctor, I've never had such poor service. My husband has also had extremely poor service in the optical department. Super disappointed and we will be looking for a new eye doctor.

UPDATE: I went back to see the doctor to check the prescription and it was correct. What I found out that is incorrect, is the lenses. The doctor apologized profusely and told me the problem is human error - that the ladies in the optical department entered my prescription into the computer incorrectly FOR THE SECOND TIME! I may return for eye exams here but I will go elsewhere for lenses and frames. I do not recommend the optical department.
They did a great job! Quick and courteous and wore masks while inside. Will definitely use again.

Was a little unsure when I walked in to an empty restaurant at 6:30 Friday night. I ordered vegan Pho and spring rolls, both were so delicious! The young lady at the counter was very attentive and friendly. Can't wait to go back!!

I stopped by for a pedicure.  My polish wasn't completely covering my toes.  It's chunky and not smooth.  I've been completely ignored for the last 20 minutes.  The technician is sitting on her phone in a manicure chair ignoring me.  I had to ask to leave.
Orange Chicken and teriyaki chicken both delicious. The portions are huge we have dinner for two nights. Made breakfast with leftover rice just added eggs and fresh asparagus from my garden yum.
Friendly, helpful and good with communication. They carry quality products for a fair price and are customer oriented, family owned business.

Food is always excellent. Difficult to get seated at popular times. We either go early or late or sit in the bar. Honey Walnut Shrimp (or sub chicken) and sushi are our favorites. Sunrise Role was fantastic last week.
Dr. Kent is very thorough and explains everything very well. His support team is also very helpful.

Very professional staff, we trust their recommendations and have confidence in the excellent care we always receive. The entire team is extremely personable and friendly. We always feel very welcome and comfortable. Brandy and Julie are truly pros, their helpful advice and extra attention to our periodontal needs goes beyond customer service, more like "customer care".

This place is delicious! Always hits the spot when I need a quick, REAL meal! I haven't had anything I would not order over and over! My first service experience was fantastic, later service, still good but the bar was set pretty high by a fantastic young man who walked me through the entire menu, and finally helped my settle on the ninja chicken, grilled not fried! Still my favorite!

There was about 4 servers, 1 bartender and a manager on shift... we got there at 8.. we ordered drinks... that took 30 mins... a couple came in after us and they got their drinks first... okay no big deal... then ordered our food.. didn't get it until 9:20... my salmon was dry burnt... and it was super small.. no lemon wedge with it... came out on a huge plate with a little scoop of mashed potatoes...  not one person checked up on us or asked how things were... I had to leave the table and go to the bar and ask for more drinks for me and my friends.. at 9:45.. we were still waiting for our checks and boxes.. I asked 3 people for a box and a lemon wedge... I didn't get anything... I had to go up to the bar sit there and wait for someone to come out from the back... they were all just sitting there chit chatting... very very disappointed.. there was only 4 tables the whole time... couple of the staff went and sat inside booths just talking... didn't care or greet the 2 new table tops that walked in... it was a ridiculous shit show.. never again... ‍

I'm so bummed. The only good thing about this place is the ice. It's hit and miss with customer service. The guy that helped me today was so rude my son even asked what is wrong with him?! Not worth it anymore.

A friend took me here to eat. The first time, I felt very nice. Good food, good taste , good service. However, compared to the price, the portion of each dish is kind of high. Me and my husband and a 6 year old daughter  came another time, the bill including tips was over $70, but frankly, we didn't feel very full. The waitress was kind of rude too. I don't think I'm coming back to this restaurant because the service sucks and the food portion was inadequate.
I went here for the first time and got a Taro Milk Tea with Boba Pearls and it was amazing! Would go again :) everyone was very nice too and they have many options

Extremely disappointed with the results. I booked an appointment on 8/01, gel manicure and gel pedicure. I paid $130.00 for this service. The polish began bubbling right after the service. The color is uneven. The results do not appear professional, especially for $130.00. There are many grooves in the polish, very disappointing.

Love love their Coconut Milk Tea w/boba. Very cute place, staff super friendly. Prices are great. My daughter loves their blended Taro w/boba. I didn't think it would taste good but it was and the purple color is just beautiful. Great job Urban Fox!!!

This restaurant is so good! We got the trough burritos and they were amazing. The staff was nice and there was no wait. This place looked really popular as there were many people dining in, which made us confident in our choice to eat here. We will be back soon!

After two visits I'm just not a fan. This last visit was with a gift certificate (kind of - Sweet Deals $50 gift certificate for $25). I'm always up for a good bloody mary so I ordered the sloppy hog - their version of a bloody mary. I asked for the spicy version. I'm not a fan of their homemade bloody mary mix. It's chunky. I think there were bits of bacon in it. But I'm not sure. I just know that there were more sips than not that were so off-putting because of unexpected bits of something. 
The first time we were there I tried the Prime Steak Sandwich with sweet potato tots. Loved the tots. The sandwich was good but there was way too much fat. Unfortunately I felt like I was spitting out inedible fat with every bite.
This last visit they had Lobster Morney on the menu. I ordered that and the waitress let me know the lobster was served cold. When I changed my order she said she'd had a lot of complaints because the cold lobster so I was letting people know. How about letting the cooks and management know??
So I got the Baja Scramble with house fries and a fruit cup. The egg scramble was fine. Honestly it was a big mix of a lot of flavors. Nothing great. The potatoes took up more than half of the huge plate = ALOT of potatoes.
The home fries were great for the first few bites. And then there were a lot of very burnt bits and then undercooked slices. Some had a lot of seasoning and some that had none. The fresh fruit bowl was very good and flavorful. 
Hubby got Chicken Fried Steak. He said it was fine. He also got the home fries and his portion was a bit smaller but the same issues as mine.
They have some cool big drinks that would be fun with friends, but I'm just not impressed with the food. Maybe after a couple of their big drinks I'd check out the appetizers. Seems like they have a good happy hour menu.

Great selection of cases and other phone accessories. I have been in a couple times and the employees always take care of me.
