When I upgraded from my older iPhone and went to get tempered glass I was excited to see that there was a new option that covers more of my screen so It gives a little more peace of mind but also includes an extended protection. I told them the new phones are expensive and the employees understood and gave good suggestions on protective cases. I will definitely return to Tricked Out for my next upgrade! 

Pros: Selection of cases, good customer service, protective cases, awesome warranties, repairs done same day.

Cons: Can be expensive, older phone models are phasing out,

Been here a couple of times since moving here.  I come from an area with a lot of Vietnamese restaurants and this one was pretty good. Tried the brisket pho and two types of bahn mi.  All delicious.  I will be back.

went on a triple date last night with some friends here and they suggested this place. it was very obscure on the internet and I couldn't find anything about their collaboration with sushi shack. so i'll make sure to give you the info! 

upstairs is a lounge with a full bar and tables. downstairs is the basement with a huge wrap around bar and lots of tables and a big TV. it's more of a pub vibe down there. it's in a basement. upstairs is more of a classy bar vibe. we chose downstairs because they had a big glass and wood table big enough for all of us. you can still order cocktails downstairs, they just have to go up and get them.

hop haus has a small bar food menu, and sushi shack has a full menu with lots of appetizers, rolls, and poke bowls. we were told some of the apps on the menu weren't available (maybe print a new menu then?), and the entrees were all unavailable. this included some yummy sounding sandwiches. it makes no sense to me to not just remove them from the menu and reprint, but whatever. I wanted sushi anyway.

I ordered the sassy roll and the california roll. unbelievably fresh and delicious. I was not expecting it to be that great to be honest. I was wrong. we also had the edamame with sweet chili sauce. everything was delicious. I was impressed. my friends rolls looked great as well. we were all happy! the atmosphere was pretty hip down there and a lot of young people as the night went on. i'm 34, so i'm not some old lady- just I would say the average age down there at 7:30 on a saturday was 25. maybe the lounge is different, I don't know. 

I really enjoyed the sushi and my husband loved the extensive beer menu with lots of local brews on it. we left full and happy. looking forward to coming back.

Not the best set I have received, the shape of my nails did not match, I didn't get the color I asked for and I was told and paid the amount I was told and was called after I had walked out of the door and one of the employees shouted at me to pay another 10$ I was not aware of. The employees were very kind and the establishment was beautiful, however I would not return.

I've since been here several times since my first review. I have come to really like the pizza here and I suppose the pizza prices are in line. They are a thin pizza though although excellent crust texture and taste.

This review is for the Fairview location.  I placed a door dash order for my dad several days before father's day to have breakfast delivered to him.  My order was for 8:30am.  And 8:30 I got a text from my dasher saying she was there and waiting but it was busy and should be a bit (totally fine) at 9:15 she is still there waiting and she says she was informed that the order was being canceled because the cafe had decided they no longer want to do DoorDash because they're too busy.  So not only did my dasher have to wait 45 minutes for nothing!  My dad didn't get his father's day breakfast.  For me the most infuriating part of this I tried calling and spoke to the hostess, I asked her what was going on and she confirmed that they were in fact turning off orders.  I asked to speak to the manager, I could hear the hostess tell the manager what was going on and I HEARD the manager say "tell her I'm too busy to deal with this" the absolutely unprofessional "manager" refused to speak with me.  I get it's a busy day, but to completely refuse to speak to a customer is so rude.  My parents go often so obviously now won't be back.  What a disappointing and unprofessional experience!

Just have to say that this place is good! 
Upon walking in the front door I was greeted by a very nice young lady whom promptly seated me and my husband.
The decor reminded me of a small little villa in italy. The music volume was nice.(not to loud)
We decided on the family style meal, Shrimp fettucinne and chicken marsala which also come with a small personal size pizza. However our server mentioned that we could upgrade the size of the pizza. YAY!! Leftovers.
Got to say food was great, plentiful and priced right.
We will be back.

The food was fine and the servers were pleasant, but...they need more help. The now hiring sign was a dead giveaway. We finally left without a printed receipt. I hate the new checkout system. I do prefer a paper receipt, but who ever was to deliver it was busy "chatting" with two ladies at the bar. Will not go back.

Really efficient and effective! I really thought I was going to have to start cohabiting with the sugar ants, but Envi proved me wrong. Scott was who serviced my house. He was professional and friendly. I really appreciated all they've done. Thank you!
Modern, friendly, excellent choices of tea and coffee! Great people, quality products!
Skipper has been coming here for 10 years. Jay and his team are the best. Skipper won't go anywhere else

I had hesitation about using this place since it's inside a home. But the home is setup like a business and the lobby is closed off to the rest of the house. The owners were knowledgeable and eager to help me. Prices are reasonable and they have a quick same-day turnaround, if needed. I highly recommend using this business.

The now-husband and I asked Leif to take our engagement and wedding photos after seeing him work his magic at multiple weddings of our friends! Leif is such a pro and really listened to our ideas but also had even better ideas of his own for where we should go/ what shots would look amazing (because seriously.. I don't know!!) We were able to do multiple outfits and locations for the engagement session and Leif perfectly captured sweet natural moments of us that I LOVE! I don't feel that I am that photogenic and can also be a little shy, but Leif had such a perfect way of directing us that didn't feel awkward or forced- it was so fun!! 

Our wedding day was just as amazing! Leif came early to multiple locations to get special pics of everyone getting ready, got individual shots of each bridesmaid and groomsmen (you're welcome, wedding party) had the patience of a saint through the various required family photos, captured the perfect sneaky shots of guests during the ceremony AND the reception (Like Gramps starting the conga line!) Seriously I felt like Leif was my eyes the whole night- since especially as the bride I hardly remember getting to speak to anyone for more than 5 minutes. Looking back on these pictures is the perfect memory of our special day!

ALLLLL of this awesomeness and we were just so impressed by the value. As a youngish couple we wanted to be respectful of our wedding budget and Leif was right on board with us as far as finances, what we wanted to spend, and what things we felt we could do without. There was never a feeling of pushiness or awkwardness the whole time with a.n.y.t.h.i.n.g. You are not going to find a nicer guy with better skills - MONEY WELL SPENT PEOPLE- Leif is the package deal!

First rate!  Class act!  The staff are always so friendly, the place is super clean, now if we can just work on their prices.  Dental work should not cause one to take out a mortgage loan.  

It's the same everywhere, except Mexico!!  LOL!
Some of the absolute best food and service I have ever had. The staff is so friendly and informative. The food tastes as good as it looks.

Dr. Eaton and the Staff of Bluecreek Endontics are FANTASTIC!!!  After receiving the bad news from my dentist that I needed a root canal I was referred to a couple endontists.  After careful research I chose Dr. Eaton with Bluecreek.  I was very pleased with my treatment and experience (after all, who wants a root canal?)  The office was warm and comfortable, the equipment  state of the art, and staff friendly and caring.  Dr. Eaton was very pleasant taking the time to carefully answer all of my questions and explaining the treatment options thoroughly.  The root canal was performed quickly and was much easier and less painful than expected.  Afterwards, Dr. Eaton provided me with his cell phone number in the event there were any problems when the office was closed.  He even called me a couple days later when he was at his kid's practice to personally make sure I was OK.  I have received calls from doctors offices in the past (from staff), but was totally impressed to receive a call from the doctor (during his family time) to see if I was OK.  Dr. Eaton is top drawer and is highly recommended!
Illene was so fun! She explained the wines, flavors and gave samples. She has a great store and so eager to educate!!!

Nice place to hang out with friends. We came here twice on the weekends to have meetings. They have a high long table that fits 8-10 people. They also have corner tables that can fit 8 people. The drinks are not so sweet...my preference. The boba is kinda sweet for my taste, but it's good balance. Lighting is good, modern design, and clean. Wish they sell more pastries that can go with the coffee or milk tea.
Fantastic product and service.  Lots of choices, but they really made an effort to personalize my visit.  Don't miss this gem in Meridian!!!

It's as though this company applies plain water instead of a weed and feed formula, and I am paying a ton of money to them to take care of my lawn all summer.  Each time they come and service my yard, I get a bill for over $100. This is supposed to take care of fertilizing and preventing weeds on my lawn as well as spraying my shrubs and trees. After paying them over $300 for three applications so far this summer, I would expect better results. When I called and talked to them about it, and they said they would not do anything for me because I didn't buy "the full program", Which works out to be well over $500. My neighbors who have been dissatisfied with Senske as well recommend Summer Lawns.  Please don't waste any money on Senske services.

Took my son here for his 23rd birthday. I had biscuit French toast. It was so good. My son had bacon bacon burger. It had a bacon sauce on it that my son loved. He's been back since. Every time I go it is packed. I am excited they're building one close to me on Linder by the Linder/Chinden WinCo.
The girls at the front suck at their job especially the one with purple hair...the worst service. They also don't wear masks at all.

An old Diana Ross song starts with lyric of one lover singing to another "OH NO, don't go...".  I offer that lyric with a bit different take as advice for this restaurant.  Smack-dab-in-the-middle-of-lunch-hour at this Meridian strip mall located fast-casual Vietnamese food eatery and the place was empty when we entered but for one guy at a window table, at a time when other area restaurants were crowded with diners.  We found there is a good reason for the low diner interest.  It is very bad food. 

In Henny Youngman fashion, "How bad was it?", I hear you ask.  Here's the answer.  

THE EATS:  The green curry chicken with rice my husband ordered was a mucous textured gloppy mess.  The mushy chicken looked as if it came out of a can and the dish was the sort of color that might be so if a cat regurgitated semi-digested grass.  On top of that, it had zero SE Asian curry flavor.  It was literally one and done for a single bite.  It was absolutely, completely inedible.

Being flexible types of smaller appetites and not wanting to have to walk back to the counter to find the nice girl who took our order to start with, we decided to share my order of bun cha (aka bun thit nuong). 

Or what was supposed to be bun cha, which when made correctly is one of my favorite Vietnamese dishes of cool vermicelli rice noodle salad served in  bowl as was this and usually with fresh SE Asian herbs and greens, shredded veg (almost ways carrot plus often daikon), thin sliced marinated and grilled pork and a dipping sauce alongside and dipping sauce that is sweet-meets-fish-sauce salty and sometimes spicy too with the addition of chiles.

In the mode of nothing is hopeless, they got the dipping sauce almost right (absent the spicy which I added from on table chili paste).  But the rice noodles in the bowl were steaming hot, the pork was cut too large and in a small portion of which at least 30% was inedible gristle, there were prepackaged 'mini-baton cut' carrots in the bowl along with spears of supermarket variety cucumber and the only herbs were a half dozen sprigs of wilted cilantro.   It was not a good dish but it was at least edible.  But even for two people sharing one dish - remember the other was completely inedible -  we had no interest to finish it. 

THE DAMAGE:  We walked out $18 poorer for two dishes of food, one of which we left behind in total and I imagine they could puree to repurpose for wallpaper paste.

THE SERVICE DRILL:  Order at the counter from menu board overhead and they walk it to your table when ready.  I've read dings here for poor service but the girl behind the counter who took our order, who I think was the only employee in the place besides the cook as she also delivered our food and was wiping up tables with a spray cleaner, was pleasant.  I'd be unpleasantly depressed working there were I she.  Employers galore have umpteen jobs needing filling these days.  I wanted to ask if I could help her brush up her resume to get the heck out of there.

THE VIBE:  Sort of cafeteria style with skinny black tables and chairs set on the dirty tile (?) floor that looked as if it may not have been cleaned since they opened 9 months ago.  Windows (that also needed cleaning) on two sides made it light but also contributed to a stuffy, hot ambiance as sun beat through one side.  In fact, so hot inside on a mid-January day that it made me wish I was wearing late-July attire.  Lionel Ritchie in the days of "Stuck on You" and Maria Carey in her "One Fine Day" era were the kind of music on the sound system.  Although their grand opening was 9 months ago, the announcement banner still hangs out front.

THE BOTTOM LINE:  I should have paid attention in advance to others who previously left low reviews here.  They are deserved.  As we were leaving, now the only people in the place, four women were coming in to try it for the first time. I was tempted to throw myself between them and the order counter and warn them to run.

THIS N THAT to know if you decide to go...besides "OH NO, don't":

1) PARKING:  Ample amount in strip mall lot.

2) ACCESSIBILITY:  Accessible (AKA ADA) parking in lot. Level in the door and all on one floor.  Table seating is standard height.  Ample clear floor space.  The loo(s) are accessible too. (Although my husband tells me the gents was needing a cleaning.)

3) ALTERNATES:   For good Vietnamese fare, drive to Pho Bac or 208 Pho, both in Boise.
Not great quality, 22$ for mandarin chicken, and side order of teriyaki chicken, order of teriyaki chicken was about 2 table spoons worth

John is fantastic! I called Gem State Generators about my Onan RV generator. It would not start even after trying the usual tricks to get it running. John told me on the phone that he new what was probably wrong and would be happy to come take a look and we scheduled a date within a  few days on my call. 
I called him the day before our appointment to confirm and he had me on the schedule. 

He came to my location and resolved the issue within  5 minutes. He told me what it would cost to do the work and had it running within 30 minutes. He also gave some tips to keep in running properly. John is really good and has 30 plus years servicing generators. He is quick, thorough, fair and, in my opinion, a true professional and expert with generators. I would recommend him for any RV related generator issue and will call him again when required to service my Onan genset.

I was searching for a new place to get my gel nails that would LAST.  Several friends recommended LINDA at Q jails.  I have not been disappointed! She has a real talent and is genuinely kind and caring. First time in a long time my Nails have stayed nicely for weeks!  Call LINDA today.. She books quickly because she's so good.  But has always managed to "work me in".  She'll do the same for you.  Sue M. In Meridian Idaho.. Not LA

We stayed here this past weekend while visiting some relatives in town. We could not have chosen a better place to stay. This hotel was very clean and quiet during our stay. Great rates, the pool and jacuzzi were a added perk. All around a great place to book for a stay.

Well we tried this place twice. Food is OK nothing special, seems it can't decide if it wants to be Asian or American. Service was good, large doors were open and flies were annoying, spoke with the manager who advised us " wait a few weks and they will all be dead". What an attitude! Took friends and atmosphere was so loud, the background music was blasting away, maybe to scare the flies, we felt like we were in some sort of college bar, Really not a special place, probably wont be back, certainly not till "the flies die" !

Review for resale experience only:

Recently took an absurd amount of baby/toddler stuff here to resell. I've had mixed experiences with these kinds of places but this place seemed pretty legit.

They are extremely organized, which is a good start. You drop off your goods, they tag them & tell you when to expect a call. I received a text the next day (they were closed). They let me come in and see what they had taken and decide if I wanted to accept the offer or not. They also offer to donate anything they don't take to The ARC.

I feel I was well compensated for my items. I chose cash vs store credit.

They took mostly my toddler items and some new toys I had. They told me they don't take baby Onesies since they never sell them and are also very picky with baby clothes in general as they rarely sell them either :/

This place is nice. I really like their cold brew. It's unlike any cold brew I've ever had. There's so much seating inside and outside. It's nice to get a coffee and sit outside by the fountain. The service is great too.

The perfect spot for casual drinks and a bite! We have been going here since we moved to town in the winter and it's our go to spot. They have a little bit of everything with sushi and upscale cocktails upstairs, and a massive beer list and bites downstairs and the best part is that all of it is available whether you sit upstairs or downstairs! I also have to give kudos to the management- when we first started coming it was a little iffy on the customer service but it has improved SO much! Every server and bartender we've had in the last few months has been excellent. I would imagine this has something to do with Covid letting up and staffing being less of a stress for some restaurants. 10/10 recommend!

Majestic serves its purpose to watch a new movie on a big screen, but that's basically it.

It's very old, the employees seem sad to work there and honestly I hate that they don't butter your popcorn - sure having the power to add butter is cool but self serve butter is useless considering you can only get the top :/

For a matinee with the Hubby or taking kids to a theater this place is fine, for a date movie I'll continue to go elsewhere

We came back for a second time. So I give the place a 4-star adhesion because the food and drink were sooooooooooo good and very worth the price. The quality of the meats was ridiculous and we ate so much. My only complaint is that When we were seated we didn't have a waiter or waitress acknowledge us for a good amount of time. I would like to blame in on where we were seared, kind of tucked in the corner but there was a table behind us that was very much more tucked and they were taken care of very well. It wasn't until, who I assume, the manager walked by and noticed that we have been sitting patiently for even just water. He took very good care of us, got us our drinks, bread and plates. 
When the guys were coming around to offer us the different meats they seemed... well I don't want to say rude but they were... off. I thought that they were just like that until I saw them interact with other tables and they were joking around and being very interactive with the tables. It was very strange. It wasn't until it was time for dessert that our actual waiter came to our table, didn't introduce himself or anything. 
I did get the flan for dessert and it was soooo good. For drinks I got the Sammy's Mojito Royale and a coke. The mojito was the best I have ever had and, very strangely, the coke tasted really really good compared to most restaurants. The final small thing that was I little odd was that they offer still water and sparkling and we asked for still which came in a bottle. Nothing wrong with that but little did we know that each bottle was 7.50 each. No one told us that but that's OK. 

We will be back, don't you worry.

I had not stayed at one of these new Hilton Brand hotels before this weekend. I had my family of 5 kids and my wife. We had a double twin and single king adjoining rooms. Setup was great but a little snug for this big of a family. My wife and I plan to use this brand in the future for whenever we are on the road solo or with a small group. Big tv's, nice shower and great common areas downstairs with oversized games like Jenga and Connect 4. All in we had a blast and the service and cleaning crew were on point.
Excellent food and the best service last night for my friend's Birthday Chicken Lettuce Rolls were perfect as always !

food is a very good if you like that gangster pasta and garlic bread no problem with your family and friends sundays are a lot of fun and i am going to be a little more than honest owner is a very good guy and has a little bit of hard time with good help and hope that he will. no problem flawlessly with a lot more than you can eat and needs a hard workers who are up for a challenge. family food 1

On 4/12/21, KM and I went to Ling & Louie's for the second time and had an outstanding dinner. We got there during Happy Hour, so all of our appetizers were reduced prices. We ordered:

Chicken Lettuce Wraps ($6) - Water chestnuts, onions, lemon grass, Thai Basil, cilantro. I've only ever had chicken lettuce wraps once before and that was at PF Chang's. I thought these were good.

Pan-Seared Potstickers ($6) - Served with seasoned dipping sauce. I don't normally order potstickers. These look beautiful and we're good quality but it was the least interesting menu item for both of us. We would not order them again.

Korean Cauliflower ($6) - Roasted cauliflower, Korean glaze, gochujang aioli. This was a knockout dish. It was our favorite appetizer. 

Crispy Crab Wontons ($6) - Served with sweet chili dipping sauce. I don't normally order crab wontons but I could tell that these had real crab. Crab with melted cream cheese isn't really my thing, but if this is an item you like, I would recommend trying it here.

General Ling's Chicken ($16) - Crispy chicken, green onions, red bell peppers, carrots, Thai Basil, sweet and spicy soy. I expected this dish to be a bit more like General Tso's chicken. It's completely different and less spicy than I had expected, but it was my favorite of the two entrées. I would order it again.

Honey Walnut Shrimp ($18) - Crispy shrimp, broccoli, mushrooms, candied walnuts, honey sauce. I don't care for sweet entrées, so this isn't the kind of dish I would normally order. It's only the second time I've ever had it. I thought it was good though.

Uncle Fu's Fried Rice -Combo ($15) - Chopped vegetables, scrambled egg, secret sauce with chicken, shrimp, pork tenderloin and flat iron steak. We would have ordered the pork fried rice but we were told the pork had a sweet flavor. The combo version of this dish was good but the meat had been marinated and was a tad on the salty side for me. Next time I'll try it with just the pork.

Banana Caramel Spring Roll ($9) - Banana cheesecake, fresh strawberries, banana mascarpone, vanilla bean ice cream. This is a great dessert and perfect for sharing.

Ling & Louie's is not a traditional Chinese restaurant, but it knocks most of the competition out of the water. In addition to great food, we received excellent service and the ambience was lovely.

If you need any more incentive to try this restaurant, they now serve brunch on the weekends and children ages 12 and under eat free on Sundays.

Other appetizers that our
server highly recommended but we did not order are:
Crispy Calamari
Pineapple-Chili Shrimp 
Asian Nachos

Highly Recommended!!!

I give three stars for the service, nice people, warm environment. The drinks were ridiculously sweet. Want any tea with your sugar? I had asked for a 50% sweet and I still could not taste the tea. The boba was hard, not cooked enough. Not soft little pillows in your mouth. Just hard tapioca balls with super duper sweet drink, not even sure if it was tea. I had gotten the earl grey milk tea with boba. I don't recommend the drinks

I have taken my terrier in several times, and always been very pleased with the care, service, and cost.  I trust them, and consider them professional and knowledgeable.  My dog has been in for everything from ingesting toxic substances to "what is that lump?"  She required repeated visits for monitoring her blood levels several weeks for the poisons.  The vet was very thorough and conscientious.
I'll add that she had already been to our close-by local vet (can't get in, and no good for emergencies), and West Vet (the only one available on weekend nights) and when I got to Meridian they already had the records from the other two vets and had reviewed them. I was impressed by that.
They have really good Teriyaki Chicken and Teriyaki sauce! They steam their veggies at just the right temperature.

This review will be short because I only enjoyed one delicious beverage. But I will absolutely be back and can't wait to update!

I got a honeydew milk tea with popping strawberry boba during the COVID-19 quarantine. There was one worker and they set up their card swiper on a table in front of the counter so it forced you to maintain 6ft. My tea flavor was so good. The honeydew tasted like they blended up real honeydew for it. I was not a fan of the popping boba. Very flavorful but I guess I'd rather chew on my boba than have it burst in my mouth. I can't quite put my finger on it, but it sort of tasted fake. Like candy? But my sister had the same drink and loved it. So just preferences I guess? 

The employee wasn't wearing gloves which I didn't love but I guess I just have to trust that there was lots of handwashing. Very cute interior. Can't wait to meet friends here.

I have had their seafood pho and vegetable Udon. Both were excellent. I heartily recommend them. 
Jim Reynolds 
Eagle

Nobody likes to hear the words "you have to have a root canal." But if you do, please go to Dr. Eaton, he is amazing. Very caring and professional. He and his assistant, Shannon really took the best of care with me. I cannot say 1 bad thing about the whole experience and I don't give compliments easily.

First of all, Lauren L. was hands down the best server I've ever had! Friendly, knowledgeable about the store, the menu items, and so prompt with everything we ordered or asked for, incredibly attentive!  Then, the food! Just wow, truly amazing flavor!  We came for breakfast and I had the Tradish Benedict with the sweet potato tots (ask for them because they aren't on the menu) and  a huckleberry parfait, all of it was outstanding, my friends got the huckleberry biscuits, and the farmhouse, with the loaded fries covered in a sauce that will make your taste buds sing! My daughter got the loaded fries too and I don't remember the name of what else she got but it was the breakfast sandwich that had thick cut bacon (to die for) and eggs!  Of course we all tried each other's food and you can easily do that because the portion sizes were big!  The 3 of them also got 'the flight' of mimosas that allow you to choose and try a variety of up to 4 flavors, which they all got something a little different so I think they tried most of them and loved almost all of them! My daughter didn't care for the strawberry basil but Lauren L replaced it with the mango one for her and she loved it!  I highly recommend this place and so do my daughter and friends!  We will definitely be back with our hubbies!

Amazing bacon - it's like next level, crazy good. Wonderful service - our server was funny and engaging. I had the avocado toast with the addition of tomato and cheddar cheese, and home fries for the side. The avocado toast was ok - not the best I've had. But the home fries - WOW! The best fried potatoes in the valley. Really really flavorful, with some crispy bits of potato and onion. Yum!  My husband had the Idaho Pork Melt, and said it was ok - the pork got lost in all the other flavors going on in the sandwich. He had a house salad with raspberry vinaigrette and said it was fresh and delicious. He then proceeded to eat half of my home fries.

Tried out the lunch buffet (which seemed very good from the information online) it was horrible. Worst pizza buffet we've ever been too. There was maybe a total of 10 pizza SLICES total on the buffet and all slices were dry and disgusting. Salad bar was half empty and the (pasta bar)which was only one bowl of the driest and grossest pasta I've ever ate. Won't be returning and was a waste of lunch break and money.

Booked a room on Priceline with the dog filter. Got the email to confirm walked in the door with my dogs was asked to sign a piece of paper was never told about the pet fee of $30 per dog. Check my credit card statement and there's $63 in pet fees. I was never told when I called to find out what the fee was they told me to check their policy.  You would think that in today's day and age that people would be a little more forthcoming with fees

Awesome place.  Just exactly a place my wife and I want to hang out at.   Today we must have been transparent.  We sat at the bar.  The bartender poorer us 1 beer, never asked if we wanted food and left our glasses empty while talking to people that were obviously his friends.   It's rare that someone can feel ignored while sitting at a bar but we absolutely did.    Sad because it's such a cool place.

Seriously?! This hotel is slightly and I mean slightly better than a motel 6!! For $138 a night we were extremely disappointed!! Only 1 chair to use, bathroom amenities were terrible...squeeze soap containers?? After being gone all day, the beds were not made and the bathroom not cleaned...not even t.p. replaced. Very hard to believe this is a Hilton property. We will not return ever!! And actually are considering not using Hiltons again!! Marriotts will be our choice.

Great place with friendly service. The perfect overnight stop in the Boise area to get rested and to be on your way. Very comfortable bed for a great night's sleep. Plenty of great food options in the area. High-end shopping right across the street. An A+ stay.

Everything was delicious! Get your home fries hog style!!  Drinks looked great although we just got a beer. We will definitely be back! I'm from Georgia and I wish we had something like this back home!

This is probably my favorite asian food in Idaho. My son and I Both are addicted to the egg rolls and the ninja chicken. They have a food truck that we try to catch if we are out at the fair or any big event in Boise, and they also have a brick and mortar spot in the village in meridian when we are really craving the food! If ya haven't tried them out yet you'll enjoy the flavors and the awesome staff as well!
They totally understood what I needed and they were very efficient!!  I will go back for future alterations.

This is the third Brazilian Steakhouse I've been to , and it's the best so far. Texas de Brazil has a terrific salad bar, with LOTS of fresh veggie choices. The meats are wonderful. Our favorites were the lamb chops, flank steak and flatiron steak. Our son has nut allergies, so we had several questions about the desserts. Our server was patient and very helpful and got all of our questions answered. We thoroughly enjoyed our meal.
Great food!  This was my first job( and only job), in Mounrain Home, Idaho as a car hop.

As I like to travel about the country, trying new hotels is always fun. My place was a lot of fun. Now it looks to me as if it's setup for people who stay more than a few nights, as the room we stayed in had full-size appliances including refrigerator, stove, microwave, and all the other regular goodies like an ironing board and more. Everything was comfortable. Everything was clean. The staff was nice. I'd stay in these places again anytime. It's a good idea, and I hope this chain succeeds

All of the meats were INCREDIBLE!! They are so flavorful and you get a variety! I'd suggest not filling up too much at the salad/soup bar so you can enjoy as much meat as possible! While it was a little spendy, the food and drinks were delicious and I'd recommend trying this place out for a special occasion! Sierra was also a fantastic server!

Ling & Louie's is an American/Asian fusion food restaurant that i would say is sub-par. If you don't want to be near large families or kids go sit in the lounge by the bar, very nice seating. Our server was very nice and prompt, he recommended the 50 cent tacos on Tuesdays- they're pretty tasty for a good deal. Our food came out fast. My fiancé ordered the Evil Jungle Princess beef, I ordered the honey walnut chicken. Both dishes were poorly plated in my eyes. We payed extra for 'fried' rice. It was more like white rice mixed with vegetables, then they pile your entree on top so you can't tell. My honey walnut chicken was so-so. I don't think the flavor was very great or even matched the description of the dish. The only thing i have really enjoyed so far was the calamari, it's better than most places. Ling & Louie's is hit n miss for me, some things i enjoy and others i don't. Probably would not go back unless i had a gift card.

First going to say it was very good food. Huge portions, but VERY expensive not a place for retired people on a fixed income. That's the ONLY reason for the three stars. I would go again but can't afford it !
Wonderful people! Kind, caring, and took the most stress out of my wedding! Made my dress beautiful! Thank you guys so much!

At this point I wouldn't buy another Hubble home if they paid me!  If it's already a couple years old and the home owner has already fixed everything out of pocket and made the necessary improvements it's a great home but if your building from the ground up they are an absolute terrible low quality builder.   The quality is absolute crap and as soon as the one-year warranty is up everything starts breaking.  And the things that are wrong in the first year warranty you're told oh I'm sorry that the exterior hose attachments were not put together properly in your entire backyard is flooded every time you turn it on... that's not under our warranty...too bad fix it yourself. Also the extended two year and 10 year warranty's are an absolute joke they don't cover anything and they want to $250 just to file a claim that they are going to deny anyway.  Also the HOA is an absolute joke! I've spent 2.5 years fighting them and they do nothing for this neighborhood yet you pay a high HOA fee.  Buy at your own risk! Our home is absolutely beautiful and I love it but that's because I put so much into it on my own.   I know many of my neighbors in this neighborhood who have the same complaints and we have all had to replace multiple items in our home within the first two years that we should've never had to replace that soon.  Hubble claims their quality has improved through the years... It hasn't!

Best place for fairly priced fun stuff that you can't find anywhere else! You'll find things to redecorate your house with, things to eat and drink that you've never tried, fun gifts for every occasion, and so much more!
Terribly rude at the front desk!!!! No coffee pot in the room, hair all in the shower!!! There's too much to write , will NEVER come back here again!!! Yucky place
Me and my daughter always come in for half price appetizers which are Amazing. But the real is trace he is always helpful kind and attentive.

Food was typical americana.  I could tell it had been around for a while and I wanted so badly to love this place, but it was just middle of the road.  Prices were good and the people were awesome here.  I would go back, but only if it conveniences me, otherwise there are better choices at same price point even in the general area.

I work for an RV dealership, with skilled, certified technicians.  When they can't figure it out, we call John.  Hands-down the best generator technician in the Treasure Valley.

(As for someone complaining about his driving, let me say that this isn't the forum for it.  Go to Facebook or Twitter.  You've got no business crying on Yelp about how a person you've never done business with.  If I went to your work and complained about you for something not related to the business, that'd be pretty unprofessional).
Never had a bad experience there always friendly the eye doctor and pharmacist are awesome too

Such high hopes. Totally disappointed. Been here sitting at a table for over 30 mins. Have asked for food menu multiple times. Still no menu. Not crowded but feels like they're packed. It's because they literally have one server, poor girl. She says she can't find a menu. Not sure why. Whoever owns this place is loosing money big time. Friday night and no turn over.  No sales because no server. Just got my first beer only 40 mins after arrival. So...we'll drink our beer and get out for some food since we can't order without a menu. Don't go. Waste of time.

The food is good but not to the extent that it is worth eating here. My boyfriend had his credit card stolen the day after we ate here. They charge extra for everything, even if you want a to go cup, although you already paid for a drink. You can't substitute any meals with fried rice that has meat or shrimp in it without buying two meals. They can't just charge you extra to add meat. So, in summary the staff is not trustworthy and their silly extra charges and "company policies" are truly ridiculous, making for a very poor customer experience. Also, if you do choose to eat here, pay with cash.

There was a young lady by the name of Mary Ellen at Walmart in the garden center who was an amazing help in regards to working with us via phone as to a product that we were going to purchase and then decided not to and then called her back up who did not handle the situation and was able to secure it for us.

she so went above and beyond as it was a pretty confusing situation as my girlfriend was explain it to her and to be honest I was getting confuse so great job!!!!

Nice people and good drinks, but the service was SO unorganized. We saw two tables get up and leave before being served. I had the Brie bites - they were nothing special. My husband had corned beef and cabbage. The corned beef was very dry and the cabbage flavorless. My recommendation to the owners - go to Kahootz in Meridian on St Patty's Day to experience how corned beef and cabbage should be done.

I haven't even had my pre-op appointment yet, but wanted to give the West Idaho staff kudos.  I have been battling insurance issues -- which were eventually corrected -- but through months (!) of delays, rescheduling, phone calls and paperwork, Teri A. and Arian (sp?) have been amazingly patient, understanding, and kind!  I felt that they each were genuinely concerned about my case, and wanted to help.   They were waaaay more accommodating than I would have been!  Teri has also taken the time to explain the billing and other processes to me.  Never happened with any other doc's office!

In my initial consultation, I was very impressed with Dr. Daines and his knowledge, background/experience, and approach.  Practical, detailed, and gave terrific insight from different perspectives.  Asked great questions.  I also felt that I had time to ask all the questions I had.

Will update this once the surgery happens.

They rushed through getting my nails done, which I hate being rushed. Also their prices on the website are wrong they charge way more when u go in. Will never be back at this place and I will make sure non of my friends end up going here.

I am a big fan of Sunrise, some locations more than others. This one to me seemed to make smaller portions than the others. Perhaps the management at this one wants to cut back on food cost, and for the most part that's an ok thing-- helps us stay healthy-- but, I want a big omelet when I want a big omelet darn it, and theirs was way smaller (like 1/2 the size) than others. However, fast friendly service- the workers bust butt and all customer seem very happy to be there. The atmosphere is more country feeling.
This is a fabulous restaurant.... had California Roll for lunch and was very pleased with the freshness of the food!!  Will go there again and soon!!

We visited Margherita Pizza for lunch on MLK Day, Monday January 20, 2020. We arrived at noon and we were immediately welcomed and told to sit wherever we'd like. The menus that were brought to us were clean as was the restaurant. The friendly woman walked us through the menu and showed us the lunch specials. We ordered waters and one personal pizza and one of the lunch specials that consisted of a side salad and personal pizza. 

The super fresh salad arrived shortly after, it had sliced tomatoes, shaved parmesan cheese, and croutons over spring mix. Basic but delicious! I was very happy that I ordered it.

The pizzas were also brought to us in a timely manner. We shared the Supremo (Supreme) pizza and the Pollo All'Aglio (Garlic Chicken Pizza). Toppings were fresh, cheese was melted, outside crust was a great mixture of chewy and crunchy. The ONLY thing we wish was different would be for the bottom crust of our pizzas to be a bit more crispy. It was that close to being a perfect homemade pizza to us. Our favorite was the Garlic Chicken Pizza...super tasty! 

Overall, we had a great experience here and would definitely recommend everyone to go visit! We'll be back :)

Very rude and rushed through my mani/pedi. I have had many mani/pedis, but never has someone taken a Dremel tool to my cuticles! The lady made me bleed and 2 days later my skin was peeling at the nail beds. To top it off, the polish started to chip away the day after getting it done. I highly discourage anyone from choosing this place with so many others in the area to choose from.

Great location, very experienced seamstress, quick professional service, very reasonable pricing.  Perfect for small-medium seamstress work.

Not recommended for in-depth or difficult tailoring work due to language barrier.

Had a great dinner with a large party (family), 12 to be precise. Since we made reservations we had a private room all to ourselves. 

We started with appetizers - Lettuce Wraps, Asian Nachos, and calamari. We enjoyed all the appetizers. The filling for the wraps was delicious.

 I had the Drunkin w/ fried rice and water to drink. Others had sushi and a mix of the entrees. All were finished with gusto!

Several in the party had drinks from the bar and commented that they were flavorful.

We will surely return when we are back in the Boise area.

Met my cousin's daughter here while we were in town.  We had a delicious breakfast and a great visit.  Since we were talking, we stayed at the table much longer than usual.  The waitress never rushed us and kept filling our coffee cups.  This a very friendly place with great food.

I walked in for lunch one day and was treated like an infected alien for not wearing a mask upon entry, and this is after the mask recommendations had been lifted for over two weeks at this point. 

After asking four of the stunned employees what the problem was, one proceeded to ask if I had a mask. I responded no, and followed with the mask recommendations/mandates ended two weeks prior. Also, I'm a healthy individual who's already had Covid, overcame it naturally with my own immune system, and still possess antibodies, so I'm in no way shape or form a threat to virtually anyone. 

Even after all of this they still said I was required to wear a mask because it's a policy that their franchise owners instilled and they have no say in it. After realizing this, I thanked the employees knowing they have nothing to do with it, but were instructed to treat paying customers this way, and said no thank you, I'll take my business elsewhere. 

As I'm walking towards the door, one male employee offers to take my order outside in my car and bring it out to me. I understand he was trying to be nice, but please explain to me how being treated like an outcast or a diseased carrying contagious individual is any different from separating skin color? It's all black and white, mask and non-mask, vaccinated and non-vaccinated, etc. Explain to me why you're trying to segregate your own customers, which in turn causes you to lose customers, hence why most businesses stay clear of anything political or religion based because it decreases the amount of consumers that bring their business. If you try to tell me this is for safety measures or guidelines, it's not true because mask recommendations were lifted as I said, cases were drastically down, and I've already had the virus and still contain antibodies. So this is primarily a personal choice based on personal beliefs at this point. This has nothing to do with safety, guidelines, or mandates. 

I respectfully declined, reiterating to the young man how absurd it was that you won't take my contactless order inside, but you'll be willing to do it outside away from public view, like we're doing something illegal? No thanks, I'll take my business elsewhere. 

I've lived in SoCal, Dallas, Vegas, St. Louis, and now Idaho and I've NEVER in my life been treated in such a way. I used to go to jersey mikes and Jimmy John's frequently in all of those places, but as of that moment, I've been boycotting Jersey Mike's along with all of my friends and family who I've shared the story with and all think it's wrong, regardless of what your political/health stance is on the matter. I'd give this place zero stars if I could. 

I hope the owners read this review and think twice about forcing their customers to choose sides because you'll be losing out on a lot of business in a red state such as this. Especially in Meridian. Keep in mind, this is coming from a middle eastern ethnic male that has dealt with racial/ethnic oppression and slanders my entire life. Open your minds people.

Ling and Louie's was great! The service was great, food was excellent, prices were good (went during lunch and happy hour), and the environment was calm and quiet. I really enjoyed my experience there and will be going again, SOON! The only thing I think need improvement is the front host staff, we waited there for someone for probably a good three minutes before we were acknowledged. 
Food I ordered: 
Shrimp Tempura Roll- Excellent 
Mongolian Flatbread- Excellent 
Drunken from the Wok- Pretty Good
Thai Mai- Good

4-12-19:

We are very unhappy with your employee who left one of your flyers on our door. 

We have a prominent sign, with bright RED lettering, next to our front door that states:

STOP
NO SOLICITING
DO NOT LEAVE ANYTHING
on the PORCH, the DOOR, 
or ANYWHERE on
our Property!!!!!

NO ADVERTISING, NO CARDS, NO FLYERS,
NO BROCHURES...
NOTHING!!

We put this sign up because we travel frequently and, for the security of our home, DO NOT want anything left on/near our door that would advertise the fact that WE ARE NOT HOME!

Your employee disregarded the sign. Shame on you.

This is the second time this company has left a flyer, despite the sign we have posted. I spoke to Jamie, the employee who left the flyer (the employee's name and number was handwritten on the flyer). The employee told me that the boss, DAVE, tell his employees to leave a flyer at someone's home even if there's a NO SOLICITING sign posted. That's terrible. I would never use a company that completely disregards the wishes of a property owner. I left a message at the company's main number and received a call back from DAVE (owner?). He confirmed that, if there's a NO SOLICITING sign at a home, he tells his employees to leave a flyer, but just don't ring the door bell or knock on the door. Unbelievable.

I really tried to like this place as it is around the corner from me.. but the first time I came they dug in too deep into my cuticles so I'd move to warrant like hey that hurts.. but she kept on. My nails came out beautifully the first time. Second time in and I brought my daughters in and I never have let my girls get full sets and so as a reward as long as they were short I didn't mind, but the workers practically scolded me and made it feel like I was a bad mom for letting my daughters choose this option and of course it was followed by not speaking English and the only thing I could understand was full set with laughs in between and it just felt uncomfortable so I just told my daughter they didn't have any that fit her size nail so she didn't get too upset.. well she went with the gel and when she was done she was like mom the nail polish is all over my fingers and so I was like wow.. and of course again with the jabbing and going in too deep on my pedicure. When I said something she just laughed and started talking amongst the other workers and it was not worth $60 for that "deluxe" pedicure it was cut short as well. My oldest daughter is super quiet and said the lady was telling her yeah I'm not a real nail tech I'm not professional.. I didn't understand why she would even joke about that. To each their own I guess. But definitely won't be returning

I can't believe how this business screwed my 19 year old daughter when she got a gel pedicure recently. We were on Eagle Road & my daughter called & they told her to come in right now so I dropped her off at 2:00 pm & she was done at 2:25. It appears they had a bridal party of 7 women that came in SO I KNOW that is why they hurried & she didn't get a good pedicure. I recently received a 1.5 hour pedicure (NOT HERE!) with gel polish & it cost me $40. Envy Nails is a rip off!!! They charged $15 extra for gel polish, so for $55 my daughter received a 25 minute pedicure. Part of getting a good pedicure is the relaxation of being pampered & not rushed. Go somewhere else if you want to be pampered!!

Went here after jiffy lube wouldn't honor an oil change coupon and didn't bother to look up the oil capacity in my vehicle. 

Friendly, professional, free beverage and $5 off car wash.

This is a prejudiced review.  There! That said I can also tell you it's honest as all my reviews are. My number one requirement for eating out is this simple rule:  The food MUST be at least as good I as my wife or I can make for ourselves at home. Sound easy? Not so with the combination of the modern "Sysco Foods" eatery and the problem of aging taste buds (you lose up to 50% of your "buds" by the time you reach 50). "Sysco" they are the place where so many eating joints now look to buy already cooked meals in single serving fashion as to eliminate as much labor as a cafe/restaurant can and still manage to keep the doors open. Ever wonder why one of your favorite dishes taste and looks the same from one place to the next?  You can tell that Louis' does not participate as far as I can tell.  We've been ordering and making the huge sacrifice of driving down Fairview through it would seem, all the most jammed intersections in all Idaho to get to our favorite Italian restaurants on earth. (been going to Louis for damned near a half a century now).  We think by far the best eatins on earth is the "Louis Family Delux" pizza. My stomach just told me to go get another piece right now and hurry! I don't know his recipe but the combination of his home made crust, just right sauce and cheese but wait... where does he get those onions/mushrooms and green peppers at?? For the life of me I don't know how you can continuously get those standard provisions that taste OH so much better than anyplace else.  I'll tell ya... If it wasn't for that half hour drive on Fairview I'd weigh in at around 600lbs. PLUS.  Anyhow, try  the LFDP and see if you don't agree! BTW the other offerings are great too but I just can NOT get past that wonderful pizza.
Update, Update! After several unreturned phone calls from Dicks corporate office the developer put in a bicycle rack north of the store entrance. Thank you developer!

The theater itself is average. Seats are nice, theaters are on the smaller size, which isn't good or bad. What makes me give this 1-star review is the pricing and service. Bought 2 tickets for a matinee which were clearly priced at $7.50 each. Our total came out to $20.14. We didn't want to miss the start of the movie so brought it to management afterwards. Two different employees, one of whom I believe was the manager, couldn't figure out the discrepancy, saying it may be the new owners/system. In the 30 min they investigated, we watched person after person being considerably overcharged, 30% over the posted ticket cost. When the staff finally gave up trying to fix the problem, they gave us 2 free tickets and took my phone #, promising to call the next day. Of course, I've not heard anything since.

Pump it Up!  Gyms have gotten a bad rap over the years, whether it's the crazy and expensive membership fees, lack of good equipment, the type of people working out, there's any number of excuses to make anyone hate the gym.  Gold's is convenient which needs to play into your decision on where to work out. It's a pain in the arse to get to the gym, you're not going. There also needs to be a variety of machines to use so that one day you can do Cardio and the next isolate and work on a particular type of muscles.  Lastly, some gyms are shall we say, MEAT MARKETS. This has not been my experience but I have been to some of the gyms around the valley over the years and between the grossness of the sweat and lack of sanitizer to the amount of drool from guys looking at girls and versa versa, it was straight up uncomfortable. The hours are great and the staff are phenomenal. One feature that I loved was the Cardio Cinema, where a movie would play in the darkened room while you would be on a treadmill. What a way to watch a movie.  It's true the opposite of coach potato, more like activity eggplant.  For some unknown reason, it's not available, but if you are looking for ellipticals, treadmills, espresso bikes, stair masters, rowing machines, a ton more machines, Gold's has it. Lastly, they have awesome trainers who really know their stuff, like Damien H.

Just had the breakfast steak & eggs and it was the best breakfast steak I've had in a long time. The eggs were done just the way I like them and the hash browns were golden brown without being greasy. Our server made sure we had plenty of coffee and what we needed. The prices were fair. I will definitely return for more!

I originally was going to a physical therapist in Boise that my doctor referred me to. My coworker told me about this place and I refer everyone I know to them! I will never go anywhere else! It's locally run and they truly care about their patients! Jamie takes his time to evaluate your injury and the cause and effect. I came in with what I thought was a hip injury. Come to find out it was all stemming from my back. They took their time to teach me how to run again to take the pressure off my back. My hips no longer hurt and I feel so much better running. If you have been searching for a physical therapist, do not hesitate to call this place! Your body will thank you later and you surely will not regret it!
My new favorite place! It's alive you can feel the energy, you can feel the energy and man is it amazing! Food is amazing! Masks are optional! Best of all people are happy and living!

4 girls and my husband got pedicures and manicures. They were amazing! Best pedicures!! Beautiful manicures... once you go, you will know!! 
Thank you Hannah for the best Pedicure and manicures!

What a fantastic Yelp event put on by the CM, Amie! Thank you for including me. Everything served from the milk teas to the snow ice desserts to the turkey wrap with chocolate chip cookies was decadent in flavor, taste & presentation. I loved that the event was family-friendly as most Yelp events I attended out of state were not. In addition, I was given a frisbee, chapstick, bubbles for children & stickers all adorned with the Yelp logo. Thanks again for a wonderful event. I'll definitely be bringing the rest of the family here very soon.

Worst UPS store ever.  Highly unorganized, with and crap and boxes stacked every where.  It's a hazard.  Most unfriendly workers.  I always regret going to this one.  Not all UPS stores are created equal.  Terrible terrible service, with an unfriendly atmosphere.

I would have loved to been able to truly rate this place but unfortunately I was a ghost to the staff the second I was seated.   Can't miss me,  I'm a pretty tall guy.  When I walked in a server was contemplating buying some services a sales guy was pitching to them so she walked off with the guy and the whole time I sat there I watched a few waitress walk by me with a menu in front of me obviously looking to order.  After almost 10 minutes I had to walk over to Beef O Brady's to get a burger.   Ordered right away.   Juds is missing the key ingredient to a successful company,  customer service.

Awesome food, and Danielle was great. She kept us laughing and having a great time all night!

The Kung Pao tofu was tasty. And the lava cake was over the top.
Jeff was fabulous and was able to get me in no problem. If you are looking for someone to do your taxes look no further! Definitely will use again next year.
So glad this place exists! Authentic delicious boba and super friendly people. Soothing place to hang out in too.

If this was in our old area- it would a 3 but for Treasure Valley- it's a four only because it was the best Asian food we've found since moving here.  It's the only place we've tried that we'd go back to (and I can walk there from our apartment if I wanted to).  

Food was fresh.  I had the chicken and beef teriyaki combo with double fried rice.  Husband had the Katsu and teriyaki combo- also double fried rice.  

The beef was my husband's favorite (even if it was my food), but the chicken teriyaki was good too.  For quick takeout dinner- worth the money.

Horrible food, messed up order completely. We should have just gone with our gut feel and stuck with the soda's, love the ice. My son's order a regular cheeseburger and got a double quarter pounder bonus you say. We ordered two double quarter pounders we got regular burgers we were charged for what I ordered. They forgot the drinks and had to be reminded.

The food was just not good, the only fresh burger was my son's the other food looks as though they had sat a long time as cheese had gone solid again. Fries were all cold, we live above a minute from this Sonic so they did not sit long on my end.

Also the drive thru speaker is not working along with so,e of the pull in speakers. It will be a long time before we go back, except for soda.

So- ordered water in a cup- paid for it- YES!!!  Along with the kids' Italian Sodas and milks. When I got my order, the  manager, said, "In the future, Hon, we can't do water like that". 

I told her I specifically requested water with ice. That's all I drink, I don't drink plastic bottled water, yep, she replied, we won't be doing that for you in the future. 

Came for the street Tacos- YUM!  Kids wanted a different drink- so Village Coffee was a good option. But this will be my last purchase. If I want ICE WATER, and willing to pay, gimme a break. AND DO NOT CALL ME HON!  Seriously, rude!  It's very warm inside, and they do not make it welcoming that's for sure.

This place is unbelievable. I have not had better steak and eggs in years, SO very good. It must be  aged, not large but it's great for breakfast.  I can't eat runny whites & the eggs eere perfectly cooked. The homemade biscuits are  huge.  I can only say come and try it if you haven't -  it it is great.  My only complaint is I couldn't finish it. . .If I did I wouldn't be able to eat dinner at my daughters!!!

Difficult review!! I am a huge beer nerd and I love tap rooms. I have a Boise Brew Card, and decided to come check it out. First impression was awesome, very cute underground bar with a cool atmosphere. I went at a really slow time so there weren't many people and it was quiet. The bartender was great and very nice, he let us sample any beer we wanted and we talked a lot about different beers. My only complaint was that the beer was warm and tasted a little flat. I really am hoping they might have been having issues with temperature in the keg room etc or the lines because I will definitely be back to try it out again! I love beer but I also want it cold! It's hard to gauge your thoughts on a beer when it's not served as "its best self", haha. Hopefully it gets fixed!

The service was atrocious. I told them my order three times, and they still messed it up. I politely confronted them, and they told me they couldn't do anything, so they went and got the manager. Then the manager started giving me attitude, and insulted me as he reluctantly fixed the issue (which is only because I didn't back down). I couldn't believe that the manager was literally talking to a paying customer like that. The crazy part was that I wasn't even acting belligerent. I just thought they would fix the problem; I didn't even expect them to act that way at all. It was completely uncalled for. I was literally left speechless. Is this how Burger King trains their employees? Obviously, I definitely won't be eating there again. I hope this helps.
My roof was leaking during recent wet weather.  TVE sent an expert ASAP who repaired the roof.  Thanks!

Absolutely the best shipping center in the Boise Meridian Metropolitan area.  As a small business owner they have been super helpful in my success.  From shipping advice, to business cards and facing services, they are second to none.  Everyone from Ted, Andrea, Andrew, and Hannah have been extremely helpful.  They have longer hours than any other shipping facility in the area, and always great me with a smile.  I have tried other shipping services, and this UPS Store is the best, and has become the only one I use.

I experienced the Rice Works food truck at a concert last night.  I ordered the vegetable bowl, which was noted to have 2X the vegetables, and chef selected.  I'm sorry to report that it was just broccoli and cabbage over  rice, very disappointing since I was looking forward to some more colorful vegetables.  And, like other rice bowls, there was too much rice.  Not worth the high price at all.
Clean, friendly and one of the better Holiday Inn express  locations I have stayed at.  Plenty of restaurants and shopping nearby and easy drive from the airport.
Amazing! Super fast, great food, incredibly friendly staff! 10/10 will come again and probably make this a weekly stop on my way home from work!

I want to like Big Jud's, but.... Been here several times before. Always enjoyed the food, especially the French fries. Very yummy. But service has always been iffy. I was there for lunch. There were several employees that walked by and saw me but just ignored me. Not even saying "we'll be right with you". After about the 5th time I was greeted and seated. Drinks and ordering came quickly. Food was good but the fries were a little chilly. When I got my check I went to the register to pay. No one there but a bell to ring. After a couple rings someone came to take my money. 

Overall, not a bad place but does lack in service.

Fancy Sizzler.... the food was meh... it was just OK... service was good... waitress was really nice and so were the "gauchos"... atmosphere was good for Family Dining.. but not so much for an intimate evening ... it is wide open space with the tables pretty close together... for the $150 tab... (including wine and tip... but no dessert) ... there are much better places to spend an evening out
Amazing service, the family feel is absolutely adorable! The pizza and salad were great I will definitely be going back!
They're not wearing masks and not distancing. We've been there a few times and they were but I guess they've changed their mind. We will not be going back.

Heard about this place in an article.  It is a disservice to think of it as just a "pizza place".  They make quality gourmet pizza in a woodfired oven. Great service, nice people and talent for making traditional pizza with great ingredients.   You will be glad you tried this place.

Most importantly....my dog loved this place. He had a great time, wasn't stressed out, played great with the other dogs being groomed....and the haircut looked great. Will definitely be making another appointment soon

I've been trying to get a pizza here for so many days. I'm trying to support a small business owner on this Saturday. But your clothes on Saturday and Sunday? Saturday is a busy day why are you closed on that day? You are my favorite pizza here in Idaho but now I have to move on to somebody else because your consistency 
With being open and closed do not coincide with your yelp or Google accounts like you refer us to on your voicemail. I had called on the Monday Tuesday Wednesday nobody answered. I drove there the lights were out nobody was there. It's such a big disappointment.

After at least 15 years, they have "updated" their menu and taken out my favorite meal. The VEGGIE PLATTER!!! 
BRING IT BACK!!!  So rediculous to drop items from the menu. Won't come back until IT comes back

Ok I'll keep this short.
Prime rib a rip off. Small portions and the meat is coated in a horribly over salted coating. I mean DAMN salt is not the only seasoning on earth.
$80 dollar dinner for 2 come on
(No desert ordered)
Save time go to Goodwood for great service and delicious food. I took a chance here and got screwed big time!!

I visited Nail Envy for the first time today, and unfortunately I will not be returning. I was overdue for a mani/pedi since moving so I was really looking forward to some relaxing and pampering. Once I showed up, they took me right away. However as I sat in the pedicure chair, I had a gentleman standing at my side working on my nails, with me trying to balance a bowl of water in my lap to soak my other hand while the girl worked on my pedicure. It felt very rushed and not relaxing at all. I'm told at the counter that it's cash only which I didn't have so she pointed me to the ATM machine that they have. I put my card in but it wouldn't give me cash because the machine was empty. She then says that they will let me pay using my card. They do have a sign that says to make sure you are satisfied before leaving and no refunds. I have two open cuts on my cuticles and a just ok gel polish job. I left paying $65 for to sit their and not be able to relax or enjoy any part of the visit. There was no liners used the the pedicure bowl and now I'm treating the two cuts and hoping they don't become infected.

I think this is under new management.
We have gone to this place consistently throughout the last 5-6 years.  It's close to my work so it's was easy to drop off and pick up my pants in 2 days.  Previously- either to hem my pants or take the hem out for my husband's pants, it would be $10 per pant.  The owner for the past has been super efficient and I knew what to expect. I would come in, wear the pants, she would mark them to where the hem needed to be then would leave and pick it up in the next few days. For my husband's, she would take out the hem-about an inch, sew and press them.  
Yesterday my husband went to drop off 4 of his work pants.  There was a couple that was there, not the original lady.  They tried to charge him $14 a pants just to release the original hem! He negotiated it down to $11. 
It would be nice to have some standard pricing on the wall.

Had a great time trying Happy Teriyaki today. We sampled the gyoza, tempura prawns, spicy chicken Teriyaki, fried rice, beef yakisoba and teriyaki prawns. We also sampled three bubble teas, strawberry, peach and coffee. We also had a ton of food to take home and all of us left stuffed! The spicy chicken and gyoza were the table favorites. The teas were fun but very very sweet. Strawberry with rainbow jellies was the favorite. The service was amazing and attentive. We live miles away an we most definitely will come back. Fun experience, great service and food.

Edited to add this is the Meridian location on Overland. It's always great.

The Harp is near my office and so I watched the build out progress as I commuted for the past few months.  Frankly, the Boise area is short on good pubs, be they Irish, English, German, or good ol' American, so I was anxious to give They Harp a try.  I had to work a half Saturday a few  weeks back and decided to try this place out treat myself to a lunch and a couple of beers.  Overall they have done a good job of adding some personality and flow to space that has been a bit awkward from the beginning and never really worked in the past whether it has been a deli, pizza place, or something else.  Decent beer selection, but nothing all that unique in this age of even gas stations having 30 taps.  I was hoping they might have a few English beers too, but no such luck.  I made my way to the bar, got the attention of the bar tender (most staff were preoccupied with hanging and arranging beer/liquor brand decor the day I was there ) and ordered a Smithwick's.  She poured it promptly and asked if I would like some food. I ordered the lamb stew and pretzel bites with beer cheese.  The pretzel bites were pretty pedestrian.  Six small thumbnail sized pretzel nubs and a small ramekin of what I think was cheese whiz.  Taste, was alright overall, but nowhere close to the great pretzels you would get at some decent German pubs/restaurants.  Guess I should have known better.  The lamb stew arrived next and it, on the other hand, was really quite good.  Great flavor and high quality ingredients.  I found myself wanting more, and the was the problem.  Value-wise it just didn't measure up.  The stew cost $8.99 and was served in a small cup, not a bowl.  It was gone in maybe 10-12 spoonfulls.  I realize that my trip was just a few weeks after opening and that they probably have a few kinks to work out, so I'll be back.  My hope is that they find their balance that they enjoy a long and prosperous stay at this location.

I ordered food to go tonight for me and some friends. First off, the girl who answered seemed annoyed by taking a to go order. Secondly, she didn't know how to take a credit card over the phone?! She didn't even ask for a name or phone number for the order?! My friend got to my house with the food and the order was wrong!! I ordered Uncle Phu's fried rice, but got combo fried rice! How was that even mixed up? Lastly, the hostess told my friend that there were already chopsticks in the to go bag when she asked for some. Guess what? There was not! Also after looking online at the prices, I was over charged almost $15!! Unacceptable! Totally disappointing experience tonight! I have had previous positive experiences with this place, but this experience really put a bad taste in my mouth! Extremely poor customer service! It's hard to say if I will dine with Ling and Louie's again!

Horrible job. The clear gel or acrylic is crusted all over my nails, and, for some reason its super spotty. Many spots throughout. My nails looked better bare! 

Also, look at uneven the filing is, some nails wider than others. How can you screw up nails when no color is applied and only clear Gel on acrylic? I have this done all time, and they manage to fail here. Also, the woman Vin or Van need not lecture me on masks and covid, rude!!! I was wearing my mask and I asked why she wasn't wearing gloves for my pedicure and said she didn't need to that the mask was enough even though it kept falling down. The logic is missing! I won't be back!!!

This place is SO GOOD. We're from out of town and decided to stop by due to the good reviews. We were more than satisfied. The pizza was so crispy and so delicious. This is one of the best pizzas i've ever had and I'm so glad we stopped by. Definitely go here if you get the chance.

How have I not tried this pizza before? It's so close to where we live and DAMN is it delicious!! 

We ordered carry out during COVID19. The team took my payment over the phone, passed my boxed pizzas by scooting them across the counter and had hand sanitizer on the way out. 

We ordered 2 pizzas, a pepperoni and a veggie. The veggie was a nice assortment and not too packed full. The pepperoni was so good. It's clear that they source really good pepperoni. Tastes like it's sliced right off the link! The crust is thin with the sweet smokiness of a wood fire oven. The tomato sauce is deep and slightly sweet. We loved it!

We were very pleased with Mike and Ed and the work they did to install a new water softener for us.  They were professional and very comfortable to have in my home.  I was very impressed with how thorough they were both with the estimate and the work we hired them to do.  They took the time to explains things and show me how it all works.  Thanks guys!

Great new place to stay..   it's NOT your average Hilton as Tru is more community with a big working space much like s .com start up..  Food/Snacks ans drinks 24-7 (pay), pool table, board games, games, newspaper, magazines, USB and power every 4dr along the walls, free breakfast and much more. The patio has games and Lounge space as well. 

Indoor pool, gym  and multi Diamond member parking spots!  

The rooms? Nice with comfy beds, big'ol TV, plenty of power snd USB ports. They're a bit smaller vs your normal Hilton.  2 beds takes up 90% of the space.  Shelf with TV and phone.  Small fridge and no closet but some open space area and pegs to hang stuff up.  Bathroom is good size but no tub shower only.  Free liquid soap, wash and shampoo in shower and same at sink. 


Pros 
Inviting fun and tailed to the younger crowd
Smiling and friendly staff
Diamond member Parking
Simple and small rooms.
Big board of community info with daily updates and  notes, (where to eat, shop, etc). 


Cons
No room service or meal option 
No door personal
Breakfast is carby as no hot eggs, bacon/sausage or waffles yet (they said soon) .
 Not s place you and the family want to spend tons of time in the hotel room as they're about 25-30% smaller then average..

We've only been there once so far, but it was a great experience.  We went for breakfast/brunch during the week and sat down right away.  Service was good.  Food was excellent.  I had the brisket and it was one of the best we've ever had.  Very juicy.  We will be back for sure.

Got here around  10:30. It is 11:20 still only received our drinks! Our waitress has the worst attentive attitude and of you are pissed off at the world then don't come to work. Can not comment on food yet since we are still waiting! No refills on water and our mimosas were served warm! Will not be back!

So after an 1 hr and 20 mins the food finally came out and too bad bcuz it had great flavor. But I cannot ignore the absolutely horrible service. This brought this down from a respectable 3 stars to a 1 star. What really was shown that their is no leadership at this restaurant walking around to ensure of good service. The employees and not stereotyping but young people running this is not a great idea. I would agree with Michele R who also rated this place lower.  We are all trying to be patient with people not wanting to work but doesn't excuse rudeness and you actually have to try to be rude harder than you have to be friendly. So for me your welcome for my one time deposit and won't be back. Pretty sad bcuz if you know me I am a super loyal person to great local establishments....

The atmosphere and lighting is the best thing about this place. The food- Meh. Tucanos salad bar is far more impressive. The meat was just ok too. Everyone was professional and kind, however. 
It's far overpriced for what you're getting. $3 for an 8 oz. bottle of coke was the frosting on my 2  star review.

What a wonderful surprise this was! Urban Fox is a delightful place to get a huge variety of fun drinks including color changing lemonade, strawberry milk, and of course... coffeeeeeee. Think of it as a fancier Dutch Bros.

It's a beautifully zen place to chill with greenery decorated around the room and a colorful yet simple overall aesthetic. The staff here is absolutely lovely and cheery. I explained my excitement for the lemonade and the milk to a couple of the fine ladies that work here, and rather than staring at me like a crazy man baby, they were super sweet to me and shared my enthusiasm for their wonderful establishment. 

This is a seriously fun spot to drop and have a refreshing beverage. My date and I saw lots of lovely people getting their favorite drinks and have a mega chill sesh with their peeps. They have BOBA here too! I'm not that big of a fan, but for whatever reason BOBA is really popular! Hurray for popular things! 

"Why do I like boba?! Cuz everyone else seems to like it!!!Having opinions of my own?!?! No waaay!!!"

You're probably wondering "Do I really need a tax guy? I can use TurboTax."

Yeah, I thought the same thing.  And you probably CAN use TurboTax if your taxes are super basic.  But anything beyond basic and doing your own taxes becomes exponentially more complicated with questions that, if you don't know exactly what you're doing, could leave you with a pretty distressing tax bill to Uncle Sam.

I saved thousands (literally!) by putting my ego aside calling "Just Another Tax Preparer".  You can too.  Get your taxes done right and have a pro get you the return you deserve!

Staff is super friendly.
Food was fast and really amazing.
First time coming here and will definitely recommend to friends and fam!!

came back recently and had a GREAT service experience. I still don't know that I love the food as much as other choices, I seriously could almost just have the big bowl of miso and a salad of some type.

The kids loved their huge bento boxes.  This places gives kids a great great meal!

The food here is cheap and consistently good, unlike other Quik Wok locations in Boise, where the quality varies. This isn't gourmet, but it's fantastic for a good, filling lunch. I only wish they didn't use MSG.
