Just ok. All the hype surrounding this place I thought it would be better. We got seated quickly but sat so close to other tables I would have been annoyed preCOVID. The server was pleasant but we only saw her 2 times. No refills on coffee or water. Our food came in an appropriate amount of time. So much food and expensive I would have rather has half for half the price. We had the breakfast tacos, trough buritto and the chicken and biscuits. Lots of chipotle flavor. Its not my favorite but the others in our party liked it. The home fries were good. My chicken and biscuits was ok. The biscuits were soft and the gravy was tasty. We all took half of our order home. I probably wouldn't seek it out to go again but if we were in the area we may visit.

Honestly not
Impressed with the coffee... the atmosphere is pretty dead too. I say there for about an hour with my coffee and it was just not cozy or comfortable. It was fine. That's all i can say about it.

MUST TRY!! Saw the name and popped in for some lunch.. the lady there was very kind and helpful and made one of the best Italian style margherita pizza I've had so far. Base was just perfect! Will definitely pick a few pizzas for the time I'm here! Place was super tidy. They also serve wines and pastas..
Thanks Felicia for the great service!!!!  Food was great and she was very attentive to our needs!

Visited in September during a road trip. 
I had never stayed in a Tru by Hilton. Most of my business travel takes me to Hilton garden inns or the Hampton. I had some points and was able to get two rooms as it took fewer points compared to the Hampton and we could get breakfast included. 

The entrance is on the side of the highway, we initially went to the back and that door was locked unless you had a key.  The rooms were a bit sparse. They weren't uncomfortable, but it was very minimalistic Scandinavian kinda thing, and there were many outlets. I liked the sugar scrub soaps that smelled yummy. 
The pool was nice and we were fortunate to be able to schedule a time slot right away as you had to make an appointment. 
The next morning leaving they were having out "breakfast" and coffee from the front desk. It took some time to get through it with all of the people, but the staff were very friendly and apologetic for the wait as some people take FOREVER to put cream and sugar in their stuff because they don't know how to keep it moving and not inconvenience others, but I digress.
Overall, it was pleasant as most Hilton's are and I'd stay again if I'm in the area.

I just want to thank TVE and especially Schonie Lee for going out of her way to  do everything in her power to make sure my insurance would cover the cost of my new roof, which they did!
I had two other roof people come to look at my house, one guy never came back and the other never got in touch with my insurance.  Both of them said it looked like it was just an old roof and insurance probably would not cover it. 

AND THEN I MET SCHONIE from Treasure Valley Exteriors.... She spent more than an hour on my roof. She really knew her stuff, and she contacted our insurance for us!!  She also made sure she was here when the insurance adjuster came here to look at our roof. Even though other people told me insurance wouldn't cover the price of my roof, when Schonie did all that work, my insurance approved a new $19,000 roof within 3 days of being contacted by her. Also what made good even better..... was that it only took ONE day for them to put the roof on!  ONE DAY!!!!  My neighbors were astonished because some of their roofs took 3 days to install. 
Plus the crew that did our roof was amazing!!! They swept and blew off the property as well as going over it with a big magnet  To pick up any nails or staples they might have missed.
Thank you Treasure Valley Exteriors! Schonie Lee, and the awesome crew that did our roof!
Also It would be pretty nice if homeowners would offer the shade of a tree or the shade of their backyard for the people who work so hard on their roof.  I noticed that these guys put towels and blankets over their windows because that's where they take a break, in their hot car! Well I had An Ice chest full of water, some cookies and offered my patio for them to sit in the shade. I was told that never happens for them? So if you have a roof done just remember those people working in the blazing heat and at the very least have some water, and offer the shade of a tree and maybe buy them some popsicles or a snack, they deserve it!!!!

As far as the over all happiness I am with Treasure Valley Exteriors, I am as pleased as punch!!!!!! Thank you so much all of you for the hard work you did for me!!!

Don't let the 3 star rating fool you. I liked Ed's as a breakfast place, it just didn't have anything that wowed me or would make me say I need to go back. The pancakes were very good and my wife felt the omelette was very good as well. I had the chicken fried steak and it was NOT home made as I would have hoped. It was a processed/battered chicken fried steak of average size. If you are in that part of town and need to eat breakfast but don't want fast food then I would definitely suggest Ed's. The service was good and the prices were average. Note to parents: They did not have a kids menu so be prepared.

This is our new happy place. Everyone needs a happy place. Ours just has booze and giant pancakes. 

We visited Biscuit & Hogs on a Friday night around 7:30pm with a party of 6. We only had to wait a minute or two before we were sat. Some of the dining tables were round, which we loved! It gave us plenty of room plus we were able to see all of our friends and it was easy to talk to everyone. Much better than rectangle where you pretty much talk to the person on your left and right. However, it was absolutely freezing in there. Granted, I'm always cold...but it really was exceptionally cold. 

Let's talk about alcohol. I HATE when places price gauge on cocktails. It's always like a bajillion percent mark up. Not here. Not at Biscuit & Hog. Their every day prices are shocking. $3.49 for a mimosa...check! Gotta have one of those. But wait...$12 for a carafe of mimosa? Yes please!!!!! I'll change my order to that! But if that wasn't exciting enough, check out their happy hour where a ton of drinks are half off. Thank you Biscuit & Hog!

But then there is the food. Huge proportions, especially for the price. My hubby and I split the pancake breakfast and we still brought home leftovers. All our friends really enjoyed their food too. 

We can't wait to go back and try new cocktails and food. Next time, we're bringing the family!
Service was Excellent and Food was great especially Suchi  and lo mien.  Made reservations everything worked like clock work.

Ordered the general chicken and teriyaki chicken bento's, and my husband and I could not even eat them. They tasted frozen like they just pulled them from a freezer and drizzled thawed sauce. We had tried the bulgogi a few months back which was decent, but the chicken bentos are gross. Not worth 10 bucks.

I couldn't be happier with the service and just amazing overall experience we had here. Today was our first time going because unfortunately my dog he was having issues with her hip and our normal place wasn't able to get us in for a few days so this place came recommended and I couldn't be happier. They were able to get us in within the hour. The vet literally sat on the floor almost the entire visit with my little Chihuahua as she was super nervous. The vet was thorough, soft spoken with my dog and kind. She explained everything to me and didn't try to push any unnecessary testing or exams which I really appreciated. The whole staff was so sweet and we will definitely be back in the future!

$5.49 for the five piece chicken tenders. Four very sad brown things made it to the bag, with no sauce. Child size fries with the cheeseburger combo meal. Didn't even try the mints. I hope our $15 order goes to anything other than the marketing & advertising budget.

After going by this restaurant many times over the last year, we finally tried it last Sunday. We were absolutely delighted with food, service and the cleanliness of the facility. We sat in the bar and the bartender did a great job. Quick service, attentive and made great drinks. The best part was that there are so few good Asian restaurants in this area and the food here was great. Most reviewers seem to agree. The one or two that have said there is no flavor - they must have missing taste buds. The food is fresh, tasty and very flavorful. The Firecracker chicken tacos are excellent along with the Orange Peel Chicken and Firecracker Chicken. It blows away PF Changs in every way. Someone tried to compare to Panda! Not even close. If anyone is looking for good quality, freshly prepared, flavorful Asian grill food, you need to try this restaurant. Yes, you will pay a little more than other lousy Asian food places, but it is well worth it! We have gone back again and will keep going back as long as they continue with the great food and service (and drinks). There are so many other items on the menu we want to try. Can't wait to get back there.
Love this place! Definitely my go to place in Meridian for craft beer. Love the vibe. Love the music. They have cocktails and every beer you could want. Definitely come here! Cheers!

Went to CPWM yesterday, first in the morning, bought a bunch of things including a piece of furniture had a great experience with a very helpful staff member. Went back in the afternoon to buy a lot more furniture, expecting the same experience, was prepared  to spend a lot of money but instead walked out of the store with nothing  as I encountered two of the MOST lazy and rude staff members. It was nothing but attitude saying people who want to buy furniture should shop online...WHY have a store if they DON'T want customers?  Needless to say I did find another store and spent my money elsewhere. I do love CPWM but the difference between heaven and hell really are the people. Perhaps they need to train their staff to know that employees have a job to do for the company trying to sell products and it's not all about THEM! Get off your lazy butts and do the job you're being paid to do!

This feels like a family restaurant not a franchise. The staff here makes your entire experience a great one because of the environment they provide. From the hostess, servers and cooks who bring meat all are welcoming and kind. 

One thing that stood out to me was their salad bar. I felt like it has items to compliment your meal such as sauces, rice, fried jalapeños and gourmet cheeses. They also bring you mashed potatoes and fried bananas during your meal both phenomenal and a nice addition to the other sides.

Beyond this all the meat from the lamb, chicken and steak was cooked to perfection. We split a flan at the end and it was amazing. I will say it's a bit pricey compared to other resturants in the area but perfect for a date night.

We had a great breakfast and excellent service. Our server, Ana, provided the best service we have had in a long time. Our food arrived steaming hot in a timely manner even though the place was full (@ 50% due to Coronavirus restrictions) and a steady stream of to-go orders coming out of the kitchen. We will definitely recommend this restaurant.

I decided to try this place yesterday morning. Great experience and good food! This is a solid place for a good breakfast. The bacon wasn't all fatty like so many places, nor was it too crispy. The moment I walked in I was seated and got my cup of coffee, the staff is on top of things even though they seemed a bit busy. The food was about what you'd expect at a good restaurant that serves breakfast, my food all came as I ordered it and I had no problems whatsoever. My only critique is that my hash browns were a little more soggy than I prefer but that might just be preference. Maybe I'll become more of a regular customer because the price of my order was fair. Only reason I give 4 stars and not 5 is because of the too soft hash browns and also because I was not served with jelly to go with my toast other than those tiny disposable single use packets of Smuckers Jam. I would really recommend to this place to investing in some more variety and/or quality of jam. The food was good, this place was a great experience and my server Charity was great too, I look forward to coming back! I hope this place keeps it up, I'm hoping to bring my family if this place continues to serve good food with the excellent service I experienced on my first visit.

This sonic really is terrible. I don't think they have ever gotten our order correct. I guess I'm the sucker, because I come back. But it is so close and I'm lazy some days after work. It just is painful how wrong they get the order each time.

Food was good and so was our waiter. About half way through our meal, my 19 yr old son says to me "Uh Mom they are having sex on the tv behind you!" I turned around and sure enough...full on sexcapades happening!!! Couldn't find our waiter or anyone else for about 5+ minutes....during which the tv is still showing the sex scene. We had our 15 yr old son and our 2 yr old grandson! Definitely not appropriate for a "family friendly" restaurant!! The waiter and manager Desi were clearly embarrassed and the channel was changed. Desi stated that they are only suppose to have the TVs on to sports but clearly this is not enforced! We were offered to-go soft drinks and the manager gave us 2 to-go lava cakes. Mind you there were 5 adults and a child. No discount on our meal. Definitely won't come back here, especially with my kids!!

Excellent food. Excellent service. 11 out of 10 sunrises, would break the fast here again.

We showed up about 8AM on a Saturday and were seated right away. Our waitress was Peyton and she was the best!  She was kind, courteous, knowledgeable of the menu, and she kept the hot coffee top-offs coming (NICE!!). She was also very funny, which is not a requirement of good service, but we sure got a kick out of her.

We visited the Sunrise Cafe specifically to try the month-long St. Patrick's specials, the Guinness pancakes and the corned beef eggs benny. Leapin' leprechauns, my friends, these specials were off the chain. Huge fan.

We've never been to the Sunrise Cafe before. I hate that it took me stumbling across an ad on Facebook to get us here. My friends must be holding out on me, not wanting to give up their secret to one of the best hidden gems here in the Treasure Valley (hey, I get it, because getting seated right away on a Saturday morning was quite a delight). I'm looking forward to our next visit to the Sunrise Cafe to try all of their regular solid menu offerings!

The food is fabulous but lately not the wait staff. You should notice that we don't have utensils and you should remove the empty plates that sat at the table for 20 minutes. For 80 bucks for three customers, I expect more.

Called these bums for a quote and watched the estimator walk around confused in my living room for 15 minutes trying to use his high speed IPad program to measure a square room.  
I suggested a tape measure but he didn't know how to use one. Go figure. 
After that show I asked how long on the estimate? He said real soon. Well, three weeks later and no estimate.  Guess he can't use email either.  Maybe he's making too many trips to the Ontario weed shops.  I wouldn't let these 's measure my dog for a diaper.  
Cheers amigos!

If you're looking for breakfast, this is the place to come. Their breakfast menu is vast and plentiful, and the place is cozy.

I ordered the Simple breakfast that gives you three choices that are listed. I chose scrambled eggs, sausage and hash browns. Pretty simple, right?!

It was served hot and quickly. Service was attentive and excellent. Absolutely no complaints whatsoever.

Highly recommended.

Living in the Treasure Valley you hear about Ling & Louie's the moment you move into town. It took me almost three years to get here but I did, finally in the winter. We arrived and were shocked to see how many people were waiting, we made a reservation and waited about 40 minutes to be seated. The bar seemed to be packed with lots of couples on dates, it was cute! We sat at a large table and ordered and honestly it was DELICIOUS. I love that they had some gluten-free options and they tasted GOOD. It is a bit pricey, but worth the price. I would not recommend going during normal hours and I think if possible make a reservation!

I went for dinner for the first and last time at the new location in Eagle.  The most money spent for the worst food I have eaten in town.  Overpriced buffet.  The options were limited and dinner for 2 without drinks was $134.  I came in hungry and left disappointed.  I personally will not return.  You get a better tasting meal from any other low budget buffet in town - Seriously!

I LOVEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE this place! I've been working from home like everyone else, and saw Biscuit & Hogs pop up on Door dash a few times...The food looked great - but ordered it from Meridian to the North End seemed risky. 

I am so glad we decided to drive out there one night for dinner! It's freaking awesome. Warning: the staff might not be wearing masks, and maybe they aren't social distancing...but am I the ONLY person who welcomes the normalcy? I tend to find myself wanting to go back here because they AREN'T being strict A-holes about protocol. 

Anyways enough about covid. 

1) Their website/website menu is kind of false advertising I think. It seems so proper and clean and beautiful plates of food...Dude. You are in for HUGE plates of food, and ridiculously titled drinks. Like...cocktails out of a plastic yard flamingo, and bloody marry's out of what looks to be the size of a paint can. 

2) CHAMBONGS. yep. little glass champagne "beer bongs" for like $1.50. You HAVE TO ORDER ONE! ( or three ) 

3) whatever you choose of the menu (there's SO MUCH, but I suggest a scramble) ...order the side of pancake. ITS THE SIZE OF A FREAKING 12in PLATE! If you need to take home the leftover pancake, ( you will. ) they bring you a pizza box! HAHA.

This place gets it right! Our server has been Brenda both visits, and she is a badass who really gets customer service right! We literally can't stop telling people about this place! Can't wait to go back!
Last time staying here and I was going to suggest this place to family who will be visiting... I have changed my mind... They need new cleaning people.

The staff are excellent and friendly. Especially in times like these were you can't help but feel like the times are just bleak and hopeless.  The wait staff were bright and hopeful people who took it upon themselves to create a warm friendly atmosphere.

I was not so thrilled with what I ordered.  I tried to Turkey melt.  I was disappointed when I received what looked like one of two things: either canned turkey on a sandwich or my order got messed up and I was given the tuna melt instead.  Either way, I was disappointed.

Everyone else in my party seemed to enjoy their food.  So there is that.

Hopefully next time the food I order will be much better.

It's been on my radar to try this restaurant for awhile. So glad we finally made it in!

Atmosphere is that of a bar & grill with the addition of lots of nods to the restaurants mascot the hog.

We were greeted and seated immediately,  which I hear is not always the case. Not the lack of friendliness but the fact that there was a seat available right away.

In eyeballing others selections on the way to our table and seeing others photos on Yelp my hubby and I decided to share some menu items. We came for an early dinner and didn't want to leave uncomfortably stuffed.

We got the Carne asada fries as an app and the BLT con huevos for our entree. Opted for the salad as the side, since we already had a plate of fries. 

The app was devine.  I was worried it might be too cheesy, and the fries would get soggy but nope it was perfection. Portion was definitely a shareable size.

BLT was also very good. Good amount of all the fixings and the bacon was thick and full of flavor. We also really enjoyed the side salad.  It had fresh ingredients,  a mix of greens, and yummy bacon crumbles. Made us actually consider returning for a full size salad in the future.

I also chose to try a BYO mule. I picked the blackberry option, since those are in season right now. Yummy puree of blackberries I did find and topped with a plump juicy one to garnish the top. Drink was refreshing & mixed well. 

Our server was very attentive & friendly.  She gave us suggestions on the popular items, how much food to order and refills on our drinks.

We looked over the breakfast menu and saw lots of things that seemed like winners. I think definitely worth bookmarking for a breakfast or brunch outing in the near future.

If your crew is into creative mimosas, bloody Mary's etc they've got an extensive & creative list of those too. Including something in a lawn flamingo.  :)

Restaurant is located on the end of a strip mall.  Parking lot could potentially get busy, but there is lots of additional parking nearby behind the building if needed.

I dig this Irish pub. Real nice bar table, the owners are very nice and friendly. I had the pretzel with my beer here and it was awesome. My brother got the meat and cheese board which was pretty dang tasty. One of my buddies also got the shepherds pie and he said it was amazing so I'll have to check it out next time I'm there.
Apparently ownership forgot we are in the middle of a pandemic, not one employee was wearing a mask.  The food was ridiculously overpriced and mediocre at best!!
I absolutely hate this place. The food is the same as all applebees, but the service is horrible.

Needed a quick place to play that allowed pets and all of the nearby Marriotts said they wouldn't allow them. I was in a bit of a bind so I was okay staying somewhere new and tried them out. I was very pleasantly surprised. Customer service was the best I have seen at any hotel (and I'm a platinum reward member at Marriott). Sheets were soft and comfy and the hotel was quiet and clean. The hotel is definitely no frills as there was no breakfast buffet or anything but it was a great place to stay if you are ever in the Boise area!

Unfortunately this sonic location taints the sonic name. This location is conveniently located by the neighborhood. We continue to give this place a second, third, and fourth chance but am let down each time. Our orders have been wrong EVERY time and we often experience extremely slow service. In addition I had the opportunity to watch one of the employees brake apart a banana and throw in in my milkshake with her barehands. We now make the drive to a further much more attentive sonic.
Awesome place to eat they're happy hour is probably the best in Meridian/Boise when it comes to sushi and apps!

My friends and I went here on St. Patrick's Day to kick off the night.  We have been here a few times before but this night was a bit more memorable.  This place has a plethora of beers on taps and a few in the bottle.  If you are not a beer drinker, like me, they have added a small bar to the back where you can order a cocktail or straight spirit.  The bartender is a very nice guy and is always making sure everyone is having a great time.  They also have a couple of games that are available to play if your group is in the mood such as Cards Against Humanity and Joking Hazard.  

Their beer selection is super crazy and should please anyone with a thirst to quench.

If I had to describe this restaurant in one word it would be mediocre. It claims to be 50 steamed however I would consider it more of a Marilyn Monroe and Elvis Presley themed restaurant. It has a lot of Elvis memorabilia from all decades up to and including the 70s. The food was okay. My wife and I got grilled chicken sandwiches which were pretty average however we asked for sliced tomato and onion and they charged us $2 a person for IT which is absurd. Other than that the food was not bad the fries were on the greasy side but tasty. My kids got chicken strips which were clearly previously frozen. I doubt I would go there again.
This is a cool new spot on Eagle Road with plenty of options for Irish beers or whiskey. Lots of natural light and subway tile brighten the room.  Soccer game is on - my type of place.
like a worse version of PF Chang

Was a fabulous experience!  Prompt response to online Yelp Quote, great with covering options (can do just exterior, just interior, etc) & explaining prices- then a Professional Crew showed up on time & ready to work the day of the appt.  I definitely plan to use this service again.  They got out almost everything... lots of coffee stains over 13 yrs!
Huge, amazing cinnamon rolls, good coffee, and excellent breakfast menu. Service is fast, dishes are hot, and cooked great. I love the French toast and bacon and hashbrowns.

We used Andy for several minor projects around the house, things we've been neglecting for awhile: a leaky faucet, base board repair,  electrical switch covers, caulking, even sharpening my lawnmower blades and a few other little fixes.   Andy is pleasant to be around,  quite competent and fair and honest. If you use him you'll feel you got a good value.

I love this place!!! And so does my little blue Merle toy Aussie x corgi! They are so so friendly here and really make your pet feel as comfortable as possible with all the love and attention they give them. I can't recommend them enough!

Ok. I'm starting with a 5-star review because this is the new Meridian location on 10 Mile just off the interstate. Not sure exactly when it opened but on a Friday night at 7:30pm they are open. There are half the tables filled with happy diners. The others, like me are taking our orders to go. Like other locations, the atmosphere is bright and open. A big screen tv is on the wall and a self serve dispenser for soft drinks. My order has finally arrived so I'm going to go. Hope it's tasty.

I cannot praise Blue Creek enough! I have never had a cavity or any scary dental work (aside from braces as a kid) and when I learned I needed a root canal I was terrified!

I walked into Blue Creek and was kindly greeted at the front desk. The atmosphere is so welcoming and calming. The front desk staff are prepared to take care of you and your anxiety lol.

The dental staff are amazing as well. My procedure was a two-part and they are just so nice and caring to us poor people needing awful work done.

I highly recomend.

Understanding that covid has an effect on business at this time it does not affect costumer service. I waited at the drive through speaker for 15 min with the employee telling me they are having difficulties and to wait a few more minutes. I was understanding and then again asked much later if he was there and no answer. Left me no option but to drive away. They need to tell customers they are temporarily closed if they are not able to serve customers. I wondered why the car in front of me also drove away, this explains it.

I ordered Louies for take out. I saw one of their posts on Facebook regarding their family of four curbside takeout specials during the COVID-19.

I gave them a call and placed my order and told them what time I would be there. When I got there everything was so organized. I pulled up I called I let them know the color of my vehicle. They ran my credit card earlier in the day so all they had to do was run my food out to me. The person that came out was so grateful that we had ordered thanked me several times for my order and wished me a good day. It made the experience wonderful.

Louies has always been a family favorite and the customer service is always above and beyond.

We ordered the mat manicotti with salad and garlic bread for four people. It came out hot and ready to go and was still hot by the time I got home 10 minutes later. We were looking for a non-meat option for Friday and this was an absolutely delicious and perfect dinner for us. Everything was hot and it was tasty. 

Overall not only is the customer service amazing but the food is absolutely delicious! 

Be sure to place a to go order and support the small business. You won't wait too long, your food will be hot, and you will not be disappointed!
Their double bacon burger was HUGE!!! I could've barely finish it. Their tots are great too!  Will for sure eat here again.

I have shopped at this location for several years. The reason I'm giving it 2 stars is because first of all, they have a great grocery section, and I'm able to find most of what I need there and prices are reasonable. However right now, they say they require masks, and I've been at the store three different times recently and they do not enforce the mask requirement. Every time I shop there, I see numerous customers throughout the store who are not wearing masks. Most seem to be teens and young adults. I talked to a cashier about it because I don't confront people, I just try to stay away from the ones who are not wearing masks, and the cashier said that they can only enforce mask wearing with their employees. I've seen employees not wearing them in the aisles at times. She said that they're not able to enforce mask wearing with the customers. That's ridiculous, other stores are very stringent about it. This puts others, especially older people, at risk. So I'll have to stop shopping there. Very disappointing.

Worst experience ever! Went in to cancel my gym membership because of horrible service prior to me canceling! A guy at the desk was busy on his phone and was very short with me. I stated to him I needed to cancel my membership he wrote down my info and proceeded on his texts. I walked away thinking things were done. Now 6 months later after a rude call from their financial dept and a threatening letter from their attorneys they are telling me I owe $105 and they are telling me I have to pay $100 or they will turn it into the credit bureau no payment arrangement is acceptable! Run do not use these criminals they have horrible service!

Yes, not for the faint hearted, price wise. But I think it's a good price for the really amazing, flavorful and succulent meats they dished out during out stay. The veggie bar is also so very worth it. I couldn't stop eating my favorite, palm hearts and many more goodies. Kapirinia, thé Brazilian cocktail was delicious. Wine / beverages blue glasses are so fragile, I broke one once and almost tipped another second time. And I rarely break dishes. Wish they replace them with more sturdy ones. My husband loved the decor but for me it felt so missing. I felt like I was in a big hall with many tables squished next to each other. It wasn't my favorite at all. Also, I would skip the dessert. Simple Cisco ones with a high price tag. I will definitely go again and enjoy the wonderful fresh meats. Drilling already.

My wife and I were walking around the village. After a few awful experiences with other restaurants we found this place. We had no intention of eating there but holy hell did we feel like we won the jackpot. Our waiter was Jayke (with a Y) and he and all of the staff was amazing. The food was amazing. The manager came and asked how we were enjoying our meal...he was amazing. Cost wise it's a bit above my pay grade but it was memorial day and my wife is a vet so 50% off so we could afford it. Best meal I've had in what feels like forever but it was the service that impressed me the most. I highly reccomend this place. You will not be dissatisfied with the food and more than impressed by the service. Do yourself a favor and try this place and hope you get jayke as your waiter.

Nicely decorated interior. The ceiling lighting creates a beautiful ambience. Salad bar is not traditional. Cold cut meats and cheese with a few other limited selections. The lobster bisque was delicious. Enjoyed most of the meats served table side. Felt most had very limited seasoning. Waitress wasn't very attentive. Took forever to get our drinks. Dirty stacked plates would sit for great lengths of time before she would take them away. Wasn't offered plates for the meat. Had to retrieve from the salad bar. Restaurant as a whole seemed a little disorganized. I was surprised to learn they have been open for ten months. Seemed to function as a brand new restaurant that hasn't figured out a system yet. The biggest reason for the low score was the service and pricing. At $45 per person it's extremely over priced. This outrageous price doesn't even include a drink or dessert. I definitely will not be going back.

Gave it a try today, wow was really surprised sampled the gravy it's been hard trying to find my favorite place we left. But to my surprise it was great food was super, waitress's were very friendly and Service was very good also will be there again !

We booked this hotel because it was about $50 cheaper on Hotels.com than the rest when we were driving through. It was getting late and we needed to eat and there are tons of restaurants and shopping nearby. It ended up being one of the most comfortable rooms we've stayed in. We travel a lot and stay in a lot of chains that have higher ratings, but I would definitely pick this one again over a lot of others. The bedding is NICE. Super soft! Seems like a newer hotel and is really clean. The ladies that checked us in were very polite and helpful and the lighting in the room this morning when I needed to get ready was perfect! I always get annoyed by bad lighting when trying to put on my make up, lol... so My Place is winning.

I made a wish... I wished for a simple alteration.  Specifically, I wished for a pair of designer jeans to be hemmed - and, as any qualified seamstress does, I wanted the original hem removed and put back on.  Despite the name of the store, my wish was far from granted.  Instead, the seamstress was argumentative, disrespectful, and flat out refused to accommodate my request.  Worse still, the owner backed the poor attitude of her employee.  Needless to say, we walked away without an alteration, and we're headed elsewhere.  I'd have given zero stars if I were able.  Sadly, Yelp wouldn't accommodate my wish either.

I've been a long term customer at this store for many years. I took items in on Friday and never received a call or text so I called today and spoke to Lynn, she proudly told me it was donated & they can't hold onto things forever for customers. I spend a lot of money on the clothes I buy for my kids and for them to just be donated without a simple call saying come get your stuff is a shame on this store. I will NEVER shop or sale stuff to this store again! Lynn whom is the owner hung up on me after telling me she was done talking to me. Horrible customer service and what a shame on this store.

I called back and spoke to Jenny, she explained to me that Lynn was busy and couldn't talk. I requested a check be mailed to me for the credit amount since they've taken my stuff and I won't be using this store every again. Jenny said they'd only give me the cash amount. 
This store takes no responsibility to what they've done. 

After a few minutes passed Brittney called me to say they were able to get my items back from the donation company and I could pick them up along with a check. 

All I can say is WOW!

This was my first time eating at Biscuits and Hogs so I was not quite sure what to expect,  I was greeted promptly at the door and seated right away.  The wait staff were all wearing masks.  Service was adequate.  I ordered the hamburger called "The Hog" which was described as "two 4 oz signature patties on a brioche bun with lettuce, pickle, onion, tomato and hog sauce."   Hmmm . . . I wondered what "hog sauce" was.  Along with the hamburger I ordered tomato bisque soup (rather than fries).  This hamburger came promptly and was very tasty.  The beef was seasoned nicely and the 2 patties were a nice portion, not too skimpy.  I really liked the generous amount of pickles too.  And the "hog sauce" . . . well, I am not sure what was in it, but it was delicious!  It seemed to have a bit of a sweet twang to it.  The soup arrived hot and was great also.  It had a touch of spicy heat which I really enjoyed.  Overall, I enjoyed my meal.  The only thing I did not care for was the loud country music.  It just was not relaxing to me.  I would rather have no music.  If anything would keep me away next time, it would be the music.  Oh, and before I forget, the price for my meal with a diet drink and tip was a bit expensive - just under $20.

kim is the best! after four years of mostly horrible experiences with groomers through out the cerritos and long beach area, i finally discovered pet cutz mobile salon, when my neighbor was getting her dog groomed. 

i find her price extremely reasonable! i have paid more at other groomers where i have to take my yorkie, kona, to the place and leave her for sometimes over 4 hours. you know how traumatizing those places can be with them caging your dog up for hours at a time and they lack the personal attention that a mobile groomer can give your furbaby.

kona's last grooming appointment before kim went horribly. i had asked the groomer to take just a little off of kona and when i came to pick her up they had shaved her completely bald! she was terrified and shaking profusely when i picked her up and i swore to never do that to her again. i did my best to groom kona myself for a year before finding kim. 

i explained to kim kona's previous groomer experience, so she would be prepared for any difficulties. i explained to her the cut i was looking for and when kona was done she looked exactly as i wanted her to! never had i had a groomer do exactly what i wanted, which is to keep a little length on her body and long ears and face, kona has floppy ears and i love to show them off :)

i know how difficult kona must have been after going a year with out experiencing a groomer so i was extremely happy to have her returned to me beautifully groomed and happy. 

i highly recommend kim! she fills up fast so booking in advance is necessary :)

This store has the BEST customer service. During covid they would literally bring items to the door so I could see if I wanted to purchase online. Now I just do their pick up which is free. When you order online and do a pick up they actually give you a discount! Amazing!! They are currently open to public too!

Ordered the fried rice. Came out lukewarm. Not one but two servers could not tell me what the chef special for the sushi was. The sushi we had was not made properly some of the worst I've ever had. Way over priced for what they have. I would expect to have better sushi for the price. I will not return.

Overpriced greasy food. They seem to think it's top notch, I felt like it's kind of mediocre. Fancy items they have made up were made sort of blah. Took forever. Covid or not, the menu is too big to move food out quickly. Nothing bad, just not worth $20+ for average breakfast. They're supposed to be known for bacon. I thought it was good. But just bacon. 
   They'd rather sell you the $30 mimosa flight. Those are too little cheap champagne and watery juice. My opinion. 
Chicken fried steak was decent, not special.  
   Instead I'd try their other restaurant, the Huck House Brunch in Garden City. It's very creative and airy. Food fantastic too.  This is noisy and unimpressive. Big portions are fine if food was a little better.

Great service, from the minute we walked in the door. A manager open the door for us, he greeted us like he had known as all his life. We got a table Runway and the service was just phenomenal. Lots of food. Great drinks. And we had so much fun with the servers. The guys carrying the food around, the ladies with the drinks, the managers, everyone was friendly and personable and just fantastic. Worth every single penny.

The pho here is exceptional. Homemade and hearty, this is a meal to look forward to. The staff are very friendly and there to help. You order at the counter and they bring your food to your table. 

The vegetables that the put on the side to add to your pho (love the jalapenos​) are fresh and colorful. They taste as good as they look. 

The portions here are substantial and you won't walk away hungry. The noodles are tender, plentiful and separate nicely for a complete mixture of broth, noodles, meat and veggies in every bite. The flavor and texture combinations of this meal is unbeatable.

The interior of the building is a little basic and could use a few touches here and there but it is very clean, nice and mostly comfortable.

This has become my go-to​ pho place in Boise whether I take out or eat in.

I usually only come here after 9 up unto 1 am, all apps are half price and drinks are 3 50, if u want to have fun for cheep, this is the place to go!
my fav...
buffalo boneless wings, Sliders and a root beer
total cost:13 .25

Trying to be as constructive as possible- you made us wait for a table with a half empty restaurant for almost 20 min at 7pm on a Saturday night, when we asked our server for something for our table with "excuse me" her answer was "what!?" And all of our food was borderline cold when it came to our table. Needless to say we were not the most fun table with 3 adults and 4 kids- but we came to this place thinking that we could get a good meal while we visited with our good friend. Instead we are all suffering from a gut ache and buyers remorse from not leaving after the first 20 mins. We have sworn off this place and I hope in leaving this review you take a step in the right direction of better appreciating the patrons that walk through your doors.
Danielle gave us the best service we've had in a long time! We will definitely be back to be seated in her section! She was an absolute delight! Food was great as usual.

Such a good spot. The downstairs is incredible. Great beer selection and there is wine for non beer drinkers. The upstairs is in progress and looks to be ready soon. Bartender was awesome and helpful to try new beers.  Definitely will be back

Where to begin... this place is absolutely delightful. The menu has something for everyone, and there's a lot to enjoy on it. Everything I tried was DELICIOUS. The servings are plentiful and could probably be split between two people. I definitely recommend getting the waffle- have no idea what they put in their batter but they're incredibly fluffy and sweet, the maple syrup is some of the best I've ever had!!! My new fave spot in town.

I highly suggest not giving Envy Nails your business. Go to CT Nails on Fairview. I used to go to Envy Nails and I enjoyed the service. I stopped getting my nails done, because of financial reasons. On Saturday I decided I would start having my nails professionally done at Envy Nails again. The lady that normally does my nails wasn't working so I made an appointment to have anyone of the ladies there to do my nails. The lady that helped me, her name is Hannah, was extremely rude! I've never been treated so rude, she seemed very lazy and unwilling to help. I had a nail break on Monday and I went back to have it fixed and she was talking about me in her Asian language to the other ladies and then she yelled at me and said she had already fixed my nails and that she wasn't going to be there every day. I was so humiliated that I wanted to cry! So please, if you're considering on going to Envy Nails, Don't go there! If you like being treated like dirt and being belittled in front of everyone in the building then go for it. I'm going to take my business somewhere else where they appreciate me and are there to help me. I know from this day on I'm going to let people know that Envy Nails is a low class business with very little to offer the consumer, especially if they allow people like Hannah to work there, she's a bad apple, shame on her!!

DO NOT HIRE THIS COMPANY!  I have over 30 pictures showing how Boise Housekeeping did NOT clean my house yet checked items off the list as having cleaned them.  Next to nothing was actually attempted to be cleaned.  What was attempted had to be re- cleaned.  I spent 10 hours cleaning the house after Boise Housekeeping had supposedly done a move-out, ready-to-put-on-the-market cleaning.  Floors not touched, banister not dusted, toilets not cleaned, ceiling fans and vents not cleaned, window sills and tracks not cleaned, door tracks and doors not cleaned, switch plates not cleaned and the list goes on. Boise Housekeeping would not offer any kind of a refund.  They ask for a credit card in advance, then you're charged regardless of any cleaning actually being performed. (We actually offered to pay $100 if they would refund the rest - which we thought was more than generous on our part... and the answer was a firm no after they had been shown the pictures and had multiple conversations).  They have every excuse in the book as to why we aren't satisfied including blaming us!  We have filed with the BBB, the Attorney General, and the FTC, and have refuted the entire charge with our credit card company.  It is fraudulent to charge for services not performed.  Please either clean it yourself or hire anyone OTHER than this company.  If I could give negative "stars" for a rating, I would.

I really wanted to give this place a better review, but they are out of lots of things all the time, their baked goods are stale and hard, and way overpriced. Hopefully they open a different coffee shop in the Village, because this one is a let-down.

While the food & service was excellent, this was NOT an enjoyable breakfast. 
The noise level was painful on my ears!  The acoustics seems to be made to make the sound louder than it needs to be.  We where there around 9am an it was only about half full.
Getting back to the food and service, I'm on a Keto diet and it can be hard to find a keto friendly meal, I asked the server if she had any recommendations and she made a couple of suggestions.  Including cauliflower & cheese hash browns.  Excellent choice and help in selecting!  Thanks!!!

Meridian Veterinary offers incredible care with skilled doctors and staff with the highest quality care in the valley.  We have had all of our experiences be total positive and reassuring experiences.   Our Frenchie has had a hard time breathing due to a squished face,  so the skilled staff performed 2 surgeries to take a flap out of his throat to clear his airway and open up his nostrils.  His care was top notch and within 48 hours he is eating, playing and breathing so much better. Dr Amy Albrecht takes good care of our Frenchie and the surgeon was highly skilled.  Thanks to the entire staff

Worse chow mein I have ever had. It was like crispy chow mein noddles that were soggy. I expected traditional chow mein and I don't know what you call this. Also got chicken fried rice that was so flavorless. It didn't even look like chicken fried rice. The Beef with Peppers was more peppers and onion then beef and the sweet and sour pork was very tough. DO NOT EAT HERE!!

Great food. Service was great. We decided to sit outside and the gal came out to recipe the table and open the umbrella. Then they brought out our food. Well done! It's all about customer service and it was amazing!

I took my 13 year old son there for a few different issues and was so appreciative of the staff and Dr. Loveland. They were so kind and gentle with him and made sure he was understanding what was going on and was comfortable with what was happening. They were so thorough in covering all the basis. We left with a solution and a game plan for my son to follow. I got in quickly and every person I interacted with was professional kind and helpful.

I had a wonderful experience at Blue Creek Endodontics! Dr. Eaton is one of the most kind, gentle, caring, as well as professional, knowledgeable and talented doctors that I've had the pleasure to meet. His reassuring bedside manner really made me feel at ease during an otherwise uncomfortable procedure. I appreciated him telling me what he was doing during each step of the root canal, as well as his sense of humor (it was hard not to laugh sometimes!). Dr. Eaton - you are a treasure in our community!
Fantastic! This is now one of my favorites.  Excellent beer selection and fantastic wok dishes.  Now I can't wait to come back and try the sushi.
Great Irish music, authentic  Irish food, great  Irish beers on tap, and warm fun atmosphere and staff

This place is great! We just got the newest member of our family, Jake, in June. I was looking for a groomer that I could trust to leave my little guy with.  Reached out to some friends on Facebook and quite a few people recommended Groomingtails. I called one morning and set up an appointment with Jay, he was very personable and had a great sense of humor.... So far so good. Later that day on my way home I stopped in to check the place out. I met Allison, she told me that because of insurance reasons I wasn't allowed to see where Jake would actually be. I assumed the animals get groomed behind the wall in the front. The lobby was clean and bright. The next week I take my little guy in for his day at the spa. Jay was there to check him in and helped make Jake a little more relaxed (he was nervous). Later in the day I called to ask a question and Jay let me know Jake was doing great, he even sent me some pics of him playing w his new friends. My husband picked Jake up in the afternoon, he looked and smelled great! I almost didn't recognize him! ;)

This Asian fusion restaurant can be found in 2 places in Ada County - Kuna and, the more popular location, the Village at Meridian. It's safe to say that this is not an Asian restaurant so don't expect any kind of authenticity. I don't mean that in a bad way. The food is still pretty good! 

I ordered some General's Spicy Chicken and potstickers after a wild night out so all my body really wanted was some mainstream greasy dish. It was actually really good! The spiciness wasn't all I hoped for though. I ordered a level 3 thinking it would suffice but I should have went for a 5. I grew up eating spicy Asian food every day so my palate is strong as steel. Added my own chili oil and that fixed the problem! I ended up eating the entire dish which is something I rarely do. I didn't have the highest expectations, however I was impressed. By the end of the meal I had a belly full of yummy food and my brain didn't feel like goop anymore. I

I don't know if I'd come back here, though. Probably not unless I'm at the Village and it's all that sounds good. I have to say, compared to other Asian fusion eateries it didn't really stand out. Pretty subpar. Fixed my craving for the day so for that 4 stars!

This is the spot to avoid your group having to sit apart from each other, or if you want to have that one seat gap between you and the next person (unless it is a premier).  It is fun to go to the Village and new theaters, but hard to beat the laid back easy going feel of Majestic.  It is relatively new, clean, decent prices on refreshments, and you don't have to deal with the oversized crowds.  I really hope this place stays as a staple movie theater in our community, because I am not always a fan of theaters with every seat filled and sharing an arm rest with my neighbor.  Relax and try the majestic out if you want a solid movie experience, without the hustle and bustle.

* Pretty chill, especially on a hot day. The radio/music was too loud to let me feel relaxed. The tables are clean, and stable. The seats all are cushioned from what I can see. I don't know of a bad seat here, as far as comfort goes. From my booth by the window, I could see six different television screens, showing various sporting events. I'm not a TV fan, so this was not much of an attraction; however I did read a review mentioning that a youngster saw something inappropriate on TV here. I would not bring my family here anyway, because of the alcohol being served.
* In Memphis, I often went to a restaurant to order a full rack of ribs. Applebees was never my favorite for ribs, but I settled into getting the riblet basket almost every time. It was satisfying and filling, strips of cross-cut pork ribs with zesty fries.
* Today I tried a rib platter with mashed potatoes and green beans. The rib bones were not as loose as I would like. The green beans were a touch undercooked. Yet, it was a decent meal. But I can think of better restaurants for the price.

Been meaning to go to this place since it first opened. Staff is very friendly and place is clean. Prices were a little high but once I got my food....I soon realized that I was getting my money's worth. The platter was huge! I got what was called the 'Idaho Scramble' and it was pretty good. The only downside was that it needed a little bit more seasoning. Their potatoes were delicious though! My husband got the 'Bacon Bacon Burger' and he said it was decent. I'll tell you what though... their Bacon was soooooooooo good. I also tried their Strawberry basil mimosa. Couldn't really taste the Strawberry or basil just mostly the prosecco. All in all, pretty decent place. I like the atmosphere and I would love to come back and try more dishes in the future.
I love coming here! The employees really know their stuff and they are really welcoming to new players! Great place would recommend.

Great variety of beers and a fun,'different atmosphere to enjoy them in! Lots of seating either at the bar or tables and it stays nice and cool being downstairs in a building with rock foundation! Big fan!!
Great experience!! The theater was clean and the new reclining chairs are sooo comfortable. We'll watch all our movies at this location.

These guys were so friendly and helpful. And very kind to my puppy. And best of all their prices were very reasonable. Cheaper to buy natural treats than chewy or amazon. I'll be going back regularly!

Love coming here 2 pick up new threads 4 my boys! I switch in/trade in their old clothes 2 get store credit. They itemize my old items while I shop, and then I use my store credit to buy new & gently used items. I've had 2 awesome experiences both times I've shopped here. Thank you!

The staff was fabulous. The meat was good. Very consistent and yummy. I really enjoyed going at lunch. Wow what a delicious salad bar. I could eat that all day long. I thought all the meat was cooked perfectly. The staff was really helpful on picking the meats that are the best.

I normally like this Walmart, but tonight my brother and I were completely ignored and disrespected by the two men working in gun and ammo. My brother needed to buy some ammo that was behind the glass for our dad for Christmas, and asked one of the men to open it for us. I'm assuming the old man did hear him, but we got no help or any explanation.  The two men even dumbly walked to the glass, played with the handle, and walked away from us. Didn't even acknowledge us. Wow. I know it's Walmart, but you guys sure pick the best of the best to work for you, don't you? Maybe instead of working at Walmart, these two men need to be helped to the nearest nursing home.

We sat at the bar and had to move because I didn't have my ID, I am 55.  I get protecting your license but don't be ridiculous.  We moved to a table and waited about 35 minutes  for our food because they had a to go order that took them down a rabbit hole, so the waitress said.  On to the food, overpriced & nothing special.  They give you a fair amount of food but for 2 of us it was $40 and I drank water.  Probably won't drive from Nampa again.

Let me start off by saying that I am a huge Jersey Mike's fan. I've always loved their subs, and it has always been consistent regardless of location.  I remember chatting with the manager at a different store about how awesome their food is. And his reply was that it all comes down to good training and making sure your team knows exactly how much of each item to put on a sub even down to how many shakes of "the juice". We tried this Meridian location (ordered on the app) and our kids each got ONE slice of meat on their sandwiches. The meat is sliced thin which is one of the things that makes their sandwiches delicious, but one slice even for a child just doesn't suffice.
Love this location. The trainers and owner are so friendly, flexible and helpful. My fiancé and I love working out here!

Great drinks and great customer service! Everyone working is SO kind and sweet. They even helped me decide on my drink because there were so many great options!! Everything was reasonably priced and the lids on the boba cups are so unique and cute!!! Really a great place.

Had to have my labs drawn this morning and came to this location as it's more convenient for my morning errands. I was greeted Buy a very friendly receptionist and checked in promptly and asked to take a seat. Not two minutes later I was called by the phlebotomist and taken back and labs are drawn. She inquired if I wanted a flu shot to which I thought was a great suggestion. Another associate brought in my flu shot and I was out in less than 10 minutes. What a great overall experience no long lines no waiting clean and friendly facility and wonderful staff
Wow! So Awesome! The Veteran Day breakfast was off the hook! First time here and it was amazing! I'll be back for sure. Thanks for supporting the service members!

The wait wasn't too bad only about 5 minutes or so.  We were greeted  right away by our server and she was very friendly.   We ordered a Vegas roll as our appetizer, which is a deep fried sushi roll, it took quite a while to come out but it was delicious. 
For our entree's we ordered Buddha's feast with steak and noodles, extra sauce and honey walnut shrimp over brown rice with extra sauce.  Again took quite a while to come out.  
Both dishes were so good and flavorful I would highly recommend both.  The steak was cooked medium and was  very tender and the extra sauce  is a must if you want to taste it because without  it it's pretty dry.  

Over all good experience  except for the long wait in the food.  Our bill for the 3 items was $53.  So it's not a really inexpensive place.

We came to a new Brazilian style steakhouse in the village for dinner tonight. The Dallas based churrascaria chain just open their doors last week. My husband been nagging me to go there & try their food so off we went.
Come hungry because they have a nice selection at the salad bar, after you go back to your seat flip the disk from red to green then the gauchos will come over with meats and when you're full or need to take a break then flip over the disk to red again. Our favorites are the grilled Shrimp, lamb chops, filet mignon, flank steak, Brazilian sausage & their fried bananas!
I order Caipirinha; it's a Brazil's national cocktail; made with cachaca, sugar & lime. It was tasty!
For dessert we ordered Brazilian cheesecake and Expresso w/a shot of 43 liquor. It's a Spanish liqueur made with vanilla, citrus, fruit juice & bunch of spices & herbs. I love it!!
We like the place, it's clean, good service, good ambiance and everybody were nice. It's kind of spendy but it's worth your money. We will be back!

I have used Kim and her service many times. I have ALWAYS been more then happy. My Daisy loves her too. She does a great thorough job. I would definitely recommend her to anyone... And I thought she had a wonderful personality, easy to talk with and very funny!!
Love the workouts, something different every day. The trainers are great, very motivating.

Clean rooms. Very friendly staff. Nice wide hallways.   Check in was easy and fast.  Our room had a view of a horse paddock which was kinda cool.

Breakfast was nice. I like the fact that you can grab some fruit and beverages before you check out, a few snacks for the road.

I would stay here again.

Tucanos is just as good if not better and half the price. Also don't get refills on soda cuz once your 8 oz mini bottle is done that's all you get. No free refills like tucanos. It was good just there's a better option for half the price. I live in Emmett though so I'm not the kind of person that wants somebody folding my napkin for me every time I get up but if you like that kind of stuff maybe it would be worth the extra price?
Such a convenient and excellent service with great results. Highly recommend!! My tan looked natural and consistent. Kris set up fast and left everything spotless.

Really great cocktails, sushi, service, and atmosphere! The mixologist/bartender is so great and creative. 
Recommended for sure

We did two different mimosa flights and really liked them all. There was one that we didn't like so much, the huckleberry mint mimosa. It wasn't our favorite. We like the price and serving size of the dishes. You definitely get your money's worth. The pork belly bacon was delicious! We will be back!

Needed a place for a few days while visiting friends and former work associates.

Nice staff.  Good, good quick breakfast with make-your-own waffles, eggs, biscuits & gravy and other stuff.  Room was super quiet, super clean and well maintained.  Beds were firm and comfortable.  First floor room was fine and access to the front and rear parking lots from the lobby was convenient.  Didn't use the exercise room or indoor pool.  They looked nice and well maintained.  

Location near lots of businesses which travelers would need. Right off Highway 84 with good street access to Meridian and other Boise suburbs.  less than 20 minutes from the airport.

Room rate was around $90 with tax and everything.  Much better than the Best Western out near the airport which we rated ONE star because negative stars are not allowed.
Saved sisters wedding dress in 24 hrs after initial seamstress did not fix issue!!! Would recommend hands down and will use again for any alterations!!!!
This is an awesome coffee and boba shop! They have an array of special coffees, shaved ice, boba teas, & desserts all served up in an urban decor! You'll love this little place, give it a try!

The breakfast lady was rude and has no idea about customer service. Tall lady with blond hair (? Renee). Witnesses her telling an couple elderly they couldn't have any water or breakfast even tho the food was still out. Nasty lady! The rest of the crew were great, very nice, very accommodating. Just sad to see someone like that in the hospitality.

Probably won't eat here again....

Hubby and I were stuck at St. Luke's as I just had a baby and we were sick of hospital food. This place was super close and sounded great so we gave it a try. Wish we'd just ordered hospital food...

We ordered the Mongolian Flat read, Hand wrapped potstickers, Louie's Loaded Nachos & Uncle Fu's Fried Rice.

My husband ordered the flatbread & nachos. He was disappointed with both. He said the nachos were ok but barely had any chicken despite the item description stating they're loaded with chicken. He ended up giving away the flatbread after one piece, said it lacked flavor.

I enjoyed the potstickers very much, but they are very rich.

The fried rice has a lot of potential but the meat ruined it completely. I ordered the special, which is a combination of meats. The meat was so salty that I party contribute my recovery swelling from it  and the rice, while basically very good was also greasy.

Our bill came to over $50, definitely not worth overly salted, greasy and food that doesn't live up to its description.

Can't say we'll ever eat here again

Great local game store! Had an amazing inventory and the staff was friendly and knowledgeable. Was able to get SW Legion stuff I was looking for that nobody else had and picked up some board game expansions I've been needing. Would highly recommend.

I love a good Thai tea with boba from this place. It's pretty dang good considering the lack of boba places in the Treasure Valley. They aren't always super consistent with the customer service, but that is to be expected with the hiring shortage and covid and all the other factors that are making the service industry that much harder right now. I'd say all in all they are handling well despite the challenges. Worth stopping in!
Needed our RV washed due to traveling from Ca to Idaho.  Called him and he came to the Meridian KOA and washed our trailer.  Fast response and our trailer looks like new again

We were very sorry to see Devon and the other guys behind the bar gone.  They made this place the neighborhood place and we always felt welcomed, and our drinks were on the table when he saw us enter the bar.  It's obvious something was different, which is too bad.  A nice gal took care of us, but a lot of "in training" people were wandering around, without a lot of knowledge or experience.  We saw the barmaid check out the recipe book quite a few times, which showed she wasn't a pro.  Previously, this bar always had pro's working in it, which made it seamless for the customer.  Kinda sad.  Food is still excellent.

We are definitely getting a 2nd opinion. My son and I saw Tessie McInnally, PA, and based on our experience, I think my son was her first patient. She wasn't able to answer any of our questions without going to ask her 'colleagues'. Our appointment took longer because she had to keep leaving the room to find an answer. We all were learning together it seemed, but unfortunately we left without a clear path for treatment or recovery. We were given the option to 1)ignore the life-altering problem 2)get a shot which doesn't really work or 3)have surgery which generally just postpones the condition coming back. While those might be the only options, I wasn't confident because our PA was relaying information she was getting from...a google search? I can't say for sure because the receptionist had one of the treatments and couldn't have been more pleased with the results. I just didn't trust anything at this appointment. I wish they'd refund my money as I didn't receive the services I paid for.

If your goal is to support a responsible local business and enjoy good food then move along, there is nothing for you here. Because this owner, also of  Original Sunrise Cafe, seems metaphorically standing with his middle finger raised to issues of public health by ignoring Central District Health rules for masks as pandemic mitigation measure and staff do not wear them and distanced seating is ignored.  Beyond that, the production kitchen turns out huge portions of mediocre food so there's that even if you decide to take out.  Unless, of course, your food consumption goal is quantity and not quality.  I have been sharing on Yelp for going on a baker's dozen in years and in that time I have taken the time to post precious few 1 star opinions, only 31 of 1328 to date, because it takes time to do it and I'd rather spend mine focusing on good places for people to know about. But sometimes it really is the right thing to do to point out the bad ones.  In my humble Yelp opinion this is a miss.

Update;;; 
The waitress was new and didn't know the system and started her shift with no one there to help her. Bad management...
HORRIBLE!!!! 
SERVICE WAS HORRIBLE. didn't get water and our drinks because bartender was on a break. Finally got those. Ordered regular side salad and Caesar and got two regular, wasted NEVER came back after we got entrees to ensure everything was ok. THEN, we were charged for two other meals on top of ours we never ordered. Waitress said it was managers fault, which it was. Love the food, restaurant is usually great. NOT TONIGHT!!!!!  think waited name was Kadie!!! I think. Horrible service
The food itself was fine. Till I found a piece of metal fried into my food. Maybe order from somewhere else for mediocre Chinese food.

Dr. Kent performed a PRK corrective procedure on my eyes. I work in the medical field and was well aware of Dr. Kent's ability as a surgeon and was sure that he was one of the best if not the best ophthalmologist in my area.  My procedure was efficient with minimum discomfort.  Dr. Kents staff was very professional as well as very helpful.  In a little over a week since my procedure my vision is 20/20 and actually continues to improve!  There is nothing simple about eye surgery getting the right surgeon has made a big difference both in my eyesight and in having 0 complications from the procedure.  I would highly recommend this surgeon!

I had an excellent experience at Riverbend Family Dental. The environment was very comfortable and everyone was extremely friendly! Dr. Bennion was informative and helpful with any concerns I had. 

I would highly recommend!!

This use to be our absolutely favorite place for brunch. Recently we placed an order to go through their website. We were given a pick up time. When I showed up at my pick up time. I let the hostess know I was only there for a to-go order. She snapped at me and said they were slammed in the kitchen because a lot of door dash orders. I said ok and waited to the side. As I stood there I saw multiple door dash drivers arrive and she continued to snap at them the kitchen was backed up. Listen, we understand that things get busy and kitchens get backed up. It's how YOU react as an employee. Clearly she doesn't need to be in this position as she cannot handle the pressure of a busy restaurant on a Sunday. I let her know I wanted a refund. She said she would go check my food. I said no, I wanted a refund. She said she would get her manager. Magically a few minutes later she appeared with my food (which I will NOT be eating as I don't trust her intentions) and she put on a smile saying here is your food and you will not be charged. Too bad she couldn't have this service when guest originally walk in. Even if it is fake.

Yesterday was my first time back here since before last year. It seems like their prices have gone up and service has gone way down! My pedicure was super rushed and rough. We had an appointment and there was no one waiting but she went so fast I couldn't even relax. Paid 94 dollars including tip for gel mani and pedi. Will be looking around for another nail place next time.
We went and the chicken parmigiana was sitting in about an inch of water, the enjoyable part was the garlic bread. For the price your better off eating at Olive Garden.

Came for Mother's Day , not impressed with  their over priced menu , the salads bar was empty and took a while for them  to fill it up , and they came maybe like 5 times with meat and they offered the same meat twice  , never coming back Tuscanos is way better with their selection and meat , don't waste your money $325 not worth it ,  Celedonia1977@icloud.com.

Great food and great place!
The wait staff is so welcoming.
My favorite is the Rueben Sandwich
 But the Mac and Cheese is so yummy too!

Hadn't been to the Village in a while, so we decided to have some lunch at the Rice Works. As always, the food was great, the servers were friendly, but something was missing.  What happened to the "de rish ish" shirts the guys used to wear? Please don't tell me you caved to the politically correct minority. Anyone "offended" by the harmless humor of those shirts and raises it as an issue should be nicely told to take their business elsewhere. A person who would complain about a non-issue like that would also nitpick your business to death on social media.  It actually upsets me that you would cave in that manner. Bring back the shirts!

Happy Teriyaki made this round eye very happy. We recently moved here and hadn't really found a good place to get chicken bowls but that quest is over. Tried this on a whim and was really glad. You get a lot of food for the price but the best part is the quality was amazing. Chicken was lean and the flavor was great. Only thing but not a dealbreaker is that it isn't "fast food" it takes about 15 minutes but that's fine cuz it tells me they are actually cooking it for me.

Came here today and had a very UNUSUAL  experience..
The 4 stars are for this store being well stocked, clean and having a fabulous selection of merchandise. 
On to the tea...
OK I'm not sure what happened today at this Ulta. I was doing my usual rounds, taking pics of products for my IG, testing new items and grabbing my must haves. I've been in the beauty industry for over a decade so nothing really shocks me anymore, I even own a small indie brand StinaFace (find me on IG @stinaface, bet you liked that little plug right) So I am definitely familiar with the retail sector of the industry. Anyway today I was waiting in line to make a purchase, my hubby walked in with my 1 year old son and they walked over to me to stand with me while I waited in line. Thats when it all started... 
I heard a loud voice yell from about 15 feet away "YOU READY?!" It was the cashier closest to the entrance. I politely said yes and walked over. At first I just assumed maybe I wasn't paying attention, or maybe I didn't hear her the first time even tho I was actually In a hurry to get rung up because my little family and I were headed for the corn maze. When I reached the register The cashier didn't greet me, she said in a very stern manner "do you have a phone number on file?".... that's when I knew whatever this attitude was, it was directed intentionally towards me. I said yes and gave her my number. I also had a digital coupon on my phone, she saw it and scanned it and gave me a pretty annoyed look. She handed me my bag and that was it.... but man this girl threw so much bad energy my way I felt like I needed to run home, burn some sage, pray to Jesus, take a spiritual bath just to get whatever she threw on me off. Even my husband was like "what was that about" ... Maybe I'll never know..
it was some twilight zone stuff for sure.

visiting from california, and worth the stay and money, beds are very comfortable staff was welcoming . hotel room has a stove refrigerator and microwave. they have a laundry room as well and complementary coffee, hot chocolate location is very close to food restaurants gas station and a Walmart

I was long overdue for a haircut and was in the area running errands. Despite some other negative reviews, I thought I'd give them a try. I'm a recent transplant from out of state and heard radio ads for Lady Janes where I used to live, so figured I'd find out if there was something to them.

I'm not picky about my hair, so when my stylist asked how I wanted it done, I told her I just wanted a "clean cut" look and to do whatever she thinks would look best. (This is what I tell anyone that does my hair.) And I have to say that my hair ended up just a little different than how everyone else does it, but in a good way. And for someone who doesn't mind how their hair looks, I like how it turned out. Where it went from good to great was this: I've been to a fair amount of places for a haircut, and this was only the second one in my life that did my eyebrows (which was awesome - my wife makes fun of my bushy eyebrows.) Plus she took a straight razor all the way down my neck, which every one of my past stylists have skipped. 

With all that being said - a haircut is a dime a dozen, at least for most of us guys. So I tend to gauge my experience overall based on how conversational the stylist is, because sitting there in silence in a one on one type of environment is weird. And my stylist was super friendly and conversational, so she earned a +1 there.

The steamed towel, shampoo rinse, and scalp massage were icing on the cake. The price was fair too and the stylist seemed genuinely grateful for the tip.

I'll be coming back.

Yes, yes, yes! For so many reasons. 1. It's circus training and all their classes are 45 mins long. You get in, so you shit, get out. Each day is diff. I think mon, wed, Friday's are cardio and the others are weights! There are instructors there to guide you. Also, the workouts are on a screen so you can always follow the screen if you need to. The first two weeks are FREE and they have multiple locations! This is so much better than a regular gym, in my opinion. 

Also, they have filtered water, towels and at the end of each session the offer you an ice cold towel chilled in lavender EO. TRUST ME, you'll need it. The best workout, EVER!

The overall experience wasn't that great. We arrived for a little girls brunch and was greeted with long wait times to get seated as while as long wait times to get drinks and eventually our food. Some meals came out cold and was sent back to the kitchen but returned to us straight out of the microwave. When it was time to get the check our waitress had clocked out and the manage brought us our check, but we asked for separate checks and that when her tone toward our group started to go down hill, when she came back she was rude and seemed to be angry with us. When asked how we liked our meal one said that she wasn't happy with it and as she started to explain the manager just stormed off in a huff! Wouldn't recommend unless you'd like to spend your morning waiting around to get unpleasant attitudes and microwaved food.

I've shopped here since they first opened. Never really get that great of a credit for bringing in my items, despite name brands and good condition. However, I typically find good things. Recently I have noticed that they are marking some items above retail price. When asked why I was told "We are pricing them at what we feel they will sell at. We will not price match to the retailer for original retail price." I found this odd for a consignment shop. Especially when the items they are selling for well above retail are not even new and many are missing pieces/broken and unable to be returned. Most people go to consignment shops to get a good deal. If I wanted to pay full price I would order directly from the retailer and ensure brand new quality and ability to return if not. Also not impressed with the customer service I've received in store when asking questions like this.
So good. Service was fast and the food was over the top delicious!!! We can't wait to come and get something else.

My biggest beef is the amount of food on the plate doesn't justify the high dollar amount. 
The noodle dish was very bland but the manager fixed it with his secret sauce.

I had heard good things about this place so I took my family there on a Friday night.  We were seated immediately, received drinks and bread immediately and the server took our order promptly.  The food came out quick and was pretty good.  They didn't like the tiramisu that was made that night so they gave us a free order of cannoli.  After we had finished eating we asked the server for some boxes to take the leftovers home.  He took the plates back to box them up but someone accidentally threw them away.  The server came back and said they were making a fresh order to go because of what happened.  I'm impressed with the service we had at Louie's.  The ambiance is very nice and the staff is super friendly.  If you're looking for an Italian restaurant to take the family to with good food, great service at a fair price then I'd go check out Louie's.  We'll be going back!  Thanks again for the outstanding service!

What I thought were holes from poor dry cleaning they assured me were actually moth holes. Once the item is dry cleaned the weakened fabric comes off and the hole shows. It makes sense at the nylon was in tact but the wool was gone. They explained ways to fix it through alterations. They did a great job in general and I believe they are telling me the truth.

We went during the first week they were open.
