The hosts  seemed confused that we showed up without a reservation - which was funny because it was 4:30 and literally there were only two taken tables at the time. I know this is supposed to be a higher end restaurant(and the price reflects that!), but that initial attitude when we came in and the dress code for the staff made me(and other diners) feel out of place. I think putting this restaurant at the village(next to a boozy bowling alley nonetheless) was a mistake since it gives no clue to a potential diner that this is a more formal restaurant. 

The salad bar was okay - I like acidic food but everything tasted like it was drenched in vinegar. They also had the bread bites that just weren't very good either(I left bread on a table! Unheard of!). The meat though. That is where they excel. The lamb and the amount of high end options is what sets this place apart. Other Brazilian type restaurants will always have a couple nice meats and lots of cheaper meats, with the nicer cuts never appearing. This place however, gets it right. The staff were excellent and excellently trained. Multiple managers on the floor even before it got busy. The servers were wonderful and attentive, with everyone making sure we got everything we might want. The service and the meat are 5 stars. The salad bar and the price are why I put off a star. For $125(with a $20 off coupon!), I would have liked the salad bar to have some different flavors. But really here...you come for the meat, not the vegetables! The price will keep us from making this a regular spot, but that's probably for the best considering it's all you can eat.

You may drive right past Heritage Hop Haus if you don't look for the sign and the brick building on the corner. We went there last night, Wednesday, for dinner to try the sushi. The vibe was really cool from the atmosphere to the variety of people. We sat upstairs and ordered the Potstickers, the Lemon Lily...very mild, the Bombshell with crunchy balls on top, and my favorite Sassy Sis with alot of flavor and a little heat. Since we're not beer drinkers, we ordered a bottle of Edna Valley Chardonnay that had crisp refreshing taste...very good. Ask for MacKenzie who was our friendly and delightful server.

My wife and I have been with State Farm for about 47 years now, and during this time, have had a few not-so-good agents, and a couple of GREAT ONES.  Steve Crowl DEFINITELY falls into this later category, as when we were transferring our accounts from our former home in CA to our new one in Caldwell, he worked very hard to make sure that we obtained the best coverage for the lowest cost.  He also took special care of us, making sure that we understood all that was going on, and keep in close contact throughout the entire transfer.  Our son and daughter are now pleased to have Steve as their agent now also.

First time eating here.  Good amount of chicken for $7.95. Flavor is great and stove hot. I just had the veggies, no rice.  The only negative is the straws are hard to unwrap. Both of the young ladies working there were very friendly and helpful.

I used to come here all the time with my mom. We enjoyed it very much. However, my mother in law bought me a certificate worth $100 for my birthday and when I came in 7 months later they claimed that it had expired after 6 months and they would only credit me $50 worth. NOWHERE on the certificate did it have an expiration date or the purchase date. It was only through conversation that I mentioned it was a birthday gift from 7 months ago. I was SO disappointed! I am not one to argue over things like this and didn't want to make a scene, but I felt like as a loyal customer I had been let down. I would not recommend this place after that event. I am so bummed by their lack of customer service and how they took advantage of me. I wish I could continue going there, but I will not be returning.

My daughter's expensive wedding dress was ruined by a different seamstress, who had shortened the bodice at the last minute and changed the whole look and fit of the dress. Just 2 weeks from the wedding, we had to scramble to find someone who could fix it. Everyone I contacted said they were too full, and that it couldn't be done in the short amount of time left. I had had some custom sewing done by As You Wish Clothiers in the past and liked what they did, so I decided to call them. I am so glad I did! Not only were they kind and understanding and willing to take on the challenge, but they did such an amazing job the dress actually looked better than the original when they were finished! They were able to lengthen the bodice and return the fit of the dress to what it was when my daughter first bought it, and they also fixed several other things the previous seamstress had done wrong! And in record time, too! I can't express enough how talented and amazing these two ladies are! They turned a fiasco into a beautiful creation! Highly recommend! Thank you, thank you, thank you!
Wish I could post the final result pic, but just be assured this is the best place to go for custom sewing and alterations!

Super overpriced, food is good but nothing special. It seemed like everything was wrapped in bacon and that's all you could taste. Save  some money and go to Tucanos. They have a better salad bar and the same meat choices. Service was excellent, food not so much.

Ordered through Uber Eats. That was the best part.  Everything else was not so good.  

I get a cold steak, cold broccoli, cold shrimp.  Not the driver's fault. I watched his progress and got to me within minutes of pick up.  

Then, no napkins, no utensils, no salt and pepper!!  Who ever packed this wasn't smart enough to add this for a hotel delivery. 

Long time since I've tried Applebee's.  It was near by and I'd thought I was making the right choice.  Live and learn and never again.

I have been here before and will not return!  Yesterday was the worst mani/pedi I have ever had. The person was more interested in watching the Olympics then paying attention to what he was doing. My cuticles are a mess and look awful. I would not recommend going here unless you are prepared for pain and horrible service.

We had another fun night in the bar last night and wanted to let you know how much we appreciate Devon and how he always takes care of us!  We don't come every week, so unsure how he remembers, but he remembers what both of us drink ... even that I like more limes in my cocktail!  He knows we like to have a few drinks before dinner, so leaves us alone yet continues to check in and seems to know when we're ready to order.  He even knows what our favorites are for dinner!  If I want to try something different, he always helps me to make the right choice ... last night it was the chef's featured roll, and it was DELISH!  I'll have it again.  Devon's a great addition to L & L, and we enjoy when he waits on us.  Cool ambiance and people.  GREAT food with a terrific staff!
Super busy the other day we were in for lunch.   2 servers on the floor,  and they did a great job.

Thank you to the two employees that helped me load 6 bags of chicken feed to the cart and then into my car, such fast and efficient service, in and out in 5 minutes with no lifting!!! Thank you so much for the great service today!!!!

Urban Fox is the best place to get boba in the Boise area hands down. They are super friendly and have great customer service. And their boba is so delicious!! It's a great place to go get some boba and study, or hang out with friends! Overall the best boba place!

Local only
They do not have name brand food here. We came here for dog food after a pooch party cause a coupon was with it. Thought we would find a new place to buy bule Buffalo. NOPE
drove out of the way for nothing. Not looking forward to changing dog food for a temporary time. That would be a terrible mess
Amazing food. A lot to choose from.  Very friendly staff. The flat iron steak lo mein is delicious as well as the Mongolian beef.  Only downside is kinda small portions for the price.

We are moving from Idaho falls to Boise. We called to set up a unit so that we could drop stuff off on a Sunday. Roberta was absolutely amazing! Late on a Sunday night, She happened to be driving by and stopped to see if we needed help. One of my kids were fussy from the drive, she popped her head in and started talking to him to calm him down. She then offered to watch them while we unloaded. She also verified all of our info to make sure that we could get in. Seriously THE BEST customer service I have ever received. I will return to citadel storage for all of my storage needs BECAUSE of Roberta!
older theatre with comfortable seats but you're making me open my purse to check for snacks from home? no thank you - will choose Edwards or the Village in the future.
Always love this place! Korean Salmon w/asparagus & rice and cashew shrimp stir fry. Delicious! Then dessert if banana spring roll! Yummo!

the place is like ikea does hotels!
very small rooms
 eco friendly theme, but it really is more about keeping the overhead low in the name of eco friendliness. 

clean rooms. 
hypoallergenic.
Very good food just the right amount of heat. The fried rice was spectacular. The o no ly thing I wasn't fond of was the hot mustard but you really didn't need to use it the food was so tasty

I've been frequenting Kidz Again for the last two years and went in again yesterday and am writing my review based on my experience yesterday. 

I took in two coats, three pairs of shoes, pants, brand new children's books, and a still sealed Melissa and Doug toy. All name brand (Snozu, Children's Place, GAP, Nike) MAYBE worn once shoes and clothes. My trade in value was $19 for 10 items!!! That's less than $2/item for coats, shoes, clothing, and brand new in original packaging books and toys! Unreal and highway robbery if you ask me. I've had much better experiences selling on Mercari, OfferUp, and LetGo. I feel that I lost money on the unopened items that I paid out of pocket for. I feel that each time I go into Kidz Again the value I receive for my items is less and less. 

The quality of the pre-owned  clothes is pretty shabby expensive for used clothes. I wouldn't bring clothes in that were in donatable state to try to resell. The ONLY reason that I'm giving Kidz Again 1 Star is because they do have brand new clothes and shoes from Costco, Carter's, and Target that are from last season and didn't sell. The selections are severely limited though. I'm not sure that I will be doing trade-ins with Kidz Again in the future for the pure unfairness in value of items. I understand that they're trying to run a business but to literally give a few bucks for brand new and like-new, barely worn items (no stains or worn look from washing) because kids outgrow clothes faster than they can wear them out.

Arguably one of the worst experiences I have had.  Similar to others, hear all the radio ads, thought it would be great.  Haircut wasn't all that bad (might suggest some additional training with the straight razor), but the customer service fell ridiculously short.  
During the haircut, well post-neck shave, I mentioned a couple of times to the stylist that my neck was burning.  She treated it (or so I thought).  Got home and my wife asks me why there is blood on the collar of my shirt.  Turns out she had done a pretty good number on my neck and it was bleeding through my shirt.  So I call and supposedly I'm speaking to the manager.  Essentially tells me that she can't replace or even clean the shirt (not that blood comes out).  Fine - ask for my refund.  "Can't do that."  Call B.S. - company policy or some such nonsense like they are unable to swipe cards to refund charges and ultimately offer for me to come back in for a free haircut.  WHAT'S THE DIFFERENCE - NOW OR LATER? & WHY would I EVER when this is the overall experience I 'enjoyed'.  Tell you what - never had this experience with SportClips whom they are trying to gain marketshare (certainly locally) from.  That said - I mentioned writing a negative review and whether or not that carried any meaning or value to her or the business.  She thought I was threatening to do so - as I said then, I will post a review as I felt I, and others, deserve a much higher level of service and ownership of the mistakes of their employees.
Many other places that actually appreciate your business.

Went with a group of 6. Service was horrible. Food very average at best. Ran out of water before we even got meal. Waitress came by and ask one person at the table if she needed more. Really empty glass and still did not have meal, what do you think. We asked for water for everyone came back with a couple pictures set them on table and left. When she brought food she handed plates across the table. We were sitting at a round table with plenty of room all the way around. I have had better Italian food at the spaghetti warehouse and there food was terrible. Not going back.
Decent wood fired pizza. Nothing to rave about and only one size pizza? A tad pricey for small pizzas.

Went here for the second time to give it a second chance. Mistake. Ordered 2 different sushi rolls the Vegas and the double dragon, both were ok, nothing spectacular. My husband ordered pad tai and I had the drunken stir fry. Both were terrible. His pad tai was very sweet, my chicken dish was too sweet as well. I'm angry that I spent $70 on a meal I hated. I would have been better off at Panda Express. I don't recommend this place if you like Asian food.

Food quality is always good, but this rating is for your customer service. When I had gotten home with my food for everyone I realized the receipt was pricy and that I was charged for something I didn't want and given someone else paid for it, I went back to get the money. Pulling up to the window is when the girl inside decides to tell her coworkers "The B***h is back I'm not dealing with her" someone else helped me fix my problem, but that made me livid that you have someone that rude and childish working for you and I regret wasting my time there.

Trade in beware! They have a coupon out that sounds as if you get an extra 10% on top of the 50% trade in.  But that is not the case,  you actually only get 10% on top of the amount you made from your trade in,  which is significantly less. And I have a hard time trusting a company when they do something that seems deceptively sneaky like that.
Definitely won't be trading in there again
Service was good.  Homemade potato salad and soups.  Fries come with a lite seasoning and crunchy.  Burgers are good and hot.  Note much larger breakfast menu compared to lunch.  Closed for dinner.

I order fried rice and lemon chicken. The chicken itself was good but the lemon chicken sauce didn't taste like lemon at all and they didn't put much sauce on it. The chicken would have been better off just plain.  The fried rice was kind of tasteless.  I ordered pork and seeds on this side and to be honest I put hot mustard and ketchup and seeds on the pork so can't really tell how the pork would have tasted on its own.  I won't order from this restaurant again

Wow!!! Highly impressed by this hotel. It's advertised as a 2 star class hotel but they exceeded our expectations. It was affordable, their customer service was wonderful and they can accommodate pets (under 80 lbs). And just FYI they only have a certain number of pets rooms so call ahead to check if they're available. 

The hotel itself and the room were very clean and to our surprise there was a kitchenette with 4 burner stove, microwave and a full size fridge with ice maker inside. 
The bed was comfy with super fluffy pillows. They have laundry facilities and a small store on site for basic food items like chips, drinks etc.
It was within walking distance of restaurants and really close to shopping centers. 
My only very minor, tiny complaint was there was no silverware in the drawers. 
Anyway, Would highly recommend this place and we were so thankful to find a place where both us and our little dog could rest for the night.

We have always loved shopping at this chain, particularly when it was in Boise.  Last weekend we went to the Meridian store and found some dining room chairs and matching counter stools we wanted.  We had a difficult time finding someone on the floor to help us, but we finally found a young, exasperated woman who was willing to go and see if they had all the ones we wanted.  After waiting over 20 minutes, she returned further exasperated and said they did have them but they were way up in the warehouse and it would be several hours before they could get them down. They asked that we not pay until pick up so we left our contact info and asked that they call us when they were ready to be picked up.  We never heard from them so we called today and reminded them what we were hoping to pick up.  We drove to the store (one week later) and after having to search for someone to help us (everyone seemed annoyed by our questions, we finally found someone who said that someone in the back was getting our chairs down.  We went to see the boxes and they were all the wrong color.  Of course, they don't have enough of the color we want.  Here is the real problem, not one person apologized to us and when we asked if any other store had them, the lady helping us acted like we had just asked her a huge favor so we left.  Later we checked online and found that the chairs were available but the counter stools were not. 
We try to shop locally as much as possible, for one it is nice to touch and feel what you are going to buy and we also want to support our local economy but this experience has sent us running to shop online.  Our experience was time consuming and frustrating so it will be a while before return.
The food was amazing, our waitress (Serenity) was very attentive, and even though it was a slower night (Thursday), the staff was at full strength! Clearly well run! I'll definitely be back!

Fireplace way out of proportion to size of living room, $3,000.00 fridge with no water dispenser ( the one in the showroom does!), sloppy paint job, no telephone outlet.....design services lacking, Hubble real estate agent not at all helpful.

Yummy thai tea! Boyfriend and I had been craving boba for a while and tried several times to go to Boise Boba, but they seemed to close earlier and earlier every time we went, no matter what time it said they closed. We then saw someone mention Urban Fox on a review for Boise Boba and decided to try going there. Do not regret it! Love the atmosphere and the drinks, and the girls working were so nice. Can't wait to go back.
I would rate this as the second best movie theater in Meridian.  Fresh popcorn and I like being able to self butter and salt.  Place is clean and the seats are comfortable.

What a lovely, delicious experience! I had my first Brazilian steakhouse experience in Seoul, South Korea and loved it! This wonderfully decadent, high end, and delicious restaurant is absolute perfection in every way: service, food, atmosphere, and I could happily curl up in their salad bar and live in it! This is a great place to bring out of town guests or have a fun night out at a trendy but yummy and elegant place. We went for lunch and it was a great lunch place. 

While it might seem pricey, the price includes everything, all you can eat, and a beverage.  At lunch it includes dessert. I do not consider it overly expensive for the quality of the experience.

Lovely staff, however, was told they don't accept blue Cross of Idaho insurance.. .really? Since that is pretty much the only provider up here I was shocked to hear that. Since I could not afford the $76 for my prescription and it has been filled already I was grateful that I had a discount card. Of course I can't get my future prescriptions filled here ... Too bad for Walgreens.
No one in the back had a mask on, no one had gloves on. The lady at the front was rude and though she did have a mask she kept taking it off. Very disappointing.
Average Best Western , poor signage.
I give them 2 stars for being creative but the French toast biscuits were a fail. The eggs and bacon were soggy and greasy.

I made an order to go and they said it would take about 20 minutes, it ended up being almost 50 minutes. 

The pho was actually really gross. It had the most odd flavor for beef pho. It almost seemed like it was watered down. 

We really wanted to like this place but unfortunately, we will not be back :-( 

Two stars for effort?

Went to a celebration for my granddaughters end of season softball league last night. My friend and I where the first to arrive and placed our order right away. The room filled up and the last to arrive where the first to be served. We never even got bread or our appetizer even asking for it 3 times. People were finished with their meals and still no food!!! So we left and do not plan on ever coming back. The only reason we had drinks is because I went to the bar to order them. Very poor management, didn't know what she was doing at all. I politely told her why we where leaving. She didn't say anything!!! Very disappointed but the league celebration was great!
I ate take out from here while visiting friends. I talked my friends into trying the Tom Kha Gai soup. It was the best I've had. My friends loved it too. A good reason to revisit Boise Idaho.

I will stick with Tucanos, if I am going to be completely honest. The Flank steak was great, and the lamb was really good, but the salad bar was pitiful, and if you do not drink alcohol there is nothing basically but water, and it was just way overpriced in my opinion. One thing I will commend them on though is when the manager came over and asked how things were, and I said I was out of water, the manager took it upon himself to refill my glass. Nice place maybe for special occasions, but probably will not be going again anytime soon.

This is our go to mechanic shop.  We have had various types of repairs here on many different types of our cars and we have always been satisfied.  Price is very reasonable and all the work we have had done is usually same day.  We have never felt like we were being ripped off, much like we have with other other shops.

I visited a friend in Boise and she took me here to get boba. I got the honeydew milk tea with boba and it was SO good. I liked it so much I came back a 2nd time and I tried their iced short and sweet latte. It was espresso with sweet cream. It literally was one of the best coffee drinks I've ever had. Whenever I come back to the Boise area, this will be one of the first places I'll go to. I definitely recommend checking this place out.
I have been a mail box customer for 8 years. The staff (especially Andrea) is always friendly, efficient and helpful.

Little Miss Mackie and I loveeee going to see Jay at Groomingtails!!!  Hands down the best groomer in town.  So gentle with my 1 pound 1 ounce little chihuahua.  The prices are amazing.  Even better I feel comfortable and SAFE leaving her there while I run errands and she gets a bath to get all pretty.  The bf and I spoil our puppy like she's our child.  For God's sake she has a Juicy Couture collection already.  Since she is SO SPOILED, we're very careful with who we leave her with. I took my first chihuahua, Kingston, to Jay since he was around the corner from my apartment and I really didn't know of any great groomers in the area.  I was so glad I made that choice! From that day forward, Kingston, then Deucey and now Miss Mackie all enjoy going to Groomingtails!  Even more so, they LOVE their little bandannas after their bath.  It feels nice knowing your leaving them with someone that enjoys what they're doing.  I'd recommend to anyone and everyone!
Boba is good. Butterfly lemonade is pretty drink;) price is very good. Atmosphere is great! Very cute boutique like. They did great with design.

Dr. Nicola and his team are the best. I researched extensively, met with two other surgeons, and selected Dr. Nicola. I had total knee replacement on August 24th and six weeks later I was playing golf again. Everything went perfect. Dr. Nicola has an excellent "bedside manner". His PA who assists in the surgeries, Craig Jamison, is also excellent. "Thanks Craig, my scar is barely noticeable." I believe Dr. Nicola and his team are the best in the Treasure Valley for total knee replacement.

New to the area and just needed a routine cleaning on top of consultation about some jaw pain, and was treated wonderfully. Excellent staff, very prompt and attentive, and in a very comfortable office. Thanks Riverbend!

Staff was great, the protein kept coming. We kept loosing the green and red paper so we just have that up. The salad bar seemed a bit fussy and we really wanted pineapple on a skewer. The salad bar stuff had an odd flavor. Pretty pricey but like I said the meat was very good and made the entire experience worth it. Get Pineapple and we will be back.

I was a bit nervous to go here due to the older reviews, but the more recent ones were good, so I decided to give them a chance. I came here to get something notarized. They were professional, fast, and friendly. I am super glad to have had a good experience because I have a UPS business account and often need to ship through them. Ignore the older reviews and go here if you need to. I will be back.

I went here with my mom a couple days ago and we both got dip polish on our fingers. I have been getting dip on my nails for over 2 years now with another salon but I wanted to try a new place. The whole time I was there, none of the workers seemed like they really knew what they were doing. Usually dip lasts about 4 weeks but two days after I went here, my mom and I both had nails already starting to chip and peel off which should not be happening. They charged me more than any other place I've been and I am very disappointed in this experience.
Ling and Louies is great.  Food is flavorful. Kids eat free on Sundays.  Cant beat that.  Only reason for 4 stars is their portion sizes are alittle small. I would recommend the generals chicken.

We can't be happier with the service and care our precious little Rosebud (all 3.7 lbs of....well, our best guess is a Scottie/Chiahuahua mix) has been receiving.  She was having difficulty breathing so we knew we had to get her into a vet.  The question was "Who do go to?"  We haven't been here that long and finding a "good" vet is like finding a good doctor, dentist, mechanic, etc.  I live right down the road and see that their sign always has a great message and a picture of a dog of the week, so I thought this would be a great place to start with.  I just felt that they would be a caring place.

Well, I was right.  My husband took in Rosebud and he said that Dr. Fisher was very kind and caring over our precious fur-baby.  She took x-rays and saw that Rosebud has a tumor on her lungs.  She was very patient and thoroughly explained some of our options and said that my husband and I could discuss it and let them know what direction we wanted to take.  She sent home a cough syrup to help alleviate Rosebud's coughing fits and it really worked well.  She also told us to give her some chicken and rice to help increase her appetite and wow! What a difference that and the cough syrup made.  My husband went back in today and saw Dr. Kara and she too, was incredibly sweet and caring and patiently answered all of my husband's questions.

Of course, we will be looking into cancer treatment for her, but I just had to Yelp about the wonderful, caring, patient, understanding and wonderful team they have at this veterinary hospital.  I feel very comfortable knowing that they care more for the animal and their owners than just their pocketbook.  Vets we have dealt with in the past, just seem to want to push whatever "they" want or feel is best for their pockets.  I am so glad we found this place and can now rest knowing our little Rosebud is in great hands.
THANK YOU MERIDIAN VETERINARY HOSPITAL!!
Usually not that bad a wait. Pretty good breakfast diner. It's a Monday and else have been here for an hour so far no food.

Everything was great! We want to come back for the drinks. I can't remember what everyone got exactly.

Stupid comment but I kind of wish they put that the breakfast burrito is SPICY. It said chipotle sauce but that's usually not too bad. This was inedible (for me) but had great flavor. I literally was unable to eat it unfortunately. My step dad who likes spicy was even sweating, so it wasn't just me lol

Also I have had the pancakes several times, two first times were great but the third time it tasted like cornmeal and onion. Not appealing for a pancake...not sure if this was a one off or if they changed the recipe.

Overall it's a great place to eat and recommend it to everyone. They have some amazing cocktail and drink options as well, which again we are going to try eventually.

I took some pants in for dry cleaning and the job was excellent. They even asked if I wanted creases and did it with no extra charge. I don't know if that is done at other dry cleaners but it was very nice to have it done. Seems like a very good price to me and the service was done in.1 day.

PARENT REVIEW: I was nervous this hotel would be "cheap" with thin walls, crappy beds, crappy tv ect BUT I was totally wrong! 
PROS:
-Awesomely huge LG 4K tv
-Comfy beds (not to hard or to soft)
-The fan is smooth
-Theres a actually night light in the bathroom (but we used it in the room for our 1 year old, yes you can move it! Yay!) 
-There's a mini fridge
- HUGE lobby area with fun seating and cool games (there's a pool table and tons of board games!) 
-THE FRONT DESK STAFF IS AWESOME! They very sweet and actually seem like they care! (Side note: I called the front desk to ask about checkout time, she asked If she could put me in a brief hold of course I said yes and then I figured I'd just call back later since it wasn't very important. A couple minutes later we got a call to our room, I thought it was very nice that they called us back VERY quickly even though I know it was prime check in time) 
-the room was big enough to fit a play pin in comfortably! 

CONS:
-The water gets literally SCORCHING hot so be careful if you have younger kids that are independent.
- they don't have any healthy snacks like fruit out in the lobby just a lot of junk food so make sure to bring your own! 
-that's about all, just picky little things. 

I will definitely be staying here again if we need to! I love the price and the place!

I was staying nearby and ordered a yelp recommended double chicken mushroom burger with one fried and one grilled. Beautiful.

The service was great, I'll definitely be back

Initially the job went well, but when I went out and reviewed all of the work, I found problems, screws and staples left in the field, they used the wrong screws to attached cross brace.  They came back to fix and they still did not get it right, so we agreed to try a third time.  Lack of attention to detail.  They did write off the final bill, but they tried to blame me saying I had reviewed their work before they left, that was a lie.   Wish I could add pictures of the work.

I always find this store to have a great selection of clothes. I have a hard time finding boys clothes for my 3 year old boy, that are in good condition. This store never disappoints! Prices are so reasonable. Paid on average $3 per item.

Wish they had a bigger shoe selection, but I guess they are at the mercy of what others bring in.

I have never brought anything in to sell, but it appears to be a very organized process.

I find this consignment store to be better than the others in that, they are so organized and have so much room so things are not crammed together. Love that they categorize clothes by color. So helpful!

They also sell maternity clothes, toys, baby furniture, etc.

Worst experience I've ever had at a "high end" restaurant. Food was disgusting, I spit the flank steak out it was horrible. Asked for well done or medium well and i got nothing even close. I would never ever eat here again!! Also asked for a soda never got it but they didn't forget to charge me for it!!Then when I brought up to management how bad food was and the extra charge. Took 14 bucks off the bill and sarcastically asked if I wanted it to go. I spent 200 on the worst dinner here!! I'll never be back here because of the horrible food and bad service. WILL NEVER RECOMMEND!!!

I've been going to Jersey Mike's for years. Today I went to the one in Meridian. I ordered a cheesestake with mushrooms. It was $10.60 for a regular. When I  opened up my sandwich it had 3 half mushrooms inside! I brought it back and spoke to the general manager and she told me that was the portion size. I laughed   what a rip off for the extra money! I couldn't even see the mushrooms in the sandwich.  The cook had to pick it apart and show me the 3 little pieces but the general manager still said that was the portion. So I returned it and got a refund with no apology and best of all I received an attitude which was unprofessional for a manager to treat a customer! Hopefully corporate will see this review and retrain this rude general manager also I had to ask her name 3 times before she gave me her last name.

The staff and manager went above and beyond to correct an error.  We had an order to go and came all the way back to Boise and took a couple bites before realizing that that our gluten free order of Jeweled Beef had regular noodles containing wheat.  The manager took responsibility, apologized, gave us a gift certificate and delivered us a new order of gluten free Jeweled Beef!  Very impressed, very pleased, and looking forward to returning.

I would give zero stars if I could. I was getting a full set and asked for thin nails. They were looking thick and I reminded her to thin them out. Before painting I told her I didn't like them. She explained that she couldn't thin them out because they'd break. I've had my nails done for years and explained this to her. After painting I asked to take them off because I didn't like them. She refused, I paid and she said to never come back! The worse nails and service I've ever received!!!! I shouldn't have paid for them!

When I need a specific item, this place usually has it! I haven't had luck on the shoes lately, but clothing I'm able to find when my kids need it.
For resale, it's worth it if you're going to donate anyway. They come out to your car, pick up the items, then call or text you the amount they will offer. Cash is a little less than store credit. They will donate the rest to The ARC if you pick that option. In my opinion, they don't give you much money, but if I'm just going to donate it anyway, it's worth it to me to get some credit. And I don't have to stay in the store and wait!
Jake the bartender is a cool guy. And they have tons of brews on tap. Nice cozy downstairs for smaller groups.
Wow what an amazing place to shop. Great staff and great assortment of sports and outdoors items. Good mix of high end products and good deals!

DONT DONT DONT whatever you do Absolute worst place I've ever been they have no customer service skills whatsoever could care less that you're a patient at all I would definitely NOT recommend to any person values their time any bit at all

Lasagna! Maybe you are tired of it or maybe you just haven't had it in a while. I was a little of both until I became inspired! If you have had Sicilian pizza, you know that that the topping is not always the featured ingredient. Like some Sicilian slices, marinara is the topping on Louie's Lasagna. This marinara sauce I'm talking about is delicious! The lasagna itself is familiar in texture but the layers and ingredients are nothing without this sauce.
Our group went with a family style meal. The alfredo was light and one pan had artichoke hearts added. The garlic toast was ok. I was very impressed with the amount of dressing choices and elected to go with traditional Caesar, which I enjoyed!
I honestly can't wait to bring my family and dine in the private family area!
Always greeted when we go in. Staff is amazing. Some of the best tasting burgers. Warning they serve big portions! Clean and love the atmosphere!

I would give no stars if that were possible.  I didn't have an appointment but dropped in for a pedicure.  There was only one other customer in the salon.  I don't know the name of the woman who did my pedicure but she didn't seem to care about the quality of her work and did the spa pedicure in 30 minutes flat.  I've never had one take less than 45-60 minutes. She never said a word to me the whole time she did the pedicure. Didn't push or trim my cuticles, and the foot massage was a joke. Then  charged me $35 for it.  It would also be nice if they posted a sign that they accept cash only. On the door or smack in the middle of the desk.  Where it is clearly visible. I see on their Yelp page that they do in fact take credit cards. They told be specifically that they take cash only.  I don't carry cash so using their ATM to get cash costs me an additional fee simply for me to patronize their business.  Not one employee said "hello, " how are you", "thank you", "good by", or anything.  Won't be going there again. And won't recommend them either. It would be a much better business practice if you practiced a little better customer service and interacted with customers who are there for the first time. It is the way you grow your business.  You have a lot of competition in this area....one right across the street and I hear they are wonderful and serve their customers with a smile and are welcoming.

Watch out for this one. I had scheduled aeration service with Senske in April, which they repeatedly cancelled and rescheduled. Eventually they stopped calling entirely. This was both strange and frustrating but I was just going to let it go considering the COVID situation. Come August and I receive a bill in the mail for the aeration in June, which had never been done.  Either their techs cannot read an address and they served the wrong place, or, and I hate to think this, their techs lied about providing service.   I suppose it is also possible their automated system puts together bills based on schedule and not on actual verified work. In any case, if I had signed up for a service that wouldn't have been as obvious as aeration, such as spraying for weeds or bugs, I wouldn't have known about this problem and would have paid for nothing. I will not be attempting to hire Senske again for any future service, nor would I recommend others to do so.

Great job, stress free and a very happy girl! Looking good!
Arrived early and good thing, Bella was way over due for a cut. 
Jay's experience is quite evident. 
Highly recommended and the price was well earned!

WARNING: QUIK WOK IS NOT QUICK!!!

I ordered food to be delivered to feed my family at 6:25PM. The food arrived at 9:15PM; the kids had already gone to bed (school tomorrow). The delivery guy copped an attitude when I told him he wasn't getting a tip, because the food was so late. I live about a half mile away from the restaurant. I called the manager. I told her I wasn't happy the food was room temperature and late and gave her every opportunity to make things right. She said the best she could do was discount my next meal 15% for the inconvenience. 

Report Card:

Food Quality = D (may be lower if I get sick tonight)

Food Value = D (fried rice shouldn't cost 8 dollars)

Service = F (manager's attempt to make things right was anemic); Not even the delivery fee of 3 dollars paid in advance was refunded!

In summary, once you place your order and pay for it online, including delivery fee, you are locked in and will get your food when they decide you should get your food... in this case hours later.

I will tell my friends to go to Fusion Grill instead, basically same price, much better food!
Place was so good! Regionally would come back! Breakfast of champions right here for sure!!

How have I not tried this pizza before? It's so close to where we live and DAMN is it delicious!! 

We ordered carry out during COVID19. The team took my payment over the phone, passed my boxed pizzas by scooting them across the counter and had hand sanitizer on the way out. 

We ordered 2 pizzas, a pepperoni and a veggie. The veggie was a nice assortment and not too packed full. The pepperoni was so good. It's clear that they source really good pepperoni. Tastes like it's sliced right off the link! The crust is thin with the sweet smokiness of a wood fire oven. The tomato sauce is deep and slightly sweet. We loved it.
Amazing place! Great vibes. My favorite is the sheppards pie! I love the Pretzel and cheese appetizer! Great place to try new drinks too!

Tried this location because it's convenient and was prayingvthe service was better than the state street location. No dice, same care free (couldn't care less) service and mediocre product. $14 for a large sub is a crime. 

Go to subway. At least then you can leave without feeling like you were robbed blind.

I'd recommend literally any other sandwich shop in the Valley.

I was very disappointed with the way this facility scheduled appointment. I called and had my appointment at a set time and they call me 10 min before to cancel. I drove 45min and was already at the facility. Please be aware of your patients time. Very upset with how they handled everything.

If you're interested in a medical staff that truly cares for their patients, look mo further than Summit Family Health and for me, Dr. Angela Pellant. Dr Pellant has been my family's primary care provider for 10 years. 

We first selected her out of convenience to our home. We moved across town to follow her because she is that great. When we have those unexpected needs for her care or that of the other staff, they always find a way to squeeze us in. She, her nurse Allia, have gotten to know each member of my family and are able to converse with us about more than what's written on our charts. We love them. 

Care for all, friendly staff and doctors that treat the whole person. If you want amazing service, give them a call. Truly 5 stars!

My stay was only for 3 nights and I didn't spend much time in the lobby, so my review will be primarily about the room.  First, let me say that all the staff were incredibly warm and welcoming; I had no difficulties with checking in or out and I felt like a valued guest.  That said, the rooms are not spacious and have very few amenities.  Specifically, there is a mini-fridge and a television, and that's about it.  There was free DirecTv, but programming kept being interrupted because the signal was poor.  Housekeeping won't come unless you request it, which I actually like, but it would be nice if the room was well stocked with towels.  The bathrooms have dispensers for hand soap and body wash that you have to squeeze and God only knows how many people had touched them before me.  Just not a good idea during a pandemic.  There was no closet in the room; just a small bar with hangers and 3 hooks on the wall.  The entire hotel is painted with bright colors that give you more a dorm room feel than an hotel.  I don't recommend staying here.

I had an amazing experience at this store. My baby girl is 9 months and I haven't been able to get my hair cut or trimmed for about over a year. I baby wear my baby and don't have anyone to watch her. I went in to the Ulta salon and Stephanie had no problems cutting my hair standing up while I wore my baby. She even interacted with my baby. To all the mothers out there you know just how much this means to a mother. My hair looks so much better and I was able to get it done with my baby and all. Thank you so much Stephanie! To top it all off every single employee that walked past me while I was waiting asked if I needed help and even had a conversation with me.

I've been wanting to come here for a while and finally made it. Went on Saturday during lunch and was very busy, naturally things were a bit slower, but staff and food were great! I'll plan to go back at more "off" times. Like the variety on the menu and prices are reasonable. Going to over analyze this one but initial impression on the burger was slight disappointment due to meat patty smaller than bun. As I ate, patty was thicker than expected and with the deliciousness of the burger and the bacon, I decided to forget about the initial appearance. Fries were everything I wanted them to be after looking at pictures and would proudly eat a large order by myself the next time. I already feel like I need one of their t-shirts.

They offer masks at the front door, this is really a welcomed change from other stores in the area.  However, their inventory seems really low. Wanted a children's book and there just weren't many left. Along with a Birthday Present and the toy selection is minimal.  We waited quite a long time to use self check, but the place was just really busy.

Omg!! The chicken and biscuit was incredible. The chicken was so delicious and don't get me started on the gravy.  I had my eggs over medium and it was perfect on top. I loved that they used red potatoes instead of russet. The meal is large enough for 2 possibly 3! I am so glad I found this place. MMmmMMmmm!! Going to definitely bring family here. Time for a nap :)
Biggest pancakes I've ever seen! Place has a friendly great atmosphere. Food was fantastic, portions were large, and service was top notch! Will definitely be a repeat customer!

The owners here are awesome and have a great facility in Meridian. They accommodate athletes for whatever they may be training for and keep the facility cleaner than your typical gym. You will definitely get a killer workout whether it be weight training or cardio!
The place reeks like bad BO.  You can smell it the moment you step in.

Incredibly rude old woman working today. 
Just quit if you hate your job. 
A simple hello and less of an attitude would have prevented this. But of course this miserable old woman wants everyone to feel what she is feeling inside of her.

The service was extremely slow, salad options not near a normal Texas de Brazil. Meat dry as can be, medium rare? The meat options aren't the same as a normal Texas de Brazil, as well as the small salad bar. Had meat brought by maybe every 10 minutes. Terrible service, first time and don't know if I can come back. Once again, service was awful, slow, and the workers almost looked confused.

From the time we texted them for a quote to the end of the project, we were very pleased with their customer service and work!  We texted at 8pm and they responded letting us know they were leaving their last job for the day and will get us a quote in 15 mins.  I informed them they can send me a quote the next day.  They sent us a quote the very next morning!  Very prompt!  They were able to schedule us a week later.   They arrived earlier than expected!  They cleaned our windows inside and outside.  It looks AMAZING!!  You will not be disappointed !  We will definitely use their service again!

I've tried a variety of fitness classes and this is by far the best. Individualized coaching, plenty of options, and a variety of workouts. It's never the same. My body is improving and my fun run times are getting better. I love this place!
Kyle did a great job painting the inside and outside!  Very affordable and fast!

29th reviewer of Ed's 50's Cafe Meridian, Idaho. 
This is my 391st review. A-OK. 
They are open 7 days a week and only mornings- early afternoon.

Location is excellent! It's right next to the McDonalds on Meridian Rd., in front of Winco and right off the Freeway. Inside is classically decorated with cars and more vintage 50's theme items such as the iconic Marilyn Monroe. 

I ordered the chopped salad and my partner ordered an omelet. The food, to both of us, was meh-- just ok-- nothing to write home about.  The staff was friendly, and it appeared that they have been there a long time because they had a bunch of regulars that walked in the door. 

It's worth a stop by-- especially if you're into vintage cars and 50's theme.According to the Yelp photos-- their take on the classic milk shake looks pretty good!

All I had was an irish cream breve, but it was a darn good one. The location is really hip and stylish, yo. The Village is basically U-Village in Seattle's U-District. This coffee shop offers high custom ability, a few pastry options. The menu is a tad overwhelming, but the staff was friendly in helping me pick out a drink.

This was our first time here, and it was amazing! The food tasted excellent, and was priced more than fair. The service was great too. I had the gluten free pizza, and it was so good.  The crust was very tasty, and not greasy like other places. Looking forward to coming back again soon!

After living in Idaho for almost a year I finally ate at Big Jud's.  It came highly recommended from a lot of friends & I had seen the episode of Man Vs Food. 

We (me, the hubs, my 13 y/o son, & my ex mother in law (don't ask! Lol. She actually lives with us!) arrived at Big Jud's on a Wednesday around 7pm. We walked in and were greeted by a very nice host. I was surprised by this because I always thought Big Jud's was a fast food establishment like Fat Burgers or Five Guys. The host was able to seat us immediately and told us our server would be with us soon. 
After about 5 minutes our server arrived and took our food & drink order. We got:
Big Jud's special with onion rings
Bleu Bacon Burger
Double Pastrami Burger
Small fry (free with the purchase of 2 burgers)
3 deep fried Twinkies 
2 pepsi's (1 drink was included with the Big Jud Special)
2 waters

It took about 10 minutes to get our drinks. It wasn't super busy so I'm not sure why it took so long.  However, our food made it out in a reasonable amount of time. I was really impressed with the food.  I expected the Big Jud to be a mess of ingredients slipped onto a huge bun, but it wasn't that at all. The condiments were not overpowering, the veggies were plentiful and the last bite tasted as good as the first.  Overall Big Jud's is a good burger joint and is definitely worth trying.

This place is pretty meh. Good for boba, but not much of a cafe like it's advertised. It's chilly and not super comfortable. Their pastries are average and so is the coffee. Pretty mediocre for a boba shop.

food is good, but called in for takeout and was told it would be 20 minutes which would have been fine, but got there when they said it would be ready and had to wait another over 30 minutes. made us late to an event and staff was also unfriendly.
Friendly service, great atmosphere and delicious food! The portions are HUGE so bring an appetite. I definitely recommend this place.

Honestly this isn't even for the store just UPS in general. I typically have really good service with them but this time it was awful. They didn't even provide valid information or updated info for any packages I ordered and when they did it was when they were already closed. So now I don't even get any of my items on time. It's so frustrating and I feel, unprofessional to have to deal with this. This whole issue could have been avoided had they used a more efficient source to track packages. I received all my information too late and it was pretty much pointless. I'm done dealing with their lack of communication for tracking. Definitely finding elsewhere to ship my things.

It's the last couple minutes before they close and I walk in with an aquarium fiasco. So much that I brought a sample of regular house water previously to check because we've only had an aquarium for 30 years and have never had this annoying water mess.  

Anyway-awesome everyone pitched in,  came up with ideas and solution as well as offering for us to bring our filter in for further evaluation. Definitely will be back!

Wow. Just wow. I cannot believe the experience I had. It almost feels like I'm stuck in a nightmare. 
I went in to see Alyssa Guzman to have my hair cut and highlighted. My hair was virgin hair, since I had a pixie previously and I decided to grow it out during the pandemic to allow for new growth. My hair was completely color free and natural. I had expressed that I wanted my hair color to look like the photo (screenshot) but I understood that it may be a little different. I expressed to Alyssa that what mattered most was that it had the same tone as the photo and that the highlights were placed like the photo. We agreed that the photo was "caramel" colored highlights on top of a dark chocolate brown. That is what I asked for. 
Alyssa stated that she wanted to color my whole head first and then go back in and "lighten", aka bleach, my highlights in. I specifically asked her if that would cause problems since she was trying to bleach what she had colored and she assured me that because "aveda products are made from plants, there wouldn't be any problems". I trusted her. She told me that she had been a stylist for 11 years and I trusted that she would do a good job, I was completely wrong for placing my trust in her. 
After the color was finished, she began placing highlights. I sat with foils under the heat for a timed 10 minutes the first time, then she checked and sat me for another 6 minutes. My foils sat for 16 minutes after she had finished painting them. 
After she rinsed me, she toned the first time. She took me to blow dry and we both had a look of shock as to the new YELLOW colored highlights. I expressed that it wasn't the tone I asked for and I showed her the picture again confirming that I wanted a soft caramel tone, so she toned them again. The next 2 tones she did, it turned more and more orange. She left the toner on for 3 minutes the first time and 2 minutes the last time. More and more orange it turned. After the 3rd time toning and with no change, her attitude turned sour. She scrubbed my head aggressively and so harshly that it physically hurt me. She threw the towel aggressively on top of my head and said "go to the chair". I kept telling her that I was unhappy with the tone and she said "well it will match your husband (a red head) in photos coming up." She stopped saying that she was mixing for caramel and started saying that she was going for a "copper" tone. I told her multiple times that I didn't want copper; I wanted a soft caramel like the picture. She responded "Well you're one of those people that is looking at reality versus expectations." 
Asking for a better toned hair is not unrealistic. 
She kept saying "aveda products are weird. You have to guess every time you put something together". She said "it's chemistry and it can be hard" and she said "as upset that you are, I am just as upset that it didn't turn out" 
The time had turned to about 6:45pm (appointment started at 3:15) and she said "I don't have time to blow dry you, just take a photo tomorrow when it's dry and send me a picture." 
I was shocked. So I left the salon with wet, orange hair. She charged me $200 for this disaster of a cut and color.

She messaged me on Facebook that night apologizing that the color didn't turn out and that she was upset that I was sad and disappointed. Before I could respond to her message, she blocked me. I don't understand the whole text or the reason for even sending it.

The last few times I've been here it's been a really crappy experience. The food was good but it really doesn't matter if you don't have good service. 
We weren't greeted, one of the servers or bussers threw menus on our table and walked away. She never gave us a kids menu for our child. 15 minutes went by and still no server. I wanted to walk out.
We never got coffee refills, and the servers ignored us whenever we needed anything. We ended up having to be those assholes that get up out of their seat to wave down a server for the check after waiting almost 20 minutes after we were finished with our food.
They either need to hire more staff or be better organized. I brought in out of towners and I was bummed it was such a crappy experience.

Came here for a yelp event! Amazing service with super nice staff. Coffee and boba were delicious! Plenty of comfy seating options. 2 restrooms for all genders. Lots of natural light in the space. Very modern/boho decor that makes the space feel homey. No free WiFi, but you can ask the sweet staff for the password. I got mango milk tea with strawberry popping boba and the mango snow ice. My mom got the almond milk tea and it wasn't my favorite because it was super sweet! Anyways, lovely place with great staff. :)
They are always closed because they "don't have employees" so dumb tbh just wanted Burger King but no they had to close early

First off the food is fantastic drinks are also fun and great but be aware the service for dine in isn't always fantastic. The location can be hard to find parking if busy but still great place for the restaurant. 
We did try to go on a Sunday which we knew it was going to be busy but I arrived at 1030 to look at getting on the list for a table for 5, they do not do call a heads or reservations. Was told it would be a 2 hour wait which I expected a to wait but not 2 hours. We decided to wait it out anyways since most of our party hadn't arrived yet anyways. We waited about an hour before checking in the with hosts as we did watch a lot of people leave and not maybe people going in they still didn't have anything. Another 30 minutes and a different member goes up to ask and finally we're given the option to take a booth and add a chair which had been available for at least the past hour. So we were absolutely starving. 
The server was kind and repeated our orders back to us as we ordered she recommended drinks and explained the menu as it was our first time. Once the food arrived there was something wrong or missing from everyone's plate. Most just wrong sides and when trying to replace they were out of fresh fruit so swapped for something else. However one of our plates was completely the wrong dish. Still ate it, minus one plate that needed to be remade, and enjoyed but when brought up to the server she made it seem like it was our fault that she had heard the other dish instead but she had repeated back the correct dish when ordering. Not really taking the responsibility and blaming others. So that wasn't the coolest thing also after working as a server it was shocking that so many things went wrong with the ordering and not a single manager or anyone came to the table. We are a very relax low maintenance group but I could only image if we were five "Karens". 
Once again the food was fantastic, if this was based solely on the food it would be a 5 star but the long unnecessary wait knocks .5 stars and the server easy knocked it down 2. You could come here and have a great time with your friends, expect longer waits during the peak times though!

Clint gave good advice and instead of snaking my drains and having to charge me the full price he recommended I go with a conservative option of Roto-rooter pipe seal fluid first. I appreciated that because he could have easily snaked my drains (that were not clogged) and went about his day and got more $$ out of me potentially when it was not needed. Clint is very experienced and knowledgeable. This business has a customer for life because was my positive experience both with Roto-rooter where I moved from and now the one here in the Treasure Valley.

They have really good chicken teriyaki and orange chicken. The fried rice is made with different meats and also good. Love the gyoza's with the dipping sauce. The downfall about this place is that they nickel and dime you for everything. Every sauce is an extra $.25 and now the containers that the sauce comes in is half the size. You can only order any of the meats in a platter with only plain fried rice. All of the fried rice with meat have to be ordered separate without any of the stable meats. You can't substitute anything. They force you to order stuff you don't want but have to pay for just to get the meat!! When you get through ordering your chicken platter your separate pork fried rice your Gyoza's then having to pay extra for sauces the price really starts to add up and you end up walking out spending $50 on some Asian fast food and it's not even enough to feed a family of 4.

Worst place ever!!! Do not eat here! Chicken has no flavor and undercooked! Vegetables served with no dressing or anything! The most disgusting place we have ever ate!! Waste of money! 
Go anywhere but here!! Nothing like what their pictures look like!

We were told our house would be cleaned in 14 hours. When we checked progress at the end of the day there wasn't a single room completely finished. We were told there were some difficult areas and more time spent on them but even those areas were not completely cleaned. The master bathroom shower still had soap scum, mildew, hard water stains, etc. Upon contacting the company my wife was told the house had not been cleaned in years so more time would be needed. My wife was able to easily remove some of the gunk around the shower door with a sponge and no cleaning additive. We promptly recorded this to show it would come off with little effort. A supervisor showed up and confirmed shower would come clean by scrapping off some soap scum with just a fingernail. This has convinced us that very little cleaning effort was put in despite being told multyiple cleaning crews came in and 4+ hours spent in the master bath alone. We now have to finish the cleaning ourselves and reschedule the painters do to the poor and incomplete cleaning. We were ready to pay for more cleaning up until we saw what 14 hours yields. We are so disappointed in their cleaning services and lack of effort to make this right. Will never use them again and will not recommend to any friends or enemies. Thanks for wasting our time and money!
Great atmosphere, sweet employees! Good boba (: I'm satisfied with this business, and has become one of my new favorite spots for study and meet ups!

I am a delivery driver for a third party app. This was my first time here. I must say. This place smelled delicious walking in the door. And they were very busy. Not surprised because it's a Sunday. I walked to the register and I have to be frank. Both ladies that I felt with both were very smug and did not seem happy. Both of which felt the need to try and pass that terrible attitude my way. Not happening. I was not greeted at all either. I had to ask  for assistance. The looks that I was getting as if I was in the way or that it was a hassle to help me. Eventually I had a second lady tell me AFTER I was told by the first one that I should wait to be helped at the register which is where I went. I had placed my delivery bag on the counter and the second lady had grabbed my delivery bag and said for me to not place that one there. She was so rude and just miserable. She went on to tell me that the register area was for PAYING CUSTOMERS only. Uhhhh what's is this third party delivery system then? This is a PREPAID order that I am simply picking up and delivering. Yes, I may not be the person laying but I am representing a customer who ALREADY PAID. Back to this second lady, she proceeds to tell me that there is an area they specified and that it's by the sign. Well this SIGN was actually FULL BLOCKED with a stack of THEIR take or menus so no, I didn't see it. And I let her know this and she had the "oh shit" look on her face because she was being incredibly rude. My point is that I really hope some one checks these ladies because they were incredibly rude and unpleasant and I personally think that it's a bad representation of an establishment that seems to be much more than what these two ladies are capable of offering.

If you're looking for a good beer selection you must check out Prefunk! Also if there's a line at Flatbread across the street, they let you order food and they deliver it to you!! Sweet!! The service is so great. Evan (the owner?) even let us take a look behind the scenes at all the kegs. He let us taste test the selection to find what we wanted. They have trivia nights on Wednesday and live music on weekends. I live in meridian and didn't even realize this place was here. I plan on coming back very soon!

Have given this place a chance multiple times and it's not my style. The general tso chicken is always tough and hard to chew. The sweet and sour pork was also very tough. Rice seemed slightly undercooked or just old. I've had 4 day old reheated chinese food that tasted better than this did fresh.

The atmosphere is nice, but the food was very mediocre, especially for the price they charge I was expecting a lot more, the meat was extremely dry, and oddly seasoned, their side dishes are bland. Definitely won't be going back.

Jeff is absolutely wonderful!  We are new here and were looking for someone that was affordable, reliable, knowledgeable, efficient, and pleasant to work with and that is exactly what we found with Jeff.  

We just had to drop off our paperwork and within a couple of hours, we got a call that everything was ready! WOW!  He sat us down, explained every item, gave us some great advice and we were done.  Doing taxes has never been so effortless, or friendly, and we were thrilled at his excellent service.  Jeff made it quite enjoyable, and he even gave me the envelope and printed out the label for our State taxes for us, now THAT is customer service.

We have definitely found our new "forever" tax preparer and I would highly recommend Jeff to everyone.

I ordered the traditional benny with Idaho fries. Wow! So delicious! Their Idaho fries are some of the best breakfast style potatoes I've ever had. Also, the staff are super friendly. Definitely coming back here! Keep it up Hogs!
We ordered a small pan of cheese ravioli the other night for curbside pick up. It's $5 to add a salad and breadsticks - a perfect meal for the 5 of us! It was delicious!

This place makes me so happy. They really respect the social distance guidelines and take great pride in both their customer and employee relations. Everyone who works there seems to work as a team and be helpful towards each other and their customers. I'm happy with the product every time I leave because they are consistent.

Freedommaid is a business that is dedicated to customer satisfaction. They get the job done better then my own satisfaction. They are dressed professional when they come to a house and they make sure to get the job done right. The owners are very family oriented which tells me they care for me not just as a number buts true and dear client. Choose Freedommaid they won't disappoint.

OK so Fast Eddies was bought by Jacksons and the new owners have removed all traces of the prior owners.  It was the best convenience store in the state.  I doubt the new owners will keep the large flower vases out front.  There seems to be a lower customer service level and the lines seem to have gotten longer.  But no worries the new owners have put the condoms up in the front of the store in the candy aisle where you will be standing with your kids.  Keeping things classy aren't we Jacksons?  One of the best things about the prior owners was the wide range of strange new food products at the cash registers.  You know, strange oreo flavors, weird new M&Ms that kind of stuff.  It's all gone, replaced by 5 hour drinks and cigarette lighters.  Why no condoms?  The bathrooms have been dirtier too.  Honestly, if the service or product  changes much more I would recommend you drive another mile down the road where the gas is cheaper.  Still an above average convenience store.

My first time at Ling and Louie's, for lunch, was really a treat! We decided we wanted to try several things so my mom had a ginger margharita (delicious!) and I had a Belgian White Ale that was crisp, smooth and full of flavor. We split 2 appetizers--chicken lettuce cups and siamese spring rolls-- and both were great. The spring rolls had a very unique and fresh taste, not greasy in any way and the ingredients, the sweet chile sauce, and the fresh chopped thai basil really made them better than any spring rolls I have ever had, and I am a spring roll snob! We also split the Evil Jungle Princess chicken which is a very spicy dish, but they were able to give us a less spicy version which was perfect. This would be a dish I would recommend, again as unique, and fabulous with the brown rice! We had leftovers to take home as it was a lot of food for 2 people.

Our server, Angie, was also wonderful. Very friendly and attentive, without being over the top. And our food came quickly.

Ling & Louies decor is the icing on the cake. The wall colors, the stone, the glass waterfall, the lamps, everything was beautiful and made for a relaxing and fun environment.

On our way out, because it was our first visit, we were given a little packet with 2 "fortunate cookies" which were one of the best ginger cookies ever! I am also a ginger cookie snob. I will go back and I look forward to trying the Louie's American fare, although there are so many great things on the fusion menu, I am not sure when I will get to the American items. I highly recommend Ling & Louie's for a great time and a great meal!

Delicious!! I loved eating here! Their chicken is seriously amazing, and it is HUGE. Biggest chicken tenders you will ever have in your life, but still so yummy. The fries were great too. I'll definitely go again!

The location was clean and the ladies were very busy. My stylist was Megan and she was excellent.She was very kind and made sure I was comfortable and gave me a excellent hair cut. I would recommend her to anyone I will be a return customer of hers.

Awesome burgers. Awesome price. Awesome service.  Burgers are hand pressed and fries are fresh.

I've been to all of the Big Kid's locations: the old Boise one, the one in Archer, ID, the one in Ashton, ID, and this location.  Try it. You won't be sorry.

You'd think all UPS Stores would be created equal, right??  Whelp . . . based on my recent experience that seems to not be the case. 

I'm assisting with an online business that will most likely have lots of future shipping needs and have been exploring my options on pricing, as well as, most importantly ease of logistics on completing my visit.  I recalled this particular location as I frequent this shopping center and it was near my home so I thought let's give it a go!

There were only 2 other people in the store when I entered and 2 employees working. Not bad, for being in the Holiday season. When it was my turn, I explained what my needs were and that I had a UPS account I would like to use. I was immediately told that they only took pre-printed labels or I'd have to pay there. Neither of these was an option. So I asked where the closest place was that I could actually use my UPS account #. I was told there was a UPS HUB that just opened over on Silverstone. The other employee heard the conversation and didn't provide any commentary. I was given the address and went to seek it out.

25 minutes later, I finally found the HUB and well you guessed it, it is strictly a HUB.  Meaning, its where UPS drivers go to get packages not a place for people to drop off packages. I looked like a total retard walking into their office looking for a place to drop off. 

So . . . I thought, yah know.  It just seems odd that a UPS store can't take an account #. I mean what would be the point.  I looked up the info for another location on McMillian and rang them up and explained my situation. The woman who answered told me they absolutely could help me and when I told her about my experience up to that point she was flabbergasted. 

Not sure what the deal was, but I think I'll not risk another 15 min errand taking me 60 min again and opt for another location.
This is my favorite nail place and I found my new nail lady. Sonya is amazing and so precise! She did such a tremendous job and had a great conversation the whole time! Highly recommend 12/10

This is a great place to chill out and grab a burger.  The beef is fresh and the patties start at 1/3 lb. and go up to 2lbs.  No joke.
If you're looking for a quality burger and you don't feel like eating it out of a wrapper, you'll appreciate the servers and excellent table service.  Shakes are also available and thick.
Delicious, filling, and Comfortable.

I am really pleased with the layout of this place. Looks absolutely stunning inside. The food however is so so...the salad bar is awesome! The pizza is good but it has a sweet sauce which i really dont care for. Server is on point!

We ordered the Easter ham dinner for delivery. The food was so delicious! We were able to choose our sides & a dessert. They also offered a kids fun kit for a little extra, that had egg dye, 10 stuffed eggs and some coloring papers. It was so nice not to have to go buy anything for Easter celebration! I hope they do this again next year. I was going to take a star off for them getting some parts of my order wrong, but they more than made up for it when I brought it to their attention. Great customer service!

Taste and quality of the food is there , however the portions on the protein were a little small for the price .
Employees were eating pizza on the counter where they bag your food so that was concerning ( any basic restaurant knows you don't eat where your prepping and cooking food ) I contemplated ordering until I saw them wash there hands. 
I would hope you could give your employees a designated eating area out of guests view or advise them to hold off until guests are not in there view.
We ordered two sandwiches, one with wheat bread, the other with Parmesan rosemary.  They used plain white bread for both .  Not a good start for first time customers.

If you are hungry and you have a big appetite Than This Is The Place To Go!  Big plates of food and prices very fair. I had the Idaho Scramble and it was delicious. Customer service was awesome.  Even the customers were very nice. Alot of positive energy in this place.

I had an amazing dinner with my husband at Texas de Brazil. Their sangria was absolutely delicious and the wait staff was very attentive. I ate more than any human should eat at one sitting and went home and took one hell of a nap. Thank you for helping us celebrate our anniversary
Their Pho has actually turned a 180 degrees. I still don't recommend the bahn mi sandwich cause it falls apart and has zero flavor but their pho is DELICIOUS.

I wish there was a way to give more than 5 stars. Dr. Loveland has taken care of my family of 6 almost 19 years since my first baby was born. He's taken care of us through pediatric tummy issues, mental health management, chronic pain, and multiple acute symptoms. He's always listened to me as an individual and a mom and never let me feel embarrassed for crazy mom worries. He is so knowledgeable in medical care but also has known when it's time to refer us to other specialists - only specialists that he would feel comfortable taking his own family members to. We were so excited when he opened his practice at Summit Family Health in Meridian. The atmosphere and all the staff makes it feel like going to a friend's house where we belong. We have referred many friends and family members because we want everyone we love to have great personalized health care that Dr Loveland offers.

Recently waited 1 hour and 20 minutes...for a haircut, only to be told I was up next while 2 other employees were goofing off. I left. But,  I'm going to share the rest of my experiences.

My previous experience:  I don't want to buy overpriced products and charged for a stupid mvp when I didn't want one. I asked for just a cut. After, she asks if I wanted my hair washed (sure why not?). Then she proceeds to do the remaining mvp stuff. But, I skipped out on the massage. Because it's creepy and a pos vibrating something or other. I end up Charged for an mvp, and I was in a decent mood, so I asked the lady with a smile "You got me on the mvp didn't you"...and she does some cheeky smile like she know she cheated me. What does this remind you of??? 

Thanks Shontoya! (Sp?)

I hate commercial joints like this for a reason. Employees don't care, employers don't care, and managers are...pointless.

I have found this place is now for kids. Not adults. 

Glad they have a ton of people coming for the wait. I'm sure he franchise owner loves that. But I'm tired of these stupid bad experiences!

Peace I'm out.
This place is fantastic. Delicious food, beautiful outdoor seating, great service, reasonable prices, and a slice of cake the size of my daughter's head. I found my new favorite spot.

I can't believe how big the portions are here, definitely worth the price!! My husband and I had the s'mores coffee & it was to die for! Food was delicious & flavorful. I love how normal it feels in here! We will be back & tell all our friends about this place! Love supporting businesses that allow you to make your OWN decision on whether to wear a mask or not.

Massive quantities. Interesting combinations. And some fun photo opportunities. This is a nice spot to go with a large crowd of people, if you are looking to dine in a hurry, or have kids. Think of it kind of like an elevated Denny's.

I have eaten here twice now. I dined in once with my kiddos. I ordered some French toast and the whole meal was so obscenely huge, I didn't even eat half. That meant that I got to bring home a full meal for my old man. My little one ordered a kid pancake breakfast to split with her sister. But the pancake breakfast was just as big as an adult size! The pancake is literally the size of a pizza box. No doubt the sizes here are very generous.

The second time my husband ordered takeout for Mother's Day and ordered my favorite breakfast meal, eggs Benedict. Unfortunately it was swimming in grease and the hollandaise was broken. The potatoes were super good! I can't decide if I like their bacon or not. It is candied, but also very thick and served a little floppy. In general... fluffy bacon is against my religion and this kind even tastes a bit burnt. Not horrible, not amazing. I think next time I'll try a different meat.

With other breakfast spots around the valley to enjoy, I don't know that I will return for breakfast. But I would like to try their lunch one day.

After months and months of research and quotes and bids and blah blah blah...we finally found NRG Flooring! Talk about a true gem and a total find! The service from the salesman to the sales floor people to the actual installation crew... 100%, A+ and Superb! 
The carpet and pads that they use are all top quality but definitely affordable. They have a very wide selection but if you have something else in mind they will try to get it for you. 
The installation was super quick and very clean. I had about 1200 sqft of carpet and pad removed and then installed. 
They absolutely turned what was beginning to be VERY stressful and budget bursting experience into a pleasant and budget friendly experience.
We love our carpeted rooms and everyone that comes over gushes over the comfort and beauty of them.
If I could give 10 stars I would in a heartbeat!!!
Great workouts with awesome and fun coaches and classmates ... workouts are also fun challenging and intense within in your own fitness levels
