I really don't understand how this restaurant has so many negative reviews. I ordered dinner here for the first time today an hour before closing time. Wait time for the pickup was 30 minutes. I arrived 10 minutes early and was greeted, food in hand, and out the door in about five minutes. The customer service was fantastic. 

I received the following: Combination #4
Chicken Chow Mein, Chicken Fried Rice, Mandarin Chicken, & Fried Shrimp. You can bet that i promptly ate a fried shrimp in the car. I unpacked the food at home, skeptical due to the negative ratings. I found very little to be negative about my meal. The chow mein is awesome, the fried shrimp crispy and hot, the mandarin chicken is BOMB, and the fried rice while a little dry was still good.

Plus I got so much food, there's enough for seconds and thirds. Not sure how they only have two stars. I will go back!
Amber's facial was amazing! She also carries a product line that is made of High quality ingredients and has really helped my skin fight the dry Idaho weather. I will be seeing her regularly!

I absolutely loved this place. I went here after a failed trip to Eagle Island during one of Boise's grand rain torrents and this diner cheered me right up!

The food was amazing - seriously, the plate-sized pancake is a wonder. So so good! The coffee was great, and staff was sweet and filled coffee cups promptly. And plus, the walls are decorated with great '50s everything! Marilyn Monroe portraits, Elvis, records everywhere. So fun. It's a pretty small restaurant, but worth it in the authentic '50s vibe.

I'll definitely return.

Pleasantly surprised. Eggs Benedict was beautifully done and hubby loved The Hog. (I took a bite of his bacon, incredible ) Portions were great, definitely won't leave here hungry. 

The owner made incredible changes. Was not a fan of the menu/restaurant before. (Same owner, new menu, new name)

I don't write many reviews,  but I do on occasion,  I went to Biscuit and Hogs for breakfast, and let me just say,  if you have the a name of the food you serve in your restaurant name,  it better be good.  I am from the south raised on buttermilk and Cathead biscuits,  a staple growing up in just about every household on any given Sunday morning.  I was excited to try Biscuits and Hogs to get my "biscuit fix",   I got my order, a "Square" biscuit, and surely this was not baked on a pan. Nobody wants a "Pan" baked biscuit.  The biscuit was undercooked and quite doughy, and the bottom was cut off,  so I just had a top half of a biscuit,  My assumption is that the bottom either stuck to the pan or was burned,  so they just hacked it off and just sat on the plate.  I always get my gravy on the side, so I can properly manage the amount of gravy to biscuit ratio,  I had no complaints about the gravy, it was OK nothing worth coming back for.

I'm torn on how to rate this. The food was good. The portions could feed a small army. Or maybe two teen boys. The staff was friendly. However no staff had masks. They were not limiting seating. In fact it was packed. I take full responsibility for not walking out when I saw what I was walking into. Almost (but not quite) no safety precautions were being taken and it was very obviously deliberate. I won't be back during Covid.

Have been here twice food was prepared quickly didn't have to wait to long for it to be brought out . Our drinks were kept full the entire  time we were here. The place was clean and servers very friendly great for a quick meal out.

My one experience with Boba Tea was not favorable.  But, my son swore that this was good. I was surprised at all the choices. There were 5-6 kinds of teas, around4 kinds of flavorings and 2 types of Boba in 4 different flavors. 

I chose green tea with mango flavoring and Lychee flavored popping Boba. My son always gets peach black tea with mango popping Boba.

They also had strawberry and peach flavored Boba and jelly Boba.

I would be interested to see if they had sugar free options.   It was really good. I will be back.

We have been using Jay at Groomingtails for over ten years.  He takes wonderful care of our Great Pyrenees.  Edelweiss loves her visits with Jay and is just gorgeous when she comes home.  Jay is so loving with all of his furry clients!  I have referred many people to Groomingtails over years and all are long-term clients, very happy with the service.  You won't be disappointed either.

Just went in to check it out and grab a quick coffee. Coffee is not bad but I felt snubbed after not leaving a tip. I only ordered a black iced coffee to go. Easy enough. I tip when it is warranted but now a days everyone expects one just for doing their job.

The food was fantastic! I ordered through DoorDash. Delivery was fast and food was still warm when it arrives.

I ordered the Grilled Corned Beef , Hash , over easy eggs, Biscuits with gravy, and four sausage links.... all very good!!

Came here last Friday afternoon around 8:30. Waited in line and when it finally get to us, we walked one step up to the register ready to order, the person behind the register turned around and walked away. Then he started to talk to other staff. 15 seconds later he looked back at us like oh you're still here. Left. What kind of service is this?

Food was fresh and really good! Pick up was easy. We will order from here again 
We had grilled prawns, orange chicken, chicken teriyaki and gyoza

I took my girls here for birthday mani pedis. The women at the salon were true to our appointment time, and were very nice to my kiddos. My youngest mussed her nails several times and the manicurists fixed them without complaint or event being asked. 
They offered suggestions and were very patient. 10/10, would recommend.

Despite Vader being a giant baby every time he has to go to the vet, and the 17 year old Princess the cat also hating it-  these really are the best vets in town and possibly the best we've ever had for these two animals of mine.  They don't do unnecessary tests and are fair, honest and kind.  

Despite Vader just wanting to escape (or Princess wanting to bite) it's not their fault in anyway shape or form.  The vets are all nice, and try their best to make Vader less fearful.  My 17 year old cat- well- they just let her be 17 and grouchy.  They don't push vet diets and understand owners (and their budgets).

If you need a vet in this very busy area- try to wait for these guys.  It's worth it.

I'm Thu I working here over 7 years I love this place, we all like family here. Whenever we have time we give each others pedicure and manicure. Today i got Dipping powder on my nails with a little Spring flowers design.

Best place ever! Food is always
Fresh and the restaurant is spotless. It is our new go to place to eat. The owners and staff are top notch.

My husband and I visited over the weekend and we were very disappointed. For a high priced steak house the quality of the food and the service was pretty bad. One of the staff members glared at us the entire time we were in the restaurant, which was extremely unpleasant and very uncomfortable. The meat was chewy and we had to spit out a few pieces that would not go down. We had multiple servers and due to the mask mandate we could not hear the young men serving us. We asked one in particular to please speak up and slow down as we could not hear him nor understand him all night. Sadly, the worst part was we purchased a slice of cake for dessert and there were 2 pieces of hair in the cake. We will never go back and we suggest you go somewhere else as there are much better options in the area for a good steak house.

For spending $100 a night I expected more out of a hotel. Could have stayed at the Hampton Inn Downtown for the similar price with a much better experience.

Room was dirty: Housekeeping is lacking. 

Loud: walls and floors are paper thin. The room above us either was housing a doggy daycare, football team, or dance troupe. Honestly, I think they had dogs up there. The crazy running back and forth all night definitely sounded like dogs with the zoomies. So much for a quiet getaway for some good sleep...cuz that definitely didn't happen. You can hear every door close...slam, every footstep, every person coming down the hall, EVERYTHING!!!

Lighting: the bedside lighting didn't work. There literally wasn't a switch. Weird, I know. I checked all over even called the front desk and they came to help and were bewildered too. 

Bathroom: smallest bathroom ever. It's nearly impossible to walk into the bathroom and actually close the door. If you have any mobility issues at all...and I mean at all, even the smallest amount, like old joints, getting in and out of this bathroom around the toilet and the door will be nearly impossible. Trying to manage small kids in the bathroom was a nightmare.

Parking: good lighting for safety

Road noise: nearly zero road noise for being so close to the freeway and Meridian Rd. 

Won't stay here again.

We operate a small property management company in Boise and met Max of Treasure Valley Exteriors about 4 months ago.  We are always a bit reluctant to provide recommendations until we have some history with any of our vendors.  Since our first job with Treasure Valley Exteriors we have completed  four more separate projects and couldn't be happier.  This company is well run, super competitive and do an exceptional job with every installation. Whether its windows, gutters, or stucco, they are timely and have left every job site super clean. The installers are super skilled and very easy to communicate with no matter how basic your questions may be. They take the time to explain things so you understand exactly what is being done, and when it will be completed. This all starts with their owner, Max. He has instilled a great can do attitude with every member of their team.  I wouldn't consider another exterior project without Treasure Valley Exteriors. 

Bill G.
CR Managers

I would highly recommend Vincent at Nicely Nails to anyone looking to get great service along with beautiful nails, a relaxing pedicure or a soothing manicure. Everyone at Nicely Nails is friendly and accommodating and their prices are very reasonable. I am more than satisfied with Nicely Nails and will not go anywhere else.

Last month, I finally decided to see what all the hype was about around Orange Theory. After my first free session, I was hooked!

I quickly discovered that I not only enjoyed the class, but I also could see myself doing this on a regular basis. What I love about OTF is that I don't have to think or prepare a workout, I simply show up and I'm told what to do. 

During my last month, I never burned less than 700 calories at any of my workout sessions (once I burned 987 calories). An additional bonus is that workouts never repeat (at least not during the time that I've been a member). Every time I come in, there's a new exciting workout. The instructors are amazing and make every effort to get to know you personally. It's so encouraging to come in through the door and be greeted by name! 

Highly recommend everyone to try OTF at least once. Not only is the first session FREE but you also have the ability to schedule your session at whatever time is convenient for you. Trainers are super personable, the fellow members are encouraging, music is bumping, equipment is on point, and best of all, you will get a workout that is worth your money.
Bad management, don't even try to get a job here the owner will fire you withen a month for no reason
Great stay! Nice rooms very new and clean. Good breakfast in the am and the staff was extremely friendly and helpful.

I will never be returning after our experience. Upon arrival at the restaurant the table next to us had just received their food and were seemingly upset about something. When the waitress came over they said they had been waiting for a super long time only to be served cold food. They were so mad they didn't eat at all and, instead, got up to leave. The waitress told them, "I mean, I can put your food in the microwave. I don't know what else you want me to do." Being in the service industry, this comment made me cringe. We ordered some drinks and didn't receive them for a very lengthy time. When she came back to take our order, we asked about them to which she replied, "Oh yeah! I set them down somewhere and must have forgotten where they are." How is that even a possibility?? Our order of three entrees and a side dish of noodles was taking a long time, so we ordered a soup. When the food came an hour and ten minutes after we ordered it (not exaggerating) the soup was still never brought out. When I asked about it at the end to make sure we wouldn't be charged for it since we never got it, she said she had forgotten to ring it in. I looked around the restaurant and noticed it wasn't even filled to capacity and that every other table looked pretty irritated and everything seemed disastrous in the entire atmosphere. Even if the place is running behind, i feel it would be acceptable to warn the guest you have long ticket times. Communication is key. The lack thereof was VERY noticeable. We missed our movie time by 45 minutes by the time we cashed out and were able to, thankfully, leave. There was not really any form of apology, not manager sent around to talk to people, nothing. I won't return and I wouldn't recommend anyone else go unless they enjoy horrible service, no drinks, and ten minute or more greeting times. You guys need to get it together or that place will go down in flames, quick! Cheap happy hour can only get you so far.

* I had the Buddha Feast stir-fry with steak and rice. It was served on a rectangular white plate. I liked it alright, but it didn't fill me up. Snap peas could have been cooked another minute in the wok. I could have eaten one of their desserts, but with only two choices, it's clearly not their specialty.
* No problem finding a parking spot. Lots of reserved spaces. No asian servers that I could see. No asian chef. No asian music. Fancy full service bar, basic asian-inspired interior design. Solid wood tables, cloth napkins, chopsticks available at the table.
* Had a hard time finding something I liked on the menu. If I return, I would check out the photos of fresh sushi rolls online, prior to ordering. Didn't care for the American Oldies Music; didn't jive with the asian theme.

We came here on a busy Sunday after church. Fortunately I did some research ahead of time and put our names on the waitlist through open table (we were number 23!). It probably ended up being about an hour wait, but we timed it perfectly and arrived right when our table was ready. 

We sat down and ordered drinks. I ordered the "Laura", which included coffee and a mimosa. I really love this idea since I wanted both and you save like $0.70 on the mimosa. For our meal I ordered the Idaho scramble with the biscuit french toast and fruit. 

Everything arrived surprisingly quickly for how busy it was. The mimosa was great and there was certainly enough alcohol in it. I can see how the other reviewer's mimosas don't have much flavor because you're getting mostly Prosecco with a splash of juice! The biscuit french toast was my favorite. It was incredibly soft and the flavor almost reminded me of a funnel cake. My scramble was also really good and it was such a huge portion. 

Overall we had an amazing experience here. Even the service was on point, especially for how packed the place was. We'll definitely be coming back soon!
This was a great experience, they accommodated my request when my order got mixed up. The service was great and the sassy sis roll was delicious.

We have loved Ling & Louie's for a long time. Today for Happy Hour they have added more TV's and have some fun music videos playing of all genre's of music.  Tables are spaced. Employees are wearing masks. Great place to be!!
I love the half priced apps and how affordable it is to come here on a daily or weekly basis. The servers are pretty and want to do the best job they can. Long live Applebee's.

Home cooking, looked and tasted like something you could make at home.  I got the spinach omelet and it was good, nothing special but good.  Tons of stuff on the menu to choose from, not huge portions and fair priced.  Probably would go back if I had other options.

I've been coming to this nail salon for close to three years.  I think the nail techs do a good job and the salon is clean and always busy which is a good sign!  Sadly though, I was told on my last appointment that they will no longer be accepting credit/debit cards, cash only (due to banks charging for credit cards).  I for one rarely carry cash and find it inconvenient to have to stop at the credit union to get cash out (or use a grocery store).  And the ATM in the salon charges to use the machine.  So, in short, I won't be a regular customer anymore.  It would appear they would rather lose a customer(s) for the above rather than pay a slight fee for credit card transactions.

My first experience here was great. I ordered DoorDash and had the Chicken Biscuits and Gravy. It was very good and tasty. I decided to order again this morning and I ordered the same thing. I receive chicken that was raw in the middle, potatoes that were also not cooked well and very cold. The only thing editable was the eggs the rest went in the garbage. I sent a message to DoorDash regarding the issues and they said they would note it and they have me $4.75 back. For a $16 meal that was completely inedible. I decided to call the store to inform them as well and I had a nice woman answer and she apologized for the "inconvenience." She never once offered to let me speak to a manager or said she'd pass it along to the kitchen which is what I was actually most worried about, someone else getting raw food. Instead, she told me the best she can do is offer me a $25 off my next meal when I come in and that my name would be on the list. Thanks, but no thanks. I don't think I'll be dining here again. It was a waste of money for a Sunday breakfast and I could have gotten a better meal at the McDonald's drive through that would have at least been cooked.

I've gone to Q nail spa for a few years now and I've never had a bad experience. I'm always tended to quickly and my nails always look great! All the women I've had have been very good about making sure my water was the right temperature and that I was comfortable through the whole experience.

I love Q nail spa and I'll continue to come here as long as I'm in the area because I don't feel like they are over priced and it's been a great place every time I've been in. 

I would defiantly recommend!

Boy this is sad. No help, mop and broom sitting in the middle of the floor and against the counter. Tables rocking, booths dirty. Sad!
I had decided to try their Philly Cheesteak special. I waited and waited. Finally decided to get it to go. When someone came out, I asked.it turned out it had been sitting on a try on the shelf. If I had not asked probably still be there. Help fail!
The cheesesteak was served on a small hot dog bun, with flavorless chopped meat and onions. I never did find cheese or cheese sauce. Terrible! Horrible quality control andvavstaffbthat couldn't care less.
Tori was our server and she was wonderful, we just got appetizers ans drinks but it was quiet and mostly empty. Thank you Tori!
Best mechanic around. Fair and honest. I only take my cars to Les and you should to. I have been going there for over ten years and never a problem.
Not a bad place...just the location is not as convenient as others...nice people!!

I called Envi a few weeks after the first treatment because I didn't see the results I was hoping for. Let me just say I am so happy with them! They came back out and retreated my house at no cost and were professional and courteous and did a fantastic job!! I would recommend them to anyone!

If you are looking for a spray tan call Krissy!! She is the best and your tan looks amazing. Krissy makes you feel so comfortable and is very professional.  Krissy is amazing. Get your tan from her......you will look sun kissed!

I ordered from here for lunch, I placed my order and explained it was a pick up, it was ready in 5 minutes, nice! The place was very busy, which I love, it means for the most part the food will be hot and hasn't been sitting.  The service was very nice, I liked it that she added some extra sauce for us and asked about silverware to go.  I'd go back for lunch again, overall I was satisfied with my experience.

This place if adorable! Lots of natural light, surprisingly great views of the mountains, bright and fresh décor. The staff is very friendly and the coffee drinks we had were perfect. The store is a perfect place to meet up, work on your laptop or just sit and relax. I had burned myself at home prior to our trip to the pet store and I needed to stop in somewhere and get some ice to put on it. We saw Urban Fox and decided to try there. The people at the counter were so kind and not only gave me some ice, but also helped me tend to my 'wound'. What a joy to receive such kindness! We will definitely support this local business and hope others will, too.
Bar none best pizza in town and ive tried them all. I'm not into thin crust and my family part Italian.

Kim was wonderful with my dog Molly.  I tried to take her to a groomer that would put her in a kennel before she was groomed.  She is still a new dog to us and has some "anxieties!"  Kim was great with her and Molly got along great with her from the beginning!  This is definitely the way to go if your dog does not like to be in a kennel.  Kim was on time and was finished in the time she said she would be.  I thought her price was very fair!

Went into sonic tonight and didn't realize till I got home that all of the cheese from the mozzarella sticks was completely melted inside the container. Along with a piece of both hair and aluminum foil inside. Not only that but they didn't even get my drink right and brought me something completely different. Like how hard is it?

My husband and I were excited to try this place!  The disappointment was almost immediate.  I ordered avocado toast and upgraded my 'side' to a huckleberry yogurt parfait (around $15 for my meal).  The toast was a single piece of very small white bread (possibly the end of the loaf) with a tiny bit of avocado spread on it and some honey drizzle.  It was a child portion.  And the extra $3 huckleberry yogurt parfait?  That was a commercially packed yogurt with a dollop of jammy substance with some broken cookies.  And the commercial packaging was super hard for me to open, I actually spilled the product a bit.  The taste was nothing special, cookies were cold and stale.  The portion left me still hungry.  But the most disappointing thing was watching our waitress, who was also bartending, spend most of her time making shots for herself and the other waitresses and it wasn't even noontime.  Gals would arrive to work, pass hugs around to all of the other servers, take their turn doing a shot with the bartender and get to work.  Our high-rise table was situated next to a computer for the servers and across from the bar pick up.  Holy cow, those servers went through a lot of Deep Edy Lemon - something!  And these weren't shot glasses, they were large juice glasses.  I truly do not know how my server could actually work.  I did mention to her that I was not thrilled with my meal, mainly the portion and she just said, "Oh, Sorry about that." and brought us our bill.  Super disappointing food and service.  Seemed like a popular place but I wonder how they turn a profit. *** I was asked to send a private message to resolve this, but the owner didn't explain how to do that.  So, I emailed the business directly and heard NOTHING.

This is our Sunday morning go-to.  The food is always exactly what you would expect for a good old fashion home cooked meal and the service has always been perfect.  This place is always full; however, we have never had to wait long for a table.

Is pizza from a wood fired oven a big special thing?  Not really, it is done all over Italy  and the USA.  In those places where I have had the pizzas, they were much, much better than the product from this place.  The pizzas here are just a slight bit better than what one can sadly get from gas station pizza.  It is much more expensive than gas station pizza, so I don't get the attraction and the rave reviews.

Looking for real Italian pizza from a wood-fired oven?  Go to Vincenzo's in Garden City and then decide on where to buy your next pizza.

The owner fixed my mom's pillow, which means the world 2 me as she passed in 2006. She simply changed out the zipper, and it cost only $20. The dry cleaners up the street wanted 2 charge me $45, which is ridiculous, so I'm glad they referred me here. Awesome, meticulous service!

I do not recommend this place the food is always cold when they bring it out they also make you wait a long time and they microwave all there food and i knew someone that worked there a long time ago and she still hasn't gotten paid DO NOT GO HERE it's not worth the money at all

My first visit because I was told their Boba was pretty good.

I ordered an original milk tea with Boba.  The Boba is indeed very good.  Very chewy and bouncy, which means fresh and done perfectly.  However, the milk tea is not what I am used to.  A bit different, perhaps a bit too sweet for me.

I was hoping that they would have a bit more pastries or snacks to sit and enjoy a bit, but not many options here.

They only have Boba, lychee and mango jelly.  No popping Boba or other flavors.

Allyson Doll is amazing at what she does as well as an amazing person. I took my 16 year old daughter to her for color and after Allyson was done, her hair looked exactly how she wanted it. My daughters hair was already dyed black and she wanted to change it to a dark violet. (I wish I would of took a picture of her after it was done.) I even had an appointment for blonde highlights and have no complaints. We will definitely be going back. I would definitely recommend Allyson to anyone. She knows what she is doing.

*havent. Visited* but after all these sad reviews I'm not really convinced to stop by I saw moms saying limited sizing for 3 and up and sadly I always have a harder time looking for size 5 in 2nd hand shops. But since this a consignment I thought the standards would be better...it seems like the owner isn't accepting the nice used clothing from the frustrated moms on here...I won't donate here will go on let go where It's fair...ugh so disappointing...

This was our first food stop in Boise - looking for a good burger and fries OF COURSE.  There were 3 of us in the party and when we sat down the special of the week just happened to be the BIG Jud - bingo.

We ordered one and were talked into a large order of fries - the waitress guaranteed us there would be food left over - true to her word we had a takeaway box - amazing.  The bill when all said and done - came in south of a crisp $20.

We have clearly gone back and have tried other menu items - so far it is on our monthly must do list. A keeper for us ..

Omg. The food was AMAZING our server was AMAZING (I wish I could remember her name  I think is was Laura? ) 

10/10 HIGHLY RECOMMEND

Andy's the best!! We live in CA so my husband called Andy for my mother-in-law's rental house in Nampa. He came out right away and was able to provide an excellent, thorough and informative inspection. He was extremely prompt, courteous and professional. We highly recommend Andy!

My family and I were greeted by warm friendly staff for our weeks stay during Easter break. First I noticed how accommodating everyone was especially for my mother in law who is limited. The rooms were very clean and staff made sure we had what we needed during our week stay. When we were away we felt that our belongings were safe as the cleaned and tidied up our rooms. What was most impressive is when I saw "Mr. fix it" on Easter morning keeping the very well maintained property mowing and edging the facilities. When we returned took my kids swimming in the very clean pool that "mr. fix it just cleaned and filtered. He continued to be very friendly and explained to my kids they may feel cold spots as he just back walked and was refilling and then made sure area was spotless from trash as well as swim towels for my kids. I've stayed at a lot of hotels and this by far is a safe clean and best place I've stayed. Thank you !!

Tried to take my donations to goodwill and the youth ranch was rejected by both due to "short or no staff" so to the dump my donations go......7-8-21 window on the door says hiring $10 an hour????? Might want to start paying people better. Being an employee my whole life as well. I'm proud of people rejecting these low wages and taking a stand. Companies need to take better care of their employees.
I've tried other nail salons in the area, and Q Nails is by far the best!!!  Quality and efficiency!  My nails are beautiful, and not a lot of time.  BEST pedicure ever!!!

This was a great find. We happen to see it while driving by. We did a pick up order with very picky eaters and they got it 100% right. Every dish was fantastic. It was so good we're going back two days later. The bartender was extremely friendly. This is a must go to place for breakfast lunch and maybe even an early dinner because they close at 6 PM every night. The chicken and waffles were some of the best my husband has ever had and we have been to Roscoes chicken and waffles and had chicken and waffles in the south too. Our kids got the club sandwiches and changed a few things on them. My picky daughter loves the club sandwich and it was amazing. I got the chicken fried steak and home fries. The gravy was awesome the home fries were awesome the whole meal was great very large portions. Some people could even share. Give them a try because we would love for them to stay open since there a newer restaurant trying to survive during this pandemic.

Had and amazing breakfast this morning my server had the most amazing personality her laugh was infectious and her table side manner was impeccable will return for her service every time thank you kendra she sold us on the hog style and I'm so happy she did it's addicting

On Monday I was sent from work to get tested because I was exposed by a coworker it I have no symptoms it's just a request. My job is just around the corner so I walked there because it was something fast that I could do during my hour lunch. Well it took almost 20 minutes just to check in I was standing by the door watching and no they weren't taking long because they were disinfecting. Not at all! I finally get put In a room and I'm there for another 45 minutes I was going to be late for work as I do work in health care & we don't make our patients wait I walked out the room and a man was sitting down the hall and I respectfully asked him how much longer will this take can I come back after work I can't be late my patient is already at the clinic and he responded so rudely saying " well we are open till 8 idc you can leave whenever or wait or come back" and I said that wasn't my question my question was how much longer and he rolled his eyes and said well you are next so it should be within 5 minutes. I went back in the room & I walked around because I was there for another 20 minutes the provider finally walked in swabbed my nose and he said we will call you tomorrow with the results. This was on Monday it is now Wednesday and I haven't heard anything this was by far the worst experience I've ever had in health care. I am a health care worker and I would never treat a patient with that wait or that tone. I was not pleased...

My name is Lilly, I am 15 years old and I play soccer. Over the years I have had many injuries and D.O.C. Has always been our go to. However 2 weeks ago when I injured my knee the story changed. If there was a way I could give them zero stars I would. I came in after injuring myself in a soccer game, my knee was swollen, unstable, and barley weight bearing. After waiting for quite some time they called us back and I received a X-ray. I told the PA that I had heard a pop and was concerned about my ACL. He disregarded this saying he was "not concerned about the ACL",  and told me I was "To swollen for me to assess your ACL" and "To swollen to recommend you for an MRI." He then diagnosed me with a fractured patella, put me in a straight leg brace and sent me off. After a couple days of pain and frustration, I went into Saint Al's Orthopedic care where they did a very thorough X-ray. My doctor at St. Al's also referred me for an MRI, which by the way is not effected by swelling. I received my MRI results today, I have completely torn my ACL and Meniscus. My patella however has no fracture whatsoever. D.O.C. Completely misdiagnosed me and disregarded what I told them had happened. I will never be going back and I would not recommend this place to anyone.

I'm from southeastern Idaho so I remember stopping at the original Big Juds in St. Anthony and loving it. When we moved here to Boise in 2003 and we were so excited to see another location here! Now they've opened up a Meridian branch and we are thrilled they are doing so well. 

The portions here will make you feel like a hobbit. Even their drink cups are ginormous! A large fry or tot will easily feed two or more people. 

You can't go wrong with just about anything you order here. But my favorite and I think the best are their finger steaks and steak fries. The steak are tender and have a nice crispy coating. And the fries...oh my love affair with French fries. This place has amazing homemade steak fries. And gobbs and gobbs of fry sauce. When in Idaho, dip everything in fry sauce. 

Overall for the price and portions, it's a great place for families! Check either location out here in the Treasure Valley!

Ordered from here via DoorDash. My wife's corn beef had a hair in it. The hash browns were barely cooked. The benedict didn't have the avocado spread like it said on the menu. Flavor of everything was mediocre. This place has gone to sh**.

Everyone that works here has the worst attitude ever, you ask for help and they take forever to get you something out of the jewelry counter, I try to avoid this Walmart as much as possible, the only person that has ever helped me more than anyone was an older lady I didn't catch her name but I'm sure she was Russian, she was so kind and sweet. Just wish she had better coworkers.

This place is amazingly good I love it, I literally eat here 3 times a week, they are very friendly and started to get to know me real quick. If your looking for a great place to eat teriyaki then this is it. The chicken is good and there beef so if you can't pick one just flip a coin because you can't go wrong with either one.

If you are hungry and want to try someplace relatively new to the breakfast scene then you have found your spot! Biscuit and Hogs has massive breakfasts that are some of the most delicious in the entire Treasure Valley. The potatoes, gravy, biscuits, jalapeno jelly, bacon, pancakes, etc, etc, are all absolutely delectable. They are a little on the pricey side but the portions make it totally reasonable, you'll definitely have leftovers. They also serve lunch and have a full bar with a very impressive happy hour! B&H is a place that should, without a doubt, be on your list of places to eat on the regular.
Fast, efficient, on time, well done and very pleasant to deal with.  Not inexpensive, but we needed a bridesmaid dress altered in one day.  They delivered without a hitch!

Well they were amazing but I had a bad reaction to the medication they put me on for the dental anxiety that I have due to Terry riley dentistry and had a bad reaction at the end of my last appointment  
I dont remember what happened and now they wont let me come back for a second chance. I thought the place and people were so kind at the time but now I feel because of my disability that I have I am being thrown out without a way to show I'm not that kind of person. Figured I would tell everyone if you have a reaction to a new medication that is to sedate you be careful on what you do because it can be unforgiving when you have a mistake happen. I just wish they would give me another chance. Heck after my appointment for my filling on my tooth it's been bugging me and they won't even see me to check out why it hurts. Not right at all. I also had more extensive work that needs to be done that will cost me a lot. I feel that while I was sedated the team made the pain worse on the teeth that need the extra work and the one tooth with the filling they did before the deep cleaning that I was sedated for and I was denied a support person from my family to insure i would be ok and nothing would happen.
Also while I was sedated they allowed me to leave with no one there to pick me up. I could have been hit by a car or taken by someone I didnt know over this. They are not allowed by law to allow me to leave under sedation of the medication I was on. I will be looking into what can be done over that

What a fun place in downtown Meridian. They have a great beer selection and their snacks look so tasty (how can you turn down a nice warm pretzel?). It is a nice place to cool down on a hot summer day being in the underground area of a building. They have cool decorations and the service was great. We look forward to trying here again.

Took someone in for heatstroke and because she was hyperventilating they wouldn't let her in screaming she has covid no matter how many times we told them she doesn't she just worked in a hot environment and wasn't able to eat or drink for a long time they wouldn't listen very ridiculous she just needed an iv to get some fluids. Ridiculous never going here again.

Unfortunately, on our visit, we never got to try the food so I can't speak to that. We went in on a quiet Tuesday at lunch time and were seated promptly. Someone took our drink orders and brought us menus, and then we waited...and waited...and waited. 20 minutes of waiting to order went by, and though we could see plenty of wait staff in other sections, ours was completely deserted, despite the two other tables with couples who were eating. We finally gave up, left a few bucks on the table for our drinks, and left. Bummer, since we were looking forward to trying several things on the menu. We won't be back.

We waited several minutes to be seated. Our drinks were slow to get to the table. Once we had our food our waitress never came back to our table to check on us. After I paid my bill I asked for a manager. I was told the manager was not on duty. I asked for the phone number of the owner. No phone number was produced. I once again asked for the manager. At that time a manager was found. I told the manager that our waitress and rather sit down and visit with her friends then to come to our table to check on us. We were 100% done when the waitress finally came back. There were other waitresses and other ladies they were obviously not on duty visiting at a table outside of the kitchen. Biscuit and hogs was not busy at this time. There was no reason why our waitress couldn't spend a moment or two coming to check on us after we received our meal.  We are not new customers to biscuit and hogs. At this time we do not plan on being a customer of biscuit and hogs. I do not feel that the manager is going to take this seriously. So if you would like slow service and have the entertainment of watching the waitresses visit with each other this is the place to go.

Circuit trainings are definitely my thing. I'm a super competitive person and I always try to push myself out of my comfort zone. Orangetheory Fitness is definitely the place to go if you're looking for team challenges that combine full body workouts with an amazing atmosphere and friendly staff. You get a training session unlike anything out there. Prepare yourself for a VIP treatment as the coaches watch your every move and push you to new levels with each class. This is definitely the training you're looking for if you goal is to loose weight and build lean muscle as it combines the perfect amount of strength/cardio and endurance training in just one class. Highly recommended and addictive. Plus the music is pumping and full of energy as well.

Very disappointed in both shopping and resale experience. Brought in two big tubs of baby clothes all in great shape, most of them outfits, and they basically took only a couple of items and then threw everything back in the buckets and gave them back. I spent a bunch of time preparing everything to take in, and have experience doing resale before, so I made everything nice and organized. I was shocked at what they didn't accept. As far as shopping goes the selection was very limited, but it makes sense after the resale experience because it seems they don't accept much. My suggestion to them would be to list on their website what brands they accept so that people aren't wasting their time.
Went over and had the man vs food special burger . Not the tastiest but it was huuuge . Great experience !!

We just went in for brunch and immediately walked out. The restaurant was overflowing with people not wearing masks, not social distancing at all and the host wasn't even wearing a mask. I realize it may be a little cold outside, but people waiting should not just be stuffed in the entryway, so unsafe!

If you are looking for a light meal,  Don't come here lol, this place is great, you get so much food,  the lobster scramble has so much lobster, the potatoes are great the French toast biscuit which i mistakenly ordered was great,  he ordered one pancake in the side it was the size of a small pizza,  the ham steak was yummy, and the pork belly bites,  we could not finish it all , taking the rest home . The servers are super friendly, place is very clean.  Yes we will be back

Lovely staff, however, was told they don't accept blue Cross of Idaho insurance.. .really? Since that is pretty much the only provider up here I was shocked to hear that. Since I could not afford the$76 for my prescription and it has been filled already I was greatful I had a discount card. Of course I can't get my future prescriptions filled here ... Too bad for Walgreens

Breakfast was SO FRESH, hot, full of flavour!. country breakfast, & veggie omelet with idaho potatoes. 
It was Soo good. The coffee strong but NOT BITTER... so good.. we couldn't finish it was so huge! That's ok we saved it for later as we travel & have a way to reheat on the road... they have SCAN TO PAY DOWNLOAD A GUEST APP.. QR CODE  I believe Apple Pay google pay.. our waitress was so busy. She made it look easy though.. she came by our table & everyone else with the talent many don't recognize when a place is hopping... I recommend this place as they have gluten free options & keto diets.. they aim to please..

DON'T DO IT...DON'T BUY A HOME FROM HUBBLE

I would give zero stars if you could. The service and warranty are not worth the paper they are written on.  We have 4 problems and they are only addressing 1 issue.  They claim no responsibility for the buried plastic pots that are in our back yard where the grass will not grow.  They take no responsibility for the sprinkler zoning that has front and back yard zones mixed.

I am the type of person who LOATHES going to the gym, but I took a chance and tried this place out. OMG! I hate mornings, yet I'm up at 4:30 am to get to the 5:00 am class! I usually don't stick with a work out for longer than two weeks, yet here I am going on four months!!!

 I was scared I was going to be judged or that I wasn't "fit" enough to fit in, but ya know what? These people are my motivators and family. Sure I don't like it when a trainer notices I'm not giving it my all, but I do love their encouragement and how proud they make me feel about myself when I do push through and succeed....just like they knew I could. 

I came to lose weight and build muscle, but I have found my tribe and that's something!

My sister got her nails done by Tina, and she was very accommodating and made sure that the smiley faces on her nails looked the way she wanted them too. At the end she also took a cone shaped drill and got rid of the roughness underneath the nails and made them thinner at the tip so they were not chunky

I am not a very nice person. You prob would not like me but I am honest. I am the guy that can and did, just a week ago line up 5 bourbons blind and tell you what 3 of them are. I can, blind tell you which wine is the $110 bottle the $30 and the $10. I occasionally go to restaurants where the bill is over a grand for 3 of us. I am serious about beer bla bla bla. So Ling & Louis's ? Ok went there a few years ago and it was great, good food and nice ambiance so went back today and I was in sushi mode. Had some happy hour appetizers. Lettuce wraps, spot on! Beer menu not great, they need more micro but they had a 10 barrel IPA so that was fine. Satay triple was good but too spicy hot for me (but that's just me) And then the sushi, had a rainbow roll and the 10 piece. Now if you can't tell the difference between sushi at a super market and a good restaurant or if you like the all you can eat places you can save some money and maybe this place is not for you. If when the bill for 2 is over $100 and you give the restaurant a bad review because you can't afford that, maybe this  place is not for you. But if you want the best sushi in Boise that is comparable to and prob 90% as good as some of the best I have had in Seattle, San Fran, etc at one third of the cost. Check out L&L. Rainbow roll is $16. We will be back.

Servers not wearing masks, tables not distanced, no mask wearing policy or recommendation. 
Ada county health order requires masks and 6 foot social distance. 
I've got immune compromised family and friends.
Won't be back. 
Not the local business I'm down to support.

I really don't know why people would choose to go here. Honestly, the service was great, attentive and kind. But. The. Food. 

I mean, maybe if you haven't eaten REAL Italian food. or if you like your tomato sauce out of a can, this would be a great spot for you.

the gnocchi was literally over boiled gnocchi, with no flavor...with a ton of sauce dumped on top. it was TERRIBLE. flavorless. so blasé in presentation and taste. ew. 

We ordered another pasta dish - but I honestly can't even remember what it was. The pizza seemed to be the favorite bite of the meal, i think it was like pepperoni...and other stuff...again, not really memorable.

I would NOT go here. There are SO. MANY. OTHER. GREAT. Italian places!!!!

Kidz Again is incredible in every way! Who likes spending full price for baby and kid items when you basically blink and they've grown out of it? This store is brilliant because they have high quality standards, a beautiful and kid friendly set-up that makes it fun and easy to shop, and fabulous prices. I can't sing this store enough praises. When I've traded in items, it's fast and convenient. What a gem for parents!!

Had dinner at Biscuit & Hogs.
The service was awesome.(Madison) was very helpful. The sliders are enough for two my wife and I sheared them 
Coming back tomorrow for the $1.00 Beer.

Was easy to make a reservation, salad bar was excellent.  Wasn't too impressed with the meat offerings other than the bacon wrapped chicken and flank steak but to each his own.  One thing happened that was of great concern, however.  When I went to pay the individual taking my credit card disappeared for a minimum of 30 minutes, something rather alarming in this day of identity theft.  I've had to replace my card once already this year due to unauthorized charges and now I have to be on the lookout yet once again.  I tilled well due to the number of folks that waited on us but the issue with my credit card threw a pall on the entire evening.

We usually go to Happy Teriyaki in Eagle, one day we wanted to try this location and it didn't taste as good as the food in the other location. 
Our boba teas were ugly and our kids got sick. 
Definitely not coming back to this location. 200% loyal to the Eagle restaurant. 
There's a lot of room for improvement.

First time visit and we order to go.. They have a full bar so that's always a plus they seem a bit busy with to go orders and on top it was happy hour from 3 to 6 on weekdays hey that's alway a good thing to know. So they do offer doordash of what I notice while I was waiting for my food. I order 3 sushi rolls. I can't say much about the service because we didn't get much of a service other than when we  order.

If you find yourself in the Boise area on the way to fish the South Fork to the north or maybe Silver Creek  farther east and have  profound fetish for charred animal flesh I can unreservedly recommend this place!
Warning.... come with a serious appetite and DO NOT heed the negative reviews. 
The eatery  is definitely upscale and would fit in comfortably with fine dining spots in any major city. However you can walk in in jeans and your Simms shirt and not draw a glance from the other patrons or staff. 
Back to the eats...top notch. All you can eat so pace yourself. Salad Bar starting off is incredible. Smoked salmon, lobster bisque, assortment of fine aged cheeses, 
Shrimp, sushi, plus the usual greenery and assorted charcuterie!!!!!!
Take your time and enjoy. 
Your servers, "gauchos" , as they are referred to will come by at your beck and call with an assortment of expertly grilled meats.... unlimited portions. Roast lamb, lamb chops, Argentinian and Brazilian sausages, fillet, flank steak, marinated pork, beef ribs, pork ribs, sirloin, plus grilled chickeni probably forgot another 3 or 4 cuts. 
All comes with unlimited sides.....mashed and scalloped potatoes, rice, a delicious Brazilian cod dish, fried plantains. 
The service was impeccable. Servers were super friendly and than attentive. 
The dinner is well worth the $45/person price tag. Children at a discount. Inquire. 
We even brought our own wine ... a bottle of Sawtooth Malbec procured from a local winery on the Snake River and no corkage!!!!! Unheard  of in Cali!!!
The wine list was extensive Bd looked honest enough. 
Go and bookem Dano  but please remember to take your time and enjoy.

Updated: we had a bad experience about 8 months ago, but now realize it was just a isolated incident. We went back last week before a show and really enjoyed the experience. Thanks to the owner who took our feedback to heart and was kind in offering a better experience.

Place is awesome what can I say? Feels like a piece of Korea town is here! The sweet toast is so good and yummy! The staff is friendly and helpful. If you enjoy boba, this is 10 times better than any of the boba places in town, no powder crap, real boba drinks and tea. My wife got the boba milk tea and I got the green tea passion fruit with mango jelly. The drinks are on point and refreshing. Can't get any better than this. The sweet toast is awesome, rich, sweet, creamy, buttery and crispy. Great place to take your date and impress them. Share this and you might find out if you are a match. I am so glad that Urban fox is here and I hope you all will enjoy it as much as I do. If you are on eagle road, check this place out! I really do recommend it.

I've had a great experience every time I've gone to Margherita pizza whether it be for dine in or take out.  The pizza ingredients and salads always taste so fresh and have so much flavor.  Highly recommend!  Hard working people in there too!  I appreciate you!

Nice little diner.  You really feel like youre in the locals breakfast spot.  They have a decent kids meal with large pancakes.   I had the biscuits and gravy with hash browns.   The gravy needed more flavor hash browns also slightly plain.   Are drinks were kept full the car decor great for us since we appreciate classic automobiles.

I absolutely love our home but House slowly starts to fall apart a little after a year once warranty is over.  So far on our own we have had to level out the back yard (EXTREMELY sloped and our fence is off in one area because of it), replaced our bathroom sink twice through the manufacture, $600 light pendant attachments because the wires completely broke in half, central vac main attachment Through the manufacturer who told me that The ones Hubble provides are not recommended, very cheap and bad quality. We paid for an upgraded one.   dishwasher is a piece of crap.  Had Frigidaire come out since the beginning multiple times because it does not work properly and They will not replace it and microwave caught on fire because the microwave safe separator that comes with it is not so microwave safe after all.  I've spoken with numerous neighbors who have had the same problem with their Frigidaire appliances as well. Unfortunately I paid $5000  for an extremely upgraded kitchen/appliances. Going to have to replace both appliances out of pocket after a year and a half because Frigidaire will not honor their warranty even after paying for a second year warranty.  Also the electricity In our master bedroom continues to shut off because having only a light on and one computer running is too much wattage and consistently blows the circuit.  
On another note, I absolutely love the neighborhood and my neighbors, but we sit so close to all of our neighbors I can hi 5 them all through my window, the HOA is an absolute joke, you pay an extreme amount per year for absolutely no amenities and they do not take care of their responsibilities.  I have complained to Hubble and the HOA consistently for two years now it's starting to get a little better but that's it.   We also signed up to live next to the park that Hubble has advertised for over 2 years now and get you in this specific location with the promise there will be a park built within the next couple years. There won't. They haven't done anything with that park in two years.  Instead we're living next to a giant field of weeds and in turn get the privilege of dealing with mosquito, bug, and mouse infestation's.  I understand it is the city's responsibility to build it not Hubbles, BUT they STRONGLY advertise it, get you to choose your subdivision and plot based on that park.  If you are going to advertise it and use it as the main sales incentive to get you to choose this location and Hubble, you honor it and take responsibility for a promise unkept.  there are a lot of great things about our home as well though.   Like I said.  I love our house but......
Oh there boba is to die for!!! Such a friendly environment!! The workers are very friendly too!! I highly recommend trying Urban Fox. I believe there the best boba place in town

Quick any easy place to get a haircut. Their app makes it easy to check in online to reserve your place in line before you even get there. My favorite stylist is Maddie! She's awesome and always does a great job cutting my hair. Plus they always have sports on the TVs!
Took some pants for a quick, last minute fix. I needed them for a trip I was leaving for. They graciously repaired them within an hour. Perfection! The price was great too!
Very friendly workers, and helpful.  They loan u a lawn spreader for free. They have propane too .

Mike Walters at Realty World;

 was the perfect Realtor to fit our needs.  We found Mike in his office on a holiday weekend.  We were walk-ins; not from Hollister!  He immediately brought us into his office and started working for us to locate the perfect home, (He had just stopped by his office; not intending to be there long.)  Our circumstances were a bit unusual however that did not deter his efforts!  He treated us as if we were his first clients and he was new to the field - amazing dedication, enthusiasm and determination to help us.  Mike put in hours of work for us.  He truly listens to what you need and want in a home; so no wasted time in viewing homes that do not fit your criteria. He is very helpful in pointing out aspects of a home that you may not initially see; assisting in the decision making process. Very honest!  Both my husband and I highly recommend Mike to find your perfect home!
The wife and I decided to stop and try this place out.  We ordered a Thai tea boba and large drip.  It took 15 minutes to get our drinks. Boba was good, coffee meh.

We had never been to Texas de Brazil and won't ever come back. Save yourself from the overpriced, pretentious environment and head to Tucanos Brazilian Grill.

We spent the entire meal being stared at by staff for walking in off the street to grab dinner. As luck and the weather would have it, we were in jean shorts and sandals. The manager visited every table except ours and the waitress told us she'd come back to take our payment, but proceeded to prioritize the table next to us.
We used them for embroidery and they did a great job. Affordable and quality work. Would recommend them for any need. Only thing is it's hard to find.
We had our siding replaced. House looks amazing, work was done professionally and quickly. Thank you to the guys.

These subs rock! Great food and great service. Without a doubt, this is the best sub place around. I don't mind paying a little more for quality food that taste good and doesn't make you feel terrible after you eat it. The bread is so soft and the deli meat is fresh and tender. Highly suggest #17 Mike's Famous Philly. Super easy ordering. We used the app and it appeared on our doorstep 30 min later. So glad you came to our side of town and we'll be back!

Had a 9:30 appointment today. I arrived at 9:20. When Tosha saw me she asked me if I had an appointment. Which she had set up for me when I called her a couple days before. She told me she would be with me as soon as she was done with the client she was working on. I had my day scheduled so having to wait when I had an appointment was going to create problems for me. They have a poster on the wall saying "If you are in a hurry set up an appointment "
Don't bother it doesn't do any good.
This was my second and last I will time going to Lady Janes!
Great food!  Idaho lacks on good Chinese food.  This place is the best we have found so far.

Well, this made me think twice about every bringing my fur pup there.  I called 45 mins before closing, because my dog was sick and weak, but instead of wanting to take of my pet, they suggested I go somewhere else, because they were closing soon.  That just showed me, they don't care about the animals, but when they are wanting to go home.  On the answering machine, it said press 0 if it was an a emergency, so that's is what I pushed, and then I was pushed off to go somewhere else, because they wanted to make sure they left at 6 pm.  All I know is I will not take my fur family to a place that really shows what they care more about and that's is not them.  I have to take my sick puppy to a place that really care, and not about what time they want to walk out the door.

Since my first appointment and first review the service I've received from this company has gone way down hill. I'm guessing it's one of those companies that sends out the well-paid, highly-trained, "deal closers" to the first appointment to get you hooked and sign the contract. Then after you're locked in they stop sending those guys and instead swap them out with the usually younger, minimum wage crowd that don't really care about anything except a paycheck and even then they could go either way. 

After the initial visit we waited three months and out of the blue received a call telling me, not asking me, about an appointment they'd set up for my next spray. The time and day would not work so I had to reschedule right then while at work so I wouldn't have guys showing up the next morning when no one was home. Got that done, the guy came, however it was raining so he only did the inside and said they'd call to reschedule the exterior. 

I never got a call about the outside so I called them and set it up. I left specific instructions that we would be home at 5:15 and there is a locked gate to the back that we will open when we arrive, they can do the front yard if they arrive before we do. The appointment day arrived and so did the technician (early and ignoring our instructions) but before the work could be done the guy's truck broke. My husband gave the guy tools to use and a few parts (washers, nuts, etc) to get it fixed since the guy had nothing with him and they resolved the problem. Immediately after that the equipment to do the spray broke also and again the guy (Maxx) had no parts or tools to fix his equipment. He still had an hour and a half in our time window but decided he didn't want to drive to Meridian to get the part and then come back to spray so we'd have to reschedule, again. 

Once again, no call to reschedule from them. I called and told them this was the third attempt at the exterior. Set up the appointment, waited for the day, raced home after work to get there no later than 5:15. We pull in the driveway and can already see the note flapping at our front door. Landon had been by but apparently couldn't spray because of the wind conditions and couldn't be bothered to wait for us to get there and explain so we got a note shoved in the door telling us to reschedule, AGAIN. At this point we don't even want to bother with this crap anymore. 

I called to complain and cancel but they apologized profusely and promised to make it right. They agreed to send their best technician to finish the exterior and since it had been so long at this point they agreed to do the interior again. In addition, they would not charge us for the next service after they finally finished the first contracted one. They sent a tech and this time we got what we'd thought we were going to get the whole time. He was friendly, extremely thorough, and really knew what he was doing. He explained that he's typically one of the guys who does the first visits, surprise, surprise, but he had heard about others not being thorough. We thanked him for being so thorough and friendly and things were looking up. Until three more months went by and we had to deal with them again.

Once again I received a call telling me what my appointment time and date was. Again, they scheduled at a time that will never work for me so we had to reschedule. Again I went over the specific instructions that others had ignored about what time we'll be home to grant access to the rest of the property. My window was 5-7 on that date. I get a call on my cell phone from Maxx (oh yay) around 3:00 asking if we'd like to move the time earlier because he's ready right now and doesn't want to wait for our time so he can be done earlier. I explained that earlier wasn't ok because my husband and I were at work and wouldn't be done until the time specified in the notes we left. He said, "oh...ok", and hung up. We race home anticipating that Maxx will be waiting there since he was ready two hours ago but nothing. 5:45 rolls around and still no Maxx and no call so I finally called him. He finally arrives after 6 and then wants to speed through things. My husband asked him about the stuff they sprinkle in the lawn for bugs and Maxx says, "yeah we do that but it's getting kinda late so maybe we should reschedule that part". Oh no, I don't think so. My husband had to follow him around the property and ask multiple questions to get him to do the full service that was expected. Anywhere he could have cut corners he would have if my husband hadn't insisted it be done right.

Overall, not impressed with the customer service methods of this company. The ladies in the office tell you one thing and then the notes they are supposedly writing down are always missed or ignored by the techs. Every tech we've had, except the very first one and they guy sent to keep us from cancelling, has been awful. I would highly recommend looking elsewhere for pest control services in Boise!!!

This is an updated review of their bahn mi. Pho 779 has definitely stepped up their sandwich game. I ordered the bbq pork bahn mi and it was so tasty! The bread was in an actual baguette and it was soft and tender. Perfect amount of vegetables! I will totally be back for the bahn mi and of course, their Pho! Yum!

I've been going here for over a year and they always do an amazing job.
Their prices are reasonable and they are quick but never make me feel rushed or do a messy job because they're in a hurry.
Rude and disorganized. 45 minute wait times with an appointment and you get attitude. Not a great value

Brenda P. was very nice and understanding as I explained how I wanted my haircut. 

Petros K.
Awesome service great food very reasonable pricing definitely will be a repeat customer!

Walking into the Harp I wasn't sure what to expect. This location has changed businesses so often in the past 5 years that I didnt even know the Harp was even there as I drove by daily. 

As you enter you have a bar section to your left with bar seating and high tops. I figured the reastraunt or casual dining would be on the right, which it was, but the seating options are pretty poor. They have a long bench along the window side and a few small metal tables with metal chairs. No booths or comfrotable seating. I chose the benching seat because it looked way better than the small metal chair. 

For apps we ordered the meat, cheese, fruit spread and for $12.00 I was very dissapointed in the amount of food we got. About 6 peices of two assorted meats, a little bit of grapes and apples, and about a 1/4 cup of assorted nuts. It also had a hummas and a bread. It was OK. nothing too exciting. 

I ordered the shepards pie and a Guiness beer for lunch. 

The Shepard's Pie was great and I'd recommend it. I've never had a shepard's pie so I'm not quite sure how it's supposed to be made/taste/expect ect, but I really enjoyed what I got. The beer was great, but Guiness is always awesome.

Overall I enjoyed my meal, I didnt feel the price was worth what I got overall, but It was a business trip so no big deal. I would go back, but probably only on business trips. Also wont order that app again, not worth it.

Great meals with big portions. Everyone left happy and full! Loved the beer selection and salads were delicious and huge. Kid's breakfast meal fed the kid and his dad, with leftovers still going home with us.

So...the ac has been out for over a week!   It's only 100+ outside...don't the owners know how many people have walked out of here.  The food....sometimes it's great,  but you can order the same thing a week later and it's completely different.   Don't get any chicken sandwich...they are horrible thigh meat full of grissel,  and they are 15 bucks....what a waste.   The bartenders are great and they have good beer,  but I won't eat here anymore....beware!

Nice little pub.  Other guests were enthusiastically watching football games.  
We enjoyed cocktails, an amazing Shepherd Pie and Corned Beef with kraut and potatoes. Very authentic!

There aren't too many boba places in this town but Urban Fox is a star in the game.  The almond milk tea with mango boba is life-altering in the best possible way.  I am a customer for life now and pretty much go here every morning on my way to work.   Cannot wait to try the Thai tea and other boba drinks.   

I realize Eagle Road is a force to be reckoned with, but this is a true gem and worth a visit -- or 5.  

Seriously.  Check it out.  You will not be disappointed.
This is the best way to go on a date. My wife and I went there for on date night and we're able to have one Burger holy cow and it was good and tater tots and french fries way to go Big Juds

My wife and I wanted Italian food for dinner so we googled it to see if one was close by. It came back with Loui's pizza and Italian restaurant. This place was a wonderful find. Beautiful decor, great wine list. Try the Condrum, it was great. The food was excellent. I had the eggplant and it was the best I ever had. Our Server was Christy and she was amazing! Best experience we've had in a long time.

I know, can you believe I am giving a dentist five stars! One because if you have read some of my other reviews of dentists you will see I seem to have horrible luck choosing them. Two it is a dentist and who likes the dentist right?

But I really, truly had a very enjoyable visit and would highly recommend anyone looking for a new dentist.

The office is located in the new strip mall on the corner of Linder and Chinden, next to Fred Meyer. It is a clean, comfortable office. Some modern conveniences but nothing ridiculously over the top. Not sure if it is the norm, if it was because I was a new patient, or if it was because the hygienist was finishing up with another patient, but I was actually greeted in the waiting room by Dr. Thompson  AKA  Scott.  Definitely a first, I mean when is the last time your Dr. has ever come out in the waiting room to greet you?  I bet never!

Scott was very personable, and genuinely made me feel comfortable and welcome in his office.  He spent a few minutes getting to know me, before we even talked teeth. When it was time for my cleaning, the hygienist was finishing up with another patient and Scott said he would go ahead and start the cleaning while I waited for her.  WHAT??  Have you ever had your dentist clean your teeth?  Seriously, I wasn't sure until now that a dentist even knew how to do that!

When the hygienist, I believe Jessica was her name, came in she was also very friendly and personable.  And best of all, the most gentle teeth cleaning I have ever received. 

The dental assistant who took my x-rays was great.  He was friendly and made the process painless.  I hate those little plastic film strips, and he did a great job!  The technology they have for taking photos of your mouth is really quite amazing.

New patient exam,  x-rays and cleaning $59!  Based on my x-rays Scott talked to me about his recommendations for the future, and then Lori (from the front desk) came in to my exam room and talked to me while I lounged in my chair about scheduling future visits, payment options, etc.  She even gave me a photo of the tooth they suggest I get fixed, so that I could have something visual to take home with me.

I was looking for an authentic Irish pub to celebrate my husbands birthday with friends and came across The Harp on Yelp & am very happy I did. We had such a great time and the food was great & very much authentic per my husband who said the Bangers and Mash were just like he had in England. Tiffany was our server and she was AWESOME and friendly! We weren't waiting long for food or drinks! Not one of us had a single complaint and will be back again! Thank you so much for your hospitality, Tiffany. My husband had a great night and won't forget it! The Irish music was awesome as well! Loved everything about this pub and will recommend to anyone looking to have a good time!
FB little hole on the wall.  Waitresses are very patient with my 85 year old Dad with bad hearing and dementia.

Jeff is the best!  He has been doing my taxes for years.  The one time I tried a different preparer, my return was a mess!  I am confident that Jeff does a thorough and effective job, always managing to maximize my refund.  I wouldn't go to anyone else (even though I live far away).

Suzanne

I've been here a few times.  The first is when my husband and I were looking for houses this summer.  I had finally convinced my hubby to try a pedicure.  They were great at making him feel at ease and making him laugh.  We both got amazing pedicures. 

 I stopped in recently to get a gelish/shellac manicure.  I don't remember the last time I've had such a fast manicure.  I quickly realized that a "regular" walked in shortly after me and my lady was hurrying to get done with me so she could do the other lady's nails.  This was a bit disappointing.  I'm still happy with the result but I expected much more.  My hand/arm massage was prob about 1 minute total and she didn't take much time to file and shape my nails to look similar (some are square edges-some are round).

For all you can eat, this place is hard to beat especially for the price. They have pretty good quality ingredients and tons of sauce options. The best part of the experience was the staff who were all very friendly to us and the other guests but most of all was the hostess. It's not the best food by any means but you can get whatever you're feeling at the time and the price is unmatched at about $23 for food and drink for 2 people.

As a boba addict, i was super excited about this place opening up, But I gotta say I was a little let down. It's not the best boba, the boba was not enough soft and sweet, the tea was okay but not enough flavor. Maybe I'm too picky for boba...but still. I was expecting too much! And I tried some desert toast. It was okay but they can use fresh strawberry instead of frozen strawberries since they just put whipped cream and strawberry on top of the  small block of bread.

none of the workers were wearing masks and more than half of the people in the little waiting area/the rest of the restaurant weren't wearing them either. if you're concerned for your health and safety, this wouldn't be the place to go.

Quite possibly the worst experience.  If you ask for plans, you won't get them and you will be lucky to get what you actually ask for.  We spent a lot of money on a firplace from them.  While the fireplace turned out satisfactory, it was like pulling teeth to get the work done and get what we asked for.  They contracted to have some electrical work done, it was shoddy to say the least and when they came back to correct the fact the outlet was 1/2 inch above the mantle and not flush they still could not get it flush.  The first thing I plugged in the socket fell right through the mantle!  Save youself the headache and go somewhere else.  I can not recommend anyone else but ask whoever you are looking at to see work they have done at actual houses and call past clients.  I came from the Seallte area where you could find quality contractors, here in Boise they are not so easy to find.  I do know the standard of service with Alpine is horrible and that goes all the way to the headquarters where you will surely get an attitude if you have any problems you wish to address.  Hope this saves someone from the mistake we made by using them.  If you are into compromising what you ask for becasue they have selected something different for you, having no follow through, high cost for just average service these are the people for you.

My least favorite Zamzows. Gracelyn was rude about my dead fish and controversial rather than helpful or empathetic. When I spoke to the manager he told me they "shouldn't have sold me 3 fish" and that I needed to buy more products. Laughable. Will not be back. My fish are happy and will source from nicer people. I love buying local and I love Zamzows but I love being treated better more. Also please keep in mind this was a $2.39 fish.
Have been there at least 20 times before    Today a huge disappointment....slow service and Mongolian Beef that tasted like tough donkey

We chose the Majestic because it doesn't have the silly chose your seat method like The Village. It is the older of the two main Meridian cinemas, but clean, well maintained, updated, and shows all the first run flicks.

Tuesday's are $5 movies all day. If I could eat that much popcorn, I would love the $13.50 refillable, reusable bucket. Bring it with you for the next movie and get a refill for $3. 

Oh yeah, parking is much easier than at The Village Cinemas.

Leif is a truly gifted photographer, and one of the most genuine, wonderful people I've had the honor to meet. I first met Leif at my cousin's wedding, he was her photographer. I was impressed by his professionalism, but when her photos came back I was in awe. They were truly stunning. I was just beginning to plan my own wedding and I knew without a doubt that we had to choose Leif. It was the easiest and best decision we made while planning our wedding.

He made the whole process seamless and so easy. His communication leading up to our wedding day was excellent. His presence on the day was calming and professional and made everything flow that much better. I feel very uncomfortable in front of cameras but he put my husband and I at ease. And his creativity with the shots he took throughout our location was simply amazing.

We had a very fast turn-around time with our photos, and they could not have been any more beautiful. He captured the most magical moments of that day. People see our photos and rave about how they look magazine quality. They are STUNNING.

I cannot speak highly enough about him. His talent is phenomenal, but picking Leif as your photographer also gets you a sincere, genuine, thoughtful friend to make your day go that much smoother. And most importantly, you will undoubtedly get incredible, breath-taking photos.

I can't tell you how much better I feel after just one physical therapy session with Dustin. He was very thorough with diagnosing my problem,  working on my pain area, and giving me exercises to do at home. I look forward to my next appointments and feeling better than I  have in a long time. Thank you !!!

I really wanted to like this place. It's been on our places to go for over 3 years. The waitress started out strong coming out 3 times right when we sat down to get our order. Then it progressively went downhill. After she dropped the water and coffee and took our order. She didn't check on us until bringing our food out 35 minutes later. Mind you, the restaurant was 1/4 full. The table in front of us and behind us while seated outside came after we already placed our order yet they received their food 10 min before we did. The waitress checked on the table behind us 2x and we couldn't get her attention for more coffee or water. We waited 35 min for our food only to be incredibly disappointed. My home fries were soaked in grease and half cooked, barely room temp. My eggs were over hard and there was barely any visible jalapeño jelly. The fried steak with gravy and eggs, he had a hard time cutting with a steak knife the chicken was so over cooked. I had to walk inside to pay my check because our waitress never checked on us and I didn't want to wait another 20 minutes. 

I really wanted to like this place. They have a really unique menu.
American freedom with optional mask wearing!! Five star *****. Amazing food! We appreciate not being told what to do!

So full! 

We had an excellent brunch.  I had the bargain brunch where you can pick three items from a very long list.  Two French toast triangles, two eggs your way (over easy for me), and hash browns.  It was definitely more than what I could eat and portions are pretty big!  My hubby got the special carnitas soppas.  He said it was very tasty, however it was cold on the top from the salsa.   So eggs were not as hot like fresh cooked, although they were.  

Staff was incredibly nice and very welcoming.  Decor is very "dude" centric.  Although a new branch, it could use an interior decorator to make it feel more homey or farmhouse like, but that doesn't change that the food is still good!
