Advice/suggestion:  do not vacuum while people are in there eating.  It was hard to hear each other and otherwise would have been pleasant.  Also, just don't vacuum around food.  Wait till everyone is gone.
I've been here several times and the food usually good but last night I had the orange chicken and tuna sushi  and ended up with food poisoning.

I took my family here for my daughters birthday dinner. The food was very bland, my daughter was brought out her meal "chicken artichoke fettuccini" with a totally different sauce than she ordered. I had the baked rigatoni that was over baked with a very burnt sausage. After fixing my daughters sauce and my sausage it was very very bland. Our appetizers of pizza and mozzarella sticks were mediocre at best. When we brought this up to the manager we were told the reason it was so bland was because we did not put any Parmesan cheese on. The only thing good that we had was the garlic bread.

I called them up and asked if I lived in their service area and was told over the phone that I was, so I scheduled a consultation visit with one of their 'Account Executives'.  The appointment was very timely, and the gentleman who looked over my trees was very professional and personable.  He didn't believe it was a problem where I lived and he told me that he would consult with his tree expert for the best course of action to assist some distressed trees, and spray all of the others on a periodic basis for good health.  He actually came out to my house a second time to take pictures and look over my trees again.  He said that he would talk to his experts the next day, and would get back to me regarding remedial treatment, but said that the office will be contacting me to get me on a recurring spraying maintenance schedule for what I thought was a reasonable price.  

About 2 weeks later after I didn't hear from the Account Executive, I emailed him to ask about the status, and the next day I called the office and asked my question to a very nice lady who passed my message on to the Account Executive.  He called me later that day and left me a message that Senske would be unable to provide service because of my location.  Really?  Now, I'm 3 weeks delayed from maybe getting another service to help with our trees.  

I'm not sure when the Account Executive was going to call me to tell me that, if at all if I hadn't inquired into the status.  You know, bad news seldom gets better with time.

In summary, Senske does a good job on the sales part, but I'm not sure their development strategy is synced up with the Branch leadership.  They could have looked at my address to see where I lived to determine if I was indeed in their service area before they even came out to waste the salesman's time, or mine.

In addition, I think its short sided for the Boise branch to not service my location.  I live no further than 25 minutes from BOI and 15 minutes from Warm Springs Avenue.  My neighborhood is expanding with more new homes being built, and one of the best advertisements for any service company to have is their service trucks routinely in the area along with neighbor testimonies for quality of service.  

I'm sorry I can't attest to any level of service other than sales as we didn't get that far in the process.

P.S.  Since I first the above review, another Senske salesman called me up a couple of days ago to get me on a regular service schedule.  When I told him that I was earlier told that I lived out of their service area, he was confused, and then he put me on hold and searched for our address and I think he asked someone else in the office, and then came back and told me that he apologized, but yes, I did live out of our service area.  Once again, the company is not really communicating within themselves.  Actually, I'm glad I do live out of their service area.
Stopped by for happy hour on a Saturday afternoon.  Great menu and atmosphere.  We'll be back for dinner soon!!!

Thank you Groomingtails for allowing me to drop off Derby for his last bath.  You treated the Old Pup with kindness and compassion.  You are amazing.  Thank you for your help with Brown Derby.  We will be back for sure.

We waited for 45 mins after being told we we onmu needed to wait for 25. The floor had spilt food and drinks all under our "cleaned" table. The serves was super slow and it took forever to get our drinks and food...Customer Service welll let just say there is non....

We have been going to Louie's as a family for as long as I can remember, and their pizza is by far the best I have ever tasted, ever.  When I moved away to Boston for five years, I would ALWAYS make a stop to Louie's on my visits home.  My favorite pizza they have is the family style, with Italian sausage, pepperoni and mushrooms.  The toppings are out of this world and I have yet to find any as tasty, and their sauce, crust and cheese are also excellent contributers to making this the best pizza around.  I have seldom ventured away from the pizza for other dishes, but there has never been a reason to.  Their pizza is that good!  I would definitely recommend with highest regards!
This is where I spend my "me" time as a new mother. I love it because I can check in with my body and mind before starting my day.
Wonderful food and good service. The potatoes were amazing. The portion was massive. My wife loved it too. Will definitely go again next time in town.

Before visiting Idaho, my coworkers and I scouted places to dine. I was super excited to try this place for breakfast. The food looked as amazing in person as it did online and tasted even better. This is definitely a spot for a family or friends to share a meal. The only reason why they're not getting a 5 star rating is because of the person who greater, sat, and served us. She was not the happiest person and was super dry. She did her job but her attitude was very dry. Even a tiny bit rude-ish. I would definitely go back if I ever visited again.

I've been a fan of This salon since they opened up many years ago. Sadly , our relationship has ended. Pushing for cash only whereas they had accepted CC since the day they opened up, and not mentioning cash only until after your appointment. Super FAST pedi (20 mins) on my last and final visit yesterday. I had made two appointments for a gel appointment so my friend and I could go and relax and catch up ... we were rushed the minute we walked in and 2-4 minutes into my pedicure i had to stop the tech and ask if she was in a rush??? Her reply was no... she was also a brute and I had to ask her to slow down! Needless to say... this business has changed and no longer the same nail salon that it was even up to a year ago... goodbye:

Estimated wait times is completely incorrect. 
Gross older dudes stare at anyone. I can't say anything about the service because it has been double my estimated wait time. 
If you want to catch a cold, have creepy old gross men stare at you and waste your entire day here- come on in.
Great theater with friendly staff. I was super impressed with the plush heated recliner seats. We will definitely be back.
Living in Boise my whole life, not a lot of places interest me. This place was a 10/10 all around. Very pleased, and VERY satisfied! Will definitely be back.

I love thrift shopping! What I don't love about goodwill is how the store is always trashed. There are always employees everywhere and the store is still a mess. The clothing racks are also always over stocked so it is hard to look at the clothing. 

Prices are great.

A great "one size fits all" stop. It's got milk teas, tea, coffee, lemonades... you name it!
We stopped by here a couple times during our trip to Idaho. I tried a couple different drinks (lemonade fizz, coffee, and milk tea) all were incredible! Good flavor, maybe a little on the sweet side across the board. 
Overall we really liked it and will definitely grab it again when we head to Idaho again.

Ordered the chicken mushroom sandwich and split it with the wife. The piece of chicken was much too small for the bun. There were very few shrooms as well. The flavor was good, but size does matter. 

The side salad was good. 

The place wasn't busy at all, and it took over 20 minutes for the food to come out.

I may go back again, not real sure.
I had the Andy burger it was good a little expensive for what it was. The onion rings were also good but nothing to rave about. I am sure I will go back but not for anything specific.

Can't comment on the food quality as my husband and I have been waiting for 40 minutes and still not received our order (with only 4 people ahead of us when we ordered). We have had faster service at full on sit down restaurants and are now going to be late for an appointment thinking this was a somewhat fast food joint. I'm not sure if this is typical or not but it would take a lot for me to eat here again if this is their normal speed.

When I took a vest in to have it altered the staff was very knowledgeable and I had high hopes. That was almost three months ago and I still do not have the vest. Each time I have stopped by the shop I have been told that due to Bridal emergencies my vest wasn't done. I tried to call them but they do not allow me to leave a voicemail, but rather I have to send an email or drive out there. 2 weeks ago they told me I would have it last week and that they would call when it was done but I have not received a call. I could not be more disappointed in the service.

Family-owned, great Italian food for your whole family! 

We were celebrating a family birthday and made a reservation in the private room seating 15 people. The team at Louies was amazing. We all arrived separately and they got us all seated and drinks very quickly.   Bread was brought out and not too much later our order was taken.  Our waitress was super attentive to everybody, and with the amount of people we had everybody had a perfect order.  

The white Alfredo sauce on tortellini is amazing and the red marinara sauce on baked spaghetti is amazing. 

Overall restaurant was really clean and well-maintained bathrooms were clean and well-maintained we had an excellent wait staff that made our experience very pleasant and charming. 

I highly recommend making a reservation and if you're going to have a large party request the small private room so that way you guys can be loud and laugh and and not bother everyone in the restaurant.  We had a wonderful time and did not feel rushed.
Absolutely delicious Thai Tea Boba . Definitely gonna have to stop by again before heading back home haha. Highly recommend this spot! Super friendly staff, and quick service!
We couldn't have had a more enjoyable experience here. Tae, the manager, was very accommodating and helpful for our needs. Will definitely stay here again!

We only had our items there for one and a half months. High potential for vermin damages and nothing got damaged.  Never noticed telling signs of vermin until after moving out. Though only two or three pellets

Be hungry! 

We came for dinner with a crowd of about 12 and had amazing service on a game day. They also have great BSU game day happy hour specials!

The food is delicious and plentiful! We sampled many different menu items and all really enjoyed our meals. 

Our service was fantastic! Looking forward to trying breakfast here soon.
This place is awful, stuff is very disrespectful and rude, i don't recomend this place!
They also do pedicures for old crotchety men (like me) with extremely thick, tough, difficult toe nails.  I am a big fan.

LOVE me some big Juds! 

So this place holds a special place in my heart. Going to college in south east Idaho the original run down Big Juds in Archer, which is still there (a structural and food safety miracle), was always packed. Filled with college guys trying their best to get their picture on that wall of fame after completing the big jud. The unsuccessful being rolled out of the place beaten, hurting, and hunched over in pain from that barstool sized burger still fighting back. The best fries on the flipping planet and filling the cracks with ice cream afterwards. 

I am happy to report that the Meridian location is a very good representation of the original. The burgers here are actually put together with more detail and taste identically delicious. Let me say this now.....Big Juds has a fantastic burger. They are truly great. Not the greasy American cheese oozing burger you fell in love with, but something just as nostalgic and comforting. They are big...the singles are managable, the doubles are perfectly big (for me), and the Big Jud will feed a family if needed. 

But it doesn't stop there, oh no. They have chicken sandwiches that rival that of the burgers! I have recently discovered an insanely....rediculously....mind blowingly great chicken sandwich here, that when altered in just such a way becomes a miracle between buns (that's what she said). The mushroom swiss chicken... order it in a double... and get one fillet grilled and one fried.  Life changing,  you are welcome...I now own you for the remainder of your days.... yes it's that good see my photo. 

So I mentioned the fries being the best on planet earth, and they are at both the original location and the Ashton location just before heading up to Yellowstone, however it is sad to report they cut them differently here in boise and they are really good but not as good as the original locations. The onion rings are spot on however and remain some of my favorites anywhere. And did I mention you can get scotch and soda here? Cause you can... and I do. 

If the length of this review doesn't give away the memories I have at this place I dont know what does. The Meridian location is very good. A solid 4 stars plus....but missing those fries, the original location gets 5 all the way. One of the best burger joints in the state of idaho....and for this guy it is THE burger joint in Idaho. Just dont go too often.... your children want you around after the age of 55.
rude and condescending :/ and made drinks for a line of other people's orders before mine (who ordered after me), when all i ordered was basic milk tea, nothin crazy.

Boise doesn't come around easy in Boise. Urban Fox delivers it all - friendly service, modern atmosphere and absolutely delicious product!

Since this was my first time here I wanted to keep it simple, and I didn't look up their menu beforehand so I resorted to good old taro. My husband is obsessed with Thai tea this summer so that's he went with. The drinks were made super fast and the girls working were very friendly. They did say we could mix things up and think about other options, and while I knew what I wanted I appreciated their patience.

Both teas were delicious! The boba was fantastic. It was just the perfect amount of sweetness. Additionally it was cooked to perfection. My husband got some jellies in his that were fabulous to him albeit I found them way to sweet for my liking.

I'm definitely coming back soon to try their butterfly tea boba! Nothing better on a hot summer day than cold ice tea and boba always slaps, amirite?!

Took my daughter out of network on July 5th for X-rays and a referral for an MRI for an injury that isn't healing. This is also a second opinion. PA ordered additional X-rays and an MRI. It's now July 14th and they have yet to complete our referral for an MRI. I called on Thursday of last week, and again twice on July 13th (yesterday) where the receptionist stated that our case was still "open" and it shouldn't be. She assured me that she would call me back in the afternoon and get this situation resolved.... She did not. I called back @ 4:30 and got the vm service.  Today, the office opened at 10:00 and I can't get anyone to answer my call from my cell number and it goes directly to their voicemail service. Absolutely Horrible Service!!!

Came by for breakfast, so glad we did.  The decir is retro 50s, very cute. I decided to have lunch, ordered the small salad, even that was too much, soooo yummy.   Food is reasonably priced, service is fast and friendly. Would definitely come back.
It was just ok. For the price could of gone to great wall and got my fill. As it was I walked away hungry. The outside atmosphere was the redeeming feature. Near the outside fountain.

Ed's 50's Cafe was well within my wheelhouse for everything I love about 50's style cafes!  The 50's decor is fun to look at all around the entire cafe.  Unlike many of these type of cafes where the booths and chairs are allowed to decay of the the years, Ed's booths and chairs are pristine!  No tape or cracks.. very comfortable to sit without worry that your bum is going to be pinched or scratched!  LOL!

The staff is really friendly and helpful.  They even help each other so customers do not wait very long for refills or help of any kind.  

The menus are plastic covered and taped to each wall at every booth.  You don't have to touch them, keeping everyone that much safer.  Genius!

I've been here 3 times already and I enjoyed enjoyed the food every time.  I definitely recommend giving Ed's 50's Cafe a go!

Purchased a kids bike a few months ago, we did not have a lot of time to ride due to weather.  Gears are bad and pedal fell off.  Dicks response was "Did you purchase the protection plan" - really Dicks?

I will be taking my business else where and my daughter is hurt because she had an accident that when the pedal fell off.

Horrible sweet and sour chicken. 
Dry chicken bland sauce & it took over 20 minutes to get our food. They were also out of sprite and took a solid 15 minutes to get us our drink. 
All in all the food was completely disappointing & the time it took to get our meal means we won't be back!

I cannot say enough good things about Riverbend Family Dental! My son had a really bad toothache and they got him in the same day. They were patient and caring with him and helped put his nerves at ease. Dr. Bennion truly went above and beyond for my son and I am very appreciative. I would highly recommend him to anyone!
This is a solid little place!  Small, but on-point menu, great service, good food, and friendly atmosphere. This place checked off all the boxes.
Love this place. Good food and great service. Can't wait to eat there again. I would reccomend to family and friends.

This is one of the my favorite place in town. I came in town with my family for memorial weekend, my friend recommended this pizza place. This is 10 of the 10th, Best pizza, unbelievably healthy & unusual ingredients and best service. I'll recommend it to everyone. Next time I'm in town, this is my lunch and dinner place.
Thank you.

Nice little spot to grab a cup of coffee at the Village!

Coffee is great and their pastries are quite yummy. However, I do think it's strange that it shares that same establishment as Rice Works and Calle 75 Street Tacos. I wish this place was its own little store but I may be asking for too much and have been spoiled with other coffee shops around town. 

Nevertheless, this place is ideal for those looking to grab a quick cup of coffee and hang around the Village. Be prepared for the volume to be a bit louder than what you are used to at a more typical coffee shop.

Interesting enough, someone changed my original review! Stopped by yesterday morning, my son and I. Ordered two steaks medium and over medium eggs! When the ordered arrived the waitress asked if we needed steak sauce, we declined. After cutting open both steaks open they were raw on the inside, not a little pink but disgustingly raw..I hate sending anything back ,so cut up the steak and the plate turned red
Literally it looked like 30 seconds on both sides, not to mention the eggs were running off the table. After a while the waitress came back and saw my plate I asked for steak sauce and told her it's the only way I am going to be able to choke this down.. she agreed and asked if I want to cook it longer and the cook has been screwing up all day. I declined, I managed 1/2 the steak. THe waitress was kind enough to take two dollars of my bill. And said she will definitely speak to the cook. Recommendations, to many other places less hassle! Not recommended!

I really enjoyed my stay here at this funky European modern version of a Hilton. Tru is a new brand here and is a mix of Lego, Ikea, and Euro styling. The lobby is super bright and colorful with a pool table, work cubicles, breakfast buffet wall, snack counters, swing chairs, kids play area over the top lighting and colors. Shocking to say the least.

The rooms are uber modern, with hard surfaces, bright colors, plastic and wood furniture and more hooks than closets. Everything is wide open, easy to clean and keep clean, efficient but cold and inelegant. Soaps and shampoo in large wall mounted squeeze bottles, enormous HD flatscreen, free WiFi, nice bed, tons of towels, good AC. 

An interesting choice with decent prices and freeway close.

I needed a pair of pants hemmed for an event (same day and Saturday no less)--they were closed, but the owner came in, hemmed my pants in about 10 min and charged me an incredibly reasonable amount!  She created a "raving fan" for sure!
Use these guys--you will not be disappointed.

I love QNail Spa. I have exclusively gone to get my nails and pedicures here for 5 years. They give me beautiful bling on my nails everytime. I'm older so they are very careful to help me in and out of the chairs.
Debra M.

Requested to eat here last Sunday as we had had good food and good service the time before. We got seated right away, in the back, which has an awkward lay out. Anyway, took server forever to take our order. When we got our food, it was COLD and my eggs were browned. Eggs are not supposed to be browned ever. I did not send them back but I did send back my biscuits and gravy which took forever to get back again. Understaffed? Someone called out? Don't care...do not serve cold food. This place is waaaaaaay down on the list of places to return to.

Great customer service and the location is very good, it's not super busy and you can pay your bill online, quickly. They are easy to work with and don't try to up sell you units. I recommend them for a large or for small storage needs.

Amazing service. Coming from Los Angeles were pedicures are 15 dollars a pop, I was having some trouble dealing with the experience prices here in idaho. I had gone to a few other salons here in bosie/meridian were pedicure were 3O/35 dollars. And although they were okay, they were just that, okay. Enchant nails does an amazing and thorough service for only 25. I've found my new pedicure salon!!!

First visit to this theater since it IS a bit of a drive from where we live.  My wife has been here a few times, and since we were on our way to Boise on an errand, we stopped in to see a great movie.

Great theater, though it wasn't all that busy for a Sunday afternoon.  Excellent seats with stadium style seating.
At the Pflugerville location, the staff are very professional and deliver a consistent, high quality experience with every visit.

Maybe the pizza is the star for this place and I missed out, but the food I had was sub par, bland, zero flavor. I wouldn't be surprised if a lot of the ingredients weren't fresh. If they were, what a waste not to season them and use them correctly. The minestrone tasted like it was out of can, or not made that day. The portions are huge which seemed like it was quantity over quality.  I would rather have normal sized portions that actually have flavor, seasoning, fresh herbs, how Italian food should be. There is a place in Meridian Gino's Italian Ristorante; that how it should be done. I will say the waiting staff was nice, and the garlic bread was good, but that was about it.

This could become our new favorite pizza place! We had the pesto chicken and margherita pizza and both with delicious. Just the right amount of of sauce, cheese, and toppings. The pesto and red sauce were both very good. The chicken on the pesto chicken was very well seasoned and not dried out. Our favorite part was the crust! Perfectly cooked in the wood fire oven and not overly thick or heavy. This is the only pizza we've eaten that hasn't made us feel overly full afterwards! The owner is lovely and the service was great. We will be going back!
This place is amazing!! I have two dogs, one young (1 yr) and one older (15). They take such amazing care of them and I am always treated with respect and care. I highly recommend them!!
Thanks to your helpful staff. They are consistently able to guide me to just what I'm looking for. The recent sales have been excellent. Well stocked and organized store.

We've been wanting to try this place for a while now.   Finally had an out-of-the-blue kidless evening and ventured in.   Being new we asked for a minute to decide among the many house drinks.   My wife decided on the gimlet special, which the waitress proceeded to make 3 different excuses as to why they couldn't, including being out of a liquor that wasn't even in the recipe.   Pretty sure she just didn't know how to make it.  According to one patron (among 2 that tried to help us and the table next to us get served) the owner was sitting at the bar BS'ing with a regular and doing birthday shots, and she later checked on the table next to us but didn't even throw us a glance.   It didn't take us long to decide against ordering food and doing a one-and-done drink visit to get food elsewhere.   Temper your expectations.....especially with a business who can't even get their hours right on their Yelp page....(what pub closes at 1 pm on Friday and Saturday).

Nothing but fantastic things to say about everyone I worked with in this company. They got my job done despite serious time constraints on my part and went over beyond. Great quality work and exceptional customer service! Thank you so much!

Been there a few times for Happy Hour and nibbles . Walked the salad bar for a look and can't wait till my stomach is ready for the full boat. 
Their house Chardonnay is the most interesting wine in a long time.
Check it out for sure.

Had a septic tank pumped - husband was impressed with punctuality, and said the technician was pleasant and professional. Really nice that he suggested we didn't need to have the second tank pumped at this time - probably go to a 5-year schedule, because the use is slight on that residence. Nice to save that $! Appreciate getting true customer service - earning trust!

They'll continue to get our business - and recommendation!

A group of us flew in from California, staying at the hotel in the same complex...wanted to grab a beer before calling it a night and ended up closing the bar down! We had a great time.. the kitchen was closed by the time we got here but we were able to doordash some food and they were totally cool with it. Aria was wonderful and had great conversation, we loved her! Thank you again to The Harp for having us.

3 times we came here within 24 hours 
Bangers and mash 
Mac and cheese 
Sheppards pie 
Bloody Mary (midwest mary) 
Bread pudding 

The owner is way cool, food is amazing... I would fly back just for this place.

We were at this Goodwill location last night. Everything was fine until they did their 15 minute closing warning. My family was still shuffling through men's shirts at the time. I took that opportunity to go put an item back in housewares that I decided not to purchase. I passed a gentleman going through electronics and at the same time, an employee named Patty walked by both of us. She, very rudely, told him "hurry up, we're closing soon." And he responded that he was aware and that he was just about done and he and his wife had a bunch of stuff. Patty yelled from another aisle over "If you've got a bunch of stuff then you're done! You don't get to shop anymore. Take it to the front. You're done." The gentlemen looked at my like *Did I just hear that?*
He responded to her "Excuse me? Are you a manager?" To which Patty replied that she was. I had my doubts that this was true, but then she responded to a call up front for a manager.
Here is my issue. One: Patty was incredibly rude to that customer who could've easily taken his patronage to any other thrift store in town. (Not to mention, thrift stores that are actually for good causes, not just for profits for the overinflated salary of their CEO)
Two: There was 15 minutes until closing! 
I get that people wander around and the store can't lock up until they're out...but the guy had a few more shopping minutes at least. She could've simply said (in a nice way) "sir, we will be closing soon and if you have quite a few items to purchase, we ask that you make your way to the front soon so that we can get you taken care of along with our other customers. "
In short...if there are any other superiors to Patty that are reading this, you need to, at the very least, sit her down and give her a stern talking to about her lack of customer service skills. Or do everyone a favor and just can her. 
As for me and my family. We prefer Youth Ranch and their kind staff.
Loved my experience with Meridian Fence. The receptionist  Gwendalin was very responsive and helpful.
Heritage now has food! Like good, non bar-food food. Upstairs is the lounge- where they serve liquor and really yummy sushi! You can sit upstairs or downstairs and get service from either section!
Nice place to get games and ttrpg supplies. Also fun to meet up with friends to play games on site.

Quite possibly the best groom by pooch has ever had!! And not even having to leave the house? Can't get any better than that! Previous groomers have always had a hard time with old Rosco's nail trim to the point where it often didn't get done, but not with Jay at Grooming Tails! He did a fantastic job all around! We won't be going anywhere else here on out!

We're in Meridian, Idaho where there hasn't been a mask mandate for a while. Was made to look through the window and order from outside because I had no mask. Sandwich wasn't that great and it was soggy, probably had sandwich Covid. Will be taking my money somewhere that's managed by humans with sense.

Very cool place! Highly recommended, great atmosphere,great staff,friendly people and a great selection of craft beer. My fiance and I are from ohio and found this place and we are glad we did! Check it out, you won't be disappointed.

Second time with Kris and so relaxed and so tan!!  Thank you!  If you want a spectacular tan In the convenience of your own home Sun Kissed by Kris is the way to go!  She has a great subtle bronze  blend that is very natural with a chill personality to put you at ease!  My husband and I are big fans!  Thank you for getting us sun ready this winter!

It pains me to give this place one star. I do this however with good reason. I have been to this nail salon 2 times prior to today's visit. Both times I got an average mani pedi. Not bad but not outstanding. It was good enough to go back given how close it is to where I live. 

Today however, I did not even get to the stage of getting a mani pedi because of how the owner treated me when I began to ask when someone would be starting my mani pedi. 

I sat in the foot bath for over 20 minutes with no one appearing to be available. I felt trapped. Why soak me when there is no one available? The owner was irritated with me asking and even went so far as accusing me of making a scene. Believe me I hate scenes. I hate that type of attention. So that surprised me. I soon realized the owner was more concerned about a scene than customer service. At that point I decided it was time for me to leave. 

I took my now raisin feet out of the lukewarm water and gathered my things and left. The owner didn't seem to care much. 

With that type of behavior I am not sure the owner puts customers first. Which could translate into a whole host of things. I won't be back. 

The mani pedi quality is average and acceptable. But bad customer service is a deal breaker. 

Oh and the ventilation is not so great. I always leave with red irritated eyes. Moving onwards and upwards. S&B Spa in the village was where I ended up. How divine. What a difference.

We won 2 free night and when we got there to check in we were welcomed with open arms by Kimberly and another lady working the front desk.  They were so genuinely happy to see us and happy that we were the winners.  It was the best welcome that we have ever gotten at a hotel.  Kimberly was so knowledgeable of all the places to visit and recommended us visit McCall, which we did and loved.  Without her our trip would not have been as fun.  Thank you for the amazing services

Senske does an awesome job at keeping my grass green &  healthy. I get so many compliments on my yard. They also helped move some of my sprinklers and got them working better. Senske is the place to go for your yard.

Kris is amazing! So sweet and makes you feel comfortable. I hadn't gotten a spray tan in years and I needed to even out a really bad tan line from running outside so soon from my sister's wedding, duh?! Kris came to rescue! I got so many compliments on how I looked and when I mentioned I got spray tanned people were surprised! It makes you look thinner! I truly believe it's what helped me look beautiful the day of my sister's wedding! Thank you Kris!
As soon as I walked in the smell of the applewood fire oven sold me. Clean, fresh, and friendly location, felt like family. Thin crust pizza with amazing toppings. I will be coming back.

If you like paying full price for half the work done than this is the place for you. Sprayed the interior for pests and said they would be back within the week to spray the outside and never came. Ended up hiring someone else because needed ant problem to be fixed. The new company fixed pest problem in an hour. A month later Envi pest and lawn called trying to charge full price saying a contract was signed when it wasn't. Still charged for the half as job they did but instead of paying the full $175 they knocked it down to $75. Even though there were still ants after they sprayed the inside. Very disappointed in this company.

After calling several times and being willing to work around her schedule in messages I left for her and never receiving a call back I would say Kim is very busy, but very unprofessional. She should consider changes in the economy affecting her industry in the future and the business she has may go away. This would be a good time for her to call on those that she could not accommodate when she was busy. I would never hire her at this point because of her arrogance and rudeness in the fact that she has enough business, so she doesn't even take 2 minutes to call you back and tell you she can't fit you in.

We have been using senske pest services for several years now. Mario, our pest technician, is the best one out there. Always shows up, always calls or texts to make sure the schedule is correct, and always follows up with us the next day. He goes above and beyond to make sure our home is pest free! Highly recommend.
Stopped for lunch on my way through town. Great friendly service and good food. Nice portion sizes, will stop by again next time I am in the area.

I was totally just ignored when I went to them for a prevention exam. The provider I saw was nice but basically dismissed my issues. She had me get a scan done downstairs the next day. I was never told about the results only that she handed me off to a male provider in her office. Incredibly rude and insensitive treatment to a patient. Will never set foot in their offices again.

My family and I have been coming here for years and we absolutely love it! The food is always fresh, the place is always clean, and the front-of-house staff is always friendly. Our favorite Mongolian restaurant!

We have been customers of Louies since they were in Ketchum.  Great pizzas always.  We used to visit every other month with dear, long time friends but the virus has us getting take out.
It is still delicious and very special.

Village Coffee you are simply awesome, I had a lovely experience here yesterday. I can't even begin to describe how happy Village Coffee makes me. Every single thing I've tried up until now has been excellent. The team is extremely friendly too. Village Coffee... Can not ask for more.

So I've put off visiting Texas de Brazil due to the price point and what I've been told by coworkers. My BF is active military and he wanted to go for Veterans Day. What I heard from others is this is an over priced Tuscanos- I also found that to be true minus the amazing pineapple. We were offered 5 meats- both the bacon wrapped chicken and bacon wrapped beef were SO salty we didn't eat them. The one chicken option was bacon wrapped, the pork was dry. No grilled veggies. The garlic mashed potatoes they bring out to every table was blended so smooth it was the texture of baby food and not edible. They also brought out cinnamon sugar bananas that were cooked as a palate cleanser, I dont like hot banana but tasted them, no thank you. The salad bar area 'looked' fancy but the best thing about it was the scalloped potatoes and the bowl of roasted garlic. Oh and they have really good ranch dressing. We ordered their signature drink, made with Brazilian rum- I ordered mango and it was incredible- like really good. My BF liked the lime and ordered two. For $120 (after 20% military discount and before tip) I would have preferred to go elsewhere. They lack variety. We may return for Happy Hour at some point.. maybe.

Hooray, grand opening as of tomorrow but open this afternoon for folks who are World Market discount members.   Much improved location than when the store was in Boise.  Love the new space.  More breathing room.  Friendly "we're glad you're here staff".  Go during grand opening and Sono Fuego trio may be performing as they were today.  Great music.  The best part of the opening.  Had they let me, I would have bought some vino from their extensive collection and a corkscrew and some glasses and poured for the folks assembled to listen to the band.

Ryan Wilson was fantastic, despite my son being very grumpy & upset due to an almost double ear infection. He was patient & thorough. We would definitely recommend his care, and if we need urgent care in the future, we would most definitely request him. Thank you, Ryan!

The only thing going for this place is the technicians are friendly.  The rest is awful.  Chairs are worn and broken, and the technicians do a horrible job.  Very little "pedicure" and mostly just a half assed attempt with bad nail polish skills.   Stay home and do it yourself and you will get a better job done.

Went here to grab some dog food after an appointment in Meridian (even though I live in Eagle) and I received such friendly service with smiling faces. It was truly a breath of fresh air and I will continue to patronize this business. Thank you!

So happy with the fairness, professionalism, patience and quality of the work this business consistently demonstrated as they updated our roof, cedar siding, door and outside painting. 

Would recommend treasure valley exteriors for any of your exterior home needs.

The best facial in Sonoma! I love that she is local and caters to the natives, not just tourists. Amber is so detailed and helps customize the best facial and products. I love her botanical approach and the Rhonda Allison line is everything and more. In 6 months my skin has dramatically changed.
Hubble Homes Rocks.... we cannot wait to move into our new home. The sales people are awesome to work with.
Great service. The service was on point! Arielle was very quick and kind. Sushi and calamari was very good! Thank you for the great experience.

First time I had Mongolian food. You can choose from a variety of protein vegetables and your choice of noodles with an added variety of sauces and finally the food would get cooked in front of you. I loved the experience!

Well let's start off by saying this business is well equipped very professional an great with my cat. I couldn't ask for anyone more convenient , an skilled to handle my cat. $ was right on for the services rendered

I've always had a good experience at this location However after my last instance there I would NEVER place an order over the phone. Their customer service when an issue happens is atrocious. 

I placed an order via phone and came twenty minutes later ( when it was told it would be ready). She reads off an order that is nothing like mine. I tell her I placed an order 20 mins earlier. I read back the phone number she says " I don't know our number". Really you don't know your number ? Grab a menu with it on it. Then she asks me to call it, I do and it rings. She doesn't know what to do, she talks w the other girl and they both don't recall anyone placing an order 20 minutes earlier. The other girl says " well it could of only been us two we we're the only ones on shift". So I'm lying? Sounds like they can't remember an order being placed 20 mins earlier and forgot about it. They're trying to make it seem like I never placed it. I have it in my call log on my phone. She said she could place an order for us now,  I asked how long it would be and she said 15 minutes. I left. Really mistakes happen, I get that but how the situation was handled by the girls running the front makes me not want to do business with them. They weren't apologetic and seemed to act like I messed up. That is not how you treat patrons.

Understanding they are newly opened, so didn't expect perfection. Pretzel bites.. 6 little bites for $6 and a tiny thing of cheese sauce... in my opinion not worth it and won't waste my money in that again. Shepard's pie wasn't bad.. wasn't really all that hot and needed more seasoning. The owner noticed us putting salt and pepper on and was genuinely interested in our input on how it could be better. Will give them another shot when they've had some time to settle in.
Great, friendly place and great tasting boba. Order came out quick and they had some outdoor seating for us to wait
Great place to eat fast food. I was really hungry and this was close to the hotel I am staying at. I am here at Meridian to visit my fam. Surprised there are places here to get great food.

Food is delicious. I ordered beef teriyaki and chicken katsu, and 2 drinks; mango with rainbow jelly and taro with rainbow jelly. The owners or people who work there are friendly. Now we don't have to drive to Boise for Boba anymore.

Ok, so I wrote a very nice review a month ago, WAS very pleased with my nails. BUT after my last visit, the man who does the nails did what he wanted to.  He suggested that I needed a NEW full set that the set I had needed alot of work.  I asked if we could do it the next time that I was limited on funds.  He said don't worry about it, it needs to be done.  Then he asked if I wanted to just do white tips (french manicure) and I said no, that I prefer colored nails.  He did the full set with white tips, which I thought were just stronger tips and that he was going to put color on them.  He decided to do the french tips without my knowledge than charged me for everything.. an $18.50 appointment turned into $31.00!  The conversations we have are about how he has no clients and rarely ever busy.. now I see why!  He is MONEY HUNGRY!   Does good work, but watch out what they want to do and charge you!  I found a much better place that actually has clients! :)

I don't give a lot of low reviews but I'm sorry this visit merits a bad one.  I begged my husband to go here for dinner because I went in the past when my work had a dinner there and I also enjoyed it when they had a downtown location.  I only had good memories about Louie's and how the food tasted.  I reeeeallly wanted this to be great to prove him wrong about not wanting to eat here.  Well unfortunately this visit was far from good. 

I think this place must be going downhill.  We started with an appetizer of Calamari, which I try at many restaurants, and it was terrible.  It was fried in so much batter it felt like we were just eating greasy, fried batter.  No lemon.  Not good.  My husband also got a beer which was poured incorrectly but he drank it anyway.  

Next, the salads.  I got Caesar-it was so soggy and soaked in dressing I couldn't even have more than 2 bites; it tasted awful.  My husband got the garden salad with ranch and he wasn't impressed...just some iceberg lettuce that looked like from a bag with little shreds of carrot and ranch dressing.  

Lastly, the dinner.  Of all I had this part was so-so for me..I got the Chicken Marsala.  I could stomach it.  But for this being a local restaurant I would expect things to be homemade and not commercialized like say, Olive Garden.  Everything tasted like it was pre-made and heated in a microwave.  The Chicken Marsala was maybe a 2/5.  My husband's steak and gnocchi on the other hand, it was awful.  The gnocchi especially, it was gummy and not good...obviously not homemade.  Overall, not impressed and disappointed that this place isn't doing so well.  The one positive note I will add is our server was a sweet girl who gave great service and the iced tea is brewed in-house which is always a plus for me.

Fantastic! The crust was so good I ate the whole thing! Toppings very fresh and abundant. The kids were helping out and they were more professional than most of the adult waitstaff in most restaurants. I'm hoping covid doesn't destroy this family business like it's done to so many nationwide. Please support this restaurant. The food is excellent, prices in line with other similar places, and the staff was wonderful
We have been taking our Lucky boy to Jay and Alison at GroominTails for over 15 years. They do a wonderful job and helped us socialize Lucky with other dogs! Text Jay at 714-726-5933.

My daughter and I walked in for pedicures at 3:30 and they were closing at 4. It's as if they were instantly annoyed to have us there. The girl who did mine did a very nice job but the girl who did my daughters proceeded to pick off the gel on her toes with her own finger nails and then cut every toe to a different length and did two coats of paint without painting the full nail on some toes. Wouldn't recommend going here.

I am the Director of a Birth Center, with the Covid-19 we needed a safe place to take care of our clients.  We called Dick's to get a professional grade outdoor tent with privacy sides, they not only found all the items we needed to make our outdoor Maternity Clinic, they DONATED it!  We drove up and they put it in our vehicle.  As a small business struggling to gather supplies to make sure our birth center is a safe place for our families and Midwives this heartfelt donation was not only a financial relief, but a warm "air" Hug in a time of crisis.  
THANKS DICKS!

Phoenix Fire is an amazing gaming company. The staff is always super friendly and will spend as much time as it takes to help you find what your looking for. They have a great selection of yugioh, Vangaurd, board games, and war hammer.
Great atmosphere!  Service was wonderful, waitress was very prompt and sweet.  Food was good and came in large serving portions.  Chocolate malt was amazing.  Would visit again hands down!

I was not going to write a review but every day I find more things that the cleaners did not catch. I signed up for a deep clean on 5/24 for $250 and I have to say I did not get my money's worth.  Just this morning I looked at my pictures on the wall and they were not dusted. They left cat hair on the tile floors plus they spilled cat litter and did not vacuum it up. I noticed in the two bathrooms that the floors did not look so clean so I took a piece of toilet paper and wiped the floor and it came up very dirty. Also, they took the brass off my sink drain. Brent promised that they would not use any pumice. I looked at the tub last night and there is still some residue from cleaner in the drain. I found broken glass on the kitchen floor. I have a rug under my dining room table and there is still cat litter all around the rug. Okay, there is a lot more but I will not recommend them or use them again. Some pluses. They did vacuum the carpet very well. The stove came out spotless. The toilet paper was folded really pretty. The cleaners just do not have an eye for detail. So many things were missed.*** I take back the vacuum part. I took my vacuum and did my own sweep thru my living room, TV room and my bedroom. I had to empty the vac three times. Now if they did a good job why did my vac pick up so much stuff. They did want to come back but why let poor cleaners come back. I am tired of people wanting to come back for a 2nd or 3rd time. Do it right the 1st time!

Best boba in town. And so many fun , delicious and unique drinks. Adorable fox theme but very tasteful and cute and simple on the decor. Very clean! Great staff, always so friendly! THAI TEA ROCKS HERE! But everything else is amazing here too. Our fave drink stop now.

Omg!  I travel all the time for work and I have a budget so I am always looking for a good deal! All I really need is a bed WiFi free parking and coffee!  This place is amazing!  The most comfortable bed and bedding I have ever slept on!  As it is a extended stay it has a kitchen so having that is nice too so I am eat in.  If u are ever in the Boise area do yourself a favor and book this hotel as the bed is the best! 5 stars !

Love the drive thru! Thank you so much for offering this to your customers when most gas stations do not. It makes my life so easy since I would never leave my kids in the car. The staff is courteous, and they're very helpful in offering options as well. Thank you again for repeatedly being awesome every visit!!!

Fun place to eat - we had the biscuits and gravy, spinach scramble and the bayou burger.  The portions are huge and the waitstaff and bartenders are friendly and helpful when you can't decide what to order.

It's been a LONG 9+ months since I've been to a gym. When I was pregnant, I had the worst all day sickness that even the thought of going to the gym was physically impossible. 6 weeks postpartum and I am back to rebuild what has been unfortunately lost. 

I decided to give orange theory a try because I've heard so many wonderful things about their workouts. Although I've only completed 2 classes so far, I have been blown away with how much I enjoy going to their classes. 

Whether you are just starting out at the gym or you're in great shape already, the classes at orange theory will work for you. You work at your own pace and all classes work for everyone. I've never felt out of sorts or judged at all. 

If you are in the market for a new gym to get back into or maintain a healthy lifestyle, check out orange theory. There are multiple locations... however, the meridian studio in particular is pretty rad

We had a build your own combo and did 2 of them.  You can choose from fried rice or chow mein and we got 1 of each.  Then you get to choose 2 entrees to go with it.  We got kungpow beef, egg roll, mandarin chicken, and another spicy beef dish but I don't remember the name.  It was all good nothing too impressive.   It is close to my house and we were hungry and I'm sure we will visit again. I do know that they do a lot of carry out and delivery orders here as well.

Great salon! I have had my hair cut and styled here twice and will definitely be going back and making this my permanent hair salon. 

They're also very friendly, professional, and will make you tea or coffee.

Fantastic, great food, great atmosphere...
Everything with bacon! The scrambles are huge, as are the burgers. Great happy hour specials, including drinks served in flamingos, what's not to love?
Food was kinda gross. Took a very long time to get my order. The place looked a bit dirty. Don't think I will be going back there.
Love this place! Really good drink and really good food. Staff are amazing as well. Being from the UK I know what a pub is supposed to be and this is 100% as close as it gets

When we initially moved to Boise, we interviewed several doctors before settling on Dr. Loveland (who, at the time, was at a different office).

He's hands down the best, most knowledgeable, kindest doctor I've ever had the pleasure of working with. In addition to my husband and my medical care, we have trusted him with the medical care of our children (our youngest has been seeing him since infancy), which any parent knows is a significant amount of trust to place in someone. Through fevers, a tonsillectomy, a sprained ankle, a torn ACL, an eye injury, stitches (my oldest is an athlete, we're not just terribly accident prone!), and the aftermath of a car accident--Dr. Loveland has seen our family through with patient, kind, professionalism. 

I recently had an appointment with him for my youngest son. We arrived at 10am to find we were actually scheduled for 2pm, not 10am. Not sure whose mistake it was (it very easily could have been mine), I asked if there was any way they could work us in, which they did. I found out later that when the front office staff had inquired if he was willing to try to squeeze us in (making I'm sure a hectic morning leading up to a noon surgery, all the more hectic), he had replied, "I've been seeing their family for years and trust them implicitly, if they say they were scheduled for 10, then I guess we made a mistake." This was excessively generous given it's just as likely that it was my error as I've never known his office to make mistakes either.

And, even with working us into his busy morning, he never rushed. He came in, sat down, and spoke to my son and I with his usual level of calm patience. 

Truly an exceptional doctor and beyond that, one heck of a nice human being.

I'd recommend him to anyone without reservation.

One of my favorite places to eat in the Boise area. Great appetizers and local beer selection. I always go with the sushi options; really surprised the quality of fish so far from the ocean. I recommend the inferno roll.

Waited Looong time, was up next in their line and then they let one person in ahead of me. 20 min later they let another guy ahead because they said it Was a glitch in the system they also lied to me and said they don't do appointments only walk in's over the phone currently walking out with no haircut after waiting couple hours

Avoid these guys!! 
They put in a vinyl fence in my backyard and screwed up almost everything. They made the fence too short, they put it in the wrong place, and put the gate in a place where it could not open all the way. And the quality was poor. The fence posts are not straight and lean in different directions, making the gate bind when you try to close it. On top of that, the "customer service" person who answered the phone when I called to complain about this disaster was incredulous and didn't seem to know anything about fences or what could be wrong with them. 

The worst experience I've ever had with a company. EVER.
Rock music noise was too loud!! Had a difficult time hearing one another during conversation. Never noticed the music being loud and obnoxious before. We love the food, graciousness of servers, etc.

Getting this company to make changes to your account is nearly impossible. Customer service is abhorrent. How can you trust them to manage a property or subdivision if they cannot take care of routine simple customer maintenance. 
I own and maintain several properties with other management companies and have never had problems. 
Every time I have an issue the owner blames it on me.

I was shocked to not see fish-n-chips on the menu...I was sad. When my hubs and I went we waited for service. Two guys behind bar saw us but never came over. We waited 20 minutes for service...no one. It wasn't busy or anything. We ended up leaving. The staff just wasn't up to par that day. Maybe next time.

If you're a beer drinker this is the place to go. There is always something new to try. The staff are friendly and provide great service.  The atmosphere is very casual and relaxing. We love hanging out at Prefunk!
Clean, nice staff, $5 Tuesdays. ..hard to go wrong. .especially if not sure really want to spend tons on a movie.   Staff is typically very friendly & helpful!

We came here with a recommendation from a friend who heard great things. We were not disappointed.  Saying their servings are huge are an understatement.  I got tri tip and eggs. The try tip was amazing. The potatoes were the bomb. It came with this giant pancake. Bf got the chicken fried steak and it was excellent.  Bloody marry could have used a little more flavor but wasn't horrible.  Overall I would come back and try their lunch menu because their BBQ was delicious.

I wish stores went back to offering customers assistance. I was at the store, in different departments, for well over an hour, saw a handful of employees, but was not asked once if I needed assistance.

The store was stocked but not fully. I was able to get by with what I did find. 

The cashier was pleasant and made small talk as I checked out. I always have to laugh when they ask, "Did you find everything you were looking for?" Then when you respond, "No, I actually did not." They just ignore that as if it's just part of the small talk. I look forward to one day finding a cashier who actually offers to ask what the item was and then gets it for me or offers suggestions. Not this time.


.......
.. ...
.. .
Fresh, new, different menu. You have got to order the biscuits and jam! It is fantastic and the money goes directly to support their staff.
My dogs love going to get pampered.   The service is wonderful.  I really feel comfortable taking my dogs to get a grooming here.

We Love Ling and Louie's.  Whenever we have the chance we go.  The Mongolian Beef is my Favorite and hubby and I both love the Jasmine Chicken Fried Rice, other than that, hubby likes most everything.  The service is always great, we've had the best servers and I really enjoy sitting by the water wall. So relaxing.

Okay so I'm kinda Western Family and proud of that. So to know I shop at Wal-mart, would probably not surprise anyone who truly knows me. I'm just simple and no frills. Yet I'm giddy about this newer service. 

My wife loves to send me to the store to pick up the shopping list items. We have been using the Grocery app from Wal-mart to keep a list, but I seem to always bring home the manly smelling laundry detergent instead of the one my dear wife requests. So she found a way to make sure she gets the sliced turkey instead of the corned beef I somehow mix up. She orders for customer pick up!  

I pull into a designated parking area, check in on the app, tell my spot, 1-9. And color of the car. Moments later my wife's order shows up in my trunk. It's magic! Best part is it goes on her Credit card and not mine!  Winner winner Wal-mart even has Chicken Dinners!  Give it a try!

Coming from NYC, i was a bit skeptical about eating asian food in Meridian, ID. But I am so glad i walked into this gem! The waitress was so nice! Maybe it is my callous east coast heart, but her cheerful demeanor really changed the trajectory of my questionable day.

The food was amazing. I had the chicken teriyaki w/ katsu. The mountain of delicious food came out fast and hot! Fresh is definitely happy teriyaki's strong suit, even if i was eating fried pork. ;) 

The restaurant is clean and has a pleasant ambiance. If i am ever back in Idaho, i will be returning with an empty stomach and with friends!

just now
I came into The Eye Associates because of the good reviews that were listed on Google. This appeared not to be the case after having to go back and forth to the building within a 3 month timeframe.

I came in simply for an eye exam, and wanted to replace my contacts that I had recently finsihed using. They told me I needed to go through a trial pair fitting, which I agreed to, and received a pair of contacts. Since I was going out of town, I brought the pair with me. While I was away the pair broke, and I continued to use my glasses.

When I came back into town I called in and asked when I could come in to replace the trial pair that broke. They gave me an appointment, and I sat with the doctor again to review other brands that might fit my eyes more comfortably. After meeting with me, he told me that the pair he wanted me to try needed to be refilled and that they would call me within a week to try the new brand of contacts.

After a week of waiting I received no phone calls, after a month still no phone call. I called them over the phone asking them if I could get my prescription over the phone, the lady I spoke with told me that she would review my file, and call me back that afternoon. Again, I got no phone call until a week later, the lady said that she needed to be reminded why I called, and I told her for my prescription. She shortly told me that she could not give me this information over the phone, and instead to come into the office.

When I went back into the store to get both my prescription, and also the trial pair, I talked to a lady in the office. She told me that they never refilled the trial pair contacts that I was promised to receive because the optometrist forgot to inform them that I needed a new pair.

This led me waiting another week, with another promised phone call for the new pair, in which I received no phone call. I called in a week later to double check that they would have the pair, turns out the pair was ready, and I did not receive a phone call for it.

When I arrived at the office, I was asked several questions, including whether or not I had an appointment. However, I called in about an hour before I arrived and was told I did not need an appointment to pick up the contact lens. After explaining to the lady that I called in, she hesitantly grabbed a pair from the back and gave it me, without telling me when they expire, or when I should come back for another contact fitting. So after 3 months of trying to simply get my yearly supply of contacts, it has come back only with a trial pair, when I have tried to get a year supply, but was told I need to complete my contact fitting.

I have visited several times but today ends my relationship with this shop. Opens at 10:00 AM if you are lucky that they are they on time! I was there for two hours for a pedicure....staff was unfriendly and acted like I was wasting their time. There were five of us customers all with 10:00 appointments....the door was locked while we waited in the rain! They only had four manicurists so they took the four first while I waited for another 30 minutes. Go some where else!

Heard about this restaurant and excited to try it. My husband and I waited an hour for our meal. When we received our meal it was cold and tater tots were hardly cooked. Received a refill for a soda with dried debris on the outside of the glass. $43.00 later it was a very disappointing experience. Will not be going back.
Excellent job cleaning my windows!  He was hear ON TIME, he was professional and did a amazing job cleaning my windows.  His prices were also very good.  I will definitely have him back
Don't waste your money or time  Biscuits fell apart,  waffle not done, needs improvement.

I really enjoyed my first experience at Boba Tea. The enviroment made me so happy because the barristas were so friendly. When you walk in they welcome you and the place is super clean. The decor is inviting, relaxing and very chic. I loved it!

I've only had Boba one time prior to this so I'm not an expert. I asked the barrista a few questions and she happily answered while giving me great advice on personal favorites. I appreciate her not rushing me or making me feel dumb. I settled on the Taro Milk Tea and I was so happy with it. It was very flavorful and I regretted not getting a larger size. I don't remember the first boba I tried at an asian resturant being as flavorful or even have this fresh of a taste.

The best part of this was I took my 6 month old in with me and he had the best time. It appears to be family ran which is important to me. It gives a business flair and encourages families to come in. They brought us complimentry animal crackers and one of the ladies talked and held my son as if he was long lost family. One reason I love small family businesses is because they make time to get to know you on a personal level. We are excited to frequent this place!

My dad is a huge fan of Louie's and we seem to go there as a place to celebrate good occasions.  Today, we took him to Louie's for Father's Day.  When we arrived, the parking lot looked fairly empty so I took it that it was a good sign that we would't be waiting long and have an enjoyable evening.  Inside, we were told that there was a 10 minute wait, which isn't too bad and went by very quickly.  As we were seated, I looked around and noticed that 1/3 of the tables seemed to be empty.
  Our server took our drink order pretty quickly but and brought us water, but then it seemed to take a little while to order our food.  We ordered a large Family Style pizza, a bowl of soup, and 2 side salads.  My glass of water was finished before the salads and soup arrived and I had to ask for a re-fill of water, I seem to recall always having to refuse water, not ask for it (just a personal observation).  The lettuce seemed to be warm, which was odd.
  The pizza again was the star of the evening and lived up to the standard we are used to.  They have the Family Style pizza down to a science and it is sooo good.  The sausage and pepperoni are always plentiful and never lack for toppings.  We never did see the garlic bread which usually comes out with every meal, even though we didn't need it with the meal.  We left with a lack-luster impression this evening and it may be a while before we return to what has always been one of Boise's best.  Maybe with the next reason to celebrate we can see if tonight was just an off night, which I hope it was.

4 lane car wash
Drive through option 
Big clean lit and TVs facing the line for your entertainment.

Safer Chimney
All our crew members live this place!!!! The owners are super cool and friendly!!! Try the Margherita pizza and cheese bread

This place is never open. I came here on Saturday at 5pm and they were closed. When I called they stated we have no staff to stay open. This is now the 4th time I have showed up during open hours and they closed early. Won't be back. Lesson learned.
You can't choose sweetness and flavors were limited. I am used to places like Gong Cha and Teaspoons that had a real focus on the ingredients. Super disappointing.
Great service great food, I highly recommend the luckys lo mein and the lochness sushi roll! We will definitely be stopping by on our next visit to Idaho!

Just an average place to stay off the freeway.  We were visiting the Boise area and was meeting a friend in Kuna, ID one evening during our travels.  No hotels in Kuna.  Our last stay with a Holiday Inn was in a Hood a river a few days prior and was thoroughly satisfied so we decided to give Holiday inn another shot.  This particular hotel is right off the highway, which was perfect for situation.  Was it as nice and cool as Hood River, OR -- no! This location wasn't horrible by any means, just mediocre.  The bed and pillows were good.  The tub was really narrow and didn't have a mat, so it was slippery so we  had to be extra careful.  Due to Covid, breakfast was provided in a bag.  You had to go to the front desk and grab them.  It came with a bacon, egg and cheese biscuit, heat in room microwave, yogurt, banana and a granola bar.  I liked the breakfast bag.  All was good. Our room was on the freeway side, at night you could hear it, but it wasn't so loud that it was disruptive, but if that kind of noise bothers you, you might want to check on that before making your reservation.
Like everyone else, why can't this place get my orders right!?!?!?! How hard is it to read a receipt? Come on Sonic! Get it together!
This place is fabulous. Everything is great, tons of flavor, ingredients taste fresh. Haven't had one bad item from here.

My wife and I were searching yelp for a new pizza place to try and we came across this place which seemed to have great reviews. We ordered online, and figured one pizza was enough, even though the website didn't mention what size pie it was. The pie was smaller than expected. The pizza had thin crust, I would even consider it very thin, but even as such it lacked the crispness or crunch that I would expect from such a pizza. Flavor otherwise was okay, but nothing above just average. The pie left us disappointed and still hungry. We probably won't be coming back.
Good food but dont change up your order or they could mess it up! Dont order gluten free or shell fish free.

If I could give less than one star, I would. This place has got to be a joke. Went to drive thru to order some breakfast. The place was dead with maybe one car in the drive up. We ordered a Breakfast Toasted (bread was cold and burnt) and a Breakfast Burrito. Well... I'll let the picture do the talking for the "quality" (or lack of) of the Burrito. Keep in mind, this burrito was ordered with everything on it...

Food was good but the service was awful. Our waitress displayed no sense of urgency about anything. She avoided eye contact and we sat for 10 minutes at the bar before she took our order. Don't sit at the bar if Jenny isn't there. It is a complete waste of time.

We were not expecting a lot when we booked this very affordable hotel. To our delight it over exceeded our expectations. They have a wonderful complimentary hot breakfast buffet every morning and Beverly ( the gal tending to the whole breakfast area) was beyond accommodating! She quickly refilled and replenished all of the food and we never felt like we were getting " leftovers" even when it was nearing closing. Thank you Beverly for your hospitality! 
My only criticism would be that our room had an odor that never went away. We bought a plug in air freshener which helped a little. It's clean and nice but not a five star hotel.

I took my niece and sister here this past Friday. The cost when we went was $38 for a mani and pedi. I am from San Diego so I think that is really expensive. It's way cheaper down here. We were the only people in the salon. They rushed the spa pedicures. It wasn't much of a spa pedicure at all. But the polish is still on, so I guess that is good. 

As for the manicure...I had the longest natural finger nails I had ever grown and they clipped them off without asking! I thought she was going to shape them and when I looked at my nails, I just about died. I was sooo surprised they assumed I wanted short nails. Who does that?! She didn't do a good job at painting the nails. It looked like they had been polished a week ago cuz she didn't get to any edge of the cuticle. There was nail showing on every edge of the cuticle..and not just a small amount. If I wanted my nails painted half azz, I'd do it myself! I asked her to paint to the cuticle and she did on a couple fingers...but she used a different color! I mean, obviously different on one hand to the other one. I didn't notice til we walked outside and by that point, I had given up on this place. 

I won't be back to this place ever again when I'm in Boise. And I don't recommend the place to anyone. :/

Dr. Bennion was so great! He is conservative and honest, which are things I really look for. I needed a few fillings from having a hyperemesis pregnancy, and it was painless and he spent extra time making sure I was happy with my bite. And TVs on the ceiling helped me pass the time not being anxious. Thank you!!
The perfect pint! Sampled the Guinness here this weekend and I am so very pleased to report that we finally live in a town with a Pub close to us that respects their craft! Well done Lads!

Ling & Louies is in my family's rotation of fave dining spots. Drunken chicken and drunken shrimp are two dishes that I'd recommend. 

On this visit, we tried four different dishes and I opted for wok seared ahi tuna tacos instead of my usual drunken shrimp. The ahi was fresh and the tacos were good, but sadly they didn't match up to other ahi tacos that I've had. Unfortunately they're served with a sauce reminiscent of chipotle mayo and generally lacking in much depth. A wasabi-based sauce, more slaw/lettuce, and some ginger would take these tacos to another level. Also, the side of "fried" rice was definitly white rice. I'll stick with the drunken shrimp next time.

Not pictured bc it was devoured immediately: Warm brownie with ice cream. This dessert really surprised the whole dining party. It was AMAZING and gone in a flash after being devoured by several folks at the table who claimed they didn't want dessert at all. We're a family of sweet lovers that never orders dessert at Ling & Louies mistakenly thinking it wouldn't be all that great...well, we learned that day. Try it!

This was my second visit. The first time I was a walk in and waited for about 50 minutes. Completely expected on a walk in. Today I went in, but this time i scheduled an appointment for 4pm. I arrived at 3:45 and checked in. I watched 2 walk-in people get taken back. I had no problem as they were there before I arrived. The first was taken back before 4 and the second 10 minutes after 4. When two of the girls finished their customers at the same time (4:20) I was sure I would be next. One young lady walked out and greeted a Male friend. I heard her ask if he had checked in and saw him physically shake his head no. She immediately grabbed him and brought him back. She hadn't even cleaned up from her last client. She swept and reset while he sat in her chair. No, problem there's another person free. So she went and cleaned up and then walked back out and took another walk in back. It is now 4:31. I walked out and told them to cancel my 4pm appointment.

This is our first brunch spot to try since moving to Meridian.  And while it had quite the wait- totally worth it.  It's in a strip mall full of some creative eatery concepts- but you can tell this is the standout.  

I got the ginormous chicken on a biscuit with Hog style fries, husband got "The Hog".  I am now sufficiently stuffed like a hog and barely got through 1/3 of my plate.  Husband did slightly more damage, but he has plenty of hog potatoes to take for lunch tomorrow.  It's worth waiting in line for. 

We'd come back- they have plenty more to try. 

And who doesn't love a place with signs saying "Don't go Bacon My heart"...

I needed to get one of my tires repaired at Discount Tires so i figured I'd walk over here and get a mani pedi while I wait. When I walked in I was greeted warmly and offered a bottle of water. There was a steady stream of customers but not crazy busy since it's Tuesday evening. Tina was so kind and did a wonderful job on my pedicure. She is very friendly and was gentle after I mentioned I had a few sensitive spots. I did not get the name of the girl who did my nails but she also did a great job. As far as I can tell, everything looks very clean and up to date. The massage chairs have a ton of different functions. The prices aren't bad overall. I got the mid-range pedicure which includes a massage and a gel manicure. My total came to $53 before tip. If you get a standard mani pedi it only costs $33 which is a fantastic deal! I'll definitely be back here the next time I need a little pampering!

At first I thought this was just another sub place, didn't see anything that would make them unique. I was missing their excellent pepper relish and wonderful bread.  I am obsessed with this place. So good!

He's the best.  There's no two ways about it.  Straight to the point and honest, he'll get your taxes done and go over all the line items with you so you can understand your return.  Worth every penny!

The first visit was outstanding, the drinks were good, the service was on point & the food was even better. The manager, on duty, I believe his name was Ryan, came by our table & I let him know that I had just eaten the best burger I had ever had. The second trip, was a disaster. I ordered the Guac burger with bacon, same as the first visit, husband ordered the steak sandwich, both ordered a salad as a side  & we ordered a side of french fries to share. Within a couple minutes the server delivered an order of home fries to our table. I told the server we had not ordered those, but we had ordered french fries to share, she apologized & within about two minutes arrived back at our table with our "cold" french fries (which we wanted with our meal, not as an appetizer). We thought, oh well, at least the good stuff was on the way. When my burger arrived, I immediatly saw the fatty, undercooked bacon hanging out of the burger. I asked the server to just remove the charge for the bacon & returned the blubbery bacon to her. When I cut my burger in half, it was red...I had ordered a well done burger...at this point, I was just done. I told our server to take it back & just take it off our bill. She said she would advise the manager, which I expected to show up tableside, which never happened. My husband & son ate their meals & my son drank his apple juice, which was supposed to be ice tea. At the end of the meal, my husband asked to speak to the manager. The manager ( not Ryan) said he would speak to the server & cooks, but never offered a discount, never apologized for the huge mess & just said I hope you come back again. Thought we had found a new spot, but we are so disappointed in the food, service & management. We will not be back.

Roto-Rooter is Top Notch!  I tried to get my Main Drain Line unplugged with a liquid cleaner that was guaranteed to work or my money back... well I hope they do indeed refund my money, as their product did not work, and left me without indoor plumbing for two days. I called Roto-Rooter and Christopher Martin was at my house in 30 minutes and had my clog cleared in no time at all! Christopher was very friendly, respectful, professional and an expert in his field! I will not hesitate to call Roto-Rooter in the future! They are the BEST!
I bought a used car on Facebook and took it to Gieslers for an inspection, they were very thorough and professional with their work. The customer service is top notch.

I enjoyed my pho tonight. It was quite flavorful. I added some chili paste which really brightened up the flavors. The tempura shrimp were very light and crispy. I will come back again. The staff was fun and knowledgeable of the different menu items.

I have a 13 year old terrier mix. He has always gotten very anxious about the groomers. It would break my heart to leave him there each time to the point that I would try to put off his next trip or diy so of the basics. I won't have to do that anymore. Awesome experience with groomingtails! Parked right in front of my apartment and greeted my dog with a super calm and warm demeanor. Only took about an hour and he came out looking exactly as I had requested. Such a happy dog! Only slightly more in cost than his other groomer but worth it for the convenience and ease. One thing to note is they do book out pretty far in advance (can't blame them, they're just that good!) so book when you can!
The pizza was really delicious! Slow little place, definitely deserves more recognition.
