Great place to chill and have a brew after work. My buddy's is right across from here so we go often. He told me it use to be an indoor shooting range in the day. Great selection here too. It changes from time to time.

After talking to the ceo and their policy on being in the room when waking up from anesthesia we will never go back. For years we have decisions on that and have decided we want to come to with spouses around. Not some strange face only. He has been there for all my sedition and wake ups. It also felt like a super rush job. If you dont mind being told no you cant be there you will do fine. But for those who know how they want treated and family included this is not your place. We either have a facility that respects our wishes or no procedures will be done at any facility or by any company period . Not being in the room is not a hipaa policy. We know our rights and you make it so i cant do my job and adviocate for said person.

What a fun restaurant! We loved the atmosphere of the place, and the food was yummy! We got the Kung Pao Roll, the Lochness Roll and the Drunken shrimp main between me and my husband. Ha- we aren't alcohol drinkers so we were surprised by the Drunken Shrimp sauce! Didn't taste good.... haha! Pretty sure there was alcohol in it   the rolls were good- nothing over the moon, but they were yummy nonetheless! I would come back for sure to try something new.
Go to movie afternoon is best here, good hot dogs, popcorn and very clean. Not crowded ever.

I stopped and notice the employee had just got through cleaning the toilets and did not wash his hands and when directly to get a customer order and delivered another's customers drink.  It was so disgusting to witness, I just had to leave.

In on a Monday night around 6 and no one else is there.  Friendly enough, but the food was just ok.  Pizza could have used a few more minutee in the oven to ensure the bottom crust was crisp and not soggy.  Had a glass of red wine which was not good and tasted bitter.  Disappointed that this did not live up to the other reviews.  Hope just an off night although I won't be back in town to give them a second chance.  

Piece of advice for the staff  - please remember to thank your customers.  They chose your establishment over many others in the area.  That should and will be appreciated!

Ciao!

I have never had a better customer service experience then I had at Dick's in Meridian! We purchased a Basketball Hoop there a few weeks ago and both Managers on Duty made sure that all the pieces were there, they went above and beyond and were so patient with us. I will be back for any and all of my sporting good needs because of our INCREDIBLE experience! Thank you

Louies is the full Italian experience done REALLY BAD avoid this place at all costs. This is by far the "Country Doughnuts" of Italian food when it comes to service. 

  It was beautiful Sunday evening and my lady was in the mood for alfredo and wanted something close by.  She got the horrible idea that we should go to Louies in which I fought against having had previous experiences.  Needless to say I lost and we end up in the parking lot at 5pm just joining what looks to be the dinner rush. 

 Here's what you can expect with your Louies experience. 

Service- 
If you've ever been to Country Doughnuts here in Boise you will know the signature service I am referring to.  The service you recieve here is that exact same feel just with a Italian feel. While C.D. delivers on quality that is not the case with Louies sadly.    Beginning our server was not very professional neither did she have a name tag. When we did make some comments about the food, they were brushed off and no resoloution was given. If you are here and God forbid have an issue be ready to just be ignored. It's all in other Yelpers reviews examples of how of their poor customer service so don't be surprised when it happens to guy you. 

Food- (DON'T MISS THIS PART) 
 After my meal I got a glimpse in the kitchen as it's easily accessible when you walk in, I noticed it was all teens/college age males.  This explained so much about the quality of my meal.

 Soup- As per the picture my meal was a minestrone soup which is a late Italian 80's classic.  As you can see they didn't care enough to wipe the rim, any restaurant that cares about quality wipes the rim so it's clean and not splashed all over the place.   This means the line cook, the expediter,  and the waitress all passed it along and it met standards.  What a shame.  The soup did not dissapoint it was as bad as it looked.  It was LUKEWARM, bland, and was watery, this was surely a soup you mix and then chop some veggies n let it stew. I informed the waitress and she took it asking if I'd like a salad, I don't eat salad so that was the end of that. 

Speghetti-
 I opted for the bolagnese (meat sauce)  This was pretty awful though they tried to present it pretty. It's easy to tell HOW your spaghetti is put together by looking at it. In the picture you will notice the pool of water, this is pasta water that collects sitting in the bowl. This means they have the meat sauce and throw it over the top, What happens is you get lukewarm pasta with lukewarm meat sauce.  Restaurants with quality food mix it in a skillet both sauce and pasta, this ensures everything is hot and evenly coated.  My pasta was LUKEWARM and dry, I had to ask for more sauce a few times and I bet you will TOO. 

Bread-
 this appetizer garlic bread is the worst.  I am sure it is pre frozen and then baked, it taste of nothing but a hint of garlic and butter. 

Alfredo- 
My date did not enjoy this at all, as soon as she tasted it she said she wished we went to Olive Garden. Once again it was LUKEWARM, bland, and tasted of mixed with water cheese.  I would bet anything this was not actual homemade alfraedo cheese sauce.  

All in all I can't say I'm surprised, the signs were all there that the food would be horrible. It's the same food that I recieved in my last review of Johnny Carinos before they went out of business.  

Price- 
The price at this place is a joke! Lucianno's delievers 100 times more for way less.  I spent $12 for my pasta, $14 for her alfraedo and had a free side of regret for desert.  Even Olive Garden offers food that has more flavor and is equally priced.  

 Final thought- THE PLACE WAS DEAD WHICH MEANS IT SHOULD NOT TAKE AS LONG AS IT DID FOR FOOD.  IT ALSO SHOULD HAVE BEEN HOT AND NOT LUKEWARM.  

My yelp fam you've been warned Lol!

I have to admit that I haven't been frequenting Louies since the downtown location closed. The Meridian location has mainly been a stop for their fantastic lunch Buffet. I don't know how they do it with their Italian sausage but it is super fine and bursting with flavor, perfect on the pizza or combined with the rich Tangy red sauce on their lasagna.

I was out in the neighborhood so I called in an order to go family style for three which included fettuccine Alfredo, lasagna, chicken Parm, and a pizza. (Crazy food value) I waited a couple minutes for it to come and was driving home when I got a call from Dean, who I assume is the manager. He told me that the hostess had given me someone else's order. I told him that I was more than Half way home and I wasn't going to turn back so he put it in the car and had someone drive it all the way to the north end. Well done Dean! Louies is always a class act!

I love Emily! She does such a great job of taking her time and goes above and beyond to make sure you're happy. She's very artistic and creative! Definitely my go-to person for my nails. Thank you Emily!
I'm so sad that this business has closed and moved to Idaho.I'm sure they will do very well wherever they go. Thank you for taking care of my Mochi.

All staff does not wear masks or follow covid procedures- not limiting people, protecting customers, and staff.

On top of it- I ordered "The Hog" and everything on my plate was burnt black.  And my waitress wondered why I didn't want to eat it or take any leftovers home.

I live in San Diego county and was meeting up with some friends from Washington State for a visit in Boise.  I had promised the girls (17, 21 and 7) that I would take them for manicures when we got there.   I searched for a nail salon with good ratings and am not sure how we ended up here.  The only good thing was that they were very near our hotel in Meridian.    The 21 year old got a standard manicure:  she works with horses in a barn so needed just a clean up and light polish.  She selected a light pink color.  Below her color you could still see where it looked "dirty" under some nail splits.  We took the polish off the next day, used a brush and polished them up natural.  (waste of $14).  The 17 year old plays basketball so got got a gel manicure that would last through practice.  The polish started peeling off the next day.  We went to have 3 nails redone. They wanted to do 2, we said "no, 3"  The 3 were redone and all peeled off  in less than a week.  (waste of $28)  And the tech that did the gel manicure had a sinus infection or cold or something.  She kept sniffing a very stuffy nose.  Disturbing.  The 7 year old got a hot pink manicure.   While they had her under the drying lights I noticed the polished was all clumpy and in spots you could see her nails through it.  I asked them to re do it with a newer bottle of polish. They didn't. They put another coat on top of the same polish which make it all thick and gooey.  And charged the full $14 for a manicure on a 7 year old instead of a "junior manicure" like most shops.   That's a total of  56 of my dollars wasted.  I was super frustrated!  I always leave a generous tip.   At least $5 each, this is the first time I have ever left nothing.  I have been taking the older girls for mani/pedis for 10 years, they commented on how pissed I must have been to do that.  What the heck?!?  Can it be that difficult to do standard manicures?

Worst nail salon experience I've ever had!  Check out past reviews on YB (Yellow Book).  These were consistent with my review.  My daughter and I (I was visiting from California), went for a girls day outing.  We were relaxed and happy and looked forward to manicures and pedicures.  This nail salon kept changing the price from what we were quoted when we first inquired upon arriving.  They asked both of us 8-9 times if we wanted gel nails.  I politely declined every time.  After being asked numerous times, my daughter relented.  My manicurist obviously was mad because I wasn't making her more money so my manicure went south really fast!  She barely touched my cuticles because she only spent a second on each and that's not an exaggeration!  The massage was minimal and no quick dry!  I left after the mani

My husband and I love this place when going for something semi quick. Definitely will recommend the Ninja Chicken, it can be spicy but it's a mild kind of spicy. Also the egg rolls are delicious! The food is very filling, so for me I always tend to have some leftovers. The staff is very friendly and quick to get your order out.
Nice little retro cafe, good standard breakfast with very knowledgeable friendly waitresses.  Not large but was seated very quickly.

We were excited to try this place out due to the unique menu and our love for both burgers and breakfast. My wife ordered a scramble and a pancake while I went with the burger. My burger was exceptional. Great bun, wonderful toppings and cooked to my liking. I would love to see a house cut fries option and wax a little disappointed that they said they couldn't do a mix of fries and tots when I asked. The sweet potato tots were okay but nothing exceptional. 

My wife enjoyed her pancake however, she didn't like the large amount of grease that the eggs and potatoes were soaked in. Eggs and potatoes tasted good but there was an unusual amount of grease on the plate with it. 

All in all, great burger place and would definitely consider visiting again.

My husband and I were long time loyal customers until a few weeks ago. We had breakfast there for 2. Our bill was approx. $26.00. When the bill settled through our bank it was for over $112.00. Someone added on a very large tip. I have tried to call the restaurant but they are not returning my calls. So far I have not been able to get a refund. Do not trust this place with your bank cards. This is theft and we will not return

Family in from Virginia...two adults and three children under 8.  Planned a 'special' evening out, but where to go?  Since they had frequented Texas de Brazil in the past, we decided it would be a good idea to celebrate our family get-together at this establishment.
First, the up-side.  We (Missus and I) enjoyed a wonderful evening pre-Covid at this establishment.  Fantastic 'salad-bar'...actually far more than a salad bar...so much so that we couldn't stop bragging it for the next year to anyone willing to listen to us!  Meat was fantastic and was served with prompt attention to the 'yea-nea' discs used to summon the servers.  Even the manager (same gentleman this same visit) stopped by to make sure we had a pleasant experience (didn't make his round this time).  Couldn't say more positive things about this place.  Couldn't wait until our next visit.
Family in from out of town...made reservations for 7...again, 4 adults, 3 children.  
Now the down side.  Took forever for anyone to come to the table after being seated.  When someone from the waitstaff finally arrived, he took a drink order and disappeared.  After an unreasonable wait, the drinks finally arrived.  No complaints.  At this time we ordered a bottle of wine for the 4 adults... Louis Jadot Beaujolais-Villages.  Now this particular wine (one of our favorites and one we drink at home with some sort of frequency) sells outside for approximately $12.99...actually, Fred Meyers has it on sale now for $10.99.  I more than understand that a restaurant has to have a profit margin on everything they offer or they would be out of business.  Texas de Brazil charged me $50.00!  Since my daughter-in-law had her heart set on this wine, I let it go.  As far as I'm concerned, it was a total rip-off and a slap in the patrons face, to boot.  The 4 wine glasses that were brought to the table were sent back by request.  Lip and finger marks on every one!  Moving on. 
The salad bar was half of what it was a year or so ago.  The charcuterie platter was lacking in choice and size.  A lobster bisque was tasteless as was the parmesan cheese which should have had a salty-nutty flavor.  Nothing was as we remembered.  
Despite the 'summon disc' showing 'green', the service was horrendously slow.  The dining room was about 1/3 of capacity and I couldn't see why the wait was so long.  There was no mention by our waiter, or by staff, as to what was available.  I would have thought this would have been discussed by our waiter upon arrival at the table.  Ultimately, there were chicken thighs, sausage, several beef offerings as well as a lamb steak.  The chicken was dry and over-cooked.  The sausage bland.  Beef was tough and the lamb was tasteless.  My daughter-in-law asked if any seafood was being served as this was her experience in other Texas de Brazil's.  No seafood.  Okay, I understand if there is no demand, it wouldn't pay for the restaurant to offer these items.
After all was said and done, the bill (with a 20% tip) came out to $404.00.  We all left somewhat hungry and greatly disappointed.  Not what I expected for this amount of money.  Three adults had one cocktail and we all shared the bottle of wine, so alcohol wasn't a big ticket item this particular evening.
Interestingly, we mentioned our reservations to a neighbor of ours who promptly tried to convince us to go to Tocano's instead.  After our first experience at Texas de Brazil, I dismissed her suggestion as foolhardy and looked forward to our visit.  Big mistake.
This will be our last get-together with Texas de Brazil.  Overpriced (currently for what you get), diminished salad-bar, a 'notch below' quality meats and delayed table service.
We'll try Tocano's which seems to be the place to go....

BTW...when you 'pre-calculate' a tip for a patron...DON'T add in the tax...You DON'T tip on taxes...got sucked into this one although totally my fault for rushing...possibly because the waiter was hovering over my shoulder....

The receptionists here are super helpful & kind. The assistant, Maihesa, was super great! She was friendly, informative, efficient & gentle. The doctor was just as great. The office is clean & homey, very easy to feel comfortable. Would definitely recommend :)

Amazing experience! We were new to the area and had a rather complicated return due to the move. Jeff was not only able to prepare our return correctly but did it in a timely fashion. His prices were more than fair and we will definitely continue using and recommending his services.

We were so excited to try this new place, sadly we were very disappointed.  Great concept, interior needs some cleaning ( dirty, very worn carpets).  Loved the masks optional :).  Everyone was very nice, but service was slow.  Servers should not wear shorts so short that their cheeks hang out...it's not Hooters.  Hubby ordered the chicken fried steak.  The steak and gravy were good.  The biscuits we're not fresh:(probably day old). The home fries were not cooked through, almost raw, and so greasy that we could not eat them.  My sausages were cold.  The coffee was good, just wished they would have refilled them.  Prices high for food, 35.00 for breakfast for two.  Seriously doubt we will go back.  Hope they up their game.
Our first time here and we had a great dinner.  Food was served hot and portions were above average. Good sized menu which means we're coming back!

Recently moved to Boise and read a lot of reviews on nail salons near my home. I'm picky about my nails as I don't want them damaged and I want an excellent service. 

After reading reviews, I made an appointment for a mani and pedi with LINDA. She was AMAZING! There is no language barrier you may experience at other nail salons. She was friendly, genuinely interested in me, and I felt comfortable building a relationship with her. I got a gel mani and pedi and I'm really pleased. My husband got a pedicure from a different tech and he was pleased as well. 

My only complaint, if you call it that, is that it is a bit pricey. $66 for a basic gel mani and pedi seems on the expensive side.....but I will continue to pay it for excellent service that won't damage my nails.

The Majestic Cinema in Meridian, Id. is one of three theaters, which form Hallett Cinemas, LLC ( http://www.hallettcinemas.com/ ) out of Sunnyside, Wa. 

The other two are the Yakima Valley Grand in Sunnyside, Wa. and the Walla Walla Grand out of, you guessed it, Walla Walla, Wa. Wow, that's a mouthful. I'd like to hear Baba Wawa say that. "This is Baba Wawa in Walla, Wa. We are at the Walla Walla Grand here in Walla Walla, Wa." but I digress.

I went there for the first time, yesterday. 

Okay, so, when compared to the huge, multi-screen cinemas and chains in the area, the Majestic "feels" less grandiose, less labyrinthine, more accessible, more "user-friendly". Judging from the activity I observed on an early Saturday show-time, the locals just love the place; it was well attended, busy, but not overcrowded; in short, comfortable, manageable. 

I just noticed that they have a "Bargain Tuesday," with $5.50 general, and $6.50 for 3D admission charges.

The chap taking the tickets was just having a ball for himself, greeting all the customers and chatting-it-up with them.

I did not patronize the concession stand, but I certainly saw a good number of people roaming around with buckets of popcorn. So, I am ASSUMING there is some deal on the bucket sized serving.

The theater we were in was fairly large or, better said, larger than I expected for a complex like this. The seating was comfortable and the sound system was not overwhelmingly loud, as is so often the case. There were almost no pre-movie glitzy commercials, but rather a nice assortment of movie trivia and "support-your-local-business" style advertising; after-all, Hallet Cinemas, LLC, is more-or-less "local".  

They showed a few, but not too many, previews prior to the feature film, ("Hostiles" in this case). 

So, bottom line --- with the exception of the three idiots seated near me, who just "had" to take a look at their cell phones during the screening --- it was a great experience. The friends with me, the first time at the Majestic for them too, certainly agreed.
Service was ok at best. Food was very sweet, everything from potatoes, bacon, bread And gravy. There were flies everywhere inside!  Definitely not our cup of tea.

I had a credit for items I sold about 9 months ago (before they moved locations.) It was about $40 or so that I planned to use for fall/winter shoes for my daughter. Went to the new location and they told me I didn't have any credit. Didn't give me any options, etc. Just shrugged it off. It's not a life altering bad experience but I was really disappointed that I chose to sell there for credit and it's not close to where I live and they were just like meh, sorry.

Unfortunately the majority of the low reviews for this place was further supported during my first visit. I almost gave 2 stars for the nice venue but decided not because this review is solely based on what is important, which is quality work and customer service. I was led to try this place because I received a gift card although I was already hesitant based on the other reviewer's comments. I was there prior to the shop opening so I was able to walk right in when doors opened, quickly grabbed a color and snagged one of the pedi chairs they had on. There were more people there than staff. Other ladies had an appointment at 12noon and they had to tell the staff. I'm not sure if appointments really make a difference if there are not enough staff to tend to them. 1 showed up to open the store on time and a few other staff arrived shortly. I wanted a mani-pedi. 

The lady I had a language barrier which made it difficult to communicate so I didn't even bother to tell her that she was pretty sloppy on providing detailed service. She barely scrubbed my feet with any effort, which I thought the scrubs they were using looked used to begin with so I guess I wouldn't have wanted it  anymore. (I also remembered one of the reviewers expressing the same experience in her review about tentative to no scrubbing effort so I didn't bother to voice anything if nothing were to be improved anyway).

Barely a foot massage if you can call slight patting a massage. She was trying to rush through it to get to other customers which I think ends up being bad for all customers when they get short changed on their pampering, and provided lack of detailed pedicures. She never even double checked her work and I had to point out certain areas for her to tidy up where nail polish was outside the lines.  

I was then asked to wait for my mani until she completed another customer's gel pedi first so she had my hand socking in a bowl on my lab. I eventually had to take my hands out since my fingers were getting prune like. When she came back over 30 minutes later she did the same fast rushing, sloppy mani with lack of attention to detail as she did my pedi. 

She had globs of top coat on my nails that when she had me drying my nails by the fan the wind was blowing them wrinkled. When she returned after she was tending to another customer I asked her to fix the nails where the top coat was becoming wrinkled and she asked me what I did to make that happen? I was like I didn't do it you put too much on there and it started bubbling and wrinkling up in front of the fan. Then she tells me, "uh that is why you should get gel" as if it's my fault she did a sloppy job. I already told her when she kept pushing me to get gel for my mani-pedi in the beginning I didn't want it because my nails needed a break from gel. 

Maybe there are other staff members there who are better at detailed quality customer service, but this lady didn't make me feel welcome or show any effort that she cared about her work she was doing for her customers. If I have to go home to clean up my own mani-pedi I might as well not waste my time and do it myself. At least I know it would be done well. Won't be back until the service and quality of work improves. Thank goodness I had a gift card for it because that is not an experience worth paying for.

Biscuits tasted like hockey pucks. Bacon greasy. Eggs blah. Hubby's chicken fried steak very mushy with bland gravy as was his gravy on his hockey like biscuit. The only good thing about this place is the bar. No patrons wearing masks during pandemic  or practicing social distancing so we ate in our Jeep. Food did come up hot and service was great. Won't be going back

I have NEVER had as good of food as I have ate here. I mean it is so dam good! Sierra my waitress was a super sweet young lady who provided me the best service I could ask for. 
Also the atmosphere here is very welcoming and they did a good job with the look. Kinda like a classy sports bar. 
This is by far my favorite place to go!!!!

Definitely one of the best local chains. Zamzows hits that sweet spot between high quality and low cost--every plant, animal, and other product I've ever gotten from here has been healthy, vibrant, and in pretty much perfect condition, without being extraordinarily expensive.

If you go here for fish or plants, you should talk to Cheyenne! She was amazing in helping my mother and I find sturdy, beautiful aquarium plants and is known around the store as the fish expert. I even had another employee suggest that I wait until Cheyenne is in to ask questions about a particular fish.

The store hours are also relatively long, so unlike some other local stores I regularly have time to actually get there. If you have a busier schedule, this store might just be your saving grace.

Amazing store, always my go-to.

I will never be going here again. I've worked in customer service for over 6 years and it takes A LOT for me to be angry about any customer service experience. This was my first time at Envy nails and it was going fine until she glued the acrylic tips on and cut them, then asked if the length was good, when I told her I wanted them longer (and I showed her a picture beforehand of the length I wanted, and she didn't just cut them a little short, they were SIGNIFICANTLY shorter than what I asked for,) she told me it was too late because she had already glued the tips on.. Okay then what was the point of asking me if I liked the length??!? I got a simple French fade and it was $50. WAY over priced, I don't pay that much unless I get rhinestones so getting charged that much and not doing what I asked for, and then proceeded to CLEARLY talk badly about me and my friend, is absolute bullshit. The lady who did my friends nails literally cracked her nail in half and caused her to bleed a lot, resulting in my friend not even being able to get her acrylic fill. She had to get a gel dip and was charged $45. Then gave us attitude for the $5 tip. Didn't deserve one at all in my opinion, I'm in the beauty industry myself and this is just not okay. Terrible service over all.
We love Kim! She is really great with our nervous dog, she's always on time and responds quickly to text messages. Highly recommend!

My wife and I have not been to Applebee's for a long long time. We quit going because of poor service and poor quality food. Well, the other day we decided to give them another try. Based on this visit, it will probably be a long long time before we go back. 

Our server was just plain bad. He was dressed poorly, had bad manors, and was not good it his job at all. Other wait staff had the personality of a Turnip. 

I had a burger. It was flat, and tasteless. The only thing on the burger that gave it any flavor at all were the pickles. And those were few and far in between. 

I would not recommend anyone waste their time at this place.

I began using Golds Gym because I was referred by a friend to invest in a personal trainer there. I was very reluctant at first because being a newbie I didn't know my way around and felt a bit self conscious. Jonathan Smith became my guide to my daily nutrition and workout routine. I've been going daily now for 4 1/2 months and have never felt or looked better! Thank you Jonathan Smith for helping me achieve great results and the staff at the gym have all been supportive and kind! Best part of my day is at Golds Gym In Meridian

Cool spot but man.. please for the love of god change the bubble gum music! It does not fir the atmosphere or the age group in there. But on the flip side bar tenders were gleefully singing along to the tunes that fit them.

How have lived here for a month and just now stopped into this place!? This is an awesome cafe and boba stop right off of Eagle Road. There's plenty of parking and service is super quick. The interior is nice and full of seating for a study session or hangout with a friend. I ordered the large Thai Tea w/ boba and it came out super quick! Total was $4.61 with tax. Very affordable for the size of the drink. They give you a stamp card when you order and after ten stamps you get a free drink. I've only tried the boba so far but their coffee and baked goods also looks good so I might switch it up next time.

This has now become my new favorite boba place in the TV. I'm pleased to know there are at least two good boba places in the TV. This is type of place where I can see myself becoming a regular and taking my friends and family when they come visit me. I look forward to my next visit!

I've been to this location a few times and the food is satisfying, not great but not bad either. This was the first visit i was actually disappointed with my meal. I ordered the Korean dish Bibimbap and received a version that was not close to the original. It was basically chicken and shrimp stir fried with some veggies with an egg on top.

The food here was excellent. The two young ladies that assisted us were very helpful.
I had the standard chicken teriyaki plate while my wife had the orange chicken. We rated both as A-  quality. Steamed rice was tender, and the fried rice even better!

The whole experience there was an "A"

You really can't go wrong here

BL

This place is not only delicious but enough food on one plate for an army! Portions are very large and prices are very reasonable. I had the farmers omelet, husband had chicken fried steak, daughters had biscuits and gravy and chicken and waffles. I highly recommend the food! It was all delicious!

I was so excited to see a coffee shop coming to this shopping center and it's a fantastic one. I've had a decaf latte and the earl gray milk tea with Boba- which were both super good. The decor is really nice, the atmosphere great, and it's a perfect place to hang out or get some work done.

The worst customer service I have ever experienced in the photo department I have been using their photo services for years and this will be my last time when I finally receive my photos. 

I ordered Christmas cards (I usually just do the glossy photos (.99 cent per photo) but this year I thought I would spend the extra money and buy the premium card stock (2.49 per card). I did same day pick up and showed up to get them on Black Friday. When I arrived over an hour after they were supposed to be done, they went on to say there was glitch with their system and the computer    where the order was processed  was not talking to the computer that does the printing. 

I went back Saturday morning and picked them up. I got home and looked at them and they were horrible. The back of this premium card stock had snowflakes and the card stock was so thin and low quality that you could see the snowflakes on the back showing from the front of the picture. We used a brand new iPhone 11 Pro and the picture looked amazing on the phone and computer. Because the card stock was so terrible the image turned out horrible. I called immediately and said i was very disappointed and i needed this fixed. They assistant manager said no problem just place a new order and come in and they will credit me the difference. I was thrilled with this. 

I placed the new ordered and decided to just stick with the cheaper glossy photo option as those always turned out great. Again i showed up about an hour after getting the email saying they were ready. I requested for Jeff the assistant manager as he said he was going to process the refund. He pulls the new photos and they looked great and he asked  me how he wanted this to be done. I said well you said you would do the exchange and refund me. He said well i need to see the ones you didn't like. I said you said nothing about me needing to bring the other photos back and asked if i could just take the photos and i would bring the others back on Sunday. I was trying to get the photos out in the mail today. He said no you will have to come back.
This would be a 3rd trip. I did not think bringing the other photos back would matter as they were trash  and what would they do with it?! 
Sick of wasting my time with this Walgreens  and making multiple trips

Dr. Eaton and his staff were amazing! I was having trouble with a tooth at the end of June and my dentist referred me over to Blue Creek. I'm so thankful they did! They saw me at 5 pm on a Friday and relieved the pain from an abscess. When the pain flared back up, they got me in on Tuesday at 7 am. Dr. Eaton had the root canal done in under an hour and with no pain during the process - in fact I almost fell asleep!! I've been very happy with the root canal, especially since he did it in such a way that only required a filling and not a crown. Very impressed! Will always come here for root canals!

Absolutely disgusting and horrible service, our waitress spent the entire time talking with her coworkers. Was given moldy fruit and sour salsa when I brought it up to the waitress her response was "yeah that's gross." Won't be back.

Family owned and operated.  Tim, Laura, and their expert staff have provided our family with a level of care that is unrivaled by similar providers. Rock & Armor does it all.  Exceptional chiropractic services provided by Dr. Tweedt, private training classes for our son, by ultra athletic, Kelsee Bobrowski, or Tim's suoerior and advanced physical therapy services.  Rock & Armor cares for about their clients and it shows.  Highly Recommended

I have been to this place 5 times now, and really I keep giving it a chance because I like Guinness and it's near my house.  The owner is absurd. She parks her big Range Rover next to the door and is outside on her phone, or inside and walking talking on her phone and interrupting servers and bar tenders to show them something on her cell. She is extremely trashy and unprofessional (and was DRUNK this last visit), which is a contrast to the actual bar itself because it is a pretty cute little place. The food is fine, really, nothing special but nothing bad. The menu has changed a few times and I've tried enough to know not to order anything now. They pour a pretty good Guinness even though, as another reviewer stated, it's much too cold. I'm bummed about this one. Definitely won't be back at this point.
Delicious food,  lots to choose from, excellent friendly service! Cinnamon rolls are homemade and giant!

Food is overpriced and the quality does not reflect the high price. Waitstaff is rude and not attentive. Also there were absolutely zero COVID precautions; waitstaff were not wearing facial coverings, no social distancing, no gloves or sanitizer. Extremely disappointing experience all around.
I just moved to Idaho and needed some quick teriyaki chicken, the chicken was juicy and flavor was great. The price was good too.  Also the girl that helped me was very nice as well.

I'm just going to start by saying that I never write reviews but I'm so done with this store and I have to say something. I'm sure everyone who does their curbside pickup can agree. It is TERRIBLE every. single. time. and I have used this service once a week since COVID began. They just can not get their s*** together. I've tired placing my order at times where I think it should be very slow, I've tried placing smaller orders that aren't too complicated (no items that are not edible, only great value brands, packaged produce instead of handpicked items, etc.) NOTHING ever gets better. Random things are constantly "out of stock" when I go to pick up that my order is nearly cut in half. It's kind of a waste of time to even drive there since I'll have to reorder the next day for the things I actually need and didn't get and they will be in stock usually the next day...why? I don't know. 
I'm actually currently waiting on an order that was supposed to be ready between 3-4 pm and it is now well past 5:30pm and I still haven't received any info on my order. And I know when it is "ready" I'll wait in the parking lot for an hour once I get there and check in because they are so behind now. It happens all the time. But when an order is placed days, or at least a day - per the rule, in advance it's confusing to the average person why it's not ready 24 hours or more later...
I appreciate the idea of this service being offered and I completely value that this is being done FOR me so I don't have to bring all of my children in a store with masks on. I know the kids that do the work are doing their best but I people NEED this new way of getting groceries and it's just not working at this location! We need this now more than ever and it's only getting busier so for them I hope they will figure it out. I personally will choose a different store or location that is farther away from where I live just to avoid this headache from happening every week.

Fair food without the fair prices, gobbs of people. I had the big hungry burger combo. I devoured it. It was just what I wanted. I also go a chocolate malt. It reminds me of the slower paced life that America has forever forgotten. It was nice to sit outside. The atmosphere is just right! I'll be back!

This was the first time I had been here and it was decent! The salad bar was plentiful but the selection was a bit odd in how they curated it. There is likely something for everyone on the salad bar though. My favorite part was the bread they served at the table if that tells you anything. I found the meat that was passed to be a bit underwhelming when it came to flavor- but please note, I only tried the beef items & some was over cooked. My table did seem to enjoy the lamb & sausage. They have a great happy hour with $5 Brazilian cocktails & glasses of wine but the price per person for food service is quite expensive, especially if you are not a big meat eater. We ordered coffee & dessert- they are your basic dessert options. The coffee was cold and we sent it back- the waiter seemed surprised that we wanted him to brew a warm pot, but he did and brought it out a few minutes later. It was not busy the weeknight we went, staff was friendly and attentive. I don't think there are any booths in this restaurant, just all tables in one giant dining room. There is a small banquet room in the back too.  It was pretty good, but I probably won't be back because of the costs.
Alan has amazing customer service.  Not only kind but extremely helpful. Call in orders tend to be uncomfortable. Thanks Alan! We appreciate you!
The Irish Mule is just as amazing as Megan the bartender is! Jamie the manager is great as well, was a pleasure to interact with them both. Will be back!
Had sushi and drinks and everything was delicious!  Also had the pretzel bites and calamari. Definitely recommend both. The service is always great!  Especially the bartender downstairs.

We tried this place a few years back, weren't impressed so we never came back.
The other night we were hosting and everyone wanted Asian food and this place was one of the only places open on Easter Sunday so we ordered a pickup order. I figured- maybe it's better now.

Nope.

Everyone hated their order, except for the pad Thai which was just okay.
The honey shrimp had a crazy amount of mayo, and I left it half uneaten. The drunk chicken had a huge amount of hot sauce that drowned out any other flavor, and the guest threw it away. Another chicken dish was bland and had too much onion, my guest didn't care for it. The fried rice was terrible and that's a tough one to mess up. I thought the crab Rangoon was good but others didn't like it. The potstickers were not good.
We also got two orders of sushi- which were actually fine, but pricy for a small portion, and came warm which was worrisome.

It was a real shame, and a lot of money spent for bad food. I felt bad for serving this stuff to my guests. We're never trying this place again.

Last night my family and I went to see a movie that had been listed online for Majestic. When we got there to buy tickets, the young man at the ticket counter stated that the showtimes online AND posted in the theater were wrong and that there were no showtimes available. This was very disappointing as we drove 30 minutes both ways to see this movie. We eventually decided to go to the village to spend our evening, but were very disappointed with Majestic. I recommend calling to make sure their online showtimes are correct before going.

I purchased a Groupon for 61% Off Mobile Headlight Restoration. I have to admit I was a little skeptical for a couple reasons. One my headlights looked hideous and driving at night was getting difficult with the haze of oxidation. Two, it was a Groupon. 

I rolled the dice and figured it was worth a try before doling out ~$140 for brand new headlight covers and suffering hours on a weekend trying to replace them myself. Some Groupon's can be risky especially with lesser known businesses. Not this one. 

I called to set up an appointment and Spencer returned my call that day and established a reasonable time that fit both of our schedules. Spencer came to my home and within 20 minutes he had my car's headlight's looking great! Let me just say, once you meet Spencer you'll know he is a trustworthy clean cut person with charisma and great customer service skills. The $35 Groupon rate was worth the risk and my only regret was not giving a bigger tip. I'm trying to redeem my good but meager tip by giving this worthy company a big thanks and a sound review! Thank you Spencer!

https://www.facebook.com/PipsTreasureValleyDetailing/info
Just discovered this place a month ago and we absolutely love it! We will be eating here once a month for sure! Best teriyaki chicken in town!
Best bacon I've ever had. Also, not joking the best gluten-free pancake I've ever tried. I don't know how this thing doesn't have five stars. I've been here multiple times and it's been amazing

I walked into envy nails today, for a pedicure and manicure for the first time and the last time. May was my girl, she insisted that I pay in cash, several times, when I wanted to use my card. I asked her if they accept cards, And she said they did. It was extremely awkward, as a customer to pay how I wanted to! That being said aside, my nails look absolutely horrible! $50 later and they are a mess. On the wall it said the Mani Pedi combo was $45, but she charged me 50! Absolute rip off

Super cute shop ! I love the atmosphere and it's close to where I live. Boba is super easy to order, pick your tea, pick your flavor, pick your bubbles and done ! They also have coffee drinks, sweets and milk tea.

We order sandwiches here about once a week and always appreciate the freshness.  I prefer the roast beef and provolone, hold the oil, add the mayo!  A sandwich is always tastier when someone makes it for you!  :-)
This is a great gently used clothes store for kids. I get 90% of my three children is wardrobes here. And their credit system is awesome, and really helps with tight budgets and big families.

I found another place that I love getting sushi at. My mother brought me here for my birthday lunch. It was so so good. I have never had such good sushi.
I tried poke for the very first time. This was so good and made me so happy. It had sashimi, some spice, cabbage, and cilantro. The rice was heaven in this dish. This dish is generous so expect a big bowl of it to share.
I ordered this roll with salmon, avocado, cream cheese, and a fresh lemon zest. I thought that I would hate it because of the lemon. I was very wrong. This was delightful to my tongue and I wished that the serving on this was just as generous as the poke.
I thought I was going to receive poor service because upon entering nobody was there to greet us. Our server was the best. She had a pleasant attitude and was there to explain the menu and check up on us. 
Ling and Louie's is a delight. They will see me return again soon.

If I could give this organization a negative number I would.  I purchased a new and according to the home warranty I am entitled to have the contractor in this case alpine fireplace come to my house and address my concerns.  Jason was a bully and I get if I could work with the manager I might be able to have my fireplace concerns addressed.  Mike was a bully as well, he talked over the top of me to the point I had to hang up.  Mike and Jason refused to work with my schedule- even after I suggested a Saturday morning and Mike said they could only come at 7 am.  When I said fine he started harassing me to the point I had to hang up.  He then called back and left a message stating they would not come out to inspect the fireplace and address my concerns.   This business has no concept of customer service or even how to accommodate customer service.  THEY ARE REALLY RUDE.  Go anywhere else's!!!!!!

Went here for Saturday brunch around 9:45am and there was a wait (which is to be expected) we were told 30mins and we were sat within that time frame. Great customer service and for Boise ID this place is a gem. Food was tasty and we will definitely eat here again.

Heck yes. We are traveling through this area during Mother's Day weekend. Asked our airbnb host, for a local restaurant recommendation. I Googled this place, they'd never heard of it. Hmm anyhow, took a chance and honestly AMAZING. 
Ample parking area, especially for my truck. immediately greeted and seated. My Idaho plate was so delicious and large. As was my little girls pancake kids meal. I mean seriously, the largest pancake I've ever seen for a children's meal option. The size of and old record, my parents have. Just huge! 
Prices were not crazy high. Place was busy, yet we never felt rushed or neglected. Such a fun little spot. We saw another table playing Yahtzee while waiting for their meals. I'd come back in a NY minute.

While it's great that this business is thriving during covid, I felt extremely rushed through my nail appointment. I don't like to leave bad reviews, but they didn't touch my cuticles or reshape my nails for my new full set. No attention to detail with the full set, every nail was a different shape and the gel looks like bubbles rather than nails. The nail station wasn't cleaned between the client before myself, or even after myself. Same paper towel was used, no sanitation precautions. 
My boyfriend had a fabulous pedicure, which is why I'm giving this place a third star. I'm from out of town and just wanted a relaxing nail experience. Super bummed, hopefully things settle down for these guys and they're able to keep up with the appointments.

I understand the impact that the current worker shortage can have on a business but if you are using technology to accept pickup orders and you have no confidence that you can hit the pickup time that you provided, you should either quit accepting orders or modify the system to more accurately predict the pickup time. 30+ minutes waiting at curbside is not really providing curbside in the spirit of the service expectation. Sorry Louie's, you control all of the knobs in this situation. I will think twice about ordering from here again.

Update-
Lou was nice to follow up with me with an email explaining what happened. I will let them share so that I don't mis-represent their feedback, but with the Father's day and regional soccer tournament occurring, The feedback was reasonable and appreciated. I will move review from 2 to 4 stars because of the follow-up. They also offered a refund,but we did get our dinner after the wait and it did not disappoint. We will be back.

Legitimately the worst food I've had in Meridian since we moved here a year ago. Every. Single. Thing. We got was COLD. On top of that, the burger that was brought out to me after I paid and tipped the lady was wrong (no cheese, pickles, etc). So they apologized and made it again and it STILL came out with cheese and pickles. I just said forget it and left. The service, taste, all of it is the worst I've experienced in all of Meridian. Avoid at all costs!

Worst Applebee's I've ever been to. Server took forever to bring our drinks. Then when my wife and i got our chicken wonton tacos the chicken was cold. And the weirdest thing is we ordered 2 ranch with the mozzarella sticks and combo platter and for some reason there were 14 additional ranch on the receipt. Good thing there was no price but somethings going on. And the server never checked on us or got refills after the food was dropped off until she brought the check. It was not very busy in there

I would rate higher but the clinic has changed greatly. Prices have gone up very much.  We took all three animals in my two dogs and my kitty in for shots and a couple other issues. One dog never got her medication for he fungus in her ears the other boy has a growth on upper eyelid. Was told to watch it and keep it clean.  It's now bigger! He also didn't get anxiety Meds for thunder storms etc. my kitty developed a very high fever 104.3 and had to get her back in for fluids and an anti rejection shot. Now they will no longer let clients make payments and we were charged for three office visits and even a nail trim that was complimentary.  And just called to make n appointment for Ben and his eye and was promptly reminded I owed $50 for bring my cat in! Not even one bit of compassion for my dog!!! Not happy and have used this clinic for many years.
Really enjoyed the teriyaki beef and the rice. The chicken was also good but the beef was much better. Great food!

Root-Rooter to the rescue again!  We have used them in the past for toilets, but this time it was for the kitchen sink and disposal!  They were very quick to get us in they even had someone on call if we needed the work done that night!  Cole was totally experienced and knowledgeable!  He got the job done and was patient in explaining the situation!

Sorry - I was anxious to try this place, the service was slow, the windows were filthy (makes you wonder about the cleanliness of the rest of the restaurant) flies and luke warm at best food. Portions are large but not worth it.

Very good food. Service left lots to be desired, very slow. Pretty spendy. Don't think the service or ambiance justify the price. No mask being worn by wait staff or bartender. Won't go back. $40 for breakfast for 2 can be had lots of places that includes excellent service.

They did a great job of working around my family and being flexible about the order of the rooms I needed so my son could take a nap. Small thing but really matters to a family. The owner was very personable and did a great job. We plan to return service yearly.

Great service if you can get an appointment - WHICH YOU CAN'T!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!   No appointments on Wednesdays...no appointments on Fridays or Mondays either!  I was told to call and pre-book weeks in advance, which I did - BUT THERE WERE STILL NO APPOINTMENTS!!!!  I'm going somewhere else...

On a side note, the amount Kim charges is arbitrary and capricious, to wit, I've been charged 3 different amounts on 3 visits (same services each time)...the new math is in full effect!

My wife and I went here during happy hour and I liked the food very much although my wife did not as much. My wife enjoys sushi and she said that it was ok, I cannot comment on that simply because I do not like sushi. We only ordered a mango margarita that was not to our taste but myself would go back not my wife.

This is one of our go to's for lunch or dinner.  Their lunch portions are perfect, dinner I usually take some of my chicken parm home. The Alfredo is also excellent but the chicken parm has won me over.  The pizza is excellent when we want to share dinner. My husband always gets something different.  The mushroom soup is one of his favorites soups they make.  I'm have never walked away unhappy from a meal here!

Wow,
GREAT pizza
BETTER service
And desert out of this world,
If you are deciding where to get pizza and are reading this review, this is it 100%
I always love Louie's.  My wife and I used to go for Sunday brunch before covid. I love the spaghetti and meatballs.  My wife goes for the chicken Alfredo but the lasagna is great as well.

We were referred to Mike Walters by a family friend (my friend, his family) when relocating from the east coast to San Jose. We knew nothing whatsoever about San Jose or the California real estate market and protocols which were quite different from what we had experienced in previous home purchases. Mike reached out to contact us in NC, reassure us about how much we would love CA, got familiar with our needs and checklist, and was ready to work with us once we were ready to get out of our short term rental into owning a home. Since Mike went to school and raised children in San Jose, he knew the neighborhoods we were considering like the back of his hand. He faithfully adhered to our budget constraints and never tried to push us into a higher price point.  Did I mention he drove up from Hollister for weeks on end to help us house hunt? Over a period of about 3 months, he previewed and/or showed us close to 80 homes and submitted many offers for us. Finally we found our home, which was a short sale. Mike was undeterred. From the date of our offer until we closed was under 10 weeks, which anyone familiar with CA real estate and short sales knows was nothing short of miraculous. We even got concessions which are practically unheard of with short sales. With all of his years of experience, Mike knew exactly how to work the system. He followed up routinely with the bank and sellers agent to get the deal done. He had contacts for everything from home and pool inspection to painters and even personally trained my husband on pool maintenance. We felt like we were working with our favorite uncle. He has checked in with us often since we purchased the home, and encourages our home improvement. We were so glad to have made our first CA friend in Mike! I have really enjoyed viewing Mike's video home tours and following his blog, both available through his website. I keep telling Mike he has a future on HGTV! Whenever we are ready to move again we will certainly look forward to enlisting Mike's help to sell this home and buy another.

First time here and we would come back!!! We ordered the pancake combo and I can't even tel you how big they were! We also ordered the chicken and a biscuit which was great. We didn't order drinks but the food didn't disappoint. We appreciate the masks and our server was very attentive.

We were blown away by this impromptu drop-in for dinner. 
We were running very late and showed up 25 minutes before closing, but instead of treating us like a nuisance, we were warmly greeted and the servers and manager were top notch attentive and friendly. 
My grandkids ate for free, and the food was surprisingly delicious. I was expecting strip mall generic food, but this was inspired, fresh, good quality, and plentiful. 
We aren't in town very often, but when we are, this will be one place I demand we go to. 
Loved it.

Top notch customer service, company staff is well educated on all the products they carry. They understand pet nutrition and do a great job of explaining pets needs to clients. They understand your dog/cat is more than just a pet. They are family and share the same goal of wanting your pet to live a long healthy life. The prices here are incredibly reasonable. You cannot beat the $1 scoop dog treats. They offer a senior discount daily.  Support your local businesses and check these guys out!

I went here last week for a pedicure.  $40.00 for a pedicure seems a little expensive to me.  I am still looking for a regular place for a pedicure, this won't be the place.  The lady did a decent job and my toes look better but the price is too high for what you get.  I was in and out in less then an hour.  She also asked me a lot of personal questions too.  It was a bit uncomfortable.  She asks me to put a mask on but yet when she talked to me, she lifts her mask and uncovers her mouth.  She asked me a few times if I was sure I wanted the color I picked.  Even after she put on one coat! At the end, she tells me I can put my flip flops on.  I asked if she could do it.  (Everywhere I have gone in the past, the person slides my feet in my flip flops.)  She looked unsure and asked if I wanted the paper flip flops.  So I ended up having to use those and walking out with two pairs of shoes.  Not the best experience.

Denizens of the Treasure Valley, when it comes to movies I am decidedly "old school."  I am not interested in valet parking, heated reclining seats, waiter service, a full bar, and most especially... being able to RESERVE SPECIFIC SEATS.  Sorry, but if you want a certain seat, you get your butt to the theater and you wait in line with the rest of us.  No way should you be able to waltz in while the previews are playing and claim I'm sitting in "your" seat.  

It is for all these reasons that I love the Majestic.  No muss, no fuss, no frills... and no slackers buying their tickets off their iPhones and taking your seat.  Ok yes you can buy your tickets online here, but that in and of itself is practically mandatory these days.  But even still, no reserve seating!  And none of that other crap either.  This is a movie theater... period.  It's not a restaurant, it's not a lounge, it's not a bar.  It's a theater.  You go to see movies.

So if you want a great place to go see a movie, let the hipsters have The Village to themselves and save yourself the money for the IMAX.  The Majestic is where you want to go for a straight up theater experience.  (If you're really hard up for a meal, the strip mall next door has pretty much anything you'd want... pizza, burgers, Chinese, sandwiches, etc.)

We were told it's a 40 minute wait when we came in.  There were constantly 5-8 open tables and no explanation of why people weren't getting seated. We grabbed a drink at the bar and were hassled about standing near the bar. So far not great customer service..  we'll see how the food is just this once...

I am a business traveler and and Honors member, and stayed here without checking revues assuming I'd get the same Hilton experience I get at other Hilton properties.
We chose this location due to having the family with me to spend a day at the water park.
The lobby is bright and inviting.
The room is a bit tight, and there is not a single surface large enough to put a bag on in order to get to your clothing.
There was no desk to work at, although there was a pullout table you could use, it was way too tall to use with the single chair in the room.
The road and freeway noise where quite problematic all night.
During this time of Covid, I understand the breakfast situation in not being able to serve your self, but limiting you to how much you get, really? Also, the selection was pathetically small compared to other places I have stayed during this time, and they actually ran out of items the second day we were there.
Finally, the kicker here is that there was no hand sanitizers to be seen anywhere, ever. When I inquired, they said they could not source any. That is a lie.
Whoever the purchaser is for this location needs to be fired as from this experience, they are clearly slacking on their duties.

This MyPlace seemed reasonable with their prices, The staff is awesome here! Our room ended up being on the 3rd floor- I used the UV light I brought after watching the Hotel Impossible guy do it, I did see some spots glowing but for the most part, including the bed and shower and toilet it was clean perfect.
The bed itself, very comfortable, there is a full size Microwave and refridge in the room, and two burner stovetop. It also has a bottle opener below the stove.
Shower was fine, so most certainly would recommend this place. But overall this chain seems to be like Holiday Inn- overpriced- so this one is different for that regards.

Tried Sushi Shack today for the first time and was so impressed!! I had the Edamame with Fire Sauce and a delicious Western Collective Peak Juice beer to start. The edamame was  and so good! I don't recommend if you can't handle the heat. For lunch I had the Sassy Sis and it was really really fresh and delicious! They had 40 beers on tap as well as a full bar. I will definitely come back. The service was great and everyone was helpful and friendly!

Love the staff they were very nice and as soon as I walked in the door they greated me and asked me how to help. Showed me around the stuff I was looking for all the different products brands things they do love the staff!!! Very helpful.

A Tru2! 
Unless your into a dorm room vibe ran by students. Kids size rooms with an adult $.

 ...definitely not worth the $129. Hilton you should be ashamed of yourself..Honestly 
Hilton on cheap.. 
I'm sure the staff is doing their best but definitely not educated in hospitality.  

Can't wait to get back to the South.

All of the employees here are amazing.  I was treated by Kim,  who got my name and said it though out my conversation with her. She was friendly and helpful, made sure my nails were perfect and clipped a few times when she noticed something.  Some places rush you through in 30-40 minutes.  You get your money here and they take their time to do a great job.  I'll be back!!!

Prices are decent for their combos! Love their teriyaki chicken combo and yakisobas. I'm usually there for the bobas! Always a must for me. This location specifically has awesome customer service! The always call in to order when we are in town and feeling for some rice. She's always nice and sweet.
Yummy drinks, great atmosphere, and super sweet employees! I got a pumpkin chai and it was surprisingly good! I was a little skeptical but also like to try unique drinks when I go places.

What a wonderful Irish pub. The food was incredible, each server was very kind and attentive, and the owner (I think, curly long brown hair, harp tattoo) even chatted with us and other patrons. Extremely clean and well organized. Music was wonderful and ambient for the place. I cannot reccomend this place enough; you can even watch the food being prepared in front of you. If you are wondering if you should stop by, let me assure you that this is your sign to stop wondering. If you need any more convincing, this is the first yelp review I have ever written. Thanks for being my favorite place to eat, you now have a patron for life!

Their food quality just went up in the last weeks or so, maybe new owners. 
Their teriyaki bowl used to have cooked cabbage and 1-2 pieces of broccoli. 
I went today , and the bowl had lots of broccoli, peppers, onions and cabbage , perfectly cooked. 
The wait was a little longer ; I don't mind waiting for better quality food. 
I hope they keep up this quality.

Not sure what to do here. Clean hotel. Good service. The standard one would expect...nothing special. But the hero was that bed! Sooooo comfortable and the sheets were amazing. Wonderful sleeping experience. Easily 5 stars for the bed. But the $350+ summer rate for a damn Holiday Inn can suck it.

DO NOT USE THEM! Incompetent repair and incredibly bad customer service.  The only reason I gave them 1-star is becaome the system would not accept a 0-star.

After promising to call with an estimate for a TV repair in 2 business days, they still had not called a week later.  When I called them, they used the excuse that they were very busy. They promised to call me back in a day, but again did not.  This happened twice more.  After keeping my TV for almost 3 weeks, they said they could not fix the problem. Also, the inside of the shop is messy and disorganized.

My Santa Saga continues for finding the perfect Santa Haircut. Last year I tried The Beardsmith and got butchered just before my volunteer work for kids caught up in the legal/government social systems. 

This time I show up and I am informed that they have no one to cut my hair. This is after calling to confirm my time AND telling them why I am coming in the middle of the summer for a Santa cut. I left work early just to meet their schedule. 

Well at least it's still early. I WILL get a haircut that WILL look like a true santa if it kills me!

In reading reviews of Sonic's most popular items, we decided to give them a try.  Husband's hot dog was just ok (we miss Weinerschnitzel) but my Sonic cheeseburger was not that good...they use cheap ground beef!  The Habit's burger are so much better and about the same price. And they can stop with that 'peppermint candy' they include with your order...it has absolutely no peppermint taste;  I spit it out.

Worst experience ever at this place!  Service is terrible.  My high school daughter and friend  had 2 separate 4:30 mani and full set apts and they made them go back to back so the one gal could take walkins.  They were there 2 And a half + hours.  The mani was meh... the full set was HORRIBLE.  Worse than a first time beauty school set! Gel polish all over cuticle.  Uneven shape.  Rough sharp unfinished edges. Bleeding cuticles... And when they asked about shape and polish on skin, they were rude and blamed it on her nail beds! These girls treated them self to this service and such a waste.  Save yourself the money and head ache!

This place was a blast!  I went there with a group of friends and we all raved about the meal, the atmosphere, and the wait staff.  If you want to have some great food in a place you won't forget, then this is your place.  Thanks for making our dinner time fun!

I recently switch out policies to Steve and I am so happy I did. The whole office is top notch! Steve will answer your calls even late into the evening while he is driving home, he doesnt care if its just a simple question, your never bothering him. They reviewed all of our policys to make sure we are getting the best rates possible, even had the Life insurance convo which is something I hate to talk about but Steve made it easy!  They treat you like your their only client, A+ in everything. Highly reccomend!

Village coffee gets better by the day. It is a great place to grab a cup of coffee, sit and people watch or to grab and go.

The coffee at Village Coffee is solid, served hot and fresh and the people are always friendly. I like that they've added a larger selection of pastry and other items to their menu. Their coffee is average price for a cup of coffee at a shop.

One of the things I like most is the seating and the fireplace. You can grab a cup of coffee or hot chocolate for the kids on a frosty day and enjoy a beautiful fire while you sip your beverage. 

This is a great place to watch the water show and people watch as well. It is a fun, lively atmosphere and seating is almost always available. I prefer this to the coffee at the Gelato shop by far which is the only other place to get coffee at the Village.

This is a great place! Alpine has a beautifully designed showroom with a wide selection of inserts, fireplaces and stoves, most of them operational. I have been in their showroom on many occasions and Mike and Brandi have always treated me with the utmost courtesy and respect.  They are very knowledgeable as well.  

My husband has a professional relationship with Alpine, and works with some of their customers who need service on their fireplace sooner than Alpine's service department can get to them, because Alpine's service department and installers are in high demand in the Fall and Winter months since that is the peak of their season. Every customer of Alpine's whom my husband has come into contact with has nothing but great things to say about them, and love their service and products. 

Likewise, having been to and tried to work with other fireplaces shops in the Treasure Valley, anyone we come into contact with who needs a fireplace, new or replacement for their existing one, is referred to Alpine, as we are confident in their service and wonderful quality appliances.

I highly recommend Alpine. Check them out!!

Eh, just ok. The rice had the texture and taste of par-boiled or minute rice. The ninja chicken was ok, lots of spice but not a lot of flavor. Hubby's teriyaki chicken as seasoned well, but the sauce was way too sweet. Potstickers were very good, but beware, the dipping sauce has a kick. The kids in our group were caught off guard.
Their online ordering and curbside pickup was very convenient. 21+ can order and pick up adult beverages! A bigger menu, and more options, than other popular teriyaki places.
When we were planning on going (Aug 12, 2020) they were not open for dine-in. Plan accordingly.
Good addition to downtown Kuna, but there are better teriyaki places. I wouldn't seek them out, but wouldn't turn their food away. We took our dinner over to the park nearby and it was a pleasant outdoor dinner.
We loved Kim but one day back in November she missed an appointment and we never heard from her again.  Poof, just gone.

My husband and I have been to Biscuit and Hogs twice now and were very happy with our orders. Tonight we decided to place a DoorDash order and I chose the KC Queen yet when our order arrived, I got a double burger!! NOT HAPPY! PLEASE slow down and pay attention to what is ordered and actually give your customers what they actually ordered.

I didn't think this place would wow me much. It sounded like another wannabe Asian restaurant that served overly Americanized dishes. It goes to say that what sounds or looks like may not actually be, and to make a true judgement you have to be willing to take the risk and try the place out yourself. Well, I'm happy I gave Ling & Louie's a shot.

First off you have to remember you're not going to find any true Asian dishes here, but American-Asian food, which means it's based off old Asian recipes but twisted into something that will delight the American's palate. Typically what that means is dumping loads of sodium into the recipes. Ling & Louie's, however, does a fantastic job incorporating other flavors to enhance the taste of their dishes. For example, I ordered the Drunken Stir Fry dinner with chicken, which was loaded with some many different ingredients. Pineapples, onions, red bell pepper, and broccoli piled one top of white rice. The pineapple flavoring dominates the dish, more so than the tropical sauce that comes served flaming. While this was as far from any traditional Asian dish as you can get, it tasted fantastic. I appreciated the hefty portions of vegetables and chicken. All ingredients mixed perfectly well together and the sauce just topped it all off for me. Well, and the pineapple. 

After scanning their sushi menu quite precariously I ordered the Vegas roll. It consists of spicy tuna, eel, cream cheese, jalapeno, tobiko, tempura fried, and spicy mayo. As with the Drunken Stir Fry, the Vegas roll was beautifully presented. And to the mouth it was divine. The tuna and eel were perserved well because you could taste the freshness even with all the extras in the roll. The cream cheese enhanced the flavor and combined with the jalapeño provided a satisfying spicy kick. Everything about this roll was delectable! 

Another highlight of the restaurant is I respect them advertising as "Asian fusion" instead of just Asian. As someone who grew with a traditional Singaporean mother, I ate true Asian food nearly every day of my life. And I truly hate eateries that pose as authentic Asian. I applaud and thank Ling & Louie's for correctly advertising their business and for providing outstanding Asian fusion dishes to the Treasurd Valley. I will definitely be returning!

It's pricey and I'm not sure it's worth it. The service we received was really sad. We had a reservation but still had to wait 10 minutes for a table (No, they were not busy. Only 3 tables were occupied). Our waitress was very slow to come tend to our needs and came by multiple times (empty-handed) without taking our dirty plates, so our table was packed with dirty dishes waiting to be taken away.
The food was very delicious and worth the wait but BEWARE of the drink prices!!! Dr. Pepper is $5 PER FILL! My husband had 4 fills so we paid $20 just for his soda....I could've gotten him enough soda for a few months with that money....but the food is good. Just be careful.

This was the WORST housecleaning I've ever had and I've had my house cleaned monthly for the past 6 years by other cleaners. We just moved to Boise so I had to try a new cleaning company. They gave me an estimate over the phone for how long it would take to do our house and when that time was up they just left! They didn't clean our guest bathroom, bonus room and left garbages full and beds unmade. It was ridiculous! Don't ever use them! Also, when I called them to discuss it with them they did NOTHING to try to make it right.

Had a semi-emergency in the form of a frozen leaking outside hose bib on a Sunday afternoon.  Called and they said they would call their technician to see if he had the parts and time to fit me in.  It had been a very long and cold streak of weather so there must have been broken pipes all over the valley but about an hour later the tech shows up and immediately gets to work diagnosing the problem.  He was so very polite and knowledgable.  He had the parts and with a little help from me to save him a third round trip under the house he was able to fix the problem. Not only did he fix it he made it so it could easily be fixed in the future if it its needed. 

My only negative was perhaps the communications. When I called on their dispatcher on the phone she said she would call the tech and have him call me if he could fix the issue and had time. But instead he just showed up. Not a big deal as I was home anyway. So only a minor issue.  Regardless either way. I got my problem resolved in a  timely manner on a day that was I sure a very busy one for them.  

For the record I did call a few other services in town and they were all too busy to help me. I think these guys were like the fourth place I called and they were able to work me in. 

It is nice too they take credit cards are checks...
I haven't had a decent dining experience in a long time but Louies was great. Staff was very friendly and the food was perfect. Will definitely be back.

Worst customer service ever!! Called for a quote to remove a large tree in our yard. They gave a bid and we left on vacation. Came back and called them to schedule the removal. They came out again to look at the tree and said he was unsure if he could do it for the same price but would have his guy come by and look at it later that day and then we could schedule. 9 class to them no return call then we physically went to the office, they we very sorry for the delay, signed up for pest control and someone would be by later today to look at the tree. Well no call and no one showed up. Today, Saturday get a call from the original guy and he was very nasty and short and said they could do the tree but it was going to triple cost of the original price. Told them to take a hike. No way would I have this company remove a tree let alone spray for bugs!! DONT USE THEM!!!
Great burger but not a lot of meat. The burger was pricey and didn't come with a side.

Overpriced, and the food isn't even good! We ate inside, and every table was dirty. The floor needed to be swept, too. The wind makes a crazy loud noise inside that wouldn't stop, like a whistling. My chicken wrap was really bland, and I ended up with a stomachache. I won't be back here! I think it's just a place to get a fun flavored drink.

Never thought we'd find top notch Asian food when we moved to TV. Ling and Louie's proved us wrong! We happened to hit near the end of Happy Hour, so appetizers and signature cocktails were a few dollars off menu prices. The Mixologist pours with a pretty light hand, but the composition of the Kung Fu Cosmo and Dragon berry Mojito was inventive and refreshing. We poured over the menu to the point of confusion! Every single item looked fabulous and it was difficult to narrow our choices down. We decided to just go for it, knowing we'd be living on leftovers the next day. The Chicken Lettuce Wraps and Black Orchid Ahi appetizers were beautifully presented, generously portioned, and absolutely delicious; Edamame perfectly steamed and salted. As one who  has lived part time in Maui, I'll testify that the Ahi was as fresh and sweet as any I've had on the Island. We ordered several sushi rolls: Karma Kaze, Boston Roll, and Double Dragon - each well composed, properly flavor-balanced and absolutely yummy. The weak link in this otherwise perfect dinner was the Honey Walnut Shrimp, which we ordered split plate to taste test drive. It was insipid, swimming in a nondescript sauce over rice; after a few bites, we set it aside. This place is popular and BUSY! No reservations for parties under 8. Clearly the servers are schooled to keep tables turning over, but at no time did our excellent server, Damon T. make us feel it was time to move along. Bonus points for a menu that has plentiful GF or GFO selections, which made hubs as happy a bird with a French fry

I just discovered Urban Fox.  The coffee is excellent ..not bitter, just a smoky, yummy coffee flavor!!  The space is cool and clean.  It has a great vibe!  It's a great place to meet friends!! I can't wait to come back and try the boba!!
I made an error when posting the review. It was to the wrong hotel and no matter what I do, Yelp won't let me delete the posting. I'm sorry.

Terrible customer service. I spent ten minutes trying to find an employee in shoes. I saw two and when I spun in circles trying to find the football cleats, they walked off. Finally found an employee who spent three minutes trying to convince an employee that a customer needed help and she needed to come out. She said maybe we could use a stick and knock stuff off the top shelf. When I asked for help with the cleats she pointed. I told her exactly what I wanted and she rolled her eyes, huffed, and got the "whatever" attitude. I told her that I wasn't buying anything with that attitude. I left the store and took my business elsewhere.

This was our 2nd visit to B & H with friends from our neighborhood.  We were all seated fairly quickly after a 9:20 arrival but the place filled up as the AM progressed.  We all order different breakfasts and here is the nitty gritty, nuts and bolts of the visit.

Pros - good wait staff, attentive and responsive / Good parking / friendly /
menu options / quick delivery of food / food portions large.
