Cons - overpriced, for what you get .. food on this day was not hot, flies a plenty inside for some reason causing distraction and irritation  /  Noisy, the metal ceilings cause echoes and with larger parties .. like a concert and an ensuing shouting match to talk / Not clean,  food bits on the floor when we first arrived .. opted to move on our own accord to another table due to the mess / average quality of food was OK.

I have never waited longer for a deli sandwich to be made.  Fully staffed, but division of labor is out of balance.  Everyone mumbled through their mask and could not retain my simple order.  

Here is the conversation:

Worker: Welcome can I take your order (while they are slicing meat on a large slicing machine)

Customer: Yes a regular kahuna cheesesteak

Worker (still slicing) Anything to drink with that?

Customer: No just the sandwich

Worker (still slicing): Chicken or beef?

Customer: Steak

Worker (still slicing): What size?  

Customer: I said regular

Worker (still slicing): Do you want everything that is shown on the menu in that sandwich?

Customer: If that's want a Big Kahuna is, yes.

Worker (stops slicing and picks up the order pad):  What is it that you want?

Customer repeats everything again.  

Four customers behind me got their sandwich before I got mine.  They ordered just like I did by walking in.  There were a steady stream of people picking up internet orders while I waited.

You have been warned.  Not recommended.  Go across the street to Gandolfo's.  They get it right.

Been coming here off and on for years, located conveniently in a strip mall right on Fairview.  I think they get most of their business from delivery house there is hardly anyone ever eating in here sometimes I've been the only one during lunch. I don't have any complaints about their food, I see mixed reviews on yelp but the food is always been very good and very consistent. The restaurant leaves some to be desired for as it is very run down with food under the tables etc. They are understaffed usually with one waiter who handles the whole restaurant, it must be owner/chef in the back and that's it. It's not the best out there but consistently quite good even their take-out I've always been happy with.

Had an AMAZING calzone!!! Had to take half of it home and I was upset I was too full for dessert because all looked amazing!! Everything looked amazing and the staff was very on point!! I am not from here but I will be back!

I ordered delivery. I'm in a hotel. During COVID. When I went upstairs and opened the food, a salad and a breakfast burrito with potatoes.  There were NO NAPKINS OR UTENSILS. There are none available here.  I ate a couple of potato slices with my fingers=meh. Nothing special. The burrito was so soggy, it fell apart and far to messy to eat with my hands especially with no napkins. The food is just sitting here. I'll be requesting a refund through the delivery service and if they don't refund I will go through my bank. 

This is really dropping the ball, during this time of mostly takeout and delivery, especially delivering food to a hotel, to NOT INCLUDE UTENSILS. I'M JUST GONNA GRAB SOME TACO BELL. #DoorDash

We loved this place! We did a pickup order and were worried about it being cold by the time we got home but it wasn't at all. I got the Mongolian beef which I would definitely recommend. The beef was very high quality. My husband ordered the fried rice with chicken and it was very packed and they did not skimp on the chicken. Between the two meals, there were no leftovers but we were very satisfied with what we ordered.

The coconut boba was amazing and the girls working were so sweet and helpful. She throughly explained the drinks when I asked what she liked the best. She even went into detail on sweetness. I'll definitely be back for another!!!
Very happy to have stumbled across this place. Their happy hour is no joke and the huckleberry mule is AMAZING! 100/10 would recommend

Oh my!  We have been to Biscuit and Hogs more times than I can count. They have it all and it continues to be consistent! Breakfast, lunch, dinner, Happy Hour and amazing appetizers. 

Each and every time we have visited Biscuit & Hogs we have been thoroughly impressed. The food is fabulous. They take their menus items up a big time notch. Biscuit and Hogs is a restaurant we love taking friends and family that come into town.  It is always a hit!  

The breakfast items are very large portions. We always go home with left overs. The nachos are absolutely delicious, and a must try. The Happy Hour menu is super unique and so creative. My girlfriends and I love the champongs :)   

The cherry on top of this restaurant is the service has always been fantastic. We have always had super friendly service. 

Biscuit and Hogs does not take reservations and does get super busy on Saturday and Sunday Mornings so keep this in mind. There will be waits on the weekends.

I have been to this Ling & Louiés over 20 times now. 
I love the food, especially the bit of Mexico sushi roll! 
I really appreciate the staff there. They have always been so attentive and wonderful! One of my favorite places in Boise to go to! I'll be back!

I love this place!! Happy hour is my go-to but at any time of the day is a great place to be. Fun & friendly staff, wonderful food ... happy hour is WONDERFUL! Sushi is innovative, fresh & yummy. 
I can't believe I haven't done a review with as many times as I've been here but I've been enough to be able to tell you it's great food & consistent.

A New Vintage was the most valuable find in my attempt at "scouting" the Eagle area on our quarterly trips in preparation for plans to relocate here in late 2011. 
The wine shop itself has a wonderfully pleasant atmosphere. My sense is that they have a very solid selection (in the 75-150 vintages range) that the owners have hand selected. While I am fond of the massive warehouse-like wine shops (K&L in California, Astor in NY, even Binny's in Chicago) where you can go in with your list of specific names in hand knowing if you find it anywhere it'll be there; for those visits where you're simply looking for a bottle of something-in-this-direction, a few bottles for a dinner party or just a few things to try out and maybe just a box or two to fill the cellar. 
I enjoy the "exploring" part of wine shopping. Judging from the selection here I'd feel quite comfortable going with their inventory. The selection is compact enough for me to not feel lost, and when I resonate with 25%+ of their selections that's a great sign. 
The store is also a wine bar (which may be what half the patrons come in for) that is just very charming. The owners/staff are very knowledgeable and friendly. 
If you enjoy wine (or beer) I highly recommend A New Vintage.

Just had my teeth cleaned by Julie and what a great smile she gave me!!  We even had a nice conversation which shows that she is a pro at her job!  Dr. Scott is fun and efficient and has a big heart sometimes funding a great cause in coordination with his clients by giving us discounts on his services when we support the cause.  I love this dentist and his kind staff.
Most of the staff are great. Not a big fan of Corinn. The rooms are ok. The "queen" bed is definitely NOT a queen. The housekeeping only comes once a week. What? Not a fan that either.

Who does not love a great pork belly lots of bacon, biscuits gravy and the works?  I certainly do, but was very disappointed when after being asked how I like my poached eggs, (not sure who eats a poached egg not runny but I was asked) to find my eggs were like two hard boiled eggs out of the shell, my biscuits crazy dry and the gravy lacking much flavor.  The server was super nice and I love the concept, need to work with the kitchen staff a bit more.

I had the pleasure of receiving a final bill of $xx.xx from Idaho Power dating back to Aug. 2010.  I immediately contacted Idaho Power to clarify:

#1 I no longer owned xyz property 

#2 to explain there must be a mistake because the renters Valley Property Management had renting the property moved out July 31st, 2010 thus no one has lived in the property since. 


Idaho Power went through their records and found in Dec. 2009 the property manager called and had Idaho Power change billing for xyz to a Landlords policy with an address change to Valley Property MGMT PO Box 1090 Meridian, ID 83680-1090.  Further finding on Jan. 19th, 2011 the property manager called into Idaho Power and advised Idaho Power she no longer was taking care of the property and to send the bill(s) to my old address (out of state).

Now this is my frustration; I don't understand why, knowing (assuming she knew/knows the details of a Landlords policy), my policy was changed and the power would then be automatically turned into my name and that the property was in foreclosure would she have not a) had the power turned off or b) advised me of the changes she made and what that meant for myself or c) CALLED me to let me know you were receiving bills from Idaho Power or d) EMAILED me to let me know she was receiving bills from Idaho Power and/or f) when she adequately called Idaho Power to have Valley Property Management's address removed/advise them she no longer was taking care of the property, she didn't at least give them the correct and most current address which I advised her of on Nov. 12, 2010 at 7:42AM. (Via email)

If I would have know that the power was turned on or still on I would have corrected the issue promptly, instead it lingered for months due to the property managers negligence. Once I received the bill I corrected the matter however I feel that the property manager should have contacted me to correct the matter once a bill was received, by not doing so additional usage charges were compounded during the months the manager ignored the bills.  

I would NOT recommend using this company for any of your properties.

This business is all about looking good on the outside, but lacks the skills when it comes to running the business.  On more then one occasion my appointment time was incorrect.  It's like the right hand doesn't know what the left hand is doing.  Also insurance coverage is not reflected accurately to the patients (I've heard this from others too). They simply want the business and move ahead without following  through, costing the patient more then they were told.  I don't believe they ever submitted or waited for the insurance to be reflected.  If there was a negative star that is what I would  give this poorly run business.

This little shop caught my eye as I left Trader Joe's, so I had to check it out. It was really quiet when I went in, which was nice. 

Coffee was prepared quickly and tasted delicious. I took it to go, but there are a couple tables inside and out. 

The menu looked to be full of lots of different drinks, but I stuck with something in my comfort zone this time. Maybe I'll branch out next time!

Steve was GREAT. We are new to the area from out of state. We needed to change our policy. Steve guided us through the entire process. We were able to increase our coverage for vehicles, add life insurance, home owners insurance, and payments are still lower than what we were paying for just auto insurance alone.  Thanks again!

Not very much to say, it is a Walmart and operates the same as most other ones. I will say the setup of this Walmart is preferable to other locations and it seems to be cleaner than other Walmart locations. Also, the employees are friendly. I have visited this location dozens of times.

We always enjoy our stays at My Place when we travel across the country. They have  the most comfortable pillows and beds, and some of the softest sheets. I have to admit that I'm a snob when it comes to hotels and this place exceeds my standards. It sits directly across the street from the Village shopping center  which offers awesome stores and places to eat. However, this location was not as conveniently located off the interstate as most other My Place hotels. The parking lot could not accommodate for our truck/trailer like other My Place hotels. No big deal- we were able to parallel park on the side of the building but just something to be aware of.

Not impressed.  I took my daughter there for a pedicure right after they opened and it was fine.  Not horrible, not fabulous but fine.  I went back in about a month ago (on a Saturday) to get a full set of acrylics an a pedicure for my daughter and they were rushed (I didn't have an appointment) and it took two hours.  Her polish began chipping after a week (I'm used to polish on pedicures lasting over a month).  When he trimmed my nails, he almost cut the end of my finger (I pulled back and he told me to relax... yeah right).  He applied the nails then sent me to someone else for filing.  It was the worst file job I've ever had.  I gave them one more chance.  I went in for a fill, with an appointment, mid week.  While he seemed surprised that he had applied the nails (yes, they were that bad), he didn't do much better.  He nicked me several times while filing and not they're all lifting. Also, he charged me for a French manicure ($5 extra) when the tips were not touched up.  All he did was apply a clear coat.  I love the location as it's perfect for me from work and home but I will never go back.  I also question the cleanliness.  It doesn't feel clean and I'm sure the files that he 'nicked' me with were not sanitized from the last person.  Gross...

Thanks to Yelp we found this cool bar while trying to kill some time. Super friendly service, great beer selection, fun atmosphere and yummy pub food. We have been back a second time and had just as great of service. They also serve sushi that looked yummy but we haven't tried it yet.

This is a cool restaurant with decent food. The wait staff is friendly and comes around regularly to check on you but never gets a clue that you need more water or soda, because they ask you as they are walking by.
I got the brisket sandwich. It wasn't warm and somewhat chewy. The smoke flavor was very good though.

Terrible service. They sat us in the corner and every time they brought out meat they kept skipping us. We got served one meat within the 45 minutes we were there. The one meat we did get was cold because they came to us last. We asked multiple times when we were going to get served and still got nothing. The manager was disrespectful and was mad at us when we told them we were leaving. They tried to charge us for the one meat we got. I never leave reviews at restaurants even if I have a bad experience but this was the worst one I've ever had.
Great food and service. If they have a wait list, check for space at the bar. That will save a lot of time if you go for Sunday brunch.

I've enjoyed this place for years.  Friendly staff and lots to options to choose from. Always a good time when we go.  Make what you know or venture out and try something new.  The choose is yours.  If you don't like the food here - we'll... it is you!  You made it!

I have tried this restaurant three separate times for breakfast. To be fair I have not tried their other dishes, like burgers Etc. I'm sorry to say that I probably won't be going back. The service is exceptional. All of the servers that I  dealt with were  very friendly and attentive . The problem is is that their food versus price point is not all that great. Out of the three times that I've been there I've had one good meal, had to send one back because the chicken was burnt to the point where I couldn't even cut it with a knife. The third meal was adequate but  could be better . I hope that they read this review and make Corrections.

We came to try the new Irish Pub. True Irish menu     I have had Shepherds pie in many places. Not usually my favorite because the potatoes are usually so bland. The Harps pie was fantastic with the great flavor of the Yukon Golds. We also had the "Boxty and Steak". It was fantastic. The potato pancakes were wonderful with great texture and leeks for extra flavor. The gravy was awesome. I will have either of these dishes again but want to try the whole menu. Good beer selection and a great cocktail menu. My Manhattan was great. We will be back.

After a full day of traveling from the east coast, my first stop was Big Jud's in Meridian. The experience was nothing short of fantastic. A burger can be personal to people and for me these folks do a terrific job.  I enjoyed a bacon double cheeseburger, fries (fresh-cut) and fried pickle spears. Portions are large and quality is high. Based on what I experienced earlier in the week out east, Big Jud's is phenomenal.  If you want a satisfying burger, please give these folks your money as soon as possible. Additionally, the servers in Meridian are on it . . . Drinks are refilled promptly and they know how to serve. This isn't a typical self-serve joint. Five stars from me!

Great food with large portions. My husband and I have split the Club sandwich, Sliders, which were the size of a Wopper Jr., and the Fish fry. Food is always hot, good, and a large portion for you cowboys and lumber jacks! Jukebox is nice for you who like to hear your favorite songs.
My dad and I love coming to Ed's 50s Cafe.  Wonderful servers, yummy food and fun pics on the walls.  I kind of wish they were open for dinner too!
Worst experience! This used to be a regular stop for us before the movies but not anymore. Skimpy portions, cold and old food. Won't be back!

Friends and I had considered going here a few times, but were unsure because of some of the mixed reviews. 
We finally went, as the place we were planning on going was closed. And we were SO glad we finally did go! 
The food was amazing. We couldn't decide what we wanted, so we ordered 3 appetizers and a sushi roll for the three of us, and it was plenty of food. 
We got the Wonton Nachos, Mongolian Flatbread, and Lettuce Wraps. The flavor on everything was amazing. 
I'm not a sushi fan, but my friends said what they got was delicious. 
And the price was very reasonable. 
Our waitress was very attentive, and drinks were refilled immediately. 
We will definitely be going back.

There are two floors, and it seems like they do the mixed drinks upstairs, and  have all the taps downstairs, but you get served anything you want on both floors.  The decoration for both floors is a treat by itself, but downstairs especially feels like... like I'm on some kind of spooky D**ney ride.  Also in the back corner of the downstairs they have a bunch of board games and one of those Rockem Sockem Robot- type boxing thingies.  Cell reception sucks downstairs, so you can concentrate more on food, friends, fun, etc..  Stay upstairs if you just wanna stare at your phone.

Service is super cool, but the guy who works down in the beer cave on most nights is next-level awesome!

I haven't tried the bar food yet.  Only the sushi.  Usually I'll get some miso soup, and one roll that I more or less pick at random, and that plus a bunch of beer will do it for me.  These rolls... good grief... if it's your first time, start with just one.  They're huge, and they're all the over-the-top with sauces, and typically more fishy on top.  If you dip most of them in soy, you should be slapped.  They serve nigiri as well.  Oh, and the pot-stickers.  They're the best I've had in memory, but that tangy sauce... I've had to restrain myself from just drinking it... don't judge.

Easily my current favorite place to be on my days off!

They charge you to print UPS labels which is already a cash grab since they get a commission per package they accept. The overkill is that it you email them a label they charge a $1 documentary service fee on top of the printing charge. It's sad that you can print UPS labels cheaper at FedEx Office cheaper than The UPS Store. So I guess that and a Dropbox is how I'll deal with UPS returns going forward. 

These stores are franchises so it's a willing decision from the owners. Not all UPS stores do this.

This place does not even pay their stylists a minimum wage. A stylist could work a 10 hr shift and make absolutely zero take home pay even if they were there and ready all day. The manager is very inexperienced and schedules way too many girls on at once. Spend the time and drive a little further to great clips or sport clips where they actually pay their stylists a guaranteed wage.

I love the Village and what they are presenting. What I don't like is being gouged for eating and drinking.  Typically we'll eat at home prior to going to the Village or eat on the way to the Village. Village Coffee changed that perception for me today. We were attending the Grito de Delores Mexican Independence Day festival from 4:00 to 8:00pm.  My wife and daughter are fanatic coffee drinkers and I saw that Village coffee was offering a discount on their Mexican Mocha. I walked up to the very friendly cashier and she asked me if I wanted hot, Iced, or Frozen. I ordered a hot and an iced. I used the Square payment that is typical in the businesses that are not sit down types in the Village and waited.  The coffees were ready in a Mexican Jumping Bean Minute and I salsa'ed my way back to the counter. I noticed a small smooth rock on each of the lids and haphazardly thought it was to keep the coffees in place. Like a typical gringo, I placed them on the counter.  The lady told me that not to leave them behind as they are the jewel of the drink. Dumbfounded I had to ask what they were. She pulled me in close to whisper in my ear like we were day traders outside of Wall Street's Stock Exchange, " Those are chocolate covered coffee beans"  I generated an Ohhhhhhhh and then pleasantly thanked her and smiled. I passed the drinks to the girls and then said, " Try these first."  They looked puzzled but with a trusting leap of faith they popped the chocolate drenched treats into their mouths and raved about it for hours afterwards. This is a perfectly nice and affordable coffee shop  that is exactly what the Village needs to keep me and others enjoying the sights and sounds.

Went here for a mani pedi before a wedding and was less than impressed with the manners of the employee who helped us. She spoke very good English, but was rude and made it clear that she didn't care about doing a good job on our manis.  Even after I pointed out spots that needed cleaning up she didn't do it and went to start someone else's nails.  AND less than a week later it's all chipping off and looks even worse. 

Look elsewhere to get your nails done!

A bit delayed in my review (it was from late summer).  A newish property, right off the highway making access easy.
Great staff and property, low frills, utilitarian, with a bit of fun - the vibrant color décor adds to the image as the pool table, couches, pool, and other "fun" stuff.
Rooms have a European feel, a bit tight, but everything has a place and purpose.
Breakfast decent, gym great with enough dumbbells and cardio equipment to exercise for a day or two.
When requesting a room, ask for one NOT facing the road. Road noise does get a bit pronounced.
A great, affordable property - just what's needed for a good night's rest.

Best pizza  I have ever had!. Sauce and crust are the best!!
Every time we drive to see our son in Seattle we always plan on stoping in the Boise area to  treat our self's at Louie's!. First went to Louies in the 80's on our Ski vacations to Sun Valley.
The food  is  awesome  and the pizza is the best. Service is okay  and 
always so nice to see the Mallane family working their!!
I brought my wedding dress in for alterations and couldn't be more pleased! They were quick, reasonably priced and did quality work. So happy with my dress and that I found my new tailor.
Good drinks but the boba isn't made right :/ boba should be chewy and soft not hard. It's either over cooked or left out for too long.

Nestled right in the middle of old Town Meridian is an establishment every Meridian resident should frequent. A magical burger shack providing mouth watering gut busting 'merica between two buns.  The Hungry Onion. 

Over the past year or so it appears things have changed slightly (see my updated menu pic). This was my first time here but I have had an eye on it for some time. They closed and have reopened and I'm sure glad they did because the entire family gave it two thumbs up. 

The cheeseburgers are exactly what you want from an authentically dated drive in, juicy patty off the flat top, creamy American cheese, burger dressing, and all on a properly steamy sesame seed bun. The onion rings are great, thick and crispy, and they give you a very generous portion with your choice of fry or tots in every combo. I am also loving the menu. Everything on it is what you want with nothing you don't. It's simplistic enough for a first timer to know what you want without holding things up, while having just a big enough spread to want to come back and try a few things...there is something for everyone, even without a kids menu. 

It's places like this that keep our community going and support our local foodies to keep on keepin' on. These are the kind of joints you want to see survive, thrive, and get behind. I'm lovin what you are doing here Hungry Onion. Keep it up and we will keep driving in and spreading the word. If you are in the mood for a burger skip the chain establishment cruise into Hungry Onion and eat up Boise.

By far the best place to get your gaming on. Great staff and product selection. Most other game stories in town will only have a few items for RPGs or board games, mostly serving to collectable card markets. P.F. has a great RPG selection and all the expansions for your board games. A great place to geek out.

Excellent hotel- great value, very friendly staff and a real stove. There are many restaurants (including dine-in) within walking distance or a short drive away if you're not planning to cook  They even supply dishwashing soap and paper towel (though not cutlery.) Spacious room with comfortable bed. The only thing missing was hand lotion. Otherwise perfect choice if you're spending time in Boise.

Great food and great service. The AYCE is nice considering it isn't cheap at $50 a person. Their mixed drinks and wine selection are also great. We had our company Christmas party here and everyone really enjoyed it. Also, their dessert selection is amazing! Highly recommend the chocolate cake.

Jeff, have been doing my taxes for over 10 years now and every single year I've always had a refund. He is very friendly and will do all what he can to help you get a refund. I would HIGHLY recommend him to anyone who needs his services. You won't be disappointed. Thank you, Jeff for all the years you've helped me and we'll continue to be my tax guy and my friend.

After driving 2600 miles to Boise from Florida we chose Biscuit & Hogs in Meridian (20 min drive for us) to begin our first day exploring Boise. We are so happy we did. 
        We spoke to the friendly hostess, then decided to sit at the bar (always my preference) The wait time was 20 minutes, always a good sign that guests want to wait) We were promptly greeted by the beautiful, friendly bartender, Kendra. We advised her that we were not in any hurry....as I was too busy gazing around at this unique cafe. 
     As the bar seating filled up, we ordered drinks (see photos) then greeted by another staff member asking if we had questions as he introduced us to the Chambong! Such an interesting concept for $2! Of course we HAD to try it! So fun & inventive! A must try, btw.
  Our food arrived...wow! Hot & Huge portions!   (We were warned by the handsome gentlemen behind the bar) We watched as he helped out the well as tickets were rolling in, the flow of the restaurant staff was easy going & on point! I mean, seating at the bar is great for people watching lol I noticed many to go orders ready for pickup (also a great sign)
   To go boxes were requested and also another round of Chambongs to end our brunch. Come to find out , the gentleman behind the bar, helping out on well and talking with the staff was the owner, Boomer. Pleasantly surprised and excited to find out he opened this cafe 4 months ago! During covid! Impressed I had to tell him Congratulations! 
    Ps. Btw this is the longest review I've ever written. Having worked in every single position in the restaurant business from prep to Manager....I'm very appreciative (and more critical) than most and always vocal , extending appreciation as much as possible. 
    If you've had any previous hiccups in the past 4 months (as all newly opened establishments have) I urge you to give them another try.  10/10 and I will be back often as I'm here only for the month of October.  
     It's always a pleasure to support local restaurateurs and staff. 
     Thank you Kendra! And again congratulations, Boomer! We will be back and bring friends !

Great wood fired pizza! Good selection on toppings, which are very fresh. They even offer a sweet topping pizza. Taste was delicious. The owner was very pleasant and welcoming. Will definitely come back!!

I had been to this nail salon once before, so when I wasn't able to get into the salon that I normally go to, I figured Q Nail and Spa would be a good substitute.  Haha.

I walked in and it was very busy... Granted, it was a Saturday afternoon.  But I expected to be greeted by one of the employees when I walked in.  After several seconds standing up front, one of the nail techs finally acknowledged me while barely lifting her head.  I asked her if they had time for a full set, and she said there would be a wait.  I sat down in a chair without being acknowledged for at least 20-25 minutes.  Again, it was busy, I get that.  I expected a wait.  But no one even came over to tell me how long the wait would be or to let me know that they knew I was waiting and that they would be with me as soon as possible.  I was beginning to wonder if they even knew I was waiting.  

Then a man peaked his head from behind a plant and told me to come over.  I sat down and told him I had a picture on my phone of what I wanted my nails to look like.  Very simple and short, nude color.  He said, "short and square?" I said yes, that I worked on a computer all day so I need to keep my nails fairly short.  He looked at my hands for a minute and said that I didn't need tips because I wanted my nails short.  I thought, ok, he's the professional, he knows what he's doing.  He started putting the acrylic over my natural nails and even though I was a little confused, I let him keep doing what he was doing.  He worked fast, and it shows in his work.  My nails are all different shapes, certainly not the shape or length I wanted, in fact they're so short that my natural nails are a tiny bit longer than the acrylic on at least two of my fingers.  I wanted nails to lengthen my fingers but these "nails" he gave me make my fingers look stubby.  Honestly the nails look like Chiklets.  Not attractive.  I had a picture of exactly what I wanted my nails to look like, how could he get this so wrong?  I feel like he was in a bad mood and he didn't care about the quality of work he was doing.  But, since I hate confrontation and I'm a pushover, I said nothing.  Even though I was angry that I was paying good money for this shoddy manicure, I kept quiet.  I paid and left, chalking it up to a bad experience.  

Fast forward to this morning when I was getting ready for work, I noticed a rather large air bubble on my thumb nail (I had gel nail polish put on).  A while later the air bubble popped and so now I have a hole almost as big as my whole thumb nail.  I first thought about going back to have them fix it, but I think I'll go to the salon I originally wanted to go to and have them completely redo my nails.  Highly disappointed.  I

Kidz Again is a large kids consignment store with great prices and a good selection. You can especially find clothing for younger children here, 0-9 months they have tons of onsies and seasonal outfits. The older the children's clothing the more sparse the selection is. 

I traded in a few things, brought in 3 big bags and the only wanted about 10 items and I got a whopping $8 for it as store credit. I could've made more selling them on Facebook so I wasn't super impressed with the trade-in, but I guess the have to make money?

I believe they also have maternity clothes and some toys. A great place to look if you're looking deals on clothing for young children.

Worst Service I've ever received!!! We ended up having to walk out after over an hour of not receiving food. Other table around us had the same compliants. The manager couldn't even account for where our order was. No apologies or anything. The hostess was rude when we put our name on the list for waiting. Then she began seating others that came in after us because the iPad broke and lost ALL the waiting list. Once we finally got seated after checking in and watching others who came in way after us get seated first it took about 15 minutes to get the high chair my sister had requested that the random server didn't want to bring because she didn't think we needed it, but we did. The manager took about another 25 minutes to get my sisters hot chocolate. All while we were waiting for our meals to come with a 5 year old kiddo who "got a headache" from waiting so long for her food because the kitchen had no idea where our order was. We had to get up to get coffee refills, from your manager. Hunt down our order which we NEVER received. The other frustrating fact is that you were serving your take outs and grub hub leaving most of the restaurant waiting for food. Not only that but tables who sat randomly after us were getting food before us while a few of us other tables were waiting forever. We had already been waiting over an HOUR with nothing... no one checked in or apologized. I know it was busy but it wasn't busy enough to be treated this horrible and have the worst customer service ever! HORRIBLE way to bring in 2020. This was a goodbye breakfast that my family so kindly got our family together before me and my spouse flew back to Denver after not seeing my family for 2.5 years and your restaurant ruined our morning and made us extremely late. We ended up not even getting breakfast before our flight. The fact that no one checked in, our order was clearly lost and NO ONE took responsibility, NO ONE apologized... We finally walked out with no food because your MANAGER WOULDN'T TELL US WHERE OUR ORDER WAS. All your people just shrugged it off just like I'm sure you'll do with this review. Horrible! If you are thinking of trying this place.... Save your self the trip don't go to this place!!!  We'll never go again when visiting. Serioulsy no excuses for today, not 1!!

My second stay here in Meridian. My brother offered to put me up at his home, but we like staying here. So close to everything and my buddy Don Bailey always books our stay here. The rooms are nice and have refrigerator's, microwave, toasters, iron & ironing boards, hair dryers, nice big screen tv's, clean beds, and quiet rooms, with excellent A/C. The staff are very nice and friendly offering any assistance you might need. Reasonably priced, because we usually stay at least a week at a time. We will definetly be coming back soon. Thanks, Jas.

Last night was our 9th visit to this new store since it opened a short time ago. Every single time, we have had the worst possible customer service. I'm not entirely sure why we keep returning for the 'abuse'... ugh. Last night we experienced the only sandwich-making line employee continue what was clearly a  personal convo for at the very least, 6-7 minutes while we waited to order. The other employee, (wearing a low visor over his long hair that covered his entire face) there immediately turned his back on us when we walked in and pretended to be doing something on the grill. We were the only two customers in the store at that moment so it would have been pretty easy to acknowledge us and be nice. The dining room is closed again and a solid row of chairs is pushed up against the order window line so that customers now have to semi-yell their orders to the sandwich maker. We were told that the reason for the closed dining room was that "we've had a ton of complaints from guests who were in the order line, that the people eating their meals at the tables do not have a mask on." Yup, imagine NOT WEARING A MASK WHILE ACTUALLY EATING ~ gasp!! Our one 8" sandwich order was ready after no less than 15 minutes... the sandwich maker begrudgingly slammed the meats into the slicer, rolled his eyes when I asked for condiments on the side, and angrily tossed the sandwich into a paper bag, and walked away without saying another word. The cashier couldn't have cared less that we were there either and definitely acted as if we were inconveniencing her. Another epically disappointing Jersey Mike's 'customer service' experience... dismal.

If I could give 0 stars I would, but that's not an option so let's keep things rolling  .
We shop here regularly and don't usually have any issues or complaints .
Decided to use curbside pickup for a change for the convenience and that was a huge mistake .  I placed my order at 8:30 am for a same day pick up slot for 6-7 pm . It's after work on the way home , why not. It's 6pm and I get notified my order is delayed . There is no email saying how long or why but just that's it delayed . 7pm comes around and I decide to call the store. No one answers the pickup extension or the associate extension. I legit called at least 8 times to get a new pick up quote in hopes of not having to cancel . I call Walmart help center and they can't get ahold of anyone either . Well, it's now 7:45 and we have no clue of when our order will be ready so we Cancel and go get the grocery's ourself, no big deal , just puts a damper in the evening . Well of course when we go in, there's a gal in front of self checkout on her phone leaning on a crate, she should probably monitoring the sled check out customers right ? Lol . Why is she not helping pull orders that are delayed  ?? I see one man rushing around frantically attempting to fill 8+ orders on a cart and I asked how backed up he was . The time was 1.5 hours and he wasn't up for conversations as he was so behind  .. We keep shopping , making our way to the back of the store , and of course some more employees standing around talking ( 3 to be exact ) .. Why aren't these employees helping there coworkers who are busting there butt for curbside orders ?? Where is the team work? Why isn't the manager directing there employees to at least answer the phone and respond to there customers who are wondering where there groceries are. Such a shame, Walmart is worth 405 billion dollars and they can't have decent team oriented people working for them. Get it together .

We stopped in for lunch yesterday.  Though the breakfast menu was tempting, I decided on the "Bacon Bacon Burger."  Holy Hannah!  It was delicious.  Ok, it was HUGE too! 

The staff was friendly and our experience was exceptional.  I look forward to going back.

This place is great, we have been there three times. It's worth checking out for a date night or just some R&R . The owner is sweet and friendly and makes you feel like a welcome guest. Food portions are small, but the service is 5 star and we will return

Struggle between 2 and 3 stars on this. The wait staff moved this to a 3 due to their very friendly and attentive service. The food though was overpriced and mediocre. For what we paid we could have had an amazing 5 star meal elsewhere. My family has said they don't care to go back.

Stopped in and enjoyed Happy Hour prices on a Saturday evening.  About half occupied, all staff were safely behind masks & and very pleasant, friendly. 
We both liked the frozen Mai Thai, the Asian Nachos and Lettuce wraps.  Will be back 
Want to try the Crab Wontons.

We have used Kim with Pet Cutz since moving to CA, she's done both our Sheltie and our poodle.  She is amazing, not only as a groomer but a person.  I am so sad to know she is leaving the area although I'm happy for her.  She's the kind of person and groomer everyone would wish for their fur babies.  She also is kind, she is even helping us locate a groomer to step in.  Good luck Kim - you will be missed.
Sandwiches aren't great. Service is terrible. Not worth the money. Buy local. This is a chain and not a good one. A sub below.

I have been going here for years and normally they are very good.  HOWEVER, my recent visit was very disappointing.  I got the deluxe manicure with Gel polish.  It looked ok upon leaving but my polish started chipping off after one week. GEL polish usually lasts at least a month or more.   I had to take my polish off after one week and it came off very easily with just normal polish remover.  This does not occur with GEL polish.  I am very disappointment.  I can tell you I got a red #477 and it was not GEL polish.  Yet I was charged extra for gel polish.  Don't think I will be back.  There are too many places with excellent pedicures and not rip you off.  

Beckie Wilson

Most unethical business I have ever worked with. In April, one of their sales reps came to my door and solicited one of their promotions.  After about a 10-15 discussion, I was informed that this promotion does not obligate me to future services - I specifically asked him because I did not want to be locked into a regular service.  I agreed to the one-time application promotion for $120 and I was told that my signature was for such.  I recently received a text message informing me that someone was coming out to spray.  I called the office and they informed me that I signed up for a 5-spray minimum and was obligated to the contract I signed.  Or I could pay $120 to cancel.  The lady I spoke with over the phone was extremely rude and gave me no recourse, even after I explained to her of her shady sales person tactic.  The rep flat out lied to me.  She told me I would be sent to collections if I didn't pay.  They decided to charge my card $120 for canceling even after I told them to NOT charge me and to send me to collections if need be.  Owners aren't available and the woman on the phone told me she was the only person I could talk to.  DO NOT do business with this shady company!!!  Another important note - when I signed the contract back in April, it was on an iPad and it only showed a signature line so it was impossible to really know what I was signing.

I was in your store on Tuesday. It's not very customer friendly but I like your inventory and prices. A lady named Samantha was very rude to me when I asked her (very nicely) if she could open one of the doors to the fitting rooms. She was upset about something, didn't answer me, then turned around and walked towards the fitting rooms. After opening a door for me, I smiled and thanked her. She said nothing and just walked away. I will not go back to this store. They are much nicer at the Goodwill store in Eagle, Idaho. They are customer friendly there and nice to the customers.

I have only had the bubble tea here a couple times- both times it was very good, boba was just right- I only wish they offered milk teas- I was told they don't have that which was weird since they have milk from making espresso coffees.

Well they were amazing but I had a bad reaction to the medication they put me on for the dental anxiety that I have due to Terry riley dentistry and had a bad reaction at the end of my last appointment
I dont remember what happened and now they wont let me come back for a second chance. I thought the place and people were so kind at the time but now I feel because of my disability that I have I am being thrown out without a way to show I'm not that kind of person. Figured I would tell everyone if you have a reaction to a new medication that is to sedate you be careful on what you do because it can be unforgiving when you have a mistake happen. I just wish they would give me another chance. Heck after my appointment for my filling on my tooth it's been bugging me and they won't even see me to check out why it hurts. Not right at all. I also had more extensive work that needs to be done that will cost me a lot. I feel that while I was sedated the team made the pain worse on the teeth that need the extra work and the one tooth with the filling they did before the deep cleaning that I was sedated for and I was denied a support person from my family to insure i would be ok and nothing would happen.
Also while I was sedated they allowed me to leave with no one there to pick me up. I could have been hit by a car or taken by someone I didnt know over this. They are not allowed by law to allow me to leave under sedation of the medication I was on. I will be looking into what can be done over that..
I had the chicken and biscuits and it was amazing!! Highly recommend if you are passing through or live in the area.
Mike was very timely in his responses. He has a lot to offer. We weren't sure if we were going to buy or rent and he was there to help with either decision!
I never add reviews, but the workers are rude and condescending. Won't be going there ever again.

I visited Friday night. Happy Hour = half liter of house wine for $5! Nice! Then I had Artichoke Chicken Fettucine. Very tasty,  a rich cream sauce, garlicky but not overly do. Try their minestrone...the veggies are not cooked to death and it's very tasty. Service was good, food has good value. Louie's was packed so you know a lot of locals like it. Try it!
Well this place was great. All the food was absolutely delicious.  Server Gloria was great and friendly. I would come back. Really clean. Fresh food. Good portions.
Great pricing and amazing turn around time, the young man who works there is smart and is a glimmer of hope for a new generations of the upcoming work force,

The lady at the counter kept trying to figure out if I was part of some delivery service called "Grubhub" she was apprehensive to take my payment at first and made me very uncomfortable. This is my first time trying the food and it makes me not want to come back.

I first happened upon Urban Fox last year, as it was the location of a Yelp Event.  I'm so glad I attended, as it afforded be the opportunity to try a multitude of menu items and confirm it was a business worth putting on rotation.  Sometimes us consumers hesitate from breaking the norm, because we are uncertain of what we don't know. 

I am not a coffee drinker, so I cannot speak to the taste, pricing, quality of these items.

What I can speak to is the Boba and let me just tell you it is delish! They have a variety of options for creating your Boba,  so if you are adventurous you could certainly have a new combination each time you come. 

My favorite to date is the coconut Boba. So refreshing, not too sweet and distinctive coconut flavor.

The staff is always extremely friendly and service has always been fast. I don't think I've ever been, when the owner wasn't present; which I appreciate. To me it shows one is vested in their business, their customers and their employees.

Urban Fox is my go-to treat to myself.  And with Trader Joe's sharing the parking lot, how could you go wrong with a little Boba and a little shopping?

P.S. Try their milk toast dessert. Its absolutely not what you think. (In a good way!) :)

Their getting 1 star because 0 stars isn't available. I contracted with 4 Seasons pest control and pre-paid for 5 services. I discovered 4 Seasons was acquired by this company. I emailed them stating I had only (to this date) received 2 of the 5 services. I asked for an immediate service and a refund on the 2 missed services. NO RESPONSE.

Yesterday, without a courtesy call, a person was at my home and he was lucky that my Doberman guard dog was in the house. I only know the person was here as I found a packet on my front door stating he had sprayed.  Do not use this company under any circumstances....
Restaurant is super clean with very yummy burgers! I would definitely recommend Big Judds for a burger crave!

The service was outstanding....and it was pretty busy!  I had the intense desire to call my waitress "Flo" maybe because it is that kind of old fashioned  place or because she was fun loving!

Food pretty good, traditional diner style etc.  My mother-in-law (almost 88) loved it and her "Healthy Meal" with grilled chicken breast, sliced tomato, hard-boiled egg & fruit! Right up her alley and enough for 2 meals for her!  My husband had the Bopper Burger with tater tots also pretty good. I had the Denver omelet...the most fresh green bell peppers EVER! PLENTY of cheese too. 

Was nice seeing the waitstaff greet TONS of "regulars" as well.  Parking a little obnoxious as it is tucked around the corner but ok!  We'll be back!

I chose this facility since they were opened locally and have a surgical center all together...a plus with aging parents who don't want to go to the doctor!

Facility was centrally located across the street from St Lukes in Meridian. Very nice and good parking close to the building. Even the "check in staff" vet friendly and took note of a closer seat for my struggling senior!

Dr Fredriksson was very pleasant and made my almost 90 year old family member feel at ease.  Talked to HER and assured her calmly and pleasantly.  

The only negative....when the nurse showed my mother the rest room for a urine sample, I was surprised to see garbage on the floor (wrappers etc) and even mentioned it,  the nurse shrugged it off.  It was the ONLY negative but surprised at the "that's below my job attitude".

The rest of the care (which was what mattered) was GREAT!

My boyfriend and I have been here before and the first time was nothing but amazing! However, when we went this last time it was rough. Our server is the reason we are giving 3 starts. However, the kitchen messed my boyfriends meal up 3 times and when it was brought back to the table the 3rd time, the solution to the problem was "can you just scrape it off". That is not professional at all and, not that I'm ever one to even expect discounts, we got nothing off the bill or merely a sorry from her... just scrape it off. Disappointed because I really do like this place but most likely won't be coming back for a while.
These people are like family... they are caring and trustworthy and the best groomers I have used. Ever.

Marco is always super friendly and we are satisfied with the service they do. Many of our neighbors and friends have chosen senske as well and appear to be satisfied. We've looked into other places to save money but senske is the most reliable and efficent company which keeps us loyal customers.

Urban fox has the best Boba I have ever had. I have tried to venture out and try other Boba companies in the valley and it just doesn't compare. The flavor of the Boba itself is my favorite overall the others. I order the Honeydew with extra ice!

Would give one more star if not for their arrogant, pompous owner.  The cleaning ladies are good and house would always look clean; but they prefer to use their own products which leaves none of that 'clean house smell' when they are finished. And the owners are quite regimented with how they schedule your cleaning; it's not the customers choice but theirs. We are now using another cleaning source; excellent work ethic, 1/3 less the cost per cleaning and they work with our schedule, not theirs.

Same here for the first time and I thought out was great. Nothing fancy but the staff were all very nice, three place was clean and the seats were comfortable.

I like that you get to put your own butter on your popcorn (I never seem to get a enough). 1 large popcorn, 1 medium drink and a bag of Raisinetts will set you back $21ouch, but that is theater life.

I do like the simplicity of this theater and will definitely be back.

What an amazing experience. Our 13 1/2 year old Chihuahua has some anxiety about being away or going with anyone else... not the case with Grooming Tails! Our girl was more than happy to go get groomed tail wagging there and back! Not only was she smiling happy, but she was jumping on the owner for more loves!! I couldn't be more pleased to recommend Grooming Tails to anyone whose looking for a trustworthy groomer.

I really like this nail spa. Everyone is nice and the various people who've done my nails all do a great job. My nails are always clean, smooth, and shaped well. Today I had an appt that began at 1:57pm and was literally out the door at 2:16. And my nails were perfect!

The food was good, had a chicken/rice bowl, it wasn't fast food, had to wait a while. This is during Covid, so social distancing, masks, but employee was friendly. Place was clean. I just waited a little too long.

A sibling of the Sunrise Cafe .. the 4 of us decided to belly up to the Biscuit and Hog bar this past week .. before going we 1st googled the menu (not easy to find for good reason) and got a good feel for pricing - higher than we are used to and glad we took this step.  Most all of the B-bast meals are 10-15 dollars (a few over) a bit steep in out of pocket for the hard working Boiseite.  After taking out a financial loan we dropped in around 10A .. first impressions were it seemed larger in person than on-line with an industrial decor look, this was OK but as the room filled with customers it was clear that it had an echo issue so a bit loud.  Seating was easy to get and the server was tops.
Since we previewed the menu we had a pretty clear picture of the meal selection - I went for the Chicken & A Waffle .. my wife did the pancake breakfast, and of course COFFEE for us both.  
The Chicken (deep fried breast patty - sorry no real chunk of chicken here), Egg and Waffle was OK, nothing spectacular but certainly easy to consume along with the sides of maple syrup and hot sweet sauce. Portion could have been larger for the $12.50 price tag.  My wife's pancakes were "ginormus" - a double stack that had "take me home if you are smart," written all over it.  The cakes came with eggs which were cooked well and the side of bacon was good and coming in at $11.50 was more in line for what you got.  The coffee coming in a $3 each was a bit high .. all in all worth the stop, is it at the top of my Boise breakfast list - nope.

Menu link with prices -  https://www.ubereats.com/boise/food-delivery/biscuit-%26-hogs-west/xtzQdI6jS-CkAIYrpI2-rA

When requested, the owner refused to send his staff in masks. He also refuses to screen his staff for COVID because "they are essential". I work in a hospital, I'm essential. I wear a mask every day and I'm am screened every time I enter the building. Check out the owner's Facebook page. He has multiple posts regarding the current political climate, including how masks are "mind control devices". 

Not interested in supporting a company who is unwilling to take care of the community they live in and "serve". Very sad. 

Otherwise, cleaning was pretty basic. Missed many things and we found we often cleaned after they left. Simple things like wiping the top of the microwave.

Had the chicken and biscuits. Great gravy covered it all. Love that they serve breakfast all day and have a full bar. 
Nice server very attentive.

My son and I were looking for a good lunch spot and this place was recommended! It was a Monday so it wasn't too crowded and the place had plenty of parking. My son was stoked on the games offered to keep him busy, they had tetris and all kinds of fun little electronic games as well as others!

We were shown to a table right away and started scanning the menu. I liked how there were a lot of different options between breakfast and lunch items. My son decided on the kids pancake and I ordered the turkey sandwich. Couldn't tell if our waitress was new or what but it took a bit for our order to get taken and our food delivered. Another waitress even checked up making sure our order was taken! 

My sandwich was a good, a bit dry but good. The star of the show was my son's pancake! It was like a medium pizza! Loved the crunchy outside and fluffy inside. The syrup was delicious and the bacon....SO GOOD!! Took a bit to get our check, another waitress took it to process (bless them!)

We'll definitely be back, there are a few other items I want to try on their menu and I just love their bacon! Hahaha Hopefully we don't get the same waitress!

Ling Louie "was"  one of my favorite places to dine.  

Now I'm going to add that - I'm not completely giving up on this restaurant.....but today's lunch experience was definitely sub-par.  

Where to start? Well our rice bowls were more like soup bowls.  I ordered the brown rice with my chicken dish.  I had to ask the waitress for more rice because it simply was too mushy and had way too much sauce.  She gave me white rice instead.  My sister had to trade hers in for a dish  less spicy.  (That one is on her) We then reordered a dish that had chicken, pineapple, rice with a egg on top.  What came?  A barely cooked egg with shrimp instead of chicken.  They had taken my sisters fork from the first plate  so we had to flag down the very busy waitress to get eating utensils.
The manager did come by half way - to check on us.  So honestly he did try.  The waitress was nice enough - but could benefit by having more training and additional help.  

This was not the service or attention to details that I'm use to. 

I realize post Covid - it has been difficult for restaurants to staff.  It is my hope that training, staffing and customer service gets top priority.

Stopped in for the night when we were on a road trip from California to Coeur d'Alene, ID. And I was so impressed with everything the hotel had to offer. I didn't make a reservation since I was unsure if we were going to stop and sleep or continue through the night. 

When I stopped to ask for availability the gentleman at the front desk was so nice. After we checked in he offered us a bottle of water which was chilled and pointed us in the direction of the elevator. When we arrive to our room the door was sealed with sticker showing the room was cleaned and disinfected with Lysol which gave me peace of mind. 

The bed and the pillows are so comfy. I have never felt a hotel bed so comfortable before. I have decided in my journeys that I would love to stay in any TRU hotel again.

This is a family favorite, something for everyone. My son loves the kids bento box because he gets to choose what goes into each compartment, my daughter is a fan of the sushi and my husband and I like the asian fusion dishes, especially the Evil Princess and Orange Crispy Spinach Scallops. Consistently great service!

Wow what a great experience. My generator was hard to start. Took it to Camping world. new plug, new filter. $$$$$. Got it home. Wouldn't start with 5 try's. John comes out from Gem State. Choke was stuck open. Hit the starter. Fired right up. I was expecting $100 service fee. No charge. I was shocked. He took the time to show me how to unstick the choke if it hangs up again. I heard John was good now I know it's true!!

We had seen such amazing reviews for this place and decided to give it a try. We stopped in and ordered breakfast to-go and I write this with a complete understanding that to-go is never as good as dine in. We ordered three breakfasts and the accompanying sides and waited for the order. About 20 minutes later, order in hand, I departed for home. When we started unboxing our meals, we realized a number of items were missing, but since we were already home, that's what we had. We started eating only to find that the food was fairly cold, but still for the price we paid, we ate our breakfast. None of us were all that impressed, and the meals did not live up to the hype. The items were hastily boxed and lacked any real appeal when you opened your order. In general, missing items, cold food and fairly expensive prices will be what doesn't make us a repeat customer.

However, I will say the potato side we did get was amazing and the service at the hostess stand was also great. The portions were also pretty good sized too. Maybe dine in would yield better results, but to-go is not a winner here...

My friend and I went here on a Monday around 12:00. The waiter was attentive and courteous. We both ordered the Pad Thai with shrimp and chicken. The chicken pieces were really dry and eachof us only had 3 pieces of shrimp in each of our bowls.   The sauce is really hard to explain.    Very acidic and sour and bitter. I could have used something to counterbalance the vinegar taste. I have had a ton of pad Thai and this is by far the worst. The only saving grace for this meal was the glass of Chardonnay. I will not come back

We switched to Dr.Loveland after a poor experience with our children's prior doctor. He is so kind and patient. I've never felt "dumb" when asking all my worried mom questions. He is respectful and NEVER condescending, which many doctors tend to be.  He's never rushed and always listens to my opinion.  It also doesn't take forever to get an appointment. We also love his nurses.
We loved him so much that we drove an hour to his old office. Glad he switched locations! 
PS his brother is an awesome pediatric dentist!

Fast Alterations has done several different alterations for me.  They did a nice job hemming my dress pants and jeans.  I also had a swimsuit which needed the skirt re-shaped.  I took in a picture from a magazine, and they were able to create exactly what I wanted.  I was happy with each job they did and felt the prices were reasonable.  They really are fast!  I have not had to wait more than two days for any of the items.  The owner speaks English as her second language, and it is best to take your clothing items in and talk to her in person.  

Another service offered is sewing on Boy Scout emblems on uniform shirts.  One mom I spoke with was very happy with how they did that.
The best sandwiches ever!! Plus Mallaurie and Janee are the best!! Fast Friendly service and made with love
Tasted like every other Asian cuisine restaurant. Nothing special. I had the veggie lo mein and was charged the full price even though there was no protein on my dish. The flavor was one-dimensional.

We were really looking to have a great experience- that just wasn't the case. The food was awful and everything had an odd taste I can't explain. Perhaps they need to clean the wok?! 
The pot stickers were amazing though! That's a positive! 
Our waitress wasn't very attentive, I wasn't expecting to fetch my own napkins and silverware for my party nor find someone to refill my husbands water...
We came here for a special occasion and left really disappointed.
Angie at the Pflugerville store is absolutely awesome. I get my haircut done right each and every time. She is professional and always trys to make it right on every visit.

Oh I am so thankful for this place! Amidst all the excitement leading up to my best friends wedding (3 days away) I neglected to try on my bridesmaid dress until a week ago. I tried it on once when it first arrived in the mail a few months ago, but that's it. All that to say, I just realized that my dress is about 4 inches too long - and 2 inches too long with heels. I called Fast Alterations to see how long they thought it would take to fix my dress and they said 2-3 days. PRAISE. All of my friends said the place they took their dresses to would take 2-3 weeks. 

On Monday I dropped in, she pinned my dress to the length I wanted, I handed it over to her and she told me to come back Wednesday or Thursday. Three days later I picked up the dress and she did an excellent job! The hem was made right where we discussed and this process was relatively quick and seamless (catch that pun? hehe) on my end.

My only reason for 4 stars instead of 5 is the price. This minimal alteration cost me $59. Perhaps that isn't steep, but I felt a bit of a sting paying $59 for a simple alteration when the dress itself cost $50. Despite my hesitancy to pay this, overall I'm happy with my experience here. I needed my dress altered quickly, and they certainly lived up to their name!

Enjoy $39 Cleaning, Exam, and X-Rays should have an asterisk at the end.* 

My wife and I saw this advertised and were excited to get a cleaning, it was long overdue. We scheduled our appointments for 1:30 and showed up, My wife right on time, I was 3 minutes late. We sat down and had our paperwork filled out by 1:45. My wife was taken back at 2:00, I followed after her around 2:10. X-Rays were taken, all good. Taken and sat down in a chair and the hygienist came back to do a probe to check out my gums. There were 4 teeth with pocket depths of 5mm( no more than 3mm is what you want) I had moderate gum disease in 4 teeth. The hygienist then leaves to tell the dentist that I have moderate gum disease and that I need $700 worth of cleanings. The dentist came and saw for herself and confirmed this was the case. After 20 minutes of waiting the next person I saw was the receptionist who came back to show me a breakdown of the $700 cleaning I needed. I said that I understood that I needed a special cleaning to get below my gums, however I requested that they could remove the visible plaque build up (which was not where the 5mm pockets were located) from my teeth while I was there, you know, the cleaning I showed up for in the first place. A little annoyed the receptionist left and the dentist showed back up. "What seems to be the problem?" She asks. I explain that I would like the cleaning that was advertised. She emphasized that I needed the $700 cleaning and I agreed with her, but still wanted the visible plaque removed. Hesitantly she, not the hygienist, agreed and did a 10-15 minute cleaning of my teeth that was sub par. By the time she was done it was almost 3:30. So it took almost 2 hours for my xrays, exam, and hardly anything of a cleaning. It seems like they overbooked and weren't very interested in giving me a cleaning at all, its pretty upsetting that I had to convince them to clean my teeth. I was very disappointed in my experience there and would not recommend this dentist office to anyone. I will go elsewhere to get the extensive cleaning that I need to treat the moderate gum disease that I have.
We've been here a few times and the food and the service are both amazing!! Great portion size. We will be returning customers!

Husband and I stopped in Friday before our movie and let me tell you....
The food was great! Our waitress Jamie recommended awesome food! We had the Short Rib and the Beer Can Chicken! So so good. Big portions but we ate it ALL. Best service we have EVER had also. Jamie was working her tail off and was so attentive and friendly. We knew they were busy but she made us enjoy our food so much more! Will be back Wednesday for ladies night!!!

I pass by this place all the time and haven't had the occasion to visit but needed a place to meet a business associate for coffee, so, it worked out.  I had seen photos on Yelp of pretty designs, and I wanted one of those.  

My associate had already ordered her coffee before I got there.  Then I went up to the counter to order mine.  I told the lady that I wanted something sweet, hot, and with a pretty design.  She recommended the board special: red velvet cake drink, and said it tastes just like a red velvet cake with a cream cheese topping.  The sign said it was iced, so I asked if I could get it hot and she said no.  Then why offer that one to me when I want a hot drink?  She wasn't really helping me in my quest to get something hot and sweet, so I just went with the caramel macchiato.

They didn't bring the drinks to us, they kind of just sat there waiting for us to look at them and see that our drinks were ready.  My associate's drink had a little heart on it.  Mine (I asked for a design) had syrup drawn this way and that way - not sure if that's a design?  And, the drink wasn't sweet at all.  I had to add a bunch of sugar packets to it.

The place is big and bright, and there were a few groups of two there meeting; it's pretty quiet.  There was a couch or two with people working on laptops and headphones - very similar to what you see at Starbucks.  The staff hangs out in another room - side office or kitchen, I wasn't sure, and when I wanted some water, I had to wait for someone to come out.  Another patron walked in, waited at the counter for someone to come out, they never did, so he left.

It's your average coffee shop with average prices.

We had our team's Holiday dinner here last night. The food was amazing, the family time was great but the highlight of the evening was Alex. He was very attentive to our group of 16. He made sure we had everything we needed and was charming . Louie's is my go to restaurant for our team events. Tisha always puts my mind as ease and I know everything will go as planned.

This company does not even deserve 1 star! This company built a home next door to mine and in the process they damaged my yard. I have text messages from the Supervisor saying it is their fault and they would fix all damages. It's been months and nothing. They damaged my front yard putting in pipes, they had to tear up my grass and the way they fixed that was throwing in dead sod (probably the pieces they ripped up out of my yard since it has orange spray paint on it) my backyard is ruined from the storm because they did not grade the new house properly and they blocked the drainage ditch in the back. They text us saying they would be fixing it and nothing. My 18 month old can't even play in his yard because of all the mud and damage. I have taken tons of pictures and videos from all the damage and we're about to file a claim against this company because we should not have to pay for the damages caused by this horrible company!!

None of the female employees during my stay were wearing a mask. Last time there was a male employee at the desk and he was wearing a mask the whole time. It made me feel comfortable enough to stay in my return trip. With numbers as high as they are in the United States and especially here in Boise (220,000) and 283 cases today then the highest safety should be taken when dealing with customers. I had to ask several times for masks to be used when handling my food. Otherwise this hotel is very nice for the price.

Busting from Washington state. Just needed a pedicure. My person was nice and took his time with my pedicure. The place is not high class and does not offer all the bells and whistles for pedicure options but it was clean and the staff was amazing.

Atmosphere:
The atmosphere is cozy. A "blast from the past" the decor is outdated, but... I love places like this. I've always had good experience. 

Staff:
The staff was hard-working. We were greeted and seated promptly. Our waitress was a "season pro". She ensured our drinks were refilled, and was speedy about obtaining our order. She didn't necessary make small talk, which was fine by our growling stomachs. 

Food:
The breakfast menu was large, and had a to to chose from. The lunch and dinner had smaller choices. 

I chose the "Bacon Club" and the hubs got "The Turkey Dinner". 

The club was medium in portion. A delightful turkey, ham, Swiss cheese, American cheese, lettuce, and bacon between three slices of white bread with a hint of mayo. The sandwich was divided into four sections making it easy to grasp and eat. The fries are my favorite cuts of fries!
A huge pet peeve is asking for "no tomatoes" and receiving tomatoes! This was the case here too. I also hate the tomato guts left on the sandwich. 

The Turkey dinner was smothered in Poultry gravy. It consisted of turkey, mash potatoes, stuffing, and a dinner roll.  My husband absolutely loved his dinner. It reminded him of K-Mart's cafeteria ( yes, there was once a cafeteria ).



Prices:
Average. About 20 bucks for the both of us. 

Parking:
Parking was horrid. Street parking. There's a very small ( 4 car lot) beside the cafe

Specialities / what "they" are known for:
 
Breakfast food.

Star rating:
I gave them a 3 out of 5. I wanted to give them room for improvement. The food, in my humble opinion, was subpar to any other restaurant. Nothing too special or standout ish... except for the mug club. Btw was stinken awesome. The food, atmosphere, staff were all at a 3 level. I singed a 1/2 Star for the tomato. 1/2 Star for food. 1 Star for parking.


More importantly Would we ever go back? 
Yes! But for something different. My husband, Will continue to get the turkey dinner. It reminds him of his childhood :)

Unfortunately this is the closest UPS store to me. The service is shameful. They are SOOOO SLOW! I was the second person in line and waited 15 minutes to just hand over an Amazon return. Thankfully another employee came out from the back to help, but he wasn't friendly, just said he would help whoever was next, scanned my item and I left. The person being helped in front of me was still not done. It shouldn't take take that long to send a package.
My sister got bacon that looked like it was for dogs. The biscuits and gravy are really good but they give you not enough sides and way too much main meals

This was Ollie's first time here.  He is a 5 month old Maltese/Shih tzu.  We could not be happier!  Jay gave Ollie a great puppy cut and even put a bandana on Ollie.  We will definitely be back to Groomingtails.

Bed bugs! I woke up with over 100 bites on my body and approximately 40 on my neck. The hotel did comp my stay but I have been miserable with the swelling, itching and pain. I had so many bites that I had an allergic reaction which required urgent care.

In the area and saw the soft opening sign...
Tried the Grapefruit & Lemon sparkler-SUPER refreshing! Not too sweet and just right amount of zing! Also...I tried the Milk Tea-Almond and Green Tea. Amazing how filling it is! I had no idea what "boba" was (think large tapioca pearls) and was a little concerned of texture but it is pretty yummy. 

They were giving samples of the strawberry milk..wow- almost like a dessert.

Friendly service... great tastes! The atmosphere is crisp and clean, modern and inviting. Super cute super hero tops to the cups!

Trying the mango next time!

Absolutely the best spot in town.  Took care of my bridesmaids dress emergency.   Thoroughly listen and we're concerned.  Turn around time was spot on.   Not to mention  the price.  This place is professional and very responsive.  Open and clear communication.  My go to place for everything now !!!
AMAZING THE EMPLOYEES ARE VERY KIND, they are super patient, you come in greeted, they sometimes complement you!! And they make your drink very quick!! they have many options for tea's!!!

First time here today, a friend recommended. I want on the hunt for a good mani/pedi and I got just that! It was Asian run and really nice and new inside; had a spa-like atmosphere. The lady that helped me was so nice and they have about 10 big nice spa massage chairs. It was very relaxing, she massaged and scrubbed my arms and legs too.  Great price for what I got!

Customer service is poor. All they care about it pure sales, not about the person. I went to visit the gym with a buddy and they do not provide any guest privileges for their members so if I wanted to workout at that time I'd have to pay $10 for a 60 day pass. Which is a good deal but I just wanted to try it once with a buddy who has a membership. Guess I'll keep my membership at crunch where I have guest privileges and could bring the same person to the gym every day  Lastly, I rated it as two stars because they do have adequate gym equipment.

We were moving from out of state and I was referred by a family member who had used them when they made the transition. David answered the phone, he was friendly and helpful right off the bat. He had my quotes emailed to me within minutes and was able to answer all my questions and concerns. David made the process seamless and easy. I would definitely recommend them for your insurance needs.

My bank made a double HOA dyes payment, I contacted Valley property for a refund of the overage. I was told they would cut a check and forward it to the HOA that week. They have not cut the check to date. I'm still waiting. I would think long and hard about doing business with this company. They can't be trusted.

If you have a generator needing repair, I highly recommend Jon at Gem State Generators!  I purchased a used RV which had a generator that just would not start. I had taken it to two places to get fixed and neither could get working from a cold start - the last place recommended I call Gem State Generators.  I called and setup an appointment.  Jon came out to my place, which for me was a bonus because I didn't have to haul the RV somewhere else.  Within 20 minutes he had taken apart the carburetor, identified there were some missing pieces, found replacements pieces in his truck, and had it up and running.

/RantOn 
I normally would not comment on this, but I also agree that this is not the forum for complaining someones driving.  My interaction with Jon lead me to believe he was a really nice guy and he went out of his way to share loads of information for me relating to the generator, how to properly run it and how to keep it running nicely.  Things happen when your driving and if it bothered you so much you should have made a police report, instead of commenting on Yelp about a person you've never done business with.  
/RantOff

I don't recommend ordering the Mandarin chicken from a food delivery service. When the meal got here it was literally just a pile of sloshy mess. I wouldn't even classify it as a solid. That plus the outlandish price for basic white rice leave me with the conclusion that it will be a very long time before I think about eating any food from this place.

I was very disappointed in this restaurant. I was here once with a couple friends for dinner and the staff was very rude we got one bowl and food was falling off so we grabbed another bowl and the lady came and started yelling at us that she was going to charge us for two bowls and was very rude about it I did not mind paying for two that's not the point. The point is I did not appreciate being yelled at in front of everyone I was not pleased with that visit. I decided to give it another try same thing happened again, yelling that she was going to charge us and that bowls can't be more then 3 inches high when 4 people in front of me had bowls just as high and she never said a word to them the cooks have a very poor attitude. We asked to speak to a manger the manager was "not there" that day. When she gave us our check she made it very clear about charges was not kind at all. I and my friends will never be back here again. Sad for a place that is close and has good food. Very poor service.

Amazing pizza! We had the supreme and the garlic chicken...both incredible. While I'm also a fan of thick crust pizza, Margherita pizza's thin crust was just perfect. Plus, it allowed us to save room for the cheesy bread! Whenever you're in the mood for pizza, go to Margherita pizza! They are a local and family owned business. Especially now, we need to be supporting small business as much as possible. This place deserves it!!

Two older lady workers had no clue what they were doing, got my order wrong, and were having people drive back into the one way parking lot to get their food because they didn't want bad window times. Get better employees.
