This place is fantastic. Great employees (friendly, chill, knowledgeable, fantastically dry sense of humor), fun selection of games (cards, dice, board-games) and gaming accessories. They have lots of tables and chairs in the back and they also have a sweet rewards program at the register, you just type in your phone# and earn more game stuff :)
They made a mistake with my order. It happens, no one is perfect. I went back and informed them about it, they took good care of me. Extra fries and pie for any inconvenience. Very good location.

I have come to this nail salon a few times with family over the past few years and have had a good experience until this last time. I came alone on a special occasion and was hoping to have a relaxing experience, but instead it was rushed and in fact physically painful due to my technicians passive-aggressive behavior towards me. I was pushed several times to upgrade my services to pay top dollar when their service is already overpriced to begin with. I said no politely several times and my technicians behavior switched towards me when she could tell I was not going to change my mind. I have never been treated this poorly at a nail salon in my life... The lady working on my toes usually will massage clients legs with lotion and in this process she actually started digging her nails into my legs and leaving red scratch marks. Then, when she was scrubbing the tops of my toes I thought her goal was to rip off the skin as no nail technician I have had before even used these kinds of techniques on me. I started to believe quickly she was out to torture me because she wasn't going to make the amount of money she was hoping to that day. The experience was rushed and painful and WAY too expensive! Sadly, I did not stop her and ask her to slow down and express that she was causing me physical pain and was kind to her hoping she'd recognize that her behavior was unwarranted. People like this really ought not to be in business. Not to mention, they prefer cash and push that even though they have accommodations to accept credit cards. This is the first negative review I have ever written, but felt like I needed to say something. This business is certainly losing my business and the business of all my family members. My hope is that this place finally learns from all their negative reviews that passive-aggressive behavior doesn't go unnoticed and pushing clients to spend more than they have isn't worth it.

Used to love this place!! Want to love it, but have to write my review. I get consignment. You bring your stuff in, and they have to go through it. You WILL WAIT! I consign all over the valley like it's my second job. I brought 3 little items in (not clothing) for them to take a look at. In the past I usually wait around 20 minutes. No big deal- we walk around and shop.

I have two kids 16 months and 4 months so our threshold for waiting is realistically about 1 hour max. We waited for 1.5 hours, and when I checked in- the lady was on some power trip. She said there were 3 large trash bags of clothes in front of my 3 items (car seat toys)...she said... ANOTHER 30 minutes sorry.

By this point I wanted to burst into tears. My kids were both crying. I was done. I said, how long will you keep my items if you don't want them- she said no longer than 24 hours. I live 40 minutes away. Okay. So I just left. She called me 10 minutes after I left to tell me they didn't want any of the brand new never been used items.

Cool. Donate them. I go to Kid to Kid now. Still makes me really upset.
Worst customer service.  Went to find paint and ask Frank where this product it. All is said we " it's over there"  . that's it. No such product so I went to Lowe's

Nicest people you will ever meet! So accommodating to my Mufasa guy! Got a bully stick at the suggestion of one of the ladies, which he showed no interest in AT ALL while we were in the store, nd now he carries it around everywhere with him! Thanks for making my guy's day. I'll be back. Quality for my guy!

The location is upscale and a pleasant departure from the noise of Tucanos (the other Brazilian steakhouse). That's about the only aspect where Texas de Brazil wins out. It's VERY overpriced. The salad bar is pretty limited when compared to Tucanos. In fact, I'd be hard pressed to classify this as a salad bar - it's more like an hors d'oeuvre station. Everything appeared dried out, especially the charcuterie and the pineapple carpaccio (ridiculously thin pineapple slices that taste like a Dole fruit cup). 

The meat is okay but many of the selections were overly salty and might be undercooked if you prefer anything other than medium rare. We were offered more chicken and pork than beef. The beef selections are sirloin and flank steak with a singular appearance of filet which highlights the overpriced nature of this place. You're paying premium prices while they fill you up on inexpensive cuts of meat. Tucanos serves several beef choices in interesting glazes and out-of-this-world brown sugar glazed pineapple which we desperately missed. Texas de Brazil did bring a side of garlic mashed potatoes (which were tasty) and two pieces of fried banana - both of these sides are unlimited at Tucanos. I would say the Brazilian cheese rolls have better flavor and texture at Texas de Brazil than Tucanos. 

The dessert choices are plentiful. We tried the creme brulee and the caramel cheesecake. The cheesecake was creamy and the caramel sauce was good. The creme brulee wasn't really set so it had a lumpy, slimy texture. 

Service was okay. They don't really go out of their way, but nothing to complain about. Just average. 

All in all, Tucanos is the better value. The meat is more consistently good and the pineapple is crazy delicious. The atmosphere at Texas de Brazil is better for a nice evening out, but the food just doesn't justify the price. Go to Ruth's Chris or Chandlers if you're gonna drop this kind of cash. Your steak will be perfect and the service will be extraordinary.

Today was my first time in this Ulta. It was very clean and decently stocked (although Black Friday had wiped them out of tons of merch). I specifically went in to get a replacement for my Anastasia Beverly Hills contour kit and a new primer. I only looked lost for about ten seconds before an associate asked me if I needed help. I stated what I needed and then a beautiful (and I cannot emphasize this fact enough) boy helped me not only find what I needed, but got me signed up with an account and helped me get product they were sold out of even delivered to my door. Rudy was so sweet and helpful, seemed knowledgeable in not only what they carry but clearly knew makeup personally as his face was FLAWLESS. Eyebrows on fleek. I'll definitely be back. Thanks guys!

My husband and I went there for the first time last night (1/15/21). Got seated right away. We knew nothing about this restaurant and the service. We were served our water and about 10 minutes later the waitress stops by and rambles on about how the service works. We ordered our drinks which took about 30 minutes to receive. The Lemon drop was ok but one of their signature drinks was horrible. Way too much rum and just didn't taste like the recipe should have tasted. I believe it was the Rio Sunrise. 

You ordered your salad by marking a piece of paper which is different since you can't serve yourself at the salad bar. The salad was good.  Next came the meat served by the "Gauchos". The beef was way too under cooked. We like med to med well temp beef and you had to cut the raw meat away. The chicken wrapped with bacon was decent and I thought the lamb was tasty. Next the waitress served a cinnamon sugar cooked banana and garlic mashed potatoes which were utterly disgusting. Mashed potatoes are not hard to make from scratch and to use instant potatoes is unacceptable. 

The wait for the next Lemon drop was at least 20 minutes. There were two bartenders at times and the restaurant wasn't that busy. By the time we were ready to leave we couldn't find our server to pay for our meal. We finally took our tab up the the hostess station and she was nowhere to be found either. The GM helped us and we told him about the lousy service and drinks and the disappearance of our server. He comped our entire tab. We don't like not paying for our meal but in this case it was appropriate. We will never go back. The price for the meal is $47 per adult not including drinks or dessert. 

The concept of the restaurant is good but they need refinement. The ambiance is unfinished. It was a loud cafeteria type restaurant. I will give 5 stars for the ceiling but it still needs work.

We took our queen-size quilted bedspread in for dry cleaning.  Took only two days to clean, and when I picked the bedspread up, it was neatly folded and placed in a zippered bag.  It was cleaned beautifully and looks and smells like brand new.  Good job!  Very pleased.
Great atmosphere & great crowd. Would recommend anyone who loves beer to check it out. 40 beers on tap.

We had a group party there and talk about an unforgettable night!!  Making the reservations and setting up the menu was a breeze -- they make it so easy!  The night of the event the service was spot-on; food was fabulous and the atmosphere was perfect.  Our server did a fantastic job keeping drinks filled, plates cleared and food filled.  I won't consider any other venue for my next event -- KUDOS for a job well done!

We would like to thank "Jenny, and the staff at B&H for great service and high quality food. We live in Nampa and enjoy the Family flavor and it's nice to enjoy that at B&H.
Retired in Nampa
Very friendly staff.  Loud bar music isn't family friendly.  Food is very bland and processed. Salad bar is fair but overpriced for just a salad.  Atmosphere is fast food like.  Wont ever go again.

Tonight we drove from Boise to the Majestic but only because of the movie start time. The young men at the ticket booth weren't very interested in us and we had to ask how to get Into the theater. So between the tickets for 4 ($45)& concessions ($30) we were at nearly $80, not out of the ordinary but with that you usually get a premium experience. The movie itself was fine but a visit to the bathroom was where it went downhill. The women's bathroom was disgusting! The stall was out of tp. The sink was backed up with dirty water and popcorn, the floor was mostly wet and dirty and the paper towel dispenser was empty. On my way out I mentioned the state of affairs to an employee who basically nodded and smiled. Alrighty then!  We will not be driving out to the majestic anymore.

Not so great.
Under seasoned if seasoned at all with too much sauce and beef that had to be a frozen puck. 

Today I was on a mission to taste test burgers and we made it to 7 burger joints. I think the only mistake we made was not having all the burgers outfitted the same. Small differences like house sauce vs mustard and ketchup and whole onions vs  grilled onions or no onions can adversely affect the taste. The thought was to order a cheeseburger from each place with nothing added or taken away just their signature burger. For that reason I am reviewing each burger as a stand alone and not head to head. Next time I think I will put them head to head with the same fixins.

In Meridian for work and staying right across the parking lot from Big Jud's. This place is a legit burger joint. Seating area was clean & bright with a garage type style. Lots of red and stainless steel. Sharp. 

Now the food. Killer. Got the mushroom bacon burger and it was delish. Not too much or too little of the important players. Tasty burger, juicy and cooked about medium. Ordered a small side of tater tots and when I seemed unsure of my choice then my server told me I could go half and half on two sides if I wanted. Cha-ching! Half tots, half fried pickles. Helluva combo. Whole pickles quartered and fried and hot enough right outta the fryer to burn the roof of your mouth if you're not careful. 

My server Ally was fantastic. Super friendly, attentive but not invasive. 

All around a must stop place when you're in the area.

My boyfriend and I love Applebee's. It's our date night, dinner choice, and just our place to go when we are craving food. However this location in particular has been a disappointment since day one. We assumed it was because of short staffed and tried to be understanding but every time we go the service gets worse and worse from as little as not being seated for 20 minutes to waiting 30 minutes for a water and then waiting another 20 to have our order taken. At those times we've tried looking for servers and are never able to find them. A lot of this would be under stable if it was super busy but anytime we've gone there's never been more then 4 other tables us included. They've gotten our food wrong when we order online they've offered refunds but never gave one and every time we try to just give it another try we are reminded every time that it was a mistake.

It was...ok. I'll start with the good.

Service: Our server was wonderful, we had a large group and she was able to cae for us as well as her other tables without a single issue. 

Food: the biscuits were fluffy and had just enough moisture that they weren't dry nor doughy. My son had the chicken fried steak and devoured it. It was tender and had decent flavor. 

The mediocre 

Service: does not apply, service was good. 

Food: they seem to be trying to compensate for lack of flavor with portion size. The pancake breakfast came with 2 eggs choice of meat and 2 pancakes. The pancakes are ridiculous...they taste like a krusteaz mix and are literally the size of a large pizza. There is no point. They come with a tiny cup of syrup and a small pat of butter on top....I'll say it again "ridiculous." 
 The Idaho scramble was ok, I think they forgot salt when cooking and have somehow been able to find salt-free bacon, ham, and sausage. 
 The brisket Benny was also mediocre. The brisket was a tad chewy (I smoke a lot of brisket so I may be overly critical here but brisketshould turn in to pure meaty liquidas it crosses the threshold of one's mouth) . The hollandaise was waaaay too mustardy, and again the portions were ridiculous. 

The Bad

Ok, here it goes...my scrambled eggs were verging on burnt, as were my sons country potatoes. Nothing was inedible....but it also wasn't exactly enjoyable.

Great restaurant! A family favorite. You pick what you want, how much you want what sauce and how much sauce! Great service as well! Their covid protocols are using gloves when picking food and everything is sanitized!
My husband got his haircut and it turned out great. The atmosphere at this location is very funky and fun! Nice customer service.

I received a birthday gift card to Penache for a hair cut and beard trim, that's when I met John. I never received so many compliments from a hair and beard cut before. I gave him a idea of what I wanted and he ran with it. I've been back 4 times now and he just keeps making the cuts better and better. Oh and my first straight razor cut at 56 years old was amazing. I would recommend John to anyone who wants a great cut from a person that takes his time to fit to you. I'm giving John 5 stars but he deserves more.

I ordered a Burger and Mac and cheese. Burger was pretty good Mac and cheese was awesome. When I left I drove around back and saw they're grill which is overflowing with fat and it doesn't look like it's ever been cleaned. I can only imagine what the kitchen looks like if what you can see looks like that . None of the employees were wearing masks and no one inside was wearing a mask.

Stayed at a local motel for a few days and made a few trips into The Harp. Almost got my punch card completed for a free beer. Good selection of beers on tap and Daniel was a good, friendly bartender. Fun to find something like Smithwick's on tap. Good local selection as well. The food was good for bar food but about par for a restaurant. A couple of tweaks and attention to detail and the food could be really good. Would definitely go back for the beer and atmosphere and would give the food another try.

Not really worth your time. I have on multiple occasions attempted to bring my stuff here to exchange for a store credit and more often then not,  they will take only one or two items.  The clothes that they sale are ok but you can get a lot of the same stuff at Walmart for close to the same price and know it doesn't have any previous owners.  I took in a box of really nice clean toys and they only wanted two of them. I should have just taken my stuff to Goodwill. Not planning on going back. Used to favorite store.

Well I booked on Open Table and the hostess greeted me with "ah we don't take reservations for less than 8 people". If this is the case why does Open Table have it listed and available. She was pretty rude and had to go get a manager and didn't actually come just instructed her to seat me and that she did. Way the hell away from most other guests over in the corner.  The only good thing about the evening was the waitress was pretty redeeming, she was super professional and apologetic. I could have been ok with the evening, but ended up getting food poisoning spent the remaining evening feeling like I was having an appendix attack without going into details. 

So not a great experience and then they refused the Open Table points. So I won't be back!!
Meh. Ok place for that "Irish" feel but lacks ambience and energy. Bathroom is not good.

I absolutely love going to OTF Meridian! Not only are the coaches amazing but there are always fun contests going on at the studio & ways to motivate us! It's changed how I view working out & now enjoy going. I can't imagine not going to Orange Theory, almost 2 years now that I have been going. 10/10 recommend trying out a class!

I like this Burger King location. The drive-through is fast. The food is hot. The employees are friendly. But, I wanted to check in on Dianna.  It doesn't matter if you order a small fry or a large fry, if you ask Dianna for fry sauce you're only going to get one.  Dianna seems unaware that I put fry sauce on my fries AND on my burger. And yes, sometimes I lick it straight out of the container if I don't see any cars nearby as I'm driving.  That's how much I love fry sauce.  I don't know if Dianna gets a kickback at the end of the day based on the amount of unused fry sauce, or if she really just isn't a fan of it altogether.  But, I do know she'll give you a disapproving look as she begrudgingly hands you one more out the window if you ask nicely.  Don't judge me Dianna, I'm just out here trying to live my best life. I'm sorry if I ruined your fry sauce quota today.

Today I got up and went to Ed's 50's cafe for the best grilled cheese sandwich and the worlds best French frys  and the greatest fry sauce!!! Oh man did it hit the spot and the waitress and the best 
Marie is the greatest of all !!! God bless them all and the Cooks are grand . I love my grilled cheese sandwich And pickles yum !!!!!
Steve napier a good customer for sure

This restaurant was AWFUL!!! I've never had such a bad experience in my life or gotten sick the way I did. We arrived at 4 and received our food 50 min later the dishes that should have been warm were cold and you could tell had been sitting we ask to take back the salad that was awful as if it was soaked in water the salmon on sushi was warm and the chicken cold. The server Bryanna C. goes to pick up the plate quickly and the fork flings off the plate all the way across the table flinging food all over and sends a manager over and they bring a new Pepsi which we didn't ask for as if that's supposed to make things better. They didn't remove the cold dishes of food we didn't even eat but charged us for them and the new dishes they brought us. Took a "20%" discount off but even with the discount we still paid more with the dishes we didn't even eat. So $70+ for 2 dishes we didn't eat and then some. And to top it off the salmon on the sushi was so warm I had to get up and go vomit in the bathroom I've never ever had pain in my stomach or been sick the way I was after eating here and don't get me wrong I eat lots of fish and seafood this was despicable and an awful experience. If I could give a 00000 I would. So so so unhappy how this was handled I would not recommend anyone to go here. I am very very angry and will be emailing the GM. Do not waste your time or money on the poor customer service and lack of communication to anyone who walks through their doors.

Very nice staff but Not the best experience. I got the farmhouse scramble & without the gravy it has no flavor whatsoever. My family wasn't a fan of their food either, bland and somewhat bitter. Also the corner of the restaurant with the bathrooms is so bad. Water damage and peeling paint bubbles everywhere. The ceiling in the women's bathroom just sags.

Oh man... Talk about an all around good experience. The food was really good. The portions were (absurdly) huge! And the staff were incredibly friendly and helpful. My daughter got the pancake and apparently the kids cake is just one of their regular sized pancakes  So that thing looked hula in front of her. My wife got the nachos which were AMAZING!! My son got the kids Mac n Cheese, which anywhere else would have been a fair sized portion for an adult. And I got the Nacho Burger with their special Beef n Cream fries -- which were fantastic. Highly recommend this place!!

Ok let's do this. Tried this on a whim as I had no desire to cook dinner. 
The GOOD- 
Pancakes were the size of a M/L pizza. Our order was to go and they were literally in a large pizza cardboard box! Not a joke! They were freaking HUUUUGE and these were off the piglet menu for kids! The best part is that they were super fluffy and delish. 
Burgers were AMAZING! Huge patties, not precut, cooked to medium. They were monsters! 
Tomato soup was really yummy. 
Mac and Cheese was its perfect creamy comforting self.

Crystal deserves zero stars and a measly tip; however, I could only provide the latter.

This criticism may belong at World Market corporate site.  I did try to contact them.  90 minutes combined on phone and on-line chat room waiting along with email to which they promised reply in 24 hours now 48 hours later all un-responded to.  So here I simply try to provide heads up for local shoppers who may think ordering non perishable food items from World Market is good idea in these covid19 times when getting into the stores is difficult or impossible.  Based on my experience it is a bad idea.  A very bad idea.   In my experience they are selling badly damaged second packaging at first quality packaging prices.  And so badly damaged that food safety could be a concern for some.

Let me set the stage with this.  Then I'll provide specifics for the "TILT" experience.  

One of the few reasons I make pilgrimage into World Market maybe 3 times annually is to purchase specific brands of food items that are not carried in most standard American grocers and hard to find consistently stocked at specialty stores even in non-pandemic times.  And, of course, even more difficult for those stores to obtain during covid19 challenges.  (Plus, they for sure do not show up on the 'order in advance lists' to pick up in parking lot shopping services.  Services I have been grateful to use for some things in the covid19 'stay home' period.  But they necessarily have limitations for product.)  For me those things that World Market has on shelf in normal times include a specific brand of Italian tomatoes and other things like a specific brand of preserved lemons and Moroccan styled harissa.  

Being near the last at home supply of my December 2019 purchases of those items as June approached, I searched on line to find most retailers were out of stock with no known restock time.   But lo and behold, the products were available at World Market but only ordered for shipping to home for delivery.  The price was as first quality ($5 - $6 each can or jar) as sold by other retailers when items were available.  For the tomato products, World Market required I purchase in minimum lots of 6 to 12 depending on the variety.  That means I'd end up with 18 cans total but I reasoned with myself that was no problem because the purchases would mean it would be winter again before I needed more.  

Alas, what I was shipped were 'seconds' items - badly dented cans of tomatoes, jars of preserved lemons and harissa with labels with ink smeared or pasted on sideways and with the top of one of the jars so badly dented that harissa leaked. 

These kinds of badly damaged cans and jars or with with defective labeling are the kinds of things that are typically sold at big discounts at clearance warehouses or "Dollar Stores" in the neighborhood of a buck for a piece or five bucks for an entire case or sold to shelter kitchens for "a dime on the dollar".  That is because consumers typically won't buy the products with this kind of packaging damage and so standard retailers won't put them on shelves.   Absent puncturing of cans or unsealing of jars (as was the case in one of them) which makes it necessary for the manufacturer to dump them for food safety, they try to find deep discount sales channels.

But I was charged full prices and paid them assuming first quality items even arguing (with myself) that the 18 cans of tomatoes I was required to purchase to meet World Market minimums would hold me for the better part of a year.  (And who knows when American retailers will be able to get these Italian originated goods again.)  Sadly, only 3 of the 18 cans was without significant damage and some to the point I would not have bought them at all in a retail store at any price.  And all four of the bottles were defective labeling - which would bother me not for "% off" but the dented lid seal on the leaking one is exactly why one needs to be cautious of badly dented packages of all kinds...food safety.

World Market obviously used a 3rd party to fulfill this order.  The 3 weeks from order to fulfillment aside - these are difficult times for everyone and I understand that - the real issue is the badly damaged items being sold as first quality.   They would not have these on shelves in their stores because of the damage. 

World Market needs to know this is happening and pull back their 3rd party distributor.  I would notify them it is happening if I could get any kind of customer service response.  (Covid19 times or no, there is no excuse for that.)

In the meantime, I provide heads up for other shoppers to consider.

Really surprised at all these reviews they have that are good .....so like I said they did a great job for me the first time. The guy told me they don't do the exterior plastic I'm thinking to myself well what the hell is the $250 for sounds like a line of crap.

They never answer the phone or it's off the hook.. it's really frustrating when you want to place a pick up order . Also the quality of the food has gone down .. burgers r to salty . Unfortunately I will be taking my business elsewhere

We tried their indoor dining last night, and it was disappointing. We had to wait a long time for a table with just 2 of us, and the workers were moving very slow. Our waiter was great, but the food was mediocre. So much that we didn't even take our leftovers home.

I wish I could leave no stars. I'm extremely disappointed. We went in there with a referral and when we found out how much the different option costs were to fix a crown they were beyond the amount that we could afford as well as the payment plans, I had talked with others in the family and they insisted that we go else where, as I told the front desk we could not afford this and will not be back, she kept insisting we wait, she said she spoke with the finiacial planner and they brought us back even though time and time again I told them we cannot even afford just an initial payment. She said well let the doctor just see her and  that we didn't need to worry about it. So as we discussed the last option I still told them we'd have to think about the payment because it was too far out of our limits and what do you know, a couple months later we recieve a bill for something we told them WE COULD NOT AFFORD, EVEN THOUGH THEY INSISTED WE DIDNT NEED TO WORRY. THIS IS BULLSHIT. I'm beyond upset, we made it very clear we could not make payments and yet this happens?! You guys are LIARS!!!!

Great place! We have been in a few times now and every time the food has been spot on and service has been excellent!  Menu is small but that is the best, food is authentic to what they say they are selling!.

Heritage is a smaller, underground bar in downtown Meridian. Their beer choices are fantastic. I always have a harder time narrowing down my options than finding something to drink. They do have a small back bar that serves liquor for those adverse to hoppy goodness.

The vibe is cool. It has a mix of industrial and wooden furniture with defaced $1 bills line the wall behind the bar. Our service has always been awesome. The bartenders have been friendly, but not overly chatty. They even host a regular trivia night!

I have never tried the small selection of food, but it looks delicious and always comes out looking high quality. Not at all like the food that you would expect at an underground bar.

This is a great location as it is very accessible. The owners and other staff are genuine and knowledgeable. They have a good selection of top board games. Their Magic events have also been enjoyable and inviting.

I haven't ordered bubble tea with boba since reading the studies about what boba actually does to our insides, but i have such a weakness for Taro bubble tea. I order Taro boba and they only filled it 3/4 of the way. When i asked why it wasn't filled all the way they said it was because i didn't order the pearls. So weird. I'm a good tipper and I'm really outgoing, i don't understand why they got so awkward and defensive when i asked

Great authentic Irish food and drinks! The staff is friendly! Everything is yummy...our faves are the sausage rolls and the Shepherd's Pie! A welcome addition to the larger chain restaurants in Meridian! #supportlocal

I'm really grateful my fiancé and I discovered this place! Twice now I've gone in and gotten a classic milk tea Boba. The staff is always super nice and fast, and the atmosphere is that of a very pleasant coffee and tea shop. I also have a lot of respect for the staff for enforcing the mask mandate during these uncertain times. I know it's very uncomfortable to stand up to the public when doing so, but the employees here make it work without being pushy. Thanks urban Fox for being awesome.

Absolutely the best dining and service experience I can remember in my life. Perry the bartender was absolutely amazing he was welcoming and made the whole experience as special as possible. With drink recommendations and a cheerfulness that is rare to find, Perry, the waiters and management alike were all a cherry on top of the most delectable meal I've had in as long as I can remember. The beef and lamb picana and lamb leg stood out as my fiancée and my favorites. A must try place for anyone who loves food and great service

I gave them $ 700. On July 29th to remove a tree on September 11. They called me at 1:30 pm the day before and said they have to reschedule because of staff shortages. They didn't even give me 24 hours notice. I emailed customer service and they replied, they sent an email to the supervisor get work done on Saturday sept 11 or refund money ASAP. They didn't come. They came back a few days later and said the person they sent to bid the job messed up. It was unsafe to climb, they need a lift. My animals were out and I was not home. 4 days later I emailed customer service asked , where are we in the process? Where is my $700. They said it would take 14 business days to give me my money they have had since July 29! I would not recommend this company at all. I asked if they were going to give me interest on my $ 700. They had since July 29th. They said no. Thumbs down!

I have been using On the Spot Cleaners for almost 3 years! The are helpful, accommodating and do an excellent job!I trust all my clothes to them and did I mention they are great on alterations and  repairs also? You will love the service, the quality and most of all, the people!!!

Dr Greer is so rude !! Reception ladies who check you in and out are pretty rude too but not as bad as Dr Greer.  If you want to be treated poorly  by people who really do not care , go here and ask for Dr Greer.

Worst service I've had in my 7 years of living in Boise. We got maybe 4 meats in the 2 hours we were there. We mentioned it multiple times to our server but nothing ever came from it. The meat we did get was dry. $200 later for 3 people & left hungry. Would not recommend.

Kidz Again used to take a bunch of clothes, in turn sold a lot of clothes. The past year I've taken loads of clothes in for trade and they've taken about 10 items. Brands such as Gap, Carter's, Gymboree, lots of Cat & Jack, Macy's...pj sets, shoes, accessories ALL in the condition you'd expect to buy at a "gently used" clothing store. If you're looking for infant or toddler (up to 2T) you're in luck, but anything larger is a very disappointing selection! Stop by their store. You'll notice less than one side of one rack for girls size 6.  They have NOTHING. They offer new retail clothes that are marked at a sale price, but still way over the "used" price you're expecting when you shop at their store. Last time I asked why they didn't have any girls size 6 clothes to pick through & the manager said they were just really hard to come by. Not true. I have an entire trunk full that is cuter than the rest of their ten items they think they're going to sell, but they chose not to take anything from me.  Boring, old news, gonna be shutting their doors soon kind of store. What a waste of such a large space.  They have to spend money to make money. Such a shame.

I was so excited when coming in to see the sign that said, mask required, you won't be seated without them, and after we were seated, a table of for his were seated with NO MASKS!!!  If you are not going to enforce your own rules, what good are they, take the sign down then!!!

I'm a fairly regular at this place while I'm traveling on business. Maybe it's time for a change. Not enjoying a wait staff (males) who insist on calling me "bud" or "boss"while I watch the other wait staff (females) stand around drinking beer with other "buds/bosses" or dashing out to their cars and back...all in their uniforms. 
The food is consistent and really pretty good but a sense of professionalism is nowhere to be found. It might just be me and I need to lower my expectations while I pay almost $35 for a one person meal. 
One more time and I might just be done. Plenty of other options down the street.

Pre COVID we would drop in for a quick lunch when at a doctors appointment in area. We have not been to a restaurant since February 2020. Yesterday, 6/16/20, we decided to 'try' a dine-in option after Stage 3 'reopening' and chose Ling and Louie's. We were quite early for lunch, about 11:15. None of the staff in restaraunt were wearing masks. We were. We were one of three parties there. We were offered our choice of seating. We chose an end booth, assuming they would not seat anyone in the adjacent booth. Shame on us that we did not ask. We ordered quickly, but before food was delivered, restaurant started to fill up. Staff immediately put a party of seven in booth next to us. My husband who was sitting directly next to adjacent booth moved to sit next to me to socially distance by approximately 4 feet.  Our food was delivered and we discussed getting it to go, but we had doctors appointments and no way to get food home safely in time to eat it. We had a couple of bites of food before deciding to leave. Bus boy, who was not wearing a mask, leaned over us to clear plates. Less than a foot from us. Waitress, who was not wearing a mask, brought us a paper receipt and could not offer a no contact payment option. When we exited restaurant people were lined up at reception without social distancing. People in line would not step aside to allow us to safely exit restaurant with proper distancing.  We left restaraunt about noon and the restaurant and bar were both about 80% of capacity. No attempt at all to social distance patrons. Will never return to Ling and Louie's because they obviously place profit over consumer safety.

Excellent professional service! After receiving multiple reviews for a cracked sub slab drain pipe we knew what the issue was when we called Roto Rooter.  The technician came out and went over all of our options actually saving us 10's of thousands of dollars. When the techs came back to do the actual work they were very neat and un-obtrusive (for jackhammering up the floor!). The quality of work is amazing...in fact it was so good I called them back out this week to install a laundry box!  Highly recommended. I will call Roto Rooter for all my plumbing needs in the future.

I don't like pedicures and always do them myself. But at 8 months pregnant, I cant reach my toes anymore. Tae gave me the best pedicure I ever got. Fast, efficient and no need for small talk. Took a while to wait with no one attending the customers as they pilled up for their appointments but for me, that's ok as long as the pedicure itself is good. Very happy with it and will be back next month. $20 for pedicure. No nail polish. Cash preferable. Don't forget a tip.

The set up of the restaurant was awesome!  That's where it ends. Salads were ok..not impressive. EVERY SINGLE MEAT WAS A PILE OF SALT...except the lamb chops. The only saving grace. We took my 91 year old grandma there as a treat and she was so unhappy with everything. The alcohol was not even worth drinking. We never got a receipt to see what our bill total was. The two stars is literally attributed to the lamb chops. Probably won't go back with our "bonus" gift card

For used clothing the prices seem high. I actually found a new shirt that had been donated with a clearance tag on it for $1.79. I went up to pay and let them know it didn't have their price tag on it, and they wanted to charge me $3.99 for the shirt. It seems like a rip off to me.
Great friendly staff. Clean location. Good prices. You get a lot of food, pretty much 2 meals worth. The smokehouse scramble was delicious.  The smoked brisket is amazing and the bacon as well.

What happened to Ling & Louie's in Meridian? We haven't eaten there in years, but since moving back to the area, we decided to treat ourselves. The first thing that hits you is the nasty smell of dirty carpet. I should have turned around. We ordered okay sushi, lettuce wraps and bad crab wontons. It was clear the wontons were deep fried in old grease. The table tent menu was so disgustingly dirty, I told the server it needed to be washed. She wasn't amused, concerned, apologetic, nothing. I really don't understand how you let such a wonderful place fall into the category of just another greasy spoon. Clean the place!

I have to say I was excited to see that they were coming to this side of town.. I had been to the OG location a couple times but never remember it being memorable or amazing. The new location follows suit. The decor is very blah and not very appealing and the layout is very very weird IMO. From what I remember and it's been a while the OG location u went up to the register and ordered and then they brought the food to u, well now they have decided to have a hostess and waitresses which I feel this is a big mistake. A burger place like this need to have a counter were u walk up and order and they bring the food to you. Learn from smash, 5guys, habit. The burgers are good but they don't justify having a waitress that I now have to tip for bringing me a liter sized drink and a burger that is on the smallest plate they could find. This just isn't needed. 

Like stated in previous reviews the waitresses get double or triple sat and they can't keep up. Luckily we ordered before the party of 10 got sat or we would have been screwed. Our waitress seemed to be doing a good job and but u could tell she forgot bout us a time or 2 which wasn't a big deal, they have runners who bring out your food and with your liter o cola sitting on the table the odds of needing a refill is slim to none..

Just my 2 cents. Get rid of the hostess and waitress open up the place a little and would be a way better experience IMO and this would be a 4 if not 5 star place..

Kim was recommended to me by my previous groomer, who was retiring. I feel so blessed and so lucky to have Kim in our lives.  My dog is going on 13 years old and has some special needs.  Kim is always gentle and caring with my dog.  I have a lot of special requests and Kim is always willing to accept every task with graciousness.  She is bright, bubbly, and delightful.  She always comes to my home with a smile on her face--full of personality, it is infectious!  My dog is always so excited to her as well. She is prompt and always keeps me informed, which I appreciate.  I don't have to worry during the grooming process as I know that Kim treats my dog as if she was her own.  Thank you, Kim, for being an awesome groomer, treating my dog with kindness, and  brightening up our worlds with every grooming visit.  From our hearts, with gratitude.

I found a beautiful smelling candle for my car and one for my house too!  I was so lucky to find a container for my traveling issues... a container that holds my passport, tickets, Etc! It's really gorgeous.
Beautiful new hotel. Great rooms at very reasonable prices. Staff (Kodi) and all here friendly, courteous, and knowledgeable of the area, and restaurants. I'll be back. Good job.

We are in the middle of a crisis with our 8 yo puppy, refusing to eat and lethargic. We called the vet and they were able to see us right away. Since we are still in the middle of the Covid19 pandemic, I was very happy to see them using appropriate protocols when receiving our puppy. 

We called them when we got there and they had someone meet us at our car ( with masks) to pick up our puppy. They were very good with explaining to us the results of her check up, answering any and all questions and explaining future treatments. Very compassionate team here. Unfortunately they are still working on a treatment for my puppy, so she will go and spend the day with them tomorrow for treatment and observation. I trust them with my family member!

Nice place, great seats and lots of good show times.  Problem is the "children" behind he counter are rude. I get it, I mean $3.87 an hour is a terrible job. But that's not my fault.  I just wanted some yummy popcorn and a nice sody pop and hang with my family but the snowflake behind the counter was grumpy because he had to get up early, bush his hair and be to work by 11:00am.  Maybe try something else there Biff, like wash cars or pick up trash in the freeway.  You have the personality of a dumpster fire.
Great place to eat.  One of the best breakfast I've ever had!  Very affordable and everything our large party ordered was simply amazing!
Definitely won't leave hungry! Just wish the food had more flavor and cinnamon roll wasn't so dry.

I was scheduled today to have my lawn aerated and overseeded. After staying home all day to be available when they arrived to clarify details of the job, etc...they never came. I called just before 5:00pm to see if they were still coming and they said I was rescheduled for next month...without communicating anything to me. Sadly, all the negative reviews are true about this business. Avoid them

Meh.  Store is in need of a good cleaning and things are kind of messy.

So far no hidden treasures.

Great pizza, friendly servers. 
I ordered a 12 inch margarita pizza, I received it quickly.  The pizza had a small hole on the  outside and the staff offered to make me a new pizza, I declined because it was not necessary.
Great place!

Oh my goodness I LOVE JERSEY MIKES!!!!  Hands down this is my favorite subs.   I used to have to drive quite a ways across the valley.  But now I have one a lot closer!  Yay!  My fav is the original Italian. So delicious!

I also want to mention here that the staff was very friendly and accommodating.  They really listened to my requested changes to the standard sandwich and got it absolutely right.  I read through some of the other reviews and wanted to add that they must have improved because I could not have been any happier with absolutely everything about this location.  I will definitely be back!

I came in for a pink and white set. I noticed incorrect label on the price sheet; it says, "Solar Gel (high quality powder)." This is just pink and white acrylic at this shop, not UV Gel. 

Tech did not sculpt extension on a free form, instead used plastic tips. I wanted the "babyboomer" effect, and showed a reference picture. The tech understood, and said she would try. 

It didn't come out as expected, smile lines were choppy, as she didn't know technique for babyboomers. She attempted to cover this mistake in glitter, but I asked to just remove it all. She replied, "It would be too hard." I agreed at this point. 

I asked for coffin shaped nails. There are irregularities in set, bumpiness between cuticle and tip, right thumb was noticeably longer than the left. She then offered to paint over whole set with gel polish. 

She kindly discounted the service, I paid $40 instead of $45.  If you are from out of town, and normally go for pink and white acrylic, or solar, you will not be satisfied. Opt for gel polish or regular acrylics. Very kind tech and staff.

Do not come here for Pokémon products... prices are extremely marked up to the point  they are at scalper prices. They are a retail store and do not buy their products at a resale price so there should be no reason to list products 4-5x the msrp. Came in and seen a hidden fates elite trainer box a while back listed at 199!! Higher than any eBay price or any price around, they are taking advantage of consumers who don't know better and should be ashamed. Please do not give into and support this behavior find Pokémon products elsewhere, wal mart, target, eBay, Amazon ... anywhere would give you a better price. Very disappointed!

Five stars for the food, two stars for this  COVID Super spreader location. The Hostess, no mask, most of the employees no mask, customers walking in no mask, the place was packed! Let me k is when you enforce rules that show you care about ALL your customers.

Heard some positive buzz about this newly opened (2mo) Brazilian steakhouse and decided to give it a try for our wedding anniversary. Glad we did!  Visited mid-week for an early dinner. All service staff were attentive and organized.  

The food - wonderful!  Where else in Boise can you find tabbouleh at a salad bar?!  The selection and variety of quality salad bar items and churrascos (grilled meats) really sets this Brazilian restaurant apart from the other main contender in the valley. Lamb 3 ways and tender Fillet Mignon are great, however, the flank steak was a true surprise!  Boldly seasoned and complimented with a side of bright Chimichurri - delicious.

The price point fits the bill.  The variety is excellent and all items circulated well including the quarterly special (prawns). It was nice to not have chicken/pork pushed heavily during service. 

Texas de Brazil is a great addition to the Boise restaurant scene.

Very good food, both pizza and pasta were fresh and tasty at a great price. Family run, very nice hostess that was more than helpful. There isnt a ton of room in there to sit down but its certainly the best pizza to take out that I can think of and the pasta was very good. I would take this over any chain brick oven pizza place and its a great local business to support.

I needed just a little something to improve my looks for an outdoor festival so I looked on YELP and found Kris.  I've done all kinds of tanning before but this is the first time I've had someone come into my home.  Scheduling was easy and in a few quick emails we'd decided on the time.  Kris made me feel comfortable in my less than perfect body and gave me instructions on what to do for the next several days.  I have to say at first I didn't think the tan was going to be dark enough but it was perfect!  I'm a week out and still have a little color.  Next time my friends and I do a girls' trip we are going to have her come over for a tanning party!  Nice chattting with Kris, too!

I went to this salon on a whim because I had limited time available,  I could not get in at my normal salon and needed my nails done before an event.   My fill was completely rushed and was done in 20 minutes. No surprise within 5 days I have 3 cracked nails.  ( I haven't broken a nail in the past 7 months with my regular place.)  When it came time for the pedicure, they automatically applied gel without asking me (which I didn't want) and I ended up paying $85 for a fill and pedicure! Way overpriced for a low quality service.

#1.  First the bad - the dining room (cute) is not nearly as cool as the old building on Main Street.  That reminded me of "the old neighborhood".
#2.  Second, the medium - I don't think the menu is quite as large as the old one was, and it may not be quite as good.  Or maybe my tongue's influenced by my eyes (see #1).
#3.  It's STILL pretty darn good food.  The lasagna is always worth ordering, the pizza (not great) is consistently good, and I've never had anything here I didn't care for.  I wouldn't hesitate to take out of towners for here for solid, basic, home-style Italian food.

Oh, and the guy who said it's "the worst Italian I've ever had"?  He probably likes Pizza Hut.
Will not order from this location. After 45 minutes they cancel order. Sad for two little kids to be waiting for food to then just cancel.

If your hungry this is the place dor you! Portions are huge! Their sliders are full size burgers. I love the loaded potatoes. I was disappointed in their chicken fried steak but everything else is amazing.

I should have taken a pic of my meal. There was so much food! It was a Saturday morning and they quickly seated our party of six. Our waitress was charismatic and such a doll! It was wonderful to see so many happy, smiling faces! I modify everything when I go out to eat so I ordered the Tradish Benny and added their Maple glazed chicken, spinach, and mushrooms and removed the bread. BEST DECISION EVER! The up charge was reasonable for a giant hunk of chicken and it was one of the best breakfasts I've ever had outside of my own home. I like to get things I don't make at home, or would be difficult, and the  chicken was that portion. The flavors went together so perfectly! I'll certainly be back for this modified dish, and the service. 
The Idaho style potatoes, were a little bland, but getting them in their "hog style" added the roundness of flavor they were missing, which was really just a little salt. Over all, this was added to my favorite list of breakfast places!

We were shopping at The Village and wanted a quick bite to eat without waiting for a table.  The menu looked very promising, but the food just wasn't good.  I ordered the Teriyaki Beef with Chow Mein noodles, and my husband got the General's Chicken.  We got an order of potstickers to share.  Since they make the food to order (as opposed to stting in a tray like fast food version of Oriental) we were able to choose the heat level for the General's Chicken, which was a nice option.

The wait time for the food seemed a bit long based on the number of people ahead of us, but the cashier was very friendly.  The restaurant isn't enclosed -- more like a big food cart with a roof. Kind of food court style -- it shares the area with a Mexican restaurant on the other side.  It's open to the Village Courtyard, with a good view of the fountains.  You see/hear all the people coming and going, and we could hear a band playing nearby.  Definitely a kid-friendly environment.

Back to the food:  The potstickers were cooked nicely, but were bland.  The sauce served with them appeared to have been poured straight from a bottle.  The Teriyaki Beef was little chips of beef with some broccoli that were doused in a bottled sauce.  The Chow Mein ($1 upcharge)  was nothing but plain spaghetti noodles dressed in the same bottled sauce.  The local fast food Chinese place has better Chow Mein noodles!  The General's Chicken was a bit chewy and also made use of some sort of bottled sauce.

It was very disappointing as we were expecting something much better based on the menu and the Village location.  We won't eat there again.
Great location, drinks and food. Bartenders and owners are very friendly and fun. Highly recommend this bar

Born and raised in Idaho. By far the best pizza in Idaho. The ground sausage is absolutely delicious. Their pastas are also fantastic. Great food, service, and Italian atmosphere. Employees are helpful and polite. Highly recommend to anyone that enjoys quality Italian food.

Welp, two months these gals have been open and I just went. Wife and I decided to give it a try because she heard about it on Facebook. If you like Irish food, you are not some stuck up snob and like people then go to the harp. If you are on some tiny budget you shouldn't be at a pub restaurant in the first place. Local American Irish people own and operate this place. Angie was a sweetheart and Jamie is the kickass doesn't  need nor will she take any shit from you. We had a great time. Next time I'm bringing friends because everyone should have some Shepard's pie or bangers and mash from the Harp. Keep being amazing loved it.
Did a great job. Were able to get to me right away. Courteous, professional. Highly recommend. Will absolutely use in the future.

Um. Wow. Just wow. First of all, they come to you! No more going into a salon or vet, terrifying your dog(s). Second, I was absolutely amazed by their ability to do two pets' nails within 15 minutes. My dogs were actually EXCITED to go with them into the trailer and happy leaving too! The owners care about your pets and choose to build a relationship with them in a way that the pets totally seem comfortable near them. I'm just absolutely floored!! We will definitely be using them again!! Thank you Groomingtails!

When you first walk in, the ambiance, the ceiling lighting will impress. After being seated, our waitress explained how things worked as far as the salad bar and the meats.
We started out at the salad bar. The salads were delicious, the salamis and cheeses were delicious as well. Not your normal items. So if your looking for your basic salad bar, you will be pleasantly surprised. And don't forget the lobster bisque. Creamy and flavorful!
Next came the meats. Filet mignon wrapped in bacon, top sirloin roasted with garlic, beef ribs and flank steak was juicy and flavorful.
If you love lamb, the leg of lamb and the chops were to die for. The seasonings were salty, tangy and garlicky. I gnawed on the bone!
Parmesan pork loin, garlic pork were delicious! They also had some chicken as well as shrimp!
Don't forget the roasted bananas dusted with cinnamon and sugar! My wife couldn't get enough of them!
That was our experience. We had a great time. If you want to go on date night, or surprise friends or family with a great experience, this is a great choice. The service was great. I would have given 5 stars if they wouldn't have run out of lamb chops for awhile. Although the manager went out of his way to speed up the Groucho's to get a move on and bring them to me. I was impressed!

Excellent food! I was quite surprised that the food was that good because I expected it to be like PF Chang's, kinda greasy and gross but I was totally wrong! It tasted clean and fresh, not overly saturated with sauces. I fully intend on going back there!

I agree wholeheartedly with the first review! I work for a prominent HVAC company here in Boise and we purchased a fireplace months ago for a commercial job. now the insert showed up on time, but the surround and accessories never did. weeks have gone by and no communication from these guys whatsoever. They dropped the ball and refuse to take care of their business in a professional manner. When you CAN get them on the phone (which is RARE!) they have no idea what you are talking about and promise to call you back and then never do....just an awful place to do business with from top to bottom. for god's sake all they had to do was order everything and we installed it, and they couldn't even be an efficient middleman. If I could give this zero points I would. Steer clear if you don't want the headache

You know what is not fun? Finding out you have an abscessed tooth. You know what else isn't fun? When you find out that means you have to get a root canal. 

Odd as it sounds, having to get a root canal was my greatest fear as a child. Because of this, I have taken every measure to take care of my pearly whites and keep from having to every experience this. But, alas, life has a funny way of punking ya. When I was in 5th grade, I broke my two front teeth in half on concrete. (You're probably cringing. Trust me, I do too when I think about it.) Anyways, there was no need for a root canal when this initially happened. But a solid 11 years later and one of the roots started to die. 

When I started noticing symptoms I went to my Dentist (Dr. Montgomery) and she referred me to Dr. Eaton. They got me in that day for an examination, and after x-raying my teeth determined that I did indeed need a root canal. They gave me a prescription antibiotic to combat any infection that may have been forming in my tooth and got me on the books to get this bad boy dealt with ASAP. The first appointment they had was a few weeks out, so I took it because it was what I could get. However, I shared with them that my mouth was in a ton of pain and I'd love to get it taken care of sooner if possible. With a few cancellations and some luck, they called me back a few hours after I left my initial appointment informing me that they could get me in that week.

So the day that my greatest childhood fear was realized was actually not that bad at all. I showed up and was offered coffee (which I declined, because, well, I was going to sit there with my mouth wide open for two hours and I was trying to be considerate). When they brought me back to the chair, I was freaked out and nervous. But Dr. Eaton and his staff were so kind and personable that my nerves were calmed very quickly. Plus, to ease the tension, even more, Dr. Eaton plays music while he works (I'm talking, like old school rock 'n roll). Aside from the shots they gave me, it was painless and as comfortable of an experience as it could be. But, oh man, those shots were killer. Talk about a terrible ten seconds. Once the numbing kicks in, it's not bad at all though.

An hour later, I walked out of the office with a half-smile (my face was uber-duber numb) with a feeling of vindication as I thought about how this thing I was scared of wasn't really all that bad after all.

Thank you, Dr. Eaton and staff, for turning a not fun thing into a surprisingly pleasant experience!

Random side note/Pro Tip: I have Delta Dental, and they covered a good portion of this proceedure. I think my deductible ended up being somewhere between $80-$100.
Terrible owner. Never gonna shop here after working for them and how they handle things

The name alone drew us in. Overall we were unimpressed. Overcooked bacon  , over cooked pancake. We also had a chicken and waffle plate, under seasoned chicken. The waitress was friendly. No desire for a second visit.

This is one of the best medical experiences of my lifetime (I'm 81!) The time from check to out the door with me treated knee was 1 1/2 hours. No messy ER rooms to deal with, no delays dealing with  GP. Just get, get-er-done, and get out. Oh, by the way, knee doing fine the next day. Yes.

The HOA where I own a home has pawned off the HOA responsibilities to this agency and they are useless.   We have some real issues in the HOA and Valley Property Management does nothing.   However, when I first purchased my home, I hired a flooring contractor to install hardwood flooring.   I got a rude letter from the HOA about the contractor's trailer being in my driveway for 3-4 days (which is perfectly legit), but now that we have serious issues, nothing is being done.

Huge portion sizes! 
Brett and I split the chicken and biscuit 
It was perfect for us, I didn't even finish my half! 
Overall this was a very good meal, breaking things down individually I would have to say the chicken is what really does it for this particular meal. 
I thought the chicken was cooked to perfection and remained crunchy under gravy and an egg. Soft fluffy biscuit but nothing distinctive. The gravy was perfect for the dry biscuit but overall lacked flavor.
Like I said though it was a good dish, each ingredient worked well together. I wouldn't be upset if I got this dish again.
I like crispy potatoes and these aren't crispy but are not bad!
GREAT bold iced tea!! I'd consider myself an ice tea snob so seeing a dark glass of tea always makes me happy!
I am very much looking forward to going back here when I'm no longer pregnant and can get my hands on a Bloody Mary or one of their other unique menu items

We live literally 5 mins straight down Overland from Biscuits & Hogs and let me tell you it's all the will power we can muster to not go here every weekend for breakfast. We tried dinner once, and while it was good it doesn't hold a flame to their breakfast game which is on point.

When you ask about pancakes and the waitress/waiter warns you they are large please head their advice. Pancakes come out the size of wheel hub caps, no joke! The Trough Burrito is good size and well done along breakfast tacos or breakfast sandwich. We have found nothing bad on the breakfast menu.

If you read one thing, read my number 1 piece of advice. Almost every breakfast dish comes with country fries (sliced potatoes) and you can ask for "hog style". If you enjoy life and especially if you came in stretchy pants, this is your option. They have a homemade honey mustard they cut with their homestyle gravy which then drowns the potatoes and then sprinkle on small chunks of pork belly and cheese. You heard all of that right, if your mouth is watering like mine jump in the car and head down Overland! And now I'm in the car myself...

This may be the shortest review I ever write as this is a dry cleaning establishment and honestly, there's really not much to say about a dry cleaning establishment if they get the job done correctly and timely. On the Spot Cleaners got the job done correctly and timely. Went in to have five suits pressed and cleaned on a Friday early afternoon. The ladies at the front desk were very nice and smiling. They said everything would be done no later than 5 the next day. I said I have plans at 5 and asked if they're usually done earlier. They said yes usually and to just call ahead. Called the next day at 2 and they were done. Picked them up. Paid normal to MAYBE SLIGHTLY UNDER normal prices. Suits were clean and pressed nicely. Transaction complete. Hooray! No complaints here!

Good food! Great atmosphere! 
Get there early or get on their wait list in open table app. 
Trust me, you'll want to do this to avoid the long wait.

If i could issue negative stars i would! I spent days researching fence companies with my neighbor and we decided to use Meridian. WHat a disappointment.   They subbed out the job on my 1 acre lot and the work was horrible!  The simple post/rail fence was a mess.  They used home depot buckets with concrete instead of longer posts and sono tubes, The gates are still garbage and the weld wire was installed so high it was useless.  After contacting Scott at Meridian he sent the crew back out to fix the bucket fiasco and re attach the weld wire but the gates are still unacceptable. They damaged my concrete where the holes are to secure the gates as well.  I have tried numerous times to contact Meridian,  I called, emailed, and even asked for the GM to call me.  Nothing!  I have an outstanding balance that I refuse to pay until i get a professional job. Horrible customer service and poor quality.  I guess they just dont care about their reputation

Legit my new favorite breakfast place. Everything was spot on and the biscuits and gravy was stellar. Great staff, great experience, was fast but didn't mind us lingering and drinking coffee. The bacon... oh man the bacon....  seriously good food.

Roto Rooter has been a joy to work with, specifically our tech Skye. He came out a few times and helped us to find a cost efficient fix for some issues my grandma was having at her house. He was super friendly and professional and got the job done quickly and done well. We will use this company if any plumbing issues arise in the future. Also, the girls on the phone were super friendly and easy to schedule with. I appreciate how quickly they got someone out to my grandma's house in an semi-emergency at the end of a normal business day!

I really wish that I could give Sonic 5 stars.  I literally come here at least 4-5 times a week to get their perfect crunchy ice. 
The positives:
They always have ice (I have been to other Sonic's who run out)
They are friendly 95% of the time
When the food is made correctly & given to you hot, it's good. 

The negatives:
They do not give out the correct order about 80% of the time. 
The food that is delivered to you usually isn't made according to your specifications. 
They can be very slow. 
The workers don't know the menu well & the cooks are not trained to know what thing goes on different items. (For example, I had a worker argue with me concerning a hot fudge sundae. She was adamant that whipped cream did not come on the sundae & the picture on the menu board was incorrect. )
They tend to be sloppy when making drinks with different syrups. I almost always have to ask for my cup to be wiped off. 

Recently, this location has cleaned house and has new management. They have told me that they are working on all of the issues. I have my fingers crossed for all of the bugs to be worked out.  I will update my review once I see  a cha

I've been a customer since the 70's when they had one location in Ketchum.  Now I live in Seattle and only get to Louie's once or twice a year.  In the past 3 years the have botched 2 to go orders.  Bad odds.  When I emailed the "meridian@louiespizza.com" contact email the last time they screwed up my order, nobody responded to my email.  After a couple more emails, I called them.  Additionally, the product they serve now has changed.  The flavors are still very much the same, but the sauce is portioned out in probably a two ounce ladle.  I think there's a Meridian cop standing next to the sauce with his gun drawn, making sure the saucier doesn't exceed the 2 oz maximum.  This is a huge bummer, the meat sauce absolutely makes the lasagna.  To circumvent this, I order everything with extra sauce.  If you don't order the pizza with extra sauce, it will have no sauce at all.

Last night I called my order in and arrived to discover that the order didn't exist.  I had to re order and wait another 25 minutes.  I got home to find the lasagna with extra sauce had the new standard two oz portion, no extra sauce.  The pizza I ordered with extra sauce was as dry as sand.  The ravioli with extra marinara I ordered turned out to be ravioli with cream sauce.  It was literally swimming in cream sauce, overly spiked with nutmeg.  Yes, nutmeg.  I was actually glad to try the cream sauce until I tasted it.

As a 30 year veteran chef, I am so bummed to come to the realization that one of my most cherished taste memories is pretty much gone.  Perhaps I'll just order the take and bake lasagna and see if I can talk them into parting with an adequate amount of sauce to accompany it.  I wonder how much extra they would charge to part with more than a half cup for a pan of lasagna?!  Sorry to say, Louie's has changed...and not for the better.

It's been a while since we have eaten at Louie's. We ordered food for delivery through Door Dash. We were very happy with the amount of food (leftovers!) and quality. We ordered the dinner for two combo, which included soup, pizza, fettuccine, rigatoni, and bread. You really can't beat the price for the amount of food plus the quality.

Pet Cutz (Kim) is fantastic!  She has been bathing and cutting our 11yr old Newfoundland (135lbs) for about 2 1/2 years and we couldn't be happier. Ben (our Newf) was rescued at 5yrs old and is not a trusting soul; however, he has warmed up to Kim like she is an old friend.  We don't even have to be around now for him to go with her readily.

What my wife and I did in 3 1/2 hours, Kim can do in 1/2 the time.....with 10x's the results!  He is thoroughly bathed, teeth brushed, nails clipped and blown out.  He always looks and smells great.

Pet Cutz is INCREDIBLE curbside service.  Fully self sufficient, modern and clean.  We could not recommend her enough!!!

We came here for the first time with some friends visiting from out of town. Upon being seated we were run through the process at Texas de Brazil. Dinner is all you can eat for around $45 not including drinks or dessert. I stuck with water but found wine and cocktail prices reasonable. Soda, however, is $5 which felt ridiculous to me. Our server started by bringing over Brazilian cheese bread and directing us to the salad bar. The cheese bread tasted like a fluffy cheez-it and the salad bar was well stocked and also included some warm sides like rice, beans, gratin potatoes, and lobster bisque. Definitely don't skip the delicious smoked salmon or Brazilian vinaigrette! The meat is brought around on large skewers and sliced onto your plate. Our favorites were the herb marinated pork loin and steak picanha but we enjoyed everything, though the lamb wasn't for everyone. They also brought out amazing garlic mashed potatoes and fried bananas. The latter satisfied my sweet tooth. Servers were social, funny, and attentive and you could signal whether or not you wanted more food by flipping a coaster from red to green.

Awesome specialty pet food store! They carry all the high end brands and products and the staff are super helpful in providing you with everything you need.  They also make special arrangements to special order anything that they don't regularly stock.  Prices were reasonable, and they sent me home with lots of samples for my pups to try.  I will definitely be back!!  This is a great store!!

The worst Chinese food I've ever had. And I've eaten there twice (I have a friend who likes(!) it), so it's not the luck of the draw. It's not because they don't use MSG -- according to the menu, there's MSG in everything. The flavors are bland and yet off. The crab rangoon came with this bright red gelatinous "sauce" which tasted liked nothing. The egg rolls were filled with oily ground pork and not much else. I don't remember the other dishes except that they were bad. Avoid this place.

Groomingtails is an excellent facility. We have an old dog who gets very scared at the groomer's. Jay and Alison have the patience of angels, and they see our skittish boy through the experience every time. We are very happy with them. But most importantly we absolutely trust them.

The front desk lady said I had threatened her and said and I quote from her that she told "he said he was going to jump over the table and take care of the paperwork and schedule it on the computer himself" I never once did that, and because of it and her calling the police I can't get my surgery in a few days. I'm 22 years old and I can't fight against the police or make an argument over an older lady that works in the front. They had lost paperwork, they didn't send out a refer email that has to be sent from them that i asked over a week ago. And this all happened today. This  is ridiculously unprofessional and unfair. Taking a kid out of a surgery he needs when multiple Disappointed in the staff and how the treatment was.

We have been here a couple times. Cool atmosphere and great selection of beers on tap along with some tasty cocktails. The spicy jalapeño margarita is good. They serve appetizers and sushi which is pretty good. Servers are friendly and attentive if you reach out to them but they walk by tables with no eye contact and don't ask if you need anything or would like another drink. All in all it's a great place.

DO NOT USE THIS COMPANY. I saw a few negative reviews before hiring them but I thought I'd take my chance because there were more good than bad. I should've listened to my gut. 

We hired TVE in April 2021 to replace the siding on our 1,300sq/ft home. The work they've done does not reflect what was promised by Max (the owner) at all and we've had to ask them to come out over 6 times to replace broken boards and other things, repaint sections, replace all of our outlet covers that they broke off for some reason.. while they repeatedly asked for payment for a "completed" project that is still incomplete almost 5 months later. 

These pictures are what we're currently still dealing with. The house and carport needs a second coat of paint, the caulking is extremely messy, and a section of board still needs to be completely replaced. The JamesHardy board which is supposed to be weather sealed is not due to crooked gaps in the butt joints from improper installation. We also ordered a 50's style awning which came 6 inches too big on each side and they have not offered any solution. Often they came out to "fix" something only to make it worse and have shown zero communication to complete our project. This whole process has made me feel like just dollar signs to them.
I have had many things altered here and the service is always great and fast with reasonable pricing. Very friendly but a slight language barrier.

TJ and crew did an AMAZING job painting the exterior of my home. 3 of them got the job done in 3 days and were meticulous in their work and cleaning up each day. Super nice guys too!

Kyle was terrific to work with and very quick in coming out to discuss my ideas and provide an estimate. 

My color scheme and placement was a bit involved and the guys did amazing on all the cuts and corners.

Couldn't be happier! Thank you Kyle & TJ!!

This place Wasn't necessarily diet food LOL but it was fantastic fun place to stop and eat whether you're having breakfast lunch or dinner my wife and I had a great time staff was awesome vibe was way cool, this is definitely a place we will visit a second time

What I liked about Envi, great communication, came out the same day I called them! I purchased a one time exterior spray on Groupon. Even though I didn't opt for their yearly subscription I still feel like I should have seen results (because a one time exterior spray is over $100) for that much I should notice a reduction in bugs! Really wanted to like them but feel let down.

Like this place for breakfast, and we use to love it for Happy Hour, but not so much anymore. They removed all food and some drinks from the Happy Hour menu, including our favorite favorite Sloppy Hog Bloody Mary. They did however add some additional drinks which are nice. We thought this was one of the best happy hours in Meridian or Boise for drinks and snacks, but not anymore. When we asked the server about the menu change, she had no clue. We might only visit for breakfast again, not sure.

Firstly the staff is amazing and very Covid friendly. The food was so flavorful, fresh and HOT!  We had stuffed mushrooms, so great with a bite of spice!  I had the Caesar and my mom had the creamy garlic dressing. All homemade and bursting with flavor!  For dinner I had the Chicken alarm with was AMAZING!  Mom had Shrimp Scampi and that was creamy yet light but strong, and that's what momma likes!  We had the Triple Berry homemade pie which literally was THE BEST BERRY PIE I HAVE EVER EATEN!!!  Served warm with thick, creamy vanilla ice cream. I will be ordering my pies here for all Holiday celebrations!  EAT HERE!

My grandparents wanted to order my family a nice dinner in for valentine's day, we placed our order 6 hours previous to pick up. When we arrived to pick our food up some of the iteams weret quite ready. We went home and realized they didn't get our ceaser salad nor the chicken on the alfredo we payed extra for. We drove back over and we explained our frustrations the hostess said alright and just walked away. It wasn't until the manager came out that our missing food was given to us. The manager proceeded to tell my grandpa the reason our food was missing was because someone broke their arm at 4. Take out service does not work.

Shared a sushi roll as an appetizer - delicious. I got the pad Thai as my main dish and it tasted better as leftovers. Also, it took them a solid 40 minutes to get our food out and the restaurant had plenty of empty tables. A little pricey in my opinion.

My take on B&H is: sometimes, less really is better! 

I rarely let my family choose were to dine because (1) I'm the Boise foodie and (2) somehow they always manage to pick the places with the most average tasting dishes. I really should have spoken up this morning but it was 6:30 am and I really wasn't in the mood to argue. So here we go. 

Seated as soon as we walked in, I began my meal with a cup of jo'. I will point out I did appreciate the large coffee cups - small cups drive me crazy because I drink coffee like my life depends on it. Decided to belly up to the Chicken and a Biscuit (maple glazed fried chicken on a split buttermilk biscuit topped with sharp cheddar cheese, two eggs and smothered in sausage gravy with Idaho home fries, $13.29) that I split with my mother. I'm glad I did. The serving was enormous, ridiculously oversized. My overall thought? MEH. There wasn't much taste. It was okay. The maple glaze on the chicken was yummy but not amazing. Nothing spectacular. Its like they *tried* to create something unique but didn't take the extra mile to truly do so. Momma thought the same (and momma's always right). 

Husband chowed down on a Breakfast Sando (Jalapeño jelly, cream cheese, signature pork belly bacon strips and fried egg on a grilled brioche bun, side of Idaho home fries, $11.99). To be honest he really only had a few bites before he said, "I can't take this anymore." I had a couple nibs. Overall, too much going on here. Should rename it Diabetes Sando! It was overwhelmingly sweet. The jelly was piled right on the middle of the sandwich, and I got a mouthful of it. Combined with the bacon that was literally ALL fat, I felt like I was eating grease scraped straight off the pan. Big miss. He agrees. 

On one other bright note besides the coffee, the home fries were good. 

I try to be fair and not allow other reviews influence my own but all the negativities were blatantly apparent and I should have steered my fam the other direction. I do want to also point out that not one person was wearing a mask which goes to say how much the operators care about their patrons, little to none. They are in the business of making money, and that is it.
