The service was good but the food is mediocre for a high price. Some meat was raw while others were dry and over cooked. The buffet was neglected even though the place wasn't busy. We won't be going there again. The other Brazilian place in town is much better at 2/3s the price.

Excellent service!  We had a group of 9 adults on a Sunday morning and they were very accommodating. The menu was perfect with many choices. Everyone loved their food which came out hot and all at the same time. The only item that I was not 100 percent happy with was the scone which, in my opinion, was more like a sopapilla or doughnut.  To me a scone is more of a biscuit style. In the future I will get the cinnamon roll, which looked great!

This sounds really crazy saying I thoroughly enjoyed my root canal experience with Dr. Eaton, but that's my story and I'm sticking to it. Had a horrible toothache over the weekend and still couldn't get in to my Dentist until Tuesday. After an X-ray my dentist really wasn't sure if I needed a root canal, so he called Dr, Eatons office to see if he could look over the X-ray. I got a 2:00 appointment and sure enough I did need one. Dr. was very professional and explained step by step what was happening. He told  me I should be totally free of pain when my anesthetic wears off. I had my doubts, as I remembered the pain I was in when I walked in.  Sure enough, pain free and thankful for Dr. Eaton's expertise, and his friendly knowledgeable staff.

So, I'm not one to write reviews, but I've had it with poor customer service and the attitude that my time isn't valuable. My 6 year old had a 1:00 appointment. He was so excited to get a "big boy haircut". We signed in on the computer, designated when asked that we had the 1:00 appointment, and waited. At 1:30, no one had even acknowledged us, so I interrupted a stylist to ask what the problem was. She first said that my son didn't have an appointment. Then she "found him" and basically just shrugged it off and said we could wait another 20-30 minutes or leave. I asked what the point of having an appointment is if they don't reserve time. She said appointments are one hour slots... but we would have been waiting an hour WITH an appointment, which means they took someone else in our slot. We left, and my son is crying. The worst part is no one was even apologetic. I see from other reviews this is typical at this place, so that tells me this is not a company I want to do business with. It's a shame because the actual venue is super nice and affordable. I've sent this same review to corporate!

Hands down the worst property management company on the planet. Zero ability to get anything done in our neighborhood. Their only management style is management via procrastinating until the problem goes away or dely with by someone else. Mike will tell you what he thinks you want to hear but will never follow through. The day the neighborhood is turned over to the residents and no longer controlled by the builder, this company will be fired..

We were so disappointed with our experience here. There had been so much hype prior to it opening and we decided to have a special meal out for Valentine's Day. When we arrived, there were many open tables which was alarming for it being a Friday night and Valentine's Day. We sat down and our waitress came over. She promptly explained the menu and took our orders. After that, the service went downhill. It took 15-20 minutes to get our drinks after we ordered. The meat selection was ok, as was the salad bar. Our waitress provided terrible service by leaving us with empty glasses and dirty plates on our table and didn't come check on us. Save yourself some money and go to Tucanos! Better food, better service. Definitely will not be returning.

Our new neighbor contacted Meridian Fence to install a three rail fence on shared property line. Our neighbor has two dogs. He wanted welded wire attached to the fence. During the initial process Meridian Fence only talked to our neighbor because we had not moved in. We received an estimate from our neighbor and later from Meridian Fence. No one from Meridian Fence contact us to confirm the approval the estimate nor with a date that the fence was going to be installed. We just moved in and Meridian Fence shows up to install the fence. During the installation, we see that they are attaching the welding wire to our side of the fence. We told them the wire was to be installed on the other side (neighbors side). Meridian Fence bills us to move the wire. NO ONE said that their would be an additional charge to move it. Well, billed us to move it. 

We have 12 posts and 36 rails with holes (see pictures). The installers smeared caulking on the holes. Looks horrible. Further, just a FYI our neighbors are constantly having trouble with their gates. Luckily, we didn't have Meridian Fence do the rest of our fence. We are still research for a reputable fence company. We are finding that companies in Boise want the work, but the workmanship is poor - like Meridian Fence.
The environment is awesome. It's a very cozy wonderful environment especially on a chilly day. The drinks are great and the food is awesome. Very rich flavors very homey.

I can't review about the food, but the experience was no good. We walked up and asked for a table for two, the hostess look at me like was from a different planet. He said it's about 30 -35 min wait so I gave him my number and say he will text when our table is ready. So we left and looked at the clock and it was 45 mins and no text... so we went back and he told us that they are cleaning up tables ... I felt he was just blowing us off .. so I guess that would be it for that place..
Made a customer for life tonight. Great service, great beer. No frills, just beer. Exactly what we were looking for tonight! Thank y'all!

Store selection is very diverse and eye-grabbing. Got some good products. When going to check out, we waited in line for 7 to 8 minutes for someone to help us. There was only one cashier and 15 people in line. Management came by to help price a customers product but didn't think to help check the long line of people out. One customer even walked out of the store. Coordination with other cashiers will help improve incidences like these.

Wonderful food & atmosphere! 
Our waitress Lauren was very friendly and very helpful, even though they were extremely busy she was sure to get us everything we needed right away and with a smile! We will definitely be back... the nachos were AMAZING!!
My husband, 20 yr & 6 yr old sons love this place. I am glad they found a place here. The haircuts they come home with always look great!

Absolutely worth a visit for a milk tea with boba (my favorite in Boise), or you can't go wrong with one of their other delicious drinks. The service is usually fairly quick and pre-COVID they were very accommodating with bringing your own cup.

I really had high hopes for this place. My buddy and I went and I had ordered the chicken and biscuits. No gravy. The guys in the back put the gravy on the side. I guess just in case I wanted it. The potatoes with it were really good!! The biscuit itself was super dry and crumbly. Maybe that is why they have the gravy. I asked for some jam or jelly. It did help out, but because the biscuit wouldn't stay together it was just too hard to eat. Couldn't taste the cheddar on the chicken. I cut open the chicken and it looked so weird. I don't know what was wrong with it, but I knew it tasted weird. Maybe it was an off day for them. I'm not sure. I'll go one more time and try it out. 

The waitress was super nice! She was helpful and friendly.

I'm Not sure why this place has 3.5 start rating. The portions are big. They're tasty and it's the perfect brunch spot. The mimosas and bloody Mary's are awesome and original (although I wish they were bottomless ) the drink specials and happy hour is awesome. Best brunch spot in the area.

We came in hoping there would be an alternative diet we could feed to our Bichon Frise who has been on a special diet for the past 8 years but we were not comfortable because of all the preservatives in her food. The staff were so knowledgeable and friendly and walked us through all the available Alternatives we had to choose from. They are amazingly attentive and caring and extremely knowledgeable. We put her on a new diet and she is doing great and has more energy than she has had since she was a puppy. Also the scoop your own dog treats are fantastic and the dogs love them. Such a warm inviting and personal place to go and will always be coming here from now on for all of our dog's supplies. Highly recommend coming here and the prices are extremely reasonable.

The best pizza in idaho. All pizzas come in 12 inch and thin crust. The dough is authentic and fresh. Perfect amount of toppings. It's a brick oven pizza wood fire sent from Italy. It has the perfect tiger spots aka chard. They have a nice menu and also serve a couple pasta dishes. Beer and wine selection from local wineries. It's a local family owned business and not a franchise. The service was excellent loved seeing their kids helping out and checking frequently with us. Definitely will be returning frequently.

I grew up in eastern Idaho where the original Big Jud's was born. So it was to my surprise and delight when they built one in Boise and then Meridian. 

If you want a good burger and fries this is the place to go. The burgers are huge and juicy and full of flavor. But the fries are my happy place. Big and homemade and served with fry sauce (the original kind, none of that fancy crap). 

And if you aren't too full...make sure you get a milkshake, they are creamy and delicious. But I NEVER have room as the portions here are ginormous!

Seriously, in the mood for homemade burgers and fries? Look no further.
Best boba chain in Boise! Not the most authentic but always a yummy drink. I do wish they had more flavor options! Way better than Boise Boba though.

First time here as a great friend recommended, Thank You Wendy :) 
Great service, super clean atmosphere, plenty of items to choose from. Ordered there Asian Peartini which was delicious  . Very busy & plenty of elbow room

This place has become one of our favorites, from their starters, entrees and wine selections are (Yummy) this place has pretty much something for every foodie out there and the service is excellent, very friendly and caring. You won't be disappointed.

I rated this restaurant a 4 Star review only because my food was at least 20 minutes later than the rest of my party of 6.  I ordered the Gluten free blueberry pancakes which took a very long time.  Had I known - I would've skipped this item when ordering.  They were, however, very very good!  

The other dishes ordered was steak and eggs, the breakfast burrito and the spicy omelet.  The children's pancake breakfast were huge.  Their food portions were big and you definitely didn't leave the restaurant hungry.  The waitress Mandy was simply delightful, efficient and very apologetic for the slow gluten free order.  She even gave a discount of almost $7.00 off the bill for the late order.  

Would I go back again?  Definitely!  As I know things like this happen from time to time.  My only recommendation would be to have management staff the restaurant appropriately on a Sunday morning.  All in all - the food is very good!

Cost Plus has a GREAT member program.  
About once a month they have a free item for their members.  A lollipop at Halloween, a free shopping tote, a pizza cutter on Pi(e) Day, etc.  And, every now and then they'll email a coupon for $10 off $15 - that's hot.  And then you pair that with sale and clearance items to make the deal go ever further.

I love the way the store is laid out, there's always something new and interesting.  But some items aren't there all the time, so if you find something you like, grab a couple of them - or more - because it may not be there the next time you come.  Though there could be something different and better :)

This is for the location on Caldwell in Nampa.  The clerk at the front was friendly but the service was slow and the food was awful.  I ordered the pork and tempura shrimp with steamed veggies and rice.  The shrimp was good but the pork was dry as a bone and the rice/veggies were cold.  I will not be back.
Best breakfast around - never disappoints. Open another location in Caldwell ASAP. Good

Great experience being new to the area. They were efficient and punctual. Everything was explained and they were very thorough. No up-selling and they were very professional. I would recommend them with confidence.
This is the best movie theater! I love the heated recliners, super cozy way to watch a movie.

I was with a large group having dinner in one of the reserved dining rooms, so I understand the service might have been slower than usual because of the number of people we had.  But the service was REALLY slow.  From arriving, to ordering, eating and paying, I was there for 2 HOURS!  That's WAY too long when all I wanted to do was eat and get out of there.  

I ordered some Chicken Lettuce wraps for an appetizer, but when it finally arrived, I found that really had no flavor, other than perhaps the scorched char of chicken that didn't get moved around in the wok frequently enough.  The lettuce wraps at PF Changs are MUCH better.   Fortunately, the server offered to remove them from my check, which she did.   

I ordered General LIng's chicken with a $2.50 upcharge for fried rice.  When it arrived, I was surprised at the small portion size.  I had expected a serving of fried rice on the side with the entree filling the rest of the plate.  No- the rice wasn't even visible underneath the entree = small portion.   When I bit into a piece of the chicken, I thought it might have been tofu, because of the mushy, soft texture.  This is either good, meaning the chicken was cooked so tenderly, or bad, meaning it wasn't really chicken ?   I'm used to chicken in Asian cuisine having a bit more bite to it.

The food tasted good, though I prefer all the vegetables be diced to a smaller size.  I didn't eat the red bell pepper chunks, because they were too big, and would have given a weird mouth-feel to the dish.  Same thing with 3" long pieces of scallion, which I fished out (no knife included in the napkin with the fork, and no offer of chop sticks.)  I found the sauce to overly sweet, and not all that spicy, despite the fact that I had asked for it to be made extra spicy.   Although I didn't order Kung Pao, as a general sense of what this dish tasted like, it came off as Kung Pao Chicken meets Taco Time hot sauce.  It was okay, but not really what I had expected.  

I only drank water, but with my entree, fried rice upcharge, and mandatory 18% gratuity, my ticket came to just short of $22, with no leftovers to take home.   For the same price, I could have gotten a lot more food at one of the better Thai or Chinese restaurants in town and had several meals for what I paid.   Sorry L&L- I'm not in a hurry to dine here again real soon.

My husband and I both agreed that Tucanos was better. If you want the same experience for about half the price go over there instead. I like the set up at Tucanos more too. It felt too crowded here and it was an all open space. I like it to feel more private and intimate when I eat out at a place like that.
She got my clothes taiored like how you would buy in the store, very professional, and on time. The best alterations ive recieved, i will come back again.

To start, as much as I hate reviewing reviewers, I actually love it so we'll start there.  As to Spencer's review, welcome to the world of card shops.  Much like gyms and head shops, there is a certain aroma related to these sorts of establishments.  They can't really spray them down at the door, so complaining about BO is more a review of society than of a store.  That being said, I have been here numerous times, and the smell of the place is usually bearable.

Now for the meat!  As a magic and board game player, what I look for in a store is an assurance that the experience for a gamer matters to the store, and a willingness to consider the customer's enjoyment when making what are business decisions for the shop.  In Phoenix Fire, I have never found any reason to question the ownership's dedication to the local gaming community.  In the treasure valley, we are lucky to have a good selection of gaming stores, and Phoenix Fire, for me, stands at the top of the list for actual places to play those games.

Too busy for take-out.  Called to place my first order shortly after they opened Sunday afternoon, only to be put on hold and then told that they were too busy to take any to-go orders.  Only sit-down customers were going to be served and they were "booked solid" for the entire afternoon and evening.   I'm sure that DoorDash, Grubhub, and Uber Eats didn't appreciate this management decision either.

Our first time here and won't be the last! Jenny and Megan took very good care of us. We stopped just to have a drink before dinner plans with friends. 

Happy hour prices are amazing and we had the Hog style fries that were incredible - the hog sauce was amazing!!

Boomer, the owner was out and we talked to him - so personable and appreciative. We tried the Smoking Campfire drink and you MUST try it!
I literally drove here to get boba from Portland, OR. It's that good. Definitely a must go to place in Boise. My favorite is the taro milk tea :)

The communication at this office is not good. 
My husband saw a doctor who prescribed antibiotic eye drops for a cyst on his eye. He was told to use them 4x a day for a month and if it wasn't gone after that, to make an appointment to have it cut open and drained. 
We went back in after a month with no improvement of the cyst expecting to have it cut out. Our apt was at 430p. We didn't see the doctor until 630p. For those two hours, we saw multiple HCW passing us seeming to be in a rush and we were given no updates on timeframe or when we would be seen.
After finally getting in to the doctor, he proceeded to tell us the eye drops we were prescribed were useless and to come back in two weeks if it hasn't improved after using hot compress. Mind you, the cyst has been present since October, 6 MONTHS, and is affecting his vision.
It seemed like they just didn't want to start a procedure that late in the day and brushed us off for another two weeks.
I wouldn't recommend this office unless you enjoy a 2 hours wait with no communication.
I am rating the tailor, Michael. He let out my suit and pants, and did it in less than a week over Christmas.

Great food and although they make their name off food quantity, the quality is always great. We always get one of the giant burgers and split it up and with the huge drinks and tons of tots or fries, you won't go away hungry.

It may seem petty but the only reason for less than 5 stars is that they are not set up for parties of more than 4 people. They have small booths and just drag over a chair for a 5th person so you're jammed in there. If they could fix this small thing, they'd have a clean sweep.

Went on a brunch date with my boyfriend. They've got big delicious portions. Our waitress was quick and accommodating. The ambiance was nice and the place is great to take friends and family. Can't wait to try the drinks next time!

I stopped by Ulta today for 2 reasons:
1. To get my free birthday gift
2. To try out the It Cosmetics brand. 
I browsed around the store looking at all the make up goodies & scoped  out the girl who had the best makeup application on herself. I found Rachael.  I explained to her that my skin has become totally strange since moving to Idaho 8 months ago. I told her that I was interested in the It line, but I was also open to other brands. We discussed what I needed as far as coverage as well as the overall condition of my skin.  She told me that It would be a good brand for me.  She asked if I wanted her to apply some to see how it looked & I happily accepted. She used minimal amounts of the make up & made my skin look gorgeous in less than 10 minutes.  She answered ALL of my questions without a hint of attitude. She was very knowledgeable of all of the product lines & I appreciated that a lot! 
After she finished applying the makeup I looked in the mirror and was floored! It looked great!  She didn't use a ton of product & she explained everything she was doing as she applied it.  I'm pretty confident that I will be able to replicate what she did. I love how my skin looks and feels. 
This is truly a great Ulta location! If you haven't been here before , I highly recommend going out & checking It out.  I also recommend asking if Rachael is available to help you out.

I contacted Meridian Fence for two fencing projects. The person came out and measured and we discussed particulars regarding the job. When the fencing was installed the condition was less than expected and what I specifically stated that I did not want, I got. I sent an email asking for someone to come out and address the concerns that I had. He showed up the end of April and agreed to address the issues. Nobody ever came out and no correspondence was ever received until the first part of July. Seems that a two-week family vacation got in the way of the job. Bottom line, the quality of the work and the customer service is not acceptable. This company is not even worthy of receiving one star, but since that is my only choice they should consider it a gift.

Seriously underwhelmed here. This was our first (and last) visit here. The food was so bland that we had to put soy sauce on everything just to have some flavor. Portions were small.  The service was sub-par.  We waited quite a while for a waitress to come to our table and then after we got our food, she didn't reappear until we were done. Our drinks weren't refilled, and they were out of diet soda.  Really disappointed.  We could have had probably better food for less money at Panda Express.  (Sadly).  Mongolian beef had no taste....
Looking at Dog groomers and sent Groomingtails a message. It's been about a week now. Nothing came back. Crickets!

Great food and great friendly staff! My family tried this place for the first time! My son yelped restaurant and food places with at least 4 star ratings in the area and found this one! We tried the Korean BBQ, sweet and sour chicken and general's chicken and enjoyed every dish! Good price for the right portions. The food was very flavorful with just the right spice to it! :)
Love my Zamzows! Super friendly and helpful staff. Very knowledgeable about our lawn and the annual lawn care program is great.

I'm From Utah but I Visited Boise For A Tournament. Their 
Caramel Macchiato Is Way Better Than Starbucks. Would Definitely Recommend!

Fantastic food had amazing sushi, we had a bit of a mixup when we ordered asian nachos but other then that amazing service and food! I'm not sure how to spell her name but our waiter was Nickola, and she did a great job I'd say she deserves a raise.

The old owners of this location had better food and service. Staff rarely wear masks at all, and if they are wearing masks they're around their chin. The Katsu is far more breaded and greasy than the old recipe. The teriyaki has consistently made me queasy, the noodle dishes are greasy. It's convenient, but Yokozuna is far better. Wish they were closer.

Firstly. Brilliant name, Rice Works. You think... "rice, my feelings are neutral to positive about rice..." and then you think... "works... rice works. Rice DOES work. Just gotta add water. If you don't add water rice is the worst and we can all agree on that." Remember when you took a handful of dry rice to see if you could eat it? No? You haven't done that? Hm, lemme know when you decide to do something with your life.

I can't remember why I thought RiceWorks was brilliant but whatever. I really enjoyed the generals chicken. And I got it level FIVE spicy; if you love spicy foods, five is for you. And it burns so good. If you're not a spice person stay far away from FIVE unless you want to be snotting and drooling for 30 minutes. 

They have many Asian fusion type dishes so there's a little something for everyone. The cooks do a great job, the dishes are flavorful and zesty!

Like most people around The Village area, everyone is quite nice here at RiceWorks. Five Stars for the crew... five... SPICY Stars...... ehehehehe, see what I did there? Do you see! Do you?! Do YOU?!?!?!? Why isn't anyone looking at me!???? LOOOOOK AT ME!?!?! Don't leave me alone in this prison of ambiguity and anxiety!!!! What are we?!?! What is this?!!!?! 
That was a test and a warning to never write a yelp review while on ayahuasca.

I gave this place only 4 stars because I felt for what I was getting the price was a bit steep. If they threw in a cookie or a side or something I could see being okay with what they charge. But I wasn't okay with it. I was extremely mildly upset about it. Extremely mild. So mild I forgot the price bothered me until I got back to my apartment and took a bath. And in the middle of the bath I thought out loud... "liiiiiiiiitle steep." And my rubber ducky responded, "shut your face."

I went to DOC for knee pain.  I was given cortisone shots at 2 weeks apart and prescribed physical therapy.  After 4 weeks I asked for an MRI.  I was told that they had no idea what was causing the pain. End of help for my knee.  They did a good job of referring me to the Idaho Spine and Pain clinic for help with arthritis in my back.  Dr Zarse from Idaho referred me to an orthopedic dr who finally recognized it was not a knee problem but a hip problem.  I feel like DOC should have referred me but PA didnt.

I was really excited to go here for the first time, as it is right down the street from our new home. When we arrived, I was pleased to see it was busy and they were doing well. However, we ended up leaving because not one single employee was wearing a mask. We are in the worst part of this pandemic and I think it's completely socially irresponsible and unethical. Despite what you might think about the masks, as a hospitality company, it's your responsibility to make sure your patrons feel safe. I will never be going back. I've already told many people about this, as I am in the restaurant industry as well and I know that patrons want to feel safe when they go out.

We had high hopes of trying this extremely cute establishment but those expectations were sadly dashed.
The chicken in the "Chicken and Waffle" was less than stellar. The waffle was very generic in taste. The maple syrup did not remind me, at all, of 100% maple syrup that I'm used to.
Both orders of our beautifully thick bacon was uncooked fat and yet somehow the meat was black and semi-charred. 85% of the bacon was inedible. 
The pancakes were like huge cardboard frisbees. Not sure how one ruins pancakes, as they had almost no taste or fluffiness. Any other conceivable place would have better pancakes. 
I hate dissing this place as our server, Lauren, was beyond lovely and kind.

Excellent service, and incredibly quick.  The alterations were well done, and the owners of the business were very accommodating.  While the services were not inexpensive, it was worth the cost.  On time, well executed, and pleasant all around.

The food is definitely worth the wait but being able to place a reservation on open table makes the wait a non issue. Very large portions, everything is flavorful, reasonable priced, and the staff are very attentive.

Love me some good Chicken Pad Thai and a great cocktail. Fun spot to hang out with friends and family all while enjoying some delicious food. Not uber fancy but elegant enough to enjoy a lovely dinner and affordable drinks. 

Bar area is a bit small but that simply means you'll be closer in proximity with the company you're with. Servers are very attentive and quite personable, not to mention, food comes out very quickly. 

Grab your bestie and hit up happy hour!

After seeing advertisements about this establishment via Facebook and hearing about this place on KBOI radio, we gave the happy hour a try. The tap beer pints are advertised $2.00 I confirmed with our server it was Happy Hour and the beers included. Not wanting food (which I.M.O. appeared over priced on the Happy Hour Specials menu) our order consisted of two Big Wave Ales and one Bud Light.  So that's $6.00 right?  WRONG that's $12.00! Our check said two Shocktops @ $4.00 ea. and two Bud Light @ $2.00ea. Our bill was $12.72  I brought this to our servers attention. She appeared unconcerned said "oh our tap list doesn't reflect your receipt." And said nothing more!  I explained what we actually had, the price and quantity as opposed to our receipt. She gave no further explanation of the erroneous charges, took the receipt and said "I'll fix it." She then produced our real receipt, $6.36 laid on the table and walked away. Our server appeared completely unconcerned and detached. No apology. No explanation. Nothing. Does this happen regularly? Substituting products and over charging at happy hour? If you do go to Biscuit and Hogs Happy Hour, check your receipt carefully before paying. We won't be coming back.

Came here for a pedicure which was pretty good. I believe they are trying to go for a sexy upscale spa look. During my pedicure I was exposed to classic rock, country and a variety of other music that did not support what they are trying to create. After traveling extensively and visiting spas I realize at panache they are still amateurs in ambiance.
This place was great! We have been looking for a fantastic dentist since moving to the area and Riverbend was perfect! Highly recommend

Outrageously bad customer service!

I arrived with two kids after driving 8 hours from Salem, OR, only to find the front doors propped open and NO ONE behind the service desk. Instead, there was a little note that directed me to call a # for assistance. When I called, it just rang and rang... it was the main number for the hotel. I walked the first floor hallway calling out, "Hello?" and there was no one around. The door to the office that said 'This door is to remain locked at all times' was unlocked and ajar. I repeatedly called the number to no avail. I seriously thought the employee had been killed or something. 

Another customer with a reservation showed up, and she too walked the hall while I called the main BW phone number. The person who answered called the hotel as well, but was dumbfounded as to help me get into my pre-paid room. When I asked what I was supposed to do, he transferred me to customer service... and they were just as unhelpful. 

FINALLY, after about 30 minutes, a young kid comes running up the hallway apologizing and saying that he was "helping" another guest. For 30 minutes? In their room? Right. 

When I finally got into my room I found a used Q-Tip in the bathroom, pubic hair on the shower walls, and a room that was not what I would consider BW quality. 

I'm not sure what has happened to this chain. They used to be a top contender for quality, and their prices still reflect that, but they have considerably dropped. This was the only BW that I used during my recent 14 road trip and I am SO glad. I will never book another BW or any property that belongs to them!!

The service was the WORST. They didn't ask us if we wanted more? You get one small salad for $29.99???? Hands down the absolute most terrible dinner experience we have ever had. The only offered us 4-5 types of meat. What happened to all the options they should have? Server....not that nice. He literally handed us the bill and then came right back with a credit and machine and stood over us as we looked at the bill. He then continued standing there watching as I tried to figure out a tip. So rude. So unprofessional. Save your money and go somewhere else.
They're rude. Horrible customer service! I don't think that we'll be getting coffee or boba from here again!

I wish I could give this a half star.  Only went here because Taco Bell was too busy, so that should tell you something.  Let's talk about the drive thru person, I understand your "need" for a mask but make sure whoever is working the Drive-Thru uses an adult voice because you couldn't even hear anything on the speaker.  I thought it was the speaker at first until I got to the window and with my radio off, no traffic I couldn't hear anything this guy was saying and he was less than 2 feet away.  Next, if I wanted a gas station hot dog I would've gone to the gas station.  Ordered the Premium Hot Dog, but again since I couldn't hear the person working Drive-Thru I might've known it actually doesn't come with any toppings.  I realize your workers don't actually require any skills and based on experiences they won't be working anything but this type of job.  If I was a military recruiter needing to make my quota for the month I would skip this place.  The food is the same as I'd find at any other Sonic so this is more on the "service", which as always is disappointing since I presume your night manager is probably in the back getting high or something.  Anyone who actually talked to their staff would know that someone with a soft voice shouldn't be working Drive-Thru.

I really liked this place - the food portions are generous and it's very affordable! The chicken teriyaki and pork teriyaki are very tender and flavorful. I think a regular plate portion can easily be 2 meals. Each plate comes with veggies (mainly cabbage and some broccoli) and a very large portion of rice. The yakisoba was probably the best deal given the amount of food you get, but I found it to be a little too saucy/salty, albeit very good. Great place for a quick teriyaki fix.

This cafe was recommended to us by family. It is off the main drag and full of locals. What a surprise as it was fantastic. Food was wonderful and service was fantastic. A great selection of breakfast menu items that fit everyone in our large parties desires. I would like to try lunch here. We don't get to this area often but will definitely be back when we return to the Boise area.

This was the worst visit I've ever had to a restaurant. And it was really disappointing because I love Burger King. The service was rude, we walked in and they said that could only be there for 10 minutes and then we had to go because they were closing the lobby. They wouldn't let us stay and finish. We ordered spicy nuggets, and those are the only nuggets we ordered. We got 3 spicy nugget bags, we ordered 12 bags and only got 3 spicy nugget bags. Very disappointed in the service and the fact they messed up our order this badly. And their medium drink was over $2 which is a lot for a drink at a fast food restaurant. Not pleased, increase your customer service and ordering skills.

A 40-foot pine tree blew over in a windstorm - pulled the roots right out of the ground.

I trimmed off all the limbs and put them in a pile, then called Senske.

A guy came by and gave me a quote which included taking away the pulled-out stump.  Then they called and wanted a pre-payment.  That should have been my warning.

When the guys came to do the work, they just put all the limbs I had already cut off into a shredder, then cut up the trunk and packed up.  I asked them about the stump and they said to call the company.

I called, and they said that they wanted more money to do the stump - even though it was already out of the ground.  And the original quote has written on it "Remove stump"!

I would NOT recommend this company for anything!
First time eating here. Everyone enjoyed their meal. The turkey sandwich with sweet potato tots were delicious.

Horribly over priced for the limited options available. Poor service. I felt taken advantage of honestly. I am willing to pay top dollar for quality food with good services, but the options are very limited and the waitress never checked on us for drink refills or anything. I left hungry and paid $150 for 3 people!
I've had the thai milk tea about 10 times now. AMAZING!!!!! DELICIOUS! and I moved here fr san francisco where boba is king lol.  So glad I found urban fox!!!!!

My husband & I stayed needed/wanted/deserved an overnight staycation , so on 3/7/20, we checked into Tru by Hilton. Since I am a Hilton Honors member, I was able to check in online & select my room. I did need to stop by the front desk in order to activate my digital key. 
Walking into the hotel, I was immediately impressed.  The aesthetics were very nice and the style was very modern & sleek. I felt like I had walked into an IKEA (not a bad thing). The front desk agent was very friendly. 
I had selected room 227 and I was very happy with the location. It was on the southwest side of the building, so there wasn't a lot of traffic noise from the freeway or Eagle Rd. 
Walking into the room, I was a bit taken aback by how small the rooms actually are.  There is no closet or dresser. The room was nicely decorated and the laminate flooring throughout was awesome! I HATE carpet at hotels. It grosses me out. The bathroom was rather spacious, but the water pressure was awful!!
We used the hot tub.  The pool/spa are is indoor, so that's nice for year round swimming.  The temperature in the hot tub was perfect! The only negative is that you aren't allowed to take any pool towels back up to your room.  I like to be able to wrap my hair in a towel. 
My husband and I slept well! The beds were comfortable. Also, the windows have black out shades built into the window on a track.
Breakfast on the weekends is served from 7-10am. I went downstairs to the lobby for breakfast around 730, it was very disappointing.  The eggs were obviously powdered and they were sitting in a half inch of water.  The chicken sausage had no color to it whatsoever.  There was no sliced bread for toast.  They offered several different bagel selections. They advertise donuts, but they had only 2 of one kind.  As far as muffins or pastries, they has a tray of mini banana nut muffins. They offered no individual yogurts, just  a large container of plain Greek yogurt.  No fresh berries.  The apple juice that they offered was only 10% juice.  They have a waffle bar where you can make fresh waffles. The waffles were good.  They advertised the syrup as warm log cabin syrup, but it was not warm at all. 
As you can see, breakfast is important to me.  Lol!
We had late check out and had the do not disturb sign on the door and while I was in the shower, there was a knock at the door and an attempt to open it by housekeeping. 
Overall, I just feel kinda meh about this property.  The regular rate for this hotel was $167 a night (although I didn't pay that).  For that price you can go somewhere nicer with better breakfast and amenities. If they stepped up their breakfast game, I would definitely stay there again.

Went there because of the 3 positive reviews and won't ever be back. Fish was greasy and Frye's we're almost done. Tried to over charge us $10 until I questioned the carhop. So be aware of the pricing if you go, so so disappointed, loved the original Hungry Onion.

Went the first time on a Thursday. The patio was open but we opted for indoor seating. We'll definitely try the patio next time to enjoy the live music. Nice ambiance indoors though. Very courteous staff. We had a lemon drop and cider on tap. Both were good. We ordered multiple appetizers as pit meal. The wings, fried green beans and lettuce wraps were very tasty. We shared a raspberry cheesecake roll for dessert which was heavenly! We'll definitely be back!

Installation was a mess. Carpet installed over air vents. Newly painted floorboards were gouged and chipped. Carpet laid in wrong direction in closet. Someone came out once to start repairs but did not come close to finishing. Owner totally non-responsive.

Do not use this company!  The estimate is more of a joke than an estimate.  You don't want these people in your home.  The one good review they have must have been written by the garbage owner of the company.  I found a better company and so will you.

If you're visiting and staying somewhere close, it wouldn't be a bad decision to give it a try. If you're after this kind of food you'll likely enjoy it or it will meet most expectations. Overall, it is a good but pretty forgettable place. If they still offer kids meals for free on Sunday, that is probably their best deal. Doesn't have options that will work well for everyone, but also has a few really great dishes.
Our first time here,  and it was amazing!!  The food was superb, and service was wonderful!!  The lasagna was outstanding!!!  We will definately be back!!!
The door was delicious! And the fact that you don't have to prefer from a menu was a very nice change. My only complaint was price. $180 for our dinner was a bit much.
They have the best Bloody Mary with bacon salt around the rim! And the pancakes are HUGE. I had the eggs Benedict and it was amazing. Definitely going back.

I made one call to John and he came out as soon as possible and had my generator working in just a few minutes, I hated that generator because it would only start when in the mood. I and others have spent hours with this generator and never made any headway. My next step was to actually replace it.
 But it now starts first time every time. John knows what to look for.
John even called a few days later just to make sure it was working correctly. 
I highly recommend John if you need anything to do with a generator.
gb

This location just doesn't do it.  The meat selections are just ok and the salad bar is really lacking.  If they copied the location in Las Vegas where the salad bar is at least twice the size with a greater selection then I would give them a better rating.  Also, offer more meat selections such as chicken hearts and maybe more exotic meats.  Another problem is that they have a great bar with a lot of drink options other than beer.  No tap beer and the bottle beers are BORING.  How about offering some more robust beers and IPA's.  For the  'per plate' cost and the above items I mentioned just doesn't make it worth going to this restaurant.  Maybe they don't think that Boise residents are sophisticated enough to have the same experience in other markets.  Big mistake.
Great food but swarming with flies snd the slowest and worst service ever on 3 separate visits.  Only order take out of you'll be very frustrated

I would NOT recommend this service. She came to our house as agreed upon--my husband made the appointment. I came home to find my sweet poodle-mix dog--with his hair almost shaved off!! There was absolutely no style--how easy for her--she didn't groom him--she just shaved him off-the poor dog was shaking during the mornings because he was so cold. Not knowing it was the same company--my hubby booked her again and this time I met her--She came to the door and looked like she didn't even want to be there--she didn't even greet the dog-just frowned and took him and shaved him down again! Never again--I made sure I remembered her name and business so we know never to call her again!!!
Great food choices! My little girl has dietary restrictions due to allergies and they accommodate that! Has everything needful and more. Friendly, helpful and welcoming staff!

I went to the new DOC in Meridian off McMillan Rd. Greeted the moment I came in. My knee has been off and on hurting for six months and my primary Dr just has not wanted to take an X-ray or anything. The pain increased this weekend so I thought I would go there. Got in to see them right away at 8:15 am. By 9:15 I had my X-ray and cortisone shot and was out the door. The Dr took time to explain all my choices. I came home feeling relieved. I would not have been able to see my primary Dr for another week.

Hired Boise Housekeeping to provide after construction cleaning services.  They required credit card up front.  Billed us for 8.74 hours of cleaning.  Attempted to clean approximately 90% of the items they marked as complete on the checklist they left behind. 

When contacted about a credit Boise Housekeeping was argumentative and stated the poor service on their behalf was our fault and our realtors fault because we didn't do a post cleaning walk through. 

See attached photos of items they checked as cleaned. Boise Housekeeping stated their was nothing in these photos to show they did not clean these items and the debris on carpet were snags.  Debris on the carpet was from new carpet installation.

I came in here today with 6 people for my birthday. I've been wanting to try it for a long time, and wow was I disappointed. The lady taking our order was so mad, and every question we asked was met with a snarky response. The other lady ringing us up was so confused, and couldn't figure out how to count or take our order properly. It was also really loud in there, and they mumbled a lot. The sandwich was fine, but not great. I can get the same at any other sub place, and another one will greet me with a smile. I will not be back here.

This review is for the clinic off of Eagle Rd
How can a medical facility have their phone AND the email systems down for 3 weeks!  First time, after a steroid injection for my hip, I remained in excruciating pain and could not contact the office...my wife had to DRIVE in to speak to someone at the front desk.  After an MRI follow-up appointment a week later, the doctor claimed he would call in a prescription for pain.  FIVE DAYS later, no call to my pharmacy.  Attempted to call office...NO ANSWER!  Attempted to call the Boise office in desperation...same thing, no answer.   HOW IN GODS NAME DO YOU RUN A MEDICAL FACILITY AND HAVE YOUR PHONE/EMAIL DOWN FOR THREE WEEKS!!!!!  Next call to my attorney....If you need emergency orthopedic attention, go the the ER...you'll get to see a 'real physician' and not a PA to attend to your problem.  One star is way too much of a rating!
Great coffee and vibe. I don't get to this side of town that much but when I do I definitely stop in for a cup of joe.

This is not the place to go if you're in a hurry, but the spaghetti is awesome and the waiter was so friendly, he made up for the wait time.  The decor is very nice and it's been very quiet with not many customers the times we have been in.  At first, we were very weary of this because that usually indicates a negativity about an establishment, but hey, we may have just timed it right, who knows.

I would recommend ordering the Balsamic/Vinegrette salad in lieu of the garden salad, as it has more of a Spring Mix of salad instead of just iceberg lettuce with some shreds of carrot.  The garlic bread is very good and both the meat sauce (which my husband ordered) and the marinara (mine) are both excellent.
Seriously amazing food, and great service. We come weekly and have never been let down

This is an amazing animal care hospital! We started bringing our dogs there about a year ago, and we felt right away that we found our vet care place! They care for our dogs now, young and old, some with very complicated health issues.  Our doctor is Amy Albrecht. She is thorough, reassuring and compassionate.  When you see her  examining your dog, you know right away that she loves animals and cares about their well being. She was great returning my calls regarding treatments, or when there was change in my dog's conditions and I didn't know what to do - she called back the same day, often even after business hours. We have also been seen by other doctors at the clinic when she was not available, and it was always a very pleasant experience.  Oh, and the front desk ladies are amazing, too!

If you're in the mood for outrageously priced mediocre food, you can't go wrong with Texas de Brazil, Meridian ID location.  There really is nothing to see here.  Remove the kitschy serving methods of various meats being brought to your table for $45 per person (+tax, drinks and desert extra) and you have a salad bar experience that falls way short of expectations for the $30 charge.  The G.F. and I paid $63 + tip for the salad bar (we cut our losses and didn't order dinner when we saw the unappetizing looking food at the salad bar) where the best offering was the lobster bisque soup and baked ham.  Couples in our group paid $97 + for an additional few bites of bbq meats that didn't look appetizing at all I.M.O. The consensus from some of the other couples was...meh on the bbq meats.  Also when the check was brought we were charged the full $45 per person price instead of just the salad bar price. After bringing this to the attention of our waitress, the correction was made. If you're inclined to eat at these types of establishments, I would recommend Tucanos.  At the very least the salad bar is twice as big.  What a waste of time and money. Pass. PAss. PASS on Texas de Brazil.

The only reason this place is amazing is because of Jamie! She cuts my husbands hair and does an absolutely fantastic job every time.
The first haircut that he got with sports clips was a mess and extremely uneven with one side almost shaved and the other awkward. My husband was upset. He went in and had Jamie fix it. Then started going to her ever since! Nice job Jamie! 

On a side note. They don't take appointments, so it's always a 20-40minute wait to see her.

Good food,  good atmosphere.   I have had most things on their menu, for the most part it is good. 

Lettuce wraps are awesome and so is the pork fried rice. 

I have not had their sushi,  so can  ot comwnt on that.   The Mongolian beef is also really good.

I'm hesitant to post this because I feel like  this is a hidden hot spot! We tried Louie's last weekend and I can't believe we haven't been there before. Best Italian in the valley! Family run and operated, which makes the whole experience even better. Louie even came out to check on our experience! Go suport this locally owned family friendly place! You won't be sorry!
Best breakfast within miles and great Friday mimosa special bring in your own mug and filler up for $5 bucks!~

The staff were very friendly and attentive and they have a great happy hour with $2 beers.

We sat on the patio but noted the inside had a great comfortable feel.

I had the Cobb salad which was excellent. My husband had the ribeye which was very good.

Will definitely be back.

Phoenix Fire really knows how to do customer service. As a hobby store they offer great selections of both board and card games. The staff is very accommodating and willing to answer any questions you might have. I highly recommend any try this local store and support the community.

First time visit for me, but I'll be back!  Great food, generous portions, good service!.  Amy S was our server and she was very attentive and friendly.  The bacon here is AMAZING...if for nothing else you need to try it for that!!

My Wife and I went into Big Jud's in Meridian, where we have eaten many times before, and the staff was shockingly rude to us. They were so rude that we ended up leaving and not even ordering any food, which was a shame because we had our punch card 1 punch away from a free burger. This place has really gone downhill in recent days.   :-(

This place definitely deserves a 2 thumbs down. Food was terrible & over priced for amount of food that they give you, waitress  was wearing small pants which her bottom half was showing, looked like she just woke up. When I went to pay, waitress went to the table to check if we tipped her.  Then had asked me twice why we didn't tip her and was mad. I could not believe she asked me that question. What was going through my mind was. Please wear your pant size, comb your hair and fix your make up when coming to work and asking for a tip. 
After leaving, I called the number on the receipt. I asked to speak to the manager & the same lady stated, "I am the manager "WHATS UP?" waitress did not let me talk to anyone higher. I will never eat here again. I only put 1 star to leave a comment.

The food was very good, but the price is on the high side.  We had problems with the service.  This is what has influenced the rating. Upon ordering one of our group ordered filet medium.  While we all enjoyed the salad bar and various meats she waited patiently for the filet.  After 40 minutes and multiple reminders of what she ordered the manager was summoned.  After about 5 minutes he finally came to the table and said he was sorry for the delay.  Still the filet did not arrive.  Then our waitress got the general manager and he also apologized. When the filet finally arrived it was bacon wrapped which she specifically said she didn't want when she placed her order. Nothing else was said by the manager.  In the end their meal was compensated $15, the cost difference between the salad bar($29.99) and the full meal ($44.99). We can say we tried it but it is very doubtful we will return.  There are plenty of other good and better restaurants in the valley to enjoy.

I am giving three stars because Dr. Dayton was great, however, their optician is absolutely the world's worst. First of all I can't understand one word she saying and second of all she did not check in when we were there to find out what our insurance covered -it took a week for her to call me back let me know the frames weren't covered so now we have wasted an entire week. I called the service provider and his lenses are covered but she didn't fill it out correctly so they didn't cover it with her. It's inconvenient because now I need to mess around and go pick up the prescription and go to somewhere else that knows how to actually do this in their optician department. Very frustrating. No mention of how to get back the co payment I made on the glasses.

I am updating my review from 5* to 4*
My last visit the veggies were back to being mostly cabbage.
My previous visit had lots of broccoli and carrots.
I was thinking that new ownership had upped its game and upped the veggie variation. 
Still pretty good place. 5* when they add more veggie variety.

I was really excited to try this place. First mistake we went the week after it opened. I know with all new places you have to have time to work out the kinks. The sad thing is this place has the potential to be an awesome burger addition to the Village after this visit I will stick the Yard House. My friends and I love to go the Village once a week we figured we would try the new burger place. It boasts a million different topping options(it would be nice if you could actually get them on your bun when you order toppings there lol I will explain later what happened to me). The place was packed when we arrived. we were seated and we ordered sweet potato fries for an appetizer out comes this little plate of fries. That should have been the warning that we were in trouble; I don't know if they got any part of our order right except for my one friend's food. The waitress comes over and we said is this the size we ordered she said no and took them back and brought us back the right size. Okay let me add a word of warning; the pricing can get out of control pretty quick before you know it you have a $25 on up burger. I love the concept having a variety of toppings to put on your burger I don't like the fact they nickel and dime you for everything. If you want sauce on your burger you have to pay for it. I liked the fact they had horseradish cheddar cheese. I ordered a burgers medium well with a bunch of topping on it on what I thought was a sourdough bun. What arrived was a plain medium maybe still mooing burger on a sourdough not even toasted slabs of bread. The rest of the table was the same way; toppings not put on the burger even though we had checked them on the order form. The waitress took the orders back and then brought it out for a second time. Well more of the same. The burger was still not cooked, two slabs of bread were not toasted and it was still missing toppings. I honesty was just tired to trying; the waitress did buy a beer for my friend she said she felt bad because they had couldn't get our order right. The manager of the place came over and was super friendly. He went above and beyond and gave us 50% off our order and told us all about the concept. He recommended getting the bison sounds awesome but not sure I want to pay that much for burger especially if they cannot get the toppings right after two attempts. The milkshake my friend said was very good. I was pretty disappointed as were my friends; we will go back to the Yardhouse for our burgers and beer. I hope they work out the kinks because by the reviews on here if they don't they will not last very long. Sounds like they could have used more training and dry runs before they opened their doors.

LOVE LOVE LOVE this place!! I moved from Portland almost a year ago and have yet to find a place that I love....until now!! Nail Tek and Spa is amazing!! I will never go anywhere else as long as I live in Boise. The attention to detail, the quality of products, the girly clean atmosphere, not to mention the employees are amazing. So nice and love to make you laugh. So glad I found this hidden gem!!
Amazing burgers and fries. One of my favorite burger places in town. Service takes a while but is worth the wait as everything is prepared fresh for you. Give it a try.

What a great place to grab a quick meal with friends and family! For some reason, it reminds me of a diner. Maybe because it's burgers and milk shakes, but they have a delicious Bison Burger! It's definitely the best one I've had so far. I prefer it over the one I tried in Montana, but then again, I do prefer some sweetness in my burger which I got from the caramelized onions. The fried egg threw me off, but it gives the medium done meat some moisture since Bison tends to be on the dry side. Overall I am extremely happy with their food. The buffalo chicken wings are crispy on the edges and flavorful, they make my mouth water just thinking about them. They also let you create your own burger which is a great twist and they have salad versions for your burger. Their refreshers sound very exciting, I wanted to order 1 of each! I'm definitely coming back just to grab one of their refresher options!

I'm an avid fan of french fries, so I definitely had to try this place out.  That being said, the vegan burger has so many great reviews, I was pretty interested to see how it is.  The staff here are very helpful and will patiently answer all questions with a smile.  They're also intuitive (when I ordered the vegan burger, they suggested some vegan options as well as asked me if I wanted my burger cooked 'off grill', which means they put aluminum foil under it).  I selected the meal deal, which is a burger, drink and small fry.  I also added the brussels sprouts, which I got without the 'jam'.  For my burger, I went with the original and added jalepenos and I went with sweet potato fries (hannah) for my fries.  They have a lot of different seasonings to select from, so I went with the siracha salt and the rosemary garlic.  

I'm a pretty texture oriented person, so I was hoping that the vegan burger would be substantial and firm.  The taste was great, seasonings spot on, however the burger was texturally not my preference - it was a black bean quinoa patty and it was pretty mushy, but it did stay together, as it was stuck to the bun, so at least it wasn't mashing out of the edges.  I ended up eating only a 1/4 of my bun, even tough it was also pretty delicious, and one of the employees was walking by, noticed this and let me know that you can also get the burgers without a bun, wrapped in lettuce.  

The fries were great and the small is definitely more than enough for one person.  The brussels sprouts were cooked well, although a bit bland without the jam on it, so if you get these, make sure to make use of their wide variety of seasoning salts to take these up a notch.

The main reason I'm giving this place 5 stars is because of the service.  Everyone here was so very helpful and the food wasn't outstanding, but it was good enough to make me want to go back and try more of their selection.

One tip I do have is that this is a small location with limited seating inside, so just be aware of that if the weather is terrible and you're going at a busy time (lunch, dinner rush), because there may not be any place to sit and eat.

Sauces at barbecue joints are deceptive animals. Many times, they're used as camouflage to cover up flaws from the meat. Such is the case at Dickey's.

I love pork ribs and while those in a rib platter lunch were meaty and tender, Dickey's forgot to pack them with flavor. They needed the sauce to give them any excitement. It's disappointing fare from a company that traces its lineage back to Texas and 1941. Maybe it's because Texas is known for beef barbecue and not pork.

The baked potato casserole was dry and needed gravy or something else to give it some moisture. The fried onion tanglers were good, though. The roll was of throwaway quality.

On Friday I used MFs website to order same day flowers (order placed in the morning) for a birthday. Just to be safe I called to confirm the order was received and that delivery would take place that afternoon- was assured all was good. Incredibly disappointed when the recipient called on SATURDAY to thank me for the flowers that had just arrived. I like supporting local small businesses, but l would have saved the extra money on the mediocre (at best) boquet and late delivery had I realized this was the type of business I was dealing with. Bummer!

My wife and I just moved here (Meridian) from the Sacramento area (Elk Grove) of California. We have tons of IHOPS out there. All are the same. It's a hit or miss on service. Always a big guessing game on the quality of the food. It was so bad there that my wife and I were secret shoppers for a number of restaurants including IHOP. BUT ! this IHOP is awesome. ( Fairview Ave location) We have been here at this location a few times and I have never been so impressed with everything they did. From the quality of the food, to the just about best servers...... staff on the planet. They take care of you. If anything is not 100% they will go WAY out of their way to make it perfect. The district Manager "Noelle" is also very awesome. Hands down the this is the best IHOP over any other IHOP I have ever been to.

The fries are the highlight of this restaurant and there are just soooo many choices of potatos, cuts, sauces and seasonings. I tried the sweet potato and it was good enough to eat without any seasonings. They also had a great bison burger which served as a nice compliment to the main attraction of the fries.

Amazing! Came for a Daddy &Daughter Date! The restaurant was booked for a party. My little girl was devastated! Not only did they make her a personal pan pizza but delivered it to her upstairs! A+ Thank you! Made her whole night!!

I just had one of the best mani pedi experiences of my life!!!! I don't get on yelp very often to post comments so that should tell you how wonderful it must have been!!! Extremely high quality work and attention to detail!!!! Very friendly staff, comfortable chairs, incredible massages, and one of the best mani pedis I have ever received. Thank you so much Guys I will be back!!!!!
Alicia

While visiting with friends who live in Nampa, Idaho, we left a local event and were searching for food on Father's Day.  Not much was open!  Took a chance and came here, and we had a wonderful experience!

The patio was full, and the restaurant itself is very small, so there were no tables open inside.  As seasoned diners, however, we all know we get the best service at the bar, so - no problem!

The bartender and waitress were just delightful and we quickly became friendly with them.  Cocktails were delicious, and all of us really enjoyed our dinners.  I ordered ribeye steak, "as rare as you can make it", and a salad.  The steak came out more pink than expected  ::happy dance::   It was tender and seasoned perfectly.  Salad was salad - come on - but fresh, crispy, and tasty.

All in all, a terrific time was had by all;  in fact I think we must have been especially fun because the chef came out and chatted with us before we left!  Super thanks to Autumn, Ary, and Lolo - I'd be back if I lived near you!!

Great food and pleasant staff make this one of our favorites for sandwiches.  The variety of fresh breads is wonderful and the desserts are delicious.  Tuna on hazelnut or rosemary bread is our go-to here.

I've always enjoyed the Ram. They have a large menu with options for everyone in the family. The staff is very friendly and the happy hours are pretty good. 
I just don't like this location all that much. It feels like every other chain. The best Ram to go to is the one at the corner of Broadway and Park.

Cool joint with a fresh take on burgers and fries. A variety of potatoes to choose from for your fries, then variety in flavored salts a dipping sauces. The employees were also upbeat, friendly and helpful to me, trying this place for the first time.

Breakfast is way better than lunch. The first time we came here was for lunch and my husband and I were both not impressed. Then a year later on Mother's Day (French toast or pancakes are free for moms) we came for breakfast with my SIL and it was soooooo good! The French toast is bomb.com! The French toast or pancakes are AYCE. 

We just went today and I got the Italian omelet. It was really good but small. It's no IHOP. But still worth! 

Definitely recommend only gave it 4 star because I wouldn't go for lunch. Go to Zuppa's instead!
Fantastic bagel place.  Staff is fast and friendly.  Without a doubt the best cinnamon sugar bagel I have ever had.
LOVE the Willow Creek sandwich!!
Good breakfast/ lunch don't expect great service

Great service, food is mediocre. Their menu spice goes to 5, but you can get up to 10 off menu. I got the 10 and it was not very spicy. The veggies are good, the brown rice is good. The meat is terrible. I had beef, my girlfriend got spicy chicken Pad Thai. Both meats were awful. It tastes like they boiled the meats, which removes all flavor and gives them a bad texture. Thai iced tea is always good. The service was fantastic though. We never complain but the waitress made it a great first impression. That saved the day. Our waitress even offered us free ice cream since it was our first time. I would have given less stars without the over-the-top service. Very calm atmosphere. I don't know if we would return based on the meat alone. That usually doesn't does not change and having to choke it down was unpleasant. EVERYTHING else was so good, it sucks to see it all spoiled by terrible meat. Also, if you are going to offer off-menu "very spicy", at least try to make it spicy... The 10 was laughable as it was Tabasco hot. I'll pay top dollar for good, spicy Thai.

Hands down my favorite quick eats joint in the Treasure Valley. As a California transplant, Habit Burger is one of my favorite eateries that is also available in Idaho . There's literally nothing bad on the menu. Everything is equally delicious and deserves some room in your order (and your belly). My personal favorites are the side Caesar salad, onion rings and chocolate shake but everything is amazing. One thing I love about the Habit is they are more than happy to lettuce wrap a burger if you're looking to eat healthy, they have a wider vegetarian selection than most places, and everything is made with quality ingredients. You can  easily get full here for under $10.

Bowling was fun- the food was a disappointment! We ordered a a pound of wings which was listed in the menu to come with 14- it came with 8 very small wings. The waitress told us they changed the menu. The lettuce wraps came with wilted lettuce and not enough for 5 people. 
The waitress said she spoke to the manager about our disappointment and reported back "I'm sorry the manager doesn't want to do anything about it!"
Terrible management for a manager to not even show his face to unhappy customers! Won't be returning! I'd suggest not eating here!!

I really hate to do this review because the owner & help are very nice and customer service is great. There are some positives & negatives here. The good - shake is awesome, lots of food & shake for the $$, cust service outstanding. the bad- hamburger and fries were absolutely tastless, the tables were all messy, door glass on way in was filthy, the place certainly did not shine in cleanliness. We drove all the way from Garden City Eagle area and would not do it again. I am very perplexed as to how you can fix a burger with no flavor, salt did not help it either

B&W was 10 minutes late picking me up, the car had no meter, I let the driver know I was on a conference call and she talked to me during the call multiple times, the car had trash on the seat, and I was charged 10% extra for using a credit card (even though the company gets charged less than 4% for credit card charges - they basically get more fees when you use a credit card).   I think they could have done a much better job.

It seems like there are a couple hundred teens working here. I don't see myself frequenting this place, but I still had a good time. I got a steak wrap and it was really good! I wouldn't recommend the fry sauce; it tastes like they put pickled juice in it. And I wish I had gotten the onion rings... They looked really good.
We are so lucky to have such a great waterpark so close. It truly rivals the others we have been to. Coupons or deals always seem to be available and you can come & go with your hand stamp.
I was surprised at how bad this restaurant was.  The burger had a nice large bun and a small piece of meat.  The sweet potato fries were cold and soggy.  Very disappointed.

A little spend but worth every penny. The burger builds are so tasty. I get the bison and it is great. They have so many sauces and salts. I've tried almost all of them and still go back to the spicy mustard, it's so good. Sweet fries and the blueberry ketchup with vanilla salt is second. It's like a treat for how sweet it is. I go there about once a week.

Continuously clean unfinished items off if tables. Waited 20 minutes for some French fries for my son, after eating two my son ran across the building, in less than 1 minute to get him and come back they had remove the food I had waited all that time for, only to be told that it is thier policy to clean the tables off that quickly.

My husband and I have been eating here for years and love it. I've  tried most of the Thai places in town and most are pretty good, but this is where we almost always choose because it's the best. Huge menu, friendly staff, delicious meals. The fried spring rolls are a must!
Don't come here if you don't eat meat. They're food looks and smells good but they do not cater to some dietary needs. I'd say go to Panera.

My daughter and I went here in early March for her birthday.  It was our first time here.  There was a little misunderstanding when we booked our appointments.  We had asked for a pedicure and manicure but they just had us down for manicures but fit us in for both services and were very nice about it. Our nails turned out beautifully and the owner and his staff were great and did our nails just how we wanted.  The polish lasted such a long time too!  We'll be back
A great place to eat with a good vibe. Definitely a great place to go for lunch or early evening dinner. Get the Mac and Cheese w/Bacon!

Stop, do not eat here! I don't understand why anyone would review this place with more than 1 star, unless they had never had authentic Mexican food. The chips are not freshly made corn chips, they are a bad choice of purchased chips. The salsa has zero flavor - if it's home made, they need to find some spices! The taco shells are from a box like you buy at the market. Definitely not home made, deep fried taco shells. I also had a soft corn tortilla taco. Soft is an understatement. After 1 bite it disintegrated - a double tortilla taco might have helped but then again - not!!! The chicken was lacking flavor and had a strange look to it. The shredded beef wasn't any better. Don't know where they get their meat, but they should try Costco meat!!! And they charged extra for the beef. The order was wrong so we tried to cancel the beef taco but the waiter said he couldn't because the ticket was already created by the computer. Even though we didn't want the lousy taco, they delivered it and charged us. Really people, if you gave this place anything more than 1 star, I have to question your taste in quality Mexican food. A total disaster. One star is really too much - should be a zero star. This restaurant is a disgrace to the city of Meridian. Please tell the truth when reviewing this restaurant - because some of you had good things written about it, we wanted to try it. If you people had told the truth, we never would have wasted our money. DO NOT EAT HERE!!!

Can get pretty busy in the mornings but that's typical for a donut place. Always eager to help you, they even make sure to have a good variety of donuts fresh in the evening. Nice local place I take my family to from time to time because I know the place is clean and consistent.

Have eaten here plenty of times, and have been satisfied; although went last night and the service was not very good. Our entire experience there was almost an hour and half. We didn't get to order for almost 25 minutes. When we finally got our food, it was really good. But our server didn't bring the sauce we requested until we were almost done eating, even though we asked multiple times. Just a lot of time was spent waiting when the floor was not busy.

This Nail Salon is the best nail spot I have ever been to. The staff is extremely friendly. They truly make you feel like you are apart of their family. They laugh and joke and include everyone. The work they do is incredible and always exactly what I need. Definitely book an appt because they are ALWAYS busy! I seriously can not say enough good things about this place.

Sushi at a Thai resturant.... Very, very, very good.  I was so happy that I tried the Hero roll.   

It was wonderfull.

Bill did such an amazing job with my first watch, I brought back my other watches for service. A kid at the mall wanted to charge me twice as much as what Bill did for the service and I wouldn't have gotten the same kind if service.

We travel a lot and love to stop at good burger spots. This place fits the bill! They were very accommodating of how we like our burger (bunless) and the duck fat fries were divine!!  We will def stop in again

Our party of 4 went Tuesday 7/12. Despite  the $5 free arcade cards for each meal you purchase on Tuesday's, the restaurant was dead. You would think the service would be a little quicker. Not the case! It was probably a 15 minute wait just for drinks. Their unsuccessful search for Chardonnay was their excuse. I ended up with a $10 Riesling from a can. The meals were ok but next time we'll eat somewhere else and spend the extra money for the arcade.

The food was as good as we expected. The New York steak was very tastey. My wife had the club sandwich and it was awesome. The bread was perfectly toasted without being overdone. The waitress was great (Kylee). We would definitely recommend.
P.S. The bread pudding was amazing.

Best burger that I have had in a long time. Love how you can order how you want it depending what you are in the mood for.  1/3 lb beef patty was more than enough and I can' t wait to try the bison next time.  Not crazy about the shoestring fries. Wish they offered a steak fry option as well.

I decided I liked this place as soon as I walked in. It's homey and has a lot of neat choices. Not to mention there is a drive through. 
However, the dining area was pretty packed and loud, so I decided to just get everything to go. 
The turkey and artichoke panini was great. I would have never known this place was a chain if I hadn't seen other locations on their to-go menu. That's how good this sandwich was. It wasn't skimpy at all. I'm typically really picky about meat, especially at restaurants, and I have no complaints about the turkey on this sandwich. Even the bread was absolutely delicious. 
I ordered the sandwich with a cup of roasted red paper and Gouda soup. This soup is scrumptious. I'm a huge fan of red pepper and Gouda separately, but together? Out of this world. You can definitely taste the cheese in each bite. 
The sandwich came with a pickle spear and a bag of Parmesan kettle chips and I ordered a raspberry muffin top as extra. 
The muffin top was just a tad dry and bland. It had an ok crumb and tasted of vanilla. However, I could have eaten the raspberry filling on top by the spoonful. It wasn't sickeningly sweet as most raspberry fillings tend to be. The tartness was still apparent but it wasn't sour. I didn't like that the seeds were in the filling, but that's my own personal annoyance. 
The only thing I didn't like about this place is that it isn't all that big and the kitchen seemed to be in pure chaos. Dine in orders weren't completed when delivered.  The associates would notice before the customer would have to say anything, but I guess because they were so busy, they would just shout your name into the dining area from behind the order counter and ask you a question. It was strange and would make an introverted person uncomfortable. 
The wait for my to-go order took about 20 minutes, but I do have to say nothing was missing like it was from the dine in orders. I do also have to mention that I ordered a panini and soup at 10:30am. So, maybe I'm a bit of an asshole. 
Will be returning.

I love Summer Rolls with peanut sauce. Too bad they didn't offer them. I love Panang Curry but not Panang Curry soup with what looked like a can of peas and carrots thrown in. House prepared carrots don't come in perfectly shaped little cubes. I never had peas or broccoli thrown into Panang Curry either. I'd rather see a fish tank than a flock of flies but sometimes I am disappointed. And while I'm whining so loudly, why does a Thai restaurant have Sushi? Hey, pick a cuisine and do it right! This is the third Thai restaurant I've tried in the Boise area and I'm still looking for one that I would go back to a second time.

I was skeptical to sign up with this credit union since I figured it was a small bank and I had never had an account with a credit union. I signed up in 2010 so my ex who was overseas could easily transfer child support into my account and told them I would close it once he got back. I never left. I love this location as it is close to my house and the tellers are super helpful. The only reason why I am not giving them 5 stars is because I had a fraud charge from primerica since October2013 and all they could do for a long term customer who has never once had an overdraft fee was a conditional credit of 2 months. Not cool ICCU. Anyway, I am still with them as they are convenient and now have picture check deposit.

We tried Marco's pizza for the first time today and we were surprised!! The taste was awesome, plenty of toppings, and the crust was amazing! We will definitely go back, the delivery guy was friendly and we got our pizza in about 20-25 minutes.

My wife and I had our first poor experience the other day at this IHOP. the food was fine; it was the poor service we received! Some people are just not cut out working as a server.
