It's about making your customers feeling welcome from beginning to end.  Our server seemed more interested in her facial makeup and how much of a tip she gets. When I paid the bill, she didn't even bother to thank us or say anything at all. I would ask management that you please train your servers in customer service. While our waitress was a flop, we watched this young man providing service to his tables assigned, engaging in small conversation, seeing if there was anything else he could do. Our waitress was a flop and must have missed "training day on customer service." It will be a while before we return!

Best sandwiches in town! The Hugo's Special is a magnificent marvel of meaty goodness--and oh man, the sauerkraut they put on their Reuben? Woo!!

I've had several different sandwiches (The Louie is great!) and they've never let me down. Fresh bread, quality meats and cheeses, delicious house-made sauces, and crisp veggies all add up to a tasty place for lunch!

Great hotel we were just passing through and needed to get off the road and get some rest we called them when we were about 15 mins away and it was 3 am and they got us two rooms and gave us a discount because it was so late Mr. Priest got us checked in very quickly and was very friendly.The rooms were great and the bed was very comfortable and the rooms are very roomy. After our nights rest we had the breakfast which was awesome. When we checked out Tiffany was very friendly and kind she checked us out you could tell that she likes her job and that she is caring for all the patrons. I would stay here again and was very appreciative that they were able to get us a room!

We have been to 2 Fat Guy's Deli a number of times and it's always awesome. They have a great verity of turkey sandwiches and all of them are delicious. My husband loves the meatball sandwich, which has scratch made meatballs.  The soups are all homemade and the few that we've tried were very good.
The staff is really great too. Usually one or both of the owners are there and they are both super friendly.
I recommend 2 Fat Guy's to everyone I know.
Normally great service, however they didn't give me a sleeve for my coffee and my dog didn't get a puppicino.
Seeiously the BEST sandwiches you will ever put into your mouth! I have had several different types and they just smash it out of the park with each one! Highly recommended...

My companion and I tried this restaurant on a Thursday during a fairly crowded lunch rush.  We wanted and booth and waited less than 5 minutes for the server to clean and prepare a table for us.  Great!

The Food:  Upon being seated, our waitress promptly put waters on our table and took our drink orders.  The perky woman returned in just a few minutes with our drinks, answered our questions and then took our orders.  I ordered the Sonoma Bowl.  A wonderful delight of mixed baby greens, vegetables,  and two petite burgers topped with a basil pesto dressing.  Oh, did I mention the goat cheese? So yummy!  I also ordered a side of beef chili.  It was hot, hearty and was surprisingly topped with craisins.  My companion ordered the grilled ham and swiss with a side of french fries.  I tasted  the sandwich and it was hot, gooey with cheese and quite tasty.

Ambiance:  I liked the vibe on that day.  The restaurant was light and cheery, the crowd was hungry and I enjoyed looking at their chalk-art menu covering one wall.

Service:  I know a lot of Yelpers have complained about the service.  Being in the food industry, I understand the hiccups and disasters that can occur on a daily basis.  From a food delivery not coming in to one or two people out sick, it can de-rail a small restaurant.  That being said, on the day I was there the service was excellent!  Our waitress was very friendly, and went out of her way to answer questions that we had.  The food came out in a timely matter without a hitch.

Price:  Very reasonable for lunch.

My experience with The Counter was very positive.  Being located in The Village makes it even more desirable.  I can shop, go see a movie and know that this restaurant can satisfy my need for a yummy burger!

The gnocchi was beyond wonderful! My first meal there, but family has been a few times and said every dish they have tried was great. Service was very good. It definitely won't be my last meal there. We will be back.

We didn't plan ahead and couldn't get a lane for bowling (90 min wait on a Saturday night), so we went upstairs to the bar area. The service was great, the drinks were reasonably priced (and even the well vodka tasted decent). Nice low-light atmosphere but not too loud to have a conversation. Pool for $5/hour, comfy couches. Overall a really nice place to hang out. I'll definitely be back.

Tons of new and unique stuff.  Candles place mats kitchen bedroom sets etc etc.  You get a birthday month discount(20%) on one item.   Nice people family owned.  Mom, sister in law and grandma loved it.

Me and my kids came here for dinner and it was really good!!  I got sushi and my kids got fried rice and veggie stir fry.  I got to try both their dishes and they were really good as well!  I highly recommend this place!

I booked 2 nights at this property through Hotels.com. The photos they showed on the site made it look very nice however they photos must be extremely old. We checked in and went to the building where our room was and found one of the main entry doors was broken and you could't open it with the key card. We finally found a door that works and were hit with an awful odor coming from inside the building. We made our way to our room and I was not at all happy. The towel rack was literally hanging off the wall and fell off with a light touch. The headboards of the beds were covered with a thick layer of dust. The hair dryer did not work. There was garbage and food particles under the beds and along the edges of the wall (note, when they came in to "clean" our room after the 1st night none of this was taken care of). The beds were supposed to be queen and were doubles. The 2nd day I had to finally call the front desk because they "forgot" to open the pool. The hot tub was broken and not in working order. I had also booked this hotel because my adult daughter needed a shuttle to the airport the next morning and this was in our reservation. When we arrived I was told they no longer offer a shuttle and they really didn't know how my daughter should get to the airport. I would not stay here again and wouldn't recommend anyone else stay either. I am really surprised the health department hasn't taken action against this property. If I would have had the funds I would have stayed elsewhere.

We stopped by around 8 on a Saturday night.  The place wasn't busy, which was nice for us, since we don't like crowds.  The hostess did a nice job explaining the menu.  It can be very overwhelming with so many options; so be prepared that ordering can seem complicated.  The service was good, they were nice to my kids.  We liked the food.  My wife's burger was cooked a little raw for her taste, though nothing to shout about.  We had some wonderful shakes.  I love the parmesan fries.  My biggest caution is regarding the price.  This place seems expensive.  It cost nearly $60 for my family of four to eat.  We had two shakes, two burgers, grilled cheese, fries, onions strings and parmesan fries.  I love trying all the different sauces.  Be prepared, the sauces cost.

A gem of a neighborhood restaurant! Such a find while visiting family in the area. Everything locally sourced and fresh. Our table got the tempura green beans, which were nicely flavored and al dente, if a little too greasy. 1st entree was Braised Goat Ragu which was thoroughly enjoyed..flavorful but not too strong. 2nd entree was the turf special, filet mignon w/peppercorn sauce which was delicious and perfectly cooked to medium rare as ordered. The 3rd entree was the Slider Trio of which only the chicken was sub-par being over-breaded and over-cooked. Both the pulled pork and Gouda burger were deemed yummy! Since things change according to what's fresh, it'll be fun to see what's on the menu next time I'm here!

This place is always busy when I drive by, but my wife and I decided to stop and get some soup. We went through the drive through and had wonderful service. I made a mistake when ordering and the employee was quick to fix the order even though it was my fault. We ordered the ravioli soup and the chicken noodle soup. Both were really good, especially the chicken noodle. We also got the Mango Tango smoothie and No Dairy Berry smoothie and they are awesome! Ever since Emerald City Smoothie closed down, my wife and I have been looking for another place that makes good smoothies and this is the next best thing! There is a large selection and we will be back frequently to try everything. Some people have complained about how long it takes to get their food...that's what happens when a place is busy and they actually make their food, rather than unfreezing it. If you want food in a hurry, just go to McDonalds and get some crappy food.

Our waitress was outstanding. I wish I could say the same for the food. The ribeye was over $20 and half of it was gristle (not fat, hard crunchy gristle). They also have a problem with flies, they are everywhere and are aggressive. Installing ceiling fans might help that, and would also move the air around, it was uncomfortably warm in the restaurant. I might give it another shot just because the service was so good.

Very good place to come and sample some unique local cuisine. They serve a large variety of fries with an even larger variety of spices and sauces. I always go for the bison burger and purple fries with sea salt, rosemary and garlic. Great food, great idea. Highly recommended.
Love this place! So nice and so good! I'll be coming back here regularly. Micky is awesome

Okay, it was just plain gross! When a Mexican restaurant gives one basket of chips and bowl of salsa free and then charges for each additional, that's a sign to RUN! The chips were nowhere close to being fresh. The beans I would say were rehydrate. I ordered a taco with shredded beef and it came with canned tomatoes and beef chunks. The rice tasted like a box, not that it came from a box but actually the  box.  Basically there was nothing good about this place. I can't figure out why the parking lot was full. On the positive side our waitress was super nice.

First... Kenzie... Just wow... Friendly helpful and beautiful.

The burgers here are juicy charred! Fries are traditional sticks ... But perfectly made.  Fun place.

Make sure to venture out into their specialty drinks... The cherry line drink was delicious.

Love the food and drink options!
On this visit I felt the hostess was "hating her job" - bad first impression, but our server (Kelsi) was one of the best servers I've had in a long time!
Try the Armadillo eggs for a special unique treat.

So disappointing. This was one of our go-to's but we haven't been for a few months. The menu has changed which gives less options than before, which would be fine but the prices have skyrocketed! The apps are the price of a meal. A cup of soup is $4. And my husbamd's side salad was chopped spring lettuce topped with quinoa and two grape tomatoes. Seriously?

We won't be back until they figure out that this is Idaho and we won't pay these prices for crappy food. Ram management, tell corporate to get there crap together!
First time out to try this restaurant. We were recommended to try it out by a friend. We thought it was solid but not the best we've ever had!~
First time to Dutch Bros.  excellent coffee, very smooth and flavorful. Wish we had one back home in SoCal

Fat Guy's sandwiches are pretty good!! :D 

The sandwiches were well portioned and tasted great! The French Dip Sandwich was good with generous amount meat!!! :D

Very homey and clean.

Great service.
Decent food. Good place to watch a few games and keep the kids busy at the same time. Service has been good everytime.

My wife and I have been coming here for years. The food is always amazing,  the staff is attentive and friendly, and the price is reasonable for the portions you get. We typically order a pitcher of house margheritas, and I usually only order the Guadalajara Burrito as it is my favorite. I will always come back when we want good, fast, Mexican food.
Not impressed. Food average to poor.  Waitress did her best   Probably won't be returning.

Wow, great crowd, the food is super! Service is fast, pleasant service !
We'll be returning!
It doesn't gey any better for a great sandwich. Fries and home-made goodness. Don't spend your money anywhere else. SERIOUSLY GOOD!

I would come here if wasn't so expensive & far from where I live.  Little like Dave's & Busters w/o the 55ft tv and bowling.  D&Bs I do get free game $$ if i spend a certain amount there which I like.

I really love my hybrid fills. Marji was wonderful. She pays attention to detail and gave me exactly what I wanted. She flared out the ends and gave me long, thick lashes. The prices are reasonable and they are more than happy to work with you so you get the full satisfaction of their services.
My family and I have been patrons of this great spot for many years now.  The service is always great, the staff and Owner's family are fantastic.  Oh yes, we LOVE the food as well.

Nailbanger Here Again; Yikes Crazy.In town all week in the Treasure Valley area,and this is our first night out for Dinner. I found a online discount and the reviews were pretty good so we gave it a shot.This pretty much a fast food joint. Most of the photos show foil plates, but they offer regular plate when eating there, but the eating utensils are all plastic.First you order at the front and they call to pick up the order. The menu is limited to a few pasta dishes and sandwiches pretty much. We got the Cheese filled Ravioli with a Rose Sauce, Bead Sticks, Side salads with the House Vinaigrette which is all they offer for those. The Meatball appetizer and the Godfather sandwich which is a Grilled Sausage and Meatball ,melted cheese,a item that is a signature dish there. O.K.the Food is average at best, nothing to write home about.The owner is the one that prepares everything with little help at times and the other employees wear lot of hats, running to get Food items as needed from some where near and when the place is busy it can be a sight to watch.The location is it the Village in Meridian with lots of other choices. We will try some of those next time. There is lots of parking ,but we had a hard time getting a space and ended up waiting for someone to leave to get a space. As you can tell by the other reviews you either love the place or hate it?I don't hate it but I don`t love it either.We won't be back sorry to say.Restroom are not onsite and around the corner.

We came here for bowling from out of state with some friends. Front cashier was so helpful and friendly.  We bowled 2 games and had a great time. Our waiter was fast and got our food right out to us. The drinks were made great. Such a fun and family atmosphere. Kids as well as the adults had such a great time. Thank you. I hope to come back when we visit again over the holidays

If I could give zero stars I would. Extremely unprofessional. Asked for squared nails, three times. The original girl that was doing my nails suddenly left and someone else did them- and she was terrible. My nails aren't even. This place SUCKS. Save yourself the money and go somewhere else
Dirty floors (hallway & rooms). Tiny bathrooms. Shower doors don't keep water in shower stall. Noisy (could hear anything going on down the hallway). Outdated fixtures. Beds OK.

I can't believe how expensive this place it. I get that this is a nice bowling ally compared to others in Boise, but it's still bowling. After 9pm the price does goes down. If I come back it will be then. So over all...nice place, big and clean.  Just pricey.
I have been hearing about this great new place for some time! I finally got a chance to give it a try- Great food, atmosphere, and service! Can't wait to go again!

This is always one of my favorite spots to eat with the hubby and adult children.  Today I took my dad and it didn't impress me.  I ordered a mudslide martini that tasted like vodka and cream.  When I asked for another drink she stated she made it exactly per the recipe.  I said it looked like a glass of milk with chocolate on the glass.  I couldn't taste the kahula or the Bailey.  She offered to put ice in it; however I felt she wasn't listening.  Then when our meal arrived, the wrong fries were served and the au jus wasn't with the order.  Again she wasn't listening.  She bee came back for refills and didn't offer to take anything off the bill for the mistakes.  Today definitely wasn't a pleasant experience.

I love Tin Roof Tacos, BUT this time was probably the worst experience I've ever had. I went in for 3 tacos and chips and queso but ended up waiting about 15 mins on queso which is fine but then i get all the way home and realize that all of my tacos are completely wrong. I drive back to get my original order and end up waiting another 15 mins on the tacos i originally ordered in the first place, didn't even bother to rush it after waiting 30 mins, Ridiculous!
Best fast bbq in town. Love the chopped brisket! And an extra Big Yelow Cup never hurts.

I had never been to a water park before and don't have a mark to measure this against.  But, what I CAN say is that the park is clean, the water is perfect, and the weather was perfect.  We have two small children, 5 and 2, and the kiddie pool area was awesome for them. There were 5 water slides available to them in a pool that was only about 12" deep. Perfect time for the kiddos.
This is a convenient location on Cherry Lance at Ten Mile.

How have I not reviewed this place already?  I'm pretty sure this place was built like three years before the rest of the village and for good reason -- it filled a desperate need for the middle of the Treasure Valley -- A something for everyone entertainment source.  

For the adults:   They have THREE bars.  The upstairs, or "Caddyshack" is my personal favorite.  The bartenders are always super chill and they have free pool, shuffleboard, and arcade games.  Plus no kiddos.  The only downside is that the space can be reserved for corporate outting type shit, so occasionally it's inaccessible. There is also a bar in the restaurant which has like sixty barstools and 80 taps (sarcasm).  But seriously -- it's huge and they have a decent beer selection.  They also have a small bar in the middle of everything on the first floor, as if they're saying "who gives a sh**?!, we have something for everyone."  

Food: Average tasting bar food, typically.  Burgers, nachos, wings, etc.  Nothing on this front will impress you but the prices are fair for The Village.  Okay, maybe the nachos are wayyyyyy too big.  But still average.  

Bowling/Arcade - They have this.  Bowling is slightly (only slightly) more expensive than other venues in the Valley but, given other amenities, well worth it.   Arcade is also solid but not the biggest.  IDGAF, I typically play either Guitar Hero or shoot hoops.  And this is after visiting Caddyshack.  

Overall - My wife and I frequent The Village for date night as we live in Meridian, are usually paying a sitter, and the clock is rolling.  We usually do dinner somewhere else, but, ALWAYS visit Big Al's to blow off some steam and have a good time.  I love this place.

Their burgers are superb! We had a double char. chezburg, teriyaki chzburger, mushroom burger, kid burger, onion rings, sweet pot.fries, tempura green bean, coffee shake & cho. shake! Everything was good, not too expensive. We spent $38 for all of them! We'll be back!
We love Grants! Great food and even better people. Don't miss the brunch on Saturday and Sunday.

My husband and I were disappointed when the Shoe Carnival near Boise Town Square closed.  Since we live in Boise proper, having to drive out to Meridian to shop with them was a bit of a hassle, but we're glad we did.  My husband is very particular about his shoes and we've tried a number of other shoe stores with limited success so we gave in and made the drive.    The store is obviously much like other Shoe Carnivals. Spacious and bright with lots of stock.  We placed chairs at the ends of aisles too.  We didn't find the staff quite as attentive this visit, perhaps they were short handed, but we still managed to find my husband 2 pair of serviceable shoes for work.  The buy one get one half price seems to be a standing 'special' at Shoe Carnival, but if you pay attention to the prices on the shoes you are considering and if you happen to have coupons, you can come out with a bit more jingle in your pocket than you would in most other places.   There is ample parking and there are other shops adjacent as well for other needs you may have. Shoes.. of all kinds.. for work, for play, for fun. Shoes for the whole family.. that's what Shoe Carnival has to offer.

When my husband and I are looking for a fast and easy (and delicious) breakfast or lunch, Blue Sky is our spot. We have NEVER had a bad experience and the quality and service is top notch. They often have seasonal cream cheeses which is a nice way to switch it up! 

Food: I love how they have TONS of different bagels, toppings (cream cheese, meats, veggies, nut butters, etc), soups, salads, parfaits, and even treats! They make sure to serve up anything for a picky eater. My husband's favorite is the bacon, egg and cheese sandwich on a Parmesan bagel. I love the cinnamon & sugar bagel with honey walnut cream cheese. YUM. Their soups are also very good! 

Drinks: They have self-serve soda fountain but also make coffee & espresso drinks. I love that! 

Atmosphere: It smells SO GOOD in there! It's your typical bagel shop with a lunch-line style for ordering and simple tables to sit at. Sometimes the tables and floors are a little dirty, but they're so busy that they just don't have a chance to clean them off between each customer. 

Service: Very friendly and helpful. Always quick to answer questions or offer suggestions. 

Happy Hour Offerings: n/a

Healthy Hack: Looking for something lighter? Try a broth-based soup or one of their salads. 

Tips: Go often? Ask for a lunch punch card! Make sure to check out their special of the day and seasonal cream cheese offerings!
Great service and great food, our waiter was awesome and had a great attitude! Will be back! The tableside guacamole was great!
Clean, all the equipment you need and excellent rates!!!$15 a month no commitment. Jason was very helpful and quick with my sign up!
Solid quality, relatively inexpensive and a great location!!!   Love the cornmeal crust and different crust options!

My wife, my mom and I decided to take a chance and get some food while watching some bowl games, since we love the bowling at Big Al's, we thought it would be fun. Sadly the service was horrible, we waited and waited for our food--I'm pretty sure our waitress had no idea what she was doing--and when the food arrived, I was actually surprised that it wasn't cold (it was warm-ish, but definitely not hot). The food wasn't bad but the service was far from good. Safe to say we will be going elsewhere for food and watching sports. 

I would be give Big Al's at least 4, if not 5, stars for the bowling and service they provide their customers on the lanes, but sadly the service in the dining area is sub-par and not worth it.

Fresh rolls, the peanut sauce costs extra which is a first for me at a Thai place. Here they serve it with a sweet chilli sauce with peanuts and it wasn't bad but.... I love peanut sauce and part of the reason I get fresh rolls. 
The chicken in it is ground up, also a first for me. It was ok. Not the best fresh roll I've ever had but still yummy and could honestly be a meal of its own. Large rolls.

Brought my 11 year old in to get her ears pierced and had a great experience! Paul and Danny were so kind and professional. My daughter was super nervous and they did an awesome job explaining everything and making her as comfortable as possible. It was a beautiful clean facility. I would highly recommend them!
Great place for both the food and the micro brews. Menu has anything you want and prices are good too. I checked  out the happy hour menu, great selection and 1/2 price!

You need to tune the front of house. Two staff, who are overburdened at the lunch push, is not their fault. They are performing well.

This is the most common issue reported about this space.

I'd be happy to help optimize the place.

 However, am I going to bring our business group ten top back here after waiting 40 min and still no food? No.

I would give a rating of zero but that is not an option. We stayed here two nights. Both days we came back to our room without it cleaned. The bed was not made and we were not given clean towels. The first day this occurred we spoke with the housekeeper and the front desk about our room not being cleaned. That second day we came back to our room again at 11 pm only to find a room not cleaned again for the second day. I would never stay here again nor do I recommend it for anyone. Terrible!

Just saying...if you book an appointment for a specific time...not happening. Always running behind. Ha is a great guy but doesn't respect clients who make an appointment. Sadly, I would not recommend. 
My time is important too. A little respect for making an appointment and not having to wait makes a difference.

These guys offer long-lasting quality products at a price that can't be beat. Whether you are looking for a couch, a bedroom set, or a mattress... go check them out! I am not disappointed with the couch that I purchased here. After sitting on a few mattresses, I can't wait to buy a new mattress! The products speak for themselves. When I went in, there was a couple who had bought a mattress from them 10 years ago who were there to purchase another one. They also had recommended the place to family and friends. That gave me the comfort I needed to make my purchase.

Great service for vegans!  Black bean burger cooked off grill is the way to go!  Hands down the best home style fries I have ever eaten!  And you can never ever go wrong with their Brussels sprouts!  I crave them and have to have them at least once every time I come to town!!

the guys here are very kind and know their stuff. They were fast, found the small problem we had with charging the phone and did not over charge us. I would highly recommend them and will use them in the future.

My friend and I just came here for lunch and it was amazing! The owner is hilarious and he said he makes everything from scratch! You can tell because the quality and taste of his food is phenomenal!! I'll be coming here for lunch every time I'm in meridian!!
Great cozy restaurant and bar. Welcomed in with a handshake, house made food, and relaxing atmosphere. Something Meridian definitely needed. I wish I would have came in months sooner.

We had lunch there today & it was crowded, but that's ok...We were waiting for a table, one of the staff, I believe Colton or Holden, found a table for us, actually 2..One was a better fit. He even brough our order..He was so polite & just great attitude..Also all the staff are amazing, we can fix our order to any way we wish..The food is so delicious...The order was up by the time we got our table..Great burgers, shakes & salad..

Best pastries in town! The croissants are so nice and fluffy flaky buttery - yum!! Everything I have gotten from here has been fantastic, although I haven't had lunch items but breakfast is great. Customer service, ehh debatable.

Burgers are meh.  I didn't care for the purple fries but I like the Laura fries.  Bison Burger was dry and not very tasteful.  Five guys is much better as far as the burger goes.  This place is cool for a couple reasons it has good beer a good environment and lots of dipping sauces.so if you're looking for some fries this is the place to go.  I do wish they had nuts like 5 guys for the beer.  And don't even get me started on the price $11 for a burger fries and a soda are restaurant prices this is not a restaurant...  All in all not too bad but not too good I'll stick to five guys.

This place used to be an old favorite when they had karaoke on Tuesday nights with fancy drink specials. Last time I will go was when I ordered a specialty burger. I describe it as plain, crumbled in my hand, flavorless, bun was horrid and the extras were skimpy. Absolutely nothing gourmet about a bun I can buy at the $ store and low quality beef. Should've made a meatloaf burger to conceal the poor quality and lack of pride in presentation. Need to hire a new business planner to redo the menu to modernize it and be "Ontop" of quality control. That burger a shelter wouldn't serve. You bet I sent it back it was almost a $15 mistake. Plus no more seasonal Snow Angel brew and should've asked if they did away with $5 growers as well. This place was very sadly cheapended

My husband and I love this place. It's one of our favorite restaurants in the Boise area. They have great service (Mackenzie is the best) and the food is amazing. I always get the orange chicken and my husband usually gets the Cao Soi noodle soup, but literally everything is fantastic! Highly recommend.

Ordered some food today got the plate with steak and shrimp with orange chicken and a side of fried rice. Costumer service was great which is why I'll give them 2 stars but the food wasn't up to par. Idk who makes up these portions but I got 2 little pieces of steak in the steak and shrimp entre which is ridiculous because they charge 1.25 for premium entrees. Last time I went and got brocolli beef it was the exact same thing all broccoli no beef. The popular entrees never really has this problem though. Oh and the fried rice was cooked really bad it has too much water and it seemed like it was about 4 days old. I know this because I make and eat rice on a daily basis. Don't go to this panda Express they skimp you out on beef and the food isn't up to par like the other locations.

Terribly disappointed. Been there many times and it's generally ok but tonight I was served a solid rock-hard black hockey puck on a bun with cold sweet potato fries. (I so wish I'd taken a picture before giving it back to the waitress) Hubby's came just fine so he was done eating before my burger arrived back at the table. Took forever for the replacement to be brought out. Had to eat cold fries just so there was something to nibble on as my husband finished his meal whole I waited. We had come in around 4:30 and were the ONLY customers the entire time we were there, so they weren't exactly busy juggling orders back in the kitchen.

 There were two gentlemen sitting at the counter with their laptops, assuming they are some level of management or ownership because I've seen them there many times before, but the waitress never once went to speak to them about the situation. The bill came and there had been no adjustment for not even being able to eat our meal together. Not even the soda was comped. It was really sad because we have eaten there pretty regularly in the past but my husband is not interested in ever going back. Go to Goodwood, eat local and get the quality you are paying for at The Counter.

Tried the grocery pickup they didn't have five of the items I pre-bought, so convenient just went to inconvenient.  All the time I spent putting in the order waiting for the delivery on top of not getting my stuff equals a huge waste of time.
It was underwhelming. In all fairness we were the last patrons. Fries were NOR the star. The other reviewer was smoking crack. Great staff though.

Recently I became so active in yelp and I was checking something  and accidentally stumbled upon this place. I had to check it out of course Duh... It says affordable furnitures. So I went it today. I am impressed. I ordered a chest and yet to receive it, but I really got a good deal. You should go give this place a try first before going anywhere else.So far i am very impressed. 
4 stars because I am very impatient person and I had to wait long to get hold of a sales person. Normally some people wouldn't mind but I am being me.LOL.


I will update my review in a week after I receive the chest! But really I am impressed.

I had the double char burger with cheese and bacon meal with also a side of onion rings. Pretty nice services except for the person that took my order did not add bacon to my burger and when I checked my receipt it was not added which was too late. The burger was ok with the bun a little stale. The fries were good, and the onion rings tasted like there was not onions in there. It felt chewy and not like onion, more like batter.  I will visit again and see if I can't get a better experience.

I got a massage by Marcos, and it was WONDERFUL!  He is knowledgeable and skilled and was very appropriate!  I am trying to be a regular now.  The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because the customer service was lacking.  The lady at the desk never even greeted me when I came in...I later found out it was because I wasn't her client.  But Marcos and other staff made up for it!  I have sent all of my friends and they have had great experiences as well!
First time eating at Tin Roof Tacos! Wow, what great food and at reasonable prices. EXCELLENT! We will be back.

We've ordered delivery twice. First time purchased original crust for both pizzas. This time we got a thin crust for our supreme. The sauce is good- not too sweet but actually has flavor. We really like the cheese bread but the marinara sauce with it is key. The first time they forgot our sauce and it wasn't as good. It's a bit pricey- more in line with Idaho pizza than the cheaper chains but it's our go to now.

This place is soo good! We went in on a busy Saturday night and it was packed. My husband got a bbq Swiss burger, my daughter got nuggets and I got the veggie burger. I was very impressed by the veggie! They were quick even with how busy they were. All the employees had smiles and were very friendly. Had someone walking around at all times removing trays and trash. Will certainly be going back

Tried the food truck version at the Archeology Fair and let me say this food truck is a gem of Boise. Had the beef burger and it was done perfectly. The burger had the perfect ratio of flat iron char and still retained a nice juicy pink in the middle. The pickled onions, nice slice of thick tomato with spring mix and garlic aioli made for one of the best burgers I have ever had. Tried the seasonal fries which were delicious and was rather sad to only get one bag. The service was quick and helpful. Will be searching out the brick and mortar locations soon.

Called at 11:22pm to ask if they were still serving (website says open till midnight) the woman manager who answered said they were closing in 4 min. I guess they close at 1126pm now??? Bad customer service! Especially when a manager is telling customers they close early. Too bad the food is good because the staff takes away from that.

I've been a fan of Jimmy John's sandwiches for a long time, but after my first trip into Fat Guy's Deli I've changed my loyalty.  There are no wrong answers on the extensive menu.  It's all good!  My first time in I was given a hard time, in good fun, by the owner that I hadn't been before.  He offered up many good suggestions and even included free Clam chowder for us to try.  This has now become my favorite sandwich place in the Boise area.  Anytime I'm in the mood for a great sandwich I'll willingly pass all of those run-of-the-mill chains (Jimmy Johns, Blimpie, etc) to get to a REALLY good sandwich shop - Fat Guy's Deli!!!!

I love it here! If you are trying to stay low carb, you can get the burgers on a bed of lettuce. Try the Brussels sprouts instead of fries...they are just as good!!!!! Don't forget the amazing sauces! Yum! Of course...my picture has a bun and fries. Ha! It's all so good!

Five of us came here on a Monday evening.  Our service was great, our server was very helpful and attentive but not overly attentive. They have all local beers on tap.  I wanted to try the huckleberry Collins and it was very refreshing, not too sweet. We shared the tempura green beans which were tasty and came with three different dipping sauces. I had the Gnocci and it was delicious. Everyone was very pleased with their entrees, which included the Cubano sandwich, the pork chop, the ribeye, and the steak and onion sandwich. Very good restaurant.

I had to log on for the first time just to write a review.

As it's been said in the other reviews, great customer service and quality work. 

I called him after I had a rock fly onto my windshield off 84 and without hesitation, he said he could take a look at it. Price was very reasonable and he took care of the crack in the windshield quickly and professionally.

Very happy with my experience with A+.

Restaurant is clean with a good layout.   Service was bad.  Two other tables (one table with 5) who sat 5 minutes after us both received their food before our two burgers. Our server never once gave us an update on our food.  We even overheard the table next to us never receive their appetizer.  Now on to the Food. 
Starter was Fried Pickles and they received 1 star.   The pickle itself was way too thin!   The breading that covered the pickle was bland and thicker than the pickle.   The breading did not stick to the pickle.   Very unfortunate.   Burger review time. 
We ordered one turkey burger and one beef burger with a variety of toppings that we liked. It took 50 minutes to get our food.  Both burgers were very most but very bland as many of the reviews have stated.   The toppings were as expected except for the inedible avocado. 
We will not be coming back anytime soon to pay such a high price for bad service and bland food.   Many other great options for a burger in this town. 
Note to owners. ... taste your food and get the bland out.   Salt and pepper are the simple things.

My wife and I went there for sushi after a recommendation from a stranger at our favorite breakfast place. We went there for happy hour and asked for the most popular specialty roll and a rainbow roll. The rainbow roll...delicious. The big expensive roll? A fried pile of goupy mess!! Two small beers, one hit saki, and two rolls during happy hour...guess how much? 50 bucks with tip!! And the insult to injury was this horrible flute elevator music that just repeated over and over again. The service was great. The food, ambiance and prices?? Pretty bad. We won't be back.

I was amazed by this place! Thai food and Japanese food?! What an odd combination of spicy flavored cuisine and simple clean cuisine. This is not a "fusion" restaurant. 
We ordered both types and all of it was excellent! Pad Thai was awesome; my usual standard to measure Thai restaurants. Panang curry with beef was spot on too! Also tried a few different sushi rolls. 
Good price, nice and clean inside too. We will be returning to this place. Well done!
They always treat me great. Coffee is always made perfect. And the breakfast burritos are home made and awesome for a coffee shop! Hey always have awesome daily deals too!
Amazing sandwiches!! Can't wait to work my way through the menu. Super friendly!! Beware of the $50 to-go-box fee (in other words "fat-man up")

This place was wonderful. We didn't have burgers but we saw lots of them coming out of the kitchen & they looked great. 

We both had salads which were very good. We would like to try the burgers next time.

I ate here for the first time recently and had the Bohemian Veg tacos. They were soooo salty, all I could taste was layer upon layer of salt. The saltiness even overpowered the fresh cilantro. Won't be back.

It looks decent on the outside, but don't let that fool you.  The inside is gross; chipped paint on the walls, leaky toilets, noisy air conditioners, and paper thin walls.  Between the screaming kids on one side, and a room filled with 20 Nigerians on the other, well, needless to say I did not sleep.  Do yourself a favor and don't stay here.   Spend a little bit more money and get something better.  I sure wish
I would have.
I had a hamburger & home made fries...great food., spices & sauces were a wonderful bonus. Employees were cheerful. Definitely will be back..

Great little restaurant! Fast, friendly and attentive service without being intrusive. The food was very good ...I had the gnocchi with chicken and vegetables and it was delicious! My husband had a burger and fries with a side Caesar salad that was also very tasty. Fresh, well prepared ingredients and a good sized menu for a smaller scale restaurant. Definitely will be back!
Best sandwich shop in town! Personal favorite is the BBQ beef, hubby loves the big chief. You really can't go wrong!

Stopped in for lunch and left full and happy! Atmosphere was nice not too loud not too quiet. The service was spot on and the food was really good. They're outside of the box with a lot of their menu choices, which meant I really had to make a decision because there were four different things I wanted to order. Will definitely be back!
Wow, what a great surprise!  Food came quickly, was hot, spicy and delicious!!  The service was fast and friendly.
Love the burgers. Owners were nice and talkative. The place is really small but I really like the small town feel in the place. It's kind of like a Delsa's without the ice cream.

My boyfriend has been wanting to take me to Boise Fry Company ever since he first came to Idaho.  

The fries are really what makes the meal, unfortunately not the burger.  There are many different sauces to dip in those fries, the berry flavor one was the most interesting.

Yes... I am in their delivery area ! But ..... since it's Saturday night and they are so busy.... they will not deliver to my area. Oh .... you will only delivery to me if it's convenient for you? 
Yes ...... may I speak to the manager?
Oh hum... hung up on . Called back ... explained the situation to Management....nope ! Too busy... we will deliver to you... but it's too busy.... maybe on another night.
Okay .... I'll take my business to another.

So I was in town for business and casually mentioned to my client that I wanted to put in a workout at a local gym.  He then suggested visiting this one because it has old school equipment, like metal plates, metal Dumbbells and barbells.  I have memberships in LA Fitness and 24 hour fitness in my native California.  While these gyms are nice, they have the plastic stuff & I don't care for them because I like the sound of dropping metal.  
The manager gave me a 3 day pass for $10 which is a great deal because most places charge $10 to $15 for a 1 day guest pass.  Needless to say I had a very good workout in this gym.  I shall come back here if and when I'm back.

Been here many times and today I have to say the service is below par- I walked in and ordered 3 pastries- they weren't terribly busy but it took 10 minutes to get them and the guy who finally gave them to me was not a customer service wizard...
Once again I have to come here for work and Sa Waa Dee is my place of choice. Awesome, authentic Thai food!!!!

I went in for manicures with a friend and they got us in within ten minutes which was great. The shop itself was very clean but I was concerned about the tools lying on the station that didn't look very clean. Tori was not friendly, seemed in a rush and was forceful with my hands. The rest of the staff seemed very friendly and talked to us more than my nail tech. At the end the nail tech doing my friends nails reminded tori to give me a massage and then tori asked if I wanted lotion. Definitely not worth the $30. When I left I realized the skin right by my pinky nail had been cut and was bleeding. The next day I noticed a cut on my ring finger too that was becoming infected. I'm very disappointed and won't be returning.

Now THIS is how you do a sandwich shop. Holy crap, great menu, decent location, good setting, good fountain (Coke Zero), friendly staff...all the components are here. ESPN on the tv and a kinda serious/kinda not mutual animosity, let's call it spiciness or go one better and call it sauciness, and deep respect among the staff...classic. It just adds to the ambiance.

Everything is made fresh and in-house and it counts. If this was in Salt Lake, I'd probably live there and watching the stream of regulars, it seems a lot of people have already picked up on this. The sandwiches are money, so f*cking money. I think you would have to intentionally try to pick anything average and even then, I'm not sure you could. You definitely can't get anything outright bad. This is really sort of the ultimate lunch spot. Right size, right price, awesome, awesome taste, flavor and design. It just doesn't get any better than this for sandwiches and maybe not even for lunches in general.

As a side note, parking is kind of a pain and it's pretty cramped inside, maybe up to a couple dozen people inside at any one time...word to the wise...it is definitely worth braving those hazards, however...

I cannot believe that I have been driving by this little gem for years and it has taken me this long to partake of such wonderful thai food! 
Don't let the location fool you! Even though it is nestled between a subway sandwich shop and a dry cleaner that are plopped right next to a grocery store and gas station, this place shines! The ambiance is relaxing yet energetic with the music and conversation that bounces off the walls of this tiny restaurant with a bar and small sushi bar. You can tell that many people are "regulars" here by their interaction with the servers/hosts which are as friendly as can be. My hubby and I went on a friday night and were told it would be about  a 15-20 minute wait, but within 5 minutes they offered us a bar table which was a little small but the stool was comfy. We were blown away by the menus: one for sushi and one for non-sushi with a huge assortment and a picture next to EVERY dish (loved that!). Needless to say, it took us a while to order due to being entranced by the menus but we started off with the House Platter. The chicken satay was delicious, the tempura vegetables perfect and the sweet chili sauce served with the appetizer was so good I could drink the stuff! For dinner my husband got the Salmon in the jungle (the green curry is hot and delicious, the salmon cooked perfect) and I got sushi: the Meridian roll and Dynamite roll. Miso soup came with my rolls and I wish I had tasted that first due to my tongue was already burning a bit from the Dynamite roll when I got to it. Of course the hubby and I shared food and it was nice enjoying the food while eating it slow with chopsticks while also enjoying the atmosphere. Meanwhile I remember our glasses only being close to empty once and at least 4 different servers refilled them throughout the night. It was hopping the whole time we were there with numerous to-go pick ups and I now understand why this little diamond in the rough has stayed in business for so long.
Our server was super sweet and invited us to come back on wednesday nights when their happy hour consists of bogo drinks...she had me at that because they do have a nice drink list as well that I would like to check off a few :) There's several more menu items I would like to check off as well so, yes, we will return!
So glad to have found such a delightful place so near to home!
Favorite burger place in the whole Treasure Valley area!  Great customer service, attitudes, smiles!  Fresh toppings, salads, etc.  +++++++++++++++
Absolutely amazing. Everything about it is great,  from the service to the food. Never had anything better then the coconut fried rice. Would highly recommend

Where's the button so I can select 6 stars?!?

Chris and his staff continually surpass expectations.  I haven't found a detail shop in all of Idaho that can hold a candle to what this crew does.  I picked up my car the other day and there was a brand new Audi R8 getting work done at his shop.  These are the people the owners of $200,000+ cars bring their vehicles to!!

It's an honor they work on my car considering how high end their work is.  The results are always better than expected and it's definitively worth checking them out.

Have no idea how this place gets such great ratings. Went on a couples date and only one of us enjoyed our food. Very pricey for what you get and flavors are horrid. I couldn't even eat what I ordered and we had to stop at a fast food place on the way home to get me something to eat.

We have Big Al's in Portland, but when we were in Boise we had to checked this one out. This review is for the Arcade only. 

It's pretty much the same as the one in Portland, only they have some newer arcade machines. Layout, decor, service, ticket machines are pretty much the same. Less crazy than the one in Portland. We will be back if we ever need some arcade time in Boise.

Stopped by there for a business lunch yesterday and was ultimately impressed. Fresh delicious Thai food (probably best in the valley), very friendly staff. Had the Pad Prik King which although could have used a bit more meat was delicious. My new favorite Thai foodspot.

Really wonderful small local restaurant. Unique in most ways. Good menu and bar selection. The kids had the sliders, and the hubster and I had burgers. Nice patio seating too. 

A refreshing change from all the chain restaurants around Meridian!

As per usual, there are too many factors that have me torn on assigning a totally positive or negative review. My knee-jerk reaction is to give this place a four or five star review, because their food is consistently good (seriously, it's no different than any other BFC, which means it's great and consistent), their servers / service is always top notch, their beer selection is consistently decent (some duds, some amazingness), and you always have the same options for sauces (which I could care less about, but others freak about the blueberry ketchup and marshmallow sauce... yuk).

I'll try to be productive about this. For this particular location, the seating area is too small for the gigantic crowd it draws. with the navy recruiting office practically next door, we saw five servicemen during our 45-minute stay (they all opted to take their food to-go, which we would have done if we had somewhere to eat next door). Seating seems spacious when no one is present, but the place fills up quickly. The staff does an admirable job of keeping up with many, many orders, but still come off as understaffed when it's crunch time.

Service-wise, they do nice things like suggest quality beers. Twice we've ordered a beer and had the keg tap out as they were pouring it. On both occassions, they gave us the half glass for free and allowed us to order a full glass of something different. That's a huge plus for me and I believe it to be really thoughtful. However, getting them to change a keg line over during crunch time is impossible, and if they forget that second, full glass of beer that you ordered, you have to stand there until they realize you aren't just waiting for your food.

I can't criticize the employees here at all. They are amazing and cook their food well. I suppose my critique is over the location, it's capacity and it's ability to serve even a full dining room. On our most recent trip, some dude did seriously order 40-something items and hogged the condiment bar to himself for 10 minutes. Again, I can't really criticize the establishment, owners or employees for this; however, it did suck and I feel compelled to write about it.

 I wouldn't shy away from this place, but I would try to go during "off" hours or find a location that doesn't get quite as crazy (Bown, for example, which is on the other side of town).

Forgot to mention that I finally tried a beef burger. I've heard people describe BFC's burgers as "forgettable" or "nothing special." I think it's because you're trying the beef and doing it in some funky style. The only, ONLY way to get one of their burgers is a bison burger (tastes a million times better than the beef) and don't add anything else to it. That means no cheese or bacon to distract from the delicious bison. Do it in the style that has garlic aioli and red onion gastrique. It's pretty close to burger perfection.

I usually only think about writing a review when a place was really good (5 stars) or really bad (1 stars).  So tonight my family and I bowled at Big Al's till closing, but before all the lanes were closed down our screen shut down before totaling our last bowler.  Not a huge deal, but my mother-in-law asked the blond male employee wearing glasses at the front counter why that happened and he rudely stated that he "wasn't the one who closed the system."  Then as my mother-in-law walked across the lobby to tell us the employee's curt response, he overhead her and shouted to us, "I DIDN'T CLOSE THE SYSTEM!"  This made other employees and last customers look up to see what his problem was.  His obnoxious behavior was amusing, but ridiculous enough for me to make sure I came home and finished this review.  Good for him, he earned Big Al's a one star to add to their existing mediocre average.
One of the better pastrami sandwiches, but more importantly the most unique and flavorful potato salads you'll ever have.
We missed coming here two weeks ago, won't make that mistake again! It was fantastic. My wife, hard to please loved it. Great staff and great food. A wonderful evening.

This place has not seen neither a vacuum nor a scrub brush in years. I was so tired when I arrived and needed a shower right away.   Noticed hairs stuck to the dry shower wall right off the bat showered in my flip flops just in case.  Since I still was not sure about staying at all I checked the sheets for hairs and saw nothing.  Staff upon check in was ok.  Just ok.

How good can a deli sandwich place be? This place will give you a pretty good idea of just how good! The fries and sauce are just a cherry on top. The bread is fresh, the pastrami is flavorful and unique. Excellent ingredients paired with a Diet Coke, it's hard to beat. Get your nom nom on!
The food is always delicious, everyone is always friendly , and the place is always clean. I highly recommend going here. Different options for the fries, burgers, and sauces. Great prices too.

Meh. Some items (like the cinnamon rolls) are outstanding while most are just ok, although you can tell everything is fresh/quality. I just haven't found that WOW item here. You are paying for the atmosphere. Service is always friendly though :)

Just got back from eating in this place; gourmet burger restaurant! 

Pros:
-Liked the atmosphere
-Great menu, build your own burger with lots of options
-Friendly waitress
-Quality food ingredients

Cons:
-TERRIBLE service!!!
-Waited 20 minutes for waitress to swing bye to get a drink order
-From the time we placed our burger order, we waited over an hour to get our order; burger and fries were not warm, looks like they were on the counter waiting to get picked up by the waitress and delivered.

The issue was not the waiters, they were doing their best, the issue is the management.  It's apparent there is incompetent management/owner that refuses to higher more help; the bad service will be the death of this place!

I got my nails done by Tumy! She was super nice and kept telling me to not worry about telling her exactly how I wanted my nails! What a relief! All the way through the shape to the design she kept making sure I was happy with her work. The only reason I gave 4 stars instead of 5 was because I felt it was a little over priced for a full set of nails which was $50. Plus when your a new client they make you pay for a file and a buffer for a dollar to keep using when you come back? I've never encountered something like that but I guess that's their store policy and nothing that Tumy could have change for me. Also bring cash. They charge $1 for card use which I unfornately had to do. Overall experience was good! The pricing threw me off.

Enjoyed a pleasant meal on a Tuesday. Service was good. Tried the Armadillo Egg apitizer; tasty, not overly spicy, nice portion. Dinner was good, Fish & Chips, and Fried Chicken with gravy & biscuit. Portions were large brought some of each home. Nice dill target sauce with the fish. Tater tots with the chicken. Coleslaw had a little kick to it, unusual but good.

Order 2 thai dishes. 1 to eat and the other to take out. The thai dish is ok but not sure of their Japanese sushi. I asked the waitress if she is thai or Japanese n she replied Thai. Again if u come here try ordering thai not sushi. I gave them 2 star cuz for this reason.

Gee, where do I start. Walk in the door and find the teens working the cash registers and supposedly waiting on customers are too busy laughing and fooling around with each other. No desire to really be welcoming. We placed our order, fast in getting it. We both had two different brisket tacos which had meat that was tough, to say the least. Also a fish taco and carnitas taco were cold. Not enough meat in any of them. Not much flavor unless you pile on the sauces. Last but not least this was before noon rush, place was not clean, yet there was plenty of help standing around doing nothing. 3rd time we have tried, it's the last.

Easily the BEST burger & malt place in the Boise area. No other place even comes close. Try the fried onion burger Okie style if you're an aficionado of the grill & chill. The chili is also the best in this area. In fact, it may be the only REAL chili. Most places have chili flavored soup with beans. Ick. As for the malts & shakes, I've tried just about every place in this area & theirs are better. Delsa's & Merrit's are also good, but their other food can't compete. The fries are perfect every time. Their prices are cheap & the service is friendly. What's not to like? And hell, no, I don't have ANY connection to this business! It's just that I take my food seriously & there are too many bad restaurants around Boise.

Poke Nachos were delicious, other than too much sauce on bottom of plate, made for sogginess. Mac & cheese is offered with broccoli, mushrooms or vegetables - when asked what veggies they only offered broccoli or mushrooms. Waitress Tess was nice, kept our waters full.  Half price appetizers after 9!! (though once we got the bill is was more like 40% off before taxes). Armadillo eggs were weird but yummy.
Always amazing fries! I love all the different sauces and salts as well. They're bison burger is also very good. Prices are comparable to say Red Robin, but tastes so much better!

My husband and I were just in here and the girl Tori behind the counter was the rudest person I have ever met! I signed up for the perks though my text messaging and asked if I could have the $5 dollar off that it says you get! All she did was look at me like I was speaking Chinese. She didn't even respond. She looked at the sign and then back at me. Nothing. I'm not sure I will be coming back. No customer service!
I never cared for "bagels" until i was introduced to these. Simply delicious...so soft and chewy!

I've said it before and I'll say it again: I LOVE POTATOES.  So naturally this place was at the top of my list when I heard about it.  A place that serves fries up as their main item with a burger on the side? Yes please!  

I ordered up a classic burger with Laura fries while my husband grabbed the original burger with purple fries.  Everything was great, but we both preferred the laura fries.  Not just because of the taste of the potato, but also because of the cut.  The purple fry only came in regular/traditional, while the laura came in homestyle.  We both liked the homestyle cut more.  The fries come out hot and fresh, but without seasoning.  Head over to their massive seasoning and condiment bar and you can make quite the concoction!  I got a smoked salt on mine while my husband went with a chipotle salt.  Both were great.  As for the sauces, my favorite was spicy fry sauce.  Most of the sauces weren't very good.  The only ones I really cared for were the fry sauce, spicy fry sauce, and spicy ketchup.  

This place also serves homemade root beer and draft beer.  You can get a bison burger, veggie burger, or a turkey burger if you're not a fan of beef.  The burgers were good, but the star of the show was definitely the fry.  If I lived near a Boise Fry Company you would see me here after work with a large fry and a cold beer frequently.  Beer+Potatoes=Happiness. So essentially, Boise Fry Company equals happiness.
Fantastic burger.  Cooked the way I ordered it. Very tasty.  Very good service and cheerful

This was probably the best pedicure I've ever had. My nail techs Ha (I think that's how you spell his name) and Miki took their time and did a great job. They were also so sweet and funny. This is definitely going to be my new go-to nail salon!

Won't ever be eating here again! Cold "meatball" sandwich was supposed to be hot. I think they actually only use ONE meatball because I could hardly find any meat in this $8 "sandwich" As far as pizza, This was the first place on Earth I ever had SALT pizza, supposed to be tomato, garlic & basil ------- NOPE! SALT was the only thing detectable. Similar to a mouthful of sea water but dry. When complaining to the scarce server, she shrugged her shoulders and asked "what do you want me to do"? 
How about bring some water and take this garbage away, it is DISGUSTING! 
On top of that their bathroom was absolutely terrible. I've seen portable bathrooms in better condition. 

DON'T BOTHER EATING AT WHITE WATER PIZZA

C'mon!!! Mediocre at best. People in Nampa are so thrilled to have a place like this in Nampa they're willing to post this shop up as one of the most amazing places you'll ever be honored to eat at! Service was rude, food was cold, and atmosphere was wide open, cold and hipster (in- a bad way).  
I don't mind the hipster scene, at all! But, I do mind people trying to ride on coat tails of a company trying it's best to make a name locally. 
I was literally at the opening of the original (idaho fry company) then lawsuit, name changed). Then when James Orr, before he was too big to play venues like this, played his first gig there. Strangely on his birthday I was there among the first to try the blueberry ketchup. Tastes totally different now. Way to go Walmart.......
Anyway, I guess what I'm saying is that this company has relied too long on a local prestige that entitles them to your money. Go ahead...give them what they want......

The waitress made a mistake on my order and then tried to charge me extra for it because she was going have to pay for the plate.  First time and last time here.  Bad customer service and the food wasn't all that great either.

We just left Grant's and I have to say, I can count on one hand how many times I have been this pleased with a restaurant.  Erica, our waitress was amazing.  She was super friendly and fun, made great suggestions and she was attentive all night.  The food was tasty...but Erica totally made our night.  She conversed with us and made us feel right at home and my two teenage boys thought she was super fun.  We will most definitely he back every time we are in town.  Thank you!!!

As good a Ihop can be.  Whenever I've dined here the service is always fast an the staff is always courteous.  If you call ahead and pick your order up to go- they always get it right and done by the time you get there.

I love this place. Had their food at an event from their truck. Ordered the Bison burger. Super moist and flavorful. They don't slab sauces on it to make it good. The flavor was already in the meat. The food came in bags from the truck. Sauces on the side was delicious themselves. Try them. Next week I'll try five guys so I can compare them
The food is good, but the prices are higher than its worth. I only go when other people insist.

Not sure why there is a 3 star rating. This place is awesome. Watching Sunday football, hanging out with awesome friends. My bf and I were visiting from Cali and this was our last stop before heading to the airport. Had a great time, food was awesome and drinks were amazing! So much to do at this place. I could stay all day and I would never be bored. Service a tad slow but it was super busy. Love the jumbo trons. Awesome place! I love the deal on huckleberry mimosa's yum!
Absolutely delicious. Awesome fresh ingredients, big selection, and great customer service.

My 1 month old Samsung 8 Note cracked it's screen hitting my ski boot bucket. After getting a new phone, I shielded it the their Titanium Liquid Screen protector and am I glad they did because the Note 8, also just one month old, got slammed in a heavy truck door. Slammed not just once but twice as my partner tried  to shut the door harder a second timeTwo big bashes and surely I had broken the screen. But no, removed the clear cover and all is well. They replaced the screen cover within 2 minutes and I was on my way. Great product and service.

This is one of the best sandwich places I've eaten at. Chef Wally is one of the friendliest guys. He was very welcoming and willing to explain the sandwiches and joke around. I've now had the Reuben and one with ham. They both were tasty. They were put on the grill and warmed up. There was a perfect crust on both sandwiches. My work is nearby and I will be eating here regularly. I would take anyone here. A local gem! Thanks Wally!
Best donuts in the valley, and now one closer in Meridian! The store is clean. The donuts are fresh, delicious and priced just right. Love that it's a family run business.

We were trying to get patio service.  We waited and no Big Al's server came out.  We went inside to ask for service.  We were assured a patio server would be out.  We seated ourselves on the patio.  We waited 10 mins and no one came out.  10 mins is my max. We left and went over to The Counter across the street and found friendly, fast service
It's was clean, spend there only one night while on our road trip. Having a clean bed and pillow is all that matters.

Not my personal favorite. I have eaten here several times to try and see if i just got a cook on a bad day but in my opinion the food is just not that good. Everything from the spices to the thinner Thai rice noodles that were not cooked correctly. This is strictly personal preference. May be good for some peoples taste. The atmosphere and the staff are nice.

My wife and dined at The Counter today and  enjoyed our experience. The service was outstanding! We were greeted at the door and were seated promptly. Brenn, the manager was courteous and professional. Our Server, Karissa, was friendly and very helpful with our ordering of draft beer and our burgers. My wife ordered the mini's and I ordered a specialty burger. Great choices on the menu for toppings and sauces! These are gourmet burgers folks and worth the prices!  These are not fast food burgers! Our meals arrived in a timely manner and were hot, delicious and cooked to perfection!! Brenn and Karissa both checked in with us to make sure we were happy with our meals. Order the Parmesan Fries! Excellent.  We have dined at other gourmet burger joints in California and other states. This is one of the best!! This is our "go to place" for the best burger in the Valley.
Absolutely love Kneaders. The staff is friendly and everything I have had there has been delicious.

So sad to see a really good restaurant go down hill. This use to be my favorite place to go but after the last 3 trips I have made and 2 separate trips my daughter did I won't go again. 

Thai tea was so bad that my the people across the table warned me to stop drinking before it got to my mouth. Not only was it rancid but it stuck to the straw! Still we loved the place so we tried the Chili Fried Rice. Again disappointed. Hard kernels of rice from drying all through the dish.

I won't be coming back. EVER!

Just arrived from CA was looking for a common " in CA" Cambodian donut shop found it here at D's in Meridian. Thida and her daughter Mary were more than polite the donuts were excellent. Probably the best in all of Idaho much better than the large chains such as Dunkin etc. I'm telling everyone if you want quality donuts from great people this is the place to go.

What a gem! Was looking for a neighborhood cafe to get some breakfast before going to the laundromat. Oh we got so much more. Warm friendly service and wonderful fresh delicious food. Serving size was generous and the price for value is excellent. Would recommend for casual upscale dinner and drinks before catching a movie. Atmosphere is cute, kitchy and fun. Will make it a must visit next trip.

The BEST beef tacos that we've had since we've moved to Idaho, 3 years ago. 
I would love to have given 5 stars, but due to tortilla's being on the floor and the young chef's snapping eachother with towels within full view of the customers I gave a 4!

My husband and I absolutely love this location. The service is always great and fast. The food is fresh and tasty plus the portions are relative to the price. Its not home style BBQ its more of a fast food style.  For what it is its pretty great! The brisket is my favorite and the potato salad tastes like its made with green goddess sauce. Deliciousness! Some of the sides are not that great and could be improved. Hence the 4 instead of 5 stars.

The absolute worst $15 I have ever spent on food! The village should give this place the boot as they are dragging it down! Onion strings tasted like nasty oil. (No real onion to the strings)! Fries were ok but heavily salted with season salt. Now to the vegetable skewers that looked like they were going to be good however looks were definitely deceiving!!! He waitress was very friendly and was tipped accordingly but it's unfortunate that this business can't get its act together enough to make sure it has the proper staffing etc... Add some quality to your over priced menu and you might be able to keep your doors open?

Delicious burgers and sandwiches! I would have given 5 stars if it weren't for this...we waited for maybe 15-20 minutes for our food and everyone's was brought out except mine. Apparently even though the right order was written down, something completely different was cooked for me and they didn't realize til it was too late. So I had to wait 10-15 more minutes on my sandwich after everyone else already finished their food. Other than that, the food was great.

The food was quite tasty and the customer service was fantastic. The atmosphere was pleasant and the service team worked together smoothly to assure our needs were met.   It was my first time here and I would be more than happy to return.

GREAT fries, big homemade-style burgers that come pretty much any way you like it. I like to get the BLT on occasion as well: Big thick bacon on Texas Toast. The shakes are definitely a must and the food is fresh. Try it!

Anybody lucky enough to find this place will be rewarded.  Maybe the best sandwich I've ever eaten- get the 'trevor'.  Owner is in restraint almost every day, awesome staff.  I ate 4 last week in 5 days.  Don't judge me, until you've tried it!

Gee Wiz! There was a 60 minutes wait on Sat night (9 o'clock). The kids didn't mind the wait, since they can wander around upstairs checking out the video games. We had a Cheese Pizza, The Grand Slam Platter, Crazy Al*, Crimson Lemonade( 4 me), Belgian White~Blue Moon (4 my husband) & a jug of Pepsi for the kids. Everything was good. Everybody is having a good time!

Nice Staff, Good Service especially how busy it was! Wow that place is popular!! Went for lunch today with my Mom... it was super loud in there tho!  I'm gonna take my husband for dinner tonight thats how much I loved it!

I had their cauliflower 3 cheese soup mmmmmmmm very good and rich.
I had turkey bacon avacado with bacon very good as well wonderful croissants! 
Also tried turkey, cranberry croissant YUM!!
Good ranch as well.

Can't wait to go back!

We shared the Pilgrim sandwich - turkey, cranberries sauce, cream cheese on marble rye ( one of many bread choices), and a small cole slaw. Food tasted great. Place was very clean. Service was fast and friendly. We couldn't ask for better. We'll be back.

I really enjoy this place. For $2-$3 per taco it's not a bad place to stop. My wife and I like to hit this place up for breakfast after my morning walk. A huge plus is they take Apple Pay, so I don't need my wallet when out walking around. The food is decent, and their salsas are quite amazing. I personally like to combine the habanero with the tomatillo. They also have a decent beer selection and a nice outdoor patio. 
The only downside to the place is the cleanliness. I am actually still surprised that this is an issue as many people have said the same thing. Hello management!! Have your employees clean when not working with customers.

I have dined at the Ram multiple times and despite being a bit on the pricey side ($11-$13 for a burger or sandwich and even higher for entrees), I have always been pleased with the quality of the food. However, I was disappointed overall by a recent visit.

For lunch, I was looking for something low cost for a smaller appetite, so I opted for a bowl of chili, which is supposedly made with their Disorder Porter, though I didn't note any added flavor or richness. The chili was unfortunately salty, acidic, and watery, not the hearty, chunky, flavorful qualities I anticipated. It resembled a spaghetti sauce rather than a chili. In addition, at $5.99 a bowl, I would expect to receive a piece of garlic bread or even some tortilla chips to accompany the chili, rather than two packets of Saltine crackers. 

As a beer enthusiast, I also ordered a sampler flight of their brews ($5.99 for six 4 oz tasters), which was a great value. I expressed interest in trying their seasonal pumpkin beer, which was not offered in the flight, and the server was kind enough to include a taster at no additional cost. The brew is fair quality overall, and they have the usual selection that would appeal to any preference. 

While perusing the menu, I noticed they offer a very attractive happy hour featuring discounted appetizers, bar snacks, and drink specials. In addition, the restaurant atmosphere, with the multiple tv's and sports decor, provides a very appealing place to catch a ball game. 

I would recommend The Ram if you are hungry and interested in splurging on a burger or entree. For affordable options or snacks/appetizers, consider the happy hour. But always avoid the chili!

They were shortstaffed, but informed me of this before I was even seated, and handled the whole situation with professionalism and clearly worked to do the best they could. My food came out much quicker than I was expecting, and was incredible! I got the Bison is Gouda burger and almost died and went to heaven. Will definitely be back.

We sat down for dinner and had a party of 6. They put us at a table that was good for 4 we asked for a bigger table and they told us no so we took it. Our server was obviously new and took a bit longer to do anything and that's fine everyone had to learn. We made our drink order and I was water, coffee and iced tea. She came with our drinks and we asked for silverware so the person with coffee could stir in cream and so we could have it for our meal also we asked for straws, she said okay I'll get them for you but what can I get you for dinner. We told her she left and I guess she forgot our silverware and straws. Our food came out and we once again asked the food runner for silverware and they said they would be right back with it 5 minutes later our server came back and asked how our food was and we told her that we didn't know since we needed silverware to eat it. She asked if we told the food runner we told her yes and before we could even tell her it was 5 minutes ago and they still haven't come with it she said great and left again we saw her standing at her computer right next to a bucket of clean silverware but she did nothing. So one of us left the table and went and got our own silverware and started to eat a colder meal. She then came over and asked how our meal was now that someone got us silverware. We told her that we went and got it ourselves and she said great and left again. This is the first time I have left after a meal without giving a tip. I sent a message to Big Al's on Facebook and they told me more than once a manager would contact me well that never happened. I used to take my company out to Big Al's a few times a year for dinner and a few games but now we will have to find a new place for the 30 of us. I don't recommend Big Al's to anyone anymore.

Not my favorite.  I was happy to see a vegetarian taco salad on the menu, but disappointed in the product.  The black beans weren't very good, and the sprinkle of cheese was disasterous.  What kind of cheese is this anyway?  The cheese was dry and tasteless.  Whatever happened to regular cheddar?  The edible taco bowl was crispy and tasted ok but greasy (although most are).  The salsa was decent.  Unfortunately, although the cashier was very nice and pleasant, she was obviously new at the register and slow.  Which is ok, everybody has to learn. But, she was also underaged and couldn't serve us a beer.  She had to pull another staff member from a break to help us at the register while we waited.  The slow service, combined with the poor quality of food means I won't be back.   Overall I'm disappointed and would rather eat elsewhere.   And that includes Taco Bell, which has cheaper prices.
New ownership has killed the place. They don't have any of the good shoes in stock. You used to be able to order shoes that they didn't have in stock. Now whatever garbage they have is what you get.

What a great place to take the family! They just redid their kids section 54' and under, they did an excellent job! I'd also like to add that every staff member I encountered or observed was kind and friendly. We spent two days here this past week with our granddaughter who lives out of state and enjoyed every minute.
We also purchased food here each visit, corn dogs, curly fries, tater tots, sub sandwiches, and ice cream.

Our family dines out a lot and we know all of the restaurants at The Village very well.  We like several of them, but The Counter is our new favorite.  We love that it's not massive, cavernous and loud, but that it still has a lively atmosphere and a bit of style.  It is perfectly fun & comfortable for the kids while being sufficiently tasteful & stylish for the adults.

It took us a while to come in here -- the name made me think it was fast food but it absolutely is not.  It is freshly made food with table service and a good beer / wine selection.  Which is why it should not be compared to Smash Burger or Red Robin -- I'm annoyed by the negative reviews that rant about the prices.  They tell you more about the Meridian population than about this restaurant.

We usually 'Build Your Own' burger and have tried most of the meats both on buns and as bowls.  I love the seared ahi burger.  Our kids love the sliders and the grilled cheese.
