We all love the shoestring fries, I have never had a single one be soggy.  And I'm a sauce fanatic so I order a 'Flight of 3' (for a whopping $0.75) and have a little dipping party with my fries.  There are so many sauces to choose from I'm still working through the list.

For us, this is Boise's answer to the Burger Bar in Vegas, which we love.  Long live The Counter, it fills a definite gap here.

A burger is a burger?
Whomever said this hasn't eaten at the Boise Fry Company!  What a great place to go.  Your choice of Beef, Bison, Turkey or Vegan Burgers made you a number of options from sweet to hot.

Not to mention an outstanding variety of fresh fries from choices of potatoes ranging from - Russet, Gold, Laura, Yam, Sweet, Purple, Okinawa, or Brussels Sprouts in a heaven of selections of sauces ranging from spicy ketchup, their special fry sauce, blueberry, garlic, habanero to basic ketchup just to name a few.

And to top that off a friendly and welcoming atmosphere  and comfortable sitting.  If you're ever in the Boise area I highly recommend this place, you'll love it!

We had our lab and Bernese Mtn dog groomed by Dallas.  She was on time, professional and did a great job on both dogs. Both dogs looked gray and loved Dallas.  So convenient that they came to our house. Will definitely use them again.

Wow! What an unexpected treat. Small little place but the food is amazing. The pork chop with bacon jalapeño jelly side was the best I've ever had. The salmon was just perfect. Not overpriced at all and the portion size was very generous. I would recommend these folks anytime.

First time visiting Grant's and it was a pretty good experience.  Our server, Ben, was attentive and knowledgeable of the menu.  I ordered the Caesar Salad with spicy dressing (didn't taste much spice) and hubby had the pork chop with peaches, asparagus, and mushroom bread pudding. His dish was beautifully prepared and tasted divine. However, for the $18 pork chop meal price it should've included a dinner salad or cup of soup, at the very least. Beer choices on tap were plentiful. 

Although the food was good the flies were terrible!  The restaurant front has a garage type roll-up door that was opened. The place has an inviting feel but no air flowing outward to ward off said flying offenders. 

We look forward to returning, probably when less flies are around, to experience more of their menu.

SOOOO good! Today was the first time trying out this place and it was amazing. I got the silver duck sandwich and hubby got the mountain man sandwich, that are both delicious. They are huge too!  I also got a ham and cheese for the kids. I had two toddlers and split the sandwich because it was big. Hubby said the guys he had talked to were very nice and they even gave him a free cup of soup while he waited for the sandwiches. 
I will definitely be going back for some food!

One of the best gourmet burger places in Meridian and also a great place for low carb diets! 
You can order your hamburger with a lettuce bun and they have salads. Their toppings on their burgers as well as interesting flavor milkshakes make them a unique choice. 
They now have full bar and good beer & wine selections. 
I like their Carne Asada Burger. I was so good! It comes with romaine, slices jalapeño, caramelized onion, dice tomatoes, avocado, corn and brioche buns! I love the brioche buns! My husband loves their "Elvis" milkshake! It has peanut butter, bananas and chopped bacon in it!
Amazing Food!!Best sandwich we have ever had! I really wish they were open on Sunday's though!

Whitewater Pizza and Pasta just moved from its old location. They were by Panda express over by Wal-Wart. Now they are by Blimpes and Smash Burger. This new location is still on Eagle Rd, but down by the freeway. It is a lot smaller than the old one and has none of the look and feel of it. (Even though I never ate there, I did go into the old location on business once) I do not know why they moved, but just based on the smallness of it and the lack of decoration, I wonder if they started struggling financially.

My wife and I have been meaning to eat here for years, but just never have until now. I see very good reviews of Whitewater Pizza from when they were at the old location. I wish I had eaten at the old location so that I could compare the 2. 

We started with Throw Ropes, which is cheesy bread sticks with marinara. The bread was moist and tender. The marinara sauce was not overly tomotoee, which we don't like. It was not spicy at all. Both my wife and I thought it was just right. 

My wife had the Willow Creek Super Sandwich. The sandwich was a huge portion, which I am assuming is why it is called "Super". The bread was a toasted and crispy Fococcia. I would estimate that the bread alone was pretty close to an inch thick.

With 2 of these pieces of thick bread, the breadiness of the sandwich was just about all you could taste. My wife gave me the other half of her sandwich because she didn't like it for this reason.

Being a problem solver, like I am, I removed 1 of the pieces of bread. Then folded the other piece of bread, which meant that now there was double the meat and much much less bread to deal with. With this adjustment, now the sandwich was very good.

I had the personal size Thai Pie pizza. According to the menu, It had marinated Chicken, A thai peanut ginger sauce, chopped peppers and green onions with roasted whole peanuts. On the menu, it sounded wonderful!

Unfortunately, when this pizza came up, it looked and tasted very unappetizing. All I could see was a huge glob of what looked like a Mozzarella cheese. There was 1 lone whole peanut on the top of every piece. I could also see 1 very thin slice of red bell beeper on top of each slice. 

When I tasted the pizza, there was almost no flavor what-so-ever. The only thing that gave the pizza any goodness at all came from that thin red bell pepper. The chicken that was supposed to be marinated, was bland and completely lacking in flavor. I could not taste any ginger or peanuts in the sauce at all. The lone whole peanut on top did not add anything to this very disappointing pizza.

Our server was a very young kid. He seemed very lackluster as well. It took him a while to remember our order. 

We will not be returning to White Water Pizza.
We love it and will be back. Some of critique on this family business is little to harsh.  Those people complaining need to go back to McDonalds.
I love dutch bros! Coffee is always great and the service has been the same when I go there. Very enthusiastic staff and the prices are affordable!

I was quoted one price on the telephone for a hair cut from Darla, the Creative Director.  When I went to pay for the hair cut, it was suddenly twenty dollars more than the price I had been told on the telephone,  So, BUYER BEWARE!!!!!!  Needless to say, I will not be returning to a shop where the price can be altered at the whim of the beautician.

I thought I should add that I have had my hair cut in four different Toni and Guy salons in three different states.  This was my first horrible experience.  In general, these salons are very reliable.  Meridian, ID seems to be a glaring exception.
The food is not bad, but the portions are kind of small. There is a kid meal that comes with a gift card to the games up above. This is a great place to watch sports games. The TV is enormous.
Great fresh breads, sandwiches use real, not processed, meat. Triple check your order at the drive thru, messed our order up twice!

We had a very nice stay at Hampton Inn in Meridian. It's a very nice hotel--very clean and the people are very kind. Complimentary breakfast included hot oatmeal, iron-yourself waffles, potatoes and scrambled eggs, various pastries and juices, and of course cereal and yogurt. It is easy to get around and walking distance to a subway and McDonald's, if you need to grab something quick to eat. There is also a fridge and a microwave in each room. Our party of 10 was very pleased.

Really good to have a place dedicated to the wonderful option of our beloved Idaho potatoes. They have fries of almost every kind and the atmosphere is bubbly. It is definitely worth getting out of the drive thru lines and taking a moment to sit down and have options.

I travel to Boise monthly. Great hotel and location. Clean rooms and friendly staff. There are nicer hotels in Boise but this is the most consistent and best bang for the buck. I can stay anywhere on business on the companies dime but this is the place I always go back to. No fuss which is exactly what you want in a hotel.

I love these guys! The nail techs are always happy, the manager is always smiling and very interactive with whom you can tell are regulars.  It's good vibes here and I always come here only to get my pedicure. They were even able to get me in last on a Friday. They even offered me a choice on what lotion I wanted for my massage ... I highly recommend if you want your nails done with quality

I don't live in Idaho so I can't speak to this place on a consistent basis I've been here probably about 4 times in the last couple of years and have never had a bad experience. Their Naked Nachos (one of my all time favorite foods from anywhere) area always good and the ingredients fresh. Prices are reasonable and the staff has always been friendly too. I've never been when it's busy though. They did have to refill the chicken while my friend and I were there but they did it super fast. I've been to way worse and less clean places where I live before so whenever I come to Boise, I'll still plan on making a stop at Qdoba!
I was dying for a juice burger with Fries and don't forget the freaking fry sauce!!! And that's exactly what I got!! Absolutely hit the spot and I would go back anytime!!

Every time we leave the room, both keys deactivate and we have to go all the way to the lobby to get them activated again. We've had a handful of things and couldn't even get into the building because of the fucking room keys. Bathroom is really small in some rooms, paint on the walls is chipped. Housekeeping doesn't bother coming in even if you don't have a do not disturb thing on, then they'll leave a note saying they'll be back with towels because they don't have any and they never come back with them so we're left with no towels.

The continental breakfast here is awesome, they even change up the proteins everyday so you don't get bored. The staff keeps the rooms, pool, workout center, and lounge clean. There are free cookies upon your arrival and a small store for your convenience. Our room was a lovely double queen bed with a microwave and mini fridge (very handy). It was snowing so a good working heater was important! Towels were restocked everyday and our room was tidy when we returned. I Enjoyed my stay here.

Great frys!
Purple potatoes from Peru. 
This was definitely an experience in exotic French frys!

If I were rating the bear I'd give this place 5 stars. Since I have to lump the food in I'd have to give this place a 3. I suggest a tall Double Bach before eating. This way you won't even care how the food tastes.

Went in today for lunch.... Had the crunchy pork belly burger... AWESOME.... Also had the loaded bacon cheesy tater tots.. Great flavor but had a weird creamy texture.... If they would put something in them that adds a crunch or at least something to chew., they would be 5 star!! Love the burgers here!!

First time here.  Had heard wide range of comments about the food.  Menu was not huge and only a couple of items interested me.  Ordered the Cubano sandwich and my wife ordered the salmon special.  The Cubano was very good and the flavor profile was well put together.  My wife said the salmon was very good and vegetables were cooked close to perfect.  Not sure if we will come back.  They need fly traps out on the patio and the service definitely needs some work and training.

Great place to watch a sports game. Great place for families. Great place for adults. We have visited Al's on several occassions, each time looking for something different. 

One time was to take my son for dinner and for some gaming. Had a great meal which also included some credits for gaming. They have a large selection of games (even for little ones). Seemed clean and friendly.

One time, we went in just for bowling. Ordered food and drinks and had a great time. The bowling alley is large and accomodates alot of people. Good equipment options. Fun for groups.

Another time, during the summer, we grabbed dinner on the patio. They had dueling pianos at the time. It was fun. My little one enjoyed it as well as many adults. Friendly laid back enviroment. Service can be a little slow because of the large crowd, but if you are not in a rush, it's worth it. Go early to get a good table.

Lastly, went in another time, specifically to watch a nfl game. Good seating. Lots of tvs. Movie theatre size screen gives great viewing. The enviroment is fun because other fans are always there and also cheering on thier teams. Great place to bring a group of friends.

I read a few of the reviews on here; I am sad people have bad experiences. I know this place has had a few downs but believe me this place is a gem in the restaurant world in the treasure valley. I know the last few months has been up and down with employee issues which I get the restaurant industry is tough sledding when it comes to employees that being said as a regular I have seen the service improve over the last few months. I have never got sick from the food it's always been fresh and full of Sicilian flavor. I have to be honest when I first came here I always stuck with the pastas. The spaghetti and meatballs is excellent; you can tell the sauce is fresh full of tomato flavor and even little spice at the back end. Their pasta is fresh which only adds to the experience no box pasta here. For this review I want to highlight the sandwiches. Only recently have I ventured out into other areas in their menu. I have tried the honey chicken sandwich and the godfather. Your not going to find any sandwiches like them in the valley. The godfather has pepperoni and meatballs and Alfredo/marina sauce. One of the key elements in both sandwiches is the ciabatta bread; not too hard just really complements the flavored in the sandwich. The honey chicken is my favorite. It's a delightful mix of chicken, onions, basil mayo, spinach and honey. Trust me you won't be disappointed. It's one of the most unique and flavorful sandwiches I have eaten in a long time. Even down to the onions which have a honey glaze I think they were tasty. Don't forget the Rosemary fries; tip ask for the basil mayo it takes the fries to whole nother flavor level. All in all this local eatery is a must try featuring unique sandwiches and fresh made pastas and sauces give it a try you won't be disappointed!!

Delish!  Did not have any previous expectations but found out from other Eaters that this pace originated in CA. Many people in line who have waited for this place to show up in Boise. Yummy chargrilled burgers, fresh salads and fries. Amazing onion rings but don't leave without trying the fried green beans. Great way to eat a green veggie. We will definitely be back.

One of the best sandwich places I have found since moving to Boise. Food was excellent. Ordered the Blue Bronco which is a roast beef dip with blue cheese and bacon. The owner was super cool and made some great suggestions for dinner. Will definitely be back to try more off the menu.

Every time we eat here we get exceptional food with outstanding service.  Arliss loves the yakisoba.  I like the hot curry (3 peppers) and it is quite warm.  Great place to eat and is reasonably priced.

So.... an update.. I've been here a few times and the food/burgers seem to be different every time.. I had the Faberge burger as I had before (picture).. This time the burger seemed at least 1/3 less the size than before and just didn't have the  awesome flavor as I remembered... I will give them another try... But if they fail, I will not go back... There are just to many other options close by to roll the dice each time with them.

These guys are the BEST! They are passionate about their product, genuinely care about the customer, and desire to help people reach their fitness goals (no matter what those goals look like)!

Aside from offering top-notch customer service and quality products, Fleet Feet is all about the local community! Every Wednesday they host a free run at the Village and invite the community to join. I've attended one before, and the vast mix of people from all walks of life that show up for these runs is incredible! They also offers training programs for runners- so if you're looking to start running, or just want to step-up your running game, they can help you accomplish your goals.

Now on to the products...

Before they pull out one pair of shoes for you to try on they measure your foot, take a look at your arch, evaluate how your foot moves when you walk, and ask you questions about what your fitness goals are. THEN, they bring out a few different pairs of shoes to try on and have you walk around the store and run around out front in them.

I ended up deciding on a pair of New Balance sneakers, and I already feel more than amazing about my purchase! I feel like I've been blindly purchasing running shoes until now. It's crazy how wrong all my other pairs of sneakers feel after experiencing what it's like to wear shoes that are actually right for my foot. The shoes I bought were a bit spendy, but I don't even feel the slightest bit guilty for buying them because I know it will pay off in the form of being able to run without my feet cramping!

I'll def be back the next time I need to buy running shoes or anything of the sort!

Nectar of the gods. 
There isn't a place in the Boise area that I enjoy more. In fact, I found myself missing the little blue rooftop on my 3 week vacation more than I missed people. Perhaps it was the lack of decent coffee that gave way to this feeling...
No matter. 
If the coffee doesn't keep you coming back, the people will. It's no wonder this place is so popular. They are awesome. Ask for a surprise and they won't disappoint. I think I've tried just about everything on the menu via this method. 
However, if you are a control freak and just can't let go, the Kicker is a solid choice. I enjoy mine with coconut milk. 
Punch cards mean after 10 you get one free. And what a glorious day that is. 
Love you, Dutch Bros.
Talk about awesome customer service. Our experience her was great. Food is delicouse and this place is outstanding for their care for customers.

I love Keashona. She nails my hair every time. She influences me to try new things and they always come out fabulous. When I started having an allergy to beauty products, they found what they could use and used that. I return every 5 weeks and look forward to it. Also, the girl talk is on point. She's great.
highly recommend...bread this good is hard to find in Boise/Meridian.

First, a digression. Veteran Yelpies have undoubtedly trod this road before, but since Yelp evidently doesn't encourage reviews of itself, let me just say this: I WANT HALF STARS. In an era when all children are above average and shopping mall food court Chinese is "awesome," we need a little more room for nuance. According to the guidelines, 3 stars means "A-OK," which to me seems pretty good, not great, while 4 stars is "Yay, I'm a fan (exclamations deleted)," which starts to approach Michelin territory in my book.

This is nowhere more applicable than a restaurant like Sa-Wa-Dee. It virtually screams 3.5 stars. It's not SWD's fault that we live in a homogeneous area ethnically and that an authentic Thai restaurant might be a hard sell, resulting in a generic pan-Asian menu tailored to American palettes. So they lose no stars from me for the cop-out, and if you can get over that part, it's really a pretty good restaurant.

This is a sister establishment to Rice in Eagle, and there are culinary similarities. The food is well-prepared, reflecting a kitchen that pays attention to details. We've eaten in both places several times and have yet to taste anything the slightest bit greasy, reheated, or past its prime. SWD is at least as good as other Thai restaurants we've found in the area, and compared to the generally miserable lineup of Chinese restaurants, it is a shining star. The bar is low, but at least SWD isn't below it.

The fresh rolls, satay, and dumplings are standouts among the starters, and you can put together a satisfying meal from just this part of the menu. Among the entrees, the fried rice is fluffy and light, and the stir-fries like al dente asparagus and mushrooms with chicken or shrimp are winners.

So what's the problem? Nothing major really, but there are minor things that add up. The space is small, as are the tables, and during busy times it feels cramped and stuffy. In terms of decor, they've probably done the best they can to dress up a strip-mall location wedged between a Subway and title loan emporium. 

The servers are unfailingly pleasant and efficient, but please stop trying to take away my plate if I set the fork down for 2 seconds. On our last visit this happened so many times I finally surrendered, sure go ahead if it means that much to you. And do you really need constant affirmation that everything is okay?

My biggest complaint with the food is that, like a lot of Asian restaurants in the area, many of the items are really sugary. Some entrees taste more like dessert.(This is true at Rice as well.) I like sweet sauce...on pancakes or ice cream. The servers are generally helpful in avoiding these items but you have to ask, as the menu offers no clues.

It is fairly pricey for this category. The house wines available for the happy hour discount are pretty mediocre, while the other offerings are a bit better though expensive. The beer selection is fine. We paid $80-something for two, though next time we'll skip the $10 by-the-glass selections and stick with the beer. (But whatever happened to hot tea?)

Bottom line here, we'll go back from time to time but we won't stop looking. (And maybe I'll update this review with 3 stars so I can get my 3.5!)

Hubby and I found this place on accident but so glad that we did!  Great selection, yummy meatball sandwich and the service was fantastic!  We will be back again and I will definitely recommend this place.

I love Wells Fargo on Main Street in Meridian!

Every time I walk into the bank I am greeted and acknowledged.  The staff can't be anymore attentive.  I've had to do several notaries and both notaries were beyond helpful.

I also like the drive through feature for my banking needs.

Food : came out fast... I ordered a chimichanga I ate it all I liked it but  not the best I have ever had but good. My husband ordered the Macho Burrito he liked it, says average and good.

Service: Friendly staff handled a big group fast.
Environment: Wobbly table, a bit hot inside, decor was lively.

One Gripe: We brought a printable coupon and the guy was too lazy to redo the group check so we could use it. I took time to print it off before I came. I will definitely not go back because that is crap, and seemed like a totally bogus excuse and he was too lazy. What a rip not to honor a coupon that someone takes time to print off. I feel like they owe me $7... I will go someplace that will honor their coupons.
Boise Fry Company has good food typically, but I was underwhelmed by this location. The customer service wasn't great, the employees weren't good at their tasks, and the fries I received were burnt.

Thai is my favorite type of food, and I've frequented restaurants all over the western coast. 

I can say without hesitation that this is the best curry yet. 

There was a bit of a wait, but more than worth it when the food arrived. 

Sa-Wad-Dee does not disappoint

5 stars

We haven't been here in a while but have always had great burgers and salads in the past- not today. I had the soggiest Reuben ever and it's my favorite! My girl tried the chicken katsu sandwich that was piled with so many picked vegetables, sauce and Cole slaw she ended up picking it apart to try and eat the soggy chicken, yuck. The best part about this dinner was the ranch dressing.  To top things off a martini was $7.00 and a shot of (what tasted watered down) Yeager was $7.25???

Oh Ram, how the cool and fun have fallen!

Food came fast. Employees were not friendly! All tables were dirty and I had to ask for a rag to clean my table and another table so an elderly couple could have a clean table to sit at as well. Was not to impressed. CUSTOMERS FIRST!!!

I love love Sa-Wad-Dee!  I usually order the Beef Massamun Curry, but I love their Pad Thai and the Swimming Rama - they have great spinach with this.  The golden tofu is always perfectly crunchy/tender and the salads are delicious too.  It's far better than over-priced places like Mai Thai.

Went for a quick lunch the other day while the kiddos were at Noodles...the BBQ chicken salad was fantastic. Really good flavor and lots of crunch! My wife had the crispy chicken sandwich which was also really good. Friendly and attentive to-go service during a busy lunch rush. Need to remember how good it was to go back again for lunch when I'm in the neighborhood!

Awesome deli with an interesting, but classic menu. The service is fantastic, and the owners treat you like a regular even if it is your first time there. I ordered the Oriental Salad, and the veggies were freshly cut and the chicken was flavorful and juicy. I can't wait to try the grilled PBJ and this California type sandwhich that was as big as the guy's face who was eating it. There are far too few local, rad delis and I'm so happy to have one right next door to my work. 

If you don't see something you like on the menu the chef will make something you do like!
Best donuts in the valley, made fresh EVERY morning on the spot not shipped in. Pass on the Crusty Creams sugar bomb and enjoy a real deal donut.
When they say " light" cream cheese they really mean it. Truly disappointing since this was my first time. Probably won't be returning

Probably one of the better choices around for Thai. We tried the asparagus chicken and shrimp and would definitely come back just for this dish. The fried green beans were a little bit of a let down-didn't have that crunchy light tempura batter I have seen in other pics. Glad to see they have more reasonable lunch options also.

Such a great value! I booked same day through Expedia and the room was under $70. This hotel exceeded my expectations. The lobby was clean and the room was comfortable and very clean. Bed linens were soft-- I slept very well. The complementary breakfast was on point! Pet-friendly and there is green space in the back for the pups to run. Would absolutely stay again.  Would be 5/5 but the shower didn't get quite as hot as I'd have liked.
This is a very nice hotel. It was my 3rd time staying here. I love how the rooms and beds are really clean. Their breakfast is also really nice and so is the pool.

I have been coming here for over 2 years now. I love the staff and the atmosphere. My lashes are always on point and I get endless compliments. I get the volumes and they are fluffy and gorgeous and last me 3 weeks before my fill. With so many options out there these guys really know how to keep the competition on their toes. You can go elsewhere and pay less, but remember you get what you pay for. Give this salon and try and you won't regret it.

While visiting family in Idaho they took me here to sample the awesome burgers, fries, and beer.  The kids loved all the different sauces for the many different kind of potatoes they have.  Purple potatoes?  Well gosh darn, we are in Idaho lol.  If purple isn't your thing choose another.  IMO You should try them though as they are unique in the sense you don't see them anywhere else. 

Me and my son had a Payette Wet hopped Ale suggested by the guy at the counter.  Very good beer. We both really liked it.   The bison burger I had was pretty good. They have a few ways to get burger we went with the spicy one.  I forgot about reading that they cook well done.  I prefer mine medium as real burgers should be cooked  lol.   Still very good.  

I am sure when I come back in the spring we will be back.  Thanks for the hospitality and beer suggestion

I had a bbq bacon cheeseburger on sourdough son had the same. They were very good. They are also the only thing that kept me from giving 1 star instead of 2. The fries where soggy and cold. The wife had beer batteted shrimp and that was hot but that was its only redeeming quality. Service was slow when our server bothered to check on us at all.

The worst customer service. I walked in without anyone saying a word to me. There were three employees working and about five customers in at the time. While I was trying on boots, one of the employees walked right by me and still didn't ask if I needed any help. I was in the store for a total of 25 minutes. By the time I was ready to pay one of the girls was just standing behind the counter texting on her phone, I was standing right in front of her...she looked up from her phone made eye contact and continued texting. I have never dealt with such terrible service and I will definitely not be returning.

I needed a new pair of shoes and decided to stop in and check out their selection. I was accompanied by my sister, mom and dad who were in town visiting. I ended up buying two pairs of shoes and my mom also bought a pair.

We were so impressed with the friendliness and knowledge of the owner Brandon, who was later joined by his brother who also works there. The store is locally owned and this is exactly the kind of place you want to support and do business with!!!

I will only by shoes from here! They guarantee the products and if the shoes end up not working for you they encourage you to bring them back!

What a great addition to Meridian and best of luck to the owners....you deserve success with your new store!

After an extremely crappy experience at flying pie on main street 5 minutes prior  (see my previous review) Boise Fry Co. hit the spot. The place was clean, fast, extremely nice, and did I mention fast? I ordered, went to the restroom and came out to food at my table. It was cooked to perfection and delicious. The staff even came to check on us twice,  and took our plates when we were done (mind you this is a small fast food place, not a big restaurant). Thank you for saving Sunday night dinner! Not to mention the healthier option in choosing these guys, they use non-gmo and organic ingredients.

Seemed rushed and rude. When they did my mani the guy started too high on my nail and it was visibly grown out in less than a week. My pedi was not the best. Barely any massage and they didn't even try to file off the callouses. She barely swept the file/pumice over the balls of my feet and heels. It also chipped within a couple days. I get pedis regularly at another place so will go back there. Just wanted to try something different but definitely won't be back here.

Four burgers, one side salad, fries, fried pickles, and 4 drinks $85.  Food was not worth the prices.  I don't expect The Counter will have a Boise residence for much longer.  Maybe what works in California should stay in California?

First time going here and the tacos were good but cold! The grilled fish tacos were fishy, but the tin roof, pulled pork and chicken fajita were delicious. I might give it another try just wish they were warm!
The food was amazing! The waitress suggested trying the cranberry signature drink and the drink was the topic of conversation the majority of the night. I highly recommend this place!

Fun place where you can try many different styles of French fries made from different types of potatoes. They also have a wide variety of dipping sauces and seasoning salts that are fun to try.  The burgers are also good.  They typically have a good deal for happy hour.   If possible, I recommend going off peak hours as the restaurant and parking lot are rather small so seating and parking can be an issue.  During the summer months they utilize an outdoor patio to allow for more seating.

You will not find a better sandwich that is expertly prepared and served friendlier anywhere in the Boise area. Ingredients are fresh, local, and handcrafted. Recommend the Tony's pastrami but everything on the menu tastes incredible. It's over 100 degrees outside and I still couldn't pass up a cup of the jalapeño bacon chowder. You know the place is delicious when even a simple side like slaw is good enough to be eaten by itself. Keep it up fat guys- I'll be back.
Burgers not very good. Frys ok. Lots of different sauces for frys and none that good. Surprised this wasn't that good. Burgers below average

The first time I went here I didn't have a good experience so I haven't back for years.  

Food:  sushi, husband had seafood rice dish, very good!
Atmoshere:  it's 3/5 floor was sticky
Service: very good and prompt, no wait (sat night) yet the restaurant was busy.
Price:  Two adults/ 1 Sake, 2 entree, 1 appetizer, 1 dessert +tip ~$50
I absolutely love Kneaders! Everything is fresh. Tonight I came just for their desert!

We went there to celebrate my sister's and my birthday. They were very busy but we got a table right away. The service was good considering how busy they were. They took my 3 year old niece's order first and got that started right away. The food was amazing I ordered the mushroom burger which was amazing. The French fries were some of the best I've ever had anywhere. I was not crazy about the vampire fries but the regular fries, amazing. The only real complaint I have is that I ordered a 6 Oz glass of Malbec, which they were out of, but that's not a big deal, but when they brought it, they brought a 9 Oz glass. That is literally the only issue I will be coming back here for sure. Oh me and my sister also got a free cupcake for our birthdays, also very good, and they did not sing to us. I will be recommending this restaurant for sure.

We are staying in hotel behind here and saw this. So here we are day 2!  Bf needed a pedi and me a fill. I looked at the pix and saw that Jenna was good but was unable to get her. She is taking no new clientele. So I got some guy .. he was ok. Bf didn't really get let massage either so...oh well. The owner saw I wasn't really happy with my nails at first so he offered Jenna to do a few nail art nails for free. So the lady that she was working on was gracious enuf to share... that was the best part! So I got Valentines designs on a few nails. Woo hoo. Ok so I tipped $10 to make up for it. So I was happy.

I've been here three times now and it's 3/3. Very cool sandwich spot with a bunch of different choices. Everything I've had has been great and everything I've seen has also looked awesome! If you like sandwiches, you need to check this place out. Very friendly and helpful staff too! Seem to really enjoy what they do. Everything on the sandwiches from bread, toppings, meat etc. has been top notch! Potato salad is also extremely good and I don't really like potato salad.

OMG! I've never been to a Thai restaurant, until this past August. I went to visit my sister and her family in Meridian, ID. We all went to dinner at Sa-Wad-Dee. I wasn't too excited at first, because I wasn't sure what to order. The only thing I've ever eaten that was Thai, was Pad-Thai. We ordered quite a few dishes, I forgot what they were, but they were all yummy! Will definantly have to try more Thai dishes now.

I've been to multiple salons in the valley and no one has even compared to this place! I am not exaggerating when I say ive gotten the best/favorite nail services here! They don't add on surprise upcharges or pressure you into spending more money. All staff is extremely polite, considerate, takes their time and pays attention to detail, symmetry and satisfaction. I actually found them for the first time months ago on yelp and it was the best choice yet- It IS worth your time to check them out. They really do care; Seriously so in love with overall service and staff!  #perfection

Loved this place. We happened across their ad in our hotel brochure. We had tortilla soup. It was served so elegantly and was so delicious. I don't know the server's name, but he was a doll. I would rate this as one if the Mexican restaurants I've been to.

Terrible experience - took some out of town friends bowling here tonight and well no one was impressed. We paid $20 for a pitcher of beer that took over 30 ninutes to get to our table. The waitress did not have a clue what beers were on tap claiming there were no IPAs (only later to hand a list of over 40 different beers to my friend) the food was $13-$15 a plate bowling was $5.50 (per person per game) + $3.50 shoe rental. The front desk gal was horrible at explaining the process of what you were paying for. It seemed as though the staff really lacked the knowlege and communication skills needed to provide quality customer service. We were in the middle of the game when the server notified us that someone did not pay for the 3rd game our game just shut off and the lane closed. When we went to resolve the issue and pay another $5.50 for 6 people. We were not able to continue our orginal game but needed to start entirely over. All in all this was ridiclously overpriced, the service was terrible and I do not reccomed this establisment unless you want to blow money. Support a local bowling alley pay a quarter of the price and have a better time.

Long waits. Last time I had an appointment for my infant son I checked in 15 minutes prior to the time his appointment was scheduled. I did not leave the waiting room for an HOUR. And when we were in the exam room it was still another 15 minutes.  So an hour and a half wait time. for a 60 second appointment. to tell me my sons ears were still red but we they dont want to prescribe another antibiotic. None of the staff warned us of the wait and nobody apologized for the wait either. I am definitely looking for a new pediatrician.

This was my first experience at The Habit. I got the original chat with cheese. I took it home with me. The fries had some good flavor to them and tasted very fresh. Dip them in a little bit of fry sauce and this left great flavor in my mouth. 
Then I get to my burger. My SMASHED BURGER did have good taste, however it was smashed. The burger tasted pretty good. The caramelized onions tasted good. 

The burger was smashed from wrapping it. This shouldn't have happened. I mean maybe a little bit, but the but was smashed to the hamburger, but only where the wrapper covered it

My server did actually grab me some fry sauce, which was quite awesome.

First of all I don't know why anyone would give this place bad reviews. There is only one delivery guy who works with Kelly, and they always take everything in and set it up. They even take your old furniture (no matter how grody) out for you!  
So maybe the people leaving the bad reviews have the wrong place or something.

I've bought 4 mattresses and a dresser from this place, and they were all delivered & set up for me- i cant say rcwilley or ashley furniture would do that!
kelly always does her BEST to make sure the customer is happy, no matter what it takes! she even orders stuff they dont have in stock if requested. 

I'll never buy furniture anywhere else. ;-)
Really great pizza, my daughter loves the crust. We held a team event at this location for her soccer team and the waitstaff was excellent and patient with all the kids.

I wish I could give this place a zero. My wife and I and our daughter came in at 8:30 pm. The shakes were good but 6.50 apiece? First black mark. Then they bring out our daughters mini cheeseburgers which looked like hockey pucks and came out a good ten mins before the adult food. When my wife's burger arrived she ordered medium well and it was RED and cool. When asked to cook it more we were lectures by the snotty waitress that here that was medium well. I asked to have it cooked more and that it was cool and running red juices. She takes it back to the kitchen. 
Then the ridiculously rude young manager comes out and says "medium well is pink on the middle" and when I replied that it was cold she proceeded to argue with me. And so apparently in my 40 years every other place has cooked their burgers wrong?! So we send it back and by that time my wife has had it and wants to just leave because she's so mad she can't even talk to them. So I go up to the counter and the same rude manager says "what's up" very rudely. We say we just want to leave and she walks away. Then we can hear and see her bitching at the counter about us.
Needless to say they got no tip and over my dead body would we go there again. 
Stay away!!! It's expensive and so not worth it

PLEASE READ: 
   I visited this park several times before, and mostly enjoyed it. Today was different. 
   My friend and I were in line to go down the dark tubless slides, when we saw something we cannot comprehend. 
    A mother and her children were heading to get into the slides, and her son(I'm guessing it's her son.) did not want to go into the slide. I mean. He did NOT want to go into the slide. The poor child was maybe 4 years old. The mother was prying his hands off of the railings and dropped him into the slide. His hands were clenched on the out side of the slide, I mean he was terrified. Finally after a few solid minutes of the mother pushing(I mean pushing.) her kid into the dark tube the child made it down the slide, on his stomach going down backwards. MAY I ADD- THE LIFE GUARD DID ABSOLUTELY NOTHING. After a few people went down the slide, we made it down and the child was still crying mortified. 
   Why didn't the life guard do anything and why would a company support child abuse. I mean this was a huge deal. I'm defiantly never taking my child here, I'm fear someone else will treat my kid like that. Or that a life guard won't protect children.

The customer service here is amazing! Ha went above and beyond to accommodate for my daughter's wedding and get in everybody at the same time on fairly short notice. My daughter's nails were absolutely stunning and looked great in the pictures. Very creative technicians that give you great ideas for color and designs. Two weeks later and my nails still look great! The physical setting has a great look and feel and very clean.
The service was superb and the food was excellent as it sounds. But the table next to me was loud, obnoxious, and rude it gave me a headache  . I do recommend this for families

I went to Fat Guy's for the first time today after reading other positive reviews here, and it was even better than I was expecting. The owner was very welcoming and helpful when it came to deciding what I wanted. I settled on the Bleu Bronco, what seems to be the signature sandwich, but because I can't stand bleu cheese, I had it replaced in favor of feta at the owner's suggestion. Service was fast and the sandwich was incredible. The potato salad was quite good also. It is obvious that they are using fresh ingredients and making everything themselves. The price was very agreeable too. Definitely stop by for lunch if you're in the neighborhood.
Very friendly staff and excellent donuts! I had Bavarian Cream filled chocolate and Buttermilk Cruller. I will be going back. SOON!

Food here is good. The service was friendly and quick. Loved the atmosphere and decor here. Solid restaurant for a Sunday brunch. A little more expensive than I would have expected, but otherwise a solid restaurant!

I was pleasantly surprised with this restaurant because I am a fan of Chapalas and have not found anything that matches it in Idaho so far ( I am from AZ so I am fairly picky). The food was priced slightly cheaper then Chapalas and the portions were a lot bigger. I had the Carne Asada which I normally get at Chapalas also. The taste was comparable and I blame the slight lack of charring on the meat which I am fond of to the fact that I decided to get my meat rare so it barely stayed on the grill. Anyhow the beans and salsa with complimentary chips where average.. I don't really compare them to any other restaurant because I know everyone pours it out of a can when it comes to beans or at least it tastes that way. The salsa seemed homemade though... our waiter was very quick with our food and polite:). I did not get any adult beverages since I am prego so cannot comment on the strength but what I did notice is they gave us a sopapilla at the end of the meal which I always love and sadly Chapala never gives. I will definitely be back and this time bring the hubby to try out the drinks and get his opinion on the food.

Maybe this is what passes for Mexican food in Idaho. I'm recently from Arizona and have been on the hunt for good Mexican restaurant. This was the worst so far. I fact I don't even what to continue looking after this experience. 
I thought my bland chicken chimichanga was bad until my husband gave me a taste of his tamale. It tasted like it was seasoned heavily with cheap mexican candy seasoning. It tasted the way a dirty cheap convenient store smells. 
The service was horrible, we were not attend to. It took forever to get our check. 
Do not eat here.

Food has always been great. I have done a lot of business there. The service keeps getting worse.  Staff always seems irritable and frustrated.  I tried to phone  order a dessert platter to pick up the next day.  The guy that answered said he was too busy to take my order and I needed to call back later.  Not nice.  Not apologetic. They are either way understaffed or they hire the wrong people.  Either way the owners/managers need to get a handle on it if they want to keep customers.
We discovered this place when we had a B1G1 coupon, and we've been back several times.  Nice sports bar with solid pub food.  Everything we've tried has been good.

Popped into Boise Fry Company last week while on a business trip to Idaho. We came with a larger group and the service was spectacular - friendly and inviting. So many different potato options to choose from. Fry heaven! 

Beef Burger Meal ($9.40): Toppings of the burger will depend on what you choose - I went with The Original which was spring mix, red onion, tomato, and garlic aioli. It was a good burger but nothing great - the buns were subpar. Added bacon to the burger (+0.75) which made the entire burger just that much better. The combo includes a drink and small fry or house salad.

For my fries, I ordered four smalls - russet, purple, gold, and laura. I had the cashier choose the cuts of the fries for what he recommended. My absolute favorite were the purple fries with just regular ketchup (yeah i'm boring!).

If you hate making decisions, this may not be the place for you! So many selections of potatoes, salts, and dipping sauces.

Being a Yelp girl is the best thing ever.   Once again My fellow Yelpers have not let me down :). Just had a yummy dinner at El Tenampa with my family.   Chips were fresh and my enchilada was wonderful. Friendly service too.

I was so excited to check this place out. The excitement faded fast. The shabby service overshadowed the overpriced a-la-carte menu was too ridiculous for me. Our server was more concerned with socializing with his counterpart than he was with coming back to the table to take our order. I gave them the benefit of the doubt although we waited almost 15 minutes just to order our food. However, no effort was made by the staff to make me a repeat customer. When our food finally arrived, the waiter asks "can I get you anything else?" Suggesting that we were finished eating. My first thought was 'well I'm not sure because I haven't taken a bite yet'...

We didn't see him again until he brought the check...

Be prepared to spend $14-$16 on the mediocre burger of your choice!.....that's JUST the burger. Want fries, better toss in another $3. The fries and flight of dips and aioli were awesome, but I wasn't dazzled by my $15 burger, heck I wasn't even impressed. If you want a flight of 3 sauces of your choice, toss in another $1.50 or so. What is this, New York?

For the price, I choose food and service that is light years beyond that of counter burger. We spent $30 for two people at lunch and that was one lunch special (lol) and one person drinking water!! No thanks...

Crappy experience at this joint

Nope, not for me.

The food is no better than average and VERY overpriced.  The restaurant is loud with a combination of piped in music, the open kitchen, and the family atmosphere.  

The service isn't great--our appetizer came out after our dinner was brought and the server kept calling us "you guys."  I had a salad with ranch on the side--the dressing was a strange yellowish color.  When I asked the server about it she agreed that it was "strange" and looked "watered down."  Unprofessional, not to mention not confidence inspiring

Awesome delicious fresh are just a few words to describe the food. I have been here over a dozen times sometimes with coworkers or clients and sometimes with friends and family. I order something different each visit and each time I am not disappointed and all of my guests have raved about the experience. This is not your typical sandwich shop and it should be on your to do list when in the area.

Love the sandwiches and treats!  Soups are decent.  Kids cookies are marginal. Cinnamon french toast is awesome!  Typically we receive good, quick service, though we have had some rough visits where they seem a bit disorganized.  Overall, we keep coming back because they are typically on it and we always enjoy their fresh sandwiches!

Good ambiance and great service.  Liked duck and seafood curry.  Salmon curry was also very good.  Pad see eww was not good at all.  Tasted more like soy sauce and noodles were more like fettucini.  Likely wouldn't return as this is staple dish for us.

The manager who has been there for years is the rudest, poorest excuse for whatever her title is I've ever seen. I stayed there years ago and she was just as rude or ruder. While staying last week I booked a room through priceline. While staying she demanded my credit card and told me she would charge me for something incidental, knowing this I walked through my room with a room attendant before I checked out to make sure I had proof there was nothing wrong with the room. 
This week I see a $50 charge on my card and when I called was told there was damage to a towel rack which is complete and total BS. When I called and asked for the owners information I was refused his contact info and hung up on. I'm in the process of filing a complaint with the BBB in Idaho. Do not stay there unless you'd like to be treated like you're a nuisance for staying.

Very disappointed. This is not the same place as it was when it opened beware. Food takes much longer then it should, do they have one person prepping??? We spent 30 minutes in drive through much like other yelpers.

The Bleu Bronco from 2 Fat Guys was the best sandwich I've ever had in my life (and I've had some good sandwiches). It was incredibly tasty. The Bread, the meat, the flavor, everything was fantastic! The employees are really helpful too -- couldn't decide what I wanted, and they helped me out with some recommendations. You can't go wrong!

Had my lashes done, paid full price, I had an allergic reaction. Had lashes on for only 4 days, then had them removed and they never offered any other services to make up for the lost money.  So I paid 120.00 for lashes for 4 days feeling a little ripped off

Great lil place. HUGE variety of dishes. They slimmed on the offered dishes a while back but menu is still super intimidating with so many options. All noodle dishes I tasted were good. My go to when I need to meet with girlfriends to catch up.
Food is great, portions are massive.  There was a few too many Packer fans for my taste, but oh well.

I ate here about ten years ago, and enjoyed everything about, so not sure why it took this long to come back. Again, great food with good portions, and friendly customer service. Will definitely go back!

I go to different Ram restaurants in the Boise  area fairly often.  Their cheddar cheese dip is AMAZING! The last time I was there, however, to the Ram on Pine, the service was mediocre at best...not their usual style.

I went with my sister and my girlfriend to get their nostril pierced. I have never been in a more clean and fun environment. Paul did an amazing job. I highly recommend him to anybody who is interested in any type of piercing.

My favorite coffee place. They're personal and friendly. The coffee is delicious. They're not too pricey. My kids ask me everyday to go there and get hot chocolate (so cheap and come in plastic little cups we reuse) and they sometimes give them lollipops, too. :)

I love this place. There's a great variety of foods for any given time of day. Breakfast is good. Lunch option are great. Dinner and evening meals or desserts are amazing. Fast, friendly service in relaxing ambiance.

Pros:
Menu is full of options
They bring you beans and salsa while you wait
Margaritas are big!
Portions are huge
My food was delicious 
Waitress was super nice!

Cons:
Made me so sooo sick
Very weak margarita 
Carnitas were cooked weird (I've just always made them different)

Definitely the best pizza I've had in the Valley. It's the closet to Peppz or Zittos in CA that I've found. My kids are picky and they loved theirs! I had the GF crust with sauce and pineapple. It was good!
They are definitely a new business so be patient while ordering. Everyone I've ordered with was still learning their system, but I don't mind waiting during the ordering process, because my order showed up hot and correct!

Sent enchiladas back because they center was shredded cheese not melted at all, just asked for it to be nuked. They remade it, but it was still cold in the middle. And I do mean cold, not melted at all. Asked him to please not remake, just microwave. Waited 10 min, while my mom finished her dinner. It came out again with the wrong sides. Asked for it to just be taken off the bill so we could leave, server walked away while I tried to talk to him. He did say he would take off half. Asked to speak to manager who was incredible rude and walked away while I was talking to him. Don't go here, if anything goes wrong you will have to deal with incredibly rude people. As a former restaurant manager I know you should never have to ask for something to be taken off the bill, when it comes out wrong three times, you just take care of the customer so they come back. Ps. I told a friend about this and she said when she ate here she found a bandaid in her food.

We had fun here. We bowled on lane 28. Lots of lanes and plenty of seating. It's loud and they play great music. We had really great food here which was not the mormal bowling alley stuff.  Pluss we had a really fun server who we could tell enjoyed his job. I appreciated how clean everything was and that the bowling balls were in good shape since I didn't have mine with me.

The friendly staff is always makes it a pleasure to return. The beer on tap is good. The sauces are different and yummy. They have a wide selection of fries and burgers. We just moved here, and wanted a local spot to grab a quick bite to eat. I recommend this place for sure. I have been a few times and everything is always clean. The staff is very accommodating with requests or substitutes. They even walk around to make sure you are enjoying you food or have any issues at all. I've only had that happen at "sit down" waiter type of places... anyways I'm glad to say I enjoyed this place and you will too.

I can't even being to explain how much we LOVE Janna! My daughter and I happily drive from SE Boise to her new salon at Eagle & Fairview.

This is not your average, run of the mill nail salon. Janna is simply amazing.... she has a natural talent for nail art, whether it is something you want very detailed or just something in general. She paints everything by hand... no airbrushing, stencils or stickers. And the high quality of every fill is consistent. They do acrylics and gel fills, and by gel I mean true "gel" fills. (Some places will tell you they do gel fills, but they fill with acrylic and do a gel color.) Janna has hundreds of gel colors and every glitter you can imagine. I get my nails filled every three weeks and never have a lift or an issue. 

Their pricing is very reasonable, the salon is spotlessly clean, and Janna and her husband Ha are two of the friendliest people I know.

Aside from nail enhancements, they do a great job at natural nail manicures, and have a whole bank of beautiful, clean massage pedi chairs. 

If you are a nail girl, do yourself a HUGE favor and visit Nail Tek. You will never go anywhere else. 

ONE TIP: Make sure to call ahead (208-898-0077) to see if you need an appointment. They do take walk ins, but they are sometimes very busy, so it's always best to give a call first.

She has a FaceBook page that she shares lots of great nail photos:
https://www.facebook.com/100007654364983 (JannaHa Nailtekandspa)

I used to love their Arrow con pollo, tonight it was a gross dissapointment. The large chunks of chicken were nowhere to be seen, the olives had shrunk, and the sauce tasted like a bottle if katsup, and I don't like katsup. It was a huge dissapointed.

The 4th Boise fry company to open.   And what a great location.  If you've never tryed BFC and you like or love frys like I do then this is the place for you!   Pick the type of potatoe and the cut.  And choose from lots of dipping sauce and seasonings to add.   If your a dipper than you will be in dipping Heaven!    BFC has beer on tap and house made sodas.  Sample the soda first much different that other soda with half the sugar. Not a fan.   

The new decor of this restaurant is very cool.  The light bulb wall is pretty innovative. Oh and they have burgers.  I recommend the bison burger.  Very solid but frys will keep you coming back. So good!

Been here three times. Twice for lunch and once for brunch. I really love this small and fun place. The breakfast has been my favorite place. The best Montecristo sandwich as well as eggs Benedict serve on biscuits ...was to die for. Hot and fresh coffee! Owner was our server and was able to answer all our questions. We will be back again!

Not a bad lunch spot. My wife had the veggie burger- she was fine with it but it was a bit heavy on the spice for me. I got a regular burger and our kiddo tried the chicken nuggets. I like that we could get fruit for the kid's meal. He said the nuggets were fine lol. My burger was ok- not amazing, not bad. Price was decent for what it was. Place was packed (Saturday afternoon- not surprising). Staff was pleasant.
Love the chicken and fries.  Stop there or the one on overland every time I make a trip to Boise.  Wish there was one closer to Caldwell.  Also great sandwhiches.

came here today for a lunch with my coworkers and i have to say from the outside you would kind of think this place wasn't that great. I don't know why, but I thought this was like a T.G.I. friday's situation. 
I couldn't be more wrong- it was SO nice inside! it was big and bright and the bar was gorgeous- I could see myself sitting there all day drinking beers and watching sports.

they had a ton of TVs, huge bar, huge dining room, nice decor...the manager got our drinks because they were super busy and she was really cool. our server did a great job too! I was really wrong about this place and i'm the first to admit it.

the menu is a good size and they had lots of options on every category. I felt like a salad so I ordered the "olympus" with blackened chicken breast. it has artichoke hearts, roasted red peppers, feta cheese, bacon, marinated red onions, avocado...I mean honestly it was fantastic. super fresh and flavorful from start to finish- I would order it again.

I look forward to coming back here and trying more items on the menu- maybe sitting at that gorgeous bar. overall, I really liked this place.

This place just opened on Mother's Day and we were Unfortunate to eat there in the afternoon on the first day. Although the restaurant was not very busy at 3 pm, our server was very slow.  Our order was wrong.  One member of our party of 3 was served 10 minutes before the rest of us were served.  The burger was cooked rare and we ordered medium well, but after waiting so long for our food, we just ate it.  We did not receive all of the sauces we ordered & told the waitress.  We asked the waitress about an appetizer price and she left to check and never came back.  When the bill finally came, it was wrong.  We were overcharged for extra fries and extra sauces we never received.  This would have been an easy fix except the waitress didn't fix it correctly the first time and it took the manager 2 additional times and at least 20 more minutes of waiting before the bill was correct, which was upsetting and exhausting.  The manager didn't really apologize, I almost had to fight with him to charge me accurately and he just said it was their computer issues.  Not impressed, overpriced burger, unfriendly waitress, unresponsive management & after they caused us stress, no offer to earn our return business.  I won't be back although the food was good, Red Robin does just as good at a better price.

I've been eyeing the reviews on this salon for quite awhile and finally pulled the trigger and went a couple of weeks ago, passing by several other salons to get there. Well, there is a reason this place gets great reviews. Ha, the owner, did my nails. He was so friendly (genuinely friendly) and kept making sure I was happy how things were coming along. He kept insisting if I wasn't happy to tell him and he would do what it took to make sure I was. This salon is very clean and cute. I saw one of the techs sterilizing her equipment which I know is a concern to most of us so that made me feel very comfortable being there. The techs all seemed to get along well and were having a good time. I've been so many other salons, where I've felt uncomfortable and like they were talking about me "behind my back." I didn't feel like that here at all! They are very customer service oriented and it shows. My gel manicure turned out great and two weeks later it's still going strong. I also had a pedicure which Ha started and a newer girl, Li (I forgot the rest of her name :-/   )finished. She did a great job and was also very friendly and customer oriented. I will definitely be going back.

A nice enough hampton.  Could use a slight update to the room itself, but the hotel is nice, things were clean, breakfast was decent, and the beds were comfortable.  

I wish that they put a nightlight in the bathroom like some other Hamptons -- that would help.

I would be tempted to give 4 stars, except I am taking 1 star away for poor internet.  I was completely unable to stream any video during the evening, or the next morning.  I have had much better luck at other Hamptons, so I think this property just needs to pony up for some upgrades.
Great place to get lashes done.  Relaxing, great environment, fun people & very professional.

I've been going to the lash lounge since day 1!! . These girls are all amazing and wouldn't think about going anywhere else. My lashes are always on point when I leave my appt. love these ladies!! Chelsi and Lesley are amazing! They always drop anything to get me in when needed!!

We recieved a coupon from this place in the mail so we decided to give it a try.Have to say very disappointed. The ribs where very tuff far from fall off the bone and the sauce was so runny it wouldnt even stick to the meat. The fries werent even cooked very well they where mushy not crisp. Potatoe  salad had a very odd taste and wasnt good either. I usualy love BBQ and i am a very big eater But my wife and i only ate till we lost our appetite then gave most of our ribs to the dogs and threw out the fries and potatoe salad. i definitely wont be making a second trip here. Next time I want BBQ i'll go to GoodWood they almost never let me down.

2 stars only because the red velvet pancakes and sprinkle pancakes were BAD ASS!!!!!! 

The host who greeted us asked if we wanted a table, I asked for a booth, and he ROLLED HIS EYES AT ME!!!! Like it was inconvenient to find us a booth - even after I said we'd be willing to wait until one opened up. He showed us where the table was, said here ya go, half threw, half slid the menus across the table and LEFT!!! Seriously?!?!

8 minutes before someone greeted us. Another 5 before we got our drinks from the server. 26 before our food arrived. Forgot to refill drinks. Forgot my son's fruit bowl. Didn't bother with the ketchup - had to go find that myself. Missing silverware. No extra napkins like requested. Not even 10 minutes after dropping the food off, and not bothering doing any of the above^^, dropped off the check and said "have a good day". Haven't seen anyone since. Would've loved a to-go box!

But I really love those sprinkle pancakes!!!!

I'm only giving them one star because I can't rate it any lower than that. The beds were somewhat comfortable, but the front desk attendant was completely rude. We needed to exchange our towels so at 10a.m. when housekeeping was outside of our room, we asked if we could switch them out and she flat out told us no because we "weren't on her section". She did tell us that she would pass it along that we needed them but 2 hours later there was still nothing. We called the front desk and the attendant said we would have some in 20 minutes. After nothing for another 30 minutes, we went out for about 5 hours, came back to the room and STILL NO TOWELS. We went to the front desk to ask about it and instead of receiving them right then, we were told that someone would be sent over immediately to deliver them. It ended up being 11 p.m. and still nothing. We called the front desk and complained once again and they gave us some terrible excuse for why there were none being sent over. They called us back 15 minutes later and said that WE could walk down to the front desk and pick them up ourselves if we wanted them. We decided to walk over and get them and when we showed up, the attendant didn't even bother to apologize for the inconvenience, just handed them over and continued with what she was doing. 

By 6 a.m. you can hear everyone in the hotel running around upstairs, talking and even taking showers. Not to mention there is no microwave in the room and the fridge has absolutely no room, so if you're planning on having leftovers from any place nearby, good luck trying to fit them in there. 

We aren't the type of people that expect to have everything handed to us on a silver platter, but we do expect to get some service from a hotel that we're staying at, especially when it's their job to provide hospitality. I would definitely not recommend this hotel and I wouldn't stay here again if I had the option.
The bison burger is AMAZING!! And their fries are soooo good! Love the different choices of dipping sauces! Will definitely be coming back here!!

I brought my daughter here for two different piercings. Both times the staff were professional and courteous. The piercers were knowledgeable and safe. They explained everything they were doing and why along the way. I feel very comfortable here!

As a bank they are great. They will review questionable overdrafts and reverse the fees most of the time. They have expanded the lobby hours and have friendly tellers. I've been with them for 3 years and rarely experience any problems. The area I see for improvement is their mobile banking app needs updating.

The wait can be long at times, but that's because the food is so darn good!  I've eaten there several times since it opened - getting the turkey, bacon, avocado & a chicken pesto panini as well as razzleberry smoothies and some pastries (cheesecake, sugar cookie, key lime tart and a cannoli) and they were all excellent.   

If I had a long lunch period, I'd probably eat there every day.  Alas, no such luck!  *sigh*
I love coming here. They're always so nice, patient, customer-friendly and helpful. Plus, they're delicious!

My husband and I went to the ram yesterday. We both have been to the one downtown but not the one in meridian and we though we would give it a try. I got the cedar plank salmon, hubby got the Santa Fe burger, and kiddo got the Mac and cheese. The salmon was okay, it was cooked fine but lacked in flavor. I compensated that with lemon, they also give you a rice mixture that I thought was good and some "seasonal veggies". Which is in fact not seasonal, the waitress informed us. Hubby said the burger was good, and he ordered the big red ipa beer which was also good. The kiddos Mac and cheese looked like it had been sitting for a while in the back. On the menu it says Kraft Mac and cheese which we expected but it just didn't look or taste good. 
Our waitress was awesome though, very attentive and great attitude.

I simply cannot say enough nice things about Kelly and her staff. This is the second time I've purchased something from Meridian Home Furnishings and the price is unbeatable followed up with great quality items. Our new sectional is so beautiful and the mattress sets I purchased are just what we needed. I would highly recommend stopping in to see their selection. You won't be sorry you did!

Food here is pretty good, but the low review is for customer service- cashier was nice and able to get us through quickly, but the manager at this location walked around the restaurant delivering food with the phone on his ear- anytime someone made eye contact he quickly turned away- I felt like I didn't even exist. Terrible service- expect a long wait.

Wow! This place is awesome!! Great customer services. The girls were so kind and helpful. I ordered a Parmesan bagel with cream cheese, egg and bacon. Also ordered their Good Vibes Kombucha on tap (Lemon Ginger) and it was LEGIT! The best I've ever had! I'll definitely be back for more bagels and growlers of Kombucha.

We ordered pizza from Varsity Pizza through Grub Hub.  We got the medium Combo pizza.  The crust was crispy and the toppings were very tasty.  Loved the pizza.  Grub Hub delivered the pizza within an hour.  I would have Varsity Pizza again and will use Grub Hub again also.
Loved it! Singer had a wonderful voice, the service was beyond friendly and the food was good too! Gracia mi amigo!

The rotate their soups which is pretty disappointing because you never know what they are going to have or are not going to have unless you feel like memorizing their whole soup schedule. I don't feel like it would be that difficult to make smaller amounts of rack soup each day.

Favorite place in the Treasure Valley to get coffee.  Killer specials every day.  It's almost always a $3 large deal.  If the special isn't your thing on a specific day, the regular menu prices are competitive with everyone else around, usually better, even.

The staff is always nice and the coffee is always great.  I know their coffee beans are all organic and maybe that has something to do with the coffee's consistency.

I stop here on my way to work a couple times a week and at least once during the weekend.  No place I'd rather get coffee from.  The store is small and not equipped to handle high volumes of customers at once but that really is the only negative.  The coffee makes up for that.

I highly suggest people who go to Starbucks on a regular basis because of it's name recognition, step outside their box and give Big Star a try.  The coffee is always way better and it's way less expensive.

(Eagle location is also great)
I know you get this all the time...but I can't stop thinking about you!!! Such an amazing, scrumptious experience. Thank you for existing!!

Fat Guys is really for a Fat appetite. One sandwich is good enough for two people. You have been warned. Proceed how you wish. I ordered the Italian, and was able to eat only half. Their main loaf bread is almost overpowering and very filling. Don't get me wrong. I'm a big sandwich person. I love deli meat, cold veggies, a slap of mayo and mustard all smack dab in some good warm bread. I think if Fat Guys can get the bread down to a perfect-T, I would eat here all of the time. This place definitely beats the neighborhood Subway, so spend the extra dollar and go to Fat Guys. Your belly might hate you after but you will enjoy every bite.
Huge taco selection all are amazing. Staff is extremely fast at making the tacos. Great beer selection too which was unexpected. Many more tacos to try next time! Try the breakfast ones!
Well sucky. Ordered and paid extra for the "new" steak and SHRIMP and of course got home and had 1 tiny shrimp. Buyers beware check your order before you leave

Love this place so much!  They have some of the best tacos in Boise, plus they are cheap with really fast service. What more could you ask for?  The shrimp tacos are my fave - perfectly crunchy, creamy,  spicy and sweet all at once. The fried chicken, bbq brisket, both kinds of fish, and roasted corn tacos are amazing as well. I also love the chips & cheese and their sopapillas. They only thing I haven't liked was the brisket taco because it was too dry. Maybe it would be improved with one of their homemade salsas, which are delicious. I used their online ordering for the first time this week. I placed the order while at a red light at Idaho and 10th; my order was waiting for me when I arrived about 4 minutes later.

First time going here and it was delicious! I had the gnocchi with grilled chicken, and my husband had the fish of the day which was a shrimp pasta. We tried the house and Cesar salads and topped it off with their cheesecake. Everything was delicious and we will definitely be going back!

I've loved all of my previous visits to Counters in other cities. This is the first time I've tried it in my hometown. And.... it's going to take a lot to get me to go back. We were seated but our server never came to our table. We selected our meals, my boyfriend even went to the restroom. No one stopped by our table. All the tables around us got service and even got repeat checkup visits. When my boyfriend returned from the bathroom, no one even looked our way. 

We got up and left. My boyfriend will be hard pressed to give it another try.

Brittney is amazing! My lashes look beautiful and she even dropped everything to meet me last minute to fix something very small before I went out of town. She is very sweet and in general very pleasant. I felt very comfortable and her customer service is spot on. Thank you Brittney!

Sorry to say this place is going down hill. Tonight I ordered the ribs with a Caesar salad. I normally smoke my own ribs so maybe I'm biased but these ribs are your basic low end restaurant quality with Sweet Baby Rays sauce on them. Very mushy so the sauce does little to help the overall quality. I was going to order a steak, but only sirloin is found on the menu now. Oh well, gotta get outta here before the loud bar games start. Gave it 3 stars for the drink strength (doubles) and for the great service. C'mon Ram, pick up your food game!

A hidden gem in my opinion. 
Lots of variety with menu options, potato choices, how you want your potatoes cut, seasoned and even the dry rub &a sauce you want it dipped in.
They have a special taste to accommodate a variety of taste buds.
I recommend

all I have to say is WOW!
I am not a huge bagel person, but this place really does go above and beyond what a "normal" bagel is. 

we had some brought into my work from a client and I wanted to eat the whole bag! I only had 1, but maybe i'll try more later LOL!

I had the everything with the garden cream cheese- which had chunks of bell pepper and shredded carrot mixed with plain cream cheese- it was so yummy! I wanted the entire container.

we also got quite a few other flavors of cream cheese- honey walnut, berry berry, and plain.

the bagel itself was chewy and crispy and fresh. the texture was absolutely perfect. and the size of it was very generous. I am stuffed after just one. 

I can't wait to try this place again!
Best place in Meridian to get a sandwich. We stumbled across this place about 4 months ago and ever since have became  regulars. Definitely recommend trying.

HORRIBLE, by far the WORST and DIRTIEST hotels I've ever stayed in. Absolutely filthy carpet everywhere, stains, spilt milk, or who knows what, dried on the carpet. Also food, and just about everything else on the carpet. The bathroom sink is by my bed not in the bathroom. After returning to my room late, showering, and ready to get in bed, I saw a rubberband full of hair on my sheets. I tried to get someeone to change my sheets, but no luck. I'm not very picky, but this is a true dump. Shame on you Priceline for having such a trashy hotel on your site.
These guys tore it up! Great Italian sandwich and home made potato salad on the side. I have not had this good of a sandwich in the state of Idaho. This is a must eat location for everyone.

Great place for a burger! Friendly staff and clean bathrooms. I like this place out of all the burger joints around the Village. I love the fact that you can make any kind of burger your heart desires, from impossible burger (vegan/vegetarian) to Bison and turkey. All the fixings available and the size of patties are massive!  My visit with my brother for his bday was great, a nice little variety on beers, like peanut butter stout to San Adams lagers and oh don't forget the IPAs. I have been here a few times and my experience has always been awesome! Come on down and get yourself a juicy burger and enjoy the relentless flavors available. "Give it a try and feel the hunger!"

I had to get a non-metal retainer for my tragus piercings before I had surgery. I only had one day to find a shop close by to purchase items. They had exactly what I needed and switched out my metal ones. The staff was super nice and very personable and professional. I can come back anytime and have then switched back, no charge. It is near my house so it's super convenient. I plan on coming back soon for another piercing in the future.
Awesome beer and legit burgers!! Give them a try... You'll love them!!

My family had the best time at Roaring Springs. We had the opportunity to go on most of the slides and they didn't fall short of our expectations. The lines can be busy later in the day so I recommend hitting the tube rides earlier in the day. The lazy river and wave pool are a must as they can be enjoyed by everyone in the family. The cliff hanger ride was an adrenaline ride that is not for the faint of heart. My youngest loved the children's water area and she had a hard time saying good bye. We will be back!

Water parks have to be one of my all time favorite things.  Minus the part where I turn into a well done lobster in approximately 30 seconds of direct sunlight.

Roaring Springs is small, but very nice.  My boyfriend and I took my daughter here after picking her up from the airport.  It was about 95 degrees out and the water felt so good.
