Since we had arrived after 3pm, we got the late swimmers discount - which saved our party of 3 about $40 or so.  We had to go find the pay lockers to store our gear, but it was easily located by the little gift shop.

I liked the lazy river the best.  The rapids really could knock you off your feet at one part in particular where a little river enters the main tubing stream.  My daughter and I both kept going round and round the circuit to stand near that rapid and kept getting blown away.  Very fun.

We went down a couple slides and hung out in the wave pool, and kept going back to the river.  Got a little hungry and ordered some snow cones (yeah, not the most filling, but they tasted great!) then got a jump on getting through the showers before the rest of the crowd.

Would definitely go again next summer when my daughter visits.

I've been here twice now and I have to say I Love it!  First off their Bartender did an amazing job on my Peach Ginger Mule!   We had the Tom Yum Gai soup, Coconut Fried Rice ( with huge perfectly cooked shrimp) , Beef Massamun (The potatoes !!) Penang Chicken Curry, and Chicken Pad Thai, also their Sa-Wa-Dee appetizer.  All Delicious and highly recommend every dish we trie

I love this place. I've been to three Counters now. Santa Monica, CA, Pasadena, CA and now Meridian, Idaho. I am visiting my mother in law. She had never been to a Counter so we went. It's located In the Village and it's conveniently located on a corner! 

It was awesome. I loved feeling at home in Idaho at the Counter. The layouts are all different at the various locations. The hostess sat us. She was great and extremely attentive our server was another story. 

We ordered our drinks. She ordered a beer and I indulged in the wine flight. The beer came out fast. The flight apparently took off. Had a layover and took off again and landed finally on the table. The flight is great once it arrives. You get four generous samples from the wine list. I tried the cava, Pinot noir, moscato, and Malbec. The Bison So Gouda looked amazing. My mother in law orders it. I loved my turkey burger over spinach. See my picture. It was so deliciously amazing.
Nice selection of burger and fries and great prices. Loved the fact they had 8 different french fry dippings to choose from besides standard ketchup.

Cute Thai food place. Love the ambiance, the lighting, the deep colors, and the strangely suggestive yet colorful murals. They offer lots of the favorites and the presentation is amazing!

I have been assured that items are gluten/other allergen free and yet in the two times I have tried this place my stomach ends up a little "bubbly". Maybe it's the "shallots" they garnish their curries with - I've been assured 2wice they are gluten free though they look and taste an awful lot like a wonton/crouton. My spidey sense says "no go" on those shallots. If you have allergies, maybe don't get the shallot garnish. Just in case.

Otherwise the service is so friendly and helpful it's hard not to love this place. They even helped my mother in law, who is allergic to dairy, have a Thai iced tea with coconut milk instead of dairy creamer. She is a serious regular now.

All tummy bubbles aside, let's be real, I will probably be back at Sa-Wad-Dee in the future.

I love this place! As a vegetarian, Very very good food.

WARNING: Don't mess around with spiciness ratings! If you don't know what to pick, just go with 2/5. 4/5 wasn't a very pleasant experience for me :P

Also, the litchi ice cream is a must try.

Only complaint is that they were out of their in house root beer. Otherwise the food was amazing!! Classic bison burger was perfect, and the added flavor of the pickled onions, yum!! I had the yam fries with cinnamon and ginger salt, dipped them in blueberry ketchup. They have a wide variety of flavor salts, dipping sauces, and potatoes (even Brussels sprout). Service was friendly, helpful, and welcoming. I do not regret my random choice of place to eat!!!

My fav deli. Friday is must do chowder and #16 sammy! Everything made fresh. Daughter loves the double decker PB & J. Perfect place after a round of golf and or football weekend. You can call in and get it to go. Cheers!
Terrific buffalo burgers. Interesting toppings. This is NOT your normal boring fast food burger place. Fries are outstanding. Selection of fry toppings and sauces is unique.
Best Mexican restaurant in town. They have a good location and very friendly service.
Tempura green beans, with the most popular sandwich: Santa Barbara Sourdough. Nice artwork relating to beaches and surfing. Delicious strawberry limeaide, made fresh daily. Satisfied customer.

Great place for a quick burger. I personally like The Teriyaki Burger or the BBQ Bacon Burger. I also like that you can get lettuce wrap instead of a normal bun. The only downside to this place is the indoor seating is so limited, and if you come here for lunch it is a pain to find seating.

I took my 6 year old here for a quick easy brunch. The place felt very dirty. There were servers vacuuming under the table that we got placed at...and he just kept vacuuming. It was rude. The waitress asked how we were doing, and I asked her how she was. He response was "Tired, and i don't really want to be here." Ummm! We placed our order and she didn't write anything down. She brought out wrong food for both of us. Not wanting to make a scene, or have to be here any longer - we ate what we could and then left.

We would not come back to this Ihop.

I had my nostril pierced here. I am new to Idaho and was nervous about finding a place I trusted as much as the body art place in Kansas City. 

At imperial they practice strict hygiene and give very clear instructions on how to help your piercing heal without issues. They also only pierce with implant grade surgical steel posts which is important. 

The process was clean, informative, quick but thorough. I appreciated the staff's professionalism.

If you love a cheesy pizza, Marco's is the pizza for you in Idaho. Great crust, good sauce and plenty of cheese. Try the cheese bread and look for specials on their website. The 4 out of 5 rating is a personal preference for less cheese and more sauce. 
The one topping 2 medium 17 dollar special can be delivered. The medium size is a bit smaller then average pizza medium size. Delivery is quick and don't forget the cheese bread special if you register online.

First visit. Wait was long, but staff were friendly. Would have rated higher if they would have taken back from waiting sooner. Seemed to move a lot of other through steadily. Really liked doc who saw us Kristine painter. Was friendly, thorough and professional.  They were able to get us in for ultrasound same afternoon and scope two days later which was much appreciated.
Great doughnuts,  friendly service and clean.  No dirty and sticky tables and floors like an area chain doughnut shop has issues with.

The fries were tasty and I loved trying all the sauces. I had the BLT, and it was pretty delicious. My husband and four kids had the beef burger and fries. Although they all approved of the taste, I was pretty disappointed with the size of the burgers with how expensive they were. A $9 burger meal should fill you up, but my husband left hungry. I can get a cheaper meal at Freddy's with a bigger burger and more fries. Won't be rushing back.

For a place calling itself Boise FRY company... I was hoping they would have had decent fries. Shamed to say McDonalds is better. 

Their fries are soggy, old (seemed like they've been sitting there all day)

Not going back.

I always have a good experience with the grooming department. 

We have a small mixed-breed dog, and he wasn't great at being handled when he first started going in. The groomers gave us tips for how to help him through the experience. One suggestion was to purchase an electric toothbrush, and slowly get him used to the sound and vibration. The purpose was to help him deal with the clippers more calmly. Worked a treat. 

We see both Emily and Avery, and they both do a tremendous job. I leave our dog with them without a single worry. I know they'll take good care of him.

We had the habanero bison burger... Amazing! All of the sauces are unique and flavorful. We also sample three of the fries: russet, sweet, and something purple. My favorite must've been the purple potato in the blueberry sauce.

Today we were excitedly waved into the store. The sales person invited us to come running with their group!  Our sales specialist Ryan was awesome. He took a lot of time talking us through the shoes and why he was recommending them. We are excited to try them out.

Came to this lovely little salon for the first time today. I walked in and was immediately greeted, even though they were pretty busy... and the gentleman who greeted me was working on a ladies toes.(: I noticed the decor, and it was a cute little place. I had an appointment with Torri, and she was really nice. Seemed like she was pretty tired/worn-out. It was nice because they had a flat screen TV to watch as you're getting your nails done. A great way to stay entertained especially when the nail tech or the person getting their nails done doesn't have anything to talk about. Lol. The place was very clean, and all of the nail technicians were taking extra time to make sure that the customers were satisfied with their nails! That's honestly the first time I've ever had someone take their time and didn't make it seem like just another routine. Thanks Torri. Torri also offered, since I have short nail beds, that if a couple of the nails pop off too soon, that she'll redo them for FREE! This will become my regular salon. I can't wait to test out the other nail techs there! Highly recommend.(:

Earned every star.  The selection is excellent, the prices are very good, the sandwich was pretty good.  I would say this is a quantity deli, not the highest quality meats but a lot of them which I appreciate.  Treated very well by the cashier, things went very smoothly.  Get the triple decker ham and cheese, you won't regret it.  The potato salad was way over seasoned though, to the verge of overly salty, need to bland it out a bit.  Past that I recommend.

Came here for a Saturday morning meet up with a friend for coffee.

I was immediately greeted with friendliness upon entrance and my order taken.  I ordered a caramel mocha, which I found to be well prepared.  The place is smallish with only a few tables and a sofa, so seating is limited. They do have two drive-up windows and though they had a steady stream of customers, the baristas are lightning quick--getting people on their merry caffeinated way with speed and efficiency.

One minor thing--due to the size of the place, it can be very loud.  Between the blender, the loud drive-up bell, and the baristas pounding the portafilter, it was sometimes difficult to carry on conversation.

The verdict? They offer awesome, reasonably priced espresso beverages with friendly efficiency--hit the drive through!

Get to it!

Very friendly staff and great Thai food. The best I've had here so far. I went for my birthday and was given a free dessert and had a photo placed on their birthday wall. I love the Pad Thai, Jasmine Rice, and Basil Rolls!! Really nice lunch take out as well.
So impressed. Godfather sandwich, ravioli and the amazing side salad! Everything was very well done and the staff is super friendly. We will definitely be back!

Absolute worst customer service experience I've had in years. we have a party of 7. Server introduced himself after 10 minutes and said he was leaving due to a shift change and some else would be over to serve us. Drinks were late, no refills. Customer service was so bad, it actually became funny to watch. 
would never recommend nor return. Beautiful facility, great location, poor customer experience.

Rockstar computer repair is awesome! They do FREE diagnostics and were able to tell me what was wrong with my computer within an hour of dropping it off. They called to inform me of the issue and to see if I wanted to pick it up or if I wanted to have them fix it. I've heard great things about them regarding their services so I had them take care of it and it was ready with an hour after that. Thank you guys for fixing our computer in such a timely manner.

Used a Groupon last night for a takeout phone order with my 12 year old daughter.  Employee said it would be 15-20 minutes before it would be ready.  Took over 30 minutes.  Must have been dart league night.  About 10 guys drinking beer as soon as you walked in the door through the other guys smoking out front.  Very loud, inappropriate conversations. 

Although this was a takeout order and we didn't eat until we got home, the Maui pizza was cold when we got it so I'm sure it had been sitting ready for a while.   A total of 9...yes 9 bread heel pieces in the order of our overcooked and dry garlic bread.  The marinara was actually very good.

Nowhere near the quality of food and atmosphere they used to have in their old location at Eagle Road and Fariview.  No plans to go back any time in the future.

Excellent little cafe/bakery.  The paninis are good, the soup is good.  Get the cafe sandwich on focaccia with Kneaders sauce.  Their focaccia is excellent bread.

Their breakfast is one of the best I've ever had; the French toast is epic and so are the croissant sandwiches.  

This place may be deserving of five stars now that I think about it, except there are a few dud items on the menu: the eclairs are boring, the bread pudding is too dry, the chicken noodle soup is bad, etc.

I write this for all people who enjoy high quality food at a good price. I've been eating at Fat Guys for close to 6 years now  and while many well tell you that it's the sandwiches I set my clock by the soups. Handmade from scratch soups that your mom would make if she knew how to cook. If I told you that the best clam chowder in the country was in Meridian Idaho at a sandwich joint you might think I'm crazy. But then most sandwich joints aren't run by grads of the Culinary Institute of America. 32 different sandwiches that the Earl would be proud to claim as one of his creations, but they come from the culinary mind of Chef Wally the mad genius behind this palace of lunchtime bliss. Family run and friendly make this your new lunchtime favorite just like mine.
Best place in the whole valley. Maybe the whole USA. Everything is fresh and amazing. Staff and owner are just great people.

Food is always great here, but on the expensive side. I usually go to Thai Basil if I'm craving Thai food, but their food didn't live up to their usual greatness last month which is why we ended up here. Menu is huge- everything from sushi to Thai to Chinese, some Indian, and even an attempt at Japanese. They need to trim the menu down to help trim down their costs.

1 star for the concept of building a quality burger with unique options + 1 star for really friendly, not overbearing service (Mike was great!) + 1 star for a couple flavorful things like the (greasy!!) onion straws, the horseradish cheddar (that thankfully compensated for the utterly bland beef patty), and the basil pesto aoili.

No more stars.

-1 star for how highly The Counter must think of themselves to charge such silly-high prices in the Boise market with such silly-boring food. I am sure rent isn't cheap in the Meridian Village but gouging customers isn't the way to go. Additional $2.50 for a side item??? And worse yet -- an additional $2.50 to NOT get a bun?!? Yes... that's correct. Getting a burger in "salad style" is EXTRA money. Riddle me that...

-1 star for a boring, flavorless beef burger patty. I just felt like the toppings had to pull all the weight themselves to make the burger at a burger place enjoyable... it is a very heavy burden to bear.

Bonus: "Seasoned veggies skewers" = Veggies on a stick, rolled in all the salt The Counter could buy. And the shoestring fries are wimpy and boring, but (thankfully) seasoned.

The best Mexican food since we left Baker City. 
Friendly, quick service. Delicious chips and salsa 
We shall return.
It's okay but far from the best Thai food I've had. It's about $15 per plate with a drink. If we're ever in Meridian again and are craving Thai food we might go here.

Hands down the best coffee in meridian!!  Before I get that liquid gold I'm like bla.   After my shot of that delicious frothy beverage I instantly become energized and ready to face the world!!  They always treat me as they did today with a smile on their face and an  energetic tone to their voice. If you want a great experience and pick me up for your day go check out these guys!!

Solid lunch option. Prices are reasonable, and there's an excellent selection. 

Since it was my first visit, I tested the menu with a mixed Italian sandwich (#6). It was quite good; good-quality meats, enormous portion (could've easily split it with my wife), and generally well-put-together. One issue though...it contained *pastrami*, which is, in no way, shape, or form, an Italian meat. The chef needs to amend this menu item and make it properly, with salami, mortadella, and capicolla.

The sandwich also came with some pretty good potato salad (included bacon...nice add!) or I could've had chips.

The staff was polite and hustled; it took a little while for my sandwich, but they had just been slammed with a call-in order. 

I'll be back. It's worth going.

This is a great place. It is relaxing. Has a full bar and a great menu. I would recommend making reservations for groups with more than 4. Our group ordered the 3 different appetizers to share. We all ordered something different so we could taste more if the menu items. We had salmon, Mac and cheese, rib eye, and the steak sandwich. All dishes were incredible!

All I need in a convenient location and open 24 hours! The gym is air conditioned and clean with plenty of machines and weights. Rarely too busy and though I haven't taken any classes, they look like high energy fun! IFF is perfect for me :)

French Dip with fries and their Buttface Amber to wash it down - these are the finer things in life.   Atmosphere at the Ram is spacious and the staff are friendly and inviting.  Great ale-house experience.
This is the worst Kneaders I have ever been to. The cookies and orange rolls were dry and gross. Corporate should be checking their standards because it it does not meet expectations.

The girls I go to usually do a good job and my lashes hold up really well. My only complaint is listening to employees gossiping for an hour while I'm laying there. If I schedule my appointment closer to closing time it's usually fine since there's only one or two employees there but lately I've been going early when most staff is there. The last three times I've gone, I've had to listen to the girl doing my lashes trash talk another coworker that wasn't there with the coworker across the room from her or talk about everyone snapchatting about getting drunk and going clubbing. It's just tacky and unprofessional. I'm there to get my lashes done--and that's it-- yet I know more about their personal lives than my own. 

Also don't like that the same service costs different amounts depending who you book with. A classic fill ranges between $35-45 depending who you book with.

If you seek a locally owned (not franchise or chain) restaurant where the owners are on site and strive to please, this is it. Good food, short but strong beer and wine list, menu that pleases most tastes and appetites. We discovered Grant's by accident--and returned two days later. It was just as good the second time. Can't wait to go back. Warning: Others have discovered this spot, so the few tables there are usually claimed early in the evening.

Denizens of Treasure Valley, as much as I love my Dutch Bros and they remain my "default" spot to hit up when that need to caffienate hits... I am always on the lookout for good, local spots to get my coffee fix.  So this morning on the way back from the grocery store, I pulled into Big Star Coffee.

It doesn't look like much from the outside, and in fact that may put you off a little bit from pulling in and giving it a try.  But don't let appearances fool you.  It may look a little rundown, but everything about my stop here was first class.  The prices are good.  My large mocha was $4.60, which is pretty much par for the course.  I also liked how the barrista asked if I wanted the full four shots or just three.  I find that at a lot of places, four shots is just too much, but three is often just right.  On that note, the service was excellent.  Both ladies were friendly and I got my drink quickly.  The coffee itself was outstanding.  As I've said in other reviews, I may not be a coffee "snob," but I know what I like and what I don't... and I really liked my drink.  The chocolate and coffee were in good balance and it was not overly sweet.  Often I find that a mocha can end up tasting more like a hot cocoa than a coffee drink, but Big Star did it right.

Bottom line folks, if you need to caffienate in Meridian and want to go "local" instead of big chain... give Big Star a try.  You'll be glad you did.

This place is great! I have only been a handful of times, but I have never been disappointed. The sandwiches are amazing, the soups are fantastic, and the service is always outstanding. If you come during the week around lunchtime expect a line. They will serve you fast, but seating might be hard to come by.

Great variety and atmosphere. I had the Korean BBQ sandwich. Meat was tough and the sandwich fell apart. Tasted ok but had to use a knife and fork to eat it. My sons hamburger bun fell apart after three bites and he also had to use a knife and fork to eat it. Service was so so
The Jethro was seriously crazy delish! If you like stinky blue cheese this one's for you. The bacon on it was outrageous! Also unlocked the free armadillo balls. Spicy and oh so good.

BREAKFAST:
Why aren't there more of these in Idaho!? I went here over the weekend and had their unlimited cinnamon french toast for about $5.96. I am not much of a french toast lover but this was absolutely amazing! The plate came with 2 huge thick pieces of cinnamon french toast and a side of fresh strawberries and whip cream. The syrup was not what you would buy at the store, it tasted really good as well. Although it was unlimited I was completely full from the 2 pieces. 

We went there on Easter and they had Easter eggs with pieces of paper inside with a free item. I got a free full size mango smoothie which was very good, my girlfriend got a free cookie. 

The atmosphere is very nice in there, much better than I had envisioned, and very homey. Surprisingly it wasn't very busy. 

LUNCH:
So far I have only had their Panini's, I am not a huge fan of these here as Cafe Zupas beats them on this, but that is pretty tough to beat. 


Overall:
Going to be going here more often . . . maybe every weekend for breakfast? :) I highly recommend that my friends and family visit this place. Maybe with enough demand we can get more of these in Boise :)


Food: 5/5 Very flavorful and freshly made
Atmosphere: 5/5  Very homey and comfortable
Staff: 5/5 - Friendly and helpful
Value: 4/5 - Breakfast and other items are cheap, lunch is a bit pricey
Overall: 4.5/5

HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!! Spread the word!

Fun place to take people from out of town or state. 
Pretty pricy for essentially burgers and fries though. The bison burgers are worth the extra. Nice variety of different types of potatoes and cuts, and of course the fry sauce bar.
Not much room between chairs and tables, not for the claustrophobic. I'd also suggest that they have samples of the different fries ready to try. So that people don't commit to a type they realize they hate.

Wish I had read the reviews before I stopped for lunch.  Had a beefdip sandwich.  This consisted of a large tasty roll, very little beef - some places on the bread had no beef.  I think there was cheese too!  Au jus was good and there was a lot, which was good since the bread was pretty plain without the beef.  That was it - no chips, salad, fries, fruit.  My daughter ordered a different sandwich with the same results.  However she was charged a lot extra for a change in bread - seriously what about a refund for the bread we did not use.  Really expensives for just a sandwich - no extras.  People who come for the bakery treats seem to be happy though.  I wish I had noticed there was a Panera's right across the street.

Denizens of Treasure Valley, do not let the name fool you.  If you are looking for the best..................... BURGER in the Boise area, head to Boise Fry Company.  No jokes.  I took the family here in hopes of stuffing my small children with a variety of french fry goodness, but I walked out having had the absolute best burger I have had since moving here.  And if you have read many of my other reviews, you know I have hit several of the burger "hot spots" in town already and walked away less than impressed.  But despite the emphasis on the fries here (and they are good) it was their burger that won me over and will get me coming back.

Usually I lead off with any negatives to get them out of the way before the good stuff.  But I really can't think of much I didn't like about this place!  I suppose I could mention that the root beer is a lot less sweet than the typical stuff you get from a fountain.  It isn't bad by any means, but if you're expecting something super sweet like an A&W or Barq's, that isn't what you're going to get.  You may have to "adjust" your palate accordingly.  It is worth trying at least once though.

Another thing you simply must try at least once are the "bourgeois" fries.  These are russet potatoes fried in duck fat and sprinkled with truffle salt.  Yes they are as indulgent as they sound, and yes they are that good.  I wouldn't get them absolutely every time you go, but if it is your first time, you definitely should start with these.  They are outstanding.  The specific varieties and cuts of the other fries vary from day to day.  On this visit we also sampled the sweet potato and purple fries.  Both tasted great, but our kids were less than impressed.  We think this might have been because they didn't look like "normal" fries and so the kids thought they were something weird.  

Ok, so the real star of the show for me... the bison burger.  It was fantastic... well seasoned, just a bit of earthy/gamey flavor that sets it apart from ordinary beef, and the onions and other toppings complemented it perfectly.  It truly was one of the best burgers I have ever eaten... and I've had my share of burgers!  Definitely give this one a try if you haven't before.  Another minor negative I should note here though is that the "kids hamburger" is just a half of a regular hamburger.  My son thought he was getting "cheated" by getting something that was obviously cut in half.  Not a big deal, but also something to consider.

I would be remiss if I did not note the large array of sauces and salts that you can add to your fries.  Now if you do get the "bourgeois," do yourself a favor and eat a few of them plain first before you add anything.  They are divine simply as is.  But I will say I am a fan of their spicy fry sauce, as well as the blueberry ketchup.  I'm not big into salt overall and so I can't really comment on any of those as I steered clear.

Bottom line folks, yes the sign says Boise FRY Company, and yes the fries are good.  But for me it should say Boise BISON BURGER Company (and fries.)  They are the local burger champion for me right now.  We'll see if they can keep their crown. ;)

1st visit review. i had the Thai dumpling appetizer to start. the dumpling was very full & served steaming hot. very mild bordering on bland flavor, but tasted very fresh. couldn't say what was missing just need something, a kick maybe some heat. i had the ginger lover with pork. very good & a lot of food. very fresh veggies, could use a little more pork for the price. i had a piece of my sons sushi roll wish i could remember what it was called. it had to much going on & i want to make sure not to get it by mistake when we go back. it was just not my idea of good sushi. it had cooked chicken in it & carrot maybe green onion with avocado across the top with 2 or 3 different sauces. just was not a good combination to me. when i comes to thai i am about fresh so did want to give 3.5 stars, but will go with 4 stars, because i can see the potential for other dishes to be very good & am looking forward to trying items. just wish prices were a bit lower...don't we all want that? :)
Overpriced, gross bbq. Stay home and eat out of a can. VERY expensive for what you get.

The RAM is where we go when we're feeling wishy washy about where to eat...kind of a fallback place. 

The menu is large and the food is decent, but definitely overpriced. I like the wide variety of burgers, but to me the meat lacks flavor. Most of the beer is good (I usually go for the Amber or Porter) although again nothing has really stood out and impressed me. 
**On a side note we ate our Thanksgiving meal here last year and it was actually really good! We appreciated them being open.
 
But the service is always friendly, I never feel rushed, and the atmosphere is nice and comfortable. 

Overall I think it's a solid and consistent place, just probably not where I would take out of towners.

First time in Idaho. We're staying at the Country Inn and Suites across the street so we were informed we could receive a discount. "Awesome!" So glad we decided to go. 
The atmosphere is warm and friendly. Noise level is surprisingly low for the bar area. Wait staff is very nice and welcoming and pretty quick. 
Amazing food! (I got the armadillo eggs and the Plymouth Guac) So many options!
Highly recommended if you're in town!

I love this place and don't understand why it isn't busier. The pizza is great and the prices are right. The staff is so nice and helpful too. The pizzas are creative but you can get your favorites too. They expanded their menu more too for more options. I highly recommend

Delicious fresh pasta! This place was a pleasant surprise with its flavorful menu options and friendly staff. The side of rosemary fries were too good. I will definitely be going back! Spread the word about this place!

I moved to idaho from Southern California 3 years ago and what passes for Mexican food here is pretty sad. After searching for a legit and authentic flavor for 3 years I have finally found awesomeness. Thank you El Tenampa!
Loved this place!  The seats were packed & the energy is great!  Enjoyed my special pedi!!

The food is decent, the customer service is not. You go in early on a Sunday to watch a particular game they tell you the TV's are pre-programmed and can't be changed (the manager told us this, they changed them for us earlier in the season). We ended up leaving and going to Rudy's where the food is much better and they put the game on where all of us were able to watch it. 
This isn't the first time we've had poor service at the Ram. Very un-accommodating.
Three stars only because the service wasn't great. It took about 20 minutes for me to get my carnita bowl and the workers aren't very friendly. but the carnita bowl I got was fabulous!

Friendliest nail salon I've ever gone to! Great service. They did a fantastic job as well. And the best part was when I was being a pain in the ass about crooked shapes or whatever they were totally good with it! Welcomed it even!

My dad and I played pool on the one and only pool table. Good: it's only 1 dollar. The bad. There are tables tucked around the table and it's difficult to shoot.  Good thing there were no other customers. Someone would have gotten a pool stick jab in the crotch.  The other bad is that there was a family with young kids and baby hanging out at the golf simulator. REALLY? Take those kids to PoJos or something.  Kimberly was great and friendly. Beers were reasonable and apps were good.  I would go again perhaps after the kids go to bed.

I was visiting from Chicago and stopped in for lunch with friends. We tried as many things as possible. We were all blown away at the flavor and quality of our meal. We had spring rolls, sushi, coconut fried rice, Tom yum, Kao soi , fried bananas and coconut ice cream. It was better than any American Thai I have had before. I would highly recommend this restaurant. 
Favorite things = Spring Roll, Kao Soi, Coconut Ice Cream

The only thing that seems to be good about this place is the seating area. It was clean and looked comfortable. I can't recommend the coffee, the food or the customer service. The French roast coffee tasted like it was made with half the recommended amount of folgers crystals. It was extremely weak and lukewarm. I drink it black so there's no question about taste or temperature. 
The food selection is abysmal, and each pastry was individually wrapped in cellophane, making me question how many weeks it's been sitting there. The muffin I ordered said nothing of nuts, but was full of them. There was also a mystery sticker with a handwritten "2" inside my muffin wrapper. I doubt the sticker and marker are food safe and NSF certified. As far as taste is concerned, sawdust has more moisture and flavor. 
I watched the staff take the warm milk carafe and refill it with more cream, it will stay in a safe temp for maybe 2 minutes like that. If you want anything other than Half and half, you can't pour it yourself. 
If you are looking for a place to sit, you've found a great one. As far as food and coffee are concerned, stay away. They do have hundreds of bottles of syrup for sale though.

"That was a damn good sandwich" my husband just said and I would have agree! The bread was so delicious & fresh!!! He got the Wally's Special- spicy and oh man it was so freakin good! So many flavors! I got the mountain sandwich and that was really yummy as well and it had potato salad in it, creative! I definitely would go back, but just driving through. Go check them out, won't be disappointed!

Great food! Very friendly staff! It is always busy, so we usually take ours to go. The atmosphere is great if there is anywhere to sit. Restaurant is always clean and food is fresh and tasty. We have eaten here a few times and love it.

I moved into a new town house; I've always been an Ashley furniture guy. So I waited till Ashley furniture home store opened in meridian. Boy was that a nightmare!!! Feel free to read my Yelp review on them. I ended up here after seeing an affordable living room set on Craigslist. Kelly left an immediate impression on me warm friendly driven towards customer satisfaction. I ended up getting a living room set from her; another sofa and coffee table for my entertainment room. All I did was go online or you can go the Ashley store in meridian find what you like giver her the product number she'll order it for you in 1-3 weeks you'll have it-you'll save a lot of money versus the big box guys. They even deliver; they went the extra mile on my delivery. Kelly is awesome if your looking for quality or higher end furniture such as Ashley come see her you won't be disappointed!!
Clam chowder Friday is amazing. Made me so happy and warmed my soul. Also try the Wally Special. It's a mystery sandwich the chef makes up on the spot.
For Boise area this is as good as it will get with Thai food. Traveled all over and have had better but like I said this is as good as it will get for boise.

I've lived all over the country and this was probably the worst Mexican food I've ever had.  I was immediately turned off after walking in and noticing a smell similar to sewage.  Then, after having several chips, I noticed part of a chip in the bottom of the bowl of bean dip.  Are they recycling dip??  Also, ordered the fajitas and they were awful.  You can get better fajitas at American chain restaurants.  Terrible!

Busy day, walked in for a battery replacement on an IPhone. Multiple customers in the store and on the phone, but no excuses were made, just great efficient service. They ran a quick diag to make sure we actually needed a battery instead of charging us for something that we didn't need, great honest company. The repair was done within 10 minutes and we were on our way. Glad we chose these guys over the other options. Keep up the great work!

The boyfriend and I had dinner here on Sunday night.  It doesn't look like much from the street (far west end of a strip mall), but walking through the door we were pleasantly  surprised by the quaintly rustic interior.

Our waiter was pleasant and attentive.  The food was quite good.  We split a fried Brussels sprouts appetizer that was excellent.  My boyfriend had a BLT and I had the gnocchi that was mentioned in other reviews.  

It's not often that restaurants get gnocchi right, but these were excellent!  Very light and fluffy with diced butternut squash and mushrooms.  I highly recommend!

All in all a great find close to home and we will definitely go back.
Amazing donuts!!! We get a dozen each time we go and they always throw in an extra little treat! They are sooo good! The buttermilk ones are to die for!

Went there once for water pump and found out after repairs were done how over priced they are. Have never been back, would not recommend this place to anyone, call around and get a second opinion, most places do same quality work for a lot less!

Have been here several times.. always greated when walk in door..to the point where they know us by what sandwiches we order well at least my wife.. therw sandwiches are always good and huge and filling. . I love there Cole slaw. I have never been disappointed by anything I have ever got there.. one of my favorite spots

Our sons were on the same Yball basketball team a couple of years ago and I also heard terrific recommendations from other parents in the quality of care provided by Dr. Guymon and Staff.  Parents who are very discriminating in their choice of medical providers for their family.   The process to assess the need for my son to have braces, explaination of payment, benefits and timeline were all very professionally delivered about 18 months ago and my son is getting his braces off right on schedule on May 10th.  I would highly recommend Guymon Orthodonistics...
I tried a sampling of different tacos and each one was great. It can get a bit noisy inside but worth every bite.
Best sandwich in Boise.  Homemade soups are amazing.  Highly recommend!

I'm from SoCal and I honestly couldn't get a better outcome in Brentwood compared to when I received services here. Dani's a magician working with my color nightmare/laziness/mop mess. She's the absolute best with the best personality I never imagined I'd find in Idaho.

Fast, friendly and delicious!  We were passing through and looking for something local and NOT Starbucks!  Coffee is great, they have milk alternatives too!  We had the breakfast wraps and a muffin.  So yummy!!
More like 3.5 stars, but options count so rounded up. Fun place to take people outta state.  All around a good burger.

This place is always packed for reason! Best bakery in Meridian! Everything is made fresh. From sandwiches, to soups, or a huge selection of dessert,  you are bound to find something that you will love.

My favorite thing to get here is the turkey sandwich on focaccia bread. Their house spread for the sandwiches is tangy and delicious. As far as dessert goes, I really love everything that they offer year, but I typically reach for the frosted brownie which is super moist and chewy!

They also have a selection of loaves of bread for purchase which is great for people who rather have something with a more homemade taste and not full of chemicals and preservatives like the grocery store bread. 

Parking can sometimes be tricky during lunch hours, but I have never had any problems finding a spot. They also have a drive-through, which is very convenient! They are closed on Sundays, so don't plan on indulging until Monday.

We are from Portland Oregon, and we first discovered El Tenampa in September 2012.  We loved it so much that on our way thru the Boise area the following month, we stopped again.  One year later, we are passing thru Idahp again, and made a point to have  dinner again at El Tenampa.  The service is excellent, the meal authentic, and the drinks nicely mixed.  It's a definite stop for us when we are traveling Idaho.

Some guidance for reference.  If the best dining experience is 5 stars and a typical fast food experience like McDonalds or Jack in the Box is 2 stars than this establishment is one star.  We tried the Godfather-1star.  The Sarah-1 star. The list of ingredients should have worked but either very poor execution (grease) or poor quality ingredients allowed failure to dominate.  The side of pasta-1 star (when you cook pasta remember it must be salted). A side salad-2 stars, the only item equivalent even to McDonalds.  Yelp reviewers continue to disappoint, not just in Boise, everywhere. Walk around the fountain area, go to the food establishment that has customers.  That should have been our first clue as no one was here at 2:15 on a Sunday afternoon but all the other restaurants around the fountain area had customers. My final attempt at following false positive Yelp reviews.

First off, service was great and the restaurant was clean.  3 local beers to choose from to go along with the burger and fries.   I had the purple fries with cajun seasoning.  Awesome!   I ventured into the Vegan patty instead of the traditional beef.  The "burger" was pretty good.   Moist black bean patty.  Could use a little punch of flavor,  but BFC provides plenty of sauces and seasonings to get that fixed. 
Great place for a burger and fries. 
Highly recommended
We were a little nervous when we showed up and it was empty - but great atmosphere, great service and great food!!!  We will definitely come back!  4.5 stars.....

Was excited to try this place, and was disappointed. 

I'd give it a 4 for freshness, options, and service. 

But a 2 for flavor. The meat itself was pretty standard. Between the three of us we got the triple chin, Reuben, and a build your own. Again, fresh but nothing crazy. Probably better than your average deli

Boise Fry Company is such a unique, fun place to get good local grub. They are truly one of a kind and everyone should definitely try them at least once. You can choose a variety of different potatoes for your fries, along with different cuts, and then flavor them yourselves however you like. Their burgers had awesome flavor as well. The only reason I feel this business wouldn't get a 5 Star is because their space is way too small! Especially around lunch time. This place gets packed! They need a bigger retail space to hold the crowd.

[Revised review after our second visit]
You just opened, don't give up so soon!
Went for Sat. morning breakfast for our first visit. Omelette was delicious, even the kids loved it. Service was fast enough, no line, staff friendly. Inside was very clean.
Later decided we needed to try the breakfast sandwich, which was... the coldest and oldest thing I'd eaten in a long time (it was 9am - they open at 7am - so I had to assume it had been sitting about that long). They should have been embarrassed to serve food like that. Disgusting. Upon returning it, the replacement they brought was piping hot (and FRESH) and very good.
So all in all, we liked the menu, the "front of house" staff and the taste, but the kitchen has some leaning to do, and whomever is managing it isn't checking the quality.
[Visited again for another lunch which was good with no issues. Raising my rating to 3 stars - will bump it up another star if our next visit is as flawless!]
I had a great steak at Ram.  My husband had the ribs.  We had prompt and friendly service.  We will be back!

This is my 2nd visit to the counter in Meridian in the past 3 days. I recently moved to Boise from Los Angeles. 

Coming from LA, I am quite familiar with the Counter, having been in most locations in Southern California and so, I came in with high expectations.

On my first visit, I was impressed at how generous their portions are. I typically ordered the healthy options (build my own) such as chicken breast with salad base. The chicken is perfectly cooked without being soaked in too much oil. The salad was so much and it was so fresh!

The second visit was again outstanding. Same quality of food prepared! Consistent! This is simply the best the Counter I've been to!

I hope they will open in downtown Boise sometime soon!

Recommendation for those who never tried the Counter... yes, their specialty is burgers but definitely try out the healthy options and don't be afraid to ask on how to order properly. It may be intimidating looking at the menu.

Suggestions for the restaurant:
1. Bring out water as soon as customers are seated 
2. If they order side dishes in addition to other menus, please inquire if they want the side dishes out first. If all food come out at the same time, it's hard to eat them without one of them getting cold.
This Walmart is good. The staff are efficient, and helpful. The store is clean and well organized and I can usually find what I need.

My wife and I took out two others to try Kneaders for the first time.  I had the Ruben Panini and it was terrible -- hardly pressed/cooked, one sliver of meat and a lot of messy sauce.  Took it back and the manager apologized for the new help and said he would make me another one.  It arrived looking like the first one but had 2-3 thin pieces of meat.  The same was true for the person who had the beef ay jus -- very little meat.  The brocoli soup was HOT temperature wise but tasteless.  We will never return.

We went during happy hour on a Friday.  Happy hour lasts until 6 pm, so it provided plenty of time for an early dinner and drinks. The regular lemon drop was good, not overly sweet as some I've tasted.  The lime margarita on the rocks was delicious!  The happy hour price for mixed drinks with 2 shots was only $5.50.  

It seemed to take a long time to get the food and drinks we ordered.  The happy hour food portions were half size, but honestly provided plenty to eat.  Half portions for about half price, it's not necessarily a huge enticement.  We ordered loaded waffle fries, pickle chips, and Caesar salads while were all very good, but not super outstanding.

Overall, the food was good, atmosphere was fine, service adequate.  I will definitely come back for happy hour drinks, but not if I'm only going for food since the prices are essentially the same (half price for half portions).  Outside of drinks, I might require a little outside motivation to return.

My friend and I had never been to Whitewater before and thought we'd check it out for lunch. This place is definitely an Idaho place. It's decorated in a rafting theme with canoes, kayaks, rafts, and pontoon boats suspended above you.  Kind of fun because it got us talking about all of our rafting trips down various Idaho rivers (Boise, Payette, Salmon, Snake, Clearwater etc.)

Since we were unfamiliar with the menu we asked our server what she liked... there are about 25 specialty pizzas. She recommended the Power Stroke (their take on a combination) and the special - which was a new pizza called the Samurai. She also told us that we could do half and half, so that's how we ordered it. They have two types of crust - regular and sourdough. We went with regular. 

Our pizza was out in about 10-15 minutes. The Power Stroke side was barbecue sauce based and the Samurai side was Teriyaki sauce based... but you can choose to have tomato sauce as well. The Samurai came with marinated jerk chicken and a host of veggies. We ordered a 12 inch pizza and it was piled about 1.5 inches high with toppings for around $12.  The crust was crispy on the bottom and soft and warm above. My friend was so impressed with the pizza that he ordered a Samurai for take and bake (they also do carry out but no delivery) for his family. 

The overall experience was fantastic from the price to the food to the service to the decor. No idea what it's like for dinner as I've seen a lot of cars in the parking lot but I'll definitely pay this place another visit.

This is the worst meal we have had in Boise so far. We tried ordering deviled eggs to start. These are on their menu. The waitress came back and told us they didn't have any prepared. The wait was long. When we got our food both burgers were over cooked and the fries were so salty we couldn't eat them. We sent one burger back and passed on replacing the sweet potato fries. Again, the wait was long to get the fresh burger. We picked at our overly salty shoestring fries while waiting. Neither of our burgers were seasoned and therefore bland. When we finally got our bill they didn't comp any of the meal and for bad burgers it was really pricey. We will not be going back.
Perfect stay. Friendly staff, convenient location, comfortable beds, nice free breakfast, free Internet and very quiet.

Went with my wife and child on an early Friday night. Took my son to the restroom. One stall had chewing tobacco thrown all over and the other had pee all over the seat and floor. Both looked like they had been that way fos some time. food was also mdiocre for the price. Looked worse than a dive bar at 2:00 am. Disgusted and will not return.

Clean, kind employees, and well decorated. The complaints here to me reflect expecting Macy's customer service at a Walmart. All I can say is if you have low expectations this Walmart will knock your socks off.

I'm a fan.  Cool atmosphere, great fry selection, and solid burgers.  In fact, I liked the burgers more than I liked the fries.  

The sauce bar is awesome.  They have 10+ different sauces you can add to your burger or fries.  

I've been to both the downtown and meridian locations.  I like the downtown location more - just a fun vibe and a little more open space.
Go to this establishment.   Great staff, friendly, so bright and inviting.  Ceiling to floor windows bring in such great natural sunlight it just makes it a peaceful feeling salon.
We are traveling from California and stop in here to try. Very good Bison and lots of options. Would definitely come back again.

Can't believe the area manager lets this store stay open. I'm from Indiana originally and went to college in Michigan. The Dobes used to be one of my favorite places to eat. I always would pick this over any competitor because of the delicious queso... Other burrito joints didn't stand a chance. I moved to Meridian 2 years ago and saw the dobe and pulled in with my wife and daughter. We all got our usual. Mine was the chicken queso burrito. This had to be the worst chicken queso I've ever had. It tasted like it was yesterday's just reheated. I ate a few bites and called it a day. I chalked that up to a bad experience and went again last week.... Same experience. I can't believe that they would have returning customers based on my experience. I'm not exactly sure how they botch the food so bad but it's terrible. I also saw a worker smoking on the side of the building and walk inside, throw on gloves and start serving food. I'm not sure what protocol is but that's gross. Will not be bad... Luckily Costa vita and chipotle are close.

Went here for lunch today I got to say the menu was very simple and surprisingly in expensive I'll definitely go back to give them another try the meat was still a little pink in the middle and one thing that bugs me is pink hamburger meat barring that small inconvenience everything else was pretty decent for me this burger joint just did not have any kind of well factor to it it seems like another one of your cookie cutter burger places. What I can't say is that two burgers actually fed 4 family members me my wife and two youngest. So for a $6 Burger you definitely get your money's worth another negative that I have is I ordered their sweet potato fries and they were just sick extremely Bland so that was very disappointing for me I like to have some cinnamon or maybe some cayenne pepper or or some! sort of flavor on my sweet potato fries these needs work. I feel like this place could be a great place it just needs a little more work
Simply amazing sandwiches! Finally an owner who cares for his customers as much as his establishment  very tasty, great service, and one very full belly!! Kudos
My Hubbie and I ate here his sandwich was yummy, but I wasn't impressed with mine. The staff was very friendly but the prices are INSANE tho!!

My husband and I loved the original location. I was happy to hear that they had just moved locations rather than completely shutting down. We finally went to the new location for lunch yesterday. The place was completely empty at noon, which should have been a huge red flag for us.
My husband had the lunch fettuccine alfredo and added a salad to it. The salad was obviously dumped right out of a bagged mix, but they did add dried cranberries and sunflower seeds to it. But adding this for $1.99 was a complete rip off. The pasta was a tiny portion and came with a stale and flavorless breadstick. He said the alfredo sauce was "not bad, but nothing special."
I ordered a calzone and added soup to it, again for $1.99. It was tomato basil and tasted like it had come out of a Campbell's soup can with basil added to it. The waitress had to come and check to make sure it was hot enough, which it was not. The soup also came with a stale and flavorless breadstick. The calzone was huge. But even though it was on the lunch menu, I don't think there was a lunch price for it. It was incredibly doughy, the sauce was off-tasting. I had italian sausage, olives and artichoke hearts in it and the only thing that tasted right were the canned artichokes and olives.
It looked like they had a good selection of beers on tap, but so does their neighbor, Buffalo Wild Wings. 
I don't know what has changed since we first started going to Whitewater's original location, but we will NEVER be back. Sad too because I'd much rather support a local business than a franchised restaurant, but not when they deliver sub-par food.
I will say our waitress was very nice and helpful and when she had to help a bigger party who came in after we ordered the one other waitress working delivered our food so it wouldn't get cold. It's always nice to at least have good service when the product you are paying for is such a disappointment.

I don't eat donuts very often, but when I do, I want a great one! After trying two highly rated donut shops in Tacoma a week ago and finding both of them disappointing, it was such a pleasure to be reminded of the wonderful donuts that we have in the Treasure Valley. DK Donuts doesn't have a fancy store front and they don't spell donuts in a pretentious way. What they have going for them is that they are a family run business that strives to provide a fresh and high-quality donut for a reasonable price. Even if these donuts were is expensive as the ones I tried in Tacoma, I would gladly pay the price because they are worth it. The beautiful thing is that I don't have to pay an exorbitant price because the owners know that a donut is simply a donut, not a gourmet food item that should cost an arm and a leg. I truly cannot say enough good things about DK's Donuts. If you haven't given them a try yet, or haven't visited in recently, please do. You'll be happy you did!

Scam. When I refused to pay beyond the $29 LivingSocial voucher, the guy who came to do my service told me I was making it impossible for him to pay his bills and being cheap, picked up his stuff and stormed out. Complained to LivingSocial yet they still have this voucher for sale.  Guess they don't care if people get ripped off.  SCAM!
Moved here from cali 3 yrs ago. Been looking for a good mexican food restaurant with no luck, until now. Great food, affordable, fun atmosphere. Definitely recommended.

Whhhhaaat???? There's TV's in every booth?

Oh yes....there is! My family and I just moved here and we were looking for a great place to go to watch football...with a 2 year old. This place was pretty much perfect for us. It has a fun, sports-themed atmosphere and of course, the personal TV's are awesome! The food is well priced and decent portions. We ordered the potato skins, nachos and chicken tenders and everything was really good! I also think that they have a pretty good beer selection. I was a bit surprised to find a place like that has several microbrews (and they were on special for $3!!).

I gave this place a rating a four stars because the server that we had just did not seem like she wanted to be there. The only time I recall seeing her smile was when I said that I liked her tattoo. She was a good server in the sense that she gave us everything we needed/wanted, but being in the industry myself, I expected some enthusiasm...at least a little maybe...
Was nervous about trying a new salon but, was pleasantly surprised! Everyone was very friendly and seemed to know their customers by name. Will definitely go back!

Wow! What an excellent experience we had tonight. The food was beyond top notch. My husband and I have eaten at many five star restaurant and this one is right up there with them. Shack the bar tender was experienced and knew the menu as if he owned the place. This is a hidden gem and you won't be disappointed!!! We will be back!! Thank you for bringing home made from scratch recipes to Meridian! No microwave in this place, it's done right the first time!

9 different types of salt and I can't even remember how many sauces. The fries here are def some of the best I've ever had. The staff here was great and was able to share a few stories with them on my journey across America for veterans with PTSD.

Awesome water park!! I took my kiddos on a surprise road trip at the end of August. We weren't disappointed. We booked a Cabaña and the service was awesome. The staff was friendly, the park was clean and overall it was a fabulous experience. We are planing on returning next year to make it an annual event. Next time we are bringing more friends to make it even more fun! The food was yummy and reasonably priced. Well done Roaring Springs!

Xanti is the Fitness Manager at this location and this is who you need to train with. He's incredible. He not only whipped me into shape but I actually look forward to our training days -- now that's skill and talent. I started seeing results pretty quickly with increased muscle tone and weight loss ... after just three weeks. I have a ways to go but I'm just getting started. Not only that but Xanti gives you simple tips you can do at home on your own time, which I've followed through with and am amazed to see the positive changes in my body. Go with Xanti and you'll love the results. He makes it fun, too.

What I thought was a sit down restaurant was actually a cafeteria style
Sort of fast food. I was very impressed the ingredients were fresh, the meat was charged and flavorful, it was quick and delicious. I will be back again.

After going to several Mexican restaurants in the Valley our kids keep asking to return to Fiesta Guadalajara. This place has also been recommended to us by several Mexican friends. The Carne Asada is one of my favorites. The service is always very friendly and prompt.
Just went here for the first time. And it was amazing across the board from food to service to the bathrooms!!!  Very impressed will return soon

Got myself and my 2 friends nostrils pierced, very happy I did my research and came here! Matt was incredibly friendly and knowledgeable, my nervous self was immediately calmed by the amount of certifications on the wall. Matt was very helpful and educating, and if I ever need anything I won't be afraid of returning and asking for help, or getting more piercings!

Ryan was fantastic at listening to our tatoo ideas and gave honest and crucial feedback to help us make he best decision possible. He had a light hand and was easy to chat with! I would highly recommend you ask for him when you visit!

First of all I have to say that this is in our top 3 favorite BURGER chains around. Great "char" flavor and their FRIES are prob among my favorite as well.  Although not cut in house from real potatoes, still a great medium thick crispy yet chewable fry.  Fry sauce is tasty and as RANCH connoisseur, I'll say that there's might be the best in town, right up there with Idaho Pizza company.  I did however make the MISTAKE of ordering a FRIED CHICKEN sandwich last Friday and it was by far the worst I've ever had.  It had such an undeniably off taste and look, only thing I can guess is that it was fried hours before then maybe refried for my order?  Who knows.  Considering how satisfied we've always been with The Habit in general, I'm hoping this was some unfortunate fluke of gastronomy.  Will continue going to the habit but won't gamble on the fried chicken sandwich again.
Food is way over priced. The nacho's would appeal to very young taste buds. The wait staff is very good and the experience is fun. Just eat before you go.

We love this place!  I crave this place.  I love everything.  Food, Service- everything!!  We come to Boise area about 2 times a year for several weeks.  We eat here every time we are in the area.  I wish we had this kind of Thai food in Frisco TX.  This is one of my favorite places for good food.  Ambiance is nice not what you would expect from the Strip Center place.  This is a GEM of a place and the family that runs the place obviously takes pride in the place.

Went here for lunch today and it was the same excellent service and awesome food.

Had the tri tip sandwich and my husband had the portobello burger. Both were very tasty. Their sourdough is lovely! We both had their tempura green beans, they aren't to be missed!

We both also tried their Peach and Ginger Nectar. It was unbelievably refreshing.

Really love this place.

Solid! F%#! Yeah!!! Gentleman was very friendly and gave a supreme menu tour. Not from the area and glad we found this gem! Wiley's special is cool if your not picky. Tell me what you don't like and it's a rock in suprise errey time! We will
Be back when passing through again.

An overpriced, not so tasty burger joint. Great variety of options for your burger but we won't be going back.  The decor is nice with a good location. $9 burger, $2.50 for fries, onion rings, coleslaw etc. We will stick with 5 Guys.

I only go there for a pedicure but Ha does any amazing job!!! Very friendly atmosphere. 
UP.
The burgers and fries were very tasty. I like that they offer different types and styles of fries. The only complaint I have is that it is a bit pricey for fast food.

Bye, bye to all the other hamburger places in the Village.  The Habit is the only place you need to go for a great burger. 
Fresh ingredients and fast no fuss service.  They are very friendly and have a great vibe.  Good music and just great food!  
So glad they are here....no fussy attitudes and long wait times.
We love this place.  Great sammiches and salads.  Great and friendly staff, with funny jokes!  Anything on the menu is very good.  Get there early before the cookies are gone.

My husband and I love this place! Chicken avocado on focaccia is amazing and he likes turkey ranch on sourdough. Their bread is the best! Usually pretty busy but worth the wait. Haven't had their breakfast yet but looks really good.

Went in on a Wednesday, around 12. They had a promotion going on where you buy 2 passes full price get one free. I didn't receive my extra ticket. I asked about it and talked to some people in the office and still shut me down. I don't see myself coming back for awhile. I'll take my burned feet else where.
The sweet potato fries are the best, I had a sandwich can't remember the name but it had a pesto sauce and some mozzarella cheese that was really good.

A much needed change of pace from the national chain restaurants, this was a terrific choice for lunch.  Looking at my GPS, Fat Guy's was a short walk from my hotel since I was staying on Eagle Road and Overland - it's refreshing to walk five minutes from either the Courtyard or TownPlace - makes you feel like a local in Meridian heading out to eat.  If you don't want to take the walk, drive over and park around back - there's plenty of spaces for your vehicle and you're welcome to use the back door.  Keep in mind that it's a healthy idea to walk off some of those calories on the walk back after lunch.  I'm pushing the walk aspect.  

My initial expectation was to eat lunch at a sit-down restaurant but this is a "quick serve" format restaurant where you order and pay for your meal at the counter, and when your sandwich is ready, the server brings your sandwich to the table.  For beverages, you serve yourself from the fountain machine.  That's OK, you can make the drink the way you want it and get refills when you need them.  The fruit infused ice tea was outstanding.  Keep in mind that with the quick serve restaurant format, most people don't tip the server, so that saves you 15% to 20% of the total cost of the meal when compared to sit-down meal service.  

All the sandwiches looked delicious.  The food was fresh and the portion size was generous,  My choice was difficult but decided to place an order for the French dip with home-made slaw.  The sandwich had soft roll, and the meat was properly cooked, not overdone like many French dips.  When combined with the Au Jus, it was a perfect combination. Devoured the whole thing like a starving wolf.   Fat Guys can expect me to join them for lunch again on my next visit to Meridian. 

Salute!

Argumentive management.  I was charged though I was not allowed to stay there due to no I.D. They had no problem charging me for the room since I had to provide my debit card number to make the reservation! I had the same card in hand when I went in. Lady stated "how am I supposed to run your card when you don't have your I.D.?!"
Uh, apparently no problem running it online. Horrible service. There are many more hotels to stay at.  Don't stay here.
Legitimatly one of, if not the best sandwich I've ever had. I've traveled extensively over the years and this place is the business. I love that this placed is tucked away in the treasure valley.
This a a great place to come with the Family. Sunday before noon is the best as they have games for $2. Plenty of beer choices as well.

To start. The sandwich was pretty good. But the entire rest of the experience sucked. The decor Didn't match. Everyone working didn't smile or give good customer service. There was random clutter behind the counter. The sandwich was way to expensive $9. Overall not worth spending time to go.

I had heard about a new burger place at The Village, so my wife and went today for dinner. We knew nothing about it, so we were expecting something akin to Five Guys or Smashburger. Be aware: this is a full service, sit down and order burger joint. And you pay for it. 

Their burgers are based around a build-it-yourself concept. You pick your type of meet, bun (or you can get it as a salad), cheese, sauce, trimmings, etc. They have 3 sizes: 1/3 lb for $9.50, 1/2 lb for $12, or the whopping 1 lb burger for 18 smackers. The sizes are the post cooked weight, so they're pretty big.

Along with our burgers, we ordered the parmesan fries. 7 bucks (didn't know that before we ordered them) for a good amount of fries tossed in parmesan cheese and rosemary I believe. They were okay. My wife liked them a lot; it was too much parmesan for my taste.

Overall, the burgers were average. Certainly not worth 10 bucks. We definitely didn't expect to run up a $30 tab (before tip) when we walked in the door. For that kind of coin, we expected some killer gourmet burgers. What we got were decent, but nothing special. Frankly, my wife and I both said we would have rather eaten at Five Guys. 

I should mention that the service was very good. Our server was friendly and quick on the refills. The owner seems rather hands-on and was pleasant as well. 

The Counter isn't bad by any means, just not worth the money. We won't be going back.

Big Al's is serious fun for the whole family. The environment and vastness of the offerings they boast is something to boast about! Prices may be high but it's so worth it. My husband and I love going to Big Al's for date night, football watching, bowling, or just a dinner out with the whole family. They've always got specials (sometimes at odd hours/days like for bowling) but it's a fun, upbeat, lively place! 

Food: the nachos and burgers! Try them! The burgers are fatty patties on big, soft buns. The nachos are extremely huge and very good. We have tried many things on their menu, including the desserts (mud pie!!) and it is all very good. Try the happy hour food specials. They're smaller than the regular portion, which makes them a lot more reasonable for one person. 

Drinks: tons of beer on tap! 

Atmosphere: I don't feel like you can beat it! Bowling, bars, arcade, food at the lanes, a huge sports restaurant, an adult VIP lounge, a private bowling area... It's so upscale and nice! It's a huge facility, offering a lot of versatility for the whole family. 

Service: average (seems like they always have new servers), but the atmosphere trumps it every time! 

Happy Hour Offerings: daily happy hour EXCEPT during big games. 

Healthy Hack: this is one of the only places I've seen with a good salad selection on the happy hour menu. The salad with fruit (apples/pears and nuts) is so good! 

Tips: Portions are very big, especially the nachos! Bring a hearty appetite!

this place is very good, the food is good, the beer is great, lots of selections.  it gets really busy on weekends and game days.  best tip, go early for lunch for easy seating.  service is very good.
Great food and atmosphere, probably my favorite restaurant in the treasure valley. Just had corn beef and cabbage for St. Pattys day, it was amazing.
Requested a quote for an iPhone 6plus screen replacement and got a great deal. Came by later today and 20 mins later got my screen replaced. Thank you again for the quick quote and great service!

Tyler is wonderful! He has been repairing the chips and cracks in my windshields for years and I have never had a problem with the workmanship. They are also really easy to contact and get an appointment with. I had my mother in law come in from out of town and we needed her windshield replaced in a hurry so she would be safe on the drive back to Gooding, ID. Tyler was able to come out within an hour of me calling him and hand the windshield in within 30 minutes. I will never go to anyone else for my auto glass needs.

Terrible service incompetent staff, even worse management. The manager admitted to the waitress doing things back-ass wards. Swiped my card twice then a 7 day business hold placed on my card. All transactions processed. Big Al's manager says "oops". 
You're just going to be out the money until we take the funds then send them back. 
This happened on Jan 1st. Bank says another week to clear it up. 
We are only talking 77 bucks, but still. What would have happened had I not pointed out the error? Thieves in my book. If you go there my advise only pay cash. They don't know what they're doing with credit cards...just swipe swipe swipe away. Idiots

More than enough opportunity to make things right over time and they cannot seem to get it under control.  Our first visit (our fault) was opening day, it was a disaster, they clearly weren't ready. Second visit 6 months later not much had changed, food quality still wasn't there,, med rare doesn't mean char'd with cold fry's.  Finally last night after being opened for over a year they clearly have issues.  Ordered fry's to be served with dinner, they showed up almost as fast as we ordered them, the waiter was told we asked for them to be with our meal, the response was "Sorry"  placed them and left.  The mgr did come over to the table, apologized.  The consistency issues are still prevalent, this is a restaurant that I will scratch off the list, not worth the effort on our part and not worth the money.  Don't judge "The Counter" brand by this place, the others are amazing (Times Square and San Diego Airport, YES, you can get a genuine Counter Burger at an airport that far exceeds this local place)

I paid $25 for a barley (by 4 days) to get in but if I would have told them he was 3 he was free, he can't ride any of the fun rides cause he is so little, only one bigger ride, so $25 for the kiddie pool is stupid ridiculous, also the food is cold and has been sitting their forever, which most of it is fried food, no excuse not to be made per order. This place is a joke to take younger kids to, I don't mind the $30 for me and him but but almost $60 plus buying food. I won't be back.

I have been a few times now and it has always been a good experience.  The burgers and milkshakes were great, and the staff has been very friendly/helpful each time.  I have only been there when there's maybe another table or 2, but the service time has always been reasonable.  The cost of the burger limits me from going there all the time, but it is worth it to go every once in a while.

These guys are my new best friends!! I dropped my iphone into the bathtub (yes, it was stupid) and took it into Rockstar the next morning. They had my iphone up and running, pretty as ever, in no time at all!!! They are truly the BEST!!

I would not reccomend this place. Very dissatisfied in the service. The guy that did my pedicure kept turning away to watch a soccer game on the tv behind him. He nipped my toe bad enough to make it bleed and didn't say a word about it. I had to ask him to work on my heels more as he did a poor job on them. I will not return

Donuts are yummy and a good price also. My only complaint is the store is DIRTY. From the floor, to the tables, light switches... everything really needs to be scrubbed down. Makes you wonder what it looks like where customers DONT see. Also the girl who works there was asleep when we came in...
The latte I got was delicious.  The staff was very friendly.  I will definitely come back.

LOVE LOVE LOVE THIS PLACE. I got a lash lift and tint by Miguel and I am obsessed. I did a lot of research prior to making a reservation because come on, losing your eyelashes due to a bad eyelash lift or having someone get dye in your eye would suck. Miguel was so sweet and talked me through the whole thing and they turned out amazing. It was pain free and my lashes look great! Highly recommend this place!
Great bagels! Their cream cheese leaves a lot to be desired in terms of texture and taste so they lose a star for that but otherwise this place is pretty great.

The last few times I have been to kneaded the customer service has been terrible. I don't know where they find their people - but they need to look elsewhere. They're always forgetting stuff through the drive through and it takes FOREVER. Today was the last straw. I was coming back for the food but this time I ordered a turkey cranberry sunflower salad that was BAD. Check out my photos. Also the soup I ordered was ice cold and I had to heat it up myself when I got home. (I only live 5 minutes away). 

 When I called the store to complain about the salad I was asked what my name was and they said "ok cool just next time you come in tell us your name and we will give you a free salad." Wow great. Thanks guys. They didn't seem too concerned which makes ME concerned that this is normal for them. 

Either way I WILL NOT be returning to Kneaders for my "free salad". Yuck.

Love love the cute, tasty seasonal sugar cookies.  My custom order was fresh and just as I ordered it. ..sunshine cookies in january.  Bread bowls great to pick up to make an easy dinner of soup and salad a little more special.

I haven't actually stayed in the room long but it is absolutely awful and the pictures on their site are deceiving. They say they have queen size beds yet they are only full size. We booked one room with 2 beds for 4 people and now 2 of us will have to sleep on the floor since the beds are so small. Worst hotel I've stayed at. Money would have been better spent elsewhere.

Wonderful atmosphere. Friendly and attentive staff. I love the decor. I've had many different Thai iced tea and curries across all of southern California and come to Boise, Idaho to find a superior Thai iced tea! Keep it up, Sawadee!

This is my favorite spot. The coffee is always delicious. The service is great, always friendly and energetic. I go 2-4 times a week.  They have awesome deals of the day. I follow them on Facebook and they tell you the night before what the drink is. It's always any size and hot, iced or blended for just $3. They also have a punch card buy 10 the 11th is free!! Excellent coffee and Great deals.

We were at Big Al's for my husbands going away for Idaho State police. Our server not only took 20+ minutes to serve us our first beer at 5:30pm, but then when are entire party arrived and have had two beers he asked who was driving and refused to serve until someone who wasn't drinking said they were driving. He gave the highest bill at the middle of the preliminary fight. It took. 30+ minutes after the main fight to give everyone in our party including the table next to us who was not apart of us with the same server to give us our bill. I went to the manager who seemed to only care about dancing and hanging out with female severs to come over and look over our servers shoulder for less then a minute and walk a way. He did not say anything to our table or the next about apologizing for the wait he just let everyone walk over to the computer and  wait for their check. Their were still mistakes on the checks and over paid for a meals that we did not receive. I am very disappointed that I chose your establishment to celebrate my husbands accomplishment and will not ever be back. We spent a lot of money there to be so dissatisfied with our server Ryan and the Manager on duty!
I absolutely love this place, today was my second time there and it'll be my new nail spot for sure, Yuri did amazing and so talented in what she does!!

We went with family to celebrate my parents anniversary and it was great. The food was outstanding, especially the blackened salmon and armadillo eggs. My husband is also in love with their Angry Blonde which is half beer, half cider. 

Carson was our server and he was awesome as well. He made sure our entire table was taken care of. I always enjoy the menu and the seasonal items as well. This location is always a great place to grab a beer and a bite to eat or watch the game!

I went to Boise Dermatology at the beginning of December because I had been experiencing some heavy hair shedding and over all loss. The staff was nice and I got in on time to my appointment. Dr. Brooks was friendly but only spent about 15 mins with me talking about my hair. She only looked at my scalp and didn't do a pull test to see how much hair was falling out or anything, all of this I paid 120 dollars for. She told me what I could have and what could be causing it, said I could do steroid shots which would cost 85 dollars. I have no insurance and have to pay out of pocket for everything so I couldn't do that. They told me that to really know I needed a blood test but they understood that my finances were tight.
