A week or so later I got the blood work done because my hair loss had gotten a lot worse. Well my results came back with my iron being pretty high. They assistant told me it was fine and that I could keep taking my multivitamin with iron in it, and that at that time there was nothing they could do except the steroid. A week later I ended up going to urgent care because I was not feeling good, I told them all that had been going on and gave them my other lab results, the doctor ended up looking into them and told me that I am at risk of iron overload and it needed dealt with. So now I am being referred to a hematologist. So while the staff and the doctor are friendly. I am mad because they should have looked at my results and realized that things were off and no just look at the fact that the results weren't low. I have no idea how this doctor is with other things but I don't think she is the greatest with hair loss, and I don't feel like much of an exam was done for the money that I paid. Along with the fact that my other health could have been effected if I hadn't have told another doctor.

The staff here are always super nice and ready to help. And the food is always awesome too! Today there was a slight issue with my order but the manager was great about it and even comped my meal. Seriously these guys are great if you want good food, great friendly staff and a nice atmosphere this is the place(:

I chose this Hotel because it was reasonably priced and looked clean from the pictures. When I got there the computers were down so I wasn't able to check in fully. There were police officers there also investigating something. I stopped by to check out the hot tub area, it was gross, lukewarm and missing paint I decided I was not going to take a hot tub later. Then I went up to my room and the police were two doors down, so that made me feel unsafe. I went to the room and I felt as if I was going to get bedbugs the lights weren't working, the fan in the bathroom made an awful sound and the Wi-Fi was not working. I went down to ask for a refund just because I did not feel safe staying here. They said they would ask their manager and get back to me. I also asked Expedia to step in at this point to help and they weren't able to help. They wouldn't give me a refund. I stayed at an air bnb which was less expensive and way nicer. My recommendation is do not stay at a hotel that represents themselves as a clean safe environment. The pictures do not do this place justice. Definitely do not stay here.

Love their appetizer sampler/combo thing. But only when it's to go. They just make it different, and it tastes better. Also the quesadilla in the app combo is prefect full of cheese, but the actual quesadilla meal, has little cheese.

Well, @ 640pm, they are out of chicken, turkey, and have 1 sausage. I have my 2 girls, 5 & 10. We get the family pack. Cost me $36+. It was 1 lb meat, 2 sides, 4 rolls. Suppose to be enough for 4. My 5 yr old ate the 1 sausage, supposedly 1/4 lb! 5 ribs were 3/4 lb. My 10 yr old ate those. Plenty of sides for the 2 girls. 4 stale torta rolls from cosco. All of it out of a delicious warmer wrapped in saran wrap. No, it wasnt warm. I am not sure i have ever been ripped off like this. $40 for a super kids meal? I am glad i am not too hungry.

This place is killer. I've always come in for traditional Thai food. Tonight I came in during Happy Hour and learned of the great drink and sushi specials. Delish.. I had spicy Salmon, spicy Snapper, Salmon and some sweet tempura shrimp roll - along with two beers. 16$. Seriously? I know where I'll be spending more dinners on the way home from work. The sushi was awesome. Some of the best I've had in town.

We came here for lunch and were underwhelmed by the lunch menu.  I had trouble selecting what I wanted from the limited menu.  The server was very polite and friendly.

The dressing on the little salad was exquisite.

My pad prik king was ordered with medium heat and was dead on.  Overall it was very fresh and on the sweet side.  Nothing the Singh Ha couldn't fix.

We will be back!
I have to agree. The p.c Pedro is freakin delicious. Try it and you won't be disappointed. My only complaint is the sandwiches are a bit pricey but the quality is very good.

I will definitely continue to come here more often then not because the crab & artichoke dip is amazing! Honestly, just with that I'm sold. I'm also really big on calamari and it's delicious here. Unfortunately here in Idaho chevelas aren't a common drink order here. So knowing that the bloody Mary's here are great I substituted vodka for beer instead, so good!

Our favorite deli in the Treasure Valley hands down! My husband and I have been in here many times and we absolutely love the food and the service. The owner and all of his employees have been top notch every time we've visited and the food is always amazing. If you haven't tried the Clam Chowder I highly recommend it, it's the most flavorful clam chowder we've ever had and we'll drive 20 minutes out of the way just to eat here. The only reason I give 4 stars instead of 5 is that the prices are pretty high (we usually end up spending about $30 for 2 people including  tip, we do get soup to take home though) and the location isn't very convenient. That said, we still will make the trip out there at least once a month to delight in the atmosphere and fill our bellies to the brim, it's definitely worth it.

Favorite sandwich shop. Huge selection, all items tried to date are bomb including the sides. Doesn't need a big review, if you haven't been to Fat Guy's you need to get in there on your next meal! 

Recommend the bleu bronco
My pedicure looks adorable! Really took their time on my pedicure and didn't rush me out the door when waiting for it to dry. I would love to come again next time I visit Boise!

We took our family including two kids who are picky eaters for supper last night. All six of us totally enjoyed our meal and others that we shared. My wife eats gluten free and was thrilled with her choices. This place is now at the top of our list when eating out in Boise.
Best Mexican food in the treasure valley. Hands down! Our server Eddy was fabulous! So quick, attentive, friendly, he was amazing!

I never understood why this place is always so busy. The burgers are mediocre, fries like you can get at any other place. These small faults could be forgiven if it weren't for the terrible management. They overwork their employees to the point of exhaustion and fire loyal employees for no good reason, when losing staff in such a busy environment is the last thing they need. Then the other members of staff are given double shifts and no days off while management scrambles to hire and train new employees who have no idea what they're in for. I will no longer support an establishment that has such disregard for the emotional health of their workers.

Clean, friendly, and a great location!

I work with a company in Meridian frequently and travel from my home in California to Idaho a few times a year. After discovering this Hampton Inn I don't stay anywhere else while I'm in town. The staff are always welcoming and the accommodations are always comfortable and clean. This Hampton Inn lives up to the standards I have come to expect from the chain. Great for a quick business trip, or long haul stay. Definitely recommend this hotel!

Stopped in and tried the Bleu Bronco and glad I did.  Huge portions of the best roastbeef I've had yet, smothered with Bleu cheese and bacon, finished with a pesto aioli on a bun with au jus to dip it in, YUM.  The sandwich was so big I had to take a break before coming back to finish it off.  This place has quality meats you don't find in your average deli.  Next time I'll opt for a roll for ease of dipping.   Just one of thirty options until you request your own creation which they will happily do. Friendly staff under the guidance of Chef Wally, a laid back environment, patio dining and a big screen to catch the game while chowing down makes this place well worth the visit.  Great place for lunch or dinner on the run or as a Saturday resting place after a bike ride too.  Definitely worth checking out.  Thanks to all, especially Chef Wally.

Really good burger!
4.5-5 stars. Nicely seasoned fresh beef with grilled onions. 

Today I was on a mission to taste test burgers and we made it to 7 burger joints. I think the only mistake we made was not having all the burgers outfitted the same. Small differences like house sauce vs mustard and ketchup and whole onions vs  grilled onions or no onions can adversely affect the taste. The thought was to order a cheeseburger from each place with nothing added or taken away just their signature burger. For that reason I am reviewing each burger as a stand alone and not head to head. Next time I think I will put them head to head with the same fixins.

Cherry lane & 10 mile location seems to take forever to process a simple deposit.  To top it off when given a deposit slip with the transaction tends to put it in the wrong account.  If it happened once or twice ok but three or more ridiculous.  Not impressed!
Love the beers and the Brussel sprouts. We've had great meals here. Mike, the owner, is great!

My husband suggested this place for lunch, he had eaten here before.  I was skeptical but very pleasantly surprised. I had the turkey melt and it was fantastic!  In fact, it was probably the best sandwich (if you can call it just a sandwich) that I've ever had!  The servings are very generous but it was too delicious not to finish. I will definitely go back again, everything on the menu looks great! Can't wait to try more!!

I honestly don't know why I keep coming here. I guess it's because some of their food is good. But from the terrible customer service I always receive, to the excessive amounts of wilted lettuce in my salads, to them messing up my orders or trying to upcharge me for simple substitutions, I need to just stay away. I shouldn't have to tell a restaurant to make sure my lettuce is fresh but they somehow think it's okay to have pieces of wilted, soggy lettuce in their salads. Or last night when I go there and they tell me they're out of croutons for the Caesar salad I ordered and they'd have to upcharge me for bread instead. At the end of the day, they need to have some serious lessons in how to talk to their guests and prepare their food. If it happens once, okay every place will make some mistakes, no big deal. But they've been consistent enough that I feel the need to write this review. Figure it out Kneaders, your food is delicious when it's fresh, it's your low quality service that hurts you!

I guess I'm on that perpetual search for a sports bar that has great food and a tasteful looking service staff. Well, the search does not end with Cheerleaders. Like a reviewer before, it reminds one of a RAM clone, mediocre food, dreadful service, and little other reason to entice one to return and spend their hard earned cash. Avoid if you can.

I just tried this place, the BOB & MYRNA was simply AMAZING! I can't wait to get another one, and I will definitely be trying the other sandwiches as well; it's nice this place is so close!  I just wish the "winter" hours where the same as the summer but I understand why.

I visited The Habit with my two nieces for the first time about a month ago.  We walked in, and since we had never been there, we stood 15 feet back from the register to look at the menu located above it.  I get that the guy at the cash register was just trying to do his job, but he would not stop talking to me long enough to let me read the menu or talk to my young nieces to figure out what they wanted.  "How is your day?"  "Have you been here before?"  "I would recommend the double burger!" Can I answer any questions?"  And on and on. It made ordering take three times as long as it would have otherwise.  If I am standing by the register and ready to order, ask away. But, otherwise, just give me a minute.  Once we finally did order, we did get our food quickly and it was hot. I like that they have fry sauce.  The fries were good and plentiful.  But, overall it was just ok - not really that much different from getting a burger at any other burger place.  The kids prefer Red Robin, and that's probably where we'll go in the future for burgers and fries.

We have been bringing our 2 dogs here for years, and they love it. Beau is a basset whose nails are so thick that they require special tools to trim. He lays there quietly while they do his nails. Sammy is a high energy Silky Terrier who gets his long fur clipped every spring so that his is easier to groom and it keeps him cooler, and keeps the hair out of his eyes etc. He too loves the groomers at PetSmart in Meridian and he comes home very happy and looking quite dapper, and I know he is so much more comfortable after a good grooming. Their fees seem reasonable compared to other groomers too. I have recommended this service to others and will continue doing so.

They only reason I give them one star, is because their Beef brisket was super yummy. Other than that, this place totally blows. 

We came in at 8:35 on a Saturday, 25 minutes before closing time-and they were sold out of everything. Not just the meat, but all the sides as well. We got salad, and potato salad. And the potato salad was scooped for us, after the girl had just got done emptying the trash cans, with no gloves. The manager was a total B word. She was annoyed we came in and even more annoyed that we stayed with our food. I won't EVER be back here.

I've been to many "The Counter" restaurants. They are typically quick, fun, and painless. This location, however...not so much.

While the food and drink quality (I had the Ahi burger and a beer) was on-par, the service left much to be desired. I was promptly greeted by a peach of a host, but everything went downhill from there.

At 15:00 there was only one other table seated in the whole building. I waited 10 minutes for my server to finally arrive at the table. When she did, she was polite - almost friendly..but it took her another 10 minutes to bring my draft beer. WHEN THERE WAS ONLY ONE OTHER TABLE.

Seriously, pick up the pace!

I visited this salon during a recent trip to Boise. I selected it because of all the great reviews on Yelp, and I'm glad I did. 

I had a regular (non-gel) manicure with Miki, and she was terrific. She really took her time, making sure my nails and cuticles were treated properly. She gave me a great hand/arm massage and she was so pleasant!

The salon is on the small side, so you may have to wait during peak times, but it's worth it. The price, $15, was very reasonable for the service I received. I'd definitely return.

Holy good morning. I'm loving this place. I've been traveling for weeks and came in for a cup and stuck around awhile to get a little work done. Coffee is excellent and the ladies behind the bar are divine. If I lived in town I'd certainly be back to get my punch card stamped.

I called around to have a screen repaired on an iPhone for a tiny crack and rock star was the only one who offered an aftermarket screen which was cheaper. I just needed repaired so I could have phone fixed to give back to Verizon. They are fast and have good customer service. And saved me 30.00.

Stayed here for 3 nights. First room we had was alright. Small bed, old smelling, dirty shower best of all there was leftover burriots in the fridge from the last people. Second room was the jacuzzi tub suite...  first off the toliet didn't flush at all we complained and they had my husband go to the front desk to pick up a plunger...? You don't have maintenance? We fixed it but it was a temporarily fix. Next day the damn thing started acting up again. We called and I expressed how upset I was, that I paid money for this room and technically it's unsanitary.  The first girl at the front desk said "sorry we don't have anymore rooms for you" 10mins a later a house keeper comes in and was on the same page as us. So her and my husband went down to the front desk and amazingly there was a jacuzzi room available. So my husband asked "which one of you lied to me the first time when I asked to switch rooms" of course no confessed. Also don't drain the tubs and try to refill them... the jets won't work. The second jacuzzi room was the same but without the problems of the toliet. I had accidently left my pants in the first jacuzzi room and went up to the front to ask if they had a lost and found. Nope they don't, one of the front desk ladies went to the room "to check" nothing.  The next morning I saw a house keeping lady and told her what room I was in and if she could look for me. And amazingly she found them! Overall they have half ass workers who don't really care about the experience for the customers. The only good thing about that place was the breakfast. Won't be staying there again. My relaxing vacation turned into a war with the dammn hotel.
A place where A Kid Can Be A Kid and A Grown Up Can Be A Kid! Food is good and it's always fun!

Very disappointing service and food.  The waitress forgot drinks and the free appetizer, the armadillo eggs (they were weird). The kids fish was not a good value for the price.  My salad was very bland and unbalanced.  The ruben was good, I wish I ordered it....  We will not return or recommend it.

Its hard to get here and hard to order and hard to like the overly herbed sides, but the sandwiches are good. 

The layout is confusing especially because of how you enter from the parking lot. More on that below. If you come in throw the "front" door you would be right there at the counter. In through the "back" door (which is really the main entrance) we were behind people who appeared to be in line. But others came in the other door and cut. It was really crowded. People really like this place. Get there well before noon. 

The Reuben is not the best in Idaho as advertised. Maybe Buddy from Elf would be impressed. First points off: not marble rye. Nicely toasted/grilled which helps combat the too juicy kraut. I recommend that they shake off the excess pickle juice before applying. The corned beef was good. Dressing good too. 

PB&J is grilled. There's a slice of bread in between the two normal outer layers of bread. Sourdough probably wasn't the best choice. Maybe wheat would be better. The jelly was not that great. 

Potato salad was way overloaded with herbs. Thyme and oregano maybe. 

Jalapeño potato bacon cheddar soup was also too overwhelmed with herbs and smoke flavor. Kinda gave me a headache. 

Parking is a little bit of a challenge. The design of the parking lot is odd. Google maps doesn't route you to the entrance of the parking lot. Maybe the designers were thinking of a future were there's more pedestrian and bike traffic.
Chicken Satay was OK. Felt it was a little dry, but that is me. Had chilli noodles as well and did not think it really stood out taste wise.

I'm not sure any barista has ever been as happy to see me as the folks behind the counter at Big Star -  these are some truly friendly and accommodating folks! "Can I have that sandwich without the meat?" Sure! "Can you leave room for cream?" How about we steam it and put it in for you?! My coffee was great and the breakfast sandwich delicious. AND, there are little tiny individually wrapped chocolate chip cookies in a basket on the counter so you can buy just a bite of dessert - genius!! This is not necessarily a sit around for hours sort of place because it is small, but if you're looking for great coffee, food and service, this is the place for you. I will definitely be back!

Really bad meal, old stale bun on the burger and the fries had so much salt you could not eat them. It wasn't just us as I heard the people in the booth next to us complain of the same things. They left without finishing their meal too.

We tried this place 5 years ago while visiting. After California Mexican food, this was not good. Now that we live here we thought to give it another try. Meh - absolutely NO flavor to the food. Not even salt and pepper helped to raise the taste level. This is not Mexican food. Mexican food has spices and flavor. The margaritas were good and the waitress was super nice. Go for a drink - avoid this place for food.

I'm glad I read the reviews at this place. Ha was fabulous and very genuine, I've been looking for a nail place with no luck in the area since I moved here but I think i found the place for me. They were very accommodating in getting me an appointment last minute with ease, I feel like they really care about their customers here. Don't hesitate to try them out
pretty bad, not really a sports bar more like chuckie cheese

I loved the variety of types of potatoes. I had the German ones and my friend had the purple ones from Peru. Both were so good. I also loved the variety of dipping sauces. The fry sauce was my fav and the blueberry ketchup was my friend's fav. Can't wait to come back.

As a first-timer I'm not sure what I expected but I was pleasantly surprised.  It was clean, lots of room to spread out so the crowds are so overwhelming, lots of rides, and lifeguards everywhere.  The only negatives would be the food, very poor choices and the cost, its rather pricey.  We will definitely be back... for special occasions.

Laura and I had a great day at nail tek. Janna and Mitu  (unk spelling) were fantastic. They took their time with use even though they were busy. They were so personable it made our visit very memorable. Will definitely be a return customer.

So, I'm a huge sandwich guy.... and this spot hits all the spots. 

The bread.... AMAZING!  It's the foundation of a great sandwich and this bread could possibly be the best bun I've ever had!

The meats... AMAZING!  Fresh, flavorful, loaded (but not too much... the right amount for sure), and serious about what they serve. 

The produce...  AMAZING.  Fresh, crisp, loaded and a great compliment to the meat and that fantastic bread!

Service.... top notch. Fun, friendly and informative!

The establishment....  also AWESOME!  Loved the outdoor seating.

Trust me, I'll be back the next time I'm in town!  Heck, I might grab a sandwich before I leave this weekend.

The bowling was good. They had bumpers for the kids that only come up when it's the kids turn to bowl. The service was slow and the pizza was way over priced. Will come again for the bowling and not for the food

I thought for sure this place would knock it out of the park for me but I left feeling very undecided.

The sandwiches were well made and of good size, the only thing I wish was different about my particular sandwich is the roast beef wasn't med rare, nothing negative, just a personal preference.

With your sandwich, you are offered potato salad, chips or coleslaw. Both my husband and I chose the potato salad. It was very different, at best. It was a dark brown colored potato salad and jam packed with herbs, I think I saw green onions and maybe tasted bacon in it. It maybe would have been OK had the potatoes been cooked, they were pretty raw..  Not your typical potato salad overall but undercooked potatoes was no fun.

The sandwiches were well constructed and like I said, sizeable but in my opinion, pretty bland. Granted, I didn't get anything off the wall but nothing about my sandwich really stood out, very similar to a Firehouse Sub.. Firehouse might actually be better? My husband's was a little bit more tasty than mine. 

The service was part great, part weird. It was all young folks running the show and the girl there was very friendly, greeted us upon walk in, friendly delivery of food to the table. The young man that took our order acted as though he'd been awake approximately one minute before he took our order. 


I'd like to give this place another try, perhaps try a more involved sandwich and soup instead of the interestingly strange potato salad.

I am in Idaho on business from Texas and was so pleasantly surprised to find this place. Everyone is very friendly and professional, the prices are great, and Mickey does a great job. I came in once for a gel manicure, we added some rhinestones and it looks great! The next week I came for a pedicure (mani and rhinestones were still going strong!) and had just as wonderful experience the second time. I highly recommend this place all the way from the great state of Texas!

Been here twice.  The food was really good both times, however, the wait was outrageous.  There was no line the first time but the food still took 20 minutes (3 sandwiches).  On the second trip, we stood in line for over 10 minutes, then 30+ minutes to get the food (again just 3 sandwiches).  If you don't mind waiting a long time, the food is good.  Otherwise, hopefully they are able to speed up their order fulfillment or we won't be back.

Aaaaah.  The quest for the perfect Reuben.  I'd about given up since the Jewish Deli closed in our hometown of Phoenix, AZ.  

By way of background, I need to mention that I am not above sending something back to the kitchen and having them take it off my tab.  Not "fix it", but "take it off!"  (Sorry, I've heard horror stories about sending food back. )  I'm very particular about what I eat, because....heck!!!  If I'm going to cheat on my diet, it had better be SUPREMO!! 

Whenever my husband and I get a hankering for a sandwich, I'm always going somewhere with a Reuben.  You just can't beat a Reuben sandwich.  Since the Jewish Deli closed, my search has been fruitless.  Every single establishment where I've ordered a Reuben, has been greasy, nasty and tasteless.   I'm mean a real dripping, God-awful mess. I hesitate to even call it food.  

Enter Fat Guy's.  Why not???  I mean, could it be any worse than the other's I'd tried??  If I can keep it down, they get one star, which is a better score than I've handed out to date.

OMG!!!!  Let me repeat...OMG!!! This was the most fantastic Reuben I'd ever eaten.  Paralleled the Jewish Deli in Phoenix, which was incredibly hard to do!!  The rye bread was toasted (and dry on the outside!!!!  yay!  No grease!!), and the pastrami, sauerkraut and cheese were sublime.  Honestly....this was the best Reuben ever!!!  I can't remember what my husband ordered (my eyes were rolling back in my head from pure ecstasy), but I know his comment was, "we're coming back here, at LEAST once, when we come back to Idaho next year." 

Thanks Fat Guy's!!!  I've found my new go-to eatery when we retire!!

Kathy & David Schultz
Mesa, AZ

My grandma went into surgery this morning and I wanted an arrangement waiting for her in her room when she got out.  I called up Meridian Floral to put something together for me.  I wanted a cheerful and colorful arrangement.  They did a wonderful mix of daisies, carnations, and other beautiful fillers that really pull it all together.  It is a beautiful arrangement. And, they were able to make it quickly for a fast pick up without sacrificing artistry.  Thank you so much.  I know she will love them.  I highly recommend.  Beth and Natasha were very helpful!

Whenever my family craves thai food we love to enjoy each others company there.  We like to go to happy hour and order a bunch of small plates. All of their dishes are authentic and delicious.  We like when they have a live band too.  It can be a little spendy but worth every penny. Yum!

I thought this place would just be another Denny's/Shari's type of joint, but my first experience ever at a IHOP was pretty darn good. 
The food was excellent. I got the chorizo omelet with pancakes and coffee. Great taste and value. It was good enough that I ended up going back again the next weekend for the same thing. Once again, it was great. I plan on goin' back yet again, sometime in the near future.

Totally disappointing.  We bought "the deal" from one of the online coupon marketers.  It was supposed to cost around $40.00 but ended up costing us $150.00.  The guy cancelled the first time due to a family problem.  He arrived at the second appointment and informed us that we had moisture in our vents.  He said he did not have the equipment to fix the problem.  After he had gone we saw the huge mess he left in the bathroom sink.  The last vent he worked on was in that bathroom and he evidently cleaned his equipment and left a disgusting mess. We also noticed after he had gone, that he had broken a piece off of the vent on the outside of the house.  We didn't use the dryer until a few days later.  When we did, the laundry room quickly  filled with steam, leaving everything wet.  We had purchased a new vent connector from the dryer to the outside vent.  The guy that came said he would just take the old one off and put the new one on.  He didn't bother attaching it to the outside vent, so all the dryer exhaust was simply blowing into the laundry room.  I will never use them again.
I get the Rueben with pastrami instead of the corned beef. Outstanding. I tell myself gotta try something new next time, but can't do it.

I love Roaring Springs! My husband and I come here at least once a year. We don't have kids and are both in our late 20s and this park is super fun on a hot day. 

Ticket prices are a little expensive, so make sure and research beforehand and pick up some discounts before you come. 

The lines can get huge on a hot day which can be discouraging. We usual get there right when the park opens at 11:00 and it's not too bad until 1 or 2 when the lines get huge. If you come on a cooler or overcast day the lines are considerably shorter and crowds are smaller. 

All the rides are fun. Recently they added Corkscrew Cavern. One warning: keep your hands and arms tight against you as the lifeguard shows you the WHOLE way down. My first time on this ride I didn't and ended up with some pretty nasty cuts and burns on my elbows. 

We always eat popcorn chicken and fries and it's always been delicious. Dippin' dots makes our trip complete at the end of a hot day!

Overall it's a great place to come once or twice a year. We don't buy season passes and any more visits than a couple times a year makes it too expensive.

Worst service. Got a plate for two and enough food for one. What is with the carrot lettuce thing.
Owner didn't care. Salsa was not good and we had to wait 10 minutes to get are change after we paid. Not the first time their but it will be the last. Would not recommend to anyone.

I have loved the lashes I walked out with here. I did knock off one star for my initial visit - the tech did not consult me much at all and then started eating chips while doing my lashes? But I switched techs and had great experiences after that!

This was such a good choice for us as we were traveling through the state on our way to Oregon. Not far from a major freeway exit. Burgers were really good and the option of all the different kind of potatoes for the fries was really fun to try. We loved being able to season our own fries with the different kinds salts and variety of dipping sauces. The staff were extremely helpful and even came over to chat with us to see how we liked our food. I would definitely go back!

I love me some Qdoba! The Queso Diablo steak burrito is what I get almost every time, aside from the BBQ pork burrito I suppose, which is also amazing! The cilantro lime rice, 2 scoops of extra spicy salsa. Your choice of beans and tortilla type, guacamole, grilled veggies. So many different combinations. Check it out, portions are generous and you wont be disappointed.

I have been to this Counter location three times and the food is decent but what the service is terrible.  Every time it is so slow and it takes a server forever to acknowledge us.  Our most recent visit was last week.  First off, there was very few people in the restaurant.  We were there about 1:30/2 for a late lunch.  Our server took forever to come to our table for drinks.  My wife ordered a milkshake and he never even got it til he was almost done with his meal.  He also ordered an egg on his burger but they forgot it.  We asked the server to remove the charge from the bill before she even brought it but of course it was still on the bill.  We asked her again to remove it and she didn't and still charged us.  I had purchased two $20 gift cards from through the Idaho Statesman discounted gift card event they had a while back. When I went to redeem them she only redeemed them for $12 each, which is the discounted price I had purchased them for.  I tried to explain that was how the Statesman gift card event worked, that I really had paid for two $20 cards.  She had no idea what I was talking about so safe to say my gift cards went to waste.  If you are going to participate in a discounted gift card program at least educate your employees about how it works.  Very disappointed and will not be back.  Three strikes.
Really love mexican food, and this was the nest! Great service and cheep!

Flat out:   The Counter is not worth the money.  I've been waiting for this to open for months, checking their website often as the open date was pushed back a month at a time, for 3-4 months.  Finally, this past Sunday it opened, and I was able to visit last night, a Wednesday, at 6:30.  First impression is that it's nice inside, but dull.  Nothing on the walls except a couple TVs behind the bar and a chalkboard outlining the beer and wine lists.  The decor looks like it's meant to be classy, but comes off as kind of cheap feeling, but that's not what I was here for.  

The server, a young man named Jordan, was nice, attentive, maybe a little too much.  I am perfectly capable of checking the boxes on the build your own burger sheet, without the need for him to double check with me about my selections, or lack of, in the case of the sauces.  I also don't need constant reminders that my food is not yet done, but will be shortly.  Keep my drink filled, bring my food when it's ready, that's all the service I really need!

I ordered a 1/3 pound burger, with provolone cheese, spinach, sauteed mushrooms, and premium applewood smoked bacon on a Hawaiian bun, with a side of shoestring fries.  The burger was cooked perfectly, as was my friend's burger.  However, that's where my praise for The Counter's food ends.  The layer of spinach was so thin, it was basically just a layer of green on the bottom bun, not enough to be crispy.  Good thing I didn't pay extra for it!  I did pay $1 extra for both the premium applewood smoked bacon and the sauteed mushrooms.  Not only was the bacon decidedly NOT premium, I don't think I could be convinced that it's not pre-cooked bacon you can buy in any grocery store.  2 THIN, sad little strips on each of our burgers.  The mushrooms were nothing special.  I wouldn't say they came from a can, but they weren't much better than that.  The provolone was flavorless, which was a step up from the Hawaiian bun.  I seriously considered sending my burger back b/c they'd brought the wrong bun, but didn't want to wait 20 more minutes.  However, when I really paid attention, I think I noticed a very faint hint of sweetness from the bun, so maybe this is their Hawaiian.  Or maybe it was my mind trying to convince me, I can't be sure.

Like everything at The Counter, the fries seemed generic.  There are so many places in town that serve fresh cut, delicious french fries, included with their burgers, but at The Counter, you pay an extra $2.50 for the privelege of eating a tiny amount of shoestring fries.  Again, I doubt you could convince me these aren't frozen, grocery store fries.  I'm not a child, give me some real fries!  

When the bill came, the damage was over $35 for 2 burgers, one side of fries and one side of onion rings, and 2 sodas.  My half of the bill:  1/3 lb burger ($9.50), bacon (+$1), mushrooms (+$1), side fries (+$2.50), diet coke ($2.75).  With tax, my burger with fries and a coke was $18.29, and after a $4 tip for Jordan, I paid $22 and change for a most generic burger.  

As a disclaimer, my ratings take into account price, food quality, type of restaurant, etc.  Had I paid $10 for this meal, I'd have been perfectly fine with it, but $22?!  No chance.  

After we finished, we were sitting out in the courtyard of the Village and a man and girl came up and gave us a flier and asked if we'd ever heard of The Counter.  Upon hearing we'd just eaten there, he asked our experience, to which we told him many of the things I've just written here.  He started to get defensive (owner maybe?), and then gave up and walked off, clearly not taking any of our feedback into account.  Hopefully I'm wrong about that, and they'll right their wrongs, because the idea of the build yourself burger is great!  The need to provide the premium toppings they boast about, and not cheap, generic toppings at premium prices.  

I doubt I'll ever return to The Counter.  There are too many good places to get a burger, at a much better price.

A+. Always great service and drinks at this Dutch Bros!! Went today and there was a bit of a line on both sides, but we ended up getting our drinks in less then 5 minutes. One time we pulled up and the power was out, so we said we'd hit the one near RMHS and they gave us a free drink card! Awesome staff!
This is such great food and the atmoshere is awesome...price isnt bad either for the amount of food you get...recommendation. ...have some carrot cake

Went there at 7am to watch an English soccer game. Ask for the tv to turned up( they said no problem) it never happened. Ordered pancakes (ok). They handed me the bill b4 the first half of the match was over and said whenever ur ready. There was still another 45mins to go. I was the only one there. Kept asking if I was ready. The way I see it, I'll ask for the bill when I'm ready. Also I went there after work one day for a beer. Sat at the bar for 10mins, b4 the barman finished his conversation with someone, to get served.

Recently moved to Meridian, Idaho about a month ago and i really didn't know the area to much or know of any nail salons that took pride in their work. I took a chance and went to the closest spot to me and Rosa took really good care of me. She knew what I wanted right off the back and she took her time(which I like). This is now my new nail spot :))

Was not a very pleasant experience, and if I'd spent the same amount of money I would have a much higher quality meal, more food, and a better experience at a competitors restaurant.  I honestly will not bother visiting again.

Gotta say its a pretty good place. Had the double char burger with onion rings and the tempura green beans. Also tried the santa barbara char and that was good as well. Been there a few times and will be going back.

Went there as a it was suggested to be a good place to buy a mattress. Found the mattress department. First guy said hello and that he'd be back. Waited 10 minutes. First woman came up, rattled off a few prices and left without saying another thing. 10 minutes later, another woman came in, looks at us and then started helping a couple who had just come in. Ten minutes later we started to leave. They must have been bored then because they asked to help. I told them we had waited a half hour and it was too late. Went to Mattress Firm, got great service and walked out having bought a $400 mattress. Stay away from Meridian Home Furnishings, lousy

The best part about this place is the pepper station! Seriously. They have an entire station dedicated to hot peppers!!! I was able to pile as many jalapenos and banana peppers on there as I pleased. 

With that being said, the rest of the food was pretty underwhelming. I heard so much about it, but it just wasn't excellent. I had the chicken sandwich, but I felt like it was lacking something. My kids enjoyed the veggie burgers, though.

Best Thai food in the valley. The northern focus is well appreciated and executed with khao soi (which is hard to find in Idaho). The larb, som tom, tom kha gai and pad see ew are the best around.

The service is stellar my drink never went empty and the staff is so nice! In spite of the location the ambiance is stellar.

Definitely worth the trip to Meridian.

I was craving a burger, but didn't want to pay more than $10+ for it which was the going rate on the menus we checked out as we were out running errands on Saturday.  Stopped by Denny's and there was a 20-minute wait. As I was looking for places online, I noticed the IHOP listing said $6.99 burger.  Could that be true?  With unlimited fries.  Oh reallllly?  So I called them before heading over.  Talked to Brandon, asked him if they had this $6.99 burger with unlimited fries and he said yes - PLUS unlimited drink.  Say what?!  How long is the wait, Brandon?  You'll have your food in 10 minutes.  Vrooooom!  We're there.  The place was packed, but we got a table no problem.  And Brandon ended up being our server.  We ordered the cheeseburger, unlimited fries, unlimited drink deal for $6.99 deal.  S C O R E  The burger was the Classic: truly a classic burger. American cheese, lettuce, tomato, red onion, pickles and our signature IHOP® sauce.  (Not wet enough for my taste, so I asked for mayo.)  Fries similar to McDonald's fries - with fresh hot fries brought soon after you requested more.  And soda refills (Pepsi products).  Our server, Brandon, was super good, attentive, and the manager came around a couple of times to make sure we were taken care of.  I saw him pouring water at another table.  It's IHOP, so it's not gourmet, but good food, good value, and good service.  Ain't nothin' wrong with that.

the food has been good. I'm giving 3 instead of four because of the restaurant. When I visited, it smelled of weird chemicals.. very off putting. Additionally, Ive ordered to go and they have left out items. BUT the food tastes really good!

Have gone twice now and service has been great along with the food. It's our new burger place! 
The milkshakes are to die for! We will definitely be going again.

by far the worst Italian I have ever had...also some not so great service...we had the Alfredo, ravioli and fries...the fries were the best part actually...the ravioli and Alfredo were overly greasy and reminiscent of some sort of microwave pasta...also no flavor!..I would call this Italian fast food...the kid taking our order couldn't help with questions we had on the menu...we had a restaurant certificate and he had trouble figuring out how to use it... they don't bring your food to you it's more like McDonald's where you wait and take your trays for food...soon after he took our order some of his friends came in and loitered and then he left with them and the cook had to cover the register...the location is the only plus...huge plate glass looking out on to the fire place, fountain and playground...I will NEVER go hear again...thy should be charging much less for what you are actually getting.....

Don't get a seat inside if you don't want to be bombarded by sports, sports, sports and more sports.  There are more TVs than servers, to be sure.

I went again recently and sat outdoors by the river, which is quite lovely, actually, and a delightful switch from the plague of TVs indoors.

Alas, the service was slow and the food mediocre.  I got the Thai salad which was swimming in so much dressing it made the iceberg lettuce (misleadingly termed "greens" on the menu) soggy.

Not recommended, except maybe for the beers.

They did an excellent job detailing the inside of my 13 year old SUV. Feels fresh and clean now :) A little expensive ($170), but the did a full day's work on it, and it's so much more effective than this $60 "detailing" shops. Nice people, too :) I will definitely be sending more people their way.

I did not know what to expect. I had a 10-year-old truck that had never been fully cleaned inside, and I have a four-year-old daughter, so things were a little bit dirty. Muriel was amazing. The detailsShe was able to do is shocking. I will absolutely refer people to the shop and I know I will take my cars there in the future.

I ran over my phone with my jeep this morning and I thought it was this phone's last day. I brought it in and Pete fixed it to brand new condition in less than 20 minutes. He was super nice and I'm so happy to have my phone back working so fast. Thank you Rockstar! Best $108 I ever spent. Definitely my new go to for electronics repair.

These boys over there were very knowledgeable, they were efficient, quick, and reasonably priced. I would recommend them anytime. Having had Apple problems in the past, used different outfits. This particular group of young men surpass anything I have had done locally in the past.
The food was alright, needed more flavor, the curry tasted watered down, the service was slow, we waited for a while to be seated down, pad Thai was OK, overall an alright place.
They factory reset my sons tablet.   Very reasonable priced and they got it done in an hour.  Great job guys!!!!!

I don't know why I even bothered giving this place another chance. The drive through too a half hour. Then when we finally got to the window, I watched the server feed a dog treat to the dog in the car in front of us. He then handed us out food without washing his hands. Never again.
We had a good enough time but it seems more geared towards children and that's cool. I recommend Dave and busters for adult arcade time. But I you have children it's a better place to go.

What a friendly staff!  Amazing continental breakfast!  (Better than any I've had.  If others' breakfasts are "continental," Mr. Sandman's is more like a "global" breakfast!)

Special kudos and thanks to "Brooky" the front desk clerk who went out of her way to look up and print special directions for us to go and see the World Center for Birds of Prey.  (Highly recommended while you're in Boise.)

We ordered and paid for our pizza for a family gathering. Thirty minutes later received an email, not a text or call, that our order was canceled and that our money would be refunded 3-5 days. I tried calling, no one answered, and the voicemail box was full.  This is very unprofessional!

Woweedoodeedoodaday!
A burger...perfectly seasoned....done med rare...Fer under 6 bucks? Ya bet cha....

Seriously...real deal Holyfield here. Ronald McDonald can kiss my ass!

Kylee and Kristen are the badmammajammas of fried potato perfection. 

Thanks for the Laura fries enlightenment. ..

Rock out with your BFC out...!

Out....

Pleasant surprise!!!!! The bbq chicken salad was very good. But the tempura green beans! Oh my! Those are a MUST have!!!! Switch out the fries and get ready for an explosion of flavor! Yum! Also, the staff was extremely friendly, and the place was clean!

This sandwich shop was a real find. We had some of the best sandwiches for lunch today. All three sandwiches we tried were very fresh, very tasty,  and nicely sized. Very friendly owner and a nice staff makes for an enjoyable experience. The Cuban sandwich was my favorite.

Get papa Johns if u wanna go cheep
Or buy a frozen pizza beter than this place
What else can u say..

Tater tasters paradise. Boise Fry Company offers up a rainbow of tubers to try along with some yummy sandwiches.  I enjoyed the self serve seasoning bar, it's more than a bit uncommon.
Give this place a go.

I love my nails! After surgery, my natural nails just got weak, so I looked up salons near me. I went here based on other reviews, and was not disappointed!  I'm really picky when it comes to acrylics, which is why I normally get shellac. The ladies in this salon were very friendly, teaching a newer employee how to do more complicated nails. They encouraged me to ask for whatever I wanted, bring in pictures,  etc, so I could always have my dream nails. I wanted something delicate, but still a statement nail. I give them 4 stars because after I for home I noticed that one hand was slightly (I'm talking millimeters here) longer than the other, and I am quite particular. All in all, the prices are appropriate based on the work (being from Seattle,  this was cheap at $50!), and I enjoyed the ambiance. I'll be back!

I want to like this place, I really do. We came here tonight ready to drop some money on happy hour - but our waitress wasn't with the program. There were only two other tables occupied. First she forgets my glass of wine, and I had to go the bartender and ask for it. After the first round my husband wanted another drink, but our server never showed back up. When she finally checked on us (20 minutes?)? we asked for the check. The wine was nice (Argentinean Malbec), and the poutine was good, but the service was lousy.
F$*kin BOMB! The staff is so nice. Pizza is amazing. Prices are reasonable. Will most definitely be back.

We were in a rush last night, and needed to grab some food fast.  But, since we typically don't like going to chain fast-food places, our choices in our part of Meridian are limited.  Well, Qdoba fits the bill fine (even though it is a chain).  The food is pretty good for fast-food Mexican dishes like burritos and such.  The service there was great, as the ladies at the counter were friendly.  The place is clean, and a great place for families.  Anyway, if you are in a rush, and want an alternative to Taco Bell or McDonalds, Qdoba might be a good choice for you.

[ People are making apocalypse jokes like there's no tomorrow. ]

pretty amazing thai food!  Prices are a little spendy for Idaho, but there isn't a lot of other options here.  The sushi is pretty good too.  I've never had a curry dish I didn't enjoy.  Still trying to find that hole in the wall thai restaurant that has curry for 7 bucks, but til then, I'll stick with Sa-Wa-Dee, my family has been eating here for over a decade.

First time coming in and the service and food was great. I got the beef burger with their feature toppings (barbecue), hubby got the beef burger (heat), and a grilled cheese for the kid. All of it was delicious. Oh and we got fries as well, I'm not sure what kind they were actually but they were good as well. They have a ton of options for what kind of fries and many different sauces to choose from. 
Very pleased with this place thus far.

I live in CA and was worried about my family there. They were sick and I wanted them to have soup and some food for a few days.  I called and asked if these guys could help me do that even though it wasn't a normal thing delivering small orders. The guy on the phone Era and forgive me if I am spelling that wrong. He was so helpful and said he would take the food to them it was on his way home. I can't say enough how thankful I am and what above and beyond customer service that is. My family loved the food and we're so grateful to not have to try and get out when they have been so sick. Thank you Kneaders for keeping it community and thank you Era for being so helpful.

Stayed here on 7/24/2014. Arrived late. Beautiful, clean room. Nice staff. Pool was open all night., kids thrilled. Pool smelled like chlorine which indicates there is not enough chlorine in the pool and it is off gassing. PH was probably off. Decent breakfast with great staff... Definitely stay there again.

Will never eat sushi at this place again, EVER!!!!! I ordered a tuna roll and a yellowtail roll, the tuna was not even close to the dark red color you would look for, the taste was horrible. The yellowtail was far worse, it tasted very fishy and made my skin crawl. Avoid at all cost!!!!

Probably the best deli sandwiches in the valley. I have searched around for a place that does not skim on the meat or too much bread. I have found bliss here. Their pastrami is the bomb. Their Ruben is perfect, the right amount of sauce, Kraut, and meat on rye bread. Every sandwich I have tried has been the best, no disappointments yet and I do not foresee it happening soon.

This is one of my favorite places to eat!  Awesome gluten free selection!  We love their milkshakes, fries, and of course their burgers!  The grilled cheese and chili are great too!

The booths are comfortable too. 

You can get beef, chicken, bison or other burgers here. They even have vegan items. We appreciate the selection!  I've always had awesome service as well. Today was great!

White Water Pizza moved next to Buffalo Wild WIngs in Meridian and their food is great as it ever was.  The owner should spend some money and let  people know that they have moved and are NOT out of business.
best donuts ever! I just moved here and been looking for a donut place. I found DK and decided to try them. I'm very happy with them and will continue coming back since it's worth a 12 mile drive

I've given this place a couple tries but this last one was my last. On top of lousy service again, my chicken in my pad thai tasted boiled or old. It had an awkward chewy taste that made me real nervous I spit few pieces out and had to leave in fear I would be sick. Never again for me I'm afraid.
First time trying Big Star, Fantastic customer service! The girls working are great too!

I will never ever go to another sandwich shop ever again after having a Meatball Sandwich at Fat Guys. Soups...amazing...cookie...amazing. I will now begin to plan out my lunches around Fat Guys Menu. Seriously...Chef Wally, thank you for opening up your sandwich shop!
Greasy comfort food type barbecue and free ice cream cones. What's not to like, in moderation?

Started out our 2018 New Year right by getting piercings with the delightful Dan! From initial contact with the owner Paul via Yelp messages to the entire experience while in the shop- the atmosphere and service level provided is exceptional. I had a beautiful tragus piercing done, my 16 year old niece got second holes done in her lobes, and my spunky 75 year old Mom got her ears re-pierced after having her old hole tear through. The store is clean and you can tell they are real professionals in their craft- and as a RN I've got quite high standards for things like that. They are warm, welcoming and honest with everyone- not like some of the "too cool for you" places I've seen. 
The jewlery selection is varied and fun to choose from depending on your style and piercing of choice. They can be quite busy so I'd definitely suggest making an appointment. Long story short- if you're in the Boise area and looking for a quality piercing experience look no further. 
PS- for a bonus treat check out their outgoing message on the voicemail. They had me at hello

Had a long day at work, and decided to stop in late tonight for dinner. Was greeted promptly by Said. From the moment I walked in to the moment I left both Said and the other male waiter ensured it was a pleasant experience.  

The food speaks for itself, as I enjoyed an order of the fresh rolls, and spicy cashew nut with chicken. Very delightful presentation,  and the taste was phenomenonal.

So why 3 stars? Well I'll start off by saying the fries were great! I loved them to the last bite. The service was also great and very friendly. The thing is I didn't really like the burger, it wasn't good but it wasn't bad. I personally wouldn't go back there for the burgers. I also tried the Root Beer they make there and was gravely disappointed when I tried it, it tasted like normal root beer at first but then the after taste hits and it taste like Colgate mouth rinse, so unless you like a minty root beer I wouldn't go for it. But! I would definitely go back there for the fries!

Whitewater pizza and pasta is a disappointment if not just bad in general. I am not sure exactly on the history but I believe this used to be McKenzie River pizza before an ownership split and the better half didn't stay in business. 

The pizza here has changed over time but never enough to make me say yummy. They do offer a wide selection of pizzas, salads, and sandwiches. Their menu ideas are intriguing and sound delicious but every time I have left disappointed. 

The tortilla chips, a simple item, were more stale than I could have ever imagined a  tortilla chip to be. I also received horrible service during a slow lunch. Not impressed.

Awesome place for fries and burgers. Six different potatoes to choose from. The "duck fat and truffle salt" variety was amazing! 10 different ketchup styles and 8 different seasonings. Beef, bison, or veggie patties to choose from. There's also local craft beer on tap. This is truly an Idaho experience! Kristin who worked the counter was very friendly and helpful in explaining the choices, and very sweet too.

When we bought our home, it had no lawn. We had to start from scratch on ALL landscaping. 13 months later we have a beautiful, green and healthy lawn and we are so happy. Zamzows has helped our lawn a ton. Their products are amazing, well worth the cost. Highly recommended.

I have enjoyed dining at the Ram for years. Great beer and better than average bar food. My most recent visit was quite disappointing. Myself and a few friends went to grab a bite to eat and a beer and watch the UFC fights that were on Fox. When asking if we could have the fights turned on one of the televisions, we were told that they were not allowed to show the UFC fights because of the violence and that they were a family restaurant. We were also informed that they cannot show rodeo at the Ram. 

Being a former college wrestler and former amateur MMA fighter, I was actually offended. This argument of the danger of UFC has been studied multiple times and it has actually been proven to be less dangerous for the athletes than boxing and football, according to the American Journal of Sports Medicine, but what do they know, right?! 

This is a sport and the Ram fancies themselves a sports bar. They are a brewery for goodness sake. Last time I checked, alcohol is a very dangerous drug contributing to 88,000 deaths per year. Yet, they are a family restaurant. How asinine is that? I quickly closed my tab and will never go back.

Traveling through and needed a stop for lunch. Found this place on Yelp with good ratings so we stopped in for a burger. Their slogan is "Burger on the side." That was dead on because I loved their fries and the variety of sauces. We both got their burger combo and I had the original toppings which had pickled onions, garlic aioli, lettuce. The burger was moist and delicious too. 

We ended up ordering the bourgeoise fries too because it's fried in duck fat (yummy), drizzled with truffle oil, and sea salt. 

The staff was friendly and food came up quickly. We found out from the staff that their is a location in Portland, OR (where we are from) and we are looking forward to going there when we get home. 

My fiancé liked this place so much that he bought one of their clever shirts. "Powered by Potatoes!"

We stayed here last Thanksgiving because it was so inexpensive on Priceline. I should have paid attention to the reviews. I have never seen bed bugs before but a quick internet search of the bugs found under the pillow then under the mattress confirmed they were bed bugs.
Spent a couple hours washing everything (since we had already unpacked). They did give us another room but this year we will not be staying there.

Fat Guys missed out tonight. My wife and I had a craving for a sandwich and soup, so we thought FGD would be a good option. Well, prior to driving down over I figured I would call and ask about  their soup of the day. A young man answered the phone so fast that he sounded like an auctioneer, but I did decipher it as basically "hold please." I patiently waited on hold for ten minutes. My patience ran out so I hung up and re-dialed, but this time they didn't answer. As I stated earlier, we wanted a sandwich and soup, so we went to another location off Eagle Road...I must add this place was pretty good. Now the only thing I need to decide is whether I will give FGD another shot - we will see.

Ladies in store are nice enough but quality of items not so great.  I bought a headboard and when it was delivered he would not assemble it even though I asked. I'm a single mom who could have used the help.  I had to put it together myself and it was a disaster.  Box spring had a hole in it upon delivery as well. When I called she did offer to send someone out but by that time I was done. Wasn't worth the money I spent and will probably get another bed at RC Wiley or Mor and just eat the $400 I spent at this place. 
My sister also bought a couch there and the delivery guy just showed up at her door, never called or warned her. She was at work but our mother was home and not knowing, let him put it in her garage.  Must have been same delivery guy as mine because he never offered to bring it into the house or even take the plastic off. When my sister did get a chance to get plastic off, it had a huge hole in the back and the wood was sticking out. She called and let them know.....that was over a month ago and she's still waiting for a replacement.  Their delivery men are lazy.

Our favorite place for AUTHENTIC Mexican food! 
The owner is always there to greet us with a smile
They were on time, they were friendly and nice, the price was a fixed amount specified in advance on the phone, and they got me to the airport with plenty of time to spare. What more do you need...

I have been a regular here for almost 2 years. Nearly every time I go, I am highly impressed with the results. There were a couple of employees that were questionable as far as quality and cleanliness of their tools as well as my nails. However, I believe they are no longer employed here..and for the past year, my nails have consistently been perfect and just what I ask for. I appreciate all you wonderful people, thank you!

Amazing burger!!!  And that is coming from a person who generally is blah about burgers.  Can't stop thinking about going back!!!  I had a Charburger with cheese and the tempura green beans.   Others in my party had double Chars with cheese, fries and a side salad.   Nothing but raves around the table.   Fry sauce and ranch were great.  You can also get peppers, pepperoncinis, or jalapeños from the little pepper bar to add to your burgers.  We all walked out with happy bellies and counting down until we go back.  Yaay for The Habit!!

They had a great deal. $50 for 2games, and shoes for 4 people and a $20 game card. That is less than $3.00 a game when you factor it all together. The reason they only go 2 stars! We ordered about $150 worth of beer and food. No one wanted to eat the BBQ chicken pizza. Not even the kids. I find myself trying to eat the leftovers for lunch the next day. :( The BBQ sauce is horrible and the chicken is dry.

They start with a good frame.  Seasonal and creative menu, farm to table ingredients, fair prices, friendly staff, funky yet inviting minimalist design interior and a small patio in front.  Plus they are open straight through from lunch through dinner providing option in Meridian for something other than the increasing bloat in number of formula-food chain restaurants.  

But there is wood to chop here to get this right for consistency in food and training of servers.  

Based on two visits, the first much better than the second, my husband and I are cautiously optimistic.  The owner owns another restaurant in Boise so he must have the tools to build this right.  Time will tell.  

MENU
Before 5 options are on the front and after 5 options are on the back. Although they have advertise happy hour, on our dinner visit which was early enough to be in the pocket of happy hour, there were no happy hour food items, only something off libations.

I took photos of a menu to post with this review so I won't detail options or prices.  Both are subject to quick change as Grants fine tunes what sells and what doesn't.  As example, between our first visit and our second, only about 10 days apart, they had reduced some of the prices on the menu.  They had also removed some menu items given they found they didn't sell. 

The good news is the owner is nimble in making menu adjustments to meet the preferences of local diners.   We understand the menu will be reprinted / updated about every two months.  That is a great sign of focus on seasonal ingredients. 

FOOD
First visit we started with tempura fried green beans.  Perfectly cooked, great tempura coating and they came with three luscious dipping sauces.  We also ordered a housemade veggie burger to follow.  It came on a pretzel roll and although the 'burger' was a bit soft and messy to eat the flavors were great.  (A tip, ask them to leave the mayo off the 'burger' and use any of the dipping sauces on it.)

The 'burger' came with fries and we asked to have them held given we were starting with fried green beans.  We were not offered an alternate and the 'burger' came plopped in the middle of a nude plate.  Presentation is important.

Dinner was less successful for food.  We ordered from the small plates menu and chose braised pork belly with apple / parsnip puree (although that doesn't sound so seasonal for hot summer fare it was still good) and roasted asparagus with parmesan that came with salad greens.  We expected the asparagus to be parmesan dusted but it was wrapped in the melted cheese, far too heavy and made the salad greens uber limp.  

Dessert at lunch was icebox goat "cheesecake" with berry gelee.  Dinner was flourless chocolate cake with whipped goat cheese.  Good flavors but the cake was overbaked.

SERVICE
Lunch server, Sarah, was gracious, professional and got the service elements just right for delivering share plates, pacing the food, keeping water filled and checking in with us when needed.   The service is part of what made us feel so good about the first experience.  

Dinner service was friendly but less polished.  Although we said we would share the dishes and asked our server to bring share plates when we ordered,  one item was set in front of one of us and one in front of the other as if entrees.   We asked for share plates again.  Our server seemed surprised, as if hearing it for the first time.  And although we weren't finished eating, our server tried to remove our plates and asked if we'd like dessert.  Water was never filled.  She didn't check in with us after food delivery. Very friendly but training needed.

LIBATIONS
Very limited and plebian wine list.  Full bar.  Probably a stick to the basics as best here.  They were still awaiting their French Press pots on our visits.  Good news coffee will be that mode when added.

VIBE
They've done a great job of making this welcoming on a budget.  See photos.  Unpretentious, neighborhood, "all are welcome" feel.  Tables are far enough apart that you don't feel like a sardine in a can.  Yahoo for that!  And the majority of the seating is at standard height tables.  More thumbs up.  But there is seating for maybe 30 diners max in this space. There is a garage type door that can open to the outside to a small deck / patio with additional seating.  On both visits this was closed due to the uber temperatures and only one couple was brave enough to take on the outside inferno.  I can't imagine how they'll be able to turn enough meals in this small space to make the revenue numbers work.

THIS N THAT:

1) PARKING:  In the lot associated with the small strip mall where this is located.

2) ACCESSIBILITY:  A couple of spaces of accessible parking.  Level in the restaurant and throughout.  Standard height tables.  Loo is accessible but may be tough for path of travel given layout fails 36" clear path ADA rules.

3) NEIGHBORS: Nail salon and pet store are next door neighbors..

I really liked this place.  My husband and I did dinner before a movie here and definitely got what we paid for.  We both ordered the burger cobb salad (not sure of the exact name).  It was really good!  It was brought out pretty quick considering how busy it was.  I really enjoyed the atmosphere and my husband enjoyed the sports.  Great place for burgers.

Super slow service. Food was so-so. but food poisoning and spent the night in the bathroom was not a very pleasant time. What happened to the great restaurant that was at Eagle and Fairview? You moved and left everything that was good about your establishment behind. (service, quality of food that wont sicken people, staff that actually cares about your business) Will never go back.

Very cool atmosphere and good food.  The manager honored the coupon on yelp even though he was unaware of it.  Came over and personally talked to us about it.  Great service, even better food.  Definitely worth a stop if you are nearby!!!
The worst all around, not only did the food taste like it was boiled in taco seasoning, the customer service was horrible. Unprofessional and not worth a second chance!

Oh My golly gee... I absolutely love green curry and this one almost brought me to tears... 

We just moved here from Idaho Falls, and I know, I know can there be good Thai in Idaho Falls?  Well, yes there was (Origonal Thai 2).  

Do I love (and I mean LOVE), Thai... Yep.  Sa-Wa-Dee was wonderful.  The green curry was so yummy it took all I had not to lick the bowl. 

I have read a few reviews that were negative saying that they used frozen peas and carrots... Well, my dinner was fabulous.  There were peas, and they were absolutely freshly shelled, and carrots.  The carrots were tiny cubes so I cannot verfiy fresh of frozen, but there was an abundance of fresh basil, lots of eggplant, and almost too much sliced chicken breast!

It gave you that wonderful back burn in your throat.  It let you know that you were truly going to enjoy your meal.  Sweet, spicy, and just what I needed after a traumatic move.

Will I return?  Of course.  When?  Soon to sample some of their sushi.  (Sushi at a thai resturant?  I'll give it a whirl:) ).  

Oh, did I mention that everyone was beyond nice.  Beyond helpful, and a pleasure to speak to?  Well I hope I just did.

I love this place, and I hope you will too!!!!

Good food and great employees. I regularly get the Smokehouse salad and it is always wonderful, sometimes they forget the roll but lately they have been spot on. Love the tanglers on the salad. I usually order 2 salads when I'm in, one for today and the second for tomorrow.

They also now carry Dickeys BBQ rub. Used this on a home cooked brisket, delicious! 

BBQ sauce also available.

We stopped here on our way through Idaho because we've heard good things about this place. Sadly, it didn't live up to the hype... Staff was friendly, food came out quick, but the burger was way overpriced and the fries were nothing special.

The only good part of this experience was the different sauces and seasonings that were available.

Had my first bad experience here today. Super slow service, forgot part of my order and was 33 bucks for just my son and I. Was not impressed this time and I had been looking forward to eating here again for a while.
Excellent service. I believe my tech 's name is Ha? Absolutely fantastic job. One of the best ever. Friendly service, for a walk-in, and great attention to detail. I'll definitely be back!

We have eaten here for many years and love everything we've ever eaten - enjoy!!  The menu is huge and you can always find something you're in the mood for.  (Save room for the sticky mango rice coconut dessert!)

I do like the food for the most part, although pricey. I stopped in yesterday and ordered a sandwich to go. I headed in to the ladies restroom while waiting and it was disgusting!  Given this place had only been open 90 minutes, it wasn't due to a busy lunch and as they say in the biz, if the manager doesn't care about the restrooms where the customers see, it's likely the kitchen isn't much better. 
The return air vent had grime and dust as thick as my pointer finger. The walls around the edges and clear up had never been cleaned I'm sure since they opened 2 years ago. 
As I stood by the register waiting I looked around and noticed the return air vent and ceiling had a trail of black grime so thick it was hanging. One of these two vents was above where the food sat for pick-up! The whole place was filthy everywhere I looked. I had already paid for my food but there was no way I could choke it down after seeing this. I can't even imagine what was behind the counter into that kitchen! Has an inspector EVER been here because there is no way this place has seen a scrub brush in 2 years. GROSS!!!
Very good fresh food with tons of flavor! The owner and cook are very friendly and make you feel like a "norm" Highly recommend going there. I know we will definitely be going back
Just left this place. What an awesome owner/operator! Gave us samples of his homemade soups which were delicious! Very friendly! Will definitely be back!

Its not quite a 5 star hotel but for a "cheaper" hotel it is a LOT better then the average hotels. It costed $74 for a day and I stayed for two nights. 
The front counter people were alright, there was only one guy who was actually fairly nice (the other three I saw was alright but they didn't look happy at all.)
The pillows was my favorite part, it was very comfy and fluffy. The beds were kind of stiff but it was alright. I also got a double bed instead of single since they were out. It was very nice that I got both a refrigerator and a microwave. The Tv was a little bit annoying because it had a lot of statics. The bathroom is fairly small though. You could probably only have two people total in it and not even be able to move. I do also love the fact they had hash browns and cheese with ham omelets. That was a first time for me! Most average cheap hotels only offer the normal cereal, juice and coffee. They also had those but with the omelets, waffles, yogurt, and fruits. 
The wifi was fine on the phone but kept freaking out on the computers.
I will be coming back again next time I go to Boise.

This place could be amazing, but my experience wasn't. Highlights: The beer selection isn't huge but definitely hits the mark with some awesome local selections, the milkshakes are really good, location and decor are great and the pricing isn't bad. However, the food missed the mark. It wasn't super busy when we went but it still took a fairly long time to get our food. I had ordered a burger bowl and it was obvious that the burger was overdone and had sat for quite some time, I was super disappointed as the salad part was fresh. My dish wasn't the only one in our group that had obviously been sitting. Really wanted to love this place and I think it could be a really amazing restaurant. 

For what it's worth I'd give it another try.

My husband and I were excited to try this place because of all the good reviews we read. However, we were very disappointed. The food is not good. He had seafood burrito that was very salty and tasted like it came out of a can. There was nothing special about my chicken tacos. Super generic and bland. 
The staff was VERY friendly. We brought our toddler and they didn't seem annoyed when he was walking around the tables.

Came here for lunch and this place just unraveled for me. Never again on my dime.

Ordered a panang curry - it was watery, the chicken tasted like metallic dishwater and the veggies were literally a frozen pea and carrot melange. Scooped out the chicken (I really tried to eat it - hoping the curry would cover the taste of cheap meat, but alas) and tried the curry vegetarian style before deciding it was a good time to fast.

Ordered a jasmine tea to help soften my disappointment, but that too tasted like hot tap water. The alleged "jasmine tea" bag I was given didn't even smell faintly of jasmine. Not even of green tea.
It just smelled like tea bag. Bag smell. Thinking maybe my senses were confused I asked my husband to sniff test and he confirmed. It was without the signature jasmine scent. Curious and curiouser.

Two stars because husband was happy enough with his meal and because the service was and always is friendly. I know some people are just nuts for this place. I personally don't get the hype. I much prefer the curries of Thai Cuisine.
Great happy hour deals.  The pretzel bites and beer cheese is a favorite for sure.  Sit at the bar, the bartender, David is awesome.

The greeters and cashiers are all very nice. The only thing I can really complain about  while shopping is all of the people with the giant carts who are EVERYWHERE shopping for the online customers. I can never catch a break they are literally always in front of whatever product I need blocking the aisles.

But here's what really seals the deal-If you ever need to go to the Customer Service desk any good experience you have had here will be ultimately diminished by the attitude of the older woman with short dark hair behind the counter. She is awful, rude, and has no business in customer service at all. I have written to management about my issue, as its way too long to write in here.
I'm sticking to Albertsons and Target for now on. This place doesn't deserve my money.

We went here once hoping for a quick dinner after a long drive. So much for quick - and whether we got "dinner" is questionable. Like some reviewers have said, the wait is pretty atrocious - we stood in line (with a hungry toddler) for 20 minutes, then waited 20 more (with a hungrier toddler) for our food. 

The atmosphere could use some work, too - the whole place smelled like eggs (though I was in my first trimester at the time, so I'll admit I probably had some "super smelling" happening). It's hard to turn around in with the knick-knacks everywhere - which wouldn't be a problem if they were better organized and you didn't have to wait so long.

The food itself was subpar - my sandwich was greasy and my husband said his chicken tasted "off." The bright spot was the dessert - a fruit tart that was pretty great (although nothing you couldn't get at any other bakery).

I was hoping to love this place, but I think the Treasure Valley could definitely use a Panera instead - at least their quality is consistent.

I just moved here a few weeks ago from WA and was looking for a good place to get my nails done. After reading multiple Yelp reviews on various places I decided on this salon. SOOO happy that I did!! I did call beforehand to see if I could get in since they seemed very popular. They got me in the following day and I was greeted politely and asked what typed if mani pedi I would like. I had chosen to get a regular pedi and a shellac mani both with French tips. Yuki was my technician for the service and she was incredibly warm, welcoming and VERY detail oriented of which I appreciated greatly! Everyone seemed to be in good spirits and friendly and there was very little banter going on in other languages which I find to be rare and refreshing. Yuki had to look up what a butterfly was as I asked for that design on my ring fingers. After looking it up she freehanded it and it's adorable! The prices are reasonable for the quality and time they put into their work. I will definitely be going back in the future!!

These flavor combos are so delicious! The food is reasonably priced, the tacos are stuffed wonderfully, and the speed of receiving the food is quick. The churros were also awesome! So much cinnamon sugar  highly recommend this place for low cost, high taste!

My brother and I were hanging out and he suggested we go to Fat Guy's for dinner. Initially I was a little hesitant (see previous review), but when the words "my treat" were uttered, I couldn't say no. I am so glad that "free" is music to my ears, because the sandwich this time around was way better than before.
