I listened to my own advice - different bread (wheat), ask for extra spreads, chips as a side and oh my gosh - it was such a delicious sandwich! The girl at the counter also asked me if I wanted my sandwich heated up and I went for it - the extra crunch was nice and the melted cheese helped keep the sandwich a little more together (although I still did end up making a big mess...thank goodness for to-go!). After this experience, I would definitely come back (even if I had to pay ^_^) as the sandwich and chips were able to easily make two filling meals, and tasty ones at that.

Okay, so I've tried this place a few times, have resisted reviewing because everyone I talk to always has good things to say...after a few times though, I'm ready to call it with 2 stars...

Food today was OK at best...started with the fried spring rolls. They were greasy and lukewarm at best...not very appetizing at all.

I got Pad See Ew with chicken. First off, I don't think noodle dishes are suppose to come with rice so my initial impression was that they were giving you less noodles and more rice to increase the profit margin of the dish. Next time was the rice was actually COLD...not lukewarm, but COLD. The noodles themselves weren't really much warmer than lukewarm. Again, greasy and not really very flavorful at all.

My wife had spicy chicken which did have better flavor but again COLD rice and still somewhat greasy.

So after several attempts and several so-so experiences, I am ready to say there are much better Thai places in the area so I will choose to go to those in the future.

Bought a "brand new bed" and it's supposed to be hypoallergenic. Turns out it was full of chemicals since they don't keep their items stored in a clean area. My husband and I had to have a brand new bed cleaned because we broke out in rashes after the first week of having it. Poor serve. The people are WAY TOO PUSHY. We won't be going back.

Everything is usually good and we go every once in a while to meet friends and watch games, but last night it was cooooooold inside. Everyone was eating with jackets on and the server gave us some long winded story about the vortex caused by the bar above. Great to see friends and the service and food was good :)

This is fast-service bbq, something I have never experienced before. I came in and ordered to-go and was in and out in less than five minutes. Being somewhat of a bbq snob, I went with the classics, pulled pork and sliced brisket -- if they can do those right then the test has been met. For $11 I got a two-meat combo and two sides, green beans and the jalapeno beans (all four items which also happen to be gluten free). The rolls are also supposed to be pretty good but of course I was not able to test those out. The portions were good and the sauce, which thankfully came on the side, was acceptable. They have the pickles, onions and jalapenos in the self-serve area to make your bbq even more authentic. Overall I felt like I got a great deal and the food was pretty tasty.
First time to this place and loved it!  Can't complain about anything I had.  The blueberry ketchup was amazing!   Definitely will be returning to try the different burgers but the bison was amazing!
The best!! Only downside is it's right next to my gym, hard to workout knowing there's great tacos next door : )

Come for the TV and football games don't come for the food or service. 

Service was slow. We never got one of our dinners, ended up going without it. 

Server had to ask three time what drink I ordered. I'm not talking about asking for clarification I'm referring to her coming back to our table to ask because she had forgot. 

Big fail. I may try other bar for the game next time.

Annoyed servers, spotty food = Panera bread will get my business. Reference the dinner roll picture. The other experience I had with them is that I ordered chicken noodle soup for my family. The server was ladling the soup, burnt her hand in the process, dropped the container of soup into the pot of soup, licked her burnt thumb, proceeded to grab the container out of the pot, topping off the container and turned and handed me my order. Didn't go over so well.

Awesome store! The owners (and staff) are amazing-everyone is so cheery, helpful and very knowledgable! My family was passing through Meridian and looking for running belts that would fit the new iPhone6 Plus and they had just what we needed, in many colors to choose from! I was originally thinking Fleet Feet was just a running shoe store... But I was wrong! They have the cutest workout clothes, lots of running (and athletic) gear, running gels, and all sorts of fun gadgets to track runs! You can tell the store is well loved, by the owners, staff and the community! Wish we lived closer!! See you soon Fleet Feet Meridian, and thanks for everything!
Fun fry variations with good sauces to dip in. Happy hour deal of by one get one free of beer and French fries. Burgers were pretty good to. Nice change from the usual burger and fry joints.

Wow.  I got the chunky cinnamon French toast and it was the best French toast I have ever had.  And you got free refills on your French toast.  Crazy!  Excellent prices too, good service and nice atmosphere.  Over all I loved it and I will be back.

What makes an awesome nail salon? Spotlessly clean, no overt smell of chemicals, they offer you a bottle of water when you walk in, they help you decide on just the right color, super friendly and professional staff who chat with you (or don't, if you want to just close your eyes), and the very best spa pedicures for just $25!

Just noticed they finally went under. Sad to see but can totally see why. We went there a number of times over the past year hoping it would be better the next time. Nope, never was better it only got worse. Food went down, service........, what service...... crabby, short tempered and irritable, what you need something sorry I am busy on the phone gabbing with my friend....service. Meh, not so sorry to see them go after all, it'll free up the space for something better.

The location is terrible! It's at a corner of a strip mall next to a nail salon. However the food is a nice departure from the usual steakhouse fare. We had the charcuterie plate which included their own smoked salmon and jerky, the duck and New York steak. The kids enjoyed a burger and chicken strips that were as high quality as the adult meals we had. The duck was crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside. The steak was seasoned beautifully and we paired a Caesar salad with just the right amount of dressing. 
The beer selection was small and wonderful. The service was great despite it being ONE waitress who was also the bartender. The two gentlemen in the back were impeccable with the preparation of food, timing and all. We indulged in dessert despite being full. The almond cake was surprisingly delicious (none of us actually like almonds) and the chocolate torte was very rustic and paired with a very sweet berry sauce.

Review Cheerleaders:

Overall:
This has got to be one of the most underrated restaurants in the valley. Honestly i don't know why there is never anyone here honestly this place should be packed 24/7 because the food is great the overall look of the restaurant is awesome and the service is spectacular and everything is just flat out awesome.

The Food: 
I ordered the stuffed steak burrito i was able to get my food relatively quickly and the burrito was awesome. it was very easy to cut and it tasted great. with that i got a side of french fries which were really good they were the thin cut fries like they have at mcdonold's and those were crazy good. the meal was very filling and i happily walked out of the restaurant with leftovers. 

the Service: 
Our Waiters name was Kendra and she was the nicest young lady she made sure balance the tough act of keeping our drinks full with out bothering us at all.

The Price: 
i was very satisfied with the amount of food that i got for only about $9 you can easily feed two people for under $25 

Totally pleased with everything here i will be coming back.

Very clean restaurant, friendly staff, good food. I recommend the fried Brussels sprouts (comes with maple bacon jam - super yummmm!!!!). There are a lot of dipping choices that are all vegetarian friendly! I liked the Spicy Fry Sauce the best. Good prices too.
Love the beers and the Brussel sprouts. We've had great meals here. Mike, the owner, is great!

Phenomenal food, atmosphere and people at Fat Guys. I can never seem to make up my mind about what I want to order because it all is amazing. One of the most popular places in town for lunch. Do yourself a favor and Go! You'll love it.

Horrible customer service, good but overpriced sandwiches. Employee didnt say a word when I paid for my food, she took my card, swiped it and handed me my food. Get out of customer service if you can't do your job.

We had only dessert there, so this review is regarding dessert only:
The desserts were good but service was terrible.  
We stood in front of the desserts trying to figure out what was best to order.  No one ever came to help encourage us on what to decide to get, or explain what any of the desserts were.  There was just some new girl at the register that kept saying , "i can take your order here".   All other staff was just running around like chickens fulfilling drive-through orders.   We chose to eat our order in house instead of to-go, and after about 15 min we were finally served (which i thought was kind of unreasonable for desserts you just slice up and put on a plate) .   So they bring it to us in to-go containers/bags.   The I look around and pretty much everybody else in the place was eating out of to-go containers.  Talk about tacky and wasteful.  I almost hope they fail so the environment won't suffer from their excessive waste.
No messing around best sandwich I have ever had. The #16 The Trevor is legit.  If you have it in you get the stake potato soap to complete the best GD lunch you'll ever have.

We tried this place when it opened and it was very good. Last night 4 of us went for my birthday.  The only thing that was good was the Diet Coke.  The burgers were black, and dry AND cold.  The avocados were dark and spoiled.   The orders were confused.  The service was very slow.  The music was very loud and tinny-especially in such a cold and empty environment and it exacerbated all the other irritations.  It is not the caliber of experience you would expect in this charming location.

When I lived in Santa Monica, I was two blocks away from The Counter, and loved it. I was so excited to see one come to Meridian, and couldn't wait to visit.
Bummer!
On a Thursday night we had a half-hour wait, but a restaurant can't be faulted for popularity, so that was fine. My friend and I waited an extra fifteen minutes beyond the original estimated 30, but we were still fine with that.
Once seated, we went through the lengthy menu and there were lots of good options. Appetizers included both the decadent, like fried pickles, and healthier options, like veggie kabobs. They specialize in customized burgers, where you pick a meat choice, size, bun (or bowl), cheese, toppings, and sauce. I didn't pay enough attention in math class to calculate, but I'd expect there are thousands of different combinations put together. I especially like that they have a handmade veggie patty with beets, instead of standard frozen vegetarian copout. They also have sandwiches, like a wicked grilled-cheese, chili, salads, and specialty burgers that feature recommended flavor combinations like a barbeque burger or a mediterranean option. 
We had plenty of time to peruse the menu, as it took our waiter a while to come take our order. A long while. It's not a huge restaurant, and there seemed to be plenty of servers, so we weren't sure why the wait. However, I know that customers don't always know the realities of the floor, so I give staff the benefit of the doubt.
I ordered a the Asian veggie bowl, which was the house-made vegetarian burger patty on a bed of salad greens with other veggies and a sesame dressing. The waiter told me after I ordered, however, that they were out of the veggie pattie. Oh. I asked if I could substitute the sauteed mushrooms they offered as a burger topping. He asked if I wanted to add them, for additional cost, and I explained that no, I wanted them in place of the burger, since they didn't have one available. After a some back and forth, he agreed. My friend ordered a buffalo burger with grilled pineapple and a few other toppings, and we split an order of fries. Note--everything here is a la carte, so the $9.00 base burger will be more if you'd like something other than just burger.
We waited, then waited, then waited. Nearly half an hour went by before we got our food. When we did, the fries came out with the burgers rather than as an appetizer, which we had requested. Okay. They also came without the aioli, which the server said was coming. Unfortunately, by the time the garlic aioli showed up, the fries were cold. The aioli had good flavor and a rich texture, which was nice, but not enough to save the now cold and limp fries.
The waiter set down my burger bowl and my friend's burger, and we dug in. After I'd poked around in my salad, the waiter came rushing back to the table and said he had given me the wrong meal. I was surprised, because it appeared to be the Asian veggie with mushrooms on it, and given that it was a custom-order I doubted anyone else had ordered exactly the same thing, but I just nodded as he grabbed my plate. I watched him walk into the kitchen and then exit through the other door with my plate, and then set it down in front of someone else. Given that I had had already picked through the bowl and started cutting up the veggies, I was somewhat horrified. For all the server knew, I could have eaten out of the bowl, yet he gave it to another woman. She had no idea where the bowl had been, and when I watched her start eating I cringed. 
When the server came back to our table, it was with a salad plate half the size of the previous bowl. It was the size of a side salad, and not at all what I had expected. There was a total of about two button-sized mushrooms on the plate, enough to consume in two bites. That was meant to substitute for a 1/3 pound veggie patty (which they, again, had run out of)? I couldn't help but think I didn't have the right meal, but I was so hungry by then I didn't care, and ate what I got. I was so disappointed. Other than the handful of spring mix, there were a few mandarin orange segments, the several scattered bits of mushroom, some sesame seeds and dressing, and really nothing else. For $12, this seemed absurd.
My friend enjoyed her buffalo burger more, although she said it was a little dry and the thin layer of cheddar cheese didn't help much. 
At the end of the meal the server swung by and dropped off the check without asking about the meal or offering dessert. We also noticed that most of the staff was standing at the hostess station, talking to a group of friends, throughout our meal. The staff seemed so busy talking there wasn't much action taking place service-wise. It seemed a little bit like staff social hour instead of a business. If you had a group of 19 year olds operate a restaurant, I think it would look about like this. Overall, a big disappointment.

The best burgers I've had in town, hands down! You can make so many different combinations of burgers here that it's really hard to go wrong. The meat and toppings always tasfresh and their sauce flavors are all on point! I definitely think the value is proportionate to the price point here, as opposed to other larger restaurants in the village. Their specialty shakes are to die for as well (tiramisu, omg!). My one criticism is that the faucet in the women's bathroom is angled oddly and splashes up onto you, but that has nothing to do with their food or service so I can't take away a star for that! Definitely a must-try destination in The Village!!

I come to kneaders often since it's so close to my home. I tried about everything they have. Had their breakfast items, sandwiches, breads & many kind of desserts. Everything tasted good. The only thing I don't like is it seems you have to wait for everything whether they are busy or slow. You think they'll give better service when they are in "off hours" but sadly no. I guess that's the trade off to have yummy carbs.

Hit up this joint while in town visiting family. It was stupid hot out and this place helped cool us down with some bad ass italian sodas and iced coffee!  Prices are good and the lady working was very friendly and seemed to genuinely care about if we like our drinks! I would go back again any day!

Had alot of friends rave about the tacos at Tin Roof so I decided to try it today, my tacos were okay, I've had better. But for the price at almost $3 a taco they need to fill the tacos with more meat and especially the fish taco. I took a bite of my fish taco and it was mostly cabbage and tortilla. The ladies at the front counter were friendly but the line cooks not so much. I thanked  the cook for my tacos and he  blankly just staired at me. Also the woman's bathroom needed to be cleaned. Would I give it another try? I'm sure, maybe I caught them on an off day.

Not bad; not great either. When we order an entrée (and appetizer) to share for two, it's quite stingy of them to only bring a small cup of rice to share, and then charge 3 bucks for another small cup (which the server should've at least informed us that it would cost extra)! When we asked about it, the lady server just said, "I don't make the pricing here," and just walks away. Nice. (So if we ask for 2 cups each, which other restaurants would just freely provide with most entrées, that'd be 9 bucks extra? Ok.) The veggie stir-fry was 'okay' (a bit bland) and serving size is little compared to other places. We'll only eat here if we'll run out of better options.
Went for lunch I had the cheese enchilada and shredded beef taco. Very delicious. Salsa is also tasty and chips!
Food here is mediocre to good.  Service has been fair.  I've eaten here several times (hamburgers, a salad, and the chicken strips with fries) and found the prices are a bit high.

Great place for families and all ages. There is a very large restaurant and bar with plenty of large TVs for viewing sports which is separate from the gaming. There is a regular bowling alley and a VIP section which is less crowded and more adult friendly. Kids love to go upstairs after they eat to use their free game card. I think the atmosphere is very laid back and fun and the food is pretty good too.

Forget Subway and Jimmy Johns, Hugo is the place to go for a Sub. I personally love to get a Turkey sub with Whole Wheat bread, the flavor and quality is beyond what I can describe on this review. Pay them a visit, you won't be disappointed.
Very nice hotel. Comfy beds. Some odd stuff on the bathroom ceiling and missing tile. Other than that staff very helpful and friendly. The decor is really nice. Easy parking.

This place is amazing, you can taste the love! Everything is made from scratch and it is delicious. One of the best chowders I have ever had, I will go back just for the chowder! The employees are also amazingly friendly and make you feel like family. This is a place not to miss!

Not your typical sandwich shop. They make amazing fresh bread and the meat they use is not that thinly sliced, processed meat. They use the good 'ol craved off the turkey thick sliced pieces of meat. I have never been disappointed with their food. 

Avoid going during peak times such as the 11:30-Noon time frame if you want to stay there to dine in. It's always very busy and at times difficult to find a place to sit. I would recommend calling your order in ahead of time to avoid the wait if you are in a hurry or have a limited time for lunch.

I do like the food for the most part, although pricey but the place is so filthy, so eat at your own risk! I stopped in yesterday & ordered a sandwich to go. As I stood by the register waiting I looked up & noticed the dirty ceiling & one of several dirty return air vents that had a trails of black, dusty grime so thick the grime drooped down from the vents. One of these was hanging right above the food warmer where food waited for pick-up! 
When I headed into the ladies restroom it was also disgusting-walls, sink, faucet, toilet, floor, door, dispensers! Given this place had only been open 90 minutes at this point in the day, it was obvious it had been this way for years & as the saying goes, if the manager doesn't care about the restrooms where the customers see, it's likely the kitchen where we don't see, probably isn't much better.
The whole place was filthy everywhere I looked. I had already paid for my food but there was no way I could choke it down after seeing this. I can't even imagine what was behind the counter into that kitchen! Has an inspector EVER been there because there is no way this place has seen a scrub brush in years. GROSS!!

6/30/15-If you're relying on the Health Dept, HA!, the receptionist wasn't interested in any details & no one returned my call. I wonder now as I edit this if any action was ever taken...

I can't believe some of these reviews - almost like they come from disgruntled ex staff or something. I have eaten here several times and haven't had a bad experience (and we are often tough to please).  From the great beer selection to the huge variety of burgers (seems like something for everyone) to awesome servers and bartenders.  I am glad we didn't read any of these reviews before we started eating here or we may have missed out on a great place!

I have an unhealthy obsession with kneaders. I will eat their turkey, bacon, and avocado sandwich with complete abandon, no matter the time of day. I love their smoothies, sandwiches, soups, and desserts, and everything I have ever had here is good. I would definitely recommend this place, but come early! It gets busy quick around lunch time.
Great coffee fun people. The staff is great treat you amazing everytime. Gives my son and dog something fun they love it you guys rock.

Ordered the Smokehouse Salad online. Pros - it was ready when I arrived. Staff very friendly. Cons - salad was kinda small and the tangled onions were missing, so it was just lettuce, cheese and meat, plus no butter for the roll. BBQ was passable. Had a hard time finding it because their outside sign wasn't lit. Won't be back.

Amazing and adorable. I love this coffee shop. It looks sort of like it was birthed from a kitschy diner, but the way it has been transformed make it the sweetest, most adorable coffee shop around. You can order coffee on the go by hitting the drive-thru or stop in and sit at one of the tables and read or write for a bit. The baristas are friendly and know their coffee. If you're a coffee lover and you are not attached to the green mermaid place, I would definitely come to Big Star.

The Trevor Melt is the bomb! I went here after working out for an hour and 30 minutes, kind of defeated the purpose but it was worth every delicious bite! I love that all of their breads are from local bakeries. It's going to have to be a "special occasion" place for or I will be big as a house. One of the best sandwiches I've ever had.
Best sandwich in the valley. It takes a lot to wow me where food is concerned. This place is great. Super friendly staff with quick service.

Stopped in to get my dogs nails shaved down. Staff was super friendly and helpful!! We also ended up getting a collar/harness. We currently us the gentle leader. But since it goes around her mouth it prevents her from protecting herself against a dog who may try to attack her in the park. The staff allowed us to try the harness out in the store before buying it, which I thought was really cool.

I would add one cautionary note however. If you have an aversion to rodents (mice), be advised that they are in the cases/aquariums that are right in the middle of the main isle. My wife thought I should throw this info in to inform others who hate mice so that they may go down the side isles.

I been coming here since they opened and have honestly never had a bad sandwich. The soups are fresh and awesome! Today I had the bacon jalapeño potato soup. Didn't have that kick I like but still delicious, almost tasted like clam chowder with the bacon pieces having the same texture of clams. I got the fat BLT today and it was amazing! Tasted really fresh, the bacon was stacked and not a lot of grease on the bacon so really really something you gotta try. This place always makes me happy when you see an owner who remembers you and engages with their customers. Everyone is always nice and helpful. Make sure you come with an empty stomach because the sandwiches are pretty big. If you think these sandwiches are small, I can't keep up with ya, too much food lol. My wife's Trevor melt is like a beautiful piece of art, the pesto and all the meats dipped in au ju, my favorite sandwich there. Give this place a try and I guarantee you won't be disappointed!

Awesome burger chain!   Nice char broiled hamburger with OK fries.  One of the better
 burger joints.  Up there with Smash Burger.
Really fast and friendly service. The food was great. The only drawback might be the restrooms were a bit yucky.

Clean facility with all the necessary items.

No deadlift platform but you are able to stack some of the red mats up in the group area for deadlifts.

Staff is extremely nice and helpful.

Did I mention clean?

Lots of options if it's busy, but I've never seen it too busy...outside of the 6-10 am/pm rush.

Very satisfied gym member.

Just got back from eating at Grant's Neighborhood Grill and figured it was time for me to weigh in.  After reading some of the reviews, I was a bit nervous.  I had read the reviews from the Statesman and from Boise Weekly, which sounded like they liked the joint, but the other reviews I read on line were hit or miss.  Every restaurant goes through a learning curve, so I figured I would try.  We had a Restaurant.com certificate available, so $25 off of a $50 purchase makes it much less painful to try.  
    So, I ordered the gnocchi, with a ceasar salad to start.  My hubby ordered the southwest burger with a side salad and my little boy ordered the burger.  First off, the ceasar salad was no ordinary ceasar, Yes, it was still very Ceasarish, but with a brilliant slant of a bit of Jalapeño in the dressing.  Not too much that it makes it spicy, just enough to give it a different nuance, and I must say, I thought it fantastic!   My absolute new favorite, and I'm not that much of a spice gal.  Next time I will try it with different proteins(chicken, shrimp etc)   The parmasan gnocchi came plated with a variety of roasted veg, sauted mushrooms, chopped pecans and micro greens.  The gnocchi was perfectly accomplished with just the right amount of parmesan, fluffy, like little clouds of heaven, sauteed to perfection with an brown butter sauce that was there but not drenching the food.  It was a beautifully balanced dish with complex flavors.  I knew right there that I would HAVE to write a review for this place.  My 8 year old son polished off the 1/3 lb burger.  Obviously it was delicious although I do wish I could order a child portion as they did not have a burger on the kids menu.  The only children's items were listed for children under 8 I believe and they were mac and cheese, chicken tenders or a cheese quesadilla.  I do hope they change that to include a burger at some point, as a $9 burger for a kid is a bit high.  But, as the child polished it off, I had no problem paying for it.  My husband said his burger was wonderful with a great blend of meat, obviously fresh custom ground meats, that was perfectly seasoned.  Burgers come with fries, homemade obviously, that were good in their own right.  
     Dessert for us was a flourless chocolate cake.  This can always be a hit or miss in any establishment, but was a definite hit here!  It was served with a delightful custardy cream on top with a swirl of rum caramel sauce around the bottom.  I told my husband that I wanted to lick the plate afterward.  
    All in all, you can really tell that this place uses quality ingredients. Every ingredient was top shelf quality and all condiments are obviously made in house.   I'm a picky foodie, and am all over the local food scene.  THis place is worth checking out.  I look forward to exploring their menu in the coming months.  Thank goodness Meridian is getting more quality restarants like this, we need more eateries that appeal to the sophisticated palette like Grant's.  Don't be scared away from the other reviews, every place needs time to work out the kinks, and if tonights meal is representative of what I can obtain in the future, I'm all in.
UPDATE: I had them buff my exterior in a 13-yr old car and it looks amazing. They even removed my boring Edmark and Durango badges. Well done!

Me and a few friends were Saturday night regulars. We usually sat upstairs and Maren was our server almost every week for months! She was fantastic! But the last 3 weeks she wasn't there and the other servers we had were absolutely AWFUL. Two ignored us completely and the other seemed to be annoyed that we were there. The first time, we sat in the bar upstairs; the second time, we were in the bowling area, and the third we were in the restaurant downstairs. So these weren't isolated to one area or to one server. Managers definitely need to work on hiring better servers and bartenders. Maren is the only reason I'm giving Big Al's any stars at all.

Always love going to the Ram.  They do change the menu every so often. They used to have an awesome chicken sandwich called the sarducci, sadly not on the menu anymore. Updated the tvs, great for watching sports. Always have great service. Excellent place for a cold beer and to hang out with friends.  A little pricey but worth it. I recommend trying the seasonal beers,  but my go to beer is the Pale 71.
I needed an iPhone repair from another bad vendors work. They did an absolutely fantastic job. And the service was very quick. They sell more than just repair.

Every time we've visited the food has been superb and the staff is super friendly and accommodating. The serving sizes are huge and leftovers are awesome! Best Mexican I've found in the Treasure Valley thus far.

AVOID!!!!!  TRAVELERS DO NOT STAY HERE! 

The staff and GM are terrible! Funny and sad that my paths crossed with Thomas Mitchell GM again at a different location. Seems that the hotel ratings reflect it from other comments as well. Looks like another hotel in the dumps because of the way its managed and the staff Thomas hires. 

Sandman Hotel, read reviews associated with this Management! We had similar issues with Thomas at his other managed establishment.

Other hotel Thomas manages is Sleep Inn in Nampa, ID...AVOID THIS AS WELL!

 TRAVELERS DO NOT STAY HERE!
Surprisingly good, love that they have an app and a drive through. If they get the order wrong it takes a while to correct, but they do always make good on any mistakes!

Burgers were good, fries were awesome. I especially liked all of the sauces and salts. Try the blueberry ketchup, you won't be disappointed. 

Prices seemed a little high. The restaurant area was pretty messy, but the waitresses were all nice and helpful when we ordered.

Really nice food! It's location was a bit off putting, but occasionally you find a really good place in a strip mall. 

The wine list was lacking but the service and food were outstanding and at the end of the day that's what really counts. 

We shared the pork larb salad, and then we both had curry. She has chicken curry and I had the seafood curry. Very nice, on both accounts. 

Healthy, tested great and friendly service. We'll definitely be back!

Hubby had a Reuben which he enjoyed a lot. I had Calif BLT. Very good. Ate half and saved the other half for the next day. Loved the roll it was made on. 

Parking was an issue since there is a dance school near by.

This is my Go To meal... I eat here at least once a week! 
- Original beef with cheese with a side of BRUSSELS SPROUTS.  I mean- where else can you get Brussels sprouts like these?!?  They are absolutely amazingly delicious!!

Happy hour buy one get one free beer is pretty fantastic too!

I called and left a message for jeppesen twice. Each time I mentioned that my former wife has ALS and we need to do a trust as immediately as possible. He has not returned either call. Totally irresponsible. Can't imagine what would have happened if he had actually done our trust if we ran into a problem. I don't recommend this person at all.

Was a little hesitant after seeing some negative reviews of this place, but I'm glad I still tried it!  

They offer gluten free options!!  Just say you'd like your tacos gluten free and they'll use a separate grill/pan to cook your tacos.  Tacos shells are corn.  Lots of the tacos are able to be made gluten free (choose grilled not fried). 

Menu is by taco, tacos are about $2-3 each.  They are small tacos, I needed to order three to be full.  A hungry guy may need to order a couple more than me to make it a meal.  What's nice is that you can order a variety, the menu has veggie, chicken, beef, pork, fish, and shrimp options as well as dessert tacos.

Only complaint is the floors and tables were a bit dirty, made it feel closer to a food truck experience than a cafe.  The atmosphere is nice and design is modern.  Overall, still 4 stars in my book as the tacos were very good and the customer service very friendly. One star docked for cleanliness!

Seriously shitty service lately. I stood at the counter for 15 minutes while they tried to ring up my rats. I told them multiple times I needed to go and just calculate price by hand and I would pay exact change and they could ring it up later when they figured it out. They refused. They finally got me rang up and then didn't even offer a bag. They suck these days.

Awesome!! Highly recommended! Everyone there is super nice. Miki did my nails and they look the best they've ever looked. She paid attention to detail and took her time. She was also really easy to talk to while they were being done. Best salon experience I've had!!

Comparable to Chipotle, better than Taco Bell. When my husband and I visited this particular Qdoba, the cashier was ridiculously rude to her coworker and scolded him multiple times in front of the customers. Inappropriate.

Never showed up for appointment.  Finally got a hold of them and then they went through a whole song and dance to try to up sell us.  We just wanted what was included with voucher.  Said they would come right out but they never did.

For my first ever Idaho pedicure experience, Nail Tek set the bar high! I called to schedule two pedicures for as soon as possible. Britt helped me out and was able to fit us in within 15 minutes. We arrived early and right away got us in chairs. The salon has a fun and clean look, complete with sparkle-y chandeliers. Britt and Vi were so nice and made us feel welcome. They did brilliant jobs on our pedicures - I can't wait to come back!

Parking lot was packed and tables were full.  Food was good and priced reasonably.  The place was dirty,  liked like the floors under the fountain soda machine hadn't been cleaned for months.  Also, they sell these awful trinkets in the store.... likely a big money loss for them as they have a lot of inventory.  They should stick with the sandwiches and bakery items,  as they are reasonably good. Not likely that I will come back.  The lack of cleanliness in the dining area concerns meas who knows what the kitchen looks like.

Spent 3 days at this hotel with family and it met and exceeded my expectations.  The rooms are in good condition, clean, and reasonably well appointed.  The breakfast is above average and IMO the thing that puts this location at the top of list.  We always felt safe here and it is well located in the center of the Treasure Valley.  Kudos to the manager, as this level of customer comfort does not happen without competent management. Would definitely stay here again.

We came during a quiet time in the day. Service was very friendly and fast. We split one of their shakes and it was crazy delicious! (Nutella and salted pretzel, what's not to love?) my husband picked one of their expert builds and absolutely loved it. I enjoyed the freedom of building my own burger. We were both very happy with our choices. They have so many options! We loved this place and will come back for sure when we are in the area again.

Dallas did a great job bathing my kitty who has very long fur. Kitty was so nervous and scared, but Dallas did a wonderful job getting his bath accomplished.  My kitty boy now smells great and looks beautiful. Having  Aussie Pet mobile groomer come to your home, (especially if you have a cat), means  kitty doesn't  have to sit in a cage all day at a groomer's with barking dogs in a cage next to them. The  whole grooming process took about a half hour and is well worth the cost and convenience. I highly recommend Aussie Pet for all your pets grooming needs.

I've went to this place for years! No more! I called to let them know I was going to be a little late and they said ok. I get there not even 10 minutes late and they won't see my son! There was no one in the waiting room! Now we're at the ER...this is so wrong! I am a single mother and work full time, no help with my kids, so when I'm a little late because of work, they should be willing to see him. I had to take the time off work to take my child and they don't care!
So this was my 2nd time here first time checking in and I must say the sandwich was fresh and tasty.  Last time I had the sweet potato fries and they rocked
Went here for lunch to try it out, it was ok i guess. The steak on the sandwich was bland and the pork on the Cuban sandwich was dry. Meh, i guess you don't know till you try it right?

Another successful sandwich shop
Leave the boring turkey and ham sandwich at home, the choices her are unique and taste awesome

Think of The Habit like a Chick-fil-A that sells burgers... or like an In-N-Out with dim lighting. Kind of. It is a fast food burger joint that makes a solid attempt at seeming like a non-fast food joint. But really, it's still fast food... and honestly it's just OK. My husband commented that he was "Glad we tried it, but it wasn't memorable."

Food: I ordered the garden salad with a grilled albacore tuna steak on top. For about $7, the portion was nice and big but that salad wasn't excellent quality. Some of their higher priced (and higher caloric) salads looked a lot better as they were coming out. But overall, if you're looking for a healthy meal, mine was decent. My husband ordered a char-grilled burger with swiss and a side of fries. He said the burger was very average and that he'd much prefer a Five Guys burger instead. I thought the fries were crispy and salty, just the way I like them! Though I didn't try them, I do like that they serve tempura green beans and tuna steaks... very innovative compared to most other fast food.

Drinks: Self serve soda fountain, fresh-brewed teas (the black was good), and milk shakes. 

Atmosphere: They are not your average fast food. Think In-N-Out but dimmer! They make a good attempt at seeming more upscale. The music is groovy, the ambiance is cool with the cozy booths, dim table lighting and by-the-number order pick-up system. They also offer a self-serve pepper bar, which I thought was really neat! However, the seating area isn't very big, so the tables fill up quick. 

Service: Very fast and friendly. Our order came out with a mistake (no tuna on the salad) and not only were they quick to fix it, but they also offered tips on the tuna. Very nice!

Happy Hour Offerings: n/a

Healthy Hack: Try the garden salad (which is just a basic salad) with a grilled albacore tuna steak on top. It has about 280 calories, and with the fat free Italian dressing coming in as just 12 calories for 2 tbsp, it's the lowest calorie option. All other dressings have over 140 there.

Tips: If you go around lunch or dinner time, you may have a hard time finding a spot to sit. Seating is limited.

I've been going to see Paul at Imperial since I was 14 years old (with my parents consent, of course!!!!). I love his bedside manner. He has a calmness about him that puts you at-ease. Well, as at-ease as you can be knowing you're about to have a needle stabbed through you! 
They practice very strict hygiene and both Paul and Matt are APP certified, so you know you're in good hands. 
Lovely selection of jewelry, both for the initial piercing and fully healed holes. Prices are reasonable and the store front is always very clean. I wouldn't go anywhere else!!

Love you guys, your service, products and pet stuff but dang! I know it's such a busy time of year but get your sh*! together and don't make people wait in the checkout line forever. Staff seems aplenty but for crying out loud, can you put a couple of registers in the back or something? I'd rather just go to Fred Meyer. In and out there and prices are more affordable.

Not my most favorite Mexican joint in town, actually not even a close runner up!!! Lets make this review simple and cut to the chase. Service is slow and acts as if serving customers is more of a chore than a service. The food is ok, at best, and the price is a bit high for the quantity/quality of food you receive. My burrito consisted of a tortilla that was warped around itself twice before hitting any other condiments and folded on the top and bottom so it would touch in the middle. So lets just say that there was a lot of tortilla and not much of anything else!

It's to be expected to see a 5 star  rating here.  Great customer service!  I received a quote of about $230 to fix iPad. Was ready to pay it also. But they are honest. I came back and they said my iPad was not the model they thought. They were apologizing. And the price was now like $160.  They made a lifetime customer with that!

THEY HAVE SPROUTS!!!

I'm on a sprouts withdrawal since my local Jimmy John's stopped using them. I googled "Meridian Chicken Salad", this came up, and I went. It was great. Nothing fancy in the chicken salad department, but it tasted great, had white meat, wasn't runny. In short: just what I was looking for. The sandwich was on a homemade challah bun: think huge yummy dinner roll. I got my son a grilled cheese and hoped he wouldn't eat the whole thing so I could finish it. That was delicious as well. I can't wait to go back and try the BLT, as my gut is telling me they are gonna rock it.

I would have been over the moon if they had lemons for my diet coke, but all in all, a five-star experience. One of the 'Fat Guys' was working while I was there. He is very friendly, treats you like a buddy, gave my little guy a cookie if he promised to eat his lunch, and he sounds like Zach Galifianakis. Can you beat it?

Went here with family and had a great time. We spent the $13 a person to do the cosmic bowling and it was great! Had a lot of fun and were able to knock out 2 games within the hour. The place was clean and the employees were friendly. I would recommend for a fun day out.

Best Triple Chin Sandwich I've ever had,  I also had a bowl of Clam Chowder soup and some Potato Salad.  I was more then impressed from the minute I walked in with the service, We were all greeted and waited on as soon as we entered.  Chef Wally makes GREAT soups, salads and puts a AMAZING sandwich together and everything is made from scratch. I will definitely be going back and I recommend that you give Fat Guy's Fresh Deli a try!!
If I could give more then 5 stars I would this place is off the charts AMAZING!!

An interesting break from reviewing restaurants....but this place screamed for a 5 star review!  

We had been noticing several wasps entering the siding by our slider in the back of the house...no big deal...hey, they live here as well and only about 2 or 3 were going in and out...probably building a nest...not bothering us...guess it's OK...Hmmm....About two days later, my observant neighbor dropped by to tell us that swarms of wasps were coming into the house via the roof vent on the side and leaving out the garage vent...How did I miss this???  A quick call to Vanguard was in order (really good reviews on Angies List...)...Was greeted on the phone by a very pleasant young lady who assured me that a technician would be over that afternoon....and he was...about an hour later!  WOW!  Prompt service.  The technician was a young very polite fellow who examined the entire house...listened carefully to my 'complaint' and gave me a price for the 'fix'...OK...fair price...and reasonable follow-up....I remember having a pest control contract in New York and this was basically the same type...made good sense to me.  "Will start the process tomorrow...what time is good for you?"  Decided on 9AM ....and 9AM it was...on the button!  A VERY nice, professional, knowledgeable technician named Bobby Davis arrived and assessed the situation per his co-workers notes.  Told him to please feel free to come in without knocking since he would be working both inside and outside the house...And he did...I noticed he removed his shoes when he came in...Nice!  Very considerate and professional!  He proceeded to explain what he was about to do...discussed the materials he was going to apply inclusive of their effectiveness and their safety factor and what to expect.  Very thorough and exacting!  Completed his work without disturbing anything either inside nor outside the house...After completing his work, he again reviewed the process and the follow up visits to come....also exchanged several pleasantries regarding fishing and some local 'hot-spots'...a nice end to a professional job.
Highly recommend these folks...EVERYONE was polite, professional and learned about their job...nice to find this old-fashioned service, something that seems to be lacking in just about everything these days...

I had the mushroom char burger. It was a good, moist burger. I liked the amount of mushrooms it had on it.  The price for the mushroom char burger was very decent, unlike the side dishes.  The French fries, onion rings and tempura green beans, (while very good) seemed very over priced to me. The ambience was very nice inside. Not to loud for conversation.  If I had one complaint,  it would be there isn't much setting inside.

I used Vanguard recently to treat an older home that I suspected had some pest issues.  They did a fantastic job, were always prompt and even made return visit to make sure everything was taken care of.  

I've been extremely happy with their service, and as much as I hope I don't need to have them back, I certainly will if the critters return.  

Highly recommend them.

Five stars for Big star! By far the best coffee shop in the Treasure Valley. It is just too bad they havent made their way to Boise, yet. However, the hubby and I drive 15 minutes out of our way multiple times a week because it is the best. I always try their $3 special and when I find one I love I stick with it. But there are a few kinds that I loveeee. And they have cookies. The baristas are always sweet. Never a bad experience.

I have been here a few times, and this place has never failed to impress me.  The service is good, the atmosphere is great, the drinks are delicious and the good is top-notch.

I've had different noodle dishes, most recently the pad thai.  I've also had the lettuce wraps as an appetizer, which are good.

This place is pretty cool. There are great options for burgers (like bison), and even more combinations for fries (like sweet potato fries with ginger salt dipped in spicy ketchup). The  possibilities are endless! I definitely recommend!
Love the food. Love the owner. Our favorite is the Blue Bronco sandwich. If you like blue cheese, au jus and deliciousness, you will love this sandwich!!!
Worst Mexican food I ever had... went there with my wife and she did not like it either, what ever you don't eat at this place and don't believe the reviews because this place is the worst.

Too crowded at lunch but great food.  Parking is horrible.  Too many businesses attempting to use one parking lot.  Meridian P&Z you should be ashamed, this area has too many businesses for the allowable parking.

Great place,! Best deli in meridian.  They made me a custom made 6' sandwich for a Super Bowl party.  It was awesome and everyone at the party loved it. They have great fried chicken too. Te deli fries are awesome.

Very personable staff. Chase and Kathy were super friendly and personable. I had the Viking with a side of clam chowder. Both had a amazing flavor. Both the quantity and quality of ingredients blew my mind. The soup had great depth of flavor. The sandwich was packed with delicious meat and they are not shy with bacon. The meat to bread ratio should be taught in schools. My new favorite deli in Idaho!

Disgusting food. Terrible service. I had steak  Chimichangas. The meat was a cheap chuck roast that tasted like it had been boiled in old water and cut up put in flour tortillas *no seasoning and covered with bland sauce. Was not cooked properly. Yuck. My husband got chicken enchalada. He said the chicken tasted like it came from a can. Kid got cheese nachos which were burned. The rice was the only good thing on the plate. The waitress was RUDE. We had to ask for silverware  (which was dirty) a fork had dried lettuce on it. she never refilled drinks and never came back after food was delivered. We had to go up to the front to ask for the check so we could pay. And no one was up front so we had to call out to the back to get someone's attention.
This place is incredible. One of the best sandwich shops I've had. Highly recommend this place to anyone. Their clam chowder is heater bomb-beater.

Great coffee with out the Corporate price. I always order the Iced Latte. Coffee is always consistent in flavor never too strong. Visiting family in Boise home town city Tacoma, WA
Also I was surprised to see a Dutch Bros coffee stand in Tacoma a few weeks ago. Is Dutch Bros expanding?

Amazing service. Reached out via Yelp as I was visiting Boise. Shattered iPhone screen. They responded via Yelp within 5 min!  Fit me in the next day. Phone s teen replaced in 20 min. $98. Steak of a deal. Thanks, guys!
Cute little place! Awesome service. The cashier was super kind. And the food was AMAZING! I highly recommend the German fries. Thank you!!

I have seen good reviews for The Counter in irvine, but I should have looked at the local reviews before strolling in this location. It was only after I ordered and was waiting for my food that I checked the other reviews (big mistake). The extra $1 for bacon is a complete rip off.  As others commented, it was very thinly sliced and lower quality. 

The sauce options and patio seating we're nice. 

We spent $25.97 for two burgers and a side of average fries. 

Okay, we had the experience and have checked this off our list.  No need to come back.  You really aren't missing much if you stay away.

I think the beer is solid and improving over the years. The Double Bach is delicious but some of their beers lack a lot of flavor. 

The food is mediocre and over priced but they do have a great happy hour, which includes specials on beer, liquor, and food! You can find that at their website; http://www.theram.com/

Like the other reviews, I would give the Ram 4 stars for their beer/happy hour prices and 2 stars for their food.

I am relatively new to the area, and I don't drive for medical reasons.  usually I can get rides to work with family or friends, but every once in a while I find myself stranded without transportation, and I know I can rely on B & W.

I have used them twice, and both times they were very friendly and got me to where I was going quickly and for a fair price.  The first time Judy picked me up, and it was a very pleasant experience.  She got me where I was going without the clearest of directions, and even struck up some good conversation on the way.  The second time Lori was the driver.  She was very professional, and we also struck up a bit of conversation, and got home in a very reasonable amount of time.  Both experiences were very pleasant, and should I need transportation in the future I know who I'm gonna call.  

Also I enjoyed talking to their dispatchers.  I used to work reception at the Oregon convention center, and after talking to dispatch with several cab companies in Portland they were a joy to talk to.  They got complete information which made the trips more smooth.

Every now and again you run across a great proprietor running a great business offering superlative quality and value. Such was my experience today at Fat Guys!

I needed a platter of sandwiches for 12 15-year-old female soccer stars from Utah. This place nailed it!

Each came with a side of potato salad or cole slaw. I augmented with chips and water. Sandwiches were large, Marge, quality was top shelf, service impeccable and the price was right! My only regret was not being able to try one of the signature sandwiches from the menu.

Why would a Subway even bother? Give it up, you've lost! There ought to be a law against that garbage!

Thank you, Fat Guys!

The people who work here are ALWAYS friendly. Let's be real, I go back for the service. I get the chai which is just chai tea and milk, but I'll pay just to support them! I ALWAYS tip them just because they are SO KIND! And I hope others do the same. Seriously the nicest staff around. I would hire anyone just hearing they worked at this location! You guys rock! Don't forget it!

After seeing all the high reviews we checked this place out expecting a lot. Hubs got the #16 Trevor Melt (which the cashier said is the most popular) and coleslaw, I got the #20 PC Pedro woth Cordon Bleu Chicken soup and for our toddler we got the grilled PB&J with potato salad. I'm not sure of it was an off day bc I'm pretty sure my sandwich was made wrong.. I got pesto mayo on mine and it doesn't show that on the menu. Thats a pretty strong flavor profile if you arent expecting it. I also got a side of au jus which seems kinda weird for a turkey, pesto, and bacon sandwich. Overall the sandwiches weren't terrible but the sides were disappointing. My son's potato salad had undercooked potatoes and was bland. Coleslaw was bland and oily. My soup tasted weird, not sure if it was the cordon bleu flavor which seems kinda weird for a soup or I just didn't like it. We paid 30 bucks for sandwiches for 3 people and only 1 soda. We did not bring our complaints to the attention of the staff because they weren't all that friendly and just seem annoyed when we asked questions. They did not greet us coming in nor thank us when going out, even though we walked past every staff member from where we sat to the exit. One last comment, we noticed the Italian sandwich has pastrami on it. We did not try it and therefore can't say if it's good but I've never seen an Italian sandwich with pastrami along with the cappicola and salami. Weird but maybe it's delicious! I don't think we'll ever go back to find out, there are a lot more delicious and better priced options in Boise.

I got a lox bagel herb cream cheese. I have never seen such fresh looking smoked salmon on a lox bagel (and I'm from NJ). The cream cheese was home made and they had containers you could buy - I bought 2. Their organic coffee was delicious as well. I am not from here, but was just on a random road trip. It's such a nice area we will definitely be coming back and I will be making sure we stop here again. 
 PS The service was excellent.

This store doesn't even deserve one star.  The absolute worst pizza we've ever eaten.  The franchise owner and location manager need to realize that repeat business is what keeps a restaurant going.  You won't be getting that from us.  Absolute garbage!!!!

Ordered potato skin appetizers - crisp and yet still fluffy a plus!  Chicken Caesar salad was so so. Chicken was delicious and juicy but the dressing was abundant and seemed more like mayo rather than Caesar dressing. Others in party ordered the Juicy Lucy burger - big and cooked well but the cheese seemed to be a kraft slice, not exactly what you expect when dining out. 
The other items ordered were the bleu cheese chicken wrap - spicy and prepared well. And rounding out the meal was a Fiesta Salad. In a fried tortilla bowl plenty of spicy ground beef and salsa to make this diner satisfied. 
We will come back - great place to watch sports and the wait staff was friendly and on top of things.

Very professional company.  I was able to schedule online, responses were prompt, and appointment time was met.  The cost is more than I usually pay, but the convenience was wonderful.  The groomer did a great job, she even somehow managed to clean our dogs teeth.

I don't go out all the time. So when i decide to spend my hard earned money, i like it to be worth it. This place was a huge disappointment. Over priced, over cooked, limited menu. What a waste of what could've been a delicious piece of streak AND halibut. Who runs out of POTATOES in the middle of dinner hour?  7 pm - this is Idaho for Pete sake. Don't be fooled by the "cake", its some GF lump of gelatinous goo..at best under cooked brownie with an after taste I can't quite describe beyond, no, just no. The maximum capacity is maybe 20. You smell everything and that's not good considering the varied menu, not everything smells good together. If I wanted fine dining I'd have gone somewhere suited for it; The Brickyard; Chandler's or heck even The Roadhouse would've done better with that cut. I feel like the food was over priced to compensate for their interpretation of a fine dining steak house.

Great customer service!  I had gotten my nails done the day before at another location, I won't name names...but they were a disaster, the acrylic was actually all over my skin and had uneven tips, NOT good. I called Nail-Tek on a recommendation from a coworker, and the owner Ha managed to squeeze me in. He fixed the shape, the messy acrylic, and did a beautiful gel polish over them. I have already made an appointment to come back in 3 weeks. I definitely recommend these guys!
Stopped looking for a good, local cup of coffee. Great cup of coffee, best I have had for a long time. Friendly server. Next time I will go inside and get steamed milk, too.

Overpriced/Bland Food-Mediocre Service
We went today and for a huge place, it was a downer. We went to lunch first. They had only ONE waitperson in the whole place! We waited for awhile before she saw us. I ordered the Fish and Chips and my son ordered the BBQ burger. My breading on my fish was very bland and oily. The fish inside was fresh but the breading was terrible. The fries were okay. The coleslaw had the most flavor and was good. My son's BBQ burger was very greasy and he could not taste the jalepeno peppers inside the buns. The bowling area was very clean and the menu to record the frames was very easy to use.  The bowling price for two games with two pairs of shoes was almost $25.00 for two adults. I gave it a one star because of the overpriciness of the food and bowling equipment.  We traveled from Caldwell to go here. The menu was not diabetic and cardiac friendly. They caked and breaded everything.  I paid $43.00 which includes the tip.  If they update the menu, I will give them another chance. If they don't I am not going to come back.

Oh dear, what an experience we had at Big Al's. I will preface this review with the fact that I am reviewing only the restaurant. We spent a little time walking around the arcade and checked out the 21-and over lounge which seemed nice. The restaurant is a different story. Let me preface my review of the restaurant by saying that I get it, when we went there they had only been open a month, there are growing pains that are to be expected, howEVER, how can you not be ready to serve a giant restaurant, bowling alley and lounge from the same kitchen at high volumes? We went the day after a BSU game, I wouldn't be so stupid to go to any bar on a game night. We had a 40 minute estimated wait but only waited about 20. We were sat and the bad started right off the bat. Good thing I don't remember our server's name because if I did he would not want me telling about his lovely demeanor and attitude the entire night. My husband could see he was flustered from being busy so he tried to joke around with him and the server says "I'm not really in the mood for the joking around tonight, sorry" Our table of 8 attempted to order drinks and food several times but the server just kept walking by or he would only take the order of a couple people at a time. When the food orders were finally made we waited, and waited, and waited. After 30 minutes we tried to get an update and were told the kitchen was backed up but it shouldn't be much longer. After 60 minutes someone started coming around with chips and salsa to ease our hunger and frustration. About 20 minutes after that the food finally came out and what do you know, two of the orders were completely wrong! The wrong order receivers were wary of having their meals fixed because they didn't want it to take 30 minutes or more to get the right one. They were assured it would not. What happens...oh yes, two people are left with empty plates while everyone else is finished eating and ready to go play games. The manager tried to apologize but I think he was frustrated with everything that was happening that night. When we asked the server what the problem was, he says "well that's what you get when you put a bunch of teenagers and ex-cons back in the kitchen"  yowzas, no need to air the dirty laundry of the restaurant to customers. We left feeling disappointed... who knows, maybe we will go back again but not until we get better feedback from other's who have tried it.

I was hoping to like this place, but it was bad, really bad. We got yhe orange chicken which was highly recommended, and it was just plain gross. My wife tried it and spit it out. Got the beef pad thai noodles also, they were better but still not good at all. Paid over thirty bucks a d threw most of it away. If you dont know what good thai taste like, maybe youll like it!
The worst cashiers ever work here. Very slow and don't care if they have a job or not.

On May 11, 2018 my disabled husband and I checked into this motel after having made reservations with Diane. Everything went smoothly we got the perfect handicapped room with two beds and a walk in shower. On the same date we reserved the same room for May 24, 2018 and confirmed it with Diane before we left.   When we checked in over two weeks later, on May 24, 2018,, we were told that a woman with a wheelchair had more disability issues than my husbands disabilities and that all they could offer us was a room with one bed where he would not be able to shower!  The woman with the wheelchair has a boot on her leg, and was outside her room at different times with the wheelchair and or crutches.  I can't believe that the employees here would try to prioritize disabilities amongst themselves instead of telling the later person with disabilities that they have no room that fits her request for disability service!  This is certainly an ADA discrimination violation but more importantly the fact that these women chose to tell a man with disabilities that his Disability is not as important as a womans disabilities is just disgusting!

The room they gave us was in the hallway where approximately 10 rooms were being remodeled there was constant noise and constant flakes in the air from where they were using sanding machines all of the workers had masks over their face but none were offered to us!  So sad to see this type of service in Idaho I thought people were better here  then the rest of the gimme gimme world!

The good:
Burgers were good. The birthday cake shake was pretty good. The restaurant was clean. 
The bad:
The service was beyond bad. 10 minutes for a server to come around and take our drinks. Another 10 to take our order. Then 30 minutes of waiting, with no acknowledgement from the staff. We finally asked another server what was going on and our order was "first in line" seriously? They hadn't even started. 
We ordered side salads to come out prior to our food, and they did, after we asked again for our salad. They were wilted sad warm salads. Not appetizing at all. 
Then out came our burgers, which were warm, but our fries didn't come out until we had finished eating. 
The manager (we assume), came out and said we had only been waiting 20 minutes. So... Our server waited 10 minutes to put in our order. Cool. That would make sense if this place had been busy or if they made something more time consuming than just burgers. None of our burgers were custom. 

In the end, we didn't have to pay for the fries or side salad up charge, but it was still $55 for three burgers and a kids meal and about an hour and a half of wasted time. 

Super disappointed. 
Pro tip: don't order the Pumpkin Spice Latte shake, its soooooo spicy it burns your throat.

Underwhelmed. The reviews were great but the experience was not the same as I read. Got the French dip, wife the Greek salad and the kiddos turkey club. No worries on the turkey club but the French dip was on the menu as "fat" but was not quite up to that name. Very good quality meats used. Greek salad not up to par. Unbalanced portions of items, tons of the lettuce. Staff was forgetful, prices a tad high but somewhat understandable as the quality of meats, breads, etc were good. 2:45pm on a Saturday and they were out of soup (Clam Chowder). :(

I've been here a couple of times and the food was decent. I mean I don't have super high expectations for drive-thru Chinese food. BUT... this time I ordered three bowls through drive-thru and they tasted terrible. Hard noodles, hard rice and the shrimp and chicken tasted old. You should really monitor the quality of your food and the length of time after it's cooked to not get people sick.

We had a great dinner at Sa-Wad-Dee tonight.  It had been years since I had been there (like over a decade), so I was not sure what to expect.  I am happy to report that everything we had tonight was really good.  We stared off with a simple California Roll, since it was happy hour, and everything was fresh, and simplistically delicious.  For Dinner, I had "Shrimp in the Mud" (Medium Spicy), and my wife had Yellow Currie, spiced up to "Spicy".  Both dishes were great (sorry, forgot to take photos), although the Yellow Currie was spicy enough slow down the conversation quite a bit.  All in all, a very nice dinner.  Great service, and a nice atmosphere too.  We highly recommend!



[ Observation of the day:  Whiteboards are... (wait for it...) remarkable. ]
Great food.  Enjoyed both sushi and thai.  Good happy hour prices on sushi. definitely recommended.

The food here is really good so it sucks that the service is horrific in the restaurant. Waaaay overpriced as well. The nachos are really good but I mean the half order is $12, what you would expect to pay for a full order and we added chicken, it was literally 1/3 a cup on the whole thing and we were charged $3 extra. So $15 for a half order of nachos with chicken. My sandwich with a handful of fries was $13.50 and the meat was kind of fatty. Husbands sandwich was like $12. 2 year old son had a cheese quesadilla. All the kids meal was was a cheese quesadilla. No drink no fries and it was $5!!!!!! I should have made and brought my own! We even ordered water to save on the bill and still ended up with a $50 bill. Ridiculous. Save your money and go elsewhere for food!!
Got an auto loan from Casey at this branch yesterday and he was fast, courteous and personable. Couldn't ask for a better experience. Love ICCU!

I give them three stars not because of their customer service, because they are friendly, but because they do not give you the correct information on how to care for your fish, etc. 

I was recently there as a newbie for owning a large fish tank and tropical fish (I've only many betta fish only) and I was told that my betta fish (one only) could live amongst the other tropical and non aggressive fish. I was elated! This lasted about two weeks and now my betta might die because of some weird fungus that he got from being in a tank with other fish like mollies, etc-and yes, my tank is clean! 

When I called the pet smart in Boise, a young man told me that that is the issue and I was to never mix them all together; that betta fish easily get sick from being around the other fish. 

FYI, I know we expect people to know what they're talking about when working in a particular area or field, but we can't rely on them to properly do their job. Do your research!

I popped into this gym looking for free weights and a step mill. It had those things and more. The equipment was well maintained, clean, and the staff was friendly. I was happy to see a room with kettle bells, bosu balls, and real pull up bars. Only four stars because there was only one step mill.

Finally! A soup, salad, and sandwich spot that ALSO HAS THE MOST DELECTABLE TREATS and freshly-baked breads I've ever witnessed and an atmosphere that's cozy enough for a solo-study date or an evening out with friends. They're open early and stay open fairly late! I think I have found my spot! Did I mention they have a drive-thru and sample plates always out? Win, win, win! 

Food: I am so impressed. They boast a menu with many items to choose from and ones that are fully customizable to you. I love how many daily soups they have! I ordered a half southwest BBQ chicken salad, and it was delicious. It had corn, black beans, avocado, tomato, grilled chicken, and even a sweet cilantro dressing. The half order was plenty! I also added a cup of chicken noodle soup, which had big chunks of carrots but was a little bland, but I look forward to trying other soups in the future. 

Drinks: self-serve soda, tea and coffee. They also have espresso drinks, smoothies and frappes. 

Atmosphere: I love how it's a cafe, eatery, and a little home decor shop! It definitely feels cozy and warm with it's dim lighting and rich, sweet, fresh bread smells. Some of the tables are a little close together, but if you're lucky enough to snag a booth you'll be set. It's hard to not drool all over the bakery display! I hear they are packed around lunchtime but are not too busy in the evenings--that's a great time to go! 

Service: I was very impressed by the service. I spoke to 2 associates, both who were friendly, answered my questions (I had a lot because I'm picky), and even let me sample some non-sample items. Very kind service, indeed! 

Happy Hour Offerings: n/a

Healthy Hack: rotating soup specials for the picky/low-cal eater. They always have at least one broth-based soup, which is nice. 

Tips: n/a

really good food! the prawns were great! perfectly cooked! hubby had fish tacos, yumm!!!! and our son loved his byo burger and fries. of course we ordered a flight but alas... too hoppy for us! waiter was the bomb!!! good family restaurant overall!!!

Best sandwiches in the entire treasure valley! That is not debatable. I just discovered that DoorDash will deliver to my work and I am so jacked!!! Never again will I be stuck at the office and have to order that garbage Jimmy Johns because they deliver. Screw Jimmy Johns.
I came here for the first time and got the pad Thai with a level 3 heat and it's great, very good flavors will come back.

Excellent sandwiches.
Definitely going back again.
Enjoyed the experience. It is busy but I didn't mind waiting a bit longer to get my Rueben.

I have been coming to this Kneaders for a few years and something was very different.  Usually things are clean and the food taste wonderful.  However,  this time the parking lot and inside was dirty and trash scattered. Food  was cold and wasn't even good. What happen? I miss the clean and wonderful food guys.

We just moved to Eagle Idaho and one of the many things we have to find with a new pet groomer. We struck gold first time as these people are great.
That communication is great they turned up on time, we have two elderly cats who needed a lion cut and as weak know cats are not always the easiest :-)
They did an amazing job the cats are so happy and I was able to go in to that mobile which was very clean. We also have two dogs I won't hesitate to use Aussie Pet Mobile again
So delicious! Staff is so wonderful! (Mina was great! So helpful in our decision). We will be back!!!

I am from Pennsylvania, live in Utah right now. We went up to visit my boyfriend's family and loved it! Our ages ranged from 7-63 years old and we all had something to do! I was so happy they brought us there.

Defiantly not authentic, definitely not homemade, if you are in a pinch, maybe, just maybe, however, they lack flavor and spices. For those anticipating a legitimate taqueria for Meridian, unfortunately, we'll have to keep waiting.
Service is great but so far the best sandwich I've tried is the Ruben. I've tried about 4 different sandwiches and was a tad disappointed but the Ruben keeps me going back!

Just finished having a great meal at Grants! I had Pork Chops with Stuffing and Green Beans. My wife had the special, Salmon Fish and Chips. She said the fish "melts in your mouth". The Pork Chop was cooked to perfection and was a nice thick cut. The stuffing was delightful and was topped with a Carmel sauce. The green beans were crisp and very good. Grants is my new favorite place to eat!

Meh.  Shakes are pretty good, but the burger was absolutely killed by smashing it until it was way too dry.  Extremely tasteless too.  Been there several times hoping each time it will be better, but unfortunately not.  Fries are consistently undercooked and everything is just way too bland and dry.  Won't be returing.
I've lived and worked all over the country and this is one of the best sandwich joints I've ever been to - I'm hooked on the Trevor Melt!

Dr. Guymon and his staff are the best! They've done a great job on our boy's braces, and he replaced my retainers as well. We won't go anywhere else!

Thanks Dr. G and staff!

Sooo good! Better than any other pizza around and they have great prices to make it even better! We got a a pizza and my husband had the meatball sub. We have ordered quite a few times now and will continue to go back! Great size and quality for the price!
Good service, very friendly, prices are fair and the donuts are goooood. Best I've had in Meridian.

Seriously this place is awesome! My hubby and I were looking for a place to grab a quick dinner after a long day of work and meetings. We walked in and were immediately greeted by the super friendly owner! He recognize my husband from eating their months previously, and immediately started to banter with both of us while figuring out what we were interested in for dinner. I got the meatball sub and my husband got the Wally. Both were wonderful! Coming from an Italian family I had some pretty high expectations for the meatball sandwich, and it was almost as good as my grandmothers! Although we all know that nothing can ever compare to grandmas food. The sauce was out of this world! And when I asked for a little bit more for my sandwich he gave me a bowl! The meatballs were seasoned perfectly and had large chunks of fresh garlic, Yum! They were cooked perfectly not too tough or chewy, and the sauce complemented them perfectly! If you have not tried this place you need to get here!

I hate to admit it - but this MERIDIAN restaurant is the best Thai food in the greater Boise area. I will drive ALL THE WAY FROM DOWNTOWN BOISE to eat here. I usually get a traditional Thai dish, and haven't tried their extensive cocktail menu because of the driving - but everything looks impressive. Service is friendly and accommodating, and prices are affordable for what you get.

Everyone who lives west of Eagle Road should be thanking their lucky stars for this place!
This is probably the best Thai food I've found in town. The Pad Thai is very good and the Thom Kah is fantastic!

I purchased 2 oscillating sprinkler heads (Orbit brand) one day this Spring.  Now, 2 weeks later one falls apart so I immediately took it back, unfortunately without a receipt.  The clerk asked for my drivers license and proceeded to fill out a merchandise return form.  Then the clerk took the broken head together with the packaging (which I always keep) to compare to what was on the rack in the store that day.  She brought back what they had, an identical head with one exception, the lower gasket was white instead of black but otherwise the same head.  I was definitely unprepared for what came next.  

The clerk began a string of intimations as to my not having purchased the head there, that I wasn't being honest with them, that I was trying to take advantage of the store by returning something without the original receipt, during which all of this I was becoming more embarrassed and angry by the word.  I asked to see the manager but she said no.  I asked for my property back and told her I would leave but NO, she wasn't through yet so as she was launching into her next string about how dishonest I was being she did say she would provide the exchange but, by that time I wanted nothing to do with her or with Zamzows.  I asked 4 or 5 times, first quietly and a bit louder every time I had to repeat myself for the head back so that I could leave.  Nothing, so I finally had to shout, "JUST GIVE ME THE SPRINKLER BACK SO THAT I CAN GET THE HELL OUT OF HERE!"  I actually had to lean over the counter and take the head from her, grab my packaging, turn and leave.

Upon returning home I located the second head's packaging (identical to the first) upon which I had stapled the original receipt.

I will be visiting the store manager tomorrow.  In the meantime I went over to Home Depot and purchased the identical sprinkler head for at least 30% less than the Zamzows price.

I have been a customer of this store for years utilizing the pet grooming services and purchasing pet food for the very most part.  No more.

First off, the food is OK. Never bad, but never, "wow this is great!". The main reason for the rating is the price- it is extremely expensive. They have no real 'lunch' menu. Be prepared to pay full plate prices for your hamburger if you go there at lunchtime. The staff is great, but I would really like to see a more robust lunch menu offering.

Pretty good burger.  I like the "char" flavor.  Fries were decent too.  I don't know if I'll go back or not, since there are other burger places close by that are better (IMO only).  I like the comment from another reviewer:  "Glad we tried it, but it wasn't memorable."

Wow. This was my first time trying Hugo's and I can definitely say I was not disappointed. I had the Italian and an order of their Deli fries, which are huge! Both were delicious. This is a great spot for lunch and I will definitely be coming back in the near future!

What a great spot! Good outdoor seating on a nice day. The inside is your basic bar setting but don't let it fool you - the food is great!!
