I had the reuban with a side salad - both were delicious!!!! My fiance had a blt with fries - YUM! The fries were especially good, cut fresh daily and served with a tasty "fry sauce" on the side!
Tammy helped us. She was so nice and friendly!!
We will be back next time we're in town... hopefully for some music out on the great outdoor patio!
I just discovered this restaurant in Meridian. Freshly made and delicious. I recommend "the heat" burger.

Find it difficult to believe they are so successful with business that they turn down reservations. Called in hours before wanting to go in with 10 people and were told it would be 8:30PM before they could accommodate 10 people. What happens if a group of 10 walks in without a reservation? Do they get turned away?

Table for 5 with the team from work, 2 burgers were cooked too pink, but they were very nice to fix it quickly and added some shakes to compensate, service is excellent, clean and fun environment. I'm giving 5 star because no place is perfect at all times but The Counter knows how to right a problem, and the recipes are delicious.
This location has some of the freshest fast food in the area. I can't speak to other PE restaurants, but this one is consistently good and the staff friendly.

This restaurant can land anywhere between and 3 and a 5 depending on who's working so I'm going with a 4 in hopes that it will soon bump up to a 5 for good. 

I have dropped in here and ordered drive through on a couple of occasions. The food here is great - I love the Turkey Bacon Avocado sandwich, like many of the reviewers here and I also love the Turkey Cranberry Sunflower salad - SO good. I love the fact that their turkey is not sliced up deli turkey but true, roasted, chunky turkey. MMM. Just perfect. 

The portions are HUGE, I cannot finish the salad OR the sandwich by myself in one sitting - which is good - I can share with a friend or have tasty leftovers! The pastries that I've tried are okay - they just taste like store-bought pastries. Nothing too special. 

One thing I really love about this place is the cozy feel it has too it. It just reminds me of being home (except it's better decorated :P) and the food feels homey too. 

The only thing that needs work is SOME of the service there. Its really hit and miss, there are a handful of people there who are really great and there are a couple people there who have forgotten items of mine and who also don't appreciate time management very well. 

It's worth a try and it's a nice meal to have when you cant figure out what else to do.

Wal-mart is Wal-mart. There is nothing that makes this one Wal-mart stand out from the rest. It is one of the newer buildings so it is clean and well organized.  For whatever reason the checkout lines are always slow.

Amazing every time I go in. Chef Wally is a man he is super friendly and helpfull :) you've gotta try the Trevor melt and the Viking, but pretty much anything on the menu is beyond amazing. Soup of the day is always wonderful and you've got to try the potato salad, it is to die for!!!

These young tech savvy guys are doing it more than right. They were unable to fix my daughters phone after she spilled Sprite all over it- so they didn't charge me. Her SIM card was accidentally left out of her phone when they gave it back. When I realized and called they delivered it to my house within an hour. Yes that's right- delivered it to my house WITHIN THE HOUR and I live a good half an hour from their store! If one of our phones breaks again I'm heading straight back to Rockstar. Highly recommend!

The tacos are amazing, but they definitely need to clean up the restuarant.  We went last night, teenagers running it, not very friendly   or good customer service and the place was a mess. Dirty tables and floors, we ate quickly and left.
Tonight we tried Boise Fry Co. for the first time. The burgers were delicious, the fries were exceptional, and so was the service.

We pulled our motor home into the wallyworld parking lot, spied Marco's Pizza, and decided to give them a try. So glad we did. We just finished a delicious chicken fresco; great crust, fresh ingredients, and really cheesy!!! It was one of the best pizzas we've had in a long time. It was done exactly when we walked in the door. The staff was very friendly. We highly recommend!!!

This is the best place to buy fries on top of amazing fries it has a variety of dipping sauces for fries. I recommend the sweet potato fries and the duckfat fries. As far as seating the inside is a bit crowded but there is outside seating to make up for it. My kids love the blueberry ketchup! The only thing that I don't like is we're from
Cali so we can't come often as we'd like

This was the third time I have been here. The second visit I said "never again". But if was close by and my husband wanted to go. 
It's tired, the impression you get when you sit down is that it's not very clean. The furnishings really need updating. I had the steak burrito and it was not very tasty, quite greasy. The peppers were coated in grease of some kind. The beans were bland. Service was fast. Now I husband agrees with me- never again.
This place is extremely slow and the staff are unfriendly. We sat in the drive thru line for 20 minutes waiting for three desserts. They need new management badly!

What I enjoy most is that they let you choose your own toppings, bun, etc. It is a little pricey for a burger- $12 or more and that's without French fries. I did order a medium burger and its was cooked well-done. Any burger or steak person knows that's a crime and affects the taste tremendously (but perhaps they were having an off day- I'll have to go back and investigate). I wish they had other cooking oil options besides soybean oil as I'm allergic to it. But they do have gluten free buns, and sesame free buns which are both still hard to find these days. Although overcooked, the burger I had did seem fresh as well as the grilled pineapple.  I'll go back and give them another chance and will update this post.

Great deli sandwiches and fantastic fries! They tasted like deep fried chicken. I had a turkey sandwich with added cranberries mmm tasted like Thanksgiving leftovers! My husband had the Hugo and it was delicious too. Kind of pricey for two sandwiches, drink and half lb of fries was $18 nut you get what you pay for! If you're sick of subway and want good local deli food go here!

Took my little buddy for a few hours of bowling for some guy time.  He chose Big Als over Pins.  I really like the place over all. Service 3 stars, food 3 stars, atmosphere 4 stars, and cost 2 stars.  2 games with shoe's, 6 wings fries, and 2 soft drinks... Just over $40 bucks.  So call ahead for specials or you will over pay like we did.

Great food and service. I had the vegetable plate with chicken and brown rice. The flavors were fantastic, the chicken not over cooked and the vegetables were fresh. My only slight complaint was that the rice was not warm. I will be back to try other dishes.

I had a coupon for a free bowl today from T-Mobile so I tried out this Panda Express as I was out and about for lunch. I had the mushroom chicken and it was delicious! The restaurant was very clean and the service was brisk. My only comment would be that the serving size of the chicken to Rice could be larger.

.Two of my favorite meats are here: smoked brisket and pulled pork. I was so pleased with my burrito (from earlier this week) that I wondered if the Qdoba tacos could possibly be as good.
.Stopped in Saturday night, after 8:00 pm. I was tired and hungry after an evening of doing massage work. Ordered three different tacos, made exactly as suggested on the taco menu.
.It's noteworthy that none of these tacos had ground beef, or ground anything. Pretty bold I would say. Instead, the Two Timer had pulled pork... the Gladiator had steak... the Triple Threat had steak. When I saw them making the tacos with tortillas - more like fajitas - my skepticism flared up. This can't be that good... but after eating a few bites, it really was that good. It was marvelous.
.Don't care for adventure when ordering tacos? You can have them custom build one for you. For example, they can fill a hard shell with any grilled meat, lettuce, tomato, and cheese.
.I was the only customer there, and my server was a bit chatty, maybe lonely for someone to talk to. You probably won't get that attention here during lunch hour, when they are rushing.

We always have a great experience at Sa-Wad-Dee and tonight was no exception.  Yes, the location is a little odd and from the outside it's hard to tell exactly what it's like but the food and service are great.  We had 2 sushi rolls off of their happy hour menu ($7/each) as an appetizer and then Pad Thai with tofu and garlic noodles with shrimp.  Both were delicious and we brought home enough for lunch tomorrow.  Service was fast and friendly.  We'll be back!

Great food, great service. A local gem! The pork chop is a favorite. Finished with a brown sugar glaze that is not too sweet, but rather a great accompaniment. Wines by the glass are limited but offer unique selections with something for everyone.

We were visiting Boise last weekend and we like to try local places so this fit the bill. I got a Classic with purple fries thin cut. The burger was pretty basic, no complaints. The purple fries were good and they give you a ton of them. I loved all the options of seasonings and dipping sauces, that was super cool. I sprinkled my fries with the garlic rosemary season and it was delish. I had some garlic aoli and blueberry ketchup with them. I think they were a teensy bit overpriced but overall I was happy we tried them.
Went for lunch today and almost immediately lost my appetite. This is the salad they served me (see picture).  There is no excuse for serving a rotten salad.

I would give them zero stars as we could not eat there. A Saturday night at 8:55 pm we were informed kitchen was closed. Website claims they are open to 10:00. Young man at front was rude and said it did not matter. We came all the way across town for dinner here. So sad for an utter disappointment and horrible customer service.

I love burgers, this place has great options. Never had the same combo twice. It is a little pricey but you get great quality and decent size. I love the onion strings too. Turkey burgers are very tasty - you almost don't realize it isn' beef. In fact I took half a turkey burger home to my hubby and he ate it and loved it and then I told him it was turkey. Will keep going back!
Great selection, great quality of food.  Just a real good locally owned place to eat.  I always get the #12.

I had to wait at the changing room for 15 minuets you need to get better staff plus they were not helping me they sat back and talk about phones I'm very unhappy at the staff of your store. Taking for ever to help me and they did not talk to me and say how was my day. Very unprofessional of your store

I've heard so many good things about Boise Fry Company in general so I have been dying to try it out. Unfortunately I left a bit disappointed. I had the vegan burger (Hot) with the sweet potatoes, regular cut to go. The burger was pretty good but the fries were very greasy so if you're watching what you eat then that is something to consider. 
The fries were a good portion but I didn't eat very much of the fries because as I said they were a little bit too greasy for me. The burger was made of black beans and had blueberry sauce and some yummy spicy stuff. I'd give just the burger a four! 

The guy who cooked my fries and gave me my order was super friendly and left a good impression, however the teenager  who took my order wasn't too inviting. While I was there I used the restroom and it was pretty clean and the restaurant in itself was pretty clean. 
I was left a bit disappointed because I was expecting something a little bit healthier but if you don't mind greasy fries and interesting seasonings, such as blueberry ketchup and vanilla sea salt, then go for it!

This hotel was horrible.. The rooms are small, smelled bad. There is drug user all over the place. There was a drunk guy at the back of the hotel with a 5th of something in his hand. He was barely able to stand up right. The staff is horrible and lazy. I asked for an extra bed the "cleaning crew" brought a bed down, the bed was not made.the "cleaning crew" handed me a stack of sheets and blankets for me to make the bed. The "cleaning crew" looks like a bunch of twerkers same with the front staff. Horrible customer service. The manager Jamie is completely rude, she needs to leave the definition of customs service.

I was looking for a deli to replace the one I left behind when I moved back home and WOW did Fat Guy's deliver! I got a ham and cheese on sourdough with pepper jack cheese and the potato salad. The wait for the food wasn't too long, and since it was the lunch rush I wasn't worried about it. The sandwiches came out and that first bite was heaven! The second bite was heaven and every bite after that was just as good.

The potato salad however was a letdown. It tasted great, but the portion was smaller than expected and the potatoes were undercooked and very crunchy. I tried several bites from the portion I was given and they were all the same, undercooked, crunchy, inedible potatoes.

I will definitely be going back soon, but I will be trying the coleslaw next time. Thanks for the sandwich, it was AMAZING!
When I crave pancakes...go to the best place in town, right here! I've never had issues and I would highly recommend going for the all you can eat pancakes! Yummy!!

On a celebratory lunch with a group of coworkers, we made a reservation days ahead to make sure they could handle 15.  Upon arriving to a mostly empty restaurant, but we're ushered to a cold back corner.  Took 30 minutes to get the server to come take our order, then another 30 minutes to get the food.  The good was good, only one missed order, but we had to eat quickly, then ask for checks.  Several people were charged dinner prices for lunch items, but by that time many had to get back quickly for meetings.  Won't be going there for lunch any more.

So, now that my fiance and I found this place we can't help but go there at least once a week.  Everything that we've had there has been super yummy.  The presentation is off the hook and the decor is wonderful.  I love all the attention to detail that the owners put into developing this resteraunt.

My fav dishes are the Larb chicken salad, the Crunchy Flowers, their sushi is fantastic, Thai Iced Tea, Pad Thai....etc... You'll definitely be satisfied eating here!

This place has taken a serious fall from grace since they moved to this new location. I think they were much better years ago when they were at the location on Fairview across from Krispy Kreme. The parking situation sucks, the layout is weird and feels cramped, the food is mediocre at best, and the service seems just as mediocre. The pizza I had was pretty bland and unremarkable. The nachos were terrible, as they didn't even melt the toppings onto the chips. The salsa tasted like some weird cross between pizza sauce and chopped up tomatoes. If you're looking for a good pizza, keep going right on past this place. Much better local options available than this place.

The food here is awesome, and the employees have always been nice when I've been here. I always go through the drive-thru, and although it's a little bit of a wait, it's worth it! I haven't had one thing I haven't liked.

This place serves a pretty tasty burger!  Only down side are the prices.  You pay a lot for toppings and any side dishes that should come free with the burger.  The waitress tried to charge us for ordering a soda water with a lemon in it.  Other than that, the last serving us was really friendly. 

Good burgers with a variety of toppings, but a bit too spendy to return.

This was my first experience ordering with The Counter. I tried the turkey slider at a realty event and was impressed and since I work right across the street from them decided to finally give them a try. It's hella cold, so I used the online ordering platform which was fairly simple. They aren't "cheap" ($10 for my meal) but the portions are large and it's quality meat and veggies. It took less than 12 minutes to complete my order. I walked over and paid. They were pretty slow (1pm on a Tuesday in December) but everyone's meals looked great. It's not convenient that drinks and sides are sold separately, but like I said, really tasty food. Will definitely be back.

Extremely bad service at the restaurant. We placed our drink order and it took twenty minutes to get water.  After 30 minutes we spoke with the manager who blamed his people.   Ironically it took twenty minutes to get water but within two minutes of getting our food were presented with the bill. 

The manager offered us a free dessert for us to split (really?) which was never communicated to the other staff. Fun arcade but for the love of all that's good don't eat here.

Best sandwiches in Boise. I'll gladly go out of my way to get a sandwich from here. Potato salad is freshly made and delicious, and the coleslaw is crisp with a wonderful tangy flavor. My favorite so far has to be the PC Pedro. It has turkey, bacon, havarti cheese and tangy horseradish. The bacon they use is the real thick bacon, not the thin crispy strips most places use. Oh. Em. Gee. This sandwich is so good. I've also had their Asian chicken wrap and french dip and both were very good. A little more than you'd pay most other places but very much worth the price for a great sandwich and supporting a local business. The place has a very chill decor theme and nice TV showing sports. They serve beer too.

I've eaten here many times for lunch as it's quite close to my office. It's a great place for a sandwich. I have come to like Number 19 so much (Bob's Fav) that I haven't tried anything else in quite some time. I always order my sandwich as a wrap and I recommend the wrap option if you don't want to get filled up on bread.

The owner is a nice, hard working, fun guy and I think his dedication is reflected in the quality of his menu items.

There are not a whole lot of seats, but I've never had trouble getting a place to sit. The order line can get kind of long at lunch time rush hour, but it always seems to go pretty quick. They take your name at the counter and will bring you your order when it's ready.

Sandwich options come with potato salad or chips. I'm not a fan of the potato salad... There's nothing wrong with it, it's just not my favorite style.

This is one of my go-to places for a lunchtime sandwich.

The best, most consistent burger in the area! It seems like I eat here weekly. The char burger without cheese, the albacore sandwich, onion rings, and fries are always perfect.  I really don't understand how somebody could give anything less than 5 stars, so great.
Super nice staff, but food was way too salty to enjoy. We were visiting from out of town and saw the place had good reviews so maybe it was just an off day?

Awesome Food...  Took our daughter there after she returned from living in Far East for 3 years.  "The Best Thai food I have had since returning to the US!"  That pretty much sums it up.... Tom Yum Soup is my personal favorite....  But the Volcano is something to "light up" too.
Best tai food in Boise, my boyfriend and I go at least once a month, definitely a must go if you're visiting the area or wanting some good tai food!!

After hearing great things about the Tin Roof Tacos location in Boise, we were excited to give this place a try. I ordered a roasted corn taco and a pulled pork taco, and my husband ordered fish and shrimp tacos.  The roasted corn was good, but really skimpy on filling. The pulled pork taco was filled nicely, and the pickled onions topping it were delicious. My husband didn't think much of his order, and said that he wouldn't order the same again.  All of our tacos were cold, which was disappointing. 

We also got the chips & queso, and the queso was really good - and piping hot! I found that funny, since the tacos weren't warm at all. 

We went in on a Sunday, and the staff consisted of 6 young people who were nice, but weren't paying attention to busing the tables or cleaning the floor. The place was pretty dirty, and we had to ask to have our table wiped off before sitting down. 

Another weird thing - there is still blue painters tape all along the bottom of the walls. This place opened in May. Now it's August, and there is painters tape everywhere? Is there no owner or manager who oversees what this place looks like? Really strange. With the proper management, this place could be really good.

Got seated by 8:45. Nobody was there to take our order until 9:10. There were around 6 groups of customers, and at least 5 servers walking around. Funny almost each of them made eye contact with us and yet no sign of anyone coming over. My friend and I had a movie to catch at 10:15 so we left. Don't think they acknowledged us until the end. Maybe because we weren't white? Who knows.

WORST SERVICE EVER!!!! We waited 15 minutes and not even a glass of water. With only five other tables occupied and three servers plus a bartender you would think someone would notice you. Even the table next to us was complaining how slow the service was. We got up and walked out and nobody even made an effort to see if there was anything wrong.

Best build your own burger joint! Get over the price issue people. I bet if you got a burger at any of the other yuppy high end restaurants in the village they would cost just as much or more, and taste half as good. If you want a cheap burger go to McDonald's they have 39 cent cheeseburgers every Sunday! Haha

Awesome Thai place! Super friendly staff! We live just down the street and took us about four years to check it out and now regret we waited so long to try it! Super yummy pad Thai and angry fried rice! Sushi is really good too!

Booked thru Priceline for a total of $70.97 after taxes. At first, I wasnt super impressed, as we had paid less for better earlier in our trip. When we arrived, the front desk person was nice. Check in was quick enough. Check out is 11am, which is a tad bit earlier than we would have liked, and the breakfast was a little lacking. No meats, just waffles, biscuits and gravy, scrambled eggs, and lots of carbs. 
The room was decent. The bed was comfortable and the towels were soft. Would I rate this place 2.5 stars, probably not, but it wasn't horrible.

This place is awesome...especially if you're in a group as they have a little something for everyone--a myriad of pizza, pasta, sandwiches, salads and soup.  They are sit down with a fun ambiance (rustic with all kinds of white water rafting paraphernalia) and great service.  I went with a party of nine and our wait person was not only friendly but adeptly accommodated our larger group (even with splitting checks--and on a Saturday night!  Still friendly, attentive, and prompt).  I ordered the "fern creek" sandwich, which was fabulous (sourdough focaccia with avocado, red onion, tomatoes, sprouts, jack, and a light pesto mayonnaise--seriously marvelous).  Their sandwiches come with a side of their signature Whitewater corn chips, which honestly I could have done without (I think I ate one--I mean corn chips?  Really?).  Their pizzas are ample--we ordered a large which fed four hungry teenage boys with a slice to spare.  Another member of our party ordered their Penne Pesto, which he raved about (the serving was hearty and apparently delicious).
 
Other notes:  Though their online menu does not reflect it, they do serve beer and wine.  We ordered regular crust for our pizza (as it was what the teenage boys requested) but they do also offer a sourdough crust which sounded intriguing.  And, in addition to kid friendly pizza, they also have a separate kids menu (featuring all the kid faves...mac and cheese, spaghetti, and even a peanut butter and honey pizza).  

Overall a solid choice for groups and definitely a cut above many of the other family friendly pizza joints in town.

What a hidden gem in the Treasure Valley! We were blown away by the value -- the price gets you an incredible amount of food and we haven't had sandwiches that good since... well, ever. It's a new go-to stop for sure. My huz had the Italian and I went for the Silver Duck. The sandwiches were piled high with meat and delicious sauces. We had enough to take home. The potato salad side is a must! Best sandwich shop hands down.
Great food (as always) and great service. Clean and chill environment. Sophia was at the register and was very friendly and dope, 10/10 would recommend.

I have eaten here many times and have never had a bad experience. The staff is nice, the decor is appropriate, and the owners well lets just say know what they are doing. Keep in mind that most people that rate restaurants only do so when they are not happy, and when dealing with the mass amount of people this restaurant does you can not help but have one or two here and there. Give them a try you will not be unhappy!

I just relocated from San Antonio, Texas & I was searching for a local coffee place to get attached to for my study purposes. The girls at the counter were wonderfully sweet and the coffee was fantastic! I will definitely be going back :)

Great mix of Thai and sushi- fun drinks! They have combos that have an app, soup, entree and ice cream- nice way to try something new! Slightly pricey for the amount of food you get, no to-go boxes needed since you will likely eat the smallish portions while there. Great curry and nice heat on the dishes and soups!

Wow. Terrible service. Seems like the drive thru is more important than the line of customers to the door. Not to mention they are frequently out of food  which means another 10 minute wait after the 20 min wait in line. Bummer. Never coming back. I would rather drive to the one on Fairview at least it's staffed.
Pretty disappointed tonight. It's game night and I'm fairly certain they've only got two servers in the restaurant. Feeling pretty hungry and pretty sorry for our waitress.

I absolutely loved my pedicure from Tumy. She even shaped my sad looking finger nails.  Hand and foot massage was perfect for this relaxing Sunday. 
My mother had Ha and she said he was great too.
We are definitely coming back again!
Super fun place to take the kids and treat them with dinner and bowling.  Awesome summer deals for kids bowling.

The service and food was really good. This was the first time there. The gentleman that took the order was really helpful and made a suggestion. The French dip to not have the regular one but to have the number 16 which my cousin said was really good. I had a number 14 which was really good too.

Great selection of the best sandwichs ever designed. The owner/chef makes everyone feel welcome, whether you are new to the place or a die-hard regular. 
I would be shocked if anyone tried this place and could find at least a couple sandwiches that they loved.
Highly recommend place.

This is the place to go for great sandwiches and soups! We tried the bronco bleu, #16 dip (can't remember the name), and another cold sandwich along with the tomato and chicken/veggie soup. They were all great. And the owner made the experience even better. What a character :) I will definitely be back!

I thought it was overpriced and overcrowded. That said, it felt cleaner than jumping in the river, and the kids really loved it. Don't forget warm towels - even on hot days it gets breezy at the top of the stairs and the kids were cold. Also sunscreen. So important.

We went here for dinner tonight as a party of 10. I was nervous after reading all of the reviews but we took a leap of faith. We had a reservation and although they were very busy we were seated in a timely manner. The service itself wasn't amazing which is why I went 4 stars, but I would say the food is a 5! I had the carne asada, and the meat was perfect. The fries with horseradish aioli were delicious. The staff was nice but seemed to be a bit short staffed.  It is pricey so I wouldn't go often, but we enjoyed ourselves.

I drove by this establishment a few months ago and was intrigued by the cute little outdoor seating area.  I did some research online and discovered it's been here for a little but and I had never noticed it!  Although at the time it had mixed reviews, our family's experience here was outstanding.  This is  a very small restaurant/pub in a strip mall.  They have a lovely wooden, covered outdoor sitting area.  I like the small, casual yet quality atmosphere.  We chose to sit "outside" and although it was raining, the heaters were enough to keep us warm; but there are also lap blankets for your use.  Our server was kind and informative, telling us that most of the items are scratch made and carefully selected.  We had the charcuterie board which had homemade duck jerky, smoked fish, homemade salami, nuts, fruit, cheeses and it was outstanding.  We also had a NY steak entree (scalloped potatoes & steamed brocolli) that was delicious and served medium rare (as ordered) and 2 hamburgers that were cooked to order, hand cut fries and creme brulee.  The beer and wine selection is really good too.  I felt the pricing was on par with the quality of food prepared and served and we can't wait to take our parents here to dine.  We though everything was quite delicious and plated nicely. It is a wonderful addition to the neighborhood since we live quite nearby.  We loved it, our kids loved; this is right up our alley!
Excellent food excellent service very quick! The buffet was yummy!! Most definitely would return if I lived out here!

I am writing this review at 4:39 PM because my family went to Fat Guy's in hopes of securing some sandwiches for dinner only to find out the staff decided to close early, even with us unloading in the parking lot.  It's especially frustrating since we arrived at 4:30 and the close at 5.  I was told the place had great sandwiches but I'm content to go to Rudy's where the service is always outstanding.

I was in town on business and needed a lunch that wasn't a chain. Tried the #2 Turkey Club. Lots of meat/toppings with tasty challa bread. Had the slaw as a side. Would have been 5 stars but the slaw is shredded rather large so the delicious dressing isn't enough to flavor it beyond a couple chews. Would go back
I don't know how they do it. Delicious and the prices are so reasonable. The name suits them.

Very unprofessional. Arrived at 4pm to their tire & lube service center that closed at 6pm. After waiting for 15 minutes without being helped, when I finally was, I was turned away and denied service by the less than friendly employee who said they could not get me in for a simple tire rotation. She claimed "I need to be out of here by 6pm, so we can't get you in". Thanks for wasting my time. I will take my business elsewhere from now on.
Good old Mexican food. If you're looking for nice cheesy not super healthy Mexican food, this is a great place.

I wasn't impressed with their French toast not to mention they tasted like the griddle/other food. I've had their pancakes (not this location) and really liked those and I'm not a pancake fan... however I love me some sourdough! The price is fair tho :)
Yum!!! Great food great staff!! I had the brisket sandwich and two sides, mashed potatoes and Mac n cheese. Blew my mind!

This is just great basic Mexican food.
The guacamole is made table side and is the best in Meridian.  It is more than plenty for two!
I have been to this restaurant over a dozen times and never disappointed.
The servers are great and Eddy is so friendly.  Today we had a new server named Pepe and he did a great job. 
Great prices and the margaritas are not bad either.

I was super excited about the Hugo's opening on Linder b/c I love the Fairview location. However, I will not return to the one on Linder. I went there 3 times. The only time my order was correct was the first time when they had a staff member helping from their Fairview store--helping with transition I suspect b/c the store was newly opened. The second time I got a BLT without lettuce and it had lettuce AND avocado tasting spread. The bread was so soaked it was not edible. Then the third time I told them about this and no offer was made for a credit toward my third meal. I barely got a "oh I'm sorry". Then, the third meal I requested no pickles and no lettuce on my chicken salad sandwich--I ended up with both. I'm really disappointed compared to the Fairview store.

Long wait for this popular chain but was pleasantly surprised - large selection of sandwiches and desserts. You would think if they are always so busy that they would work with accommodating the massive lines. Lots of kitchsy things to peruse during the long wait (maybe this is a marketing scheme).... not a place you would want to go for lunch during the work week if your time is limited.

Don't order the loaded tots!  For $9 we were delivered a tiny plate of stale tots with a small amount bacon and nearly missing cheese and scallions.  

Good burgers, good service otherwise.
Everything I have had has been top notch. The soups are always great. The reuben is best that I can remember and the silver duck is a treat as well. Cant wait to go back.

Boise Dermatology is great!  The office is pleasant and modern.  I did not have to wait past my appointment time.  Dr Brooks was thorough in her exam and took time to listen to my concerns.  She seemed very knowledgeable. I recommend her highly.

Food is great fresh and very tasty but the service is major lacking.  Person at register walks up and asked us what we wanted as she looked toward the kitchen, could barely hear her.  Then asked about the chicken salad and the manager does the same thing, barley looked at us as he walked around telling us each ingredient.  Where has the Customer Service gone?!!!  Ugh
Great food!  Clean, welcoming environment!  The grilled Albacore sandwich is amazing!
Simple, but enough variety of really good tacos. Everything I've had there has been very good. Seriously the best tacos anywhere near boise!!

Dropped in here at 1000 on a Friday. Did not expect it to be so busy!!! Wow! First tip, make an appointment. Although I didn't have an appointment they did get me in immediately. The massage chairs are LEGIT! Best ones I've encountered! The staff were all friendly and enjoyable. I'm going to bookmark this place to come again!

My family has been coming here at least once or twice a month for years now.  Excellent food with great staff.  We have tried about everything on the menu.  Always bring out of town family here and never a surprise.  Make reservations as they can get very busy.  There are times take out order can overwhelm the cook staff and it takes some time to get your order but it is rare.  Great sushi.  Prices are decent for the quantity and quality of food.  Highly recommend if you are looking for authentic Thai food.  Good happy hour specials as well.

My husband and I enjoyed the ambiance of their covered patio. The service was outstanding as were the bloody marys. My husband ordered the Monte Cristo breakfast which he did not like and they let him order something more to his liking and didn't charge us!!! I had the eggs Benedict Florentine which was great! We will be back again for sure.

So the people at this location are friendly.  The service is somewhat fast. But this is now the third time the food has let me down. It's a chain so in theory you should get sort of the same flavors no matter which location you go to. This location however has a hard time with consistency. I ordered an omelet and it came with the cheese not even slightly melted, freezing cold, which in turn made my entire omelet cold. Ordered a crepe so much oil/butter on the dish that I couldn't eat half the drenched crepe. Hashbrowns room temperature. Side order of sausage lukewarm. Please start checking food temps and hire some Cooks that can get all the food out in the right order and done well. I mean I don't have huge expectations when it comes to IHOP but come on guys.............cook the food until hot!
The ram is by far one of the best restaurants in this area. Great food and awesome drinks.

We were just visiting friends here in Meridian when we found this cute and amazing coffee house. We were here for four days and got coffee each day!! The baristas were super friendly and made a mean Americano!!

The food is absolutely fantastic and good for both people who love their food spicy and those who can't even eat black pepper. The Thai tea is a must-try, and the dessert selection is fun and original. Everything is clean, the service is great, and it's on a Pokestop! One of my favorite haunts in the Treasure Valley.

What have I been missing, my company recently moved our office to Meridian. In searching for possible lunch spots I found this gem. I have never had better curry been to lunch twice now and have had the Red and Yellow.Cooked perfectly heat index restaurant uses is 1-5 3 leaves that little burn in the back of my throat. Service attentive not pushy. Only compliant a little sparse on the meat in the lunch specials, could be why they are such a reasonable price.

Booked with expedia....Room was small...bed was too small for 2 people..description said queen bed but it looked like a full..
Our second night was awful..
Got back from our activities to an unclean, unvacummed room!  I've never stayed in a hotel where housekeeping skips rooms..we will never go back to this hotel. .bad experience.

I took my wife for drinks and appatizers we had nachos and hot wings well to start off the cooks don't care about how the food looks the nachos was some of the worst I have ever had the little chicken that was on there was dry hardly any cheese as for the wings are not hot at all so when the bartender asked how was the food we said not that great she acted like she didn't care either
Great up until trivia peeps wanted their game on the big screen so my hoop game got bumped. Lame. I've been here hours before trivia. Won't be back anytime soon...definitely not in a Tuesday.
Coffee addict. Literally, the best service and coffee I've EVER had in the treasure valley. Not to mention, it's organic. The people were so nice and the coffee was awesome quality!!

Fun on a Saturday morning when they have $2 bowling. The food is delicious as are the drinks (yes I had a before noon drink)......but the prices are way too high for the portion size. Bowling was awesome. Great staff that was friendly and didn't roll their eyes too hard when retrieving the third ball our 4 year old got stuck between the bumper. Overall super fun

biscuits and gravy, scrambled eggs, waffles and typical motel fair available at the breakfast buffet.

could've used in your showerhead, but everything else was fine for the price

Ive seen this chain before, but being from Houston I always chose to go get some authentic mexican, or tex-mex.....which btw someone actually called this tex-mex....smh noo...its not texmex...the is americanized mexican like taco bell. I had to clarify..... but I digress.  they make burritos, nachos, tacos etc... with American Ingredients and I gotta say it was pretty good for fast cheap burritos.  The Beer Cheese was delicious and the guac was decent. Being from Houston I always avoided this place because I knew it would never hold a candle to anything down there...but here in Meridian if you want better than taco bell and same as Chipotle but with different foods, then this is your place.  The staff was pretty awesome too!  Ill be coming back when Im craving a ginormous burrito with some briscuit and beer cheese!!!

Great wash and cut on my Brittany dog. Easy drop off; we discussed what I expected and she offered a clear description of all services included in the package, what could be added if I wanted to upgrade (no pressure), and a chart showing the specific length his hair would be. 
She told me it'd be a 3hr appt and that it may be less if he tolerated the blower, etc, which was great b/c then I knew about how long I had to run errands etc. I appreciated the specificity provided by the staff member in both grooming details description, as well as time estimates - a significant improvement over a prior grooming experience at a different pet retailer.

Bonus: I received a "report card" when I picked him up, telling me how he did. Our groomer staff member also reassured me that he was very well behaved for nails and the blower, which I had initially expressed concern about at drop off. I really appreciated feeling like I had a clear understanding of how he behaved and handled the new experience, as oppose to just hearing, "oh he was good." 

We will definitely be returning to this salon for our dog grooming needs!

In the barren desert that is fine dining in West meridian it is a pleasure to find a fun place to eat like Grants Neighborhood Grill. The food was excellent. the outside dining experience a lot of fun.  They had some live music playing which set a nice tone but wasn't overdone. my wife was very happy with her salmon and I'm not much of a fish guy but I thought it was delicious. I got the Cuban sandwich and it was cooked perfectly. the review complaining about smells is obviously just someone trying to sabotage the restaurant I had no problems like that at all and I have a very sensitive nose.

We decided to visit Meridian again because we just love the area and of course had to stop in and get breakfast on the way back. It was again, so delicious!!! Almost 2 years after our first trip up here... the coffee was still excellent, the bagels are absolutely amazing (one of the BEST bagel places I've had outside the NJ/NY area (I'm from the greater NY area in NJ)). We will be back again after our daughter is born and I cannot wait to come back here have breakfast! Also, the service is simply excellent. Everyone is smiling and genuine. Thank you again for a great breakfast, Blue Sky Bagels!

This restaurant gets 5 stars because it's in the greater Boise area.  If it were in a coastal city with more high quality selections of Asian dining, it would get 3 or 4 stars.
As far as Boise is concerned, this is the best Thai food around.  And it's good stuff.  Most of the negative reviews you see for SWD are regarding the non-Thai options they serve.  Who goes to a Thai restaurant and orders Sushi or Fried Chicken?  I can't comment on the quality of the Sushi or Fried Chicken (didn't even know the latter was an option) but let the first experience you have here be the Thai food.  Because it's awesome.
If you're not very adventurous, Pad Thai is always a great option for people new to Thai food.  And SWD makes a great Pad Thai.
As for those complaining about the quality of the restaurant, it's pretty typical quality for a more authentic foreign dining experience.  It's not dirty, but things are a little more packed in.  All in all, I have zero complaints about the restaurant itself.
If you want good, authentic Thai food in Boise, this is the only option.  If you want Americanized places that at best you could call "Thai influenced", look elsewhere.
If you want spotless ceilings, Christian values, and fried chicken like some reviewers apparently were... why on Earth would you think a Thai restaurant was the place to go?

The first thing my fiancé said the day I got my braces off was "so when are we going to do MY teeth???". 

I am SO HAPPY I chose Dr. Guymon's office! My dentist recommended him based on his expertise with newer types of braces. I selected lingual braces which go behind the teeth. No one even knew I was wearing them! I would casually mention 'my braces' to people and they would look at me like I had lost my mind. In order to keep up my professional appearances, it was important to me to not look younger than I am. In fact, I had been wanting braces for years but had put it off. I'm getting married this summer and now my teeth are straight and I am SO glad I did it! 

The office staff was super friendly and SOOO accommodating; I had to reschedule more than typical due to my job, and everyone was so sweet. 

Go to Dr. Guymon, you won't regret it!

I had an appointment and was taken in a half hour late. I was scheduled for a pedicure and basic manicure. The manicurist did a rush job on my manicure, cut my nails too short and didn't push the cuticle at all. She was friendly and personable which is why I gave it two stars. The pedicure more of the same. Did not have  a nail buffer to buff my nails for the manicure or the color to do a French manicure. Very disappointing. Didn't live up to the reviews.
Awesome bagels.  Always friendly service and prompt.  My favorite is the everything bagel with lox creek cheese.  So good.  Only negative is that it is hard to get in and out of that location.

At first my hubby and I weren't impressed with the fact that you are charged $2 per any additional chips and salsa and honestly, they aren't worth it to pay for any extra. The salsa is not bad, the slaw concoction is interesting in a good way, and the beans are just too "lardy" and over processed (no texture).
When we received our food we realized there isn't even any time to gobble down more than one basket of chips it was delivered so fast! Also, our food came with guacamole without an extra charge or hike in price of the food so to us this evened out any possible extra charges for chips. I had the macho burrito with chicken and overall it was good. The rice and beans on the side were subpar, but I was too busy enjoying my burrito anyways. I've had better chicken at El Gallo Giro and Chapala but this was good. The hubby had the enchiladas rancheros and he enjoyed it without any complaints. 
Our waiter was very friendly and enthusiastic. From what we overheard in the restaurant it seems this is a place where repeat customers come often. 
Overall this is a good place and worth stopping in. It's nice to have a decent mexican restaurant closer to home that we can go to. Next time we will try the margaritas - they looked good and seem to be popular. This is definitely the most alcohol based mexican restaurant I've been to in the valley.
This place may be going out off business once Panera opens across the street. Food was subpar and over priced

Probably the 3rd or 4th time here. Food is ok. Burgers need some more seasoning and the chili fries were flavorless.  If you read my reviews I'm big on helping out locals and not funding the big chains and so I come here because the burgers are hot and fresh including the bun. I had to salt up my burger. All in all place has slightly better than average burgers but a bit pricey. Every time I come I remind myself that I didn't like the natural cut fries.  I need to remember it next time.  If you wonder why I keep coming back if it's average it's because I like burgers and it's close to where I work. I need to try their shakes I heard they are good. Also I hear their corn dogs are a foot long.

Such amazing authentic Thai food!! I've never been disappointed. They have really good sushi too!! The staff is very nice and professional. Lovely atmosphere! I'm a big Thai fan and I would highly recommend this place!

The flowers only lasted 4 days. Many of the lilies didn't open and the roses were sad looking. I received them as a wedding anniversary gift and noticed they were a little droopy right off the bat. Contacted them through social media since it was a holiday weekend and was told they would follow up. It's been two weeks and no word for resolution. 

I would suggest they remove the satisfaction guarantee from their website! Asked the hubs NOT to order from them again. Heck... Albertsons' flowers are fresher and last longer! And I am good about clipping and refreshing water everyday to keep them as fresh as possible!

we had our 6 y/o sons birthay party here.  The coordinating staff was very friendly and engaged.  The party went down with out any problems.  Our attendant had the name of every kid at the party and knew who they were.   She kept the party going and on track so my wife and i could socialize.  She also informed us of each phase before it happened.  We were allowed to bring his personal cake but no other outside food was allowed.   The pizza was more than enough and we had a whole pizza to bring home.   Great Job Big Als.

Great service and immediate appointments.   Techs are competent and treat customers with appreciation.  


Truly worth your time.

I love the Boise tin roof tacos, this one is lacking in every aspect. I got 2 tacos to go and chips and guacamole. The tacos had hardly anything on them, the guacamole had no flavor wht so ever. The customer service isn't the greatest either. Didn't get greeted, no thank you, and the kids looked like they were all pissed off to be at work.

I just got done getting two piercings and it was absolutely Pleasant. Valerie, my salesperson and piercer described in full detail exactly what was going to happen so I knew exactly what to expect.
I was also offered and told about all of the discounts that were available to me while I was still there so I could purchase additional earrings as well as accessories at a discount. 
Very pleased with my experience and the exceptional customer service.

Tried this out with a group of friends and I can't say I was impressed with the food. I ordered a 1/2 lb burger on sourdough with goat cheese, grilled onions and mushrooms, with a variety of sauces to try. I got the tzatziki sauce, pesto, and chipotle aioli. These were the shining stars in an otherwise un impressive meal. When it came out it looked good. I ordered it medium rare, what I got was raw burger. It was lightly browned on the outside and completely raw. I don't send things back, in fact I'm the guy that usually will accept a wrong order so I don't have to wait for another one or worry about them spitting in my food in retaliation. However, this was inedible and the look on our waiters face was one of embarrassment and horror. I re-received my meal just as everyone else in our party was finishing. The burger was unseasoned but cooked perfectly the second time. The sourdough was so soaked in butter it left me with greasy lips a napkin couldn't even remedy. My sons grilled cheese was similarly greasy and he struggled to eat it. The waiter was friendly and efficient and seemingly at the will of the kitchen. Out of seven orders at our table there were mistakes on 3 of them. All of which our waiter had to go back and correct or credit us for on our bill. With so many other good options in the Village I think it's safe to say we won't be returning.
Good service , clean, and friendly . The food is good, and they always make it right. I recommend going here at least once to try it. They have plenty of options.
Best sandwiches in Idaho and  right  up there with what I've had while  traveling. I don't  want it to end  while  eating it.

This is my favorite place for lunch. I love love their soups, and there is usually a nice selection to choose from. It comes with a slice of their "home baked" bread. (I usually get the hazelnut, which is worth a try.) I will often pick up a loaf of wheat bread or banana bread to take home for the family. I've never had anything here that wasn't delicious!

Food is great. I love the build your own burger option. For someone who has a gluten allergy, I found this restaurant very understanding and accommodating to my allergy. The staff is knowledgable about their menu, and have no problem answering your questions. I recommend The Counter for anyone who is looking for a good burger!

I'm a huge fan of Thai food and I've been eating at Sa Wad Dee since they opened. This is simply the best Thai food you can get in the Treasure valley. The food is incredibly fresh, always served cooked to perfection, available in all variations of spice and the portions are large.

The staff is always ready to help you select a dish if you haven't tried something yet and their menu is exhaustive in the selection. I have two favorites that I order over and over again, the Spicy Cashew Nuts and the Yellow Curry, both phenomenal.

The food here is far superior to the larger competitors in the area and the intimate atmosphere makes dining feel like a family affair. The staff knows your name and what you like most after a couple of visits and they always welcome you as friends.

I really can't say enough good about Sa Wad Dee. If I have any criticism at all it is that they don't have a children's menu but that is easily solved with an order of Chicken Satay and Crab Rangoons.

Eat here as soon as you can, you'll be a customer for life!

Horrible service. Waited in the drive through line for over 45 minutes. When I got to the window I let the employee know how upset I was about the wait. She half-heartily apologized and gave me a $10 dollar gift card. By doing this, she managed to get my wife to return there again, as I will never go there again. My wife went back to redeem the $10 gift card and it was only a $5 gift card. My wife ordered a sandwich that was having a buy one get one free special. On the free sandwich they would not allow her to make any changes to it. All she wanted to do is not have the sauce put on it. They would not leave the sauce off the free sandwich. Needless to say, they managed to loose her business too along with the people that were with her. Do yourself a favor and eat somewhere else.
Overpriced and just blah...I regretted purchasing that living social. We had three dishes and didn't finish any of them.

Huge menu which usually spells trouble but we've never had anything we didn't enjoy there.  We've been many times for both lunch as well as dinner.  The lunch buffet is amazing with some pretty expensive items available for no extra charge.  Highly recommended.

I would like to tell you about the food because it looked good. But with only 5 tables occupied customers had to wait almost an hour or more for their food. I couldn't wait any longer and had to leave. Kids were crying from impatience and everyone in the restaurant was staring at the kitchen thinking "please bring our food out". It says seafood on their sign but only have one seafood dish, salmon. No halibut, shrimp, or even fish and chips.

I've heard really great things and finally decided to try it out. It's a very small restaurant but very well decorated and set up to maximize the space. The menu is pretty large but not big enough where you spend half an hour reading everything... Then reading it again. We decided on the pineapple fried rice and ordered it at a 3/5 spicy. The food was really delicious but not at all spicy. It was essentially the heat of a dash of pepper. I don't know if it was done in purpose because most people can't do spicy, or if it was a mistake but I could have used a lot more heat. 
If there is one thing I wish they had, it would be Thai pumpkin or acorn squash. I've visited other Thai restaurants and I've always seen it on the menus and I love it.  All together though, it was really good experience.

I was warmly welcomed with the hostess.  My server was overworked and forgetful.  I ordered a burger with the fried peppers on top.  The server asked how I wanted it, I stated MEDIUM and she promised that it will be nice and juicy.  I also splurged for an extra $1.50, I think it was, for onion rings instead of fries.  My food took a long time and the restaurant was only half full.  While waiting for my food I noticed my fork had food dried and stuck to it.  My dinning companion's knife also had a similar problem.  The server was too busy to attend to us so we helped ourself to silverware on the empty table next to us.
My burger arrived and it lacked any real flavor and was very dry. My dining companions burger was also in the same predicament.  The thin patty was charred and beyond well done.  The BBQ sauce was placed on half of the bun causing the burger to be dry then more moist once i got part way done eating it.  The sauce still didn't help the burger.  
Save your money and stick to the fries.  While the onion rings tasted adequate, I literally had 5 onion rings slightly smaller than a half dollar coin.  REALLY Ram?  You charge me that much for LESS food?  What a rip off.  I just stole from fries from my dining companion to make up the difference.
To top it off my server charged us for a cocktail when I had a single beer.
This place was a big disappointment and I would never consider giving it a second try.  Eek! Methinks not is right.
Wow! Talk about great  customer service! 5 * service. 3* selection. Unfortunately they didn't carry what I was needing

Stopped in for lunch. Ordered the BLT. Bread was way too crunchy. Hardly any sauce on it whatsoever. Bacon was flavorless! Overall the sandwich was a disappointment. The over crunchiness of the bread made it impossible to eat the sandwich without stuff falling out. The French fry shoestrings however were good in flavor, nicely crunchy, and golden brown. Onion strings were overly greasy, flavorless and the breading was falling off. Service was great! Greeted nicely upon entering and staff was friendly. Service was very fast and we were checked on several times. Service is what moved my one star rating up to two.

Fresh quality sandwiches that will fill you up! Diverse menu for anyone with fair prices.
Iced tea fresh brewed and they have unlimited refills on soda too! 
Nice staff, offered to bring our sandwiches out to us on the patio, and came out to bring in our dishes or wrap up our sandwiches! Exceptional customer service! Will be back!

First visit was great. Awesome food and service! Second visit turned me off. Went with my fiancé and stood host told us the kitchen was behind and we'd have to wait 5-10 minutes to be seated, even though there were multiple tables open. So, that was a little bizarre, but okay, we'll wait. Sat on the patio to wait for our table. Here's the part that really irks me. The party of three that was behind us was seated immediately. I go inside to address the situation and stand there for a couple minutes without even being acknowledged. So I just left. Not sure if there will be a third visit.

Awesome sauces! I loved the Bison burger and the choice of fries. You need to try this place for a quick burger!  I only gave it 4 stars because I would have liked to see more blue moon beers. They had a lot of craft beer that I'm not into.
Great service. . Burger toppings excellent (they were right...you CAN get too many!) Few little issues but overall. .delicious!

OK for out of the bucket dough. Most of the doughnuts are fresh and tasty but not spectacular. The specialty items like cinnamon rolls and bear claws are their weak point, I was going to say that you could do better at Jackson's but they just stopped carrying Pastry Perfection products and now the best place for doughnuts in Meridian is Winco now that they have self check out lanes.
Simply put... Descent food... Horrible service... And over priced..  if your not in a hurry, have some extra cash, and want alright food.. Check it out. PS The music was horrible.

I gave this place a try and picked out a chocolate bar. When I walked in, there was an Asian family running it.....stroller and child by the counter...seemed like a good start. I like family-run small businesses and try to support them. The father was at the counter and never said a word to me....The chocolate bar was 95 cents. I paid with a dollar. He handed me a nickel and walked away without a word. Wow, okay...sorry to bother you, dude....However, I was still excited to try the bar. The chocolate was light in color and diluted in taste. The texture of the dough was too light and lots of air pockets. Not tasty. So disappointed. I had been going to Albertson's and their chocolate bars are superior....super-dark delicious chocolate and dense dough with a nice flavor... and only 75 cents. Seems like DK is connected to the other store on State Street in Boise. Terrible customer service there and we quit going there years ago. I remember the cashier who was unfriendly, very obese, and looked annoyed that she had to put her smart phone down and get up off of her chair. I saw the comments here about Country Donuts and will give them a try.

This place was decent. Authentic feel, decent prices, and friendly service. I didn't go at peak time though.

If you get your food to go, verify what you get before you leave. I ordered two crispy beef tacos to go. When I got home I discovered that I got chicken enchiladas instead.

I still ate them lol but I think I'll skip this place in the future. It was my own fault for not checking but there was only one other group in the restaurant and they already had their food!

This place just serves plain "Blah" food. Almost any taco truck can beat it. if you like plain bland Mexican ( American ) like a step up from a TV dinner.   then this is for you.

 seriously.  It's not all that cheap like people say either, I mean, for what you get it's expensive.

My husband and I stopped in here after a long day of work and didn't feel like making food. I am so glad we did. My husband got the grilled ham and cheese... it was flawless. I got the hot pastrami. It was AMAZEBALLS! They were out of their jalapeño potato soup which sounded fabulous- but that's okay because we will be going back often. My husband who is not that into food was floored and loved his food.
Been a few times for lunch.   The food  isn't worth the fight to park and the wait and the crowd.  Save yourself the frustration and goto Great Harvest.

Definitely not worth the hype. Bison burger tasted good, but the patty was very thin, for over $8.  Tried yam fries & Laura fries. Yam ones were kinda watery tasting. Laura fries were hardly any different from regular russets.  Sauces:  regular ketchup was the only one we kinda liked. Blueberry ketchup tasted like blueberry cream cheese. Chipotle sauce was mostly mayonnaise.  We've tried BFC now. Don't have to go back. I might try the purple fries if someone bought them for me.

Great soups and breads. Outstanding sandwiches (especially the turkey, bacon, avocado on focaccia). Breakfast foods are fantastic as well. Can be hard to find a seat at times when busy (what restaurant would not like that problem?). 4 words for you..."chunky, cinnamon french toast"...and it is all you can eat if you dine in. Nuff said!!

Decided to try the new burger place tonight after taking the kids to a movie.   It was after normal dinner hours on a Sunday.  Our service was great!   She was quick on her feet, answered all of our questions and was knowledgable about the beers on tap.   Unfortunately, that's where the great ends.   Our burgers were cooked perfectly cooked, but not very flavorful.  We probably won't. E going back.
Was a walk-in pretty early in the morning, very friendly, got to me quickly. Great prices, and V did a fantastic job on my acrylic gel set

Blue Sky is wonderful on two counts: they have the most awesome bagels and they are great part of our community. 

I especially like their blueberry bagels because they taste so fresh. I've tried other blueberry bagels that the local grocery stores have they taste gummy. These are fresh and fruity. Very tasty. I do agree with other people that you should ask staff to run the bagels through the toaster twice if you want a real toasted bagel. Do that and ask for coffee and you'll be in heaven. 

Also, Blue Sky is a great community supporter. They have supported the Meridian High School Track & Field program for 2 years now, and given our kids fresh bagels to sell at our JV track meet. They have allowed us to fundraise for entry fees and for getting to events at a time where every penny counts. There are few other local businesses who care about their community as much as Blue Sky.

So, my family makes a point to support them when we're in the local area. Help those who help our community. Blue Sky is great.

In town for a business trip. I have friends that went to Boise State that now live back home in Michigan. They raved about this place. I gave it a shot. I ended up coming here two times. I had the Fish and Chips the first night. The second visit, was @ lunch and I had a Cheeseburger.

PROS:

- Very good fish and chips! You get a massive portion of I think it's halibut? Not cod. Very very good and cooked perfectly! Not rubbery. They use a beer batter with the local beer and it is very good. 

- I had a Blonde type ale from their brewery. Very good I would have another one. 

NEUTRAL:

- The cheeseburger was good, it was cooked medium when I ordered well done. It was good, but not as good as the fish and chips. 

Summary:

This place is better than what I thought. I would come back here and recommended it to a co-worker who is also in town.

This place is by far the best deli in town.
Owner operated by Chef Wally it is the real deal!  The soup is out of this world, great sides and the best deli sandwich in town!
They are open until 8:00 pm.
This is must do on your deli list.  Even if you have to drive across town it is worth it.

The best sandwich shop ever! Their Reuben is amazing and the blue bronco is pretty tasty too. Our fave deli in town... Always rave reviews from our out of state family when they visit. Huge portions and always fresh and delicious!

Bowling good.

Food is horrible, kitchen is a mess. I worked on the line for a while in my past....this place is pretty bad and seems to have no organization/execution.

$8 for 6 regular (small) wings that aren't even crispy or close?  Total sh*t.  It's a rip, don't eat here.  Bowl and drinks only.  Again, don't eat here.  Maybe the chain managers will get involved one day and fix it.

Dinner was Terrible. Our server was about 14 years old and had about that much common sense. When I asked for iced tea, they brought me a glass with some strange floating goo in it. When I asked what it was, the manager said, "oh, we just brewed it."  With what? Slug trails?  I asked for a diet soda instead, much to their frustration. As is a tradition with bad service, our salads came out about 5 minutes before our food, with wrong dressings. The chicken was good, but the mashed "potatoes" were some weird, chunky slick hybrid. When I asked what the fibrous hunk in my potatoes was, I got a smile and "oh, they're Parmesan potatoes". This was not reflected on the menu, and was GROSS with country gravy. Blech. Stick to breakfast at the IHOP. The other options are pretty rough.

Oof. Here's my opinion of my most recent and last trip to this place. I'm glad my family and I didn't get sick or end up with a a food borne illness after a random Wednesday 6/14/2017 trip to this place.  Once my wife ordered and paid she was essentially locked into waiting for our order; she waited approx. 30 minutes from the time she ordered until our to go order was ready. What did we order?  One Kids meal (a burger), one No. 1 combo, and one No. 2 combo. How much?  Approx. $21. What did we get? For starters there was the bad service (did I mention the 30 minute wait after ordering and paying?) then there was our incomplete order (one of three orders of fries were missing, we did receive the kids meal fries but only one of two regular combo fries).  The separate bag with the number one burger and the number turd burger looked like a hand full of fries were chucked into a bag, no real way of knowing if the intent was one or two orders of fries in their defense, not really accustomed to the loose fries on a bag routine. But wait, there's more!  This place serves up the thinnest cheapest patties of ground beef you've ever seen. No issue with that other than only a scientist could explain how they could manage to serve up such a raw burger, assuming it ever went on the grill. I'm talking so raw I've purchased burger from the butcher that's more well done than this. Took one bite of this garbage, picked it apart to confirm what we were seeing was consistent throughout the sandwich, and then threw it out. Since it was a to go order we ate the cold fries and counted our losses. Do yourself a favor and steer away from this place. Only regret Is I don't have a photo to share (habit burger management laughing and clapping in the background), but was so revolted it just went into the trash. Go somewhere else for your twenty bucks. Zero star chain garbage.

I love sandwiches! I've only been here once and since it was my first time, I figured I'd go with a classic, the Triple Chin, it's a classic Club sandwich. It was amazing. Huge portions topped with the freshest ingredients. The bacon was crisp, the veggies fresh, and the meats were delicious!  The potato salad was a great side. I was slightly disappointed with its size of the potato salad but then I'm pulled the sandwich from the wrapper! Unfortunately, I live out of town but I will definitely make this a stop every time I'm in town! Thanks for making this awesome place in Idaho!
So so good! I love their pizza on soft and crispy sour dough crust. The house salad and dressing were delicious also.

My family always loves spending time at Big Al's! There are so many fun things to do and you offer such an upbeat atmosphere, awesome prices, and terrific service. We love watching sports on your giant TV screens, playing games in the arcade, bowling, and enjoying your live music entertainment, as well. Just thinking about Big Al's make me hungry for your amazing Big Al's Nachos! I'm on my way!!!

We visited two choices and Guymon won hands down. Professional courteous staff who easily made us feel comfortable. Love the friendly and welcoming office. All of the assistants are so friendly to my daughter and to us. They are great at answering questions and making us feel confident in our choice. Payment options are also very much appreciated. After visiting the other ortho, even though that office was closer it was no comparison to Dr Guymon's.

This place will keep me from losing the last of my baby weight! They greet you will several bread samples while you place your order- pumpkin, chocolate, blueberry, strudel.....all amazing. While standing in line you are faced with case after case of decadent pastries and desserts. By the times their friendly staff takes your order you have zero will power left. My favorite thing to order here is a combo #2- a turkey bacon avocado on Focaccia Bread with a pink piñata colada smoothly and their signature Parmesan Chips. I buy a full sandwich (which is HUGE) and split it into two meals. The turkey on the sandwich is big chunks right off the bird nothing sliced and processed on this sandwhich. They also make thier own flavored mayo which is perfect on this sandwich. It's fast food which tastes healthy and fresh- love that they have a drive through on days when you are too busy to stop in or when you are there during the busy times (11:30- 1:30) it is standing room only if you try eating inside during that time. As a side note on your birthday if you eat here they let you pick a free pastry out of their dessert case! Just another reason to love kneaders!

We have loved kneaders since they came into the valley, but recently we made a large order at the store for a funeral and they asked me to pay over the phone and I did. When I picked it up, it wasn't ready (it was about half ready) and one of the gentleman helped me out to the car. He asked if I paid, I said yes. He didn't believe me and I was charged again. 2 weeks pass and I'm balancing my checkbook and I caught it. I called on a Friday and found out that I was charged when I called and at the time I picked it up. They said sometimes the charge appears twice, but is only withdrawn once. I assured them that two amounts were subtracted from my account. They found their mistake, said they would refund it and email me a receipt. The following Monday, I called again to say I didn't receive a receipt in my email and that I understood sometimes it reflects in the account after a few days. The gal said the morning managers handle that and I needed call back the next day. At this point I was loosing patience. I called the corporate office. They gave me name of the Manager and said he would call me in the morning. I ended up getting an email that evening where he processed the refund on Monday. He didn't call. I called the corporate office back and told them that he didn't call me and just emailed me. I feel that he should have called me to apologize and own his part that I had to hold his damn hand in order to get my money back on their mistake. 
It was almost $100 and for us that's a lot of money. I'm completely disappointed. I only gave two stars because they have great food, but their customer service is horrible. I felt it wasn't affecting them and their budget so it was unimportant. We will no longer be doing business with the them over the phone as I feel their policy and procedures are not up to a reasonable standard.

This Hampton in is a little west of downtown Boise, in the suburb of Meridian, just off the freeway. 

It is in good condition, clean, and has the Hampton frills that all Hamptons offer, which is a free breakfast and free WiFi. 

Staff is friendly. The price isn't bargain for suburban Boise, prolly around $100 most times (I paid $99). But the gym is open 24 hours.

It is not really a suite, as in Embassy Suites. Just a little larger room with a couch area near the desk, but open to the bed with no door or wall.

It's a little tricky actually getting to this from the freeway, even though it looks like it is right there. You have to make a couple of turns. 

If you get in an accident trying to get here, your in luck, because it is right across from St Luke's Hospital.

I ordered the contradiction and my wife ordered the chicken. I was afraid to build my own because there were too many options and it overwhelmed me. We also ordered fries and onion rings. The place wasn't that busy yet it took 15 minutes before we got our fries. It was around another 10 minutes when we got our burgers. I got a 1/2 pound and found it to be very tasty. The vegan patty was definitely made from scratch and had a really good taste. It was late in the evening on a Sunday, so it might have been understaffed, but the food is pretty good. My wife had southern chicken burger which she found over cooked and not filling. I'd recommend not having the chicken and make sure you order 1/2 pound to be full.

The atmosphere was very nice. We were outside with the optimal temperature and had a very pleasant evening and enjoyed walking around the Village afterwards.

went here for the first time with my fiancé a couple days ago. one word: AMAZING! he ordered the Alaska roll and the queen roll. he raved all nite about how unbelievably fresh the salmon in the Alaska roll was. I wanted the Fairview roll, but with a twist. I nixed the avocado because I think I may have an allergy, and added instead tempura shrimp. the flavors in this roll were out of this world! a perfect mix of sweet and tangy, just exploding with flavor! the service was excellent! it was a Friday nite and they were hosting a birthday party so they were busy. but our waitress was very diligent and checked in often. even the manager came over and said I had created a great roll and suggested naming it after me. of course, I knew they wouldn't actually do that but it was a very nice thing to say nonetheless. the only reason I didn't give 5 stars is because my parents really wanted to try it but my mom has a gluten allergy and it would've been cool to have some gluten free options but they really don't so she won't get to taste the amazing food. other than that, the entire experience was outstanding!

Vanguard has been keeping our home pest free for close to 10 years. Very seldom does the same person come out, but every time they are the absolute nicest young men. They understand the meaning of "customer service".

This place consistently gets brought up as the best place for Thai food in the area, and it's easy to see why considering that they are pretty dang good. Their Panang curry with chicken is quite tasty. They are also one of the few places in town that will swap out white rice with brown rice, and I like brown rice. All around a very good place!

This is a really cute little place in downtown.  I was super impressed by the host/server/bartender/cashier!!  No joke, one guy did it all and he did it all VERY well.  He was so fast I couldn't believe it!  On top of it all, he had such a great personality!!  The food was pretty good but the beans were very salty.  Great chips and salsa!

Typically we go through the drive-thru, but this time we went inside. We ordered 4 burritos and a mexi-fry. During our wait for our food, there were 3 employees complaining about how it was so busy and how they are "so done" with tonight. Then a gentlemen came in after going through the drive-thru and said he was missing a taco. The employee didn't apologize or act sympathetic to the man, but did offer to remake his taco. Then they took about 15 minutes making his taco. A few minutes later another man came in who had also just gone through the drive-thru. He waited at the counter for a while until someone finally greeted him. "Oh hi. What did we do wrong this time?" said the employee. My mouth hung wide open at what I was seeing. "You gave me the wrong taco," said the man. "Ok. Do you want us to make it for you or refund you?" "Just refund me," he said. "K. We can't take it back." "I don't want it," he said. So she threw it away and refunded him. She never apologized or told him to have a good night. So within a few minutes of being there, the employees lost the business at least 6-10 dollars in merchandise all while pissing off customers. They hadn't started making our burritos yet. 

Meanwhile, we could hear the family eating dinner behind us say something like "Yeah we are still waiting for them to make us our taco. I can't believe it, it's just one taco." They were the only family in the store other than my husband and I. 

It gets better! A fourth employee comes in from doing the garbage outside and proceeds to stand around while his coworkers are making food at neck-breaking speed. There was now no one else coming through the drive-thru, and with 3 employees working on our food, it still took 20 minutes of us sitting in the store. During this time, we were sitting in the front booth literally right next to the kitchen. The employees were talking about how much they hated working there. One employee said "So you know tonight I'm going to be your DD, right? I'm going to help you get wasted after this!" These employees looked like teenagers. There was more inappropriate chitter chatter that just seemed completely wrong for the time and place. 

The food was cold and horrible. We found out from being inside this time that our burritos are only warm because they are microwaved. They use cold ingredients and then microwave it. This time it was pretty cold and the burritos were layered in such a way that you would eat an entire blog of sour cream before getting to a blob of dry rice, and then a blob of straight up cheese, and so on. No nuance or good mix of both throughout. 

This used to be our favorite place but it has really gone down-hill over the last year. We are never going back again. Please hire more competent staff.
