Passing through town father Google directed me to this gem. Full deli, great sandwiches, great people. Very clean and inviting. I had the Hugo special and loved it. Sandwiches are a little on the small side buy very well executed and they don't disappoint!
Although they are known for their sandwiches- I wasn't a fan. HOWEVER best fried chicken and potato wedges I have ever had in my life!!! They're sauces are very yummy too.
Delicious burgers. Taste fresh and definitely hit the spot! My only complaint would be that they're not as big as I would hope for.
This is one of the best Mexican restaurants I've been to! Not only do they accommodate my allergy situation, they also have extremely good food and great and friendly service! Highly recommended!

The best sandwiches in town and great customer service! I got the Trevor melt that has delicious flavor and my husband gets the bleu bronco. This time my grandma got a sandwich with horseradish on it which she can't eat so they replaced it free of charge. They also treated our son to a little cookie. I appreciate the friendly faces and flavor of food.

Very fatty ribs. Sauce was cold. Fries were undercooked. Service marginal. Price was ridiculous.  They didn't even have 5 ribs, at 11:30 in the morning? No ketchup for fries?? There are too mAny good places to go to spend 12.50 on a marginal plate of food.

I LOVE watching football games here.  Huge screens and good seating options.  Staff have always been friendly and decently attentive.  Food is OK at best.  

Thee arcade upstairs proves fun and good entertainment.  Also the vip bowling alley is fun for bowling and watching the games as well. 

Overall, good food and friendly service.  There's many different options for fun here!

I wanted to love this place. A build-your-own burger bar with sweet potato fries and a ton of other treats? Love the idea.

However, the service makes this place annoying, and for the price, takes it down further. My friend was asked if she wanted anything and had to remind the waitress of her malt order placed 10 minutes prior. We waited for 10-15 minutes before being served in general. 

I find it a little absurd that they charge for mustard here (I get the extra sauce charge, but it feels like they're going to a la carte the silverware next.) They didn't have the vegan cheese that was on the menu, but waited to tell me about 15 minutes after my order. My receipt was jacked up as well. Nice people, but the service is just not organized at all.

The burger itself was good and juicy, and the fries were decent as well. I'd say the burger itself gets a four, and the service elements a two.

Killer pie! Had the Ex-Girlfriend and she rocked... sweet (honey), tangy (goat cheese), salty (meats) and slightly bitter (arugula) make for a dance of flavors. Best brussel sprouts I've had in my life, bar none. I've worked in the restaurant industry for 20 years and I've seen b-sprouts trending for the last three or four, yet they tend to be hit and miss. These ones knock it out of the park. Daily happy hour specials that were very generous (got our medium pepperoni for the kiddo for $5)...

Keep up the good work guys. Looking forward to my next trip back to Boise!

This is a small, local gem! Went here with a friend for a girls' night out. Such a cute neighborhood restaurant and the food was DELISH!!!! I was seriously impressed at how good my roasted chicken was! Fried green beans were also amazing! Food was a little expensive, so I wouldn't go there all the time, but it was definitely a great little place for a night out. Service was a little slow, but the place was packed with people on the Saturday we went. There was even a little band getting set up on the patio which was great! I will definitely visit this place again.
Burgers were good but over priced starting at  $9. The service was horrible today. 4 tables sat after received their food before us with no apologies only excuses.

RUN AWAY! This place is horrible.  I will never use priceline or booking.com again since they recommended this place and said it was 7.5 out of 10. It is a 1. It is so dirty and smells like mildew. The floors are stained,  the paint chipping on the walls, the shower smells terrible and our walls had coffee spilled on them that hasn't been cleaned.

I'm not a BBQ person, so I was glad that they had 'normal' food too.  I had sliced ham that was very tasty and juicy.  The biscuit was OK.  Coleslaw was excellent.  Potato salad almost made me gag... I think there is sour cream in it... won't order that again.

Hubby had tons of shredded meat covered in BBQ sauce, he seemed pretty content :)

I think once I figure out which of their foods I like best, I'll have a great dinner.

Best part was the peach cobbler covered in ice cream.  YUM!

Will definitely return although the chairs are VERY grating when scraping on the floor.  I think it would be best to eat when they aren't crowded.

They have lots of sandwiches to choose from - some classics and some are more creative. We went on a Saturday afternoon and didn't have to stand in line, but several people showed up shortly after us. There is indoor and outdoor seating available, but it is a small place so I can see how it could get crowded. We've heard about lines during the week. The staff was super friendly and very helpful. We both tried the potato salad, which was good and flavorful. Both sandwiches were great. I had the Rancher - beef, cheese, horseradish, and bbq sauce. It had just enough zip and a generous portion of beef. The bread was nice and soft too. Can't wait to try some of their other creations.

Good eats but lacks atmosphere

I was hoping for more of a sit down restaurant to have lunch with friends, which this is not.  It's kinda just a sea of tables like Chipotle...but the tacos are cute & creative.  If you want really fast lunch spot or grab & go then this is it...the tacos are very small, so you need 3-4 to make it a meal...I had shrimp & brisket which were really yummy.  At $2-3 each, it's pretty reasonably priced.

I was skeptic about how my first time would be here, typically waterparks and me do not mix well (Lagoon). I was a bit surprised with all the activities that can be done here. Staff was friendly, and rules were followed to fullest from what I could see. I recommend coming at opening and then taking a lunch break with a lunch left in your car. It's  a nice break from all the activities one can do. I stayed until about 4pm that's when it started to get crowded for my liking, so if you want to beat the crowd do get there early. A lot of fun can be had, going to get the season passes for next year, well worth it.
Great beer, food, and service with a smile! They are also good for large parties! Love the RAM!!!!

I visited this restaurant the night before Valentine's day, and it was packed.  We ended up spending 2 hours here, mostly in waiting for our meals, but I don't think that's typical.
The atmosphere is lovely; not overly tacky and garish like many Asian restaurants can be, but done tastefully.  Still, it helps evoke a Thai spirit.
I'm a vegetarian as was my dining partner, and we started with veggie spring rolls.  Unfortunately the server brought shrimp spring rolls, but it had taken so long and we were so hungry, we set them aside.
I ordered the mixed veggies with tofu, which was fantastic.  It arrived hot, and in a light garlic sauce.  The veggies were perfectly al dente, the fried tofu had great texture and flavor, and the sauce wasn't too heavy to cover up the flavors of the vegetables.  
My guest had the green curry with tofu, which was also wonderful.  It had large pieces of lemongrass along with fried tofu and several vegetables in a slightly spicy sauce.  My guest nearly licked her plate clean.
The green tea was also good, and served in individual elephant tea pots, which was a nice touch.  Food was also presented well, and all meals came with rice.
The waitress was incredibly friendly and eager-to-please.  No service issues other than the extremely long wait, but that seemed to be an aberration.  I highly suggest this restaurant.
Very over priced!  Food was good service was slow and there were only few tables at the time.  Other burger places are just as good and cheaper.

Not a local - first time here. 

It was fun and interesting! Great and friendly service. Jumped at the chance to explain how the menu worked. 

Tried all the dipping sauces and now I can't go back to just traditional ketchup.

I decided on a Salad and when I got home the lettuce had a chemical taste as though it was part of what was used to wash the lettuce and I had a funny feeling in my mouth and it lingered for a good while. I plan on going in today to get a Chicken Sandwich and I am going to inquire about their wash process. I had to rate it 2 stars at this point but it will not stop me from patronizing the restaurant as there are other yummy item offered.

I found out about Habit from my co-workers on Friday 1st Sept. so I decided to go in on Saturday to check it out. The price are great for what is offered and offered indoor and exterior seating and you were lucky to get a seat.
I came here to see what it was like, loved it. Returned with family and friends. Service was great and so was food.

To their credit, this place is aptly named. A visit here is not unlike a float down the river through some class 1 rapids. Maybe even a little bit of class 2.

WPP doesn't really seem to have decided what it is. When you first walk in, there is a small bar and an alcove with a few arcade games. These two things by themselves work well in harmony since they allow mom and dad to get tipsy while the kids hit buttons and scream about whatever it is kids scream about. Oddly though the dining area that lies just beyond seems to attempt a more romantic setting by utilizing such things as dim lighting and fancy bowls.

For my food, I selected the Fall River Salad and The Thai Pie pizza. I would have liked to wash it down with a beer but apparently you can't order those from your table.

The salad may best be described through the perspective of my tongue as a teenager trying out for a role in The Sound of Music. It was like skipping through a field of blueberries, licking tiny blocks of goat cheese floating in the air as cooked chickens tossed walnuts at me. So yeah, it was good. As a bonus it was delivered to me in a fancy misshapen bowl. I knew I should be impressed by the fact that one edge of the bowl was higher than the other edge but honestly it didn't do much for me.

Soon my pizza arrived to distract me from my strange bowl. I didn't receive a plate though which I thought was also kind of weird. I mean I still had my fancy bowl but that thing was covered in blueberry sauce. Whatever, who needs plates when pizza already comes on a big pizza tray? But just as I had come to the conclusion that my desire for a plate was wasteful, one of the peanuts from my delicious Thai Pie, fell to the table. How embarrassing! Here I was in a nice restaurant with dim lighting and fancy bowls and I'm dropping food all over the table. It was then that I realized why plates really are needed. A plate would have broken my peanut's fall and saved me from the judgement of my fellow patrons. Long live plates!

Went there yesterday,  March 12th, and was told there was a 20 minute wait due a kitchen backup.  What? "Kitchen Backup" What the heck is that?  The place was less than 50% occupied! Unacceptable. We left!
Love this place, it is kind of expensive but it's worth it if you spend the whole day. I wish it were cheaper but honestly what other attractions like this exist in Boise?

Best burger that I've had in Boise.  Being able to pick everything that goes on the burger is awesome.  Great local beer collection with a wide variety of styles.  Awesome service, and with it being busy, we never felt rushed.  Highly recommend!
The food is always good, but do believe the prices are too high. Usually go because to lazy to drive into Boise and best offered in Meridian.

I'm reluctantly going with 3 stars as the service was very good, and they have Carta Blanca beer, served ice-cold, a rarity in the Boise area.  But the food is just typical McMexican - nothing to distinguish it from 90% of the other Mexican restaurants in the area.
Great bread and yummy sandwiches. Get here early. Not much seating for such a great place.

I would agree.  Much better than than the  chain sandwich places in town.  We had french dip, Cuban,  cheese sandwich,  and a fried peanut butter and jelly.  $29 bucks.   So a little on the spendy side.  Chips  or a side do come with the sandwiches.   I got the potato salad and it was just ok.  The owner is running the register and seems like a good guy.  Really into his food which is a good thing.  I will give them another try, and this time try the pastrami and  soup which was recommended by a friend.   Maybe we just hit an off day.   Overall solid.   I hoped for great but only got good............    But like I said will try again later.

This last weekend we visited this restaurant for lunch for the first time in a long time.  We hadn't gone in a while because they had changed somethings on the menu that we weren't really impressed with.  We enjoyed this visit though.  To start I ordered their grand mimosa and it lives up to the name grand.  It's made with good quality sparkling wine and it's huge!  For appetizers we ordered the armadillo eggs and the cheese curds.  Both were delicious. For my entree I ordered their Santa fe burger and was able to substitute the standard burger patty for a turkey burger.  I loved the fact that they have turkey burgers as someone who doesn't eat red meat I often don't get have a burger when I'm out because most places don't offer anything other than your traditional beef patty.  The toppings they have for their burgers are so unique, customizable, and flavorful.  My husband really enjoyed his French dip sandwhich also.  Both entrees were served with thick hand cut fries, which I really liked.  I also ordered a side salad and I found that part of my meal to be disappointing.  This item is definitely a hold over from the aforementioned menu changes.  It was made with lettuce that's topped with your typical tomatoes and cucumbers, but instead of cheese and croutons... it's sprinkled with quinoa.  I understand that they're probably trying to be unique and healthy but it gave the salad a strange texture and lacked flavor.  With the exception of the salad our meal was really enjoyable and satisfying and we'll be back.

Disgusting. Everything was gross. Found GLASS on the floor!, in the carpet, fluid splattered on walls, uncleaned toilet with poop stains, hair on the towels, etc. The screen in the window had been cut open, hindering us from using window to air out stinky room. Passed on complimentary breakfast, as it looked inedible. We shouldn't have stayed....Don't waste your money- even if it is cheap. Plenty other places nearby.

Good for families who want loud atmosphere to drown your kids noise out. The beers were a little better than Ok. They're supposed to be one of best microbreweries in area. Beg to differ. Kids meals are good. Service slow & no personality.

First let me say I love Dicky's but today our love connection was just broken beyond repair. This particular location failed to trim ANY of the fat from my to go order of brisket & almost 1/2 of the pound I paid for was pure fat & went in the trash. Normally I have a fat rim on a piece or two but a 1/2 of my pound is a bit excessive. There is nothing worse than getting home & opening up your food & realizing you can't eat a good portion of it...such a bummer!

As I said I love Dicky's; I've eaten at their restaurants for over 20 years but there is no excuse for what they gave me today. They weren't busy so they had time to take a bit of extra care but they didn't. They also cut it & weigh it when you place an order so the man could have trimmed it then but he just didn't care or did what the owner/managers at that location trained him to do. 

If you want Dicky's **avoid** this location. Don't waste your money go to another location where they know to properly trim meat before serving it to customers. If you are brave enough to visit this location watch them carefully when they prepare your order.

This is an incredible place!
We came here for a meeting. Had a party room for pizza then bowled 3 games.
Lacy was our server and took care of 14 of us very well, thanks!
Pizza was pretty good but the experience overall was wonderful. Everyone had a blast!
If I'm ever in Boise again, I'll be anxious to go back.

My little Patty-Jo was so beautiful after Theresa/Teresa was finished with her. She got an adorable St Patty's Day bandana! Which is Patty-Jo's b-day, btw....haha.
She also did a potty path for my Ophelia (kitty) and I can't wait for Oph's lion cut this springtime! I highly recommend this mobile grooming service over anyone out here. Theresa/Teresa is fun and charming and adorable! Yay biggie high fives all around! Prices are great too;)'s, 's, 's & 's!!!

First time I've been. I think I'll give it a 2nd chance before I give it more stars. The Bacon on my sandwich was bomb, everything else was so so. The bread was amazing, the potato salad not so much. Since these are things that are subjective, I'll try another sandwich and give them another shot. The service was okay, atmosphere was quaint. We enjoyed the olympics being on the tv. Over all first impression, it's nothing special. What was good, was great. What wasn't good, was awful for me personally. I say give them a shot and make your own decision.

Went to bowl with the family and our hostess took awhile to get our drink and then we were out for awhile and she served everyone else before us.  It sucked bad service if only I can give it a zero :(

Yum!  The service and food was fantastic!  Not only was the food delicious but also so beautifully presented.  My boyfriend got the surprise sushi roll.  I don't eat sushi but he said it was amazing.  The ginger filet was the perfect amount of spice and flavor.  
We will definitely be coming back.

I like Big Als food and arcade games. I don't think it's the biggest variety of games but it'll keep me entertained at least an hour but at a high price (usually 25-30hr of play). I went bowling for the second time this week and I do have to say 2 games and 2 shoes was 32 dollars???? I guess I'm old school because I remember going to 20th Century and paying way less to enjoy a game of bowling. Oh and I would not suggest any of their mixed cocktails. I even tried to order a signature martini and it tasted like Minute Maid juice. I like a stiff drink so you'd think that a martini would be a good choice but not at all. I also was going to enjoy the big fight this Saturday there but when I called they said they're charging 30 dollars per adult?? I guess I wouldn't think they'd ever have to charge cover at a glorified arcade bar. Eh, I'll be back because it's something to do but if there were more options I'd probably take my money elsewhere.
Went there last Saturday with my fiancee. Got there right on time, didn't have to wait to sit. Service was excellent and food was too. Definitely recommend!

Good for watching a game but for me that us it. The food is just average and the service has never been that great. With so many better choices in Boise for beer and bar food it is hard to see how such a large place keeps the lights on.

I spent almost $60 on a game I continued to get jackpot on...then was told that they couldn't pay out the tickets I had won. Then to make it better, I had my tickets revoked from winning so many times. Not a fan of how they deal with their arcade. I do not endorse Big Al's.

Gluten free options they got it. vegan? They have options for that as well.. I don't know why I never signed up for their rewards program till my server talked to me about it. Next trip I get fries for free, just for signing up and a free birthday shake since my birthday is this month (can't wait to try the huckleberry shake)! Btw, I got the counter combo. I got to choose between 4 burgers, and a choice between two different fries or a salad all for $10 bucks and some change which is AFFORDABLE and a GREAT deal. Our server was very knowledgeable about the menu and always had a smile on her face, and always had our drinks filled never going empty. Over all great experience

I was first introduced to Kneaders by a friend whom I met there for breakfast one day. I knew right away that I'd be coming back! Kneaders is our go-to place for a great breakfast or lunch. Their staff is second to none, always making us feel welcome, always repeating our order back to us to make sure it was correct. Sandwiches, soups, salads, all top notch. Whenever we eat there, there is always enough left over for a second meal at home, so it's pretty good value. My husband is crazy about their caramel macchiato. The fresh baked breads and rolls are fabulous and there is a huge variety. The pastries wink and beckon as you stand in line to place your order. I've never ordered something there that I didn't absolutely love. Also really enjoy all the decorator items they have for sale, which change from season to season. Beautiful gift baskets. I could go on forever. Go. You won't be disappointed.

I was so happy when I found out that The Habit was coming to Meridian! I have had my fair share of veggie burgers, and the one they make here is truly amazing. I come here often and always get the veggie burger, the awesome tempura green beans, and a chocolate malt. When I come here with my daughter, she gets the kids cheeseburger meal, it's the perfect size for little ones, comes with fries, and a drink. The only thing I'm not a fan of is that they don't fresh cut their fries. Also, the buzzer scares me when it goes off

I am a huge Mexican food fan and since moving to the area I have tried several but so far this one is my favorite.  The staff is nice, the food is good, the service is quick and the drinks are strong!!
OMG! #16 with Bacon in it --changed my little fe and perspective about sandwiches! LOWWRD!!!
Had the Artichoke Portobello soup today. One of the best soups ever!! Also had to leave with loaves of fresh pumpkin bread and snicker doodle bread. A winning Thursday!

I went here the first time and they made my lashes way too long for my eye shape, the girl who did them wasn't very friendly or ask me anything specific about what look I was going for and hardly looked at me face-to-face to see what my eyes look like open and what lashes she would need to use. They ended up looking way too long and fake. The look I told her was "natural"... I gave her the benefit of the doubt and went back for a fill 2 weeks later. I showed her a picture of what they used to look like before I got them done by her and told her I wanted them shorter like in the pictures. She looked at the picture and said "ok", again didn't ask anything specific. The lashes were not shorter like the pic, they take up all of the space on my eyelid and almost touch my eyebrows (I have an almond shaped eye) - the lash quality is thicker and pokey. They don't feel soft or look natural like the lashes used on me before this lash studio.

Being new to the running, jogging for me right now, world I was just using a pair of running shoes I bought at a non-specialized shoe store and it was really starting to show in my ankles and knees. So I decided to go in to this store at a recommendation of a good friend. I am so thankful I listened to my friend! I felt so comfortable the minute I walked in. The staff was super friendly and welcoming. I was greeted and later helped by Megan... Great personality, very educated on the subject and super easy to work with. She even made me run the hallway to see how the shoes would feel. I felt like Cinder-runner with finding my pair of perfect shoes. I will definitely recommend this store to anyone and everyone that is serious about taking care of their body while getting on with their healthy lifestyle! The customer service and product was WELL worth the cost of the shoes and inserts. Thank you Fleet Feet!

Went here for lunch with my daughter today (Sunday) 

Service: The service was great and everyone was friendly.  I never had to ask for anything, my drink was always full.  That's one of my criteria for good service, if I pick up my soda and it's empty, that's a strike, if server doesn't notice while walking by - strike 2, if I have to ask strike 3.  I never had an empty drink.  

My daughter didn't like her veggie burger and the server noticed and asked about it.  When I said that she didn't care for it they took it off the bill.  Another example of good service. 

Very happy.

Food:
I got a burger which was cooked well and tasted fresh.  I enjoyed the burger.

Fries were ok.  I had ordered them crispy but they were not crisped.  Though they were not crispy, they tasted cut fresh which I like so I am ok with that.

My daughter got the veggie burger which she did not care for as previously mentioned.  She liked her fries too.

Normally I would have given 3 stars but they did something that impressed me.  The server said the manager and the cook had started discussing what they could do to improve the veggie burger immediately.  I let them know that my daughter and most of her friends prefer a black bean based burgers and it turns out that's what the manager and the cook had already discussed.  

The commitment to improve earned them 4 stars.  I think they are working through some kinks but I expect that they will improve as they grow.

I would not be surprised if they outgrow their location within a year.

I will keep tabs on them and if they change to a different recipe for the veggie burger, we will be back.  It's hard for a steak loving dad and a vegetarian daughter to find a place to eat together.  If they put together an awesome veggie burger and they will get a 5th star and a repeat customer.

we ordered the gluten free pizza. It wasn't all that great; the crust was soggy which made it hard to eat with our hands. (we weren't offered any eating utensils). The folks at Whitewater Pizza were nice enough....just seemed rather uninterested in us as customers.

I had their Seafood Hor Mok in Fresh young coconut....it was good plain and simple.  I was happy to find this Thai food I sampled from my children's plates too and they were good as well.  The ONLY issue I had is the high prices.  I ened up paying 80 for a family of 5 and honestly there is only so much room in a coconut so I wasnt impressed enough to want to go back for that particular item.  With that said I probably bought one of the more expensive meals so there is something to be said for trying something else out.  I like Thai food and I will give them another go, but Ill keep an eye out for someplace else that might be better

I was visiting my parents for the holidays and stumbled on this place. I am so so happy that I did. Jenna and Ha are absolute gems!!! I honestly cannot say enough wonderful things about them. They take such care and do amazing nails, but they're also just amazing people. I plan to come back everytime I visit my family.

Five stars specifically for the food itself.
The service ( which is always just fine)  wouldn't and doesn't matter anyways since it is just.That.Good!
No other Thai restaurant in Idaho can compare. food is phenomenal and spectacular.All of it!
Especially If you like spicy red or green curry.
It's also cozy inside and what's to be considered as a hidden little gem.
The meals are huge so there are always leftovers 
And they have a nice assortment of beer and wine as well as holiday Moscow mules with Gin in the wintertime.
One of my top five favorites!

Forgery and theft, not a good place to workout! Will steal your money and tell you that your on a contract when your not, and when you signed a month to month contract... they'll forge your signature on a different contract saying its a 1 year contract... Sneaky and illegal.... BBB will be getting a call :)

Decent selection of beer, tho my second serving was obviously the end of the keg and was served anyhow, the alleys looked cool. My son said the burger was pretty good but the pizza was terrible. Obviously low quality ingredients period. Dough was blah, toppings were blah and the cheese tasted like low budget cheese that had been sitting out for a while. Thank you to the server that got the check reduced as the staff there was great but for the prices they charge there I would expect far better. After the quality and price of the food, I didn't care to check the prices for the bowling or anything else, I don't plan on going back period.

They have Tiki Punch too, which makes me happy. My local store in Payette never has it. 
This is a large store. In fact, one of the largest that I have been in. It's clean too. They have everything laid out in order and it doesn't have that Dollar Tree smell that some of the smaller stores do. For a DT, I was happy.

This Hampton is okay. Like other Hamptons it was clean, well priced, and the free breakfast is pretty good.

I didn't like that the TV was quite outdated and the gym was kind of small. Overall though it's not terrible, just a couple things could have made it a five star experience.

Mediocre tacos... Chorizo taco meat was burnt it had no flavor. Fajita (beef) taco was bland. Fish taco was decent with actually a delish sauce. Fajita (chicken) was over cooked as well with no flavor. Churros were fresh but lacked good flavor as well. Super disappointing.

As a server it is always my pleasure to write a good review for a restaurant. The counter is always clean and inviting. The service is always literally fantastic, and the management team is outstanding. As for the food don't even get me started the sauces always have such wonderful flavor and texture. The burgers are always grilled to perfection. Overall a the best experience one could ask for on a night out!!!
This is a newer hotel. The rooms are nice and comfortable. The staff is quite nice. Good indoor pool.

This rating is continuous as I sit here and enjoy the experience. 

First off, 

Staff: excellent, nice, courteous.

Milkshakes: amazing.....what more needs to be said.

Interior ambiance: chill, clean, very organized and pleasing to the eye.

The location is good and bad. Great that it's in the village, bad that the biggest buzz in the village is from the fountain area...probably the chi flowing from the water elements.....but I digress.

The Counter has great selection and if you love piling a ton of stuff on your built to feast burger then this is the place for you. 

Plus side! You can burn calories walking to The Counter from the fountain area and back...because most likely that's where your "Village" journey will start.

I've gotten over the lousy experiences with pet grooming and find the staff to be very helpful, knowledgeable and willing to assist in whatever way they can.  The Water Tower store even lets me use a spreader if they have sufficient, this even though I'm not a contracted lawn care customer.

Didn't even finish my food! It wasn't all that great. I ordered the.... darn I forgot! It's the one under the portobello burger, starts with an "S". But anyway, I've had better. Way better. The fries were good, just overly salted. If you want an awesome burger joint to go to that's in the Nampa area, go to blazin burger. It's the best. Cheaper too.

This is the best place to get your nails done in the treasure valley!! Definitely expect to wait if you don't have an appointment. Making an appointment is your best bet! They are the most friendly people and always keep me laughing. They have the best colors and the biggest range of sparkles I have seen! Love love love this place!!! The owners are a riot and keep me smiling!! 10/10
Fun atmosphere, the burger was good but not big enough. Great service and not too long of a wait for food either.

Free app with yelp check-in. Something called Armadillo Eggs. Really delicious. Chicken with jalapeño and cheese. Our server Carson was awesome. Attentive and gave suggestions on what to order. We went with Burgers and were not disappointed.  Large portions and lots of choices for sides. We will return the next time we roll through Boise.

Unique and flavorful deli in Meridian, ID. High quality ingredients, including bread from local Zeppole bakery. I enjoyed their 'from scratch' meatball sandwich made with hand rolled meatballs and their own homemade sauce. It was also topped with a tasty combination of melted cheese and herbs. My husband had one of their roast beef sandwiches, and commented it was quite flavorful. Our son got the BLT, which was served on a challah roll and was made with some of the most impressive bacon I have ever seen (thick, crispy and very tasty, not too much salt).  Side dish options included chips, cole slaw and potato salad. Cole slaw was a bit bland. Potato salad was very good. Tasted like they made it with roasted or at possibly baked potatoes, with herbs and little bits of bacon, which was also nice. Their soup of the day was an Italian Pesto Chicken. It was really good, but seemed a little salty after awhile. All in all though, we thought the food was great, portions were generous, and very nice ingredients. We will be back!

Whenever my wife and I come here we always say, "we should come here more often!"  This place is great. The staff is super friendly, and the food is delicious. The Saturday buffet is not to be missed. There is lots of authentic food, and the tortillas are made fresh right there. Great Mexican food!!!
Such good food but I stood in line behind one person for 20 minutes while they gabbed at the  counter- all these people working here and no one takes orders for their bakery. I left.

You guys, the employees here have such an amazing and kind heart. My fault for not catching his name, but our cashier tonight seriously has a heart of gold. You can just tell. Pizza was delicious, baked perfectly and was so fresh.  We will definitely keep coming back! Thank you again! We ordered and pizza was ready in 15 minutes!
This place is amazing. I am so glad that they are finally in Meridian I love their new cheesy dog bites they are the best!

While the food is pretty good and I appreciate the option of bison, and I knew the prices would be steep, the service was abysmal. The waiter was friendly enough, but the whole restaurant maybe had 5 or 6 other tables and it took a long time to get our food and we ended up getting part of it first, then the rest about 15-20 minutes later.

If you want awesome russet fries this is your place! Don't forget to get the garlic dipping sauce. The burgers are great also but the fries are what is the best. I stop by here after work and pick up fries to go with our dinner at home once a month and there are never left overs.

Delicious!! We started off with the Meatball Marsala with cheesy bread appetizer. Very yummy. For the entree  I had the Pork Chop with the Bacon, Jalapeño jam! So good and would get it again!  My husband had the Chicken Picatta and really enjoyed it and the rest of my entree. Very hearty meals and would definitely go back again.

!STOP! Don't stay here they have bedbugs. We booked a room for a baseball tournament, checked in at 6:00pm and at 11:00pm I saw a bedbug crawling on my stomach. I was there with my 2 year old and 11 year old. I quickly woke them up packed up bags and left. So gross!!!!

I spent 12 days in Thailand on vacation. I got back, and for one day, I was sick of thai food. Then over the next week there were 3 times (in San Francisco and Seattle) when I decided I wanted thai food again, but I wasn't yet ready for the inevitable disappointment. Then after a week I found myself in Meridian, Idaho for work, and decided to go for it, since I knew my first thai meal would be disappointing anyway and Idaho thai food was already going to be bad, obviously (offensive). It turns out both of those assumptions were incorrect. I left quite happy.

The decor is very comforting and inviting. It holds together well. They have a big menu. I got an eggplant basil dish, pad see ew, and green tea, which came served in a ceramic elephant. I prefer drinking my green tea out of the trunk of a live elephant, but I was nonetheless satisfied. Both dishes came out relatively quickly, with great presentation. Delicious. The service was very nice, and if my server wasn't Thai, she was more Thai than your average server at, say, the Subway next door.

For dessert I would have ordered the rambutan stuffed with pineapple (impressive that they actually have rambutan, eh?), but I was too full. In a good way. Overall I definitely recommend it. One idea for improvement would be to have an available selection of spicy things on the table.

In conclusion, some highlights of the soundtrack to my meal included muzak versions of Killing Me Softly, Don't You Want Somebody To Love, Imagine, Is This Love, and Isn't She Lovely.

I am not one who reviews fast food restaurants, however, my experiences when I have visited this McDonald's is as good as it gets...considering it is McDonald's. I've been here at five in the morning and I was greeted with a kind of customer service you would see at Starbucks. The wait times, although existent, are actually really good. They know how to run a restaurant and I appreciate the quality of service and attitudes of the employees.

Don't stay here!! Noisy, not clean and staff is not helpful!!  We booked because they were pet friendly and upon arrival we were told that they only had a limited number of rooms for guests with pets and there were none left. They offered no solution, so we just snuck her in because we were not about to loose the money we had paid online.  

It turns out the rooms were not so clean so having a dog in them was the least of the problems.  Wouldn't even take my shoes off.

To top it off off we had a couple in the hall yelling at each other most of the night!

Win some you lose some!  Don't waste your money on this place!!
Great food! Great service! Great music. Get there early for happy hour. They have a good Chardonnay for 6.00 and at happy hour it's 2 for one!

I was there today for a catered event. The food tables were totally picked over even though I arrived at the official start time, and I couldn't find a Big Al's employee anywhere to bring out more stuff. (Even if the organizers hadn't paid for more, an employee should have been on hand to answer questions.) There was also no vegetarian option - it baffles me how any caterer in this day and age can exclude that. It should always be assumed that 10% of the group will choose a non-meat option.

We had a hard time hearing the speaker because of the noise of water and dishes coming from the kitchen. I wouldn't recommend this venue for a speaker.

I'm pretty sure, as a guy, I'm not all that qualified to comment on a 'shoe' store, but my wife and I stopped in here today and the deals they had were pretty amazing.

A pair of fashion boots were here for about half the amount of a very nearby sporting goods store.  

Selection seemed pretty good for all types of shoes, and all employees we engaged in conversation were very friendly.

There is no excuse for a nail in our food. Not a finger nail a hardware nail no incident report nothing except trying to offer us more food. A damn hardware nail I need to know who to call or contact for further info on how a hardware nail gets in a Philly sandwich. We walked out and most def will not be back.

This place is known for the fries and you can get burgers too.
The burgers were good (I got the kids sized) 
The rest of my party got full sized burgers and fries. 
The blue fries (meh) 
The blue hash brown style petty good
The garlic fries were very good

I really wanted to LOVE this place because of the other reviews I read on here.  I feel like I came in with high expectations because of what I read here.  However, I felt like the meal was just ok.  I don't think it was authentic at all.  It seemed more like Americanized Thai food.  The atmosphere was nice but also felt a little claustrophobic to me.  Also, they have a scale of like 1-10 for spiciness on their dishes.  I really love extremely spicy food and asked for a 10.  My dish was hardly spicy at all so I had to ask for additional chilies to spice it up more.  At a real Thai place that wouldn't have been an issue.  Overall it was good but not great.  Sorry!

Great variety of fresh breads (often free samples), tasty soups, scrumptious desserts, and a rotation of unique deli offerings. Sandwiches? Meh - I go to other places for that. Decor makes me feel at home. Parking is ample, but lot seems tricky getting into. My favorites are the lemon or berry tarts.

They have really great customer service and I love their fries! I got their grilled chicken sandwich and my boyfriend got one of their speciality burgers!! Really enjoyed our food and time there! Onion rings are amazing as well!

Our family thoroughly enjoyed our food and the waiter was very energetic and friendly. We had the buffalo wing pizza with light blue cheese and it was very rich but tasty. We also had the Thai chicken salad and preferred the dressing that came with the chinese chicken salad. They definitely have more to offer here than just pizza and we will come back when we come back through the area for sure.

In town for a family wedding and dropped my IPhone in water the first day. I was so fortunate to be close to Rockstar and took it in. They were very friendly and called me within a few hours to pick it up after checking it out and fixing. Great customer service, turn around time, and price. Would definitely recommend Rockstar for any repairs, this place is awesome!

I travel a lot and I try to eat a different donut shop each day and I found DK Donuts to be the best one out of all of them. Just the right size donuts and just the right amount of sugar in them. They also feel light and not heavy like many places make them. The staff is very friendly also. Keep on making great donuts.

Terrible. Restaurant was filthy. For $26 for two adults and a kid better to go to chilis or drive a half mile and go to wich wich. Asked the manager if we could substitute the tomato soup for the chicken noodle soup on the kids meal and he said "nope sorry." My Reuben panini had one slice of pastrami and too much sauerkraut.  With all the great places to choose was sorry we picked this one.
Some of the food was ok, but some of it was really disgusting, including the soup, which was overloaded with all the wrong herbs.

This place needs direction! The tacos were decent. Probably a better tasting fish taco than I've had in a while. Fried chicken one was also tasty. Won't be back! This place could be a five star if there was some management. It's full of young kids that have zero customer service or work ethic. We are all for employing our youth. Our kiddos will be there some day soon but I pray they have more tact and sense then these ones. One of the kids ran his hands through his hair and then scooped chips for salsa. Two different customers asked for their food to go and it was served for in restaurant. The ice machine didn't work. The gal told us to use ice in a bucket because the machine made the ice taste gross. One of the kids picked up tortillas after rubbing his gloves hands on his face. Hardest working kiddo was a young man cleaning up the dining area and taking back trays. Glad that another patron told us there is a different location with some direction. 

But...the churros were bomb!

I'm in Idaho visiting and have been having the worst vacation ever...but coming here has helped me feel better. I just got the basic mani/pedi, but they really took their time and made my experience wonderful. So glad I came in. People are extremely friendly and professional. Highly recommend.

What can I say?  After a long day, we stopped for a burger.  Our waitress, Caitlin, was amazing.  Our food was correct, our waters filled, she was attentive, friendly, and good with our kids.  Thank you.

Big Al's has a fun atmosphere. The arcade is a pretty good size. The food isn't bad. The staff are pretty friendly. But seriously, over $40 for three of us to go bowling?!
Its sort of ridiculous that way.
I like the place other than that. I just don't understand what makes used shoes and balls worth the price.

I just went here tonight and it was delish! I got a cheeseburger and curly Laura fries and everything was great. The burger was juicy and well seasoned and loved the garlic aioli! The fries were crispy and very tasty. They give you A LOT of fries and the burger was the right size for the price. Also, their fries sauce is very tasty and compliments the fries perfectly. If you are wanting a quick gourmet burger stop by BFC for a great burger and fry!

We had a bad customer service experience at the Ram off Broadway a few years ago so we haven't been back to the Ram since. But last weekend we decided to give the Ram off Eagle a try. My wife got the tomato soup and a cheeseburger which was average at best. I ordered the french dip. I ate one half of it and again just average tasting and than I flipped over the second half and the bun had a pretty good size of mold growing on the bread. When I pointed it out they took my plate which I was still eating the chips, never asked if I wanted anything else, still charged us for 1/2 of our lunch, and took my name and phone number because the general manager was going to call me, which he never has. Needless to say we will not be back.

Such an awesome place! First off, they are so nice and just have awesome customer service. I'd go back just for that! But they are also amazing at what they do! I've been so satisfied with my services both times I've gone in. I also always see other people walking out with amazing nails as well! Also, it's very clean and well decorated in the salon! I'm so happy I found this place!

Food was pretty good. Everything is made from scratch and you can taste it. My only complaint is the lack of salt. I love salt and they don't use any. Other than that it was great. I had the blue bronco., a roast beef sandwich with blue cheese bacon pepper jack and lettuce, there was au jus on the side and some potato salad. The au jus and sandwich are good, the potato salad was just meh. However I am biased to my mom's.

Lovely hotel.  We asked if we could check out late it was 2 pm and not stay another night, we were done and wanted to go home but they said they would charge us $47 leave early fee (our room hadn't been cleaned).  I agree that it seems more like worrying about the bottom line than great customer service as we will regularly need a place to stay in Meridian.  The chair in our room had a big stain on it (we avoided sitting in it).  Other than that it was a nice place to stay.

We were barely greeted. The food was so so. The service was slow which I don't understand as there were 3 people sitting at the bar & one other table with 5 people. The worst part was that our table was sitting under a large TV that was so covered with dust I was afraid it was going to fall off on our table & food.

Awful service, our birthday party host dude was rude and didn't know jack. We'd ask simple questions and he'd direct us to elsewhere who would direct us back to him. We'd ask him for services (like bringing sauce for our pizza) and he told us it was not allowed. Later we discovered it was in fact, allowed. He was rude and openly argued in front of the whole party. Food was cheaply made, and could not accommodate for their own mistakes. The only thing this place really has going for it is the arcade. If you have Tyler as your host/server/whatever I'd recommend asking for someone else or just leaving all together, it wasn't worth arguing with him about shit that didn't even make sense.
This was my first time trying The Habit and it did not disappoint! The charburger was great and the employees were friendly and acted like they enjoy being there. We definitely will be back.

This is one of my favorite places to eat!  Awesome gluten free selection!  We love their milkshakes, fries, and of course their burgers!  The grilled cheese and chili are great too!

The booths are comfortable too. 

You can get beef, chicken, bison or other burgers here. We appreciate the selection!

Varsity Pizza, formally Blue Tiger, is a welcome sight. My son has eaten there on several occasion and recommend it highly.  I get so tired of hearing all the hoopla about other "Boise tradition" pizza restaurants, that fall way short of the quality, taste and service of Varsity Pizza.  When you're in the mood for upper scale pizzeria style pies? This is the place!

I love Thai food. I have to say I am shocked at all the high ratings on the quality of the food served here. My husband and I have been to some fabulous Thai places in Portland, Oregon. We were told to check this place out - not impressed. The Pad Thai was not like any Pad Thai I have ever had - they even used some stringy little noodle not the thicker rice-like noodles -it was actually pretty greasy too. We ordered another dish with chicken and asparagus. It was good but nothing to write home about. We will continue to look for a good Thai restaurant in Boise.

In Depth Detailing came to detail my VW Jetta TDI, and after he was done, my car looked even better than it did when I purchased it! I can't recommend them enough. If you're looking to have your car detailed, you DEFINITELY want to call In Depth Detailing!

Our family has visited this restaurant a handful of times since it opened near our home.  It's always a hit with the kids as they have a good menu and lots of pictures.  My husband and I always enjoy our food and I love the menu that continually changes.  The restaurant is typically busy, but the service has always been good, the food done very timely and the prices reasonable.

This place has amazing food, but horrible service. We sat at our table for 10 minutes, no one came by even to get our drink order, we had to get up and go get someone. Before we got up we saw our server just go sit down, completely forgetting about us. Also, they don't know much about the products they serve. But again, really good food once you get it.

Sa-wad-Dee is my favorite Thai place!  I am addicted to green curry, and theirs is delicious!  We really enjoy coming here and trying different things, or ordering our favorites.  On our last visit my husband ordered sushi, and not only was it beautiful, it was fresh too, which can be hard to come by in this land-locked town. The staff is always friendly and accommodating and we look forward to each visit.

Had a good time at the park my only complaint is they will not let you bring your own food in the park.  On two different occations I stood in line over 40 minutes each time  waiting for a piece of over priced pizza and an over priced funnel cake.  Not sure my family will ever return.
Oh~! Best lunch + break I've ever had during work. It isn't expensive at all even though I have ordered a tone! I would like come here again and again with my teammate:)

Tacos were just ok. Brisket taco was pretty bland without adding anything to it. Fried chicken taco had small pieces of chicken. I am guessing it was cooked at the same time as a shrimp taco because it had an overwhelming seafood flavor even though it was chicken. However, star of the show was the tin roof taco. The pineapple onion combo was awesome with the pork!
They did a great running evaluation and I think I like my new Mizuno shoes better than any other one I have had.

Such a great place. So much better than the one in Boise. Been here 3 times so far and each time they made our pretzels fresh. They just melt in your mouth when they're fresh. Definitely a must-have if you're going to the Village.

My wife and I tried this Monday night since it is truly a "neighborhood" grill for us. What a surprise!! My wife tried the Gnocci and loved it, and I tried the Salmon and it was truly on par with the best salmon that I have ever had. My side was "fresh vegetables", and I was horrified to see a hollowed tomato show up on my plate... I decided to give it a try and it was fantastic!... and I don't even care for tomato's. The meal was just so full of flavor, and we like the laid-back atmosphere. Truly a pleasant surprise!
Today was my 1st experience here and they were really fun!.  Lynn did my nails and they're exactly the way I wanted them.

The staff was very nice and they got me in late in the day. I got regular polish, but the owner insisted the nail tech paint my nails then do lotion massage at the end .... The poor girl spent her time trying not to accidentally touch my wet toes and it wasn't a good massage because of that. With so many options I'll go somewhere else next time.

This place was amazing. I moved from AZ a few month ago and have had a hard time finding a good nail place.  I had been going to the same guy for years. Jana Nail Tek was currently busy when I went but booked me an appointment for later.  Did a fantastic job on my nails which were HORRIBLY done at a previous facility.  The price was good and decal was included! Very happy with my experience and will be going there again!

I'm visiting from Los Angeles and we don't have one of these amazing little blue shacks near me! My friend has been raving about this place and I was so happy to visit while in town. We told the barista in the drive thru line that it was my first time and they paid for my coffee as a first time, what the heck, that's the sweetest freakin' thing!! I got the hazelnut latte and it was so yummy!!! My friend loves their black coffee with almond milk, they also have a stamp card. Being from LA I'm a bit of a coffee snob and this place hit the spot! Yummms!

Very disappointed in our visit here tonight. First we called to see how long the wait was; a quick time answer turned into a 1 minute phone call of the manager talking my ear off about how great a place this was and that the 10-15 minute wait would be quickly. We got there around 7:15pm. expected to be seated by 7:30 because they said it was "busy". We arrive and there are multiple open tables therefore the wait should have been much less then that. We didn't mind waiting thats not the point of my review. Anyways we got seated and waited another 5 minutes before anyone came over to introduce themselves as a server or give us water. The manager proceeds to come over and. take our order. We didn't even know our servers name and definitely was not really satisfied with the food. I could have saved 2 hours of my time and made the food at home. Fries were very dry and burger was alright. I loved the counter back in California but the staff here simply does not move with purpose while on the clock. Very disappointed and will not be back... Waste of $45..
I don't see what the fuss is about. It's not that great, I've had a lot better fries at a lot of other places for better prices.

Not only do we love Thai food, we cook it at home regularly.  This was not what we would consider THAI food.  It tasted more like like Japanese food.  Not bad but bland. Not flavorful like Thai food normally is but bland. None of the normal Thai favors we are used to, none of the normal Thai punch, even in the broths.  Please do not base your love of Thai food on what this restaurant provides.  Thai food has a lot more flavor, richer sauces, richer food.  Sorry but this was a disappointment in our quest for Thai food in the Boise area.  It was good food, just not indicative to Thai favors.  More along the lines of the mild favors of Japan. If they advertised that they were a Japanese restaurant, we would have given a higher score. This is not the flavors of Thailand.

Not horrible. But not great. Our room did not smell like others have said, but when you turned the heater on, it did smell like burnt hair, and the smell didn't go away.

Staff wasn't super welcoming, they didn't seem like they wanted to be there. 

Room- no huge complaints, the carpet is all bubbly I'm assuming from being old. Walls are VERY thin. You can hear everything. 

If you're just passing through it's fine, if you're staying a few nights I don't recommend it.

Ate at BFC while looking for a home in Meridian, saw it on the food channel so wanted to try them. No big deal, the regular burger was just ok and I had the duck fries, I  didn't notice any difference in flavor with the duck fat. Best part of the meal was the sauces, some very good. Don't think I'll return.

I work nearby and decided to order a lunch for pickup. I  ordered the 1 meat plate with beef brisket, and chose green beans and the baked potato casserole as my sides. Meal includes buttered roll. 

Pros:
You can place order online from their website, which is easy to navigate and has no pesky requirements to create an account.  When I arrived to pick up my order 15 minutes later, it was packed up and ready to go.  Utensils and napkin were already included in the bag.  Staff was friendly.

Cons:
The food.... The food wasn't good!! The brisket was OK -- although it was bland it was fairly tender.  Didn't taste too bad once it was dunked in the included BBQ sauce.  But the green beans were definitely canned, and were sitting in a pool of watery liquid. No flavor other than the flavor of canned beans, even though the description states they're cooked with bacon.  As for the baked potato casserole, I'm pretty sure it was made with instant potatoes.  The potatoes had the gritty texture and odd flavor that only comes from a box.  I'm not a total food snob, but I don't even eat canned veggies or instant potatoes at home and definitely don't want to pay restaurant prices for them!  The roll was alright, but they forgot to include butter.  Maybe the butter is just brushed on top?

I knew the food wouldn't be as good as one of the local BBQ restaurants that makes everything from scratch, but I thought it would at least match the quality of the other BBQ chain restaurant in town.  Not even close.  I gave Dickey's 3 stars due to the convenience and good service, but the food itself is worth closer to 2 stars.

Everyone keeps talking about their donuts and they all miss the most important aspect of this place......They having mutha ducking KOLACHES!!!   Being a Texan  that was exciting for me...   Donuts where ok...wasn't Shipleys...  but its better than anything else Ive tried around this place.  especially Krispey Kreme....yuck...  My only suggestion would be to get rid of the hotdogs and start using sausages..boudin... ham and cheese...etc....

This Hampton Inn is a little nicer than the typical Hamptons only because they have a larger dining area and the doors open up to a nice curved staircase. The breakfast and rooms are typical of other Hampton Inns and the staff are extremely friendly. This hotel has smoking and non-smoking rooms, so you can smell the smoke down some of the main hallways, but once in your room it's smoke free. Great hotel to stay at for business since their amenities are available 24/7.

Great quality pizza, great price and nice owner. They are under staffed and we did have to wait a while for our pizza but they were very upfront about it. Hopefully they can work out the staffing issues. Keep up the good work! We hope they are around for a while.

I absolutely love Sa-Wad-Dee! My boyfriend and I live close to Meridian and this restaurant is a nice break from the usual bland chain food that has become the usual out here. As a vegetarian who prefers to eat vegan, I love the options that Sa-Wad-Dee has to offer. They are willing to adjust almost any meal on the menu to make it suitable for veg heads (minus most of the curries which come with a premade fish sauce) and the service is excellent! We've become friends with many of the servers here and besides the fact that they will occasionally give us a white forest on the house (our fav dessert with lychees and coconut milk yum!) the owner and people that work here are the type that you want to see succeed and do well. 

My favorite items on the menu are the pad woonsen, the spring rolls, the Dr. Greg noodle, the tofu show, the ginger lovers, and the garlic noodle.  Their bubble tea is fantastic (definitely need to try the taro flavor) and I love getting the lemon meringue pie mixed drink although I'm not sure if this was only a seasonal addition.  As far as dessert goes, the white forest is my favorite but there are many other delicious treats such as the F.B.I. and the sweet mango sticky rice.  

In my opinion, Sa-Wad-Dee has the best Thai food in Boise hands down not to mention the recently starting serving Japanese food as well that is better than most of the other Japanese restaurants in Boise.  One more plus, their miso soup is vegetarian!!!  Where else in Boise can you find miso on a menu that doesn't have bonito in the broth? Awesome!

The "Trevor" is the best sandwich I've ever eaten! The "Blue Bronco" is also amazing. Can't imagine that anything on their menu is less than mind blowing. The service is wonderful! They seem to be having a lot of fun together and are ready to crack a joke with you and share their passion for their menu! Who knew sandwiches could be so uniquely delicious?! Find this place! You'll never regret it!!!

This restaurant never disappoints the sushi is good the Thai food is good everything is good been here more times than I can count and the service is always good and to me that is just as important as the food being delicious I will always recommend this over Kona or Fujiyama which are good as well but this place is the best because of the service.

Eric and his team are great!  I was impressed from the minute I walked in that they care about what they do. They listened, then analyzed my Mac's hard drive and gave me a few options with repair estimates.  There was no variance to the estimate and actual price I paid for the repair. Eric's team is knowledgeable and seem to have fun at their jobs. I would highly recommend taking a computer or I-phone in to Rockstar for any type of repair work.

Finally, something other than burgers and fries. LOVE the soup, go thru the drive thru whenever I can, even with the wait inside, the food is worth it. FRESH and great tasting. VERY happy they are in Meridian. Try the 3 cheese cauliflower soup, but be warned, you'll be hooked. Breads and pastries are wonderful, croissant is light, flaky and melts in your mouth. Highly recommend, and don't blame them that the line is long, there is a reason for that!

Our 1st choice for Mexican food. Excellent extensive menu including for kids and for smaller appetites. Amador (owner) makes a point to stop by our table on most visits to say "hi" and to be sure that we're pleased. And, they are the quickest to bring your meal! We love it!

Good place for games, bowling and watching sports. That's about it.
Food was disappointing, service was disappointing. Our waitress told us they had about 40 beers on tap, but could only name the beers that every bar has on tap (Bud, Coors, Blue Moon, etc). There was only a list of the breweries they had on tap, but not the specific beers. When we'd ask what beer they had for a specific brewery our waitress had no idea, and then tried to justify her lack of knowledge by then saying they'd had a big event the previous day and were actually out of a lot of beers. And then it was her manager's fault for not getting her updated beer lists. 
We ordered appetizers - chicken skewers, spinach artichoke dip and onion rings. The waitress recommended the chicken skewers, but then said she'd never tried them, but hear they were good. They were okay. Teriyaki flavored, but only 2 small skewers for $5 (happy hour price). The spinach artichoke dip was actually pretty tasty but the tortilla chips they served with it were beyond stale and obviously dumped on a plate from a plastic bag. And after the food was dropped off our waitress (and all the other staff in the restaurant area) seemed to disappear.
The one great thing about the restaurant was the wall of BIG screens. The night we went Monday Night Football and baseball playoffs were on. I'd go back to watch sports there and enjoy beers, but I'd probably pass on food.
We did do some bowling with friends. If you like loud tween-type music that you can't talk over you'll enjoy this place. That being said we did have a pretty good time. At 9pm they started cosmic bowling. We weren't expecting it, but it was fun. We didn't play any other games, but might check it out again for that.
It's in a nice central location and luckily there are a lot of other places around to eat. I think when or if we go back it will be for beers and games or sports watching, but we'll be sure to eat first. And go in expecting just okay service.
I will say that the one waitress serving the bowling lanes did a good job of keeping our beer pitchers full. And the bartender at the bar by the bowling alley was great.

Such a cool place! U get to choose the type of potato, sauce, and seasoning of the fries! You also get to choose the type of meet and toppings for your hamburger! It's all pretty much custom which I'm a fan of. "Just the way you like it." Super creative flavors all around. We ordered it right before beginning the 5 hour drive home to UT and made the drive way more entertaining trying all the types of sauces with our two flavorful types of fries. We tried a beef and turkey burger and the turkey was for sure one of the best we have had. Smaller burgers, which was great since I was hand feeding my husband who was driving the car, decreasing the mess, and we were able to easily share the burgers making it just the right amount of food. No one wants to feel over stuffed when ur on a road trip. Loved it! Friendly staff too!

We love our visits to Counter burger in Meridian. It is a great place to go as a date or even with kids (we have 4 under the age of 10).  The food is always excellent and built to cater to my VERY picky and strict nutrition plan. The service is always great and I appreciate the fact that they always treat our kids so well. We will be life time customers!
Good prices. The roasted corn taco was really good but not warm. Probably as they were so busy. Chips and salsa was good roo.
Lame, they state they're open until 9pm on Sundays but when I went at 8:30pm they had all the lights off and employees were just playing around in the kitchen area.

To be honest, I don't go here for the food. The draw is the 18,000 big TV's that you stare at when theres a bunch of great college football games on a Saturday afternoon. I've been here a lot of times... the food is below average. It's just simply not good. If the food was great I'd go more often. Great entertainment.

Two and half stars would be better. The service was alright. The ambiance of the resteraunt was quiet. A little too quiet. We ordered the dino eggs, those were awesome but that was it. The rest was pretty basic. Overall it was just okay nothing exciting.

Pretty good Mexican food here today. Had the ground beef tacos and their chips and salsa. It was all really good. The salsa especially had a really good limey flavor. I'd give it a 5 star, but any place that serves beans and rice as sides to a dish can't get a perfect rating. Beans and rice is prison food.

If you want a full stomach on the most amazing sandwich you'll ever eat, come to Fat Guy's! The Italian is delicious. Every Friday they make clam chowder which is incredible. Definitely bring an appetite, or a friend to share a sandwich with. Portions are HUGE! :)

So this review is specifically for the food, as I have yet to actually try the other portions of the place and haven't been bowling in years.

Walked by and realized that I had a gift card from Christmas and suddenly really really wanted a burger.

So being someone who loves spicy food (used to work for an Indian Restaurant where some foods could give Pepper Spray a run for its money) and eats it almost exclusive, I looked for the spiciest burger on the Menu.

Lord and behold, the Near Death burger. Really wasn't expecting it to be that spicy because most burger joints and Grills say they have "One of the Spiciest things around" and it ends up being, "Meh,".

However it was well named because it nearly killed me and 3 hours after eating it, my lips are still burning.

Kudos to your chef, he knew exactly how to make one of the spiciest things I've ever eaten.

I've come across Hot Curries that are less spicy.

Thus I am impressed.

Oh I also loved your seasoned, crunchy fries too. Seemed to be a lot like those addictive potato wedges you can find at Grocery Delis but smaller and more crunchy. Some of the best I've had recently.

And will prolly be back to go bowling, play some arcade games, and see if I can make it through another one.

LOVED IT.

Went out with the wifey and another couple for some bowling/cosmic bowling and food at Big Al's over the weekend. The service was a bit slow at times, nd had to wait to flag someone down to get another beer, however they were quite busy being a Friday night. The food was decent, but certainly not hot, the Nachos were luke warm at best and the spur cream dollop slid right off after grabbing our first chip. There was no offer for more sour cream as it sat on our table until we cleaned it off. The wings were pretty good and had plenty of sauce and dip. The bowling was great fun, especially when it changed to cosmic bowling. The biggest downside to the night was the heat in the building. We were told the AC was on but the servers were sweating profusely, and the guests were doing the same. Overall this was a bit pricey for the experience, though I will probably go back.
The fries are great. Tons of different options and the sauces add extra options and new flavors.  4 or 5 stars for fries. Burgers left a lot to be desired. I would go back for the fries!

Had the pound burger was amazing great service
Friendly customer service great milkshakes

Really enjoyed my meal!! Avoided the wait by sitting at the bar; prompt service, good local beer. 

The noodles were really tasty, and the sushi was fresh. We had the "twisted" roll. It was unique and flavorful.

The restaurant was clean, the food great, and the staff helpful. Will definitely be coming back!
Last years wedding reception was terrifying. They did a very poor job! Michelle shame on you for ripping us off !

How can this stuff be called coffee?!  It's terrible!!!
I've been to alot of coffee shops and this one is the worst. Service was ok, but they're  selling garbage. 
Yuck.

I was impressed with the burger and fries. Though I still miss In N Out, this is now my go-to burger place in the Treasure Valley. Double cheeseburger was full of flavor, and great cheese too! Fries were crunchy, which is good, but seemed as though we got all of the end pieces - most were small. Not trying to be too critical, but even though, this is now my favorite place for a burger. Ambiance was excellent - love the decor and especially the music. Will definitely be back.

This place was a lot of fun! We bowled on the side with the big screens and music which made it 10x more fun b/c bowling is not our forte. It was like stepping back in time to MTV at times and then there would be a country song, I think it was $32 an hour

sweet jesus!  is this why i was born vegetarian?  had me a large order of purple tatos w/ sweet tatos mixed in... i added vinegar salt + sriracha powder + malt vinegar.

wait!  not done yet!  sit down a minute:

also ordered a vegan patty with 'heat' sauce to help ease the burden of this tashty tashty meal.  sooooo good!  soooo happy!  i love boise!  and i love this place!

What a nice little bagel place next to our hotel. It was hidden around the other side of the parking lot, but I take long morning walks and it popped up right away. Now I do like my Pumpernickel Bagels, but alas no pumpernickel. The Sesame Bagel was wonderful toasted just right, and I loved it. Nothing like having a nice little bagel place right around the corner.

This little gem was definitely worth the drive. The food was amazing.  I had salmon with fingerling potatoes and sautéed veggies...even saved room for an excellent chocolate torte! Tammy, our server, was very friendly and made us feel welcome.

I have to say that the overall food was quite good. My problem lies with the fact that I inquired and about the sauces and their cost I was told by the server to ignore that they hadn't got around to correcting in on the menu and that they don't charge until the 5th one. So I ordered my burger 1/3 pound hormone  free antibiotic-free yada yada yada burger. I add brie, bacon, onion confit and mushrooms. And I get the roasted garlic aiol house mustard and sweet sriracha. The burger was spot on juicy and flavorful the mushrooms and brie worked great as did the sauces. My problem lies with the fact that I was charged for 2 of the 3 sauces after being told that sauces aren't charged until the 5th one. If your waitstaff tells customers something this should be the case. I will come back but I will also note this event at the time and will dissect my bill when it comes.

Came here on a friend's recommendation.  Ordered the basil bruschetta burger on the same recommendation.  What a mistake.  

The combo "deal" they offered brought a $9 dollar burger to $12 bucks, with a side of greasy pasta noodles.  Pasta is easily the most overpriced food.

The burger itself was large, but stuffed in a gigantic ciabatta bun.  It took me a lot of bun bites to actually get to the burger, which was drenched in balsamic vinegar.

Here is where you can find the mark of a sandwich maker that knows what they're doing or don't.  Competent sandwich makers don't drown their sandwiches, because liquids eat the bread.  

So, I ditched the ciabatta, and went for the burger itself.  Crunchy on the outside and chewy in the middle, like they flash fried it.  One of the worst burgers I've had, and that price doesn't help it at all.   Like every other restaurant in the Meridian Village, overpriced garbage, and you're just better off wallet and portion size grabbing a burger at any of the other great local places in Boise / Meridian.

Also, I don't much care for the "hipster" ambiance of these types of places. 

Wow, you're so cool playing hip hop from the early 90's from a tinny little stereo by the cook. High ceilings, noisy place, my friends and I practically had to yell to be heard in an empty joint.

This place is fast! There was a line when I arrived but they are super quick and cheerful here. They have a good variety. I usually stick to my same everything-bagel-with-cream-cheese most of the time, but their cranberry orange bagel caught mu eye so I tried that. There are a few others I will try next time, too. Close to my new place, so I will def be back!
The band is awesome!!!! You should really think about having them year around!!!   Upstairs would be perfect!

The sandwich was made perfect but my only complaint is the bread.  I had a french roll and it was awful.  Tasted like they just bought it from the store and pulled it out of the fridge.  It was cold, not soft and was not fresh tasting.  If it were made on a pastry perfection roll or other good soft bakery roll it would have been perfect.  A good sandwich starts with good bread.  Other than the bread the sandwich was very good.

First time eating here, service was great, clean and food was wonderful. Variety of fries and the bison burger tasted fantastic. Price was more than fair for the meal. Heading back to Boise soon and will be heading back to BFC.

Torn about this place, I went to Costco before going here to compare prices.  The difference isn't much.  The product here is appears to be returned items that are missing things or damaged, with not a huge savings.  May have just been the product I was comparing.  For example, newest model of food saver @ Costco 120, food saver (older model) in a card board box in pieces here, 100.  

This staff has been hit and miss, sometimes great, sometimes very rude.

The food is good but priced high.  I do think they care about presentation and if the taste is good.  Very small interior for sitting but, they have a garage door they can open if the weather is.nice. Worth a try!

Well when you can buy everything for a dollar how much more can you say. Of course I went in for one thing since it was next door to another store I was already shopping at and came out with ten dollars worth of stuff. 

Nothing is for a long term investment but for the cheap stuff that you need for a one time event this is the place to buy it at.
Dave is awesome.  Does a great job on our pool.  Worry free for us.

I had the Bleu Bronco it was something like I never tasted. The clam chowder was crazy good too.  It was hard to find but it was so worth the find. Thanks Captain Bill G. for the sandwich recommendation.  Amazing.
Amazing donuts! The best donut is the bacon Maple bar! The service is very friendly, and they always have a excellent selection.

Great ambiance, authentic thai staff, smells of vibrant thai seasonings, and of course tasty food.  Been to Thailand twice and this is the most authentic thai food I've had in the treasure valley.  We even did a Christmas dinner hear and had a blast with the live music that night...  Next to buying a ticket to Thailand, this stop is A1 if you gotcha a cravin for Thai...  Recomended newbies start with the Pad Thai and have a Thai sweet tea to perk u up:)
This place was just meh.  Atsmophere was fine and the service was great but i wasn't impressed by the food.
This place has the best customer service. My kid asked about 12 questions about foot pain & all of his questions were answered perfectly! Thank you

GREAT VALUE - Room was small but adequate. Needed to have an inexpensive room for one night that was clean and comfortable and it was. I would recommend but just don't expect high end. For $65 it was perfect for me.

We had our company Christmas dinner at Grants this evening based on an employee's recommendation. The service was excellent,  special drinks and appetizers better than promised and entrees incredible. I had the Pot Roast which was moist and flavorful, my wife had the salmon slab, which truly was a slab, not something you'd expect at your typical restaurant. The others that had the pork chop were equally impressed. It felt like dining at an old friend's home. Not your typical place. Thanks for making our evening memorable.

Another VERY satisfied customer as usual!!! This however was my first one getting the bagel sandwich and it was AMAZING!! I had the Asiago cheese bagel with sun dried tomato cream cheese, chicken breast, Swiss cheese, avocado, deli mustard, tomato & sprouts! FANTASTIC!!! My girlfriend had bacon, egg & cheddar on a wheat bagel with jalapeño cream cheese! Again knocked it out of the park and we are already deciding on what we will have next! Great job Blue Sky & the fabulous staff!
This is a newer Walmart. Clean and nice, the staff isn't burnt out yet. If a 24/7 Walmart is what you are looking for, THIS IS THE ONE.

I just moved to Meridian and wasn't sure where to get my nails done. Having gorgeous and fun nails is part of me. I took a chance on calling Nail Tek. Everyone there was friendly and fun. I have to say that Lynn did an amazing job on my nails. She will be my go to girl from know on. Thank you.
