Can't recommend.  Chicken was old, dry and chewy. Meal had no Thai flavor.  Barely passed for Asian food. Don't have their eye on the ball

Have eaten here off and on.... But since new owners have take over... the place is fantastic. Homemade is the key. Soups, pasta, and Pizza... for get your thoughts of another Pizza Hut... This is a true dinning experience.  Delivery, Catering and Take-out... Actually my entire Team is having a catered picnic today with salads and everything on the menu... to hard to decide which is best....  Thanks Dave, Stacee and Crew!

My dogs are verrrrrry finicky with their nails and I've never been able to trim them myself.  Aussie Pet Mobile came by and did a great job at trimming them, better than any other place I've taken them to.  I also had my extremely fluffy, fat cat groomed, they did an awesome job with her as well.  Highly recommend, I will be using them in the future.

Nice convenient little strip mall location. Service is good, food is quite good. Nice range of authentic Thai foods and a few Americanized dishes. I was surprised at how good it was. The night we went they had live music that was really nice as well.

I took my MacBook Pro in for a desperate diagnostic testing. It was not working well, had become extremely slow and frustrating. Pete listened to my tale of woe and reassured me that I didn't own a doorstop. He gave me an estimated time for him to run tests and give me an estimate. 
I was delighted to hear that my computer could be repaired and returned to me within 24 hours of the time I dropped it off!!
The service was terrific and fast, and the price was very reasonable. Not to mention how nice these guys are!  
Highly recommended for your computer needs!!

Went there for a company Christmas party. Don't even know where to start. The food was possibly the worst I have ever experienced. Salad - dry, brown, wilted and warm. Rolls - hard as a rock. Vegetables mix of Broccoli,carrots - dry, uncooked, too tough to chew and no butter or seasonings, terrible. Potatos mashed - no doubt from a box, no flavor. Roast beef - aha they can cook something after all. Drinks - Vodka Cranberry was all ice, no booze and very little Cranberry $6, Beer $5 for a 16 oz and it was warm. Nowhere in Boise,Nampa or Meridian is a 16 oz domestic beer $5, hell not even in Chicago Denver etc. It was a bad experience all the way around

Very small side salads, like tiny. Out of potato salad after the guy talks me into it.
 But after all said and done... one pretty dam good sandwich. I will try it again.

We went on Christmas, a huge family! The waitress was so awesome, I wish I could remember her name. I am gluten intolerant, and she was so kind and helpful, thank you for not taking my food sensitivity personally.  Food was great, service was the best! Thank you for a great holiday memory.

Favorite Thai restaurant in the Treasure Valley area. Don't let the strip mall facade fool you, the food here is great. Restaurant is clean with good ambiance. We usually get to-go but the table service is pretty good (has been a bit slow when they get busy). Sa-Wad-Dee accomodates gluten free requests (my favorite is Thai Chili Fried Rice) but they can do many other dishes gf as well. Try this place if you are in Meridian!

Great locally owned restaurant with big sandwiches that will make you full!  Awesome soups and lots of sandwiches to choose from. They will be happy to make you a custom sandwich that isn't on the regular menu!  Friendly faces and great food!

Zero Stars if that was possible, possibly the worst meal I've eaten in my entire life, the steak was chewy the cheese was to choke for, it was practically inedible, margarita tasted like margarita mix, everything tasted disgusting...
This place is really great, and I would definitely eat there again. Funny that it's unapologetically a knock off of in n out burger. Not quite as good as in n out but as close as we can get in Idaho!
Great park, fun rides for both thrill seekers and non thrill seekers. fun times here. Obviously still theme park priced food but otherwise more than worth the admission price for sure.
This place has excellent service and fabulous food.  I have had thai food from a lot of places and this is still the go to for our family!  Fresh ingredients!!!  Wonderful drinks and desserts!!!

After reading the reviews on Yelp, I had to try this place out and it did not disappoint. They were able to get me in quickly despite the busy location. Each tech made an effort to learn my name and the massage during the pedicure was out of this world. One thing I particularly liked was that they massaged my legs/feet while my nail polish dried vs. finishing up and leaving me to sit there waiting for my polish to dry. It was a great treat and so nice to be able to leave right when it was done. What a great crew! Will definitely be back.

First time in Idaho and I had to get fries.  I was visiting a friend, and she took me to Boise Fry Company.  Delicious food, and the staff was adept at handling food allergies (gluten and corn).  Excellent, and will definitely be back again on my next trip to Idaho!

Big Al's is a novelty.  It's sheer size is reason enough to at least "take a look". Along with its two separate bowling allies it has a massive bar with 9 different TV screens.

Up stairs is an entire floor dedicated to video and other games that garner winning tickets which can be used to buy prizes.

My son loves this place so when he is with me we go there a couple of times.  However, I prefer smaller venues with a little character.

The food is not bad but unremarkable.  The beer is cold and the atmosphere "mall like".
Good place to take a break...rooms were clean and for the price it can't be beat. Pool and spa were clean
I've tried every Boise Fry Company and this one is my favorite.   The customer service is stellar,  the restaurant is clean,  and the food is always top notch!
Great hand crafted sandwiches! Chef Wally is a genius. You will love this place I promise. Order the "Big Chief" and bring your appetite.

Decent food, prices, & selection. 

Service is okay, some extra training might help the girls make better tips :) 

Cheerleader salad= bagged lettuce, bagged carrots, bagged cheese, fresh avocado yum, slices of red onions and pretty good ranch with decent croutons for $5ish on a huge plate! Not too bad! :)

Ordered a chicken wrap took a couple bites had a little spice I enjoyed but overall just meh, got bored of it quick.

Husband ordered the triple club, husband thought it was very greasy, wouldn't order it again. He prefers there burgers better.

Go here if you want to chill and enjoy subpar/decent food, prices, and service.

The food was great, serving sizes were big and options were simple but good. They know what they are good at and stick with it. They line was longer but fast to get to the front. Seating opened up quickly also. The price wasn't bad but a little more on the expensive side for French fries and a burger. I would definitely return just plan on smelling a little like French fries when you leave!

I enjoyed the Habit Burger. It's kind of like In and Out or Five Guys. You order at the front counter, they give you a pager, and then page you when you're food is ready. The food was fresh and I enjoyed it. I actually liked it more than Five Guys.  So that's the scoop.  You've got to at least try it for yourself.
Big selection as long as you show up earlier in the day.  This is our second time here.  The first time was in the afternoon, and there was little left to choose from.

Sandwiches designed with the dagwood lover in mind.  They have a large variety of types for every taste.  The bread is more "substantial" which I prefer over a Subway type of bread that's more wispy.  Bread is better when you need to tear at it a bit.  The meat is always ample and the sauces and veggie choices are good too.  The Louie is my favorite.  Staff is always pleasant and helpful.  Price is a little much at $9 for a super-bird but then again that's a bigger hoagie.
I tried this place years ago when they first opened and didn't like it. Gave it another chance today (had a free sandwich coupon) and really liked it. I'll be back.

So glad we gave these guys a second chance. Tried them out when they first opened and wasn't impressed, but then gave them a second shot what a difference getting settled made.  Now they are my go-to for hot pizza carry out and I much prefer them over the national PH chain up the road. Flavors are good and pizzas are cheesy. If your looking for a good deal try their $6.99 2 topping carry out ;)

Stopped in for lunch with my wife.  It wasn't too busy and we were seated in a comfortable booth.  The place was clean, and had a few flat screens with sports on.  You can custom build a burger or choose one of their prefab creations.  My wife had one of the menu and I created a turkey burger with jalapeño cheese, lettuce, tomato, pickles and onions.  You put the ketchup/mustard/sauces on yourself.  We both enjoyed the burger.  I also got Cole slaw as a side dish and was happy with that as well.  Service was very good.

My sister and I were looking for a new salon so I jumped on Yelp and started reading review's. The pictures of this staff's work were beautiful and reviews were great. Called them and asked if they could accommodate walk-ins and they had a few cancellations, could we be there in 15 minutes?

Their spa pedicure was so relaxing and they have great color choices plus glitter dusting and designs. Ha was very funny and personable, made us feel right at home with his friendly banter. You could tell that he loves his job. 

Price was great for a basic pedi so we left good tips. This will be a new sister tradition whenever I am in Boise!

Family favorite!! Bought season pass for family this year. Expensive, but we will see if we get our money worth.

7 year old hurt himself on pipe sticking out of ground. We complained to staff. Next day CEO calls apologizes comps our lunch and the pipe fixed on our next visit.
Some of the friendliest baristas I've encountered :) The breve was unique and they did not skimp on the whip

Came in for lunch, wanted to try something new. Ordered a BLT. Bacon was bland. How does that happen?!  Bread was so crunchy it was difficult to eat and the sandwich was just dry. Had to add mayo to get through the whole sandwich. Onion strings and fries were passable on flavor, though the onion strings were super greasy. Service was fast, friendly, and helpful.

Yesterday I ordered a turkey burger with classic toppings and bacon. They messed up on my burger 3 times before I got what I ordered. By the time I ate it, it was cold and wasn't a fan of thier smoked fry sauce. Although their salt and ketchup bar are fun my fries were so dry and a little cold that nothing would stick to them. Overall I was really let down. I had high expectations... not interested in eating there again.

I've eaten here several times and it's always been great. The owner is a really cool
Lady, I don't what's up with all the negative Nancy's on here...

Drove by a billion times, finally decided I need to check it out. Glad I did! A++ on the friendliness of the staff, decent prices, and the best part... one heck of a menu. I was completely overwhelmed by the choices! Ended up getting a little bit of everything. It was all superb. Very lean meats. I think the beef brisket was my favorite. Or maybe the grilled chicken. Hmm but the pulled pork was excellent, too. See? Overwhelming. We got take-out... and it was ready very quickly. Definitely going back there.... soon!

Good food, but one of the employees ran out the door after us when we left and yelled " Hey, you're supposed to bus you own glasses!  Oh, but don't worry, I'll do it."  First time there and we were in a hurry for an appointment.  So, yes we forgot about our glasses, but this is no way to treat someone who just tipped you.  Won't be going back.
we went to breakfast after dropping the kids off for school.  The food was fresh and great tasteing.  Jesse was very friendly and a great host.  Ask for Jose to make your food.

I just had Marcos it was delicious. For me it's all about the crust and the sauce. The crust was crisp and fresh and the sauce was really good. The next time I go I'm gonna try the ultra thin crust. A must try for pizza

In Meridian for a business trip brought here by clients for lunch.

I love the variety of sandwiches on the menu and love love that the sandwiches were fat and not skimpy on anything.

I got me the Chicken Salad with Chips and a drink, very good deal.  Sandwich so fat, I only ate half of it.

Customer service is great, they greet you as you walk in and thank you as you leave.  But that part of the culture in Idaho...in my opinion Idaho has the most friendly people on the planet.

Came back to visit Boise with my family and we made a trip downtown to hike camel's back and go to BFC.  The fries are still the star (although my favorite purple fry was out that day).  The bison burger is very good;  highly recommend it.  A new addition is the half size burgers for the kids;  portions were perfect for elementary school age kiddos.  My wife had the quinoa salad,  which is a great side to have with fries.  

The only suggestion I have would be to punch up some of the sauces.  Not hotter just maybe a new sauce.  The fry sauce is legit but the garlic aioli doesn't have enough garlic taste.  Maybe it was just that batch. 

Great place.... please come to Denver.  Folks in Highlands wait for an hour for craft ice cream...  people we love BFC in the Mile High City.

I read the reviews before coming here because that was my mistake. I went in thinking there sides would be good because of the reviews and the fries and sweet potatoe fries were below average quality. Also we asked for ranch and the cups weren't filled up. But the burgers were very good and very cheep.
Best sandwiches I've ever had hands down. I've had a lot of sandwiches and these are by far the best across the country. If you are driving through Boise I would make a point to stop here.

The service was soso.  This probably accounts for the lower rating.  They miss on how long it takes to get the check and such.  The fish and chips are superb large filets lightly breaded.  My daughter loved her chicken tenders and her teammate loved the Mac n cheese!!!  I love this chain.  The service at this location could be better!!!
Thr absolute worst attempt at Mexican food I have ever had
Been going to this one since i was in high school its been awhile lol!!!! always good best coffee around ... kicker, cho milk, green apple smothie = amazing
Delicious!  Not the cheapest but still reasonably priced.  One of my favorite Thai restaurants in the valley!

Ew! Disappointed in this place - it might be the worst place to eat in The Village. Overpriced, low quality beef, and a soggy bun... I'll pass. 

ALSO, the service was slow and it wasn't even busy. Safe yourself the time and money and eat a better place with a better view in the village.

Sure to be an instant success. We ordered all sorts of stuff and loved it ALL. Signature drinks are great on a hot evening and I don't do fruity stuff that often. Ambience was great too. Small place but totally worth it. I challenge you to go and tell me I'm wrong.
The buttermilk donuts are to die for!  Coming from a place with no local donut shops, DK is like heaven!  I have now ate over a dozen in two trips spanning two weeks! I better slow down.

The sandwiches and jalapeno bacon soup were amazing! The service was excellent, so friendly and accommodating. Put 4 tables together for our large group, including 2 babies. Brought out home pickled jalapeno peppers that added the perfect amount of heat. Definitely worth coming back and trying other items in the menu.

Went in on yelp reviews. It was amazing. Started with the peppers stuffed with goat cheese and egg plant. Not like any others we have had. Very good. I had the NY steak and the wife had the duck breast. Both were excellent. Cooked just the way we asked. Thought we were done and saw an order of fried green beans go bye. Glad we tried them! Friendly attentive staff. This place is a gem.

Really enjoyed our lunch here with my family. Very family friendly! And so many cute things to look at in the store!  My kids loved their lunches except their packaged grapes did have some mold on a couple of them, (I didn't get a chance to look at the manufacturer/dates) but they loved their sandwiches and the special sugar cookie and small toy and even the cute bag it came in.  My husband enjoyed his panini and I loved my Thai chicken salad.   We will go back again for sure.

Clean and relatively comfortable with decent service.  The sandwiches are good.  Soups are OK, and pizza is OK - none of them that I've had are outstanding.   I like the Santa Fe chicken sandwich with jalapenos the best.    It is large enough take some home, unless you're really hungry.

This would closely relate to In and Out burger. The prices are super affordable and everything is sold separate. The atmosphere is modern and you can see them cooking your food. The staff was super friendly and helpful to make sure you got your best experience. I ordered the Teriyaki char burger and onion rings. The burger was packed and a tad overwhelmed with the condiments (lettuce, tomatoes and onions) that the burger got lost. I did pull the rest of the burger from the bun to get the true flavor and it was delish! The onion rings were yummy. If you need something quick and have a hankering for a burger, I would recommend!

Our first visit we were greeted by a very nice gal and we asked what she recommended So we got the Carmel mocha and the white anialator. We pulled forward to the window and the blonde gal (didn't catch her name) was very nice as well! We just moved here and it was our first time at Dutch Bros. the service was more than what we were used to in Las Vegas and we will definitely return! Thank you so much!

Best coffee in Idaho!!!
You literally cannot go wrong with this place.

They have unusually happy and energetic baristas ALWAYS. Seriously, I've never seen anyone at any location who wasn't in a fabulous mood. I don't know how they find their employees, but they always seem to find the most positive and fun people to work here.

Now on to the coffee,
I appreciate Dutch because they have many "skinny" options from multiple milk options to many sugar free flavorings. I can get a great tasting "light" drink and not sacrifice flavor, because let's get real, skinny vanilla lattes can get boring.

They have white bean coffee which has more of a nutty flavor and supposedly it has more caffeine than regular coffee. This is my go to, with a shot of sugar free flavoring. The Cocomo is also a great choice, but they have endless flavor options, just ask!
Ha did an amazing job on a gel manicure for me. Highly recommend this salon. Cute decor and clean. Need an appointment, as they are very busy.

Best thai around. Spring rolls solid start or dumplings...the green curry is some of the best i have had...huge chunks off eggplant...yum...sushi was just ok...nothin special...menus are way too large...but good food.

I've seen positive reviews that state plenty of parking. Duh, who wants to eat this stuff? We first tried it almost 3 years ago shortly after moving to Kuna. It was terrible.  Crappy service, dirty bathrooms,  and mediocre food. 
We decided to give them another try. Heck, 3 years in business,  may we hit a bad day or they've improved. Wrong. 
The free chips, salsa & beans. Chips were stale and unsalted, salsa was ok, but the beans they were gross. Not only lacking in flavor but very greasy mouth feel. Should have walked out at this cause if you're a Mexican restaurant and can't get chips & salsa right, you shouldn't be in business. 
We order and hubby specifically asks if there are onions in his meal. No sir, no onions. You can already guess, it was loaded with onions. At this point he was done with their lackluster service & food and didn't get a replacement. Son got the beef fajitas. There was probably 2 oz. of beef, tons of onions a few peppers and some tomatoes. 
The food would be bad enough on it's own, but then on top of that, you can hardly find a server to save your life. 
If that all wasn't bad enough, their women's bathroom was filthy. How hard is it to clean out a vent fan every few months. This one obviously hadn't been done in years. 
Don't know who these folks are giving the place good reviews - maybe they never been anywhere else. Taco Bell seriously has more flavor.

Try the boneless wings with Asian sauce. SO GOOD. And if you're looking for great bar food, try the irish nachos. SO good. TVs on each of the tables are a good distraction from the waitress' way too skimpy and unappealing shorts. Maybe if they wore some hooters-type hose. :)
Great BBQ what can I say. There is a Dickey's BBQ in Tacoma WA where I am from and this is a must have.

I really wanted to like this place, however I have found that the best way to describe it is mediocre. 

I ordered a 1/3 (their smallest) burger with all the fixings, fries and drink. Total bill with tip was $23.   Bun was soggy, but the ground beef was ok. Not good enough for $23. Not even close. 

I should have taken the hint when the Yard House and twigs were packed and this place had two tables at 6:30 at night. 

Service was fine, locations in the village was poor. Too far away to enjoy the fountains or anything else. 

All told the dining experience was worth $10 not $23.

Finally, a deli that can satisfy my wife's craving for a veggie sandwich. She has never really been able to enjoy one, until now. I think it's maybe the best sandwich she's ever had, but she wasn't totally sure. Her only complaint was that the sourdough could have been more sour.

I got the silver duck and it easily slid into my top five sandwiches of all time. This is the best sandwich shop I've ever encountered in Idaho, at least for traditional sandwiches. Bleubird is still up there, but their's are more experimental. I am so happy that Fat Guy's at least stacks up the meat, since most places commit the sin of understacking the meat, like that time Great Harvest gave me one slice of pastrami on a reuben...


EAT AT FAT GUY'S AND BECOME ONE YOURSELF. IT'S WORTH IT.

Visiting from out of town and brought my son here who is 8. We had a blast, well trained staff around every corner, short lines my so for a bloody nose and the EMT took care of it in a flash great memories!

I'm always a fan of the IHOP chain restaurants.  This was our first visit to Idaho I-Hop.   I was very satisfied.  I felt that customer service in general and the waitress were great!  When I asked for decaf coffee -  they made it a point to let me know that they were brewing a fresh pot and that it would be a little delayed.  I felt welcomed and very pleased.  We will definitely be back.

I was in town for the day to officiate at a local University. 1 of my crew mates who is a Boise area local took me to the Meridian location before being dropped off at the airport to go back home. I koved the Purple Fries!!! I only eat meat maybe twice a year, but I saw grassfed Bison on the menu so I had that. Then I had the rootbeer on tap behind the counter. I rarely drink soda. Holy Moly did I enjoy it all and didnt regret any of it! So yummmy in me tummmy!!! I was in there yesterday Sat Sept 16 @ 650pm. The young gal behind the register and the male cook ( who seemed to be shift lead) were so friendly and patient with a non meat eating , non soda drinking non local dude, that I will for sure be making this place a regular every time I come back. :)

I have been to this Boise Fry Company 4 or 5 times before and have always had a 5 star experience. I  came in today to pick up food for me and two other co-workers. 3 hamburgers and 1 large fry for all 3 of us to go. Normally the large fry for my family of 4 can share and all feel like we got our fare share. This time around the sweet potato fries where soggy and only got a handful of fries total.  Maybe they gave me a small? I told them it was to go but they still put it on plates and had to ask them again to put in a beg. They where not on there game today. Disappointing...

Ya know, I haven't had anything I don't like here. I especially like the brisket, smoked chicken, pulled pork, all sides, and that you can get a gallon of sweet tea. I like the family specials in that I can get something for dinner everyone likes. Staff is always very friendly food is always hot and tasty.

Went to Hugo's for the first time today on a recommendation.  The recommender said their fries were amazing.  To me, they were just good, sort of like potato wedges without being in a wedge shape.  My husband described them as creamy, and he loved them.  I ordered the Hugo Special on marbled rye and it was very good with a generous portion of meat. We ordered water, but changed it to soda when they told us that water would be the same price as soda.  That was strange, but the service was otherwise very good.

It was a busy night so we had to sit at the bar or go elsewhere.  We enjoyed the atmosphere well enough at the bar although the patio looks like a better option weather permitting.  We think lunch options might be good - as well as happy hour.  What we ordered was a little greasy so we might opt for soups and salads in the future.  The gnocchi was ok...and the salads and dressings delicious.  We were satisfied with the experience.  Staff was friendly and busy the whole time we were there.  We will give it another try.  

Servers did not tell me their name and were very busy pitching in everywhere.  It's a little out of the way and a small place that they will outgrow.  Their Yelp menu and their actual menu are a little different so don't get your hopes up until you get there (or they update it)

Prices are ok as well.  Happy Hour is 2 for 1 well drinks if you are interested.

I had high hopes for The Counter as I eat a plant-based diet and they have veggie burgers on the menu. Like a lot of restaurants in the Village, The Counter wants to project a high-end feel to the restaurant - and the prices reflect that. Unfortunately the food and the service can't live up to the hype.

We came on a Friday night and the place was busy but not packed. We were seated pretty quickly. We picked out what we wanted to order and that's when the trouble started.

I ordered the Veggie Sprout burger with the grilled veggie skewers side and my wife picked the Asian Veggie Burger Bowl with the sweet potato fries. Our waitress took our order but returned in a few minutes to say that they were out of tuna for her salad. We told her that there wasn't any tuna in her order and she left again to order the food.

A few minutes passed and she returns again to tell us again that they are out of tuna and she'll need to order something else. We repeat again that there isn't any tuna in the dish and ask to look at the menu to confirm. Instead of reviewing the menu, she goes off to talk to the chef. Minutes pass. Quite a few minutes. I look up up the menu on my phone since she wouldn't give me a menu to confirm. There's no tuna in her dish.

More minutes pass. She returns to take someone else's order. We flag her down and she confirms that their order input system said there was tuna but the chef confirmed that there isn't any tuna in the dish. Annoying.

The wait for the food wasn't too bad in spite of the confusion, but there were issues:

- Our food arrived with knives, but no forks. We sat looking at our food for a few minutes until we could flag down someone to bring us some forks.

- Vegetable skewers were just okay. In some cases the veggies were barely warmed vs. grilled. Raw zucchini but would have been better actually cooked a bit.

- Asian Veggie Burger Bowl touted "grilled pineapple" in the salad and visions of Tucanos Grill style grilled pineapple came to mind. What arrived? Some canned pineapple rounds that looked like they were on a "grill" for about 5 seconds. Basically two big canned pineapple rounds in the middle of the salad. Not acceptable. Talk about a let down. Also, the sesame ginger dressing was mostly untouched as it really oily. Some of the lettuce pieces looked very wilty and ready for the compost pile and were not eaten.

- Sweet potato fries were okay. Could be they were frozen vs. fresh prepared as they were a bit soggy. 

- Veggie Burger was okay. Patty had a good flavor and wasn't all mushy like some veggie burgers can be, but it was just lukewarm - like it had been sitting on a plate and/or just barely warmed up in a microwave or something. Definitely not hot off the grill and really off-putting. I would not have eaten it if it had been a beef patty at that temperature. The rest of the ingredients were just fine. Not amazing but decent.

My wife ordered a strawberry lemonade which was super sweet (as you would expect) and nothing special.

I think that's it. Not a satisfactory experience and I won't be back.

The bill? $35 with tip. That's pretty steep for two hamburgers with a side and one lemonade.

Like I said, the food and service does not match the price or the Village hype. Maybe they'll get their service issues straightened out, but canned pineapple will still be on the menu - which is a crime.

Finally.  A great deli in the south end of Meridian!  This describes Fat Guys Fresh Deli to a tee.  I'm a pastrami lover and theirs was excellent!  Lean and lots of it on perfectly toasted sour dough bead w/pickle and mustard (by choice).  Much, much better than the downtown Boise deli's.  My GF had the Ruben with the same reaction, great!  The potato salad is homemade and superb.  The price point is very good for the quality.  Plus if you show  your C.W.P., you get a free drink!  Now that's the American Way!  Bravo Fat Guy's Fresh!

I have had very similar experiences as the other reviewers - 3 or 4 different times...thinking I must have just had a bad and unprofessional therapist but they were all similar - SUPER late, mediocre at best, ended early, etc.  They had a special for awhile for Wednesdays and Sundays $45 for a 90 minute massage.  You definitely get what you pay for...it was maybe a 60 minute massage and none of them took much pride in their work.  I wouldn't even buy their groupon deals if I were you!

Well sucky. Ordered and paid extra for the "new" steak and SHRIMP and of course got home and had 1 tiny shrimp. Buyers beware check your order before you leave. 

Well here we are again. After the last review Panda offered me a voucher which I declined because I'm not after free food. Unfortunately I tried again tonight (Monday 16th) and I am very unpleased. ALL of the food was so hot it was inedible for most. All of the teriyaki and the orange chicken. 3 bigger plates not eaten. To make it worse the jerk at the drive thru window was very rude to my wife when she asked for more teriyaki sauce. He told her she already had one and that was enough. She pointed out that we had 3 orders of teriyaki and would like 2 or 3 more. He pissily handed her one more. Hands down one of the worst panda expresses out there.

The last few times I've gone to The Habit have been disappointing. Their fryer was "turned off" so our fries came out 15 minutes later than the rest of the food. However they were kind enough to give us coupons due to the inconvenience. Then the next time they ran out of fry sauce and ketchup. Not really the end of the world. But then this last time I ordered my dad a tuna filet sandwich and there was a sliver of tuna in the corner of the sandwich. Somebody actually made that sandwich and thought it would be acceptable to a customer, probably because we hard ordered it to go so they knew we would be gone before we noticed. So now all of these little things are adding up to show that The Habit employees exercise an extreme lack of care. The food is okay though. Good place for good burgers and undercooked onion rings.

I just moved here and decided to try this Salon. What a fun experience. The atmosphere was one of friendship and customer satisfaction. Ha, yes that's his name, did a great job of checking in with each customer to make sure they were happy with the Tech and the job they were doing. I got a deluxe pedicure and a full set of pink and white and my gal was wonderful. I will definitely be going back.

This place is worth finding, friendly staff, amazing desserts.  I had the turkey feta salad, romaine with huge pieces of pulled turkey, cucumbers and tomatoes, feta and great dressing.  I live 6 hours away our I would be a regular.
Dave takes great care of my pool.  He always gets back to me quickly and is very meticulous and thorough.  The company backs their product fully.  I highly recommend Aquatech for quality and service.
The best place to get your nails done in Idaho. Very friendly staff. Ha did my nails and did such a wonderful job. I will be making the drive from Boise to have my nails done.

Stopped in Boise on the way East and found this unique place when looking for an early dinner. The people are friendly, helpful and attentive. The food is very tasty with unique and homemade sauces.  Prices are a bit higher but the quality is very good. I would visit again in the future.

Called for an appointment and they made room for us...after they closed.  The pedicure was relaxing and looks great.  They also explained the difference between gel and normal nail polish.   Even though they were closed, they did not rush us.  It was a great experience.

With all the hype that a California burger place comparable to In -N- Out Burger was opening in Meridian, we decided to try it.  Let me preface this review by stating that I grew up on In-N-Out burgers. On The Habit website they plainly boast that in a Consumer Report best tasting burger survey they beat In-N-Out by one tenth of a point.  Could the Double Char w/cheese deliver?  In a word, no. Not even remotely close.  Although The Habit's Double Char w/cheese resembles the Double-Double, the taste falls way short. The flavor is very mild, almost not there at all. Plus they are small.  A five-bite burger.  Similar to Smash Burger, which I don't care for either.  The price point is on par with Five Guys.  The fries were ok, better than the Double Char. The establishment is modern and clean.  Service is very good.  But you'll have to judge the burgers for yourselves.  For all the hype, I can think of four other local eat-in burger joints that blow The Habit out of the water.  John Lennon would be proud.  I kicked The Habit and no cold turkey.

Surprisingly delicious ive been twice and loved it both times. So did my kids. Its a little expensive for a walk up and order place but the quality is great. I also love the home made juices and shakes! We bought the coffee shake. It was delicious. My burger was a California burger!

Friday nights are family night from 6 to 10.  Still a bit on the expensive side..  But I will say it's worth the money!   No matter the age this is the place for everyone!    Lots of food options and great overall facility.  

The best part and the thing that makes this place special is the service.   All the life guards that help people on and off the rides are all so kind and caring.  I watch several time them helping little kids get on the slides with sure care!  Awesome job!

I really like the ram. It a great location for a lunch time get together for business. Good food I had the pulled pork sandwich lots of flavor. They do they're fries right nice and crispy. The chicken fingers are very good fresh and  lots of good dips and a big serving. Check it out.

up to last night (10/21) hugo's in meridan was-by far-our favorite deli in treasure valley and we have tried many.  we have been going to at least twice a week.  but, last night around 6 pm ordered two sandwiches and one fries to go.  one sand very good as usual; second only fair.  however, worse yet, the fries were not edible; accordingly, went down garbage disposal.

while almost everything has been very good the fries have been outstanding--the main driver for us to go to hugo's so often.  unfortunately, if last nite is start of a trend we will have to move hugo's down from #1 on our list.

by the way, until last night hugo's in meridian would have received a 5 star rating from us.

Came in for lunch, server was nice and took my drink order quickly. Ordered a lemondrop which was ok, little sweet and slightly watered down but I also like mine tart with real lemons so I am rather picky about them. I am the only person at the bar and there are people at 5 other tables.  The ambiance is nice but I can see how it would be loud when crowded.
Ordered the BBQ chicken quesadilla appetizer which was yummy but not spectacular. I will be back to try something else.

have ordered burgers two times now, first time they were very good and well cooked (medium).  I like the brisket burger combo and they were nice and juicy.     Second time I got a mouth full of raw burger- cold center.  Oops.  The reorder was well cooked... Medium... Medium is their default so I think they would have it down pat.  On second visit I also ordered the green bean app which is very good.  Nice sauces which go well with the fries... Note if you want more sauces they do charge for it.  

I subtracted a star for the raw experience.  If we go back I'll update if this was a fluke or just bad cooking.

The first time I left, I was on the verge of writing a one star review. The first girl that did my lash fill was quite unpleasant and almost half of them fell off that same day. However, I called and spoke to someone the next morning and was truly pleased with their follow up. I saw a different girl, Rebekah, and she was amazing. Very meticulous and my lashes look amazing!!! I am glad I spoke up.

How I missed out on this gem is beyond me. Being a non-red meat eater, I just assumed they wouldn't serve anything but beef burgers like that other burger place. Not true!
Had the vegan burger & it was pretty good. I'd like to have them 'upgrade' to a vegetarian burger for a bit more flavor. 
I sampled my friend's turkey burger & it was flavorful, juicy, yum!!
The Laura fries were excellent. I had pretty much given up fries but these, oh!...& the sauces were too good to be true! I had the basic gluten free ketchup & the fry sauce- both very good & there are many more choices. 
This place was packed at 2 pm & people were still coming. That tells a lot about a place.

I'm kind of torn on this review because my husband thoroughly enjoyed his half rack of baby back ribs and french fries.  I ordered the sirloin steak and blue cheese potatoes that could have used more seasoning.  I ate my husband's coleslaw that was bland as well.  However, the service was excellent.  Not sure if I would return.
Fast Food. Soggy take out.-............................................it's like Chinese in a can. No freshness. It sets in those warmers too long for my taste.

Went to The Counter tonight and had a great burger and experience! Before we went my wife and I read reviews and were somewhat concerned about the type of experience we were going to have due to the low rating found on Yelp.  In my opinion these other reviews couldn't have been more wrong about a place serving the "gourmet" burger experience.

The Parmesan fries were amazing!  The best fries I've had in a long time!  The burger was cooked exactly the way I ordered it, and had great seasoning and taste. I had the Hawaiian bun and it was great!

Although there were additional costs to toppings,  all toppings were of gourmet caliber and exceeded my expectations. Plus the additional cost was not an extravagant amount.  The small price to pay in order to customize my burger was worth the money.

Our server was very helpful and friendly.  Not only was the food great, but so was the service.  

All in all, I spent around the same amount that I usually do when sitting down to a major chain restaurant, and got a great gourmet burger experience. I would encourage others who haven't eaten here to go in with an open mind.  I believe that you won't be disappointed.

This is the first year that we did season passes and we are not disappointed! It is only June 3rd and we have been 5 times and our passes are paid for. The kids who are 12 and 9 would spend 12 hours here if I would let them. We love it here. The cheeseburgers are great too but EXPENSIVE!

This place gas some talented chefs that make some of the best Thai food in the valley.   I had the pho and the broth was full of flavor.   My son wanted sushi but they weren't serving it the night we were there so he had the curry shrimp and said it was very good.   We also had their spring roll appetizer and it was good.  The place can be busy on weekend nights but I believe that it's worth the wait.

This is the only other Mexican place in this area that I like.  On Saturdays they have a freaking Mexican Buffet what what???/ with Lengua and Barbacoa and Pastor and so many other tradition foods that most places around here simply do not have.  OH and there is a sweet old woman sitting right up front making homemade corn tortillas.....mmm deliciosa....  The price was pretty low cost about 40 dollars for a family of 5 on Saturday.  I would give this place 5 starts except during the week it feels like they lower their standards and the food isn't as good as saturday.  Maybe I came on a bad day during the week IDK but on Saturday if you want a fat belly with some good Mexican this is your place

Had I read the reviews, I may have thought twice prior to booking. I booked my room via Hotels.com and they're photos made the motel seem better than it is in person. I'm ok with a room being "dated", I mean, I'm not living there, but I had an issue with the smell. There were no smoking signs all over the premises, but it wreaked of a combination of cigarette smoke and car wash cleaner. Mr. Sandman could stand a nice polish. I wanted to give 2.5 stars because the staff was pleasant and the location was perf, right off the highway, but couldn't give 3 because it was not what I was expecting.

Great experience! I called, made apt for 45 minutes later. He greeted me by name. Asked how I wanted my water, did a great pedi. Staff was friendly, kind, difficult to understand but he tried. Massage chair was newer and fantastic!! I will come back. 
Only bummer I'd say was a $15 up charge for gel toes. $25 pedi is a good price, but $40 for gel pedi is steep! They'll even do these awesome glitter nails but the cost is $50.

The server was very good. The beer was cold.  = 2 stars
But the food was not good. The chicken on the salad was still partially frozen. The lettuce was wilted. The chicken with rice soup was not a broth base as expected. It was a very thick cream base that tasted more like flour than anything else. Soup and salad was a bust.+ Zero stars
We ordered The Kayaker (meat lovers) with mushrooms on a sour dough crust.The crust was crispy and tasty. = 1 star
But the meat on top tasted old. It spoiled the whole experience. We pulled off all the old meat,and poured a side of marinara on it in order to salvage it. Take away the 1 star.

If I want a cheese pizza, this would be my place. Otherwise, I'll pass and head over to Garbonzo's Pizza.

Customer service was okay. The fries were TERRIBLE, probably the worst I've ever had. My burger was pretty good though, even though it came with a flat bun (like flatbread). If it weren't for my burger having good flavor I would have left zero stars. I won't be back.

The staff here is amazing.  Great small talk and they are genuine.  I love seeing the fun daily specials and the prices here are better than other coffee houses.  I love the feel of their cups too.  No need for a sleeve with that cool ridge cup.  Love that they have PB syrup so they can make that killer Reece's Mocha.  A must try.

We ate the Saturday buffet. It had great variety but offered nothing too different than many of the other restaurants around. It was kind of spendy. My two kids, 4 and 6, only ate beans and got charged for two $6.99 buffets. The adult buffet was $12.99. For the price I'm not so sure we'd try it again but would be worth a try if you like trying new places at least once.

OMGosh! So, Yelp helped us find this jewel of a place and I'm so glad we tried it! While visiting in ID we discovered my favorite sandwich place of all time! 
We sampled:
A grilled PB & J with bacon (5 stars !)
Trevor melt
Chicken parm
Bleu bronco
All with potato salad...
Everything was amazing...we all left thinking we had ordered the best item on the menu, mine was the pb&j w/bacon trust me it's a must try

Drive-thru salad, lettuce wasnt wilted, but toppings were few, the chicken had a weird taste. The dressing container was half full, not enough for a salad. The sandwich had VERY few slices of meat, and they ran out of the suggested bread. the drive thru guy was nice though. i always see a drive thru line at this place, but i just dont get it. nothing special to see here. i will go to firehouse two blocks away instead...

I love this place! They have the best chai tea latte! Everyone is so friendly and I have enjoyed everything I have eaten so far. If you are going to eat lunch there go by11:30 am or wait till after 1 pm because it gets packed!

First, the positives. My husband had the BLT which was loaded with meat. One person in our group had the gnocchi and she pretty much licked her plate clean.

Unfortunately, that is all the good that I can say about this place.

The seating is ...very limited and we had to sit at an outside table. At least the weather wasn't hot. The menu is very limited; the prices high.

The bread on my husband's BLT was so tough that it was very hard to eat. It had avocado mayo that was put on so thin that you didn't even taste it. The fries had a good flavor, but were greasy. Three of our group had hamburgers (1 Grants burger; 2 southwestern burgers) and no one was impressed. The menu stated that the hamburgers were made with "pretzel buns", but all came with plain hamburger buns. The Southwest Burger came with avocado mayonnaise that was tasteless and spread so thin you didn't even know it was there.

If you really want to serve a southwest burger, why not try Carl's Jr's Santa Fe Chicken--and use similar ingredients. Definitely didn't taste southwestern! The pico de gallo was definitely fresh, but it had absolutely no seasoning and there was so little of it on the burger--and most of it fell off--that it added nothing to the taste. 

Our waiter did a fairly good job committing to memory the orders the orders for five people (instead of writing it down). However, one person who ordered their burger well done, got it cooked medium. One person added bacon to their hamburger and asked to leave off the lettuce and tomato. The bacon was not added and the onions, pickles, and "condiments on the side" were also left off. And why do places believe in serving "dry" hamburgers, no mayonnaise or sauce unless you ask for it. And then there was the size of the burger--pretty small.

The service was also very slow. Although we were not in any rush, it took nearly an hour to get our food. Others sitting nearby who arrived after our orders were taken were served before us.

We were very disappointed after driving nearly 20 miles to visit Grant's. We always like to support small, local businesses, but in this case we will not be back.

Our first experience here, and it won't be our last! The service was excellent, and Jasmine didn't steer us wrong on our entree selections. The Tom Yum and Tom Kha had fantastic flavor without being overwhelming. Duck was a bit dry and tough on the curry, but didn't deter my husband from finishing his meal. If you do order appetizers, keep in mind the fresh spring rolls are substantial enough to be a meal in and of itself. The Pad Prik King with chicken was so yummy, y'all. I ordered it light on the sauce and it was perfect---the green beans were cooked just right, and the peppers and mushrooms were only enhanced by the sauce. Can't wait to return and try more!

Terrible! First the hostess wasnt very welcoming she was obviously too preoccupied to care. They werent even very busy and there were several employees wondering aimlessly around. Didnt ask if we needed a highchair either. Then we sat at the table for a good while without even a drink order. I said we needed a high chair 3 times my husband finally got up and got one. Finally got our drinks, the coffee was terrible. Husband got the country fried steak of which tasted like freezer burn. Everyones eggs looked and tasted old even my baby who loves eggs refused to touch them. No one came by to offer refills either. The only good thing was the strawberry sweet cream crepes.  We will certainly not be returning.

This place is so cute and clean! Been looking for a new grooming place to take our pup, and this will now be our go to! Staff is very friendly and informative and they are FAST! Which is what I love that my pup isn't sitting in a kennel all day, he was in an out in about an hour!

I'm surprised by any bad reviews. I do not personally know these people, nor did my brother-in-law who highly recommended them to me. They did an amazing job on my minivan, which had been really done over by my kids over the last 8 years. They worked hard on it over several hours, and I can't believe how great it looks. They were more than fair on the pricing, especially for how much work they had to do and how thorough they were. These guys don't just do a quick wipe down and shampoo, they really get in deep and get the grime out. I'm very happy.

First off: I have never been a big fan of donuts because they tended to never sit well with me. Someone brought an assortment of these in to work one day and with my coworkers raving about them, I cautiously ate "half" of one...and was sold! Tried regular sugar glazed, maple bars, apple fritters and something filled with apple and everything was tolerated nicely by my system. While the store has no frills, the donuts speak for themselves - they melt in your mouth and leave you in a happy, round, fried-pastry coma. Yes, these are truly donuts to crave and will put a smile on your face as you savor them. Do yourself and your coworkers a favor and bring in a dozen!

My family and I tried this place for our first time and were not disappointed one bit.  Kids eat free on Sundays so for the four of us, our entire meal was only $20!!!  The kid's chicken nuggets were over cooked but that was our only complaint.  I had a pork baker which was fabulous and HUGE!  My husband had a brisket westerner that was also delish.  The staff were all very curtious and genuinely seemed to be passionate about the business.  Our food was neither greasy or tough so we will be back to check out the consistency.

Great place for some delicious Thai food. The chicken pad thai is amazing ! Decent prices. It's quite the quaint little restaurant a hidden gem in Meridian. If you want to try something new come on down and check out the folks here!
Burgers? Amazing and fresh. But I literally dream about the Parmesan Fries. They are to. die. for.

Very small restaurant tucked into the corner of a strip mall in a residential neighborhood...didn't seem like it would be anything special but it most definitely is! We've dined here regularly since they opened and have never been disappointed.

The space: A handful of tables inside with additional seating available on an outdoor patio. Patio has a cozy feel with an assortment of pillows on the seats and pots of fresh herbs along top of walls. In cooler weather they turn on warmers and supply blankets.  Due to size limitations this wouldn't be the best choice for a large group though.

The food: Everything is locally sourced and fresh, and made from scratch. There are appetizers, burgers, salads, sandwiches as well as a few dinner entrees. Entree preparations vary depending on what's seasonal and freshest that day. I frequently get "the salmon" but it's not the same dish each time. Last night it was served atop an arugula salad with sauteed zucchini and cherry tomatoes -- so delish! My husband had the best burger and fries (that I couldn't stop eating.) And I think his pickles were homemade... They have yummy desserts too, but sadly we didn't have room for any last night. 

The service: Each time we've had great servers who are speedy, attentive, and know the menu well. We've never had to wait for a table but I'd recommend reservations if you plan to come during prime time.

The value: We find the prices to be very reasonable, especially considering the high quality of the food. If you're on a budget, the burgers and sandwiches are a good option as the prices are lower than entrees. Sometimes they have coupons available, so keep your eyes open for them.

Grant's has the kind of food we'd go out of our way for, so the fact that it's available so conveniently for us is awesome. I highly recommend Grant's even if you're not as close -- it's worth the trip!

First off waited over twenty minutes for two simple drinks. Secondly the reason we waited was because the two adult boys working were chatting up the customer in front of us. There was a line of at least five cars waiting behind us as well. Got to the window the kid didn't even know what drink was what and blamed the wait on the previous customer having six drinks. It was clear they were just messing around, in reality she only had four drinks. To top it all off we got blended drinks that had separated because they had been sitting around while the employees bs'd with the customer in front of us. If they want to compete with bigger coffee  chains they really need to step their game up.

Just had an amazing dinner with the family here - I always LOVE the atmosphere at the Village @ Meridian. Cacicias had wonderful service and amazing food that is not lacking in flavor we had a couple Godfather's and a basil burger, toasted ravioli and fries with a side of Alfredo sauce to dip the fries in :) our stomachs are happy campers

First time in and the food was terrific.  Had the tempura green beans to start which were tasty.  Wife and I both had burgers which did not disappoint.

Dessert was excellent and the beer was cold.  Finally, we have a nice dinner restaurant in our neighborhood.

I have been going to Steelz since they opened and I love this place! The owners are very nice and are always willing to help. If your looking for Costco products without the membership this is the place. Go check them out!!

Took my daughter for lunch. I had the Cubano, which was served panini style and was very tasty. She had the Grant's burger, with a hand-made patty and packed with deliciousness. The fries were very good and the non-cheesecake desert, their specialty, was amazing! It's great to finally have a cravable eatery near home. Did I mention the house-made lemonade....and full bar?....

I went to Big Als as part of a large group of hungry people after a large martial arts tournament a few miles away. They were extremely accommodating to our large group and got us seated very quickly. They only assigned one waitress to our group of 40 which I think was a huge mistake. She had some help with people bringing out orders once they were ready, but no help taking orders or checking in on tables if anything was needed. We waited well too long for someone to take our order. Once taken, it was a long time before our food arrived. I would say it was in the range of 20-25 minutes of wait time for each thing to happen so we were there for 45 minutes before we had food arrive. The food was average to decent. You do get a lot of food for your $. The peanut butter burger was awesome. The Greek salad was just ok. The chicken I ordered on the salad was much too well done and it was like chewing a shoe leather. The french toast sticks were pretty good. We waited forever to get our bill as well. The meal came with a $5 game card credit and the 4 of us headed upstairs to play games. There were a lot of options and the entire group of us had a great time. The atmosphere of the place is really pretty cool and a fun place to have a family evening I think. Just don't be in a hurry or expect anything flavor wise that will knock your socks off.
Good quality burgers very well priced, the fries are average however aren't very flavorful. Food was severed quickly.

A fun place to try. You pick your potato type and then the available cut. We got 4 small fries, purple potato, sweet potato, Yukon gold, and one other. All different cuts. The po balls were actually really yummy. The fries come out without salt or seasoning, you get to pick! The sweet potato fries were delicious with the cinnamon ginger and vanilla seasoning. They have a plethora of dipping sauce as well. Overall it was pretty good. Though, the blueberry ketchup seemed like it could be good, but overall it was not very good. Their fry sauce needs some work, there was too much bbq sauce flavor. Stick to classic ketchup, mayo, and pickle juice.

Stopped in on my way thru Boise and so glad I did!  Wally the owner was such a nice guy who steered me in the right direction.  The soup, sandwich and coleslaw were all some of the best I've ever had. What an awesome deli! Do yourself a favor and check it out!!

Amazing service!!!! We had a gentleman named Richard who helped us and I would have to say it was some of the best customer service I've ever had!!! Thank you Richard for going the extra mile and being so friendly!

I have only visited once, because I heard it was sort of like a Subway for burritos and the portions were huge. This turned out to be a false rumor. They do ask you what you want on your burrito but the selection is very limited  In any case the main ingredient will be rice. Not even Spanish rice, just plain white rice. This place does the same thing so many Mexican restaurants try which is to make a burrito look huge by stuffing it with beans and especially rice. Neither of these ingredients even belong in a true burrito. Their salsa was pretty good, even if their hottest variety was still really mild. The steak, what pathetically little there was, tasted good once I picked the couple of bites out of the rice. If they just stuffed the thing with steak and peppers and put the rice and beans on the side where they belong, this would be a good meal.

The baristas are all nice however when I was in the drive thru once, I was behind a car who ordered a ton of drinks and waited forever. Well the car behind me was brought her drink first (she was at window one and I was in between both windows) I still thought it was rude that she was services before me.
This is my favorite dutch bros by far. The staff is so friendly and they keep their line moving quickly which makes my before work coffee addition possible. Thank you Dutch Bros!

What great service. The co-owner checked out my gate and recommended several shoes for me. I tried a completely different brand than I was used to and she advised if the shoes don't work for me to bring them in for a different pair. They stand behind their products and provide much better service than the big chain stores. I highly recommend their store.

Update - I had to return the pair of shoes after a few runs. Just not the shoe for me. They gladly took them back (no receipt needed if you are in their system) and exchanged for my normal brand. If that wasn't great, I also had a loyalty credit from my purchase that allowed me to get some new running shorts. 

I will be back for my next purchase.

I personally hate burgers with a passion, but this place is one of THE BEST restaurants I've been to in a while. The service was incredible- timely, friendly, and informative. Our waitress went through the entire menu with me and my family! And everyone had the same thing to say about their food: WOW! It was so delicious, my parents said these were some of the best burgers they've ever had, and my mom was ecstatic since the 1/3 pound burger was the post-cooked weight as opposed to the pre-cooked. I had a scrumptious chicken sandwich, and enjoyed every bite. Even my brother, who is the pickiest eater I know, absolutely LOVED his burger. I might even try a burger next time! Needless to say, we will be visiting again, and again, and again. An outstanding restaurant to say the least! Definitely a place to try!

This is a pretty good Thai place and they make a great Tom Yum soup (which is always hard to find). I went with a group and we ate family style so I was able to taste several different dishes and none of them disappointed. The only complaint is that is definitely on the pricey side for the amount of food you get. I've been to a lot of Thai places and even ones that have better food aren't quite this expensive. Knocked off a star for that but the taste of the food was great.
I love coming to Dickey's in Meridian they have the best pulled pork sandwiches and spicy sausage is wonderful the manager Julie is the best

Service friendly and efficient, very crowded but it was brunch-time on a weekend. Lots of things to look at (random gifty things) while waiting in line (10 minutes). Then another wait for food, but that gave us time to snag a table (totally full).  They actually were putting out orders quickly, just a large volume.  Seating I hope might improve as weather warms, possibly outdoor tables in the future?? I saw some gift baskets being put together, these had quite a variety of items (container of fresh fruit, loaf of bread, interesting basket, one of their 'subway signs,' or I assume any of their wide variety of random things for sale) looked like a great sort of fast gift, one I noticed was $59.

Food: Plain old drip coffee fresh and hot and plenty of it. Will try the espressos next time. Hubs and I each got a breakfast sandwich, mine a combo w/fruit cup and coffee. He loved his sausage/egg/cheese. The sandwich defaults to on a croissant, however the cashier did ask if that was ok with us. I prefer my croissants plain, so got mine on ciabatta. Wound up trying a corner of the hub's croissant, it was fresh flaky buttery and very good. My egg/cheese sandwich on ciabatta was just the right size for a real meal without being too much. Unexpectedly it used american cheese. I happen to like this type, no cheese options were offered. The ciabatta was fresh, chewy, flavorful.  Also made off with a loaf of the plain baguette, which wasn't unreasonably priced at $2.59 and is at least two feet long.  It isn't 2 feet anymore, I ate a good chunk already.  This is another fresh and chewy bread with a crust that isn't too hard. Not quite enough body for truly good french toast later, being a classic baguette, but serviceable for soup bread. 

Also had sourdough samples at register, good texture and good flavor (not too sour, I am picky). 

Next time I want to try the pancakes or french toast, saw the toast going by it looked huge and amazing. On the subject of french toast, didn't notice challah or other egg-bread. Maybe I missed it, maybe it will be seasonal later?

Came for dinner looking for something different in the area. Good environment to kick back with friends and have a chill meal/drinks. Presentation of food is done well and complimented with even better food. Service was excellence.
I've been here a lot.  There is cheap booze on Wednesday's (I think).  Try the coconut rice.  Very tasty and fun to eat.  Nice people.

They are so welcoming and eager to do what they can to make it a good experience. 
My tech was a little rough but did a very good job and I was happy with the end results ! I can usually find something I don't like after getting my nails done but they made sure I left happy! 
They will be my go to nail salon from now on!

The food is OK.  Not bad but nothing special. A little on the pricey side for what you get.

The service is terrible.  We recently moved to the area and have gotten food there twice.  The first time was delivery, which they charge a $6.00 fee for!

The second time I ordered for pickup.  I was told it would be 30 minutes.  I gave them the benefit and didn't show up for 45 minutes.  When I arrived, there was a family of 5 waiting for dine in.  There were plenty of tables, but they weren't being seated.

Meanwhile, I was completely ignored.  The topper was someone else came in for a pickup, and the served them first!

The last straw was, I just called for a pickup order, and was told they aren't taking pickup orders tonight.  So I'm willing to pay for a meal that requires no service, and no delivery, just cooking, and they don't want my business.

Three strikes and your out.

Had dickies on Sunday and it was terrible. Brisket was so dry u had to douse it in sauce to just choke it down. The bread biscuit thing was so stale it was basically a crouton, my son would not eat it and he loves bread.  The Mac and cheese had been sitting there all day had a disgusting crust on it.
The cashier tried to overcharge us. I asked him if that was the right price. Then he began arguing with me and another employee got involved and told the cashier he was incorrect. 
Also they have really raised prices. Too expensive for very substandard food.

This evening was our first time visiting the restaurant. It was cute and staff was friendly. We were super disappointed with our food though. For starters...it is the Boise "Fry" Co, so we thought we were going to be getting the best fries in town. We were sooo let down.  The fries were like soggy limp noodles. I don't know about you, but I like a fresh, crisp on the outside, and soft on the inside fry...if I was only rating fries they would receive 1.5 stars.  Onto the burgers I ordered the vegan burger...it was tasty, but the bun was greasy, and the patty was not cooperating with the bun. Taking a bite meant pushing half the patty off the bun...it was a hot mess.  Kids burger patty was almost crescent shaped and looked like someone said "hey this is a kid's meal, so who cares". Beef burger was rated just ok by my husband. For the price we payed for three burgers and a fry it was not worth it, and we will not be back. Super sad because we were really excited to give it a try.

It was a good little spot to try & revisit. It's a little out of the area we normally haunt but the service was excellent and so were our drinks.  My husband has the cold brew & I had a frozen hot chocolate.

This was not good. Wasn't busy, but waited 45 min for a simple sandwich. Pesto was two tiny leaves of basil. Three orders by other people were returned while I was there. Only reason this didn't get a single star is that the potato salad was decent. Not hurrying back.
Great food and a vary chill atmosphere. Friendly service.  Being able to sample the food before you order is another great service they have.

Just wanted to give a quick compliment to the corned beef sandwich, very tasty. Corned beef was tender and juicy the creamy horse radish sauce was a great compliment and not over powering  and the rabbit punch Irish red au jus was a great finish. The only downside is that the bread will be very soggy tomorrow when I  eat the other half but I would definitely recommend this sandwich just wish they served it all year. Also wanted to say that the wait staff is always friendly and courteous.

Military stay away! I had moved out of state for the military and had to pay my car loan at a different credit union instead of online because to pay online it's a $20 SERVICE FEE!! Who does that I mean honestly? Now that I'm deployed I tried to put in my loan number I have been using to pay at a credit union in to the online account service it doesn't work? You can't get anywhere on their website without that number and there's no way to recover it and no way to move ahead. Emailed them couldn't do anything to help me unless I called or came in 9000 + miles away very limited phone access and they won't help me. And they time I did get ahold of someone there the most rude individual. Never do business with these people. Never.

Very unprofessional group of people. Went to see them for repair on my phone, sent in my phone and after diagnosed they said they need 7 days to change a part, so I agreed, on 9th day gave them a call and the reply was waiting for my permissions before they change a part ( wtf!! They did not even call to ask and I have to wait till I call them, Why did I bring my phone there in the first place?), ok I replied press on, now the said they need another 10 days.....guess what...call them again on the 11th day, now the replied they waiting for the part need another 4 days or will give me a call once done. On the 4th day no call from them, so I called them again....their replied still waiting for parts....!!!!! I gave up on them ....went done to collect back my phone and found scratches on my back cover that was not there before.... a bunch of unprofessional, no customer service (don't be fooled when you call them there is a recording saying the conversation will be recorded for customers service training....they sure need a lot of it)

Hugo's Deli is a best kept secret.  Fresh bread  and a monumentally huge menu. With all the different combinations of sizes, breads and meats offered.  Also fried chicken and other deli delights.  Hugo's is clean and well appointed with excellent service.  I had the hot pastrami/coleslaw/provolone super size grinder.  The pastrami was very lean and flavorful.  The coleslaw was just right to be on a sandwich...not too sweet, not too tart.  This grinder was huge.  I also ordered the custom battered steak fries which were delicious.  The prices are reasonable for the amount of food you are given.  I'm a huge fan of another deli in town north of Hawks Stadium.  But that's a drive for me and not convenient at all.  The Fairview location is centrally located for those of us who live on the west and southwest side.  I'm looking forward to returning to Hugo's Deli and trying some of the other sandwich selections.

I have gotten over 8 large tattoos by Nathan Ealey at Imperial body Arts.  The shop has always been clean, organized and everyone there was very knowledgeable and friendly. I haven't gotten any piercings there yet, but as far as the tattoos Ive gotten from there some are as large as 12 inches tall and 8 inches wide, and each and every one was exactly what I wanted. It's never difficult to work around my schedule nor is the pricing bad. He has done things from custom script to vivid color pictures on me and I loved it all, there's a reason this place has been around for so long!!!

Been 2 times in short time it's been open.  Specialty drinks are amazing.  Hard to go wrong on the menu.  Great options and they do it right.  Don't miss out on the appetizers.  Tempura green beans are my new best friend.

We went there with a group of six adults and one child, which is large for this place.  The service was great and so were the mixed drinks.  As for the food, over priced and over cooked.  I got the chicken breast dish.  My chicken was so dry, broccoli was under cooked and mashed potatoes were over flavored.  We also ordered some apps which seemed okay.  My issue with the "bacon" flatbread was it wasn't regular bacon but more of like think ham pieces.  This should be explained that on the menu.  The place is cute but in a bad location a and severely over priced!  Go during happy hour for the buy 1 get 1 drinks to off set the price of the food

We were not overly impressed. It was ok. The novelty of building your own burger was interesting. The burger was bland but the sauces and toppings were tasty. If they just made the burger have more flavor it'd be worth the price.  The service was good and friendly. The chili cheese fries were tasty. But the place is based around burgers and the burger was blah. It was over priced for the flavor we expected despite the quality ingredients. We won't be back.

I've always had a pleasant experience at Roarings Springs, it's definitely one of the best places I've gone in Idaho. The park is fairly clean and the staff is generally kind. There's a lot of fun things for kids to do-- even if they're too scared to go on the rides. For the more daring people, there are plenty of intense slides. My favorite has always been the Vortex. 

My only complaints would be that the bathrooms were pretty vile on my last visit, and needed to be restocked soon. Also, some of the drinks and snacks are overpriced. It's a little over $5 just for a lemonade.

I am giving this a rating of 3 because we have been twice in the last week. The first time it was a five and the second time a 1. The first time I thought the food was incredible. The pulled pork sandwich was fresh and the bbq sauce was awesome. The Mac and cheese was creamy and a kids dream. The second time the food tasted old. I could not even eat half my sandwich. The Mac and cheese was old and was not creamy. It looked like it had been sitting in a heater all day. We will not be going back any time soon.
Hard to find a good Mexican restaurant here but I'm glad I came here service is great food is excellent.  I had th chicken burrito and it was good and fresh.

Good vegan burger, which can be hard to find! The service was good and they were prompt. I would recommend the sweet potato fries over the shoestrings fries if you are torn. Their mini burgers were the perfect size for our 3 year old's little hands :-)

Unique burgers with great flavor! I tried the four pack of different ones, all delicious. I went back a second time the same week and got the 1lb burger. The only place I've been to that offers such a size. A little pricy but the food and service is great!

The owners and all the techs are awesome. I always love my nails and the atmosphere is fun and relaxing. 
Extremely clean and they work hard to fit you in when it's convenient for you. 
I've gotten gel polish, acrylics, and pedicures here and they have all been perfect. Prices are reasonable and they have loyalty stamp cards

This is Dickeys in Eagle.  I ask how many ribs was in a rack of ribs, I was told 12 then I said I want a rack and a half. When  I got home unwrap the ribs counted 12 in full rack and 3 in for the half rack.I have been cheated. Won't go back
Customer service was great! The burger was great. But the fries were awesome. As well as all the different dips. Will come again!!
Definitely some of the best pizza I have ever had.  Reasonable prices and nice folks too!

Best subs, sandwiches and fries in the valley.  Don't come here expecting a cheap meal, but you won't leave feeling disappointed.  

We have traveled all over the US and very few places manage to meet the standard that Hugo's has managed.
I was disapointed in Sa-Wad-Dee dishes compared to some of the other Thai restaurants in Boise.  Food was just so so and the 3 star hot sauce was not even 1 star

I've had vanguard pest control for about a year now. I waited to evaluate them for that year in order to truly know if I would want to recommend their services. They come 4 times per year and I have had excellent pest control. Very pleased this far. It

Had a family dinner and needed a place that was able to take reservations and thought we'd give this place a try. The location made us skeptical but once inside the atmosphere was quaint and pleasant. The food was incredible and everyone in the family found something they loved! Service was great too! A must visit for sure!!
This place is delicious! Not only are the burgers good but the onion rings and milkshakes are on point also. My favorite is the Santa Barbara style (which you can order as a single).

Simple and casual atmosphere.  Design your own burger with alternate choices of veggie, chicken, tuna, turkey, or Bison.  Nice options for cheeses, sauces, and toppings.  

Personally, i wish they would give Idaho a Slater's 50/50 option with bacon/beef mixed burger (nobody seems to have caught on to that here).

Side menu could use a little tweaking.  Felt limited and with all the effort i made in designing the perfect burger, i could have used a few more options to compliment my choice.

Good support shown for the area breweries.

Fast & friendly service.
Solid sandwich shop and great customer service.  I live in Boise I would frequent more often, no doubt. Don't sleep on this gem.

Came here after seeing it online and we were not disappointed. We tried 3 types of fries and they were all great. Our favorite was the po'balls (I think that is what you call them) they are crispy balls of potato heaven. We also tried a burger and it was also great. They also have a bunch of salts and sauces to choose from. Very happy, sad I don't live closer.

We were visiting our daughter and grandson in Meridian last week.  I am just getting into the gym routine and didn't want to break it.  Stopped by the IAC in Meridian on Fairview and ask if I could get a three day pass.  They never hesitated in honoring my request.  On of the main reasons for choosing IAC over any other club in the area was the fact that they have the Free Motion equipment recommended by my PT.  Thanks IAC, you were great.

Great food. Sandwiches where very good. Wa able to sample the soup. Everything is home made andd the sandwich was fresh. I liked the roll they use. Had the number 11. There are a few more i'd like to try. Probably will go on fridays for the chowder. I asked to see the pastrami and it was cut thin and was lean.

Great food.  We are vegan and it is easy to get very tasty vegan dishes. 
Cyndy had Thai Basil fried rice and I had Basil noodles.  Both were absolutely delicious

Food is pretty good but inconsistent. Sometimes I have eaten there and it was bland or overcooked but the server was so wonderful and fun I almost forgot about it. I will still go there but only if someone else is wanting to go there. It wouldn't be mu first choice though
Top notch. Love coming here. Their brussel sprouts are fantastic, and fries with their blueberry ketchup is my fav!

We have tried this place three times in hope that it would improve as it is very close to our house.
Food is mediocre and service is terrible. The first two times we went we didn't even know they had specials and our server was not attentive at all.
The third time we went our server just left after she served us drinks and a appetizer. We had to waive down another server to order dinner. That server thought we were "closed out". 
The food is not worth the terrible service.
It was ok. Kinda of dirty inside the restaurant. The blueberry ketchup was weird! Overall better than most fast food joints.
This is hip, fresh and tasty taco joint. Located one block away from St. Luke's Hospital and was a great find for a quick bit and take out. Young family vibe with a nice outdoor area.

One of the cleanest and nicest shops in town. I've been to a lot of different artists, and Travis at Imperial is 10/10. Clean lines, perfect color, and even pressure with the needle. This most recent trip was for my daughter's first tatt and she loved it. Props to Travis and team.

I ate here for a quick lunch i loved the tuna and the bread it came on was flavorful and te tuna had dill in it i loved it. I had a strawberry smoothie was very good. Downside it took me 8 min to get a full tuna sandwhich and a smoothie at the drivethrough and i was the only car. Panera still tops it
