Good food. Quiet place. Good service. The portions are decent and their happy hour is okay. Friendly place. Small environment.

Best sandwiches in the valley!!! Great selections, great prices and the soups are super good! I eat at Fat Guys at least 2 times a week! I haven't found a better place to get fresh deli sandwiches or really friendly service as good as Fat Guys Fresh Deli! Ask for Wally and tell'm coach sent you!

Just Ok food if you are looking for pub fare. Decent amount of screens and the personal screens in the booth seats is an awesome idea.Service is not terrible but could be better. Since it is close to where I live, I will probably be back quite a few times to catch a game or two.
Good atmosphere. ... Delicious my new place for a great steak .... Stay tuned for more updates I am definitely coming back...

My husband & I were visiting from California to see some family that lived in Boise and they recommended this place. It was a very calm environment with very kind people. We have the bison burgers and purple potato fries & a variety of sauces. When I come back to visit I will definitely be coming back to Boise fry company again!
Great place.  Sandwich and soup were excellent!

This place is awesome!  Great burgers with fresh toppings and awesome service.  There are definitely less expensive burger options out there, but this place is worth the extra couple bucks. Thanks for opening at the Village. See you all soon.

Service was ok but the food wasn't. My husband ordered $14 tacos that had hardly any meat on them, my tacos came out wrong (they did fix it right away) and we ordered apple juice for our daughter and the cup came half filled. Not worth the cost that's for sure.
Great food and Great employees!! Try #16 it's super good. The Bleu Bronco is amazing and is great with any soup of the day!

Wow. Excellent customer service, great food! I am impressed!!! Huge sandwiches, great bread. Def recommended. 

I got a vegetarian sandwich built special today- and next time I'm traveling back through Boise, we know where to go.
Love the food here!  Their soup is incredible, their sandwiches are amazing on their delicious bread!  Oh and the desserts- yum!

The rooms were gross! My husband and I got one (not cheap) that had something sticky all over the counter and cereal in the bed!!! EW!  It made me wonder what else was in that room that I couldn't see! The rooms are also not presented well: they look NOTHING like they do in the picture online. In fact the room we got was dark and musty with an old-looking brown blanket on the bed. They gave us a different room, but it was not much cleaner. It really made me question what in THIS room hadn't been washed either. DON'T STAY HERE. IT'S A WASTE OF MONEY!

They nuke the pastrami I should of look for the word Hot Prastami on the menu Potato Salad is good. The place is set up like the name states like a grocery deli. The place has been around since 1980. Could use some updating on there decor to look more like a real NY Deli.

Aside from them slicing the brisket WITH the grain and the meat being dry (had pulled pork and obviously brisket), the experience was ok. Sides were pretty good - although also dry. I just couldn't get over them slicing the brisket wrong... if I wanted stringy pot roast, I would've gone to up-chuck-a-rama.

My sister thought this would be a great place for family dinner because we've been to this place before in California.... Well here, it was terrible. The service was not good, the orders were all wrong... I mean this it not worth the money what so ever... We've had better burgers at Carl's. Sorry guys but don't waste your time and definitely not your hard earned money.

My husband and I love this place! He always gets the pineapple rice which is delicious, I stick with the curry. The chicken satees (sp?) are a yummy appetizer, love the peanut sauce.  They deliver as well, which I love on a lazy movie night!
This excellent thai food the best i have ever tasted.  Never been disappointed with this restaurant. Excellent service.

Good food. Staff did nothing about 2 children running around to other tables screaming and even throwing shoes onto tables. Absolutely  awful dining experience on this alone. Prices were high for burgers. Spent $50 with tip for 2 people. Didnt get the avacado I paid for. Slow to get food. Though, never felt rushed even though we were there past closing. Very friendly service. Unlikely to return.

When someone pukes in your car, you're going to have a bad time driving until you can get in to see these guys. Chris and Muriel did a great job cleaning my fabric seats in my SUV! I especially appreciated the ability to have the service done on only the parts that needed it, rather than having to get the entire interior cleaned like most shops. Scheduling what I needed done was a breeze on their website. I'll definitely schedule with them again for any car cleaning needs.

I don't think you can go wrong with curly fries in any situation.   And I really liked the purple fries. My suggestion for the dipping sauce is make your own fry sauce with garlic Aioli  and ketchup... Better than their fry sauce. And the blueberry ketchup was very good
We really enjoyed our food.   I had the chicken bacon macaroni and cheese and my husband had the bourbon glazed tri-tip.  They definitely give you a good portion.
A fabulously tasty sandwich shoppe that bakes its own breads, makes its own pasteries, and cooks its own meats. Both times I've eaten there I've left full and satisfied.

Decent food. Last time however was not so great. Problem was a lemonade I ordered for my kid. We get home and I take a big swig.. tasted like lemon-flavored gasoline or something. Not sure why, but definitely not pleasant..

I have driven by here plenty of times and paid no mind.  We were looking for something local and decided to try Sa Wah Dee.  We walked in and was ignored for about 5 minutes and then finally seated.  We didn't get service for about 10 minutes.  We were ready for drink but she only brought us water and said she'll be right back.  Another 10 minutes and then we ordered drinks.  We were ready to order but she again needed to come back.  We ordered the friend Green Beans, they were the best part of the meal.  I ordered the orange chicken and that's what is was, soggy breaded chewy chicken in an orange sauce.  It was too sweet!  My bf ordered the Ginger Filet.  He asked the spice rating and she said you can get it a 1 or 2.  He can handle spice but still got the 1.  IT WAS SOOOOO SPICY!  We told the waitress and she just smiled so we asked for more rice, still too spicy.  He couldn't eat it at all!  So after spending $65, we were highly disappointed.  I called the next day and asked for the manager.  A woman took my number and I still haven't heard back.  Very disappointing!

Was just riding through the neighborhood when I found this treat.  I must admit I did not find any of the issues in previous post.  I did come on a weekday happy hour and got great attention with a friendly staff.  Cheap beer and good food made me a happy camper.  As far as the property, I find it hard press to find any other attraction in the Boise area that has Bowling, a arcade, and 4 bars on one property.  I was pleased with my experience and will come back when passing though.
First time I went fish tacos were good. Second time I went The fish was not good at all.

Big screen was amazing. I ordered the turkey burger 11.00. It had cilantro in it which some people love and some people hate. I HATE it!  The description did not mention it or I would've not ordered it. When I told them they offered no simpathy. So I basically got a handfull of fries for 11.00.

I was recently sent a message from Yelp that my original review was deleted. Guess someone from management noticed and didn't like it. PM me for specifics, but ladies be warned...don't send your men here.

Great service!! First time here and walked in the Owner was there chatting with customers and even commented on my new sweet hat! Food is great and you get a good amount for the price. I'd definitely recommend the potato salad. Can't rave enough about the service !! Great place all around and parking is easy too.
Fantastic food.....wife had Cubano, I had Ruben with fresh horseradish.....WOW. Will stop again when in the area. From Asheville NC.
One of my favorite places to get a simple BBQ bacon char with a side of fries. Staff if friendly. Place just opened and looks clean. Price is right. Docking 1 star because fries was a little salty.
Were on a traveling vacation (via automobile) from WA state to Denver, CO.  We like the Hampton Inns & Suites and this property "made the cut"

The Counter has all kinds of great options even for gluten allergies! I can have a burger over lettuce when I'm being good or have it on a bun when I'm feeling bad. There are really countless ways to build a burger here. The only thing I caution is that the service here can be slow so it's not the best place if you are in a hurry.

Love love love Boise fry Co. This is probably my favorite of the locations too. I had a regular cheeseburger with the heat topping which is blueberry compote and habanero peppers. Absolutely delicious, burger was cooked perfectly! The fries were the regular russet (classic fry) and they were also cooked perfectly, with a nice crispy exterior. The blueberry ketchup is my favorite sauce. The service was friendly and quick to boot. Cannot recommend enough!
Not impressed the girls cooking and prepping food had lots of hair not tied back and kept touching it. My beef tasted like it was left over from the day before. Probably not going to go back here

Who are these reviewers?  OR maybe by now they've worked the kinks out??  We had a party of 13, we were waited on perfectly always getting exactly what we ordered in a timely fashion, the happy hour was amazing-micros for 3.50...WOW...yummy food from $5.00 and under...and the nachos were HUGE!!!  We ALL shared them and there were still leftovers.  The server happily memorized which kids belonged to who despite quite a few musical chair changes and she split our tabs into exactly the right orders with no problems.  We had an excellent meal for an excellent price and continued on to a fun night of games and bowling afterward.  We will definitely go back, both to eat AND play!!

The bowling here is great and the games are alright. The food leaves a bit to be desired the only thing I have liked so far are the nachos. They lack very many vegetarian options. The services seems to be on par. I would recommend it for a night of fun. My husband loves watching sports games on their GIANT tv's and you can't complain about the free pac man!
This is for the restaurant only. The service was exceptional and staff was super friendly. That is what saves them in their rating as the food was average.
Great sandwiches!  I especially love the PC Pedro and the potato salad is the only kind I like or will eat.

Very friendly and efficient service and food is as good as expected.

Restaurant was super warm when we arrived but thankfully someone kicked the ac down at some point.

Bathroom smelled like straight sulphur.

I don't expect a ton from restaurants like this but the food was rather tasty and the servers on the floor were very welcoming and expedient about getting drinks, food, clearing plates.

Overall a fine experience.
Atmosphere is lacking, Staff was a little bit rude when I tried to use a coupon I got on yelp. But the outside dining is nice. Food is nothing special. Good location and good drinks.
Awesome tacos for dirt cheap prices. The chips and guac is great too. So glad this opened up by us!

Fries were okay. The cheeseburgers were a little scary (found hard chunky things in a few bites). The tempura green beans were awesome. The portions for sides were small. Great fry sauce and hot pepper bar. The thing that grossed me out the most was that the cashier (who takes people's money, etc.) grabbed my cups and stuck her fingers inside each cup to count them out. That was disgusting and poor hygiene. I didn't use the cups.
Delicious, high quality hot food. I was surprised at how hospitable and friendly they all were...not just while ordering, but throughout the visit! The Ruben was amazing....this is such a hidden gem!
Pretty decent sized portions. King burger was OK and they have some good chilli fries.Has a real mom-n-pop feel to it which I liked.

The location was nice considering if you sit outside you won't be roasted by the sun. The build a burger was neat and my kids loved their meals.  I asked for my burger medium well and it came with no pink and a lil dry.  They were out of Moscato so I ordered a peach bellini.  I assumed it was some fancy drink that would come with something sticking out of it like an umbrella or something but it looked rather plain but tasted good.  I had to ask twice to get a glass of water and I thought it was unprofessional for the staff to be allowed to have facial piercings.

Judging by the other reviews, I can't tell if I got lucky here or if everyone else has ridiculously high standards. Either way, I thought this hotel was alright. It's not what I would consider fancy by any stretch of the imagination but it was comfortable enough for 2 nights. My room was clean (I always check for bedbugs and can confirm my room was fine) and quiet , which is realistically all I'm looking for in a hotel room. The staff was pleasant enough as well.

I am beyond impressed with the quality of the pizza coming out of this kitchen but mostly with the customer service, which is like nothing I've seen. We ordered a few pies, a little late. Our bad! But they felt responsible for the delay and gifted us with salad and cheesy bread. Truly enough to feed half our street. This is good food! They are good people who care about what they're doing. Not something you find in most places.

We tried to eat there today, but weren't there long enough to order. The cook was banging on something in the kitchen, and the banging went in the full time we were there. It wasn't that long, but it really was annoying, so we left.

This restaurant is absolutely superb and you never know what style the plate will be when it is brought out.  The prices are really reasonable too.  We like the yakisoba and hot curry dinners.  Give them a try.  You will not regret it.

I frequently go to this Walmart  for groceries toiletries and miscellaneous .  The store is clean the isles are big ,  on a weekend you will wait and check out for a bit but it's not long compared to Costco !
 I've use their grocery pick up several times and have been extremely happy with the produce they pick, the speed and service !

Love Dr.Mcmurry he makes my dentist trips quick and painless. Highly recommended and his staff is amazing too so helpful. Mcmurry explains ever procedure step by step till I understand it completely and so I'm comfortable with what's going on.
These donuts are outstanding, the Kolaches are amazing, and the family that runs the place are so friendly and warm.  A must every visit to Boise/Meridian.

There is no way to hide the awful taste of frozen peas and carrots. Thai food is one of my favorites.  This place sucks! Soy sauce is not traditionally used in Thai food.  Here they opt to use soy in the pad thai. I let the wife try hers before I told her what I thought. She agreed, "Worst Pad Thai ever!"  I think Kate S in the other review must either work there or have a friend that does.  Yeah, Kate S. I'm calling you out!
Horrible service and mediocre food. There are several other good Thai restaurants in Boise area so we don't bother going back to this one.

Good food with great price.  Ribs were yum as well as the brisket.  Kids enjoyed it as well.  They loved the ice cream at the end of their meal.  Dining room is just a tad noisy with the heavy chairs being drug on the floor.  Other than that it was good!

***EDIT TO ORIG. POST- at Midnight I ended up getting sick from the dinner here. I had an upset stomach all evening and my body simply could not hold down the food I guess... DEFINITELY A NO FROM ME***

ORIG POST:The service was good (not great but not awful), but the food however was sub par at best. The burger I ordered was well over well done and dried out. (Not to mention the waitress didn't ask how I would've liked the burger cooked which I didn't realize until now.) The garlic fries are literally some garlic tossed on top of steak fries, and the steak salad my sister ordered was saturated so much with dressing that it was already getting soggy 10 mins in! Our table also ordered the $10 BBQ chicken quesadilla which was something anyone could make at home and definitely NOT worth the $10...Not to mention it was not busy at all so there's really no reason for the food to be over cooked. Nothing was worth coming back for and unfortunately as a first time customer I will not be returning...unfortunately I cannot recommend this restaurant since the food lacks severely.

Gave them another try. Sure it was on a busy Saturday but the service was definitely subpar. This time we got served but we were just about to leave again when a girl came over & asked if we had been talked to. 

Food was alright but I won't return because of lackluster service.

This is where i love to go. Great friendly staff. Fun flavors. No extra charge to make it sweeter. Extra flavors were free. Yummy. And the staff bends over backwards to get it perfect for you or they try again.
Love this place!!!! Been in Ohio and they didn't have one and now that I'm in Idaho they have one!!!! Oh yeah:)) Best burgers!!!

So. I know not to expect much from the IHOPs of today. However, this location has fallen to lows not yet imagined. 50 mins to get food, open tables everywhere, food comes out cold. Nothing tasted correct. I  so disappointed. This was literally awful. I foresee the fall of IHOP if this is an indication of the direction the company is going. Please spare yourself the agony. Dennys is just across the street.  Only one cook... oh the excuses.

I thought Zamzows was great. I just moved from AZ and went in with my 3 dogs looking for lawn feed and garden tools. Everyone was super friendly, helped me with everything I needed, loaned me a spreader for the lawn ( with their lawn care program which for my size lawn, about 2500 sq ft, was a hundred dollars--I think it's a good deal--you get food now and a regimen for lawn care for the entire year) then helped me get everything in the car. Plus I got treats for the dogs and the place is just really pleasant to look around in. It's a lot less hectic and exasperating than finding what you need at big box stores. I loved it! 5 stars from me, for sure!

Went here for a late lunch Saturday. I have never been. Ordered the fresh spring rolls and their beef noodle pho. Both were absolutely phenomenal! Will be going back this
 weekend for sure!

I have gone here over 20 times and I love this restaurant. I do not eat the sushi, so I cannot comment on that menu, but I do eat the Thai food and I find it very tasty. The restaurant is small, but not cramped. The decorations are tasteful and elegant which makes for a great date night. 

As far as the curry's, I'm not an expert of food, so I can't say it's "authentic" because I don't know. However, it tastes good and there are a lot of options. For most meals you can get chicken, beef, pork, or tofu. I tend to get the tofu. They also have brown rice. I like to order extra veggies with my dish. The food has good spices, but it's not overwhelming. You can get different levels of spiciness depending on your preference.

I have been looking for a deli all over Idaho and what that represents to us "Big City Folks" is freshness and decent portions. We were stuck taking care of business in Meridian and decided to grab a bite to eat while we were in town. We stumbled across Fat Guy's Fresh Deli because of favorable YELP reviews and we were pleasantly surprised. We have found a top notch Deli in Idaho! 

The pastrami sandwich had at least 1" of meat on incredible bread from our favorite bakery, Zeppole's. I had the Cuban sandwich and being Cuban, I can say it surpasses any expectations. 

I will drive across town again and again to come back here. Oh and the owner was delightful, engaging, and passionate about making us feel welcomed and made sure we finished our meal with homemade lemon coconut and white chocolate chip cookies. I have never tasted a cookie so good.

Amazing burgers. I always get the double char santa Barbara. It is always awesome. 

My all time favorite burger place. Beats smash burger, five guys, and inn n out hands down.

We were at this restaurant at 7:15 to order 1/2 rack of ribs. They told us they were out for the night. How do you advertise ribs and not have any?  Don't go. The management is poor to non existent. Shut the door if you can't deliver your signature dish early in the evening on a weekend night. We will not return to this Dickey's.

I'm surprised to only learn about this place this year. I tried looking up Meridian donut shops on Google maps, only to see Krispy Kreme, which is out of the way for my commute to work. I found a workable situation where I'd get KK donuts from a Chevron on the way, but it just wasn't the same as getting hot fresh donuts from a local source. Then one day, it's as if a perception filter was turned off, I actually just saw DK donuts with my own eyes. So I went in, and it's pretty much everything I hoped from a local donut shop: Hot fresh donuts, a creative variety, a good price, and it's on the way to work.

The best thing about these donuts is that they're not heavy like Albertsons' Donuts, but nor are they unrealistically light, like Krispy Kreme. They're the perfect mix of both, in my opinion.

Set up an appointment with Justin, worked around my schedule and told him some ideas. Come in a couple days later and am blown away with what he sketched up. The tattoo was better than I ever could have imagined

These bagels suck.  It is obvious that the folks here have never gone to NYC to see how bagels are done.  Barely any cream cheese on my Lox bagel.  If in the Boise area, I  would recommend going to Alia's in downtown Boise and skipping this place all together.

Delicious food.  I got the burger and added cheese and bacon. Amazing fresh tomatoes and lettuce were piled on top. This is one of the best burgers I have had. My wife had the Cubano,  and said it was delicious.  We also had the lemonade,  which again,  was great. That is theme of this place,  taking grill food and cranking the taste,  and visual appeal very high. We are already planning on coming back for dinner. 

Finally,and  we split the Host cake,  which was decadently chocolaty.  Nothing was good,  it started at amazing,  and just got better. 

Another great part of Grant's,  is the attention to detail. It speaks elegance. White linen napkins,  Elegant glasses,  with black straws and black napkins under. Paired with large,  white plates that just round out the presentation.

The prices are a little on the high side, but for the pure quality of food, it is a good price.  One other aspect, is that many of the pieces that make up the meals are made in house.  That is another aspect that makes it so delicious.  Plus, as we were leaving, we heard them talking about how all the meat is sourced from grass fed beef.

I've been here a bunch of times since it opened and now I finally I can review because I finally went bowling.

Service-is amazing without fail every single time, except one, and looking back I feel I should have said something to the manager, but seeing your server sit down at another table and be on his phone when your service is lacking already really annoying. But that's one time out of dozens.

Crowd-It's busy, almost always, if you don't want a crowd come around 8 pm in the middle of the week. It's noisy I don't know what people expect. Sometimes yes it's annoying but oh well.

Food- It's truly just alright. Only two things I've ever had have been amazing, the Pear Pecan Salad and the Chicken Noodle Soup. I've ordered burgers either under cooked or cooked. I've gotten the Cesar wrap, which is always more salad then meat, and never enough dressing. But oh well.

Drinks- I would say the drinks are one of the best things about this place. Always good for a decent price. BUT I will say this, it depends on who makes the drink. There is nothing I hate more then ordering a drink and sipping it to realize it's mostly juice. Again I digress, it is what it is.

Bowling-Crazy long wait, insanely over priced, and too crowded. They really should have a set number of people you can have on your lane. Maybe next time, I will get a more expensive lane in the other bowling ally, that is if it's ever opened.

All in all, I highly doubt I will stop coming here, because frankly it's always a good time. But, I do think there are changes that could be made so regulars that come here a lot, don't stop coming here.
Fun time, good adult beverages, a little on the expensive side; however, we didn't expect anything less.  Four stars due to the limited overpriced drink menu.

I just started at this gym not to long ago. I'm am a student only here for the summer so I was looking for something close to home, no contract and 24 hours; this gym hit all the key points. The only reason I am giving it four stars is because I max out most of the machines and wish they went up more in weight. Other then that very clean, affordable gym with very respectful staff.

A unique experience that was also so fun. We made custom burgers that didn't disappoint. Fries are also very good. Beer selection was diverse. 
Will return. Highly recommend.

Okay, so I'm a regular.  There's a reason, the food and drink are pretty good!  I'm a fan of the craft beers.  They have several that are on the menu all the time and the seasonal flavors.  My husband really loves the Total Disorder Porter while I usually prefer sometime milder.

The ribs are a bit on the pricey side, but well worth it.  I've had them many times and have never had a bad batch.  Their burgers are tall and filling.

The menu does change often and they will often have a seasonal menu with special burgers, salads, or entrees.  If you need to special order, they are happy to oblige. 

Since we're regulars, we sit at the bar and the service is typically very, very good.  Any seat in the bar is up for grabs.  There is a restaurant where you do need to be seated.  

There is a mixture of sports on the screens and if you have a particular game you'd like to see, ask.  They may be able to put it up for you.

If you like playing trivia, they have Buzztime there.  Good food, good drink, good fun!

Qdoba SHOULD get 4 stars, they really should, but the lack of customer service and not knowing if it's going to be a "good meat" or "bad meat" day really puts going in there as a gamble for me. In fact, I LOVE how Qdoba has more than the basics that Chipotle has, like the queso and gumbo, but MAN--the service just leaves you hanging and desperately wanting more. 

Food: I think the food at Qdoba is spot-on for what you're getting... it's fresh tex-mex, so don't go in looking for authentic Mexican food. The gumbo is one of my favorites, combining tortilla soup with your favorite burrito add-ins. The quesadillas are also awesome. I LOVE their queso dip and it's one of the main reasons I'll pick Qdob's over Chipots... because the offerings are just a lot more broad. But gosh, you just never know what you're going to get with the meat. The quality just isn't up there and sometimes it's cooked perfectly... but other times it's just WAY overdone. The inconsistency with the meats is what typically prevents us from going... because my husband wants to know that he's getting something good if he's going to pay $8+ for a burrito. Oh, and yes, their prices have gone up as of late... so a cheese quesadilla is now $8. That's crazy!

Drinks: n/a

Atmosphere: They have a variety of low and high tables with a TV for catching some sports. It's not my favorite place to enjoy a meal, but it's typically pretty quiet so you can enjoy your meal without all the fuss.

Service: This is where Qdoba struggles. Sometimes the servers deliver super-quality service. But other times they look at you like you're stupid if you ask for half the beans or if you make a request that's out of the ordinary. I truly wish they'd understand what an impact a smile and a friendly "no problem" can make and just how far it can go to getting you to come back. My husband and I recently purchased a bowl of gumbo, a cheese quesadilla and a drink. Our total was $19. It seemed steep! When I asked if prices had gone up, the return response was literally so rude. I was blown away. I truly like Qdoba but think that some good customer service training would help them out.

Happy Hour Offerings: n/a

Healthy Hack: The gumbo with chicken, black beans and pico is really reasonable. It's filling, spicy and low in calories.

Tips: Don't go in with high expectations. :)

Any dollar store is going to be hit or miss. I love decorating for the holidays and I can find nice quality stuff at the dollar store that last a few years. I visit the dollar store atleast once a month.
A great burger place and fries that are outta this world!! I haven't had the hot dogs or chili yet but they loom really good!! This place features real meat no additives. The shakes are yummy too!!

Fresh doesn't begin to describe this place.  Hands down the best deli I have been in. These sandwiches and salads are off the chart enormous!  Stacked full of the freshest meats cheeses and veggies!  The homemade potato salad is amazing and the homemade soup is even better than that!  Do your belly a favor and try this owner operator deli. The staff is phenomenal. You can thank me later!

This place is absolutely amazing!!!  The house made jerky is amazing, the employees are amazing and the huckleberry vodka is to die for! It is a must try restraunt and I will defiantly go back! Everything is fresh and made in house, local and just delicious!

I seriously love this place!  The guy who greets each time is so friendly we are always happy to see him. I recommend the Tuesday night special, two dinners and an app for $20. The Chile Verde is also very good!!
Yummy, yummy, yummy! They put a spin on pizza that is like no other. Fresh ingredients, unique combinations, and fabulous flavor. They're great for large groups.

Delicious! The Laura fries were my favorite! Burger was pretty good too but not splitting size. Price was really quite reasonable considering a large McDonald's fry is probably smaller than a large here and only a little bit less. I would definitely go back.. better than 5 guys fries which were my favorite before trying these!!
Staff was great. Food is Woodstock meets McDonald's not impressed at all with there burgers but the fries are ok

First time visiting- ordered the bologna with a side of bell pepper soup. The soup was SO good! The sandwich was good too but the bologna was thicker than expected. Must love bologna to love this sandwich lol but overall decent food with very friendly service. Would recommend.

If you ever find yourself in Boise, ID, stay at Mr. Sandman. We were traveling from Florida to Oregon and needed a place to stay for the night. We'd stayed at several larger chains along our route including Best Western, Motel 6, Travel Lodge, and America's Best Value Inn. Mr. Sandman was the best motel/hotel/inn we found in our travels! Loved it! Unique and homey feel, friendly staff, clean accommodations, what more could you ask for? 

Only complaint was the bed was a bit stiff for our taste. Regardless, we had a very restful stay.

I liked this place a lot more than I expected to. 

It's a walk up and order then find a seat, get your own drinks kinda thing. 

Their strawberry lemonade is so good, this isn't typically something I'd note or even get but opted out of soda for this and oh man, what a pleasant surprise..  not overly sweet and taste like real strawberry and lemon. Just lovely.

The customer service here was on their game, especially to be young folks. Very quick, friendly and efficient cashier and pleasent girl who removed our dirty tray, etc.

Food was great, I got the teriyaki burger and it was just a step below the one at Red Robin - very juicy and tasty. Only 4.05 for the burger. Holy cheap!

I got tempura green beans as a side which was an awesome and welcomed change to the normal burger and side options. They were delightful.

My husband got the Santa Barbara burger which was also really good and the kid got chicken nuggets which she seemed pleased with.

Restaurant was tidy through and through and it was buzzing on a Tuesday night.

All in all, a very good experience for somewhere I kind of had reservations about. Will return!
The best shake I have had in a long time, the burger was good and I always appreciate "real" fries. Prices are very fair. It's a gotta try burger joint.
the new a la carte' menu is stupid. the guy tried telling me it'd be cheaper than the 2 meat platter they used to have. I'm not particularly confident with his maths skills. not going back.

Good Food. Good Beer. They serve food until midnight most nights. 
We stopped in on our way back into town sometime after 10 pm. Ate in the bar. Started with an order of Armadillo Eggs -  wow they are tasty!  Don't worry about what they are, order some. You won't regret it!  
We both ordered and loved the Hawaiian Poke salad. It was delicious!  Beer was good ( the pale ale),not the best but way beyond simply acceptable. That said, Boise is a big beer town with lots of brew pubs and tough competition so my comment is hardly negative. 
We will be late night regulars

I like these sandwiches! And the fries are awesome! For the carb conscious you can also get fried chicken(remove the skin to reduce the breading which is minimal) and I have been able to ask for a simple salad as well although I don't believe it is on their menu.  

Decent selection of bread and fantastic tasting meats.  Generous portions not like those regular "fast food chain" sandwich shops.  

When I have a craving for great unique french fries this is where I come.  Lightly breaded and fried until perfectly tender. So much flavor you don't need any sauces, however they have several varieties should you choose.

COFFEEEEE!! Yup. their coffee is good! Better than STARBUCKS  Staff is HAPPY!! (which is refreshing)  But their have been days where there is only one employee working and that REALLY slows down the line. They should let customers know about their free stickers too! I would love to have one and never got one because I figured they would be expensive. NOPE .. FREE! My favorite drink hands down is a double shot iced ANNIALATOR :) They also give me a military discount when I'm in my uniform and that makes me feel appreciated! KEEP UP THE GOOD WORK!

This was one of the first Mexican restaurants we came to in Meridian (Boise). After going to a few others, we decided, kids included, that this is one of our favorites in the area. It's not perfect but it's close enough without being too picky. All of the staff are very friendly. The main suggestion I would make is to clean the carpets and tile floor and and fix some of the ceiling tiles so it's a little more presentable. I've found this to be a common issue with many Mexican restaurants. All week long my kids keep asking if we can go to Fiesta Guadalajara. The pico is really good and warm fresh tortilla chips are a plenty.

The owner pulled my first review, which was positive and 5 stars. I don't get it!?? I've  been back and only give it 1 star due to the cold fries, limp and soggy, and 40 minutes to receive our order! Burger was just ok. 

I've eaten at The Habit, Slaters 50/50 AND other Counter Burger locations. This place
Is inconsistent and doesn't deserve to carry the chains name. Poorly managed!

I'm sure the owner will have this review removed also.

First year using Zamzow for lawn fertilizer. Both me and my neighbor used it. Our lawns were the yellowest on the street. Being in a new development, we all had new sod placed in the last year. So all things were equal as far as I can tell. 

At zamzow, everyone was always too busy to even talk about why this was the case. I will never use Zamzow again. Stick with what works. Scott's has always been green for me.

We had a very bad lunch experience at our last Ram visit. The food was bland and gross. The service was horrible. It took 20 minutes for our server to even take our order.  she never offered drink refills. the only edible thing we ordered were the sweet potatoe fries which were served without any ketchup or dipping sauce. my husband went up to the kitchen to ask for ketchup. Our server never asked how the food was (because if she did we would have told her awful). It was very disappointing. We used to go to the Ram a lot years ago. Either it's really gone downhill or we just came on a really bad day.
This is an amazing place.  Checked it out for take out tonight.  Got the Blue Tiger Meatball. It's worth checking out if you haven't had it.  Meatballs, ricotta and amazingness.
Colton and Norman in the arcade area were the most helpful staff, fun and personable. Colton and Norman thank you for making our time in Boise a fun and memorable one.

There is no way to hide the awful taste of frozen peas and carrots. Thai food is one of my favorites.  This place sucks! Soy sauce is not traditionally used in Thai food.  Here they opt to use soy in the pad thai. I let the wife try hers before I told her what I thought. She agreed, "Worst Pad Thai ever!"

Went and checked this out for the first time last night. Impressive menu. I had a sangria that was really good. The turkey burger was pretty dry as was the bun, which seemed like it was maybe left over from earlier in the week. We split the loaded baked potato fries which were a pile of fries in a bowl with a small amount of grated cheese, bacon bites and some sour cream. Quite disappointing since they were cold and stuck together by the now cold cheese. 

The wait staff was super except for we asked for water towards the end of the meal and never got any. To me, when there's only 2 or 3 small tables of people in the restaurant, I shouldn't have to ask twice.

All in all OK experience but with all the restaurants to chose from, I probably won't go back.

I was between doctor appointments and had planned on going to Graemercy's for lunch.   I had pulled into the parking space and decided I didn't want to eat in a big noisy restaurant alone.   As I was backing out,  I saw a little storefront that said "Fat Guy's Fresh Deli."  I thought,  why not!  Pulled forward and parked again and walked in.   My olefactory senses went into high gear!  What IS that heavenly aroma???  I walked up to the counter and started perusing the menu on the wall.   So many delicious sounding sandwiches!  I told the smiling young lady behind the counter that I'd never been there before.   She went into her schpeil about fresh ingredients,  fresh baked bread,  yada, yada,  yada.  Okay,  okay.  I  just wanted to eat whatever was making that wonderful aroma before I slipped in my own drool!!!  She got to the part about "Our most popular sandwich is #16, The Trevor."  I looked over the ingredients and thought,  heck, yeah,  sign me up!!!  After a very short wait,  she brought out the MOST delicious sandwich that has ever passed my lips!  There was a generous layer of roast beef,  cappy (a light spicy Italian meat), bacon, pepperjack cheese served on a soft,  fresh, flavorful sandwich roll, which had an epically tasty pesto sauce, served with a hot,  aromatic bowl of au jus for dipping.   I salivated in anticipation of that first bite!  Not disappointed in the least,  my taste buds did Olympic back flips!!!  WOW!!!  Sandwich,  where have you been all my life???  In all my years (60), I have never had a better tasting sandwich EVER (and trust me,  there's been a lot of sandwiches from all over the world)!  I AM NOW A "FGFD" ADDICT!!!  No trip to the Boise area without coming here for lunch!!!  Eat here!!  You won't be disappointed!!!  (Side note:  The potato salad was also epically delicious,  but I wasn't leaving any of that sandwich,  so I didn't finish it.)

I would give Sa-Wad-Dee 4 1/2 stars if I could. My only criticisms are directed at the tight dining area. As long as you don't mind sitting close to others, this place is a great experience. Enough negativity. 

We enjoy the yellow curry. Rich flavor and, to us, the perfect amount of heat. Every dish we have tried has been very satisfying. Portions are generous. 

The service is outstanding. They always have plenty of hands to tend to the typical full house. 

Overall a great dining experience. Very good value.

They have a great beer selection, we took advantage of the free armadillo appetizer with checking in. It was great! cheesy, not too spicy, crunchy paired well with the beers they brew. The burgers were good although a bit bready. The kids enjoyed their cheeseburger and fish filets, our server was pleasant and we are so glad we stopped by. We will be returning, they definitely deserve more yelp stars.
Came in for the first time tonight. We were greeted warmly and brought chips right away. The food was very tasty and they had 2 for 1 draft specials. We will definitely be back soon!!

I wanted to like this place...we walked in clearly with our daughter by us and were seated in a booth. The hostess says "oh let me go get you a kids menu" that kids menu never came...then we sat there for 20 min...yes I timed it...TWENTY minutes and no waiter had came to our table to acknowledge us or take drinks orders. Keep in mind there were probably only 4 other tables occupied. I had to get back up and go to the hostess table and ask for a waiter to our table. Ridiculous. We ordered, and ordered for our daughter without seeing any kids menu options. Food took quite a while to come out. It was ok, nothing great. If a manager reads this I think you need to wake your staff up. It was a pretty disappointing dining experience for us. We should have walked out like we had talked about after having to wait at our table for 20 min with wait staff walking bye not even blinking a eye at us. My advice, go to another restaurant in the village.

I know I am going to be in the minority with my review, but I want to bring in some more perspective. I've been to Fat Guy's twice - once a  year ago and then more recently. Not much has changed - the owner (I believe he is anyway) was working at the register and was extremely friendly. I wanted a veggie sandwich and he said that he would read me the different options (bread, toppings, cheese, sauce, etc.) and I could pick what I wanted. This was pretty fun - and the further along in the process we got, the more I could not contain my excitement. "Lettuce?" - "yes", "Tomato?" - "Yes", "Olives?" - "YES", "Pepperoncini?" - "YES!", "Sprouts" - "OH MY GOSH, YES!!"...you get the idea. There were so many options that I figured the sandwich would knock it out of the park (I remember thinking the sandwich was ok on my first visit but as the positive reviews continued to pour in on Yelp, I figured it was time to give it another go). 

Unfortunately, there were several problems. 1) The bread seemed old and stale, ick. Also did not really detect a lot of 'sour' to the sourdough. 2) There was not enough pesto/tomato spread...if I did not see my bread slices were slightly tinged with color, I would not have even know it was there (I thought if I took the copious amount of sprouts off my sandwich, it might help me taste the spread more, but alas...no difference). 3) The side options...chips, slaw, or potato salad (which has bacon). I went with the slaw and it was ok, not a lot of flavor. The biggest issue was how small the portion was. It was put in one of those side-sauce containers, maybe 3 oz. total? If I knew that, I would have gone with chips. 4) The price for all of this... $10. Yes, the sandwich was quite large and the ingredients were fresh. However, for that price, I can get a delicious gourmet sandwich and side from a very popular sandwich place downtown (I'm sure many of you know to where I am referring). There was just a major lack of flavor and despite how friendly the staff were, I cannot justify that kind of money for something so average.

Clearly a lot of people have had delicious sandwiches from here and two of my four issues could easily be rectified - maybe the bread is more fresh when business isn't so slow and you can ask for extra spread/sauce depending on what you select, knowing they go light on it. I'm personally not willing to risk it, simply for the fact that the price is too high to deal with inconsistencies. If you do brave it, take solace in the fact that at the very least, you will be treated to great customer service.

I had gotten a free burger coupon for here, or else I don't think I would have tried it by myself. However, it was awesome!! The food was so surprisingly good. The burger was probably on par with In-n-Out. Their fries where also good and they have a wonder fry sauce. The wait was a bit long (but apparently you can order in advanced online) however I would gladly wait for that again!

I use to get cheesecake from Kneaders all the time. The last few times I've gotten really small slices of cheesecake, so this time I attached a photo. Their cheesecake is good, I just think it's not worth the $4 asking price. Probably won't be returning.

Tried a couple different options and they were very good. Will go back to try a few more flavors, like the lemon. Went late on a Saturday morning so the selection was not as full as it would have been earlier in the morning.  Will try again earlier in the day to have the full flavor options.
Thanks for making my son feel so comfortable when we comes in for appointments. He loves your staff and the wooden nickels!!

I give the RAM four stars for its beer and three stars for food. They brew their own selection of beers and they are great! The food on the other hand is hit and miss. Sometimes its pretty good but other times its off the mark. A good place to watch sports.

The Good: burgers were outstanding and being able to pick all the toppings and type of protein from a huge selection is awesome. 
The Not So Good: as many others have mentioned, it's pricey but you know that ahead of time and it is good food. To feed a family of 3 $60. Nothing exotic either. Burgers, fries and shakes.
The Bad: the service. Our server just sucked: another server had to being out our food, never checked on us, didn't smile, and it took us almost 90 minutes start to finish on a slow Thursday night. Really unfortunate because we would go back for great food but the crummy service ruins that. 
2 stars and only because the food was delicious.

Overall, Big Al's is expensive and slow. Food is average with big portions but overpriced. Arcade is also pricey but redemption prizes are the best in Boise. The biggest problem is the wait times for food and drinks. We waited 20 minutes after being seated to order and another 60 minutes for food. The check was another long wait. Took us almost 2 hours to finish dinner!  Other tables around us were also upset about service time. If you want to pay a lot and wait a long time, eat at Big Al's.

The fries are good, the onion rings and fried beans amazing! Burgers are terrible as they are bland and too sloppy to eat without taking them apart and the toppings are disgusting. I didn't know tomatoes were transparent and white. The pepper bar is just weird. The onion rings however are incredible. It always seems these fast food burger place either get the sides or the burger right but not both.
Delicious bagel sandwiches and friendly staff combined with free wifi make for the perfect location for breakfast or lunch.
It's OK. The appetizers we amazing but the burgers were subpar. The bun on one burger was very greasy and the side salads were limp. Next time we will go somewhere else that cost half the price.
Fair, upfront prices. Quick and friendly service. Not much else to say! They are an easy 5-stars..

We are new to Thai food and really enjoyed our experience at Sa-Wad-Dee.  We will most definitely be back.  The decor feels authentic with paintings and fixtures.  Very friendly staff that help each other out refilling drinks and checking on the guests.  Presentation of the food is a big deal.  I ordered the Seafood Hor Mok in Fresh Young Coconut and my wife has the Triple "S" Noodle.  It was amazing!  The Hor Mok had shrimp, scallops, squid, mussels and salmon all baked in a coconut husk.  The Triple "S" was loaded with salmon, scallops, shrimp and veggies.  We ordered our dishes mild, not too spicy and they were just right.  The waitress recommended we try the Angry Ocean next time we come in.  Can't wait to try it!
First time here and we loved it. Great service, delicious food. Great experience for an alacarte build your own burger place. We will be back!

After someone brought in Kneaders' rolls to a work party, I decided I HAD to get some for our Thanksgiving dinner. I even braved bad weather and too many people the day before Thanksgiving to drive out to Kneaders on my lunch break to grab some. I was excited when a coworker told me they also have lunch options, although warned me they tend to be on the slow side. 

I arrive around 12:30 and the place was jam-packed! I thought about heading through the drive-thru, but decided since it was my first time there, I wanted to head inside and check things out.

I was so glad I did! The inside is so cute and cozy with all of the decor that's for sale. The line to the counter wasn't too long, and I was able to check out what they had to offer while I waited. I grabbed a dozen of their soft rolls, ordered a chicken pesto panini and a peanut butter cookie for the road. 

The gal that checked me out, as well as the gal filling another order behind her, was very nice and helpful. Not to mention, patient! With how crazy it was, that was a nice quality to see displayed by the staff. While some of them worked hurriedly, none of them looked as though they were frustrated in any way. 

My coworker was right about the wait - I stood near the drinking fountains for 10-15 minutes waiting for my panini to be made. (At least it was fresh!)

The panini was awesome, and something I wish I could have every day! Packed with flavor and just the right amount of everything. Plus, they served it with a side of kettle chips (not sure if they were house-made or not) that were tossed with Parmesan cheese. Yummmmm! 

The cookie drew me in with presentation - I just couldn't resist the chopped peanut butter cups on top! The cookie was crunchy on the edges and perfectly soft in the middle. I did not want it to end. 

And the rolls, as expected, were delicious. Even for 4 days after thanksgiving.

I took my family out here again tonight for dinner for a Friday night and where everything was spot on the last time we came, this time our appetizer showed up the same time as our food and my younger sons entrée was forgotten. From that point on I was thoroughly impressed! My sons burger was out in just a few more minutes and every 5 minutes we had a different manager at our table apologizing and checking on us. Our server Jade was very attentive and our drinks were always refilled immediately! 

Mistakes happen all the time, however the way mistakes are handled by management vary quite a bit. The management and staff here are amazing! My sons food was on the house and we honestly felt important as guests and will definitely be back.
Spaghetti and Meatballs was not good.  Sauce tasted burnt.  Meatballs were okay.  Portion size was nice.  Atmosphere was great.  The sauce just didn't taste good.

This place has the new Impossible Burger, which, if you don't know, can only be purchased at restaurants in very select cities right now. I think Vegas is the next closest place that has them. It's amazing and since there aren't many vegan options around I had to apologize to my husband after eating it because this is probably the only place I'm going to want to go for date night for a LONG time. I love they don't charge extra for you to get a TON of toppings and they have vegan cheese and mayo, in addition to a lot of other toppings or sauces.

I love me some Thai food. "There's a Thai place nearby!" my sister enthused, after having moved to Meridian, Idaho, from Nevada a little over a year ago. "We'll have to try it out when you get up here."

I'd been wanting Thai food forever. And, once I moved to Idaho, we decided to try Sa Wad Dee.

I'm still wanting for Thai food. Because... I don't think what I was served was actually Thai.

Don't get me wrong; I think some Thai people were working there. I didn't check their papers. I'm just saying they could've been Thai. They were Asian. And they were friendly. That explains the two-star rating. Without the friendly staff and the excellent service, one star might've been pushing it.

I ordered the Pad Thai. One of my favoritest meals ever. I've often cited it as my favorite. Depends on time and mood. That day, I was in the mood. So I ordered. And got something that wasn't much better than a barely-cooked package of ramen noodles I could've purchased myself at Albertson's for 13¢ and a paltry covering of- Stuff. Seriously, I could've made this in my dorm room in college and it would've pissed off my roommate and he'd have shat on my toothbrush while I was out.

The jasmine sticky rice was good. And the tea. As a nice, unsolicited touch, they brought a plate of rice for my great-niece molded into the shape of a Teddy bear after having bestowed upon her a set of crayons and a coloring book. She enjoyed drinking tea with her grandmother and the staff doted on her.

For desert, we ordered plate of fried bananas with coconut ice cream to share. What we got was a mix. The plate was too small for sharing. That's not the establishment's fault. But it was priced too high for what we got - for what a single customer would've gotten - and, really, there wasn't much there for a single customer to enjoy. The desert was a small scoop of house-made coconut ice cream - which was outstanding - ringed by fried bananas and the plate was drizzled in chocolate on one side and another sauce on the other. The sauces were tasty... The fried bananas were not. I'd recommend a dish of the coconut ice cream if that's what might be on your mind if finding yourself there... But... It's a disappointing series of hoops to go through for ice cream.

I wish I could tell you about the food, but that won't happen here. After walking in and requesting a table I was told there would be a 10 minute wait. No big deal, of course, that's pretty standard. We stood and waited at least 10 minutes and finally a spot in the waiting area opened up and we sat down. At this point the staff had cleared 4 tables which we could visibly see were set and ready to go. With one group ahead of us, I decided to run next door to H&M and grab a couple of items. I was in and out in less than 10 minutes thinking upon my return my husband and daughter would be seated and waiting to order. To my surprise they were still in the waiting area!!  At this point we've already invested close to 30 minutes and still weren't even seated!  A couple of minutes later we FINALLY got a table. 

After sitting down we spent a lot of time reviewing the menu and at no point did a server come by to greet us. After about 10 minutes I took my daughter to use the restroom. She is 3 so bathroom trips are not quick. When we got back to the table my husband mentioned he still hasn't been approached by a server. At this point we got up to leave. We told the host we were really upset about the lack of service. He didn't seem too concerned. 45 minutes of our time spent, with a hungry toddler, and we made zero progress towards getting a meal. We will never try them again. No burger in town is worth that much frustration. 

To top it off we decided to then go to Yard House where we knew we would get quick service. We told the waiter about our experience and he brought us an order of free truffle fries to make our day better!!!  Now that's service!!!

Don't waste your precious time at The Counter.

This review is probably biased. But that's fine, because this DK Donuts is spectacular.

Full disclosure: When I woke up at 3:40 a.m. on a vacation day and climbed out of bed and into -1  degrees of  raw Idaho morning to make their 4 a.m. grand opening, I became more than this outlet's first customer, ever. I became its donut godfather, and thus assumed all the responsibility and impartiality that such a made-up title implies.

I'm totally rooting for Darren, his family, and their little slice of a strip mall that has long been a place where Meridian's small businesses go to die. Partly because he shook my hand and claimed I'd been good luck when I came back for a second box at 11 a.m. on their first day and found they had almost sold out, but mostly because they're a close and easy place to get delicious donuts.

And they most definitely are delicious donuts, fried in stages all morning so you're always likely to get something fresh. Their strawberry and blueberry frosted cake donuts are the best of their kind, anywhere, and their old-fashioneds live up to the standard set by DK's flagship Boise location.

The old-fashioned crueller, in particular, is a hard-fried, butter-soaked monument to West Coast donut supremacy that would rank as the single dopest pastry in the Treasure Valley if it weren't for Country Donuts' legendary fritters.

Speaking of fritters, the apple ones at DK are decent -- a little thin, flimsy and dry, but still far superior to Winco, Albertsons or Freddie's. Likewise, their other raised options suffer from the same pitfalls that plague the original DK: thin, watery-tasting frosting, gluten-heavy dough and an unenthusiastic fry job that leaves their exteriors without enough rich crust.

That said, their maple bars are still totally worth a shot, mainly because the DK dudes do a spectacular job of hiding their flaws though the simple expedient of slapping a slab of bacon on top. That alone is a good enough excuse to drop by for the occasional breakfast, although I'm pretty sure the tremendous cake donuts are enough of a  draw on their own.

We saw the sign from the road that said Deli and we loved it! The best deli in town! Our new favorite! Food is great! Their fries are amazing and they have a fry sauce they sell and it's worth every penny! Try it out! Only con is that it's small during a rush and hard to find a place to sit. Hopefully they find a way to expand! Love this place!

Small local restaurant that packs a big punch. Really varied menu that I would like to try all of - steak, duck, pork, venison. Had the prime rib special which was excellent! Asparagus done just right and prime rib very tasty. They obviously know their beef. Wonderful choice of wines and the Revelry cab was a great recommendation - thanks to our waitress for her suggestions! A little off the beaten track but well worth it!

Drove from Ketchum to Boise for a doctor's appt and since my MacBook  Air had some 'issues' I made an appt with Pete to diagnose. Promptly at the 10a appt he  listened, knew what to do, and was very patient in explaining the options. He needed a couple of hours to work on it and it was ready at the appointed time. Pete, YOU are a ROCKSTAR!! The experience was wonderful and you were so very clear in your explanations, courteous and fun to deal with.
PS I had read the reviews of the Apple Store in Boise and was so intimidated and turned off by the reviewers negative experiences. I investigated alternative places and Rockstar was at the TOP 5 star of yelp reviewers list. 
Thanks again!!

Jane O
I had this meal delivered by Cafe Courier and no fault of their own but I ordered brisket not chipped beef.

My son just got his braces off and we are SO happy with the results!  Dr. Guymon and his staff made it such a great experience.  We looked forward to every appointment.  The atmosphere was fun-from the video games, earning coins to buy something cool, to the random contests. Not to mention writing on the wall and getting a head shot to display on their wall when the braces come off! I would recommend Guymon Orthodontics to everyone!

If you like your food with a side of salt and grease, come to Cheerleaders. The service was terrible, took over an hour to get our food. Drinks were fine. Lots of TVs, like everywhere! I hope their raved-about breakfast is better than the rest of their food.

We went in to get our pizza and got a thin crust. The only reason we go to papa johns is for the garlic sauce. Apparently you don't get one with a thin crust. We asked for one and the guy told us no, he was so rude and had no customer service abilities at all. Will not order from here again.

Great location on Chinden, very clean environment, and nice array of weights and machines to be able to do anything you would need to do.  Also, the 24 hour member access and rate is superb.  I highly recommend Idaho Fitness Factory to friends and family, they are lot better than the previous ownership.

I was worried I might be too harsh due to personal preferences/obsessions, but mine may actually be one of the more generous reviews. The Counter already has a lot going against it, including stiff competition in the burger department from restaurants with better Village locations. The burger at Twigs is the best gourmet burger I've ever had, and the burgers at Backstage Bistro are surprisingly tasty, too.

My husband and I found the burgers here okay. There are a lot of options and you get a nicely laid out form to fill out with your specifications, but we weren't impressed with any of the toppings we tried. The patty itself was juicy, but lacked flavor.  The horseradish cheddar was bland and devoid of heat.   I ordered a "float" of sauces to try with my burger and fries. The horseradish aioli had a little bit of kick to it, but it needed something to round out the flavor. I prefer the garlic aioli at Twigs to the Counter's roasted garlic aioli. The watery country ranch tasted too strongly of onion. The shoestring fries were the perfect size and cooked just right, but poorly seasoned, and, without a satisfying dipping sauce, I was doubly disappointed. 

The kids' meal sliders are shamefully small (more like one slider trimmed down to a square and cut in half.)

Despite the name, you don't order at the counter like you do at places like Five Guys or Smash Burger. Instead you have table service. We did receive very good service. We sat on the patio, but it's not off the courtyard so there is no view.  That can't be helped, but flavor and prices can.

Wonderful greeting when we walked into the establishment.

Gentleman was very nice, welcoming, and charismatic.

The food was pretty good. The atmosphere was good. The guacamole appetizer was AMAZING.

This place could have received 5 stars if....
The female hostesses would have smiled more. And the chubby one in the pink shirt could have smiled at least ONCE and said something like "have a nice evening" or something. Instead if felt like she just wanted us gone.

We'll come back for more. The prices are reasonable. But anymore bad service from the hostesses - we'll find another mexican restaurant.

Good friendly service, quick wait time for food, nice selection of breads, sandwiches and soups.  A little on the noisier side, but thats expected with the size of crowds that pack into the place around lunch time. The gift shop-like environment feels a little like Cracker barrel, which I don't particularly care for, but the quality of food and service makes up for it.  Also, their banana bread is very tasty as well. Worth a look for anyone wanting to try something that feels a little more fresh and down home.

I went into Kneaders with high expectations based on a friend's recommendation & what I came away with was an expensive lunch that I could've had almost anywhere. Their menu is good, but nothing special. Their treats are ok, and that's maybe what's keeping people coming back. The quality of food isn't worth the price you pay. I could take it or leave it.

I like this place but they're pretty inconsistent in their food prep.  Sometime Sammys are packed so full you can barely eat it, other times there is so little meat you get lots of bread.  It a cute place but very cramped, desserts always look yummy.

Joe got the burrito Verde. He said it was a nice portion size and tasted pretty good. No real complaints there. I had the flauntas with shredded beef. They were okay and the shredded beef had a really good flavor. I'm use to my flaunats with cream cheese in them and some melted cheese on top, so I missed that with this dish. I asked if they had any white queso I could add on the side and they didn't really have that option. We did love the chips and dips they brought out before our meal. Bean dip and a unique shredded cabbage sort of pico. We would go back but are still on the search for the place that will hit our Mexican food craving!

A group of work friends went to Big Al's last week for a send off party for a co- worker. There were about 7 of us throughout the evening. I will start by saying it was a Thursday night and not busy in the restaurant. The service was terrible. We would have to actually waive down our waitress to take an order. She was not friendly or helpful. The food was delivered by a young man who just asked "finger steaks?" Then pretty much dumped the plate down and walked off. We were never checked on for drink refills or checking on our order. The food was not very good either.  Said finger steaks were over cooked and two were too grisly to even eat.  Everyone in our group was disappointed. I don't think I'd return to eat.  The bowling is fun, but I just can't recommend eating in the restaurant when there are so many other options in the area and places that value my business.  Very disappointing.

I'm originally a SoCal girl so when I saw a hometown favorites was moving to my new home in Idaho... I was ecstatic! Habit is just a good ol' fashioned burger with great taste and classic sides turned up a notch. One thing that makes this Habit better than those back home is the fry sauce, yes I've conformed to the Idahoan ways of fry sauce and now I can't eat fries any other way. I always get the charburger and my husband gets the meal and we upgrade the fries to either sweet potato or the tempura great beans. Both are absolutely amazing and are big enough for us to feel satisfied with splitting our side. I'm so happy that we now have a Habit just down the road from us! Welcome to Idaho!

Like I said...the bakery has some of the best customer service I have seen in a long time. I got a drive thru order and it took longer than normal but not much considering your getting high quality prodicts. I get to the window and the nice and friendly cashier said I appologize for the wait can I get you a drink? I know its just a drink but I didn't have to ask for it or hint anything.  Good job guys! Now...for the food, wow! High quality, fresh, and full of flavors! The bread has good chew, taste, and softness to it...it was amazing! The veggies were very fresh and the meat was REAL meat, not processed thin slices of lunch meat but real peices of chicken, turkey, ham, etc...excellent! It may not be the fastest food around but for the price and high quality food I am ok with waiting longer for a meal. If you want faster you might need to go to a fast food joint...sorry.
This place is awesome. Fast, friendly service and amazing burgers. I built my own and the burger tasted great and was cooked perfectly. Toppings were fresh. Definitely coming back.
Good taco restaurant that opened their second restaurant in Meridian.   Good tacos and great chips and guacamole.  Great prices and friendly staff.
After getting a citation Dutch bros covered my drink. Thank you so much Dutch Bros. Trevor had helped me out today

I live in Boise and have tried just about every Thai restaurant in town.  Decided to expand the search and heard good things about this place.  Definitely glad I took the drive.
Food was great.  My Thai sweet and sour was just right, crispy vegetables and the sauce was just the right amount of sweet.  We had a tempura vegetable appetizer which was a good match with the sweet chili sauce.
Our server was friendly and attentive.
The restaurant is small so it does have a tendency to be busy.

If you're in the area and want some great thai food at a good price I recommend it, I will definitely make the drive again in the near future.

This place is such a welcome addition to Meridian. Love their donuts. They always are very fresh and there is always a wide selection. Much better then the grocery store bakery donuts which seem to be the standard in this area.
The shop is bright and clean and the staff is always friendly. My favorite guilty pleasure is the bacon maple bar. But I regularly get an assorted dozen for the office and they are quickly devoured.
I tried the apple fritter today. It wasn't bad, but definitely needed more apples. But the crispy outside and moist inside were good.
Great staff, but make sure you're being specific or they're gunna talk to their fellow nail teks too much and miss somthing/not file what they need to file or file too much ;)

My friend and I popped in here for a quick dinner after a long day of traveling.  This place is located in a strip mall but it's decorated so cute with colorful lights hanging in the windows and some cute bistro sets on the front porch for dining al fresco in better weather.  I had the old stand-by, Pad Thai, which was good but a little heavy on the noodles and light on the veggies and meat.  My friend had the Garlic Noodles which I think I probably ate the majority of.  It was delicious!

The prices were decent for Thai food (around $10 an entree) and beers were buy 2 get one free on Wednesday night.  The only gripe I have is that there was a trio of musicians playing bluegrass music (non-stop) in the restaurant and it just didn't seem to enhance the Thai vibe.

Fast, fresh, and delicious! I wandered in here to grab a quick sandwich, and was very pleased to find this gem. I really prefer to stay away from the chains, and my visit here today reminded me why. I had the Reuben, small macaroni salad, and a Coke. Everything was great, and the staff was pleasant. I am looking forward to returning to explore the menu further. I would highly recommend giving this place a try.

I really like their soups, they always sound a little different, but I've yet to taste one I haven't liked! I only gave them 3 stars because 3 out 5 times I've gone in and stood at the register to place an order, and no one was at the register, but there have been 1 or 2 employees making stuff right there and they say nothing to me! Not even a quick, be right with you. They just ignore me as if they don't see me, even though they do. I just think the service could be a little better. And, I don't think the sandwiches are "fat" but they do taste good.

I gave another shot at this place. I booked an appointment online with Andrea. She seems to be a more experience massage therapist than the last one I saw. She asked me which area that I have problem with or need to be emphasize at. I told her my right shoulder, right arm and hip. She started massaging me and asked if the pressure is good enough for me. I told her to be slightly more. Andrea is a strong woman and has a good massage routine. You will feel relax afterwards. More importantly she let me feel she try to do her best and put effort into it. That's what we call dedication and professionalism. We chatted some and get to know that she is a hard working woman. Ever since, I see her once a week and became her regular now. However, she has become flaky in appointment and I stop seeing her.

I want to update on my recent experience with them. I have gone back to this place about 3 months ago. Have been really busy working and need to relax my muscle. Managed to make appointment with the owner Chrissy which supposed to be the best. She indeed quite good compared to the rest. At the beginning so far so good. But until ~3 weeks ago, she started kept cancelling the appointments at the last minute, at least 3 times, and have to reschedule. A couple of times, she just assigned my appointment to some other masseur without my approval. I only find out the masseur was changed when I saw the email reminder. That's pretty rude. I let it slide during that time. But until last appointment 3 weeks ago, she cancelled it again and offered a free make up session for me. I said that's cool. I have her rescheduled it on a Saturday morning. Then guess what. She cancelled it again like the day before claiming she will be out of town. I saw she has other clients on that day too. I guess she had to cancel them all. Then she texted me telling me that she will call me to reschedule after she came back. Luckily I did not wait for her to call me back for reschedule it. I texted her asking when will I get my appointment like after 3 weeks. Guess what. She was never out of town. She just about to leave out of town the week I texted her. What a liar ! She then said she can see me on Sept 8th after she came back. I told her sure. Then she texted back saying she is all booked until Oct 4th. WTH ! I have to wait for ~another 2 months to just get one session. It will never happened in this way if she has proactively and more considerately to schedule my make up session in advance. I asked her how come she cannot just squeeze in one session for me within the next 2 weeks. Then she brought up the single mom kids reason...and she only can work day time, which is fine with me as I told her that I can do weekend day time. But appears that she was booked for weekend for those 2 weeks. if she has schedule me way in advance, this thing will not happen. She later offered to pay for the session for me with another masseur. To get it over with, I accepted. It seems like flakiness, irresponsible, and inconsiderate are common entities in this establishment. Not to mention appears that arrogant and rudeness are also quite popular there. The reason I gave them a 2 star because there appears to be there are still a couple of decent masseur there.

Stopped in for a quick cup of coffee during a road trip and am so glad I stopped here! The coffee was awesome and the girls working there were super friendly. It's a nice little local spot. Definitely recommend it!
Love love love them! Their iced white mochas are delicious. Bagel sandys are to die for. And the tomato ravioli soup is delicious!!!! Plus the staff is always friendly and up beat!!

Hampton Inn was clean. Most staff was friendly. Plenty of parking. The walls are paper thin with big heavy doors that slam loud. It is right off the interstate so lots of noise from traffic. The breakfast is sad and not for anyone who is eating low carb or low calorie or gluten free.

My friend and I love this restaurant and come in occasionally for some yummy Thai food. Tonight, (Saturday at 6 PM) was a terrible experience of bad customer service and just poor staffing. My friend and I got sat right away. We were at a back table by the restroom. For 13 minutes, not one single employee greeted our table to take drink or food orders. We finally got up and left after watching three tables who were sat after get greeted by a server who took their drink and food orders very promptly.

I went to this restaurant because some friends recommended it. Something must've been off the night I went in for tacos because the chicken and pulled pork tacos that I ordered were too dry. Two out of the three tacos that I ordered were just not what I had expected. This seems odd because it has such great reviews, so I might give it another chance. Other than that the prices, the portion sizes, and the service were just what you expect from me fast casual dining restaurant with good solid reviews.
A great little coffee shop. The staff is very nice and there is good seating. Would recommend.

Supposedly open until 11pm but when I went there the other night, the doors were locked and chairs up at 9:40pm!!! Went out of our way to drive there but clearly you can't depend on them to actually be open when they say they are.

BFC is one of my prime spots to get a burger fix. The menu is simple and straight to the point. The bison and beef burgers are delicious but the fries definitely takes the cake. They have various salts and 9 types of ketchup to accompany the fries. They also have an option to get Brussels sprouts which are to die for. They have chairs and tables outside which come in handy during the summer.
These are great doughnuts. And the service is exceptional. Dk is your consistent west coast style doughnut

Can't taste the coffee, this is more for the younger crowd who want a sugary drink.  If you're looking for a bold, dark roast, look elsewhere.  I ordered a triple shot soy latte with sugar free syrup and all I could taste with the syrup.  After a triple shot?  The syrup they use must be low quality because it had a sugar-free aftertaste.  That typically doesn't happen with higher quality sugar-free products.

Sooooooo amazing.  We walked in for the 1st time not knowing what we were to expect.  So many different varieties of taters and alternate options for meat! The bun was amazing too.  Not your prepackaged sesame bun that leave you feeling like you need to immediately poop afterwards.  It was insane good.  We will be back someday on our travels.

Took our out of town guests. Food and service was terrible. It seemed to have been homecoming night for area high schools so the entire restaurant area was swamped. Cacicias had only two employees working and were struggling to keep up. Employees said they had been trying to call the owner but no response. Owner should have known this Saturday night was going to be busy. The village had posted signs advising of overflow parking. 
Our wait was over an hour for our food. Employees wanted to comp our meal but didn't feel they had the authority. Too bad.
Not returning.

Probably one of the better sandwiches I've had in a long time.  Got the Italian and a bowl of chowder and I was not disappointed.  The meat was piled high, delicious fresh baked bread and some special sauce.  

I would definitely go here again!

When in Idaho.... Work trip brought me to the land of potatoes. Found this place on Yelp and had to give it a go. I mean come on Boise Fry Co. "Potatoes"!!! Was not disappointed, from the choice of potato when choosing your fries to the amazing line up of dipping sauces and salts for your fries. Don't pass this place up, they do it right here. **side note, burgers were on par as well!!

My husband and I went here this evening and had an amazing time! The prickly pear margaritas were amazing and the food surpassed our expectations. What really topped the night was our server, Eddy. He was very attentive not only to us but also the "regular" couple that was seated next to us. My husband and I loved hearing him interact with them in a genuine way just like he did with us! We already are talking about going back and it's only been a few hours since we ate!!
