We celebrated my hubby's birthday here with family. We were all first timers and had a great overall experience. Service was awesome and the food was top notch. We had the clam/chorizo app, which was by far my fav of the entire meal. Our dinner selections included the ribeye, a few burgers, veggie sandwich and the chicken salad. Everyone loved their food. Its a very small place with only a few tables and bar seating, but made for a quaint, intimate vibe. We live in northend Boise, so it was a little bit of a trek to get out there, but ultimately worth it.
Justin was my artist. He was very nice and professional. Did great work on my tattoo! The whole staff was very nice and the parlor was very clean!! Will definitely come back!!

I like the Boise locations so much better then the meridian locations. Boise always gets my drink right and we have never had an issue. We live in meridian and drive into Boise to get coffee. I used to hate coffee until I tasted Dutch Bros Coffee. I only drink the white coffee. My kids love their shakes!

Cheap but still not worth the money. I'm guessing the bed bugs are a real concern. My baby woke up with two bites this morning that look like images of bed bug bites. We are frantically washing everything we own in hot water now after arriving him. I also had my room reserved for months and have been charged for a night the entire time, I wasn't guaranteed a room when I arrived after six hours of traveling. After stressing about possibly not having a room, they apparently had one left to give me. Now, I still need to fight to get my money back because they have no record of charging me when I made my reservation. It sounds like I'm not alone concerning the overcharge because I heard a receptionist, that I haven't dealt with talking about a similar situation to another employee. They also kept a record of my card number in their data base. Don't be fooled by the hot breakfast, nothing special. It's a cover up for the place being completely inadequate to sleep in.

My roommate had never tried The Habit, so I insisted since it's always been a favorite. I have always LOVED the burgers here. I ordered the Teriyaki burger, which I have always favored. Unfortunately, there was absolutely NO teriyaki sauce. The mayo and pickles completely overpowered the burger and it was so salty to the taste. I am so disappointed as it was not a good burger at all. What a waste of a meal and money. I would not recommend this to anyone who enjoys a great burger.
I absolutely love Dr Guymon and the staff. They already greet with a smile and the best atmosphere, plus gave my daughter and amazing smile

Fat Guys has not only some of the best customer service I've ever seen but also some of the best sandwiches. It's a little out of the way but I always make it the first place to go for sandwiches in the general Boise area. Chef Wally knows what he's doing and could not be a better person to run such a fine establishment. If you've never been to Fat Guys Fresh Deli, it's worth the drive for the great food and service!

Stopped by tonight for dinner on the patio. Great food and atmosphere! Obviously quality fresh local ingredients and made from scratch! So lucky to have this place a few blocks from home! Try the tempura green beans for an appetizer- best I've ever had!

I am a HUGE fan of Boise Fry. I live in Houston, so every time I am in Boise visiting I must eat here. (SO excited for the Austin location to open!) 

We always get an order of the bourgeois? I think, it's the ones with the duck fat. I was skeptical the first time but they are delicious! I've had other types of fries here and have never been disappointed. 

I love the flavors of sauces they have, and how the plate your burger comes on has a spot for three different sauces of your choosing. I always mix & match, but love the maple marshmallow and the spicy fry sauce. The sauces change and they don't always have the maple marshmallow though. The burgers are good, but the fries are why you come here. I always get the original beef burger with bacon- garlic aioli, spring mix, red onion gastrique, tomato. 

This location seems bigger than the other one I've gone to that is closer to BSU campus.

What's not to like about this place other than it's located in Idaho?
The breakfast was the best I've ever had from a hotel! eggs, sausage, waffles, toast, bagels, coffee, yogurt, biscuits, cereal, juice, milk, ect. 
This was not your typical cowardly continental breakfast that hotels half ass this was a real breakfast!
The hotel was super nice too. WiFi worked good. Super clean. Can't beat the rate either.

Love this place!!! The quality is worth the price and the experience is excellent. Very fun crew!  If going on a weekend you may want to call in advance for available appointments as they do get busy... with that however I have always seen them do their best to get you in a chair as soon as possible.

A unique, intimate grill offering an exciting alternative for Meridian. Creative and fun signature drinks, excellent moderately priced wines, and a small but amazingly varied menu. On our first visit with family and friends we managed to try most of the items on the menu and there was not a disappointment in the group. The crab cake and the gnocchi were huge hits. Grant's is reminiscent of the finest sidewalk cafes in any major city. Meridian is in for a real treat.

I never understood the infatuation with tacos...until I came to Tin Roof! I had no idea Tacos could be this good! This is one of my favorite places to eat! Their salsa is amazing, their Tin Roof Taco is by far the best, but I haven't had a bad taco there. My wife has had the fish taco and did not care for it but other than that we have enjoyed everything! They also have a pretty decent beer selection for a little joint. 

I have been to both locations and they both have been great. I do enjoy the downtown boise location more. I have noticed that the meridian location brings in are more families, and tin roof seems to be more of a quick eat kind of place rather than sitting down for a meal. The meridian location crowd also seems to not quite grasp this concept where they spread out take up lots of room, take all the salsa's regardless if they use them or not. I believe the meridian location is bigger too, but somehow it feels smaller. More of an annoyance than anything, it would never change my decision on coming or not. 

This place is delicious!

I NORMALLY don't have any issues with Big Als but that changed today. I went in with my kids. I didn't know you can't bring outside food or drink. There are no signs and I dont like paying $25 for a plate of nachos. So I brought snacks in a canvas bag like I normally do usually with no problems. I asked the waitress for some waters. Immediately after, the manager walked up and said they didn't allow outside food or drink and that it was a health hazard. I realized that the waitress snitched on us then she proceeded to continuously wait on all the tables around us but never approached our table again for the entire hour and a half we were there. I felt singled out. Very unprofessional. And the table next to us sat uncleaned for at least an hour which I would consider a health hazard. Big Als, please train your waitresses better.
Fantastic bagels & sandwiches for an excellent price. I love their breakfast sandwiches. The service is fast and efficient.

It's been several years since I've been to the Ram. We came here in hopes for a decent dinner and was left horribly disappointed. The steak was bland I asked for gorgonzola melted and got crumbles. Asked for it to be melted and the waitress said that's all she can do. Their blue cheese Au gratin was tasteless, dry and it was paired with a nasty red onion, corn and green bean mix. The fish and chips were mostly breading. The service was severely lacking and our waitress was almost non existent. The manager was very nice and took care of us. Although the manager came in at the end, we won't be returning. The price and quality of food is not worth it. Go to Bodacious pig or Texas Roadhouse.

They have amazing fries and burgers and they have so much flavor. I love their wide variety of fry and sauce choices. I also appreciate how most of their ingredients are organic and local. They have high qulaity meat and you can tast the difference. The staff was so friendly and helpful, they went above and beyond to be kind. I will definitely be returning to this place many times in the future! If you love good food and supporting local business than this is the place to visit.

Best jojos in town. Try them with the fry sauce. The sandwiches are delicious, the service is usually pretty good. The food is on the higher end of what I like to spend, but it is yummy. I wish the seating was a bit better.

I have been going to Janna for years!! Her husband and her bought a shop called the Nails tek on eagle rd behind red robins. I constanly get kudos on my nails and the designs  she does free hand. Just bring in a picture and she can  do anything. She is fantastic!!!! The prices are great and its very friendly!!!!!! Her husband does fantastic pedi's and the massages he gives omg to die for!!! Should come in a give this place a chance., dont knock till you try it.
I am all over the fries and the black bean burger, but the bomb is the root beer soda.  I am not sure what the secret is but I can't quit it.

This place is the best!  The food is outstanding and you get what you pay for.

It's small, so depending on the time you arrive, you may not be able to get a table.  The staff is fun and the owner is a card when you get to know him.

If you don't see what you want on the menu, just ask.  If you're feeling adventurous, try the "Surprise me."  My husband has never been disappointed.

The clam chowder on Fridays is really good.

If you haven't tried it before, then you should.  I hope they move into a larger location soon.
Always good service each and everytime I've came here. Other then that it's your typical IHOP

This is the first year that we did season passes and we are not disappointed! It is only June 3rd and we have been 5 times and our passes are paid for. The kids who are 12 and 9 would spend 12 hours here if I would let them. We love it here. The cheeseburgers are great.

Update July 4th 2018 we still love the Waterpark but we will no longer order food here. The food has gone downhill. I spent almost $200 on food passes and my kids don't even want to use them. My husband and I ordered a 2 pizza slice meal and there must have been a huge bubble in the pizza because there really was not any cheese. The food is not worth the price. Fries always cold. The park would do a lot better with having better food or maybe even 2 surfside grills. 

I also wish they had more season pass holder perks. Such as putting a bracket on season pass holders and letting them go down slide every other paying customer. It's frustrating when you buy a pass and wait an hour to ride something because it's $15 day to the general public. If they want to keep selling season passes they need more perks.

I had a free two week free trial given to my husband by the previous manager who had retired. With that being said, the only reason I went was because it was free. The place does not feel clean, the pool is tiny, no one wipes the equipment down after using it, and there always seems to be a shortage on towels. The staff seem friendly, with a dash of snooty. I had an appointment to talk about membership, but canceled because the YMCA is better... By leaps and bounds! When I called to cancel my appointment, I was placed on hold and hung up on. They don't have a lot going for them. 
The only reason I signed up for yelp was to warn others about the Idaho Athletic Club. Readers be warned.
Great atmosphere, the ladies are amazing . I Love that they offer different styles of lashes including colors to have some fun with.

The service in The Caddyshack and the restaurant was horrible both times we went last weekend.. They also don't keep a good eye on people getting overly intoxicated.. There were several people who should have been cut off long ago. Do not order the Grand Slam appetizer.. Waste of $16 for 1/2 of it to be potato chips. 

We will not be back, which is sad because we were looking forward to watching games on their huge screen in the bar.

This is a new business in a small strip mall next to Costa Vida restaurant on the Eagle and Ustick crossroad.  If you blink, you'll miss it.  The only reason we found it was because I went to Costa Vida and saw it.  

The tech we worked with was personable; and even though we came in close to closing, he saw us anyway.  Wrote a ticket and had the computer repaired the next day.

There is an upfront fee for diagnosis but if you have a repair, it can be applied to that.

They will work on Apple products, PC's, and mobile devices.  They will also work on XP machines that other places won't touch.
Great place. Local food all freshly prepared. Great service as well. Prices were more than reasonable as well.

Yes, it's a chain. And it shows in the food, which is chain quality (at best). The beer, however, is very good. The Taildragger IPA is by far the best IPA I've had in the Boise area.

So - 5 stars for the beer, 1 for the meh food, and I find myself at a 3.
Great service and consistent food quality. One of my favorite fast Mexican restaurants.

Awesome fries!! Burgers were not very good.  The fry sauce, gag!!!  The staff and service was pretty good.  The restaurant was very small; we had people in line right next to our table which made us feel crowded.  If it wasn't for those great fries the rating would be a lot lower.

AMAZING PLACE!!! 
You'll always catch the owners in working alongside their employees! And if you're a regular, they'll remember your order better than you do! Aside from raving about the experience, the food is phenomenal! Fat Guy's is one place that I visit regularly and return again and again! Thankful for a consistent, clean place to grab my lunch!

So happy to have the new Meridian location!  Breakfast tacos on the way to work. Score! Pork or Baja Tacos for lunch. Double Score!!  $1 bag of chips and Salsa.  Tin Roof is the best! This place is a must for anyone looking for a good variety of street tacos.

Tyler answered the phone on the first call. We scheduled to replace the front windshield after it had cracked from an airbag deployment.  The day of the appointment, of course it was pouring rain outside. Not to worry, he had the equipment to be able to do the job inside of my tiny garage. He worked quickly and the end result was a windshield that looks much better than the car! A+
Overall a great choice.  If you like Thai, give it a try.
Great family run restaurant ! We had the chile verde and it had really nice spice to it!  Live music on Saturday night.  Salsa was good. We look forward to coming back and trying more things!
I had the twisted caprese sandwich and it was absolutely delicious! Service was great as well! My girlfriend and I will definitely be coming back to try more food.

I booked this room here because it was close to my parents house. I got a good deal through Expedia's site (bad mistake) but I should have done more research on the place before booking. 

Pulling up I knew it wasn't going to be great. The motel is in the JB's parking lot (JB's is a Denny's type restaurant). It's an old nondescript building. When we checked in the woman taking care of our reservation was eating takeout noodles at the same time. She continued to chew and wipe her mouth with her sleeve as she checked us in. None of the employees wore name tags or uniforms so it looked as though they were guests who decided to hop behind the counter. We got our room keys which had advertisements for Domino's pizza on them, not a very classy impression.

Our room was small but it was clean. There were no lamps at all so the only lights were florescent lights. The bed was so bad it bounced with every move we made no matter how small. They put us on the first floor next to a jr.high sports group which took up about 5 rooms around us. They only stayed one night but I was shocked the motel didn't consider that when we checked in...perhaps she was too busy eating. 

We did finally get good service when we requested new pillows the second time. The first time we got this lumpy pathetic pillow. When I returned to the front desk the next morning the woman (again no name tag) was apologetic and informed me she'd ensure we got better pillows (which we did that night). When we returned late one night the gentleman at the front desk greeted us nicely and gladly helped us when our keys weren't working. These two employees made up for the horrible experience checking in with the hungry employee and the bad room.  If it weren't for them it would have been a horrible trip. So thank you to both of them - too bad they didn't have name tags or I could have been more specific. 

We won't be staying at the Sandman again because it wasn't a comfortable room nor a relaxing nights sleep and isn't that what matters most when you stay in a motel?

Always chipper! You'd never think these girls aren't morning people. They have great attitudes and always seem eager to please. My wife and I wish there were more locations so we could be elsewhere and still get their coffee. They give Starbucks (IN SEATTLE) a run for their money. I say Seattle because the Starbucks here in Idaho don't meet the standard.
This is for the Nampa location. I ordered the Golden Chicken Sandwich, the chicken was burnt and the bread was so hard, I was unable to bite into it. $7 down the drain.

I absolutely love this place! Great service and the staff is so friendly. I used to live in Boise and moved to LA. I've been here for three years and I've had some of the best/terrible sushi, Sa Wa Dee rocks! I can't wait to come back.

I come here while in Boise on work trips.  Lots of televisions and a good beer selection.  They have HUGE mugs which are chilled to the point of nearly being freezing, the beer taste so good. 

Depending on the day of the week there is always some special, they also have a good happy hour.

The food is typical bar fare, nothing amazing, most is deep friend, and or generally greasy.  I do like their nachos and I've also tried the Italian sand which which comes out warm.

Generally speaking a great spot to watch a sporting events and drink beer.  Staff is all friendly, mostly young attractive (female!) servers.

A natural stop for me while in the area.

I thought this place was awesome at first! I loved that I could play my favorite game, Pump It Up, and go downstairs and then get ice cream! (and even pay with your game card). But since they downgraded Pump It Up versions I really have no reason to go back. Why keep the game but get a worse version? The one they have now is no fun at all. The music is 10x worse than any music on DDR, and 10x less fun!
Loved it but not anymore, guess I'll be going to Dave & Busters.

When ordering we couldn't hear the gal at the register because of all the kids running around and jumping off the chairs. The parents were oblivious--.
We couldn't figure out how to order and what came with the breakfast meals. We wanted pancakes and they were out of "batter" at 10:00am. We ordered om lets and asked if toast came with it, she said no, so we ordered a sleeve of rolls. When we received our meals, there was toast with them and one roll. We won't be back.
Umm yumm. My mom and I love to go get food from here. So many different options and they are the perfect size!

We are visiting Idaho and decided to go here tonight with our friends who live here! First we went bowling, and had some drinks and then played some arcade games!!! We had an absolute blast and when we went to go exchange our tickets for games we had two of the absolute best employees there!! Colton and Norman were the best ever!! They were so nice and helped our group out so much! They are definitely one of the main reasons we want to go back there!! 10/10 would recommend! We had such an absolute blast!!! :)

Booked appointment with "curly hair specialist" & she didn't show up due to family emergency so I had my hair cut by another gal & I just wasn't happy with the outcome. I went to this high end, specialty salon to get hair help with creative ideas since I am not a hair stylist & I dislike being asked by the stylist for ideas. Isn't that what we customers pay for? I  might give them another try...might, not promising I will.

We got sandwiches here the other night. I had the Rueben and my hubby had the pastrami. They were very big (for me anyways). I like to think of myself as a Rueben connoisseur as it's my go to on any menu. They really seem to take their time with the sandwich which I can appreciate. I had gotten one around the corner the other day and though I asked for it to be heated, the meat was cold. Definitely not the case here! I watched as the bread was toasted, meat heated, and then put together in the panini press. This one did not disappoint, one of the better ones in this area (the all time best is found in Spokane). The potato salad was a bit over seasoned for me, but I'm super picky when it comes to potato salad. The owner came in while I was there and was "loud" but super friendly! We will definitely be back!!!!

I mean....it's not the worst - but it is definitely not the best. 
I got it on Priceline for a pretty good deal. 
(note to self, Priceline will always put me here! SO QUIT DOING IT) 

Check in was easy and Jo at the front desk was SUPER helpful and great, so she does deserve a shoutout! The cookies were also wonderful! 

The room was clean enough and I had a nice view. We were only in the room for a quick sleep - so it honestly didn't matter. I slept fine, the wi-fi was good, and it was quiet. 

The bathroom shower is a little bit strange - but the shower head was decent. The towels are SO SMALL! hahaha and the rough kind of towel - not soft.

They do offer a breakfast but we were sleeping still - so cannot comment. Outside pool - so it was closed but they do have an indoor hot tub. 

I would never pick this place by choice - but if you do a 2 1/2 * Priceline for a mid range price - you will get put here.

I really wanted to like this place. Multiple potatoes, multiple fry cuts, multiple dipping sauces, multiple salts for fries, multiple meats for burgers. What a great idea. Unfortunately, in practice I didn't come away saying wow. Had the beef cheeseburger. There was way to much bun for the meat. Really couldn't taste the beef. The beef had no fat content so seemed over cooked and dry. Maybe I just like juicy burgers. As for the fries you really can't pick the potato and the cut. Certain types of potatoes only had certain cuts. I opted for the special duck fat fries which were only russet potatoes. Nothing like you would get in Canada where they regularly cook their fries in duck fat. If you go try the poutine. My wife had regular fries and there really was nothing special there. Sauces for dipping were nice, but not enough to overcome everything else. Been to a lot of places with much better burgers and fries.
Awesome! The food is great! The staff is always hustling and everyone is very friendly and accommodating... so happy to live close

This is definitely the place to go for bagels--they have all kinds of flavors!  I usually get the wheat or cinnamon raisin.  The cream cheese is special and they have several flavors of that.  It's very fluffy and creamy--the honey walnut and of course plain are both really good.  I've never tried any sandwiches here as I usually take the bagels home.  They will even slice the bagels for you which is a nice touch!

I've been going here for a few years and usually reserve my (usually positive) comments for dining establishments however after my experience here last Saturday, I felt compelled to post. 
Hands down the worst experience ever. Granted I get it's just a manicure, however when it's the only thing you do for yourself and the only thing you spend money on yourself for, the last thing you want to feel is like an inconvenience. My "nail tech" Lonnie was completely rushed for some reason. It was 1 on a Saturday. I have gel. She put acetone on to soften the gel but rather than waiting, as everyone else does, she began to drill off my polish, which she already drilled down. She was cutting my skin and causing me to bleed. I said something to the effect of "don't you scrape the polish off as most do" to which she didn't reply but gave me a very annoyed look and proceeded to not scrape but use a very coarse file to essentially do what she was trying to with the drill. 
She allowed my fingers to soak for no less than 15 seconds and continued to rush though the rest of the manicure subsequently missing trimming cuticles and painting 3/4 of 2 of my nails. Hanging skin. Bleeding. Shoddy polish and I left feeling like crap. Like I had just spent what takes me more than 2 hours of work to make to pay for a horrible experience. I called. I spoke to Randy who I assume is the owner and didn't get much grace or understanding. Out of principle I returned and a very nice (and fairly new) gentleman fixed her work and tried to make the situation better. He didn't excuse away the poor work and even stated that this is something that many women treat themselves to and that she should have done a better job. 
I've repeatedly dismissed the "credit card machine is broken" sign and have withdrew cash, despite the atm fee, even though it is clearly not a broken machine. They don't want to pay the fees. Fine! Inconvenience your customers. If that was the least I had to contend with I would probably continue going there but I will be giving my business to someone else. 
I realize this sounds trivial and superficial but as previously stated, this is the only thing I do for myself and while to many it may not be, this is a big thing for me. 
Sad that I can no longer support this local business but alas, there are others.

I somehow had never tried this place. I enjoyed trying different sauces and seasonings. The fries were tasty, and most of the sauces were good (a couple were definitely  not). The burger was pretty good but not really unique from other places, the fries are the star here. Theres a good selection of drinks as well. Friendly staff who were happy to explain the menu and options to me. I wouldn't come here regularly but it was nice to try.

Janna and her husband are absolutely the nicest people ever. I've been getting my nails done by Janna for years and no one beats the great job she does. My nails always look flawless and a regular fill is mostly around one hour for me without ever having to wait on the client in front of me (I greatly appreciate being on time). I always wait three weeks in between fills and never have a nail break or chip. I never went to Nail Tek prior to Janna owning it; so I don't know what it was like before, but now the salon is very clean and welcoming. I highly recommend Nail Tek.

These guys are AWESOME!! Was on my way from Salt Lake to Seattle and an annoying problem came up with muy BMW. It is an easy fix that I have done several times in my driveway, but it requires ramps and taking the belly pan off. I stopped at John's and explained my problem and that my family was waiting at the motel to get  back on our way. They pulled my car right it, put it on the lift and fixer the problem. Total time in and out was10 minutes. Here is the kicker.... Mechanic said it was too short of a time to bill and to have a save drive.

This place is so cute and the food is amazing. I love that they change up the menu too. We had the flat iron steak and pork chop. The vegetable mix was great. My only feedback was a tiny bit too salty. The presentation was great and the staff was friendly. It was a good mix of spending time with family waiting for food and didn't take too long at all. The almond cake was so so so good. I could have eaten 5 of them and my kiddos we a fan too. Kid menu was limited but they loved the butter noodles and grilled chicken. They finished their plates. We will be back - 100%.
Changing my review after receiving an offer to try their restaurant again. This time, the whole family went with burgers and we were not disappointed at all. That's their specialty and it shows.

Penny and Herbie loved their first visit! They both look great after their spa day. The staff were friendly and really showed an interest in my dogs. Store was clean and organized. Nice selection of food, toys,treats, and other dog friendly products. We will be back!

I love places like this. Kneaders is even better than Panera Bread in that the quality is better (large pieces of white meat turkey instead of thin, deli-sliced turkey) they give you larger portions, and it's less expensive. The desserts and pastries are certainly comparable, but my wife and I always go for a chocolate dipped strawberry when we come here that Panera doesn't have. Everything is always fresh and tasty.

We came with some friends who recommended it and were very impressed.  We tried 6 different flavors and all of them were great.  The roasted corn was my favorite and the bacon breakfast taco was my second favorite. The chips and queso and guacamole were a great value.

The tacos here were better than i thought they'd be. There is plenty choices of meat and they do great job making each meat really savory! If only they could have some dessert and not be all out when i go. Unfortunately, I havent tasted their desserts for that reason.

Food was tasty. My favorite was the beef fajita. Loved the crunch of the onions. Place looked a little disheveled and messy. There were tortillas all over the ground and on the tortilla making thing and you could see where they dropped tortillas and didn't retrieve them. Just made the place seem dirty.
Very good, cooked my hamburger just the way I like it. Wait staff very nice, helpful, and efficient.

I am born and raised East Coast girl with parents from the Midwest. I grew up in the same state as the donut master Dunkin Donuts , Honeydew Donuts. Plus the famous Mike's Pastry close enough to me. Krispy Kreme are just too loaded with glaze to even taste the donut.  I have to say that we love DK Donuts. On the occasion of needing a tasty sweet on those lazy Sunday mornings. The Kolache are incredible I get the regular and can never stop myself from eating it before we get home to heat it up. With the light and fluffy glazed donuts are heavenly and the kids love the maple and chocolate bars too. It might need a good scrub down to me but very friendly service. Some would say a bit pricey for donuts but you don't get that light as air amazing sweet glaze flavor for free.

Hands down the best deli in the valley. Granted, if you go during the lunch rush, you're going to have to wait for the best soup and sandwiches around, and if you go late in the day, they might be out of soup (the lentil soup is to die for) - so get there early! 

My favorite sandwich is the Trevor Melt. The homemade pesto really makes an already great sandwich extra special. The Mountain Man is also really, really good. And then there's the Blue Bronco...and...and...and...!

Lots of great choices to please most anyone. I love the parmasean or asiago with herb and garlic cream cheese. Kids love
The cinnamon and sugar bagels. We usually get a dozen and keep for the week. Even when they are busy you are in and out of there quickly. Always had friendly staff.

What a wonderful find in meridian. The food was excellent in the winter cocktails were superb.  Great place to come to relaxing not real big in the staff is very friendly. Will be back when driving through.

Yummy, yummy, yummy!  Whitewater has excellent service and food!  My favorite is the Willow Creek sandwich.  It has different kinds of meat, bacon, and avocado on it.  The sandwiches come with tortilla chips, too!  The salads, pizza, and sandwiches are huge!  Their pasta is also very tasty.
The best homemade cinnamon rolls ever! Great place when craving something sweet in the AM with coffee  very convenient they have a drive through

We tried this restaurant while in town visiting because of the great reviews and and full dining room but we were extremely disappointed. The service was great ( which is why I gave it two stars)but the food was mostly just SALT and garlic! Which aren't bad things but so many subtle flavors we usually enjoy with Thai food were missing!! Would not go there again. 
Sorry

Very nice staff, some decent selection on the bagel side, though there was a bit of staleness as well. The cream cheese, like the bagels there, are all created on-site and are excellent. There is a good selection of the usual bagel fixin's and a lot of options for bagel sandwiches. Taste was excellent on both the bagel and the cream cheese, though if you go for a double smear, it can be very difficult to eat while driving. There is also kombucha on tap, which is well worth enjoying. It's a cool little spot and nice for a change of pace or a quick bite.

Really good service...maybe even a bit too good. Our server was at our table every 3 minutes checking on us. And, she was pretty loud, so we heard her checking on everyone else as well. 

The portions are generous. No complaints there. The prices were also fair. 

I had chicken, shredded beef and shredded pork in different items: a taco, enchilada and tamale. While the flavors were between a little bland and not, the meat was tough. 

Great potential. But we were disappointed.

Went there Sunday to watch a football game and we weren't impressed. We got 2 rounds of drinks and an appetizer, that was barely enough for 1 person let alone 2 of us, and our bill was $50.00. Now I know why the place was empty. How about a Sunday happy hour from 11 to 3?  Would make it worth while, burgers are good, but didn't want to try and stomach one at 11 am. All the games were on and the atmosphere was great, ridiculous prices for drinks and appetizers wasn't worth it. If you do decide to go maybe just drink water and get some nachos or something. We won't do that again. Too overpriced for mediocre food and service!

Absolute best donut place in Idaho. I came from California where my favorite donut shop was Spudnuts. Sadly we don't have that here in Idaho. I tried many different donut places and when I landed on DK Donuts on a whim, I was in heaven! Delicious donuts, great prices, friendly family-run business. They even made me a batch of fresh apple fritters when I came in to buy a donut in the middle of the afternoon - JUST BECAUSE. How awesome is that? I ended up buying a dozen of them when I only went in for one!

I called this morning to get an estimate. Cost was $88 for my iphone6 screen. They answered, were professional, and when I took it in, I got a receipt of exactly what I'd pay. Replace took 20 minutes. Every other place needed my phone for a few hours. Although there are "cheaper" options, expect cheaper service . This place was worth the money. Thank you!

I would give this place ZERO stars if I could.  We stayed only one itchy night at this place. Turns out there were bed-bugs all over our room. We had to treat all of our clothes and luggage. It took weeks to get rid of the infestation!!!
This place is horrible. Don't go near it!
The food here was aweful!  The meat was over cooked and tuff.  Staff was rude and very ignorant.  Not much appreciation for their customets!

amazing service 10/10 recommend going there!!! they were beyond nice and actually talked to me goodness i felt at home! they give you your own stuff to bring home and back and wow they make your nails look so amazing!

Great food, terrible service. Two days in a row I've called to place an order. Without saying hello they immediately place the phone down and do not return. Over FIFTEEN MINUTES yesterday, before I gave up. Called later to speak to a manager to which I was told none were available.

Followed by calling back and continuous ringing.

Today I just gave up after ten minutes.

Really terrible customer service and the food made both me and my friend sick!!! It's loud and obnoxious and too expensive... they could definitely use a revamp. It's nice that it's connected to the bowling ally and games and they have us $10 in free play so that was nice but still wouldn't eat here again.

Sandwiches were delicious but the side dishes were a little wimpy. Also the price for 2 sandwiches and 2 small sides was about 22.00 dollars. If your looking to clear your wallet on a delicious samdwhich this is the place for you!

Sent a "Deluxe" arrangement with Lilies and Roses to my wife for our anniversary and had then sent to her office.  What looked great on the website was completely different than what she received; a few small Lilies and Baby Carnations in a plastic vase! No roses at all.  Hardly "comparable quality and equal value"!  I was embarrassed of the bouquet that Meridian Floral sent! $50 wasted -  will not us MF again!!

Finally decided to use our Amazon local deal and try it. We went on a Monday evening and it wasn't very busy. It is definitely a strange set up when you walk in. Stranger were the three guys who were screaming f bombs every few minutes while playing darts and games in the bar area near the front. Even if I wanted to come back, I don't think I'd bring my daughter back here to this supposedly kid friendly place.

We waited well over thirty minutes for a personal pizza and a calzone. I passed the time by watching the other people looking miserable during their wait and listening to new swear words being yelled out from the front. The buffalo pizza was interesting and wasn't horrible although my wife said the crust tested like a communion cracker. My calzone was easily the nastiest I have ever had the misfortune of trying. Thick under cooked doughy crust with a drippy water sauce leaking out of it.  Too bad the watery sauce didn't have any taste too it. There was some kind of strong rosemary garlic taste in the crust that made me forget how doughy it was but unfortunately it made the taste worse.

Service was not very good either. One of those times you feel like you wasted a dinner out. I actually feel like they owe me money for trying their nasty food and wasting an hour and a half of my life. I will never be back.

Flew into Boise late for a business gig and this was one of the only places open after 10pm so there we landed, great food and service, awesome burgers  and huge nacho plate and washed it down with a few beers till closing I'll be back to this place.

Front staff is friendly.  Nurses are competent and quick.  

We originally met with Dr. Peterman as my friend, a mother of 4, highly recommended him.  There was nothing wrong with him, we just feel pediatricians should be a little bit more "warm" than he was.  

We asked to switch providers and they scheduled us with Dr. Beauchaine.  She saw our infant before we left Boise, and we returned to her when we came back to Boise.  We are happy with her.  She seems caring while still remaining professional.  She addresses all of our concerns without making us feel silly about them. 

We've never had any issues scheduling and the wait times didn't seem any longer than at any other clinic.  I think people have an unrealistic expectation of appt times.  If the patients before you need more time in an appt than scheduled, then yes, yours is going to be delayed; that's just how it is.

I have to say where can you go to bowl, eat food, drink and it's all relatively cheap. I got the turkey burger and it was so good my husband got the halibut burger and he said it was amazing. We bowled three games and they were very cheap we had a blast. Our server was great. In between serving the servers bowl and I'll tell you the servers can bowl like nothing I've seen (but nobody's going to invite me to their league anytime soon lol) This place is a good family.

Our experience at John's Auto was simply the best.  We were in the middle of a cross country trip and in need of a smart, accurate and quick (and reasonable) diagnosis of our vehicle's trouble.  Kevin at John's Auto Care was incredibly professional, kind, and so helpful.  Their space (including their restrooms!) was really clean and inviting.  They let us keep our travel trailer which we were hauling, in their lot for several days as we figured out our best options for moving forward with our trip.  We can't say enough out about Kevin's great customer service, the smart and helpful technicians and their quick and accommodating business style.  We are incredibly grateful that we worked with John's Auto and Kevin was so kind and accommodating.

This place needs a thorough cleaning. First thing I did was use the restroom and it was awful. Urine all over the pot and floor, toilet so filthy it has a thick scum ring around it. Overlfowing trash. They have a soap dispenser, but it was empty...so they had a bottle of dial soap on the sink...also empty of soap--but filled with water. That'll get ya clean! Not. The paper towel dispenser was empty, but the wet roll of towels sat atop it. The light switch looked to be covered in either gravy, baby food, or you-know-what. I cringed as I went towards the counter. Praying that those who would be making my sandwich hadn't used the restroom yet that day.
I walked out to meet my husband in line and by this point I'm seeing this place through a whole new set of eyes. Behind the bar there are stacks of dirty dishes, once I saw the guy grabbing a dirty bowl to reuse, we bounced. Come one guys. Pull it together. My husband loves this place but after seeing what we saw, I have no idea how you're still in business.

I didn't look these guys up on Yelp until after we had eating (because I wanted to give them a nice review).  I'm pretty surprised at its low rating (seriously, Denny's and Burger King have a better overall rating...come on, people.)  I almost gave them a 5-star rating just to bring up the average. 

I had the veggie burger and it was very flavorful and a unique combination that I really enjoyed.  My toppings were fresh and the sauces are fantastic.  The menu is huge, but I love the unique options that they offer.  I gave in and had the fries - seasoned nicely, a little crispy (like I like) - nice little addition.  The hubby had a more traditional style cheeseburger with lots of toppings and he was a very happy fellow.  It is a little pricey, but it was worth ti to us for something really tasty and unique.  

We will definitely be back.

Very impressed by this place. Had the bbq bacon burger with onion rings. The burger was really good. But the onion rings were phenomenal. Unfortunately the serve Coke instead of Pepsi but I can look past that. The fry sauce and ranch are both very good as well. Not sure if it's made in house but I think it is. Definitely try this place... They do have a veggie burger for vegetarians.

I just like this place when I'm in town visiting relatives.    Food is good and I always get a good meal.   It's very consistently good.   

Every time I'm in town I'll be back for a meal.    Thanks!

Solid three star place that is a very small and local restaurant.  Simple menu with good food and great service.  The food is not something that is craveable and would excite you enough to return.  I will say the service was excellent.  I would suggest that you give the place a try.
This is my go to nail place, never had a bad experience.  I'm not the only one who thinks so, so make an appointment if possible.  But they do take walk ins.  Yuki is my favorite, ask for her!
Great food, great service. Good variety of options on the menu. Define recommend for a burger joint in a budget. The only reason I give it three stars is because it's a chain.

New in town and checking out some of the top rated local places- this one is a huge winner! Owners, workers, all so friendly. The sandwiches were AMAZING! My husband said it was his favorite meal of the week (we've tried almost everything everywhere in town this whole week). Best part was the potato salad- we waited for some to get finished and it was so worth it, I could eat that stuff at every meal. My kids (toddlers and preschoolers) ate all their food! My 6 year old polished off a BLT (these sandwiches are huge!) and we tried the California club and the #16 (most famous sandwich there) and they were killer. Our new favorite neighborhood eat for sure! Can't wait to come try more!
Worst food Mexican food ever! Service wasn't that great either. Definitely won't be going back.

Tacos are more than delicious. Had the steak and eggs and pulled pork. The steak and eggs is by far one of the best tasting tacos I have had to date. You can't beat 2.00-2.50 a taco for the size. The sides are good portions also. Only thing that fell short was the chips we ordered came out in very small smashed pieces. If it wasn't for that it would have been 5 stars.

I had a tough hot chocolate spill. Hot chocolate that just happened to be several days old! After the spill, I made a mistake by trying to have it shampooed out, which I did not know makes things worse! In-depth came out the next morning and so far so good! It was quick, and the awful curdled milk smell has not returned! Muriel was very personable and more importantly, knowledgable with a great attention to detail!

I've been to The Counter a few times now and I must say that the food is excellent. Burgers can be completely customizable with more toppings, sauces, bun options and sides than you can possibly imagine. Watching your carbs? You're not limited to just lettuce wrapped burgers - you can also have your burger in a large, fresh salad.

What is not excellent about The Counter is the service. Every time I have been here, the service has been the same - terribly slow. I'm not sure why it takes 45 minutes to an hour to cook a burger and fries, but that's the consistent timing at The Counter, no matter how busy the restaurant may or may not be.

I'm sure I'll be back to The Counter in the future - I'll just remember to bring a book with me for the wait and make sure that I'm not starving...
No! Just no. The two girls in there were snotty, unintelligent and done right unpleasant. The pretzel was WAY TOO salty! Not fresh and not good.

Worst motel ever! Should of went to an Air BnB! Only have full size beds! Seriously???? The staff girl was not gonna help one bit! Apparently third party reservations are doodoo to them! The gal that checked us in was nice. The other gal not helpful at all! She clearly has no gift of At least the AC works. Priceline, think you lost a customer!

Nightmare situation after thinking this would be a calming experience for my dog who hates getting groomed. The groomer was cold from the start, they were playing loud rock music in the car while working (seriously?!?!?), I am pretty sure they didn't bathe my dog, he smelled funky, they injured his foot, had another nick from the shaver, was given a horrendous grooming overall. There is no question my dog was traumatized by the ordeal. I like the concept of the business but the employees need to be trained up. I could care less about being reimbursed or the cost just wanted a nice experience for my dog and they failed in every way possible. I never give bad reviews but felt obligated to do so.
My panini was soggy. The bathroom was filthy. I ordered 1/2 dozen cinnamon rolls to go. They are dry. This was my first and last visit

Went to Kneaders the day before Thanksgiving and the place was packed at 2:30 in the afternoon.  Several lines people were ordering lunch and a ton of others were getting baked goods for Thanksgiving.  I can see why...I had lunch and it was great and when it comes to baking there is someone with serious baking skills making some really good stuff.  I had a chocolate brownie that was to die for and I am getting the munchies just writing about it.   It really shows that if your a really great restaurant you can do well during hard times because you are that good.   Kneaders is that place.
Apparently it no longer matters that you have a no soliciting sign.. Still rang door bell and left a flyer.
Chicken was bland.  Beef looks like it was squeezed out of a tube.

Oh man, talk about trying a sample of something and then craving nothing but that place... that's what Cacicia's will give you. You just want to go back for more, more MORE! And go back I will! 

Food: Their Village location might not seem to fancy, but don't be fooled. Their homemade food is amazing and so rich and tasty. We tried their alfredo and it was like indulging in hot, cheesy, garlic, cream love. I may taste the garlic for days, but it was SO WORTH IT. 

Drinks: TRY THEIR ITALIAN HOT CHOCOLATE/COCOA. Oh my gosh! It's made with the heaviest, most decadent ingredients but it's truly heaven on earth. I think I'd rather have a cup of that cocoa over an ice cream or cake dessert any day of the week. It's served in an 8oz cup, and trust me, that's plenty. It's SO GOOD, so thick, and so heavenly. Think hot, melted brownie batter. It's that good, if not better. 

Atmosphere: To be honest, I think the atmosphere is the only part where I feel let down! And it's not Cacicia's fault. It's that it's located in a window-walled tiny spot in The Village at Meridian. If you like to people watch, you'll love it. If you like cozy, it's not quite the place. But hey, to each their own.

Service: Cacicia's EXCELS at service. You'll often find the owner behind the counter and taking your order AND making your food. He's a rockstar and not only will he hand-prepare your meal, he'll often let you sample something to see if it's up your alley. Win/win.

Happy Hour Offerings: None that I'm aware of, though they do have a daily special. Check the board for listings!

Healthy Hack: n/a, but if you like healthy, do NOT order the Italian Hot Chocolate :) 

Tips: TRY THE ITALIAN HOT CHOCOLATE. It's like hot, melted brownie batter.

A gem of a deli just off Overland. Very fresh sandwiches and soup that rival any big city deli that I've been in. The Reuben is just right!!! Worth making the trip. They have counter service but we took out and the order was put together quickly.

At least 3 times I have gone to Fat Guys and walked out saying, "That is the best sandwich I've ever had."  

Chef Wally is a great guy, and has made this deli my favorite place to have lunch in the Boise/Meridian area.

I recommend the soup.  All of them.  Best soup ever!

Came here several times and had a good experience each time. Their Brussels sprouts are amazing, salads are huge, and pizza is great! Service is always quick and attentive. Love the small casual atmosphere here!

I live near this location so in the past when I have needed a quick meal, I have stopped in to fuel up. Unfortunately I won't be doing so again. Customer service here isn't very good. Management needs to step up here and either let some people go, or start fresh with new training all together. They are slow. They aren't very cognizant of their guests. And they don't take initiative when they see that something needs to be done. 

Every time I have come in at least two of their food items are low or out. The Veggies!!! Every. Single. Time!!! If I am eating at a place like this I want grilled veggies. And they never have any cooked. At my list visit they had the typical one grilled onion and green pepper left. They will always ask if they can prepare more for you. But when I said yes, the cooked it for 10 seconds and I essentially had raw veggies thrown into my burrito. Not good. 

So this time, seeing that the veggies were again out, I asked the woman making my burrito. "Why is it that you never have veggies grilled? I've been in here 5 or so times and every time they are out". Her response: "oh yeah, they are always really popular" .....

Seriously? Well then pay attention to the rate at which they are depleting and be prepared to make them more frequently so that you can keep up with demand.  

There are many other quick Mexican places like this nearby, and I'll be sticking with the others from now on.

This is the nail salon you've always dreamed of!  The nail techs listen to your input, they take their time and do meticulous work, the owner is always checking out new products and techniques to bring his customers the best, it's clean and comfortable, and reasonably priced!  I LOVE this salon.  I've been to many nail salons in many cities and this one stands out for the amazing customer service.  I also highly recommend Vi.  He does great gel polish and is skilled with free hand designs as well.
Love this place, great spot for visitors to the state to enjoy Idaho products cooked to perfection
This place is incredible with arguably the best burgers in Idaho. If you like minis then you'll love the mini mash up like I do. Five star service. Five star people. And five star food!

I had an excellent 3 night stay at this Hampton. Rooms are large and clean. The beds are some of the best hotel beds I've ever slept in. The bathroom is double the size of an average hotel bathroom. It has an above average breakfast well stocked and fresh. The location is very convenient to jump on hwy 84 or eagle road. 
The only negative thing I could come close to mentioning is the TV was a little smaller than I would prefer, not small but not huge.

Love the coffee at dutch bros! this location is always extra friendly as is almost every dutch bros location. Sometimes a little to friendly in the mornings lol. Always great coffee occasional dollar coffee days are nice except the line gets so long!
Aussie Pet Mobile did an amazing job! We will be using their services regularly, the quality and convenience are great.

WOW! We went with a friend that said we would love it. She was right! We had 7 kids there between us. Each of them were treated with respect. We were checked on many times and anything we asked for -- they worked with us. 

As for the food -- OH MY GOODNESS! My oldest made her own burger. It was gone! I had the Sonoma with a different vinaigrette and rare. Best thing I ate on my visit to Idaho! Yummmm-mmm-mmmy! The hubby liked his, as well. Our 3yo even ate without too much of a fuss. Our 1yos ate there, too. They loved the applesauce. Win-win!

I am a huge fan of Thai food (and I'm from Seattle where the Thai is usually top-notch), and this place has yet to disappoint me in my probably 30 visits. The Panang Curry is absolutely to die for. The service is always great, and tonight was no exception even though they were packed. Our waters were refilled constantly and our waitress was back frequently to check on us. I love that they offer both steamed and fried tofu in the dishes, as some places only serve it fried, which I'm not a huge fan of. The food is always fresh, the dishes are seasoned well, and the menu selection is immense (lunch less so, but it's still good for me). The portions are plentiful, and orders are served quickly. Worth the trek to Meridian to eat here!

I ordered a kale salad, knowing I was taking a risk at a burger place.  It was one of the worst salads I have ever had and I should have returned it.  Instead I ate most of it, removing the yellow and unsightly pieces of kale.  There was cabbage mixed with some dressing and tiny pieces of feta cheese at the bottom of the bowl.  The top had some kale but immediately upon seeing it I knew it was bagged salad that looked like it had not been washed and it had no dressing on it.  There were a few pieces of jicama on the side-that was the best part of the salad. I asked for more dressing and it was a thick tasteless substance, nothing like the "lemon vinegarette" on the menu.  One server asked me if I liked it.  I said it was just ok reluctantly, but she didn't ask anything further.
The service was friendly, but I left disappointed, having paid $9 for the salad.  After reading the other reviews now, I can see I am not alone in feeling that the food is rather tasteless.  Sorry to write a bad review, but it's time for Idaho restaurants to serve fresh, tasty food, especially at these prices!

We were so excited to come here after reading all the reviews. We took my husband's uncle and his new fiancée here to welcome her to the family. We started with the fried green beans; salty but not wholly unpleasant. Beans still had a snap to them. I got the inside and out grilled cheese with a Caesar, hubs got the Cubano with fries, my mom got the gnocchi with chicken, and uncle and his fiancée split the half chicken. Grilled cheese was mediocre; the cheese inside was barely melted and the bread was tough. The Cubano was decent, but too sweet with the bread and butter pickles. Uncle and fiancée enjoyed their chicken, but the famous gnocchi was the worst offender. It was supposed to be "sautéed" but it was burned - blackened. The waitress suggested we cut it off because it was so good otherwise. No apologies. 

Manhattan was bitter and the Moscow mule was weak. Super disappointed overall.

The TV didn't work, room smelled like cigarettes, looked nothing like the website photos, no elevator in either building.  

Thomas Mitchell the GM was not willing to help me at all and said there was no one he could or would refer me to.

Visited this morning for the first time after hearing good things. Told the cashier it was our first time. Cashier was bored beyond belief, certainly didn't want to be at work. Ordered the French toast, oatmeal, 2 coffees and a cookie. French toast was good. Oatmeal was cold and came without milk. Coffee and cookie did not come. Asked if there was milk for oatmeal, answer was, no we don't do that. Had to buy a cup of milk for the cold oatmeal. Had to ask for the cookie . All in all, we were not impressed with the cashier and the food.
Love the food, especially the garlic fries. Hostesses and wait staff are very friendly. We have never had to wait long to be seated even during busy times.

I love this place. I have been several times and have had great food and great service each and every time. 
Prices are right on with the quality of food you get. If you want lower prices, you'll get a lower quality of product. Want a unique or typically more expensive cheese? Expect to pay a little more. Want a protein that is of higher quality or has less demand? Expect to pay a little more.  Expect to get higher quality for a slightly higher price point.

I don't really want any of you to know about this place as it's the best in the Boise area. The sandwiches blow ALL the competition out of the water. 

Get the PC Pedro with an extra scoop of potato salad. 

Now they just need to open up downtown (at least closer than way the hell out on Overland) so i can blow more of my money (and my waistline) on their food.

Caveats: If you go at a busy time expect to wait a bit ... they are busy.  If you want a cheap, crap sandwich don't go here.

No wonder why is so Manny bed review worst experience at the counter burger very bad service 
I and my family stop by to have dinner today we got to Oder our food  one hour leader some rude person came to our table to ask me what I want after I asked my survey for my order 
Did not apologize for longer times  we was waiting 
I will never go back to this restaurant

Best local deli, not only for the food. The service is excellent and they seem to always be happy. 

Highly recommend fries with your yummy sandwich. They coat them with a similar coating to the fried chicken. 

My only suggestion is local art in the walls would improve the deli design.

It was great how much time the sales associate spent with me. All of the questions and options she provided got me the most comfortable shoes I've ever worn. I'm a customer for life thanks to the outstanding customer service and variety of products you offer.

I was invited out on a work lunch with a large group of people, and the Ram was the destination.  I ordered a Hillbilly burger, which was pretty decent.  Pretty typical pub burger and fries, cooked well done.  The service was great, and since I didn't have to pay, price was not a factor today.  I don't know if the burger warrants a return trip here, but it wasn't bad either.  Ok place for quick lunch.

[  Last night was rough. I dreamed I was a muffler...
I woke up exhausted.  ]

THIS WAS A GREAT EXPERIENCE !!!! Ke'Shana is AMAZING !!! this was my first haircut since moving to Boise from Huntington Beach,  Ca. and I can't wait to go back !!! Ke'Shana knew exactly what to do with my hair and im soooooooooooo in love with the cut she gave me. She. Is. A. Rockstar. For sure :-) next stop: colortown #KeShanaRocks !!!!!

New Owners & they are fabulous!   I have followed Janna to many studio's because of her awesome attention to detail & artistry in doing nails.  Finally she & her husband bought their own place! You will not be disappointed!  They are great people & give attention to each and every customer that comes thru the door.
The atmosphere and  service was nice also the prices where reasonable, but the food was bland and the meat was dry tasted like it was out of a can.

I have been driving by every day and finally made it here for dinner.
We sat at the bar and I was impressed about the girls knowledge about beers, she certainly knew the beers and details. We tried a flight of beers which were all brewed locally and were all tasty. We settled for a pint of IPA and Porter.
We had the Parmesan Crusted Haddock Fillet and a Ahi Tuna Melt sandwich. Both were delicious however the croquettes on the Parmesan Crusted Haddock Fillet were a little to large and not fully cooked through. I would suggest to make small cylinder shaped croquettes instead of these huge balls. Makes them easier to fry.
Over all it was a very pleasant visit with friendly staff and nice atmosphere.
We will be back for sure!

Had a fun lunch today at their Grand Opening with Dad.

We both had pulled pork sandwiches and enjoyed them very much.   They were served without sauce, and mine was tasty & juicy enough to eat plain.  Dad tried both the regular and the sweet sauces and liked them both.

I'm putting Chick-fil-A on notice right now... the waffle fries at Dickey's are just as good if not better.  YUM!   Mine were hot and fresh, and salted just right.   Dad enjoyed the only one I was willing to share with him.

Dad chose the Fried Onion Tanglers as his side.   They were nice & light "onion straw" type onions.  I found the batter a little too spicy for me.

Nice, big 32 oz. cups and do-it-yourself sodas.  Also, they have free ice cream!   Near the drink machine is an ice cream cone dispenser and an ice cream machine.   They also have little cups and spoons if you'd rather.

Interior is rustic and western-looking.   Nice, heavy distressed wood tables and chairs.    Big screen TV's -- one was on news and the other on ESPN.   If you'd rather do take-out, there's a convenient drive-through window.

We were worried about the service since it was their Grand Opening, but they were Johnny-on-the-spot about everything.   Even district manager Barry was out among the customers grabbing take-home bags and helping out with a smile.

Stopped in on a whim with my friend and her two teenage boys after visiting Linder Farms.  They were short staffed.. but you know.. we weren't in any hurry so we chatted.  Good things come to those who wait.  While it took some time, all of our food arrived hot and well prepared.  We had not one single complaint. It helped to that it was obvious the staff was doing the best they could- AND they maintained a good attitude the entire time.  This is more of a 'fly by' that a full on review I know. However I want to put it out there that sometimes in our run run run lives it's worth it to just relax and let things happen.  This was one of those events for my friends and me.

We've stopped in twice and each time left happy and full. I'm surprised this restaurant doesn't have higher reviews. The Olympus Steak Salad is particularly good- I substitute the steak with chicken. Concerned with paying $13.50 for a salad? Don't be. The quality and quantity (I split this with my guest and both portions were larger individually than you'd receive in whole at other restaurants. Dishes to mention: appetizer of the pretzels and beer cheese 'fondue'.  Dessert: ice cream cupcakes. 

I'm more concerned with the food than service at an establishment, but what a treat when both are dead on. Our servers have been attentive, genuine, and great with recommendations!

Place is awesome! They have like six different kinds of fries :) their burgers are great too. Gluten free buns!! Specialty burgers like elk burgers are on their menu as well. A must go if in Boise or meridian.
I love DK Donuts. It's good food and very original recipes. It's also a wonderful family run business that I love to support. Kudos for this local business doing great.

This will now be one of my favorite burger joints to eat. They have a wide variety of healthy and unhealthy food options, the food is flavorful and good quality, the value is decent, and service was good. 


So, the first time and second time I came here, I was not impressed. The biggest problem I had was service; it was incredibly slow even though it wasn't that busy. However, after the owner reached out to the Yelp community to show that he's been making improvement, I decided to try it again. This time I had a good experience. The menu is simplified with a few good options. The service had improved significantly, which allowed me to notice how good the food was.

They have a variety of options for traditional burgers, gluten free, vegetarian, etc. The side dishes consists of a variety of options including fries as well as quinoa salad. The quinoa salad is great tasty healthy dish that's also very filling.

The place is located in the Village, so the atmosphere is nice. The restaurant has an interesting combination of modern/classic resulting in a pleasant experience.

DO NOT STAY HERE!!! My 69 yr old mother, booked a room directly with the hotel, prepaid with her debit card and received a confirmation number. Upon arrival, she had no reservation and the front desk personnel was EXTREMELY rude to her! The woman was not willing to look at her records, showing the transition from the hotel, showing the payment. When my mother stepped outside to make a phone call, the clerk ran my mothers debit card 9 MORE TIMES! This completely drained her account. The woman also stated she needed to pay a $50 security deposit, which could be cash. WTF? My mother never did get a room and thankfully had some family to stay with. We were all traveling to Boise, for my grandfathers, my mothers fathers, memorial. My mom will be seeking legal advice to find out of this was a fraudulent situation!

I would rate the beer average at best.  The service was good for a Sunday lunch crowd.  The food is mediocre to poor and way over priced.  Tablerock or Bittercreek are better choices downtown for both food and beer.
Had the silver duck and the Italian, the silver duck is a must have! Unique and delicious sand which. I like the $9.95 menu.
Everything is delicious every time I visit I try a different sandwich. I am not sure who the guy is but he is super friendly and humorous. Best sandwiches in the valley
Love this place, particularly when Lindz waits on us.  She is a such a delight, and the food is excellent. Branched out this time from a burger and had a BLTA. Wow! It was yummy!

You can always count on delicious food, good service, great drinks, awesome bowling and fun games. You can easily spend multiple hours bowling, eating, drinking & playing games. Great for all ages. Weekends are always extremely busy, so try to go on a weekday. Prices can get expensive, but you get what you pay for. There isn't a better bowling alley in town!
Great food and the owner is a very friendly guy. I have already told a lot of people about it.  Try the blue bronco

I had Steve upgrade interior and exterior of two buildings in California before he moved.  He and his crew did a wonderful job and for a very fair price.  I'd definitely love to have him back here in So Cal!  So, if you are in Boise area and need upgrades, maintenance, additions, or whatever you might want for your home, give Steve a buzz!

This place is one of my FAVES. I never have a bad meal there. I have only eaten at this location in Boise, ID and I live in San Diego. Not sure if they are on the west coast but I have not seen them. 

Their food is fresh and delicious. They make their breads and pastries fresh in house daily. 

When I was there this last time I ordered an artichoke chicken panini with tomato basil soup and it was excellent. Warm, crispy, amazing. I also had a lemon muffin top for dessert but a friend had the double chocolate chunk brownie. This was my Grandma's favorite dessert when she would come so I think that's what I'll have to order from here on out. 

I've also had a few other sandwiches but I can't recall what they were called - only eat here when I visit. Also, they have the CUTEST section for gifts and cards and things. I bought like 4 things on my last trip and spent more on gifts than on food! Haha. 

Anyway, do yourself a favor and go to Kneaders. You won't regret it!

Always so yummy and the staff are funny and thoughtful. We love all the salt and sauce choices! Purple potatoes and Laura's are the best, and Okinawas if available!! The burgers are fresh and on point! We love this place and visit way too often
Great place for families and just adults. Something for everyone. Tough to get in for bowling, very popular! If you're hungry, there's the restaurant grill. Pool or shuffleboard at the bar!
One of the best custom burger joints I've ever been to.  You will never feel a lack of options when you go here (unless you don't want a sandwich or fries).

Never disappointed. Definitely a different feel than most burgers and fries I get, but that's why I like them so much. Everything is unique and you can customize both burgers and fries. They use high quality ingredients. I LOVE the purple potato fries and my husband is a fan of the sweet potato fries. We've tried most, if not all, of the dipping sauces and we love 'em all.

The fries were average, the burger was good, the fried green beans were fantastic and the peach ginger lime basil drink...OMG,  nectar of the gods.  I felt comfortable in the warm visually appealing dining area.  The person that took our order was friendly and patient with my son who was being a pain.  We will be back.

This is truly the beat thia food in the treasure valley. All of their food is fresh and made from scratch each and every day. They also have amazing sushi with a chef who knows what he is doing. The staff they have is always helpful and really know the menu by heart. Always very fun to talk to and  even remember what i had last time. If your looking for amazing food for a good price then this is the spot.

So first off this review has no info about the food . So I called at 5:30 and asked if they were  reservation only. The young man that answered said it's preferred. So I said can I make a 630 reservation?  He said if you arrive by 6:00 we should be able to get you in by 630 at least. We arrived at 5:50 and put our name on the list. Waited 1 hour and asked what was the update and they could not tell me . If you think you can't seat six or need to split up just tell the customer. With no estimation of time after one hour we just decided to leave. I do not mind being told no, but I do not like to have my time wasted by poor organization. Had one cocktail. It was fine.

I've now lost count of how many times I've stayed here.  This year alone has been three times.  I have never had a problem with this hotel.  The staff has always been friendly and helpful.  Every receptionist I've dealt with here has been professional, more than willing to answer questions, and displayed a cheerful attitude.

The rooms have always been clean and comfortable.  Never had a problem with noise.  The complementary breakfast has been fine.  

Next time I visit Meridian I'll staying here once again.

One of the very best meals I have ever had. Incredible service. I had the bison burger with a variety of vegetables and a couple of sauces. Wonderful. The server noticed I was stressed out and engaged me in conversation and asked if I was ok.

Love this restaurant. Great food, great veg options, the staff are usually friendly. Only had a couple visits where I had to deal with a snotty waitress. Most of the time, the waitress staff here are quite nice. The prices are a bit high and the wait times are quite long even when they aren't busy, but the great food and customization options make it worth the wait. Would recommend to anyone not in a hurry.

BIRTHDAY RUINED

We had my birthday dinner here at 6:15p last night-just three of us and a baby and everything was great...until our waiter forgot about us after he served our entrees!  We sat there with empty glasses, dirty plates for almost 40 minutes while he talked with a couple at the bar...then he went thru the kitchen and we never saw him again!  My daughter never got her side salad she ordered. They weren't busy-our waiter only had two tables.  The other waiter finally cleared my plate as he passed by. Our food, otherwise, was delicious...oh and when my husband ordered another IPA after our appetizers, our waiter served him the wrong beer.  The waiter did switch it out for him.

I had planned on another cocktail and dessert but we were totally abandoned!!!  For 40 MINUTES we sat there!!!

We needed to get home to get the baby to bed by 8:30p and my family wanted at least to get me ice cream somewhere since we never were offered dessert options at Grant's.  My daughter finally took the baby to the car and I flagged down a waitress at 8:05p to get our bill.  She kept apologizing, but frankly, it ruined my birthday dinner!  She had to adjust our bill since he charged us for three beers when we only had two.  My husband was torn about leaving a tip since we sat there for 40 minutes waiting for our waiter but we had appreciated the appetizer sample he had offered at the beginning AND the steaks were fantastic.  I had saved my "calories" for that meal and dessert.  Kinda grumpy about it.

Bottom line?  Started out great-food was fantastic and well-seasoned and prepared...but the service went DOWNHILL AND FAST!!!  Please don't forget about your customers or they'll never come back no matter HOW good the food is!!!

I have been a here few times since they opened in Meridian based on all the positive reviews on yelp and their rabid following in the Boise area. They have super friendly service and are always willing to give menu suggestions. They offer more than just burgers and fresh condiment bar which is a nice touch if you dining in for lunch/dinner.  It's so hard to give burger places a rating in Boise there are just so many; seems like one is opening up every week claiming to be better than all the rest. I have found the charbroiled cheese burgers (which does add a nice touch to the burger) to be a little on the bland side; just didn't wow me or form a habit in me to come back every week as their name suggests. I did enjoy the onion rings (you can tell they are made fresh each day no frozen onion rings here); I would definitely get those above their fries any day. If I was to go back for a burger; it would be for the onion rings. The fries were the often used stick fries; small and little too crispy for me. I know this place has a huge following (there is usually a crowd when I have gone there) but I didn't really taste it in the food; nothing seemed to separate from the other guys in town not to mention the drive across town to Meridian. If your in the village area shopping or checking out a movie and in your the mood for a burger this isn't a bad destination I just think there are better options in Boise and Meridian for that matter some pretty close to the village.

This place is definitely one of the better Mexican food spots I've tried in Idaho!  

Pros: The outstanding service! From sit down to leaving the servers were prompt, friendly, and knowledgeable.  They always made sure drinks were full and answered all our questions.  THE GUAC!  I honestly had a to say their tableside guacamole rivals even Barbacoa's!  Amazingly fresh and a sizeable portion for the price. A must order!  Food was delicious and made quickly and of course we loved the salsa and beans they brought out as an appetizer.  

Cons: The women's bathroom is very tiny and can be difficult to navigate if you're a bigger person.  But that being said, there's no other cons i can think of!

Be sure to scope this place out when you get your next Mexican food craving!

This was our first trip to Hugo's, and we haven't been to any of the other locations. 

It's a small place but it was clean and friendly. You walk in, check out the menu boards, order and sit. Tip: the static menu boards on the wall to the left have less options than the electronic menu boards above the counter, so be sure to look at the electronic ones for more options.

Cashier was friendly, and her suggestion of the sourdough roll for my turkey sandwich was spot on. My wife ordered the pilgrim (without cream cheese) and I got a "build your own" turkey with all the basics. We opted to share a medium fries on the cashier's suggestion and got two small drinks. It was about $21.

They offer a spicy, horseradish based ketchup and a spiced fry sauce at the DIY counter with the soda machine, and that's about it. Both are good, but I wasn't quite as impressed as others seem to be.

The sandwiches came quickly (but not too quick- they were freshly made quickly and not just stuff sitting around!). My wife really enjoyed the Pilgrim and my turkey was delicious. It has a great meat to bread and veggie ratio, plenty of mayo, and I enjoy the shredded the lettuce on my deli sandwiches. The fries were piping hot, and they are very big. They are thick cut, and I assume dredged in a flour coating (not my favorite), and the insides are soft and full of potato flavor. I would ditch the coating but that's a personal flavor preference, and they need salt but otherwise they were very tasty. Contrary to my normal, I would have preferred a normal mayo or ketchup and mayo to their sauces but it was fine with what they had or even just plain if you sprinkled a touch of salt on them.

Sandwiches were nicely sized and we didn't finish the medium fries even sharing, so a decent value option. Relaxed and low key, with simple and healthy options, we plan to bring the kids back with us next time we want to stop for lunch while we are out and about. A good, solid lunch location!
This place has great sushi and the restaurant is gorgeous! It's an awesome place for a lunch or dinner date! The staff are also very polite and good about coming by to see if you need anything.

If you want a great pizza with the BEST crust, Marco's is the place! Super friendly staff and the place is clean! We ordered the Delux XL and the cheesy bread. The Cheesy bread came out first -done to perfection, crispy and hot! It is so good and a meal in its self! The pizza came out a short time after and was also cooked to perfection! The crust is crispy and cooked through. The flavor is excellent. Not too much sauce. The other pizza joints can not get the crust right. Marco's did it up! I highly recommend this place.
