The turn time was pretty quick, too. The staff was friendly, pleasant and accommodating. Finally! A pizza joint like back home! Get some! Delish!

Awesome atmosphere and insane selection.  I personally recommend going with the big pot to share.  They do offer coconut milk if you prefer.  Would make a fun first date instead of the traditional drinks or coffee date.  Sit on the couches and play a game of chess.  This is definitely a place I would recommend.  I can't wait to try them all.

Finally a Thai restaurant in the Treasure Valley that I enjoy. I didn't eat here this evening but I wanted to make sure I gave Sa-Wad-Dee its well-deserved review. The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is because I've had the real deal at home (parent's cooking) and in Thailand. The Pad Thai doesn't quite use the right type of noodles but is the best in the area so far. As our waitress informed us, the dish has more of a southern influence, and I am used to the type served in Bangkok (also what I have experienced at the majority of Thai restaurants in NV and CA).

My only complaint is that the pieces of chicken on the chicken satay and in the Pad Thai were a bit too large/thick. It feels as if you are eating chunks of chicken. The chicken larb was spot on, so if you like lettuce wraps this is what you should get.

What I was most impressed by was that our waitress Brie (sp) spoke Thai, and very well. This wasn't something I had expected from a non-Thai, let alone non-Asian, person.

Overall the service was also wonderful. I will be returning to fulfill my Thai cuisine cravings!

Kneaders is one of those "middle-of-the-road" restaurants; it tries to appeal to every taste and ends up being un-inventive and too safe.  We had a Caesar salad and a Rueben Panini. The salad was mostly lettuce and croutons with a little chicken and a tiny cup of bland dressing. The croutons were stale and the slivers of parmesan cheese were thin and rubbery, as if they had been grated several days ago.  The Panini was just a toasted sandwich...nothing "Panini" about it. The caramelized onions were too sweet and again, it was just bland.
All the pastries in the cases looked fresh and tempting, so this may be more of a dessert shop. Doubt I'll be back...I can find bland anywhere.

This place is named so appropriately because their fries are amazing.  I've tried all the varieties, each with their own unique flavor qualities, and enjoyed them all.  All the different sauce and seasoning options are great too.  The burgers aren't too shabby either but I wouldn't be surprised if people come in just for the fries because they're just so good.

Good, fresh bagels abound. My favorite is the onion bagel with jalapeño cream cheese! They also do fairly good coffees here. The day-old bagel bags are a steal at $2, and still taste pretty darn good compared to the fresher ones. 

One tip, if you like a crisp toasted bagel, have them run it through their toaster twice or you'll end up with too soft a bagel.

Get the bear claws. Don't think about it, just go get one. Happy, sad, celebrating, just go get a donut from this place. The best! The addiction is a slippery slope, so do ensure you have a support group of good friends around you to pull you away after eating too many. Enjoy!

I'm from California so clearly I understand what it takes to make great food.  Dont listen to the reviews from all these local yahoos.  

This place is trendy and hip.  The atmosphere is on point... modern design and a cool crowd.  The tacos taste like they are fresh off a SoCal food truck.  Authentic -- with loads of avocado and vegan options.  They have the most organic, locally sourced PBRs.  

Try the fish tacos.  Baked, not fried, of course.
Where's the beef?  In all seriousness, the overpriced French Dip had very little roast beef.  I did enjoy dipping the baguette into the au jous though.  I will not be back.

Came here to take advantage of instore specials in place of ordering online. I walked in and was just amazed the store was a complete disaster shirts laying unfolded all over the place and on the floor. I was trying to find a shirt I saw online and I had time finding it. I looked never could find a store associate ended up finding it after 20 minutes. The lines to the cashier were super long and the slow cashiers several seemed very new especially the one that helped me. It seemed like it could be easy to apply for a credit card turned out to be a length ordeal. With the holidays approaching might want to do some training and hiring improve their overall store appearance, help customers find items, proceeds credit card applications and ring up customers.

The customer service was not great, they don't volunteer assistance and I stood at the front desk for way too long before someone bothered to ask what I wanted. The breakfast wasn't good, there wasn't much food and it was mostly cold. The rooms don't have fridges so if you go out to eat there's no where to keep leftovers. Also, I left my phone charger there A MONTH ago and have called literally 5 times about getting it mailed to me and every time they have been rude and either found and excuse why it hasn't been sent or said they would get back to me and never did.  Overall unimpressed and pissed about the customer service.
I have been to slot of Thai places in the area this is on the top 2 of my list. The food is excellent!
I love this place really good food and really nice people I hope to come back soon really ez to make sure you get what you want on your food the brisket is sooooo good there and I like their drinks

It's like going home for lunch!  If you go more than once, ur like family - the staff remembered that I like my roast beef well done, and that my husband doesn't want the pickle!  The Trevor Melt is beyond delicious, and the Big Chief is my personal favorite ;)  Great soups, accommodating staff, prices commensurate with quality.

This site had a fire summer 2011 and the restaurant has been renovated and is very nice on the inside now. I just love the Taco Time hot sauce. The crisp meat burritos are excellent here but be warned, this site waters down the hot sauce. They are NOT following the Taco Time restaurant guidelines. The watered down hot sauce earns this site only 3 stars. If you love Taco Time hot sauce, see my review on the site on Fairview, Boise, and other locations that have earned a 5 star review.
We ordered takeout at 6:30 on a Saturday. Out of turkey, chicken and both types of sausage. WTH! Got home, 2.4 miles and all was less than warm. Management, pay attention!

Tin Roof Tacos is usually top notch (Broadway), but the Meridian location had dirty tables and floor. All the bottles of salsa were low and then out. The kid wiped down tables, but wiped down the tables on to the chairs. Food still pretty good, experience just lacked.

Review for the restaurant only.

The Food:
My tri-tip was likely a flank steak as noted in another review. It was neither tender, nor correctly cooked. Taste was below average. The accompanying mashed potatoes with cheese were dry. I'd guess they had been uncovered in a refridgerator for most of the day, and then warmed to order.

My dining partner's chicken lettuce wrap was equally disappointing. The chicken cubes appeared to be reconstituted from something dried - think Mountain House meal that hasn't adequately soaked before eating... no... really.

The vegatables that came with the meals were cooked to a nice crispness and had great seasoning.

The drinks:
Good selection of cold beer. The wine was good, and the after dinner cocktail was tasty.


The service:
Quite good, and what redeems this from a 1-star review. We checked in at the desk and were told there was a 20 minute wait. We went upstairs to get a drink and were texted shortly after. When we learned that our table would be near the bathrooms (I'm not sure why, there were plenty of open tables in a much nicer location), we opted for upstairs. Upon returning, we went right to ordering drinks and dinner. All was well in the service dept.

The advice:
Eat somewhere else. Come over for the bowling, arcade, wide beer selection and drinks.

We won't have dinner there again.

Part of New Years was there decision to be healthier and join a gym. After a lot of research I tried Idaho Fitness Factory. Very convenient, great staff. Eric is a good guy, very personable and helpful. Good mix of equipment and I can always find the right machine for my workout. This is becoming a regular part of my week and I've already lost a few pounds. Thanks Idaho fitness Factory
This is a great salon--it's clean , nicely decorated and tidy.  The new owners have done a great job!

Walked in this morning needing a case that is, well..."me" proof! (I tend to be rough on electronics, by accident!). Pete greeted us and was helpful,knowledgeable and fast. Friendly service and pricing was good. I will be bringing my troubled laptop there soon.

Few notes to keep in mind- bring a debit/credit card as the cash for change is limited. Also, it looks fairly sparse and selection wasn't large but its quality at good pricing. Ask for what you need!

As I've stated before, being blessed () with celiac (gluten allergy), I always appreciate a restaurant that has great gluten free options and the Ram is such a place.
They are currently running their Burgerama promotion which includes about 6 or 8 burgers, on top of their other regular burgers. The most loved burger will become part of the permanent menu after the promotion. I chose the "Guac this Way Melt", which "is made with Applewood smoked bacon, savory garlic roasted mushrooms, freshly made guacamole, Wisconsin Swiss cheese and roasted garlic mayonnaise on our grilled classic marbled rye." (Lifted from https://www.theram.com/news/). Of course I swapped out the rye bread for an Udi's gluten free bun. 
It was an amazing burger!!!
Please bear in mind they do not have a certified gluten free area so there will be cross-contamination, which isn't a huge deal for me.
Our waiter was super friendly and the service was prompt and fast. I was there with four other people.at about 11:30 on a Thursday.

We recently discovered The Habit and enjoy going there for a burger. Their basic burgers and specialty burgers are affordable and delicious! Great value, atmosphere and service. Wish there was one closer to us, we'd go more often:).

The chef is amazing! The fish and chips are out of this world. They made my son a normal grilled cheese which was very kind. 
The only reason I am giving them 4 stars, the cheeseburger was really good but it was anything special, not a a lot of flavor in the meat. 

Other then that- this place is great!

I took my F150 Supercab to get the Ceramic coating on it. I opted to go for the top of the line service. It has been almost 1 month since I had the work done.
The product does NOT perform the way I was told it would. Water beads somewhat but still a lot of work to wash. I have tried four times to reach out to Chris and he tells me nothing is wrong.
I wish that I would have saved the 
$500 and the headache this has become. I  personally do not recommend this service or the so called customer service I haven't received from them. 
Very dissatisfied!

OMG best sandwiches I've had!!!
I got the #16 Trevor Melt, this sandwich rocked!
I would definitely recommend this place to anyone in the area.

I don't know why I ever come here for food. It always lets me down. It's the definition of insanity. I keep hoping for a different outcome. I had gotten the chicken taco salad. The lettuce was so finely chopped that I couldn't pick it up with my fork. It was shredded. The red peppers weren't fresh. They were soggy. Red peppers raw are supposed to have a nice snap to them. These didn't. The cilantro dressing was really good though! Ordered the s'mores Sunday hoping it would be good. It wasn't. The marshmallows weren't even toasted. Super disappointed. The chocolate sauce they used was Hershey's. Nothing wrong with Hershey's, but if I'm paying $8 for this, please make it better. The gram crackers inside the Sunday were also soggy. Couldn't eat it all and left it less than half eaten. I even had someone trying to eat it with me. We both gave up.

Mmmm delicious bagel sandwiches. Same deal as the Boise one--fill up your own Dawson Taylor coffee. 

Got 2 today: a ham and a turkey ($4.95 each). All the veggies / cream cheese / condiments are included in the sandwich price. Which starts at around $4. The onion bagel sat on my desk tempting me into taking an early lunch. 

People work fast and you are in & out in less than 10 min. 

Personally though, I like Panera bread bagels better because the flavor is better.... not sure if Boise has one. But I think the cream cheese at Blue Sky tastes better.
Austin did a great job today helping get me fitted with new shoes. Knowledgeable, positive personality and resourceful.

Great service from Erica tonight. The place was packed and we mistakingly did not make a reservation.  So glad we lucked out and got a table. The food is worth with wait we will definitely be back again!

The tacos were good but I wasn't as impressed with this venue as I am with the one downtown. The variety of tacos that you can get is nice and they are yummy but for some reason I just feel it fall short of the original venue.
Liz is so sweet and friendly and does an amazing job on my lashes! She is very thorough. My lashes always look great, all the way up until my next scheduled, three week fill appointment :).

Not impressed used a shop vac pretty much just wiped the outside cover of the vents. Cleaned the dryer vent?? Knocked the connection off the dryer so now I have to deal with that. Didn't really clean the ducts

Extremely satisfied! Best nail salon I have ever experienced! Called at 5pm hoping to walk in and despite closing at 7 they let me come in at 6:45 for a full set of gel acrylics. When I got there they were super nice and did an amazing job on my nails taking well over an hour. I will defiantly be going back and highly recommend to everyone I know!

Ate at this Mexican restaurant this evening. We were seated fairly quickly considering how busy it was. The service was very good; the waitress was friendly and helpful, checking on us frequently but at good intervals.  We don't like spicy foods and the waitress accommodated us nicely in that respect. The food, however, was very bland.  You can have great flavor profiles using a multitude of seasonings without making the food spicy hot. There was very little flavor in any of our food. The sauce on my burrito tasted like Campbell's tomato soup right out of the can. I'm sure it wasn't as there were pieces of vegetables throughout. The asada steak pieces in the burrito was not seared in a hot pan, so there was practically no flavor to the meat. The refried beans were very runny and, again, had very little flavor. If the food had been anywhere near as good as the service, we probably would go back.

Grabbing some appetizers after a movie!  Maybe get a few beers. Well we will just say not met with open arms.   The waiter was so unhappy we were there he could not hide his disappointment.  Food was ok and well you guessed how the service was.   So sorry we bother you and we won't make that mistake twice.   No hard feeling just won't ever be back.
Great place for a after work bite to eat or meet up with friends.  Good drinks good food. Decent prices with good servers.

Super terrible customer service worker. About 18 and dumb as a pile of bricks, must have been dropped on her head as a child. Other than that, the supervisor is a sack of sh!t. Went to check out the produce and to my dismay none of it was fresh. All mushy, rotten, disgusting. Also Fairview Walmart has rotten produce. In fact I bought a rotten coconut on accident once.

Bowling was nice!  Food is basic and nothing to brag about!  Took the kids up to the arcade....some tickets came out of the machine other times we were told "it went on the card". I think this is a bit of a racket, because we counted up much more than we got when the employee scanned our card....not gonna make a big deal, since they are just typical cheap carnival toys, which is fine....I recommend at the very least, you just keep a total on your end to make sure the kiddos what they deserve!

Downhill! Sad to say, but after our last couple of visits I doubt we will return. The burgers were fine... nothing special and definitely not as delicious as they used to be, but the service on the last visit was AWFUL!  It took FOREVER for the 5 of us to get our meals. The waiter was kind of snarky and didn't seem to care about what he was doing. Someone else delivered the meals... then left. We had no napkins, no utensils... had to flag people down to get these items, which is fine, but its not like the place was busy AT ALL. We placed a dessert order after and at least 30 minutes later... nothing. The waiter finally noticed that we did not have the desserts and asked us about it... ummm... why don't you ask the people in back??? The whole experience was bizarre. Why would you not check on things before that much time passed anyway? Nothing was done to compensate, just a half-assed apology placing blame on the kitchen staff and making sure we knew HE turned it in. We said forget about it and asked for the bill. Just left a bad taste for this place after that experience.

I was so nervous about getting my nostril pierced, but Paul was amazing and put me at ease the second I walked in the door. I've only gotten my ears pierced at the mall, so going to an actual shop was a new experience for me. Paul was so friendly and informative, kindly answering all my questions and explaining everything in detail. 

When it came time to do the actual piercing, he explained the whole process and then talked me through it again while he was actually doing it. It was quick, almost painless, and I felt totally comfortable! I was really impressed with the level of hygiene that was practiced. I will absolutely be going back to Imperial for any other piercings!

Just stopped in here for lunch with my family after shopping at the village. I'm so full and left happy! We were so excited that they had a bunch of gluten free/vegan option since both of my kids have food allergies. I had a custom burger over lettuce (Keto friendly) and I would honestly say it was one of the best burgers I've had in Meridian. My husbands burger looked awesome, and the kids were happy and especially loved their shoestring fries. 
There was a little mess up with our order but the waitress quickly made it right and we appreciated the service. 

I think we found our go to sit-down burger place in Meridian! Now we are going to have to go back for date night and try some shakes...

Seemed like the meat had been in the steam table a bit too long (we ate at 8pm) and the guac was that "Wholly Guacamole" crap with an off flavor. And (apologies to Woody Allen) they didn't give me a full container! 

Go to Chipotle instead; it's only a mile or so down the road.

Don't bother making a appointment you will still wait 45 minutes. Poor and small selection of non gel colors Won't be back, and don't recommend.
I have never been offend by the employees speaking their own language but it was so extreme at this place and the laughing and pointing was outta control. I have never ever not left a tip but this place me and my cousin only paid the $25 no tip. Highly recommend not going here and wasting your money for crappy service!!!
Sa Wad Dee is the best Thai food in Idaho. If you can ask to sit in Derek's section, he is a fantastic server and will exceed your expectations!

The sandwich I ordered was pretty good. The group of friends I came with liked their sandwiches as well. The potato salad was not very good. I do think it's over priced for the size of the sandwiches.

Great atmosphere and delicious food! Expect a short wait because they are usually busy! They have a wide variety of "street tacos" and all are packed with flavor. I ordered three different ones and they were all my favorites! You have to try these!!

Awesome concept. Pricy. Counter dude didn't have any recommendations on his favorite fry. (4/22/16 @2pm) They have 30 different types some guidance could be useful. I want to like it but this is visit two and just a little underwhelmed each time.

I went in to this place a week after getting spider bites done. One of them didn't have a long enough post and the inside of my lip healed over the back. 

The place is decent sized and has a good selection of jewelry. I was greeted right away by the guy at the front.

The wait was a little long but the guy was doing a piercing when I got there. I never want them to hurry MY piercings so I don't expect them to do so for anyone else either. All good. 

Paul was as gentle as he was able to be while digging the post through my healed-over lip. He also made me feel super comfortable as he made small talk. 

The new post was not expensive - $10, and I can come in and get it changed when I need to. If/when I decide to get pierced again, it'll be here. Two thumbs up!

I had been wanting to try this place for a long time as I'm a huge sandwich fan and had heard good things about it. My wife and I went over the weekend and were greatly disappointed. 

It started by us waiting at the register for 2-3 minutes before anyone even acknowledged us. Not too big of a deal by itself, but even a "hey, we'll be right with you," would have been nice. After ordering, it took a good 20-25 minutes for our two sandwiches to be made. Not sure what took so long, but it shouldn't take THAT long to make a couple of sandwiches.

After getting our food, I noticed that mine had mustard on it, which was not listed as an ingredient. I double checked their big menu as well as they take home menus, and it wasn't listed on either one. I had asked for no tomatoes and they did omit those, but had I known it would come with mustard I would have asked to leave that off as well. 

The sandwich itself was okay, certainly nothing special. I ordered the Italian. The potato salad was not good at all. 

I don't mind paying 9 bucks for a sandwich, but when I do, I expect a good sandwich and good service. Here, I received a decent sandwich with lousy service. Not a recipe to get us to come back. Which is a bummer, because I REALLY wanted to like this place.
We continue receiving very good results for grooming our little Maltese dog. He always feels good about himself after being washed and groomed.
I loved their coffee! So so sad to see them go out of business! I will miss them for sure!

Review by me and my 13yr old

Pros:  Fun, lots to do, both generations can go

Cons: Service and cost

Meh:  Food 

13yr olds point of view:

Pros: arcade games are absolutely fun,food is good, and the building is clean and well maintained.
Cons: service is awful and we didn't understand stuff so we went for help and the lady treated us like we were stupid and was no help at all she was being a brat.
Love this place. Will pick up donuts any time i need more than just sugar air! These donuts are quality and worth trying.

You've  probably heard an old saying that says something like "If Mama's not happy, ain't NOBODY happy!"  I would add, "If Mama's FEET aren't happy, ain't no way MAMA'S gonna be happy!!  Well, I've been living that, from one foot or ankle problem ~both actually, my feet have been MISERABLE!! And as retired seniors, hubby & I wanna start a walking regimen for our better health but I need shoes that  are comfortable & fit for a good daily walk.  I had seen ads for "Fleet Feet" store at the Village in Meridian & decided I'd give 'em a try.  So my husband & I drove over there Sunday evening & went in at about 7 p.m., a pleasant young man named Austin, greeted us & we explained our purpose for being there  & he ushered us to a row of comfortable seats where he then had me remove my terribly uncomfortable sneakers & then escorted me the few steps to a 3-D imaging  device on which I stood while he captured the images to then show us once seated again....it was a very cool device for foot measurement!  I always knew that our feet flattened out as we age, & our arches [basically] just collapse under the weight of a life time!  So it isn't just our skin and/or hair that changes, our feet do as well....get 'em properly measured folks!  Austin asked a few pertinent questions related to styles and colors & excused himself to zip into the back & locate some ideas he  had in mind for me.  He returned with 4 boxes of different shoes which he unwrapped & prepped for me to slip on & walk around  the store in. For a variety of reasons, none of the first four worked & after a bit more chatting, we decided I should try a New Balance model.  It is AWESOME.....the shoes are a perfect fit & they're nice looking too! I am NOT an athletic type (wanna be but never was) but I DO love to walk outside in the sun preferably but will take whatever God sends us weather wise & go anyway, if possible.  I am eager to get out there & get healthier!  So to wrap up my too long note here, THANK YOU to Fleet Feet!!  And to their excellent hiring choices & offering such a well trained & wonderful employee, as was Austin,  to assist a couple of old seniors on a Sunday night!  We HIGHLY RECOMMEND  this store in the Village at Meridian and their wonderful employee, Austin.   GO.....get your dancin' feet happy again!!  :D  :)

Autumn did a fantastic job grooming our Australian Shepherd!!! She asked lots of questions about how we like him trimmed up and did exactly what we like. She also was so sweet to my boy and made him feel comfortable with her before I left him.

Dutch Bros, at their Fairview location, has is always fast, reliable, friendly, and serves up a delicious cup of Joe. I love the white coffee! They almost always have a line, but if you get there early enough, you may find yourself in luck! 

Food: n/a

Drinks: The quad shot white coffee americano is a kick in the pants! Very strong without the strong coffee flavor, though slighly & naturally nutty. I love to drink it with splenda and a little bit of sugar-free syrup. They'd get 5-stars from me if they served drip coffee.

Atmosphere: Two-lane drive through, patio seating outdoors and a walk-up window. I just wish there wasn't always a line to order! They're popular! :) 

Service: Fast, easy service. These guys try as hard as they can to move the line through and it's greatly appreciated! You always know that if you see more than a couple cars in line, they'll have someone coming out to your car to take your order so that it's ready as soon as you hit the window.

Happy Hour Offerings: n/a

Healthy Hack: I always order my drinks, even the white coffee, BLACK! 

Tips: n/a

Had one of the best breakfast sandwiches of all time. The bagels were super fresh, the choices were bountiful, and the cream cheeses were delicious. Had to grab a monstrous cranberry cookie for dessert. This will be one of my new favorite breakfast spots!

Not my favorite sandwich place. They boast "fat" sandwiches...not the case, at least not today. My sister ordered a Reuben that had a very small amount of meat. 

My mom ordered an Italian, it had more meat in it, but it was all to one side of the sandwich and very hastily slapped together.

I ordered the Greek salad, which was good (I don't know how you can mess up a salad) with a side cup of soup. It was advertised as steak and potato, but man, I could have sworn it was SALT SOUP. I brought it back and they let me exchange it for their other soup of the day, clam chowder (free of charge, which was nice of them) but it was also just okay. 

Additionally, I know some people don't mind and enjoy the smoked/cooking meat smell, but I smelled like bacon for HOURS after eating here. Not great when you have things to do during your day.

I would give this little spot a 4 for customer service alone. Everyone here was kind, personable & actually fun! Ordering process was easy And quite fast. My favorite part is they cook the fried okra to order. I took advantage of the yelp buy one 2 meat platter get one free for checking in. So that was a bargin for sure. The pulled pork was delicious and the hubby loved loved loved the smoked turkey! As a southerner i really enjoyed the sweet tea. Also... if you can possibly save space there is free soft serve icecream for dessert! We will definitely go back and dare i say be *regulars*
:-)

I ordered a Charburger and fries, Sherry ordered a Guacamole Crunch Charburger and tempura green beans.  My Charburger was tasty, but Sherry's Guacamole Crunch Charburger was a disappointment.  The garlic in the guacamole overpowered the charbroiled taste of the beef, and the tortilla chips quickly grew soggy and tough to bite through.  The tempura green beans were a peasant change from a typical burger joint, and I liked the selection of drinks which included some house made lemonades (reminiscent of Zuppa's) and the banana pepper / peperoncini / jalapeño bar.  But for the price (our tab was $15 after a coupon for a free Charburger), there are better options out there.

My husband and I went here for lunch the other day and ordered 5 tacos to share. It was plenty for the two of us and only ended up eating 3 whole and 2 halves. Our favorite was the fried shrimp one. 2nd favorite was the breakfast jalapeno egg taco, 3rd the fried chicken, 4th the brisket, and 5th the pork (tin roof) taco. Not bad at all! Food was called out quick, not too expensive ($16 for 5 tacos and a drink). Reminded me of an american styled version of 180 Tacos in Provo, UT. I would say that it is my new favorite taco place in the area.

This restaurant is responsible for no less than 25% of the new cases of diabeties in the valley. If you have celiac and want to die happy, this is the place to go. The desserts are fantastic and the sandwiches are above the best. No need to go anywhere else... It doesn't get any better than this.

I thought everyone that worked here was extremely friendly and welcoming. They were hilarious and invited me into their conversation. Not to mention the great job they did on my nail designs. Love it!

Excellent fast food, great menu, the only negative is this lady named Mari is a super bitch. No customer service skills whatsoever. Other than that it's not a bad location. Hopefully I'll learn what days she works and just avoid her in the future.

Our son has been at New Horizons in Meridian for almost a year and we couldn't be happier. The director is amazing, informative and understanding to any and all of our sons needs. We have been so happy with each teacher he has had and I am constantly impressed and proud of the things my son learns on a weekly basis. If you are looking for a center that is structured, nurturing, clean with lots of learning and fun, then I highly recommend :)

Breakfast wrap was good. The server, not so much. 

She just proved my theory that common sense is actually not common at all. 

I ordered the breakfast wrap that was really good, as I am eating one half of it I was excited to take the other half home to eat later. When we were finished she asked me if I wanted a to go box, I said yes. Instead of getting me a box she took my plate without asking and added everything on the plate that I didn't eat into the box. The salsa I didn't touch, the fruit I don't like and the only thing I wanted, the breakfast wrap. Not shockingly the wrap was soggy when I opened the box. 

I would expect that from a younger person,  but not someone of her age.

Will I be back? Probably not.

Have you ever been treated like family by a stranger? Have you ever smelled the aroma of 10 pounds of recently cooked bacon? Have you ever interacted with staff at a sandwich shop who have worked there for over 5 years? Have you ever bitten into a delicious Reuben that was absolutely perfect in every way?

Wally is the best! Wally's staff are the best! Wally's sandwiches are the best! I absolutely love everything that is Fat Guy's and you will, too!

The best spot. Fries with a side of burger. Also affordable and has so many options. We got the Laura Curly Fries and the Russet Regular Fries... I adore that they come unsalted because I can't stand how much salt places put on fries. Then they have the entire dipping bar with makes it kinda fun and definitely easier to share with others! Natively from Oregon I was thrilled to find out we have one in Portland too!! It's a must have.

Imperial is the cleanest shop in town! They took amazing care of me. I had some piercing that were totally messed up by another shop in Boise matt happily took them out for me. They are seriously so fast and so friendly. I may have learned the hard way that cheap piercings aren't good piercings and good piercings aren't cheep but imperial is definitely my go to spot now!
Food was cold not even warm, after bringing up to the staff they just said "we are sorry ". Did not offer to give me a refund or even a gift card. Will not go back again.

This place had the largest portions I have ever seen. So if you have a big appetite you will love it. I personally would prefer quality over quantity and it was a bit lacking in that department. 

Pizza is thick crust. Oober thick. As in you will exceed your carb limit for the day in one piece and get less of the flavor from the toppings.

By far the worst Mexican I have ever had.... I mean who the heck boils freaking fajitas....this place does....and if it wasnt boiled then they cooked them in a crockpot and it was just bad. never again for me

Shout out to these guys!  I've never had a bad sandwich.  Even when they're busy, it's only a ten minute ticket time MAX.  Seems like quality ingredients, fast service, and the owner (I forget his name) is funnier than hell.
Way overpriced! It has a great environment with ok service, but you will rack up a tab incredibly fast for basic bar food and bowling....

We went to bowl for my sons Birthday. It was very loud, super crowded, dark, hot, and really loud.  We could not find any balls.  People all over our side of lane.  After one frame we packed up and went to get a refund.  They were refusing to refund our shoe rental.  I had to ask for manager and then all he would do was put the $49 credit on a gift card.  Very disappointing and would never go back if we didn't have to spend gift card.  They really didn't care about quality or customer service.

I wanted to love this place since it's so close to us, but I just couldn't. I called in a to go order and when I got there there was a line and the guy at the register was taking phone calls while the other guy at the register was also taking phone calls. Finally when it was my turn the cashier didn't say anything to me but answered the phone and began to take another phone order. When he was able to finally help me my to go order was sitting on a bakers rack not in a warmer waiting for me to pick it up so my pizza wasn't hot. I even arrived early to pick it up so I could get it right from the oven but with all the phone calls it was never gonna happen. The pizza itself was okay, nothing spectacular. I'll be honest and say I may try it again because I don't want to base my whole decision on the service however it does have a lot to do with the experience so it's a maybe.

Aussie Pet Mobile is courteous, professional, communicative and most importantly, did a great job with my dog Stella.  Stella is a 56 lb. American Staffordshire Terrier who LOVES getting groomed.  Tanya, Stella's groomer, was kind and caring with Stella and did a great job with the regular grooming in addition to recommending a couple additional treatments for shedding and her nails.  I recommend scheduling appointments in advance via phone, text or email with John who is GREAT at responding in a timely manner and working with your schedule.  Overall we are very pleased with Aussie Pet Mobile Grooming and looking forward to Stella's next spa day.

Samatha is hands down the best with long hair blended layers. My hair hasn't look or felt this good in some time. I was on a work trip to the Maridian area and just found this salon via yelp. They had the best review and they're all just about on point.  I'm super happy and hope I'll find her twin in upstate NY.  Thank you Samantha for your amazing service. Best of luck and keep making people feel special with beautiful hair.

Best burger I've ever had! This is an upscale burger place, if you want a basic blah cheapo burger, go to a drive through.  Awesome selection of premium ingredients, friendly staff, and delicious food.

Best Hampton I have stayed at so far. Even got the secret Californian welcome high 5 when checking in. Everything looks clean and new. Rooms are really clean. Quiet and overall comfortable. TV was 11 years old, but worked fine once you found your channel. Beds have the thick pillow top cover that feels great. King has 4 pillows. Rooms were well insulated, so neighbor noise was almost non-existent. Normally you hear showers and toilets, not this location. The ONLY minor complaints are the worn out chair cushions in the breakfast lounge. They look good, but when you sit on one you sink down way too low to use table. Honestly every Hampton seems to have this same issue. Oh, and loved the extra touch for tall people. They actually mounted a second lobby phone 6" higher to save us from straining a back muscle. Sweet.

I called for a taxi and David showed up within five minutes. He was super friendly and made the taxi ride very enjoyable. The fare was exactly what they quoted me which was cheaper than I expected. I would definitely recommend B and W taxi, and hopefully you will get David as your driver.
I've gotten better tacos at Taco Bell and for a cheaper price. Tacos are tasteless. Salsa is tasteless. Very disappointing.

Great tacos in a friendly atmosphere.  Great prices on tacos and chips and salsa, we can usually get out for around $15 for two of us.  Love the picadillo tacos and my wife always gets the chicken fajita tacos.  The floor always seems to be slippery but it certainly doesn't deter us from getting our fill of tacos.

Lots of bad reviews, kinda surprised.

I took my family here on my oldest daughters 15th birthday.

Received good service and the food was great. Lots of options to choose from and not terrible expensive; 4 adults 3 children $90 w/tip.

We will definitely be going back.

"Do you have reservations?" the friendly blonde barkeep asked as we walked in to the small restaurant with five or six tables and dominated by a large bar.  "Are you kidding? For a bar?" I thought as she motioned my friend and me to the only two empty seats in the place at, of all places, the bar.  We looked at the nondescript menu printed in black and white on plain white paper and chose our fare.  Cybil opted for the Cubano, one of her favorite sandwiches.  I chose the Skillet with bacon.  Given the setting, the menu, and the very reasonable prices we expected, well, bar food.

We chatted and looked around the place as the barkeep mixed drinks right in front of us.  I saw her put a few shots of Buffalo Trace in a glass and mix in something from an unmarked container. I asked what it was and she said "maple syrup".  Cybil didn't quite hear and asked what it was and I quipped "A way to ruin a perfectly good tumbler of Buffalo Trace".  We asked what the drink was called and she said "The After 10".  Since we came here right after church I glanced at my watch and said jokingly "I assume that means after 10 AM", and she smiled and nodded affirmatively.

That's when Cybil spotted something on the food warmer and exclaimed "Oh. My. Gosh!"  I looked over and gasped "What is that?"  "I think it's my Cubano!"  And in an instant, everything changed, and I knew why reservations are recommended here.

Cybil's Cubano was an œuvre d'art (don't be impressed, I Googled that), breathtakingly assembled and beautifully presented with a house salad and house-made Dijon dressing on the side.  Unlike most local Cuban sandwiches that are served with just ham or ham and roast pork, this one was served with ham and house-smoked pulled pork complete with a candy-like bark, some of the tastiest I've had anywhere.  The sandwich and salad were easily big enough for two and I'd like to say I sent Cybil home with lunch for tomorrow, but if I did I'd be lying.

My Skillet was less generously sized than the Cubano but also an explosion of flavor, with a light smokey taste suggesting the chef let the flame from the stove briefly ignite some of the fats in the pan as we've all seen on professional cooking shows but never tried for fear of setting our houses on fire.  It was served with a dense artisan sourdough bread with a wonderful Parmesan garlic crust.

All in all, Grant's was one of the most unique and surprising dining experiences we've had in the Treasure Valley.  We especially enjoyed the friendly conversation with our waitress/bartender, who even while she was engaged in conversation was extremely attentive and greeted everyone who came in and said farewell to guests as they departed - a rare trait you'd expect only in a high end and high-dollar restaurant.

I highly recommend you give them a try.  Don't forget to make reservations.
Dr. Naomi Brooks and staff were exceptional.  Ease of checking in as well as very thorough and explained thoroughly as biopsies were were needed. Great follow up and highly recommend.

I was prepared to like this place but I walked away very disappointed.  The prices are very reasonable and they have a good selection of tacos.  I tried the fried chicken, pulled pork and bbq brisket tacos as well as the chips and guacamole.

The chips and guacamole were great.  The tacos were not.  The fried chicken is bone dry.  The bbq brisket was like a strip of leather -- note the meet was not chopped or diced, just a big hunk.  The pulled pork was dry as well, and while a little spicy, wasn't flavorful.  I don't think I'll be coming back unless I am jonesing for chips and guacamole.

If I could give this place zero stars, i would. It's bad when a customer comes in and folds a rack of your clothing just so we can see what is there. Goodwill is cleaner. Speaking of goodwill, consider donating the clothes that have been on clearance for months on end. The floors appear to never have been mopped. The walls in the dressing rooms are covered in dried fluids. The bathrooms are constantly in some sort of failing state. This place is in desperate need of a remodel, thorough cleaning and an entirely new CAPABLE staff that has common sense when it comes to the importance of having a clean and organized store. I'm honestly amazed this place hasn't gone out of business. A hoarders home would be a better place to find clothes.

I wish there was an option to give more than 5 stars...that's how amazing these guys are! I just moved to Boise and was in desperate need of a detail on my Mazda CX-5. Thankfully I found these guys. Chris and his team are fantastic. I have a golden retriever who, I swear, sheds enough hair to make a new sweater every day and these guys were able to make my car look brand new again! Obviously my dog will not be welcome in the car for a little while :) An exterior wash and complete interior detail for a VERY reasonable price. Completely professional and genuine individuals. I will definitely be back time and time again!

I literally knew nothing about running and they went through the whole complete package of shoes, socks, hydration, nutrition, headphones etc. They were all so patient and supportive especially when I told them I'm running a half marathon in 7 weeks.

We grabbed two bagels this morning for breakfast. We order an everything bagel with lox spread and sesame seed bagel with sprouts, tomato, capers and cream cheese. Both bagels were pretty good but next time will remember to tell them to toast are bagels twice cause they were not toasted enough.

I always get the charburger with raw onions on sourdough bread and this location is the only one that has served me Burnt bread more than once. Cmon the bread shouldn't be black in certain areas, quickly remake it.

Ive lived in Boise my whole life and I cant believe I've  never been here. I got the turkey bacon avacado. Superior taste everything was fresh and made to order. The staff was extremely friendly. You can tell that they enjoy their job. They have lots of goodies for sale from local compainies. I especially liked that this place is a legitimate deli; meats, cheeses, breads, sides. The inside is older but gives you the small town ma and pop feel which I love. Highly recommend for lunch or just whenever. Also, if you need some awesome sandwich meat.

I have enjoyed nachos on a few occasions while watching a game.  The steak nachos are very good. Recently I had the opportunity to partake in some pizza. I haven't been this disappointed in pizza since discovering Tony's and Totino's while in college.  It was unimaginative and bland.  Avoid disappointment. Avoid the pizza.

Slow as hell!!!!! Went through the drive through. Gave  my order. Wanted 15 min. I know that doesn't seem like a long time but it felt like forever!!! Got to the window and she took down my order wrong. Sitting here still waiting for our food. Never going back!!!

Love this place! Fun! Electric! Awesome environment! Lots to do and see! Flashing lights! Lots of sound. 
Arcade games and adult bar with golf and a great  view of downstairs from upstairs.
Downstairs finds  bowling, 2 more bars, ice cream, and an AWESOME (did I say AWESOME!!!!) dining/bar area with mega awesome giant tv screens and great food. Awesome wait staff. Delicious drinks. Fun environment. Try it! You'll like it!
Found a bug in my salad... needless to say I wasn't happy. Noone offered to replace it or refund. I spent over $30 and mine and my family meal was ruined. Total waste of money.

I contacted Chris to see if his shop could get some scratches out of my car and he was really fast at responding on here and making an apt for me (although when I showed up his crew couldn't find my apt) but they made it work. I dropped off my car and they brought my car back to me so I didn't have to find a ride back to the shop. They did a really good job! I had to bring it back to get a few that were missed but they fit me in right away and started working on my car. 

Thank you and I do recommend dynamic detail as they were very responsive and prompt
My family and I love this place. Some of the best burgers we've had! Also I really like their chicken sandwich! Great pricing for the quality!

My husband and I went to the "soft open" a few weeks ago. We liked the atmosphere and decor. We actually loved everything (the guy below who gave you one star and didn't put his name must work for a competitor or just be plain crazy because he is just simply wrong ;)). 

I like that it's small--that way it's not overly crowded or noisy. And I like that everything is fresh (you won't find cans of anything here). We sat out on the patio and it was really nice. Hubby had the gnocchi-so delicious (we've tried gnocchi before at other places and weren't thrilled, but this was amazing--perfectly cooked and flavored). I had the BLT. At first I was surprised by the bacon--it was really thick and tasted almost like ham--but it was really delicious and it made for a great BLT. But even better were the fresh-cut fries--again perfectly cooked and perfectly delicious (and I'm kinda a fry snob)---so much better than the frozen fries you get at the majority of other restaurants. 

We also enjoyed some cocktails (and I typically am not a fan of drinks at all)--the Cranberry Drift was the best drink I've ever tasted...it was such a unique combination, but so refreshing (I might go back just for that!)...and the Sangria with the fruit at the bottom was delicious too. 

We had the toffee pudding for dessert and again I was surprised because it wasn't a pudding at all (maybe the description should say that?)...but it was a really moist, yummy (but small-which isn't bad because we had eaten plenty!) cake (guessing it had pudding in it to make it so moist). Even though it's a bit of a drive for us, we'll definitely be back regularly. Meridian peeps...you are super lucky to have a wonderful, fun, innovative new restaurant to enjoy! And everyone else...it's worth the drive...you won't be sorry!!!
Took my family and had a great meal. Very friendly and the food is very fresh. The chicken Mexican pizza is awesome!

Great place for a quick delicious lunch. Their burgers were fantastic. I had the tumbleweed... Cooked perfectly... So messy and tasty. The husband didn't speak to me the entire time except to moan about how fantastic his Hawaiian burger was. Seriously.. He was in heaven. The vampire fries are fantastic! The kids were happy too and the ice cream surprise at the end was a nice treat. Our waitress was sweet and helpful... A wonderful experience. We will be back!
The Santa Barbara burger was delicious. Sweet potato fries were crispy and the environment was pretty nice and clean

Coming from Vegas moved to Boise...first thai restaurant my Husband took me to...great service and bomb ass food! My Husband and u love spicy so we asked for level 5..their hottest level and they delivered it perfectly! Will definitely be back for more! We had the volcano chicken and larb and longan and sticky rice, was soooo good!  The owner and our server were the sweetest!

I live very close to Fiesta Guadalajara but I will go to Corona Village instead-- unless they change management and their rude front desk staff. I asked for a plain quesadilla with just cheese and they wouldn't do it!! At first she said, "If we just put cheese I still have to charge you for the guacamole and sour cream" and I said fine --but when she checked with her supervisor ---he says no they can't make a plain quesadilla. So I finally said can you just get a raw tortilla and some raw cheese and put it in the tortilla and I will just microwave it at home? They gave me raw cheese on a tortilla and charged me full price. I'm not going back unless they change staff and management. Terrible customer service!!

Small local joint, with a small patio that they put warmers on and offered blankets and pillows when that was where we were seated. "Casual upscale" atmosphere, with some far reaching buzz words throughout the menu. Great concept. 

The service was ok. We went for an early dinner on a Friday with the family, we each had an entree plus we ordered a side of veggies for the munchkin because none of the "kids" options had veggies. The beer menu was large in options but not a solid mix, especially for those that enjoy a darker beer. They had one option for us that was a very light porter. It was decent but a better selection would be a draw for us. 

For the slightly over $60 (before tip) we spent (quail, chicken and a kid's burger plus the green beans, one beer and waters) we could have easily gone to one of a dozen other options and enjoyed the food more. None of us "loved" the food, although the kiddo did like the green beans :). Nothing was horrible, it was just...okay. The best thing, we all agreed, was the potato "puree" (it was mashed potatoes lol) with the chicken. The stuffing in the quail was very salty (and I love salt and usually add it to everything: I could barely eat it) but the bird was cooked nicely. The flavor was just boring. The chicken was slightly better, but again...just okay. Everything felt heavy and just overdone, despite it looking nice on the plates. 

We have had much better meals at places like Fork or Red Feather or Bittercreek Ale House compared to this one. Even though this one is very close to our house, we will trek a bit further for a more well rounded option.

Food is good. Service is sometimes slow as it was today. We had fried pickles for appetizer and I had club wrap as
Entree. It's as good. Bacon was thick and tasty. Otherwise it was
A
Little bland. A/c was a little cold for a spring day.
They did a great job.  Guaranteed the polish and told me to come back if it chipped.    It's been at least two weeks now and it has never chipped.
Wow what can I say but killer bakery and I had an amazing club sandwich  ... this is a top notch place and I highly recommend Kneaders !!

Seriously love this place. The people are always incredibly nice and take effort to remember us. The turkey sandwich is awesome with the jalapeño cream cheese, which is what we normally get here. You just can't go wrong getting any bagel/sandwich/cream cheese combo! Just a few reasons we keep coming back!!

Very kind, friendly, professional. Dallas had to deal with my 17 lb terrified long hair cat. He had mats all over his back and was worried this experience was going to traumatize him. It was nice that they come right to your door. Prove was very reasonable considering everything they had to do. She got the mats out, shaved him, cleaned his paws, ears, gave him a bath. Not only is he not traumatized hes MUCH happier.

Mostly great associates. Great prices and selection! A little tip for people of color, don't go through the self checkout. You will automatically be stealing and watched like you are shoving things in your jacket. Not just at this location either. Seems to be a requirement to get the job. Skills on resume: Profiling

The food here is really good! I ordered yellow curry with tofu and the rest of my family had gyoza and sweet and sour with chicken. Their Thai tea seems a little off to me although I can't put my finger on why. 

The curry was yummy and I'll definitely order it again. The only thing I didn't like was the waiter didn't ask how spicy I wanted it (I usually order no spice so I can share with my daughter). I got what was probably a 3 out of 5 stars which was too spicy for her. 

The prices are reasonable here - the restaurant isn't fancy and the prices aren't either. They offer take out and delivery, which I thought was cool. 

One star off because although our waiter was friendly enough he seemed disinterested and sort of disconnected, like he had three other places he needed to be. 

Other than that, this was a decent experience and I'll be back.
This is my favorite Thai place in the valley. The food is always good and the wait staff is friendly and attentive.

Stephen has worked on two of our properties and his work is impeccable and adds so much beauty and value to our properties. He is a hard worker who takes great care with our homes as well as caring how he leaves for the day. Everything is clean and tidy so we don't have to worry that our dog will get into anything. He is the best contractor and I would most definitely recommended him to my family and friends as well as using him for anything needed in my home.
Very tasty.  Atmosphere not great but food and service fantastic. Shrimp curry ...yum.  Healthy and fresh ingredients.  Too bad building has a strip mall feel.

WOW!  Finally I have found a really great thai place!

Pros: Too many!  The interior is awesome and not cheesy like some thai-themed restaurants can be.  The service was very friendly and informative about menu items.  Ended up ordering the oh-so-classic Pad Thai with extra veggies and cashews and fried tofu. THE TOFU!  I cannot remember the last time I had legit amazing tofu.  Usually it's too soft/squishy with a bland and terrible flavor - which happens when you don't know how to properly prepare tofu.  Get it fried!  The overall flavor of the dish was quality and bursting with flavors.  For dessert, we tried the "sampler platter" which I'm sure is called something else but has 3-4 different desserts to try on it. Enjoyed the house-made coconut icecream.  Very tasty!  


Cons: The "sampler platter" dessert we tried, although very tasty, overdid it a bit with how much deep-fried stuff was on the plate.  Other than that, this place is champion of thai food and I am eager to return!

Check this place out when your next thai food craving hits!

Lately I have been finding myself eating here more often; there's two things of how they have me coming back again and again. When I originally went my initial first impression was just your typical cheeseburger. After eating there a few times now it's become quite apparent their famous char, seasoning, and those grilled onions represent a discount flavorful burger profile that can quickly turn into a burger habit!! I love how the cheese is perfectly melted underneath their lightly toasted bun. They use real meat no fillers here haha. I've tried their fries a few times; they get it just right perfectly cooked given you a slightly crunchy soft texture with the perfect amount of salt. Something else I have noticed is they do the little extra things well from the pepper bar to giving you the option for grilled onions on your cheeseburger. Lastly I discovered this by accident; they have a sauce called boom boom sauce creamy, spicy with quite the lunch great for dipping fries or on top of your char burger just make sure to ask for a side of it after ordering otherwise they will charge you for it. Overall on second review I've found they have quite the burger that char flavor and boom sauce will have me coming back for me guess you could say it's become a habit :)

Radio hosts are always promoting this product or that place and typically I don't get enticed to go somewhere based on what they say since it can be a paid plug etc...  Lately though the ESPN Boise team, Coach and Johnny Mallorie have been doing spots at Fat Guy's Deli and talking with Chef Wally.   I could no longer take tease and had to check it for myself.   The deli is tucked away in off of Wells street on Overland by Eagle road.  There are any number of sandwiches with the draw of everything is made from scratch and being local.  The Bleu Bronco with a small side of homemade potato salad.   This was a togo order so the aromas were plenty distracting while I was driving. i was tempted on many occasions during red lights to take a peek and sneak a bite but after examining the girth of the sandwich, it would be an epic fail to eat this behemoth anywhere else beside the dinning room table. Once home, I gently unpacked my sandwich, side and au jus.   The potato salad was the first to get to sampled.  It is very clear that the potato is from scratch and homemade. It is gritty, and was bound by chucks of potatoes, celery and bacon. It was very flavorful but if you are used to the generic stuff at the grocery stuff, you are in for a different ride albeit a good one.  Afterward dispensing with the side, I carefully unwrapped the Bleu Bronco and just admired its girth and weight.   The sandwich could easily be shared with two people. The brioche style bun was evenly soft and beautiful.The roast beef was tender and not gristly or poor product.  The bleu cheese had time to melt on the way home and was really the winner along with the pesto mayo.   I wasn't sure how the pesto and bleu cheese were going to be bedfellows but they were paired well like they had been a perfect match from eHarmony.  The lettuce strips was a nice touch however I would have preferred either a green or red leaf for more nutritional value.  I ate half of the sandwich for lunch and the other half for dinner.  Quite honestly I did not even sample the au jus.  I just did not think it necessary.   Fat Guys' Deli is simply worth the trek to Meridian, and when you hear about Chef Wally talking on the radio about quality, it's no bull but all truth.

I want to love this place. I mean...it's tacos! However, I can't even eat my tacos. The shells fell apart getting them out of the foil. I'm disappointed - I was excited for tacos and can't enjoy it. My suggestion is to double up the tortillas if they are to-go orders!

Worst BBQ I have had in a long time.  Had the brisket and pulled pork found both to be dry and flavorless, tried to save it with both the hot and regular sauce but found both to be the worst BBQ sauce I have ever had.  Imagine your normal BBQ sauce with a cup of vinegar poured into it.  Yuck!   The BBQ beans tasted like they poured them out of a jumbo sized can and warmed them up and the mac & cheese was right up there with what you got at the school cafeteria.   The only saving grace to this experience was the coleslaw and roll which were both very good.  Beer selection was pretty slim, nothing on tap so had to wash this horrible meal down with a bottle of bud light.

Love them and my Pomeranian Rufus does too! He doesn't want to leave when I pick him up. Just make sure you make your appointment in advance because they get booked quickly! They are totally worth it! Rufus always looks so dapper when he trots out and he knows it!

Always a fan of The Habit. I patronized the original one for many, many years. Still do, when I go home. I just love the food. The burgers are tasty and not overcooked. The fries are my perfect! We all have our own preference on skinny versus steak versus waffle. The Habit's are just awesome! Great salads. And, they are fairly speedy with getting the food to you.

A friend said DK had the best donuts in town, so I stopped by to pick up an apple fritter one day. I picked up the fritter and a habit...of stopping in every time I drive by or near or remotely near to pick up a fritter or two because that first one was amazing. Magically, DK replicates the best part of the fritter (the edges) throughout the entire fritter. There is no overly doughy middle. It's all mouth-watering perfection.

First time to a Papa John's and the owner (which I clarified) helped me out.  I had a coupon from groupon which specified the location and to use in store.  The owner was very displeased with my coupon saying that it must be a corporate thing and it didn't include her store.  Since the coupon is what led me to come in I showed her that it indeed said it included her store as it listed her store address.  She finally said "fine, I guess I have to".  
Afterwards, she was anything but nice.  

That led me a one star review but moreso it is her and her staff who do not use gloves when preparing the pizza.  Even after handling money you would think they would have strict policy regarding cleanliness.  

I know Papa Murphey's is a lot more careful. 

Let's just say that this was the first and last time I will be at Papa John's.
Love these guys! Totally able to help you with phone and computer help. So nice, down to earth and able to answer technical questions. Also found the price points and turn around time excellent!!

This is the Zamz I go to when I want selection! This place is huge and has trees, shrubs, flowers, and plants galore. It is like Mall of America for a Zamzows.

Every time employees are extremely helpful, knowledgeable, and patient. I love asking questions. I think they love answering them. 

Look for the cat that is roaming around. My only complaint is kitty wouldn't hang out with me. Kitty kept walking with swagger to its next adventure. 

Plenty of parking!

Get your Zam on!

Dad & I have enjoyed many a nice meal here, today included.   We typically get the pulled pork burrito and, since I'm very averse to spicy foods, the pico & corn salsas on them.   When we have burritos here for lunch, we typically don't feel hungry for dinner.   

Today is New Year's Eve and we called to find out their hours -- but nobody ever picked up the phone.   This was the first lapse in service that we've experienced here, however.

The dining room doesn't have much in the way of decoration, but there is one TV which was playing ESPN today.  The table tops are metal, which make for pretty nice looks and (I'm sure) easy cleaning.

Restrooms are generously-sized and have been clean when we've used them.  

Qdoba is definitely our burrito-joint of choice, being of better quality than Taco Del Mar and better value than Chipotle.    We saw a sign on the door that they'll start serving breakfast tomorrow, 1/1/14.
Yummy little place! Staff treats you like family! Their margaritas are wonderful! Try the fajitas, they do not disappoint. My whole family loves this place.
We waited over an hour to get our food. Our waitress did not check on us during that time. Ihop has always been the go-to place for my friends and we will now be going elsewhere. Very disappointed.

My ultimate favorite! Love my Iced Triple Shot Vanilla Caramel Mocha!!! They always give back to our community, especially with an event that is very dear to my heart that I participate in every year...Relay for Life! Everyone is always so sweet! Always upbeat. They truly care about everyone!!

I was super excited to try Boise Fry Company. I moved to Idaho only 4 months ago and have heard nothing but good things. The staff are so kind and welcoming, and I think that really adds the cherry on top. 

As for the taste of the food, the burger I had was very good! I had a beef burger with lettuce, tomatoes, pickles, bacon and cheese. I wouldn't say the taste was anything special but still good. The fries, however, are just what I was looking for. Hardly anyone sells true home cut, homemade fries, but BFC got it perfect! My dad makes amazing homemade fries, so this gave me a little taste of
home.

The presentation I thought was incredible! I love their trays. There is a spot for your sauces as well as your fries bowl and it just makes the whole presentation come together. 

My only protest would be the sauces. I am a sauce fanatic and can't have fries without them... unfortunately I was not extremely impressed by their sauces. I tried 5 different sauces and didn't like any of them, which really bummed me out. I wish that their fry sauce was more of a normal ketchup mayo mix. Also their chipotle sauce didn't have a very strong taste, so you could barely notice that you were even eating it. 

Besides that I was pretty impressed, and will most likely be trying it again!

I visited your location tonight 3/12/19 for a couple games of bowling. Worst service i have ever experienced. The server was very unattentive, they did last call and we pressed the call button and he never came back around. So i went to the bar to order. The bartender was extremely rude. I asked for a $2 beer and she said they were out. I asked for a mixed drink and she said she had put all the mixers away. (Right as they called last call) then we were on our 8th frame and they shut the game off so we couldn't finish the last 2 frames, meanwhile at least 3 other lanes were still bowling around us for at least 15 min or more longer. We only had 4 of us and totally could have finished in the time everyone else did. Then we went to the front to ask about it and the cashier was extremely rude so i asked to talk to a manager. Even worse idea, she came and was extremely rude and acted put out that we had even asked to talk to her. So in the end we ended up getting one free game coupon for the 4 of us that were here (which the manager explained was "very generous" considering). I will be spreading around the bad experience i had and posting my experience for all my friends to hear. Believe me, i will be spending my money at other establishments from now on. Very disappointed at how your staff was this evening and we used to visit frequently on Tuesday nights. I would rather go to a local alley and play and spend my money.

I can't believe how long it has taken me to try this place out.  Gourmet burgers and salads for fast food prices.  The presentation itself is similar to a 5 star restaurant except of course the plastic plates. Service is fast and friendly.  I was thinking 4 stars but after thinking about it there is no reason but to give this place 5 full stars.  It's my new "GO TOO" place to eat.

I looked these guys up on Yelp and went in and talked to Ryan and showed him what I would like done so he took a few photos and when I went back for my appointment boy did he deliver! I couldn't be more happy with my tattoo.  In fact he did such a great job I took my twin sister back to get the same tattoo.  I will definitely go back to Ryan should I want anymore tattoos done in the future , super nice guy ! 
Thanks Ryan :)

Update: if you go after 8 p.m. On Saturdays all of their breads and desserts are 1/2 off. It is a steal!  I got raspberry bread pudding, an entire loaf of cinnamon chunk bread, a chocolate dome, a berry cheesecake and a soda all for $9!!! That is crazy in such a good way!  And no all of those snacks weren't for me- I'm not that greedy! Just know the line will be long because this is such a good deal.  I plan to have this place on my regular visit list.

So far I've enjoyed everything I've tried here, but the list isn't long. I had the chocolate peanut butter cupcake. It was moist and tasty.  Nothing I fell in love with, but still decent.  However, the raspberry bread pudding is a completely different story. It is a MUST try. It has a delicious raspberry flavor- not too bitter or sweet. The bread isn't dry or hard. It also comes with creamy and delicate vanilla custard. It's beyond delicious and a perfect combination to the tart raspberry flavor. They also have a drive through, which is convenient if you want to pick up a fresh loaf of bread. I'll be back to try some of their breads and will update my review.  I went around 7 pm on a Saturday, and it was quiet. If that's the case during the day, it could be a great place to have a treat and enjoy a book.

My husband got food poisoning from this location a few months ago and now we get to pay off the medical bill for the next two years! I would highly recommend thinking twice before coming here. Thankfully we ordered slightly different things, I was only a few weeks pregnant at the time and would have for sure lost the baby had we had the same items.

Very nice hotel and extremely kind staff.  We stayed here when moving from Portland to Cleveland.  The rooms are set up with a small kitchen for cooking, a refrigerator, plenty of space to unwind.  They are pet friendly and have space for running your dog and we were able to park our car right outside our window.  These rooms are wonderful especially for the price.
Always great service.  The food comes out fast and very consistent.  Slightly over salted, but still delicious.  We enjoy it.

If anyone is looking for a dentist: serious shout out to Dr. Hansen and all the staff at Austin Creek Dental. This was my first visit so it was going to be a long one... I had to bring my kids with me last minute and the entire staff was SO accommodating and wonderful with me and my kids (both under 3). They explained things to my son and encouraged his curiosity. They were not irritated with them one bit. They were patient with all of us as I tended to my kids and, they were gentle and respectful to me while examining and cleaning my teeth. I HIGHLY recommend them! I was very stressed about having to bring my kids with me and they made me feel so comfortable. I would recommend them over and over again (but don't recommend bringing your kids to your dental appointment HAHA). It's the best experience I've had at the dentist in years!

Worst customer service. Asked an employee that was standing decently close to the paint section if he could help me mix some paint. He tells me no so I ask if we can page someone to come help me and he said no there's no way for him to. Beyond annoyed at this point I just leave. It would have taken him 20 seconds to walk over and page for someone to come to paint to help me.

I was very frustrated with my experience with in depth Detail! I went on line and made an appointment when asked if  I would like to have the work done at their shop I checked the no box. They sent me a confirmation indicating the time and address. The address listed was my home!
After they did not show up I called their shop and they said that they were not doing mobile detailing right now and If I wanted mobile service it would be November! They were surprised to hear that the confirmation listed my address.
They charged my cc card $ 20.00 deposit. 
I will be looking to see if they credit my account.

We booked a party and paid a deposit over the phone for my niece's birthday. When we were emailed the actual documentation to confirm our reservation, we realized that the deposit we put down was NON-REFUNDABLE and that we would be responsible for paying for 12 guests NO MATTER WHAT, so we didn't sign the documents. We also had found out that some of our friends were going to be out of town and were not going to be able to make it. So we called back to see if the reservation could be cancelled. It was, but we were unable to get the deposit back. Apparently we agreed to the terms over the phone, but honestly do not remember hearing them and doing so. Not sure what the purpose is of having documents to sign if your money can be kept without signing. No way to confirm that was explained except that they feel they did.  We just wanted to warn anyone else thinking about booking a party, make sure you are ok with paying $40 per person, a minimum of 12, EVEN IF THEY DON'T SHOW UP, NO MATTER WHAT!!! It basically cost us $120 to say we were interested in booking a party at Big Al's. We won't make that mistake again...

A star for your food. No star for your service. Thanks to the girl in the drive thru at around 2:30, I had to order blindly because she didn't know her menu. Also, when someone has a serious allergy "I don't think so," is not an appropriate response. Lastly, when I make sure that the something I am allergic to, doesn't come on the salad because nothing has a description, laughing at me is not appreciated. Thanks but no thanks. I'll pack my own next time.

My family of 4 have eaten there twice since it has opened and we love it. The variety of toppings and friendly knowledgeable wait staff make it a pleasure to visit. The concept of building a burger to order, right down to the size and type of patty and bun is a great idea. This makes it a new taste experience every time you visit. I could go there 50 times or more and order a new delectable burger each time. 

The Parmesan fries are so addicting, as are the sweet potato fries and onion shoestrings.  The Counter also has an amazing selection of dipping sauces to drown your sides in. Their milk shakes are favorites as well. They have an excellent selection of local craft brews in both bottle and draft. 

The wait staff is friendly and very helpful. They have made great strides in providing efficient, quality service between the two visits we have made and I can only expect it to improve with experience and time. 

Regarding previous reviews complaining of price, I would defy those folks to go to any other burger place in town and find the variety of toppings, choices of patty, and quality bread products The Counter offers in any price range. This is not Red Robin or McD's and you will know that the moment you enter and peruse the menu. You are going to have a high quality burger made the way YOU want it.
LOVED my experience at Nail Tek!! Super friendly, attention to the details, great atmosphere and you can tell they love what they do! Thank you for making feel at home while I visit Boise!

I gave TRT 5 stars, even though they earned 4.5, because I think the problem we had (taco meats weren't hot) is because they're so slammed for their first week and probably cook ahead. Everything else was bomb. Prices are amazing ($2-$2.50 per big taco). Flavors and options were plentiful, including vegetarian options. (I mean, who wouldn't want a grilled corn taco with Mexican mayo, cojita cheese, onions and cilantro? Yes, please!) Service was friendly, tacos were out in less than three minutes, and we were super happy. Bonus that it's walking distance from us. Welcome to the neighborhood, Tin Roof!

Tonight, we celebrated my brother's birthday there tonight. The food was great... we ordered pizza and nachos. They brought him a huge ice cream sundae with cake and five cookies!! Alex was a fabulous waitress!! 

After, we played in the arcade upstairs while the other half of the party stayed in the restaurant watching the basketball game!! Great night.

Food and pricing are great! The restaurant is clean, relaxing and really cozy in the winter when the fireplace is going. 

Recommendations for breakfast is the French toast!!! Amazing! For a lighter breakfast, I like their scrambles. For lunch/dinner get their French dip! So good! 

Bakery - One of my favorites is the orange cranberry bread! It's a bummer that they only have it in the fall. But all of their loaves of bread are yummy and moist. The dinner rolls & pies are awesome, especially for the holidays. Their cookies are really good but as for the pastries, I haven't cared for most of the ones I've tried. And I've tried a lot of different ones!

Tip - Call ahead for holiday orders! I tried to walk in to get some dinner rolls for Thanksgiving and it was impossible.

Very small shop, sweet, beautiful arrangements, a little on the pricey side, but the number of fresh flowers you get seems worth it.

I was able to choose my flowers and the amount I was willing to spend and got a gorgeous, full, fresh bunch of flowers, wrapped with a beautiful purple bow.  Very pleased and would highly recommend.

Great food,  many local beers on draught, great choices in quality ingredients. Very few restaurants offer a true gluten free diet, paleo diet, or vegan diet options along with offering a good ol fashioned burger. I see some negative reviews out there but not a lot of positive ones. Yet I think the good people of the treasure valley should experience this place for themselves.

We were hoping Olive (Doodle) would be cut evenly and about 1.5 inches all over with long hair on head and straight even cut, fluffy and smoothe to the touch. 

Washing such a big dog in a van is not probably not easy. Olive returned to is happy and clean. I need photos to show them what we want next time should we try this service again. 

Dallas was sweet and Olive was happy.
20 minutes in the drive thru behind 4 cars is far too long for low quality food. Would get faster service and better food at a sit down restaurant. Lesson learned.

I ordered the spaghetti and meatballs and my husband ordered the chicken sandwich. His sandwich was not bad but not fabulous. My spaghetti and meatballs tasted like cafeteria food. After we ate we when over to the ice cream parlor to get the taste out of our mouths from the spaghetti. Did not enjoy it.  We like the menu that they had when they first opened.

Dickey's was a huge disappointment! Last night was our first time and we were grabbing dinner to bring to a friend's house. The first thing we noticed was the difference in prices between their sign and the price I paid ordering online. It was a significant difference too, like $13 on a package. When I mentioned it the girl laughed and said that their sign out front wasn't accurate either. The meat was dry and the rolls were rock hard. The BBQ sauce was good and the Mac and cheese and baked beans were fine. Overall definitely a 2-star experience.

Fun, Fun, Fun!

It was everything we were hoping for.  We drove for 6 hours to get there and we weren't disappointed.  We stayed the whole day and it was a blast.  I had a teenager and a 1st grader and they both had tons of fun.

It was spendy, but if you spend the whole day it is worth it.
