Here's a tip, don't go to a water park and expect gourmet food, it's just not gonna happen.  It is snack shack food warmed up by college kids.  Sneak in fruit snacks and granola bars like everyone else if you need a snack.

I kept putting off getting a daith piercing because I was terrified.  I had heard that people had some success in reducing the amount and quality of migraines with this piercing.  So Monday morning I called them to see if they could get me in and Paul was able to get me in that afternoon. First that office reminded me more of a doctors office than "tattoo palor"....extremely clean. He was fast and yes it did hurt but only for a short while. Most important though was his setup and handling of equipment and supplies.  As someone who works in surgery I watched him carefully to see the clean technique.  While it wasn't a 100% sterile technique it was a very clean setup.  I had no qualms about him doing my piercing.  After several months now, my migraines are significantly less by 95% and since I'm having my own surgical experience coming up he was able to replace my hoop to a very very small clear plastic piercing that is cleared for me to continue to wear for my surgery.  Already looking at getting a different piercing after my surgery and I know I'll go to Imperial Body Art or I won't get it done.  Excellent job!

We tried Kneaders the other day even though the parking lot was full and there were a lot of people inside.  The sandwich we ordered was really good--turkey, avocado, and bacon on foccacia.  The turkey was thickly cut and didn't taste processed.  I was unimpressed with dessert which was a fruit tart with cream--not what I expected.  We also tried a couple of the soups, artichoke and mushroom and corn chowder.  Both were delicious!  I could do without all the country type decorations in the place. It seems cluttered and takes up room.  I think it's good that they have baked items for sale to take home. The customer service was good also and the staff was very pleasant and helpful even though the place was jam packed.
Complete garbage every time. Dry, old, and inedible.  It's rice and chicken, it's not rocket science.

Amazing nail salon! I am from out of town and have a very high standard for nails and this place exceeded expectations! I called in and they had 1 opening for the day and were able to get me in. They were on time and so nice! They had so many options for gel and provided recommendations which I loved! The quality of my gel manicure was so impressive and I really loved chatting with the nail techs there. Pricing was so affordable as well! Needless to say, I loved my experiences and my nails-- will for sure come here every time I'm in town!

It's ok. Nothing special. I'm from Sacramento. I'm a Chipotle girl. 

I do like their queso sauce...so there's that. I just wasn't that impressed with the burrito bowl. It was  not bad...it was just fine.

I haven't even gotten my food yet this is all on service and this burger better be out of this world  because this service sucks my hole. I decided to get it to go after I ordered it because I couldn't stand being inside of here. It's not super busy but it's not dead. Amy older blonde lady seems so annoyed I asked what kind of lemonade I wanted to feed my kid.... "the kind you buy in the store" - the girl blonde girl at the door handed me a sheet of paper expecting me to know wtf to do with it... okay I got my food... not I'm infuriated! Who is their gosh dang right mind would pay nearly 10 bucks for these mini burgers  I can't stand how upset about it. I spoke to the main manager( owner) have him a little bit of feedback and he tried to be awkwardly humorous - I didn't find anything he said funny "my employees are rude" my 4 fries were salty AF AND THE TWO BITES I GOT were pretty decent but F! Not worth it G whiz that really half pissed me off

This is the worst Taco Time in the Treasure Valley.  Food was cold and portion size was ridiculous.  Also, did not give me my drink.  Had to go back and ask for it.  No sauces on the salsa bar either.  I eat at Taco Time frequently at other locations(a LOT).  I have noticed customer service at all locations is lacking.  No more Taco Time for me.  This one sealed the deal.

We have been with Reliable for years and for good reason. They always do everything they can for us, and genuinely care. Even when we are late on our payment, they call to ask if everything is okay and if we need more time, as opposed to other companies who threaten to repo if you are a week late. Reliable credit have earned customers for life here.

Quite simply the best tacos in Meridian. Tin Roof is an oasis amidst the cookie-cutter dining options in NW Meridian. We have been frequenting this location since the day they opened and the Boise location before that. I've tried every taco on the menu and none disappoint but favorites are the Baja Shrimp and Tin Roof. In addition to the great food, the staff is laid back and friendly. You get the sense that the workers actually enjoy working there, which is important to me. Finally, the prices. In a time where I can't even get my little family of four out of McDonalds for under $20, we routinely dine at Tin Roof for under $15. Under $20 with beers. That's just crazy. 

Tin Roof is legitimately the best thing about this part of town.

Update:. It was about 1 year later that we came back.  Unfortunately, it was not as good as before.  My shrimp was raw.  My wife's salmon was not that great.  It was super fishy smelling.   I hate going from 5 stars down to 2, but raw shrimp is the main reason.

On a plus side, they fixed the bathroom door.
My favorite hidden gem in the area. Never been disappointed- service is slow to warn people as it's all scratch made and a small place

I REALLY wanted to like this place. I love fries, so it seemed kismet... I stopped in and picked a potato that the guy behind the counter suggested... I just wanted a snack / so just an order of fries for me! 
They were really bland and sort of soggy? I saw a counter with sauces and sprinkles and thought 'AWESOME'!!! There was only one sauce that I found to be OK, I think the chipotle something? And the sprinkles were great in theory - but didn't translate well. I tried a garlic powder and something else... it just didn't work. 
I wouldn't recommend...
Delish fries with lots of seasoning options. Hamburgers and kid food is ok, we go there for the fries.
Good stuff. Ribs and brisket is good! Sweet tea is amazing. I will be back!free ice cream.
Been there before not bad.  Went today took tacos home 3 minutes away.  Absolutely cold all 5 different tacos.  I will never go back.  It was gross.  I will not recommend this place to anyone.

Found this little gem during a Boise visit.  Being from Portland and having access to excellent food I have high standards.  
The service was professional.  The dishes were top notch.  Fair pricing and large servings... we came home with enough leftovers for another meal for 2 for $40.  I recommend highly!

I am kind of surprised to see this place has such a low rating. We've been there three times now. Twice for UFC events and once for bowling with our child.

All three times we found that staff to be very friendly and accommodating.

Yes, it is pretty loud here and there are plenty of teenagers and young adults around. It's a sports bar/arcade/restaurant/bowling alley. I wouldn't expect anything different. 

It's a very large facility and is well maintained, all of the areas we have utilized thus far were very nice.

This is the best place to watch UFC thus far, when BWW is loaded down we can easily get in at Al's and always get amazing seats. There is a 5.00 per person cover charge.

This is definitely not the cheapest place but it has a lot of perks to make up for it.

The food is pretty tasty. It is good bar food.

All in all, assuming you consider the type of place you are at, it's pretty nice.

This place is a french fry place and nothing more. I was extremely disappointed in my bison burger due to over cooking. They make the patties super thin to speed up cooking for mass production but the stoners in the back cooking clearly dont pay attention to how long they cook the burgers. Super super dry and over cooked. I wish I had four arms to give this burger 4 thumbs down. I'm giving this place 2 stars only because.the ketchup is.good and the fries are tasty.  Big disappointment.

My car broke down in Meridian, Idaho, in the middle of a road trip and the staff at John's were incredibly helpful in helping me through my auto troubles.  The staff at John's were all very helpful and respectful and I felt the charges for services were very fair.  Thanks to the staff there for their friendliness!  I would highly recommend John's in the future.
Wanted yam fries, but they were out of them so took sweet potato fries, which turned out to be way undercooked and very greasy. Yuk! Wouldn't go back.

A sit down place to grab Mexican food, ok then. I understand it's a bit more than take out but my family can dine here like twice a year or so. Seriously. We are looking for good, cheap food but this only covers the good part. It's a bit americanized in that the tacos are like taco bell tacos. The rice is good though and I love their chips and salsa app (free) before the meal.

The staff at Fleet Feet is phenomenal! They truly listen and have the technology to assess your feet and make proper recommendations. I have bought 3 pairs of shoes here and will not go anywhere else!
Great family fun. Bowling, food, and arcade. Food is a little pricey, but tastes great. Kids get a $5 arcade card with the purchase of a kids meal.

Called in for a take out order.  Very confused order process.  Order not correct; called again still issues.  Got the food.  Cold.  Second attempt at ordering from this restaurant.   Not good either time.  Skip this restaurant.  And both times issues with their pricing.  Disappointing .

Chris and Kyle did a great job on my Denali. Best detailers I've ever seen and I've been through a lot of them. Professional and on time. Did not grease my leather all up or overuse their products. Made my vehicle look like new.
Top notch service, my Shepard was in desperate need of a wash and de shed. My groomer Matt was professional and great with my fur baby. Had him all cleaned up in no time

Too bad the tacos don't look like the pictures.  The tacos we had were very tiny, had little inside and were cold.  

Chips were good.

You can certainly build a delicious burger here! I prefer doing a bowl (1/2lb chicken). It seems like bigger portions & about the same price. Plus it's healthier! We have had 2 great experiences here & the servers/managers went out of their way to make our experience great. If you had a bad experience here the first time, I would definitely give this place another shot. It's a bit over priced but not bad.
Average hotel, friendly staff, easy to get to, quiet, comfortable beds, adequately clean. I'd say 2.5 rather than 3. It is fine for a night at a reasonable rate if you are passing through.

Been coming to the Ram for 5 years, tonight was by far the best experience.  They've been consistently making improvements lately, not the least of which being a much needed FRY change.  They listened to the reviews, got rid of the soggy steak cut and switched to a thin cut, so much better!  Everything we ordered tonight was awesome and service was excellent.  Order anything with confidence and try the Armadillo Eggs appetizer, crazy good!

The best part was I called on the weekend and got in nearly 2 days later!! Jenny managed to get my mangly golden retriever back into shape! He has a shiny fluffy coat again and looks about 10lbs lighter with all the deshedding she did! She was fast and efficient and the best part was she came to us even sooner than expected as well as all the focus was on our precious chewy! We love the fact that we didn't have to leave and expose chewy to other dogs germs being a germaphobe wasn't really what we had planned but after contracting fleas not once but twice from the local franchised pet store groomers we have found our new clean and shiny groomers! Make sure to try them out and get your discount! Chewy is super happy from pampering as well!

I have been coming to this nail salon for over a year . Amazing customer service ! V does my nails
and Brittany does my daughters nails.  I make an appointment every time we go and never have to wait . Great service and I highly recommend Brittany for nail design work .

I've been eating at Boise Fry Company for years, first at the Broadway location, then Bown, and now the Meridian location!  I've even been to the State St location, and they are all great!  I was pumped when I was told that a new location was opening just 2 miles from my house (Meridian), since the others are all pretty far away.  

I've eaten at this BFC probably 5 times already, and it's every bit as good as the others!  The main difference is that this one is PACKED at lunch time.  Get there early, or come in a little later, otherwise seating can be hard to come by.  

The food is great!  Hand formed patties, these aren't perfectly shaped, instead looking much like they would if you made them at home.  Fresh buns, simple toppings, there's nothing not to like about the burgers.  

And then there's the fries!  If you love fries, you'll love BFC.  You can choose your potato and the cut of the fries.  I prefer regular or homestyle (thick cut), but there are other options as well.  In addition to the selection of fries, there are a number of sauces and salts to season your fries perfectly.  My favorite is a mixture of cajun, smoked, and vanilla salts!  

The portions are not huge here, but are plenty, especially if you don't want to feel lethargic after a huge lunch.  

The staff is a friendly, sort of hipster bunch, and they give the place a good vibe.  If you like burgers and fries (who doesn't?!), BFC is definitely worth a try!

This is a great Thai restaurant with all of the classic dishes. The wait is never long and the staff is very friendly. I recommend most of the coconut curry dishes except the Beef Massamun Curry. The potatoes make it far too bland.

The Tom Kha soup is very good. I'm no Thai food expert but the food here is delicious.

Small and intimate place. The staff is friendly and attentive. I went in with a huge group and still had great service. The pizza was great quality and had it own unique names. I had the fungus amungus which was a basil pesto sauce with goat cheese and mushrooms! A few people I was with got the spaghetti and meatballs. I really want to get that next time.  They have a decent list of beers on tap too. Definitely will be going back here

Too expensive for the quality. Service was slow for a restaurant with few customers and lots of help. The Impossible burger is impossible to eat. It is cooked into a meatball. Out of three burgers at the table, the medium rare burger had some juice and flavor. The medium and medium well burgers were dry and tough with just a hint of pink in the medium. The toughness makes the burger patty impossible to squish so the thickness of the burger patty makes them impossible to bite into. The end cap of the tomato with skin means you get the whole tomato in the first bite. The shoestring fries are dry and crunchy, more like shoe string potatoes in a can or bag. 
I should have gone to the other side of the parking lot to The Habit Burger Grill. 
The design of the restaurant is definitely not wheel chair or walker friendly. Too many tight corners and narrow pinch points. 
Try again....

Burgers are great. But if the person at the cash register is coughing into her hands then handing you cups, preparing milkshakes, it's pretty off putting. Please train employees about spreading germs!

We are on a total Sawadee kick-- for the past 2 years!  They always have great food we have eaten so many things in the menu I can't list them all here but some of the highlights are- green chicken curry; swimming Rama; the house noodles; spring rolls. My husband always orders something different and even if he wasn't blown out of the water by it, he was NEVER disappointed. Whatever you order is going to taste like what you ordered. The only issue here sometimes is service being slow. Reallllllllllyyyyyyy ssssssslllllllooowwwwww. The shining star and always the exception to that is Derek. He is one of the best servers ever anywhere. We always ask to be in his section now. The kitschy decor is cool. The most often seen live music- Lyle Sinclair- is great!  He and his buddy just sing song after song in a relaxed way without overwhelming the space. And they are good musicians! We always appreciate talent.

Is there a new baker or is this the norm? I was recommended this place but the bagels have disappointed me. It was my first time and I ordered 2 everything bagels with cream cheese lightly toasted. The bagels tasted "off." Almost like they were missing a key ingredient or I was given a day old bagel. I refuse to accept that this is the standard for Blue Sky and I'll give them another shot especially since my review is completely different from the others. I'm also a New Yorker who ate a bagel pretty much everyday for breakfast. I decided to eat these bagels for dinner-did I also mention I'm 35 weeks pregnant lol. Maybe all of this contributes to my 2 star review, but I'd like to make it clear that the staff was very nice (even though I had to take a phone call-typical New Yorker I know!) I really hope I can update this review to 5 stars but so far my favorite bagels in the Treasure Valley are from Sarah's bagels in Nampa!

Went there once for water pump and found out after repairs were done how over priced they are. Have never been back, would not recommend this place to anyone, call around and get a second opinion, most places do same quality work for a lot less! Not looking for discounts from a friend, just best pricing. You can call around and get better pricing from other places. If you go here bring your platinum card, cause you will pay for it

If you haven't tried this bagel shop you are missing out! Everything is made in house and you can taste it! I got their bagel and soup and it was phenomenal! The honey Walmart spread had chunks of Walmart! And their asiago cheese bagel was fantastic!

When you first go in it's a little confusing as to where you order because the cash register is near the entrance. But the staff is super nice and they quickly pointed us in the right direction. 

The staff recommendations were on point. 

If you're in the area I highly recommend you stop by and have lunch

The food was great. Service awesome.Atmosphere nice. It was a little bit pricey but I felt that it was really good quality. We had the sliders, and two build your own burgers. Everyone's patties were cooked perfectly. Meat was most and flavorful. Buns were soft and tasty. Obviously this place is about choices and the toppings and sauces were seemingly endless. Only reason I'm not giving it 5 stars is that it is a little expensive. My criteria always ends with the question 'would I go back? ' The answer is yes.

We have always wanted In n Out to come to Idaho but THe Habit is great. First time here and closest I have seen to the other. Fresh ingredients, presented very well, fries were excellent. I think we have a new favorite. The tempura green beans are awesome. Fantastic burgers.

Love the sports bar at Big Al's! We just stopped by to grab a quick bite and I instantly loved it. It's a really large room with one massive TV and 8 large TVs up where everyone can see. We sat in the very back and could easily watch the football, baseball, and volleyball that was playing. There are also a bunch of small TVs that are great for people sitting at the bar. There is a huge mural of the Boise State blue turf which is really cool and catches your eye the moment you walk in. There is a ton seating with tables, booths, and bar seating. 
This seems like the perfect place to come watch a game or a fight. I would love to come back someday to experience a Boise State game here. 
We ordered the artichoke dip and a caesar salad. The Dip comes with "homemade chips" which tasted suspiciously similar to Tostitos. They weren't bad but we were expecting more homemade tasting chips. The dip itself was awesome. You can really tell they make it fresh. I ending up scraping the bowl with a spoon because it was so good. 
The salad was average. It had a bit too much dressing on it but the croutons were very good. They were unique. They were soft and moist and I believe they were fried. They tasted kind of sweet. Unfortunately there were only 4 on the whole salad.
There were 3 or 4 tables total in the whole place at the time so you would expect the service to be relatively good but unfortunately it was pretty slow.
Overall, this place is great and I can't wait to come back and cheer on Boise State and try some other menu options.

I went with my adult son here for dinner. It took a bit longer than we expected for our server to greet us and ask if we wanted anything to drink (she walked right past us) so we were concerned we were in for some bad service, however once she greeted us, she did a great job and was attentive without being overbearing. She was friendly and provided great service. 

I had the salmon dinner and my son had the fish and chips. Both of our dinners were good and were served hot. The only "complaint" we could have is the french fries could have been crispy. Overall a nice dinner.

This place is busy for a reason! Delicious, love it! My service was great, got the first sandwich on the list, it was huge!! The double chocolate brownie, lemon almond bar, and Easter sugar cookie for my son. Wish I bought more! Please, please, put one in Nampa!!! please!

We were excited to try the Boise Fry Company but were disappointed with the food.  We tried 2 of the different burgers and didn't care for either one. The patty had no seasoning that we could discern. If you enjoy the taste of beef or bison with no other flavor then you might like it. Very little sauce to add any flavor either. If you're looking for a tasty burger , this is not the place. 

The people working there were friendly and enjoyable :)
And the place was clean. 

The novelty of the different types of spuds with various sauces and seasonings is worth a trip for the experience , however we were disappointed in those as well. 

Will not be returning. A little pricey for a burger as well.  Wish I could of loved it! A novel idea.

I would give zero stars if I could. Came here to bowl with friends two weeks after moving to Idaho, had no problem at all getting served while at the lanes. Switched to the bar to watch the UFC fight and was caught at the bar for a solid 30 minutes when I was told that they wouldn't accept my out of state ID (issued In 2018) based on a 2017 ID guideline book. After I pointed out that he was referencing a 2017 ID book and my ID in fact stated it was issued in 2018 he replied with 'I googled it and were not accepting it'. I feel discriminated against Bc I am from out of state and was presented with no real proof that my ID WAS 'fake'. When I asked him to test it with a black light, he replied, nowhere in Boise tests with a black light, which is false, everywhere downtown does. Moral of the story here is I would not recommend visiting here, they don't know what they're doing, they're not in compliance with the law when presenting out of date ID materials, and they have no concern for maintaining positive customer relations.

This place is HUGE! Great for a night out, or to spend the whole day. Their restaurant isn't what you'd expect from a sports bar as they have everything from Burgers, Salads, and Wraps to awesome steaks. The restaurant has these massive projectors and a stadium feel that is really unique. One of the best places to watch sports, and they keep the schedule for the big screen on their website which is convenient. 

Aside from the restaurant there is a massive bowling alley. Its split into 2 parts, there is a main bowling section, and a more private section with some nicer seating and amenities. It gets very busy on the weekends so you'll want to come early. Unfortunately they don't do reservations at all unless you plan ahead with an event. This can be rough on game nights and weekends but visits during the week are usually easy to get a lane or a seat in the restaurant.

Lastly there is a whole arcade area upstairs as well as a 21+ private bar area. The arcade is massive with tons of games for all ages. They definitely have the most and the coolest prizes of all the other entertainment places around. The private bar area is super nice as well with a sweet view down to the big screens in the restaurant, plus they have pool, darts, and some retro games. 

Their loyalty program is really nice too!

By far I am the most critical of sandwich, sub and deli food as I grew up eating some of the best and everything gets compared to those memories.  On a business trip through Boise ID I happened upon Fat Guy's Fresh Deli, a no-nonsense and unpretentious sandwich counter.  I ordered The Tony's Pastrami on rye with potato salad.  Full disclosure, I experienced Pastrami nirvana at Nate-N-Al's in Beverly Hills so this test of Fat Guy's was probably not a fair one.

With the slogan "Always trust a fat sandwich" plastered everywhere I was a bit underwhelmed by the sandwich itself.  Having said that, their food was fresh, potato salad definitely seemed homemade and the sandwich was good, just not Nate-N-Al's good.  The staff was friendly and the restaurant clean and sunny, a welcome respite on this trip.

Fat Guy's Fresh Deli is a solid 3.5 but as that is not an option, I am giving it a 4.

So far I've enjoyed everything I've tried here, but the list isn't long. I had the chocolate peanut butter cupcake. It was moist and tasty.  Nothing I fell in love with, but still decent.  However, the raspberry bread pudding is a completely different story. It is a MUST try. It has a delicious raspberry flavor- not too bitter or sweet. The bread isn't dry or hard. It also comes with creamy and delicate vanilla custard. It's beyond delicious and a perfect combination to the tart raspberry flavor. They also have a drive through, which is convenient if you want to pick up a fresh loaf of bread. I'll be back to try some of their breads and will update my review.  I went around 7 pm on a Saturday, and it was quiet. If that's the case during the day, it could be a great place to have a treat and enjoy a book.

Dad & I tried Sa Wad Dee today and we really enjoyed it.   We'll definitely be back!

Our server, Brianna, was an absolute delight.   We'll be asking for her next time.  If I owned a restaurant, I'd try to hire her away.   Food came very quickly and our water/soda was refilled efficiently.

I really like Pad Woonsen (clear glass noodles) and order it whenever I try a new Thai place.  It was very good!   The beef was tender and the vegetables were cooked just enough.

The Asparagus Delight that my Dad had was very good, too.   (See the photo I uploaded -- there was an orchid atop it!)   Nice big shrimp and pieces of tender chicken accompanied the al dente asparagus and a generous amount of sauce.    There was enough of this for leftovers.  :)

The sushi was fresh and had a very good rice-to-filling ratio.  Pretty presentation.

A woman sitting at the table next to us had a large bowl of noodles, meat and broth.   We asked Brianna about it, and she said it was Tom kha.   It'll likely make its way onto my table next time we visit.
So many different choices, and the food is delicious!  The Baja shrimp tacos are my favorite, and the bacon egg breakfast tacos are a close second.  Guacamole and queso are also delicious!

Our baby goes to New Horizon for a year now and we couldn't be happier. We love how secure the daycare is, requiring ID and a secret access code to enter the premises. The teachers are well versed in childhood education and are patient with the kids from what I've seen. Rates are fair, typical for a daycare but you get what you pay for. High quality care. Special shout-out to Miss Paty, Miss Erika and Miss Ashley. They have been so wonderful to our princess. Miss Amber is a wonderful director and always helpful answering questions. Our son also attends New Horizon during the summer and he attended as a baby 7 years ago.

I'm a fan of bbq pork ribs but not from here! I just ordered the ribs with 2 sides. One Mac and cheese the other creamy spinach. I got these really soggy green beans and 2 sides of Mac. You can't really mess up Mac and cheese so thanks for the 2. But these ribs were no bueno. They were falling off the bone tender but they tasted like boiled plain unseasoned ribs! Literally a had no taste to them. I was very disappointed. I'm a cook myself and I could definetly say I can make better ribs then that. I am pretty sure they were not freshly cooked. They taste like they were made last weekend and was microwaved to order. You're not fooling me!

UPDATE!!!!!!! 
 
It's only been about 2 hours or so since I had your food and Im already having signs of food poisoning! Wow, thanks a lot! YOUR RIBS ARE CRAP!!!!

Boise Fry Co. is doing a ton of things right that need to be applauded. From sourcing the best possible potatoes to the grass fed beef and bison to their intentions of leaving as little a foot print as possible, you can really feel good and support their mission statement. But execution has to be part of that statement. My experience had some wonderful positives and one huge negative. The burger was a masterpiece and the Po' Balls were a huge letdown. I would have thought it the other way around. The Po' Balls were overcooked. They had an off putting taste that needed to be masked with a dipping sauce. They were not over cooked that I felt I needed to be a pain and have them re-done but their color should have been a clue not to send out. Execution. I love the taste of potato so if I can avoid a dipping sauce I do. Since I couldn't I found a bevy of choices and the clear winner was their Blueberry Ketchup. It turned my overcooked balls into a sort of tasty dessert. The burger was out of this world. I ordered the Original (cheddar, spring mix, tomato, red onion gastrique and a garlic aioli on a pillowy bun). The burger was perfectly griddled and was seasoned nice. The gastrique and aioli made for a sweet and savory bite that was fantastic. Burger 4 stars and the potato was 2. To sum up went to a fry joint and got a fantastic burger.

First visit to Meridian a few weeks ago and we ate at this restaurant. Good food, good service. We looked forward to eating here again when we returned to town.
2nd time eating here was last night. Work hours dictated take out instead of dine-in. Got the food home, started eating, and all 3 of us were totally disgusted.
Carne asada burrito was so salty that a 2-pack-a-day smoker couldn't tolerate it. Second meal was beef enchiladas that had shredded beef inside of tortillas, with enchilada sauce on top. That's all- plain, dry shredded beef inside a tortilla, with sauce over it. Folks, you could do far better with a Stouffer's frozen enchilada dinner from Albertson's.
Our last dinner was the fried fish- we ordered the trout. A whole butterflied trout that was so over-cooked that it was not edible. At all! And it was as salty as the carne asada burrito! The whole meal was drenched with oil, as if the fish was pulled out of the fryer and dropped directly onto the veggies and rice. 
Two out of our 3 meals went in the trash. This place is garbage.
You can do far better than this!

I rarely leave reviews--but our experience at this sandwich place was TOP NOTCH! We were looking for a good sandwich as we passed through town on a family road trip and they delivered! The gentleman I believe is the owner was attentive and super friendly to everyone the entire time we were in the deli. He made custom sandwiches for our kids (amazing!) and our orders were so fresh and delicious! The pesto mayo was delish and I've never tasted anything like their homemade potato salad (which somewhat reminded me of a German style salad but the flavors were unique). Bread was incredible - so fresh! My picky nine year old was making happy noises as he devoured his pastrami and bacon sandwich. My hubby finished his but my four kiddos and I are saving the leftovers for dinner. Thanks again for an awesome experience from start to finish!
The BEST soup and sandwiches in town! Highly recommend the #11 Blue Bronco but can't go wrong with any of them.

Nice clean place....employees are very friendly and the food comes out very fast.

I love their char burgers with fries. Portion sizes are spot on...enough for a big meal.

Drinks are self serve...as are condiments for your meal.

Definitely a good good place for burgers and fries.

I travel for work 26 weeks out of the year and often like to stay at the Hampton Inn and/or Hilton brand hotel (Hilton Honors Member) because they are consistent in service.  Most if not all of my experiences with the Hilton Brand are great but unfortunately this location is exception to the rule.  

Got a room that smelled so I asked to changed room and the lady at the counter did changed my room but it seem like it was an inconvenience for her because it was an unusual request and that she had not had this type of request before.  

I accidently lock myself out of the room and the same person at the counter wasn't too pleasant and nice to help out but she did.

This is very usual to have this type of experience at a Hampton Inn and/or Hilton Brand.

So this is my second time coming here I was hoping to probably have a better experience here with the taste of food but it doesn't seem like I got that different experience. The food looks good and the description makes it sound very delicious but there's nothing to me that seems to make the burger stand out. I had the mushroom char burger. I challenge anyone who wants to try this place out to do so you might enjoy the food better than me :)

I shopped 15 different furniture stores.  I went to the large furniture store off the freeway (RC Willy).  On that particular day, I was rushing around because I just moved into my house.  I was wearing sweats and had hair pulled up, I guess I looked like I could not afford furniture, because I was completely ignored.  I just kept thinking to myself, I have a 4-bedroom 2 living room house to furnish and I can not get any attention.  
Granted I am from Alaska and I am also very frugal, but I want some bang for my buck.  I found other furniture stores overpriced for the quality of furniture. 

I walked into Meridian home furnishing, don't expect the flashy floor room, expect a family run business.  They are amazing. I was looking around the floor and the salesperson was so helpful.  When another couple walked in she said "excuse me while I help this couple, we run on a very short staff so we can pass on the discounts to you."  She was so professional and "Honest."  This family run business helped me furnish my whole house.  Every room.  Some of the furniture on the floor room, was not what I was looking for, I wanted a little better quality, so they helped me shop through catalogs to buy inexpensive, quality furniture.  
I absolutely love my bar stools - we picked out restaurant quality.
My power sectional couch is simply amazing!!!

I simply love my bedroom furniture and also picked out an adjustable base - It is very similar to really expensive Tempur-Pedic I bought in Alaska.

If you want quality and to support a locally run business, spend the time at this store.  They will not steer you wrong.
Way too overpriced. I would go to the lanes in garden city if you are wanting to bowl.

Amazing sandwiches! The Blue Bronco has to be the best sandwich I've ever eaten! 

Chef Wally is a true artist, and will create anything you want.

If you want amazing sandwiches, head to 2 Fat Guys, don't miss out!

The absolute, most terrible, tacos I have ever put in my mouth hole. Serious question here; how do you make something that is so easy to make really really well and make it so very bad? I had the chorizo and egg, the tin roof and a fajita chicken. The chorizo was black. Literally burnt to a crisp. The chicken was over cooked, lacked flavor and was dry. The pulled whatever that was in the "tin roof" was congealed and flavorless. The only thing that was positive was the price. Floors and tables and drink stand we're filthy. Do yourself a favor, save your money and go somewhere else. Anywhere else.

What can I say? If you want real-deal Thai food, go to Sa-Wa-Dee! Ornate atmosphere and design transform your dining experience in the restaurant. The food is incredible and this place does not mess around when it comes to Thai heat and spice! Traditional yet amazing food choices. In my humble opinion, always go for the Pad See Eww or Red Curry. Their Panang Curry is great, too! Noodles are life, especially when you're talking Thai food.

Really good food and great options for people with different food preferences like vegan/gluten free. Our server Jesse S was incredibly friendly and accommodating to our requests. You absolutely have to try the birthday cake milkshake. Will definitely be returning.

This review is for arcade only::

It was a "meh". Went to the arcade for my son's birthday before the movies and thought we'd be spending a few hours playing arcade games. We were done about 45 minutes into it. There were a quite a few games out of order and a few that could use some maintenance (joysticks not responding well, pinball flippers getting stuck etc). Didn't like the odd pricing ($1.15 for some games??) I understand that they're probably more about dinning and bowling but the arcade was "meh". Also the bathrooms were dirty and could use someone checking on them more often. We did let an employee know so hopefully it was remedied. Honestly, we'll probably be going back to Wahooz for more of a family arcade night.

Grants is a such a hidden gem. It's pretty inconspicuous in strip mall but don't let the location deceive you! We've never been disappointed. We've tried everything from sandwiches and burgers to steaks, salmon and gnocchi. Everything is always fresh, delicious and presented very well. While it's relatively small, there's a fantastic patio when weather is good and the garage door rolls up and makes it feel bigger. The staff is also excellent, attentive and will take great care of you. Grants does take reservations and would recommend if you're going for weekend dinner or holidays.

Went in for my wife's birthday to have a laid back casual dinner and maybe some bowling, had a few drinks our friends met us and we ordered our food, apps were good service from the bartender was great..........then they brought our burgers which all had been bacon burgers of some variation. The bacon was raw on every burger, and no not just a little bit on the ends I mean translucent raw, having been a cook for many many years I was shocked but ok mistakes happen although it was visible before we even bit into our burgers not sure how it was able to leave the kitchen like that. A manager happened by and we showed her and she didn't say anything and took one of the burgers, when we tried to tell her it was all of ours she snapped and said "I only need one!" My friend tried to tell her to just forget it we didn't want to eat there now and as she was walking away said something over her shoulder in a rude tone we could t quite make out, we watched her at the window to the kitchen shrugging and shaking her head, which myself having worked in kitchens knew already what the conservation was "yeah it's fine I don't know what their problem is." Little did they know they were serving someone who worked as a cook for over 10 years. The manager came back and just said "they are remaking your burgers!" She then stormed off and never once said sorry or tried to apologize at any time, after her rude service we decided just to leave, and pay our drink tab. As we walked out to go to a different restaurant that would serve us cooked food, we happened to walk past the kitchen at which point a different manager was overheard telling his cook "those are the people that complained" and then the glaring stares from the kitchen as we walked out. Won't ever return, maybe they should find some staff in the kitchen who actually have some pride and passion, and some managers who actually have some customer service skills, I would have been so embarrassed had I been working in that kitchen and let four hamburgers leave the window with raw in cooked bacon, and then to let the floor staff treat us like it was our fault your cooks are a bunch of microwave warriors, with no standards.

Won't be back.  Passing through Meridian Idaho stopped here for dinner.  The place looked quaint and the service was very nice but the Pizza the pits.  My wife and I shared the Whitewater pizza, a garlic chicken, basil and alfredo combination that was completely flavorless on a doughy undercooked crust.  Pass this one by.
This place never disappoints! The deli fries are AMAZING, and we have never had a bad sandwhich. The customer service is awesome, you can really tell they care about their customers.

There are a few Thai options in Boise but Sa-Wad-Dee is my fav.  Prices are reasonable and selections are plenty.  Service has always been very courteous and prompt.  Overall very pleased with Sa-Wad-Dee.

Note: for a Thai joint they have a pretty good selection of Sushi that is pretty decent.

We have always loved this place but this is the third time we have come in and sat down at the open seating area and were completely ignored for 45 minutes. This time no one came to serve us for an HOUR and even after hunting down a waitress during their slowest time i've ever seen she said she would come back and never did. Even the manager on duty walked by us multiple times and never even said anything or asked if we were helped. We ended up having to walk up to the bar and get our beers and never even got food. This was our go-to place but no longer.

Dad and I have been enjoying burgers & such here since shortly after opening day.  (We attempted opening day, but it was freezing outside!)

The yeays:
 - Burgers are very good. They also come half-wrapped so messy eaters like me won't drip!
 - Other nice sandwich options like an ahi tuna filet, chicken club, tri-tip steak, veggie burger.
 - Lots of salad options.
 - Three different kinds of tea and a tasty strawberry lemonade are drink options, in addition to soda.  All are available for refills.
 - Char Club doesn't sent too many messages, and when it sends one there's a great offer inside.
 - The staff is friendly and they keep the restaurant clean.

The nays:
 - Not enough seating.  We've been here twice when there was not a single place to sit.  We had to wait.
 - Lighting is dimmer than we'd like.
 - Unlike 5 Guys, mushrooms cost extra
 
We'll certainly be going back.

I visit family here in Meridian couple times a year, I'm from California and I can honestly say Fat Guys has the BEST Sandwiches I've ever tasted! Amazing sandwiches and soups.....you have to try the Jalapeno bacon soup! Wally and his crew are the best! Can't wait to visit again and chow down some Fat Guys sandwiche and some delicious soup!
Love their food but not always consistent on the amount of sauce on the tacos that can be frustrating. Love how quick it is and the simple atmosphere.
My new favorite burger joint in the valley. Great food, great service and affordable prices. I loved the onion rings with a Charburger.

The atmosphere is very relaxing. The service is dreadful. I ordered a margarita and after 20 minutes I asked where it was. No one had put in the order. When it finally arrived, it was wrong. After 40 minutes our server asked if she had taken our order, which she had. Two taco salads arrived, which were marginal, and we had to flag down the waitress for water. This was on a Monday. I can't imagine how dreadful the service is on a busy day. We will not be back.
Love this place soup salad or sandwich all are good. But my favorite is the baked goods.
Been living here two years and finally got to this place. Been missing out. Unreal subs with great service from the top down. Cool sports vibe too. Solid.
Awesome variety and fresh taste!! They are very fast and prices are more than reasonable. The chips and queso is a must!

I believe I am probably one of the most particular about how my vehicle is handled and who I allow to touch it. I dropped my 2017 Ford F150 Lariat FX4  off at Dynamic Detailing and just a few hours later picked it up only to be absolutely amazed at what an incredible job these guys do. The level of detail is astounding. While I'm sure there are others out there that are good, these guys are great. We also took our 2016 Toyota Sienna which had been lived in by three 9-year-old boys on our road trip. The leather seats were fully reconditioned, the carpets were meticulously vacuumed and cleaned, all of the channels and grooves were thoroughly vacuumed and cleaned out, windows, trim and door jams were immaculate. Trust me I looked. Get the Platinum package and you won't be disappointed.
Don't forget to ask for military discount. The most professional and friendly staff I've ever had the pleasure to work with.
We LOVE this place. Great tacos for a very affordable price. It's never a long wait and my favorites are Fajita chicken and Fried chicken. Delicious.

I wish there were more stars! Austin Creek Dental has amazing staff and Dr Hansen is an awesome and very honest dentist. If something needs to be done the staff is upfront about the costs. Nothing worse than having a surprise bill. Clean office with up to date technology. Great dentist for the entire family. The ceiling has a TV so you can watch and listen during your procedure.

Wife got the #16 Trevor Melt and I got the #2 "Those Damn" Californian Turkey Club.  Ok, ok, I added "those damn".  Anyway, both sammies were amazing.  In fact they looked so fantastically delicious that the wife failed to take a picture before eating AND she never forgets to take a picture folks!  Drop on in, tell em its your first time and ask them for suggestions!

I love this nail place so much! I've come here 3 times now and i've loved what they've done every time. They have great customer service and are super friendly! They do a really good job every single time and have great prices. I highly recommend Nail Tel and Spa!

Top notch work.  Extremely reliable, knowledgeable, honest and hard working.  Steve did seemingly endless research to make sure the job was perfect from start to finish.  He used the best products and still maintained a fair price.  His attention to detail and job management makes him stand out as top-tier in the Treasure Valley.  My new egress windows are no doubt the best in Meridian. Steve is the contractor you don't need to compare any others against.

I've never had a problem with CapEd or this branch location. Their app and website have improved too. We started here with a car loan but the app improvements and newer policy allowing me to download statements for 24 months was enough to get me to move all my accounts over. Goodbye big Bank fees hello interest on my balances. They donate to local schools too!

2 stars because of service and attitude. Food I can give a 3. The sandwiches and burgers were very good The MAC and cheese runny. My Chefs salad mediocre. My grandson ordered a quesadilla. I didn't notice until he finished there was a dingy brownish dollop of something on his plate. It was the guacamole. Totally old and inedible. When I asked the waitress she said she'd ask the manager who we watched roll her eyes for us questioning it.
Our bill came to 100 dollars. I felt she could have comped us a happy hour beer or something. Anyway snootiness will keep us from going back. I think a good manager would want repeat business.

We love Papa John's. It's the only pizza place we order from anymore. The food is consistently fresh and yummy. The delivery is (almost) always quick. And the prices are great!

I can't comment on the poor customer service other reviewers go on about because it's 2016 and we order online like most reasonable people.

I love Dutch as much if not more as the next guy, but, the last couple times I've been to this location it seems as if the baristas are only concerned about having fun and sitting on the window ledges flirting with the patrons. I get being overly nice but this is too much, especially for the age groups that work here. They need to try focusing more on customer service and making sure they aren't making drink mistakes.

Wow, I had a really similar experience as "Braden H." from Nampa a few reviews down from here. The CLEARLY OVERWORKED manager lady was yelling at an employee that he was an idiot. Not sure why, it is a lot of youngsters in there, but they work really hard. Also, the managers close the store randomly?  Like, they turned the lights off on me and a few other guests. How does Taco Time corporate allow this? Quite strange. I honestly didn't think I could ever recommend Taco Bell over, well, anywhere, but here we are.

Went there for dinner and I ordered the original cheeseburger. My friend and I shared the listed tots and fried pickles. The loaded tots were supposed to have cheese on them. But it looked like it was only on the bottom. As if if had cooked in, and some tots looked like they were burned. There was maybe one strip of bacon... maybe even half a strip of bacon used for them also.  They definitely lacked flavor. The fried pickles were ok. But they lacked flavor
Also. The dipping sauce they gave was just weird and didn't compliment them. Best thing about the pickles is that they were crunchy. My burger seriously had no flavor. I ate half of it. I dislike how they put all the topping in the bottom and the burger on top of them. I always go in thinking that they place will be better, and I'm always disappointed.  The one good thing was the pineapple Moscow mules. But that was $9. Not worth it.

Tiffany from sales and the staff are top-notch. I've had nothing but a great experience at Hampton Inn & Suites, Meridian. The facility is clean and decorated in good taste. A great place for families and events, as I booked an event there and Tiffany worked with me and made the process simple.

I'll admit... I had fun.... but holy mother of Jesus  $14 dollars for a "bucket" margarita! And it was no more than about a 20oz cup!!! Drinks here are an absolute ripoff! $7.00 for a beer!! The food prices were so high we decided to cut out early and eat elsewhere!

I love this branch. Even when I'm annoyed with something I ultimately caused they go out of their way to show they appreciate my business, and always friendly. Don't always like the big company wellsfargo but love their customer service at almost every branch.

It has been almost a year since my last review and I have now been doing CrossFit for a year and a half. I still believe joining Fireside was one of the best decisions I ever made. I feel great and look forward to going. I love the coaches, the community and the programming. On top of working out there 4-5 times a week I see Catie the nutrition specialist. She is amazing and has helped me learn so much about what my body needs and doesn't. Since being here I have lowered my blood pressure enough that my doctor took me off of my medication. 

If you are looking to make a change in your life - there is nothing I would recommend more that trying CrossFit Fireside!

This was probably the worst customer service experience and food service I have ever had. Wanting to save some time, I stopped by the Meridian Taco Bell location. I ordered 3 items and a drink. I arrived at the window and paid. No drink was given to me at that time like normal fast food. After waiting 8 minutes, I was given the wrong order and had to ask for my drink. The gal didn't believe me that it was the wrong order and was rude. She went to go find my order and came back to tell me that they messed up and didn't make my food.  I said, "you're kidding". She responded, "No" and closed the window as I was talking. 8 more minutes go by. I am given my food without an apology. The Mexican fries were cold. No offer of a coupon to come back or anything.  I hadn't eaten at Taco Bell for over a year due to a previous bad experience.  Obviously nothing has changed. Ruse people. Bad customer service. Sub par food. Will not be back.

Excellent Work and very friendly..

I am very impressed with the work that was done, and the excellent customer service that was given. 

I totally forgot about the appointment I made and when I got a call from A+ I felt terrible, but he waited for me to rush home, and replaced my windshield.

Support a great local business like A+ you will not be disappointed..

Service is awful, employees are awkward and unorganized, don't know what they're doing. Employees either ignore you entirely and are too busy talking to help you properly. Overpriced, busy and always a wait for food or a lane. Arcade is lame. The building itself is super cool but the bowling and arcade are a joke at best.

We love this place. Their hamburgers are simply delicious, they have hamburgers for every taste. 
The price is affordable and the waiting time is great, especially considering their crowds during peak hours. 
Keep up the good job!

We tried the Fry Company on our last day of our Boise trip. I was really impressed with the quality of the food. Also the selection of fries was so fun. We will always visit the Fry Company on future trips

Didn't have any betas when I came they usually have stacks upon stacks of them but when I need to buy one they don't have any. I guess we did come late though and I bet they were can changing them out

This was my first time using a mobile groomer and boy was I impressed.  Dallas arrived on time and got to work grooming  my 14 year old cat that I recently "inherited".  I was concerned  Minnie would come out of this entire  experience stressed --- when she and Dallas emerged from the van Minnie was totally relaxed.  I would highly recommend Dallas and Aussie Pet Mobile.

I moved up here from southern CA and had practically lost all faith in finding decent Thai food here.  Ignoring the obsession this place seems to have with putting restaurants in strip malls, I tried this place.  AMAZING!  The food is super good...and you get the desired spice you ask for.  Unlike a lot of restaurants here where a 5 is really a 1 or 2.  

The portions are decent, but I rated it a four because it seems a bit on the pricey side.  The menu can be a little overwhelming since there are so many dishes to choose from.

I've been to every Thai place I could find here and this is the closest to authentic Thai as I've been able to find.

Fresh ingredients, decent sized portions, great usage of spice, perfectly cooked food...I haven't had a problem there yet.

Fiesta Guadalajara is your standard Mexican joint with an authentic atmosphere but doesn't quite deliver on food or service compared to some other local favorites like Mi Casa (Meridian) or Casa Mexico. 

Food: The chips and salsa (which comes with beans, which is nice), is just OK. The chips aren't too salty and the salsa isn't too chunky or hot, all of which I prefer. The bean dip is good on the side though! I've had the cheese crispy, which is one of the better cheese crispy's I've had as it's big, SUPER CHEESY and quite salty. Yum. The Super Burrito is super giant, but super bland, too. I recommend adding salsa to spice it up. To be honest, I'd rather have a Burrito Supreme from Taco Bell... which actually comes with burrito stuff in it, other than just rice, a bit of beans and too much meat. Blah. I don't like giving poor reviews, but Fiesta just doesn't stack up for me. 

Drinks: Everything on your typical Mexican menu. 

Atmosphere: Authentic Mexican with fun music in the background. Lots of separate rooms, which can accommodate bigger parties. 

Service: Slow at best. We had a large group last time we were there, and my husband and I ordered less than two minutes after the rest of the group. Our food took 26-minutes longer than everyone else's food to come. It was crazy. They were done eating by the time we began. Also, we asked if the cheese quesadilla was the same price as a chicken/beef quesadilla. Our server replied, "Well it's your choice if you want meat or not. It's the same price no matter what." We just don't often see service that ... bland. 

Happy Hour Offerings: n/a

Healthy Hack: Try their rice soup.

Tips: Go to Mi Casa or Casa Mexico instead.

Sunday 9/22 I get my bill with the kids meal included. I hear the waitress telling the other people that kids eat free. I asked why mine wasn't free. She says she cant do anything about it. I ask for the manager, who says she cant do anything about it but maybe the waitress can. Well, waitress already said she couldn't so who is on first and are you kidding me. I tell them I will leave this review and they flipped out and tried to, then give me the credit for the meal, which I declined because the thing was so dramatic with both employees yelling at me. I am convinced they are SCAMMING their employer and the customers out of discountable costs and refunding later an keeping the money. It resembles a criminal enterprise. Not a big money operation but still resembles a SCAM being run with that manager.

Best Thai in Boise!!! Great service. Delicious food and the guitarist is AWESOME!! Best dish is the basil duck. Word of warning when they say spicy it is SPICY!! My FIL is a retired firefighter and was unable to finish eating a 4 in one sitting. Can't wait to go again!

Stephen is an excellent example of how a contractor should be. He is on time, great work ethics, clean job site and his work is amazing and reasonably priced. I would recommend Stephen to anyone. Hands down one of the best contractors I have ever used. 

Satisfied customer

Amazing service! I am new to Boise, and I want to get back into running. I looked online, saw that Fleet Feet Sports wasn't too far from my house, and I decided to stop in. Fantastic service! I got 1 on 1 service with the manager- she was very friendly and knowledgeable. I will be returning for another pair of shoes soon!
Good place for brunch with fast service. Food tastes good. I would recommend it if you're on the go or if you would like to sit down and enjoy!

Tin roof tacos is deeelish! Definitely a great quick foodie stop. Atmosphere is casual and great for a group setting. Food is great, reasonably priced (2-2.50 per taco), and comes out nice and quick! Would recommend. :) And if you go make sure you try the apple cinnamon fried taco for dessert! So good.

Came in here with a buy one get one free coupon and my wife and I really enjoyed their brisket and pulled pork.  As for sides we tried the green beans and caesar salad.  I've been here a few times and haven't quite found a side that I enjoy.  I do love the rustic feel and look to the place.  They are always efficient in getting you through and who doesn't like a vanilla cone with your meal for dessert!

Great way to end 2014 on New Year's Eve morn with bagels at Blue Sky based on the recommendation of friend Carl Y who has provided my hubby and me with tip-top-tips on local gems since we moved to Eagle in mid 2014.  Maybe not Brooklyn bagels but pretty darned close says my hubby native of that NYC borough.  Blue Sky boils the bagels before baking, just as should be, lending chewy texture and bakes them on cornmeal dusted pan adding that "just right" element to the bottom.  We are new fans.

EATS
Friendly people behind the counter serving up bagels of many kinds.  There were people in and out on New Year's Eve day buying bags of bagels to go (94 cents each or less if buying a half dozen or more) or eating in bagels with a schmear (about a buck and a half) of many different kinds of cream cheese.  Several people were also enjoying what looked like generously sized bagel sandwiches, deli and breakfast styled both

For future reference I noted they have egg salad on the menu and also tuna salad.  There are not many places I trust to eat their tuna salad but this is on that list!  Next time.   

This time I can attest that the jalapeno cream cheese was really good on a sunflower seed bagel and so was the honey walnut cream cheese a winner on the cranberry orange bagel.

VALUE
Fair prices it seemed on all menu board items.  Two bagels with cream cheese and two cups of coffee clocked in at only about seven bucks, including tax. Great   value.

VIIBE
It smells wonderful when you enter this bright, light space with lots of room in aisles and between tables.  High seating and standard height table seating.  

THE DRILL
Line up at the counter to place your order.  One of the friendly staff will bring it to you when it is ready.  Get your own beverages (Dawson Taylor coffee is from a pump pot) and bus your own table when finished.  

THIS N THAT:

1) PARKING:  In the Millstone Market stip mall lot.

2) ACCESSIBILITY:  Level in and throughout.  Plenty of aisle space.  Standard height seating throughout. 

3) DAY OLD BARGAINS:  In the back of the shop is a basket with bags of day old bagels priced at five bagels for only two bucks.  Each bag holds one variety but there were several varieties in the basket.  Day old bagels make great strata, bread puddings, crutons and sliced up toasted as alternatives to regular crostini for snacks.  Finding those here was worth the trip even if we hadn't enjoyed delicious fresh bagels too!

4) TRIPLETS:  There are two other Blue Sky Bagel locations in Boise.  Same owner for all.

A great experience for both our dogs!  Booking was super easy, with convenient evening appointments available.  Jennie our groomer did a great job and our dogs looked amazing!  We found the right place for our fur babies, thank you Jennie!
Awesome gym!  Don't waste your time anywhere else.  This has been a life changing experience for me.

My dogs have always looked good after picking them up from getting groomed, I will give them credit for that but I am very unhappy with my last visit to their grooming department. I scheduled 2 appointments for my two yorkies both at 12:30 with two different groomers so they would get done at the same time. They told me 3 1/2 hrs. around 4 we went to go pick them up even though they didn't call yet. We didn't see them getting groomed through the window so we figured they were done. We go in to see the guy who was suppose to be grooming one of our yorkies, grooming  another large dog. He said it would be another hour and that he gave her a bath but hasn't started her grooming. He also said that my other yorkie was done but had two large dogs ahead of the other one he was suppose to be grooming. I was pretty upset considering I don't understand how you could groom two other dogs before mine when a smaller dog would be much faster than two large dogs. Ended up taking 5 hours. I scheduled my two dogs with two groomers for a reason, I do not like my dogs sitting in kennels all day. I don't kennel them myself. I don't think they let dogs out to potty while there because as soon as I got home one of my dogs peed in the house and they both were gulping down water. I will not be taking my dogs back.

This is a great place for tacos. I had the #2 Tin Roof, the fried chicken, the brisket and the Baja shrimp tacos. They were all delicious. I also tried their tomatillo and habenero sauces which were also a great compliment to the tacos. We ordered chips and pico and chips and guac. The guac is really good. They will also refill the chips for free if you want more. This is a great place to go for awesome tacos

I have wanted my nose pierced forever but I've always worried about if I could pull it off. I finally got the guts and did a little research. Since I'm in the customer service biz I take reviews with a grain of salt. I was impressed about how many people talked about the hygiene of this shop. I am in remission from stage 4 cancer so cleanliness is a huge deal for me now. I brought this up before I got pierced and was offered a tour of the place to make sure it was up to my Dr.'s standards. I was told exactly what was going to happen and felt comfortable the entire time. I can't remember my guys name (he was an apprentice) but he was so professional and kind. The girls at the front were helpful picking out a pretty stud and being honest. I wanted to go bigger and am extremely glad I didn't. They sent me with very clear instructions on how to take care of my piercing. It's only been a few hours but I'm very happy with my decision and recommend this shop. Thanks guys

Great nail place! Call ahead for appt. Decor is adorable with pink and grey artfully used. Clean and friendly. Many color and glitter choices. I was impressed with my mani/pedi so have made another appt for next month. Highly recommend Nail Tek.

My husband have been here a couple times now and it is great!  A nice selection of tacos both breakfast and lunch/dinner.  A nice selection of beers too.  Service is fast and friendly.  Give them a try if you haven't stopped in yet.

This is by far my favorite neighborhood pizza place. The quality is always up to par. I'm a crust person, it's flavorful and crispy. Yum! I also enjoy the sandwiches. If my kids want pizza and I'm wanting something different, it makes us all happy. The staff is amazing and attentive. There was a line for pick up, a delivery driver walked in and immediately asked for my name and got my order right out to me. Polite and friendly

Great Deli! Walked in and everyone is friendly and patient with the customers and the kids that were there. We were not sure of what to order so we got the Big Fat BLT's and a Mountain Man... this was AMAZING.  We were pleasantly surprised that the owner came out to see how everything was and he was friendly and fun! This is our new favorite, even our 8 and 11 year old kids loved it!  Great Job Chef Wally!

My husband and I loved this place.  We had excellent service, and great food.  We split a 1/2 pound burger on a Pretzel bun.... it was delicious and plenty for 2 people.  In addition we ordered the veggie skewers, and an order of sweet potato fries.  The skewers were excellent, and they even sub'd the mushrooms since neither of us care for them.  Loved the garlic aioli sauce.   We went for happy hour (till 6 p.m.) which has $3 beers..  my husband had a Mac and Jack which he loves.  We will be back!

It's interesting how the two of you remember this. At no point did we request "privacy"----we wanted help. We never yelled at another customer. We were just very frustrated with both of you. 
As for the matresss we bought, it was much more comfortable then yours. Of course, if we had been helped we might have bought a more expensive one at your place. 
Lastly, apologizing here might have shown that you were at least sorry and might have brought us back another time. However, it's clear from your attitude and comments that you don't desire or need any more customers----apparently you can't handle the ones you have.

We have always wanted In n Out to come to Idaho but THe Habit is great. First time here and closest I have seen to the other. Fresh ingredients, presented very well, fries were excellent. I think we have a new favorite!

This food is like homemade... BUT BETTER!!! The flavor is phenomenal, the service was excellent, and our meals came out piping hot! We will definitely be coming back and bringing all our family as well.
1 cashier and worlds slowest Jenny. I spent nearly 1/2 hour in line while Walmart employees decorated the front. Super frustrating

On recent travels thru Idaho we found ourselves at a local sports bar in the downtown area that was suggested by our hotel.  We found the food and drink to be great along with the area locals. Staff was very polite and helpful since we didn't really did not know our way around the city. A must for lunch or dinner in when in Boise.
Friendly service, decent drinks.  I do avoid this place if the lines are long but they are pretty good at moving the line and getting people through.
Amazing service and extremely nice techs! So happy we went here! Definitely will be returning
Turkey bacon avocado on foccacia. That is all. Oh, and the turtle cheesecake. SO GOOD

I was impressed with this place!  Walked in last week to get my nose pierced and was lucky enough to get an opening.  VERY informative!!  They let you know what was going on every step of the way and it was painless.  Would highly recommend and I would definitely go back for my next piercing!

Justin was amazing! From start to finish, our experience with Justin was top notch. My husband and I entrusted him with planning our family estate documents, and the experience was wonderful. He was thorough, efficient, and responded to all of our questions quickly and in way that was understandable to non-legal ears like ours. Justin was friendly and welcoming to our two young kids who had to tag-a-long with us to our final signing appointment as well. I highly recommend Jeppesen Law to anyone! Thanks Justin!
The service was fine, but I wasn't impressed with the burger I ordered. I will try them out again and order something different. The burger just wasn't anything special.

Excellent computer service by this team.  Hard drive storage was completely full and even after deleting files a virus kept maxing out our storage.  We took our CPU to CPR for help and their recommendation and they cleaned our system and provided a reasonable solution.  Not wanting to purchase a whole new CPU, we went with the CPR team's option of replacing our old hard drive with a brand new solid state drive.  They cloned our old programs and files and transferred them to our new SSD drive, cleaned the drive of viruses and doubled our storage space for a reasonable price.  Our desktop is running a heck of a lot faster and our problems are solved all within 24 hours.  Thankful for the CPR team!
First pizza while living in Boise. It was hot and fresh when we got it. Will definitely be ordering this again.

I have brought my daughter here 2 times. Each time we have been warmly greeted by the check in staff and the nurses, PA's and doctors have all been friendly and professional.  One of our visits we had to wait due to a medical emergency.  They apologized for the wait and made sure my daughter was ok until she could be seen. They even have contacted us after our visit to check up on how she is feeling.  Truly a caring staff and they go the extra mile. I wouldn't hesitate to bring my kids here. Especially since eat infections don't always wait until the work week!

How can a love seat cost the exact same amount as a couch? Two seats to three seats. They shouldn't be $600 each. When we asked her to see if we can get it less, she said that she can give it to us for $575. Not worth it. Probably won't shop here to get furniture. I wouldn't recommend it at all.

Edit: no on should have to pay the same amount for something and get 1/3 less. That math doesn't add up. Why would I pay $600 for a two seater, if I can get the three seater for the same amount? That math doesn't add up. I'm not paying the same amount and get 1/3 less. That's not smart shopping.

The woman working kindly described each item and made recommendations, as it was our first time. The empanadas are baked, and the crust is truly delicious. The chimichurri is definitely worth trying, I thought it was a perfect balance of flavors! I even went a little crazy and ate it with the chimichurri dipping sauce. My two year old loved the ham and cheese (which is made with real ham not deli meat soaked in preservatives.) My only disappointment is that I didn't get to try their braised beef one as it was sold out. Almost all other flavors were there though, and it was late on a Saturday. It was very clean, and had a fun atmosphere as well. The staff was very kind and friendly! I am sure it will become one of our frequented locations.
Their food is delish and I love the beautiful presentation. So worth it! Their coconut fried rice is the best!

These guys are great.  I took my brand new 2018 Raptor to them after a bunch of brush scratches and they did an amazing job removing them for around $150.  I will be taking all of my cars here going forward.
The best place to go for tacos in Meridian!!!! If you haven't tried it you've got to go!!!!!! Fried chicken tacos are my favorite!!!!!
Really good tacos!  Read the menu carefully so you know exactly what you are ordering.  The tacos taste like homemade tacos from my childhood.  The price is right, too.
Worth the wait!  Can't wait to go back and try the pastries  :)

Fries are definitely the reason to come here. They offer different types of potatoes. Laurel seems to be crowd favorite. Currently, they have good orange hibiscus and root beer soda.

The burgers are okay. Sometimes they have some interesting and enticing toppings. I like the umami topping when they have it. I do like their side of salad option when I want something more healthy. I wish they had a larger option.

Overall it's a great place and especially if you like fries.

First time with InDepth Auto Detailing, I chose the Halo stage two ceramic coating job for my Corvette.  Wow, it really looked good!!  Prompt and courteous service, would definitely recommend InDepth Auto Detailing!  Check them out!

I got an upper ear cartilage piercing by Paul. The building was lovely and clean and the staff was professional. Everything was super sanitary and I felt good about it. They moved their location from orchard to 2498 E. Fairview Ave and this location is much nicer and in a better area. It was a great experience and I got a great piercing!
Great service. I felt a little crammed because the restaurant is small. Food was good! But the hamburger bun was really thick.

Service was friendly, the vibe was welcoming, everything was sparkling clean and the food was pretty good.  I know this is a franchise and that means someone has a lot of their money invested and heart vested in its' success.  But I also have to say I left thinking while I would go back if in the area and it was convenient or someone else suggested it, I am not eager to go back.  

LOCATION...as drawback:
The Counter isn't the kind of place where I think the "ladies' who shop and lunch" are likely to want to stop during a day at The Village.  Plus it is on the wrong end, away from the fountain and across from Z Gallerie, to attract the crowd that wants to eat with Fountain view...or gather for an after work libation...which is true for Rice Works or Grimaldi's or Kona Grill or Bodovino.  For many folks who are making The Village restaurants a destination, they want that fountain proximity.  Or they're looking for a convenient bite before or after a movie, and the theater is also at the fountain end.

For that reason, it seems The Counter is more a 'families with children' dining destination  location.  Which seemed so for customers on the day I was there.  For that reason, I think The Counter might be doing better if it were in a different location where it was easier to get from parking lot to the table for this as destination.  Even if located in the area near The Co Op it might be easier access for foot traffic.  Absent that, nearer the other restaurant cluster at the fountain end might help them.  Because at lunch hour when other The Village restaurants were doing brisk business, The Counter had few customers.

VIBE
Bright, light, sparkling clean, an "all people are welcome" setting reminiscent of upscale coffee shop or "in the day" burger hang out but better.  Counter seating is high stools (with backs).  All other seating is user friendly for all ages and abilities standard height tables and booths.  There are a few tables out on the sidewalk too and big garage style doors roll up to the outside.  There was background music that fit the setting and it was at a level to know it was there but not to interfere with conversation.  Nice.

SERVICE
All three women who crossed our table's service path were friendly, efficient, helpful.  We enjoyed the service.

MENU
If the roughly 13x9 sized paper menu of front and back options for chili, salads, sandwiches and yes, of course, burgers doesn't have something to tempt you, you can build your own burger from a checklist cleverly clipped to a clipboard with pencil attached.  They have beef burgers, bison burgers, turkey burgers, crab cake burgers and veggie burgers to name a few of the options.  Sizes can be ordered 1/3, 1/2 or 1 full pound.  You choose your bun style (or not...available on lettuce too), sauces and toppings.  A few extras (like bacon-onion marmelade) add a buck or so upcharge.  

The menu also includes shakes, sodas, floats and adult libations.

FOOD
Two of us shared a 1/3 lb veggie burger (roughly $9 as we optioned it), a side of coleslaw ($2.25) and a chocolate malted shake ($5).  Food was hit and miss for us.  The  veggie burger was good and nicely cooked, the multi grain bun was fresh and the toppings we ordered were as well. But the half-cup'ish little serving of coleslaw that seemed only grated cabbage and parsley with not much non-descript dressing was not worth the $2.25 charge.  And the shake was both too sweet and too thin (if you can drink it with a straw it is too thin) and as it melted, since we didn't finish it, it became oddly viscous. We'd stick to a float next time.

Presentation lacks something too.  Unless you order a side, the burgers come seemingly "plopped'' on a good sized white plate.  All OK if you have a side perched there too.  But the burgers look small and lonely on that too big plate.  Yes.  I know you don't eat the plate.  But you know what I mean.

Here I'll pause to say the salads being eaten at the table across from our booth looked splendid and I'd definitely consider at salad here!

VALUE
One meal ordered to be shared by two.  The price for a veggie burger at the smallest (1/3 lb.) size, small side and shake was roughly $16.

TIP
I think Wed. nights have a wine flight special.  Some different specials on Mon. / Tue. nights too.

Y'all...I'm a procrastinator. My high schooler needed a corsage for homecoming tomorrow. I called a different place and the lady was less than friendly. Made me feel stupid because I didn't know the precise tone of blue that my sons date would be wearing. Do y'all have a high school boy? Communication...what's that? Can I get an amen?!?! Anyhow, I called Meridian Floral and Gifts. I was greeted by a super friendly gal named Elizabeth. She made the process simple and to the point. She was friendly and giggled with me ensuring it was no problem that I didn't know all the things. Customer service goes a long ways. I'll be back for sure. Thanks again. 

Sincerely, 
Struggling student, full time employee and boy mom!

Today was the first time I dined in. I used the restroom before ordering and used up the last of the toilet paper. When I was at the counter to order, I told a young guy, "First and foremost, can we have someone put more toilet paper before anyone else goes in there and doesn't have any?" He said yes but then I was expecting him to tell someone before taking my order...
