I got their tuna sandwich. The 12 grain bread it comes with isn't for me. It has big nuts in it. I tried wheat today and wasn't too impressed. Maybe I'll go back to the bread it normally comes with since it had more taste. 

I had a big old chunk of lettuce base in my already small salad. Bleh. 

I liked the tuna sandwich. 

Don't forgot to get or use your frequent diner card. They don't do a good job asking before hand and you can't earn points after you pay. 

I also remember when I came in last time the person didn't really sound that enthused about the program... wow. 

I also witnessed a lady standing in line for at least 3-4 minutes with 2 people walking by doing other orders and didn't even say hi or otherwise acknowledge her. I did hear the guy apologize for the wait when he finally serviced her. Does that make it better? I was about to call the store from my table because it was getting kind of awkward. 

Also I wish I caught his name but the young guy I don't think ever told anyone about the toilet paper. I went to go check and it still wasn't changed after 30 minutes so I had to tell a young lady with short curly hair and she said she would take care of it. 

I understand a lunch rush but their straws and medium lids were pretty much out of stock; so they not check that?

We order pizza here weekly and it is very good!!! The staff are polite and the place is clean. I gave this place 4 stars because of my experience several times with order delay. I grew up in restaurants and owned a couple myself and honestly it appears that the person in charge had little to no experience in the hospitality field. As I was waiting for our online order in the lobby I was witness to customers becoming very upset and frustrated about the long wait. Staff were trying to appease by stating not much longer.  Listening, I  realized the orders are numbered and the pizza cooks are making pizza out of order. So they are not reading the tickets and placing them in the correct order. After an older gentlemen politely gave his opinion of the situation the owner finally came out from the back. I was SHOCKED, he had been hiding in the back while having kids deal with this escalating situation. One women who had been waiting 2 hours had been offered free desert. REALLY!!!! 
I am going to give some free advice and believe me I have 30 years experience in this business, Mr. Owner you better get yourself some business cards for free pizza and hand them out when shit hits the fan. Those people should not only have received the order free but also a card of apology and a free pizza on you. You may think this is going to cost you money. Guess what it already did. Those people will tell everyone they know how bad it was. You give them a card for a free pizza at least you may gain the customer to come back. That's the name of the game JACK, make sure your customer's are treated right and make sure they come back!! You should be on that cooking line amping up those kids to move and helping them organize so they don't get behind.  Get it together or you will piss off to many people and you will earn a bad name. It is so important to organize that line and keep people moving.

Very professional business. They were quick to reply to inquiries. They did a great job on my interior cleaning and for a great price. I was completely satisfied with the detail. I'll be back to get the exterior cleaned when the weather is a bit more cooperative. The owner, Chris, was very attentive and had a few last touch ups once my vehicle was out of the shop and in the natural light.  Based on my experience, I will continue to support this business.

This place is not good.  I don't care what kind of special they have going on RUN away.  

I booked my appointment with the owner Chrissy  who is supposed to be experienced.  It was terrible.  The most uncomfortable massage I've ever received. There was nothing good about it that I can even come up with.  And honestly, she would not STOP talking.  No offense but when I go for a massage I go to relax.  Unfortunately I left feeling LESS relaxed and more exhausted than when I went in. I heard her entire life story. At one point I stopped talking back but she just kept going. 

Also, if a relaxing atmosphere is what you are looking for this is not the place for you.  First of all as far as environment is concerned when I walked in it was dirty and cluttered.  Then while waiting for my massage (which I was really hoping would be relaxing as I had, had a rough week) the receptionist had the radio on but it wasn't that soothing spa type music.  It was the 80's rock station.  Look, I love the 80's!  But it was just a really awkward vibe.  Not relaxing or therapeutic feeling at all.  I would think these are basic things to know when running a massage spa.  The floor was filthy, the fish tank where I received my massage was a dark green (disgusting).  I was starting to feel concerned about the sanitary conditions of this place and almost walked out.  I really wish I would have.  

Also what ever she used on my back was terrible.  I broke out for a good 6 months after this massage and now have acne scars on my back.  I have NEVER had acne on my back!!!!  Never, and I have had plenty of massages.  So I am speaking from experience when I tell you do NOT go here.

I'm giving this 2 stars because the shrimp tacos make my mouth sing with joy. But if you ever modify a taco just don't waste your time because they won't modify it. I think the last 10 times i've asked for "no onion" on my chicken taco i think they've added extra onion just to give me the taco finger. not cool tin roof. I expected it to be a one time thing but it's an every single time i've asked for no onion type thing. but it's not just onion. i've asked for "light cabbage" on my beloved shrimp taco and i felt like i got a cabbage taco. i can't take this any longer tin roof.
Located in a strip center off of Overland Rd., Boise Fry is a great place for burgers and of course their creative french fries.
Great food with gluten-free food that's great and the service is even better.  Unofficial endorsement, Meridian police officers eat there too

Awesome atmosphere, friendly staff, and amazing food! This was my first time going to this place and I will for sure be back! Wally gives amazing service but loves to joke around and have a good time. 

I had the #6 Th Italian with potato salad and it was one of the best I have had.

Yummy!!! Go enjoy all the delicious food choices at Tin Roof; you won't be disappointed.  I always feel at home(Texas) when I go into either location.  Thank y'all for bringing QUESO to Idaho....and chips, SALSA(Tex Mex style;love that the habanero is actually HOT), and guacamole! I really like how the sides compliment the already delicious tacos(my fav is the Baja Shrimp/hubby's & kids is the Texican).  If you want a good ol' taco for a great price head on down to Tin Roof Tacos! Also a wonderful place to watch sports or Aggie football while you fill your tummy with some goodness. The only thing that could make this place better would be Blue Bell Ice Cream.....I would have my two favorite Texas treats all in one place.....it's just a thought!

I don't enjoy going to eat at a place where me ordering food, getting a refill and asking for hot sauce is an inconvenience to the entitled highschooler behind the counter. If you don't want to help customers, get out of customer service. Thank for showing me the definition of horrendous customer service.

Great job, great service and a very competitive price! They thoroughly explained the options and the recommendations and made sure I was happy with the work prior to charging me. We will be using Dynamic Detail from now on!

I'm writing for the enormous prices Hugo's has. I was looking at the ad and most of the "on sale" items are at Walmart for the regular price that Hugo's has on sale. RIP people off big time and they are monopolizing grand forks.
Good fast casual restaurant. Great variety of street tacos. Sauces are tasty. Bottomless chips. Everything tastes fresh.

I found InDepth Detailing very flexible and easy to work with.  Two people came to my home and worked diligently on my car.  Although my car is twelve years old, it looked brand new when finished.  I will definitely use their service again and recommend them to my friends.

Amazing Thai! That's right! 4-6 daily try the apps & then split an entree. The Hero & fresh spring rolls were fresh & excellent in taste. I like spice & this did not disappoint. Wanton cream puffs were delightfully spectacular. Pineapple rice was flavor town! Hubs devoured it with a touch of yellow curry. Service was 5-Star also! We'll be back.

A first time stop in for me on this spot, I had heard from others it was worth a stop.  One word, underwhelming.   Good service and a clean self serve environment but the food was "average" at best.   Having tried a few other burger stops in the Boise area,  this one (Habit) quickly drops down the list and most likely will not see a repeat from us.

I went to Dickeys at 8 after work. I had received an email promo thought they wanted my business guess not. I know an hour before closing is iffy to start with but walking in you'd have thought this location was closed. I walked in and no employees in sight. I stood there for 10 minutes no greeting nothing. I then hear a broom on the floor I actually made eye contact with the young lady sweeping the dining room floor. She said nothing just kept sweeping. I stood there for another 5 minutes no one came to the counter. I decided hmm must be closed. I left and banged the door on the way out she watched me with her eyes my whole way to my car and made no effort to even try to come outside and fix the situation. 
2-17-17: I was contacted by the owner and he was really upset about the lack of customer service. I appreciated the call him taking the time to call me and want to make things right for future customers and with me too. That's why I take the time to do honest yelp reviews for you; help you find great dining destinations. When you hear an owner talk about their culture and this isn't it makes you feel valued and that future customers hopefully won't have the sane experience I am willing to give you another visit.

I love the new location in Meridian. I have visited the location in Boise several times and I love the variety of tacos. I have tried them all and cannot say anything bad. They even have breakfast tacos. The price is so inexpensive I can eat, drink a beer and have some of that delicious homemade salsas with fresh hot chips and still spent under $10. The staff is wonderful, and they work hard.

The owners of this spa care the hardest working, kindest most accommodating people in the business. They have great product and they're very good at what they do. If you try them I hope you have the same experience.
The best pastries in town. Delicious breads. Best paninis ever tried. Even the chips they serve with the sandwiches are awesome. Come here quite often and always impressed.

Meridian public auction is top notch. Thank you so much for helping liquidate my uncle's estate we've never been more happy with a service we found in the valley. All the staff is professional and courteous and full of information, we never felt lost in the process whatsoever. We don't think we can thank you enough for helping us through this difficult time. Super big hugs to everybody who helped especially the front desk and the young boys in the back of the warehouse, thank you.

This was my first time visiting Kneaders! I've been wanting to stop by and I'm glad i did! The baked goods were so beautiful and fresh and the little store inside was a pleasant delight. But the service was unimpressive. The cashier was rude and bothered, may have been an off day. Other than that it was a good visit.

I just went to The Habit. Had a free charbroiled Burger coupon. I purchased it to for charity a few months ago. Did not know there was an expiration date on it. My bad. But management and nobody would even meet me halfway or do anything for me. Management has gone downhill at this location since the lady is no longer the manager now there is a dark-haired gentleman. It use to be cleaner, and a little more personable.Now it's take or leave it, we don't care attitude.Very disappointed my family and I have enjoyed eating at this restaurant. But probably taking my business elsewhere from now on , as there are a lot of businesses opening up that are just as good or better. Sad day, loved the habit I guess I have to go elsewhere.

This was my first stop at BFC having driven by the location several times.  Being a fry and burger boy I was looking forward to the visit.  A good selection of both types of fries and burgers .. all coming with a  price tag.  We opted for a standard beef burger (classic) and gold fries.  The prices are a bit higher here, about 10% over one of fav burger spots.  All in all - not worth the visit.  The food was just average, while fry portions were large the burger on its best day was run of the mill.  Nice staff but no real plans to revisit at our end  ..

Disappointed in my meal. I got half of the avocado veggie sandwich on French bread and when I got home and opened it, it was literally one slice of cheese, two thin slices of tomato, one leaf of romaine lettuce, one thin piece of avocado cut into four pieces, and a piece of onion on like half a loaf of bread. The mayo didnt even cover half of the bread. I wound up putting 2 slices of my own cheese from home just so that I didnt have plain bread for half the sandwich. I should have just eaten at home and saved $10.
Very good service. Fast and reasonably priced. Had four watch batteries replaced and they were able to do it right away.
We were in a pinch and we able to book an unloading of a truck the same day.  Dusty and Dillon showed up on time, worked quickly and did a great job.  We would use A Moving Company again.
Truly the worst in town for customer service from staff to management.  If you looked up apathy in the dictionary this restaurant would be in the di

Found this place near where I was working!  I had the ruben and a choc chip cookie! The sandwich was ok!  The meat was good but the rye bread was more like a marble bread so light!  The meat was nice but sparse so I was a bit disappointed !  It was more like fast food than a deli!  The cookie was very good

Theresa came out to do Patty Jo again and also my 13 yr old Ophelia (cat). She did a lions cut on her. Oph absolutely does NOT like any kind of fussing or being bothered kinda kitty. Theresa said she was purrrrfect and allowed her to bath and cut! This totally surprised me! So once again (my second review), it just speaks to how awesome Theresa is. And my Ophelia is just so happy and pleased with her new lion cut. She has even decided to come out from her usual seclusion and lay around on the couch with the family! Incredible & weirdly unbelievable. She's a very happy kitty.

Great customer service.  Although I don't go there very frequently there is a waiter who always remembers what I like/want.  Not to mention the food is amazing.  The chicken yellow curry is extremely delicious. Level 5 spice of course.

This is my 2nd time purchasing running shoes from FF. ALWAYS amazing customer service and very detail oriented! 

I also used a Groupon deal- which is always nice!

I love this place! They are friendly and helpful. The staff is patient and kind and works hard to look after the safety of its crowds. The layout is easy and the park is clean. Great for families! Highly recommend!!
Kid friendly plus creative problem solving for unique patient needs. Affordable, too!

This is our new favorite place in Meridian! Small restaurant, but their specialties are awesome. Ribeye steak, salmon, pork chop, all excellent. Has a neighborhood restaurant/bar motif, servers are efficient and friendly, we've been several time and never disappointed. Has lImited seating, so I recommend reservations.
Had an issue but they took care of the dispute respectfully and professionally. Thank you for making it right John's auto.

Excellent service and great prices on brand name shoes.  I can't believe how great the service was here.  I walked in the door and was immediately asked if I needed help.  The woman took me directly to comfortable work shoes and then helped me find shoes in my size.   Then came back to check and make sure I was doing ok.   As I browsed through the store two other employees asked if I needed help.   The woman at the register was also helpful.  Plus, I saved $60 on my purchase.  I highly recommend shopping here if you need shoes.
Thank you for the service you gave to my furry friends. The employees are very friendly and helpful. The store is very clean. They have so many things for every pets you have.
Can't go wrong here, but my faves are the pulled pork, shrimp, fish, or fried chicken taco. And always get the queso! Inexpensive, fast, and delicious!
Wasn't bad, just hoped it was going to be a little better......I think they should have offered the different salts as an add on so they could toss it rather than having to try and do it at the table
The tacos are delicious! However, the staff aren't too friendly. It would be nice to hear a hello and see a smile. They seem more concerned with talking to each other than the customers.
Good food but the door is always open so it's hot inside and there's usually flies all around. Plus I was almost stung by a bee!

This was my first visit.  I ordered Pad Thai and it was the worst I've ever eaten.  The noodles were bright orange in color, stuck together and with a pasty taste.  The chicken pieces were really bad.  They were not cooked in the meal but thrown in as an after thought.  No taste, dried, and really  chewy. Normally, I don't write reviews but it was annoying to see this place get good reviews.  Also, from my experience, any restaurant that has that many items to sell cannot be cooking with attention to quality.
Pork belly appetizer is divine. We enjoyed a Cabernet with our ribeye. Why go anywhere else?

Fusion tacos. In Land Locked Idaho, you can get some really good shrimp tacos... go figure. The flavors have a Mexican street taco feel, but the pineapple salsas and the array of meat choices really set it apart. 

The other cool thing... Breakfast tacos all day. 

I recommend the chips and guacamole as well as the apple empanadas. All in all a fun, affordable, tasty dinner destination.

Only reason I gave it a star is because I couldn't give it 0. Went to the sky box. Being in the service industry for 15 years, bartender up there was top 5 worst I've ever seen. 2 guys at the bar that she talked to for 15 minutes with me waiting credit card in hand. Ready to open up a tab. She talked about everything from the weather to bread preferences. She even walked over in front of me to get the walkie talkie to talk with the kitchen. After 15 minutes of being ignored I gave up and left. Guess the reviews of horrible service are true. Absolutely embarrassing
They are likely known for the 32+ sandwiches on the menu but I come here for the gigantic fresh salads and delicious homemade soups. The staff are all really friendly too. Highly recommend.

Absolutely Disappointed in this place. Ordered a Chicken Salad sandwich but asked for different bread other than A croissant. They charged me an extra 2 dollars to cover my bread so it's now 8.59 for the sandwich and if that wasn't enough, they serve another salad with this Chicken Salad Sandwich. I asked if I could trade the salad for chips and I was hit with another charge of .99. I cant even make this up..so sum total for Sandwich plus chips and a drink...$12.05  If I want there with my Bible Study I'd left...Never again... The Cashier Misty was absolutely Amazing...All she could do was apologize...

We went to Fat Guys deli today and it was solid deli. We ordered the chef salad and a Reuben sandwich. The salad was loaded with Turkey, ham and blue cheese am with good fresh greens. The ruben sandwich was nice grilled and the meat was delish. If your looking for a good deli give this place a try.

I had the sliced brisket today and it was mouth-wateringly good, the sauces were on point and atmosphere was just right. I'm surprised it's taken me this long to eat at Dickey's. Huge fan of the slow cooked, smoked flavor and simplicity of the menu. Very simple food model and great selection for anyone out there who is gluten free or just wanting to get their home style BBQ fix. Their catering service looks phenomenal - definitely something to keep in mind for the future. Overall 5 star experience today and will be delighted to go again.
Super friendly guys, highly detailed in their work; my car looks absolutely amazing!  Thanks guys.

Delicious food, friendly people, awesome service. Our second time here (while visiting from Seattle). Everything is fresh, delicious, and was prepared quickly even for our large party. I'm not sure why they have so few stars - it's wonderful.

This is our favorite Thai restaurant in the Boise area; nice, clean, decor, friendly staff and great food.  Closed on Mondays and crowded on Weekend dinner times so make a reservation.  Everything we have ordered has been great except for the orange chicken on one particular night; maybe it's great the rest of the time but I didn't reorder; so can't really recommend.

Dickey's is the most affordable BBQ in town and is just as good as a sitdown restaurant at half the price. I love their brisket and ribs are fall off the bone good! free ice cream for the family after your meal when dining in!!!!
Love the fry selection. Sauces are awesome too. Thousands of combinations of fries, salts and sauces.

I've loved being a member at this gym! Rarely crowded. The only reason I'm giving 4 stars is because my swiper card I use to get in to the gym gets ruined SO easily, which means if it's not reading correctly no gym access for me until staffed hours. In a year of membership I've had to replace my card 3 times. I work night shift so I'm often going to the gym during weird hours, which is why I love the 24hr open gym, but I wish there was a keypad or a more reliable way to get in.

I eat at Panda at least once per week. I don't normally use this one, but was in the area and really needed to eat. The food quality was decent, but the portion size was tiny as compared to every other Panda. I guess if you are on a diet, this is your Panda.
Spent two years in Belgium and became a french fry afficianado.  I have the body to show for it.  Boise Fry always gets it right.

This place does not have a good burger. I do not know why it had 4stars but definitely not for taste.  I got a classic beef burger and a Heat beef burger and both were not tasty. I've only came here once before, so decided to give it another try, and I was very disappointed for lunch yet again.  I wouldn't waste my lunch time or money here.   Lots of sauce options but Now I know it is because the taste of the burgers are so dry, you have to swarm it in a sauce to make it edible. Fries were good and abundant.

They have good food that is very affordable. They are also a nice place to go if your awake at 3 am ans really craving some food. It's also a good place to come with the family to grab a bite to eat quick before a trip.
Friendly, fast service. The portions are large but the food is really tasty. Plus the place smells like bacon so how can it be bad?!

We have loved NHA since going there in 2017. Our son loves the staff and I have never been mis informed and the app they update throughout the day is so helpful for a protective parent...I love this place. We moved and had to go elsewhere and it's really hard! I wish there was a location in Southwest Boise! Still hoping for one....just can't say enough how amazing the staff is here!

I give 1star only because I can't give 0.

In short: It has been the WORST customer service ever. I never went through something similar. I am still waiting for excuses or an explanation.

I bought a coupon from livingsocial and booked an appointment by phone. The day of the appointment I waited and no one came. I received a call and the booking was pushed back more that 1 month. 
The scheduled day I called the contact several time, but the answering machine replied only. No one came AGAIN. 
Determined to have the cleaning done, I booked an appointment through the website. It was scheduled for 3:00pm. It is 4:20pm and no one called me, no one replied to my phone, no excuses received.

WORST EVER. DO NOT BOOK WITH THEM

Recently moved to the area and are in the hunt for our new go-to Mexican restaurant. Being from AZ I'm pretty picky. Loved the all-out decor and booths. Our waiter was super friendly and attentive. And a must for me-- the chips & salsa & rice were good. Enjoyed my enchiladas suizas and will be back to try their margs and burritos. If you're looking for a good, traditional Mexican restaurant, this just may be your place.

This is one of my favorite Mexican restaurants however when you order to go they charge you for your to go containers   So I never order to go any longer   seems like restaurants would realize with all these extra charges folks just aren't going to do it   I never order to go because they charge for containers. It can add $2.00 more to your order.

I really wanted to like this place.  Local business, owner is a Meridian High School grad, and I try to support local businesses.  Really wanted to like it, but did not and will not return.  For three of us to have an average burger and generic fries was $45 plus tip!!!! Seriously, across the street at Texas Roadhouse is better food, similar prices and I always have left overs!  Service at The Counter was friendly.  I just want to warn you that if you go bring your buckets of money and I would not pay $1.00 extra for the 'premium applewood bacon' which was more like floppy pre-cooked bacon.  Sorry, but this is Meridian and as beautiful as the Village is I don't think the prices at the counter are appropriately matched for the quality of food and location.

asked for a grilled cheese sandwich cut in half for my boys to share. What I received was a tiny one in a tiny box, was literally ONE slice of bread with melted cheese. That's it. not enough for 2 to share, and my receipt showed it was a 1/2 cheese melt for 4.59!!??? Almost $5 for ONE slice of bread folded over. I was confused cause I've ordered this before at the drive thru and never had an issue. The manager was either mentally challenged or just didn't care. He was almost arguing with ME and never tried to set things right. It was a frustrating conversation of back and forth going no where. I had to get my kids something else somewhere else. ugh

Little late on review, but it's deserved! 

I was introduced to this place from a friend. Thankful I was, it's so good!
I try to stop in at least once a month and grab a sandwich. Each time I try to change it up. 
Let's just say, I'll keep going back!

We're a big fan of Dollar Tree.  The location is great as it is close by and the hours of operations allow us to shop early or come late.  We have purchased everything from holiday decor, sandwich bags, instanta glue, ( Kragel  ), birthday bags, tissue paper, cards, etc.... 

They have started to sell breads and there's also a freezer section in the back.  We have not partaken with the groceries so we can't comment on the quality of savings but the store is constantly stocked and there are plenty of things that one can find.  Sometimes we'll go with nothing in mind to purchase, and brainstorm for a particular event. It's everything a dollar or less so keep the expectations in check but you can save some $$$s. Here's some tips.

Wanting to make gift bags for the kiddos for an upcoming birthday party?  Go to Dollar Tree

Need some school supplies or in need of some mailing supplies? Go to Dollar Tree

Sandwich bags, Ziploc type bags, brown bags for lunch?  Go to Dollar Tree

Birthday, Anniversary, Baby Shower cards? Go to Dollar Tree

Invitations or Thank you cards?  Go to Dollar Tree

Psst.  We've been told that the cleaning supplies are just as good but we have not tried them, so if someone has an update on this, please let us know.  

The service is good plus they have balloons and helium.  

If you haven't visited the Dollar Tree, take a couple of one dollar bills and check them out!

I ordered the Grant burger, it said specifically "cooked medium" I was looking forward to a burger that was cooked properly. I got a burned, unseasoned hockey puck. Fries were nothing great either. for 13 bucks, (no cheese, that is a buck) I could have had 5 big macs, and they would have been better.  I mentioned the way it was cooked to the waitress, she looked at it and said yes, it is overdone, but offered nothing, not even an apology. Won't be going back.

I found this florist by accident through instagram and decide to take a chance! Greatest experience buying flowers! Angela did such an amazing job! From creating the bouquet, to on time delivery! Thank you so much! Will definitely be ordering again soon!

I love this store.  They have such beautiful items and the service is wonderful.  I will recommend this store to everyone and especially to those who admire the items that I have purchased there. They carry Jan Barboglio and have a wonderful selection.  Thank you Steelz for popping into my life.  Wonderful experience.

I have a 2015 GMC Denali HD Truck with about 50k miles of backcountry roads. I took it in to the guys at Dynamic Detail and purchased the Platinum package. They went above and beyond providing rides to/from work and spent the better part of a day on my truck. On the outside, they removed all of the blemishes and brought the paint back to the new truck shine. The interior was spotless. It looked so good that when it started raining I kept it in the garage and drove the old beater to work. ;) Great guys that work hard and deliver the goods!

Who would have thought that Meridian Idaho would know how to do Thai Food.  This small restaurant measures right up with the best of the them.

We had Pad Thai with Shrimp and a Green Chicken Curry.  Both of these dishes were excellent.  Topped it off with sticky mango rice.

This is definitely a go to restaurant.

Stopped here for lunch based on the good reviews. The staff I interacted with were all very friendly and helpful. The space itself is pretty cramped, but they do have some outside seating as well. I ordered the roast beef melt and potato salad. I was disappointed with the sandwich, mostly the herbal mayo which was pretty overpowering. The bread and meat (roast beef and bacon) were good, but the mayo was so powerful it detracted from the overall taste. The potato salad was much better. It actually had good potato flavor, which I find many versions lack. While I wasn't blown away by my first experience, I'd be willing to give them another chance sometime.
We loved the dueling pianos!! Great entertainment along with good food, drinks and service.

Kids always love the bowling. I finally got beat by one of them yesterday...  yes I can admit that!!  The tots were great but the entire family LOVED the PIZZA. Great balance with the sauce, cheese, toppings and crust. They really loved the crust!!!  See you next weekend Big Al's!

Did not enjoy this place at all. Service was bad, burger was way over cooked. When asked how our food was we told them it was over cooked, instead of offering to make us something else they offered us a shake...we already had one. Do not recommend.

Lots and lots of choices. If you want a good hearty authentic sandwich and some soup this is a great place go. I typically find that these places are a bit on the spendier side and this place follows suit. So for me that's the only down side. If it were more affordable I'd go more often!!
They've got a crazy big selection, quality ingredients and tastes yummy.
The coconut Tom kha soup is the best! Garlic shrimp is  very yummy. The sushi is fresh and delicious. New sushi chef is awesome! I definitely love martini there.

I always knew my cell phone battery was a dud but I got a few years out of it. When it finally died for good I took it to CPR Cell phones. Super fast service! Reasonably priced. Really good return/problem policy. I'll definitely go to them first when my next cell phone issue arises!

So glad there is a Hugo's Deli near us! We love this place!

We have never not received superior service or delicious sandwiches. We have tried several different sandwiches, sides & soups in house and to go and they never fail us.

Our favorites are the Hawaiian and the Chicken salad - sourdough, of course!

Their fries are too good, nice & crispy and extra soft on the inside - they have awesome fry sauce and a spicy ketchup that is reminiscent of cocktail sauce (a must if you love horseradish like me!)

They open earlier than most for lunch which is excellent for us since we work on an East Coast schedule.

All in all, a lifetimer.
Ordered loaded fries and they were disappointing and lacked toppings. They were out of the other appetizer we ordered. Replaced that with an order of mozzarella sticks that were also sub par.

Why do what I did and call 5-10 places trying get quotes? There the cheapest, fastest and really know what they're doing. Repaired my iPhone 5s lickity split(cracked screen). It would be a big waste of friggin time to call less experienced and more expensive places(was insulted by some of the outrageous quotes). They treated me right so I'm a customer for life.

Yum!!! This place was great! Our waitress was super, and the food was amazing. I loved the option to completely customize your burger. It's great being able to order exactly what you like! The burger was flavorful and juicy and the fries were PERFECT.  The fried pickles was something new that I've never tried. They come with apricot sauce, and it sounds like the strangest combo ever, but honestly it was really good. The apricot takes the bite down a notch and I enjoyed it! All in all it was a great experience and I recommend giving it a try.

Good ole' Panda Express! A place where American-Chinese food exists. Quick, and easy fast food with a touch of Asian culture. 

Location

The location is great, it right off of 10 mile and W. Chinden. It is located in the Walmart's parking lot. There is ample parking. It is new 


Atmosphere
I've come to realize if you've been in one Panda Express you've been in them all. Luckily, this one isn't too crowded. 

Staff
Staff was friendly enough, on par with other fast food restaurants. 


Food
The food was fresh, nice and warm. Lucky for us, it wasn't sitting under the heat lamp too long. I gave a four star because the lack of flavor in the fried rice. I couldn't taste any seasoning. The orange chicken was delicious. Cooked to perfection. Not too soggy, and just put out. 

Most importantly... would we go back?
Yes.

It was my lucky day when I found Jeppesen Law during an internet search. 

I was having a terrible week. I was in a desperate situation and needed an attorney NOW who could help me with the process of retitling my property, which had become complicated. Time was not on my side and I was feeling hopeless.  An escrow could not close without this transaction.  Everywhere I turned, there were roadblocks.

Enter Attorney Justin Jeppesen. One phone call to him in the early afternoon, a short question/answer/information sharing session and Justin went to work.  By the end of the day, Justin found a solution and scheduled an appointment with me the next morning to sign documents. A quick trip to the County Clerk's office and we were done. All of this in less than 24 hours AND at a very reasonable price.  I could now move forward.

 I cannot thank Justin enough for the compassion and courtesy, professionalism, efficiency and speed with which he handled and resolved my transaction.  I was truly amazed. 

 I was so RELIEVED. It was the first day that I could begin de-stressing and putting things in order again.

It is my pleasure and honor to recommend the services of Jeppesen Law.  It is the best experience that I have ever had dealing with an attorney.  

Justin is trustworthy, honest and dependable.  

I am forever grateful from the bottom of my heart to this awesome attorney.

The atmosphere is great! We had so much fun bowling. We went with a company holiday party and ate (wayyyy) too much. Plus it's nice to be able to have drinks brought to you while you play so you don't have to keep changing your shoes. The staff however were horrible. No one was rude but there were so many associates not doing anything and when I'd ask questions or need to be shown where something was, no one knew anything. Super frustrating.

Stopped in tonight and as usual the sandwiches were awesome!  Only complaint was the lighting over the sidewalk outside.  Lightning was discussed as we have handicapped folks and its a little bit unnerving trying to make a transition from pavement to sidewalks.  Corporate apparently controls the lights.  So although I can always give the restaurant 5 stars for the food I won't be stopping in for dinner anymore.

Good service. Decent prices. Love the build your own thing, but I always love any place that's accommodating enough to allow me to build what I want or make adjustments. Clean restaurant too, very important. Cool atmosphere, very laid back. 

My favorite there is the hippie salad sans goat cheese. Sometimes I'll substitute a different kind of cheese. They are always very accommodating with any requests. I like their sangria as well. Decent place for a quick lunch! 

Don't really want to give just 3 stars, wish there was a 1/2 as that's where I am with The Counter. I went to 4 because they have so many healthy options and lots of organic food.

Dr. McRae and his staff are the perfect blend of professional and friendly - Professional in that the work they do is top notch, done with obvious expertise and skill;  friendly in that it's one of the few places left that practices hospitality along with their actual business. 
Their first and foremost focus is the patient's comfort and outcome of the work done. Bravo, guys!  You made me smile again!!

Five stars for this little tiny drive thru shop because our barista was so friendly! We drove up and had no idea what we wanted (we're new in town) so he waited patiently til we decided. He took our order and had it out pretty quick. Despite the fact that he was in a drive thru window in a kiosk, he just hung out and made small talk with us while we waited for our drinks. 

The coffee was good - really good. I ordered a mocha with coconut milk and I'll probably order it every time I go now. 

Definitely coming back!

So they made my sandwich not how I ordered and I told the guy who was working drive through who was pretty nice and told his coworker and she replied don't tell me, it's a little unprofessional response I feel like, anyhow before they fixed my order they made everybody's sandwich that ordered after me which was like 5 people, then I asked for my cinnamon roll warmed up and they brought it cold then I had to go up and correct them and they let it sit in the microwave for about 5 mins then I had to go up and ask them for it before it got cold, this was my first time being here so it wasn't really a good experience especially since I had time to sit and write this review lol, I do want to eat the drive through guy was nice and apologized for the mistake
I don't know the staff seemed stressed maybe they should have training for handling stress at work just breathe it'll be ok
They did give free bread which made it a little better

The worst customer service of ANY restaurant in Boise by far.
Usually no manager is even on duty, so its understandable...

As good as it gets is an understatement...This is an excellent restaurant serviced by amazing people.  Our server Lindsey is incredible!!  We have been blessed with her as our server several times, and she will always put a smile on your face.  The food and service has always been perfect both for myself and my vegetarian wife.  There are plenty of options and you will not be disappointed sampling the many items on the menu!  Enjoy!!
Best nail salon I've ever been to!! Very clean and the service was incredible. Everyone there was so friendly. Ha did an awesome job on my manicure and Jenna did my nail art. Love it so much
I have been a regular at the Meridian Boise Fry location for about 3.5 years now. The food, drinks, and staff are incredible. Check out the attached photos for a look inside!

This place smells so good when you walk in and the food does not disappoint! Good food. Support local! Greek salad with chicken was fresh and delicious and the #26 spicy shiracha chicken sandwich was just the right spice with chunky bacon! Potato salad is good too!
They just did my nails for my little sisters wedding and they did an amazing job! I have short nails and was worried they were able to work with them!

Dr. McRae has been my dentist for a decade or so!  I first went to him as I met one of his hygienists, Katie, who became a friend.  Long story short -- every time I needed any sort of dental cleaning, work done, or guidance, my experience has been superb!  Friendly, customer focused, and available is the name of the game at McRae Dental!  Plus, they have a beautiful office right near Eagle Road and 84.  BONUS?  Yes!  Always leave with a parting gift and yummy snacks to choose from!   Thank you, Dr. McRae for having the best dental team in the Treasure Valley!

First time using a mobile groomer. My Pom is a senior at 17 yrs old. Taking her to a groomer has become too stressful for her at her age. Aussie Pet Grooming was less stressful for her and she looks and smell great. Very professional and friendly. Will be using them again.

It is a Panda Express, so I do not really think the food will ever really tip the scale either way to a 5 star or a 1 star. As long as you don't get the last couple scoops of cold orange chicken, in my experience it is usually the service that sways my opinion of experiences at Panda. This trip was something new however, it was my first experience at a drive-thru panda express and it was pretty cool. 
The food was as to be expected. We got lucky that it was not the last servings before they had to make more, so our entrees were still semi fresh. 
I threw in an extra star just because I liked the ease of the new drive-thru experience. The lady taking our order was polite and the process was quick and convenient.

I ordered a boba smoothie and curry to go. I picked up the boba first and the actual boba was inedible. It was old and hard. I took it back in 10 minutes later when I went to get my food. Instead of offering a refund, they used my 10 minute old smoothie to try to remake it. The boba they microwaved to try to make it taste better. Then they added it back to my melted smoothie. I wasn't pleased after paying $4.50 for this drink. It was the worst boba smoothie I have ever paid for.
Then, I asked for silverware and a plate since I'm staying in a hotel and don't have access to dishes.
The waitress came back with napkins and plastic silverware but no plate because they would have to charge me for a plate. 
I don't feel like I'm a very picky person but this experience left me feeling frustrated and if I lived here, I would never be back.
The Panang curry I ordered tasted fine.

What an amazing place! I love the funky atmosphere, with the eclectic furniture and sparkly chandelier. There's a comfy couch sitting area to relax and enjoy the tasty tea drinks and snacks. There was clearly a lot of thought put into the comfort of the guests because of the book selection available to browse and the board games to play. I also loved my blended tea drink and maple scone. Can't wait to come back!

Have eaten at the Boise location (by Costco) and it was quite good.  Took five family members to downtown Meridian last night and the food, service, and atmosphere were superb!  In fact, this was the best Mexican food we've had in the seven years we have lived in the Meridian-Boise area (from Portland, OR)...and we love GOOD Mexican fare!  Don't know why there are complaints...maybe a different cook on those occasions...but our experience last night was top-notch, including the lovely waitress we had (she was a "kick"!).  "We'll be back"!
These florists really have a unique style!! Esmae designed my wedding and couldn't be happier. We had many compliments. Top notch arrangements and great prices.

While towing a 21' trailer on vacation to Meridian in the recent record-setting heat, my 2002 Expedition started experiencing a loss of engine power when taking off from any stop.  No engine lights ever came on, and this odd condition would only happen after the engine was warmed up, towing the trailer, and the outside temperature was over 95 F.  Knowing that this type of intermittent problem IS and can be an expensive one, the assistant manager, Kevin, said they try to diagnose the problem for a minimum charge of $100.

He called back a few hours later to say they could not find anything wrong, no codes showed up with the diagnostic equipment, and that the tech had spent well over an hour on it.  And then apologized for having to even charge me half ($50.00) as they could not find anything to fix.

I'm from out-of-state, and this is good, honest automotive service above and beyond what one normally expects to get and I would not hesitate to recommend them - thus I am writing this review.  Thanks Kevin and John's Auto Care Center!
Amazing donut shop with a decent amount of donuts to choose from! Friendly service! And did I mention the delicious Maple Bacon donut?!?! The best I've had yet!

I have never been so disappointed in a loan process for a customer. We have 2 families trying to close on their homes today before Christmas and you all can't seem to get docs to the title company for one of the families. For a local credit union, this has been the most frustrating experience. You have had now 7 weeks to get this loan done and no one will respond to our requests. Docs were promised to Pioneer Title Co. by 5:00 yesterday, and we're still waiting. No one will call me back, the selling agent back or the title officer back. 

I would sure like someone to address the problem."

I love the Counter so much! Their BLT&A is amazing and has amazing flavor. I'm not a huge burger person and for a place that mainly serves burgers, they have a great selection of salads and sandwiches. I love their Caesar salad and they have such great service! The waiters/waitresses are super nice and ask you how your food is(*cough* Rib Shack Barbecue *cough*). I really love The Counter and totally encourage you to try it!

On vacation and this was the first and only place I ate at upon arriving to Idaho. Waitress was pleasant, food was okay... But, DO NOT DRINK THEIR TAP WATER!! Both my nephew and I got food poisoning a few hours after leaving the restaurant. Fiesta Guadalajara, I recommend to get a filtered system for your water. I immediately knew something was off by the taste. Gross!
Crisp bean is only $1.89 here! The taco time by my house is $2.59:( This is a big win
Good enough god for the cheap price. Fun atmosphere, great outdoor seating, fire, covered, cheap booze.

I dislike exercise in general, and would almost always rather sleep in than get up and work out. So for me, I need to go someplace where the staff and members are positive, encouraging, and are the type of people I'd want to chat with outside of the gym as well.

Fireside is that kind of place. The coaches and members are genuine, motivated, and respectful of where we all are on our journey. Some are high level athletes. Some are simply in there to get a sweat on. Some - like myself - have rocketed past a certain chronological barrier (i.e. 40) and are looking to lose the Dad-bod and get stronger without getting hurt and/or working around existing cranky injuries.

Which brings me to my last point. They know their stuff. I've got some nagging injuries that they help scale around. Any advice about movements or technique they've given is spot on tailored to me. I've learned a lot, gotten stronger, and lost weight in the 3 months I've been there. You get a free week to check the place out...life is short, why not spend it with good people who make you want to come to the gym?
Oh yeah! Awesome burgers with sides that will make it fun for the whole family. The burgers are truly a craft. Not a run of the mill average burger. Solid help and of course they have a pepper bar

Excellent turkey sandwich combo # 3 with the German chocolate brownie was amazing staff is awesome very friendly- also the cinnamon rolls great heated up
Great value for lunch 
 recommended fresh quality, drive-thru service best ever,

While my wife and I were in the store getting her HP computer fixed, which they did a fantastic job on, I spoke to Pete about my iPhone that was out of storage space. Without pressure he walked me through several options and saved me a ton of money buying a reconditioned iphone with 4x the storage I had with my old phone. I would have paid several hundred more had I gone to the Verizon store across the street for the same model. He even gave me a decent trade in value for my boat anchor of a phone with only 16G storage. They put in a new battery, put on a cover protector, made sure all my data and apps transferred and I was out the door. These guys are my new go to for any computer/ phone issues.

Hard to find anywhere that will "lettuce wrap"  correctly, very juicy, thick lettuce as a bun replacement makes it easy to handle and very enjoyable.  This place has great burgers and fries anyways but this sets The Habit as a go to for anyone, especially on a low carb diet.  Everything is grilled to order, seems to be always busy but moves quick and well worth it.... casual but definitely not fast food. Oh, they have great salads there too!  Hard to find a true lettuce wrap when searching Yelp, hope this help.

Angela the florist does amazing work! She has a knack for creating beautiful bouquets and arrangements. She filled my order on time, made a beautiful bouquet with the freshest flowers and delivered them free of charge with a smile. P.s. did I already say delivery was free??? Will definitely come back!

We went through the drive through just as usual. we ordered our food and the lady repeated our order correctly. we got our food and then drove home. We got home to open up our food and realize they messed everything up. How when they literally just correctly told me my order. We drove back to tell them. when we told them, they seemed irritated that we asked them to remake our order!! Very unimpressed with this service and I won't be returning to this location

Best food I've eaten at a Taco Time in a very long time. To my surprise, the crisp burrito actually had real cheese in it. I live in Western WA and I cannot stand the food at the Taco Time NW locations since their food is dry and bland.
The service at the drive thru window was excellent. We had a complicated order and the young woman who took our order was very kind and patient and she double checked that everything was correct before we left.
 I wish we lived closer to this location. We'll make sure to stop there again when travelling through Boise, ID.
Best grilled mahi mahi tacos! Lots of taco choices & great prices. Fresh & fast. Very yummy

A+ chip repair & replacement is absolutely amazing and I highly recommend them to anyone looking for work on their windshield. I had a rock hit my windshield while on the interstate causing several cracks from the point of impact. I called a different local company that we have used before, long story short, 2 messages and a week later still no call back so I started looking for another local auto glass company to call. I called A+ and Tyler said he was working nearby and could come look at the crack when he was finished with that that repair. 45 minutes later he arrived at my house to look at my windshield. After trying to repair and fill the crack be found that it was too big and couldn't be completely filled. After discussing all of my options I decided on just replacing the windshield. He ordered it then and set a appointment for a couple days later when he could come back to do the replacement. Tyler and Chris showed up that morning exactly when he said they would, they did an expert job of removing all of the trim and old windshield, placing the new windshield, and then cleaned up the area that they had been working in in my garage. I could not be happier with the job that they did and my only regret is that I didn't know about A+ sooner so I spent a week waiting for a different  company. I won't make that mistake again and if any of our vehicles need windshield work I will be calling A+ right away.

Being that I live within walking distance, this place is very convenient for me for lunch. Unfortunately what makes this place hard to love, is their inability to consistently get my order correct.  I've gotten more food than I have ordered, I've gotten someone else's complete order, and I've gotten my order half right, half wrong.  I consider myself a regular customer, but I don't leave without pulling all my food out and unwrapping all the tacos before leaving.  But when they do get it right, it's good. A little pricey too, fyi.

I've had windshields in two vehicles replaced in the last two months and both projects went flawlessly.  The phone is answered when you call and they fulfill their promise to arrive within a one hour window.  Prices are competitive. They even transferred my oil change sticker!

Eric and his team are very knowledgeable when it comes to CPR. I've had my old cell phone repaired, and they fixed it with ease. It was just a broken screen repair, but nonetheless, it was repaired with no hiccups. In addition, we bought a refurbished Microsoft Surface for our business. There was an issue, but they fixed that as well. If you have any cell phone needs, this is the place to go!

I have to admit I frequented the other two business before this one I think it's always been the same owner. To me this transition was very very bizarre. I have been to blue tiger pizza a handful of times really enjoyed the pizza. I guess there was some legal drama surrounding them and the guy who came from the northwest to help them launch blue tiger so they had to change the name. To me, it's really bizarre was a little nervous if the food/service would be the same. This is actually one of three restaurants all in the same area(deli is being built next door, the bar is upstairs so if you are watching the game at the bar perfect way to grab some food). The guy who was running the front of the house was so friendly and on top of the orders definitely top notch service on the front end. I walked in right around close they had a few customers he was by himself yet it was all very smooth. I ordered the FB special $5 medium pepperoni for carry out; I waited around 10 minutes to get my pizza. The pizza was how I remembered it; cheesy with a pillowy crust. I did find the pizza to be very greasy and the crust seemed to be a little thin outside of the edges. I found the pizza to have lots of pepperoni and cheese which I like other places they skimp on the toppings (cheese was thick didn't fall off the pizza). Overall my anxiety was unfounded the pizza and service were excellent (pizza was great just like last few times). If you are looking to grab a pie in meridian this is a great place to try!!

I've been here twice, and each time the place was very clean. The bar area has monstrous TV screens that have sports playing. Bowling tips: Tuesdays are $2 bowling and $2 shoe rentals. Wednesdays 9-11 pm is $10 unlimited bowling and includes shoe rental.  Wednesday nights are a little late for me to go during the work week, but we make it an occasional spot for date night. It's also not crowded at that time!  Seems like a great place- I have no complaints. If I try their food and it's delicious, I will bump this up to a 5 star rating.
Good burger and fries. Clean place, well laid out.  Friendly servers. Handicap parking

I'm a fat guy, so i know donuts. I had a twisty maple bar and let's just say, if I wasn't married, I'd marry that donut. 

It was perfectly fluffy and the frosting was on point. 

The owners are very kind and it was obvious they were passionate about their job and cared about each customer. 

Boom.

We started our Saturday at a well known furniture store not named RC Willey and about 2 hours later had an agreement in place for our son's bed but we were not happy with this retailer, that's for a later review.  I happened to log into FaceBook to see what I missed during my time at this location and I saw an ad for Meridian Home Furnishing where customers were raving about the deals and service. I told my wife, let's go and check it out.  We drove past the Meridian Home Furnishings location just like we did for the last 14 years. I circled back and entered the parking lot and looked for the front door. It is a simple and plain building with little curb appeal. We entered inside and saw a little office and proceeded to climb the stairs to see the furnishing offerings.  The furniture looked great.  We remarked how the prices were so affordable and begin to wonder if it was too good to be true.  ( Unfortunately, we, consumers have to think this way, especially if we have been hoodwinked before, and boy have we been hoodwinked )   We were met by Kelly and showed us around another floor with beds taking the time to let us know the different types of mattress and pricing. When we explained that we wanted a bed for our 12 year old son, she chuckled and said, " I guess he doesn't need gel therapy and king size "  She was exactly right. We simply needed a mattress and a decent frame. No frills and no super-sizing.  She provided us with a couple of options including pricing then we went downstairs and picked out the frame. Here's the biggest difference between those " other guys " and MHF. You'll know what the total price before paying versus the mystery amount and dozens of signed papers later with those " other guys "
The price was affordable, and Kelly rocked it out. We had an issue with our credit card, and we were not able to pay that day, but we were still able to schedule a delivery on the 4th of July.  Kelly called me that morning and we ran the card with no issues, They delivered and set up later on the 4th.  Amazing service, Quality products, Highly recommended. Please visit Meridian Home Furnishings. You'll thank me later for the hundreds of dollars you will be saving.

Fantastic arcade area! We purchased the $30 token deal and my kids were happy! Well worth the money. Games accumulated tokens on a card that the kids cashed in at the end for some great prizes! A plus my birthday child was given a massive ice cream sundae on the house! Will be back for some bowling!

I've typically used just a regular old car wash; i needed to have my Ford Fiesta detail cleaned since I was trading it in for a new car. Super awesome job!!! The car looked amazing ended up getting more than asking price. They go the extra mile too cleaned off the engine block; it looked brand new from top to bottom. I purchased a Land Rover he told me about his coating-he created it and offers it for $200 (other guys upwards $1,000). This gives your car a lasting shine for up to five years; is resistant to water, salt, water spots will ensure you will have a shiny car. They did an excellent job again..I'd highly recommend them for a detail clean, coating or just a car wash. Call them today...

This place is AMAZING. LOOOOVVVVEEE Sa-Wad-Dee! friendly awesome staff, delicious food, and excellent vegan options. This is my favorite place to bring visiting friends out to dinner or lunch (the lunch menu rocks!). Part of me wants to selfishly keep this place a secret because they are SO GOOD ;)

I'm very pleased with this business! Ha did a wonderful job with my gel painted manicure and made me feel comfortable and cared for. He encouraged feedback, but I didn't need to give any because he was attentive and aware of my needs. My sister got a gel painted pedicure and felt her experience was just as stellar. The atmosphere of the shop itself is very relaxing and fun. I would recommend this nail salon without hesitation! Clean facilities, friendly staff, and competitive pricing

Angela and her team are honestly the best! She did literally everything I wanted for my wedding. When I saw my wedding bouquet, I was speechless! I cannot simply thank her enough for everything. If you're looking for a wedding florist, look no more!
As of right now I've been in the drive through for 30 minutes behind 4 cars and it's not moving. We are leaving. Never seen anything like this in my life.
Don't go here if you want anything done. Their website, front door and phone message all state they open at 10:00 AM on  weekdays. I was there at 10 and waited till after 11:00 and they never opened.

Family and I stopped in here after graduation for some grub. I am giving this place 3 stars because our server (Quinn) seemed super pissed to be working and everything was a chore. We were there celebrating a happy time and felt like we were an inconvenience to the server. . Also they were out of impossible burgers. I do however appreciate you having vegan options!!

This is our "go-to" Mexican restaurant, the one we take out of town guests to. Love the food, the salsa is awesome, just the right spice! The enchiladas and burritos are excellent. Eddie is always friendly and we look forward to seeing him each time we go. 

Love the margaritas, one is enough to make me "glowy happy". The prices are still reasonable. 

Keep up the good work!

This place has great service and food.  They serve  traditional thai food along with sushi with a few pages for each type of meat and vegetarian dishes. The only reason for the 4 star instead of the 5 is for their mango sweet rice dessert. Their sweet rice was overcooked to the point where it was very hard and chewy.  Felt like it was pulling our teeth with every bite.

A little beacon of light for real, delicious food in the sea of Meridian area lousy food chains.  Locally owned to boot by the dynamic-duo sisters who launched super-successful Tin Roof Tacos in Boise.  Opened today (6/5/18) this location has same menu as the Boise mothership, very young and clearly still in learning mode staff and same hours; that is opening 6:30 in the morning here too.  They are in soft opening mode right now, not advertising, to let the new place wrinkles get ironed out.  While it is clear staff processes and the facility aren't quite fully baked (patio seating not yet in place as example) they are on the right path.  The advantage of going in in early days is that only die-hard fan(atic)s of Tin Roof (who? me?)  may know this and crowds will be fewer...for now.  

FOR BACKSTORY:  In their own voice from website here is what the sisters say:  "Just two sisters from Texas wanting to share what we miss most from home - fresh tacos at the neighborhood taco stand. Tin Roof Tacos sticks to the staples of a street taco: simplicity, size and most importantly, made from scratch. What makes us different? From BBQ Brisket to Baja Shrimp, we bring a new style of tacos to the table. They are not only unique, but you get more taco for less Dinero."

THE DRILL:  Order tacos (roasted poblano are my fav) at the counter from paper menu (and one on wall here eventually, though not up yet), they'll call your name when ready and your tacos are served in carboard "boats" on a circular tray to carry to your table.  Salsa bottles at counter to add to your eats.  (Green (my fav), red or habanero-hot-as-Hades orange.)  

GOOD EATS 4 LOW $: Breakfast tacos - 6 options.  Beyond breakfast there is menu of tacos including Pork & Poultry - 2 options each, Beef - 5 options, Veggie - 3 options and Seafood - 2 options.  Prices run from $2 - $2.50 each.  Chips &...salsa or guacamole or queso @ $1 - $3.   I can never eat more than 2 tacos or one and chips, so I'm a happy Tin Roof diner on wholesome food for around five bucks.  Can't beat that!

LIBATIONS:  Soft drinks @ $1.50 -  $2 or beer @ $2.50 - $4.50.  

VIBE:  Open and industrial.  Concrete floors.  High ceilings.  Communal tables but with enough space around the perimeter of them that you don't feel as if you're in a sardine can.  Hooray.  Windows on two sides keep it bright.  Patio seating to come. I like this interior space even more than the Boise one as it seems more open...breathin' room!

ACCESSIBILITY:  Level in and all on one level inside.  Order counter is accessible height (as required by ADA since 1990 but so few get this right in Boise area - they do here).   Communal tables have wheelchair seating clearances on back sides of two and each table has wheelchair clearances at each end cap.  Loo is marked with access symbol.  All good!

PARKING:  Private lot in this small strip mall.  Two ADA spaces at mid building.

NEIGHBORS:  Fanci Freeze at opposite end of the building.

Poor service, mediocre food, disorganized, not clean.

My husband and I went here for a pastry and a coffee around 8 pm.   Only a few of the items in the dessert case had labels so we couldn't tell what was what.   We waited approx 20 minutes in line.  Orders are placed with the cashier, you provide your name and when your order is ready someone calls your name and brings your order to you.  We got to the front of the line but in order to place our order we first had to ask someone what the items were in the case (ie what type of pies, pastries etc. as the lables were not on the items).   The cashier didn't know what the items were so we had to hail someone else from behind the counter, interrupting them from what they were doing, so they could inform us what our options were.   This made us lose our place in line.   When we had the information we needed to place our order we waited in line a 2nd time to place our order with the cashier.   When we got to the front of the line again to order, we had to repeat our order to her 3 times.    I think she may have been new.   We ordered a piece of pie, a pastry and 2 lattes.   They took our name and we found a table to wait our food delivery.
We waited approx 10 minutes for our food to be delivered.  During our wait we observed the atmosphere and noticed how messy and untidy the place was.   There was a pile of empty boxes stacked and crammed in a decorative cupboard in the eating area.   some of them were on the floor.   It was unsightly.
The tables were not clean and had garbage on them.    The garbage area's were overflowing and there was no room to place our trash in the recepticle.
When the food was delivered, the pie was in a 'to go' container stacked on top of a sandwich basket which also had the other pastry on it.  The coffee's were luke warm.  The pastry was very good.   The pie was mediocre.
After we ate our dessert and coffee we left the restaurant and walked along the outside of the building towards our vehicle and decided to peer into the windows in the baking area.   We could see the ovens and mixers.   There was a scale on a table pushed up to the window we were looking through and we saw a dirty, never been cleaned, build-up of grime (flour and dirt) on the table/scale. 
Don't think we will be going back.
Food was great!  Service is a bit slow but I sensed that they just need some more staff to accommodate the number of guests.  Place is clean and inviting and we will be back.

This was a huge disappointment! They advertise walk ins welcome so, I walked in at 11ish on a Tuesday morning. There were only 4-5 people working and I was asked to come back at 4. I scheduled an appointment for 4 for a mani/pedi. A little before 3 I called to see if I could be seen early but no answer. I then replied to the text I received when I scheduled my appointment, no response there either. I arrived about 3:30 and had to wait until about 4:10 to get started. I picked out a gel polish only to have the tech waste 10 minutes trying to find it. She never found it. The brochure notes the pedicure lasts 25-30 minutes but, I was in the  chair no less than an hour! It was not  because I was being pampered! In fact, I did not receive the sea salt scrub as indicated on the brochure and when I asked about it they were all clueless as to what it was. Then I got my manicure... I had dip product on my nails that she was able to remove just as if it was gel, no extra work however, I was charged extra for the soak off never mind the fact I didn't soak! Anyways, I was there well over 2 hours and paid way more than I should have. It's a beautiful salon, there was about 30 pedicure chairs and even more manicure stations but, that's not really impressive when you don't have any technicians to use them! I will not be back! Great concept but, poorly managed. I would think that they would have their issues worked out by now.

My son has Celiac Disease, and this wonderful restaurant offers gluten free buns, multiple gluten free dipping sauces, and all of their fries are gluten free!   They offer a great variety of meat for the burgers too!
Also, the kombucha here is great!  We will definitely come back here, and we highly recommend this restaurant!

Was taken to Hugo's for lunch yesterday and it was absolutely delicious. I had The Prairie - Turkey / cranberry sandwich and their fries which were the best I've ever had. Customer service was outstanding.  Heading back this evening for dinner. No brainer.

The quality of the food is good, the bakery items that I have tasted in the past are good, but this time I went in for sandwiches and we all asked....WHERE IS THE MEAT??? The bread to filling ratio of their sandwiches is way off. We had two French dips and a turkey avocado on focaccia... there was SO MUCH bread but very little turkey or beef. 
Hopefully it was an off night because I really want to like this place.

We moved here from California and must say this our favorite place so far. Their whole beans have flavor and I love their enchilada sauce. Far from Tex Mex. Good chips and salsa too. Great service. We will definitely be back!
Awesome food! Great service! Fresh food served with a smile. The mules were amazing. Great atmosphere and burgers were the best.

Can NOT get a well done burger in here, despite my best attempts.  First visit, sent it back and my entire group was long finished before it arrived, and it wasn't much more cooked than the first.

Tried again today...nicely stressed the well-done.  Ate a pink burger, as I didn't have time for a remake.  Mentioned to the manager and though she offered a remake, no apology...

Freaking Awesome Burgers with Amazing flavor.
I Love this place.
The staff is friendly and prompt.
We've used this company several times over the years. They have great quality and fast service! Will do business with them every time we need our chips repaired or windshields replaced.

Service was good. Chicken piccada was good. Family said the burgers we're good. 
I felt insulted with the $30 dollar ribeye they put in front of me. I felt like I was at Sizzler. Small, thin and blah. No flavor.  It was cooked right at least. Place is  way overpriced for what you get. Not sure we will be going back.

Joining CrossFit Fireside was one of the best decisions I ever made. I was really out of shape when I joined and am slowly getting into better shape. The coaches and other community  members are super supportive and really help you reach and exceed your daily and long term goals. I'll admit I usually finish everything last but everyone is always there cheering me on so I can finish!

Each time I go in (4-5 times a week usually) I surprise myself and what I am able to accomplish. The programming here is awesome and can always be scaled to fit your abilities. When you join you are required to take foundation classes which teach you proper moves and techniques so you don't get injured. Each class begins with a warm up and a refresher of the moves we will be doing. 

Hubby and I have made lots of friends here and look forward to going almost every day. Over the summer classes were filling up so the Coaches/Owners worked with the members to find a good time to add another class to fit more people's schedules. 

People often "complain" about the costs but you get what you pay for. This is the best money I spend every month. I get unlimited classes, lots of advice, nutrition classes, and mobility classes for better movement and stretching. While the coaching is not one on one you do get individual attention to make sure you are where you need to be. They offer yoga and barbell club as well.  

If you are looking for a new place to work, to get started or to drop in from out of town I can't recommend Fireside enough! They have great programs for kids too! Lots of members bring their kids, even babies and sometimes dogs. It is a family atmosphere and I couldn't be happier to have become a part of the Fireside Family.
Great sounding menu but the teenagers running the place don't have a clue.  Very dirty. I may try it one more time.  But I've heard a lot of people with the same complaints.

They always do a great job! He always smells great and has a cute bandana when he leaves. They go above and beyond with how kind and welcoming they are to my dog, who I know is not the easiest to bath or blow dry. Even though baths are a big fear for him he is always so excited to go and see them.

Food is amazing. I've been eating at this restaurant since I was a kid at a few different locations. The owners are incredibly nice people. That being said, I called in an order for pick up, and when I tried to give the man who took my order my payment information he argued with me saying he was just too busy to take it. I asked him again to take it as I would not be the one picking it up. He got audibly upset and handed the phone to someone else who told me there was a "change in policy" and they no longer take payments info over the phone. Too bad, I liked using them to order from but due to the rudeness and their new "policy" I suppose my business will go to someone else.

We ordered in through door dash while in town. It was an excellent Mexican choice. Delicious street tacos, nachos, salsa, beans, rice.... the sauce that came with the tacos was phenomenal- spicy with a great heat! When I come back to Boise I will stop here again!

We've always had a good experience with Papa John's.  I've ordered pizza here 10+ times before the review and they have always delivered excellent pizza whether we pick it up or they deliver out to Kuna.  I enjoy PJ's more than all the other delivery/carry out pizza places in town.
I have worked with Angela on multiple events. Very reliable, professional, and sweet. She will go beyond out of her way to deliver on exactly what you want. Highly recommend!!

The food is great, the staff is friendly and attentive, Bieber the menu is overly confusing and they are more than aware of it, which is not a good thing to me. It seems as though they almost use it as a sales technique, requiring someone to stand there and translate it for you, really kind of sucks. 
My wife son and I are all very indecisive, that said it is extremely encumbersome to have to have it explained the times. 
For this reason I think three stars is generous

Garbage food and the cashiers tried to keep my change! I am outraged!
I went there 5 times and went to different people every time and they all had very bad attitudes.
Great little neighborhood restaurant best food would taste it will come in order again soon

Bedbugs!  We booked three nights with them. The second morning, we found bedbugs. We cancelled our third night immediately.  They refuse to refund our money for the last night we cancelled. This place is a sham!

Went last night.  They had the patio doors open and fly were everywhere. One landed on my burger as I was picking it up to take a bite and was almost a gonner.

Food was mediocre. Nothing really stood out.  Was hoping for a lot better as we love to take care of small businesses.

Quaint and gourmet place that is a "Must Visit" for anyone in the Treasure Valley.  Like an upscale restaurant in a small area with outside dining also.  Great chef and service. If you leave dissatisfied or disappointed then you didn't communicate good enough because this place aims to please and most of the time succeeds.
Oh I almost forgot to mention, they have an amazing brunch on Sundays.  Made to order 5 star chef dishes.
Great burgers. Unprecedented fry, sauce, burger and seasoning salt options. A big winner with the family. I never knew their were so many possibilities for fries. Must try to appreciate

Nice small town eatery. The service was pretty good for only having one hosts/waitress on shift. The menu is small but packed with options for all. There were four of us and we had a range of dishes including salads, sandwiches, and burgers. All of which were great! But the best part of my meal was the bacon! I don't know how they cooked it but that was some of the best bacon I have ever had! Whatever you get add bacon, if it already has bacon get more!

Yep, still an awesome 5 star review (my original was 03/16/2018)!! Obviously I'm too busy enjoying the Mango Fried Rice, Tofu Appetizer, or veggie Tom Kha to bother checking in on this app (sorry!) but we've been loyal Sa-Wad-Dee customers for a few years now. Have fun and try the Angry Fried Rice (sriracha magic!), the White Forest dessert, or the Garlic Noodles! So good. Also, vegan & plant based options galore!

I've been to several salons over the years in the Treasure Valley and none make you feel as special as Ha and his NT&S team!

We have so much fun when we go in and Vi does an amazing job! 

I'm moving from the state and will miss them terribly but now my spot is own for some other lucky person!!

We were hoping Olive (Doodle) would be cut evenly and about 1.5 inches all over with long hair on head and straight even cut, fluffy and smoothe to the touch. 

Olive was cut so badly I cried, we were totally reimbursed our funds. She looked like she fell in a blender to put it bluntly, another in our neighborhoods cat had lacerations, never again. Beautiful rig but they sent our someone who had never worked as a salon artist before. 

The business tried to make it right for another grooming but I can't chance it again. I sent photos, many pics of just what we wanted, it was ignored and our dog took months to grow back long enough to even out.

They forgot to put the main entree of chicken in one of our to go orders. So we get home and realize we have a container of rice and a empty spot of where the chicken was suppose to go. We called to alert them of this matter and the "shift lead" pretty much said oh well, nothing we can do about it. They made no effort to make it right. So we paid for something we never received. Thanks for stealing our money Panda Express. Get it together.

Such a fun place!  You choose your burger and types of fries. Then, theirs plenty of dipping choices to place your fries in.  From bison to turkey or beef burgers there is something for everyone unless you want a salad.  Then this isn't your place. I enjoyed the original burger and Laura fries with garlic aoli.
