Loved the outdoor seating option since the summer sun was out although don't choose it fir the view which is parking lot or movie theater front.
Burger was okay. Loved the onion rings. I had the double burger with cheese. Like the sauteed onions but otherwise average burger. Place compares to 5Guys or Smashburger.

I don't understand the terrible review. I love this place. Easy process to make an appointment and get checked in. The nurses were friendly and the process waa quick and efficient. Our new doctor is amazing. Friendly and even though she just met my 5 year old her concern was genuine from the get go. I love this place.
Came for happy hour...not a very good menu.  However, the appetizer menu was reasonable.  Service was SUPER SLOW!  (That is why I gave such a low rating).  Food was good.

WORST service ever. Stood at the front for 15 minutes while employees kept walking past me looking at me. No greeting or "I'll be right with you." Someone eating even walked passed me and said "i guess it takes forever for them to help you." They didn't even have a full restaurant and there were several people working. People were piling up behind me and still nothing. Like HELLO. I finally get someone to talk to me after I walk up and bug someone and no sorry or anything. I just wanted to order take out and should have walked out sooner but I was starved. I finally place my order and she says it will be 30 minutes. That's when I walked out. Headed down the road to Thai Basil...greeted right away, they ask me if I want water while I wait and was handed my food a few minutes later. What a huge difference in service. Will never be back to this place...head to Thai Basil if you're wanting some yummy Thai food and good service.
Mind blowing blonde action all up in here! Thanks  Erica for hustling hard @Tantalum‍‍

This was our first visit to Dickey's BBQ with my family we were great with a delicious aroma of BBQ and a very helpful friendly employee.  We tried the pulled pork and brisket. The self serve BBQ sauces was a neat idea so you can dish up warm sauce to your likely. Food was delicious atmosphere was nice too.  You can grab a soft serve  cone on the house as well.  We will definitely be coming back

My husband and young son and I enjoyed a fabulous lunch at The Counter last week.  We ordered the turkey burger with bacon and the 1/3 pound beef with cheese and aioli.  Both were delicious.  We also shared the deviled eggs with bacon - what a delicious twist!  The staff was attentive and helpful.  They were friendly to my 3-year old and made sure he was served ASAP.  And his sweet potato fries were fantastic!  We look forward to returning soon!

We have had our daughter in New Horizon Academy since we moved to the area about 3 months ago. After visiting many daycares in the area and being extremely disappointed in the childcare options, we were so so excited to find New Horizon. Amber the director was so kind and thoroughly answered all questions/concerns we had. The facility is clean, warm, and very secure. Our daughter just loves going to school every day! Since being enrolled here she has learned so many new things including a bit of sign language! Miss Kaylee is such a great transition twos teacher. She is always communicating with us patents on what the kids are doing during the day and even sends pictures through the app! Not only does she care for them on a child care level, but she teaches them a new subject every month and always has art projects for them to do that correspond with the theme. 

My husband and i are completely at ease every day that we drop her off into their care. And the home cooked breakfast & lunch & snacks are always healthy as well!

First off, I absolutely LOVE the pastries and food here. Everything I've ever tried is extremely tasty and isn't very expensive. The reason I give 4 stars instead of 5 is because the service here is very questionable. Some days I receive great service and other days not so much. I wish they would keep consistency in service because it would make the overall experience more enjoyable.

FREE PREZEL DAY!!  But I just wanted to PAY FULL PRICE to get a snack for my team. (10 pretzels) They had the foresight to put out crowd control barricades but not enough to have more than 1 ONE (1) UNO worker. 

WOW !!  HOW STUPID IS THIS MANAGEMENT TEAM!!  DO YOU HATE MONEY?????? First you give away free food (I assume to get new people to try you out) then put on one worker to give the most unpleasantly possible experience. NICELY DONE!!

The manager and owner should be ashamed of their management abilities. The poor lonely worker was working his tail off.

I used to live in Santa Barbara and got to choose between In-N-Out and Hamburger Habit and would choose The Habit at their downtown location often. I haven't had one of their burgers in years since then. Maybe even ten years ago.. And just ordered the char burger with sweet potato fries and a chocolate shake and I can say it's just as good as I remembered. The burger was immaculately made. It has more flavor and tastes way fresher than Five Guys. Awesome meal. Will order again from them! Classic California burger!

Good variety of choices and great portions.  Food came out fast and hot.  Value was good and tasty salsa.  Queso was a little thick, maybe less American cheese so it wasn't so plastic like.  Would come back to try the breakfast tacos.
Decent taco spot! Chips are just ok. We like the fried chicken taco. Lots of seating.
Terrible service.  I will not be going back. Ever. The servers literally do not want to be there. To be had because the food and patio are great. But the servers not so much.

I have a 8 month old 96lb Wooly Malamute that i cant keep out of the water and he hadn't blown his first coat yet and may not have this summer. I kept up as much as i could, but he still had mats on his belly and he was hot all the time. Being a first time customer, I emailed ahead and warned them it could take a little extra time. Turns out "little extra time" was an understatement. Kait showed and was very polite and professional and I wasn't aware there was even an issue until i wandered out to the van two hours later. Come to find out, we didnt allow enough time.  It took Kait about 3 hours to complete a job she probably thought would take 1.5 before she showed up. I caused her to have to bump her next several appointments and made her day longer than it needed to be. That being said, Kait did FANTASTIC work and most importantly my pup was happy, clean (for a day) and cooler. I will be on the schedule every for weeks or so from now on. No need to try any other groomers. Thank you again.

Prices are steep for dinner so we went for lunch. I have dietary restrictions that were accommodated. I loved the Caesar salad that I added salmon too! Seconds please (another time). I had the Vodka Toddy! Fantastic! I'll be back, if only for a repeat.

Prices are steep for dinner so we went for lunch. I have dietary restrictions that were accommodated. I loved the Caesar salad that I added salmon too! Seconds please (another time). I had the Vodka Toddy! Fantastic! I'll be back, if only for a repeat.
9 months later, I'm shamelessly and joyfully a regular for the famous (in my eyes) Caesar salad! Consistently delicious every time.  The gluten-free almond cake or chocolate torte are an occasional scrumptious sweet treat.

I am a big fan of Dutch brothers, this one did not live up to the name. Terrible service, saw 5 employees standing around talking, took the longest I have ever had to wait and they didn't provide the friendly service I am accustom to with Dutch. Sad day
What a fun experience! The boss was there and said he would make the for us and he did! What a guy...  To the pizza... EXCELLENT! Nothing in the area can beat it!

The staff was very nice and helpful.  The wait time was super short except for once I got in the room. They were running behind.  However the doctor was quick and got my meds ordered right away.  I would highly recommend this place to others.
The best pizza and wings  love the crust. It's the best in town. Ask for the wings to go through twice for a great crispness

We took my husband and youngest daughter for brunch. The staff was very nice and patient. The food tasted great and was served quickly. 
It was an excellent first impression and we plan to go back and enjoy more pastries.
I love Yuki --their darling nail technician. My pedicure s always last a long time and the staff is super personable and cares about making sure their clients are satisfied (:
Tyler was wonderful! He responded quickly and made the whole process fast & easy. He helped us get our insurance to cover the repair 100%! We will definitely use them again
Amazing place to plan a party!! There is so much to do, wonderful food and great staff.

I am very happy with Aussie Pet Grooming and Matt (our groomer). We have a large golden retriever who gets very sad when we go for a fun car ride only to be left behind at the groomer. This service comes to your home and although the price is slightly higher, it was worth it for us.  Customer service is wonderful and attentive, Lenny exited the van wagging his tail - happy to be in his yard within steps. For this old dog (Lenny, not me), a new trick made the grooming experience very positive.
I've never had a bad pizza there.  I love the flavor, I love their rewards program.  I've recommended this place to a lot of people!

If you thought the name of this sandwich shop was Two Fat Guys Deli, your memory is not failing.  It was called that for a time, but the Two Guys had a falling out, one departed and instead of two Guys plural it is now Guy's possessive in the name.  It was the cook guy who remained here and the sandwiches by any name for the shop are just as good.

FOOD: 
We order what is not on the big chalkboard menu and that is a veggie sandwich.  It seems veggie options are less popular in the Boise area than in our former home towns and we will travel to find good ones, like the veggie sandwich here.  

This is a completely 'build your own' endeavor for the veggie option and they have a veritable plethora of veggie ingredients from which to choose from the standard lettuce, tomatoes, onions and avocado to jalapenos and pepperoncini and bell pepper slices and kalamata olives and...well...as you can see.. potential abounds.  They have rye bread too, real rye, which is a big plus. Horsradish too.  

 We think sharing is key since it is such a big sandwich.  At about $9 to for a sandwich big enough feed two people it seems a very good value to us.

You will get to choose a side with your sandwich, one of which is coleslaw.  Just a heads up that it is really more of a coarse grated, oil and vinegar dressed cabbage salad than a more traditional styled slaw.  We think it makes a good sandwich ingredient.  

Homemade soup is in the house too and on most Mondays they do Manhattan clam chowder. That soup is one of my husband's favorites but if he could wave a magic wand over the pot here, he'd have them reduce the salt by a good amount.

SERVICE:
Very nice folks behind the counter.  Top notch for friendliness and sandwich making skills!

VIBE:
A bunch of tables line the wall of windows.  Not the grandest of ambiance but you don't eat the vibe.  Outdoor seating at tables on the patio / sidwalk but they can be hot even in the not hottest of months.  So can the inside at times.  Just a tip about that since ordering to go option is also a good one at times.

THIS N THAT:

PARKING:  In the private lot associated with the little strip mall where this is located.

ACCESSIBILITY:  Lot has accessible parking spot.  Level in the door.  Most seating is standard height although quarters can be tight at full house times.  Loo is accessible.
Love this place! Great apps, burgers, side salad and a nice bottle of local vino rounded out our first visit! We will be back!

They earned three stars because the service was excellent.  With that said, it seems to me that the burger was not anything exceptional and under cooked.  I also thought that the product did not live up to the price.   I did love the shoe string French fries.   You can do better elsewhere.

The food is okay, but the steak is so over seasoned that it's inedible. The atmosphere is terrible. It's dirty behind the counter and the staff is unorganized. You can't call in an order. No one answers. Even when they didn't have a single customer. Now when you call you either get voicemail or it hangs up on you. After 4 months this place has gone downhill. Fast.

First visit. Wait was long, but staff were friendly. Would have rated higher if they would have taken back from waiting sooner. Seemed to move a lot of other through steadily. Really liked PA, Christine Paynter who saw us. Was friendly thorough and professional. 

Second visit. Across the hall for the endoscopy. Got us in timely. Irene prepped her and had a good sense of humor and interacted well. Upped
Rating to 4 stars overall.

Recently I was visiting friends in Eagle, Idaho and their 2 pups, small dogs ( cocker/poodle mix), had a noon appointment for grooming days before Thanksgiving and were dropped off on time.  At 6PM, after checking several times throughout the afternoon as usually they're done in 3 hours, and being told that they were just so busy with the holiday rush, they were told it would be one more hour.  They were picked up at 7PM as instructed and both had terrible hair cuts!  The muzzle area was different on both side of each dog, along with the ears of both dogs  The ear of one had a blunt-straight cut into the hair in the middle of one ear well over an inch long. One can only assume what happened to the tail of one!!  Oh, it's there, but nearly shaved right down to the skin right up to the scraggly cut fluff on the end. 

Yes, I saw these dogs before and after and for sure will NEVER take my dog there for grooming!!!  These pups have been groomed for well over a year by licensed groomers and are very use to being groomed.  So, what's the point of an appointment at PetSmart?  A 7 hour appointment for 2 small pups is totally ridiculous.  Let alone, if there are new groomers, customers should be made aware, along with point out and correct flaws they preformed when the customer comes to pick them up.  Makes me wonder, what kind of treatment the dogs received during their 7 hour stay!

This has been one of these worst places my family and I have stayed. First of all we get here and the beds only have one sheet on them, no comforter and the skirt was ripped. 
Bathroom shower was dirty on the bottom, left over pubes. Toilet had pee on the ring of it. 
After seeing this we call and they apologize and send a cleaning crew. They did clean the toilet and gave us more blankets so it was okay. 
Oh but wait there's more.. popcorn under the bed, one of us stepped on a thorn, AND a piece of GLASS. So we searched more and found a PILL of god knows what. We have a toddler walking around and who ones what could've happened if he got ahold of that. 
Please do not stay here, not worth it.

I was looking for a detailer because I needed to get my car detailed before I shipped it due to a PCS. I am glad that Indepth was the first placed I called and didn't have to look further! Chris is such a genuine guy, super helpful, friendly and really took care of my car! He was able to remove the hard water spots making my black car shine again. Also noticed he was able to get my make up off my steering wheel and visor . If I wasn't leaving I would come back but I highly recommend!

Love this place. First time I went I was cheap and didn't buy the soup. The owner came out and said you gotta try this so he gave me a bowl of the clam chowder for free soon after he gave me a bowl of the tomato bisque or something.  Both were homemade and amazing. I will order the soup every time I go. The sand which had so much meat in it with a homemade mayo.  Best sandwhich I've had in Boise area since I've moved here. My only complaint is the hours. I want to come for dinner but they close at five. Great food, great service!

I am finally getting to reviewing this place after being here several times and enjoying a wide variety of sandwiches and soups.  On several occasions, the owner has stopped by the table to chat and to check in.  He is extremely nice and friendly and I appreciate the warm atmosphere he provides when there.

I have tried several sandwiches and I could name the ones I like but the ones I have tried have all seemed to be really good in their own way.  Fresh daily soups are really good.  Lately, I have been enjoying the Italian sandwich but the fun thing about this place is the vast amount of choices and uniqueness to their menu.  Try it several times with different sandwiches every time and I think that is part of the fun here.  Overall, great experiences every time, minus one star as the location is not very convenient and parking can tend to be difficult at times.  Many turns to get into this parking lot and tight parking spots.

I needed to fix a couple of nails badly as I had just gone to a place that totally ruined my nails. I scheduled an appointment and went in and got put with a gentleman named Jackie. He was so knowledgeable about how to get my dip powder fixed and keep them stronger for longer it was amazing. The owners were there and one of them must have thanked me 10 times for being there and reminding me to let them know if I thought something wasn't how I wanted it. The salon is Klein and the people are kind and that will give anyone 5 stars in my book. Definitely the place I will be going for however long I stay in Boise!

This is my first time and it won't be my last time going here.
The pizza is really good, its cook perfect it has a crisp to the bite. 
I love a lot of sauce and they did great on that, I feel like the bread of the pizza itself is missing a seasoning I cant figure it out. 
I love the crunchy little pepperonis a lot. Little to greasy 
Good job guys I'll be back

We waited 20 minutes for two cold unremarkable hamburgers. $9.50 per cold burger + $2.25 for a small order of fries.
Server never checked on us after delivering our meal. This is a one and done dining experience.
Just walked out. The line was long and I heard them say to other customers that "the beef isn't cooked yet". It's noon, and they haven't cooked the beef?

I reached out to Justin via email. He was very responsive and helpful even though he does not practice in the area of law I needed help with. He was able to point me in the right direction and get me started. Thanks Justin for taking the time to promptly answer my emails. I appreciate your assistance.

The food here is amazing. I had the Rib-Eye and my wife ordered the pork chops. Both were cooked to perfection. The service was also fantastic. If you are looking for a fantastic meal you should really try Grants. You will be happy with the quality. We have eaten at top restaurants in the past and I have to say that the food here can not be beat. This is a jewel in Meridian. Thank you so much for a great meal!

Arrived at 6:20 on Friday evening. The host took my name and told me 5 minutes. We sat in the entry right beside the podium to wait. We gave up and left after 40 minutes when the fourth new party with no reservations was seated. Too bad.
Great place. Great service and great new menu. Love the build your own burgers , salads and shakes. Comfortable place! Fries and onion strings are fab!

Two years later and they still haven't gotten it right.

I've been twice, once when they first opened, and again last night.

Great fries, as usual, bummer burger.  The bun was ice cold as if it was just defrosted earlier that day, so definitely not fresh.  The patty was dry, and in general the thing seemed hobbled together without care.  They also skipped the tomatoes.  Think they're taking the whole "burgers on the side" thing a little too far.  Maybe just stop offering burgers all together, or at least stop charging money for them?

The kids that work there are nice enough, but could probably benefit from a little leadership by way of a manager, especially on a busy Friday night.  Hate to see what the place is like on a Tuesday.

This is my go to donut place and it has been for years.  I highly recommend the maple bar with bacon bits!  It's delicious!  If your not a maple bar fan give the apple bear claw a shot.  Honestly there isn't anything I haven't liked.  Always fresh and the staff is friendly and helpful.

Fun atmosphere, but their prices have really gone up. $8.29 for a kids meal?! Our family of 6 spent $80 on dinner and it's not even that great. Another $70 for bowling leaves is unlikely to do this often.

Absolutely the best detail company in the the valley! I have had other people come out to detail my cars and they were not as prepared and as professional as these guys were. They got scratches out that I thought I was going to have to get body work done. They saved my a chunk of change!  They are fully mobile and they would have came out to my job to detail my car but I though it would be easier if the came out to my house. Chris the owner is really respective and friendly. They worked really hard and I watched them the whole time, they never slowed down. They were so awesome! Thank you dynamic detail I really appreciate your guys hard work. I would recommend you guys to everybody

This place is absolutely amazing. Chef Wally is a magician when it comes to all things edible. Put it this way, I have hated peas in every form since I was a kid and still do. After frequenting Fat Guys for about a month I started to believe no matter what Chef put together I would love it. I saw a green soup one Wednesday and in my heart of hearts knew it was Split Pea. I accepted his offer to try the soup of the day anyways and it blew my mind. I still dont like anyone else version of anything involving peas. If you havent tried this place, you better make it happen. NOW!!!

I needed to have my Toyota Sienna detailed so we could list it to sell. I called around and everyone was booked out for a week or two. I called Dynamic Detail and Chris offered to get it taken care of the next day even though he had a full schedule! The van was in much worse shape than they had anticipated, so it took them a lot longer than expected, but the outcome was AMAZING! Gums, stains, and 5 years of beating from 5 kids had taken its toll. After taking it to Dynamic Detail it looked like we had a brand new vehicle! Chris promised to take care of us and he fulfilled his end. I had 2 buyers waiting at home as soon as I left Dynamic Detail and it sold immediately! The buyers were so impressed with the condition of the vehicle and I'm sure we probably could have asked a few hundred dollars more purely based on the immaculate condition on the inside and the shine on the outside! Service was excellent and the price was fantastic! Thank you Dynamic Detail! We will certainly be referring you to others!

Great bagels! Funky friendly staff. Fantastic coffee. 
Here today working from home. 
I am enjoying a toasted everything bagel. Flavor is fantastic, and the salt flakes are just the right touch. 
I'll be back.

We came to this location and found that this deli replaced the one we expected to find.   That's okay, because we got good stuff!

Hubby had a very nice meatball sub.  The star of the day, though, was the bowl of clam chowder that he brought home for me.   I'm a Floridian raised on seafood -- I've even been to clam chowder festivals -- and this one could have rivaled those.  It was creamy, well-seasoned, and had a respectable clam presence.   I'd definitely recommend it.

Treated very poorly and made to feel like the worst pet owners on the planet because our goldendoodle was matted.  We used them once for the convenience however the price and the demeaning treatment was not worth it.

Myself and three friends come here often. It's the only place we will go. Ha does my nails and he's perfect. When I first started coming about a year ago I had hang nail issues on both toes and he worked a miracle fixing those to where I have no issues now. I'll never go anywhere else. Love this place!

I've been going to Dr. Hansen at Austin Creek for a few years now and I love them. 

They're always very nice and helpful if I need to change appointments. When I had an issue come-up he told me to come in right away, got me in within 5 minutes, took a look and didn't even charge me for the visit.
Gold fries are my favorite. Their burgers are not too greasy, staff is always cheerful!
I love their fries and the variety of dipping sauces. Clean and friendly staff. Burgers are tasty too!

Solid Thai Food for Idaho. We tried two entrees at lunch:
- Complimentary garden salad: 2/5 based on neither of use liking the dressing.
- Pad Thai with Shrimp: 3/5, the sauce were too sweet for either of us
- Vegetable Lover with Shrimp: 3.5/5, garlic sauce was tasty

$3 each for the shrimp up-charge for ~5-6 shrimp is high, however, would be a good value with chicken or beef.
Turns out the chip was too small to need repair. But Tyler came out anyway just to make sure. So very nice and professional! I would highly recommend!

Come for the kids, stay for the adults! I cannot begin to appreciate this place enough! Reasonably priced food and drinks, happy hour, kid meal specials, huge TVs, the list goes on! Sign to kids up for Kids Bowl Free, hang outside on comfy furniture, or grab a table in the restaurant that actually shows WORLD CUP SOCCER!! Even the women's! Matt in the bar area is incredibly accommodating and personable!

I walked into this shop while on vacation in Boise. Being a nail tech in California, I'm always skeptical when getting my nails done by new people but was so pleasantly surprised by the folks in this salon! Great personalities and the husband and wife team bring a fun sense of familiarity. Janna is a real artist and is knowledgeable and caring. She did a fantastic job on my nails and I would recommend this salon to everyone, all day long!

I like this location. The management tries hard and runs a tight ship. There are a couple things that have been bothering me for quite some time. One is the inside temp; has always felt too cold and if I don't bring a jacket with me to lunch then I'll always skip Panda Express b/c I know it won't be enjoyable to shiver while eating lunch.

The other is this one napkin dispenser that's been disgustingly gross/dirty for months. There was a woman cleaning the surrounding area by the drink machine today, and just in passing, I mentioned that there was one thing that never seems to be clean, but is obvious, and that is that napkin dispenser. I didn't say it in a particularly nice way. But she immediately went to the back, grabbed a new rag, and spent almost 10 minutes cleaning the heck out of that thing.

Her name, best as I could tell from her nametag, was Anjea.

So I applaud and salute her responsiveness, can-do attitude and persistence to make it right!

Still have to go w/ 4 stars since so cold and that thing was dirty for months. Hope during future visits I will be able to up that to 5 stars!

I thought this would be a good place to come with my sick daughter.  We sat waiting for over 90 minutes and we were checked on once with a "it should be any minute now" and that was after an hour.  When I asked how long it would be, I was told it was due to the fact there was only one provider and I was welcome to leave if I didn't want to wait any longer.  I had mentioned that most urgent cares wait time is not longer than 20,minutes. It would have been good to know when we checked in that there was only one care provider on the pediatric wing and one on the family wing in such a massive building.  Once we were finally seen, the care provider was great. She answered my questions and I didn't feel rushed.  That is the only reason there are two stars.

I found this place pretty mediocre.
The fries I got were soggy not crisp. I got one yam and one Laura. Are they supposed to be soggy?  If so, not a fan at all.

The sauces were cool but I found them all mediocre again and nothing was delicious.

Bummer. Cool concept though.
I'd never eat here again the staff are awful and the foos is better at the on by the mall I'm sorry but you guys need to close your store it awful

I heard so many people rave about this place - I was excited to go. I wasn't impressed at all. I guess my expectations were higher. The food is ok, for what you pay - I think there should be more. Maybe I will try again to see if they have improved.

The new girl booked us right in the middle of a row of rooms blocked out for a wedding party.....we didn't know this until we were trying to sleep and not to mention, it was one of the rooms that faced the open foyer....right next to the staircase. Once the wedding reception was over around 11pm, the party raged on in the foyer, stairs and down our hall. They sounded like they were having a great time and if I hadn't of been in Boise for a family medical emergency, I would have probably opened my door and joined in the fun. 

However, I had a very long day and all I wanted to do was sleep. As much as I wanted to be happy for the new couple, I was getting angry that they were inconsiderately interrupting my sleep and maybe others' as well....I had a 4 hour drive the next day and I thought, "Surely the front desk is aware of all this and how could they let this go on knowing there are other people around?"......so I called at 1:30am to ask if they could get the crowd to settle down and be quiet. That didn't work. I called again around 3am. 


I finally fell asleep around 4am but then was awakened at 8:30 to the sound of kids running, hollering and breakfast goers. When I went to check out, I told the lady at the front desk my room number and without mentioning any of this to her, she told me  my room had been comped. The manager was well aware of the festivities that were taking place last night and she was very sorry that the new girl didn't book us at the other end of the hotel. They admitted that there were other rooms available and that we should have never been booked in the middle of a group of rooms reserved for a wedding. I was blown away at such service....I didn't even have to say anything for them to make it right! I will definitely be using this hotel again in the future, but definitely suggest a room away from, "My big fat noisy wedding" next time!

Bunch of thieves, avoid at all cost, the last payment i made to them of $500 only $20 yes $20 went to principal, needless to say i refinanced with Capitol One for literally less than half the interest

I have been to many dentist over the years and Dr. McRae is by far the best dentist I have been to.  I had always assumed I could trust my dentist but personal experience has taught me that many dentist aren't concerned with doing what is best for the patient.  Dr. McRae is knowledgable, professional and most importantly Dr. McRae has integrity.  Dr. McRae provides his patients with the most effective and safe treatment options available.  He will actually take the time to educate you regarding your health. Dr. McRae is also an amazing cosmetic dentist.  After consulting with many dentist regarding veneers only Dr. McRae could explain why I needed what he recommended and why it would look best. I love my smile makeover and I'm so glad I didn't go anywhere else!
Really great pastries for an American bakery! I love the atmosphere too. It's a very nice place for tasty desserts.

This PetSmart is awful for one reason. CORA is absolutely the rudest person I have ever met. I not only saw her belittle her coworkers in front of customers I witnessed her belittle the customers themselves. This is disgusting behavior and This PetSmart should be ashamed they allow this person to continue to work there. Also she uses the IN STORE DOG FOOD FRIDGE for her own personal beverages. Seriously go look I bet you'll see some open soda in there!

Now for my second home.  This place is the definition of a modern-day Cheers, with the exception of great food and no smoke.  The atmosphere is welcoming to any sports fan, with televisions at every booth and a convenient bar with a wide range of drink selections and prices.  Not to mention very attractive young women there to make your morning (they serve breakfast), afternoon, or evening fun.

Ok, call me biased because it is within walking distance from my house, but the atmosphere certainly makes it worthwhile.

Great Tacos here!  We are from out of town visiting and stopped here for a late dinner , about 8:30 pm. Place was very clean and staff very friendly. We had the shrimp Tacos and cooked with great seasonings. 
We will be back!

First of all - the customer service here was awesome.  The staff was incredibly friendly and upbeat, which is always a nice thing!  I had the turkey bacon and avocado salad and it was great.  I normally see turkey bacon and avocado sandwiches on the menu (they had that too, but I opted for the salad), but I've never seen this combination offered as a salad before.  I don't know why, because it was great!  My mom, sister, and I all had salads and then desert afterwords - their bakery items are delicious too.  This place reminded me of Panera, but with more character.  The store was decorated and felt more like a home than a business, and their merchandise was adorable.  Would definitely go back here if I lived closer - unfortunately I don't think we have any of these in California, but I'll definitely go back the next time I'm in Idaho!

I like the Dickey's franchise, I just don't like this Dickey's location.  I had a string of good meals at this location for a period of time.  Then I hired them to cater an office function.  The guy showed up 45 minutes late.  I find out later, from the manager, that he left Dickey's early and was apparently driving around in circles for about an hour, despite having my contact number and a Google Maps printout with him.  Meanwhile 50 people were waiting around for the food to arrive.  Since he drove around for so long with our brisket in the warming oven on the truck, the brisket became very overcooked and dry.  When I called to notify the manager, we received a 20% refund.  Frankly that didn't compensate us for the extremely late arrival and the ruined brisket, but there wasn't much else I could do at that point.

I've been back the restaurant a few times since that incident.  Our brisket orders have been dry and unflavorful.  Overcooking the brisket or using old cuts seems to be a problem at this location. 

The final blow was the visit this past weekend.  We put in our orders and the guy cutting the brisket coughs into his arm (at least he was attempting to cover his cough) but it is a heavy, congested cough.  We had already ordered our food and it felt awkward to just abandon ship, so we didn't.  However, that guy was obviously sick with a cold and should not have been working.  And we received our brisket and it was dry as a bone AGAIN.

Not going back.  This location seems to have a management problem.  The employees are not being supervised appropriately on multiple levels.  The food, aside from the recent streak of overcooked brisket, is usually pretty good.  Dickey's has delicious BBQ sauce and the sides are good too.  I'd recommend finding another Dickey's location in the area.

Boo. Do not come here to drink and watch football. 

Way overpriced once you flag one of the rude and slow bartenders down. Waited almost twenty minutes to be served then paid $15 for a pint of coots lite and a well vodka.

This deli is like no other. 

Forget your normal deli order: "Turkey and Swiss on a French roll with....."

The menu is kinda strange, but the taste of their creations is out of this world. (You gotta try the Trevor Special) I have not had a bad thing there yet. 

Love the food, love the friendly folks behind the counter and love the atmosphere. 

Highly recommend.

We ate at Grants last night and it was one of the best meals that we have had. My husband travels all over the world and he said that the pork chop that he had was even better than ones that he has had in Germany. Everything from the service to the food was perfect.

Reviewer no. 6

I visit this location often as it's right by my baby mommas house and on my way home from work. I've written four reviews on Dutch Bros tonight as they all came up in my suggested places to review, therefore I know I visit too often and have an addiction!

I've been to this location about 5 times. I like to visit Irena's European Fine Foods which shares the same lot with this Bros. There are some other shops nearby, too, such as jump time and Goodwill. We frequent Crunch Fitness across the way on family swim nights and get a Dutch after the swim. 

I get an Americano (black coffee) add cream and sweet-n-low and it's only $2.75 and about 50 calories. I can get my kiddo a not-so-hot chocolate and my dog a treat (FREE, YAY!), too! 
I like the Bros mainly because of its people. Seriously, I don't know how they hire so many amazing people! Save some for us that need good employees!! Seriously, I've said this on all of my Dutch reviews because they are all top notch people, every time... and they don't appear to be faking it. Maybe it's the espresso? Espresso makes the world a happier place?!?

There are lots of different drinks with their many sugar-free syrups making the guild a little less than going full-on calorie. Oh and Google Dutch Bros secrete menu-- lots more fun stuff like the BOB Marley, Ninja Turtle and much more! 

Keep up the GREAT job Dutch!

So my wife see's one of the employees abusing (roughly jerking a dog on a leash), reports it to the manager. We are now blacklisted from ALL of the petsmart locations in our area. Nice business practices. Will never do business at any location again.

Im more than willing to pay a decent amount for a great meal,  in a great location, with a beautiful building, or beautiful views, but this place isnt on a mountain top, isnt in a gorgeous historic building, and honestly doesnt have a high quality chef, but they sure like to charge like they do! If the prices were literally half what they are i think they would be maybe 3 stars. But this place isnt worth the $$$$ not even close, and the service is mediocre at best. I have never felt so ripped off in my life.

This place is disgusting. I watched multiple times the employees not washing their hands after they cleaned community condiments. I watched as they pulled food from tray to bag to tray over and over again. People kept returning incorrect food and I had to return for incorrect and missing items. The bread was soggy. The food is poorly packed. Will not return.

I was very disappointed with the quality of a wrist corsage I ordered for a high school homecoming dance. I just picked the corsage up and the center flower is practically dead. When I touched it, petals fell off. In addition the white flowers all had brown edges. This is a waste of $30.00. I would caution using this florist again!!!

Such a wonderful place! Fine dining tucked into the corner of the Meridian neighborhood. I had the porkchop and it was beyond delicious. 2 Inches thick, bone in, and nestled on a bed of asparagus, red peppers, red onions, and mashed potatoes with a savory mushroom sauce the tied it all together. Absolutely fabulous. I will definitely be back!

I was honored to manage here until it was closed on 8/9/2019. I am so happy that my employees and myself were able to banter and have fun in the mornings regardless of the negative people who think coffee should be silent. Working in coffee for about 14 years, there is no such thing as coffee shop that is silent and there never will be.

Been here twice. We live in Bend, OR and came with another family for a visit in Summer 2008 and Summer 2009. Might come again (seems to be a tradition now) if plans for some place else don't supersede it. 

I am not a water park connoisseur, but from my experience this is a great place to recreate with family and friends. Both times we had that attitude---of relaxing & vacationing---so we reserved the pricey cabanas. 

If you are a regular and just want to come, get wet and go home....not worth it. But if you have the extra money to spend and want a "place of your own" where you don't have to worry about your belongings or someone taking your coveted lounge chair....go with a cabana. 

The park itself is very clean. The staff is friendly and well trained. Both times we saw on going training and testing of the lifeguards with an "Oscar" thrown in by surprise to test their response and skills. (Oscar being the name you give a dummy that needs saving....from my Coast Guard days). I was impressed. They did great. 

The rides....er.....slides and attractions never seemed overly long or crowded with lines moving at a good pace. All are fun, but I leave it up to you for personal preference for faves because there is so much variety. 

The continuous river is another cool feature and it's surprisingly swift. One would have a difficult time walking against the current, but you gotta try. Grab a tube, hop on and float away. Very relaxing. 

The wave pool is another kick, but when you watch the waves for awhile...here is a tip....for the best action and biggest waves, it isn't in the deep water like one would expect. About midway out, where they are about to crest is where you will get the biggest bang for you buck if that's what you are seeking. Watch out though because if you ride one in and it breaks close to "shore" the cement isn't very forgiving and I've seen some people come up with scrapes and bruises. 


Oh, another tip---wear "acqua socks" or "reef shoes".  

First time we came, we spent one day. Second time we spent two. In truth, I like the fact you don't feel the need to rush when you spend two days.....but one day is really enough for us. By the end of the second day, we were definitely ready to leave. 

You can get a park hopper pass that allows you into the neighboring arcade grounds. Be forewarned, you need to wear a shirt and shoes....and it was a little annoying that the "kids" who allowed us out of the water park as we got our hands stamped didn't say anything because we were promptly turned away and had to come back for t-shirts. 

But the bomb over there is the laser tag. When you get the pass, you can play as many times as you like and it is a kick.
There drive thru was a straight fraud. They are terrible at service. I was sitting for what seems like an eternity. Never go

Wow! We love this place. As native Californians it can be a struggle to find tasty, authentic Mexican food in Idaho--well, not any more! Fiesta G is where it's at! We have 4 young children who are almost impossible to dine out with and the staff at FG was superb when it came to handling them! The service was so prompt, the food was delicious (I'm a vegan and they made me veggie no-cheese enchiladas that were divine) and the restaurant was spotless. We will definitely be back soon!

Used to love coming in this place on Friday or Saturday nights. No longer go in those nights, David the bartender is more worried about drinking on the job and flirting with the girls. Very disappointing, used to be my go to place. Food is still phenomenal just choose wisely when you go in
Great place! The staff is super friendly. They did a much better job then Petco.  I'm very happy with the service and will be bringing my dogs back soon.

Please pick up the pace! We just ate there and as the times before, service was extremely slow and they were only 1/4 full! We love eating there, but can't understand the slowness. I also don't understand why a to go milkshake is about 1/2 the size of an eat in portion!

Well, two attempts to get a burger cooked right that was okay the second time around was a big disappointment.  The staff were rude when asked about sampling a sauce on an item or being able to advise what was in the sauce.  Both types of potato's and styles of fries were undercooked and served barely warm.  Definitely not planning on returning if we visit Boise in the future.

I've used A+ Chip Repair 3 times (2 chips and 1 windshield replacement) and I couldn't be happier! Tyler is the best... great communication, accurate scheduling, amazing quality of work, and a trustworthy professional. I'll be using A+ Chip Repair for all of my future glass repair needs. Highly Recommend!

I had my ear cartilage re-pierced by Matt. I had the area pierced previously & had issues with it, so had to take the piercing out. This time I decided to have a professional piercer do it & I am extremely happy with the results. Matt was really professional & knowledgable. He answered all of my questions & explained everything in detail. He was great about helping to pick the best spot to pierce & made sure I agreed before he proceeded. He was extremely clean & everything was kept sterile. My friend who was with me is a nurse & she was really impressed as well. Matt is super great to work with & I will definitely go back if I get more piercings & recommend him to others. Thanks Matt!

I frequent the Big Al's where I live and was a tad disappointed upon visiting this one that it didn't quite have the same quality. I still love the Big Al's concept of huge bar with sports viewing + luxe bowling + arcade for the little ones and young at heart. The luxe might be a bit much though as I think the prices are pretty high for the area without a huge return on quality. 
For instance, many of the machines in the arcade were broken. One or two would be understandable but it seemed like several. Additionally, the staff wasn't very friendly and seemed scattered. Hoping that was just a one off. At those prices I would hope for a smile and some efficiency. The bowling equipment worked fine and the wait was about what you would expect on a weekend evening. 
Overall it is still a good place to pass the time in the area. Maybe I'll just sample more of their large beer selection next time.

Doesn't matter how good your tacos are if your dining area is disgusting. Went 2/8/19 and the entire dining area was absolutely trashed. More than a handful of people had to clear garbage from tables just to sit down. Had to get my food to go. Will stick to the downtown tin roof.

Always great food and good service. Cozy little restaurant and bar. They do a great job answering questions about their menu items and the source of their food. They genuinely care that you're satisfied.

Overall food quality was OK. I think the jerky manager brings the place down. He gets impatient with his employees in front of customers...never a good sign. Other manager lady seemed nice. My order got screwed up and it seemed like a federal case for the manager guy to make a simple fix for me. I bet he could get much better performance out of his employees if he checked his attitude and got his own hands dirty in the kitchen more often. Overall, nothing special, not the "must have" burger on the block by any means.

This is a wonderful service for our dogs. They come directly to our home to bathe and groom our dogs. 
Jenny was our Groomer and is a kind and delightful young woman. Our dogs immediately felt comfortable with her. From my first call to schedule my appointment until Jenny arrived and left it was a great experience for us and our dogs.
We have our second appointment booked already .
Thank You
My favorite sandwich shop ever! Never had better service or sandwiches!

To go or dine in, their flavors and service doesn't change. They have a huge selection to pick from and three vegetarian tacos for people like me. I tried two of the three options and I liked both. 
The fun atmosphere, quick service, and both outdoor and indoor arrangement make them good for big groups or small gatherings. 
If you like tacos, you may want to give them a try.

PS- there is a scope of improving the quality of Tortilla itself.

Excellent experience. Absolutely love the new mattress we picked out. The pricing was fantastic, and the customer service was perfect. Low pressure, casual environment, and knowledgeable staff. After leaving, and having questions about delivery timing on my purchase, they were responsive, and made sure all my questions were answered. This is so important, as they demonstrated wonderful service not only during the sale, but afterwards also. I will definetly be going back, as I have other furniture needs. If you're shopping for furniture they need to be on your list of places to visit.

I'm always a huge fan of a good sit-and-dine deli, but these guys are awesome. They have the usual deli vibe, but offer superb customer service...the whole group of them. They have a delicious variety of sandwiches and the "design your own" option as well. Oh, their fries! So good! Big ol' fries with a delicious crunch. And don't let me forget their fry sauce...YUM. I would have given 5 stars but was slightly disappointed by the potato salad. I just wanted more....I suspect that this particular potato salad was a store bought salad :(.

I took my watch in to get fixed.  The owner asked a few questions, then told me to try resetting it after charging it more.  He said, "I can do it for you, but you can easily do this at home."  Sure enough, it worked like a charm.  I was clueless walking in.  He could have told me that it would be 2 weeks and $75 and I would have believed him.  Instead he greeted me as soon as I came in and treated honestly with me.  I'll be buying a new band from him and recommending him to everyone I know that needs their watch fixed.

Not worth your time! I had heard great reviews about this place, so decided to try it today. Walked in and both women behind the counter looked up, but never said a thing. No "welcome" or "you order here" just two unfriendly expressions!! While waiting to order the manager walked by and asked us to "please move, so the delivery drivers could get by". There is very little room to order, it's loud and the staff were all just rude! We walked out and will never go back!! Don't waste your time or money on this establishment!

Let's talk about Fat Guy's Fresh Deli.

First of all, put down your expectations and just come in for a good meal. Our experience here tonight was a 200%, A+++. Chef Wally is friendly, full of personality, and felt like an old friend within a few moments. The guys working the counter were busy, but also friendly. Great customer service here. 

My husband and I both decided on the Wally Special, which is a surprise or chefs choice.  We're not positive, but we think we were given the Trevor Melt and the Rockaway. Both DELICIOUS and filling. Pretty good sized sandwiches for $9.95 a piece, with plenty of fresh and tasty toppings. 

The food here is GOOD. Sides are different, but tasty. We had the potato salad and coleslaw, both tasted just as described. Neither are cream based. Try both just to say you did. I will definitely be back again for another Wally Special and then again again until I've tried them all.

Our favorite one in the Treasure Valley. The servers are friendlier than the one in Federal Way.  Service is always quick and good. We love the special menu/pancakes for every season. Cozy for anytime of the day, been there very early and very late.

Not a fan of this place, as an adult who drinks beverages. Hardly no bar service, no personality, too big for their own good feeling.  Chuck E Cheese for Adults? Nor our thing. Tried to watch Sunday football there. 21+ over bar not open? Are you kidding me? I'm sure its great for some situations, parents wanting to drink while kids play? Thats not us. Rudy's it is!
The staff at Big Star are the sweetest ever! They gave my Gunner boy a nice treat and made me a delicious Iced Green Tea! We will definitely be back again.

It's a good enough burger but it's really just a good fast food burger. Maybe the hamburger space is too crowded and it's hard to distinguish yourself from everyone else but this just feels like the rest of the newer burger joints.  Fries were good the burger just didn't wow me like I was hoping.

If I could rate negative, I would. Beyond the most horrible customer service. I checked in last night, my room being $102. Whilst checking in veiwing my bank statement. I see the $102 come in from Mr. Sandman as well as an additional $152 charge. Before I even leave the front desk or get my room keys I address the problem and show that I did not just get double charged, I have an additional charge that is over my current rate. The lady states she didn't charge that and it must be something else. I again show her my statement that clearly says Mr. Sandman. She states , "Oh, well there is nothing I can do about it." I am extremely tired at this point. I ask the gal to handwrite me a letter stating what has happened and that I pressed the issue at the time of check in, in hopes it will be cleared in the morning. I wake up, still there. Note, I have minimal funds and a flight, luggage costs money. I get a call from the front desk at 11:01am, sir check out was at 11am. This is as I am trying to collect everything I need to present hopefully a manager. I get to the front desk, no manager. I can continue, no need to. No money for my luggage nor uber, a shuttle? No. Currently sitting beyond the property line because it is private property and they stated they will call the police if I remain on property. No treats from this Sandman.

We attended a friends bday party on Saturday the 9th of March. We started downstairs and moved our party upstairs to the bar. The service was terrible! The ladies were so rude to not only the customers, but also to each other. I couldn't even get a menu. After waiting for about 30 minutes, I asked a waitress if I could order food. She told me I could only order through the bartender who opened our tab. So I had to wait another 15 minutes. I witnessed a waitress ask the female bartender for some ice in her pitcher. The bartender responded, "if you come back and get it yourself". I realize it was super busy, but their attitudes and customer service were awful. On top of everything else, the cheese on my nachos were completely burnt. Its a Saturday night, it's better to be overstaffed than understaffed. The only person who was decent to us was Lloyd. All the other bartenders and waiters/waitresses were rude. I've worked in a restaurant for 7 years. This was terrible!

Cool coffee shop that recently went through a remodel. They offer coffee drinks and also wine and beers on tap. Plenty of seating options with a dedicated working section in the back and some private style seating areas. Very friendly and helpful staff. Recommend if you're looking to get some work or studying done and like plenty of drink options.

The Counter is all together a great restaurant! The food was extremely good, and the Build your Burger menu is fantastic and is like no other restaurant. The restaurant had lots of options for people with allergies, like gluten free buns and great service! One of the best burgers I have ever had. My main complaint would be the price being too high, but you do get good food for your money. I highly recommend this restaurant.

I ordered flowers for my best friend because she was having a hard time. They were to be delivered to her work. The delivery driver Angela could not find the address I provided for her, due to no fault of her own. She spent a considerable amount of time trying to figure this out with me and went well above a normal delivery with the time and effort she put into making sure these flowers were delivered. She went so far as to drive them more than 30 minutes away from the original address. My friend received her flowers because Angela is awesome and the flowers were absolutely Gorgeous! I would highly recommend this business! Thanks again Angela!

This was my first venture to Boise Fry Company, and now I'm a believer! My cheeseburger was super-legit: the beef was juicy and cooked perfectly, the bun was fresh, and the pickles were great. I was actually wondering if the pickles were made in-house, but they were busy so I didn't ask. The fries were good, too, of course, and I really liked how many potato choices there are, and the sauce selection - a unique and cool angle on fries. The service was friendly and the price point is right. What more could you ask for in a casual, gourmet burger? Very happy to find them. Can't wait to try the black bean and the turkey burgers!

Brought my 2 year old in for a fever right as they opened. The staff was incredible. I didn't catch anyone's name except the PA who saw us, Jessica, but the nurse and front office were sympathetic and gracious and so helpful. It was so nice to go to an urgent care geared for pediatrics. They understand that little ones don't always show us where it hurts and can't describe symptoms. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for care for their children!

Tawny was fantastic! I brought my 2 year old son in and she showed an immense amount of patience to keep a busy fella entertained while getting his hair cut. Everyone at the salon was super friendly and accommodating. We will be back!

This is fabulous. The server Tracy  was amazing. She was new and messed up on Andy's drink (he always orders wrong, so totally not her fault lol) other than that hiccup. Superb. I had a fried pickle burger. Andy had a farm house style with egg and bacon and Linda had fish and chips. Very good place to eat. Would eat here again if I was traveling through and hungry. And you better be hungry.  The portions are huge.

LOVE their vegan burger! I usually get the original toppings and then ask to leave off Garlic Aoli. You can to get your meal completely vegan (made off grill and with a vegan bun)  Also, purple fries are the bomb with vanilla salt!

It's been a while since I've been to a relaxing restaurant with great service and amazing food Carrie and Sarah we amazing and who doesn't love delicious bloody Mary's for 2$ the food was amazing I couldn't even eat it all they have home made pickles and there fries were so fresh and the pasta is cooked perfectly! From the atmosphere to the staff and food overall great place it was great very warm and welcoming if you live in Boise or Meridian this is a must try!
Horrible. We have never received service like this before. We won't be back again. We spent to much money. Now we have to clean up our van seat, it drained through the bag into our seat.
The food is amazing and the food is better. The wood smoked flavor beats all else. The kids eat free Sundays and free ice cream are awesome and definitely earn this place a 5 star review.
Typically "The Counter" of wonderful options. Medium rare bison or turkey to proper temp are favs on organic greens. Has gluten free menu "safety net"!

My favorite place to grab a great sandwich and enjoy Manhattan Chowder!!  The staff is great and friendly.   Every sandwich that I have tried are superb.  This deli is worth the try because once you have tried it you will keep coming back

Pat L.

In the past the Ram was a good place to go for a beer and burger with the guys to watch some sports on the huge tvs.  A bit over priced but the service is always  very good.   Tonight the server was very nice!  But the food was awful.   The armadillo eggs that are complimentary when you check in on yelp were not good.  They sound and look good but miss the mark.  The overpriced Caesar salad had this tiny piece of blacken chicken that was not the best!  And for some reason I ordered a bowl of chilli... It was terrible!  I don't  want to be disrespectful so I will just say the the chilli and the food we had tonight is not what we would ever expect to eat or be served at the Ram.  I recommen the beer,  but not the food.

Where to begin. Plenty of staff and still slow. By the time everything was placed on my tray my sandwich, which was made first, was cold. Brisket had very little taste to it and was dry. Expensive prices for the amount of food you get. Dirty floors and tables. Ice cream machine was putting out very soft ice cream which actually tasted like ice milk, very icy and not at all creamy. Let's not even mention the dirty smelling bathroom. There must be better bbq places around here. I'd honestly give it a half of a star if I could.

Had my lashes done here in December and since then went to 3 other salons offering half price what I paid here.....well you know what they say you get what you pay for....at look at me now my lashes lasted 5 weeks others 1-2 weeks here compliments other salon Nada I'm not saying don't try other places I'm just saying come here first!! update....returned last month apparently it depends on the person who is doing your lashes....lashes lasted 48 hrs not going to return...used tape on my eyes not full or long as I asked unimpressed......I did call the following Monday to have them fixed....not my first rodeo....wasn't interested in returning just lack of personal touch since my first visit...salon seems more like a mass production of lashes lost its charm in my opinion..

I was in a week ago with a couple of gal pals, and we were pretty surprised.  Three of us ordered med well burgers, and all came out to us very nearly bleeding raw. Two more tries and they got it right. Waitress actually told us how crummy situation there was (but she used a much more harsh term, to customers!) Took far too long, but did give a chance to watch the show... employees arguing and fighting in and out of the back. One gentleman smelling of smoke so badly it could make a person ill.  Ive personally been in 3 (?) times before this, and I have to say the entire place seems to have gone down hill.  I dont know what they are doing differently but Im afraid we are losing a burger place in meridian if they dont clean up their act.

The other locations are great, but this location is phenomenal with children, especially my three-year-old who refuses to cooperate when getting vitals, except at this pediatric office. They specialize in treating and seeing infants to children, and they are such a blessing. Thank you for turning a bad experience into a great one!
The food was terrible we all got sick within an hour of leaving called the manager he acted like it wasn't his problem. I'll never go back

We got an appointment quickly. They were friendly and prompt.  She listened to what we wanted in the way of Gingers cut.

They did a great job and called with a message when our baby was ready. Also texted the same. We had time to shop and go home and put away the groceries and she was done  

She looked so cute with her bandana on.  Her fur was soft and still is 5 days later

This place is like no other sandwich shop. In fact it's a place that makes you feel like the series (cheers).
They know you when you are a return customer, always making us laugh and feel at home!
That is what this place is...   it's home!
Wally is a treasure and I look forward to going there on Fridays for chowder and a laugh.
Thank you Wally and the staff for making it feel like HOME!!!!

All things considered, I have received good experiences here. I've had things come out incorrectly or not up to par, which at first was a big no for me. What surprised me is the willingness to fix any mistakes made and the wonderful customer service from management. 
I am here ordering chicken, spicy kielbasa, and okra OFTEN. My husband and I are both fans. With that said, typically it's younger people working the counter. They do get things wrong and sometimes we have to get our order corrected, but every time I've been, the staff is kind and hustle to get things done. That goes very far in my book. We have not had issues in a few months now, so I'll say four stars and highly recommended the fried okra with some ranch!

At least once a week I come to this coffee shop for convenience and the coffee.  Today is one of the past three times that I have had to listen to the employees talk loudly and amongst each other. That is unprofessional and no everyone would like to start their day listening to loud random conversation and bantering. It appears the manager was involved as well.

The food IS good, especially the Turkey Cranberry sandwich but sadly this establishment has gone down hill.  No little salad that usually accompanies it and they usually split it for us as a whole sandwich is too much for either of us, nope not today :-(  Not a deal breaker but here's what IS...filthy floors with food debris and ants, this restaurant seriously needs a deep (over-due) cleaning and that includes the walls which are also in dire need of repaint.  Nice employees but dirty restaurant has spoiled our desire to return, sadly so.

Uh I am not sure what the recent complaints are about, I've been eating here for a year (at least once a week) and love it each time. Best deal In town for fresh and tasty tacos! Just go already and do it often! Love y'all at Tin Roof!

We were just passing through Meridian, checked Yelp for a good Thai restaurant. We were not disappointed. Best Thai we have EVER had. We shared the panang curry and pad prik king 3 stars on the lunch menu. Just enough food, so much flavor! Service was prompt and very pleasant and attentive. Just wish it was closer to home.

Ordered online which in and of itself was strange since it had me select the time it would be ready instead of telling me when it would be ready. Then the system sent me an email with a tracker to show the order progress. The tracker never did work. We called for an estimated time for pickup about 15 mins after we placed the order. They told us another 20 mins. We go to pick up our food and the parking lot was empty (now we know why!). Not sure why it would take upwards of 40 mins when no one was there.
When we got home, the meat wasn't even warm and had a dried out appearance. It tasted as dry as it looked. I had to smother it in the bbq sauce just to tolerate it. The sides were equally unimpressive in size and taste. The mac n cheese was bland at best, the green beans were ok, cole slaw was not bad and the creamed spinach was vile.
Big waste of money on not even mediocre food. Don't waste your money.

I went online to order a birthday arrangement for my daughter. I was specifically hoping to find one with lilacs, as that is a real favorite of hers. I found one at Meridian Floral and Gifts. It also had a lot of pink, which is her favorite color. When I called to wish her a happy birthday, (I live out of state) she said it was gorgeous, the prettiest arrangement she had seen in a long time. She also said it was huge, even though I ordered the standard size. Based on her reaction, I believe I have found a florist for all my future needs.

Located in a small strip mall between a Subway Sandwich place an income tax prep place and facing busy Fairview Ave. 

Despite the strip mall location, Sa-Wad-Dee has a beautiful interior, inviting and comfortable.

We made reservations, but really didn't need them. They did have a table reserved for us and welcomed us warmly.

Our waitperson was a delight and was friendly and very attentive.

But the food was the reason we were there. To begin, the menu is rather extensive and, if you are unfamiliar with Thai food (which we are not) the names of dishes can be confusing. Fortunately, they are described and, as far as were concerned, accurately - no surprises!

We started with appetizers - Thai Dumplings and Chicken Satay - both were excellent.

Our entrees were SWD Fried Chicken and Seafood Hor Wok in Fresh Young Coconut, once again, excellent!!!!

We are looking forward to returning.

I would recommend making reservations, just in case, and pull up their web page and review the menu before visiting.

LaRue cut my little boys hair.  We came from craftsman unlimited where it seemed to always be good or bad depending on who you got.  LaRue was a breath of fresh air.  She was super professional and knew what I wanted before I even had to say.  She quickly was able to figure out what went wrong with the previous haircuts.  Not only have I come back again, but we will keep coming back... to her.  Thanks LaRue!
Misty is such a sweet lady the service was great as it always is at this location. Food is up to par with IHOP standards. Love this location!!

Another place I can't believe I waited so long to try. This is just as good, if not better, than Hurricane Harbor (the water park connected to Six Flags Magic Mountain in CA). In fact, it was much cleaner and staff were much more friendly. Lifeguards were all constantly on their game and I felt that all of the kiddos were totally safe.

Okay, more importantly, THE RIDES ARE LEGIT! I screamed like a little girl and loved every minute. Avalanche rocks, Cliffhanger was scary as hell, Endless River gave me some good exercise (trying to chase down / keep up with the kid) and the grounds were generally great. Food was overpriced, but it's an amusement park, what else is new? Actually, the food was a lot more creative than other amusement parks. I saw a stick of spiral-cut potato (with seasoning), funnel cakes (haven't seen since Six Flags) and DEEP FRIED CANDY BARS! The kiddo had a deep fried Milky Way, which I wound up finishing. Covered in crispy donut batter... dear lord. That's probably some of the best fair / park food since the three-foot corndog I had in Los Angeles.

If you're on the fence about whether to come here or not, give it a try. It's huge, clean and awesome!

I had a little trouble finding this place because there is no signage out front but I'm sure it's coming since they are new.  When I walked in I was pleasantly surprised. It looked like a cute little dog boutique with treats and fun accessories for purchase. I was warmly greeted by the staff and they asked if there was anything specific about my dogs grooming that I preferred over what the standard cut was. I was really glad that the grooming is done in back behind closed doors because my dog tends to get a little over excited when he first sees other dogs. It was nice to walk in and not have that issue while I was talking to the groomer. All in all, I would recommend this place. They are conveniently located in the new part of Meridian and the staff was really nice and friendly to me and my dog. I loved his cut. He even got high praises for being a sweet well behaved dog and they seemed to really enjoy him. Makes me feel good when the dog has a good experience as well as his owner!

Ordered a turkey burger and damn was it good. I don't think I even like turkey burgers not I'd order that again and again. Purple fries were pretty good especially with blueberry ketchup. I wish they had a little pre salt on the fries though
Ate here for the first time a few weeks ago and absolutely loved it. Great food, cool atmosphere, and the wait staff was super kid friendly. We will definitely be going back soon!

This place is awesome... Daryl is super funny!
They do a great job and their chemicals work great...

I would have rated this 4 stars, but had to take off 2 stars because of the prices and hidden charges. 

Id guess that all these restaurants inside the village pay a lot in rent. So of course they have to pass this cost off to their customers.

I have been seeing The Counter for a while now. The thought of a "Build Your Own Burger" was just to appealing to pass up.

The actual restaurant is nice, but a bit bland. It looks upscale and not like a burger place.

There is a huge bar right that is right up front. My family and I got here around 4:30, which our usual time for dinner on Friday's. We like to avoid the crowds and waiting times that you can find at places in town.

The waitress that we had was very nice. I wish I could recall her name, but I cant. She said she was from Oregon, so she loved the Ducks. But she wound up at BSU.

I just happen to wear my Oregon Ducks shirt that I had just bought on our latest trip to Oregon. Go Ducks!

Though on a side note. I have never seen a duck do much more than a slow waddle. (No idea why Oregon picked such an slow an odd animal as its mascot)

The menus are in 3 ring binders. One of the most oddest menus that I have seen. The pages of the menu are on a paper that easily gets stained. My wife even mentioned that her menu was dirty. 

I would be very interested to return here in a few months to see if their menus stand up to wear, tear, and sticky finger prints. My guess is that they wont and will eventually want to replace these with something more durable.

Anyway, The Counter's claim to fame is their Build Your Own Burger. I was amazed at how many choices there were for the burger. I could only imagine in my mind a cool storage room filled with nothing but this seemly endless list of burger add ons.

I ordered a Build Your Own Burger. The form for these are at the back on the menu. You take one out, check off what you want and give it to your server. I had to ask questions on several things. 

The main question I had was on the very odd system of cryptic +1 and +4's by certain items. I looked for a legend at the bottom of the form, or somewhere that would explain what this was.

I figured it was some sort of extra charge, but I was expecting 25 cents, and 50 cents extras.

What our server explained floored me. Many of the choices on this form range anywhere from $1 to $4 !!

This brings a new meaning to Buyer Beware!

I tried to stir clear of these extra charges, but when I got my bill, I saw that I had been stuck with a lot of them. One of my biggest pet peeves are restaurants that nickel and dime you the death. 

I was charged extra for Ranch Dressing, and several other things that I would not expect to pay for.

I ordered Onion Straws, but had to return them because they were way too greasy, An extra charge that I would expected to be written off my bill, but was not.

The hamburger was pretty good, but not what i would consider great. I would give it a 7 on a 1-10 scale. But then due to the costs, I would have to deduct 1, so in the end, I would give it a 6.

My wife had a salad, which was to have Chicken and bacon. She said that there was no bacon to the found anywhere. My daughter had grilled chicken with BBQ sauce. She commented that the BBQ sauce was really good.

If you are on family on a budget, be careful here. For my family of 3, our bill came to just short of $50. We had no extras, no refills of fries, no drinks other than fountain drinks, and I even had water.

Be especially careful here of the Build Your Own Burger. If you choose the wrong options, or are not paying attention, it will drain your wallet!!!

This was the first time I had made an appointment for my dog to be groomed.  I discussed how I would like for him to look when finished, but indicated if it had to be shorter then I understood.   However, I specially stated I did not want his muzzle shaved- wanted to keep his "moustache".  He was very clean and combed out well when I picked him up, but his moustache was gone, he was trimmed much shorter than worst case, and there were obvious shave markings behind his ears.  So poorly shaven there that I needed to shape it up at home.  Will I go back?  Probably not.  Would I recommend?  Absolutely not especially after paying close to $75.

El lugar se ve sucio. Todo, el piso, las mesas, sillas, baño.
El piso presenta suciedad acumulada desde hace tiempo. Las mesas tienen restos de comida y moscas, se sienten grasosas. Las bandejas donde se sirve las órdenes necesitan ser lavadas con un buen detergente.

We have been working with Matt C who grooms our 3 labs monthly. Convenient recurring appointment and the dogs do so well walking out their front door to the van. They look beautiful and happy when they waltz back in. Great value service.
Excellent brunch menu. The eggs Benedict was delicious and everything was very fresh.  Will was our server and was great. Will definitely be back.
This is a great salon--it's clean , nicely decorated and tidy.  The new owners have done a great job!

Big All is overrated for me.
I understand it's great for kids and youngsters but, in my opinion,, if you are over 25, there is a chance you will find yourself being frustrated and unhappy.
Our waiting time was too long. We got our meals mixed up, and the server brought me a plate with things I explicitly said I am allergic to. Now that is not the only reason why I am giving them only two stars. Our last party of 9 - all of them said their orders were bland and tasteless. For the money, I do believe Big Al's should make sure their menu is tasty and their staff is more professional.
One of the best Thai restaurants in the Treasure Valley.  Love all their food and their cocktails are amazing as well.     A bit pricey but the food is worth it.   Love this place

Excellent service, friendly guys. I was in there this week for a battery change on my Audi. I had called my normal Audi mechanic who couldn't get me in for a week (what? A week?) Called around to about 6 other places, who transferred me and made me leave messages (to which I haven't received a call back YET from). My husband called John's Auto Care. We got a LIVE PERSON on the phone. They stated they too were pretty busy but to bring the car in and they would try to squeeze us in. Within 1 hour of showing up I had a new battery installed, friendly people to chat with and my car was as good as new. You want old fashioned ACTUAL service? Take your car here.
After seeing someone else as I preferred a female, I realized that you can't compromise on care. This place is great and Dr. Hammerle (sp?) is someone I would recommend.

Great place to go for food, tv, outside seating, late night eating, drinking...service is standard and simple. Menu has some great choices for food and drinks. Burgers are great and Crab/Artichoke sandwich is recommended. Bar and family seating are separate and also a patio is an option. Great beer and prices are what you'd expect from a brewery. Also open late, so go check it out.

Tipped off to this place by a stranger, and it turned out to be a very fun experience!

Located in The Village complex, Big Al's is a massive facility that is customer friendly and wide ranging in scope. There's a sit-down restaurant, a sports bar, plenty of arcade-like games, multiple private rooms, and a large bowling alley. It's clean, well laid-out. Moderate pricing, tons of parking.

Their staff was kind and pleasant, with Austin being a real positive and customer service oriented person in the bowling area. 

Enjoyed my time bowling, even though I am truly brutal! Plenty of shoe and ball options. Video screens add to the experience. Thought the darkened building at certain points of the night made it fun, lot of lights. Bumper guards available if needed. Easy to use scoring system.

My companion and I thought we would try out Fat Guy's Fresh Deli on a Saturday afternoon.  We heard the lines were long during the lunch hour weekdays.  On this particular day the small restaurant was packed with patrons and we got the last table in the joint.

The Food:  The menu was extensive and inventive.  Many classics and classics with a twist.  This truly is a meat joint because there wasn't one Vegetarian sandwich on the menu.  I'm sure I could have ordered a veggie sandwich and they would have put the normal veggies on it but I was looking for something with some invention...just like the other sandwiches.
