That said, I decided on a #4 Triple Chin.  A Club with ham, turkey, bacon, pesto mayo and veggies.  My companion had a #3 Fat French Dip with horseradish and havarti cheese.  We also ordered cups of soup.  She had a Tomato Cheddar soup and I had a Clam Chowder.  Both soups were very tasty and I could have had a bowl with some bread and called it lunch.
The sandwiches were HUGE and we both saved the other half for dinner.  Super yummy sandwiches!

The Ambiance:  Due to it's small environment, tables were packed in with a small bar area.  All tables were taken and it seemed a bit cramped for sure.

The Service:  This is where Fat Guy's shines.  The owner Chef Wally was there going from table to table talking to ALL of the customers.  He was giving free cookies to small children and truly was engaged with the patrons.  When stopping at our table, he asked if we liked the soups and offered to get us another cup for free!  How many owners go out of their way to connect with the people that keep them in business?

Price:  About $10 for a sandwich.

I enjoyed Fat Guys Fresh Deli and will be back.  I would have loved to give them 5 stars but with no Vegetarian options on the menu, I felt shorted.  Maybe a signature Mozzarella, Tomato and Basil sandwich?  How about a Hummus sandwich with sprouts and all the veggie works?  A little effort towards Wally's customers that prefer no meat will go a Loooong way.
I love the veggie sandwiches at this place. Capers, horse radish, jalapeños, garden veggie cream cheese--it is all so good! And it's only $4.55 with tax.
Nothing but praise for Wells Fargo. Every employee has been great, and they always make me feel welcome. The banking app is also great!
Received a detail in April, 2017. They were very professional and went beyond the call to detail my F150 Platinum--when I picked it up from them it was nicer than when I got it from the dealer.

Stopped in to try some sweet treats.  The eclaire are amazing. The German Chocolate brownies my husband saic are excellent too. I wasn't hugely impressed with the chocolate bombs. The bread we had previously tried was tastey.  Will go back again, would like to try the cafe.

Finally found Yelp. This review is from Christmas Eve of 2017. 

The food and our server was amazing, but the service was sub par from the front end. We made a reservation for Christmas Eve night knowing it would be busy. We were a little early due to all the snow (we left early so we wouldn't miss our reservation). We were told to come back at the reservation time ( in 15 minutes) that our table wasn't ready and that we couldn't wait inside, we had to go outside of the restaurant to wait (there was no one else waiting at the time). We had to take the family back out into the car in the cold and snow. When we went back in at the reservation time we were sat at the table right in front of the door so every time it opened we were gifted with a shot of freezing cold air. I strongly feel that guests that take the time to make reservations on a very busy night should be treated much better than we were. I doubt we will be back after our first experience here. I do have to stress that our server was absolutely amazing and accommodating and we had absolutely nothing but good to say about her service. However, the host and hostess and the one in the back giving them directions need some serious coaching on customer service....
Great prices and amazing doughnuts! I love the apple fritter. Also its right next to Starbucks so you can grab coffee too!

Biggest issue was price and watered down drinks.  Had the chops, but for a $24 entree it was expensive.  Just some veggies and mashed potatoes.  We each ordered drinks and got basically flavored water.

We wanted to try the place because of the reviews.

I have been lucky enough to have had Kelsey as my hair color artist for the past few years and couldn't be more excited that she opened her own salon. It is everything and more than I could have expected. Stunning, sparkly and a thoroughly designed layout for an ultimate client experience. Cannot wait to get my express dry bar/shadow root-tone membership for blonde maintenance. Solves so many hair challenges I face with my last-minute lifestyle. Try it...you won't regret it.

We came in for lunch today and left extremely disappointed. We sat for 15 minutes with orders ready, and then was greeted by a different server than the original server who said she'd be back to take our orders. We ordered two med rare burgers. Over 35 minutes later, we received two well done burgers that was chewy and difficult to eat. On top of that, the bacon, that was an additional charge, was burnt to a crisp and inedible. Because of our overdone and overpriced burgers ($40 for two burgers, one side of fries) combined with very poor service, we will not be back

Food, employees, atmosphere, all are outstanding.  Everything on the menu is very well prepared and tastes delicious!  I would highly recommend to anyone seeking the best sandwich/wrap in the Boise valley.

Tyler was awesome.  He came out to my house the next day was on time and ready to work. After assessing the rock chip damage for about 5 minutes he told me that I didn't need to have anything repaired at the time. He said the previous repair would still hold and that I'd be wasting my money to have it repaired again. He did say that if it got any larger to give him a call and he'll be happy to come out and repair the damage. Incredibly honest guy. I will do business with him again if I need windshield repair. I recommend him wholeheartedly to others.

Literally can not get enough of Fat Guys!! This will be my third time eating there THIS week! You will NEVER be disappointed in anything you order. Soup is always homemade and delicious, along with EVERYTHING (fresh sliced meats daily, fresh cut produce daily, homemade soups made daily) coming out of this deli. I'm so serious when I say I am OBSESSED. Plus I am very lucky to live so close to this location! Plus if you ever get to meet the owner he is incredibly nice and very warm welcoming! I promise you will not be disappointed!

Yay!! A yummy, fresh and affordable burger! Great place for a quick Burger. Very down-to-earth, friendly, clean, quick and affordable, not to mention tasty! In and out in half an hour and it didn't hurt my wallet which is a nice change nowadays. I read the reviews and wanted to check it out but never seem to get there. I'm really happy that we tried this place today. Keep up the good work guys n girls!

I want to like this place more.. here's why I rated a 3!!!

First of all, don't get me wrong. I love, empanadas. And enjoy the many different ways to prepare it/ make it. These empanadas are made from a flour. Forgot the location of country; Argentina or Mexico maybe? 
Anyways, a few things bugged me. Took a bit long to re heat my empanadas in store. There prices are a bit high, for everything. 
They serve alcohol but at $5-$6 a can/cup? No thanks. Don't go to drink, unless you are that person who NEEDS an IPA or foreign beer with an empanada. I dont know. I tried one of them, forgot which one. Maybe the Saudi one, regardless I will be back to try one more they have. Notice I said 'Try': yes, one or two to try is all you need. Anymore and you will go BROKE. At 3.50 an empanada is kind of ridiculous. I would need to get 3-5 to fill a hunger. And that's just by myself, what about guests? Never mind. The salsa they save is FOR SALE?!?! Yea $1 for a small small cup that should be FREE!!!! That pissed me off. I went during a rush, and the poor gal up front had to deal with all of them, at this point (since everyone who walks in there is practically new, she has to explain the menu and everything like 10 times in an hour. Spending so much time with one person or group. In other words it felt like it was just here and under staffed. Even a customer brought it up. Nobody wants to wait, not to order/ not to wait for it to cook/ not for anything. 

Look I want this place to succeed, I really do. It needs work. I'll be back to try one more. Thanks

It has been a few months since I have been to The Habit. After my initial bad experience, I was very hesitant to return. But if being a christian has taught me anything, it is that we all deserve 2rd chances and sometimes 3rd, 4th, 5th...105th chances.

So my family did go back here. I am glad to report that The Habit has improved. I still cannot move then way up in the star rankings, but they have moved up 1 star. If they address just a few things, they might move up more.

I had the Teriyaki Charburger. My daughter had her usual plan hamburger with nothing on it. My wife had the regular charburger.

I am happy to report that many of the issues we had on our 1st visit have been addressed. The burgers now have a good flavor. One issue I have with them is the size of the patty. It is hard to estimate weight of the patty once cooked, but I would say it less that a 1/4 pound and perhaps way less. So much so that I could barely taste the meat.

I would compare the size of their patty to McDonalds or perhaps even a bit smaller. Its pretty small. The toppings overwhelm the taste of the burger. What I could taste of the meat was good, but there is just no where near enough of it. Now you could say that I could get a double and that would solve the problem, but If I have to over 2 patties just to get a good meat flavor, and pay that extra, there is a problem here.

The other issue is the meat itself. I opened up my burger to take a peak under the hood. The meat looks......well it looks odd. It does not look like the normal all beef hamburger patty that I would expect. I searched the restaurant and their menu looking for a sign or something that would tell me what they use for meat in their hamburgers, but I was not able to find anything.

I did see signs that said that they use Better Ingredients, but I saw nothing to tell me what these better ingredients are or why they are better.

So based on this fact that I cant identify the meat that they are using, and the patty is so small, I still cannot recommend this place and was only able to move them up 1 star. 

Their fries are good. No flavor to them at all, but that is par for the course. No one seems to pay any attention to adding any flavor to their fries, but really, why should they? We just drown them in Ketchup or fry sauce anyway.

The fries were crisp and not greasy at all!

Love the flower arrangements that are inside the dining area of this place. It looks and feels nice

This is one of our kids' favorite restaurants, so we usually go in, order and make it to go. 
We've been lucky and they've given us freshly made, tasty and warm food. 
I don't give them 5 stars because this location needs some more clean up, someone should be in charge of wiping out the tables, sweeping and mopping. And they should improve their lead time, because they run out of food and by now they should know  how fast  entrees and side dishes go.

The 3 stars is for the kind staff. Everyone working was super friendly. But the food is trash. They were out of pancake mix so I ordered a side of scrambled eggs for my son, & it was just gross (see picture). I also had the sausage egg & cheese croissant which was decent, but flavorless. They put both meals on the same plate, makes it difficult for 2 people to eat when sharing a plate. 
The place has a poor set up. They don't have a system when handing/walking out orders, even if you're dining in. They just yell your name until they find you, then bring you your food. Very obnoxious & unnecessary. I wouldn't recommend & wouldn't go again.

Last time we will eat at The Counter! Service is the worst I've ever seen. We were at this establishment waiting to be waited on and then waiting for our food for well over an hour and a half. The waiter tried to say that they were very busy. Not true. How is it that most restaurants can have a full house and still have good timely service? Major issues with this place. The food is not bad, although my husband ordered his burger medium well and it was pink throughout. We did appreciate that the waiter took $10 dollars off our bill after we complained about the slow service. Prior to us, we heard him twice apologizing to customers regarding their own experience.  Management, It really can't be that hard to up your game on service!

So much fun for the family, although I came here with friends and we rented The Owner's Suite upstairs in the Skybox bar and got the VIP treatment for a bachelorette party. Really great pricing, super sweet staff, and the drinks were poured with a heavy hand

How does this place only have 3.5 stars?!!! Every friend and family member we have sent here loves the pizza and for the price it's unbeatable! The crust is THE BEST, and the green olive and sausage is our family favorite :) Their ingredients/toppings are of the best quality. Definitely do not let the 3.5 rating detour you or you'll miss out!

Chris and the team at Dynamic were great to work with from the start. They helped us from the beginning to determine what services would best fit our car needs. We had to make a reservation change very last minute and they accommodated our schedule change professionally and kindly.
We had our 7 year old car completely detailed for the first time and the results are great!! The carpets look like new. The leather feels great. The cleanliness of the inside is crazy! We have dogs and they got all the hair and "snort art" off of everything. 
The car looks showroom ready and shines under the sun. We forgot that the blue car was blue... well this blue.
If you need a full detail of your car, check out Dynamic for sure. We will take our cars back here for sure. I reccomend finding a day that allows you to drop off in the morning and pick up later in the day so their team has plenty of time to knock out an amazing job.
Cheers Always!

Had a craving for a Teriyaki burger, so I decided to try this place. The service was friendly and fairly quick. The sweet potato fries were great with fry sauce on tap. The burger was quit good. Will definitely return and try other menu items.

Crew appears to be in desperate need of an on-site manager.  Only two of about six employees wore hats at foodservice station and none had hair nets.  Stainless at cooktop is not polished, though I'm hear for early lunch. Easy to see areas of the floor in the kitchen/register area are littered with garbage and food. 

Food has potential to be good if proteins were fresh.  Ordered 5 different ala carte tacos, with help selecting by cashier. Mahi taco and pulled pork taco were bone dry.  Fried chicken taco was scorched earth dry.  

Also surprised that open cases of beer candidates/bottles are stacked on the floor at the front door where they're readily available to the high school lunch kids.  

Not likely to return, but hope ownership will take note.

Excellent customer service and work.  Tyler was awesome to work with.  He will drive to your location and he guarantees his work.  He was very efficient and it was his primary goal to get us taken care of and utilize our insurance.  What a great local company!  I have had poor experiences with other companies in the past, but not with A+!
I think this is a love or not like at all kinda place. It was too greasy and salty for us. But, it was packed and everyone else seemed to be enjoying their lunch!

First off if I could give Tyler and his company 10 stars I would.  New to town and called Tyler who picked up on the second ring. After explaining that I was turning in a leased vehicle, I set up an appointment.  Tyler explained that my insurance company might pay for the damage, but did not think I had the coverage.  I called my insurance just prior to the appointment and they advised me that I was in fact covered. Tyler arrived promptly to the appointment and looked at the damage.  I explained to him that I was covered through insurance and it was not an issue.  After a quick call to the insurance company he did the work and explained the entire process.  Not only is Tyler a very friendly person but also very professional.  I would would highly recommend Tyler and will definitely call him again if needed.  And Tyler the windshield did pass the inspection thanks again Lauren

My husband and I went here after hearing that this chain was rated best in the country. Nice little place that offers pickup, delivery and sit down. We ordered a large pizza with ham and bacon. Also on the pizza we had them put garlic butter and parmesan on the crust. The pizza was good. The garlic butter and parmesan really added to it. I wouldn't say that it was amazing but it was good. We also got an order of their Cheezybread. It was tasty but was lacking cheese. 

Honestly, if you were to ask me if I would rather have Marco's or Domino's I would have a hard time deciding because they are very similar.

I like Big Als food and arcade games. I don't think it's the biggest variety of games but it'll keep me entertained at least an hour but at a high price (usually 25-30hr of play). I went bowling for the second time this week and I do have to say 2 games and 2 shoes was 32 dollars???? I guess I'm old school because I remember going to 20th Century and paying way less to enjoy a game of bowling. Oh and I would not suggest any of their mixed cocktails. I even tried to order a signature martini and it tasted like Minute Maid juice. I like a stiff drink so you'd think that a martini would be a good choice but not at all. I also was going to enjoy the big fight this Saturday there but when I called they said they're charging 30 dollars per adult?? I guess I wouldn't think they'd ever have to charge cover at a glorified arcade bar. Eh, I'll be back because it's something to do but if there were more options I'd probably take my money elsewhere. 
UPDATE::::

I gave this place another chance... such a bad experience the last time which was Saturday. I took a group of gfs out to late night bowl and we get to our lane and it's just not working. It took them about 15 mins to get it to work which normally would be fine but it was 11pm when we got there and wanted to get out game started because they close at 1am. So our service was awful this time ( I get it's almost time to go home but when you're on the clock you smile and earn money) I'm a server I deal with late night rushes all of the time. Our original server left and didn't say bye and obviously didn't tell the new server we asked for our bill to be split from the start so that took extra time however that's not the worse part.... our game during all of our last frames just took our balls and we couldn't even finish. The server literally said "well that's unfortunate". I hate to sound like I'm full on ranting but I'm really really really disappointed in this place. I won't be returning!! Save your money and go to a smaller bowling alley.

Angela is simply AMAZING!! She and her team did such a stunning job at our wedding this Summer at Old Sugar Mill in Clarksburg. I really couldn't have asked for a better florist to work with. We are still receiving compliments over the beautiful floral months later! 

Angela was easily a favorite vendor to work with. She was very professional, accommodating and so very kind. After browsing the internet/social media, I came across Esmae Event's profile on the WeddingWire which prompted me to search for their Instagram. I loved what I saw and I quickly sent them an email. Angela responded and soon thereafter we met in person to discuss the wedding details and what vision I had in mind. I had some ideas, a few inspiration photos and a rough vision that needed some polishing. Angela walked me through some really neat ideas that were not only beautiful, but that were also within our budget. I felt confident when leaving our meeting that I was in great hands. 

I really can't explain the pure joy that I felt on our wedding day when I was able to see all of Angela's beautiful work on display. I loved it! We just received our wedding photos and fell in love all over again. 

If you're still searching for the perfect florist for your special day or event you really couldn't go wrong with Angela and Esmae Events!!

My dad and I were checking out Independence range next door...we were hungry and Fat Guy's was conveniently located outside of the parking lot. What a freaking amazing surprise to find this place! Felt like walking into your buddy's place because they treated you like they knew you! And the sandwiches were nothing short of fantastic! Come hungry because the sandwiches are fresh and huge! You won't be disappointed!
A great place to eat and they have great shopping options.  A must do for lunch.  Try the roast beef crosssant sandwich with avacado and a peanut butter cookie...great duo.

I'd only visit Big Al's during happy hour when 100oz beer towers are $10.  Wings are pretty good especially the super hot ones.  The only downside is the arcade section.  I'm over the freakin' ticket games!  I won't want tickets, I want old school games that let me kill and shoot bad guys.

First time in and very impressed. The owner asked if we were new in here right away and explained his story and the shops story quickly. Out of 4 people we all ordered something different. 1 person at our table said after eating The Silver Duck, it is now in her top 5 of sandwiches (pesto mayo was great, bread was wonderful toasted and warm). I ordEred The Big Chief which was delicious to say the least (what a kick with the siracha and 2 types of meats). The own walks around talking with everyone even if they're new, getting to know you and the people at your table. Great experience and food!

Employees were nice

Ordered large fry and 3 burgers
My burger was a yumiyum or something like that
Teriyaki glazed mushrooms , all I could taste was salt. I like salt on my burger but not that much. Couldn't taste the mushrooms or teriyaki at all. 
Fry's were done early and sat on the counter until our burgers were ready. By the time we got our order the frys were only warm. 
Unfortunately probably not going back. 
You could tell the employees cared and were trying , I attribute our experience to poor training.

I came in for a acrylic over lay w/ gel and was SO happy with my nails! The shape was perfect and they have so many choices for colors . The staff was very polite and professional! I will definitely be back and their prices are great too

Excellent help!
Nathan - amazing service
Jessica - amazing service
Friendly, go the extra mile!

Really good bagels here, and they have Dawson Taylor coffee too.  My wife and I hadn't been here in a long time, and we just wanted a quick bagel breakfast this morning, so Blue Sky was the destination.  I got a blueberry bagel with berry-berry cream cheese, and my wife got cinnamon sugar bagel with plain cream cheese.  Both were very good.  Mine, in fact, was berry-berry good. (Sorry, I couldn't help slipping that one in.)
This tech team is awesome!  My iPhone went thru the washer. Within a few hours they had me up and going. I depend on this phone for business and they kept me going!  Thank you Rockstar.
I am sick a tired of ordering a extra meat French dip and not getting it this has happened so many times.

After four years of living five minutes away, I caved and came to roaring Springs with my wife and kids. I have completely underestimated this place, it's bigger than it looks from the outside, and there's a wide range of activities for all ages. Got to experience an adrenaline rush for a little over $10. Can't beat this place during the hot summer!

We ate there yesterday for lunch and had not been before. The pizza was great and all ingredients fresh. The guy working there (maybe the owner) told us we would pay less if we got the special the way we wanted instead of building our own. Good food and good prices too.
I have been a regular customer for awhile and they have excellent food and service! I recommend coming here! Try the Santa Barbara Cobb Salad. It's delicious!

This is my favorite Walmart. Great location, friendly staff, never overly busy. I recently took my car in to get an oil change, tires rotated and balanced. There is always a decently long wait at the Walmart in Nampa. These guys got my car right in and were done in 45 minutes. I talked to two employees while getting my car done and both were very friendly and helpful. I definitely recommend this Walmart and their auto center!!!
A vodka and a draft light beer = $20. No thanks. They don't even bother to open the quiet upstairs bar for adults on a Sunday evening. It's a bowling alley for cripes sake.

I use to think this was a great place but it's kind of gone down hill. The bathrooms were a mess. A stall was missing a lock, the next one was missing tp. It looked like the bar tender had a shot of something which is unprofessional. There was garbage under the tables which is in plain site of the front desk. But then while we were bowling the pins would be dropped or not counted. I hope they clean it up as we do enjoy bowling
Great food and sushi. Don't order off there drink menu as they don't know how to make any other drinks.

My family has recently switched over from our dentist to have our dental needs met by the McRae dental team because we had heard they are all amazing. And they are! We have been seeing this dental office for the last couple of months and each time we have gone and I have been so impressed. Impressed on so many different levels! The office itself is stunning and the interior decorating looks like it should be in a magazine. You've never seen a dental office look as stunning and fancy and well-kept like this office is. I love that all of the receptionists have been so friendly and so kind. I love that the assistance are totally on top of their game and they work hard at what they do. Now Dr. McRae, well, once you've gone in for one visit you feel like you've made a true friend for life. He genuinely cares so much about each patient that sits down in his chair. He is so fun to talk to and so thorough in his work and takes so much pride in what he does. I love that he has such a huge passion for humanitarian work and he often has specials and deals that come up in his dental work that go towards profiting children and countries in need. Dr. McRae is a dentist Who listens to you. He has been patient with some dental phobias that some family members of mine deal with and has been so sincere in making dental experiences positive ones. 

If you want to look forward to having dental work done and feel like you've made instant friends and feel heard and cared for in a ten star way, it's time to ditch your old dentist and make the switch like I did. We love this office and will be sticking with them from here on out! I'm so glad we found them!

I really love kneaders but I'm not liking it lately. I got about three tiny chunks of turkey and very little cranberry sauce on my sandwich. For a place whose food is pretty spendy, I was hoping for a little more. When we ordered at the drive thru, my son didn't get his chips and we didn't notice till we got home. 
I feel like kneaders needs to up their game! I'm certain that the amount of meat on my sandwich wasn't even $1 worth. The quality checks before handing customers the food needs to be double checked. We want what we pay for!

We have been very please with Vanguard Pest Control.  We have been with several pest control companies throughout the Valley and these guys are the best!  They are willing to come out on Saturday, which works best for us because we need to bring our dog inside while they spray.  They have also come back out a couple of weeks after spraying if we ever have an issue.  We are customers for life!

This review is about Management not the food nor workers.  I ordered spring rolls in the drive through. I handed the clerk $2.10 cent, it was windy outside and the  $2 blew out her hand and into the parking lot. I got out of my car to look for the cash but it had blown away and I could not locate. The worker didn't not know what to do, she went and asked her manager. They told her to come ask me how else I wanted to pay. I told her they should just give me the $2 item. She said she is not allowed to give away the food. I said I paid for the food. The poor girl was stressed. So , I repaid and she gave me back my .10 from the initial payment.  No one from Panda tried to look for the money or assist.  They want to charge people twice and really have no character.  Very disappointed in the managers lack of character and leadership skill.Come to the window and not send the worker in awkward situation.

Very. Friendly and Helpful!!! Bought several items and very happy with the service in the store and with the delivery team!!! I knew what I was looking for. Good quality and discount pricing for guest rooms. I got exactly what I needed and some extra items that were such s good price, I had to get them!  Warehouse look and pricing with excellent service!!! Thanks, Kelly!!!

Great place to get a wash.  I have a monthly pass and I use it all year.  The staff is great, friendly, and will always put the effort into making everything right.  The place is clean and always has clean towels to dry the last few drops of water off the car or polish the inside.  I recommend getting the monthly pass and highly recommend checking it out.

Ok if there is a place that I would say you must try, it's this one. Excellent food. I absolutely loved it. Chips are nice and hot. And as someone who isn't wild about sour cream, this place made me explore my tastes and was actually surprisingly good. If you love the traditional sit down Tex mex style restaurant, then this is the place for you. Good food. Good fast service. Only complaints are that the salsa was a bit runny for my tastes. Also one of the bathroom doors the lock is broke and it's positioned weirdly so I almost got swung and knocked out and I felt bad because the lady seemed guilty but it didn't bother me much. Also I'm a huge horchata fan and this place is missing that one key element for me, to truly be considered a good Mexican restaurant.

I dont get the opportunity very often to eat anything other than normal American. So I was excited when my wife said that she was willing to try Thia.

It was a toss up between the newer Thai Basil and this place. I decided on this place because they looked they had a more authentic Thai based menu.

Thai Basil's menu is more of a cross between Thai and Chinese. In all my years in Boise and Meridian, I have never been to Sa-Wad-Dee

The old saying is that you never get a 2nd chance to make a 1st impression. This saying stands as true just as much for restaurants as for people.

Standing outside of Sa-Wad-Dee getting ready to go in, I had my initial impression. It was of a run down restaurant that had not curb appeal what-so ever. 

It suspect that it looked like it looked many years ago when it 1st opened up. It could be any business. Just a drab store front type location on the outside. 

Then my wife and I walked inside. The inside is small, but not that bad. After all, sometimes good things do come in small packages, so I kept an open mind.

The waitress sat as at a very small table. There were just 2 of us, but this table barely had room for us both. I was not impressed. It made me feel claustrophobic. Like If I leaned just a bit too far to the left, I would fall off.

My wife and I watch a lot of Restaurant Impossible. The show with Robert Irvine in which he tries to fix failing restaurants. Restaurants that are failing due to neglect and bad food.

So when we walked into Sa-Wad-Dee, the 1st thing we did is looked around. When a restaurant has a dirty and unkempt dining room, its always a sure sign that the kitchen is dirty and unkempt as well.

This is of course only logical. Why would a restaurant keep their kitchen clean if they cant do this in their dining room, and vice versa?

The answer is that they dont. If any restaurant has a dirty dining room, you can just about guarantee that the kitchen is no different.

When we looked at the dining room of Sa-Wad_Dee, we saw ceiling tiles that were dirty and had those nasty looking drop down ceilings. The ones that usually conceal lots and lots more dirt along with dead rats and other such nastiness once the ceiling tile is lifted up.

Once my wife and I saw thins, we lost our appetite. But we ordered anyway. I had the SWD fried chicken. On a side note, what in the world does SWD mean?

The Chicken tasted like it either had been frozen or cooked much much earlier. It was a dish that was similar to Sweet and Sour Chicken minus the sour. So the chicken dish was nothing but sweet, and not a good sweet either.

My wife had the Yakosoba. It did not look appetizing at all, so neither my wife or I could bring ourselves to try it.

The only real nice things I have to add to this review was our server, the menu and the box they used for the check.

Our server was very nice. And they all looked Asian. I hate eating at Asian restaurants where all the staff is white.

Speaking of the serve staff, there were a lot of them. There were only 3 or 4 tables that were full of people eating. So I have no idea why there were so many staff. They all just stood up at the front behind the counter like a police line up.

The menu had a wood cover with a large image oh a Hindu god. As a Christian, I was not pleased to be presented with this, but it did make the menu look like what Id expect in a Thai Restaurant.

When we were done with our meal, or lack thereof, we were presented with a box with our ticket. Like a cigar box, but not as thick. The box also had this Hindu gods image on it.

After this experience, I doubt that my wife will let me take her to another adventurous  place. This was an adventure, but not a good one.

We were happy to leave this place and will not be back.

We had a big group of adults wanting to hang out and a big group of kids wanting to play. It worked out perfect. Our waiter kept it all pretty straight even with the chaos and we had a safe place for our kids to enjoy each other. It wouldn't be my first choice but it's a great family environment. 
The quinoa salad offered a healthy alternative to the pizza and burgers. And the restaurant gave us a quieter atmosphere than the rest of the place. I loved the $5 bonus on the kids cards on Saturday night. Plus the cards kept track of the kids money and tickets. I didn't have to try to manage the silly tickets. Overall a great place for big groups and families. 
PS- I rocked the arcade basketball.

As a vegan, I don't typically have many options when going out to eat unless it's to Thai or Indian food - even most Indian food is iffy because they often use cream or milk. 

Boise Fry Company gives a decent option and had a grill specifically for vegans so there's no accidental meat-juice contamination. 

The employees, though cordial, don't cross the line to friendly. We didn't tip. 

I ordered just the side salad and golden potato po'balls this time, although I've had their quinoa and black bean burger before (heads up: it's delicious but not very cohesive - it falls apart pretty quickly). The salad had a pear vinaigrette that was so good I asked for an additional side of it and the red onion gastrique is delicious! The quinoa was a nice touch and added a good filler. 

The po'balls: whoever came up with this idea deserves a medal. It is soft, mashed-potatoey goodness fried til the outer layer is crispy and mouthgasmic. I got the gold potato ones and topped it off with some garlic, rosemary and salt.

There is a plethora of choices for dipping sauces ranging from mundane ketchup to the more exotic blueberry ketchup (catsup?) There are only two vegan choices: ketchup and mustard. Go figure. 

If you eat all your dinner (or lunch), you can also get house-made donuts here but they aren't vegan so I had to skip on these. 

Overall, delicious food, average service, average atmosphere. We'll be back if for no other reason than to have another side of pear vinaigrette!

Reviewer # 35

I stopped here mid day on a weekend and there was a large selection available. There was a young person working and she provided good customer service. This is a small family owned place. My mom was excited to find an original doughnut that she has been looking for a while and she enjoyed that, which made me happy. Who doesn't want to make their mommy happy? 

We ended up getting a dozen doughnuts and took them home for the whole family. Everyone liked the treats. We will come back again.

LOVE IT BEST SPORTS BAR IN TOWN. Bring your family wife who ever here and pay over the top prices for half ass food if you get a server named Grant or cindy you are in luck because the youngsters serving do not give the best service and vapin out back if you looking for a second beer managment is kina ran by young hip over kids with no love for the job. Tip of the day happy hour drink at jakers go to als and get beer tube so you can depend on the second beer. HR DEPARTMENT and GM hard to impress and its a better job i hear than the quality of product. GRANT WILL KEEP YOUR BEER FULL CINDY WILL NOT LEAVE YOU HANGING thats my opinion.

Let's point out the obvious, Guadalajara is an intense word. But the food is great. I brought my Mom here for our traditional home visit Margarita session. I got a classic on the rocks, she got it blended, and it was wonderful. 

I ordered the new chipotle enchilada dish, and my mom got chile relleno. We both thoroughly enjoyed our meal! WARNING: the chipotle sauce is spicy! I'm a pepper belly, so don't take my words lightly! The only reason we BOTH finished our food was because it was so delicious. Hats off to the chef, and whatever else he wants us to take off. 

I do have a complaint... But it hasn't changed the rating because it made me laugh... The music....... For at least 10 minutes it sounded like the chipmunks were singing. It was annoying, and adorable, and creepy, and funny, and horrible. If I was on a date and that music starting playing; zero chance of second date .
Cute lil dog salon boutique to pamper our lil guys. Great service & smiles every time we go

It's IHOP! It's universal breakfast fare and I ate it. My fingers have typed all they have to type. I came, I ordered, I ate! I am a breakfast Caesar! I have crossed the Rubicon and Rome is mine. BLEEEECH!!!! In 54 bc Rome had no internet. So, let's not go there.

I don't like leaving negative reviews, however...
First, to be clear, I haven't gotten lashes here. And this is why: My sister and I were looking for a new lash place that we could go to together now that we live fairly close. We were a little late for her first appointment, but decided to go see if they could still get it done, or at least reschedule. The girl at the front desk (who I think was also the lash stylist) was kind of rude and sketchy about making another appointment. She said she was booked way far out and could only do it that day, but that she also only had 30 minutes and wouldn't be able to do a full set. Obviously, that wasn't okay but we were late so my sister took it in stride and asked politely to schedule with another stylist. The girl did this (begrudgingly, might I add), and I was already not super impressed.
My sister has her appointment with the other girl within the week, and the girl was nice but the lashes we just not good. It was supposed to be a volume set and it looked like a normal set that already needed a fill. SO disappointing. Her eyes looked no different than when she went in for the fill in the first place.....Huge gaps on both eyes, one eye was heavier than the other, it was just not good at all. Also pretty annoying is that she had a photoshoot scheduled later that day, but it got cancelled because, well, her eyelashes were all effed up. The only good thing I can say is, the owner of the store was pleasant to work with when she emailed to complain, although because the stylists are private contractors, they are responsible for refunding. In the end, the stylist only gave my sister a partial refund which was really, super disappointing. We will not be going back.

I'm fairly new to the area and am looking for a stylist that I can trust with my hair. I came across Tantalum and after looking at their Instagram account I decided to give them a try. In the many posts I found a picture of hair that was colored by Jade. I took a peak at her page and from the pictures I felt I could trust her. I booked through the Tantalum website. Can I just gush about how much I loved Jade! She is a doll and definitely knows what she is doing. It turns out that she grew up in the town I had lived in for 10 years! I'll definitely be going back to her in the future!

I think I've tried all the different tacos and enjoyed every one of them. I used to buy street tacos in Arizona three for $1.50 so the price was a bit hard to swallow at first, but I got over it based on how delicious these tacos are. We love the queso dip and the apple taco for dessert.

I have tried nail salons all over the valley and finally found my place! They have a great selection of colors, clean, and super friendly! The biggest plus is that they guarantee their work. Even if you chip your mani, they will fix it for free. I have had Jackie and Ha do my nails so far, and both did an excellent job. Penny did a design for me and she did great too. I would feel comfortable going to any tech there and getting great results!

Wow! Friendly on the phone, friendly and accommodating with huge smiles. Mallory and Autumn made us feel like royalty! The Cabernet and the Sauvignon Blanc were excellent, the ribeye so tender and delicious and the NY...mmmm! Such a relaxing and fun atmosphere!!!

I've been getting roses here once a month for almost two years now. Beth, Natasha, and all the staff are personable and ensure I am happy with what I get. I know they would quickly and kindly make adjustments if I weren't.

Bowling is expensive unless you're getting a deal(which btw If that's the case be prepared to wait atleast an hour before playing) 

Staff are so rude, and snobby. You literally can't find one kind person. 

Not only is the bowling expensive, so are the food and drinks. In the bar area, I spend $40 on 2 'house drinks' which weren't even that special. The games upstairs will leave you broke, For mediocre games. Not worth my time.

Have eaten here for many years. Started at there Broadway location then moved to there bown crossing and even ate at the street and new overland location. My favorite location is bown crossing as it's usually never super busy but have noticed they have been skimping on the fries lately. The state street location was always hoping and fast service. There new location on overland was always packed and wasn't always easy to get a seat but definitely closest to the house.. I never tried any of there special burgers or fries always just got the OG number 1. With all there diffrent sauces and seasonings everything was always on point and never had a bad meal and will miss this place so much.

I heard so many different reviews about this barbecue spot. I was against coming here but my friend was very adamant that this location was really good. The customer service here was great walk-in was greeted by Ethan he definitely knows how to make somebody feel welcome. After hearing some of his favorites I ended up with the brisket and jalapeno cheddar sausage, with mac and cheese and waffle fries all the food was great except the brisket was very dry. had to put on a lot of sauce just to be able to eat it. Overall my experience here was great staff was excellent.

Dickey's is my favorite place! No better value for great barbecue in the area. I have been to this location at least a dozen times since the reopening and have a large collection of Yellow Cups to prove it. I've gone through the drive through, eaten in with my family and friends, held casual business lunches, and catered food offsite.

The family packs are an incredible deal and even though the price has bumped up recently it's still only a few dollars more than I typically pay for my family of 6 to go through an average drive through. My teenagers eat their fill and we still have leftovers half the time.

The Texas Chopped Brisket is the best thing on the menu. If you are getting the brisket sliced you just aren't understanding how much the chopping and squeezing adds to the tenderness and flavor. This ain't no pot roast!

I've also had the pulled pork, several sausage varieties, chicken, turkey, and the very tender and meaty ribs. They are all very good but the brisket is still my must-have. 

The Bakers are another fantastic option and no better way to enjoy what Idaho does best than to smother a giant moist potato in fried onions, sour cream, smoked meat, and tangy BBQ sauce. We're not putting this on the menu for Jenny Craig any time soon.

As great as the main dishes are the sides measure up to the same standard. My favorites are the barbecue beans and the baked potato casserole which are heart attack inducing but delicious! Other southern comfort foods like fried okra, mac-n-cheese, green beans-n-bacon, and waffle iron fries are good enough to make you want more than 2 sides with your meal.

Last but not least the peach cobbler is the best way I know of to test the elasticity of your stomach. It's always amazing and tastes just like I made it at home. Add a little of the always free soft service ice cream and you've got a little cup of heaven begging you to undo your belt one extra notch.

If you haven't tried Dickey's yet consider this your invitation. There ARE better barbecue places in town but it costs twice as much to feed the same number of people and the difference just isn't enough to spend my money elsewhere.

Always an enjoyable afternoon out. Delicious beer, great cocktails and fabulous appetizers. Our bartender and Server Desarae was a 10/10, especially when she filled our growlers without an ounce of complaint!

Absolutely delightful and very helpful, friendly staff who went above and beyond.   They recommended a nearby restaurant, Yard House, and gave us a $5 coupon.   We got a breakfast bag to go in the morning.   The rooms were spotless with an excellent shower and bed.  Will definitely return.
Great nearby option....can't go wrong! Just needs to be in a bigger location.

Ok I tend to be a happy hour snob but don't go here for happy hour! Usually happy hour means you get the regular priced food and drinks for half price. Here what they do if you order a normal quesdailla has 6 triangles they only give you two triangles and charge you 1/2 price....so it ends up being more expensive during happy hour than thier regular price. What a ripoff! They think most people wont figure it out. What a scam! too bad because they do have a great beer menu and the tvs are great. A micro beer is $5.00 bucks ouch! This place needs a new manager. I wont go back till they fix the happy hour scam.

Fresh bagels every morning. All different kinds of cream cheese and eggs sandwiches, meats, cheese, etc. Open for breakfast and lunch. Friendly staff and lots of places to sit. Fun place for breakfast.

Went a couple weeks ago. Inside is clean and spacious. Lots of seating. Staff very nice and professional. Cooks were awesome and the food was yummy. This Panda Express is far better than the others. Everyone working was super friendly and happy. Check out the Panda on Ten Mile. You won't be disappointed.
Was told this the best Thai in the Treasure Valley and I have to say, I agree. Great food, nice, friendly service, excellent value and a wide ranging menu. We will back, frequently :-)

I LOVE Kneaders!! Whenever I'm near the dreaded Eagle Road I always have to stop at Kneaders. It's probably my favorite place in town to get a sandwich. The homemade breads and soups are delicious, and the desserts are heavenly! My favorite choice is the Turkey Bacon Avocado sandwich, Mushroom brie soup. and Key lime tart! They actually use real turkey pieces on their sandwich rather than a deli meat style, it's amazing.  I also love their little shop inside with giftables and home decor.
My favorite place to go for Mexican food. Food and staff are great. They opened a bar area and the TVs are always going. They also help Oort the community.

Inside out: even when it's busy I haven't had trouble parking. This place is lovely inside and great for working, meeting a friend for a conversation or playing a card game over a pot of tea. They have a lovely selection and a knowledgeable staff who will help you even if you know nothing about tea!! Clean bathrooms and they keep the whole place super clean.

Their serving ware is cute and solid. They have a great amount of seating and occasionally live music and events (follow their Facebook!!

The tea and goods: they have light fare options and the tea menu is a book, you can't go wrong if you love tea!! I haven't had a single bad tea and I keep forgetting to check in here because I forget from having too lovely of a time! The price is exceptionally fair and if you like the tea you can buy it and take some home. They have books and a candy store as well. 

The service: as mentioned above is stellar and it's hard to find better, they even bring the tea to your table! 

This place is worth the drive from Boise, I make it often now! I highly suggest meet a friend or ten, or take yourself for a lovely cup of tea, lounge on a couch, and enjoy a book and a cup of tea on any day.
I'm never disappointed when I come here. Truly some of the best tacos I've ever had. Anytime I'm traveling through Boise, I always find time to stop here. So many great tacos on the menu.

Big shout out to Burt. Our server. Super nice guy in a very crowded and busy Monday night. Was my first time here and was surprised to be seated so fast. Service was friendly and we had mixed drinks, fish and chips, & Big Al burgers. Didn't cost a fortune to eat here, and will most likely be back. Great job Big Al's.

Food was good just a little overpriced for what you get. The burgers are on the small side but were yummy. The fries were fun and the sauces and different spices were a fun way to switch things up. I especially liked the spicy fry sauce. It was kid friendly and we will be coming back.

What can you say about Big Al's.  What a cool place.  Gorgeous architecture and design, bowling, games, massive TV's and really fun place in which I can easy spend an entire afternoon there.  I was there the other day doing just that.  I spent most of the afternoon just watching the Olympics and having a smorgasbord of a variety of things on their menu over the course of my day.  Unknowingly, happy hour was from 2-6pm so I was able to try a lot of appetizers at half price.

Some were good, some were average but all in all, I had a great time watching sports on their big screens and chatting with a friend.  The restaurant has really nice tables and chairs.  Even though the restaurant is really big, my waiter checked back with us constantly giving us personal attention.  Food always came out fast and hot.  Prices are a bit steep but if you come during certain times, you can enjoy a quiet atmosphere and some decent food with really good service.  When they first opened, they were working out some kinks with their staff but I would say in the last couple years, if not more, the staff has really been much better and I have been really pleased with the level of customer service I have received.  I wish them the best and it is a beautiful addition to the Village area.

I have never been treated so well by a nail studio before!  Janna and herteam are amazingly talented and exceed my expectations every time.  Theyare true artists that can create anything and everything that you dream ofon any length of nail, from pink and white to a simple design or completelyblinged out (such as myself) - AND they guarantee their work!  I leave witha beautifully unique piece of art on my fingers every couple of weeks and Iam always excited for my next visit.

All of you with fingernails and toenails - Make an appointment at Nail Tekand Spa.  You'll be glad you did!

Usually a big fan of this place but this time we ordered and they delivered an entirely different order to us. Called back and they were rude that I had called to tell them about the mix up. Delivery guy came back and asked if we touched the order because he was still going to deliver it to the other customers. This is all during COVID-19 as well. Really bummed I had such a bad experience with them but probably the last time I order from them.

So disappointed with what Meridian Floral thought appropriate for the order I made in person a couple Saturday's ago. Tulips and Freesia's for my mom - to be delivered the following Wednesday. This may seem like a special order however both of these flowers can be purchased separately at the local grocery for a fraction of the cost. I thought I was ordering a special display for a special person. Six tulips (drooped by Thursday) and six freesia sprigs and an over abundance of greenery. Since I was in the hospital my mother did call to let them know there waa an obvious iasue and was promised fresh flowers. She is still waiting. Have had such better experience ordering arrangements online from an unknown. Unfortunately I cannot recommend Meridian Floral or use them again.

Tyler was awesome. He's a super nice guy and does a great job. He called my insurance company, validated my coverage, and replaced the windshield of our Jetta in my garage (it was raining). He also fixed a chip in the windshield of my truck during the same visit. 
He's local, owns the company, is timely, and does great work. 
Call him, don't go anywhere else. 

Thanks Tyler!

I brought 8 eleven year-old girls for a birthday party to eat pizza, play games and bowl.  They put us on two connecting bowling lanes with one tv screen that has been broken for weeks. When I asked an attendant for help or to change lanes he went over and laughed with his co-worker. When I went to the front desk for help they said they could only split the party into two lanes far apart. No offer of a discount, no sorry and no offer of an additional free game.  It cost $84.80 for 8 girls to bowl ONE game. Don't bring your kids here. Bad customer service. They should have that lane out of service.

Excellent! The service was great! The food was hot, fresh and delicious. Our server Becca was outstanding.  She was knowledgeable about the menu, friendly, and witty. An enjoyable dining experience. Can't wait to go back.

I had a very negative experience with In Depth Detailing.  I hired them to detail a small SUV that I was getting ready to sell.  The owner, Chris, promised the technician would be prompt.  However, the morning of the detail, the tech was more than 30 minutes late, making me late for a meeting.  The technician also did not do a thorough job.  There was plenty of dirt and grime inside and out after he finished.  I discovered later that he tripped a circuit in my garage, which would have left him without power.  No wonder the vacuuming job wasn't very good.  The tech also used a product that left light discolored splotches on the beige cargo area carpet.  I was extremely unhappy when I came home and reviewed the work that had been done.  I took photos and immediately notified Chris.  He came to inspect the vehicle.  He agreed that the detail job was poor, although we both tried to give the tech the benefit of the doubt since it had been a cloudy, rainy day and there was a lot of pet hair in the vehicle.  However, Chris argued with me about the discoloration, stating that it wasn't their fault.  He provided some scientific literature about how the chemical works and continued to claim it wasn't their fault.  Bottom line, I had vacuumed that carpet the weekend before and it wasn't discolored.  I don't care how their chemicals work, they created a discoloration where there wasn't one before. 

I did not pay for the detail job and was offered a comp detail from Chris.  However, he fell through when it came time to schedule the comp detail job, claiming his equipment had been sent to Australia and putting me off on scheduling the complimentary detail.  At the end of the day, I don't know if I would have been 100% comfortable letting them work on another vehicle of mine anyway.  I ended up detailing our other car myself the following weekend and did a much better job than what In Depth wanted to charge me $230 for.

I found In Depth to be an unprofessional outfit in all aspects of the way this was handled and I would not recommend them.  Given my experience, I am also very suspicious of the legitimacy of the 5 star reviews they have received.

I just moved to Boise and have visited a few nail places not finding one I really liked. I came here because a friend went and they did such a great job with some amazing nail art. I walked in, they were very busy. They didn't have anything right away but said they would in 45 min. I had the afternoon to myself so I went to get a snack and went back. I realized soon that it's a small staff of 4, at least was that day. They quickly got me to a chair to soak my feet for my pedi. It was a little longer to soak than I usual because they were still pretty busy but it was nice to relax. 
I feel bad now that I don't know their names. But one of the daughters came over and started my pedicure. She was so sweet. She made great conversation and took special time on my feet, massaging and pampering. I asked for a flower on my big toes and she did such a pretty job! 
Her sister came and started my shellac manicure while my pedi was finishing. She did a great job evening my nails. I went over to the desk for her to paint them. She did a great job and I asked for a flower design on my thumb and ring finger. She did something I had never seen. It was so cool! She had some flower stencils that she out nail polish on and transferred the design to my fingers. Then filled them in with color. The sisters together finished up my nail art and did such an epic job! 
I'll definitely be back! I love that it's a family that does nails. Even the regulars that go there are super friendly and sweet. 
If you want unique and fun nails with a friendly experience, go there!!

Very clean salon! Each of the nail techs that have worked on my nails did a wonderful job. I always leave very happy with my nails, and they stay on over 3 weeks with no lifting! I also love that I don't need an appointment and they always fit me in pretty quickly. I love New Nail & Spa!!

This is one of my favorite Mexican restaurants however when you order to go they charge you for your to go containers. Because of  that I never order to go any longer seems like restaurants would realize with all these extra charges folks just aren't going to do it I never order to go because they charge for containers.  It can add like $2.00 to an order

I was visiting family in Boise; when a bridge fell out. After calling about a dozen dentists, Legacy Smiles Family Dental was able to get me on right away. Doctor Williamson and his staff were very professional and courteous. I would highly recommend them.

This is just a little neighborhood bar.

But they have the best calamari I have had in a very long time. It is a big tender piece and not the traditional rings.

Don't buy it to share. Order your own order!

The same goes for the Pork Belly!!
I have never had a bad or cold order from this location. I always get orange chicken and it's always piping hot and crispy like it should be!!

This place has gone downhill! When it opened it was pretty darn good but now they have a bunch of new people in there that are just messing this place up. I asked Laura for an extra salsa and she tried to charge me after I've spent 15 bucks and tipped them??? I wanted a Mexican coke and she made me look through the front fridge for it. "We can give you a warm coke" REALLY!!?? Serious?? As I was leaving she didn't even restock the fridge with any Mexican coke?? They're sitting right there at the front! What about a thank you or have good day or anything. Just terrible service. They over salt there chips now and the tacos went from delicious to tiny hors d'oeuvres!

We waiting for an 1/2 a hour to get seated the place was half empty on a Wednesday evening. We asked for help and the lady was very rude the two guys in front of us waited longer and they ended up leaving with us!! So disappointed!!!!

Have visited the N Eagle Road location two times and our experience on both occasions was great!  The first visit was with our son who was visiting from the east coast and picky about what and where he eats.  We all ordered single burger combos and loved them.  The burgers were were well done but still juicy on the inside.  The buns were toasted and the regular and sweet potato fries were crispy good.  Having read some of the other not so flattering reviews, and understanding that dining reviews are typically only as good as the most recent visit, we returned for a second try and the food was just as good as the first time.  So our experience has been excellent, to date, and we plan on heading back again to try something different!
We have held our last two Christmas Parties in the "Skybox" at Big Al's and have had an amazing experience every time!  Jessilyn King is the Even Specialist with Big Al's and she is amazing.

First of all, I am basing my review on that this is more of a fast food establishment, than a restaurant. 
The setting is cafeteria style. You go to the counter, order your food, wait till you are called, then either sit down at a cafeteria style seat, or go home.
My first visit in, I stopped to look at all the selections of tacos. As I was reading the board, the young woman asked me if I was ready to order (not holding anyone up), I was the only person in line. She sighed, and asked me again in about 30 seconds. Feeling a little rushed, I ordered 6 tacos, 2 beef, 2 shrimp, and 2 pork. They come with specific toppings, but basically street taco style.
When my order was ready, I was asked if I wanted sauces...yes please. I asked for the hottest, and some tomatillo. 
I choose to take out. When I got home, the tacos were wrapped nicely in foil, and marked with a sticker as to what kind they were.
They were all pretty good, and generous fillings. They ranged in the mid $2.00 each, and I thought that was fair.
I will go back from time to time, I'd like to try the breakfast tacos soon (several options there also). 
It's fast food people....but good fast food. I have read reviews that is is like California food truck quality....NO......not even close. But good for a quick, semi-healthy meal.

Food was excellent my server was knowledgeable and very polite.I'm glad they have an extensive menu for different palates. My husband and I love coming there for breakfast. I have no complaints so far since they opened here in Boise.
I do need say something about the people that work there. Please tip them 15% or 20% percent. That could be your mom or dad working there trying to support you and your siblings. Thanks for reading !!!!
Stay Tuned!
Best sushi in Meridian. The pad Thai dishes are great with lots of flavor. Smaller location so a bit tight for wheelchairs and strollers but nice place in general.

A regular here. I've tried the various options off their menu, but one I did not try until today was the albacore tuna. If you're a tuna fan, I recommend this sandwich as well. It was cooked well, and was surprisingly juicy, not dry. Still a huge fan of the tempera green beans in substitute for fries!!

This car wash has really helpful employees! They even helped get some things out of the bed of my truck. They only reason I took a star off is because you can't use their vacuum unless you pay for a car wash. But it did a great job washing the truck!
Great sandwiches and top notch customer service. Different soup varieties every day, and haven't found one yet I didn't like.

Although this place doesn't officially opened for a couple more days I decided to brave the lines during one of there free burger days. Although everyone was in training and the ordering process took alot longer the overall experience was really good. It's a nice little place not super huge but plenty of seating and they have some patio seating also with heaters for the winter. It looks like they have a pretty diverse menu although I was limited tonight to just a single burger. I got the BBQ bacon and it did not fall short on taste. The burgers aren't huge but the quality is definitely very good.. I can't wait untill they open to try some of the other options on the menu for sure only sad part will be having to pay even thought there prices are very reasonable compared to some other local burger places. Do yourself a favor and go get a CHAR!!!!!!

Crossfit Fireside is the nicest CrossFit gym I have ever been too. The gym (box) was immaculate, no joke the place was spotless. The owners Ben and Catie are super nice along with their members. Their coaching is the best I have ever received. My wife and I were visiting from Portland and needed a box to workout at and were lucky enough to find CrossFit Fireside. If we lived in Boise we would sign up to go here in a second. If you are looking for a good CrossFit gym I would go here, no questions asked. This is the ideal box to workout at. We will be back.

Tyler has the best service and he knows what he is doing. Unfortunately my windshield has cracked several times but I trusted him to get the job done. He answers the phone, gives you a quote, and doesn't hassle you to commit. His work is great and his prices are fair.

 I recommend A+ Chip Repair !
Isn't it amazing that the food you get from Taco Bell never looks like what they advertise.... they should stop false advertising

Atmosphere
Sophisticatedly beautiful! It is luxury for the people and for the four legged pets. Unlike most places, the smell was neutral which was pleasant. The place was clean, well organized, and colorful!!

Staff
The gal upfront was very helpful. She was able to answer any questions. The gay who came out to grab our doggies asked their names. Total plus. They weren't just a thing. I even mentioned that our smaller dog has a small circle. He was not going to go to the tech willey nilley to him. He asked if he would be more comfortable carrying him. I was amazed! Such great hospitality towards animals

Service cost
Your wallet will not be hurting! 


Most importantly... would we go back?

Yes! Appointment is already scheduled.

This Walmart is really nice. It usually doesn't take long to find an employee for help if you need it. That alone is huge for me! They take the time to answer my question or help me find something. It is clean and well stocked, and not overly crowded. I've used the pharmacy, bakery & grocery pick up, and had good experiences with all of them.  The only reason I took off one star, is because there aren't many cashiers working the registers. They heavily rely on us checking ourselves out.

I did get my chest - but it was kinda damaged. I had to complain it to them but I am promised of a replacement in about ten days! They do not have any standard return policies or anything. hopefully next one I get will work for me. They did promise a replacement , but the fact that I gotta wait so long for a chest is bad. Hence 2 stars.! Wish to have a better experience next time.

I had never had Marcos before but i had always seen their delivery car out. We tried the Hawaiian chicken and it was excellent. Its different than a lot of Hawaiian pizzas but different in a very good way. The combination is delicious and i highly recommend it to anyone. Definitely a quality, tasty pizza.
Love DK donuts, best in town. The staff is always very friendly and helpful. Get there early for the donut holes, when they are still warm it's so good.
This was the BEST burger we have ever had!! On top of that we had the best most fun bartender Marina,she made the whole time we were there so much fun
Meh. Don't know what the big buzz is about. It's "ok" I suppose. Give me a Five Guys over this place ANY day of the week.
Probably the worst tacos I have ever eaten. Fish tacos were disgusting....nasty fish! Very pricy, too! Craving tacos....go to Blue Toro! Went to Tin Roof once...would never recommend it to others.

This place is small and we have had to wait every time we have gone but the food and service has always been worth it . 
I can't recommend anything because it's all
Good ! 
Great place to eat !

I was very excited when I saw this new burger place, but I thought it was going to be a sit down restaurant. To my dismay, the Habit is just another fast food joint, but I decided to give it the good ole college try anyway.

From the outside, the smell of this place is wonderful. A strong small of a backyard smoky BBQ that I just cant resist. The smell was heavenly. 

When I walked in to the Habit with my family, I was very pleased with the look of the inside. This did not look like a normal fast food joint. Except for the large counter at the front, the decor here looked nicer than I have seen in some sit down restaurants.

The Habit has only been open for 3 days, so the new has not worn off here yet. When I arrived, the line was almost out the door, but it moved quickly.

We placed our order quickly and were given one of those pagers like you receive at restaurants to let you know when your table is ready. Here they give you these pagers to let you know when your food is ready so you an then come to the counter and pick it up.

After we placed our order, my first stop was to get a drink. The Habit offers the normal soft drinks, but no Dr Pepper. If you are a die hard DP fan like me (Im a Pepper, your a Pepper, wouldnt you like to be a pepper to?) , this alone might make you think twice about coming here. They do offer Mr Pibb, but any real DP fan will tell you that Mr Pibb just dont cut the mustard. Its like that Mayo commercial. If they dont have DP, it just aint worth the effort.

They do offer some teas, which I tried. The Tropical tea had no tropical flavor at all. The regular tea was just ok. 

We sat in our booth and waited for our food. While I waited, I looked around. The Habit was nice and clean. Pictures of surfing covered the walls. While I admired that fact that they were staying true to their roots (The habit was founded in Santa Barbara CA), "You are not in Kansas anymore Toto"). 

I noticed the grill behind the counter up front. The grill was ablaze with lots of fires. I thought to myself that the Habit was staying true to their name and the name of their burgers. All the burgers here are called Char Burgers. My mouth was watering in anticipation.

We picked up our food and I was still hopeful, but that soon dissipated when I took a bite. I had the Teriyaki Char Burger. There was no real taste of Teriyaki at all. Instead of a UFO, it was UBS (Unidentified Burger Sauce)

Next came the bun. The Habit toasts their buns, which would be a great thing if they did them right. Both buns on my burger were burnt. Both buns on my wife's burger were burnt and both buns on my daughters burger were burnt.

The patty on all 3 of our burgers were way over-done. They were so over cooked that they were dry and tasteless. On a scale of 1 - 10, I would have to give my burger a 2, maybe a 3 at best. There is just no excuse for burnt buns! 

Its toasting bread after all, how hard can that be?

Next came the fries. Not sure what to say here. They tasted like your average frozen fries. They had no flavor what-so-ever and didnt even have any salt on them. On my 1 to 10 scale, I would give them a -1

This place has 3 other reviews, which are all glowing. The only conclusion I can come to is maybe they were having a bad day. We all have them. Restaurants are no exception. Maybe they were not expecting such crowds and they got caught with their pants down. Whatever the reason, I hope they will read this and improve.

The only other possibility for the other 3 glowing reviews is thatare fake. I certainly hope this is not the case, but there are many professional review writers out there that make a living writing reviews for places that they never tried. Again, I hope this is not the case as I think Yelp does try to keep these off here. 

The last thing Meridian and Boise needs is another Fast Food burger place. If I was the owner of The Habit, I would convert this into a nice sit down restaurant, make killer specialty gourmet burgers and add other items here that no other restaurant in Meridian can touch. New Restaurants have a 80 to 90% failure rate. Fast Food is about the same or worse. 

The old expression is that you never get a 2nd chance to make a good 1st impression. I love a good Hamburger, but the ones that The Habit severed to myself and my family today were not it. 

If The Habit survives, I will return here in a month or 2 to find out if they have improved.

Joining this gym has been one of the best decisions I have made! The coaches are amazing and are so knowledgeable! They not only make sure your safe doing every part of the workout, they are right by your side cheering you on every time! You walk in this gym and immediately feel like you have a family on the floor with you! Can't wait to crush some
Goals in 2020!!

Here at 3:00 pm on a Monday. Tacos are cold. Meat is dry. No Fried Fish for fish tacos. How can you rate the taco place fairly without checking their fish tacos? The woman at the counter, very friendly, said they were in the back thawing. Poor planning?
Even though there are lots of things against it to this point it has good flavor.
Shells are not heated on the griddle. 
I cannot get over the dried out warm/cold meat. 
I ordered the number 2 Tin Roof, number 14 the Baja Shrimp and the Texican. Bye far number 2 the Tin Roof was the best. Good flavor, meat was warmer, heavy onions good flavor.
I started off to give this place a 3 1/2 but after a few bites I cannot bring myself to budge the needle any higher than two. Lots of work needs to be done here. If you're looking for a Subway style taco shack, chain, this might be the place for you. Don't come with high expectations though, come with a big appetite for street tacos. 
Another note, the limes used for squeezing over the tacos is actually in the taco so be looking for it. 
The tomatillo salsa is tinny flavored. Metal.
And, you better mask up here.

LOVE IT!  I'm not a huge fan of BBQ, but Dickey's is so convenient, so yummy and has so many choices you can't go wrong.  My husband and daughter love the ribs, I love turkey and the spice sausage and my son, well, he loves the mac & cheese.  Everyone's happy and I didn't have to cook or do the dishes.  Plus, Dickey's will let you taste everything before you order so you know what you're getting.  If the ribs are a little overcooked - there are lots of other options!

I took off a star because they're hard to see from the road - I've driven by so many times and had to turn around and come back the right direction - not an easy task at that intersection.  Also they have really hard chairs.  I guess they assume if you're eating at a BBQ joint, you probably show up with your very own ample padding on your behind, but it's just not so!  :-)

This has been a favorite spot of ours, for a couple of years now. Staff: sorry I'm just now getting around to writing a review.

We typically frequent Grant's on Sundays, after church. Cindy is an excellent server, although we are usually taken care of by Michael.

The service is always fantastic and so is the food. My favorite is the chicken fried chicken (it's organic!). If we ever head in for lunch, I get a fried chicken sandwich or a house salad with sustainably-farmed salmon. The salmon is always cooked tremendously well. 

My husband's favorite is the eggs Benedict, or a burger, or fish n' chips. My parents order the club or the Monte Cristo.

We recently went in on a Monday, which is rare for us, and Michael was running around, as the only server, bartender, and busser. He does a fantastic job!

The cocktails are also great.
Not the cleanest restaurant. Nice workers. Have been a patron for large orders but after today will share the business with other locals.

My mother in law and I got a manicure without polish.  When I walked in I though what a pretty place.  We had new people working on us.  I don't think my person knew what she was doing.  The guy working on my Mother in law had to tell mine what to do on me. We Felt very rushed and they didn't have people waiting.  I was very disappointed!

They make remodeling so much easier and enjoyable. Kelsie went above and beyond and was so patient with any returns, change orders or adds etc. My supplies were always pre-pulled am ready for pick-up. I'd never shop for plumbing, lighting or appliances anywhere else.

Visited for the 1st time. Nice atmosphere. It is situated at the end of a small strip mall in Meridian. 
Waiter brought us waters, and went over specials. All sounded very good.
We were not very hungry, so we both chose sandwiches. I ordered the steak sandwich , and a Caesar salad while my girlfriend chose the cordon Bleu.
My salad was fine...a typical Caesar. Our sandwiches came in a very crispy panini 
Bun. My steak was not seasoned at all, and made it pretty bland. After adding S&P, it was better.
My girlfriends sandwich was also under season, and bland.
I will say that the main dishes that we saw, pork chop, salmon, etc. looked really good. Might give it another shot and see if those are tasty. Would be nice, because it is so close to home.
Stay tuned.

I have been here with both my pups and they are absolutely amazing, even when my spouse had accidentally sprained his ankle and they reschedule everything no problem. They do an amazing job with the pups as well, and my dogs always are excited to go! Not to mention they give the cutest goodie bag at the end! Their prices are unbeatable and overall superior to any other dog salon I've been to!

The food and service is amazing. Came here for the first time with family and we will definitely be coming back.  We tried the # 2 the beef was fantastic, #5 my husband loved the chicken, #7 all of us enjoyed the portobello, #8 my daughter loved the citrus beef and #9 vegan is excellent as well. Highly recommend this place.

We arrived Saturday night around 5:00 pm. Got seated right away, as we were in a group that had a table saved for us. I ordered the blackened chicken salad without dressing. Yum!!! Fresh and a lot of chicken. I didn't see any avocado but It was so good that was ok. Hubby ordered a turkey burger and said it was good. Kiddo had the fish- hubby tried it and said it was pretty good. Our server was nice and attentive. They got the bill a little mixed up but fixed it right away.

Meant to come and say thank you a few weeks ago. 
My grandpa Dube passed away around a month ago. He loved going by "Coach" and would almost never be seen wearing anything but his Texas Burnt Orange.

He was a regular at Tin Roof often times going 4-5 times a week. The day he passed my Dad and I went there to pick up dinner for the entire fam in his honor.
The workers all remembered him and his BIG personality and gave us our entire order for free. 
I just wanted to say thank you fellas! We got home and it brought my Mom & Aunt to tears. Meant a lot!
