Heard good things about this place. I tried two tacos, shrimp and brisket.
2.50 each. Brisket was hard and unchewable. Shrimp was borderline too spicy hot. Very SMALL tacos. The basket of chips was ok. Ordered a coke. 
Unimpressed. Wont be back.

Well normally I love Costa Vida and the way they have responded to the the covid precautions, tonight I was very disappointed. The woman making the tortillas had no mask on and she was an older woman putting herself that increase risk as well. The good news is everyone else had their masks on and appropriate. This makes me not want to frequent this Costa Vida again which makes me very sad. I believe we all have responsibilities to protect each other especially if you're working behind the counter at a fast food restaurant. I hope this was just a one-time incident as I've never observed this before. Normally Costa Vida would get five stars from me but not today

I'm sitting here eating my take-out and realized I have never left a review for my FAVORITE restaurant! Before COVID-19 we would eat there or order out at least once a week! I can't express my love for Saw-wa-dee enough!!!

Me and my husband have been frequent visitors for  4 to 5 years now, which is sad because I have lived in Meridian since I was eight and hadn't been here before we randomly decided to try something new! 
We are NEVER disappointed with the quality of the food or the outstanding customer service! 
We frequent so much that we are recognized by the staff as soon as we walk through the door (our favorite waiter says "hi" or waves everytime we are in if he isn't the one doing take-out! And he makes THE BEST mojitos!!) 
We've tried at least half of the menu items and love them all but definitely have our favorites! They also have AMAZING sushi rolls and we LOVE trying the specialty rolls when we decide to do sushi. The Chef's  NEVER disappoint! 

List of MUST have's: 
- Crispy Flowers  (I ALWAYS have at least one order of these)
- Fried Spring Rolls
- Curry Noodle aka Dr. Greg Noodle (actually a dish that was added to the menu because of a frequent business owner/customer Dr. Greg Callis, who is also my family Chiropractor)
- Basil Fried Rice (1 of 2 for my personal favorites! I don't even have words for the wonderful flavors!) 
- Yellow Curry (2 of 2 for my personal favorites! It's so perfectly blended. Whenever I make my own at home it just isn't the same/right)
- Triple S Noodle (one of my husband's go-to's when he wants noodles. It's even become a favorite for our cousin!)
- Panang Curry (also one of my husband's favorites!) 
-  Coconut & Pineapple Fried Rice (Who doesn't LOVE fried rice? Better yet? They respectively come in a half of a Coconut & Pineapple) 

We WILL keep coming back, it's always amazing and we just can't get enough!

I enjoyed my experience at Fat Guy's Fresh Deli from beginning to end.  

Upon entrance, we were immediately greeted and made acquainted with the menu.  Their menu includes a variety of sandwiches, wraps (in addition to the wraps they have listed on the menu--they can also wrap any sandwich listed), salads, and daily soups.  

I ordered their tuna melt with chips for my side.  The tuna was white albacore, herbed, and delicious.  My dining companion ordered their Asian Chicken wrap which was huge!  The service was beyond friendly.  Our sandwiches took a bit--but precisely what I would expect for sandwiches so wonderfully prepared. 

I live in north Boise and would absolutely make the drive for their sandwiches.  They are serving up some of the best deli sandwiches in the Treasure Valley.
The sandwiches here are always spectacular and the owner is quite the character.  Highly recommended.

Jacquie did a great set of gel nails. I came back two days later with my mom for a spa pedi and loved it! I've been looking for a good pedi and found it. The atmosphere was light-hearted and fun. Both my mom and I will be back. 
They have a large selection of polishes to choose from and the pedi chair was comfy and modern.
Thank you, Jacquie and V!!

Went in here to see what all the hype was about.  I am glad I did.  I thought the place was very clean, employees were super friendly and tried the original burger  by itself and it was excellent.  I am looking forward to trying other things and changing this to a five star review.

This was an excellent experience!  Our waitress was extremely knowledgeable and had some wonderful recommendations.  Spice level was perfect for us and perfectly balanced with great flavors.  We will definitely be back!

Over 6 months they have worked on our yard. Still have not finished or fixed what was not correct. Cement left dried all over the fence and house siding and was told that it's our fault we didn't point it out to them.  Very smooth talkers but will take advantage of you and not finish the work.

Pretty good burgers. Had the purple fries. They were just ok for me. Have some different types of soda (in addition to Pepsi) but they have cola, root beer, etc. Tons of different fry sauces and spices. I'd probably go back since when I go there it's for work and can expense what I eat.

This was the best dining experience we have had in awhile. Both the food and service were excellent. The staff was very accomodating and nice, even though we  came in on a busy night with two small children. I would recommend this place to anyone. We will be back!

If you haven't been here you're missing out! They bake their breads in house, they have cute gifts and will create a basket for you if you'd like. My 'go to' is the veggie croissant and salad- amazing! Another is the turkey, bacon, avocado salad. Not only is it huge (I get a half and it's plenty) the turkey is like Thanksgiving Turkey not deli meat. They have soups, smoothies, pastries (get the salted caramel pecan praline cupcake or a mini fruit tart) and so much more.. the service is always outstanding and fast. I'm here at least once a week.

Do not pay for the $30 wash with the interior cleaning.  The dash wasn't even wiped down, the carpets were barely vacuumed and the front window is streaked with dirt. I drove back to show them these things, and while they re-wiped the dash, the rest of the terrible job was left undone.  I honestly feel ripped off.  NEVER AGAIN.

We bought large boulders from this place and gravel from their sister company Conveyored Materials. They do a fantastic job and good price. Very professional, polite & on time. They came out with a huge crane and placed the big boulders where we wanted them. And for gravel we got the conveyor belt, it shoots it out where you need it. It saved our backs and no shoveling with a wheel barrel. It was awesome, it was so worth it!!! I highly recommend both of these companies! I would give them 10 stars.
This place is fantastic ! The service was amazing, the bloody Mary's were strong and delicious. Will definitely make this a reoccurring spot for date night.
First time coming here and had the BEST experience with Marshall. He exceeded my expectations and did an incredible job on my nails. Request Marshall for your nail needs, you will not regret it!

So I've heard nothing but good things about this place then go in to have a piercing done and get told that they double booked my appointment and because the person who also booked at my time showed up before me I need to reschedule. Also received the WORST service from the people at the front desk, they were complete assholes about the whole thing and did nothing to make me even want to return to do it. Awful service even if they are good at what they do they should have WAY better service than what was provided and that service alone will be the sole reason I tell people to never go here. Ever. AWFUL CUSTOMER SERVICE! You guys really should re-evaluate your front desk people to more hospitable people. I would have rescheduled for another day if they weren't complete dicks about it.
It's not a huge store, but they always seem to have the top-reviewed shoes at really good prices. And the staff are friendly and helpful.

This review is not about the food. I was downtown today and I needed to use the bathroom, and the server told me "the owner says the restroom is only for paying customers". So  I offered to buy a Coke but she just stared at me, so I left. It was about 10am so I wasn't going to order a lunch or anything. I moved away from the big city so I can get away from these stupid rules dictated by homeless people. I thought downtown Meridian was a nice place. Well I had an accident so I'm writing this in anger. Thank you El Tanampa for being so welcoming and understanding. Small downtown Meridian has become as inhospitable and uncivilized as San Francisco, apparently.

Anti Maskers please leave our small businesses alone ! These are our kids and young working trying to survive pay bills you tell them they are lazing they are the ones trying to keep things open and going  during pandemic trying to stay safe while doing there jobs you are threating our young people and there jobs !

Really? The "new hours" are posted right on the front door which says they open at 9am on Friday. The lights are on, at least two employees are inside, the doors are locked. This is the second Dollar Tree I've had this experience with this week. They're losing a lot of business.

We are new to the area and this was our first time using Aussie Pet Mobile.  I made the appointment online and a staff member, John,  contacted me the same day to confirm it.  John was very professional on the phone and took time to explain all the services they provided and answered my questions.  Dallas was kind, professional and  an amazing groomer who had to deal with my lab, german short hair and my 1 yr old cat. This was Lilah's (my cat) first professional grooming session so I was worried she'd freak out. Once I told Dallas this, she took a few minutes to hold Lilah and pet her making her more comfortable before bathing her...  I high recommend them and will be using their services again.

The Ram of yesteryear is no longer. Gone are the days of great food, drinks and service. The Ram is a mediocre place that no longer is the place to be. Truly disappointing. Food and drinks took forever to get and had to remind our server about our appetizer.

I've come here often for hamburgers.  They make a great hamburger and I like the spicy ketchup sauce.  It might be my imagination, but does anyone else think their hamburgers have gotten smaller?  It seems the bun is smaller and the meat is less.  Anyway, I probably will enjoy them, but not as often since they are smaller than the average hamburger. -- I do like the additional space they've added in the past year or so.  I no longer worry about whether there will be a place to sit.

These guys are awesome. It didn't take them long to find out what was wrong with my computer....at no charge! They were very knowledgeable, helpful and had great customer service skills. They even told me the best route to get through the heavy traffic. I would highly recomend Rockstar Computers if you need repairs or if you want to purchase tech items. They even fix phones. Thank you Jacob

Got my hair done with Kendra. Not only did she do a great job with my hair, but she made me feel comfortable as a new client. The hair studio is so beautiful and open and everyone was accommodating. I will definitely return to get my hair done again in the future. Thanks everyone!
Amazing food, awesome positive service (really) and wifi to get work done...this place is the place to go...great veggie sandwich on super good bread and their in house sauces are worth it!

Best deli I've ever been to and I have been to them all over (including NYC for you New Yorkers).  
Can't wait to get back after quarantine.  All sandwiches are great that I've had but the grilled Peanut and Butter with bacon is just an awesome sandwich.  Sounds silly but give it a try if you like PB&J.
Best Thai in Boise! Love their sushi as well! The crispy chicken basil is the best! Great lunch specials and friendly staff.

Meridian now has two empanada joints on Fairview and I had to try them out. Empanada Club is easily accessible off of Fairview with tons of parking available. The restaurant is on the end of a strip mall allowing for it to have tons of window seating inside. As you enter the restaurant you will be greeted with a super friendly employee that will walk you through their menu and answer any questions. Inside you will find plenty of seating and a very clean restaurant. You will find the customer service to be amazing and friendly.
After getting my tour of the menu I ordered the traditional and the chicken/chimichurri along with both dipping sauces. The traditional was filled with tasty beef, olives, and an egg. The combination works to my disbelief. The tart olive was a great punch inside the little pie of goodness. The chicken item was my favorite of the two (they have 7 other flavors I need to try still). The chicken was juicy and the sauce was great. The two sauces were a great addition to the pies with their chimichurri sauce as my favorite. The sauces add a bit of moisture to the bites which is helpful as the dough was sometimes a bit dry.
The only caution I have is the paper that they seved the empanada's on. Once you get the paper wet or tear it from the knife, it's over....a mess of paper and shredding begins. Either grab that empanada by the hand and go finger food style, or cautiously cut your empanadas on the paper. 
I would definitely recommend this place to anybody as  I plan on going back many times. 
Cheers Always!

What a great find! We were staying at the campground across the street and didn't feel like cooking after a long day on the road.  Best BBQ chicken pizza that I have ever had. We enjoyed the relaxed environment along with a cold beer. If we are through there again, I really want to try a salad, they looked delicious.

BEST FOOD EVER! If you want to support an incredible, delicious, local family restaurant this is the place to be  Fabulous food, great staff and ownership.

My girlfriend and I came in for drinks this evening, the staff and owner were so lovely and accommodating. The food is fabulous and the owner even came out and personally gave us a sample of one of their entrees (Chicken Tikka Masala, HIGHLY recommend)

I highly recommend the 4's teachers here at this location. Miss Betty & Miss Isabel are an amazing team & have been in the same classroom for 10+ years. In addition, Terra, the director, is very good at her job, a great communicator & wonderful with kids.

Do not get conned in by these people to buy their Wellness Plan insurance for your pet I paid $500 that one teeth cleaning now they tell me my dog's teeth need cleaned again but he's not eligible until I renew for another $500 in next year what is scam don't be a fool like me

The food was okay, I got their BBQ bacon cheddar burger. Their prices are a bit on the high side. They actually cook your burgers how you want, I asked for medium and I got medium. 
The service was great tho! 
Can't say I'd go back.

I keep getting coupons and flyers through the mail for this place!
Really? 
Stop sending them to areas you don't deliver to when it's too busy !
Maybe spend the money hiring more delivery drivers.

Went in for a pedicure after I called and they told me to come in at 11 and I sat and waited for 20 minutes. Very busy and rushed my pedicure the guy who did it was nice though felt bad for him. The lady when I went in was not very polite didn't even say hello or welcome just asked right away if I had an appointment. Probably won't be coming back here.

Love old Navy! I read the bad reviews and Came over to check it out. Everything was  neat and organized, super friendly staff and a great selection of clothing. We found exactly what we needed and we are visiting from out of town! 
Ps we didn't find any clothing lying on the floor!

The empanada shell is amazingly flaky and perfectly cooked. The filling is perfect and had a ton of flavor. Both of the selections I got were just a hair salty for my taste but otherwise really amazing!

This is one of the best sandwich places to go, and I am not a sandwich person, like at all.  I went with work colleagues who swore it was the best sandwich place in town.  They did not disappoint.  After ordering a meatball sub, my go to, I went to sit down, looking at what other patrons had and I was amazed at the serving size.  It felt like a true down home place, like Cheers, where everyone knew everyone.  The owner even gave me a little fun teasing about having a certain football team on my debit card.  When I received my order, it was fresh, hot, and tasted amazing!  This is a hidden gem in the city of trees.  If you have the chance to stop in for a bite, make sure you come hungry.  They even have a menu option where the cook gets to make your sandwich and you get what they feel like making.  Make sure you go try Fat Guy's Fresh Deli, you wont regret it.
Loved this place! They have cold beer and good food! We split a New York strip there a couple weeks ago and will definitely be back to check out more beers and more of the menu!
Food was good nothing overly special. Service was ok, but the drink were amazing. Bloody Mary was really good and comes with a beer chaser.
Food comes out cold. Long wait times when there is no crowd. Missing items. Really crappy service. Unfortunate because I love their menu options.

No!  Teddy, a usually amiable corgi cried so much that even the neighbors commented.  Matt didn't seem to appreciate the fact that corgis legs are maybe 1-2 inches long, and yanking them around hurts their shoulders.  Also he was advised ahead of time that Teddy had two bad back knees and to be gentle, so I was quite astonished when I poked my head in to see that Teddy had slipped off the table with one of those bad back legs and was in pain.  I had to point that out to Matt who didn't seem to notice, and would have just continued grooming my dog standing on three legs, one of which is a bad knee.  They are pricey so I expect good service.  Maybe they have other groomers that aren't so rough but it's my job to protect my son so I won't be using them again.  When I voiced complaint to the owner he simply offered to take me off the next appointment.  No offer to make it right, or apologize.  Instead, Matt was defended and I was told I'm the only one who ever complained. Hmmmm.

Phó House was recommended by a couple of people on FB so I was pretty excited to support a local business! I called for a pick up order and spoke with a young girl that was very nice. I told her I had a gluten allergy and verified with her 3 times no gluten and only the no gluten  sauces as I ordered spring rolls and that comes with a gluten sauce. I picked up the order and verified with her once more that she spoke to the chef and it was all gluten free. She happily assured me it was. (I actually ate the spring roll on the drive home) I excitedly opened my rice noodle dish once I got home and there on top of everything was an egg roll (completely glutinous) after a bit of a fit I called them. The young girl said "oh no "",it's habit for them, I'm sorry". I asked if I could come back and get a fresh one sans egg roll and she said let me go ask. I said of course and she came back and said yes but it will be 20 more minutes... I sent my husband and they did not have it ready, they wanted the old one that we tossed and weren't going to give him one!!! They (the nice girl) had the audacity to act like it was his fault that they screwed up. Needless to say after explaining our situation for five additional minutes to the chef he did get a new meal but I will not recommend or ever be back. The worst part is after waiting all of that time for my bun thit noing it was only subpar.

Stopped at Tin Roof Tacos tonight for dinner! 

Service: was great! Not overly friendly but very nice, answered questions, and made recommendations. Food was out in about 5 minutes. 

Food: good tacos, LOVED the shrimp taco. Decent portion sizes for the price too! I was wishing for more sauce on the shrimp taco and the fried chicken taco, mostly because it was so good. The brisket tacos were not our thing, but they were not bad. HEADS UP: if you order chips, each order comes with an entire paper bag full of chips and a smaller sized portion of salsa/pico/guacamole. The ratio is off here, for sure. 
The churros were tasty but didn't taste freshly fried. They were lukewarm and a little rubbery. 

Price: $24 for five tacos, two orders of chips and pico, two orders of churros, and one drink. Add a $5 tip and I'm not disappointed in the money spent, but next time I will stick with just a couple of shrimp and fried chicken tacos. With extra sauce.

We used to love coming to Big Als. Great service and menu. After Re-opening to a limited menu, they also decided on a self service route. We won't be back with the big family until things can return to the way they were. If it had not been for our 4 kids that wanted to go we would have left before ordering. Praying they can make the changes. Too many other restaurants have improved during the shut down, didn't happen here.

My family and I are new to the valley, and needed an oil change for my car. Christian Brothers on Meridian Rd. was offering a promo for an oil change, and I took them up on it. From the very beginning, they had excellent customer service. They texted me confirming my appointment, but it wasn't a generated text, the owner took the time to send a personal confirmation. I had to reschedule my appt. due to a massive ear infection on the day of my appointment, and there was no trouble rescheduling. Then, when I did arrive for my appointment, they asked how my ear was feeling. They were super kind, and professional, and the facility was very nice. They offered waters and snacks in the waiting room, but we took the shuttle home to wait. The owner was the one driving the shuttle, and you can tell he truly cares about his customers, and serving the people in the valley with quality work. They completed the work requested, and they made some recommendations for future work, but NEVER pressured us into that work. They also provided pictures of the car to back their recommendations. We will continue to use Christian Brothers on Meridian Rd. for all future car repairs!! Thank you Rich, and staff!

I cannot say enough good things about Christian Brothers.  As a woman, I feel listened to, helped, and not taken advantage of.  They explain everything and have been very honest with me.  We take all our vehicles to them and have had nothing but excellent service every time.  Thank you!!

Usually I ask what is fresh and get that today I didn't . I just grabbed what sounded good and unfortunately started eating it and it was all hard. I took them back and told the lady (unpleasant) about them and she offered to swap them for a different fresh product so that was nice but she never apologized for the inconvenience or for the original situation then I asked for a glass of water and she said it'd be .37 cents. I told her never mind. It was incredibly rude especially since I walked all the way back to exchange my pretzel and what I got it replaced with was a dollar cheaper than what I ended up with! The boys that works there are always so nice. She was very rude. I work in customer service and retail and worked food industry 10 years and I just hate snotty employees. Get a new job if you're unhappy .

Understaffed.  Poor service.  Came for a simple tree question.  They only have one person here with any ability to even field the question.  He was busy.  Waited and waited and finally left.  
Tried to get my propane refilled.  They couldn't even do that.  For a Saturday afternoon? At a nursery? Can't vouch for other Zamzows locations but I'm done with this one.

I had several watches in need of a battery replacement and found this spot on Yelp.  I contacted the owner and inquired about the service.  He quoted prices and said he would be able to assist.  I appreciated his fair prices and fast service but as other Yelpers mentioned, just call ahead.  Especially with COVID, the owner is accepting contact-less repairs so be prepared to leave your watches along with your information.  He is very good at communicating about the repair status or even when he is out to lunch, so you won't miss him if you leave him your number! He repaired 3 of my watches, (Guess, Marc Jacobs & Baby G) and even gave me the email link to the Tissot service center since that model requires some special tool to open.  Thank you Meridian Watch Repair!  I'll be back!

One of my boys won a free pair of shoes through Pacers at their school. Fleet Feet not only provides valuable information on finding the right shoes for you and your family, but they encourage and help motivate kids to run! Brandon was amazing with my other son during The Fastest Kid in the Valley race, that they put on. My son was getting behind and feeling down on himself right from the start and just started crying. Brandon took the time to talk to him about always doing the best he can and doing it for himself. My son didn't end up finishing the race but he restarted 3 times to try, and he wouldn't have done that without Brandon's encouragement. Wonderful store ran by Wonderful people!

I have never gotten a watch fixed, but this was a great experience. The gentlemen was up front, gave a very good price, and let me know when it was done through text. Would recommend if you want good customer and overall service at a decent price!

Came in yesterday, service was great but my boyfriend and I both received burgers with parts of the patty still completely raw. It was disgusting to eat and see entirely uncooked parts of meat in our food. The waitress had even asked how much pink we wanted in our burgers my boyfriend said none and I said very little so it's kind of ridiculous that cooks just put out raw meat to serve to customers.

I met a friend here for lunch.  It's a small restaurant at the end of a strip mall.  The place is clean and had both tables and counter.  The server was very friendly and attentive.  The three taco lunch plate I ordered were small but delicious and filling.  The pulled pork was perfect.  Needless to say, if the tacos were this yummy I can imagine what other menu items would taste like and with that I will be returning very soon.  Thumbs up!

Really nice facility with an outstanding staff. Top notch service from when you walk through the door clear till the end of your procedures. Squeezed me in when I was having a really bad tooth pain and now have me on track to clean up my oral hygiene and are working with my schedule perfectly. Offering late night appointments as late as 6 to not affect my work time. Won't go anywhere else and will always trust this group with my dental needs from here on out. Last on the list was getting my 4 wisdom teeth removed! All though I don't remember it. I bet they were still friendly as can be while I was completely out of it.

service was outstanding! food was good quantity and quality - warning 2 spicy was hot for me.  That is a personal thing and hard to gage but it was more spicy than I have had in along time.  Food came fresh and fast!

Amazing service! I had my oil changed and received a complimentary car wash and detail! They cleaned my car! WOW. The employees were very nice and professional. Wait areas were so nice as well. I will definitely be back

My husband and I stopped in for lunch and really enjoyed our tarta and empanadas (chicken chimichurri flavor was spot on! the curry was a little lacking) We loved that they were baked and not fried! The empanada club is a husband & wife team who've brought some argentine deliciousness into Meridian. Finally, some international flair in an area that needs it! The prices are reasonable, compared to every restaurant/shop in meridian. (for that 3 star reviewer-the sauce is .50 and don't get beer or wine if your gonna just whine about the prices ;( ) People of the treasure valley just come try for yourself!

Carly has such a sweet presence about her! We were on our Massive Momentum Tour coming through Meridian. She was able to get us right in and make us feel beautiful and pampered. They were so gracious that my 2.5 son was with my mom and I while we were getting our hair done. This salon is in a great area with a great on the go sandwich and salad shop to order from right next door! Next time I am in Boise area I will look Carly up for sure!

Called to do a curbside order and a girl named Jennifer answered the phone. She was very monotone and honestly so rude. The whole time we were trying to order she acted as if it was an inconvenience for us to be placing an order. I work at a restaurant and would never expect to treat paying customers the way Jennifer thought she needed to treat us. This was my first time ever eating at The Habit and with the poor service we received I will be taking my business elsewhere when I want a supposed "great" burger. Maybe Jennifer should realize that even though your business is not completely face to face anymore customers can hear a terrible attitude very easily over the phone. The service was so poor I wrote this review while we sat in the car waiting for our food. Extremely disappointed.

Tucked away on a side street (Wells) off of Overland near Eagle Road in Meridian is a hidden gem called Fat Guy's Fresh Deli-- 160th person to review the Deli. This is my 462nd review. This is near the Primary Health and Human Bean. 

WARNING** This place can get quite busy, especially during peak times; however, they do a very good job of getting the whole process completed quickly for you. 

Parking can be a bit tight as it shares a lot with many other businesses and street parking isn't available. 

The space inside is small(ish) with tables positioned all along the windows and a main seating area with a few tables. You can sit outside, too. The decorations are pretty cool. The place is very, very clean, too, except the air conditioning duct needs cleaned for sure, but all in time. Just don't look up! 

The customer service was great! The owner came in when I was there with produce and other good. The staff call him Chef. He is a nice man-- takes pride in his work and the food speaks to that. 

They have many, many (literally) options for you to chose from including many sandwiches, soups, chips, and salads. The salads are some of the biggest I've seen. If you're looking for a large salad-- go with the 1/2 size. Trust me. 

They have kids meals and I believe cookies, too. 

Be aware that some of the photos on Yelp are old and the pricing has changed. Although we should keep that in mind with any photos as change happens always! 

I really, really like Fat Guys. One thing I thought was funny being a "fat guy" was that there were many (probably 15) fit men getting super large sandwiches and here I was with a salad... at FAT GUYS!!!! 

I certainly recommend this place and I can't wait to go back!

DUDE this place has it all! One bite of their signature Charburger will have you dreaming of the next visit. I've had plenty of delicious burgers from chains but the Habit outshines most! I probably visit at least once a month so allow me to highlight my favorite menu pieces: 

Right off the bat I can tell you my all-time favorite is the Santa Barbara Char. This masterpiece includes two hot, fresh, chargrilled beef patties with cheese and avocado on grilled sourdough. Talk about a world wonder. Whenever I think of the yummiest burgers I've had, this one lands near to top of my list. That's saying a lot considering I've eaten more burgers than you (I'm totally willing to bet on that.). 

Another item I can't leave with raving about is the new(ish, by now) Chicken Caprese on Garlic Ciabatta. This seasonal sandwich features a fat, juicy piece of chargrilled chicken breast on toasted garlic ciabatta with tomatoes and lettuce, topped with melted mozzarella cheese and basil pesto aïoli. This sandwich is a burst of flavor, a neat twist to bring a little Italian to this burger joint. If it's still offered, you best get yourself one before it's gone. 

Lastly, it would be downright disrespectful to leave out the OG. If you didn't have a Charburger at least once have you ever really been to the Habit. This signature can come with one or two juicy chargrilled patties, but I only recommend the latter if you're feeling up for a challenge or sharing the meal. I got one today and ended up having to save half it was so darn big. It will make a fantastic lunch tomorrow! 

Before I leap off my soapbox, I would like to name a few honorable mentions, all sides. French fries, onion rings, sweet potato fries and tempura green beans are all fabulous choices, can't go wrong with any of them. I mean, the salad is good too, but if you're going to get a burger for crying out loud give yourself a break just get the damn fries.

This review may be a little over the top for a chain, but it's well deserved. Hit up the Habit if you're looking for a quality burger. Just like me, you just might make a habit out of it.

Dan is super informative and knows what he's doing. Will be coming back for sure, would 100% recommend to my family/friends. Piercings came out amazing, wish I would have came to them for my other piercings

I had a dine in breakfast. I had ordered a half order of biscuits and gravy. I asked the waitress how they were she stated a lot of people order them. Not really a stellar recommendation but went with it. After all,  most of the south wall of the restaurant was wrapped with a huge picture of biscuits and gravy stating they are "famous". So if the Capri is going to spend the $$ putting that kind of advertisement on the wall they must be good!  WRONG!  I do not recommend them. The biscuits were too moist birding on wet and the sausage gravy and next to no sausage and was relatively tasteless. 
That sums it up no flavor all the way around. Order something else.

What can I say, I should buy stock in this place once they go public.... amazing like always.... tastes just like the empanadas in Argentina........ ....
.
Best Argentine empanadas hands down anywhere in Idaho.... or the Pacific Northwest.

i'd give it zero if i could not sure if the lady was a manager or what but her attitude was disgusting and i wasn't even here to eat only simply to grab a door dash order but she was rude and scuffed when i didn't know more then the place the order was and the name of the customer and she expected me to know the whole order off the top of my head- moments later i hear the order come through and instead of her just saying the order just came through she made me read out everything i was suppose to pick up for the customer and then stated that the odder just came in even and even giving me the order was just attitude i'm glad i don't eat here and was grabbing a door dash order

Worst customer service ever. If I could give zero stars I would. We just went in here for dinner on a long road trip. We are tired and hungry but have never been to Habit before so we took a few minutes to look at the menu then stepped forward to order. This is when it felt like I was in the twilight zone bc we were told they "no longer take our order because we are behind on online orders." Confused because they had just asked us two minutes before if we were ready to order, we asked them to repeat themselves and then if that meant we had to wait and how long. Again we were told "we are behind and it is an undetermined amount of time you would have to wait." What in the crazy food service is happening?!?!? Completely confused how you would refuse to service customers standing right in front of you! Also, they were not short staffed, they had many workers behind the counter and only one register open. And no one in line behind our family of 5! Will never be returning to this place or even this chain of that is the business practices they are using. Too bad because I heard they were good.

First time we decided to dine out in over a year.  We decided to go to Meridian because we assumed the mask wearing in the kitchen would be more likely.  
10 of us were celebrating my husbands bday.  
We walk in and the server has her mask around her chin.  Wanting to serve us with no mask.  Uggh. So frustrating and gross.  
Hopefully Goodwoods will be better.  He really wanted bbq.

Lovely wash shop! We came in for a self service wash. The owner is very helpful and the stations have clean towels and forceful air blowers. There are ear wipes and the shampoo they provide is natural and gentle. Neat treat selection turned an apprehensive pup into a doughnut chomping fluffy beaming creature!

Spring is here and we will be back soon!

I've had Mexican food here in the past, their Tacos and they are good.  I thought I would try the Chicken Mole and was I so disappointed!  This was more like chicken Colorado.  I've never had Mole with mushrooms and celery.  The best mole I've had has always been made with chocolate and peanut butter.  Maybe they changed cooks and if they did, they should get him back, if it's the same cook, he needs to learn how to properly make MOLE. Just saying.

My best friend and I decided to get our first tattoo together on our foot. We brought in the design and Justin was our artist. Within 5 weeks the ink started to fade and eventually most of the words are now gone. I came back in to see what could be done and Justin did not take any ownership and basically said that he warned us both that this would happen which he did not! Had we been told that we would have never done it!

Our Family has enjoyed eating at Grant's for many years now, and the food and service has always been amazing.  Sadly, when we ate here for the first time following the COVID reopening we were very disappointed. The burgers are no longer home made, they were pre-made patties and just were not good in comparison to what they used to be.  We are hoping after having been open again for a period of time they will go back to their original menu.  We will give it another try as we love the people and the atmosphere, but if the quality of the food doesn't improve, we will be looking for a new favorite.

I customarily do not like to leave negative reviews for independent workers. I've given it some time and quite a bit of thought before I leave this negative review. 
Jenna Leigh,  colored my hair and when I left I was absolutely thrilled with her work.  Unfortunately by the second wash it was evident that the color was washing out. 
When I spoke to Jenna about it she, advised me that she put in a rinse and not a hair dye. Because of Jenna's verynegative response I am leaving this review. I've included photos before and after. I paid $475 for the coloring. After the tip and products the total came to $550. I don't mind spending the money but the pictures will show why I am unhappy. The first photo is of what my hair look like when I went in. The second photo is when I left the salon absolutely beautiful. The third photo is after approximately 30 days.
We only did the bowling today but I had to give only three stars because the music was so. dang. Loud! We had to yell to hear one another.

I don't care for breakfast food so I ordered lunch.  My friend ordered a philly cheesesteak sandwich which looked really good.  I'm going to try that next time.  I had a chicken sandwich which was good also.  I would recommend this place and I will definitely be going back to try other things.

Ate here once. Had the Reuben, $9.95. In fact, all the sandwiches are $9.95. 

The Reuben was quite good, but not as "fat" as all their advertising and marketing might want you to believe. It was served with a tasty potato salad, and I had a serve-yourself-drink, 21 oz., $2.19, free refills.

Friendly staff, quick service, and the place was clean.

I sat at the counter. Oddly, no mustard, salt or pepper conveniently placed on the counter; had to ask for mustard.

Depending upon how you want to describe this, either the counter is too high, or the stools are too low. My plate was in my face as I was trying to eat the Reuben. Table seating would have been a better choice.

There is a large flat screen TV, which was showing hunting shows, probably in deference to the indoor shooting range, nearby, and the customers who come-in from there.

When in the area, and hungry, I'd certainly drop-in again.

I absolutely love ICCU! When I arrived in Idaho a year ago, I was banking with Bank of America. To my surprise there was only a single BofA branch and it was located in Northern Idaho. My husband and I both were told my multiple people that ICCU was the best credit union around and they came highly recommended. 
We made the switch to ICCU and our experience has been great.  They offer so many benefits to their members...free notary service, counter check printing, immediate debit card issuance, & even discounts at theme parks. Those are just a few of the benefits! Their hours are great! Monday-Friday until 6pm & Saturday until 3! The employees are always very friendly and helpful. They have tons of locations all over the treasure valley! I really feel like I will be a member of ICCU forever. I have never been so pleased with a bank or credit union.

horrible service waited over 45 min after our order was supposed to be ready another establishment that can't seem to get there shit together during this covid-19 bs. still cant understand how togo is so much harder that eating in.  to top it all off our order was wrong surprise surprise check you order before you go!  update hour and a half after our order was ready they served16 people ahead of our order through the drive thru no people who ordered ahead then had the audacity to tell us there out of food fuck this place hope they all fall in the fire pit!!!

A great organization with great people.  I went for a car wash and had a tire losing air.  The oil change lanes were already closed for the evening as it was well after 7pm.  I asked if I could get some air for my tire to get me down the road.  The manager discovered the air sensor was not aligned to the right tire, he took the time to find the low tire, the nail and repair it.  And since I was due an oil change, I said out of loyalty to their extra efforts I would be back in the morning.  No worries, they went ahead and took care of my oil change while fixing my flat.  Clean car, clean synthetic oil, and safe tire pressures.  Jake and his crew are awesome!  These are the people who make America great!

Good food at am average price.  I ordered a double and at first thought it looked small but about half way through realized it was the right size.  Fries were good and the self serve fry sauce was welcomed.  Super busy. They do have access to add your own jalapeños or peppers for those who like spice.
$13 for a quart of soup and another $6 for 4 slices of bread.  Hardly any noodles in the soup.  Disappointed.

They have such horrible service and tonight the meat was cold! Tonight was the 2nd time in two months that we experienced horrible service. The first time we placed an order through the app, both of us got the daily special which includes a drink. However, picking said drink was not an option through the app. When we arrived at the drive thru, they did not give us a drink. We questioned it saying we ordered the special through the app, which we were promptly told that you cannot order the special through the app. So we proceeded to show the receipt which in fact stated there was a drink, this being the same receipt we were just handed. She then proceeded to argue stating we didn't request our drink choice, but wait you just tried to tell us we couldn't order the special through the app and couldn't get a drink! She ultimately gave us one but I think mainly because we weren't backing down! Tonight, we ordered again through the app for curbside pick up, but even after checking in nobody ever came out. My husband attempted to call and it went right to an answering machine. He then got into the drive through (had a child sleeping in the car so couldn't go in) and the intercom was broken. He waited in line and once he was to the window they seemed to take care of everyone in the lobby first. It's now 40 mins past our pick up time! Needless to say the meat was all cold but the sides were at least warm! I guess we will be driving across town from now on for better service and food!

Edit: the last few times I've come here, I've had a complaint. Since I wrote my original review they have definitely gone downhill. I paid for a salad and received slimey, Brown, wilted lettuce. This is not an isolated incident, DO NOT waste your money on their expensive salads because they do not check the quality of the leaves. I had to completely throw it away this time because there were more bad pieces than good. 

****

Everything is made fresh. From sandwiches, to soups, or a huge selection of dessert,  you are bound to find something that you will love.

My favorite thing to get here is the turkey sandwich on focaccia bread. Their house spread for the sandwiches is tangy and delicious. As far as dessert goes, I really love everything that they offer year, but I typically reach for the frosted brownie which is super moist and chewy!

They also have a selection of loaves of bread for purchase which is great for people who rather have something with a more homemade taste and not full of chemicals and preservatives like the grocery store bread. 

Parking can sometimes be tricky during lunch hours, but I have never had any problems finding a spot. They also have a drive-through, which is very convenient! They are closed on Sundays, so don't plan on indulging until Monday.

So sad tonight!  As a Mug club Member of close to 10 years this is painful for me to write.  In a community where things are now fully open why reduce the happy hour menu to 4 freakin' items???  Went on Monday and it was the COVID-19 menu and today it was cut in half?  Naughty!  Service...uhm...not bad but the server wearing his hoodie with hoodie on and then later on his cell phone in the dining room while on the clock was less than optimal.  Higher prices should not create a less than pleasant experience.  Is this an impact of HQ in Washington?  Maybe...but come on...don't make me find a new weekly, or more, hang out.  Not mad...worse...disappointed.

Got pierced by KERRI. Didn't know what I wanted exactly - she picked the earring and the placement (between veins so least traumatic/bleed). Earring has healed so well and easily that I was accidentally sleeping on it within a couple of days. Don't recommend sleeping on it - just saying. Really great jewelry selection at this shop (and I have been to over a dozen of different places known for jewelry.)

For a mask requiring restaurant i was shocked when the employees were not wearing masks. The cook did not has a mask on and neither did the manager. As an older individual this was extremely disappointing. Fix this policy.
This happen long before yelp. But beware, this shop sucks. Qoited over 2k for a fuel pump me a ND a mechanically inclined friend did for less than $500.

THE best dog groomer in the valley.
Rachel was so kind to my old girl.  You cant beat her.

I went to Austin Creek Dental one time when I was visiting my parents.  They told me my teeth had several cavities that needed to be fixed immediately.  When I got back home, I went to another dentist to get the cavities filled.  The new dentist (who's been in business for 30 years and has had great reviews) said that my teeth were almost perfect.  He couldn't even figure out which teeth Austin Creek Dental could have thought needed a filling (after examining my teeth AND looking at the x-rays).

On the plus side, Austin Creek Dental had a lot of new technology that I haven't seen at other dentists.

I like to come back after a while and revisit places after I review them just to see if establishments rest on their laurels and begin to slide. Well, I am happy to report that Fat Guys Fresh Deli is as good as the day that I first reported on it. The sandwiches are as good as ever, the soups are EPIC!, and the service is like family without all of the family baggage.

 Fat Guys Fresh Deli ranks right up there with the nations best delis with one difference... I've been to Katz's, Stage Door, and the 2nd Ave Deli in New York, and the food is equal, but here's what sets Fat Guys Fresh Deli apart....
 It's Chef Wally.

In any famous deli like Katz's you go to the counter, and you had better know exactly what you want or the rest of the people waiting in line will start to groan and moan. The people behind the counter don't have time to get to know you, nor do they want to because they're New Yorkers, and frankly could care less.
 
We are so very lucky to live here in Boise, Idaho, where we DO CARE about our neighbors, and we really do care about the relationships we build with our neighbors, customers, patrons, and we try to make friends with everyone. Chef Wally genuinely wants to know if "poopy seeds give you heartburn", or if you are "allergic to soy", or if you need a "low cholesterol diet"... Chef Wally wants to know you, and by knowing you, he can serve you better. I have seen Chef stop the construction of a sandwich and ask the customer, " hey, this basil mayonnaise might irritate your Reflux, do you want to just hold off on it or maybe go really thin on it?"... 

This is the kind of customer care that makes Fat Guys Fresh Deli such a jewel in our community, and should be on your menu list.

Even when they are busy, you are not shuttled in and out like you would be at a "famous deli". They really "like" their customers, they care about you, and it shows in the little personal touches they add to every meal that puts them not only in the same category as the "famous" delis, but in a very important way puts them beyond the "famous" delis. Yes, it is about the food. Yes, it is about the taste, the service, the experience, but the bottom line is, at Fat Guys Fresh Deli, you can have all of that, plus you become part of a family. A very delicious and reasonably priced family, but a family none the less.

 I don't get there nearly enough, so I guess I'm that uncle that works overseas or something, but cmon in and be the new cousin, or niece, or nephew, etc, etc...  if you need a cookie cutter meal, press on down the road, if you're ready to open up a delicious new branch on your family tree then head on down and go see Chef Wally. No one leaves disappointed because they care enough to ask you, and will immediately rectify anything not to your liking.
I love this place and would swear by it...

Like most folks who post reviews, I like to scan to see what others are saying.  Sadly, there are clearly some sabotage reviews on this restaurant, however, the majority clearly rules.  137 reviews and 4 stars speaks volumes!  Good job guys!  Well deserved.

I stopped in this past Saturday for lunch with my good friend who happens to be a culinary chef.  We both started off with a nice cold IPA.  After some browsing of the self-described "American style grill, focusing on Northwest cuisine..." menu, I decided on the Cubano sandwich and my friend went with their Pastrami Burger.  

The food and the presentation was very impressive and satisfying.  The Cubano had a bit of a smoke flavor to it which was an interesting twist.  

My friend was absolutely floored by his selection and did not leave a single crumb behind.  

This place isn't huge, but it doesn't need to be.  It's just right!   

This was my second time there and I will definitely make it a point to stop in again and try something different.  I hear the Bacon and Brussels appetizer is to die for.  

See you guys again soon!

Splendid!  My favorite place to visit while visiting family in the area.  Simply delightful!  Friendly employees and the towels for drying make this place standout!  I look forward to getting my car washed here every time I am in town.
Beautiful salon with professional technicians.  Friendly atmosphere. I can't wait to bring my friend for her birthday.

My favorite donut shop in town!  Seriously,  I don't understand the hype about Krispy Kreme.   DK Donuts is the real deal!  I can get all my favorites that I learned to love as a child.  I haven't had a donut in several months but today I splurged and had a chocolate bar for breakfasts and a chocolate cake donut with BSU sprinkles for lunch.  

I stopped in this morning to pick up 2 dozen donuts for an employee meeting.  I got one dozen of mixed bars and the other dozen was a mixture of old fashioned, cake with sprinkles, custard filled, etc.  The owners are friendly and it is always clean.  My grand total was $19 and some change.

Extremely Pleased with Dr Brooks and her Team in Meridian,  ID.
Having grown up in Phoenix &
 So California and being 65 yrs old. I visit their clinic three times a  year. 

Seasoned Professionals  !

This McDonalds has always lacked something.   Frequently my orders are wrong and they hand out drive through sodas with soda drops and leaks from the lids.  A particularly annoying thing to me.

Due to the convenience of the location we continue to use it once a month or so.   It's getting better than it used to be, but it's not up to the high standards of a few of the other McDonalds in the valley.

Amazing nails. Thanks girls! Everyone was friendly kind and knowledgeable. The store is clean and relaxing with plush massaging chairs. 
We found this store through all the positive reviews and by talking to other customers I can tell they have a lot of happy repeat customers. 
You won't be disappointed here 
My daughter and I came here for full sets of dip nails and pedicures. Our hands and feet look and feel fantastic. Best nails to date.

Started out great then went to nothing....
So I spent WEEKS researching who I felt were top tattoo artist. In my eye Imperial has the best in the city, at least what I thought from pictures. My wife and I stopped by on May 2nd and I asked for Travis but he was busy so I spoke with Ryan. As I left I felt a great connection with him initially and understanding of what I wanted, on May 5th I sent him pictures as he requested. Fast forward two weeks later and I've yet to even be able to get an appointment scheduled or barely a reply from this guy. I've followed up with him through email once and text twice. You would think that if I'm ready to spend hundreds to thousands of dollars that he would at least get me scheduled for a future date but I've got NOTHING. (Keep in mind all I said was that I would like to get it done by mid July so I felt that was reasonable). I believe in a man's word. If you aren't going to do what you say then just say you can't do it. That's the respectable thing to do. Don't have someone waiting to hear back from you when you have no intentions on helping. That's bad for business!

I love the friendly service at this location. The food has rarely let me down, as it's always been pretty good [for the price too]. I've had a vast variety of their food from the burgers, chicken and salads. I love the fry sauce as well. I've yet to try a shake but I heard they are also delicious. 

The seating area is slim pickings sure, but its a nice atmosphere and you can tell the staff around here work hard to keep things running smoothly.

I love this place and more importantly my fur baby does as well. Their prices are reasonable and my favorite part is that they do exactly as you want. (Trim here not there etc.) They have a friendly staff and the place is real clean!

I went to the Rocket Express Car wash to get my car cleaned as I had not for months I had a Pleasant suprise the staff was friendly to work with and the cleaning was well my car was perfectly washed and with the free vacuum It helped to get under the seats overall a great experience would recommend

I travel a lot. I decided to do something nice for the wifey and order some flowers when she was feeling a bit down. They were not cheap @$100+. The ordering process was simple enough and intuitive. 

I get a message from my wife asking if I delivered flowers that were meant to be a surprise. I told her yes and asked what happened. She said she received a call saying no one answered the door and that they left the flowers at the door, but they weren't there. 

I looked over the security cameras and saw that no one had came by the front door. I called Meridian Floral to inquire about this and they got me in touch with their driver who then gave me a call. She never once seemed remotely able to take any blame and said,"that is weird, I always check the numbers" and she acted like I was in the wrong. Well the fact that she delivered to 1512 and not 1511 (changed for security reasons) when both houses clearly state the numbers she clearly didn't check. All I got one minor apology that was the kind you get from someone who doesn't think they did anything wrong. I called the office to complain and got about the same thing but at least the second lady was quicker to take a little responsibility. The only reason for the two stars is that the flowers (once grabbed off our neighbors porch across the street) were nice, and the timeframe for delivery would have been quick had they actually came to my house. I don't expect perfection and mistakes happen but owning up to those mistakes is the most important thing you can do in customer service. Will not order from here again.

Pictures of my wife coming back from the neighbors with the flowers in hand and of the flowers themselves are attached.
Absolutely love this place, Tran and Vu are amazing! My cousin and I love there service and awesome technique

My favorite store in the world and we have traveled extensively on God's globe. Many decorator items in our home have been purchased from Heritage Reflections. It is like walking into homey sweetness when you open the door of this store.

I usually don't leave bad reviews but I feel like it is necessary. I was very excited to get a blow out for my family photos tonight and I was looking forward to trying a new place. It all started when I walked in and noticed the floors were really dirty and I wasn't acknowledged for the first 10 minutes, which I looked past to them being busy. Then once I was checked in the girl let my stylist know that I was there. I waited another 30 minutes before my stylist came to let me know she was running a little behind. I let her know that was ok but then another 10-15 minutes rolled by and I still wasn't helped so I decided to leave. I hope that others can have a better experience than I did.

This place is absolutely ridiculous I've been here several times and there never open I probably tried to come here 10 times and every single time they are CLOSED. Employees are in there just watching people go to the door. I feel sorry for whoever owns this store.

Absolutely loved this adorably decorated salon. From my first interaction on the phone, they were so kind with setting up my appointment and answering all my questions. I was booked with Paige. She went over everything with me before she started, so I knew exactly what she was going to do and the cost. I love my hair color and cut. She was super sweet and professional. All the stylist were so kind and you can tell they love working here. I am Super excited to have found a salon that I can come back too.
Our favorite pad Thai spot! Perfect portion sizes, fair prices, and the spice levels are spot on every time.

I'm a big panda fan and I'm currently eating the most disappointing panda meal ever. I paid extra for the beef entree and it is completely inedible. Every chunk is just gristle. The chow mein noodles are dry and the orange chicken is meh. Won't be returning.

I really enjoyed this place. The flavor of the pho was not very strong but I relate this to the broth being made properly with bone marrow and not with additives like sugar. Where I live most restaurants incorporate sugar and other additives. I appreciate that this place does not especially because we have family members who struggle with blood sugar. Beef fried rice was good and the pork sandwich was minimalistic but good. Café sua da was good. I would come back again.
Yummy and clean! The yellow curry was delicious. Fast and friendly service. They have a Happy Hour Menu that's fun too!

I live in WAAAYYYY east Boise. But that did not deter me from driving all the way to Meridian for this level of deliciousness. Even though the Broadway location is closer, I had to come see the new digs and check that Tin Roof maintained their consistency that has elevated them to heroic taco levels. Yes. They have. A spacious location, tried and true menu, and much more patio seating (coming that is) makes this location just as memorable as the first! Well done, keep it up, and we'll be back!
Great food and so many options! There are plenty of vegetarian options too. The service is usually really good and people are nice.

I'm going 2.5 stars, it wasn't horrible, but so much could have been better. Ordering was easy enough, chips and salsa were cheap and great! Huge negative: the trays they serve food on are absolutely filthy! It's beyond me how these are not washed. For Covid times, tables were not cleaned between patrons, couldn't find napkins anywhere. As for the tacos, the flavor was good, but my tacos were not even warm at all. WTF? We drove 25 minutes here, as DT location was closed. Not even worth it in my mind. I will give DT location a try when it's open again, but Meredian, you can have this one.

Awful! The last two times I've been to this location I've sat there for a ridiculously long time. The first time was around 40 minutes. Thought it was a one-off and decided to give them another chance. Tonight we sat in line for over an hour! There were probably 5 cars ahead of us, so I figured there would be a little wait...but not an hour. To top that off, two of us have bad stomach cramps and diarrhea. I noticed they were hiring all positions, so it might be that they're understaffed...but this is not the customers issue.

Good breakfast if you dont mind waiting over 30 minutes for it after placing your order. Owner was too busy putting together gift baskets to realize the food was taking too long to come out, and when it finally did it was cold.

My family and I have gone to Big Als of several occasions and always had a food experience. My brother and his family were visiting from Utah and it was my nephews birthday so we thought it would be fun to go there. We played games and the girl working the prize counter was awesome. After we went down to have some happy hours drinks and appetizers. It was Friday around 2 so it wasn't very busy there were probably three other tables that had people. We sat there for about ten minutes before the waiter even acknowledged us and said like he was disgusted that he was the only one working and it was going to be awhile. So we debated on leaving but decided to stay. Needless to say he took our order it sat in window forever while cooks stood around. Never got refills on drinks and just came back to bring us our bill. So we were quite disappointed. We asked to speak to the manager and whether this girl was the manager or not was debatable. We told her our concerns and she acknowledged she saw the waiter struggling but she definitely did not care and had quite an attitude. Which made me even more upset I told her that it seemed she didn't care and that we had been there before and always had a good experience and we probably wouldn't be back and she Said ok and walked away!  That definitely was the icing on the cake and I am so not impressed. I even emailed big als and never received a response. Very disappointed!

Excellent empanadas with authentic flavors. I had the carne picante, citrus beef, and chimichurri chicken. I enjoyed all three with the chimichurri chicken being my favorite. If you're looking for something filling then go for the citrus beef. It's a great flavor and very hearty. I'm eager to explore the rest of the menu because a lot of the other items sounded  great. I paid for some extra chimichurri and salsa. One cup of each was more than enough for all three for how I like it. 

I appreciated the time taken for myself and other customers asking questions. It was clear they have a real passion for the food they are making and I think that came through in every bite. This is a welcome gem that really stands out among the chain restaurants.

I just picked up dinner for the family. Six empanada's and a chocolate chip cookie. We've had empanada's before at various places, but these were far and away the best any of us have ever had. Fillings were delicious, the crust was light and not greasy. The cookie was exceptional. We will be regulars.

Warning: This review is for the catered picnic area, not the general park. This is for those corporate event planners out there.

I am very lucky to work for a company with locations across the U.S. and we try to take them all out to picnics every year or two. I "have" to go to these events to meet families and live it. Hands down this is now my favorite location of them all. Best park, staff, food, and venue.

The park isn't small, but I wandered around beforehand and I would love to go on the rides. Later after they opened, I didn't notice any with crazy long lines or over attendance.

The staff were all, universally pleasant, attentive and engaged. This must be a great place to work with solid leadership and management.

The food ain't the best you will eat, but it was the best Park food I've had on many park visits for company picnics. Everything was well cooked. Even ribs that were tasty. The burgers and dogs were actually cooked. The baked beans were very flavorful. Not a fan of the cookie I tried, it wasn't I. The same class. All the rest was well above expectations. Best of all - I even saw a Quality Control person testing the temperature of the food on the buffet. I have NEVER seen that kind of care.

Finally, I enjoyed the covered picnic area. Plenty of space, great shade and totally convenient for the employees arriving and the logistics to set up.

Have you tried the P.C. Pedro? Named for the radio character on the Austin Hill Radio Show.......
I have to say, it's one of the best sandwiches I've ever had...
Austin Hill's show is now on 99.1FM on Newsradio KINF from 6am to 9am....
Soon, on Fridays, at 8AM the show Non-Offensive Friday will be playing again... This is the show that spawned the sandwich The P.C. Pedro! A turkey French Dip with Horseradish Havarti Cheese, pesto mayo and special politically correct Au Jus, it's not your normal French dip. It's better.
Chef Wally and Dave now have an adult beverage counter, where beer and wine are served, and their beers are really inexpensive because they like to say that everyday is happy hour at 2 Fat Guys Fresh Deli...
They also say......
Never Trust a Skinny Sandwich...!
You can't go wrong at this place!
Food is killer! Soups are from scratch every day!
Tell them P.C. Pedro sent ya.
First pedicure after Covid shutdown!  Talk about amazing. They did a great job on my much needed pedicure.  Very friendly staff and pleasant to deal with. I will certainly be returning.

I was never informed that they would be taking 45% of every item that was sold. bad deal for me, good deal for them. I will never use this auction again. they said most people bring items in not for the money, just to get rid of them. I guess I am not most people. this has been a while back but it still eats at me. and I just found yelp.

Bill was fantastic. I needed my watch to be resized. The entire process took less than five minutes and the cost was very economical. The shop is located in the old historical area of Meridian.  Parking was limited due to construction in the area, but the owner cannot be faulted for that.

The talented staff at A Beautiful Reaction care about you having hair you love! I've gotten blonde, brunette, and red hair at the salon and been pleased every time. The salon is beautifully designed, bright and fresh, and in a great location. It's the perfect place to bring your girlfriend for blowouts before a night out.

Love love love this place and the service! 
Amazing quality furniture and the prices are unbeatable. Best service ever from a furniture store! I will definitely be buying here from now on!!

I absolutely LOVE M. Vince! They have been very thoughtful with their COVID protocols, and their pedicure stations are just the best. This is THE place to book some treatments, and just relax! Two thumbs way up!
Hands down the best sandwiches ever! The staff are always friendly, service is great.

Took girlfriends car (BMW X5) in for a complete detailing. We went over the different plans they offer. Decided on the platinum. Also asked to get the headlights cleaned (plastic covers discolored).
Guys were very polite, and took the time to discuss options and expectations.
Got car back late in the day. Car loos great. There were a few very small areas that didn't get cleaned, but overall I was satisfied.
Vietnamese sandwiches are below standards they should be more like $3.00. The vermicelli was fantastic 4 Stars  for that.

I have been drug into this place many times and they never disappoint.  They are always slow regardless of when youre in there, the fries are almost always soggy regardless of the type, and the burger is nothing special except for its price (high).  Most of the burgers I have tried were also very salty.  It is the type of place I bring out of state friends to because it is unique in its multiple potato  choices.

As always Wally and his staff never disappoint!  The sandwiches are always great, and are large enough to satisfy even the biggest of appetites.  We will definitely work our way through their numerous sandwiches!

As a customer with experience detailing, I believe that I am as picky as they come. Richard and his awesome detail specialist are the best I have seen. Easy to work with and the work is extremely thorough. There is nothing worse than getting into a car you paid for and see in between the seats dirty with food or garbage. With Dynamic Detail, that area was spotless. Amazing detail, and done on time for a competitive price.

Beware of deceptive pricing signs.  I walked up on a whole bin full of floor mats. There is a sign on the outside that says "Trendsetter Mat 35 x 47" for $12.99. Inside the bin, there two different kinds of mats. Several mats are labeled "Trendsetter" and several mats have no label at all...but they are all in the same exact bin. Not one or two of each kind of mat...there are numerous.  So I assumed that all mats in the large bin were $12.99. I brought a mat up to the register along with my other stuff to check out. The mat I brought up rang up for $35.99. I mentioned the sign on the bin and was told that was only for the "trendsetter"mats. I mentioned that the clear mats had no labels and were intertwined with the trendsetter mass. The manager said they could not be responsible for customers moving the mats. I made the recommendation to place two signs on the van to prevent confusion in the future...one sign for the "Trendsetter" mat and another sign for the clear mat. Seems pretty logical to me...but the manager didn't think so. She just walked off with a half ass apology. I asked her to fix the issue...not apologize.

I got The Classic Bison Burger and Russet Po'balls and was thoroughly impressed. The textures and flavors of both the burger and the potatoes were awesome. The value for the price was exceptional. I will return for sure.
I've had a great experience here both times. I've had a Mani/pedi & a manicure. Nice, family-run business. I enjoy talking to the girls about their college adventures.

I want to give a shout out to Madison at PetSmart on Eagle Road she did an amazing job. I know I'm not the easiest one to work with and my dog is very dramatic but I'm extremely happy with the way she turned out. What's helpful and helped me decide on what kind of cut I wanted and I love it

So I've only been there once but my first experience was pretty solid. I'm in from out of town and frankly their bagels weren't five star but the service was so overwhelmingly friendly that I had to give them a six for service and a four for the bagels. They offered options and they were helpful and answered a couple of silly questions of mine and overall seems pretty happy to help out. They're doing their best to enforce social distancing requirements even changing the entrances so that you enter one side and leave the other. I absolutely appreciate that! There was a customer in front of me who didn't have a mask and you would think they would request a little more forcefully that people wear masks because it's not the non-mask compliance people that are at risk Dash it's everyone else. The staff had their masks on and seem to respect the requirements. Good job people.

There were a Decent number of bagel and spread options so that we could choose more or less what we were looking for and they seemed more than happy to build them as we like. Pretty happy with his experience.

We have tried various Dickey's when we travel since all the ones in our area have closed down. This store on Overland had a nice friendly atmosphere and I really liked the decor. However, I suggest that you visit early in the day for meal you want, because they had run out of many items and they started cleaning the ice cream machine exactly one hour before the closing time.

The food isn't really that great and it's expensive. Not sure about the drinks-I'm pregnant! Ordered Artichoke Spinach Dip and wings. The wings weren't the greatest quality. The meat was dry and chewy. The sauce wasn't that great either (Frank's Hot Sauce) and I didn't care for the ranch-nothing like Idaho Pizza Company's Ranch haha!! The Artichoke Dip reminded me of the store bought stuff that was dumped into an oven safe tin. Because of COVID (phase 4 reopening) the service was changed, and it was the worst set up ever!! The bartender had to enter our food order so you stand in line. He also cashing you out after your meal. If you want to order anything you gotta get up and go to the bar and wait. If you plan on playing games- the cost of a reloadable game Card is $2, so keep it in your wallet for next time! Don't even get me started on the bathrooms-gross, no soap, missing locks, went into 3 stalls because of no toilet paper-on a Saturday-I can go on....

This salon is exceptional! I have been having my lashes done for years here and always recommend it to ladies that are interested in getting theirs done.  Leslie is amazing and has always insured that I am happy with my services!  Margie is now my lash person and her work is phenomenal!! I LOVE MY LASHES!!!!

Love this place! Their hazelnut bread is so so yummy, same for the baguettes and all other breads and rolls I have tried so far. Oh and if you're in the mood for sweets, the eclair and the chocolate mousse dome are to die for. It's also a nice feature that you can order through the app and get your order from the drive thru.

Such rude kids working the front desk! Won't let us use our kids bowl free after 5 pm we are working parent with kids!!!!!! That's why we pay a rate to save money not to be turned away like we are not important!!!!!! Horrible customer service!
Laura is amazing! I had the best pedicure that I have ever had. The leg and foot massage was amazing! I'll keep coming back. Ask for Laura.

We usually love this place , but this time there was flys and a piece of a hamburger on the seat. The worker charged us for two extra drinks even though  we only ordered one meal. Took about 45 minutes  for one char meal not even busy
Super good place, just went here for the first time and will never regret it. If you like donuts, this is the place to go.

Exceptional food! Great ambiance. FRI-SAT PRIME RIB NIGHT! Outstanding Prime Rib!
Friend Green Beans we're amazing as well!
Highly Recommend Grants!!!

My neighbor's cat jumped into my car and I have a severe allergy. I took it here to get de-cat-taminated (see what I did there?). My car has never been so clean, and I have two kids! Not a trace of cat hair anywhere. They are super friendly and did a great job.
Tyler did a fantastic job.  I felt that he was very honest and helpful, which is something anyone can appreciate!  He worked quickly and the end result is a brand new, chip and crack-free windshield.

I never really get my toes done separate from my hands, but the last place I went to didn't have time for my feet. Luckily I was able to book an appt. with M Vince within a couple days on a weekday afternoon. 

I didn't realize the salon is located in The Village at Meridian (big shopping/food/entertainment center) until I arrived. Parking was a little busy, but I got one within a couple minutes. The back door is actually located on the parking lot side, and the front door is on the opposite side. It doesn't matter where you enter from, but you gotta check in at the front upon arrival. 

The salon is gorgeous, I'd have to say. I felt like a queen being in there in the first place. LOVE how they don't rush you to pick a color, too. I originally picked white because I like how it makes me look tanner (haha), but Tommy (who ended up doing my pedicure) ended up giving me some welcomed color suggestions. I obliged and was much happier with the light blue result. 

It was nice to have my own little area with no one else around. The other ladies were on the other side of the salon, so I got some much-needed quiet time. I thoroughly enjoyed the massage chair and the entire pedicure itself. Tommy is great, and I will definitely request him again. He has great attention to detail and is meticulous when performing every single little task. I'm glad he suggested I get the paraffin wax as I definitely needed it from walking around barefoot all the time. He gave me a little discount which was nice, too. 

I enjoyed our conversation and the fact that he let me chill for a little while as my toes dried. The prices are surprisingly fair, so I will definitely be returning -- sooner rather than later.
Do not order delivery from here! Not sure what the quality is like inside but we spent $40 for basically a side salad and small pizza that was mediocre.

I rarely give poor reviews but I will give three because of the stress the workers are under during this COVID 19. The drive-thru was busy so I expected good food. The staff was nice and answered my questions. They were out of a lot of things but I found something that sounded good. The chicken salad sandwich I ordered was a small dollop of bland chicken salad that did not cover the bread, a leaf of lettuce and the bread was dry. I just ate the chicken salad on the lettuce. There was a mini cup of lettuce with prepackaged mini vinaigrette dressing which I was not sure how I was supposed to eat it without a fork or was it supposed to go on the sandwich? Probably won't go back because the prices are high for what you get and I can get a great sandwich a lot of places.
One of my favorite spots in Meridian. The whole family loves the empanadas. Very clean inside, superb food, and friendly service. I wish I could eat there everyday!!
