The selection of teas was fantastic!  And yes, they also have quality drip & americano coffee.  Italian sodas & other beverages are available too.  Bonus!  Sweet Zola's is located inside, alongside- so various candies & chocolates can accompany your cup o'tea.  Non diary milk choices of almond, soy & coconut, as well as high quality eco cups (compostable!) male this a must go for those of us who appreciate quality teas.  Note:  this business is very accessible & very pro every ability... floors r flat & smooth & the bathrm big!  Lots of seating at various heights & firmness... something for every body!

Hey Big Al's
Today was a big flop from beginning to end. First the lane did not work. We tried the intercom on 3 separate times no one answered and no one came. So down to the front end I went 5 times to have the lanes reset. I was unaware you set a timer for games so as I am sure you guessed timer ran out in the middle of the second game. So we did not get to finish the second game. Ordered food another mistake. I went to the lounge and ordered drinks and food. He handed me 3 drinks no offer to bring them to me or a tray for me to carry them. Ordered the nachos the kids wanted they brought the wrong ones of course. The last straw the kids had cash to buy their game cards. Yep! You don't take cash! However, you are handing me the same pen that has been used by everyone else in the building that day. Doesn't really make sense. Please I get Covid but it should make sense. You are not cleaning the counter after each person nor the key pad for cards. I spent almost 100 bucks taking the kids there today. Extremely disappointed

TERRIBLE bedside manner!!!  Do not waste your time, money and health!!!   Nobody there cares to help you as far as meds, comfort or to help you with your job protection due to a severe infection, disease.  my dr at IGA refused to fill out my FMLA paperwork and to this day still will not prescribe any type of meds to help with my side effects,  symptoms....  Told me to only call if I have a fever... ggrrrr, WTH!  I am scheduling an appt with a "real doctor" today.   My sanity, health is too important.... its sad the staff at IGA doesn't feel the same.

Pizza was good tasting. Everything else was poor. Service took a long time to get drinks, order, even bring out salads. After salads were delivered (two of three), we had to wait until staff returned to ask for silverware. after about 5 minutes we asked about the last salad, after a few minutes it was brought out with the wrong dressing. took almost 10 minutes to get right dressing. Waters were never filled. took the pizza to go because so much time was wasted by staff. staff was not apologetic about be forgetful, the delay, or being ill prepared. It was as an embarrassing experience. Will not return.

I've been to Kneader's several times now and I am always beyond satisfied and happy with my experience. They really do have some of the best bakery items in the Valley! Last time I was in, I ordered a breakfast croissant sandwich, which had sausage egg and cheese on a delicious buttered house-made croissant. The croissant was buttery, but not too much. It was just about as buttery as a perfectly made croissant should be! The sausage patty had plenty of flavor as well. The sandwich was super moist and overall it tasted amazing! I've been wanting to branch out, however I'm drawn to this sandwich every single time I'm here. It's just to good to pass up!

A couple of my favorite sweet treats from Kneader's are their yummy eclairs and spectacular cream pies. On a recent visit, I had a slice of their raspberry cream pie. It was like eating a spoonful of whip cream and raspberry jam! I'm sure it's made from scratch. The cream was so rich and delightful! This has become my favorite. The eclairs are rather small and spendy, however they are decadently delicious! The custard filling was heavenly. 

I'm looking forward to trying many other treats from Kneader's but it's so hard when you already know what your favorites are!

Ordered online which was easy.  Navigation was simple, it was quick, and an email popped up letting me know when my order would be ready.  That is why I am giving three stars.  The food itself was not how I ordered it online.  Burger was pink inside- and I clicked on well done.  Fries were soggy and salty.  I ate there once before and it was delicious, so I am hoping this last experience is not typical.

This is based soley on take-out, which I have now done twice. I definitely want to go back for dine-in because the restaurant is gorgeous! It is in a tiny strip mall in the Fred Meyer parking lot and definitely not what I was expecting. The decor is so pretty and everything has been selected with care. 

So the food. I ordered the lunch Pad Thai for my first order and the Bento C Lunch Special (California Roll, Cashew Chicken, Soup, Rice, Salad) for my second. The Pad Thai was very good...but very different from other Pad Thais that I have eaten. I am NOT an expert on Thai food, so perhaps this version is more true to Thailand? The noodles were very thin, the only vegetables were green onions and the sauce was on the thicker side. I definitely prefer a Pad Thai packed with veg, but otherwise it really was tasty. it just surprised me. 

My Bento C box was also good. The 4 year old, "Hungry" devoured the California Roll and soup. I tried a nibble of both and they were typical. Nothing extraordinary but not bad. I really enjoyed the Cashew Chicken's flavor. This one was packed with carrots, peppers, and onions. I loved that. It was a tad spotty with grease. I think the cashews just naturally make things like that. 

It was a nice Thai option close to where I live. Not my most favorite, but definitely worth a return visit.

I went here for the first time over the weekend.  I got a single char burger and the tempura beans.  It was absolutely awful!!!  

The burger was disgusting and I couldn't even eat it. The beans were not crunchy, just soggy and tasted like beans dipped in grease.  

We got it to go so I was not able to send it back or I definitely would have.  Save yourself and go someplace else!!!!

I would suggest to stay away from!

They are so great! My dogs always look beautiful after getting cared for at splash and Dash. They accommodate my scaredy cat dogs who won't walk on a leash. Too notch!

My dogs have long hair. The first visit was truly a miracle. One of my dogs had a lot of mats and I thought he might need to be shaved. Splash and dash did an amazing job to save his hair. They worked very hard and treated him well during the process. Now that I am on a monthly plan, they will never have mats again. 

Thank you!!

You can't go wrong at Habit. I go for the tempura beans. I was happy to notice you can get a lettuce wrap burger. Hadn't seen that before. Some days I don't want a bun. This location is really consistent. I appreciate that!
Sooooo good! Chris was super nice and informative! Everything we got was delicious! We will defiantly be back for more!

I contacted Justin about two weeks ago needing to get our current trust in order with Idaho law. He was very accommodating in getting into his office that afternoon to begin the process.  Within a week and a half, he had a draft copy out for our review including all of the rest of the documents needed.
We met with Justin to finalize the paperwork and sign.  The process was done with unbelievable speed and accuracy.  It was almost like he had been waiting for me.  I appreciate that and realize he is very busy but he does go the extra mile to get things done.
I definitely recommend Justin and will continue to use him as my trust and will attorney.

My wife and I love Thai food and we have visited every Thai restaurant in the valley at least 2 or 3 times. It had been a while since we had been here so we thought we'd give it a shot. The service was extremely slow even though they had plenty of staff. Both having our order taken and getting our order took a very long time. The food was fairly good. It just lacked the pazazz good Thai food typically has. My wife returned a couple of weeks later with her father and had a similar experience. This was just our experience(s) and yours may be different.

Best customer service and friendly staff. Not to mention there is an amazing cookie place next door you can go get a snack at while you're waiting for service, but don't be too long because their techs are great at what they do

This has been and always will be my favorite restaurant!! Tonight we had Jessica taking care of us and she did amazing! The place was packed and she still managed to go above and beyond for us. Great environment, food, and very friendly staff!!!

I ordered food for breakfast this morning and received a skimpy amount of food for $18. The bacon was raw and I needed to cook it in the microwave more. Everything blacked flavor. They didn't include any plastic wear or napkins which I expected at that price. Needless to say this is my first and last time at this ihop.

So I ordered an omelet over the phone for take out and was told 15-20 mins, which I am fine with, I showed up at about the 20 min mark and paid for my food ,the sever checked all the orders on the counter and said none of them were mine so I was told it would be out in like 5 mins. Ok so I sat down to wait. About 35 mins go bye so I stand up and the server that took my money looks at me and proceeds to go to the kitchen and check on my order, then comes back out and looks at the order that has been sitting on the counter the whole time and figures out it's mine and hands it to me as she's laughing say it's been here the whole time. So it took 55 mins to get my order and then to top it all off besides my food being cold the bag of silverware and condiments I got only had a SPOON in it. All I could do is laugh cuz why would you put a fork in with an omelette. Needless to say I won't be returning or suggesting this place to anyone from here on out.
I have never had a sandwich I did not love. I'm about a 3rd threw the menu and I can't nail down my absolute favorite

I will never come back!  You park in one area on UFC fight night...try to get in and are not allowed to walk through to the other areas.  Supposed to go back to your car or walk all the way around--rediculous--No courtesy or common sense! No wander the rating here is so low.   Common sense could take this place to the moon...

My wife went in to Kristin today to get her hair cut and dyed to a "Balayage" style (brown with blonde).  Haircut came out mediocre at best, but our true disappointment was that the hair came out all brown, no shades of blonde to be seen (she's a natural dirty blonde).  The dye starts at $85 for this service but she charged $70 more ($190 for a $35 cut and $85 dye) while not providing a receipt.  Highly disappointed in the quality of service as well as the price jump without explanation.

The food at El Tenampa is as good as any authentic Mexican restaurant in Boise.  The food is reasonably priced and the wait staff is always attentive.  When you are first seated, you are served the traditional chips and salsa, but also refried beans and something made with cabbage (I don't know what it's called!)  It's so good!  I like to make a little chip sandwich with the beans and cabbage.

Hugo's is really delicious! I've never been disappointed. The service has been fast and courteous. I've been to the Overland and Five Mile and Fairview location. Both are clean and well maintained. If you go in for lunch, just be prepared for a line. It is a popular lunch spot. But the crew is fast and they'll get you in and out fairly quickly. 

I've had their sandwiches, fried chicken, mac n cheese and deli fries. The fries are top notch. They use a delicious spice on the outside of the fry, which gives it a zesty crunch. I like the "Grinder" or "Italian" sandwich. They're quite large and if you're not famished, you might get away with splitting with a friend! They use a local bakery for their bread, but I can't for the life of me remember who. Zeppole? Gaston's? Gah, I can't remember. 

An amusing anecdote: Yesterday, my 4 year old had her first day of preschool so we went out for a special lunch after. She chose Hugo's. ("The place with the BIG fries and sandwiches!") :) There is no drive through, so I had to drag the beasts in and then she wanted to dine in. So we settled in, made a mess and enjoyed our food. I did notice that we were the ONLY female diners for the entire 30 minutes that we sat there. Lol. Every single customer was a big, burly male who really seemed to enjoy their large sandwiches and delicious sides. It made me laugh.
Just moved here. This was my second place I tried and I found my new nail place! Lena was amazing! She went above and beyond. Can't say enough!!! So happy!!!

Super Disappointed. We try to support local and order in occasionally while we are both working from home. This was our first time trying El Tenampa. I ordered the Street Tacos & request no beans, and double rice. My order arrived with beans anyway. They also had not put a lid on the cup of hot sauce in the center. This caused the cup to spill over half the container. It was way too spicy for me and I couldn't eat any of the food drenched in it. Two of the avocados were more black than green and as I was separating out what could be salvaged I found a long black hair in one of the tacos. Sadly, I only got to enjoy a few bites of my $15 meal and the rest went in the trash.  My husband enjoyed his chicken enchiladas and the salsa was good.

The last repair I had done by someone else and unfortunately they weren't available, but FORTUNATELY Tyler was! Came right out and got us fixed up quick style. Definitely will do business again if the need arises... who says you can't have jobs done quick, fast AND reasonably priced? Thanks Tyler and A++!!

The absolute worst pizza and service ever.  So disappointed that a new local pizza place sucks sooo bad. I will never order a pizza from this place again.  Look at my reviews dont normally post negative reviews but this place.lied to my face and had the worst customer service that I experienced in this town.  I wont even go into the details but if you want a pizza here be prepared to wait 2 hours or more and they will tell you 5 minutes but 30 minutes later your pizza wont be ready.  Nothing special AT ALL.   Soooooooo bummmmmed

We hired this company for pest control with our franchise food business, and all was well until summer came. I now have continuous problems with flies outside the restaurant, and that leads to more inside than is acceptable. Vanguard came out an extra time recently to put out extra product to deal with this problem, and just days later it was worse. We called in again and the receptionist told us to wait a week and see how it is, never mind the fact that its in the contract that they are supposed to come out as needed for additional problems. Bad customer service, and thus far sub par work from this company, we will be looking for someone else to do this job.

Had a wonderful experience at M Vincé Nail Spa today! I got the signature spa pedicure + gel and it was amazing, definitely worth the price. The two artist that helped me NAILED my inspiration picture!

This place ALWAYS has a line! I have finally had the time and day where I was able to try this place for the first time. The standards were pretty high considering other customers around us were boasting about the place. The boyfriend and I have decided since ALL their sandwhiches sounded so good (even those I don't particularly like). We decided to be open minded and start trying every sandwich on the menu. I started at the top with the Reuben, and he started at the bottom with The Silver Duck. The place did not disappoint! And you can't beat the price $9.95 across the board! 
I will definitely be coming back.

Meridian Floral went above and beyond for my family today. My brother-in-law, a veteran, passed and I did an on-line order for flowers at 1:30pm and requested same-day delivery (they close at 4pm). Not two minutes passed before I received a call about my order. I planned to call them, since I knew I was asking a lot for same day delivery. The delivery person had left for the day, but returned so she could deliver my order. They added American flags to the arrangement in honor of his service. It was a beautiful arrangement of roses, Gerbera daisies, lilies and carnations. I couldn't be more grateful for their kindness and commitment to quality service. Thank you so much!

I usually have a good experience going to this location but this last time was not one of those times. I understand places are short staffed but this night they clearly weren't. There were 4
People in the back cooking and 3 or 4 people up front. They had no ice for the drinks, it took30 minutes for our food and when we got it the fries were cold, the buns were over toasted and hard. I was very disappointed.

Well, two attempts to get a burger cooked right that was okay the second time around.  The fires for a 'specialty fire restaurant' were soggy and under cooked.  It didn't appear to matter why type of potato or style fry as we had a variety between the 8 of us dining together.  Everything was just  par-cooked and not crisp.  

Also - staff was rude when approached about issues or desire to sample something before making an entire order (sauce) for a burger.  I'm glad this place is local to Boise, I won't have to rush back as the attitude plus poor food ruined the entire experience.

First time here and I really enjoyed it. The turkey burger was super good. The Bourgeois fries were really good. They were buttery and savory. The fries were cooked to perfection. I recommend the garlic aioli sauce!

The is a quick joint. You order at counter and the find a table. The space is huge and looks like it could get busy during lunch hour. The tacos are definitely not authentic Mexican tacos. The tortillas were hardly heated up and tasted like hard, cold corn. The meat was just so so and nothing to rave about. Over flavors were okay. The "spicy" habanero sauce is not spicy at all with no salsa like flavor. Next time I'll just skip and find a taco truck somewhere.

Worst customer service ever by owner Chris M. One of the tag line under History is, " We are customer based." Ha! Far from the truth. He spewed profanity and insults bordering on misogyny. All because I asked for a discount on an incomplete job.  The Titanium Package was $369 and for that price I expected everything to be spotless.  There were still cob webs left on the inside of my door.  Inner door panel and lower door pillars were crusted with dirt. A couple of the rims had brake residue. The exhaust tips were still black from soot. The  headliner still had stains in a couple of places.  Chris made a few attempts to clean it but was unsuccessful.  Given all the issues, it was not unreasonable to ask  if he could extend a discount, (I didn't give a percentage or a figure) but this unhinged him and went into a vitriolic rant and called me garbage and a moron, which made me very uncomfortable.
His conduct was very unprofessional, vile and downright intimidating.  Customer based indeed.  Oh, if you're from California, he hates you--he said as much during hate filled tirade.  Do not patronize Dynamic Detail.  You've been warned.
Loved this place! Went there for the first time tonight. Staff is amazing and fun!! Tumy did a great pedicure, love my toes.

My two sons and a friend went to Roaring Springs on Saturday, June 20. It was kind of a big deal, because at $30 a kid we don't go very often. In fact, we haven't been there for at least 3 years.

My 12 year old was insulted by a lifeguard in a serious way. Near the Endless River, he called out, "Hey, kid! Hey fat kid! Go to the other side!".

I called Roaring Springs. They told me they already knew of the incident, and had talked to all the staff that hadn't left from that shift. My son knows he was blond and wore a snapback. Unfortunately, that describes every male lifeguard at the park.

I suppose I'm supposed to be happy that she talked to her staff? The kids left the park because my kid was crying. I'm glad she's trying to make sure that it doesn't happen again, but that doesn't make it alright. The kids won't be going again - I can't afford it at $30 a person. I'm totally mad!
This place is innovative and fun. I just moved to Boise from a much larger city (a renowned foodie town) and *yawn*... so much of the same stuff. Boise Fry was fun, simple and affordable.

I have tried going to other places to get dip and they just don't last and the quality and smoothness doesn't compare to Ha's dip! Ha makes my dip last for 3 l+ weeks and nothing chips them. He actually preps the nails and takes really good care of the cuticle. I can only go here.

I'm with a group of 5 sitting at the bar top. There's a group of three sitting 10 seats down from us. The three bartenders have made their way to us once. We've repeatedly had to walk over to them to order drinks, get menus, and order food. Our drinks were made wrong and one of the staff came behind the bar while eating a hamburger. Overall terrible service
We ordered several types of tacos and we enjoyed them all.  The beef fajita taco was particularly good and the guacamole and salsa were great too.
The food is pretty over priced for the quantity, upon arriving the hostess greeted us and had an attitude. Heard good things about this restaurant... Sadly it wasn't up to par.
They did an amazing job for both of our fur babies! We will definitely be back every month! Our two labs are happy for the great service and so are we! Highly recommend!

Treat yo'Self here! My husband's gave me a gift certificate to get my nails and a pedi done for Christmas. It's locally owned and operated by a husband/wife team whom are also nail techs. I came in as walk in and they were able to fit me in by adjusting their next appointment for both services. I was exceptionally pleased. I didn't get anything too fancy just a regular pedi and a manicure with gel polish. The owner let me know if there was anything I wasn't happy with to let him know and he would immediately correct it. Now that's reassuring. 
The place has quite the conversation that leads to great entertainment and staff were very friendly and personable. I definitely will be back for future services!
Pretty good food, and big portions. Visited this location twice now and slightly dissatisfied in the second visit. Waitress forgot an item I wanted twice! Will return just not anytime soon.

Was told my refrigerator trim package was in after waiting a yr to get it so drove to their Nampa store where I was told it was only to have them say they know nothing.Tried to call sales person Tisha but of course she couldn't be disturbed even though I pleaded with the operator.
EXTREMELY POOR CUSTOMER SERVICE

This is my family's "go to" donut place. Their donuts are super yummy. I'm obsessed their donut holes. My kids love the sprinkle donuts. My husband loves the maple bars. The staff is friendly and the donut shop is clean. Do beware of the one-way street in Meridian- I almost turned into one way traffic- my fault! The doughnuts are worth the drive for us.
Grants is a great restaurant with quality food and a 'family style' staff. Hope that everyone continues to support them. :)
Amazing service! Our server Lindsay was so amazing and recommended the best additions to my burger so it being my first time! Also the veggie burger was the BEST I've ever had!!

Even though it's the age of the phone, I still like having my watch. I hadn't worn it in years because the battery died, and I hadn't found the time to replace it. I put my watch in the car on the off chance I found a place to fix it. After getting my hair cut today, I did a search for watch repair and was surprised to find out all I needed to do was to walk across the street! The owner was busy when I got there but he didn't hesitate to work me in since I don't live nearby. Ten minutes later and after a nice talk about the Midwest, where we were both born, I was walking out with a functional watch after paying a very fair price. Highly recommend!

I was looking to purchase a boat so I applied at CapEd online to get a pre approval before shopping.  The online application is very short and easy but also very incomplete.  After a couple requests for additional information and no sense that a loan pre approval was pending I switch to a different lender that approved my loan over the phone and would ACH the funds to my checking account the same afternoon.  The interest rate at the new lender was also at least 1.2 percent less than quoted on the CapEd website.  I am not going to try to figure out if the problem is a lack of experience with the loan officer or a general lack of responsiveness with CapEd.  Just don't expect fast service.

I was so happy with the quality of service and the measures taken by staff to ensure our health during these uncertain times. It was nice to take a moment for ourselves and relax, and we could not have chose a better nail salon. The interior is so luxurious and also comfortable. Kim, my nail tech, was easy to talk to and was the reason I tried dip powder this time. She explained everything she did, since I had never had it done before, and even recommended the color I ended up loving! Definitely recommend coming here with a girlfriend or two, especially when they can start serving mimosas!!

This is my go to hotel when in Boise.  Unfortunately, it seems to have gone downhill. When you travel frequently, you just want a place to rest and help you prep for the next day of business.  This did not occur here. From the start there were issues. 

No acknowledgement for my Hilton status or for welcoming me back to their hotel. I guess I am just used to Hilton hotels being appreciative of their frequent guests.

Elevator out of order is understandable, but no indication from front desk when I checked in that it was out of order and where to find the secondary elevator.

Noise in the hallways.  Called about 10pm to front desk because there was a man, a woman and two children standing outside of their room in the hallway.  I called down to front desk about the noise and if they could send someone up to ask them to be quiet.  The front desk girl said she would take care of it.  40 minutes later, there were still out in the hallway talking loudly and walking up and down the hallway.  No one ever came to talk to them.  Also, it smelled like they were smoking in their room and trying to blow the smoke out the window.

Shower handle not working.  I had a meeting at 8am, and was getting in the shower about 6:30am.  I tried to turn on the water, but the handle just spun around loosely.  The water would not turn on.  I tried pushing and pulling on the handle, but nothing worked.  After about 20 mins of doing this I called the front desk to move me to another room so that I could shower.  Unfortunately, no one picked up the phone.  I called a total of three times but no one picked up the phone.  I started to use the sink and a towel to wash up, but realized this was going to take longer than expected and I was going to be late for my customer meeting.  I had to call my customer and change my meeting to later in the day.  I after I spoke with my customer, I gave the shower handle one more try.  I put my weight into it and was able to force the valve to catch and turn.  So I did eventually take a shower.

I came down and spoke with a young lady working the front desk.  She was not at the desk.  I had to start makeing noise for her to come from the back room.  I explained the issues.  She did not apologize.  She just said she can give me some points.  But that she would need to talk with the manager.  She said she would call me after she spoke with her manager.  She wrote something on a pad with cell phone number.  I never got a call.

One star for the comfortable bed.  One star for being convenient and close to my customer.  Not sure I will return to this Hilton location.

The best sandwich I ever had!  I usually get them to go.  There's not much seating.  The staff is helpful and friendly.  The sandwiches cost more than some other places but they're worth it because they're that good.

I take walmart for what it is. Cheap and easy. And as long as the store is clean and the shelves are stocked then I am happy I don't go for the excellent customer service or the employees knowledge of a product. I go there cause I can get 99% of everything I need in 1 trip. Yes sometimes u have to wait a bit to check out cause they have 2 checklanes open but I go into it expecting this so it doesn't bother me. This is one of Wal-Mart's smaller format store so it's more condensed and I feel cleaner and nice and easier to get around. They had everything I needed and it's always good to.swing thru the clearance section cause u never know what u can find... another positive shopping experience

I went and had my conch done today. I've had many piercings done before but NO ONE like Dan.  Hands down the best piercer I've ever had. He took his time and made sure I felt 100% comfortable. The price was well worth it. I'll be back. Also, the lady up front was AWESOME! She was so helpful when it came to picking out my jewelry for my ear. 

Thank you all!

The two large orders of mexi fries and cheese sauce were not in our bag so we tried to call but no one answered the phone so I went back in and they said I was lying that the mexi fries were put into the bag. I lost my cool after being called a liar. I asked for my money back they said I would have to come back Monday I said bullshit I want my money or the fucking mexi fries right now that I wasn't leaving until I got one of those options so they finally gave me my money back but damn to be called a liar by a bunch of stupid kids that can't do their job is not something I am going to take. Bad customer service, I do not recommend this place at all.

Yuki Was absolutely AMAZING!!! I came in with horrible nails from a different place and she fixed them so well and asked me what i wanted. She was so sweet and i will definitely be coming back. The whole environment was comfortable and everyone was so nice. Thank you!!!! my nails look beautiful now!!
Delicious and the staff was very nice. The pizza is some of my favorite in Idaho. It's not super greasy and the portions are nice sized! It's not bad on price either!
they used to be great - now they arre too big.  their mortgage rates are not competitive and they get immediatley sold to  new lender.

Overcharged. They charged me for a larger plate which I did not request. The order is no different from the smaller lunch plate. I tried to call but they won't answer and not able to return due to work...

Bill is an honest profesional who does exceptional work. I took a keepsake (watch) of great personal value in for repair. When it's time to replace the battery or something is wrong, I get all sorts of anxious because I know my watch is difficult to do any repairs on. Mainstream jewellery, watch stores and small repair stores have been unable to perform any maintenance/repairs (not that they didn't try. I often saw them sweating as they tried hard to even get it open but to no avail). Bill, was able to do everything needed in an incredibly timely manner. After notifying me that he had completed the services on my watch, he took the time to explain/break down what had been done. He's friendly, his work is quality and he's very efficient, exactly as written on his business card. I highly recommend him!

Debra Hicks
I found jeppesen law to be very organized and efficient. Very casual no stress environment. Justin was very thorough asking questions what I wanted in my trust. Flat fee which is nice no nickel and dimeing the client. Keeps you informed about progress. My trust came in a very nice binder with tabs no thumbing through pages trying to find something. Will definitely use Justin for all attorney needs.
I have received great treatment. I went in for 1 mole thing on my arm and they looked me over and found another spot of concern. Whew. Fast results so not having to wait weeks.

So we stopped tonight at The Habit.  Smelled AH-MAZING  as soon as we walked in.  But it was so crowded, the area from the door to counter were the line was, was very small.  We had to wait up against the doors.  The decor was nice and pretty trendy.  Very zen meditative ish.  But seating was VERY limited.  We gave our order and found a place to sit.  It was a bench that was against the wall with 3 very small tables, each with an opposing chair.   Obviously 3 sitting areas, for 3 couples.  You also had to step up to get into the seat or bench....making it a little bit of an effort if you are vertically challanged.  Anyway, we choose one of the corner bench, table, chair, arrangements and wait for our food.  While waiting a family of 3 comes in and chooses to sit right next to us.  The husband, a very VERY large man is directed to squeeze himself onto the bench next to me while his wife attempts to wedge herself in on the other side.  In doing so, this very large man practically sits on my lap.  

Now....we get our food, which was delicious.  But now we are ready to leave and of course, the stranger who had previously given me the worst  lap dance ever, makes no attempt to stand up, to allow me to exit gracefully.  So, I stand up and climb over him, apologizing excesively, while I try not to fall on my face. 

While the food was delicious, the seating really left a lot to be desired and I just don't like sharing my dining experiences that closely with strangers.  I feel like had they not had that middle table, this would not have been an issue.  

I had the Santa Barbara burger, my husband had the Teriyaki Char and we got the Mushroom Char to go for our son.  We will eat here again, but we will more than likely get it to go.  I feel like eating in my car, in the 17° weather would most definitely,  been more enjoyable than what I just experienced.

We ran into Boise Fry Co to grab some food to take over to Growler Guys where we were hanging out for the night.  I really like Boise Fry Co because of the quality of the food, clean facility and friendly service.  If you love French fries this is your spot!  Soooo many choices it's hard to decide.  They made it easy for me this time because they were out of my fave sweet potato fries.  I wasn't in the mood for meat so I ordered a grilled cheese with a large russet fry well done (crispy).  Once you've picked the type of potato you want then you pick the cut.  If that's not enough they also have a wide variety of dipping sauces and seasoning that you can add.  I put a little sea salt and rosemary garlic on mine.  My personal fave dipping sauces are garlic aioli and fry sauce.  I honestly enjoyed my grilled cheese so much that I may never go back to the cheeseburger.
Amazing sandwiches! My favorite is the triple chin w/ coleslaw on the side. One of my go to lunch spots!

If you're in Idaho nads can't make good fries you need to pack it in.
This place is really quite good.
Give the Bison Burger a try. I loved it.

While driving down 84 a rock flew up and put a pretty good size chip in my windshield which within a day or two began to crack so I called Tyler at A+ and he gave me a time when he could look at it.

At the agreed time Tyler and Chris, his dad, showed up and told me it could be repaired and proceeded to deal with my insurance co. and repaired the crack in no time. They even gave me a highly competitive price in the event I had to replace the windshield in the future. I might ad that it beat the glass co. my insurance recommended.

Bottom line is these guys are nice professional glass experts and  I can't believe you can do any better!

Splash and Dash in Meridian has a great staff and pampers our pers.
My dogkids always look great after a bath or grooming.
Such good food!  We have been here three times in the last two weeks and we keep thinking and craving their food.  Super high quality.  They do a great job!

Definitely the best Vietnamese food we've had in Boise, and our family is very picky about pho and such. The service is excellent and the place is nice. Oh and the bathroom is clean!! We will absolutely frequent this place!!

My wife,4year old and I went to grab lunch here. First let me start off with.... we have heard that this establishment has great food and service. I know they are just starting back open for regular business post pandemic, but there is no excuse for the filth. There is food everywhere on the floor, I went to take my 4 year old daughter to the restroom and I was afraid to touch the door. Now let's get started on the food. Our order was incorrect and when brought to the attention of an employee they said" well sorry I don't know" they then walked away. I took one bite of the chicken salad sandwich and did not carry on. I won't get in to how it tasted even though it was not great I want to focus on the fact that we were so grossed out by the lack of pride and cleanliness of the establishment and lack of pride in the good looking literally thrown together we did not finish our meal and left despite the high cost of poor food.

Yeah so, you know how in a relationship it's the little things that matter the most? Well let's act like me and dickeys are in a relationship. That said you guys couldn't even do the little things and it was ABSOLUTELY TRAGIC. 

I'm not a Karen, I'm not a 50 yo Bob. I'm a 24 year old person who knows that fast food quality and restaurant quality is absolutely different. I understand you can't have the highest expectations. If every business around here operated as this dickeys does then the quality of food would be that of a 3rd world country during drought season. Absolute trash.


So, first thing. We've come here a few times and there is always something missed. Sometimes the toppings of a sandwich, other times it's entire sides. That happens all the time and it just happened again. 

Secondly, they wrapped the sandwich as lightly as possible, only closed on one side, and put it upside down so everything fell out of the back even before putting the bag down on the passenger seat. The kids meal was given to us upside down and mashed everywhere. 

3rd the meat in the kids meal was literally fat and joints. Like I get it you guys aren't an actual bbq place but Fuck trim some fat sometimes???

Fourthly, this is the second time they didn't even toast the buns or whatever the heck the machine does. It was a stale, hard, rubbery piece of bread with COLD AS THE GATES OF HELHEIM MEAT. Why. Why is the meat cold. You guys keep it in a warmer. You literallyCool it for hours. Do you place it underneath an industrial fan before you give it to people now? Did you get sued for burning someone's mouth with hot meat? Is your boss afraid of temps over 43°?? Please help me understand


Lastly, I would like to break up with dickeys because they are the worst boyfriend ever and as you can see above, can't even manage the little things. And no, you're not getting your jacket back.

Our family loves Pho and I'm pretty sure we've tried most of them and this place is hands down the best broth I've had!! They don't have chicken pho on the menu but we ask for it and they put the chicken in the reg broth and it's so good!! We've already been back again in a weeks time
Great service meh food! They need a diaper changing table in the bathroom... that made things very difficult :(

Wow. Blown away at How delicious this place is. I ordered the Hugo and a side of the best fries I ever had. I bet you never knew fries could melt in your mouth...I sure didn't either until today.
It was my first time here today, and I stopped in based off the craving for a sandwich, a small jingle in my pocket, and it's stellar reviews. I mentioned that it was my first time here and even those in line behind me had to chime in with their very stellar thoughts of the food here. It did not disappoint, the food is of high quality and so is the customer service. Keep it up!!
We loved this place and loved A-Aron. He was the bestest. Couldn't have asked for better for service for like 16 of us! I would soooo go again!
Wide variety and good price for what you get! Tacos are full of meat and breakfast tacos are flavorful as well. I will be a regular here

Great nail salon! They can accommodate big groups and the spa itself is quite glamorous. If there is a chip or you just don't like something they fix it free of charge. I have been going their routinely for almost the past year now. Affordable and great service.  Highly recommend!

Thought we'd try out Grants about 8pm on a Friday evening and found all the tables taken and one was reserved, so we sat at the bar. We were kept entertained while selecting our drinks and menu items for dinner. Food was very good, but a bit on the salty side. For the two of us we spent double what we normally do when we go out, but were splurging since my Wife started a new job and we learned the bar and table tops came out of the old 8th Street Cafe' Ole' which we were fond of and really miss. Heard they are going to upgrade the outdoor area to double the size, so they don't have to turn as many people away, since more folks are finding Grants! Recommend trying, and yes we'll be back again...

I had my suv detailed here recently and was truly disappointed. Read all the great reviews at the time (since have seen some negative ones) and decided I would schedule my appointment. I was told what time to return to pick up my suv and when I got there it was incomplete and they wanted to leave it at that! The owner was rude, don't know if he was having a bad day or what but as a business owner that's just not how you treat people especially if you want return business no matter where someone is from or their race. I might not have been born in Idaho but have lived here almost 20 years, and have never been treated like I didn't belong before this joker. Won't return and will pass the word along to family, friends and neighbors!

I've been coming to Fat Guys for several years. This is by far the best deli in the Boise area. Everything is made with love. My favorite sandwich is the Bleu Bronco. The potato salad is amazing as well.

Not sure what was going on with our female server, but she avoided us at all cost, another server brought our food, another server had to bring us condiments, we finally stopped our female server for water and she never brought it, so we had to as another server.  We never got our check, we had to ask the hostess to ask our server for our check, and she was very cold to us.  I would of enjoyed the food, but the service wrecked it.

Ahh...RATS!  Three windshield chips on a recent road trip.  AHH...SOME!  Tyler's professional responsiveness and top notch quality work in making the repairs. He brings his service van to you so you don't even have to leave home to get the work done.  Also while our insurance would have paid for these repairs the price to have all three chips fixed was so low that we simply paid cash for the work.  As icing on the proverbial cake, Tyler is the nicest man.  At his business description on this Yelp page he writes:  "At A+ Chip Repair & Windshield Replacement it is our goal to be your first and only choice for auto glass replacement and windshield repair..."  Tyler sure has secured our customer loyalty forever.

They have surpassed EVER hope I ever had for a dental office.  I have FINALLY found a place that has all the technology to make my visit comfortable.  I have been terrified of the dentist my whole life (like has to be sedated) and now that I have found MaCrae- I don't even stress about coming.  I'm telling you- this is the ONLY place to come. The hygienists are also- AMAZING.  Every one of them. LOVE LOVE LOVE.

I wish I could give this place a 0. The Dentist seems to only hire "hot, young" girls who don't really know what they are doing. Let's face it.. the staff sucks. They don't have any patient care and make you feel stupid for asking any type of question. 

This is the last place on earth that I would recommend to anyone seeking dental care.

I feel that all we are (as patients) is a dollar sign. 

Absolutely no care from this office.

I don't like how this company treats their employees.  They go through drivers continuously.  I have personally spoke with the owner about their rates always going up and the man was very unprofessional by screaming "If you don't like it call someone else".  I was just trying to confirm that I was charged properly cause it was much more than before.  Perhaps he shouldn't be in a customer service business if he can't keep his cool long enough to answer questions.

With two young girls, we frequent Claire's at least once a month. I don't usually mind it as it's a bit like walking down memory lane. I remember the magic of being a young girl shopping in Claire's. All the glitter! What I do have an issue with is the lazy staff and complete disarray that I found the store to be in. For starters, if three people are in the store, it becomes crowded. It's very compact in there. This is made worse by crap all over the floor. Cramped in by the scrunchies, one staff member standing right behind me to restock them, refusing to step out of my way so I can move. I got a huff and an eyeroll and that was about it for me. I made a comment that the store was a shithole and we left. Count yourselves lucky that my kids didn't fall and hurt themselves in your store.

My coworkers recommended this place to me multiple times so I was excited to try it. 


.....I'll never listen to them again.

It's looks so good but it was soooooo bland. I got about 6 different tacos and some queso. Every taco was just bland or seemed off to me. The queso was kinda cold and chunky.

I couldn't for the life of me figure out why my coworkers would recommend this, but then I remembered they boil hotdogs....

We are long time customers. Sometimes food has been a bit inconsistent, but usually pretty good option for fast food. However, must give a low rating for their consistent decline in quality, esp over the past couple of months. 

Out if the last 4 visits, twice they were out of certain menu items. And a mistake in our order each time - some small such as no napkins, no fortune cookies (a big deal for the kids), no sweet&sour sauce for the spring rolls that I specifically requested.

Some bigger problems. Twice got the wrong side dish.

And I don't understand why they always ask if you want the terriyaki sauce on the chicken or on the side. They're going to do it whichever way they want anyway. 

Decided to try it last night (honestly we like a couple of their items very much) but it was the worst.

Young woman taking our order talked so fast that no one in our car could understand her. Long line of cars stacking up behind us, so very inefficient service to have to keep asking her to repeat herself.

At the window, I've learned to remind them for my sauce. Sure enough, cashier scurried back to grab the rest of our order.

Got home and found no napkins, one wrong side dish (which was repeated back to me correctly when I ordered).   And an unappetizing mess in the middle of my orange chicken, a dab of mushed food that appeared to be beef and a chewed-up looking green bean (neither of which were ingredients in my order. 

Nastiestest part? When I picked out the beef/bean glop, I discovered a 1 1/2 inch piece of hair. My order went in the trash. Being I'm inclined to drive back to the restaurant in 5 p.m. traffic, have simply decided not to return. Last straw (or should I say hair?).

Dr Hanson and staff were excellent. I was visiting my daughter up here in Idaho from California and I lost the cap to my back molar. We called the dr on Monday morning they got me in by 8 the next morning. I couldn't be happier.
Of all the Zamzow's, the Eagle location is my favorite.   Love the guy from Brooklyn.

We have been bringing our Toy poodle Gus here for months now and I can't say enough good about this place. Gus is being snuggled and loved on EVERY SINGLE TIME we pick him up.  

We have him on the monthly bath plan and weather we bring him in 2 times a month or 2 times a week they are always excited to see him and have never made us feel like we bring him in too much :-)  

WE LOVE SPLASH & DASH!

Our experience with this company would suggest that you avoid doing business with "A Moving Company" of Meridian Idaho if you care about damage to your property.  We were told that their insurance covered our move and it did not.  We submitted a detailed list and pictures of much damage to furniture, antiques included, and a broken, flatscreen television. The movers were not careful and did not wrap our furniture in blankets as promised.  We have moved many times and never experienced this kind of damage and breakage.  It has been 2 months since we submitted the claim. No remuneration and the response was a final denial of all claims.  Avoid "A Moving Company" for your moving needs.
Clean, beautiful spa. The lady who helped me was so friendly. My toes have lasted about a month!

I want to say thank you so much for making my morning awesome! I just got off of the graveyard shift, heard on KBOI you were giving away breakfast burritos.  I was tired and hungry...drove slightly over the speed limit to see if anywhere left.  OMGOSH! Best breakfast burrito and salsa I've ever had.  Plus your staff was super sweet! Thank you Chef Wally!!!
Once again giving A+ Chip Repair 5 stars. Tyler was very prompt and friendly. He came out same day and the insurance process was a breeze. Highly recommend to anyone needing glass repair!

The kids were so excited to come. Getting into the park was fine. Once inside we waited in line to get on the slide for a half an hour to find out that they were closing it because not all employees showed up to work. So not many slides were open which caused longer lines on all the slides that were. Paid $190 for our family of five and only could go down 4 slides until we were finally tired of waiting in lines and left. Would not come again.

More than horrible service. Went in about 843 pm right after we finished dinner a few buildings up in the same plaza. Looked at the pets found what we were looking for. Went over cages and stuff. Was finally ready to ask for the hamsters qe decided on, to be interrupted and told actually we are closed and you can come back tomorrow. -.-  No sorry. Absolutley rude, spoke over me, and let me pick out cages to say oops. We did the till justnow. Absolutley no accountability to their job. One lady when asked a question forced my husband to speak to the expert, who talked for 10 minutes. If I had wanted to be rude and interrupt her back, we probably could have gotten what we came for? No we wont be back in the morning. Horrendous service. Lost my business for life. 
Sad. I really wanted that hamster. But with business practice liek that, he is probably not well taken care of. I'll find a petshop thats not about the 901pm theory. After I've been shopping for 20 minutes and super patient about getting information and opinions I did not ask for.

Great service and amazing food!!! That should sum up how good this place is. As a lover of Asian cuisine, I would recommend this place a hundred times over. You like spicy, they got it! You like ethnic food, well here you go! Amazing, and I literally just had it earlier today. The waitresses were extremely friendly and tended to what we needed when we had asked. Since my family and I had gone there for our first time, we all ate different meals. Keep in mind, even if you love spicy food, Asian spices are extremely different than any others. And its my absolute favorite. Mild and medium spice is what we had ordered because I knew that none of us would be able to eat something that was "hot" spicy. But still, amazing!!! No complaints whatsoever. And I would definitely go here more often.

went in to grab lunch , was told to sit anywhere.  no direction in regards you have to get up and go place your own order with the bartender for food .  they won't even bring you water . very poor service , at least have someone give a small heads up on your ordering procedure ...
I absolutely love this salon.  They do great work and they are funny!  Guarantee you leave there in a good mood and happy.

Today I was shopping at Heritage Reflections and my 3 month old started getting fussy and loud. I walked outside to try to avoid annoying anyone in the store while I calmed him down. A sweet worker quickly came outside and told me "we don't mind if he cries in here, that's what babies do!" 
It was a very sweet, kind, and encouraging gesture. I love shopping at places that care about their customers and the overall experience more than just making money. 
Plus their selection of home decor and related items is impressive! Quality items to match a wide range of styles and very affordable. I'll definitely return often and tell my friends!

IF YOUR COMING HERE FOR EXTENSIONS LOOK ELSEWHERE! I never want someone to experience what my appointment and aftermath was with them. I needed a simple move up on my hand tied extensions. I was there from 11am 5:30pm. Way to long to be in a salon chair for a client not receiving a color or cut. Ive never had a move up take longer than 3 hours. I was trying to be polite throughout the entire appointment. But I got really uncomfortable when she continued to use superglue on some of wefts. Fast forward to now, I currently feel like I have a bunch of clip in extensions all in the back of my head. The ends she used the superglue on are popping out of my sides. My hair feels so uncomfortable and it's VERY noticeable that I have a weave in. I can't even wear a pony tail without them popping out. The whole purpose of hand tied extensions are to be hidden and comfortable. The results they give you are so bulky and apparent, it was a lazy job done that took all day. Go to The Processing  Bar in Meridian if you want your extensions done right and seamlessly, because you will not get that here

Love this place. They do an awesome job. 
No one else touches my yorkie dog. Very friendly staff. They also have fun treats and toys for my sweety. She loves going to her spa treatments.
Had my nails done by Taylor and she did an amazing job. Very precise yet quick! Loving my French manicure!! Definitely recommend her.
Super awesome! They have everything someone can enjoy. The number 1 Traditional is definitely my favorite!
Steelz is awesome! I shop there all the time. They have great deals and the staff is always very friendly and helpful.
Not what I wanted. Wanted a skin fade and lined up. She buzzed it and did not line me up. Would not recommend!!!

Dentists have always been a sore spot for me.  I had some bad childhood experiences regarding one, and those memories tend to not leave you.  :/  I found Dr. McRae a few years ago, and am SO thankful that I did! :) :) He has truly taken care of me and my family, in such a way that i've never experienced before!!!!  He is kind and very honoring with all of my concerns and requests, even if they seem to be not very "mainstream".  I feel so comfortable that when I go in there, he will actually "listen" to me and not just push me through as "another dollar another day."  His office has made going to the dentist fun for my kids!  Which is a word that I would never have used to describe walking into a dental office before.  ;) That is so important to me, considering I DO NOT want them growing up with the experiences that I had, and hating to take care of their teeth. Most importantly, being somebody that is passionate about taking care of our bodies the best natural way that we can, I feel that he addresses ways to remove toxins and bacteria in our mouths, in a safe manner!!  That was something I had been searching for repeatedly in the Treasure Valley.  Not to say no one else is out there, but it definitely seems few and far between.  My husband and I cannot value any more than what we do,  what we have established as far as a great dentist goes!!!  You most certainly will not regret trying Dr. McRae and his amazing staff out today.  It will be the last dentist you have to try ;)
Pretty good low cost pizza. $6 for a medium. Tasted better than dominos or Pizza Hut.

I called on a Friday afternoon for an appointment to get my septum pierced and they got me in within a couple hours. Process was fast, clean, comfortable, and well worth the money. The piercing cost $35 and my jewelry, a 16g silver captive ball hoop, cost $12. There was some swelling for the first couple days but no real complications, and it healed quickly. I'd definitely return for more piercings and I've already recommended Imperial to friends.

I have been to other restaurants during the covid pandemic. None have made me feel there was a problem and the were in danger of closing. 

Most restaurants are doing a great job of social distancing, closing down every other table to stay in line with a 50% capacity and doing other things to help.

The Ram though has taken this to an extreem. Their signs and staff say this is because they are trying to cut down on waste. I suspect the real reason though is that they are feeling the pinch from Covid. 

While I do understand this and sympathize, there are ways to cut back without looking like you are cutting back. There are ways to do things without creating issues for your customers.

Examples from The Ram of the wrong way. 

#1 The Ram does not have menus anymore. There are signs on the tables to go to the web site to see their menu. This is very inconvenient. I asked for a regular menu and they brought out a photocopied menu that was not printed well. 

#2 They did not have the normal napkins with silverware wrapped in them like normal restaurants do. The silverware was brought out in plain brown wrappers and both mine and my wives were dirty.

#3 When we got our bill, they would not take our credit card. We had to go onto to an app, enter out own credit card info and pay that way.

As for the food, I had a burger. The burger was fine, but overcooked and the bun was stale. My wife had a beef dip. The bun was stale and the meat was plenty, but I think it was packaged meat. Everything lacked flavor.

My take from this evenings meal at The Ram is that they are having financial problems and are cutting back in every way they can. While I understand this, they are going about this the wrong way. 

When the going gets tough, a business should doing thing better than the competition because there is less revenue to go around. For example, when I am looking for a restaurant to eat dinner at, and I have 2 choices. 

Restaurant A is going the extra mile even though times are tough to make sure they produce the best food, and give the best dining experience possible.

Restaurant B is also feeling a pinch, but it chooses to cut staff, cut food quality, and cut down on other things that create a poor dining experience.

Which Restaurant do you think will get our business?

Phillip

Food was not bad but the service was lacking.  Waited 10 minutes for someone to ask if I was ready to order.  No one came back to see if I needed anything Once I received my food.  4 waitresses working but only a few customers so there was no reason to not have good service. With all the room available they were seating people right next to each other.

We have been to the restaurant and the arcade with no problems. Tonight we went to the bowling lanes and ordered food off their menu and the food was horrible. We ordered the sampler platter, finger steaks, and the lettuce wraps. None of the food had any flavor. The sampler platter was so cold the cheese sticks had solidified. the finger steaks were over cooked and the chicken in the lettuce wraps seemed like it was boiled. We barely ate half the food. It was very disappointing. The service was great though. They offered to re-cook our orders but we knew that even if they made a fresh batch it still would taste like cheap frozen food.

Zero stars...worst customer service ever..manager Steven horrible...ordered to go..took my order home got nothing that I ordered, was told NO REFUNDS PER GENERAL MANAGER JULIE...have to dispute my credit card to get my money back.  Manager cut down the workers, admitted his employee was a slacker...my family was very good customers here..we will NEVER be returning..just beware..youre probably not gonna get a refund.

In shopping around for a place to repair my phone, I sent a message to Rockstar -- and received a very quick response. From the owner, no less!  Very upfront too. With that first impressive experience, I went in for the repair, and everything went exactly as described.  Price, time to repair, etc.  They found an issue with the phone, explained it to me, gave me options (which included doing nothing -- no pressure). I listened in as they helped other customers -- very practical, down to earth, and focused on getting problems solved, with minimal expense and hassle.  I also overheard the owner's handling of a person looking for work.  He was kind, gentle, gracious, but also let the kid know that RockStar hires people who already have experience or are at least on a complementary training track (school, tech training etc.)...which is great to know, as a customer.  I'll definitely go back to these guys if (gawd forbid!!) I need help with any devices.

Dayyyyyum! This place freaking rocks! It's kind of hard to find a good deli still in operation these days. I remember scouting downtown Boise for a good one, and while Main Street and Deli George were good, they don't match up to Hugo's one bit. 

My wonderful husband and I shared a turkey bacon avocado on sourdough bread ($7.99). I'm super glad we decided to split because it was huge! There was a good amount of turkey and bacon stuffed into the sandwich. And holy cow was it FRESH! In my opinion, quality trumps over quantity, meaning I'm more than happy to give up an overstuffed meat sandwich for one that's not so overflowing but made with fresh ingredients. The bread was also excellent! They use locally sourced ingredients, and for that I applaud them. You can buy full loaves of Zeppole bread from them. We took home a ginormous loaf of sourdough ($5.99) and have been happily devouring it every chance we get. 

The location is a little out of the way if you live anywhere beyond southwest BOI. It's located in an older strip mall right off he corner of Five Mike & Overland. But worth the trek, I guarantee! There is also a location off Fairview. 

I'll be looking forward to my next visit here! Not sure if I wanna branch out because the turkey bacon avo was soooo good! I'd recommend this to everyone in search of a great sandwich shop!
this was some of the worst food I've had in a long time. I would not eat here again if they paid me!

About 30+ kids came to this ihop after a school dance, and we were served wonderfully. They handled our last minute big party so graciously (including some fairly rude orders.) Our waitress Ashley was a saint and helped us so well. All in all, this was a great experience. Thank you Ashley and the fairview ihop.

Friendly service, high quality food and very clean restaurant/deli. We went right after lunch so the fries looked like they'd been sitting a while. But we just came for sandwiches so I was a bit glad they weren't a temptation. 
A few tables were outside and inside there was a lot of space between the tables. We got our sandwiches to go.
I got the Ruben, it was delicious. The marbled rye they use is very fresh and tasty. There were a few spots that got a little mushy on the way home, but we brought it back to Nampa so I'm not faulting them for that. And it didn't keep me from finishing the entire sandwich.

Had lunch there last week with my daughter. Pretty good!

I had bowl of pho, which was as big as it should be, with nice fresh sides. Tripe was not available, but I understand maybe it wouldn't be a good seller, so I had meatballs and beef. Daughter had a bahn mi, and we split some summer rolls. 

The Bahn mi wasn't as good as at Baguette Deli, but it was ok. For $%, a pretty good value. The rolls were decent...maybe a little too much lettuce. Pho was fine.

It's pretty average Vietnamese food, not as good as a lot of SoCal places, or Baguette Deli, but nice that it's close here in Meridian. Also service was friendly and quick.

If you're in Meridian and want Vietnamese, this will do it.

Are used to live in Garden Grove California which I believe is the second largest Vietnamese population in the world. We used to go out and eat pho all of the time and I have to say this beat every place I went to there.... If you'd like pho you have to check this place out.

I just moved to Idaho and i had my very first cup of Dutch Bros coffee and was amazed. The girl who helped us was extremely friendly and fun, and the coffee is AMAZING! I am glad i live across the street because this will be on my morning drive to work now!

Tidy, and friendly staff delicious empanadas. I enjoyed 3 different ones and will be back to try more. These are light and don't leave me feeling heavy even after eating 3. Satisfying lunch or snack anytime. So grateful to have some authentic Argentinian bites here!

We purchased an Amish dinning room set and 3 bar stools.  We are completely delighted with this furniture.  Granted, it was expensive, but the quality is amazing.  The furniture selection is done in the store.  You pick the kind of wood, the style, and the desired stain.  Then the order is placed and each piece is hand crafted by artisans who do amazing work!  But you must be patient for the order because it takes time to put together the quality furniture.  And the wait is so worth it.  Our dinning room set matches our home perfectly.  It arrived in perfect shape, without a scratch!  This furniture will last generations.  And it is gorgeous!

Roaring Springs has cones in their parking lot and NO video cameras, so when damage occurred to my car, all they had to say was "it's not our fault someone may have tossed a PLASTIC cone at your car" be careful leaving your vehicle in their parking lot!

Hired Gabriel to do a job as I had known him for a few years now. He came out to my house and my wife and I explained the job we wanted him to do which was a walkway from the driveway into the backyard. We asked him for a soft curve so we can take out garbage cans out. I come out after he is finished to realize that he didn't do anything we asked. The reason? He forgot to write down anything we told him to do. So instead of asking he apparently just guessed. We asked for a soft curve, he gave us a right angle. We ask for it to be long enough to line up to the slab in the backyard and it was obviously short. The cherry on top is that they also cut the wires to our sprinkler system so none of the ones in the front of the house would turn on. So they cut the wires, failed to repair them then he asks me why I didn't call the very people who failed to do it properly the first time to come repair it with a giant slab of concrete on top. I had a more competent landscaper do it because I wanted it fixed properly. I mentioned how much I paid and he said that he would only reimburse a fraction of what I paid if I could prove it was his fault. What was most disappointing of all is he never apologized for screwing up. He did not do what we asked and he broke our sprinkler system and he never bothered to apologize.  This is the type of person you are dealing with. You have been warned.

Tyler did a great job replacing my windshield today, short notice and professionally. He came to my work, was no nonsense and got my on my way with a beautifully looking clear windshield. I'd recommend him to anyone in the area. Great job!
Really good local Mexican restaurant with extensive menu.  Fast, very friendly service and great food!  What more do you need; right?

Fun, family, and friendly! Lots to do for all ages. The food is good and reasonably priced for a theme park. Get there early if you want to claim a lounge chair. Plenty of shade and ice water is free if you bring your own container!

This is my first negative review in my life. It took me over one and a half year to finally decide to post it. Dr. Wade Pilling was recommended to me by my best friend who also happened to be part of Dr. Pilling's family. I think that people should know about my experience with Dr. Piling. If I knew what I know now, I would never let him even touch my teeth. Everything what he did, wasn't right. The implant, the crowns, etc. The gum edges where the implant was inserted are not even and very bumpy. In one of the bump I could see and feel something white. When I brought to his attention, he blamed the previous dentist who extracted the tooth. He said that this is a tiny part of the tooth and at some point it should come out. When I asked to remove it, Dr. Pilling requested additional $250.00. At this point after paying over $8,000.00 for the procedures, I felt that he should just remove it to show that he cares. Well since this wasn't the worst experience and since the implant was not in the front, I just let it go.

I wish I just stopped there!

Well, next thing that Dr. Pilling did was a crown and after that nothing was right in my mouth. The tooth/gum had been hurting ever since when I try to eat on this side. I went back two or three times and Dr. Piling tried to adjust my bite by shaving the lower tooth. It seems that this is his "go-to" technique as mentioned in previous reviews. After that my lower tooth became very sensitive to anything and the original problem wasn't fixed. I still couldn't bite on this side. When I went back, Dr. Piling informed me that I probably would need a root canal of this tooth. He also informed me that he doesn't perform root canals. I questioned him as why did he put a crown on the tooth that needed a root canal. He said that's no big deal because the specialist can make a small hole in the crown. In the meantime, my insurance expired and I was paying everything out of my packet even the root canal. I was informed that the root canal procedure costs $1,200 but the specialist said that he would try to do something else and see if this would help. I paid something around $250 (I don't remember exactly), and it didn't help.
I have been so unhappy with Dr. Pilling's work but I think it hurts more that he didn't care. He never apologized for his less than mediocre work that had been causing my pain ever since. He never showed any compassion. He never offered to lower the cost of the crown that he messed up and wasn't able to fix.
On many occasions I discussed the situation with him and then Aubrey. It seems to me that they are very quick to take your money but if something goes wrong, they are not willing/not able to help. This is my opinion.

Fast forward to today. 
I moved to another area and finally found a dentist who not only is skilled but cares. I scheduled an app but in the meantime I experienced a horrible pain affecting the same tooth that Dr. Piling worked on. Finally, it was determined that I have an infection and root canal was performed in an emergency situation. Today, finally I am free of pain after what seems like forever.

I would never recommend Dr. Piling to anybody!!! I would not like anybody to go through such experience and pain.

The only good thing that I experienced in this office was their hygienist. If I were to write a review for her, she would get 5 stars!

I am posting this review for other people to research and check, and double check before making decisions.

They had made the floral arrangements for my father's funeral and did such a great job within a couple of days. They turned out beautiful and the quality was top notch. Great customer service with a special shout out to Samantha for helping us out!

I completely understand that most restaurants during this pandemic are understaffed and service as expected will be slower, our server did let us know the kitchen was running behind however the servers service was beyond horrible. Every single table around us was filthy dirty, our server was not polite. My daughter never got her drink my husband asked three times for creamer before he finally got up and got it himself. The eggs on my sons plate were wrong as well as the meat side
He ordered. We had no utensils or napkins til I asked for them after the food was already at the table.
When my husband got up to get hot sauce he was scolded and then our server came back over to rudely say "I already told you the kitchen was slow". (The kitchen was not the issue) as she dropped the check off without even checking on us or us having a bite of the food yet. 
This place is a clown show.
Get it together ihop!

We were not impressed! Our water cups were  continuously empty. Our appetizer took forever to arrive at our table. Our waitress was to spread out and had a hard time getting to our table. I ordered a salad and it came with a crayon in it. When I showed the waitress she apologized and had a new one made and only comped $3 off the meal. Very disappointed! Will not be going back to this restaurant any times soon!

Marco's Pizza quietly opened last week in Meridian and I was looking forward to trying it. I had never heard of Marco's before, so I went online to look at their menu. While online I noticed that I had the option to place my order through their website. The ordering platform was very user friendly! It had different sections of the menu broken up by foods (pizza, sides, salads, etc) and also included a section for their current specials.  I ordered 2 Large Pepperoni Melt Pizza's ($10.99/each). Before I placed the order, I was given the option of registering as a customer or continuing as a guest. They offered 10% off my order if I registered on their page & verified my email. Their system allowed me to immediately sign up, verify my email, & use my 10% off discount.  That makes me very happy! I was also rewarded with an order of free cheese bread for signing up for their rewards program, again they immediately gave me the free bread.  The remainder of the ordering was super easy. They allow you to be very detailed in the customization of your pizza. They also give you an option of paying cash in the store, I have noticed other places not allowing that.  Once the order was placed an order tracker popped up and kept me in the loop for what was happening with our pizza. 
When I walked into Marco's I was cheerfully greeted by the employees working the front counter. I was very impressed by the decor, available seating, & the overall vibe.  I was helped by Alex. He was great! I believe that he was actually a manager. He was very helpful to customers who were unsure of what to order or who had menu questions. When my Pizza was brought to me they opened the boxes to show it to me. Alex then asked if I needed any cheese, peppers, or plates. Yes, please! It's such a nice touch when a pizza place gives you paper plates! Dinner with no dishes is always a good thing. 
The pizza was delicious! The dough was really nice and had the perfect amount of chew to it. This pizza was LOADED with cheese and pepperoni! I'm a total extra, extra cheese person and I thought it was perfect! The pepperoni was plentiful! I overheard someone saying that the large Pepperoni Melt has a total of 72 pepperoni's on it. Impressive! The 3 cheese blend that they use is wonderful, not at all tough, perfectly melty, & just a slight chew. I really liked this pizza and so did my entire family. 
Marco's is delicious and worth trying. They are open until 11 during the week and midnight on weekends & they offer delivery.

I am so very upset and frustrated with CapEd..tried to cash a check from an auto insurance company to buy a car and was denied cashing it because it was from an insurance company and they stated that insurance companies frequently issue bad checks and they would have to put a two week hold on it. I called the insurance company and they never had any financial institution do that before. I told the young credit union rep that I will lose out on buying the car I put a deposit on..she said I should have planned it better or get a different car...terrible response and even worse customer service.
Tried to speak to the branch manager but wasn't there..

Very. Friendly and Helpful!!! Bought several items and very happy with the service in the store and with the delivery team!!! I knew what I was looking for. Good quality and discount pricing for guest rooms. I got exactly what I needed and some extra items that were such s good price, I had to get them!  Warehouse look and pricing with excellent service!!! Thanks, Kelly! You all work hard to make your customers happy!!!

I have had three other colonoscopies at other facilities and I can say Idaho Gastroenterology is far the best I have been to. When I called to schedule my procedure I had a live person answer the phone and didn't have to leave a message and wait for a call back. They were pleasant and efficient getting the colonoscopy scheduled with my provider of choice Dr Bonnie Waite. Two days later I received all my instructions and info packet in the mail, along with the prep prescription that had been called into my pharmacy. Can you say really efficient! A couple days before my procedure I was able to check in online and the day before my procedure I got a call from their anesthesia staff, who discussed my health history. The day of my procedure I was greeted by a friendly smiling face at the meridian office check in procedure area. She made a big difference to help me remain calm. Shortly afterwards I met Steve my nurse. Steve was professional and efficient as he got me prepared for my procedure. He also had a warm blanket waiting for me once I was changed into the procedure gown. That one little act of kindness sure made a big difference. He was excellent getting my IV into place and all I felt was a tiny prick, barely noticeable. That had not been the same experience I had with my last colonoscopy, at another facility. Finally Dr Waite arrived and we had a quick chat before being taken to procedure room. Dr Waite was awesome and she made me feel like we were new friends. Once in the procedure room I met Jill and Nick. They both were very welcoming and made sure I was as comfortable as I could be. Now I'm embarrassed to admit there was another nurse in the room getting things ready for my procedure but I have forgotten her name. It wasn't  because she wasn't memorable but I'm gonna blame it on the good drugs Nick gave me sending me into my happy place for the remainder of the procedure. 
The next morning I even got a follow up call to make sure everything was going ok and I didn't have any questions or concerns. 

Idaho Gastroenterology staff are wonderful, efficient, compassionate and professional.  They all truley make having a colonoscopy less stressful and not a big deal at all. In five years I will be back again for my next one.

Pretty good pho, flat noodles were good as well. Been twice and service was good. The chicken rice plate was a small portion for the price. Food has always been good and the restaurant is clean. We will go back.
