I'm leaving there right now. I ask if I can use Apple Pay and nobody knows so I had to pay for my meal in advance to make sure I could pay. I order pancake and eggs and as the manager is walking by I am pulling a long hair out of the center of my pancake. The manager apologizes and runs back and gets me two new pancakes. I understand this type of stuff happens so no big deal he brings me two new pancakes and the pancakes crumble apart you could literally pull the pancake in half. It was liquid in the center and dark brown burnt on the outside. So now what?I paid for the meal in advance and I drove all the way from Eagle specifically for pancakes. This is a day ruined. I'm so pissed off right now!

I'm going to be real, I come to Boise too much. I stay at hotels in Boise too much. This is by far one of the better ones I've stayed at. 

First off, it's clean and the lobby is very inviting. I was taken care of right away. Check in was very easy. I explained to the front desk associate that I might need to extend a day, she told me it was no issue that they could accommodate that. 

When we got up to our room the door had a seal on it. I know it might not matter to some people but because of COVID, I like knowing my room is cleaned. 

The rooms are spacious, as are the bathrooms. It's quite. I don't know if that was because of where our room was at or what. But I seriously didn't even hear a door shut the entire time we were there. 

There is tons of parking so you're not fighting for a spot which is an issue at some hotels. 

The only reason I'm taking off a star is because they don't have trash cans anywhere in the hotel. Not a one. Near the elevators nothing. Their waste baskets in the room are so small and it annoyed me I couldn't throw my take out away anywhere but my room. 

Other than that, I'm sure we will stay here again.
Clean space, family business, authentic and fused options. This place is a real treat; whether you want a bite or a full plate, it's all tasty!

The only nail place I'll go to here in Boise! These guys are the best. If you're looking for a good nail place, these guys are California quality. No other place in Boise has met my standards, being a California native myself. Plus, they stay open late and are here everyday of the week- makes it so easy

We ordered Marco's again (after a bad experience) thru doordash.  The driver was super friendly.  The pizza was excellent as were the bread sticks.  We knew the previous order was an anomaly.  So glad we gave it another try as it's our favorite pizza.

Absolutely favorite sandwich shop. The fries are heavenly, the bread selection is sublime, and the staff is absolutely incredible. They are always so friendly and willing to help, even through all the stress of the pandemic. I wish I could be as friendly and optimistic as them.
Support local, support small businesses, especially this one!!

This place never disappoints. Make a reservation- especially since they aren't seating many. Their drinks are great, the food is even better. Their menu isn't huge but they don't need pages of dishes when literally everything on the menu is to die for. My friend got the salmon and I got the steak. We started with fried green beans but we devoured them before a photo could be taken. They even went out of their way to stuff a few olives with blue cheese for our martinis- easily one of the best smaller places in the entire valley- yup I said it

My kids and I are comfortable and relaxed during all of our appointments. The dentists, hygienists, and office assistants have been wonderful. Scheduling has been convenient. They always greet us with smiles, make us feel welcome, and are easy to chat with. I highly recommend this office regularly to my coworkers, family, and friends. They were especially great to help me out with an emergency during the Covid lockdown. They went above and beyond for me and made me feel important.

We tried this place for the first time the other day. The bagels flavors were good but were a bit rubbery. We also got coffee which was super good, my husband said it's better than some other coffee places we've gone.

Went out to celebrate the purchase of our home to be absolutely dissatisfied. First of all the options are next to none. The mozzarella sticks we ordered were basically barely nuked and the cheese was barely melted. The steak I ordered was overdone and "charred" which was disgusting. Left the taste of burnt food in my mouth. The waitress was the best part of the whole visit. I just wish she would have taken my steak off of our bill and kept it because it probably going to end up in the garbage when we get home because it still has the charred/burnt taste. Instead she took $3 off of a $18 item. We will NOT ever be returning..
They do an amazing job. The nail techs are all very friendly, everything is very clean and they guarantee their work.  Going above and beyond is just a normal day for them.

I was out of town and decided to come here since they have "Walk-ins Welcome". I went inside and asked what I wanted and told me to sit. Someone got me ready and filed my nails and another guy came to I guess to finish my nails. I had not picked my color yet and he was rushing me. I showed him what I wanted and he said we could not do that since there is no time. What the heck? Why didn't you tell me that from the beginning, I would have been fine with that. Bad service, do not recommend.

Garbage. All meat was cold. Shrimp taco had about 4 table spoon full of nasty orange suace that didn't let you taste anything else but the sauce. Go down the street to Del Taco you will save money and get better quality tacos.

This is kind of a small Walmart, but it's clean and seemed to be mostly stocked. They were COMPLETELY out of baking powder when I went, which is so odd. It's not prime baking season either, so it's perplexing. Other than that, it was a good place to shop.

The salon is beautiful and the staff are nice but not the best pedicure I've had.  For the cost it was a little bit of a let down. The massage was mediocre and the "mud mask" was just like a lotion they put in our legs with a hot towel. I went with two others girlfriends and when we went to pay, we were all charged different prices for the exact same pedicure. Seemed pretty dishonest.

Sandwiches are quite tasty and are pretty big and I haven't been here that often but the last two times I was less than impressed with the owner Wally. He seems annoyed if you don't know what you immediately want & frankly comes across as an A hole. This is 2nd time in a row that I've left disappointed at his demeanor. I get it that he might have been understaffed and under pressure but it doesn't give you the right to be short with your customers and act aggressively towards them. If you don't like people you're in the wrong business Wally.

I used to come here as a kiddo and I loved it. Something must have changed (probably my age) but when I went here a month or so ago the food was pricey for the taste. I did not think anything was bad but when I went to eat my leftovers I re-cooked everything because it did not have any spice (which I requested) and was very sweet. If I am every in the area I will consider trying it again but so far I have had better luck at Thai Cuisine on Overland (quite the drive if you live in Meridian though). Presentation here is excellent though!

Being an amateur watch guy I have made the mistake of allowing a Walmart employee to change the battery in one of my watches.  At Meridian Watch repair I only needed a replacement leather band for the stock nylon one my Seiko came with.  The service was excellent, price was fair, and the owner was very knowledgeable and patient with all of my questions about movements, various brands, features, and quality of watches.  This is where I will continue to take my business!

Went to The Counter this afternoon. Wait staff was polite and fast, not at all like the other reviewers have complained about. The atmosphere was fine and enjoyable. However, the burger was barely edible. I ordered the Korean BBQ Steak Sandwich. What came out looked and tasted delicious. However, it was nearly impossible to eat due to how tough and chewy the meat was. I was forced to deconstruct the sandwich in order to cut the steak with a knife. Still had to saw through the steak to eat it. My plate looked a complete massacre by the end. Fries tasted fine, but I think I got the tail end as there wasn't a single fry longer than 2 inches.

All in all not a great experience, but not horrible either. But because a burger and fries was almost $15 - I'm extra unforgiving.

I may return and order something different next time. But with so many great burger joints in the area, it's doubtful.
The service is not that great!  The server seemed overwhelmed!  They mixed up our order, and served  2 people food that was never ordered.  Might be great for lunch but not dinner on a Friday night!

I can't say enough about this nail shop!! I was soooooo pleased with everything they did. The pedi was soooo relaxing, the person who did it was so kind. My mani was so nice & relaxing as well. My designs are spot on. Before I left I already made another appt. My nails are 5 days old in the picture below. I had dip nails taken off & gel polish put on. So clean, so nice!
Delicious. Consistent.  Wonderful service and incredible food.  A long time favorite for our family.

I would have rated Dutch Bros. zero if I could.  I stopped by there on 10/19/19 to purchase some drinks and a gift card for my daughter.  However after charging my credit card for the gift card they informed me that their card machine was not working and then they informed my they could not provide me a credit at that time but look for it in the next 5 to 7 days.  As of the writing of this review still no credit.  I attempted to contact Dutch Bros. Corporate by both phone and email and even though they state someone will contact me withing 24 hours it's been 10+ days and still no response.

Dutch Bros. it is a simple as refunding my money.  You have my phone number and email address and to further assist you the purchase was on 10/19/19 (total purchase $60.00 was suppose to include a $50 Gift Card and I dealt with Aleana all of this was included in my 2 voicemail messages and my email)

I have never been to a Mexican restaurant that was so joyful. I called on a Saturday night to see what time they close and I could literally feel happiness over the phone. I know I sound crazy, but for real, the atmosphere at this place is unreal. 

Beautiful wood carvings, an 8 foot tall fountain at the entrance, music playing outside of the restaurant, stained glass and murals throughout, and potted plants growing all over the place. Sincere smiles on all of the employees. 

Best of all, the food! Portions were very generous and they kept our chips and salsa well stocked. So much flavor, from every aspect of the meal. 

I will definitely be back. Thanks for helping me find this place, Yelp!

I have listened to advertisements for Fat Guy's Fresh Deli on KBOI for a year plus. So visited Fat Guy's deli for lunch with my daughter. The taste did not meet the hype on the radio. Not bad, but not great. I run cattle in southern idaho and pass through Gooding Idaho often. The Shop in Gooding (a sub shop) has sandwiches and flavors that would be good for chef Wallt to try to incorporate. As is, I would rate Fat Guy's as a 6 and The Shop in Gooding as an 8.
Perfect spot to grab a delicious handmade empanada and a beer or a nice glass of Argentina wine. Highly recommend!

They were professional in sanitary practices as well as Covid protocol. They did nice job in nails as well. I purchase the pedicure that was 42. Can't remember what it was call. Good experience overall. Only thing negative when you book you aren't told cash only tips do,,,bring cash

I stopped in, was told that the wait would be 30-35 mins for pizza. So I ordered some winds and a pizza. Paid for both, waited on the wings, that took about 15 mins and then gave them my address and ask that they deliver the pizza to my home. It took about 35 minutes form the time I got home to get my pizza. Driver kept texting me that he was 7 mins away, then 7 minutes later he would text me he was 1 min away, then 5 minutes later he would text me again he was 5 mins away. i finally tracked him down and got my pizza. From the time I paid for my pizza until the time it was delivered, 1 hour.

The wings we just ok, the pizza middle of the road.

This place came highly recommended, and I love supporting innovative, local businesses, so I stopped in for lunch yesterday. I have to say, I was not disappointed. The food was absolutely top notch and the owner was friendly and very helpful. You can tell they love what they do and genuinely value their customers. 

The restaurant was clean and beautiful, but I opted to take my lunch to go, so they heated my empanadas in their convection oven (no microwaves) to a perfect, golden, flaky brown, which only took about 4 minutes. I left with hot empanadas, delicious sauce, and a new favorite spot for lunch. 

Planning to head there for dinner soon and try out some of the wine and beer pairings.

It was busy so the orders took awhile which was completely okay, but I spent my time waiting observing the cashier. She was incredibly rude to not just me but many different customers. She should not be the one interacting with people. Why go into customer service if you clearly hate it?
It would have been nice to know in advance that me order was going to take over an hour and a half . I wasn't told the order would take that long.

Super disappointing. My husband ordered sushi, sweet and sour pork, and chicken pad Thai for dinner last night. Our last time here his sweet and sour pork was all carrots but I was craving sushi and forgot, and suggested we get take out. After ordering my husband was told it would be twenty minutes. After almost an hour later, he was told the sushi bar was closed and was given these. It was like the kitchen had closed and we got whatever they could find. It would have been much better to have told us when the order was placed rather than having us wait and then pay for such a disappointing meal. My pad Thai was so dry I could barely eat a couple fork fulls of noodles. I didn't even attempt the chicken. Normally sweet and sour pork comes with deep fried pork. Unsure why my husband got this kind of pork? He was still hungry afterwards and disappointed too. We won't be back.

I previously had a bad experience. However, after contacting the company, Masir made it up to me. I love the Bison Burger. I also really enjoy the purple fries. I seem to usually have a great experience. When you order the Bison, get it with "the heat"

I hate to be a Karen. But the food is wayyy too expensive. It wasn't even served to us correctly. The park doesn't allow food in, which makes it so that you're forced to pay 15$ for a small basket of tater tots and a salad with barely any lettuce in it. We also ordered a combo that was supposed to be 12. We didn't even get out drink. I am thoroughly unimpressed. They need to up their game. The only good side are the rides.

Great deli resource. My sandwich was made quickly and tasted fresh with quality meat. The marble rye looked delicious but I chose the wheat roll since I was sharing the sandwich with someone who doesn't like rye. I liked the wheat roll, and the fact that you could add banana peppers (hoagie-style!). All in all, I was happy and would def go back again. Plus, the cheesecake looked extremely good.

This was our 2nd visit. Our first visit at least 6 months ago and we left disappointed. The bagel had no flavor and they didn't have sausage which is what we usually like on a bagel. We decided to come back again because people keep saying it's so good. Well... we will not be back! 

Husband and I got a simple bagel with cream cheese. And then we asked for an egg for our daughter. They charged us $2.17 for a freaking egg! Our bagels with cream cheese were $2.22 each. So I asked the one who rang us up and the manager why I paid $2.17 for an egg and they said because we added an egg to our order so they make one of the bagels an egg sandwich. Ok I don't care how you ring it up but $2.17 just to add an egg is absolutely ridiculous. 

Our bagels were ok. I got the onion bagel and it had zero flavor. My husband got an everything bagel and said it was ok. And my dad got a parmesan bagel with jalapeño cream cheese; he said it was good because the jalapeño added some flavor to it. All the bagels needed to be toasted longer. 

Our $2.17 egg was flavorless, thin and gross. Our 16 month old loves eggs and wouldn't even eat it. 

I'm not sure why everyone raves about this place but it has NOTHING on Einsteins which I wish there was more of then around here.

Our family loves Pho and I'm pretty sure we've tried most of them and this place is hands down the best broth I've had!! They don't have chicken pho on the menu but we ask for it and they put the chicken in the reg broth and it's so good!! We've already been back again in a weeks time.
Delicious Burgers and Fries! I got their Teriyaki Charburger and their sweet potato fries and they were super good! Definitely going there again! Can't wait to try more from them!

Grant's never disappoints. We picked up dinner for our family tonight and the Bleu Burger and Prime Rib dip were exceptional and so fresh. We love this local restaurant and will continue to support them, especially during this uncertain time.

I love this place! You MUST try it! I used to live in Argentina and the empanadas at The Empanada Club are 100% authentic and so delicious! My absolute favorite thing to order is the traditional beef empanda (#1) with chimichurri sauce. Don't forget to get the chimichurri sauce!!! I would say get 2 empanadas if you are pretty hungry and one if you're not super hungry.

This place is run by husband and wife, Cecilia and Thomas, and they did an amazing designing the interior. Cecilia got the ideas for the interior from café's in Buenos Aires and Thomas made her vision come to life and did most of the work on the interior himself. I know this because I chatted with them when I went there for the first time. They embody South American friendliness! 

Empanadas are baked, not fried, at The Empanada Club which is my preference although my husband prefers fried empanadas. 

Do not miss this gem!!!!

I called and made an appointment for 3pm. I left my name and phone number with the gentleman who answered my call. When I arrived for my appointment, I was told by the young lady that she could not find a reservation under my name or number. She could not find out who answered my call earlier that day, but just assumed it was someone who didn't know how to make appointments. Why would such a person answer the phone, is beyond me! Needless to say, I won't be going back. If you can't master the basics, such as booking an appointment, I'm not willing to see what else you can do!

This is one of our favorite places to hang out and sip a nice glass of wine. If they get the pork belly back on menu you HAVE to try it. It explodes with flavor and moist pork fat that can't be explained.

Fat Guys has abundant vegetarian and value options. Try a half a salad made how you like it with house dressing on the side.  Substitutions are not a problem.

I've had the sandwiches and they are good.  But salads are awesome here.  It's a working class salad, nothing fancy but it does not have to be.

Coke products. Monster in cans but they charge accordingly.

Soup is well salted it's true, but not bad. Certainly not worth losing a star over.

Come on in, park in the back.  Drive past the front door and take the furthest left to get behind the buildings.

Enjoy.
They greet your pet when you come in, they are kind and engaged.  They listen to you on your requests and do a wonderful job.
First time eating here.   Reuben and BLT, 1 fry 1 chip.  Out freaking standing Reuben!  OMG!  Quick.  Staff was great!  My new fav lunch spot!

Back in Boise after many years. Had to make a stop at an old favorite. Burgers are still great   Emily was our server, she's the "new kid" who's going to a great asset to the place when she's done with training

ADDED: (I read some other reviews after I wrote mine and I wanted to add that every staff member was wearing a mask while I was inside the place was impeccably clean they had hand sanitizer available I saw no flies and my food was not cold but just right when I got it! And as you'll see if you keep reading my review I'm in the restaurant industry I've had food poisoning three times and I would not eat here if I thought it was a danger to anyone) 

I want to preface this by full disclosure that I am in the restaurant industry and  also serve as a food and beverage consultant :-)

I had heard about this place from a friend and wanted to check it out on my last night in town. I checked the Yelp page and found out they closed at 10 PM and headed over around 845. Parking lot was empty but the open sign was on when I pulled up about 8:55 PM and saw four workers inside cleaning. When I walked in I was greeted by a friendly cashier! 

Sometimes when I walk into an empty restaurant towards the end of the night I see the staff give each other side looks kind of exchanging glances like why is this person making us work when we're almost closed but I got none of that here! In fact the staff was talking to each other and seemed very happy to all be working together. 

I ordered my food and as I was paying the girl asked me my name and jokingly I said you should just put my name down as solo because I'm the only one here. 

She said oh that's because we close in five minutes :-) she didn't say at me and she said it with a smile kind of trying to explain why there was no other customers. I felt terrible because obviously if someone in the business I would never walk in five minutes before a restaurant closed and expect to order food. I apologized profusely to her and explained that the yelp site said that they closed at 10 and she said they had adjusted hours because of Covid. I again explained I am so sorry it's OK you guys don't have to make my food. But another staff member chimed in at that time and said no problem! 

I have to say to whoever manages this restaurant I was so very impressed that these young people working here we're not upset at all by the fact that some dude walked in five minutes before closing and then of course when I looked over what they were doing they were cleaning and everything had already been cleaned and they had to make my food even though they were almost ready to go. I did give them a decent tip !

I also sat in the parking lot eating my food while I watch them working inside and I will say that they worked fast efficiently and they all looked very happy to be working here!  As an industry professional that is either good management good ownership or both :-) I don't know if they will see this review but to the crew that was working Monday, January 18 thank you for being so kind to me and for doing such a great job especially the girl at the cash register! 

Now onto the food I had fried chicken tacos and the ground beef taco and both were excellent I will definitely be back for more tacos and because of the stellar service I received thank you tin roof tacos!
Wonderful customer service, clean and follows Covid 19 protocols. And the food is absolutely amazing! Heathy and oh so good!!!!! I would give it 10 stars if I could

I broke my wristband on my watch. It was repaired at no charge. I encourage everybody to patronize this business. Even though my experience was short and uncomplicated, I could tell this is the place you want to go to for all watch repairs.

waited at grocery pickup for over an hour. when i kept seeing so many cars that arrived after me getting their groceries i tried being patient but ended up calling the grocery cust service. his response is "sorry weve had some incidents today. youre order is coming out." then walmart associate comes out and says nothing to me. i believe they just overlooked my order. If there were incidents then why did all the other individuals get there groceries as soon as they parked? I'd like to note, I wasn't late at all! My pickup time was 5pm, received my email my order was ready, checked in at 443pm, waited until 607 to call customer service, received my items at 616pm. 
At this walmart ive had soooo many issues using this service and will not be doing it again. it would have taken me under 1hr to just walk into the store to get it myself. with all the substitutions i have received that werent similar to what i originally ordered, 2 rude associate situations and now this over an hour wait with an order that was $46, im most definitely done using this "convient" grocery pick up. not worth it!

Gabriel and team did an awesome job on our side walkway. He was friendly, professional and his crew did a phenomenal job. They were here when they said they would be and worked until the job was done.

Thank you!!
Heather

Worse Experience of my whole life, if you read my review, please listen to me, Do NOT go to this place, I'm traumatized, first of all got there at 6:30 and left at 9pm to do the worse pedicure and acrylic I ever had, started with my feet, the girl was nice but unfortunately she doesn't know how to do a French nails, after very disappointed with my feet, I didn't know it could get even worse, the guy that did my acrylic nails, was so rude, and did a horrible job, ridiculous Expensive, $80 for my feet and $55 for my nails. Never again I go back to this place.

Angela did a wonderful job with a flower arrangement I needed to be delivered to a client who lost their mother. I ordered at 11 am and she had a it ready and delivered in a few hours. She communicated and sent me pictures when it was done. It was gorgeous! I will definitely be using her for the future.
Dallas was fantastic! My 15 yr old golden retriever was is sad shape and Dallas was patient and caring. I would definitely use them again.
For those of you that want the inside on a great time.....   head upstairs and look for A...A... Ron.... aka Aaron.  If he doesn't make your night, I owe you a drink.
Everything at Boise Fry is delicious, but especially their Buffalo burgers and the brussel sprouts. It's too bad they've had to shut down their sauce station because those are excellent, too.
Drinks are very expensive here! Salads don't come with silverware you have to ask for it separately. Will not be going back. Not locally owned.
Marshall did an amazing job! I brought in a Pinterest picture and he topped it. His hands reminded me of a magician, and he was so funny! I'll go back again just for him!

I have been here twice now and each time have absolutely loved it! They really take the time to get to know you and what you want. They are very accommodating and are so much fun to be around. They joke and talk with you and each time I have gone they have made me feel right at home all while doing a wonderful job on my toes! The designs are adorable and the polish did not chip! I would highly recommend them!

We had Pete unload our POD this morning! He was early!!!! He was the most pleasant person and hard worker we have had the pleasure to meet!! We will definitely use your moving services again!
Reese as I stated on the phone both of your workers take pride in their work. They were fast but also made sure not to damage any of my belongings.
Thank you so much for your great service

I've been wanting to put a will in place for many years and just never got around to doing it. My father passed away unexpectedly this year and that forced me to address what I had been procrastinating about.  Justin sent me a list of questions to work thru and then I sat down with him to discuss everything.  It wasn't as daunting as I imagined it would be.  I feel so much relief knowing that my family is taken care of if something should happen to me.  I would highly recommend Justin to guide you through the process!
Visiting from out of state. Solid deli. Got the BLT, great bread, not my favorite potato salad. Everything was a bit salty for my liking, but I'd come here again if I find myself in town again.

Chris and his team took care of me right away and had the car finished early.  I liked building my own plan, talking with an expert on the phone who was happy to talk through all the options with me, and recommending a custom package for my exact needs. 

Pricing was good, service was excellent and we are happy with the outcome.

The food here is absolutely amazing. Tonight, my family was late getting to Big Al's -- and we simply didn't want pizza again. So, we walked over to The Counter. The hostess was a tad distracted but she was nice enough. Our server was great and the service was spot on. My husband ordered a bison burger -- and he just loved it. I am a cheeseburger girl -- so I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of the meat and the great taste!! We will definitely be returning. Even our two teenage boys enjoyed it and our 16 month old daughter, too!!
Nice little cafe. Food was good. Only 4 stars because their corned beef hash is the mushy kind, probably from a can, not the good chunks of home made corned beef.
Fantastic food, great owner. Got to give them a try. Supporter of military and first responders. Live this place

After bad service last December, my family convinced me to try it again. Well....I didn't think it was possible, but the service was worse. Our order came out wrong. We told the cashier and was told the correct food would be made ASAP. 15 minutes later, no food. Back to the cashier. This time I made sure the new order was given to the cook. When our food was delivered, the server gave a lame excuse that the kitchen ticket printer was messing up the tickets. I didn't believe it considering 5 orders went out just fine after ours. Stay away.

Just went through the drive thru and ordered a #2 with no onion, with Mac Sauce. I get home and the cheeseburgers are regular. Cannot believe attention to detail has either skipped this generation or they just think it is okay to not complete the order as asked for. Well those cheeseburgers are trashed!! It even stats on my receipt that I had special ordered burgers.

I usually always go here for a haircut. This one morning I went at 10am recently and the employee got there just at 959am and was rushed to get ready to start the day. 
 While the barber was trimming my eyebrows this barber cut my eyelid due to being rushed I believe. Then totally butchered up the rest of my eyebrows. I did not realize it until I got home. The butcher part that is. 
 My eyelid was bleeding and the barber got it to stop by wiping it a little with a wet towel. No discount or anything was offered which is fine. I was honestly not looking for anything. 
 I will be thinking twice about going back here for a haircut. Their prices are great but honestly would rather pay a little more and know that my barber will not be rushed and not butcher me. Sorry guys.

I've known John for decades and have found him to be as good as they get.  I've had all kinds of repairs done over the years and NOTHING has ever been anything but first rate.  He pays his mechanics well providing they do the job right the first time so you seldom see something come back to be re-done.  I am certain that several of these comments left in the past have been purely made up, especially the ones from out of the area.  Facebook courage is easy to strut but I'm sure they would have none face-to-face.  Once my brother came through in his motor home, broke down and, even on a weekend, John and one other mechanic came over and got Bruce back on the road in no time.  Bruce was stunned and swore he'd treat folks he saw broken down on the side of the road a lot better once he'd experienced John's kind of Idaho courtesy, hospitality and professionalism.  Bruce also fancies himself something of a mechanic and was more than surprised when John told him the repairs were different than he'd imagined and for a lot less than Bruce planned on spending.  But, for the cheapskates and whiners who are complaining about John's pricing just understand this, he isn't your daddy or your old boyfriend who will do sub-par work for a sandwich.  He has a family to support and has earned every dime he's ever been paid.

Had a detail done on my Yukon today and they did a great job. It looks once again like when I purchased it last year. I was a dog walker, now retired and would take my clients to the hills most days when the weather was nice and there was a lot of sand on the floor and hair on the ceiling of the vehicle from my Dane standing and hitting the roof. I highly recommend this company for a detail, they do a fantastic job and their prices are good.

What a great spot! 4 of us and our 16 month old sat down and everything we had was amazing! From the Thai ice tea to the green curry, everything was a home run. On top of that, the drink menu was tailored to Christmas which was really fun. The staff was very kind and attentive. We we absolutely be back!
Absolutely the best nail salon I've ever been to. The staff is so friendly and welcoming. Moon does an amazing job! I definitely recommend them to anyone looking for a great nail salon!
This is my childhood dream shop. Best fries I have ever had in my ENTIRE LIFE. Their sandwiches deserve a 10 across the board as well. Every time i return to Boise this place is a MUST.

They rarely have what we want to order.  Have gone several times when they did not have multiple items and did not offer to make them.  The last time we went they had no white rice, no mushroom chicken and no shrimp..they offered to make mushroom chicken, but would have been 10 minute wait.  Was 2 hours before closing..would not have said anything if this had been the first time but as I said has happened multiple times..will not likely go back to this location..
Wow! The food is awesome and the quality is so fresh.  The menu has allot of choices but the Chef is point on for his recommendations. Thanks guys for a wonderful and filling meal.

Food was okay, not great. Our tacos were lukewarm with no sauce offered. The chips were very good and it was nice to have beer on tap. We ate outside on the patio (only one other group that finished as we arrived)-ALL the tables tops were dirty from previous customers, no napkins at the tables and had to go back in to ask for salsa (I know it can't be left out on the table). Overall during this extra-prevention time this restaurant felt less than clean (although workers did have  masks) and when the young man came out to clean the tables he just used the same rag for 6 or 8 table without any cleaner.  A WET RAG IS NOT ENOUGH ANYMORE. Need to step it up with more obvious sanitation to get us back.

My mom is a regular at this salon and suggested I try it out because I couldn't get an appointment with my normal gal. I called about 3 hours before I needed to get in and they were able to squeeze me in even on such short notice. I went in not having any idea of what I wanted and Tume (I think thats how she spells it) knocked it out of the park with a cute glitter snowflake combo. Most salons don't like doing the loose glitter nails and they will sort of hide it and not have it as an option unless you ask for it. Not here, they have all their glitters on the wall and were excited to do something fun! The salon is clean and not harsh chemical smells overwhelming you. It was great that they could fit me in last minute and I felt comfortable going in, they treated me like I was a regular customer. I will be returning here from now on!

I would give this place five stars, but I heard you cannot always give five stars or the review will seem fake. So the four stars is just for the strip mall location way in the corner, perhaps hard to find. Otherwise, I have eaten here three times and love the fresh, aesthetically pleasing and tasty, well prepared meals. They have a small outdoor dining area with a pleasant ambiance. A bit spendy, but one of Meridian's best kept secrets for fine food.

I did a drop in class while visiting from out of state. I had a wonderful experience! The gym was clean, laid out beautifully, and had great equipment. The staff and members were very friendly and welcoming. Awesome workout and sounded like great programming based on the workouts they were talking about from the week. I look forward to dropping in whenever I'm in town!

My family and I have always been a huge fan of IHOP. This specific location is very clean, has great, friendly staff, and cooks every plate very well. I very much enjoy dining at this location, and can't wait to cone back again.

I think everyone in fast food in the valley should have to go to this restaurant and train.  These employees are consistently the best in town.  I still agree with this original post, this location has a strong management presence and it show through there staff.

Had a pretty good experience with my nail tech Tiffany! The only issue I had was I went in for a fill and ended up getting a simple French tip for a design (pictured). I was told on the phone 40 dollars for a fill and ended up paying 60:(
My nails were already almond shape as well.

I like The Ram and we have been going there for many  years  I especially like their  fish and chip but have always had a love/hate relationship with them because they switch their suppliers so often and are not consistent BUT I decided to give them another try after not going in for over 4 months and.....  the atmosphere is the same noisy, and pretty chaotic. We were seated and greeted immediately by a manager and were told about their new fish and chips without even asking so we thought we'd give them a try.
We got a side salad had an appetizer crab & artichoke dip before which was pretty good, I do like their blue cheese. When the fish and chips came out there were three medium sized pieces and a nice portion of waffle cut fries along with the coleslaw and the tartar sauce on the tray. When I tasted them I was overjoyed to see it was cod again not pollock.   
Nice thin light beer batter breading with a good crunch and very tender and moist fish. Happy they got a good new supplier, hope they keep them. Will be back for more fish and chips.
The only reason for the three star rating is because the service was a bit slow and the noise of the environment

I drove by this place near where I live and noticed that they put up some good deals ads. I decided to give them a try. Their place closed early like around 6pm. It is not very convenient for most working people like me. Cause we do not get our from work before 6pm. I tried to call them many times for appointment but no one answer the phone. It is always the answering machine. One time one guy did call back but it was too late for me. 

So I went to their website to see if I can get more information. I found that they actually has a 30min free massage trial session. So, I booked an appointment thru their site.  On the day of the appointment, I arrived on time. When I walked in, there is no one there to help me. There is one customer filling up the form and so I also grab a form and started filling up. My massage therapist was not there to greet me or ready for me. Finally I have to tell the other massage therapist that was helping the other client that I actually was waiting for my appointment. He checked their computer and finally found it. He told me my massage therapist is Theresa. I thought I remember when I signed up the appointment on their site, it was Tina. Anyhow, I did not made a fuss about it as long as the massage therapist is good. Finally, Theresa came out and told me to wait so that she can adjust the massage table. Hello ! I have been waiting for 10 min already and you still tell me to wait ? Nonetheless, if she still give me the 30min session, I am OK with that. Wrong ! Finally when she was ready, I noticed that it was already 15min past my appointment time. She asked me to get ready and said she will be back. When she came back, she started to massage me. It was not like I requested on the form I filled up. The form asked what kind of massage I want and where I have pain. She totally did not focus on the parts I have pain. Also, the worst is that I asked for deep tissue, she gave me a light at most medium massage. She did spent some time at the beginning of the session reading my form. I don't know why she did not get it. Well, long story short, after only 15min, she told me that it is done. I did not made a fuss but she was so wrong that she think we customer are so stupid to not realize that ?! I definitely will not go back to her. I will give the place one more chance for other massage therapist and hopefully I need not to write another similar review.
This is a hidden gem! Such great food, even my ultra picky 7 year old loves their pho!!

I have taken our dog Stella here 5 times now. They have a great facility with easy to use self washes, nice warm water to get my dog comfortable, all the tools you need. It's all super clean and comfortable too. The staff really loves dogs and they take great care of them during grooming. Great use of masks and safety precautions, which I appreciate.

the guy who did my piercing was great (his name was dan) he helped me not be scared and made the process great! the place was super clean and handled covid well. my only thing is that my friend brought in jewelry for me to get pierced with the day before and the lady said it was ok, but then the next day we got in trouble for it when we wouldn't of done it if she wouldn't of given us permission , it kinda sucked we really didn't know and i wish she would've told us no in the first place, other than that it's a great place!!!!

I would consider my Wife and I regulars, but will NEVER go back. When a business chooses to shut out regulars for private Christmas parties is a risky business decision. I hope you guys made a lot of money off of those parties because you lost my business FOREVER. Was it worth it?
Great raspberry Mocha and poppy seed bagel. Had it at two of their four locations. Consistency is key. Great job.

Being from Houston, I'm pretty picky about pho, I have to say this one hits pretty close to home. Ordered take out and it was packed hot and fresh. The broth was rich and flavorful. Service was quick and friendly, he double checked and made sure i had everything needed.

My go to place for a fresh and delcious sandwich. I always get the ranch turkey on Asiago bread. Bread is always fresh and made on site, turkey is hand pulled, produce is crisp. Just hits the spot. Husband loves the pesto chicken panini.
Fed my whole team here. I love their Barbacoa taco. My team loved it as well. Lots of variety and they can handle catering well.

This is better than the other pizza chains such as little Caesars, Pizza Hut, and dominos. The ingredients taste much better. It didn't have a fake cheese taste.  However, I definitely wouldn't call it authentic Italian as they advertise. 

I will say their cheesy bread is delicious! I ordered a meatball sub, and it was ok but nothing great or something I'd order again.  I had a half pizza with Italian sausage and tomatoes and that was tasty. Many of the pizza chain restaurants that serve Italian sausage taste awful. But Marcos had fresh tasting sausage and they were a good size: not crumbled on the pizza like shavings. I would say if you are looking for delivery- try this place as it's better than other options. It's not the best and not the worst. If you do go, definitely try the cheesy bread.

What a great place to wash your car! Friendly, hard working employees prep the vehicle thoroughly while guiding you into the machine wash. Then you can vacuum out the inside for free in the back. Sadrac, the GM wants to make the customer happy. They also offer basic auto services like changing windshield wipers and fluids replacement including complete oil & filter changes. Ask about becoming a member and receiving unlimited washes for $19.99/month and other discounts and.

Found this place recently looking for fish  tacos. We tried the location in Meridian, last week, then last night tried the one in Boise. Boise has outdoor seating with a fire pit. We've only tried the Grilled Mahi-mahi and Shrimp tacos, with limes, and a side of chips & salsa. There's many more choices to choose from. Really like mixing the jalapeño & habanero sauce together.
You'll need 3-4 tacos a piece to make a meal.
Prices are reasonable, atmosphere is good, adequate free parking right out front.

Love this place! And don't worry, it's not really a club, anyone can go there. If they used beef tallow instead of vegetable oil, I would say this is the most gourmet place around this area. But overall the crust is nice, and the fillings are amazing, and everything is clean and fresh. The wine and beer selection is pretty good too, but maybe could be a bit better to compliment the great flavors of empanadas they have. I like that I can really taste the cumin in the traditional flavor, but it doesn't overpower. Would be nice if the caramel one was homemade caramel and not that condensed canned stuff, even though that us "authentic" to do it that way. The wife (I think?) seems like she's from Argentina, and is as beautiful and sweet as a fresh spring rain. The main guy is cool but a little surly. He likes to dominate the conversation, and this is not helped by the fact that the place has terrible acoustics. You can hear the person behind the counter OK, but they CAN NOT hear you, and the husband guy gets kinda annoyed by people being too quiet I think. Bad interior design. But great restaurant overall. Would be great if they did breakfast, and got at least a basic Keurig set up for coffee.
Excellent ribs & brisket  fried Okra & Cole slaw was good too. Best Smoked meat so far that we have tried

I was having difficulty finding shoes in my size (large and wide). I even tried ordering online, but then when they arrived, they didn't fit. I found Shoe Carnival online. I called and one of the associates answered the phone even though the store was not open yet. Since I have to drive a long distance to shop I wanted to ask if they had shoes in my size before driving down. The kind associate assured me that yes, they had shoes in my size. I went to the store and was pleasantly surprised that there were several options in my size and I was able to purchase a comfortable pair of shoes for a reasonable price. I will be back! Thank you Shoe Carnival and your kind associates

Definitely my favorite burger joint since it arrived dethroning the long running champion of Big Judds. Sorry Judds. 
I love the Santa Barbara and my wife and I both love the protein (I stole that name from In-n-Out).  Everything there is very clean and the onion rings are very good as well.  In-n-Out vs Habit?  Well I prefer going down the street as opposed to 5 hours on the road. I would still pick Habit in a heartbeat.

Stopped in last night for dinner. Was not very busy, never heard my name called. So had to go inquire about my order, that was sitting on the counter. Had the fried chicken and the baja shrimp. Was really looking forward to that first bite. Was very disappointed the tacos were cold. The chicken had the feel like it had been sitting in an unheated container. Almost refrigerated even. Stale and overly crunchy. Shrimp were a little warmer, but with the cold greens was still overall cold. My son had the beef fajita tacos, and had the same issue with his. Probably the worst Tin Roof experience I have had. I keep coming back hoping the quality improves. This place has such promise.

Welcome to Meridian!  As major fans of the downtown location I have been salivating with anticipation.   What a surprise at how big and open the new location is.  Menu is the same as the other location so I know what I will be having, chicken fried steak.

Excellent child care. The education and emotional  skills they offer are truly wonderful. Our son loves it here, his teachers are great and the age ranges they cater to are also a plus. We plan on keeping him here as long as possible!

Went to Big Al's Saturday night 10 October 2020...The place looked to me like they would be out of business in a month. Staff member told us to order from the bar, not many customers, 8-10 filthy tables heaped with dirty plates and food scraps...nobody was cleaning any of it. TV volume was so loud we could barely have a conversation. Nobody greeted us or acted as if they cared we were there...We were disgusted enough that we didn't even sit...went nearby to Yardhouse and had good food, great service, in a clean establishment...I've been to Big Als with large groups before and had good times there...looks like those days are gone...if I was running that place, I surely would dump the managers and start over.

Very poor service with this location! I love Dickey's and have ate it across the country. I ordered a 2 meat plate, brisket and jalapeño Cheddar Kielbasa  and wanted a bun for the brisket in order to make it a brisket sandwich. How hard is that? I got a sandwich with chopped brisket and kielbasa thrown on it?? When I asked them about it they confronted me like it was my fault, as it was I had to ask for drinks at the window as the girl was too impatient taking my order (when they had an empty parking lot and no one behind me) to ask for drinks. They were not very friendly! When I found out my order was messed up, they  were more concerned about proving what I did wrong than simply trying to correct their mistake.. I would recommend retraining if I were the owner as I see an average rating of 3 stars, wish I would have checked reviews before going here.

My husband, my son, & I went to Big Al's (2/16/20).  The last time we came here it was for my husbands birthday.  We celebrated with dinner followed by bowling.  It was a fairly large group.  Our original experience wasn't the best, but I called in the next day and spoke with Vincent about our experience.  He was very apologetic and offered to make it up to us the next time we came in.  It was very thoughtful and appreciated.  This convo was back on 8/16/19.  So, back to Sunday....we arrived around 6:30 and gave the cashier our name.  She set us up in the VIP bowling area and got us our shoes (as promised by Vincent). As my husband was setting up our names for the computer, Vincent came over to speak to him.  He told me husband that he remembered the conversation and apologized again for how bad things were the last time.  He introduced Ian, our server, to us and said if we needed anything to let him know. 
The bowling area was great! It was super clean and well maintained.  It had pleasant music playing and it was loud enough to allow you to have conversations & listen to the music too! A lot of times it gets so loud a bowling alley's you can't hear anything.  
We ordered some food & drinks. 
Pitcher of Pepsi
Pitcher of Ice Water
2 blue Icee's
Mozzarella bites
Large pepperoni pizza
Large Bbq chicken pizza

The food was great! The pizza came out hot & nicely put together.  The mozzarella bites were delicious!!! I did think that the price of the mozzarella sticks was a bit high.  They were $10.50 for 8.  But that's the only negative & definitely not a big enough deal to take off a star. 

At one point, our ball return stopped working & so we had to request assistance.  It took about 10 minutes for them to get the problem fixed, but the attendant had the missed time added back into my time without ya asking. Ian was an awesome server.  He was very attentive and was on top of everything without being over the top.  He treated everyone around us just as well.  Thanks to Ian & Vincent, we had a wonderful Sunday evening.  They 100% made up for our prior negative experience.  I really appreciated Big Al's making things right. Vincent is an awesome manager who delivers great customer service. We are looking forward to our next visit!
*i highly recommend splurging and just renting the VIP lanes by the hour! It's worth it and really doesn't cost much more.

I am legit surprised this place is as good as it is!

Husband wanted BBQ for Father's Day and we opted to try something new. Dangerous, I know.

Because our kiddos were napping I ordered our food to-go. We ordered a 3-meat plate and a 2-meat plate both with ribs and sliced brisket, and a pulled pork sandwich plate. For sides we tried BBQ beans, macaroni and cheese and baked potato casserole.

When I got to the restaurant to pick up I was worried the bag was so small, for $40 I felt like there could have been more. I was also disappointed drinks weren't included since they're pictured, but I understand I shouldn't assume.

As I plated our meal when I got home, I still felt like there wasn't a lot of food for the price. My husband said something similar - HOWEVER - we both agreed that in the long run we were grateful considering we're usually in a food coma after BBQ.

The food was honestly really good. The brisket was well seasoned and tender. A good balance of meat and fat. The ribs fell of the bone, no dry spots or bland meat. The kids ate up the pulled pork sandwich. The sides were all really good as well, I was pleasantly surprised with the baked potato casserole.

So while I can't see us ever dining in, it's a great spot to hit the drive-thru and get BBQ to-go. The portions could definitely be bigger but they are probably closer to how much we SHOULD eat lol
As I've gotten older, I realize that good stuff costs a little extra. I still come by this place fairly often and it never disappoints. The staff and owner run a great restaurant.

Meh. It was ok. The pizza was mediocre but due to a kitchen error we did score so free cheese sticks. The cheese sticks were easily the best part of the meal. Unfortunately, for the cost I can think of a lot of other pizzas I like better.

Looked like a nice place. However, I walked in at 6:33 PM with no other customers inside and was told walk ins were no longer being taken. 1st and last time.

Made it to another business who took me 4 minutes before closing. No grief from the employee.

I LOVE, LOVE, LOVE this store!  Everyone is super friendly and helpful. I show them pictures of ideas/projects and they do their best to find the items I need. They even call/text me about sales and new products too!  Here are a few pictures of the projects they've helped me with.

I have been getting my nails done by Janna at Nail Tek and Spa before she started her own business.  I just love her work and would recommend her to everyone I know.  She does such exceptional work and always I always receive compliments on my nails everything she does them.  Both her and her husband are very nice and easy to work to.  Keep up the great work!

It's my first time here at the spa and I had a great experience from checking in, to my actual nail service and from checking out... Lena did a great job on my mani/pedi! She's the best!  I will definitely go here again...

I really wish that Yelp had a better rating system.I dont think that The Counter quite deserves 4 stars, but I like them more than just "A- OK". They deserve something in between. 

It has been a while since I have eaten at the Counter. I am very happy to say that they have improved. It was as if they read the reviews on yelp and took them to heart. I love it when that happens. So many places either don't care, or take the attitude that its my place and I will do things how I want.

One of my main issues last time was the prices. Last time, there were a ton of premium ingredients on the menu. It was very easy for your $13 burger to turn into a $20 burger, and you would not even know this until you got your check.

Now there are far less of these premium ingredients on the menu. In case you missed my last review, premium ingredients cost more. For example, you start off with your $13 burger, then add on ingredients that cost anywhere from $1 to $3 more per item.

These premium ingredients that cost more are now on a place on the menu clearly labeled Premium Toppings +1 each. Though for clarity, and transparency, I suggest putting +$1 here. Some will still not know what a +1 means and choose these without knowing that they cost more.

There are other places on the menu that also say +2.5. These are still deceptive and someone that has not been here before can have a rude awakening when they get their bill only to find that they have chosen toppings that cost extra that they did not know about.

In fact, while I was here, I overheard a customer complaining about this very thing. They said that their $13 burger had become a money pit and they did not know it.

On the upside, the burgers here are good. I would give them a ranking of around a 7 on my 1 to 10 scale. The main reason they did not improve as much as I wold have hoped in the burger rankings is;

#1 The price has improved, but for those that have not been here before, you still need to be careful to keep the price of your Build Your Own Burger down.

#2 The meat is not a consistent size. Even though "Nothing But Net" is great in Basketball, in eating a burger, the last thing you want are bites that contain no meat. The meat patties are not a a good size and shape. They are thick in the middle, and thinner on the sides. The patty does not cover the entire bun, so I got several bites of nothing but bun. I looked at my daughters plate and she left uneaten bun on her plate for the same reason. A meat patty should be of a size that fill out the entire bun. I also prefer a meat patty that is a pretty consistent thickness so that I get a good ratio of meat, bun, and ingredients in every single bite.

My guess would be that The Counter makes their patties this way on purpose in order to make them seem more natural. So many places used frozen patties that are all the exact same size and shape. They probably want to set themselves apart from this here, which I think is admirable. But what The Counter needs to do is strike a good balance between having a good consistent sized patty while still staying away from that mechanical Frisbee shaped patty that most other places have. 

I did notice several other improvements as well. They have added several per-built burger to their menu. There are shakes, salads, something called Burger in a Bowl, and many other really nice things to their menu.

Speaking of the menu, I did notice the menu itself has not changed. Its still a plain paper menu that is not laminated. Mine had some stains on the pages. Oh yeah, guess I need to comment on the fries. We had the regular fries, which are shoestring like that fast food place Freddie's. The fries are just ok. I did not try any of their specialty fries due to trying to keep our ticket price down. 

All of the staff here is very friendly. John is super nice is you happen to run into him. The staff deserve their own rating system, but Yelp just does not allow that detailed of a system. The staff gets 5 stars!!!

I would be very interested to return here some time to try these and also their shakes.

From my first information call to online booking to drop off and pick up this was a very easy transaction. I loved being able to build my own detail online without worry because when I dropped my vehicle off Brenna took the time to walk through each of my selections and make sure they aligned with my desired results. I had purchased a used vehicle from an individual and was wanting that new car look and smell as if I had purchased it from a dealer. InDepth gave that to me and quickly so I could start enjoying my new ride.
This was our first time eating here. Not the cleanest of places but the pizza bowls were yummy, the Caesar salads are huge, and the service was friendly. Would go back again for sure.

Had my car towed to find out what was wrong. Come to find out a bad fuel pump. Was given an estimate of $1000 to fix. You gotta be kidding me? Other places gave me an estimate of under $500 including labor. I have heard from others this is the best place to go but was disappointed to find out how overly expensive they are. The ONLY good thing was the nice guy I spoke with on the phone Nick.

We are new to the Boise area and my husband was driving behind a large construction truck and wham! A large rock hit our car windshield and put a big size chip in it. The next day we went to a gas station that advertised chip repair but the young man didn't seem to be very knowledgeable about chip repair. We found Tyler on Yelp and he was very helpful and seemed to know just how to fix our windshield. He met us at our home the same day we called had our windshield looking like new! You can't even tell the windshield had a good size chip a day ago. He told us the best thing you can do when you get windshield chip is NOT to wait. If you call ASAP for repair the better the repair is going to look. Don't wait for the chip to spread. 
Thanks Tyler. We will be calling you again, if and when we need you.

Critical: Quality, Responsiveness, Value
Really disappointed in Jiim.  4 years ago he took on the job of redoing our gunite pool (replaster, squared corners, new plumbing, lights, equipment, auto cover, etc.) but now that all the plaster is cracking he blames it on his subcontractor who only provided a 1 year warranty apparently (when others I call say at least 5 and up to 10 is typical), will not stand behind his work, and does not return messages or information promptly.  I am having to find my own help to get the work redone, which at minimum I would have expected him to follow through on. USE WITH CAUTION.  He has done some amazing pools for Andre Agassi, etc., but too busy to help folks like me from what it seems when problems arise.

New sammie time! The chicken ciabatta sandwhich is pretty darn good. It has grilled chciken breast and SALAMI (mmmm...salamiii..) amongst other toppings and sauces. I personally am not a fan of balsamic so I ordered without, but I will be back for this sandwhich. Still paid with a $10 bill and god a good lunch in me.

I went to Imperial for a nose piercing in July of 2018. Dan was the artist I worked with. His bedside manner was intimidating and unfriendly. Regardless of this interaction, I left that day excited about my piercing. 3 months later, I went back because my nose ring was not healing properly and I wanted to have a less irritating stud to replace by original one. I once again worked with Dan. When switching my jewelry out Dan thought my jewel was a corkscrew, and pulled so hard on it that I started bleeding. He found out after the damage was already done that the stud was not a corkscrew, but he pulled so hard on the jewel that he broke the top off. I left that day with a painful nose and regretful that I let him touch my nose. Since then, my nose has never healed. It is constantly red and irritated. I have done everything to treat it properly as directed by Imperial, online forums, and my nursing training (I am an ICU nurse). Over a year later (September 2019) I went to another shop on Overland called Krahnic Body Art. I worked with Chris on troubleshooting my nose ring. He was AMAZING!!!!! He spent over an hour with me looking at my piercing and solutions. He ended up putting in an 18 gauge titanium stud. He identified the stud that I had in my nose from Dan was cheap irritating jewelry that was bent so poorly for my nose that it was constantly irritating my piercing. Today is 5 days after I worked with Chris at Krahnic Body Art and guess what?? My nose is almost completely healed!!! For the first time in almost 1 1/2 years!! 

So in closing. Do not go see Dan at Imperial. He is horrible. Go to Krahnic Body Art!! They are the best in Boise. They are super clean and knowledgeable. Don't waste your time with Imperial.

When asking around for a place to get my septum pierced, Imperial came highly recommend. Couldn't be happier with my choice. Laura did a great job and was very friendly and helpful. It was quick, clean and relatively pain-free. Would definitely go there again.
While the food was delicious, forgetting food is unforgivable. No bbq sauce for the ribs and missing one of the sides.  Way to expensive and we didn't get to enjoy it all.

When in Idaho, gotta have BFC! Unique concept, you get fries and burger On The Side! 

They also have Brussel Sprouts fried, truffle it up and you're set!

Customer service is spot on!! Owner is extremely friendly and makes you feel right at home. We ordered the Tuna Melt and the Triple Chin with potato salad. Potato salad has bacon in it and leaves you wanting to lick the container clean. I really enjoyed their fresh brewed iced tea as well. You can tell the water wasn't too hot when they brew it because of the smooth flavor.

One word: Phenomenal. Seriously, everything they make is filled with amazing flavor and fresh. Let me break it down, how many times have you been stoked about a side salad? The entire menu is just what Boise needs. It's different and amazing. Imagine gourmet Italian mixed with burgers, grilled cheese, salad, and more. We were very impressed and will be back!

I hate having to give Big Al's in Meridian a negative review, but after a disappointing visit, and one mediocre event, I have to try and save future guests their precious time and money.  As a business owner in Meridian, I chose to host an employee appreciation event at Big Al's.  Not only were the party packages way too expensive, their food was sub-par (and that's being generous).  You could definitely tell the buffet items were prepped from a box, defrosted, reheated, and drenched in spices to cover the bland taste.  The banquet staff seemed like they hated their jobs, and the event coordinator was rude and abrasive.  Not only did it take her 2 days to return my assistants phone calls, she constantly interrupted her and spoke down to her whenever we asked her a question.  The bowling and private room was nice, but not nice enough to offset the poor food, and miserable event staff.  On another visit, we decided to try out the Caddy Shack bar upstairs.  Sadly there was no bartender or server to be found, and it took nearly 30 minutes to get their bar staff to greet me and my guest.  Not bad enough?  Well after waiting nearly 30 minutes we were told we couldn't order an entree in the upstairs bar, bur rather had to go downstairs to the main restaurant, only having enough time to finish our drinks before having to leave for another appointment.  It was a complete joke and a complete waste of my time and money!  Management at Big Al's obviously doesn't think that their customers have other options or choices.  Well I'm here to tell you, WE DO!  Save yourself the headache and find another venue for your company/employee related events and meetings.  Unfortunately, Big Al's is a BIG FLOP!

DO NOT go to IGA.  Some clinical practices are weak - particularly as it relates to inquiring about patient's history with prep solutions.   Was given a colonoscopy screening prep solution, whose instructions I followed to the letter. It didn't do the job, so the quality of screening results were "fair".  When I asked about this, I was told they used a prep cleansing solution that was easier on patients, than the GoLytely prep solution that I was accustomed to.   1 year later, I received a letter from IGA stating that it was time for "another" screening. I called the office and learned that I received the letter because my screening results had only been "fair" the previous year.  After talking at length with the billing office, I surmised that it would likely be an out-of-pocket expense for me, because my insurance company doesn't pay for colonoscopy screenings every year.  Bottom Line: Nobody at IGA bothered to ask me if I preferred their "standard prep solution", or the highly effective GoLytely solution, which had always worked very well for me.   I guess I was supposed to fit their clinical protocol and live with the results (mediocre screening results, and the potential health risks).  Never again.  I will be contacting my insurance company to voice serious concerns about this particular network provider.

Old chef no longer at Sa Wa Dee... new chef hasn't got a clue.
My husband ordered something medium heat; I ordered mine with the least amount of heat.  (I always order the same thing!). His arrived with 0 heat, mine was too spicy/hot to even taste the food.  Their solution??? They brought my husband chili sauce to add himself, mine they doused 
with coconut milk and handed the same food back to me.  Really horrible customer service handling like this.  We won't be back.
No more sushi at Sa Wa Dee either!!

Update to "T.T.'s" response:
We've been to your restaurant 
More times than I can count over the past 15 years.  I always order the salmon curry, not cold salmon soup which it ended up as after the addition of the coconut milk).
My husband asked for medium heat on his noodles. He should have been served noodles with medium heat!! 
Stop placing the blame of your inferior serving practice on your long time customers.  Now we will never return and be sure to spread the word!
Always fresh and so satisfying! The staff is very kind and helpful. I love the open kitchen, the aroma is wonderful. Definitely one of the best burger spots in town. Must try!
I got a pedicure here. It was absolutely amazing. I also appreciate the precautions that they are taking during COVID. I am looking forward to going back again!

My left eye has a blood vain from how hard Bailey  the tech was. I have a headache as well. I had to tell her to be gentle two different times.  She did not seem to care. 
It felt like torture the whole time.
I have been getting eye lashes done for over a year now and only went to this salon because my usual place was booked.
The pain  lasted the rest of the day and I had to stay home.
These guys are great! Less expensive than a lot of the competition & absolutely great to work with. They are super professional, friendly and prompt. I would  definitely recommend them!!

They start with a good frame.  Seasonal and creative menu, farm to table ingredients, small plate options, fair prices, friendly staff and a small patio in front.  Plus they are open straight through from lunch through dinner providing option in Meridian for something other than the increasing bloat in number of formula-food chain restaurants.  

But there is wood to chop here to get this right for consistency in food and training of servers.  

Based on two visits, the first much better than the second, my husband and I are cautiously optimistic.  The owner owns Papa Joe's in Boise so he must have the tools to build this right.  Time will tell.  

MENU
"Before 5" options are on the front and "After 5" options are on the back. Although they advertise happy hour, on our dinner visit which was early enough to be in the pocket of happy hour, there were no HH  food items, only a discount on libations.

I took photos of a menu to post with this review so I won't detail options or prices.  Both are subject to quick change as Grants fine tunes what sells and what doesn't.

As example, between our first visit and our second, only about 10 days apart, they had reduced some of the prices on the menu.  They had also removed some menu items given they found they didn't sell. The owner is nimble in making menu adjustments to meet the preferences of local diners.   We also understand the menu will be reprinted / updated about every two months for seasonal focus.

FOOD
First visit started with tempura fried green beans.  Perfectly cooked, great tempura coating and they came with three luscious dipping sauces.  We ordered a housemade veggie burger to follow.  It came on a pretzel roll and although the 'burger' was a bit soft and messy to eat the flavors were great.  (A tip, ask them to leave the mayo off and use any of the dipping sauces on it.)

The veggie burger came with fries and we asked to have them held given we were starting with fried green beans.  We were not offered an alternate and the burger came plopped in the middle of a nude plate.  Presentation is important and this was 'fail'.

Dinner was less successful for food.  We ordered from the small plates menu and chose braised pork belly with apple / parsnip puree.  Although that doesn't sound so seasonal for hot July fare, it was still good.  We also tried roasted asparagus with parmesan that came with salad greens.  We expected the asparagus to be parmesan dusted but it was wrapped in the melted cheese, far too heavy and made the salad greens uber limp.  

Dessert at lunch was icebox Greek yogurt and goat "cheesecake" with berry gelee. Just right. Dinner was flourless chocolate cake with whipped goat cheese.  The cake was overbaked.

SERVICE
Lunch server, Sarah, was gracious, professional and got the service elements just right for delivering share plates, pacing the food, keeping water filled and checking in with us when needed.   The service is part of what made us feel so good about the first experience.  

Dinner service was friendly but less polished.  Although we said we would share the dishes and asked our server to bring share plates when we ordered,  one item was set in front of one of us and one in front of the other as if entrees.   We asked for share plates again.  Our server seemed surprised, as if hearing it for the first time.  And although we weren't finished eating, our server tried to remove our plates and asked if we'd like dessert.  Water was never filled.  She didn't check in with us after food delivery.  Training needed.

LIBATIONS
Limited and plebian wine list.  Full bar.  Probably a stick to the basics as best here.  They were still awaiting their French Press pots on our visits so no coffee available as coffee will be that mode when added.

VIBE
They've done a great job of making this welcoming on a budget.  See photos.  Unpretentious, neighborhood, "all are welcome" feel.  The majority of the seating is at standard height tables.  Thumbs up.  But there is seating for maybe 30 diners max in this space. There is a garage type door that can open to the outside to a small deck / patio with additional seating.  On both visits this was closed due to the uber temperatures and only one couple was brave enough to take on the outside inferno.  I can't imagine how they'll be able to turn enough meals in this small space to make the revenue numbers work.

THIS N THAT:

1) PARKING:  In the lot associated with the small strip mall where this is located.

2) ACCESSIBILITY:  A couple of spaces of accessible parking.  Level in the restaurant and throughout.  Standard height tables.  Loo is accessible but may be tough to get there given layout ignores the 36" clear path ADA rules that have been law for 25 years.

3) NEIGHBORS: Nail salon and pet store are next door neighbors.

Run, don't walk to this hidden gem. Warm and inviting atmosphere. It feels like you are in their home kitchen. There are traditional flavors but also something for those that might not be familiar with this Argentinian delicacy. We had the picante, chicken chimichurri and the traditional beef. They were delicious and three was plenty for my husband and I. They have sweet flavors too. We ate there and had a lovely lunch. We will be back soon!

Customer Service went downhill. The rep didn't greet me or count the money out. He took it out from the machine and just handed it to me. I had to count in front of him. He didn't seem to care and ask me if I need anything else. Disappointed about the service!

Love my nails! Service was great and friendly! I showed a picture and Im very happy with the outcome and how closely detail was payed attention to during my experience. The overall place was very clean and nice!

Wonderful authentic Thai food - fresh veggies and nice portion sizes.  
Very friendly staff.   Highly recommend!

I just had a colonoscopy (first ever) at the Meridian location with Dr. Story. We arrived at 10 am and I was taken back to a room. The nurse allowed me to gown in privacy, then came in and gave me a painless saline IV for hydration. After I signed an electronic form (I had a hard copy, too, that I could read while waiting), Dr. Story came in and was friendly and, wanted to know if I had any questions. I didn't, so he smiled, said he'd see me in a few and left. Nurse said she would give me sleep meds after signing their form. She gave me a shot in my hand (again, painless--she was really good.) She was all business, not unfriendly but I could tell they were having a busy day. Still, she was willing to visit with me and explain things. I asked her again when she was going to give me the sleeping meds. She laughed and said, "You've already had the colonoscopy and you're in recovery." WOW! That was amazing. It was like a split second had gone by. My friend was now with me and had asked how I was, to help me wake up. She reported that I said cleary, "New York Rockettes." This makes me wonder what actually went on during the procedure. :)  But I don't want to know. It all went smoothly, they knew their jobs well. I was carefully prepared for the prep part (no fun) and I had an excellent experience. I knew my prep would probably be a bit more complicated due to unrelated health issues and they quickly figured that out. I had a horrible experience with, as I call them, Digestive Wealth (health). All they wanted was money up front and seemed disorganized and staff didn't seem educated for handling a first contact. I ended up cancelling the procedure. I had a bad feeling about them. So glad I did. I would confidently recommend Idaho Gastro to anyone who needs a gastro-related procedure. They are all well trained and educated, right down to the basic members of the staff. If you've got a smart person answering the phone, you're way ahead of most businesses. I highly recommend them.

What a friendly nail salon!  Everyone was kind and Yuki is so talented and helpful. I didn't know exactly what I wanted but while I was getting a pedicure she told me to find a picture online which I did and I was so happy with the floral design Yuki copied. Great place and glad I found them!

Dr. Pilling did a great job!  I was in a lot of pain and he took care of it immediately.  His staff is also very helpful and friendly.  I would definitely recommend him to anybody for your dental care needs.

I'm always on the hunt for something different in the sea of sameness and driving through Meridian after visiting the Post Office, the The Empanada Club logo caught my right eye.  I wasn't even sure if it was what I thought it was. When I arrived home, I quickly accessed my Yelp app to look it. Sure enough, The Empanada Club was listed and I was able to look at the pictures and check out the menu.  

The Empanada Club offers a variety of tasty empanadas.  If you're not familiar with Empanadas, they are baked turnover stuffed with deliciousness.   The Spanish verb, empanar loosely translates as ' embedded'   They got that right. There's a lot of tastiness embedded in these empanadas. 

There are 10 different empanadas to choose from.  There are the traditional meat choices ranging from Carne Picante - Spicy Braised Beef to Chimichurri Chicken.  

They also offer a vegetarian and vegan options  Woohoo!
