The vegetarian option is the Portobello Mushroom with onions and cheese delightful stuffed inside the empanada. 

The vegan option is the Vegan curry.  Fresh roasted vegetables in a coconut curry sauce. 

I reached out to the owners via Yelp Messaging to ask if the pasty / dough was vegan and if it stayed vegan during the baking process.  Sometimes with baked breads, eggs and milk can be used.  

The owners quickly replied and reassured me that the dough was vegan and remained vegan throughout the process. 

I made my plans to stopped by at the beginning of the week and get a variety of empanadas.  I entered TEC and its is bright, welcoming, and the empanadas are separated out by types and clearly labeled. Behind the counter is some amazing tile work and wine bar.  There's also a nifty Empanada toaster machine.  Check it out!

One can order the empanadas as they are or warmed up.  It doesn't take but a couple of minutes to warm them up as they travel through the toaster machine.  

The empanadas are a good size and reasonably priced at $3.50 each. It is possible to order dozen. Doing so saves you some ' DOUGH ' !   

If you order a dozen, which is highly recommended, you may wonder how to tell which ones are which.  TEC has it figured out. Each empanada flavor has its own number baked into the corner.  There's no mix up a Carne Picante and a Vegan Curry. 

When you want to eat one at home, toaster ovens are recommended.  375 for about 7-8 minutes.  My daughter used the microwave, kids these days. Arrgh!  and while it was hot and tasty, the empanadas really love the heat from the oven.  

There are also Tartes and Mini Tartes. These are like pasty pies. They look fabulous.  TEC also offers baked sweets and goodies plus dipping sauces. So make sure to check it all out.  

The owners are super sweet and very welcoming.  

Lastly. If you can't get over to their shop, you can order online at www.MyEmpanadaClub.com 

Have some  fun without going to Buenos Aires just go to The Empanada Club!

One of the worst pedicures I've ever had.  Not only did the tech ignore my repeated requests to thoroughly remove all of the old gel polish, (stating that the new polish would cover it), but he also failed to properly trim and shape my toenails no matter how many times I asked.  I've never had a tech who failed so miserably at such basic tasks and I will definitely not recommend that anyone else subject themselves to such a miserable experience.

Had my wife and I visited only once, I would have rated this place 5 stars. Sadly our 2nd visit was soured for a number of reasons. 

Food: First time was stellar, the burgers were tasty, and arrived hot  to the table with correct cook temps and toppings. The cooks and servers were in sync and nothing sat at the pass long enough to be noticed. The 2nd go around was startling in contrast. Food moved slowly and often sat under the heat lamp for long periods of time. Servers were frequently going back and coming out empty handed, or with half an order. The worst part was that a cook saw it fit to serve my pregnant wife raw bacon on her burger. The order was however refired and discounted. My thanks for doing that, but I'd encourage management or the owner to have a serious talk with their Sunday staff. That's a pretty big restaurant no no with undercooked pork making it to the table. 

Staff: Front house was quick as usual. The cooks were slacking today and slacking bad. We got sat down in a half empty restaurant and it took over 40 minutes to be served burgers, not counting the re-fire. Food going out slowly seems to be a reoccurring complaint here on Yelp and I'd encourage management to look into it. 

Overall experience: The build your own menu is great, but could me made smaller to help get food out faster. I'd rather eat a good burger built from a smaller menu than a mediocre one from a giant menu.

My husband and I go to the Ram regularly for NFL Sunday Ticket games, and have been for a few years now. We love the bar staff (especially Desiree), the food/drinks/beer, and the general ambiance of having all the games on throughout the bar on Sundays, so leaving a negative review is somewhat bittersweet, but we felt like we should allow management to hear our frustration. 

We were disappointed this last Sunday, and ultimately left the Ram and went elsewhere to watch the game, and now we're not sure we'll return. 

When we arrived (a little late) at 11:08, the doors were still locked, so we waited with a small bunch in team attire for the doors to open (no problem, we've done that before), only to find that our game (which was broadcasted at 11:00) was not posted on any of the TVs in the bar. We asked the bartender, and he told us that our game was on in the dining room only and that he could not change it despite the fact that only 3 parties (including us) were in the bar/restaurant at that time, and quickly walked away. 

After he told us that, we looked around again, and in the bar area, there was one TV with Nascar, one TV with trivia, and another without a designated team lineup posted to it, which I'm not sure what that was showing.

There was also a guy in Vikings clothes already halfway through a beer at the bar (not sure how he got served so quickly when the doors were locked ahead of us), but that's another question. 

While I understand that keeping the TVs on games keeps guests from constantly asking to change the channel, I don't understand how on Sunday mornings, TVs are allocated to trivia or other sporting events when the company advertises NFL Sunday Ticket specials, happy hour deals, and has special bar top football game schedules/info. 

I want to watch football in a bar, not in a dining room around kids and grandparents, otherwise, I would've stayed home. Thanks to Wingers for having our game on in the bar and also having cold beer.

I'm used to "REAL" Mexican food and quite honestly this was very very good and pretty close to real deal. I had a coctel de camaron. I added a small amount of ketchup and BOOM... there it was. The shrimp were clean and BIG. My significant other ordered the chipotle chicken enchiladas and he really really enjoyed them. They were  stuffed with juicy shredded chicken and lots of cheese. The complimentary chips, salsa and beans were delicious. Our server was so nice, attentive and cheerful.

Always on the lookout for a new experience we've discovered empanada's. They are conveniently located just off Fairview with good parking. Even in these challenging times they have a wide selection, all good. They are aware of current dietary inclinations. Their dough is vegan. Their ingredients are heathy choices. Nice folks making a go of it in challenging times.

My experience while in the shop was pretty average.. but since have been very disappointed. I got a pedicure and a dip manicure. My dip manicure chipped within the first week.. and now being about a week and a half since getting it, they are almost all very badly chipped. 

I have been getting dip for several years, and though the shape looked good. I don't think it was thinking enough and chipped so easily. Normally mine from other salons last least 4 weeks.. 

For paying a lot more for the service I wish I would have lasted longer than a normal manicure.

Rachel at Royal S'paw did an excellent job with our Golden Doodle Lila. She communicated promptly with me about the appointment. She indicated the services would take two hours to complete, and right at two hours I got a message saying Lika was ready to be picked up. When I picked her up she was happy and energetic not scared or skittish. Rachel's pricing was fair, and she had quick availability. Overall a great experience!

I have been taking my 1.5 year old 100+ lb wooly Malamute to Rachel for about 6 months. She is so patient and thorough brushing out his mats (he's a swimmer), trimming him up (she always calls if something needs to be addresses before cutting hair) and is extremely breed knowledgable. He loves going to see her and having his S'Paw day. He gets sooo excited when we pull up. We have a reoccurring appointment every 4 weeks. She is one of the best in the valley. I cant express how much i appreciate her time and patience for my best friend.

Wow. Simply the best.
Great place, wish you were in Tucson. Very nice presentation and eelicious food. Thanks

These guys are pretty awesome! Last week I crashed on my dirtbike and shattered my phone screen. I was pretty stressed out over how expensive it is to replace it. I found these guys and much more affordable prices. I made an appointment on their website for the next day (super easy! They have a code to save you $20). It took them less than 30 minutes to fix my screen and it looks amazing. I'll definitely be back if I unfortunately break my screen again.

I'm not big into over the top sports bars but if you are...this is the place for you. The sports fan with us loved the huge screens, the bowler with us was very excited at the lit up disco lanes, and the arcade is pretty cool for the kiddo. 3 air hockey tables is a plus because they were all busy. 

This is my second visit and It's hotter than Hades in August upstairs where the arcade is ....bluhhh. But you can bring your beer up there if you're An adult. 

I didn't go to the upstairs bar. We ate at the main bar and grill. I got a French dip with fries. The beauty was the fries. Not quite steak fries but pretty this and well cooked. Perfect actually!  Hard to find fries this good around here. Kinda reminded Me of Red Robin fries. But better. 

The French dip was a 2. And I only give it a 2 because then bun was not soggy (thank you!) but the meat was quite sparse (2 thin pieces) and not fabulous. I don't think I've ever put salt on a French dip before.  Way mediocre. 

the two people who got burgers raved about them, 
(One chicken breast and one classic burger) didn't look fabulous to me but they say YUM and easy to eat  (looks like a potato bun - shredded lettuce) 

Great Place to take out of town visitors if they've got kiddos.  Otherwise, i personally would go somewhere smaller and less loud and hot 

Great service

This is my first time visiting a Habit Burger Grill and I was VERY pleasantly surprised. We ordered a teriyaki char burger, a cheeseburger, and the spicy fried green beans. The food was sooooooo good and I was shocked at how delicious the green beans were! Will definitely be back!

We always loved this location. However, whoever is cooking last night (10/01/21 9:20pm) has DROPPED THE BALL.  The photo shows what's in my cheese quesadilla with fried chicken, or I should call it cheese quesadilla with fried bread crumbs???   I am speechless.
This restaurant never disappoints. I try something different every time. Flavors are exceptional in everything. Probably my 5th time here. I came here because of other reviews. They were spot on.

Best sandwiches in the area hands-down! Really great meat quality (I'm super picky) and really creative flavors that are always a win! I always get the turkey with bacon and my husband loves the roast beef! The coleslaw and potato salad sides are just okay, so we opt for the chips! Highly recommend!

This was my first nail salon experience since moving to Idaho. I made and appt for a pedicure and dip manicure. I don't remember who helped me but I felt like the process was kind of backwards. She did the dip manicure first and then did the pedicure. Pedicure wasn't impressive at all and then I was rushed out with wet toes. So wet that even getting in my car one of my toes chipped. I didn't feel super comfortable so I just let it annoy me and left. The dip did last several weeks so that was a huge plus but I haven't been back. I would suggest doing pedicures first and then nails if you are doing each separately so toes can dry. Not sure I will return to this salon.

Things are really headed down hill for the springs. 
Between slide closures, malfunctioning equipment, bathrooms being closed for hours and the wave pool not working its getting a little bit silly.

Best bakery café they make the most amazing at eclair's pancakes sandwiches salads.  They use  top notch ingredients & everything is fresh!!! And you can use GrubHub or door dash. Be sure to support this local eatery. You won't be disappointed

This bank is basically a Wells Fargo masquerading as a credit union. They are unrelenting in their fees and very unforgiving. During the height of the pandemic I was transitioning from this bank to a different one. I took everything off automatic payments but forgot one. The bill was maybe $20. I had $15 dollars left in the cap Ed account. The bank paid the 5$ needed during the automatic payment and then charged me $35. More than the actual bill.. I called to ask if it could be forgiven, it was an honest mistake. The woman droned on and on that it couldn't. I said ok I'll pay it and I would like to close the account. She said I can't close accounts I'll have someone call you back. No one ever called me back. Next thing I know, I'm getting harassed by a bill collector for $35. Talk about petty.
Great staff and great deals! I have went there 3-4 times to furnish my house and always feel like I'm taken care of!

We love coming to Big Al's for family bowling.  Music,games, and food all in the same place!  This location however is progressively getting dirtier and less customer service oriented.  The kitchen and bar are stinky (smells like a greasy drain back by the restrooms) and many of the tables and chairs are greasy and dirty.  We had to wipe our own table before sitting down!  We love Big Al's!!!  Come on management!  Get your priorities straight!
Excellent service. Dropped watch off and it was ready the next day. Owner kept everything contactless. Reasonable price. Will be back with all my watch needs.

It's Wally World what can you say?  I can say plenty!!  The Wal-Mart's in the Treasure Valley absolutely have the WORST employees in the entire valley.  They know nothing, hear nothing, see nothing. 

After standing in line for 20 minutes, we tried to check out and my husband wanted some cigars.  We were told they only rang up tobacco products on isle 10.  We proceeded to 10, some lady was checking out a rather large cart, but at the very end she had a 6pack of Stella.  They HAD to call somebody because the cashier was not 21??  Say what??  We walked.  We will take our business back to Costco.  

I try to shop anywhere else but Wal-Mart!!  If they don't get their act together in the Valley, they will soon find their stores boarded up!

I brought our puppy in to get groomed for the 2 nd time, when we dropped her off we were told it would be  about 3 hours, okay that was fine her appointment was at 12  so I stopped back in around 245 to see how it was going and because my phone was in need of a charge and I didn't want to miss the call to pick up our puppy, they said she had been shampooed but was waiting for her cut. I went out and sat in the car came back in a half hour later the receptionist walked away and hollered Bee's owner was here again,  um yes my puppy is in there now for 3 and a half hours, they said oh she isn't cut yet it would be another 40 minutes . I asked for my puppy and said I would be happy to pay for the services rendered, I explained we did not live in the area and we could not wait any longer, I was nice about it and they did not charge me, but next time they are short handed call the clients and reschedule them or at least let them know you are short handed. I will not be back because customer service is as important as the work you do.

This is in my top 3 restaurants in the Treasure Valley! Great tasting food that is prepared and displayed beautifully on your plate. I had a dish with duck and shrimp. I forget the name. My wife had the salmon. I am not a big fish eater but I tasted hers and I end up finishing what she could not. It was so delicious! It is decorated very nicely. Service is very good. One of my favorite attributes is that it is not a noisy space. It has somewhat of a finer dining feel. Not old and rundown like some smaller Idaho restaurants. Great date night place! Enjoy!

This place is awesome!  Cant say enough good things about this place. A hidden gem literally. Sids Garage could learn something from this place as far as customer service. We will definitely be back! Kudos above and beyond!!

I cut down a huge 60' tall tree in my yard and wanted a way to cover the stump so I visited Rock Placing company in Meridian, ID.

I had used them 10 years earlier for another boulder project and was very satisfied with their prompt and professional service.

This time, they were very quick to respond and took the time to look up my previous project on Google Earth so they could match the type of rock I had used before. 

Their guys were on time and made quick work to place the 1500 pound granite boulders just where I wanted them using their large boom and claw.  They came in on budget and on time.

Great job Rock Placing Company...Thanks for helping to make my yard's landscape project a big success!
The worst location. Employees are rude, slow service and always making mistakes on orders. I would recommend driving further to find another location or starve.

We visit Kneaders on a regular basis because the baked goods there are as close to homemade as we can find in the area. The orange rolls are ridiculously delicious. In fact, that's why I'm writing this review. We had ordered two dozen orange rolls and another couple dozen dinner rolls for Thanksgiving dinner. When we arrived Wednesday evening for pickup, due to a bakery error, our rolls had been sold to another (lucky) party. Kevin and his wife apologized for the snafu and promised that they'd make it right.

They did.

The rolls were delivered to our home in plenty of time for turkey dinner, and they went the extra mile with a couple of goodies for our trouble. Kneaders' food is good quality and delicious, and our local Kneaders ownership understands business, building relationships, and helping customers. 

Run to Kneaders and get something--anything--and you'll be glad you did.

Suggestions:
- Orange rolls
- Key lime pie
- Berry pie
- Sourdough bread (Uncle Mike says it's the best he's ever had)

Enjoy!

Great food and environment!
I have been to Thailand,  and this place is on par!!
Definitely a good find!

Last night we watched the fights and had a great time! Aaron was amazing and it was clear and OBVIOUS that he was doing the MOST work! He was running around busting his butt while the others just sat behind the bar. Yes the other bar tenders were making drinks, but not once stepped out from behind the bar to help, even when people weren't getting drinks all but maybe 2 times? I've worked in the restaurant industry for a long time and know how things work. The others looked LAZY, Aaron did great A+++ for him!

Please Big Al's make the in dining ordering easier...your app system is next to horrible for large groups.  Probably ok for individuals or couples but not good for everyone else.  Thanks to the wonderful bartenders who helped out and placed the orders and got us on track.  They were incredible and deserve to be recognized as the only thing that kept us from leaving.  I get you are short staffed and this new system looks good, probably on paper, but when every restaurant at the Village has an hour wait and you guys are barely half full, there is something wrong.  I know we aren't the only ones who fought this crappy ordering app.  The food was still pretty good but you guys could do so much better on the customer experience.  It also wouldn't hurt to run out and wipe the tables and chairs down outside before the live band plays.  It was embarrassing to see how dirty it was, especially since we talked it up to our out of town guests we had with.  Don't blame it on not having enough people...I did see 4 of you standing around by the kitchen for quite a while...looked like managers too.  5 minutes and all the tables and chairs could have been nice and clean.  Management, please take some pride in what you do so your place can be enjoyable again.  We really enjoy coming for the live music but you make it look uninviting now.  7/2/21 dinner night with a group of 8.

Probably the best place I've gone in Idaho for nails so far at a reasonable price, but still didn't necessarily scratch the itch of a good nail place. I personally just got a pedicure - they did a nice job cleaning and the massage chair was excellent. Paid a little extra for a mud mask on my legs and idk if it really did much. They use gloves while they scrub your feet, which is probably better for hygiene but low key just make me more ticklish. I'll have to see how the mani's go!

If it matters to you, they speak good English

Going here, you should know that you're basically getting left-over BBQ which can taste good, but not consistently.  For BBQ, the food quality to price value is okay, but the kids they hire need to be drug tested more often.  They become easily overwhelmed if you order more than one thing and you can see that they are trying, but you need to expect your order to be wrong.  Go there with a family of 3 or 4 and forget it.  Food service is not for everyone and the three working today at lunch were proof of that.  I won't be going back.

My family and I have gone to this place for years, however we are done! I went in with my one year old . I was wearing a mask as requested they would not serve me without my baby wearing a mask,  a Baby really ? I blame the owner not the employees, bye bye.

There was nothing impressive about it. Everything was extremely average and the girl running the register was clueless. I love trying new places, but they gotta make sure that their staff is trained and know what's going on. They have a "promise of delight... let us know and we'll make it right". Well we ordered online and signed up to receive free cheesy bread (which is actually the best thing we got). The coupon never came to my husband's email, so he tried registering again except this time with mine. It still didn't work. When I went in, I explained how we registered twice and the coupon didn't arrive. The girl working just said, "well you have a coupon for next time if you want. I don't know how the specials work" and handed me my pizzas. I really feel, as a place that promises to make it right AND as a new joint trying to make it, that if someone mentions a coupon and then you give them the exact thing they just mentioned, then you apply it to the order and not wait till next time.  I really don't see us going there again. There's better family deals within the same mile radius and the food was nothing special.

I feel terrible that I can't remember the guys name, but Integrity Electrical really does stand behind their name. My business has used them twice now for electrical work, and the owner always shows up on time, does an excellent job, and at a reasonable price. I really appreciate how he takes the time to explain to me what he is doing, why he is doing it, and how he may be able to save me some money. Definitely my go to electrical guy!

This place was great. I was visiting from WY and was only in town for a few days. Even though they were booked solid, Chris was able to get me in last minute and turn my car around in less than 24 hrs. I got an interior detail only and they did a fabulous job (I had a lot of dog hair in the vehicle as well as dust). I was really pleased with their service.

Tyler was fantastic! I contacted him and the next day he came out to my apartment and fixed my windshield. He was very nice and professional. Called him back the same day to have my moms windshield fixed and he fixed hers the next morning as well. I'll definitely keep referring him to others!

4 years ago, in 2016, one of my three wisdom teeth poked through and needed to come out.
I saw my regular dentist, who said he could dig it out and pull it.  It didn't know there was a higher probability of complications doing this at 45 years old, so I let him do it instead of seeing an oral surgeon.
My husband was there after the procedure to take me home and said our dentist was acting strange and was overly concerned about my well being. Within 24 hours of the procedure, he called us 3 times to check on me. I knew something wasn't right when I couldn't feel the lower left side of my gums, lip and jaw by the end of the evening. And almost immediately pain set in.  A nerve had been damaged during the procedure, which it turns out was a risk going in and one of the reasons an oral surgeon should have performed this procedure.
There's no option for repairing this damage other than time, ice and medication.  There's one risky surgical procedure but not worth it as things could be made worse.
The problem with the mouth is that it's always moving.  Talking, eating, brushing my teeth, putting on lip gloss and kissing my husband are all uncomfortable.
As the nerve tries to heal itself the pain can be agonizing. Even the weather seems to effect it.
I found a way to strap an ice pack to my face in order to fall asleep at night.  We put a mini fridge in our bedroom so could keep multiple ice packs close by as by the end of the day I sometimes go through 3 or 4.  I take Gabapentin and pain medication every day, which does help but makes me feel like a zombie all day.

I met local surgeon recently who had the exact procedure and damage. He said it took 8 years for his mouth to stop hurting and for all of the feeling to come back.

Last week I had an itch on the left side of my chin for the first time since the incident. Slowly, but surely, the feeling is returning. It comes at a cost. There are days I'm absolutely exhausted from fighting pain all day.

Tim Hansen, DDS caused this damage. He never apologized or took responsibility for it. I know he didn't mean to do it, but he also had no business performing this procedure on an almost 46 year old woman.  I've been so angry about it for such a long time. He knew right away - right when he hit the nerve - that I was going to have issues for a long time and be in a lot of pain for years. Most of all, I miss kissing my husband.  I love to talk too! I know, after hanging with friends for several hours, I'm gonna have to get the ice going. My friends and family don't think anything of it when they see me holding ice to my face.  On a really busy work day, when I've been on the phone non-stop, there's often ice and tears.
Did I mention we still had to PAY for the procedure? Yeah, we should have sued. At least for what he took from me and the costs associated with medication and seeing other doctors for pain relief. Costs I still incur every single month.
I've never been one to blather about my aches and pains on line but If you need oral surgery, see an oral surgeon, not a dentist.  Even for something basic. And stay away from Tim Hansen's office.
That's my advice. Do with it what you will!

I am new to the area and my new place does not have an easy place for me to give my 60 lb Border Collie a bath. I took him to Shadow's Paw Wash and it was a great experience. The tubs they have are easy for the dog to get into and it was so easy to wash him. So good for my back! They had everything I needed and it was nice to not have to clean up too! We even did a nail trim while we were there. He was very squirmy because he hates getting his nails cut, but the staff was helpful and very patient. The price was so reasonable. I will definitely go back there - so convenient!
A great mix of quality food, cheap prices, and character. When I say character, Wally has it in spades. Great lunch today. Thank you.
I think everyone in fast food in the valley should have to go to this restaurant and train.  These employees are consistently the best in town.

We visited the showroom ready to spend a lot of money after doing research for weeks. We were immediately confronted by an employee who told us that a muzzle was required. I informed the employee that the county order does not apply in situations where 6ft can be maintained. She responded by saying that she knows the county order but it's the owners policy that we must wear a muzzle. I hope the owner knows we bought from their competition that very day. I still don't understand the logic where a business will literally destroy itself in order to not be destroyed. Muzzles are not only unsafe for me to wear, but requiring me to wear a medical device for entry also violates my free and equal access as described in federal and state civil rights laws. 

Just because the owner decided to violate my civil rights does not make it legal. Going above what even the crooked politicians "mandated" tells me a lot about the person behind the policy.

Why don't you allow your customers and employees to make their own health choices?

Reviewer #7

I heard about this place at work. Apparently they buy semi damaged, discontinued merchandise, or return items from  discount stores such as Costco. As I toured the isles I didn't see anything that made me want to come back here again. There isn't a significant savings, either. It's worth checking out once to see if it's something that you're interested in.
Great little place. The service, The food the atmosphere and the decor are all excellent. The owners work hard to make sure that you have a great experience.
Beautiful nails - went in for a mani/dip and nails look beautiful - Tony is the best!

I don't know what my problem is.  I live less than 10 minutes from this place, and I've only been there mebbe three times in the past two years.  Unacceptable.

Best burgers I've had in Treasure Valley.  I've had the mushroom swiss, and the Royale With Cheese (say it right, or order something else.)  Both were amazing.  They have other offerings, but.... I can't get over dem juicy, nicely seasoned patties.

The fries they serve are those great big steak fries.  I don't usually like that style, because it seems most places serve them kinda limp/soggy, and I can't stand limp/soggy fries.  These are.... like.... remarkably crisp.  I usually don't even care that much for good fries, but these are excellent.  Ask for fry sauce.

I need to go there more often.  You need to go there.  Now.  Stop reading, and go try one of their burgers!
Thought I would give the Habit a try, so I tried the Tri-Tip Steak Sandwich. I couldn't eat it because of the amount of grisil. I'll give them a second try by ordering a burger instead.

Sorry guys we aren't fans. Five guys behind the counter and things were still moving slow on a not so busy late afternoon. When we finally sat down to our meal there was instant disappointment with the sample size sides that accompanied our main course. The brisket was Luke-warm to cold and not very exciting, pork ribs were tender and a bit more flavorful. The fried okra was good and plentiful however the waffle fries were few and flat. At these prices we could have enjoyed a more filling and tasty meal elsewhere.

Looking around the dining area, it was obvious that the crew had no interest in the other aspects of keeping the place clean and in order. Food on the floor, dirty tables, bbq sauce and ice cream mess at the condiment bar.
I was looking forward to some lemonade however the machine was off and upon inquiring about it; the employee simply stated we are going to clean it so no lemonade. A strange time to clean a machine. Apparently they were getting a couple hours start on closing down for the day.

We won't be back!

Ordering the pizza online was a nightmare.  WORST online order experience ever.  Not user friendly.  After spending nearly a half hour to figure out how to place the order, I was given breadsticks instead of the pizza I ordered and paid for.

People usually ask me, " Do you go to Petsmart or Petco?"  I answer right away with Petsmart.   It's like the Coke versus Pepsi argument. To each their own, but my experiences at Petco, and I am referring to the new one at the Village hasn't been great.  I like my Petsmart because not only do I feel appreciated but our Siberian Husky loves how he is treated when he is there, and ultimately, it is his satisfaction that counts. So, why Petsmart? 

Two reasons. 

(1) Banfield Pet Hospital. It is very close by and the hours are fantastic. How fantastic? How about 7 days a week 12 hours a day and there's emergency after hours.  They have wellness plans that are very affordable. 

(2) The Grooming Department.  Here is where Petco failed in our opinion and why Petsmart is   where we trust to take Kody.   Petco has dedicate itself to have several groomers available on a daily basis and not just one person.  There are at least 6 to 7 groomers and assistants working when we bring in Kody. They greet him and love him like their own. This is critical for us and we appreciate how they treat him like a Rockstar.  The grooming department can even help you schedule with a favorite groomer and depending the breed they offer a free brush out a week after grooming.  There is also additional services like teeth cleaning and nail trimming.   


If you have a pet that needs to rock the diva look and you're not happy where you are going, make sure to check out Petsmart!  You'll be the smart one!

We drove by this place and had to flip around to come check it out! 

This is such a beautiful shop! So many fun gifts as well as gorgeous furniture. We only had about 20 minutes today, so I'm looking forward to going back to really explore the whole store. 

We were greeted by friendly staff as we walked in. It's a quiet, comfortable shopping experience. Definitely worth poking around if you're needing furniture or a gift!

Needed a windshield for my F-250 replaced. Got a great quote over the phone. They came out to my home the next day, and did the work when they said they would. Everything went great. Highly recommend.

My fiance and I went here and it was by far our worst dining experience in any place in the area, I think ever. The burgers and fries were delicious - but it quickly didn't matter. It was really staggering how terrible every other aspect was. 
The amount of time that passed between when we put our order in and when it actually appeared was about 45 minutes, no joke. For two burgers and 1 side of fries. We actually had to ask them to check on our order. Also, the table next to us that showed up after we did got their order before us. No communication from the staff whatsoever on the status of our order, and no offers to comp not even a single penny of what would turn into a ridiculously expensive meal. We sat outside, and turns out there are no lights at all on the patio, save for one on the very far corner, so pretty soon we were sitting in the dark, pissed off. It was not busy, there was no way our food should have taken half as long as it did. We were eventually told it was because the kitchen was "slammed with two parties of 5 and 6". Inexcusable really, and still no offers to make it right.
We had two build-your-owns, 1 side of fries (which did not come with the meal, instead was $2.50 extra), parmesan fries appetizer, and 2 beers, which ended up being $42. Far too much and also, you have no idea really what the price of the build-your-own is until you get the bill. 
Date night was ruined. Don't come here if you plan on leaving with anything left in your wallet, or if you have anything at all you plan on doing the rest of the evening.

I went through the drive thru about 20 min ago and I truly believe one employee in particular needs some customer service training. She had darker hair with some purple streaks. She was very rude, didn't say a word to me when she handed me my food and when I asked if I can get some bbq sauce she again didn't say anything she continued to hold the bag out the window so I grabbed it. She walked away and came back with a few of the bbq sauce, I ordered quite a bit of food so I asked if I can have a couple more and she threw he arm up half way as if I was such an inconvenience to her. She needs some serious training on how to give at least decent customer service.

Cooks and servers were not wearing masks. While everyone at my table has been vaccinated, have they? One server was wearing a mask. I gave him a $60 tip. It is all his. THANK YOU! I left one on the check too, but not nearly as much.

The food was decent, but will not be returning.

My wife and I visit this restaurant about twice a month. We have always enjoyed the staff and energy, especially Becca...thanks.  But unfortunately today will be our last visit. Strike 3!  I order the same meal EVERYTIME. I always get the Chicken en Mole $13.99 dinner.  Today's visit was such a let down from past experiences that we will no longer go back. My meal was sooooooo salty!  The Mole is typically supposed to have a spicy chocolate flavor....today's sauce was far from that.  Salt was th predominant flavor!  Not cool. When I politely mentioned it to the server, she removed my plate, which still had my entrè untouched (2 bites), and promptly brought us our bill w no adjustment or further discussion.  It didn't break the bank, but we also, as regulars didn't expect this level of service. 
FAIL!!   Bye-Bye
Best and most favorite for years!  Small and large groups.  Great service and fantastic food.

This place is wonderful. I used the drive-thru for my first visit. There's quite a few choices on the menu. Everything was so fresh and tasty. Very generous portions are a welcome return to value for you money and the great customer service is also refreshing! Prices seemed a little high until I saw what I received.

Tried This New Empanada Club Has a nice modern feel .
The place has assorted Empanadas Meat & Sweet Ones To choose from The meat are good but are lacking something maybe some type spice can't put my finger on it and their size are WAY TOO SMALL for the $$ .
The Sweet Empanadas are good suggest having more flavor choices . Oh and what goes with a sweet pastry ?   COFFEE , COFFEE  which they don't carry due to a drive thru place across the way, But WHO wants to go from one place to another to get Coffee and come back to enjoy their pastry right ?
They should at least carry Regular Coffee they don't have to get fancy with it and give their CUSTOMERS a choice .

My mom needed to update her Will and Living Trust. We knew that her previous lawyer had done the bare minimum. We were amazed at how well we were treated, impressed by the questions he asked and at all the documents he assisted us with (in addition to the Will and Living Trust). My mom now has her Estate Planning complete. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND Justin Jeppesen. He is fantastic!

My boyfriend and I had such an amazing experience tonight! We were seated promptly, greeted by our amazing waitress, and the food and drinks were amazing. Everything was distanced properly, the staff was masked up and overall we had such an awesome date night.

I just received the most beautiful flower arrangement from Meridian floral . Not only is it stunning the smell of these flowers is amazing. 
I can't get over how beautiful they are . 
Side note - the deliver girl was so nice !

My rating is a bit generous and would have been 3 1/2 if that was an option.  We had 2 burgers, fries, and onion rings.  The food was fresh and tasty.  I appreciated that the meat patty was thicker than places like Smashburger.  It was pricey but generally competitive with similar casual burger specialty restaurants.

If convenient it's a much better choice than all the major fast food joints and worth the wait for your food.

This is gunna be short and sweet so open up your lugholes....Marcos is your standard fair chain pizza joint. Pizza is never bad.. Marcos is good...it's pizza, get some and it will fill the craving, dinner for a night, or a quick call to shut the kids up.. I do like it better than some chains just don't expect it to be something crazy special and you'll love it. I did. Eat up boise!

We go here at least once a week. Absolutely love the chips and taco's. Every time my wife ask what we should make for dinner I always say Tin Roof Tacos.

Update: went tonight and I think they opened the foil and threw all the ingredients in there from across the room. Balled it up and sent it home with us.
We like to go here for family breakfast.  The location is convenient for us and the staff is usually very friendly.

We met with Gabriel in Feb of 2020 and we were told our yard would be completed within a few weeks. They did not "complete" the yard until May 2020, going into June for corner plants and now into July for replacement sod. They laid the sod dormant in April, on top of highly compacted clay soil preventing it from rooting properly. 

Gabriel is simply not a man of his word, and not willing to put anything into writing. If you text he calls, clearly not wanting a paper trial of his words. 

We are left with cement chunks in our rocks from where they were parking their trucks, we have cement splatters all over our brand new house, the expansion pad is already cracking, the decorative patio area is chunking and cracking, stain from decorative pad was splattered and left on regular patio. We were told they'd clean up the splatters on house, then said too bad its dried now nothing we can do. Told they'd order new sod to replace dead areas.... This was in May and it's been two months. The workers are sitting down over half the time smoking and chatting, left cigarette butts all over my yard and soda cans crushed on top of fence. Refuses to give an itemized list of materials and labor fees. 

At first I was recommending Gabriel to others, now I see how he treats customers once he gets paid and doesn't hold true to his word on things he says they'll be back to correct. Overall the decorative pad is beautiful, but not worth the mess left.
Update:  The manager contacted me and had me bring my car back and he cleaned it personally and offered me my money back.  I am impressed that they actually cared.  I will try them again.

I hired Treasure Valley Duct cleaning company to clean my ducts and dryer vent. They showed up in vehicle with no labeling, uniforms were t shirts and jeans, they didn't put on shoe covers, I shouldn't have to ask. They walk in shake hands, plug there rechargeable tools into my receptacle, there vacuum requires two receptacles so it doesn't trip the breaker. So you know, the vacuum is loud and inside your house, not in a truck parked outside They cleaned my ducts only about 6-8 feet in, their reasoning " that's where a majority of the dirt collects" and I had to request they clean my dryer vent from both ends. They essentially run a drill with a matted down brush that's about  6 or 8 feet long down the floor registers and dryer vent and then shove a 2-3" diameter vacuum hose down to suck up the dirt loosen by the matted brush.  I went back to check a few floor registers and there was still dirty in them. I called the owner/manager to talk to him about the quality of service and he has the service tech call me back...I asked to speak with the manager/owner. They overcharge for the extra vents, return or supply based on size, it didn't take them any longer, I should of questioned it at the time but I didn't want to get in an argument. . I ended up paying about $150 with the discounted coupon, it was $75 for the two extra return vents...in my opinion the service was worth about $50, it took two workers just about an hour. My loss is your gain

Really good food! Had a great sirloin and fries, topped with yummy onion crisps. Tasty Long Island Iced Tea. Not the greatest of wait staff as they seemed "too occupied" to help. Forgot my Long Island and got the check before finishing my meal and never offered anything else, or desert. I'd come back for the food in hopes for a better server.

Have you ever heard of an upscale to buje' McDonalds? Well this McDonalds has that atmosphere. When you walk in you stop to wonder for a second if you walk into McDonalds. the service is friendly and fast.  and the food is as good and fresh as any McDonalds. for fast food this is a good McDonalds to visit. in fact if it wasn't fast food I would have probably gave it 5 stars. When ordering breakfast this morning the manager asked if I would like a free coffee. it's nice to see good customer service at all levels that I want to earn your business.
Jackie is the best! He has great attention to detail and I have been looking for a nail tech and found the one since moving here from California thank you Jackie
Stopped here on my way to Washington from Utah. There were plenty of locals there which is always a good sign.

I returned here for the last day of the Burger Rama. It was not as good as the last visit. The "Count Von Count" (Garlic Burger) was good, but just didnt quite live up to the first time.

I think its like the 1st kiss when you are in love and that love is new. There is just nothing like that 1st kiss. You build it up in your mind over time. When you get it, its heaven. While the 2nd and subsequent kisses are good, they often just dont quite measure up to the 1st one.

This is why when I find a really good place that I like, I sometimes intentionally dont return for awhile. I want to experience that 1st kiss of that burger that I fell in love with again.

Unfortunately, my Count Von Count burger is going away, so I might have to wait a long long time to have that experience again that I loved so much.

I am told that 3 of the burgers from the Burger Rama are staying, but none that I liked. Im assuming that means they are going back to the old boring menu.

If you like a good burger, the ones here are pretty good, but be careful of prices. They are expensive and sometime weird things tend to sneak into your check.

For example, I went here today with my 13 year old daughter and her 12 year old friend. I had a buy-1-get-1-free burger coupon. 

Even with this coupon, our bill was over $40! I deducted 2 stars from my review because of 2 things.

First - The price of burgers and food here is high compared to their competition.

Second -  My daughters friend wanted Tater Tots instead of fries. Little did I know that Tots are extra. Not only are they extra, but $2 extra. Im willing to bet that the food costs of a tot and a fry are pretty similar, if not exactly the same. 

I felt....violated at this, especially since I was not told of this extra expense.

There are only 3 other places in town that I know of where you can get a good burger (Prepared on a grill. Not on a flat top) 

The # 1 spot still belongs to Famous Daves BBQ. They use a nice combo of Brisket and Beef and char broil em.

The #2 spot belongs to Red Robin. This is mainly because of their huge selection of burgers both chicken and beef and bottomless fries. They are pretty consistent here, but even here, you can get an occasional dud.

The #3 spot belongs to "The Counter" in the village. This is mainly because the offer Build You Own burgers and they offer a lot of different ingredients from which to choose. But they can get pretty pricey, so be careful.

#4 The Ram gets the #4 spot mainly because they have a nasty tendency to be inconsistent. Some days their burgers deserve the top spot, while other days they drop off the charts completely. Also because of their pricing and sneakiness.
The chicken tender taco was good but I wasn't a fan of the pulled pork or fish one I got
The fries were awesome, cool to have different choices of potato type and dipping sauce. The burgers were okay, nothing special but not bad either.

We are briefly in town and have a flight out early early in the morning so we decided to stay in the hotel and order from the Ram through Uber Eats. There was a mix up with the burger but we contacted the restaurant and they brought us a new burger right away. The hubby was very excited when he opened up the box and saw the perfect burger. Highly recommend for the food and customer service!

We used to come quite often to Big Als and have always enjoyed ourselves and have gotten good service. Tonight was horrible. You don't get service. You have to go up to the bar and wait in line for 15-20 minutes to place an order for dinner including drinks. They then give you a number. Once our food arrived I noticed we were missing tots. I went by the kitchen and let the lady know. She rudely 10 minutes later brings over some kind of potatoes in a skillet and tells us "on our end we showed you ordered these"! We nicely told her it was incorrect and she said well this is what you ordered. We told her we didn't want them because we didn't order it. She got pissy and removed them and we never got our tots. Anytime we needed a water filled you have to go wait in line again. We had $100.00 ticket between the 3 adults and 3 kids. We were so disappointed as this was our weekly go to spot during football season where we typically spent almost $200.00 each Sunday. We won't be back and will be finding a new spot.
Good food if this your style of Mexican cuisine. Not bad at all, just not my preferred style. Generous portions.

District Manager please tell me how a manager can leave on Labor day weekend Sunday night one waiter for the whole restaurant for 2 hours we went at 1030 pm super busy only 2 waiter now  staffing was Great attitude and hard workers cooks did  great job food perfect once again second time I'm here. But still No manager. That's wrong of him I saw a lot of people tired of waiting left.

All the Walmarts I've ever been too have been a haven for chaos, crime and rude people. Because of this, I never thought I'd actually spend the time reviewing a Walmart. 

My very first time there, I had traveled at 11 o'clock at night. First off, I was blown away by how incredibly safe it was (which speaks volumes for the whole of the area as well). When I walked in, I couldn't believe how clean, organized and relaxed everything felt. It was as if everyone had been shopping at 12 o'clock in the afternoon, like it was the most normal thing. The staff was very personable and pleasant. I was promptly assisted (with a smile) and when I couldn't find the item I was searching for, the staff member led me right to where the item could be found. Since then, my family and I had shopped here a second time and our experience was just as pleasant. 

This is by far the best Walmart I've ever shopped at.

Going to the McRae Dental office is always a positive experience for me.  The staff is so friendly and professional.  I always feel like I'm in someone's beautiful home... love the bathrooms!  Seriously, I appreciate the time that is spent on me and how well my procedures are explained.  I have always been taken care of and have appreciated the team effort that is put into every visit.  Thanks guys.....

Once a week our business orders lunch for the entire staff (approximately 10 people)  About once a month we give our business to Fat Guys Deli.  (which may not happen ever again)  The guy who answers the phone is extremely rude.  A person who answers the phone to a business should be professional to say the least.  When asked if we could order cookies, he stated "we don't have any and I am not going to make you any"  
The sandwiches at Fat Guys Deli are not the best to begin with and I would definitely take my business to another sandwich shop that has nice staff.  Who knows this could have been the owner of this establishment.  I know when we spend in excess of $100 for lunch, staff should be to say the least "kind"

Stopped by to see some familiar faces at Two Guys Cookin' at the Meridian Bike Shop!  Awesome big ol' tacos, two tri tip and one chorizo. The tri tips were awesome but the chorizo was simply perfection!

this was kind of a "meh" experience for me and my dad. we came in for lunch because they had a coupon and an ad in the magazine they deliver to your house. without it we might have never even seen the place. it's tucked back in the corner of a strip mall and is surrounded in patio. 

I think our first regret was coming for lunch. no one was in there, which should have been our first sign. the server was friendly and easy going but she told us they were "out" of 2 different things. the whole reason we came was the rueben in a bunch of the pictures on here that she told us they stopped making a couple months ago. whatever. 

I had the blue cheese burger with no bun. it came on this weird wooden board. I don't know how they properly sanitize those. i'm not going to think about it. my dad ended up getting the soup and salad because they didn't have anything he wanted. the soup was whatever and the salad was a basic caesar it wasn't anything to write home about.

to me, places like this should be something to be excited about and i'm sad to report I found nothing unique or special about it. that's just my opinion. 
we won't be back. the coupon saved us $4.

Ordered at drive thru - took 15 min to get to the window and then were told to park out front in the waiting spots that were already full...had to wait another 20min just for Chow Mein but they didn't give us the rest of the order even though they had that ready. The server brought out the food but as we checked the bag we had the complete wrong order and she gave our order to
a different customer who was already driving off. She started sprinting and waving at the van and of course failed to get their attention... she then came back and told us she'd be right back out with the correct order of food ... so we we're waiting AGAIN. After another 15min we went to check INSIDE the restaurant and discovered she completely forgot about us as customers. We waited at the front for 20 min and they didn't help us for almost 5 min. We finally got the food and in total waited OVER an hour ... absolutely ridiculous. Never come here on a Sunday they have horrible service. We weren't even compensated for the horrible service.

I was quoted $1333 to do everything I wanted to my hair when they were finished I paid almost $1400 I ordered my hair on a Friday and Erica said something came up and she could not put it in Thursday like we had planned and that she would fit me into schedule and I told her OK let me know and she never texted back I texted her multiple times and she would not reply and then when I did finally get my hair done they done a horrible job of putting the extensions in. 
the extensions in my real hair did not match they toned my hair to a color I did not agree to I am very upset with the customer service and I am very upset with the way my hair came out for $1400 I would not recommend going to this salon and not to mention I was definitely over charged on the extensions there self they were $1,023 alone then the toner and putting the extensions in was the rest

I hadn't been to Roaring Springs in probably ten years. In that time the park has expanded and offered new slides, additional amenities and the ability to go back and forth between them and Wahooz. We were in the park for a birthday celebration. We had cabanas and discounted food, which was AWESOME. The girls took great care of us. The park was very clean and easy to maneuver. The new attractions were fantastic too, offering diversity for all patrons. That is about where the positive stops. 

A new addition that had been added was getting weighed at each slide. I wouldn't have such a problem with if it were accurate across the board. Even soaking wet, would maybe be another 1-2 lbs max. I get that the park is trying to minimize injury and keep patrons safe. My boyfriend and I were enjoying the park together and each time we were weighed, it was completely different. We came in at 398, 402, 404, 405, 407 and 408. At one point, we were kicked off a ride that we had ALREADY been on meeting the weight requirement and when we came back up to step on the scale again, it was TEN pounds difference over. Pretty sure that in 30 minutes we didn't not gain weight. The lifeguard told us we had to go down separate and made us weigh again. These scales need to be calibrated on a more consistent basis and as hard as it is for many to get in a bathing suit, their weight shouldn't be in display for everyone to see either.

After doing some research of local detail companies I decided to go with Dynamic Detail. I was in the process of putting my car up for sale and wanted a good interior/exterior detail. Chris and his team were so easy to work with, accommodating, very efficient and did a fabulous job. The buyer of my car was so impressed with the cleanliness of the vehicle. I will definitely recommend Dynamic Detail in the future. Thanks guys!
BISON BURGERS! YUM!  and the garlic aoli, arugula and bacon. Laura fries and fry sauce.  Tried the blueberry ketchup but not for me.
Good service and staff is very attentive. Food is good presentation and taste. Overall the bill is a bit on the expensive side for a breakfast spot but good for an occasional splurge.
Professional and meticulous attention to detail. Veteran minded. Friendly staff. Fun atmosphere and great app to book appointments etc. I go every two weeks minimum.

Tried to find a printer in the electronics department.  Found the empty spot where the printer I wanted once inhabited. Asked the clerk about it. I swear she turned her back on us as she was talking, and said, "it's not here."  I waited several beats for her to suggest perhaps checking to see if they had anymore in stock...didn't happen. So I inquired. "No," she said with her back still turned to us, "if it isn't on the shelf, we don't have it." And then she walked off into Walmart oblivion.  Surly customer service seems to be epidemic. I really try to buy locally, but it's as if local stores dare you to spend your money at their store and you feel so grateful if finally find some one does his or her job. So, from now on, whenever I need anything other than food, I will buy it on Amazon where I receive excellent customer service and competitive prices.

The product was great but we have never been treated so unkindly. The associate by the name of Susan (who to be fair had a long line at the beginning of our visit  to the store and was in a poor mood) was our cashier. We got to the check out snd placed our items, she did not treat the items with respect, and as we were trying to put products on the belt she did nothing to help the posters that were falling when she could have grabbed them (hard to explain but was deliberately unhelpful). We had balloons we mentioned to her and placed in front of her and when she gave us the total my mother asked, did you get the balloons? she groaned and very rudely said I wish you would have told me that before I rang them, these are the first words she had said to us the whole time. And my mom and I were both surprised by how rude and she apologized and said she was sorry and didn't realize she didn't see them, and then Susan proceeded to complain about having to go back in scan them claiming she couldn't do that, in an effort to make it easier my mom offered to do a separate transaction. She ignored us,and put the balloons on (Which apparently she could do). she handed the receipt to my mom aggressively and made no eye contact. My mother wished her a good day and she completely ignored her. She was rude, cold, and showed 0 effort in doing her job well.

What a joke for Mexican food. They need some SoCal Mexicans to come into the Boise area and a mediocre SoCal restaurant would be 5-star here. Super salty meat. Whatever you do, don't order the enchilada-like ranchero tacos. Margaritas sucked. Everything sucked.

Friendly staff and high quality grooming! We've had a few bad experiences at the last groomer we used for our 1 year old medium goldendoodle and were nervous to try a new one. When we got there, our pup was a little anxious (and so were we) but the groomer Sam came out and talked to us for 10 minutes about what we wanted for his haircut. It seemed like our needs and wants were being taken seriously and it was important for them to have our dog feel comfortable there. We will be returning for sure!

Stopped by for a leisurely lunch.  Had a club sandwich while the wife had her broccoli cheddar soup in a bread bow.   Ummmmm, good!

Quick, pleasant service makes this place a regular stop for us.  Nothing says "Idaho" quite like Kneeders!
Great service great coffee and great speed of service that's all you can ask for and they do it all!! Wish they accepted tips they deserve it!!

Check this spot out!
This place was so delicious!
This is the place that reminds me of New York deli's.
Idk what it is about New York but they do deli meet right, as does Hugo's!

So fresh!
Will be back so very soon!
(We went back the very next day)
The best fries
Best sandwiches 
Best fry sauce, boyfriend bought a bottle of it.
I got the Rueben and my boyfriend or the racheal
The next day we tried the Hugo special and the Louie.
We both ate the whole sandwich and enjoyed every bite.
Great staff
Clean building

Ordered pizza for delivery waited an hour and nothing so I called. Turns out driver got lost they didn't input my info correctly so I go pick up our order. Manager Isreal (sp?) apologized and completely took care of the cost and added cheese bread and cinnabread since we waited so long and had to eventually pick it up ourselves. Not often I give a good review after such a fiasco but she made it right and we will keep going there based on her actions. Thanks!!

We stopped in for a quick happy hour after work.  Turns out neither my husband or I liked the happy hour drink options.  They do not offer a well margarita so my husband ordered a double patron margarita.  It was the worst $16 margarita we've ever paid for.  He told the waitress as feedback when she asked how everything was.  She offered to trade his drink but said that all the bartender had was margarita mix.  Bottom line... do NOT go to the Ram if you're into margaritas.  This is definitely not a top contender for best happy hour in town.
If you're looking for authentic street tacos, at super cheap prices, this is the go to spot! The food is always fresh, with little wait time! Highly recommend!

If I could give zero stars I would. I have never had worse service ever! We got to big Al's excited to bowl. The wait time was over two hours, no big deal. Well just go walk around the mall. We saw that Saturday's were $2 bowling for kids, put our name down around 4:30 and went and enjoyed our time around the mall. As it got closer to our time to bowl we decided we'd just eat there. After ordering our food we got the text that a lane was open for us. My husband took our older kids to go bowl and I sat with my baby to wait for the food. Guys. It's took them over 30 minutes to bring the food. Ok whatever, sometimes things are slow. I get it. They drop off the pizza. No plates. 3 minutes later a girl drops off the wings. Still no plates. I started timing at this point, I asked a girl walking by for plates because at this point I haven't seen my waitress in over 40 minutes. The girl never returned with plates . More time goes by and I ask to speak to the manager. I still have no plates by this point. Finally the manager shows up, he was nice but when I told him I had been waiting 25 minutes for just plates, he didn't say anything. Like didn't even seem to care. Didn't even offer a complimentary drink. It took over an hour from the time we were sat to when I got the final thing I ordered. AN HOUR! That's not even an exaggeration, I had a sleeping baby and nothing to eat so what else am I going to do but time how long until someone brings me a simple plate. 

At this point my husband lets me know that because it took two hours for us to get a lane, we missed the $2 bowling. Not a big deal, it was definitely our responsibility to read the super tiny print that was very visible. Honestly, if the food hadn't been such a disappointment, I wouldn't be bugged about how god awful the bowling prices are  ($5 a game AND $5 shoe rentals) but by that point the whole experience was ruined for me. We spent over a $130 to be treated like garbage by the wait staff and have a manager that didn't seem to mind.

You would think this review would be over, right? I mean what else could possibly go wrong at this point. To be fair, the family bathroom was clean, but no toilet paper. Like for hours. On top of that there was no soap in the men's bathroom and my husband told multiple employees, it took them over 2 hours to put soap in the bathroom. 

Honestly, I'm just flabbergasted that we spent so much money and had such a terrible time. My kids loved bowling there, so there was a bright side, but I don't know I'll ever be able to bring them back. We'll look for a smaller, better run bowling alley next time. And we won't be returning to go to the arcade like we planned.
Thank you, Ha, for my beautiful Christmas nails!! I love the sparkly new dip colors. Such a variety to choose from too!! Great salon and service!!
I personally had a great experience here!! I got dip nails and they were absolutely beautiful and stayed on for like 4 weeks!!! I would recommend and go back myself.
This place has some of the best breakfast food I've ever had. Not to mention the burgers or the Philly cheese steak which are both to die for!

If you're a gambling person, and open to trying anything on their menu, this is the place. 

Cause the likelihood of actually receiving what you order at this location is unlikely. 

Even after saying twice initially, repeating it again where you pay, and then once you receive the food. 

High fives all around. 

Sad to hear my 5 year old say, " they tricked us again dad". 

Smh

Went in around 1 hour to closing with my girlfriend and ordered 3 burgers, fries and a shake. The staff was VERY friendly, we ended up waiting til close for our food. A staff member came to our table and asked if we were waiting for anything and we gave them our receipt, and their heart sank. The order didn't go through on their system and they already shut off the grills, I told them it was okay and I could just get a refund so they didn't have to turn everything back on. They promptly said it was no problem and fired up the grills, and proceeded to make the absolute best burger I've ever had. They gave us coupons for free burgers for the mistake and were very apologetic. I will definitely be returning, the food was ridiculously good, my girlfriend and I couldn't believe it. Best burgers for the price in town! Can't wait for our next visit.

This place has an amazing atmosphere. The coaches are extremely helpful (no matter how many questions I keep asking). In less then an hour and I'm dripping in sweat and I don't even need weights to get the best workout that they can dish out.
My favorite pizza joint. Local and delicious.  I know its lame but I love the pepperoni.  Nothing fancy but so good. Also their salads and wings are great too!

Availability for appointments is good. Environment is clean and relaxing. Good options for services (dip, gel, colors etc). Only complaint is that both times I've had my nails done, with different colors, the color seems to be diluted so it is uneven on my nails. The first time I though it was just the color I chose, but then it happened again. If they are diluting the product to make it last longer this compromises the quality of overall.

The burgers here are good. Really really good. Not a huge fan of the rest of the menu... lacks something pretty much menu wide. There is a bartender there (younger, female) who makes one of the best bourbon sours I have ever had. Bar none. The other servers are not able to match her. Steaks are perfectly cooked. Just a bit small for the price. 5 star if we can get the rest of the experience dialed in.

Was a favorite of mine when living in CA but it is just average - at least at this location.  

Burger was sloppy with way too much Mayo and it was cold.  Fries were unseasoned. Malt was okay but not with real ice cream so kind of icy.  

No need to try again as there are a number of better burger joints near by.

I've always received good service at all the Zamzows I've visited. However, this is a review for the class I attended this weekend and the instructor, Christopher.
When it comes to lawn and garden I am the worst variety of nerd. I have no natural talent nor basic skills. After this harsh winter, our lawn and plants took a beating. We had large "crop circles" of dead grass on our lawns that looked as if aliens had landed. We found out from an associate at Zamzows, that this is called "snow mold"...who knew?  She recommended their Saturday lawn class and I am so glad I went!!!
Christopher is both a biologist and horticulturist. His expertise is amazing.  He shared with his audience everything you needed to know about growing plants or keeping lawns healthy without using industry jargon or being too general. You could tell that he enjoys what he does and really understands the ecosystems in our area.  He kept the care plans simple and the products are both natural and easy to use. As he went along, he answered individual questions and offered useful solutions.  He was concise and direct, which I always appreciate. There was no upselling of Zamzows products...you could use whatever you like. But I prefer their fertilizing plan which is only $99. a year and takes care of all our lawn needs. They even send you email reminders to let you know when to pick up the next bag of fertilizer and when to apply it.  What I like best about their products is that they are not toxic to people or pets....and will not stain your driveway.
After attending this class, I feel better educated and really understand how each product works, not only to make our lawn green, but to enrich and augment our soil.  I appreciate Zamzows approach to gardening and customer service.

Came here last weekend, and the food and service was great, my husband loved the double IPA, and the fish and chips was some of the best I've had not near the coast! however we were sat extremely close to the kitchen where we could hear one of the chefs making vulgar sexual remarks towards the young girls working. I'm unsure if management is aware of this behavior, but the restaurant otherwise provided a wonderful atmosphere.

They get 2 stars because the service was good. The food on the other hand was not. This is the restaurant we come after church and family events. The last few times we have noticed the standard going down with the food. Tonight was my birthday and I chose to go here. The first annoying thing is they have sparking water on the menu for 2.99. It's the first thing I ask for, the waitresses never know about it, today I was given the carbonation from the soda machine. Then the food came out I order fish and chip, the fries tasted like they were reheated. My husband ordered soup and salad, his soup was cold. Then I noticed the kitchen area, they had cooked food like fries sitting under the heat lamp and then using them for orders. Which is why my fries tasted old. So we have decided we are done with this Ram.

I went to Boise dermatology for botox. My usual dermatologist (who doesn't offer botox) recommended Dr. Naomi Brooks. It was my first time and I was nervous. Dr. Brooks spent a lot of time with me explaining the procedure, how to works, what it costs, and what she would recommend. The cost structure is upfront and very reasonable . She performed the procedure herself (not the nurse or PA). The results are amazing!
I would highly recommend Dr. Brooks and will be going back. Thank you Dr. Brooks!

I just had my first check in after the initial spraying and have been very pleased with Vanguard. Two different technicians have come out and both were very knowledgeable, friendly, and efficient. Even after the first preliminary spraying we've experienced a significant reduction in the amount of spiders and earwigs in the house/basement. 

It's a little pricey ($89 every three months, +$350 a year) but they'll come out any time between the quarterly visits for no additional charges if the product breaks down and bugs start getting in. And you can make some money back with referrals. 

Best part was they were very mindful of the honey bees we had in the garden on the back of the house and didn't spray on the first visit, since the first "real" visit was going to be in cooler temps and the honey bee activity was reduced.

It's Panda Express. It's fast food American-style Chinese food. We went last night. 

It was incredibly busy on a Sunday night so it can't be that bad.

They're young people (most 21 & under?) and a couple seemed a little flustered (due to so much happening in such a short time) so I think they did fine. They're still learning and they were friendly and stayed on task so those are all wins!

Yes the noodle (chow mein?) side was almost out so we had to wait for more to be cooked.

Yes the spring rolls were being cooked when we happened to decide we wanted a couple of those after eating the rest of our meal. 

But we got fresh food and the manager? directed the cashier to ring up the spring rolls as if we'd ordered them at the same time as the rest of our food, so it was 25% cheaper than the price on the menu for 2 spring rolls.

We were able to go support a guy who decided to repent and be baptized for the forgiveness of his sins in accordance with Acts 2 (and Romans 6 and plenty other Acts examples after Jesus rose from the dead) of what shall we do when we realize our sins put a sinless person on the cross. 

And we barely can even afford to eat out and it was food that tasted good served by friendly young people so it was all good to us!

Did a good job on my Australian shepherd but was very expensive. Was unaware just how expensive it was going to be until she was finished. I wished she would have updated the estimate prior to completing the grooming services.
The food quality is not the same as the downtown location. There's usually one person cooking and the food just isn't good. I'll only visit the downtown location from now on.

If you want delicious authentic mexican food, try the  best Mexican restaurant in downtown Meridian. Super friendly and fast service.  There is a reason this restaurant has been around downtown for so long. Great tasting food bursting with flavors in every single bite.  Give it a try.  You won't be sorry

Basic maintenance is a must to get the most out of your vehicle. Manufacturer maintenance is a very important also.  All vehicles will need repair/service eventually and yes this can really sting financially. I have a friend in CA with exactly the same vehicle as I and we discuss prices for parts and service. So finding a trustworthy establishment with manufacturer certified computer software and mechanics is a must.  When it comes time for any of these services, I trust and can recommend Christian Brothers Automotive on E. Calderwood in Meridian. They have always lessened the inconvenience of having my vehicle in for service, Richard the manager is conscientious and provides a prompt shuttle service if need be. The front desk personnel are knowledgeable and will communicate with you about your vehicles status.  Parts and labor are guaranteed.  I have had my truck in for manufacturer scheduled service and repairs a couple of times now and am very satisfied with their work.  Also their prices for service are in line with other top tier vehicle repair establishments.

Stopped in over the weekend to order a Giant Baker and was told by the kid behind the counter THEY WERE OUT of baked potatoes!! WTF?!?! We're in IDAHO and NO POTATOES??? No wonder why the store was empty!!

Love this salon! I'm new to the area and went here based on reviews. I am happy I chose this place. It's extremely clean, the environment is fun with the way the employees interact with their customers, and they do excellent work. Will definitely be back!

I've been going to Crossfit Fireside since spring of 2017, and this community is something else! Every athlete welcomes eachother (new or veteran to the gym) with a smile, handshake and introduction. They each genuinely care about one another. Coming together to cheer eachother on in WOD's, competitions, and in life (both good and not so good) without question. I've never met a gym where cliques aren't a thing and everyone is your biggest cheerleader!

It was ok. I've heard a lot of hype about this place so was excited about how amazing it was going to be. It was ok and I wasn't hungry afterwards but I wasn't blown away by the service or the food. I'll give it another try but I'm not in a hurry to run back
This nail spa is very clean and relaxing.  My nail tech was delightful! She gave me the best pedicure I've ever had.  My feet feel amazing.

I needed to fix a couple of nails badly as I had just gone to a place that totally ruined my nails. I scheduled an appointment and went in and got put with a gentleman named Jackie. He was so knowledgeable about how to get my dip powder fixed and keep them stronger for longer it was amazing. The owners were there and one of them must have thanked me 10 times for being there and reminding me to let them know if I thought something wasn't how I wanted it. The salon is clean and the people are kind and that will give anyone 5 stars in my book. Definitely the place I will be going for however long I stay in Boise
This place rocks.... great variety of tacos for everyone! Serving ice cold beers and delicious chips and guacamole and quest!

Food was ok. Service was poor. They ask for your name so they can call you up. After 45 minutes of waiting I asked if my food was done and they had it set on a shelf behind the counter. They never once called me up. I think the service would have better if the guy with the long hair was not trying to tell everyone jokes. I get that there are people who enjoy that kind of customer service but not at the expense of forgetting to call someone up.

I got my conch piercing with Laura and she was FANTASTIC. She made me feel really relaxed and explained everything very clearly. She was such a calm presence. The rest of staff were also super friendly and ready to answer any questions. Can't recommend them enough. Thank you all!

This hotel is not set up for COVID. Even though Hilton says that the hotels are safe, there was no hand sanitizer anywhere in the lobby. Breakfast is the same as it always has been with a Buffet and people sitting 2 feet away from you. 9 people in a hot tub. They make you sign a paper just to say what type of car you have. No protection screen. No Masks. And no signs to stay away from each other. I was very surprised that in a city the size of Boise and a hotel brand like Hilton they were not more prepared.

The staff at this Qdoba are shockingly rude! I visited this location, and even though I and my daughters were the only ones in the whole place they were sooooooo slow. 

Out of everything on the front line (it was only 6:30 pm) Instead of making more grilled veggies they scraped the bottom and put 2 pieces of onion and one lone green pepper on my burrito. The meat was all dried out. I ordered a kids cheese quesadilla as well. Which came burnt. And rock hard. 
The water out of the soda machine has a horrible nasty metal poison aftertaste.

I took my kids to use the bathroom before we left. Although there was nothing to be seen the ladies bathroom stunk! And I mean it smelled like backed up plumbing. Disgusting!
