Upon arriving home, and saying to myself I am NEVER going to that dump again. I realized my 6 year old had left her hat there. I tried calling repeatedly and no one ever answered the phone. I called again in the morning, and again NO answer. 

So I drove back down there. I asked the girl at the front. She ACTUALLY rolled her eyes at me, and said she would look in the back office. She left the front and I could see her standing in the back area. She did NOT check, just stood for a few seconds then came back and said it wasn't there.
I politely asked her to check again, as my daughter had just recieved it as a christmas gift and was quite upset that she left it behind. She then very rudely shouted across the whole restaurant to another employee if hed seen a hat. He was clearly startled at being screamed at, and meekly shook his head no. Then the girl says "well there you go, we don't have it"
What an awful place. You couldn't pay me to step foot in that disgusting, stinky place. NOT WORTH IT!

Nope. This place used to be good but something changed. The past 4 times we've gone here hoping for those authentic Mexican food flavors and our food has fallen flat each time. The sauce is Orange gravy. So so so bland. My boring white kids ordered fries and even the fries were bad...came out still frozen and unseasoned. Super disappointing! And the prices are high! I just want good enchiladas ugh. Los Betos are the best in town and they're basically fast food!

I can tell if a meal is going to be good if the egg rolls are good. Outstanding egg rolls! Tried the pho, which had a lot of flavor and tender meat. My husband tried the grilled chicken, also great flavor. Portions are generous and prices are good. Staff is very nice and friendly. Decor has been updated since the last tenants and looks great. We'll be back!

I have nothing but good things to say about this place. I grew up in a predominantly Vietnamese community and this was like a little taste of home for me. Their Pho has a great flavor! The staff was nice and the restaurant was very clean. I will definitely be coming back!
Fantastic!! Everything is always fresh and delicious. Customer service is amazing. My favorite Thai restaurant.
Easily among the top taco spots we've found since we moved to Boise.  Great people, great ambience, fast service - and super yummy tacos to boot.  They deserve five stars easily.
Amazing! Love the atmosphere and the staff. The empanadas are phenomenal. Fresh and so full of flavor.

The tacos are great and our experience would have been wonderful if the place had been cleaner.  We were at the Meridian location and it was very dirty. We were there at about 2:30 pm on Saturday and it wasn't even half full (i.e. not very busy). The tables and chairs had not been wiped down in some time and the floor was greasy and had bits of food all over. The tray return and garbage can were especially dirty. There were a lot of flies as well. 

A bit more attention to cleanliness would be much appreciated!

Update:  while writing my review I watched a young staff member organize chairs and attempt to wipe the tables. His efforts amounted to wiping the food around and onto the seats of the chairs. Then I witnessed him, dirty rag in hand, place more plastic lids for soda cups in the small lid holder near the soda fountains. Clearly more training of staff on proper cleaning and generally accepted hygiene practices is needed.
A solid 4 stars. Great chips. Nice and thin. Had the chimichanga and us was very good and full of meat. I like my Mexican food a bit spicier, but still very good.
Great breakfast sandwich- quick, friendly and easy ordering.  Great alternative to drive through places

By far the worst nail salon I've ever been to. It's a complete chop shop. They want to get you in and get you out as fast as possible and take no care in your nails. The person I had was so into her conversation with a co-worker she wasn't even looking when she cut my finger really deeply. What did she do after it wouldn't stop bleeding? Put two applications of glue into my nail and skin as a "fix." If you don't care about your nails, safety or the way you are treated (not even offered water), then this is the place for you!

I love this place! The salon is stunning.  I only wish it was a little closer to me as I hate the traffic around the Village. 
I've been to this salon multiple times and always had the best experience.
Emma has done my dip nails and they are always perfect. Yesterday, I had the best pedicure. They always offer complimentary drinks and chat with you to make you feel welcome. 
Literally, the only salon in town I've never had any problems with.

Food is really really bad, especially for the price. They won't let you put your name on the 2+ hours waitlist over the phone. And it's not our first experience of our bowling lane kind of broken. Overall I'm dissatisfied with my visit every time and it seems like it's getting worse.

LOVE Nail Tek & Spa. It took me a long time and several nail studios before i landed at Nail Tek & Spa; now i won't go anywhere else! They're efficient, reasonably priced, and guarantee their work. They have soo many Gel colors. I've recently switched to dip and my nails look better than ever. A+++ ! 5+ stars

Date night! Yay! Where to go? How bout Big Al's we haven't been there in forever. Let's play some shuffle board and have some beers and a good meal! That was what we thought as we headed out. First, only a bartender upstairs in the bar. College football playoffs on and it's about to be busy. We sit at the table by the shuffleboard but have to move because it's way too wobbly. We go to the bar to order beer. We go to the bar to order food. Wait for awhile. The place is busy and this poor guy is on his own. Our food comes. No silver wear offered. The waitress from downstairs just drops it off. I wait in line to ask for silverware. No one checks on us. Good thing the food was ok or we'd still be waiting. Now I'm in line to order another beer. No one sees me. It's been 10 min. I'm over it and I think we'll go somewhere else and probably not come back. Sat night, they really should have a waitress up here. Oh and can't play shuffleboard the lights on the table are out. Makes it hard to enjoy.

Got a daith piercing from Victoria, best experience I have had with a piercer and piercing place ever. Victoria was very professional and assuring when doing my piercing, she explained everything she was doing while the piercing. The overall vibe of the shop is amazing and the worker at the front was very helpful. Will definitely be coming back for any future piercings
Wow amazing great food. If your looking for a empanada with flavor, best place in town. You won't be disappointed!!!

Sorry to say the quality has gone way down hill.  The food we ordered came out like it had been sitting under heat lamps for a while. Dried out.  My enchilada mole was burnt. 

We used to love this place. Looks like we're going to find another restaurant.
Absolutely incredible sandwiches! I had the mountain man and my child had the chicken Parm. They were just perfect. They also support law-enforcement, that is a change from where I came from!

The worst service ever.  I ordered 2 hours ahead of time online since it was a Friday.  I called 15 minutes after my scheduled delivery time, was put on hold for 7 minutes, and was told it was on its way even though their site showed it as being made still.   We are now 45 minutes past the delivery time and almost 3 hours since I ordered with no pizza even though their site says delivered haha.  This is the second time they have totally botched an order and we won't be ordering from them in the future.  I just wish they would contact you and tell you they can't complete the order.  Honesty goes a long way.

Wooza, I've been driving by this store now for 9 months and never ventured inside until today.  The minute I walked through the front door I knew I was in trouble.  Their Christmas Displays were out of this world. Every room inside the store had Christmas tress all decorated and tons of other Christmas items.  

Of course I knew I wasn't going to be able to leave unless I bought something.  Apparently during the various holidays they have lots of decor items to help you decorate those holidays with as well. 

They had some beautifully made Amish furniture around the store as well.  They have an upstairs with quilts and other house hold items.  

If your planning on coming to this store for the first time just know it us a 30 minute stroll just to take it all in.

Meh. The girls are nice enough but data errors and problems with their system are a reality. Had one of their ATMs take $100 from me, and had my info on my account changed without my consent. Two stars just for the nice in person customer service.

Today was our first trip to this restaurant.  It is convenient to home and we chose it because it was rated in the top ten of the Mexican restaurants in the area, (not on Yelp).   Well.....not if you like Mexican food it's not even close to any top ten.  First of all...the man who greeted us, if you could call that a greeting,  said not a word to us, just grabbed some menus from the desk when we came in the door and started walking towards the dining room.  He tossed the menus on a table and just kept walking.  He didn't even break his stride.  Eventually a waitress came and took our beverage orders...she didn't even say hello...just ask if we wanted something to drink.  Dropped the water and my husband's iced tea on the table and said not a word.  An actual waitress finally came and took our food order.  She did say hello but that was it.  

The food was not good. It was well below average.  Fairly tasteless.  Little if any authentic Mexican spices or flavor. VERY bland.  I had the seafood soup with clams, shrimp, fish, and crab.  First of all...the soup must have been simmering on the stove for several hours, which in itself is not necessarily a bad thing but it is if you have already put the sea food in the soup.  The fish had not been completely skinned and had completely fallen apart, the shrimp was tough and they had not deveined them.  Nothing like shrimp you either have to devein yourself at the table or pass on eating the shrimp. Five in my bowl and not one of them had been deveined.  I ate one before tasting the bitterness and realizing the deveining problem.  The clams were still in shells but were also tough and they did not provide you with anywhere to put the shells after you ate the clams.  The crab was two small legs and a small body portion but they did not pre crack the shells and did not provide you with a utensil to get the crab out of the shells.  I guess they expected you to crack the shells with your hands...and no where to put any of the shells or pieces of shells ....

My husband's Enchiladas were tasteless, so were his  rice and beans.  We did get a thank you from the waitress when we paid.  

I've been to Guadalajara, Mexico several times....trust me...this is NOT the quality of food you get there....


We won't be returning.
The burgers here are always great. My whole family loves it. We had the habit back home in ca so I was very glad to see it here.

Terrible. 

Worst ribs ever. Fatty and flavorless. The pulled pork and brisket were average, sides were meh. 

Much better choices available. I'm not sure how they stay in business with the food they serve. 

Yuck.

Went here on a Friday night with my family, heard great things about this place. Ordered a pizza and one of the boys working said it was going to take 3 hours. I of course thought he was kidding so I placed my order... apparently it wasn't a joke. Half way through my wait I asked how much longer and they said 5 minutes, I asked about 7 times after that. Finally I received my pizza and it was raw. There was a wing sticking out of the pizza too.  Saw bugs coming out of the kitchen. Overall 9/10 experience would come again.

the food here is really good and their fries are the best!
today was my worst experience ever the staff was rude and not helpful at all!!!
the tall skinny hunchback acted annoyed that he had to help us.
due to COVID you can not get refills on your drinks.
and that is fine except apparently that does not apply to the employees because the one guy kept filling his drink.
all the tables were dirty and the customers have to wipe off their own tables. but that is totally cool with the COVID rules they are trying to do to help our safty‍
super disappointed experience Hugo's!
What can you say , it's McDonalds . The drive threw is always a long wait , the staff isn't very friendly or nice or even polite at all .

I've been to all of the Walmart's in the treasure valley and this one is by far the best! It's clean, awesome clearance sales others don't seem to offer, and I haven't had a rude employee cross my path yet! No drama that I've noticed and that's why I drive from Nampa to Meridian when I need to go to Walmart. Keep up the good work Meridian 10mile Walmart!
There happy hour is one of the very best. $4 beers, $4 Mulligan pub burger, and the best pretzel and beer cheese dip for $9.99. Hits all the best of a happy hour.

So we had a move scheduled pre paid and ready to go! Then on the morning of the move yes the morning of the move the owner Texts not even a phone call and has 5 excuses why they can't do the job! So one hour before we move they text yes we had a truck booked and help on the other end 2 days before Christmas and they left us hanging........... as to your response we had talked and made arrangement and you said you would be there Period..Then you Texted not called texted the morning we where moving and said you could not make it and this left me in a bind so close to Christmas, you left me scrambling to try and find a mover on the day we are moving so close to Christmas and to clarify YES when you book your company through Uhaul they require a deposit SO YES THERE WAS A CASH DEPOSIT YES IT WAS PRE- PAID

These two guys are bringing their unique take on BBQ to us. With dining inside an issue, this place is bringing great bbq to us outside. 
As you approach, you will be lured in with the sight of real bbq cookin going on! The location in Meridian on Main Street next to Meridian Cycles provides a few chairs and shade structures for your comfort.
The two pit masters are super friendly and welcoming. They happily offered the current meats available for consumption. 
In regards to the menu, it is simple and direct. If you want bbq meat....you will get it! I ordered three tacos for $10. The available meats were Tri-Tip, Pork Loin, Chicken, and Hot Link. I opted for one taco with each of the following meats Tri, Pork, and Chicken.
The tacos are big fyi! They are not shy of providing meat in the tacos!! The tacos are filled with traditional street style goodies. The chicken was very juicy and had the least bbq smoke flavor. The pork and tri-tip were huge on smoke flavor! You will not go wrong with either of these meats if you want some bbq smoke flavors.
If you see Rick y Elias out and about working the bbq, I would highly recommend stopping for a few tacos.
Cheers Always!
Got a new helix piercing by Paul today, he was super fast and clean! He was also really nice and informative about how to clean it! I'll be back for more!

Had a pedicure today and was exceptionally pleased with the results.  Cindy was wonderful!  I would be delighted to become her regular customer.  She paid close attention to detail.  Was friendly and professional.  She certainly knows her craft!  I'm coming back in a few days for a full set of acrylics and have requested Cindy for that as well.  Fingers crossed!

I was curious because I kept
Seeing them around the place. I was only visiting area Im use to Starbucks but gotta say great place. Friendly staff in Meridian and a variety of drinks choices. I really enjoyed it.

Yes, yes, yes yes!!!! Everything is . Drove by this place numerous times thinking it was a bread shop. But boy I was so wrong! They make fresh sandwiches that are not like your typical food chains but made and handle with care. The sandwiches aren't small and you basically can ask for warm, cold or grilled on various bread choices. I've tried a few so far and ready to go back for another. I've had the vegetarian sandwich on ciabatta bread and a chicken salad on a brioche bread. Both delicious. My daughter had broccoli soup in loved it!!! But I want to make a personal recommendation.....I would give this place 5 stars but the PEACH smoothie needs a bigger giant glass!!!!!! So good!!! I will keep going back, love love every bite and every slurp!!!! I'm addicted... try it you can't go wrong!!!!

I stop here regularly as it is just up from where I drop the kids for school.  Organic Coffee is superior to any coffee in town.  The staff is always friendly and I always look forward to getting my morning Joe there.  I would recommend this shop to anyone that wants excellent coffee, excellent service served by excellent people with a smile!
I've been going to this dentist for years and I have had more problems with my teeth then I ever had. The girls that work for dr pilling are very nice but dr pilling is arrogant and money hungry.
Excellent service for my two small dogs!  Prices are totally fair and they always do a great job!

I dropped my phone in a cooking pot of water and tried everything  (rice, reset, etc.) to get it working again.  Then I booked an appointment online -- super easy -- with CPR to get their opinion. They were great. So honest about what was likely wrong and cost to repair, which in my case was more than my older phone was worth. I so appreciated their time and honesty.  They even shared their thoughts on best carriers in Idaho when I asked. I recommend these folks for sure!

I wasn't disappointed. The service was fantastic with a very friendly staff. I had the gnocchi with a roasted chicken breast in brown butter. The dish was fantastic. Another had the lamb which she said she couldn't stop eating no matter how full she was.  The sauce was wonderful. We will definitely be back!  We didn't have room for dessert this time but will have to start our meal with it next time. Great place!

I like the unlimited hair cuts a month. Only problem is it's hard to get a time and day you want since everyone around is using the app. Which is hard planning for days weeks in advance, things come up and things change. You tip every time so it ends up being the same as paying $20 a cut somewhere else twice a week. It's fine, almost not really worth it. I made an appointment, was a little late and had to wait behind a couple walk ins. Salty I suppose, but gave the review a 2 because of availability and how busy it is here. Cuts are okay, then again, it's the same everywhere Else

The staff is wonderfully friendly and helpful. The pizza tastes great. Nice chewy crust, good quality cheese. Their sauce is also some of the best I've had. I love that the owner often greets you. You can see into the cooking area and everything is clean. I think it's a family owned and operated place, and there is a nice mix of young high school and college aged young men and women who work here...all of whom restore your faith in the youth of our country with their professionalism and niceties. We've definitely found our go-to pizza place.

I live this place!  Empanadas are top quality and lots of variety, and the rotating tap is always interesting!  When you order, don't forget the Fuego or Chimichurri dipping sauce! 

Don't want to eat here?? Take them home!  A++ awesome!

We, a 20 top table got thrown out.  By a snotty manager who said,  after he caused a mager scene,  that his name is Cody Wyatt.  

We had waited over an hour to be seated.  We inadvertently wound up with  12 people at one table and  8 at another.  "CODY" came out of no where,  and got really snotty with us. Witch didn't go over super well.  I asked for his name,. And he got more belligerent.  He actually started cussing and shoved one of our party. I will NEVER  DARKEN THE DOOR OF THIS PLACE AGAIN!!!
Always great, warm bagels.  My favorite is ham, egg and provolone on everything bagel.  Coffee is much better now that they've switched to Caffe' D'Arte

I came in to get pierced by Laura and she was amazing! Made the whole thing really comfortable because I was really nervous. She has a lot of knowledge about piercing and aftercare. The place has really pretty jewelry as well.

We usually eat at the ram at least once every few weeks. The food is good the burgers are good, like the French dips, the wife and I have been splitting the fish and chips for years here and they've always been very good with a large enough portion to where we can add dinner salads and be quite happy. Love the blue cheese dressing they have here. Something has changed, the fish and chips have gone from a large steak to several smaller pieces and then tonight I think will be our last night Of ordering the fish and chips. The portions were so small even the waitress and manager said so although they admitted that is how they are now. They have switched from cod to a cheap Pollick and kept the price is the same at Almost $16, definitely not worth it anymore.  We substituted the fries for tater tot's, ordered two side salads and ask for them to be delivered before the meal. They showed up, and within 30 seconds our meal showed up and we sent it back so we can enjoy our salads. It is always been that way at the ram, if you order anything before you have no time to hardly eat it before they throw your meal in front of you even if you request a delay at the very start.  We split the meal and they brought us a couple extra pieces to try and keep us happy which were under cooked and raw to top it off. Our waitress was very nice and so was the manager, it looks like this is just the way it is now. They did comp us a dessert in which we ordered the mud pie, we've had it before and it is amazing!

10/14/18
Got a reply from manager at the ram apologizing which was nice, said they changed their fish and chips about a year ago, what he doesn't realize we've probably had this same dinner 25 times since it was changed and now it has changed again no longer cod and a cheap haddock, if you look at my review in the photo you will see the pieces are literally no bigger than the size of the lemon wedge that came with it, very small about half the portion size as the mini times we've had prior to this. Say all you want, pictures are worth 1000 words And when your manager on duty and the waitress both agree that it was ridiculous something is definitely wrong.
Absolutely great service! This is my kids favorite pizza place and each time we order, it's amazing. I appreciate the consistency.

So as I have said on a few of my other reviews, I am not a big red meat eater. Typically something about the texture is off-putting to me but when I came to Habit with my family and some of our friends I was pleasantly surprised. I will start with my dish which was the veggie burger with cheese and other fixins. I really enjoyed my burger, it was filling and even some of our company who don't typically eat veggie burgers ordered them and were really happy with their meal as well. Next I tasted my Mom's burger and wow! I don't think I have ever enjoyed a bite of a burger so much! I wanted to take it right from her! Then, I tasted our friend's fish burger and wowee! That was delicious too! Probably my favorite part of the meal was the tempura'd green beans. I have been raving about those non-stop. I cannot wait to take my partner there to have a solid, economically efficient meal for two. Oh and I did not even mention the milk shakes which were plenty tasty!

Pretty good spot. I'm visiting from Ga, the staff was nice, and even made sure to ask me well after I ordered if there was anything additional I needed for my veggie burger. The spicy green beans were awesome!

This is the best Empanada in The Treasure Valley by far. I had the citrus beef and the chicken. Both were delicious my fav has to be the citrus beef though. You can taste the fresh ingredients and that it isn't processed. Also love the chimichurri sauce. I highly recommend it.

I absolutely LOVE this salon. My favorite part is that it is NON TOXIC! They use clean ingredients. Not to mention it is so beautiful inside. Very chic. Can't wait to go back to give my hair some love!

Brought our Ford Explorer that had a little dirt/mud on it to be washed today and were told it was too dirty to be washed. He suggested we go to a self-wash to spray off the mud and bring it back. Uhhh???

We were here a couple of times in past one month.  The staff members were very efficient and friendly both times regardless if they were busy or not.  

We bowled, we dined and we played in the arcade.  Not a cheap place to do all of those, but it was a treat and was a great time especially for kids.

I love their food as well.  Not bad at all while bowling.  I only gave 4 stars because of the price and I can't afford to go there  all the time.

We have been driving by this place for a long time and always meaning to try it but haven't dine so until now. I only wish we would have come in a long time ago because this is now our absolute favorite Mexican food restaurant.
The decor is great, the food is Absolutely awesome, and the customer service is great. The gentleman that waited on us was the happiest and friendliest guy we have seen in a long time and really made our day.
Everything is fresh and their homemade chips and salsa are the best I've ever had. The chicken enchilada and Chile reliant were amazing.
We will definitely be back and often.
I highly recommend this place.

Terrible!  The Big Nacho for $25.99 was basically chips topped with very little else.  It was not layered at all.  Their nachos do not compare with Legends in anyway.  The 22 oz. Coors Light seemed expensive at $8 but also $8 for a Diet Coke is ridicules.
Really good place to get a burger with a difference. Plus - 4 different kinds of potatoes in a variety of different styles and an almost endless chose of toppings. Will be coming back for sure.

Great place to eat. Great food, large portions, super awesome staff. Prices are good for what you get. If you ever want to feel like you work at this place sit at the bar and see how these people take crazy and put it on a plate and severe it up!

I have been a Kneaders regular for a while now, pre and post pandemic, and I have to ask, What Happened? First off, for a business that advertises as a bakery, where are the baked goods? I came in for cinnamon rolls and holiday sugar cookies and was informed at 9 am that they were sold out, for the day! The pastry case was empty and covered in crumbs and spilled items. The sweetbread case was empty and breads not put out, they were still sitting out editing to be cut or wrapped.
Secondly where is the star staff that I bragged about,? It took a good 20 min for 2 breakfast sandwiches and fresh fruit. The sandwich was cold and the fruit slimy and the person who served us acted like it was a big deal to get fresh! The person who said he was the assistant manager looked like he had just rolled out of bed and the cook was too busy talking to everyone to pay attention to orders.
This store has gone down hill and very disappointing, I'm sorry to say that with even their star employees seem to have jumped ship, at least the old front of the house manager obviously cared about the presentation and customer service, the other employees seemed to care about the next story. I won't be coming back for a while and I encourage everyone else to try somewhere else.

The service was above excellent.  My brother's dog received her first grooming service which lasted for three hours and Claire the groomer was still smiling when she brought Edu into the house.  Edu was beautifully groomed and and calm.  We were all pleased.

I brought my BMW X5 into Dynamic Detail and Richard and Bryce made my 4-year-old SUV look brand new! Even my friends asked if I got a new car! Their prices are great, especially, for how immaculate my car looks now! I would highly recommend them to anyone! I will be back!

I'm always checking out different Mexican restaurants so I gave  El Tenampa a try for lunch.  I ordered the Taco, Enchilada lunch plate. Tho start with the table side chips and salsa were very good.  The shredded beef Taco was mediocre at best. The biggest drawback being a grocery store taco shell.
I don't understand why so many Idaho Mexican restaurant use store boxed taco shells. Tacos are basic for Mexican restaurants like spaghetti is basic for Italian restaurants.  This is one area that should done in house and never compromised.  The enchilada was good but way too much cheese. There was more cheese in top than inside the enchilada.  Retried beans were so-so but the rice was very good.  On the plus side...the service was excellent and my waitress Becka was the best.  She was 5 Star!

Delicious!! Fresh and tasty. Sauces were flavorful.
We ordered the vegan ones and it was just enough curry flavor not to overwhelm. Obviously a family owned business with their heart in their food. Go! Perfect as a to go meal.

I absolutely love this deli. You are welcome as soon as you walk through the door!  They make their sandwiches the way you like it. Not only do they have wonderful sandwiches but fried chicken and all the fixings to go along with it.
My husband and I loved their fried chicken so much...we had them cater our wedding! Yes! Pounds and pounds of fried chicken, potato salad and coleslaw ; you name it. Perfect country themed wedding with good country food.
Good place to eat. See you guys soon.

This place was great. Super clean and very professional. Matt explained everything on maintenance of my piercing. He said if I needed anything just stop in and he would be more than happy to help. He was fast and very sterile. My friend was with me, she's more than likely coming her to get a piercing done in the near future.

The food was good the bartender was great, but their operating model was ridiculous!  Went there to watch Thursday night football. The TVs are very good, but if you don't want to stand in a long line of patrons to order your own drinks and food then I would not recommend it. They have no waiters or waitresses, just this one poor bartender taking all orders and making all drinks. They have a few young girls that expedite the food, thankfully so that the poor bartender  doesn't have to do that too!  Stupid management is going to lose a lot one business over their bad management skills. I will not be going back.

Founded in Santa Barbara, California in 1969 (the year man first stepped on the moon!) by two brothers who were on a mission to provide great burgers at a great price, the Habit Burger Grill now has over 200 locations in the U.S. It is a fast-food chain that is famous for cheap burgers chargrilled over an open flame, meaning grilled quickly at a very high heat. They have three locations in Idaho -- Meridian, Nampa, Twin Falls. The one in Meridian is conveniently located close to the Village.

For me, the Habit is synonymous with post-volleyball food. I've been there a couple of times after playing volleyball on Sundays, and I have to say it's not your typical burger fast-food restaurant. Their burgers are lean. Not greasy. And they're affordable. My go-to is the double charburger (two chargrilled beef patties, lettuce, tomato, caramelized onions, pickles, and mayo on a toasted bun). Last weekend, my friend tried the Santa Barbara char (lettuce-wrapped double char with cheese and avocado on grilled sourdough), and he thought it was "really good." You have to try their onion rings, too!

I think the burgers at Habit are above average. The superb burger patties and reasonable prices set them apart from other fast-food chains.

Great atmosphere. Good location. Friendly staff. Clean bathrooms. Affordable prices. Lean burgers. Five stars in my book!
Some of the most authentic Mexican food in the Treasure Valley. Wonderful service and congenial staff. A must!
Nice char burgers, very good tempura beans, reasonable prices.  Not as impressed with the guacamole burger though,  the tortilla shells in it weren't great, would be better without them.

This is my favorite spot in Meridian! Sage, the owner, is super knowledgeable about his teas and always great with recommendations when I'm not sure what to order. The vibe is soothing and perfect for the mood I'm in when I go out for a tea. The teas themselves are high quality and delicious flavors, and I love the convenience of the downtown Meridian location. (Not to mention, it's in the same building as Sweet Zola's Candy Shop for Inclusion. If you have a sweet tooth, this spot is all you need.) Having moved back to Idaho from the Bay Area, I've been searching for my go-to tea shop, and this is it! Can't recommend it enough!

I have no idea how they have a 4.9.  I bought my daughter a detailing there and they did a horrible job, plus they scuffed her headliner.  See the photos - taken right after the detailing.  I asked for a refund and they said they wanted to see it for themselves.  No problem.  That was three weeks ago and they've failed to respond to my offer to bring it back in - or anything.  I'll never use them again.
Amazing pho, it is delicious and it comes out quick. The people are nice and and restaurant is clean.
Very nice new location! Went for breakfast & it was very good. Would go again if we were not moving out of state

Stopped by Grants Neighborhood Grill for lunch and had an amazing steak sandwich. Kind of a light lunch crowd for a Friday, so there were plenty of seats to be had and didn't have to wait long to be served. 

My server Sarah and the general manager, Chalico (I know I spelled that wrong), were both very friendly. 

While I was waiting for my food, Chalico told me about how the owners were looking to create a restaurant that used locally sourced, high-quality ingredients in their dishes. The chef takes pride in crafting a menu that uses "real" food as opposed to overly processed food components many restaurants are guilty of using. 

The steak on my steak sandwich was very tender and the horseradish aioli was amazing. The fries they served with the dish were obviously fresh-cut and tasted amazing. 

Grants is kind of tucked away on the corner of Cherry and Linder in Meridian. They have outdoor seating and a rollup garage door that I'm sure they could open if it wasn't oppressively hot outside.

The decor is modern with a nod to the farmlands from which it gets its food. 

Sarah said that Friday and Saturday nights are busy, and that reservations are recommended. Grants has a bar so if you need to have a libation while you're waiting for seats, you're in luck. They also have a modest happy hour from 4 p.m. to 6 p.m. Monday through Friday. 

I was very pleased with my first experience at Grants and will definitely be back. I'm curious to see what their dinner offerings are like. If they're anything like the lunch I had, I'm in for a real treat.

I liked my doctor, but I can't seem to get back in without waiting months. Called to reschedule a procedure and was told to call back in a few weeks. Then got billed for my copay, even though I paid at the time of my visit. They want you to see nurse practitioners as the doctors are too busy with procedures to see patients. Seems like they are not well organized. I don't have all day to sit on hold, nor should it take several phone calls to resolve things. Such a waste of my time!

Our last visit was much like every other visit.  Our order was missing items and the items we did receive were wrong; things we asked to be added weren't, and things we asked to be subtracted weren't.  When we immediately reported the issue, it took time to hear back and the reply was grilling us about what was wrong with the order.  Habit was more interested in having us spell out in unnecessary detail everything that was wrong with the order then trying to apologize for the experience or compensate us for the errors.  The only good experience we had was our very first visit, when we decided to try a new place.  Since that first time, every visit has been a disaster; and compounded by how difficult and painful it is to get anyone to even respond when reporting an issue.  Then, the fix is always being asked to accept useless coupons and give Habit another chance.  It is possible that Habit has some good locations, so our review is only regarding our local location.

While I was waiting for my food a customer brought back what was suppose to be a double quarter pounder but only had one meat patty. They passed it back to the assembly line where it was opened and another patty added. The entire line  and the prep guys gloves were then potentially contaminated by that customers contact with the packaging and product. The right thing to do was to waste it immediately and redo the entire order. I think I'll go to Chipolte's next time at least they are getting rigorous training in food safety.

Out of BBQ Brisket, Pulled Pork, sausage?? Really??
The employee was very nice and was apologetic about not having anything but chicken. Online ordering has its risks.. what we did get was good. Just disappointed..
This place has the best food! Good price and huge sandwiches!!! Chef Wally is the man! He is fun and personable. Highly recommend this place!!

There are better Pandas out there, this one in particular forgets my teriyaki sauce as often as an 8 year old forgets to brush their teeth before school. Their turnaround time is good but their attention to detail can be a bit lacking sometimes. The food can be hit or miss.

This review is regarding a serious health concern. Last night, my mom and I witnessed one of the worst unsanitary situations ever. One of the women working there (seemed to be the manager, not sure though) was coughing into her arm (closer to her hand than her elbow) and then directly  packaging up customers food afterwards (putting her hands on the food and then putting it into the bag with her whole arm. Luckily she did not bag ours.) Additionally, we saw her drinking out of her personal water bottle at the counter, which also raised concerns regarding sanitary conditions. The cherry on top is that a gentlemen coming out of the restroom delivered a lost grey sweatshirt that he found in the bathroom. After she took the sweatshirt behind the counter (which undoubtedly has to be extremely dirty, especially after being found in the men's restroom), she proceeded to wait on customers at the register, exchanging money/ cups, and bagging up food WITHOUT washing her hands or using sanitizer. All of this happened within a matter of a couple minutes while we were waiting for our food inside the restaurant, Monday September 13th at approximately 7:25pm at the Habit Burger on Eagle in Meridian ID. 

In normal every day conditions this would still be disgusting, but given that we are living in a PANDEMIC with rising numbers, we were mortified and needless to say we will not be back. A note to corporate / management: please help your employees understand that customer service goes beyond just being nice; in this climate they should also be extra considerate of cleanliness and basic decency when preparing and serving food to your customers.

Justin was referred to us by a friend who was very happy with his services.  Upon first meeting him, I could tell Justin is a very sincere person and genuinely cares to help families plan for some of the hardest times of their lives.  My husband and I were really dragging our feet and started the process of our estate planning during the summer.  Justin was very patient with us (it took about 6 months for us to finally finish) but made sure to follow up and ask if we had any questions.  Through the whole process Justin patiently answered all my questions, and I had a lot, and was very down to earth.  I have, and will continue to, recommend him to friends of mine.  I'm grateful for his affordable prices and great customer service!
Pray you don't have "Weng" making your food. Impossible to understand and backs up the lines. Will never return to this location.

I wish we had Metro Express in Salt Lake City! ....Wait...Towels?...whhaaaat? It was a first for me to be provided w towels to dry off our vehicle!!!  I was % impressed with this operation! I'm taking my truck in right now!

This place is awesome! The salmon is off the hook. 
Desserts are great. The staff great. All the dishes I saw come out looked delicious!

Went to try out and was so disappointed with the pile of trash behind the counter between register area and cooking area. You could smell the garbage. Sorry but thats not right and there is no excuse. Covid or no covid. We decided to leave immediately as we saw the lady helping the register person scratch her armpit and right after scoop salsa and grab a bag of chips for the people in front of us. I feel bad for leaving this review but its the truth and thats just nasty. Have some decency and be professional while handling food. Please also power-wash your entrance as the garbage juice is leaking at the front door. Maybe a lil embarrassment will help you step up your game. We immediately left when we saw the armpit scratch. Happened Tuesday night. Will never return. Went to Deltaco and that was not any better but no one was scratching anything from what i could see.
Oh well onto the next....the quest continues....

Don did outstanding work removing my old fan and replacing it with a new ceiling lamp. He put in the bulbs that I had for the lamp, and when they were too dim, he went back and replaced them all again instead of my doing it (I am short and would have had a difficult time reaching the ceiling!).   Don is personable, has high integrity in his work and provides excellent customer service.  I highly recommend him!

I ordered a total of $64 in one order. The maps section wouldn't work to ask for delivery so I chosen "pick up" and called the next day to ask for delivery. I had planned to add to the bill, so my total ended up being $64 + $80 (added gallon soup plus fruit platter). 

In regards to delivery the person on the phone wasn't helpful because there was evidently no delivery person. After we added to the order to be a total of $100 they said hey could deliver. 

Ended up getting our order and 2 sandwiches and one soup was missing.

I called to ask what happened and the man was seriously one of the rudest customer service people I've ever talked to. He said "I don't know what to do, I don't know what you ordered, sorry you should have given us more time with this order"

Excuse me but we paid $144 on pretty crappy sandwhiches and salsa for a Work conference, so I'm pretty sure you should be a little more polite. I called the man out for having such a poor attitude and he said "we're busy". 

I don't care.

This was a terrible experience and I won't ever return. I also would like a refund on the two sandwiches and one soup that never came!
Laura is the best.  So creative, so patient.  I love my nails.  I'm a nail tek customer for life.

I've never experienced this at a restaurant before. After my ribs meal (way too much fat on the ribs) the waiter took the check with my card. When he returned (after a while), he had two different checks and was confused which card was mine. My check was $35, but my card was with a check for $23. I told him this wasn't my check and he apologized and took my card back to the back. I check my bank account on my phone and see I had two different charges, $35 and $32 (not even the $23 that my card was with). He returns again and I show him the two different charges. He says, "that's strange," and leaves again, comes back and says the extra charge was taken off. He joked that I almost paid for the table next to me. Now, I think all is good and figured out. But, the next time I look at my bank account, there are three charges! $35, $35, and $32! 

This review is probably confusing... just like the waiter was.

I'm going back tomorrow to figure this out!

I must say that my family I enjoyed our day here and my complaint is not with the park itself but with the management. My son rode the slide on the Double Trouble pool and was told he needed to take off his mask to ride, even though other kids were wearing their masks. When my son went down he dropped his mask. We were told at the end of the day we could pick up his mask from the customer service office. That was not true. The customer service office told us to file a lost item report, which I did. We followed up multiple times to see about recovering the mask and got no response. Given that the pool that it was dropped in was small and deep and had a life guard the entire time there is no possibility that the mask is not in the pool. Despite this the mask has not been recovered(It has been 3 weeks). To top it off my request to get the mask was cancelled by park employees.  If it was not for the lost mask I would have given the place 5 stars for our experience.

Hands down the best Mexican restaurant in the valley. It is our go to restaurant, we love everything this place offers. We especially love the service here! Eddy is the best waiter we have ever experienced! If you haven't already you should go here!

I just got my order from delivery and opened my street tacos - ate part of one only to find 3 live larva crawling around inside. I notified the delivery service and they are looking into it. I am so grossed out. Never again.

Edited to add that the restaurant reached out to me on Facebook basically accusing me of lying. Awesome.

This has easily became one of our favorite deli's in Boise! Better than Subway, Jimmy John's, and even Firehouse in my opinion. You can tell that all of their ingredients are fresh, and their signature sandwiches are all amazing! There's a sandwich here to satisfy all of your different cravings. My personal favorites are the Reuben and the Wartman. And their homemade Fry Sauce is the best in Boise! 10/10 would recommend!!

I finally couldn't take it another second!  I had to get my nails and toes done!  Since we (Idaho) had the green light from the governor to go to nail shops - I decided to book an appointment.   I was a bit nervous at first but was happy to learn that the  salon adheres to wearing mask.  I was also quite relieved and impressed to see a plexiglass between the manicurist and the client.  

I learned that New Nail & Spa is under new management. 

I had a nice and very thorough woman named Holly do my pedicure.  My toes were a mess.  I use to have a pedicure monthly Pre COVID days.  Holly did a great job!  I then went to Moon who did a great job on my manicure.  

If you are nervous about getting out there as I was - don't be.  They do a very good job!  Their customer service skills are very good as well.  I felt very pampered!  Thumbs up to New Nails!

This place is SO good. Like so so good. We have tried almost everything on the menu and are very impressed with the quality and flavor. We have had a lot of pho and Vietnamese food (in California) and this is by far the best we have ever had in our life lol. We come here at least once a week. Our kids love the fried rice!

I recently just moved to the area and have been searching for a nail place . I decided to try this place out and I wish I didn't . Full set $46 pedicure $41 or so . 

Let me start by saying that the techs are very welcoming and nice . The salon is clean and they were able to get me in quickly . I came in for a full set of acrylics and a pedicure . I was very verbal with my nail tech about what I wanted . My acrylics looked like I already have back growth before I had even left and my cuticles weren't trimmed . I had asked for just a square file with no cutting for my toe nails . The man cut my toe nails short and took the cuticle cutters and cut the sides of my toe nails deep into the bed instead of just shaping them . My toe nails did not need to be cut on the sides . I have never had any techs do this to ALL of my nails . My toes look super weird now and next time I'll get my nails done some place else . Also, they don't have a great color selection

The lady in the front was extremely rude and they upsell everything, I paid $20 just to get my nails ripped off not even soaked off like they said. I have gone and got my nails off (with no service) just to get the acrylics they put on off (after 5 weeks of having them on) and it was free and this time made me pay? If you're going to do that stay consistent or have your whole team be on the same page. 
Never going here again, and spreading the word that this place is awful. I have also had appointments before at 5pm for example and they didn't get to me until 6:30 and this has happened multiple times. The didn't give me a discount or anything either. There are way better more affordable nail salons out there. Don't waste your time at this place.

At first I was really impressed with the haircut but after noticing my dog was scooting a lot and got concerned. I check her tummy and near her butt and saw she had a cut near her private parts. 
I am very upset, my dog is very uncomfortable, and I won't be going back!!!

Hands down the best!!! The pho has fantastic flavor and the sandwiches are absolutely delicious!! Not dry, honestly perfect. I made a to go order at 8:30 and the staff was so nice!! They are definitely running a top notch restaurant!! Don't let the location fool you, doesn't look all fancy from the outside but the food speaks for itself!! Definitely go here for all your Vietnamese cravings!!

I went here on August 6th to get my nose pierced for my 18th birthday. I initially wanted a hoop but I was told I had to get a stud first, let it heal, and then get a hoop. They said that they'd pierce it a little differently so that when I decide to get a hoop it would be the right placement. The lady with a blue pixie cut was super nice and talked me through the healing and piercing process. However, she pierced it wrong. She pierced it at a downwards angle. I went to the front and paid for it while she went in the back nervously to get her higher up. The owner(?) came out to look at my piercing and told me that the piercing was at the wrong angle and was too low and might heal weird but "it might be fine". What? They offered me no discount or refund and I paid full price with a very good tip just to be told AFTER that she messed it up. Tonight I went to a different place to get a hoop in and they looked at what I have and told me immediately that a hoop would not work in my nose because of the placement and the angle pierced. They gave me the hoop anyways and it looked so terrible. Now, I can't get my initial hoop that I specifically asked for and I'm stuck with a wonky stud in. Place is clean and the people are nice but will tell you after you pay that they messed it up. Nice.
I love this place! Good food and rolls. I personally enjoy their coconut fried rice. Service is good and personal.
Authentic empanadas. Fresh and delicious.  Great service.  The inside is nice, clean and inviting.  Had lunch and took a box of empanadas home to the wife and kids.

I recently had a problem with my car driving home from work, so as a repair partner for Carmax, I took the car to John's Auto Care for repairs that had to do with a fuel injector gone bad. This was confirmed by Carmax by a few mechanic who ran the codes, but couldn't do the work at that time. 
The people at John's Auto Care were friendly, professional and prompt. The car was ready in 2 days and they updated me every day. 
The car is driving perfectly!!

This is one of my favorite restaurants in the area,  and perfect if you want Thai and sushi options.  I've been coming here for years,  and I've never had a bad meal.  It's consistent- I know it will taste the same every time,  and always so flavorful and great portions. Worth it- it will never disappoint!

Too bad I can't give 0 stars. This review is directly for the food wait staff and management of this entire facility. The bartenders were great.
Whoever the manager is or multiple managers need to be fired. I have never had a more worse experience when eating at a restaurant. My husband and I were out of town visiting a few friends of ours. We all went to Big Al's to allow the kids to play a few games and get dinner. We grabbed a few drinks at the bar, played some video games and then grabbed dinner in the restaurant area. The food was cold when it arrived and the presentation was very messy. And to make it worse, there was absolutely no customer service whatsoever. Every single employee just stood up near the kitchen and did absolutely NOTHING the entire time we were seated eating dinner. We ordered from the mobile app and gave an in advance tip which I seriously wish we could have reversed and given them nothing. The rest of the time we were seated, not one person came to check on us, asked how our food was or asked if we needed anything. It is as if we did not exist. In addition to absolutely NO SERVICE, every single table around us was filled with food from previous guests dinner. It had been sitting there for hours which is absolutely unacceptable and disgusting! It was quite shocking really. All the while the wait staff was standing around doing NOTHING. We even tried to get their attention multiple times but they were too busy chatting away and looking at their phones. I don't normally write bad reviews but this place is seriously lacking and has absolutely no business even operating when you're employees do literally nothing. We all got so frustrated and mad that we left abruptly and told ourselves that we would never be back. And to make matters worse, as we were walking out, the outdoor area was completely trashed. Garbage was everywhere. You could tell it had not been cleaned in months. How gross. The whole entire place was such an eye sore and left such a bad taste in my mouth I felt compelled to write this. Do yourself a favor and DO NOT GO HERE. This place has ZERO respect for its guests, does not care about making money and has horrific management service. Go spend your money elsewhere.
Derrick is an amazing tatoo artist- his attention to detail is amazing and his prices are really reasonable. Strongly recommend him!!
Best sandwiches in the valley! Everything is so flavorful! The pc pedro is so good!! Also their potato salad

I called and made my dad an apt for a head shave and Heidi did an amazing job!! She made my dad feel pampered at 73 yrs old. She was very careful and took her time. My dad was very pleased and looked clean shaved and handsome!! Thank you Heidi and the gentlemen manager (can't remember his name) very professional though!!

I have been there twice. Once was for a holiday party in the Caddyshack. The first time experience was good. It didn't require much service on their part and their drink options were awesome.
I made the suggestion to my buddy that we should go here  to watch the niners/packers game this weekend "because the TVs are big and the atmosphere is cool." What a terrible mistake. The TVs are the only thing that makes this place cool.
The service sucked. We let the server know that we were gonna be there for the entire game, ordered a beer and some of their recommended nachos. Beers came out 5 minutes later and the beer I ordered was wrong. No big deal, I just let her know I received the wrong beer. Nachoes took a little while but being a server myself I know on busy days with the kitchen getting their butts handed to them it's to be expected. When they came out they were cold, the cheese wasn't melt on half the plate and the chicken didn't taste right. 
Our server didn't return to the table for a good 30 minutes. I didn't see her anywhere! Our beverages were empty! When she finally returned she asked if I wanted another. When she returned she brought that along with the check!! Then she left for another 30 minutes and I even told her we were thinking about getting something for dinner! This continued the entire time we were there. When we ordered something, she replaced the new receipt with the old in our checkbook and didn't return for a while. I would never come here to just have dinner in the first place but why would anyone assume someone is done when all they've ordered is drinks and an app. Ugh, I will never come back expecting good service. Sorry Big Al's, this place is not all that it's cracked up to be. 
STC

Definitely do not recommend. 4 weeks ago after a test, they told my husband they would send his results in 3 business days to his surgeon. This never got done until we started asking the surgeon why they haven't called us for a surgery date. Even after we had to all for the results twice this week, it shows the gastroenterologist doctor never really even analyzed the results to dictate his report. Unless you're willing to follow up consistently it get no results... don't go there.

Was told that this was the most like Panera Bread in your area. Decided to give it a try.  We went at 11:30 a.m.  The lines were out the door, but did move pretty quickly. The place was so noisy it was hard to visit with dining companions. The soup in a bread bowl was decent, but a little bland (broccoli cheese). The salad croutons were very good. The pastries in the case were all beautilly presented, but we did not try any of them.  I'm not saying I would Never go back, but the noise level was a bit too much to really make me think of this place first. This seems to be a recurring theme with most eateries any more.  To build the acoustics so it sounds like there are a hundred people in there even if there are only 30. That alone will probably keep me from going back to try their food a second time.  I may pop in for some pastries to go.
Awesome food. Best Mexican food around and the service is superb.

I called the restaurant directly to place a to go order. I had my son pick it up. When he got home we were missing a burrito. Usually not a big deal as they usually make it right. The manager was extremely rude when I called to let them know. I told him I would have my husband run down and just get a refund. When my husband got there the manager argued and said we should take this up with Uber eats even though my son picked it up. He essentially called us liars saying he made the burrito and it was in the bag for sure! I will never order from here again.

Love the drive thru! I had no issues with the ATM & the driveway was wide enough 4 my vehicle as well. With a newborn, I have a renewed love for all things curbside and drive thru, esp in the snow & winter, so thank you very much from a mother who'd rather stay cozy & warm in her vehicle than park, grab a stroller, etc. I appreciate you!

They took excellent care of my dog Jax, who usually demonstrates anxious behaviors after a grooming, after his grooming at this plave he did not have any of those and the groom was breed specific and spot on what I requested. I will definitely be returning with Jax in the future. Thanks!
great service, great food and adjusted some things for special dietary needs....very pleasant afternoon lunch....

So disappointed.  Decided to order take out from our favorite Mexican restaurant to celebrate Cinco de Mayo and ordered  lunch  and the food was horrible. Been going here for 20+ yrs never have I been this disappointed. I ordered a chimichanga and beef enchilada meal. It was awful. No sauce on the enchilada and hardly any ground beef and the Chimichanga was soggy and the pork meat was dry. The beans and rice had no flavor as well. What a waste of time money and time.

The lady who checked me in was super rude. My daughter grabbed the glass jar at the reception desk, and it fell and broke. I tried repeatedly apologizing and talking to her about it. She just huffed and stormed off. She was then very unfriendly about getting my nails painted, so I didn't feel comfortable staying to get them done. Very poor customer service.
Flavorless cold food. I recommend big daddy's bbq over this place. Will not be returning to dickys

Love this place. Tried it on my birthday. The food is great and I love their happy hour special. Only thing I wasn't wild about was the Thai noodles I had. I had been craving a good noodle but they just disappointed. But that's just how my taste buds work. I did really enjoy the sushi a lot though.
Great donuts! Nice selection. Friendly staff. Would definitely pick up a dozen again.

I've visited this car was around 100 times over the past year. With the monthly subscription service, I could visit every day if I wanted. It's an incredible value, the staff is friendly, and I've never had an issue with damage to my car here. Other car washes have damaged my car. Compared to other car washes, I feel like this location does a noticeably better job than others, especially with the drying and tire shine.

Had a tattoo done with Ryan. It turned out beautiful. He was very friendly and professional. He practiced a clean, sanitize job. Very happy with the result. The shop is very clean. The girl in the front desk was very friendly also. Thanks for the good job

This place never disappoints! Recently took very discerning out of town guests for dinner, who come from a major metroplitan area. Once again rave reviews from all.

Excellent customer service from the hostess, to our charming, and absolutely delightful wait person. She was attentive, available and just plain fun throughout our stay.

I am not a Sushi fan, but guests in my party raved about the freshness, and quality. The other food is always, piping hot, fresh and tasty. The Ginger Martini is a must.  We are lucky to have this place in the valley.
Took grams to her favorite spot. Mexican pizza was delicious.  Tamale and cheese enchilada were made simply and not overloaded with extra ingredients. Very tasty!
Big Als was one of our favorite places to eat. They changed up the menu and took off the things that my family eats so we don't go as much as we used too. I do recommend the cheesy chicken dip!

This restaurant was very good. We used their wait list and were seated within the timeline they said. The food quality was top notch. We had a very good waiter that attended to us well. We will be coming back.

LOVED IT. We went here in early June and felt safe, comfortable, and like we were back in the "normal" world. It was hot, the rides were super fun and refreshing, and it was a total blast for my entire family. We rented a cabana, which was very nice to provide a home base for our stuff. There was free ice water, "room service" style food ordering, and shade and comfy seating. This park is awesome and we loved our experience!

Worse drug infested hotel in the area. Don't bring kids cause there maybe left over meth on the uncleaned sheats that have cigarette hole in them. Management is even worse. Very rude and arrogant. They should tear this hotel down and built something else. Manager was very rude and arrogant to the point where I felt threatened. He even said the words fuck you to me. I've been a guest here before and you don't tell guests fuck you
I love T&G products and was so happy my favorite hair dresser started working at TG! Liz is awesome and such a sweetheart. The whole staff seems very nice and I look forward to my next visit.
This company responded quickly, came and gave a very reasonable bid, showed up on scheduled date and followed up completing the job. We are very pleased with their work and recommend them.

It's our favorite local place. It's a great neighborhood bar/restaurant. They are a very friendly crew and my girlfriend painting is in the entry. Not sure I can get my wife to order anything but the pork chop with mushrooms.
I love going here!  i always get a great wash and the staff is so friendly!  I always tell people if you are having a bad day just come here. You get a fresh wash and lots of smiles

This place is amazing, not only you can try amazing food, but also the comfort to eat outside. And be able to see how they prepare your order, their meat selection is amazing, the pork, tri tip, chicken, spicy sausages, you can always make a combo out of those meat selection. And their sides are always changing, and the tacos with home made tortillas are beyond this world with fresh pico, authentic Mexican salsas are delish. Their huge quesadillas, and cubanos are amazing as well. Can't wait to go back again and enjoy all the delicious food. Come and see Rick and El.
Very helpful. Got very fair pricing on 2 trees. Friendly and accommodating staff! Will shop there again! Very knowledgeable as well.

This is for all primary health's in general: they suck and do not give a fuck about you. I've gone to primary health's for years and every single time I've had a bad experience. From they're scheduling to staff, they are lazy incompetent and not organized whatsoever. They are the worst of the worst when it come to healthcare. Literally a completely waste of time at any location save yourself some time and do not go to any Primary health. Fuck you al!!!

Staff were all very friendly & very helpful. The store was very clean, lots of great products & good prices. If in the area it's worth a stop. I do love the local Northwest Pets- but it is pricey. This store cares from budget friendly to higher end items.
Not "stacked" like a local radio personality claims, but, the food was good.  My french dip sandwich as just as it should be.  My wife's pastrami was pretty good.  Not outstanding, not terrible.
Wow! So amazing and spot on. Great food, great service. You won't regret coming in. Some of the best Empanadas outside of Argentina. You won't go wrong with anything on the menu.

We got takeout and part of the order was forgotten by the person who handed it to me when I picked it up so I had to return to get what was not handed to me.  They comped a dish, which they didn't have to, but the food itself was ok.  It wasn't bad but it wasn't great, it was just good enough.  Best analogy is it's like going to Starbucks is with coffee, it's ok but nothing we ordered (10 different dishes) makes us want to order it again.  A place with a smaller menu would likely make each dish with more flavor and with better ingredients.

WAY OVERPRICED and a total RIP OFF! Charged 83 dollars for a part that is 29 bucks at the dealer. Plus the diagnostic cost was tacked on top of the cost to do the work when every mechanic I have ever used waives the diagnostic cost if you get the work done. Was told that the mechanics that waive the diagnostic cost, when work is done, don't do the the job the right way. Total joke! I recommend looking at other options. Called and asked about the parts being over priced and they say the parts are better than what the dealer can get. No way! The part everywhere is no more than 29 dollars they charge 83. And since the job I got done needed 2 of them I was overcharged by over 100 dollars for these parts.
Off the hook Reuben sandwich and some the of the best, most flavorful  potato salad. I am picky on my potato salad and was assured it was fantastic. Glad I took the plunge!

My spouse wanted me to come here with her as she thought their Reuben was really good. So I joined her and realized she was correct. The restaurant was nearly empty, as most came for takeout during covid times.

Still we both had a reuben and a beer, and it was very nice. Service was good (as it should be with the number of people in the restaurant) and friendly.

Nothing super special, but good food and good service make for a good dining experience.

Horrible food and service. Every Shareable we ordered was dry. The wings were overcooked and extremely dry. The fingers steak were  more like dehydrated meat nuggets.  The pretzel was over cooked and the queso tasted what a locker room smells like. And last not least the floating stuff in the pitcher of Blue Moon. Just telling the truth. It was 50 bucks I wish I could have spent elsewhere.
Lacking on Vegetables with their stir fry noodle lunch specials, supposed to get a choice of soup or salad and it is always salad regardless,  No soup.  Not bad otherwise

Yikes, I haven't eaten the pizza yet.  First they don't have gluten free, which is kind of rare for a pizza place now a days.  Since my wife was adamant about Papa Johns, I ordered anyway.    Second, I felt compelled to write this as soon as I got off the phone with them.  The person on phone was not friendly by any means.  They were running a deal of 2 toppings on a large for $10.  I ordered one pepperoni and sausage and one with just extra cheese.  The person said that it was a premium topping and would charge extra.  I clarified that instead of two other toppings, I would just like extra cheese.  She just said, "nope" in a matter of fact, without a friendly, "sorry, I can't do that".  I used to work at a Papa Johns when I was younger and we made exceptions like that all of the time because it's good customer service.  Terrible customer service.  Even if the pizza is great, (which it doesn't sound great from other reviews) it will be the last time we ever go there again.  I'll just go to Papa Murphy's to get my gluten free pizza (which is really really good)

This is a very sad day. I have eaten at Grant's twice before tonight and was pleased with the meal even though the service was slow then. Tonight, not only was the service painstakingly slow, the food was substandard. Let's start with the service. We ordered the pork belly appetizer to eat while waiting for our other guests to arrive. 35 minutes later it arrived. We immediately ordered our meals. The meal was to start with 3 soups and 1 salad. The main dishes ordered were 1 chicken dish (split plate), 1 bacon-wrapped beef tips in a red wine reduction/sauce and 1 lamb shank special. About 35-45 minutes later the soups and salads finally arrived. Just prior to the soup and salad coming out, the boss looked over at our table and saw that we were still waiting for the food. He said something to the staff and one staff member responded by claiming he had called for the soups to be prepared. The soups and salad were delivered without any apologies for the slow service. Another incredibly long wait happened again before the main dishes arrived. 

Now for the food critique. I ordered the chicken and dumpling soup--a soup I've had before and loved. The soup features a large feather-light dumpling but not this time. My dumpling was dense and gummy from being significantly undercooked. It was gross!  My beef tips were also substandard. The meat was bland, tough and overcooked. The sauce had potential but was thick and gloppy. I ate a few bites and gave up. 

I don't know what happened tonight. I don't know if they have a new chef or if the chef was simply having a bad day. Regardless, I won't be choosing to return. And this is sad because Grant's had a lot of potential. 

Sorry for the bad review. It is not something I enjoyed writing. I am writing it so that hopefully you will make whatever changes need to be made to reclaim greatness.

I've known John Biss for a long time and he is one of the most honest guys I've ever dealt with. If you actually read all of his online reviews (49 Google Reviews with a 4.2 rating) and almost 1 thousand third party reviews from his actual customers which you can find online you will see what I'm talking about. I'm not sure what the negative reviewer was referring to but it looks as if she had a horrible time in Meridian because both of her reviews while there were bashing local businesses. Anyways you can't go wrong with John's Auto Care. Just read all of his online reviews and you'll get the whole story.

As good as everyone says!  I took my 2018 Audi S4 to get cleaned up after driving it from the East Coast. Had some scratches and they polished everything with the Gold Package. My car was showroom ready when I picked it up!  I will be taking it back again for regular waxing and detailing!

First time in the office and was super impressed! So friendly and very professional. My husband has been going to Guymon for a year now and he always has great things to say but today when I took our son to his appointment I was very happy with the visit and what they suggested for treatment!

This was a lovely experience. The salon is bright, cute and very relaxing. My stylist was great and it's close to my house. So many wins! 

I was able to make an appointment the next day. I saw Alex and didn't have to wait for her at all. I just got a regular haircut (which took seriously 6 minutes) but the whole process was about an hour because Alex took her time to give me a wonderful shampoo, head massage and beautiful blow out. My haircut was simple but well done. I was very pleased with it. My favorite part of the experience was how Alex showed me how to style my own hair just like she did. She showed me all the product but didn't try to up-sale me on any of it. I like that. 

The space is open but not so spacious that it loses intimacy. The decor is traditionally feminine with chandeliers and pink walls and ornate mirrors. They offer a complimentary mimosa or wine (yes please!) and when getting shampooed, you'll get a hot towel wrap and a few minutes of a head massage. It felt like a true spa experience.

I was in desperate need for my 2 Shih Tzus to get groomed, as their regular groomer was sick. I called and was lucky enough to get right in. They called me 2 hours later, which seemed really fast. I was actually a little worried. When I arrived, I was very pleasantly surprised. They did a great job!  I would definitely recommend The Royal S'paw.

If I could give 0 stars I would. 30 mins our food sat out before it was delivered, food was cold, staff was unresponsive and mostly lethargic, order was incorrect. This place has lost it... last visit.

After submitting two website contact us forms, a Facebook message, a Twitter message, and posting a review here, we finally heard back from someone.  It was a reply to the posted review.  Sadly, the reply was not reassuring.  Instead of receiving a refund for food not received and/or not edible due to food allergies, we were given what we are sure is a sincere apology and a generous offer of coupons.  The only issue with that resolution is the strange assumption that offering coupons, inviting us back, basically telling us that we need to spend more money, is not an adequate resolution nor appropriate compensation for our current monetary loss.  In fact, we find it insulting.  We had not decided whether to give this place another try.  I think we have now decided based on how this issue was handled.  Thank you for your time and listening.

Service is awesome sometimes I bump up
points just based on service but the food was equally amazing as service. I got the god father which was AMAZING and the fries are delicious as well. Two weeks later and im craving another sandwhich!
Great overall experience. Everything was super clean and professional. Will be returning for a pedicure next time! Lots of gel polish and dip color choices

This place knows how to flavor up a sandwich. Ingredients are fresh and the menu has many unique options. I consider myself a regular there now and frequently order sandwiches that are consistently great. Hospitality is great and the owner is awesome.
I'm pretty sure those who rate this place low probably go to Subway every other day for their dusty cold cut with mustard, mayo, and olives and call that a tasty sandwich.

Would highly recommend this sandwich shop!

We am hoping this will be the last update we post regarding our now ongoing disappointment with this place.  The level of apathy from this place towards us as customers is unending.  We just now received the coupons offered to us, which are obviously unsatisfactory as a substitute in lieu of providing an actual refund for inedible and erroneous food.  To make matters worse, the coupons came with a letter which had a paragraph of restrictions tied to even attempting to use the coupons.  
Now, we will await the canned, automated response that will surely follow this post, as we have received an exactly worded response with every review post we have left, asking us for the very same information we have already provided; proving that no actual person is monitoring these reviews, only an algorithm.  
Our first review hinted that we may be undecided about visiting this place again, and even hoping for a reason to try one more time, based on our desire to find new places close to us.  We believe our decision is made based on the actions of this place.

I love this restaurant. The yellow curry is my favorite My husband likes their sweet and sour. The staff is always friendly and helpful. The atmosphere is nice, with both, indoor and outdoor dining. If I could give this place more than 5 stars I would.

Our daughter offered to order dinner, go pick up. $105 in food. 
They forgot the double order of Spring rolls requiring a second trip to pick up. 
After talking to the manager who said they offered a store credit or to come pick up, our daughter who wanted the Spring rolls went to pick up.
They credited us the cost of the spring rolls but there was no apology, only curt collection of the credit card information.
She said they were very busy but when daughter picked up, said there were 6 people there.
Saw wa dee is our go-to restaurant. If all the food was included in the original order there would not be a problem.

I came here for a "below the belt" piercing and it was the best experience I've had out of my 15 piercings. Paul did my piercing and I was so incredibly pleased with his skills! Paul was extremely clean to diligent. The situation wasn't awkward and he kept me informed with everything he was doing. The shop is clean, bright, and welcoming unlike some tattoo/piercing places I've been to in the past. The private piercing room is lined with certifications he has received which was awesome to see and made me feel extra comfortable. He provided in depth rules for the best chance to heal properly and sent me home with a card with my jewelry specifications on it and a pamphlet on healing. I was iffy about the pricing since it seemed steep but now that it's all done I don't mind paying the extra cash for the experience and expertise I received. I will never go to another shop after having this piercing with Paul! If you are looking for the answer on where to go for your next piercing, Imperial is the only place to go to.

We have tried a few Mexican restaurants in the area over the last couple years, but never El Tenampa. Boy, were we missing out!! 

The service was phenomenal. Our waitress was so speedy, friendly, and attentive! The food was so delicious. I had carne asada street tacos and loved them!! The avocado on top was perfect. My husband did a taco and enchilada combo, which he also loved. The house made hot sauce is SO GOOD! Don't pass up on that. 

I had a margarita on the rocks, husband had his blended. I don't think I'll do on the rocks again... it tasted too much like a premade mix. But, the food and service made up for a mediocre marg!!

Great location to get a pizza to go. We went with the Hawaiian pizza that had Canadian bacon, pineapple, chicken and bacon, mozzarella cheese and red sauce.
