Counter staff were helpful and quick to serve. Things were busy with takeout, so there was a bit of a delay with my pick up. The quality is well worth it so the delay was not a big problem.  I would recommend as a go to place for take out pizza. 
cheers!

Just awful. Slow doesn't begin to describe the service. Half of our party's orders were incorrect. Lots of staff but all were most likely untrained and the (already low quality) food suffered for it. Eat at one of the other Village restaurants!

This is the WORST company with which I have tried to do business in the last 30 years! We called the office and made an appointment to have somebody come to our home and give an estimate. Clara Crocker came and did her "best" to try to estimate how many rocks we would require. She knew very little about the inventory at Rock Placing Company even though that was really her job. I then went to the Boise office and examined the rocks myself and made a selection. I told the people at the office exactly what I wanted and that I would like to make an appointment to have everything delivered. Then I made the mistake of saying that Clara had been out to the house and she was working with us. They said they would have Clara follow up and call us to make final arrangements. A month went by with no call from anyone, no followup from anyone. So we purchased our rocks from a competitor and are very happy with the result. I don't know how these people stay in business.

They constantly try to upsell and don't take no for an answer, starting from one of the receptionists to my nail tech. I told my nail tech I really didn't care about having a leg treatment, I cared about getting my feet buffed so they'd be soft and moisturized. She looked at me and said "we don't do that here". When she agreed to do a basic pedi she went through the motions for 15 minutes from start to finish. My cousin got polish so her nail tech took a couple minutes longer. They have a timer to make sure they don't massage or in my case scratch your legs with busted acrylics for more than 1:30 each leg. Every where you look, they are asking for cash tips. It was just a bad and awkward experience from start to finish.


UPDATE: I'm going to post what the most basic pedi says on their menu so y'all can see I'm reasonable. These people have me taking impromptu pics at work to defend myself lol. 

I did NOT request extra massaging because I didn't want a massage. I wanted any bit of roughness I had to be buffed. That's all I cared about. So you're wrong for assuming I have terrible callused feet that I'd be "refused service", Ashlee. If you are so concerned about following safety and sanitation rules why did she not even wear gloves? Like I said she was scratching me with her jagged nails the whole time. Not very sanitary. Sorry that's a terrible assumption on your part and a bad excuse. Just to let you know, because she did one swipe on each side of my feet and called it good, my feet are more rough than before but I'll go elsewhere. And don't even go there with credit card machines. Bad excuse number two. But hey, now I know how this business runs. Just informing others. Have the best day!

We were hesitant to try Habit again after our poor experience a few months ago, but everything else was packed and we didn't want to wait. This is a true review as we did not receive any coupons or refunds from our previous bad experience. 

We were so happily surprised. The food was amazing, fresh, perfectly cooked, and hot. It did take a while to get our food, but that is something that every restaurant is dealing with right now. 

We were so grateful for a wonderful experience! Will definitely be returning to our favorite burger joint. Yes

I dropped my daughter's iPad with a broken screen due to being dropped on the drive way. I came in less than 15 mins before closing time and the guys still welcomed me in. They said that it would be done by the end of next day but to my surprise, they called me by 1:00pm the next day to let me know that the iPad is ready for pick up. Work quality was excellent, there's no dark spots on the screen which had happened to me in the past. Screen works like new, there's no sign that it had been replaced. Overall, I'm extremely happy with the repair. Will definitely come back to them for future business

I've been to the Counter a couple of times since it opened. 

In the 3+ months that it has been opened, it has GREATLY improved. In the first month or so, the team was clumsy and figuring out how each other worked. The service speed suffered during that time. The Counter now has found it's groove and service and speed has improved immensely.

All four times that I have been there, David has always served or been around, and he alone really makes the place standout. He's incredibly friendly, welcoming, and professional, and handles customer issues like a pro. 

The menu is extremely minimal, and can be confusing during your first visit, but I've found my servers always willing to explain it if any questions came up. Once you get the hang of it though, it's very simple to understand. 

My go-to order is always a chicken sandwich on a Hawaiian sweet roll (yum!), with spinach, pickled carrots and daikon, red onions, and their house mustard. The order always comes out correct and delicious. Usually accompanied by a side order of 50/50 fries with their shoestring and garlic parmesan fries, that way I can switch between the two. Don't want a bun? Fine! You can get it in a bowl instead for $1 more because they put in more ingredients for you than what a bun could hold.

The food is great. Period. There's an option for anyone and everyone. Those that complained in earlier reviews about hidden charges, let it be known that The Counter Meridian has since taken some off and reduced a few prices. If you're still confused or wondering about what anything on the menu means, ask your server. Those complaining about price, well, you did choose to eat at a restaurant located in The Village, I'm not quite sure why it came as a surprise to you. The Counter listened to demands for higher quality meat, and therefore needs to charge accordingly for the antibiotic and hormone free meats, as well as the other higher quality ingredients and sauces that they offer. I do not think that the pricing is bad at all. My bill usually comes out to $15- $20 for myself, including alcohol and a side of fries, and I think it's reasonable since it is located in The Village, the food is good, the service has improved, and it's a higher quality of product.

As someone who does not enjoy the taste of beer (they have local!) or wine, I really like that they do have two equally delicious cider flavors available. 

The overall design is also nice. It's a very modern/minimal feel with a relaxing color scheme and granite tables and counters. They have a large chalkboard on the wall, and while patrons can't draw or write on it, the typography that is featured on it is very nice to look at and gives a great feel to the place. The patio is a little small, but still enjoyable. The only complaint that I have about the design is that there is not a hook or small table in the women's restroom to place my purse on, because I would really like to not have to put it on the floor or the back of the toilet.

Again, as someone who has been to The Counter four times since the day they opened until now, the service has improved and found their footing. They still have a few problems every now and then, but each time I visit, they've resolved more and more and have only gotten better and better. Can't wait to see how much they've improved by the time their 1 year anniversary rolls around.

Don't let a few negative reviews from the early days of the restaurant deter you from trying this delicious restaurant at least once.
The wash got the sides of the car clean but unfortunately not the front or back... so 2 stars it is.

Absolutely gorgeous salon.  Carly is such a delight and she listens to how you would like your hair cut and then proceeds to go beyond your expectations.  I am used to leaving a salon after a hair cut only to go home and redo the style but not this time.  I left there with a cute cut, ready to go shoe shopping!  Thanks Carly!  You are the real deal when it comes to hair styling.

They just opened and are still getting things going, but the pho was really good. Broth has excellent flavor and there were lots of noodles. Also I usually order no meatballs but forgot to and so I tried them and they were very good. I expect them to just get better once they are able to fully open. Really good!!!!

They are so great! My dogs always look beautiful after getting cared for at splash and Dash. They accommodate my scaredy cat dogs who won't walk on a leash. Too notch!

My dogs have long hair. The first visit was truly a miracle. One of my dogs had a lot of mats and I thought he might need to be shaved. Splash and dash did an amazing job to save his hair. They worked very hard and treated him well during the process. Now that I am on a monthly plan, they will never have mats again. 

Thank you!!!
Expensive park with poor customer service, mostly just kids working with little experience
Very friendly customer service.  That type of home town feel, where they give out sample.  They don't short you on meat and it was excellent!

I live very close to Fiesta Guadalajara but I will go to Corona Village instead-- unless they change management and their rude front desk staff. I asked for a plain quesadilla with just cheese and they wouldn't do it!! At first she said, "If we just put cheese I still have to charge you for the guacamole and sour cream" and I said fine --but when she checked with her supervisor ---he says no they can't make a plain quesadilla. So I finally said can you just get a raw tortilla and some raw cheese and put it in the tortilla and I will just microwave it at home? They gave me raw cheese on a tortilla and charged me full price. I'm not going back unless they change staff and management. Terrible customer service!!

The iced tea was hot. The hot sides were cold. The brisket was sliced incorrectly (with the grain) causing it to not be nearly as tender as it should have been. Had to ask for rolls. Very dissatisfied after spending $50 for lunch.

I ordered through Uber eats... I paid 3 dollars for what I thought was a big yellow cup came as a very small yellow cup. But was worst was when I opened my meat container and found more then half of my cheddar jalapeño sausage grey, dried out, and cold! I won't eat here again. $50 down the drain....
Go to Mexican in the valley! Raised by my Abuelita, I'd take her here any day of the week!

My hubby and I couldn't decide what tacos to get,  so we got 4 different ones to share. Full of meat and they filled us up fast! The chips and queso are a great deal for $3, and you can't beat the house made tortilla chips. Not overly greasy, perfect amount of salt.  The habanero sauce is great,  has a kick to it. I'll definatly go back for more!
Tanya was great. Our dog is a special kind of snow flake and she was able to make him look great. I look forward to using them again.

Hey everyone! The people at Steelz are great! They helped me out when I really needed it. They only have a 30 day warranty and I knew this upon purchase of my new vacuum. After about 90 days my vacuum stopped working.( I know this was the vacuum and not the company) I brought back my vacuum and they gave me a brand new vacuum even though the warranty was up. I highly recommend Steelz! Thanks Steelz for all your help.

The staff...strange. It's like there was an after party for a quinceanera or something. Been here 20 minutes and none of the tables have been bussed, the entire party that got here after us already has their food...like what? Do I tip before I eat to get service or can I just serve myself? Might be better. Would not recommend. Shit service and no f**ks given.

Yes please! 

I felt like I was cheating on Tango's but now I'm happy to say that I'm in a polyamorous relationship with both establishments. :) 

This place is so awesome. I loved the set up. Clean, open and modern. Lots of fun Argentinian touches. 

The star of the show is the empanadas. We had so much mixing and matching the flavors. We tried the beef, chicken, chimichurri chicken and ham and cheese. Everyone (even the picky 2 year old Hurricane) enjoyed all the flavors. Next time we are ordering double so we can all have our own. I love green olives so the traditional flavors were my fave. The little people enjoyed ham and cheese and my old man wanted more of everything! 

We really loved that these were baked. The grease was non existent and we think they traveled really well. The queen of Yelp Boise (she's a triple black - you know who she is) says that the uncooked pockets of goodness freeze and bake up at home super well. I'm definitely going to stock up for a quick and delicious weekday dinner. 

Well done to this little business!

We got boneless chicken wings as an appetizer to share, and sirloins for our entrees. The wings were a joke, more like chicken nuggets from the freezer. The sauces/dressings we got were buffalo, honey sriracha, and ranch dressing, but we ordered bleu cheese, all were very runny, and meh. The honey sriracha was terrible. When our entrees arrived, we asked for salt and pepper, and some butter. That request took 15 minutes, no butter, but some weird theatre type butter spread, and only salt, no pepper. The mashed potatoes tasted like instant box potatoes poorly made. The seasonal veggies were green beans, also very bland. Just left the sides alone they were that bad. The steaks were okay, but again very bland. First and last time eating there.

This location has some serious issues.  4 people working.  A couple was in front of us and a woman wondering around waiting for her order.  She finally got it but had to say 'where is the meat'.  More people came in behind us and after standing there waiting 10 minutes or more for some eye contact and for someone to ask us for our order we finally were acknowledged.  He had to go get paper to write our meat orders while another girl got our side order.  We go to the register and have to tell her again what we ordered.  She brings it out about 10 min later and forgets what we ordered and also put one of my sides on my husbands plate and his were missing.  Had to go ask for them.  No one else stayed in the restaurant and just one couple was in there before us.  Tables were dirty and were still dirty when we left.  Ice cream machine had a sign on it that the ice cream wasn't ready yet but it didn't seem to be on at all.  Tv's weren't on, no onions or pickles were out like I've seen before.  Maybe trying to conserve energy in this time of less people eating out?  I will not visit this location again.   I could tell there was poor management and training of these staff members.  They were slow, disoriented and couldn't remember anything.

This is a classy and super clean place to wash or have your dog groomed. They have great rates for the diy wash! They have everything you need: walk in tub, apron for you to stay dry, shampoo, brushes, combs, ear wipes, towels and blow dryer, and ear muffs . They even give your furry friend a treat when your done. We've had Alex groom our Bernese and he's done a fabulous job each time.
Amazing atmosphere and empanadas. I love that they have traditional empanadas as well as modern and vegetarian options. Very good empanadas and kind staff!

Rachael and David at The Royal S'paw is AMAZING!  I came in with my very scared doodle dog (she's always been uncomfortable with grooming) who was immidiateley shaking upon entering.  David got down on the floor and just started petting and talking to her.  After seeing that it had only been 3 weeks since her spay, Rachael requested that I reschedule to allow her to heal up a bit more before grooming.  Now that may have rubbed someone else the wrong way but I was so appreciative that she was willing to push me out further for the good of my dog instead of her bottom dollar.  When we did come back for grooming, she groomed my pup exactly as requested.  They seem to be loving and gentle with each dog and I know my high anxiety dog and I are much appreciative!  Looking forward to our next visit!

I made an appointment pretty last minute for a full highlight and toner with Katie after seeing my friends hair and also seeing them on Instagram stories! I loved how beautiful the salon looked in pictures and how cute all the stylists were in their profiles. For me that is the face of the salon-it's marketing in itself and I loved it. Anyway, Katie did my hair and she was so patient in that I wasn't quite for sure what I wanted, but she listened and I showed her pictures and she looked! That's something that doesn't happen everywhere!!! She took great care in every foil, and then sat me under the heater which felt so good! I had a glass of champagne, and relaxed! It was so nice! Then she toned me and conditioned my hair while I had a warm towel around my neck-it was heaven! The whole time I was there I felt pampered by every stylist that was there-they all are included in your experience which I loved too!! Katie styled my hair so cute and I left feeling so good. A huge plus was the products she recommended to me-they're amazing too. Just all around an amazing place!
I love this place! The vegan curry is so good and the staff is super friendly every time!!

I just got food there. I tried to upgrade and get a larger order. Instead of them giving me a bigger portion. They were very lazy and had the worst customer service ever.  Not only did I receive a small portion of the second entree, and very little chow main. There was hair in my food as well.

I have been to every thai restaurant in town now except for this place, so of course I had to give it a try! I had heard lots of good reviews on it, and people have told me I HAD to go there.

came in on a saturday evening at 6. no wait. the host did ask us if we had a reservation (kind of weird, but ok). 

to start we got the "dumplings" which were chicken and shrimp and steamed. they were $6.99 for 4 small dumplings. they were flavorful, but in my opinion they were over priced for what you get. if we had gotten 6 of them, i might feel better about it. 

my go-to order at thai is chicken green curry, so of course I ordered that. the rice that came on the side was over cooked and mushy, and the curry came in this big fancy bowl with a fancy carved carrot on top. unfortunately, it was barely even warm. not piping hot like I would expect. i'm not the type to send food back, so I lived with it luke warm. for $15.99, I expected more. 

my husband got a noodle dish- I forget which one. his food was hot. it was okay, pretty flavorful, and they made it spicy which he said was okay. never spicy enough for him. 

I also got a thai iced tea which tasted like vanilla ice cream, like they had put imitation vanilla in it. it was not great. i've had better in town. 

1 beer, 1 thai iced tea, 1 appetizer, 2 entrees- $56 + tip. i'm used to paying prices like that in LA, not a little hole in the wall place like this. it was disappointing.

I wasn't impressed and likely won't be back because I have had better thai food in town and I don't get to eat it all the time so when i do have it I prefer to go somewhere I love.

We have taken our dog here just a couple of times, for a bath and maybe 2 haircuts. He was always very nervous having to be left there and I just thought it was because it was a new place. But from how this one groomer treated our dog I will never go back again. When my husband came to pick our dog up the groomer lady grabbed and pulled on the bottom of his chin and he just yelped. My husband asked her why she did that and she told him that's how she has to get control of him. No telling what else went on that we didn't see. I would think twice before taking your dog here. No wonder our dog didn't want to be left there. We are so upset this happened. I can't even give this place one star but it won't let me submit it without one

Ok, today was the third time trying to get curbside service to actually work.  Yes, we know you are getting bonus "virtue-signaling" points for having curbside service.  But what about the service actually works?  Nothing.  Nada.

Each time I pulled up, I dutifully went to the pizza tracker on my phone and hit the button that says "I have arrived".  Then I am treated to a 5-10 minute wait past the time the pizza is ready and boxed.  The reason why the wait is only 5-10 minutes is because that is when I get out of the car and ask the dullard behind the counter if my order number is ready.  Each time I get the same answer, yes (getting colder by the minute).

Goodbye forever, Marco.  Back to Dominos whose employees actually get off the dead rumps to bring the order to your car when you tell the pizza tracker you are there.   Maybe you, or your system, or your employees need to learn some customer interface skills.   Best of luck failing the next customer.
Super clean place with fantastic, authentic Argentinian empanadas. Good selection of craft beer and wine. Awesome place to chill with some friends or for a quick after school snack with the kids.

First time customer. Horrible service. Paid for club cut. Did not get the shampoo, hot towel. 

The hair cut in itself was below average. Had to point out few times the areas that needed levelling ( and I do not have too much hair)

Charging $4 extra for sanitization. Why will the customer pay for sanitization.

Will never visit.

I'm glad that their is still shops like this one. Took two watches one for a pin replacement and other for loose crown. Very reasonable prices and fixed in a reasonable time. Will definitely go here next time.

After working to clean the undercarriage of my 1970 Ford van for a while, the technician stopped, had me come over and look at his work, and said he wasn't sure if he was going to be able to get the under carriage completely clean, and he didn't want me to have to pay for something I wasn't satisfied with. I don't think this has ever happened to me. Talk about customer focused. Suffice to say, he had already removed the vast majority of the gunk under my car and it looked great. Definitely clean enough to work on now after having sat in the dirt for 12 years. By the way, in the bay next to the one where they were working on my van, there were two big trucks they were detailing. I have never seen trucks sparkle like that before. The paint looked like glass. I am not kidding you when I say these guys do amazing work. You can't go wrong with folks  company. I'd give them 10 stars if I could.
Second time here and just as delicious as the first time.  Great crust and just the right amount of filling.  Service is always great too.

Stopped in for dinner tonight and was impressed by the selection of empanadas and wines! The owner Tom made great recommendations. I went with the carne picante and chicken chimichurri, both were delicious and tasted just like they did when I visited Argentina. I will definitely be back to try more!

Unfortunately we didn't check the Yelp reviews before eating here tonight, or we could have saved ourselves. After arriving, I checked to make sure that they served a veggie burger - the waitress confirmed, and said it was delicious. Come to find out, twenty minutes later, and after ordering - they are out of veggie burgers. There were probably six tables in the place, surely they weren't all eating veggie burgers. Being a vegetarian, my only option at that point was a salad. It came out lacking many of the options I had chosen on my list (cheese, salsa), and it was just bland and chopped to oblivion. When I order onions in a salad (among other things), I expect them to somewhat resemble onions, not minuscule slivers of their former selves. It simply looked and tasted like a mash of lettuce in a dish. The $1 add-on option for avocado was about 1/6th of an avocado. If I'm paying extra for a topping it needs to be more than that. I could have thrown together a better salad at home for 1/4 of the price. My dinner mates thought the same of their burgers, bland and not impressive at all. It's incredibly overpriced for what you get. Not worth it. Go somewhere else.

First time I'd ever had to pick my seasoning level on Thai food.  But when they say spicey, believe them!!!
The food was excellent, service very good. Can't wait to go again!

This place is great if you're looking for some great thai food.  Service is fantastic and the sushi is damn good.  They're a bit small so during their rushes, like 6pm, you'll find yourself on a waiting list for seats.  It's a testament to their quality.

Staff is super friendly and accommodating, not to mention the food is bomb. I've had pho made by a lady who owns a restaurant in Vietnam and I was not disappointed by this place. Great broth very tasty, check it out!
The food and staff are amazing! Chef Wally is great even though he has poor taste in football teams. We highly recommend you try this place!! Go Raiders.

The name says it all - they have empanadas!!

Bigger than I thought they'd be (I ordered online) but all were vary good.  In order of preference:  Traditional. Carne Picante.  Ham and Cheese.  Italian Sausage.  Both sauces went well with all.  

Service was very good (owners?).  Will be back.

I became a fan if Walmart pickup when it was first launched.  It's a Godsend for my disability.  The amount of pick-up spaces at this store is pretty amazing.  I have yet to see them all full.  The employees are always fast and friendly too.

I haven't actually gone into the store but if the inside is as good as pickup... top notch Walmart

Manager was rude unprofessional and did offer solutions to the order I had. Instead overcharged me and gave me kiddie portions. Will never go back and will make sure family and friends don't either. I also called when I got home and the manager just argued with me and did not apologize. I have never left a bad review for anyone but this was so bad.

Being a big guy, I can eat about 4-5 of these street tacos...man are they GOOD! The BBQ brisket is always delicious when I've swung through. I'm practically in love with the house made habanero salsa that comes on the side in bottles...
The soda machines got chewy ice as well so...who could possibly complain!  
Great casual spot.

Great service and food. I had the chicken Cobb salad. Lots of bleu cheese crumbles, tender chicken, REAL slices of bacon and eggs. Yumm! My husband enjoyed his chicken nachos and Full Curl draft beer. We will definitely be back

We had an employee from there trying to re-cruit people for this gym. I believe he was a manager. We decided we would sign up and his super low rate and had 3 days to change our mind. so after 2 days we decided the price and what they had to offer was not right for us we went in and canceled. 5 months later had some random huge charge from the place on our credit card! We were IRATE! The only time we'd ever stepped foot into the place was to deny membership! Why did they keep us in there file and why did they randomly charge us a fee?? I'm just glad that the credit card it was on wasn't cancelled or else it would have gone to colections and ruined our credit with out our knowlegde! Stuff like this makes me super angry!

Went here on a Saturday, I was the only one in there I asked the waiter for a beer he brought me a beer set it on the table didn't bring me a glass or even open the bottle for me was walking away I asked him would you please open this for me it's not a twist off , I could tell he really felt put out. But I ordered my pho anyway, I was hungry. Well he brought my food dropped it off didn't ask me if I needed anything else and hurried off! so I would order out and not eat in I didn't leave him a tip which is not like me but I had to ask him for every single thing.

Just had a burger and some of their yummy purple fries....yep i said purple fries!! One of the best things about this place is their many different types of fries and dipping sauces to choose from...sooooo fun! Their burgers are really good as well...give the bison burger a try, it doesnt disappoint!

Always a good go to Mexican restaurant.  We came for lunch today and I am always amazed at how attentive the staff is.  They never let your glass sit empty, they keep the chips full and they are very friendly.  
I also have to mention their soup is wonderful.  
The ambience is really fun too.  
Definitely a good stop for lunch.

I like the organic concept... But organic to me doesn't mean without flavor. The burger and the fries had no flavor whatsoever. Both my husband and I found it. Waste of money. The plus here is that the fries are cooked in an oil that isn't vegetable/ soybean oil- just wish it tasted good as well...
...always friendly, always thorough & always willing to priority schedule. I've felt very safe having procedures here even during era of Covid-19.

25+ mins to wait then it's slow (2customers) is unsat.  Managing the two other people standing around can easily help this situation. Walked in at the time you all told me it would be done and you didn't place the burgers on the grill for another 3 mins.

Spent way too much money for this business to truly not deliver the "5 star" service they claim to have. Would recommend checking out another place in Boise that won't waste your time and money. My car didn't even get fully cleaned after spending $270+... 
They said they would clean it if I brought it back in, but everything should've been done the first time without me having to drive clear across town to fix mistakes they made. Next time take quality time to do your work.

New location few mins drive from the new Costco. Wonderful and strong vacuums. Easy to understand plans and always a staff member available to help and answer questions. The other location has a wonderful mat washer that I think is also available here. Haven't seen it yet so can't guaranty it. My fav car wash in tower. Simple and straight forward process and great cleanup area too

Got invited last minute by another couple for dinner on Friday night made a call to grants and they said half hour wait. By the time we got there we were seated immediately. We've been here one other time a couple years ago, this place is great! Fresh food chef designed well thought out Menu, very Will final choices. This place sits on the end of a little strip mall in West Meridian on Cherry Lane. Not a lot of seating, summer time they open up the patio and there's lots of room there.

So I haven't come here in awhile but I just arrived and I'm already questioning my choice to come back. The seating was a confusing mess when I asked to be seated toward the back because I have a baby. Then my waitress asked if we were ready and I said yes and asked for a spoon. She left to get a spoon and hasn't returned for awhile.

So our food arrived shortly after and redeemed the one star I originally was going to give. Not great service but at least the food was good.

Went here last weekend and was slightly disappointed. The place in is this kind of strip mall off the beaten path. It is small but had a really nice vibe to it. It has a nice little outdoor seating area which I bet is great in the summer months. Service was good, waitress was quick with refills a getting orders. She checked on is once but mostly just left us to ourselves which we like. The food is what really bums me out. My husband and I both ordered steaks, his medium rare and mine medium well. Neither was cooked to how we ordered. They were both probably medium. The meat wasnt the greatest  either. Both has chunks of inedible gristle. Flavor was lacking on the steak. Sides were good but there wasnt much. The cost were I think 28 each for the dinner and it was not worth it. I had some really high hopes, but left feeling disappointed and annoyed for spending that much money.

I'm so happy to have a new delicious Vietnamese restaurant in Meridian! My wife and I went to try in out for lunch today and we were very pleased with our first experience here. Being a Vietnamese-American who grew up with Vietnamese food, having a good Viet restaurant near where I live is a great blessing to me. The flavor of the pho was delicious and I can definitely see myself becoming a regular here. The Thai tea was a nice drink to pair with our meal too. They have a decent sized menu with only Vietnamese dishes here so you can tell their focus is just on delivering quality Vietnamese food.

I had heard that the last Vietnamese restaurant that occupied the venue wasn't very good and was unclean, so I had my doubts about this restaurant which took its place. I glad my wife and I tried this restaurant because not only is their food good but the dining area and restrooms are clean. The dining area is nicely laid out with paintings on the wall that reflect the architecture and culture of Vietnam. The restaurant is under new ownership as they bought the place from the old owners, and it looks like they've replaced it for the better. I look forward to trying their egg rolls next and their combination rice special. Thanks for choosing to open in Meridian, and I look forward to dining there again!

What a surprise!!!!  Quaint with a patio and full bar.  Staff was very friendly and helpful.  The food hit the spot for us.  The double cut pork chop was out of this world.  We also enjoyed the bacon wrapped poppers ( a must order).  Since we are new to the area we are so happy we found this hidden gem....

Delicious empanadas!  I had the original, the chimichurri chicken, and the spinach feta.  They were all excellent but the original was definitely my favorite. 

The service was great and also very attentive.  The ambiance is great and everything was impeccably clean. We didn't get any wine this time but they have a nice list of Malbec (my favorite!) that I plan to sample next time. 

I highly recommend if you want tasty and authentic empanadas!

What a great experience!
Excellent food and exceptional service. 
The cinnamon roll is huge and perfectly cooked.

I'm finally getting my credit in better shape, and got offered a much lower interest rate (about half of what reliable gives me), but in the interest of loyalty I asked if reliable could match or come close to what the other company can get me. They WOULDN'T BUDGE on the 29% interest saying "corporate wont allow it", then turned around and offered me more money on the same 29% interest loan. Nah. I changed my business to the company who would give me the interest rate that now closely matches my credit score.

Reliable is fine if your credit sucks but don't expect them to grow with you. They will not budge on their interest rates even if you improve your credit and have been a loyal customer for years. 

Congratulations reliable credit, you lost a customer permanently.

This place is great. I randomly decided to get a nose piercing, and I called an hour ahead and they got me in. I was super nervous because I was afraid of the pain, but Dan helped me through the whole thing and I barely felt a pinch. He was incredibly careful and gentle and it's turned out great!! Affordable and informative, highly recommend.

My first time trying this place out and I'm so happy with their food and service.  I'm particularly picky about Asian food, growing up in Hawaii and living in Southern CA (lived in and near 2 high density areas of authentic Vietnamese restaurants--Reseda, CA and Westminster, CA).  The pho broth was delicious!  Also ordered the flat noodle shrimp and broccoli.  This has been the best Asian restaurant I've been to since I've moved here a little over a year ago.   This place is close to my home so I'm pretty sure I'll be back again to try out more dishes.  I was actually happy to see that they did not serve sushi.  Seems a lot of places here try to mix Asian cuisines as two separate types of cuisines in one restaurant as opposed as fusion.  That never goes well when I try those places.  Looking forward to going back to try more here.
Friendly serve. Great sandwich's. The potato salad is outstanding. Has a good area for outside seating.

My children have attended NHA from the infant room all the way up to the school-agers, it is the only place I feel comfortable sending my kids. I LOVE their Daily Connect access! I get real-time updates & photos of my kids while I'm at work & can message back and forth with the teacher. The teachers are really accommodating with my breastfeeding and pumped milk. Ms. Sydney in the toddler room is so loving!

If you haven't been to The Empanada Club yet, add it to your to-do list! I got a takeout order tonight for family and friends and it was amazing. While I waited for my order to be ready I chatted with the owners who were delightful and felt like friends by the time I left. The empanadas were just like the ones I had in Buenos Aires, with baked, flaky pastry (not fried) and generous fillings with tons of flavor and quality ingredients. Our favorites were the carne Picante and the portobello mushroom. Gourmet flavor for $4! Also be sure to get some chimichurri sauce with your order. Why does anyone go to fast food places when the Empanada Club is so close?

This was my second time visiting Big Al's for a family Christmas bowling session and I'm sure we'll be back next year as well! 

The bowling is cheap and the whole place is super family friendly. The food is okay but the wait service is very attentive and fast. The arcade area has something for everyone and isn't overly crowded. They offer great price bundles that ensures you get your money's worth; spend more, earn free stuff!
My daughter in law and I went there and I can guarantee that we will be going again. Thank you so much

Planned on coming here to drink and bowl so I got a lane in the VIP section. Paid 45$ for me and my wife. We had to ask for someone to come help us for drinks and food after bowling 15min. Someone finally came to help us with drinks. Next time they came to ask us if we needed another drink was at the end of our time bowling. Worst money I have ever spent. Last time I come here. What a joke!

Lovely ladies, full of love for county, cooking, and you await your pick up. Bought for a work function where everyone raved about the taste, texture, and varieties of choices. Don't forget to pickup their cookies, too!

Loved the car wash when i used it! My problem is that i told them i was moving and i needed to cancel. It's been over 3 months and I'm still getting charged. I call and no one answers. There is a form online to cancel but i no longer have the windshield sticker (because i thought it was cancelled) and you need that to make changes online. Can't find an email address anywhere. I do regret getting a membership..because at this point I've paid over $100 without using it once. :(
I loved my pedicure technician. She was very gentle and thorough. She made appropriate suggestions, taking into account my time constraints.
Authentic, delicious, decently priced. Great atmosphere, too. Definitely worth a try.

Walked in and stood at the host booth while 4 girls walked by me and looked me straight in the eye, no greet or anything, just kept walking and ignored us. Finally sat down, and ignored again. We ended up leaving. Working in customer service before, I know that it's important to at least great customers and let them know they are seen.

Maybe we didn't look like people they would want in their restaurant.

The fam was pretty excited when we saw Tin Roof being built by the house. However, it's hard to justify going there at the moment. The last two times we've went they're 2 for 8 on our orders. That'll work in baseball but not for a food business. Cats are working too fast to get the orders out without reading what's actually being ordered. 

Portions are kinda weak too - don't mean to be so negative.

Atmosphere:

The atmosphere is authentic, and I love it. The vibrant colors will take you to the heart of Mexico City. Nice and large. Good for big families or family events. 

Staff:
Eddy was very hospitable. He greeted us with a smile and was friendly. He waited on us too. Which was nice. He was continuously ensuring we had our drinks, and were okay. 

Food:
You'll be greeted with salsa, chips, and a bowl of bean dip. 

Salsa is Silvia's. Really good. Chips were nice and warm. The beans were okay. Not tons of flavor. No cheese or red sauce. Just straight grounded pinto beans. 

I ordered lunch fajitas, and the hubby ordered shredded beef nachos. 

The nachos were fantastic! The shredded beef added a nice texture. The cheese blend tasted favorable and robust. Very generous portion of cheese. Comes with a scoop of Guacamole and scoop of sour cream. 

The fajitas were very authentic. The flavor had an earthy taste to it. Not my cup of tea, but if you like earthy food, it's the thing to try. Also, I asked for no mushrooms, and they forgot to omit that tiny ingredient. Which may of caused the earth flavor. The skirt steak was burnt to a crisp. The lunch was large in portion. You receive heavy sides and light main course. Which I'm okay with, I love rice. 

Our server was generous enough to give us a desert. Very thoughtful of him. It was very delicious. I'm not too sure what it was, but had brown sugar and honey on it. 

You'd be sure to get a fill. 

Also side note, the restaurant does not allow you to do substitutions. Hubby wanted steak nachos. The waiter said there could many be substitutions. 



Prices:
Average. 

Parking:
A short coming. We parked across the street. 

More importantly Would we ever go back? 
Yes. It's the closest authentic place we've tried.

Fat Guys Deli....a deli not only for fat guys. 

Love me some fat guys! Feeling lonely and need some company? Grab a fat guy. Insecure and need moral support? Grab a fat guy. Love bacon with the rest of the sane world? Go to fat guys. 

Honestly though, this deli is great. It's not your average meat slicing and shredded lettuce with oil and vinegar type deli. It's a hot, savory, melt in your mouth deli that your taste buds will be rejoicing over later. The sandwiches are very unique, juicy, and crave inspiring. 

The bacon here by the way....thick cut and generous in portions. BLT will blow your mind, bronco will leave you speechless,  you just need to give it a shot. One of of best in the valley for sure. 

Great job fat guys...keep it up and none of us will need belts soon. Eat up boise!
I went to ihop tonight and preferred it took an hour to get my food and didn't even get water

Look. I understand not wanting to be at work, but this is pretty bad. 

I ordered the broccoli beef and got one piece of beef . Like come on.

We love a good deli sandwich. We tried "Fat Guy's Fresh Deli and it is one of the best sandwiches I've ever had. The people who work there and very nice and make a great sandwich. It is small but you can eat outside too
They won't make me crispy meat with no cheese burutto. Same on you lost a sale!    People don't not go to this location. An d bad service!!!!!!

Meridian Floral saved my husband's life when an online service fell through.  He should probably be writing this and giving rave reviews ;) They did a GREAT job... Especially for a last minute on the fly purchase.  The roses were beautiful and we were able to enjoy them for nearly 2 weeks before they started falling.

Courtney and the Beautiful Reaction team are absolutely fantastic!!! My highlights and cut came out so beautifully and the entire process was really enjoyable.  The care and attention that every stylist showed to clients and each other was so refreshing - from offering mimosas to keeping the space spotless, there's a lot of pride in their craft!  Courtney made sure to go over the look I wanted to achieve and after such a nice time chatting and relaxing (amazing products with the most refreshing scents, lovely hot towel and head massage, did I mention mimosas?) she styled me and I was off!  I can't wait to come back! Thank you :)

We had a company come to do pest control. They told us what they'd do and it sounded great. We hired them and the tech came and we thought they did what they were supposed to do. VANGUARD came by a couple days later and when I told them we just had it done Austin pointed out to me that the job was not complete and showed me several areas that were not taken care of. He said what he would do for us which was to come out for free and do it again just to get our business. We called the other company to give them a chance to rectify the situation and they didn't return our call. Vanguard sent Chester to take care of things. Great experience and appreciated the great customer care and professionalism of the company. Won't use anyone else from now on.

Burger (sergeants pepper) was amazing!!! fries were hard I usually eat the fries couldn't find one that was soft. Service was great! Bathroom was hug the toilet to get in the stall but clean. Overall good lunch stop on our holiday adventure.
Good Thai food. Only had the Pad Se Ew and Thai iced tea as they are no favorites..Been back several times and have not been tempted to try anywhere else..

My right thumb is crooked and when I said something he was like "no from you the way look at it it is."  I made an appointment for a  full set acrylic. But he did acrylic dip powder , which feels like I have on cheap press on nails. Not even an hour after having them done the gel on my left thumb came completely off. Under my nails there is glue and acrylic powder stuck to them. I'm not happy or impressed with these nails at all

I was very dissatisfied with my experience. Im young and was planning a funeral for a close friend who unexpectedly passed away. I had no idea what I was doing but I knew money was a problem for me. From the moment I walked in it was "money this money that". Not one time was I cared about or spoken to in a kind manner. I ended up going with someone else and had a much better experience. When someone loses someone, you should absolutely treat them with more love and compassion than I was given.

I had my hair done for the first time at A Beautiful Reaction and absolutely loved my experience! The salon is decorated so cute and was very clean. Katie was my stylist and did a great job. She made sure to ask all the right questions to make sure she understood what I wanted, and the products she used made my hair shiny, soft and smelled amazing. Plus I was able to enjoy an ice cold, delicious mimosa...just what this mama needed to enhance her time of beauty! I'll definitely be booking again!

Rachel & David are amazing! My dogs were both groomed, and they loved it. My lab got his teeth brushed, and he needed deshedding for sure. When he was done, he was not only super soft but happy and smelled clean as well. Thank you 4 taking care of my fur babies. I hope you get Care Credit soon! Please let me know once it's offered.

Worst movers.  They take no protection to protect your furniture.  Their movers are not experienced.  They DO NOT return calls, emails or text message.  The company says they want to make it right, but they don't.  I do not recommend them.

I am in between homes right now and I need a project done while I could be at the one house. I contacted Gabriel and he worked with our schedule and they did an amazing job on our patio. It looks great and they did what they said. I would for sure use them again. I also really appreciated the cleanup they left the site looking nice and clean too.

Gabriel and his crew did a fantastic job and I definitely would call him again. They arrived early, finished on time, and were careful at each step that the quality was right. Would highly recommend. Thanks!

I love this place and more importantly my fur baby does as well. Their prices are reasonable and my favorite part is that they do exactly as you want. (Trim here not there etc.) They have a friendly staff and the place is real clean!

Been here several times and shocked haven't written a review!  Maybe I was too excited for their garlic noodles or the basil chicken dish...either way I've been VERY happy with everything I've had here!

During this lunch visit there was only one other table seated to start but my son and, I were seated away from other table in nice quiet spot.  Was happy to see the scaled down menu....still tons to choose from. Jasmine our waitress very friendly and service was spot on. 

We waffled over what to try this time...the red,  yellow or green curry (heat scale 1-5) Panjang Curry or maybe the garlic noodles again....truthfully all have been delicious!  The included side salad not to bad with crisp  iceberg lettuce & orange dressing.  

Soon the restaurant filled up and all the delicious smells. Service still great. 

They even have live music on some evenings! ill be back again and again I'm sure!

The absolute worst pizza and service ever.  So disappointed that a new local pizza place sucks sooo bad. I will never order a pizza from this place again.  Look at my reviews dont normally post negative reviews but this place.lied to my face and had the worst customer service that I experienced in this town.  I wont even go into the details but if you want a pizza here be prepared to wait 2 hours or more and they will tell you 5 minutes but 30 minutes later your pizza wont be ready.  Nothing special AT ALL.

Typically impressed with tin roof but not today. Arrived to order an they didn't have brisket, shrimp, fish, fried chicken, chips, or flour tortillas. Literally everything I was going to order couldn't be prepared. Lack of preparation lands them a 1 Star review.

I've been a patient here since 2007.  I used to like the Doctors (Williams and McMurry) and the Staff (Ann, the Officer Manager is fabulous).  In the past year or so, every time I would go in, Dr.  Williams seems to always be in a rush, is short and seems annoyed.  He has also been rude to his staff in front of me several times, which makes him look arrogant. There are plenty of other dental places in town.  I refuse to deal with rude people, especially when I am paying a lot of money for my services.

Stopped in for a quick snack, pleasantly surprised. Super friendly staff and great empanadas. We had traditional, tuna and chicken. Delicious!! We happen to be in during happy hour so we enjoyed some local beers at a discount too. We'll be back for sure! Check it out.... you'll be happy you did.
Had to edit to add dessert.... just do it; so delicious!!

We are on the move on our cross country road trip from the PNW to Northern VA!  This is one of my first reviews of a dining spot for us tired, hangry, roadtrippers!  Looking for something unique, locally owned, reasonably healthy, and kid friendly in the Meridian - Boise area.  We found the spot.

Empanadas are a perfect handheld and convenient food.   This spot is owned by a couple who were raised in Argentina and touting empanadas made from SCRATCH!  Wonderful ingredients and such an incredible flaky and savory experience.  

Vegan and vegetarian options include the Spinach Feta and the Coconut Curry Roasted Vegetable.  Wow, what a flavor explosion.  Add some Chimichurri dipping sauce (garlicky herb goodness) or Fuego sauce (mildly spicy but oh so yummy) to top things off.

Get some!

I've come here a few times when it's time for complete change for my hair. I don't mind paying a little more for better quality and great service. The one time I went somewhere else and got a color that wasn't exactly what I expected, then Ashley Heimback took care of it the next day and I couldn't be happier. When I'm in town, I try to always schedule in an appointment with Ashley she's the best!
Good place to take out of staters to get numerous styles of French fries. Burgers were okay...not the best but still worth it! Crazy amount of sauce choices to go with the fries!

I can't say I love the place, but also can't say that I hate it either. It's been hit or miss of the times I've been here, both in quality and customer service. Bagel sandwiches are generally pretty good, and not the typical food chain near work so as to why I stop in now and then, just to change up my lunch options. The bagels with cream cheese spread is definitely a favorite, but the sandwiches are just OK in my opinion.

I have brought my goldendoode to the groomers and I left very unsatisfied. He was shaven completely down to the pink of his bone along with bruises. I was charged the full price of the grooming although they did not trim his nails either.. claiming he did not allow (never been a problem before). In audition, the groomer asked me if i had wanted to keep all the fur that was shaven off to use it for something. Please save yourself some pain and your poor precious pet from grooming here. I strongly recommend researching other groomers before taking your pet there, which I wish I had prior to my visit.

Local owners who tout supporting local but then disappear. They are 2 blocks from Meridian High School but i don't see them supporting them. I understand that small local businesses can't support everything and say yes to every request but I haven't seen them do any and they are in the heart of where all of these students and their families live. My kids play football, lacrosse, basketball, cross country, and participate in the high school bowling team. The food is delicious, pricing seems a little high but it is specialty so may be appropriate. Staff doesn't seem overly appreciative of patronage but they definitely are not rude
Not even authentic. It's essentially just some gourmet Taco Bell/ del taco smh. Insulting

Cute little Thai/sushi restaurant. My husband, my friend, and I tried several different items on the menu and the one thing that we didn't like that much was the pad Thai. It had good flavor, but the noodles had a sorta slimy texture that wasn't pleasant. However, everything else was amazing. Coconut Tom Kha Soup, Fresh Spring Rolls, sashimi trio appetizer, OMG specialty roll, a dumpling appetizer (can't remember the name), beef pho, and for drinks, ginger lemon drop and long island ice tea. I will definitely be returning whenever I visit Meridian, Idaho.

As you can tell by my number of check ins here, I come here on a regular basis.  Part of me thinks that because I come so often I see more of the cracks & flaws than someone who visits occasionally. However, since I am a regular and have a VERY specific order, I kinda expect them to realize that it's me & if my order is wrong, I will send it back.  So, here is my overall opinion:

Pros:
Majority of managers seem to really try hard to make customers happy
Lobby is consistently clean
Overall friendly service
Decent prices
They are willing to give sauces & ketchup if you ask for it

Cons:
Lack of communication with the grill employees. It seems like the people working the grill simply do not listen to any direction or instructions given. I have literally seen a manager stand at the pass & send a cheeseburger back 4 times trying to get it made with extra mustard. She ended going back & doing it herself. 
High employee turnover

We stopped by for lunch and the service was terrible! Never got a Hello or even a Thank You when we paid the bill. The servings are huge but the food is gross. This is not authentic Mexican food. I mean they served us the pre-made taco shells like the ones from taco bell -thats not authentic.  The atmosphere was bizarre,  seemed like no one was happy working there. Glad we got out of there and never going back.
Yummy and authentic tasting empanadas! The worker was so kind and offered some of the popular items as well as described what was in them.

Update based on March 2021 repair work: 20+ year certified pool plaster company removed all plaster and found the bonding layer for the plaster was not properly prepared for adherence and some of the concrete they used to build up top portion had pieces of plastic in it and was crumbling!!! See you in court Jim....
I purchased the 30 dollar interior wash & am not impressed at all. I could have done a much better job myself in half of the time.

Hmm where do I start with all that is terribly wrong with this business.  At the scheduled appointment for wash, cut, nails etc., we were told they ended up not having enough time to finish the job and rescheduled the cut to the following week.  We brought in our dog on the date they wrote down on a "sticky note" and provided to us.  The gal up front told us they didn't have our dog on the books, but would "squeeze" her in.  They then charged for the full service despite the fact they were only doing a cut.  We had already paid for the other services rendered the week prior.  When asked to rerun the credit card for a refund on the "cut" portion of the charge $29, the gal advised she didn't have the authority to do that. HMMM she has the ability to charge someone but not credit back an erroneous charge???  She then went on to say that they don't particle out services and it's a full $59.. well we asked then why did you charge $30 the week prior for just the wash and nail trim... She couldn't explain that.  I can and told her that it appears to be a racket for them to "run out of time" for services and to have the customer come back, only to charge them AGAIN for services already rendered.. and then conveniently be unable to credit back the charges... Someone say scam?? 
We then got a call that the dog was done.. when we went to pick her up, they hadn't even started her.. they had no reason why they called and said she was done, disputing they called.. ah, they did.  Have the phone record to prove it...  She then said she would have the owner call me and left it at that.  Well I then pointed out she didn't have my cell number so how was the owner to know who to call and what number.  Out came the sticky note pad where I wrote down my name and number and she advised she would have the owner call the following Tuesday... it's Thursday, no call... 
Side note, I waited for our dog to be finished when I went in the shop to see what was going on later as she still wasn't done.  they brought her out, full of cut hair that got all over me and the car.  What a sloppy mess.

Unfortunately, this is another example of a great place that has gone horribly downhill. 
It is sad that when bagels are to be toasted that they come out soft and gummy with no color change on the bagel implying toasting. 
It is also disappointing that the consistency is poor enough that my bagel had loads of cream cheese making it disgusting to eat, and my wife's bagel had so little cream cheese that when the halves were separated there were dry spots. 
The sun-dried tomato cream cheese used taste like sun-dried tomato and actually had tomato bits in it. Today's sun-dried tomato cream cheese tasted like black pepper and had no sun-dried  tomatoes in it.
I also used to be able to taste bacon in the bacon scallion cream cheese. But all I tasted today was salt. 
I am starting to rethink my loyalty to Blue Sky Bagels. There are other bagel shops in town. Albertsons sells some too and unfortunately those taste much better than the ones I was served.

Tonight my son and I took the car to this wash place. It's my favorite car wash in meridian. It's the first one I visited about two years ago when I moved here. I can say that each and EVERY single time I've had outstanding customer service. The name has changed about 5 times since I've lived here but the customer service has not faltered. Tonight was no exception. We rolled up to the pay station. We were greeted with a smile. We paid and we approached the wash. Just as the young man started spraying the car my son said, "oh no". He got a bloody nose and was searching the glove box for napkins. The young man ran off. I said to my son, "hey, where did he go? He didn't get the back"! Just then that young man approached my window with a handful of paper towels. Some days my cup is absolutely drained in the day to day life. But today my cup was filled. A very small gesture that meant the world to me and my 17 year old son who was embarrassed about his misfortune! Thanks!!! You are so appreciated.

From start to finish the service and food were 5/5.  Excellent service.  Chose to sit on the patio which was very nice and had a great ambiance.  We had the crispy flower and spring rolls for appetizer.  The crispy flower wontons were the best we have ever had.  Spring rolls were great but the wontons were excellent.  Yellow curry with potato was a perfect measure of spice, curry and vegetable/chicken.  Server was constantly available.  Food came quickly.  Don't hesitate to try this restaurant.
The best yellow chicken curry I have ever had! This is the best Thai food around. I'll definitely be back!!

It's good for everything but groceries. When grocery shopping there are to many of the on line shoppers pushing their big carts around and in the way.  They are always out of lots of items with empty shelving. I do my grocery shopping elsewhere now because of this.

Fiesta Guadalajara is an "old school," family owned and operated restaurant, serving delicious Mexican cuisine that's based on the city that the restaurant is named after, Guadalajara, in the Mexican state of Jalisco.  This amazing restaurant serves some of the finest Mexican cuisine the greater Boise area has to offer, and the delicious fare is served with a smile.

We're still in the grips of the COVID-19 virus scare, so seating in the lobby is taped off.  As you enter the restaurant, you'll be greeted by a friendly "meeter/greeter" who will seat you.  On this late Thursday afternoon, the restaurant was sparsely seated, so our "greeter" suggested we sit anywhere that suited us. We decided to sit in the main dining room.

Shortly after we were seated, our super friendly server, Nancy, brought out a large basket or warm, fresh corn tortilla chips, along with a small bowl of in-house-made salsa, and creamy beans, perfect for dipping.
My friends are a little "sensative" when it comes to salsa, so I gave it the "ol' college try" and rated the "heat" level at medium-low, which works perfectly for me.  My friends opted to enjoy the bean dip, so I got to eat the salsa all by myself!

From the "Combinations" section of the menu, I ordered a #5, which featured a tamale, and enchilada, along with a taco.  All combinations include rice, and either refried or "whole" beans.  Like the "Mexican" I am, I went with refried beans, which are one of the foods that I LOVE the most.  When asked for my choice of meat, I "porked out" and went with pork, all the way.

Choices of meat for all entrees includes chicken, carne asada, pork or carnitas. Talk about a tough decision!  I went with carnitas for my taco, enchilada and tamale, but I could have "mixed and matched" if I would have wanted to. Fiesta Guadalajara is very flexible, and serves YOUR food the way YOU want it!

The carnitas meat in my meal was simply mouth-watering amazing, as it was juicy, tender, seasoned, and spiced perfectly for my taste.  The enchilada was amazing, being stuffed with carnitas, onion and garlic, but the tamale simply blew me "out of the water," as it was SO great!  When you surround the juicy carnitas around perfectly prepared masa, a little on the crispy side, you go to "Jalisco heaven" without leaving the greater Boise area!  My taco features carnitas, lettuce, tomato and onion, in a crispy, fried tortilla, that actually held together while eating it! The restaurant's chef has talent!

The rice was great, but so-so, as rice never excites me. The refried beans... oh the refried beans!  Now you're talking... the refried beans were creamy, and I could taste a little garlic and lard in the beans, which makes for outstanding refried beans!  The beans were topped with grated, melted Mexican cheese which, along with the tamale, made me think I was dining in a  restaurant in downtown Guadalajara, Jalisco.

Do you love thick, flavorful red chili sauce?  I do, and my dinner had lots of it from the enchilada and the tamale, which made for perfect dipping with my beans and rice.  My enchilada, tamale and beans were topped off with two varieties of grated, melted Mexican cheese.  Muy sabroso!

My dinner was simply outstanding!  My dining companions felt the same way, as both Cindy and Katie commented on how much they enjoyed their fine meals.  Anyway you look at it, Fiesta Guadalajara is a fine restaurant...

You'll love the food, you'll love the friendly service, and you'll love the "old school" Mexican-style dining room.  The recent addition of an upscale bar and dining room is a nice touch as well.

When you combine amazingly friendly service, delicious food, and reasonable prices, it all adds up to 5 stars for Fiesta Guadalajara.

My husband and I met our Designer Amy here to check out plumbing and bathroom fixtures.  Tish was very patient and was a huge help in keeping us within our budget.  If we liked a particular item that was over our budget, she knew the exact model of a different one, more in our price range with similar looks. 

There was lots of sinks, toilets and bathtubs to choose from.  The bathroom lights and mirrors are gorgeous. 

I recommend this place and the staff is super friendly.

Absolutely unprofessional. I called a week in advance; set up my appt & confirmed before only to get in and have my appt be completely wrong with no time for my original ask. I would give zero stars if I could.

After going to many different groomers across many different price ranges, I've finally found my favorite! Aussie Pet is great with my energetic 120-lb Alaskan Malamute! He blows his coat a couple times a year so I make sure to get him groomed frequently and he always comes out of the truck looking like a new, dapper dog! Couldn't recommend them more. Their owners/managers care about their customers and their service and quality is great!

My husband and I came here for a stress-free awesome dating lunch - We sat upstairs and had dinner killer service from Aaron. Did not disappoint!!! Music is fantastic, great atmosphere. Will come back.
Probably worst experience at a barber I've had.... I tipped over $10 for them to stop cutting my hair early so I could go elsewhere and get it fixed...

It was my first time at BFC and my last. I had the bison burger with Okinawa fries. The burger was overcooked, small, and with a scant amount of fixin's on it. It needed a second patty which is an option for another three bucks. The fries were good and the array of dipping sauces was vast. It cost me $8 for the burger and I wished that we had stopped at Five Guys on the way there. The service was good. Drinks wise, if you like beer they had a few options but that wasn't for me. They have a short list of Pepsi options. I had the family with me and they didn't have a high chair so I had baby in my lap the whole time.

Customer service is okay. Ordered a double chicken protein bowl... which is extra chicken and fajita veggies.. literally got three bell peppers on my plate. Didn't get asked if I wanted anything else added. Definitely not impressed. For the price I expected better.  Will be going to costa vida next time

I went for the first time as a walk in 5 days ago for a gel polish manicure. The staff is kind and friendly and awesome, but my gel polish is already cracking and chipping I've had gel polish last me 3 weeks and you can only see new growth. I don't know why it's already cracking, but I am very disappointed and wish i didn't spend $30 plus tip there. I won't try it again...

We recently moved to Boise, and we were so fortunate to find Justin! Justin met with us and asked very detailed questions about our wishes. It was apparent, even then, that he is very knowledgeable & wanted the best for us & for our desires to be documented. He then drafted our living trust & wills. I was surprised at how easy it was! When we came into the office for final signing, all documentation was laid out for us in a very easy & clear fashion. He did all of the heavy lifting for us and we would HIGHLY recommend him to anyone considering their trust or estate planning.
Had such a fun time with the family! We have season passes and are never disappointed with the staff or experience. I encourage all to come!

This is our favorite Mexican place here in the treasure valley. They have good food, the prices are reasonable, the employees are always friendly and accommodating. Our youngest daughter is obsessed with their bean dip that they bring out with chips and salsa at the beginning of the meal,  sometimes we even get a giant order of it to go. I eat gluten free so I get the carne asada, which is delicious, the kids like the super burrito or the nachos to share. Fajitas never disappoint either. I still remember going to a fancy, completely overpriced Mexican restaurant in Sun Valley and just wishing for this carne asada, salsa and bean dip instead. We love supporting our local, hardworking restaurant owners!

I have been coming to the Ram for years, but I have not been here in a while. The reason. Their menu had not changed in years and was getting very very old and tired.

I am very happy to say that they have a Burger Rama going on now that I hope and pray they keep. There are several new Burgers and sandwiches to choose from.

The Mamma Mia sounds very interesting. It says it is a blend of Italian sausage and ground beef patty with spices.

The Chicken Banh-Mi Sandwich looks and sounds good. It is one that I will have to try for sure. 

The Chicken Katsu Sandwich sounds like some sort of Asian inspired burger. 

I asked the waitress about this, but she did not know if any of the burgers will stick around.

The one I had was the Count von Count. The name reminded me of that Cereal "Count Chochola.

Its a roasted Garlic Burger. When I saw it on their seasonal menu, It was like that movie "Jerry Mcguire". They had me at Garlic!

There is only 1 other place in town that I know of that does a Garlic Burger. It is done by a place in the Village. I love love love Garlic, so anytime I find a Roasted Garlic Burger, the place that makes it gets my undivided attention.

If you love Garlic like me, and hate those nasty Vampires, you have to come and try this burger. For me, it needs a bit more Garlic, as my opinion of Garlic is there is no such thing as too much. But it is very good. The Garlic Aioli they use is nice and creamy and yeah, almost forgot....Garlicy!

Also of note here, that I do know is on the menu for sure, and not going away is the Armadillo Eggs. In your face Easter Bunny!

Ingredients in these delectable bites are; Chicken, diced jalapeños, pepper jack, cream cheese, secret sauce and seasonings, rolled in saltine crackers, cooked golden, ranch dressing.

They are well worth your time just to come here for these. Unfortunately, they are just appetizers, so you only get 5 of them.

Another fav here is their Mac and Cheese. Yeah I know, its mac and cheese, but this stuff is good. Its creamy and pretty darn good. My only wish is that they would add more cheese, but it is pretty good.

The bottom line is that you need to try this place if you have not already. At least while they are doing this Burger Rama, which I hope and pray they keep.
-----
I just learned that the Burger Rama ends this weekend (5-3-17). The team leader was nice enough to email this information. 

I am very sorry t report that none of the 3 burgers I like are going to make it to the new menu. I plan on going to The Ram this weekend for my Garlic Burger, but after this, if they continue with the same old boring menu, with the same old boring burgers, I wont be back.

The Ram really should take a note from the Play Book of their competitor Red Robin. Red Robin is constantly adding new burgers to its menu.

To stay relevant and in business, a restaurant Must stay on top of coming out with new and better food offerings. Especially in the highly competitive Burger wars.

Overall it was a mediocre experience. The rooms are supposed to be "non-smoking" but as we entered our room we were hit by a pungent smoke smell!! The floors weren't clean, and there were food wrappers and debris still behind the night stand that was about 6 inches out from the wall. The sliding bathroom door will not slide closed, so privacy is not an option! I had to lean against the door to get the inside deadbolt to work and the next morning we thought we were going to need to call the front desk to come unlock the door to get out!! We finally got it to unlock! The breakfast was fairly good for a free meal. I would have to rate it a 3 out of 10. When informing the morning desk clerk about out experience, she was very kind and apologetic and said the manager would be calling us and "making it right", never heard from anyone. So, you decide.....

Fun as hell !! But if you're afraid of heights you will not go down the slides, wave pool was fun as hell but very crowded, lost how many feels i copped !! Just kidding, but seriously very crowded, expensive, food ,lockers $12.00 for a large locker, splash shop everything expensive,$32.80 for my family of three to eat 2 double cheeseburgers 2 fries ,2 cokes. Lazy river very crowded, tubes in splash pool and lazy river are a finder keeper type set up , if you see one floating around you grab it if you want one same thing in the splash pool. Best to get your tickets online otherwise your going to wait in line to get tickets, long line for that , online you go straight to the security gate scan your online tickets from the email you receive that sends a link to your digital online tickets, they check your bag for outside food and drink but bottled water is ok to bring in. Hard to find a place to sit out of the sun again finder keepers for tables to sit definitely recommend getting a cabana cost a bit more but worth it! Free lockers and a server that brings food to you, no waiting in long lines for food, and a place to sit  private and yours.

My dog received an amazing haircut here! They cut her hair exactly the way I wanted to and she wasn't in long. Since my dog is a Goldendoodle, her hair gets matted easily and on top of that she's super curly. They were able to comb it out without cutting her hair short which many past groomers have done. I highly recommend this place and will be back!
Everyone was super sweet and even though I didn't have an appointment they were able to get me sat right away with a tech. They are fairly priced and my nails have never been done so well.

No idea how it's only one $ when it's pretty expensive. Pedicure ranged from $35 - $90 and up! In addition, the cleanliness was questionable, at best. She dropped all the tools (which happens, we're all human) all over the floor and in the water, but then she kept using it. The "massage" was lightly putting on lotion with zero pressure. Which, again, is fine but it's not a massage. When she was painting my nails, she dropped the polish in the water but then she kept using the brush straight from the foot water and even dipped the dirty brush back into the jar! Even if the rest was a good experience and the price was reasonable, the lack of sanitation alone will make me keep my distance!
Good food but the service sucks. Don't order to go if you can help it. The fries are soggy by the time you get home. The employees are high.

Good food, will eat here again but not mind blowing...

For burgers we tried The Classic and The Heat, both beef and all the fixens. The smoked sauce on The classic was good, but otherwise a very meh burger. My husband enjoyed The Heat. 

For fries we ordered The Purple shoestring & Regular cut Russets. The purple had excellent flavor but were quite wet from the fryer, they were pretty messy. The Russets were good, but just your average fry. 

I look forward to trying other things here and really like the concept.
This place will blow your doors off.  Great menu and everything is awesome.   You'd be dumb to get a sammich anywhere else.   Highly recommended.  Get the #11.  You'll see what's up.   Killer

The Potters Tea House has many different unique tea choices. They also have coffee, Italian Sodas and other beverages. They serve the drinks in eco friendly cups which is nice for take-out. If I could make a recommendation it would be to serve the dine-in drinks in mugs or glass cups to give it that personal touch. The inside is very cute and has a warm cozy atmosphere.  If you love tea, this is definitely the place to go.

Wow great little place here. Very homey with little knick knacks they sell like jam and candles. I wasn't sure at first since hadn't ever been here. Gave it a shot , $8 for a half sandwich and a cup a soup isn't bad considering what most places would charge for the same items. Lots of desserts and plenty of coffee too. Would come back for sure.

Whoa! What a delicious burger! This burger is so full of love that it literally drips down your hands... . I had the Santa Barbara salad and it was delicious. You know when you are super hungry  and your tummy growls? Well it won't when you leave!!!
I can't forget to mention the delicious Brussels sprouts! Yep let's rewrite that, the BRUSSEL SPROUTS are to die for!!!! I mixed those into my salad and I was in heaven!!!
The only reason I gave this a 4 star is because I think the chairs could of been upgraded to meet the standard of " cushy butt"!

When they said they would be at my home at a certain time, they were there and with good attitudes each and every day. Thank you again Alan, Cory, John, and Jerry.
     I cannot wait for the landscaping to go in to accentuate these beautiful walls.
Fantastic food. Jovial, fun server. It was like having a comic show with a meal. Even good with teenagers. Very customer focused. Humble and friendly staff.

Worst to do business here. First they are very expensive, they pressure you into mouth guards you really could do without. Food is excellent. Better to dine in. We purchased take out and when we got home realized our rice was missing. Paid for double portion of veggies and amount was pretty skimpy. Great experience at Boise Dermatology. Very friendly staff,  Dr. Brooks was awesome.  Definitely will go back and recommend highly to others!

This is also a tuff one to write. The Ram is not consistent at all. We love GoodWood for that reason. We always know what its going to be like.

Love the original pretzel with salt and love their bites as well. Love the bites with cheese. Also love the bites with cinnamon on them.

I just recently relocated to the Treasure Valley and have been looking for a good nail salon that I could start going to. Great food and service! Has some screens to watch games and hang out. Great atmosphere for family and friends.
Had the best eggplant basil tofu dish this past Saturday evening and excellent service from the male who served us while we dined outside.  Thank you!

Today i was calling for order pick up.... this is not my firat attempt at eating from the Ram in meridian, however, every orevious visit was dissapointing, in its own way, so I thiught ordering to go, would eliminate the poor service experienced when dining in. Anyway, I called four different times today, with no answer... the phone would ring for 2 minutes then hang up. This will be last time attempting to order from the Ram.
