Loving our new electronic sectional leather couch,  wooden bar stools & kitchen bar table! Thank you for a great experience, excellent customer service & affordable prices. I would definitely come here again for any of our furniture needs.

This salon is gorgeous and I wish I had better things to say! They took a while and all I wanted was a clean french and they couldn't even find a pinky undertone. This is such an awesome park! It is located pretty far south in Meridian, but if you are one of the poor people that live in this restaurant and entertainment desert, then hurray for you! Discovery park mixes all the fabulous things of a traditional park with educational pieces about Idaho. 

The play structure is great. It has usual bits like slides and nets to climb, but it also has funky bridges, musical components and a variety of ladders. There are two very long zip lines with the attached seat, making it perfect for all ages. (Yes even my 32 year old husband thought it was amazing) There are these super fun roller slides that are fun for older kids to try and climb, but also littles who don't like to go too fast on a slide. 

I love that this is the rubberized surface. When you have an early walker, this is the best type of park to go to. Behind the play structure is the best part of this park. They have a water feature to help kids learn about Idaho rivers! Kids can play in the sand, dig ditches and levies and divert water streams. There is also a traditional splash pad around the side. 

There are three covered picnic areas, large bathrooms and plenty of parking. This is a wonderful new park addition to our community!

I don't live in Boise anymore but always come here to eat and drink when I'm visiting. I always go to the bar area. I love the food and drinks!

I want to like this place... But the service and staff just kind of suck... Honestly they could seem to care less on the product they put out... I don't think I've had a hot taco yet... Most of the time we get orange chicken and broccoli beef as our entree's. They did it for me multiple times in the past and then all of a sudden the manager, MaryAnn, refuses to make it.  I asked why and explained that it has been done many times before. After much consideration, and reading the Yelp reviews, I decided to risk going into Kneaders for a visit.
We got there about 9:15am or so and were kind of surprised that the parking lot was empty. The entry is tucked back in the corner of the parking lot it looks more like a delivery door. After entering through the double set of double doors we looked around and saw probably 20 empty tables, with the exception of one person sitting there. Lighting was not real good and the couple of up selling displays lining the path to the sparsely populated display cases did not give me a good feeling. Tired and listless. It looks like the owner/s are tired and bored. 

The remaining pastries in the dimly lit cases looked OK but the scones had a little charring around the edges which means that the already ordinarily dry pastry is going to even be more dry now. I'm not a huge fan of scones unless there's a certain degree of moisture.
The snowman iced sugar cookies looked great but as I mentioned, the scones and two muffin tops were the only items left which could be considered a pastry. The rest were brownies and stuff. Looked good but just too heavy for breakfast food. 
Wait! There was a full tray of cinnamon rolls. Now, I'm picky about my cinnamon rolls so I will say that these were not to my personal preference. Not enough icing and the corners looked dry, again.
So now on to the order I finally made.

I ordered a breakfast croissant sandwich. Sausage and cheese (see pic). 
Horrible. Wrapped in aluminum foil, trapping in the  heat and making the croissant soft, no longer crisp. The ultra thin slice of cheddar was barely there and melted to a tough layer of epoxy-like coating. The cheese did not even cover the sausage patty, which actually wasn't bad. I'd give the patty a 4 star. The croissant was flattened and dry. I could go on but a picture is worth 1000 words. 

Service and staff were great! Friendly, professional, tried to up-sell, all good there. 

Cleanliness-fair. Nothing glaringly obvious. 

Having lived in Europe and experienced authentic gourmet pastries there is nothing here which would cause me to return nor recommend. 
Sad since it wouldn't take much to bring it up to a good standard. 
Here are my recommendations:
1) Dress up the external entryway. Make it more inviting. 
2) Update the interior lighting, both in the cases and in the entry area inside.
3) Improve the variety. Tons of scones (empty when I came in), which are a fairly quick and simple item to produce. I would love to see bear claws, twists, sfogliatelle, soufflés, etc.

I will continue to read the posts here to determine if it's worth returning.

Hello my name is Johnnie and I would like to bring to your attention about the volume of your sound system. Myself and my guest had lunch today 07/09/2021 at your North  Eagle Rd location. The music was so loud it was hard to carry on a conversation.  I'd like to mention that  another couple sitting across from us outside happened to ask us if we thought the music was too loud. If your intentions were to make people uncomfortable and leave as soon as they were done with their meal you were successful. I've eaten at this location many times before and don't recall hearing loud music. The music selection was fine just way too loud.

"Do you have reservations?" the friendly blonde barkeep asked as we walked in to the small restaurant with five or six tables and dominated by a large bar.  "Are you kidding? For a bar?" I thought as she motioned my date and me to the only two empty seats in the place at, of all places, the bar.  We looked at the nondescript menu printed in black and white on plain white paper and chose our fare.  Cybil opted for the Cubano, one of her favorite sandwiches.  I chose the Skillet with bacon.  Given the setting, the menu, and the very reasonable prices we expected, well, bar food.

We chatted and looked around the place as the barkeep mixed drinks right in front of us.  I saw her put a few shots of Buffalo Trace in a glass and mix in something from an unmarked container. I asked what it was and she said "maple syrup".  Cybil didn't quite hear and asked what it was and I quipped "A way to ruin a perfectly good tumbler of Buffalo Trace".  We asked what the drink was called and she said "The After 10".  Since we came here right after church I glanced at my watch and said jokingly "I assume that means after 10 AM", and she smiled and nodded affirmatively.

That's when Cybil spotted something on the food warmer and exclaimed "Oh. My. Gosh!"  I looked over and gasped "What is that?"  "I think it's my Cubano!"  And in an instant, everything changed and I knew why reservations are recommended here.

Cybil's Cubano was an œuvre d'art (don't be impressed, I Googled that), breathtakingly assembled and beautifully presented with a house salad and house-made Dijon dressing on the side.  Unlike most local Cuban sandwiches that are served with just ham or ham and roast pork, this one was served with ham and house-smoked pulled pork complete with a candy-like bark, some of the tastiest I've had anywhere.  The sandwich and salad were easily big enough for two and I'd like to say I sent Cybil home with lunch for tomorrow, but if I did I'd be lying.

My Skillet was less generously sized than the Cubano but also an explosion of flavor, with a light smokey taste suggesting the chef let the flame from the stove briefly ignite some of the fats in the pan as we've all seen on professional cooking shows but never tried for fear of setting our houses on fire.  The sourdough bread it was served with was a dense artisan bread with a wonderful Parmesan garlic crust.

All in all, Grant's was one of the most unique and surprising dining experiences we've had in the Treasure Valle.  We especially enjoyed the friendly conversation with our waitress/bartender, who even while she was engaged in conversation was extremely attentive and greeted everyone who came in and said farewell to guests as they departed - a rare trait you'd expect only in a high end and high-dollar restaurant.

I highly recommend you give them a try.  Don't forget to make reservations.

I took my friend in for the first time just the other day. It was my first time since Steelz moved. The new, much larger warehouse is great!  We both found several treasures. It is so nice they have fitting rooms at the new location!
 They often have broken cases of groceries from Costco. I like being able to buy one to try instead of a whole case at Costco.
It is like every other store I walk into: you have to watch the prices. Sometimes you find a great buy, and sometimes you don't!

Reviewer No. 80
Writing this review on 10-5-2017 on a Southwest flight to Mexico on my 10-4-2017 6PM MST visit on Grants Neighborhood Grill, Meridian Idaho. 
Service: 5/5
Food: 4/5
Price for value: 3/5
Bariatrics/Healthy Options:4/5

The owners and employees love this place and it can be seen for sure. 
I live near Grants, seen it a few times, but never thought to stop in, yet I did bookmark it several months ago--I am glad that I did.  This place is rather small, like many other places in the area; however, they make good on their space .They have patio seating that goes out into the shopping center parking lot with a fence around the area for safety and privacy. 

The inside is decorated pretty awesome (see photos). I like the vibe of the place and felt very comfortable inside. The waitress made the experience a positive one for me. She ran outside and handed me my sun glasses. THANK YOU! But then I started to drive away and she was running after me again with my phone... what's going on with me?!? THANK YOU, AGAIN! I was dining with good friends and was in a fun, albeit serious conversation. The wait staff box up your food for you, which is pretty cool. 

Price: As you can see from the photos of the menu that I uploaded this place isn't cheap--but then again the food isn't cheaply made. In speaking with the waitress everything is fresh and local--they make their own dressings (ranch, BBQ, blue cheese), they cut their own bacon (super thick) and even grind their own burgers (good). So, because of the quality, and the fact that they use everything local, I can understand the cost and am happy to pay it. However, one thing that made me a little upset was the fact that healthy eaters have to pay $3 more to substitute salad for fries. Many places do this, but when you're paying $13 for a bun less burger, you have to now pay $16 to get a hamburger and lettuce with cheese, and let's face it, the salad wasn't much more. I really think this should be taken away from this small business-- 

So, we talked about the inside and I touched on the service (extra positive), let's get to what's important... THE FOOD!!! All food (what we ordered) was served on plates that look like cutting boards inside a cookie sheet, which I thought they were really cool and unique! I will touch on all four of our purchases with the review from each devourer:

Me: I got the Mushroom/Swiss 1/3 pound burger with no bun and a side salad substituted for the fries. $13 +$3 for the "salad". This burger usually comes with a locally made Acme Bakery blended pretzel bun. The waitress asked how I wanted my burger--well done please. Well, it came bloody still, which I wasn't a fan of. The mushrooms were very well cooked and the Swiss melted deliciously. The salad was nothing short of lettuce, with some shredded cheese, and peppers. The ranch is homemade and was okay, nothing too special. I took it to go, ate the Swiss cheese and mushrooms later and gave my dog the burger--now, that's because I don't like red hamburger, the flavoring was good and others would really enjoy this. 

Inside out grilled cheese--pretty cool concept. I happen to like cheese fried so if I ate bread I would have tried this. Basically it' white cheddar, Parmesan, and Gouda cheeses cooked on the outside of the sourdough bread with fries. My dining companion said that it was "good" and a fair cost at $9.

BBQ pulled pork, $11-- slow cooked BBQ pulled pork in their homemade sauce served on a locally made Brioche bun minus coleslaw with fries. This sandwich was served with tomatoes, which I thought was interesting. George liked it, but thought that the BBQ sauce was a little spice, be he is someone who doesn't like any spice. However, he enjoyed it and called it a 3/5 or 7/10. 

Deli Club, $11--Turkey and pit ham with lettuce, tomatoes, onion, roasted garlic, mayo, and house-made bacon. My dining companion, Yesi, said that it was delicious and she offered me a bite of the bacon, which didn't look like bacon because it was super thick--it was delicious! She only was able to eat half of the sandwich and fries and took the rest to-go. I recommend this, based on the portion size and the amount of yummy goodness! 

Healthy eating 4/5-- When choosing a place to eat, I think about how I can eat healthy--veggies, protein, low/no carb. Again, I am not a fan when a place charges to substitute salad for fries. I mean, come on people! There are 4 dinner salad options, a cheese/meat board appetizer, grilled chicken, and many things you can take the bread and sauces off of. The steaks are all natural, no hormones, steroids, or antibiotics. 

We will be attending for brunch soon--they have a small, but good looking brunch menu. The waitress suggested reservations on Sunday, but Saturday we should be good. 

Well, thanks for reading! I hope you're having a good day whenever you read this!

The lady that made my order she had darker skin and dark curly hair and she was the sweetest person I have ever encountered while getting dutch. She was patient and soo so friendly.
Not a fan. The burger was meh, the fries were meh. I can make better at home for way cheaper.

2 issues.

AND they didn't give the half-price happy hour deal. AND no comp for the cold food. AND the lane broke down. AND they directed us to non-happy hour drinks. I WILL NEVER RETURN TO BIG AL's! Westy's FTW!

I absolutely have LOVED this store for years... But every time I go in lately I leave empty handed. The reason? THE PRICES are outrageous!!!! Even at 25% off I can't bring myself to pay those prices. Very sad.

Some of the best Thai food in Idaho hands down. Very clean restaurant, friendly staff, and great prices. We ordered the Thai Dumplings, Pad Thai, and Crispy Cashew Nut Chicken. Everything was delicious! The plating is also quite fantastic, far above most restaurants locally. I can't recommend this place highly enough and encourage you to give them a shot. Cheers!

I made an account on yelp for one reason.
To give this amazing place a review they deserve, I may not be picky but I can tell good food from bad food and this was amazing, in fact! The whole experience was amazing! The moment we walked in we were greeted by a kind man who was wonderful the entire time we were there, he explained the menu and what's more popular but also the origin and what goes well with it. He was very personable and the food was to die for. The chicken chimichilla (I'm not sure if that's the correct spelling) was my personal favorite, but all of the ones I tried were delicious. If you are thinking about getting some empanadas come here because the place is beautiful and clean, the people were great even someone from the back came to say goodbye, and the empanadas were simply delicious. Thank you for the wonderful lunch I will be back very soon!

The atmosphere was a little overwhelming at first since it was bumping and a lot was going on and it was my first time.  But I will say that this is a place with a lot of regularity and returning customers. You can tell they know their clients. I got a full set with overlay and Jackie did a great job. He was very thorough and checked and double checked each of my nails to ensure they were symmetric. And they have better prices than a lot of places I've seen before. I would highly recommend. Make an appointment beforehand since they're pretty busy.

They've got a returning loyal customer here, Tommy was amazing & didn't rush the process. 
He made sure I loved my shape & cut of nails. 
Even after we finished he was kind enough to let me stay a little longer until my nails were dry. 
I had gotten a regular polish manicure, by the way. 

I was so pleased that I came back the next and booked my spa pedicure w/Tommy again!! 

Excellent service, & amazing work! 

Thank you Tommy!!!

Up until recently I have been very pleased with everything from marco's pizza.

 However lately, there seems to be a very poor lack of sanitary guidelines for deliveries. I have repeatedly asked that if I order for delivery, that it is handed to me. I don't want you dropping it on the ground knocking on the door and running away. Twice now I've had to pick up my food off the ground when I have specifically asked to be handed my delivery. It's disgusting to think people want their food tossed in the dirt before eating. For the time being I will use other sources for food deliveries who won't throw my food in the dirt.

Second time here and I wasn't disappointed again! This time, I tried the #28 Silver Duck: sourdough, pesto mayo, roast beef, pastrami, horseradish, havarti cheese and sprouts. On the side, I had the homemade cole slaw and a cup of homemade tomato basil soup

The ingredients of everything were fresh and the taste to everything as crisp and full. While I probably won't order again soon, it's definitely one to try if it peaks your interest. 

Yet again, the hospitality and friendliness of staff is incredible. 

We all need to support great small businesses like this one.

Im giving this place a 2 star as an overall experience... last night we ordered some food in the bar area. Our wings came out with no sauce on them (not how they were ordered) We immediately and politely asked our bar waitress about the issue and thought it was handled... 15-20 minutes later (the wings are now COLD) we checked up on the issue again and one of the bar tenders walked in the back and grabbed a cup of sauce and set it on our table... no apology... nothing... so we ate cold wings. The correct thing would have been to bring new wings out with the correct sauce on them that was WARM. We'll skip the bar food entirely next time..

New salon to me!! Wow! All the girls her are incredibly kind and every client I saw leave durning my visit was looking bomb.com

I will definitely be back!

I really  like this place. It's the best place  I've found in the area. The owners and staff are very  nice and accommodating. I find their prices are a bit high and they charge for everything. A dollar for using a credit card, nail files, which you need to bring with you each  time, if not they charge again for it. My biggest complaint is an extra charge of $5 for "long nails". I've always had this length (for over 25 years) and I've never been up-charged. I'm happy with how my nails look but will be on a lookout- if I find another place as good, I'll be sure to review as well.

I've visited many Thai places and this one has been my tried and true favorite place for a few years now. I won't go anywhere else! I'm super picky about my Pad Thai noodles (I don't like them super super thin like other places have) and this place has the best!

This is the second vehicle I've brought into them. The current lifetime package is a no-brainer....excellent results on the first application---vehicle looks better than new, and I get a refresh every year for as long as I own the car.

Great place to work out! it's clean, open 24 hours, and I've never had to wait to use any equipment. The staff is really friendly and always helpful when I have a question. I like that it's a safe place to work out at night- the doors are locked to non-member, the parking lot is well lit, and there are lots of cameras so it's not creepy to walk to and from my car.

Tom daily served by Michael....I'm a happy camper! They even made special seating arrangement for us so we don't sit in the heat! Ordering food now but excited to try this jalapeño Caesar dressing on their Caesar salad!
As far as alcohol, they serve House Frozen Margaritas, a few Beers on tap & Bottled Beer. Enjoy.
Great pizzas arrive hot! Staff friendly whether you call in or they are delivering your order! Great value too!

First of all I'm from Texas and I know a little about how Texas BBQ should be (oak wood smoked). With that said this place makes some great mighty fine BBQ brisket!  
This is as close as I'm going to get to Texas BBQ and at good price here in Idaho.

Spending a weekend in Boise and knew I had to fine some french fries. My friend suggested Boise Fry Co, and I'm glad she did. Unfortunately, the only cut options available were regular and homestyle which was a little bit disappointing, but they were still really good. We got the purple fries, russet fries, and gold fries. I really enjoyed the spicy ketchup and cajun salt on my fries! I also got the grilled cheese, which I wouldn't recommend (the cheese was not very melted unfortunately) but the whole point of this trip was for fries and for that I was satisfied!
I like the food but of the 3 orders I've done on 3 separate occasions twice  the orders were wrong. Missing items

Used to be our go-to place for breakfast, lunch or evening treats, but of late with staffing and item shortages, things have gone downhill. Our food orders have been wrong the last three times, and a couple times a staff member tried to make things right by providing a loaf of bread or choice of a pastry, however the last time we ordered online and used the drive-through to pickup, we appeared to have gotten someone else's order, else items have been substituted, possibly due to running out. We are hopeful things will turn around soon so we don't lose one of our favorite places close to home.

This place deserves 0 stars! I thought I'd order because it is convenient from where I live! I called and they let the phone ring FOREVER! When she answers she says your going to have to wait and sets the phone down... doesn't even put it on hold. All we could hear in the background was scrambling around and talking about condoms and how something fit like a sock.. ummmm so unprofessional! This went on for 15 whole damn mins and she still never came back to the phone. So I hung up and had to drive further out to the ihop on Emerald. This was between 1:50AM-2AM 11/23/2020. Manager needs to get on this poor customer service! We are so disgusted!

We tried Marco's tonight.  Delivery so the review is not as positive had we had dined in so I'll be as fair as possible.  We thought the sauce and cheese was good if not better than the 3 main delivery chains but the thin crust on both pies were over cooked.  In fairness, it's not NY style but reminded me more of tavern style pizza.  

We'll give this place another chance as we'll dine in next time to get a better idea how this stacks up with the competition and hopefully give it a better rating.

So many issues. It was my boyfriends and my first time eating here on a Friday night a few weeks back and the experience still frustrates me. Where to start. 

We came in the Restaurant and the host asked the people in front of us if they wanted to sit at the bar or at a table. I wanted to sit at the bar since it was Friday but as we stepped up to the host stand they grabbed some menus and walked us to a table without asking what our preference was. They also did not hand us drink menus..? I still don't understand why. We are in our mid 20's. 

Then our waiter comes up and has me repeat my order to him several times. I asked for a peach alcoholic beverage and he brought me pineapple. I still wasn't going to complain because we are not ones to start drama. We ordered  a total of 2 alcoholic drinks which tasted like they had no alcohol at all by the way, 1 appetizer and 2 burgers. The food was god awful and made us both sick immediately after leaving the Restaraunt. 

Our bill came to $80 something dollars and change.... I had to study the receipt for several minutes and pulled out my calculator because the meal was maybe worth $30 to me.... Just awful.

Typical furniture box store. Prices are really good. Nice variety with good quality items and lower budget pieces. Some furniture did not have pricing and the employees seemed to preoccupied to ask.  Never acknowledged when I went in or looked around or as I was leaving.

They only get one star because I cannot give them ZERO stars. What ever you do,DO NOT USE YOUR CREDIT CARD here. I tried to order on line for pick up the morning of our moving. My credit card would not work. Tried again, nothing.  Do we went to IHOP. Two days later I find this Denny's charged my credit card twice for the exact same order I NEVER received. I called that branch of Denny's, on Fairview, only to be hung up on or left on hold four times. I have contacted the corporate office but have heard nothing back. I will be fighting the charges and I will get my money back. Save yourself the stress do not go here! rudest people I've had the displeasure of working with in my entire life. Good bye Denny's!!
I had my nose pierced there and the service was awesome! From the booking of the appointment over the phone to the amazing piercing job by kerri. I highly recommend!

Way too overpriced for hardly any food. Extra $3 to substitute steamed to a cup of fried rice? Really? An entree with 2 pcs of about 3x5 so thinly sliced.  Spicy beef (C4) is so salty none of us could eat it.
Fresh. Delicious. Awesome. Authentic. A must try...and then you will want to come back.

Went to Fiesta Guadalajara with a group during a quiet Sunday evening. We were hopeful, but everything was meh. In short, this place would work in a pinch, but there has to be better Mexican food in the Treasure Valley.

Here's the long of it:

- Waiting to be seated: Our group was acknowledged right away, wait was minimal

- Seating: We passed several dirty tables on the way back to our large table though restaurant was quiet. Table appeared clean at a glance but was actually dirty - looks like they didn't move any of the salt/peppers/sugars when they wiped the table

- Service: Friendly, but lacking. Initially we were seated and checked on several times by a woman who turned out to be the hostess, not our server, but she didn't mention that until after bringing out drinks and checking on answers to questions about the bar and the menu. When our server came to the table later, he was able to answer only part of our questions - when asked about the beers offered, he started with, "Now don't quote me on this, [...]" , (I couldn't resist ;) ) which left with the feeling that we'd be gamboling on if any beer we ordered would be there or not. 

- Food: Large dinners, as well as kid's menu items, were ordered by our group. The food took a while but was served hot. The food was okay, leaning a little on the oily side for my preference. None of the food  (ranging from carne asada platter to fajitas) stood out as really fantastic to anyone. The chips and salsa served to the table while we were waiting for our food order were pretty good, though we found it interesting that the salsa had large chunks of stewed tomatoes - every Mexican restaurant has its own special salsa version right?

- Boxes & Check - Didn't take long to get a couple to-go boxes and the check, however, we waited for the server to close our check and finally had to go up to the hostess station to pay. Not sure if table or hostess counter is the way to pay here.

There are so many more restaurants to explore in the Treasure Valley, and there was nothing amazingly terrible or wonderful to make me want to return to Fiesta Guadalajara.
Great pizza. Favorite in the area. Fresh ingredients. Always on time. They'll even bring it out to your car if you don't want to get out and go inside.

I made note this time that a full set with gel was $48. Also just being in there, they were booked out for the next two days when people called. So I'm my opinion it's best to call ahead instead of doing a walk in.

Went in here by luck, I call it luck because wow! 
It's been hard finding a good burger and not just good but consistently good. The food was good! the veggies were fresh and crisp, the burger was perfectly cooked. I think what made it worth going back for was not only the burger itself but the guy working at the front counter. I hate to describe him as the bald guy but haha I didn't catch his name! 
Dude was phenomenal at finding us the best burger to try and even went into detail about how big to let me know I didn't have to order 4 of them to get full. 
His positive energy mixed with the food, it's on the top of my list for recommendations! 
I would post a picture but I was to busy eating it and totally forgot. Dang it! Guess I'll have to come back in.

We came here & asked if we could stay over 1 night. They said yes. We haul RV trailers. Flying J truck stops in the area do not accommodate box truck or RVs in the front., or back for that matter, and believe me we checked them all in the area. Which took up time & $$$. (You might ask why we don't stay in a motel. Well we Cary so much stuff with us, & if a motel had a bug problem... it would be insane to get rid of in a truck that you spend 18 to 23 hrs a day in... plus we have to drag all those things into the motel with us incase they get stolen..)
This is a nice sized Walmart & has friendly staff. It's very clean, bathrooms are maintained regularly. The parking lot is so clean too. It was a good experience getting groceries here. 
Thank you Walmart.

I was looking forward sooo much to the classic burger... It looked great. Completely raw burger... not a little pink... all pink . Very disappointed. I gave 2 starts because everyone else's food except mine turned out to be ok.
I couldn't return it, I ordered a take out ..

Haven't bought a lot here, but they certainly have some great deals on scratch and dent stuff from Costco.  

Bought a really good Vizio surround sound system with soundbar.  Got home, it worked great but after downloading the manual, found I didn't have the right remote.  Went back with the wrong remote and they didn't have one so was told they'd order a new one.  I called a little over a week later and they said they had it in.  Picked it up, tested, all good.  Now I can access all the options it has and what a difference.

Bonnie was a great help and everyone I've met there seems to be very friendly, polite, and attentive.  Now if we only had some extra money to go get this $250 stand-alone fireplace they had out front today!
My boyfriend and I have come in quite a few times and every time we are greeted immediately by Eddy! He is such a hardworking kind man! We LOVE coming here!
Food and fries was okay... burger was tiny. Outside eating was open. Tons of flies everywhere so not the most ideal dining experience.
Cindy was super helpful after taking the time to help me when I had made my appointment at a different location. I'm from out of town and was in a rush. Thank you Cindy!
Best Thai food we've found in the TV. Excellent pad Thai and pad see ew. A bit pricey but very good food.

The lemon coco white chocolate dulce de leche cookies are to die for! Amazing! Try the Chimichurri Chicken empanadas with a side of chimichurri dipping sauce! Each time I come I try a different combo of empanadas. ¡Muy rico!

Worst IHOP location possible. Stood at the host stand for 20 mins before getting greeted (keep in my they did see me. Three staff turned around to look at me including the manager). Then took another hour to take our order and receive our food. I wish I could say this is due to Covid but definitely not the case. Our server even stated she forgot we were there. Luckily for them, it being so late and us being hungry we had to wait instead of finding somewhere else to go. Completely mismanaged establishment. I hate say this but being an executive chef at an establishment, this is far from any service standard set by any restaurant. Please save your time and money from this IHOP. The only thing that was good was the food.

We came in here because of all the great reviews! Little did we know, the burgers are plain and just disappointing. The fries are great tho! My husband ordered "the heat" ( which we got a totally different burger) and it came with a moldy looking fry attached to the bun, actually stuck in it. He was looking forward to a spicy burger. Instead we wasted $30 on a disappointing meal that we only had 2 bites out of. My husband went up to the counter to ask them if it was the correct burger, the man glaced at it and said yeah and walked away. (IT'S NOT) 
Needless to say we would never recommend this place.

I'd give them negative stars if possible. If you want your family to starve order from Marcos! They take forever and are completely rude if you ask them "where's my order?" Customer service is terrible! With all the pizza places nearby, they won't be getting any business from us or our neighbors. Hasta la Vista Marcos!!!!!!

One of my favorites for a good turkey sandwich. Two of us shared a sandwich combo meal with the cauliflower cheese soup which was more than enough for both of us. Maybe add another diet drink selection besides cola for diabetics. The tea was gone. And they could really use a good cleaning! Everything was just kind of dirty looking. That's always a turn off for me. If it's dirty in the front, it's dirty in the back.

I would never recommend anyone to do business with these people. Their website is nearly impossible to get what you want accomplished. The customer service is terrible and lack communication skills at every level. The management is extremely rude and insensitive. They made duplicate auto-withdrawals from my account in the same month and wouldn't apply the double payment for the next month.This is One of the MANY issues Ive dealt with. Very difficult people to work with. Save yourself time and money, don't make the same mistake I did. READ THIS!!!

I really like the shrimp taco, fried chicken taco and the texican. They lost a star because sometimes the tacos are poorly wrapped on to go orders which can cause a mess, and I hate the country music they play at the Meridian location. You can't even escape it out on the patio.

All right, had to post that one of our longtime favorites, the ram, has redeemed itself.  The last time I posted we had a bad experience with their fish and chips that had changed again for the third time in the over a decade long time we've been coming. Tonight we were greeted, seated, and the manager after hearing what we were going to order told us the fish and chips had changed. He told us all the positive things about it that it was now card and they were sending it out to be beer battered and brought back beautifully ready to be fried for us to enjoy. He was not kidding, they were amazing, split the meal like we used to with between my wife and I along with  with our usual salad with blue cheese and this time we also opted for the Crab artichoke dip with the garlic bread. Everything was amazing tonight so glad we gave them another shot and we can continue calling this our favorite place for fish and chips!
This subway is great! Customer service is fantastic. There is a young girl named cyann who works there who is very helpful and went out of her way to help me out. Great fresh food.

Fantastic service and pricing. I recommend Bill to anyone who needs a watch repair or battery replacement. A local supermarket/jewelry store chain replaced a battery in one watch that stopped working the next day. Bill discovered that the wrong battery was installed. Same chain wanted $120 for a battery replacement for a Swiss watch. Bill did it for $12!!  Don't look any further than Bill's shop!!

A couple weeks ago a friend and I went in had dinner, one of the waitress blond just returned after leaving her crazy husband in another state, for about a half hour this waitress told a couple behind us all about her divorce, and how one of the gentlemen that have been working at this restaurant for quite some time stated that her and him are the best to employees they have and they can't wait for all the other employees to leave.
we returned one more time to have dinner The waitress took her order give us a water and tea to never return again not offering us anything else to drink had to ask for utensils not even a dessert she didn't even have time to drop off our ticket. I didn't go in there to listen to how she left her husband at another state and how the credit card debt was hers than and they're going through this legal divorce and he's crazy. if I walk in there one more time and see this girl sitting people who will not stay to eat dinner she is not a very polite waitress.

I have been dining here since this establishment opened, and needless to say they have always strived for excellence. From their top-notch customer service, to their immaculate food preparation this restaurant is a must see if you're visiting this area. The owner is very kind, and costumer conscientious, and has created quite an extravagant dining experience.

Pretty disappointed in the customer service.  We came in on a week night and inquired about bowling services. At 9:30 we were told there was a 45 minute wait and usually they close at 11 but were extending the hours until midnight to allow more bowl time and that the unlimited for 10 bucks would be worth it. My group and I obliged and did so. 11:20 they gave the allies a 10 min warning before shut down, and when we went to complain They said we shouldn't have had a big group (2, not 5) and they would have allowed us to keep our land open until the end of the game. Not only that but they didn't even give us up until 11:30 to bowl, they shut down 3 minutes early. I know it seems minor but it's the moral of the fact and we could have gotten at least another roll each. It's unfortunate that we were recommended such a deal but in the end not given what what was expected. Thanks, but no thanks Big Al's. Your staff could require some better people skills.

Great place! 1lb burger on the menu and various types of meat. Way better than the Habit if ya ask me. It ranks right up there with Double Tap in BoDo. I'd love to bring some of my friends there to try it out sometime. Ill be back!!

Had a great night visit here driving through town. Think of it as a gourmet version of 5 Guys. Had a pepperjack bacon bison burger (BFC original variation) - also yam, curly gold and bourgeoisie fries.

Positives:  
1- taste (world class flavor - fries and burgers) 
2- variety (fries, seasonings and meats/meatless)
3- fry sauces / blueberry, garlic aioli, jalapeño ranch, spicy ketchup - I feel like the next time I have fries with plain ketchup I'll be slummin' it.
4- close to freeway
5- kid friendly 

Negatives:
1- no public wifi
2- bathrooms closed for cleaning (but no sign) (I had to ask if I needed a key).
Wonderful park for all ages. Great for kid's events or any birthday's and big groups. Come and try the zip line and the water fountains and the little river sand pit!

wow what a dream this new salon is! the owner really went above and beyond on every single little detail of the aesthetics ...the whole place is a vibe. the minute you walk in you feel like a princess- pink walls, fancy velvet chairs, crystal chandeliers, mimosas, and a totally dreamy staff that caters to you.

I came in really needing my hair done. I have just had a baby and it had been way too long since I had pampered myself. this place made me feel relaxed the entire time. kelsey was my stylist and she's the owner- she listened to my request of what i wanted, and she was off. she is friendly and personable, easy to talk to and overall you can tell just a good person. she quoted me up front what it was going to cost as well, which from my experience has not been the case anywhere else.

this place is spendy but reasonably so- you get A+ service, good wine, gorgeous ambience, and a staff that knows what they're doing- this is a far cry from super cuts. 

I genuinely left feeling amazing and highly recommend this salon- and kelsey- to anyone looking for the full experience!
Good place to grab some pho; the warm spices traditionally used in pho broth really come through. Good prices and great portion sizes.
Super with kiddos, and talented stylist with adults.  Where ever Whitney goes, we go!  She's the BEST!

The actual place to eat is fine but if I could give negative stars I would. This place basically ruined my life. I don't wanna get into details but I just hate when people try to rush me. Yes normally if I'm going through a drive thru I will want to try to be as fast as possible but it was super early in the morning with no one in sight and the lady on the speaker didn't even want to wait for me for more than ONE second! Well unfortunately my nerves and anxiety got the best of me....
All I got to say: completely for only girly girls, they had nothing for anyone else and were overpriced.

This is an okay restaurant. The restaurant was clean and still look new. The pho was good, the portion was good, and the price was decent. The only thing that I was a bit disappointed was my pork, shrimp vermicelli, it was just too plain. Overall, it was just an okay place for me.

I have visited this establishment quite few times in the past and I always and only have ordered the Salmon Filet (Locks & Cream Cheese) sandwich, so I cannot comment on anything else on the menu. The first time that I visited, I got my order to go and when I got in the car and opened up the paper to reveal my sandwich, the bagel was sort of bland, and not toasted at all even though I requested it to be toasted, so each time after, I would request the bagel to be extra toasted, but for some reason, it was never even remotely toasted. Strange. "Maybe it's a busted toaster or something", I thought to myself. Each time that I have ordered from the downtown Boise location, the sandwich was nice (besides the toasting ordeal). Today, I found my stomach growling and decided to order from them again, but I ordered through Door Dash instead of visiting any of the locations. Same thing happened. I requested the bagel toasted and it arrived without a hint of toasting, white as a ghost, yet soft and obviously fresh. Having said that, on it was spread THE thinnest layer of cream cheese I ever did see, one very small slice of smoked salmon, (not enough for the price at $8.99) and two slices of tomato, very little lettuce, and a decent amount of very, very thinly sliced cucumber (my special request). I was a little disappointed to say the least. Bummer, because it's one of my favorite sandwiches and no many places serve it. Hopefully, if I communicate my request the next time I will have better luck. I will always try again!

Save your stomach and your appetite....for a different place. Sad, because the staff was friendly but the meal was more than disappointing. My Pad See Ew had raw, hard noodles and was greasy with no good flavors. I also took a bite and found myself crunching on what seemed like sand. Our Thai Teas were overtly sweet, think we now have Diabetes. How do you mess that up?! My husband's "crispy" chicken dish had old soggy chicken that tasted like play doh. He's now home in the bathroom for the third time, regretting eating his meal.
We love Boise Fry! Their burgers are delicious and their fries are the best in town. This is where we send all of our friends when they come to town for a visit!

I CANNOT rate this place with just 5 stars I would give 10 stars. I was a little hesitant as I always am with new salons but WOW. AMAZING!

The salon is soooo beautiful and very large so good for a group! They also follow COVID protocols so well and it is super socially distanced. 

I had a picture of what I wanted and wasn't sure if it was something my nail tech Emma would be comfortable with but she knocked it out of the park! 

The detail and time they took I felt so comfortable and confident that it would look amazing. Seriously the detail. They took their time to make it PERFECT! 

And finally the price was soooooo affordable. Even with a soak off and full set. I was expecting it to be a lot because of the professional quality and time spent paying close attention to detail but it did not break the bank! 

Once again I cannot begin to explain how happy I am with the service.

Sadly I am modifying my review of Fiesta Guadalajara to 1 star.  As one can tell by the number of check ins I have here, I have eaten here a lot! The food was mostly consistent and we really liked some of the staff, especially Daniel (a bidder). Daniel has easily become our favorite part of coming to eat here.  I joke with my husband that he and Daniel have a bit of a bromance happening.  
Last night we went to dinner here.  My husband ordered the 3 Carne Asada tacos plate and my son and I ordered bean & cheese burritos. I requested that mine have extra cheese. Our burritos were as simple as you can get...no sauce, no sour cream, just beans and cheese.  No rice and beans on the side. The size of the burrito wasn't huge.  I would say it was made on a 10" tortilla and had 1/2-3/4 cup of beans and 1/4 cup of cheese.  
When our bill arrived, we noticed that we were charged $10 for my sons burrito and $11 for my burrito (I was up charged $1 for extra cheese). We have NEVER been charged that much for a bean and cheese burrito here. Ever! My husbands combo plate was $11!  We couldn't locate our server to inquire about the price, so we spoke to another server who said that he would figure it out. After about 5 minutes he came back and said that he spoke with the manager who said that we were charged for a traditional burrito and since they don't "technically " have a bean & cheese burrito on the menu (except on the kids menu) they charge for the traditional burrito. It seemed crazy to me. The traditional burrito comes with meat and other things that I didn't get.  I mean at least if they are charging me for a meat burrito and I don't get the meat don't upcharge me for the extra cheese. In all of my visits here, I have never been charged this much. In the end, we just paid the $10 & $11, but I have no desire to go back to a restaurant who severely overcharges when there are plenty of other places to eat.  Sorry Fiesta Guadalajara, it was good while it lasted.  We will miss you, especially Daniel.
Good quality food at a great price.  The service is outstanding and I love the atmosphere.

One of the things we miss in Idaho is a good donut shop.  We are not a big fans of Dunkin' Donuts nor Krespy Creme.  We found it is lacking simple but descent donut shops in the metro of Boise.  You can find donuts from the grocery stores but they are just not the same.

This is my first personal visit.  My husband always swings by and grabs donuts from DK donuts and we have been loving it.  The donuts here are very fresh, soft and made the ways we think donuts should be.  Not sure if it was because I was there around 10:30 a.m. (a bit too late) or the selections were not that many.  The shop is small but nice and clean.  Quite some stools and chairs you can sit down and enjoy a donut with a cup of coffee.  There is a surcharge of 40 cents if you want to charge your purchase less than $4 on a credit card.  I did not try their coffee but there is a Starbucks right next door if you prefer that.

Since there is no half of a star, I had to give it 4.

This store has been great.  We joined the lawn club and have been very pleased with the results.  The staff has always been very helpful every time we have come intonthe store.  

They even have low cost dog vaccinations on certain Saturdays.  They have supplies for our animals.  What impresses me the most is their honesty.

Today I came in and I was going to buy weed killer.  The lady at the register told me it would be best to wait for Spring when the weather warms up to apply this because it will be more effective.

What impressed me was the honesty of the employee.  I could have spent close to $30.00.  This wasn't a lot of money, but I could have spent money and would not have gotten the best results.  

I appreciate their honesty, and this is one more reason for me to keep coming back.  Thank you Zamzows.

Empanadas for the people!  Meat pies of the heavenly skies!  Meridian is lucky to have a place like this and I hope they get the support from this burger, pizza, IPA town.  Location might be hard to get attention so I really hope anyone reading this will tell others to support this business!!  They have desert empanadas, and a mix of many beautiful flavored savories.  

I would suggest they use no green bell peppers in the food as many people need to avoid them specifically.  By being green you are most likely serving peppers that aren't even close to ripe, which has several downsides.  People deserve to eat ripe foods and green bell peppers do not have near the nutrition as other colors, and are hard on some digestion tracts.  Also, they are high in oxalates and red are not.  My favorite restaurants generally don't last in this sports bar/soccer mom town of Meridian, for what my guess is, lack of people that try new things.  Wake up and love these puffy baked pillows of perfection!!

There is nothing here that warrants their prices. There are so many establishments in our area that paying $16.50 for an appetizer is outrageous. Sure, the food is good, and portions are fair, but so is the place across the street, down the road, in the mall, downtown... you get my drift. 
I've read, since coming here, many people complaining about their cost as well. You only get one basket of chips and the other costs $2. 
We placed our order, then changed out mind as the waiter was putting our order in. He said it was too late to change it because the cook already starting working on it. It was a quesadilla... and then we waited for 20 additional minutes. I don't think the cook started it.

Roarings springs is kinda fun, When u actually get to go down a slide.  Lines are very long and workers could do a lot more to speed it up , but the (mostly ) teens working don't really give a rip if lines are long .... they are still getting paid.  The workers wait unnecessarily before they let you go down.  

Renting a locker is outrageous. $10, 12, or 15 depending on the size. Of course when we got there the cheapest ones were sold out.  Just gouging the public, highway robbery.  Even at five bucks they can make a huge profit for a locker, why do companies need to gouge people? 

Basically the most fun things are the lazy river and wave pool because there is no line, and kids play area. Like waiting in line for 10-20 minutes for a 25 second slide ride (if that) pretty much sucks. Most slides are actually quite short. Not like Wisconsin Dells Noah's ark park. Their slides r huge and a good minute or 90 seconds. 

Never had their overpriced food , we ate before we went. But prices looked extremely high.  Lot of really fat people there too, who look bad in swimsuits. 

Hey at least parking is free.

Both Dr Pilling and his staff are extremely professional and friendly with the latest of technology.  I always feel comfortable and like I'm in the best hands.   I highly recommend Dr Wade Pulling for all your dental needs.

The food was excellent after we waited at least 30 minutes to get it. The staff was friendly but only functioned at one speed. So while we were waiting I  noticed that the place needs a good cleaning. 
The ceiling over the sandwich making area is dirty along with the doors. This is the best sandwich shop that I've eaten at in years. Please clean it up.

Sooooo good! Chris was super nice and informative! Everything we got was delicious! We will defiantly be back for more! Tom always offers amazing customer service and lets me know what's new in the menu. The desserts are a must get. They also have patio seating for the summer:)

We had a minor family emergency this morning and I had to reschedule a reservation. I called and spoke with Lexi who was very professional and understanding and was able to help us reschedule.  Thanks again!

I've only been here one time, but I think I've found my dentist. 

The staff are very friendly on the phone when making an appointment. Same in person, the front staff was welcoming and pleasant. The waiting room is beautiful. The business is compliant with COVID safety measures. 

My dental hygienist was friendly and very knowledgeable with all aspects of my cleaning and x-rays. Dr Hansen was also personable, nice guy. Nobody tried to sell me any extra services. My teeth are generally healthy, but other dentists have tried to make me feel bad like I wasn't flossing enough etc and there was none of that here. 

I believe this is a new location for them, and it shows. Very clean, very streamlined, very bright and beautiful. Calming. I'm going to enroll all of my adult family members here. 5 stars.

I adore this salon! I moved to Boise last summer and this is my forever go-to place and Ha is my go-to guy. He is SO careful with his work, takes his time, and always pauses to stop and make sure I'm 100% satisfied with the length, shape, and color of my nails. Added bonus - he's super friendly, laid back, and cracks jokes to everyone in the salon. I'd recommend booking an appointment because they are ALWAYS busy! Love it here!

When it comes to Mexican food, there is only one place for our family to go to: El Tenampa in Meridian!  We often go after work with the kids and I "kid" you not, the employees can't be any friendlier to mine!  Starting with the drinks, we only seem to ever get the Margarita's and that is for one reason, they don't skimp on the alcohol!  Very tasty and we just seem to love them.  The food is top notch in my book.  The re-fried beans are made with plenty of lard in them so they are creamy and tasty as ever.  I get one of two dishes: the pork carnitas or the camarones el ajo.  They do the pork in such a way that it has a crispy layer that seems to have been done in pork fat and as often as I ask them how they do it, they won't give it up.  Good for them because it keeps me coming back!  The other dish is the shrimp (camarones al ajo).  It has this tasty garlic butter that comes with it and anytime you add butter to shrimp you win outright!  You never leave hungry and the people, like I said, are top notch.  I can't say enough about this place!

I called for an appointment, my dog had been to splash and dash a couple of times for a bath. I don't live in the area full time so there was a bit of confusion there. When she figured out who my dog was, she was so rude!  She said they had no grooming appointments until after the first of the year, they could possibly get her in for a bath unless she was matted?  I really couldn't figure out if she was just having a bad day or if I should take it personal? Well I took it personal will never take my dog to anyone who has a shitty attitude! Maybe she should find another line of work

Vegan curry has perfect crust and chewy texture. Flavorful with lots of different veggies. Delicious man. The chimichurri chicken also had a nice firm but chewy texture and wasn't greasy. The meat of the empanada was tasty. Not watery so it was easy to dip into the sauce. The chimichurri isn't spicy at all but great tasting.
Samantha is fabulous!!! She listened to everything I said and created a beautiful color and cut.  Love it.

Tried this spot while visiting the Boise area last week (late September 2020).  The fries were very good and the dipping sauces were fun to experiment with.  The burgers, though, were dry and bland.  Actually not as good as any of the typical drive-through burger chains.

At least at this location, the fries and dipping sauces are the only reason to come.

I've been looking for a place to do/care for my hair. I'm very particular when it comes to my hair and usually dread going to the salon. This is the first place where I actually enjoyed the experience. My haircut was perfect and better than what I expected. I went in a week later to color my hair for the first time EVER. I'm so glad I got it done here because again the end result exceeded my expectations. Alex worked on my hair both times and she did an AMAZING job! So glad I can finally count on ONE place to do a stunning job on my hair.

We're from jersey where they got amazing sub places. So moving here I was on the look out for a great place to get sandwiches. 
Well THIS IS THE PLACE!! 
I got a Ruben and oh my word! Best I've ever had! They sandwiches you get are massive! And for an awesome price! I didn't go in to order, but my husband did and he said everyone was awesome in there! We will for sure be going back!!
I always enjoy Dickies if I am craving BBQ. It's not over the top amazing, but a really solid Sunday afternoon meal that will make you feel like you are back in TX.

This repair shop quoted me $125 just to look at it through a scanner. Since apparently it's an OBD1. They were not any help and referred me to another mechanical shop. This place will also sap the money out of you. I can think of a few places that will do this around town. Shame

I called ahead to make sure they were still doing curbside at the time I planned on picking up the meal and they said yes, no problem, so I try to call to do my order when I told them I would call back, and got busy signals. I went in and the hostess said, " we took it off the hook, because we had too many orders" and they don't do sushi right now, because they don't have a sushi chef. I was still thinking about ordering and she said, " it will be a long wait"! Needless to say, I left. How's that for customer service?!

It pains me to even write this review because El Tenampa used to be the best place in Meridian (or valley for that matter) to go out an have Family Mexican. That said, we've been going to a different restaurant over the last year, but decided to give El Tenampa a run last night. Luckily we got Eddy as our server (he's still awesome), but the food lacked flavor and proportion. 

Eddy, my man, get El Tenampa back to its glory!

The most cleaning n sanitary salon in the area. They're deep clean and use hospital grade disinfectant at night to make sure we are safe. And the staffs are professional and skilled. Highly recommended

Our family has been part of the Guymon orthodontics family for around 10 years now. They really are like a family! I've see the same smiling faces who greet me and each of my 6 children like friends. So far 5 out of 5 have kept their beautiful straight teeth. If there has ever been an issue of shifting teeth they've addressed it right away and my children have maintained their great smiles over the years! It's a great environment with great quality orthodontics! Worth every penny for a lifetime of perfect teeth!

My daughter got lashes done here, and not only did they do the work without my signature on the consent form, she's 16she said Jessica didn't listen to what she wanted and I came home to a crying child. She said she was obligated to tip them, or she wouldn't be able to leave. I was in a movie when I got her upset texts. The lashes look like those on a cheap doll. I wish she'd used my credit card so I could dispute it, but no. I left messages saying how unhappy she was and they took them off for free. Omitting the alleged 70.00 removal fee. All in all, she was super upset and their lack of consideration is staggering.

Okay,  maybe it was because we showed up just before 5pm but service and food were outstanding!  

The menu and summer menu (only good for another couple weeks) had plenty of options.  My fave the Turkey Havarti Melt is always a great option but opted for the Ahi Tuna Melt since it won't be available much longer.  It was piled high with Tuna salad & the cheese was melted perfectly.  Bread grilled perfectly too. The greens were as nice crisp & cool contrast to the melted cheese but was a little too much when biting through bunch of lettuce with melty goodness all falling out. .regardless,  a fork helped!  

Ali the waitress was super attentive & even let my mother in law sample dressings (this is after my mil said-bring me something "exotic") and we discovered that the Serrano Grape dressing was just a little too spicy for this 86 years old & decided better just go with Bleu Cheese, Ali didn't miss a beat & was back in a flash. Waters were never empty nor did we have to ask or look for anything.  Nice!

Ok,  I tried to take a pic of husbands Bronco burger. .but it was mostly gone by the time I remembered!  He said cooked just how he likes & flame broiled. What more can a girl ask for,  husband AND inlaws happy, fed & no dishes!  

Add we're leaving tables getting very full and we see the waitresses running around a bit..so experience seemed enhanced by getting there early!

From the second you walk in the door, first class. Beautiful state of the art salon. Kelsey is the owner and what a beautiful soul on top of being an amazing hair artist. She in up on the new trends and constantly researching and educating herself and her staff. The BRE Team is so nice and pays close attention to your wants and needs. The DRY BAR is best in Boise! Check out their website for details on it. They offer memberships which is so great. Always love my mimosa and time at this new, beautiful salon! The hot, essential oils towel at the sink was amazing. You won't be disappointed!

My husband and I went to the Meridian Ram for a date night. We've always gone to the one in Boise and love the food, great service, great beer choices. This trip however was very disappointing. We dropped in about 9:30ish and were told as we walked in, "Just so you know our kitchen is closed." Still interested in having some apps and a couple beers we decided to stay. The whole place was rather empty, one other table had a couple people seated and already eating. There was one waitress and one bar tender but a whole bunch of employees sitting at a booth in the bar together, maybe off for the night not sure but some of them went in and out of the back so it was obvious they worked there. It wasn't a good look considering it took forever to get our first drinks and when I asked if I could substitute onion rings for the fries with the burger I chose to have, the answer was just "No, we aren't making onion rings anymore." Our waitress didn't smile the whole time, seemed like she would rather be somewhere else. We ate our food as quickly as we could and got out of there. Typically we would've had a few more drinks and enjoyed the time out together but it was pretty bad. I'm honestly only giving 2 stars because our food tasted good like always. We live in Nampa but would prefer to drive to the Boise location because the service at the Meridian location was so terrible.
I called them for the second time.  Once again fast and friendly service at a fair price.

We've taken our dog to PetSmart to get groomed about 4-5 times. Our puppy is about 9 months old now and we started taking him at 3 months for the puppy trims (to get him used to the clippers)On our 1st visit, they were nothing but nice. But as soon as we started to have our dog get actual haircuts is when the rude comments started. I made sure to book with people that specialized in small dogs and even put in our puppy's age so they knew he was a puppy going in. We have to have our dogs haircut on weekends because my husband and I work full time during the week. On our 1st real haircut visit, when we went to get our dog, the lady who cut our puppy's hair told us we need to come a different day and time because she couldn't handle that our puppy's excitement. It also took her 6 hours and there were chunks of hair that werent cut AND hair that was cut way way way too short. We obliged and brought him in at an earlier time and tried a different day even though the conversation was a little rude. The next time we went back, we received a phone call that our puppy was overly excited again and we needed to pick another day that works around their schedule when it's not so busy. Another 6 hours later, when we went to pick up our pup, the lady working the counter reminded us again that our dog was "overly excited" and we need to find a different time. AGAIN. When I complained to customer service about the LACK of customer service for a job these people have supposedly trained for FOR A YEAR, the lady who called us to clarify told us it was OUR problem and that we DID need to pick a different day and time. She was extremely rude, no compassion for our feelings, and the fact that we even accommodated the first time. If you can't be nice to your customers who are paying $50 for an O.K. haircut, how do I know your respecting my puppy who doesn't have a voice of his own?

Couldn't be happier with the service, flexibility and communication. I had to move my service from home to my work at the last minute and it was no problem. And they knew how to work with my insurance.

The Habit USED to be one of our favorite and hamburger go-to places, but not after this visit. We took our food to go and the whole thing was a mess. As I took out the food one hamburger completely fell out and apart. We hardly received any fries, and the hamburger in the kids meal was so undercooked we didn't even eat it. Very unimpressed. I understand that they were extremely busy, but was very disappointed.

Stopped here for lunch last weekend and it was well worth it. The Thai iced tea was sweeter than most but I enjoyed that. The menu is extensive and it all looked and sounded great. The fried tofu was light and crispy and the drunken noodles were exactly what I look for in Thai restaurants. The one thing I did not enjoy was that the noodles used in the pad Thai are similar to angel hair pasta in shape. By no means was this bad but I've become accustomed to a flatter noodle for pad Thai so this felt unusual. Overall 5 stars may be slightly generous but I would absolutely go again.

We ended up leaving.. Came in with 4 people to eat and have beers. They don't have menu's at the table anymore, no servers taking your order.. just a QR code on the table to scan. The QR site wasn't working so we were told to go up to a counter to place our order. This is extremely inconvenient for groups. We need to see a menu, ask questions, and we need a waiter to bring us beers or other items while we're eating. We're not going to get up and go to a counter every time we want a beer while eating. None of the restaurants in the area operate this way. This is ridiculous, please don't try to suggest you're doing this due to Covid. We won't be back as long as you continue this nonsense.

This cute little place was fantastic! Clean, nicely decorated and comfortable. Very quick service, and server was kind and attentive. We had two rice dishes and one noddle and we all left with empty plates and happy stomachs. Everything tasted fresh and delicious!
I absolutely loved my time with Tony. He gave me my first set of acrylics ever and they are gorgeous. He is such a sweet and funny man. I would highly recommend M Vince!

If nothing else buy the bread!  It's made fresh daily and it's to die for.  Their roasted pablano and corn soup is probably my favorite soup ever!  Unfortunately it's seasonal, so I can only enjoy it during the fall/winter.  Their sandwiches are great because they use FRESH bread and REAL turkey.  You should definitely order dessert at least once ;)

My husband and I stopped in on Monday night around 9:25pm. We were looking for hot coffee and a dessert. The employees looked annoyed when we walked in, but we continued to look. We had never been here. I worked in coffee shops years ago and I understand what it is like to be tired at the end of the night. Still, the girl at the register did not smile, did not talk to us, she just looked annoyed. The man working was trying to be funny, but only to her and she was looking less happy each time. 

We ordered two desserts (berry cheesecake and apple bread pudding) and two coffees.  The coffee that we got was luke warm at best! When we finished putting coffee in our cups, the girl came out, set our food on a table, and literally threw two forks on the table beside them. I was just praying someone had cleaned the table! 

At 9:40, my husband tried to get more coffee, but the creamer had been put away.  When he asked for the creamer, she looked very frustrated and brought us a giant cup of it.

All in all, the food was good, the coffee was cold, and the service was unfriendly. Next time, we will stop at the gas station for HOT coffee and a candy bar!
This place is the best!  Cute decor and very good prices    I love going in here every couple of months to see what's new.  I always leave with something. Great people as well.

My husband and I have been Dr. Lon McRae's patient for over 15 years.  I am the wimp in the family and if it was not for McRae Dental I probably would not have all my teeth at 68 years old.  

Now my husband, 67, also is a patient of McRae Dental. For 15 years Dr McRae has salvaged his teeth, kept him healthy as best as possible, but as some will say, it's just not possible to do much more with what has deteriorated.  We are being provided with solutions to help continue his dental future.  I am so thankful for such a wonderful staff, their dedication to trying to keep our mouth healthy and to do what is best for us. 

We love Dr. McRae!  We currently live 6 months in Florida but we choose to continue to make sure our dental health needs are always  done here at McRae Dental!

Ok so we went to big als back in 2018 for a company party and we had a blast. 
Just went back with a group of friends for the $10 night deal or whatever it's called and we are all sorely disappointed. Half of the arcade games were broken and didn't work, the food was decent but then they turned off all the arcade games 5 minutes before they closed. They say you can play until 10pm not until 9:55.

We'll be finding a better place to go hang out. At least until they update and fix their arcade.

Every time I visit my inlaws in Eagle, I come to this car wash!

This is one of my first stops after we make the drive here from Washington--this car wash gets all of the gunk and road grime off of my truck and makes it looks shiny and new again. The staff is super helpful and friendly. 

The vacuum area is covered and kept clean, and there are always plenty of damp towels to wipe down your interior with. 

The membership is WORTH IT.  For the cost of 2 washes a month, you get unlimited washes. Signing up and canceling are easy peasy. We were there for a couple of weeks and signed up because the wind and dust were blowing and I knew I'd be at the car wash enough to make it worthwhile. We canceled the day we left town and it took no time at all.

If you love your ride, this is the place to take it.

Purchased deal through Livingsocial (realize now what a SCAM that whole thing was). Called to book a service and the owner of Treasure Valley Duct Cleaning is telling me that the coupon is really WORTHLESS and he needs another $150-$200 for the service I thought I paid for in the $29.00 voucher. The coupon value is supposed to be worth $321.00 of service for the discounted rate we purchased it at. Why even do a deal if you are not going to honor it, MAJOR SCAM...

I somehow missed all the NEGATIVE reviews out there. I filed a claim with my bank for the original purchase as they are unwilling to honor the services I PAID for already. I ran into the same thing, called recording says it's a 1 hour wait, WHAT... sounds like no one works at Livingsocial to handle any issues, no one is on the other end, you can't ever reach a live person or even leave a message. SCAM, SCAM, SCAM...

Dr. Guymon's office is AWESOME! Two of my children needed to get braces and I spent a good deal of time finding the perfect orthodontist. After 4 or 5 consultations with other orthodontists, I went to see Dr. Guymon.  
The office is conveniently located across the street from Meridian Middle School.  The office is super fun! They have a small arcade with video games from the 80's that you can play while you are waiting for your appointment. There are phone chargers in the waiting room for just about any phone. They even have a step & repeat that you can use when taking a selfie! Next to the step and repeat is a question of the month.  When you answer the question you are entered into a drawing for different prizes (gift cards, for example). Once your kids are done with their braces Dr. Guymon gives you a delicious gourmet caramel apple & you get to sign the wall. The walls in the treatment area is covered with writing from everyone who completed their braces treatment. It's super cool! Another nice bonus is that they have a soft serve ice cream machine & the kids (and parents) are able to grab an ice cream cone on their way out when their appointment is done! The pricing & financing options are very fair and flexible. 
Dr. Guymon's office is great! I couldn't imagine going anywhere else.

Being new to the area, and craving an empanada, I decided to make a quick stop in here...and boy am I happy I did! It's a super cute little spot, I got 2 traditional empanadas with chimichurri and the Fuego sauce. They were SO delicious, (I should have gotten 4 instead of 2) probably one of the best empanadas I've had...the owner was extremely nice (which is always nice when you're new to a area) they also have a great selection of wine! I will definitely be back, and highly recommend.

Came to Big Al's to bowl and had to wait about an hour to get a lane- not a big deal so we decided to hit up the restaurant to get a snack before. We were seated quickly, but the hostess asked if we knew how to order using a QR code, which we did, but that was it. There was nobody that came by to make sure we were figuring out the menu or had any questions, which we did, but had to guess on what was good. We decided to get two orders of the Big Al's wings and buffalo dip. The wings were $18 each, so we assumed there was a good amount we would get. Wrong. There were 8 small wings in each order. The Sweet chili and porter bbq were decent, but don't bother with the Nashville Hot and the Bourbon bbq wings. We legitimately thought they forgot to put the sauce on the wings because it had hardly any flavor. We also had issues with receiving half our order because the QR system "didn't go through" even though we had the electronic receipt on our phone. The drinks we bought were decent, but not enough to make the experience worthwhile. We were then shocked to see that on Wednesdays they charge $6 for 5 wings as well as half off whiskey. We were not happy that we had spent so much money for wings. Even knowing this deal, we would hesitate spending even that much for the wings we got. Bowling itself was pretty inexpensive, but don't waste your money buying drinks while you bowl. A pitcher of Blue Moon was $25! Overall, I would save the money and go somewhere else for bowling, dinner, and/or drinks at a sports bar.

Update to my review. I emailed as asked to (as I had done prior to my review) and have yet to receive any response. The concern displayed was apparently only superficial for Yelp, not that they actually wanted to address any issue.

Last night I walked in the door with some coworkers and was treated to one of the best customer service experiences. Cindy, Albert and Brent took things to the next level. So I asked them what they considered to be the best item on their menu and Brent their Cook said, "I got you". I literally had my mouth water as I was given a delicacy of a sandwich. It was a teriyaki tenderloin steak sandwich that was tender as could be with pineapple, avocado, bacon, lettuce and tomato on grilled sourdough. I immediately coined it as the "Big Red" in honor of the awesome chef that "Got Me". All I can say is I found my favorite place to go and will trust this amazing staff to deliver!!! Thanks guys for the absolutely awesome experience!!! You guys rock!!!
A cute and quaint neighborhood spot! The food is always delicious and consistent. We love sitting on the patio for appetizers and drinks, but it's also a best kept secret for an upscale dinner!

I don't wash my car often, but when I do, I like to use an automatic car wash. Especially in the dead of winter. Who wants to get sprayed with high pressure water and oily soap when it's 40 degrees? Not me, thank you!

I've been to Metro 3 times. I always get the cheapest $7 wash (I mean I don't think Hilda, the 2004 Honda Pilot, deserves to treat herself). And despite my frugal ways, my car comes out sparkly clean each time. I especially like the high powered dryers which wick away almost all of the moisture, making the manual labor of wiping Hilda down with a towel almost obsolete. 

I will say the car wash is LOUD and a tad aggressive. "Hungry", my 4 year old, thinks its a delightful show put on just for her, and "Hurricane", the 1 year old, shrieks in fear. That only escalates the noise level. 

I love that they have super vacuums with long hoses to suck away all those goldfish bits and flecks of granola from the floor. They also have air compressor hoses to refill your tires. 

My main annoyance (and the reason for 4 stars) is that I HATE that they have some poor 16 year old waiting by the pay machine to "assist" me in my purchase. Listen Colton, I may have had to use dial up internet once upon a time, but I do know how to put 7 ones into the machine and press a button. Clearly it's a sales tactic to sell the higher priced wash, but my cheap heart can not be swayed. If they would give those poor kids another gig, I would happily visit Metro regularly.
Love love love. Vegan curry empanada. Not even a cheat meal and so good!!  I love that they use fresh veggies!

Amazing food, and the freshest, highest quality ingredients. The portions are always generous, and the food is always good. Friendly, fast service, locally owned, and the fries are the best around (get em with the cocktail sauce). Can't go wrong with anything on their menu

Tried this place today for the first time. It was very tasty. Food was fresh and yummy. We had the adobo chicken and carne asada in form of burritos and quesadillas. Staff were friendly and patient as we looked at menu and decided what we wanted. Very cool-looking inside with wide open eating area, plenty of seating, and it was very clean!  The queso is really good. I didn't care for the salsa but the queso was good and the guac too!
Lan and Ann are wonderful! They each took care and did a fantastic job with my gel manicure and pedicure. I will definitely be back!

Nice place, cleaner than most.  Linda was great, but unfortunately one of my nails chipped same day. Given it was a gel manicure, that should have not happened.  I will go back considering as mishaps occur.  I habitually arrive places early and thankfully they did not leave me standing at the door and let me right in.

FYI - the staff did not assist ig a "fix" for my nail.

very nice park that just went up. there are a lot of homes around the area that will benefit from this place.
