I have an almost 2 year old son and this equipment is for much older children. they do have a small little playground for the younger kids but it is directly next to and in the same area as the giant slides and rock walls which of course hold much more appeal to a toddler. 

because the areas aren't separated at all, he wouldn't even go near the little kids stuff and was ready and willing to go up the stairs to the biggest slide I have ever seen at a playground ever. it's a little dangerous.

also when we were there a girl about 8 was trying to climb the rock wall and got stuck and was screaming in fear for her mom. she was well within the age range for this equipment and it was dangerous.

I don't think we will be back anytime soon. if you have an adventurous child who is 7+, this is the park for you!

Everyone seemed to be having a great time. Just a heads up for seniors who purchase a "spectator" ticket. You may not find shaded seating. 90% of the seating was reserved with someone's towel. My wife and I ended up sitting on cement blocks around a planter area. We were uncomfortable the whole time.

Was so excited to finally get my nails done. Very disappointed and frustrated. Not only did it take forever but terrible job!! Had French done, very thick, the white is awful. Spent way to much and now I have to go somewhere else to get them fixed!!

Taco Time changed my life. Yes. Very good. I had heard many a time the legends of Taco Time in Meridian, Idaho. I knew the time would come one day I would step foot in this sacred place. Long live taco time!
Cinnamon and sugar bagel, fresh out of the oven I would like to add, topped with the berry cream cheese...delicious. It was the perfect chewy texture that I expect.
Excellent burger matched only by amazing service. They really went out of their way to get us what we wanted. Staff was friendly and I left full :)

they had good availability and then even got me in early, i had very stubborn residue of dip nails and my nails tend to be thin/brittle so i was hesitant, but they look perfect. i got a gel manicure for $42, my only complaints and reasons for 4/5 stars would be that i had three fingers bleed around the cuticle from over filing and trimming. the tech did not address this and the alcohol added to them was definitely uncomfortable. overall i'd still go back:)

Fantastic job on dip nails and great customer service. We were able to be helped instantly as walk-ins for 2 dip nail appointments. Moon is great and really takes the time to make each nail look perfect! 

I've been trying to find a great nail salon in the area that doesn't rush their appointment, does a good job, and truly cares about their work. This is the place! I will definitely be back.

I recently moved from Washington, and this was my first time here.  I've had the lash lift and tint for the last 5 years so I kind of have experience on what is a great lash lift.  I got the lash lift and tint today, and it came out horrible. The job done was sloppy.  She also got tint in my eye and my eye was burning.  There is no curl and the tint and glue from the stickers were left on my eyelids, and when I came home I had to clean up her mess.  Terrible experience, and I will not be going back. Hopefully I find a lash salon that takes pride in their work.

I really like the habit. I've eaten at several locations and out of state too. Great burgers, excellent ahi tuna sandwiches, and their fries are great too. I really hope they maintain their quality since the company was recently bought out by a major fast food giant corporation. Please don't change a thing.

Love the Thai food here!!! This is my go to stop for Thai in Boise/Meridian area! They have all the traditional stiff as well as some unique fun menu items that will get your tastebuds chatting! Their sushi is just ok in my opinion, but it's a huge sushi  menu and I haven't tried every roll on it. Good atmosphere and attentive staff...give this place a try if you are craving Thai!
Very nice place with good prices. Nothing super special in terms of extras but nails always come out looking good which is the most important. Nice ladies and clean environment

We had Justin draw up our estate documents recently and we could have not been more pleased. Justin is amazing! He is very knowledgeable and professional. He walked us through everything and answered all our questions and then some. He provided us additional information that made the entire process wonderful. Definitely try Justin as we can not say enough good things about him.

Look no further. This is the place you'll love. 

We called Chris, in a panic, after dropping a huge mess on the fabric seat of a brand new car. Liquid went in all the cracks and crevices. Horrible mess. Chris calmly said to bring in the car; he'll be waiting for us. What?? This was amazing--the best detailing shop in the Valley and we get top-notch and immediate treatment for a spill? Yes. You know why? Chris could tell that this was an important--really important--issue for us, and we needed him to help us get through it. Chris believes in the power of relationships, and that value carries through his business. 

Chris was, of course, waiting for us and got to work on the spill right away. The front seat looked as good as new after an hour. It was a perfectly-executed job. What was and is more important to us is the customer care that Chris lives in his business. We have found a new, wonderful business partner and it all comes down to Chris treating us like family. 

Seriously--don't look any further than 272 E. 5th St. in Meridian.  We are so glad we found Chris and his business; it's like no other. Tell him Laurel sent you! ; )
They turned off the toaster an hour and a half before close, didn't tell me until halfway thru my sandwich, and left me with a cold, soggy, miserable looking sandwich. Yuck.

Horrible. Zero stars. Not even a full serving of Cold meat which was mostly fat and gristle. Gave me my plate upside down so everything went everywhere. My husbands sandwich was an absolute mess. Didn't even wrap it well enough in the paper so it just fell out into the bag. Sandwich still wasn't right. Coke was all carbonation and nothing else.

I'd expect This if I was eating someones leftover plate out of the trash can. In fact at this point I think it would have been better if I had just dug someone's plate outta the dumpster. 

The previous time we came here they forgot an entire side we ordered and paid for. Never coming here again.

If you enjoy being mad, wasting money, and eating trash, this is absolutely the place for you.

Don came out to my house & spent a day replacing old plug receptacles & new circuit breakers. Installed new LED lites in my garage. 
He did an excellent job. Showed up the day & time he said he would.
I will definitely use Integrity Electrical Services again.

Called and asked for someone to come give an estimate to build a pool.  Jim came to my home and we talked for about an hour.  When he left, I gave him my email address to send the estimate to.  About a week and a half went by but no estimate.  I called to inquire about the estimate and was told by Jim that he got the impression that it was too expensive when he "ball parked it"!!!   He then went on to say that "people" from California come here and expect to get a pool for 20K and there are pool builders who will build a pool for that fee but he was not one of them.  The take away here is this:  Jim, don't ever let an impression dictate the proper and professional way that you should do business.  I am a believer in that if you tell someone you will do something, then follow thru and do it.  I didn't appreciate the lack of follow thru and I certainly didn't appreciate the comment about Californians.

Limited menu but I enjoyed my burger and fries very much.  Very clean and nice inside.  I enjoyed it all except the employee having lunch from another restaurant while yelling at someone on her cell phone at the table next to us.

I feel like I want to rate Dickey's BBQ higher than 3-Star, but I feel like 3 is generous honestly. 

Dickey's concept is simple. Pick the quantity of meat's, pick which meat's you want, get two sides. The food itself tastes fairly decent, but the cost and portion sizes are a bit off. I didn't feel like I was getting 'texas sized' portions with their 3 meat offering. 

Overall the food is decent, but can be fatty or grissley.  I think If you're looking for a quick BBQ joint this will be about average.

THIS IS AN EDITED VERSION OF MY PREVIOUS REVIEW TAKEN DOWN AT THE REQUEST OF THE COUNTER. APPARENTLY, THEY CAN'T STOMACH THEIR OWN FOOD EITHER:

Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to challenge yourself how you think about burgers. At least that's what the folks over at The Counter want you to do. They are about creative construction and feel they make things delicious with what I am convinced must be Monsanto inspired ingredients. Life is about experiences, and if you want to try stuff, learn something or be creative, try your local college dorm. There, you will not only have more fun picking off the scabs from around your lips, but will so intensify your senses from the endless consumption of gourmet frozen-burrito-ramen-noodle-doo, that you will actually enjoy paying high prices for the food at The Counter.

It is without a doubt in my mind that the vast number of toppings available for your creation can only be made possible through the efforts of Nicolas Appert and the magic of butylated hydrocyanisole and hydroxytoluene. How else can they afford to keep that many ingredients in one place? I hope I'm wrong and that their Market Selections are in fact sourced daily and not preserved.

My particular creation started with the hormone and antibiotic free beef, then it was topped with Gouda cheese (a personal favorite), sun-dried tomatoes, roasted green chilies, and the roasted garlic aioli all on a standard brioche bun to preserve the flavor of the ingredients. Along with the Parmesan fries, it all sounded like a delightful and flavorful combination to me!

Now, don't let the looks fool you! The burger was in desperate need of salt and was simply not impressive; the bun was dry, the tomatoes had little flavor, the garlic aioli was okay but still lacked garlic and the green chilies tasted like, well, what you might imagine a Leprechaun would taste like . . . green with a just a hint of Guinness! The Parmesan fries were dissolving in their own grease and became more limp than the aforementioned Leprechaun.

The only redeeming quality of The Counter was the service! Our server and the rest of the staff were fantastic. Friendly, welcoming and efficient, almost to a fault. A wonderful crew, indeed and I would go back and try a shake just to be served by them one more time.

My personal burger combination at The Counter was not at all what I had built up in my mind and the cost made the whole meal even harder to swallow. With over 312,120 ways to to build your burgers, you could spend a lifetime creating and devouring different combinations! Unfortunately, only one combination was enough to convince me that there were perhaps 312,119 too many. Consider me disappointed.

Just tried this place for the first time & I must say: "WOW!" Chef Wally lights up the room with his infectious smile & booming voice. The sandwiches are to die for: all fresh ingredients & little add ins to make them different from the normal boring versions. Sandwiches are big & filling, just like the OUTSTANDING Customer Service. We will definitely go back again & again!

I love(d) big als when they first opened. The hype for the Meridian Village was becoming real. I would using visit on Fridays after work with a bunch of buddies. The fact that they are open late is a huge plus to people who are looking for a dinning experience at midnight (the rare few of us out there). 

So let's talk about the pros and cons

Pro: large new facility offers plenty of amenities.  Clean up kept facilities. Large televisions for sports. Arcade and bowling for family or wholesome fun.

Cons: food is WAY over priced for what you are getting. If the food tasted better I would understand a hefty price. I've had several burgers on more than one occasion have melted plastic in the cheese. The staff is always willing to re make food,  but it's disheartening to have it happen 3+ times. 

Would I take friends to Big Als? Probably for the excitement during game day, but their are other options around that compete in this market. I recommend they adjust the food prices.

Don't get me wrong. The burgers are great! But the fries are the star of the show. Large portions and so much variety it takes half the menu to list them! We stopped today while traveling through Boise. I had the classic burger with cheese, bacon and aioli sauce. My husband had the bison burger with bacon. They were fabulous. But we tried three different fries (there are 7 if you count the Brussels sprouts) and 7 or 8 of the "ketchup" options. Friendly staff. Clean and cool. We will be back on our next trip!
Meh. There was barely any maple/chocolate glaze on any of the donuts. Got in right as they opened and it was clear the donuts weren't all fresh.

I got the basic pedicure for $25, and it was pretty good. I think I'll get the higher package next time so I can get a massage included, too. The lady that helped me was very nice. They only took cash, which surprised me when she told me at the end. Luckily I happened to have enough!

Horribly done extensions. Done by Montana. 3 days after installation I called with concerns of strings being loose on my wefts. The owner, Erica played it off as it was normal. Made me feel stupid. 6 weeks go by and they are LITERALLY falling out of my hair. But I was told it was NORMAL. I didn't feel comfortable going back so I went to a new salon and these pictures were taken. Literally awful. Contacted Montana for at least some kind of agreement and 50% refund for the damage done and splotches on my extensions and horrible installation job. Nothing. Literally not okay and I don't recommend having anyone go there. Bad, cheap, lazy work.

We found GNG on Yelp, and we wanted to try someplace new. So glad we did!!! The Cuban was outstanding, and my friend said her chicken sandwich was the best she's ever had! I always have to order fried green beans when it's on the menu somewhere, and Grants was spot on! Generous portions!!! All the food going by looked delicious, and the owner, Grant was very friendly and accommodating!
This place is small, but has a patio and bar seating as well. Heard the brunch gets real busy. You won't go wrong if you give this place a try! YUM YUM!!!
Our favorite local breakfast spot either in Meridian or the original classic  location near downtown Boise. Friendly staff and great food!

The salon is beautiful! They pamper you with sparkling wine or a mimosa if you desire. My hairdresser was Kelsey Crawford who is the owner. She took the time to ask me what I wanted and worked with me to stay close to my budget. I have fine hair so I like the fact that the products used at this salon are ammonia free. Kelsey did a fabulous job on my color. I highly recommend this salon to others.

I've never been in a place where the boss and the employees are fighting. Yelling at each other telling them they are sweeping in the wrong place. 

Then they were yelling at each other saying they were "stupid as hell" and the manager proceeded to yell at the employees in front of me and another person who were waiting for their food. Jesus. Never again

If I could give this place a negative rating I most certainly would. First of all, the first room we checked into flooded, they then proceeded to put us into 2 DIRTY rooms. So I complained. Later I called Priceline, who I booked through, and they said they Can't so anything about it because the motel said that we smoked in the room. We did not. They were just mad because I didn't want to stay in a dirty room. There were nasty stains on the walls and couch. Plus the first room got some.of our things wet. I will never stay at this place again. If you are smart, you won't either.

Pretty good. I had the mango chicken and calamari. Calamari was good, sauce was nice. Mango chicken is my fav at Thai and Malaysian places and this one wouldn't crack the top 3 from restaurants at home (Atlanta) but it was OK. It had a lot of vegetables, mushrooms carrots, peppers, but a very mild thin sauce.

I was very thankful that the guy (sorry - didn't catch his name) helped me manage my expectations regarding the repair I thought I needed (battery). He told me I'd be welcome to get the service, but my phone's battery likely won't be noticeably better. He explained why in a way that I understood (software updates demanding more from the phone) and in the end, I didn't end up having the repair done.  That was great service and I wanted to at least "pay" CPR with a positive review!
Best sandwiches ever, Trevors melt is my go to here. Best sandwiches in the Treasure valley. The staff are  great as well.

My sister and I were looking for a nail place for pedicures and this place showed up on Yelp. There's a reason it's so highly rated! We called ahead and they were booked for the day, so we made an appointment for the next day. We were welcomed in and seated almost immediately. He even asked what temperature we wanted the water! The entire time he was checking up on me to make sure the cut was the right length, that the nail file wasn't hurting me, and that the paint was perfect. Both mine and my sisters nail artists were so friendly and comfortable to talk to. My toes are now beautiful and clean! Would definitely recommend this place to a friend. 

The interior decoration was also super gorgeous, it was very clean and cute inside, it looks a little jank from the outside, but inside it is beautiful!

Take a trained Chef from one of the largest and most competitive food markets and plant him in our little town of Meridian, ID.  Then tell him to make soups and sandwiches, and you get Fat Guy's Fresh Deli. 

Gourmet soups are made from scratch fresh daily secretly in the dead of night by Chef Wally so no one disrupts his masterpieces. I highly recommend the Cheddar Bacon Potato Jalapeno which I think he does on Wednesdays.

Now let's touch on the sandwiches.  Your first warning is they are HUGE so expect to either be full, or take 1/2 of it home with you.  What do you expect, though, from a sandwich place called "Fat Guy's Fresh Deli"?

I've had ~10-12 different sandwiches and have loved them all!  My personal favorite, though, is the Turkey Melt.  Sure it sounds plain and boring but it's the best turkey melt I've ever had. 

Get your food, eat, and spend a couple hours recovering then walk over to Gamercy Park Pizza and Grill for a drink and an amazing dinner.

A new taco place in Meridian! I've been watching with anticipation as this business has been moving toward its grand opening, as it's a short distance from my office. What's better than a mid-day taco??

They've got a pretty diverse selection...both breakfast tacos as well as lunch/dinner tacos. I tried the Beef Brisket, Pulled Pork and Grilled Fish tacos today. 

Not bad...

Not great. 

I honestly couldn't tell the beef from the pork. 

The fish was a little dry (but hey, we live in Idaho). 

The portions were about what I expected. Reasonable. 

Flavor?? Eh. 

This brings me to a 4 Star rating. After all, they're selling tacos! How bad can it be. 

Perhaps a breakfast taco will really impress me and my rating will increase?

Lots of people trying it out. Good luck!

I went here today on my 30 MINUTE lunch break and was very disappointed.  I have been the BFC on State St before so I thought this location would be just as fast. Boy was I wrong! After about 5 minutes, I started timing them and, finally, after 23 minutes my order was ready leaving me 7 minute to eat and drive back to my employer.  I was upset by this because there was only 2 people ahead of me.  I was able to eat my burger, but not my fries. Nothing like having to rush when you are trying to enjoy and relax on break. Please hire/schedule more people for the weekends at least!!

This is some of the best Thai food in the Boise area!!  Everything about this little gem is great...I cannot say enough good things about it.  I've been here numerous times with my boyfriend because he always said it was his favorite place to get Thai and it's now becoming one of mine.  

Sometimes I get the sushi, sometimes the Thai, but they are both equally as good.  The presentation is beautiful, the menu has some tasty, unique options, and the service is awesome.  The servers are always so sweet and give great service.  They also have a unique cocktail menu including a delicious chocolate martini!  At Sa-Wad-Dee it surely seems like they pay attention to every detail including the beautiful decor...it's so serene and sticks to the Thai tradition...makes you feel warm and cozy.   

The icing on the cake was ordering the Curry Noodles tonight....absolutely delicious!!  I'd recommend this place to anyone looking for good Thai or sushi, and living in Boise it is definitely worth the drive.

The food is really good I usually get the chicken enchiladas very tasty great chips on the side just know the service is not all that it's pretty much Hit or Miss but most the time it's not really that great, totally ratchet whatever-
They could do so much better-
But I will say the food consistently is good
That's where the 3 stars

Super Tasty, Trevor Melt is crazy good! The Lead Fat Guy (owner) was very friendly, however when he started giving my son and another customer the business (teasing) he went passed funny and into, "alright, lets calm down a bit" bordering rude. I think he believes since he is the owner, his customers are his "Audience" Will for sure go back, but I will take it outside to eat, or To Go...

I met my grandparents at Sa-Wa-Dee for dinner on Wednesday and had a very enjoyable evening.  There wasn't an empty seat in the place and there was live music being played by a gentleman who seemed to be able to play any instrument.
  We ordered the Crispy Flower appetizer and they were very tasty.  I ordered the Mango Chicken which had a nice flavor, but I wish it would have had a little more spice to it, or maybe i was expecting a little more mango taste.  My grandfather didn't look up the entire time when his Crispy Almond Shrimp arrived.  He really enjoyed the dish.
  The part I really want to bring attention to is the staff.  My grandmother ordered a somewhat spicy dish and after having a coughing fit, was unable to continue eating the meal.  The waitress offered to bring some coconut milk to help bring down the heat of the dish and my grandmother kindly turned down the offer.  The manager on shift came over and offered the same service and asked if she would like anything else since she hardly touched her dinner.  Again, my grandma kindly turned the offer down saying that the meal was just fine and it was a personal issue.
  When we were handed the bill, the waitress explained that they had removed my grandmother's dish because she hadn't really had any of it.  It was a very moving motion on the owners part to make this offer.  The restaurant was full of customers and for the owner to offer this service to my grandmother meant a lot.  It's nice to know that there are some people who know what is important.  Thank you to the staff for being so kind, you earned a long term customer by showing your generosity and understanding.

Marcos has become our go to pizza delivery joint.  The pizza is good to above average and always hot.  Good price point and the delivery time is usually with-in 30 to 45 minutes.  Give them a try and you won't be disappointed.

My husband and I had a ultimate pedicure each to celebrate our anniversary. It was amazing. We will be back just to celebrate anything.  Best of all his feet look amazing in sandals.  They took the time to even make his large toe nails smooth.  Wonderful clean salon.  My husband appreciated the open light atmosphere.
Very very good food. If you plan on going on the weekend better get there early. There bar drinks are strong which is worth the money. I will go back.
Great food and service. I had the terres major steak. It was well seasoned and cooked perfectly.

Meh the wash is over priced the second to last set of wraps driver side is coming down on cars to hard i went through twice and it happened both times and there mirror bump on the passenger side has to be off the same smudge from my son was still there after both washes. Wish I would have just done the cheapest wash because there 18 dollar wash just isn't worth it

Like many posts here, i wish i had read them before i shopped here. I bought a sweatshirt labeled "medium" which was so small it wouldnt fit my 87 lb granddaughter. No store credit. No manager to talk to. (Clerk is afraid of getting fired, which is telling of how management runs this business).

Be wary of what you purchase. If it plugs in or runs on batteries, check it in the the store. Once you take it out the door, good luck for a return. They have more excuses and rules than goodwill with the customers who support them.

The customer in front of me purchased a waterpik device 2 days earlier, and it didnt work. No refund for her, no store credit. "We test them. We dont know what you did at home"

 Seriously?!?

Why dont you just post a "NO REFUNDS. ALL SALES FINAL". At least we consumers will go into  the purchase with knowledge that we won't get a refund unstead of cheating us.

Some good deals, some not so good. Know your prices before purchasing,  and know you wont get your money back if the product does not work or is mislabeled.

The first time I came here the gal who did my nose piercing was the best. She was easy going nice and fun. It has been the allotted time frame for changing out my piercing now. I didn't see an option online to do a piercing change - so I just booked for a nostril piercing it's for $30. When I walked in and the employee at the front checking me in  asked about me getting pierced etc and I let her know I just wanted my nose piercing changed out. I would think it's not a big deal. They were so passive about me booking the wrong thing online. Nothing on their website stated to call or whatever and piercing changes etc-  "You could've just called us" and then she told the actual guy who was going to do the piercing change  that "she's actually getting her jewelry change even tho she booked a piercing" he was pissed and you could tell. I kept apologizing and said y'all can keep the $30, I'm so sorry. And they didn't even say "it's ok" he was like "well I guess we refund for the $30". With an annoyed tone. Sorry I didn't understand the process fully. They made it extremely uncomfortable. I wanted to walk out right then but I guess I was already there and I should just get it done. I wanted more piercings but I will not be going back. I get it's in the industry to be assholes. I hate that - though there's always the nice ones too. My whole body minus my neck and face has tattoos. But I don't understand why they had to be assholes about it. I hope they keep the $30. Not going back- and I suggest y'all find another place to go to.

I had my nails done today by Cindy.  I would highly recommend asking for her! She filled my nails perfectly!! Polish was smooth and super shiny! She was fast and gentle.  Cindy also did my
Pedicure last week and I am just so pleased with her and the nail spa.  Clean, fast, and sweet ! Win win!

The photographs looked nice, the reviews were good and I was hopeful after moving here and receiving two horrible, expensive manicures within a month. Alas, joy was not found at this place.

Let's start at the front desk: The good news is the gentleman has a mask on. The bad news is the mask plus his accent rendered him incomprehensible. I had to ask him to repeat everything he said at least once.

Then I'm seated in a big chair for a pedicure with a lovely lady who cannot understand English. After about 10 minutes I asked if the manicurist would be here soon. She just smiled and shook her head. At least she didn't hurt me like the manicurist did; in fact, her leg/foot rub was so short and light I barely realized I was getting it. My first husband was like that.

The manicurist finally comes running over like he's late and he never slows down -- every move he made was more about winning a speed contest than making the client -- me -- feel relaxed. The first thing he did was pull out a drill, when I had specifically asked when making the appointment that my gels be soaked off. I had to say it four times before the front desk guy came over and took off the gel polish with a nail file. There never was any soak off.

He then starts jabbing at my cuticles, filed both my nails and my skin and I now have the dorkiest looking nails ever. He topped off the show by giving me a hand/arm massage that should've been in a Marx Brothers movie, with Groucho giving an exaggerated speed rub.

Honestly ladies, if you book here, you deserve to lose your money.

I have heard this is a good restaurant over a year ago.  I went there for dinner tonight.  I had Pad Thai with chicken.  It was seasoned excellently and was fresh.  The chicken was good and the portion was decent.  My server was Salina and she was very attentive.  

I had a Bud Light with my dinner.  The experience was wonderful and I will be back again.

Went there with our kids on New Years Day to go take the our kids bowling for the first time ever. Wait time for bowling was 1 hour 45 minutes, which we expected. Kids were hungry so we figured we get dinner before bowling since we had time. We were seated in the restaurant area promptly, given menus and were completely ignored for over 20 minutes. Finally we got up and left with our kids crying because they were hangry. Ended up walking over to a fast food place and made it back just in time for our bowling. Lane side the service was very prompt and our server was friendly. While I like Big Al's overall, the service in the restaurant was severely lacking that day.

Wouldn't recommend. The nail tech Julie kept cutting my toe nails. I asked to do the regular cut & file yet she just kept cutting them. At one point I asked if she was going to file them straight since they were so off, instead she cut them again. I ended up filing them myself a little in the chair but there was no hope. They were too short to where my toes are super sensitive & sore. Also I'm worried one is going to get infected she trimmed into my skin so deep. I left embarrassed by my toes. I mentioned it to the desk girl & she said I should have said what I wanted when I clearly did.

I've been going to look at me lash lounge for about 8 months, up until recently. I really liked them at first, and was always happy with my lashes. I went in for my appointment a couple months ago and was told they have changed their adhesive. He did my fill, and within 24 hours half of my lashes had fallen out. I had to work out of town that week, so I called when I got back to let him know they had been falling off. He scheduled me in a week later. By this time, I had nearly no lashes. I arrived for my fill appointment, and could not believe the response I got from him. Asking me what I did differently? Like it was my fault? He seemed very annoyed at me because HE choose a different adhesive that didn't work. I have had eyelash extensions for awhile, I know how to care for them. Don't blame your customers for your incompetence! Very rude. I won't be back.

Thai food has to be in my top three favorite kinds of food and Sa-Wad-Dee did not disappoint. All the classic dishes available plus some really cool chef specialties. We started with the fried zucchini which was good not great, but then our dishes arrived and we were blown away. The basil duck and jungle salmon were phenomenal which lots of veggies, tender meat, and a perfect amount of spicy (we love spicy food so we get medium). Highly recommend this spot - I'll definitely be coming more often.

What an absolute little gem! I love this restaurants atmosphere and style. It looks like a cool European bakery, I can't wait to be able to go in and eat there! our empanadas were to go, we received instructions on how to heat them so they were fresh and all of them were delicious; even the Vegan curry!! So good!
Great sandwich! Trevor special was delicious and I loved the potato salad. Looking forward to trying more sandwiches

Went to big Al's a few years ago and loved it. Fast forward to present day, went back expecting the same great experience, and it was very crowded, and someone was blatantly smoking weed inside the upstairs portion! The restaurant is very good, and the prize store is awesome. Games are fun, a few of them were not working and some of the ones we wanted to play had too many people waiting to play them and we couldn't get to them.
This is one of the best Vietnamese restaurants I have been to. Most authentic place and the Pho' is delicious!!!

Just amazing burgers! My favorite is the Bison burger with extra patty and habanero. And of course, you're in Idaho so the fries are the bomb!!

I always come here when I visit Boise or Meridian!
Terrible service!! Lazy and don't want to fix there mistakes. I don't recommend this one to anyone
Favorite place in meridian. Fried chicken # 4 taco is delicious along with the chips and queso. Staff is always nice and the order comes out quick

Love this park and the kiddos sure do as well! It's very new and you can tell a lot of work was put into it. It's very well maintained all around. There are nice facilities available as well for when that 4:00 PM cup of joe begins to make it way through you and your kids are relentless on leaving.

I don't know why I waste my taste buds on eating sad, bland sandwiches sometimes.. (I guess mostly for convenience) but after coming here, why would I ever go back to that when I can get tasty, filling, hearty sandwiches here!! First of all their menu is EXTENSIVE. I could've spent half an hour trying to decide what I wanted since they all looked great, but  I ended up ordering the rockaway (and didn't let my eyes linger on the menu any longer before I changed my mind). My friends ordered the mountain man, and turkey club. When the food came out, all the sandwiches looked amazing. They stack the deli meat way high, and stuff the other ingredients but like super neat and tidy? It was impressive. The herb mayo and roast beef on the rockaway were actually memorable... it was so good. After I ate half, I was already starting to get full -- but my sandwich just looked so amazing and I knew that I could not let it go to waste or risk eating it many hours later. So of course I devoured the whole thing and had no regrets. I was in a bit of a food coma, but it was worth it.

The sandwiches aren't unreasonably priced at all, especially considering the size, and each sandwich comes with your choice of potato salad, cole slaw, or a bag of chips. I will say the potato salad is different and not your typical bbq light yellowy potato salad. the potatoes are more "raw" (not as mushy/boiled) and tossed in a much lighter (less creamy) dressing. It seems like healthier alternative to your typical potato salad, and while I didn't dislike it, I can see how others may not be a fan. Didn't end up finishing it but that was because I was already stuffed. Next time I'll probably go with the cole slaw mostly because I was already so full, haha.

Even though this is out of the way from my hotel (traveling for work), I definitely plan to come back! My mantra: no more sad sandwiches!! (and salads while we're at it)

After being told I would need to wait at least two weeks to get a replacement filling, I called them up and they gave me a same day appointment!  Additionally, they have a 3D printed so instead of giving me just a filling, they were able to give me the crowns I needed for my teeth on the same day! I was in and out in just over 3 hours with a months worth of work done! No waiting for crowns to show up, no hassle, and nothing but awesome service. They give you glasses, headphones, and have TVs in the ceilings as an added bonus. If I ever come back to Meridian, they will absolutely be my first choice. I've been to countless dentists and these guys are my new first choice.

I have visited 2 of the 4 locations they have. I am not a fan of needing to make an appointment but I was so tired of the maybe good, may be bad haircuts from those that do not have appointments. In addition, when a place is busy enough to make appointments you have to ask yourself why. I tried Craftsman once as a walk in, then signed up for month to month and now am a yearly member. I don't mind the appointments and I have had to cancel a couple times because I could not get away. But it is well worth it. It is not just a great haircut, I actually get complements. The conversation is great, atmosphere is very comfortable and they stock diet Dew. I recommend it to anyone, just test it out if you are tired of the maybe good, maybe bad haircuts like I was getting.

Got invited last minute by another couple for dinner on Friday night made a call to grants and they said half hour wait. By the time we got there we were seated immediately. We've been here one other time a couple years ago, this place is great! Fresh food chef designed well thought Menu, very Will final choices. This place sits on the end of a little strip mall in West Meridian on Cherry Lane. Not a lot of seating, summer time they open up the patio and there's lots of room there.

I normally love this restaurant because it is simple but I am not sure what they did to their churros tonight. We ate them within 20 minutes of pickup and they were so hard.  Sad end to our yummy taco dinner.

I got the Titanium Package detail on my seven year old Mercedes. The paint came out looking like brand new, other than a few scratches and marks that aren't going to buff out. I looked over the entire car under my garage lights and the paint was like glass.

The reason for four stars instead of five is that the Titanium Package is supposed to include a light engine cleaning and it was obvious that they didn't do that.

Update - the owner called me within an hour or so of seeing the review to apologize and offered to get the engine detail taken care of. I definitely would be taking my car back anyway, and would have mentioned it at that point, but the follow-up called earned an upgrade to five stars!
Den of theives capitalizing on peoples needs thru high interest rates and disregard to any kind of history a customer(the sucker) may have with this company. Run from this place.

Two words:  Fried Okra!  If the rest of the food was terrible, I would still eat here for the Okra.  The good news is everything on the menu is at least very good, sauces excellent, service ditto.  Only quibble is the price, which considering you serve yourself, is a bit high.  But hey - fried okra.
Favorite Thai restaurant in town.  Great noodle dishes and always friendly and helpful servers.  Go eat and enjoy.....

This review is from a month ago... I'm only giving a two star rating for the lone bartender's service and the big TVs. The last time we were here was about one year ago during the start of football season. We haven't been back because of our prior experience of poor service and poor food. We decided to try it out tonight because the Seahawks were playing and their TVs are awesome!

We arrive and see the signs at the hostess stand that say "please seat yourself" and "order food and drinks at the bar." We get a table without a problem about 20 minutes before the game. The bartender served dozens of guests ordering food and drinks from the bar. There were tables of up to 8 people and the dining area in the lower section of the bar was full, approximately 40 people, by the start of the game. This is an extremely poor concept for a restaurant of this size, even with COVID being present. After standing in line for 10 minutes for a beer, I asked the bartender why there wasn't another bartender helping him. He said it's only busy because the Seahawks are playing and management must've overlooked the game... This is unacceptable. Another man, maybe the bartender from the bowling alley or the manager, comes to the restaurant bar and pours a shot for a guest who wasn't in line. The employee takes the guest's payment and leaves the line of guests who are waiting to order. It's odd that the manager isn't helping the bartender serve guests and get through the line quicker.

Our first food dish arrives in maybe 10 minutes, which is great. We ordered spinach artichoke dip. It came lukewarm and was cold in the middle. When I asked the employee who delivered it to warm it up, she brought a new one that was the same temperature. The spinach artichoke dip tasted great but the fact that it was cold was disappointing. We also ordered a pizza. The bartender let me know when I ordered the specialty pizza with several toppings that it would end up being a $40 pizza because he has to enter each $1.50-$2.50 topping in when placing the order. That is beyond ridiculous! I'm thankful he told us it would end up costing that amount because $40 for a pizza is absurd. We ordered a personalized pizza with 4 toppings, which ended up being $30. It arrived hot but it was not good. The crust was very greasy; you needed a fork to eat it if you didn't want your hand dripping with grease. We were fed up by this point to complain about the food again.

It's unfortunate Big Al's isn't operating with better management. This place has great potential with the atmosphere (big TVs, comfortable seating) and one dedicated employee - the bartender, Richie!

This is the absolute worst habit burger. I have grown up in an area with multiple habit burgers and eaten at them my whole life at least 3-4 time a month. Since moving to Eagle we have given this location opportunity after opportunity. The food is either burned or they treat you like absolute shit. We brought my father in law in because he likes milkshakes and the girl working the cash register straight up told him "no." When he asked for a shake (mind you there were probably ten shakes sitting on the counter). He said "I'm sorry why not? There are shakes right there on the counter." She says "we're too busy to make you a shake." WHAT THE HELL YOU NEVER SAY THAT TO A CUSTOMER. Then the manager tells one of the workers to get working because "people are looking at them like they're retarded." Yes she really said that. Then the food came out burned and we waited for 50 minutes. We will never be returning ever again. I would rather eat at McDonald's than this piece of shit location. Would be a zero star if I could because one star is way more than this place deserves. Absolute shit show with terrible management.

I really enjoy the hamburgers here.  You can select how you want your burger made and then pick the sauces or ketchup you want for the burger and fries.  They also have a selection of different kinds of fries.  I am not a fan of french fries, so I've not tried any of them.  The only negative comment I have is that there is very limited seating inside.  So I usually try to stop here in the off-hours when they are not so busy.

Disappointing...I went in wanting it to be better than it was.  I ordered online and actually showed up ten minutes after when the food was supposed to be done because of traffic.  I ended up waiting another 15 minutes before getting my food.  While waiting I noticed there was only one person cooking and another person greeting and working the register.  After waiting ten minutes two other employees showed from the back and started helping out and things got rolling.  If the food had been right it would have been worth the wait, but things were missing off the burgers and they were overcooked.  The to go sauce containers need to be bigger.  Those tiny cups don't cut it.  You can barely dip a fry.  The food has great potential, just needs that step up.

I was visiting from out-of-town and normally enjoy the Dickey's near my home.  We ordered the XL family pack (serves 8) to be delivered. The order arrived promptly, however there were a few errors. It was missing the waffle fries, onions, and pickles. The sliced beef brisket came chopped and the amount of bbq sauce would serve maybe two people, not 8. We contacted the store immediately and was transferred to a manager. The manager placed me on hold to "verify" what I was telling him. (?)  He then asked if I could come pick up the missing items. I said "no" as we had out-of-town relatives. He told me they could not send another delivery out. He hesitantly offered to refund the cost of the fries.
 
Note to manager:  When your business makes an error like this, FIRST, you apologize, instead of making the customer feel bad. SECOND, if you can't make it right at that time, you offer some sort of consolation, such as, "Hey, I'm so sorry, we'll refund the cost of your items missing, but we value your business, so I'm going to leave an envelope here with your name on it and it will have XYZ freebies or coupons for your next visit. Again, I'm sorry we failed on this experience for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with?"  

Dickey's Meridian, you lost 6 customers (and many more referrals) that day.

Update: My credit card reflects a $5.00 credit from Dickey's. I was charged $5.00 for the delivery!  And I gave almost triple that to the delivery driver as a tip!

If your assigned Nail Tech boasts about how high quality their Gel Polishes are, you would expect the outcome to be high quality as well. 

I gave 2 stars because the service was lovely, however the results were not. The Gel Polish looks very "chunky".

I was very disappointed with Dr Brooks. I was in for an overall check and wasn't even given time to change all the way. Her and her assistant came in without warning, which left me scrambling to get my gown on. I don't feel that I am overly modest but it is uncomfortable to have two strangers watch you get undressed. The entire appointment the Doctor did not smile once, or really say much to me at all. When I had a question about a lesion that I had noticed and asked her about it,  she told me what she thought it was but gave no further explanation. After she checked my front side she instructed me to turn over onto my stomach (which is awkward to do while laying on an exam table) The Dr made no attempt to try to help me at all so that my rear end wasn't hanging out while I tried to turn over. Now I know that she is doing an exam and will have to check my entire body but she could at least help instead of watching the patient struggle as they flip over. Again, she just watched and didn't say a word. The only time she really spoke was to her assistant while she noted any lesions present. Honestly, this is probably the worst experience I that I have ever had with any provider. On that note, her staff was great. Everyone else in the office was very friendly

About three months ago, our family sat in the auditorium at Rocky Mountain High School and one of the coaches said, " Go see the team at Fleet Feet, for you kiddos needs."   

I repeated, "Fleet Feet" and "The Village in Meridian" several times over trying to remember where I had saw where they were located as being a frequent visitor to The Village, I must have passed it several if not 10 times over but for the life of me I couldn't recall where it was situated. 

That weekend, I parked the car on the outskirts of the Boise Coop and walked over to The Village, ( Hey, steps are great.) 

Fleet Feet is located on the side between both avenues and if you're thinking that all of this is completely useless, ha! you're in for a surprise. 

I, too, was skeptical walking into a runner's store after spending time in big-box retailers, factory stores, Amazon and the rest but Fleet Feet is different and it's different in the following ways. 


(1) Alex and the team are simply phenomenal. They care about each and every person who walks in.  I've been there three times, and each  time Alex, Austin, and/or anyone of the team greets me by  name and asks about how we're doing like we've been out-of-touch friends. 


(2) The time that each of the staff spends with you, getting to know you and what you're looking for is genuine.  They're not doing this to up-sell you or empty your wallets.  They truly want you to feel better and for your feet to feel fantastic.  They are experts in the field.  They know running, exercising,  jogging, running, track and field and more. 

(3) There are sizes and styles for everyone.  Plus there are all sorts of gadgets, and accessories.   

(4)  The prices are not crazy expensive. Think about being on your feet 8-10 hours a day for 7 days a week, 52 weeks a year. Do you really believe that the comfortableness or the pain is worth not investing in your feet?

Hey, I'm tight on my budget but while you can get the same selection of shoes on Amazon for essentially a 1 or 2 less, you're not getting the information and care that your feet need. I can assure you  that Alex and his team will empty the store shelves to find the right shoe for you.  I am believer and I am so thankful to have had the opportunity to listen to the coach all those months back. My son and my wife both are better because of Fleet Feet.
Sooo good! We did takeout on fried rice, chicken pho and chow menu... and it was amazing! Seriously not one bad item!

Always an enjoyable meal. I ordered the regular char burger with cheese and tempura green beans which are my favorite.  I must say the line was out the door but still once we placed our order we received our food in a reasonable amount of time. I think this is my favorite place for a decently priced and tasty burger.

M Vince Nail Spa always has an appointment available when I need it.  Their techs are quick, efficient and do quality work.  I'm very pleased with this salon.  Parking can be challenging, but worth it. Two thumbs up!

Spent $30 (top of the line option) for a car that is *covered* in spots. I'm honestly pretty pissed-- I don't usually splurge on the most expensive option at these places, and usually end up with a much better result. Won't come back here, recommend you don't either.
I think I found my new nail nail salon, $30 for an amazing pedicure & they were so accommodating.

It was a dark and quiet morning.  5:00 am, and nothing is moving in Meridian, Idaho.  Slowly and silently, a quiet Yelp reviewer and his wife pull into the parking lot, desiring coffee before heading down the road for a long road trip.  Suddenly, and without warning, a bold red light becomes visible out of the corner of his eye.  "What can this be?", he gasps.  There are red letters for "DK" shining forth, followed by the invitation "Donuts".  They feel the draw of the words; They can detect the scent of baked goods wafting in the soft morning air;  The donuts call to them...  They can not resist...  They partake.  It is good.

Summary:  Perhaps the best donuts in the treasure valley.
Read it.  Learn it.  Live it.


==========true story==========
Me: "Someone told me you look like an Owl."
Wife:  "Really?  Who?"
Me: "Nailed it!"
This store is awesome.  Really nice quality furniture.  The staff was very helpful and nice.

If you're in a tight spot and need money at any cost, this place is good enough but you will definitely pay for it. I unfortunately let my credit score slip and needed to purchase a new vehicle for a new position I was offered. This place was the only one that would step up, but are charging me 30% interest...yeah, I know. I have been paying the loan off without fail for the last 4 years (never missed a payment) so the last time I was in the guy tried to get me to take out more money (at the same interest rate) since my account was in "excellent" standing. However, they wouldn't adjust the interest rate even though I had never missed a payment in 4 years...because they had to treat everyone within the same "parameters". Long story short...don't look for anyone to go above and beyond for you here, the almighty dollar is their bottom line...nothing else.
Love this place, so much fresh baked goodies to choose from. I had the turkey and cranberry croissant sandwich and a sour cream brownie. Both super delicious! Friendly staff too.

I really like this neighborhood gym. The equipment is in good shape and it's a very clean facility. The staff is always cleaning! While it is very small, I've lucked out when I go and I haven't had to wait for cardio machines. I will say, and this frustrates me to no end, that I have had to wait for weight machines. Men, this is for you, USE ONE MACHINE AT A TIME! Consistently, when I use the weight machines I have about 2 men using the circuit at the same time. They bounce around on multiple machines and intimidate the women out of using them. They have their settings adjusted and do not like people disrupting their routine. Your ass can only sit on one machine at a time! Finish your sets and move to the next. This is extremely frustrating! I had a guy today run up to the machine I was going to use and said "Wait! Can I do one more set?" Fully intending to run back to the machine he just got off of. I REALLY wish there was signage in there to discourage this behavior. This gym belongs to each member equally, so next time, my answer will be "after I finish mine."
Other than that, I love it there!
Wasn't sure what to expect but man I was happy when I left. Meat was juice, veggies seemed fresh and everyone was so excited for me to try the food. Very glad I did and you will be too.
Yum yum. Breakfast tacos and mimosas one of the best ways to start a day. Typically super speedy on getting orders ready.

In the words of my husband... "This is waaaaay better than Jimmy Johns!!"  And that's saying a lot.  He's a big fan of The Italian #6.  I ordered the California Turkey Club #2 and it was so big I could only eat half (my husband enjoyed the other half for dinner).  I usually don't order sandwiches with bacon; however, I was pleasantly surprised with the well done bacon on my sandwich and it was delicious!  I also made a couple tweaks to the original sandwich and I highly recommend the pesto mayo.

We called in our order and it was ready when I got there.  The staff was extremely polite and helpful and they got me out the door quickly.  Next time we will dine in... It was very clean and you get unlimited drinks while you're there.
They provided fast, quality service at a price much cheaper than anywhere else. I broke my Surface screen, and they fixed it in an hour for $200 less than Microsoft. I definitely recommend them!
Very nice salon, excellent service. We had an appt, and there was actually no waiting which is a huge plus for me. I got a full set and a pedicure and both were great!

Two weeks in a row we have had horrible service... last week they gave us a medium pizza in a large box (we ordered large) and this week their own website identified my location and yet somehow the system misspelled my address and phone number... but the entire time their own tracking system said my order was en route and even provided a count down.  When I complain via email the manager knew exactly what was going on and yet hadn't contacted me via that email? He knew my name and that there was a problem but waited for me to email him... DO NOT ORDER from here. If something goes wrong they will say it's your fault.

Terrible experience! They were very rude. They cared more about their subway sandwiches than helping out a customer. The couches were disgustingly dirty. They told me that I could wipe them off... myself?? They were not friendly AT ALL. Very rude. I would ask for help and they would walk away and start eating their food when I still had questions about the couches. I DO NOT recommend this place. Terrible selection and not worth the gas or time to even waste your time there.
Nice people. I had Vermicelli with pork.  Delicious. I'll be back on regular basis. . They are new to this location. If you like Phó try them out.

I have been here several times and I have been holding off to write a review.  I have always had excellent customer service here.  Even though dated in the interior, it gives off an old school Mexican style environment and it fits.  They have recently opened up a new section of restaurant which is newer which consists of booths, tables and bar area, it is really nice.

In regards to the food, it doesn't warrant the price.  I have been coming here for years and there have been some recent price hikes that just don't make this place worth it.  I used to order a dish that was about $15 and within the last couple years it is now close to $20.  My wife always gets their Mexican pizzas and there has been a small price increase but the portion size has gotten drastically smaller.  I know our valley is in need of great Mexican food but there are better Mexican restaurants in the valley.  I know there are several Fiestas in the valley and they tend to be different in quality.  I do enjoy the one in Kuna more than this location.

As mentioned, always great service and fun place to hang out but would love to see their quality of food and prices get better.

Wow. I was the first customer when they opened today (April 11, 2021) . The store looked like what you would expect on Black Friday, like it had been hit by a cyclone. There were stacks upon stacks of clothes on tables that were strewn about, unfolded. Hangars and other trash scattered all over the store. Dirt and dust bunnies all over. Frankly it was disgusting. I really hope a DM or secret shopper visits this store unannounced and sees for him/herself what a mess this place is. What a shame. I spent 5 minutes in the store and walked out. Can't blame Covid on this disaster.

Savannah did an amazing job with my hair!! I had long hair to my mid back and wanted to chop it all off. She gave me the haircut I've been wanting for years!!! The salon is so gorgeous, too! Their Mr Smith products smell amazing. All the girls were so nice and welcoming. 10/10 would recommend!

Reviewer number 110. 
My Yelp review of Kneaders Bakery and Cafe from my visit on September 25, 2017 about 2 PM. I was referred to this place by one of my Yelp Besties, and overall amazing person, Yulia N. when I asked for her opinion on the best dessert place in town to take my mommy to when she was in town. 

Service: 3/5
Food: 3/5
Price for value: 3/5
Bariatrics/Healthy Options: 3.5/5 
Community involvement/charity: 5/5
Overall stars for this establishment, for me, is 4 and here's why:

They have a nice sized brick and mortar location on Eagle, which is conveniently located. There is ample parking and that have a drive thru, too. When one walks they're greeted with a home-style warmth feeling. I, personally, feel like I am in a craft or scrapbooking store. The ambiance exudes memories and heartwarming love. I like that. Once you approach the ordering area you are overwhelmed (in a good way) by the pastries and fresh breads on shelves and the cold case in front of you. The menu is high up on the wall, which allows a clear view. They give back to the community and seem to be wholeheartedly genuinely nice people with a positive message (the owners).  

The staff were friendly people, not extra friendly, but mildly friendly. The counter service could have explained more but a teen checked me out--I have three teens. I know how hard it is to get them to do extra... 

The food seemed to be made fresh. I ordered a chicken salad. It came with fresh croutons on them. I thought I would like that, but there was absolutely no flavor and I just tossed them out. The salad was nice in size and fair value at $6 for  1/2 salad. I asked for extra ranch and was given a total of 3. I didn't need that many, so I took them home and put em in the fridge for later. My dining companion, George, got a sandwich and he liked it. There was a good amount of "guts" and had a fresh taste, but nothing extra special. I did purchase a coffee and they were out--totally okay being 2 pm, but the time that we left about 20 minutes later, the requested coffee still wasn't available. I ended up getting iced tea in my coffee cup, which is my only complaint.  There are many sandwich and soup options for you to choose from. 

We DID NOT try any deserts. I did buy my daughters elephant cookies and ALL of the proceeds go to support childhood cancer, which is an amazingly good cause. This warmed my heart to see this and the love that was put into each cookie is evident. The girls thought the cookies were "cute" and too cute to eat, but I haven't seen them around anywhere so I think they were eaten! 

There are gift baskets all around with fresh baked goods. This seems to be a good gift concept, especially when visiting someone's home, or someone that's been ill. You can get all sorts of baked goods, jelly and jams, and nuts among others. It's an easy gift idea--in and out in minutes with a gift in hand as you eat some yummy goodness along the way. You can even go through the drive thru! 

Healthy living--Lots of healthy options and portions to maintain a healthy lifestyle even with the yummy goodness lurking in every corner. You can get soup, or a breadless sandwich, or a salad. The food is fresh and uses quality ingredients.

Well, thanks for reading! I hope you're having a good day whenever you read this!!! Leave a comment and say HI! Would love to know your thoughts on Kneaders!

We had been putting off planning our estate for years and then our financial planner put it on our checklist to do. He recommended Justin and we hit the jackpot! He made us feel comfortable and was very professional in what can be a very emotional process. Put us at ease from the beginning and answered every question. We are so happy with his service and feel much more secure with our future. We have already recommended him to several of our friends. So comforting to know that he is there if we should need him.

I ordered a bicycle table that was advertised over a month ago. I called today to ask where it was and I was told they delivered it to the wrong house so they switched it out but now they can't find it. I received no calls and no updates. This is the first and last time I ever order from them.

Cute little backers, friendly people. All of the treats looked super yummy, but we went in for coffee while we waited to get in to Yo Momma's for breakfast next door. 

The people were super sweet. I wish I'd gotten a treat, but all I can rate them on, "food-wise," is the coffee. I got a cappuccino with an add-shot, and it was soooooo bad. Like coffee water. I couldn't even drink it. I decided right then and. There that is just stick to starbucks for coffee in Idaho, and I'm not even a Starbucks person. 

So I'd skip the coffee, unless you're in middle school and just starting to dip your toe into the coffee world, and stick to a cinnamon roll there. I can tell l, just by looking, that those were good!

As a teenager, I attended MVHS the highschool across the street and I'm devastated that I never tried this place! Now as an adult, my husband(who also attended but never went) and I decided to try it out and it didn't disappoint! Jason was the gentleman who served us and gave us a run down of the restaurant which we appreciated so much! 

Pros: 
* They don't call it the Boise Fry Co for nothing!! The yam fries and the russet regulars were so dang good! I love how they cook fresh to order them as well! I would always wait for potatoes to be cooked fresh, as they should be! 
* The multiple choices of protein was so fun! My husband tried Bison for the first time because we enjoyed something new and foreign to us! He really liked it!
* my husband tried one of their lagers on tap and liked that too! It was just a simple beer not the sweet one.
* Lastly, the sauce and salt bar! FANTASTIC!! I would apply the maple marshmallow sauce as lotion if it was socially acceptable and wouldn't make me gain twenty pounds, lol. But seriously, that sauce on not only the yam fries but salted russets, tastes like you're dipping your fries in ice cream! YUM!!

Cons: 
* Speaking of sauces, I would 1000% replace the jalapeño ranch with a plain Buffalo sauce! Both my husband and I didn't like the jalapeño ranch and felt like the only thing that was missing was a Buffalo sauce!
* My husband and I both kinda agreed that the burgers were okay. Not amazing, not the worst but nothing to write home about. 

Overall, great customer service around 5:30pm on Black Friday!!

Horrible. Lies and rudeness. Dezuray or whatever the fuck her name was said they had the fan my wife wanted in stock because our online order wasn't going through. She straight up lied that they had it and we called another store. Just as horrible service. Go fuck yourselves Walmart employees.

Always love the staff. They treat my dog like she's is their own and I'm so thankful for their kindness and awesome work. We've been active members of splash and dash for a couple of years and have recommended them to many friends. My dog always comes home happy and looking pretty. Love them!
Authentic Argentine cuisine with a personal touch. Great unique wine selection and friendly staff. A little known place that you must try!

https://www.facebook.com/kandisharaee.fowler/videos/617110482633304/

No dog should be crying while getting their hair brushed. He obviously is in pain as he is flinching. while she is handling him so rough. This is hard to watch and no one should bring their dogs here.

Tiffany did an amazing job on my nails. I asked for a pink and white ombré for my wedding and she exceeded my expectations. Everyone was so nice and professional! I also got a pedicure and it was so relaxing and my technician was very pleasant. I will definitely be back and I highly recommend this spa

I don't normally write reviews, but after today's experience with Indepth Detailing, I had to. Rob arrived at my home on time and went right to work on the car. First washing it, then de-contaminating it. He took the time to get all the pollen & sap off the car before moving on to polishing the car.  
My car is black and shows every little scratch & swirl in the clear coat. Initially this was to be a 4 hour job. Rob took the time to do it right, even if it meant staying longer to get it done correctly. He takes a lot of pride in his work and doing things the right way, without short cuts. Visiting with Rob was nice as he is very positive and helpful with tips to keep the car looking good. WAY better than the drive up car wash / detail shops.
If you need your car polished, these are the guys to call. With them you are not a number or just another car - they take the time to do things right. A++++

I love Chef Wally, I love the staff, and I LOVE the sandwiches. My favorite is the Silver Duck but there really are so many delicious sandwiches it took me a while to decide. I love that they use high quality ingredients and they don't skimp on the amount of product they use. There's always LOTS of meat and plenty of sauce. On my favorite sandwich they put lots of sprouts on it. I love that and I notice that other places barely give you any, even if you ask for extra. I definitely recommend trying this place and I would bring my friends and family here. Do keep in mind that they get really busy during lunch time so it's best to go in before noon.

My windshield got destroyed from a rock flying off a truck on an entrance ramp and then two more rocks hitting it on overland in a construction zone. At this point it wasn't drivable! Tyler got me on the schedule as soon as he could and did an amazing job replacing my windshield! He was fast and super nice. I highly recommend him!

Giving one star because giving zero stars isn't allowed.  Ordered lunch via DoorDash from this place - got the message, your order has been received.  Got the message from the Dasher that he was there waiting for the order.  45 minutes after I initially placed the order, I got a message from the Dasher (not the restaurant) saying "we're out of croissants, would you like to make a substitution."  This was at 1230 on a weekday.  Disappointed with all this, I cancelled the order.  But wait, there's more!  Checking my credit card later, I found that Kneaders had charged me for the entire order and never provided a refund after my cancellation.  So now I'm wasting more time disputing the charge (it was lunch for 4 people, over $50).  With this level of customer service you may not want to risk patronizing this place.  At any rate if you want a croissant at noon on a weekday, try another option.

If your looking for a great sandwich Fat Guy's is the place to go. The customer service is always exceptional and they are always willing to help in their vast knowledge of the menu. The menu is amazing you'll never see a menu like it, the combinations are so good. If I had to chose on sandwich it'd be the Trevor Melt hands down the best sandwich I've ever had!! This is a place you have to go too if your in the area.

I'm so glad some people are showing good sense and realize a mask  
benefits all of us ,I've had both shots but still like to wear one ,heads up to the owners. Of Heritage Reflections

The food was good, although they were out of gluten free buns. But couldn't get past the lack of cleanliness in the kitchen area, the bathrooms, and even the door that exits to the outdoor eating area. If I was the owner of this place I would never let it get this bad, but I certainly would make sure it got cleaned up! Come on, you serve good food, make it seem like you aren't eating in a pigsty!  Especially with COVID, everyone is more aware of cleanliness.

It feels weird being the first person to not write a stellar review. It looks like (and from my experience) if I had had Dr Guymon the entire time, I would have also left a 5 star review. Instead, I had the pleasure of dealing with Dr. Morris for my retainer fitting. That man has no business dealing with people, let alone children. 

I contacted Guymon Orthondotics after my retainer of 12 years broke. It contains two of my front teeth, and one of the teeth broke off, so I fixed it temporarily with superglue. The initial visit went well...I wasn't actually seen by the doctor (not sure which one it was), for 45 minutes after my appointment time, but I guess that's to be expected. Once they took the mold for my retainer, I was in and out.

When I came back a week later, the assistant showed me my new retainer, and immediately I knew there was a problem. My old one (and my new current one, once they fixed it), has very little metal. This is something I have in my mouth all day. I eat with it, drink with it, talk with it, etc. It is very much apart of my mouth. It appeared that the people who made this first one assumed it was something that didn't need to be worn all the time (with the two front teeth attached...not sure how they came to that conclusion). I expressed my concerns to the assistant, who was incredibly sweet, but in the end had not control over the situation. 

Then comes in Dr. Morris. The assistant and myself relayed my concerns about the metal clasps that were essentially over my back teeth with this retainer, and Dr. Morris just brushed me off. I tried the retainer on, and expressed my concern that my left side teeth were hitting the retainer and it was uncomfortable. He took a glance inside my mouth and told me I was wrong, that the retainer was fine. Look dude, I've had metal in my mouth since I was 7 (now 30), I know what should feel right, and that wasn't it. This is also just one of 4 retainers I have in my mouth at any given time (2 permanent, 1 I wear and night, and this one) so I know what to expect. When I told him I was also worried about food getting stuck in the extra metal pieces, he told me I shouldn't eat with it in, and to take it out. Um, my TEETH are on this thing!!! Do you think I should just remover my teeth whenever I go out to dinner?!?!? Ass. He then left, and I continued to express my concerns with the assistant. We discussed me trying the retainer for a week to see if it would really work or not, and then if I could come back to get it adjusted if it wasn't a good fit. During this conversation, Dr. Morris came back, picked up my new retainer and proceeded to break off the metal on the left side. He then threw it down on the table and left, with a snide comment about how "now it's the way you want it". Never being in a situation with such an aggressive doctor, and for some reason doubting myself, I tried it again, and sure enough, now the whole thing was unstable. 

Due to his treatment, I found myself embarrassed and in tears in the office. fortunately, many of the other ladies working decided to help me, and they took control of the situation and talked with me about how to make the retainer comfortable and practical. They spent time to take pictures and another mold. From there, they ordered the correct retainer.

I came back a week later, making sure my appointment was NOT with Dr. Morris. And Dr. Guymon helped fit me with my new retainer. He listened, when I told him my tooth was hitting the right side this time, adjusted the metal, and poof! Retainer fit perfectly. The new retainer looks amazing, and I am so happy with how my new teeth look. I just wish I had never had to deal with Dr. Morris.

Everyone else that I spoke to at Dr Guymons is amazing, sweet, kind, and understanding. Dr. Morris is a bully, and I hope any parents reading this will listen to their kids if they have a complaint about him. I would never let my child be touched or talked to by that man. He may have just not given a damn about me, since I was not going to be a long time braces client, but that is no excuse for his retched behavior. If I ever need help with a retainer again, I will try to go to Dr Guymon, but if I can't get an appointment with him, I will definitely find a new place to help me.

This store is awesome! A friend of mine told me about their furniture and I fell in love as soon as I walked in the door. Quality furniture like restoration hardware, dare I say better than pottery barn for fraction of the price. 

They have a great selection, so reasonably priced and the customer service is 10 stars! I love everything in that store! My brother was over recently and thought our couches were restoration hardware! He wants to buy them now. I said they are even better. We got the romy chairs  and cloud couches and they truly are like sitting on clouds! 

Bridgett in particular is so wonderful. She is so patient and knowledgeable. She helped me put together and transform my entire living room. I have her to thank for making our living room look so great! I have gotten so many compliments. She is so positive and fun to work with. I look forward to working with her again in the future when I tackle our bedroom furniture. The store is so lucky to have her! 

And go into the store instead of ordering online because I found that furniture like the Romy chairs say sold out online but you can order in the store. They were in back order but we got the cloud couches the following week which is unheard of right now especially!

Yo, so I walk in and am immediately greeted and asked if i want some thing to drink while I wait.  My barber, Ariel i believe, says, "I've got this one to finish and one after, then you're up, is that okay?" Its Friday, its busy, people get behind.  I'm cool with it.  Once I sit down, we talk about my haircut and she gets to it.  Good conversation (even though she's a Packer fan), and haircut was on point.  I scheduled just a haircut to feel it out but I'll be signing up for a membership.  Great job.  The only reason its four stars is because I'm a stingy bastard that has never given five.

BUYER BEWARE !!! 2 weeks in a row, these people either sold or gave away items that I was high bid for. So just because you think you won & they e-mail you an invoice,(YOU MIGHT NOT HAVE WON) You won't know until you get there. So I guess, you don't have to pay for what you take. Pay for something cheap, and after you get there, Pick out what ever you want!!! Nice people, BUT very incompetent and unprofessional.
Heard about this place through Facebook.   What a large selection.  Teas from all over the world, tester stations, great atmosphere.  I will be coming back.

I went to the Meridian office, the people that work here are the best.  They are all so sweet and took such good care of me.  Dr. Story is the best.  After my procedure, he came out promptly and explained everything.  They even gave me a call to follow up and see if I was ok.  That is the kind of care I'm talking about!!

First (and only visit) went in for new patient special ($95) which included X-rays, exam, cleaning.  I was advised to get the "deep cleaning" which cost more...$53 MORE and it was anything but a deep cleaning and my teeth were not even polished inside and out like any hygienist does on a normal cleaning, teeth weren't even flossed afterword.  Dr. Williams advised lots of work after seeing my X-rays and when I went to pay my $148 cleaning fee, the itemized cost of future work they recommended came to just under $7,000.  My former dentist did 8 crowns three years ago before I moved to Boise.  This dentist says I need 2 more crowns plus other work done. Another Boise dentist I saw just last year found none of the above other than a cavity.  I would equate this dentist and hygienist to "up-selling" and on par with used car salesmen tactics.

I am as nervous about leaving my baby as he is about me leaving him.  They are kind, listen to my request and have done a wonderful job.  They cut him as I asked...not as they think he should be cut.  They are prompt and he always gets an adorable bandana.
Amazing Mexican food! Their interior design is very cool and has an authentic Mexican style.

I've had the opportunity to buy a table and chairs, a bench, and a Pantry/Amour .
Very high-quality stuff, lasts a lifetime. Very ample inventory and many many beautiful selections, different woods different stains different pieces. If you really are looking for a statement piece of furniture to last a lifetime this is it.
Impeccable service and tasty drinks. A-aron really gave it his all. He was hilarious! Will definitely be back.

I ordered five double beef with brocalli and rice plates through Uber Eats tonight. The rice was so old and crunchy that it tasted like it had been left out overnight. There were only four small pieces of beef in my order. Avoid this location like the plague.

On Valentine's day we failed to make reservations anywhere, but decided to try the Ram since they didn't have a wait. I was actually pleasantly surprised by our meals. We had the parmesan crusted chicken and the chicken caesar salad. The parm crusted chicken was actually really good! The green beans and mashed potatoes were just okay. The salad was decent too. If we're ever in a pinch without reservations, I'd go back!

So disappointed! I have been driving by this location for over 3 months anticipating how wonderful the food will be. I went in yesterday morning ( 1/25/21) at 10 am.
