After waiting for a dark haired woman server ( who seemed happier talking to a guy at the counter than helping me) I placed a half order of eggs benedict and a side of the well known cowboy potatoes. When I received my soon to happily devour breakfast I couldn't wait to dig in! New place in Meridian, well known in Boise, had to be amazing. As I cut into me egg benedict, what, my egg wasn't a runny poached egg goodness! It was cooked, completely over cooked, not poached!!!  Super heavy cheese sauce. I love cheese sauce but this wasn't going to cover up my $ 9.45 overcooked egg! Ham was skimpy. Cowboy potatoes weren't mixed well but definitely flat as a pancake. Those were $5.95 as a side. $16.00 breakfast, a complained to my server about the egg. She didn't even offer to bring me a correctly made egg benedict. No " I am sorry",  No " let me have a new one made for you", no discount, nothing.  Not worth your time and the service I experienced made me feel more like a nuisance than a valued customer.

,

Excellent service and product! I had a wooden deck that was super old and rotted with the house I purchased. He tore that out and fixed me up a beautiful backyard patio, with color and decorative stamp work which looks SO amazing!

Mmmm, Mmmm! Love this place. They have a limited menu, so if you don't like burgers or fries, you will not find alternatives here. But if you do enjoy a well made burger and a mountain of fry choices, Boise Fry is the place for you!

I have been to every location in the Treasure Valley but this one is my favorite for its proximity to my humble abode. It is also spacious, and has an outside seating option. My favorite burger is the original. The red onion gastrique is so good. Sweet, a little sour and complementary to their many sauces. I always add a little bit of spicy ketchup to the garlic aioli. When I'm feeling well behaved, I leave out the bun (sob!) and get my burger and toppings on a bed of spring mix. Though devoid of carby heaven, I am always satisfied. It is actually my favorite burger in the valley. It tastes delicious but has a lighter quality that makes both my gluttonous heart and my delicate innards happy. 

Though I enjoy a good fry, I can't eat large quantities without feeling yucky. I like the fresh and diverse options here. Every person in our party will order something different and we will just share family style. My favorite is the Russet Curly. We did get shoe string once and they were painfully thin and almost a tad burnt tasting. But apparently I'm a 3 year old at heart, because I am here for the dips! They must have 10 different types of dips. My favorite is the Blueberry Ketchup. I don't know why. It's just delicious and it works.

The food is great and it would get 5 stars if it were just on the food - but we are in a pandemic. The social distancing needs some attention. They really need to consider closing some tables so there aren't too many people dining in at the same time.

Pretty good for a place that takes walk-ins. Some places they only talk to each other and not their clients. I don't mind keeping to myself but sometimes it's like they aren't even paying attention! My provider was very respectful and attentive. Massage length was indicated in the menu and she did an amazing job (I almost fell asleep!). And my toes are perfectly hot-pinked!

It's been years since I have been to a IHop. My husband and I went on the Fourth of July as it was pretty much the only close restaurant open.
Walking in to iHop was somewhat disappointing. The restaurant is dated. Needs updating. We were seated and our waiter was very good. Checked on us without being overly attentive. I ordered a chicken fajita omelet. My husband ordered two eggs over easy with pancakes with bacon. I will be honest, I was a little concerned about the food. .... Buy my omelet was delicious! I was impressed. My husband had no complaints!  I couldn't eat the whole omelet (it was a healthy portion). Needless to say, I did bring the remainder home.

As far as reubens go, this one is near the top. Just the right amount of sauce. Sauerkraut was just right. Bread was crispy, not soggy like a lot of reubens get. Definitely getting this again!!

4 starts because the milkshake was mediocre. Wouldn't get the shake again.
OH MY GOSH! So good!! 10/10. Baked empanadas that have so much flavor. YUM YUM YUM! We will be back soo good!

My wife and I wanted to try something different since we're new in the area. We ordered a medium garden pizza and a steak and cheese sandwich. Let me start with the sandwich, I seriously thought it was bread sticks! I kid you not! $10.99 sandwich that had little meat and cheese. SUBWAY would have been 10 times better for less. The pizza was so so and it needed to of been cooked longer. Not worth the $30 we paid. At least we gave it a try.

After 2 years of Marco's, I'm going to have to take off a star. The staff is still very friendly and accommodating. However, I have found a lot of inconsistency with wait times. Sometimes I will get an email that my order is done but when I go pick it up it's still in the oven. Then you're sitting there waiting and they don't tell you when it's done you have to keep getting up and asking. Also, we like "well-done" pizza which is an option, but the end product is never the same...ranging from very brown to barely any color at all. Other little things...side sauces not being provided, things available online when you order that aren't really available when you go get your order. 

We still love our Marcos and will continue to go there as our default. The pizza is tasty, the coupons are bountiful, and the people are nice. It's just that the attention to detail has fallen a little.
Gel manicure was done quickly and in such a clean and precise way. Definitely going back!
I ordered two bbq pull pork dinners. The pork was at least 75% fat. I will not order from Dickey's again.
Amazing Pho! My husband and I have been waiting for a place like this to open in Meridian. You will not be disappointed
Great food. Virtually all home made food. Try the bronco sandwich. A blue cheese lovers dream. Will go back regularly!!!!

Dr. Guymon is one of the nicest and friendliest Orthodontist I have met. His years of experience and expertise has helped with the treatment of our family.

Our experience with Dr. Guymon and his team has been the best. From the moment you walk in, you are greated with a warm, friendly, smiling face and will receive the best treatment.

I absolutely love this Walmart. Aside from the obvious reasons like low prices and the convenience of being a one stop shop, this location is the best!
The store is always clean and well stocked. The one thing that sets this store apart is the employees. From the second you walk into Walmart they make you feel like family. The main greeters on the market side entrance are Chuck & Kurt. The two of them are not only super funny & welcoming, but they take a few minutes to get to know you.  My family has really gotten to know Chuck during our Walmart visits and we just love him! Another great employee who works in the deli is Bailey. She is always super friendly and eager to help.  She is really quick at getting my meat and cheese sliced. Bailey always makes sure to put paper in between the slices of cheese to prevent them from sticking together.  She is an absolute asset to the store!! Then there's Tanya! I look at her as though she is the queen of the store.  She usually works in self checkout and is always helping people get through the line while being super friendly. Tanya is really funny and always has a joke to tell you. She also makes sure to tell everyone about the Walmart app & the savings catcher feature.  
I can't say enough about this location. Walking into this store is like taking a step back in time to when people were friendly and cared about others.

Tried this place for the first time and was kind of upset they didn't have more on the menu. You also have to purchase the burger and the fries separate instead of a combo like you usually would find at a restaurant. I loved that they have different options for potatoes for your fries! They also have a lot of sauces for your burgers or fries :) however, the food was beyond greasy! I don't think I'd go back. But a lot of people might like the place! :)

One of the hidden gems in the Treasure Valley! Unbelievable empanadas! Had no idea I needed this restaurant in my life!
Terrific service, drink selections, and atmosphere!

Nail Tek is definitely a Meridian gem!  It was super easy to call and make an appointment. The inside is super adorable and very clean. They have a wide selection of normal polishes to choose from and an AMAZING gel selection. I don't think I've ever seen so many gel polishes in one place as well.  Everyone is very friendly and super accommodating. Overall a really great experience and I would highly recommend coming in!

We are signed up for the Metro Wash Unlimited. We have been members for over a year now and love the drive thru wash.

Today is the first time we had them do the interior. This gave us a chance to check out the waiting area. It is very comfortable and customer friendly with complimentary drinks and freshly popped popcorn. Your choice of Coke or Pepsi products and coffee with flavored creamers.

I am sure my wife will use the interior service more often. She loves the convenience of someone else cleaning up after the grandkids and enjoying a quiet moment to herself while someone else does the work.
Very rude staff, she rushed us the whole time. I would never go back again. Didn't get the donuts we wanted because she was in such a rush to ring us up.

Is it possible to leave less than 1 Star????  Went to get the family some dinner nearing closing time. 4 ice cold tacos with almost no ground beef..... a crisp meat burrito they didn't even include in the bag when I got home. $20 dollars for a horrible meal.  Nice work kids..... I won't be back!!!!!!

We decided to give the RAM another try after an underwhelming experience a few years ago and wish we wouldn't have! We ordered the steak special and it was a small steak and a handful of under seasoned fries; ordered the bacon Mac & cheese burger because the picture looked good. The Mac and cheese was dry no cheese sauce as described on the menu so we asked the server about it, she sent the manager over he stated they mix the cheese sauce into the Mac and cheese so we showed him the burger and he AGREED it looked dry asked if we wanted extra cheese sauce to fix it... all good until they charged us for the cheese sauce that the menu stated came on the burger. Complained again after the bill and he offered to refund the charge, but seemed oblivious to the fact that the charge should not have been added in the first place. Needless to say we will not be going back again.

I love Steelz. You can find amazing deals on all kinds of things. The only drawback is that their inventory changes daily. If you see a great deal one day on an item, they may not have that item again for a long time. That is just the nature of the store. But, on the other hand, this also makes every shopping experience different as you see new products every day.

I had scheduled this appointment almost two months in advanced and the day of the appointment I was informed the groomer was running late. Then I was told the groomer didn't have correctly working tools then was asked to reschedule. Since I had already waited so long and was leaving out of town I said I didn't want to reschedule but that I had concerns if they didn't have the correct tools to use. I was assured the groomer would be sufficient to continue. The groomer Brandi showed up and confirmed she had the written instructions I had sent in. An hour later my dog comes back and I was in the middle of a work call so didn't do an inspection when the groomer checked out. Once I had a moment to look over my dog I was extremely disappointed that I had paid well over $100 and the only thing done to my dog was he got shaved down almost to his skin which was not part of the instructions I provided, we are in the winter season I would not have my dog shaved down this low. Nothing else was done at least not accurately. His face was not cleaned I don't even think he got a full bath. His paws were not trimmed, his nails were not cut and all of the areas he had shave marks were choppy, sporadic and bumpy. The only reason I am giving this company two stars is because they did offer to come back but informed me it would be the same groomer. I decided in the end it was not worth having them return as they obviously did not know what they were doing. Any groomer that is familiar with grooming shih Txu knows you do not touch their eyelashes but sadly my dogs eyelashes were cut and it takes a very long time for them to grow back out. I feel I paid WAY too much But was hoping I would get really good service for the price. " you get what you pay for " Not in the case.

This is a great place for breakfast or lunch! It feels homey and we always get seated quickly. My favorite so far is the grilled chicken salad. We've also come to the ice cream counter when we're just looking for a dessert. They have a lot of fun flavors. The staff is super friendly here, too!
Everything else was great.. but these fries are BURNT. Kind of crazy they decided to serve these.

They made things right.  It took months and lots of calls, but the management truly made a solid effort to fix things.  They gave us a loaner bed to use until the correct one could be found.  The bed the salesperson promised us never came but they delivered a substitute the other day that works.

I walked in knowing nothing about Pho House. I wasn't sure what the quality would be since it is in the Rite Aid parking lot. What a pleasant surprise!!! The food was delicious and the servings were large! The host: server was so helpful and welcoming. The gentleman in the back brought the food out and was just as courteous and helpful. I don't know if they are the family that owns this restaurant but I look forward to returning soon!!! Thank you for such a great meal and wonderful service!!! See you soon!

Been going here since it opened.  Jacked their prices way up, lower level of service.. way lo.  Like you have to go up to the bar to ask for water.  Very impersonal service.  Have been an MVP here for years and will never go back.  Poor management decision on the structure.  Too bad because service earns the big tips too and since things are relatively self-service, bye bye tips....

Hate this.  I worked in the industry for a long time and it is such a great sports setting, but if I am spending my money, I would like to at least pay someone to make sure I have a good experience...
Wonderful customer service and delicious empanadas! Definitely try! The flavors are perfectly balanced and the pasty dough is just right.

Love their tacos. Awesome food. But I like to order ahead online, to skip the ordering and waiting line. Both times I have done this, it takes Forever for someone to bother to help you, you're standing right there at the pick up counter as disinterested employees walk back-and-forth behind the counter and do not even acknowledge you. If your service was as good as the tacos, it'd be five stars!

One the best burgers place in Boise! They have lots of options (including gluten free) for customizing your burger and fries. The food is so delicious and satisfying. We are always greeted with professional, helpful staff which is important because the menu options can be a bit overwhelming. The staff is great at providing recommendations and patient if you need to change anything.
Food is okay but the service is super slow. We were seated and given drinks promptly, but then had to wait at least 20 minutes for the waitress to take our order, and the restaurant wasn't busy.

This is just a review for the restaurant and bar.  We didn't check out the bowling alley or arcade.  Ambiance is cool for watching sports.  And that's all they have going for them.  I know COVID has things messed up.  But having to go stand in line at the bar is not even close to providing good service.  The wait was around 10 minutes.  The bar was understaffed and a total mess.  Piles of glass.  Liquid all over the space.  Out of pint glasses.  The food was average or a little below.  My burger was slightly under cooked from my medium cooked order.  But the wait in line and lack of wait staff had me not go to get it fixed.  The rest of my party had mediocre food too.  A barely warm Philly cheese steak for my wife.  I want to like this place, but this visit on top of a couple others leaving feeling a little blah before makes me pretty sure I won't be back for a long while if ever.
Just like Delsas down the street, this place is top notch! The food and employees are awesome! Definitely need to try the ice cream! Nothing compares to Delsas ice cream!!!!!!!

If you like bowling, don't miss the Tuesday specials : $2,00/person/game!!!! Enjoy!
Good time with friends bowling. They have over 30 lanes that you can enjoy. Recommended to book the lanes in advance to not have to wait over 1 hour.
They also have a room to follow sports on tv and order food. Food menu is basic and fried food overall. Our group tried various  appetizer and food, it was overall ok, but not fantastic. The service was pretty disappointing on that side : needed to ask 3 times to get silverware and was told our last round of drink would arrive before the closing time, but never did...
The bathroom cleanliness is also something they  should consider.

We had a really memorable meal here last week out on the patio. Absolutely everything we ordered was delicious from the drinks to the appetizers to the entrees to dessert (best carrot cake ever). We're definitely looking forward to coming back; would be even better if the staff showed their beautiful faces as well.

This place was phenomenal! Unlike YardHouse and Big Als (other places that have burgers in the village) the burgers here have a good flavor! I got Levi as my server (Who did a great job and even got me to try their Mimosa shake (YUMMY!) He answered all of the questions I had (like how the sauces come on the side, Great idea!) The burger came out Juicy and exactly how I ordered the temp (pink throughout). It was honestly one of the best burgers I had! The burger I got even looked like the picture!! (I got the counter burger) I will definitely be back to try some of the other burgers they had listed on the menu!
Best thing I haven't eaten in a long time! What a treat. Awesome place, super clean, good beer. I'll be back.

The lady who does my nails recommended this place. As she is Vietnamese we took her recommendation and got dinner here. Now we have been getting Grubhub to pick it up and deliver to us! One time I accidentally ordered the wrong meal. Totally on me. And I had an awesome dinner then as well. The Pho - awesome. Fried rice- awesome. Egg rolls- awesome. Special rice combination dinner (the accidental order) was awesome! We are so lucky to have found this place.

I have only used the curb side pick up at this location a couple times. This service is very convenient especially for people like me with a bunch of little kids. If your pick up order is delayed they will send you a text informing you. This location is fairly new and there are plenty of parking spots for the store and for pick up. I will be coming back on a weekly basis.

Due to the ever expanding chip seal repair here in the Treasure Valley I have received windshield damage on two vehicles in the last two months.  The damage consisted of four rock chips and one windshield in need of replacement.  

I contacted Tyler (Business Owner) through Yelp messaging and had my first rock chip repaired within a few days. Tyler arrived early during his suggested time window and he seemed much more confident than other technicians I had used in the past. 

Just two weeks later I found myself in need of a windshield replacement.  Once again Tyler set a high standard with the installation, quality and price of the windshield.  

While I don't look forward to having anymore rock chips I feel it is inevitable. Based on his repairs Tyler has earned a lifetime customer.
These people don't know what street tacos are. The tacos and tortillas were cold. Street tacos are supposed to come with 2 tortillas not just 1. I was bummed. I wanted to like them.
SO good!!! You have to go here!! The sauces were amazing and the empanadas were outstanding!! Can't wait to try them all! Support local!!

So I got my lashes about a week ago and so many have been falling out. They look spidery.  Almost all of the lashes I have seen fall out have fallen out on their own and not with my lash attached. I'm pretty disappointed to say the least. I have an appointment next week to get a fill. We will see if they last that long
Prompt reply and service.  I appreciate that they came to my home to do the chip repair.  Highly recommend!

Today I went to the shop to get my headlights cleaned and de oxidized. I had the best experience ever. Chris has an amazing shop and is a great person. He has great employees and they all are extremely courteous. Tabitha at the front desk is also super kind. I'm grateful that we chose to come here for our services. We will be back

We used Justin to review my mother's existing trust documents (from FL) and to help make a few adjustments specific to Idaho.  Justin did a thorough review, provided helpful guidance and insight, and answered questions that came up.  He's very knowledgeable, personable and professional.  We'll use him again as my wife and I put our estate plans together.

Nightmare dog groomer!! Took in our labradoodle and they shaved her hers bald! Thought I was gonna cry.  They didn't even bother to call me and ask first. Girl groomer said "she looks cute". Absolute PTSD from the experience. TERRIBLE!!!

I have not been to The Ram for a while now. Last time I was here, the menu was getting old and boring. The burgers seemed to lack luster and the place in general just seemed slow.

Well, Im happy to say that things seemed to have turned around. I ate here with my Meet Up group. We say in the bar area, sort of. The actual bar area is divided into 2 sections. One part of this section is the actual bar.

The other part that is separated by a partial wall is more of a an extension of the dining room. Our waitress was very very friendly and as nice a waitress as I have encountered anywhere. I wish I had gotten her name, but I did not.

Burger Rama is going on at The Ram. This seems to be a temporary promotion that they run every now and then. Im not sure why its not all the time, because the burgers on this separate menu are outstanding. I had the Korean BBQ Burger. 

It is topped with something called kalbi sauce. Not sure what this sauce it was its delicious. It has Korean BBQ pork Carnitas as well, which are also amazing followed by a sweet kimchi slaw. 

This burger is one of the best I have ever had. No joke!

An I dont say this easily. I consider myself a bit of a burger snob. If a burger does not measure up, I let folks know.

This burger is killer. It has a crunch, it has a sweetness akin to teriyaki, but much much better. The pork carnitas are shredded pork, but I would not have known it is pork. It was very tender and some of the best meat I have ever add. An excellent addition to the beef patty. 

Run dont walk to The Ram and try this burger before the Ram ends their promotion. Im hoping and praying that The ram puts this one on their regular menu.

if enough people go here and order this burger, maybe they will add it.

The Ram (in Meridian) has been our go-to restaurant when we are in the area... enough that we joined the mug club this last season.
She (wmbo) wanted calimari, and we were not dissapointed. They were tender and tasty as always.
Where things went south was the "Chef's Specials." Three dishes featuring "Gulf shrimp."
We both shared a steak & shrimp entree, served with mac and cheese, and seasonal veg (green beans).
Mac & cheese was The star. The steak was cooked as ordered... medium rare, and seasoned nicely. But, that is where the compliments stop.
The steak should have been served with a buckle... as it would have been better purposed as a belt. And it was only contested by the beans. Not sad, frozen, chopped,water-logged green beans. But beautiful whole baby green beans that have had all the life and joy sucked out of them.
Which brings me to the "gulf" shrimp (the feature of all three "chef's" offerings.
I will only say I was disappointed by the quarter-sized, ovecooked offerings, that would have been shamed if they were placed next to a box of Gorton's frozen shrimp from Albie's. Maybe that is the "Gulf."
At $15 I would have been dissapionted. At $24 I just feel used.
The beer (that they still have on tap) is still on point. The apps are great. For mains, ..  I will be looking elsewhere
Great customer service! Highly recommended! Very fast, efficient and helpful. Will definitely come back to them for any future needs

Super disappointed in Kneaders for our Thanksgiving pies. First of all, I preordered two pies weeks in advance of Thanksgiving to be sure I'd get exactly what I wanted. After waiting in the drive thru for 40 minutes on Thanksgiving Eve, I got to the window and was informed that they sold out of pumpkin pie...including the pie that I preordered! Apparently they didn't set the preorders aside and allowed walk-in customers first pick of whatever they wanted. They offered a replacement pie, but I chose a refund. 
Secondly, I get my one pie home and it looks like the photo. It was completely slopped in the pie pan that it's barely presentable. Unacceptable.
I gave two stars only because the raspberry pie tasted good. The presentation sucked and I'm still unhappy about my pre-ordered pie being sold. I won't be returning to Kneaders for my holiday pies.

As The Proclaimers say (almost), "I would walk 500 miles and I would walk 500 more... Just to be the (wo)man who...walks a thousand miles... To fall down on your floor." (Conveniently under you coffee  spigot so I can lay on the ground and have your coffee fall into my mouth.)

My daughter and I stopped by for lunch and we absolutely loved it. Large selection of empanadas. We tried 4 different ones, and loved each one. Charming atmosphere and really friendly staff. I wish I liked wine because they had a beautiful selection. I will definitely be back.

These guys rock.  I'd been in several years ago and had excellent service, but wasn't sure how they might have changed over time.  Turns out, they are just as good if not better.  Excellent on-line quote system (which turned out to be exactly what I was charged IRL).  Excellent online appointment making ability.  Accurate projection of time-to-fix, cost, etc.  It was painless, quick, and the phone has been working without a hitch ever since.
I love this place! Yummy bagels, great coffee, perfect location. It's my new place for coffee dates, lunch and just meeting a new friend casually.

I was super disappointed in my experience here. I paid 60 dollars to get my nails done, and they only lasted 4 days before chipping. You also have to pay for a nail file and buffer at your appointment. Not worth it!

Service was good. The guy was nice and friendly. I would do more stars except our classic sandwiches did not come with pickle and onion and that is what drew us to want that sandwich. Also every single time I try to order the jalapeño kielbasa they are always out! This is the 4th time I have tried to order the jalapeño kielbasa only to be told like always that they are fresh out! my wife also ordered a side of these onion things and they forgot to put them in the bag! I know a lot of fast food places forget things and it's hard to judge them to much because they were about to close in 45 minutes. Just not the greatest experience. I will come back and change to 5 stars if the next time I go to dickies they have jalapeño kielbasa!!!!!!!!!!!!! But if they are out the next time I will leave it forever as 2 stars. "Folding arm emoji"

Everything we ordered was wrong. Soup was cold, enchiladas had no enchilada sauce and chorizo was left out! Man we were bummed to spend over $40 for a bad lunch. Time to step it up! Server was very nice though he worked hard- we understand it's a hard time but we also have to pay good money for food- we work hard too!
Not happy with my $40 gel manicure top coat peeling after less than one week. Also my finger was cut and my foot as well. Staff was nice but for the price it's not worth it.

I called at about 1210 on a Saturday for an appointment for my daughter to get her nose pierced. I was nervous, she is 16 and I just had visions of everything that could go wrong, I was worried for no reason.  We were able to get a 1 pm the same day.  Paul was WONDERFUL. Calm, explained everything he was going to do, then explained again as he was doing it.  The process was painless and fast and incredibly well priced.  Piercing and stud was $46.  He also told her that if she needed help changing the stud to come back anytime and he'd be happy to help her, and teach her.  Great place.

i went here for a small tattoo and it was a great experience. nice clean, open space and very friendly people! they were so patient with me being so indecisive. my tattoo is healing so well. highly recommend to anyone looking to get a tattoo!

Two of my friends recommended The Habit over In-N-Out and that's a high hill to climb over. I was skeptical but was game to try them.

Both chains were born in Southern California, In-N-Out in 1948 in Baldwin Park, outside Los Angeles, and The Habit in 1969 in Santa Barbara. Both have fanatical followers.

I ordered a single Charburger and fries. They were ok, but nothing that screamed this was one of the best fast-food meals I had ever had. The burger didn't seem to have any seasoning and lacked the distinctive char burger taste. 

Since I hadn't eaten at The Habit before the company got bought out in early 2020 by fast-food behemoth Yum Brands, I have nothing to compare. Except Yum has a stable of mediocre brands: Pizza Hut,  Taco Bell and KFC. Maybe The Habit has gone the way of those brands.

In-N-Out, on the other hand, is still owned by the founding Snyder family.  They've kept things simple, pay a wage that's much higher than typical fast-food joints and continue to put out a quality product. I can't wait until they come to Idaho.

The coaches are top notch here! They truly push you to accomplish any goal you have while maintaining your safety! The steps they have taken through Covid made everyone feel safe inside these walls and I would recommend this gym to everyone...no matter what your fitness level is, you will feel welcomed and encouraged every time you walk in!

We are living in crazy times with COVID-19. I'm beyond impressed with the effort this location has put into keeping things clean and sanitized. We've always loved dining at this location and were so pleased to see that they've been able to keep their bar high during these times. Masks were worn by all employees. Tables & seats/chairs were sanitized after every customer left (yes I watched them). They put a sticker on the table to show they were sanitized. Trays were sanitized too! The manager has definitely trained his employees well. We've always loved this particular Habit but seeing them rise in such a terrible time makes me love them even more. Keep up the great work!!

My wife and I came in for lunch after shopping at WalMart. We found nobody working the counter and the dining room tables were all dirty. We rang the bell on the counter to get help, waited and nobody came. We rang the bell again and still nobody came. We looked around the corner into the back room to find both employees with their EarPods in and not paying attention to the counter. I guess that they really don't care. We left and went elsewhere.

Took my son in for his 16th Birthday for a nostril piercing. Staff was friendly, professional and very accommodating. Paul did an amazing job and I will definitely recommend this shop to anyone and everyone in the future! Thanks guys!
I have been getting my lashes done by Lesley Hughes for 5 years. She is absolutely AMAZING!! I can't imagine life without my lovely lashes! Thanks so much!! Look at me now lash lounge ROCKS!!!

They did a great job
Friendly, responsive and fun! 

When I called for quotes he took his time with me and explained all the packages clearly. 

They made one error (forgot my trunk) but we quickly responsive to my call and send a guy out here to my house with equipment to fix it. 

Reasonably priced for the job. This a sole proprietor with a few employees and I love to support local. 

My car was filthy. My 6 year old ruined my back seat. I'm sure it took them some time. It it was very pretty when I got it back.  I meant to post before and after pics but my son already ruined my back seat again haha.

We really enjoyed the feeling of being welcome and not rushed through our services. We have been twice now and each time we've had a wonderful experience. We called ahead for appts prior to arriving and they were ready for us right on time. I tried the nail dip option and they were able to explain how it works and the color options were great. My daughter always gets a fill and loves to do something fun and creative and her tech was so great at helping her. Can't wait for our next appt.

Blue Sky makes me feel nostalgic. We used to walk to the downtown location a lot as poor college students and it always filled and warmed us up! 

My favorite is definitely the Asiago Cheese with veggie cream cheese! But I think I have had every bagel they have to offer (except maybe plain...what's the point?) and most of the cream cheeses (Or "bagel frosting" as my 4 year old likes to call it). Each one is really perfect. The bagels are delicious with excellent texture. A shiny, firm exterior with a squishy center. They are made fresh every day and it's easy to tell. Some of the local grocery stores carry their cream cheese to buy and that's always a treat!

They also have great sandwiches. Lots of yummy lunch meats and options, like chicken salad or tuna. All the extra veggies are free (I feel quite offended when someone charges me $0.50 for lettuce). Insider trick: skip the slice of cheese and mayo and have them spread cream cheese inside. Oh yea!

They do have soup, but I am really not a fan. I should ask the next time I go in....but I'm fairly certain that the soup is not homemade. It tastes canned to me. But this isn't a soup place, so I'm not really holding that against them. 

I would love to see Blue Sky get a little crazy and start featuring a unique bagel of the month or something. Something creative and zesty and unique. Their bagels are delicious but predictable. I would definitely go out of my way to try something fun and new.
My husband and I both had a egg, ham and cheese bagel sandwich with jalapeño cream cheese. The sandwich was really good. I loved the chunks of jalapeño. Would definitely visit again.

I could eat here for weeks on end and I'd never get tired of the amazing tacos. Everything is good but I highly recommend the shrimp tacos, I get at least 1 every time I go. The Service is fast and efficient and the food is outstanding. Don't hesitate to go to Tin Roof.

The food here is excellent.  Everything tastes homemade.  I particularly enjoy their soups and brownies.  Their service is good.  All the employees are friendly and will go out of their way to help.  Plus, everything is reasonably priced.

The last two times we have been to this location we have been disappointed. One time we ordered to go to eat in the car. We got our food and it was cold. 
This past week we dined in and it was horrible. They had no ice, no duck fat, all the burgers patties and duns were dry. We had 5 burgers, how do you mess up all of them! Then the manager came over to see how we were doing and he did not make it better. He said they have been have issues with their bread supplier. 
SO HE DECIDED IT WAS OK TO SERVE OLD BUNS? NOT OK!
 
Dear Manager,  
At the time you did not have fresh bread to serve you go find some. You do not serve your guest old bread and dry  burgers NEVER EVER!

Odd that I find myself reviewing a medical speciality office rather than a .....well, restaurant!  They were so wonderful that a few words about them is in order.
I had postponed a colonoscopy for about 15 years and was well overdue for my first...appointment made through my primary care physician about 3 weeks ago (no rush, i.e. no complaints or symptoms) and was dreading the procedure until today....Gave me a complimentary box of bowel prep ($80+ in the pharmacy!) and showed up this morning at 8:30AM for the procedure.
Bottom line:  EVERYONE was polite, professional, caring and friendly (yes, that about covers it) from the receptionist to the nurses and to the doctor.  They made an embarrassing and humiliating experience easy, quick and painless both physically and mentally.  Dr. Sericati was especially nice explaining the procedure beforehand as well as taking the time to offer a very in-depth discussion afterwards.  
I would urge anyone requiring this type of procedure to seriously consider these folks...Well done!

My husband and I are huge fans of this place! We were having a hard time finding good pho and other vietnamese dishes. This has definitely been our favorite so far. Their pho is really delicious and doesn't make you feel like crap after you eat it. We've also had their bahn mi, egg rolls, and flat rice noodle dish. All were very tasty! I especially love the noodle dish. We will definitely frequent this restaurant in the coming winter months

The best empanadas in the area. Friendly and family-owned service. I usually order online and take them home hot and fresh. Our favorites are the chimichurri chicken, vegan curry, and the choclo tarta; but everything we've ever had is absolutely delicious. And fresh. And baked. It makes me miss Argentina!

This food is the most dank! I got the chicken blackened bowl, and subbed steak. Tons of steak. And so much food for the money. My friend got the buffalo cauliflower and they were so good. And they got the Mac and cheese burger which was bomb. Highly recommend! Our waiter was mason, and he was so nice and helpful in helping us choose out the best food! Their beer is really good too.

I am new to Meridian and my little pommie just can't deal with going to the groomer. I choose this service due to previous reviews. I was not disappointed at all. Great service, prompt reply and attention to detail. Pricing is a bit high however I was willing to pay it to make my dog as comfortable as possible  I will definitely be using this service in the future.
Make sure you Go to Guymon Orthodontics for any of your orthodontic needs! Dr Guymon & Morris are top notch guys! Staff is always so friendly and amazing! Would recommend them to anyone!!!

Here's the positive.  I agree with all of these reviews. The park is expensive but it is very fun and there is something for the entire family. The slides are very fun, park was very clean, the staff was professional and excellent at their job. 

    Now for the down side. While it takes a lot of confidence for some to even put a swimsuit on and then ro walk around in a public place without feeling self conscious and being your own worst critic, half of the slides give you an extra confidence boost by weighing you every time you approach tge slide. To add to the confidence booster they have either lights or a digital readout for everyone to see. While i understand safety concerns and such, i feel like this has a negative impact to body-shaming and self confidence for some. I feel that maybe their could be something done to the slides to reinforce them or added area for slowing down the riders , whatever the issue may be, to help the confidence for thise that are not exactly proud of their looks but are willing to try to enjoy life.
Good "fast food" bbq option. Their sandwiches and sides are always super yummy. Would not recommend ordering through any third party delivery service as they always seem to miss order notes.

Pretty good nail salon. Nothing too big to complain about but I don't think their A/C was on so it got a little toasty and there weren't a ton of options for regular polish. I loved their hot towels for my pedicure and they were able to get 3 people in on short notice. Also there was great precautions for social distancing (everyone wearing masks, dividers up, masks, etc)

I would avoid this location if you can. Food is mostly excellent regardless of location but the service is almost always mistake prone at this location. The state street and downtown locations are much more  reliable and competent. Can't speak to the other locations outside of those three.

This place is pretty good. They have a variety of fries. They all taste very good an unique. There is also a variety of seasoning you can get on them, from jalapeño to garlic. There is also a sauce stand that has about 10 difference sauces from aioli to chipotle to spicy ketchup. This is nice because you can dip your fries in a variety of sauces and they're all pretty good. The large fries are huge, they'll feed at least three people.  

The burger was also good, I got the beef burger with the hot toppings. It tasted very unique, but unique is good. Would definitely suggest trying this place as it is unique to boise.
Excellent food and super attentive staff!  The Taco's are superb every time without fail.  It's also very nice that they keep the lower IQ (Anti-maskers) out of the establishment.

Grant's Neighborhood Grill might have given me the best meal I've had since I moved to Idaho over 4 years ago! We went there for my birthday and we were beyond impressed. My only regret is that I was too full to have dessert on my on birthdya because the entree was so good! The pork chop is something out of your dreams, I promise you! You don't be sorry!

What a MESS. I sat on the phone for 20 min just to confirm a reservation.
It cant be that busy.

I was introduced to Tin Roof Tacos by a friend of mine. I ate at their Boise location and it was pretty good. Good enough that it stuck in my mind and I thought; "If these guy ever put one of these in Meridian, it might be a regular place I eat at.

When I discovered there was one on McMillian just down from where I live, I was excited to try it. This is my 2nd visit. Both have not gone well. Usually this comes down to the food and service. But in the case of this location, the 1star (I would rate them less than this if I could) is due to cleanliness, being unsanitary and not appealing at all to eat in.

Any restaurant can have a bad day, so this is why I came here twice. The dining room is infested by flies. Dirty, disgusting flies are everywhere. We spent more time trying to keep them off our food than eating it.

Flies are terrible anyway. They fly from place to place carrying their diseases and filth. Flies don't care where they land. The visit trash cans, other peoples food, other people, other food, and even poop they may have found outside. 

If these flies are in the dining area landing on other people and their food, its a pretty good bet they are inside the kitchen as well cross contaminating the food there.

Especially in these days of Covid. a restaurant doing proper sanitation is critical. A fly could even have flown into an infected person and then onto us!

Come on guys! There is no excuse for this. Your restaurant fly problem is disgusting.

Clean your restaurant!

For now, I will not visit this place again.

I am a transplant from California. I've been in Idaho about four years. Before I moved here, I had a somewhat ethereal, intangible thought rolling-around in my otherwise empty head, 
"Well, at least the french fries will be good." Wrong!

I don't get it. Here we are in the potato capital of planet Earth, and good french fries are hard to find. This is becoming a huge mystery to me, right up there with, "Is there intelligent life in the Universe, including Earth?"

So, when I saw the "byline" for Boise Fry Company, "Burgers on the Side", I thought to myself, "Eureka! At last!" Wrong, again!

There are little menus available near the cash register, which are entitled, "How to BFC." In other words, an instruction manual, which narrates how to go about ordering at BFC. Okay, fine.

Fries being primary, and the burgers secondary, STEP 1 is to order the fries from a large assortment of choices in small or large portions: russet, gold, laura, yam, sweet, Okinawa, or brussels sprouts. Then the cut: regular, homestyle, curley, chips, shoestring, or po'ball. 

Then, as STEP 2, you order your burger: beef, bison, turkey, or vegan.
Then, your topping: garlic aioli, spring mix, red onion gastrique [SIC], tomato, special sauce, or lettuce ... then, an "add on": cheese, bacon, babanero, an extra patty, and/or a gluten free bun.

STEP 3 is to order a drink, which can be a craft beer, a local wine, or "house made" sodas. I don't drink alcohol, so, I cannot comment on the "craft beers," which have become a big thing these days.

And, finally, STEP 4, dessert, which can be a rootbeer float or a donut. A donut? Why would anybody, anybody --- except the most obese who waddle amongst us --- want to eat a donut after fries and a burger? The only reason is to be certain that we consume all the basic food groups at one sitting: Triglycerides/fatty acids, carbohydrates, and sugars. Customers get to choose their own style of sodium and sauces after the fries and burger are served. These delicacies are available at a dispensary, which rivals the control room of spaceship Enterprise, "I'm givin' her everything she's got, Captain!" 

So, I ordered a beef burger, with lettuce & tomato, a fountain drink, and small portion of russet fries, cut "homestyle," which is supposedly a thicker cut than "regular". This came to $11.79, including tax.

Kindly refer to the image, attached here. Looking at this image, you may be able to understand why, when it was served, I had high hopes. The fries, in particular, looked as though they were gonna be delicious, what with that nice, deep-fried color and all. I was hungry, and my mouth was watering. What a disappointment! 
(PS: The little holes in the serving platter are there to accommodate the little paper cups for the dipping sauces, and such; kinda clever.)

As appealing to the eye as those fries might have been to the naked eye, the taste was left somewhere, but where? It's kinda like having just seen a film, a film which "just misses". You know: You watch the film, and can't help but wonder if some of the best scenes were left on the cutting/editing room floor.

The fries were soggy, mealy, all-but tasteless, and no amount of their special salts would relocate and resurrect the long-lost flavors. I ate most of them (but tossed some of 'em), because I was hungry, but I cannot say that I enjoyed them. Bummer!

Boise Fry Company states that their supply of potatoes and other ingredients is seasonal. So, maybe I just got a bad potato, I dunno.

The beef burger was okay, not great, just okay, but I am not complaining about the burger. It was well within the confines of "acceptable" ... with only lettuce and tomato, it was a back-to-the-basics-burger, which is what I wanted. And, oh, I ordered it cooked "medium" and it was cooked just right. Albeit with low expectations, this is all to say they got the burger right.

Oh, the fountain drink, lemonade, was okay too, nothing special ... just your common, ordinary machine-dispensed drink. I, somehow, managed to miss-out on their advertised, "house-made sodas".

Most Yelp reviewers seem to think that the Bison burger, that's buffalo, if you don't know, is the way to go. So, I may try that the next time and, yes, I will give the place another try. The place MAY have potential but, from my point-of-view, I am still searching for the best fries in the greater Boise area, at least for now.

Update (Nov 20')

I took the owner up on the gift card and took the family to El Tenampa.

1. Eddie is still the best!
2. The food is definitely on the uptick (Arroz con Pollo) was outstanding.
3. We will be back (Thanks for reaching out)....
Love the Potter's Teahouse. So many tea choice. Now serve sandwich&salad. Yum. You ask anything you want as tea goes. I want the Hong Kong milk tea. Delicious!
Great food every time. Love the crispy chicken basil & crunchy flower. Would recommend!
Indoor and outdoor seating available. Best tacos I've had in a long time! Only problem was the service could have been friendlier.

Friendly folks and fantastic food. Lots of F-words to describe an A+ deli. I'm still on a gluten free diet, so they made me a lettuce wrap. Great flavors and tasty bacon. I'm not sure you can do much better. The pickles are out of this world and the slaw was nice and crisp.  Greatest spontaneous lunch stop in a while. I definite place to return to. Meat eaters have no need to worry... The pile of meat on the sandwich will keep me until after dinner.

What this facility lacks in polish, it more than makes up for in quality of care. They've taken excellent care of our 1 year old. He's always excited to arrive in the morning, and in a great mood when we pick him up in the afternoon. His teachers are loving, attentive and professional. They do an excellent job of keeping us updated throughout the day using the Procare app, and everyone who works here seems genuinely happy to be here. Childcare is expensive in general, but the peace of mind they provide us here, and the joy they bring to our little boy, is priceless.

Visiting from out of town and the hubs got a craving for a French dip Sammie. Found fat guys fresh deli and the combination of great reviews and delicious looking food had us interested in trying it. I am so glad we did. The Trevor melt is absolutely delicious. Accompanied by a mild but equally delicious au jus dipping sauce and slathered with basil pesto mayo everything combines so beautifully. I highly recommend a side dish of horseradish for that extra spicy kick. Will definitely come back when visiting in the future.
This is hands down my favorite street tacos in the area. I would eat here daily if I could. Food is always super fresh and the place is very clean.

Company bowling party... good service and pizza/soda for a group works well.   Only problem, this place caters to the younger crowd even for bowling. Lanes are terrible.  Floors are very sticky and you almost trip as you complete your release of the ball.   Obviously no care is taken on the bowling part of this facility.  Don't go if you actually are serious or even remotely a decent bowler.

Well, lunch is apparently NOT where this place shines!
The portions were VERY small. I asked for NO hot seasoning on my Pad Thai, and got a big glob of red chili sauce on the middle of the plate in the last 2-3 bites, ick!
The Thai Iced tea was way too sweet, I don't know why people would want to drink it that sweet! 
The server was very attentive, but really, write down the order.  I had to repeat it to her 3 times.
After today, I'm not sure you will get me into your place again!  Good luck!
One of my favorite spots for drinks and delectables!  The tea selection is wide and unique, the worker is knowledgeable, and the sitting spaces are beautiful and comfortable.
Excellent customer service and went above and beyond to meet my schedule requirement.  It was our pups first haircut and our groomer took extra special care of him!  Will use again!

Horrible customer service, service completely depends on if you get a good tech or not, and it's extremely overpriced, so don't waste your time or money. Spent $90 on their ultimate pedicure, was supposed to be 70-80 minutes in duration, but I guess they must start your clock the second you walk in the door because my pedicure was over 72 minutes after I came in, and that includes the time I spent picking out a color, for which I arrived to early to do.  I was rushed by the tech to pick a color, she burned me with her callus shaving sander, massage was essentially her rubbing lotions in my legs, not a massage at all, she spent a good amount of time in the back room while I sat with lotion and towels on my legs.  While my nails look ok, I could have saved myself time and money and painted them myself.

We were visiting from California and have never been to Dutch Bros.  After seeing so many of them, on our last day in Idaho we decided to find the nearest one.  We visitied on June 22nd.  The person who took our order was SO nice.  Sorry we didn't get her name!  We told her we have never been and was interested in an iced latte.  She asked what we liked and then suggested a drink.  We ended up with an iced caramel and coconut almond milk latte!  So delicious and tasted so much better than Starbucks!   A different person came out and brought our order to us.  She was so sweet.  Her name was Alea.  (Unsure of spelling.)  Both girls were so great and the drink was so great!  We are definitely going back for another drink next time we are there.  :)
Love the chicken pad Thai but giving it 4 stars because they are not consistent with their spice levels

I'm angry. I ordered online for pickup. I ordered a pesto artichoke sandwich, a turkey bacon avocado sandwich, two soups, a chocolate croissant, an oatmeal cookie and a dairy free smoothie. I go to pick up my order and they are out the pastries I wanted and gave me two random ones, out the smoothie I ordered so they made me something random. I get my food and take it home a solid 20 minute drive , go to open it up to eat it and it's two grilled cheese sandwiches. Not what I paid for or ordered. They only thing they got right on an over 40 dollar order was the soup. I tried calling to tell them and get this fixed but no one is answering the phone when I know good at well they had no customers in the restaurant. I want my money back.
Boise Fry was quick favorite for us. Good quality, great flavors, and love the fries of course!

Amid uncertainty in these trying times, one thing is for certain, this IHOP know how to run their restaurant. We were quickly seated and we could already see certain tables were closed off to comply with the social distancing rules. Each server was very friendly as well. Our waiter came to us quickly and so did our food. Despite the quick time our food was EXCELLENT. Each bite hit the spot. I got an omelette and my wife got the chocolate chocolate chip pancakes. The ingredients were evenly spread throughout my omelette. I will gladly come here again.
I have only had the chicken tacos and they are good.. the chicken is really tasty. My fam has had the fish too and they said its good. Chips are good too.

I've been to this restaurant countless times during COVID and have kept ordering since then. I've never had a bad experience. The staff is SO friendly. 

The chefs are doing something right because my favorite (Carne Asada with beans and rice) is cooked to perfection each time.

Love their guacamole, salsa & chips, too.

You can't beat this Boise Mexican restaurant, in my opinion!  

Takeout is easy and fast! Plus, you'll have plenty of leftovers if you're like me!

Walk-in in there were maybe 3 or 4 tables, none with more than a couple people in them. I asked if they could baste my eggs. Since it was a breakfast place I thought maybe the cook would know how, apparently not. 

I asked for over easy eggs with the yolk soft and the whites done no slime. Requested brioche French toast. Requested bacon almost burnt and baby red potatoes with sausage gravy on the side. You would think that's a simple order but apparently not.

30 minutes later I am delivered regular French toast, hard eggs, hash browns, half cooked bacon and no gravy in sight.

2 servers and a cook should be able to provide that breakfast in less than 30 minutes. Jiminy Christmas he could have watched a video and learned how to baste my eggs in that time adding to his sadly lacking skill set.

Disgusting. No wonder they're thinking about rebranding. They hire people who are incompetent and wonder why people don't want to come back. I'm off to see if I can find a restaurant that can make a simple breakfast.

That was 40 minutes I'll never get back wasted freezing in a s***hole. IHOP maybe you should think about finding someone who knows how to manage a restaurant and getting some people in there who can do their jobs before you lose this restaurant altogether. 0 stars

Extremely disappointed in the service and my experience here.  My wife bought me a Christmas gift from here (around $150 spent).  It was something that required a fit for an existing appliance at our home.  Long story short, it did not fit, and therefore is unusable to our family.  When I took it into the store, they said they could not return it unless it "could not be used for its intended purpose."  Apparently fitting does not fall into that category.  

*I will say that they have this policy posted in the store and on the receipt, so shame on us.  

What I can't fathom is how a business would not be willing to give in store credit (which I would have gladly taken) in a scenario like this.  They still have our money, our loyalty, and our positive word of mouth.  On the contrary, now all they have is our money.  Needless to say, I will never shop here again, nor would I recommend anyone else shop here based on this less than stellar experience.

Ordered food from them and waited almost an hour just for them to cancel my order. If they would have told me that they could not make my order right away or even 20 minutes after I would have ordered elsewhere. Extremely dissatisfied with my experience here and could not recommend to a friend

Visiting my daughter in Meridian (we are from Northern California) and she suggested Grant's for lunch. We are foodies and drinkies, so she thought this would be a good choice. 

It's a simple place in a strip mall. I believe it was Mike who was our server and bartender. And oh boy, did we luck out!!!  He was the most amazing "bartender" ever - he was also our server. Fresh lavender lemonade with Tito's - told him I wanted a strong double and he delivered!  He literally squeezed the lemons and the lavender is from the outdoor garden. Delicious and packed a punch. Had to order a second. My daughter ordered a mojito. Mike excused himself to get the fresh mint from the garden (we are in a strip mall people!), and made the most delicious, refreshing mojito she's ever had (me too, cuz I had a sip!). My husband ordered an Old Fashioned. He LOVED it!  Best he's ever had!  Served over a larger square ice cube as it should be, in my opinion!  We had dinner at Chandlers tonight and the Old Fashioned he had paled in comparison. Hey Mike!!!

The salad I had was amazing with fresh tarragon and dill (probably from the garden, who knows!). The fried chicken sandos and burgers were a hit with the rest of my family. 

If Mike is there (gosh, I hope that's his name!) order a cocktail. He is a genius. An absolute genius bartender. The service was great and the food was delicious!  Thanks to the chef, whom we didn't meet. 

So happy we got to experience this place while visiting beautiful, Idaho!

I would love to give a ZERO star review, but it's not an option!!!  Went to the showroom 2 months ago. Ordered all our new kitchen & bath plumbing supplies for our remodel.  Came time for delivery, they only delivered 1/2 our stuff.  We had to go pick the rest up ourselves.  Then, it was the WRONG stuff!  Warehouse manager was a complete asshole, refused to give us the correct supplies, as we had "compromised " the hardware.  Refused to even work with us on a solution. So we improvised.  Went to install the handle, and of course it doesn't fit with the other incorrect fittings!!!   Fair warning:  you go there for a purchase with a "professional " consultant. Spend thousands of dollars. And they may screw up your order & guess what?  Screw you!  WORST customer service I've ever experienced!!!   Take your business elsewhere, or be prepared to get screwed!
Just want to say that 'service' definitely improved months prior and even now prompt excellent  Drink refills yes,,nice... Of course the food is still very much on point consistently great

We ordered a large order for our family if seven, online, for curbside pickup. While we live a nearly 30" drive away, we had a great first experience with Habit Burgers, and traveling that far, we thought, was worth it, to satisfy our craving for a second round!  On time for our curbside pickup, we only had to wait a few minutes, for the large bags of our food to be brought out to the car.  Could hardly wait to dive in while driving home, and when I got there, everyone was already at the table, famished, ready to sink their teeth into burgers & fries.  To our disappointment,  one whole order was missing.  So I called (a frustrating phone tree experience to try to reach someone, anyone).  When I finally connected, it took them a bit, passing the phone around, until I got someone on the phone to hear my dilemma.  And that person sounded stressed and irritable. He said, if I wanted to drive back, they would make that order for me.  When I explained that we lived a 30" drive away, and that it would take me an hour round trip, away from my family that was already eating, and that I would prefer a refund, he said he couldn't do that.  Instead, he said I would need to contact customer service, online, and report the problem. Wasn't easy to find how to do that, but I persisted and wrote a report to customer service online. Promise was made, that someone from customer service would contact me within a couple of days.  All this was back on Feb 16th.  No follow up, no call, no refund, no acknowledgment.   We won't be back.

I asked for a foot long tuna sandwich when a young man with a blonde perm was back talking and cussing at me under his breath.  I won't be returning to this location because of this. Teach your employees some manners!

We have two dogs. A 11 pound cockapoo and a 27 pound Mini Australian Labradoodle. Madison came to groom them from Aussie Pet Mobile. She was awesome. Patient and kind and very talented. Our doodle is a challenge because he is hyper and still a puppy (almost 2). Madison was so patient with him and gets an A++++ for the beautiful grooming of both of our dogs. I will definitely call again. By the way, John, the owner, actually followed up after the grooming to make sure we were happy. Very rare these days. Very impressive.

This is the worst Gym I have ever joined.  Their employees are rude, equipment is always broken, it's always packed with people that must have hitch-hiked there from Caldwell and the locker rooms are filthy.  I decided to join another gym in the area that cost quite a bit more, but it was worth it.  There is a lot of locker room theft and the trainers are rep counters that have limited knowledge when it comes to fitness or nutrition. Lots of Serbian wannabe-gangsters there too - lol.

You guys ROCK!  We walked into your office the afternoon before a holiday weekend and picked out the rocks we wanted for our yard...
The price was so reasonable and the guys there were incredibly helpful, friendly and fun.  Then to top it off, the rocks were placed in the flower bed within the hour!  It's a rare thing these days to have such an easy and professional retail job done so well. Thank you Rock Placing Co!
Terry and Gail Anderson

So tasty! Food always tastes freshly made. This location has a drive-thru and the staff is very friendly, professional and fast! Order is always correct and comes with utensils, sauces and fortune cookies. I love this location - they do a great job!

Drove all the way across town to get the car washed. Got up to pay and was told they cannot accept a Fifty Dollar Bill. No where does it state this. I will not drive across town to patronize your car wash.

Usually their food is good, and the green curry was.  But I also ordered Pad Thai which was a huge disappointment.  It was little more than noodles, ketchup, a lot of sugar with a sprinkling of peanuts.  Where was the green onions, carrots, tofu, etc?  It was so sickening sweet I couldn't eat it.  Never again will I order that.

Theseguys are great, any time I have a phone issue I go there first.  They know what they're talking about and can often fix the problem instead of replacing your device.  I've pretty much resigned myself to having to get  a new phone on two occasions but went here first and they were able to fix it for a much lower cost, not to mention the time of restoring all my apps, settings, contacts etc.  Nice people working here, knowledgeable and the have a lot of parts in stock for a quick fix. If you drop your phone, break a screen on your laptop, get some moisture damage or any other defect, I highly recommend taking it here first.

This place is amazing.. The food was phenomenal, the service was extremely friendly, everything we ordered was prompt and delicious and made with excellent quality. I highly recommend this place. They have a selection for every member of the family.
Love it here! Brittany squeezed me in same day as calling for a fill and I'm beyond satisfied with her work. Exactly what I wanted. Good people, top notch customer service. Found my place!

Pretty solid brewery/restaurant.

We ordered a flight horn (wheel) and were able to try 6 of the in-house brews. Options were a little confusing because the taps had been switched but the menus weren't updated and there were no temporary labels but our waitress was friendly and we made the best of it!

If you can make it for Happy Hour that is definitely the best band for your buck money-wise. We ordered the pretzels and beer cheese + HH burgers which were simple yet delicious!

Re: COVID-19 measures - tables were spaced out and/or had partitions, staff were wearing masks, and hand sanitizer was readily available upon entry/exit.

I'm pretty bummed about feeling the need to write this review. In all honesty Imperial is a great place to get piercings for a lot of reasons. The shop is very hygienic, the piercers are informative and really make you feel like you're in good hands! My biggest complaint is the customer service at the front. I have been into the shop multiple times with friends getting piercings and to buy jewelry for myself...the last time I went in I left feeling like I had to say something. Customer service may not be the most important aspect of a piercing/tattoo shop, but the people at the front desk always make me feel like I'm a nuisance and a chore to help. I'm not one to make complaints and I always try to give people the benefit of the doubt, it's taken going in 4 different times and being treated the same way every time to finally speak up. The level of service this place can provide is being seriously hurt by the way the two people at the front treat customers walking in the door. I would never tell someone not to go here, but I would definitely let them know they won't be walking out feeling good about the way they were treated by certain people in the shop.

This store sucks the place is dirty and the discounts were bad. They had a protein drink box that had eighteen shakes and there was one that had nine and they took off like five bucks. They have a weird back room that is super small and the rest is the warehouse. The price tags were messy like there was two of the same light bulbs and one was five dollars more. But the thing that made me leave was that they played Disney songs and it was horrible. The music put me over the edge and I needed a break after l left the store. Overall it was just an awful experience.

Not sure I'd call 10% off original price a "steal" but hey, that's just me! Wide selection of Target, Costco, and other stores returns or damage. They have a lot of food, like smashed boxes of Cheerios and pop tarts. For what you're getting (off season or damaged products) I don't feel the discount is worth it. Unless, however, you are getting a big quantity of something. We are considered getting laminate flooring here, slightly cheaper than getting it directly from Costco. They have boxes of Costco baby wipes all dented up for about a dollar less than Costco. I guess if you really want to save a buck or go on a treasure hunt to find something you didn't know you needed, this might be the place for you.

Amazing place to eat! Every thing is fresh! You can tell the owner knows what they are doing. I will be taking every one I know here. I had the fish and chips and the pork tacos let me tell you this place knows how to cook everything amazing!! So impressed! Best in Meridian!

Last evenings dinner was spent in great company and food of equal quality. I admit the lack of mask wearing in Idaho is alarming. Even when it is posted people just do not comply! Maybe Corona will sweep through here and property values will drop substantially as the death tolls rise!
Every waitstaff member wore a mask which is reassuring, friendly efficient. The flavors were world class and I would recommend this hideout to anyone... it also offered outside dining.
Fabulous trip to Meridian was great company spectacular....

I worked right across the street from the original Hugo's on Broadway and I frequented this local sandwich shop as much as I could afford! Each location doesn't have a lot of inside seating, but a lot of people take their sandwiches to go, so I can usually find a spot. 

They have a fantastic sandwich menu with lots of combinations to choose from. My ultimate favorite is the Pilgrim which has turkey, cream cheese, and cranberry sauce. It's like thanksgiving in my mouth! 

Their sandwiches are pretty pricey (the only reason I gave them a 4 star instead of a 5, although if Yelp had half stars I would settle on a 4.5), but the ingredients are so fresh. One of my favorite things about this place is the half sandwich option. You can make any full sandwich a half size for a discount. Which is right up my alley since #1, I'm cheap and #2, I don't eat that much. 

Let's talk about the fries. Oh french fries. If you have ever read any of my other reviews you know I have a love affair with fries. Name a place in the Treasure Valley, I'll let you know if their fries meet my standards. And Hugo's deli does! They are unlike anything I've had before. Not quite as thick as steak fries, but thicker than regular fries. Whatever they batter their fries with is heavenly. Gives it the perfect seasoning and crunch. But you MUST eat them with fry sauce. Fry sauce is an Idaho/Utah original and thankfully Hugo's does their fry sauce the correct way (mayo and ketchup, none of that thousand island crap). If you are there to try a sandwich, you MUST also try the fry's!

Now, I'm off to persuade my hubby to head to Hugo's for lunch!

The staff here is so great! The store is so clean & organized, and I found the Ugg's I was looking for at a much cheaper price than Kohl's next door. One of the employees suggested buying a water proof spray for the boots - genius! This would have saved my last boots. She was also helpful figuring out some good sales for socks. Anyway, it was a great experience, and I'll definitely come back here first when I need some new shoes!
I called an got an immediate appt, very clean salon. My technician was great! I thought pricing was extremely fair. I will be returning!
Very pleased with my nails!  The owner, Ha is a perfectionist!  great job!  Thank you!
DK Donuts is the best donut shop I have found since living nearby for almost 2 years. The prices are reasonable and the donuts are amazing!

Three GENERATIONS in my family ALL have Dr Lon And his awesome staff keeping our teeth health, happy & bright.  We have decades of experience with McRae Dental.  As I am the eldest & the most hesitant, scared, and wimpy patient!  I am awed by their care!  Thank You Dr Lon & To my special Hygienists, Samantha!

First time here, ingredients were all high quality and service was great.  

5 piping hot pockets of delicious plus two bottles of coke for about $20 bucks .  Deal of the century.

Imagine a delicious pot pie w a variety of flavors, and amazing crust.

We will be back!  Clean modern atmosphere too.

Great homestyle Argentine Empanadas.....

Made just like they do in  Argentina....

If you have not been here yet, then you are truly missing out..... 

I picked up3 Dozen empanadas  and in 2 days here at home they Vanished.... they are that good..

This was an awful experience.  I was passing through town on a cross country trip and I knew my front bearings and drive axles were on their way out, so I decided to get them fixed before the last leg of my trip.  Went into John's and spoke with an employee who hoisted up my car and proceeded to point out to me every thing that was wrong with my 2002 subaru outback.  I was polite and understood there are common issues with aging cars, but nothing I thought needed my dire attention to make it home.  So I asked him for a quote for only the things I asked to be repaired and he quoted me double the price compared to my original quote from another mechanic two days ago.

To top it off, he told my that my car needed thousands and thousands of dollars of repairs and - better yet - he knew a guy over at Kendall Ford that could get me into a new car and I can trade in my train-wreck.  This place is a disgrace to mechanic's reputation all over the nation.  There are honest hard working mechanics out there they just have to be found and this place does not employ them.

Needless to say I left that place clenching my wallet as quickly as possible.  I ended up at a locally owned shop and will shamelessly plug them here - go to Northwest Auto Repair in Boise.  He is sensitive to the fact that people are taken advantage of in this industry.  Just stay away from John's.

If you know the menu and don't have a single question then you may be ok. Our first time in and everyone was rude! We just wanted to know what was on certain sandwich and what juice they had and we were responded with the rudest comments that we just said, cancel our order we are never coming back! We will never go back either!

Took my 15 year old to get her nostril pierced during Covid-19. Everyone was wearing a mask. We had to make an appointment & show IDs. Excellent experience. Laura was very knowledgeable & thorough. I highly recommend this place!

Pristine establishment! Lovely and classy!! Lena is awesome!  Loved my experience and my nails!! While other nail salons were closed at 7:00,   Vince's took my tardy appointment and Lena stayed late for me. SO HAPPY!!!

We've been taking our cream Golden Retriever, Bella, to Splash and Dash for a few months now and we've had zero bad experiences with them. My husband and I love the staff and so does our Bellybean! 

Bella visits about every 2 weeks for a bath and she always comes out looking super cute and smelling fresh! The staff are always so nice and happy to see her. Bella is always in a good mood when we pick her up and she's never shown any signs of stress from her bimonthly baths. 

We do the monthly unlimited bath plan and it's proven to be well worth the money for us. Splash and Dash is also very accommodating and they always do their best to get Bella in even with short notice. Keep in mind, they're usually busy pampering your pups, so you'll likely have to leave a voicemail. But they will get to it when they're able, so don't worry! :-) 

Their little boutique is also very cute and we are blessed by the cutest and well-behaved furbabies Jax(?) and Iggy the Piggy whenever we visit.

We are so happy with our back patio, the end result is exactly what we wanted. Now we really get to enjoy our backyard. Gabriel and his crew did an amazing job. We look forward to working with them on future home projects.

This was terrible! They have taken the personalization out of the entire experience. When you arrive you find your own table, scan the QR code for a menu, order your drinks and your food through the app pay through the app. Wait for 15 minutes for them to figure out which table your drinks belong to. Another 15 or 20 for sun-par food. 
They never come check on you. If you need anything you have to go through the app. There are six employees hanging out at the bar, and none of them check on any of the tables. The food was subpar and  VERY overpriced.  We ordered au gratin potatoes but they were actually potato skins, which were burnt and stuck to the plate. We asked for a to go cup for our leftover soda and they looked at us like we were speaking another language. They said they would have to find out if they could do that, and then  never came back.
we will never go back.

Benn driving by on my way to and from a major big box hardware store and decided to try it. Not a complete waste. I learned I won't come back. 
I ordered a soft taco combo (w "Mexican fries"and a drink). Mexican fries are just tater tots with no seasoning.  Very bland. The beef in the taco is unseasoned and plain. Not MEXICAN at all. Go to the bell. It's much better!
Lacks a basic knowledge of general medical principles and is an embarrassment to the healthcare community.

I've been coming to this establishment for the last 3 years. It wasn't only until the last two appointments that I haven't been too pleased about this service I received with customer service AND grooming. For some reason, the person who always checks us in and out at the register has turned sour. Now I hate even just walking into the place knowing I'm no longer going to be greeted like a deserving human being. As for the groomer, she makes me feel ashamed for my dogs being slightly matted. She basically asks what I would like then tells me she will do whatever she can. I just don't feel like there is any regard or compassion or thoughtfulness with these two ladies in particular. We dropped our puppy off at 1::15 and by 5:30, we still were waiting for our dog to be done and they close at 6 PM. If we have an appointment for our dog at 1:15, why on earth would it take them that long to finish?   Bye bye Splash and Dash.

The counter deserves every bit of 4 stars if not 5.  I waited a long time to try it because everything NEW at The Village is usually packed for the first several months of being open.  Now that I've tried it I'm going back ASAP!

We had company in town and decided the counter would be a good fit for everyone on our way to see a movie.  Unfortunately it was a Friday night and it was pretty busy.  We sat at a long counter type table with 2 girls sitting at the end.  I honestly felt bad for tagging on to their table because they seemed to be having a quiet girls night out and we were a larger group of 6 enjoying some adult beverages.  For that reason they didn't get the 5 stars but I am willing to update my review upon my next visit :)

Holy OPTIONS!  If you are a picky eater (like myself) this is the place for you.  You really can't go wrong with the Build Your Own option; however, you might be a little overwhelmed by how many choices you have.  They also offer several suggestions on the menu such as the BBQ burger that was AMAZING.  The meat is top quality and hormone free and the bison burger was a HUGE hit at our table.
