I split a grilled cheese with 3 different cheeses and an order of 1/2 fries 1/2 onion straws with my mom.  We wished we had added avocado and bacon but we had more than enough to eat and left several fries and onion straws behind.

I definitely feel that the QUALITY is worth every penny of the extra few dollars you would spend on a burger at The Counter vs. Red Robin.  You get your food EXACTLY the way YOU want it!

Overall experience was great, was my first time here Got a full set and will come back for my fill! Hopefully they start serving the wine and champagne again was bummed that service was unavailable as you do pay more for the services here and would have been a nice option to have.

Love the bagels. Mine is always a 'lunch' type affair replete with all the goods.

Have to drop a star for the container of Sundried Tomato cream cheese that was covered in mold when I opened it two days after I bought it. It came straight home and went into the fridge on Saturday. Opened it Monday only to find a constellation of black mold spots all over it.... [insert disgusted face here].

I absolutely LOVE this place!!! Staff is so friendly, the facility is soo cute and clean and they are really fast!! I've had trouble in the past finding somewhere good I can take my fur baby & I'm grateful I found y'all!! Y'all make him look so handsome! Can't wait for his next haircut! :-)
AJ did such a great job on my nails and was so funny and friendly. After recently moving I can say I have definitely found the place to get my nails done.

I took my daughter here to get her nails done for her 5th birthday. Everyone at the salon was very friendly and all wished her a happy birthday. Establishment seemed clean, and her nails stayed on for 6 weeks!! Which is record breaking for a 5 year old!

Love this place!

Great gluten-free burgers. I recommend the classic, with the po-balls. But I've yet to try one of the French Fry options that isn't awesome. 

My only frustration with this place? It takes people such a freakin long time to place their order. Newbs are especially irritating. Too many choices for most people to handle, so they just freeze. May I make a suggestion? Stand back at out of the way, watch a few of us pros place our order while you make your extensive analysis of the menu board. It's really not that tough, and you're aggravating those of us who know what we want and are drooling all over your back!

Stopped in on a recommendation for a bed frame and mattress, but the girl on the sales floor was so scatter brained and hardly present that it was a waste of my time. Not only did she not help me with questions I had, she just quoted quick prices and then disappeared into the back to help other people while helping me. After standing around way too long waiting for her to come back, I just decided to leave the store. The selections were not very quality in my opinion either. Quick, cheaply made furniture. Won't be back.
Shadow's is a great place to take your dog for a wash or service.  The facilities are great and service even better.  Highly recommend Shadow's.

I love this place and more importantly my fur baby does as well. Their prices are reasonable and my favorite part is that they do exactly as you want. (Trim here not there etc.) They have a friendly staff and the place is real clean!

Good burgers and decent fries. Fry sauce tastes like it's made with Miracle Whip instead of real mayo. For some people that may be a good thing, but for me it needs to be real mayo. The pepper bar is welcome and enjoyed that.  Next trip going to try a BBQ chicken salad that looked really good when it came out for someone else.  

It was pretty busy, and they were not actively cleaning the tables. The booth we sat in was really dirty and had to be wiped before we could eat. The tile floors were also really dirty and slick, my toddler actually slipped and fell on the tile because of this. The outside covered patio seating is nice.

Buyer beware on their listings. I recently bought an item without reviewing it first. I went off their description and only their description. The description and photo did not match and I couldn't get any answers until after the auction was finalized and they told me I purchased a product for nearly twice the going price. Highly unorganized and I wish I would have looked at other reviews before working with them. There are several other reviews with the same issue, them saying one thing and the actual item not being as described. So unless you can go and review in person I would stay away from this auction at all costs.

First off this review does NOT regard my nails because they turned out wonderful and so was the man who did them. This review is about the two fake & rude receptionists. I was sitting right up front, next to the front desk and was appalled by their conversations. When I am paying OVER $100 at a salon, I expect more professionalism. Not only did I hear them make fun of people out on the streets while the door was open, they went as far as to call people inbreds. Absolutely rude. I heard them talk rude about an old client & laughed and said "what is she gunna do about it? Just don't come back in? Sorry baby girl." and the one girl was using profanities each sentence. Every time a guest would come in or call on the phone, the girls voices went up 5 octaves. No need to be fake or talk like that while you are on the job. They were even rude to the man who did my nails and snickered at him. Classless. I will sadly not being come back in until they are gone, bc my nails were great.

It has been great to see many business adapt to the Covid climate and continue to provide excellent service to customers. Sadly for Big Al's this has been the complete opposite. My wife son and I went today for some bowling and arcade games for a fun Friday outing. This was the second chance my wife and I had decided to give this place after a separate negative experience in the dining establishment where we as customers were required as wait and service staff due to the DRASTIC lack of appropriate staffing. We went today a couple months later and to my dismay this establishment has only gotten worse. You have staff running around trying to keep their heads above water as they are tasked with a ridiculous amount of responsibility. Of course this naturally leads to an abysmal experience for all customers. It took about 20 minutes to get our bowling lane functional and working after multiple return trips to the counter and eventually having to be bumped to a adjacent lane. I do not fault the employees working as it is blatantly apparent they are being forced to run the establishment by management with a disgustingly inadequate amount of staff. We then couldn't finish our bowling games as the lane shut down with two frames left in our second game and at this point we were over it and wanted to take the kiddo up to enjoy some arcade games. This was only to find out once we got upstairs that their one machine that reload gameplay cards is inoperable. This place has gone to absolute shit and it is sad because it used to be a place for family fun and enjoyment. However it is now apparent that the current owners and operators of this establishment have chosen to drastically under staff this place so that they can provide a worse experience for their clientele in order to maintain their profits by shorting the staff members they employ. Fantastic example of a business doing it completely wrong and they have most definitely assured that I will not be a return customer.

Terrible customer service! 
My husband and I were looking for some ski/trek poles. He found one set that was still in the package (not missing any parts) marked $23.99. There were others there that were not packaged, and missing several parts marked $19.99. He grabbed the packaged one ($23.99), and one set with missing parts and we went to the counter.  When the girl (blonde, who was very polite) rang us up, the price on both was $23.99. My husband politely questioned the missing parts price and went back to find a set for $19.99. (We weren't going to pay $23.99 for a set with several missing parts). He found a set ($19.99) and asked to be rung up for that one instead (we had already paid for two at $23.99 but hadn't left the store) the girl seemed confused on what to do (from looking at the complaints, probably because they don't do refunds and she didn't know what to do - however we hadn't left the register). She went to get help. In comes Stephanie. My husband politely explained the difference in price and parts missing. Stephanie didn't say anything, so he briefly went over it again. Stephanie then snapped "We don't need to go over this over and over again"- like she was speaking to a child! Up until this point, we had no complaints with the store, but this was over the top RUDE!) I told her that her customer service skills were horrible, and having spent 20 years working many levels of customer service, this was unacceptable behavior. Stephanie just got more indignant and I asked for a manager. We asked for our money back as we refuse to spend money in a store that treats it's customers (the bread and butter of retail) so poorly.  I told her she should have kept her feelings towards our questions to herself. When leaving we asked another employee what Stephanie's name was, and Stephanie said loudly "Oh I'll be talking to the owner myself!" In other words, she'll be heading off my complaint.
Stephanie shouldn't be working with customers. This is the wrong position for her. In my opinion, she can't control her mouth. If she continues as is, I know she'll be upsetting customers in the future. Good luck with that.
As you can see from my Yelp history, I am not an unreasonable poster. Only when something is egregious, will I post a complaint. Stephanie was extremely offensive  to my husband and I for simply having questions.
I will never shop at Steelz again. And I will make sure that everyone I know in the area doesn't shop there either. I'll be posting this review on my FB page and several other social media sites.

Where to begin? Food is disgusting, staff is rude and the whole thing is just a mess. The patio has tables stacked on top of others, and it looks so bad. The meals came cold and the staff acts like they'd rather be anywhere else but at work. Skip this place if you're in town.

Boise Fry Company never disappoints - even amid a pandemic! We ordered through a delivery app and our food came hot and our bag of fries even had instructions to heat if we weren't satisfied. I order the brussel sprouts every time (they're THAT good) and this time I tried and loved the BFC. My husband got his usual variation of a burger and fries and, as always, was very happy with the choices and customizations available.

So many great things to say about Kelsey at Beautiful Reaction! I just had my hair done by her for the first time after four months of not being able to go to a salon due to covid. Kelsey is a pro. She assessed what my previous stylist did, what my re growth looked like and the photos of what I wanted. She worked several hours on getting each piece of my hair colored and cut exactly the way I envisioned. Her pricing is also lower than where I previously went and her conversation and hot towel service are awesome! Highly recommend her for blondes and cuts!

The flavor in their empanadas in outstanding and the lemon dessert is phenomenal! I love supporting small, local businesses and this is one whose food is delicious and their service is very personal and exceeds expectations.

Not a wide selection of doughnuts in the mornings on Saturday, the lady seemed to be pretty in a rush to get us out of there and on the the next but. Let's talk about the doughnuts they are soft yes good doughnuts but there where no doughnuts holes so I can't speak for those the original can't compare with kk but over pretty good

Still the best.  Dining room is closed but outdoor seating socially distanced with umbrellas for shade.  Order inside with barricades to keep your distance from the counter. Still tasty as can be. Still recommend a half a chef salad,  I substitute feta.  If you can catch them with lemon cookies in stock they are super yummy. Coke products.  

Chef Wally is the best and he has very experienced help. Do yourself a favor and get on down here.

Have been here twice. Once when they were doing there preview and once again the day they opened. Both times besides a little slow service on the preview day the food has been top notch. There menu is simple but they have some options even for people who don't want a burger. You can taste the freshness in the burgers and fries and the price is right on par for what u get. You can easily eat with a full combo meal for under 10 bucks which is an awesome deal for a good quality burger. I will be coming back to the HABIT many many many time. The only true down fall is they don't have the multi choice coke machine and when you get your order everything comes on one tray so if there is more then 1 of u there isn't anything for the other people to eat over which can be a little messy.
I ordered the silver duck I believe (roast beef sandwich with sprouts etc) and holy crap this is a good sandwich. SO GOOOOOD.

I came here for the first time today and I couldn't have had a better experience! Today was my daughters 5th birthday and we took her to get her favorite food in the entire world -a turkey club sandwich. Not only was the owner incredibly kind and giving but the food was amazing. 
The owner even made it a point to make my little girl feel special on her day. 
Thank you so much. I will definitely be coming back again soon. 
I had the wally special and it was amazing, and my daughter ate her entire turkey club!

Everything is made in house, from scratch.
Pure gold.

I can not wait to return.
I love when food is fresh and prepared well.
Great quality, great quantity.

Okay so I just want to state I'm not a fan of crab Rangoons what so ever. Although they call them crispy flowers, it's their own take on crab Rangoon. I decided to try it because 1. I'm pregnant and 2. The weren't just really hard fried egg roll paper with a teaspoon on cream cheese. They were delicious. 
We ordered the "together" appetizer and it came with the flower crispies and spring rolls. If I am correct there was five around each and I found it was a pretty big appetizer.
The spring rolls were also fresh and delicious.
Too be honestly I haven't stopped thinking about either since we finished them. 

The pad Thai was also really good. The only thing I'd change is the fact that the chicken was in considerably large portions on top the PAd Thai. I think it would be better placed in and in smaller portions. 
Very happy I finally came to check out this amazing Thai restaurant. 
Great little spot!

Usually have good experiences here 
Well not so good this time 
Watch ordering salads first thing in morning apparently they use lettuce from night before 
Brown edges inedible in my wife's opinion 
Asked for compensation or a new fresh to go 
Sorry can't do that you already ate the top and the chicken and I can give you a bowl of new lettuce is what they offered 
I may second guess making this my choice for a Sunday lunch option .

The place is nice, and from what I saw they had one confident; experienced barber and 2 frightened young girls.  I try new things now and then, so I skipped my main st. barber this time and gave them a shot.

I should have waited for the obviously experienced one with the (Blue or Green, I don't recall) ponytail.

When you're in the chair and the cut is almost done and you ask a question and the person cutting your hair says something like "I get my barber's license tomorrow,"  It's time to shut up, nod your head and get out.  

Well, I'm not that rude in person, so I waited until she was finished and when she put a mirror in front of me while my hands were pinned under the bib along with my glasses, I just nodded and got up to pay.  Ironically,  left her a good tip because this girl's got a long road ahead...

I got home and my wife laughed. The whole left side stuck straight out and a few clumps of thick hair mixed in with really thin spots along that same side made me look like 2 different barbers cut my hair, each taking a different side.   I comb my hair straight back, so the differences really stuck out.

It'll grow out, and I'll go back to the guys on Main Street who've done a great job for me before and call it a lesson learned.  I'll just be facing folks a little sideways as I sit & stand facing left a little to show the good side for a few weeks...
Great value and nice staff. My sister and I went here recently and had a wonderful time and our nails look fantastic.
Food is great and in a good location but incredibly long delivery times every time I order. Dine in our order carry out
service is a joke in this place, 45 mins waiting and the order was all messed up. there were non plates, no cutlery and no apology from the waiter. the bowling alley is pretty good though.

I see a lot of potential for this little spot! If you love tea, definitely check Potter's out. I'm going to offer a lot of suggestions because I really want them to succeed. 

I've been in twice now. The first time to try some tea and the second to buy some of their loose tea for a present. I will begin this by saying, I'm not a tea drinker. At all. Borderline loathe it. BUT... I did not dislike the tea I had here, so that is a very good sign. I tried the Chocolate truffle and it really was delicious! Tasted chocolatey and creamy with a hint of spice. 

One of the owners was manning the counter and he was very kind and pleasant. He answered our questions and let us smell the blends that we were interested in. 

Their location is actually quite large, though a bit awkwardly set up. You walk through a darker sitting area to get to a brightly lit, but not very aesthetically pleasing counter. I think the front area could benefit from a freshening up. They had some old tea sets pushed to the side that would have made nice displays. Perhaps the sterility of the space could be softened with old nick-knacks and tchotchkes. The giant leather couch in the seating area looked comfy  but didn't promote cozy tea cottage feel. 

I would LOVE to see real teacups in use. However your drink is served in a to-go container (though I believe it was decomposable so that's a plus). Wouldn't it be lovely to come here for some great tea, conversation and to have a high tea experience? 

There are a few pastries available but they looked pretty sad. Most were wrapped in plastic, displayed in a plastic case. There was barely enough to fill 1/4 of the case. I totally get not wanting to put out too much in case they don't sell. But maybe they could display in a different way? A few different elevations, with glass pedestals and domed containers? The few tea things they did have out were not displayed prominently or with style. 

Potter's shares space with a small candy shop called Sweet Zola's. They have lots of nostalgic candy, but the best part is that they only employ young folks with developmental delays! Pretty cool. 

The product and workers here are great. I mostly think the ambiance of the place needs a rehaul to draw in people and make them want to stay.

Our first time eating here was excellent!! We ordered a custom pizza and a salad online and used the curbside option. Our order was ready on time and made exactly per our request. The food was SO good. The salad was really fresh and the pizza was huge and delicious! This is our new favorite place in the Treasure Valley! We will definitely be eating here again!

What a delicious burger. I got a classic cheese burger with the fried green beans. The green beans are delicious and so are their fries, I ate some of my friend's. Both sides were hot and fresh and crisp. The burger is made really well with good quality beef, not over cooked and dry, quite juicy. It's put together very nicely with fresh lettuce, tomatoes and onions and a fresh soft bun. I really enjoyed it. I'm very particular about my burgers. The staff was happy and friendly and provided great customer service. The establishment is clean and modern and spacious. I've made this place my go to burger place.

Really fun day with my 13 year old twin sons. Lots of slides to choose from and a great wave pool and lazy river. Food was pretty reasonably priced too. Staff was super friendly. Great experience - would do it again next time we're in that area!

Liked it a lot. Tried 6 different kinds of tacos and liked all of them. Reasonably priced, staff seemed nice, I'd go back. Curious if the location in Boise is that different. Location is a little out of the way from the highway. Wish I would have gotten a jarrito drink instead of fountain soda.
Have eaten there a couple of times food is ok. Love the patio seating. Music inside is quiet loud hard to have a conversation. Salad is really good.

Eddy, the server was fantastic. Everyone that you come in contact with is wonderful. The food is good, not great, but the service makes it worth coming back for.  The rice is not typical Mexican rice, but wow, it pops! Thanks for the great service!

I only have good things to say about this place. We went into the store 15 minutes before they closed but they still went above and beyond to help my son. In the end we purchased a phone rather than getting his repaired and even though it was well past closing, Eric made sure all of our questions were answered and his phone was fully functioning and ready to use. Phone problems are frustrating and usually very expensive however these will always be my go to guys to make those problems disappear. Thanks again for all you did and the extra time you didn't have to spend helping us out.

We have been coming to the Ram for years. I have to say within the past few years, they are inconsistent in their service and especially the quality of the food. We have been there for lunch, happy hour and dinner and have been delighted (in the past) and disappointed (recently). I would really like them to pick a cuisine and stick with it instead of trying so hard to do so
much, maybe they'd become more consistent: 1. Burgers are generally good, but often way over cooked, and that's after they ask how you'd like it prepared. 2. Steaks smell awesome. They are "usually" cooked to the desired doneness - but dear God, their own steak knives could barely cut the meat and the toughness could only be fixed by slow-cooking it all day, and there goes any sign of rareness. Terrible steaks, do not recommend unless you like chewing and chewing and chewing. 3. Salads? Perfect. Sometimes weird combinations, but to me, that's what makes a salad good. 4. Ribs and fish? They're trying to show off their ale-inspired batter and sauces. Sauces are good, ribs are shoe leather with bones. Fish is tasteless and as with the rest of the menu - over cooked. Hard and dry fish and chips as well as grilled salmon are a crime of nature. 5. Happy hour: drinks are very good. 6. Appetizers are (surprise!) often over cooked. I've had their wings several times and they are so hard a fork can't get into the meat and it just shatters. We're not talking the wing bones, but the alleged meat: hard to the point of shattering if rapped on the plate. Disappointing. But the topper lately: they've got a new ordering system that the servers hand-carry with them. My check was presented, I paid with card which is inserted into this handheld device and given back to sign. The tip is pre indicated (the 20% was pre-selected for "convenience") but their math is not the math I grew up knowing. Last night's check came to $32. I checked 20% tip and signed, expecting a $6.40 tip added. I was charged $9 for the tip. A few dollars scam isn't a deal-breaker, but bad food preparation, inconsistent service AND tip scamming IS a deal-breaker. Ten years ago we'd visit the Ram once every week or two. I've visited three times since September and each time was disappointing. The tip scam has definitely cooled my desire to go back. Goodbye, Ram, for a long while...please, fix what's wrong. I liked the Ram, fix your menu and preparations.
EDIT: Someone  from the Ram contacted me via email to contact the manager. I did and left  my phone number. About a week later a disinterested man called me, said "yeah, we'll look into that", referring to my bad review. He then offered me a free meal. Whoops. Bribing me without offering to fix your restaurant's issues is the kiss of death. Goodbye, Ram. It's been an up and down 19 years we've been going to your place, but there are better places with better service and food. You can keep the "free" meal and the 2-for-one coupons.

I have had two pedicures here. The first one wasn't bad, wasn't the best but not the worst. I decided to try the place again since it is convenient and it was the WORST pedicure I have ever had. The woman at the front desk apologized because she knew it was terrible. She called the owner and was told there was nothing they could do about it except have my nails repainted. My nails were a good length when I came in and there were cut so short the skin under my nail was showing and hurt. They were not only horribly short they were crooked and didn't match. There was nail polish on my skin on almost every toe as well. Terrible!!!! I did try to reach out to the company from their contact info online and have yet to hear back. Save yourself and go somewhere else. This place looks nice but it's like lipstick on a pig.
Giant sandwiches and amazing potato salad. The meat is top notch. No mystery meats here.

The Ram has reopened, but maybe they shouldn't have.. I know it's a "Challenging time for all' but getting curbside from these guys was expensive, ($60 no drinks) and just not very good. I ordered the Sgt. Pepper burger, it was like a mouthful of...something. Just plain blah mush I didn't finish it. Sweet potato fries cost extra and were not cooked all the way. We got the skillet cookie desert Which was partly raw, maybe take N bake? ( My wife had to put it in the oven) Also watch out for these guys the payment machine defaults to a 25% tip. If your not paying attention you'll be driving away before you catch it. Some of the servers will ask you if you want to leave 30 or 35%. Really!? We won't be back.
5 staff members at desk when I walked in. None of them acknowledged me. Walked around looking for 15 minutes. Not one of the staff came to see if I needed help. Walked out.

I took my girlfriend here after researching the valley for over a week looking for a charcuterie AND cheese board.  You will not believe me but Grant's was the only place I was able to locate which offers this.  The closest I came to was Red Feather downtown but they had no boards which had both, only one or the other and would have had to spend almost $40 to get the variety which I believed was commonplace - as I am familiar with the F&B industry locally and in CA.,HI.,etc.  

The board was amazing with adventurous (for a board) smoked salmon, smoked duck and 2 other traditional charcuterie meats I don't recall; Also on the board was 3 different Artisan cheeses, local valley-sourced honey, granny-smith green apple slices, house-made pickles, dates, prunes and house-made dijon that had a diffenet horseradish essence to it..  All the flavor and color was awesome and done with professional presentation on the board, the bartender gave us an explanation of the board when he served it and continued to make good but un-intrusive conversation with us about Gran'ts and focused a lot on making sure we knew that they source locally and prepared as much as possible in-house.  The portions, , flavors, preparation and variety made the board an awesome value.
$18.00

The other item we ordered was the slider board, it had a brie beef slider (which they make in house with %70 chuck and %30 brisket), a fried chicken (white meat) & house-marinated kimchee slider, and roasted pork & slaw slider and the board had their house-made pickles on it as well (they like to throw those around ha).  All if it was very tasty and again, professional presented.  Another great value, I think $11 if I'm remembering correctly.  

Decor was a little rough behind the bar, although it is a pleasant place the environment does not do their cuisine justice.  The covered patio with drop-down see-throughs seems as though it seats more than the dining room which is cool.  The only negative thing I have to say is that they should keep non-educated bartenders/servers out of the bar.  My girl ordered a "Goose Cosmo" and was initially served a ill-prepared well-Cosmo which was then fixed to a proper martini after bringing it to the primary bartenders attention.

Great value, very good service, we'll go back again.

I had such high hopes for this place but was sadly disappointed, in a lot of ways. 
First, the tacos were flavorless. We had to put quite a bit of salsa on them to make them flavorful. 
Second, the establishment was dirty. The tables were filthy and the floor was covered in crumbs. 
Third, I tried Tin Roof a few weeks ago & while I was hesitant to leave a review, even with the unimpressive food, they appeared to be very pro-police! You don't see a lot of companies these days that are pro-police so I was willing to give them a second chance! Now that I am learning that they are taking their customers voices away for expressing their freedom of speech, I will no longer be giving this establishment a second chance. 
This wouldn't fly in Texas, where they're from & certainly won't fly here in Idaho. Be a better part of our community.

Buyer beware. What you see is not what you get. Garbage. Also, their soft bidding practice is borderline illegal. They continuously add 4 minutes to bidding when under 1 minute...Criminal...stay away!

Do NOT recommend going here. Under the care of Dr Morigeau I declined rapidly and they did nothing. Once a NJ tube was placed they messed up and didn't send the right formula paperwork to the formula company, leaving me without a way to eat or feed for 5 DAYS. Their words since it was a 3 day weekend was I was just SOL. Dr Morigeau also thought it was appropriate to throw in my face that I got a second opinion and literally said 'I'm not holding you hostage' and name dropped who I saw at another practice. DO NOT RECOMMEND HERE OR DR MORIGEAU. She also refused to apologize and saw nothing wrong with what she said as I was coming out of general anesthesia. Disgusting lack of patient care and empathy

I am surprised by how much I genuinely love Big Als. It really is a perfect place to hang as an adult or bring your kids. 

I've come with just my family and also a corporate event, and both times were impressed and left having a great time. 

Their pizza is really good, definitely not large chain quality (mean that in the best way). And their burgers are also great. 

Honestly, Big Als is 100% worth all the hype it gets. I definitely recommend! 

My only complaint is the price. It's crazy expensive... but if you budget and plan than it's worth it.

I am completely in awe of how fantastic my experience was at Nail Tek! I brought my mom with me and Nail Tek exceeded my expectations. The staff was extremely friendly and made our experience! We both had pedicures with extreme attention to detail - far more than I have ever experienced! You can tell that they take pride in their work and want customers to be satisfied! I'm impressed, consider me a regular because I won't be trying other places to find something better (because frankly, I don't think there is)! 

My mom needed a quick manicure too, and they were able to squeeze her in after we arrived! Not only were our pedicures fantastic and well with the price, the staff did everything possible to meet our needs! They also asked if there was anything we needed multiple times which provided me the opportunity to ask for something if I needed it.

I noticed some reviews about reused tools and lack of antibacterial, but everything was completely up to my expectations for cleanliness. Both of us had antibacterial drops added to our water before we started which could be difficult to see if I hadn't been paying meticulous attention in a (new to me) salon. Tools were sanitized and I was never worried that my safety was a concern.

On a side note, I would make an appointment because this place is fantastic and therefore busy! They are worth your pre-planning and will ensure your nails are just what you are hoping for!

***Update: I went back to Nail Tek to have a full-set done today! From Saturday to today, I managed to mess up my toes and Ha repaired them at no charge! My full-set came out beautifully and exactly what I wanted - Classic French tip with some sparkle! My nails took a little while to do, but every "can you shorten this" or "can you smooth this out a little more" was done without making me feel picky or obsessive! I really love this place, and if you don't try it, you are missing out on a truly awesome nail experience!

Such a nice and friendly place to eat in or take out.  Truly traditional.  The Traditional Beef was well made abs tender with a nice blend of spices.  The Chicken chimichurri was delectable!  Happy aHour special $12 for two empanadas and a nice draft.  

Husband and wife are very caring abs attentive.  Skip the chains, go local.
Amazing burgers, and amazing customer service, they make the fries out of the Idaho potatoes, and they taste greatttt!!!

This is the best Sandwhich shop in Boise. They are innovative, flexible, and use the best, high quality ingredients. It is locally owned and operated and I have yet to taste a sandwich that doesn't just totally blow me away. Their bacon is fantastic. All their different breads are wonderful and they are happy to make any swaps or substitutions. If you want a killer sandwich in Boise, this is the place.

I am from california and this water park just amazed my family and I with what they had to offer especially compared to where we go in our state.  First off the food was very economical and unlike california did not empty your pockets for a hamburger or pizza.  The food was pretty good as well!  Some of the water features were also heated which is nice and the variety of water features was ample for the price we paid to get in.  We did have some young children with us so it was especially nice to see they had a really large safe area for non swimmers and plenty of actual slides to go down for the kids to entertain themselves the whole time.  I enjoyed the park very much and I would recommend this park... of course as long as the ambient temperature is above 85 degrees but that is true for any water park!  Thanks Roaring Springs....

Amazing!! The food, no matter what you order, is amazing!! The smoke flavor isn't over powering. The sandwiches are huge, actually all the portions are large. The coleslaw is great! These two know what they are doing!

Absolutely horrible location. Every time I come here I always have a negative experience with the employees. Today I was waiting in line for approximately 15 minutes and this one girl with big scary lashes and an attitude kept looking at us and I didn't know why. After the car in front of us ordered. She seemed to look confused so I let her know I was next in line since cars were all over the place behind me. She proceeded to give me an extremely rude look along with an unpleasant attitude! I immediately left the line. I come to Dutch bro's for a delicious coffee and a welcoming conversation with employees. I received neither today. I will not be returning to this location.

Love this dental office.
They see you at your appointment time.  Nothing better than having your time respected.
They hygienist uses hand tools and does a great job.  Taking their time and not rushing.

They are also super with kids.  They give kids a coin at the end of their appointment to use in one of two toy machines.

Well decorated and clean office.  Clean clean clean.
I can't rave enough!

Superb service.  Great value.  Didn't have any problems after installation.  Only thing I would change is the blue tint/shade.  I thought it would be fine, but it's at the same height as my line of sight since I'm so tall.  Next time I'll ask for the window without that.

I love this place and more importantly my fur baby does as well. Their prices are reasonable and my favorite part is that they do exactly as you want. (Trim here not there etc.) They have a friendly staff and the place is real clean! I hope in the future they carry more clothes for the small dogs in their boutique.
The food was delicious but the price didn't match the amount of food served. My husband and I were both hungry after eating our entrees.

I am "repurposing" a cart and the nylon on the much-used cart I bought was REALLY dirty . It is an old cart, but I wanted to see if it was possible to achieve "somewhat" clean.  

A lot of shops might have passed on such a small project because there is not much in it for them financially, BUT, boy oh boy, Muriel and Chris embraced the challenge as through I was offering them the opportunity to clean a fleet of vehicles!  

Upon first meeting I was greeted as though I was a long time client. 
I think how a business treats the "little guy" tells you a lot about their commitment and Chris and Muriel impressed me. 

When I arrived there were vehicles "in progress" in their place of business, so they asked me leave it with them and they promised to have it ready in an hour.  I was a little surprised and thought I would need to pick it up another day.  I returned in an hour to find a VERY good outcome.   

Good work, great staff, very reasonable pricing.  Who could ask for more!  Thank you Chris and Muriel for your skills, your kindness and your willingness to take on small  projects at a very very fair price.
I love, love, LOVE Sa-Wad-Dee! They have the best Thai food and sushi in Boise. Heading there right now to eat. Going to order the pineapple fried rice and some sushi. Mmm

Weekends are busy, so a wait for breakfast is expected    What wasn't anticipated was having host Josh immediately seat his party of 3 friends while my party of 3 had been waiting for a table 
We weren't in Alyssa's section, but she saw how long we'd been waiting to order, and she took our order 
Mandie also knows how to hustle with a smile! 
If you get the right staff, it'll be a great experience; if you don't, you won't.

The person running this establishment was completely rude. On my lunch break I ordered food for takeout and I ended up working a late one. I called and let them know that I was running 2 hours later than intended. By the time I got there the man had asked what took me so long, I said why? And he said because he had to remake the order 2 times because I was late. I told him I called and he said no you didn't. Rather than argue and bicker with him I said forget it and to credit me. Ruined my appetite for this place
I love there empanadas. And I also love the way the place looks super clean. Also the customer service is super fast.

We had been wanting to try BFC for awhile and on whim got dinner here on a week night. We ordered online for pick up. I appreciate that they don't start the fries until you arrive so they are as crispy as possible when you get home.  I got a turkey burger and my husband had the bison burger with bacon. We both really enjoyed our burgers and fries. We just ordered a large russet fries and they were delicious and the portion was huge! We will for sure come back to check out the other potato options and dipping sauces! The blueberry ketchup has me intrigued! This is a solid place for a good burger and fries!

I rate a good sandwich place based on the Reuben.  This is a GREAT sandwich place!  
Fast, Friendly and Affordable.  They will need to expand soon if they keep making food like this!
Thanks!

This is the coolest idea. Cut my dog wash time in 1/2 at minimum. And dryers, soap, brushes, towels, smell good are included. And to top it off...a treat. We will without a doubt be back. The staff was friendly and the shop dog Charlie is the sweetest little gal. Grateful for a place like this. Our Golden had a bad past experience and remains very skittish when washed or brushed. The tubs here enabled us to maintain some control and keep the mess to a minimum. Want to know he greatest part...I didn't have to clean up the mess or puppy size hair balls left behind.

Seriously?  This place got four and five stars? I was disappointed, seemed like it was just so so as for food quality.  The environmentalist was terrible, extremely loud, seemed like the seating was entirely too tight, and worst of all the server seemed to preoccupied with the table that had the rude and obnoxious group to even notice that our drinks weren't full. 
Some people go out of their way to keep customers happy "that's what customer service is about" some people rely on their friends writing great reviews and then snub their real customers, and still yet some don't seem overly concerned either way, the staff at this place seemed a mix of the last two.

Empanadas for everyone! Truly perfection. I stopped by on a work trip and BOY, I wished I lived closer! The vegan curry was amazing regardless of what you eat, if you like curry you will love it! The mushroom and cheese went great with Chimichurri sauce. They can do gluten free but request a batch ahead of time. The dough is perfect, also like that they stamp the number of empanada you ordered on the dough for east recognition when reheating a batch. They can be ordered to go hot or cold to heat at home, very authentic

My husband and I went to try this place and it was very good.  The owner and chef is very sweet! The empanadas look like they had a thick heavy dough but it isn't at all.  The filling is delicious, non-greasy, filled with meat if you get the meat filling ones and well flavored. The dough is like a thicker flaky croissant dough and not heavy at all. I'm not a carb person but I ate everything. We ordered 6 of them and our favorite was the spicy one. When the empanadas come out, the dough itself has a little dough number on it, so you know which one you are eating. Such a cute touch! We needed up ordering a few to go and planning to come back very soon. It's a little gem here in Boise. I'm impressed!

Emily Chapin is amazing at her job very professional and fun to talk to! My lashes look amazing too 10 stars for amazing customer service and beautiful lash work she was def made for the beauty industry!

We took our four-year-old twins into the arcade for the 1st time today! They had a BLAST!! The manager of the arcade made our experience even better! He was patient and helpful! I stopped in here early morning, about 6 am, to get 2 dozen doughnuts for a work meeting. The couple working were friendly and are hard workers. They had the doughnut case super full and fresh. It was a busy morning for them and they were working hard to get everyone's day started right and timely. 

Durning the meeting there were many compliments on the doughnuts and asked where I got them. I thought that was cool because they're just doughnuts after all, but apparently, people know when they get a good doughnut and DK delivers. 

FUN FACT:
This review had me pondering-- is it Doughnut or Donut. I hadn't put much thought into it until now. According to grammarist.com, the dictionary-approved spelling for the ring-shaped cake made of dough and fried in fat is doughnut. The shortened donut has been around since the late 1800s, but it wasn't popularized until the late 20th century, when the successful American doughnut chain Dunkin' Donuts made it ubiquitous. Today, writers outside the U.S. still favor doughnut by a wide margin. Donut appears about a third of the time in published American writing.

This is one of the best pho places I've ever been! It's cute inside, staff was super nice! We were lucky enough to try their new "street food" crepe, it was sooo good! Spring rolls are super fresh and delicious, and of course the pho was outstanding! We can't wait to go back!

There are a few ways I view our experiences at Guymon Orthdontics: the quality of work and care, customer service, and facilities. 

We felt from start to finish that Dr. Guymon and all the technicians were top shelf - everyone is well trained and experienced.  They are efficient and took the time to explain everything as we went never leaving a question unanswered; a reassuring experience we appreciated.  We couldn't ask for more and my son's teeth are simply spectacular!

I'm big on customer service and at no time were staff anything less than friendly and engaging.  We always felt welcomed and it felt more than a patient/Doctor relationship. To say it was truly outstanding understates the quality of care and customer service.

The office is clearly kid friendly and in the midst of all the fun things for kids to do, there is an orthodontics business. It truly is something to see and experience.  

Top to bottom Guymon Orthodontics is truly incredible and my son's teeth look fantastic!  If it isn't the model for amazing orthodontia care it should be.

Boise Fry is consistently my favorite burger spot in the Boise area. The burgers always taste fresh and are not over thought. The fries are some of the best I've ever had. I'd recommend the classic burger or the vegan burger and you can't go wrong with any selection of fries you choose. Make sure you sample the blueberry ketchup!
We waited an hour and a half for a small pizza and ten wings. We were the only ones in the restaurant. It ended up being $23 and was a huge waste of money and time.

I wanted to treat my visiting daughter-in-law to lunch this afternoon while my son was off snowboarding with an old college friend. She loves Thai food, so based on Yelp reviews I chose this restaurant. 
We were greeted by a friendly hostess, who indicated a table for four right near the door and proceeded to carry our menus to that table. When we expressed our wish to sit farther in, near the window at an available table for two, indicating that we'd be happy to wait for it to be cleared, she set our menus down on the table for four and wandered off. I felt like maybe we offended her?  Anyway, another employee came by and seated us at the window table. 
So far, so good. The restaurant was clean and pleasantly decorated, and there were lots of delicious-looking choices on the menu. 
We decided to order spring rolls with dipping sauce as an appetizer, and chose to pay extra to have them served lettuce wrapped because my daughter-in-law follows the low-carb Paleo diet. When they were served, I was astounded to see a plate of deep-fried mini egg rolls (wrappers were dough) with a small pile of iceberg lettuce leaves placed on the side. NOT my idea of spring rolls, and definitely not served lettuce wrapped. We were expected to take those deep-fried rolls and wrap lettuce leaves around them ourselves? I wanted to send them back. She didn't want to make a fuss, so instead she scraped the filling out of the dough and put it into the lettuce, leaving behind a pile of fried dough on her plate. Did I mention that the "lettuce wrapped" option cost more?!
Our lunch entrees were both okay, but by this time I no longer really cared about the food and focused instead on enjoying her company and conversation. Which I did. She's delightful! 
Would I eat here again? Well, there are other Thai options in the Treasure Valley that I will likely try first before returning to this one.

I don't usually give poor reviews, I try to look for what the restaurant did right, and there were a few things to call out, but overall, it was not a great experience. We were along for the ride and were happy to go spend time with my parents while we're here from out of town. I understand too that many places don't have good workers right now, but man, the wait was horrendous. We waited probably 15 minutes to be seated in an almost empt restaurant. Once seated it took another 15 minutes before we got our drink orders and we asked if we could just put in our dinner order at the same time, but she said no. After waiting another 10-15 minutes she came back with our waters and took our dinner order. The whole ordeal ended up being close to an hour and a half, which is insane for an almost empty restaurant. My heart goes out to them, but it seems like they shouldn't be open if they don't have the necessary help. Had it just been my family, I would have left, but my parents really wanted to eat here. The one redeeming aspect to our visit was that our server brought out a full banana for my 9 month old baby to eat and didn't charge us for it. I had planned to give him some of our food off our plates but it took so long he was getting really feisty. Such terrible service.

I know service is going downhill everywhere but her manners where something else. Went to get a game card. Standing in line on the required box per instructions. Game attendant kept chatting with his friend and would not even wait on us until we asked if he was working or should we call for someone else. Will not be going back.

Reserved the hotel for 3 nights and ended up staying 7 nights so it was pretty great that they had that availability. Stevie did a great job cleaning the interior of my car. I will definitely be back for detailing on all of my vehicles. It was easy to make an appt and easy to find their location in Meridian.

Had high hopes for this new neighborhood restaurant, since both my wife and sister in-law raved about the original Capri location downtown Boise, however our first visit here was just OK. My wife had a waffle with berries and whipped cream and said she liked it, my French toast breakfast with bacon and eggs started with the eggs being over easy (ordered scrambled) and I had to wait 10 mins. to get syrup. Since I was hungry, and didn't want to complain, I went ahead and ate the eggs while trying to get the waitresses attention. Finally asked another waiter and I was pleased the bottle was warm, since my French toast was cold by this point. I was very disappointed on my first bite to find what looked like maple syrup had no flavor or smell. I suspect it was cheap corn syrup (Mrs. Butterworths would have been better).
Coffee refills were quick and we didn't have to ask, the place was clean, neat and new. The bacon was very good, rivaled Joe Mammas. The service was good considering they were busy. Since we were seated at the counter, I was able to observe the table clearings, and noted there was a good deal of food being left on the returned plates. Not a good sign, and someone should investigate to see what needs to change. For me, if they changed to a better grade of syrup, even if it wasn't real maple syrup, I would be mostly satisfied with the short-comings I've noted, even the eggs. Will we go back, yes maybe (I'll order something else), but no hurry, there are better choices available. Oh, and Delsa's ice-cream will be opening soon inside the same space...

Very over priced.  I ordered a salad, all it was was lettuce and apples with a watery dressing.

This was my first visit to El Tenampa and I was quite pleased. Our server, Eddy, promptly greeted us and was friendly, efficient, welcoming, and attentive through our entire stay. The complimentary chips and salsa we started with were fresh and delicious, and always kept filled. 

The menu is pretty extensive and includes all the typical obligatory favorites (tacos, burritos, enchiladas, etc), as well as some perhaps more authentic dishes and platters, including quite a few seafood items. I even spotted menudo on the menu. I ordered the Macho Burrito--a huge tortilla filled with a large portion of either chicken or beef (I opted for ground beef), topped with a mild red enchilada-style sauce, melted cheese, green onions, tomatoes, and very generous dollops of both guacamole and sour cream all served with rice and beans. The burrito was fresh, tasty, and massive (it encompassed my entire plate). I'm a pretty hearty eater and I only finished half. The rice and beans weren't anything special, just the standard run-of-the-mill accompaniments you'd find at most American-style Mexican restaurants, but I did appreciate that the rice wasn't dry or hardened and the beans weren't liquid watery goop  like I've experienced at other establishments around town. One of my dining partners ordered a chicken chimichanga, which she was very pleased with. My other dining partner had a cheese tamale, which she made no complaints about, but it looked rather small to me didn't seem to have much filling. 

I didn't order any alcohol, but I saw there is a full bar. 

In summation, the service was friendly and attentive, the prices are fair, the portions are generous (except perhaps the tamales), and the food was fresh and tasty. I left El Tenampa with a positive first impression and will definitely return to sample other dishes and perhaps a few margaritas!
The staff was so great and amazing. Will be using this business for all my floral gifts. Amazing job.
They dont have their drivers out after 10pm because it is "unsafe" and they dont take orders before they close....that's what I was told when I called at 1040pm.
These guys have been awesome!! I have had my vehicles detailed many times by other companies but never again. I have used Dynamic detail a few times now and have had the best service every time.

I've picked up sandwiches several times here and found the food to be delicious and the service is excellent.  Portions are very generous too.  There is a large selection of sandwiches, soups, and salads.  Many of the sandwiches are grilled or hot.

Downhill trajectory since their opening (six weeks ago) in service level, food quality and cleanliness seems a function of many of the young staff pretending they are at a summer break party instead of at a paid job.  As big a fan as I am of the Texas transplant sisters who opened Tin Roof in Boise and this one as their second location, I say with all respect that these are management's problems to fix.

Have they bit off more than is chewable with this second location in the Treasure Valley? That I don't know.  But I intuit they would solve the majority of this location's problems, at guest service level and food quality level, by putting a grown up, which doesn't mean age specific but in behavior, in-house manager in charge.

I do know that across the fast food and fast-casual food restaurant industry there are problems with service staff and line kitchen staff performance these days.  It is not unique to this Tin Roof location.  In the current low unemployment economy it is very often the least skilled with the least interest in staying employed who end up in service staff customer facing jobs in fast or fast-casual food jobs.  Hiring and training and reinforcing and firing when necessary and rehiring have always been challenges for management in any eatery in this segment.  Even more challenging now.

But it can be done.  If the sisters who own Tin Roof want to see how it is done right, they might take a look at the performance by staffs at Madre Boutique Taqueria in Boise or Taziki Mediterranean Grill in Eagle as two examples where involved and present management has assembled teams that do really good work for service and also preparing consistent quality, delicious food served in well maintained spaces.  None of that is happening at this Tin Roof location now.

My children have attended NHA from the infant room all the way up to the 5's, it is the only place I feel comfortable sending my children. I LOVE their Daily Connect access! I get real-time updates & photos of my kids while I'm at work & can message back and forth with the teacher if need be. The teachers really do LOVE their students.

Picked up the Boutonniere for my daughter for her homecoming dance and it was a carnation and not a rose like we ordered. I also ordered hunter green or forest green for ribbon and they used a bright Kelly green. The worst part was no needle for my daughter to pin the flower on her date. We will go elsewhere from now on. So disappointed.

The guys at in depth are great! Some of if not the best I've ever seen. They will not charge you anything extra if they run into a problem, and always willing to spend extra time free of charge to get your car to top shape! Greatest polishing work you could get!  And for low prices. I will always send any of my cars there and trust that great work will be done. I suggest that you use them and you will be saving a sh*t load of money and love the work.
Carl Goicoechea

This review is based on the order online and pick up in store service.
  
You used to have to go to the pick up counter, if no one was there, you'd have to press a button and wait for them to come, look up your order, wait for them to go get it, and then you have your order.  It wasn't bad .... because they are really great on customer service at this location.  
But now they have a tower right when you walk in to the door over on the pharmacy and home side, you hold your phone/barcode up to a little window, and your package comes out lightning fast.  I mean really fast.  I was scratching my head just amazed by technology and really how quickly my order came out.  It makes the order online pick up in store process super easy, timely, and convenient.

Great place to eat with your family or just yourself. They have different kind of burgers, fries for everyone. I love this place because they have multiple different kind of dipping sauce for the fries or to put on your burger. The patio upstairs is great when the weather is nice. Must of the time if the weather is crappy, they close the patio. They also have some good beers and canned wine.

In Boise for 2 days after relocating from the west coast and I find this gem! 

Sandwich was awesome, the potato salad is a must and the owner is as genuine as they come. 

I highly recommend this place if you want to enjoy a real deli style sandwich, (none of this subway, Jimmy Johns, Quiznos garbage) and want to support a local business. 

You will not be disappointed.

WOW ! moving from California to Idaho and having to start all over , finding new Doctors , Dentists ect. Can become overwhelming! Hands down the best ...!!!! Relaxing atmosphere, Very Friendly - and OMG , I got a Paraffin wax hand spa all in one ... !! My transition from California to Idaho is by far the BEST ! My daughter is a hygienist , Definitely 5 stars ! And they are not skimpy on their to go package

My husband found this little gem a few months ago. I just love their pizza. My favorite one is their veggie. Now I have never been a real fan of just veggies but man oh man...Marcos veggie is super yummy. It has to be the seasonings they put on the veggies. The veggies still have crunch unlike other pizza changes their veggies are dead and lifeless.  Their cheese pizza is okey gooey good. Lots of cheese! Definitely go and check out Marcos if you haven't already. You won't be disappointed!!

I simply can not believe this doesn't have more stars.  Look food vendors ... when you do chips and guac, do it like tin roof.  If all you get here is chips and guac, or if you only get one thing, do the chips and guac.  Nice size of guac.  Also texican ... awesome and cheap.

Every time we visit Boise we hit Dutch Bros..... all we ever get is Americanos but if the rest of their drinks are the same quality as their Americanos, I give them 5 stars!  They are friendly, fast and efficient!
They all do such a great job. The culture is great, they genuinely remember your name and your story.. truly a great experience every time. :)
We love this place! Their flavors are very authentic and I'm so glad Boise has a creative place to eat at. I love the vegan curry empanada! Wow!

This place was so amazing! They have a lovely selection of bagels and you can create your own bagel sandwich. I got the Lox and it was soooo good. My partner got the chicken salad sandwich and was raving about it as well! The staff was super friendly and funny. They were also very on top of their covid protection for both employees and guests which I appreciated so much.

Got a single custom pizza to share for lunch.  The estimated time for the curbside delivery was off by 5 minutes.  

Pretty tasty pizza.  Decent value.  First time trying any Marco's pizza and liked it.
Sweet place with fabulous sandwiches! Make sure to get a box because you will not finish a full sandwich! If you dine in, you'll see the entire bakery case...try not to drool on it.
Great people, great facility and oh, GREAT Dentist and surgeon!!!! Highly recommended. Pic attached.

I came here twice before and had a good experience. However, this time was awful. The younger lady who took our order looked annoyed the entire time and seemed to not completely know what she was doing. Sure enough, she got three of our sandwiches wrong including one that was a COMPLETELY different sandwich. When we explained that it was the wrong sandwich, she got defensive and was trying to tell us we said it wrong. No apology whatsoever. So, I spent $46 for 5 sandwiches and was left with a horrible feeling. Won't be coming back.
Great people! Ha and Jana have been amazing since the start. I've been coming for years and they continue to amaze me with their work.
When we came in was crazy busy, but the staff was amazing they where moving so smooth and fast. The quality of food was great and the taste was just as good. Prices where not bad at all.
I've already visited 3 times in the last 2 weeks so that's got to say something! I highly recommend the chimichurri chicken or the carne picante as your first try.
I really like this nail salon. They have a ton of SNS (dip powder) to choose from and they do a really great job.

We are new to the area and we were looking for our new favorite Thai restaurant. We'll this isn't it!  We weren't very hungry, so we placed a pickup order for Fresh Rolls and Tom Kha. The rolls were mainly lettuce and the soup was okay, but the serving size was very disappointing. We know prices for food have increased everywhere, but $18.00 for this was unacceptable. We'll keep on looking!

Had their special...T-Bone steak. It was great. Very tasty and so tender! Also their steak salad was terrific according to my date! That steak was done to perfection and also very tender! Will be going there again soon!
Great choice for breakfast. Hot, fast and fresh. Who doesn't like a sausage McMuffin with egg? I deliver these to companies and everyone always loves them.

Downtown Tin Roof
Shrimp Tacos
Beef Fajita Tacos
Pathetic excuse for a taco...terrible! 
Don't waste your time...Taco Bell is better
So good. This place serves very traditional Argentinian empanadas that are spectacular. I've never been unhappy here or received bad service. Owners are great. And they serve wine

Update:  The owner wasn't available but the manager was extremely helpful.  They refunded our purchase and offered to fix it to how it should have been.  We already had another appointment scheduled with the regular stylist and deferred.  I still keep my recommendation on Kristin, perhaps even more so after she sent some less than professional texts to my wife, but the management is excellent.

My wife went in to Kristin today to get her hair cut and dyed to a "Balayage" style (brown with blonde).  Haircut came out mediocre at best, but our true disappointment was that the hair came out all brown, no shades of blonde to be seen (she's a natural dirty blonde).  The dye starts at $85 for this service but she charged $70 more ($190 for a $35 cut and $85 dye) while not providing a receipt.  Highly disappointed in the quality of service as well as the price jump without explanation.

I do NOT recommend this company for a loan. After years of being within good standing with them, when our car started falling apart, we wanted to continue paying off our loan to remain in good standing and keep our credit rating good, instead they basically said "screw you." Honesty doesn't matter here and in the end you still might get screwed.

My husband and I went in to look for new walking shoes for me. I'm a distance walker (10-13 miles a night) and go through shoes pretty quickly. I last had my stride analyzed by a local running shoe store on State Street but wasn't taken too seriously there. I'm not your typical athlete but take my walking seriously and want the best shoe for my feet, having had multiple surgeries on my feet and ankles. 

We were helped by Mark who put me through all of their stride and pressure analysis systems and was extremely thorough in his presentation of the facts. He was able to assist me in shoes that I'm hopeful will be just what I need. He was so helpful that my husband, who works on concrete floors 10 hours a day, decided to go through the analysis. We left after spending $300 but feeling good about the validity of our choices. Thank you, Mark. You do great work!

5 star pad Thai! I am from Seattle so I consider myself well versed in Thai Food because we have it on every corner but this place beats them out of the water! It was delicious! Usually pad Thai comes in a large clump if noodles and is never saturated enough with the sauce but Sa-Wa-Dee does it perfectly!

Every time I visit the Treasure Valley I will make sure to stop by! I'm sad I lived next to this place for 20 years and never stopped in!

We were having a really good day, until we had to stand in line for an hour for a drink we wanted and when we got up to the counter to order they told us the ice cream machine was broke.  They should have posted this, as that's why we stood in line for so long. Also in the lazy river they do not have enough tubes. We tried to do it twice and neither time could we get a tube. Other then that is was so much fun to have a day out with the family.  We feel they post when rides are under maintenance, they should post when they are out of stuff.  If we would have know before hand we wouldn't have been so disappointed.  We decided to leave after the ice cream issue.  Besides be a little tired, we were a little let down.  

Ps, and to all you patrons who complained about the water dumping on you as you enter a ride, you do realize this is a water park and with that you tend to get wet.

OMG! Why have I taken so long to try this place? It's tucked in the corner of a strip of businesses off of Linder so it would be easy to miss. I tried the prime rib sandwich & it melted in my mouth! The house salad had a variety of veggies & was perfectly sized. It's a little pricey, but the food quality is worth it. Treat yourself & try it!

Decent burger, nothing outstanding but enjoyable. Would have given it a higher rating but during my visit I noticed that one of the cooks was not wearing gloves or a mask. I thought masks were mandatory when preparing food. I know for sure that gloves are and that was a rule in place long before Covid. I wouldn't go back because of that.

We were looking for a place in the Treasure Valley that had a traditional Hot Pastrami on Rye bread.  Were so happy to find Fat Guys.  Great sandwich!  They have a huge variety of sandwiches, so you should be able to find your hearts desire.  Friendly service by Wally and he went out of his way to make sure everyone got the sandwich they wanted.   We will go back often.

We went in thinking this place would be great because I deliver food for a living and there's always a line of people. Sadly the food was kind of bland and the dessert was as well. Don't get the hype.

First time here and it was really great. I got the California turkey club without bacon and it was really good. The turkey and bread tasted fresh. The people there were really nice as well. When we were ordering our sandwiches we asked for no bacon. When the owner asked what sides we wanted, we said potato salad. He let us know potato salad has bacon in it. I really appreciated him letting me know because I can't eat bacon (which he didn't know) so i was able to get chips instead. To me, it showed he cares about the customer. Great pla

Very well-staffed store. Unfortunately, not a single staff member looks up to greet you when you walk in, asks if they can assist you or even acknowledges your presence, though you've been walking around for a full 5 minutes. Nobody bids you well on your way out the door, though they're all standing there. Overpriced, subpar merchandise. Save your money and time. Go elsewhere.

I moved to Idaho from California about 9 months ago & have had a difficult time finding good Mexican food. My husband and I pass by FG all the time & we finally decided to give it a try.  Our expectations were VERY low. 
As soon as we walked through the door we were greeted by the hostess. She was very friendly. Once seated, water, chips, salsa, and bean dip were delivered to our table.  When I tasted the bean dip I knew the food was going to be good (I gauge Mexican restaurants on how good their refried beans are). 
We ordered:
Tacos Suprema- this is a plate of 3 carne asada tacos with onion & cilantro in corn tortillas smothered by a red sauce and served with rice and beans

Taco Salad-no explanation needed here. Lol

While waiting for our food, the owner stopped by our table to say hello & welcome us to the restaurant. It's nice to see an owner who interacts with their customers. He also makes sure water & soda glasses are full and even refills them himself. I totally respect him for doing that.  

Our food arrived hot and looking delicious. Our food was amazing!! My husband LOVED his entree. The portion size was big and had a reasonable price. My husbands entree was $16.95 and mine was only $8.75. We left very full & happy. 

We have since visited a lot. FG is one of our go to restaurants for dinner.  We are there so much that the owner & one of the bussers know our name. I have heard a lot of negative experiences at FG from friends. I wasn't sure why their experience was so different than ours so I decided to attempt to figure out why. I found out that there are several FG's in the area but they are owned by different family members. So, they are totally different when it comes to service & food quality. One of the locations even charges for chips & salsa after your 1st basket. This location does not do that. If they did I probably wouldn't go back. I suggest if you have tried one of the other locations and were not happy to give the Fairview location a try, you will be impressed.

Today Luke from Ferguson's made my day! He was knowledgeable and patient with helping me today for our Bradford White water heater purchase. That's why he's the expert, he told me where to go and Art, the guy at the counter that would know what to do when I get there. When I got there, it was a smooth transaction, everything I needed ready to go. We love Ferguson's!

Got my oil changed, tires rotated and an inspection of the entire vehicle. They were extremely professional and kind. Very reasonable considering the Jiffy Lube that is basically next store is roughly 20% more expensive and they don't rotate tires. I will be going here again for sure.

Our long-hair kitty was needing professional attention due to some matting. Scheduling was easy, and getting a quote beforehand was great. I loved being able to get a Saturday appointment and having Aussie come to the house. I had no idea how the cat would react to the groomer or grooming, and when our kitty came back inside, she was all purrs and showing off her pampering to our other cats! I will definitely be a return customer!

I signed up for their unlimited monthly pass this week and got my first car wash. The entire experience was a positive one -- the attendant was friendly and knowledgeable, the wash cleaned my car's exterior very well, the tires shined like they were new again, and the powerful vacuums took care of the interior. They even provide microfiber towels to wipe down those pesky areas that are still wet after the air dryers do their work.
I was a loyal customer of Quick Quack Car Wash in Sacramento for several years; but now I am a big fan of Rocket Express!

Dr. McRae has been my dentist for 20 years and has always done excellent work. However, his incredible skill set came out on behalf of my son. Dr. McRae and his office manager Deborah turned out to be an amazing team to help my family through a terrible mouth trauma.  

In July 2017, my 17 year old son took a hard hit baseball to his mouth while playing first base. It knocked in two teeth, fractured his jaw and ruined the line of his teeth. He had naturally straight teeth, had never had so much as one cavity filled. He had only seen a pediatric dentist until that day. 

The accident happened at 3pm on a Friday afternoon in Twin Falls and an emergency dentist did his best to set the jaw.  At 10:30pm on a Friday night, I couldn't sleep and decided to call Dr. mcRae's office call service.  Dr. McRae called me within 10 minutes and agreed to see us the next morning.  

In his lawn mowing clothes, he pulled out his camera and began to educate us,  document my son's injuries and build a treatment plan and claim. We saw the office nurse practitioner Monday and were hooked up with a wonderful endodontist in the coming weeks.  Deborah helped that office navigate billing medical insurance for work related to this trauma. She submitted claims to medical and dental insurance.  It was a five month process spanning two calendar years (late July to mid January) requiring painstaking detail and documentation to support the case to give my son his smile back. 

20 months out from the accident, my son has a beautiful, confident smile. We just found out that more than 80% of the cost of his reconstruction was covered thanks to Dr.McRae and Deborah's skill and hard work.  I absolutely appreciate and recommend this dental practice.
This place is Great !!!  Just like the Boise location, most all the employees are from the other two locations in Boise .
I normally like this place but got bad service there last week and won't be going back

Just got a pedicure at this salon and it was my first visit. The lady who did my pedicure was so kind and took her time. They did not charge more than I was told on the phone and did not try to sell me a bunch of extra things. Very very relaxing environment. Thank you so much for the great pedicure! I will be back.

I've never laughed so hard at a burger in my life. My wife unwraps her burger and I can't stop laughing... I can't even look at it because it's too hilarious. She glares at me while she pokes at it. I think whoever took our order mistook "I want a hamburger" for "please find a huge tub of mayonnaise and empty it all over some brown paper. Then wrap it... Oh ya, and could you throw some other burger looking ingredients on there just so it kinda looks like a burger?"  I took a picture and it still cracks me up every time I look at. Hahahaha

When my friends ask what we should eat I say, "I know just the place!" Hahaha "How about a burger?" Then I show them the picture of this masterpiece of mayonnaise. Sells em' every time . Thanks for the mems Idaho Fry Company. 10/10 will come back again... for the fries... or a weeks' supply of mayo. Lolllllll

Soooo happy we drove a little bit out of the way to come try this place. It was a little bit out of the way of our hotel but I told my husband "The sandwiches look really good." 

So we did it and upon arriving the staff was extremely friendly welcoming us all of them. Asking if we needed help with deciding or anything just super friendly. 

I ordered the BLT and it did not disappoint! They loaded that thing up with bacon. They did not skimp you on anything and that's how I like it. For once in my life I felt like the sandwich was worth the price. The bread was good right amount of topping. My husband got some California sandwich and it had avocado and sprouts on it and we ended splitting our half's with each other and his sandwich was just as amazing. 

We got on the side a cup of chowder soup and that was also very good! Our daughter enjoyed the soup a lot. 

The building was clean and they had high chairs for my youngest. It was overall a awesome experience here for a quick lunch. We will definitely be back when we visit again.

Impressed! 
Fast, friendly and professional! Donny was a pleasure to work with. He showed up when he said he would, offered good advice, and went above and beyond to help with a variety of projects around the house.  I would definitely recommend him to anyone looking for electrical work in their homes and businesses.

I'm a huge fan of Pho so when I saw that the old Vina location was now a Pho restaurant, I got pretty excited. I've tried every single Pho restaurant in the valley so I have a pretty good idea of whats good and what isn't. This place is now my favorite! 

The Pho is excellent here. The broth is flavorful and fresh. Very clean tasting. Meat is tender and plentiful. Also the noodles are portioned out nicely as well. 

The customer service is excellent too! We didn't have to wait long, the servers would come by our booth every few minutes check up on us for refills and ask us for our feedback on dish.

Overall, top notch spot for some good Pho! Oh, and I heard that eventually they'll be serving Bun Bo Hue!! If you haven't had that, you'll be in for a treat.

GREAT Mexican food especially on Sunday. Refried beans are very creamy. I loved the extra hot h
Salsa.  I really wished they had menudo

Just had a dip powder manicure! We love this nail spa, the moment you walk in it's relaxing and pretty! Employees are polite and professional! They do amazing pedicures too in cute little section off areas.

This is my favorite burger joint, to me it even surpasses in and out. Reason 1 is because their patties are char broiled. Reason 2 their fries don't taste like cardboard. I'm so glad this place finally decided to show up to Idaho. It is a little pricey for a burger but you get what you pay for.

Ok must admit usually love this place but today was the worst. Ordered the cinnamon chunk French toast, it was cold and very dry- tasted like yesterday's leftovers. 
Told the manager of my issue but instead of getting an apology was brushed off with "we have more coming up in a few minutes". I just really wanted to let them know so other customers did not have the same experience. 
Asked the cashier if she could take my plate, and she said"you can just dump it in the trash over there". 
So not only the food was a disappointment 
Customer service left a lot to be desired.

A+ was great!  I got a crack on a road trip and contacted them as soon as i got home.  He responded to my emails on a holiday and came out the next business day.  He billed my insurance company for me and was done in 30 minutes.  Excellent quality of work, response time, demeanor and the price was great (if you don't use insurance - cheaper than the national services).  Would highly recommend.
Food was good but only half of my order was delivered. Very disappointed for the price I paid for this.

Went in as I've had the food from them before and it was good. The food was good again, but the service was on the complete opposite spectrum. Everything we ordered last night was already made (cookie, cinnamon roll, and 2 soups with bread).
