The girl working the register didn't know the system, the order was to go and another girl brought it out after nearly 10 minutes as an in store experience. Then it took another several minutes to get it simply bagged. Also missed the bread we were supposed to get with the soups.

This was a fun trip to Meridian Idaho! We went to Roaring Springs Waterpark! Lots of fun!! My favorite was the slides;  Corkscrew Cavern and cliffhanger were my favorite!! Very scary at first but at the 10th time I got used to it!!  Lifeguards were really good at keeping everybody safe social distancing was enforced! ( no masks but what can you say? Your at a water park!)  Good place for the whole family!!

So disappointed. Came through the drive up twice today and Kneaders had signs on their windows saying masks are mandated but both times we went through the drive-up the woman at the window had her mask hanging around her neck. Makes you wonder if they're following the other health mandates.  She got all flustered when I kindly asked her if her should actually be on her face.

Fat Guy's Fresh Deli has become a weekly staple for lunch in our office.  We order at least once a week and they are our favorite deli in the valley.  Our preferred sandwiches are the #20 PC Pedro and the #16 Trevo Melt.  Both sandwiches come hot with a side of au jus.  Fair warning these sandwiches are BIG so we usually split in half and order and extra side of jus.  The bacon is always cooked to perfection and highly recommended.

Let's talk about the owner too... what a great guy!  He is always friendly and takes care of any problems that may ever arise.  On the rare occasion that there has ever been a mistake on our order he always makes it right (I've had my entire order comped for a small error).  I love that he gets in with his crew and works the rush hour of lunch.  This is a busy place with a never ending line at lunch hour so plan accordingly!

This place was going downhill. I left a negative review and now it's being upgraded to 4 stars. Went there recently and the tacos were pretty darn good. I love their salsa and the chips were not over salted(still little too much for me).

Claire's employee (Maddy) was rude! Either she's just an unhappy person in general or she hates her job. They always have some kind of deal... Buy 3 get 3, I wasn't aware that nails weren't part of the promotion. My 6 items rang up to $78. I questioned the total, that's when she told me she that I only had 4 items that qualifies for the buy 3 get 3 free, Not a big deal... So I told my daughter to quickly grab 2 more items. Maddy acted as if it was a huge inconvenience. No one else was in line and my daughter already new what she wanted to add to the pile.  Luckily I did that because the price then adjusted to $63.
It's 11:16 on a Wednesday and they aren't open? Three people waiting outside and no employees there and it's closed. ‍
Ice cream was crunchy like it was freezer burned.  Little to no topping and the place was empty on a 90F day.  Will not go back!

We love all the great deals that we've found at this place. The staff is very friendly and helpful. 
It's worth to pay them a weekly visit, they always have good surprises.

Waited in the drive through for about 30 minutes on my lunch break had a very small and simple order, 1 taco and a side of mexi-fries and they forgot the mexi fries but after the long wait I was in a rush to get back to work and didn't check until I got back. Hate paying for shit you don't get. Won't be going back.

Ordered a 'caffe latte'. What I received was a watered down, gas station-esque drink (well worse than a gas station coffee actually). The sausage egg and cheese croissant was good. It was a little on the salty side, but that didn't bother me.

TLDR: get their croissant sandwich, don't get their coffee

So the food is good, which is why we tried Big Al's for a second time. Unfortunately both visits yielded the same customer service result, absolute garbage. Start off by seating yourself. Ok. You use a QR to view their menu and order food. Didn't mind that. You pay on the app, which is...ok. Choose a tip while you pay, before receiving any service? What type of crap is that? I selected no tip, but had cash to give should the service provided be at least adequate. While waiting for our food, we decided we wanted drinks. We get in line at the bar to order drinks, waited 2nd in line for about 5 minutes, not too bad. When we start to give our order, we had to repeat the same order 3 times, two margaritas and a pitcher of beer. They deliver our drinks, both margaritas are wrong, and one of the glasses for the beer was filthy and clearly unwashed. We get that corrected. After about 20 minutes, received our food.  We get our food, no silverware, no napkins, no condiments. Server drops food off, and bails. No "Hi, I'll be serving you today" no conversation at all! OH WAIT, we need refills on margaritas and sodas. How do we get refills? Who the heck knows. Get back in line and waited nearly 15 minutes, oh and now their blender is broken...weird. So now, our food is cold by the time we get back. At the end of this really crappy service, we decide to personally tip the lady that busted our table before and after we sat down...but...she can't take a tip because she's the manager. The "manager" is busting tables? Maybe if she was managing instead of busting tables, the service wouldn't have sucked so bad. She suggested tipping the bartenders instead...but we kindly let her know the bar service sucked! Probably not going back there ever...
So happy there's a Marco's in the area! Recently moved from Colorado and Marco's is the best! Ordered online for pickup and Pizza was ready when we arrived.

I've been trying to frequent and assist various stores and businesses during COVID. I've always been seriously impressed with how well this Habit is run, but WOW was our family blown away with how well they are handling this crisis. I feel for them as this has to suck to wear masks, gloves and bear the cost of the over the top cleaning, but this place is killing it and is setting an example for everyone out there. Tables are marked when sanitized, a girl with a cart is cleaning, cleaning, cleaning. You have to change your cup to refill a drink and that process doesn't exist elsewhere and more. You'd think service might decline a bit, but heck no. You can sense the smile behind the mask.

Well done Habit!!!!! Our family has always loved this particular Habit and we thank you for going above and beyond.

We have kids bowl free and two of the three times we couldn't even use it! Definitely recommend if you have kids bowl free avoid Big Als as they are not kids friendly!!!!!!!!!! Not worth the hype when the customer service is extremely rude at the front counter! Avoid them like the plague!!!!!!!!!!!!
1

I ordered through DoorDash and was impressed with the quality of my order. Usually delivery orders aren't as great as if you are at the restaurant but this place did not disappoint me. The egg rolls I ordered were crispy and hot! The Pho I ordered was also very hot and fresh. It was a generous portion of soup, noodles and meat! Definitely worth the price! I highly recommend this place and I will be back!

This time we drove to pick up our order, where last time we used Uber Eats delivery.  

Upon arrival, there were so many cars, (like 8!) in the drive-thru that we decided to go inside.  Good choice because there was no one waiting so we got served immmediately.  Everything was clean, organized and well-stocked.  They had all the usual favs and the Orange Chicken was just coming out from the kitchen.  

We had 2 orders of the Cream Cheese Rangoons, which I think are worth the price.  They've been consistently crunchy and generously filled.  We also took home orders of Beijing Beef, Grilled Asian Chicken (sauce on the side) along with the Orange Chicken.  We wondered if the Grilled Asian Chicken is the same as the Teriyaki Chicken. They also asked us which sauces we wanted and there was plenty.

Overall, we were able to get in/out and home fairly quickly to eat our meal.  We'll return when we have another craving!

So VERY good!! Relaxing and communicative. Very sweet people. I got the deluxe pedicure and it included a DETAILED cuticle cut, massage, scrub, mask on my legs, and hot towel. Took about 45 min and would totally do it again. This will be my regular spot. Thank you Holly

Another great experience at the Ram. Love their fish and chips and the Brussel sprouts were terrific.  The service was very slow and our server paid lots of attention to the beer table. It's one of my pet peeves when serves ignore families because they think they don't tip. Their loss at the end with us.

Do NOT use "Treasure Valley Cleaning" for ANYTHING!

I bought a $49 Groupon for a whole-house duct cleaning, including a dryer vent and one return air duct. First, they charged me $80 extra, for the two extra return air ducts, which took them about 5 minutes to clean.

The fellows came and "did the work", but left a MESS. They left a whole lot of debris in the driveway, including screws, nails, Legos, bits of wood, staples and a whole lot of ick. They left more of the same in my garage, and in various places around the house. When I pulled up the vent covers and looked, I found all sorts of crud left in there, even including cheerios! They didn't return all of the vent covers...some were askew.

When I called and complained, they said they had a malfunctioning vacuum, and they'd come back and do it again. They did come back, and were here about 15 minutes. They said that it was "normal" for there to be extensive debris remaining. Hmmm...how come MY vents don't look like the ones on their website? I'm guessing they did a "cut and paste" from someone ELSE'S website!

They said they cleaned up the mess in my driveway and garage, but when I went and looked it was just as bad. I asked them again to clean it, pointing out thumbtacks, bits of wood, pills! They made a half-hearted attempt, but never did get even 50% of the stuff picked up. The vents look somewhat better, but my Dad came over and looked and said we could have done a better job with a shop vac and a screwdriver.

I'm out $129, and things are STILL not clean. I have complained to the BBB and to Groupon. We'll see what happens. I should have checked the BBB first, there are other complaints there.

Awesome! Is the word that describes Christian Brothers Automotive. We were getting ready to take a long trip when our Ford F-250 started making a grinding sound from under the hood. I called our regular guy and he said he couldn't see the truck for over a week. I drove into Christian Brothers and asked for what I thought would be impossible. It was 11am and we were planning on leaving the next morning at 7am. Could they fix the truck that fast??  
Well, it turned out the air conditioner compressor was going out, and the serpentine belt needed to be replaced. They said they would do their best to get it done that day, but it might not be ready until that next day some time.   Well...They did it!  They even stayed a little late to get it done.  I rarely give five stars, but if I could give these guy six stars I would

Love this place! Always friendly, even during this pandemic and everyone else seem to be in a mood. 
They have lunch specials every day. If there is one thing I would change it's this location's hours, but they are open for lunch. Their other location is open later.
I personally love the Louie sandwich on sourdough with their fries - OMG THEIR FRIES!  Their fries with their fry sauce is AMAZING!

The guy who got me going (Probably the owner) is who we need in America right now.  Honest business guy - makes a GREAT sando - no BS - but cool and gets the job done.  Good quality food - good prices - quick service and friendly.  on my 1st Day in the new Hood - he hooked me and my friend up with 2 delicious lunches.

Great Place - Great People - Get some! Today!
Dwight

One of my favorite places to go! Food is yummy I recommend the buffalo chicken dip and their chicken strips are amazing! Also very good service! If you feel like drinking and playing games to bowling to enjoying a good football game on a Sunday this is the place to be! Also kid friendly as well lots of games for them to have fun and ice cream bar as well! All ages fun!

These guys did a fab job on my wife's X5. We drove all the way from Phoenix with Chuck the white lab who was in full shed mode. When Christian and his crew turned the car back you couldn't find a white hair anywhere on the black carpet. The rest of the car was beautifully detailed. I enjoyed working with Christian. He was just a nice guy. And I especially enjoyed his assistants assistant, Olivia. 

Finally, I thought their charges were very reasonable. It was like getting a new car for $200.

One person here, taking orders, payment for said orders AND making the pizza.  Told Managers in the bathroom? I don't think so.  

Oh and pizza maker was not wearing gloves... but he was really nice.  So there is that.

The menu declares 5 different crusts:  original, crispy thin, lite, thick & gluten-free.  The one employee said he knows of only 2 but could not describe them or tell me which one is thicker and which is thinner.  Really strange.  

Now it's down to how the pizza tastes.  Stay tuned...
This is so amazing. We ordered every taco off the menu and most of them were fire. Best meat burrito was fried chicken and the texican. Best veggie is the black bean for sure

Worst taco place ever. The food was disgusting and I found a bug in my taco. Also the customer service is ridiculous I had gotten kicked out of there just because I left trash on the table. I wouldn't recommend this place at all

Soooo I really, really wanted to like this place. This is actually the first time in over a year we went out.... so we were excited to say the least, and pumped to bring the new baby along  for an outside eating experience. We just bought a house a couple blocks away and walked down tonight. Unfortunately the dining experience was not good. 


1) We weren't planning on going out tonight but we decided if there was a happy hour we would go for it. This is how that conversation went:

Ring-ring-ring

Odd woman on phone: Hello
Us: Uh is this el tenampa?
Woman: yes
Us: ok we were just wondering if there's happy hour going on
Woman: I don't know. I'll go ask
:::::waiting:::::
Woman: yes it is
Us: oh great until what time?
Woman: I don't know. Let me ask. 


Ok so you get the point. They are in need of someone who knows what's going on. And here's the worst part, we walk down and as we sit the waitress tells us there's no happy hour and tells us we called the wrong restaurant. We confirmed that we did indeed call the right number but she kept saying we didn't... ok not going to argue, regular priced drinks. 

2. We sit down outside and the Menus and our cups were pretty dirty. Probably not a big deal but in the times of covid... I think cleanliness needs to be paramount. 


3. You have to walk through the restaurant to access patio. Padlocks  on the patio gates which seems like a safety hazard if you have to get out of area seems weird. Also with a new baby we do not like to bringing her inside public places, so it's a bummer that they have it locked up especially when all the employees wear their masks on their chins or below their noses. 

4. We were not offered a drink menu... maybe they don't have one? The waitress listed some drinks so we ordered two different margaritas. They were good. 


5. This place has so much potential and could be a gold mine....but unfortunately the patio is boring and has blaring music. It is in need of flowers, and maybe even some of those colorful banners you see hanging overhead.


6. We planned to get some food but decided against it because everything listed above so after three drinks ($30) we left and went to another restaurant. 


Like I said, we want this restaurant to be amazing because we live close by, and we really think it has potential! But with so many amazing outdoor eateries close by and many others coming to downtown meridian, we feel El tenampa needs to make some changes to have customers become regulars.

Being from the OC with close proximity to Little Saigon, we had the benefit of exceptional Vietnamese cuisine. That being said, this restaurant is the closest thing we have found so far in Boise. For some reason, Pho broths are made too sweet for our tastes here. This one is favorable, but still too sweet. The traditional Vietnamese eggroll(Cha Gao) is to be eaten wrapped in lettuce with pickled carrots and radish inside, dipped in fish sauce. Usually the lettuce is green leaf, not iceberg. We were given 2 tiny pieces of iceberg and a few slivers of the pickled items. Enough to do only two of the eggroll pieces properly out of 8. The egg rolls were tasty though, but the accompaniments need to be beefed up. We will return, but are still missing What we are used to.

My kids always choose Big Al's for their birthday dinner and then some arcade games after and it had always been fun until last night. Unfortunately they adopted a new self serve business model thru a subpar app, a tip is a requested in advance but for what I'm not sure and once food is dropped off then good luck getting a refill on drinks unless you seek out one of the many staff people standing around. Not to mention you are paying twice the amount for bar food at $18 for a burger and tots, $18 for a sale, $25 for cold nachos with minimal cheese.  It wasn't even good bar food. This will be our last celebration here.
Costumer service was acceptable when I was in the store but they don't contact you about banking once you leave. 1/5 stars for no follow through.

Fun visit today, Thursday between 3-8pm.   Lots of people arriving at 3pm for the $16 admission price.  Parking lot was full so we used overfill parking in the dirt lot adjacent to the park.  Inside, most seats were taken but some available.  We got 4 shaded lounge chairs together by the wave pool so we were happy.  Rides did not have long lines.  It was busy in the park but not so much so that we couldn't ride what we wanted to.   The food stands had mellow lines and the food was good.  The selection is mostly burgers, chicken, pizza, and fries.  Prices are fair for what you get.   Five hours there was plenty.  In that time frame we got to do everything, relax, and eat.

Came in to get my dogs nails trimmed.  I have a 14# Boston Terrier named Betty. She's absolutely adorable in every way, but she gets long nails.  I called Splash & Dash to ask if I needed an appointment for a nail trim. They told me that I could just walk in. 
It was a little chaotic when we first walked in because there were several owners picking up their dogs at the same time. 
After a few minutes of waiting the owner checked us in. I told her that I wanted to get her nails trimmed. She asked me if I wanted them to also smooth them down with the dremmel & I said yes. They promptly took Betty into the back area. Betty was pretty apprehensive so they had to carry her back.  Betty was in the back for less than 5 minutes and she strutted back into the lobby when she was finished.  She came through the door adorned with a cute pink bandanna with anchors on it around her neck. 
I returned to the counter to pay & was charged $15. I was a little confused because the price sheet clearly states a nail trim is $10. When I asked why it was an additional $5 I was told it was because I wanted Betty's nails to be dremmeled after they were cut. I have never paid additional for dremmel. In my opinion it should be included in a nail trim just like when you get a manicure and you get your nails filed after they get cut. I didn't expect to pay an additional 50% for the service.  I paid and didn't complain. 
Overall, the shop is cute but I don't think I will be getting Betty's nails done here anymore.  I hope they update their price list soon so others don't have the same sticker shock as I had.

Bought the $29 LivingSocial voucher to have the ducts cleaned. Called and got an appointment and the guy ended up convincing us to get the $199 deal to clean the entire duct system. The guy I spoke with said that the $29 was just to vacuum out what was close to the vents but not a real cleaning job. Since we hadn't used a duct cleaning service before decided to give a shot. I will never use them again and will not recommend them to anyone. They cleaned the ducts but in the process blew all the dirt and debris out of them and all over my house. They didn't bother to cover anything and didn't even attempt to keep anything clean. DO NOT USE THEM!

This was seriously the best salon experience I've ever had!! From booking my appointment, to Alex the stylist to the amazing owner, all 5 stars!  I tried to make an appointment with Canvas Salon and had a terrible experience so I decided to give A Beautiful Reaction a try, based on yelp reviews.  Wow, this salon is GORGEOUS and all of the staff was welcoming and did beautiful work. They all know the latest trends and techniques.  I'll never go anywhere else and can't wait to tell all my friends!

Great place to get nails done! Very nice massaging chairs for pedicures and the employees are very kind and professional, and they do great work. I've been here twice now and both times I was very happy with the results. It was $84 for gel polish mani & pedi, so pretty reasonable (considering I've had a pedicure cost almost that much by itself at other places).

For the love of God do not eat here! The French dip was not toasted, the au jus was watered down, and the mozzarella sticks were caked in Parmigiano. 

The western burger was saturated in BBQ sauce to make up for the overcooked burger. On top of everything they have no real wait staff, and we found a hair on our food disgusting!

The only redeeming quality was the Cajun fries. Thanks for the hundred dollar waste of food!

I work near John's Auto and pass by it on my way home every day. First thing I've noticed Is that they stay pretty busy, which initially convinced me that they must do good work. But they're never too busy that they can't fit you in. I know this from experience.

I was on my way home from work about to get on the freeway and my '15 Silverado went into limp mode with a check engine light. I was able to nurse it back towards work, and I figured I'd stop at John's for a consultation. As soon as I walked in the door, I was offered help and one of the gents there grabbed a code reader. We went out to my truck, pulled the code, and he went to work researching what might be wrong.

We quickly came to a conclusion that seemed viable.  And I agreed to a price, and handed them my keys. I was told they'd expedite the part and have it done next day.

Next day they ran a diagnostic only to find out that our original suspicions were a little off. The problem Ended up being a freak niche situation from aftermarket parts. Brendan took care of me, practically gave away his time... and made me feel valued as not just a customer, but as a human being.

I was just pulling out of the parking lot, feeling so blessed by my entire experience, and I see Brendan sprinting into the street to get me something I had left sitting on the counter. Talk about service. These guys are hard working, humble, honest, gentlemen. I will 110% be back when my vehicle needs any work done.

Ordered 1 taco 1 enchilada 1 tamale combination plate. I wasn't impressed. The tamale was awful, very bland, and very dry. The taco meat was bad too, as were the soggy taco shells. The enchilada was the same bland, dry meat as the taco except caked in half melted cheese. Sadly, I don't have a single positive about this meal.

NOTE FOR DOORDASH AND OTHER DELIVERY DRIVERS!!
This particular dickeys location is fully stocked with lazy, slow, and incompetent employees. I would HIGHLY recommend declining orders from this location unless you have 10 to 20 minutes to waste

This was our first time getting Molly groomed and I've heard about Rachel's place through a friend that recommended it. I know Molly was not that easy to groom from personal experience, but she looked great when I picked her up. Rachel was awesome!

This place could have been better. 
Not too into the burgers, bison or fun guy.
Disappointed with the fries because we were the only ones in the building and our fries were very soggy. Especially devastating when you order your fries for the crisp. 
The sauce collection is very cool, who would have thought blueberry ketchup!?

Donna is awesome and her skills as an artist are unparalleled. My G/F and I both started our arm pieces and we cannot wait to get them completed, and then definitely work on our next pieces with her. 

I would definitely recommend this place to any other.

My 2 1/2 year-old iPhone 6 developed a problem with the ear speaker. I was wondering if it was time to get a new one. Pete and the guys at Rockstar had me in and out in about an hour with a new speaker and screen at a very reasonable price. Thanks, guys!

My kids begged me to take them to IHOP yesterday for National Pancake Day.  Knowing that they were handing out a short stack to all customers with no purchase required, I knew that it was going to be slammed!! I was ok with that & so I did not expect quick service. I was totally realistic. 

We arrived around 6:00pm & waited about 30 minutes for a table. It was loud & crowded, but it was what I expected.  We were sat at our table & greeted by our server. She took our drink order & allowed us ample time to review the menu because we were not just eating pancakes. We placed our order:

3- 2 egg & sausage breakfasts with hash browns (scrambled)
2 eggs a la carte over easy
Bacon, ham, & egg crepe with cheese sauce
2 Dr. Peppers
3 Orange Juices

The food arrived about 25 minutes after we ordered. As soon as I took a bite of my eggs I gagged.  They were ice cold. It was disgusting.  I checked the temp on my sausage & hash browns...same thing.  When our server came by to check on us, we told her the egg situation and she took the food back.  As I was waiting for my food I noticed that my daughter had stopped eating hers.  I asked her why she wasn't eating & she said that there was a hair under her hash browns. She handed me her plate, & sure enough, there was a black, short, curly hair. It looked like a hair from a beard.  We got the attention of our server again & showed her.  She was very apologetic & took it off of the bill. My daughter didn't have any interest in eating anything else. 

The customer service was great. That's why I have 2 stars. While I understand that they were super busy from the pancake promo, it doesn't justify a complete lack of quality from the kitchen.  I overheard one of the servers talking & she said that she had been working for over 12 hours & she had made less than $20 in tips.  That sucks.  I think in the future, I think IHOP should have a requirement that all servers should be left a tip.
Best Bloody Mary's in town and a great place to relax and take in a game.  Just wish they'd bring back the cheese curds!

Great spot for a hot summer day... or any day for that matter! The lanes are immaculate and so much fun to play on. The food available is surprisingly good... those fried mac n cheese "bites" are magical haha. Our server David made our afternoon memorable, great server!
We didn't get a chance to get upstairs for the games but we are definitely planning to return to check it out.

Had a lot of fun bowling Service is horrible this is the third time we've attempted to eat there waited 20 minutes for water once we started bowling waited another 20 minutes finally just left went to Jack in the crack  came back and finished bowling. Was there a total of four hours  we ask every employee there that we seen where do you order food everyone of them said talk to your server after the third time we won't be going back for food but definitely for bowling and arcade lotta fun just do not go hungry  and never attempt to order peanut butter hamburger  it is a literally A hamburger made out  of peanut butter I do not know why it's called a hamburger they should call it a peanut butter sandwich
Definitely their fires are good and they have so many choice for dipping sauce! And we can bring our puppies if we sit outside! Its our Saturday casual brunch place

LaRue is a true professional.  I've had many haircuts and LaRue really stands out because of her skills and ability to listen to what you want.  I didn't have to wait for 3 weeks to pass to enjoy my hair. Thank you so much l! I'll be back soon.

I was pleasantly surprised by the exceptional Sa-Wad-Dee Thai food. We picked up some lunch and were immediately considering ordering more food for dinner. It was that good! 

Rich in flavor, cooked exceptionally, and prepared with love and thought. I will most definitely be eating here again!

My apologies for the poor grammar on my last update, and for submitting one more review.  It took almost a full month to be contacted and the person who contacted us said they just received notification regarding our issue and asked us for all the information about our situation that they should already have in their records.  It took some time, then we finally received a refund for our purchase.  This process was much longer, difficult, and more complicated than what was necessary or acceptable.  We appreciate that we finally appear to have resolution.
This place is disgusting. Please don't waste your money. Your food will be ice cold and dried out from sitting in the open air all day. Seriously, don't come here

Excellent burger, choice of Fries, sauces & salts!

Would have gotten five stars, but when I walked in I was greeted with "Hi Guys!"
I'm not a guy! What's wrong with "Hi Folks!"
I'm not the only woman that hates being called a guy!

0 stars. Will not go back. Went once, horrible service, went back a second time just to make sure it wasn't a fluke, and was told my food would be ready in twenty minutes, an hour later it still wasn't ready. I was a cook at ihop many years ago and no matter how packed the restaurant was our plates were out in six minutes as a general rule...with two cooks! There was at least three cooks that I saw tonight and the kitchen was out of control that's ridiculous, I will not be going back to this place, thanks but no thanks.

The people that work here are nice. They keep the chips full and the salsa and bean dip flowing. The food however was just subpar. It wasn't bad, just not great. The chips were delicious though. Super fresh and crunchy. I wouldn't seek this place out but I also wouldn't not eat here again.
We love this park. I have 3 young kids who adore making the 30 minute drive just so we can play here!

I was very pleased with the service I received at CPR. My son accidentally broke the screen on his brother's Samsung tablet and was required to fix it on his own dime. I first went on CPR's website to confirm their service offerings and hours. I noticed they had an estimate request section, so I went ahead and filled it out best I could. I received a very prompt reply and after confirming some additional details, was quoted a price. 
I brought my son into the store to set up the repair. We were given different routes we could go with the repair, including the option I was quoted on the phone. 
Turnaround took a little longer than quoted, as the part ended up being on back order. But I was called as soon as it was ready. 
Tablet has worked just fine ever since. 
I felt their pricing was fair and service was good. 

(I have had a cell phone screen repaired years prior at another establishment and the experience was AWFUL!  So it was nice to go somewhere that produced an entirely different experience)

If I could give less than 1 star, I would. Helping a friend manage payments on a loan, and there is less than zero customer service from CapEd. They won't take phone calls, their online system won't register a new online account with the correct information entered. there is no online customer support of the website...essentially all the complaints listed in past reviews. They are not set up to serve the customer. I have online banking set up with national and local banks, and have never had difficulties working with a financial institution until CapEd. Stay away.

I've been looking for a sandwich shop to frequent and love since I've moved to the Valley, and I HAVE FOUND MY PLACE!!

Entered the Deli and was warmly greeted by all the staff behind the counter. Since this was my first time, I had no idea what to order. So, I asked the gentleman behind the register for suggestions. After a couple of questions, I figured I'd give the Trevor Melt with a side of homemade potato salad a try. I was not disappointed!!

The mixture of tender hot roast beef, melted pepper jack cheese, and bacon all dipped into the hot au jus was absolutely awesome!! The potato salad was a little bland for my taste, but great nonetheless. We could all use a little less salt in our diets. ;)

1 Trevor Melt + no drink = $10.55

But the food isn't what made this visit 5 stars. It was Chef Wally and his employees. From the second I walked in to the moment I walked out, I felt welcomed and part of the family. Chef Wally takes time to speak to each of his customers, get to know them a little, and give a ribbin' here and there. He took time out of his busy schedule to chat with me (we found out we're both originally from SoCal), and even introduce me to the Mrs. when she came in. He's an awesome host with a passion for the food he serves. He even dumped a bag of chips on my plate when he noticed my potato salad was all gone!

I HIGHLY HIGHLY HIGHLY recommend stopping by for a sandwich. Whichever one you choose, you will NOT be disappointed. If you are, it's your fault.

Well even after talking to the cashier and pointing out that "I'm NOT a guy" after his jovial "hey what up guys!" Greeting...

I won't be going back again!  
The food isn't as good as it use to be, & I don't need the stress of some kid not understanding that women aren't Guys!

We had a 20X40 pool constructed by CHI Aquatech. We found during the entire process that patience was important because they tend to be too optimistic with their scheduling. The most troubling is that unless you are planning on a state of the art, huge pool in Sun Valley, you will find yourself at the bottom of the company's importance level.
At the time of this review, we are mostly happy with the basic construction job. We had them pour a concrete patio during the pool build. It has major cracks in several places. The pool itself is so far crack free. Our pool has an automatic pool cover which has not worked correctly since it was new. Time and time again we call for service, and it takes months to get these guys to come out. When they do, it is a frustrating process. A guy will look things over and say that it's not installed correctly or something. Then they need to come back. Weeks go by. Finally a partial fix. Repeat. 

Pros: They were good at helping us decide the shape and picking the sanitizer and filter equipment. They had a fair price. The pool is usable about three quarters of a season.

Cons: Our biggest problem is been the pool cover. It is a total failure. We have asked them to refund the money for the cover so we could get another. No luck. This company sells itself on service after the sale. It is nonexistent. You have to call time and time again just to get a basic response. Our pool has been unusable for weeks on end while we waited for them to come. 
Unfortunately, I would not recommend them because of the lack of support. I would find a company that is able to service what they build.

Mark in Eagle

I picked up two pounds of turkey and a pound of sausage for a meal we hosted for high school boys. When I got home I opened up the turkey and was beyond disappointed. The meat was disgusting. It was green. Not ring of smoke, not just barbecued, it had a foul taste to it. The meat is so injected with fake flavors to begin with. Think deli sandwich pressed meat flavor. Add that on top of the fact this meat  seemed to have been in a warmer and kept for days.  I couldn't serve it and threw it away. I essentially took $30 and threw it in the garbage. Can not stress enough do not waste your money or time on this garbage. Service was adequate at best. Yuck!

The kids really enjoy Roaring Springs so do my out of state family members so we plan annual trips. In my opinion it is better to go at the end of May/Beginning of June. The weather is not as hot which as a result means a less bitchy me while dealing with three kids under 10. 

I also recommend skipping the discount times if you can and going early on one of these days instead. It makes a big difference. We went during the 3-8 1/2 off Thursday and I felt like we missed out on a lot versus going early on a Friday morning when the open. On Thursday they were really busy and we only went on a few rides. Also I've learned quick that the treasure valley is at its hottest around 3-8pm so keep that in mind. They also rush you out so be prepared for that.

If you have older kids this time might be better for them. But if you have younger kids I reccommend going at 11 AM, packing your own lunch and you can eat at the tables outside (they'll stamp you) and leave around 6 and you will have gotten your moneys worth.
Always fast and good service. Great food, friendly staff. Good setting for the family. Would recommend,  will continue to go back

I've written reviews before for BFC and now feel I should give an update once again.  My last review mentioned that the hamburger had become smaller.  This time I noticed that the bun and meat were back to their normal size.  The manager did come over and ask how my burger was.  I told him that I noticed the hamburger was back to its previous size.  He admitted that for a while it was smaller, but now they are back to their normal size.  I am glad the larger burger is back.  I look forward to enjoying these more often now.
Food and drinks are 10/10. Lanes -1/10.. like they don't even try to maintain them. For bowling for fun not for those who know how to bowl... which sucks. I really like the Capri suns...

Easily the Best Thai restaurant in town if not one of the best restaurants in town. The guy replying with the bad comment I don't personally believe has ever eaten there or has no taste in food. This food is generally authentic and VERY fresh and VERY good. There is no better value for great food in town. The selection is amazing and also... some of the best Sushi in town from a sushi fanatic.. thats right.. amazing Thai and sushi in one place!

I have gone to this salon a number of times. Usually see Andy and he's always been good. 
I haven't been well and today my husband decided to surprise me with a manicure and pedicure. He has no idea the difference between a manicure and acrylic tips etc.  and he didn't know to ask for Andy. 
When I came in, Andy told me to choose my color. I asked if I could use the gel and I had a nice pedicure. The woman doing my feet did a great job and rubbed my feet and was very kind to me. 
I went and sat down for my manicure, I told the lady I wanted the white tips on my nails. She asked if I wanted them long or short and I said I usually have them cut them shorter. So she started cleaning my nails and she started doing a manicure so I asked again, "We are going to do the white tips on the ends of my nails right?" Again she said yes. Then, she grabbed the gel nail polish to start painting them and I stopped her and said, "I really would like to have the white tips on my fingernails." 
She stopped and said something in Vietnamese to the woman behind me who spun around in her chair and began accusing me of being wrong about what I asked for and that I need to make up my mind and if I say I want a manicure then I'm getting a manicure and if I want fake nails I have to say fake nails.  She was so rude and loud and embarrassing and the entire shop could hear this happening and I just sunk down in my chair and felt the tears coming out.  I told her that My Husband had made the phone call and he didn't know the difference and it was my mistake obviously the woman and I didn't understand each other when I asked for the white tips on my fingernails. She corrected me over and over and even started speaking to her coworkers in Vietnamese about it using the words manicure and acrylic nails and white tips in English so I knew that's what she was talking about.  It was one of the most embarrassing moments of my life. 
I didn't have the presence of mind to stand up and walk out with my wet gel fingernails so I sat there and just told the woman to please just put some clear polish on them and dry them so I could leave and that I just wanted to go. 
I'm still upset and in tears over the way that women treated me.  It honestly doesn't matter how great some of their employees are when there is one person in there willing to humiliate a customer in front of a room full of people because of a language barrier and a simple misunderstanding.  We could have easily just added those tips on to my fingernails and it would've been no big deal, instead this woman had to lecture me about how wrong I was and I just can't understand why somebody would treat another person like that, especially a customer.  
I know that I probably should have left at that time but I didn't know what to do. I was so out of my comfort zone. I paid and I even gave a 20% tip because the woman who did my feet did a good job and didn't deserve to be out on a tip. I paid $70 total and she cut my fingernails down as short as they could possibly be cut so I have no fingernails with clear gel on the top and the red blotchy face from crying at the nail salon.  
I can't in good conscience recommend this place to anybody because I would never wish that kind of treatment on anyone.

We love this place! Every year when we come to Idaho we stop in for fun. This is such a great place to let the kids burn off energy. The food is expensive but they have a decent selection from which to choose. 

The kids and my spouse love the slides and for relaxation you can't beat the Endless River and the Wave Pool.
It takes like 4 days sometimes more for checks to be available in your account. They'll let you use the money but then fee you for it

We are very disappointed.  

We wanted to try a place we had not visited before.  This place is close to where we live and work, so we had high hopes for finding a new place we could frequent.  Our first order was wonderful.  We enjoyed the value and the service.  On only our second time ordering, our food was wrong, which we did not discover until returning home.  When we attempted to call and speak to someone.  That is when it went from bad to worse.  We spent easily twenty minutes, or more, trying various methods to speak with an actual person.  When we finally reached a live person, they told us to report our issue using the app, unless we wanted to drive back to the location.  The person we were finally speaking with told us they were not even local, they were in a call center.  We did as instructed and reported our issue using the app.  It has now been almost a week and we have not heard from anyone.  We do not expect perfection, things happen, everyone makes mistakes, it is how those situations are handled and resolved that make all the difference and earn our loyalty.  This place has made it difficult and complicated to resolve issues when it addressing concerns should be simple and easy as not to add to the frustration and disappointment that inherently comes from things being wrong.  

To have this much inconsistency and indifference after only two visits is not acceptable.

RUDE , RUDE, RUDE! (three times for emphasis) Yelp has never steered me wrong. The 3 stars is to good for this establishment. You would think with all the stuff going on in the world with minorities in this country, that the Chick sitting on a stool- doing a customers toes, would be a little more appreciative of yet another person [who could very well chose to paint her own toes or go to the other seven nail spas in the vicinity] coming in to spend 20+ dollars on a pedicure. My 3 year old daughter and I walked in, 'The Chick' looked us up and down, said "Yes"; I responded: "I would like a pedicure"; she replied (rudely) "We don't have time"; I said (nicely and with a smile...might I add) "OK" (Hoping she'd realized she judged 'this chick' allll wrong). I'm taking the time out of my wonderful day to post this review because I would hate for anyone else to experience the level of haughtiness I did, while simply trying to kill time.

Mediocre place, but man the manager was quite the a-hole. I come here to eat and get a call that a relative went into cardiac arrest, so I immediately tell a server I need to go. However my card wouldn't work, as if it coincidentally wanted to screw me over. She tells me it's fine, because my partner and I had only gotten drinks, one of which wasn't water (which shouldn't need to be paid for). I go running out and the manager yells back at me to come back before he calls the cops for not paying, and when i told him of the circumstance, he gives zero f***s. Loved waiting for a credit card to process after what felt like an eternity while my cousin's life was on the line.

I had a nostril piercing, I told the piercer that with my ethnicity I am concerned because I wanted the stud to lay flat. Being an islander, makes it difficult to get the placement right. However, he did such an awesome job and I love it.

I took my son to Faith at the meridian location. She was so sweet with him and patient when it came down deciding what he wanted. She was very professional the entire time. Definitely recommend seeing Faith. She will be the only one I'll take my kids to get their hair cuts.

I'm currently very pregnant, and while I normally don't mind taking my car to the car wash and vacuuming it out after, it's not fun right now. I didn't want to pay $40 for a car wash with interior cleaning  services, but honestly it was 100% worth it. The staff did an amazing job (way better than I could, pregnant or not), and they were very friendly! A bonus was a really nice lobby to wait in, stocked with drinks and comfy couches. Totally a good place to wait with kiddos! I will definitely be coming back!

There we sat getting over another round of COVID when the pho craving got real. 45 min later door dash left a warm gift on the front porch. 

We have only had the Pho here but if it's any indication of the other dishes this place has serious potential. I got the house special Pho (beef and meatball), and my wife got the chicken Pho. Both were fresh, savory, and delicious. I'm sure I'll have an update with some pics of their other dishes coming soon because I'm not sure how long I'll be able to keep away. Support your local eateries and Eat up Boise!

I feel like this place could and should be better, but because of my first and only experience, I'm not a fan...for now. 

We were exhausted at the end of last week and decided to order delivery from a new place in hopes of finding a new local favorite. Saw a decent deal at Marco's for a large specialty and large 2-topping for an ok price and ordered online. One of them was a supreme pizza, and the other was a custom that was supposed to be a deep dish with a garlic crust.  Ordering online was easy enough, though we were surprised to find out AFTER we ordered that the expected delivery time was around 80 minutes. Unfortunately, it took even longer than that. Probably around an hour and a half to finally get it. 

Now to the actual food. The supreme was pretty good. We didn't make any modifications to it so no complaints there really. I thought it was good. Now for the one I ordered...oh geez. Now listen closely...for my custom, 2-topping pizza, I ordered a DEEP DISH pizza with DOUBLE white sauce, DOUBLE GARLIC CRUST, grilled chicken, bacon, and a side of garlic dipping sauce. But what did I actually receive? A normal, if not near thin crust pizza with barely any white sauce and barely a hint of garlic crust. But it's cool cause I'll just dip it into OH WAIT NO THEY FORGOT TO INCLUDE THE DIPPING SAUCE THAT WE PAID EXTRA FOR. The pizza itself was decent, but had they done it the way I actually ordered it, I think it would have been fantastic. 

To summarize, between the 1.5 hour delivery time and complete mess-up of my order which included forgetting items all together, I don't find this place that appealing. Really left a bad taste in my mouth, no pun intended as I believe the pizza could be super good. I might try them again at some point if a good enough deal rolls around for me to forget how much they messed up everything the first time.

I recently enrolled my daughter in the program as she is navigating into toddler stages. I will say I was very nervous coming out of a pandemic and she's never been around anyone but me (mom). I went back and forth for months trying to decide if this was the right decision. I can honestly say I'm so thankful I did. My daughters teachers. Ms Marisa and Ms Jessica are honestly amazing. My daughter is not verbal yet but I will tell you after only one month of being there she is coming home trying to talk more and more already. I can honestly say I don't ever want them to leave her. Im so thankful for both of them and how well they are with my One year old.

I will admit that I went into this with high hopes. I'm always on the search for a good honest burger at a decent price. I stumbled onto Boise fry co. While looking through yelp. Based off the other reviews I was very excited to go. 

Finding the location was a bit difficult. The sign isn't well illuminated and difficult to see from the street at night. Took two passes to see it. 

The inside is clean and has unique decor. I couldn't tell you what exactly they are aiming for, but it gives for some conversation. 

The twist for Boise fry co. Is that your meal begins with the fries. They had s large selection, but I tried the basic russet original.  I ordered a bison burger with average toppings. The food was quick to be ready. 

You need to season your own fries and they have a large variety of seasonings. This is probably the best part. The sauces were disappointing to me. I've had better at other locations. 

The burger was dry and bland. Didn't seem to be cooked by someone who has a deep knowledge of cooking. The fries to me were great. I enjoyed the whole bag. Unfortunately I can't just review on the fries. 

If the burger tasted better id be very satisfied with this location. I just can't get behind only having fries as a meal. Will go back, but not in a rush.

Hi everybody! It's me Bob Flanders, your favorite food critic. I went to Boise Fry Company, with one of my vegetarian acquaintances and they ordered the funguy burger. I thought I was buying a 26 year old fun guy, but they handed us a burger. When we got  the burger it was 30% mushroom, but it was 70% beef! My casual acquaintance was horrified. But really, if you're vegan or vegetarian order the vegan burger.

I've been to this Habit Burger twice and it's a good spot. I know it's a chain but they do burgers well! Prices are very reasonable and you get quality food! I've only had the burgers and fries here. Burgers remind me of In and Out, simple, delicious, and quality stuff going on it. I add a little fry sauce and it feels like it's "animal style", burgers have caramelized onions already (if you want them and why wouldn't you). They make everything to order which is always good but yes you'll wait a few minutes. Fries are pretty standard but that's fine with me. Leaps and bounds above In and Out fries. It's a very solid fast casual burger spot and if you enjoy burgers, definitely worth checking out. I still like my local Boise area burger spots but could see this being part of the rotation.
I'm from The Bay Area and then moved to Sparks NV then on to Boise ID and here at Big Al's on a Sunday and I have had the best wings that I have ever had.

Terrible service.   THU 11 NOV. 

Waited 5 minutes to be seated by hostess while 10 employees were talking among themselves 5 feet away.

Hostess finally came up and said I could sit anywhere I wanted.

I've been seated 20 minutes (and counting) and no one has bothered to offer a menu or and initial drink while in plain view of the bartender and 3 other employees that walked by and said nothing.

Four other tables in my area with patrons seated with food and drinks. No servers checking on them either.

Recommend going to the Ram sports bar in Meridian and NOT Big Al's if you liked to be served food and drinks at a sports bar.

I am tired of going here and seeing that the place is so unkept. Tables need wiping, the floors need sweeping. I have given them 2 stars, down from 4 stars.The kitchen area looks like a disaster a few times we have gone in. Where is the health inspector?

Their biggest problem seems to be the quality of their employees at this store. Too young, undisciplined, no attention to detail. I know that good help is hard to find, but they better do something here or they will find business isn't good. I have been here 4-5 times and I am not judging on 1 visit.

Food needs to be hotter too.

Located at The Village in Meridian. This is a huge two story building that contains a restaurant, a sports bar, a 21+ bar, a bowling alley, an Ice cream parlor, and an arcade. 

We have eaten at the restaurant a couple times. If Big Al's was just a restaurant then I would probably only rate it 3 stars. But it is so much more, and the arcade is fun for kids, so that bumps up my rating. 

The restaurant is a sit down restaurant with waiter/waitress service. They have a build your own burger section of the menu where the vegan Beyond Burger is available as an option. One of the ingredients you can add for 50 cents is sautéed mushrooms. They only put about 4-5 slices of mushroom on the burger though. 

The kids meals are 7$, but they come with Icee (slushee) drinks if the kids want, as well as a 5$ game card for the arcade. 

Once we were done with our meals it was time to go upstairs to the arcade. I wouldn't recommend cashing in your game card for tokens because there are only a couple games that take tokens. The kids had fun playing games and then going to the prize shop afterwards. They have handheld shopping baskets and the kids get to pick and choose which prizes they want. Then they bring it up to the cashier counter with their game card (don't forget to swipe your game card after each game to put the tickets on your card). 

Fun experience for the kids. Next time we will probably just skip the restaurant and go straight to the arcade.

I took my car here for a fairly expensive detail and was shocked.  They don't even hand wash it there.  They took it down the street to a drive through car wash.  Then they don't do much by hand.  All spray bottles where everything gets messed up by overspraying.  It was a mess on the inside.  They sprayed something inside that got on the inside of my windshield and I can't get it off.  Tried everything.  Overspray on my info screen on dashboard.  I mean, how amateurish. Found  a couple spots on the outside where they just missed whole areas.  They won't see me again.

This review is kinda difficult to write.  I really love Kneaders.  I was first introduced to this little haven of deliciousness when I was in Park City Utah for a girls weekend. When I realized that there was one in Meridian my heart (and tummy) was very happy. 

The Good:
2 words....crunchy ice. 
Treats-there are a lot of delicious treats. They have amazing caramel apples that they will even slice for you, carrot cake, chocolate mousse, cheesecake, cookies, brownies, pies...all baked fresh. 
Bread-the bread is all fresh and really good.  They have entire loaves that can be purchased & they always have a sample next to the register. 
Turkey-its hand pulled turkey breast. It's always moist and delicious.
Soup-always delicious! My favorite is the potato soup. I wish they had the potato soup on the menu all the time instead of during the winter only. 

The Bad:
Service-I have had issues with my order being incorrect and when I bring my food to the counter to have it corrected I am treated like I am bothering them and they are totally annoyed. 
Execution-whenever I order a sandwich I have to take it apart and reassemble it in order to have the meat, cheese, & veggies evenly on the bread. The mayo is never covering the entire bread.  It literally only has about 1/3 of the bread 

Kneaders also carries some cute household items & gifts.  They even offer gift wrapping!
Overall, I would give Kneaders 3 1/2 stars if it were possible.  The food is great, prices could be better, but everything is fresh, so it's a trade off that's well worth it.  If they can just get their customer service on point they will be at 5 stars!

My husband and I have been shopping for a new bed (headboard:footboard/side rails) for a few weeks.  We priced what we were looking for at several stores around the valley.  A week ago I saw an ad on Facebook for Meridian Home Furnishings.  I sent a message asking if they carried a king size tufted bed.  I wanted the headboard to be very tall & grand.  They responded that they did & so we decided to go check them out. 
The store is located in a warehouse right next to the city offices. The building doesn't have much curb appeal, but it is clearly marked so it's easy to find.  We arrived at the store around 4pm on Saturday afternoon (they close at 5). When we walked through the door we were promptly greeted and asked if we needed any help.  I told them that I was the one they spoke to regarding the tufted bed.  She remembered our convo & escorted us to the area where the beds were. As we were walking to the beds she introduced herself as Kelly. When we got to the beds I told Kelly that we were happy to look around and then find her if we had any questions because they were pretty busy.  
My husband and I were able to look around without any pressure whatsoever. We ended up going through the entire store to see what they had.  They have a great selection of quality furniture at amazing prices.  My husband and I were both impressed.  While we were browsing, Kelly & a couple of other people checked in with us just to make sure we were ok.  
We found a bed that we liked, but it wasn't exactly what we wanted.  Kelly brought out some books filled with inventory and showed us a few different options that could be ordered.  As we were looking through the books she remembered another option & pulled it up on her iPad.  It was EXACTLY what we were looking for.  The price that she quoted us was less than half of what other stores wanted for the same bed.  We decided to order it.  Kelly told us that she would be placing the order on Monday morning and the bed would be here in 7-14 business days. I left very happy. 
Kelly texted me on Monday to let me know that she had placed the order.  
On Friday morning I received a text from Kelly that said, "Your bed is here!" What!?!?! I thought it would be 7-14 business days! It was only 5 days INCLUDING the day she ordered it! 
We went and picked up the bed yesterday (Saturday). It was exactly one week since we walked into Meridian Home Furnishings. They helped my husband load the boxes into the trailer and again, service was great.
My new bed is BEAUTIFUL! I'm in love! I'm so happy that we found a store that has such great prices, great products, & great service.  If you expect your furniture salespeople to be pushy and wearing a suit, this is not the place for you! This is a family run business. There may be kids there. I don't mind it al all! I prefer buying locally and supporting a family. 
Thank you so much Kelly & everyone else at Meridian Home Furnishings! You have a customer for life! We will be buying more furniture in the very near future from you.

Very nice and professional staff. They were hard to get ahold of, I just needed a jewelry change and the website  does not offer to schedule the service so I tried to call about 5 times before I could get anyone but once I did, I was able to get in on the same day.
Super glitchy loan system. They kept taking autopay payments even after I paid off the loan.

Yum!  I just received my lunch via door dash and this place is pretty dang good!   I'm from CA and lived near the best pho places and this place is comparable for sure! 

The pho was super good, fresh and stayed really hot!!  

Spring rolls were tasty and the peanut sauce was awesome!

Holy smokes. This place is DELICIOUS.  My husband and I came in and tried some of the more "basic" tacos. After trying those we tried a few more unique tacos and they did not disappoint.  I can't wait to be back trying even more of their tacos. They have catering and I am hoping to have an event I need catering for soon.

After being treated like an inconvenience to Ethan on the phone, I had to repeat my order to him 5 times. I don't think it has ever taken me 10 mins to order one pizza. After takin my card info he just says ok, no total no estimated delivery time. Then 20 mins later they call me leave a voicemail that says they forgot to process my card so they needed me to call back. I didn't hear my phone so when I called back, an hour after I placed the order. They informed me that they didn't even make the pizza yet cuz they didn't have payment. Then Ethan says I could throw a discount at it. I don't care how much it costs, I care that my entire family is starving and cranky. Sad thing is, papa johns is my absolute favorite pizza and I won't be eating there again. Seems like anymore customer service is just not important to people

This is one of the nicest Walmarts I've ever been in.   Now that I think about it, the Walmarts in Lodi, Ca, Eugene, Or, and St. George, UT were super nice too.  I'm talking about safe parking lots, clean stores, and normal people shopping inside.   This is an exception, not the rule with Walmart.   

What I've come to expect at the majority of Walmarts is scary, dangerous parking lots, dirty stores, and weird people.  Not the case here and it's nice to shop with a sense of peace at a store that takes pride in its appearance and safety for its customers.

The Counter has delicious food, but it's not worth it for us to go there unless every other place in Boise is full. So expensive for what you get!! Weird menu. Strange atmosphere - it's kind of dead. Wait staff is friendly, but they've always been very awkward to interact with every time we have been there. Malts and milkshakes are to die for, but the wait times and price for everything makes it not worth what you pay for. Not our favorite.

This is our first delivery request since moving here a year ago. We drove in for our first pizza a couple weeks ago and picked it up. My husband's favorite, thin crust. It was great! Today we ordered delivery of a thin crust pizza and a regular crust pizza with garlic,  for me. Not only was the delivery 15 minutes early, but everything was steaming hot and purr-fect! You must try Marco's first! You won't be disappointed!

Got the Bakers Dozen and four different cream cheese spreads. Bagels are excellent with that great tug and chew yet soft in the center. We had an assortment of flavors and everything was fantastic. Great customer service as well!
Bagels are always delicious and staff is helpful and friendly.  You can't go wrong with Blue Sky Bagels

I am so happy to see that The Habit is now in Boise! I have missed it so much since moving to Idaho. I stopped in today with my mom and my husband, and we were all delighted with our food. It was just as good as the location we normally frequent when back home in Santa Barbara, CA (my hometown as well as the birthplace of The Habit). My mom and I both had Char Burgers and fries and my husband had the Tri Tip Sandwich with BBQ sauce. Everything tasted really fresh and was made quickly. It was much more streamlined inside and less of a 'burger shack' in appearance compared to the open air location I visit back home. I was so happy that it wasn't a disappointment and I can't wait for my Idahoan friends to enjoy it!

Their times are inaccurate their staff kind of pass you off to one another. They serve who they want when they want. Time was 1030 am for service, go in at almost 11 the girl on the wok absolutely ignored me, she saw me come in but refused to say good morning or anything. Then the gentleman who was in the back was highly unprofessional laughing and everything when trying to tell me their manager had to be there for them to have service, which I found to be absurd since a gentleman had just come out with a drink as I was pulling up. I found it to be highly disrespectful and unprofessional to have your doors unlocked as well as the time on the door to be something then turned away after standing there for over five minutes because "they did not have enough staff to operate" until their manager returned. Will never return back to this facility and I spend 25-40 dollars at Panda Express continuously. I do not recommend this place at all. I live in downtown Boise and I will go elsewhere to buy for my child and I.

Maybe it's because we ordered through Door Dash, but we weren't very impressed with the food from El Tenampa. 

Our food was cold, the chips were stale, the salsa didn't have much flavor, and the tortillas were dry in all the wrong places. Everyone loved the guacamole and we thought the rice was made well, but that was about it. The meat was okay, but nothing special. 

Overall, we didn't love El Tenampa, but I wonder if we had dined in if we would have walked away loving it? Sometimes the magic is lost in the delivery...

My son and I seek out donuts every Friday morning. This morning we came across this small piece of heaven. I think we have finally found our new "go- to" donut shop. 
The donuts are amazingly fresh and so darn good! Seriously one of the best maple bars I've had. My son has said "this is the best donut ever!" about a million times so far. It's a bit of a drive from west Nampa but totally worth it!!!

Went and had lunch with a group in the bar and grill so that we could watch some football this last weekend. The visit was about as bad as it gets and the only reason this is 3 star review is that all the other visits I've had were beyond stellar and your man Sean is a rockstar. I don't know if he's a manager or just wears a lot of hats but every time I've come he has always been able to help and impress us.
Our server was brand new, as in she was in training.. as in she should have had a trainer with her. We got her, alone and although extremely nice and apologetic.. the worst server I've ever been served by. I've been in the service industry at about every level and thought I'd seen everything. Not even close. 
We ordered drinks as soon as we sat down and then proceeded to wait 15 minutes for the first half the order and another 10 or so minutes for the beers. I mean it was so bad it got to be almost comical and we just decided to see how long it would take for the drinks OR the server to come and check on us so that we could inquire. I eventually went down to the bar to ask the bartender about the beer part of the order and instead of actually helping me out he says rather rudely "that beer comes from the other bar, your server has to go get it"! I get that he was the only bartender on at 1pm during a NFL playoff weekend but that's not my fault. Missed opportunity for service recovery there for sure! I've bartended for a decade in much worse situations and have never treated someone with such disregard. I also inquired about a cocktail that was made with soda rather than tonic and he had the audacity to argue with me about how the drink was made.. I mean clearly soda water and tonic taste quite differently and if YOUR particular brands don't.. that's just weird and I'd look into that as a manager. Again, another service recovery opportunity missed! 

I was able to flag down the server some time later and informed her that she needed to go to the other bar to get the beer. She was really apologetic and totally lost. 

The beer was cold and delicious as always. The food was fried and hot. The games were horrible.
I'll probably be back but I do t think I'll ever set foot into that bar and grill again. I'd rather just watch games while bowling...

Big Mr Concrete did an AWESOME job on our 400 sq ft patio. We were having such a hard time finding a reliable contractor who could get our project done in our time frame and Big Mr Concrete came through ON budget and ON time. Gabe is very professional and all his guys were very respectful while at our home. They got the job done exactly when they said they would and our patio looks awesome. I would highly recommend Big Mr Concrete. You won't be disappointed!

Good craft brews on tap are always a good start.  I'm a big fry guy and they have great options, not mention a great selection of dipping sauces and flavored salts.  Had a nice burger with it all.  Will be back.

I took both of my boxers in for bathing, nail grinding, ear cleaning, & teeth brushing. Both dogs looked & smelled great when I picked them up & neither was acting afraid (this was their first spa day ever). Rachael did a wonderful job.

Not our greatest experience, service was so-so and no one seemed to be in a rush to help us once we were seated.  We ordered, had a decent meal and when the check came, my wife noticed that her drinks were much more than what was on the menu.  She asked the server about it and his response was, "Sorry, that must have been one of our old menus."  While that may be the case, you offer some sort of compensation for your blunder.  Instead, it felt like we got a big middle finger.  We like this place because it's local and has pretty decent food.  It's amazing what one experience can do to change that.  

Get your menus up to date, know when to right a wrong, and make a little extra effort for those who want to support your establishment.

Disappointed, won't be back for a while.

Used to be a better deal but they are selling many things for maybe $1 less than Costco regular price and sometimes more.  Even if the packaging is torn or its missing parts.  Not to mention things that are on sale at Costco  not worth the time

Always a good option! We sat in the bar and ordered the Ricardo sandwich with fries. A protein lovers meal! It was awesome! Service was great. The only downside is ALL seating is very high. Very tall tables and raised booths so if you're in a wheelchair it's not at all convenient or comfortable. Chair users like to enjoy a beer and watching the games too!!

Why this place averages only 3 stars on Yelp is beyond my comprehension. When we moved to Meridian and started patronizing The Village my wife immediately recognized The Counter from living in LA. We immediately tried it out and have eaten here several times since. The build-your-own burger option is great, never gets old as the combinations are endless. Burger meat is delicious, toppings and options are also all of good quality and taste.

We will continue to be back over and over!

Just enjoyed another burger from here last night and I always forget how tasty they are. 

The only burger I've ever ordered from Boise Fry Co. is a Bison burger original with cheese. It is so good on so many levels, I truly cannot switch to something different. 

One thing I have tried different though are variations of fries. Sweet potato or yams are probably second favorite. My all time #1 side dish I order is Boise Fry's brussel sprouts! Oh my goodness they are crispy tiny cabbages of goodness. 

Last night was a special treat for my husband and I..  during the fall/winter season, one of the house made dips is a maple marshmallow cream. My husband loves to dip his sweet potato fries in it.... and let me tell ya, it's definitely worth a try!

Same good stuff prepared by the same good folks.  Michele R. as always has the best description of setup and food. So, using her as a point person means I have less to drone on about.

Have been twice to the new digs so far and they are still trying to get up to 100% OPS. But the tacos and other foods are just as good as over at TRT #1. Try the Guac and Chips. Fresh avocados and chips are yummy. And top off the meal with sopapillas and honey. Freshly fried and yummy honey poured into the middle and what could be better?

I find I like the mid-day better than breakfast, but the serve breakfast tacos all day. I am not much of a veggie guy, but the meatless corn taco is so good.Everything is priced from about $2-$3, and two tacos and a beer are a good lunch for even a big guy like me.

A few rough spots so far, like no iced tea available and seems like fewer bottled beers at this place v. TRT #1? Maybe just my imagination since I am a micro draft kind of guy. Also, the Patio area is still waiting for tables and chairs. Heard it is dog friendly outside.

They could also stand to wipe down the tables more often at both places.

The Loos are large and handicap friendly. 

PS-Yelp, the address is 1750 W. McMillan, Meridian at the new Northpointe Retail Plaza shopping center.
Very good work, bring my mini australian shepherd and they treat him very well, was just a bath but they even trim their nails and paws fur. Very happy

This spa was one of the biggest spas I've ever been too! It was very clean and the staff who did my nails was very nice. The lady at the front desk was little short with us but overall the Royal Pedicure was fantastic! I feel 100x better after having it. Would def recommend!

We had a very good time with friends, but the service was sooo slow only to arrive incomplete, and incorrect We opted for dining in as well as bowling. We were told there was an hour and half wait for bowling although there were at least 20 unoccupied lanes that we saw when we arrived, so we decided to have dinner at Big Al's while we waited. It took 35 minutes to get our drink orders, and at least another 20 to receive them. By this time our lane was available, so we had all our food transferred to our bowling lane. When the food arrived, there were missing orders, then completely wrong orders, on top of having to wait longer for bowling shoes. Geez. We had a great time in spite of it, but I think in the future we'll go to a different establishment.

I ate at The Habit on State St in Santa Barbara a  couple of years ago;  was pleased to see a  location  here in Treasure Valley (near The Village in Meridian). The Santa Barbara Char, the Portabello Char, the Tri-Tip sandwich, and the Ahi Tuna Filet sandwich are the best fast food items of any menu on Earth. They may compete with In-and-Out, but there's no contest--The Habit is light years better!

The food was good, but the service was SLOW. We stood at the entrance for 10 minutes without being acknowledged, several employees walked past us, not one made eye contact. Finally a waitress seated us. She was polite, but was one of the employees that walked past us multiple times. 50 minutes later we got our entrees. Again, the food was good, portions average size, but the service was terrible.

Major kudos to my husband for finding this place for us to try! 

Per the recommendations, I made a dinner reservation for 4 people at the time that would work best for us. When we arrived, I noticed our table right away and we were seated promptly. Our server was so kind and had some amazing recommendations. My husband and father in law got some fancy bourbon cocktail that they said was very good! I will get to try one of their fun cocktails once I'm no longer pregnant. 

Their food was also incredible. We started with their roasted Brussels and they were everything I had hoped they would be. All of the food that we ordered was very tasty. The chefs were incredibly kind as well to assist with a special request from my husband as well. 

At the end of it all, we were all very satisfied and looking forward to returning. We also tried their seasonal desserts they were offering and I'm still drooling over the lemon cake.

Yummy yummy in my tummy. I love Blue Star and this location is great. The people working here are great! Bagels are delicious and they make it just how you want (for me light cream cheese, tomato, onion, and salt and pepper. Go here and be happy.

I've been coming here since it opened with my family. It's awesome to get to watch a game have some food, take your kids to the arcade afterwards. But lately, not having a server and having to order by scanning their QR code, PREPAY for your food and not really have an option for refills, request for napkins or even silverware, it is too much work for the hefty price. I got a burger with a beer for $25 with a meager tip.  I had to order my family's food and drinks first because it already took too long to do that and I have a current iPhone and I am not technologically challenged, the app doesn't work well on my iPhone so it took 20 minutes. Going to the bar isn't an option if you have to leave your young kids to go order. You have to pay a tip when ordering not knowing who it's going to or even why I'm tipping. I do not blame the people working here I blame the process. It's no longer a fun experience I had to have my head in my phone to order ignoring my family. Pay your servers a living wage and just bring them back.

Edit** I will give that food came out faster than usual and that was great it just means I was still ordering my own food when it came. Stopping to help situate the kids. Then I didn't want to put in a 3rd order for more drinks and dessert shushing my kids while having my head in my phone in my trying to navigate the website. We would've stayed longer and ordered more but it just wasn't a fun easy experience like it used to be.

I came here the other day with some friends.  I had a skinny margarita, I was surprised as to how small it was and the presentation wasn't your standard presentation of a margarita. My friend ordered a burger off the menu and I ordered a build your own burger. I received my burger and it tasted burned, I asked it to be cooked medium well but the flavor was off putting.  My girlfriend tried the chicken and it was definitely cooked, fried to a crisp. I don't think I'd be back, the place was empty and our bill at the end of it all was pretty high for burgers and one alcoholic beverage. Sorry, maybe it was an off night.
Took my car in for the brakes. They provided pictures of the brakes that showed in detail the requirement for replacement. Done quickly and the price was reasonable.

I like kneaders.  Is it the best food out there?  No, does it make me feel warm and happy?  Yep.

My go to is the french dip and the wild rice soup.  Good stuff.

Rather than accepting bowling reservations (which makes no sense, especially now) you are expected to show up and hang out for 2 extra hours, during which time you'll be invited to a dining area to wait.  This might seem reasonable until you encounter the strange, automated environment which only looks like a normal restaurant.  In fact you will be required to seat yourself, navigate an online menu and pay for your order, including tip, before you receive any type of human interaction.
