Your food may or may not arrive on the first attempt but rest assured you'll be charged both times.  And there is literally NO checking back or ongoing service of any kind so tipping seems rather inappropriate.  This is an experience that should be represented as it is:  grossly overpriced, mediocre tasting fast food.

I've been coming here since I moved to Boise and I've never been disappointed. Today Cindi did my pedicure and she's amazing, she was gentle and super nice! :) The environment is beautiful and the staff is great overall. Once you come here, I don't think you'd want to go somewhere else!

Jade is amazing! She is professional and gives honest opinions about hair color and style! She is educated and up to date on techniques and procedures. She gives the best head massages and always makes me feel pretty when I leave! She's amazing! Such a talented artist!!!

I have used Vanguard for six years and they have serviced every house I have lived and my rental. They come out quarterly to do a full service and make sure that all areas are covered. If issues arise between services, just give them a call and they will send someone out to take care of you. Tim was sent on this last visit and he was fantastic! He was helpful in educating how some of the sprays work and how to further prevent some of the issues between services if needed. But he very much made sure that if we needed anything between services, to call and they will get him or someone else out. Highly recommend using them!
Atmosphere was nice and the restaurant was clean. Food was delicious. Lots of flavor and the beef was so tender. Was a wonderful mixture of veggies rice noodles and protein.

This is an OVER THE TOP LARGER THAN LIFE sports bar and bowling alley! Not to mention arcade games, food and fun! This place has HUGE with emphasis on HUGE TV screens (it covers an entire wall) and they have an over 21 bar too in case you dont feel like hanging around all the kids.

Pros: lots to do and a nice BIG clean atmosphere. Good place to catch a big game...they have a full bar and a decent beer selection.

Cons: its extremely busy and LOUD!!! Kids and teenagers EVERYWHERE! In my opinion the food is mediocre at best, and its always difficult to get a bowling lane (always seems to be an hour or more wait). Overall I would say as a whole, my experience with Big Als is ok (I've been here more than 20 times), as they have gotten busier, the staff seems more stressed out, and with that stress they have become borderline rude. I don't go here much anymore, which is unfortunate because the concept of this place is brilliant....the execution just seems to be off!

The food was actually really decent. I ordered a steak and it was cooked perfectly and was highly tender. My review lacks star power because the service was extremely slow. We sat waiting for our food for a very long time. For sure go for the food but don't expect to rush.

Had the crap scared out of me by a med spa regarding "suspicious" mole/sun spot. Thy for me in the same day!!! Very kind and thoughtful bedside manner. Gave me a thorough once over to see if I had more and scheduled me for a snip for the spot near my eye. I returned and it was a simple procedure. Barely felt a thing, even tho she doubts it anything g to worry about she still sent it off to pathology. Physician was on time and staff was very attentive. Thanks for the free samples.

I've given this place a few tries but I'm done.  

Cold food and everything tastes the same.  A bunch of cotija and cold ingredients on a cold, and falls apart easily corn tortilla.

I've tried to hard to like this place but nope -- not again. 

Plenty of better tacos spots in this town than this place.
For great food and service this is one to go to regularly.   It's a small restaurant tucked in a strip mall that's a delightful find.

I can not rave enough about this salon!  After a cheerful greeting that warmed my heart I was repeatedly offered refreshments while I waited for my daughter to have a haircut.  Moms, I'm sure you feel me here when I say my teenage daughter has waist length hair she is VERY particular about.  Well Katie nailed it!  It was the first time in a very long time my daughter had anything done to her hair where she got back into the car with a smile on her face, confident and happy!  A Beautiful Reaction Indeed!!!

My husband and I were skeptics when we realized child care was needed with our demanding work schedules. Neither of us went to day care growing up and we were worried about the quality of care our son would receive.  We were both pleasantly surprised and our strong advocates of New Horizon and their program. We have been going to the Meridian location for over two years now, and have seen how much our child has learned within that time. The structure is so great for him, he actually gets sad when the weekend comes and he can't see his "friends".  He is constantly learning new things and comes home everyday with a report of what he did, which is great because I can not personally pick him up, so this is my only way of recapping his day.

I would say my only complaint is that the staff definitely at times has lack of communication with each other. I try to be understanding, as I realize there are many children to keep tabs on, but it can be frustrating when you feel like you have to repeat yourself or hunt down belongings that have gone missing.

I was in the area, and in the mood for a sandwich, and had heard about this place from 2 acquaintances recently, so I decided on Fat Guy's for lunch.  I'm not sure if the door I walked in through was the front door or the back door.  It's the one that you go into if you're coming from the parking lot, but you walk in and are faced with the bathroom ... which is not well-kept.

Being my first visit, I had no idea what to order and was a little overwhelmed by so much on the chalkboard, so went with what I know and like - a meatball sandwich.  
He asked if I was ready, and I ordered the meatball sandwich ..... and was told they were out of meatballs.  So, I asked what's good and he said the #16 - Trevor - is popular.  He said it's like a French dip.
#16 Trevor Melt, $9.95.
Roast beef, hot cappy, bacon, and pepperjack cheese.
I told him I didn't do heat though, and he asked what kind of cheese I would like, and I went with Swiss.  He then asked what I wanted for my side; I went with the potato salad.  He said anything else?  I asked for a cookie .... and was told they were out of cookies.  Alrighty then.  Just give me a large soda .... they only have one size for $2.19

When they brought my meal to me, I have to say, it looked pretty dang good.  I bit into my sandwich and it was a pretty dang good sandwich. 
 But then I started to feel the heat.  I opened the sandwich because I was sure they put the pepperjack cheese on it, but it wasn't that.  So, I took another bite.  Gah, where is that heat coming from?!  It was from the "hot cappy" - and you can actually see the red heat sauce on it.  I said I didn't do heat ....  Anyway, I picked off the hot cappy and finally enjoyed my sandwich.  I knew my husband would love it had he been there, so I was planning on taking the other half - with the hot cappy I had taken off - home to him.

Then there was the potato salad.  People actually like this salad?  Man, those potatoes were so hard.  Like freshly cut and never boiled hard.  Not even kidding.  Really really hard.  And the sauce was waaaaaay herby.  I just did not like this at all.  I'm actually making a face as I type this and am thinking about it.  It was horrible.

I drank my soda and then went up to the counter to ask if I could get a box.  The girl took my plate and said she'd take care of it and then proceeded to pull off the sandwich and put the potato salad (was taking it home for the husband to try to see if he had the same opinion) and the meat I had taken off, into the trash.  She wrapped up the sandwich and put in a new cup of potato salad and a new cup of the au jus.

It's a fast-paced place ... though the orders don't come out as fast as you would think.  And it's not very clean.  The floors, the walls, the chairs, the tables, they all need a good washing.

Tried these today for a quick supper. This newish business (about 3 months old) is in the former Irena's European Foods location on Fairview.

There are 9 empanadas and usually one torta each day. Wine, beer and soft drinks are available. Before visiting today, I made the mistaken assumption that it was another outlet for Tangos over on Orchard. But, I was wrong, as they are their own business. And another difference is that their empanadas are baked, not fried as those from Tangos.

To give us a good taste, we took home a #1-A beef, the original beef, #3-chicken, and a #9-the Vegan Curry veggies. Since we were going to have them for a light dinner, they asked if I wanted them unbaked, so we could self-bake at home. She gave me simple instructions and I was good. Normally they would bake while you wait, about a 5 minute wait. Each empanada costs $3.50.

Overall, we enjoyed all of them. The flavors were good and clean. Of the three we enjoyed the #3 chicken best, the #9 Curry next, and the #1 beef. The beef, for our tastes, was too salty. But for some diners, a salty empanada with beer would be wonderful. We would go back to try some of the others next time.

The establishment is clean and the help is anxious to insure you have a good experience.

45th person to review Dickey's Barbecue Pit in Meridian, Idaho on Overland near Eagle Rd. This is my 409th Yelp review. 

Yay! I'm a fan... I've been here a few times this month and had both Uber eats and Grub Hub deliver to work. Why so much? I like to eat protein and low card, so I can get a 2 meat plate with 2 sides (usually beans, a salad, or spinach) for $12.99-- wait there's more!! If you check in on Yelp you get a FREE (YES!) 2 meat plate when you buy one and 2 drinks ($1), which is either lunch for tomorrow, or a kids lunch! You can't get this deal when ordering delivery, tho. 

The meats are very tender, juicy, and seasoned. The portions are small to average, which is perfect and filling. You get free ice cream from the soft serve machine! Kids love making their own cones. 

The staff is very friendly, always. The building does well with its space-- many tables all made very sturdy and accommodate any body size and shape. They have very long picnic-like tables for large parties. 

They do catering, too. I've taken many photos of the menu, of the deals, and the yummy food!

Holy smokes these are the best sandwiches Ive ever tasted. Fresh ingidients, great combinations, friendly staff,and always super full bellies. I cant wait to try all of the sandwiches they have on the massive menu.
We have the package where they clean the inside and out. They have a great lounge with soda popcorn and coffee to wait while having your car cleaned. The car always looks great

Man, Covid must have messed up Big Al's birthday parties. We had one here in 2018 and it was amazing experience. Private Room with party planner/server/Did It All host we were blown away how nice and organized it was we didn't have do anything. 
We Just had one here this last Sunday and it was nothing like our last party there. We didn't know you no longer get a private room and no party organizer. You have to walk up to order your food no servers no party area setup like it was last time.  Glad we brought plates and balloons just as back ups cuz last time that was all included. At least the lady clearly off tables helped us out some. The kitchen wasn't even going to give us a lighter fit candles or a knife for the cake but this lady said she would do it. They even put gratuity on our bill but no one served us we did it all. What is wrong these days. Seemed like prices were super high and 1/2 the quality. Unreal. Definitely won't be telling people to do their kids bday parties here like we have been.

My wife and friend went to lunch here on Tuesday. It took them over 45 minutes to get an order in. You stand in line to order. They should have left. 

They ordered soup and  a half of turkey sandwich. Unlike previous experiences, the soup and sandwich were of lower quality. Before, their turkey sandwich was one of the best in the area. Their pastries were always meh, compared to others. 

The dining room was a semi-mess with the large crowd. Doubt if they will return after this experience.

Food tastes good, but not authentic. Service is prompt but not very good. The server was so busy that he had no time for small talk or smiles. And he never checked back after delivering the food.
Clean place, playing Mexican tunes. Overall experience was okay. 

I doubt i will be back.

The bed was kinda comfy and the shower was big but that's really it for this place. Our room smelled so bad I was scared to look under the bed to find a dead...SOMETHING! I don't know why it smelled so bad. We slept with window open and that was not to bad but got a little chilly but not to noisy. When we first walked in to our room we were overwhelmed with air freshener. But after we turned off the blasting air conditioning it smelled of rotten milk and death. SO SHOAL!! Nasty carpet too.

Originally had my first Habit down in California. Was excited to see it here in the Village Meridian. Figures the Village would have it as they are getting all the best franchises available. 

Habit features a good honest burger very similar to In and Out. They set their burger apart by the caramelized onions. It's great getting a pub style burger at a great price. 

Average wait time and clean building. Defiantly recommend to anyone looking for another burger joint.
One of my favorite places to browse! So much to see. Bigger than all the other Zamzow's and such a large variety of plants, shrubs, trees, flowers, pots and patio decor! Very knowledgeable staff!

This is a solid Meridian neighborhood restaurant equipped with made-from-scratch, flavor infused options to entice your tastebuds! If you are tired of the crowds at the Villiage, give this place a try. Great atmosphere, fantastic mixologists with fun different drink options. I have had both dinner and brunch here....both excellent. So if you find yourself in Meridian, stop by and grab a cold one on the patio!

I order Marcos a lot because we live so close.  The pizza is good and the $6.99 medium pizza is a good deal.   My two complaints are:
1. Cooks need to wear gloves. They handled my money and went straight to handling dough with no washing of hands.
2. The website rarely works.  It's so frustrating. Coupons never work. And you're $10 rewards expires too fast.

Absolute garbage on a plate. I don't know who is "cooking" this food, but they CLEARLY do not care about making a good product, and have no pride in making food that tastes good. I don't know how rice, that has been sitting in a steamer all day, can taste almost undercooked, and overcooked and dry, at the same time. The chow mein was dry as well, and tasted funky. The kung pao chicken contained very few vegetables, and as I was chewing, the thought popped into my head, "stop eating this, you're going to get sick. Something's not right." I believe it was my survival instinct kicking in and warning me to not put any more of this crap into my body. I listened and threw the rest into the trash can, where it belonged. I really hope I don't get food poisoning.

I am not exaggerating when I say these empanada are amazing! You can tell they're made with love! I like the fact that I'm supporting a small business of an amazing women! 10 out of 10 would recommend!! I got the chicken and ham with swiss empanadas.

Pleasantly surprised with their food. We have not had the best of luck with Mexican food in this area lately. El Tenampa had delicious Margaritas, good food and great service. We will be back to try other items on the menu.

Do not bother.  I get your short staffed. Everyone is...but don't let us sit there for 45 minutes, serve people seated after you then make me go up to the front and plead for someone to take our food order,, with the busboy standing there "saying this is the table I have been telling you needed service" then serve so so food! Thank God for the busboy who kept us in chips & salsa and even got us our Margaritas.
Great tacos!  Hate the menu set up. Hard to figure out what's what on the menu and then feel rushed in line.  I like the flavor, but don't go out of my way for that reason

Place is trash. Spent $80 on three meals and sides, delivery driver dropped off the order missing sides, cold food, tiny servings. Tried to call no one answered. Read the other Yelp reviews, turns out I should have done that first.

They have a good variety of all different kinds of sandwiches. Many are not to the liking of the variety of people that live here in Idaho. I was very turned off that they had played Fox news on their TV and that they were promoting racist and negative commentary while you're trying to purchase a sandwich from them. They are open to customizing a sandwich but I think it is extremely political for them to politicize negative commentary at their sandwich shop And will never return their because their job is to make and sell sandwiches and not push politics on the patrons who are there to spend money in the shop. I feel that him publicizing his racist views it's a stream Lee demeaning to the American population it should not be allowed.

UPDATE 5/11/2021 - Well, Leo contacted me through Yelp and offered me a $25 gift certificate to come back in and try them again "under new management" and re-review them. Leo said the gift cert would be waiting at the counter. We drove their last night to have dinner and asked for the gift certificate and it could not be found. They asked if we still wanted to dine and that "is no liquor being served okay because we don't have our license right now?". My answer was "no" to both questions. Well folks, my experience has been nothing but "no bueno". GOOD LUCK!

I am so very thankful for Dr. Brooks. She helped get my skin back on track from (I am not exaggerating) a breakout that came straight from the pit of hell. 

After spending three months trying everything I could think of--cutting out gluten, dairy, adding in supplements, changing my pillow case every day, switching up my skin regimen, etc, I was fed up and went to the dermatologist. I was able to get on her schedule within a day of calling. I showed up, filled out a little paper work, and then spent about 20 minutes with Dr. Brooks and left with a game plan.

I've been following her treatment for the past two-ish months and I'm starting to see great results. She assured me I wouldn't see results in a month, and to be patient and give my body time to adapt to the treatment. My skin if finally clearing up! **So many happy tears.**

We just had a follow up appointment and she seemed unsurprised that my skin was responding well to the treatment she prescribed.  We've now decided to start tackling the beast of erasing the scars this breakout left behind. When taking a look at them, she seemed unfazed and with confidence let me know those will go away, and quickly. PRAISE.

Thank you Dr. Brooks for helping me get my skin back. I am so unbelievably grateful for what you and your staff have done for me!

had lunch today and will not go back because BBQ pork sandwich was fatty, and wife was unhappy and her potato salad was not very good. I had the brisket sandwich and it was ok but I ordered fries and sandwich was almost gone by the time I got them. Had to ask where the fries were and was told getting them now.

Also got there lemon aid which was nothing but water and asked them to throw it out because it had no flavor and was told they would fix  the machine and when I left no one had gone near the drink machine.

Thought the price was a little high for what we had 2 drinks, 2 small sandwich's and 2 sides were 18.00 and change.

could have gone to Goodwood's for about the same price and had a better meal most likely will not go back.

Been banking with ICCU for over 30 years and I would have to say that the only improvements I have seen are in that they have more locations and they are open on Saturdays.   I used to do all of my loans through them but even though my credit falls into the "very good" category this bank seems to have a problem with having competitive rates or even giving loans in a timely fashion.   I have kept an account with them just because of their location to my house but most of my banking is down at another bank that has better rates and faster turn around on loans.

I really hate giving out bad reviews, and honestly only save them for situations that I feel were just bad all around and not necessarily one component.  Unfortunately, my experience here this last weekend and a follow-up return today to discuss a situation I discovered later, were both very disappointing.  

I stopped in this past Sunday evening, around 7pm.  Barely anyone sitting in the dining area, one person in line in front of me being waited on.   The customer ordered two items and I can say without exaggeration that I stood there for a good 5 minutes before it was my turn.  The server was moving so slowly it was ridiculous. 

When it was my turn, I told the server the what I wanted, and after making the second item assumed I was done ordering and asked the woman now behind me what she wanted.  I politely commented that I wasn't done and she didn't even apologize.  I apologized to the woman behind me. 

I got our meals to go, not paying much attention to the total, grabbed a fountain drink and left.  The food itself was really not very good.  I ordered two steak tacos on corn tortillas.  Tortilla was dry and tasteless.  The steak was also very dry and cold, which leads me to believe it had been sitting there awhile.  Very unimpressed.  

Upon further inspection of my receipt I found in my wallet, three days later, I was shocked to realize that I paid $14 for my two tacos! ! ! ! !   OMG!  I am not even sure that two tacos at Barbacoa would cost $14.  Clearly something was not correct here, so today I returned to inquire about the charges.

The cashier looked bewildered when I explained the situation and quickly passed me off to her manager; which is fine as he was probably the correct person for me to speak with anyways.  I explained the situation and he confirmed that I was actually charged for 6 tacos, not 2.  Holy Cow!  That is quite the difference.  I asked for a refund for the difference and he told me that wasn't possible.  Returns can only be done on the same day as the purchase.  What?!?  Maybe I am wrong, but I am pretty sure a POS system can give a refund no matter the day of the week.  He said the best he could do was give me a free meal voucher.  Really???  I told him I didn't see this as a fair trade.  He then agreed I should get two meal vouchers.  I told him I still didn't see this as acceptable, but if this is all he was willing to give me then I would have to take it.  So great!  I get vouchers to go back to a restaurant, with service and food that I was not impressed with in the first place.  Really disappointing, especially when the only reason I came here in the first place was my go-to restaurant across the street is closed on Sundays, so I thought I would give the competitor a try.  Bummer!

This is a very clean and professional place to get piercings. My boyfriend and I went together and each got piercings. They were super friendly and the woman who helped us was really meticulous - which is good when you're getting a piercing!

We were seen in urgent care this morning by Gabby (an NP there). I was very impressed. She was personable, knowledgeable and very helpful. She went above and beyond to answer all of my questions and was very kind and courteous.

Fast and friendly service makes this burger joint stand out from the rest. When they are giving you your order they tell you what it is so you can make sure you are getting the correct item. After you place your order at the counter they give you a pager and it blinks when your order is ready and then you go up to the counter to receive your food. You can also customize everything. My favorite item is the veggie burger. You can you make it vegan by omitting the cheese and mayonnaise. The veggie burger also comes with lettuce. tomato, and cucumber. It is very yummy and only about six bucks. There is a condiment bar by the drink station and it has peppers, mustard, ketchup, and fry sauce.

I've been going to Fat Guys since they opened several years ago. I have personally tried every item on the menu. There is honestly something for everyone, from the classic Italian to the Bologna sandwich. The fresh salads, meats and sides are super tasty and did I mention this is for Fat Guys!! The sandwiches are huge!! 

Chef Wally is a perfect character for a deli so aptly named! Shelly and the rest of the staff are great additions who take pride in making each dish fresh and tasty. 

If your planning on stopping by for lunch plan to take your time as the lunch rush is usually busy...go figure great sandwiches for lunch right!! 

On another note for those of us looking for a tasty option for the tailgate or office they do catering. I organize a retiree luncheon each month. Chef Wally creates great tasting options like enchiladas, lasagna and pulled pork sandwiches that are always a hit!!

Come for the service and stay for the food!! Fat Guys is worth the wait!!

Service was good but unfortunately not all the food was.  I had the ribeye and for the price I was not impressed.  Small cut, not really seasoned and neither were the asperagus that came with it.  My wife did have the pork chop and it was very good.   I do want the place to succeed and believe it showed it is worth a second try.

A big come down for BSB. Bagels seem to be lacking the former quality. Not as chewy and pale as piece of balloon bread. Seems like they aren't boiling them, but just baking. Bagels are no better than supermarket in-house bagels. The left over day old bagels basket seems to reflect this poorer quality. 

My advice is to buy your bagels at Panera from
Now on. Much more toothsome bagels. And, go on Tuesdays and get a baker's dozen for less than $8. 

We won't be returning.
Amazing, legit empanadas. Clean, cool atmosphere. Even you've never eaten empanadas before, this is a great place!

This place is VERY high priced. Noise level is just plain loud and unpleasant.  The food was just average to poor but priced like fine dining. Very poor value for the money. Service was a little slow but ok. Bowling was very expensive. Much better bowling lanes elsewhere at far better pricing.I guess not much to like about this place.  VERY expensive and overrated.. Will not go back.

DO NOT RECOMMEND and would not refer a friend.  
Booked a GEL manicure which was smooth over the phone. We showed up on time and were immediately approached when we walked in. Sat down with colors in hand to choose from.  

My technician yanked my arm to get my hand closer, twice (sorry I'm short). I was shocked as I would expect her to ask me to scoot up instead of aggressively yanking on my arm?  

My daughter's nail table had the previous customer's nail files and nail dust still on the table and the tech brushed it off but didn't use anything to clean the area. My daughter's technician also immediately asked for her color but since they were so quick to seat us we hadn't picked one out yet, which unfortunately seemed to annoy her.  

Still picking colors and my technician files my nail bed and pushes my DRY cuticles back with her fingernail instead of a sanitized metal tool that I'm used to. I'm also used to soaking my cuticles first as part of the process but this was a new place so I went along.  

I was told to go wash my hands. The sink and soap bottle were dirty. There was also an option to use a bar of soap...but I think you can imagine the filth of that.  

My technician then starts applying clear paint and I asked if she would be willing to cut the cuticle since I'm used to that in any other manicure that I've ever had. She told me she did cut my cuticle, that I talk too much and implied I wasn't paying attention. This is false. You can see in the picture my cuticle is still there.  

When I asked for a natural GEL color that was transparent, my technician said no but my daughter's technician was very helpful in finding 4 colors I could choose from so I picked from those choices.  My daughter and I were talking about the cuticle issue and her technician interrupted me to tell me they were saving us $5 by not soaking and doing a full manicure and that if we wanted to pay the full $28 we should have spoken up. This was confusing from a customer standpoint since we requested a GEL manicure on the phone, they quoted $28, they confirmed GEL manicure when they sat us, I asked for her to cut my cuticles, and then didn't do a manicure?  

At that point, I wanted to be done and out of there because of course they are talking in their language to each other and it really became kind of a hostile situation and very uncomfortable.  

Within 2 min of finishing my nails, my technician greeted a recurring customer so welcomely and started working on her nails. I think the good reviews are for recurring customers that got past the initial visit? I'm not really sure.  

After my daughter's nails were done, my daughter's technician took our payment, printed a receipt and instead of waiting until we were done signing, she just walked away leaving us at the front to sign and then....I guess leave the signed receipt on the counter? I totally regret leaving any sort of tip. We are both in the service industry and we were very generous to them!  

Overall, the technicians were rude, argumentative, not apologetic, and lacked any sort of customer service skills. While they were cheaper than other options, it's not worth it to me for the unprofessionalism, not using sanitized tools, and the dirty conditions. There are many other options to choose from...definitely try H.O.C. Nail Bar and Spa. I love them!

I consider myself somewhat of a nail snob and since moving to Idaho Nail Tek has become my go to place. First they are always busy, which is a good sign. The decor is super cute and girly and everyone that works there seems to genuinely enjoy their job. I have had my nails done by Tumi and she is incredible. She does some ridiculous design work and no matter how crazy of an idea I bring her she figures out how to make it work. An appointment is for sure required if you want to get in and out as quick as possible. Oh bring cash and they will give you a punch card which earns you freebies. They accept credit cards but there's a $1 fee. I love this place!

Great location too watch a game. Cannot complain about the sound and the large screens to watch it. Cost of alcohol rather steep at the current time it may be due to covid you have to order each order individually off of a QR code that will not work with my phone I had to download scratch that go to a website that would allow me to use the QR code to order drinks and food. Couldn't complain about the food. $25 a pitcher is up there but you can  hear the game and the environment is completely about the game at hand. Very quick service, but different than having a server. Cost of food is expected an environment like this that cost a lot to run. If you want to watch a game with sound and it's all about the game don't care about the price great place.

Let's be honest people, this is not top notch BBQ but... for fast food BBQ, its not bad; especially the prices. The service was great and you get free ice cream. :) The lettuce and veggies are always bright in color and crisp. They have a lot of specials and I like that they are consistent with their food.

The bagels here are quite good, but not the best ever. But probably the best in Boise. 

The  cream cheese smears are many, but are applied too heavily for my likes. Ask for the smear on the side and apply to your own taste and thickness. They also make sandwiches from the bagels. 

Coffee is Dawson Taylor and that is worth an extra star, in itself. 

This a good place for a quick breakfast and bagels are stout and large enough to share for 2 light eaters. 

My favorite bargain here is the bags of day old bagels for $2.00 a bag. If I am going to freeze bagels for home use, this is a perfect option. 

Access is good, although parking is sometimes full, but not often. Handicap parking is close by and the floor is all one level. No trips to the loo, so no comments here.

Seating is spacious and tables with standard chairs prevail. The tables do need to be wiped down a bit more often sometimes.  

If you have trouble locating them, look behind Crispy Cream Donuts.

Review for the restaurant only: My boyfriend and I started going to Big Als restaurant for game days to watch all of the games. It soon became routine to go every Sunday. But almost every time we went we had poor and slow service. We would often see waitresses walk by without checking on our table and it would take a very long time before someone came over to take our order. I had, on a couple occasions, the wrong food brought out to me. 

It is also very cold in the restaurant, so cold that I often have to bring multiple sweaters just to feel comfortable. The group of people we would go with would also complain about how cold it was.

Although I love the big tvs, we have had consistently bad service and overpriced average food. We most likely will be finding another sports bar to watch the games at.

My wife and I had an outstanding dinner tonight.  She had the Salmon and loved it. I had the gnocchi with grilled chicken and that was great too!  The service was great as well. The only negative I can say is the door to the men's restroom was very difficult to close and open.

Some of the best thai food I have ever had. The sushi is absolutely amazing. The staff is always super polite. The food is very authentic. The only slight issue I have ever had in the numerous times I have visited here was slightly long wait times, how ever that happens with most restaurants when they get super packed. I would highly recommend to every body
*UPDATE* Recently picked up take out and when I entered the other patrons started chanting "Let's go Brandon" at me because I had a mask on .. staff didn't do anything .. will NEVER be going back.

Sherry and I went to enjoy Smooth Avenue Band on the patio, and we were both pleasantly surprised by the quality of the food and drink.  This is not your average bowling alley.

Our server nailed it with his recommendation of a Peanut Butter Bacon Burger, Cobb Salad, and Lemony Stardust libation.  The burger was large and juicy with the charbroiled flavor of the beef blending perfectly with the smokey bacon and peanut butter sauce.  The Cobb Salad was generously sized and topped with a flavorful sliced grilled chicken breast.  And the Lemony Stardust was an amazing combination of a mojito and a lemon drop, a perfect drink for a hot night and sizzling blues.

Unfortunately while the back of house rocked it, the front of house needs a major tuneup.  Our food was served without utensils, napkins, or the ranch dressing Sherry had asked for on the side.  After waiting 5 minutes, I had to hunt them down from the hostess inside.  We had to ask our server (who was scrambling to cover an area that should have been staffed by three) four times for fry sauce and a drink menu.  To his credit, he comped our drinks.

The service experience diminished what could have been a five star evening down to two stars, and that's a shame because of the potential of presented by the menu and the location.
Awesome place , everyone is so helpful and friendly. Was a great decision to go here. I would highly recommended this place.

Love love! Great little place, convenient location, super friendly staff and affordable. Nice menu, not so many options that it's overwhelming but a nice variety. Lots of beer and wine options. Will definitely be back!

I love Craftsman, from the free drinks with a membership to my incredible stylist Kristina, to the hot towel massage-thingy is all around a wonderful experience. Kristina does a bang up of a good job!

I got my nose pierced at Imperial Body Art six years ago. When I got it pierced, their location was on Orchard in Boise. Since then they have moved to this location on Fairview in Meridian. 

My piercing experience way back when was great. Sure, it hurt a little and made my eyes water. But it was still a pleasant experience. High levels of professionalism, cleanliness, and there is just a friendly bunch of folks that works here. I left their shop with a cute little nose hoop in--never once got infected, never gave me any problems, so I have never once taken out the hoop! YOU GUYS. That is SIX years without ever taking it out. I've been so happy with it that I've never wanted to take it out or put a different piece of jewelry in. 

But this last week I had to take out the hoop and put in a stud for a formal occasion. I've spent hours in front of the mirror trying to figure out how to take this thing out and just could not get it. So, I gave them a call and asked if they'd swap it out for me. I showed up, waited a few minutes while the piercer finished up with an appointment, picked out a new stud, and they swapped it out for me. All I had to pay for was the stud! 

The gal who helped me was super friendly and quick! Plus, she told me that I can come back whenever and have them swap it out for me if I don't want to mess with it on my own. "We only charge if you're buying jewelry or we make a new hole," is what she told me. I left paying $28 for the new piece of jewelry that I bought. And now as I write this, I am missing my nose hoop. So with that, I think I'll head their way right now and have them swap it back out for me. :)
YUKI IS ABSOLUTELY THE BEST...  amazing work, amazing customer service, amazing personality.... A total pleasure all the way around!!! I'm obsessed with my nails every time.

I cannot recommend this place enough. The food was so tasty. I got the vegan pho- so good! The tofu was yummy. (I will say they didn't have veg broth- so I opted for chicken broth) the egg rolls were very good as well! Paid $20 for the pho and rolls- which feels like a very fair price. Also the atmosphere here is nice - can definitely see this being a date spot. 10/10 will come again

I'd give zero if I could. I used to love this place but everything is changed, everything is insanely priced which would be fine if we had wait staff! They sat us.  Then no waiter came around for 15 minutes. They had an order online QR code so we did that but there was no way to get a kids drink on there for my son they didn't have all the sides and you couldn't substitute anything.   It was really impersonal and then they ask for a tip online. It was equal to a cafeteria type experience but for 80 dollars worth
Of burger and pizza and two drinks' . The Netflix and chill drink was not the same as its always been and honestly it's just such a disappointment. The person I came with also was not happy and he isn't even from here.   All the wait staff just stood around talking.  I'll revise my review IF I go back and things are better.  Don't go here. It's not an idaho kinda place anymore.

Really good sandwiches! First time today! The sandwiches we ordered were the turkey bacon avocado and the turkey avocado. I would definitely go back and get the turkey bacon avocado, the bacon added that nice crunch. The sandwiches were really fresh and pretty tasty! I would also go back for their fries, nice and fresh and you don't even need to eat them with any sauce!

First time going to Tin Roof
I am offended as a Mexican with these "tacos"
Tortillas not heated up and falling apart
Cold food 
The lime was inside of the shrimp taco it was a very poor experience and I wish we hadn't wasted our night our choosing this restaurant.

Came here for the first time and was pleasantly serviced. The nail tech kept asking me if I was happy with his work several times while doing my pedicure. He kept explaining what he was doing while cutting and filing my nails. Great service. Coming here from now on.

Pool: 20X40, 8.5 ft deep gunite pool with an automatic pool cover. Pool is heated using a heat pump. Included in the bid was a very large surface drainage system and placement of 18 large landscape rocks. also included was a request to pour a 2200 sq ft. free form patio around the pool.

We requested bids from 4 companies, and after careful comparison and research on the internet, chose ChI. It was overwhelming at first because we had no prior experience with a swimming pool and each had their own idea on equipment and pool design. During the comparison process CHI always stood out. CHI not only offered a great price, but was hands down the best at design ideas. One company wanted me to design the shape by using a can of paint! One kept coming back to the same design no matter what we said. It was their way or no way. CHI used CAD software to help us visualize ideas and guided us through each decision. It was great.

Construction went smooth, and these guys were always willing to accommodate little changes here and there. We started in late February, and even with spring weather always causing problems, were swimming by the first of May.

In the end the entire project either met or exceeded our expectations. Especially the pool. Its beautiful. They finished early, and without price changes. If you are thinking of installing or having a pool repaired, I'd highly recommend you get a bid from these guys.

Hi everybody! It's Bob Flanders your favorite Idaho food critic. Today at around 2:30 I was gonna get my usual after lunch donut but then, my go-to donut shop was closed. I gasped and clenched. I was in disbelief. I was panicking, I had to have my after lunch donut. I was in tears. I was hopeless. Then, I saw a shimmer of light in the alley way. A shaman emerged from the alley way, as his loin cloth fluttered in the wind. He said " My boy, there is a donut shop not to far from here.". I said " Thank you!" as I bowed to the shaman. I looked in the direction of DK donuts, and then I looked back into the alley way and he was gone. Then, I started my journey to DK Donuts. The donut was acceptable.

Elizabeth is amazing. I usually get my lashes done in LA but they always over charge and the lashes always find themselves on my face or pillow the NEXT day. It's been almost three days and they've stayed in perfect form. I've barely had to comb through them. I've received endless compliments and my husband LOVES them. (Hubba hubba! ) The rooms are nice and cozy. I'm five months pregnant and she didn't mind me tossing and turning every second! Haha She was so easy to talk to, I wish I could find a nail technician like her back home. (I'm sure there are, I just haven't found them yet)

I was her last client for the day and was probably anxious to get home but she also happily waxed my eyebrows at the last minute. 

My sister, her MIL and sister in law also get their lashes done here and absolutely love them! 

I'm totally coming back when I visit. Ask for Elizabeth people!

Great food, the fries are amazing and the burgers are good too. Lots of cool different salts and sauces to make everything really neat. The only bummer was that they didn't serve their burgers upside down. Everyone knows that your burger needs to be upside down because it's just simply more efficient to pick up and eat. Please change this and make your restaurant 5 star by serving the burgers upside down. Thank you!

My husband and I visited The Habit for an eat supper. We were given a friendly greeting when we walked in. The cashier/order taker efficient and friendly she answered my questions about how the burgers are dressed.  You can see into the kitchen area. The burgers are well seasoned, the onion rings are you standard restaurant onion rings, but an order is went for 2.

Honestly, it should be 4.8 stars but because the burger I tried was sooooo good, I gave it 5.

My husband's vegan co-worker took him there once, and he was really impressed with the Impossible Burger and decided to take me there.

Neither he nor I am vegan, but he insisted on having to try the Impossible Burger for the first timer as he did.  I whined, I cried and I begged not to.  I needed my meat.  I asked the waitress to explain to me about their Impossible Burger, she did thoroughly but it did not make much sense to me.  I still yielded.  I ordered a 1/3 lb. vegan patty with toppings, sauce, and stuff I like.  Just in case, I ordered a regular Swiss cheese instead of vegan cheese.  I figured, if I did not like the vegan burger, at least I could eat the rest of the toppings I like with a slice of real cheese.

When the burger came, I was surprised. It did not look like a vegan patty at all.  When I had a bite, I was shocked!  Not only it did not taste like a vegan burger, it tasted like a real beef burger.  Juicy patty with everything I like (including my real Swiss cheese)!  The -0.2 star is because I realized they missed my grilled pineapple topping after I had 2 bites.  The server quickly fixed it, but frankly, I don't think the grilled pineapple actually affect the taste of the whole burger.

Impossible burger.  Now I know why it is named so.  It is IMPOSSIBLE that was not a beef patty.  

If someone would buy me this burger everyday, I would not mind to be vegan.  (LOL)

If I could give a zero rating I would! The employees are rude and they act like they are doing you a favor by "letting" you spend your money in their establishment! After having a bad experience with my family prior to this visit we decided to give Big Al's another shot. The manager Alex is lackluster and  when I voiced my complaints to him he became a mute and the only function his body seemed capable of doing was nodding . I recommend taking your family to a place that treats their clientele with a little respect and dignity!

I am pretty freakin angry that this place didn't live up to expectations as I just moved close by and it's within walking distance, so my dream of walking to a Mexican restaurant, getting destroyed by stellar margaritas, then dominating a gigantic burrito with pristine chips and salsa may have vanished. Now please note, this review is not based on their food as we didn't end up getting any(aside from chips and salsa), but rather on everything else. STORY!

We went here on a Saturday afternoon, and the ONLY reason we went is because I made a call to them to see if they had a weekend happy hour going on. A woman picked up the phone who definitely sounded like she either didn't work there at all or who just started and knew absolutely nothing. I asked if they had happy hour going on at that moment, she said she had to ask, put me on hold for almost two minutes, then came back and said yes. Excitedly, I asked how long happy hour was going on today. Put me on hold again for the same amount of time, came back to tell me 6pm. We walked down with the little baby(first time going to a sit-down place since before pandemic!) and were super excited to sit out on the patio! We get there, unfortunately have to walk through the restaurant to get out to the patio as both gates were locked, but whatever. We are sat by a waitress who has a face mask around her chin and nothing else. Probably wouldn't have cared THAT much if she didn't lean in close to talk to us when ordering, but the music outside was SO LOUD that maybe she had to...

Anyway, to the ordering part, I figured we could handle the ridiculously loud music and chin-mask lady with some cheap margaritas! I ask what kind of specials they've got going on with their happy hour(see above), and are told that they don't have happy hour on weekends.....oh. I explain that I called and spoke with some woman who told me they do, and I was told that I may have called one of the other locations and she has been the only female at the restaurant for the past hour or so. The thing is, I definitely checked the number on Yelp AND El Tenampa's web page before calling to make sure I called the right one, but alas, I didn't want to argue so I just said ok that sucks but whatever. Also, I triple checked after she went back inside and yes, I called the correct number provided. Who did I talk to then?!

Anyway, after looking through a super dirty menu, I ordered a Cadillac margarita and the lady got a blended house. The baby can't talk so she didn't get anything. We were brought our drinks and a basket of chips and salsa. Let's get into that real quick...not good. One thing we had been missing beyond words during the pandemic was sitting down at a Mexican restaurant to munch on some quality chips and salsa...this didn't happen. The chips were too thin and didn't seem fresh and had no flavor, and the salsa was...ok. Not incredibly fresh tasting, not a lot of flavor, but I've had worse I guess. It also came with a bean dip. That was ok as well. Just ok. Now the drinks? They were pretty much the only good thing about this experience. My Cadillac was pretty good! It was sweet and had a good, classic caddy margarita taste to it. However, it wasn't very big or strong for the price tag. Would have been totally worth it during HAPPY HOUR PRICES WHICH IS WHY WE WENT IN THE FIRST PLACE. The blended house marg was decent as well. Biggest problem with both of them were dirty glasses. Ugly water spots and who knows what else. Don't give people dirty glasses to drink out of. In fact, if you're a restaurant, don't give dirty anything. 

As we were deciding if we should get food or not, we started realizing how this was not the experience we wanted for our first trip back into society as we slowly move back to normalcy. Loud music, maskless waitress in our face, bad chips and salsa, patio not even nice, lies and/or confusion about happy hour...so we told the waitress we were just going to go after three total margaritas. She said ok well unfortunately, if you don't order food, they have to charge for the chips and salsa........ok.........so we ordered three margaritas during what was SUPPOSED to be happy hour for over 30 bucks, but you still gotta charge for the chips and salsa. Ridiculous. 

So unfortunately, this place turned out to be a dump. Again, I'm super sad about this as it's the only Mexican joint within walking distance and it has SOOOO MUCH POTENTIAL to be something great if you get the right elements in there, but until that happens, I won't be back. Super disappointing!!!
Absolutely loved our pedicures and how welcome they made us feel. You can tell they care about their customs. I will definitely go back and recommend them.

Stephen recently fixed our roof, finished some drywall and installed a new floor in our home. Not only was he consistently reliable, he was honest about costs, had amazing rates and did excellent work. We will be using him for any and all of our handyman needs. My only fear is that he'll be in such high demand, we'll have to wait for his services because he's that good. You can't go wrong giving Stephen a call!

I used to like the Habit Burger.  Their burgers were always flavorful and everything was fresh.  
My last two experiences have left me never wanting to go back.
The first time was the lure of a free delivery.  We ordered online and had a delivery time of 6:30.  Well our food was delivered at 7:15 which is 15 minutes after they had closed. Everything on the order was so disgusting that i had yo throw it away. The food had to have been sitting on the counter for 30 minutes and they probably had someone deliver it as they were leaving for the night. 

Second time I ordered at the location.  I waited in line probably 10 minutes which is about the standard wait time anymore but there were really just 5 people in front of me. The person took my order was nice and polite. Said it would be ready in a couple of minutes. For 30 minutes I watched a FEW orders get prepared. I saw one where fries and onion rings were placed in a bag, the 5-8 minutes later a couple of burgers were added to the bag but it was still not done. Another 5 minutes later another sandwich was added and the entire bag was then placed on the pickup area.  Another person got their order and had a problem with the burger.  Habit took the burger out and re-did the burger.  Everything else in the bag was left with the customer. Well 5 minutes later the burger is up and Habit gives the customer the burger.  I don't know what else was in the bag but if it was food, it was now sitting in that bag for 10 minutes.  

I was tired of standing so I went to a table to sit down and a few minutes later the pager went off.  Took the food back home and ate it. Not good,  the old Habit burger flavor is not there, the bun was hard, and the fries have to be microwaved, but i was really hungry after being gone for over an hour total so I just sat and ate it.
In that time I could have fixed a full steak and potato dinner with a salad for me and my wife and it would have been about the same price.

I realize that there is a work shortage but something should be done to coordinate the food so that it all comes out together so we all don't get terrible food. They do burgers, fries... how hard can it be.  

Off to Culvers from now on.  They have always been prompt and food is very good for fast food and I get a variety of items to choose.
Had major Idaho pinstripe issues, these guys rocked it and my truck looks like new... Very reasonably priced and a pleasure deal with. Highly recommended

Don't expect any service in the restaurant area.  Once you select a table, ou sit down and and order online while the wait staff stand around and visit with each other. When your order is ready they drop off drinks and food to your table and they never stop by again to see if everything is okay or if you need anything else. If you do need anything (like refills, ketchup or a to-go box) you have to go find someone to help you.

The food is expensive and the service is non-existent.

Marco's Pizza quietly opened last week in Meridian and I was looking forward to trying it. I had never heard of Marco's before, so I went online to look at their menu. While online I noticed that I had the option to place my order through their website. The ordering platform was very user friendly! It had different sections of the menu broken up by foods (pizza, sides, salads, etc) and also included a section for their current specials.  I ordered 2 Large Pepperoni Melt Pizza's ($10.99/each). Before I placed the order, I was given the option of registering as a customer or continuing as a guest. They offered 10% off my order if I registered on their page & verified my email. Their system allowed me to immediately sign up, verify my email, & use my 10% off discount.  That makes me very happy! I was also rewarded with an order of free cheese bread for signing up for their rewards program, again they immediately gave me the free bread.  The remainder of the ordering was super easy. They allow you to be very detailed in the customization of your pizza. They also give you an option of paying cash in the store, I have noticed other places not allowing that.  Once the order was placed an order tracker popped up and kept me in the loop for what was happening with our pizza. 
When I walked into Marco's I was cheerfully greeted by the employees working the front counter. I was very impressed by the decor, available seating, & the overall vibe.  I was helped by Alex. He was great! I believe that he was actually a manager. He was very helpful to customers who were unsure of what to order or who had menu questions. When my Pizza was brought to me they opened the boxes to show it to me. Alex then asked if I needed any cheese, peppers, or plates. Yes, please! It's such a nice touch when a pizza place gives you paper plates! Dinner with no dishes is always a good thing. 
The pizza was delicious! The dough was really nice and had the perfect amount of chew to it. This pizza was LOADED with cheese and pepperoni! I'm a total extra, extra cheese person and I thought it was perfect! The pepperoni was plentiful! I overheard someone saying that the large Pepperoni Melt has a total of 72 pepperoni's on it. Impressive! The 3 cheese blend that they use is wonderful, not at all tough, perfectly melty, & just a slight chew. I really liked this pizza and so did my entire family. 
Marco's is delicious and worth trying. They are open until 11 during the week and midnight on weekends & they offer delivery.

I went to The Habit Burger Grill to get my free birthday burger (sign up for their emails and get a free one for your birthday).  We went for lunch on Saturday and the place was pretty busy  I had never eaten there before so it took me a minute to figure out and place my order at the counter.  I wanted a burger and fries and a drink so I asked about the teriyaki burger and if there was a meal deal.  The girl happily told me that everything is  à la carte (like that's a good thing to pay more for separate than get a deal for a meal - ha ha).  So I ordered the teriyaki burger, onion rings, and a drink.  My daughter ordered the double charburger with fries.  And my mother ordered a burger with sweet potato fries.

I found the meat to bun ratio to be off - wayyyy too much bun for not enough patty.  A teriyaki burger has a pineapple ring on it - and it did, but it was the smallest pineapple ring ever.  And I could not find or taste the caramelized onions.  I didn't think pickles belonged on a teriyaki burger though - I just took them off.

The onion rings looked good, but there was a lot of breading for not a lot of onion.  I found myself chewing batter only and again, struggling to find the onion (like on the burger).

Overall it was just OK for me.  The location is at the Village at Meridian but on the outer part near Eagle Road where you don't have to struggle to find parking.  The prices were reasonable.  But the food was just OK for me.
AWESOME FOOD, even better environment! Came to get one sandwich left with 3 hahahaha, you will not be let down!

This was a great experience last night!!! We looked this place up feeling like some Chinese food and this came up. So glad we came here because everything from from to service was a 5 star. Our waitress Luck B was over the top awesome. She made the whole experience and despite waiting a little longer just did an amazing job!!

For food we had a smorgasbord of items including shrimp pineapple fried rice, pork Yakisoba, orange chicken, spring rolls chicken yellow curry and chicken Pad Thai.  Everything was great and tattered completely fresh. I would highly recommend this place to any local or any traveler to the Boise area. Great local find!

This place is really fun! It's not too expensive. You can put $20 on a card and play quite a few games with that. It's also really easy to win lots of tickets which you can cash in for some pretty decent prizes. I wouldn't recommend this place if you are just looking for some good food, but it's a great place to grab a bite to eat after playing some games or going bowling.

I had a membership at this location and the company gave me an UNBELIEVABLE runaround when I moved and wanted to cancel my account.  They charged me over $200 for me and my wife to cancel, AND they charged my January membership fee even though I cancelled in December.  

Companies that choose to treat their customers this way don't deserve my business.  

The YMCA doesn't make me do any contract and their facilities are superior anyway.
10/10!  Our server Alyssa provided the best service we have had since Covid began 19 months ago.  This was the first time, in a long time, that eating out felt like old times.

The Habit Burger is a great burger place when you want something more than fast food, but less than a sit down restaurant.  Everything I've eaten here is tasty, cooked fresh and perfectly cooked.  The bathrooms are kept clean as are the tables and floor.  

It is a favorite place for a cheap ice cream cone with the kids too.  They have the best onion rings I've had.  This last visit I tried the tempura green beans, and oh my they were delicious.

This was the first time I've every had a slight issue.  My son's ice cream had some black stuff in it, but they promptly changed it out for another one.

The customer service was wonderful at this phone repair shop. I lost all my photos and info and they were able to restore it quickly and let me know ahead of time how much it would cost.  Super nice and honest guys working there!!!

I stopped doing dip forever ago because it would never last at other salons I've visited. A couple months ago, I came to Nail Tek with a girlfriend and have been coming back ever since. My dip nails last 2-3 weeks which is crazy because I'm so hard on them at work. Ha always makes sure I love my nails and that they are perfect before I leave every single time. He cares very much about his customers and does a *beyond* perfect job.

Whoever you go to here will remember your name and the big or little things going on in your life. Everyone here is so welcoming, and the atmosphere is great. It's the most personable and fun salon I've ever been in. If I could give a million stars I would! Highly recommend this place.

Live right down the road so I've been here more than a dozen times. They are just as likely to mess your order up as they are getting it right. I'm not kidding. I've had a mess up of some sort AT LEAST 50% of the Times I've been there. Those aren't great percentages for a restaurant. To top it all off, the staffers are rude 50% of the time. Avoid
Great find and they offered capers on my bagel, nice change. There sandwiches looked pretty good but I just came in for a bagel.  Friendly service and clean restaurant.

I was too hungry to take a picture before I inhaled the first part of this sandwich. We are new to the area and saw this place while we were out and about. Hugo's is a MUST stop place. The food is fresh and incredibly delicious. Not to mention the chocolate chip cookie was one of the best I've ever had! I told my husband that next time I'm not sharing! Lol. Basically, go to Hugo's!
The cinnamon bread loaf is really good and it's only $5. It's the best deal in town. I didn't have any of the other food yet.

Another burger joint to add to my quest for finding the best burgers in town. 

The counter is positioned well with a great location in the Meridian Village. The area its in is low density compared to the other sides so parking and availability are good. The location itself is clean and modern. I dislike the booths for size, but I'm a big guy. 

The burger options are great and I like that you can build your own. I appreciate the selection in sauces ect, but I feel like anything I actually want on the burger costs more (bacon, ham, eggs) I have never tried the pre built options but I'd like to see them to compare prices. 

The staff is 'meh'. Nothing that surprised me, but did leave me wondering where my food was. 30 minutes from order to placement is too long for a burger and a salad. 

Will I go back? Yes, but isn't my first choice.

I was going to give this place one more try, but when I went in , it was just as messy as previously noted. So, about face I went and left. 

I note that I am not the only one giving them low ratings, but I have yet to see and responses from the owners even acknowledging these comments. Not a good sign when there is no management concern.

Long time customer, however I changed salons due too over charging. I waited longer to have my nails filled then they preferred, so overcharged me for service. Very convenient as your stuck paying the difference. Plenty of other nail salons, I found one that takes good care of their customers.

I ordered two Egg McMuffins. One of them every time I took a bite almost there was something gritty in it that I've never had before in the muffins. And then the other one the egg was still halfway runny and Soggy. Needless to say it was a waste of money. I'm not going to get their Egg McMuffins ever again and did not eat these for breakfast.

Absolutely delicious!! I love how creative the ordering processes is with how they have the number on the side of your empanada. We tried 5 different ones today and all were very tasty. We will be back again soon to try more!

Let me start by saying as soon as I walked in a few of the girls greeted me and it was so welcoming. The entire salon was really clean and so beautiful, I loved every little detail, the set up was sleek and just so pretty. Savannah cut and styled my hair and did an AMAZING job!! I've neglected my hair for a while and wasn't just going to go to any salon. Let me tell you...Savannah is so sweet and very detailed, she made sure I left happy and with exactly what I asked for. All the girls that work in this salon have beautiful hair! That should say a lot. Definitely my new salon!!

We've been taking our pupper to this PetSmart location for nearly 2 years.  We go about every other month (sometimes longer) when her nails are too long and we can't handle her filthy face anymore - LOL

We pay $68:  $55 for the grooming and $13 for the nail grinding - and it's worth every penny.

We typically schedule an appointment via their app for a Saturday morning.  When we took her yesterday (appointment was right when they opened) they told us it would be 3-4 hours because they were going to be very busy.  And it did take them just about 4 hours to call for us to pick her up.  She was scheduled with one girl and someone else groomed her so maybe her person called in sick or something.  Either way, they told us about the delay in advance which we appreciated, and she came out looking and smelling clean and beautiful with a cute little bow in her hair. 

I would definitely recommend this PetSmart - and continue to go there - great staff who is kind to us and great with our pupper and who does quality work.
First time here. Ordered the boneless chicken. You would think with a name like that the (all) the chicken would be home made. Had better a Wendy's. Chicken was hard like it was from Costco.

Very nice atmosphere. Large facility to mingle and chat. Spacious outdoors with at least 10 tables for sitting. While it seemed odd to be given a cup to go fill myself from some coffee dispenser, I did like the control of filling my own cup!

I'll be back!

First time here. FIRST- the bar area is too small for this location. SECOND-the margaritas are excellent! I will need to visit a few more times to comment on their menu. The street tacos were OK. NOTHING TO WRITE HOME ABOUT.  My husband had the surf and turf. Carne Asada had an excellent marinade and his shrimp were perfecto Garcia. We will come back and I will dig a little deeper and 
update this review.

Great place to eat !! From out of town, and a friend recommended I go there. Very good food, had chicken fried steak, it was awesome!  And the lobster bisque was the best soup I have ever had! If you are in Boise this is definitely a destination for a great meal and good atmosphere. Best place I ate all week!

Food is good with lots of options. We have found good pescatarian options. The Monday Night Football 1/2 price on all full-sized appetizers was great value. One disappointing seating where they gave our outside table away to someone else and didn't care.
One of my very favorite places to go eat and drink. Good beers always on tap, great salads and very friendly staff.

This place will blow you away. The service is great, the place is sharp. They have blood orange lemonade. The layout is intuitive and everything was designed by a business person who knows business. Everything from how you enter to leaving, the flow is great. They only have 11" pizzas so it is perfect for 2 people, or 1 person with a few leftover slices. I always only get through half. Their to-go boxes are half boxes, meaning you don't have a half pizza sliding around and a total waste of cardboard. Well planned! When you do a custom pizza, they let you and all the toppings you want as a fixed price of Just less than $8. If they keep THAT up with the blood orange lemonade, I'm a customer for life. I go there about 1-2 times per week.

Tried it out this evening with my daughter. The food was awesome, has a bar vibe. My only complaint was it was colder inside than out. After making a comment to our server, who was very cold, I told her don't be afraid to say a customer has complained about the temperature.
This place is horrible! Over priced food/ beer and horrible service. If you like the food here you must have just gone off a hungryman bender

Edit: They tried to make this right. Ultimately I didn't accept their offer but I'll at least give them 3 stars instead of 1. 



I used to be a huge fan of Blaze. Until tonight. I ordered some pizzas to go a few hours ahead of time and turns out, I was going to be a little earlier than I expected. I called ahead to ask them to move the pickup time from 4:40pm to 4:30pm. A very annoyed guy tells me they don't do that and I have to come in, have the pizzas made while I'm there, and then leave instructions with a cashier to have my order canceled at 4:40pm. 

Okay... so I poiitely asked if he could take my order now, and I would come right over and take care of it. He said no, online orders only. I again said I wouldn't be able to make it for my original online order time and could they please change it... again no. So I didn't make it for my pizza pickup because I frankly couldn't and they wouldn't do ANYTHING to help me.

This results in my wife getting a call around 6:30pm from an angry manager saying we would be charged for the pizza either way (you have to put your credit card info in when you order). Extremely unprofessional. I ate there 3 times a week minimum and now I will never EVER go back. So much lost revenue for this place.

The owner has always been rude, but the older guy who seems to be the general manager is a great guy. However, I will never go back. All my co-workers who go I will make sure never go back. And I will take every opportunity to make sure Blaze is not patronized by anyone I know. I will also be disputing the charge on my credit card since I did everything reasonable I could to let them know I needed my pickup time change. 

Disappointing ending to an otherwise great experience.

Of course the donuts are good! Plus, it's totally fun to watch these bad boys get made! Yay industrialization!  

This particular location has both a drive thru & a team of employees that seem totally miserable! The atmosphere of anger/frustration was...awkward. I just hope these donut makers are okay. Stick in there guys.

Having just moved back to Boise from Los Angeles, I was very excited to see some of my favorite businesses breaking ground in our great little city. One of them being Blaze. Disclaimer: this is not a sports bar or pub or a high end Italian restaurant. It is a bold your own go-to lunch spot. That being said, it is an excellent and innovative establishment for its kind. Natural, fresh ingredients and a wide selection of toppings and sauces. You can also order online for pick up which is really convenient. The staff was very knowledgeable, eager to help, and didn't seem overwhelmed which is great for a newly opened business. They even go around to tables and offer services after you've been through the line which is unusual for this type of business. Very clean and inviting atmosphere. If you are not the type for Lloyd music, be warned, they do play it loud.

Yardhouse. Don't be so corporate!  Everyone in Boise is carrying multiple selections of Fresh Hop beer.  This is a seasonal beer that is big out here. The bartender didn't even know what I was talking about. Keep your eye on local guys!  Otherwise we enjoyed the Hop Nosh beer!

Always outstanding, consistently good service and food. I love the atmosphere and the music they play is very good. I've had Zach as a waiter several times and always try to get in his section if he's working but the other staff members are also good.
Food was good really flavorful. But some bites a little salty. Will go again. just use less salt.

I had Jonathan come clean my carpets and couches tonight.  How he did it I don't know, but my carpets and couches look BRAND NEW..... Thank you, I will defiantly use you again and recommend to everyone!!!!

Close to my house so I've been in a few times.  Positive - good, solid service, great selection of beer, good bartenders (had the best old fashioned I've ever had), lots of TVs for game days.  Negatives - the food isn't the best...  I had a Gryo last Sunday that they should pull from the menu - the meat looked like cold beef jerky, didn't taste good and the pita bread was dry and split apart right away.  I've had wings - average, cod bites which are ok.  I do recommend the Cubano Sliders!  Overall a good pub that's great on beer/drinks but average on food and stay away from the Gyro.

First off the waitress was plain rude. Food came out at all different times some people were done eating before others even got their food. Food was mediocre at best. Last person to get their food was a child and the chicken dippers were soggy and undercooked and took 45 minutes or more to get to the table. Needless to say I wouldn't go back.

Back today for lunch; same co-worker, and a guest. This time I had the "boneless" wings. Better choice...I didn't expect excellent bone-in wings like I did last time, so I wasn't disappointed. Same waiter, same BOGO, same prices, same issues, but I can now say, if you go here, get the boneless wings and you'll be OK.

I honestly can't get enough of this place, my favorite pizza in town. The dough spicy sauce are so good. I love the fact that there is not cheese type limit for the build your own option. Huge fan here.
Food was fresh, hot and tasted great!  I like the fact that they have whole grain pasta as one of there choices.  And that you can add a small cup of soup for $1.

We have been here twice now, if you like hot wings, the pterodactyl wings are a must order! We also ordered their steaks and they are always delicious and big enough to share. Their beer selection ensures that there is something for everyone!

Stopped here while travelling for work based on reviews and they did not disappoint! My coworker and I both had the rib eye special with baked potatoes. The steak was seasoned and cooked perfectly.  The baked potato was the best I've ever had. You really can't beat the price either! I will definitely be back if I am in town.

I have driven by Kahootz a million times but have never gone in. It kind of looked like a dive to me! After reading up on it via Yelp and a recommendation from a colleague, I knew I needed to stop by. I'M SO GLAD WE DID. From the atmosphere to the food (oh, the food!), to the service... I could keep going on and on. Give Kahootz a try... no matter HOW long the wait is. It's worth it.

Food: Oh wow, their menu may not be huge but it's FILLED with goodness (though it IS a little expensive). We started with the Con Queso dip, which was HUGE (definitely enough for 4), and contained big chunks of sliced jalapenos and onions. It was the best queso around, as my husband claims, though I still prefer the cheese dip at Corona Village. Next up, we ordered the French Dip (we added swiss). It was a big, toasted sandwich and came with a side of fries that could not have been seasoned more perfectly. We finished with the bread pudding (half order) and MAN, that dessert rocked our socks. The bread pudding was soft and doughy but came out on a steaming skillet, which caramelized the caramel (ha!) and then they poured even MORE caramel and a fresh scoop of vanilla ice cream on top. This is the dessert of champions, I tell you what. ORDER THE BREAD PUDDING! 

Drinks: Over 43 beers/ales/ciders on tap! Tons of wine to choose from.

Atmosphere: The atmosphere is AWESOME. Despite looking like a dive from the outside (sorry Kahootz), the inside is actually really nice. It's an upscale sports pub and has limited seating, so it makes it feel very cozy. There are TV's scattered throughout with eclectic memorabilia all over the walls. It's a little dark inside, so it feels warm, friendly and has a great vibe.

Service: When we arrived, there was a 30-minute wait so we sat at the bar top when a spot opened up. Not only was the bartender kind and helpful, but the service was fast and top notch. Each server was kind and respectful, and our drinks were always filled as soon as they were down to 1/4 full. Great job, Kahootz!

Happy Hour Offerings: n/a

Healthy Hack: n/a

Tips: If the line is long, it's long for a reason! They'll seat you quickly. Still don't want to wait? Try snagging a seat & eating at the bar. The service will be rockin' there, too!
Traveling through Idaho with my boys and looking for Pizza.Very inexpensive for what you get. Pizza's are excellent. Highly recommend.

Could not be more excited for this location to open.  We love ALL the restaurants but the 'home' spot is my favorite by far. Staff, food, welcoming attitude are all off the charts. Relocated from CA a year ago with my kiddos and have been search for 'our spot' this is TOTALLY it!!

Took my new pup to the small dog side of the Storey Bark Park in Meridian and was very impressed!  I love that they have a special place for the little guys and there was plenty of access to water from the hose, dishes, and little pools.  Real and artifical grass for the dogs to run on, agility structures and other features.  My favorite part was the short water fountain for the small dogs and the sidewalk that went around the park for the people to walk with their dogs.  Will definitely be back!

Have had lunch here several times and it's been decent.  Today is a different case though.  Something has changed.  Server took my salad away before I was finished and she was chewing gum.  Not good.  It took over 30 minutes to get our order and we had a normal sushi/sashimi order so we had to rush to eat before my wife had to be back at work.  Also, the sushi pieces were a lot smaller and less than normal.  There's a Fujiyama opening not too far away on Fairview and we will probably start going there for lunch instead.  Sakana dropped the ball.

I love this place.  Trendy but friendly, AMAZING FISH TACOS.

I've had a few other menu items, all of which are delicious.  Plenty of beera on tap.  Not the place for a quiet night out.  This place has energy.

Got here in time for happy hour.  We floated the river so a nice booth inside was a welcome respite from the sun.  Ordered a bunch of apps (at happy hour prices) which included pizzas, egg rolls, and seared ahi sashimi.  All good.  Had a Bulleit Old Fashioned which was made well.  Service from Zach was polite and professional.  We like Yard House because it has something for everybody and it's all pretty good.

My wife and I just moved here to Meridian from the Sacramento area of California. We also have a Texas Roadhouse in Elk Grove just outside Sacramento. The staff here was much more friendly, the steaks were far better than the elk grove, Calif location. In fact I have not had a better steak in a very long time. In general I would give this Texas Roadhouse a 5 star rating and the Calif location a 3....... Awesome Steaks Texas Roadhouse.
