Visiting my brother and came here with the family on our last night here. Food was great! John our server was fantastic!!! Will definitely be back when we come into town. We give the a big ole HEE HAW!!!!!

The wings at Buffalo Wild Wings are the best I've ever eaten.  Lots of different flavors, not just mild or hot.  Fun sports bar atmosphere, but still good for kids.  In addition to all the sporting events imagineable on about a million tv's, you can play the interactive trivia.

First time visit. Dinner was outstanding, a little pricey with addons, but it was worth it. The server we had was outstanding. The best I have seen in quite some time. I would recommend this place to everyone.

This is my favorite place to eat. The food here is always great. I love the endless peanuts and rolls. The chilli is usually spectacular. The sweet tea, the margaritas, green beans,.... I could go on and on. As far as I can tell, the only issues this place has is lack of freindlyness from the girl handling the seating chart. She is never friendly. The other issue is that they often can't get the temp of my steak right. My steak arrives, which is under cooked,to which the manager always replies "well we cook our steaks a little under"  hmm I always thought that if a ordered my steak medium, that's what I should get..... food for thought.

We went here on a Friday night. Neither my BFF or I had ever been here before. I'm always on a diet so you know I purposely avoid places with the word "noodles" in them. But my BFF is a high protein high carb diet and so I acquiesced.

The first thing I always notice about a restaurant is if it's clean, and this one was. Check.This is a fast casual type restaurant where you walk in, place your order at the counter and sit down.  Next,  the service. The gals at the front counter were friendly and helpful when we mentioned we had not been there before. We were looking at a table tent display by the register which was advertising some new meatballs. We were discussing among st ourselves whether we should get them or not when the girls handed us a coupon to try them for free.  Good service; check. 

My BFF ordered alfredo noodles with chicken and a side of chicken noodle soup. I ordered Pad Thai noodles with Tofu.We also ordered soft drinks.

Even though the girls had given us a number, when the order was ready they brought it out to us.  The food was really good! The noodles were fresh and flavorful. My BFF who is a chef, was impressed. My pad thai was a little spicy and very flavorful. In fact I had mentioned it had more flavor than the last pad thai I had at a local thai restaurant.

Going back to the diet thing. This restaurant has different portion sizes and the menu shows calories, which made it easy to find something that fit within my diet.

All in all we enjoyed our experience here and will be coming back again.
I liked this Walmart because it was clean, organized, always well stocked, good parking space, and safe. It is the best of four I've been to in Ada and Canyon counties.

This is now my new favorite happy hour! It is very clean,  great service, excellent food, and wonderful prices. They have happy hour every day and always at the bar top. It's a great place to take the whole family or to go watch a game. I highly recommend Jakers!!!

Stopped at the bar to have drinks and appetizer before a movie and walked out without either. After waiting for about five minutes we ordered drinks and watched our bartender spend almost fifteen minutes at the register and socializing with coworkers.  She didnt deliver the drinks but did leave us a bill for them.  ?????

Met some friends for dinner and had a great time.  Bar service was a bit slow but otherwise everything was good. Great value for the money. Steak was excellently prepared and all enjoyed their food. Will definitely return.

Great food and service. Fall off the bone ribs. Always a bit loud for chatting, but fun  good energy environment. Fried pickles are tasty and different for an appetizer. My wife loves sweet potatoes here. Steaks are
Always good and the rolls are made fresh in house and served
Warm with honey butter. Yum. Yum!

Moxie vs Lucky Perk no difference in staff or speed.  At the drive thru I order the same drink same size about 3 days a week.  It tastes different every time, usually costs different and I may or may not get the size I ordered. I think it is great that the staff are having a good time while they work but it usually appears as though they need to finish their story to each other before turning around with finished drink in hand.

My 9 y/o loves coming here to make her own pie. They typically have great specials and we can eat for a reasonable price. Love their pick two lunch specials. I tried the chicken arugula basil salad and even though it was kind of thrown together the flavors were good.
Most chains,( which the area loves) are horrible. However, this place is great! Go try it, never a bad experience.

First time in... been Looking forward to checking it out, won't be back. The bartender, bald guy with a beard, was unfriendly, except to other employees and people he obviously knew. Was making a drink next to me and I'm no prude but his language and sexual talk was disrespectful and unnecessary! I've been in the service industry for 20 years and would never talk like that in front of guests. Blew the beer we were drinking and dropped off the half a beer, didn't charge us, but also didn't bother to explain why we had a half a beer, just set it down and walked away.  The onion rings looked sooooo good but they were completely flavorless, we ate two and left them. Seasoning people, it's a thing!! Overall not impressed, not a ton of choices in meridian but I'll take my business elsewhere.
Definitely a place to get a good brew but the food is average. The service was great which is why i give it 4 Stars. Unfortunately I wouldn't recommend it if your looking for good place to eat.

Glad to have a new neighborhood place.  Have been here twice now. Once for breakfast, and once for dinner.  The breakfast menu was limited, but the food was good.  The dinner was great, had the souvlaki pita. Love the flavor of the fries, and the good selection/variety of beers available.  Only complaint I have is the acoustics/noise at dinner. Its so loud with all of the hard surfaces in there, I know I will not be able to bring my parents (in their 70's) as we would not be able to have a conversation with them with the noise level.  A small investment in some fabric baffles in the ceiling would be a worthwhile investment as Meridian is a big retirement community with lots of folks with hearing issues.  Thanks.

I am only rating them four stars for how expensive they can be and  my past experiences. But tonight they killed it with the onion ring tower and Elysian porter. It's Monday night and they have an all night happy hour during football season. I am very happy with my meal and pleased with the service.
Stopped in here on an evening to try out a local place. Burgers were good, fries were very good! Service was quick and the prices are decent. Would definitely recommend.

It's walmart not sure what people expect.. I expect cheap Prices and that is about the extent of it. They started having more and more self check outs which is always good and this one seems to be one of the cleaner ones even though it's starting to show it's age for sure.

Down home steakhouse with really tasty food. The wife's prime was fantastic, the Idaho baked potatoes were perfect and the other steaks were really nice. But the prime rib was amazing. 

It's on the small side so the wait is a bit longer than I like but it was worth it. The hostess was really nice and Ellie our server took great care of us. 

Finally the price was more than fair. Parking was fine. Overall a real find in the suburbs of Boise. 

Next time I would probably skip the desert. But otherwise a perfect meal.

I went to marshals for the first time and I was greeted by a really nice young man named Anthony. He helped me with all my questions. He fitted me for my bra and and complemented how my jeans made my butt look he said "dayum that booty is out of this world" the only downside is the toy section, I couldn't find a "Thanos car" for my son. Also the cashier asked if I had ligma, it was my biggest mistake asking what ligma was, then she said ligma balls lmao

This was one of the worst Mexican meals I have ever had. The salsa tasted HORRIBLE and the chips had a weird chemical aftertaste. The enchilada looked about as appetizing as wet dog food served up with red sauce.

Do yourself a favor- avoid this place at all costs.

This is not a dive. They keep it clean and well maintained. The burgers are delicious and I love to get my fries extra crispy. 

The prices are a bit much for a burger joint but I don't mind because you get a real burger not a wimpy patty and the bacon is peppered. Thumbs up!

Best personal pizza around. The workers are always so welcoming and friendly.. downfall is everyone else loves this place too because when I go there's always a line. But don't let that turn you away, they are very fast and you will be so happy you waited! Sooo good!!

For a place specializing in wings, is it too much to ask for them to toss the wings to cover them in your sauce choice? At least 50% of my visits, sauce just dumped on top of wings with naked plain fried wings on top with maybe half coating of sauce and wings on bottom soaked in sauce puddle. Consistently inconsistent....
I really don't write many reviews,. Simply put the Yardhouse is too loud, too dark over priced and over rated.
This place is great! Perfect little restaurant for a family of weary travelers. We ordered steaks and hamburgers!! "Thumbs up"

Very impressed to the customer service and the food quality of this location. Great value and did not disappoint on any level. Upbeat service with a smile and will happily come back here again - hard to find good food like this in this area.

Three of us went to Yard House on a Thursday evening, fairly busy for not being a weekend. The area is nice if you have not been.  The menu had a lot of options in regards to food, however, nothing stuck out and seemed that exciting.  I ended up with the pepper jack burger, we also ordered the Vampire and fish tacos.  Wait time for food was about 30 minutes and cost about $45 for the three of us.  The burger tasted fairly bland, the fries that came with it were amazing...thin and crispy!  Our 14 year old had ordered the vampire tacos, he will usually eat anything.  He ended up not liking the tacos, the rice, or the beans. I ended up trading him half my burger for one of his tacos, originally thinking it was a good trade!  It was not, his tacos were terrible and he ended up with the better deal!  On to the fish tacos...a lot of toppings with a few pieces of generic fish that were drowned in pico de gallo. The pico was good!  And again, the rice and cup of beans covered in cheese were left on the plate with a mere sampling removed.  

On the plus side, the area is nice if you have not been, they have a large selection of beer, and a nice outdoor dining area.  If you dine inside, it is dark and loud enough that conversations will be difficult to have at best.

The food was amazing, and the service was even better! Today was my first time here, and I am impressed! Very nice and cozy inside,  and waitress was very friendly.  I had their Korean tacos, and I ate every bit of it!  I will definitely be returning soon,  and recommend everyone try this place out!

We ate here tonight with a party of 30. Matt was our waiter. He was absolutely outstanding. He was quick on refills, polite, and knowledgable. He and the cooks had our food out in a timely fashion and the food is always delicious. I will always highly recommend them any time to anyone. We go there regularly just my husband and I so we knew they would be amazing. So happy with how it all went. Thanks Matt and Jakers staff!!! We had a great 100th birthday celebration. Ps love your new patio seating area! Such a necessary add on.

So I'm not a HUGE fan of chain restaurants, but living where we live it's impossible to completely escape them and Buffalo Wild Wings is one of the few I actually like! For a sports fan, you CAN NOT beat it...every sporting event you'd want to see is available on about 100 NEW tv's. The food is pretty straight forward bar-type food, but the wings really are good with a variety of sauces ranging from mild to insanely hot. The place is kid friendly as well and have had our 2 year old in the dining room many times. Was great to have them up and running during March Madness!
We come here once a week after our pinnacle group meets and before grocery shopping. Never had a bad lunch
Definitely one of meridians best restaurants. I'm not a formal dining type, but I do enjoy good food and good at this year. This place has those things in spades.

We've eaten sushi here a number of times and I order lunch frequently because it's closest to my office and the lunches are a great deal. I usually just order a roll, nigiri or sashimi and have never had an issue with the quality. It's usually quick service and easy to get into.

Christopher is a hard working young man. I watched him literally run out to cars to greet them with a newspaper and offer a beverage. This was my first time there and I was really impressed with my whole experience.

This is equivalent to chipotle in the pizza world.  Great fast food location for kids who wish to create their own pizza.  

Inexpensive no frills place to take your family.  

Expect this Blaze to be busy in the evening, but the staff is great.  

Minus a star for a slightly over cooked pizza.

So personable and sweet. Family owned and run. The husband did my mani/gel pedi. He was a jeweler in Vietnam and did a great job trimming and shaping my nails. Then the wife came back and finished my pedicure. The husband gave me the best foot massage I've ever had and the shop is beautiful and clean. The daughter speaks beautiful English. I will be back in two weeks!
Nice, small shop with great customer service! Appointments can usually be made less than a week out and they listen when I describe the cut I want.
Service was quick and nice, appetizer was fine (cheese curds) meal itself was very under whelming (Lobster and Shrimp Agnolotti) especially for the 22-ish dollars I paid for it. Not very impressed.
I love Einstein's, the service is excellent, the prices are great, the facility is very nice! When you arrive for an oil change they give you a newspaper and a soda, coffee, or hot chocolate. :-)

Stopped here after bowling league yesterday to gwt dinner on the way home.  They werent busy at all.  Ordered a steak burrito, burger combo large and a chicken tender combo medium.  Went to the window to pay the lady there was rude.  Thats fine with me but she then gives me my drinks and my bag of food.  I drive home and find out she only put a burger and a burrito in the bag.  No fries no chicken tender meal.  Called them and the guy that answered told us we need to come back and he will give us the food after they make it.  I told him i cant comeback since i have to get up at 3am to go to work.  Terrible service at this location and its sad because Carls Jr. Used to be great.
Pricey for what it is but it's fun for kids and it's easy for picky eaters. My piece of advice is to skip the noodles and just add the rice as a side.

I have tried to get my carpet cleaned with this company two times and both times they made me wait for hours just to cancel on me. I needed my carpet cleaned because I am planning on having an open house and before the realtors come to take photos  I wanted to get the carpet cleaned. So I made an appointment for 8am to 9am Friday and since they had already failed me once they promised to give me a discount. So Friday 930 came along and nothing. I reached out to them to find out where the tech was and they told me that they where going to find out. I didn't get a response until 2pm! I am extremely  disappointed so i told them not to bother coming. will never ask for their service again.

The last two times I have been there it has been terrible!  Once I saw the cook wipe his nose and keep on cooking without washing his hands.  I said no thanks and left.
I are there yesterday and got food poisoning !  I think the cook is maliciously trying to put the place out of business.
I will not go back!

It was good for a reasonably priced steak. They grill the steaks so you get the smoke flavor bonus! The interior was kind of like a country bar and everyone was chill.  Not to mention a pretty good wait staff and that always makes the meal a little better! So four stars for the category this place fits in. I'll go back if I ever happen to be in.......uhhhh Boise? Well this steak will make Boise better.No it wasn't that bad there and it was nice to get away from a normal congested city. I do wonder though where in the Hell are all the Starbucks and Dutch Bros. In this part of the country!? That was not a good thing at all! Ok so yeah Steak steak steak!!
Extensive beer selection and incredibly friendly staff.  Just popped in for one beer (I had more than one) but I'm looking forward to ordering some food on my next visit as well.
Great price. Delicious crispy thin crust pizza. Fresh squeezed orange blood lemonade. Yum! I would definitely recommend this place! And your pizza is done in 3 min!

Love this place. Small but effective menu, food cooked just right. Locally owned. Friendly staff. What's not to love? Especially love the outdoor seating in the warmer months. Great place for a cold beer and a gourmet burger. An absolute must is the bread pudding. Don't miss it.

The wife and I went out to eat for our 27th wedding Anniversary on a Monday night to the Yard House as it is one of our favorite eating establishments. My wife has a very restricted eating diet so it took some time for her to decide what on the menu she could actually have. The waitress, Brittney, was very patient and helpful. Once she realized the extent of my wife's dietary limitations she asked Jared, one of the chiefs, to talk with my wife and see what it was that she was actually allowed, and what she was not allowed to eat. Jared made several recommendations, and after several trips to verify ingredients and dietary restrictions they narrowed her meal down to an excellently cooked and well presented meal. The establishment went well above and beyond any of our expectations and sealed our loyalty to the Yard House staff. Now I can't say everyone will receive this excellent treatment as we did as it is a very busy restaurant and there are limits to every establishment, but I will say we received the best service possible from both Brittney and Jared. Five stars. Keep up the great service, food, and drinks Yard House.

North End Meridian Rejoice !! We have a legit bar and grill in our area now !! Went there for lunch on friday. Service was excellent. I love how they have good music playing in the pub at just the right volume ! 
1. Wings are hot, flavorful, juicy on inside and crispy on outside
2. Fish and Chips Are Rad ! Perfect batter and light and flaky on inside. 
3. Bbq burger was juicy, big, full of flavor. Try the onion rings with it !
4. Club sandwhich is huge. Lots of flavor. 
5. The pints on tap are awesome. And the mixed drinks are perfectly executed ! 
My Hats off to my new local pub by my house !

One of our favorite Sushi places in town. We usually swing in for lunches. The atmosphere is relaxed, the sushi bar is beautiful and the staff is warm and inviting. The fish is always fresh and the rolls are always tasty.  They are quick and efficient with their service and always deliver!

Yard house is delicious. I was super impressed two times ago when I went there. I ordered a turkey burger and they messed up and gave me a lamb burger, which I didn't notice. My server noticed the garnishes and burger didn't look like the typical turkey burger and they realized they brought out the wrong food: they wound up comping my meal and drinks and giving me a extra turkey burger to go! Great customer service.

Blaze Pizza has been my favorite since I first discovered it two years ago in CA. I love the ability to build your own and put whatever/however much you want on your pizza. I've been to this location about 10 times now and I've noticed each time I go, they put less and less on my pizza. I have to ask for more mozzarella about 4 times because they really don't put enough. My opinion of this Blaze has been going down each time I go. Hopefully they can improve..but I'm just waiting for the location in Nampa anyway

Went for Happy Hour.  The appetizers are supposed to be full size but they only give you half as much and at $3 off they are still expensive.  The food tasted great but I really felt ripped off. Ordered the seared ahi and the biggest piece (about 3) were the size of a quarter and then they got smaller.  Maybe 6 pieces total.  Their advertisement shows different, so it's false advertisement.  The prime rib sliders were half size, the size of the bread was smaller than two fingers in width.  I've seen pictures of this appetizer and it wasn't close.  Won't waste my time or money going back.  You don't get what you pay for there.  I wish I had my phone to take pictures but I didn't : (

What is there to say! Great store for any of your home improvement needs but has completely sold out on customer service and knowledgeable employ's. In my experience the most knowledge you are going to find from any given employ's is what isle you will most likely find what you are looking for. I will give Lowe's this, they have a nicer selection of finish materials than Home Depot.

If I could give this experience a -5 stars I would. 

I love Wendy's and go to the Boise location often, but was highly disappointed, along with my dad, during this visit. 

Around 4-5pm was our arrival time. After helping one person in front of us, The cashier, a 18-20 year old punk with long brown skater hair, wearing a hat, stood there filling drinks without even acknowledging us or the people behind us in line for at least 10 minutes. Then when he finally comes to help us, he just stared at my dad, without saying anything. 

My dad ordered in an upset manner as would be expected. I was a prison guard and am used to dealing with shitheads so it didn't offend me as much, but was still disappointing. This guy should be on the "scared straight program"  for customer service skills. 

Have a great day management, hire someone else.

Generic stuff.  Unimpressive wait staff and unremarkable food.  I don't know how this local guy managed to give his restaurant a "chain" feel but its a real shame.  I would have given this only 2 stars if it had not been for the Idaho Statesman advertisement.  Kind of makes me want to go back just out of principle....

My steak was definitely amazing and so were the sides I chose to go with it. I have the 8oz sirloin with a loaded baked potato and corn. The atmosphere was very nice and they give you complimentary peanuts at every table and while you wait to be seated. Our waitress was super friendly and gave us our recommendations as needed.
Great selection of beverages and food. One of the only places in the treasure valley I can get a good meal without compromising on my dietary choices. The service has consistently been satisfactory.

I received a gift card for Rain Salon and Spa for Christmas and finally got around to using it.  I called and scheduled my appointment and because this was my first time I needed to complete some paperwork.  They suggested I arrive 15 minutes early to complete the paperwork or it would dip into my 60 minute massage. I was there 20 minutes early because I want all 60 minutes being pampered. 

As I completed my paperwork I was given a lovely tea and enjoyed the peaceful sounds of the waterfall. When the massage therapist came and got me she showed me the restrooms which are right outside the massage rooms.  This is where I get frustrated and wonder who designs spas. Why would you put the only restrooms outside the massage rooms?  The walls and doors are not sound proof so you hear people talking and doors slamming. A location away from the massage rooms would have been ideal. 

The massage was relaxing and I was given great tips for helping with my back pain. I do however feel a little cheated as it was not the full 60 minutes I had dreamed about, it was 50 minutes. I checked the clock right as the therapist entered the room and then again when she left.   I understand there is prep time, but the price for a massage you should be getting the full 60 minutes.  

I will be back as I still have more on my gift card and hope that I get to change my review to 4 or 5 stars.

I have been to Jaker's many times but have never written a review. It is really an unremarkable restaurant but I have a few things that I enjoy like the salad bar which is why I come back every so often. Last Friday evening my son and I decided to go for a late dinner. We got there 15 minutes before late night happy hour. The host seemed really insistent on us seating ourselves at the bar lounge. When saw the high tables I said I would rather a regular table but again he said that the seats were comfortable so I figured okay maybe we will get better service there an agreed. Unfortunately that did not turn out to be the case. It would be 10 minutes before a server would come and ask us if anyone had helped us. When I said no she said she would be right back with menus and water. It would be another 10 minutes before a different server would come by with menus. It was okay because other than being hungry I was not in a hurry and was really waiting for happy hour to start. 

So $3 off Tapas menu we decided to order from it during happy hour.  We got a garden salad which was basic but good. We also ordered the calamari, baked potato and the prime rib sliders. The calamari was terrible...tasted mushy like they were not fully cooked but over fried and full of grease. The baked potato was good but average. The prime sliders were delicious and melted in your mouth. I would get that again but that is how all the food is here either a hit or miss. 

Through out all of this our server was AWOL. We needed a bit more ranch for our salads so got tired of waiting and just went to the salad bar for more dressing. Little things like that. We had to get a different server to let her know that we were interested in dessert. She asked what we wanted (we had no dessert menus) and my son requested an Oreo milkshake. When our regular server brought the shake he said it was quite a production to find Oreos to make the shake. I didn't know if that was supposed to make us feel good or bad? We were appreciative regardless and the shake actually tasted pretty good. 
I wish I could give Jaker's more stars but 3 stars is how I left feeling for the price, service and food quality.  You just either make your peace with it or you don't.

I've had both good and not so good experiences here. The amount of vegetarian options is great, it's wonderful to have an assortment of things to choose from and try each time I come. There have been a couple times where my food hasn't been hot and the pizza is absolutely horrific here so don't get that. Their Gardein brand options I've tried have all been really delicious and their potato and Brussels sprouts dish is to die for. Service is hit or miss just depending on who you get, like most places. One of the bartenders is a complete jerk and shouldn't be working in the service industry. Overall though, it's a place I enjoy and come to often.

I went here today with a small group of women.  The special was a Lobster BLT.  Well I did get a BLT but only about a teaspoon of lobster. It was not held together with anything so when you bit your sandwich it just fell out. Now, I expected a few large to medium pieces but got just a few shreds. My friend also ordered this and she had to take her sandwich apart to eat it. Not a good idea. I have to say the crab/avocado looked good as well as a few of their other salads. I only ordered this with a recommendation from our waiter.  He was quite good but had to try and find him for 20 min to get some more hot water for my tea.  I will not be going back.

My friend and I stopped by for lunch.  Pleasently surprised by service and food.  I had the fish tacos and they were delicious! My friend had the cali club and she loved it.  Can't wait to go back with my husband!

although this place is a chain and we did have to wait for an hour to be seated, the food cannot be beat! 

sat at the bar while we waited and got a skinny margarita with the $2 extra shot made by tiffany- one of the best margaritas I have ever had! and it's under 200 calories?! seriously too good.

I ordered the smothered chicken with cheese, a sweet potato, and a side salad...you can't beat all that food for $11.99!

my husband got the bone in ribeye- wow! and you can pick your own steak if you want to as well- they have a meat display when you walk in. he opted to let them pick it. it was absolutely cooked perfectly and so flavorful. he also got a salad and some loaded mashed potatoes.

our server janelle was friendly and prompt- actually, every single employee in there was super friendly and accommodating. you can't beat that!

this was a really great meal and we left so full and happy- we will definitely be back! it's worth the wait!

Eh. It's okay. 

Pro: atmosphere, good for game day, great views of DIRECTV Sunday Ticket, and ESPN Game Plan. Staff is great.

Con: chicken is frozen. No reservations. Get there early for a seat for your favorite game.
Basically they have every drink that exist in the world, right in the village and food is always great.

Honestly, I give a lot of bad reviews. I'm very picky with my food and I do believe that quality is key. Kahootz has such good food. I really think that this place has the best steak in the treasure valley. They also have so many beers on tap. The service is always friendly. 

The only thing that sucks about going here is the restaurant is slow. They have a small building and it doesn't seem like they have a lot of room in the kitchen. Regardless like I said earlier, quality is key. I would way rather have a quality cooked steak with good service, then a cheap cut of meat that comes out quick. 

I love this place and I would recommend it to anyone.

Darn I wanted to score this delightfully adorned little strip mall joint with more stars but...I found a good sized chunk of chicken in my kale beet salad (I'm not vegetarian but this means the cutting board they're using isn't cleaned between choppings ...Hummm and $13.50 for the artichoke salad my friend had was a bit overpriced~tasty but not a breadstick or parm wafer with it...and medium sized for the $. Our waiter (?) Cassell is easily recognizable if you're a foodie from the area as he's worked many places. He's sharp and charming. I'm going back for sure cuz I have faith the management will see this and wake up the clean up on the chopping zone AND I found the food tasty and the menu is worthy.
Food was amazing!! Did an online order to pick up and they had everything ready when we got there and packaged up nicely! Staff was super friendly!

Food is ok there's lots of options to choose from but basically it's an over glorified Mongolian grill. My biggest complaint is service is always lacking their waitstaff seems bored and disinterested and good luck getting a refill, to go box, or anything once they've dropped off the check

Came here for the first time on a Thursday night thinking it wouldn't be very busy. Boy, was I wrong! It was 6:30 and the place was packed inside & out.  My husband and I got the last table and water and menus came shortly after we were seated. The waitress was attentive and friendly.  The menu is quite limited, but if you're in the mood for steaks, this is the place to go.  My husband had the black and blue rib eye and I had the Jr New York steak.  I ordered mine medium to medium well and it arrived with just a touch of pink. My husband's rib eye was a medium and it was pink throughout and cooked to perfection. The asparagus and roasted potatoes were a bit boring, but his mashed potatoes were delicious and creamy. Although we were stuffed, we had to try the bread pudding because of all the rave reviews and we were not disappointed. Absolute heaven. We had 2 beers that were great and a glass of wine and the total was $78 before the tip. Dinner took about 35 min to arrive, but well worth the wait and the waitress checked on us often. This is s great local steakhouse and I'm sure we'll be back again soon!
There were a lot of people when I showed up and expected to wait.  After filling out paper work it was seen in about 10 minutes.  Dr. Ward and staff was awesome. Very good service and friendly.

Me and my boyfriend have gone there 2 times now. The first time was not bad which is why I am giving it two stars. But, the most recent time was very disappointing. 
I want to start by saying we are both servers so we understand how the restaurant business works. 
Me and my boyfriend are broke college students so when we have a chance to splurge we want to enjoy it. It was a Monday or Tuesday night, so we went to yard house on a date night. We were seated on the patio as requested by me because it was such a nice night. The first thing I was not happy with was it took us almost 7 minutes to be greeted by our server. My boyfriend asked about one of the alcoholic beverages and the server did not answer his question or any there after. So he decided against an alcoholic beverage. We order soda to start and it took her another 5 minutes to get those for us. We took a look at the menu and decided on what we wanted and we didn't see our server for another 20-30 minutes. When we had finally ordered and got our meals they were very salty and neither of us finished them. Yet again we didn't see our server until the very end of our meal. All the other servers on the patio were checking in on us and refilling our drinks. By the end of the meal we were both irritated and just ready to leave. 
All in all a very disappointing date night.

Took 3 stumps out of our backyard. They were quick, efficient and reasonably priced! Super nice people..if you need any type of tree care or landscaping, use Chavco!! Support your local Fresno businesses!

Very disappointed as I am a fan of the matador downtown and in Seattle. Food was incredibly marginal compared to the other locations which is unfortunate - we were looking forward to having it as an option when we go to the Village.
Love coming here and getting to make my own pizza. I love all the smelly foods, onions, garlic, peppers etc. So this stops my fiance from complaining about my Concoctions , and I get to eat on bliss.

We have never had a bad experience or Mediocre  food here. We have had a wide variety of their food and all is very good. The long Island iced tea is the real deal, top shelf and you won't need a second one, lol.
The staff are all amazing and really care about creating a great experience. This is our go to eatery when we go out.
Portions were way over priced for how small they were. It's way too expensive and no drink specials unless it's beer or under poured drinks and slow service.  Went across to Twigs and loved it.

Do the homestead bar now a half a dozen times and unfortunately the service hasn't improved at first they were slow because they're learning tablets I guess I got rid of those and they went to the old fashion way but any event fairly priced may be overpriced they charge like 10 bucks for a greyhound and put half the vodka is supposed to end it mostly use all of the Cuban sliders are good some of the other food just mediocre and it's a little loud and noisy and hopefully someday they open up and have a band they do have a patio and the chairs are uncomfortable but Tuesday night so I eat spaghetti night I guess that's the highlight so if you're the corner at Chinden and Eagle Road and you got no other options the place is good but wants to Applebee's or someone opens up sorry will be closing the doors quickly unless management turn it around Go Yinnine!
Worst service ever!! Food wasn't very good either. Has went down hill since it opened. Won't be back

We eat at the bar fairly often. The bartender was ok. She was good about over pouring & not cutting off my visibly drunk friend. He had 4 doubles of whisky, couldn't walk to the bathroom without stumbling. He wanted more & she was going to give him another drink. My group of friends had to raise a pretty big stink to not give him another drink. She made a big deal about going on break to smoke her vape. While she was gone a server took over the bar & was passing out free shots of Fireball. I would expect this at a bar in downtown Boise, not in Chilis! Free shots & over pouring in a Friday night, pretty good place to party without going downtown.

This is a great place for Prime Rib, Steak, Steak Salad, vegan, and many more.  The beer selection is excellent, and they have all the other drinks you might want, too.  The atmosphere is almost like a sports pub, but without all the TVs in your face.  Sometimes they have live music, especially in the summer.  There outdoor patio is one of our favorites from late Spring, into the Fall.  Apple Bread Pudding is an amazing dessert there, too, if you leave room for it!

Stopped in late one Saturday evening shortly before closing time and they treated us as if it was the start of the day. Excellent service and friendly waiter.  Meal was excellent and loved the French Onion Soup.  Enjoyed our visit and will enjoy returning for more meals

This is one of our families favorite pizza places. My eight-year-old 12-year-old enjoy it because they can get what they want and it makes him feel in control. My wife and I like it because of the variety and it's consistently great. One of the best fast casual restaurant in the valley.

The food was absolutely, delicious and amazing. We had the chicken nachos, pepper crusted fillet, and vampire tacos. We both thoroughly enjoyed the unique mixture of flavors.  They have an impressive beer selection and offer many other drinks too. Our waiter Bob was fantastic and we literally may be back tomorrow to try some other options. Yummy! This could be our new favorite!

My husband and I celebrated our 40th wedding anniversary at Texas Roadhouse in Meridian. We have never been there before. I was surprised by the quality of food for the low price. The service was also good. Great job TRH!

Went into the Homestead and I was pleasantly surprised. Had a mixed drink and it was strong which to some people might be good but I figured I got my money's worth. Was mixed well however could tell it was stout. I normally am disappointed when I get nachos at a bar and grill however I was not this time. Toppings were layered through the nachos all the way to the bottom. Will go back and try more good for sure. Friendly bartender that was working!

The Yardhouse is where it's at if you want to try a bunch of different beers from all over the country and beyond. If you need to kill some time or just get a buzz before you spend more money in the village, slide up in the Yardhouse for some high ABV brews. I get the Men's Room Red by the Elysian when ever I can since a portion of every glass and bottle sold donates to the Puget Sound VA Fisher House in Seattle, WA. Can't beat drinking for charity!

The staff is nice and the environment is chill. They had four different NFL games on and I'm down with that.

Horrible! Had a party of 8 and the food was cold. I had spicy jambalaya and it is nothing like normal! No sauce , had to ask for more sauce and still not up to par! The beer is outrageous and this place SUCKS!

This review is a little late... we were in there a few weeks ago and the staff was so rude! Absolutely no customer service.  We were herded like cattle through the line and spoke to as if they were irritated that we dare come in for lunch.  Not even a smile or how are you today.  I expect more from you Idaho, being a Californian I am used to rude. But Idaho you have standards! Don't become California.

Ok, so when they first opened up my wife and I went there for dinner and was very disappointed. The manager "Brad!" Called me after my first post and explained why there was a problem ( First opening and not knowing what kind of people he was hiring, not his fault) l was invited back, a month ago and went there for lunch today. I can tell you this, it is now a 180 degree turn around. The service and food was absolutely perfect! I will be going back again and again! 
PS. My wife said the Grande Nacho's are the best she has ever had
Great job to all!!!!!

We are so happy to have this restaurant in our neighborhood. We have been to lunch twice and the food has been fantastic. Pizza is delicious and so fresh, macaroni and cheese was hot and yummy. Service was excellent and fast. Only negative for us is we like to share. We also purchased a Caesar salad for $10. It was very small for the money. But we will be back. Again, very impressed.

I love flatbread because they pick awesome locations for their restaurants.  Their food is above average to solid and they have a very good happy hour (half off pretty much everything.)  

The downside to this location is the lack of a patio and the awful Fred Meyer strip mall add-on.  Once you get past that -- you arrive at friendly (like super friendly) servers and bartenders.   They have an expanded menu due to the larger kitchen, relative to the other locations.  

As a side note -- I'm so glad somebody put the previous business (Bono's, I think) out of their misery and put a legit restaurant in this space.  

I'm not going into too much detail because there are like fourteen other Flatbreads in the valley and the menu is pretty much the same.  You can look up their reviews and then apply to this one.  If you've never been to a flatbread then you're from out of town or live under a rock.
So expensive, but the food is vast and yummy. Beer selection is OK. Lettuce wraps are a great start. Just stick to no drinks since they'll eat up half your bill.

The beer selection is phenomenal!! However, I was disappointed with the sliders. This appeared to be one large patty cut into four pieces and put on a slider bun. The flavor was good but I missed the crispy edges around the entire small patty that you typically have. The service was great and very friendly and the atmosphere was pleasant. A nice place for a beer, but not a food choice for me.

Keep having issues with delivery. Our pizza this time looked like it had been dropped. This loxation has quality control issues for sure. We called and were told that they weren't our usual store??? Wtf does that mean? They delivered the pizza and have done so several times... each time there has been an issue of some kind. I think I will stick with the meridian location. It seems to be more consistent.

Let me preface this review by stating that I go to Starbucks more that I probably should and 99% of the time I have an awesome experience.  The coffee is overpriced -yes- but I always enjoy what I get.  Today, July 25,2016 at 10:25am, was no exception and my drink was fabulous!  My Barista, Jen, not so much.

After my two companions and I received our drinks from barista JEN (her nametag is written in all caps) she proceeded to wash something on the other side of the partition where we had just picked up our drinks.  While plunging whatever it was she was washing into the water, the contents splashed on me, one I was with, the counter, and the floor (appeared to be whipped cream or possibly the remnance of a Frappuccino).  I kindly let her know there was now a sticky mess on the floor (twice) and received no acknowledgement.  Thinking maybe she didn't hear me I told her again and included the fact that the sticky mess was also on two of us.  Her curt reply was "OK, I know", while not even looking at me.

I have never received such rude customer service at this, or any other Starbucks, that I can remember.  Barista Jen displayed terrible customer service.  A thoughtful apology would have been nice but I, at the very least, would have liked to have been acknowledged.

The service was pretty good, maybe even excellent.  The food, however, was mediocre at best.  The place was packed the night we went so I figured the food must be awesome, but it was disappointing.  We won't be back...sorry Jake.

Epic fail at customer service.  Received 3 napkins and asked for some more. Upon asking for the additional napkins, was given a strange look.  Don't question me, just give me some freaking napkins!!!!!  Manny was our server and he was kind of useful at best.  Was attentive at first but then lost interest.  Food is just ok too.  If you can make it to the On the Border in Boise, I recommend it!

A friend was strongly suggesting this while we were staying in Meridian - so we decided to go for an easy dinner on a Friday night. 

There is a great indoor/outdoor feel with ample seating in both. Lots of TV's with sports on. We found our way to a tall table, there was lots of empty seats which I was kind of surprised for a Friday. Our waitress(es) were kind of slow on drink refills, but it was okay because we had been drinking most of the day so one cocktail turned out to be enough. We started with the nachos to share. Perfect for 4 people. 

ORDER THE FISH TACOS. Literally, I order tacos at every restaurant I can. These are def. in my top 3 tacos ever! EVER. I can't wait to check this place out again, there is a lot more on the menu I wanted to try........if I can force myself to not get the tacos again! 

Great Job!

Excellent food, great service, terrible hostess.

Right when we walked through the doors, all we heard was a monotone "how many?"  The blonde hostess looked like she hated life and seemed annoyed that she had to seat us...she grabbed the basket of rolls and took off to our table. We had trouble keeping up with her! She never said one word to us, she just sat the basket of rolls down and took off.  Definitely not a good first impression! 

Good thing our server and her trainee were exceptional! They were so sweet, timed our apps/entrees perfectly, and were smiling the whole time. They checked on us the right amount; enough to where we felt very taken care of. The steaks, pork chops, and mashed potatoes were delicious!

We will definitely be coming back, we just hope the blonde hostess learns to smile a bit.

We had Texas Roadhouse cater our wedding and we are so glad we did. We eat there a few times per month because the service is always the best & the prices are amazing for the amount/quality of food you get. We were a little nervous to try out the catering but I'm so happy with how everything turned out. They were able to help us customize our menu based on our guests. They were also able to deliver & set up the food hassle free for us on our big day. I would totally recommend Texas Roadhouse to anybody wanting a simple yet delicious catering service on their big day. We had so many compliments that the food was amazing. Thank you Texas Roadhouse!

Had an amazing meal here with even better service. Mikayla was so charismatic and attentive. Ashely ran our food with much efficiency and always had a genuine smile. The Hawaiian chicken was better than I anticipated, but it was truly the service that was memorable.

Okay place to grub, kids love the play area. The service is ok, wish the folks were making a bit more, they have the "wish I was somewhere else" look on their face most the time.  For a burger joint that place is like $30+ to feed two adults and three kiddos, wow!
Ok place with a *great* selection on tap. Its cold in there- bring a jacket. Not enough private seating- very open environment. Tour the tap room if they will let you- worth the trip.

I DESPISE Olive Garden and Red Lobster.  To me, they are the Wal-Mart of casual dining.  Somehow, Yard House is in the same corporate family.  It's there the similarities end.  

They have wayyyyyyyy too many beers to choose from.  This means (probably) old kegs and stale beer on certain offerings.   But -- I've never had a stale beer there.   Also, there is a gratifying feeling of having somebody pour you a beer next to 100+ other beers on tap.   Do it once -- for the sex appeal.  This bar is HUGE!!

Food is 90% of the time really really good.  I'd say Lobster Mac, Nashville Chicken and Vampire Taco's are my favorite dishes.  Ask your server because they are (in my experience) incapable of lying and will tell you if something sucks or not.  

They do have a solid happy hour menu which makes a beer ~$4 but half-off on wings, pizza, etc.  I prefer their entrees to the HH menu but still a great HH spot.

I can not say enough great things about this place! we came in on a Tuesday night, expecting there to be a long wait. the village holds many specials on Tuesdays, so most places there get decently packed. My party got there and when my wife was wondering around after talking to one of the servers about open tables, a server callie told a host that we were welcome to sit in her section, even though they were clearly a little busy. we sat at a tall table near the kitchen which gave us a good view of everything that was going on. the food was excellent and although my wives enchiladas were a bit on the cold side, our waitress callie took care of it right away with a smile and apology, not a snarky look like some of the other restaurants ive been to in the village. She was up beat and joked right back to our table, really making sure we had an experience there, not just dinner. they also had a young gentelmen who would fill up our waters and chips when they were anything less than full, talk about customer service! overall I would recommend this restaurant! we might have just gotten very lucky looking at some of the other reviews but we will be back.

One of my favorite restaurants in Boise. They have so many options on the menu. Everything I've tried has been fantastic. Service is always quick, and staff is very friendly. They also have a great happy hour menu. It's the best restaurant to eat at in the Village. Very happy with my experiences at Yardhouse!
Jakers is good for sandwiches, pastas, chicken and steak. Lobster is good and affordable when they have it. Great buffets for New Years and Christmas.

Moving from Cali, I knew it would be hard to find a decent sushi place. This place is clean, well lit, and well taken care of. BUT, the tuna was not fresh. I ordered the Dragon Roll in hopes of it being delicious. The slice on top was  in no way or form fresh. I am a huge tuna lover, and it was just wrong tasting. Their gyozas and miso soup KIND OF saved the night, but was very disappointed in the sushi. Although, the presentation was gorgeous. This place has everything going for it. Maybe I'll come back for a fire show....

Firehouse Subs is new to our area so I tried it for the first time after watching from my car as a guy waved a huge sign.  I decided to go in since it was nearly lunchtime.  The space is brand new and adjacent to Five Guys and other small eateries there.  It was clean and the employees were very welcoming.  I chose the most popular  sub---the Hook & Ladder--smoked turkey, Virginia honey ham, Monterey Jack with mustard, mayo, lettuce, tomato, onion with a  Kosher dill pickle on the side.  It was served on a toasted white roll.  I ordered a medium--nine inches which was totally shareable and ample for both my husband and me.

I also like that there are low calorie options listed.  Since this business was founded by a couple of firefighters, they also have a foundation that contributes to firefighting organizations in the way of equipment and also scholarships.  A very worthy cause besides getting a very delicious meal at a bargain price---$6.00!
This place hands down the best restaurant I ever ate a lot of deferent beer selections and good wine also the food best steak Ive ever had. excellent service too

Second time I've been there and I was just as impressed as the first. The Turkey Burger was just plain fantastic and seasoned so well it was better than most beef burgers I've had. The fries were a little cold but we ordered delivery but they were still devoured even without reheating.

The portion size on the side of onion rings was gigantic and turned in to leftovers for many meals to come. The portion size for the fried chicken strip appetizer as well was as much as a meal and even came with fries (maybe that was a mistake?).

Amazing place - my favorite restaurant in the Village.

The pizza options, price points, and ambiance here are awesome. I frequent often and favor the white top pizza. I'm not a fan of the salads or snacks like the s'mores. Don't male the same mistake I did and go to a pizza place to get a s'more. Pizzas are great.
They have a large menu and great drinks, it's a little pricey but what isn't at the village. The food is fantastic and you must try the mini chocolate soufflé for dessert!

It only gets 2 stars for all the TV's and the good air conditioning.
This place is horrible, poorly run, bad food, run away.
The wings were dried up.
The salad was wilted.
The serving staff and hostess were disinterested/absent.
I could go on.
Management needs to wake up, fire everyone, get better ingredients, and start over.
You're welcome.

Great selection of EVERYTHING.
Could use some more airbrush supplies though.

What can I say, had a couple great experiences, then tonight kind of ruined it for me.  All it takes is one bartender to spend her shift floating between co workers obviously in a bad mood complaining about stuff to ruin your night.  It's hard to miss when you are sitting there and only want to order a drink.  You look for your bartender and every time she is leaned over talking to one of her peers instead of selling you alcohol.  With the amount of staff they had at the bar, there is no reason why anyone should be waiting in drinks.  There are a lot of options here for a consumer, and I will seek those options out now.
Been looking for a new nail salon for awhile. Received a gel pedicure with my mom and it looks great and the nail techs were very friendly.

Love this place! 

I prefer to go for dinner on the weekends--ordering from the chef's selections for the evening. Always a nice selection of microbrews on tap. 

It's popularity combined with it's small size does make it busy though. Come early (or late) for dinner or be prepared to a wait a bit for seating.

We wanted this place to be great.  It was recommended by our BNB hosts.  Unfortunately, our hopes were dashed beginning with drinks.  One in our party had to send their drink back for a remake. Dinner delivered, tepid is best we can say for temp on three dishes.  Sent back and returned barely warmer than before.  A disappointment = three meals out of four.  So sorry to give this review but unfortunately it is the honest truth.
A family favorite, we love how fast everything happens and how we can just add whatever toppings we want.  Always tasty.

Husband made an appointment, even received a reminder call. Showed up for the appointment, and he wasn't on the schedule. Staff was extremely rude, claimed that they used an answering service and there was nothing they would do.

The Noodles & Co menu somehow made it onto our bulletin board at work in Nampa.  After days of staring at the various yummy-looking dishes I decided to give it a try.  I ordered online and arrived a bit early on a Wednesday night.  The entire restaurant was full.  There were servers running all over the place and people waiting for 'to go' orders.  According to the website, if you order online you can waltz right up to the pick up counter, bypassing the line, and grab your food.  This, unfortunately, was not the case.  I stood there for a few minutes watching everyone scramble to get orders out.  The few people who glanced my way were in the back preparing dishes.  Finally a very nice person asked if I had been helped.  Apparently the online system spits out orders "in the back" so I waited for him to check it.  He said the order had just come through so he was able to pull it up on the cash register in the front.  I paid and he offered me a cup for a beverage while I waited.  There is a great selection of teas (I had a blackberry-jasmine-green tea mixture) and a giant machine that dispenses a million different drinks.  According to their website:  "The Coca-Cola Freestyle® machine is now at your neighborhood Noodles & Company. Offering dozens of non-carbonated, low-calorie and caffeine-free drink options, it's flavor like you've never tasted before. Choose from favorites like Dasani®, Minute Maid® and Powerade®; - more than 100 drink possibilities in all."

Considering I was early for my pickup, they got my order out fairly quickly.  I chose the truffle mac and cheese, with visions of the same dish I had in NYC.  Unfortunately, there was hardly any truffle flavor and the cheese used was cheddar.  It didn't seem like the two went together as well as a white cheddar or a lighter cheese, although the flavor was good.  The dish is supposed to come with portabella mushrooms and parmesan but I didn't see much parm and there were about 7 slices of mushroom on top of the pasta.  You can add a salad on the side for a dollar more, but when I got home I realized the portion of the cucumber tomato salad (although tasty) was small.  If you want more salad, I recommend ordering a full sized side. 

One thing I like is that the small bowls really are small.  They are the perfect portion if you want pasta but don't want to go overboard with an Olive Garden-sized portion.  

Like any new restaurant, this one has some kinks to work out, but I will be back again.
Overpriced and better options to eat at in Meridian.  Save your money and enjoy a better meal elsewhere.

I went to BWW with my wife and mom to meet some old friends from AZ and watch football Sunday. My review is always based off of realistic understanding of where I am dining. We had cold beers, hot wings and apps and good service (Angela). Since everyone was a fan of a different team we there all day to watch the games. My wife is pregnant and they kept her waters full with a smile. When a few more friends joined they were accommodating. We had buckets of beers (5 for $12) app pretzels with queso, a few different sauces with the wings, fries and later the "dessert nachos." I thought that a tortilla with ice-cream scoops and 4 cheesecake bites was kind of boring, but the girls loved it. We went to BWW and got solid BWW food and service.

I took the family to try Wok Fusion: General Chicken, Chow Mein, Spicy Mandarin and Sweet and Sour Chicken. The service was great, the portion sizes were great, the flavor of the Mandarin, Sweet and Sour, and Chow Mein were great. The General Chicken (which is what I had) was good, I'd order it again, but it needed a tad more flavor (maybe spice) for my liking. Bottom line; we'll be back and I hope they stay in that location for a while. Thanks!

I've been here twice now and think it will become part of my regular rotation. The pork chop I had was insane, and so was the bread pudding (and I don't generally care much for bread pudding). Bf's steak was also very good. The next time he got a burger, I got the pasta special, a bolognese, and we split the toast points. My bolognese was a miss for me for several reasons, but the toast points were great and Bf liked his burger. In hindsight, I don't know why I ordered pasta at a steakhouse, but I'd go back for that pork chop any day.
Awesome beer selection and great food options. They rotate their beer selection frequently and change up their food menu often enough that you don't get board with the same old stuff.

Less than average service.  Was put on the waiting list for 6 people... When we were called up to get our table, we had 3 people walk up to the hostess as the other 3 had gone to the restroom.  Initially taken to a table for 2. Umm won't fit then she tried to take us to a table for4.still won't fit. I think what happened was one hostess tried to accommodate another group of 5 and thought we were a group of 3 and made the call to give our table away....if I ask for a table for 6 and you only see 3 clarify the situation before guessing or listen to what I told you when I walked up.   I was quite annoyed that they said that they were busy and this was the best they had.   What...... I wait 1.5 hrs for an uncomfortable table? Also I saw you gave our table to a group that was buzzed after us  because you made a wrong decision.  


The drinks took an average of 10 minutes to show up after ordering.  Some people ordered wine to show up with our meal, that didn't show up till half way through our meal.  Waitress was putting in a lot of effort to keep things on track commendable...There were a lot of workers in the restaurants jaw jacking( people in white shirts... Management???) and not doing much.  Would have thought they  would notice the slow service and at least help out....

I tried the crusted chicken, Gorgonzola hamburger and rib eye steak and all were cooked well and had good flavor.  The food is why I am giving a decent rating. 

The restaurant is loud.  Very hard to hold a conversation with a person 1 seat away.  Don't expect to talk much unless you want to yell all meal.

This location is new and I have never had a problem at the other yard houses I have eaten at..

Its really hard to find a better burger/finger steak joint for this price. Any more a meal at a fast food place costs as much as this local business that cooks it fresh and gives you sizable portions. I have never been disappointed in the food there, and i am willing to wait the extra 5 minutes to get it.
Huge variety of food for every taste and craving. Everything I've tried has been very good so far- especially the seared ahi tuna sandwich! Great service and atmosphere!

Although they came in a little later than expected. Jonathan and Joshua were very apologetic for the timing which we totally understand. We are very pleased with the results of our carpet. They were not rushing to get things done but rather make sure that the carpet is cleaned. The owner takes pride of his work and we absolutely love it!

Came here with a large group on a Sunday night.  It was hoppin' and we were told our party of 8 would have a 20-30 minute wait.  However, we were seated less than 10 minutes later (nice!).  

To start the evening off, I ordered their Upper Manhattan.  It's made with Bulleit Bourbon (love me some Bulleit) and along with the usual Manhattan ingredients, they add a little peach puree.  Ummm...divine.  Exquisite, even.

For dinner, I had their grilled cheese with tomato bisque.  The tomato bisque was beautifully creamy with fresh basil adding a nice punch of flavor.  The grilled cheese was made with gorgonzola, cheddar, swiss, and fontina.  They had me at gorgonzola (aka the cheese of the gods, my people).  They add roasted roma tomatoes and the option of bacon and/or avocado.  I went for the avocado (heads up, though, my avocado addition translated to $1.75 increase in the price of the sammy).  It was, in short, delicious.

Our server was able to keep up on our group of 8 quite well and was friendly throughout the evening (with our separate tickets etc).

The prices are a skosh high for what you get (after tax/tip my grilled cheese, soup, and one drink was $30).  It IS pretty noisy and so, I wouldn't necessarily recommend it for an intimate date night.  I found their lack of waiting area a little annoying as our party struggled to find a place to stand where we weren't in the way as we waited. 

But, overall, I'd definitely venture back.  The eats are solid, the drinks divine, and the service lovely.  And?  They can handle a large group!  Kudos!

Get to it!

Just enjoyed a great late afternoon lunch. Good crowd even at 3:00ish. First time dining at the Yardhouse and definitely worth going back. The beer choices seem unlimited. There is certainly something for every beer drinkers palate. Poke nachos appetizer was incredible and the portion of ahi was very generous. Spicy jambalaya was fabulous. Carnitas enchiladas stack was great and large volume. Vampire tacos were OK. Our tastebuds did not find the cheese encrusted shells to be fabulous, but the filling was very good. Service was FABULOUS!  Thanks Amanda.

This restaurant takes Mongolian stir fry to the next level. 

First and foremost, the staff has always been an awesome part of the dining experience. The hostesses and waitresses are super friendly, and will answer any question or fulfill any request with a smile. And it only gets better when you encounter the staff at the grill. They are fast, attentive and fun! They always greet you with a big smile, cook your food just right and then serve it to you with an enthusiastic "enjoy!" 

Now, the food. There are 7 meats, 8 seafoods, tofu, 6 noodles and pastas, 4 sides, 13 dry spices, 37 vegetables, 23 sauces, 5 tortillas and wraps and 14 finishing sauces! Now, how you put it all together is up to you. Although don't feel overwhelmed, they have many recipes available to follow. And I have never not thoroughly enjoyed what I created. 

Overall great experience and meal, all for a reasonable price.

Jenna treated us wonderfully!  
Absolutely love the biscuits and cinnamon butter.   Their salads have chopped eggs and the blue cheese dressing is amazing!

I normally wouldn't give Walmart a 4 Star because, well, it's a Walmart. However, this one is clean, the people working there seem to be more helpful than a regular Walmart, and it's spacious. This location is a lot cleaner and more put together than other Walmarts that I have been to. If I have to go to one, I go to this one. 

Note: The photo center seems to be closed or is under renovation.
I was hoping for something tastier than subway.  Canned mushrooms and meat looked bubbly.  Wish I had gone to five guys.

Highly recommend this restaurant. We went here for a late lunch while on vacation visiting family in Boise.  My son ordered the kids chicken and fries with a side of fruit and pretty much summed it up for all 5 of us when he said, "...best chicken ever; not joking MOM..."

Again I keep coming back trying to give another chance but it's getting worse each time, this time we decided to sit outside cause it beautiful out,  it took about 15 min before anyone came out to see if when been help or even ask what we'd like to drink, out appetizer ended up coming out with our meals so what's the point of an appetizer, our drink we ordered weren't made right, a blue Hawaiian was more like a pina coloda same color as a pina so why is called a BLUE Hawaiian? BWW step up your game

I have been wanting to try this spot for awhile since it's around the corner.  I made the mistake of going on a Thursday night during football season so it was really busy.  My husband and I both ordered burgers which were pretty good.  I took off a star because my fries were cold.  I will give it another try soon!!!

I took my car here for an oil change and because my car was making a whining sound. I knew I needed power steering fluid so I asked to make sure they checked it. Of course the paper says it's included. So.....they finally found where the power steering fluid goes (I guess it's way in back). The mechanic pulled out a funnel to put the fluid in but it wouldn't reach so they told me we can't put it in for you. I said this is the reason I came in here today, I need power steering fluid. The mechanic asked, you didn't need your oil changed? Um....yes I did but this is included so once I heard the whining I came today. They just kept telling me sorry we don't have a funnel that can reach your power steering fluid. So....what am I supposed to do? Oh well, we send our customers to Bobbys Transmission for things we can't do. So let me get this straight because you don't want to think outside of the box to get my power steering fluid into my car (which was included in the price) I'm supposed to go somewhere else and waste more of my day to get the job done when I just paid you for it???? What's really funny is they weren't even going to check it until I asked. The real kicker is that on my paper work it says that my power steering fluid level was ok. Interesting. And for the send off that I was given, "I hope you're day gets better." Wow. The car I drive is a Chevy Impala which is a very common vehicle so I'm not quite sure why this place wouldn't be show to perform a full oil change on a common car. I went to Bobbys Transmission and they were amazing! The mechanic got the fluid in in less than a minute! I will not go back to Einsteins again. Now I'm wondering if they did this same thing to me the other 2x I went in, telling me everything is ok and it's not.

Drive through took at least 15 minutes, food was ultra greasy (and I normally love Wendy's). We asked for some mayonnaise and got an overflowing cup of mayo that the window attendant used her fingers to wipe excess off. Ew! Fries weren't hot. They forgot our drink. Just skip this place.

Not one to write bad reviews (unless called for), but this place falls somewhere between 'mediocre' and 'slightly above mediocre'.  Sushi and sashimi was average...nothing to write home about, but honest and straight-forward.  Service was...well...sub-par.  Waitstaff very anxious to clear your table whether or not you're finished with your order...strange....no lines outside waiting for a table, so what's the 'rush' deal?  Anyway, slightly below an average rating and probably will not return unless I absolutely need to travel no more than 5 miles for dinner....Sushi Ya a much better deal...I'll stick with them....sorry.
We love this place! Our pup comes home with a good looking cut and the best is that it's reasonably priced! Our "go-to" place!

Never coming here again, what a waste of time! The service was awful, even for a Wednesday night at 5. My Mac n cheese came out cold and who calls noodles with melted cheese on them "Mac n cheese"? Mac n cheese involves a creamy cheese sauce and sometimes melted cheese. My boyfriend got the club on sourdough and the bread was extremely soggy. The Cubans sliders were good but they were definitely thrown together and were way too messy. Lastly there were flies everywhere... gross!
The food I had here was not a good as I expected, the burgers are bland and the fries weren't anything special.the staff however was quite friendly.

We rolled into Boise in late September, blinded by hunger after driving for a very long and full day through some pretty uninhabited parts of Idaho. And although hunger may have had its influence, this is still a great little steak house. They were very close to closing time when we arrived, but I never once got any vibes that we needed to rush.  The service was excellent, the ambiance typical for a old fashioned, casual steak house.

The special for Monday and Tuesday was an 8 oz ribeye steak for $13.  Really? These prices are unheard of in our neck of the woods. I wondered if we were getting a  not-so-tender cut.  But how can you lose...after seeing vast expanses of nothing but cattle ranches for the past two days. This obviously is a beef (and Idaho potato) mecca, so sign me up. I think we got the last two specials available.  Lucky us, seriously.

Our steaks came with a choice of starch (I highly recommend the wild rice pilaf), a slice of incredibly delicious, soft white french bread, and some beautifully grilled asparagus.  This was a great little steak, cooked to perfection.  It could have used a tad less seasoning, but overall was exactly what I was craving.  To my surprise, I polished that entire steak off, me, a usually reformed non-red meat eater.

And don't get me started on the bread pudding.  Thankfully we shared. They split it before bringing it to our table on a sizzling platter, each portion with healthy scoop of delicious vanilla ice cream & side of caramel sauce. Me, who thinks she does not like caramel. 

Excellent meal, great memories! If I lived in Meridian, I would find myself tempted to come here often.

Great dog park.  Things to know when going to this park.

No ones running the park, which means you are responsible for your dog.

No dogs in heat allowed= if your dog isn't spayed there may be unwanted surprises in your future.

No one is there to clean up your dogs poo, so be a friend and help clean up.

The main entrance is where everyone hangs out, this means there is a high potential for a dog fight.  Enter from the side to reduce this risk.  

If your dog is a jerk, be aware of that, dog parks are great for socialization but not the cure.  So stay off your phone and help your dog make friends, who knows you might too.

This is open to the public, not everyone is vaccinated, so enter at your own risk.  This goes for your dog too!

All and all my family of dogs really enjoys this great park, keep up the good work City of Meridian!
Service was friendly and the food was delicious. I had the Apple Brandy pork chops... excellent!
Forget about those roadhouse or Chandlers this is the best steak I have ever had.  The Bloody Mary was Bloody good. My hat off to the Steak Master

Poor quality of food for the price!  I ordered the "Jakers Signature Salad Bar and soup".    Soup was good but the salad bar was the worst I seen.  It was very selective on lettuce choices but ALL were watered down. Someone must of rinsed all the items off and forgot to strain them. My plate had a cup of water ready to overflow it was that bad.
My aunt thought about splurging and went with the $23 Prime rib and added on Blue cheese for $2.   The meat looked Microwaved and was sitting in a pool of liquid as well.  Very cheap looking and tasting.  She couldn't finish it as it was so nasty.  Also the "scones" they bring to the table are NOT scones.  I will never eat at this place again!

Amber D. You deserve a 5star.
Thank you for reminding us that customer service is alive and well in Boise Idaho. 
For 3 hours you did not change your demeanor or smile. Your consistency and smile left us appreciative of who you are and the work ethic you provide this establishment. 
You are appreciated, unforgettable, and I am grateful to have had you as our server on my trip home. 

Thank you

Visiting from CA where we dine in 5 star restaurants. We wanted steak so decided to dismiss the "not so good" reviews and try it. Don't let the appearance of the building fool you.  WE ABSOLUTELY LOVED IT!!! Atmosphere  was great, waitresses were cute & friendly and above all, the food was amazingly delicious!!! We ordered chorizo stuffed mini bell peppers (stuffed with so much meat) for an appetizer, the Ribeye (perfectly cooked, not too much fat, and SO tender) with "real, thick" bacon green beans (tasty) and Au-gratin potatoes (which were better than a 5 Star fine dining restaurant in CA) and of course the TO DIE FOR BREAD PUDDING!!! I could have eaten the whole one rather than the half. The alcohol was reasonably priced and there were a huge selection of good beers on tap. What topped our night off after an amazing dinner was that the waitress Justine (so cute and friendly) informed us that the owner was COMPING our ENTIRE MEAL & DRINKS because of it being their 13th anniversary!! Unbelievable!!! It's hard to even find a restaurant to comp a dessert these days. 
THANK-YOU KAHOOTZ and to the owner & Justine for making our last night in ID a memorable one. When we come back in summer to ID, you can bet we'll be back!!!

Needed to have 3 trees trimmed. Josh's team arrived on time on a cold rainy day. They got the work done quickly, safely, and charges were as estimated. Cleanup was spot on! Will definitely ask them back for future work!

I would give it a 3.5 but since that's not an option Ive got to round down. Its GOOD, but not great. They were busy in the kitchen and it showed in the final product.What should have been a med steak was a seared raw steak and for the money were a bit small. Wine prices are a bit high too.
It's a fun little place and worth a visit.

Wife and I love the food and atmosphere. Sometimes it's a little crowded, but only because it's a great place to have dinner. Only complaint is that at the parking lot can fill up and I've got to park across a four lane street.

My husband and I just love this place. This is probably our 6th time eating here and the food and service is always superb. We have had the pleasure of having Emma twice now as our server, and she is so sweet and even remembered what we had ordered the last visit. She also helped recommend a summer Sangria that was so refreshing. The Cappicola, Italian Sausage, and Sopressa Pizza was so delicious and fresh, I don't think we left a crumb behind. As always Aubrey, the manager is making sure everyone is happy and asking if there is anything she can help us with, or get for us, to please let her know.  A warm, comfortable place to enjoy a wonderful meal.

If I could give 0 stars I would. Save your money and just get some top ramen. First time here and very disappointed. I love mongo and was excited to try this place. The fried rice is terrible! But not as bad as the mongo. Put extra sauce after reading reviews and it still wasn't enough. On top of that the mongo was burned or over cooked. Never done this before but I had to put soy sauce on it to give it some flavor. Only good part was the super nice server.

Chilis is not what they used to be. grilled chicken is no longer being grilled like they used to, instead it is processed on the conveyor belt like in a fast food restaurant. Our mashed potatoes were brown and discolored from sitting too long in a pan. My wife's corn on the cob was cold. I worked for Chillis as a cook for over five years and they definitely took a turn into the wrong direction, most likely to called down on the cost at the expense of the quality. I will take a break from Chili's for a while

Great place for a family dinner or have a few drinks with friends! Lots of food/drink options, comfortable decor and attentive service. My kids love the kids menu. 

There salads are worth trying, although I should have ask for the dressing on the side. I tried the Quesadilla Explosion Salad with grilled chicken breast, shredded cheese, diced tomatoes, house-made corn & black bean salsa, crispy tortilla strips & citrus-balsamic dressing. Served with freshly toasted 3-cheese quesadillas. I thought it was quite creative and tasty.

Decent food and the beer selection was plentiful.  
Not that great for kids: no milk-only soda and water.
Nice place to sit and have a brew.
Not sure what the draw here is.  The menu isn't as expansive as other ale houses but they seem to have a solid local following.
This will probably be a Meridian must-do as time goes on.  Pretty ok

We have been coming here for 9 years and they are always consistent.  The food is amazing, the best in the valley, and the staff is the best. They remember their customers and our kids. We love this place!
