Ultra fab service and food. Went here for my daughters birthday and we couldn't be happier with the service. Matthew was our server and he gave us premium attention. When we got our bill, my birthday girls desert was on the house! What a fab place for a celebration!

We took my mom and dad there for their 52nd wedding anniversary , and we had an amazing time! The service was impeccable and the food was perfect! Kailyn was our server and took wonderful care of us. We highly recommend this restaurant!

It's chiropractor over billed for services and wrote a treatment plan that included me having a treatment for times a week for an injury from the accident. Dr. Strickland was rude and abrasive. If I could give them zero stars I would. I would not recommend his services for anybody and chiropractic care. I have been to multiple chiropractors and found this office unbearable.

Don't get me wrong,  I love the concept and restaurant. The wait time is as expected and not too terribly long. The food is good and I fell in love with their onions rings :) 

Just is always super crowded when I go and sometimes the bartenders are inattentive. We tried to get their attention a few times and had to wait until they made their round at the bar. 

Food is overpriced..As is usual with a chain.

I mean, for me, I do like this place, but every time we go, it's just not a super fantastic experience. That's all.

Anthropologie is my happy place!  Wow, this is the biggest Anthro store I've ever seen!  The sale section was smaller than I've seen, though.  
 
Unfortunately, the memory I will take is of a twenty-something sales associate (with clear plastic eyeglass frames) on the floor who, when I looked at her to ask a question gave me a snooty look, looked me up and down (no joke), and walked past me.  No smile, no offer to help, nothing.  Are you kidding me?  The store wasn't crowded at all.  I was even wearing an Anthropologie outfit, but I guess she didn't think I looked rich enough to be shopping there or something.  :(  

Soooo, that pretty much killed any desire to stay and look around any longer, and I left and went to another store where the two sales associates, in a **crowded** store couldn't have been friendlier or more helpful if they had tried.  I left Anthropologie empty-handed; but not from this store because I felt like they really appreciated my business.    

Like I said, Anthropologie is my happy place.  Maybe not so much this location, though.  :(

If I could put a negative number 1 hr and 45 ,min to get food and then it was cold and over cooked.  Along with a poor excuse of why.  We have been here before and it was good,  both managers basically told us that others came and were more important.

Great experience. Lexi was super accommodating and helpful at the bar. It was my first time there and we were celebrating my husbands birthday. Our original plans fell through so we ended up here late night hoping to get it one last drink before they closed. She made our evening and we look forward to coming back! Thanks Lexi!!

The food is really good here and that's what keeps me coming back. The service is either amazing or terrible. 
The gnocchi are amazing so is the Chianti burger. The French onion soup is great as well.
They have a really good happy hour and on Tuesdays most of the pizzas are only $10 

Will continue to come in

Big boy movers were great to work with even with all the schedule issues due to the race and Street closures. Hunter showed up on time and got working right away and carefully moving items. They are reasonably priced, we would definitely work with them again!

**Updated in response the business owner's response.

If it had been as simple as Friday being booked, why was another appointment not offered? We've been dealing with several companies (appliance and furniture delivery, flooring installation, and even Comcast!) and all have been extremely understanding of our situation. Like I said in the message you sent privately-I was up front in regards to my moving situation. Each time I rescheduled, there was never any mention of it being an issue (the last time being 8 days prior). When you found it becoming a problem, you should have made mention of it instead of flat our denying to reschedule. Had you offered to reschedule for your next available date, without all the unnecessary excuses, we may have continued to do business with you. That would have been an example of "appreciating each and every customer", like you claim.**

We called and got a quote from Katie and I mentioned the Yelp deal ($90 for $100 deal). She said not to purchase it through Yelp and that she'd just give us the deal. I called to reschedule 3-4 times because our closing date for our new house kept getting pushed back (each time giving at least 2 days notice) and it was never mentioned that there was an issue. Today, we got a set date to get our keys and called to move our appt, only to be told that she would be cancelling our appt and not rescheduling due to the number of times we rescheduled. I was upset that she wouldn't accommodate us this last time. Had she mentioned that there was a problem the first few times we rescheduled, I would have been more understanding. She went on to say that they don't normally reschedule this many times (again, after having already done so without complaint) and that they're a small company and were unable to fill our previously scheduled appts. So, we took our business elsewhere. We currently have an appt with Love's Dry Carpet Cleaning.
Loooooovvvvveeee their asparagus... beyond my favorite!! Worth the wait to be seated sometimes because of how popular it is. Definitely a must go to. I will be returning multiple times.

Terrible service. Terribly under staffed. The Hibachi man was wonderful, our waitress however did not refill beverages unless asked. Brought back a dirty tea cup with lipstick on it, my mom wasn't wearing any... Servers response "my bad, I thought that one was yours." So she obviously switched it with someone else's. And a stranger got my moms cup. Let that sink in for a moment. Ew. Won't be coming back. Terrible service ruins a place.

I went here tonight for dinner and I will just say that I will make sure that the next time I want wings, I will be going somewhere else.

For starters, the service was terrible.  The waitress had a massive attitude problem, who also apparently could not comprehend carrying more than one item at a time.  Add also, it took what seemed like forever to check on us. (and no i wasn't drunk, she was just slow as could be)  When asking her about items on the menu, she completely quoted it incorrectly resulting in us spending unnecessary money because she was wrong.  Worried that this waitress may actually have the nerve to spit in my food, I decided to hold off calling out the many mistakes in the restaurant.

Finally when it was time to go, our food had to sit for 30 minutes before we decided to get up, find her and get the boxes upon our own request.  We had quite a few items to carry without offering a bag to carry it all in.  

I will never be back to this location again and I will make sure that our company outings are held at another location.

The only reason I even considered one star is because the wings were amazing.  I'm guessing our waitress had nothing to do with those...

I just had lunch at the yard house with my husband. I had the lunch special with Roast Beef Dip and Tomato soup. My husband had the turkey club with the Caesar salad with also a French onion soup. The food was fantastic with the exception of no crackers or bread being served with the soups. Who doesn't serve crackers with soup or even offer? My husband was irritated that the staff kept stopping near the table and complaining about work and taking their personal items into the kitchen. We were seated near the kitchen so in the future I would request a seat far away from the kitchen. Large beer and wine selection- excellent variety. They do not offer a military discount.

This is a REALLY great restaurant considering it is a big-box streak house. It is always crowded, which is a good thing because people love to eat there (to be read as get there early if you don't want to wait outside).  The bad part of that is that it can get really loud, but it is, and always has been a crowded steak house.  

I love the peanuts they have by the bucket, and my son would be sad if I didn't say that we both really like the rolls with the sweet butter.  I haven't had a bad slice of beef there yet, and their ribs are usually pretty awesome.  Is it world-class?  Of course not, but the grades of meat used are very, very good.  Others note the "YeeeHaaww" and dancing thing they do, which I could really do without, but that said, it is a spirited group...spirits you say?  The bar is good, meaning I haven't anything less than a refreshing Margarita, beer, or glass of wine the many times we've eaten there.

texas road house, is one of my favorites restaurant.
i always enjoy the entire meal, and my favorite dish is the rib eye with caramelized onions & mushrooms with the mashed potatoes & white gravy. 
food always are very tasty and the steak was cooked perfectly. ........plus a great and fast service to.

Stopped in for lunch with the husband. I loved the look and feel of the place, and the service was nice. The food was... Okay. We ordered chips and salsa and guac to start. The guac tasted like the wholy guacamole you get at the grocery store. Not much flavor, and the salsa had no kick. Chips came from a bag... Not what I was hoping for for the $9 spent. We then shared the homestead burger. The portions are generous, but the burger was lacking. The meat itself was fine, but there was no seasonings or mayo or ketchup, etc. Just bun, Patty, lettuce, etc. Over halfway through we saw the Sriracha ketchup on the table and it saved the day! Made it a great burger instead of the blah one we were served. The fries were probably the best part of the meal, but for $22, I think we'll pass on this place next time...

Horrible service. Inattentive staff and management. Did not get to eat. Left after more than 30 minuets (no exaggeration/probably closer to an hour) of no one coming after being seated with a menu. Not even any eye contact from employees passing our table by. Saw the manager back and forth without eyes on the entire restaurant. Complete tunnel vision. Finally left and tried to inform someone leaving and why. They were not concerned. There with my hungry family, kid included. Too bad because we like the beer menu. I will never come here again. It's like they think the brand speaks for them so there's no concern with the level of service.

We came here based on reviews from other yelpers and we were NOT disappointed!! We ordered the prime rib French dip and the steak bites for an appetizer! Both were fantastic!! Thank you so much Law for your wonderful service!
Great local spot. Great food, service and a good selection of beers on tap. We live close by and will definitely be coming back!

Great food poor customer service..... My family eats here a couple times a month and always had great experience. This last time we had downloaded there new app, well that is where the bad service started. No one knew had to let us use the app to pay and get our points. It got to the point that the manager told my wife to just give her out card to pay for the food. Plus we already used rewards for a free drink. We don't get points also. Very unprofessional and don't blame us you don't know how to work your app.

Slow response time last night and it was not busy.  Food was cold.   Beer was warm.  Order was wrong and they didnt offer to fix it.  Food not good.  Paid 14 bucks for carna asada tacos that had barely any meat on them.  I can get 2lbs of carna from campos that tastes wayyyyyyyy better for the same price. The only good part was the chips and dalsa.

So, I'm from a place where good poke is easy to find. Since living in Boise I have found places that satisfy my poke craving but haven't necessarily been noteworthy.... until I found Fish Poke Bar!

It's a great spot and we were greeted by the owner (I'm assuming). He had choices of small, medium, or large... which I appreciated because most places only have have one size. We also had the choice of how many different types of protein we wanted. 

I had tuna, salmon, lobster, and yellow tail with sauce #4... and wow! The fish was fresh! All of my toppings, super fresh! The sauce, super tasty! 

My boyfriend, who considers himself an anti-reviewer stated this place was fantastic and will be returning and stated I could quote him saying that. ;-) 

Anywho, I'm thrilled to have found a place
That matches my expectations for phenomenal poke and I will be back!

Just as good as I remember.  The last time I had KK had to have been when I was living in Torrance, CA.

I only ordered two doughnuts - a regular glazed and a sugared.  

Oh the pleasure!  I sat in the passenger seat and immediately ate my doughnuts.  From the looks I was getting from my fiance, I think I must have resembled a starving wolverine eating a rabbit. . .

I wish there was a KK near us. . .

This was my fifth time, not in a row, ordering to go. And out of the 5 times my order has been incorrect for 3 times. It is kind of frustrating when you get home and you don't have what you ordered. And it is frustrating that you ordered to go and then you have to sit there and wait while the order gets fixed. And while they are fixing the order. The other half of the order is getting cold. Someone needs to do a better job at training the employees how to read the screens.

Tried Wok Fusion for the first time the other day.  Instantly greeted by a very nice lady who was attentive to our every need.  Drinks always remained filled.  Restaurant interior pretty plain but spread out nicely.  We all ordered the Kung Pao lunch special with fried rice.  We all agreed it was good, nothing spectacular but would come back and try other things on the menu.

Let me start by saying the service and ambiance is good and the food is average.  However the price is no where near average.  I'm getting food that should be priced at $8 for $18.  Or drinks that should be $7 that are $12.  But the biggest problem is how oily everything is.  My burger and fries had more oil than a carnival's grease trap.  Overall will not be returning.

Amazing for a chain! Really good food. Steaks are some of the best I've ever had. Wait time can be a bit of a hassle occasionally, but people don't wait for bad food! Well worth the wait. Fair pricing and great service. Always a treat for us!

Have been into Sakana multiple times. This was the first place I had sushi. I had the Pink Lady. You get a lot of rolls for what you pay I normally leave with 2-3 rolls left over unless I'm super hungry. Very nice and friendly staff. Place is always clean and has a very clam atmosphere. No tv's loud music etc.

We ate here on the recommendation of a friend, for my parents anniversary.  They served one of the best meals I have ever had.  Everything was great, and fun.  Our server was awesome, and the bread pudding?  (I hate bread pudding).  I could not get enough of the bread pudding!  Truly a great dining experience!  If you are in the area, you gotta eat here!

Good drinks and the sugar cookie is divine!  I do think they need to add items to the menu or I don't think they will make it.  Seating area was ample but overall the atmosphere is a bit stark- could use some plants and maybe music playing

I have been to Jarvis Dental several times recently to get my teeth back in good working order. I have had an excellent experience every single time. I cannot praise the dentist and staff enough for making me feel welcome and doing such a great job. I usually don't like dental visits, but actually look forward to them at Jarvis. My kids love it too. I'm so happy I found them!!!

This place rocks! Everytime I've been here I've had great service and excellent food. Today we shared the capricciosa pizza, roasted chicken portabella sandwich, italian wedge and the Mac and cheese. 

Pizza was awesome. Sandwich had great flavor bit would have liked it to be a little warmer. Fantastic salad ... Love the flavor of the dressing. Excellent blend of cheeses in the Mac.

Beer was nice and cold. Somewhat limited selection but enough to satisfy most people. Great wine selection. Really like the wine flights. 

Service was perfect. Very  timely and attentive.  I highly recommend this place. Thanks Ashley.

Food is always amazing, drinks are great and price point is fair. If you want a good meal in an easy going atmosphere you will not be disappointed. 
I always look forward to a trip to yardhouse! Their burgers are great, the onion tower and crispy Brussels are regular faves.

The hibachi guy was awesome! Funny, but seemed like he wasn't surprised with how crappy the service was. The servers were under staffed bussing their own tables. The cup that was brought over to my mother with lipstick on it was enough for us to throw the towel in! Yuck!!! Their special should say ".75 cent hot tea with lipstick!". Gross!
Great service. I had the half sandwich and salad. It was very good. The beer selection was great. There are quite a few beers on tap.
Food was good and service was good for a Saturday afternoon lunch.  But what was fantastic is the help I got after I left from Rudy when I left my credit card behind.  Now that's customer service!!!
This is the second time I've been here. Food is decent. Korean noodles are SPICY for sure. The ladies working tonight were super nice.

Such a great place for friends! I bring my friends here all if the time and we just have so much fun! Friends are great and this place is the friends capital! Shout out to my friends in this review! Thanks guys, you're great friends

Pleasant mix of Mexican and Tex-Mex. It hits the spot for a flair of something extra in the Latin food department.

No table side guac like a few spots in the area but the interior has a mellow Old world Spanish feel that makes for a nice ambiance.

Men's bathroom has excellent dia de los muertos wallpaper - so they have that going for them.

We live near Sakana and sometimes stop in after the gym. We also pick up occasional to-go orders.
The sushi is always yummy, service has always been fast and courteous, and prices are reasonable.
The atmosphere isn't too bad. My biggest complaint is the door wrap on the front door, I stabbed my finger on the zip-tie that holds it. Also they have a weird curtain things that block the interior and you have to walk through, it's annoying and too short for tall people. If the sushi wasn't so good, I wouldn't return just because of that it annoys me that much.

As far as food goes, I've always enjoyed it and we continue to eat here.
Good place for some great food! Tons of great beverages along with a bunch of beers on tap..
Not really sure why anybody visits the place. Poor food and mediocre beer selections don't make up for the sports environment.

This location is always one of the best.  The Wednesday steak special is a great deal at any price.  Brandon stopped by to check on my dinner, if he is the manager, he is doing a great job.  Emma was my server and was spot on with everything.  I have never had a bad meal here, but tonight was out of the park.  GREAT WORK!

When I called Dunn Right, I was in desperate need of carpet cleaning to be done the next day. I was looking for one that was reviewed recently and was convinced to try them out due to the glowing reviews. I'm so glad that they did not disappoint at all. They were able to accommodate me for the time I needed the service. They came promptly and were very pleasant and professional. They've had years of expirience in the industry and they know what they're doing. The carpets look and smell awesome! I also appreciated the discounts for being a first time customer and other extras. Thank you, John and Brian!

I took my son here to celebrate his straight A's, and I really regret it! The Staff were excellent, but the food was horrible. We ordered the onion cactus blossom, and I am not even kidding when I say it came out with at least 2 tablespoons of oil in the bottom. So everytime you picked up a piece of onion, the oil would drip off. It was disgusting. We ordered the bacon cheeseburger, and they were extremely salty. I took one bite of mine and my son could not even finish half of his because it was waaayyy too salty. Like I said, the staff here were friendly, but the food is terrilble!

This place makes me want to move to Idaho. The food was incredible and the service was great! We unfortunately weren't very hungry so I just ordered a beer, some wings and we shared the bread pudding. But these weren't just wings; they were pterodactyl wings. They were MASSIVE! And oh-my-gawd so so so good. I would fly back just for those wings. But then we were handed the bread pudding. There were four of us and we shared a half-order and it was just the right amount of sugary awesomeness. The sizzling sound of caramel being poured over the skillet and the heavenly aroma it produced will stick with me for the rest of my life. Their beer selection is excellent and features plenty of local microbreweries which made the evening perfect. I've heard rumors their mud pie is equally as insane - I might have to try that too!

I need to come back to try their other menu items, but the bread pudding will be a recurring theme for sure!
Waited for over an hour when we were told it would be twenty minutes.  Will spend the time driving to the Nampa location next time!

So excited when I found out Yard House was going in at the village! Great place to meet up with the guys and grab a beer, or two and also a great group atmosphere for dining. The Pastrami sandwich is my favorite with truffle fries! However the ginger salmon with wasabi mashed potatoes is is also delicious! Knowledgeable staff and all very friendly.

I can't say enough about this restaurant.  It has been my families go to restaurant since the day it opened in 2002.  Best Prime Rib and Rib Eye specials in the Valley.  All their food is home cooking and nothing fried.  Looking for a treat?  Try their "fresh sheet" unbelievable.  No reservations so get their early!  40+ beers on tap and GREAT Service!

I have had great takeout from Jakers before in Idaho Falls while in town for work so I decided to try my local branch for dinner with some friends.  Our waitress was nice but....  our food arrived about 30 minutes after our appetizers, was cold and had all the wrong accompaniments.  We ordered several cocktails and those arrived very late too.  We also requested two separate checks and those were done incorrectly. We didn't bother to have it corrected and just paid and left.  I am giving two stars instead of one cause the whole experience was so bad that it was hilarious.

Waited 1hr 45 min for a table. 
The last 45 min they kept telling us we were next but sat other people 
The hostess put our car seat on a chair in the path of our server who got frustrated. 
They told me they didn't have anywhere to put my baby's car seat because they don't allow car seats on high chairs so my six-month-old baby sat on the floor under the table the entire time. Luckily she is good and didn't make a peep, but really? 
Our food arrived but we didn't have forks. We asked for some and they dumped a pile on our table. We didn't get any other flatware and asked nicely for knives. We got three. We asked if chips and salsa came with the meal- since everyone around us had some already- and they said oh yeah, and brought us some. 
Our waitress was nice enough and very apologetic and the food was fine- nothing spectacular - but pretty good for the price. The food came out quickly and the dining experience probably would have been alright if the rest of our experience had not been so chaotic. I wanted to try it at least once, but 
It isn't worth it to me to give this restaurant a second chance.

Tried for the first time last Saturday and will definitely go back.  Pleasantly surprised to find that happy hour applied from 9 to close every day of the week.  The cocktails were great and the nachos with pulled pork were more than enough for 2 people not mention they were only $5.
Pretty good food, great customer service.  My only criticism is it's very noisy  and crowded inside.  Crowded means they're doing good business, and it is a sports bar so it will probably be noisy.

Just opened. Very clean environment but still working on getting all the kinks out. Their new Big Chicken Filet on a freshly made bun was very good. The Fried Zucchini was good for fast food. Their new Grilled Chicken Flautas was rather tasty with a good helping of guacamole on the side.

Only reason I'm giving 2 stars instead of 1 is my first experience here was great! This time if I could give 0 stars, to it I would.  My husband and I waited over an hour, which we were ok with, but where they sat us we were not! Part of date night is atmosphere, they didn't even ask us if we were ok with sitting in their dark, dungeon of a patio in winter! We would have waited a while longer to be seated in the bar or restraunt.  The drinks were not up to $10 a glass standard. When I told my waiter my drink wasn't good, he acted like I was an idiot for even thinking that. The chicken was also very dry and over cooked in the nachos. We do not get out much and this date was special, their patio mid winter is not a nice place to sit! We wanted to be inside with all the other people. It felt like being sent to the hall to do your work in elementary school. Maybe the hostess should ask first if they are going to seat you somewhere other than the inside restraunt.  The staff was just ok, they seemed stressed or something. Not like the super friendly people that waited on us the first time we came here. We spent close to $100 with tip, such a waste of money.

We ate at Kahootz last night and really enjoyed our food. We had the filet and the cioppino as well as the bread pudding for dessert. The steak was like cutting butter, a real treat served with rosemary red potatoes. I love their potatoes. Very moist and flavorful. The cioppino was served piping hot, a devious tomato based fish stew. My hubs loved it. Very rich, flavorful and filling. The bread pudding was delicious although we both felt it could have benefitted from the addition of raisins. Kahootz is a small restaurant, with a bar. It is a noisy,popular place so expect a wait. For the two of us on a Saturday night we waited 45 minutes for a table. We were not in a rush and we felt like the food was worth the wait but carrying on a meaningful conversation was difficult. We would go back to eat at Kahootz and support a small local business.

First time here for a transmission flush and oil change and could not be more impressed. Dakota was our Tech and he was awesome very friendly professional and polite and courteous. Their attention to detail is incredible and being able to pull in and watch everything on monitors that is being done was amazing to us. We will definitely be long-time customers here and would highly recommend them

The service was ok they can be really busy at times...The food was great and awesome. We order 3 appetizers, we had the fried calamari, sliders and the kalbi boneless short ribs. Wife and I had our own plate of kalbi boneless short ribs because it was that good and the rest of the appetizers were shared and it was just her and I. When the bill came l was surprise  it was not as expensive as it was. Everytime wife and l go to the yardhouse we order the same things except minus one depends if we are really hungry or not...If you go to the yardhouse try those appetizers.
Good burger. Tasty and filing. Fries were good and onion rings were good too. Only complaints are the floor was sticky and the booths are too small.

good food, fun atmosphere and great selection.  Only downfall was our server, who was trying way too hard to be funny & connect with his customers to make sure he had a good tip.

would recommend to anyone passing through the Village to eat there.

Food was good.  Atmosphere was good.  No free refills on soda was really a turn off for me.  We paid a lot for pretty good food and I had to pay for refills.  May not come back just because of that.  It was just average experience.
Excellent food, great service! Ordered the pterdodactyl wings, pork chop and kids cheesy noodles.
Great Boise beer selection, been to yard houses in San Jose, Roseville and now meridian, this one is great

The food quality at this Carl's Jr does NOT live up to the other locations in the Treasure Valley. The food clearly was heated (and poorly) and not freshly cooked. The fries were cold and the buns were stale AND the condiments were sparse AND the Coke tasted watered down. I would highly rate Carl's Jr, just not this location.
Husband had the chili and said he liked it better than Wendy's. I had the hot Italian sub on wheat and it was flavorful. The place was very clean. Best of all its not Subway!
Not much to say here, good hot fresh doughnuts. The coffee could be better, not a fan of that but the main item there is the doughnuts so I shouldn't be shocked I guess.

This is already a favorite place for us because it's quick, delicious, reasonably priced, and pretty close to where we live. We have been 3 times since we found out about it a few weeks ago. I do wish they had a wedge salad on their menu, it would be perfect then! The pizza dough is really good and the unlimited toppings are AWESOME!!! One time I felt like I was at the soup kitchen on Seinfeld and the person helping us at the beginning of the line was kind of impatient, but the other times the staff was friendly.

I am in Meridian performing (I'm a comedian, not a stripper) at the Bull's Head Pub down the street from this restaurant. I walked over for lunch and was happy to see a decent salad bar. I HEART salad bars. And they have a soup bar which was really good. I got an all-you-can-eat salad/soup bar for only $5.99 and it came with these little yummy dough balls they called "scones". They were more like doughnuts served with honey butter and they were YUM!! 

My whole meal, with a soda, was under $9. For a Los Angeles girl, this is like a bargain basement super discount deal price. I was VERY happy with the food and prices. I didn't order "regular" food from the menu, and maybe it is unremarkable like the other reviews say. 

Now, the real poop: I'm only giving 3 stars because the service was pretty lame. I had to stand and wait a few minutes before the host came to seat me and the restaurant wasn't busy. I arrived after major lunch rush - around 1:30pm. My server seemed really blah and hating her job and could care less about earning a tip. She didn't smile, wasn't pleasant, etc. It took a long time for me to get my bill when I was done.  So that was lame. Overall, loved my lunch, didn't love the restaurant. 

I'm still going back for lunch today though because I don't have a car and it's convenient to my hotel.

Penny is head and shoulders above anyone I have ever been to. When I go to her for a facial, I don't have to say a thing, and she knows exactly what my skin needs and provides treatments, personally tailored and with excellence, down to the details. And if there is something in particular I am seeking, she engages fully. Her hands are angelic, her skill unrivalled, her manner professional, her personality delightful, and her care sincere.  I leave glowing.  To boot, she's also the ONLY ONE who can shape my rather healthy eyebrows just right!  A visit to Penny will do you much good, outside and in.

My husband and I come here at least every other week. We love it! You can't beat $7.25 for a decent size pizza with as many toppings as you want! This place is usually packed but the service is really fast. The pizza oven only takes 90 seconds. 
The pizza size is enough to fill you up and take some home for the next day. The spicy red sauce with lots of veggies and the pesto drizzle on top is my favorite combo. 
I definitely recommend trying Blaze out!
Went in with my wife and we both got pitas, we were both happy with our meals and the prices weren't bad at all, we will definitely go back, service was quick and the atmosphere was good!
Great drinks and really good food.  I wish a couple of the personalities rare little better...

Amazing!  My husband and I got a large to share and after add ons it was 18$. Pricing is a bit high but the quality is superb and we were both full. With a large, you can choose up to 5 types of fish, we added salmon, tuna, octopus, red snapper, and yellowtail. They were out of white tuna. You could also choose from tofu, chicken and a couple others. After that you choose sauces and add ons. We did roe, cilantro, avocado, and a few other items. 

Overall, I love this place and would definitely go again!

I went to Kahootz last night for dinner and a beer and really enjoyed it! They had a great beer menu with a ton of different beers from all over the west coast. We sat outside in their very cute patio area which you cannot see from the road. We ordered the top sirloin steak and the apple cider pork chop. The pork chop was delicious and the sauce that came with it was wonderful! The top sirloin was good but slightly over cooked but was tender and seasoned well. I added the house salad and it was very tasty and came with soy nuts on it. The service was awesome and our waitress was very nice. Overall, a great local spot to grab a beer and a good meal for a solid price.

Buffalo Wild Wings is a bit expensive but we love their Happy Hour.  Sometimes it's hard to beat "2-4-1" drinks.  The $4 Happy Hour appetizers aren't the greatest but they let you sample a variety of offerings for less than full price.

In the bar area (where Happy Hour takes place), Amanda (Blonde, says Amanda on the back of her BWW jersey) is amazing.  She's personable and just a pleasure to deal with.  The first time we had her as a server, I figured she was nice just to get a bigger tip but the next time we went in, she was again super friendly and felt exceptionally genuine.  I wish she'd be my server every time I go there.

The downside to BWW is it's always loud but more so in the bar.  You get the good with the bad I reckon.

Good food. Very fresh. I had the lettuce wrap burger with salad bar. It wasn't the most amazing thing in the world, but a great go to for anyone looking for a nice local spot to eat. Definitely would recommend.

The bar inside is nice and the drinks aren't too bad, but I would say you probably don't get the bang for your buck if you are paying regular prices. I would advise happy hour for sure. We got the steak and lobster (it was a special) and a salad bar. The salad bar is pretty great, typical salad bar with lettuce and fixings but it has chicken, shrimp and ham to add some protein to the salad. The dinner items were good. The lobster was pretty big and had plenty of meat in it, the steak was a little small but flavorful and tender. I would say the three star was for the amount of food we spent a pretty penny for the dinner and could have gotten a little more at other places. Worth a stop for dinner but you have better options all around the town.

I frequent the other location on Milwaukee and Fairview. I'm a huge fan of this place since I found it a couple of months ago. 

This location is larger and had a much better dining room area. Great for families. The crew is friendly and the area is clean. Had the Italian today which was great. The large was 12" with over a half pound of meat!  Very shareable for me and my wife. The sub was $8 so with drink and chips we ate for around $5 each. Not bad!!

I highly recommend this place. Easily the best sub around. Only warning would be they are busy between 12-1 so plan accordingly!!

$1.25 per wing?!!!  I love BWW traditional wings, however prices have skyrocketed at this location (and franchise-wide) in the past year.  On any day besides Tues, traditional wings are now running about $1.00-$1.25/per wing for orders of 5, 10, or 15 wings.  Tues .40 cent wing night went up to .70 wing night.  The only night it is worth going is Tuesday .70 wing night.  The service is generally pretty good at this location, although phoning in a carry out order when it's busy usually involves being put on hold for a long time.

Ordered beef and broccoli with additional spice...thought it was delicious. The spring roll wasn't great, but it was okay. Our waitress was very polite and friendly, and our food arrived quickly. I think the entrees were reasonably priced as well.

Kahootz is one of my favorite places in town. Been coming here for years! ... But had to post this evening in regards to the hamburger. The beer was great, the salad was wonderful, the service was fantastic as usual, but the hamburger tasted like frozen hockey puck food service garbage. Raise the price by a buck or two if you have to, but for the love of God use fresh ground beef for your burger. Hell, I wouldn't hold it against you if you called it over to Main Street and brought it in a bag, but do SOMETHING!

It was ok. I went for the hibachi and the chef was great! He was entertaining and friendly. The wait staff was not great even though they weren't that busy. The food was average, nothing to be excited about. I wasn't impressed and won't make an effort to go back.
Terrible food!  The service was good, but that doesn't make up for the poor quality of what was delivered.  Won't be going back, unless it's just for drinks.

Sorry, but if you want a donut there is no other but Krispy Kreme.  Get them when they are hot just made and ask for icw cold milk.   Yum.  Maybe it's because I am from Krispy Kreme Krountry in the south, but I am positive that Krispy Kreme donuts are going to be in Heaven when I get there.

I was extremely disappointed with their services.  They did not work efficiently or timely which resulted in them not fitting all my stuff which should have fit, then paying for them to take extra time.  They took their time and would wait for each other to walk back out to the truck or bring in loads so they could finish their conversation.  They went to the incorrect address after I specifically verified with them because I knew there can be confusion. They didn't fold blankets which took my mother and I another 25 minutes. They open two bags of blankets and only used half of each.  They didn't use the dolly which was SPECIFICALLY asked for when I hired their services. I also then had to pay for an additional moving van to move the remaining items, and my 62 year old mother doing most of the heavy lifting as I am still recovering from shoulder surgery which is why I hired movers in the first place.  No pleased, and will not be recommending to anyone I know.

The pizza is great...but I recommend you eat it at the restaurant rather than carry out.  The crust is really soft & porous so it gets soggy quickly.  We love the pepperoni sausage portobello pie.  I have been trying other offerings lately...kale salad - roasted chicken portobello sandwich - bistecca papardelle entree' ... all amazing.  It's so nice to have a great restaurant with atmosphere here in N. Meridian.  Way to go, Flatbread!

By far the greatest pizza ever! You get all the toppings you want for one price. The ingredients are fresh and lots of choices for everyone. The employees are fast and happy! This is a great franchise. I will watch for it wherever we go.

Loved this place. So much variety, food is fast, delicious, and fresh! I was a first timer, and they explained everything very well. Restaurant was clean, and employees were helpful and friendly. We will definitely be back! Very delicious food, and excellent service! 
If I had one complaint, it would be that the crushed garlic on my pizza was all in one location, which made for a pretty distasteful bite, so they could maybe do a better job at spreading toppings evenly. But again, that is a VERY MINOR complaint and I truly LOVED this place, we will definitely be back!!

Their fish and chips are delicious - No wonder it's listed under favorites.  Their jalapeno tater is excellent and not so hot that it loses the flavor. They also offer malt vinegar,  which is a big plus in my book.
I have eaten at a few different Blaze locations and they always provide the same great service and product. I would certainly recommend them for someone looking for a good pizza for lunch.

This is just another chain resto bar dumbed down to serve the masses. Some of the food was actually fairly good while some was mediocre and delivered tepid.  The service was good overall, but again its a generic chain surrounded by traffic.

Decent craft beer selection is the only reason it's even worth  one star.  

From the front door opening up RIGHT onto a table where you have to be careful not to bang into chairs, to the 20 minute wait for water and menus in a half empty resteraunt, to the cold fries once the food arrived, to the slow and poor service, we will NOT be returning.

We had to ask for silverware and napkins after we finally got our food, then got extra while a table near us still didn't have any.  Someone else had to take menus from a table where a couple got up and left after sitting there for 10 minutes with no one even stopping by their table.  It wasn't like they were just short staffed either, there were 5 people walking around not really doing anything most of the time.

My jalapeño burger had 4 or 5 little sliced bar peppers on it but was at least warm if slightly more done than I prefer, but my wife's sandwich was cold chicken and cold fries and had.obviously been sitting for a while.

Lots of TVs but pro bowling,  2 different senior golf channels  (one looked like a classic), some espn interview show (without even closed caption) and the harlem globetrotters of all things.  They might have just as well have been turned off. There was one little TV in the bar with college basketball. 

All in all, avoid at all costs for now and see if they stay open for a while to figure out how to operate a decent place.

This place is awesome! Not only was the veggie pizza (with vegan cheese) delicious, but I had actually ordered it wrong on the website and they completely saved the day! While ordering, I didn't select to remove the regular cheese but only to add vegan cheese. They verified with me that I only wanted vegan cheese and not both (thank you!)
I'm so happy to have a yummy vegan pizza option near by

I like the med salad with dressing on the side. Service is always great and they won't take tips. It is great for kids who like the soda machine, a great way to end or start a target shopping trip in Boise.
Great food matched with great service,very friendly staff and budget friendly food specials,the 10.99 steak dinner on wed is a true value,get there early cause this place gets busy...

My husband and I were gifted an evening out with childcare for our 4 young kids. Because we were kid-free, we picked a place we had wanted to try but never wanted to bother taking kids to.

We came on a Saturday evening and were seated at their last indoors table. It's fairly small inside the restaurant but not uncomfortable. We were seated quickly, it was super clean and the wait staff was very quick and friendly. My husband picked out a beer (they have an excellent HUGE selection of beers on tap) and we went ahead and ordered the special - prime rib dinner.

The wait wasn't long and the food did not disappoint. We splurged and got the 16 ounce cuts which we absolutely would do again. Go big or go home!!

Cooked perfectly, priced well for what you're getting but don't expect to enjoy a cheap date here. In our opinion, the food and experience are worth what you pay.

Highly recommend for a date night, special dinner or a place to bring your in-laws or out of town guests. Plan to try some beers and do better than we did - budget for an appetizer or two!! We didn't try them but saw a couple and they looked amazing!!

We will go again, for sure.
Very popular, usually pretty crowded. I love the pizza the little too much but man they make it quick. I think they need either a bigger dining room or a secondary location.
The food was great! We had delay in getting our food for some reason but the manager took it off our bill, so great customer service!

Great food and some of the BEST customer service we have received in a long time. Definitely best service we've had since moving to Meridian from Texas about 2 months ago. We tried a variety of items (steak fingers, burgers, onion rings, tots and a shake). NOTHING to complain about. Only suggestion that would send this place over the top...hand cut fries. Can't wait to go back!!!

The only reason I'm not giving 5 stars is because typically this place has long wait times to get a table during core dinner hours.  The person that grills the steaks really understands what medium is and doesn't overcook the meat.  Flavor is outstanding.  Prices are reasonable.  Rolls are excellent.   Portions are quite large.

If you are looking for a quick pizza then this is the place. I love the fast food spin at Blaze. You can choose from the regular menu or build your own. Awesome selection and so affordable it's crazy!! The crust is amazing with the crispy edges from the fire. One pizza fed two of us for lunch. If you are really hungry I suggest each person getting their own. Great place, friendly service and super fast. Highly recommend.

Fantastic! Everyone in my family loves pizza but me... It's the sauce, blech. However, here I can order a fantastic alternative, and my family can get their pizza fix. All of the toppings are yummy, I even make each side different from one another. They have little boxes available for your leftovers right there by the drink machine. The pop variety is nice and assorted other beverages too. We have been there twice now, and the eating area is always clean, and the workers are helpful and nice. We preferred to make our own instead of the choices they suggest, and got just what we liked. Try it, you can have fresh pizza and a pop for under $10.
Every time I come to town I stop here at least once. Good food and they know how to make a good martini!

I like this place.  Very clean, nice ambiance and good prices for what you get.  Unlimited soup and salad bar (Thai Chicken soup, soooo good) and unlimited Mongolian grill.  I know there are so many other varieties I haven't tried yet but I am very well pleased with the quality and freshness of their food.  Everyone in there is so nice and helpful and I have been there over 10 times and it is consistent and great every time.  I was trying to come up with something negative to say but I have to say it's difficult.  The only thing I can say is it gets kind of loud in there as all the cooks are around the grill and the grunting when a new plate gets put on the grill along with the sound of their metal tools.  Other then that, it is hard to find something negative about this place.

Good service but it was at 2 on a Thursday.  We seated ourselves as instructed by the signs.  Zack took care of us well enough.  We had the wings.  The sweet Chile wings were good the hot were soggy and nothing special.  

I ordered a build your own burger however the ingredients were not fresh and has none of the great taste of grilled onions or mushrooms.  

Now for the worst offence.  The ceaser salad was dripping wet... With some kind of bacon bit ceaser dressing???  It was super heavy and nasty.  The lettuce had no crunch and reminded me of The lettuce in a 2 day old roach coach sandwich. 

We will not be back

Great food!  The first time we dined here it was excellent. The service was excellent and the food was too. We were excited to return. Unfortunately the second time we were a bit disappointed. It was largely to do with our server.  I asked for coffee and she told me they were out. No big deal. I walked next door, bought a cup from a neighboring business and brought it back. Then when asked what kind of fish they use in the fish tacos it was described as a "hodgepodge of a bunch of different white fish all thrown together".  That didn't sound appealing. I found myself envious of all the other customers who appeared to have attentive servers.  To our luck a different person brought out our food who was very nice. The evening continued to get better as the food was absolutely delicious. We will most likely return and strategically find out who our server will be before we sit down to order.

I have never had that much of a pleasurable experience with s drive through person! He was nice, commented on my lanyard, and gave my dog a cookie. Not to mention the food was prime and I could not have asked for more. For the love of all that is holy, give that man a raise
Probably the best burger place in Meridian. Great customer service and delicious good.

I've been to the Yard House before in other states and I'm more likely to go there than to the location nearest me. 

We went to dinner on Wednesday night and the restaurant wasn't that busy. With that being said, our food took much longer than expected to come out. The manager (Vince) was nice enough to apologize and comped us desserts. We also asked the waitress for glasses of water 3 times and those never materialized. The service was subpar to say the least. 

Next time I want a beer and burger, I'll head somewhere else.

What can I say.  I you like DIY projects the odds are this place has your fix.  Everything from fake flowers of every type, holiday decorations, paints, home furnishing, to a frame shop.  Place is staked with stuff for any hobby.
The food here is very good. I love their steak specials--such a great deal and it tastes delicious!

We've gone here a couple times looking for fresh food, usually disappointed but not completely discouraged. Our last visit this past weekend was the last time. 

The customer service here is always sub-par, they really seem to hate their jobs. I can get over this though since it's a quick order and we're on our way, although I don't particularly trust their attention to food safety/quality. What really got us this last time were THE FLIES. Oh boy! I didn't notice them at first, we ordered our pitas and went to the other side to give one of the girls our order...like other reviews they resembled something along the lines of zombies...dragging their feet, low energy, no smiles, mono-toned. Anyway they walked away to find the Avocado that I had ordered, one fly landed on my opened pita that was sitting on the counter waiting for Avocado. It irked me a little but I said suck it up, it's Fall in Boise, there are flies, then I saw a second and really started to get upset, I mentioned it to my husband and while saying this looked around the establishment and literally there were 40 flies all over the tables, chairs, my eyes started wandering onto the food as I cringed... Flies on the food. Wanted to vomit. When the girls came back my husband demanded new pitas for us due to the flies, the girls looked at us like 'really....' and threw out the pitas and grabbed new ones. We picked out the items that looked to the eye fresh, left out the other items we'd normally order but looked gross (tomatoes, pickles). After we got home, we both took a few bites and were grossed out so we threw them away. Waste of $22.

I find it despicable that the shop owner would allow such unsanitary conditions for paying patrons. A couple flies? sure it happens but anything over that is disgusting and I counted at least 40 while we waited for Avocado. I would highly recommend you do NOT come to this Pita Pit!
I love this restaurant especially the pizza and appetizers despite the long wait time. I highly recommend this restaurant for lunch, dinner or happy hours.

Dining at Jaker's Bar & Grill is always a great experience. They have a wonderful lunch menu that includes salads, pasta, burgers and a variety of sandwiches. The dinner menu offers a variety of appetizers, steaks, fish and chicken entrees. The salad bar has a wonderful selection of salads and fresh fruits.  The fresh scones and honey butter are a great way to start off your lunch or dinner.

I have personally enjoyed a variety of the menu options at both lunch and dinner. My personal favorites for lunch are the sirloin burgers or the BLT sandwich with avocado. For dinner I recommend the prime rib, which is always a treat. The Chicken a la Jaker's is another great option that features a breaded chicken breast topped with bearnaise sauce, crab meat and asparagus spears served atop a bed of linguini noodles.  

The restaurant has an intimate atmosphere. The staff members are friendly, helpful and knowledgeable about menu options and can offer great suggestions. The restaurant is conveniently located in Meridian right off Eagle Road between Fairview Avenue and Franklin.

We love the Pita Pit but this was the worst one we've ever been to. We stopped in this location on Saturday evening after a long day on the road. The women's bathroom smelled horrible and had no toilet paper. There was no place in ether bathroom to change a baby. The staff gipped us on meat, only four small slices for the gyro and then counted two pickles and two shakes of Parmesan as "toppings" for the 3-topping 'Lil Hummus pita that we ordered for our 7-year old. Finally, the the avocado and hummus were .95 extra each for my gyro, but they only put on about 3 cents of each.

I frequent Yardhouse in Vegas often (where I am from) for many reasons and their happy hour ka definitely one of them. 

I was visiting town and my friend suggested Yardhouse and I happily agreed. This Yardhouse was located at the Village shopping center and was pretty easy to get parking! Maybe I came on a less busier night? I heard it can get pretty busy sometimes. 

We were seated immediately and greeted by our server who provided us with the menus and showed us the happy hour options, before we even asked! 

We decidided on the Poke Nachos, BBQ Chicken Pizza and Chicken Tenders with buffalo sauce on the side. As usual, everything was amazing--especially the Poke Nachos! There was actually a lot of tuna on the plate so I was very pleased with that. Overall, Yardhouse is always a good choice and definitely one of my favorite places to go to for Happy Hour!

I may be just a huge BWW, but I loved this location. I was in town for work and went here almost every night because it was across from my hotel and I don't have a BWW near me. Mikey, the bartender, was awesome. And all the other staff was great as well. I also had another bartender, on a different night, I can't remember her name, but she was great as well. As for the people complaining about the prices, you will pay that much for wings from dominoes, papa johns, wing street, etc. it's just the cost of goods now for them, so get over it. The desert heat and the Thai (like a spicy peanut sauce) wings are phenomenal for anyone complaining about flavorless wings.

I have always loved this place.  Tonight we went there for dinner. I had my favorite,  the rib eye steak. It was paper thin and no flavor. My wife had the sirloin and it was very good. Sorry Texas Roadhouse, I need a good steak. Will be some time before I try you again.
I took my niece here for her 9th birthday and they were so sweet bringing her cake and singing her happy birthday. Plus they gave her some chopsticks tied together so she could use them.

Went with some friends before a movie.  My second time, their first....all of us agree it will be our last.  Took 20 minutes to get our first set of drinks.  We had calamari for appetizers.  There was a fishbone in the calamari which is odd unless they are using fish and calling it calamari.  The plates brought to share the appetizer had a chunk of fried food on it....not a small chunk.    At that point the bone and the dirty plates diminished our appetites but we had an hour to kill so we ordered.  The truffle burger and truffle fries were amazing.....the only reason I would recommend this place is to sit at the bar and order truffle fries....that is it.

SO NOISY. Go here for the beer and appetizers but forget the food. The food is not up to par. Every time I think I'll take a chance and try the food, I'm disappointed. At our last visit we had a party of eight, only two people really enjoyed their meal. I ordered the halibut. NO flavor on the fish, and the rest completely drenched in gravy. It was like eating a bowl of gravy with a bland sponge on top. Did I mention the noise? We literally had to yell at the waitress so she could hear our order and forget having a conversation with someone at the other end of the booth. Hang with the buddies for the beer but don't take the in-laws for a family dinner.

Love this place, it's very close to work and perfect for a quick drink during happy hour. 
Staff is great and the crowd always has a great energy. 
Very good food, haven't had anything there I didn't like.
Great food, great atmosphere. Will definitely go back! Good sized portions, burger cooked perfectly and tasted great. And having Pepsi products is a plus!

Went here to try a new place. Was ok. Noodles good, sushi so-so. Service good. But as it's a sushi place, they should have good fish. The yellowtail was very good, but the salmon and tuna were not very good. The rolls were ok, but not very interesting or diverse.  There seemed to be a good amount of business, so that's good for them, but as my spouse said, I'd hope someone's first sushi experience would be with really good fish so they wouldn't dismiss the whole style out of hand.
The food was delicious, the service sucked.  Took forever to get a refill on some beverages. Had the french dip and cheeseburger
Ya can NEVER go wrong at Hobby Lobby! I love this place & the Meridian store is really nice! So happy they have one in this area :)

The staff at Primary Health Medical Group were awesome.  Ann, Aaron and Shannon took great care of me while I was out of town on business.  I had a ear that had been hurting and the hooked me up and I should be good to go.

I recommend them to anyone in Boise, but especially to anyone traveling on business to the area that has any issues.

The Boise location is significantly better.  The food was great, but the service was terrible.  We sat at the bar, and were stuck to the waitress service station at the bar, which meant we had to listen to the wait staff complain and gossip the entire meal.  There was a bartender names Travis or Trevor that was just awful.  He was arrogant and rude and pretty much ruined the entire experience.

My daughter and I went in to have lunch today with my 18month old twin grandchildren. The twins were especially messy and not very well behaved. You know how babies can be like time bombs, well they went off today. Lunch was not relaxing, needless to say; however, the server and the manager made it almost manageable. My hats to all the people that work there because no one made us feel like they wanted us to leave.  We did eat as fast as we could (great food), and left.

To say this place is good is an understatement!

I sat down with a fresh ROOT BEER in a 23oz frosty mug!
I started with Pterodactyl Wings with homemade sauce and was blown away at the tenderness of the baked wings and the sauce... oh my

a book could be written about it. Not to hot not to spicy, just right!

I followed the 5 wings (true wings wing and drum connected in one)

with the "Mutha of all" Reubens!

Fresh corned beef, sauerkraut and homemade 1000 island dressing.

Wow!!!

Now I am not a beer drinker but they had 25 or so on tap.

Next time I am in the area I will be visiting again!

Wow!  We have eaten here 3 times and we try something new each time.  The Grilled Chicken Avocado, Roasted Turkey Melt, and New York Steak Sandwich are the best.  In case you haven't noticed we are going down the menu on their sandwiches.  This is our new best American restaurant in the Treasure Valley.

This is a must place to eat!  This place will not let you down.  The bench seating is very comfortable and their are sports games playing on all channels.  You will have a wow moment with your first bite...

Okay, we cheated with the Appetizer Sliders...  YUM! YUM!

Worst pizza I have ever had. I'm from italy and maybe my judgment is correct, but pizza is an art and when you cut corners all you get is a round disk of oily mess that resembles a pizza but in reality tastes like and flavorless blend piece of cardboard. Save your money and go eat somewhere else.
Did not like their food. Way overpriced and rude staff. Burger had very little flavor and the bun wasn't good.

Quality of food does not match the ambience. The menu font is more appealing than the greasy burger I ate. Skyla the bartender was eating candy when she took my order on a napkin, then neglected to refill my beer or acknowledge my presence for the rest of the meal. Finally I got a beer, but it was after the printed ticket, so I added a star for the free beer. Bar is full of dirty dishes, meanwhile skyla is texting. She should be demoted to dishwasher.

This little gem of a joint is a real find for the burger aficionado.   The meat is fresh and very tasty.  The portions are generous. The restaurant is clean and well maintained.  The price?  Extremely reasonable for the quality of food.  The burger buns are fresh daily and delicious. I had the double bacon burger  w/Swiss cheese and it was outstanding!  You can go somewhere else and pay way more for a lot less of a delicious burger.  Main Street Burger ranks right up there with the big boys (Highlands Hollow, Westside Drive In and Big Judds). I'll be going back soon.

I really had expected to give a better review but based on our experience this week, sadly I can't. Went with the family for a casual dinner the other night and the place was hopping for sure. Things started out ok with cold beers and root beer. Ordered the nachos with chicken and they were fine nachos...nothing terribly exciting but passable. When all of our food came though, everything was barely warm. Usually kids mini corn dogs are like lava hot but these could be eaten right away. Fries were at the same room temperature temperature. Maybe it was just an off order or whatever, but it certainly didn't make me want to rush back anytime soon!

Really?  You had one job to do- take the pizza out of the oven, CUT IT, and yell my name.   And yet, I had to rip the pizza into individual slices because it wasn't cut, and of the six pieces, ONE piece represented a THIRD of the pizza.    Take some pride, do your job. If you are cutting pizzas, CUT the pizzas.   (How often do you attempt to drive home after work, and MISS the destination?!?)  Same thing.   Do your job !!

I liked Blaze Pizza.  A single topping Pepperoni is AWESOME.  And yet, having to endure poor parking, LOUD music, and incompetent line cooks/servers who don't pay attention to detail, is disappointing.  Hello management !  Are you listening?  Attention to detail MATTERS !!

What is up with the "one-size-fits-all" 12 oz fountain drink?  I want to soak my face in at least 32oz of soda while I'm ingesting carbs and fat.   Not everyone appreciates a spill-proof kid-friendly sippy cup.  Offer some larger cups !

I'll be back, but cut/slice your toppings into smaller/thinner slices, and your pizzas will be SO MUCH BETTER.  Otherwise, I can always heat up some Tony's frozen, and avoid the drive to Meridifornia.

I have taken both my vehicles to Einstein's in Meridian since reading reviews on them, and I agree. They are way more efficient & thorough than any other service company I have been to over the last 30 + years! Their prices are very competitive, service is excellent and professional. I like that the guys are yelling out what is being done AND verifying it.......sometimes with some humor thrown in. During my last visit they even pointed out that my license plates were expired. Great job guys!!

The salon is really clean and nice, but the pedicure was pretty awful. The woman might've been new and inexperienced, but she messed up several times, the polish was uneven and lumpy, and when I was finished, I was told "Cash Only." (They have an ATM, which of course charges a fee, but no obvious signage that they are Cash Only.) I was not happy at all with my pedi, and won't be returning, unfortunately.

A Great Place to Unleash the Fun! 

The Storey Bark Park is a fully-fenced 2.25 acre dog park located in Meridian, Idaho, at 430 W. Watertower Lane. 

It features a safe leashing/unleashing area, separate large and small dog areas, shade shelters, a restroom building, water fountains, agility playthings, paved pathways, a variety of ground covers, benches and picnic tables, bike racks, fire hydrants, dog-themed street signs, fire hydrants, ample parking and more! 

Storey Bark Park, a project of the Meridian Parks and Recreation Department, is open daily from sunrise to sunset. Admission is free.  (Opening Date: August 12, 2015)

This place has quickly become one of my favorites. Their menu is incredibly diverse. I've had everything from salads to pizza to burgers to steaks, and it's been excellent every time. Their happy hour menu is great and convenient, and their drinks are always delicious. They have both indoor and outdoor seating, which makes for a great atmosphere for any occasion. The bar is HUGE, and a great place to go when waiting for a table. The servers are always friendly and attentive... And did I mention the food? 

They are a little pricey, but the quality is worth the price. The price is very comparable to other restaurants in the village, but in my opinion the atmosphere and food is so much better.

Kahootz is the top restaurant in meridian for sure.  You just need to be there on the right night or time.  Best times are during the week with great wait staff on Tuesday and Thursday nights.  Great meal for the price. The pork chops are always solid as are the steaks.  Beer selection is top notch with northwest micros.

I have been wanting to try Firehouse Subs for quite a while now and just got the opportunity this week.  Very impressed with their efficiency, the accuracy of our order, the table service in a somewhat fast food restaurant and the quality of the food.  We will certainly return whenever we are in the area.  Thank you Firehouse organization for all you do for the community as well!!

Went here last Friday for dinner with friends.  Food is sub par.  Do not order the steak and lobster for their special for the month of February!  Total Joke!  The best thing about this place is their darn rolls they serve.  Those were pretty good I'd have to admit.  Service was also good and they were really busy.

I have been to the Yard House on a couple occasions and this time it was just so so.  I ordered the Baja Fish Taco (crispy white fish with lemon sriracha aioli, green cabbage, cilantro, pico de gallo and guacamole) this time it lacked the flavor it has had in the past.  

Next time I will try a different entrée and see if my three stars will improve.

Well, this is a tough one, a $17 burger, delivered. It was al a carte, just burger, bun, and flavor. I paid extra for a caesar salad and truffle fries. Everything arrived lukewarm or cold, I was surprised a burger of this value was totally unaccompanied . It was good, well cooked and very flavorful. The truffle and garlic fries were great also, my wife had the lobster noodles and loved them and the clam chowder. While the food was good it was also very expensive, like Chandler steakhouse expensive. $70. For a burger fries soup, salad and noodles, seemed like a lot but we thought we would give it a try thinking it would be amazing. I would place the value at $ 40 max and would have appreciated more extras and more care in the delivery package. Some of us are handicapped and as much as we would like to experience dining out it just can't be accomplished. So we order delivery. Some restaurants take it very seriously others act like its a hassle. I would put this establishment in the not to excited about take out or delivery. I think they reign in their pricing and plate like were there it would be a great option for us delivery foodies. It just doesn't cost much to slice up some tomatoes, onions, pickles etc... to throw in the container. I will probably try again and hope the take take out more seriously in the future...

Usually like this place. It can be a little pricey for what it is but it's tasty. Today I got off work late, went in at 9 (they close at 10), got my food to go and after I got home, I opened up my order of BBQ Pork Mac and it had no cheese! It was just pork on top of cooked macaroni noodles. They also specifically asked if I want jalapeños which I love and then didn't put them on. I'm sure if I had been there, they would have fixed it but they were closed by the time I got home. It is so frustrating to get home with food after a long day and it not be correct. I'll be wary of my food from there from now on for sure. It definitely makes me not want to return because of the frustration. I've worked plenty in the food industry and know mistakes happen, but it's clear employees aren't paying attention when your order is that messed up. I'll likely take my money elsewhere from now on due to the bad taste in my mouth from cheese free noodles and a bad restaurant experience.

My first time here tonight, in this location in The Village celebrating my friends birthday (I've been to Matador downtown) I like that this is located just beside the parking lot, you can spot it easily & no need to do a lot of drive to find it or walk far. I actually like the look outside & it does look great inside as well. 

Chips, salsa & guacamole were already served when I got there, they're filling if you don't watch how much you've eaten. They were good! 

I ordered the street tacos but it seems bland to me. Not so much taste, it was just okay. My friend let me try her food though, the steak & shrimp with rice & it was yummy -- highly recommend. I like Mexican food but not so much & I usually order something with rice & seafood so maybe I will just order those kind of stuff next time. 

Our attendant was on point, attentive & made sure we are served well eventhough he was just a trainee! He did great! I'll probably come again & try some other food aside from the street tacos.

My Husband and I just moved to Idaho and the yard house was the first place we went to dinner. We went on a Wednesday night at 7:30.. there was no wait and we got seated at a patio table right away. The surrounding area with the waterfall in front of the restaurant made it really nice! 

To drink I got the Caribbean breeze which was delicious, and my husband tried several different beers, and they have a huge selection so that was a plus for him!

For dinner I got the Poke Bowl, and my husband got the Pork Burger. My dinner was very fresh, there was surprisingly a lot of tuna on my dish, and it was a huge portion.. very filling! 

The staff and service was great too.. we were checked on more often than I can remember being checked on at any restaurant! Bryanna E was our waitress and she was so great and attentive. She came by and told us to pick a free dessert since our food was taking longer than normal (and it was a day before my husbands birthday).. which we didn't even notice!! The manager came by and told us he was waiving two of our drinks off the bill as well due to this.. our dining experience took less than an hour, and we were just enjoying the scenery, so we weren't even concerned with the wait even though it wasn't long! 

Altogether the food was great, the location is beautiful, the service and gesture we got for our "wait" was just the cherry on top.. and the food is a great value! Definitely made us returning customers :)
