I always love a good Ribeye. I will have to say if you want a good ribeye this is not your place. A good sirloin yes. I had went to longhorn and then here a few days later and ordered a ribeye and was so disappointed.  Half of my ribeye was fat. My daughter however had a sirloin that was amazing. This place is also awesome for their rolls and their amazing house salad. But be prepared for a long wait to get in unless you show up right at 4 pm on a a weekday.
I wanted to write a review about the service me and my husband received here at chiles! Our servers name was Marleigh and she provides EXCELLENT service! Would go back for the service!

Pros: BWW has a plethora of tvs, so if you're there to watch a game, prepare to watch multiple games at once which is great!  Staff is also pretty friendly (usually).

Cons: Food is average at best and overpriced.  Beer is ridiculously overpriced also.

The food was amazing, so they get 5 stars for the food!!!
We came for the Mother$$$ Day Brunch, very disappointed, the buffet was 90% seafood. The only non seafood items where Prime Rib (amazing), potatoes au gratin (good), & salad bar (fair). 
Lot's of seafood my wife loved.
Service was poor and lay out of buffet was very bad, no flow, people bumping into to each other.

Bottom line great food just wish I would have come on a different day.

Were the carpets cleaned? Yes. 

How was the service? Nice people but still learning how to run a business. The communication and scheduling was not good. Had called and left a message with no return call. Called again and was able to talk to Jonathan. He scheduled me for a Saturday between 9-10. Took my first name only. Saturday morning I called to confirm the time as I had moved to a new home and would need to meet him at the home that needed servicing. Was told between 12-1 now! He said he was on his way to another job and would call me when done so he could come to my home next. Fine. Mistakes happen.  That was around 8:15. 10:30 rolls around and I call to check on status. No answer. Calls back at 10:40 and tells me he will meet me at the house. We confirm the address. 11:20 and no one is at my house. Get a call from Jonathan and he's at another house with a person who has the same first name as me!  He got confused, said someone else rescheduled this and basically saw there were two people with the same name and assumed I was the same person! Needless to say I was over there business. I cancelled the job. In tears and frustrated I left. Then Jonathan sends me text, is very sorry for the mix up and wants to make it right. I get someone to come later that afternoon to let him in as I had made prior plans to be out of town for the day which I had already been putting off due to the scheduling mistake. I send him a text to confirm what he quoted and the services and the address. Also requested an invoice be left as I need to show proof to my landlord that it was complete. I seriously don't think I should have been charged the full price at that point  but I paid right away through PayPal once I received the text to pay. Next day, Carpets are cleaned. No invoice! 

I called, texted, messaged on FB, and wrote on their FB page to get a response. I'm frustrated and wanted a reply ASAP. Finally got one and their response was apologetic but the main concern in their part was how did the carpets look?!! Well, yes clean but I would never do service or make recommendations to a company that has communication issues no matter how well they did the job I paid for.  Would you?

Pita Pit is a great change of pace from typical fast food, burgers or sandwiches.  We hadn't been there in quite a while, and decided we needed to try it again.  Tonight my wife had the Chicken Souvlaki, and I had the Buffalo Chicken.  The Tzatziki Sauce was pretty good, and was very interesting combined with the Buffalo sauce flavor.  So when you feel like something a little different, Pita Pit is a great choice.

[ I made a belt out of watches once...  ...It was a complete waist of time. ]

edit: after posting my review it got the owners attention and they did come and fix the dish network... i will change the stars based off the fact it is working and fixed now.. but i still feel like people deserve to know what happened in the first place... 



my family have all went with these people and everyone of us had problems... they left before our dish was set up... turns out they left us faulty equipment... my grandparents and brother stopped using them but my parents decided to give them the benifit of the doubt and try them again, we'll the dish didn't work for over 10 days before we got there attention via yelp, we are locked in a 2 year contract didn't get what we were promised....they also never answer texts or calls... until they saw our yelp.. i'd say look into your options and make your own choice. 


not just once did this happen but twice.. and not just to us but to other people... i don't think it's just me who gets a bad feeling. but do your research and make your own choice.

Extremely impressed with the environment and interior design once I step through the door. Being in a strip mall you never know what your getting sometimes but this placed impressed. I was immediately greeted at the order bar. All the fish and add ons looked fresh and yummy. I got a medium bowl with sushi rice with salmon, tuna, and tako.  They had what looked like every ingredient and sauce you could ask for to make the perfect bowl. Mine was outstanding and I'll be back.
Poke bowl was very yummy as well as the sushi. It taste very fresh and healthy. Great choice for good food

Service was good, food was not this was first visit I will not return I was very disappointed with the quality of the food flatbread pizza it was totally raw the crust was very soggy. Totally not edible. GLEN B

If you like a variety of beers this is your spot! Lots of seating, patio area is always fun in the summer. Wait staff and food has always been good. They serve an excellent moscow mule. We keep coming back for more. Enjoy, you won't be disappointed.

I've never had a bad meal or dining experience at Kahootz.  Everything is made with fresh, quality ingredients and the service has always been excellent. While their menu is limited, everything is done well.  Wish they had a few more menu items, or rotated in a few more options, especially in the $9-12 price range. Overall a good place to dine.

I can't say enough about this restaurant. Great service great food. The Halibut is amazing and so is Ahi. Might be a little on the expensive side but well worth it. My daughter also loves the hamburgers she says they're the bomb.

I used to really like this place. You will see that in my past reviews. But like so many places, they are evolved into something I just cant recommend anymore. My main stay here was the Wisconsin Cheese Steak sandwich. 

The sandwich was hot, very flavorful and just plain good. One of the best sandwiches around. All it needed was to be bigger and it would have been a hit.

But alas, Noodles has decided to drop their entire sandwich line up. Now they are doing more with Mac and Cheese (I saw 3 different ones where I was here) and they have their soups.

I had the Pad Thai this time. This has changed as well. Gone was the good flavorful broth this dish used to have. On this occasion, it was just noodles. Gone was that wonderful Thai spice that I had loved before. 

What I tasted was Fish. What Fish has to do with Pad Thai I am not sure, but this is all I tasted. I left the dish sitting there. I am not sure we will try this place again. 

What I think is happening to all these places in and near the Village Mall is that they are suffering from the closeness of the competition. Usually competition is a good thing. What is supposed to happen is that competition causes places to keep their prices down and drive up quality.

The problem though is that the area in and around the Village is over saturated with food businesses. The market simply cannot sustain them all. 

It is having just the opposite effect of what it should. Instead of driving up quality, its driving it down. In order for these restaurants to compete and keep their doors open, they are having to hire the cheapest labor they can and buy the cheapest ingredients.

So what is happening is that when a new one opens up, everyone flocks there. Due to the restaurants huge intake in revenue, they think they are doing really well and will continue to do so. The restaurant given this false since of success, hires more employees, puts new items on its menu and does other upgrades. They even think about expanding and building new locations. 

Then when the next new restaurant around the corner, or next door, every goes there. Its the thing that happens with new kid on the block. Everyone loves the new kid and he is very popular until the next new kid comes along. 

When the next new restaurant opens up, all of the sudden business falls off dramatically at the old (new) restaurant. They are forced to fire employees that were experienced, and making too much. They hire new cheaper less experienced labor that is forced to make due with substandard ingredients. Business then takes a nose dive and before you know it, no more business. 

This is actually a pretty common scenario with food related businesses, which is why they have the highest failure rate of any business. But I think this process is going to be magnified here in Meridian. 

It is going to be very interesting to watch what happens in the next several months here in this area around the Village Mall. I think what we are going to see is several of these places failing. 

But this might actually be a good thing. Once the heard is thinned out, the ones that survive should be stronger, better and hopeful have good quality food and decent prices. We will all just have to sit back and wait and see.

My boyfriend and I went here as a quick dinner before our movie! As a server, I always find myself paying the most attention to the waiter/waitress and ours was amazing. Thank you Brian! He made us feel very at home and personable, would love to be back and have him as a server again.

My favorite drive thru burger joint!  Yes you have to wait but it's worth it.  The tots are always super hot and the fry sauce is cold.  I go with the cheeseburger and tots every time and I have yet to be disappointed.

Good gas prices. Awesome car wash. The best convenient store! They have everything! The food is the best "gas station food". Doesn't feel like a fuel station when you walk in. Easily located in the corner. The staff is friendly and keep things clean and very well stocked.

We ordered in advance and food still took 1/2 hour.  But food was pretty good.  We came in a group of 11.  Service staff were nice and kept the waters coming.  I would come again but would wear a sweater.
Super yummy! We got chicken chow mein, salt and pepper shrimp, ginger chicken, and beef broccoli.  All very tasty.
We were starving for a steak and found Kahootz on Yelp.  A local neighborhood feel and super friendly waitstaff.  Had a great steak and beer. Will be back!
Our waitress was so awesome today. She was lively and her personality was infectious. I think her name was Lacy. We will definitely come back in the future!
Sports bar with great atmosphere and dining. . Different speical for each occassion.  Food portions are huge and moderately priced. Wait staff gracious and fun. Get there early for a table!

This is a passable restaurant where you can go sit down for lunch.  I like Chicago pizza and appreciate what this place is doing to try and bring it to Idaho, its just not working very well.

The pizza was a plain deep dish pie that was good while I was there but very forgettable.

The food isn't too bad but the service it terrible. Plan to wait for just OK food. My kids love the place but the service is always a disappointment. I just wish they were more attentive to customers.
Friendly little joint.   Nice outdoor covered patio. Service was a bit slow but the food was excellent.  Nice rotating tap beer selection.

AvA has been to many Dog Parks in several states. This is one of her favorite. Lots of friendly and active dogs. Plenty of cool people to meet and mingle with. 

Good grass and pea gravel surfaces. Very little mud and plenty of room to Run.

I've been to the Utah one so now that we are living here I thought we would try out the local "Texas Roadhouse" in good 'ol Boise.

I had the 16oz Prime Rib Rare,  wife had a 10oz rib-eye.  Both were exceptional, I thought her rib eye was a little under seasoned but she thought it was perfect and I devoured my prime rib not wanting to share even a bite with the wify (but she still managed to snag one or two!)

Service was great, our waiter Jonathan was straight off the Boise Farm and couldn't have been presented as more country.  We're country folk but big city livers (until we just moved to Boise) so we really enjoyed the atmosphere here.  

Prices were reasonable for portion / quality and we will be back again!  I give them an over all B+.  Wait times were a little lengthy and it was really crowded but that has to tell you something!

.I just don't get the "fast fired" angle here. So they can cook a cracker-thin pizza crust in about three minutes. Big deal. And the fire angle. Really? Yeah there is a gas flame in the back of the oven, as seen through the opening/entry. But so far as I can see the pizza sat on a regular steel plate surface. It doesn't matter to me how they heat the oven - charcoal fired, gas fired, lava fired, or infrared fired. My pizza didn't have any special flavor imparted to it by means of the oven.
.I do like the custom assembly line method of preparation. I do not like exposed toppings, sitting on a bed of skimpy cheese. My pizza was cooled to room temperature within 8 minutes of delivery, and I tried to eat it while it was still warm. Lots of interesting combos to chose from. Not a bad flavor. Yet I enjoyed the chocolate chunk cookie more than the pizza.
.Solid bare comfortable attractive wooden tables. Collect your napkins at dispensers over the garbage barrels. Loud pop hipster music. "There is no wrong way" - their gift cards proclaim. Perhaps that's true with pizza. Different strokes...
.I'll be stroking elsewhere.

I actually think the food is really good.  However, I won't be going back because of how the staff treated the food during preparation.  One of the cooks was sweating while cooking. He would wipe the sweat off with his hand and then continue touching the food.  I saw another guy scratching his head and then touching the forks and plates to place in the to-go bags.  It was really gross.

I'm giving 5 stars because Kahootz delivered as I expected it would. Not talking super high end OR super simple. For the area, the bar/restaurant is spot on.

The beer. Great selection - the server let me try three before I settle into a nice IPA. Very attentive and the beer was chilled perfectly.

I ordered the steak special. I wasn't too hungry and the small rib eye with potatoes, bread and taters filled the bill.

The owner was behind the bar a couple times watching the pours and the meals coming out - Yes, great attention to his investment - and it pays off - the place is quality. He caught me in the parking lot and asked for feedback - super smart thing to do.

Traveling through the area I ended up with a nice meal, good environment, beer and excellent service.

Well done

First things first, the service was pretty great! Our servers and the hostess were genuinely friendly. We were greeted with water & chips and this deliciously spicy salsa. I went with my mom, grandma, and aunt. We ended up ordering 4 appetizers & just sharing them family style. We ordered; Mushroom & Goat cheese quesadillas, bacon wrapped stuffed grilled jalapeño peppers, their fried calamari with a garlic aioli, & loaded chicken nachos.
This place was good, the atmosphere was nice, but the food was mediocre. The calamari was soggy & rubbery, there was hardly any cheese on the nachos & the quesadillas, and the jalapeño peppers were overly rich with whatever they were stuffed with and I'm pretty sure the bacon was turkey bacon (not that I don't like turkey bacon, but I expected real bacon). We ended up just having water; our waitress was awesome at keeping our cups filled pretty consistently, my only complaint with that is the water cups are pretty small in size & that being said we had to get our cups filled probably 10 times (though we were all really thirsty). My other complaint is that the food was either super salty, not seasoned, or way too spicy. There was no in between. I'm a huge sucker for guacamole, we got some on the side, but it was bland, and unseasoned. It was just mushy avocado with no flavor.

However if you're one for tequila or mixed drinks, I would say that's definitely a good place to go. It's a nice addition to the village. But I'm not sure I'll return.
Great food, great beer, phenomenal service even though it was busy- please stay away so we can enjoy! LOL seriously, prices are fair, quality of food was really good. Enjoy!

I really want to love this place. It's close to home and they have a large selection of beers on tap. However, the food is hit or miss. On our first visit, we had burgers and they just were not good. The meat was bland and was obviously from a frozen patty. We visited again about a month ago to give it another go and were pleasantly surprised. The fish tacos were delicious. The batter was so light and crispy and the tortillas soft. I was excited that the quality had improved. We just went last week and I had the tacos again and was so disappointed. The fish batter was not the same. It was kind of soggy and the tortillas hard. One thing that is consistent is the beer. It is not ice cold. I'm not sure why, but it is on the warmer side. The live music on the patio is a nice touch, but inside can be kind of hectic and loud. We can overlook that if the food is good. We probably won't be back again due to the quality of our food on the last visit.

Food is good, hospitality sucks. After eating with some old friends they asked to see some of the latest magic I had been working on. As I was starting my second one the general manager came over and said I would have to wrap it up. He said corporate doesn't allow that kind of thing. I didn't even bother to ask what that meant, we all just got up and left. They didn't make me feel welcome, so i won't be back.

This place is amazing! So relaxing and smells beyond words with all the essential oils and organic products that they offer. The facility is warm and inviting and the staff create a wonderful energy that you can sense through the entier facility! I love my new hair style and I will defenatly be back!

Dr. Crowley Jarvis is very gentle and has always put everyone in our family at ease when we visit.  Our youngest started seeing Dr. Crowley Jarvis when she was 3 and was very comfortable going by herself immediately.  Between the five of us we've had extractions, fillings, crowns and a root canal and we always felt the recommendations for these services was appropriate.  The staff is very friendly and helpful with insurance questions.  The hygienists and dental assistants are conscientious and want to accommodate any needs or concerns you have, too.
Good steak and potatoes. Steak was cooked almost perfectly. Only complaint not enough Yee-Haws.

Ordered a French dip sandwich and a Caesar salad for delivery. The sandwich was excellent and came with a side of fries which were just passable. The salad was large and fresh but because it was large there wasn't enough dressing. Delivery was within the advertised range and was on time with the time reported by Yelp.  My only significant complaint is that I was ordering for one but had a minimum order requirement of $15 with about a $6 delivery fee so I had to order more food than I wanted just to get it delivered. I am not exclusively faulting Yard House for this since most places I checked had similar requirements.

I've been to many Mongolian and Asian-fusion places and I have to say Mongo's is near the top of the list.  The number of choices in every conceivable food group is excellent.  Foods that must stay fresh, like shrimp, remain frozen so they are at the peak of freshness right before you cook and eat them.  A significant number of choices for the different sauces, so much that it's overwhelming.  A good problem to have.

Drawbacks: It's a little too pricey to go back weekly; it would cost me close to $65 for my family if 5 BEFORE a tip.  Drinks and desserts are sold separately and would buoy that price northward.

I enjoyed the environment very much because the chef's at the grill were dressed in coordinated uniform and would give rousting cheers like a "team" when they flamed up the cooking surface with oil.  Made you feel like you were part of a family operation and the employees seem like they were having a lot of fun.   It WAS fun, and delicious, and I would recommend the place highly.

TERRIBLE SERVICE! My party had to wait 40 minutes for our food, and our server didn't apologize until right before we got it. We had to ask for refills on drinks and chips. When our food got here, 3/5 plates had cold beans and rice. Not lukewarm. Cold. My boyfriend requested no onions on his plate as well, 40 minutes is more than enough time to fix that mistake or not make it all. The most frustrating part was the restaurant not even that busy. Not coming back any time soon and definitely not recommending this restaurant to anyone else.

Thank you so much for doing a great job cleaning our carpet!!

Extra thanks for the following:
1. Coming to Esparto
2. Taking time to do the job right.
3. Calling when you were on your way

All of these things give you extra points in my book. Plus the carpets look great! I will definitely call you again to do more of the house and maintenance cleaning of the other carpet especially the hallway of high traffic!!!
Service was excellent and food was delicious. Definitely has potential to become a favorite .

I am blown away by how many programs this library offers. They really are committed to the community. The kids and teen sections are wonderful! Great outlet for parents and kids to interact with each other. Highly impressive staff too. I can't believe the level of costumer service and personality the staff here has. They really are doing great work at the libraries in Meridian. I'm very pleased.

I was wondering if this place was still around so I hit them up yesterday for lunch while running some errands. Great food. They use all beef dogs and add a good helping of onions, tomatoes, a slice of pickle, peppers and spicy mustard. I opted for the jumbo, a 1/3 pound dog. It comes with a load of fries (about one and half orders of large fries at McDonald's) for $6.50. We were welcomed but honestly the staff all sounded like robots. Not a single person was swayed by different conversation. They were in way too much of a hurry and not personal at all. If it weren't for the pizza themselves I'd never return because of the service. Personality is strongly encouraged.
Great food. Great service. No wait time. I was very impressed with my first visit to the Yardhouse and WILL be back soon!

Terrible service, everyone we talked to treated us like we were the biggest inconvenience ever.  It's probably been the 3rd or 4th time I've been in there and it's been bad every time.  I won't be going back.

So I look at the bowel and wonder.... Where's the rest of the food? The lady there was rude and was trying to rush me through when there were NO OTHER CUSTOMERS in the store. Also they barely gave me any food for what i payed for, very stingy. And I asked the lady a question about the cucumber, and instead of answering my question, she just put it in anyway. Horrible service, mediocre food. Will not be returning

Great place, great service and the menu has so many options.  Great for a special occasion or just to visit during happy hour. A lot of options for beverages also, my husband is always pleased with their beer options

First time here. Was welcomed at the door by friendly staff that took time to explain the menu since it was our first time. I had the Bangkok Curry & my daughter had the Steak Stroganoff. Both were very fresh & delicious. I thought the small size was going to leave me hungry but we were both completely full after we ate. Their soups, salads & sandwiches look like they would be really good too. We will be back!!!!

I ordered a regular Philly and a small Prime Rib. They came out the same size. When I asked if there had been a mistake in size, they argued that it all depends on how much you put it in. The regular Philly had double the filling and came out the same size as the small Prime. She had to ask me which one was supposed to be a regular. No apologies. 

I like Pita Pit, but don't like being lied to when it's pretty obvious. Bad customer service. Probably won't be back to this location.

This location serves the best Carl's Jr! My wife and I are self-proclaimed experts since we have been going to their restaurants since 1965. This location always serves hot and tasty food quickly including when we order a non-menu item that was on the Carl's Jr menu back in '65 (the Big Burger and the ChiliCheese Burger). Highly recommended!

I honestly don't recommend this carpet company if you're looking for a great deal. I was hooked with a two room 50 dollar special, and I was really excited but upon they're set up they started to upsell me and add additional costs for chemicals to treat pet odors. It was understandable but it upset me because I was told that the pet treatment was all covered in the final cost for the job. It was initially 4 rooms at 100 dollars but I ended up with a bill for 275 .

I dug this place.  Got the Chicago Dog (minus onions) both times.  The seasoning on the dog really gives it a little something extra.

The (I'm assuming) owner was very nice.  I'd like a credit/debit option to pay, as I never have cash on me.  That's really the only thing keeping me from going back more often.

Ok the food is good not great, the service is just terrible! I mean really the worst of the worst. The waitress was busy chatting it up w her friends at another table. I was actually waving my arms at another waitress and she turned around and walked away! Did she think I was doing the lone wave? if you can't even get someone to bring the steamed rice you ordered maybe that is their way of saying you should have ordered the fried rice and paid the extra. You would think it was something amazing to be there by the way they act....Nope, go some where else.

The only saving grace for this place is that the cook was very good at the hibachi and very entertaining and friendly!
I have used Dunn right several times now and they have always done an outstanding job.  They are easy to schedule, show up on time, and do quality work.
Great atmosphere but I always seem to get sick when I eat here. Drinks only for me when visiting.
The food was UMAZING!!! We had a server that really knew the menu and directed us to some of the best meals we've had in a long time! Cannot wait to go back! New favorite!
Service was great! Went to get awesome wings! Left still wanting awesome wings! Food was sub-par!!

* I don't go here often, because the country music was too loud for my family, and my toddler found many ways to make mischief. Also, I dont have much disposable income.
* So what am I doing back here again? They don't need my review; they do great business. Saturday dinners are incredibly busy. Unless you like waiting an hour or more, try doing lunch instead.
* A sports fan could get comfortable here with all the animal heads, trophies (like knick-knacks, fancy awards), television screens with various team sports going on, buckets of peanuts, neon signs, and alcoholic beverages. None of that is attractive to me; it sometimes creeps me out. 
* Its all about the food. I used to chow down on a whole rack of pork ribs and steak fries at places like this. If I was 25 years younger I still would. Today I ordered the small prime rib, which turned out to be a full blown meal with two sides and a basket of bread & butter. Melt in my mouth, and no horseradish thank you.
* Service was snappy, friendly, and everyone working here seemed happy - even the gal who dropped a butter cup face down onto the carpet. Twice from one plate.
I absolutely love this restaurant.  With a family of 5, it is affordable and great food. The 6 Oz sirloin is my favorite. The service is always great.

Typical BWW. Always packed. I have been to this location about 5 times and we sat in the bar area each time and we got great, consistent service.  Asian Zing and the Mango Jabanero have definitely been the top two flavors...haven't quite found a third yet.

If you've never eaten here before you are missing out. If your a health nut like me you have to get tired of the typical subway blimpie etc. this place has fresh food great tasty meat and the service Is always excellent.
Great ambiance but the food is a bit lacking. The flavors are missing that taste-bud blast. For the price I would go to Cafe Rio instead.
Great service, amazing food, and great beer selection. Only problem is that their dinner items weren't available at lunch time (the menu doesn't indicate this).

.When I lived in Memphis, Krispy Kreme donuts were the bomb. My favorites were blueberry filled and cinnamon apple filled. Both had powdered sugar coating. I guess that's too hard to make anymore.
.I was delighted to try the donuts here. I love the chocolate cream iced. Or is it chocolate ice cream?  Pumpkin cream is delicious, but its a gamble to go there just for that, as its only seasonal. 
.One thing I would make a special trip for is some good apple fritters. This donut (doughnut?) maker charges more for apple fritters. Since I grew up loving large fritters, it seemed fair they would cost more than regular donuts. But these fritters aren't THAT large. And the dough is loaded with so much sugar, it overpowers the apple.

The wait staff was very friendly and the drink prices were great. The food was far from exceptional but the vibe 
kept us staying for drinks.

My experience at Yard House has been terrible. The food is very inconsistent. I went there last Sun night. The service was terrible. We waited forever for the food. The fries came out on a little plate and they were stale and cold. I mentioned it to the waitress. She took the cold fries and she returned about 15 min later with fries that weren't much better. She did not seem eager to correct the problem as a matter of fact she acted put off by the fact that we wanted new fries. This is not the first time this has happened to me either. Due to the limited number of restaurant choices in the Village I've continued to give Yard House another try, but after last week's experience I don't think I'll be going back anytime soon.

This food here is not bad for another one of those Japanese restaurants owned and operated by Chinese. 
If you go Monday or Tuesday for the dollar sushi... you will be highly disappointed!
There is NO sushi on the dollar menu!
Just rolls... or roll . For example...2 little pieces of California roll ... or 1 thinly sliced tempura roll...
If only the sushi chefs would shut the heck up for a little bit while I'm eating lunch or dinner! At least tone it down!
They will not stop talking to EACH OTHER! 
Annoying!

We had a great dinner experience at this location.  The service was great and food was fresh and served in a timely manner.  My wife had the bone in rib-eye which was prepared perfectly.  I had the rib-eye and shrimp combo and the shrimp was plump and juicy.  My only suggestion would be if the rib-eye I had was a little thicker.  We think we're fairly picky and cannot find anything to complain about our recent experience.  Great job!

Fantastic! My wife and I went in last night, Saturday, around 6:30, and there was about a 40 minute wait when we checked in. Not too bad considering it just opened and it was Saturday. We had a margarita at the bar while we waited, and the time seemed to go fairly quickly. We ordered the shrimp ceviche, a carne asada burrito, and some enchiladas. Needless to say we were quite full and could not finish our dishes. The food was amazing, and our waitress was awesome! We will definitely be going back!

Great little spot for prime rib and a beer. 
They have a nice selection on tap. Ask the bartender for a sampler platter, and he'll pick like 7 different beers for you.  

The wings are a bit strange. They don't separate them at the joint so you get both the wing and the leg in one. 

Prime rib is amazing, sells out fast though so get there early enough on the weekend.  
Their desserts are huge. Make sure you save some room.

Good service and many beers on draft. Unfortunately going on a Saturday evening was not a good idea... out of the special- stuffed meatballs... Out of the special- prime rib.... fortunately the con queso dip was available and delish! My fiance and I both ordered steaks, it was good, not great. 

We would be up to try to this place possibly in the future just not in the near future, or on a Saturday evening.
Absolutely love this restaurant. The wedge salad is to die for and my kids love making their own pizza!

This place was surprisingly good!  The prices were reasonable, and you could get pizza with pretty much any toppings on it that you like.  You can either order one of their "specialty" pizzas, or do a "build-your-own".  I would definitely recommend doing the BYO, since you will likely see some ingredients along the way that you hadn't thought of when you ordered the "specialty".  I went overboard getting pretty much every option they had for meat on my pizza, topped with a few olives.  The bacon really added something to the pizza.  Yum.  The crust is thin, and the sauce is delicious.  The staff is friendly, and you get the pizzas really fast, thanks to their 12000 degree fire'd up pizza oven.  My only criticism is that they don't have anchovies.

This place is so noisy, it should be required to wear hearing protection. Concrete floors and all other surfaces are reflective. Add in about 8 TVs and screaming patrons and it is impossible to talk without shouting.  My  hamburger was charred and cooked well done and was dry as a bone. They only have coated French fries, so you better like them, because that's all they have. Service took an extra 30 minutes because the kitchen was backed up. 
Almost any burger restaurant in the Boise area is better.

The food is, well, Carl's Jr.  Over the years I've found it pretty uniform across locations far and wide - and typically enjoy it. 

Over the last three months I've been to this location three times - once each during breakfast,  lunch and dinner hours. Different staff on each visit,  all of whom exhibited amongst the worst customer service imaginable. Waiting patiently for someone to come to front, only to be greeted with "What do you want?" - followed by complete inability to describe menu items is not appropriate. 

Essentially same experience last two visits - completely morose looks and attitudes coupled with completely crappy service.  Today noticed every other napkin holder was empty,  as was the ketchup dispenser.  Could this location be sucking it so bad they're about to go under?  Actually one thing above all did stand out today - I wasn't the only customer in the store.
This place is real busy,had to wait 20 min to be seated.steak was done as requested.service was very good.
Not so good tonight. Prim rib was cold, Baked Sweet Potato was bad. First bad meal here.

I've been here twice now, first visit was very smooth. Very friendly voice on the other end and a quick transaction.

My visit today was greeted by a much more grumpy voice. Not terrible.. but not amused since Im paying for the product you're selling and all..

Donuts are to be expected, these aren't top shelf but some are quite tasty.

Overall a fine experience for what it is.

We love Main Street! The food is amazing!! The only complaint I ever have is the time it takes in the drive thru. We have to have at least 30 min to dedicate to waiting when we come here. Average wait time for 3 cars is 20 min or more. Prepared to order is understandable but even then it's a little excessive. With a 5 year old , sometimes we have to choose another option just for the time aspect. Despite that we will still remain loyal patrons given our schedule allows!!!

We succumb to the indiscreet charms of the burger-oise infrequently, in a probably futile effort to live forever. But when we decide to indulge, the burger better be a good one. This is the best we've found in the Boise area so far, and it's good enough to tempt us more often than we would like. 

There are fancier burgers around to be sure, made with prime grade beef from hand-massaged, foie-gras fed cows from the Andes & served on imported brioche buns, that cost the equivalent of a car payment. That's not what we're after here. We want a traditional American hamburger made with quality ingredients, cooked by someone who's paying attention.

The meat here is advertised as 100% premium, organic beef, so no worries about pink slime and other stuff you don't even want to think about. While we do appreciate the versions grilled over charcoal or wood flames, these are cooked to order on a hot steel griddle, which gives the meat that crusty bite and slightly-charred flavor. It's served on a fresh-tasting roll dusted with cornmeal (why doesn't everyone do this?). The toppings are pretty standard, although with extra credit for the lettuce that looks and tastes like it was actually grown and harvested during this decade. Sometimes we say to hell with it and get the fries (okay, always), which are better than average but not the reason to come here. We don't drink liquid sugar, so we're grateful for the brewed iced tea.

The ambiance is noteworthy for the pictures of classic hot cars that adorn the walls and, in some cases, your own memories. These thankfully distract from the predominant view of the Chicago Connection alley and parking lot next door.

Some reviewers complain about the cost. But I really don't think 4 or 5 bucks for a well-made burger is expensive, and two of us are out the door for under $15. That's an honest deal.
Pepper Fries! Serious good local burger joint.

Love, Love, Love this place!  I get a craving for the pizza here (any variety) about once a week...but the other day I decided to try the burger.  It is a strange combination of toppings for a burger, but I'm a foodie so I decided "what the heck!" and ordered it.  It was the best burger I've had in years.  I also love the consistency...good food and service everytime I visit.  It's so nice to have an upscale restaurant like this in Meridian!

We stopped in Meridian while on a road trip and decided to try out Jakers. It was the first and will be the last time that I dine there. The entire experience was a disaster from the start. There were some good aspects but the negatives completely outweighed the positive.

First, we had a three year old with us and when trying to decide what to choose for her, I asked the server if the Mac & Cheese was from Kraft. She assured me it wasn't from Kraft and made fresh in house...what we received - Kraft Mac & Cheese. Okay, it's fine if they serve kraft, but it would prefer honesty as I would have simply chosen something else off the menu. Second, I asked for garlic fries and was served regular fries. Service was so incredibly slow, even though it was a slow night, that they ended up fixing the fries after everyone had eaten. We also asked if the lemonades had free refills and the server said yes - and we received the ticket with the refills charged. It was fixed...but it took some time. When we ordered drinks, we asked for water and it never came until we reminded her. We ordered a small scoop of ice cream for our toddler for dessert and waited thirty minutes until she came by and told us goodnight. We reminded her about the dessert and it turns out the ticket never printed. Seriously it was one thing after another. My husband did like the "evil Thai salad" and I liked the burger; however, in all honesty it was just okay. The food was "ok" and super overpriced!

When visiting Boise again, we will not be dining here again.

Very disappointed. We've been to Yard House numerous times and usually there isn't a problem. After waiting a half hour to be seated we were put at a table where the high chair doesn't work. I approached the hostess to see if we could be seated somewhere else. She told me they were busy and there was no where else to put us. We wouldn't have been opposed to waiting a few more minutes for the next available table that a high chair does work at but it wasn't offered.  She basically threw here hands up and gave the impression she didn't really care. So we left and went elsewhere. Very disappointed in the staff. Probably will be a long time before we try again there.

We stared using TPD in January of 2017.  We had some needs for special reports and additional maintenance work.  TDP has taken care of it all!  They are very responsive to email and phone calls.  We are very happy!

Great place for eating wings.   The last few times i dine in this place, they always say the wait time for a table is 30-60 mins.  I always ask them why the wait time needs to be so long especially there are so many empty tables.  They always agree and end up sitting us right away.
When they learn to make drinks it might be ok. Until then I will head down the street to the Dutch buddies place.

We rushed from Yakima, Washington to make it before closing and weren't disappointed. Great menu with unique options. Food is prepared from scratch from quality products. I'm not a drinker but my partner loves the beer selection. Save room for their amazing desserts; but share, they're enormous. If something isn't right, tell your waitstaff so they have an opportunity to make it right.
If you like frozen crab cakes heated up in a microwave and frozen tasteless unidentifiable fish heated up in a fryer then this is the place for you.

Pizza has become in a sorts, traditional, its classic, easy and very filling. What it has not been, is fast and for those of us willing to invest 20-30 minutes of our day waiting for it to come to us, not a quick lunch. The blaze veers away from traditional and makes pizza more fast food friendly while maintaining pizzas traditional roots. 180 seconds! I was skeptical at first, something must be sacrificed to make it this fast, but it's an awesome tasting pizza. Is it Casanova's? No! But it's a hands down winner over commercial pizza places, with a price that's pocketbook friendly! I will admit the build your own section is a bit confusing with all the choices and be warned, if you're OCD watching them create it, will be nerve racking but well worth it. The blood orange lemonade completes the meal and 17$ for two, might be worth a shot for date night. I'm a fan!

Make sure you get and use the little menu with recipe suggestions! This will open your mind up to the different flavor combos they're really going for and give you ideas to break out of the traditional Mongolian food flavors. A bit disorganized. Need the flavor recipes throughout the restaurant. Make sure the servers don't take yours away!

First time here. We had to wait about 30 mins. Not bad for the amount of people there. Peanuts every to eat and drop the shells on the floor. Now to the dinner. I had a T-bone and my wife had the Prime Rib. Both were cooked to perfection. The wife said "It the best she has every had but it was too big for her. " I guess I'll have to eat it for lunch. Along with my T-bone. Yes, it was too big for me. It covered the plate and was 3/4 of an inch thick. It came with onions and mushrooms. With drinks the meal came to little over $50. 
We will be returning for another dinner soon, but next time I will call ahead of time for a table. Can't wait to try their BBQ Ribs.
I was curious which was better Sakura or Sakana.  Now I know......hands down......Sakura on Chinden!

One of the hardest things about a new town can be trying to find a new place to eat. Sometimes Yelp will help, sometimes it becomes an abyss, where you try to categorize how much to trust the rating. In this case, the rating was well-earned and highly appropriate.

Basically here you have a sort of brewpub/alehouse that also happens to have food, definitely in appearance. It's very eclectic inside and very comfortable. I really dig the interior quite a bit. However, they call it a steakhouse, which denotes much higher standards. Fortunately, the kitchen staff is very high end and these guys can definitely be trusted to execute. You can put a blindfold on and stab a finger at the menu and hit something good, if not great. 

The pterodactyl wings were gigantic things, somewhat similar to Hooters wings, but the grilling and the sauce combination was worlds better. I wouldn't order them again, as they weren't crispy enough for my suiting, but they were solid. The ribeye was cooked to perfection, but failed with the rub, which was also what they used on the vegetables. Speaking of those, the asparagus was exquisite beyond belief and one of the best I've ever had. 

Bread pudding was also very rich and while delectable, was borderline too much. Were it not for the grace note of the almonds, it would have been too far into cloying. As it was, it continually was on the borderline of balancing between too much and perfect. I don't think I'd order it again, but everyone should definitely hit it up once, just like this place. If I lived in the area, I'd definitely be found here often.

This is more of a 3.5 star :) 

Clean! 2 tv's with the World Cup! 

Friendly service good at refills! 
Had a special where we ordered two large pizzas for medium price. Decent prices!

Hawaiian yummy!
Combo very good! 
Nice deep dish crust!

Group of 8 and they put two tables together for us! 

Lobby was practically empty.
Legendary service. They remodeled the bar area which really opens up the restaraunt. The food is on point as usual. Good music good company. Lots of smiling faces from people who love their job

I have to say I am very impressed with the excellent customer service. I needed emergency  carpet cleaning this morning and they were able to accommodate me and have someone out within a hour of me calling. David was the service guy that came out and he was extremely friendly and did a awesome job on my carpet. I highly recommend them!

My filet had a piece of plastic in the crab meat on top of it. At first I thought it was a piece of human hair and it really got me upset.  Little did I know the manager informed me it's a piece of plastic brush no big deal continue on with my meal.  The manager replaced my meal at full price missing the point of the fact my eating experience was ruined at this point and insinuating eating plastic with my 40.00 dollar meal is no big deal carry on it happens a lot around here or something it's fine you'll totally live we serve plastic in all are food no biggie.  Needless to say Burger King would've comped my meal never going there again.
We got sat by the door on a slow saturday night around 11pm in December, needless to say it was freezing. couldnt really enjoy it but i know the food is good and well will be back.

Honestly, I have no idea what the folks that posted one star reviews are seeing. I am so very glad that I did not look at the reviews before trying this place, it might have turned me off from a great place. Family of five ate for about $30, three kids bowls of spaghetti and meatballs (they loved it, ate every bite). Wife had the Pad Thai and said it was good, I had the spicy Thai Peanut Noodles, I added shrimp. The help was quick, food was brought the table hot and fresh. No complaints at all. We will be back for sure. Family friendly as well, plenty of high chairs and such.

We have worked with Courtney and Carly at TPD Property Management for a few years now.  They truly go out of they're way to help they're owners and also they're renters have the best rental experience.  They have both parties interest at heart and have been a pleasure to work with!

I recently revisited Mongo's and wanted to update a few of my comments. 

My #1 complaint has been fixed. They've added a moderate selection of wines as well as beers on tap. Kudos for that! 

As for my 2nd complaint about food being lukewarm, this was not the case on my recent experience. If anything it was overdone. I suppose it's a hard balance to make but I'm much happier with them erring on the side of overdone. 

I selected a moderate amount of Tilapia to include in my dish and it was so mashed and cooked together that I couldn't tell if there was any fish in the bowl at all. The cooks left the noodles to sit on the grill for a good minute or two which cooked the bottom into a stiff mess. When they went back over it after it had been sitting it tore up the noodles. They ended up not being as long as you would normally get. It could be the long metal paddles they use are too heavy for some of the cooks? Perhaps using wooden ones would encourage more "churn" of the food and better consistency. 

Service was much improved with a moderately attentive waiter. We only had to call for them once and that was right after someone in our party forgot they wanted something after the waiter had just stopped by to ask.

Overall the experience was an improvement so I increased my rating to 3 stars.  I think this is about as high class as you can expect from a Mongolian style Grill restaurant in the valley. I wouldn't recommend it as a destination place but it fits the bill if you have a family with kids hankering for good Mongolian Grill.

I had an appointment scheduled for today to just do my living room and a throw rug.  They were to arrive between 12-1pm.  I have been waiting, and waiting.  I sent then a text at 1:30, with no response.  I called at 2:15pm and left a message.  Hopefully they show up, but it's not looking good.  I will update when and if they contact me.

3 of us at work decided to try something different, so this was to be it. We ordered 2 Philly sandwiches, and 1 ham & cheese.

 Not only was the person on the phone rude ( obviously hates his job and dislikes his customers ), but the food was inedible.
 
 $30 for 3 sandwiches that are burnt, with very little meat...and a little bag of crappy chips & cookies. 

 Not worth it.
I go there pretty frequently for date nights because I like the ambiance and a lot of my friends go there as well. Their food is pretty decent too!! ^_^

I went here on 10/20/15 at around 6:45 am. I ordered 2 pumpkin spice lattes and a butter croissant. When I got to the window, the a lady with short curly dirty blond hair was making it obvious she was angry that we wanted to reload our Starbucks card through the drive through and she began to basically tell us how to order in the drive thru. Then because our card didn't have enough to pay off the final bill, she slammed her hand down and asked for the remaining cash. Me and my wife felt very uncomfortable. I would not recommend this Starbucks to anybody. If you want good service, GO TO DUTCH BROS. I'll never come to this Starbucks again.

Some of the worst service I have ever gotten from any where. Took me 15 minutes and asking 3 times to get my beer and water. I ordered steak and salmon, the waitress didn't ask me how is like it cooked. My steak was well well done (I would consider it burnt...) and the salmon was cold. My girlfriend had a sushi roll that was very poorly rolled and actually fell apart every time she went to pick it up. (Sushi did taste good though) I could understand their outrageous prices if their food and service was good. But, it wasn't. I will never go back here; And I will also tell everyone I know not to dine here.

Preface: Not only am I a diehard foodie I've worked as a manager in the food and beverage industry in CA for over 15 years including serving as a GM for a fine dining waterfront restaurant. So my views may be skewed a little and my expectations high.

That being said, Kahootz really surprised me. As you walk in it has the feel of a bar/pizza house but don't let that fool you. The service was friendly and on point. The food was great with great portion selections. My steak was cooked a perfect medium rare and had a great flavor. A touch over seasoned but I won't hold that against them. Great beer selection also offering 44 taps of primarily high quality craft beer. A reasonable wine menu for the size of the restaurant as well. I'd definitely recommend Kahootz to anyone dining in the area.

Why do restaurants play loud music?
At the other end of the scale, a restaurant that places profit above dining experience often plays loud music with a fast tempo that subconsciously puts diners under pressure to eat more quickly, even if that means that they are less able to enjoy their meal. ... This is what most often ruins the dining experience for me.Jul 4, 2014
The Psychology of Restaurant Music | Psychology Today. Reason why not 5 star. 


But the salad is crunchy and cold. The drinks are high priced. Starting around $7.50. The potatoes are real!  The steaks we had we flavorful and tender. We were seated quickly for lunch and our waitress was quick, sweet and lovely.

Great selection of beer and the food is fantastic! We had a chicken nachos to start and the swordfish tacos. I also helped myself to a pretty good selection of beverages. The only thing that may have dinged the 5 stars was that the ran out of Elysian Space Dust shortly before I got my order in, but they had plenty of high quality alternatives

We've been here several times and keep coming back for the delicious steak. They always make it perfectly and have a great Caesar salad we love. The kids enjoy eating here, although none of the drink options for kids are palatable since they are mostly sugar. Between the large portions of steak and delicious trout we never make it to dessert.

Coming from a health-nut, I wish that they served more pizza and salad because I'd be a frequent visitor to Blaze (my husband definitely is already!). For a fully customizable pizza that's ready in 3-minutes, it's affordable and lives up to every expectation.  

Food: each pizza is unique and totally crafted by you. Looking for inspiration? Try one of their house favorites. We typically like to make our own pizza with toppings like ovalini, sausage and green pepper. The pizza, for how darn fast it's ready, is actually very good and serves up a giant portion for the cost. The crust is thin and crispy and the oven gives it the right amount of flavor. I typically order a salad. The salads have TONS of greens and not too many toppings but I'm pleased with their portions, there is always enough for us to share or take half home for a 2nd meal. One wish that I had, being a health nut, is that they had more options. I crave a hot bowl of soup or delicious sides, and the fact that Blaze only offers pizza and salad, which makes for a pretty limited menu, is a bummer to me. 

Drinks: self-serve soda fountain 

Atmosphere: this is the only aspect where Blaze falls short to me. Since it's a subway-style pizzeria, the seating area is pretty simple. It's typically packed when we go so I feel like I'm shuffling through a cafeteria and then don't have anywhere that's really comfortable to eat. But hey, that's just me! 

Service: always fast and friendly! 

Happy Hour Offerings: n/a

Healthy Hack: not feeling like pizza? Grab a salad. More than enough for 2 and/or a leftover portion. 

Tips: n/a

A little pricey, busy, distracted waiters due to too many people, the food was just okay. I would rather go else where. On the plus side, location, location, location, right! And a great beer selection, so that's the trade off my friends, take it or leave it.

I am mad at you, Homestead! You took away your ribllets!!!! They were so delicious and honestly the best in town. Why did you take them away? Please bring them back! Nonetheless,  I do enjoy frequenting this place. It's always lively, the food is good and plentiful, (like the  mozzarella sticks!), always fun and friendly service, and I really like the brunch menu, especially the Bloody Marys!

The service was excellent. I had the steak sandwich and asked for medium rare. The steak came out overcooked to well done. The horseradish was really uneven, in some places it was really thick and overpowering in other spots it was just right. Overall the food was pretty good but not exceptional.

So far so good best happy hour in town two dollar margaritas and two dollar and 50 Cent blended margaritas you can't beat that. The calamari so far is amazing I will continue my reviews as we are eating

All around great experience! The hostess was super busy and still did a great job at getting everyone a table in a timely manner. The bartender, male with Oakley glasses, was supper friendly and mixed very good drinks! Amy, our waitress once we got a table, was the best waitress I've ever had. She went out of her way to ensure that we had the best food possible. I'm not the type of guy to complain about food, but she walked by and saw that my burrito was lacking some steak.. Without me asking, she brought me a brand new burrito with more steak. Hands down great overall experience and great staff! Thanks Amy for going the extra mile to ensure that we had a great experience!
Waited about 45 minutes for my food.  Evergreen Roll just tasted like rice, and Pacific Roll barely had any lobster in it.  Idaho is not good for sushi.

I ordered a pizza over the phone for delivery from this store. It was a busy time of day, so the wait was an hour. 
The delivery driver delivered the pizza and stated that I ordered from the wrong store. This store is actually closer to our house than the other store he told me to order from so that is why I called this store. And when I called no one told me otherwise. But the delivery driver said it multiple times. That seems like something he should be telling his manager about so he doesn't get sent out our way if it is so far for him to go. Although google maps would say otherwise. But instead he went on like it was my problem or fault.
Then, the wrong pizza was made for us. We ordered a pepperoni-sausage and received a supreme which we do not like at all. I called to tell the store and they admitted they messed up and then offered me the correct pizza and a refund to which I agreed. And another hour wait was tacked on.
Then, 20min later I was called and told by the employee I spoke with that they talked to the manager and the ticket they placed said "supreme", so that is what I must have ordered. So then I said no, you guys have my number in the system and I said I wanted the same order I've always gotten a pepperoni-sausage, then the woman I spoke to said back to me "pepperoni-sausage pizza" and I said yes. So then the employee said that is all he could do and is very sorry and the manager is not there to talk now. So we agreed to the refund.
First off, I know what I ordered and the person taking my order literally said it back to me and I confirmed it. Second off, of course the ticket will say whatever pizza they made, because they wrote the ticket, not me, and they messed up obviously right there when they wrote "supreme". Never in my life have I ordered a supreme pizza...or wanted a supreme pizza...I think I know what I ordered. This customer service to rectify the situation was awful. 
This whole situation was absolutely ridiculous and very frustrating.

Krispy Kreme doughnuts are great, but I wish this one stuck to "one free original glaze" when the hot light is on. Also, if you buy anything other then a doughnut through the drive thru be warned that its not fast service. There staff is always great and super friendly at the drive thru though!

One of the BEST places we've eaten so far, if not THE BEST!  Everyone in our family said it's their favorite so far.  Fun atmosphere, great service (Madison is one of the best waitresses we've had), and the food was delicious!  Large portions of food, and the rolls are amazing.  Can't wait to come back!

Best place to have your car washed and for $10 more hand toweled dried and interior cleaned. Employees leave your car looking like new. Friendly and clean facility. Don't go anywhere else to have my car washed and cleaned.

Great local neighborhood bar & grill that serves a great burger and such.  The place is very popular and has a great beer selection.  Lots of TV's and it is very loud.   It's no BDUBS...but a great  neighborhood sport pub.

Ahhh... the cold weather is upon us and for me it's soup season. This was the first time I had eaten here. I had the chicken noodle soup, which was fantastic, it was well spiced, with plenty of vegetables. Would definitely recommend in the fall and winter times. I think next time I shall try the tomatoe soup!

Brought my mum for bday lunch,  she'd never been to Chili's! Pretty busy for a Sunday but our waiter Justin was friendly and on top of it! We both ordered the Triple Dipper appetizer for lunch.  The chx strip were tender,  juicy (lots of breading but light! ) & hot!  Big mouth sliders looked at first a little dry but they too..great flavor and not dry at all.  Fresh cilantro on their onion rings....nice touch!  Great experience,  leftovers to take home even! Good day!

I actually enjoyed the food here a great deal more than I expected,  the Mandarin sauce is far better here than any I've had before.  The prices are a little high in my opinion, hence 4 stars rather than 5, butt truly a great tasting meal. 

The ambiance could use some help, but over all the customer service won me over, making ambiance less important.  GREAT PLACE!

:( 9/10 fries are great, friendly service at window. Everything else disorganized or sadly put together. I know it's fast food, and doesn't always come out looking like the picture. If you order a burger, and say you want only bun, meat, & catchup,  it is SUPER FRUSTRATING to get mayo and cheese on the burger. We have yet to go through this drive thru and have our order 100% correct, even if the only "special" part of our order is the one burger.

Ok Chinese.  Nothing fusion about it, which if why I tried it.  Lots of deep fired dishes, which is really American and not Chinese.  Salt and pepper pork was really bad actually and greasy.  Will I go again?  Not likely.  Nice people and decent service, but food is why you go right?
Great salon. I love Aveda products and Brianna did a great job with my cut and weave. The hand massages are a great touch.

I haven't been to Chili's in awhile. My favorites are the Chili con queso and those incredibly crispy chips - warm and thin. I also love the Enchilada soup, it was a little thinner than I remember but the chicken is so tender and the flavor is so tasty. Our server gave us a bag of warm chips to go home with our left overs. It was a very fun lunch with my grandma.

Ben and Sandra are fantastic.  We bundled Direct TV and CenturyLink and we are very pleased with the level of service and professionalism that they provided.  Ben informed me that they offer free service  calls if there's any problem. Very glad we went with Home Satellite Solutions.  Yelp comes through for us again.

the office staff are clowns. They never return calls and get snotty when you call them on it. I take that back I did get a call from the workmen's comp coordinator to let me know they do everything right and that I shouldn't leave poor ratings. They did surgery with a worse outcome than leaving it alone,  a spinal cord stimulator trial that was awesome. Here I sit over a month and no stimulator, no pain pills, and no simple response from people who should advocate for there patients. The doctor whispered in my ear "your not very patient are you" then pushed me in the back to bend over to have the needles removed. Now mind you it was my third trial and removing them was never painful before. It felt like he stirred the needles around before removing them. I believe it was instrumental for the last month of unbelievable pain I was in for over a month. The pain in my back is way over a 10 and it doubles me over.  I spoke to a potential patient at the pharmacy telling her my story and she won't be using them. People beware your nothing more than a piece of meat being pushed through an assembly line. My experience has been like out of a movie. I didn't think professionals acted this way. even though I like Dr. Bradley the support staff was so horrible. Dear Dr. Bradley the buck stops with you.

We ordered the street tacos and the shrimp enchiladas with poblano sauce. Both were ok, but not very warm. The rice and beans were almost cold beside the enchilada.

For drinks, we had a strawberry margarita and a white sangria. The margarita was wonderful, the white sangria had an odd perfume flavor to it. We will not order the sangria again.

As for the service, it was amazing. We had a young man named Camron. He was friendly, informative, and able to give opinions and advice. This server is the reason I am giving 3 stars instead of 2. He made our time great, even if the food/drinks were not fabulous!
Only place that seems to be able to cook a perfect medium steak that is tender and flavorful. No A1 needed here. :)

Holy cow! Probably the best burger in the area (that i have had:)).  I had the 5 Alarm burger and fries. The burger was not too hot; it was cooled down by the cornmeal bun. Yum! The fires were crispy and seasoned perfectly. Even the fry sauce was good. Lol. It was also clean. Win!

Soooo good for a quick meal that tastes amazing. I got the gluten free crust, thin but tastes great. No cheese because I can't have dairy, but it didn't lack in taste. I wish they had one of these in Utah!

Just ok, it really has never been that great or anything just some place to go get a beer with the guys. The wait there is pretty silly, 5 or so mins for a beer and 20+ for wings. I only go there when Brewforia is busy to get some beers and play trivia or poker. Find a new sports bar IMO

I came In yesterday for a single lady date day, and it was seriously the best experience I've had in a very long time! My server was Lacy, she was amazing! Beyond helpful, I asked her to surprise me with lunch and I'm sure that's annoying but she picked the perfect meal! The Gorgonzola burger so yum! She made me feel like I was an old friend and I love that kind of service! Thanks yard house for a great lunch and thanks lacy for the great conversation!
This place is above and beyond! I have yet to have anything less then superbe.  Whether it's beef jerky or pepperoni sticks or steaks you just can't go wrong with beef and pork here.
My friend and AAA said I had to try this place and it didn't disappoint. Pizza was good and really big. Super flavorful. There is a type of pizza for everyone. Loved the specialty drinks too.

This place never disappoints. 

Always great service. Great reception. Good people working there.

Menu is a bit limited but the apps make up for it - as well as the food of course.
Ate at Blaze in Palm Springs On vacation. Was amazing ! Can't wait to eat at Blaze in Boise/Meridian Idaho !

We stopped here for a quick early dinner prior to attending a free concert at the village. I had the bacon cheddar cheeseburger my wife the mac & cheese.

I ordered my burger medium well and what I got was closer to rare. The shoestring flies were plentiful and quite good. Although the mac & cheese was tasty it was rather oily. Service was good and friendly but the music was too loud to have a conversation at the table.

It might be worth a return trip to try a different dish and to sample one of the many beers on tap. Prices were a little high costing us $35 for a small serving of Mack and cheese and a burger and fries and two cokes

We have been going to noodles for over a decade, menu has slowly been changing  and this item was the final straw not made the way it used to be dry and the amount of chicken was very minuscule. It's too bad, we won't be coming back anymore we like the old way it used to be made with with the whole-grain noodles and lots of vegetables.

Not great food at all.  Menu is extremely big..and why i don't know.  Keep it simple! When food arrived it was dry & bland.  Maybe they should change to just a beer & appetizer only.  Too LOUD! DOES a place really need to be that big....If u don't want to talk to the person your with....GO THERE...HA, HA

The drinks and food here aren't bad. The happy hour menu is decent as well with good prices. 

The staff? Laughably rude, inhospitable, and untrained. 

The cheap drinks take care of this but don't take a date here or boss you're trying to impress.

Horrible place. After being there for almost 11 years im done. We had an issue today with my daughter and they didn't seem to think it was that big of a deal. I told them I need to have her in today if there was an opening or after school this week. They said if it was so important I would take her out of class to get her tooth fixed. I'm sorry but my daughters EDUCATION is important and to miss one day or even an hour is not good. They got her in and fixed her tooth after we paid them 60.00 for it and then after words told me to find a new dentist. Well don't worry I was already finding a new one. The STAFF sucks. I hope Dr Whitt will see this and the letter I wrote to him today about this issue and call me back. But I am doubt that will happen. I'm sure when I left my letter was thrown away. But take your kids to them and good luck. Wish they had better office staff that actually listened to you and didn't seem pissed off every time you call in with problems or needing an appointment. They claim they give good service but they really don't. My kids never got anything for NO CAVITIES like others have. I think they singled out my family for a long time.

Another bad Mexican place. Just skip it. I went for office lunch and nobody liked their food , there were 5 of us.  Tequila selection looked cool, might have to come back for that.  If you hungry, skip this place and find another good option in the village.

My new home away from home. Josh and Laurie are da bomb!! Gracious hosts/owners! Great selection, friendly atmosphere, beautiful historic building! I'll be back guys, look forward to seeing you again!

Food was very good. We had a large party and the waitress, Amber, was fantastic. She really was on her job. My daughter had the lobster mac and cheese and absolutely loved it. My wife had the lobster garlic noodles and loved it. I had the fried chicken and liked it. The creamed corn was fantastic. I didn't like the gravy though. Just didn't go with it. I can't even describe the flavor. Highly recommend the restaurant.

Totally disappointing!  We ordered our food for delivery and it showed up 2 hours later!  First, I ordered the turkey pot pie, and got a message saying they were out of it.  So I ordered the Chicken Kale Caesar salad instead and also ordered the BBQ Chicken kids meal for my 2.5 year old which came with a kids salad.  The $14 Kale Caesar salad was mostly romaine lettuce with a little kale and maybe 1 whole Brussels sprout shredded, and sprinkled with a pinch of the other ingredients it's supposed to come with.  The BBQ chicken was dried out chopped grilled chicken with a side of BBQ dipping sauce and the kids salad was a bunch of chopped romaine lettuce (that even had some brown pieces in it) along with maybe 3-4 paper thin slices of carrots.  I also ordered the Salted Caramel Butterscotch pudding which costs $6!  It was the smallest dessert I've ever seen and the pudding had gross chunks in it like it had formed a skin from sitting out for too long and they just stirred it up before putting it in the same size container at the side of salad dressing.  They included the salted caramel in smaller container on the side, (which was the best part of the whole meal), and then also included a small container of "whipped cream" with "cookie crumbles" for the topping.  I put those things in quotes because the whipped cream was completely watery and the cookie crumbles was more like cookie dust.  I have been to the Yard House before and if I ever came back again, it would only be for the beer and happy hour.  Definitely not worth the price otherwise!

Yard House is always such an enjoyable place to eat or have drinks.
I would recommend to others. 
Good music, friendly staff, good food.
Plenty of parking.
It was a great environment to eat but the food was so so. The options were good and it was really well priced for what you get. The sauces where not that great :(

What will they think of next?  A pizza made like a subway sandwich.   I was not sure I would like this new concept.  Well I will tell you it is very cool and I am a big fan!  It's fun and the pizza is very tasty!   It's very simple,  any sauce,  any cheese, any vegetables,  and ALL the meat I want!  $7.25!   And the pizza is thin crust and takes just a few minutes.  Everyone gets their our pizza just the way YOU like it. The staff all were happy to explain and made the experience kind of fun. This will be a fun place to take a group of people or a bunch of kids!   This is definitely not your traditional pizza place!  And I'm ok with that.   

Down side.. No beer!   And no TVs.. Oh well.   I will still be  going back this weekend with the kids!

Morning all,

For New Year my wife and I brought our 15 month old to celebrate. I thought those delicious honey butter rolls would be a great thing to introduce our daughter to and try their prime rib at the same time. I have had their filet, very well done, flavor, juicy...mmmm. I like mine a little more done than most, so I asked for medium-well. They brought a rather flavorless and rare steak. I was disappointed, they usually do a decent steak. They environment was still the same with their peanuts and several games on.  Overall I enjoined every thing else.

A whole industry seems to have sprung up selling waste chicken parts for absurdly high prices, out of cavernously obnoxious plebeian beer-hall type places overrun with TV's set to endlessly blaring "sports" events and commentatings, and served by boorish fat guys in T-shirts or girls who've never worked in a restaurant before but got hired for having oversized udders they're willing to stick in your face.

Lovely.

I'll be back there in...  somewhere around...

Yeesh.


.

The few times we have been to the Matador the food has been a solid 7 out of 10. We were served cold food once when this location opened up but the second plate came out hot. The salsa needs less garlic (and I'm a huge garlic lover) and the chips need to be beefed up a bit. 

Nachos are very good. They are Very large and you should defiantly share them.
We had no exception other than getting pizza.  We were a little hesitate in the beginning but convinced after the first bite. The only drawback is the noise levels can get loud. We will be back.
Great food and fun atmosphere. We ate out on the patio, they do happy hour all night on Mondays. Service was great and all of our food was cooked perfectly.

This is fantastic pizza, fast! They have a really thin crust which allows them to cook in pizza in maybe five minutes. It reminds me of chipotle where you can build your pizza. This pizza is 11 inches across and it plenty for two people to share. The ingredients are fresh and the crust is delicious. I also find that paying $7.55 for two people is unbeatable when I'd pay about that to make my own pizza. I will definitely be coming back regularly!

Being from out of state i gave this place a try. Mojito was great at the bar. 
Ordered street tacos. To me it seemed sweet than spicy. Totally didnt enjoy it.

I don't know if there's anything more oxymoronic than sushi in Idaho. But it exists, and it's not half bad.

The sushi and sashimi's a little more expensive than I expected, like maybe 10-20% more.  But I have to say, I was quite surprised by the quality of the fish. The hamachi was actually buttery and melting in my mouth, though an extra order that should have cost $4 was $5 for the amount of sashimi that I got.

The oyako don was only okay, and tasted a little bland. It looked really good, though. They needed a bit more sauce underneath.

This place has its presentation aspect down, on both the decor as well as the food. The owners (or at least one of the chefs) I think moved from LA, and they're all either Cantonese or mainland Chinese. No Japanese here. Still, it's well done, especially for Idaho.

Still can't beat SF or Seattle, though.

I'm from CA and our friends took us here. Fun atmosphere. Beers are huge! Prime rib cooked to perfection! Portion are fairly huge. Servers were fast. Never a dull moment here. I would definitely come back.

Great steak! Split the porterhouse with my wife. It was so good. Not much into all the bread and fried stuff but will definitely be back for some more steak!!!! The cook nailed it as far as cooking it to the temp I wanted. Way to go!!

Awesome awesome awesome,great steaks, the people are super friendly ready to please,and I've gotta say absolutely bye far the best bread pudding I've ever eaten in my life, I use to think that creme brûlée was my favorite, and they do make an awesome brûlée, but I will definitely get the bread pudding every time I go there!!!

We really like this place. My wife is Chinese and we've decided this is our local go-to place for very tasty Asian dishes. We also find the service very friendly and efficient. Give these folks a try, I am certain you will not be disappointed.

Hate how they nickel and dime you for every little thing like ranch dressing is an added cost. The waitress brought more chips to us for our chips and queso and charged us .99 when she didn't ask if we wanted more she just brought more she also charged us for salsa. And every time we go 3/4 the wait staff is pregnant. That's just an added bonus I guess.

Stopped here for lunch before a movie. Took fifteen minutes to be seated although there were many seats available. After we were seated, the waitress was cordial, we both ordered a beer from their highly diverse beer list. It took twenty minutes for us to get our beer order. She then took our food order, after another thirty five minutes the waitress brought us our fries. Just our fries, not our hamburgers, she said the kitchen made a mistake. When we finally got our hamburgers, mine had obviously been sitting in the window, it was barely above room temperature and the grease and juices had begun to congeal. The manager did comp us our meal, he was the only bright spot to the experience. He did offer to have my hamburger redone, but it had taken so long that we needed to get to our movie. 
To put it simply, this is The RAM, just add a 25-35% price increase to each menu item, and minus 75% on service and food.
This is a pic of my chicken noodle soup. Two carrots , one piece of chicken and lots of spaghetti. My strawberry fields drink was awesome though!

First time here and I'll be coming back. Fantastic beer selection. The food was amazing. Not your typical bar food here. I ordered the chutney app, delicious.
