I ordered the Ruben sandwich, BEST RUBEN IVE EVER HAD!  Decor is perfect and very clean. My service was excellent and quick. Silverware was clean, wine glass clean without spots.

This is one of the worst pizzas I have ever had in town.  It's obvious the kids putting the pies together have no technique.  They just slop ingredients on with no distribution.  The pizza cooks in an oven with a superheated steel plate and the handlers check for 'done-ness' based on the state of the crust.  Problem is the crust heats very quickly while the toppings on top do not.  

The restaurant interior is a place filled with a horrible cacophonous din.  I do not understand the appeal of the high open ceiling style restaurants.  They are noisy and uninviting.  

I came in with a free pizza coupon and got two pizzas.  One was their signature green stripe and the other was a custom one.  On my custom pizza they slopped the ricotta cheese and roasted garlic just right down on the dough, so it was all concentrated in one spot.  Both pizzas were flimsy with a very well done outer edge.  Pizza should be firm and crisp all over, not just on the outer edges.

At the eight bucks ish a pie that is neither sizeable or satisfying, I'd recommend just taking that money over to Little Caesar's instead.  This place is all style and no quality.

After a long day driving, checked into my hotel and saw this place in the guest book.  Called for delivery and they never showed up or called.  Got the machine when I tried to call them for an update on my order.  Horrible service, very disappointed.

Been coming here for years. Burgers are great. Love the tots, chicken strips, finger steaks...but not a big fan of their fries at all. Seasoning is fine, but the fries are just too...limp & mushy, even when hot.  Yuck.  
Wait time is longer than your typical fast-food place, but totally worth the wait. 
Prices aren't too steep, portions are large, & the staff is always nice. 

Love this place!

$6.75 for a beer and $9.25 for a small vodka cran? Do they realize this is Meridian, Idaho? The food was good - nothing to rave about. We sat at the bar instead of waiting 25mins for a table and our waitress/bartender was extremely attentive at first, but after we received our drinks she never spoke to us again. Our soup and salad came out after our food - strange? After sitting with empty drinks and napkins over our plates for 10-15mins another bartender wrapped up his lengthy conversation with the people next to us and asked us if he could clear our plates. At that time we asked for our check. It was extremely loud inside as well. We probably won't be back


UPDATE: 
Lidia from the Yardhouse contacted me on here which was surprising (see below), and we exchanged several emails about our experience there. I must say, I was quite impressed they read these reviews and care enough to contact the reviewers for feedback. She sent us a VERY generous gift card to the Yardhouse in hopes we would give them another chance. 

I returned last night with a girlfriend around 6:30 and decided to wait for an opening at the bar instead of waiting an hour and 45 mins for a table. We were told we could order a few drinks and cruise around to look for an open seat. We stood at a opening at the bar that didn't have seats, for a good 10mins staring at the bartenders and making eye contact before we finally asked if we could have a menu and order a drink. We finally found a spot and again waited and waited while bartenders kept passing us. We eventually asked for a menu and ordered. We did end up with a nice bartender and unfortunately his name is escaping me. He was middle-aged, tall, with brown shaggy hair. He always greeted me by my name (which was on our ticket) and kept our drinks refilled and was attentive. Ah! What a relief! I ordered the Penne with Chicken and it was good, however the noodles were a bit on the al dente side. Not my cup of tea, but I did really enjoy the flavor and the man next to me asked what I ordered. We did encounter a slightly intoxicated man next to us and after he left we had several members of the staff come and apologize to us.

Overall, I had a much better experience this time. I still think there are some improvements to be made and the music should not be as loud. As other reviews stated, it's way too loud to have a conversation in there. I will be back solely because of the excellent customer service Lidia has shown me. I will also continue to tell others how I was impressed with her.  

Side note: purse hooks under the bar! Love that!!!

The staff here is very welcoming.. The food was okay.. if you are looking for authentic Mexican food I don't recommend coming here. The mango chicken salad needed more mango and jicama in it. The fajitas where okay beans didn't have much of flavor.. the guacamole dip was just avocados with cilantro. No flavor. It was missing the onion the tomato the lime juice the salt. The only thing I liked about coming here was the services. Our server was great. On top of it all food was way over priced for the quality of the food.. I can't believe the avocado dip was $7 bucks I can buy everything I need to make homemade guacamole for $7 bucks.

I had called on a Saturday night at 5:00 or 6:00pm a few weeks ago and had such a great experience! I can't remember who I talked to, but I had very specific diet questions that the hostess had complete patience with! She even sought out the answers if she did not know them! She even at one point worked with the kitchen to fit my specific desire for sushi. I was very impressed. Great customer service!

This place has amazing blue cheese dressing!!!  
The appetizers are huge - definitely can double as a lunch order.  
They even have steak specials at lunch.

Yard House is a decent restaurant that has some hits but also some misses. Most of the sandwiches are top notch. My favorite is the Cuban dip and my wife's is the Turkey 2.0. The downside here would be the burgers. You can order them medium, just don't ever expect it to come less than medium well, or well done. The fries are thin, so they cool quickly. Way too often they come lukewarm. 

Other parts of the menu follow this trend. The carnitas and the chicken enchilada "stacks" are superb. Instead of rolled enchiladas, the come stacked with crispy corn tortillas. Each has it's own sauce. The mac and cheese full of chicken and bacon is also quite good. A half order is plenty for me. The pizzas are so-so. 

There are more than enough beers to please any aficionado and several decent wines by the glass.  

Given the hits and misses, topped by being pretty spendy, Yard House is a solid three stars. A little improvement in consistency and price would quickly bump it up a notch.

From the area, but live out of state now. Everytime I come back to town I hear I need to try this place. 1st time food wasn't bad and beer selection was good, but there was a huge fly problem inside. 2nd time  (today) fly problem wasn't bad, but the service was terrible. I'd like to comment on the food, but I can't because after ordering apps and a few beers we didn't see our server for about 20 minutes. Empty plates sat on the table and no one came back to take a dinner order. We paid, left, and went to a different spot for dinner. Not sure I'll give them a 3rd shot.

My wife and I have been to the Yard House multiple times, we go back because they have such a spectacular selection of drinks.  Our favorite is the Wild Turkey Double Bourbon stout, (or something like that),  An amazing dark beer.  Most of the food is pretty good, the BBQ chicken salad is one of the best salads I have ever tasted and they have some other good options as well.  Go during happy hour for discounts on appetizers and drinks.  The patio is excellent this time of year, it overlooks the rest of the village with the fountain and is very comfortable.  The inside is a bit dark for my tastes.

Went there with a fairly large group. The staff there were very helpful and accommodating to all of our needs. The butter rolls with the cinnamon butter was a very good start. The ribeye was very tasty and for the price was more than worth it. I was amazed at how large their menu was and at such an affordable price. Will definitely make more trips there in the future as it was an all around great experience with the food, the atmosphere and the service! By the way, throwing peanuts on the ground and not having to clean up was pretty fun to do.
Tried out Firehouse Subs tonight for the first time and was very impressed!  I cannot wait to go again.
Sorry but this food isnt authentic. I was in the mood for Mexican food, Los Angeles style. I wasn't impressed. Not worth going again.
The veggies were fresh.  They were skimpy with the chicken.  I ended up eating it with a fork and knife.   The girl making my pita seemed more engaged when I asked her to season it the way she likes.

Sakana has the friendliest staff out of any sushi restaurant I've been to. They are more than willing to answer any questions or help you decide on what roll you want. The Sushi itself is great, and is pretty decently priced. I will continue to give Sakana my business, since they always treat me like a valued customer and I never leave disappointed.

Always packed - and for good reason.  Steaks are always great, waitstaff is always very friendly, and, hey, all the peanuts you can eat.  A couple of fair caveats to make:  1) since it's crowded, it's going to be noisy; 2) expect a wait of at least 15 minutes - Fridays/Saturdays can get up to 1 hour+ (depending on the size of your group).  Great environment.

I've been using this practice for several years and I've been very happy on the whole.  They don't have all of the amenities that some other practices have, but they have been great about working with me within my budget and generally getting me in within a short period of time when I needed them to. 

Today I woke up with a really painful abscess, unfortunately they weren't able to get me scheduled within the timeframe I needed (immediately).  Out of necessity I scheduled with another dentist so that I could get my very painful tooth treated.  I called numerous offices in Nampa near my work and all of them were significantly higher priced, from 80% more to double the cost for the exact same procedure.  I was referred to Basic Dental because I was looking for a low cost dentist, and I never realized how much less they were until today.

I am sure that the reason they are booked out for 3 weeks is because they are so much lower priced.  They don't have TVs on the ceiling and they don't have cameras that can show you a real time picture of your teeth, but they will fix what you need fixed and it won't cost you a weeks pay.  They have given me temporary fillings in and out for $35, I've gotten an extraction for $88, they did gold crowns with the root canal for under $2000 for my husband.  

Basic Dental is exactly what they say they are.  Their staff is competent and friendly and they will give you basic dental care at an affordable price.  I know I don't need all of the bells and whistles that other offices have, especially if it keeps money in my pocket.  On the downside, if you have a painful emergency, they probably won't be able to get you in on the same day you call either.  Nevertheless, they are an excellent choice for routine care, and today's experience made me appreciate them all the more.

This is one of my MIL's favorite restaurants and where she wanted to spend her 80th birthday. We were a party of 6 but were seated promptly and drink orders taken fast by a very nice server. We ordered all over the menu and overall the food was quite good. I had the shrimp and calamari diablo over black pasta. This was very good, the seafood cooked well and not over done or rubbery, the pasta cooked very well and sauced nicely. The only dings with my dish were it must of set out for a bit because it was a little on the cool side and a nice piece of bread would have been a very nice addition. My brother in law ordered the fish and chips, love that we all feel comfortable enough to share because I was able to taste his as well. There were 2 generous sized fish portions, and these looked to be hand dipped. They were well seasoned but cooked just a little to long, still very good but just a touch over done we both agreed. My husband wasn't impressed with his pork sandwich, it fell apart. They very generous and brought my MIL a lovely desert out that we all shared. Beautiful location and I would go again!
Carpets look great and the price was very competitive.  They arrived on time and confirmed the day before.

Well, I am officially done giving this place my money and my time, to be honest.  Great location, good beer list, horrific service and below par food.  

We have tried several times, but it just keeps getting worse.  

This evening, upon arriving we had to wait for 15 minutes for someone to figure out that we had actually arrived.  Once we started to get up a waitress came from across the room and asked if someone had helped us, and then worked very hard to get us to stay.  We should have just left.  After bringing over our drinks, our half stoned waiter handed us our menus and then immediately asked us what we had ordered to drink and whether we were ready to order.  I asked for a few minutes...he returned 20 seconds later to take our order.  I once again asked for some additional time, which was met with a flippant response.  

After taking our order, he disappeared for quite some time and someone else delivered our food.  My daughter's burger included the top seal of a ketchup or BBQ sauce bottle, under the bun, which I guess was to show freshness.  My daughter expressed her thoughts with a resounding "Grrrrooossss!"  

There were no utensils or napkins until my son pleaded for a napkin near the end of our meal.

The food was okay at best, but the experience was an absolute zero.
Do not get an order to go!  You pay regular menu price for 1/3 of the food. You would do better going to a grocery store and buying the "pre-packaged" meal in the deli.

What an awful experience!!!  Worst service ever. We went for happy hour after work, and our waitress, after ignoring us for about 30 min even though there was maybe 2 other patrons in there....finally took our order and then came back to ask us each to describe the ingredients in the drinks we ordered cuz she didn't know how to make them (I ordered a cranberry margarita. She asked me 3 times what flavor that was...???) Then she brought us all the same thing....what tasted like weak strawberry juice.  Didn't bring straws, didn't bring napkins, even after we asked for them multiple times we had to go to the bar and get them ourselves. Then she came over and begged us to order appetizers cuz it would look good for her (straight up told us that!) When we said no thanks, she got our bill wrong( twice) and then blocked us in our seats as we were trying to leave, and asked us why we didn't tip her well. I wish I was exaggerating. What a waste of time and money

Firehouse is awesome. The owner us legit! He came out and talked to us and was friendly.  I loved the fact that he was genuinely interested in our thoughts.  The food is always good at both locations in Boise.

Buffalo Wild Wings is a good place to come watch sports occasionally and actually has better than average food based on the 5 or 6 things I've had off the menu (I recommend the fried pickles and lemon pepper wings). 
The only problem I really have with this place is the information overload. It's loud, there's about 40 TVs each showing different games, every member of the staff is crazy busy flitting from table to table... It is extremely difficult to focus on a single sporting event. Frankly, after an hour spent here you will begin to feel exhausted.
That said, give it a try on a football Sunday and see if BWW is for you.

This.Place.Is.AWESOME!!! We were visiting Boise recently, and came in here for the first time. They instantly greeted us and seated us. Loved the decor, LOVED the peanuts and the rolls (the cinnamon butter, oh my word!)! We were able to order off the early dinner menu ($8.99) and our food was great!! The manager came over to greet us and thank us for our first visit, and gave us a bag of peanuts to go! It was so thoughtful and made us feel welcome! Will DEFINITELY be back here!!

Let me start this review by saying I'm a huge fan of hibachi and sushi. Sushi is in fact my favorite food. I was persuaded to go to this restaurant based on it's high review. To say the least I was greatly disappointed from start to end.

To start our meal they sat our party of 5 at two separate hibachi grills because they were trying to fit two parties with one chef. I couldn't even enjoy the entertainment factor that the restaurant offers. I then ordered a coke and the waiter brought out a root beer. 

We ordered the playboy sushi roll which sounded amazing. For a $15 roll I was expecting something great. I have been to my fair share of sushi restaurants and know what I like. When the roll got to our table it looked fantastic, beautifully presented. However, the waiter once again forgot our side of eel sauce. The shrimp tempura in the  sushi wasn't even deveined. You couldn't even eat the sushi because as soon as you picked it up, it fell apart. 

I was disappointed that they didn't offer clear soup, only miso soup. The ginger dressing on the salad tasted off, which was surprising because I usually enjoy the dressing a lot. 

When the chef started cooking the meal I was hoping my opinion on the restaurant would change. Because there were so many people at our table, his proportions were off. I barely got any fried rice while other people were getting huge amounts. The vegetables were 90% onions. My husband and I both ordered chicken entrees. By the time the chicken was finished, everyone else was finished eating. I barely even ate the food. It had such little flavor to it.

If the meal wasn't bad enough, the server messed up our check. My husband and I were treating his family to dinner and wanted the check split between the both of us. Instead he put the two of us on one check and the rest of his family on another and gave the check to his father. After explaining to the waiter I was paying for bill A and my husband was paying for bill B, the waiter gave the bill to his father AGAIN. 

I wish I could give this place negative stars. I have never been more disappointed by a restaurant.

Just drove in from San Diego to visit family and went here to get me coolant replaced because I accidentally put windshield wiper fluid in the wrong place :-p. They also checked on my oil and saw that it was near black and recommended an oil change.  I'm glad they did because I had no idea we needed one, seeing as how our car has only been driven about 5000 miles.  After I saw the oil stick, however, I quickly changed my mind and decided better safe than sorry.  They also provided drinks to me and my passengers and were extremely courteous and kind.  We got a good laugh out of hearing the playful yelling of the employees.  You can tell they enjoy themselves and their work by their demeanor.  Would give 6 stars if I could!  Great place to go!

Quite possibly my new favorite . They cook your pizza in three minutes. The white top was so good I want to try every other pizza they make. It was savory and salty and the flavor were amazing.
Second visit just as impressive as the first. The bbq chicken pizza  . I go with their recommended  toppings. Their crust is chewy and crunchy at the same time. Their sauce isn't too sweet and just right.
My husband tried their beet salad and it was very good too.

******update. I ordered online. Either i am an idiot or the website isn't intuitive. My daughter is a vegan , i am not. Her pizza and mine were combined. It was so gross and if i were to order from the counter it would have been faster and correct.

We love Kahootz!  Been there many times and have yet to be disappointed.  Great place to just unwind with a cold beer (if you can pick just one from all of them).  Very casual environment and we always look forward to the specials.  This place is a must go.

I would return here with friends if the location was decided on without my input, but I would not be the one to suggest it. The wait time in the evening is horrendous. I got chicken tacos and they were EXTREMELY spicy. Service was great. Water glasses were tiny. I would say that the food was not worth the wait.

The food is absolutely fresh, hot, and delicious. Their portions are great sizes - ordered 5 plates of meats, an order of chow mein, and fried rice...fed a hungry family of 6 with leftovers. We will definitely be back. We ate inside and though it's a small restaurant, the service was great and they checked on us a few times...very courteous and friendly.

Took a family of four out for a reasonably priced meal.   We ended up taking half our meal to go for lunch tomorrow.   Service is great .   If you do not like country music, it's not the place for you.    $8.99 dinner special M-F until 6 pm with 2 sides is the way to go.

I ordered two California club sandwiches and chili, I have to say when I arrived to pick up the food, I had to wait awhile due to them being busy. The check out person was very pleasant and on top of getting the orders out as fast as possible! After picking up the food and arriving home, I was surprised how good the sandwiches and chili were. The sandwiches were cooked perfectly, and the chili wad good! I highly recommend this Chilis for a great meal.

This review is of Ian, a massage therapist.  I wasn't quite sure how to feel knowing my massage therapist was a male. Having had a bad experience over 15 years ago, I always made sure to see a woman massage therapist.  Due to an error in my appointment time I was switched to him and decided to give him a chance.  I'm use to only seeing females.  He immediate put me at ease.  I think being a male in this industry can either be a blessing or a curse.  Some refuse his service just on the basis of him being a man.  He was quite the gentleman and not once did I feel uncomfortable or exposed.  His technique is excellent and I was very relaxed by the end of the massage.  Not once did I feel he hurried or cut me out of my time, which I've experienced with others.  He actually went over my time by 10 minutes.  A lot of massage therapist watch the clock like hawks and skim on time which is very frustrating when you pay for 60 minutes.  I recommend Ian and hope those who refuse his service based on being a male, should give him a chance.  He does his job well and was very considerate.

For a chain restaurant, not bad at all!  We went there on a Saturday night and surprisingly did not have much of a wait.  The atmosphere was upbeat and had some country music playing as well as the football games on the big screen TV's.  The food was cooked and prepared as ordered the first time around, the staff were friendly and accomodating, and the price wasn't bad at all as well.  Only reason I don't give it five stars because it's not a stuffy, five star cuisine restaurant.  Great choice for a good steak, drinks, and fun atmosphere!

The service here is phenomenal! I've only been three time, had three different servers, and all of them totally rocked. The beer selection is overwhelming but they help you decide. The food is super expensive and I'll only go during happy hour when it's 100% worth the price! The Poke Nachos are my fave. The rest of their food is good too, just not worth the $ any other time. 3 stars for food (5 for Poke nachos) and 4-5 stars for service.

We knew they just had a remodel-re-open. Had not been before, so don't know what the remodel consists of, but were first struck by the incredible noise. It's Tuesday evening, 8:30. There is absolutely no sound buffer in this place, and, not only can we not hear what the server is trying to tell us, we cannot hear each other across the table. The walls are lined with 20+ TVs on various channels. We watched people, and can honestly say we never saw anyone in this packed house ever even glance in the directionless of one. We ordered some wings. I pray that they are edible, but, more importantly, that they come before I start screaming "will you all shut up?!"

Ok, we got our wings and they were good. The Asian sauce was really good. 

The best part of our experience was our awesome server, Alexis. What a sweetie. Very accommodating, very personable. She helped make what initially was pretty awful, a more pleasant experience, and if we ever considered coming back, it would be because of Alexis.
Worse happy hour ever!!!! On Friday who ends a happy hour at 4: 30 on a Friday! Very disappointed, service was ok but don't plan on ever coming back! To expensive

I love noodles and company everywhere. I've been eating the Penne Rosa for years! We used to go down to Denver and I would eat it every meal before my tennis matches.  I prefer it with feta cheese and without the parmesan chicken, but that's because I typically don't like chicken. Somehow,  whether I'm in Ann Arbor, Denver or Boise the service is top notch and the food is delicious too. Also where else can you get a side for $1.50?!
I love their bread, meat and salads.  A little spendy but great food.

I started using Dunn right about a year ago and since day one I had a good feeling about them,they were friendly and outgoing,I actually had to go back to work so I told them just to lock up when done, there totally trustworthy and I get my carpets done every 4 months just because Im anal and have a dog and I always just open the door and leave them to do the job. My carpets stay looking brand new :) oh and I forgot to mention prices are great stanly steamer charges double and Dunn right has the same quality equipment and does a Better job in my opinion..highly recommended!
It's an OK sushi place,  a sit down kind of restaurant.  The sushi (nigiri and rolls)  weren't anything to write home for,  the miso soup a bit disappointing.

Seriously disappointing! The staff attitude is rude and unwelcoming. They will rush your food to move tables. If I want fast Mexican food I will hit a drive through, thanks. Not only was the food poor quality and served lukewarm, the staff were annoyed to be bothered to help with minor things like refills or requests for napkins. This place could be a wonderful dinner venue. It is beautifully decorated. But the beauty is obstructed by the terrible customer service and second rate cuisine. Don't waste your time - you will leave with a bad taste, literally and figuratively.

MERIDIAN, ID: It's time for me to update my earlier review, Sakana is better than I originally believed.  Interior isn't flashy but its clean and pleasant.  The service is friendly.  The presentation and plating of the food is perhaps even above average.

I tried three menu items:

Hana Roll (4.5 stars): This was very good!  Flavorful, complex, sweet and filling with light citrus hints.  Also very pretty and with crunch.  Recommended

Mamasan Roll (3.5 stars): I bought this roll because many reviews have lauded it, but it was only okay.  The roll is pretty and a little sweet but lacks much flavor.  Just avocado, cream cheese and tempura shrimp, but no kick.

Chicken Katsu: (4 stars): This had a flavorful, crispy exterior and a tender, moist chicken interior that was fairly thin sliced and delicious.  Nice entree.

I often eat at Texas Roadhouse because I love their steaks.  They are great!  However, the music was even louder than usual.  I could not even hear our waitress when she told us about the special and also took our order.  The manager came around to check on us and I told him that the music was too loud and he offered to turn our section down.  Well, I could not tell that it had been turned down any at all.  Still too loud for my dining comfort.  It will be a while before I return.  I just do not like loud music when I want a relaxing meal.  Therefore, the rating has been reduced from 4 stars to 3.  Looking at other good steakhouses.

The Chipotle of pizza places. Really fast and surprisingly tasty. Wasn't expecting a whole lot from this place, but the ingredients were tasty and the crust was perfect. Decent sized pizza for the price as well.

Great bartenders,great service!My wife and I went on taco tuesday....Coronas were great,tacos were absolutely horrible!!! Tortillas were dry,meat was dry and hard.I couldn't believe they served them like that!They should pay more attention to the food they're putting out!!

At Better Life Chiropractic my health needs are treated with utmost importance.  The team really takes their time to get to know me and my lifestyle in an effort to provide the best care. After beginning chiropractic care at Better Life Chiropractic I noticed a marked improvement in my overall health and wellbeing. After suffering from food allergies for most of my life I experienced relief of symptoms within a couple days of my first adjustment. I highly recommend Better Life Chiropractic to anyone interested in living a healthier life.

Merritt at the register was a pleasure from the start. The staff was friendly and fast. I had a coupon, but with the $10 Tuesday, I did not need it! It is close to home. I will be back. The pizza is so yummy too.

Very poor service.  Slow, even during quiet periods.

The music is mind-numbingly loud.  It's difficult to even have a conversation at the table!

The food is so-so.  I've had much better.

The only thing going for this restaurant is a beautiful interior.  But, that only goes so far, when you're looking for a decent restaurant.

We won't be back.

This was an amazing meal. Our food was delicious and our service was great. Our server was friendly, but not too friendly and was unbelievably fast. Our food came out so fast. Everything tasted so good! (I definitely recommend the watermelon margarita!) Our whole dining experience was perfect and I would come back tomorrow. If you're in the Village at Meridian, you have to try Casa Del Matador.

Couldn't find what I was looking for, and a customer service girl offered help.  I wanted an electric model, but not in stock. She told me about another guy who bought one by ordering and delivered to his home.  He liked it so much he came back to order more.  So easy, I spent 5 minutes on order info and it ships to home. And this young lady assisting me was so knowledgeable and helpful, she deserves a raise.. Look for her carrying computer tablet on strap around her neck if you need help.  She's awesome!

Get the wings!  Seriously dinosaur-sized. The steak, red potatos, and asperagus are all amazing. It will be hard to go anywhere else when in town.  My waiter named Cody was a stud and he's single and I suggest that the ladies ask for him when they come in.

Enjoyed our Tuesday evening with a few other Yelper's to take part in the dollar sushi night.  I liked the concept of the cart which displayed the variety of sushi option for a $1.  It gave me an opportunity to try out different sushi rolls. However, I was so excited when I saw my favorite roll The pink lady was an option. Every piece I tasted was wonderful.

The services was just so so, took awhile for her to come back around.  Next time I will make sure to order more rolls in the beginning.  I will definitely be coming back!

This was my second time here. Went for dinner on new years day. I had been for lunch before and this was a pretty good experience.

I ordered the crab cake entree. The only thing I wasn't pleased about was the amount of butter on the plate. My jerk reaction was a little bit of disgust at the puddle of butter the cakes were sitting in. I only ate two of the three cakes and my stomach is not feeling good right now. But the cakes themselves were good.

Someone else got fish and chips and they were delicious. Light and flaky with delicious crisp batter. 

Another person in our party got the kobe steak cooked medium. I've had good cuts of american kobe and even tried authentic wagyu and this sirloin was just okay, but I still think it's a notch above your regular choice cut steak and perhaps on par with a prime steak. She has never had kobe or wagyu and thought it was excellent, so there's that.

Our server was pleasant and helpful. It was a little bit expensive though and I've enjoyed other restaurants' food at a similar price point more than I enjoyed this meal. I might not pick it for anything other than decent steak and the salad bar.

The Yardhouse is not great, don't buy the hype.  I've been to other yardhouse locations, and the boise restaurant failed to live up to expectations. First, the beer: it's incredibly expensive,  mediocre local brew selection, average pours and service. Food: we had 4 people and our waitress even told us some plays were getting cold waiting for the rest. Portions are lacking. My nachos were small in size, cold, and only served on one plate (should be cooked on one plate and served on an additional plate). Atmosphere and service were good, but I can name a dozen places where is rather drop $50 for one person. Try the Taphouse or 10 Barrel downtown for better food, prices,  and overall experience.

We saw the $1.00 sushi banner and almost turned around, but didn't. We walked inside, saw the décor, staff and clientele and almost turned around, but didn't. Folly, friends, pure folly.

This is frankly just bad sushi. All the decorations are vaguely Japanese-ish, but we couldn't find any actual Japanese there. Without getting into race, what we wound up getting was what would happen if someone described to someone else how to make sushi and then that person tried to make it. Lots of hiding going on here and we didn't get to the $1 sushi at all. So, we had various mayo stuff, crab with a "k", catfood sushi and a variety of old and stale fish. 

Beef tataki was cooked acceptably, but this is tataki by name only, unless tataki means basically very rare beef in a Sriracha soupy glop. The "seared' salmon was better, except the "seared" part did not exist. This is sushi that needs a lot of help, so expect to have to cover it in more sauce, ginger pieces, soy sauce and whatever else happens to be around. 

All in all, this is just extremely poorly done. There is better in town. Skip this place.

We LOVE the food here, but the music is just WAY too loud to enjoy the meal experience.  I swear it has gotten even louder over the last year.  Maybe I'm just getting old (I am early 40's!).  We do love country music - but please turn it down a notch.

Worst customer service ever!!! Both the girls that were there were such downers...  No smile , and when they had to ask us questions about what goes in our pita,  all we got was an attitude . They were so slow  No motivation what so ever. There was another girl with the most unprofessional look...  I love pita pit but never comming back to this one.

These guys are GREAT! We've been here for various reasons over the course of the last year or so, and we've always had great care. 

Front desk is friendly and helpful. 
Plenty of waiting room and parking. 
Nurses are friendly and skilled.
Doctors answer questions and don't make you feel like they can't wait to get out of the room, instead, taking time to listen, even if they are the only doctor there that day and you *know* there's a line.
Even on busy days, wait time was reasonable and staff kept us informed during our wait.
Called their billing team with questions on my statement and they were kind and helpful.

All in all, fantastic urgent care location!

Came here for dinner - it's 7:51 PM on Sunday, April 29th. Both the website, and door say they're are open until 10:00PM. Doors locked. Employees in the store just looks at us. No sign on the door stating they'd be closed early or anything.

I would give this place 6 stars if I could!
My husband and I went for lunch today and we're very impressed! We had the baked goat cheese starter and it was beyond awesome. We then split a burger( go figure, we went for pizza!) we had the Calabrian Chili Burger. The first bite, I was in love! The bacon pepper jam was astounding! The flavors just kept coming! Can't wait to go back and try a pizza!
Our service was also very good and the interior is very nice. Gonna try a pizza and drinks next time!
I love love love this place! It's super yummy. I would give 5 stars but sometimes the staff hasn't been friendly. I would feel not welcomed if I wanted to sit at a dirty table

Four stars and great food, but it'll cost you! Jakers is a place we don't go as often as we should due to the price of many of the menu items, but man, when you're looking for a delicious meal, excellent service and a romantic environment, this is a great place to go.

Food: We typically ONLY go for happy hour, so I will only speak to the appetizers here. The prime rib sliders are where it's at! They're like a French dip with the tastiest sliced prime rib in the middle. Oh yum, they're good! The salads are also really reasonable, being just perfect to add to the side of the meal. I have ordered the lobster bisque, and while the creaminess and taste is there, I wish the chunks of lobster would be bigger. Also, MAKE SURE TO GET the scones and honey. Those little dough balls are MONEY! 

Drinks: Great cocktails, especially if you can score them at happy hour prices. I like the lemon drop and wines.

Atmosphere: Very dimly-lit and cozy. This is a nice place to take a date if you're looking for an upscale spot. They also have a self-serve salad bar, which impresses me because it seems so different from the dark, cozy atmosphere. We also like their bar area and the fact that happy hour is served throughout the restaurant, not just at the bar.

Service: Fast, friendly and reliable. They know how to take care of you.

Happy Hour Offerings: $3 off appetizers and drinks daily from 4-6 and late happy hour, too. Enjoy it throughout the restaurant, not just at the bar!

Healthy Hack: Order the appetizer salad with a cup of gluten free vegetable soup. Healthy, filling and delicious.

Tips: Enjoy happy hour from anywhere in the restaurant. Score!

If you like ginger beer, this is the place. The Hawaiian Mule was perfect! They suggested the white sangria but I found it a bit fussy (pom seeds, s'berries sitting atop of a slice of blood orange). Good news is that if you don't like their suggestion, they take it off the bill. The VAMPIRE TACO is a MUST! The mushroom lettuce wraps were filling and very flavorful. They raved about the deviled eggs but truthfully they were too busy. There was a little bacon bite and a sweet tomato coulis of sorts on top. Not impressed. Rest of our meals were yum - mo.

My all time favorite burger joint. Everything made to order, not fast food in the best of ways. Go in sit down and enjoy, Fresh made fries and if you have a bug appetite I'd suggest the double bacon cheese, should satisfy just about anyone. Thanks for the quality food guys!

I loved the environment clean open beautiful and such lovely ladies all around happy clients I felt so comfortable and right at home first time I've ever walked into a salon and even before my amazing hair guru worked her magic thought this is where I will go from now on! Can't thank everyone there enough I'm in love and will definitely be going back! I'm a busy mom of two and I finally feel put together again my husband loves my new hair style and I do too! Alana made me so beautiful and made me feel that way too she's a hair guru i know very little about hair and I left there feeling confident with how to manage my hair and how to treat it. I've learned a lot from the gals there in such a short time and I feel so confident now definitely will be going back again And again! Very very amazing work for a very decent price I am one happy customer!

Except for the extremely sweet servers, I can see no reason to dine at Jakers.  The food is mediocre tasting, unappealing visually and such common fare.  But, the place is packed so I guess that's okay for some!
Ok wow for a new place this was a great deal and tastes great being from Queens I'm not impressed often but I was very surprised.

We had the fish tacos tonight. I know, we are supposed to order steak at a steakhouse, but sitting outside in 95 degrees...fish seemed a little more appropriate. 

Since we were going with the tacos, we also ordered the queso dip. It was very good...loaded with jalapeños and onions, but the Tillamook cheese makes it great. 

The tacos were just ok. The corn tortillas were undercooked. The Cod had good flavor, however. The salsa is too mild for my taste. 

The service is excellent. Friendly people and attentive.
Homestead is our new go to! Icey cold beer, waitress/waiter staff very attentive and get the beer on the table quickly! Love Shelby & Baby Dez!

Terrible wait! There's a reason for the popularity, that being the tasty food.  The long waits are NOT an issue of efficiency or lack of seating. Go right around 5pm if you can, we have waited a full hour for a table for 2 on a Friday night because we went at 5:40pm. They don't do reservations, fyi.  Bread at the table: Soft, sweet, I usually eat six of them. No appetizer needed! Full bar means a pina colada for me, their long islands are good too. Then, a 6oz steak with house salad and loaded sweet potato. Perfect. Actually slightly too much food, so if you go earlier it's about right to have time to digest before bedtime.  Pricing is more like $15/person with one drink per, I do believe that 'moderate' range is too large.  A regular choice for dinner.

This is the best dog park around! My dog loves it. It gives him the opportunity to be off leash and socialize with other dogs. Most of the dogs are friendly! We go their every weekend and have yet to see a dog fight. There is room to run around and play fetch. They provide plenty of dog bags so owners can clean up after their pets!

While in Boise, we had to have dinner here.  The Texas Roadhouse close to our home in California is always packed.  Well, same goes for this place.  Waiting wasn't too bad, maybe 25 minutes.   But during our visit to Idaho, the heat was blistering.  Waiting outside was out of the question.

The food is good.  Salad and ice tea were exceptional.  Our waitress was sweet.  The bread.... the bread is served with a cinnamon butter that is whipped to perfection.  Oh.... and you get a bucket of roasted peanuts and are encouraged to throw the shells on the floor.

Have gone twice for urgent care for self and family. Front desk ladies were above and beyond nice and friendly! Younger doctor with glasses who wears Converse is a great Dr. He not only helps you understand what is going on with you, but will related to recent studies that he's read and all with a nice, kind and patient tone. Very impressed!

First dog park I've been to and I wish I had my dog! I was just waiting here (like a creep) while my ride was coming.. 3 hours later- but I would definitely recommend this park! It was big, and so clean. I was surprised it wasn't all dirty and stinky, but people come in and let their dogs run their little hearts out and play! I was there on a Friday at 12-3 and there was a lot there too-
They have a little pool, a hill, water, rocks, other dogs etc. everyone cleaned up after themselves. They had more than enough benched in the sun and under cover. 
They also had a gate that separated big and little dogs (is what I assumed) in case you want your smaller dogs away from big ones. That area was a little smaller but just as nice! And there were small dogs with the big dogs too and there wasn't any problems. 
Just know dogs can be dogs. Some don't get along and stuff happens- bringing your animal to a dog park does put them at risk for anything to happen and you can't be overly protective when you let them run free with 15 other dogs.

I should have read the Yelp reviews!  Off to a bad start! Called and said will be 2 hours late, arrived 4 hours late. I called several times to verify a specific time, no answer. Once technician arrived on the phone, than stays outside for another hour. Very unprofessional! If I had not moved the furniture, I would have cancelled. The nightmare continued, the equipment broke down. Well at least after a full day of craziness, the carpet looks nice. Whew

We've lived in Meridian for some time but never stopped in to eat at Kahootz before tonight. It is clearly a popular place and has a good following of what appears to be regular patrons. The parking lot was pretty full so we were concerned that we might have a long wait but were seated promptly. The food was good, prepared well and adequate portions. My only criticism is that the service was a bit slow but then, they were pretty busy so I'll give them a pass on that this time.

If you're anything like me, you will have no coherent memory of your childhood, nor will you be able to muster a cohesive narrative as to how you arrived in that recycling bin so many years ago. Childhood, as I've seen on television was filled with tender moments, situational comedy and magic adventures that always seem to take a wrong turn before concluding with a lesson learned. All of this and more was experienced in my short time at Sakana Sushi. Now that the famine is over we can all give thanks for rolls that won't lead to a regrettable evening, but will transport you to flavor town. One way ticket! And as a self identifying "purveyor of special goods and services" I could appreciate the reasonable prices. I ordered the dumpling soup which was a little heavy on the onions and after taking it to go (so I could marinate the dumplings in ketchup and ranch for a few days) I decided they were PRETTY GOOD. All in all a great experience. My one complaint is that the dance floor left a lot to be desired and the other diners were not very receptive to alternative dance moves.
The most excellent bar service!Absolutely loved our bartender,Donnie. 10/10 would recommend the Presidents margarita as well as the queso & chips! The sirloin was also to die for!

Contacted by the restaurant management over the bad service & food.  Was very impressed with their response.  We are satisfied that they are going to try and handle my concerns. Hopefully we will try another meal in the future.

This is definitely a popular bar.  Very loud inside. I ordered finger steaks and onion rings.  Fingers steaks were good but the onion rings were burnt. When the waitress came by to see how our dinner was I told her about the onion rings and she agreed. My question is why would you serve burnt food? She did remove the charge for the onion rings and did offers me a new batch to take home.  Onion rings aren't really reheat-able. We won't be going back.

The service my girlfriend and I got was excellent, very friendly, polite and had a great sense of humor. We received our food really quick. We were in and out in about an hour and a half which was faster than I expected. I ordered a rare steak, and received a perfectly cooked rare steak, warm and juicy that literally melted in my mouth. With a excellent seer on the outside. My baked potato was delicious. The calamari I had was very delicious as well.
It is a bit spendy In my opinion but you get what you pay for. Highly recommend this restaurant. And will be going back.
Very nice place for a bite before the movies. The black bean queso or any of the tacos are very nice. Very good staff.

Great food and great beer!  This is a very popular restaurant on the weekend and its small so if you don't want to wait go during the week. Also not the most kid friendly restaurant. We went without our son and I don't think we would go there with kids.

Went on a Friday night so it was busy but we got a seat at the bar right away.  Bartender was very attentive and had no problem with me tasting pretty much all of the 40+ beers they have on tap.  Food was amazing.  My husband had the Alfredo which was more cheese and garlic than cream. So good!  I had the sirloin sandwich which had an ample amount of horseradish!  

I almost didn't write a review for this place because I want people to stay away but I had to say it is now my favorite Meridian restaurant!

Always outstanding! Wood fired pizza is tops in my book - love the commitment to authenticity! 
We love their pizzas, salads and appetizers. 
Our go to is the fondue appetizer and chopped veggie pizza. They also have an excellent happy hour food selection.
Great food with different specials everyday and a good selection of beer on tap. Really friendly staff also.

Visiting Yard House is always so nostalgic for me and my husband. We come from California and lived down the street from Yard House. However, having said that, the Yard House in the Village is by far one of the best. For some reason, the food tastes better here. The customer service is also great. We love the Yard House in the village and recommend it.

One of my favorite places! TR has always been a treat and never a disappointment. The only reason I can't give five stars is the long wait time...always a sign of good food, but never fun to endure.

Last night, however, we were seated and ordering in less than three minutes from entering the door. And the place was packed! How did we do it? We found a couple of places at the bar! And it worked out great.

TR is a relaxed, friendly place...a place I could go to monthly, or more often if my budget allowed. Not that it's all that spendy...a great meal and a drink can be had for $15 to $18. I've had their Road Kill special, as well as their pulled pork meal, and they are delicious, filling, and more than I could eat in one sitting. I love take-home boxes!

Last night's experience was typical of all of our visits to any TR. I appreciate being greeted upon first entering the restaurant. We asked about the wait...40 minutes, and then asked if there was a place at the bar. They said take a look and see what you find, and we found two seats open. 

Robin had a Pina Colada, and I had a Raspberry Tea Vodka...both delicious. The bread and cinnamon butter...delicious. Creed, one of the two bartenders, took our orders for drinks and food in a friendly, efficient manner. Food was set before us after maybe 10 minutes or so...delicious! 

I appreciate the variety of sides available. The bar was full, but not crowded. No one was rowdy, the music was not distracting, the televisions were showing a soccer game and a basketball game, volume muted, and that was ok. I'm not a sports fan, but I actually enjoyed watching both games...I like the symmetry of it all, I guess.

I fully intend to return to TR many times, and I can recommend it to all my friends.

Amazing prime rib!! Rolls were hot and fresh! We ordered side house salad with ranch dressing and it was super!  The atmosphere is fun if you enjoy country music and we do!! The waiter Michael was very informative and pleasant!  He told the manager Carlos it was our first visit and he came to the table with a gift!  Overall, this is a Great Place!  It's not Outback! Thank Goodness!

I have tried really hard to love this place. Since my initial review I have been in several more times and was having better luck but the last two times were not good at all. The 2nd to last time I went to lunch with a friend and we asked for no chips. They brought chips anyways and my friend asked them to take the chips away. We were told to just not eat them. I thought to myself ok bad server not bad restaurant. I went back with a small group of friends for late night happy hour and drinks. We were out celebrating, friend's kids had babysitters and we had our DD too. We had horrible service. We sat at the large table around the fire place. The waiter handed all of our waters to one person and expected us to pass them down so they didn't have to move. I had to ask several times for chips. (I know... we wanted them this time) I ordered a black bean queso dip and waited for chips and waited for chips then got them and my dip was cold but still really yummy! Then our waiter Chris ignored us for quite sometime. We wanted salsa for our chips and more drinks. Our food came out slow and not together so some were done eating and others didn't get their food yet and we waited too long for drinks. We had planned to stay all night but opted to leave and go somewhere else. Checks took forever too to no surprise. I generally am a good tipper and I tip on the full price of items not the happy price cost but not this night. I left extremely disappointed and thought food was still good just another crappy waiter. 

Now on to why I am writing the new review. I work at HPI and plan a lot of events. Some large, some small and this week we are doing a team building event offsite and wanted to do happy hour after. There will be 25 - 30 people on a Friday from 4-6 or so and I imagine several people will stay and have dinner and more drinks. I needed a reservation. I called Matador and have played phone tag with the GM Brad for several days. His assistant told me they only have the mezzanine but we couldn't have it on a Friday night because we wouldn't meet the cost minimum. I asked the cost minimum and he would not tell me. How does he know how hungry and thirsty we are? Only some food is on happy hour and the only drink special is a margarita so most drinks are not discounted. I think he should have at least told us and let us decide. I called again today to try and get something in place. Brad is not in a new gal who is also in charge of reservations told me they don't take reservations. I said not even for a group of 25 people? Was told no. I told her "Ok, thank you. We will go somewhere else." She tried to get me to secure the mezzanine where they do take reservations. I told her we just needed tables not the mezzanine/ private area she reminded me "We are a no reservation restaurant!" Except the mezzanine that you can reserve at their no reservation restaurant but only if you spend enough and you know what enough is. Guess that is not me. 

I wont be back and I really hope they do better training of staff for those people that do want to go there.
Awesome donuts, especially when they're have free ones. I love it when they're running the frosting waterfall. My kids really love this place. Great family fun
The donuts are awesome, as with any other Krispy Kreme. Love the simple plain donuts. The coffee was alright,  but sort of a typical diner coffee. Service was good too.

Worst hibachi ever! Slow service, steak over cooked, shrimp fishy and barely warm, fried rice had no flavor and not much of anything that made it fried rice (egg, onion). I feel a little bad for the cook, looked like he was the only one there on a super busy Saturday night. Will never be returning here.

Great food great people this place is amazing fiod is always great swrvice is better
I go here about once a month sometimes more one of the best places to eat in meridian

Great hot subs and fast friendly service! We have ate here twice and been pleased both times. 

Kids love the soda machine that literally has hundreds of options. 

Large subs are huge. Unless you are starving, you can get by with the medium.  The Italian is my favorite and slightly different than other places (sweeter). 

Highly recommended.
Pizza crust too thin and sloppy I had to throw half of it away because it was so incredibly salty. I would maybe give them another shot but mostly likely not.

This place is definitely hit and miss. I don't mind the loud noise, I don't mind waiting longer when it's busy, and usually the staff is really friendly. However, I do mind when I find a hair in my wings, get it re-made, find a second hair in my new wings, get it re-made again and then for the third and final time...I find yet another one. ALL IN THE SAME VISIT. Needless to say, I was incredibly grossed out and walked out hungry. I should have gotten the hint after the first hair. Haven't been back since.

I've been to Jakers many times but I haven't strayed from getting the French Dip sandwich. With all but one experience, the meal turned out very well and I cleaned my plate. 

The scones are also super tasty. Have to hold back from eating other dinner guests' share.

My friend loves their potato soup (that's saying a lot because she makes amazing potato soup).

Texas Roadhouse has a fun vibe and is a continual crowd pleaser. The service is prompt, friendly and professional. You are greeted pleasantly as you enter the establishment and thanked profusely for your patronage as you exit.

The food is served hot and to your exact specifications. The wait staff circles back shortly after your food arrival to ensure that it is just as requested.

The portions are ample and tasty. The place is fun but loud. Don't plan on having an in depth conversation here, it's too noisy for you to be heard.

I really love this store. I have only been there once so far, but I enjoyed my experience there and could definitely spend a lot of money. I needed some help making something for my friend and the lady who was working in the fabrics department helped me greatly! She helped me think of ideas, gave me her opinion when I needed it, and didn't stop helping me until I had everything I needed. I greatly appreciate it because it was a pretty important gift. The only problem I found with the store was there they had their merchandise spread all over the place. I was looking for a glass jar and one employee found three different spots that they were at and then I ended up finding another in a completely opposite spot. But other than that I loved it!

Wonderful food! I had the 10pz steak cooked to perfection with bacon and Gorgonzola topping. It came with asparagus that was to die for and red potatoes. The service was great. We also had the chocolate mousse dessert. That was amazing! Definitely go try this place and I will be back! :)

I was very excited to try the many vegetarian dishes they have, The gardien veggie orange chicken is amazing. The truffle fries are really good too. However the music inside is way too loud. Could not have a conversation. Went there again for the great veggie dishes but got take out the next time and ate outside by the fountain.

I realize this is just another franchise joint alongside Eagle, and I realize that the competition must be brutal, which is why I don't understand how this place can be so bad and still survive.

Let me begin with our waiter (they all were number 32 jerseys, by the way). The best way to describe him is with the word slob!  He was unshaven and looked as though he was probably unbathed..  He could have cared less that we were there, except for the fact that he was being shadowed by a trainee.  I guess in an attempt to look cool, he made bad jokes and talked down to us.  The trainee was excellent and looked somewhat embarrassed by the treatment we were receiving.

Most meals come with some sort of sauce, of which there are numerous.  I guess you are supposed to know what you want when you order, because if you don't, the rude waiter will tell you to read your menu!  We finally ordered some nondescript items and waited and waited and waited.  The slovenly waiter finally came by and we asked the status of our order, since the table next to us, who were seated and ordered after, had already been served.  He said, "We are really slammed right now."  That was odd, because the place was maybe 25% full - not sure what happens if they exceed that number.  So we waited a little longer and were finally served. It was not worth the wait!

If this Buffalo Wild Wings is representative of all of them, then I will have to say never again.

Went to Buffalo wings this weekend and found myself feeling blahzay about the atmosphere and the food. Felt like I could be in any town in any restaurant. The food was OK, the help was OK, the atmosphere was OK. So I guess, not bad but not good. Definitely didn't give me a reason to go back or try again.

The owner responded quickly to my desperate request to get my carpets cleaned asap today! Johnathin arrived on time, worked quickly and did a thorough job! Both were very polite and professional. They rescued me! Would definitely recommend their service and use again.

My wife and I have visited Jakers on numerous occasions.  Our experiences with servers has varied from great to poor. There seems to be little consistency in the service area.  Is it due to the inconsistent labor pool here in Boise? Maybe!

The food area seems to be more consistent and we can actually say we've never had a bad meal at Jakers.  Kudos to the chefs at Jakers who seemingly care about preparing nice meals. 

One recent annoyance observed at Jakers is that the servers no longer carry straws. Are you kidding? This isn't California, nor should it ever be. We were told it is now policy for the servers to not carry straws with them.  If a customer asks for a straw then the server must retrieve a straw from somewhere in the back. Seems to me that Jakers wishes to make a political statement. If not political why not allow the servers to carry straws?

Worst mojitos ever......pure club soda with one shredded up mint leaf inside.  We should have sent them back, but politely tried choking them down instead.

My trout was extremely dry and chicken parm mediocre at best.  Staff is friendly, but I wouldn't go here again.
Just love eating here the steaks are so tender the melt in your mouth great I'll always come back ! And say Hi to Billie she is great all the staff is wonderful
Was made fresh and the staff was very nice and kept asking us If we needed anything. So if your looking for a good burger and good frys go here!

Happy hour 2 to 4;30?  When everyone is at work?  Really?  Salad was tiny and $3.75 on top of meal cost. The salad was great but very small for the price.  We used to come all the time because the food is fabulous although i had the scampi that said Jumbo black tiger prawns and there is NO way they were Jumbo,  no way!  Bread pudding is to die for.  Not sure with those 3 reasons if we will be back.  Sad :- (

We ordered r pizza's and the manager was loading the veggies, onions peppers etc.. and than took my money for the pizza's never changed her gloves, I will never eat there again. Totally grossed me out I mean why wear the gloves if you are going to be touch8ng everything
Great company to work with! I would recommend them to anyone looking for a property manager.

This place is hard to see if you're not actually looking for it.  It's set back from the road a bit and the building is dark green so it sort of blends in with the trees that surround it.  We went on a Saturday and were lucky to get a spot out on the patio because they were quite busy that night.  There was a one man band playing a mix of blues, rock, jazz, etc.  The atmosphere was perfect!  The service was excellent, the wine was delicious and the food was pretty darn good too!  It's mostly a steak house but I ordered the fish tacos which were tasty!  Don't pass up the Queso Fundido!!  It's to die for.  Can't wait to go back!

Food was decent, a little pricey but considering it's in the Village, not unexpected. Took about 10 minutes to get a table. Service was slow, and drinks came out with food. Thought coming at 5:30 we'd beat the busy dinner rush, but even with a half full restaurant they were unable to keep up.

Why don't we live in Meridian so we can come here every night?? We can here as an alternative to our favorite soul food place on our vacation. We did not regret it! The steaks were cooked to perfection and seasoned well. Their special appetizer for crab stuffed portobello mushrooms should be a regular on the menu. The kids cheesy noodles were quickly gobbled up by my 8 and 6 year old. The teenager couldn't stop raving about the chicken alfredo. The many beers on tap were a winner with the husband. Finally, the full size bread pudding was big enough to share with my family of five and was simply amazing. This is a must on our future visits to the area!

Definitely a favorite of locals, and we were made to feel right at home from the moment we walked in the door. Service is superior, friendliness made us feel comfortable and welcome. Food was excellent and well prepared. Highly recommended! We will be back.

STARTERS: The truffle fries are FANTASTIC topped with some kind of magical cheese.  The salmon poke bowl comes with a generous amount of tuna dressed in sesame oil a bed some light veggies.

TACOS: I'm still drooling over the Korean pork belly tacos.  Absolutely phenomenal.  Very rich in flavor, topped with crisp kimchi.  The swordfish was great too, but a touch on the salty side.

DESSERT:  The cheesecake and coffee Sunday are giant portions, best to share.  I also tried the mini cobbler, which didn't come out s as warm as I'd like, but who can day no to ice cream over crumble topping?

Awesome service! Einstein's is an appropriate name, their operation is pretty genius... Good prices. they bring you a beverage, offer you a newspaper or kindle, show you everything they are doing...They give discounts for getting your next oil change within 500 miles of the recommended mileage. Will check/top off fluids and tires in between oil changes for free. They gave me such great service, they even changed my brake light for free! Highly recommend!!

First time to come to this restaurant. Service was good, ambience not the greatest... dark, step up to booths, bar prominently placed as you first come in and decor could use a fresh update. I had the New York steak cooked medium rare. It was very flavorful with roasted rosemary crusted red potatoes and asparagus. Potatoes good asparagus average. A bit tough.... I think the prime time for asparagus is a bit past. All in all I probably will not e back I can get a good steak with better atmosphere elsewhere. But they advertise meet your friends here... I guess my friends and I we'll meet elsewhere.

First time here great impression. My food came out in a timely manner, and I ordered one of their "back and cheesier than ever"' s, the Truffle Mac, and it was definitely different, but very good. I will return, and try other dishes

One of mine and my husbands favorite places! Great sushi and service! Everyone is very friendly. Can get a little busy and food may have a little bit of a wait time, but the 1 star reviews are ridiculous. I have never had bad sashimi there and have probably had their food over 30 times, at least at the Meridian location.

We went to Kahootz's last summer and we're very disappointed. The beer is good but that's were it ended. I ordered a NY steak! medium rare. The steak came out after a long wait and it was still quivering. It was barely cooked on the outside. I don't usually send food back and will just eat it but this was ridiculous. 

I got the steak back about 2 minutes later! Still raw, hmm, imagine that. I sent it back a third time and got it back in about 3 minutes, still raw, hmm, imagine that.

I gave up on it and sent it back for good. At leash they didn't charge me - though I wouldn't have paid anyway.

But hey, did I mention the beer was good;)
My son and I ate here the other day and now have a new favorite burger joint.  Food was excellent.  Staff was incredibly friendly.  Good prices. Nothing too complain about.

Had the most amazing dish I may have ever tasted here.....Crab Stuffed Mushrooms - stuffed with red crab and topped with Parmesan and jack cheese (and this cheese is the real stuff people!!  Had 4 other appetizers to die for.  Our waiter Jarod was an incredible host and made our experience even more awesome!

Great new find in meridian. Stopped here for lunch
Am pleasantly surprised at the quality and service. 
You can tell they care about their customers. 
Hot and sour soup delicious. Mongolian beef incredible. Crispy egg roll. You can't miss here. Come check it out.

I've been coming to Main Street Burger for years. The staff is cheerful, they hustle, they get orders right, and do so during the busiest times of the day. One of the best burger joints I have ever been to and will continue to go, and often. GREAT FOOD!!!

VERY HIGH PRICED beer. Huge selection but not worth the serious over pricing. Had 2 appetizers with my wife. Fries were great. Shrimp were dry and over cooked. Will not be going back. Better food and better pricing everywhere.
Update, Manager reached out to me and sent a gift card. Appetizers were very good this time. Beer pricing still high for the area. 
Very friendly waitress.

Just in town visiting family for the holiday and we swung on by Blaze...  Kind of a Chipotle operation they got going on here.  Good Idea!  

The girl at the cash register who took our orders was super-duper excited to give my wife and I the run down on the deal here i.e. build your own, get a signature pie, or get a signature pie and customize it the way you want it... still the same price for added toppings... just $7.25.  

Great Deal!

When we got our orders, which wasn't too long, the crust was nice and thin and crispy and the flavors were spot on.  I got the Link In and my wife the White Pie.  My sister got the Artist and my nephew, a Simple Pie (cheese only).  I only wish I had added more because although I was content upon our exit I felt I could've eaten more.  I'm a fan.

Surprisingly cool vibe for a strip mall joint. Lots of beers and a decent selection of whiskies.

The wings were good tasting but even though I ordered them extra crispy, they were still a bit soggy for taste but not a bad effort. The Outlaw Mac, on the other hand, was over the top, packed with bacon, cheese, jalapeños, and a hog onion ring on top.

Good solid effort with good service. I'll be back to try the Monkey Shoulder whiskey.
Food is fine! Typical chili's.... but majorly understaffed. Went on Mother's Day and there were 17 empty tables and we still had to wait 30minutes. Needs new management!

High quality food, and excellent beer selection.  The staff is friendly and competent.  This place has been my go to lately!  It's not the least expensive, but the quality is solid. I've never been disappointed with this place.

We waited forever for our meal and it wasn't busy.  We were there at 4:30.  I had to ask the waiter of they could please turn the heavy metal music down...we could even have a conversation.  The good was ok BUT THE BIGGEST THING WAS I THOUGHT WE WERE GOING TO BE CARRIED AWAY BY FLIES!!!  IT WAS REDICIOUS!!  Won't go back, thought it was very unsanitary....

Went in for a late lunch and were disappointed we couldn't get a steak. But, the waitress gave us a dinner menu and said we could order anything on it except the prime rib and baked potatoes because of the time it took to cook those. So we each had a rib eye steak and I had sweet potato fries and my husband had the scalloped potatoes. The sweet potato fries were quite tasty, but when I tasted his scalloped potatoes I wished I had ordered them instead. They were delish!  The rolls (they called them scones, but the Brits would take exception to that) were warm and yummy. We decided to go ahead and get dessert. Ordered the creme brûlée and it was exceptional!  Yes, it was a little pricey but we both thought it was well worth it. Highly recommend. It did have a rather amusing wall between our row of booths and the next. The lower half was mirrored and the upper half was clear glass. So when you look at the wall you saw your (and your dining partner's) body and the other table's heads. So I saw my female body and a male bobbling head because the guy on the other side of the wall bobbled his head as he talked. My husband and I were quite amused.

Came here last week with a couple of friends. Very nice ambience, the decor was dimmed as well as half lit lighting.

They must of had over a 100 different beers on tap from light to dark. Really nice setup as well with the full bar. 

We started with Drinks and Appetizers, I can recommend the Blueberry infused beer as well as the Moscow Mule here. 

The Beer served in a chilled glass 
The Moscow Mule served in a metal tin cup. as it should be. 

Both had great tastes. I had 3 rounds of the Moscow Mule and 2 Rounds of the Blueberry infused Beer.

Started off with the buffalo wings all traditional with there spicy buffalo sauce. Yum. still juicy inside with the spice on the outside. not over cooked but prepared just right.

we had 2 rounds with the wings as well as a house salad with blue cheese dressing. They have real blue cheese dressing here. i could almost eat it from the jar it was good.

first time eating at this location for me and the experience will definitely have me coming back for round #2

the service here is really on point as well. if our server was busy and another server saw me looking up they came over to help out right away. great work ethic

Never fails...... you go in for one thing and come out with 10! Not only is this a great place to get home decor but it is also a great place to find random gadgets to make your daily life a little easier, especially when it comes to cooking tools. The service is always friendly and the lines are fairly fast. There hygiene department is surprisingly big with a better selection than even Walmart, not sure how the prices compare but worth checking out. If you are ever looking to buy some really fun widgets for your home and have a few extra bucks to blow, you will certainly find something that interests you. I mean really, who doesn't need a potato / french-fry slicer?

Always a little wait time, this is a busy place! Fresh food, classic drive in style. Finger steaks are super with an excellent side dipping sauce, the crispy chicken salad is another favorite. Not on the menu, but they make a fountain scotch and soda. Try it, you won't be disappointed with the food.

We don't shop much at Walmart in Portland, but when we visit Jesse's family in Boise, we come here for grocery and such. I must say, this is the most organized and clean Walmart I've ever been to. They have everything here from salon, cell phone kiosk, family portrait studio, and even place where you can cash your checks. 

I found out they sell Horchata in cartons at the refrigerated juice department. I've never seen that before. That's pretty awesome. Also, they have Churros cereal. We didn't get any, but life will never be the same knowing I can eat churros in form of cereal for breakfast. Combine the churros cereal with Horchata, I wonder if my day will be fantastico and faboulouso?

We went here for the first time on Mother's Day. It was packed but we got a table quickly. Our burgers were great and at the end I got a dessert on the house to celebrate the special occasion and I thought that was pretty awesome, rarely does anyone do anything like that. The waiter was super friendly and always made sure we and the kids had everything we needed. Can't wait to go back for some more truffle fries

I don't know why I chose to come here, I should've known better. I almost feel like Taco Bell's food is better. I know, that's going far. They're Spanish rice and has to be pre-made and come in cans. Also, Rosarita refried bean are way better. I'm giving them two stars because they have good salsa.

Superb care. From the moment you walk in, everything is geared towards children. The reception area is bright and comfy, I've never had any excessive wait times to be seen. They have a nice little play area for the kids while they wait. All the dental assistants I've met genuinely seem to care about what they do and have been wonderful with my kids. Highly recommend.
By far some of the best sushi I've ever had. My boyfriend and I try to come here at least three times a month. We are never disappointed with the food or service.

Pizza, football & family make for a great Sunday evening.  However, I was really disappointed with my experience at this Chicago Connection last night.  We called in our pizza order thirty minutes in advance and had to repeat the order a few different times.  When we arrived to pick it up only one of the two pizzas was ready so I asked the employee if I could add on a family size salad.  He told me that they only had one size but several questions later he admitted that he was a new employee and he should probably go double check.  He came back with good news that they do in fact have a large salad container.  The restaurant was pretty dead but it was clear that they were understaffed for a pizza & football Sunday (especially considering that the nice young man helping me was new and had little experience).  I was given a salad container to build a salad while we waited on the 2nd pizza.  The salad at the bar was nearly gone and what was left was floating in water... Soggy salad?  No thanks!  After a 20 minute wait and reminding them at least 4 different times someone finally refilled the salad.  The dine in customer that didn't want to wait drip dried her lettuce while complaining.  

We finally got home to a house full of starving adults and children and a game that had already started.  I was two bites in until I realized that they didn't even get my order correct.  My FAVORITE pizza is the combination with white creamy garlic sauce NOT red sauce.  I can't eat red sauce because it's too acidic.  Unfortunately they used the wrong sauce even though we specified which sauce three different times when placing our order.  Apparently they specialize in delivery and next time I will go back to my usual location in Meridian.

After a long day of driving, Hampton Inn reception suggested Jakers when I said "steak".....even had a menu.  Great suggestion....very good food and excellent service! A little pricey, but worth it! Enjoyable evening.

I can only give a review of their sushi. I spent over 80 dollars worth of sushi on a take out order. Service was great and timely when I arrived. Took the food home and ended up throwing away 3/4 of it. No flavor, sloppily made rolls, and just plain awful. Albertsons sushi is a step up to this place. Last time I come here for sushi for sure.
Such a fun environment. Great food if you're a foodie. It is more on the $$$ side. The only negative is the restroom was out of stock and dirty. That was definitely an appetite suppressant.

First time trying this place and it was pretty good. I had the honey chicken and my wife had honey shrimp. Overall the food is good just wish the portions were a little bigger for the price. & wish they added more honey sauce to our entrees. Customer service is good. Calm environment very quiet. Almost too quiet haha
Needed my Carpets cleaned after the winter season. Dunn Right came in for $50. And absolutely killed it! I will never use another service. One phenomenal job is all it took to gain my loyalty.

This was our first visit but certainly won't be our last because every dish came from the kitchen fresh, hot and tasty! It is our new favorite Chinese restaurant and is close to our home in Meridian. The menus was surprisingly expansive and varied. Will definitely be back. Because the portions were liberal, we had leftovers for 2 meals for both my wife and me after eating our fill at the restaurant. Oh by the way, the wait staff was pleasant and knowledgeable, always a plus!
I was attacked by dragons whilst eating my savory pie. After yelping for help the waiter was neither prepared to fight with either sword or bo staff. FACT! Pizza was delectable though.

My boyfriend and I have been to this location a couple times with no problems but that changed tonight.
