We ordered their spinach dip for an appetizer, but with my second bite I bit into something that stabbed me in the roof of my mouth, when I pulled it out I saw that it was a piece of wood. Come to find out, they use little skewers to stir their artichoke dip. It's all good though, we received some coupons, and a sorry for getting stabbed in the mouth.
These folks could not be more professional! If you choose Josh and his team you will not regret it.  Fair, honest and dependable.. and they know what they are doing.

Pretty damn good pizza for 7.50.  You can put whatever you want on it.  Do yourself a favor and check it out.

Five stars because I can't really think of any improvements I would make.  This is well-executed QSR.  And they have beer.

This review is about Chili's in general and not this particular Chili's. 
On the whole. Chili's is cutting corners with their food quality and ignoring their customers council. The food they serve looks nothing like what is on their menu, the quality of food is poor. Once they had amazing chicken fried steak you could cut with a fork. Now it's smells like rotting meet, is very thin hard to cut with a knife and almost impossible to chew. Hot wings are very very small, nothing like menu. Poor. Quality chicken, and disgusting. The new commercial....really, look at the huge one being shown being eaten. Then look at the skinny scrawny taco time burito shown all rolled up at the end. Allfiction. Yes Chili's is on their way out of business because the don't care anymore.

Good food, horrible service. I love eating at Chicago Connection when I'm visiting town, and was excited to bring my husband here to try it. We  got here around 1 and were seated fairly quickly, but continued to wait for 20 minutes and never received drinks or had any contact from our waiter! So we left and went somewhere else.

Very impressed with this place! Awesome, friendly staff. Pizza came out in minutes. Very decently priced, especially for all the options available. All of their ingredients look extremely fresh. The blood orange lemonade was great too. Most definitely will be back!

Yard House has a great beer selection. The service is usually pretty good, but suffers a little (especially at the bar) when the place fills up. I suppose that's pretty standard, so it's not really a negative, just something to be aware of. Service is very prompt when it's about half-full. When it's busy, the wait time for a table can be anywhere from 10 - 45 minutes.

I have noticed that during happy hour, Yard House gets really busy and it can be hard to flag down your server to get another drink or appetizer. It is a little pricey for what you get and meal portions are on the small side, but happy hour prices are lower and help you feel a bit better about that fact.

The food is passable, but nothing particularly noteworthy. I have had several different menu items and they've mostly lived up to their descriptions. They're not bad, but they're not great. 

This is a good place to go if you have some time to kill before seeing a movie. If you're in the village and desperate for a good beer, this is the place. Otherwise, there's no real reason to go out of your way to come here.
3 stars for rude community members. Great facility however, I would make this a destination dog park in the future.

Girls lunch and movie date! We chose The Yard House because of it's proximity to the theater and we've all wanted to try the food here. We ordered the lobster dip appetizer and all agreed that it tasted rather fishy, like tuna. Four hungry girls but we only finished half of it. Two of us ordered the lamb burgers and two of us ordered the roast beef dip sandwich. Both lamb burgers had soggy bottom buns. They were so soaked that they were inedible but the burger itself was delish! The roast beef sandwiche however, were a hit! Two of us also ordered a beer. One ordered a second beer but the server brought the wrong kind. She offered it to anyone else at the table who may want it so we accepted. Another 5 min and the correct beer came along. When we received the check the incorrect beer was included but they righted their mistake once we pointed it out. 
They didn't seem to be overly busy yet the service was slow and inconsistent. We had to ask for things like water or a side of fry sauce multiple times. The food was ok but I expected better for the location and price.

Standard Walgreens. Convenience store with pharmacy, photo services, make up, snacks, drinks etc. 

Low prices and rarely any lines at check out.
Excellent sushi and sake was hit and delicious! The service was fast and there was no waiting to get a seat. Great place to grab sushi or habachi!

I love to frequent texas roadhouse. I have tried different locations all over the US. Our service here last night was phenomenal. The 1 stars I am giving is specifically for service. Our waitress was very attentive and friendly. Our water cups never went empty and we received out food in a timely manner.  

Before I move onto the food im going to explain why we left not only angry but frustrated. I have a serious heart condition that is soon needing surgery and about 1x per day I tend to black out. When we were finished with our meal I used the restroom and upon walking back from the restroom I blacked out and hit the ground pretty hard. The paramedics were called and I was on the floor for 5+ min. When this happens, my breathing and heart both stop completely. I had a few family members so worried- they were in tears and distraught.....and during all of this we were pestered by two different woman to "hurry and pay our bill." I would NEVER leave a restaurant without paying and nor had I planned on it. Although,  the fact that instead of worrying about making sure their customer was safe and taken care of- they were so worried about the bill to the point that they had asked 3-4x. I will never go back to this location and I hope that one of the owners or managers sees this review. I have been a loyal customer to texas roadhouse for 8 years and as of last night my family members nor myself would probably ever return.

The food on the other hand was a huge let down. There were 6 people in our party and 4 out of the six meals were either wrong or overly dry. 
The food:
Rattlesnake bites- they came out raw....they mushed as you picked them up and didn't look like they had even been cooked. (These are normally deep fried balls of cheesy spicy goodness). Instead, we received raw mush.

Potato skins: looked and tasted as though they sat under a heat lamp for 20 min or so before being served to our table. They were chewy, cold and greasy. 

Chicken fried steak: 2 people at our table ordered the chicken fried steak and they both received chicken fried chicken. ....so both had to be sent back. By the time the meals were corrected, everyone was done eating and ready for the check (extremely frustrating).

Smothered chicken: the chicken was so dry! It had the consistency of jerky! And the mushrooms and onions on top were saturated with cold oil!

Chicken critters: the chicken critters were dry (again) and tasted like old grease. Think lots of breading and hardly any meat.....ew

Oven roasted chicken: tasted as though it had been soaking all day in a giant vat of oil or juice and then they cooked the crap out of it...even the skin was soggy. 

I would avoid this place at all costs. The food is not up to par with normal texas roadhouse standards and they do not give two craps about their loyal customers. 
1 star/rant over

Counterintuitive to logic, parking and going inside when there is a long drive thru will NOT save you time on getting a cup of coffee...at least the third or fourth time I have gone inside with only two people in front of me and they forgot to pour my coffee. I waited patiently and nothing.  Finally had to ask barista where my coffee was. Hey Corporate coffee take a clue from McDonalds and get your systems in check. This location hit or miss for service with a smile

This is my 2nd and final visit to this establishment.  Came in at 1:30 for lunch, we had to send the tacos back to have them remove the crema sauce.  It was a good 15 mins before she came back with the tacos.  The place was empty and the service still SUCKED! 
Never again!
Slow service, confused waiter. Less than awesome experience. One plate at our table was brought out a full 10mins before the others. Weird! Won't be back, way too many other options!

Disappointed with our experience on Sunday evening.  After a 10 minute wait, we were seated at one of the several tables that had been empty our entire wait.  The temperature inside was freezing!  Even with light jackets we were cold.  There was only agreement that it was cold when we complained.   When dinner arrived, my Mom received a cup of soup instead of a bowl and my mac and cheese was luke warm.  It quickly turned cold in the cold room.  We asked for pepper and was given a lone pepper shaker without its salt companion.   Our fountain drinks and water were not filled until we asked and another glass of wine was not ever offered to my Mom.  Even though we were seated in the middle of the room, I felt ignored, or like I was in a cafeteria.
Best Italian Sub in Idaho, Hands Down.  Wish it was a little cheaper, but other than that amazing subs.

Transparent, fast and efficient, offers extra services but never pushy. I like that they ask me about my car! The only place I will have my oil changed in my Mini Cooper other than brand (Mini/BMW) certified technicians.

I just showed up to the restaurant to grab some food and a couple drinks and my ID was a little bit messed up. They had taken it before and this time had decided not to take it I then asked to talk to the manager who treated me so poorly that I will never come back again. He then told me that if I come back again I would be trust past and he also called me a bitch. his name is tanner.  I would never try to get anybody in trouble but I am going to call corporate and let them know not only how poorly I was treated but how imature and a responsible their manager is I can't believe they let him on the store. I will never come back again and I wouldn't recommend it to anybody I will be in touch with his boss at corporate

I believe most chains are 3-3.5 stars or less.  I gave them 4 stars because the place was packed for a ufc fight and the service excellent.  I love their soft pretzels with queso dip.  I got the small boneless wings and live the chipotle bbq and Parmesan garlic.  My favorite combo is dipping the wings in the queso dip!!! Live that combo!!!
Great food,  prices and atmosphere.   I'd give it 5 stars If they didn't have such a cappy beer selection!

Love me some Yard House.  This is a great place and we frequent regularly with our familiy.  If you are looking for variety and options, I mean LOTS of options this place will not let you down.  Friday and Saturday nights are busy but that is to be expected.  Food has always been consistent and high quality.  Our kids are big fans of desert.  Keep up the great work Yard House, great to see you in Boise.

Texas road house rarely let's you down. And today was no exception. They did great. The service was wonderful the food is always good and the peanuts are addicting. Lol. My only complaint about this visit (which is not a reflection on the staff) is these 2 alternating crying babies at the both I was siting in. lol. They were not happy campers at dinner but hey that's why they have loud music playing. Lol.

We finally tried Kahootz after several rave reviews and I have mixed feelings about it.  The food was delicious but I was not a fan of the drink situation and the service was SLOW.  I did not feel that our experience was worth the $86 + tip tab.  

When we arrived around 6 there was only outside seating available and it was too HOT.  We oped to sit at the small bar and order a drink while we waited for a table.  They didn't have a large selection so I ordered a grey goose with 7up and sprite.  I thought it was very small and weak for $8.50.

We started with an appetizer of chips, queso & salsa.  I'm pretty sure I could eat the queso everyday!  I ordered a side salad with ranch and a baked potato as my meal.  The potato was cooked to perfection.  My husband had the Garage Grinder and it was very good and flavorful.  We did not order dessert but next time I have to try the bread pudding... Someone in the room ordered it and the caramel smelled yummy.

Our server was very nice and did a great job but I believe she was the only server.  We waited a loooong time for food and drink refills.  They were also sold out of prime rib by the time we ordered so go early if that's what you're looking for.

The grade is based on ambiance, not the quality of food.  

I was hoping to sit down and have some PIzza but was very disappointed that this establishment had zero TV's so I left.  What kind of pizza restaurant don't have TV's showing sports?  Another disappointment, no bar.  The way it's currently set up, this place appears to be more of a to go joint, rather than a restaurant although there are plenty of tables. I was hoping it would be similar to Grimaldi's, also located at the village.
Noodles & Co. is my life and regardless of the fact i can hear myself getting fatter after every trip here, it's worth it. Spicy Korean Beef Noodles make me want to be a better person.

This was my first time here and it was great.  My friends and I were seated promptly.  Our server was really friendly.  The chips and salsa were delicious.  Their salsa was spicy and savory...  The best I've tasted.  The happy hour menu is great. I got the frozen lime margarita and the shrimp quesadilla appetizer off it.  The margarita was delicious.  The shrimp quesadilla was amazing.  The shrimp was cooked perfectly and tasted fresh.  The crema it was served with was super tasty. While the frozen margarita was great,  the bartenders margarita was even better.  It's by far the best margarita I've had.  For my entree I had the chicken fajitas which were yummy and served sizzling.  My only critique of the dish is that there were too many onions and not enough peppers. This place is definitely one of my favorites now.
I love how fast the pizzas come out. Make sure to salt the crust or add pesto to the crust before baking.
Don't even have to get out of the car. Plus you get a drink to go along with it. And as a teacher you get 12 dollars off every time. I might be coming here from now on.

If I could give 1 review for taste and a 2nd review for everything else I would, so my average is a 5 star.  I have been eating at Noodles for over a decade in different states.  I was one of the first ones to walk through the doors when they came to meridian.  I have brought dozens of people to this location.  I left the state for a year or two and came back to noodles and I must say, I was disappointed.  I wasn't so much disappointed in the taste, it tasted pretty good.  The prices and portions didn't match up.  Something has changed.  When I got a look of shock that my $9 bowl of noodles was smaller than it used to be the manager made me feel like garbage for saying something.  Either I'm getting bigger or the portions have changed.  Something is definitely different.  Used to be a good bang for your buck, now it's a decent bang for your buck.
Been going here for about 3 years. Staff is great and so is the service. Ladies up front are a little ditsy but they get the job done.

Came here for the first time today to celebrate a big sale with my sales manager. Skyla (I believe) was our bartender and she was great.  When we went to close out Skyla asked how we were getting home, as to express concern for our well being. We told her we were getting picked up which was true.  When we walked out we were followed out by some wanna be restaurant manager who said she was gonna stand there until our cab showed up. We insisted that we were not taking a cab and didn't need her to "wait with us." She responded with, "ok I'll just call the cops than." Irritated with her response we went back inside and talked to the actual manager who apologized and comped our bill. 5 Minutes later our ride showed up...like we said. I've never been treated with such disrespect and will never come back again. Maybe her intentions were good but her approach was terrible. First and last time I'll ever come here.

What a great find! Family owned and operated (it appears) right on Ten Mile and Ustick. The dishes are tasty, not loaded with MSG, and the portions are very fair. Prices are reasonable. The Atmosphere is friendly and clean.

So I normally would give this place a 5 star but today was just meh. Usually the food is great, service is just as good, and I haven't really had an awful experience here. Now that being said there are some days that the food is just okay, nothing special. Also I guess they have changed their drink preference where you can't substitute for a shake anymore. Now their shakes are delicious but they are stingy as hell with their size. To my knowledge they only offer a 16 oz. I have asked for a larger size when I first started eating here (a couple years ago) and they said there is no larger size. Anyways overall its usually good but maybe it's when certain people are working that makes it seem like an off day?

I have been to a lot of papa Murphy's, but this one is by far the best. It is clean and the service is incredible. I had an online order and it was done exactly on time. The manager was so friendly and I could tell she cared about her store. I was very impressed. Will definitely use this as my "go-to" papa Murphy's from now on.

My family and I came here for a quick dinner and we were definitely impressed! There are lots of drinks to order from and the prices are great. The sushi rolls were crazily presented, we loved the uniqueness! We will be back for sure! :)

Wow, absolutely amazing food. Love the owner, you can truly tell that he loves what he does.
Do not forget to order the bread pudding for dessert. Simply mouthwatering, melt-in-your-mouth decadence!
$8.00 for a PINT of Pilsner (in Idaho)? I MIGHT expect that in Manhattan. Sure there are good beers available, but not for that price!
Not that great for sushi. All rolls taste similar. Somebody recommended this place to us and I was disappointed. For the best sushi try Simple sushi in Nampa. It is by far the best sushi around!!!

This is my favorite places when I am in town. I come for the rolls, really! I don't know what it is about the rules here, but they are always so fresh, soft and paired with the whipped cinnamon butter. I could down about six of these! Be careful, though, they are total calorie bombs!

The portions here are pretty good size; I almost always end up taking a box home. 

Service has always been good, the waiters here are usually pretty friendly! Parking is never an issue and they are pretty good about getting people quickly off of the waitlist and into a table. The only reason why I don't give this place four stars is that they open so late. I really wish that they opened for lunch.
I have no idea what happened to this restaurant that had OK service but now it is closed and tore down...

This is the foulest Carl's Jr that I have ever been to.  Gross does not describe the experience.  First, the food we ordered was cold, I mean cold (Fries. Chicken strips, etc...). Second,  there were only two employees working when we came in by the time we left.  We sat down at 7 pm on a Tuesday.  Two female employees came in from outside the store, placed their purses under the counter and started working with the food without washing their hands.  The bathrooms looked and smelled liked an outhouse after a destruction derby.  Stay far away!!!!

Great food! Great pricing! Great service!
Only drawback might be that the menu is bigger than the kitchen can handle. It took longer than expected for breakfast and was only half full of patrons. Worth waiting for if you aren't in a hurry. Maybe they'll get faster as they go. I'll definitely be back.

First time eaten here and the food was delicious very authentic Italian food, they got the bread dough right from Italy and the service was super professional, the manager greeted us. The lighting are perfect. Will be back for sure. I think this is my new favorite Italian pizza restaurant!

This was our first time to Jakers.  My husband and I came in for lunch.  

First decor....not over the top but cozy.
Our server was excellent, his name was Justin.  He explained everything to us and was right on point at the right times.
Second...food.  I had the French dip sandwich.  It was one of the best I have ever had.
My husband had the prime rib and believe me he is picky....and has has over 30 yrs experience in the restaurant business.  He loved it!!
Third...desert YUMMMMM cheesecake!!!!

Ok....we are new to the area and have tried many local restaurants so far.   We will be regulars.

Great restaurant! We were driving to Arizona going through Meridian ID looking for a decent dinner. Kahootz was great! The steaks and sides were well prepared! The service was very good as well. You can't go wrong to have a meal there!

Went on Christmas Eve and it was packed. We were a family of 7 with call ahead reservation. We were promptly seated (can't really accommodate large parties) into a table that was a bit snug. Our waitress was Sooooooo accommodating. Came to the table right away to take our orders. Have been to many restaurants in boise when service is mediocre at best however very impressed with the service and kitchen turn around times.  As crowded as it was we still got our food and everything we needed in a timely manner. I even commented to the manager how impressed I was with the kitchen. Would definitely recommend and picky as my daughter is a chef.

This is only the second restaurant in the Boise area that I've given a 5/5. One other got 4/5, and everything else got 3/5 or 2/5. This is definitely one of my favorites now.

For a chain, I was completely surprised by the food here. This is one of the best restaurants that I've been at in the Boise area. The sweet bread knocked my socks off. And though the Ft. Worth Ribeye had some charred bits at the end and a little bit of tendon, it was cooked exactly as I ordered it (medium). With sauteéd onions and jack cheese, the epicurian experience was amazing.

The only thing that I would knock on is the green beans. Kind of too salty, and didn't expect them to come soupy.

And the service was great. My waitress was Steph C from Iowa. She was so good and friendly, I tipped her 50%. Yeah, crazy, huh?

If I could give this place a negative star rating, I would. I had never eaten here before so I ordered something safe: teriyaki chicken. How can a Japanese restaurant screw up teriyaki chicken, right?  Oh my gosh it was terrible. Usually teriyaki chicken comes with the skin on, cooked with little charred places that makes the glaze become a little sticky. Yeah, this didn't resemble anything I've ever seen. It was two boneless, skinless chicken breast pieces (I think it was one breast cut horizontally into two pieces). The meat was moist because it appeared to have been steamed. After the chicken was plated, a very watery, diluted teriyaki "sauce" was ladled over the top. The sauce had the consistency of chicken broth (and not a whole lot more color either). The table next to ours ordered the same thing and it looked exactly the same. Besides the chicken being moist, it had no redeeming qualities: no flavor, no texture, pretty colorless, weird, weird, weird.  The only person I could imagine who may find this acceptable is a very picky child who likes everything bland. I would never return.  Oh, and even the water tasted awful and smelled terrible. We stayed right down the street in a hotel whose water tasted perfectly fine out of the tap.  Nasty smelling and tasting water in a restaurant should be a clue a good dining experience is hopeless.

I don't live very far from Lowes so it is usually my first choice in getting supplies I need to fix up the house, yard etc. I must say every time I go I hate it more and more. They usually never have what I need and I wind up going to Home Depot(who at least has friendly employees) besides the fact that they are unfriendly, rude and act like it is just the worst thing for them to do to answer a question or wait on a customer. What is that about?  The people act like they don't even want to be there. Right now I hate shopping at Lowes. Anywhere is almost better.

I visit the Yard House often. In fact, the only 'chain' restaurant/bar I visit. Service, food, atmosphere, drinks are always exceptional, until today. I was seated at the bar, enjoying drag racing on TV. I checked my text messages and when I looked up, the channel was changed. At least give me the courtesy and ask if I was watching the races. 
This might be my last visit.
Always a favorite. The servers are always nice and keep your drinks full. The rib eye was delicious! The only thing that wasn't so great was that my wifes steak was over cooked.

Awesome beer selection, good ambiance, and the food is decent. Prices are a little high in comparison but IF you get a good server you won't mind too much. Service is hit and miss, but if you order another beer...you may not notice.
Dug out the box the wall mount came in.  It included a stud finder which they didn't use.

This used to be such a good Wendy's. Sadly enough over the last year or so it's gone down hill. The last two times I've been here my order was off. The last time I waited almost 15 min. after our order was done and told them my sandwich was missing before canceling my sandwich and getting a refund. The customer service was terrible and the manager that gave me my refund acted like she didn't apologize for the mix up.

Sakana is probably one of the best sushi places in the Valley. Sushi selection is great and quality is right up there. I think the only things to judge raw food by is quality and presentation. Sakana has both.

We came across Noodles at the Yelp Spring Spectacular that we hosted last week.  They catered our Ladies Night for 60 people.  The food was amazing, showed up on time and all around was a great experience and very affordable.   All of our attendees loved the food.  
High Desert Harley-Davidson.

$16 salad bar?! I didn't understand why this was priced so high and when I asked, the explanation I received was less than compelling.

Went with an $11 burger instead and was super disappointed with the dry hockey puck received. Fries were good, fry sauce tasty. But this was not worth the price. 

We also ordered fish and chips ($17), the fish was dripping with water after every bite. Yuck.

Waitress was overly friendly and fake, wore way too much perfume. 

Don't know why they think they can charge what they do. 

First and last time here.
The food is incredible and the menu offers a huge range of great choices. It's not exactly cheap, and some menu items are downright pricey, but I have never had a bad meal from there.

Loved the pizza, the service, the price and atmosphere! One pizza was about enough for each of us, my 10 year old son took some home. An employee walked around checking on us waiter-style, and the side of ranch was free. They even had fun, non-traditional sodas such as Mango-Orange. My family and I enjoyed Lemonade. This place was super fun and we will be back!

AWESOME!! Can't wait to go back!! I am beyond picky when it comes to steaks and their ribeye steak was to die for! And the prices are so reasonable, for what you get! And yep - customer service was wonderful as well! Just moved here and I'm so happy to have found a great restaurant already! One thing, it's noisy! Not a place for a relaxing quiet or romantic evening - just an FYI!

Great new Cigar lounge. Very well put together beautiful shop. Owner is awesome as well as staff.  Good  selection, they are picking up new lines as well.  They picked up one of my favs AF Casa Cuba.  When they get Opus I will be in heaven.

Hip fun atmosphere, yummy pizza at a reasonable price - you can get exactly what you want on a pizza and not have to share. Great drink selection also - Coke Zero to Blood Orange Lemonade. This will be the first place in town where you can make a salad to order as well.

The good, the ok, the ugly..

The good:  Been here twice and had consistently good food and service.  It's a seat yourself kinda place and they were packed, so my first instinct was to just leave due to no hostess.  They quickly remedied that and put us on a waiting list.

The ok:  Atmosphere is loud.  The bloody Mary/ beer list is odd you have to look at a tv? Menus in our first visit were dirty, like really dirty, not a big deal but I kept wondering how clean the kitchen was.

The ugly:  I ordered a virgin Bloody Mary, even double checking with the waitress because she brought me the side beer, they changed me alcohol price.  I asked her to correct the tab and she said no that was the price.  She gave me a weird explanation that that was the cost, but if you spend any time working in the bar business you know what she said was bs.  

Upon my first visit I plugged the address in my phone and it sent me to Kuna, told same waitress she said couldn't be because the address was clearly on the menu.  Meh, I guess everyone has a bad day.  I did see that there is two locations of this address on Linder the difference is if you put "N" or "S". 

All of the "meh" experience I had was the first visit, didn't experience any of this in the second.  All and all I would go back, seems like they're getting their sea legs.

The first Idaho location of Buffalo Wild Wings is now open in Meridian next to St. Luke's hospital that is earning a lot of buzz! Buffalo Wild Wings at 3223 E. Louise Drive is part of a chain that started years ago back in Minnesota and is purported to be one of the fastest growing restaurants in the United States. We arrived towards the end of the lunch hour and found the place hopping with lots of young people playing poker and trivia on hand held devices. It was a Tuesday which we learned was "Wild Wing Day" with .45 cent wings all day long. Thursday is .60 cent boneless.

We were seated near the front door. The large projection screens mounted near the ceiling were not very visible because the light pouring through the glass doors on a sunny spring day made it difficult to view the picture. Had we known this we'd have opted to sit in the large bar area which offers better views of the televisions. 

Buffalo Wild Wings is known for their wings, and their sauce. There are 14 kinds of signature barbecue sauce ranging all the way from sweet & mild to something called blazin'. The mid-spice range sauces are the most popular: Honey BBQ, Spicy Garlic and Asian Zing. We loved the spicy barbecue sauce, Asian Zing, on the half dozen tender, melt-in-your-mouth chicken wings. Tangy, sticky and delicious!

There are sandwiches, wraps, burgers, chicken tenders & wings, ribs and combo plates to choose from. A red star depicts customer favorites on the menu. We ordered Honey Barbeque Chicken Salad ($7.29) and . Our entrees weren't as exciting as the wings. My salad was not very large and was poorly presented in a black plastic container. Iceberg lettuce with freshly shaved carrots contained disheveled shredded cheese on one side, chicken in the middle, and pico de gallo on the other side. A small plastic cup held the dressing. This was by far one of the poorest salad presentations ever seen. What's with all the plastic? Al Gore would have a fit! The only redeeming quality was the juicy barbecued chicken in the salad. The cheeseburger was good but a bit overcooked for our liking (all meat at Buffalo Wild Wings is cooked medium-well) and was missing the barbecue sauce. The flavorless paper-thin bacon did not enhance the burger in any way. Accompanying fries were tasteless. If a teenager leaves fries sitting on a plate you know something isn't quite right!

Service was inattentive. We asked the waitress for mustard; twice. Beverage refills were never provided and had to be requested. Our check was brought to the table with the assumption we would not be ordering dessert. That's too bad as there's cheesecake, apple pie and a chocolate cake with chocolate ice cream, all priced at $4.79. We left with the impression the servers are given too many tables and can't keep tabs on everyone, or perhaps a much larger lunch crowd showed up than expected? It was, after all, Wing Day! Since this restaurant has only been open for a few months we'll let them get a few kinks worked out then return again because the wings sure are great, the crowd is young, and the atmosphere is lively!

Happy Hour (as of April 2009) is $1 off all drinks, Monday through Friday from 3 - 6 pm.
From 10 pm until closing, nightly, get $1 off all drinks and .45 cent wings. 

Find user comments and more at htttp://www.idahoeats.com

It's a shame because this used to be my favorite spot when they first opened, but they have dropped several notches across the board from quality of food to service to management seeming to care. The only thing that remains second to none is their beer selection, but that doesn't even earn them much credit because when I was in yesterday they couldn't even seem to pour the right beers we ordered! Ordered a strong IPA, and was brought a Bud Light. The server proceeded to argue that he had "punched it in" correctly and no effort was made to rectify what was clearly the wrong beer.

The food here used to be amazing and spot on, especially their pizzas. Not only have they gotten rid of the best pizza on their menu (the Thai pizza), when you order a different kind they don't even finish cooking them (are they in a hurry?).

Management used to stop by every time we visited to check how things were going and it's now been 4-5 consecutive visits with no one stopping by.

Sorry guys, but I'm done giving you chances to fix this. Stop acting like a half-rate chain and fix your issues and I might come back. Until then I will be perfectly happy to spend my money at one of the other myriad options at The Village.

2nd best pizza in Idaho that I've found in 30 years.  The pizza is delicous.  Their prices are outrageous.  You'd think you were getting a 3 pound pie for that price.  I always seem to get coupons the day after I go there.  Oh well, still very delicious pizza.  Their crust is the best in the state.
Great service. Food was good, just a little dry. Had a little fly issue. The carne asada steak had a really good interesting flavor. I'll come here again.

I was pleasantly surprised by Blaze Pizza. I've had mixed experiences with quick-fire pizzas. So I proceeded with caution on my first visit. It wasn't worth worrying about. Blaze delivered. 

I got a Meat Eater-pepperoni, meatballs, red onion and mozz on spicy red sauce. All for under eight bucks and a sizable personal pan that had me stuffed. What I loved the most? They don't charge for extra toppings. None of this two dollars for basil leaves stuff. So I piled on olives, basil, mushrooms, and artichoke for nothing extra. Goes to show how much is added to a restaurant experience when people aren't nickel and dimed. 

Ambiance was typical quick service modern. Employees were friendly and they make a point of using your name as they make your pie. I'd definitely visit again!
Always a good choice! Get here early or choose to wait!  There is NO prime rib in the two county area that is better!

MERIDIAN, ID:  Jakers is an institution in this part of Idaho.  Just a terrific all-around restaurant that delights the senses.  The ambience is fancier than a neighborhood grill but not stuffy, ideal for a business meeting or a casual night out.

They have amazing scones that come with every meal.

FOOD

Lobster Avocado Sandwich (5 stars); This sandwich rocked.  Spicy queso, lobster, and generous portions of avocado atop Texas toast.

Drunken Noodles (4 stars): Good, flavorful noodles with a sweetish sauce.

Burgers (4 stars): They are good restaurant style burgers, served up big and a little dry.

I didn't have them come and actually do carpet cleaning. I contacted them, quick response, and scheduled. Price was reasonable. Ended up not needing the service. Felt bad canceling after they were so nice about it. Will find call you guys for next time I need carpets cleaned.

I believe these guys had the claim to the most taps in Idaho (43) for a while, however there's a new place in downtown Boise as well as a Yardhouse in the works, so that record has fallen.  Still a really good selection.

I've been here a few times with my family, all of which were good experiences.  Their $9 sampler mat is a bargain.  It's also 40 oz of craft beer, much of which is high ABV, so make sure you have a driver if you need one.  I've got one tiny gripe on the beer, they don't appear to have any hard rule to pull a keg after a set amount of days.  This is becoming more commonplace in big beer bars (removing a keg after 30 days regardless of how much is left) but the beer scene in this state is definitely still evolving.  Hopefully they implement something like this in the future.

The food is solid, nothing amazing but everything I've had was tasty.  It's a tad on the pricey side but not ridiculous.  I wish the menu was a bit larger, I tend to prefer sandwiches or burgers with my beer and their selection is a bit small, but so is the restaurant so I understand they might not be able to support a huge menu.

Overall it's a solid place that I will continue frequenting.  Kid friendly too, my daughter loves their kids menu.

I adore Kahootz. There are several things I always do when I visit: 

1. Arrive hungry

2. Order the pterodactyl wings and a PDF pale ale straight away

3. Convince hubs to split an entree with me (my favorite is the steak salad) in order to save room for..

4. Dessert! Any that I've chosen have been a delight, especially the caramel apple almond bread pudding!
Good pizza, speedy & friendly service, would definitely go back!

Entering the restaurant my husband and I decided on going into the bar. We picked an empty table, hostess followed as we started to sit I noticed the hostess hurried and wiped broken chips off the table, no big deal but after I sat I seen spilled dried salsa, when waiter Finally came to take drink orders we ask table to be wiped as we sat to early at dirty table. Chips salsa came (which were great) drinks came, they were good, shaken margaritas. Table not wiped. Chips salsa gone. It is a all you can eat chips and salsa. No one came to offer more. When our dinner arrived it was delivered by someone from the back. Our waiter did not check on us. He finally remembered to come clean our table. When I tried my flauta it tasted like over fried in bad grease. My husbands fajaita was great except for the end peice of inedible onion. We decided to stay and have one more drink but for 15 minutes could not make eye contact with anyone. Decided to just get the heck out.  I have never left a bad review but I came 3 hrs from the mountains  and was looking forward to a great mexi dinner. So disappointed! I just wonder if managers were not there that night. They all seemed like young kids that didn't know how to care for everyone.

LOVED IT!!!! I went today and will now make it a big part of our lives.  Grilled cheese and tomato bisque soup.  WONDERFUL.  I don't drink much but occasionally want a beer.  I was fortunate to have a 9 oz beer.  Just enough.  Thank you for bringing this to Meridian.

Stopped in on a business trip and was not disappointed. Really cool spot with a small town feel. The food came out really quickly and was hot and good. I had a bacon cheeseburger and tater tots and left full and happy!  This review is shorter than most but it reflects the place. Simple, down to earth, and good. Go here if you want a taste of small town life.
Awesome food,'. Friendly staff, thank you to Katie at Blaze Pizza for being so rude so we went next door. This place is not run by children.

Wonderful place for dinner, a night out on the weekend, or just a quick stop after work. Check out the awesome early (2-6 pm) AND late (9-close) happy hour menus. I love this place! And you can't beat the 20+ flavors of wings to choose from. You can go from mild to spicy in a matter of seconds! The beer selection is superb as well.
Excellent dentists and staff. They put in a filling that came out 6 months later and fixed it same day (Front teeth are hard to patch). Very glad me and family found them. They've been great.

Every time we go in young teenage girl behind the counter has the WORST attitude. We were so excited to have a papa murphys so close but after trying this location for the 4th time and still receiving terrible service we will continue to drive across town instead of dealing with them.

Found this little place one night when we decided to try something new. The food was delicious! (I recommend the alfredo) Don't leave without having some of the bread pudding!
It is a bit dated inside, but clean! The staff is awesome and on the ball with refills or whatever else you need.
Sandwiches are awesome, prices are fair, definitely better than subway! One of my new favorites!

Yard House has been the worst experience I've had. I went several months ago. The service was terrible the food was cold. I swore I'd never go back. My son wanted to go for his birthday. Again, the service was terrible.  Our waitress went on break and left us to another waitress. She never checked on us, she didn't bring my son's drink until we had to get a busser, who then got the manager. I'm so shocked Yard House is part of Darden enterprises, who typically have high standards. I will not return to Yard House again.

We love this place.  Where else can you get an amazing beer and high-end restaurant quality food in an informal setting.  For beer lovers, they actually have The Abyss on tap right now!!! You have to "know people" to score that beer!  This place is like cheers!  I rarely go past the huge specials list for my order.  The dishes are innovative, well prepared, and always delicious!  Go early, as they don't take reservations.

My wife and I have come here several times, and really like the creativity of the menu, tap list, and bar room style atmosphere. Inside the walls are all wood panel and a bit crowded... If the temperature is right I'd recommend eating outside... They do a great job 4 sure!  Save room for dessert!!

I ate here twice in the past week, it's an awesome environment and great food. Build your own pizza! You can't go wrong with that. Your pizza will be done surprisingly fast and it'll fill you up. Great place to go eat, I'm definitely going back soon.

A nice atmosphere, and the food is typically good. Service however, has gotten sketchy at best. I never understand the giant cluster of help, that huddle at the front desk. God forbid! We arrived 10 minutes prior to our reservation time and were repeatedly, questioned about it by a flustered man. This was once a favorite place. I took a group (4 Adults) recently for dinner, and honestly never felt so un-welcome at a so called nice place...ever! After being questioned about the reservation repeatedly, we were finally seated, and told twice by the young woman who sat us our waiter would be...and then many minutes later it would be...someone else. And then, a totally different "named" waiter, a robotic, unfriendly, inattentive, rude gentleman finally came, I wish he hadnt. Two of our guests were celebrating their 64th Anniversary, he could have cared less! It will be a long while, if ever, that I visit again.
Great buffalo wings and happy hour has good prices. Also enjoy how there is tv's playing sports. Only reason I'm giving a 4 star is because service Could be better

This is the best steak house around. The food is so so so good here. I love the honey butter. Service is always A+. Great for family's or just adults. Managers are always walking around checking on the customers.  If you can always do the call ahead setting to save yourself on the wait time.
Two words, bread pudding.  They have figured out how to turn dessert into a mini show.  It's AMAZING!!

Nice restaurant at The Village in Meridian. We stopped in for a late lunch before attending a matinee at the theater next door. 

They have a rather extensive menu so sorting through it took some time. The side Caesar salad I ordered was pretty decent and quite large for a side salad. My Creamy Cajun Pasta Jambalaya was really good. The jumbo shrimp were cooked perfectly! 

Everyone in our party seemed to enjoy their meal and the service was top notch.
Looked for a cigar lounge, only two found on yelp that interested me. Nice walk-in humidor, great selection. Good conversation with some of regulars completed the evening.

I just want to say how great this company is. I learned of this company while working for a company that had them come clean sectionals on a daily basis for us. They were always on time and called if there was any reason they might be a little late.I also chose to use them in my home and was very satisfied with the results and the price. On my tight budget. So I decided to have my moms carpets cleaned and sent a message for same day or the next, I was immediately contacted with a appointment for the next day. I will definitely recommend them to my friends and family.

We come to Yard House about once a week. Everybody is happy since there is a huge selection on the beers & cocktails. They also have great food! We been coming to Yard House since they've opened. The service is good and if something comes up the management handles the situation right away. We'll be back!

Overall. 
I feel very let down with this restaurant. My family and i were very axioms to check this place out seeing as how it is the first restaurant to be put to to the new village center in meridian and i can honestly say it was a complete let down.

The Service:
the Service Was absolutely terrible. it was very easy to tell how new the restaurant was but they must not have hired anyone with serving experience. because our waiter only checked on us a couple of times the entire night after waiting about 20 minutes to order i was very angry at how long it took for the food to come out. i don't think he refilled our drinks one time the entire night and it was just over terrible service.

The Food: 
I ordered the macaroni and cheese with bacon on top and the macaroni was completely over cooked to the point where it was disgusting and mushy. in addition to that the bacon (which was cut up) was pretty much just fat and it had that tendon-like texture. very frustrating.

The Price:
The price was extremely steep for both the quality and the quantity of the food got there hung left hungry and of story.

Bottom Line:
Hope these guys get some new managers and staff. Will not be coming back.

This place is beautiful if you are looking for a bit more dining experience to into the Japanese Culture. They have sliding door rooms to experience the full flavor of this. Their rolls are beautifully done I had the miso soup, Spicy Tuna, and a Caterpillar roll (sushi roll with avocado slices on top). I recommend checking out the opportunity for the privacy sliding door rooms.
My step son who came home to visit from deployment took us here , the food , service and atmosphere was a delight . A must try if you are in the village
I gotta say my first impression of the place is im impressed, nice clean, friendly and beautiful place. Nice selection of cigars and good choice of coffees to choose from.

I love Carl's and have been eating their food my entire life but, food aside, my experience here would have been much nicer if they sent the drive-thru tyrant through some customer service classes. Disappointing

I've had Jonathan clean my carpets at my last house and my current house.  Both time, he and David arrived promptly, worked hard, were professional and respectful.  Jonathan's wife wad diligent in setting up the appointments and sending us an invoice.  I was thrilled with the professionalism and quality of work.  I will most certainly call Dunn Right for any future carpet needs and I would recommend them to friends and family!  Thanks guys!

We stopped by Yard House after a movie. Service was fast, friendly and attentive. Plus I got carded, so that put me in a good mood. We already knew the prices going in, and it's not like Meridian has a shortage of less expensive restaurants . I'm pretty sure a lot of Village business comes from Eagle anyway. I don't think we really spent any more than we would downtown, and it's closer to home.

We tried the firecracker wings because they have a plum glaze. The plum flavor isn't as present as the plum glazed wings at Bardenay but I guess that's why these are called firecracker wings and those are called plum glazed wings. I prefer the sweetness of the plum glazed wings, but if you want something more savory, these were cooked just right and had a nice kick to them.

I also tried the Black Orchid: raspberry vodka, Curacao and watermelon liquor. So yummy. If you like boozy Popsicle flavored martinis (and clearly I do), it's great.  

The restaurant is a bit louder than Kona Grill, and the menu perhaps too extensive, but I'm sure we'll be back for drinks some time. Then again, Twigs is opening soon...

Almost a year since I've had sushi when my sister and cousin took me to Sakanas. It was very busy the evening we went but were seated right away. There were 6 in our group and the sever was really on the ball. Got our drinks quickly and put in our order as we got them. One person in our group did all the ordering and having never been there before I put all my sushi trust in him. This place really rocked it!  I had some of the best sushi combinations ever. The Spicy  Angel roll and seared peppered tuna were AMAZING! I could eat both of them everyday all week long. I give this place a big thumbs up and will be back soon and often. If you love sushi this is your place.

So delicious!!  I had a dog tweaked my way and it was good!  There were a ton of hot, fresh fries.  Steve is very sweet and I'll definitely be back to try something different.  Love the fact that I can bring my dog and she eats for FREE!

I like main street burger.  The burgers are excellent and it is locally owned and operated.   Awesome fry sauce.  The prices are not very cheap.  But the quality is there and they don't have the buying power of a chain restaurant.  Good place and suggest that you try it!

Sushi in Idaho. Yup thank good for jets.  The place feels like a remodeled  Wendys building. Needs more eye and sound appeal, but once you get past the appearance the food was good. 

We seat to the sushi bar and chatted with the chefs. They where helpful and showed there skills with a smile. The fish had good color and texture without any smell of the ocean. 

We had the house salad(3.50) and wow......Calamari and greens mixed with sweet ginger sauce.  

We had smoked and regular salmon, yellowtail,. and eel  again they were large freash portions and clean presentations 

Price was in normal range to us. Worth the price.

Good wings, good sports atmosphere and super busy on Tuesday nights which is pretty impressive for a bar/restaurant in Meridian. Our server - Stacy (I think) was excellent. She went above and beyond to ensure our relatively large & demanding group was well taken care off.

Our hibachi chef was really fun y, and a terrible aim when it came to shrimp tossing... Which made it even better. The meat and vegetables where really good but I wish the fried rice had some more flavor and color. Tried the dollar sushi as well, it was good but the prices were so small it could have been half a piece, and they counted it as two. Better to just buy a roll.
Amazing food, great service! Went at about 10am on a sunday and had a great experience! We had the mega bloody mary, idaho mac and the siracha cod! So good, everyone needs to go!!

Good food, great selection, nice service & definitely something worth going back too! Was a little loud but it is a bar & there is outside seating. And I liked seeing babies & kids & adults of all ages!

Matador is my go to when I am in meridian. Being from California, their salsa is the next best thing. Drew is a great bartender/server who remembered what I ordered the following time after I went there once! Their shrimp quesadilla is delicious and they gave a great happy hour!
Everything is tasty, and slightly daring.  My fav is the pesto artichoke chicken sandwich.  Salads my least.

Never gone to Krispy Kreme before.... Thought I'd swing through the drive through on my way home from work this morning. The doughnuts may be tasty and all the rage but the drive through customer service was unbelievably snarky!!! If they want the customer to order a certain number of tasty little fat pills then they should remove the $1.10 EACH or $7.99 for a classic dozen glazed. Oh, they should also remove all the options they offer if it's too much of a hassle to order differing numbers of each.....
Loved the Manasan roll! So yummy!! Everyone recommended the evergreen roll but I spit it back out... maybe it was just the texture for me. The speciality rolls were HUGE though!
I had broccoli beef and steamed rice and my husband had Mongolian beef and fried rice - we had an order of chow mein to share - everything was very good and prices reasonable- good, friendly service!

I came to Chicago Connection to celebrate my nephew's 15th birthday party. We made reservations and were able to get the back room, which is nice for larger parties. As far as pizza goes, it's not bad. I will say that everyone raved about the Buffalo Chicken pizza. I, however, LOVED the garlic cheese bread. If you like cheese, I've been told that Chicago Connection is the place to go. I cannot disagree, especially where the cheese bread is concerned.

In a pinch Mainstreet burgers is better than any of the fast food joints around.  I always judge a burger by the way the eat taste without all the extras.  Main street has thin burgers that oftentimes are a little too dry for my taste and it lacks any real seasoning.  Now with all the condiments and extras put on, Main street makes some pretty decent burgers.  I like their 5 Alarm burger although if it was up to me Id put a habenero slaw on it to make it truly 5 star.  Otherwise like I said if you don't want nasty mcdonalds or burger king but don want to spend 15 bucks on a burger this is your joint.  Good prices ok food.

Casa Del Matador had very good salsa with their complimentary chips.  Everything else was very so-so unfortunately.  My daughters and I tried the variety taco plate which consisted of 5 - 6 small two bite tacos.  They were lacking in flavor and garnishes.  My other daughter had a beef enchilada, it was okay but nothing outstanding.  The service and ambience were both very good, a solid 4.5.

Free rolls with honey butter, fair prices, fast service. Menu is huge.  Always leave full usually with leftovers too.  
Can be a bit noisy

These guys were terrific!  I had everything from a 3-bedroom home in a storage unit and needed it moved into a house and they did a great job of handling that for me.  I had a time scheduled for later in the day and on the day of the move I called to ask if it could be changed to that morning they happily accommodated and were ready with the truck 30 minutes later.

Dalton and James were the two guys that handled the job for me and they both worked hard the whole time and were careful with everything.  They did a perfect job of loading the truck, which was quite full, ensuring only 1 trip was needed and no time was wasted.  When unloading the truck into the new house they were both careful and respectful markings on boxes to be sure anything fragile wouldn't be harmed.  Boxes and furniture were all thoughtfully placed into appropriate rooms, which included a lot more upstairs than I remembered having when I was originally describing the job over the phone to them.

On top of all that, both Dalton and James were a pleasure to chat with while working, which made for a nice way to spend the morning.  Ask for these guys when you call; you'll be happy you did!

What a great addition to The Village! Casa Del Matador has it all: delicious food, fantastic margaritas, attentive service, and a gorgeous ambience to tie it all together. My favorite dish is the enchiladas Roja with braised beef. The roja sauce has the perfect amount of spice, not to mention the dish is a huge portion for the price. The Bartender's margarita is strong and full of flavor, made with a reposado tequila. To top it all off, Matador has happy hour EVERY day from 4-6pm and 10pm-1am. Definitely a must-visit!

In my expert opinion:

There's one legitimate reason to make a visit to Buffalo Wild Wings, and that is HOT wings.  If you're looking for a burger and fries or some sort of pita-tized abomination you'll have better luck most other places in the area.  And beer?  Forget it!  Do what I do and sneak out behind the dumpster with your MD 20/20 on your lunch breaks - the drinks are at an ultra premium price.  

This particular establishment seems to have trouble keeping a hold of good staff including those in the kitchen.  The wings run at about a 70% success rate of satisfactorily seasoned/cooked and about a 15% rate of timely delivery during a weekday lunchtime visit.

After well over two dozen visits I can sum it up like this:

Come here:  If you want traditional (bone-in) wings and an excellent variety of hot sauces and you have plenty of time to spare.

Don't come here: If you want boneless wings (effing gross at this place), burger & fries, or other non-wing fare.

This place is super funky to try and get in and out of, being in some sort of business collective with the name "Village" in it. Fine for walking, but if you're not walking because it's, for instance, a shit day out, parking and generally getting around rather blows. Not the fault of the Yard House. I tend to back this chain because they have a plethora of beers on tap. I don't back this particular location because it was so dim and the feeble little LED candelabra bulb things in the centers of the table did next to nothing to add light that people were using their cell phones. Too much dim. Way too much. Annoyingly so and a star deduction just for that.

Waiter was a-ok, but the menu was weird. This is another with the shotgun theory of menus, featuring all sorts of stuff. I had some sort of Nashville hot something or other, which was not even quite up to the level of KFC's version and was meant to be a chicken and waffles take, I think...hey, 2 birds, 1 stone, amirite? Except it kind of thudded here. Then again, I didn't realize people actually came to these for food...this one didn't do so hot with tvs, either and they probably need to strongly re-consider what they're doing here and do some re-arranging...overall ok, but not worth the fight...at least this visit.

On the Simpsons, the gun retailer is named "Blood Bath and Beyond". When Homer is told he can't take his recently purchased gun immediately because BBB has a waiting period policy to comply with Springfield's laws, he says, "Five days? But I'm mad now!"

That would never happen in real life, because at Bed Bath & Beyond, you wouldn't have to wait 5 days. BBB has the best customer service for a chain retail store anywhere. 

We bought some chair cushions that made sitting in the chairs feel like you were Helena Bonham Carter as the Red Queen of Hearts in "Alice in Wonderland". Much too tall and puffy. So we returned them with no questions asked. All retailers should do this. If you don't you risk loosing immediate and repeat business. I was in such a good mood we decided to stay and shop for K-cups of tea and Breathalyzers (such a good deal at $15 - a DUI is not worth it. Don't drink and drive).

The staff are friendly, helpful and all the usual things that you would expect from a great store. They are also funny and transparent about what a hard job it is to be a retail store clerk. The return desk associate joked with me about how there is usually a calm before the storm when customers seeming to hide in the back of the store come rushing to the cash registers right at closing time. Who can blame those indecisive customers, there is so much cool stuff to consider buying. I mean, damn! I'm thinking, the pillows are so cheap and high quality, we should replace all our pillows and fend off dust mites.

The selection at this Meridian BBB appears to be much larger than the one on Federal Way in southeast Boise. Especially the "bath" product aisles. It's the largest array of travel sized consumer packaged goods I have ever seen.

The air of casual joviality is what appeals to me. We are all humans here. Let's laugh at ourselves and our ridiculous demands that we make of each other. And along the way we will conduct commerce and exchange cash for housewares and hygiene products.

Amazing rolls!! Yum yum! I ate wayyy too many! 

First time I ordered a burger here and the last! It was okay, smash burger is better.

I should have tried the salmon.

Always enjoyable steaks.

Appropriate prices!

Good service ...except for when you ask for your drink refilled and they have to stop and line dance for five minutes. Leaving you torn to start eating without being able to quench your thirst or wait and let your food get cold but properly be able to wash your food down.

Always loud. Played some of my favorite country songs tonight!!

The absolute worst nail experience I have ever had. It was dirty and the woman was physically pushy. Not to mention being charged $10 extra for them using pink powder for my fill which is advertised at $15. Horrible salon. Never ever again.

When walking into the restaurant there was a nasty smell...that should have been our first clue. Staff was friendly. Basically not much to choose from on menu if you don't eat meat, so I had the loaded mashed potatoes and black beans. The potatoes were rubbery and horrible like they were made a week ago and then microwaved. The beans were ok. The food actually upset my stomach. We will not be returning and would not recommend.

Husband and I decided on this place as a spur of the moment choice for our anniversary dinner. We both love steak and are so glad we went here. We both got the top sirloin and baked potato and it was absolutely delicious. He got a wheat beer and I got a Bloody Mary (it had bacon, olive, and celery). For dessert we had the apple Carmel bread pudding with vanilla ice cream and it is our new favorite dessert. We're planning on taking our family here again soon. Staff was great! Awesome place!
Never had anything bad here.  I love this place.  My favorite meal is a Mamasan and a Rainbow Roll

My fiancé and I just came in tonight and had one of the best experiences!! Tyler was our server and he was fantastic! So incredibly friendly! We started with their green chile potato soup (which is not offered everyday) and it was so rich and creamy!! I had the chicken alfredo and the dish had some of the best flavors. My fiancé ordered their 16oz prime rib with a loaded baked potato and asparagus, which was cooked perfectly! And of course we had to save room for dessert... we had the bread pudding and it is probably one of the best desserts I have ever had! This place has become one of our favorite places to eat and if you have not been in, now is the time to go!! You won't be disappointed... we always leave full and very very happy!
Seriously talk about a staffing mess on a Friday night. Hostess is turning away more people than sitting. 45 min mandatory wait even with open tables.

I was disappointed when I Ordered the peppercorn filet medium there was no pink in it it was burn not crusted no flavor. The sauce was separated and I was really upset I've ordered this before and it was great. Very inconsistent. The hot and spicy edamame we got was cold. The service was fine drinks where good.
I love the vegetarian boneless wings. My daughter and I go here to eat. They have a good vegetarian menu.

Went here last weekend for the first time, been looking forward to it since they opened, I love Tex/mex.

First the good, and really only one good point, the server we had was fantastic, did a great job, with a party of seven, very impressed.

Now the bad.....
1. Hostess was not friendly at all, maybe I caught her on the day her dog died or something, but this is the first impression of your establishment, be friendly!!!

2. Very, very, very loud music, and apparently there is not a quite seat in the house. When we came in we asked to be seated in a area away from the extremely loud speakers, the hostess either could not hear our request or see #1.

3. Food was over priced and quite frankly bland.

So bottom line I will not be going here again.

Very good pizza at a fair price. I like choosing my own toppings and they are fresh. The guys at the end of the process (who take your pizza out of the oven and call your name) need to call out louder as the restaurant music is way too loud to hear your name. If you go, watch and listen carefully or your pizza might sit on the counter getting cold.

Really great service every time, good food, and OMG the bread pudding. I dream about this pudding. It just melts in your mouth. The servers all seem to like their job and the overall vibe of the restaurant is great. ONLY thing I would change is the booth seating. After about twenty minutes my butt goes numb and all I want to do is stand up. It feels like a church pew, they need some padding on those things. Other than that it's awesome!

Yardies earns five stars for their robust menu, AWESOME happy hour, lively atmosphere, and overall quality. When I think of my favorite places to go in Meridian (or Boise for that matter), Yard House is in the top 5 because I can get any and everything there... and it's SO GOOD!  

Food: I have never been disappointed with a Yard House order. THE MENU IS HUGE! To be honest, we typically order from the happy hour menu, as we don't usually justify going there (since it's a bit more spendy) during non-happy hour times. The nachos are huge and amazing... probably our favorite app. The spicy calamari, lettuce wraps, volcano tacos, and pizzas are also all amazing. I like how their "sushi roll" comes out as more of a sushi cake. It's great to share or enjoy a giant portion of fresh sushi all to yourself. I recommend the spicy tuna roll! I was also very impressed with their garlic noodles! Though they don't cost much, the portion is really reasonable and it was very filling and tasty. I also love how YH offers big and small dessert portions. Their dessert sampler gives three small ramekins of desserts and is great to split or enjoy all to yourself. Since the portions of everything else are so huge, I don't mind the smaller desserts. 

Drinks: What's not to love about their drinks? From their incredible tap selection, to the wines to the cocktails... there's literally something for everyone.

Atmosphere: Always going and alive. The restaurant is dimly lit and usually packed. If it's warm, we try to sit outside on the patio. They offer a surprisingly large number of patio tables, and the people watching in The Village is great. I like how they have outdoor heaters so it doesn't get too cold out there when the temperatures start to drop. 

Service: I almost always sit at the bar and enjoy the fast-paced service offered. I don't think I've ever had anything come out incorrect, and we can be picky orderers! 

Happy Hour Offerings: M-F happy hour, and late happy hour as well. They offer food & drink specials, and the food menu is not only pretty big for a happy hour, but the portions are big, too! 

Healthy Hack: n/a

Tips: Don't want to wait? Sit at the bar top!

My Harley riding buddy and I were in Meridian to attend the Pacific Northwest Harley Rally.  We checked Yelp for a good steak place that was reasonably close to our motel.  Without question, the Yelp reviews leaned heavily toward Kahootz Steak and Alehouse.  And, the reviews were right on. We arrived shortly after 5 PM on a Friday afternoon, and the place was already close to full. We sat at the bar, which was a good choice.  Tom, our bartender, helped my buddy choose a beer to drink (they have 43 to choose from).  My buddy sampled three different types of beer before selecting one he liked.  For dinner, I had the small New York strip, and my buddy had the large top sirloin.  We both ordered the rosemary red potatoes.  Both steaks and fixings were outstanding.  Even better, my check (without tip) was under $20.  We were both very pleased with the food and service.  Highly recommend (and go early).

Consistently good food.  Fried Wisconsin cheese curds are very good.  They used to have mushroom lettuce wraps on their menu, but no longer have them which is a disappointment for vegetarians since there aren't a ton of vegetarian options.  Halibut was very good as were fish and chips.  Would go back, but would go more often if they had more vegetarian options.  It is pricey so wouldn't go there very often for that reason.

Cash-only hot dog stand in the Rite-Aid parking lot. EXCELLENT versions of Chicago-style hot dogs. Also serving sausage and Italian Beef sandwiches, which I haven't tried.

These are legit Chicago dogs, with sport peppers, neon-green relish, and celery salt. Very good setup and presentation. Currently (summer of 2015) a dog and fries is $5; 2 dogs, fries and a soda are $9, and sodas are ~$1.35. He switched from crinkle-cut fries to regular fries, they are still just fine.

You can take out, eat under s atreet umbrella next to the stand, or sit in a little homemade plywood hut next door that's pretty sketchy (but awesome, considering the street vibe).

WHAT NEEDS WORK (or why this isn't 5-stars):
-Dogs were not piping hot, so the cold relish and condiments gets it cold quick. That could be fixed...I think he's cycling them through the water too quickly. The buns were not warmed enough (at all, I think).

As JFK said, "This is a great country, but I think it could be a greater country...". Well, this is a great addition to our culinary scene (a no-kidding Chicago dog) but it could be greater. Make the dogs piping hot, steaming, and warm the doggone buns!

I'll still be back, for sure.

What a crappy experience.  We came on a Saturday night at 600pm.  The place was only half full and we asked for a booth.  They seemed annoyed by our request but whatever.  Our server was really cold and short.  Never looked up from her pad while we were ordering.  Food came out quick and I asked the food runner for ranch but she never came back with it.  So I asked another server that was walking by and he was DEFINITELY annoyed.  Food was gross.  My daughter's mac n cheese noodles were soggy and the tortilla for my wrap was stale.

I've never thought this place was great but I don't remember it being this bad.  Doubtful we'll ever come back.
Best Chinese food I have found in the area. Employees were very friendly and made you happy to be there. I will be returning.

This place was wall to wall crowded.  We had to wait about 45 min on a Friday evening, BUT, when our food came...omg....it was absolutely delicious!! Well worth the wait!! Customers I talked to said they keep on coming back because the food is awesome....I AGREE!!

Delicious! I had the salmon and it was amazing it was on the specialty menu, my husband had the New York steak. The service was great, the food was great, everything was wonderful.  Tom the bartender was also great server we sat at the bar for our dinner because it was very crowded! Oh, the bread pudding was absolutely amazing not your grandma's bread putting!!
This is my third time here, and each time gets better! They have a splendid happy hour 4-6 with amazing $5 & $6 apps and $5 margs. Everything we have ordered has been over the top delicious!

The beers on tap were plentiful and varied which I'll give credit for but at $6.25 per 16 oz pint is too much, especially for a Lagunitas. We had the Garage grinder with beef, should have been called the garbage grinder. Over cooked and unseasoned beef, bread wasn't toasted which would have helped not soak up what little juiciness was there. Just very bland and boring. Should just make a cheesesteak with that instead with a creamy chz sauce. Also had a cheeseburger. Looked/tasted like a frozen patty not impressed. I just feel like too many restaurants skimp on burgers and over charge for them and this is one of them. The servers were attentive and friendly which is great. I however won't be spending my dollar there again with so many great breweries and beer options elsewhere that don't charge so much.

Have been to BWW about 10 times in the last 2 years.
It is exactly what it is supposed to be. Wings, beer and sports. The atmosphere is fun and the wings are perfect each time. Had great service, friendly and genuine, many times. The place is usually packed so that has to tell you something. Great place to take a client or date. Amazing happy hour too!
If you want fine dining you are in the wrong place. This is a true sports pub. 
Only down side, the beer is too expensive when its not happy hour and they don't fill the glass. 
Hope that helps.

Great company, used them 4 times moving my extended family from California to Idaho. Once I made a mistake and couldn't make the initial appointment, they moved their schedule around to accommodate MY mistake! Always arrive on time, always professional and hard working with zero complaints. Very reasonably priced, book them with confidence!

This was my second time ever going to a BWW, and beforehand all I had heard about it was how the service is terrible and it's way over priced -they were 100% right.

First off, our waitress "forgot" that she had our table, so it took forever to order.
Her attitude was terrible, 2/5 orders were wrong, and my whole party thought she had come to work high -due to the communication skills, forgetfulness, etc. 

My salad was quite mediocre, but the chicken was good. My boyfriend ordered a wrap and some wings -he liked it. Overall, not worth the $60 and we won't be returning.

My bf finally convinced me to eat here....it is his favorite!  I was not disappointed!  I got the French Dip and it was so yummy!  The special that night was prime rib so the au jus was from the prime rib!  It was so delicious that I paid to take extra au jus home! The only reason I gave it 4 stars is it was difficult to find a seat and the bar was crowded. It was a Friday night so it's to be expected and I guess is a good sign that it's a great place for food and drinks!
Best Prim Rib I have had in a long time. Great place to go.

The good - The Chili was pretty good, it came cold so we sent it back but the flavor was good. to their benfit I must say that we ordered the chili during breakfast so it probably was rushing them. The server ( bartender) was pretty responsive, not the best but not the worst. The beer is cold and they have a lot of choices but they need a paper menu beer list. It is a pain to have to look at the computerized reader board and wait for the list to appear only to have it disappear before you can decide. 
The bad - The wings were mushy, not crispy, pretty average in flavor. The menus were disgustingly filthy to the point we almost left without ordering. Lots of flies and it is November so I can only imagine how bad they would be in warm weather. Our server was fair to good but I saw a lot of servers doing nothing with people waiting for food. I also saw a table that had to get up and go get their own condiments. The servers had plenty of time to do some extra things ( like clean the menus and condiment bottles) 
We will give them another chance but it needs to improve or that will be the last

I must say, the restaurants in Boise are consistent. This place is no exception. The steaks have been full of fat and grizzle. Even their Filet Minion is not very good. 
Just like every other place in Idaho, expect no less than mediocre. Once you've lowered your expectations to where they can't go down any further, you will never be disappointed here.
Idaho has cornered the market on 2nd and 3rd rate restaurants. 
Thus far the only consistently good restaurant in my opinion has been Chandlers !!
My macaroni was smarter than the employees. I swear every time we go here my order gets messed up. Sucks, but the foods still good so I guess it's whatever

Alexis our waitress was awesome, definitely the best service we have had in the valley, I had the chipotle chicken tacos and they were great, my wife had the tortilla soup and chicken club and liked it alot, the food prices are average, but the drink prices are absolutely nuts, normally I will not pass up a drink, but I was not willing to pay 10.50 for a cocktail that costs  $4.00 everywhere else. The parking sucked to say the least, you have to park a very long way from the restaurant, I will definitely be back for the food and the service, I just don't think I'll ever be able to bring myself to buy a drink there.

Not sure why this place has such a low rating. My wife and I ate here with a friend and I was impressed with the drinks we tried. Our bartender recommended the bartender's margarita, I also tried the pork belly tacos off the specials menu and they were delicious. My wife tried the mushroom quesadilla which I also sampled, it was quite delicious as well. The chips and salsa were great too, but most importantly our server/bartender was attentive and polite.

Great place for a late night snack. Always happy hour, and their happy hour menu is really good ( except maybe the oddly pre shaped calamari ). Good drinks, great salad bar, and a very upscale decor. Dinner menu is good also.

Awesome Bloody Mary's!!!! Right amount of spice, I prefer to OG, but hubby likes the remix. Both are awesome though. We had a bad experience the first visit, but our friends kept telling us to give them another chance. We did, but will only go during their off times.

Went here with my husband, we sat at the bar and Craig was our bartender/server. He was awesome, very friendly and as crazy busy as it was he still made the time to make us feel like we were his only customers. Our food was delicious as always. But really I feel like you can't go wrong with any of it, I got the Italian wedge and it was so good and the perfect size. We will definitely be back to eat(the entire menu)!
Excellent food!  I had the Rib Eye with shrimp, the steak was cooked to perfection.  It melted in my mouth.  Service was a bit slow for a Sunday night.
Service at lunch is horrible. It took 10 mins for someone to figure out they had our table and 30 mins went by with no food and we got a sandwich

So sad to give this restaurant a poor rating. We ordered pizza for pick up tonight. When I arrived to the store there were several people eating there that needed attention. One customer actually walked up to the cashier and ordered his drink and salad at the register. He must have know there was not going to be a server anytime soon. In the 15 minutes I was there people were continually coming to the register to request drink refills. They also had no more lettuce at the salad bar.
