With all the chaos I was not surprised my pizza wasn't ready. So I waited maybe 10 minutes. To get my pizza I ordered 30 minutes prior. Apparently the pizza was ready. It was not hot or even warm when we got home. It wasn't even hot in my lap on the drive. The pizza was not as good as it used to be. I don't think we'll be going back.
Best Chinese food I've ever had.  Quick and friendly

One of the worst customer service experiences we have had.  A group of 4 of us went for dinner.  Our server never smiled once and about 1/3 of the way thru our dinner asked if we wanted to go box's and our checks.  I politely told him we were still eating and he never came back to our table.  EVER.  If you look around at most employee's there are very few smiling faces in this facility.  Our one bright spot was the "captain"  She was very nice and entertaining.   I might add that the smiles should start from the management that stood glaring (no smiles) at the employee's.

Great little restaurant with a large menu. Food was tasty, large portions and great value.  Wait staff was very attentive and checked in frequently to be sure our meal and experience was great. Will definitely return.

We have been to Blaze Pizza twice.  Both times we had good experiences.  The first time was a family dinner.  The second time was just me and my boys ordering food to-go.  Both times, the staff has been friendly and helpful; offering suggestions and being very good with my oldest son, who likes to order his own food.  The pizza was good and it doesn't take long at all to cook.  During busy times, the seating can be cramped; though that seems par for the course at most places, nowadays.  We will go back.  I think this place is worth trying.
If you like paying high prices for mediocre food this is your place.... I wont ever come back there are better burger joints in town at WAY lower cost.

I've come here with a group of friends several Sundays to watch me some football. So this review is basically an average of four different experiences. I will say that it's BWW, nothing fancy, though I would never expect that. My first visit however was almost distressing. They must have 15 TVs in the bar area alone.. talk about sensory overload. I had no idea where to look or focus and kept spinning around in my seat. I left with a headache. My second visit was more successful. I first found the TV I wished to watch, then arranged my seat accordingly. Logical, yes, but I was too overwhelmed my first visit to even figure this concept out!

I generally get a beer (Sam OctoberFest) and something to nibble on. My most recent discovery is the breakfast wrap which is super tasty. I have found that my experience varies greatly depending on the server. Once our server (who I won't name.. I do save my receipts) went MIA for so long we started flagging down other randoms. Maybe it wasn't her fault, as it seemed she was waiting tables both inside and outside and perhaps had a difficult time managing that. But still.. other weeks I've seen her give more attention to her cell phone than her tables. I do wish to commend Kaylnn (she's helped us twice now), who manages to put correct orders in and follow up in a timely manner with a smile on her face during what I imagine to be a tough shift to work.

All in all, BWW is a fun place to watch a game and catch up with friends. Plus, I've never had to wait in line for the bathroom.

We had some great service and great food! We highly recommend this restaurant. The superior dinner was well worth the price. The enchiladas were yummy and the environment was over all quality. Room to improve with making us feel more welcome. :)

Food is really good 90% of the time however the staff is hit or miss. Some of them are really awesome but the manager and many others really don't care. The manager is extremely rude and unhelpful. His behavior and attitude is enough that I will not return to either location. People don't normally drive 30 minutes to be ignored by the waitstaff or have a manager roll his eyes at you.

Under no circumstance should you or anyone you know go to this restaurant. They have the absolute worst service the poor quality and unprofessional people working there. They have repeatedly gotten my orders wrong, you would think someone would learn the 1st time but I guess it took a while for me to understand this is the worst place in the entire Treasure Valley to get food.
Just finished eating here.  I don't write may reviews but this place was fantastic.  Food tasted fresh burger was delicious.  All the of us really enjoyed it.
After visiting several sushi places in Meridian and Boise, I can't seem to find one that tops Sakana's Meridian location.

Probably the best local burger joint in Meridian.  I love the Western Bacon Cheeseburger.  The only sad part is watching the employees walk around trying to find out who ordered what.....when you ask who ordered the Saturday Special and 6 hands go up then there is an organizational issue.   Using names or numbers would greatly speed up service.

Just got home from a dinner at Texas Roadhouse on Fairview. We love this place, but my daughter was diagnosed with Celiac Disease, which means she needs gluten-free food. We have come here about 4-5 times over the past year, and get a different story each time from each server when we ask what is gluten-free.

Tonight our server was Albert, who took the time to bring out printed gluten-free information about the food items served at TR. Unfortunately, we discovered that the ranch and blue cheese dressings are not listed on the list of gluten-free dressings. We have been eating them for months! Such a disappointment that we have been told several times that they are gluten free and they are not!

I talked to the manager, Nick, tonight about my experiences/concerns. He was very receptive and I hope TR will start to print a gluten-free menu soon. Red Robin does, as do several other restaurants. More and more people are realizing they need gluten-free food, and restaurants need to provide factual information about their food ingredients. I was very happy about how Albert and Nick handled the situation, though I wish servers in the past had been more informed.

I give TR 5 stars for their food, and 2 stars less for the vagueness surrounding which items are gluten free - an average of 4 stars. Albert and Nick 5 stars each.

One last thing -- the music is SO loud that it's difficult to have a conversation across the table!

This is not a terrible place, but I grade on a curve and it is definitely in the bottom 40% of restaurants.

We had sushi there and it was tiny little rolls packed tight in seaweed.  We got three rolls, and I wish I had written this review while I was there, because 30 seconds after departing I had already forgotten what I ordered-it was so boring.  Nothing creative and stingy on the Ingredients.  For a place advertising the sushi, it was just unacceptable, I may as well have been buying it from Albertsons.  

Fellow respected Yelpers have given this place high marks; I recommend following their reviews to have a good experience; I'm actually eager to try again after having read others, but my review serves to notify you that there are definitely landmines on the menu.

New menu!

The Kurobuta Pork burger is just shy of perfect. Any closer and it would be taken up to heaven for being too good. 

45-50 min wait on Friday and Saturday nights. They have call ahead. 

I was not a fan until I had this burger and now will come back to give the Yard House another shot at glory.

Ordered a salad to go and got 2 little cups full of dressing.  That is not a sufficient amount of dressing for a meal salad especially considering that the salads are lame at best.  Chopped lettuce with chopped tomatoes, cucumbers and green pepper as well as cheese cubes.  That is what is advertised and I'm fine with that, but at least provide enough dressing to wet all of the greens.  My son's sandwich was good.  The real reason for the 2 stars though is the staff.  They were far more interested in chit chat amongst themselves than helping customers.  We had to stand there and wait while they chatted about their day for 5 minutes instead of helping us.  The customer should always come first.  They can chit chat all they want when there are no customers in there.
Now that I work within minutes of this place I make a weekly appearance at least. Solid burgers and their chicken fingers are some of the best!
We had many visits in Boise location so we stopped here for a lunch .  Wasn't the same cool set up for a Business lunch but flatbread Attention to detail and customer service always makes up for it

Great place for lunch.  We came on Tuesday @1:30   Will return to try dinner.  We were greeted at the door by Chloe who was friendly and bubbly.  

Autumn was our server who was friendly and very accommodating who gave us the password for wi-fi.  
She checked with us often to see if we needed anything.

I had the crab avocado salad and chose 1000 Island dressing.  It was Hugh and sooo good. Took some home for dinner. Hubby had fish and chips which he liked. The Creme broule wad wonderful.

We will be back soon

Responded to an ad posted by Chavco, of course they didn't post their name in it. The ad promised "free Wood Chips in Clovis", and the ad said if would be a mix of wood and leaf, but what I got was over 90% unusable branch and leaf material, with a spritz of wood chips on top so it would look good in the truck. They were nice enough to drop it in the right area, but when I went to sort through and use the material, it was completely useless. I got what was to be wood chips, was merely a free dumping ground so they didn't have to pay to drop it at the landfill. Contacted them, and they said there was nothing they could do about it. So now I'm left with cubic yards of useless material covering my front yard, and will not have to take it myself to the landfill they wouldn't. I would recommend anyone else. 

Jeffrey

I started out by yelping italian places by my house and outside of a pizza joint, this was the only one around. I just moved to idaho so I'm not familiar with many good places to eat. I saw a one star review and a five star review and read them both. The one star review was all about customer service and wait time. The five star was on the food. I had plenty of time so I wasn't worried if I had to wait... I just wanted good food. It was easy enough to find right by Fred Meyer. I walked in and was greeted right away. He asked if he could help me and I mentioned I hadn't been there before. He asked how many it was serving and told him it was just me. He recommended either the meatball sub or spaghetti for one. I ordered the spaghetti with meat sauce and a loaf of bread. I was surprised at the affordable price . They packed it up and I was in and out in less than 5 minutes.

I made it home and dumped the spaghetti out on the plate and was ready to dive in. The noodles were huge and cooked to perfection. The sauce was probably the best sauce I've ever had. The fresh bread was a nice dipper for the sauce. I couldn't have had a better experience. If you are looking for home made italian on the go, this is the place for you!! Two thumbs up. I will be back soon!

So delicious! The line was crazy long but it moved fast. We had the Red Vine with extra mozzarella and it was perfect. Great flavors. You can tell everything is fresh and they are generous with the toppings without charging extra. I also loved the aguas frescas - tart, slightly sweet and totally refreshing for about 1/3 the calories of soda (and no fake sweeteners.) We will definitely be back!

It's good.  It's a chain restaurant that let's you eat peanuts and the throw shells on the floor.  The service is usually very good, and the food is excellent.  It has TVs for the sports folks out there.  Bummer they aren't open for lunch, though.  They open at 4pm, which makes kind of a late start-type meal.  

Anyway, the only reason I don't give 5-stars is how crowded and loud it is.  Yes, I know, I shouldn't hold it against the business who draws that type of crowd.  But it's frustrating, none the less.  You can tell me to shut up now.  It's good.  Eat there.
Great Pizza! They have gluten free options too!

Very friendly and entertaining bartenders and servers. Good prices for amazing food and wide beer selection. The bartenders know how to mix drinks. I have always had an awesome experience and highly recommend.

When we arrived, it took almost 10 minutes to even be acknowledged and seated.  Once seated, we were not acknowledged for another 15 minutes. We were just about to walk out when our server arrived.  He complained about being under staffed and the majority of the servers being in mc call.  Finally got our drinks another 10 minutes later and my glass was so sticky I had to go wash my hands.  It's been  35 minutes and my husband still has yet to get his drink or have chips and salsa brought to us.    This is my first time here and I will never be back!  Very poor service.  Can't comment on the food because it has yet to come
Update.... an hour and 10 minutes later our food arrived,  my order was totally wrong.  Had a chat with the manager who was sweating profusely, and not very helpful.  Got chips and salsa at the same time our order arrived.  Food was decent, once I got what I ordered.  Nothing special.  Definitely avoid this place in the future.
I think Main Street Burger has the BEST burgers!! They are perfectly seasoned and compliment the toppings well. I would definitely recommend!
Great find, passing through town.  All three meals were tasty and the service was really good.  Don't leave without trying the bread pudding!

Chance, our server, was truly incredible. He was very knowledgable about the different food and drinks the restaurant had to offer. We told him that we just moved from out of state, and he even told us about other things that would help us out, such as different internet companies and which one is the best. The food was amazing as well! I got the roast beef sandwich with chicken noodle soup, and my boyfriend got the black truffle cheeseburger. Oh, my goodness, soooo good!
Great food and even better drinks :) the place had a great vibe to it and the way it was decorated was awesome. Good location at the village in meridian

I was a little skeptical of a fast pizza place, but I'm now convinced this is the greatest idea for a restaurant. For those of you who didn't know what to expect, it's like subway, but minus being gross. I created the best pizza of my life, with some help from the crew, and I'm getting a second meal out of the personal pizza. Every ingredient is really fresh and the difference in quality is noticeable. The service is just as good as the pizza - I ordered a pizza which had a malformed crust, and the crew remade my entire pizza without me asking. I would've been totally fine with the one I was getting, but that really impressed me. They also redid my girlfriend's pizza because it was a little too done. TLDR; go here and be a regular because it's worth every penny.

Poor service and our waiter had a big ego.
Spent all night with an upset stomach and in the bathroom. I'll NEVER go there again

Moxie Java knows how to get a little funk on.  Live music most Saturday nights!  They have a small selection of food to go with the coffee, tea and blended concoctions.

The atmosphere here is colorful and this is one of those places where you get the impression the people like to work there.

Starbucks no, Moxie yes.
I come in once to twice a month for their $1 sushi deal on Monday and Tuesdays and their pink lady roll is to die for!

My husband and I eat here ALL THE TIME. They have $2 Tacos Tuesdays which is my favorite. They seem to be able to accommodate vegetarians pretty easily. I wish they hadn't started putting corn in their lime rice though. The service is always a bit slow every time we go in, so they could work on that. There are also inconsistentancies in how spicy their food is, it can be frustrating. All in all we keep going back though!

While I'm clearly NOT a fan of chain restaurants this one is a good choice. The food is good, designed provided you stay away from non local "fresh" fish... Like no salmon. 
The service is good and the wait staff is respectful of your time and privacy. The atmosphere lends itself to good conversations and the music melts into the background. 
One small drawback is this place is hard to spot, even though it's located adjacent to a very busy street.
Worth a stop. Who knows, they might even ask you if you want desert, even if no one asked me tonight. Maybe, just maybe I give off that vibe.

We've been to Texas roadhouse about a dozen times now and the bone in ribeye is perfect each and every time!The staff is friendly the place is clean and I love it ! Please I will try to find a bartender though she'll kick your ass!!!

We decided to come to Buffalo Wild Wings today to have wings and watch football. We were sat out on the patio and all the tables around us were dirty with baskets full of eaten wings. There were at least 8 dirty tables.. waiters kept walking past them. It was actually really hard to eat because I was so grossed out.

I was really excited about a sports bar that serves brunch by my house. Was first breakfast menu had 5 items which still fine if 5 descent items I ordered a breakfast burrito and 1 pancake the package was actually really good but the burrito eggs that were definitely out of a box weren't cooked and the honesty let fries they put in it over cooked and over seasoned I sent back dish and ordered 2 over hard eggs. They came out over easy and when I told them no I want over hard the guy who brought me them said they were rang in over easy and walked off. I then found my server who replaced them with over well eggs and again I sent back saying I ordered over hard and my yolks weren't don't the third time it came back over hard and the server told me they do there over hard eggs with the yellows runny.

Since the first time I found this pizza place I love their pizza. When I get asked where id like to go for dinner I always say Blaze Pizza. But I do have to say the whole system has changed since they first opened.
Our new favorite pizza place. So easy, fast, and fun!! Not to mention the food tastes great!! Very kid friendly.

Going on a Sunday is a very bad idea.  Sushi is not very fresh and they bill you for things you didn't get.  The manager argued with the over-whelmed server in front of customers and then brought the kitchen ticket to our table.  She indicated that the poor waiter would be paying for things we did not get.  Not going back and neither should you.

Excellent customer service, quick, helpful and fun people. You can't beat it for the price, grab some smore's and stay for a brew and pizza. Quality, fresh ingredients, this is up there with the best of the fire brick oven pizzeria's that cost twice as much!

Living in the state that has some of the lowest income statistically, I am not sure how this place will stay open with their prices. As soon as the newness wears off, it will slow way down, I'm sure. 
My husband and I went there on a date night. There was an hour long wait. The entrance was crowded with people standing because there is no place for anyone to sit while they are waiting for a table. It made it very awkward to even go in the door at all. Once we were finally sat at our table it took a long time to get any attention. I remember stating that if we had gone to Goodwood BBQ they would have brought us a water and greeted us withing 1-2 minutes. We couldn't figure out what the service issue was since there were sooo many servers wandering around. Food servers, drink servers, managers, etc. Why wasn't anyone greeting us or paying attention? It went on like this most of the evening. The server was seen rarely. We were only brought one water. I ordered a hard cider and didn't get it until my food was gone. Speaking of food, I ordered a spicy tuna roll and was not informed by the server that it  would look nothing like a traditional spicy tuna roll. It had no rice and it was just one giant pile of avocado and tuna.  I can see how some people would like it, but I was not impressed since I was craving a traditional spicy tuna roll. If I would have been properly informed, I would not have ordered that. I also ordered a chop salad which was amazing. I would order it again. 
Basically, we decided that we would have no reason to return to that restaurant with all the other, lower priced, great places to eat in the area. 
The only thing that saved the night was when the manager offered to comp the tuna roll even though I didn't complain. I wasn't really eating it and he stepped in to say he would take it off the bill and "didn't want me to pay for something I didn't like" and that "the server should have explained to you that the roll is somewhat different"
I would give it another shot JUST because of that manager and how he ended the experience for us. However, it would need to be a special occasion or something because of the pricing.

Not impressed at all. Disappointed to say the least. The burger was dry and lacking flavor. Tator tots were overly salty, fry sauce is plain ketchup and mayo. I'd prefer to support small and local businesses but I won't be back. We also ordered a chocolate shake, it was 3 and SMALL, nothing but soft serve ice cream and chocolate syrup. I can get a frosty at Wendy's for less.

Had a take out order of a deep dish pepperoni and sausage.  It was amazing and was a great price. The waitstaff was friendly, and the wait was normal for a cook to order pizza.  We will be back to visit again!

The food was amazing and the deals were great, but the staff was unacceptable. We came in to ask the wait and to get a table and he said 5 minutes. We left the restaurant and came back shortly there after. The employee Blake acted as if he had never seen us before and again asked for our name. The wait was over 30 minutes as opposed to the 10 minutes he said it would be the SECOND time we came back. WHEN THEY FINALLY took us to a table, it was still dirty w/ food on it and they had to take yet moreee time to clean it. 
The waitress was really rude, rushed through taking our orders, and took a very long time to refill my water. It was pretty busy, there were plenty of games on, but that should not make the service this bad. 

The chefs and the wings were great. Props.

We decided to try sakana again for their lunch specials.  The service was good, however we all agreed that their fish is never as fresh as our regular place, fujiyama.  Their sashimi lunch special is a good value with 15 pieces of fish, miso soup, and salad for $12.  The fish was good, but not great.  When sushi is at its freshest it has a very clean, ocean taste, and while it wasnt fishy tasting it didn't have the fresh, crisp flavor that it should have had, so a little disappointing.

Texas Roadhouse earns five stars for consistency, reasonable prices, DELICIOUS food, super-fast service, and an overall great experience time after time. If you're into steaks, BBQ, big portions and free biscuits with honey cinnamon butter, this is your joint. Don't mind the wait... it's worth it.

Food: I've ordered almost everything on the menu and have no complaints about any of it. The steaks are always cooked perfectly, complimented by two delicious sides. The BBQ and smothered chicken is always good. The salads are AMAZING and huge. I recommend trying the Chicken Critter salad, but have them toss the chicken in their buffalo sauce and eat with the low fat ranch or honey mustard (add extra cheese!). The Road Kill and Beef Tips are also good, as well as the country friend chicken/steak and all of their sandwiches. Don't even get me started on the ribs and pulled pork! I'm telling you, it's all good. Try loading your potato (baker or sweet) and you'll be one happy camper. Also, TRY THE DESSERTS! The apple cobbler and brownie sundae are amazing!

Drinks: Epic-huge margaritas and cold draft beer. Watch out for the sweet tea... it's made by brewing tea and adding THREE red solo cups of white sugar. Ouch!

Atmosphere: That place is ALWAYS packed. While you may have to wait for a table (or sit at the bar to be served right away!), the wait is always worth it. The music is jammin', the ambiance is loud, and sports are always on the TV's. It's a great place for a big group or where the kiddos can toss food on the ground without fear of making a mess. While I love almost everything about Roadies, the ONE thing I don't love is the dancing. It's so awkward! Nix the dancing, dudes! 

Service: Incredibly fast. Most servers only have 3-4 tables, so they're able to devote time to making sure drinks are refilled and food comes out quick. I haven't ever eaten anywhere that has such fast service for the high volume that goes through.

Happy Hour Offerings: Early bird meal if you eat before 5pm. No food/drink happy hour.

Healthy Hack: Order the Country Veg plate. You can pick 4 sides. I usually choose the house salad (no cheese or croutons), steamed vegetables, sweet potato, and then one other--depending on the day. Also, portions are GIANT so ask for a to-go box with your food so you don't over-eat if that's a concern.

Tips: Use call-ahead seating. It won't take away your wait time, but it will help reduce it once you arrive. Want immediate service? Sit at the bar!

I have heard some great reviews so i had to try Texas Roadhouse.  I was not impressed.  I have taken my family there three times thinking that the extenuating circumstances must have been the cause of our bad experiences each time.
I won't be trying it again. This visit was a 30 minute wait of several servers walking past our table avoiding eye contact.  I figured they were very busy so I would give them some time.  After 20 minutes, on a trip to the restroom with my son, I grabbed a server and asked if we could get some service.  "No problem", I was told.  Still no service.  Ten minutes later, I went to find the manager.  Rob took our order, apologized for the wait, promised a discount on our bill, and promised us a server would be there shortly.  By then our kids had filled up on peanuts and rolls (I had walked up and helped myself to more rolls to keep the little ones happy).  Our server was great and checked on us often, even filling our drinks when she saw them getting low (this is huge for them).  Our food was good (another surprise after two bad food visits).  I had the roadkill chopped steak and it was delicious.  We had planned on having dessert but our kids were letting us know that the hour and a half that we were there was too long and they were ready to go.  Our check came and surprise surprise, no discount.  I didn't care but DON'T SAY YOU ARE GOING TO IF YOU AREN'T!!!!

After sitting there for 30 minutes watching people who were seated after us receive their food when we hadn't even placed our order, listening to all the apologies from servers at every table within earshot, and having a manager miss out on making it right, we WILL NOT be returning to the Texas Roadhouse in Meridian.

The only restaurant, we know of, smart enough to put a cap steak on the menu.  And it was perfect.  Second entree was the pan fried trout, also delicious.  We both had the Baker as a side.  It was hot and tasty.  The dinner salad was average but the ranch dressing of good quality with a buttermilk taste.  We had a wonderful dinner and will likely be back.  Service was attentive.  Loved the sweet dinner rolls.

One of the places that will surprise you for sure. What seems to be a bar but with fantastic service and food, that knows presentation as well. Ribeye special for $14 that's a bit thin but Cooked perfectly and sides that have attention to detail. Definitely one of my favorite places in the Boise area

Service has dropped to the point I no longer will be giving this company's my money.  It's corporate from top to bottom and the customers look so worn out from where they were not even a year ago. A shame this place sold out. Oh well
Great beer selection and the steaks are always a juicy treat.

Gluten free info...
Came to try this out for my birthday and it did not disappoint. No wait for a Sunday evening at dinner rush. Our server Amanda was great. Very warm and friendly. The menus have marked on then items that are GF as well as vegan. That's always helpful when you have those food needs 

We choose to split the meals and got the basic nachos for an appetizer and the carne asada plate. IT DID NOT DISAPPOINT. The serving size for the nachos could easily feed 4 and the entree left both of us stuffed. Plus drinks (soda and a mango lemonade) or bill came to $35. 

Where most Mexican themed food only serves the meat, rice, and beans, they add grilled corn, jalapeno, and red bell pepper. We took the nachos home that we couldn't finish... Which was most of it. 

The only downside I can mention was that our water want always kept full. Otherwise it's for sure a place to try out if you're looking for good Texmex.
Love this place! Little pricey but the food is GREAT. Only down side, it's too small...would be fantastic to see them buy the vacant field next door and expand.

I just ate at main street burger for the first time and was placed into a food induced comma after downing a bacon double cheese burger and fries. Hands down they've got the bigger better burger loaded with fresh veggies and real bacon not the canned crap you get from regular fast food places. The fries were made hot n' fresh to order.
I went to order take out ..needless to say the rice was over cooked and had no flavor. Kungpao  Chicken was ok but tasted old or cooked in old oil...not fresh！
I have had my sectional and area rug cleaned and very happy both times. Nice guy and I like supporting a small business. I will definitely use them again when I need them.

The burgers are good, but a little on the small side. The garlic fries are awesome! If you want beer the selection is great, but the prices are way too high. I would never go to The Yard House for drinks. A pint for almost 8 bucks is ridiculous.
Love the HUGE beer selection and the food never disappoints! It's definitely a favorite spot in the Village, especially in the summer, when you can enjoy a cold beer with friends on the patio!

Literally the worst 8$ salad I have ever had. The drive through took 20 minutes and I had to "Doctor" the salad to make it decent once I got home. That was their last chance to make a good impression on me. Go to Five guys. It's higher quality
Food.

My husband and I came in here for dinner for our weekly date night. I ordered a salad , my husband ordered the meatloaf , when it arrived the middle was cold to the touch. He let the server know and he asked if he wanted another meal. My husband then waited for 20 more minutes for the same meatloaf to be heated up and reserved. The server made no attempt to remedy this situation, there was not even an apology. We will not be returning.

I really enjoy visiting Yard House before seeing a movie at The Village. The wait staff is so friendly and even though it's nearly impossible to know everything about every single beer they have on tap, they're always nice and willing to get you as much information as possible from someone behind the bar. The samples are generous and the food is delicious. their truffle fries are a real highlight! The atmosphere is great and the restaurant is clean. I'll definitely be back. Only con is the prices are a little high. That won't stop me though!

It was good food, beer was tasty and service was attentive. Definitely a place I will visit again.. after getting paid as the prices...are a little steep. Atmosphere was fun as well! I can't wait to eat on the patio and drink a beer!

Nice having a good Chinese restaurant near our home. Had the hot and sour soup and it was good! The food was good and the portions large. Reminds me of restaurants back east where the family works at the restaurant and take pride in what they do. Will be a regular place to eat for me and my family.

Ate there tonight and wish we had gone somewhere else. Eating in or taking it to go is pretty much the same. No plates? Really? How about a tray at least? Nope... We also circumvented brown lettuce and avocado by speaking up and saying no to both and chose a different lettuce. The meat, cheese and rest of the veggies were good. Just wish we each had a plate because it made a huge mess. Won't be back... sorry.

One of the very few times I feel Yelpers have let me down. The Tuesday $1 sushi was not worth the cheap price. You get 1 or 2 pieces for that dollar, not a while roll, and it seemed very obvious that the pieces were cut extra thin. Better to just order a normal roll with 6 full size pieces. I also had hibachi chicken (cooked in kitchen because they refused to do a hibachi table for just one patron) and the broccoli tasted like lighter fluid and the chicken's flavor was inconsistent. Some pieces were OK while others had a funny taste. I'm just glad I didn't end up getting sick later. And I can't even describe how awful/weird their "yum yum" sauce that came with the hibachi was. Gag!

Look at my history. I rarely rate restaurants this low. Wish I could write a better review because I went in excited for a tasty meal.

We we're in town for some medical treatments and the doc recommended this place.  Not disappointed . Good fare,  reasonable prices.  Great service and a plethora of on- tap brews.  Average price about $12 a plate.  Now the down side.  If you want to substitute a salad or soup for the fries,  which are baked and delish , it's $4. Pints are about $6 a pint.  Wide variety of brews.

this is another one of those places at the village where its mediocre food at high prices.  I wouldn't even call it Mexican.It is definitely not Tex-Mex sheesh....  Hit up the nearby taco stand instead and save yourself some money.

Great food and service! We had prime rib and it was delicious exactly how we like it. Their clam chowder is really good too, I wouldn't recommend getting pepper though because it already has quite a bit in it. The bread pudding is out of this world amazing! They pour this caramel sauce over the top and it sizzles on the cast iron skillet they serve it on, I'm literally drooling as I write this. You can't go here without ordering it, you will regret it.

The worst pizza I've ever had. EVER!

I ordered a large deep dish margarita pizza, ate one piece, and threw the rest away. This "pizza" was devoid of flavor, hard as a rock...and it looked just as bad as it tasted. The $20 I spent on this pizza would've been put to better use if I lit it on fire.

It was pretty good food. The prices were reasonable for them out of food that they offered. Service was good.

I got the sushi/shashimi plate for one. There was a lot of food and the quality was good. Not the best ever had but certainly good. 

Just be careful coming in and out of the front doors. There's some hangy down curtain thing you have to fight your way through to get inside the restaurant. I guess it's good for you to work up an appetite before you sit down to eat.

Jonathan Dunn & this company are highly recommended IMHO. I'm a repeat customer & I have nothing but good things to say about this company. Thank you for being flexible in your schedule today, so my little man cub could get some shut eye. In addition, I recommended you all on Next Door.com as well  for my neighborhood. I won't be going anywhere else but Dunn Right for my carpet cleaning & restoration needs. Thank you again for yet another great experience!
Went to eat next door and they were closed..... Yes....  Man, the fish and chips was EXCELLENT. Rueben was also outstanding.

Went by myself. I wanted a steak to bad to wait for anyone. I waited 50 minutes for a table. I sat in the middle of 3 tables. Was great. Eating by myself now I'm surrounded by everyone. Took over 30 to get my food. Green beans had bacon in it. My fault. I should be more comfortable with the menu. Took a bite out of the steak, was lukewarm. And so were the mashed potatoes. The steak itself was cooked at medium. But I just wanted my check and to leave. The manager came over. And he made it so my whole bill was $0. I appreciated it. I just don't know if I will go back again to get a steak. I wanted one so bad, and it wasn't at all satisfying.

This place is really good. The wait time can be long but if you want there good food and dont want to wait then you better get carry out.I really like the ribs. There steak is always good as well. The rolls are soft and fresh.mmmmm. Getting a little drool just thinking about this place. Definitly a good meal to be found here.

My sister and I have had some very bad meals lately, very bad. 
 We had been to Texas Roadhouse about (wow) 10 years ago, and we pretty much forgot about it.
 Shame on us! This restaurant, though loud, has the BEST attitude towards their customers.And the food, the food is delicious, it made us wonder why we ever tried anywhere else.
 We made sure to tell the manager how wonderful our waitress is, and pretty much let him know we enjoyed our meal, we will definitely be regulars.
 You just can't beat a well made steak, or tasty ribs, and this restaurant has both, so this is a gem of a find!
 Note: I usually have trouble trying to choose a place to go for my birthday....I am going to Texas Roadhouse!

This place ruined me. I live right by this place... why didn't I find it sooner??? The top sirloin steak was perfectly cooked, so tender, so juicy, so flavorful...  The queso... How good can queso get? Apparently, stupid good. The beer I got was basically chosen via eenie meenie minie mo, and it ended up being the best beer I've had (Cheers, Honey Brown by Dundee brewery)! The quaint friendly ambiance and great service was the icing on the cake. This is probably the most incoherent review I've written, but I'm in disbelief. If your not a vegan, do yourself a favor and check this place out.

I ordered delivery for my first experience with yard house and man they blew me away. The entire meal was delicious and so filling!  I had enough for left overs at dinner time. Made well, presented well, good quality foods. I got the veggie burger it was soooo tasty. I can't wait to go in and experience the restaurant first hand. Keep up the awesome work you guys!

If I could give less than one star I would. I knew I was trying to schedule last minute as my escrow close was kind of a mystery until it happened. I was ecstatic when Dunn Right agreed to come clean our carpets in the minimal time we had before we moved in (1 day window). I made special arrangements to be there 1st thing in the morning and get our new home keys "early". Dunn Right didn't show and didn't call. I called them and was told they had an equipment issue and they were needing to still finish a job from the night before. This continued throughout the day; multiple check ins, promised time frames, and 8 hours later of me waiting around for Dunn Right- I finally told them to forget about it. I was so disappointed after all the good things I had heard.

Came here with family to grab a few beers after a family reunion. I'm sure this is what everyone else comments on, but the selection of beers is incredible. Really cool atmosphere in the Village with all the light up water fountain things. If I'm back in Boise I'll definitely be back. Oh yeah the onion rings were outstanding as well! Easily best I've had in my life.

Quantity does not make up for quality. Ordered my hamburger rare - it came well done. Tomatoes and onions were ice cold and old looking.  Side salad was not edible - a huge portion which looked like it had sat several days. The Calif club was not a Calif club. Just because you put avocado on something does not make it "California".  The restaurant is extremely tight.  Tables are jammed together and it's hard to get around them. I hope the fire department doesn't drop by during rush hour.  It's extremely noisy making conversation difficult.  Who needs that many tv's in a small space?

All in all, we gave it two tries.  Will not be back.

Looks can be deceiving: this may appear to be a beer-centric pub, but these fellows take their food--especially their steak--seriously. Their New York was spectacular. Steak is why we came to Idaho, and this place did not disappoint. Highly recommend!

I placed a "to go order" and it was JUST FOR FRIES! To go means you pay, come in within the allotted time, grab your food and go. Not wait 10/15 minutes to get .07 in change and fries. Just a little bit irritated.

Brilliant place for our puppy to socialise with other dogs, it can get very busy after work but during the day it's pretty quiet. 

Facilities for both pooch and owner are brilliant. 

Only reason we didn't give a 5 star is the amount of poop not picked up.
Good place to eat. I do like the noodles and company restaurant chain. This one was typical for the chain restaurants. Place was nice and clean, food was good. I would recommend going
Wait staff is very attentive and very nice. Food is good and diverse. I would highly recommend. Lots of beers on tap. It is small and intimate with an English pub feel. Try it out!

Chili's has been, at least up until now, our fall back place to eat in Meridian. We typically stay close to where we live, well, because we are lazy. 

When it comes time to eat, we just dont want to have to go very far. I am from Texas. Everything in Texas is a long ways off. So its normal to drive and drive a lot. We would drive a half hour to an hour just to find a good restaurant. 

Well, those days are over. I am 53 now and I just cant wait that long. If I did, I might end up on the side of the road. The stone above my grave would read. "Here lies a good man that just took too long trying to find a good restaurant and died en route"

I dare not take that chance, so I stick close. I used to love Chili's. After all they made a pretty good Chicken Fried Steak. But you know. when you grow up, you tend to put childless things behind you.

Chili's is one of those childish things that has to go. I just cant eat bowls of grease anymore like I once did. My stomach will revolt.

My Chicken fried steak was awful. It was small, greasy, not crisp and very very hard to chew. A good Chicken Fried Steak should be so tender, that it cuts like butter and melts in your mouth the same. 

A good Chicken Fried Steak is not Greasy, its large enough to take an average sized plate in a single bound, and its Crispy.

And to top it off, when I told the waiter, the manager came over to our table and told us that he was going to give us a whopping 50% off my meal. Not 50% off our ticket, or a full 100% off my Fried goo, but just half off mine.

We will not be back!!

I had another great experience at Daddy Daycare The Vault. All the patrons are friendly and helpful. Josh and his wife Laurie are always so friendly as well. I smoked a Alec Bradley cigar and it was a great smoke. They have their beer and wine license which made for a enjoyable experience. I had the awesome opportunity of getting to talk to Steve who used to own the cigar store down the street. Steve spoke very highly of Josh and filled me in on the two paintings in the Vault. Josh is a awesome artist. If you haven't had the chance you need to really look up close on both art pieces. Josh and Laurie had provided free hotdogs and chips for the game. I look forward to my next visit.

Wow! May i say, The cook this time made the food even better, Thank you to the cook for making such a mouth watering meal,
I ordered from cafe currier online again to order the ribs, chicken strips and a turkey club, and it was even better than before!
I will visit soon this is my second time eating your food from delivery. I cannot wait to enjoy your food from the grill. Thanks again. Al Loose.
The servers have the shittiest service and the managers do not really help either. The manager was snotty and was rude about us being out of state.

I am not a big Chinese food fan, so normally when my family wants to go I am not excited. This place is so good though! Everything is fresh and the flavor is great. Nothing seems greasy and the veggies are crisp/fresh tasting. The family who owns it are also so sweet and their service is great! They also keep it spotless in the restaurant. I've tried the Mandarin Chicken, Shrimp Egg Foo Yung (my favorite of things I've had there and best one I've ever had), Mu Shu Pork, Kung Pao Chicken and a few others. They all have been great and I will always be willing to eat here!

Mongo's is trying to be a high end Mongolian BBQ but they are coming up short. I went there for dinner tonight and was disappointed. 

First the good:

Ambiance: Beautiful! The layout and the decor are top notch. The place looks great! 

Ingredient Selection: one of the best I've seen, faux crab and multiple seafood selections such as Mahi Mahi and small, dime sized scallops. Overall I was very impressed. 

Now for the bad:

My #1 complaint.... NO Wine or Beer selection! Why in the world if you are trying to elevate Mongolian BBQ in a beautiful venue with nice built in bars are you skipping out on this aspect of dinning. Mind Boggled....

2nd: the central cooking element is huge, the biggest I've seen. It's so big that there are 2 to 3 cooks around it at one time. Because it's so big the cooks don't move around and the food sits in one area while cooking. I've never seen this in a Mongolian BBQ before. Usually they move around and the food gets mixed and cooked well, mine however did not. It was luke warm and the noodles were in one clump and vegetables/meat in another. I had picked out some seafood so I was a little concerned with the temp. It was not steaming hot like most Mongolian BBQ are. I don't know if is was intentional or not. 

3rd: The service was meh, how hard do you have to work if the customer picks out the food and there are only Cola drinks to select from. They actually messed up my partners order of water with no ice. Just wow... 

Anyway, it's not a bad place to go if you want a Mongolian BBQ but it falls far short of changing the paradigm and the service is mediocre.

This five-star review is for Brian the manager.  

I actually haven't had the best food or service at this location and now that the happy hour has changed, I'm even less impressed. But it's close to the movie theater and I love the large selection of beer.  

Long story short, I took my fiancé here for a birthday dinner/drinks before our date night at the movies. We were celebrating her birthday, our engagement, and our weekly date night. 

Our service in the bar was very slow!  We were waiting a very long time to order food, get our food, and then pay our bill which was making us late for our movie. After waiting about 15 minutes without anyone checking on us to see if we wanted to pay our bill or even have another drink, I spotted the manager, approached him, and shared our experience with him. 

He quickly apologized and took care of our entire bill. I told him I didn't expect that but he insisted and validated my concerns about the lack of service we had experienced. 

If it hadn't been for Brian and his excellent managerial skills and attitude, I probably would have never come back to the Yard House here in Meridian.  He definitely redeemed our experience and I appreciate his generosity. 

Cheers!!!

On that note:

Help Raise Awareness & End Human Trafficking...

Visit: DontBePimped.com

My husband and I are fans of this place. Great for a quick date night or lunch.
This place is okay for sushi. I absolutely love their dynamite roll and their spicy tuna.
My husband likes their saki. 

The last visit was slow service. It just seemed they may have been understaffed that day, which understandably happens.

Ever since the first time I have been to this place, I have always felt a sense of kindness. All the staff here treats you like family and not like a customer. I would highly recommend this above any other orthodontist. 6 Stars if it were possible, wonderful experience every time I come.

I am so glad I found Sammie. It was the best facial I have had in a long time. I have oily, acne prone skin and the outer peace facial has really helped me alot. She is gentle and not a talker. I don't know about you but I don't like to chat when I am trying to relax. 

I do really love Aveda products too! I am in love with their botanical kinetics hydrating lotion.

Delicious food, super service...once you get seated, that is.  It's like a cattle pen waiting to be seated, though.  We used call ahead seating because we had a large group and we  were given a time of 6pm to show up (60 minutes after the call). They say you'll wait 10-15 minutes after arrival...well 30 minutes later we were finally seated. If you are claustrophobic, don't go if it looks crowded. Who would have thought a Wednesday evening would have this place so crowded.  I would have been better off to forget the call and just show up when we wanted to...the wait would have been about the same considering from the time I called ahead to the time we were seated was 90 minutes. Call Ahead Seating is a joke.
On the positive side, I had the salmon...it was cooked to perfection. My husband had steak and ribs and ended up taking half of the ribs home.  The rolls with the cinnamon butter are to die for...my daughter and I have a gluten intolerance, and we suffer the consequences because we cannot pass up those rolls!  My step dad loves the peanuts...lots and lots of peanuts.  There is something for everyone on the menu.  
Our server (couldnt hear her name) was phenomenal. She joked with us and even cheered up my grumpy son!   
I would give them 5 stars but the call ahead seating debacle made me mad.

The huge Bloody Mary is enough to keep me coming back here. It's a meal in itself and soooo good! The food is decent - Id say above average bar food. The salads are absolutely HUGE and soooo good! Happy to have you so close to home, Homestead!

I have been to Buffalo Wild Wings many times and the Habanero Mango & also the Asian Zing sauce is to die for. The food has always been good and service was excellent until this visit. We always sit at a table by the bar and usually Amanda waits on us. She is very attentive and knows what customer service is. This trip we were not so lucky. We got a very slow waitress by the name of Jan. She left our drinks sit on the bar until it was no longer cold, She sepnt too much time visiting with what appeared to be a customer she knew. I left a small tip but felt like it was too much.

This place is a cool place to eat in the village! The food was pretty darn good. I came here for happy hour and got the firecracker boneless wings and the margarita pizza! I expected the firecracker wings to be hotter, but still delicious! And the margarita pizza was very tasty! The only thing that would make it better is a balsamic drizzle overtop. My only complaint was how many flies their were. We sat inside and we had to keep swatting away flies the entire time we were eating.

Normally not a fan of Buffalo Wild wings.  I have been to a few of them in other states.   And to this one and the one in Nampa a few time for a game or after an important meeting with big shoots.   Another words after a round of golf with the buddy's :). .   And just have not  been a fan of the mega sports bars... And the wings are ok.   And I've never done a review because isn't not horrible but it's not great either.   

So why a review now?  

Because I'm starting to like coming here more.  I tryed some dry rub wings I really liked and the happy hour isn't to bad.. I like to add my own sauce because I was born a dipping and I shall remain that way till the day I die.  I will always try a mom and pop place first but will come here due to peer pressure from the guys!  And now be ok with it!   Serve seems to be pretty freindly the last few time as well.

I reluctantly chose this group cause they live close to my house, even though their online ratings are worse than any company I have ever seen. I wish I had chosen another group.  Just a terrible experience with them from start to finish.  I wish I had never called them.

My boyfriend and I have been interested in trying Yardhouse but have waited until now because of the previous poor reviews. However, today we decided to try it out and I am beyond impressed. The service was great, even though the restaurant was packed. And the food was even better. I chose the tuna burger with the citrus soy salad and my boyfriend had the pepper jack burger. They were both delicious. The price was a bit spendy for what we got but it was so good that I didn't even mind. Also, the beer selection was AWESOME. There are so many beers on tap that I was almost overwhelmed with all of the choices. Overall, Yardhouse was fantastic and I definitely will be back.

Arrived on time, worked hard and fast. Super helpful, super friendly. Really great experience. We had Dalton and Brian come out and they completed unloading a truck that took us 5 hours to load in 1.25 hours! No complaints about our super heavy couch or having to move tons of boxes to our second story. Really enjoyed working with them. I will be calling and requesting them again when we are ready to move next time!

Their French dip is what I will measure all French dips against for life.  The prime rib was tender, juicy and melted in my mouth.  The scones to start the meal with a honey butter was amazing and then I can a chocolate brownie a la mode that was also ridiculously good.  
My server, Tasha, was an excellent server.  Great experience.

20+ minutes to get a small order of traditional wings out, on a Tuesday at 2:30, restaurant at 1/3 capacity... add on top of that, mediocre service that didn't make up for the wait time. I appreciate good service too much to make a return visit to this joint.

We tried this place out with extended family in town. They mentioned that the visit with family was great and that they will certainly be back for the pizza. We really like the concept of building your own pizza. Everybody can get what they want. I am sure that we will be back several times between family visits. Thank you for the great meal and outstanding service.

Haven't eaten here for quite some time.  Service was mediocre at best.  Prices in my opinion a little high.  Biggest complaint is that we are in the restaurant and just handed our pita.  Asked for a plate and was told that how you get when you eat in house.   Seriously provide a basket or a plate.  Don't want to put my food on the table.  Won't be back.

Needed an oil change while traveling.  Exactly what they say, offering drinks and a newspaper while you wait.  Attendant appeared to have a difficult time putting air in the tires (one of which was being reported a couple of lbs low on the TPM), but a minor nit.  The cameras showing the "work" being done, though not of under the hood, is a nice touch.  Camera angle was wrong for my vehicle to see what was being done under the hood.

Straight up a good place to go for having an oil change done.

This is my first time writing a yelp review, but thought this was necessary as this is the third bad experience in a row with Texas Roadhouse.
A few months ago we ordered prime rib to go for me and my husband. We ordered it rare, it was medium. I understand they are working with one whole roast so you dont always get it cooked exatcly the way you wanted it, so we let it slide that time. Then two weeks later we dined-in. We normally dont do this because at any given time it is packed full of people, insanely loud, and the servers rush but thats why we usually do carry out. We both wanted to give the prime rib another shot so we both ordered 16 oz prime ribs. After 20 min the waiter came out and said they were completely out...we got there when they opened, that doesnt make sense. The manager himself came over and apologized and said there must have been some ordering mistake on their end. That was polite of him so we shook it off and ordered something else. Well, I guess third time is NOT a charm because when we ordered prime rib to go this Friday, ordered rare, what we got is two slabs of WELL done prime rib. Couldnt even eat it. Its safe to say we will never order prime rib from Texas Roadhouse again, since they just cant seem to figure out the difference between rare and gray meat.

The food is so great!!!! However, for the portions, the prices were a little high. The atmosphere is always great, however I have had a few visits where the waitresses were a little prissy and not very attentive. But I do enjoy meals at this restaurant.
Excellent service and food. I had the Crunchy Ahi Salad which was outstanding. The Ahi was cooked perfectly and I really enjoyed the soy vinegrette. Definitely recommend!!!

Second visit, the food was great again but ... 1. Flys ,  there were a lot of flys in the restaurant this time. The bus boy said they bombed the restaurant the night before  but there were still flys and then there were a lot of dead flys along the window where we sat.  I got up to take my son to the rest room and had to ask my wife to make sure no flys got on my food.  2. The cilantro they put on the fish tacos we ordered looked brown and inedible, we showed the waiter and all he did was take the cilantro we placed on napkin backed to kitchen, didn't    bring back any more ??

Went here through a recommendation. The music is so loud we were yelling to hear each other. My mother in law got someone else desert before we got our food. When we finally got our food everything was super over priced for what we got! 
The pan seared ahi was bland and so salty it made me sick. In total it was 156 bucky father in law got I'll, I got sick, and my Moscow mule had less alcohol than a cheap dive bar trying to stay afloat financial. 
If the cooks are reading this:
USE LESS SALT!

I would have given them 5 stars if they would turn off or turn down the loud music.  Everything else was perfect.  My filet was cooked to my liking and was very flavorful.  All the food was good.  Our service was excellent.  Jenn D was our waitress and she was very attentive, even anticipating what we might need or want before we had thought of it.  I thought it was very nice what Texas Roadhouse does for the veterans.  I am not sure I heard correctly because the music was so loud, but I understood that if you eat some of the peanuts in the bucket, the restaurant gives gift cards to veterans.  What a great idea!

Went during lunch; had an Italian sandwich and got it to go. It was good...lots of food, and quality was fine. I'd recommend maybe a turkey or roast beef next time, since their version of the Italian sandwich was non-traditional; it had a sweeter oil & vinegar dressing and a sweeter ham. I would prefer a mortadella and capicolla on the sandwich, instead of pepperoni and (apparently) honey ham.

The filling was heated, which was nice...it melted the cheese and added flavor to the meat...but after taking it back to the office, the lettuce got a little warm. 
 Service was friendly and reasonably quick, took a little over 5m to make the sandwich, and it was at noon.

I could see going back if convenient, but it's not on my "top" list...Jimmy John's is closer to me and pretty comparable.

What's good: Friendly service, selection.

What needs work: Italian sandwich not to my taste; too sweet ham and dressing.

Quoted a 20 minute wait. Then they changed the quote to 40 min. Now, were at 50 min and counting. Terrible terrible terrible service. Chelsea is running the stop watch.  The gal who quoted 20 minutes isn't standing up to correct the apparent mistake. Too bad, the food is usually not too bad.

A review about Wal-Mart? What's to review?  Everyone knows what they have and offer. While of this is true, here are some helpful tips that maybe just maybe you don't know.  

(1) early morning shopping is the best in terms of selection and lack of the traffic
(2) check out the end caps for clearance items marks down to 1,2,3 dollars
(3) The auto section specifically the guys who help with oil change and tire service are veterans and are extremely knowledgable and friendly 
(4) Looking for a handgun? You will not find one here. This WM only has shotguns and rifles
(5) To the left one aisle removed from the seasonal section is one complete aisle with markdowns and clearance items 
(6) The specialists that work in the Cell phone area up front are experts in cellular coverage, products, and accessories. 


Lastly, the Wal-Mart Site to Store option is a fantastic way to shop. There are options of free shipping, free pickup at a designated store and lastly free pickup today.

If I could give them 0 stars, I would. My fiancee and I were here to pick up some Solar Eclipse donuts, which they said would be ready by 4pm. We drove over there around 4 and they said they did not have any until 6, so we just shrugged it off and decided to order some regular donuts. We asked for regular glazed, and they were out. We then asked for chocolate glazed, and they were out of those as well. We were so frustrated, we left. We sent my fiancee's younger brother to this location at 6:30 to pick up the Eclipse donuts as well as a few glazed donuts and to no surprise, they still do not have them available after we were told they would be ready by 6pm.. Do you guys even make donuts..? Are your employees just sitting around, doing absolutely nothing? We have tried calling them endlessly and no answer! This is absolutely ridiculous! This place needs some new management. Until then, you will not be getting my business!

Staff enthusiastically greeted us and treated us with care and kindness. They have some amazing vegan and vegetarian options, both healthy and greasy in variety. This would be a great place to take my adult siblings or parents, since there's something for everyone to eat. The beer is amazing. Cocktails delicious. Onion rings divine. Happy hour saved us a lot of money. Worth the price!

They were good hard workers in a day that hit 118 degrees.  I was getting heat stroke watching them work.  I did not like some of the packing techniques like putting the hide-a-bed on end.  It shook some of the mechanisms loose. Same with a couple of other things.  They also did not have a receipt book with them.  They promised to email me a receipt for taxes but still have not.  But over all they were friendly hard workers.

The fastest and tastiest pizza we've ever had! 
And we've been all over the nation. Crazy good! 
And the blood orange lemonade! Try it!

Marv's came out and removed all the old insulation and baffles and when my attic work was done they were right there to install new baffles and insulation. Very professional, polite, and the price was right. Thanks Marv. Scott E.
The worst fish tacos I have ever had. The taco shells were broken in half. The fish was dry and tasted like old frozen fish sticks. Don't waste your money.

This place is not great. The fish is very fishy tasting and not fresh. They try to mask this by drenching everything in eel sauce and mayo (I mean DRENCHING- the whole roll was soggy). Service and atmosphere are good and the edamame was fine.

If I could give this place negative stars I would! This place is so disorganized and the food is disgusting, the chicken was so dry and tasted like jerky! And the rice tasted like uncle Bens instant rice, actually no uncle Bens is better! I would say go for the drinks but even that takes up to 20 minutes to get one, they never even put our second drink order in so it never arrived! I really don't know what people like about this place?! I would in no way go back nor recommend this place!

I loved the first time I came here! I got a Classic Cheeseburger and it was juicy and tasted just how it should. But today I went there for a birthday dinner and got the BBQ Bacon Cheeseburger and it was not to my liking. The barbecue sauce was exquisite and you can certainly taste that hint of rum. But, my patty on my burger was burnt, I understand if it was supposed to bring a more smoked flavor but it was too much for me. The sweet potato fries were delicious. Customer service tonight was fairly good.

Denizens of Treasure Valley, why did nobody tell me that Meridian was actually hiding all the good burger joints and not Boise?  First I discovered the Hungry Onion, and now this little gem just a bit further down the road.  While Hungry Onion really captures that "greasy spoon" diner style of hamburger, Main Street is a little bit more upscale, but no less delicious.  Every burger combination we've tried has been fantastic, and their finger steaks and onion rings are to die for.  Well... actually you just might die for them, considering how bad for you they probably are. ;)  My wife loves their guacamole burgers and I just go for a straight double cheese, although their Western burger is tasty too.  

I'd love to give them five stars, but they are just a bit too pricey for this type of food.  Yes I know they use organic beef, and that comes with a cost, but when two burgers and a basket of rings comes to nearly $20, that's a bit too much in my mind.  That and the drive thru service is VERY slow.  Again, I understand that "made to order" means you're going to wait.  But that kind of service does not lend itself to a drive thru.  There's a reason places like Chipotle and such don't have drive thru's.  They know it is too slow for their model of service.  I would say the same about Main Street.  Fresh made burgers like this do not lend themselves to drive thru service.

Bottom line folks, if you want a damn tasty burger and are willing to pay a bit more for it, Main Street Burger will absolutely do you right.
Awesome! Awesome! Music is great. Bucket of peanuts at the table. Great hot rolls with honey butter! Mmmmmmmmm!
Had the Ribeye it was great. I would highly recommend stopping in haveing a beer and a steak. We had great service and some nice beers.
This is a great little spot for a nice beer and a quick appetizer. We stop in here often, before a movie. It's a little loud and very busy in the evenings. But service has always quick and helpful.

"Bruh let's open a Pizza chain."
"Aight my brotha, but what should we call it?" 
"Oh you KNOW what we're calling it! We're calling it BLAAAAAZE pizza bro!"
"Aw yeah brometheus! BLAAAAAZE PIZZA - you are a genius my sibling." 
"You know it! And one day... one day PizzaKen and PizzaTom will write all about our fine food establishment!"

So here we are.

Blaze is a Pizza-Chipotle. You go through a line where you tell the pizza-makers what sauce, cheese, and toppings you want. They slide it into the oven for 10mins. Price for a personal pizza is around $7.50 and the pie is a decent size. Tom got a "Green Stripe" which is a chicken pesto with red peppers and arugula. I got a "Kenny's Awful Creation" which is spicy tomato sauce, goat cheese, pepperoni, and bacon.

-Green Stripe-
Tasty pizza. I was surprised by the crust. Brick fire oven style. Both of us thought it was a lot like Allegrezza's crust which is super good. Cheese and toppings were nothing special but they used nice ingredients and everything went very well together. It was a pleasure eating this slice.

-Kenny's Awful Creation-
The toppings were fine but the spicy tomato sauce was well... spicy. I thought that it would be tame for some reason and figured I could take it, but it kinda gets to you after a few bites. Keep in mind that Tom and I are both not very good with spicy food. Goat cheese did not go with peps and bacon at all. Long story short: I don't really know if the pizza was good or not because I ruined it to begin with.

-Verdict-
Nice ingredients. Fun experience. Nothing really stood out though. Above all we learned that Tom knows how to pick his pizza and me: not so much. Unlike Chipotle, which tastes similar regardless of what you put in the burrito, there really is a wrong choice with pizza. Make sure you know what you are doing. If you don't, grab one of their signature creations.

3 slices out of 5
I went here for the first time today and I loved it.  It was getting an oil change plus entertaining at the same time.

Brand new so we decided to try it out based on the google reviews we saw. Food was very delicious. From the shrimp chow mein my son had, to my Kung pao chicken and to my wife and daughters sweet and sour pork. Family restaurant with great service and very friendly. Don't hesitate to try them.

I've  always enjoyed Noodles and Co and was anxious for this location to open near us...It's been on my calendar since the Nov. b'day of a friend.. a promise to take her there (belatedly) to celebrate.
Arrived shortly after noon and the place was packed - very hot, noisy, and tables tightly arranged..We decided to share a salad and a pasta dish.. We were asked our preference of feta or parm for the salad.. Specified parm and the dish came with feta.. Spanking new fangled soda dispenser that is all touch automated... Line built for drinks because it is so unusual.. 
Chances of returning anytime soon.. slim..

Food was decent. Great service. The beer selection was on point which is the reason for giving it any stars. The best food we had was the cheese balls appetizer. Wow those were tasty. The price was a little expensive, but not unreasonable. I would go back again just not with my kids.

When in Boisetown, I like to make my way to Meridian to eat at Jakers.  It has a nice inviting Interior.  The menu is full of inviting picks and it has a full bar and a selection of a few good wines.  We all enjoyed our meals and will return again.  Nice staff too.
Although I love Poké- this wasn't my favorite. Lacking in variety, I heard "that's extra, is that ok?" twice while picking from limited toppings. Pricier than other Poké places around.
Pretty good burgers but a bit too pricey . I would expect a better taste for what they cost.

Wow.  Service could not be any worse for a restaurant.  Ordered an appetizer that never showed.  Ordered drinks that ran out for ten minutes before server decided to ask If we wanted refills.  Waited 45 minutes for our food and finally decided to walk out.  This place sucks bad do not go here if you want or expect good service.

Dr Paul Kelson did my braces back when I was in high school. Firstly, I was told I would only be in braces for a year, then it was 14 months, then it turned into two years. It was only after my parents had paid off my balance that my teeth were miraculously straight enough to no longer need braces. When my braces finally came off, I noticed that I still had an overbite, but was reassured by Dr Kelson that it wouldn't pose a problem as long as I was regular about seeing my dentist, making sure my permanent retainers stayed in and wore my retainer at night. I was religious about wearing my retainer every single day. Now here I am 12 years later and that seemingly benign overbite has caused the same tooth to be chipped four times, and my back teeth have worn down to a point where I have to go see a prosthodontist to fix my bite that I was assured would not be a problem. Do yourself a favor and DON'T waste your money going to this orthodontist. You will be spending $10,000 a decade later getting everything repaired.

Overall:
I am pleased to say that i believe that this is by far the best restaurant in boise in terms of service, quality and quantity of food and price 

The Food: 
I ordered the sirloin steak with ribs with two sides of caesar salads. the steak was cooked perfectly and the ribs really were fall off the bones like most other companies advertise but do not deliver on. for the amount of food you receive compared to the price no other company compares hands down. in addition to the awesome meal they have amazing and addicting rolls and the butter is what makes them truly addicting! best restaurant ever!

The Service 
whenever i come here i am always so happy with the service i receive. the waiters and the waitresses are among the best of any restaurant in the valley at no other restaurant can i be completely sure that the service will be great every single waiter i have ever had has been remarkable. this should be a reference point for every other restaurant.

The Price: 
i think i pretty much summed it up you get so much food for what you pay for and i have never walked out of the restaurant hungry. this is my favorite  place in boise to come and eat. This Place is awesome!

We ate here on a trip to Boise a few weeks ago and thought it was pretty awesome.  Our waiter Rich was great, he even managed to get my fiance to try something besides bud light and she loved it. No small feat she usually hates craft beers.  He knew his stuff and was great and funny.  The food was good.  We shared the Cuban dip(?). I think that's what it was called but it was hot and tasty and the dip added an excellent kick.  A great place, great atmosphere, definitely going back on our next visit.

There are very few restaurants that prepare a steak as well as these folks, almost none in this price range.  Steaks are done to perfection every time we go there and, actually, steaks are all we order.  I have raised cattle for years and know a good steak when I bite into one.  Unfortunately, there are so few good steakhouses that I don't order steaks as a rule.  Did so here when someone else was paying for the meal (yea, I'm that cheap).  Been doing it ever since.

I would also agree that this is the best burger in Meridian. It is really not expensive, especially for what you get. Some of the reviews say the burgers are pricey but this is not a normal fast food restaurant; the food is made to order, always hot, assembled neatly, and the inside is always spotless. I've been half a dozen times since I discovered it and have never had a bad experience with customer service. It's not fancy it's just a great burger. The only draw back would be that the burgers are only 1/3 lb. I'd go for a 1/2 lb of there were one available. I'd recommend it to anyone who can taste a higher quality than traditional fast food.
When we received our order they had messed up, the service to try and get the right food was slow. And the employees were less then helpful !!!!!  Won't be coming to this location again.

I love this Rite Aid.  But something happened and they raised their prices to astronomical levels. Medicare will pick up these prices but at the rate I am going I will fall into the Medicare doughnut hole very soon and have to pay the whole tab for my prescriptions.  For example one medication Riteaid charged me for was $83.99 and at Costco the same medication is $12.92. Another one is $109.99 and the same medication at Costco is $50.46. Another one is $89.99 and at Costco it is $15.82.  Highway robbery is what's going on at this pharmacy.   I have two other prescriptions I pick up at Costco because of the price difference but until January of this year the difference was not as huge as this. I will have to put up with a lack of convenience at Costco in order to save a bundle on these scripts.  Totally unfortunate.

This is just like any other TRH you've been to.  Cold beer, spotty service and ok food....let us not forget the cheezy yehaw for birthday guests... How annoying.  But I reckon it's a chain staple to act silly on birthdays.  All the clapping, dancing and yelling was VERY ANNOYING.

This Roadhouse was packed which might explain why it took more than 10 minutes for anyone to bother recognizing that We had sat down.  It took another 5 minutes (15 total if y'all are counting) for someone to ask if We'd like a drink. Not a crisis situation but certainly not an over the top service.

On the up side our server was a pro.  Well done...
Good food.  Staff great.  Entertainment too loud.  Would be nice if there were fewer flies ... way too annoying while eating.

We took friends who were in town visiting and wanted to try something local.  We arrived around 12:15pm and were pleasantly surprised that there wasn't a wait.  Everyone was happy with their selections of beer, apps and lunch entrees.  We will definitely be going back for lunch again soon!

We came in for lunch. It was a wait for our drinks to start. Service was slow. We waited over an hour for our entrees. The food was good however, it was hard to focus on that with the 20 flies buzzing us inside the restaurant. The waitress admitted putting in our food order in late and then forgot one person's tortillas. Over all the only thing good was the food when it finally came out. She also charged us for tortillas that we were supposed to get with the meal and then had to ask for. Overall not impressed and wouldn't come back. All this and it wasn't even busy in here.
This is now our favorite pizza place! They have the best pizza for the best price. Super fast service and very friendly. Great place for the family or groups of friends

Visited The Yard House last weekend for lunch and drinks with friends.  The food is always consistent and good.  I really like the fish tacos and fries.  Lettuce wraps are also good and the nachos are awesome!  The drinks get a little expensive $10 for a smallish margarita) but that's getting to be fairly standard these days. The Yard House is a good go-to when you want something familiar and easy.

While I'm undecided about the whole "Village" concept, this restaurant did a great job tonight. Despite being slammed, with an hour wait for people arriving at 5:00, and I'd assume the night only getting more busy, the staff was charming and calm and my group was treated with hospitality. After a slight misunderstanding with the manager about our seating, he was apologetic and bought a round of drinks, which was unexpected and incredibly gracious. Our server was warm and friendly, knowledgeable about the menu, and had great recommendations. Despite the fact she probably wanted to turn the table, she never rushed us and was genuine. A real star server.
As for the food, we enjoyed everything we ordered. With half-price appetizers during happy hour, we tried a bunch. The onion rings were crispy and tasty, the slightly odd California roll not what we expected, but tasty. Sliders were to die for, and only topped by the amazing shoestring fries. A bacon cheddar burger was equally good. Two members of our party got beer, which they liked, and they also enjoyed a cherry limeade and a pomegranate margarita. The cherry limeade, however, was quite sweet.
We also ordered a dessert trio which was incredible. I've never had better peach/apple crisp. It was almost all streusel, but so buttery and crumbly that I didn't mind the lack of fruit. It seemed slightly underbaked, but the flavor was so rich and sweet I didn't mind. We loved the chocolate mousse, which had a nice silky texture. The creme brulee was passable. With banana and chocolate, I expected it to be decadent treat, but it was actually slightly bland. Overall, though, the desserts were tasty.
I'm giving four stars because while the food was great and service really stellar, the prices are pretty ridiculous. $10 for basic appetizers and near $20 for most entrees. For those prices, you can get fine dining elsewhere.
It's a fun, noisy atmosphere and definitely the place to be right now. For an upscale bar, it does a great job.
