LOVE this place!! great for families, as everyone can order their own pizza with their favorite toppings.  Lots of greats toppings to choose from and the staff is great.  Fast service and clean restaurant.  We will be back again and again!!

Ordered the prime rib and it was delicious. Cooked to my liking,  potatoes and asparagus were excellent. The service was polite,  prompt and courteous. Sitting outside was nice because you can people watch,  view the water fountain. Plenty of space to get seated quick. Plus the menu is ginormous and you can find what you feel like. Look it up online, you won't be disappointed.

I give it one star for the nice friendly greeters and my original male waiter for being so nice. I Ordered ceaser salad appetizer, a med rare 6oz Sirloin, sweet potato, and broccoli.  Salad was good, and fresh but only with one crouton... steak came and was a blue rare cold center, blood all over my plate soaking my potato. The server asked me to pick up the steak and put it on a separate plate and they would throw it back in the grill. Anyone who knows restaurant steaks, knows this is a restaurant no -no.  I sent the whole plate back. Told her I would prefer a new steak. Moments it came back burnt on the outside and medium well on the inside, tough as can be... and missing my broccoli. I travel a lot and when ever I am close to a Texas Roadhouse I will arrange to eat there. This is unusual and the first time I have experienced this at any Texas Roadhouse. I travelled 22 minutes to get to this from my hotel. Very disappointing. The manager comped my uneaten meal, and my eaten salad. I then googled Outback, and had a perfect steak, and had a perfectly cooked steak. But I do like the Texas Roadhouse flavor better. Texas Roadhouse in Boise needs to work on customer service, when a meal is sent back untouched and customer asks for a new steak cooked correctly cooked.... a little customer service goes a long way and wouldn't have hurt the restaurant in the least.

I am a Idaho native, and I think Sakana is wonderful. I have been to many Japanese restaurants and this holds par with the best of them.  I may not have the fish background some of the other reviewers seem to think they have coming from LA, but maybe they should just go back and eat it there!
Plus the service is fantastic and always treat their customers well.

BEST FISH TACOS IN THE TREASURE VALLEY. Honest! I've tried fish tacos just about everywhere  and these are outstanding.  My friend had the French dip sandwich,  which she also enjoyed very much, lots of beef. The waitstaff was terrific on a busy Thursday lunch rush. Can't wait to go back and try more. Really good prices on the food, but thought the prices too high on the alcohol.
Pizza is very good, best deep style in town. Generous toppings. Not cheap but worth it.

Not bad for a sandwich joint. I had the pastrami & corned beef. Had to ask for lettuce, tomato, onion. Great flavor. They are right at the front of the "make it a meal" swindle - er, trend - charging 2.99 extra for chips and a drink with your sandwich.

Can't say enough good things about this restaurant. We had great, quick, fun service; the waitress was very kind and did great explaining descriptions of the entrees we ordered. We started with the artichoke dip, very very good. Not your typical dip, this one has chunks or artichoke and enough dip to cover each and every piece of bread. We tried the sample of beers for $9. Good variety of stouts, ales and ciders if you can't decide on just one. I ordered the Fettuccini alfredo with prawns and my husband ordered the filet mignon. Both were beautifully presented and delicious. For dessert, we got the ever so famous mile high mud pie. A foot high triangle of mocha almond fudge ice cream with an oreo crust and whip cream. We ate a quarter of it before tapping out! Prices were a little high, we paid $90 (w tip) for the two of us. But I would rather spend the money to a restaurant that has awesome food, awesome environment and good service.
THE best frosted sugar cookies ever!!! OMG they are amazing!!!!!! Wish I never went... Now all I will be thinking about are those cookies!!! The sodas are super fun too.

Casa Del Matador is a cool little spot, and there are certainly enough people waiting outside to make the place seem like it's awesome. It is not. 

I went to this location not too long ago with a friend after a long work day. Maybe it's because it was closer to Christmas and most places are busy, but there was a pretty good wait. I think we were told wait time was 40 minutes, but in reality it was closer to 30. Once we got seated and the waitress took our order, it was all pretty good speed and good service... no complaints there. My complaint, and the reason this place is a 2-star and not a 3, is that the food was very mediocre. It did not blow me away. It wasn't bad, not at all, but it also was not good. It just tasted kinda ok -- like I was ok with my first few bites, but it took some effort to kill my last taco (I ordered the taco platter). The person I went with felt similarly, so I don't see it being a one-off thing. In any case, this place is helped by the service and the atmosphere, but hampered by the food.Ultimately, though, food is the most important thing.

Texas roadhouse is a mad house on a friday/saturday night but it is still worth it especially in this area. Texas roadhouse does a great job minimizing the wait time with a speedy turnaround and free peanuts the whole family can throw on the floor. 

They do a great job with their relatively reasonably priced meat. I have never had to send back meat there even when they are busy. That is a huge hurdle too because I usually take my mom there, who has to have her meat well well well done (jerky-ish). 

Again, in Boise, there probably isn't a better steak for the price (except Kahootz in meridian).

I think so far this is one of my favorite places to eat in that area. I haven't tried a single thing there I didn't like. The wait can be long but it's definitely worth it. They are by no means cheap so be prepared to pay $$.

Small bar offering full menu. You cannot beat their prices. I loves they offered small size steaks. The upgrade to have dinner salad, was really large for a side. Super big baked potato, but then this is Idaho. I didn't have room to try their famous creme brulee.

Everything is pretty good here, you can reliably get a good meal at a slightly high price. (But not crazy high) I just wish they could figure out how to finish cooking their pizzas. The inner 4" diameter of the pizza is always soggy.

Update 5/25/2018 - Went back in after receiving a message from the owner. We tried his suggestions on ordering and the food was great! As a general rule, I don't give out 5 stars because no one or no restaurant is perfect, but I would say this was about as perfect as you get for customer service. Thanks Robert and to the staff, we have been back multiple times since and will be back even more in the future.

Order your pizza well done, you wont regret it!

I LOVE this place! Its not just another lube center, its much much different. First off, you NEVER get out of your car. You drive in, they kindly introduce themselves, offer you a beverage & newspaper to read while waiting in your car. Another huge difference is there are 3 TV screens right outside your window. 1 tv has the news playing, & the other 2 screens are live video of the person under your car draining your oil & the other screen is the guy working under the hood of your car! These guys are nothing but fast, efficient & professional. They informed me I had a license plate light out & replaced it no problem. I recommend Einstein Oilery to everyone I know! Also, they always have coupons circulating for $10 off or $24.99 oil change. My fathers Volkswagen Touareg & Eos both require synthetic oil & the price at Einstein's was $20 less than the dealership price.
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED

The staff was wonderful, they're basically the only good thing about this restaurant.  It's decorated like the living room of a white Grandmother that's trying to be "ethnic". The food is terrible and its the least authentic I've ever tasted. Honestly you would be better off eating a frozen Hungry Man enchilada in your living room than eating at this establishment.

Pros: good beer, three-million wing sauces and the namesake wings are tasty, friendly service, good wings, 500 huge tv's playing football. Cons: fries are just meh. In summary, a great place to watch the game but not your figure. Would go again if I've been getting plenty of exercise.

Food is decent. Service is hit or miss. They are NOT young child friendly. I have 15 month old twins and went with a friend with a 16 month old along with 5 adults.  They placed us in a booth that would only allow 1 highchair. They offered booster seats with belts so we thought we would be okay. The boosters were so light that if either of my kids leaned they fell over. The food choices aren't little kid friendly either. They seen geared toward kids that can use utensils. We have tried them multiple times and we have the same experience when our kids are with us. The staff really needs to think about families and their children's comfort and safety.

Stopped in to have lunch at Jaker's and it was not a memorable experience.  Our waitress was excellent, but the flies buzzing around our heads was annoying.  The waffle fries were very greasy and limp.  The croutons on my salad were also greasy and very bland.  The seafood linguine was good as were the finger steaks.  But the atmosphere of flies and greasy food makes Jaker's fall off the list of our local places to go.
Our server Amanda did a fantastic job! The Wings were delicious! My daughter devoured her burger spit must have been good. The staff did a great job of making us feel welcome.

My wife and I used to go here regularly. The burgers were not great but acceptable. The main draw for me was the chips and salsa and the Chicken Fried Steak. I am from Texas and long for a god Chicken Fried Steak. 

The one and Chilis (Surprisingly enough) seemed to be the best in town. On a side note, even the place that I thought would have a good one (Texas Road House) Stinks. I say that it used to be good. 

I don't know if they have changed management, cooks or what. But now the Chicken Fried Steak is mediocre at best. Its often greasy, tough, and does not have a good coating on it. If anyone knows where I can get a good Chicken fried Steak, please please let me know.

We still go here occasionally for the convenience. Its close by and we can always get in.
Before giving up meat Main Street was my go-to burger joint. They have all fresh, made to order burgers and fries with killer milk shakes!

Service was great from the hostess to the waitstaff. We had appetizers I had buffalo wings my wife had chicken lettuce wraps and we shared a tower of onion rings. The onion rings were ok I recommend red robins tower over here's but they were good. My wife enjoyed the lettuce wraps said they were like pf chang's. The chicken was great. Not the best I've ever had but the meat was good and the sauce was the perfect amount of wait I need a drink before the next bite. Worth a try.

Update 9/27/17: Third time a charm? Well it was better than the first and second. They definitely improved their salsa. Much more flavorful. 

We there for lunch a while back... Our second visit. It's one of those places that you really want to like. After a so-so experience the first time I wanted to give them another chance but after the second visit I liked it even less than the first time. 

The service was fine but the food, not so much. I ordered street tacos that were beyond too greasy! My guest ordered enchiladas that were extremely greasy as well. No, we didn't order the healthiest but the dripping grease was just too much. And overall, not very flavorful. 

I agree with the person that wrote about accessibility in the bar. It's non- existent. You might as well say "Disabled Not Welcome"!

I can't decide what to get when we go. The wings are monsterous and delicious. The dip with the garlic bread is good. The beer and drink menu is fantastic. The prime rib is really good. Guess I'm saying everything on the menu is good.

My friends and I went in this new Mexican restaurant last Friday night and checked it out.  My biggest complaint is the attitude of our waiter, and the food was cold.  After having appetizers, we started to wonder when our food would be served, as we had been there an hour, so I politely asked our waiter if "we were getting close" to our order.  His response was "do you have a deadline?", and I answered "not really, we'd just been there a while".  He said he would check in the kitchen, and immediately brought our food, so it obviously had been setting in the kitchen.  Bottom line, the enchiladas were cold, as were the beans, soup, etc. Very disappointing.  Our food was super spicy hot, and we specified when ordering that we wanted the least spicy enchiladas, and was assured they were mild.  When the waiter ask how the food was and I said "great, but very spicy", his response was condescending stating that "we are after all, a Mexican restaurant", as if I didn't know that and had never eaten at a Mexican restaurant.  
We will go back and try again, as there was potential for sure.  Our waiter needs some attitude adjustment.

Main St. Burger is a gem of the Meridian community. Their food is incredibly fresh and full of flavor. Their burger patties are cooked to perfection, fries are always hot, and the bacon thick and crisp. 

Yes, the food takes longer than McDonalds. PEOPLE! This food is made to order. Fresh, just for you. And guess what? You are rewarded for your wait with incredible food. I go to Main St. about twice a month. The staff is always friendly, and I have never once been disappointed. Their shakes are unreal as well. I always love taking people here for the first time and seeing their reaction. Main St. is a classic example of locally owned businesses that keep you coming back with their hometown vibes and better-than-boring-chains appeal.

Came here for beers & that's exactly what we got. Altho we were disappointed when we were told we can't order the "Shorty" size beer. So you were stuck with a pint! Hope you like the beer you tried. Beer selection is obviously great & the menu has a lot of options that sound delicious. We got the crab/something something dip with pita bread and chips and it wasn't anything special. 

Lots of tables, lots of TVs, our waitress was good. I'll come back even if the beers are overpriced.

This place is great!  We had the Moo Goo chicken and spicy Mandarin chicken. Both were excellent. They were served with fried rice. We loved it. The service was excellent. My wife even got to hold our waitresses 3 month old daughter!  What!!!   It's a family restaurant and our waitresses other 2 children we're helping with bussing tables and at the register.  We loved the whole concept.

This is a place that seems a lot like someone described Chicago-style pizza to someone else and they made a restaurant based on the description. Actually, I'll go one better. Totino's used to have a frozen deep dish years and years ago, where the toppings would fall below the top of the crust. This is more like that...even in flavor a bit. 

Apparently, andouille sausage is a bit trend up here and this is another place that had it, but this one was not as good as what Smoky Mountain has. It's not bad, but it is missing a note. Pizza itself was ok; nothing too notable one way or the other. I expected more, I guess, foolishly perhaps...the beer I had was also very malty and tasted borderline infected. Homebrewers will know what I mean there.

Also had the toasted/baked ravioli, which were somehow burned. It has some sort of cheese-ish, cheesefood maybe?, blend in here, which sounded good enough to try once but I would never get into again. Service was slow and mostly absent...all in all, the 3 is probably a gift, but nothing was outright bad...just both of us have had worlds better and if a dessert case full of commercial candy bars like Kit Kats and Snickers (I wish I were kidding) doesn't bear that out, nothing will...

Should have known when I pulled up and there was a sign "$1 Sushi Monday's". On Wednesday regular sushi $4 a roll. You get what you pay for. Didn't matter if it was hamachi, tuna, shrimp it all had no flavor. I've had better sushi from any grocery store I've been in to.
Better than subway. I've decided to replace subway with Firehouse almost completely. Love it!!

We had a horrible experience and we will NEVER be back. I ordered a ribeye and for my $22 I got a paper thin, grisled tough piece of something I wouldn't give to my dog. But they were consistent. The service sucked, the food sucked, and the prices sucked. Too bad you don't have minus stars. By the way, I have a big mouth and I tell EVERYONE about our horrible experience.
Frozen margs good.  Food...it's ok, nothing special.  Service fine.  Best to go happy hour.

Steve Dimaria runs Taste of Chicago and is a US Veteran.  He's also a veteran of great Chicago Dog craftsmanship.  Please go check out the place!  The food is sublime and the character of the place can't be beat.  Just make sure you bring a fiver because he only takes cash! #hometowngood

We went within the last couple of days.  A couple of points to remember when going here.  
It's 16.99 all you can eat.  Yes you customize your bowls and have all you can eat salad and soup, but for 3 people, it's 45.00 dollars.   
The bowls and trays are small.  I get the 'personalized' bowl experience but it is difficult to get what I want in my bowl without most of it fallen on the small tray or on the floor.  
Lastly. Out server gave us a massage coupon with our bill.  That was weird. Not sure if that's a side business or what.  We're going to save our monies and stir fry out veggies in our wok at home. Thanks but no thanks.
Wow, best place I've been to in Boise/meridian!  Food is good, bear is great, staff is awesome!

Great place if you want to try a few new beers. The price of liquor is a bit out of control. I was shocked after having a drink with an old friend. We had a two shots each of a medium quality alcohol. With tip my bill was $50. Compared to the rest of Boise, Id say that it's pretty poor value.

I love steak and I live in Miami where I'm rather spoiled in terms of fabulous cuisine. The servers are phenomenal ( which is why I'm giving 4 stars, food wise it's a 3-3.5). It's a good place if you want to eat a steak and not break your wallet. The steak is decent quality ( not top notch) but it's very well seasoned so that makes up for the quality. I would go back.

The moon shone bright on that November eve, it all happened upon a Tuesday. Barbara  says, "Shall we try Jakers?" "Sure!" I replied.  Upon entrance the air felt an uncomfortable cold. The young hostess notified us of a twenty minute wait so we decided to endure. We then Noticed several empty tables available. I figured they were reserved. Twenty minutes later we were notified of a vacancy and we're led to a large area containing at least ten vacant tables. I soon deducted that the ink embedded in my skin accompanied by a sweet mullet had placed us away from the general public.  We can't recall what Barbara ordered as it proved extremely forgettable.  I got some southwest burger that featured mostly pickled ingredients which rendered the entire experience into a vinegar soaked nightmare. Needless to say, we will not be returning. The only reason I gave it two stars is due to the waiter, Paul, I believe was his name.

Love this place! The beer selection, is my motivating factor when deciding on Yardhouse (obviously). The Chalkboard always has great selections, and with samples available you can always make the perfect selection. 

Food is good, although I typically get the same thing every time. I am certain other items are just as good. 

One suggestion I have would be to promote the website membership where you can track your favorite beers. Given the selection, this seems to be a daunting task without a bit of help.

A great experience!  Seated immediately- great food and Becca was an adorable and perfect waitress. Drinks were excellent- the blood orange margarita and the Jameson "new" fashioned was an excellent start. The ceviche and the guacamole were amazing!  Try it - you'll be glad you did.

Fantastic service! Seriously, the awesome staff is what makes this Chili's stand out. From hosts, SAs, servers, managers, all super friendly and helpful. Haven't met any cooks yet lol but the food always comes out top notch. Have a couple food intolerances in our group and this Chili's team always takes excellent care of us and our food :)

I came here with family for dinner a few nights ago and we thoroughly enjoyed our meals. I had the Green Chile Burger which was fantastic! My dad did not really enjoy how mild the salsa and food was as he likes things a bit spicer, but was still content excluding that. 

I was disappointed with the customer service as we had to ask multiple times for refills or hot sauce before our waitress brought them. Not a reason for us to never visit again, but this did deter from the experience. I can understand that she had a large section and was working it alone, but I was slightly disappointed with that. 

All in all, the food was good and service could be better. We would definitely go back but dad would ask for hot sauce in advance!

They did an awesome job with the carpet! Had to reschedule but offered a discount for the inconvenience. Everyone was very friendly and they clearly explained the cost prior to starting work. We had a little snafu with my card being charged twice and Katie fixed it immediately even though it was after hours. Thank you for wonderful service!

The worst Japanese food I ever had. This place sell fake Japanese food.  The owner n everyone that work there r Chinese. The sushi is stale n the rice is not cooked right. Save your money n go some place else.
I'm from San Francisco n I know what is good sushi.

It's a pretty bad sign when you walk into a place that serves breakfast on Saturday and the place is empty. Most places that serve breakfast in the area are packed and require a wait. There were 8 staff waiting on 3 people in the restaurant.So naturally the service was incredible. Unfortunately, the food was not very good. I think they have a total of 5 breakfast entrees.

Love this place. Love that it is somewhat close to our house. Great food, great service, great prices. They have small sirloin dinner which is all I need ~ for only $13. Yep a steak dinner for only $13. I ordered it the first time I went and haven't ever gotten anything else because it was so good. Everyone else I have been with has ordered different items and the appetizers and desserts have always been great.
Just love eating here the steaks are so tender the melt in your mouth great I'll always come back ! And say Hi to Billie she is great all the staff is wonderful
Pleasantly surprised.  Nice flavor on the Enchiladas.  Really enjoyed the chicken tortilla soup, too.
Love this place!! Food is awesome! Watched the packers game..... They have amazing wings and burgers
Great staff and this franchise keeps up to the food quality of all buffalo wild wings !
Perfect Cedar Plank Salmon, service was amazing and the ambiance was awesome. What a perfect yummy welcome to Idaho!!

Ok so I'm always skeptical about a lot of good reviews on here but I was NOT let down. I HIGHLY recommend these guys! Awesome communication and the work was fantastic for cheap. They quoted me a cost and then when the FANTASTIC job was done said they were going to charge me less so I paid them more just because of the phenomenal service and sweet crew. I quoted 6 other yelp listed businesses and they were the best cost and my tile floors look like new! Deff will call them again for my carpets too!

My go-to store for my kiddos clothing and for home decor. The prices can't be beat and I am always impressed with the variety and quality of their selections. I've found name brand items at fantastic prices which keeps me going back again and again.

Despite how busy this place usually is, the pizza really isn't that good. Also, the vibe here is irritating for some reason. Since it was my first and only time here I ordered the simple pie, which had red sauce, mozzarella, and Parmesan. Yes, they have tons of choices for toppings, sauces, but a well made pizza should not need all those added things to shine. I don't like how they press the dough into a perfect circle before it gets it's toppings, a rustic hand tossed pizza is so much nicer and not so processed looking, I felt as I was eating a "gourmet" frozen pizza. I got my pizza to go, and while you are waiting for your pizza you stand awkwardly by tables where people are eating and by the drink fountain, trying to get out the way until you get your name called and presented your meh pizza. Grimaldi's which is not so far away will give you an awesome hand tossed, coal fired pizza that will make Blaze seem like a McD's of pizza.
Very very good food. The soups are delicious, as are the spring rolls.  The Egg Foo Young is the best I've have in the Boise area.

Once the newness wears off, I highly doubt this place will do very well.. Which is unfortunate, considering I love the idea of taps galore and funky fusion food. 

My take:

1.) Prices. How on earth did the Yard House upper management staff decide that Meridian, ID can support a restaurant with $10.50 Martinis and $7.00 pints of beer? Seriously, I'd like to know how that discussion went in development meetings. Those prices are what I would expect back home in Boston. This is Idaho, people. Even if you don't order alcoholic drinks, the price of the food is a bit steep for what you get.. My friends and I ordered burgers, appetizers, tacos, and a seafood entree. The burger (which, granted, had lobster on it) was on the smaller side and $15. Each street taco (the ones that are $2 at On The Border on Tuesdays) were between $4-6. Each. $12.55 for 2 Korean beef street tacos (think mini tacos), a cup of flavorless beans, and a small mound of Spanish rice.. Make sure you download the PDF menu online before you go so you can check the full price list out and know what to expect. 

2.) Service. Party of 4, Sunday at 5:00, was told by hostess staff there was a 15-20 minute wait. We waited between 40-45. The bar was packed tight with couples and families with babies and small children despite multiple signs stating "no one under 21" so we couldn't even find room to buy a $7 beer or $10 cocktail. 

Once we were seated, it took over 10 minutes to receive drinks from the bar, and our server was stretched way too thin.. You have bar runners and food runners, but the lead server staff looked (when we saw them) crazed. I agree with a previous reviewer remarking on white shirt management staff meandering around without much purpose.. We ordered our meals as soon as our server came back to our table after her initial greeting and still waited a half hour for our appetizers, then the dinners came 5 minutes after that.. We didn't have enough room in the table for everything. Not once did our server acknowledge our wait on anything. I've worked in upscale restaurants.. It's common to apologize and acknowledge abnormally long wait times on drinks, food, etc. or if there's a rush on the line and food isn't spaced correctly. 

3.) Ambience. There isn't any. It's loud, it's crazy busy, and there are food runners and bar staff constantly approaching the wrong table trying to dump someone else's food or drink. This occurred 4 times in the hour we were seated. What's with that? Train your staff on the table numbers. 

I really was looking forward to a cool new place to eat, drink, and meet up with friends, yet another chain disappoints. I'd rather hit up the Ram for $3.50 mugs as part of the mug club for a beer night, or Barbacoa for fancy drinks and a heck of a lot more food for the prices! I sadly won't be back.

I ordered guacamole as an  appetizer and when the waitress brought it over she said we were lucky because they only made it an hour ago and it was way fresher then normal ! I thought that was gross/weird to say our food was made an hour ago. I also ordered a  chimmy chonga and it was gross. Don't eat here!

It is what I thought it was. Texas Roadhouse is everything you would expect a place where you throw peanut shells on the floor to be. We had great service. I wish I could remember the servers name because he was all over it. We didn't really need to think about asking for anything because he was 3 steps ahead of us. We had the app sampler and it was pretty regrettable. Just your standard over fried mess that sat in the window to long and became more soggy than crispy. Salads were great and came on ice cold plates. Steaks were cooked perfectly and as always, the honey rolls were amazing. Oddly, both of our sides wound up on Bur's plate....I would recommended and return because it's a safe place to eat and you pretty much know what to expect. Prices are low too for what we ordered. $66 for 2 entrees, app and drinks....

Great little beer bar with excellent chef inspired food.   The steaks are top notch and trimmed in house.   Good tap rotation and the friendliest staff in town.   I'll keep coming back for the great atmosphere and better food,  the beer don't hurt none neither.

I eat here a lot.   The food is good.   I have eaten at other on the boarders and it hasn't been as good. 

One thing g of note.   The service is typically very slow.  If you know that God g in,  you won't have any surprises

Nice little neighborhood bar and grill with a little bit of everything.
Had a nice filet, cooked properly, and added mushrooms, like everyone should.
The bread pudding is ridiculously delicious ... just do it!

Pretty much the only authentic, non chain-conformed Chicago cuisine around here. And my favorite hot dogs as well, beating out Stan's, Costco, and any hot dog stand roving around downtown on a weekend night.

Taste of Chicago is a small hot dog stand next to the Rite-Aid on the southeastern corner of Main and Fairview (the address displayed in the business info is actually Rite-Aid's, as their menu doesn't show an official one other than "Fairview and Main").

Hot dogs and hot sandwiches are what are served here. They use Vienna Beef dogs and get them shipped in weekly from Chicago along with some of the condiments. The buns have poppy seeds and are steamed. And of course there's the trimmings involved with a Chicago-style dog: celery salt (put on both my dog and fries), the neon green relish, sport peppers, mustard, onions, tomato wedge, and pickle. It's the real deal. He also has footlong, jumbo, and BLT dogs. All come served with crinkle cut fries. The best value and my constant order is the daily special-- two Chicago-style dogs, fries, and soda that ends up being cheaper than just ordering two dogs.

The four stars are for the dogs. As I don't make it into that area often within the limited hours the stand is open, that's what I go there to eat when I do make it there. My only other excursion into the menu was his Italian beef sandwich. I love the Italian beef from the Portillo's chain, and Steve the owner swore that his was better. Sorry Steve. Perfection denied. The roll was subpar and the taste was lacking. He also serves meatball and sausage sandwiches.

By the way, Steve is very chatty and personable and has some good stories to tell if you're up for them.

Now, when can we see a restaurant pop up that will serve some REAL Chicago-style stuffed pizzas a la Giordano's?
I enjoyed the recommended Pastrami sandwich.  The service was fine, server very friendly and helpful, quick to bring anything needed.  I'll be back.

SLOW TERRIBLE SERVICE!!! We waited over an hour & 10 minutes for our food. We had 3 kids with us under 3 years old & had to keep them entertained for that long. It was AWFUL. We saw people come in AFTER us & LEAVE before we even got food. She also forgot our drinks. Terrible service. We were a party of 7... four adults & 3 kids... it should not have taking that long. I'm pissed because I had to take my pizza togo since my kids were melting down after sitting for so long.
Great staff and good food.  I have been to Sakana for lunch and dinner many times and they deliver every time.   I only wish they had more specialty rolls.

Pros: Best chicken tortilla soup I've ever had.  Food is outstanding!  They also have more beers on tap than any other restaurant I've been to.

Cons:  It's always packed, so be prepared to wait for a table.  Also, the prices for any beer are pretty pricey.  Even cheapo domestic beers are spendy.

Overall, this place is a wonderful restaurant to get really tasty food and watch a game!
Great little deli! Staff is always warm and welcoming. My favorite is the Deli Club.  Several bread options and meats and veggies are very fresh.

I've said it before. . .I love this place!  The bartenders know my drink when I walk in the door (my mom would be so proud of me!)  Great bar food, reasonable prices and I just saw that they have one in Nampa by the Edwards Theater.

Finally a good Chinese restaurant in Meridian! We got the sweet and sour pork, broccoli beef, fried rice, and chow mein. All were very tasty! Not only was the food good but the customer service was great! Will definitely be back!

Usually a good experience here but tonight something was off. Service was slower than normal but it seemed like they were bussing tables as well as serving. Food, which is usually excellent, tasted stale like it sat in the kitchen a while. I won't hold it against them but I will pay attention and see if it's back to normal next time.

Had lunch with Dad here recently, and we really enjoyed ourselves!

He had the salmon bento box, and the salmon was very nice.   The bento box included soup, salad, rice, a California roll, and fruit for under $8.    Screamin' good deal!

My meal started out with the Seafood Salad.    Our server could not tell us what it was or describe it to us.    I ordered it.     It was 8 sashimi-style slices of various fish on top of a handful of iceberg lettuce and what seemed like Ranch dressing.   It was alright, I guess, but had she known what it was, I would have ordered something else.

The do have Hokkigai (surf clam) nigiri, although they spell it differently and the other server helping us didn't know what it was either.    On the good side, it was under $4, making it very reasonable compared to other local sushi places that have it.    I had to order it, of course, and it was very good.

Service (aside from the frustrating issue of servers not knowing enough about the menu items) was friendly.     Soda and water glasses were kept full.    Bathrooms were large & clean.

Saw a sign that they're offering $1 sushi on Mondays, so guess what my plan is for this Monday?

Have eaten there 4 times
Food took longer than 30 minutes to get
Chilly was cold I was told they forgot to turn on warming pot
3 out of four times food order was wrong
Will not go back again

Why isn't there a zero stars choice? Had to wait 40 minutes for a wrap and fries, both of which tasted bland. Zero value in going here, only positive are the sports. Bad management, terrible service, slow kitchen. We went in at 11:30 on a slow Friday and it took FOREVER. Even to get cashed out at the end. Will not be returning. Eff BWW!!!!!!

Hot, delicious donuts plus 30 minutes of free entertainment for my kids.  Absolutely perfect.

If you've never been here, you can't do better than coming between 5-8 pm and getting a standard glazed right off the conveyor belt.  One of the superior culinary experiences in our world.  And bring your child of choice; they love it.
By far my favorite burger joint now. The service is great and the food is AMAZING! Definitely has my business :)

Had lunch here today as always food was great.... Lacy was our server, she was amazing always checking us bringing us refills and checking how we were doing. I have to tell you very impressed. GREAT JOB LACEY!!!!!!

Bad enough that their food is generic pub grub, but then there's this (posted to FB by a friend of mine).  Don't know about you, but it sure makes me not want to give them a dime of my money:

Jakers (of Meridian) took out a full page ad in the Idaho Statesman (which must have cost a pretty penny).

It reads:
"Thanks to Fanny Mae, Freddie Mac, our Federal Legislator, and especially Barney Frank, home equity, IRA, and 401k values are depressed. So here's what we've done for those who have been affected by reduced asset values....."

It then goes on to describe their menu and prices. And is signed by Jake.

Food is always amazing and service is great.  The chicken pizza and BBQ burger are my favs.  My only complaint are the sweet potato fries are a little limp than I prefer.  But I will still devour them.

I worked in the food service industry for 10 years and NEVER complain. This experience has left me with no alternative.  We had reservations for 12 people for 6:30 pm. The entire party was there on time. We were seated at 6:45 pm. We had reservations for the hibachi table. They only staffed one cook, and all 3 hibachi tables were seated at the same time.  Once we got the attention of one of waitresses and asked to order, 3 different times, she shook her head and walked away, LITERALLY  I can't make this stuff up!  It took 20 mins to get waters. While waiting for THE chef to make his way to our table, we were seved miso soup and salads. So at  8:15 pm our meal was finally started and when more room was needed on the table for our meals, we had to bus our own table.  4 of our party of 12 were children between the ages of 3 to 6. The kids were loosing their cool, and the staff couldn't care less.  Around 8:45 pm our meal was served, at that point the children were over it and the 3 year old broke down into tears. Their solution is to bring the 3 year old, and the 3 year old only, ice cream without asking the parents if that was cool. The other children lost it because only one kid got ice cream and not them. The only reason I gave one star was the chef charmed the kids and the food, what little I was able to eat before the melt down, was very good. Granted I could have eaten the hind end of a rhinoceros by the time the food was served, but it was good food.  You've been warned.

I want to start by saying, I love their pizza but hadn't eaten it for a good 5 years.  This is why I stopped in on a Friday.  Here's the break down of my order, medium lasagne pie, 3 sodas, 3 salad bar add-ons.  The bill came to $50.  When I inquired about this seeming excessive, she informed me they are now adding 18% gratuity to the bills.  Yep, $50 for a family of three.  We cancelled the order and left.

My husband and I went to this newly open restaurant yesterday. Both of us ordered their 3 item dinner, including soup, main course, and fried rice(you can choose steamed rice too). He got sweet sour pork and I had stir fried veggie. It is very good value for $9. 
Everything tastes good and we will definitely come back.

Lunch time meal, service was decent despite having a little soda spilled due to the glass being filled to the rim each time it was refilled.  Ordered the smoke house burger medium, it came out closer to well done.  The cheese had slid off the patty and apparently it comes standard with the bun being toasted which basically makes it impossible to actually bite into it as a burger.  According to the manager, Brandon, you would have to specifically ask for it NOT to be toasted.  For burgers, I will definitely be staying to my usual of Red Robin or something like that.
Great Lobster!!  Great Wine!!! Our waiter was wonderful and even brought a snack tray of veggies for the kids.

One thing I love about this store is I can ALWAYS quickly find someone to help me. There is usually someone in every department willing to help you. And they don't say "it's over there" and point you in that direction, they take to you the exact product you're looking for.
First time at Jakers. Had lunch.  Service was fantastic and the food was great.  Will come back.  Food is a little more expensive, but portions were big

We were searching for a Japanese restaurant in our area and when the local Yelpers posted a "night out" at this place I was intrigued.  We decided to go at lunchtime on a Tuesday because we heard about the $1 sushi deal.  Three friends joined us and the experience at this place was a good one.

We all ordered Bento boxes-----Pork Katsu for two of us and Shrimp and vegetable Tempura for the rest.   These boxes were huge!  And contained generous  servings.  I'd never tasted Pork Katsu before and this was a lightly breaded boneless chop, tender, and served with what tasted like a barbecue sauce.   California rolls were also a part of the meal, and there were five of them!  I took some home and enjoyed them for two more days!  I tasted the Shrimp Tempura and liked it----just a nice breadcrumb coating and lightly fried.  The Miso broth and salad to me were just kind of bland.  I'm not sure why Japanese restaurants serve this typical iceberg lettuce with orange dressing.  I might skip that next time.  

We decided to sample sushi off of the cart and made a selection of six.  All good, fresh, and tasty!  I'd like to try some more.  I'd  also like to try the hibachi offerings as our server recommended those as well.  To end this meal we opted for an assortment of Mochi----flavored ice creams wrapped in sticky rice.  A delicious, refreshing ending to the meal! 

I will give a lot of pluses for the service.  Our server was very helpful, friendly, and was knowledgeable about all the sushi and dishes.  As to the actual surroundings, like most reviewers I would say it's plain and understated, but that's kind of what you expect in a Japanese restaurant.   There were also a few private dining rooms that had a communal table where one could dine with a group.  Another plus about this place was the cost of the meal-----for five people the total was $57 and with the addition of a tip, the price of the meal averaged around $14 per person.  You really can't beat that these days for a decent meal in a restaurant, and it would be even far less if you stuck to the $1 sushi deal!

I am giving this BWW a rating higher than normal because of the exceptional service we received once seated. Our waiter, Dillon, was fantastic! He was on the ball, polite, and went out of his way to provide a great dinning experience. I was not overly impressed when we first arrived as we were told that there was a 20 minute wait. I get that it was boneless wing night, but they had 2 or 3 empty tables and we were the only ones waiting. Needless to say our actual wait time was about 7 minutes, but seriously it made me mad when I was told the wait time of 20. The beer selection was quite disappointing especially with the great local craft breweries nearby. I get having the generic Coors Light and Bud selection, but I think this BWW should stock an ample supply of local brews.

This was a great stop. Broke down in Meridian and stumbled upon this little gem. Quality cuts of meat, expansive ale selection, homemade dressings and friendly service. Faith took great care of us and made us feel local.

Amazing burgers.  I had the BACON CHEESEBURGER and my wife had the AVACADO BACON CHEESEBURGER.  The staff was super friendly and the music was great.  We went to the 1615 Main st location.  We will be back often.  GREAT JOB!!!!! KEEP IT UP.

We love this place. Not only is the food AMAZING but everyone who works here treat you like family.
No matter what you order, it's going to be delicious. The quality of food is exactly what you would expect and what you would give your family. We are repeat customers!!!

Called Friday & got an estimate of $100 - $120. Made appt for today. 

Had my car upolstery cleaned $120 - no haggling. I had asked about the discount offered on their Facebook page & he says she puts things up there all the time (on this page). He'd have to check with her first. 

Needless to say he demanded the high end of the quote & gave no discount. 

Granddaughter had upset stomach & it went everywhere. Cleaned it up myself but it left some residual on the center of the bottom of the back seat of my Ford Focus ZX5. Little car. Little bit still on the carpet.  

I had cleared my car of most things but left my phone charger & phone mount & 4 floor mats. 2 regular sized mats in the front floorboards & 2 little mats in the back floorboards. I went back inside the house. 

The owner, Jonathan & his helper ran a motorized carpet cleaning machine for approx 45 minutes.  I was called to go outside & for the most part satisfied. 

Then find my phone charger in pieces in a garbage bag & my phone holder. I went to passenger side of Jonathan truck & asked what happened to the charger. Jonathan said it fell apart when he say sat it on the ground. Says he thought it was broken already & that he didn't step on it.  I asked him why he didn't show to me & say what happened & he said he forgot & thought it was broken already anyway. I told him I was dissapointed that he didn't show it to me & that he was going to leave without telling me about it. He apologized & offered to buy a new one but it's not a common charger so he'd have to order it online like I did. I think I can put it back together & let him leave.  

Moral to the story, don't leave your vehicle or other property in others control. Supervise. Or suffer the consequences.

$9 for a tiny garden salad and a cup of soup?!  $3 for iced tea?! 

Clearly it's all about the beer here. You know that as soon as you reach for the door handles and notice they're shaped like a yard-long drink glass. And that's nothing but classy... In Las Vegas. 

Here's a tip - go in knowing what you want. Otherwise you'll be stuck reading a menu that's almost as long as the Cheesecake Factory's. My theory on long menus is that the variety makes up for the lack of doing anything well. Jack of all trades, master of none. 

We didn't have an issue with service and we were seated after a short wait while a booth was wiped (but still crumby). 

All in all, not a place I'll frequent. The other restaurants in close proximity are so much better.

We are locals and regulars at Kahootz, at least once a week. Everyone there ( Beside the new people :)) know us by name. 

Kahootz deserves five stars. I am only giving it 4 because I am not a big fan of sauces on my steaks and putting sauces on their steaks is kind-of a thing for the chef. The food here is great and there are regular specials. The clam chowder is the best I  have ever had.  

I love their wings and usually get one of the specials. We do not drink but if you like beer I do not think you can go wrong. The owner has 47 beers on tap with a special way of bringing it from the keg to the tap.
Quite possibly my new favorite . Your pizza cooks in three minutes. The white top was so good I want to try every other pizza they make.
My best friend took me out for lunch.  It was delicious and our server Lacy T was amazing! Definitely coming back. Yummy!

The steak was swimming in sauce bit perfectly cooked.
The beer was amazing and with 140 to choose from it was even better.
Waitress was amazing and so helpful.
Cheese curds were great
Can't say enough about the beer.

Amazing prime rib!! Rolls were hot and fresh! We ordered side house salad with ranch dressing and it was super!  The atmosphere is fun if you enjoy country music and we do!! The waiter Michael was very informative and pleasant!  He told the manager Carlos it was our first visit and he came to the table with a gift!  Overall, this is a Great Place!  It's not Outback! Thank Goodness!
Huge selection of food and beer! This place is very very vegetarian friendly! I got the truffle fries and vegetarian "chicken" fingers. It was delicious!

Always great food, service and really decent beer selection. The dessert portions are worth mentioning; they are huge! The bread pudding is some of the best in town. This place is no secret though and gets busy fast, but is well worth the wait.
Good food for the price. Will definitely be returning to try some other promising dished.

I have visited both locations and think Nampa have the best management by far. I was among the guests to get a free meal and take 3 friends along the day before they opened when they did their trial run. One thing to say about that why invite people in and then have no type of feedback survey or card what's the point? 
Cons: every time I have gone in unless I get wings my order was wrong,wait time is always pretty long too. Every sandwch I have tried has been gross sorry its true! Stick to what u do best WINGS or fix the menu.music can be way too loud 
Pros; love the wings  Honey BBQ, Spicy Garlic and Asian Zing. We loved the spicy barbecue sauce, Asian Zing, on the half dozen tender, melt-in-your-mouth chicken wings yum! They have specials tues and thurs
Will go back when I am cravin wings but won't eat any of the other menu items

I think everybody and their dog are happy that these guys opened here in our neighborhood. From the day they opened their doors the restaurant has been slammed with customers. We have been there 4 times and the Paulaner Salvador is an awesome beer, it says it's only 5.9%, I don't believe it. . The food is good, we've tried a couple of their 1/2 lb burgers and both have been very good, I tried one of the salads and wasn't too impressed because of the lettuce but it was ok, the nachos are awesome!  They are made with some kind of a crispy waffle type chip, very good and big enough to share. Service has been good every time we've gone in. They are always checking to make sure we are satisfied and to see if we need anything else. I'm happy with them, we will keep going. I did recommend them to a friend who went later in the evening one time and didn't have the same experience as we did, he said it took extra long to get their drinks because the waiters are all sharing one order station, hopefully they are working through any details and things will just keep getting better.

Great local bar. Huge selection of regional beers, and a full bar. Food is mostly good, we live close so come here often. I've had good and bad, but overall I would highly recommend this place. Portions are typically huge, can usually share if desired.
This Chili's is the best in the area, always quick service and always clean!  The food is awesome as usual too ;).

Food was amazing! We were a little worried based on some of the reviews on this site, but it was truly flawless.

We had pork belly tacos that made my eyes roll with pleasure! I have had some bad experiences with pork belly at other restaurants where it was very flabby, but these pork belly tacos were crispy and perfect. I loved the tangy/spicy sauce on top. 

We also had the blue crab cakes in mango sauce. The sauce was so good I could have had a pint of it. 

My friend also ordered the surf and turf burger, and I scoffed at it initially. I just couldn't imagine Swiss cheese working on a burger topped with lobster. I usually find American Swiss cheese disgusting, but somehow it worked. This burger is great!  They literally smashed a huge chunk of lobster on top of the hamburger along with asparagus, and Swiss cheese. Talk about decadent! 

This restaurant also knows how to cook meat. The burger was requested to be cooked Medium Rare and that's exactly how it came out. 


I will definitely be coming back regularly.

Mixed bag. I have been to Matador several times and LOVE the food. The mushroom enchiladas are my favorite. The last 3 times we have been here the service has been really bad. I waited to write this because I am a firm believer in giving everyone a few chances. As a former restaurant owner I understand that sometimes you have an off night, are understaffed or just busier than expected. The last few times there we have had to repeatedly ask for utensils, napkins, chips and drink refills. On the last visit our server told us all about the Happy Hour specials, took our order for these and then returned a few minutes later to tell us that she was sorry, we had missed Happy Hour by a few minutes. Not a huge deal, but a little frustrating as we had ordered items based on the HH prices. She then completely forgot to take our dinner order and seemed genuinely confused when we flagged her down to place it. Cocktails were forgotten, and one member of our party didn't receive his food until the rest of us were done eating. When the bill came it was incorrect. Again, not a huge deal but we were trying to get to a movie on time and the added delay was inconvenient. I really do love the food and atmosphere, and all of the staff that we have been in contact with has been very friendly. Maybe some increased training or streamlining of some systems might help to improve the service. Wish I could give 5 stars.

The food is really good.  I meet my friends there all the time.  The reason I did not give a 5 rating is because the water they serve tastes like dishwater.  Totally unfiltered and awful.  Eat but don't drink the water!!
Over priced, tasteless. Never have had Pad Thai that's was burnt. How do you burn boiled noddles? I had the added shrimp, obviously the shrimp was old- tough, chewy, had a fishy taste to them.

I rarely come here but when I do it is really good and I wonder why I don't come here more often. I will definitely get the Angel Roll next time, it looked so good but I was so full. The shrimp tempura was good and the gyoza was okay but not vey hot. Had the spider roll was good but the stars were the five dragon roll (see picture) and isomaki roll. The wow roll is good but very rich!! The Evergreen roll is excellent as is the Hana roll and the tiger roll. The spicy yellowtail is wonderful too. Absolutely delicious!! We initially came for the hibachi but they don't start that until 4:30 pm but offered to cook it in the kitchen regardless. They were very accommodating. Service was great. Sushi chef was very nice and tried to explained rolls as much as he could with his language barrier. Still super nice!! And the price was like $50 less then what I pay for at the other sushi places I frequent!!  I need to come back soon!! Come for $1 sushi and sample so you know what rolls you like without spending too much. ;-)

I love going to the downtown Boise location, so naturally when they opened one closer to my home and work place I was thrilled. I am usually always here for their happy hour, and the best part is they have a happy hour twice a day, 7 days a week! I always get the mushroom quesadilla off the happy hour menu, it's so flavorful and only 5 bucks! Sadly, they never have happy hour drink specials, which I thought was the point of happy hour. The margaritas are pretty pricey, but they are strong so one usually will do! I love how they use fresh squeezed juices, and fresh ingredients in their drinks VS bottled mixers. So the drinks are worth the price for the quality and amount of alcohol they use! The service here can be hit or miss. Most times the bartender is very attentive, friendly, and makes small talk and other times I get a bartender that is the opposite and makes me want to quickly eat my quesadilla, drink one margarita, and leave ASAP. So I just don't go sit at the bar the nights that particular bartender is on duty. I really enjoy the atmosphere and look of this place.

Alright. Nobody like going to the dentist. Myself included.

This place, however, is the exception! Having just moved to Boise from California, I took a serious gamble and chose the first dentist on my insurance list. It turns out that I made an excellent choice.

Upon arrival, the office staff was a pure joy to work with - not your typical receptionist. They took the time to get everything squared away for me and saved me from a bunch of hassle finding my insurance information. To make things even better, the office was absolutely beautiful. Modern, well decorated and very comfortable.

When I was checked into the exam room, I was immediately seen by Dr. Jarvis. IMMEDIATELY! Dr. Jarvis and her team were seriously the best medical providers I've ever worked with. Super polite, funny, genuine and above all, gentle. The staff constantly checked to be sure that I was comfortable.

Without the sales pitch from usual dentists, I got a realistic treatment plan - both for immediate correction and long-term preventative measures.

I can recommend this office without ANY hesitation.

Great food, especially fries, and wine at reasonable prices. Beer is the specialty here, but I'm not a beer drinker. Very good service from friendly wait staff. Nice place to get together with family and friends.

I don't think I could ever give Chicago Connection a bad review.  My only wish is they were located in Seattle. The pizza is literally my favorite pizza and whenever I go to Idaho this is one of my first stops. I even make my boyfriend bring this pizza home if I can't make it to Boise. Great pizza, great service, and I actually really want some now....
This place was yummy clean and fast. Even had delicious gluten free crust and cold beer.

Me and my wife made reservations at Jakers last Sunday for our anniversary. We made the reservations for 5:30pm. We walk in the door and they hand us a buzzer. Thought that was strange but went along with it for 25 minutes with 20 other people waiting as well ! We looked around and there were tables clean and available for customers to sit down to order their dinner. We finally asked the hostess that was running around ragged how long it would be and we finally were seated. We ordered crab stuffed mushrooms for an appetizer and I ordered surf and turf (prime rib and prawns). The waiter then told me they ran out of crab stuffed mushrooms. We said that's ok we will just eat the complimentary scones instead. Then 5 minutes later the waiter comes back by and told us they had run out of prime rib as well !! I was very upset and it ruined our anniversary dinner !! Also no manager came by to ask us how our meal was were I could have let them
know I was not happy ! This was unfortunately the first and last time I go to Jakers to eat dinner ! People always go with first impressions regardless of this was just a bad night or not but I am so disappointed and so done with this restaurant !!
Great poke, very clean and friendly place . Highly recommended , lots of choices of fish & shell fish. Tons of sauces & add-ons
Best sushi and service in town! Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for good sushi!!
Not only is the food terrific but the staff is phenomenal. This place is worth the wait trust me. Thanks for a great experience every time
Great food, fantastic service.  Reasonably priced as well.  I will absolutely go back.

How can you screw up soup and salad?  Well they did.....Chicken dry as can be, dressing was non existent.  Manager was nice and comped the meal after I sent back.  This is only the 2nd time I have ever sent food back in my life.

Arrived at 11:20 place was empty and we still waiting 35 minutes.

Ordered Caesar salad with soup - lunch portion.  Very small portion .
Great food, great service. Had the special today which was chicken fried steak! Fresh and hot! Nice to have more breakfast options in the neighborhood!

Had a very enjoyable lunch...we were seated promptly and the rest of the service was good: quick and friendly.  I enjoyed the Cuban pork sandwich...it was served on traditional cuban style bread, with a large portion of diced pork, pepper jack cheese, pickle and tomato with a slightly spicy tomato flavored au jus for dipping.  The bread was as good as any other cuban sandwich bread I've tried at cuban restaurants and the pork was a nice texture, it was simply, yet nicely seasoned with not much more than salt and pepper. The pickle always adds a nice salty, sour, and crunchy component..the tomato didn't do too much for me as it wasn't that juicy or flavorful.  The cheese should have been better melted as there wasn't any gooeyness to it.  What made the sandwich was the spicy broth for dipping.  The flavors were hard to distinguish but it was very flavorful, with a little heat, and hint of tomato.  Without the dipping broth, the sandwich was decent, but subpar from traditional cuban restaurants...with it, it was kicked up a notch.  The truffle fries completed the meal: nicely twice fried with a subtle taste of truffle, not overpowering at all.  In general a good  experience, would like too see a more expanded lunch menu with lunch sized portions of their regular menu items and a healthier options section, but otherwise there's always something new and delicious to try.

Excellent food at a very reasonable price. This place is crazy busy, so be sure to call in ahead. You'll still have to wait a bit, but it's definitely worth it. Despite being packed out tonight, the service was excellent. Shout out to Colton for being so friendly and attentive. We will definitely be back:)

Yum! The best sushi in the Treasure Valley. Tony and the crew at Sakana are fantastic. Tony is more than happy to create a unique roll for you if you want something other than what's on the menu. I also look forward to Thursdays when they have their Uni flown in fresh. They also just added Kirin on tap. I recommend the Sushi Lover and the Ika Salad appetizer...for starters.

Fist thing. I have never seen so many beer choices in my life. They have few different flights which is a great way to sample. We had the Kung Pao Calamari app and the Jambalaya. Both were excellent although the Kung Pao was a bit sweet but nice and tender. Would definitely go again.

I've been going to Jakers  for as long as I can remember , even before the restaurant moved to the Meridian location.  What I like about dining here is the friendly, helpful wait staff and the menu.  I especially like the smart plates section as it offers a selection of smaller portions at a lower price.  My favorite is the London Broil with mashed red skin potatoes.  I also like the lightly breaded trout.  The house wines are good and very reasonable.  Like any restaurant it can be crowded so it's best to go during the week or at an earlier time. I don't recall ever having a bad meal here, but I guess it can happen, just like at any restaurant!

When you see those horrible sitcoms of a bunch of idiots at a fast-food place, or restaurant- I imagine that the employees of Idaho Pizza Company resemble something very similar.

Placed an order for a pizza, at 6:00. 55 minute wait time. Okay sounds great.

Someone from another location- which we have never ordered from, calls me at 7:20 informs me he needs my credit card information, again. I check my bank account and I say, um no- it's already a pending transaction. 

He says, they transferred orders to another store and he needs it. I say, you're nuts and I'm not paying twice for a pizza and putting my faith you'll be smart enough to refund the original transaction.

*pause... mumble something incoherent, passes the phone to the Manager*

Hi, we need your credit card information he says. NO, I say- figure it out in your system and get the money from your other location, if you did indeed 'transfer' the order.

"Okay, we will do that."

Shady business, maybe not even necessarily shady- maybe literally just not smart enough to handle their finances internally.

 Still sitting here, an hour and a half later.

*Update*

It is now 8:00, 2 hours later- the genius Manager, transferred our order to his State St. location- after confirming our address & taking our order.

Not sure why, he wasn't either when he called, as they have delivered to us at least 12 times. We haven't moved & when I initially called in, they verified we were in radius of THEIR location. So I guess our pizza is somewhere in downtown Boise, alone and homeless while we starve.

At this point it's laughable at just how stupid they are. We will never order again from these morons.

The food is always delicious. They cook to order, so service is a little slower than the fast food joints.  It's worth the extra few minutes you have to wait.  Their iced tea is fresh brewed and tastes great.

Pretty good sandwiches, but the ham is WAY sweet. It takes over the whole sandwich. Also, make sure you tell them if you don't want your sandwich hot, they put most of them through the oven. I may try again and not get ham:)

I was never a sushi eater until my girlfriend turned me on to this place, & I'm so glad she did. The sushi is phenomenal, presentation and interior is nice,and the staff members are cool. 

We've tried just about all the special rolls and enjoyed them but a couple that stand out were the Dynamite, Viking, and Black Dragon! 


Give it a try. This place is BOMBBBBB

I absolutely love this place! This is my number one choice when we go out to eat! The service, atmosphere and of course the food is amazing!! Unfortunately I don't get to eat here as much as I like because the wait to get in is so long!! We go out to eat often but with kids the wait isn't an option for us. Only on special date nights are we able to come. It would be great to have another one out here so my kids can enjoy the great food and atmosphere too!

We frequent this location, because our food is consistently hot and fresh.   Service is what is, Try to avoid the kids 1/2 price night too much traffic.  Check mail for coupons.  They'll take multiple coupons at one transaction.

It's time for me to do an updated review on Jaker's.   We hadn't been here for awhile and as it was on our way to another event last evening we decided to give them a try.  We were joined with two friends and  the dining experience was good for all.

Having smaller appetites we all opted for the Smart Plate Menu.  This is a really good bargain because the portions are smaller but also include a soup/salad plus a choice of a side.   There are many choices including trout, calves liver and onions, sirloin steak, braised short ribs with mashed potatoes, almond coated chicken breast, and salmon.  Quite an assortment for a limited menu and something for everyone.

Two of our party chose almond crusted chicken breast----very tender, tasty, with a crunchy coating.  I had trout---it's offered two ways---chargrilled with lemon caper butter or pan fried.  I chose the grilled, lemon caper version and found it to be nicely cooked and flavored.  One in our group had liver and onions---two large thin slices served with crispy bacon, sautéed onions, and two large onion rings on the side.  He said it was tender, very tasty and ended up taking some home there was so much!

For dessert, my husband and I shared a white brownie sundae, topped with caramel and chocolate sauces.  It was good, but a bit sweet.  Our friends split the silky chocolate cake and said it was delicious.   The four of us expressed disappointment that Jakers no longer offers Mud Pie, which was this incredibly delicious coffee ice cream in a chocolate crust, drizzled with chocolate syrup!  Maybe one of these days we'll convince them to bring it back!

went to main street burger yesterday at the wrong time: lunch time.  placed my order for a burger and drink and paid my bill.  was given a drink cup.  the place became absolutely packed while all parking places were taken and the drive line actually blocked an exit lane.
i determined my rating due to the lunch time crowd.

could not make a rating based upon my burger experience since i never received my burger.  after a very lengthly wait observing new customer coming and going i inquired into the status of my order.  was given a sincere apology and a refund for the amount i had paid.  the three folks working there were very, very busy and very nice.

will return some time in the future to determine the quality of their burgers; however, not at lunch time.

Excellent food chicken Parmesan was excellent!! Drinks from bar are not that great stick with their abundant and excellent beers and wines. I had the steak and it was juicy and melted in my mouth cannot complain there. Staff was excellent could easily become my local spot that I go to often.

Disappointing first visit. My Phad Thai was overlooked, eggs and veggies were burnt to a crisp, as was the tofu, which was inedible.  The soups were served only lukewarm.  The Mac and cheese was tasteless.  When I asked if the tofu was usually cooked that way, she answered, no, it's usually cooked with the noodles.  Then why did you serve it as charcoal when you knew it wasn't done right?  At least they gave me my $$ back.

Pros: located in an excellent location in the Village near the movie theater.  Friendly customer service.  Wide variety of appetizers, meals, beverages, and alcoholic menu.  Meals are huge portions so rarely do you even finish a meal without needing a box.  Wait staff is quick to get your drinks and order, felt they made a point to get to us, and gave great  dinner recommendations. 

Con: it's always so busy so either call ahead or plan on waiting a little bit.  (It's busy because it's good!) it is pretty noisy inside so it is hard to have a conversation at the table.  Great for people watching not so great for a conversation at dinner.  The menu tastes great and portions are large, but it is soooooooooo expensive for Boise.  For two people to have an app and dinner, it's close to a $100.  

Overall a great place for a nice meal, but you'll spend a pretty penny for it.

We had their special tonight. 11 oz Sirloin with two sides. We also had their dessert. Wife had the strawberry cheese cake. She said it was delicious. Same with Grandmas Apple ? Pie Alamodome. We both just about had to roll out of there. The service was excellent. Steaks were awesome as well as the sides. I have never gotten a bad meal here. Keep up the good work.
Lots of eager-to-help employees as compared to many stores nowdays where you have to hunt for someone to help.

My husband were in the mood for Mexican and were close by so decided to stop in. The service started out fine but once we got our food were were completely forgotten about. The busboy was actually the most friendly and helpful person in the place. 

The food was bad just bad. I had the Baja plate which is a stuffed fried avocado and an enchilada. It was dry and very over done. The sauce was dried to my enchilada like it had been sitting under a warmer for awhile. 

My husband had a burrito that came cut in half. Half of the burrito had the chicken while the other half had the rice and beans. It was really salty and dry. 

We paid $30 and left feeling completely unsatisfied and regretful!

After a long day of soccer tournaments, we were starving for some substantial food! We entered and were told to choose our seat; the ambiance was perfect! It was so chill and the perfect noise level for a bar and grill. All of the cocktails on the table were superb and the food even better. My dad and I ordered steaks, my mom the salmon special, and my brother, who is exremely picky, received a completely personalized pasta dish based on what he likes. The flavor of the food was perfect! The staff was friendly and accomodating, creating a perfect atmosphere for needy children or a relaxing dinner party with friends or family.  I would definitely suggest this venue to anyone!!
Love the atmosphere. Wait staff is great. I appreciate that they save the large booth for six plus groups. Food was delicious. Can't wait to go back again.

Went on a Friday night and the restaurant was packed.  They did not have a host so it was a free for all to find an open table.   Food was typical pub fare... I had a Reuben... Not sure if it was standard item on the menu since it was near St. Patrick's day.  It had good flavor.  Also had a bite of the fish and chips which was good as well.  Thought the Siracusa ketchup was a nice change of pace. 

Lost some points for bad service... I know they were busy... But it took 10 mins for someone to show up at the table.  Beers and drinks were empty for over half the meal.    I had to ask waiters from other tables for things.   I don't think it was that busy since I saw our waiter go to a different table several times before stopping by.... And the tables next to us were getting good service.   After finishing our meal.. Took 10 minutes to find our waiter to get the check.  Took another 10 minutes to get out check after we asked for it. Was going to pay with a credit card... But after 5 more minutes waiting for him to pick up the check... Decided to pay cash.
Best finger steaks hands down!  The price is right, too. And the friendly guy taking the order is a big plus.

My food never arrived. The delivery service, EAT24,  provided an email confirmation of my order which included an online chat and telephone number to call should I need to contact them. At 90 minutes of waiting, I did try to contact them. However, they did not respond to my chat nor did anyone ever pick up the telephone. After two hours of waiting I called the Yardhouse directly.  In speaking with their manager, who was very professional, he advised that there had not even been a carry out order placed for my food nor had he ever heard of EAT24.  He himself is contacting his marketing department.   Believing EAT24 is a sham,
I have since filed a claim with PayPal to refund my money.
I had these movies move my sons home into a storage unit. They were fantastic.

I was never sure about this place, but thought I'd try it. It was great, we had to send one of our dishes back and they promptly brought another. The girl who served us was very friendly, it was like talking to an old friend. I'm looking forward to trying their other dishes.

I'm a huge fan of Mongolian bbq... If you are too, skip this one. They boast they have "more" but that certainly does not equate to "better."  The salad & soup bar-not something you typically find at a Mongolian bbq-the salad selections were limited & wilty, & the soup tasted like it was from a can.  On the Mongolian buffet area, veggie items appeared to be prepped to early (browning carrot sticks, dried zucchini slices & shriveled mushroom slices) or overly prepped (mushy pea pods, edamame & asparagus).  The bowls here are so small (they are wanting diners to make several trips) they don't hold a single serving of ingredients-my noodles slipped over the top of the bowl, across the edge of the also too small tray & onto the meats slipping off the next guys bowl & tray... Speaking of noodles... we couldn't figure out why they had Italian pasta shapes out next to the ramen noodles, either.

Fast, inexpensive, and delicious pizza.  I doubted that a pizza made that fast could taste that good, but I was wrong!  

One of my new favorite lunch spots.

Would have gave this place 4 stars a week ago when we came but my experience last night will probably keep me from coming back. Tried it a week ago and it was very good. Last night I went through the drive thru and the boy taking my order was taking to me in a robot voice (on purpose) and I could hear him giggling with co-workers as he was doing it. It was so awkward for me. Then at the window he was trying to explain why he was talking in that voice. Just weird and unprofessional. When we got home with our food he had forgot the cookies and our sandwiches were made wrong. I looked at the receipt and they were punched in wrong. Probably because he was having more fun acting like a idiot through the speaker. Kinda sucks. My advice, hire more mature staff. I'm not sure if there was a manager in there at the time but my experience was not good.

I LOVE this store!  All of my experiences have been great.  Sales associates are very friendly and helpful.  Yes, it can be pricey, but they do have promotions (and a great sale room.  It's just so nice to be able to shop for clothes, household items, etc. that are somewhat unique from many other stores.  I have been an Anthro customer for many years (in another state) and I am very happy they have one here!!

I'm here visiting my daughter and her family . It was the first time at this restaurant.  I enjoyed it very much . My grand babies loved the most we went on kids night , root beer or orange floats !! The adults had the big O brownie .. yummy !!  The waitress was wonderful Becky was her name , and we loved the balloon man !! Thank you for the love birds and flower for my grand babies . We will be back when at my next visit . Thank you again for the great experience.. only one thing I didn't care for was the music was a little to loud.. Love country, but you can put it down a little

I'm not a fan. Service was super slow. I'm not really sure our server knew what he was doing as he seemed to get distracted repeatedly, would disappear for long periods of time, and didn't take our order until we had probably been there for about 20 minutes. It was not busy at all either. Maybe five tables were being used. Our family had mixed reviews on the food as well. Kids pizzas were so burnt, I would have been embarrassed to bring them out. My daughter and husband enjoyed their burger and macaroni and cheese. My souvlaki pita was super disgusting. I don't know where the chicken was from, but the few bits inside the pita were fatty and gross. It was mainly filled with lettuce. My husband wants to try them again... I'm not sure I'm up to it.

This is a great place to eat.  The decorations and setup are great and the food is consistently good.  I would give them a 5 star if they could just fix their  water.  I realize that is a small thing but the water needs some filtering as it tastes like chlorine.  I have been here maybe 5 times so far and every time the water is terrible. I'm not a soda drinker.  Staff is friendly and all the food is very good.  Please just buy a water filter :). Lasagna is the best I have tasted out of several top places that serve it.  I was honestly very surprised as it was far better than Gino's down the street

Great job on our carpet, they were quick and got the job done. Easy to schedule an appt. we added our upholstery cleaning and it came out like new. Our neighbor and our house got cleaned, I would highly recommend it!

Marv is great! Called him and he stopped by later that same day. We had a room that did not get insulated when the house was built (just bought the house). Marv was able to get attic access from the adjoining main attic and add insulation to this room.  The cost was so reasonable that we had them add insulation to the rest  of the house. We are now in 100 degree weather and the house feels great inside!  The room that had no insulation is now livable! Marv was quick, responsive, and did great work.  I recommend them.

Awesome pizza in 180 seconds!!! Your choice of toppings or predetermined from the workers themselves: either way, one of the best pizzas I ever tasted! Seating was good and the turnaround time was quick. Wish you folks had one in Hawaii!!
My house was all moved real fast. Very friendly very careful with my stuff. They were amazing. I am very pleased and thankful I called this company.

I love coming to this location because it is less crowded than the downtown one and has a much larger seating capacity. I love sitting at the fire table.
