Happy hour is essentially only good, but really good food. My favorite is the chicken tortilla soup ( I know boring). But it is really flavorful and super filling. They also have huge shrimp quesodillas that are amazing. The only complaint is that there are only two drinks in the happy hour meni, their two premixed margaritas, which I find too sweet.  This really need stone expand to include the other margaritas they have on the menu.

Pros: Great steak, big chunks of meat on the Ruben and excellent service (5 refills). Cons: Little spendy with not much elbow room and the chicken was little done.  Overall great presentation and worth another visit since it is truly a steak ale house.

We arrived to Jakers during Happy Hour and I was very pleased with the variety on the menu.

We ordered several items on the menu.  The delivery of each item was quick and the portions for a happy hour item was really good.  We got full eating from the happy hour menu.

The staff was very friendly and attentive, clean restaurant...I had a feeling of wanting to return the next day but we were departing Idaho.

I was afraid to try sushi again after a bad experience somewhere else, but I got courageous and tried again and I have to say this place was great. The service was quick, staff was nice and the food was awesome! I have been back a few times now and will continue to eat here a lot in the future.

Great place for your car's periodic Maintance. All service people were very attentive and explained all procedures thoroughly. 
Was concerned when one attendant leaned over the running engine with his tie and tie clip on. I have been around aircraft engines and we never allow this due to the FOD hazard.

This is the third nail place I've tried in the area, and now I've gone here probably five times and even brought my mother in law here. I always get pink and white acrylics, and have gotten 2 gel pedicures from Tim. The techs always do a great job, they will fix any imperfections rather than just pretend they didn't happen. And they're all nice to talk to.
Finally, the reason I originally tried this salon- they always, always get me in same day. Even on Fridays. I'll continue going here even though I moved across town.
I've been here twice and both times the service has been incredibly friendly and crazy fast. The food has been utterly delicious, and my girlfriend reports that the margaritas are top notch.
First time trying firehouse and it was Way better then I expected. I had it delivered which was perfect. Will be eating there more often.

The rib eye steak here is out of this world good! I've eaten my fair share. They only get four stars because of their stubborn refusal to serve them to me by a three legged nun waving sparklers while riding a unicorn.

Ingrates.

My 1st visit was great! I had the Turkey Burger with original fries. The staff was more than accommodating (however, I was a Lone Ranger) and friendly. Plenty of TV's for watching sporting events (or any event). I wanted to sit outside, but the seating was already full. Overall, fantastic experience and great turkey burger!
Love their beer and love their food. Chicken nachos on happy hour is just absolutely amazing. 8 dollars can feed 3-4 people. More money for those tasty brews!
This place has a nice variety of beers, service was great and the food was really fresh! Try the bloody mary!

This is our favorite restaurant. We go for the Poblano sauce, which is the best!  One Happy hour nachos feeds all our kids! Yes, you can take your kids to this location! The wait staff is so friendly. It's a great location for a date. Can't wait to go back!
In the simplest of terms, if you do not eat here you are dead inside. Blaze is AWESOME - you have have to wait a few minutes - even with a long line - but the short wait is well worth it.

Came here on a Tuesday evening with a group of Yelpers.  I can say that I will most definitely be back!  

On Tuesday evening (they may have the deal all day, but I know for certain they have it for dinner) they have dollar sushi night.  They bring around a cart that features a vast array of sushi rolls and each piece (2 pieces if it's a smaller roll) is just a buck!  My dining companion ordered one of each so we were able to try a little bit of everything.  There was not one single thing I didn't like.  It was all fresh, lovely, and delicious.    The shining stars of the evening for me were their Pink Lady and Hana rolls. 

The service was attentive (if a bit slow at times).  Our server was able to keep up well with our table of 6 (and we had separate checks--all of which were calculated correctly at the end of the evening).  The dining area is lovely and if you have a large group, they have the option of private dining rooms.  They're done in a modified traditional Japanese style.  By modified, I mean that you do take your shoes off prior to entering the dining room, and you do have the option of kneeling but you may also sit in the more American way by how they have the table set up.  They also have hibachi grills you may sit at to eat and be entertained by the chefs!

Overall, a wonderful experience.  I definitely recommend coming on Tuesday (or Monday as I believe they have dollar sushi day on Monday as well) if you've never been.  It's a wonderful way to try different rolls without having to commit to an entire roll.  And....a bargain to boot!

Get to it!

The yard house was a fun evening out. Got there early and found seats at the bar. Ordered our beers after having our great server answer our questions. We ordered a menagerie of items from the happy hour menu. Items came out spaced out  correctly so items didn't get cold while waiting on the bar. After a few hours it was packed and time to go.

Pleasantly surprised and thank you for coming to our end of town.  Great bar with some cool promotions (Thanks Deschutes!)   I am not a fan of bar food but this place is different, first you will find salads and pitas which is a great addition.  The fries, well they are great and the food quality and taste has been consistent since the beginning which tells me we have some owners who are focused.  I cannot imagine how difficult the restaurant business is but Homestead is doing all the right things.
Has been my favorite meridian restaurant for years.  Its a real community secret.

This place seems to have an identity crisis. The presence of TV's showing ESPN around the entire restaurant doesn't gel with the swankier decor. Is Jakers supposed to be fine dining or a sports bar? By trying to do both, you get neither to me.

Our server Phil was fantastic. I chatted with my dinner date for a long time before we ended up ordering, but we were never pushed or hurried despite the restaurant being packed. He had a keener eye than most on when he should and shouldn't approach our table. Funny, gracious-- this was some of the best service I've had in Boise.

Unfortunately my food was overpriced mediocrity, and that's an automatic two stars from me. The proprietor from one of my favorite places to eat at in Boise says Jakers is in his top 3 in the valley, so I went based on his recommendation. He told me you can't go wrong with the beef or salmon there. But Jakers was pushing a Lobster Fest that week, and I got sucked into that. I opted for lobster ravioli with some lobster bisque. The bisque had a nice chunk of lobster in it but the soup was unremarkable. The lobster filling in the ravioli was lacking, and the dense cream sauce that accompanied it overpowered what little of the lobster I could actually taste. The asparagus that came with it were small and mushy like they had come from out of a can. Even if they didn't, they weren't prepared well. Definitely not worth the $19 I was charged.

Shoulda gone with the beef. It's conceivable I may come back for it unless the Double R Ranch beef they use can be found somewhere over-the-counter in town.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Response to owner's comments below: Your response is appreciated (sadly not too many owners take the time to respond). However the proprietor that I mentioned above no longer recommends your establishment after having a couple subpar experiences there with the beef after I had posted my review. Given the prices of the entrees, returning to Jakers is a risk I'm no longer willing to take. Give Phil a raise though.

If I could give no stars I would. Unfortunately this Carl's is close to my house. I told myself a trip before that I wouldn't be back but tonight I made an exception and decided to give them another chance. I have no idea how this location is still in business with the quality of food I've gotten there. My wife ordered a #10 the last 2 Times we've been there, if you don't know it's a lettuce wrapped burger, both times we've gotten home it's a regular burger with a bun. The fries tasted and the temperature of said fries has me thinking they cook as many fries as they can when they open and that's the fries you get at 7pm as well. How hard is it to train employees and have some quality assurance at your restaurant??? Proceed to this location at your own risk...

For the special occasion Japanese meal, I recommend Sakana.  I say this because in my book Japanese food over all, is very pricey for what you get.  Walk in here and you'll be lucky to leave for under $50.  But this is not a slam, just the usual price point of Japanese food.  The staff is friendly.  The service is very good.  Grill/Chief style seating if you prefer or private authentic Japanese style rooms for larger parties.  The food is excellent.  The sushi/sushi-mi it seems as gotten slightly more pricey and the rolls a tad smaller. The atmosphere is open and comfortable.  All in all a very, very good Japanese restaurant experience.

This place was awesome. It was casual, the service was excellent and friendly and the food was delicious. We had a steak and baked potato, salad and wine. Perfect place for a casual steak (other people's food looked delicious as well!) dinner.

Every bite was perfection, we had the iron skillet deluxe and the pork egg foo young, melt in your mouth, the pork on top was like a whole different dish. We cannot wait to come back. This place is a gem! Just the place we have been searching for. My husband says best Chinese in a long time. Family owned and staffed.

Our experience tonight here was absolutely terrible. Cold soup (how does this happen?), WAY undercooked hamburger- it was raw in parts, my steak and asparagus was not only not cooked right but it was inedible due to the temperature and toughness of the steak, another steak was purple inside and it took AN HOUR to get all of this food. We also had no refills on drinks and the waitress wasn't really around at all. Do not go here.
I'm sorry but the sushi is just not good enough. Good service.

Very overrated, I have eaten here 3 times, have to say there will not be a 4th time, The food is OK seems like i always have to send something back because the server doesn't put the order in correctly.  The prices are high,   Very disappointed

Love being able to order my own personal pizza for a decent price. Their spicy red sauce is amazing. They have to go boxes too which is nice since I never finish the whole thing. It's the subway of pizza places!
Mahi Mahi was the special, and it was out of this world!  Good beer selection as well, this place didn't disappoint.

I gave Sakana a 3 because they are right in the middle. There sushi is delicious. Taste fresh and well put together however I don't feel they take the same care in there bento box meals. I purchased the teriyaki chicken bento box. Firstly I pre-ordered picked it up got back to work to discover they forgot the rice and California Rolls. No biggie I work 5 minutes away I called and they had it ready when I ran back. The downfall to the teriyaki bento box though was that they give you a dry no flavored thin chicken breast and the teriyaki sauce that I got on the side was a mild flavored gelatin. No joke , was like Jello that you put to much water in. The flavor was teriyaki but like it had been diluted. Suffice to say I was disappointed and will not be getting anything but sushi there. I think if they dedicated the same amount of pride to their bento boxes as they did sushi this place could be 5 stars.

Went to the Yard House to celebrate 14 years of marriage. We have also been celebrating losing over 130 lbs so eating out is more of a challenge. The Yard House was very accommodating on requests. Also the waitress was very nice and always checking on us. It was a great time and a great date night.
Really? It's Texas Roadhouse! Always consistent food, service and drinks. Plus, although it's typically loud, the ambience is fun too. Have fun.

Went to Yard House with a group of friends...I had read many Yelp reviews, but decided the experience it just the same.  This is expensive!!  $13 burgers, $6 beers.  The food is just OK, but due to the high price, was not a good value for what you get.  Service was good, ambience was good, if not a bit noisy.  Too expensive to bring the kids.  Go to Red Robin and get the same quality for a better price.
The young guy working right now at the window (9:40pm March, 21) was so nice!! Great customer service, made my night :)

Ate there last night...  I agree with earlier review about noise. The music is way too loud to hold a conversation. Food is only average at best. Asked for no mayo on sandwich and got mayo.  Calamari app was very average.  They replaced it and comped it, but it wasn't good at all. Go elsewhere for a turkey club.  Overcharged for house wine. Gave us the $11 glass instead of the $6 glass. 
They were mobbed so don't need my business, but I won't be back. Disappointing.

Let's start with the basics. The ambiance is absolutely amazing. Such an eclectic and warm atmosphere. It's cozy in the best way possible. The food is great. A little pricey but worth it. The black bean queso is probably the best thing I've ever tasted. Service is excellent. Lots of smiles and my water glass was never empty. So why not 5 stars? It's not the best Mexican food I've ever had. It's good but not the best.

So far so good best happy hour in town two dollar margaritas and 2.50 blended margaritas you can't beat that. The calamari so far is amazing I will continue my reviews as we are eating.
I had to update this I had a Moscow Mule and it was absolutely delicious perfectly made! When my hamburger came I think I started to drool and it was so good and so huge I ate way more than I should have but that tells you something about that hamburger that was sitting in front of me. If I don't like something I don't eat it. The problem with dinner it was almost too good the service was perfection and the hostesses in the front were so sweet. Jacor's got 10 stars for congeniality 10 stars for their food and 10 stars for the service if they allowed me to give it

Now open..  Freindly not so fast service. But is new and close to the house.   The first time I've ever got the 2 tacos for a buck? Is it wrong that I actually like them.  And know I was not drinking.   That's all I got.

Ate here yesterday the southwest egg rolls tasted old. We would have sent them back but our wAiter seemed to be having a bad day. Not what I expected from Chilis.  Won't frequent this location again. Step up your kitchen guys. We're not here for mediocre food.

5 stars for this joint. We have been to this location 4 times now and always have a great experience. We have pretty much dubbed this our "usual" Friday night joint for dinner. Whether we bring our kids or just get out for a quick date night we always feel welcomed and enjoy great food and a great atmosphere. Even last week there must have been a mix up on which server was handling our table and it took a few minutes to get service (not the first time this has happened to us in our life and won't be the last... pretty common) but they went above and beyond apologizing, offered a free dessert, the whole deal. We told them it wasn't necessary and we just appreciated the concern. They insisted so we just had a delicious cookie with some super cold milk. Perfect way to end a meal here. We live the food, the staff, and the atmosphere. They are a great place to have this close to our home!! Keep it up!
We love this place! We currently live in Vegas now but every year we come home and this is our first stop! Always fresh the meats are always cooked perfect and the service is wonderful.
Jonathan was great. He dies great job on my water damage on my floor. He fix the one that the other guy I hired. Very good service. Worth recommending !!!

I was in town for a baby shower-i went  there around 1.00pm, the last day of my trip i had lunch with a friend, she suggested them, 
we both had the salad bar, $9.99 which had a great variety of fruit, spinach, romaine,shrimp, chicken breast, strawberries. i also had a big huge glass of raspberry ice tea with berries in it :) 
the rest of my group arrived to Jakers during Happy Hour and were  very pleased with the variety on the menu.

They ordered several items on the menu.  then shared them,The delivery of each item was quick and the portions for a happy hour item was really good. they reported that they wish they had known about it earlier  in the trip.
my daughter,that loves in the area couldn't believe how reasonable it was, her hubby takes her there and dinner for 2 always runs over a $100 with drinks.
Areas for improvement :
 have the soup and salad together in one place, or consider serving the soup via the wait staff.
We were not asked for refills on the drinks even once.
Wiping down the table is nice,but please dry it too! Didn't like putting my new Coach fabric purse or phone down on the wet surface.
offer sugar or honey with unsweetened teas, my only choice was artificial sweetener
This place is no chandlers or five star steak house but if your looking for great priced tasty food, this place is a great choice. Anyone who disagree is really picky and should stay home.

I regularly dine here. The staff is friendly and great.  The menu is good and they always get the food out to you fast and hot.
The bar is nice too. It's a great place to see the BSU games.

Hubby & I have eaten here a few times, and the Alfredo Montamore is my go to favorite. We checked out the specialty drinks they advertise, but with so few options, we end up getting a drink somewhere else. We like restaurants that are transparent about their ingredients and that exclude harmful chems in the food, so we'll be coming back.

Here's my breakdown of BWW for you in stars.

One Star- Open Late even durning the week
One Star- Late Night Happy Hour
One Star- Cheap

But other then that, I was NOT impressed. The drinks were all juice when I swear I asked for a VODKA and cranberry. The service was all right. The whole experience was ah for me. Especially for the drive.

Ribs are great..... Nice place for large groups.... The butter is to die for.....This is a kid friendly place. The food and drinks are great. If I travel to Boise area again I will stop for sure.....This is a chain and for that I would say yes.... yummy friendly and fun... They dance and have country attire....I will be back

Yardhouse has good food , no doubt about it. They have a huge menu and lots of beers on tap.  But it is very expensive.  Most meals are between high teens and low 30s.   You will have to wait to get a table, we waited about 40 minutes on a friday night.

We went here to watch the Packers vs Cowboys game and they were awesome. We told the hostess which game we were there to see, and the two girls  literally tried to get us the best view. I wish I could remember their names! But it was about 1:30pm on 10/7. They both kept coming and telling us about a table with a better view of the game. Trying to get us the best spot while letting us know it was totally up to us! And they got us right in front of the big screen. So awesome. Then there was our server, John. Excellent doesn't even describe his level of customer service. He was beyond great. 
This was our first time at this BWW, we are new here to the state. Great food, awesome service. We will be back, definitely.

This place is great, great then they bomb and do something stupid like run out of their tasty bread and or another staple entree food.i like jakers,i want to live jakers but dang if our bad experiences out way are good ones
Realy great food i like there ribs and i cant get enough of there fresh rolls . just wish that they where open for lunch.

Food is good. Service so so. Brought our bill before we began eating dinner....guess I didn't want another drink or dessert.  Copes an attitude when i asked for a to go box. Atmosphere is loud but it's a sports bar.

We used Home Satellite Solutions after bailing on CableOne.   We've really enjoyed our Direct TV experience.   Sandra and Ben were wonderful to deal with and they work hard to get you the best deal with current promotions, refferals deals, etc.    I loved their personal service and I liked supporting a local, family run business.

It's new. It's over-crowded like every new Boise restaurant. If you don't have a reservation expect to wait an hour or more pretty much any given time of the day. Reservations can be made up until 6:00pm. 

The drink menu is extensive, at least 1/3 or more of the gigantic menu is wine, beer and mixed drinks. Drinks seem to be on the pricey side - $9.50 for a Mojito. The food menu is also extensive spanning several pages. 

We had a group of 8 for dinner. The service was very attentive but there seemed to be a lot of people helping to serve the group, including two servers and many runners. 

The food was good but nothing to write home about. No one had any complaints but there weren't any raves about a particular dish either. I was super disappointed with the gluten free menu. It was about 1/8 of the regular menu options and my server didn't seem to take my need for gluten free too terribly seriously. Maybe it was lack of training, not sure. We did ask for the artichoke dip to be made gluten free and it came out with bread crumbs. 

I will try the Yard House again when they get some of the kinks worked out and aren't SO busy.
Thank you Brianna for an awesome ombré!  From experience I know this takes talent, and she is truly incredible. Thank you for recommending products that work wonders on my mop! ;)
Very nice staff. Fish was really fresh and flavorful. Good selection of toppings and sauces too. Will definitely be back!
When I take a cheat day from my no carb diet, I will  definitely go here. Super nice workers and awesome burgers and fries!

it has been 9 months since I have eaten here.  This has been a favorite of mine in other states and this was my first experience in ID.  I was greeted with an anti 2nd amendment billboard.  "BWW bans guns on these premises".  The food is good but not so good that im willing to compromise my values.  Don't support BWW.  We won't be going back until that sign is gone.

Great food at a great price. I ordered the Pastrami sandwich, it was amazing with lots of flavor. Wish there was a Yardhouse in Tacoma, WA
Restaurant is always clean, service is ok but friendly. The AC is a little too cold.

Very clean place.  More grill than bar.  The help was polite, but slow.  Food was just ok....we ordered a variety of things to try.  Nothing special.  Seems it would be better served having some more unique items on the menu and more experienced help. Our area has amazing food in general, so it needs to be better than okay as the competition is fierce.

Great place for steak,  casual atmosphere but with awesome food. I recommend, the side salad with house made blue cheese dressing,  yum! 
Asparagus was good,  next time though I want mashed or baked potato.  The grilled red potatoes need flavor.  But overall, really good!

Pot Belly Deli has just opened on Franklin & Linder in Meridian, and I was hoping for a terrific deli experience. The women behind the counter were nice, and the food was made quickly, but frankly, I could have made the same sandwich at home. It was nothing special. I had a Philly Cheesesteak, and everything was placed onto the bread cold (including the previously sauteed onions), then heated up in the microwave. 

I'll give it one more chance, but with other terrific choices here in town (2 Fat Guys, The Curb, Kahootz), you have to really have something good to compete for my dollar. Jazz it up some, Pot Belly Deli! Maybe toast the bread, put more meat on the sandwiches and whip up some homemade gourmet mayo?

Disappointed. We were so looking forward to eating at this busy place  

Festive greeters and staff people. 

Peanuts at the table to enjoy with margaritas that were good. Cinnamon butter was perfect and wonderful with the rolls it was served with. 

I had never had Texas ribs and even though they were very tender and falling off the bones I did not like the sauce on them at all 
If that's how the sauce is in Texas well  I'm not a fan. The Idaho baked potato was done perfectly. The rice side was so-so. 

Hubby liked his rib eye and shrimp a lot. However the apple pie was terrible.  Way too sweet with maple syrup or something poured over. 

If you like a quiet place this isn't for you. Liked the music though.

We are in town for a wedding and staying in a hotel. We wanted someplace decent but quick. We called in our order and the food was fresh and good. Staff was courteous and friendly. Pizza was really good.  The only reason I am not giving them five stars is because the pasta had large chucks of garlic. I like garlic but it was a little overpowering. We will eat here if we are in Boise again but I probably won't order the pasta.
It's upbeat and can be somewhat loud. Overall the pizza is great. You make your own style pizza and cooked in a fire wood oven. Enjoyable every time we come here.

Dim, noisy, greasy, expensive, and long wait times. 

Still, they offer excellent vegetarian options and their onion rings are good. Not as good as your standard Red Robin's. But not bad.

I thought I had a favorite pizza place until I went to Blaze Pizza. This place is fantastic. You can pick your sauce and toppings. Little of this...little of that or more of this and less of that. However you want it. They fire it up and in just a few minutes delicious hits your table.  They also have a delicious blood orange lemonade that's amazing. This place can get super busy and that can make it hard if you have a larger group. Great staff and great customer service.

Good food, service was fine and management stopped by our table to make sure everything was ok. 

I do love the wings here, but it is overall a better experience if you can come in with some NFL or college games on.
Great place, awesome service, large beer selection and fair price on menu items.  Cubano sliders are very tasty
Consistent - Consistent - Consistent.   Sat at the bar on Sunday afternoon.  Both bartenders were attentive and did a great job.  Food came out quickly and tasted delish.  All was great.
Love the vampire tacos and are never disappointed with the Moscow Mules!

We stopped by the Yard House shortly before 6:00pm on a Friday night.  It was very crowded and there was a wait, but we were seated within the promised 30 minute window.  The hostess and server were both friendly and polite, and the service was fairly attentive considering how full the restaurant was.  The atmosphere was trendy and upscale, but far too loud for my liking.  Don't go at prime time with plans to catch up on conversation with anyone, because you won't be able to hear.

I can't comment on the beer as we didn't order any, but we were rather disappointed by the food.  My husband ordered the clam chowder and said it tasted like it came from a can.  My French Onion soup was fairly tasty, but was only lukewarm underneath the crouton.  We both ordered the Hawaiian burger.  The middles were done nicely, but the outside edges were charred and tough.  They were topped by little bits of pineapple that wanted to fall off.  A whole ring would have been much nicer.  We had to specifically request lettuce, onion and tomato.  Evidently it's not automatically included with most burger choices.  Overall, the burgers were rather dry and tasteless.  The French fries looked appealing, but didn't actually taste good. However, the butterscotch pudding was fabulous!  If this review were only about the pudding, it would easily be 5 stars.  Great butterscotch taste with little flecks of sea salt... I could almost be talked into a return trip just for the pudding.  But probably not.

Have lived here for just a few months and been making our way around to the nearby eateries.  What a find!  Have seen the sign several times but assumed it was just another pizza place. We were quite surprised when we walked in and even more so once we ate. Food was excellent, prices good, fast service and a full bar!  One of the best places we've tried so far in Meridian/Eagle. Will be one a place we visit frequently!
I've had only the Salmon and Steak hibachi. It doesn't taste quite Japanese, but it is good nonetheless. Good service. They hibachi portion size is very substantial for a single person.

We love to go to Texas on Wednesday's because of the Wild West Wednesday deal. It's an 11oz sirloin and two side items for $10.99. With two of us, we typically leave there for under $30 including a decent tip!  

We have pretty much always had great service, but this last time we went later (8pm) on a Friday night and the waitresses were seriously racing to get out.  Our waitress didn't want to chat with us or have a good time because she said she had to go home and finish a final. I understand the struggle of being a student and working- I do it as well- but I don't think the customers should suffer. So I guess my only warning to you is to not go there too late because you might feel pressure to hurry up and leave by your waitresses.

I used Marv's insulation about 2 months ago here in Eagle.  This company is extremely professional and their prices far out weigh their competiions! I had 3 bids done and they were almost half the price of either of the other 2 bids.  If nothing else, you should at least get a bid from them!  Highly recommended!

If they put as much effort into their food as they do into their cleanliness they would be a five star restaurant. So after not having been in in many years my wife said let's try Jaker's. I saw their sign advertising crab fest and went sure. Started off with crab stuffed mushrooms, which were one note boring unoriginal I personally could have done better in my kitchen at home with one hand tired behind my back. It was exactly as the menu described it mushrooms with crab and parmesan and jack cheese, baked no hint of seasoning of any type. My spicy crab and shrimp linguine was made that way with the addition of srirachia no chili flakes or garlic or anything to make it more than a boring one note dish. The service was impeccable which is the sad part. If your going to provide top notch service in a clean and friendly environment at top dollar have food that matches.

What were people thinking? Food was a long wait after we ordered. I ordered the sirloin steak sandwich...dry & chewy.  My husband's dinner was just okay...pork chop & mash potatoes.  If I'm going to pay $25 for a dinner in a bar..then it better be spectacular...this was not.  Sorry.

Chinese food as it's meant to be!!!  Excellent!!!  After two visits, we have finally found a Chinese restaurant with the food quality and preparation experise that has missing in the Treasue Valley.  The service is friendly and the restaurant is simple but spotless!  A must try for those who appreciate wonderful Asian fare.

My all time favorite restaurant in Idaho. I always do the hibachi where they cook in front of you and order some sushi and the food is simply outstanding. Very nice place for a date or to take a group for an occasion. Decent prices too

Went for lunch with a co-worker; had a coupon. Both of us had the bone-in wing basket. Even with a BOGO coupon, it was $15, including 2 sodas. A bit much.

I should mention I went to college in upstate NY, so I believe I know Buffalo Wings, and I have a clear idea about what they should be. I believe they should be deep-fried until crispy...maybe a little on the done side, not breaded, and tossed with a vinegary hot sauce; ideally 50/50 Frank's Red Hot and margarine. They should never be baked.

Wings here were OK. I had "Hot"; my friend had "Wild". Hot was a little tame, and "Wild" had too much of a tomato/chile puree texture (but heat level was OK). They were served with fries, celery, and blue cheese dressing. The wings were also plump...which was good...but not crispy enough. I suspect they were soaked in a salt solution to plump them. So overall, not great wings. OK, not great. Also, our server was a guy...I thought part of the appeal was a hot waitress. Finally, the overall ambience was sports bar/vieo game arcade, with lots of music and flashing lights and screens...I felt a bit overstimulated. I could see a 15-y/o boy loving this place.

What was good: 
-Nothing stood out. Very average.

What needed work:
-If you're gonna be known for wings, you should put out good wings.

I would only recommend it if you were dying for wings, since I don't k now a better place for wings (yet). When I find a go-to wing place, I won't recommend this at all.

i dont know what the other reviewers were smokin but this place rocks. the food was phenomenal and the service was excellent. good salad bar and really good entree salads, fresh ingredients friendly staff. the waiter even saw that i had swiped my husbands lemon and put in in my coke when he brought my refill there was another lemon!
we had the lobster mac n cheese, the evil thai beef salad (actual name) and the advocado and crab salad. everything was superb!
This is a simple place that has great great food!  The employees were very helpful and kind. Great inexpensive place for a date.
Over rated! The bloody Mary is really not special people. The stacked food in the drink is weird and bad. Mediocre atmosphere, felt like a crowded food court.

Ordered lunch from here and really enjoyed it. The California Club Toasted Sandwich was ok - above average but nothing earth shattering. However, the Southwest Chicken Soup was incredible. Extremely tasty! I ordered To Go, and the service was perfect. Very friendly staff.

However, now I check my confirmation email against my receipt and find out that I have been overcharged by almost $5!! I was happy with the food, but not with this - especially when they had my order details and pricing in front of them. You made an extra $5 off me, but you have lost a customer and earned yourself a poor review. It was a 4 star review before, but now I'm going to 1-star. Overcharging is not acceptable!

I don't usually review restaurants however I will make an exception in this case.  This is my second visit to this place and both times I have been monumentally disappointed.  The first time I visited this establishment I ordered the Wisconsin Mac and Cheese bowl.  It was cold...not even lukewarm...cold.  The manager apologized and replaced my order however the replacement was barely above lukewarm so very unimpressive when you know that a hot dish is expected and your personal attention to that one detail fails.  How anyone can serve lukewarm food twice in a row is beyond my comprehension.  Add to this hat the sauce was runny and barely had any cheese flavor.  Certainly a bowl that wasn't living up to its picture on the wall nor its name.  Then my second visit.  Tonight I had the Alfredo MontAmore.  The image and description on the wall sounded delicious.  Unfortunately when it was delivered to our table it was barely lukewarm.  The chicken was thin and dry.  At this point I have decided that this is how they serve their food.  The dish didn't look anything like the image on the wall.  All the ingredients were there but when delivered to our table it looked like a pile of spaghetti.  Everything else was on the bottom including the barely existent watery sauce.  The flavor of the sauce was surprisingly good but there wasn't enough to cover the paste and it was less of a sauce more of a broth.
Worst food I've had in a long time.  Had the Mac and cheese.  Pre cooked macaroni which was cold and dry.  Cheese must have come out of a can. Terrible!

It's pricey, but there are lots of selections. Bowls are small. Most all you can eat mongo is 12$, they are $15 plus drinks.

Pros- service was great, lots of selection, desert

Cons- price, small bowls

If you want gluten free crust, most pizza places fall way short.  Blaze does not.  Their GF crust is excellent.  It's thin and crisp and doesn't taste like sawdust.  

Pizza may be the hardest part of being GF, but Blaze makes it easier.

I also love that they don't nickle and dime you to death by charging extra for toppings.  Get all the toppings you want for the same price!

We tried this place for the first time on Saturday night. We were coming from Mountain Home so we called ahead to make a reservation for our group of 7. We were told at that time they do not take reservations but to call back when we were 20 minutes out to hold a table. What? This seems like a ridiculous practice. Anyway, we called back when we were 20 minutes away and was informed they will not take a check in for a group that size. Okay, now we were just confused? We arrive 20 minutes later and head in only to be told there is an hour long wait. This information would have been appreciated during the two earlier phone calls. We decide to wait since we were there already. Skip ahead an hour later and we get our table. They have a HUGE menu and tons of beer and drink options. Our server was excellent even though the place was slammed. Everything we ordered looked and tasted good. I was the only one not choosing a burger or sandwich of some sort. I opted for the crab cakes. They were I bit overcooked honestly,  but still tasted pretty good. Really, the only negative thing I have to say about this place is you need to be prepared to lay down some cash to eat here. Now I don't have a problem paying a higher price for a nice meal but this place doesn't quite hit the mark for the prices they are charging. The bill for one entree, one appetizer, one side and four beers was $75. A little steep...

Awesome ambiance. Hip and urban with classic Latin/Mexican influences mix together for a truly unique and beautiful setting. Unfortunately, the food didn't live up to the decor's impression. The salsa is actually pretty good. Unexpectedly spicy, which is coming from a spicy-food lover! I ordered the chicken tacos, with rice and black beans. This meal was not flavorful! If you're looking for real (or even just a tasty Americanized version of) Mexican food, don't come here. Plus it's pricey for not the best food!

We came to the area for something else. We decided here looked like a good second choice. (thanks yelp) From now on this would be my first choice. There was not one thing that made this experience anything  less than a 7 star. If you want beer options this is the perfect place. At a glance they had at least 35 on tap. The row of taps is impressive. We will return many times. Don't let the size of this place fool you.

Have given this place a try  a few times and it is not getting better.  Tried giving them the benfit of the doubt for being new in town, but the quality and taste is more than lacking. Pad Thai has no taste and is beyond dry.  Pork is very dry and tastes of nothing beyond the excess black pepper.  Disappointed and frustrated.  Done with this place.  It's the epitome of a "chain restaurant".  Nothing special and they are many other place to eat in town to grab some GREAT noodle dishes.  Also, they employees do not wear hait nets or gloves when preparing food.  I witnessed the gal cooking playting with her hair, then use those same hands to grab up the ingredients to make food for people!  Gross!!!
Food was great and the service was just as great! I definitely recommend the filet. Oh, and the bread pudding is absolutely amazing!
In my opinion: the best wings! Average service , the ranch cups they serve are half full , Sometimes it can be crowded. Just avoid major sporting events . Unless you enjoy the crowds.
Neat little neighborhood bar and grill with pretty good  pub fare. Service has been excellent. It would be easy to frequent this place. If you find yourself in these parts...go here.

Best burgers in Meridian. Literally. Always have great, cheerful service and the burgers are super yummy. A little pricier than you'll see someplaces. The drive-thru IS often pretty slow but that is mostly due to the fact that they don't cook your burger until you actually order, so no complaints...just don't go when you're running on a tight schedule. Always ask for fry sauce!
Double bacon cheese burger was excellent as are the fries. Pricey? Yes but the food is outstanding! Friendly staff. Treat yourself to a shake, you'll be glad you did.
Nice place, waited 20 minutes  for drinks waited another 10 to order. Had to leave for lack of service.

My husband and I have come here twice. We like to sit in the bar, lots of TV & they always have the games on. The beer selection is good & the chips are delish. I tried the guacamole this most recent time and it was DESPERATELY lacking flavor. I had to salt and pepper it like crazy. I was disappointed.

If we find ourselves back out in the area & wanting mexican food, we will probably go to Cafe Ole.
Food is always great at Kahootz.  Be prepared to wait on the weekends as the place is pretty small. Specials are the way to go. Bread pudding is awesome. Service is pretty good most of the time.

This is THE place for steaks in Boise, IMO. Only 4 stars because of the ridiculously long wait times and over crowding. It is also not very infant or toddler friendly as it is noisy and crowded. Aside from that, their buns are to die for. Even the most critical members of my family love them. My to-go item here is the prime rib. Amazingly tender, juicy and just plain delicious.

Being a connoisseur of Reuben's I have to say the second best I have ever had. A little more corned beef would be great. Sauerkraut was slightly sweet but tasty. Family all enjoyed the meal. Baked fries were delicious. Others had the Rachels and thought they were excellent as well. Fourth had the fish tacos and rated a 7.5 out of 10. Service of the food was a little slow but very polite.
Great atmosphere next to fake fountain.....ice tea is better in Buhl....but the food is great!!!

I was driving through town on a Tuesday night and thought to myself, man that town is peaceful and quiet that night.  Stopped in Buffalo Wild Wings in Meridian and found out why it was so quiet.  EVERYONE IN TOWN was at Buffalo Wild Wings for .40 cent wing night!  The energy was amazing!  Idaho is known for having some of the friendliest residents in the country and I guess on Tuesday nights they all gather at this Buffalo Wild Wings to have some fun.  And the cool thing is, they welcome strangers right into the mix!  I travel all the time and go to BWW's whenever I find one because I enjoy the energy they generate and this one tops the list!

Its a must for anyone who is looking for an experience when they spend their money!  Now its probably not the best place if your a foodie as it is bar food.  Great bar food with 14 sauces I must admit since you can put any of their sauces on any of the menu items, but definitely not meant for foodies!  Its good for those folks who want to loosen up, laugh a lot with friends with every sporting event available on like 50 big screens going in the background.  Its great for folks who want to experience Idaho hospitality at its finest.  The staff and the customers are all some of the friendliest folks I've ever had the pleasure of dining out with!

I absolutely love this place.. In the early 2000s I was really young and naive and I got scammed by a very well known company. I told them that I was traveling out of state so the man helping me told me he couldn't legally let me leave unless I "fixed" everything that need fixed. $300 later - I realized I had been had. I have always been very skeptical since because I know I am an easy target but the employees here have never made me feel like they were talking me into anything. They always let me know what is suggested and they let me decide. They have amazing customer service and really seem to enjoy their job. I love that they offer you a newspaper and something to drink and the fact that I can stay in my car is awesome. Best place to get an oil change, period.
Get the pterodactyl wings! And of course their prime rib is amazing. Service is also good.

Just had lunch there - a hot roast beef sandwich with sautéed onions and cheddar cheese, pickle wedge and pepper which came with a choice of bagged chips (many flavors/varieties) and a drink.  SUPER CHOCOLATE PEANUT BUTTER BAR!  Delightful staff and owner.  Pleasant environment.  I'll definitely go back!!
Loved them! They rocked! From their sushi to their service....can't wait to come back again!
Great steak for the value.  Comes with rolls, sides , peanuts.... the Dallas Filet is my favorite . Nice cut , tender . It as good as some steaks I've had in "fancy" restaurants.

I eat here once a week.  Once you start eating their quality organic meat, you just can't go back to eating the corporate garbage.  Main Street Burger has pretty much ruined other burger joints for me.  Oh, well...at least I know their meat is better quality.  I do love their fries as well.  The men and ladies who work there are so very friendly and I have met the owner as well.  He was so kind to me and my son.  Never, have I had a bad experience here.  
I LOVE MAIN STREET!

The staff are good. The ribs aren't really "fall of the bone" like they say, and the music is far too loud. Nothing was bad, per-say, but nothing was great. Mediocrity at its finest, nonetheless. Good wood is cheaper, better ribs which truly have meat that "falls off the bone" and we could hold a conversation without hollering over the tunes. Just mediocre... typical chain restaurant gig. Like McDonald's of the "steak world". Enjoy, if you may.

I LOVE Hobby Lobby. I'm almost embarrassed to think about how often I am in this store, and joke that the employees must recognize me by now!

This is not only a great craft store, but has all kinds of reasonably priced, adorable decor items for your home or office.

The store changes it's sale items weekly, so if you want it and it's not on sale, wait a week or two and it probably will be. They also have a coupon for 40% off a non sale item on their website, just look up on your smart phone and BAM! 

Fabric department is very small, as is their sewing supplies. But that is what JoAnn's is for!  Great scrapbooking department. And always tons of selection for holiday decor.

Never have had trouble returning something. Have never used any of their custom services, so I can't comment on this area.

Only downfalls, they close at 8pm and are closed on Sundays. I totally get it, but am always bummed as Sunday is usually my only free day for crafts and shopping! :)

I'm in this Moxie all the time, mostly because it's close to my house and the baristas are nice, friendly kids.
The brewed coffee is pretty bad, I won't lie.  It lacks body and flavor, often times I get grounds in the bottom of my cup, and about half the time it's lukewarm.  Because they have serve-your-self airpots I think I get hours-old coffee sometimes, and it's not very good.
However, if you complain you can have them freshly brew up a new pot, which is equally insipid.
Still, the atmosphere is nice, the prices are in line with everywhere else--and they have a great happy hour three times a week, although the baristas tend to forget to give you the discount--and they have a large selection of pastries and bottled drinks.  It's a better place to hang out than to actually get good coffee.

WOW! We had originally tried to place our order online- come to find out once we had put everything in that this location is not setup for online orders through the Chili's app. Calling in the order was a ridiculous process, I don't think repeating an order 4x is necessary. Nor is it appropriate for anyone to question their tip when checking out! 

Part of our order was missing when we picked it up, and while the manager was super sweet about it- the kid running the "to-go" section and the girls rolling silverware just to the side of that area were very rude and acting like we were out of line for asking that our order be filled completely. 

Amazingly disappointing..

We came here expecting a wait since its Father's Day and what a pleasant surprise 6 of us were seated right alway. THe service was amazing the food OMG the ribeye was melt in your mouth exactly how it should be. The rolls you could tell we're not frozen and the butter was yummy too.  The side salad was as expected and the ranch obviously homemade. Loaded baked potato was good but would have liked sour cream and maybe green onions but I didn't ask what it came with and was still delish. Refills came often and we weren't ever asking for anything. The peanuts were a fun addition my 5 yr old especially enjoyed.  We will definitely return.

Simple home town burger place. Inside seating, tables outside and drive thru. Several burger choices, standard, bacon, guacamole, 5 Alarm to name a few. Reasonably priced. Fresh cooked to order, came out without having to wait too long. Pleasant counter help made everyone feel welcome. Also have shakes and soft serve ice cream.

This is one of my favorite restaurants.  I have been to a few different Buffalo Wild Wings locations and have never been disappointed.  I love their traditional wings.  And Wing Tuesday makes them that much better. 
The atmosphere is great with all the big screen TVs.  It may be a little loud, but it is not overwhelming.  It is especially awesome on UFC fight nights when the place is packed and everyone is cheering for their favorite fighter.  
I always get great service and great food and beverages here.

the atmosphere is what you pay for here, and i couldn't be more pleased. for the price the food is good, but I love that it feels like a restaurant/pub instead of a fast food/ homeless shelter enviroment

Food was great and Kayla made the experience even better with her great attitude even though I was a pain, contagious smile and sweet self! I will definitely be back to this noodles n company since they took such good care of us!

Excellent service, excellent atmosphere and food was awesome. 
Very busy but no one waited.
The crab cakes with mango, papaya salsa are awesome! The turkey burger is the best I've ever had!

My husband and I have been here twice -- the first time everything was good (service and food); the second time was terrible. We went for an early Father's Day dinner and my husband wanted lobster, and it was their LobsterFest. They ran out, so he ordered a steak and asked for it to be cooked medium. The steak was rare when he got it so he sent it back. Upon return, it was still closer to rare than medium. Our waitress did ask if there was anything else he wanted or if he wanted it returned again. He did decline. I ordered the almond crusted halibut over rice with asparagus, and it was good, but not worth $27. The rice was undercooked and I got 5 small pieces of asparagus. I would also like to add that for a Saturday night they were not that busy, and there were 4 customers (all at different tables) sitting around us that returned their food, 2 of which were lobster. The food and experience was disappointing for as much as we paid - over $100 (food and cocktails). We will not be going back.
Service tonight was terrible.  It way first time here and although the food was great but I won't return.  I think the staff should drink less and provide better service.

VEGANS/VEGETARIANS/ANYONE WHO LOVES A GOOD BURGER: I finished eating the Gardein Vegan Burger here just moments ago, and let me tell you, that shit is amazing. I did not put the burger down once, nor did I say one word while eating it. As I finished this burger I wiped my hands, placed my napkin on the table, and proceeded to tell my group of people that I hadn't dared tell them how delicious it was until every last bite was gone to avoid any chance of them attempting to try the burger. Summary: The vegan burger is amazing and I will be back shortly for another.

Great Wings, excellent Bloody Mary. Just down home good food, burgers, tons of beer, great Mac and cheese. My only complaint is that it is always busy, but that happens with good food. Ample televisions, good kids menu, and generally just a great atmosphere. Highly recommended.

We always love this place. The flavors are intense, the veggies are crisp, the soda machine is da bomb. It's just a yummy experience all around.  I can usually find something pretty "clean" and my hubby loves to load his up with sauce.
Great service, but steak was undercooked. Asked for med-well, got closer to med-rare.

Jakers can be hit or miss depending on what you order.  If you order correctly.... woo hoo!   I've been about 5 times, here are my recommendations:

Mango Lemonade
Tender Steak Bites (I dream about these! So yummy)
Evil Jungle Thai Steak Salad 
Side salads - Iceberg wedge and chopped bleu are SOOOOOOOO good.
Almond-crusted Chicken
Ribeye Steak


Skip the Prime Rib and the Ahi Tuna.  

Show up between 4-6 pm and you can enjoy 1/2 price appetizers.
I left here looking 5 months pregnant. So much delicious food! The menu is huge (almost a little overwhelming) but everything is tasty. Tons of great beers and cocktails.
We had the smores brownie. Huge size. Better to share. House white ale had a Smokey aftertaste. We sat outdoors and enjoyed the rock the village series.
We dined in on Thursday night. The pork chop was spectacular. The bread pudding wss phenomenal.

When I lived in Colorado, Noodles was a go-to for quick, good food. 

Now they're here in Meridian and I couldn't be happier. They got off to a bumpy start but they improved noticeably. This location is typically pretty busy but they move smoothly. If I've ever had an issue they've been more than helpful in rectifying it promptly. Love the Mac & Cheese. 

Fresh, fast, and tasty. We need more restaurants like this.

Terrible service and attitude.  The young people running the front seem to seat people based upon their preference rather than the order people enter the restaurant.  

I just took my wife and kids here this evening and we put our name in.  We were third on the list and admittedly the restaurant was busy.  While we waited I saw several tables be cleaned and sit empty.  While waiting I see a man enter the restaurant, speak to the two young men at the front and immediately be seated, I didn't see him with a flashing pager and I hadn't seen him out his name in.  Meanwhile, another group walks in and is immediately seated as well.  

So I wait.  Finally I approach the counter and ask if perhaps my pager isn't working. They send a test signal and everything seems to work.  So, while I am standing there another person walks in.  They ask if he would want to sit outside as there are no tables available.  Suddenly one greeter says "table 35 is available" and they immediately seat this person at 35.  By now I am pretty mad, and I ask, how does that person get seated in a booth by himself that seats 4 while we wait?  Does he own the restaurant, is he someone's friend or a vip?  They look at me with a puzzled look as if I am crazy.  So, I toss them their pager and leave.  

It sucks because my family loves this place.  Now I feel like I can't go back.  Sad really,  and to the young man I tossed the pager to, I apologize for losing my cool.  I may have been better served by waiting longer, wish I had just asked for a manager... Oh well

When I first walked in I was greeted by a male host. I was looking at the screens in the bar and seeing if they had the pre season football game on. I asked him if he knew hat time it was on and he said no because he doesn't like football. He thinks it's boring. 

When then were seated in a corner both. The seats had crumbs all over it. I brushed it of and the host asked me if there was was food the seat and I told him yes. He was sorry there was food. 

We were then gr by Madison. She was very nice. We ordered our food. Food came in about 15. The portions sizes I felt just right. Taste and quality of food was good. However I rate this a 3 star based on the intial service and cleanliness.

Best pizza deal in town. All the toppings you want, and a good selection, for $7.99. Get there before they wise up and raise their prices. Beer selection could be a little broader. Overall, a great find.

I always enjoy this Buffalo Wild Wings location, and I've never had an issue with service, food or the beer. It offers great atmosphere and they'll show pretty much any sporting events that's on, with the many TV screens they have. Cool outdoor area, the staff are always very friendly, and the price isn't too bad either. It can get pretty busy sometimes, but that's to be expected.

This place is a beer lover's paradise. There's about 30 beers on tap. It's a pretty small place and looking at it from the out side it appears to be another low budget bar. You would never guess that the food is actually amazing. 

The crew that servers lunch on week days is not the same crew that cooks at night. At least that what it seems like to me. I mistakenly took some out of towners to Kahootz for lunch expecting the same incredible food. They were not impressed.

oh man.  i have to prepare myself when i go to tr.  we had a big group but was able to be seated right away.  next time i have to remind myself to order the kids meal.  the serviings are super big and delish.  love the bread.  lots of parking.  service was next to none.  will be back.

The ambience is very quite but very welcoming. Very kind and attentive to our table at all times. The food was cooked to perfect. The color, smell, taste, and plating was on point. We will definitely be back for the great food and exceptional service. The Kung Pao Chicken was delicious, a little too much mushroom for my liking, but overall combination of vegetables was great. The fried rice was beautiful and delicious. The egg roll was pork and could be a struggle for those who don't like pork. For myself it was great, but my spouse wasn't a huge fan. Haha. The Beef Egg Foo Young was eaten by my mother and she reported the dish was exceptional and delicious. Excellente! Overall, 5 stars was given due to great food and exceptional services. We'll definitely be back! 

Side note: There were only two tables including ourselves as one table during the time we had dinner at 5PM. Bathroom was very clean. Parking can be an issue if the restaurant is full. Restaurant is kept at a very good temperature (were from Texas though).

Casa Del Matador is a decent suburban Mexican restaurant in the upscale Meridian neighborhood west of Boise. Their restaurant is part of the fancy shopping and entertainment center. Parking is abundant, but you may have to walk a bit during peak periods. 

The menu is classic gringo Mexican with lots of traditional options. Most of the menu has a lot of big meat and cheese options popular with the area, but I focused on the street tacos. The chips and salsa were fresh and tasty. My tacos were decent, but I was surprised they were not served with rice and beans like my fellow diners. Their dishes were a bit light on the meat too.

We were lucky to get a booth with kids on a Saturday night as a walk in. Staff was helpful with the kids and their picky needs. I really liked the interior with lots of metal work and nice touches. The food was just ok, but it's good for the area. Nice for date night, but I would find a taco truck for more authentic food.

Fantastic!!!  Wonderful wait staff, casual atmosphere. We enjoyed the ribeye special Tuesday and came back Saturday for the Prime rib special. Both were perfectly prepared; including the potatoes and asparagus. The bread pudding is out of this world!  This will be our go to restaurant when visiting Boise area

This was my first time here to buy a suit. I ordered one to be shipped in. As sometimes happens, something got mixed up and my order was cancelled.  When the assistant mgr. Juliet LeClaire  heard about it she called me to make it right.  I went in at 5:00 pm by 6:30 I had my new suit. The tailor came in after hours and made the needed alterations that were needed.  Thanks to all the staff, and especially  Juliet for going far above what was expected. I will definitely be back.

Where did the quality go?   Drinks (iced tea and margarita) served in plastic cups, no plates for the appetizer...somewhat disappointing.  Food was ok. 

Waitress never asked how I wanted my steak cooked with the fajita so they cooked it well done.  It was like jerky.
What a wonderful find for us! The food was delicious, & the service was exceptional...Best thousand island dressing in town!

My experience with these guys was pretty good. At first I used a different company to come out to repair and hook up my home theater system but they were not successful. The Wire Guys are very skilled in what they do and their charge didn't seem excessive.

very impressed .. nice selection .. very diverse menu .. something for everyone .. we were are party of 7 .. felt comfortable .. lots of space .. excellant service .. great speed of service .. big portions .. would most definitely return .. mahalo!

This place is great. Food is delicious and everything was cooked properly, service was great as well. I've never been here and the waitress asked if we've experienced Texas Roadhouse before and we told her no, and she put a little flag in our peanut bucket. Not knowing what  that meant, we went on eating our appetizers and right when we got our entree , Dave (not sure if he was the manager or owner :x) , came to us and welcomed us to the restaurant and asked if we enjoyed the food so far. That was very kind of him. I really do enjoy the food and service at Texas Roadhouse, gotta come back for more!

We love Dr. Kelson and all of the staff. They are very personable and have taken very good care of my daughter throughout her time in braces. We highly recommend Dr. Kelson to anyone looking to get braces.

Service was quick and friendly.  Spaghetti was tasty. Salad was alright but the dressing made up for the iceberg lettuce.  I enjoyed the slightly spicy sausage and the beef meatball was amazing.  We got a ton of food in the family 4 pack,  enough for two meals. We'll definitely go back again sometime.

Hands down, the best in the Valley!  Wok Fusion has a quality to their dishes that I have not experienced in the area before.  The restaurant was clean and the service was over the top.  Family owned and operated and it shows by the way you are treated.
Nice atmosphere. Come for happy hour. Crab cakes are absolutely my favorite. Citrus crush a delicious drink. Great selection of on tap beers.

Been here twice in the past few months and it was consistently a great meal both times. The name of the restaurant is exactly what they do best: excellent steak and great beer. Quality of the beef. Expertise of butchering and preparation all came together for an outstanding steak at a reasonable price. This is not a fancy restaurant. Here you wash your steak down with one of their many craft beers versus a red wine!

Food was amazing!! Service was amazing! We loved our server Andrew! I never yelp but had to about this place! And their chips and salsa are to die for. Made in house!! Will be back for sure next time I'm in Idaho!!!!!

As an owner looking to remove the burden of managing tenants affordably and without delays TPD masters the profession.  Owner/Property manager terms are better than any others I have seen in the Treasure Valley.  The contract terms are clear and not left for interpretation.  Maintenance work is communicated.  The staff at TPD has clear and effective communication regarding the work that is performed and expenses associated with the work.  I have never had to question any work orders that were performed on my property.  During the transition to TPD the staff was friendly and patient in answering all of my questions. They are knowledgable and have successfully relieved the burden of having to manage tenants in a property.  I would recommend any owner to TPD for property management.

The doughnuts are great but the doors lock early. Got there 3 minutes before closing and doors were locked yes locked. Lucky there were customers inside to let me in. The employee said we lock the doors at 10:00, I  tried to tell the guy I was there outside and the doors were locked early. At 10:02 my transaction was rung up. Maybe your managers need to tell time. Won't be back there any more!

I took my Honda in this morning for an oil change service. The staff members were all very friendly and ready to assist me.  Saul assisted me throughout my visit and he was very polite and informative regarding the services that are offered here. I was able to sit in my car with my 2 year old son which couldn't have been more perfect. We were kindly greeted the moment we approached the building and were offered water, coffee and hot chocolate, a newspaper or a kindle! Saul even gave my son a lollipop which made him very happy! The oil change and inspection did not take long at all. Everyone was so polite and efficient on getting my car in and out! I will definitely be returning here! Thanks for all of your help!

Nice friendly greeting 
Great beer and liquor selection 
Nice atmosphere 
Amazing food

Great atmosphere, great food. Drinks I'm sure are good, but I'm not a fan of the Long Island. But that's personal choice. It sure packs a punch though. Delicious beautiful food without the hoity toity atmosphere. Definitely go here.
Sushi was not fresh, used too much mayo sauce on all the rolls making each roll taste the same.  I will not each here again.
I kind of like Kahootz. I went there because my mother was raving about it. The food here is awesome, but there is not much variety on the drink menu.
Their Asian dishes are very dey and bland compared to how good their photos look. But their pastas are delicious.

This place is always my number one choice when I am going out to eat. Sometimes the wait can get pretty long, but they provide call ahead seating and the food is worth it!! The food always comes out in a timely manner and tastes delicious EVERY time! Steaks are cooked to the temperature the guest asked for and the rolls never disappoint, I mean, cinnamon butter?!  The staff is ways fast and efficient and nice and a manager always stops by the table to see how everything is. By far the BEST place to have dinner!

Wanted to try a new burger spot besides your typical five guys or smash burger when I came across Main Street burger and might I say I'm already wowed with the customer service and I haven't even tasted my burger yet.
Seth recommended his favorite burger which was the western burger. My hubby got that and I got a regular bacon cheese burger.
The prices aren't too shabby we normally spend $20 together anyway.
Fast forward to this burger though, nothing short of amazing I thought so...
P.s there is about a 10 min wait because your burger is made FRESH. If you wanna zip thru and can't wait for a burger head to McDonald's ... their burgers don't age ;)
I recommend coming here you don't regret it

The upside:
As far as choices go this place is a step above most other Mongolian grills.  More options than you could use in two or three trips. Tons of vegetable choices, a dozen or so types of meat.  White, brown or fried rice on the side.  You can even get your dish made into a wrap or served with tortillas. I received friendly, timely service and the restaurant was clean and relatively quiet.
The downside:
Not that I care, but no alcohol.
The only non meat substitute is plain firm tofu, not fried which is better in stir fry.
Options are; soup and salad, or stirfry, soup and salad. Basically I had to pay for soup and salad I didn't want and my wife filled up on salad and barely ate any stirfry.
But the biggest negative as far as I'm concerned is that since you can make multiple trips they don't allow any take home.  One of my favorite things at a mongolian restaurant is getting an extra big bowl and taking half of it home as left-overs.
Best burger joint in the treasure valley! Always efficient and delicious. High quality food for a good price.  one of my families favorite places.

Service was terrible today I waited to get seated and they passed the people that got there before us. When I said something they gave us a table but still no server ever came to us and offered us our drinks servers just passed by us and ignored us so I had to leave

Been here a few times now since they opened. Was hoping to find a good neighborhood place to go and support. Unfortunately this is not the place for me. Final straw was about a month ago. I had finger steaks which is a new item on the menu and they were horrible. The batter was falling off the meat and the meat was burned because there was nothing protecting it from the oil. In addition they were very greasy . I can't even believe that the cook or the bartender brought them to the table. I sent them back but kept the fries.  When I got the check they had deducted 50%. Apparently because i kept the fries.  SERIOUSLY?  When I said I wasn't going to pay for them the bartender finally took them off. Really no apology and no real effort to make me happy as a customer. Won't be back.
One of the best Burgers that I have had in Boise. Would probably make my "National Top 10". The onion rings were just typical, nothing extraordinary. The staff was very friendly and efficient.

Solid food and great service, peanuts shells all over the ground but that's normal. Only down side is its often packed so it takes a little time to get seated, but they do their best to get you seated as soon as possible. And I mean the rolls, who can resist the rolls. Great place to eat.
Always a fabulous sandwich. Everything in the menu is a winner! And...they're extra friendly to boot.
One of the best burgers in town.  They do have the best fries in town!!!

My husband & I love this place great food (huge selection & portions)  lots of seating for large parties. Everything is well priced and the beer selection is HUGE. We have had a great time every time we come in... defenatly on our list if favorites.

The service is always great; time, attitudes, quality.  Plus, there are always families around so we can be ourselves, even on Friday and Saturday nights.  The food is outstanding, my wife craves the chips and salsa and blackberry ice tea, and she is not even pregnant.  The staff is always willing to do what we need, even last week when my wife wanted to switch tables after we got our food (not quite enough space for all the fajitas).

I love going to this place. It's a cozy place to go for the winter, and a relaxing place for the summer. Lots of beer on tap paired with good food equals a pleasant experience. Most of the beers on tap are micros, with many of them local and regional. The beer is reasonably priced also. 

I had a New York steak, which was above average. Nothing fancy was on the plate. My wife got the Alfredo, and it blew us away. It was the best Alfredo I have ever had. It had a good blend of garlic, lemon, and a little cheese. 

I look forward to going here again.

Good breakfast and service. The menu is to long/much and small print. The place is clean and nice. I would definitely try it out again beings this was our first time there and that they are brand new. I want to go back when they've been here and been established for a little bit longer

Awesome local restaurant. No fryers here, all of their food is cooked the real way (fries are baked). They have an extensive beer list and a good selection of wine but the downside is no full bar (however in Feb. '12 the server told us they were working on getting their liquor license to here's to hoping soon!) They have great specials, steaks are always priced right and delicious. My favorite dessert here is the creme brulee but I've also seen a flaming bread pudding dish that looks to die for (but not gluten free so I'll just look). Get here early as there are only a handful of tables and no reservations.

I was so excited when this opened at The Village, I love the location downtown and this is much closer. But...

The first time I went to this location it was just ok. My husband and I stopped in for a very late lunch while holiday shopping. We shared "Happy Hour" appetizers and drinks. The restaurant was slow this day and we had very average service. 

Fast forward to the following weekend when I was out shopping with a friend. We stopped in for "Happy Hour" and it was not a happy hour. We intended to have a quick bite and a drink and continue shopping - the visit took us close to two hours. We came in a day it was pouring rain after a long walk from a busy parking lot. We were not greeted with a smile or hello. It took us forever to see our waiter who brought water. Quite a while later we got chips and my friend ordered a cocktail. Then we waited and waited and I timed it to be at least 15 minutes and was about to leave when her drink order showed up. Then the waiter had to come back to take order - again a lengthy wait. Finally got our food. My friend's order was wrong but a minor issue. I took a bite of my taco and it was cold. Not: not hot, or room temperature but somehow colder than that. If that wasn't bad enough there was a hair in my pork al pastor. I put the taco down and waited and waited for the waiter to come check on us. My friend kept eating. By the time the waiter came back she was done and I was hungry. He did apologize and sent a manager over. She did offer to place a new order for me but with the wait it wasn't worth it to wait for food and service and make my friend wait while I ate. After yet another lengthy wait for our checks we received them and they were not correct. 

I went home hungry. I was too frustrated to finish shopping and I needed to make something to eat. I get that people have bad days and things happen but everything that could go wrong here did. I won't be going back to this location and don't get downtown enough to eat at the other location.

I have not eaten here in a long time. The only reason I did was because it was via gift card. We ordered online and were told that our takeout would be ready at 4:30. I got there just after 4:30 and waited 5 min for anyone to greet me. While waiting I had a good view of the kitchen. There was a woman working in the cooking station and another female was cooking. They were all over each other. It was disgusting to thing that these two people who are in charge of making the food kept hanging all over each other. Holding hands and getting way too close in that kind of environment. I do not care what you do at home but that was NOT THE PLACE FOR IT! I will never go there again. I finally got help when a guy and a girl came out from the back and asked if I had been helped. I can not give Zero stars and I am forced to give it one star.

Not as clean as I'd like. (no liners in the jetted tubs and it's my understanding the tubing can carry the bacteria and spread fungus)

The lady doing my nails soaked my finger in acetone for nearly an hour while doing my pedi and then still resorted to completely grinding my nails (cutting 3 of my fingers around the cuticle and grinding layers of my natural nail bed). My nails looked more battered coming out. 

I wouldn't recommend.

This place was such a great find! Huge selection of beers on tap, good selection of wines, amazing steaks and seafood. They have a weekly special menu that changes each week. I've never been disappointed. My only complaint would be that I'm so full after dinner that I never have room for dessert and their bread pudding looks and smells amazing!! I'd consider going there just to try that!
Service is wonderful.
It is a small restaurant that fills up quickly. They have a nice patio outside that I'd like to try for happy hour sometime. Traffic is bad in that area right now with lots of road construction, but it doesn't seem to be hurting business at all.

My wife and I sauntered over to Kahootz to try something new and we were impressed by what we found; a small, neighborhood pub with a great beer selection and food to match.

Kahootz is a very cozy feeling place with the decor and ambiance you would expect from a pub/steak house. The staff was excellent and our glasses were always full. Actually, the staff was much more professional than I expected and we were pleasantly surprised by our waiter. 

As far as beer selection, it's great. My two favorites (Pike St. Kilt Lifter and Mac and Jack's African Amber) were both on tap and it looked like they were accompanied by twenty or so other brews. In terms of food, the usual steak, burgers, and chicken selections were there. I ordered a reuben and fries and my wife had a steak sandwich. We were both very pleased by our meals. 

Gripes? I don't have any. Good food. Good beer. Good price. Great service. Give these guys your money, they deserve it.

Angela was wonderful with Abby. Abby was nervous but Angela was very gentle and calm with her. Abby is fussy about her nails getting trimmed, but she was patient with Abby and got them trimmed. Her coat/grooming looks great and will defiantly be using Clean Pup again!

Great meal! So many choices to choose from too! But our server Kara was wonderful and all smiles! I came with my husband, son, long time friend, grandmother and my two year old. Everyone absolutely enjoyed themselves. We got to sit outside and enjoy the warm September air while still being able to enjoy Monday night football. And happy hour was all night! We've decided to make this a monthly trip :)
Its a hit and miss.  Sometimes the visits are great and other times the service is lacking and the quality is subpar.

Very slow service every time I've gone. I've tried it a few times because it's near where I live. Food is pretty good. Burgers are huge though, hard to get a realistic serving. Turkey on sandwiches is dry. Also, I've found hair in my food on more than one occasion! Multiple times in the same visit! Very difficult to get refills on sodas, staff doesn't pay attention to when your beverage is low and/or gone. The one thing they have going for them is the French fries- they are excellent.
Ordered drive thru, they forgot 2 items. Went inside and gentleman at the counter thought this was funny and laughed. I immediately asked for a refund and left.

Went on a Monday evening so it was slow. I guess slow enough that they thought it was ok to dust light fixtures while people were dining. That was the first turn off. Who wants dust falling into their food or even stirred in the air to breathe?
